introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: Lisa reviews the sales data and secretly planned business improvements with Freda
introduced.quote: Lisa: I was just looking at the sales data, and it seems like you two have quite the talent for business. The potions seem to be flying off the shelves!

introduced.name: Freda
introduced.how: Freda designed the efficiency plan with Lisa and can explain the upgrades in detail
introduced.quote: Lisa: I'll let her give you the details, though. Why don't you go and find her?

introduced.name: Business efficiency upgrades
introduced.how: Three areas of the business can be upgraded for efficiency: brewing, cultivation, and sales
introduced.quote: Freda: Currently, there are three areas you can improve — brewing, cultivation, and sales.

introduced.name: Shop venue
introduced.how: The shop is the venue where the business runs and customers are served
introduced.quote: (Approach the shop venue)

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Lisa: Taking a break, cuties?

assumed.name: Freda
assumed.quote: Freda: ! Paimon! Hello! Is there something I can help you with?

assumed.name: The business and its reputation
assumed.quote: Traveler: We've made quite the name for ourselves.

threads.claim: Lisa has been quietly working on the business behind the scenes, hinting at a hidden side to her character.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, so you've been doing things behind the scenes this whole time!

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: A Melusine painter who introduces herself and lives in a quiet house near the village
introduced.quote: Mamere. My name is Mamere. I was painting here, but...

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: The underground home of the Melusines, reached by swimming down from the cliffs
introduced.quote: Hmm? Ah, right. It's our home — we call it

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: A talking mechanical dog who is Mamere's best friend and critiques her paintings
introduced.quote: Mamere: Yes! Paimon, , this is Seymour — he's family!

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a traveling art collector who wants Mamere's paintings
introduced.quote: Jakob: Me? You can call me Jakob. I am a... traveling collector of art.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: Underwater people who live in Merusea Village and paint, with short hands and a taste for shiny components
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ooh, so Melusines can paint too?

introduced.name: Maison Lumitoile
introduced.how: A Fontaine law-enforcement group whose uniform the Traveler claims, named in honor of a founder who lit the seas
introduced.quote: Traveler: Hmph. I'll have you know that this *is* the uniform of the Maison Lumitoile!

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Hired mercenaries who came to take Mamere's paintings in exchange for Mora for their employer
introduced.quote: Irus: Hey, Kaykubad! What are you doing just watching over there? Just toss her the boss's Mora — then let's take the paintings and go!

introduced.name: Gardemek
introduced.how: A mechanical meka, presented as a new-model prototype used by the law enforcers
introduced.quote: Traveler: Take this new-model Gardemek, for instance.

introduced.name: Prisms
introduced.how: Crystals used to resonate with hard ore so it opens up and can be mined
introduced.quote: Mamere: Um... If you try to gather it directly, you won't be able to dig anything out... You have to use the prisms first...

introduced.name: Shortcut whirlpools
introduced.how: Red whirlpool-like portals that Melusines use as shortcuts through the waters
introduced.quote: Mamere: It's a shortcut. Haven't you seen one before? There should've been many of them along the way...

introduced.name: Components
introduced.how: Shiny scrap mechanical parts that Melusines trade as tokens of gratitude, a currency-like good
introduced.quote: Mamere: When we help each other out, we give the other components as tokens of gratitude.

introduced.name: Paint from ore
introduced.how: Paints are ground from ores, and impure ore gives dirty colors so purer ore must be mixed in
introduced.quote: Mamere: These ores contain a lot of impurities. If we were to make them into paint like this, the colors won't be even — they'll look dirty.

introduced.name: Father
introduced.how: Mamere's father, heard only as a voice; he knows many machines and shortcuts and is her source of knowledge
introduced.quote: Mamere: Father, of course.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Traveler: That's enough. This is Fontaine.

assumed.name: Chi
assumed.quote: Paimon: (Wait, like the chi?)

assumed.name: General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Traveler: Don't you know the face of Fontaine's General Mahamatra?

assumed.name: Pumpkin Protocol
assumed.quote: Paimon: According to... the Pumpkin Protocol, those who take advantage of others must not be let off lightly...

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Paimon: You'd think that a new invention from the Fontaine Research Institute would...

assumed.name: Alain Guillotin
assumed.quote: Jakob: Alain's "own little invention." You've been slumbering for years, haven't you?

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Traveler: I do recall us helping Albedo gather Starsilver back then...

assumed.name: Starsilver
assumed.quote: Traveler: I do recall us helping Albedo gather Starsilver back then...

assumed.name: The Snowy Past
assumed.quote: (If the player completed The Snowy Past)

threads.claim: Jakob's real reason for wanting the raw paint materials is still unknown and he deflects the question.
threads.quote: Jakob: Let me ask you this instead: what else do you think these paints can be used for?

threads.claim: The mysterious boss who hired the Eremites is revealed to be Jakob, who changes the commission.
threads.quote: Jakob: Get rid of these people. As for your pay... Will seven times the original amount do?

threads.claim: Seymour is a relic from an earlier era whose origin and purpose remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Jakob: Well, now. I didn't expect to see a relic from those days ever again...

threads.claim: Seymour may be an invention of Alain Guillotin that has been dormant for years.
threads.quote: Jakob: Alain's "own little invention." You've been slumbering for years, haven't you?

threads.claim: Seymour may have been sent flying from an explosive accident at the Fontaine Research Institute, which the players question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Waaait a minute... Did the explosive accident at the Institute back then send Seymour flying all the way here?

threads.claim: Seymour speaks only to Mamere and is unresponsive to others, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: Mamere: Sorry about that. For some reason, Seymour only talks to me.

threads.claim: Mamere hears and talks with a Father whose voice others cannot hear, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Mamere: Father, of course.

threads.claim: The Traveler repeatedly hears sounds and feels dizzy near the red ores and portals, hinting at something unseen.
threads.quote: Traveler: I hear something.

threads.claim: Red ores might contain toxins that affect people's minds, a possible cause of the Traveler's dizziness.
threads.quote: Paimon: Could this have something to do with the red ores? Some ores do contain toxins that can affect people's minds...

threads.claim: Mamere's paintings depict hidden subjects, and the Traveler is able to read them where others cannot.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...A drowned throne.

threads.claim: The Maison Lumitoile founding legend was improvised as a bluff, so its true origin is still open.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, we were just trying to fool them! made that one up on the fly...

introduced.name: Gaming
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a guard for the Secure Transport Agency and a friend of Aunty Xianyun
introduced.quote: Me? My name is Gaming. I work as a guard for the Secure Transport Agency.

introduced.name: Xianyun
introduced.how: Revealed as an illuminated adeptus, Cloud Retainer, who runs the kite workshop and is called Aunty
introduced.quote: Traveler: Aunty is no way to address a mighty and illuminated Adeptus.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Introduces herself as one of Xianyun's disciples, who is often tired from overtime
introduced.quote: My name is Ganyu. This is Shenhe, and this is Yaoyao.

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: Xianyun's disciple who has never made or flown a kite before and is eager to learn
introduced.quote: Shenhe: I have neither made nor flown a kite before. As long as Master is willing to teach, I am willing to learn.

introduced.name: Yaoyao
introduced.how: Xianyun's young disciple who is building a kite with her friend Qiqi in mind
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: Ganyu, Ganyu! C'mon, wake up! Some friends have arrived!

introduced.name: Shuyu
introduced.how: Xianyun's young disciple who fetches the food and calls Xianyun Master
introduced.quote: Shuyu: Master stopped to buy Grilled Tiger Fish to share with everyone — come get it while it's still warm.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: One of the two kite culprits, who is revealed to be an old friend of Xianyun's
introduced.quote: Paimon: Moon Carver? Mountain Shaper? What are you doing here?

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: The second kite culprit, who was flying the mechanical kite near Mt. Aocang with Moon Carver
introduced.quote: Paimon: Moon Carver? Mountain Shaper? What are you doing here?

introduced.name: Menogias
introduced.how: A past clothing designer whose talent and stubbornness Xianyun describes
introduced.quote: Xianyun: He possessed a singular talent for clothing design.

introduced.name: Bonanus
introduced.how: An adeptus who once secretly complained that a skirt Menogias made was too long for battle
introduced.quote: Xianyun: At a gathering of adepti, Bonanus once complained in secret to some of the ladies in attendance

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: A large commerce organization far bigger than a small tea merchant like Gaming's father
introduced.quote: Gaming: My dad is just an ordinary tea merchant. Small-scale stuff, you know? It wouldn't even make sense to mention his business in the same breath as the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

introduced.name: Wushou dancing
introduced.how: Gaming's dream profession, which his father dismisses as a child's pipe-dream
introduced.quote: Gaming: Of course I have! I told him I wanted to be a Wushou dancer — that I wanted all of Teyvat to see what I could do!

introduced.name: luminescent dyes
introduced.how: Dyes that work on cloth but are harder to apply to paper for kites, so Gaming must reformulate them
introduced.quote: Gaming: It's one thing to use it on cloth. But applying it to paper is another matter entirely.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite
introduced.how: A festival that Xianyun says should be a day of family reunion and of addressing problems
introduced.quote: Xianyun: One means to say that Lantern Rite should be a day of reunion.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: When it came to topics relating to garments and accessories, not even Rex Lapis could best his stubbornness.

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Ganyu: Gaming... The name sounds familiar. I believe I've heard your name mentioned around the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

assumed.name: Supreme Cuisine Machine
assumed.quote: Paimon: Seems like your Supreme Cuisine Machine is just getting better and better, Xianyun!

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: Well, Qiqi's been super busy helping Dr. Baizhu lately... I'll meet up with her later and give her a huge surprise!

assumed.name: Dr. Baizhu
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: Well, Qiqi's been super busy helping Dr. Baizhu lately... I'll meet up with her later and give her a huge surprise!

assumed.name: Yuegui
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: You gave him to me, and he's just the best!

assumed.name: Moonchase Festival
assumed.quote: Houzhang: (We can hardly avoid her forever. That may suffice during Lantern Rite, but what about the Moonchase Festival? Sooner or later, she will discover our true identity.)

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Gaming: But... I'm sure you both already know how that's going. Wushou dancing's just not that big in Liyue Harbor.

threads.claim: Gaming ran away from home after a fight with his tea-merchant father over his career, and has not returned since.
threads.quote: Gaming: My dad... *sigh* He always wanted me to inherit the family business, to be a merchant like him.

threads.claim: Gaming's dream of becoming a Wushou dancer is central to his character and conflict with his father.
threads.quote: Gaming: Of course I have! I told him I wanted to be a Wushou dancer — that I wanted all of Teyvat to see what I could do!

threads.claim: The kite and its tether hint at a theme of freedom versus being bound, which Gaming seems to feel personally.
threads.quote: Traveler: (The butterfly symbolizes the desire for freedom. Perhaps that's also what Gaming's searching for.)

threads.claim: The mechanical kite may be connected to the Jade Chamber, a link left unexplained.
threads.quote: Ganyu: Is that... the Jade Chamber?

threads.claim: The kite is described as a Fontainian device of mechanical motion, hinting at Fontaine technology in Liyue.
threads.quote: Houzhang: Hmm. This Fontainian device of mechanical motion is quite curious indeed...

threads.claim: Xianyun has long seen through the disguises of Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper, who fear being identified as her old friends.
threads.quote: Xianyun: It is of no consequence. Long has one seen through their disguises.

threads.claim: Xianyun resolves to help Gaming and his father resolve their conflict before Lantern Rite, with her plan still unrevealed.
threads.quote: Xianyun: It is a time to address problems before they turn into regrets.

threads.claim: Xianyun holds that suffering and misfortune strike people without design or reason, a worldview the story may return to.
threads.quote: Xianyun: Fate is fickle. The cruel reality of this world is that suffering and misfortune can befall any of us without design or reason.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: Sends the commission letter and hosts the Traveler's meeting with Nefer
introduced.quote: Paimon: We just got a letter from the Curatorium of Secrets. Nefer must need our help with something. C'mon, let's open it.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Head of the Curatorium who offers the paid commission for the expo
introduced.quote: Nefer: Ah, you got here even earlier than I expected. That should give us just enough time to go over some details before the opening ceremony.

introduced.name: Nasha Town
introduced.how: Began as a black market that grew into a settled town
introduced.quote: Nefer: Over time, more and more people settled here, and what was once a black market became what is now Nasha Town.

introduced.name: Voynich Guild
introduced.how: Organizes the Nod-Krai Trade Expo and takes a cut of deals
introduced.quote: Nefer: Yes. The Voynich Guild is organizing the event, and that comes with a lot of responsibilities.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: Guild staffer handling expo setup and overwhelmed by the workload
introduced.quote: Nefer: Normally, I would let Jahoda handle most of the work. But this year, it might prove too much for her to manage on her own.

introduced.name: participant coordination
introduced.how: Duties include registering participants, verifying goods, placing booths, and mediating disputes
introduced.quote: Jahoda: It's things like... registering all the participants, verifying their goods, showing them to their booths...

introduced.name: no-violence rule
introduced.how: The unspoken rule that violence is banned at the expo, guaranteed by the Guild
introduced.quote: Nefer: No violence at the expo. The Guild has pledged to ensure the safety of all sellers and buyers in attendance.

introduced.name: Ashvapati
introduced.how: Guild member known for being uninterested in profit, guardian of the children
introduced.quote: Jahoda: Ah, right! Ashvapati! The one man in the Guild who wouldn't know profit if it hit him in the face.

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: Aino's companion who uses a sensor module and keeps the Craftshop's budgets
introduced.quote: Ineffa: Although this location is indeed rather secluded, Aino has equipped me with a special sensor module.

introduced.name: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
introduced.how: Workshop that takes orders for dangerous creations and is short on funds
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: The Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop does take on a lot of orders for dangerous creations, but I think in this case...

introduced.name: Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots
introduced.how: Anti-pest defense bots Aino upgraded for the expo
introduced.quote: Ineffa: Upon further testing, these bots turned out to be highly effective, so she decided to perform some upgrades and bring them to the expo.

introduced.name: Yelan
introduced.how: Liyue investigator, identified by Nefer as an official from Liyue
introduced.quote: Nefer: Ah, Miss Yelan from Liyue and Miss Chevreuse from Fontaine. It's quite the honor. Forgive me for not greeting you sooner.

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: Fontaine detective pursuing arms dealers, working with Patrol members
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: As a detective, I know that I'll need to put the rules aside for now if I want to get things done here.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: Infamous merc captain of the high seas who sells weapons at the expo
introduced.quote: Paimon: Beidou! The infamous merc captain who sails the high seas!

introduced.name: The Alcor
introduced.how: Beidou's ship, the second in her fleet, currently patrolling Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.quote: Beidou: Actually, this is the second ship in our fleet. The Alcor's back home, patrolling Guyun Stone Forest.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: Representative of the Spina di Rosula and nicknamed the top dog of the criminal underworld
introduced.quote: Navia: You got that right. Representing the Spina di Rosula, of course.

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: Champion Duelist serving as Navia's bodyguard
introduced.quote: Navia: Fair enough. Guess you can mark down our Champion Duelist here as my... bodyguard.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Fontaine organization of great importance whose president is protected by Clorinde
introduced.quote: Clorinde: Nod-Krai is a chaotic and dangerous place. Considering the Spina's importance to Fontaine, the last thing we need is for something to happen to its president.

introduced.name: Guizhong Ballista
introduced.how: Revamped long-range weapon with remote guidance and heavy firepower
introduced.quote: Beidou: A while ago, Ningguang revamped the Guizhong Ballista. The beauty you see here is one of her new and improved models.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Fontaine body that made a new pneuma and ousia relay weapon and sold it through the Spina
introduced.quote: Yelan: The Fontaine Research Institute made the right call going through the Spina di Rosula rather than selling it themselves.

introduced.name: pneuma and ousia energy
introduced.how: Energies used in battle by a new device that could arm bandits
introduced.quote: Yelan: A device that uses pneuma and ousia energies in battle... With that kind of tech, a bandit group could rob a caravan without even showing their faces.

assumed.name: Ashru
assumed.quote: (Faced away from the Traveler and Paimon, Nefer is seated on a couch while petting Ashru beside her)

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: It's been a while, great hero of Teyvat.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Beidou: A while ago, Ningguang revamped the Guizhong Ballista. The beauty you see here is one of her new and improved models.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Beidou: Haha, don't worry. Compared to the model the Millelith's using, this one might as well be an antique.

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: The same is true for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, I'm sure.

assumed.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: And, on that note, I should get to work. I've got Patrol members waiting on me.

threads.claim: Nod-Krai's legal black market has no restrictions, which invites illicit trade to hide in plain sight.
threads.quote: Nefer: In principle, the Nod-Krai Trade Expo is a platform for commerce with no restrictions. That said, the Guild does have one line that is not to be crossed.

threads.claim: Someone is secretly supplying gangs and bandits with powerful weapons, and the supply network is run by international arms dealers.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: Our investigation indicates that someone has been supplying the gangs with some unusually powerful weaponry.

threads.claim: Yelan and Chevreuse are separately hunting the same arms dealer, who is believed to be attending the expo.
threads.quote: Yelan: Miss Chevreuse and I seem to be here in Nod-Krai to reel in the same fish.

threads.claim: Nefer may have anticipated the rival investigators and engineered the meeting in advance.
threads.quote: Yelan: Heh... I wouldn't be surprised if she got involved because she anticipated this from the start.

threads.claim: Nefer has an agenda behind the commission and wants the real story of events, hinting that she is hiding something.
threads.quote: Nefer: In that case, do me one more favor, would you? When this is all over, I want to hear the real story behind everything that goes down.

threads.claim: Advanced ballista models are also used by the Millelith, hinting that military-grade weapons are circulating widely.
threads.quote: Beidou: Haha, don't worry. Compared to the model the Millelith's using, this one might as well be an antique.

threads.claim: A new pneuma and ousia relay device can be wielded in battle, and it could make bandits far more dangerous.
threads.quote: Yelan: A device that uses pneuma and ousia energies in battle... With that kind of tech, a bandit group could rob a caravan without even showing their faces.

introduced.name: Faruzan
introduced.how: senior Akademiya researcher from Haravatat, with a century-long career and an unusual personality
introduced.quote: Her name is Faruzan, and she's a very experienced senior researcher.

introduced.name: Faruzan's century-long disappearance
introduced.how: she vanished for a hundred years in a past incident and was only found in the wilderness a few years ago
introduced.quote: She is, but she vanished for a hundred years because of a certain incident.

introduced.name: Haravatat
introduced.how: an academic Darshan that researches languages and runes
introduced.quote: Haravatat is an academic faction that researches languages and runes.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: a Darshan specializing in researching mechanisms, separate from Spantamad, which studies energy flow
introduced.quote: I don't belong to Kshahrewar, which specializes in researching mechanisms, nor am I in Spantamad, which specializes in researching energy flow.

introduced.name: Acara Crafts
introduced.how: a toy-making business that wants to design early learning toys for children with the Akademiya
introduced.quote: In summary, Acara Crafts wants to design a series of early learning toys that will cultivate curiosity and learning in children.

introduced.name: Pagoda Stack
introduced.how: a tower-moving puzzle toy with rings on three poles that must be stacked big to small
introduced.quote: It's like building a tower. The rings in the three poles must be stacked from big to small.

introduced.name: Kamal
introduced.how: introduces himself as the Branch Master of Sumeru's Adventurers' Guild
introduced.quote: Let me introduce myself. I'm Kamal, the Branch Master of Sumeru's Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Sumeru guild of adventurers who explore ruins and handle ancient machines
introduced.quote: Let me introduce myself. I'm Kamal, the Branch Master of Sumeru's Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Anis
introduced.how: Kshahrewar's representative, staying at an inn in Port Ormos
introduced.quote: Anis, Kshahrewar's representative, should be staying in the inn at Port Ormos.

introduced.name: Mamdouh
introduced.how: owner of Acara Crafts who recruits volunteers to test his toys
introduced.quote: He's usually at the slope up ahead recruiting volunteers to test out his toys.

introduced.name: Faruzan
introduced.how: Akademiya scholar who vanished for a century and was found unchanged in appearance
introduced.quote: I've told you before that she had disappeared for 100 years, right?

introduced.name: Karkata
introduced.how: a mechanical life form Tighnari rescued, which is now sick
introduced.quote: This is the mechanical life form and I saved a while back. Its name is Karkata.

introduced.name: Abattouy
introduced.how: Tighnari's late junior and the creator of Karkata, a Spantamad-trained researcher
introduced.quote: Abattouy was, for a time, quite passionate about excavating the Great Red Sand.

introduced.name: Restitution Module
introduced.how: ancient self-repair device that copies living bodies and needs energy and upkeep
introduced.quote: It replicates the behavior of living things to achieve a self-repair function.

introduced.name: Ruin Wanderer
introduced.how: legendary monster said to have roamed ruins for centuries before vanishing about a decade ago
introduced.quote: It's said that this monster, the Ruin Wanderer, traversed through various ruins for centuries!

introduced.name: Raed
introduced.how: leader of the archaeological expedition who introduces himself
introduced.quote: I'm Raed, the one who organized this archaeological expedition.

introduced.name: Tamimi
introduced.how: mechanical life form that once followed Faruzan on expeditions and carried her letters home
introduced.quote: When I would go on expeditions, it would follow me, take notes for me, and send my letters home.

introduced.name: Tales of Shahryar
introduced.how: a book series written by a Vahumana researcher about a century ago and once popular at the Akademiya
introduced.quote: a Vahumana researcher wrote it while researching folk legends.

introduced.name: Maddah
introduced.how: storyteller at Puspa Café who tells the Legend of Antara and is descended from the Tales of Shahryar author
introduced.quote: It's Maddah from the cafe over there.

introduced.name: Light novels
introduced.how: popular books from Inazuma that are now sold on Treasures Street
introduced.quote: I've been reading light novels from Inazuma.

introduced.name: Tropes
introduced.how: fictional rules used to push a story's plot forward
introduced.quote: Ah, those fictional rules used to push the plot forward, yes?

introduced.name: Legend of Antara
introduced.how: an ancient hero's tale still told in cafes and the only surviving work from the Tales of Shahryar author
introduced.quote: So Antara's story is the one that lasted through the years...

introduced.name: Dark history
introduced.how: slang for embarrassing youthful fantasies that people later hide in novels or tree hollows
introduced.quote: But as they grew older, they started to become embarrassed by such memories.

introduced.name: Spantamad
introduced.how: school of mechanisms and elemental applications that builds intricate machines
introduced.quote: Students who are interested in mechanisms and applications of the elements generally enroll in Kshahrewar and Spantamad.

introduced.name: Haravatat
introduced.how: school of language research that Faruzan belongs to
introduced.quote: I guess that's a language researcher from Haravatat for you...

introduced.name: Ancient ruins machine creators
introduced.how: ancient makers who tried to build perpetual mechanisms that could replace or surpass life
introduced.quote: once tried to create a perpetual mechanism that could replace life or even surpass it.

introduced.name: Derafsh
introduced.how: antique seller on Treasures Street who sold Faruzan the fifth volume
introduced.quote: I never thought that this book would ever get sold...

introduced.name: Raed's relic ledger
introduced.how: his code word tent meant excavated relics that were secretly sold on the black market
introduced.quote: January 5th: Three tents sold.

introduced.name: Tamimi
introduced.how: a secret from Faruzan's past that was remodeled in the past and is tied to Karkata
introduced.quote: If they could remodel Tamimi successfully even back then, there's no reason why we won't be able to do even better.

introduced.name: Raed
introduced.how: a schemer who tried to get an ancient relic and was reported to the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Thankfully, it didn't end up in Raed's unscrupulous hands.

introduced.name: archaeology team
introduced.how: an archaeology team involved in the relic affair that the Traveler reported
introduced.quote: I told them about the archaeology team.

introduced.name: ancient civilization relic
introduced.how: the components brought back from the desert are relics of an ancient civilization
introduced.quote: So this is a relic of an ancient civilization? Unbelievable...

introduced.name: Faruzan's lost years
introduced.how: Faruzan was away for about a century and her old friends and family thought they had lost her
introduced.quote: I once believed that I'd never hear from my old friends and family ever again.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Even though most of the Akademiya's restrictions have significantly relaxed, I'm still a bit worried that the matra might give her trouble.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: It's been a while. What a coincidence, I was just thinking about asking you to accompany Collei to Sumeru City.

threads.claim: Faruzan vanished for a hundred years because of an unexplained incident, which raises the question of what happened to her.
threads.quote: She is, but she vanished for a hundred years because of a certain incident.

threads.claim: Faruzan's body stopped aging during her absence, which explains why she looks unchanged after a century.
threads.quote: Her body apparently stopped aging during the years she was gone, so that's why she looks the same as she did 100 years ago.

threads.claim: The matter Tighnari is pursuing concerns research banned by the Akademiya, hinting at a hidden and forbidden field.
threads.quote: concerns research banned by the Akademiya.

threads.claim: Ancient mechanisms in ruins are more dangerous and complex than people realize.
threads.quote: Ancient mechanisms are more dangerous and complex than one might imagine.

threads.claim: The Traveler is credited with helping the Akademiya recover, and Faruzan has long wanted to meet them.
threads.quote: It is thanks to you, after all, that the Akademiya is finally getting back on its feet.

threads.claim: Ordinary people who cannot read are shut out of written knowledge, so the Adventurers' Guild needs picture-based learning.
threads.quote: We have many members who can't read, so books are of little use to them.

threads.claim: Faruzan holds that knowledge should not be judged as useful or useless, only as right or wrong.
threads.quote: knowledge is either right or wrong. Superiority and inferiority do not come into the conversation.

threads.claim: Faruzan cannot remember where the ruin was or how she escaped her 100 years of entrapment.
threads.quote: She doesn't remember anything else, including the location of the ruin and how she finally managed to escape.

threads.claim: The mechanical life form Tamimi had been carrying her family's last letters across the century to her.
threads.quote: All so it could deliver these last letters from them to me.

threads.claim: A legend says a monster called the Ruin Wanderer roamed ruins for centuries and its origin is unknown.
threads.quote: It's said that this monster, the Ruin Wanderer, traversed through various ruins for centuries!

threads.claim: The wreckage seems to have stopped moving only about a dozen years ago, contradicting the centuries-long legend.
threads.quote: At most, I'd estimate that it only stopped moving about a dozen years ago.

threads.claim: The Ruin Wanderer is revealed to be Tamimi, remodeled to self-learn and wander the ruins.
threads.quote: Tamimi, which used to be incapable of even moving heavy objects, became the

threads.claim: Faruzan wonders how the Tales of Shahryar story ends, a question left open.
threads.quote: I wonder if Aliyah and Aziz ended up together. And who obtained the Desert Gem in the end...?

threads.claim: Maddah reveals the Tales of Shahryar series was never given an ending.
threads.quote: In the end? There's no ending.

threads.claim: Popularity versus lasting quality is raised as a theme, and the Traveler argues that personal enjoyment matters most.
threads.quote: It doesn't matter if it's a classic or a fad. What matters is that you like it.

threads.claim: Karkata cannot be repaired by ordinary means and needs rare replacement parts for its Restitution Module.
threads.quote: I'll need to swap out the damaged parts in the Restitution Module to repair Karkata.

threads.claim: Faruzan brings back components from the desert to extend Karkata's life.
threads.quote: Now, here are some components I brought back from the desert.

threads.claim: Raed is exposed as secretly selling excavated relics and disguising them as tents.
threads.quote: You're supposed to be an archaeological expedition team, and yet here you are, secretly selling the relics and profiting from it.

threads.claim: Abattouy was passionate about excavating the desert before being expelled from the Akademiya, and his fate is unclear.
threads.quote: Abattouy was, for a time, quite passionate about excavating the Great Red Sand.

threads.claim: Faruzan has a family who has been waiting for her to come home.
threads.quote: Hurry up and come home for a meal. Your mom always makes an extra portion of food, you know?

threads.claim: Faruzan receives her family's farewell letters, which were delivered by Tamimi.
threads.quote: I've safely received the letters... Your work is done now. You can sleep.

threads.claim: Mechanical life forms have a limited lifespan, which may explain why Tamimi became trapped and stopped.
threads.quote: Just like a living being, mechanical life forms have a limited lifespan.

threads.claim: Only Faruzan and the Traveler know about Tamimi, so Faruzan must decide whether to tell the others.
threads.quote: I should let Faruzan decide whether to tell the others about Tamimi.

threads.claim: The Restitution Module comes from ancient civilizations that tried to build perpetual machines to replace life.
threads.quote: once tried to create a perpetual mechanism that could replace life or even surpass it.

threads.claim: Tamimi is a secret Faruzan keeps from Tighnari and Collei.
threads.quote: Thank you for keeping Tamimi a secret.

threads.claim: Faruzan worries that revealing Tamimi would make people feel bad about Karkata's components.
threads.quote: If I tell them about Tamimi, will they still feel happy for Karkata?

threads.claim: Faruzan plans to tell Tighnari and Collei about her past once Karkata stabilizes.
threads.quote: Once Karkata's condition stabilizes, I'll find a chance to tell Tighnari and Collei about all that.

threads.claim: Faruzan once believed her old friends and family had abandoned any hope of contacting her.
threads.quote: I once believed that I'd never hear from my old friends and family ever again.

threads.claim: A letter from Tamimi showed Faruzan that her old family had never given up on her.
threads.quote: However, I could remember them clearly again after reading the letter Tamimi handed to me and learning that they'd never given up on me.

threads.claim: Raed attempted to seize an ancient relic, and the evidence against him was handed to the Akademiya.
threads.quote: I've already given all the evidence we have against Raed to the Akademiya.

threads.claim: Components from the desert are relics of an ancient civilization.
threads.quote: So this is a relic of an ancient civilization? Unbelievable...

threads.claim: Karkata needs time to rest after repairs before its condition is fully stable.
threads.quote: Collei: It looks fine, but even so, it needs to properly rest up.

threads.claim: Faruzan finds a home again when the Traveler welcomes her back after her lonely return to Sumeru.
threads.quote: Yeah, I'm home.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a land of islands surrounded by sea, with no official authority governing it
introduced.quote: Nod-Krai is made up of islands surrounded by the sea

introduced.name: Nasha Town
introduced.how: Nod-Krai's port city and most bustling commercial hub
introduced.quote: They arrive at Nod-Krai's port city, Nasha Town.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a pure, primordial elemental energy found only in Nod-Krai, tied to the moon
introduced.quote: It is a unique elemental force found only in Nod-Krai — or rather, a pure, primordial form of elemental energy.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki
introduced.how: a sprite native to the land, a familiar of the Moon Goddess said to bring good fortune
introduced.quote: That is a kuuhenki, a species unique to the land of Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: a recurring Abyssal calamity of ghostly, eldritch attacks around Nasha Town
introduced.quote: It is a phenomenon that has been occurring for several centuries now, yet the time and location of Wild Hunt attacks are seemingly random.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: the indigenous people of Nod-Krai who revere the Moon Goddess
introduced.quote: According to the Frostmoon Scions, the indigenous inhabitants of this land, the kuuhenki are said to be familiars of the Moon Goddess

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: introduces herself as a Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: I am Lauma, Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: introduces himself as a Ratnik who guards the northern graveyards against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: I'm a Ratnik of Nod-Krai, normally stationed near the burial grounds to the north.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Grand Master of the Adventurers' Guild, absent; he went to Amsvartnir with his knights
introduced.quote: Word reached him of trouble brewing around those parts, so he took his knights to check it out.

introduced.name: Demyan
introduced.how: bartender at The Flagship who reports Varka's whereabouts
introduced.quote: Eh? Well, well, if it isn't the ineffable Ineffa!

introduced.name: Amsvartnir
introduced.how: a lake in the northern reaches of Nod-Krai where trouble is brewing
introduced.quote: It's a lake in the northern part of Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Aino
introduced.how: a tinkerer whose Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon guards Nasha Town
introduced.quote: That is Aino's "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon."

introduced.name: Ineffa

introduced.quote: Ineffa: Paimon, , welcome to Nod-Krai.

introduced.quote: Heading to Hiisi Island, the two are greeted by a unique kuuhenki

introduced.name: Luonnotar

introduced.quote: it is a special kuuhenki called a "Luonnotar," beings born from the Moon Goddess' blessing.

introduced.name: Kuutar
introduced.how: the Moon Goddess of the Frostmoon Scions, whose statues dot the land and who left after the Scions' greed

introduced.quote: One of the most well-known is that of the Lantern Fae.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a region with no current ruler that the Fatui are trying to rule
introduced.quote: Just because Nod-Krai lacks a ruler at present, that does not mean it should not be ruled.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions

introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions? You mean, the people who believe in the Moon Goddess?

introduced.name: Lightkeepers

introduced.quote: Oh, they're an organization set up to keep the locals safe.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius

introduced.quote: That bunch of booze-loving Mondstadters?

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: a dispute-handling place in Nod-Krai run by a woman with a temper and high fees
introduced.quote: Just... a place that handles all kinds of disputes.

introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
introduced.how: fragments of shattered moons that rained down on Nod-Krai and are the source of its kuuvahki
introduced.quote: It is also said that when the moons shattered, most of their fragments rained down upon this land like stardust.

introduced.name: Three Moons of Teyvat
introduced.how: Teyvat once had three moons (Eternal, Frost, Iridescent) that were destroyed in a war triggered by the Descenders
introduced.quote: In the distant past, Teyvat had not just one moon, but three.

introduced.name: Kuutar
introduced.how: the Moon Goddess and Moon Maiden worshipped by the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: Yes. Kuutar is our Moon Goddess — the Moon Maiden who guides us.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger the Frostmoon Scions believe may be their missing Moon Goddess
introduced.quote: Judging from what they've said... our Moon Goddess is actually their missing Harbinger

introduced.name: Hiisi Island
introduced.how: an island claimed by the Fatui as sovereign territory of the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, home of the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: which, by the way, is a sovereign territory of the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: kuuhenki-like beings born from the Moon Goddess's blessing that bring good fortune
introduced.quote: beings born from the Moon Goddess's blessing.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki
introduced.how: creatures regarded as Kuutar's familiars that guide travelers to treasure
introduced.quote: From that day forth, the kuuhenki have been regarded as Kuutar's familiars.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a tidal energy in Nod-Krai that affects all creatures and makes them dependent on it
introduced.quote: The tides of kuuvahki affect everything in Nod-Krai

introduced.name: Lunasoul Stone
introduced.how: a rare stone full of kuuvahki used to craft the Frostmoon statues
introduced.quote: crafted from the very finest Lunasoul Stone.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: a sacred remnant fragment held by the Frostmoon Scions in which a divine presence is sensed, said to reveal the past
introduced.quote: Successive generations of Moonchanters have all detected a divine presence within it.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Night
introduced.how: a yearly ceremony on the night the moon is closest to Teyvat, when the sacred chamber can be opened
introduced.quote: The ceremony is held on the night when the moon is closest to Teyvat.

introduced.name: Moonchanter
introduced.how: the highest rank among the Frostmoon Scions, entrusted with conveying the Moon Goddess's will
introduced.quote: The Moonchanter holds the highest rank among us Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Aino
introduced.how: a young mechanic who salvaged Ineffa and lives with her, and who knows Varka
introduced.quote: Do either of you need my help with anything? Anything at all! After all, I'm the head of this household!

introduced.name: Amazing 'Bot
introduced.how: small robots Aino builds and keeps around her house
introduced.quote: It looks like Aino has created three more little bots since I've been gone.

introduced.name: Paha Isle
introduced.how: one of the two islands where Ancient Moon's Remnants landed, and site of a Fatui research facility
introduced.quote: The two largest remnants landed in Nod-Krai — one here on Hiisi Island, and the other on Paha Isle.

introduced.name: Fatui research facility on Paha Isle
introduced.how: a Fatui research facility built on top of a remnant
introduced.quote: The Fatui built their research facility on top of the remnant over on Paha Isle

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: an ancient golden realm whose last descendants are the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: We Frostmoon Scions are the last descendants of the ancient golden realm of Hyperborea.

introduced.name: Statue of Kuutar on Hiisi Island
introduced.how: the only Frostmoon statue of the Moon Goddess that still keeps her original form
introduced.quote: but now, this is the only one left that still retains her original form.

introduced.name: Vilemina
introduced.how: a Frostmoon Scion who serves Lauma and is worried about her
introduced.quote: Vilemina, this is and Paimon. Kindly arrange for two additional dinner settings for our honored guests.

introduced.name: Kaarina
introduced.how: a sick Frostmoon Scion girl whose condition makes her sensitive to kuuvahki
introduced.quote: Lady Lauma, it's my daughter, Kaarina... Her illness...

introduced.name: Ognjen
introduced.how: a Fatui officer who delivers the three-day ultimatum to the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: Orders from above. We're here to deliver the Frostmoon Scions a warning... or rather, a final ultimatum.

introduced.name: Oiva
introduced.how: a Fatui officer who openly scorns the Frostmoon Scions as savages
introduced.quote: Then again, I guess that's what you'd expect from savages.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: the Traveler's own identity, linked to the war that shattered the three moons
introduced.quote: I'm not from Teyvat... I'm a Descender.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a land steeped in ancient stories, and the first place the Traveler set foot in Teyvat
introduced.quote: (Nod-Krai... A land steeped in ancient stories...

introduced.name: The Damselette (Kuutar)
introduced.how: a moon-born figure the Fatui call The Damselette, whom Frostmoon Scions revere as a Moon Goddess and who does not know her own name
introduced.quote: Kuutar, The Damselette, the Moon Goddess... Pick whichever takes your fancy.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: a kuuhenki that leads the Traveler to hidden places and brings them to The Damselette
introduced.quote: The kuuhenki... She brought you here...

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: leader of the Frostmoon Scions, unusually sensitive to moonlight and kuuvahki, who suppresses her senses
introduced.quote: I am unusually sensitive to the moonlight, as well as to the kuuvahki's ebb and flow.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, an information broker
introduced.quote: This is Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: an information-dealing establishment that strictly stays neutral among Nod-Krai's factions
introduced.quote: The Curatorium of Secrets has always striven to abide by a policy of strict neutrality.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a Nod-Krai people who revere the Frostmoon and their Moon Goddess, with a bloodline now thinning
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions' bloodline has long since begun to run thin.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions' secret chamber
introduced.how: a hidden sanctum of ancient trials, closed to outsiders for generations
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions' secret chamber has remained hidden from the world for generations.

introduced.name: Moonchanter
introduced.how: a title for Lauma's duty to the Frostmoon Scions and their relic
introduced.quote: Recovering the relic is both my duty as a Moonchanter and a step toward fulfilling the promise I made — to help uncover the truth of the past.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: guardians who patrol Nod-Krai at night as a long-held tradition
introduced.quote: We Lightkeepers are accustomed to patrolling at night — a long-held tradition, you understand.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: a Lightkeeper who met the Traveler at The Flagship and drives off Wild Hunt creatures
introduced.quote: Flins: Yes, we ran into each other at The Flagship this afternoon. I'm honored you still remember.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: the Frostmoon Scions' sacred relic, said to hold answers about the origins of Teyvat
introduced.quote: It holds answers... about the very origins of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a force whose ebb and flow is felt as a tide by those sensitive to it, and which can push and pull
introduced.quote: To others, fluctuations in kuuvahki are something you easily get used to — like a gentle tide lapping away at the shore.

introduced.name: Columbina's lullaby
introduced.how: the only melody The Damselette remembers from her birth, sung as a lullaby
introduced.quote: Columbina sings the first two lines of the lullaby: Dormi cara columbula / O columbula mea

introduced.name: Vilemina
introduced.how: a Frostmoon Scion who sets traps against the Fatui at Lauma's request
introduced.quote: Vilemina: Lauma asked me to set up these traps to keep the Fatui at bay.

introduced.name: Hiisi Island
introduced.how: the island where The Damselette has been hiding all along, reached through a secret cave
introduced.quote: (So The Damselette has been here on Hiisi Island all along...

introduced.name: Kaarina
introduced.how: a sick girl whose reactions to kuuvahki Lauma secretly treats with her blood
introduced.quote: Lauma: ...A medicine prescribed by a local doctor. For ordinary people, my blood has the power to counteract any adverse reactions to kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions' prayers to the Damselette
introduced.how: the Scions asked the Moon Goddess for everything until she could no longer answer
introduced.quote: They asked for everything, and I obliged... until the day came when no answer could be given.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: Fatui facility, built to use kuuvahki, where the stolen relic is kept
introduced.quote: The goal of infiltrating the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau is to locate and, if possible, recover the relic that the Fatui stole.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
introduced.how: Profit-minded information group in Nod-Krai that Lauma and Jahoda used to work for
introduced.quote: In Nod-Krai, it's common knowledge that the Curatorium has a nose for profit and opportunity... the same way aphids flit from flower to flower in a neverending quest to make honey.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Information dealer who runs an office and employs Jahoda
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait a sec, how did you— Ohhh right, like you told us before... Your business is "dealing in information."

introduced.name: Vilemina
introduced.how: Lauma's childhood friend, a former Frostmoon Scion who defected to the Fatui
introduced.quote: Vilemina: We grew up together, Lauma. I know you were chosen to be the next Moonchanter when you were just a child. They never gave you a choice in that.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Hiisi Island clan of moon worshippers, led by Lauma, who see her as family
introduced.quote: Lauma: You don't understand, do you? That's the difference between us, Vilemina — I care about the Frostmoon Scions. They're family to me.

introduced.name: Moonchanter
introduced.how: Chosen leader of the Frostmoon Scions, who can act as a vessel for the relic
introduced.quote: Vilemina: We grew up together, Lauma. I know you were chosen to be the next Moonchanter when you were just a child. They never gave you a choice in that.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: Energy source from the Light Realm, used as backup power and a weapon, that Lauma can sense
introduced.quote: Lauma: I sensed kuuvahki inside it during the fight just now. They must've been using it as backup energy for their armor.

introduced.name: Portable Kuuvahki Charging Component
introduced.how: Kuuvahki-filled power units that can be collected to restore a terminal's power
introduced.quote: (Pick up the Portable Kuuvahki Charging Component near the sentry bots, optional)

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Relic the Fatui stole, found hidden inside Pulonia and carried by the Traveler
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey, is that... the Moon Marrow! It was hidden inside that big robot of hers all along!

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: Marionette's giant robot, which hides the Moon Marrow
introduced.quote: Marionette: Ugh... That's "Pulonia" to you, not just some "robot"!

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: Fatui Harbinger in charge of the Starsand Shoal operation, who has the relic
introduced.quote: Marionette: Mm? You mean that thing your antlered turncoat brought us?

introduced.name: Starsand Shoal
introduced.how: Beach where Marionette takes the relic and where the Wild Hunt attacks
introduced.quote: Vilemina: Marionette has the Moon Marrow... She went to Starsand Shoal.

introduced.name: Hiisi Island
introduced.how: Island that is the Frostmoon Scions' home
introduced.quote: Vilemina: But you were right about one thing — I haven't considered Hiisi Island my home for a long, long time now.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: Phantom force that attacks the Frostmoon Scions and can mimic people's appearance
introduced.quote: Nefer: Hmm... A phantom that can mimic the appearance of others... Quite different from what we've seen before.

introduced.name: Tideseal Stone
introduced.how: Device used to cleanse the Wild Hunt's permeation, though it can burst open
introduced.quote: The Tideseal Stone is ready! Interact with it to cleanse the Wild Hunt's permeation.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: Ratnik who tracks the Wild Hunt and seems unsettling to the animals
introduced.quote: Flins: Hmm? I thought I sensed the Wild Hunt nearby... Don't tell me... you've already taken care of it?

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: Nod-Krai guards usually stationed in remote areas and keeping to themselves
introduced.quote: Jahoda: They're usually stationed in remote areas and tend to keep to themselves. So, uh, it's not surprising they end up a little... eccentric?

introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
introduced.how: Fragments of a fallen moon, one of which lies hidden underwater beneath the facility
introduced.quote: Lauma: ...We're standing on another fragment of the Ancient Moon's Remnants.

introduced.name: False sky
introduced.how: The moon in the sky is fake, and the true Frost Moon lies beyond it
introduced.quote: Lauma: No, that's not it. I'm talking about the fact that the moon in the sky isn't real.

introduced.name: Vilemina's defection
introduced.how: Vilemina stole the relic at the secret chamber and gave it to the Fatui
introduced.quote: Vilemina: Yes... and in your final moment of hesitation, I... took the chance...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: we've been to a bunch of nations already, but we only just arrived in Nod-Krai today.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: After spending some more time in Natlan, Ineffa waits for the Traveler and Paimon outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: Have faith in the people of Mondstadt, Paimon.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Katheryne! We meet again!

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Chasca, Iansan, Ororon... even the Pyro Archon herself!

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Sandrone states that it is about time that she met the "variable" (Traveler) in person.

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: Traveler: A bit like phlogiston?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Ineffa: ...There came a devastating Abyssal calamity that swept across Nod-Krai

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Although Nod-Krai lies on Snezhnaya's border regions

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Moon Goddess? Don't all people here worship the Tsaritsa...?

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: So the origin of their beliefs goes back even further than the Archon War?

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Marionette: Look very closely, for standing before you is none other than Marionette, Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers.

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: the Traveler, who reveals that they are the latest Descender and are looking into their and their sibling's past.

assumed.name: Light Realm
assumed.quote: Maybe they both belong to the "Light Realm" that the Lord of the Night mentioned...

assumed.name: Eternal Moon
assumed.quote: The Fatui had pulled down parts of the Eternal Moon

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: The Traveler and Paimon head back to The Flagship and get some sleep

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: But we are in Nod-Krai now, and as such, I strongly advise you not to stand in the Fatui's way.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Traveler: Long time no see, Dori.

assumed.name: Ineffa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ineffa!

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, the real Katheryne's back!

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Huh? Hey, look! Isn't that Lauma... the Moonchanter?

assumed.name: Uncle Varka
assumed.quote: Uncle Varka talks about you guys all the time!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: A spaceship, huh? From outside Teyvat?

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon
assumed.quote: which one was Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon related to?

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: But those doctors are all Snezhnayan!

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: Those two Fatui, the ones who were causing trouble in Nasha Town...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Not at all sorry to interrupt, but we're not here for Mora.

assumed.name: Fatui Harbingers
assumed.quote: number three amongst the Fatui Harbingers!?

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: I'm searching for the truth about me and my sibling's past...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: (The Fatui... they seem to be conducting some kind of research on the Ancient Moon's Remnants...

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: (And Varka just happened to be away... Could it somehow be related to the Abyss...?)

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: (That presence... it's the Abyss!)

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: (Is that... the Wild Hunt? Did it show up when we entered this domain?)

assumed.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
assumed.quote: It was shortly after the fall of the Ancient Moon's Remnants.

assumed.name: Natlan Abyss crisis
assumed.quote: They're the heroes everyone was talking about before — the ones who saved Natlan during the Abyss crisis.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Tsaritsa was right. Freedom always comes with a price.

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: When you called yourself a Descender, I had a feeling you might be able to confirm what I had always suspected.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: I trust you, I still do. Through all the worlds we've traveled, you've always been there by my side.

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: She told you that the seal can only be broken on Moon-Prayer Night, when the flow of kuuvahki is at its peak, yes?

assumed.name: Lightkeepers
assumed.quote: Jahoda: Whew... At least, that's what the Lightkeepers' handbook says...

assumed.name: Ineffa
assumed.quote: Jahoda: Let's see... Huh, no kidding! Ineffa told me about something like this before. Can't believe that dumb robot actually helped me out for once...

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Jahoda: (Oh no, it really is a Harbinger this time...!)

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Traveler: You know, this is only the second time we've fought together since the day we both woke up in Teyvat.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Jahoda: Huh? Seems like the Fatui in Snezhnaya are trying to harness the power of the Light Realm to build some kinda weapon...

assumed.name: Kuutar
assumed.quote: Vilemina: (Wait. Who's that with ? They look so alike... Hmm, they seem to be heading... towards the statue of Kuutar!)

assumed.name: Aarto
assumed.quote: Aarto: Yes, my Lady...

assumed.name: Vanamo
assumed.quote: Vanamo: I'm not sure. Seems like the Moonchanter has something important to tell us...

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: Traveler: But when I found you, you were still in hibernation. Even the key to the chamber was still secure on your person.

assumed.name: Nefer and Lauma's rift
assumed.quote: Lauma: I don't believe so. Nefer and I have our differences, but that shouldn't interfere with our shared objective.

threads.claim: The Traveler's spaceship landed on Nod-Krai's shores, and the Traveler recognizes the power they felt when they first arrived in Teyvat.
threads.quote: This is where our spaceship landed when and I first arrived in Teyvat...

threads.claim: Aino has never seen an alien ship, so the spaceship may still be intact somewhere.
threads.quote: so the ship could at least still be intact.

threads.claim: The moon the Traveler and Ineffa see may not be the true moon, since kuuvahki power comes from a different direction than the visible moon.
threads.quote: Ineffa: Negative, I was referring to... Ah, here we are.

threads.claim: Lauma confirms the skies are fake and that the Scions' moon-power comes from elsewhere.
threads.quote: She asks the Traveler if the skies were fake, which they confirm to her relief

threads.claim: A prophecy said the Moon Goddess would return, but it did not come about as anticipated.
threads.quote: a prophecy was passed down in which the Moon Goddess would return. While it came true, it did not come about as anticipated

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt began as a ghostly shadow of a woman in the mist and has grown into an Abyssal calamity, and its nature may be changing.
threads.quote: But the oldest legends say that all people saw was the ghostly shadow of a woman in the mist.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt can impersonate others, as the Traveler's sibling seemed fake in the fog.
threads.quote: they hear their sibling's voice, but realize that it was never their sibling to begin with

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling may have acted differently than the Traveler remembers, and the sibling's motives are unclear.
threads.quote: The sibling asks them to do it for their sake, though the demeanor leaves the Traveler confused as a fog sets in.

threads.claim: The Traveler's memories of their sibling waking them and leaving the ship conflict with the account they were given.
threads.quote: remembering that they'd been told that the sibling had found them still in their hypersleep pod

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow holds answers about the origins of Teyvat and the Traveler's past, and it is hidden and hard to obtain.
threads.quote: The sibling then admits that the Moon Marrow also held answers about the origins of Teyvat

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow is stolen by the Fatui and taken away, then the Traveler is forced to store it within their own body.
threads.quote: With her guidance, they store it in the Traveler's body, just as Nefer returns

threads.claim: Columbina, Kuutar and the Fatui's Damselette may be linked, and the Moon Goddess's identity is uncertain.
threads.quote: Lauma suspects that their Kuutar is actually the Fatui Harbinger Damselette.

threads.claim: Columbina says she has no name of her own and was born alone, but the Frostmoon Scions once prayed to her.
threads.quote: she admits that she does not know her own name as she had been born alone

threads.claim: Lauma secretly cuts her own hand to make silver blood medicine, a condition the Scions have hidden.
threads.quote: Lauma tells Kapy to wait outside, then takes out a knife and cuts her hand, spilling silver blood

threads.claim: Lauma's silver blood treatments reveal she has been medically treating others the same way.
threads.quote: noticing similar healed scars on her hands, the Traveler realizes she has been treating others the same way.

threads.claim: Columbina remarks that freedom comes with a price.
threads.quote: the Archon remarking that freedom came with a price.

threads.claim: Flins's lantern feels off to the Traveler, suggesting something hidden inside it.
threads.quote: Traveler: (There's something off about that lantern...)

threads.claim: Flins sensed something wrong about his lantern and the Traveler suspects his true nature.
threads.quote: The Traveler notices just how they can feel something off about Flins

threads.claim: Nod-Krai has no official authority, so it is either a lawless paradise or a paradise of freedom.
threads.quote: In theory, at least, it is somewhere a person can do whatever they wish, and become whoever they want to be.

threads.claim: The Fatui have been watching the Traveler's every move.
threads.quote: Does that mean the Fatui have been watching our every move?

threads.claim: Marionette warns the Traveler not to interfere in Fatui matters.
threads.quote: Marionette states that she had come personally as a friendly warning.

threads.claim: Nod-Krai had an age of peace under the Fae and an Abyssal calamity later swept across it.
threads.quote: According to legend, there was indeed an era of peace in Nod-Krai's past — the age of the Fae.

threads.claim: The spaceship from outside Teyvat has left no trace in Nod-Krai, so it either crashed unseen or was hidden by someone.
threads.quote: So either your spaceship crashed somewhere it's never been found, or someone DID find it and then hid it really, really well.

threads.claim: Moonchanters are said to possess a relic that lets them see the true past, which may reveal the Traveler's history.
threads.quote: They say that each of their Moonchanters has had access to an ancient relic that lets them

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow can only be retrieved once a year on Moon-Prayer Night, so the Traveler must wait.
threads.quote: Judging from the tides this evening... a little less than two months.

threads.claim: The Iridescent Moon's remnants were never found, and her fate after the war remains unknown.
threads.quote: The Iridescent Moon's remnants were never found.

threads.claim: Kuutar may be the Fatui Harbinger Columbina, which raises the question of why the goddess joined the Fatui.
threads.quote: Judging from what they've said... our Moon Goddess is actually their missing Harbinger

threads.claim: Kuutar left Hiisi Island long ago and was seen there again after the remnants fell, but where she went is unknown.
threads.quote: But just a few months ago, after those two Ancient Moon's Remnants fell from the sky, she was spotted on Hiisi Island once more.

threads.claim: Kuutar was born on Hiisi Island about five hundred years ago, and a priestess recorded her birth as a prophesied rebirth.
threads.quote: was born here on Hiisi Island around five hundred years ago.

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions' prophecy that the Moon Goddess would return has come true in some unclear, partial way.
threads.quote: And in the end, that prophecy did indeed come to pass, though not quite—

threads.claim: Descenders are tied to the war that destroyed the three moons, linking the Traveler's origin to Teyvat's ancient catastrophe.
threads.quote: This happened in a war triggered by the Descenders

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for the truth about their own and their sibling's past.
threads.quote: I'm searching for the truth about me and my sibling's past...

threads.claim: Lauma appears to heal Kaarina with her own power, hinting at the unusual abilities of her bloodline.
threads.quote: (Did she just use her own power to heal that girl...?)

threads.claim: Lauma's question about hiding a secret from family hints that she is concealing something of her own.
threads.quote: If you were aware of something, a secret that could hurt your family... Would you be honest with them, or try to hide it?

threads.claim: A Luonnotar has attached itself to the Traveler and Paimon for reasons no one can explain.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...She's following us.

threads.claim: The Fatui demand the relic and Kuutar's whereabouts within three days, threatening Hiisi Island with a cleansing.
threads.quote: You have three days to hand over the relic and reveal the whereabouts of your so-called

threads.claim: The Fatui's Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau and its facilities are rumored to hide dark secrets.
threads.quote: hides secrets wilder still!

threads.claim: The Curatorium of Secrets is a dangerous place whose owner is said to be a notorious operator.
threads.quote: Do not, under any circumstances, go there!

threads.claim: Uncle Varka suddenly left on unexplained business and has not returned.
threads.quote: A couple of days ago, he suddenly said he had to head out on business

threads.claim: Kaarina's illness makes her hypersensitive to kuuvahki, and her treatment is not a long-term solution.
threads.quote: Her sensitivity to kuuvahki is flaring up again...

threads.claim: Lauma quietly carries a heavy burden for the Frostmoon Scions that others worry about.
threads.quote: Deep down, though, I know she's been quietly carrying the burden for the rest of us.

threads.claim: Ineffa was salvaged by Aino and contains ancient dragon technology.
threads.quote: After all, she was the one who salvaged me — ancient dragon technology and all.

threads.claim: Lauma privately believes the moon in the sky is false and that the true moon lies beyond it.
threads.quote: "The moon is false"... I reached that conclusion long ago.

threads.claim: The Traveler confirms that the sky above Teyvat is a lie.
threads.quote: The sky above Teyvat... is a lie.

threads.claim: The Damselette's origin story is written on the real moon, which is beyond her reach.
threads.quote: The real beginning of my story lies up there on the moon, forever beyond my reach — like a message carved for blind hands, sealed away where no fingers can find it.

threads.claim: The Damselette was born in Teyvat alone and does not know her own name or where she came from.
threads.quote: according to Lauma, she was born in Teyvat alone

threads.claim: The Damselette remembers only a lullaby from the moment of her birth, and its meaning is unknown.
threads.quote: It is all I remember from the moment of my birth — a melody, a few lines of lyrics, like a lullaby from a foggy dream.

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow holds the answers to the origins of Teyvat, which the Traveler wants to see.
threads.quote: It holds answers... about the very origins of Teyvat.

threads.claim: The Traveler and their sibling do not know why their spaceship crashed into Teyvat or what happened to them before.
threads.quote: What happened to us in the past, how we came to Teyvat, why our spaceship crashed here...

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling has been acting strangely and cannot be fully trusted.
threads.quote: (Who should I trust...?)

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling can wield the power of the Abyss, which the Traveler admits.
threads.quote: Can indeed wield the power of the Abyss.

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions' sacred relic has been stolen, and its thief is unknown.
threads.quote: The sacred relic of theirs... It's been stolen!

threads.claim: The Fatui suddenly called off their search for the relic, which suggests they may already have it.
threads.quote: Word is, today of all days, the Fatui suddenly called off their search for the relic.

threads.claim: The Abyssal phenomenon in Nod-Krai seems different from elsewhere and may be connected to the Abyss.
threads.quote: (Come to think of it... It feels like there's something different about the Abyssal phenomenon here...

threads.claim: The Damselette warns that the moon can be treacherous, without explaining why.
threads.quote: Take care... The moon can be treacherous.

threads.claim: The Fatui only wanted The Damselette's power as the Moon Goddess and treated her as a valuable piece rather than family.
threads.quote: All they wanted in truth was my "power" as the Moon Goddess.

threads.claim: The flowers around The Damselette change color with her strength, turning red when she draws on power and white when she is weak.
threads.quote: (So... they turn white when she's feeling weak. And when they went red that day, that was because... she was drawing upon her strength?)

threads.claim: Lauma believes the Frostmoon Scions pray to a false moon and a goddess who can no longer answer, and she wants to change this.
threads.quote: The Frostmoon Scions now walk a path of error. They offer their prayers to a false moon, and to a goddess who can no longer answer them.

threads.claim: Scions like Kapy keep praying to the Moon Goddess, yet their prayers go unanswered.
threads.quote: I've been praying to the Moon Goddess every day... Why isn't she getting any better...

threads.claim: Lauma secretly treats sick Scions with her silver blood, hiding this from the Scions' families.
threads.quote: For ordinary people, my blood has the power to counteract any adverse reactions to kuuvahki.

threads.claim: Vilemina doubts whether the Frostmoon Scions deserve Lauma's efforts, and she plans to leave them.
threads.quote: (*sigh*... Either way, this will be my final night with the Frostmoon Scions...)

threads.claim: Lauma reveals that the moon in the sky is not real, hinting that the true Frost Moon lies beyond the false sky.
threads.quote: Lauma: No, that's not it. I'm talking about the fact that the moon in the sky isn't real.

threads.claim: Lauma publicly tells the Frostmoon Scions that their moon is hidden and that the story of a false moon is true.
threads.quote: Traveler: And so, Lauma began to reveal to the Frostmoon Scions a truth long hidden within her heart... A story of a false moon, and the death of gods...

threads.claim: The kuuvahki in the Moon Marrow may be linked to the Three Moon Sisters and the shattered Eternal Moon.
threads.quote: Jahoda: "...Analysis of the kuuvahki extracted from the Moon Marrow suggests that its energy core bears some close relation to the power of the former Three Moon Sisters..."

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow turns out to have been hidden inside Pulonia, and Marionette gives it up.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hey, is that... the Moon Marrow! It was hidden inside that big robot of hers all along!

threads.claim: Flins suspects the Wild Hunt's actions are purposeful rather than aimless, hinting at a hidden plan.
threads.quote: Flins: Please, don't get me wrong. I've been tracking the Wild Hunt lately, and I've come to suspect that its actions... aren't as aimless as they might seem.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt can mimic people and has targeted the Moon Marrow on both occasions, suggesting a deeper connection.
threads.quote: Nefer: ...And on both occasions, it was accompanied by the Wild Hunt too. It appears there must be some close connection between the two.

threads.claim: Flins seems different from other Ratniki, and the animals are afraid of him.
threads.quote: Lauma: The animals... they've told me they're afraid to even go near him...

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling may be a Wild Hunt phantom, since they were found in hibernation with the chamber key.
threads.quote: Traveler: But when I found you, you were still in hibernation. Even the key to the chamber was still secure on your person.

threads.claim: The Traveler defeats the sibling impostor, which disintegrates into purple mist.
threads.quote: (At the same time, the Traveler slashes through their "sibling," who disintegrates into a cloud of purple)

threads.claim: Vilemina stole the relic and joined the Fatui after a Harbinger offered her a chance.
threads.quote: Vilemina: Yes... and in your final moment of hesitation, I... took the chance...

threads.claim: A Moonchanter can carry the relic inside their body, but only for a limited time.
threads.quote: Lauma: But it is a grueling trial of will and endurance. The Moonchanter who did this... only lasted two days.

threads.claim: Lauma suspects someone who entered the final chamber carried an Abyssal presence, and the Traveler senses Abyssal power.
threads.quote: Lauma: Among those who entered the final chamber, there was either someone with impure intent, or else... an Abyssal presence.

threads.claim: Another fragment of the Ancient Moon's Remnants lies hidden underwater beneath the Fatui facility.
threads.quote: Lauma: ...We're standing on another fragment of the Ancient Moon's Remnants.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: Python King who reportedly built the Tonatiuh and died after the Abyss came, per legend
introduced.quote: Yes, that's the Python King Och-Kan.

introduced.name: Tonatiuh
introduced.how: legendary sky-vessel built under Och-Kan, long sought by adventurers and not yet proven to exist
introduced.quote: Legend has it that he abused and oppressed his people to get the Tonatiuh built

introduced.name: Altar of Primal Flame
introduced.how: altar where offering Pyrophosphorite transports people up to the Tonatiuh
introduced.quote: Anyway, so we're gonna offer Pyrophosphorite on the Altar, right?

introduced.name: Pyrophosphorite
introduced.how: stone that stores energy and is offered at the Altar
introduced.quote: Looks like Pyrophosphorites contain the energy as well.

introduced.name: Jade of Return
introduced.how: item adventurers seek aboard the Tonatiuh
introduced.quote: The ones who came to this cursed city are likely here for the Jade of Return anyway

introduced.name: Chu'ulel
introduced.how: ancient dragon city whose heart is the Core of Chu'ulel
introduced.quote: The Core of Chu'ulel. Seems like it was once the heart of the entire city.

introduced.name: Sacred Lord
introduced.how: figure who in ancient times transformed himself into the heart of the dragon city
introduced.quote: the Sacred Lord once transformed himself into the heart of the dragon city

introduced.name: Cocouik
introduced.how: small green dragonspirit awakened from the city's machine, named by the notes' author
introduced.quote: It's so small, and absolutely adorable! And it's green like a chunk of turquoise, so I think I'll call it Cocouik

introduced.name: Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker
introduced.how: guardian automatons in the city that can understand speech
introduced.quote: Unlike those I've encountered elsewhere, the Secret Source Automatons here seem to be able to understand speech.

introduced.name: Radiant Fragments
introduced.how: energy fragments placed on Radiant Pillars to dispel Abyssal filth
introduced.quote: Can we place them here to dispel the nearby filth?

introduced.name: Abyssal Blight
introduced.how: corrupting filth seeping down from above that spreads through places
introduced.quote: This is nascent Abyssal Blight. Looks like it's seeping down from above

assumed.name: Bona
assumed.quote: This strange fortress looks just like the place where we met you, Bona.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Paimon gets it now. Coco didn't want to come in because of the Abyss.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: Did you forget that I'm an adventurer of the Flower-Feather Clan?

assumed.name: Golden Entreaty
assumed.quote: Isn't that the big black dragon on the mural in the ruins where we got the first Golden Entreaty?

assumed.name: Liriwu
assumed.quote: I saw the signs left by Aunt Liriwu

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: make sure you two tell everyone at the Adventurers' Guild about what we've done, alright?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: telling Katheryne will be as good as telling all of Teyvat!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: telling Katheryne will be as good as telling all of Teyvat!

assumed.name: Saurian
assumed.quote: Don't worry, our little Saurian's a brave soul.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: It's rare to find adventurers who emphasize the journey in Natlan.

threads.claim: Most people think the Tonatiuh is only a dream and its existence has never been proven.
