threads.quote: Most think it's just a dream, an illusion. A fantasy that people suffering due to the Abyss find solace in.

threads.claim: The party finally sees the Tonatiuh in the sky, confirming it is real.
threads.quote: Is that the Tonatiuh? Woohoo, we've done it!

threads.claim: Och-Kan's fate is uncertain, and he may still be haunting the Tonatiuh.
threads.quote: Maybe he's still roaming the Tonatiuh and feasting on his treasure.

threads.claim: Notes were left by an unnamed adventurer whose identity and fate remain unknown.
threads.quote: Month: Unknown. Day: Unknown. Weather: Rainy...

threads.claim: Cocouik may be a real dragonspirit, and its true nature is an open question.
threads.quote: But is this little guy really a dragonspirit?

threads.claim: Pyrophosphorite stores energy that Cocouik can use to fight the Abyss.
threads.quote: Looks like Pyrophosphorites contain the energy as well.

threads.claim: The Abyssal Blight is seeping into the ancient city from above and cannot be trusted to be avoided.
threads.quote: Hmm, I thought a place festooned with frescoes would be safer.

threads.claim: The Abyss is shown to be the reason Cocouik refuses to enter, and the group decides to purge it.
threads.quote: We have to do something about the Abyss.

threads.claim: The mural suggests the black dragon was the master of the city rather than a mere enemy.
threads.quote: But in this painting, it looks like the black dragon is the master of this place.

threads.claim: The Sacred Lord merged with the city's heart, leaving the origin of the city's machines unexplained.
threads.quote: Did the Sacred Lord make them in order to protect himself?

threads.claim: Bona argues that adventures without recorded success may be meaningless.
threads.quote: The journey itself is significant.

threads.claim: The Jade of Return is the goal that gives past adventurers' efforts meaning.
threads.quote: If we cannot find the Tonatiuh and retrieve the Jade of Return, then everything they did would have been in vain.

threads.claim: Finding a second Pyrophosphorite raises doubts about whether Bona's stone is genuine.
threads.quote: Wow, and here I thought that the one I have was the only one in the world.

introduced.name: Serene
introduced.how: Merusea Village resident who welcomes the Traveler and Paimon and gives them components
introduced.quote: I'm Serene. Just call me Serene.

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: a village where Melusines live, welcoming outsiders
introduced.quote: Alright, I got it! and Miss Paimon. Welcome to Merusea Village!

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: the people who live in Merusea Village, usually unseen by outsiders at first
introduced.quote: The village is home to lots of Melusines... Well, you can't see them here, but you will if you keep going forward.

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: Serene's quiet ward who is always alone and rarely speaks to Serene
introduced.quote: That child's always alone and never tells me about anything...

introduced.name: Components
introduced.how: collected scattered parts that the village uses and that can repair Seymour
introduced.quote: These components are both lovely and useful to the village

introduced.name: Windwheel Aster
introduced.how: a tough wild flower named after the windwheels that spin in the wind
introduced.quote: Windwheel Asters are called that because they spin in the wind as well.

introduced.name: Silk Flower
introduced.how: a flower from distant lands that is beautiful and can be worn
introduced.quote: The flowers themselves are beautiful too, and they can even be worn!

introduced.name: Naku Weed
introduced.how: a flower that vibrates before storms and is used by locals to predict them
introduced.quote: Naku Weeds can even grow in places that are stormy all year round.

introduced.name: Sumeru Rose
introduced.how: a tough rainforest rose with a distinctive scent used in perfume and desserts
introduced.quote: But the Sumeru Rose's most distinguishing feature is its scent!

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: a robotic dog-like relay module that wakes from hibernation and reveals its pre-recorded replies
introduced.quote: Relay module detected. Environment check... Contamination levels: High. Activating in Safe Mode.

introduced.name: Token
introduced.how: a memento every Melusine is born with, proof that they are alive
introduced.quote: They were the first memento we received when we arrived in this beautiful world — they are proof that we are alive.

introduced.name: Father
introduced.how: a voice only Mamere can hear, whom she speaks to and who guides her
introduced.quote: No one can hear his voice, just like how no one can understand the paintings' contents.

introduced.name: Glaisti
introduced.how: a Melusine who hid among rocks from monsters and asks for help rescuing her friend
introduced.quote: Sorry! Did I scare you?

introduced.name: Puca
introduced.how: a young Melusine trapped in seagrass who is rescued by the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: I'm just a normal Melusine, and I'm not tasty at all!

introduced.name: Rifthounds
introduced.how: hostile monsters that jump out of glowing circles and appear alongside the quakes
introduced.quote: Those monsters kinda just came jumping out of those glowing circles

introduced.name: Virda
introduced.how: self-titled apprentice agent of the Marechaussee Phantom who was training alone and chases suspicious humans
introduced.quote: My name is Virda, but just call me Vi. I'm an apprentice agent of the Marechaussee Phantom!

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: Fontaine's authorities, which Virda belongs to in name
introduced.quote: Ooh, so you're with the authorities in Fontaine!

introduced.name: Irus
introduced.how: a mercenary who admits being hired to fetch ores and recounts Jakob's dealings
introduced.quote: That madman got us to bring him those red stones... Y'know, those you gathered previously.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: a purple-clad man who hired mercenaries to gather ores and steal paintings and then left them unpaid
introduced.quote: After leaving your place, that Jakob guy led us to the intersection up ahead.

introduced.name: Quakes
introduced.how: recurring earthquakes that come with the monsters and the red screen effect
introduced.quote: It was accompanied by a quake this time...

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: This must be reported to Monsieur Neuvillette immediately.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: we could go somewhere like the Fontaine Research Institute and find someone to help us

assumed.name: Sedile
assumed.quote: One day, though, I'll be a proper agent, just like Sedile!

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: From the Raiden Shogun? ...Wait, but thunder isn't fertilizer in the first place!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: (Y'know, Paimon, you find Mora beautiful.)

assumed.name: Elynas
assumed.quote: Still, what are these things doing inside Elynas?

threads.claim: Mamere hears a voice she calls Father that no one else can hear, and it guides her actions.
threads.quote: Father says... it's dangerous, hurry...

threads.claim: The Traveler hears the same voice during Mamere's distress, linking the Traveler to Father.
threads.quote: (That means that the voice I heard then was...)

threads.claim: Environmental contamination is rising and linked to the quakes and the appearance of monsters.
threads.quote: Warning. Extreme increase in environmental contamination detected.

threads.claim: Jakob may have summoned the monsters through a hand-sign and an unknown language, and the monsters attack Melusines elsewhere.
threads.quote: he did some hand-sign and blabbered out... something in a language I didn't know.

threads.claim: Seymour has a master he is bound to protect, but Seymour cannot identify who that master is.
threads.quote: However, she is not my master. My master is...

threads.claim: Seymour's memories are damaged, and his searches for critical data fail.
threads.quote: Some of my memories have suffered light damage.

threads.claim: Father says the token and components together can cure Seymour.
threads.quote: Father said that if we put this in as well, we'd be able to cure Seymour...

threads.claim: Seymour's lost relay module is restored after the Traveler and Paimon gather components and help him.
threads.quote: In any case, thank you all for your help in restoring my lost relay module.

threads.claim: Melusines' birth is unclear, and they arrived in this world with tokens as their first memento.
threads.quote: Actually, Paimon's not sure how Melusines are born in the first place!

threads.claim: The Traveler experiences hallucinations linked to the contamination and the quakes.
threads.quote: (Could that be related to the hallucinations I saw earlier...?)

introduced.name: Thoma
introduced.how: Thoma introduces himself as the Yashiro Commission's housekeeper
introduced.quote: Thoma: I'm Thoma, the housekeeper for the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: a body with many staff, where Thoma works as a housekeeper
introduced.quote: Thoma: I don't think we need to go down that route, though... in any case, as a housekeeper, it's hardly my place to get all high and mighty with other staff in the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: a decree that hurt Ritou's trade and drove away its prosperity
introduced.quote: Thoma: Ritou's been going downhill ever since the Sakoku Decree took effect.

introduced.name: International Trade Association
introduced.how: a merchant group formed to help merchants harmed by the Sakoku Decree
introduced.quote: Thoma: Merchants have faced hostility at every turn. That's why the International Trade Association got together...

introduced.name: Keiichi
introduced.how: a merchant who introduces himself and says he owes Thoma for help
introduced.quote: Keiichi: No, no, you don't know me, but I've heard of you before.

introduced.name: Shuumatsuban
introduced.how: a secret ninja organization answering only to the Yashiro Commissioner
introduced.quote: Thoma: That's right — the Shuumatsuban only answer to the Yashiro Commissioner, Kamisato Ayato.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: the Yashiro Commissioner who lets Thoma bend rules in special cases
introduced.quote: Thoma: However, I was talking to Commissioner Ayato a while back, and he agreed to let me bend the rules in exceptional circumstances.

introduced.name: Taroumaru
introduced.how: a ninja dog who is always on guard
introduced.quote: Thoma: Well, you'll rarely see Taroumaru roll onto his back, though. He's a ninja dog, so he's always on guard in case an enemy approaches...

introduced.name: Inu Shoushou
introduced.how: a red Shiba ninken who was left behind by a Shuumatsuban ninja
introduced.quote: Kazuaki: Ah, I think I know. You must be talking about Inu Shoushou.

introduced.name: Kunai
introduced.how: a ninja blade whose tip wore blunt from its owner's training
introduced.quote: A kunai that has lost its edge. You've heard that its user once used it while being put through a tough regimen.

introduced.name: Sailing Breeze
introduced.how: a shop in Ritou selling Mondstadt wines
introduced.quote: Thoma: This is Sailing Breeze, a purveyor of Mondstadt wines.

introduced.name: Chuyu Trading Company
introduced.how: a Liyue trading firm with a branch in Ritou selling ore
introduced.quote: Thoma: This is a branch of the Chuyu Trading Company, based in Liyue. They sell ore from that region.

introduced.name: Yumeno Tennenan
introduced.how: a shop renowned for Inazuman confectionery
introduced.quote: Keiichi: That's right! So here it is — some confectionery from Yumeno Tennenan, a fine purveyor of Inazuman delicacies.

introduced.name: Thoma's shipwreck
introduced.how: a storm sank Thoma's boat on the trip from Mondstadt to Inazuma
introduced.quote: Thoma: Unfortunately, we hit a huge storm on the way, which sank the boat.

introduced.name: Housekeeping class
introduced.how: Thoma plans and teaches a housekeeping class at the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: Thoma: Well, we're thinking of starting a housekeeping class.

introduced.name: Ogura Mio
introduced.how: a textiles shop owner Thoma knows, who offers to help promote the class
introduced.quote: Thoma: As it happens, I know someone in town who runs a textiles business. I'm sure she must know lots of people interested in housekeeping.

introduced.name: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos
introduced.how: Mio's textiles shop, where Thoma buys fabric
introduced.quote: Ogura Mio: Welcome to Ogura Textiles & Kimo... Oh! Hi, Thoma! What brings you here?

introduced.name: Furuta
introduced.how: the Kamisato Clan's butler, whom Hirano suggests as an expert
introduced.quote: Hirano: As the Kamisato Clan's butler, I'm sure she'd know a lot about housekeeping.

introduced.name: Thoma's first stray dog
introduced.how: Thoma shared an onigiri with a stray under a tree on a rainy day, after being turned away by a clan elder
introduced.quote: Thoma: I still remember the first time I fed it. It was a rainy day.

introduced.name: Kiyoe
introduced.how: Yashiro Commission staffer who explains the lost shipment and the merchant dispute
introduced.quote: Kiyoe: Basically, something downright awful's happened, and we're discussing what on earth we should do about it...

introduced.name: Masanobu
introduced.how: Yashiro Commission staffer who greets visitors at the Commission
introduced.quote: Masanobu: Greetings, welcome to the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Yuusaku
introduced.how: Narukami Island merchant who raised prices sky-high when the Commission urgently needed goods
introduced.quote: Kiyoe: But he's a shrewd one. He caught on to the fact that we needed the goods urgently and raised prices sky-high.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Has no direct authority over merchants, so it cannot force a price or sanction a seller
introduced.quote: The Yashiro Commission doesn't have any direct authority over merchants.

introduced.name: Kazumasa
introduced.how: Yashiro Commission samurai who pressures Yuusaku and serves the clan head
introduced.quote: Kazumasa: We serve the head of the clan. If the clan is in trouble, we must bear whatever humiliation comes our way to resolve the situation.

introduced.name: Furusawa
introduced.how: Yashiro Commission samurai who goes with Kazumasa to press Yuusaku on price
introduced.quote: Furusawa: But the samurai spirit...

introduced.name: Yuusaku's feud with the Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Yuusaku once sold defective ceremonial implements, which were returned and exposed, so he holds a grudge
introduced.quote: Kiyoe: He once sold us some ceremonial implements of exceptionally poor quality. We returned the items and exposed his malpractice in the process.

introduced.name: Yuusaku's jailing
introduced.how: Yuusaku was locked up by the Tenryou Commission after Thoma reported his goods as cheap fakes
introduced.quote: Yuusaku: Do you know how long the Tenryou Commission locked me up for? And all thanks to you, going on about my goods being cheap fakes!

introduced.name: Lost ceremonial shipment
introduced.how: The Commission's ceremonial implements sank to the ocean floor when their ship was hit by strong winds
introduced.quote: Kiyoe: But as luck would have it, our ship got hit by strong winds out at sea. The entire shipment is now sitting at the bottom of the ocean.

introduced.name: Yasutake
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission quartermaster in charge of procurement and weapon supplies
introduced.quote: Thoma: That was the quartermaster of the Tenryou Commission. He's in charge of all their procurement, and also responsible for keeping their weapon supplies intact.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Holds Yuusaku in custody and runs a quartermaster-led procurement system for weapon supplies
introduced.quote: Thoma: That was the quartermaster of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Iron Ore trade
introduced.how: Trade in Iron Ore is driven by weapon-making procurement, with the quartermaster as key decision-maker
introduced.quote: Thoma: Making weapons involves purchasing raw materials, so he's the key decision-maker in all the related trade in Iron Ore.

introduced.name: Hironori
introduced.how: Delivery worker whose Iron Ore cargo was attacked by monsters on the road
introduced.quote: Hironori: Argh, man this hurts... those monsters came out of nowhere..

introduced.name: Sakai
introduced.how: Lender who gave Yuusaku a loan with a long repayment period
introduced.quote: Sakai: You betcha. The guy owes me Mora, for sure, but there's a long repayment period on that loan.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Furusawa: Oh, well, no wonder. What do you think Miss Kamisato even sees in that guy?

assumed.name: Kamisato Clan
assumed.quote: Thoma: If a little private gossiping helps them let off some steam, well, good for them. It does no harm to the Kamisato Clan.

assumed.name: Komore Teahouse
assumed.quote: Thoma: Today it's time for a hard-earned rest. There's been so much to deal with since I got out of Komore Teahouse — this vacation's been a long time coming.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: Thoma: Hehe, back to where we first met. I haven't been there in a long time, actually.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Thoma: You've been to Mondstadt, right? I assume you've been to the Angel's Share?

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: Thoma: You've been to Mondstadt, right? I assume you've been to the Angel's Share?

assumed.name: Dawn Winery
assumed.quote: Thoma: It must be said though, the wines here aren't quite up to the Dawn Winery standard...

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: Thoma: Narukami Island will be packed right now, so we could go to Ritou instead.

assumed.name: Hanamizaka
assumed.quote: Thoma: There's a sakura tree in Hanamizaka where I go to feed them. Let's meet there in a short while.

assumed.name: Kurisu
assumed.quote: Traveler: I wonder how Kurisu's doing?

assumed.name: Katsuie
assumed.quote: Thoma: We sure did. Katsuie, from the Kanjou Commission, was persecuting those poor merchants, until you stepped in, of course.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: Thoma: The whole reason I took you out was to thank you for all the help you gave us during the Vision Hunt Decree.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kiyoe: Oh... you're Miss Kamisato's friend, aren't you?

assumed.name: Guuji Yae
assumed.quote: If the festival goes pear-shaped and Guuji Yae or the Almighty Shogun hears about it

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Traveler: Do you want me to mention this to the Raiden Shogun?

assumed.name: Doushin
assumed.quote: Doushin! I need a Doushin!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Clearly he wants to take us for every Mora we're worth

assumed.name: Iron Ore
assumed.quote: Thoma: I remember last time we spoke, you were grumbling about a lack of Iron Ore.

assumed.name: Noctilucous Jade
assumed.quote: Weren't you after some Noctilucous Jade last time we spoke?

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: Last I heard you were in Ritou... then you just vanished into thin air.

assumed.name: Kamisato Clan
assumed.quote: Kazumasa: We serve the head of the clan. If the clan is in trouble, we must bear whatever humiliation comes our way to resolve the situation.

threads.claim: Thoma survived a storm that sank his boat on the way to Inazuma, and the full story is being held back.
threads.quote: Thoma: I'll spare you the rest for now. Lemme take you around.

threads.claim: Thoma's father's omamori may have been the reason he survived the storm and reached Inazuma.
threads.quote: Thoma: Who knows, maybe this omamori was the only reason I survived the storm and made it to Inazuma in the first place.

threads.claim: Thoma's father moved back to Inazuma and vanished, and his fate is unknown.
threads.quote: Thoma: Later, my father moved back to Inazuma, and then we never heard from him.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree has badly hurt trade and business in Ritou.
threads.quote: Thoma: The Sakoku Decree has not been good for business.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree has been abolished and Ritou's trade is starting to recover.
threads.quote: Thoma: I heard the Shogun recently abolished the Sakoku Decree, and trade and commerce is already starting to recover.

threads.claim: Ritou's past is tied to freedom of trade, culture, and lifestyle, which the Sakoku Decree took away.
threads.quote: Thoma: Freedom of trade, freedom of culture, and freedom of lifestyle.

threads.claim: The ninja dog's owner has gone missing, and the dog keeps waiting for him on the beach.
threads.quote: Thoma: It's extremely rare to find them on their own in the wild. So it makes me a little concerned.

threads.claim: The ninja dog's owner died on a dangerous sea mission and will never return.
threads.quote: Kazuaki: What I can tell you is they went out to sea on a dangerous mission, and... he won't be coming back.

threads.claim: Thoma wants a long vacation to travel home, but he has too many duties to leave.
threads.quote: Thoma: Once I'm on top of things, I think I'll have to ask milady for a long vacation, so I can take a trip back home.

threads.claim: A gift given to repay a favor is transactional, while a gift given freely carries more meaning.
threads.quote: Thoma: If you lend Mora to someone, you can guarantee that any gift you receive in return will have been chosen according to its material value.

threads.claim: Thoma's father spoke fondly of the Angel's Share, and Thoma never got to drink there with him.
threads.quote: Thoma: Back when my father was still in Mondstadt, he used to talk fondly of the Angel's Share.

threads.claim: After the Sakoku Decree ended, the International Trade Association is split by disagreements, and Kurisu is mediating.
threads.quote: Thoma: Now that the Sakoku Decree has ended, there's some disagreements within the International Trade Association. He's doing his best to mediate.

threads.claim: People are gossiping about Thoma behind his back, a rumour that Masanobu dismisses.
threads.quote: Masanobu: People have been talking about him behind his back? Surely not.

threads.claim: Thoma says reputation matters little to him and that being close to people who know the real him is enough.
threads.quote: Thoma: I'm just the housekeeper of the Kamisato Clan — reputation isn't all that important to me. On the contrary, having too good of a reputation can be restrictive.

threads.claim: Yuusaku resents the Yashiro Commission and will not back down now that he can get revenge.
threads.quote: Kiyoe: He's resented us ever since. Now that he actually has the chance to get back at us, there's no way he'll back down.

threads.claim: Thoma resolves the feud privately by cutting off Yuusaku's customers and loan revenue, forcing him to apologize.
threads.quote: Thoma: So the solution in this case was to cut off his main line of business, and make him really feel the heat.

threads.claim: Thoma routinely cleans up problems for others behind the scenes, which takes up his personal time.
threads.quote: Yasutake: You always seem to be cleaning up for other people behind the scenes, it must keep you pretty busy. Seems to eat up all of your personal time, too.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses a hidden agenda in Sakai's dealings and doubts he can be trusted.
threads.quote: Traveler: It felt like there was a subtext to your whole conversation...

threads.claim: A convoy of Iron Ore was attacked by monsters that appeared from nowhere, and their origin remains unknown.
threads.quote: Hironori: There were so many monsters, I didn't even see where they came from... It was a dicey situation...

threads.claim: The Iron Ore trade seems unrelated to ceremonial affairs, but the Traveler is told the link will be revealed.
threads.quote: Thoma: On the surface, not a whole lot, I'll admit. But you'll see. Very shortly.

introduced.name: Vennessa
introduced.how: first Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, who sealed Ursa away
introduced.quote: After the Knights of Favonius were founded, our first Grand Master, Vennessa, sealed it away with the Anemo Archon's help.

introduced.name: Ursa the Drake
introduced.how: ancient dragon that first appeared in Mondstadt a thousand years ago and brought calamity
introduced.quote: Ursa the Drake was a dragon who first appeared in Mondstadt a thousand years ago, bringing calamity with its immense might.

introduced.name: Eroch
introduced.how: former Inspector and the greatest Knights traitor in a hundred years, who colluded with The Doctor
introduced.quote: He was the then-Inspector of the Knights of Favonius, and the greatest traitor to the Knights in a hundred years — Eroch.

introduced.name: Crepus
introduced.how: Diluc's father, a merchant who drove Ursa off and died doing so
introduced.quote: But the swaggering dragon was driven back by a mere merchant — Diluc's father, Crepus... who paid the ultimate price.

introduced.name: Diluc
introduced.how: former Cavalry Captain who held the youngest-Captain record
introduced.quote: The previous record holder was our former Cavalry Captain, Diluc.

introduced.name: Adorno
introduced.how: the Benevolent Knight, Captain of the 5th Company and Lohen's direct superior
introduced.quote: Adorno the Benevolent Knight. Captain of the 5th Company, and my direct superior.

introduced.name: Lohen
introduced.how: Vice Captain of the 5th Company, set to inherit the Benevolent Knight title
introduced.quote: And Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company.

introduced.name: Theodore
introduced.how: trainee medic with the 8th Company who helped build the simulation
introduced.quote: And this is Theodore, a trainee medic with the 8th Company.

introduced.name: Rächer of Solnari
introduced.how: former Sinner with Abyssal powers, banished by the party after a fight
introduced.quote: He was a Sinner who once set his face against the world...

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: Consider this a direct order from yours truly, the Grand Master, so don't go using work as an excuse, you hear?

introduced.name: Benevolent Knight
introduced.how: knightly title given to honor conduct, held by Adorno and to pass to Lohen
introduced.quote: But in the vast majority of cases, they are titles conferred to honor said knight's conduct and achievements.

introduced.name: Ursa's Flesh serum
introduced.how: Eroch and a Dottore Segment extracted Ursa's power into a serum that drove users mad
introduced.quote: Varka: In his pursuit of transcendent power, he once conspired with one of Dottore's Segments to extract a serum containing the power of Ursa the Drake from the dragon's flesh.

introduced.name: Children kidnapping rescue
introduced.how: Eroch's cronies kidnapped children for experiments, and the Knights intercepted them and rescued everyone
introduced.quote: Adorno: They cut their experiments short and tried to transport their victims away... But we intercepted them in transit and rescued everyone.

introduced.name: Simulation Training Bubble: Type 02
introduced.how: magic bubble that recreates senior knights' memories as training enemies
introduced.quote: Are you here to assist with the development tests for the Simulation Training Bubble: Type 02?

introduced.name: Ursa-flesh monsters
introduced.how: beasts bearing Ursa's Flesh that form packs yet attack their own kind
introduced.quote: Varka: Because such beasts, bearing Ursa's Flesh, have appeared before, and not just once, either.

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: Diluc's family winery whose caravans pass through Dornman Port
introduced.quote: Dawn Winery's caravans pass through Dornman Port.

introduced.name: Friendship fee
introduced.how: Lohen's allowance-based 'friendly custom' of paying money to friends
introduced.quote: I receive an allowance for special missions. Guess it all piled up before I knew it.

introduced.name: Ursa
introduced.how: a legendary drake whose power has haunted the land for a thousand years
introduced.quote: The legend of Ursa has haunted this land for a thousand years, after all.

introduced.name: Ursa's Flesh
introduced.how: remains of Ursa buried beneath the facility, source of its dangerous power
introduced.quote: Varka: For now, I'm more concerned about the remains of Ursa's Flesh, buried here beneath the ground...

introduced.name: Ursa serum
introduced.how: a high-concentration serum extracted from Ursa's flesh that grants power and extends life
introduced.quote: Theodore: Lohen, listen to me! The Ursa serum works!

introduced.name: Eroch
introduced.how: a mage who captured Varka and is skilled in this kind of magic
introduced.quote: Varka: ...Who was captured by Eroch and is familiar with this kind of magic.

introduced.name: Experimental site
introduced.how: a hidden facility left behind by one of The Doctor's Segments, where Ursa's flesh was experimented on
introduced.quote: Diluc: Your earlier conjecture appears correct. This place indeed looks like an experiment site left behind by one of The Doctor's Segments.

introduced.name: Benevolent Knight
introduced.how: a title held by Adorno, passed on as an honor and to be buried with him
introduced.quote: Lohen: The title of Benevolent Knight is to be buried with Adorno.

introduced.name: First Grand Master's seal on Ursa
introduced.how: the first Grand Master sealed Ursa's power a thousand years ago
introduced.quote: Though a thousand years have passed since the first Grand Master laid her seal, the drake Ursa's power remains as formidable as ever.

introduced.name: Plan to incite panic
introduced.how: the experiments aim to spread rumor and dread among the masses and blame the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: The plan to incite panic through the use of the test subjects has progressed with remarkable success.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Traveler: Talk to you later, Kaeya.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Shame we were so busy with the issue of Dvalin's corruption back then, or we'd have held a ceremony for you, too...

assumed.name: Expedition
assumed.quote: This is our first award ceremony since the expeditionary force's triumphant return.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Adorno: "Honorary Knight"... The same one that resolved the Stormterror incident...

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: Lohen: That's right, your old friend — The Doctor. Or would it be more accurate to say one of his Segments?

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Lohen: It was the Anemo Archon who scattered the snowstorms that once swept Mondstadt, the Knights of Favonius who won the peace we now enjoy through conquest.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Varka: "The situation in Sumeru is as described above... It is time to eliminate the remaining poison Dottore has left in Mondstadt."

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Sucrose: Hmm... It's as we thought — the magic Miss Alice left behind isn't so easily understood.

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: Traveler: Looks like something the Hexenzirkel cooked up...

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Could he be just like Collei...)

assumed.name: Void Realm
assumed.quote: Sucrose: No... It's not the elemental energy we usually encounter, and it isn't the "Void Realm energy" that Mr. Albedo talks about either...

assumed.name: Alder Knight
assumed.quote: Adorno: If he and the Alder Knight had been here, they never would have allowed Crepus's heroism in driving off the dragon to go unrecognized.

assumed.name: Fatui Harbinger
assumed.quote: Lohen: In the end, it was also "perfect timing" that the Fatui Harbinger who exterminated it just so happened to be "passing through."

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: and we didn't run into you in Nod-Krai, either...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Traveler: He wields Abyssal powers far beyond our imagination.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Varka: But Dottore's backup plans were dismantled by in Sumeru, a fact you're no doubt aware of.

assumed.name: Lohen
assumed.quote: Varka: Still, being spotted by witnesses and leaving traces... That's not the Lohen I know.

assumed.name: Adorno
assumed.quote: Lohen: Goodbye... Adorno.

assumed.name: Theodore
assumed.quote: Theodore: ...You don't look like you're here to assist.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Diluc: No wonder the Knights of Favonius have failed to discover the entrance for so many years. It was most likely his handiwork.

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: Paimon: Past this point... That's where Eroch and the Doctor conducted their experiments on Ursa, isn't it?

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Lohen: Eroch, Rerir, Dottore... Hah, and now Ursa? Guess I'm not destined to rise to such challenges.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: (Ursa conjures up images of Rerir, Varka, and Venti, respectively)

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: (Ursa conjures up images of Rerir, Varka, and Venti, respectively)

assumed.name: Fatui Oprichniki
assumed.quote: (Through a narrow opening in the box, they see that they are flanked by Fatui Oprichniki)

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Varka: These metal scraps and vessels... It's like leading the expedition through Snezhnaya again.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: (The Traveler uses Elemental Sight and leads the group to a streak of on the ground nearby)

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: I accept that we should send our strongest warrior to fight Nod-Krai's battles.

assumed.name: Crepus
assumed.quote: Crepus is dead.

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Varka: Oho? You really are something, eh, Honorary Knight?

threads.claim: Ursa reappeared in Mondstadt a decade ago, timed to catch the Knights off guard.
threads.quote: Adorno: However, just a decade ago, it appeared in Mondstadt once again!

threads.claim: Ursa the Drake was once an angel who chose to keep its power.
threads.quote: Varka: No. It was spared because... Ursa the Drake was once an angel.

threads.claim: Eroch's serum drove its users into madness, and they attacked each other.
threads.quote: Varka: Their strength and bloodthirst increased in equal measure, and consumed by madness, they even attacked each other.

threads.claim: Eroch lost control of the serum's power and died in the process.
threads.quote: Varka: Ironically, Eroch ultimately failed to control that power. Not only did he turn his sword against his followers, but he went to his own demise in the process.

threads.claim: Monsters bearing Ursa's Flesh form packs yet fight each other, unlike natural monsters.
threads.quote: Diluc: Forming packs, yet killing each other... It's not the behavior of naturally occurring monsters.

threads.claim: The location of Eroch's experiment site remains unknown to the Knights.
threads.quote: Varka: To this day, we've yet to find any information to locate it.

threads.claim: Someone has likely restarted the experiments.
threads.quote: Diluc: I'm afraid it goes deeper than that — someone has likely restarted the experiments.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses a familiar power in Lohen but cannot be certain.
threads.quote: Traveler: (I thought I sensed... some familiar power back there... but I can't be certain.)

threads.claim: The power Lohen released during the test looked unusual and was not ordinary elemental energy.
threads.quote: Sucrose: However, the Simulation Training Bubble: Type 02's parameters were all normal... If anything, it was the power Vice Captain Lohen released at that moment that appeared unusual.

threads.claim: Lohen believes he needs power to stay free from others' control.
threads.quote: Adorno: He's always believed he needs power to stay free from others' control.

threads.claim: Lohen nearly became a test subject in Eroch and The Doctor's forbidden experiments.
threads.quote: Adorno: Lohen nearly became one of their test subjects.

threads.claim: Eroch suppressed the truth of Crepus's defeat to protect his own plans.
threads.quote: News of this defeat did not favor Eroch's plan to seize power through terror, so he suppressed the truth, claiming he was doing so to "maintain the honor of the Knights."

threads.claim: Adorno's Benevolent Knight title and captaincy are meant to pass to Lohen, though Adorno says he may let them go.
threads.quote: Adorno: Lohen... The title of "Benevolent Knight," and the 5th Company's captaincy...

threads.claim: Lohen promises to confess to the Knights the next day, and Varka grants him one night.
threads.quote: Lohen: Please give me one more night. Tomorrow, I'll go to the Knights of Favonius and explain everything.

threads.claim: Theodore is hiding a dark plan and admits he has done wrong.
threads.quote: Theodore: And what I'm about to do... is worse still...

threads.claim: Good people can be turned into villains by wealth, power, and authority.
threads.quote: Diluc: Wealth, power, authority... Too many things can turn a good person into a villain.

threads.claim: The Simulation Training Bubble is still being debugged and its principles are not fully understood.
threads.quote: Sucrose: However, we've been debugging the bubble for a while now, and we still haven't fully grasped its underlying principles...

threads.claim: Lohen is haunted by the idea that Rerir was once a mere mortal too.
threads.quote: Lohen: ...But he was once a mere mortal too, wasn't he?

threads.claim: Diluc, the Grand Master, and a third young man once dreamed of their futures together, and the third turned to obsession.
threads.quote: Varka: Once, there were three spirited young men who imagined their futures together.

threads.claim: Dottore left poison behind in Mondstadt that the Knights mean to eliminate.
threads.quote: Varka: "The situation in Sumeru is as described above... It is time to eliminate the remaining poison Dottore has left in Mondstadt."

threads.claim: Dottore's covert Mondstadt measures are believed to have stopped working after the Sumeru operation failed.
threads.quote: Varka: We believe this means that the covert measures he took in Mondstadt have also ceased to work.

threads.claim: Ursa's Flesh remains buried beneath the facility, and its power is dangerous if stimulated.
threads.quote: Varka: For now, I'm more concerned about the remains of Ursa's Flesh, buried here beneath the ground...

threads.claim: Ursa's Flesh is destroyed, ending the risk of its power activating again.
threads.quote: Diluc: Ursa's Flesh has been destroyed. There shouldn't be any further risk of activation.

threads.claim: The first Grand Master sealed Ursa's power a thousand years ago, and it remains formidable.
threads.quote: Though a thousand years have passed since the first Grand Master laid her seal, the drake Ursa's power remains as formidable as ever.

threads.claim: Eroch's lab was found and its experiments on Ursa's flesh were restarted by Theodore.
threads.quote: Varka: ...Relying on hazy childhood memories, Theodore was the first to find this place, restarting Eroch's experiments to prolong Adorno's life.

threads.claim: The experiments are meant to pave the way for northern allies to intervene, hinting at an outside power's plans.
threads.quote: It will pave the way for our northern "allies" to step in with their timely assistance.

threads.claim: A note says Varka is back and is being brought everything achieved, hinting at a hidden figure guiding the experiments.
threads.quote: Varka is back.

threads.claim: A note reports Crepus is dead, raising questions about his role in the experiments.
threads.quote: Crepus is dead.

threads.claim: A mysterious voice offers Lohen power and claims to be an angel, tempting him to accept Ursa's power.
threads.quote: ???: Once, you believed you could control your fate by gaining power.

threads.claim: Lohen rejects the voice's power, refusing any power he does not control.
threads.quote: Lohen: Begone. I have no need for power I don't control.

threads.claim: Lohen pursues power and claims he knows why, saying acknowledging limits is the first step to transcending the mundane.
threads.quote: Lohen: Of course. After all, someone once told me.... acknowledging my limits is the first step towards transcending the mundane.

threads.claim: Lohen still has residual serum from past experiments in his system, which causes headaches.
threads.quote: Lohen: There's still a little in my system from previous experiments, though... That stuff gives you a real headache.

threads.claim: The Benevolent Knight title is withheld from Lohen, who will not allow an unworthy successor to inherit it.
threads.quote: Lohen: I will not allow anyone unworthy to inherit it... even if the unworthy successor is me.

threads.claim: Monsters captured long ago for experiments survive through The Doctor's apparatus and Ursa's power, and some were added by Lohen.
threads.quote: Lohen: ...Monsters, captured for experiments long ago. They've survived until now thanks to The Doctor's apparatus and Ursa's power.

introduced.name: Palace of Glacial Reflections
introduced.how: a dangerous domain the crystal monster operates in, which is not Novokitezhgrad
introduced.quote: This isn't Novokitezhgrad! This is a... a dangerous Domain.

introduced.name: The Shimmering One
introduced.how: the crystal monster that seeks to reconnect the Palace and take over, now revealed as Thrud's transformed self
introduced.quote: The Shimmering One: Through that... I can reconnect to the Palace of Glacial Reflections. I must hurry, or else... Hah... Where is it? Where...?

introduced.name: Thrud
introduced.how: a Domovoy princess, daughter of Grand Duke Alvis, who is revealed to have become the Shimmering One
introduced.quote: The Shimmering One: I am the daughter of the Domovoy Grand Duke. Everything is mine by birthright, including their service.

introduced.name: Alvis
introduced.how: the Domovoy Grand Duke who created the Shimmering One from his own flesh and died of a chest wound
introduced.quote: The Shimmering One: To that end... Alvis followed Hvergelmir's methods and created me from his own flesh, making me the perfect vessel for this power.

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: the Court Jester who helped kill Alvis and claimed a fragment of his power
introduced.quote: The Shimmering One: She and I killed Alvis together, yet she claimed that fragment of power before I could... She and I still have a score to settle.

introduced.name: Hyperboreans
introduced.how: ancient people who created the Shimmering One's kind in pursuit of transcendence
introduced.quote: The ancient Hyperboreans created us in their pursuit of transcendence...

introduced.name: Seven Sovereigns
introduced.how: ancient sovereigns, one of whom the Shimmering One's flesh is said to descend from
introduced.quote: Our flesh descends from one of the Seven Sovereigns of old.

introduced.name: Monomakh
introduced.how: a sovereign whose divine blood the Shimmering One claims to share
introduced.quote: The divine blood flowing through His Majesty Monomakh is no different from our own.

introduced.name: Cryo Dragon
introduced.how: a dead dragon whose remains form the Palace and whose power the monster draws on
introduced.quote: Paimon: No... Wait, this dragon is... already dead...

introduced.name: Blightkristall Core
introduced.how: a crystal core, stronger than others, that must be destroyed to stop the monster's power
introduced.quote: Paimon: Look! Is that... a Blightkristall Core? No, this one looks even stronger than the others.

introduced.name: Traversing Mirror
introduced.how: a mirror that lets the party pass through to another side where Cores lie
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ugh, that was weird! For a second there, Paimon felt like she went through to the other side of the mirror...

introduced.name: Light-Focusing Pedestal
introduced.how: a powerful spotlight that focuses a Luminous Beam to break barrier seals
introduced.quote: Paimon: It looks like a spotlight. Though it seems a little more powerful than a normal one...

introduced.name: Freeze Mark
introduced.how: a marker that can be picked up and moved to a higher position to be used
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm... This Freeze Mark's in way too low a spot for us to use it. Let Paimon move it up real quick...

introduced.name: Luminous Lamp Crystal
introduced.how: a lamp crystal that is installed on the pedestal to power it
introduced.quote: Traveler: Take the lamp crystal

introduced.name: Leshy
introduced.how: Leshy in the Palace that have been corrupted by the black crystal
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ugh, these Leshy must have been corrupted by that black crystal.

introduced.name: Novokitezhgrad
introduced.how: a city that belongs to its humans and fae inhabitants, not to the monster
introduced.quote: It belongs to every human, Volkodlak, Domovoy, Vila, and all the countless other fae who call the city home... It could never belong to you!

introduced.name: Glinin
introduced.how: an envoy from Zapolyarny Palace who is now overseeing affairs in the city
introduced.quote: I traveled with you and with that Glinin fellow. He was actually an envoy from Zapolyarny Palace, wasn't he?

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: a people with lives far longer than humans, whose royalty holds high standing
introduced.quote: They were also royalty among the fae, a position far more exalted than most fae or humans.

introduced.name: Authority
introduced.how: the Cryo Dragon's power of purification, which lets the monster reach its stage
introduced.quote: But even without her, I have reached this stage all the same... through the Cryo Dragon's authority of "purification."

assumed.name: Koshkin
assumed.quote: Paimon: Koshkin asked us to bring Thrud back... It looks like we can't.

assumed.name: Sadunova
assumed.quote: Thrud: Before all this, Sadunova came to see me... I asked if she was the one behind everything, and why she had done it...

assumed.name: Hvergelmir
assumed.quote: Alvis followed Hvergelmir's methods and created me from his own flesh

assumed.name: Kresnik Kristall
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's why it had to turn so much Kresnik Kristall into that dark stuff.

assumed.name: Teplo Oasis
assumed.quote: Paimon: Novokitezhgrad, Teplo Oasis... All of them, just for...

assumed.name: Old Kitezhgrad
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh...? That mountain has such a strange shape. Does that mean this is Old Kitezhgrad?

assumed.name: Domovoy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why would there be a Domovoy here? C—Could this be...?

assumed.name: Chief Flight Officer appointment
assumed.quote: Thrud: Hehe, perfect timing. Remember when I promised to appoint you as the "Chief Flight Officer of Novokitezhgrad," Paimon?

assumed.name: Second earthquake
assumed.quote: Thrud: There was a second earthquake!?

threads.claim: The crystal monster may have trapped Princess Thrud inside the Palace.
threads.quote: Paimon: Come to think of it, could that monster have trapped Princess Thrud in here?

threads.claim: Thrud begins to realize she is the dream and is transformed into the Shimmering One.
threads.quote: Thrud: No... How can this be? Paimon, ... I'm the one... I am the "dream." I...

threads.claim: Thrud confirms she was the crystal monster all along.
threads.quote: Thrud: No, I... I was that crystal monster. And it was me.

threads.claim: Sadunova urged Thrud to awaken from the cocooned dream and take vengeance.
threads.quote: Thrud: I remember now. At the Grand Duke's residence, Sadunova knelt before me and said, "The time for vengeance has come. Awaken from the cocooned dream."

threads.claim: The Shimmering One believes transcendence requires shedding all mortal love and joy.
threads.quote: Ultimately, for the spirit to attain a more perfect state of transcendence, all the mortal world's so-called love and joy

threads.claim: The Shimmering One argues that only hatred freed from love can reach transcendence.
threads.quote: The Shimmering One: Beneath the firmament, love is nothing but a curse. Only hatred freed from love can attain the truth of transcendence.

threads.claim: Grand Duke Alvis was killed by a chest wound, with the killer left unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: Grand Duke Alvis... There's a deep wound in his chest.

threads.claim: The Shimmering One and Aksinya jointly killed Alvis, and Aksinya took a fragment of his power.
threads.quote: The Shimmering One: She and I killed Alvis together, yet she claimed that fragment of power before I could... She and I still have a score to settle.

threads.claim: The dead Cryo Dragon's corpse seems to still have a will that cries out.
threads.quote: Paimon: The dragon's corpse... Is it crying out?

threads.claim: The Cryo Dragon's authority of purification lets the monster purify soul and will.
threads.quote: But even without her, I have reached this stage all the same... through the Cryo Dragon's authority of "purification."

threads.claim: Passing through the mirror may actually transport a person to another side.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...Huh. Does that mean Paimon really did go through the mirror?

threads.claim: Novokitezhgrad belongs to the people who build a life there, not to any ruler.
threads.quote: Novokitezhgrad belongs to everyone who works hard to build a life there.

threads.claim: Paimon rejects the monster's claim to give away Novokitezhgrad, affirming it was never theirs.
threads.quote: Paimon: Make us the heirs to Novokitezhgrad? Don't talk so big! Novokitezhgrad was never yours to give away in the first place!

threads.claim: Whether the people of Novokitezhgrad should learn Thrud's true role remains an open question.
threads.quote: Glinin: Do you think... that we should tell the people of Novokitezhgrad the truth about her, or?

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Knight of Boreas and Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Varka, Knight of Boreas, and Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Expeditionary force on foreign soil that uses the Northern Intelligence Network for local intel
introduced.quote: As an expeditionary force on foreign soil, working with them has offered us the most effective way of getting our hands on reliable local intel.

introduced.name: Northern Intelligence Network
introduced.how: A black market of intel that sells information to all factions and has contacts in every nation
introduced.quote: Aka, the black market of intel. No matter what faction you're with, it's THE place to buy and sell information.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Current head of the Northern Intelligence Network and the intel broker of Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce the current head of the Northern Intelligence Network. If it's intel you're after, she's your woman.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: Nefer speaks on its behalf and it is one of the factions of Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: On behalf of the Curatorium of Secrets... I wish you all the best of luck.

introduced.name: Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: A Fatui facility where Sandrone works, which the group must visit to find the Iridescent Marrow
introduced.quote: The Experimental Design Bureau? Are you saying... we need to involve Marionette?

introduced.name: Fatui Harbinger
introduced.how: Varka reveals that Columbina, the Kuutar, is a Fatui Harbinger
introduced.quote: So, the Kuutar is actually a Fatui Harbinger

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Followers who worshipped the moon goddess Columbina and lived without her after she left
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions have already grown accustomed to life without their Goddess.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Moon Marrows hold a moon's kuuvahki power, and the group needs them to borrow the Eternal Moon's power
introduced.quote: That's why we need the Moon Marrow — to borrow the Eternal Moon's power...

introduced.name: Iridescent Moon
introduced.how: One of three ancient moons, the most mysterious, whose marrow could restore Columbina's power
introduced.quote: Three moons once watched over this world: the Eternal Moon was the largest, the Frost Moon was the brightest, and the Iridescent Moon was the most mysterious.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: A force that has plagued Nod-Krai for centuries and that Varka says has never been wiped out
introduced.quote: The Wild Hunt has plagued Nod-Krai for centuries now. If we want to stop it for good, we have to get to the root cause of what's driving it.

introduced.name: kuuvahki
introduced.how: Energy contained inside a Crystonite, which Rerir drains to grow stronger
introduced.quote: the Crystonite itself is physically intact, but the kuuvahki it contained is all but completely diminished.

introduced.name: Amsvartnir
introduced.how: Lake where Varka and his men were led by a false lead about a Wild Hunt source
introduced.quote: The reason I led my team to Amsvartnir was because we'd had reports about a possible source of the Wild Hunt showing up there.

introduced.name: Tholindis
introduced.how: Rerir's former fiancee, whose memory the group glimpses through the fragments
introduced.quote: He was engaged to a woman named Tholindis and his duty was to eliminate descendants of the Crimson Moon Dynasty, though he did not tell her of it.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Rerir's past is revealed: he was a Khaneri'ahn under Irmin's rule
introduced.quote: discovering his identity as a Khaneri'ahn under Irmin's rule.

introduced.name: Arlecchino
introduced.how: Revealed to be one of the Crimson Moon descendants who learned of her past through Pierro
introduced.quote: revealing to the Traveler that she's one of the Crimson Moon descendants and learned of her past through Pierro.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: Controls the Bureau's machines and is a former colleague of Columbina
introduced.quote: Marionette: Let them in.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: Former Fatui member who was once worshiped as a moon goddess
introduced.quote: The Damselette: It brings back memories from the old days, when I was still worshiped as the Moon Goddess.

introduced.name: Moon Goddess
introduced.how: Columbina was once worshiped as a moon goddess in the old days
introduced.quote: The Damselette: It brings back memories from the old days, when I was still worshiped as the Moon Goddess.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: Region where the Bureau is located and where Arlecchino's group worked
introduced.quote: The Damselette: I'd like to speak with Arlecchino. Is she in Nod-Krai?

introduced.name: Arlecchino
introduced.how: Called The Knave; left Nod-Krai with two associates after the facility was finished
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? You mean, The Knave!?

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: Machine that Marionette upgrades and sends against Rerir
introduced.quote: Marionette: I've upgraded Pulonia again since our last encounter... and uploaded every last scrap of your data.

introduced.name: Landcruisers
introduced.how: Marionette's combat machines that the player controls against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: (Marionette presses a big red button at her console, sending her Landcruisers to fight the Wild Hunt)

introduced.name: B.O.S.C.O. units
introduced.how: Numbered combat units that Marionette directs in battle
introduced.quote: Marionette: B.O.S.C.O. 1, lock onto target!

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: A horde of monsters that attacks the Bureau
introduced.quote: Ozerov: My Lady, it's the Wild Hunt! A horde of monsters is headed straight for the facility!

introduced.name: Rächer of Solnari
introduced.how: Rerir, who claims to be a king's guard but is a brutal executioner who leads assaults on strongholds
introduced.quote: Orlog: His name is Rerir, and he claims to be one of the king's guards.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Prosperous former nation with stone architecture, where Rerir lived; ruled by the Vinster King
introduced.quote: Nefer: (I don't recognize this style of architecture... Must be Khaenri'ahn.)

introduced.name: Vinster King
introduced.how: Ruler of Khaenri'ah whom Rerir serves
introduced.quote: His Majesty, the all-seeing Vinster King, now guides our nation on the path to prosperity.

introduced.name: Court of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: The royal court where Vedrfolnir is renowned
introduced.quote: (Vedrfolnir, Dainsleif's elder brother... Renowned throughout the Court of Khaenri'ah as

introduced.name: Vedrfolnir
introduced.how: Court prophet called The Visionary, Dainsleif's elder brother
introduced.quote: Vedrfolnir: Hello there, Rerir. You need not address me so formally outside of court.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Vedrfolnir's younger brother, called the Twilight Sword, and Rerir's drinking friend
introduced.quote: Rerir: Heh, who'd have thought the great Twilight Sword was an even greater gossip?

introduced.name: Tholindis
introduced.how: Rerir's fiancee, who does not know his real job
introduced.quote: Rerir: Tholindis, I never wanted to keep this from you.

introduced.name: Crimson Moon
introduced.how: Former dynasty overcome by the Eclipse, whose bloodline the king now hunts
introduced.quote: Yet it was destiny that the Crimson Moon should be overcome by the Eclipse

introduced.name: Crimson Moon bloodline purge
introduced.how: The king's ongoing purge of surviving Crimson Moon descendants
introduced.quote: the purge of the Crimson Moon bloodline grows ever more intense.

introduced.name: Orlog
introduced.how: Child-seeming figure with red X-shaped pupils who reveals Rerir's identity to Tholindis
introduced.quote: Orlog: Are you waiting for someone, Ma'am? Could I tempt you into buying some flowers?

introduced.name: Memory ceremony
introduced.how: Nefer's ritual that lets minds follow her into Rerir's memory fragments
introduced.quote: Nefer: After initiating the ceremony, your minds will follow me wherever I go.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: Organization where Nefer runs the memory ceremony in a sealed room
introduced.quote: (Nefer opens a sealed door to another room in the Curatorium)

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: A businesswoman who investigates Rerir's past through a memory ceremony
introduced.quote: Nefer: I, on the other hand, am just an ordinary businesswoman.

introduced.name: Dori Sangemah Bay
introduced.how: Nod-Krai merchant who trades gear and information with Nefer
introduced.quote: Dori: If you wanna make it big in Nod-Krai, it's all about connections.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Lunar essence that Columbina cannot contain alone, so she splits it with Arlecchino
introduced.quote: My body cannot contain the marrow of two moons, so I'll be leaving one of them in her care.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: do you remember when we encountered Rerir just after regaining his body?

assumed.name: Five Sinners
assumed.quote: He's one of the Five Sinners...

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: Last time, we had Marionette and her big robo-buddy to help us, and we still barely held our ground.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Dori pulls out a flower-shaped object from her pockets before realizing Nefer intended to use it.

assumed.name: Eternal Moon Marrow
assumed.quote: she taps into the Eternal Moon Marrow stored within the Traveler, unleashing a burst of kuuvahki that teleports them and their allies away

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Marionette: Back when you were under the Tsaritsa's protection, no one would have dared come at you so openly.

assumed.name: Tartaglia
assumed.quote: Capitano sometimes used to bring Tartaglia around too

assumed.name: Rosalyne
assumed.quote: First Rosalyne, now you...

assumed.name: Varka

threads.claim: Rerir's deep hatred of the moon has an unexplained cause that may reveal his purpose.
threads.quote: There must be a reason why he despises the moon so deeply...

threads.claim: The meaning of Rerir's title Rächer of Solnari is an open question tied to his motives.
threads.quote: Perhaps it'd shed some light on his title, the

threads.claim: Rerir's true objective is unknown and may be more than gathering kuuvahki.
threads.quote: Rerir's true objective remains unclear.

threads.claim: Rerir's current strength is far beyond what has been shown, and his full power is unknown.
threads.quote: And that probably wasn't his full strength.

threads.quote: If we want to stop it for good, we have to get to the root cause of what's driving it.

threads.claim: Columbina's power is fading because the world has been rejecting the moon goddess since birth.

threads.claim: Finding the Iridescent Moon's marrow would let Columbina regain her strength faster.

threads.quote: Inside, the Traveler and Columbina explore the domain and successfully retrieve the marrow.

threads.claim: Nefer is confused about how a memory of Tholindis ended up in Rerir's possession.
threads.quote: she is confused as to how it ended up in Rerir's possession.

threads.claim: Rerir's past duty was to eliminate descendants of the Crimson Moon Dynasty, which he hid from Tholindis.
threads.quote: his duty was to eliminate descendants of the Crimson Moon Dynasty, though he did not tell her of it.

threads.claim: Columbina's true allegiance and identity as a Fatui Harbinger is revealed, raising questions about her role.

threads.quote: she hopes that she doesn't become corrupted to the Abyss like Rerir did.

threads.claim: Arlecchino's hands are corrupted by the Abyss after she defies it, and she refuses purification.
threads.quote: As a result of defying the Abyss, her hands became corrupted.

threads.claim: Rerir is hunting Columbina, and she must retrieve a lost moon before she can face him.
threads.quote: The Damselette: Rerir is hunting me. If I'm going to face him, I must first retrieve the lost moon.

threads.claim: Arlecchino is connected to the Iridescent Moon's marrow in a way the Traveler does not understand.
threads.quote: I don't understand what Arlecchino has to do with the Iridescent Moon's marrow

threads.claim: Columbina splits the moon marrow, leaving one part in Arlecchino's care.
threads.quote: My body cannot contain the marrow of two moons, so I'll be leaving one of them in her care.

threads.claim: The king's purge of Crimson Moon descendants is growing more intense.
threads.quote: the purge of the Crimson Moon bloodline grows ever more intense.

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir is said to make everything he says come true, and his reaction to Rerir's secret is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Tholindis: Ah, Mr. Vedrfolnir. Yes, I've heard of him. They say that everything he says ends up coming true.

threads.claim: Rerir is hiding ties to the intelligence services behind a cover as an ordinary royal guard.
threads.quote: (It seems like Rerir was deliberately hiding his ties to the intelligence services

threads.quote: Could it be because Khaenri'ah is underground, so it doesn't get much sunlight?

threads.claim: A journal hints at the burial place of a fallen moon, a location whose meaning is left open.
threads.quote: The burial place of a fallen moon

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah's leadership treats the Crimson Moon as a dead moon that has no place in the nation's future.
threads.quote: Khaenri'ah has no further need for a dead moon.

threads.claim: A group of red-eyed beings called Orlog's kind has lost many members and is reaching out to Tholindis.
threads.quote: Too many of our kind have fallen lately

threads.quote: Didn't you say you were about to pop the big question?

threads.quote: Ozerov: My Lady, it's the Wild Hunt! A horde of monsters is headed straight for the facility!

threads.claim: Columbina left the Fatui because she was exhausted by being used as a source of power.
threads.quote: I never wanted any part in their grand ambitions

threads.claim: With all four poem stories collected, the Five Kasen story is now fully completed.

introduced.name: Keqing

introduced.how: A floating palace high above Liyue, which Ningguang keeps expanding
introduced.quote: This palace floats in the skies, higher than the peak of any mountain.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: A long war between gods that ended about 2,000 years ago and left seven victors
introduced.quote: Many gods used to walk this earth, and many long wars were fought between them that did not abate until 2,000 years ago.

introduced.name: The Seven
introduced.how: The seven surviving gods who rule nations after the Archon War
introduced.quote: In the end, only seven victors remained standing in Teyvat.

introduced.quote: Another Lord of Geo will arise sooner or later, yet how are we to forget Rex Lapis?

introduced.quote: I am a mix of human and Qilin. Adeptus blood flows through my veins.

introduced.quote: As one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, it's my duty to see the will of the Tsaritsa fulfilled.
