threads.claim: Rex Lapis is dead and his passing is a disaster that the Qixing and adepti are reacting to.
threads.quote: Rex Lapis' passing is an unimaginable disaster for Liyue, but the order of The Seven will not collapse simply because of that.

threads.claim: The Exuvia may be a decoy, and Rex Lapis might still be alive.
threads.quote: Traveler: The corpse was fake?

threads.claim: The Gnosis is not in the Exuvia, so its true whereabouts remain unknown.
threads.quote: Given that the Gnosis wasn't taken by anyone, then we must look once again to the beginning.

threads.claim: The Fatui are trying to duplicate the Sigils of Permission for an unknown purpose.
threads.quote: Traveler: You've been trying to duplicate them.

threads.claim: Childe reveals that the Sigil given to the Traveler was a by-product of the Fatui research.
threads.quote: Childe: Indeed. The one that was given to you was just a by-product of our research.

threads.claim: An ancient god named Osial lies sealed beneath Guyun Stone Forest and could be awakened.
threads.quote: I will awaken the god that lies dormant beneath Guyun Stone Forest.

threads.claim: The Harbingers serve the Tsaritsa's will, and her ultimate goal is still unrevealed.
threads.quote: As one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, it's my duty to see the will of the Tsaritsa fulfilled.

threads.claim: Ningguang's true intentions are hard to read, and the Traveler may be being steered by her.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Although she's friendly, there's no way of clearly discerning her true intentions.

threads.claim: Zhongli is closely tied to Childe and the Fatui, and his role in the crisis is unclear.
threads.quote: Anyway, Mr. Zhongli, you're one of Childe's close associates.

threads.claim: The adepti only recognize the Geo Archon's contracts, which sets them against the Qixing.
threads.quote: The adepti do not acknowledge the Qixing, they only acknowledge the contracts of the Geo Archon.

threads.claim: A mortal repaired an adepti mechanism in a single night, which puzzles even the Qixing.
threads.quote: Keqing: Anyway, for a mortal to be able to repair an adepti mechanism is quite the mystery, even to the Qixing.

threads.claim: The Traveler's strength far exceeds earlier assessments, and the reason is a secret.
threads.quote: Childe: Your show of ability today far surpasses that of Signora's initial assessment of you in Mondstadt. Tell me, how could that be?

threads.claim: Zhongli's supposed death leaves open whether the archon is really dead.
threads.quote: don't we still need to get to the bottom of that archon's

threads.claim: Zhongli feigned his own death as a test of Liyue's readiness for its next age.
threads.quote: Zhongli: So I feigned my own death, and gathered the cast of Childe, the adepti, and the Liyue Qixing to play their roles together on the stage that was Liyue.

threads.claim: Zhongli is confirmed to be the Geo Archon Morax, who is Rex Lapis.
threads.quote: Zhongli: As the Rex Lapis Morax, I can easily create Mora.

threads.claim: Rumors name a Fatui Harbinger as Rex Lapis's assassin, leaving the culprit and the murder unresolved.
threads.quote: Big-Footed Dajiao: There's only one real possibility in my mind. I've heard that the assassin was that Fatui fellow.

threads.claim: The Qixing publicly deny the murder and call Rex Lapis's death a divine trial, which seems suspicious.
threads.quote: Fengyan: Rumors and hearsay abound on the streets that Rex Lapis was murdered. Now, let the truth be revealed.

threads.claim: How the ancient sea god Osial broke free and returned to attack Liyue is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Uncle Gao: You know that god from the ocean couldn't have just shown up out of nowhere.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun has begun seizing Visions across Inazuma under a new decree.
threads.quote: Zhongli: But starting from last year, the Raiden Shogun began promulgating the "Vision Hunt Decree."

threads.claim: Inazuma is closed by its deity, which blocks the Traveler's search for The Seven.
threads.quote: The nation that neighbors Liyue by sea, Inazuma, is presently closed.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun's ideals point toward something called the Heavenly Principles, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Seven ideals for seven gods, and of these, Eternity is nearest unto the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The bargain the Tsaritsa used to win the Gnosis is hidden and left for the Traveler to uncover.
threads.quote: Zhongli: As for the bargaining chip that the Tsaritsa used to balance the scales...

threads.claim: Zhongli gave the Gnosis to the Fatui on a contract that is solely between him and the Tsaritsa.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I do not give it for free. I give it as agreed upon in the contract... for it is a matter solely between the Tsaritsa and I.

threads.claim: Mora production at the Golden House is in doubt now that the Geo Archon is gone.
threads.quote: Paimon: Also, isn't the Golden House the only mint in the entire continent? Will it even continue to work?

threads.claim: The adepti's era of ruling Liyue is over, and mortals will now shape the city's contracts.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: The time of contracts between gods and Liyue has long since passed. Now is the time of contracts between Liyue and its people.

threads.claim: The Qixing used Zhongli's death to seize complete control of Liyue from its divine protectors.
threads.quote: They seized the opportunity to supplant Liyue's divine protectors, and used the subsequent power vacuum left by my death to quickly gain complete control of Liyue.

threads.claim: Zhongli reveals that he hinted at his survival through the adepti art of gifting dreams and visions, explaining Ningguang's dream.
threads.quote: Have you ever heard of this particularly convenient adepti art known as "gifting dreams and visions"?

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Night
introduced.how: Nod-Krai's long-held festival, the region's biggest celebration, tied to the moon's closest approach
introduced.quote: Lauma: Yes. Celebrating this festival is a long-held tradition here in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: the group that first celebrated the festival, wearing Moon-Prayer Blossoms to honor the Moon Goddess's birth
introduced.quote: The festival was first celebrated by the Frostmoon Scions. On this day, they would wear Moon-Prayer Blossoms and celebrate the birth of the Moon Goddess through song and dance.

introduced.name: Moon Goddess
introduced.how: a goddess whose birth the Frostmoon Scions celebrate at the festival
introduced.quote: celebrate the birth of the Moon Goddess through song and dance.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Klee's mother, a Hexenzirkel witch who appears in person and explains the crisis
introduced.quote: a mysterious stall appears — and the “final boss” reveals herself to be Alice, Klee’s mother, in person.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a Hexenzirkel witch who explains Hyperborean moon gateways and how to recreate one
introduced.quote: The Traveler meets Nicole, who explains ancient Hyperborean attempts to reach the moons and reveals a way to recreate such a gateway through phantom projections and kuuvahki resonance.

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: an ancient civilization whose phantoms date to about 6,000 years ago
introduced.quote: They claim to be from Hyperborea — a name which I've heard from Lauma before. If this is true, it means they must be from 6,000 years ago...

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah Cataclysm
introduced.how: an ancient Abyssal disaster; Flins says Teyvat suffered one five hundred years ago and Nod-Krai was devastated
introduced.quote: Then, five hundred years ago, the whole of Teyvat suffered an Abyssal disaster.

introduced.name: Aether & Lumine's Spaceship
introduced.how: a phantom flying ship at Starsand Shoal that matches the Traveler's spaceship and cannot be damaged
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's gotta be the one you came to Teyvat in.

introduced.name: Moonveils
introduced.how: floating decorations hung from buildings that create a misty effect when viewed through
introduced.quote: Lauma: Moonveils. We hang them from buildings in the city during the festival.

introduced.name: Verdant Crest
introduced.how: a tree whose crescent-to-full moon change, with Moon-Prayer Blossoms, signals the festival
introduced.quote: Lauma: On this day, the crescent moon at the top branches of the Verdant Crest turns into a full moon, and the Moon-Prayer Blossoms bloom with a special radiance.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
introduced.how: an intelligence broker group that sells information and investigates the Hyperboreans
introduced.quote: But I'll leave the archaeologists to ruminate over that conundrum. As an intelligence broker, my sole interest is in the value of the information I gather.

introduced.name: Phantoms
introduced.how: mirage-like replays of past events in Nod-Krai that interact with each other but cannot be changed
introduced.quote: Varka: These phantoms are reenacting real, historical events in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Hexenzirkel mage and Klee's mother, introduced to the group as a friend
introduced.quote: This is Alice from the Hexenzirkel. She's a friend of ours, and of Varka's too.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: An angel who kept her power and is a Hexenzirkel mage, self-introduced
introduced.quote: My name is Nicole, and I am one of a very few angels who have retained both their preferred form and their power.

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions introduces herself
introduced.quote: I am Lauma, Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions. It is a pleasure to meet you.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Knight of Boreas of the Knights of Favonius, self-introduced
introduced.quote: Varka, Knight of Boreas of the Knights of Favonius. Alice might have mentioned me before.

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: Second Fatui Harbinger, once a student at the Akademiya under the name Zandik
introduced.quote: The Doctor, also known as Dottore. Second of the Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Trilunar Syzygy
introduced.how: The gathering of all three moons' power in Nod-Krai, threatening Teyvat's borders
introduced.quote: Trilunar Syzygy

introduced.name: Phantoms
introduced.how: Phantoms are signs that Teyvat's border has been disturbed
introduced.quote: And the phantoms you've been seeing are a sign that the border has been disturbed.

introduced.name: Abyssal energies
introduced.how: Abyssal energies lie beyond Teyvat's border and would be dangerous if they broke through
introduced.quote: Abyssal energies are all that lie beyond Teyvat's border.

introduced.name: Moon Goddesses
introduced.how: Before the Heavenly Principles, three Moon Goddesses controlled the laws of the world and split those powers
introduced.quote: it was the then-three Moon Goddesses who controlled the laws of this world.

introduced.name: Iridescent Moon's Marrow
introduced.how: A Moon Marrow that should never have existed in this world, now retrieved
introduced.quote: the Iridescent Moon's Marrow — which should never have appeared in this world — has been retrieved.

introduced.name: Hyperboreans
introduced.how: Ancient humans who built a ritual structure linking Teyvat to the moons beyond the false sky
introduced.quote: The Hyperboreans were humans I once aided.

introduced.name: Kuutar
introduced.how: The name the Frostmoon Scions worshiped Columbina as, a goddess they revered
introduced.quote: And she was worshiped as Kuutar by the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Damselette
introduced.how: The name Columbina's Fatui comrades called her
introduced.quote: Her comrades in the Fatui called her

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: The Marionette is Sandrone, a Fatui figure who knew Columbina
introduced.quote: Oh... Sandrone...

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: A mage organization Alice belongs to that keeps a low profile
introduced.quote: none of them are affiliated with the Hexenzirkel, and we ourselves keep a very low profile

introduced.name: Razmaspes
introduced.how: a father searching for his missing daughter, who is caught in a repeating loop of deaths
introduced.quote: Razmaspes: Hello there... Have you seen my daughter? Spargana's her name. She's carrying a large backpack...

introduced.name: Spargana
introduced.how: Razmaspes's missing daughter, who carries a large backpack
introduced.quote: Razmaspes: Hello there... Have you seen my daughter? Spargana's her name. She's carrying a large backpack...

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: an ancient homeland of Razmaspes's ancestors that was destroyed in the distant past
introduced.quote: Durin: I have, but... I heard that it was destroyed in the distant past...

introduced.name: Sal Vindagnyr
introduced.how: a lost place on Dragonspine that now survives only as ruins and stone tablets
introduced.quote: Albedo: I have seen that name on stone tablets on Dragonspine, but I'm afraid the only things left of that place are its ruins.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a great white tree whose branches can be cut off and used to build a puppet
introduced.quote: Traveler: Yes. A branch of Irminsul that was once connected to the main tree.

introduced.name: Dodocommunication Device
introduced.how: a device that connects people by call, through which Alice contacts Durin
introduced.quote: Dodocommunication Device: Dodo!

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: a voice on a call who monitors signal fluctuations at the border
introduced.quote: Alice: Hello friends, it's me. What have you been up to, hmm? I'm detecting some unmistakable fluctuations here at the border.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: an expert who lays out the plan for the kuuvahki resonance process
introduced.quote: Nicole: Fine. Simply put, we need three human representatives to successfully undergo a process of kuuvahki resonance.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: an organization that cares for and protects children
introduced.quote: Nicole: The Hexenzirkel is an organization that cares for and protects children. We will not have them do dangerous things — not even tests.

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: a land of freedom and happiness with festivals and a welcoming church and Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: Mondstadt is a place of freedom and happiness.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: a nation of problems and strict order, where knowledge is sought
introduced.quote: Sumeru's a lot more uptight. Not really the kind of place where you can relax.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an academy built into a giant tree in Sumeru where the Traveler studies
introduced.quote: And you're from Sumeru, where they've built an academy into a giant tree?

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: the Damselette, a moon goddess fading away, whose name is a Fatui codename
introduced.quote: That was the codename the Fatui gave me. But it also came up in the song I heard when I was born...

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a power that qualifies people for a resonance test set by the moon goddesses
introduced.quote: Think of it as a test from the three moon goddesses to see if the entrants are qualified, with the most recognizable qualification being kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Congenital kuuvahki sensitivity
introduced.how: a condition in which people living here react badly to kuuvahki, with symptoms like the risks of transfusion
introduced.quote: Nicole: The symptoms are similar to another condition that some people living here suffer from, known as congenital kuuvahki sensitivity.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Night
introduced.how: an upcoming festival and deadline that the candidates must meet
introduced.quote: Flins: Moon-Prayer Night is getting closer by the day. We're running out of time. We need to look for other candidates.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: a power Durin can use to alter the world where a phantom is located
introduced.quote: Durin can use the power of the Abyss to affect the world in which the phantom is located.

introduced.name: Phantom
introduced.how: a human phantom whose choices and actions can be affected by barriers
introduced.quote: which in turn will affect the choices and actions of the human phantom.

introduced.name: Arlecchino
introduced.how: The Knave, who offers herself as a candidate because she can accommodate a Moon Marrow
introduced.quote: The Knave: Since I have the ability to accommodate a Moon Marrow, I should prove to be a suitable candidate.

introduced.name: Hyperborean sanctuary
introduced.how: a sacred Hyperborean ruin whose gate needs a special process to open
introduced.quote: This was a sanctuary of great importance to the Hyperboreans.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Traveler: (We haven't seen Columbina in a while...)

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: Paimon: We didn't get to follow up on it at the time, 'cause we got wrapped up in that whole Rerir situation.

assumed.name: The Doctor (Dottore)
assumed.quote: Traveler: We learned back in Natlan that he's been investigating the moon...

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: Paimon: True. Paimon would much rather deal with Marionette, anyway.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: it was either The Wild Hunt causing chaos or the Fatui stirring up trouble...

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: it was either The Wild Hunt causing chaos or the Fatui stirring up trouble...

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh yeah! Lauma told us that was coming up soon.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Durin: From everything I know about you, you're not cold or ruthless, and you're not indifferent to the suffering of others...

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: Since you helped so much in our fight against the Rächer of Solnari, I think you deserve a farewell party before you return home.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's fair. It's a bit like the Lantern Rite in Liyue.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Traveler: Although, in their case, the adepti definitely do exist...

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Nefer: And Jahoda loves a party, so I'm sure she'll jump at the opportunity.

assumed.name: Moon Marrow
assumed.quote: You said you saw the same thing through the Moon Marrow, right?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Nefer: First, the Abyss.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Traveler: Don't forget, I'm a member of the Knights of Favonius.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Columbina! We're back!

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Traveler: You look just like Klee!

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: There's still a few days until Moon-Prayer Night, so we're in no rush.

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: Come on, let's go to Nasha Town.

assumed.name: Kuuhenki
assumed.quote: Weren't there a few kuuhenki here last time, too?

assumed.name: Luonnotar
assumed.quote: What about Luonnotar? Luonnotar, you there?

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: that battle against the Rächer of Solnari only weakened her further.

assumed.name: War of funerary flame
assumed.quote: There hasn't been an event like this since the war of funerary flame.

assumed.name: Durin and Albedo
assumed.quote: Oh, and it's Durin and Albedo, too!

assumed.name: Ibis King
assumed.quote: Back in the ruins, when the Ibis King mentioned that student

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: It's not like the Akademiya has prohibitions against going abroad.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: I'd better go pay the Fatui a visit...

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: Huh, it's a Seelie!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: That was the codename the Fatui gave me.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: using technology left behind by the Khaenri'ahn schools of mechanical engineering.

assumed.name: Scaramouche
assumed.quote: (An image of Scaramouche appears, then falls away)

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: The Traveler, Paimon, Lauma, and Varka approach Nicole in a cavern with a glowing pillar of light

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: The Traveler, Paimon, Lauma, and Varka approach Nicole in a cavern with a glowing pillar of light

assumed.name: Lohen
assumed.quote: Shame that Lohen's already left. That guy's even tougher than I am...

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: And when we fought the Rächer of Solnari, it seemed like she exhausted her power for our sake...

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Sandrone has been keeping an eye out for something like that, so she informed me.

assumed.name: Moon Marrow
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh... like the place that housed the Eternal Moon's Marrow?

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Albedo: Monsters approaching from the front.

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Nefer: I'm getting a slight headache.

threads.claim: Columbina has not physically left Teyvat but is fading out of existence because the world rejects her.
threads.quote: Columbina has disappeared, not physically left.

threads.claim: Columbina says that if she stays in Teyvat she will cease to exist entirely.
threads.quote: If I remain in Teyvat, there will come a day that I disintegrate.

threads.claim: Columbina and Kuutar are not her real identities, and she has been given names she rejects.
threads.quote: The Damselette: But, they call me Kuutar. And the Fatui have an arrest warrant out for me.

threads.claim: Columbina learns the party is searching for her true name, which is needed to anchor her existence.
threads.quote: She learns they are desperately searching for her true name and that people actually care about her

threads.claim: Kuuvahki energy peaks on Moon-Prayer Night, which is when the moon is closest to Teyvat.
threads.quote: The kuuvahki in this land will reach its peak at that time.

threads.claim: The Doctor has been absent and his whereabouts are unknown, despite his moon investigations.
threads.quote: We've seen no trace of The Doctor so far.

threads.claim: The Traveler's spaceship landed in Nod-Krai and its whereabouts are still unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: When we first got here, you mentioned that this was where your spaceship landed.

threads.claim: A phantom of the spaceship appears at Starsand Shoal, impervious to attack, and the party suspects the real ship or its story can be found.
threads.quote: To me, that says that we'll either find the ship itself, or the story behind it

threads.claim: Alice recruits Albedo and Durin for an experiment, then loses contact with them.
threads.quote: Albedo: Alice contacted me a few days ago. She'd like me and Durin to assist her with an experiment.

threads.claim: Flins explains the phantoms show immutable history, and fate and history are basically fixed.
threads.quote: Flins: Yes, fate was determined long, long ago.

threads.claim: Phantoms claim to be Hyperboreans from 6,000 years ago, a civilization the Frostmoon Scions have heard of.
threads.quote: They claim to be from Hyperborea — a name which I've heard from Lauma before.

threads.claim: The phantoms may be the last memories of people from the distant past coming to life.
threads.quote: Nefer: Given the scale and nature of the phantoms, it's almost as if... someone's last memories are coming to life.

threads.claim: The party suspects the visions show the Khaenri'ah Cataclysm, a past Abyssal disaster that devastated Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Albedo: My guess would be that we are seeing Nod-Krai during the Khaenri'ahn Cataclysm. Would that be accurate?

threads.claim: Flins is six or seven hundred years old and lived through the past disasters, which is why he is calm about them.
threads.quote: Flins: Hmph... Alas, I am forced to show my age. I must be six or seven hundred years old by human measure.

threads.claim: Durin struggles with his Abyssal nature and whether he should exist, but sees the darkness within him as a possible source of strength.
threads.quote: Durin: Even before I became who I am today, the question dogged me constantly... should I even exist at all?

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions now know their past beliefs about the Moon Goddess were founded on a falsehood.
threads.quote: Even the Frostmoon Scions are eagerly awaiting the coming of Moon-Prayer Night, despite now knowing that their past beliefs were founded on a falsehood.

threads.claim: Lauma laments that Columbina's birthplace cannot grant her shelter, so she has no real home in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: This is her birthplace, she ought to belong here, yet no one has been able to grant her shelter.

threads.claim: The Moon Goddess's true name is unknown and she has never accepted Columbina or Kuutar, so finding it becomes the first task.
threads.quote: and she's never really accepted either of them.

threads.claim: Columbina has not left but has disappeared, leaving her existence in question.
threads.quote: She has... disappeared.

threads.claim: The power of all three moons gathering in Nod-Krai is an unprecedented event affecting Teyvat's borders.
threads.quote: The power of all three moons is gathered here in Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: Phantoms are symptoms of a disturbed border, and their numbers this year are unprecedented.
threads.quote: there has been an unprecedented number of phantoms appearing this year.

threads.claim: Piercing the false sky to reach the moon requires an enormous amount of power.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, piercing through the false sky will take an enormous amount of power.

threads.claim: The Hyperboreans built a ritual connection to the moon beyond the false sky, which may offer a way back home.
threads.quote: Yes, I do know a way. It began with the Hyperboreans who lived after the war of funerary flame

threads.claim: After the war of funerary flame, the Moon Goddesses lost their recognition and foundation, and their strength is fading.
threads.quote: After the war of funerary flame, the Moon Goddesses were no longer recognized by Teyvat.

threads.claim: Records of Kuutar are mostly mythologized, and the worship changed nothing for Columbina.
threads.quote: But for all their devotion, worshiping her day in, day out changed nothing.

threads.claim: Dottore has been recalled by the Tsaritsa but may still be pursuing secret experiments.
threads.quote: Accordingly, Dottore has returned at her orders.

threads.claim: Abyssal power might be able to affect phantoms, something never tried before.
threads.quote: You're saying, Abyssal power might be able to affect these phantoms?

threads.claim: Irminsul records everything in Teyvat, and its corruption during The Withering allowed impossible things to appear.
threads.quote: Everything in Teyvat is logged in Irminsul, but The Withering that once occurred in Sumeru was a sign that that great world tree was being corrupted.

threads.claim: Columbina held a Harbinger seat with a purpose the Tsaritsa never revealed.
threads.quote: The Tsaritsa's plans had long contained a place specifically for her.

threads.claim: The Moon Goddess is widely revered yet fading away, and the reason for her disappearance remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Nicole: Strange... The moon goddess is clearly revered by many people, so why is she on the brink of disappearing?

threads.claim: The Damselette's name Columbina was a Fatui codename, and she may have a deeper identity tied to a song from her birth.
threads.quote: That was the codename the Fatui gave me. But it also came up in the song I heard when I was born...

threads.claim: Razmaspes senses that the deaths he suffers feel like real memories, hinting that he is caught in a repeating cycle.
threads.quote: I haven't done anything yet, but those monsters, those deaths... They feel like memories. Like things I really did experience...

threads.claim: The barrier that guides Razmaspes seems to be controlled by someone, raising the question of who is behind it.
threads.quote: Razmaspes: Wait, is that the barrier I saw earlier? Why is it appearing now... It's as if someone's controlling it...

threads.claim: Alice has detected unusual signal fluctuations at the border that are unlike those seen before.
threads.quote: I'm detecting some unmistakable fluctuations here at the border.

threads.claim: The Traveler was a puppet built from an Irminsul branch with Khaenri'ahn technology and was abandoned by a creator who saw them as a failure.
threads.quote: I was a puppet built from the branches of a white tree, using technology left behind by the Khaenri'ahn schools of mechanical engineering.

threads.claim: Durin struggles to resist the Abyss's influence and its urge to destroy, and the Traveler warns that he may still create a new tragedy.
threads.quote: Durin, resisting the influence of the Abyss, suppressing the urge to destroy, trying to do the right thing... None of these things are easy.

threads.claim: Mondstadt is presented as a land of limitless freedom, contrasted with the stricter Sumeru.
threads.quote: Razmaspes: You say you're from Mondstadt, yes? A place with windmills, where the people enjoy limitless freedom?

threads.claim: After the all-devouring black tide passed, humanity survived and rebuilt prosperous civilizations.
threads.quote: In other words, after this all-devouring black tide passed, humanity did not merely avoid extinction, but rose to build prosperous civilizations anew.

threads.claim: Moon-Prayer Night is a deadline that drives the candidates to open the gate before the festival.
threads.quote: Flins: Moon-Prayer Night is getting closer by the day. We're running out of time. We need to look for other candidates.

threads.claim: The resonance ritual succeeds and the pillar of light expands into the gate to the Hyperborean sanctuary.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wow, it really opened!

threads.claim: Razmaspes's fate cannot be changed, though the group has made progress in understanding the loop.
threads.quote: The ending of this tale did not change, but I believe that we've just made the most progress we have yet.

introduced.name: Pierro
introduced.how: revealed as the Fatui Director, known as The Jester, who oversees the experiments
introduced.quote: even I, as the Director of the Fatui, am not privy to its full scope

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: Fatui life-force-draining power boost, unfinished, allocated voluntarily for missions
introduced.quote: The Delusions used by the Fatui have always been an unfinished product that drains the user's life force.

introduced.name: Crimson Moon
introduced.how: moon that took the authority of death; its broken remnant merged with the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Crimson Moon took the responsibilities of death

introduced.name: Three moons
introduced.how: moons that once held the authorities of Life, Death, Time and Space
introduced.quote: Long ago, the authorities of Life, Death, Time, and Space all belonged to the moons.

introduced.name: Four Shades
introduced.how: Heavenly Principles' four rulers who redistributed the highest authorities under new rules
introduced.quote: these highest of authorities were reclaimed by the Heavenly Principles, who redistributed them between the Four Shades under a new system of rules.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: higher-order beings that the Fatui contend with
introduced.quote: We contend with the Four Shades of the Heavenly Principles, beings of an altogether higher order.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: Fatui spy-training organization that is to become independent and stop training child spies
introduced.quote: The House of the Hearth will become an independent organization, no longer serving as a Fatui intelligence agency, and no more children will be trained as spies.

introduced.name: Universitas Magistrorum
introduced.how: scholarly body that long studied the Crimson Moon in Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: Back in the days of Khaenri'ah, the Universitas Magistrorum never ceased its research into the Crimson Moon.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: facility whose research hub brings many labs together under one roof
introduced.quote: This is the research hub of the Armory Palace, which brings all the various labs together under one roof.

introduced.name: Abyssal Influence Index
introduced.how: real-time meter showing how much Abyssal energy affects the user
introduced.quote: An Abyssal Influence Index meter appears in the top left corner

introduced.name: Hroptatyr
introduced.how: Pierro's former teacher who gave him a notebook before merging with the Abyss
introduced.quote: Hroptatyr gave him a notebook, which contained the truth he sought along with his remaining humanity he was abandoning

introduced.name: forbidden knowledge notebook
introduced.how: notebook of forbidden truth that would have driven its reader to madness
introduced.quote: found its contents would have driven him to madness — forbidden knowledge

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: active Harbingers must unanimously vote to recover the forbidden book
introduced.quote: he'll have to convene all active Harbingers, who must unanimously vote in favor

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: mysterious group with a connection to the Korolevskiy Troupe
introduced.quote: the Traveler asks him about the Rokot

introduced.name: Irminsul forbidden knowledge removal
introduced.how: the Traveler and Nahida removed forbidden knowledge from Irminsul during their Sumeru travels
introduced.quote: they and Nahida removed all traces of forbidden knowledge from Irminsul

introduced.name: Traveler's Sibling
introduced.how: Hroptatyr also summoned the sibling at the same time Pierro summoned Paimon
introduced.quote: Pierro reveals that when he summoned Paimon from Celestia, Hroptatyr also summoned their sibling at the same time.

introduced.name: Hroptatyr
introduced.how: a Sinner of Khaenri'ah who absorbed the Abyss and once led Crimson Moon research
introduced.quote: Hroptatyr, now a Sinner who had absorbed the power of the Abyss.

introduced.name: Eftirvit
introduced.how: a younger Pierro, a scholar in Khaenri'ah and Hroptatyr's rival and friend
introduced.quote: (A younger Pierro — Eftirvit — and Hroptatyr meet in a courtyard in Khaenri'ah)

introduced.name: Mimameith
introduced.how: an elderly professor and teacher of Eftirvit and Hroptatyr, who falls ill
introduced.quote: An elderly woman, Professor Mimameith, approaches them in a wheelchair

introduced.name: Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Hroptatyr is one of the Five Sinners, the people who betrayed Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: He ended up as one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, didn't he?

introduced.name: Curse of Immortality
introduced.how: the notebook's research into immortality is revealed as a curse of endless suffering
introduced.quote: The Curse of Immortality.

introduced.name: Blessing of Immortality
introduced.how: Hroptatyr's original name for his Crimson Moon death-authority method, later crossed out
introduced.quote: I think I'll go with... the 'blessing of immortality.'

introduced.name: Forbidden knowledge
introduced.how: knowledge tainted by the Abyss that was sealed away and later erased from Irminsul
introduced.quote: Almost sounds like... forbidden knowledge?

introduced.name: Harbinger unanimous vote rule
introduced.how: national-level risk decisions must be voted on in person by all active Harbingers and pass unanimously
introduced.quote: Any decision that entails a national-level risk must be voted on in person by all active Harbingers.

introduced.name: Universitas Magistrorum
introduced.how: an academic institution that under Hroptatyr researched the Crimson Moon
introduced.quote: research by the Universitas Magistrorum — which under Hroptatyr's leadership was also focused on the Crimson Moon

introduced.name: Crimson Moon
introduced.how: a power source whose death-related authority Hroptatyr and Eftirvit studied
introduced.quote: As you know, I've been leading research into the Crimson Moon

introduced.name: Sealed-Off Archive
introduced.how: an archive in the Armory Palace where the notebook is kept sealed
introduced.quote: The notebook is sealed in the innermost depths of the Armory Palace archives.

introduced.name: Prism memory
introduced.how: a prism carved with Abyssal power that replays Hroptatyr's memories and pulls people into them
introduced.quote: Yes, a prism with an image carved upon it using the power of the Abyss.

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: a prominent civilian organization whose members are mysterious
introduced.quote: Ah, the Rokot, yes. They've become quite a prominent civilian organization as of late.

introduced.name: Korolevskiy Theater
introduced.how: a theater troupe with performers Vodyanitsa, Odette and Alyosha, admired by Pulcinella
introduced.quote: In particular, those of Miss Vodyanitsa, Miss Odette, and... ah yes, Alyosha.

introduced.name: Project Stuzha
introduced.how: a major Snezhnaya project that was put on hold
introduced.quote: I hear you haven't had a single day off since Project Stuzha began.

introduced.name: Morepesok
introduced.how: a place Pulcinella visits, home to Tonia and Teucer
introduced.quote: I'll take another trip to Morepesok as soon as I have the chance.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: an important vault facility whose security is being upgraded
introduced.quote: Yes, the Northland Bank's vault is an important facility

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: Snezhnaya's best engineer, a Harbinger who handles security systems
introduced.quote: As I'm sure you know, Miss Sandrone is the best engineer in all of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Genesis Pearl
introduced.how: an object sought by two blond crown heirs in a parable Hroptatyr heard
introduced.quote: the story of two blond heirs to the crown who sought the Genesis Pearl.

introduced.name: Vedrfolnir
introduced.how: 'The Visionary' who told Hroptatyr the parable of the blond crowned heir
introduced.quote: Vedrfolnir must have told him... The Visionary.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: Ruler of Death who inflicted Dainsleif's Curse of Immortality
introduced.quote: Ronova, the architect of my torment over the past five hundred years, the one who inflicted the Curse of Immortality upon me...

introduced.name: Four Shades
introduced.how: four gods who can enforce the rules of the world itself
introduced.quote: She is one of the Four Shades, after all. They have the power to enforce the rules of the world itself.

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Ruler of Life, a guest meeting the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: The guest arriving today is Lady Rhinedottir, the Ruler of Life.

introduced.name: Anastasya
introduced.how: the Tsaritsa, called Mother of Khaenri'ah, ancestor of all Khaenri'ahns
introduced.quote: As I'm sure you know already, all Khaenri'ahns are descendants of a bloodline that began with you and the Third Descender.

introduced.name: Asmoday
introduced.how: Ruler of Space
introduced.quote: Recently, I caught sight of Asmoday, the Ruler of Space.

introduced.name: Naberius
introduced.how: a voice that speaks inside Rhinedottir's mind
introduced.quote: (Naberius speaks in Rhinedottir's mind)

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ahn survivor from five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: he's a Khaenri'ahn survivor from five hundred years ago

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: researcher whose soul bears Ronova's mark and who is sensitive to curses
introduced.quote: Ever since my soul was marked with the sign of Ronova, I've become sensitive to things like that.

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: a discreet, unofficial group helping Mitya
introduced.quote: Could you be a little more discreet when mentioning the Rokot, Mr. Mitya? You make it sound like we're a public organization.

introduced.name: The Jester
introduced.how: Eftirvit's alias, a name he wears with bitter irony
introduced.quote: every time I hear Eftirvit referred to as "The Jester," I can't help but feel as if I have more cause to mock my fate than he does.

introduced.name: Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Rhinedottir is one of them, known as "Gold"
introduced.quote: Rhinedottir isn't just the Ruler of Life. She's also "Gold"... one of The Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: The Wise
introduced.how: a past incarnation Snezhnaya can contact, who fled Teyvat
introduced.quote: Snezhnaya has found a way to converse with a past incarnation of The Wise

introduced.name: Third Descender
introduced.how: a past figure who bargained his life to resurrect Anastasya and was erased from memory
introduced.quote: Meanwhile, the Third Descender ascended to Celestia to negotiate with the Heavenly Principles, willing to trade his own life to bring yours back.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: a court herald's instigator who incited the gate-opening and fled to the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: On that fateful day, the Belyi Tsar incited you

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: the gate-opening to the Abyss that triggered Abyssal disasters for a millennium
introduced.quote: This single act triggered the numerous Abyssal disasters that have plagued the world over the past millennium.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: powers that erase memories and punish gods who defy them
introduced.quote: However, at the time, the Heavenly Principles cared little for such details, and immediately erased your existence as punishment.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a tool the Heavenly Principles used to erase all traces of the Third Descender
introduced.quote: At that time, the Heavenly Principles used Irminsul to erase all traces of the Third Descender's existence from the world

introduced.name: Curse of Immortality
introduced.how: a permanent curse Ronova cast under divine judgment that she cannot undo at will
introduced.quote: the Curse of Immortality was a permanent curse placed by Ronova under the judgment of the Heavenly Principles back then

introduced.name: Curse of Death
introduced.how: a curse Ronova imposed on her own to seal away Snezhnaya's technology, which ends when her power is reclaimed
introduced.quote: Ronova's Curse of Death, imposed on her own initiative to seal away Snezhnaya's technology

introduced.name: afterlife
introduced.how: where souls stay for a while after death, unable to return to the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: The recent incident at the theater proves that even if someone dies inside, their soul will be trapped there for a short while, unable to return to the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Gnoses
introduced.how: energy nodes that define the bounds of a time-slowing field
introduced.quote: The Gnoses are revealed as energy nodes defining the bounds of the field

introduced.name: Seal of Life
introduced.how: a seal formed from memories that helps the Traveler escape the afterlife
introduced.quote: The "Seal of Life" formed from your memories will help you escape the afterlife.

introduced.name: Authority of Life
introduced.how: a power Vesna can use to save the Traveler from death
introduced.quote: Vesna uses the "Authority of Life" at the very last moment

introduced.name: Eye of the Fatui
introduced.how: Pierro's power that summons sigils and a massive Electro nail
introduced.quote: Pierro draws on the full power of the Eye of the Fatui, causing sigils etched with Ancient Teyvat Script to appear around him

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: a special device visible in Pierro's palm
introduced.quote: A special "Delusion" can be seen in Pierro's palm

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: where the Belyi Tsar fled and kept some memories of the Third Descender
introduced.quote: By fleeing into the Shadow Realm, only the Belyi Tsar was able to retain some memories of him.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Traveler inquires about the Tsaritsa's mind

assumed.name: Ronova
assumed.quote: Ronova initiates the curse of death, which the Traveler quickly escapes from.

assumed.name: Rhinedottir
assumed.quote: Why does the Tsaritsa want to meet with Rhinedottir?

assumed.quote: the Traveler asks him if he knows about Anastasya's meeting with Rhinedottir

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Refusing to let Snezhnaya fall like Khaenri'ah did, he asked Anastasya to seal the notebook away.

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: Dainsleif, who had arrived on Pierro's request

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: didn't Lyney say that The Knave went to discuss something with The Jester?

assumed.name: Gnoses
assumed.quote: Though she has yet to gather all seven Gnoses

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Since this involves the Abyss...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Faced with an enemy of this caliber, Snezhnaya has no need to keep secrets from our allies.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Sandrone and Pantalone are the next two to arrive

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: If Dottore had been in charge of this project

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: experimental machines designed and built by Lady Marionette

assumed.name: Peruere
assumed.quote: When we discovered that Peruere was a survivor of the Crimson Moon lineage

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Arlecchino isn't with you... Did something go wrong?

assumed.name: Tartaglia
assumed.quote: That would mean ranking below Tartaglia. No thanks, I'll pass.

assumed.name: Twelfth Harbinger rank
assumed.quote: You lost the right to rank ahead of me all the way back at the Golden House.

assumed.name: Delusion project
assumed.quote: This is precisely the greatest problem we are currently facing in the Delusion project...

assumed.name: Authority of Death
assumed.quote: Perhaps our understanding of the Authority of Death is still far too superficial...

assumed.name: Ronova and Rhinedottir
assumed.quote: Death is not a power to be abused, Lady Ronova. You should know this well.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: The fact is, I actually know very little about the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: But during this period of slumber, Celestia only monitors our actions periodically.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ahn cataclysm
assumed.quote: Was it at the time of the Khaenri'ahn cataclysm?

assumed.name: Abyss project
assumed.quote: You mean the Abyss project?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: By that time, I was already serving under Her Majesty the Tsaritsa as Director of the Fatui.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Like Dottore, right?

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: After everything that happened in Nod-Krai...

assumed.name: Nahida and Irminsul
assumed.quote: During my journey in Sumeru, the Dendro Archon, Nahida, and I completely erased the forbidden knowledge from Irminsul.

assumed.name: Rosalyne
assumed.quote: Thinking back to when we last gathered for Rosalyne's funeral...

assumed.name: Ruler of Death
assumed.quote: that should last at least until the Ruler of Death issue is resolved.

assumed.name: Pulcinella
assumed.quote: Ah, Mr. Mayor has arrived.

assumed.name: Crimson Moon lineage
assumed.quote: As a survivor of the Crimson Moon lineage...

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: All I wanted to do in Teyvat was find my .

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Snezhnaya really face the same fate as Khaenri'ah?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Tsaritsa, huh? ...Who knows?

assumed.name: Arlecchino and Sandrone
assumed.quote: The Knave: You have more nostalgia for those times than I expected, Sandrone.

assumed.name: Delusion research
assumed.quote: That is one of the reasons I am so willing to cooperate with the Delusion research.

assumed.name: Project Mistilteinn
assumed.quote: Now that the blockade on Snezhnayan technology has been lifted, Project Mistilteinn can finally move forward.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: I was half-convinced the Fatui was out for my arrest.

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: Whenever a Sinner or the Abyss Order shows up, Dain's never gonna be far behind.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Khaenri'ah would have been proud to have a "mother" like you.

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: It certainly wasn't on Celestia's radar, but that comes as no surprise.

assumed.name: Vinster King
assumed.quote: It merely struck me that your aesthetic taste differs so vastly from that of the Vinster King.

assumed.name: Cryo Archon
assumed.quote: Am I wrong, Cryo Archon?

assumed.name: Descenders
assumed.quote: I truly do not know what it is that the Heavenly Principles values so much about Descenders like you.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: unable to return to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: The authority of Death persists in Teyvat through the Crimson Moon's bloodline and the Abyss.
threads.quote: It resides within the Crimson Moon and its people's bloodline, as evidenced by the Two Worlds' Flames.

threads.claim: The new Delusion model is said to draw only on regenerable life force to avoid lasting lifespan loss.
threads.quote: In short, it will only draw on the regenerable portion of the user's life force, ensuring there is no long-term impact upon their lifespan.

threads.claim: The Delusion accidentally drew on another Crimson Moon authority, causing hallucinations and loss of control.
threads.quote: the new model of Delusion inadvertently drew upon another of the Crimson Moon's authorities besides Death alone, introducing an unstable variable into the equation

threads.claim: Others in the Fatui know the Traveler can purify the Abyss, and the Traveler does not know how that is known.
threads.quote: How does everyone know I can purify the Abyss?

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's staged plan against Ronova is hidden even from the Fatui Director.
threads.quote: I can only presume that meeting with Rhinedottir is one of them.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa has not yet gathered all seven Gnoses but may already hold enough power to affect Teyvat's rules.
threads.quote: Though she has yet to gather all seven Gnoses

threads.claim: The meeting between Anastasya and Rhinedottir is unknown even to Pierro.
threads.quote: Pierro admits that he doesn't know, explaining that in spite of his position he is not privy to everything

threads.claim: Because Irminsul was modified, the forbidden notebook is mostly empty and holds only Hroptatyr's own thoughts.
threads.quote: Due to the Irminsul modification, most of the book's contents are left empty, and the few that remain are based on Hroptatyr's own thoughts.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr's remnant appears to the group and the Traveler's sibling may be connected to Hroptatyr.
threads.quote: The Traveler also meets with him and asks if he saw their sibling, but he did not.

threads.claim: Pierro's sinner choices and the Khaenri'ah fall shaped his effort to protect Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: Refusing to let Snezhnaya fall like Khaenri'ah did, he asked Anastasya to seal the notebook away.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr managed to replicate the Curse of Immortality but came to regret it.
threads.quote: They discover that he had managed to replicate the Curse of Immortality, but he soon regretted his decision.

threads.claim: The House of the Hearth is being reformed into an independent group that stops training child spies.
threads.quote: The House of the Hearth will become an independent organization, no longer serving as a Fatui intelligence agency, and no more children will be trained as spies.

threads.claim: A clash with Ronova is treated as inevitable and drives the emergency use of Delusions.
threads.quote: Pierro explains that the Delusions are given on a strict basis and only used in emergencies, of which their inevitable clash with Ronova falls as one

threads.claim: Pierro's new Delusion overpowers Ronova and crushes her under a pillar, though she survives mortally wounded.
threads.quote: only to be overpowered by Pierro's new Delusion and crushed under a large pillar.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr summoned the Traveler's sibling at the same time Pierro summoned Paimon.
threads.quote: Pierro reveals that when he summoned Paimon from Celestia, Hroptatyr also summoned their sibling at the same time.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles are asleep and may awaken to bring a reckoning on Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: Ronova also said that when the Heavenly Principles awakens, there will be a reckoning in Snezhnaya...

threads.claim: Celestia monitors the world only periodically while the Heavenly Principles slumber.
threads.quote: But during this period of slumber, Celestia only monitors our actions periodically.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether the Heavenly Principles fell asleep at the time of the Khaenri'ah cataclysm.
threads.quote: They must have fallen asleep long before my journey through Teyvat even began. But when? Was it at the time of the Khaenri'ahn cataclysm?

threads.claim: Hroptatyr left his last trace of humanity sealed in the notebook, and the Jester wonders what it refers to.
threads.quote: along with the last trace of his humanity, which he was now abandoning.

threads.claim: The last trace of humanity is revealed to be a prism memory that holds Hroptatyr's nostalgia for the seminars under the tree.
threads.quote: I have decided to engrave those memories and leave them behind in Teyvat, along with the 'humanity' this land fostered in me.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr's notes claim a death-authority method, a 'blessing of immortality', that could save Mimameith.
threads.quote: With the power of an authority on the level of the very rules of the world, it's possible to avoid death entirely.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr's notes reveal that the immortality method was a curse bringing only endless pain and suffering.
threads.quote: It is no blessing at all. It could never be... 'Immortality' of this kind offers only endless pain and suffering.

threads.claim: The notebook's forbidden knowledge was sealed away, and most of its contents are now blank.
threads.quote: Much of its contents are now blank, presumably forbidden knowledge that has been erased.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Nahida erased the Abyss-tainted forbidden knowledge from Irminsul, so it can no longer exist in Teyvat.
threads.quote: Today, forbidden knowledge tainted by the Abyss should no longer be able to exist in Teyvat in any form.

threads.claim: The Abyssal prism can project memories and pull people inside them, with the Jester sensing outside influence.
threads.quote: And yet, something here feels different from a memory as replayed by an ordinary prism. Could it be the influence of the Abyss?

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling was separated from them long ago and may have been in Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: We were separated... a long, long time ago.

threads.claim: Hroptatyr summoned the Traveler's sibling from Celestia at the same time he summoned Paimon.
threads.quote: When I summoned Paimon from Celestia, Hroptatyr summoned someone else at the same time...

threads.claim: A prophecy says a first blond crowned heir will answer The Wise's call and embark on a destined journey.
threads.quote: He also told me that, in the near future, the first crowned heir will answer my call... and finally embark upon their destined journey.

threads.claim: Ronova holds death-related power, and the Heavenly Principles' sustainer is a threat that the Harbingers fear.
threads.quote: Death is not a power to be abused, Lady Ronova. You should know this well.

threads.claim: Mimameith's health declined after she returned from His Majesty's Abyss research project.
threads.quote: Chronic complications from His Majesty's research project

threads.claim: The Jester's Delusion project is stalled at a bottleneck and he is racing to complete a new plan.
threads.quote: Just as we reach a bottleneck in our Delusion project, our attention is drawn to research by the Universitas Magistrorum

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's true intentions are hidden, as her mind is unreadable even to allies.
threads.quote: Her mind is like a lake frozen to the very bottom.

threads.claim: Anastasya asks when the Heavenly Principles will awaken, and Rhinedottir refuses to answer.
threads.quote: Tell me the current state of the Heavenly Principles, and when they will awaken.

threads.claim: A hooded figure stood with Asmoday, and Rhinedottir suspects this figure may be Asmoday's new master.
threads.quote: And that hooded figure, is it possible that was... Asmoday's "new master"?

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles erased the Third Descender from all memory except the Belyi Tsar's.
threads.quote: The only thing the Heavenly Principles erased from your mind... was the Third Descender and all memories related to him.

threads.claim: The Third Descender set a curse to punish the Heavenly Principles if they broke their promise, and Anastasya suspects it caused their sleep.
threads.quote: He had his own way of holding the Heavenly Principles to their word

threads.claim: The Third Descender's remains were split and have been treated as the playthings of the gods.
threads.quote: The Third Descender's remains have been the playthings of the gods for centuries now...

threads.claim: Ronova is apparently destroyed, and her last words suggest she no longer despises mortals and gods.
threads.quote: Ronova: I need not despise you any longer

threads.claim: The Jester is Eftirvit, a figure with a hidden history who called Dainsleif into the plan.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Eftirvit contacted me, so here I am.

threads.claim: Using the Eye of the Fatui drains Pierro's life force and takes an irrecoverable toll.
threads.quote: Pierro pours more energy into the Eye of the Fatui, which begins to drain his life force.

threads.claim: Ronova's Curse of Immortality created a lasting feud that may never end.
threads.quote: From the moment the Curse of Immortality was cast down... it created a feud that, perhaps, was also destined never to die.

threads.claim: Mitya's experiment in the afterlife may bring findings back to reality, but Ronova's domain could interfere.
threads.quote: there's still a chance of completing the experiment in the afterlife.

threads.claim: The six Gnoses Anastasya collected powered a time-slowing field meant to deal with Rhinedottir.
threads.quote: It was all to deal with me

threads.claim: Celestia monitors resurrections, and Rhinedottir missed the agreed window because time was slowed.
threads.quote: the window of resurrection that Ronova and I agreed upon to bypass the Heavenly Principles' monitoring system

threads.claim: Rhinedottir may be shielding the Tsaritsa, and Naberius suspects she intends to spare her.
threads.quote: You intend to spare the Cryo Archon?

threads.claim: The Traveler argues that Ronova, bound by rules and tools, has never known true freedom.
threads.quote: And you've never even known true freedom yourself.

threads.claim: Paimon may be writing her own destiny outside of Celestia's control.
threads.quote: Don't you see? Paimon is writing her own destiny.

threads.claim: Ronova hints at a forbidden creation called Eitr hidden in the Shadow Realm.
threads.quote: Hidden by Hyperborea in the depths of the Shadow Realm: the "Eitr"...

threads.claim: The Wise, as a past version of Hroptatyr, likely lacks the answers Dainsleif seeks.
threads.quote: (Considering when that version of Hroptatyr is from, he probably doesn't have the answers Dain is looking for...)

threads.claim: Anastasya, the Mother of Khaenri'ah, struggles with guilt over forgetting her past and her descendants.
threads.quote: I've just never known how to face you all.

introduced.name: Yunning

introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ah, , your timing is most optimal. Allow me to introduce Yunning, manager of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe. She has commissioned the Guild to—

introduced.name: Yun-Han Opera Troupe
introduced.how: opera troupe managed by Yunning, with Yun Jin as its top talent
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ah, , your timing is most optimal. Allow me to introduce Yunning, manager of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe. She has commissioned the Guild to—

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: celebrated opera star and the troupe's top talent who has gone missing
introduced.quote: Yunning: Look, when you're a megastar like Yun Jin, you gotta start taking things a little more seriously.

introduced.name: Boyi
introduced.how: editor-in-chief of The Steambird, a tabloid publication
introduced.quote: Boyi: Ahaha, we're from The Steambird. I'm Boyi, the editor-in-chief, and this young lady is Shiyun, one of my journalists.

introduced.name: Shiyun
introduced.how: junior journalist working for Boyi at The Steambird
introduced.quote: Boyi: Ahaha, we're from The Steambird. I'm Boyi, the editor-in-chief, and this young lady is Shiyun, one of my journalists.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: small tabloid paper that recently moved back to Liyue from Fontaine
introduced.quote: Boyi: We were based in Fontaine, just recently, we made the move back to Liyue.

introduced.name: Divine damsel opera role
introduced.how: heroine of the Liyue opera who sacrifices herself, presented as brave in the play
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Granted, she later admitted that she preferred the version of events given in the opera, with its portrayal of a divine heroine sacrificing herself for others...

introduced.name: Acting methods
introduced.how: Yun Jin teaches immersion, life experience, imitation and choreography as acting approaches
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Because as far as I'm concerned, the immersion method, drawing on life experiences, and imitating others are all valuable acting methods.

introduced.name: Liyue labor contract penalty limits
introduced.how: under Liyue law a penalty in a labor contract cannot bankrupt the employee and is not binding
introduced.quote: Shiyun: You can't have a labor contract that would completely bankrupt the employee in the event of a breach. It's not legally binding.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: stage performer whose onstage persona differs from her private, offstage self
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: But there are many more sides of me than the few you see on stage. So ultimately, yes, I am not the same person onstage as I am offstage.

introduced.name: Chihu Rock
introduced.how: food spot with barbecue and drinks that Yun Jin favors after performances
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: I can smell the fragrance of food in the air. Yes, Chihu Rock is definitely the place to go after a performance.

introduced.name: Third-Round Knockout
introduced.how: restaurant with a great view, good for tea and listening to stories, favored by one of Yun Jin's fans
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Third-Round Knockout has a great view. It's the perfect place to drink some tea and listen to a good story.

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: cramped restaurant known for its Black-Back Perch Stew
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Also, it's a bit cramped in there... I prefer open-air restaurants.

introduced.name: Black-Back Perch Stew
introduced.how: hot, spicy, fresh stew served at Wanmin Restaurant that is hard on the throat
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Wanmin Restaurant's Black-Back Perch Stew is hot, spicy, and fresh... but it's not kind on the throat, so unfortunately I can't eat much of it.

introduced.name: Grilled Tiger Fish
introduced.how: barbecue dish served at Chihu Rock, considered the best around
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Hey, have you been to place before? His Grilled Tiger Fish is the best around.

introduced.name: Chen the Sharp
introduced.how: cook at Chihu Rock who makes Grilled Tiger Fish and quietly experiments with drinks
introduced.quote: Chen the Sharp: Yeah, I don't advertise it though, because it's just something I'm experimenting around with for fun.

introduced.name: Hot Pot Game
introduced.how: guessing game where one player secretly adds ingredients to a drink and the other guesses them
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: I'll add some based on my tastes, then you try to guess what I added. Sound good?

introduced.name: Milk tea
introduced.how: popular milk-based tea drink from Mondstadt that Chen is trying to add to his menu
introduced.quote: Chen the Sharp: A merchant from Mondstadt told me a while back that there's this popular drink doing the rounds there, called, uh... milk tea?

introduced.name: Autographed photos of Yun Jin
introduced.how: signed onstage pictures of Yun Jin that fans ask for and consider valuable
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Well, people ask me for autographs all the time. Usually, what they want is a signed picture of me onstage.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: I'm sorry, but we don't have any adventurers available at this instant...

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: It's a pity, though... I was so close to achieving the state of mind that Shenhe was talking about...

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Traveler: Worst-case scenario, she still has a Vision...

assumed.name: Jade Chamber battle against an ancient god
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: The battle you fought on the Jade Chamber was a very strange set of circumstances, even for someone like you.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Boyi: What are your thoughts on Snezhnaya and the Fatui...?

assumed.name: Qixing
assumed.quote: Shiyun: 's the Traveler! You know? The one who even the Qixing will listen to!

assumed.name: Geo Lord
assumed.quote: Yunning: Geo Lord bless us! Spare us any more offstage drama...

assumed.name: Sacrificial Knives
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: Look at those red-clad scarecrows — but I want you to see them instead as those Fatui who brandish the Sacrificial Knives...

assumed.name: Chef Mao
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: Oh? You're a fan of Chef Mao's cooking, too?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Chen the Sharp: A merchant from Mondstadt told me a while back that there's this popular drink doing the rounds there, called, uh... milk tea?

assumed.name: Dongsheng
assumed.quote: Chen the Sharp: Well, I managed to scrounge some milk from Dongsheng next door...

assumed.name: Yunning
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: Yunning suggested that I keep a bunch of them on hand at all times to make things easier.

assumed.name: The Divine Damsel of Devastation
assumed.quote: Dongsheng: Ah, yes, that one is a picture from "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

assumed.name: Pine Nectar and Snow Blossom teas
assumed.quote: Yun Jin: Hmm... I wonder what kind of new flavors I could create with some more traditional teas, like Pine Nectar or Snow Blossom?

threads.claim: The opera's heroic divine damsel may differ from what really happened, an idea Yun Jin raises but leaves open.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: Granted, she later admitted that she preferred the version of events given in the opera, with its portrayal of a divine heroine sacrificing herself for others...

threads.claim: The editor probes whether Snezhnayan visitors linked to the Fatui have ties to the opera.
threads.quote: Boyi: So, I saw Gentry Maocai and a Snezhnayan gentleman come down from upstairs. Are they patrons of your shows, too?

threads.claim: The Traveler's battle against an ancient god on the Jade Chamber is treated as a strange, formative experience.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: The battle you fought on the Jade Chamber was a very strange set of circumstances, even for someone like you.

threads.claim: Someone may have scared off the pigeons at the bridge, an unexplained detail Yun Jin sets aside for later.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: Hmm... Alright, never mind. We'll come back to that another time.

threads.claim: Yun Jin hopes to one day write an opera about the Traveler.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: For now, I hope to incorporate part of you into my performance of the divine damsel. But one day... I hope to write an opera all about you...

threads.claim: Boyi's tabloid uses a false pretense and a binding contract to pressure Shiyun into silence.
threads.quote: Boyi: Hmph. You really think she still would've talked to you if I hadn't told that little white lie? Besides, what have you got to be afraid of?

threads.claim: Yun Jin's legal bluff leads Boyi to reveal his scheme and he is reported to the Millelith.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: I'm not a legal expert. I haven't the faintest idea.

threads.claim: Yun Jin settles on a mentor title for the Traveler, deepening their teacher relationship.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: And if I won't let you call me master, teacher, or coach, I've got to think of something you can call me...

threads.claim: Yun Jin's public stage image differs from her private self, and people misread her as cold and aloof.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: Sometimes when I get letters from people, I can tell from the way they write that they see me as someone cold and aloof.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: Coach-like Collective of Plenty guard who asks for patrol help and later leads the team against the Order
introduced.quote: I didn't expect to run into you two here.

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: Tribe settlement that is hosting a bodybuilding competition and is short on patrol staff
introduced.quote: The Collective of Plenty is holding a bodybuilding competition soon

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: Masters of the Night-Wind member, called Granny Itztli, who is irritable and claims to know the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Huh, I wasn't expecting to see you here. Are you here to reinforce us?

introduced.name: Mavuika

introduced.quote: Oh? Great timing, Iansan. I was just about to send someone for you.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: A Natlan tribe whose warriors the Order has focused its attacks on
introduced.quote: Ah, the warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind are here!

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: A secretive cult that has now launched a coordinated large-scale attack on Natlan's tribes
introduced.quote: I've heard of the Abyss Order, but this is the first time I've known them to take organized action on such a large scale.

introduced.name: Direidyth
introduced.how: Injured young woman who introduces herself and sees monsters only when touching someone
introduced.quote: I haven't had the chance to introduce myself yet. I'm Direidyth.

introduced.name: Savior
introduced.how: A prophesied figure who alone can stop a doomsday, described as a man of specific appearance
introduced.quote: a Savior would reveal themselves to us

introduced.name: Doomsday
introduced.how: A prophesied disaster foretold by a sage that the Savior is meant to prevent
introduced.quote: The sage said that... doomsday was coming

introduced.name: Traveler's Sibling
introduced.how: The Traveler's sibling, now the current leader of the Abyss Order, with whom the Traveler is estranged
introduced.quote: One belongs to me, and the other, to my .

introduced.name: Key to the "Hibernation Chamber"
introduced.how: A spaceship key the Traveler has kept, and a matching one found in Natlan
introduced.quote: The key to the Hibernation Chamber on the spaceship.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: A dream realm where the Traveler's sibling speaks with Yohualtecuhtin
introduced.quote: they find themselves in the Night Kingdom

introduced.name: Yohualtecuhtin
introduced.how: The Lord of the Night, seen speaking with the Traveler's sibling in a dream
introduced.quote: their sibling talking to Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night

introduced.name: Kantalo

introduced.quote: His name's Kantalo...

introduced.quote: Dainsleif realizes the Baptist is Haden, Dainsleif's former master.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: Location of the Abyss Order's headquarters, found by the Scions of the Canopy
introduced.quote: the Scions of the Canopy found the Order's headquarters, stationed at Ochkanatlan

introduced.how: Mavuika's base where Natlan's information is gathered and reported
introduced.quote: If there is any information out there, she's the one people report to.

introduced.name: Darklight Candlestick

introduced.quote: Darklight Candlesticks, created by believers in the Abyss and chaos, will constantly absorb nearby characters' Elemental Energy

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: Nation where the Order has not historically been active and where the tribes now defend themselves
introduced.quote: Historically, Natlan has not been a hotbed of Abyss Order activity

introduced.name: Atlas of the New World

introduced.quote: This also resulted in them creating the Atlas of the New World, which contained New Khaenriah's Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: Natlan army commander introduced as a friend of Paimon's who wants to thank Dainsleif
introduced.quote: this is a friend of ours from Natlan. Her name's Iansan.

introduced.name: Direidyth
introduced.how: girl who sees monsters others cannot see; met on the journey to find the Savior
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, and there's more! After finding the key, we also ran into this weird girl.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Khaenri'ahn court guard captain and Twilight Sword swordsman on a long war against the Abyss
introduced.quote: The swordsmanship Dainsleif has mastered as the Khaenri'ahn court guard captain allows him to easily espy the weaknesses in opposing Elemental Wards.

introduced.name: Iniquitous Baptist
introduced.how: Abyss Order figure who addresses Dainsleif as the Twilight Sword and claims the Abyss has won
introduced.quote: Iniquitous Baptist: Twilight Sword, Dainsleif... Is this really what you want?

introduced.name: Vinster King
introduced.how: ruler of Khaenri'ah whose title and power-seeking led to the Savior myth
introduced.quote: All that title really stood for was the Vinster King's lust for power.

introduced.name: Court of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Khaenri'ah's court that loudly promoted the Savior's coming power
introduced.quote: The Vinster King and the entire Court of Khaenri'ah set about loudly proclaiming the might that would bring to the nation.

introduced.name: Savior
introduced.how: celebratory title given to the Traveler in Khaenri'ah, now a myth
introduced.quote: "The Savior" was the celebratory title given to the by those who believed this rhetoric.

introduced.name: Haden
introduced.how: Dainsleif's former instructor in Black Serpent Bladework, now an Abyss Order figure
introduced.quote: Had you been so generous during your time at the Knight Academy as my instructor in Black Serpent Bladework, I might not have come to loathe you so much.

introduced.name: Knight Academy
introduced.how: academy with a code of chivalry where Dainsleif and Haden trained
introduced.quote: All my good deeds were clearly in the spirit of the Academy's code of chivalry.

introduced.name: Surtalogi
introduced.how: Dainsleif's co-student who was punished for following knightly ideals and lost limbs
introduced.quote: And as much as it pains me to bring up his name... Even my co-student, Surtalogi, was prosecuted for following the spirit of knighthood.

introduced.name: Traveler's Sibling
introduced.how: the Traveler's other self from five hundred years in the future, who steps out of a portal
introduced.quote: (A portal appears and the Traveler's Sibling walks out of it)

introduced.name: Istaroth
introduced.how: Ruler of Time, suspected of arranging the meeting across time
introduced.quote: Traveler: So that's what happened... Istaroth, the Ruler of Time, must have had a hand in this.

introduced.name: Lord of the Night
introduced.how: ruler of the Night Kingdom who grants permission for the Loom of Fate to work
introduced.quote: So, I directed the Abyss Order to feign an attack on Natlan, buying me some time to enter the Night Kingdom and negotiate with the Lord of the Night.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Natlan realm that appears to be an exception to the rule against new Ley Lines
introduced.quote: But then, I learned that Natlan's Night Kingdom appeared to be an exception to the rule... It has intrigued me ever since.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: ley lines explained as the collection of memories about a place
introduced.quote: Think of Ley Lines as the collection of memories concerning a given place.

introduced.name: Loom of Fate
introduced.how: device that weaves Ley Lines and needs memories to work
introduced.quote: The Loom of Fate cannot weave without an abundant supply of memories...

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: forces that lock Teyvat's Ley Lines so none can be added or replaced
introduced.quote: I'd always thought that Teyvat's Ley Lines were locked by the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: Atlas of the New World
introduced.how: product of the Loom of Fate holding the full Ley Line network of New Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: What I now hold in my hand is the Atlas of the New World.

introduced.name: New Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: the Loom-woven revived homeland claimed by the Abyss Order
introduced.quote: New Khaenri'ah... is complete.

introduced.name: Curse of immortality
introduced.how: curse that keeps Khaenri'ahns alive so neither Dainsleif nor Haden can fully destroy the other
introduced.quote: The curse of immortality means neither of us has a way to completely destroy the other.

introduced.name: Cinder City
introduced.how: Abyss Order headquarters and central command in Natlan
introduced.quote: Iansan: The location — the Cinder City.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: figure who argued that preserving the Ley Lines should come before all else, opposing Mavuika
introduced.quote: Mavuika believed that we should fight to protect our culture and memories, while The Captain believed the preservation of the Ley Lines should come before all else.

assumed.quote: I don't think it had any tangible effect on the Night Kingdom or on our Ley Lines

assumed.quote: Paimon: We ran into quite a big group from the Abyss Order just now.

assumed.quote: Dainsleif: The last time I heard that term was before the Cataclysm...
