threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling is the current leader of the Abyss Order, and the two are estranged.
threads.quote: The current leader of the Abyss Order...

threads.claim: A matching spaceship key suggests the Traveler's sibling was connected to the Order's activity.
threads.quote: The key to the Hibernation Chamber on the spaceship.

threads.claim: A sage foretold a doomsday that only a Savior could stop.
threads.quote: The sage said that... doomsday was coming

threads.claim: The Traveler matches the Savior description in every way except gender, hinting the Savior is their sibling.
threads.quote: Everything, except the gender.

threads.claim: The Savior was a term the Traveler's sibling was called before the Cataclysm.
threads.quote: which he recognizes as a term that their sibling was called before the Cataclysm

threads.claim: Direidyth's question about the starry sky hints that she may know the sky is false.
threads.quote: Does she know about the false sky?

threads.claim: Some monsters are invisible until the Traveler holds someone's hand, a strange unexplained effect.
threads.quote: The Traveler fails to see them until they touch her hand

threads.claim: Some monsters are visible to the Traveler but not to Direidyth, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Turns out there are also monsters which I can see, but Direidyth can't...

threads.claim: The sibling's Natlan superimposition is what lets Direidyth see the Traveler.
threads.quote: With it, they created a superimposition on Natlan, thus resulting in Direidyth being able to see the Traveler.

threads.claim: A voice in the darkness is heard for the first time, speaking of a blood-red sky and curse.
threads.quote: (I think... I hear a voice in the darkness.)

threads.claim: A strange noise has appeared in Natlan's Ley Lines, hinting at a signal from another dimension.
threads.quote: I sensed something strange in my dream.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order's true goal in attacking Natlan remains unknown.
threads.quote: That's what I'd like to know as well.

threads.claim: The Order's wishes were fulfilled because the sibling re-wove Khaenri'ah's Ley Lines with the Loom of Fate.
threads.quote: had finally been fulfilled

threads.claim: Dainsleif believes Direidyth is a pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn from a remote settled group.
threads.quote: Dainsleif believes that Direidyth is a pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn, with a group of them having settled somewhere remote

threads.claim: Haden admits the claim of Khaenri'ah's revival was a bluff, since it was not yet finished.
threads.quote: He then admits that he was bluffing over Khaenri'ah's revival, as it was not yet finished.

threads.claim: The curse of immortality, which Haden invokes, looms over the characters.
threads.quote: Haden reminds them about the curse of immortality

threads.claim: Surtalogi was punished for following the code of knighthood, a parallel to Dainsleif's past.
threads.quote: Dainsleif then remarks about Surtalogi, who had likewise been punished for following the code of knighthood

threads.claim: Istaroth played a part in the events that drove Direidyth and the sibling apart from Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: realizing that Istaroth had played a part in the events

threads.claim: Direidyth sees monsters that others cannot, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: She kept seeing monsters that we couldn't see...

threads.claim: Monsters become visible to each other only after the two make physical contact.
threads.quote: We could only see the monsters in each other's sight after making physical contact.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order claims Khaenri'ah has been revived by re-weaving its Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Iniquitous Baptist: Correct. As of now, our homeland has been revived...

threads.claim: Haden admits the homeland has not been revived and the Ley Line weaving is incomplete.
threads.quote: The homeland hasn't yet been revived.

threads.claim: The new Khaenri'ah is a realm grown on an Inteyvat and superimposed on present-day Natlan.
threads.quote: Using an Inteyvat as the base, I was able to grow a realm based on the Khaenri'ah of five hundred years ago, superimposing it over present-day Natlan's spacetime.

threads.claim: Direidyth suggests she and the Traveler are not from the same world.
threads.quote: We're... not from the same world, are we?

threads.claim: The Traveler reveals they come from Direidyth's future.
threads.quote: No... I come from your future.

threads.claim: The meeting is an intersection of two versions of the Traveler's memories five hundred years apart.
threads.quote: That's where we are right now — an intersection in our memories.

threads.claim: The Savior title was used before the Cataclysm and referred to the Traveler then too.
threads.quote: The last time I heard that term was before the Cataclysm...

threads.claim: Everyone prayed for the Savior at the Cataclysm, but the Savior was nowhere to be found.
threads.quote: When the Cataclysm first struck, everyone prayed for the Savior to deliver them, but was nowhere to be found.

threads.claim: Direidyth decides the Traveler is her Savior, though the Traveler is from another time.
threads.quote: I've already found my Savior — it's you.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders why the Lord of the Night agreed to the Loom of Fate plan.
threads.quote: But what I don't understand is, why did the Lord of the Night agree to this?

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night imposed an additional condition that Citlali does not know.
threads.quote: However... I believe she imposed an additional condition of her own...

threads.claim: An unnamed Highness of the Abyss Order infiltrated the Night Kingdom and achieved the goal.
threads.quote: Our Highness quietly infiltrated the Night Kingdom

threads.claim: The Traveler admits directing the Abyss Order to feign an attack to buy time in the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: So, I directed the Abyss Order to feign an attack on Natlan, buying me some time to enter the Night Kingdom and negotiate with the Lord of the Night.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's ring resets his body and his memories are sought by the Abyss Order.
threads.quote: For you possess a ring, left to you by your elder brother, which continuously resets your body's condition...

threads.claim: Dainsleif agrees to trade a few fading memories for the Abyss Order's army.
threads.quote: So be it. A few of my fading memories for your entire army? That strikes me as a fair trade.

threads.claim: Memories, spirit, and personality of the immortal Khaenriahns have eroded over five hundred years.
threads.quote: Memories, spirit, emotions, personality... They have long become eroded, fragmented beyond recognition.

threads.claim: The Traveler's memory was blank when first arriving in Khaenri'ah five hundred years ago.
threads.quote: My memory was completely blank.

threads.claim: The Hibernation Chamber key was lost and found near the Collective of Plenty.
threads.quote: We found 's Hibernation Chamber key near the Collective of Plenty.

threads.claim: The Traveler gives the key to Direidyth as a memento, removing it from the inventory.
threads.quote: (This removes Key to the "Hibernation Chamber" from the inventory)

threads.claim: The Traveler wants the might of a whole world to speak with the Heavenly Principles as an equal.
threads.quote: If I wish to speak with the Heavenly Principles as an equal, I will need the might of an entire world behind me.

threads.claim: Dainsleif suspects Direidyth descends from pure-blood Khaenri'ahns cursed with immortality.
threads.quote: I suspect she is descended from pure-blood Khaenri'ahns afflicted with the curse of immortality.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's old teacher Haden is also cursed with immortality.
threads.quote: The curse of immortality has struck you too, then, Haden.

threads.claim: Citlali senses a strange noise in the Ley Lines of Natlan, a signal from another dimension.
threads.quote: It seemed as if some "noise" had found its way into Natlan's Ley Lines...

introduced.name: Nikita
introduced.how: Starshyna leading the operation, waiting at the great mead hall
introduced.quote: Illuga! Finally! Starshyna Nikita's been looking all over for you!

introduced.name: Torchforger
introduced.how: smith who sealed the undying fiend five centuries ago and forged the arrow
introduced.quote: Five centuries ago, the Torchforger lacked the strength to vanquish the undying fiend, managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff.

introduced.name: Arrow of Terpikeraunas
introduced.how: ancient bow and arrow forged to end the undying fiend, passed down through generations
introduced.quote: They forged this bow and arrow with ancient craft, so that when the day came to end the undying fiend, it would be ready.

introduced.name: Spiralblade
introduced.how: missing arrowhead of the Arrow of Terpikeraunas, now retrieved by the player
introduced.quote: the Spiralblade you retrieved is the arrowhead it had long been missing.

introduced.name: Pillar of Embla
introduced.how: structure that has fallen to the Abyss, where the Professor stands
introduced.quote: The Pillar of Embla has fallen to the Abyss...

introduced.name: Kipumaki Cliff
introduced.how: where the undying fiend was sealed five centuries ago
introduced.quote: managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: generational guardians who have kept the Arrow of Terpikeraunas
introduced.quote: Since then, it has been passed down through generations of Lightkeepers.

introduced.name: Rauthvangi
introduced.how: the undying Professor, a mad monk revealed as the true identity behind the Professor
introduced.quote: Rauthvangi. Mad monk.

introduced.name: Cataclysm Egg
introduced.how: a threat that will hatch soon and must be stopped before it does
introduced.quote: We need to act before the Cataclysm Egg hatches.

introduced.name: Elysium
introduced.how: the Professor's promised paradise for the shamed and forgotten, where fae nobles would kneel
introduced.quote: Picture it — an Elysium for the shamed and forgotten, a place where the proud fae nobles sink to their knees before you.

introduced.name: Nightmare Orioles Investigation Squad
introduced.how: investigation squad led by Illuga that took on the most perilous assignment
introduced.quote: led by Illuga, took on what was perhaps the most perilous assignment of all.

introduced.name: Reed Miller

introduced.quote: the name Reed Miller is one I will take without hesitation

introduced.name: undying fiend sealing

introduced.quote: Five centuries ago, the Torchforger lacked the strength to vanquish the undying fiend, managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff.

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: Illuga! Finally! Starshyna Nikita's been looking all over for you!

assumed.name: Piramida
assumed.quote: (Arrive at Piramida)

assumed.name: Silver Lampwick
assumed.quote: isn't that the same old guy who asked us to look for the Silver Lampwick?

assumed.name: Wind-Stirred Ripples
assumed.quote: (If the player completed Wind-Stirred Ripples first)

assumed.name: Tower of Inversion
assumed.quote: (If the player completed Tower of Inversion first)

assumed.name: Alia
assumed.quote: I can only assume Miss Alia is still fighting to keep it at bay.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Thanks to Flins and the others, preparations are nearly complete.

assumed.name: Moonchanter
assumed.quote: Together with the first Moonchanter, they pressed on in hope of a future victory.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: The Abyssal creatures have made it this far...!

assumed.name: Serpent of All Evils
assumed.quote: This thing again... It just won't go away!

assumed.name: Return to Sender
assumed.quote: Didn't we already beat this thing before...

assumed.name: To Turn Each Sin Against the Sinner
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed To Turn Each Sin Against the Sinner)

assumed.name: Ultimate Calamity
assumed.quote: This insignificant world is but kindling for the blaze... A blaze no life will escape...

assumed.name: Grand Duke Alvis
assumed.quote: that too was a trap you devised alongside Grand Duke Alvis.

assumed.name: Sampo Mill
assumed.quote: The Sampo Mill turns its face from me once more.

assumed.name: Fae

assumed.name: Relya
assumed.quote: Relya, do not waver.

threads.claim: The undying fiend was only sealed beneath Kipumaki Cliff five centuries ago, not destroyed.
threads.quote: Five centuries ago, the Torchforger lacked the strength to vanquish the undying fiend, managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff.

threads.claim: The undying fiend is finally buried for good after the Arrow is fired.
threads.quote: That undying fiend is well and truly buried...

threads.claim: The Professor is revealed to be Rauthvangi, the undying fiend beneath Kipumaki Cliff.
threads.quote: Rauthvangi. Mad monk.

threads.claim: The Professor insists the Traveler's ally Alia is Relya, the chosen heir to his plan.
threads.quote: Relya, do not waver.

threads.claim: Alia accepts being mistaken for Relya and takes on Relya's role and legacy.
threads.quote: You might have called me Relya by mistake, but it suits me all the same.

threads.claim: The Professor promises an Elysium for the shamed that would sweep all others aside.
threads.quote: Picture it — an Elysium for the shamed and forgotten, a place where the proud fae nobles sink to their knees before you.

threads.claim: Alia reveals the Elysium was only ever meant to serve the Professor himself.
threads.quote: It was only ever meant for you.

threads.claim: Alia reveals that Illuga's fall from rank was a trap devised with Grand Duke Alvis.
threads.quote: that too was a trap you devised alongside Grand Duke Alvis.

threads.claim: The Sampo Mill holds a power the Professor wants bent to his will.
threads.quote: Now, bend the Sampo Mill's power to my will!

threads.claim: The Professor used his followers to seize the Sampo Mill for himself.
threads.quote: Every promise, every lie, you spun them all to make him seize the Sampo Mill for you.

threads.claim: Alia's fate in the fight against the undying fiend is left uncertain.
threads.quote: I can only assume Miss Alia is still fighting to keep it at bay.

threads.claim: Alia takes on the name Reed Miller to end the Professor's story.
threads.quote: the name Reed Miller is one I will take without hesitation

threads.claim: The Arrow of Terpikeraunas was forged long ago to end the undying fiend.
threads.quote: They forged this bow and arrow with ancient craft, so that when the day came to end the undying fiend, it would be ready.

threads.claim: The Spiralblade is launched from the Arrow toward the Cataclysm Egg.
threads.quote: (Together, the Traveler and Illuga push the levers to launch the Spiralblade toward the Cataclysm Egg)

threads.claim: The Cataclysm Egg is about to hatch and must be stopped first.
threads.quote: We need to act before the Cataclysm Egg hatches.

threads.claim: The Cataclysm Egg is destroyed by the Arrow's shot.
threads.quote: (The Cataclysm Egg explodes)

threads.claim: The Ultimate Calamity speaks of a patron whose loyal servants will be spared.
threads.quote: Save the loyal servants of our patron... Those fated to endure...

threads.claim: The Serpent of All Evils accuses the Traveler of unforgivable sins and blames them for its fall.
threads.quote: Sins... Unforgivable sins...

threads.claim: The Pillar of Embla has fallen to the Abyss and the Professor now holds it.
threads.quote: The Pillar of Embla has fallen to the Abyss...

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: a harbor town where the Crux Fleet stocks up
introduced.quote: Paimon heard that the Crux Fleet is stocking up in Ritou at the moment.

introduced.name: Crux Fleet
introduced.how: a fleet that runs small-vessel supply trips and works with Kazuha
introduced.quote: we took the small vessels into Ritou on a routine supply run

introduced.name: Chao
introduced.how: a Crux Fleet crewman who reports on Kazuha at Ritou
introduced.quote: Chao: You're looking for Kazuha too, huh?

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the authority that investigates assaults and handles official business
introduced.quote: in which case the Tenryou Commission would absolutely get involved.

introduced.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
introduced.how: a detective agency that knows town affairs and takes only legitimate cases
introduced.quote: The Detective Agency knows the most about what goes on in town.

introduced.name: Ryuuji
introduced.how: a detective at the Sango agency who gives leads
introduced.quote: Let's see what Ryuuji has to say!

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: a Shogunate official who offers Kazuha goodwill on the Shogunate's behalf
introduced.quote: We invited Mr. Kaedehara here to extend a gesture of goodwill on behalf of the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Clan
introduced.how: a clan of Shogun-serving bladesmiths that was wrongly blamed for a revolt
introduced.quote: In short, there once was a group of select bladesmiths who served the Shogun directly

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: secretly orchestrated the bladesmiths' revolt that disgraced the clans
introduced.quote: We later learned that the whole misadventure had been secretly orchestrated by the Fatui.

introduced.name: Bladesmiths' revolt and flight to Snezhnaya
introduced.how: some Shogun bladesmiths revolted and fled, and both clans were blamed
introduced.quote: But there came a time when some of these bladesmiths revolted and fled to Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Musou no Hitotachi
introduced.how: a Shogun strike that many consider unbeatable
introduced.quote: Well, to some, the Musou no Hitotachi is something that can never be defeated.

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: a practice that ages the user and is wrongly blamed for Kazuha's power
introduced.quote: Using a Delusion turns you old and frail, and Kazuha still looks fine...

introduced.name: Raiden Gokaden
introduced.how: the five most acclaimed bladesmithing arts of Inazuma
introduced.quote: The Raiden Gokaden was the collective term for the five most acclaimed bladesmithing arts in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Amenoma Clan
introduced.how: the only clan that still keeps its bladesmithing art alive
introduced.quote: Today, only the Amenoma Clan has kept its art alive.

introduced.name: Amenoma Smithy
introduced.how: the smithy run by Tougo, Yuuya's uncle
introduced.quote: Yuuya is the nephew of Amenoma Tougo, the owner of Amenoma Smithy.

introduced.name: Amenoma Tougo
introduced.how: the owner of Amenoma Smithy and Yuuya's uncle
introduced.quote: Yuuya is the nephew of Amenoma Tougo, the owner of Amenoma Smithy.

introduced.name: Amenoma Yuuya
introduced.how: a missing samurai of the Amenoma Clan
introduced.quote: The other, Amenoma Yuuya, is a samurai from the Amenoma Clan.

introduced.name: Nagato
introduced.how: a well-known collector who went missing
introduced.quote: One of them is a pretty well-known collector, surname Nagato.

introduced.name: Nagato Sachiko
introduced.how: Nagato's wife, who explains their debts and dispute
introduced.quote: My husband has gone missing, and I'm still trying to find him.

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: a combat-oriented sword art aiming for harmony between blade and mind
introduced.quote: Isshin Art strives for complete harmony between blade and mind from the moment that forging begins.

introduced.name: Amenoma Art
introduced.how: a blade-making philosophy modeled on water wearing down stone
introduced.quote: As an example, the Amenoma Art strives to emulate the abiding patience and determination of water as it turns stone to sand.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: an ancient malevolent energy that lodges in objects and affects living things
introduced.quote: Tatarigami energy often lodges itself within physical objects, then works to subtly affect any living organisms in its vicinity.

introduced.name: Prized Isshin Blade
introduced.how: a sentient cursed sword that possesses people and says it was forged by a famed Isshin smith
introduced.quote: Many, many years ago, I was forged by a famed bladesmith of the Isshin tradition.

introduced.name: Takatsukasa Clan
introduced.how: a clan whose abandoned secret base is now held by ronin
introduced.quote: Since the Takatsukasa Clan abandoned that secret base, it's been held by ronin ever since.

introduced.name: Prized Isshin Blade
introduced.how: a sentient cursed blade that introduces itself, reveals its origin, and admits its wrongdoing
introduced.quote: You are a true Kaedehara, in flesh and in spirit.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: a malevolence from the ancient past that is the source of the blade's mania and savagery
introduced.quote: Tatarigami is a malevolence from the ancient past. It is the source of your mania and savagery.

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: a blade-smithing and swordsmanship art that requires skill, blade, determination, and desire to be aligned
introduced.quote: Skill, blade, determination, and desire — all these must be aligned in the practice of Isshin Art.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Clan
introduced.how: a clan of bladesmiths whose family line Kazuha continues
introduced.quote: The Kaedehara Clan has always been a family of bladesmiths, so it is only proper for me to continue on this path.

introduced.name: Amenoma Yuuya
introduced.how: introduces himself as the successor of Amenoma Art and is the man the blade possessed
introduced.quote: Successor of Amenoma Art, Amenoma Yuuya.

introduced.name: Kagotsurube Isshin
introduced.how: the blade's real name and the weapon crafted using a long-lost Kaedehara forging art
introduced.quote: a weapon crafted using a long-lost blade forging art of the Kaedehara Clan

introduced.name: Bladesmith's exile
introduced.how: the smith's exile in Snezhnaya, where he learned the truth and atoned for the desertion of Isshin smiths
introduced.quote: While in exile in Snezhnaya, the bladesmith eventually learned the truth behind everything that had happened.

introduced.name: The bet between Kazuha and the blade
introduced.how: the blade agreed to a wager with Kazuha, hoping to reach harmony with him
introduced.quote: You wanted to reach a state of harmony with me.

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, hello! Do you know where Kazuha is?

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Huh? So you don't have a Vision after all.

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Something about him blocking the Raiden Shogun

assumed.name: Nazuchi Beach battle
assumed.quote: If it's because of that battle on Nazuchi Beach

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Captain Beidou had a great run there too

assumed.name: Haishan
assumed.quote: the technique Beidou used to strike down Haishan

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: We were just discussing the repealing of the Vision Hunt Decree.

assumed.name: Vision thief at Beidou's tournament
assumed.quote: when we were chasing down that Vision thief at Beidou's tournament

assumed.name: Irodori Festival and Hues of the Violet Garden
assumed.quote: You may recall the story of the Raiden Gokaden from the Irodori Festival.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: But the long journey from Snezhnaya back to Inazuma has left you battered and broken.

assumed.name: Musou no Hitotachi
assumed.quote: Yours is the blade that took on the Musou no Hitotachi

assumed.name: Almighty Shogun
assumed.quote: much less the Almighty Shogun.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: we'll vouch for your innocence to the Tenryou Commission!

assumed.name: Kujou Kamaji
assumed.quote: And it's also time to give him a response to the offer he made me.

assumed.name: Sangonomiya
assumed.quote: I may find myself embroiled in conflicts between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: He felt intense regret at being tricked by the Fatui

assumed.name: Captain Beidou
assumed.quote: I'll probably take to the seas with Captain Beidou again for now.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: just as the sight of those who fought to repeal the Vision Hunt Decree did

assumed.name: The Crux Clash
assumed.quote: This reminds Paimon a bit of The Crux Clash.

assumed.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
assumed.quote: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency tells me that they've found the missing Mr. Nagato.

assumed.name: Amenoma Tougo
assumed.quote: Ah, it's Yuuya! You have returned!

threads.claim: Tatarigami remnants linger in Nagato's warehouse and drive obsession and possession in people.
threads.quote: It felt very much like that ancient presence in Inazuma... the remnants of the Tatarigami.

threads.claim: The mysterious samurai's possessing force is revealed to be a cursed Isshin blade.
threads.quote: But what if instead of facing Amenoma Yuuya... we are in fact facing the blade in his hand?

threads.claim: The attacker seems to share a special, unexplained fighting connection with Kazuha.
threads.quote: I think this guy may have a special connection to Kazuha.

threads.claim: The Shogunate offers to restore the Kaedehara name and wealth, and Kazuha hesitates over leaving his life.
threads.quote: The Tri-Commission has made the recommendation to use this opportunity to restore the honor of the Kaedehara name.

threads.claim: The Fatui secretly engineered the disgrace of the bladesmith clans, and this has not been made public.
threads.quote: We later learned that the whole misadventure had been secretly orchestrated by the Fatui.

threads.claim: Kazuha's block of the Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi is considered impossible by many Inazumans.
threads.quote: Well, to some, the Musou no Hitotachi is something that can never be defeated.

threads.claim: The Isshin blade wants to face the Raiden Shogun to prove the might of Isshin Art.
threads.quote: I seek but one thing: to face the full force of the Raiden Shogun's blade, and prove my power, the might of Isshin Art!

threads.claim: Isshin Art forms express the user's thoughts, and a blade must be in harmony with its bearer to unleash its power.
threads.quote: As I've mentioned before, the forms of Isshin Art convey the user's thoughts and feelings.

threads.claim: Kazuha prefers a wandering life and will go wherever the wind takes him.
threads.quote: go wherever the wind takes him

threads.claim: Nagato's letter reveals Yuuya wounded him and stole his blade, partly answering the disappearance.
threads.quote: I was wounded by Amenoma Yuuya. He took my most precious blade.

threads.claim: Tatarigami is the malevolent power that drove the blade's corruption, and the bladesmith may never have known it.
threads.quote: I believe the bladesmith might never have known that the power he worked with was that of the Tatarigami.

threads.claim: Kazuha hints that the blade's true form may finally be revealed in its current state of decay.
threads.quote: Perhaps this time, we'll finally have a chance to see his true form.

threads.claim: The blade's long-forgotten true name, Kagotsurube Isshin, is finally revealed.
threads.quote: Kagotsurube Isshin

threads.claim: The blade gives up its entire consciousness to reforge itself so its maker's wish can be fulfilled.
threads.quote: Yes, the cost is my entire consciousness

threads.claim: The Isshin Art suffered a devastating blow when its best smiths deserted it.
threads.quote: The Isshin Art had been dealt a devastating blow by the desertion of its best smiths.

threads.claim: The bladesmith was tricked by the Fatui and could never return to his homeland.
threads.quote: He felt intense regret at being tricked by the Fatui, but he could never again return to his homeland.

threads.claim: The bet between Kazuha and the blade is settled, ending that wager.
threads.quote: I believe our bet is now settled.

threads.claim: The blade releases Amenoma Yuuya and restores his consciousness as it promised.
threads.quote: I will release Amenoma Yuuya, and restore his consciousness.

threads.claim: The missing Mr. Nagato is found alive but badly wounded.
threads.quote: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency tells me that they've found the missing Mr. Nagato.

threads.claim: The Traveler's quest to face the gods and find a sibling inspires Kazuha.
threads.quote: Your quest to face the gods and trace your sibling inspires me in the same way.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: Revealed as an illuminated bird-adeptus now taking human form; also called Xianyun
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh!? You're the illuminated bird? But you look human! How did that happen?

introduced.name: Xianyun
introduced.how: Cloud Retainer's chosen human name, adopted on Ganyu's advice
introduced.quote: From this point on, when in public occasions, be sure to refer to one as "Xianyun."

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Cloud Retainer's disciple who works at Yuehai Pavilion
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ah, right! So by disciples, you must mean Ganyu and Shenhe!

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: Cloud Retainer's disciple who now works at Wanmin Restaurant; lived with her for over ten years
introduced.quote: Shenhe: I've trained and lived with Master for more than ten years. I would recognize you no matter what form you take.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: Rival who lost a race against Cloud Retainer
introduced.quote: Shenhe: Master once participated in a race against Moon Carver.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: Owner-chef of Wanmin Restaurant, who lets Shenhe take a break
introduced.quote: Chef Mao: The lunch rush isn't in yet, Shenhe, so I've got things covered for now.

introduced.name: Shuyu
introduced.how: Young girl who introduces herself and her grandmother; wants Xianyun to take her as a disciple
introduced.quote: Shuyu: Great! Thanks so much. My name is Shuyu, and this is my granny, Yuandai.

introduced.name: Yuandai
introduced.how: Shuyu's grandmother with dementia; secretly a former crane who became human-like
introduced.quote: Granny has pretty bad dementia, so her memory's getting worse all the time.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: Knowledgeable about Liyue's chivalric tales and heroes of the past
introduced.quote: Oh! Xingqiu knows tons about Liyue's chivalric traditions.

introduced.name: Streetward Rambler
introduced.how: Also known as Madame Ping
introduced.quote: Paimon: Streetward Rambler... Oh! You mean Madame Ping?

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: Expert appraiser who verifies Xianyun's wares
introduced.quote: The expert turns out to be Zhongli, and he verifies the authenticity of Xianyun's wares.

introduced.name: Shaozu
introduced.how: Cautious buyer of Xianyun's collection of items
introduced.quote: Shaozu, cautious about spending his Mora, reveals that he had also hired an expert who was coming.

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: Teleports in to check on Xianyun; fought alongside her in the past
introduced.quote: Xiao suddenly teleports in, scaring Paimon.

introduced.name: Bi-Cyclical Thunderflash-Mobile
introduced.how: Iron vehicle Xianyun built in forty-nine days, powered by adeptal energy, that could cover thousands of miles a day
introduced.quote: Xianyun: You refer to the "Bi-Cyclical Thunderflash-Mobile." One spent forty-nine days conceptualizing and crafting it.

introduced.name: Suspensus Somnium Mechanism
introduced.how: Device giving a breeze and adeptal tune that relaxes listeners and can restore lost memories
introduced.quote: Xianyun reveals that the device in question is the "Suspensus Somnium Mechanism"

introduced.name: Soul-Revitalizing Teapills
introduced.how: Pills from a merchant that suppressed Yuandai's illness for decades
introduced.quote: gave her Soul-Revitalizing Teapills, which kept her illness suppressed for several decades.

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: Busy restaurant where Shenhe now works, staffed on Ganyu's recommendation
introduced.quote: Wanmin Restaurant's business has been booming recently

introduced.name: Mt. Aocang
introduced.how: Cloud Retainer's home mountain
introduced.quote: Oh, why don't we pay Cloud Retainer a visit at Mt. Aocang?

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: Commerce guild in Liyue where Xingqiu can be found
introduced.quote: Let's go find him at the Feiyun Commerce Guild!

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: Inn where Yuandai stayed to recuperate and met the merchant
introduced.quote: The group heads to Wangshu Inn, where Yuandai begins to reminisce about her time there.

introduced.name: Chihu Rock
introduced.how: Location where Xianyun sells her items
introduced.quote: Two days later, the Traveler and Paimon head to Chihu Rock to visit Xianyun

introduced.name: Mt. Tianheng
introduced.how: Home mountain of the exorcist Yuandai fell in love with
introduced.quote: Eventually, she met an exorcist from Mt. Tianheng and after the drought ended, lived a reclusive life.

introduced.name: Liyue drought
introduced.how: Long-ago drought and gas crisis in Liyue that Cloud Retainer ended by summoning rain
introduced.quote: It is said that once, a long, long time ago, there was a severe drought in Liyue.

introduced.name: Nameless heroine
introduced.how: Mysterious fifty-year-old heroine who cleared evil spirits and bandit camps during a drought, unnamed in tales
introduced.quote: a mysterious heroine came and cleared both evil spirits and bandit camps

introduced.name: nameless heroine
introduced.how: legendary unnamed heroine of a fifty-year-old drought, featured in chivalric novels
introduced.quote: The novels often speak of a great drought from fifty years ago.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: a war the Archon and adepti fought in, whose peak came after Guizhong's death
introduced.quote: The Archon War reached its peak after Guizhong's death.

introduced.name: Mt. Aocang
introduced.how: mountain where Cloud Retainer retired after the war, appearing only in avian form
introduced.quote: After the war, Cloud Retainer retired to Mt. Aocang, only revealing herself to the occasional visitor, and always in her avian form.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: inn where Yuandai once stayed while ill and received the teapills
introduced.quote: I was confined to my room in Wangshu Inn, where I spent many days unconscious.

introduced.name: Azure Crane
introduced.how: a crane that lands at the scene, linked to Yuandai's true form
introduced.quote: An Azure Crane lands in the foreground

introduced.name: Yuandai's crane nature
introduced.how: Yuandai is revealed to be a former wild crane, not a human
introduced.quote: I am, in truth, not a human being. My real form — one that I held for centuries — was that of a wild crane.

introduced.name: Human Mimicry Potion
introduced.how: potion letting a crane take human form for ten years, after which a failed return erases the crane past
introduced.quote: Once she learned of my desires, Master prepared a special dose of Human Mimicry Potion for me.

introduced.name: Soul-Revitalizing Teapills
introduced.how: pills made from adepti blood that eased the illness, given by a merchant
introduced.quote: He told me that the pills were concocted using adepti blood and could be used to alleviate my symptoms.

introduced.name: Suspensus Somnium Mechanism
introduced.how: Xianyun's invention that releases a breeze and tune to relax and help recover memories
introduced.quote: It periodically releases a soft breeze which, when paired with a gentle adeptal tune, can help the listener subconsciously relax, and even enter a semi-hypnotic state.

introduced.name: Shuyu's grandfather
introduced.how: the exorcist from Mt. Tianheng whom Yuandai fell in love with
introduced.quote: Though he was human, he had spent his entire life training on Mt. Tianheng.

introduced.name: Shuyu's father
introduced.how: the infant born in the abandoned house during the flight, Yuandai's son
introduced.quote: That baby was your father.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: one of Xianyun's disciples who chose to live among mortals in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Yet, in the end, all of one's disciples ended up in Liyue Harbor. Ganyu, Shenhe... Yuandai... They all chose a life among the mortal world.

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: one of Xianyun's disciples who chose to live among mortals in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Yet, in the end, all of one's disciples ended up in Liyue Harbor. Ganyu, Shenhe... Yuandai... They all chose a life among the mortal world.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: the funeral parlor where Zhongli works as a consultant on valuables
introduced.quote: This is Mr. Zhongli, a well-respected consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, and an expert in all manner of valuables and antiques!

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: introduced as a consultant and appraiser at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, who knows Xianyun
introduced.quote: This is Mr. Zhongli, a well-respected consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, and an expert in all manner of valuables and antiques!

introduced.name: Shaozu
introduced.how: a cautious buyer who hires Zhongli to appraise Xianyun's collection
introduced.quote: Shaozu: Here, allow me to make some introductions!

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: a fiduciary house where the buyer makes an initial deposit
introduced.quote: The Northland Bank? Oh, you refer to the fiduciary house. Very well.

introduced.name: Xianyun as adeptus
introduced.how: Xianyun reveals she is an adeptus, the Cloud Retainer, to Shuyu
introduced.quote: One is indeed an adeptus. Is that of some concern to you?

introduced.name: Adeptus' Temptation
introduced.how: a dish said to be impossible to stop eating after one bite
introduced.quote: I heard it's impossible to stop eating after even just one bite!

introduced.name: Unsigned Letter
introduced.how: a letter tucked in a book of accounts on Shuyu's boxes, written by her parents to their daughter
introduced.quote: Little Yu, my dear daughter... By the time you read this, Mommy and Daddy will have already left to go on a long journey.

introduced.name: Granny
introduced.how: Shuyu's grandmother, who gets forgetful and needs reminders, left in the daughter's care
introduced.quote: Your Granny may get a little forgetful sometimes, so try to jot down little reminders for her around the house whenever you can.

introduced.name: parents' dangerous mission
introduced.how: Shuyu's parents left on a long journey for a mission they knew was dangerous and chose to take
introduced.quote: They told Daddy that this mission would be super dangerous, but both Mommy and Daddy decided to sign up.

introduced.name: secret code phrase
introduced.how: a phrase Daddy taught the daughter as a child, to be used to recognize each other later
introduced.quote: Do you still remember that one phrase Daddy taught you when you were little?

assumed.name: Archon War

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: And when we told her that Rex Lapis had been assassinated, she immediately threatened to "squash Liyue Harbor"!

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Though adepti blood flows through your veins, excessive exhaustion will still cause grave harm to your body.

assumed.name: Mora

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Huh, it's you two... What brings you here?

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Madame Ping: I have recorded the tune that you requested. I hope it will be of help to you.

assumed.name: Streetward Rambler
assumed.quote: Xianyun: Streetward... Ping, what has amused you so?

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Woah! Xiao! What are you doing here all of a sudden? You scared the living daylights out of Paimon!

assumed.name: Guizhong
assumed.quote: The Archon War reached its peak after Guizhong's death.

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: One recognized you upon your very entrance into Wanmin Restaurant.

assumed.name: Chihu Rock
assumed.quote: One has already picked out a handsome property near Chihu Rock.

assumed.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon: , should we make a trip to the Feiyun Commerce Guild? It's totally up to you!

assumed.name: adeptus
assumed.quote: Or, who knows, maybe he has some super powerful adeptus looking out for him?

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

assumed.name: Xianyun
assumed.quote: Actually, Master, have you ever tried

threads.claim: Xianyun's visit to Liyue Harbor serves an important purpose that is not yet revealed.
threads.quote: The moment is not yet upon us. Still, the truth will be revealed to you in time.

threads.claim: A nameless heroine saved Liyue from a drought long ago, and her identity is unknown.
threads.quote: a mysterious heroine came and cleared both evil spirits and bandit camps

threads.claim: The heroine's deeds may actually have been Cloud Retainer's, as the old lines were written about her.
threads.quote: Ganyu: Actually, those lines were originally written to describe Cloud Retainer herself...

threads.claim: Yuandai recurs to a dream of a figure telling her to find her and be free.
threads.quote: She told me to come and find her — and that once I'd found her, I would be free.

threads.claim: Using the device restores Yuandai's memories and she recognizes Xianyun as Cloud Retainer.
threads.quote: She then addresses Xianyun as Cloud Retainer, having remembered what she once was.

threads.claim: Yuandai was originally a long-living wild crane that gained sentience under Cloud Retainer.
threads.quote: in the past, she was not actually a human, but a long-living wild crane.

threads.claim: A pure white illuminated crane saved Shuyu from a fever, and her rescuer is unknown.
threads.quote: when she had a fever, a pure white illuminated crane came down, flew her to her adeptus home and gave her a potion that allowed her to recover.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer was the one who healed Shuyu's fever.
threads.quote: She was also the one responsible for healing Shuyu when she had a fever.

threads.claim: The merchant's pills that suppressed Yuandai's illness were a gift from Cloud Retainer in disguise.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer states that the pills were actually a gift from her and continues on the story.

threads.claim: Yuandai prayed for breaking an oath she can no longer recall.
threads.quote: she prayed for breaking an oath which she does not recall.

threads.claim: Shenhe suspects Xianyun is lonely, and Xianyun refuses to admit it.
threads.quote: Shenhe: Have you been lonely, Master?

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's supposed assassination is known to Cloud Retainer and provoked a furious reaction.
threads.quote: And when we told her that Rex Lapis had been assassinated, she immediately threatened to "squash Liyue Harbor"!

threads.claim: Novels describe an unnamed heroine during a drought who later vanished from public life, hinting at a real person behind the legend.
threads.quote: The novels often speak of a great drought from fifty years ago.

threads.claim: Yuandai is revealed to be the nameless heroine who hid herself away from the world.
threads.quote: The nameless heroine hid herself away...

threads.claim: Shuyu recalls seeing a pure white illuminated crane that may have saved her, hinting at a crane connection.
threads.quote: Shuyu: Well... One time when I was a little kid, I saw a pure white illuminated crane.

threads.claim: Yuandai confesses she is a former wild crane who took human form and is now fading back.
threads.quote: I am, in truth, not a human being. My real form — one that I held for centuries — was that of a wild crane.

threads.claim: Shuyu suspects the travelers and Xianyun are adepti in disguise after hearing Xianyun call herself one.
threads.quote: Shuyu: Well, I've kinda been meaning to ask ever since we started talking in the restaurant, but are you guys all... adepti in disguise?

threads.claim: Xianyun openly confirms she is an adeptus.
threads.quote: One is indeed an adeptus. Is that of some concern to you?

threads.claim: Yuandai has a mysterious illness with no known cure and cannot recall its name.
threads.quote: Yuandai: I'm sorry, I don't. *sigh* Ahh... If only I wasn't so useless...

threads.claim: Xianyun explains the illness stems from Yuandai's refusal to return to her crane life, and her own blood only delayed it.
threads.quote: Xianyun: Even the power of an adeptus has its limits. Had your condition continued to deteriorate, you would have forgotten your life as a human entirely.

threads.claim: Yuandai suspects the traveling merchant who sold her the teapills was actually Master in disguise.
threads.quote: Yuandai: Master. Don't tell me... Back then, that merchant was actually—

threads.claim: Xianyun admits she disguised her features to deliver the medicine herself.
threads.quote: One took great care to alter one's features and select the appropriate attire.

threads.claim: Xiao hints that Yuandai fought alongside him in the Archon War in her crane form.
threads.quote: Xiao: I have indeed. I fought alongside her in this form on many occasions during the Archon War.

threads.claim: Xiao hints Cloud Retainer once took human form about thirty years ago for an unspoken purpose.
threads.quote: Xiao: ...Although, I do believe there was an occasion some thirty odd years ago when she decided to don her human form.

threads.claim: Ancient disasters on this land were far worse than the recent drought, hinting at a larger past.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: Still, as terrible as that drought was, it was nothing compared to the truly calamitous disasters that befell this land in ancient times.

threads.claim: Monsters attacked because the adeptal blood medicine drew them and godly remains, linking the drought to adepti.
threads.quote: Xianyun: Those monsters would hardly have pursued you with such ferocity without sufficient incentive.

threads.claim: Zhongli and Xianyun share an old history, a reunion of friends centuries ago, that is only hinted at.
threads.quote: Zhongli: It was a reunion between friends several centuries ago.

threads.claim: Xianyun plans to leave Mt. Aocang and settle in Liyue Harbor with Shuyu as her first human-world disciple.
threads.quote: That is precisely why one plans to relocate to Liyue Harbor. Shuyu shall have the honor of becoming one's first disciple in the human world.

threads.claim: Xianyun wonders what drew her disciples to stay in Liyue Harbor instead of Mt. Aocang.
threads.quote: One is most curious as to what aspect of Liyue Harbor could have enticed them to remain there.

threads.claim: Shuyu's parents left on a dangerous long journey and asked her to look after Granny while they were gone.
threads.quote: Mommy and Daddy are counting on you to take care of Granny while we're gone!

threads.claim: The parents left a secret recognition phrase for their daughter, and its meaning is not revealed in this text.
threads.quote: That can be our secret code the next time we see each other again.

threads.claim: The Millelith is presented as a guardian that stands against evil, but its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

threads.claim: Daddy's near-fatal childhood illness and unexpected recovery hint at a protecting adeptus, left unresolved.
threads.quote: Well, even the doctor could barely feel Daddy's pulse, it was that weak!

introduced.name: Gediminas
introduced.how: a Fatui Oprichnik who appears to deliver news from The Knave and gives the group a map
introduced.quote: I come bearing news from my Lady, The Knave.

introduced.name: Jotautas
introduced.how: a Fatui grunt who used to serve in Columbina's unit and reveals Dottore's plans
introduced.quote: I was part of the The Damselette's unit to begin with.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: the Moon Goddess-linked former Harbinger, called The Damselette, who left the Fatui and was taken by Dottore
introduced.quote: Lady Damselette may have left our organization

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: a Harbinger scientist who has been building an artificial Moon Marrow and holds the Traveler captive
introduced.quote: Welcome, one and all. I've been expecting you.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: the moon-related gemstone-like spheres that Dottore stole from Columbina and that grant the power of the moons
introduced.quote: The Moon Marrow spheres. He stole them from their rightful owner, Columbina.

introduced.name: Trilune
introduced.how: a strange object Dottore carries on his back that holds the Moon Marrows
introduced.quote: He tells them that it is a Trilune, which holds the Moon Marrows.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a group that considers rescuing the Moon Goddess their duty and is helping the Traveler
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions consider it our duty to rescue the Moon Goddess.

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: top Fatui officers, some of whom are already inside Dottore's facility
introduced.quote: Two other harbingers had the same idea as you.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: the Snezhnayan military organization whose members may become allies to the group
introduced.quote: the Fatui will be their allies should they choose to rely on them

introduced.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: a Tsaritsa-owned research bureau in Nod-Krai where Sandrone's unit is based and where refugees can seek safety
introduced.quote: If you need us, you'll find us at the Experimental Design Bureau.

introduced.name: Special Territory Research Institute
introduced.how: the research facility in the far north of Nod-Krai where Dottore's lab is located
introduced.quote: (The player is teleported to Special Territory Research Institute)

introduced.name: artificial Moon Marrow
introduced.how: a man-made version of the Moon Marrow that Dottore is trying to create to gain godlike power
introduced.quote: How would he create an artificial Moon Marrow?

introduced.name: kuuvahki pulse
introduced.how: a kuuvahki energy source that can manipulate past events
introduced.quote: She discovers a kuuvahki pulse and, touching it, realizes the pulse is able to manipulate past events

introduced.name: Katya
introduced.how: A restaurant staffer who offers the Traveler hot dogs and specials in Nasha Town
introduced.quote: Katya: What are you in the mood for today? A hot dog? Or something else? We've got some special discounts at the moment — you wanna see the menu?

introduced.name: Moon's reflection
introduced.how: A mysterious realm beyond the Moon Gate where Columbina is trapped
introduced.quote: Columbina: (So this is... the moon's reflection? The mysterious realm beyond the gate?)

introduced.name: Moon Gate
introduced.how: A gate Columbina forced open with her strength before leaping through it
introduced.quote: Columbina: (Where is this place? It took all my strength to open the Moon Gate, and then I leapt into it...)

introduced.name: Maisie
introduced.how: A child in the false family scene who claims the Traveler visited their house before
introduced.quote: Maisie: Hey there! I haven't seen you in ages... What's keeping you so busy? I've been looking forward to playing with you again.

introduced.name: Dottore's false reality
introduced.how: Dottore creates fake, peaceful versions of Nasha Town and invented family life to deceive the Traveler
introduced.quote: Traveler: (Could this be... a false memory?)

introduced.name: Trilune
introduced.how: Dottore's completed set of three Moon Marrows, two primordial and one artificial
introduced.quote: The Doctor: Ah, so you noticed. This is the completed Trilune — two primordial Moon Marrows and one artificial specimen.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Dottore built an artificial Moon Marrow to replace the Frost Moon, and it is not rejected by Teyvat
introduced.quote: The Knave: Using this knowledge, he then fashioned an artificial Moon Marrow to serve as a replacement for the Frost Moon beyond the sky.

introduced.name: Dottore's curse
introduced.how: Everyone who entered Dottore's research center was implanted with a curse that may trigger if they leave Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Marionette: Dottore, you son of a... He's done something to us! Everyone who entered his research center has been implanted with some sort of curse.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai energy fields
introduced.how: Multiple energy fields from Dottore are slowly swallowing parts of Nod-Krai and expanding
introduced.quote: Durin: Each field is slowly growing, swallowing up more of the surrounding area in the process.

introduced.name: Southern Isles
introduced.how: One of the two most populated areas of Nod-Krai, along with Piramida
introduced.quote: The Knave: The residents of Nod-Krai are quite dispersed. The two most populated areas are the Southern Isles and Piramida.

introduced.name: Illuga
introduced.how: A young, socially graceful figure who waits at Mimisbrunnr Books and helps Flins plan the search and evacuation
introduced.quote: Flins: You are most considerate, Master Illuga. But in fact, I know you have been sitting here for quite some time.

introduced.name: Four Great Rulers
introduced.how: Four rulers serving the Heavenly Principles who govern Life, Death, Time, and Space
introduced.quote: The Doctor: Someone of your talent and experience must surely know of the Four Great Rulers who serve the Heavenly Principles. They govern Life, Death, Time, and Space.

introduced.name: Dodocommunication Device
introduced.how: A modified device Nicole gives the party so they can communicate across Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Nicole: It will allow us to communicate over long-distances within Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: A Hexenzirkel member who speaks to the group remotely through a device, since she cannot come in person
introduced.quote: Nicole: Sorry, this is the only way I can speak to you all right now.

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: A scanning device or assistant Sandrone uses to analyze the curse on the party
introduced.quote: Marionette: Pulonia, scan.

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: A source of moon knowledge and technology that Dottore gained through contact with its phantoms
introduced.quote: The Knave: We also know that through his contact with the phantoms of Hyperborea, he gained knowledge about the moons and certain Hyperborean technologies.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: The Traveler is Teyvat's Fourth Descender, a status known to all harbingers and why Dottore is interested
introduced.quote: The Knave: Agreed. is Teyvat's Fourth Descender — all harbingers are aware of this.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: Divination cards that Barbeloth uses, with the first representing destiny
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: Please, draw the first Lunar Arcana.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: An energy Columbina uses to influence reality and write messages, which is consumed when she acts
introduced.quote: Columbina: (The last two times I tried to influence reality in this space, it consumed a lot of kuuvahki...)

introduced.name: Dottore's Mondstadt crimes
introduced.how: Dottore committed numerous crimes in Mondstadt, including murdering the father of a former knight
introduced.quote: Varka: The Doctor is guilty of numerous crimes in Mondstadt as well.

introduced.name: Dottore's lab
introduced.how: A research center that has operated far longer than expected and holds many monster samples
introduced.quote: The Knave: Dottore's lab has clearly been in operation for a lot longer than we realized.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Moon Marrows may be equivalent to the moons themselves, and Dottore has built his own
introduced.quote: Or does this mean that the Moon Marrows are equivalent to the moons themselves?

introduced.name: Teyvat's moons
introduced.how: Teyvat's sky holds multiple moons, with three in legend, and apart from the Frost Moon the rest are husks
introduced.quote: But then it occurred to me that apart from the Frost Moon, Teyvat's moons are just husks.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: A machine-minded creator who built Marionette and tried to use Rene's Remurian records
introduced.quote: The way Alain Guillotin saw it, the world was comprised of machines.

introduced.name: Rene de Petrichor
introduced.how: Rene is a researcher whose draft lectures and theories about Remurian technology are being studied
introduced.quote: Rene... His full name was Rene de Petrichor, if I recall correctly.

introduced.name: Petrichor
introduced.how: The town that was the main source of records on Remurian civilization
introduced.quote: That place was also the source of most of our information regarding Remurian civilization.

introduced.name: Remurian technology
introduced.how: Ancient Remurian technology is cited as a source of advanced wisdom and ideas
introduced.quote: It is an ancient Remurian technology, a wisdom unparalleled.

introduced.name: World-formula
introduced.how: A diagram that calculates the fate of an entire world, which Sandrone is trying to understand
introduced.quote: The world-formula calculates the fate of an entire world.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: Descender is a status Dottore claims the Traveler has lost and can restore, and an outside variable that may matter
introduced.quote: I will grant you special privileges, and give you back the status you rightly deserve as a Descender.

introduced.name: Light Realm
introduced.how: Teyvat's seven elements come from the Light Realm's primordial power, which opposes the Void Realm
introduced.quote: Teyvat's seven elements are derived from the more primordial power of the Light Realm, which is antagonistic with the power of the Void Realm.

introduced.name: Void Realm
introduced.how: The Void Realm is the realm whose power opposes the Light Realm that elements come from
introduced.quote: Teyvat's seven elements are derived from the more primordial power of the Light Realm, which is antagonistic with the power of the Void Realm.

introduced.name: Radiant Beast
introduced.how: Humans turned into monsters by Dottore's experiments; one was once a subordinate of Sandrone
introduced.quote: That Radiant Beast was once a subordinate of Sandrone's.

introduced.name: Human-animal mind swapping experiments
introduced.how: Dottore swaps human minds with animal minds, leaving bodies dead and animals guarding them inside energy fields
introduced.quote: He's swapping human minds with those of animals...

introduced.name: Dottore's time freeze
introduced.how: Dottore froze the Traveler's time for a month while claiming he can control time
introduced.quote: A whole month passed before you opened your eyes again — but only for you.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: A kuuhenki-like familiar linked to Columbina as the Moon Goddess's familiar, who has been with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Is it because she has a connection to me as the Moon Goddess's familiar?

introduced.name: Final Night Cemetery
introduced.how: The base where Flins works, holding files on Nod-Krai's history
introduced.quote: This is where Flins is based.

introduced.name: Harbinger curse
introduced.how: Those who fought Dottore are cursed and cannot leave Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Also, those of us who fought Dottore have been afflicted with a curse.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai pollution
introduced.how: An uncontrollable pollution spreading from Nod-Krai, sourced from Dottore's experiments
introduced.quote: Beware, an uncontrollable pollution is spreading forth from Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Dottore's energy fields
introduced.how: Dottore's energy fields hide experiments and can be torn open with elemental energy
introduced.quote: We've found a way to break through the energy fields.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: Columbina created her from a piece of her own soul, and she has been present in every past location Columbina entered
introduced.quote: It was I who brought Luonnotar into being... I gave up a piece of my own soul to create her.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Blossom
introduced.how: a flower made from Columbina's power that can transform into Luonnotar
introduced.quote: Columbina draws out some of her power and shapes it into a Moon-Prayer Blossom, which floats towards the Traveler

introduced.name: Columbina Hyposelenia
introduced.how: the name Columbina took on after she stopped being a lost dove
introduced.quote: Back then, I was just a little lost dove... I had yet to become Columbina Hyposelenia...

introduced.name: Segments
introduced.how: Dottore's creations, originally modeled on an analysis of the Traveler's operational principles
introduced.quote: Dottore doesn't recognize me, but his Segments were originally made based on an analysis of my operational principles.

introduced.name: Descenders
introduced.how: beings who are rare, unlike the mortals found everywhere
introduced.quote: Mortals are found everywhere one looks. Not so with Descenders.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Lady Arlecchino's subordinates are your comrades if you want them to be.

assumed.name: The Knave
assumed.quote: Tell them that Sandrone and I will go on ahead.

assumed.name: Barbeloth
assumed.quote: reminiscing about her time with Barbeloth

assumed.name: Rerir

assumed.name: Boreas

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Columbina: (I don't believe Dottore's scheming will stop just because I escaped.

assumed.quote: Nefer: She entered the space beyond the Moon Gate, knowing what became of Rerir and Tholindis...

assumed.quote: Columbina: (Oh... Yes, that was the fortune-telling stall run by Barbeloth from the Hexenzirkel...)

assumed.name: Frost Moon

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: For a servant of the Tsaritsa, that goes beyond being disloyal.

assumed.name: Nikita

assumed.quote: Dori: I think it's important that someone informs the Dendro Archon of what's going on in Nod-Krai.

assumed.quote: Lauma: As for those dwelling south of that line, I will ask the Voynich Guild to help persuade them to leave.

assumed.name: Columbina

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
assumed.quote: Some of them are from the Narzissenkreuz Ordo

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Flins: Oh, sorry if we're disturbing you.

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Childe: It's been a while, Arlecchino. You look well.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: the Tsaritsa has authorized Fatui Internal Affairs to review Dottore's case.

assumed.name: Varka

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Khaenri'ah ceased to exist long ago.

assumed.quote: Seeing Ineffa and Aino reunited like that sure was heart-warming

threads.claim: Dottore plans to create a third Moon Marrow himself if he cannot get the other two moons.
threads.quote: if he can only get his hands on two of them, he'll create a third one himself.

threads.claim: Dottore believes he will become a god of a new world through the Moon Marrows.
threads.quote: I will be the god of a new world... and you speak to me of honor? How charmingly naive.

threads.claim: Dottore has used an artificial moon to replace the Frost Moon, threatening control of the three moons.
threads.quote: Dottore had used his artificial moon to replace the Frost Moon in the sky.

threads.claim: Dottore has cursed everyone who entered his facility, with the curse activating if they leave Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Dottore, who mocked them in the message he'd encoded with the curse.

threads.claim: Columbina realizes she is travelling backwards in time through the moon's reflection, trying to change events.
threads.quote: Columbina realizes that she is travelling backwards in time; in the present

threads.claim: Luonnotar is a presence that can see Columbina while she travels through the moon's reflection.
threads.quote: Before she is thrown back into the reflection, she spots Luonnotar, who can see her.

threads.claim: The Traveler has a strong desire to see their sibling once more, which Dottore might exploit.
threads.quote: along with a desire to see their sibling once more.

threads.claim: Dottore admits he still needs to master his control over the power of time.
threads.quote: admitting that he still needs to master his control over the power of time.

threads.claim: Illuga suspects Flins may not be human, and Flins denies knowing what he means.
threads.quote: Before he leaves, Illuga asks Flins if he isn't human, though Flins feigns ignorance.

threads.claim: Dottore has swapped human minds into animals in a twisted experiment at the energy field site.
threads.quote: having swapped the humans' minds into the animals.

threads.claim: Arlecchino vanished as soon as she entered Dottore's facility, and her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Arlecchino disappeared as soon as she entered the facility.

threads.claim: Dottore suggests the Traveler has been mistreated as an alien and offers to restore their rightful status as a Descender.
threads.quote: offering to restore the Traveler to their rightful status as a Descender.

threads.claim: Columbina seemed indifferent to the world and often stared at the sky while she was a Harbinger.
threads.quote: In fact, she seemed sorta... detached from everything.

threads.claim: Columbina wakes in the moon's reflection unsure whether she is still alive.
threads.quote: Columbina: ...I'm still alive...?

threads.claim: The others fear Columbina may be gone for good after entering the space beyond the Moon Gate.
threads.quote: Lauma: The loss of Columbina could not have come at a worse time... Do we... do we think she's truly gone for good?

threads.claim: Nefer reads Columbina's wall message and realizes she is alive.
threads.quote: Nefer: Columbina... She's alive...

threads.claim: Columbina wonders whether time flows backwards within the moon's reflection.
threads.quote: Columbina: (Does this mean that... within the moon's reflection, time flows backwards? Starting from the moment I fell in?)

threads.claim: Flins infers that Columbina is changing the past using kuuvahki from within the moon's reflection.
threads.quote: Flins: It sounds like she's found a way to influence the past using kuuvahki.

threads.claim: A gravitational force pulls Columbina back whenever she alters reality within the moon's reflection.
threads.quote: Columbina: (Every time I influence reality within that space, this force intervenes and pulls me back...)

threads.claim: Dottore builds false, idyllic realities to manipulate the Traveler.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Could this be... a false memory?)

threads.claim: The Traveler rejects Dottore's illusory paradise as deceitful.
threads.quote: Traveler: False beauty is deceitful. Lies are to no one's taste.

threads.claim: Dottore has fashioned an artificial Moon Marrow to replace the Frost Moon.
threads.quote: The Knave: Using this knowledge, he then fashioned an artificial Moon Marrow to serve as a replacement for the Frost Moon beyond the sky.

threads.claim: Dottore boasts of his artificial Moon Marrow and his own creations.
threads.quote: The Doctor: Think of all the novel things I've managed to create — like the artificial Moon Marrow.

threads.claim: Unlike Columbina, Dottore is not rejected by Teyvat, which gives him an edge.
threads.quote: The Knave: Unlike Columbina, Dottore is not being rejected by Teyvat.

threads.claim: Dottore suggests Columbina's identity and lineage kept her from integrating into Teyvat.
threads.quote: The Doctor: Her identity and lineage may have been a thing of glory in the Old World, but they were also shackles that prevented her from ever integrating into Teyvat.

threads.claim: Dottore has implanted a curse in everyone who entered his research center.
threads.quote: Marionette: Dottore, you son of a... He's done something to us! Everyone who entered his research center has been implanted with some sort of curse.

threads.claim: Flins is cursed and fears it will trigger if he leaves Nod-Krai, so he must stay and act.
threads.quote: Flins: I've been afflicted with some sort of curse, and I'm told it may well trigger if I set foot outside of Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: Dottore claims the Traveler truly longs for family and offers to reunite them with a missing loved one.
threads.quote: The Doctor: What you want is not friends — it is family. But do they know this?

threads.claim: The Traveler admits a deep longing to be reunited with a missing loved one.
threads.quote: Traveler: (I want to see . After everything I've been through, words can't describe how much I miss , how much I want to be reunited with .

threads.claim: The Traveler is Teyvat's Fourth Descender, a fact known to all harbingers.
threads.quote: The Knave: Agreed. is Teyvat's Fourth Descender — all harbingers are aware of this.

threads.claim: The Traveler is asked whether being a Descender is why others see them as different.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...Because I'm a Descender?

threads.claim: Dottore argues that the Four Great Rulers shackle the world and that the gods should be challenged.
threads.quote: The Doctor: These four divisions anchor the world and shackle those who live in it.

threads.claim: Rumors suggest Flins may not be human, a question left open.
threads.quote: Illuga: ...Fine. I'll be frank. You're not human, are you?

threads.claim: Columbina has written messages that moonlight through open windows will reveal on the wall.
threads.quote: Columbina: ...Simply open your windows on nights when the moon shines bright, and the moonlight will naturally flow towards the words I have written.

threads.claim: Nefer and Flins find Columbina's wall of clues, revealed by moonlight, and learn of her survival.
threads.quote: Flins: Not only that, but she's left us an entire wall's worth of clues...

threads.claim: Dottore's energy fields are growing and swallowing Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Durin: Each field is slowly growing, swallowing up more of the surrounding area in the process.

threads.claim: Nefer suspects Dottore is responsible for the energy fields but cannot prove it.
threads.quote: Nefer: I'm convinced this is Dottore's doing, not that there's any way to prove it.

threads.claim: The extra moon detected may be an artificial Moon Marrow built by Dottore.
threads.quote: In which case, the fourth moon you detected may be Dottore's artificial creation.

threads.claim: Dottore stole two Moon Marrows meant for Columbina and built a third to concentrate tri-lunar authority.
threads.quote: Dottore stole two Moon Marrows that should have belonged to Columbina, then built a third Moon Marrow of his own

threads.claim: Columbina is most likely still alive, trapped in a space where time runs backward.
threads.quote: Sandrone, you were right... Columbina is most likely still alive.

threads.claim: Columbina's location is shifting into the past in reverse order, and she may never find her way out.
threads.quote: Random locations... appearing in reverse order?

threads.claim: Columbina wonders whether her actions change the past or merely complete an inevitable process.
threads.quote: (Are my actions changing the past... or are they simply completing a process?)

threads.claim: The world-formula could reveal how the fate of the world is determined, possibly through outside variables.
threads.quote: The world-formula calculates the fate of an entire world.

threads.claim: Ancient texts suggest that introducing variables from outside the system is needed to save civilization.
threads.quote: The sparks of civilization shall run out unless we consider introducing variables from outside the system.

threads.claim: Sandrone suspects Descenders are the outside variables and that Dottore wants their status.
threads.quote: ...Descenders?

threads.claim: Dottore offers to restore the Traveler's Descender status, showing how the title is valued.
threads.quote: I will grant you special privileges, and give you back the status you rightly deserve as a Descender.

threads.claim: Dottore hints that the Traveler misses a sibling and fears learning the answers about them.
threads.quote: That might be because you miss your sibling and fear getting answers that you are not ready to learn

threads.claim: Dottore's experiments swap human minds with animals, turning people into monsters across Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: He's swapping human minds with those of animals...

threads.claim: Those who fought Dottore are cursed, which keeps the Harbingers bound to Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Also, those of us who fought Dottore have been afflicted with a curse.

threads.claim: Rerir and Tholindis may also be alive inside the time space, but no one has returned.
threads.quote: if she's alive, Rerir and Tholindis might be too

threads.claim: Elemental energy may dilute the Light Realm's power, which could weaken Dottore's energy fields.
threads.quote: Could this mean that elemental energy can dilute the power of the Light Realm?

threads.claim: Alain distrusted Rene's claims, leaving a rift between their approaches to the world's fate.
threads.quote: Rene seemed most out of sorts when he spoke to me.

threads.claim: Dottore claims he can slow and control time, and he tested it on the Traveler.
threads.quote: The moment you closed your eyes, time seemed to grow impossibly viscous, didn't it?

threads.claim: Luonnotar is a familiar linked to Columbina and may be the presence that has followed the Traveler through time.
threads.quote: Is it because she has a connection to me as the Moon Goddess's familiar?

threads.claim: Someone has usurped the trilune authority, and Columbina must find a way to rival that power.
threads.quote: I have to find some way of rivaling the power he has usurped...

threads.claim: Time flowing backwards in the lunar reflection may lead to a final destination Columbina now suspects.
threads.quote: I think I know what the final destination of this lunar reflection might be.

threads.claim: Luonnotar is tied to Columbina's soul and is being entrusted to guide the Traveler and help a lost dove.
threads.quote: There's a little lost dove there who will need help.

threads.claim: The gates to the past end because Luonnotar had not yet been born at that time.
threads.quote: And the reason why there are no more gates to the past after this point is that Luonnotar hadn't been born then...

threads.claim: Dottore does not recognize the Traveler, and the Traveler expects he will eventually figure out what they are.
threads.quote: I expect it's only a matter of time before he figures out what I am.

threads.claim: Entering Dottore's new world requires taking innocent lives, and Dottore sees the world's creation as a scientific experiment.
threads.quote: The creation of a world is the ultimate scientific experiment.

threads.claim: Dottore offers the Traveler freedom to kill without consequence, which the Traveler questions as freedom to do evil.
threads.quote: Freedom? But... the freedom to kill? To do evil and get away with it?

threads.claim: Columbina senses a blessing and a hidden soul within the Traveler that she did not initially recognize.
threads.quote: No wonder I sensed the trace of a blessing when we first met, but I still didn't recognize the soul hidden within you.

introduced.name: Noy
