introduced.quote: he was now about to start another one with an ancient fae lord who had come from afar to share some knowledge and technology.

introduced.name: Nukvah
introduced.how: the computational array of Celestia that runs its interior spire and judges Teyvat
introduced.quote: where they are greeted by its computational array, Nukvah.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: a realm whose interior spire holds Nukvah and can be entered through a door at Mt. Mingyuan
introduced.quote: find themselves in the interior spire of Celestia

introduced.name: allogene
introduced.how: a person chosen to be preserved in Celestia as humanity's final record and to guide the next cycle
introduced.quote: the group is to select an allogene to be sent to Celestia for preservation as its the civilization's final record.

introduced.name: Hallowing
introduced.how: a spreading phenomenon that removes the barrier between the fae dead's resentment and the surface
introduced.quote: the Hallowing was removing the barrier between their resentment and the surface, thus allowing their rage to manifest onto anything above.

introduced.name: Fae war on the tundra
introduced.how: fae once fought for dominance on the tundra before the Belyi Tsar united Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: He explains that in the past, before the Belyi Tsar united Snezhnaya, the fae fought for dominance on the tundra.

introduced.name: Trial of Usurpation
introduced.how: a trial at a damaged Nail where authority is used to cure the afflicted
introduced.quote: She enters the damaged Nail and completes the Trial of Usurpation, using her authority to cure the afflicted of the fae remains.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: protectors whose shelter lets Natlanese leave their land without losing memory
introduced.quote: She said it was only safe for Natlanese people to leave their nation under the Wayob's protection — otherwise, they'd lose their memory and stuff.

introduced.name: Lord of the Night
introduced.how: the being who built the bridge linking the Night Kingdom to Natlan and protects it
introduced.quote: The Lord of the Night built the bridge that connects her realm with ours.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: the realm of the Lord of the Night, where Natlan's Nail of Retribution is located
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Right. You've been to the Night Kingdom a number of times — I don't know if you'll recall, but that's where Natlan's Nail of Retribution is.

introduced.name: Granny Itztli
introduced.how: the Great Shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, who knows the Night Kingdom best
introduced.quote: No one understands the Night Kingdom better than her — she's the Great Shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, after all.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a tribe whose shamans take part in the ceremony to reach the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Citlali: You're here for the ceremony, right? Mavuika told you to pick a tribe, and you chose the Masters of the Night-Wind...

introduced.name: ceremony
introduced.how: a shared ceremony that connects everyone's spirits so they see the Pyro Archon's ride
introduced.quote: I'm told that during the ceremony, our spirits will all be connected, and the Pyro Archon riding her flamestrider will appear in our minds' eyes

introduced.name: saurian companions
introduced.how: saurians are partners with their own families, not pets
introduced.quote: Visitors often assume our saurian companions are pets, but we have quite a different relationship.

introduced.name: Natlanese memory loss
introduced.how: Natlanese people abroad forget their tribe or how to use Phlogiston
introduced.quote: Suddenly, they'll find they can't remember their tribe's name, or they'll forget how to use Phlogiston...

introduced.name: Natlan Ley Lines
introduced.how: Natlan's Ley Lines are not connected to the rest of the world
introduced.quote: Traveler: Because Natlan's Ley Lines weren't connected to the rest of the world.

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: researcher on a new energy project at the Armory Palace who reports to the Tsaritsa and The Jester
introduced.quote: Mitya? Isn't he still hard at work researching that new energy?

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: theater staffer who does odd jobs at the Korolevskiy Theater
introduced.quote: I'm Alyosha. I do odd jobs around the theater.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: dancer at the Korolevskiy Theater who is hoisted into the air during performances
introduced.quote: Odette gets hoisted into the air while she dances.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: performer at the Korolevskiy Theater who stands on moving stage platforms
introduced.quote: I sometimes have to stand on a moving platform

introduced.name: Valeriy
introduced.how: official who oversees Mitya's project and manages his meetings
introduced.quote: My job is to ensure the project proceeds smoothly, providing effective support and intervention as necessary.

introduced.name: Noy
introduced.how: distinguished fae lord of Snezhnaya who is visiting to share ancient technology and knowledge
introduced.quote: allow me to introduce Mr. Noy, a distinguished fae lord of Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: where Mitya's energy research normally takes place, hard to access
introduced.quote: Visiting the Armory Palace entails significant administrative hurdles.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: opened by the Tsaritsa as an intel-sharing and strategy hub
introduced.quote: the Tsaritsa has generously opened up Zapolyarny Palace as an intel-sharing and strategy hub.

introduced.name: Korolevskiy Theater
introduced.how: theater where Odette, Vodyanitsa and Alyosha work and perform
introduced.quote: I haven't seen him at the Korolevskiy Theater in forever.

introduced.name: Hallowing
introduced.how: a force that resets everything in its path and releases buried fae fury onto the land
introduced.quote: But now, the Hallowing resets everything in its path, and as millennia of compounded ice disappear in an instant, their fury is released once more upon the land.

introduced.name: gods' remains
introduced.how: fae fury frozen beneath the icy plains after the fae war, released by the Hallowing
introduced.quote: Like their blood, their fury spilled onto the tundra, and there it became frozen in time, sealed away deep beneath the icy plains.

introduced.name: fae war of Snezhnaya
introduced.how: bitter war over land in which the Belyi Tsar rose to unify Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: The fae fought bitter battles over every inch of land, baying for blood and for turf.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: fae leader who rose to power during the war and unified Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: Amidst the fray, the Tsar rose to prominence, becoming a force to be reckoned with.

introduced.name: golden realm catastrophe
introduced.how: catastrophe that destroyed the golden realm, Noy's former home, while Noy was beyond the starry sky
introduced.quote: before it all came crumbling down, it was the land I called home.

introduced.name: plague
introduced.how: a curse formed by dead fae that infects living beings, causing aggression
introduced.quote: This plague — it is a curse, formed by the death of the fae, left to afflict other forms of life.

introduced.name: Love (Tsaritsa's power)
introduced.how: the Tsaritsa's power to undo most curses afflicting the world, which the Heavenly Principles granted
introduced.quote: Love. That is Her Majesty's power — the power to undo most of the curses that afflict the world.

introduced.name: Esoptron
introduced.how: system that runs the Trial of Love and asks for interpretations
introduced.quote: Esoptron: External target detected entering processing area.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: sleeping divine power whose domain lies beyond the door, unreachable by direct communication
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles still slumbers — direct communication would be impossible.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: the realm above, run by an integrated computational array called the Divine Throne
introduced.quote: Celestia's integrated computational array.

introduced.name: Nukvah
introduced.how: computational entity that explains the reset of Teyvat and the allogene reward
introduced.quote: Invitees detected. Attempting to connect to the central database.

introduced.name: allogene
introduced.how: Vision bearers chosen to ascend to Celestia as the final record of the civilization
introduced.quote: In these final 42 days, each of you is to select a single Vision bearer

introduced.name: Vennessa
introduced.how: a past allogene whose consciousness is stored in Celestia's Mind Storage Core
introduced.quote: Or, more simply, where Vennessa is stored.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: Natlan's sacred fire that held sealed information about the allogene secret
introduced.quote: the Hallowing encroached on the Sacred Flame and released some of the sealed information.

introduced.name: Hallowing
introduced.how: a spreading phenomenon that is hard to predict and brings monsters, prompting shelters
introduced.quote: Just the spread of the Hallowing.

introduced.name: Nail of Retribution
introduced.how: a destination in the desert that the sound and the trial are tied to
introduced.quote: Have you been to the Nail of Retribution?

introduced.name: Trial of the Nail of Retribution
introduced.how: a trial at the Nail requiring understanding of wisdom and access to its innermost part
introduced.quote: The trial requires us to understand the topic of "wisdom," and access the innermost part of the Nail of Retribution.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the beings behind the Nail's trials, which one must face alone
introduced.quote: Perhaps one of the stipulations of the trial is that one must face the Heavenly Principles alone

introduced.name: Esoptron
introduced.how: a processing unit inside the Nail that runs the trial and speaks in fragments
introduced.quote: Esoptron: External target detected entering processing area.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: a construct that replaced Irminsul as the center of wisdom and has great processing power
introduced.quote: It replaced Irminsul as the new center of wisdom, right?

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: a Sumeru king who studied the Nail and built Aaru
introduced.quote: Our King was an intelligent man, but without studying that nail, he never would have been able to come up with a creation as exquisite as Aaru

introduced.name: Shouki no Kami
introduced.how: a being from a past crisis that appears in the dreamscape as a painting with missing alternatives
introduced.quote: The Shouki no Kami drawn here has not yet been activated.

introduced.name: Thunderbird
introduced.how: an elemental dragon Ei slew long ago on Seirai, whose primordial Electro energy she sealed
introduced.quote: Long ago, in the distant past, I once slew a great Thunderbird on the island of Seirai which posed a threat to Inazuma's safety.

introduced.name: Primordial Electro energy
introduced.how: dragons' original elemental energy that keeps surging and gives rise to new dragons
introduced.quote: The dragons were the original form of life in Teyvat. Though they may perish, their elemental energy surges on incessantly, eventually giving rise to a new dragon.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: an energy source widely used in Natlan, originating from primordial Pyro energy
introduced.quote: I understand that Phlogiston is a widely used energy source in Natlan whose origin is primordial Pyro energy.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: a distinguished Natlan craftsperson recruited to upgrade the Shogun puppet
introduced.quote: We moved on to a discussion of the most distinguished craftspeople in Natlan. She was quick to recommend you unreservedly.

introduced.name: Skyfrost Nail
introduced.how: a structure at the very top of Dragonspine that is central to the trial and the Hallowing
introduced.quote: Fortunately for us, the Skyfrost Nail is at the very top of Dragonspine.

introduced.name: Hallowing
introduced.how: a spreading calamity that began far from Mondstadt City near Dragonspine
introduced.quote: The Hallowing started far enough away from the city to give us time to respond.

introduced.name: Esoptron
introduced.how: the automated system inside the Skyfrost Nail that runs the trial and asks for an interpretation of freedom
introduced.quote: Trial in progress. Subject: "Freedom." Please submit your interpretation.

introduced.name: Sal Vindagnyr
introduced.how: an ancient civilization that once lived on Dragonspine and was destroyed thousands of years ago, now buried under snow and ice
introduced.quote: Those voices likely belonged to the people of Sal Vindagnyr, an ancient civilization that once existed in this place.

introduced.name: Voices Upon the Wind
introduced.how: anguished voices carried by the wind near the Skyfrost Nail, the memories of a destroyed civilization
introduced.quote: It was faint, but I heard it at the foot of the mountain... dissonant voices upon the wind.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: a store of world information that leaks out as voices or monsters when the Nail's power is unleashed
introduced.quote: As a result, some of the information recorded in the Ley Lines is leaking out.

introduced.name: Varka

introduced.name: hilichurls

introduced.quote: They were once human, too.

assumed.name: Furina's Natlan trip with Mavuika
assumed.quote: Furina was in Natlan anyway, so it made sense to travel together.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Oh, wait! How's Collei doing? Is she any better?

assumed.quote: I heard about what happened in Snezhnaya in a letter I was sent.

assumed.quote: from your battle in the Plane of Euthymia

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: After the meeting in Snezhnaya, I shared my thoughts with both Mavuika and Neuvillette.

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: As is well-known, King Deshret was quite prone to afflictions of that nature.

assumed.name: Traveler's past Sumeru visits
assumed.quote: Yet again, we cross paths under dire circumstances. It is becoming quite the pattern...

assumed.name: Tri-Commission
assumed.quote: The Tri-Commission responded quickly, so things are relatively stable for now.

assumed.name: Musoujin Gorge
assumed.quote: Just like the one that formed Musoujin Gorge...

assumed.name: Sacred Sakura
assumed.quote: But this is nothing compared to the time I planted the Sacred Sakura.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: Before we take action, we need to come up with an answer that has the highest chance of being approved by the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: trial
assumed.quote: He's working on it, now that we know what this "trial" business is about.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: I'm sure you've heard from the Tsaritsa that all the rules of this world are curses.

assumed.name: Decarabian
assumed.quote: He fought alongside them and even helped them overthrow Decarabian himself.

assumed.name: Stormterror crisis
assumed.quote: It was like that during the Stormterror crisis too, so to a lot of people, it's a bad omen.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: If the method didn't matter, Dvalin could deliver someone straight to the center of the nail, and I wouldn't even need to lift a finger.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius have been hard at work scouting, moving resources, fending off the monsters, and drafting an evacuation plan.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah cataclysm
assumed.quote: Hearing those voices, they probably thought the cataclysm was coming all over again

threads.claim: The Hallowing keeps spreading across Natlan in unpredictable patterns, making its reach hard to predict.
threads.quote: But the consequence is that across the rest of Natlan, the Hallowing is showing up in an unpredictable pattern.

threads.claim: Fae who died swearing vengeance leave remains whose rage rises to the surface under the Hallowing.
threads.quote: Many powerful and heroic fae perished on the battlefield, swearing vengeance in their final moments

threads.claim: Anastasya uses the authority she loathed to cure the afflicted of the fae remains.
threads.quote: Seeing this, Anastasya realizes that she has to use the authority she loathed to cure the afflicted.

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night is cut off from Natlan and may not be able to hold out much longer.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Right now, we have no way of knowing how bad of a state the Lord of the Night is in, or how much longer she can hold out.

threads.claim: The Sacred Flame reconnects Mavuika with the Lord of the Night, easing the Hallowing's effects for now.
threads.quote: Mavuika: I've brought you the Sacred Flame. Connecting the two of you should help alleviate the effects of the Hallowing, at least for now.

threads.claim: Natlanese who leave without Wayob protection lose their memory, and the Wayob theory appears to be correct.
threads.quote: Paimon: Sounds like the Wayob theory is correct, then...

threads.claim: The Pyro Gnosis is still missing, and the group needs it to have a real chance against Nukvah.
threads.quote: Paimon worries that if they want to have a fighting chance, they need to find the Pyro Gnosis, which still hasn't been found.

threads.claim: Nukvah treats allogenes as fuel and claims their souls and memories are stored in its light.
threads.quote: and it sees them more as "fuel."

threads.claim: Nukvah says Teyvat must be reset because of humanity's transgression and that annihilation will come within 42 days.
threads.quote: Nukvah explains that Teyvat must be reset as humanity has committed a grave transgression, but commends their ability to prove themselves during the trials.

threads.claim: The Hallowing may have damaged the Pyro Archons' historical records when the Sacred Flame connected with the Lord of the Night.
threads.quote: Mavuika: (Hmm... Did the Hallowing affect the records when the Sacred Flame connected with the Lord of the Night?)

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles may have been deceived about the prophecy without knowing it.
threads.quote: since the Heavenly Principles were unaware of them deceiving the prophecy.

threads.claim: The Trials of Usurpation are the frontline tasks the Traveler must complete to stabilize Teyvat before the Hallowing spreads further.
threads.quote: The most pressing matters facing us are the "Trials" mentioned during the meeting.

threads.claim: The Trial of Love is judged by Esoptron, and Anastasya rejects its premise as a desecration of love.
threads.quote: Please note: The above answer bears no relevance to the trial.

threads.claim: All the trials are passed and the beams of light converge, ending the trials.
threads.quote: Does that mean that we've finally passed all the Trials of Usurpation?

threads.claim: Because the trials were completed, the Heavenly Principles suspend the Holy Soil phenomenon.
threads.quote: However, in completing the trials, you have proven your value. The Holy Soil phenomenon has therefore been suspended.

threads.claim: A mysterious plague spreads alongside the Hallowing, and its origin is initially unknown to the Traveler.
threads.quote: Wait, what plague? This is the first we've ever heard about any plague...

threads.claim: Noy suspects the plague comes from remnants of the golden realm, which is confirmed by the diagnosis.
threads.quote: I believe this plague may be caused by the remnants of the golden realm.

threads.claim: Anastasya declares the plague a curse and orders that sufferers will be healed when the snow next falls.
threads.quote: When next the snow falls, they shall be healed.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's love authority is limited, as she can only remove curses that were not imposed by the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: Yet this power lies under strict limitations.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles are slumbering and cannot be contacted directly.
threads.quote: The Heavenly Principles still slumbers — direct communication would be impossible.

threads.claim: Celestia intends to destroy Teyvat and reset it, while selecting allogenes to ascend as a final record.
threads.quote: Your kind has committed a transgression for which there is no pardon.

threads.claim: Allogenes are revealed to be stored as consciousness in Celestia and used as fuel to guide civilization.
threads.quote: Or, more simply, where Vennessa is stored.

threads.claim: The ancient verse about the allogene's truth refers to the allogene secret hidden in the Sacred Flame.
threads.quote: Who would've thought it was referring to the secret of allogenes.

threads.claim: Xbalanque or someone close to him may have learned the allogene secret through contact with Ronova.
threads.quote: It makes sense that he, or someone close to him, came to learn of the allogene secret somewhere along the way

threads.claim: The location of the Pyro Gnosis is still unknown and must be found.
threads.quote: But we still don't know where the Pyro Gnosis is...

threads.claim: The Traveler rejects Celestia's claim to decide the fate of the world, while Nukvah says everyone has freedom to choose.
threads.quote: The fate of the world should not be yours to decide.

threads.claim: Nukvah insists that people have the freedom to imagine and act as they choose, even as the reset is set.
threads.quote: You have the freedom to imagine what you will and act as you choose.

threads.claim: The Traveler hints that Teyvat may suffer the same fate as Khaenri'ah, a world now lost to memory.
threads.quote: (All of a sudden, Teyvat is to me what Khaenri'ah is to ...

threads.claim: Noy was beyond the starry sky when the golden realm's catastrophe struck, and he was later pulled back by a force he could not resist.
threads.quote: I was lucky enough to be beyond the starry sky when catastrophe struck.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's weapon is an energy project that is not yet ready and is meant to end the Hallowing threat.
threads.quote: If only the Tsaritsa's weapon were ready, then we could all stop worrying about the Hallowing.

threads.claim: The Hallowing can reset everything it touches, and it may be unsettling the sealed primordial Electro.
threads.quote: The Hallowing has the power to reset everything it touches.

threads.claim: A sound only Nahida can hear may be a coded signal from the Nail of Retribution.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, she seems to be the only one who can hear it.

threads.claim: Passing the Nail's trial as the sigil disappears shows the trial was completed.
threads.quote: Look, there's one less sigil! That means we passed the trial, right?

threads.claim: The Nail's signal communicates through dreams, and the answer to the trial was dreams.
threads.quote: The signal is trying to tell us something through dreams. Ready to find out what that is?

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles may be asleep, which makes Esoptron unable to handle unexpected situations.
threads.quote: It's probably because the Heavenly Principles are asleep...

threads.claim: Esoptron fails to connect to its core database and falls back to a default greeting.
threads.quote: Esoptron: Welcome... to the... world...

threads.claim: Ei's technology draws on Khaenri'ah'n knowledge she only partly uncovered.
threads.quote: There was a limit to how much Khaenri'ah'n technology I could uncover

threads.claim: Thunderstorms now come and go without the Shogun controlling them.
threads.quote: It comes and goes without warning... And it doesn't seem to be the Almighty Shogun who is controlling it.

threads.claim: Ei once slew the Thunderbird and sealed its primordial Electro energy, which made every storm in Inazuma hers to control.
threads.quote: Long ago, in the distant past, I once slew a great Thunderbird on the island of Seirai which posed a threat to Inazuma's safety.

threads.claim: Absorbing the Thunderbird's energy led to further inner battles, with more expected before it accepts Ei.
threads.quote: I suspect there will be hundreds more such battles to come.

threads.claim: The past crisis with Shouki no Kami had alternate outcomes that the dreamscape tests, though each choice fails.
threads.quote: The Shouki no Kami drawn here has not yet been activated.

threads.claim: Venti completes the trial by answering a single question, which resolves the Heavenly Principles riddle.
threads.quote: Yup, way easier than I expected. All it did was ask me a question. Liyue's intel was on point.

threads.claim: Venti fears true freedom has not existed in Teyvat for a long time.
threads.quote: And yet, I fear true freedom hasn't existed in Teyvat for a long time.

threads.claim: True freedom requires some to sacrifice their freedom so that others may have it.
threads.quote: True freedom comes at the cost of the few who sacrifice theirs, that others might have it.

threads.claim: All the rules of the world are described as curses.
threads.quote: I'm sure you've heard from the Tsaritsa that all the rules of this world are curses.

threads.claim: Barbatos was cursed with the role of implementing the rules as part of a larger plan.
threads.quote: Or rather, you cursed him with that role.

threads.claim: The power unleashed from the Skyfrost Nail is trying to reset the world.
threads.quote: The power being unleashed from the Skyfrost Nail is attempting to reset the world.

threads.claim: The hilichurls were once human and their behavior is linked to memories of the cataclysm.
threads.quote: They were once human, too.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles offer no hints because the trial is meant as a charitable gesture, not education.
threads.quote: Because, to them, this is a charitable gesture. It is not meant to educate.

threads.claim: Venti hints at a centuries-long witness and speaks of bringing an answer before the Heavenly Principles, suggesting a hidden identity.
threads.quote: And I will bring your answer, and the witness I have borne over the centuries, before the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The voices warn of a Nail of Retribution, hinting at a threat tied to the Skyfrost Nail.
threads.quote: Voices Upon the Wind: Run! Get away from the Nail of Retribution!

introduced.name: Luxembarbo
introduced.how: Security Officer of the Great Red Sand District who joins Cyno's operation
introduced.quote: Luxembarbo: I'm the Security Officer of the Great Red Sand District. My name is Luxembarbo.

introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.how: someone who still has the Akademiya's trust and can be used to gain information
introduced.quote: The current plan involves heading to Pardis Dhyai to find Tighnari, who Alhaitham and Cyno believe still have the Akademiya's trust

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: a manifestation that appears when Haypasia is touched and says the mission is futile
introduced.quote: touching her causes a manifestation of Scaramouche to appear

introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.how: a patient the Fatui wanted handed over for treatment, who has a connection to Scaramouche
introduced.quote: having arrived to ask him to hand over Haypasia for reasons unknown outside of working on her treatment

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger who left Pardis Dhyai and misled the group about his destination
introduced.quote: When they ask him about Dottore, he tells them that the Harbinger had just left

introduced.name: Azar
introduced.how: an Akademiya official who detains the Traveler and orders Alhaitham exiled
introduced.quote: However, Azar intercepts them, having been informed by an eyewitness.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: the location where Lesser Lord Kusanali is held captive
introduced.quote: there should be a way to free Kusanali from the Sanctuary of Surasthana

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: unregistered desert mercenaries who cannot enter Sumeru City openly
introduced.quote: Caravan Ribat would never let so many unregistered members of the Eremites enter Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: a system that predicts people's actions by analyzing their entered data
introduced.quote: By sorting and analyzing entered data, the Akasha can derive behavioral logic, and predict the actions of those who fit an existing logic model.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: believes all human actions can be explained through logic
introduced.quote: The Akademiya firmly believes that all human actions can be explained through logic.

introduced.name: Canned Knowledge capsule
introduced.how: a knowledge capsule that can record a message, such as a decree or the Traveler's conviction
introduced.quote: As I mentioned during the meeting, this knowledge capsule contains a decree I drew up in the past.

introduced.name: forbidden knowledge
introduced.how: knowledge that drives people insane and has been kept hidden from the public
introduced.quote: Forbidden knowledge has the power to drive people insane, but this fact has never been shared with the public.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: a bygone desert civilization whose ruins hold messages about forbidden knowledge
introduced.quote: It was a remnant of King Deshret's bygone civilization and we found some messages left by a priest of the King

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: a captive whose rescue is needed to save Irminsul
introduced.quote: In that case, it's imperative that we rescue Lesser Lord Kusanali.

introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.how: a god who created Nahida from an Irminsul branch and whose memory holds the key to Irminsul
introduced.quote: Rukkhadevata, who reveals that she created Nahida from the purest Irminsul branch to serve as her incarnation in the 'next samsara'.

introduced.name: Nahida
introduced.how: the Archon whom the Traveler meets in person for the first time at the Sanctuary
introduced.quote: Heading into the Sanctuary, the Traveler and Paimon meet Nahida in person for the first time.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a sick tree whose disease is believed to cause the Withering and sandstorms
introduced.quote: Paimon thought that Irminsul's disease is what caused the Withering and the sandstorms.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: a visitor from outside Teyvat, and the Traveler is counted as the fourth such visitor
introduced.quote: Nahida also reveals that the Fatui had classified them as Teyvat's fourth

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: a being that the Electro Gnosis could potentially awaken if misused
introduced.quote: could potentially awaken Celestia

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: Introduced as an Eremite mercenary hired to act as the Traveler's bodyguard
introduced.quote: This is our friend, Dehya. She's an Eremite mercenary!

introduced.name: The Doctor
introduced.how: A masked Fatui Harbinger with blue hair who wants Haypasia taken to Snezhnaya and is leaving Sumeru by boat
introduced.quote: He's that strange-looking Fatui Harbinger with a mask! Paimon thinks he has blue hair.

introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.how: A Sumeru-born Akademiya scholar who has been receiving treatment from Tighnari
introduced.quote: Haypasia was born in Sumeru, and remains a scholar of the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.how: A Forest Watcher and scholar at Pardis Dhyai whom the group seeks for intel on The Doctor
introduced.quote: According to the plan, we should first go to Pardis Dhyai, and ask for Forest Watcher Tighnari.

introduced.name: Pardis Dhyai
introduced.how: A place where scholars live and work, where Tighnari is staying
introduced.quote: I may be staying at Pardis Dhyai as a scholar, but that doesn't mean I'm no longer a Forest Watcher.

introduced.name: The Balladeer
introduced.how: A voice that speaks from within Haypasia's consciousness, claiming to be becoming a god
introduced.quote: I was born to become a god. My entire life up until this point has just been a meaningless routine.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: An institution of sages and scholars that controls all of Sumeru
introduced.quote: Dealing with an institution that controls all of Sumeru is already hard enough

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: The Doctor's homeland, to which he is returning
introduced.quote: Yes, he told me his return to Snezhnaya is imminent.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: A southern port where The Doctor's boat departs, full of Fatui soldiers
introduced.quote: To the south of here is Port Ormos, which seems to be where they're headed.

introduced.name: The Eremites
introduced.how: A group of mercenaries Cyno smuggled into Sumeru City
introduced.quote: I can't believe you actually got so many Eremites into Sumeru City!

introduced.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: Something the Akademiya plans to use to infuse the Balladeer's consciousness, which is extremely risky
introduced.quote: The Akademiya plans to infuse your consciousness with Divine Knowledge Capsules... this is extremely risky.

introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.how: An Akademiya member called the Scribe who handles strategy and records meetings
introduced.quote: Then I should remind you that I'm the Scribe.

introduced.name: Haypasia's encounter with The Balladeer
introduced.how: Haypasia connected her consciousness to The Balladeer and saw his past
introduced.quote: She peered into my consciousness and saw my past.

introduced.name: Jnagarbha Day
introduced.how: the Akademiya's most important day, when research and decrees are loaded into the Akasha
introduced.quote: Don't forget, today is Jnagarbha Day, arguably the most important day to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: capsules carrying research and decrees that are entered into the Akasha
introduced.quote: The sages and core Akademiya personnel are busy loading the latest batch of research developments and legal decrees into Knowledge Capsules, so that they can be entered into the Akasha.

introduced.name: Azar
introduced.how: Grand Sage whose office holds the console that can free Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.quote: Our target is Grand Sage Azar's office. Everyone in the Akademiya knows that's where the Grand Sage's console is.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: sanctuary where Greater Lord Rukkhadevata once meditated and where Lesser Lord Kusanali is held
introduced.quote: In the Sanctuary of Surasthana, there's a device of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's that she once used to isolate herself while meditating.

introduced.name: Rukkhadevata's isolation device
introduced.how: a meditation device that the sages later modified to trap a god inside it
introduced.quote: In the Sanctuary of Surasthana, there's a device of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's that she once used to isolate herself while meditating.

introduced.name: House of Daena
introduced.how: the Akademiya's extensive special collections library
introduced.quote: Known as the House of Daena, it is quite possibly the most extensive special collections library in Teyvat.

introduced.name: Viraf
introduced.how: a Haravatat student who is the top student and recent debate placer
introduced.quote: I'm the top student in Haravatat, and I earned third place at the last inter-Darshan debate.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: a system that predicts people's actions and tracks them in real time, acting as an invisible leash
introduced.quote: With the Akasha's calculation prowess, all of your actions will be predicted with an accuracy of at least 98%.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: a device worn by Akademiya staff and prisoners that connects to the Akasha
introduced.quote: Paimon thought they'd take our Akasha Terminals when they locked us up in here.

introduced.name: Isak
introduced.how: a young Eremite who disguises himself as Lesser Lord Kusanali to lure guards away
introduced.quote: Okay, got it. I'm here to pay back Lesser Lord Kusanali for helping Grandpa.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: guards reporting to the six sages, with a reputation for following orders without principle
introduced.quote: most of the guards who report directly to the six sages belong to the Corps of Thirty

introduced.name: The Eremites
introduced.how: desert mercenaries who ambush the Akademiya guards in Sumeru City
introduced.quote: This is Sumeru City, but mercenaries from the desert somehow ambushed us!?

introduced.name: Artistic Performances Prohibition Act
introduced.how: a decree drafted by Alhaitham banning public performances, to be entered into the Akasha
introduced.quote: I was originally asked to draft the Knowledge Capsule for the "Artistic Performances Prohibition Act" when I was still at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Realm of Consciousness
introduced.how: a dark inner space where a Traveler can reach a sealed consciousness, reached through a barrier
introduced.quote: (Is this... a realm of consciousness?)

introduced.name: Deus Foundry
introduced.how: hidden facility inside the Akademiya where the sages built their god creation plan in secret
introduced.quote: The sages wanted to realize their god creation plan without being discovered.

introduced.name: Boat of Consciousness
introduced.how: a boat in the consciousness realm that symbolizes reason, with its course set by where consciousness travels
introduced.quote: That's the Boat of Consciousness, which symbolizes reason here. Its course is the direction our consciousness is traveling towards.

introduced.name: Forbidden knowledge
introduced.how: knowledge from the bottom of the Abyss that does not belong to this world and cannot be understood, which pollutes Irminsul
introduced.quote: It's a kind of knowledge that doesn't belong to this world, and a form of "truth" that can't be understood.

introduced.name: The Balladeer
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger who was formerly a prototype puppet of the Raiden Shogun and is being made into a god
introduced.quote: Paimon knows that he was a prototype puppet for the Raiden Shogun before he became a Fatui Harbinger

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: a divine power source; the Balladeer was created to serve as the vessel for one
introduced.quote: One is the desire for a Gnosis, since he was created to be the vessel for one.

introduced.name: Shouki no Kami
introduced.how: the machine body the Balladeer fights in, powered by a Gnosis
introduced.quote: The Shouki no Kami violently slams against the Traveler and the others, quaking the entire shrine

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: a past war between archons, fought under the demands of the laws, whose losses Nahida calls meaningless
introduced.quote: All those losses were meaningless, driven by the demands of the "laws."

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: a restricted sanctuary that people are normally forbidden to enter
introduced.quote: It's normally forbidden to enter that place.

introduced.name: Nahida as Irminsul's purest branch
introduced.how: Nahida is a branch snapped from Irminsul, the new incarnation of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.quote: As Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, I'm the avatar of Irminsul, and you are the purest branch snapped from Irminsul.

introduced.name: samsara
introduced.how: a cycle of rebirth through which Rukkhadevata continues in Nahida as the new self
introduced.quote: You are me in the new samsara.

introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.how: Nahida can transfer memories of past samsara cycles to others as knowledge
introduced.quote: Nahida bestows canned knowledge of the past samara cycles unto the Traveler

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the cosmic laws that the Gnoses symbolize control over; they have been silent for years
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles have been silent for many years, but the Gnoses are symbols of their control over Teyvat and all the laws

introduced.name: segments
introduced.how: the Doctor's preserved copies of himself at each age, made into independent individuals
introduced.quote: So I saved "segments" of all my ages, and made them into independent individuals

introduced.name: dream-inducing sound wave
introduced.how: a sound wave that puts defenseless people into a dream, found among the sages' research
introduced.quote: Just a type of sound wave that can quickly put defenseless people into a dream.

introduced.name: Desert forbidden knowledge pollution
introduced.how: forbidden knowledge polluted the desert thousands of years ago and was repelled by King Deshret's self-sacrifice
introduced.quote: Forbidden knowledge once polluted the desert thousands of years ago, but was successfully repelled thanks to King Deshret's self-sacrifice

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah cataclysm
introduced.how: a disaster five hundred years ago that coincided with a second forbidden knowledge pollution and changed the sky's color
introduced.quote: The disaster occurred together with the pollution of forbidden knowledge.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: Rukkhadevata built it to compile human wisdom and fight forbidden knowledge
introduced.quote: I created a device that compiled human wisdom, and named it "the Akasha."

introduced.name: Akasha shutdown
introduced.how: the Akasha was turned off, so the people of Sumeru no longer rely on it
introduced.quote: From what Tighnari and Collei have said, the Akasha has been turned off completely, and the people of Sumeru will no longer rely on it.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: Sumeru's city guards, who could have served as reinforcements
introduced.quote: I didn't know we could have even counted the city guards of the Corps of Thirty among our potential reinforcements.

introduced.name: Asfand
introduced.how: the senior consultant of the Corps of Thirty
introduced.quote: Dehya went to find Asfand, the senior consultant of the Corps of Thirty

introduced.name: fate as ultimate knowledge
introduced.how: Nahida's view that fate, what has yet to occur, is the highest form of knowledge
introduced.quote: So to me, "fate" is the ultimate knowledge.

introduced.name: Six Great Schools
introduced.how: the Dendro Archon founded six schools, each for a type of wisdom, and they became the Six Darshans' homes
introduced.quote: It's said that when the Akademiya was first founded, the Dendro Archon herself established the Six Great Schools, each representing one of the six different types of wisdom.

introduced.name: Kaveh
introduced.how: Alhaitham's roommate and the Kshahrewar scholars' representative, who clashes with him
introduced.quote: His name is Kaveh, my roommate. You could say he's the representative for Kshahrewar scholars.

introduced.name: Setaria
introduced.how: a scholar who is leaving the Akademiya to teach in the desert
introduced.quote: I plan to leave the Akademiya and return to teach here in the desert.

introduced.name: The Eremites
introduced.how: desert people spread across Sumeru who can help select teachers
introduced.quote: there are many of us Eremites all over Sumeru.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a Fontaine device that records people's appearances as pictures
introduced.quote: I heard there's a device in Fontaine called a "Kamera" that can record people's appearances as pictures.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the nation of justice, with a judicial system
introduced.quote: Fontaine, the nation of justice.

introduced.name: Focalors
introduced.how: the Hydro Archon, who attends nearly every trial and can sway verdicts
introduced.quote: As archon, she still reserves the right to influence the final verdict.

introduced.name: Avidya Forest
introduced.how: where the imprisoned sages now train for the rest of their lives
introduced.quote: The sages involved in recent incidents have begun their training in the Avidya Forest

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: lingering zones left behind by the crisis that Forest Rangers must keep handling
introduced.quote: The Withering is one example. Though it won't spread anymore, the existing zones won't just disappear.

introduced.name: Descenders
introduced.how: external beings from outside this world, of which the Traveler is the Fourth
introduced.quote: A very important part of the intel was about this world's Descenders... external beings, ones that don't belong to this world.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali's great disaster
introduced.how: she used all her power in a disaster and lost her wisdom and memories, so the Akademiya abandoned her
introduced.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali once used all her power in a great disaster, which resulted in her losing all of her wisdom and memories of the past.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: a centralized knowledge system that Nahida has decided to shut down permanently
introduced.quote: I've given it some thought, and have decided to shut it down permanently.

introduced.name: Descenders
introduced.how: external beings from outside this world, not native to Teyvat
introduced.quote: external beings, ones that don't belong to this world.

introduced.name: Fourth Descender
introduced.how: the Traveler is Teyvat's Fourth Descender according to Fatui intel
introduced.quote: you are Teyvat's "Fourth Descender."

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: likely identity of the First Descender, per Nahida's hypothesis
introduced.quote: my current hypothesis is that the "First Descender" was likely what we now call the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Candace
assumed.quote: Paimon: Candace! We're here!

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Dehya: Hey, where've you been? I've missed you two!

assumed.name: General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Gaete: General Mahamatra!? T—To what do we owe the honor?

assumed.name: Jnagarbha Day
assumed.quote: Traveler: We'll make our move on the next Jnagarbha Day.

assumed.name: Rahman
assumed.quote: Rahman: ...Hmm, sounds good. I'll go make some preparations.

assumed.name: Morghi
assumed.quote: Morghi: Oh? It's the Scribe... and is that the Traveler I see?

assumed.name: Il Dottore
assumed.quote: Due to the threat posed by Il Dottore, Dehya states that they'll need information on him before proceeding with their plan.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: with the Tsaritsa calling for his return

assumed.name: Avidya Forest incident
assumed.quote: You mean, it's related to the scene you saw when you passed out in the Avidya Forest?

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: he challenges them to a fight as to reenact a scene of the Archon War

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: We need to make sure he won't get in our way when we rescue Lesser Lord Kusanali.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: For now, all we can share with you is that... your friend Cyno is working with us.

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, it's Nilou!

assumed.name: Prior encounters with The Balladeer
assumed.quote: Haha, I've missed that look of abject horror. You've given me that look every time we meet.

assumed.name: Akasha Terminal
assumed.quote: We have made the necessary modifications to the Akasha Terminal.

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: It can't be... Is The Balladeer using the Gnosis to change the weather?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: what with Her Most Noble Majesty, the Tsaritsa, calling for our return.

assumed.name: Wall of Samiel
assumed.quote: The sages have placed spies everywhere on the other side of the Wall.

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: Since you are always at Gandharva Ville, you would like me

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali has sealed off her consciousness in the Akasha ever since she was captured by The Doctor.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: This is the first time we've met in real life. Before, we've only met in dreams, consciousness, or when I was in someone else's body.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: General Mahamatra Cyno, who had defected from the Akademiya.

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: I had already left her behind once when The Doctor first appeared.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: Even Irminsul will be freed from its plight.

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: We are a people favored by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Paimon: Alhaitham should be waiting for us.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Here they come. Did you see that, Rahman?

assumed.name: Rahman
assumed.quote: According to the Akademiya scholars in Rahman's custody, Lesser Lord Kusanali has sealed off her consciousness in the Akasha ever since she was captured by The Doctor.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Please don't bring outside guests into the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Did you manage to rescue Lesser Lord Kusanali?

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: Are you here for Nilou?

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: If it was to rescue the Dendro Archon, we would've helped as well

assumed.name: Grand Sage Azar
assumed.quote: I'm looking for Grand Sage Azar. Have you seen him?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: The more I think about it, the more I believe there's something fishy about Alhaitham's return.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: To think the Akademiya wants to ban artistic performances

assumed.name: Fatui Harbinger
assumed.quote: The Fatui Harbingers are all such weirdos

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: The Fatui under The Doctor sure didn't hold back

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: falling on various people afflicted by Eleazar

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: Irminsul is still waiting to be saved

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's design is truly brilliant.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: At that time, The Seven were all summoned to the nation of Khaenri'ah, except for me.

assumed.name: Divine Knowledge Capsules
assumed.quote: It seems that the sages didn't get the chance to infuse the Divine Knowledge Capsules into him

assumed.name: Sabzeruz Festival
assumed.quote: The people of Sumeru were forced to live through the exact same number of Sabzeruz Festivals and samsara cycles?

assumed.name: Neo Akasha Terminal
assumed.quote: which was stored in the Neo Akasha Terminal

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: When we woke up, we found ourselves in Gandharva Ville, and Tighnari and Collei were looking after us.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Not even Tighnari can stop us from going out now, right?

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Collei says it's time for breakfast.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: I heard that it was Cyno who brought us here.

assumed.name: General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: celebrate Cyno's reinstatement as the General Mahamatra!

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: Well, now that I've recovered from Eleazar, I'm feeling better than ever.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: It seems once Irminsul started getting better, everything else started to recover, too!

assumed.name: Azar
assumed.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali in her boundless mercy has decided to spare Azar and the other wrongdoers.

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: When they learned that Lesser Lord Kusanali had defeated The Balladeer and saved Irminsul

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah disaster
assumed.quote: In fact, the Heavenly Principles has been quiet since the Khaenri'ah disaster five hundred years ago.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: I'm sure you remember the entity that changed your fate — the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Gnoses and Fatui Harbingers
assumed.quote: The top-ranked Fatui Harbingers, up to No. 3, possess power comparable to that of gods.

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: You mean, what happened after The Doctor put you to sleep?

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: I truly regret that I can't help you more as the God of Wisdom...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: And soon, you'll also begin your journey anew, and depart from Sumeru.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah disaster
assumed.quote: After the Khaenri'ah disaster, began journey through the seven nations of Teyvat.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: the Irminsul records on suddenly become fuzzy...

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: your sibling suddenly appeared in Khaenri'ah...

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: the information I received from the Fatui in return for my Gnosis

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: So the Fatui count three other Descenders before ?

assumed.name: Akasha
assumed.quote: About the Akasha...

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: About The Balladeer...

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: About Fontaine, the next stop on my journey...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Could it be related to... the Abyss?

threads.claim: Dottore offers to tell the Traveler about the skies of Teyvat being fake in exchange for Nahida's Gnosis.
threads.quote: Dottore offers her information about

threads.claim: Forbidden knowledge drives people insane and has been hidden from the public, possibly causing Sumeru's madness.
threads.quote: Forbidden knowledge has the power to drive people insane, but this fact has never been shared with the public.

threads.claim: Irminsul's illness may be caused by pollution from forbidden knowledge rather than being its own cause.
threads.quote: The cause of Irminsul's illness may precisely be the pollution from forbidden knowledge.

threads.claim: The Traveler's blackout in Avidya Forest and the words about the world forgetting Rukkhadevata hint at a hidden memory tied to saving Irminsul.
threads.quote: it's related to the scene you saw when you passed out in the Avidya Forest?

threads.claim: Rukkhadevata's consciousness is removed, which restores Irminsul and removes the forbidden knowledge.
threads.quote: As Rukkhadevata is removed, Irminsul is restored, which in turn allows the people of Sumeru to dream again

threads.claim: The Traveler is considered Teyvat's fourth Descender, and the identities of the earlier Descenders are unknown.
threads.quote: Nahida also reveals that the Fatui had classified them as Teyvat's fourth

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling appeared in Khaenri'ah, and records of their journey after the cataclysm are fuzzy, suggesting someone withheld information.
threads.quote: Nahida also reveals that their sibling, despite not originating from Teyvat, was recorded in Irminsul as suddenly appearing in Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: Scaramouche has been made a new Greater Lord Rukkhadevata by the Akademiya, a risky ascension process.
threads.quote: the Akademiya only sees him as a new Greater Lord Rukkhadevata

threads.claim: The Electro Gnosis could awaken Celestia if misused, a danger that raises stakes around the gnoses.
threads.quote: could potentially awaken Celestia

threads.claim: Nahida identifies Scaramouche as a false god that must be stopped.
threads.quote: also to stop the false god

threads.claim: Nahida takes sole control of the Akasha and revokes the sages' access to it.
threads.quote: Nahida reverts the Akasha to be used by herself only and revoke all of the sages' access

threads.claim: The Doctor wants to take Haypasia to Snezhnaya for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: Since you asked, I'll be frank: I would like to take Haypasia to Snezhnaya.

threads.claim: The Balladeer is close to completing his transformation into a god.
threads.quote: My deification is nearly complete. All that's left now are just some final details.

threads.claim: Haypasia has seen something in The Balladeer's past that others want hidden.
threads.quote: I'm afraid that she's seen something that she wasn't supposed to see.

threads.claim: The Doctor seems to have changed in personality and expression, and nobody knows why.
threads.quote: Also, for some reason, he seems like he's... all smiles now.

threads.claim: The lightning storms may be a living force tied to The Balladeer's power.
threads.quote: Lightning started attacking everyone, almost as if it were alive.

threads.claim: The Balladeer may be using the Gnosis to control the weather.
threads.quote: It can't be... Is The Balladeer using the Gnosis to change the weather?

threads.claim: Tighnari's master may have been harmed, since his usual signature dots are missing from recent letters.
threads.quote: I didn't find any dots in his recent letters. I believe... something may have happened to him.

threads.claim: The Akademiya is working on a big project that its master may be involved in.
threads.quote: The Akademiya has been working on a big project. I'm not quite sure what it is, but your master might be involved with it.

threads.claim: The Akademiya is pursuing a plan to create a god, which Tighnari finds ridiculous.
threads.quote: The Akademiya's... god creation plan... How ridiculous.

threads.claim: The Doctor claims everyone must eventually pay a price for what they have learned.
threads.quote: And that's also why people like you can never realize that sooner or later, everyone must pay the price for what they've learned.

threads.claim: Tighnari sends Cyno a message urging him to trust his own senses and experiences.
threads.quote: Trust your own senses and experiences.

threads.claim: The Doctor's departure was a trap, with the soldiers vanishing and Haypasia now in danger.
threads.quote: So this was a trap...

threads.claim: The Akademiya's sages are secretly trying to create a god, a plan Azar openly defends.
threads.quote: Creating a god... Yes, we are using human wisdom to create a god!

threads.claim: The false god is a looming threat that Nahida resolves to stop before it is born.
threads.quote: We need to hurry and prevent the birth of that false god.

threads.claim: The sages modified a device of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata to trap a god, so it can no longer be controlled from the inside.
threads.quote: Five hundred years ago, the Grand Sage at the time modified the device so that it can no longer be controlled from the inside.

threads.claim: Nahida's sealed consciousness is freed when the barrier around her breaks.
threads.quote: (The barrier breaks)

threads.claim: Under the Akasha, people are monitored and predicted, and the sages' control over the system is absolute.
threads.quote: Wherever you go, you will be walking under an invisible leash.

threads.claim: Nahida plans to take direct control of the Akasha by revoking the sages' permissions.
threads.quote: Since I'm now free, I can establish a direct link to the Akasha and control it.

threads.claim: Relying on the Akasha may turn humans into machines that no longer question what they are told.
threads.quote: The Akasha will turn humans into "machines." I've seen it happen many times.

threads.claim: Cyno has escaped the Akasha's predictions, suggesting its foresight has limits.
threads.quote: Admit it, the Akasha can't predict my actions anymore.

threads.claim: The Doctor is a figure who has been involved in Lesser Lord Kusanali's capture and provides technological support to the Akademiya.
threads.quote: I had already left her behind once when The Doctor first appeared.

threads.claim: Irminsul is in a plight that Nahida has been working to save.
threads.quote: Kept looking for a way to save Irminsul...

threads.claim: A voice in the sealed consciousness asks who is speaking and suggests the archon's inner voice matters.
threads.quote: Who... are you? Whose voice is that? It sounds familiar...

threads.claim: Alhaitham staged his apparent corruption to swap the Knowledge Capsule and carry out the plan.
threads.quote: When he pretended that he had been corrupted...

threads.claim: A rumor says the skies of Teyvat are fake, a secret that Irminsul hides about the true nature of the world.
threads.quote: Have you in all your mighty knowledge ever heard the rumor that "the skies of Teyvat are fake"?

threads.claim: The Khaenri'ah cataclysm turned the sky a strange color and coincided with forbidden knowledge pollution.
threads.quote: Everything that day, even the sky itself, changed into a color like this...

threads.claim: Forbidden knowledge comes from the Abyss and is so alien that even the God of Wisdom cannot understand it.
threads.quote: It came from the very bottom of the Abyss. Even I could never understand it.

threads.claim: Nahida hopes the last memory of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata will explain the most important mystery.
threads.quote: We may now finally understand the last memory of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata

threads.claim: Rukkhadevata's last words reveal she chose to be erased from the world so Irminsul could be purified.
threads.quote: "Let the world completely forget me."

threads.claim: Irminsul remains corrupted and is still waiting to be saved.
threads.quote: Irminsul is still waiting to be saved

threads.claim: The people of Sumeru's wisdom cleared almost all forbidden knowledge from Irminsul.
threads.quote: Thanks to the wisdom of the people of Sumeru, almost all the forbidden knowledge was cleared from Irminsul.

threads.claim: The Balladeer has a past that Nahida cannot explain, which fuels one of his obsessions.
threads.quote: The other obsession is probably related to his past. I can't quite explain it.

threads.claim: The Balladeer's former identity as Kunikuzushi is hinted at and treated as something he now despises.
threads.quote: The existence of what once called itself "Kunikuzushi" appears infinitely small

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles have been silent for years, yet they may respond if a Gnosis is destroyed.
threads.quote: The Heavenly Principles have been silent for many years, but the Gnoses are symbols of their control over Teyvat and all the laws

threads.claim: Nahida treats fate as the ultimate knowledge, and her own fate is now something she will personally experience.
threads.quote: So to me, "fate" is the ultimate knowledge.

threads.claim: The Traveler may remember events that others forget because they are not from this world.
threads.quote: (Did I manage to remember because I'm not from this world?)

threads.claim: Everyone except the Traveler seems to have forgotten Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.
threads.quote: Has everybody really forgotten Greater Lord Rukkhadevata?

threads.claim: The Doctor has split himself into many segments across time, and they may pursue revenge.
threads.quote: So I saved "segments" of all my ages, and made them into independent individuals

threads.claim: Nahida forces the Doctor to erase his other segments, and their dying thoughts threaten revenge.
threads.quote: How about erasing all your other segments?

threads.claim: The Akasha is turned off and Sumeru stops relying on it, which will change people's lives.
threads.quote: the Akasha has been turned off completely, and the people of Sumeru will no longer rely on it.

threads.claim: An archon's power depends on the faith of their people, and Nahida is less beloved than Rukkhadevata was.
threads.quote: However, I'm not as well-loved as Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

threads.claim: The Traveler is revealed to be Teyvat's Fourth Descender, an outsider from beyond this world.
threads.quote: you are Teyvat's "Fourth Descender."

threads.claim: Someone is deliberately obscuring the Traveler's sibling's fate in Irminsul records, and the Traveler's origin remains unexplained.
threads.quote: All I know for sure is that somebody, for reasons only they can know, is deliberately obfuscating fate...

threads.claim: Nahida hypothesizes the First Descender was the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: My current hypothesis is that the "First Descender" was likely what we now call the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles has been dormant since the Khaenri'ah disaster and can be used as leverage.
threads.quote: In fact, the Heavenly Principles has been quiet since the Khaenri'ah disaster five hundred years ago.

threads.claim: Nahida made a bluffed deal with The Doctor, trading Gnoses for knowledge after threatening to awaken the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: I told him that the Heavenly Principles may be awakened if I destroyed a Gnosis.

threads.claim: The Balladeer is in a coma, hidden by Nahida, and his future remains uncertain.
threads.quote: He's still in a coma. I've hidden him like how one would hide a feather.

threads.claim: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata has been forgotten by everyone except the Traveler, who keeps the secret.
threads.quote: Maybe I'm the only one in all of Teyvat who remembers that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata ever existed.

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali lost her wisdom and memories after a great disaster, and Sumeru has rewritten its history around her.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali once used all her power in a great disaster, which resulted in her losing all of her wisdom and memories of the past.

threads.claim: Nahida shuts the Akasha down permanently, ending its centralized control of knowledge.
threads.quote: I've given it some thought, and have decided to shut it down permanently.

threads.claim: Azar and the wrongdoing sages were spared and sent to the Avidya Forest instead of being executed.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali in her boundless mercy has decided to spare Azar and the other wrongdoers.

threads.claim: Setaria plans to bring education to the desert, aided by the Eremites and Cyno.
threads.quote: I plan to leave the Akademiya and return to teach here in the desert.

threads.claim: The desert people have long been mistreated, and Nahida plans to rebuild their trust.
threads.quote: They have been mistreated for far too long.

threads.claim: Focalors' unusual influence over Fontaine's trials hints at a distinctive and questionable archon.
threads.quote: As archon, she still reserves the right to influence the final verdict.

threads.claim: Alhaitham refused the nomination to become Grand Sage, leaving the succession open.
threads.quote: The person in charge of personnel affairs nominated me to be the Grand Sage in place of Azar

threads.claim: Kaveh suspects his Darshan may have colluded with Azar, and the Akademiya's politics remain uncertain.
threads.quote: Did my Darshan collude with Azar as well?

threads.claim: Someone with unknown motives is deliberately obscuring fate and the Irminsul records, and may be capable of more.
threads.quote: is deliberately obfuscating fate...

threads.claim: Other Descenders besides the Traveler are claimed to exist but have not yet been verified.
threads.quote: I still need to verify their existence.

threads.claim: The First Descender may be the Heavenly Principles, which remains an unconfirmed hypothesis.
threads.quote: my current hypothesis is that the "First Descender" was likely what we now call the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling appeared in Khaenri'ah and is not classified as a Descender, so their origin is unexplained.
threads.quote: Something else I noticed was that according to these records, the Fatui have not classified your sibling as one of the "Descenders."

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the Abyss may be connected to the fate-obscuring events, but this is left open.
threads.quote: Could it be related to... the Abyss?

threads.claim: The Traveler's future journey cannot be observed or recorded by this world, making it a special kind of fate.
threads.quote: It's a journey that can't be observed or recorded by this world...

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: a professional trainer and coach who designs workout and meal plans and helps lead the rescue work
introduced.quote: I'm a professional trainer. I design workout plans, meal plans, all that good stuff.

introduced.name: Mutota
introduced.how: the chief who greets the group and oversees the tribe's recovery after the battle
introduced.quote: Mutota: You're here, Iansan! Oh, and you must be and Paimon. I've heard a lot about you.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: a tribe hit hardest by the invasion, and Chasca's tribe
introduced.quote: The Flower-Feather Clan was hit the hardest, right? That's Chasca's tribe.

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: a Flower-Feather Clan warrior who brought Atoco back from the wilderness and clears remaining monsters
introduced.quote: Mutota: She was the one who brought Atoco back from the wilderness.

introduced.name: Cochitta
introduced.how: a warrior whose parents died fighting the Abyss, leaving her with severe trauma
introduced.quote: Mutota: When Cochitta was little, her parents died fighting the Abyss.

introduced.name: Gosoythoth
introduced.how: an Abyssal monster that appeared in the sky, called the Reaper of the Abyss, whose power caused the mental wounds
introduced.quote: Mutota: It's the Abyssal monster that appeared in the sky not too long ago.

introduced.name: Duarte
introduced.how: Atoco's saurian companion who saved him as a child and died four years ago in an Abyss attack
introduced.quote: Duarte was the name of Atoco's saurian companion. Atoco almost drowned as a child, and Duarte was the one who saved him.

introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
introduced.how: a mental trauma illness caused by high concentrations of Abyssal power
introduced.quote: Direct contact with high concentrations of Abyssal power causes irreversible mental trauma in most people.

introduced.name: Draught of Lucidity
introduced.how: a medicine that dispels the Abyss's psychological impact, reserved for severe cases due to lifelong migraines
introduced.quote: It's a kind of medicine that can dispel the psychological impact of the Abyss.

introduced.name: Munay
introduced.how: Ocotlan's father, who introduces himself and thanks Capitano
introduced.quote: I owe you more than words can say, Mr. Capitano. My name is Munay.

introduced.name: Capitano
introduced.how: a former outlander knight who arrived in Natlan five hundred years ago and now treats the Abyssal illness
introduced.quote: When my platoon arrived in Natlan five hundred years ago, like you, we were true outlanders.

introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.how: a military doctor and second-in-command who invented the Draught of Lucidity and died testing it on himself
introduced.quote: The draught was Guthred's invention. He was a respected military doctor as well as my trusted second-in-command.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: the homeland from which Capitano's platoon fled to Natlan
introduced.quote: Just as I fought for the glory of Khaenri'ah, they fought for the survival of their nation.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: the Ruler of Death, who can define the form of death or grant immortality, and who caused Capitano's suffering
introduced.quote: The Ruler of Death can freely define the form of death, or grant immortality to anyone she desires.

introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.how: a device Xilonen gave the Traveler that records progress for forging the Ancient Name, containing their deeds
introduced.quote: She needs to check the progress of the Pilgrim's Chronicle... that device she gave you before.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: a name forged from the gathered stories and hopes of people, which Xilonen will create for the Traveler
introduced.quote: When the time comes... I will forge you an Ancient Name unlike anything that's come before, so that you, Mavuika, and Natlan as a whole can finally put an end to this endless war.

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: the common saurian mount type that Duarte belonged to, which the Traveler impersonates
introduced.quote: He was a bit on the smaller side, but other than that, he was just your average Qucusaur.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right! When we were with Mavuika, you told us you and your soldiers defended Natlan against the Abyss five hundred years ago.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: Kinich, Kachina, Mualani! Whoa... everyone's here!

assumed.name: Abyssal power
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right, you can purify Abyssal power! Might as well give it a try!

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Iansan: Apparently, Xilonen's ready to start forging your Ancient Name.

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death can grant immortality or dictate the form of death, and the Captain hints she is the source of his suffering.
threads.quote: The Ruler of Death can freely define the form of death, or grant immortality to anyone she desires.

threads.claim: Mavuika's use of the Ruler of Death's power carries a price of death that remains set in stone even after the war.
threads.quote: Natlan must pay the price for Mavuika's use of the Ruler of Death's power. That price is death, and only Mavuika's death can clear the debt.

threads.claim: The Captain is hiding a personal goal and his aims are not fully aligned with the Traveler's.
threads.quote: However, some things are better kept secret for now. We may be working together, but our goals are not entirely aligned.

threads.claim: The party still does not know the Captain's real goal, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon: So, in the end, The Captain still hasn't told us his real goal.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the soul that possessed Ororon was Guthred, linking the dead doctor to the present.
threads.quote: Traveler: It was Guthred, wasn't it?

threads.claim: The Captain once was a famous Sentinel Knight but refuses to use that name, feeling he failed his soldiers and Natlan.
threads.quote: That name carries with it the glory of my homeland and the honor of Natlan. Yet, I failed to bring my soldiers home, and I failed to help Natlan defeat the Abyss.

threads.claim: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome has resurfaced after five hundred years, hinting that the Abyss threat is recurring.
threads.quote: ???: ...Five hundred years later, and it's resurfaced again.

threads.claim: Gosoythoth inflicted a wound on the warriors that still endures, and its exact effects are unknown.
threads.quote: Mutota: True, it poses no threat to us now, but whatever wound it inflicted on these warriors still endures.

threads.claim: Cochitta believes nothing can stop the Abyss and that it will always return.
threads.quote: It's no use. It'll just come back... Nothing can stop it. Nothing can stop the Abyss!

threads.claim: Cochitta defeats Abyss monsters herself and realizes they are not unbeatable, answering her fear.
threads.quote: Cochitta: No, wait... What am I saying? Abyss monsters are not actually that scary... I've defeated them before. I know I have...

threads.claim: Xilonen will forge the Traveler an Ancient Name from people's stories and hopes, to help end the war.
threads.quote: When the time comes... I will forge you an Ancient Name unlike anything that's come before, so that you, Mavuika, and Natlan as a whole can finally put an end to this endless war.

threads.claim: The forging of the Ancient Name begins with gathered testimony at the Pilgrim's Chronicle.
threads.quote: Okay, the progress looks good. We have enough people, so let's get started.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Khaenri'ahn with a past tie to Rerir
introduced.quote: My name is Dainsleif — and yes, I am from Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Five Sinners
introduced.how: Explained as five figures whose desires the Abyss exploited, tearing Khaenri'ah apart
introduced.quote: The Five Sinners were each driven by their own desires, and it was by playing upon these that the Abyss tempted them to their fall, tearing Khaenri'ah apart in the process.

introduced.name: Vedrfolnir
introduced.how: Dainsleif's elder brother, a Visionary who wished to foretell the future and fell to the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Visionary Vedrfolnir, who wished to foretell the future.

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: Named as the Rächer of Solnari, a former Five Sinner and ravager of the moon
introduced.quote: Rerir... ravager of the moon.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Dainsleif's homeland, torn apart by the Five Sinners and the Abyss
introduced.quote: tearing Khaenri'ah apart in the process.

introduced.name: Eclipse Dynasty
introduced.how: The ruling dynasty of the era in which the fateful night took place
introduced.quote: The fateful night took place during the era of the Eclipse Dynasty.

introduced.name: Vinster King
introduced.how: Ruler who imprisoned Vedrfolnir after gouging out his eyes
introduced.quote: only for the king to gouge out his eyes and cast him into the dungeons.

introduced.name: Crimson Moon Dynasty
introduced.how: An older dynasty that preceded the Eclipse Dynasty, whose descendants Rerir hunted
introduced.quote: The Crimson Moon Dynasty preceded the Eclipse.

introduced.name: Tholindis
introduced.how: Rerir's would-be fiancée, revealed to be a distant Crimson Moon descendant
introduced.quote: And it looks like this Tholindis, Rerir's would-be fiancee, herself belonged to a sub-branch of the Crimson Moon dynasty's descendants

introduced.name: Mini Durin
introduced.how: Albedo's brother, introduced as a new face who has come to lend aid
introduced.quote: By his side is a new face for us all, myself included — Mr. Durin, who has come to lend his aid.

introduced.name: Albedo
introduced.how: Introduced as a renowned alchemist and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Investigation Team
introduced.quote: this is Mr. Albedo, a renowned alchemist and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Investigation Team.

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: Introduced as Moonchanter, leader of the Frostmoon Scions in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: As Moonchanter, she's the leader of the Frostmoon Scions, a local religious community in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Introduced as boss of the Curatorium of Secrets and an intel-gatherer
introduced.quote: Then there's Miss Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, and intel-gatherer extraordinaire.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
introduced.how: Nefer's intelligence-gathering organization
introduced.quote: Then there's Miss Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, and intel-gatherer extraordinaire.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: Introduced as a Ratnik and guardian of the abandoned lighthouse
introduced.quote: Over here, we have Mr. Flins — a Ratnik, and guardian of the abandoned lighthouse.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: Introduced as the Moon Maiden and former Fatui Harbinger
introduced.quote: Next up, we have the Moon Maiden and former Fatui Harbinger, Miss Columbina.

introduced.name: Orlog
introduced.how: A Crimson Moon descendant who urges Tholindis to kill Rerir
introduced.quote: I want you to kill him. You are the only person he would never suspect.

introduced.name: Hroptatyr
introduced.how: president of the Universitas Magistrorum, the king's favored Chief Royal Mage known as The Wise
introduced.quote: You're president of the Universitas Magistrorum, the Chief Royal Mage known as "The Wise" by royal appointment, and by far the most favored among the Four Pillars of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Surtalogi
introduced.how: a swordsman who was once convicted and sentenced, and is missing an arm and a leg
introduced.quote: Rerir: Mr. Surtalogi. Yes, I handled your case file during your sentencing — nothing personal, of course.

introduced.name: Vedrfolnir
introduced.how: Dainsleif's brother, a prophet who spoke at court and was blinded and imprisoned by the king
