introduced.quote: It's my brother, Vedrfolnir... After he spoke at the court this morning, the king was so infuriated by his words that he had him blinded in both eyes and thrown in prison.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: captain of the royal guard who plans to storm the palace to free his brother
introduced.quote: That's far too dangerous! And don't forget, Dainsleif, you're captain of the royal guard... You swore an oath to the throne.

introduced.name: Tholindis
introduced.how: a Moon Marrow researcher who wants to see the world beyond the gateway and is Rerir's beloved
introduced.quote: But as a Moon Marrow researcher, I desperately want to see the world beyond the gateway.

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ahn official who runs errands for the king and wants only a letter of pardon for himself
introduced.quote: Rerir: (You have noble ambitions, Dain, but I'm afraid they don't do much for a guy like me. I'm not interested in saving the world — all I want is a letter of pardon.)

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: a portal to an unknown space, researched since the Crimson Moon dynasty and defined as a spatial gateway
introduced.quote: Moon Marrow can thus be defined as a spatial gateway.

introduced.name: Rächer of Solnari
introduced.how: the monster Rerir becomes after taking Abyssal power, shown through Nefer's memories
introduced.quote: Nefer: So that's how the Rächer of Solnari was born.

introduced.name: Thoth
introduced.how: the Ibis King, one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret and a retainer of the king
introduced.quote: Nefer: That's Thoth, the Ibis King — one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret. The legends say that he, the Crocodile King, and the Goat King were the three retainers of King Deshret.

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: General Mahamatra, with the spirit of Hermanubis dwelling within him
introduced.quote: Nefer: Ah, I know who you mean — General Mahamatra Cyno. The spirit of Hermanubis dwells within him.

introduced.name: House of Daena
introduced.how: a building where unclaimed mail is kept in boxes on shelves
introduced.quote: Manetho: The House of Daena, I expect. I know there's a box for unclaimed mail somewhere in there — probably sitting on a shelf.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: a group of mercenaries who send dilapidation surveys from Port Ormos
introduced.quote: Nefer: A dilapidations survey from Port Ormos... Looks like it's from a Corps of Thirty representative. What a strange thought... a bunch of mercs losing sleep over run-down buildings.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: Nefer's employee, bound by a contract with a first clause on menial chores
introduced.quote: Nefer: That's more like it. For a moment there, I was worried you'd forgotten about the first clause of your employment contract.

introduced.name: Sinuhe
introduced.how: chief of the Shimti tribe who tries to lead his people out of poverty and is Nefer's father
introduced.quote: Sinuhe: As the chief of our tribe, I'm supposed to be leading us out of hardship and poverty, onto better things.

introduced.name: Shimti tribe
introduced.how: a desert tribe led by Sinuhe, living a harsh nomadic life
introduced.quote: A Handwritten Letter: Haleel, this is Sinuhe, chief of the Shimti tribe. Surely, you remember me?

introduced.name: Iab tribe
introduced.how: a desert tribe with a well that the Shimti took water from, later seized by force
introduced.quote: Letter Contents: I found a well belonging to the Iab tribe. They declined to help us, but I really had no other option

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: Former Khaenri'ahn agent who now exists as the Rächer of Solnari and the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: The Rächer of Solnari, real name Rerir, was once a Khaenri'ahn subject who served the Vinster King.

introduced.name: Vinster King
introduced.how: Ruler whom Rerir secretly served as an agent
introduced.quote: Rerir was a secret agent who reported directly to the Vinster King.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: Rerir's current form, wreaking havoc in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: he is what we know today as the Wild Hunt, wreaking havoc upon innocent lives in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Ibis King
introduced.how: Spirit living in a cat who gave Nefer a chess set and the power to perceive secrets
introduced.quote: This cat, as it turned out, was home to the spirit of the Ibis King.

introduced.name: Thoth
introduced.how: The Ibis King's name, described as a cunning liar
introduced.quote: Thoth is a fiendishly cunning liar.

introduced.name: Chess set
introduced.how: Gift from the Ibis King that can trap Rerir inside it
introduced.quote: This chess set is my gift from the Ibis King.

introduced.name: Shimti
introduced.how: Nefer's tribe, massacred by the Iab in their home village
introduced.quote: A long time ago, the Iab massacred my tribe, the Shimti, in our home village.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: Essentially a prison where King Deshret banished the Ibis King
introduced.quote: King Deshret banished him to Aaru, which is essentially a prison

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: King whose Mausoleum board the Ibis King's chessboard copies
introduced.quote: The chessboard within is made to the same specifications as the one in the Mausoleum of King Deshret

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Believe the moon holds many secrets and possibly a gateway
introduced.quote: In the lore of the Frostmoon Scions, the moon is believed to hold many secrets.

introduced.name: Moon Gate
introduced.how: Spatial gateway said to be a path to the moon, opened by a moon goddess
introduced.quote: A moon goddess has the right to open the moon gate, since it is a path to the moon.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius and Knight of Boreas
introduced.quote: This gentleman is the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, Varka, Knight of Boreas.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: Reincarnated moon goddess among the group
introduced.quote: We have a reincarnated moon in our ranks

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Lord-Artificer who built most of Fontaine's meka and died hundreds of years ago, known to Marionette
introduced.quote: Pretty much all the meka in Fontaine are his personal handiwork.

introduced.name: Rene
introduced.how: Alain's childhood friend who pursued a dream of saving the world until it consumed him
introduced.quote: Alain Guillotin had two close buddies, Rene and Jakob. They spent their childhood years together in the Narzissenkreuz Institute.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: Alain and Rene's childhood friend from the Narzissenkreuz Institute
introduced.quote: Alain Guillotin had two close buddies, Rene and Jakob.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Institute
introduced.how: childhood institute where Alain, Rene and Jakob grew up, with an orphanage
introduced.quote: They spent their childhood years together in the Narzissenkreuz Institute.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: institute Alain founded in Fontaine to pursue his desire to save the land
introduced.quote: the desire to save Fontaine drove him to found the Fontaine Research Institute

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: appears as The Damselette and proposes to befriend Marionette, Arlecchino and herself
introduced.quote: What is this, Columbina? Are you deliberately testing my patience threshold?

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: robot maker at the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau who writes formulas in a notebook and once knew Alain
introduced.quote: I doodle and write in my free time.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: facility where Marionette works, with robots under her care
introduced.quote: (The Damselette visits Marionette at the top level of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau)

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: Mora-loving businesswoman who lost her sister and built a sanctuary in Sumeru
introduced.quote: My elder sister used to dream of finding a sanctuary. Somewhere with plenty of food, water, and medicine, where everyone could live happy lives.

introduced.name: apocalypse prophecy
introduced.how: a prophecy of apocalypse that ended the childhood of Alain's circle
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, childhood would end, the prophecy would come true, the apocalypse would arrive, and the future would never be.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: In our last operation, he courageously distracted the Wild Hunt to buy time for the rest of us.

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: I'd like you to gather more intelligence about the Rächer of Solnari.

assumed.name: Kuutar
assumed.quote: didn't Kuutar — sorry, Columbina, leave with you?

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Bye for now, Arlecchino.

assumed.name: Mini Durin
assumed.quote: It's nice to meet you.... again. We've... technically met before.

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: the other being that young guy, Illuga.

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: in the name of the Anemo Archon, Barbatos himself

assumed.name: Spark Knight Klee
assumed.quote: alongside Spark Knight Klee.

assumed.name: Mika
assumed.quote: Mika always used to say I had the talent to make it big.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: I say that's a big step forward for our dear Khaenri'ah.

assumed.name: Universitas Magistrorum
assumed.quote: Rhinedottir: Well, the Universitas Magistrorum won't stop fawning over you, so at least some of the rumors must be true.

assumed.name: Crimson Moon
assumed.quote: Tholindis: Research dating back to the Crimson Moon dynasty has established two points regarding Moon Marrow.

assumed.name: Vinster King
assumed.quote: Nefer: The chances of the Vinster King issuing a pardon for anyone connected to the Crimson Moon seem vanishingly slim.

assumed.name: Seven Pillars
assumed.quote: Traveler: And the Seven Pillars who served him.

assumed.name: Abyssal power
assumed.quote: (Rerir steps up and takes his share of the Abyssal power)

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Lauma: Nefer, it's okay... All of this is in the past now.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Lauma: If we can find a suitable time, I'd love to borrow Jahoda for a day to help out at the Frostmoon Scions.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
assumed.quote: Nefer: Evidently so. Don't worry, I'm not about to leave you to fend for yourselves. I'm not that kind of boss, and it would go against the Curatorium's labor policy.

assumed.name: Akasha System
assumed.quote: As well as receiving dumbed-down assignments and perfunctory tutoring, they do not even have full access to the Akasha System!

assumed.name: Dainsleif and Rerir's past friendship
assumed.quote: The two of you used to be friends, didn't you?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Without the power of the Abyss on his side, he almost certainly would have perished

assumed.name: Five Sinners
assumed.quote: there's no guarantee that the power of the Ibis King is any match for one of the Five Sinners.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: You mean the Harbingers who still support you, even though you've left the Fatui.

assumed.name: Kuuvahki
assumed.quote: I FINALLY got it all fully charged up with kuuvahki

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: It actually started a while back as a project between me and the Dendro Archon.

assumed.name: Mage Alice
assumed.quote: Mage Alice once warned me that this world won't stay safe forever.

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: You've been getting Kaveh to make them for ya!

assumed.name: Tholindis
assumed.quote: I highly suspect that neither Tholindis nor Rerir made it through unscathed.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Do you ever find yourself missing Khaenri'ah, Mr. Dainsleif?

assumed.name: Hroptatyr
assumed.quote: Master griped a lot about

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Jean's mentioned in her letters that you're so diligent

assumed.name: Durin
assumed.quote: So, Albedo, Durin, and I put our heads together and came up with a plan.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Albedo's been hard at work analyzing Rerir and the Wild Hunt's behavioral patterns.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: You did it for Sumeru, didn't you?

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: after discussing things with the Dendro Archon, I decided on a more effective strategy.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: Boss of the Curatorium of Secrets?

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: I've realized that you, me, and Arlecchino should be friends.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Bye-bye, dear Sandrone.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: Last time, the Wild Hunt escorted you out.

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: I hope you didn't seriously think that the Rächer of Solnari would be able to lay so much as a finger upon me

assumed.name: Pulonia
assumed.quote: Pulonia, please see Lady Columbina to the door.

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: I'll have to bring a whole sack of gifts the next time I visit the House of the Hearth.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: the same dream that had dragged his closest friend down to the Abyss.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Everyone says that you view everything in terms of Mora, and all you care about is growing your own wealth.

threads.claim: Rerir's sudden fall into madness is unexplained, and Dainsleif does not know what changed.
threads.quote: He never harbored grand ambitions — so what changed in the space of a single night? How did he come to fall like the others?

threads.claim: Rerir served the Eclipse Dynasty by hunting down Crimson Moon descendants, including children.
threads.quote: My job is to ensure the survival of the Eclipse Dynasty — and the only way to do that is by eliminating any and all potential threats.

threads.claim: The whispering voice tormenting Rerir is identified as Vedrfolnir.
threads.quote: (That voice used to be so unclear, but now I know exactly whose it is. It's Vedrfolnir.)

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir's prophetic power and his silence about the past hint at a hidden truth that weighs on Rerir.
threads.quote: The burden of prophecy was never meant for your shoulders.

threads.claim: The Vinster King's mind is clouded by Abyssal power, and his obsession with hunting the Crimson Moon is tied to it.
threads.quote: The Vinster King... a blind fool, his eyes clouded by powers from beyond this world...

threads.claim: Tholindis secretly carries a diluted Crimson Moon bloodline that she has concealed from Rerir.
threads.quote: A diluted bloodline, carefully concealed... I see it now.

threads.claim: Dainsleif was betrayed by Vedrfolnir during the palace raid, which shaped his grudge.
threads.quote: But then, I was betrayed. Even Vedrfolnir — the very person I had come to rescue — abandoned me and partook of the Abyss's power.

threads.claim: Tholindis fell into a portal so that Rerir could live a normal life, answering why she vanished.
threads.quote: she had learned the truth and proceeded to fall into it so he could live a normal life.

threads.claim: Nefer's confidential method for entering minds is a secret she withholds from her allies.
threads.quote: Nefer conspicuously left out the details of her

threads.claim: Teyvat has never accepted The Damselette, and her power is slowly ebbing away.
threads.quote: my power has been slowly ebbing away — and that is because Teyvat has never accepted me.

threads.claim: Flins has a secret about his Ratnik status that Varka already knows.
threads.quote: Sorry, I'm not even gonna bother trying to hide it.

threads.claim: Rerir is cast out of Teyvat through the moon gate that Dainsleif maintained.
threads.quote: To his horror, he discovers Dainsleif maintaining the gate as he is flicked inside and thrown out of Teyvat.

threads.claim: Moon Marrow is a gateway to an unknown location whose destination remains undetermined.
threads.quote: However, there are a number of hurdles to overcome before we can answer the question of where it leads to.

threads.claim: Rerir vows to find Tholindis in the unknown space she entered through the portal.
threads.quote: Rerir: I will find you

threads.claim: Tholindis claims the Crimson Moon bloodline will never die out and will burn like fire in the veins.
threads.quote: Tholindis: The Crimson Moon bloodline will never die out. Its light, the color of blood, will become like a fire that flows in our veins.

threads.claim: Tholindis gives Frithr a piece of the moon that must be kept safe so a red moon can be seen in the future.
threads.quote: Tholindis: A piece of the moon. All you need to know is that as long as you keep it safe, then in the future, everyone will be able to see a red moon.

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir's visions are fixed by fate, and he is powerless to change what he foresees.
threads.quote: Vedrfolnir: Everything is transpiring as I foresaw, yet I am powerless to change it... Fate is an immutable force.

threads.claim: Rerir hears a voice in his head urging him to seek power, and suspects it is Vedrfolnir's.
threads.quote: Rerir: I know it's your voice that I keep hearing in my head...

threads.claim: Abyssal power begins to corrupt Rerir's memories of Tholindis and changes his appearance.
threads.quote: (Rerir's hair turns gray and the Abyssal powers begin to corrupt his memories of Tholindis)

threads.claim: The king reportedly installed secret mechanisms in the palace and city whose power is unknown.
threads.quote: (Allegedly, the king installed secret mechanisms in the palace and around the city. No one knows where they are or what kind of power they hold...)

threads.claim: The Universitas Magistrorum has shifted its personnel to Abyssal Energy research, neglecting Crimson Moon projects.
threads.quote: The Universitas Magistrorum recently decided to move most of its personnel into Abyssal Energy research, which has stymied all Crimson Moon-related projects.

threads.claim: Nefer frames Khaenri'ah's downfall as the result of lies that were allowed to grow until they destroyed everything.
threads.quote: Nefer: (In a nutshell, the story of Khaenri'ah is what happens when the truth falls by the wayside.

threads.claim: Rerir's descent into the Rächer of Solnari is revealed to be the result of his circumstances and Abyssal power.
threads.quote: Nefer: So that's how the Rächer of Solnari was born.

threads.claim: Nefer's ruthlessness is shown to stem from her father Sinuhe's broken promises to the desert tribe.
threads.quote: Nefer: You liar... You lied about everything! You promised the world and delivered on none of it!

threads.claim: Desert students at the Akademiya receive inferior education and lack full access to the Akasha System.
threads.quote: As well as receiving dumbed-down assignments and perfunctory tutoring, they do not even have full access to the Akasha System!

threads.claim: Nefer's chess set is a special technique that has trapped her once before and can alter reality.
threads.quote: Nefer: Only once. It was the first time I used the chess set.

threads.claim: Sethos is hinted at as a figure of significance in the desert belief system.
threads.quote: Nefer: Cyno's hardly a figure of obscurity. But I know about Sethos, too.

threads.claim: Rerir may have been torn apart and survives only as scattered fragments sustained by the Abyss.
threads.quote: I highly suspect that neither Tholindis nor Rerir made it through unscathed.

threads.claim: Rerir is sent through the moon gate into unknown space, leaving his ultimate fate uncertain.
threads.quote: Rerir is sent into the unknown space and Dainsleif closes the gate behind him

threads.claim: A moon gate to an unknown world may exist, but no one knows whether it can be opened.
threads.quote: I'm afraid this is one mystery we may have to leave unsolved for now.

threads.claim: Dainsleif holds the moon gate open, showing it can be used to send an enemy away.
threads.quote: The Damselette sends him towards the moon gate and he flies past Dainsleif, who is holding the gate open.

threads.claim: The Ibis King's gift of truth-seeking may hide a deeper motive.
threads.quote: Now, you could conclude that the Ibis King simply wanted to give the people of this world the power to seek the truth, but I don't believe that's the full story.

threads.claim: The Ibis King is imprisoned and seeks freedom in exchange for answering three questions.
threads.quote: He promised that he'd have his freedom if he could find the answers.

threads.claim: Gods and fate favor a select few, which is treated as a form of favoritism tied to the Abyss.
threads.quote: Every god plays favorites.

threads.claim: Dainsleif feels betrayed by Rerir and does not understand what Rerir went through.
threads.quote: He betrayed me... and I never really understood what he was going through in life...

threads.claim: Dainsleif accepts that Rerir, though once a friend, must be defeated.
threads.quote: I came to accept that although Rerir was my friend in the past, here and now, he was an enemy that must be defeated.

threads.claim: Rerir's past as a Khaenri'ahn agent under the Vinster King is revealed.
threads.quote: Rerir was a secret agent who reported directly to the Vinster King.

threads.claim: The Abyss is described as a curse that keeps Rerir alive.
threads.quote: The power of the Abyss is most surely a curse.

threads.claim: Columbina may not be her true name, and her identity is uncertain.
threads.quote: I have a different relationship with names than other people.

threads.claim: Rerir refers to a foretold event called Vedrfolnir that has not yet come to pass.
threads.quote: Vedrfolnir... When will it be as you foretold?

threads.claim: Revenge fueled by hatred is portrayed as a snake-like path that corrupts a person.
threads.quote: Anyone who seeks revenge out of hatred for other people has become a snake.

threads.claim: Mage Alice warned that the world will face a great crisis, prompting preparations in Sumeru.
threads.quote: Mage Alice once warned me that this world won't stay safe forever.

threads.claim: The Five Sinners have powers beyond comprehension, posing a threat that the group cannot fully gauge.
threads.quote: there's no guarantee that the power of the Ibis King is any match for one of the Five Sinners.

threads.claim: Columbina left the Fatui and has a warrant out for her arrest, yet Harbingers still support her.
threads.quote: A warrant was even put out for my arrest...

threads.claim: Dori built a sanctuary in Sumeru inspired by her sister's dream of a safe haven.
threads.quote: My elder sister used to dream of finding a sanctuary.

threads.claim: Dori's memory of her sister is fading, leaving only a vague impression.
threads.quote: Slowly but surely, her face is fading from my mind's eye.

threads.claim: A prophecy foretold an apocalypse that ended the childhood of Alain's circle.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, childhood would end, the prophecy would come true, the apocalypse would arrive, and the future would never be.

threads.claim: Rene's dream of saving the world returned with a vengeance after having faded.
threads.quote: And although that wave died down eventually, I hear that it just recently came back with a vengeance.

threads.claim: Rene's attempted resurgence died out for good, but he only awoke from his delusion too late.
threads.quote: But I'm told that the attempted resurgence finally died out for good.

threads.claim: Alain asked for his manuscripts to be destroyed, but Marionette read them first.
threads.quote: Before he passed away, he asked me to destroy all his manuscripts.

threads.claim: Alain rejected transcendental knowledge and power after seeing what it did to Rene.
threads.quote: Alain continued to reject any form of transcendental knowledge or power.

threads.claim: The grand mission to save the world may have begun as a simple wish to save oneself.
threads.quote: So perhaps, for each of them, their mission to save the world began with a very simple desire: to save themselves.

threads.claim: The Traveler is compared to Rene and Alain as someone who wants to be the savior.
threads.quote: Doesn't surprise me. You share one thing in common, after all. You both want to be the savior.

threads.claim: Alain accepted that a human being had to see the Narzissenkreuz Institute's story through to its end.
threads.quote: The Narzissenkreuz Institute needed someone, and a human being, to see its story through to the end.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Klee's mother, who sent the letter inviting Klee to Sumeru
introduced.quote: Klee: Mom's the one who sent me here! She's the strongest mage ever.

introduced.name: Magic Invite
introduced.how: teleports the group wherever they shout together, usable three times
introduced.quote: Klee: Mom says we just have to all shout out where we want to go at the same time, and poof! We'll be there in the blink of an eye.

introduced.name: Lawrence Clan
introduced.how: Eula's clan, whose honor a cousin is trying to restore
introduced.quote: Eula: If you must know, it's a little complicated... But simply put, I'm searching for a cousin of mine from the Lawrence Clan.

introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.how: a Forest Ranger friend the group hopes will guide them
introduced.quote: Paimon: Okay, Spark Knight! Well, keep up the good work, 'cause very soon we'll be introducing you to a friend of ours called Tighnari in Gandharva Ville!

introduced.name: Gandharva Ville
introduced.how: a Sumeru town where Forest Rangers can be found
introduced.quote: Paimon: And everyone knows that the best place to go looking for a Forest Ranger is a little place called...

introduced.name: Pardis Dhyai
introduced.how: where Tighnari is delivering lectures
introduced.quote: Collei: Hmm, I'm afraid that could be tricky... Master Tighnari is still at Pardis Dhyai delivering his lectures.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: a magical bottle-shaped domain that the group enters and explores
introduced.quote: Idyia: Greetings, everyone. This is the Veluriyam Mirage, and I'm the caretaker, Idyia...

introduced.name: Idyia
introduced.how: the domain's caretaker, who introduces herself
introduced.quote: Idyia: Greetings, everyone. This is the Veluriyam Mirage, and I'm the caretaker, Idyia...

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: introduces her real name and says she is called a general out of respect
introduced.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Ahem... Some people call me a general, but it's just their way of showing respect. My actual name is Sangonomiya Kokomi.

introduced.name: Haddo
introduced.how: one of the caretakers of the new area
introduced.quote: Arriving in the new area, the group meets the caretakers of the area; Ferdinand, Jeroney and Haddo.

introduced.name: Water Droplet
introduced.how: a water creature that guides the group through the domain
introduced.quote: Collei: It doesn't seem hostile... In fact, don't you think it looks happy to see us?

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: jumping mushroom creatures that hit with their caps
introduced.quote: Kaeya: Listen carefully, Klee. Those jumping mushrooms are called Fungi. They may look cute, but if you get too close to one, it'll try to hit you with its cap.

introduced.name: Central Hub
introduced.how: the device that powers the domain, now stopped after components went missing
introduced.quote: Idyia: Basically, this entire domain is powered by a device called the Central Hub, which you all saw earlier.

introduced.name: Streaming Projector
introduced.how: a device that built the domain's items and now projects preprints
introduced.quote: Idyia: This is called the Streaming Projector. Everything here in the Veluriyam Mirage was made using this device...

introduced.name: Onmyoudou
introduced.how: an Inazuman art whose students train at the Onmyou Chamber academy
introduced.quote: Idyia: Onmyou chamber. It's an elite training academy for gifted students of Onmyoudou.

introduced.name: domain incident
introduced.how: a sudden disaster that flipped the domain upside down and broke its core
introduced.quote: Idyia: It was as if... the whole world was suddenly flipped upside down.

introduced.name: Ferdinand
introduced.how: Introduces himself as one of the brothers who look after the whole zone
introduced.quote: Oh right, I didn't introduce myself. I'm Ferdinand. Me and my brothers look after this whole zone.

introduced.name: Jeroney
introduced.how: Introduces himself as one of the people responsible for the area
introduced.quote: My name's Jeroney. I'm one of the people responsible for taking care of this area.

introduced.name: Haddo
introduced.how: The sickly youngest brother who designed the tracks and was taken on adventures by his two elder brothers
introduced.quote: If I remember correctly, the two eldest brothers were taking their sickly younger brother on adventures, when they ran into a sandstorm and ended up here.

introduced.name: Streaming Projector
introduced.how: Device that gives a domain's preprint material its real form by illuminating it
introduced.quote: Everything in this domain starts as a preprint and only takes shape after being illuminated by the Streaming Projector.

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolon
introduced.how: Water helpers that power the carts, keep the junctions turning, and run most of the domain
introduced.quote: Not only do they keep the junction turning, they operate practically everything else in the domain, too.

introduced.name: Choo-Choo Cart
introduced.how: Rail cart Klee built that rides the tracks and is powered by a Hydro Eidolon
introduced.quote: Hehe, I'm gonna call it the Choo-Choo Cart!

introduced.name: Jumpy Dumpty
introduced.how: Material the cart was made from that is volatile, like a bomb
introduced.quote: I gathered from your conversation that Jumpy Dumpty is a little more volatile than the cute name suggests.

introduced.name: Torrential Twister
introduced.how: A track area the brothers built and are reopening
introduced.quote: we're about ready to reopen Torrential Twister.

introduced.name: Desert sandstorm
introduced.how: The brothers were caught in a desert sandstorm, Haddo collapsed, and they ended up stranded in this domain
introduced.quote: Just like when we were back in the desert... You suddenly passed out, and Jeroney and I started arguing.

introduced.name: Missing components
introduced.how: Parts Idyia has sent the travelers to search for to fix the domain
introduced.quote: We're supposed to be helping Idyia look for the missing components.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Jean: It's been a while since we last met, but I can see you two haven't changed one bit.

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Klee: Oh, it's Paimon and Honorary Knight! It's been so long!

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Kaeya: Ah, look who it is.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Kaeya: The Knights of Favonius could never agree to send Klee off to Sumeru on her own, but Klee is rather intent on taking Alice's friend up on this invitation.

assumed.name: Eula
assumed.quote: Kaeya: What a coincidence. I didn't expect to run into a fellow Favonian captain this far from Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Klee: Hi Collei, it's been aaages!

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Collei: I'll be your backup, Eula. I know you usually team up with Amber, so I'll try my best to fill her shoes.

assumed.name: Fischl's Immernachtreich
assumed.quote: Klee: Maybe Aunty Desert lives way further down inside? This place is suuuuper big, just like Fischl's Immernachtreich.

assumed.name: Moon Pie
assumed.quote: Klee: Yeah, she's the best! She brought me some Moon Pie last time!

assumed.name: The Cat's Tail
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Cat's Tail!

assumed.name: Kokomi's prior acquaintance with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Traveler: Old friend for me... I hope!

assumed.name: Idyia
assumed.quote: Idyia is working on repairing the domain.

assumed.name: Central Hub
assumed.quote: Could it have been the Central Hub? Mm, that would mean this canyon appeared after it started spinning...

assumed.name: Master Thief
assumed.quote: Nothing, Kaeya's just the Master Thief. Don't you remember, Paimon?

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Bye, Honorary Knight! Bye, everyone!

assumed.name: Eula and Collei
assumed.quote: By the way, Eula and Collei have also returned, but I'm afraid they weren't able to make much headway.

assumed.name: Starfell Lake flying fish
assumed.quote: we aren't about to end up like the, uh,

assumed.name: Miss General
assumed.quote: How about we hold hands, Miss General? Klee will give you energy!

threads.claim: Alice's friend in Sumeru invited Klee to visit, but the friend's identity is left unrevealed.
threads.quote: Klee: Mm-hmm, the letter says that Mom's friend lives in Sumeru.

threads.claim: Idyia is revealed as Alice's friend who agreed to host Klee's visit.
threads.quote: Idyia: Just days after I agreed to let my friend's daughter come and visit, too. When she gets here, and sees the state this place is in—

threads.claim: Alice's letter flew in through a window like a bird and could talk, which the group finds mysterious.
threads.quote: Klee: Like a bird does — it was flapping its wings. It could even talk!

threads.claim: The Magic Invite may be connected to the domain it was sent from, which Kaeya suspects.
threads.quote: Kaeya: That is to say, if it was sent from within the domain, the invite likely has some sort of connection to it.

threads.claim: A rumor says a secret desert domain can make all wishes come true.
threads.quote: Collei: They say there's a secret domain there that can make all of your wishes come true...

threads.claim: The group confirms the desert domain they entered is real, answering the question of whether it exists.
threads.quote: Paimon: We made it! That answers that question...

threads.claim: Eula's cousin has books on Sumeru desert mythology and is likely searching for the same wish domain.
threads.quote: Eula: My cousin has quite a collection of books about Sumeru desert mythology on his shelves. I highly suspect that he, too, is looking for that domain.

threads.claim: A sudden incident flipped the domain upside down and caused its core components to break loose.
threads.quote: Idyia: It was as if... the whole world was suddenly flipped upside down.

threads.claim: Kokomi arrived shortly before the incident, which happened soon after she entered the domain.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Yes. I arrived here a little earlier than the rest of you. But the incident took place not long after I entered.

threads.claim: The domain keeps changing, as a huge canyon suddenly appeared where a path had been blocked.
threads.quote: Klee: But then, just now, a huge canyon appeared outta nowhere... so we hurried back here!

threads.claim: Four missing components from the Central Hub must be recovered before the domain can run again.
threads.quote: Idyia: ...Four components, I believe, which has caused the Central Hub to stop turning.

threads.claim: The group recovers the first component, leaving three more still missing.
threads.quote: Idyia: So that leaves three more components missing...

threads.claim: Kokomi's full reason for coming to Sumeru is withheld for later explanation.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Well, that's one reason, anyway... I can explain in more detail another time.

threads.claim: Kokomi uses a pen name, hinting at a second identity she keeps private.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: (At least... cuter than my pen name, that's for sure...)

threads.claim: The huge spinning structure in the middle of the domain may be the Central Hub and seems linked to the canyon appearing.
threads.quote: Could it have been the Central Hub? Mm, that would mean this canyon appeared after it started spinning...

threads.claim: Objects in the domain start as preprints and only take shape when the Streaming Projector illuminates them, and the Hydro Eidolon trapped in the print shows this can fail.
threads.quote: Everything in this domain starts as a preprint and only takes shape after being illuminated by the Streaming Projector.

threads.claim: Idyia is working to repair the domain, which has been flipped and broken, and the travelers are helping her.
threads.quote: Idyia is working on repairing the domain.

threads.claim: Idyia has known the three brothers for a long time, but her history with them is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Yes, I've known them for quite some time, after all... But I seldom go to that area.

threads.claim: The brothers keep arguing, and Ferdinand and Jeroney's feud is a persistent source of friction.
threads.quote: But aren't they supposed to be brothers?

threads.claim: Jeroney says the brothers have realized a bond keeps them together, so the rift is resolved at least partly.
threads.quote: Thanks to Klee and everyone else's help, we realized that there is a special bond that keeps us together.

threads.claim: Haddo's poor health and low energy make him feel like a burden on his brothers.
threads.quote: If it weren't for my poor health and lack of energy all the time, then I wouldn't have always been such a burden on you two.

threads.claim: The missing components Idyia needs are still being gathered, and the climbing rope is one of them.
threads.quote: I have no use for it until we have the other components.

threads.claim: Jumpy Dumpty is a volatile material that can behave like a bomb.
threads.quote: I gathered from your conversation that Jumpy Dumpty is a little more volatile than the cute name suggests.

introduced.name: Quadruple-Sweetness Sunsettia
introduced.how: a special Sunsettia processed by Sucrose's Bio-Alchemy from sweet ingredients Noelle found around Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Noelle and Sucrose then explain the ingredient they're going to present, called Quadruple-Sweetness Sunsettia, a special Sunsettia

introduced.name: Thousand-Wind Wine
introduced.how: it is the original Dandelion Wine, and its taste varies because brewers may add any ingredients they like
introduced.quote: He also explains that Thousand-Wind Wine is the original Dandelion Wine and the reason why it tastes different from brew to brew

introduced.name: Dandelion Seeds
introduced.how: added at the last second to capture the wind and preserve its memory in the wine
introduced.quote: namely some Dandelion Seeds that should be added to the mix at the last second to capture the wind

introduced.name: Razor's parents
introduced.how: a pair of adventurers who saved a bottle of Thousand-Wind Wine for their son and named him Razor
introduced.quote: His mother proposes the name Razor, which his father likes and approves because it sounds like an adventurer's name.

assumed.name: Bonds of Melody
assumed.quote: Two days after the events of Bonds of Melody

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: the Traveler and Paimon decide to go check the Knights of Favonius regarding the ingredient

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: procure the barrel given by Diluc

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Venti soon takes the stage to perform the piece

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Paimon cheers her up, saying that the Anemo Archon can come in different forms.

threads.claim: Wine can hold the memory of the wind when Dandelion Seeds are added to capture it.
threads.quote: namely some Dandelion Seeds that should be added to the mix at the last second to capture the wind

threads.claim: Brewers have freedom to add whatever ingredients they want to Thousand-Wind Wine.
threads.quote: people always have the freedom to add whatever ingredients they want when brewing it

threads.claim: Razor does not yet understand who his parents really were.
threads.quote: Razor muses that he still doesn't understand who his parents really were

threads.claim: Razor sees a vision of his parents, adventurers who saved the wine and chose his name.
threads.quote: a pair of adventurers sitting together on a cliff, drinking from the same bottle of Thousand-Wind Wine which they deemed incomplete

threads.claim: Klee feels no wind and fears the Anemo Archon rejected the offering, leaving the blessing in doubt.
threads.quote: Klee is sad that she doesn't feel any wind, thinking that the Anemo Archon is unhappy with their offering

threads.claim: Razor says he feels the Anemo Archon's blessing and has grown and is no longer afraid.
threads.quote: Klee then asks Razor if he feels the Anemo Archon's blessing and he says yes as he feels he has grown from the experience and is no longer afraid.

threads.claim: Venti hints at hidden power by winking and summoning wind while the others are unaware.
threads.quote: They ran off as the Traveler and Paimon looks at Venti, who winks and shushes them and summons his powers.

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: self-introduction as a trainee Forest Ranger under Tighnari who studies at the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Dear diary, I'm Collei. I work as a trainee Forest Ranger under my master, Tighnari. I'm also studying at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Housein
introduced.how: introduces himself as the administrator of the Grand Bazaar and Treasures Street for the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Hello, my name is Housein. I'm responsible for managing administrative affairs in the Grand Bazaar and Treasures Street on behalf of the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Plumpy
introduced.how: Dori's Jinni partner who is beaten up while trying to negotiate with the Jinn
introduced.quote: Dori comically tries to get her Jinni partner, Plumpy, to negotiate with the Jinn, only for Plumpy to be beaten up instead.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: introduces herself to the group; she is the voice that had been helping Collei
introduced.quote: Nicole introduces herself to the group, and her voice causes Collei to realize she was the one who had been helping her.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a tree that is the hub where the Ley Lines converge and that records and stores the world's knowledge and memories
introduced.quote: The tree serves as a central hub where the Ley Lines converge, and its core function is to record and store the world's knowledge and memories.

introduced.name: Akasha System
introduced.how: a system originally built to cleanse Irminsul of Abyssal forbidden knowledge, now to be restarted
introduced.quote: Restart the Akasha System, which was originally created to cleanse Irminsul of Abyssal forbidden knowledge.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: usurped and repurposed Irminsul and other things from ancient dragonkind
introduced.quote: who tells them that Irminsul was among the many things the Heavenly Principles usurped and repurposed from ancient dragonkind.

introduced.name: Apep
introduced.how: Dendro dragon who is persuaded to help Nahida and has a Heart of Oasis
introduced.quote: Apep is convinced to assist Nahida as repayment for Nahida's past actions

introduced.name: Naphis
introduced.how: introduces the six sages Baladhuri, Alkindi, Firnas, Shakir and Rushd to the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Naphis introduces them to the Traveler and Paimon: Baladhuri (Vahumana), Alkindi (Spantamad), Firnas (Kshahrewar), Shakir (Rtawahist), and Rushd (Haravatat).

introduced.name: Shesepankh and Bennu
introduced.how: King Deshret's constructs who are the other two Pillars
introduced.quote: Heryshaf calls the two other Pilars, King Deshret's constructs Shesepankh and Bennu.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: a figure who was fighting the Abyss in Gurabad and has been asleep there
introduced.quote: Liloupar awakens and explains what happened after she descended into Gurabad, which involved fighting against the Abyss

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: an ancient city linked to the sudden influx of Jinn
introduced.quote: Alhaitham speculates that the sudden influx of Jinn relates to the ancient city of Gurabad

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a gift the gods grant to those with fervent ambition
introduced.quote: They say that fervent ambition attracts the favor of the gods — and with it, a Vision.

introduced.name: Fire Seed
introduced.how: was used to revitalize Apep's Heart of Oasis and might restore Nahida's Dendro power
introduced.quote: and believes it could be used to restore Nahida's Dendro power without relying on Irminsul.

introduced.name: Alkindi
introduced.how: Sage of the Akademiya, Spantamad Darshan, introduced by Naphis
introduced.quote: We have Sage Alkindi of the Spantamad Darshan, Sage Firnas of Kshahrewar...

introduced.name: Baladhuri
introduced.how: Old-guard sage of the Akademiya, Naphis's colleague
introduced.quote: Baladhuri and I are part of the old guard, while the other four took office after Azar and his clique fell from power.

introduced.name: Shakir
introduced.how: Rtawahist Sage of the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Rtawahist Sage, Shakir, and finally, Haravatat Sage, Rushd.

introduced.name: Rushd
introduced.how: Haravatat Sage of the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Rtawahist Sage, Shakir, and finally, Haravatat Sage, Rushd.

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: Sumeru's major institution preserving King Deshret's civilization knowledge
introduced.quote: It's the only major institution in Sumeru dedicated to preserving the knowledge of King Deshret's civilization.

introduced.name: Ley Line Blossom
introduced.how: Flowers blooming from Ley Line openings that signal an anomaly
introduced.quote: Flowers that bloom from openings in the Ley Lines, indicating some sort of anomaly.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: Power source the Akasha depends on
introduced.quote: The Akasha relies on the Gnosis as a power source, and in its absence, we'll need to find an alternative.

introduced.name: Akasha terminals
introduced.how: Devices worn in Sumeru; system is shut down but infrastructure remains
introduced.quote: Yes, but although the system isn't currently operational, the technological infrastructure is all still there.

introduced.name: Apep
introduced.how: Legendary Dendro Dragon who can convert her power for the Archon
introduced.quote: Without Irminsul's aid, the legendary Dendro Dragon Apep may well be the only living thing in Sumeru who can help our Archon recover her power.

introduced.name: Heart of Oasis
introduced.how: Apep's power source that can restore Nahida's Dendro power when lit with the Fire Seed
introduced.quote: That should be the Heart of Oasis. All we need to do is light it with the Fire Seed and it'll restore Apep with elemental power.

introduced.name: Light Realm
introduced.how: Ancient primitive elemental power that flowed through Irminsul in dragonkind's era
introduced.quote: You may know it as the power of the Light Realm.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles usurping Irminsul
introduced.how: Heavenly Principles refashioned Irminsul to serve humanity and anchor the world's fate
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles usurped and refashioned Irminsul, made it serve humanity, and used it to anchor the fate of the world.

introduced.name: Irminsul predates Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Irminsul existed before the Heavenly Principles and once belonged to dragonkind
introduced.quote: That tree was not planted by the Heavenly Principles. Irminsul existed before they ever arrived in Teyvat.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: Gurabad Jinn figure who merged with the land to suppress a dark calamity
introduced.quote: After we last parted ways, I merged with the land beneath Gurabad to suppress the dark calamity stirring in the depths.

introduced.name: Gurabad sealed Jinn
introduced.how: Rumored dormant Jinn sealed beneath Gurabad
introduced.quote: supposedly, a great number of dormant Jinn lie sealed beneath that city.

introduced.name: Jinn
introduced.how: Countless Jinn stirring violent sandstorms across the desert
introduced.quote: It's the Jinn. Countless Jinn have stirred up violent sandstorms across the desert, blocking our path to the Temple of Silence.

introduced.name: Plumpy
introduced.how: Dori's Jinni partner, a hired negotiator
introduced.quote: Hired partners are reliable too! Plumpy here is a highly skilled negotiator.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: Mysterious voice guiding Collei and claiming to only guide her
introduced.quote: The only one who can help is you. I am merely here to guide you along the correct path.

introduced.name: Goddess of Flowers song
introduced.how: A song composed by the Goddess of Flowers with few surviving records, soothing the Jinn
introduced.quote: It's a song composed by the Goddess of Flowers. But very few records of it remain, even in historical texts.

introduced.name: Collei's fire dream
introduced.how: Collei's vision of everything burning under the sky and ground
introduced.quote: I wish I could give you more details, but all I remember is fire everywhere. From the sky to the ground, everything was burning...

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Professor who taught a class on dissecting Ley Line blossoms
introduced.quote: Cyno, do you remember the class I taught on dissecting Ley Line blossoms?

introduced.name: Masseira's death
introduced.how: Jeht killed Masseira in a past encounter
introduced.quote: I finally took care of Masseira.

introduced.name: Jeht
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a desert traveler traveling with Liloupar
introduced.quote: Hello. I'm Jeht, and this is Liloupar.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: Introduced as Jeht's companion, a figure who knows of the Temple's history
introduced.quote: Hello. I'm Jeht, and this is Liloupar.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Nicole Reeyn, an angel who has lived since ancient times
introduced.quote: I am Nicole Reeyn, an angel who has lived since ancient times.

introduced.name: Angels
introduced.how: Angels are a long-living race of beings, not gods, that can tell stories of ancient history
introduced.quote: Well, we're a rather long-living race of beings. Not gods, technically, but we can still tell you a lot of stories from ancient history.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Introduces herself as based in Nod-Krai and connected to the Ibis King
introduced.quote: Just call me Nefer. I'm based in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an Eremite mercenary who works in the desert
introduced.quote: I'm Dehya, an Eremite mercenary. My work usually keeps me out in the desert.

introduced.name: Blazing Beasts
introduced.how: A mercenary group Dehya belongs to
introduced.quote: Aren't you with the Blazing Beasts? What a coincidence.

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: Introduces himself as the current leader of the Temple of Silence
introduced.quote: I'm Sethos, the current leader of the Temple of Silence.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Introduced by Sethos as the former Spantamad Sage
introduced.quote: This is General Mahamatra Cyno, and this is the former Spantamad Sage Cyrus.

introduced.name: Thoth
introduced.how: Identified as the Ibis King, one of the three retainers imprisoned in Aaru
introduced.quote: It's good to see you, Thoth the Ibis King.

introduced.name: Sobek
introduced.how: Introduces himself as one of the three imprisoned retainers, long absent from the mortal world
introduced.quote: Sobek: Everything is equally new to us, in truth. We've been gone from this mortal world for longer than you can imagine.

introduced.name: Heryshaf
introduced.how: Speaks as one of the three imprisoned retainers with authority over Aaru's decisions
introduced.quote: Heryshaf: Gods and people of yore are not necessarily welcome in today's world.

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: A colossal desert institution of scholars, described by Jeht
introduced.quote: So this is the Temple of Silence... I've heard the Nagarjunites mention it in passing, but I never imagined it would be this big.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: A hidden core device in King Deshret's Mausoleum, little known in academic circles
introduced.quote: Little is known about this device in academic circles, which suggests it was hidden quite effectively.

introduced.name: Mausoleum of King Deshret
introduced.how: The place where the party hopes to find the resources to modify the Akasha
introduced.quote: so our only option is to modify the Akasha using certain resources we hope to find in the Mausoleum of King Deshret.

introduced.name: Three questions of Aaru
introduced.how: The Ibis King's account that the three retainers were trapped in Aaru and had to answer three questions to escape
introduced.quote: The Ibis King told us they were trapped in Aaru, and that they had to answer three questions to get out.

introduced.name: Golden Slumber
introduced.how: King Deshret's preserved afterlife where souls are kept inside Aaru
introduced.quote: Know you, then, that the Golden Slumber created by King Deshret is preserved within?

introduced.name: Seven Pillars
introduced.how: King Deshret's seven servants whose unanimous consent is needed to open Aaru
introduced.quote: Opening Aaru requires the unanimous consent of the Seven Pillars.

introduced.name: Dendro Archon coma
introduced.how: Irminsul trouble left the Dendro Archon in a coma, receiving treatment from the Dendro Dragon
introduced.quote: Whatever is wrong with Irminsul, it severely affected the Dendro Archon. She fell into a coma, and is currently receiving treatment from the Dendro Dragon.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: The source of Teyvat's Ley Lines and the nation-closest core, which can have defense mechanisms
introduced.quote: Irminsul is the source of Teyvat's Ley Lines, after all, and Sumeru is the nation closest to it.

introduced.name: Sumeru barrier
introduced.how: An invisible barrier has sealed Sumeru's borders, cutting off all travel
introduced.quote: An invisible barrier has appeared around Sumeru's borders, cutting off all travel in and out.

introduced.name: Nabu Malikata
introduced.how: The Goddess of Flowers, whose god remains were injected into Collei
introduced.quote: Yes. Those were the remains of Nabu Malikata... the Goddess of Flowers.

introduced.name: Collei's god remains
introduced.how: As a child Collei was sick, sent by the Fatui for treatment, and injected with god remains
introduced.quote: When I was young, I got sick with Eleazar. Nothing could cure it.

introduced.name: Hermanubis fragments
introduced.how: Cyno carries several fragments of Hermanubis's Ba
introduced.quote: Incidentally, three is the maximum number of Hermanubis's Ba fragments that I could bear.

introduced.name: Jebrael
introduced.how: Jeht's father, who was trapped in the Golden Slumber and is now released as a soul
introduced.quote: It's Jeht's father, Jebrael! That's right, he entered the Golden Slumber, didn't he...

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: Nefer's intelligence network that cooperates with groups from around the world
introduced.quote: The Curatorium of Secrets is happy to cooperate with friends from all over the world.

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: Where King Deshret buried the Goddess of Flowers' scattered remains
introduced.quote: King Deshret gathered all the pieces he could find and buried them in the Eternal Oasis, but some fragments remained unaccounted for.

introduced.name: Saint Bennu and Saint Shesepankh
introduced.how: Two Seven Pillars awakened as holograms who vote on opening Aaru
introduced.quote: Saint Bennu, responding to your call. Three Kings detected, initiating autonomous will...

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ah, , Paimon. It's been a while.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Master said he'll take me shopping in Sumeru City today, which is great

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: The Dendro Archon is in a very vulnerable state at the moment.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: No unauthorized access to this place, by order of Mahamatra Cyno!

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Mr. Alhaitham says that the written word is a crucial medium for exploring the world and understanding oneself.

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: When I think back to the days when I suffered from Eleazar

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: This reminds the Traveler of Capitano's decision to store his people's souls within himself

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: calling himself Dottore's subordinate and stating that he is here to carry out the fallen Harbinger's will.

assumed.name: Gosoythoth
assumed.quote: fighting against the Abyss up until Gosoythoth's defeat in Natlan quelled the Abyssal forces in Gurabad as well

assumed.name: Masseira
assumed.quote: Jeht informing them that she settled their old grudge against Tanit elder Masseira.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Including the entirety of Dori's Sumpter Beast Park.

assumed.name: Azar
assumed.quote: They're the heroes who helped foil Azar's conspiracy and save Sumeru.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: How is the Dendro Archon?

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Nahida once said that Irminsul doesn't contain any information about me... So theoretically, I shouldn't be affected by such anomalies.)

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Anyway, Sumeru City should be empty by now, right?

assumed.name: Caravan Ribat
assumed.quote: So, with the Dendro Archon currently in a coma, the people have taken temporary refuge at Caravan Ribat

assumed.name: Candace
assumed.quote: The Eremites will keep everyone safe during the journey, and Candace will be there to receive us at the village.

assumed.name: Akasha
assumed.quote: Paimon: Of course! It's been so long, Paimon almost forgot all about the Akasha.

assumed.name: Apep
assumed.quote: If Paimon remembers correctly, the last time we saw Apep was in—

assumed.name: Fire Seed
assumed.quote: We don't have the protection of the fire seed this time!

assumed.name: Gosoythoth
assumed.quote: Did the Abyssal presence beneath this city fall silent when we defeated Gosoythoth?

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: Namely, to the Temple of Silence... Ring any bells?

assumed.name: Ley Lines Withering
assumed.quote: Overloading and Withering both directly affect their vitality, potentially causing irreversible damage.

assumed.name: King of Invokations
assumed.quote: Is that from King of Invokation?

assumed.name: Masseira
assumed.quote: So the Masseira chapter has finally come to a close.

assumed.name: Akasha System
assumed.quote: We're planning to go to the Mausoleum of King Deshret to look for the legendary Aaru, then use it to try and restore the Akasha System.

assumed.name: Gurabad
assumed.quote: I take it the Gurabad problem is resolved?

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Our commander, Dottore, died in Nod-Krai.

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: So. This mystery man openly admitted that he was merely a Harbinger's subordinate?

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Oh — Nefer's a friend we met in Nod-Krai.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Are the Fatui behind this too?

assumed.name: Goat King, Ibis King, Crocodile King
assumed.quote: Some sort of prison where the Goat King, Ibis King, and Crocodile King are locked up.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: You encouraged me to report my dreams to the Dendro Archon

assumed.name: Candace
assumed.quote: What's Candace up to? I don't think I've seen her yet.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: I'm on good terms with Dori, and she's mentioned you all before.

assumed.name: Dar al-Shifa
assumed.quote: Even the doctors at Dar al-Shifa allow patients to be accompanied by family members.

assumed.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
assumed.quote: the Palace of Alcazarzaray, I guess?

assumed.name: Al-Ahmar
assumed.quote: The tale of how the three retainers of Al-Ahmar were imprisoned in Aaru.

assumed.name: Jinn
assumed.quote: Why did those verses soothe the Jinn only when recited by you?

threads.claim: Irminsul's information bottleneck is warping memory and cognition, and its underlying cause is still unknown.
threads.quote: Information is bottlenecking inside Irminsul, hampering the Ley Lines' flow.

threads.claim: Irminsul was not attacked from outside, so the true source of its malfunction remains a mystery.
threads.quote: There's no signs of Irminsul having been attacked from the outside.

threads.claim: Unidentified merchant caravans entering Sumeru through Bayda Harbor may be linked to the crisis.
threads.quote: a large number of unidentified merchant caravans had recently been spotted entering Sumeru through Bayda Harbor.

threads.claim: Collei's dream may be a premonition of a real danger that could come true.
threads.quote: In the long run, Collei's dream could well become a reality.

threads.claim: An unknown voice, revealed to be Nicole's, spoke into Collei's mind and warned her of things to come.
threads.quote: Just as she was about to dismiss these events as a mere dream, an unknown voice — Nicole's — spoke into her mind

threads.claim: Someone unseen seems to be steering events in Sumeru.
threads.quote: It feels as though we're being pushed along by an invisible hand...

threads.claim: Visions are bestowed by the gods on the ambitious, yet some ambitious people do not receive one.
threads.quote: They say that fervent ambition attracts the favor of the gods — and with it, a Vision.

threads.claim: The Fatui are disrupting Sumeru for an unnamed client.
threads.quote: We don't want to keep our client waiting, do we?

threads.claim: A hooded man claiming to be Dottore's subordinate is carrying out the fallen Harbinger's will.
threads.quote: calling himself Dottore's subordinate and stating that he is here to carry out the fallen Harbinger's will.

threads.claim: A flower-shaped key reveals a hidden location of a unique statue of the gods hanging inverted from the heavens.
threads.quote: The statues of the gods hang inverted from the heavens, but one alone is unique among them.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles took Irminsul from ancient dragonkind.
threads.quote: who tells them that Irminsul was among the many things the Heavenly Principles usurped and repurposed from ancient dragonkind.

threads.claim: Restarting the Akasha System requires a substitute for the Dendro Gnosis that once powered it.
threads.quote: However, they needed a substitute for the Dendro Gnosis originally used to power it

threads.claim: Liloupar's memories and her connection to Gurabad are tied to the Jinn disturbance.
threads.quote: Alhaitham speculates that the sudden influx of Jinn relates to the ancient city of Gurabad, which sparks the Traveler's memories of Liloupar

threads.claim: Liloupar pacifies the Jinn and stops the sandstorms after she awakens and learns of the situation.
threads.quote: After learning about the current situation in Sumeru, Liloupar pacifies the Jinn and stops the sandstorms.

threads.claim: The Seven Pillars agree to open Aaru.
threads.quote: they declare the Seven Pillars to officially be in agreement to open Aaru.

threads.claim: Nicole is an angel whose identity the group keeps secret from Faruzan.
threads.quote: though the others agree to keep Nicole's angel identity a secret from her for now.

threads.claim: The god remains injected into Nicole came from Nabu Malikata rather than from Dottore.
threads.quote: Nicole reveals that the god remains that Dottore had injected inside her were actually from Nabu Malikata, surprising everyone present.

threads.claim: Nahida's connection to Irminsul is draining her, and she collapses unconscious.
threads.quote: Just as he says this, the Dendro field dissipates and Nahida collapses, unconscious.

threads.claim: The cause of the Irminsul anomaly is unknown and may be a malfunction or a stress fracture.
threads.quote: Rather, it resembles a malfunctioning machine, calculations going haywire and sparks flying.

threads.claim: Healing the Dendro Archon requires healing Irminsul first, which seems impossible without her power.
threads.quote: Restoring the Dendro Archon's power requires us to heal Irminsul first — but that will be extremely difficult without the Dendro Archon's power.

threads.claim: Apep partially answers the Archon's recovery by supplying life force, though full recovery depends on fixing Irminsul.
threads.quote: It is done. The Heart of Oasis is supplying her with life force as we speak.

threads.claim: Irminsul predates the Heavenly Principles and once belonged to dragonkind.
threads.quote: That tree was not planted by the Heavenly Principles. Irminsul existed before they ever arrived in Teyvat.

threads.claim: Apep vows dragons will one day reclaim the world from the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: But there will come a day when we reclaim this world for ourselves.

threads.claim: The Hydro Dragon has reportedly seized authority from the Heavenly Principles' usurpers.
threads.quote: I can already sense that far away from here, the Hydro Dragon has wrested his authority from the hands of the usurpers.

threads.claim: The mysterious Fatui figure questions whether the Seven can be trusted to avoid corruption.
threads.quote: And how can we be sure that The Seven, who wield authority over the world, will not be corrupted?

threads.claim: A mysterious voice keeps its identity hidden and may not even be real.
threads.quote: So far, you've only heard my voice — and for all you know, it may not even be real.

threads.claim: The mysterious figure hints at a plan tied to Sumeru City and Irminsul.
threads.quote: Sumeru City, Irminsul...

threads.claim: Dottore's death in Nod-Krai is confirmed by the Fatui figure.
threads.quote: Well deduced. Our commander, Dottore, died in Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: Collei has a vivid dream of fire destroying the world that she cannot explain.
threads.quote: I wish I could give you more details, but all I remember is fire everywhere. From the sky to the ground, everything was burning...

threads.claim: Shakir suspects Collei's dream may be a prophecy despite her lack of astrology study.
threads.quote: I doubt this dream was a mere coincidence. Perhaps it was some kind of prophecy?

threads.claim: Nicole is a mysterious voice who guides Collei and gives her a song to recite.
threads.quote: The only one who can help is you. I am merely here to guide you along the correct path.

threads.claim: The Goddess of Flowers song calms the Jinn only when Collei recites it, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: It seems like the song only works when Collei recites it. But why?

threads.claim: Nahida secretly passed the Traveler a mysterious piece of information she is keeping from everyone.
threads.quote: (The moment I touched the key Nahida handed over, a mysterious piece of information appeared in my mind...)

threads.claim: Anomalous information may be hidden within the Ley Line blossoms, which the sages are studying.
threads.quote: There must be anomalous information hidden within these blossoms.

threads.claim: The Akasha needs a Gnosis as power, so the sages must find an alternative energy source.
threads.quote: The Akasha relies on the Gnosis as a power source, and in its absence, we'll need to find an alternative.

threads.claim: Dormant Jinn may be sealed beneath Gurabad and could be behind the desert chaos.
threads.quote: supposedly, a great number of dormant Jinn lie sealed beneath that city.

threads.claim: Liloupar promises to calm the Jinn and end the sandstorms, answering the Gurabad crisis.
threads.quote: Child's play. I shall quell the Jinn and scatter the storms.

threads.claim: The Abyss beneath Gurabad fell silent at a change in a foreign land to the west, possibly tied to Gosoythoth's defeat.
threads.quote: Suddenly, the pitch-black Abyss fell silent.

threads.claim: Jeht reports that he has killed Masseira, closing that chapter.
threads.quote: So the Masseira chapter has finally come to a close.

threads.claim: Apep seems to know more about Irminsul's state than the Traveler does, hinting at hidden knowledge.
threads.quote: (Could she know something that we don't?)

threads.claim: The Traveler may be immune to Irminsul's anomalies because Irminsul holds no information about them.
threads.quote: (Nahida once said that Irminsul doesn't contain any information about me... So theoretically, I shouldn't be affected by such anomalies.)

threads.claim: Aaru's true function and purpose remain deep secrets even to its custodians.
threads.quote: That being said, what Aaru actually does and why it was built... Those are deep secrets we are not privy to.

threads.claim: The three retainers were trapped in Aaru behind three questions whose answer is unknown.
threads.quote: The Ibis King told us they were trapped in Aaru, and that they had to answer three questions to get out.

threads.claim: Nefer reveals that the answer 'time' resolves all three questions, though the seal only opens for King Deshret's intended answer.
threads.quote: And that's not only the answer to the final question. It's the answer to all three of them.

threads.claim: Liloupar's escape and history with the Harbinger-linked master remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Perhaps you can ask my master one day, should you ever get the chance.

threads.claim: Nefer has a personal connection to the Ibis King, one of the imprisoned retainers.
threads.quote: I happen to have a connection with one of the three retainers imprisoned inside, the Ibis King.

threads.claim: The captured man admitted to being Dottore's subordinate, raising doubts about his true identity.
threads.quote: So. This mystery man openly admitted that he was merely a Harbinger's subordinate?

threads.claim: An invisible barrier now isolates Sumeru, and its cause is suspected to be inside Irminsul.
threads.quote: No one can leave and no one can enter. Sumeru has become a lonely island.

threads.claim: Nicole suspects Irminsul itself has a defense mechanism that sealed Sumeru off.
threads.quote: I suspect it's a defense mechanism within Irminsul itself.

threads.claim: The Mausoleum is given a hidden defense mechanism powered by Aaru, hinting at Irminsul-level protection.
threads.quote: Using Aaru's power, we shall install a defense mechanism at our King's Mausoleum.

threads.claim: The Dendro Archon fell into a coma from Irminsul trouble and cannot connect to Irminsul.
threads.quote: Whatever is wrong with Irminsul, it severely affected the Dendro Archon. She fell into a coma, and is currently receiving treatment from the Dendro Dragon.

threads.claim: Sobek claims Apep, the last Seven Pillar, is healing the Dendro Archon, which Shesepankh doubts without proof.
threads.quote: Apep is, in fact, healing the Dendro Archon as we speak.

threads.claim: Liberating Aaru will return the souls in the Golden Slumber to the Ley Lines and then to Irminsul.
threads.quote: Remember: The moment that Aaru is liberated, the myriad souls residing within the Golden Slumber will return to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: Jebrael's soul is released from the Golden Slumber, letting Jeht say goodbye to his father.
threads.quote: My soul, once imprisoned along with that of Samail, is finally free. I am truly grateful for the chance to see you again.

threads.claim: Some fragments of the Goddess of Flowers were unaccounted for and were tracked down by the Fatui.
threads.quote: Eventually, the Fatui must have found a way to track some of them down... Presumably for use in some experiment.

threads.claim: The Goddess's smallest fragments carry her instincts and would send warnings, such as Collei's dream.
threads.quote: Even her smallest remaining fragments would do their utmost to send you that warning.

threads.claim: Collei's mysterious inner voice is revealed to be Nicole, who guided her through dreams and prayer.
threads.quote: It's you... You're the voice who's been speaking in my head, aren't you?

threads.claim: Nicole's true identity is being kept secret from outsiders.
threads.quote: Let's not tell Madam Faruzan about Miss Nicole's true identity for now...

threads.claim: Nicole hints that she has quietly watched over heroes for generations.
threads.quote: That must be why I've quietly kept watch over generation after generation of them.

threads.claim: The angels have perished, and Nicole misses the days when they walked freely.
threads.quote: And yet, since the angels' demise, I have found myself missing those days on more than one occasion...

threads.claim: Cyno carries fragments of Hermanubis, and Collei carries a fragment of the Goddess of Flowers.
threads.quote: Incidentally, three is the maximum number of Hermanubis's Ba fragments that I could bear.

threads.claim: Nicole argues emotions fade once their attachments are gone, a view Nefer resists by choosing to remember.
threads.quote: Human emotions are often attached to a person, a place, or an object. When those things are gone, the memories quickly fade, and the emotions slip away along with them.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Navia's group that exists to fill the gaps where the authorities fail
introduced.quote: That's why we exist, to seep into the cracks where filth falls through, where their watch fails them.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: Navia's father, a former boss of Spina di Rosula who was called Callas the Unfaithful
introduced.quote: My father's name is Callas. Yes, the same one they call "Callas the Unfaithful" in the streets.

introduced.name: Jacques
introduced.how: Callas's friend, who was murdered and whose death Callas was accused of
introduced.quote: three years ago, her father, Callas, was accused of murdering his friend Jacques, but rather than standing trial

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: A Champion Duelist who rescued the group and was the one who killed Callas in the duel
introduced.quote: Oh, and there was that Champion Duelist named Clorinde who came out to save us too.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Chief Justice who keeps the archive of detailed case files
introduced.quote: And that is the archives kept by Chief Justice Neuvillette. A place where detailed files on all the cases in recent years are kept.

introduced.name: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale
introduced.how: A machine that takes in evidence and returns a verdict
introduced.quote: He then submits the information into the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, which returns a "Guilty" verdict.

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: A dissolved woman whose consciousness speaks to the Traveler through the fountain's water
introduced.quote: they find themselves mentally connected with an Oceanid, asking them about Vacher.

introduced.name: Vacher
introduced.how: A witness to a girl's dissolving who is missing from public records
introduced.quote: they were looking for a man named Vacher, who was a witness to the disappearance case.

introduced.name: Vigneire
introduced.how: Vacher's lover, whose notebook contains Marcel's name
introduced.quote: After collecting enough, they find the notebook of Vacher's lover Vigneire, containing Marcel's name.

introduced.name: Marcel
introduced.how: A wealthy suspect who was present at both the banquet and the murder
introduced.quote: coincidentally, Marcel was at both events.

introduced.name: Thierry
introduced.how: One of three suspects Melus identified, who is also knowledgeable about Gardemeks
introduced.quote: Instead, he gives three potential suspects to investigate that he had weeded out over the past three years - Florent, Thierry and Marcel

introduced.name: Sinthe
introduced.how: A popular recreational drink that caused drug-like harm and was made with Primordial Seawater
introduced.quote: there had been a popular drink known as Sinthe

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: Water that dissolves people and can be secretly added to drinks
introduced.quote: it had been spiked with water from the Primordial Sea

introduced.name: Garde
introduced.how: Authorities who dismissed reports of people dissolving in water
introduced.quote: when he reported about the dissolving to the Garde, they simply laughed him off.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: The only group that can operate official Gardemeks
introduced.quote: Navia asks her how the Meka were controlled, as the Gardemeks could only be operated by the Maison Gardiennage.

introduced.name: Gardemeks
introduced.how: Official mechs whose illegal copies lack serial numbers
introduced.quote: None of these meka have serial numbers, I was sure to check a moment ago.

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: Spina di Rosula's headquarters and place of origin
introduced.quote: I sent them back to Poisson, it's Spina di Rosula's place of origin and where we have our headquarters.

introduced.name: Champion Duelist
introduced.how: A duelist rank whose holders can tell whether an opponent is fighting to live or to die
introduced.quote: as a Champion Duelist, she could tell when someone was fighting to live or die

introduced.name: dissolving in water
introduced.how: People can be dissolved by Primordial Seawater, leaving no trace
introduced.quote: If it hadn't happened right in front of us, Paimon wouldn't have ever believed that a person could be dissolved like that...

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Criminal group headquartered on a ship in Poisson, run by Callas
introduced.quote: While it may look like a ship, it's actually Spina di Rosula's headquarters.

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: Town where Spina di Rosula began and has its main base
introduced.quote: Well, Poisson is where Spina di Rosula began, after all. It's our main base, our home.

introduced.name: Sinthe
introduced.how: Popular drink that causes hallucinations and severe side effects when quit
introduced.quote: At a glance, it was a kind of drink that could excite your mood and produce many pleasant hallucinations.

introduced.name: Jacques
introduced.how: Sinthe dealer who became Callas's informant and was later killed
introduced.quote: The man's name was Jacques. He felt greatly ashamed about his work after seeing many families destroyed by Sinthe abuse.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: Navia's father who oversaw Poisson and banned Sinthe
introduced.quote: As he oversaw Poisson, my father was compelled to put a stop to Sinthe abuse, and called for a complete ban of it.

introduced.name: Callas's conviction for murder
introduced.how: Callas was convicted of murdering Jacques in a rainy banquet-courtyard shooting and later died in a duel
introduced.quote: On the day my father was convicted of murder, it was also raining.

introduced.name: Banquet shooting
introduced.how: Two gunshots at Callas's banquet killed Jacques; Callas was found holding a gun
introduced.quote: But then we heard two gunshots from the courtyard.

introduced.name: Clothing at the scene
introduced.how: Clothes left at the banquet scene suggest a third person who may have dissolved
introduced.quote: there were pieces of clothing left at the scene.

introduced.name: Confrerie of Cabriere
introduced.how: Wealthy guild in Poisson that Callas helped grow and that supported the fight against Sinthe dealers
introduced.quote: It's a guild in Poisson. Boss helped it to grow to its current size and prominence.

introduced.name: Marcel
introduced.how: Head of the Confrerie of Cabriere and a suspect
introduced.quote: Marcel, the head of Confrerie of Cabriere.

introduced.name: Florent
introduced.how: Spina di Rosula's senior adviser and a suspect
introduced.quote: The first is Florent, Spina di Rosula's senior adviser.
