introduced.name: Thierry
introduced.how: Coordinates information between Spina di Rosula and the Gardes; a suspect
introduced.quote: The final suspect is Thierry, the man responsible for coordinating information between Spina di Rosula and the Gardes.

introduced.name: Gardes
introduced.how: Local authorities who mostly leave Spina di Rosula to its own devices
introduced.quote: Although the Gardes mostly leave us to our own devices, there are still many activities we have to report to the local authorities.

introduced.name: Gardemeks
introduced.how: Meka units with serial numbers that can be privately owned and cannot simply be commanded by Gardes officials
introduced.quote: So if you hypothetically wanted to do something against me, all you would need to do is get rid of the meka's serial numbers and send them after me...

introduced.name: Melus
introduced.how: Callas's and Navia's butler who knows Spina di Rosula's secrets
introduced.quote: I am the butler, after all. I live but to serve the Boss and Demoiselle's will.

introduced.name: Water from the Primordial Sea
introduced.how: Substance likely used to make Sinthe
introduced.quote: Considering what we know now, it's almost certain that Sinthe is created using Water from the Primordial Sea.

introduced.name: Dissolving into water
introduced.how: People can be turned into water, which the Traveler points out as a possibility
introduced.quote: The fact that people can be turned into water.

introduced.name: Coralie
introduced.how: Jacques's widow, who was cared for by Spina di Rosula after his death
introduced.quote: After my husband died, Spina di Rosula sent us a lot of Mora and support.

introduced.name: Adele
introduced.how: Jacques's daughter, who is grieving and resentful toward Navia
introduced.quote: ...You don't understand at all.

introduced.name: Vacher
introduced.how: A possible eyewitness in the serial disappearances case, whom Neuvillette has no record of
introduced.quote: He may have been an eyewitness in the serial disappearances case.

introduced.name: Erinnyes
introduced.how: Opera house used as a trial site for the serial disappearances case
introduced.quote: Yeah, news came from Erinnyes just after you left!

introduced.name: Sinthe production base
introduced.how: Location where Sinthe is produced and the enemy's headquarters
introduced.quote: It's the location where Sinthe is produced. Essentially, it's the enemy's headquarters.

introduced.name: Callas's rare illness
introduced.how: Callas was diagnosed with a rare illness and had about five years to live
introduced.quote: Boss also didn't tell you that he had been diagnosed with a rare illness.

introduced.name: Navia as the next target
introduced.how: Navia was selected as the next victim of the disappearances
introduced.quote: the revelation that you, Demoiselle, had been selected as the next target

introduced.name: Callas's intimidation tactic
introduced.how: Callas threatened to expose the Sinthe network if anything happened to Navia
introduced.quote: Knowing all of this, he decided to use one final intimidation tactic before his death.

introduced.name: Vacher
introduced.how: Marcel's true identity: a researcher who kidnapped women to revive his lover
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: The man now known as Marcel was originally named Vacher, and worked as an adventurer with his partner and lover, Vigneire.

introduced.name: Vigneire
introduced.how: Vacher's lover, dissolved by Primordial Sea water, whose revival drove the experiments
introduced.quote: Traveler: Is to save his lover, a woman called Vigneire, who was dissolved.

introduced.name: Sinthe
introduced.how: a drug made by diluting Primordial Sea water, which can dissolve a human when undiluted
introduced.quote: Paimon: If you dilute it with normal water, you'll get Sinthe, but the pure stuff can dissolve a human...

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: an ancient sea that once existed on the surface and nurtured early life; its water dissolves humans
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: There used to be a special sea on the surface of this planet. The nature of its seawater was rather different from that of the sea we know today...

introduced.name: Confrerie of Cabriere
introduced.how: an organization headed by Marcel, described as a sister organization of Spina di Rosula
introduced.quote: Navia: Marcel, the head of Confrerie of Cabriere!

introduced.name: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale
introduced.how: a machine whose judgment is the court's final verdict, shown by tipping scales
introduced.quote: (The scales of the Oratrice tip towards the right)

introduced.name: Gardes
introduced.how: the law enforcement that investigated the original banquet case and handles arrests
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: The Gardes' investigation did not recover any other firearms from the scene.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: Navia's father, accused of Jacques' murder, who died after losing a duel
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: Callas was defeated by Champion Duelist Clorinde in the ensuing duel, and soon succumbed to the injuries.

introduced.name: Jacques
introduced.how: Callas' acquaintance, shot dead at the banquet three years earlier
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: When the guests arrived at the scene, they found the primary suspect, Callas, holding a gun, while his acquaintance, Jacques, lay dead from a gunshot wound.

introduced.name: Callas the Unfaithful case
introduced.how: the banquet murder of Jacques three years ago, in which Callas was blamed and died
introduced.quote: Navia: I would like to take everyone back to three years ago, to the case of "Callas the Unfaithful."

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: a journalist who once profiled Navia and has long pressed her for a story on the serial disappearances
introduced.quote: Navia: Yeah, way back when I first became the president of the Spina di Rosula, she was all over me, wouldn't take no for an answer...

introduced.name: Vigneire's Notebook
introduced.how: Vigneire's diary, whose final baby-name choice was Marcel
introduced.quote: Traveler: She made a list of baby names.

introduced.name: Sinthe production base
introduced.how: a hidden underwater base where Sinthe and Primordial Sea water are made
introduced.quote: Paimon: Finally found it... So this is the entrance that leads to the Sinthe production base...

introduced.name: Duel to clear one's name
introduced.how: a charged person may accept a duel to clear their name in Fontaine's court
introduced.quote: Childe: However, I did hear that people who have been charged can choose to participate in a duel to clear their name. Is that right?

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: reveals he is the Chief Justice of Fontaine
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: Hm? I am the Chief Justice of Fontaine, of course.

introduced.name: Vacher's experiments
introduced.how: Vacher kidnapped young women for research to restore Vigneire, dissolving them
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: Vacher learned of the Primordial Water's existence through the work of others, and began to kidnap young women for research

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: the sea was known to engender and nurture life, and its reversal to devour life is unexpected
introduced.quote: the Primordial Sea — which was known to engender and nurture life — suddenly reverse itself and devour life instead?

introduced.name: prophecy
introduced.how: a circulating prophecy says sea levels rise, people dissolve in water, Furina is left crying alone, and the people's sins are washed away
introduced.quote: That the sea levels will rise, and everyone will be dissolved in water, leaving Furina crying alone on her throne, but the sins of the people will be finally washed away for good?

introduced.name: prophecy origin
introduced.how: the prophecy is rumored to be rooted in the last words of the former Hydro Archon
introduced.quote: Rumors have it that this prophecy is rooted in the last words the former Hydro Archon left to the world before she passed away.

introduced.name: Oratrice
introduced.how: a divinely created mechanism that integrates the people's faith in justice and issues verdicts
introduced.quote: As a divinely created mechanism, the people's unified faith in the concept of justice is integrated into it.

introduced.name: Indemnitium
introduced.how: a power the Oratrice can produce
introduced.quote: Not only can it produce the incredible power of Indemnitium, but it likely also possesses other traits... such as self-awareness.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: where the Fatui Harbinger is being held while his case is investigated
introduced.quote: we regret to say that the Fatui Harbinger will just have to bide his time in the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: Neuvillette's base to which he must return for his work
introduced.quote: It will soon be time for me to leave this blissful tranquility behind, and return to Palais Mermonia.

threads.claim: Vacher is a witness whose existence has been erased from public records.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, this name seems to have been wiped from existence.

threads.claim: The Traveler accuses Marcel of being Vacher, tying the witness to the suspect.
threads.quote: Returning to the opera house, the Traveler accuses Marcel of truly being Vacher, inspired by the name of the child that never came to be

threads.claim: A voice calling for Vacher draws people toward the fountain.
threads.quote: Paimon can kinda hear a voice... It's calling for "Vacher," right?

threads.claim: The Oceanid at the fountain has lost her memories and does not know who she is.
threads.quote: I'm... Wait, who am I...? I'm very sorry, I fear I do not know.

threads.claim: The fountain voice is revealed to be a collective of dissolved women merged with Vigneire, not Vigneire herself.
threads.quote: the collective consciousnesses of the women he had dissolved and had merged with Vigneire

threads.claim: Some consciousness seems to remain after a body is dissolved in Primordial Seawater.
threads.quote: Traveler: It seems that after the body is dissolved...

threads.claim: Primordial Seawater may raise a non-Fontainian's sensitivity to Hydro, which lets them hear the voice.
threads.quote: The ability to hear voices like that has to do with one's sensitivity to the Hydro element.

threads.claim: Vacher was the one conducting the experiments at the Sinthe facility.
threads.quote: They discover that Vacher was the one conducting the experiments.

threads.claim: Callas may have been framed for the murder of Jacques.
threads.quote: But I do not believe my father was a murderer. I'm sure he was set up...

threads.claim: Clorinde confirms Callas wanted to die in the duel rather than defend himself.
threads.quote: as a Champion Duelist, she could tell when someone was fighting to live or die, and that Callas wanted to die.

threads.claim: A powerful or wealthy party secretly controls illegal Gardemeks as a private force.
threads.quote: I can only conclude that some powerful or wealthy party must have obtained them via illegal means, deploying them as a private force of sorts.

threads.claim: Thierry suggests that only someone rich or powerful could obtain private Gardemek units.
threads.quote: that either someone rich and/or powerful could get their hands on private units.

threads.claim: The mastermind behind the disappearances is very powerful.
threads.quote: I believe that the mastermind behind the serial disappearances is very powerful.

threads.claim: An organization is dissolving young women, but its motives remain unknown.
threads.quote: We know that there is an organization that means to dissolve these young women, but we still don't know what they are really after.

threads.claim: The Traveler's journey is to find the truth of Teyvat, which may connect to the disappearances.
threads.quote: they wanted to speak with Furina as part of their journey to find the truth of Teyvat

threads.claim: Fontaine's authorities are fallible, and Navia distrusts the Garde.
threads.quote: Navia expresses a lack of faith in the Garde, stating that they needed to look at the case from another perspective to gain more clues.

threads.claim: Neuvillette apologized for Callas's death without emotion and still let the duel proceed.
threads.quote: even though he agreed that something was wrong with the case, he let the duel proceed.

threads.claim: Neuvillette explains he let the duel proceed because he believed humans would prioritize their lives over justice.
threads.quote: He admits that he believed at the time that humans would prioritize their lives over justice

threads.claim: Neuvillette has an unexplained Hydro power that he uses to subdue Tartaglia.
threads.quote: using an unknown Hydro power to knock him out.

threads.claim: Tartaglia is falsely accused of the disappearances.
threads.quote: Thierry urgently informs them that the authorities have accused Tartaglia of the disappearances.

threads.claim: Neuvillette promises to look into Childe's verdict and find the truth.
threads.quote: Neuvillette assures the Traveler that he'll look into Childe's verdict on his own time and find the truth.

threads.claim: The Oratrice gives a guilty verdict that differs from Neuvillette's own judgment.
threads.quote: Neuvillette puts the information in the Oratrice, which hands a "Guilty" verdict on Tartaglia

threads.claim: Neuvillette reveals he had foreseen that he might one day reach a different verdict than the Oratrice.
threads.quote: He reveals that he had foreseen the possibility that one day he would conclude with a different verdict

threads.claim: Humans can be turned into water and washed away, possibly explaining the murder.
threads.quote: So you're saying that the true murderer could have been turned into water?

threads.claim: A third person who dissolved at the banquet may have caused the shots.
threads.quote: But considering it now, it's almost certain that they belonged to a third person at the scene.

threads.claim: Navia doubts her father killed Jacques, leaving his guilt unresolved.
threads.quote: I really can't believe that my father could ever bring himself to shoot Jacques.

threads.claim: Callas hid his illness and threatened to expose Sinthe to protect Navia.
threads.quote: Knowing all of this, he decided to use one final intimidation tactic before his death.

threads.claim: Sinthe is likely made from Water from the Primordial Sea.
threads.quote: Considering what we know now, it's almost certain that Sinthe is created using Water from the Primordial Sea.

threads.claim: Sinthe's production base is the enemy's headquarters, but its evidence is not yet revealed.
threads.quote: It's the location where Sinthe is produced. Essentially, it's the enemy's headquarters.

threads.claim: Melus narrows the suspects to Florent, Thierry, and Marcel.
threads.quote: After several rounds of testing and investigative tracing, I've narrowed the suspect list down to three people.

threads.claim: Thierry says the attacking meka were private units that he could not have dispatched.
threads.quote: So I can promise you — those meka were definitely private units.

threads.claim: Tartaglia is put on trial for the serial disappearances, which the party doubts.
threads.quote: he's been accused of being the true culprit behind the serial disappearances case.

threads.claim: Vacher has no record in files or in Neuvillette's memory, hinting at something unnatural.
threads.quote: There are no records of him either in the files or in my memory.

threads.claim: Navia thinks Neuvillette expresses no real emotion and only says what he feels he should.
threads.quote: There's no emotion behind your words — you only said those things because you felt like you should.

threads.claim: Fontaine authorities may have been infiltrated by the enemy, so going to them is risky.
threads.quote: We have no idea just how thoroughly they may have been infiltrated.

threads.claim: Navia was chosen as the next target, and her father's death left her in danger.
threads.quote: the revelation that you, Demoiselle, had been selected as the next target

threads.claim: Callas had a secret rare illness that shaped his decisions.
threads.quote: Boss also didn't tell you that he had been diagnosed with a rare illness.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the mastermind behind Lyney's case may be the same person.
threads.quote: Could the mastermind be the same person?

threads.claim: Callas knew that Sinthe was linked to the serial disappearances before his death.
threads.quote: In fact, even before that banquet, Boss already knew of the connection between Sinthe and the serial disappearances case.

threads.claim: Navia suspects Marcel is a man named Vacher, a name Marcel claims never to have heard.
threads.quote: Navia: Is it a man named "Vacher"?

threads.claim: Marcel is revealed to be Vacher, who created the Marcel identity to hide his past.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: The man now known as Marcel was originally named Vacher, and worked as an adventurer with his partner and lover, Vigneire.

threads.claim: The Traveler heard a voice at the fountain that may be Vigneire's.
threads.quote: Traveler: The voice I heard from the fountain was probably Vigneire.

threads.claim: The real Vigneire's consciousness is apart from the victims and refuses to see Vacher, left unresolved.
threads.quote: Oceanid?: The only one I am not... is Vigneire.

threads.claim: Drinking Primordial Sea water heightened the Traveler's sensitivity to the Hydro element, with unexplained effects.
threads.quote: Traveler: Something to do with my sensitivity to the Hydro element...

threads.claim: The Primordial Sea no longer exists on the surface, so its remaining water is a mystery.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: But today, the Primordial Sea no longer exists on the planet's surface.

threads.claim: The Oratrice returned a verdict that contradicted the Chief Justice's expectation, with no clear cause given.
threads.quote: Confident Audience Member: Huh!? This has never happened before, the Oratrice... actually returned a different verdict from the Chief Justice...

threads.claim: Furina claims the whole trial was a scripted performance and the Oratrice never judges arbitrarily, leaving her claim unverified.
threads.quote: Furina: And of course, for every performance, there is a script. Everything has unfolded exactly as I expected from the very beginning.

threads.claim: Furina asks whether Callas intended to die in the Duelists' Ring, an open question at this point.
threads.quote: Furina: So... You mean to say... Your father intended to die in the Duelists' Ring?

threads.claim: Clorinde swears that Callas never intended to leave the Ring alive, confirming his deliberate sacrifice.
threads.quote: Clorinde: I hereby swear on my name and honor as a Champion Duelist that Mr. Callas never intended to leave the Ring alive.

threads.claim: Neuvillette reflects that Callas's sacrifice shows a justice higher than life itself, challenging his earlier view.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: A justice that is higher than... life itself.

threads.claim: Vacher discovered that diluted Primordial Sea water induces euphoria, which led to the production of Sinthe.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: During the course of his research, Vacher discovered that a diluted concoction of Water from the Primordial Sea can induce feelings of euphoria

threads.claim: Paimon notices Neuvillette's immense power and asks who he really is, a question left open.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh! Monsieur Neuvillette, that power you showed when you took him down... Who are you, really?

threads.claim: A prophecy about rising seas and dissolution in Fontaine is circulating and may be tied to the former Hydro Archon.
threads.quote: Rumors have it that this prophecy is rooted in the last words the former Hydro Archon left to the world before she passed away.

threads.claim: Two parts of the prophecy have already come true, so the prophecy is considered credible.
threads.quote: Two parts of the prophecy have already proven correct: the rising sea levels, and the ability of the people of Fontaine to be dissolved.

threads.claim: The Primordial Sea's sudden turn to devour life contradicts known laws and suggests hidden secrets.
threads.quote: There must still be some unknown secrets around the people of this land.

threads.claim: The Oratrice may possess self-awareness and act beyond simply repeating verdicts.
threads.quote: Not only can it produce the incredible power of Indemnitium, but it likely also possesses other traits... such as self-awareness.

threads.claim: A human voice was reportedly heard from the room where the Oratrice's core is stored, possibly supporting the idea of its independent thought.
threads.quote: when Lyney told us that he heard a human voice from the room where the Oratrice's core is stored...

threads.claim: Neuvillette's investigation into Childe is unfinished, and he suspects a possible miscarriage of justice.
threads.quote: If we did incorrectly convict him of crimes he did not commit, we will most certainly compensate him to the fullest extent allowed by the law.

threads.claim: Furina is gathering intelligence from across Teyvat on the prophecy, which may be a conundrum left by her predecessor.
threads.quote: she has been collecting information and intelligence from across Teyvat for this purpose.

threads.claim: Furina may not have known what was happening with the Oratrice and bluffed through the situation, raising doubt about her ability to solve the prophecy.
threads.quote: But with Furina being the way she is... can we really trust her to solve it?

threads.claim: Neuvillette has never seen a blond-haired traveler matching the Traveler's sibling and says that person never entered Fontaine.
threads.quote: Your sibling? Another blond-haired traveler... I'm sorry, but I've never seen anyone who matches that description.

threads.claim: A mysterious voice may be heard at the Fountain of Lucine after finishing the quest.
The place Melus mentioned, Erinnyes, appears to be underwater, posing a challenge for reaching it.
threads.quote: But the place Melus mentioned seems to be underwater... How are we supposed to get there?

introduced.name: Lan Junming
introduced.how: The remnant soul introduces himself as Lan Junming and is revealed as the Wind Reader, the Lan clan's ancestor
introduced.quote: Still, that was only a title others bestowed. My name is Lan Junming.

introduced.name: Soul-Binding Art
introduced.how: A Lan clan mystic art that traps part of a soul in a rattan effigy to make a commandable puppet, forbidden by later generations
introduced.quote: It traps a part of a person's soul within a rattan effigy, creating a puppet in their likeness for the caster to command.

introduced.name: remnant soul
introduced.how: A fragment of a person's soul left behind when the rest has returned to the Ley Lines, bound to a puppet
introduced.quote: He's essentially a wisp of a remnant soul bound to a rattan figure.

introduced.name: Moon-Viewing Gathering
introduced.how: A Dihua Marsh custom where antiquarians climbed heights to view the moon, drink wine and write verse; a predecessor of Moonchase
introduced.quote: There, the antiquarians of Liyue would gather in the golden autumn, ascend the heights to view the moon, drink wine, and write verse.

introduced.name: swallow mystic art
introduced.how: Swallows carry a power that resonates with Lan clan mystic arts, and they have stopped nesting in Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: I did discover that swallows carry a kind of power that resonates well with the mystic arts our clan practices.

introduced.name: Stove God Festival customs in Moonchase
introduced.how: Long ago, Stove God Festival customs were merged into Moonchase, which is why Moonchase became linked to cooking
introduced.quote: My elders told me that long ago, customs from the Stove God Festival were folded into Moonchase.

introduced.name: Guili migration south
introduced.how: The ancient Guili people migrated south to Liyue Harbor, a point before which the lost Moonchase may date
introduced.quote: before the people of ancient Guili migrated south to Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: Self-identifies as the White Horse Adeptus, who travels by flying chariot
introduced.quote: Why dance around the matter? I am the White Horse Adeptus, and he is...

introduced.name: Moonchase Rite
introduced.how: Rex Lapis once tried to awaken the White Horse Adeptus, creating a rite that ancient Liyue later imitated into Moonchase customs
introduced.quote: Rex Lapis once sought to awaken me.

introduced.name: Lan clan responsibility-or-hobby choice
introduced.how: Lan clan rule from the Wind Reader: once children mature, they choose serious study of mystic arts or treat them as a hobby
introduced.quote: Apparently, back in the day, the Wind Reader asked his descendants that very question.

assumed.name: Moonchase Festival
assumed.quote: remembered our first Moonchase Festival and how we went looking for recipes with Keqing.

assumed.quote: Wasn't she taking Ningguang to see her clan elders?

assumed.name: Yilong Wharf
assumed.quote: Seeing Yilong Wharf like this, it really has that festival feel...

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Ningguang said the Lan clan's thaumaturges would be helping the Millelith.

assumed.name: Lan Yan
assumed.quote: Well, if it isn't and Miss Lan Yan from Chenyu Vale.

assumed.name: Lu Weng
assumed.quote: There's Boss Lu!

assumed.name: Iron Tongue Tian
assumed.quote: I do recall she was headed in Iron Tongue Tian's direction.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: I needn't introduce him to you, I trust?

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: even an Adeptus would have a headache over it

assumed.name: Third Deadly Self
assumed.quote: When my Third Deadly Self walked the mortal world

threads.claim: Lan Junming is driven by an unexplained obsession that Moonchase ought not to be like this, hinting at a lost original festival.
threads.quote: Moonchase ought not to be like this...

threads.claim: Lan Junming insists Liyue was never like this, hinting that the land or its people changed in ways the Traveler does not yet understand.
threads.quote: Liyue was never thus!

threads.claim: Swallows no longer nest in Chenyu Vale, and the cause is unknown to Lan Yan.
threads.quote: But for as long as I can remember, I've never seen a swallow's nest under the eaves here in Chenyu Vale.

threads.claim: The Soul-Binding seal over Lan Junming cannot be undone by Lan Yan, and breaking it by force risks dispersing the soul.
threads.quote: The bind is locked behind a powerful seal. I can't undo it.

threads.claim: The remnant soul is fading over time and must be stabilized or released before it dissipates entirely.
threads.quote: Soul-binding like this doesn't last forever. Over time, the remnant soul slowly fades.

threads.claim: The Lan clan's question of whether mystic arts are a responsibility or a hobby is posed as an open theme.
threads.quote: If they think of them as a hobby, nothing more is asked of them.

threads.claim: Zibai and Zhongli trace Moonchase customs back to the Moonchase Rite and Moon-Viewing Gatherings, but Lan Junming rejects the Rite as his Moonchase.
threads.quote: The people of ancient Liyue later imitated this rite, and from it were born some of the customs now associated with

threads.claim: A Moon-Viewing Gathering at Wangshu Inn in two days is set up as the next step in finding the Moonchase Lan Junming remembers.
threads.quote: Wangshu Inn will be holding a similar event in two days' time.

threads.claim: The remnant soul is revealed to be Lan Junming, the Wind Reader and ancestor of the Lan clan.
threads.quote: Zibai: Is this not Wind Reader?

threads.claim: Zibai reveals that Lan Junming invented the Soul-Binding Art and likely placed the seal on himself deliberately.
threads.quote: To my knowledge, this Soul-Binding Art was invented by Mad Lan himself.

threads.claim: Zibai suspects that the wish Lan Junming made is about more than celebrating a festival, leaving its nature unanswered.
threads.quote: Still, what exactly is the wish? I do not for a moment believe that celebrating a festival is the whole of it.

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: first Pyro Archon, a legendary hero who made a deal with the Ruler of Death
introduced.quote: According to legend, he was the greatest of heroes and leaders, and the one who made a deal with the Ruler of Death, thereby creating the rules that saved Natlan's Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: a title that has passed between many holders over time
introduced.quote: But, all in all, the title has changed hands many times.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: spirits that pass messages to Citlali through smoke
introduced.quote: Basically, the Wayob passed a truly shocking piece of news to me through the smoke last night.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: channels in which special surges of power can be sensed
introduced.quote: And now, the Wayob have sensed a special surge within the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a sacred tournament now reworked into a pure athletic competition
introduced.quote: So, the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame has been given new meaning.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: self-styled Almighty Dragonlord who mocks Mavuika and others
introduced.quote: It's a quartet, you insolent ignoramuses, a quartet! How dare you treat the Almighty Dragonlord like a subhuman?

introduced.name: Ifa
introduced.how: a doctor whose catchphrases Cacucu repeats and whose clinic Cacucu assists
introduced.quote: Those are all Ifa's catchphrases, so Cacucu picked them up after hearing them day after day.

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: a juvenile Qucusaurus and clinic assistant who repeats catchphrases
introduced.quote: No, he's an assistant at Ifa's clinic, and one of my friends. His name is Cacucu.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a tribe responsible for woven scrolls and mental support
introduced.quote: We of the Masters of the Night-Wind are broadly responsible for the woven scrolls and mental support.

introduced.name: Saurian

introduced.quote: transform into a Saurian so they can talk to you.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan

introduced.quote: Lots of folks from the Flower-Feather Clan have gone to train for the tournament, and my students just so happened to want to get some exercise, so I brought them along to help.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: a coach who designs the tournament course
introduced.quote: As you already know, Mavuika, I'm responsible for designing the tournament course.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: course designer and coach who runs the tournament training
introduced.quote: No, as the designer of the course, that's out of the question.

introduced.name: Xbalanque

introduced.quote: Xbalanque is a native of Natlan. The records speak of him as a wise, brave, and upright man, and refer to him as "The First Sun."

introduced.name: Hinchei
introduced.how: owner of the Scions of the Canopy eatery who knows Mavuika as a regular
introduced.quote: Hey there, Boss, I'm here with some guests. I'll have the usual.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: a local eatery marked on the map where Mavuika takes the group
introduced.quote: (Approach the marked location at "Scions of the Canopy")

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a tournament meant to find the strongest and showcase individual growth
introduced.quote: It remains a trial to determine the strongest among us, as well as a stage upon which to showcase your individual growth.

introduced.name: Ball sports
introduced.how: ball games are an ancient, proud tradition in Natlan
introduced.quote: Ball sports are also a proud, ancient tradition here in Natlan.

introduced.name: Kindling
introduced.how: a fiery winged ball that contestants chase through the course
introduced.quote: Contestants will have to chase it throughout the competition, encountering all kinds of terrain

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: a natural sports star and tournament contestant
introduced.quote: There's Mualani, a natural sports star! She's not going to stop scoring anytime soon!

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: contestant who wins the tournament as champion
introduced.quote: Our champion has emerged! And his name is... Kinich!

introduced.name: Nlteego
introduced.how: contestant who loses the final face-off to Kinich
introduced.quote: (The camera focuses on the final face-off, Kinich vs. Nlteego)

introduced.name: Kachina
introduced.how: contestant in the tournament who is cheerful and competitive
introduced.quote: Ready to get out there and show 'em who's boss, hehe!

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: contestant who also goes by Granny Itztli in her public appearance
introduced.quote: Granny Itztli will display her dashing self on the competition grounds soon enough.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: a dragonlord who bets with Mualani and Kachina and calls himself Almighty Dragonlord
introduced.quote: Well, this kid doesn't look like he can take a single punch from the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

introduced.name: Mausau
introduced.how: grandson of Tawto who appears as a kid and is revealed to be Xbalanque
introduced.quote: Isn't that Mausau? Like, Tawto's grandson? When did he sign up for the tournament? Did he even fight anyone out on the field?

introduced.name: Balam
introduced.how: tournament commentator who narrates the contestants' races
introduced.quote: Kinich is coming up to the trickiest parts of the course here, but is he slowing down? NO! He's SPEEDING UP! Amazing!

introduced.name: Abyss war victory
introduced.how: the war against the Abyss ended in a lasting victory for Natlan
introduced.quote: We have achieved a lasting victory. A new day has dawned on Natlan!

introduced.name: Dormant device
introduced.how: an old device that the course accidentally woke and that attacked the players
introduced.quote: Seems like we've disturbed some kinda device that's lain dormant for years...

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: first Pyro Archon from the past, now returned to life in a borrowed body
introduced.quote: I am the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: current leader and Pyro Archon of Natlan
introduced.quote: I am Natlan's current leader and Pyro Archon, Mavuika.

introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.how: deity Xbalanque negotiated with to set Natlan's rules
introduced.quote: According to legends, you also used the divine throne to negotiate with the Ruler of Death, establishing the set of rules unique to Natlan.

introduced.name: Kiongozi
introduced.how: Ancient Name meaning leader of the people, inherited by Mavuika
introduced.quote: I bear the name, "Kiongozi" — the "leader" of our people.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: great shaman who learned of Xbalanque's resurrection
introduced.quote: the great shaman Citlali learned about your impending resurrection from the Wayob

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: realm where the dead dwell, hard to reach from the living world
introduced.quote: it is still extremely difficult to meet the dead outside of the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Temple of the Spirit
introduced.how: spiritual dueling space created by Xbalanque's soul, where only the sun-blessed survive
introduced.quote: This is the land of the sun, created by my soul. Only the sun and those blessed by it can survive here.

introduced.name: Natlan darkness disaster
introduced.how: sudden calamity five hundred years ago that began the war against the Abyss
introduced.quote: The disaster struck suddenly, and Natlan was engulfed in darkness.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: famed artisans from Xbalanque's era who built Mavuika's bike
introduced.quote: The hands of our friends at the Children of Echoes are as skilled as ever.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: landmark built in Xbalanque's time, now popular with tourists
introduced.quote: It's long become a landmark. Very popular with tourists, so I hear — they think it's a lovely place.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: tribe that relaxes by the water at sunset with music and dance
introduced.quote: you can always count on the People of the Springs to relax by the water, playing their instruments and dancing their worries away.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: reliable organizer who planned the tournament
introduced.quote: She's very reliable. Leaving the tournament planning to her was a smart move.

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: champion who won the Pilgrimage tournament
introduced.quote: Kinich, you've proven yourself a true warrior and athlete. Congratulations on your triumph in the Pilgrimage!

introduced.name: Mausau
introduced.how: boy with weak health who joined the Pilgrimage tournament
introduced.quote: Mom and Dad always say that my health isn't the best, and I might not be able to do all the things everyone else can...

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: tournament whose end is celebrated with a victory banquet
introduced.quote: This is the celebration feast for the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame. You participated in the tournament, too.

introduced.name: signal flame
introduced.how: brazier lit by returning people to show their tribe they are back
introduced.quote: This particular kind of brazier is called a "signal flame," and is reserved for those coming back late at night.

introduced.name: surfboard
introduced.how: board for riding water, which can be towed behind vehicles
introduced.quote: Paimon: This is Mavuika's flamestrider! Oh, we call that board a "surfboard"!

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: You're aware that Mavuika's not the first Pyro Archon, yes?

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: To hear your voice at a time like this is truly an honor, Granny Itztli...

assumed.name: Natlan-Abyss War
assumed.quote: The war has only just ended, and with their long-standing goal suddenly gone, people are feeling a little lost.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: We trained like this back when we were fighting against the Abyss, too.

assumed.name: Ororon
assumed.quote: And if you need any help, feel free to go find the Chief, or Ororon.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen? What a coincidence.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Hey! We've got a bite!

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: We're fishing, Archon! Mualani says if we're lucky, we might catch someone really special!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: My apologies. Ajaw clearly hasn't earned his ticket to see the sun today.

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: Same for the Scions of the Canopy. We're all wrapped up.

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: It's been a while. How have you been?

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Knowing Barbatos, he'd probably crack up if he heard that...

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Ah, Pyro Archon! Welcome, welcome. It's been a while.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: The Abyss no longer threatens us day and night as it once did.

assumed.name: Tawto
assumed.quote: Like, Tawto's grandson?

assumed.name: Xbalanque's resurrection
assumed.quote: You know about Lord Xbalanque's resurrection, right?

assumed.name: The war
assumed.quote: Do you... think that she seems a little bit different? After the war and all?

assumed.name: Kinich's reputation
assumed.quote: People always talk about how tough you are, and now I can say for sure: they're not exaggerating.

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: If it's for the Pilgrimage, it's gotta be grand.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: great heroes who helped us defeat the Abyss for good.

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: the great shaman Citlali learned about your impending resurrection from the Wayob

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Though Natlan possesses incredibly unique Ley Lines

assumed.name: Spiritway
assumed.quote: (While riding the spiritway)

assumed.name: Flamestrider
assumed.quote: Doubt you've ever ridden a flamestrider in your current body, right?

threads.claim: The first Pyro Archon Xbalanque is about to return to the mortal realm, sensed through the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: And now, the Wayob have sensed a special surge within the Ley Lines. A truly ancient soul is about to return to the mortal realm.

threads.claim: Return from death is considered impossible, which makes Xbalanque's coming a puzzle.
threads.quote: Still, nothing's off the table when Xbalanque's concerned.

threads.claim: Kachina suspects the meeting with Xbalanque should not be possible and that something may be wrong.
threads.quote: Under normal circumstances, it shouldn't be possible for us to meet Lord Xbalanque, right?

threads.claim: Xbalanque returned by possessing Mausau and joining the tournament.
threads.quote: Xbalanque reveals that he had possessed Mausau and partook in the tournament, however, as Mausau was not trained, he was quickly eliminated.

threads.claim: The reason Xbalanque is returning now is unknown and worrying to Citlali.
threads.quote: just why is Lord Xbalanque suddenly about to be resurrected now?

threads.claim: Xbalanque's plan to save Natlan spanned several mortal lifespans, and he wanted to see the state of Natlan.
threads.quote: His plan to save Natlan would take course over several mortal lifespans and wanted to see the current state of Natlan should they win against the Abyss.

threads.claim: Xbalanque made a deal with the Ruler of Death that saved the Ley Lines, a bargain whose terms are still unexplained.
threads.quote: According to legend, he was the greatest of heroes and leaders, and the one who made a deal with the Ruler of Death, thereby creating the rules that saved Natlan's Ley Lines.

threads.claim: It is unknown whether Xbalanque is satisfied with the outcome of the war.
threads.quote: After all, we still don't know if he's satisfied with the outcome of this war.

threads.claim: The Wayob's messages are treated as trustworthy and not mistaken.
threads.quote: Let me be clear about this: I did not mishear, nor is the Wayob mistaken!

threads.claim: Citlali's report that the Wayob told the truth about Xbalanque is confirmed.
threads.quote: Citlali tells them that the Wayob were telling the truth

threads.claim: Warriors feel aimless now that the war has ended and their daily battle training has no purpose.
threads.quote: I asked him if anything was bothering him, and he said that he used to train for battle every afternoon.

threads.claim: The Pilgrimage is reframed as a competition that replaces ceaseless battle with a new outlet.
threads.quote: That's right. We will have competition take the place of ceaseless battle.

threads.claim: Mavuika knows of a way to meet Xbalanque but keeps her method secret.
threads.quote: No spoilers just yet. Take a guess.

threads.claim: Pyro Archons may share common personality traits across generations.
threads.quote: Maybe all Pyro Archons share my disposition.

threads.claim: Xbalanque is said to be returning, and Mavuika and the group are searching for him.
threads.quote: you still haven't told us about how you plan to find Xbalanque!

threads.claim: Xbalanque ascended as a human, and the group keeps searching for him without finding leads.
threads.quote: When Xbalanque ascended to archonhood, he did so as a human.

threads.claim: Mavuika recognizes the boy Mausau as Xbalanque, who returned in a child's form.
threads.quote: But I know, beyond any doubt, that you are Xbalanque himself.

threads.claim: Mavuika senses that Xbalanque's power is absent rather than present, hinting at an odd resurrection.
threads.quote: it wasn't because I could sense Xbalanque's power, but rather that... I could not.

threads.claim: The returned Xbalanque has no strong aura and looks like a child, answering the question of his form.
threads.quote: Wait, so THAT'S Xbalanque? But... he's just a kid...

threads.claim: Mavuika seems less serious and more playful than before the war.
threads.quote: She seems less serious than before. More willing to just loosen up and have fun.

threads.claim: Mavuika hid a playful side during the war that has now come out.
threads.quote: The side of her that she hid during the war has now come out.

threads.claim: Mavuika's human side remains, though her duties as Archon keep her too busy to show it.
threads.quote: You haven't lost your human side, you're just too busy to indulge it...

threads.claim: The Pilgrimage is no longer a prelude to war and now serves only as a contest and celebration.
threads.quote: From now on, the Pilgrimage will no longer serve as the prelude to a war waged to defend our land.

threads.claim: The war against the Abyss has ended in a lasting victory for Natlan.
threads.quote: We have achieved a lasting victory. A new day has dawned on Natlan!

threads.claim: An old dormant device was disturbed by the course and attacked the group, raising questions about what it is.
threads.quote: Seems like we've disturbed some kinda device that's lain dormant for years...

threads.claim: Xbalanque won a deal with the Ruler of Death granting him perpetual existence in exchange for power.
threads.quote: I convinced her with the promise of perpetual existence and the everlasting flame of life.

threads.claim: Xbalanque's return is revealed as a bet he won with the Ruler of Death, who became an observer of the tale.
threads.quote: I bet correctly on the outcome of this war, so this trip is my reward.

threads.claim: A sudden disaster engulfed Natlan in darkness five hundred years ago, starting a long struggle against the Abyss.
threads.quote: The disaster struck suddenly, and Natlan was engulfed in darkness.

threads.claim: Mavuika reveals that Pyro Archons spent five centuries banishing the Abyss and rebuilding Natlan until victory came in the present.
threads.quote: All the Pyro Archons in the last five hundred years have devoted their lives to banishing the Abyss, rebuilding our tribes and faith, and uniting the people as one.

threads.claim: Xbalanque's second life in the mortal world will last only a single day, from sunrise to sunset.
threads.quote: You see... Uh, you don't have to worry too much about my second life, since I'll only be here for a single day.

threads.claim: Xbalanque's soul departs at day's end, and Mavuika can no longer sense him.
threads.quote: I can no longer sense Xbalanque's soul.

threads.claim: Xbalanque offers Mavuika his remaining life force, obtained from the Ruler of Death, to revive someone she wants to see.
threads.quote: Mavuika, I would like to give you all my remaining life force, which I obtained from the Ruler of Death.

threads.claim: Mavuika declines the gift, choosing to keep the past in memory rather than bring the dead back.
threads.quote: Thank you for the offer, but I don't think I'll be needing it.

threads.claim: Xbalanque senses the calls of the dead in the Night Kingdom and carries their messages to the living through a temple of souls.
threads.quote: Mavuika, as one granted the special privilege to return, I can sense them calling for you and watching over you from within the distant winds.

threads.claim: The original owner of the borrowed body is dreaming while Xbalanque occupies it.
threads.quote: This body's original occupant is currently experiencing a fantastic dream.

threads.claim: Mausau wakes from the tournament and recalls it as a dream, showing he was the body's original owner.
threads.quote: I feel like I dreamed a very long dream.

threads.claim: Mavuika repeats an answer from an earlier conversation and seems to know what the Traveler is thinking.
threads.quote: (...How come she knew what I was thinking?)

threads.claim: Strength is framed as two forms, that of the body and that of the spirit, which a true hero must master.
threads.quote: But there are two forms of human strength: that of the body, and of the spirit.

introduced.name: Miitoboru
introduced.how: a talking boat that was named by Paimon and carries the group
introduced.quote: Fantastic Boat: Blimey, at me, of course! Oh, that's right, I forgot to introduce myself.

introduced.name: Anemo Archon
introduced.how: the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt, who is blamed for the islands
introduced.quote: Squirrel: You know, the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Mondstadt mountaintops sunk into the sea
introduced.how: some islands were once Mondstadt's mountaintops, sliced off and dumped into the ocean
introduced.quote: Squirrel: Don't you know? Some of these islands used to be Mondstadt's mountaintops.

introduced.name: Immernachtreich
introduced.how: Fischl's kingdom, which is a kingdom of night ravens
introduced.quote: Oz: Paimon, please do not make such slanderous statements. The Immernachtreich is, of course, a kingdom of night ravens.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Clan
introduced.how: an once-illustrious Inazuman clan of bladesmiths that has declined
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: There was once a time when the Kaedeharas were an illustrious clan in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Kageharu
introduced.how: Kazuha's father, who is the clan head and a bladesmith
introduced.quote: To My Dear Father, Kaedehara Kageharu:

introduced.name: Kaedehara Hisamichi
introduced.how: Kazuha's grandfather, whose voice is heard in the omamori
introduced.quote: Mona: Sounds like it might be Kazuha's grandfather.

introduced.name: Kazuha's fugitive years
introduced.how: Kazuha spent time as one of Inazuma's most wanted fugitives
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Haha, one thing you might not know about my past is that I spent some time as one of Inazuma's most wanted fugitives.

introduced.name: Visions and the Archons' gaze
introduced.how: a belief that Visions represent the Archons' gaze
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: You know, they say that Visions represent the Archons' gaze.

introduced.name: bonsai mirage
introduced.how: the bonsai pot is the entrance to the mirage, and its contents change the domains
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Just as I thought, the bonsai is the key to entering the mirage.

assumed.name: Pudding Isle
assumed.quote: the group boards it to investigate an island near Pudding Isle

assumed.name: Alcor
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? It's the Alcor!

assumed.name: Raiden Gokaden
assumed.quote: After the Raiden Gokaden incident, our clan's fortunes took a turn for the worse.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: Shogunate Infantry: Vision Hunt Decree! Hand over your Visions now!

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Shogunate Infantry The Almighty Shogun is holding a duel before the throne. Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden from coming near.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: This bonsai... was in my family for many generations. Sadly, it ended up in a Tenryou Commission warehouse in my generation.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Traveler: Let's give him a call.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, ... you don't think Alice could be behind all this, do you?

assumed.name: Melodic Omamori
assumed.quote: (Listen to the first Melodic Omamori)

assumed.name: Where Ancient Stars Align
assumed.quote: (If the Unreconciled Stars event quest Where Ancient Stars Align was completed)

assumed.name: Leonard
assumed.quote: Paimon: No, you're incredible! You helped Fischl and us solve that Leonard situation.

threads.claim: The strange island phenomena cannot be read by divination and seem to be linked to an unseen force.
threads.quote: Mona: I tried to perform a divination, but my scryglass showed only a chaotic mess that was impossible to decipher.

threads.claim: Fischl's claim that the Immernachtreich is real raises the question of whether it truly exists.
threads.quote: Fischl: Does this mean... the Immernachtreich... is real?

threads.claim: Paimon suggests Alice could be behind the mirages, a possibility the Traveler does not dismiss.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, ... you don't think Alice could be behind all this, do you?

threads.claim: A squirrel claims the Anemo Archon sliced Mondstadt's mountaintops off and dumped them into the sea.
threads.quote: Squirrel: Don't you know? Some of these islands used to be Mondstadt's mountaintops.

threads.claim: Whether Visions as the Archons' gaze is a blessing is left as an open question.
threads.quote: Friend: But is being under an Archon's gaze really a blessing?

threads.claim: The Kaedehara Clan's decline after the Raiden Gokaden incident is the regret Kazuha seeks to make up for.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: After the Raiden Gokaden incident, our clan's fortunes took a turn for the worse. By the time of my generation, our downfall was complete.

threads.claim: Kazuha was hunted under the Vision Hunt Decree and forced to flee Inazuma.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: I know very well why people resist against the Vision Hunt Decree.

threads.claim: Mona feels a force changing inside the mirage and compares it to a crack in a room's walls, which she has not yet located.
threads.quote: Oh, I know! It's like we're sitting in a room and there's a crack in the walls.

threads.claim: Fischl seems reluctant to see her own mirage, and Mona is worried about what it might reveal.
threads.quote: Mona: Fischl has been very excited about this trip from the start... but I have a feeling she doesn't want to see her own mirage...

threads.claim: Venti does not answer calls, which seems unlike him and remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Traveler: This doesn't seem like him...

threads.claim: Kazuha holds that the past is gone and cannot be relived, which may be why the mirage kept him out.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: To me, what is past is gone. Everything in the world is guided by its own rules, and as for people... we can never relive the past.

threads.claim: The empty bonsai pot represents Kazuha's heart, and the mirage is a reflection of him.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: The mirage is... me. The empty flowerpot represents the state of my heart.

threads.claim: Kazuha realizes he secretly wanted to make his own bonsai, which the mirage revealed.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: I never realized that deep down in my heart, I also wanted to make my own bonsai.

introduced.name: Atsuko
introduced.how: a woman from Inazuma who escaped by raft and is now in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Oh, Paimon's thought of someone already — Atsuko, in Liyue Harbor! She's from Inazuma.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: one of Inazuma's three commissions; runs slow approval checks on everyone entering or leaving
introduced.quote: The Kanjou Commission subjects everyone leaving or entering the nation to a protracted approval process

introduced.name: Tri-Commission
introduced.how: the three commissions that together oversee everything in Inazuma
introduced.quote: Along with the other two commissions, they oversee anything in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: enforces the Vision Hunt Decree as the executive arm of the Raiden Shogun's rule
introduced.quote: Meanwhile, the Tenryou Commission is responsible for implementing the recently promulgated Vision Hunt Decree.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: the port where all non-nationals are processed on arrival in Inazuma
introduced.quote: All non-nationals are processed centrally on Ritou upon arrival...

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: Inazuma's closed-nation policy, enforced by samurai guards
introduced.quote: the samurai guards that enforce the Sakoku Decree — the closed nation policy of Inazuma.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: Visions are being confiscated, sometimes killing their bearers
introduced.quote: People that have accepted this gift are now having their Visions confiscated inexplicably, sometimes in circumstances that leave their original recipients dead.

introduced.name: The Crux Clash
introduced.how: a martial arts tournament for renowned fighters without Visions, run by Beidou
introduced.quote: The Crux Clash is a martial arts tournament that I hold.

introduced.name: Masterless Vision
introduced.how: a Vision whose bearer died; its shell may be reawakened by a new owner
introduced.quote: When a Vision bearer dies, the light in their Vision will fade away. But the shell that housed that light remains.

introduced.name: Alcor
introduced.how: the flagship of The Crux Fleet, anchored at Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.quote: The Alcor is the flagship of The Crux Fleet.

introduced.name: The Crux Fleet
introduced.how: a well-traveled naval group in Liyue with wide sailing experience
introduced.quote: Voyaging far and wide has made them a well-traveled group with a wide range of experiences.

introduced.name: Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: where the Alcor is anchored and the tournament arena is set up
introduced.quote: I heard that it's currently anchored by Guyun Stone Forest on a supply run.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
introduced.how: a temporary crewmember of the Alcor, a poet and former wandering samurai from Inazuma
introduced.quote: This young man is Kaedehara Kazuha, a temporary addition to my crew for reasons I won't bore you with.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: captain of The Crux Fleet and organizer of the Clash
introduced.quote: If you're able to persuade their captain, Beidou, then the hardest part would be out of the way.

introduced.name: Zhuhan
introduced.how: crew member who registers tournament competitors
introduced.quote: With newfound confidence, they head to the desk where a member of the crew, Zhuhan, is in charge of registering the combatants.

introduced.name: Jinyou
introduced.how: a self-described perfect person who wants a Vision and boasts about his skills
introduced.quote: I am looking to become a perfect person.

introduced.name: Rongshi
introduced.how: a semi-final opponent who joined to test himself, not for the prize
introduced.quote: Rongshi: I don't care about the prize...

introduced.name: Chai Yi
introduced.how: a disciple of the Lingshan Clan's grandmaster, hoping to win a Vision
introduced.quote: Famous? He's the founder of the Lingshan Clan, and his skills are unparalleled! Liang and I are both disciples of his.

introduced.name: Liang
introduced.how: Chai Yi's fellow disciple of the Lingshan Clan, who wants a Vision to impress their master
introduced.quote: Liang: Exactly! With a Vision, we'd quickly become our master's top students.

introduced.name: Lingshan Clan
introduced.how: a recently founded martial arts clan whose founder teaches force dispersal for a fee
introduced.quote: You probably wouldn't have heard of it, it was founded quite recently.

introduced.name: force dispersal
introduced.how: a breathing technique that redirects incoming attacks without moving
introduced.quote: It's a type of breathing exercise where you can train yourself to harness the energy around you and neutralize attacks without moving an inch.

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling was taken by an unknown god who must be confronted for answers.
threads.quote: Traveler: I need answers from her.

threads.claim: Paimon hints the journey has a purpose and an end that they have not yet learned.
threads.quote: Paimon bets still has lots more to tell us!

threads.claim: Inazuma is a closed nation where outsiders face strict checks and danger on entry.
threads.quote: One of the obligations of the Kanjou Commission is to conduct rigorous identity checks on all individuals leaving or entering Inazuma.

threads.claim: Life in Inazuma under its rulers is stifling and makes people feel they do not belong.
threads.quote: Well... because everything is just too restrictive over there.

threads.claim: The Traveler is pointed toward The Crux Fleet as the only realistic way into Inazuma.
threads.quote: You could ask someone from The Crux Fleet if they have some way of getting you to Inazuma

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree is confiscating Visions from their bearers, often fatally.
threads.quote: People that have accepted this gift are now having their Visions confiscated inexplicably

threads.claim: The Electro Archon pursues eternity without regard for her people, and the Traveler may one day confront her.
threads.quote: If you wish to find her, she will forever be there.

threads.claim: Masterless Visions may be reawakened by a new bearer, a belief Kazuha hopes to test.
threads.quote: He had heard rumors of Masterless Visions reawakening in his travels, and as such, was looking for someone to do so.

threads.claim: The Traveler fails to reawaken the Masterless Vision, so it stays with Kazuha.
threads.quote: but they are unable to either, so Kazuha hangs onto it.

threads.claim: Kazuha took the Vision after witnessing his friend's death, keeping hope alive that it could be reawakened.
threads.quote: Kazuha, who had just arrived and witnessed the final moments of the duel, snatched the Vision and fled from his pursuers, hoping to keep the hope alive that his friend had.

threads.claim: The Traveler wields multiple elements without a Vision, which most people believe impossible.
threads.quote: Paimon: Even though you don't have a Vision, most people in Teyvat think that you can't manipulate the elements without one.

threads.claim: Kazuha perceives that the Traveler controls several elements without a Vision and cannot explain how.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: To think a human could wield the elements without a Vision...

threads.claim: The Traveler's elemental power may trace back to touching a Statue of The Seven, though the cause is unclear.
threads.quote: All I did was touch a Statue of The Seven.

threads.claim: Someone senses that the Traveler and Paimon carry the essence of the stars, a hint of deeper origins.
threads.quote: You two give off not only the essence of wind and earth, but also of... yes... the stars...

threads.claim: Kazuha wants to learn what Visions mean to the gods and why they are granted.
threads.quote: I desire to know what meaning Visions have to the gods.

threads.claim: Kazuha experiments on whether an extinguished Vision with no master can be reawakened, and the Traveler fails.
threads.quote: I wanted to know whether it were possible for an extinguished Vision to be reawakened.

threads.claim: Kazuha vows to travel across Liyue searching for a way to reawaken the Vision.
threads.quote: I will travel all across the vast lands of Liyue, in the hope of finding a way to reawaken the Vision.

threads.claim: Kazuha's past with an old friend who held a Vision is hinted at, with the story promised.
threads.quote: The story begins with an old friend...

threads.claim: The friend challenged the Vision Hunters to a duel, was sentenced to divine punishment, and Kazuha took his dying Vision.
threads.quote: I heard his sentence of divine punishment

threads.claim: The friend sought to face the Musou no Hitotachi, which is only witnessed under divine punishment.
threads.quote: Coming face to face with the Musou No Hitotachi

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree stripped away people's aspirations as the Raiden Shogun built her ideal of eternity.
threads.quote: Peoples' aspirations were stripped away

threads.claim: The tempest surrounding Inazuma is an expression of the Raiden Shogun's will to close the nation.
threads.quote: In fact, the relentless rain and wind are also an embodiment of the Raiden Shogun's will to close the nation.

threads.claim: Visions do not respond to human desire indiscriminately, leaving the Vision's power in question.
threads.quote: It appears that the Vision doesn't respond to human desire indiscriminately.

threads.claim: Kazuha finds meaning in wandering and nature while keeping the warrior way, doing as he pleases.
threads.quote: But as a wandering samurai, I find meaning in traveling and the sprawling beauty of nature that lies along the way

threads.claim: Kazuha warns that the part of the journey after the storm will be the most arduous.
threads.quote: The part of your journey that lies after the storm may well prove to be the most arduous.
