threads.claim: The missing villager may exist only in people's memories and never have actually existed.
threads.quote: Traveler: He's someone who only exists in people's memories.

threads.claim: Caribert explains that everything in Vimara Village was his doing to gain a chance at the life he was denied.
threads.quote: Thus, everything that happened in Vimara Village was of his own doing in order to have a "chance" at the life he was denied.

threads.claim: Time seems to stop at dusk when the missing man and Atossa talked, hinting the case is supernatural.
threads.quote: Atossa: Time always passed by really slowly. Even when it felt like we'd been talking for hours, the sun would still be at the same position in the sky...

threads.claim: A mysterious voice that called itself a Sinner was heard in the Traveler's sibling's memory, and its identity is unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: Right! That mysterious voice heard in 's memory... The one who called himself a Sinner... Who is he?

threads.claim: Dainsleif identifies the Sinner as his older brother Vedrfolnir, one of the Five Sinners.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: His name is Vedrfolnir, "The Visionary."

threads.claim: The Five Sinners were esteemed people who chose Abyss power and did not defend Khaenri'ah during the cataclysm.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: They were once people of great esteem in Khaenri'ah, those who carried the hopes of the nation.

threads.claim: Paimon speculates that Vedrfolnir inspired Chlothar to create the Abyss Order.
threads.quote: If he was the voice of the Sinner, then the one who inspired Chlothar to create the Abyss Order... was him!

threads.claim: Stone slates in a Fontaine ruin that outlined a prophecy may have been made by Vedrfolnir.
threads.quote: The ones that outlined Fontaine's prophecy... That was likely Vedrfolnir's doing as well.)

threads.claim: Memories flow through the Ley Lines, linking the Ley Lines to the missing man and the Loom of Fate.
threads.quote: Traveler: And one of the things that flows through the Ley Lines... are memories.

threads.claim: The Loom of Fate is suspected to be related to the Ley Lines and the Abyss Order's real purpose.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Based on the intel I've gathered so far, I suspect the Loom of Fate is related to the Ley Lines in some way.

threads.claim: Caribert reveals that the Loom of Fate was completed.
threads.quote: Caribert tells them that the Loom of Fate was completed.

threads.claim: Only Dainsleif knows where the eye of the first Field Tiller is hidden, and the Abyss Order is still searching for it.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: I am the only person who knows its location.

threads.claim: Caribert had hidden the eye in his body to draw out the sibling, and he planned to give it to the Traveler.
threads.quote: He explains that he had guessed how he would act; he had hidden the eye in his body in order to draw the sibling out, then give the eye to the Traveler while they left.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order's goal remains to obtain the eye of the first Field Tiller.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: That their goal... is still to obtain the eye of the first Field Tiller.

threads.claim: The false memories were a trap set by the Abyss Order to lure the group to the eye's location.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Just as I suspected... The false memories were a trap.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's memory is eroding, and he vows never to forget the Sinners' names and seek vengeance.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: No matter how eroded my memory may become, I will never forget their names... One day... I shall have my vengeance.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the Traveler's sibling betrayed them, and the truth is not yet known.
threads.quote: Do you believe your sibling to have betrayed you?

threads.claim: Dainsleif suggests the Traveler and sibling may still reconcile because the damage is not irreparable.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: There's still hope for the two of you to reconcile. Irreparable damage has not yet been done.

threads.claim: The sibling is racing to unlock the Loom before the Heavenly Principles awaken.
threads.quote: They are in a rush to fully unlock the Loom before the Heavenly Principles would awaken, as they did not do so despite the Divine Throne of Hydro being destroyed.

threads.claim: The sibling is intangible within Caribert's memory and will be separated and ejected soon.
threads.quote: The sibling explains that they did not belong in Caribert's memory and were thus intangible, and that they would be ejected soon.

threads.claim: The Hilichurls' sudden calm hints that someone is influencing them through a gentle voice.
threads.quote: Weren't they acting super agitated just a little while ago? Why are they so calm all of a sudden?

threads.claim: The Hilichurls were calmed by Caribert's story, which he implanted into their minds as a memory.
threads.quote: So the thing that caused the Hilichurls to calm down back then was Caribert's story

threads.claim: Implanted memories must be imperfect, so there is a tell that could expose the missing person's ability.
threads.quote: Implanting memories into the minds of others must be an imperfect process.

threads.claim: Caribert explains that his memory-implanting ability comes from controlling the half-finished Loom of Fate.
threads.quote: I have the ability to control the Loom in its semi-completed form.

threads.claim: Time does not pass inside false memories, which is why the sky never changes in them.
threads.quote: The implanted memories are basically taking place outside the regular twenty-four hours of the day.

threads.claim: The Loom of Fate's full potential is still unknown, and the Traveler plans to use it before the Heavenly Principles awaken.
threads.quote: I still haven't found a way to utilize it to its full potential, but there's still time...

threads.claim: The Loom of Fate is now complete, and Caribert used it for his own goal of comforting the Hilichurls.
threads.quote: The Loom of Fate has already been completed.

threads.claim: Caribert died when he set his plan in motion, and only a remnant of his consciousness remains.
threads.quote: In truth, I died the moment I set everything in motion.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles are asleep and will awaken at an unknown time, possibly triggered by something.
threads.quote: However, the Heavenly Principles will awaken... We just don't know when that will be, or what might trigger it.

threads.claim: Celestia did not act even after the Hydro Archon destroyed her divine throne, which hints at the Heavenly Principles' condition.
threads.quote: still Celestia took no action

threads.claim: Dain may have been given a false memory, which would explain why he froze up at a tense moment.
threads.quote: Wait, does that mean he gave Dain a... false memory!?

threads.claim: Caribert confirms he implanted a memory of Dain handing the eye to the Traveler.
threads.quote: That was when I implanted the memory of him handing you the eye.

threads.claim: The eye of the first Field Tiller is a key object whose whereabouts are uncertain.
threads.quote: That means the eye of the first Field Tiller must have fallen into the hands of the Abyss

threads.claim: Dain had kept the eye inside his body the whole time until the Abyss Order took it.
threads.quote: So, Dain had the eye this whole time... until the Abyss Order took it away.

threads.claim: The Traveler and their sibling once traveled between worlds together, and why they cannot continue that journey is an open question.
threads.quote: Why... Why can't we continue our journey together?

threads.claim: The Sea of Flowers at the End connects to the sibling's old wish to find a place where a flower is in full bloom.
threads.quote: You wanted to find a place in the universe where that one flower was in full bloom.

threads.claim: The space will vanish and the reunion between the Traveler and their sibling will be forgotten.
threads.quote: Everything in this space will be wiped from existence... including all memory of our reunion.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses they have lost something but cannot recall what happened after the conversation.
threads.quote: it almost feels like I lost something...

threads.claim: A photo found in the Traveler's pocket carries a message hinting that the two are siblings who should get along.
threads.quote: The message on the photo is written in Sumeru Script

introduced.name: Ley Line Disruptors
introduced.how: devices that imitate Ley Line disruption and must be shut down to win the round
introduced.quote: There are three Ley Line Disruptors buried in the area around Aaru Village.

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: a competition held among Darshans, where a representative is chosen to compete for prizes
introduced.quote: Each time the Interdarshan Championship is held, I will be watching from close by to choose a suitable person to inherit my estate.

introduced.name: Valuka Shuna
introduced.how: Tighnari's ancestors, originally from the desert, who later migrated
introduced.quote: My ancestors, the Valuka Shuna, were originally from the desert.

introduced.name: Mehrak
introduced.how: Kaveh's sentient portable toolbox, built from a machine core, which can help with mapping and surveying but cannot talk
introduced.quote: That's right. This is my toolbox, Mehrak.

introduced.name: King Deshret's civilization
introduced.how: an ancient civilization whose machine technology is still not fully understood
introduced.quote: It was clearly from King Deshret's civilization. His technology still isn't fully understood

introduced.name: Sachin
introduced.how: a wealthy scholar whose family and research life is laid out in the document
introduced.quote: Sachin was born to a wealthy family, and his father Rajput was a renowned merchant in Sumeru, with many properties to his name.

introduced.name: Diadem of Knowledge
introduced.how: Sachin's prized collection item, worn only by the championship winner
introduced.quote: I will also be donating my entire collection, the most prominent item of which, the 'Diadem of Knowledge,' will serve as a symbol of great honor in the Interdarshan Championship.

introduced.name: Sachin's estate donation
introduced.how: at 33 Sachin gave his properties to the Akademiya and pledged proceeds to it, with ownership unchanged
introduced.quote: At the age of 33, Sachin entrusted all of his properties to the Akademiya and pledged to donate all proceeds to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: desert people struggling financially, some of whom take private jobs for the rich
introduced.quote: The Eremites have been struggling to make ends meet recently, so a lot of groups have been doing

introduced.name: Scribe
introduced.how: the post Alhaitham returned to after stepping down as Acting Grand Sage
introduced.quote: Alhaitham has now stepped down from his post as Acting Grand Sage and is back to being the Scribe again.

introduced.name: Spantamad
introduced.how: Cyno's homeland, known for its knowledge of Ley Lines
introduced.quote: I am from Spantamad, after all. We know a lot about Ley Lines

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, right! Didn't Faruzan say that Tighnari's the favorite to win? Let's go look for him first!

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Cyno: ...How are you feeling?

assumed.name: Faruzan
assumed.quote: Faruzan: Well, what do you think? Want to team up again?

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Um, is it me, or are the bags under your eyes even darker than during the last round? Are you alright?

assumed.name: Layla
assumed.quote: Layla: Thanks for the concern, Kaveh. I just... haven't been sleeping well lately...

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: Nilou: Now that the round's begun, who do you think will win, Alhaitham?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: Looks like everyone's here. I will now explain the second round to you all.

assumed.name: Rtawahist Darshan
assumed.quote: To tell you the truth, I'm still not sure whether I have what it takes to represent the Rtawahist Darshan in the Championship.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: He already has Collei, who is an excellent pupil.

assumed.name: Avidya Forest Ley Line problem
assumed.quote: I heard that you solved the Avidya Forest's Ley Line effluence problem with him not long ago.

assumed.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
assumed.quote: Or maybe it's because constructing the Palace of Alcazarzaray burned through my funds.

assumed.name: Siraj's collective consciousness case
assumed.quote: whom they met while investigating Siraj's collective consciousness case

assumed.name: Candace and Dehya
assumed.quote: Candace: , Paimon! I've finally found you.

assumed.name: Kareena's opening ceremony mention
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sachin? Isn't that the person who Kareena mentioned during the opening ceremony?

assumed.name: Hat Guy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, only three people are left? Tighnari forfeited, and Cyno's already done... What about Hat Guy?

threads.claim: The Traveler keeps thinking about a strange vision after returning to Sumeru City, hinting at an unexplained event.
threads.quote: After returning to Sumeru City, the Traveler finds themselves thinking about the strange vision.

threads.claim: A white-haired man the Traveler saw before the competition is an unresolved mystery.
threads.quote: Traveler: (That white-haired man I saw before the competition started...)

threads.claim: The Wanderer seems to know future incidents and speaks coldly of humans, hinting at a hidden agenda.
threads.quote: There shouldn't be any more incidents after this round.

threads.claim: Mercenaries disguised as tourists are targeting Sachin, the competition's sponsor.
threads.quote: Their target seems to be someone called Sachin.

threads.claim: Sachin's whereabouts are unknown, and he may be watching the championship for an heir.
threads.quote: Sachin, dead or alive? Unknown

threads.claim: Aarav confirms no one can contact Sachin, leaving his only lead to be his promise to watch the championship.
threads.quote: No one has been able to contact him.

threads.claim: Sachin will reveal himself to a contestant he particularly identifies with and bequeath all his wealth to them.
threads.quote: If I particularly identify with a participant, I will reveal myself.

threads.claim: Layla falls asleep and another Layla takes over, a mystery about a split personality.
threads.quote: Sleepwalking Layla

threads.claim: The other Layla is aware of the competition and seems calmer, though she is still a separate person.
threads.quote: Good to see you too. Whew, it's nice to be out

threads.claim: Kaveh is torn between his goal of winning and his urge to help others, seemingly at odds with himself.
threads.quote: he still seems like he's at odds with himself in some way.

threads.claim: Alhaitham's notes contain a cryptic message about nihilism and the power of small decisions, hinting at his philosophy.
threads.quote: Lofty ideals may provide no defense at all against nihilism, but perhaps little decisions can

threads.claim: The disruptors are machines that mimic Ley Line disruption, and hidden Ley Lines can be detected by elemental energy and sound.
threads.quote: The parts of them that are hidden underground can be identified via elemental energy, sound, and other phenomena.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: the legendary forger of Ancient Names, met in person for the first time
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, so we'll finally get to meet Xilonen! The legendary forger of Ancient Names... Paimon still can't believe anyone could forge those things!

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: an heirloom symbol of a hero's spirit, forged by engraving the deeds of its first hero
introduced.quote: We forge Ancient Names by engraving the heroic deeds of an individual who will become the first hero of that particular Name.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: each tribe's spirit whose acknowledgment is needed to record deeds for an Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Only memories and experiences that have been acknowledged by the Wayob can be used as the basis for an Ancient Name.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm whose records only cover deeds done by Natlanese
introduced.quote: Xilonen: Then those deeds haven't been recorded by the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: the Masters of the Night-Wind expert on the Night Kingdom and Wayob, nicknamed Granny Itztli, who is actually young
introduced.quote: Yes, Granny Itztli — but emphasis on

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: Night Kingdom tribe that talks about dreams and revelations and is considered strange by others
introduced.quote: Kinich: His name is Ororon, and he also hails from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: a reclusive young man of the Masters of the Night-Wind who rescued Capitano and was taken by the Fatui
introduced.quote: Kinich: His name is Ororon, and he also hails from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Capitano
introduced.how: a Fatui figure who wants to meet the Traveler and distrusts Mavuika's plan
introduced.quote: Capitano greets the Traveler, who had heard about them from his colleagues and had expressed a desire to meet them in person.

introduced.name: Kosterlitzky
introduced.how: a Fatui who orders Ororon back to work in a Fatui camp
introduced.quote: They confirm that Ororon is in the camp as a Fatuus named Kosterlitzky orders Ororon to get back to work.

introduced.name: Tarko
introduced.how: a Fatui subordinate of Capitano who spots Ororon at a camp
introduced.quote: He tracks them down to a camp, though a subordinate accompanying him, Tarko, spots him.

introduced.name: Lord of the Night
introduced.how: an ancient entity ruling the Night Kingdom that borrows Sacred Flame power against the Abyss and sleeps in a deep slumber
introduced.quote: The Lord of the Night is an ancient entity that rules over the entire Night Kingdom, constantly borrowing the power of the Sacred Flame to combat corrosion from the Abyss.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: leads the defense and has stationed forces across Natlan, assigning the Ancient Name task
introduced.quote: the Pyro Archon has finished assembling her forces and stationed them all across Natlan.

introduced.name: Abyss attack on the tribes
introduced.how: the Abyss struck several tribes and outposts at once in a nation-wide attack
introduced.quote: Iansan informs them that the Abyss attacked the Masters of Night-Wind, Children of Echoes, Collective of Plenty and numerous outposts all at once.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Aphid
introduced.how: small creatures Ororon raises that leave a trail of phlogiston and act strangely when their keeper is gone
introduced.quote: There was also something off about his Phlogiston Aphids — which I assume is because their keeper has been gone for quite some time.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: raised collectively by the Masters of the Night-Wind after being abandoned as an infant; grows vegetables and raises Aphids
introduced.quote: Citlali: Ororon? Well... He was left at the side of the road as an infant and the people of the tribe took him in.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: Citlali's tribe, which believes it can see human souls and views incomplete souls as a bad omen
introduced.quote: The Masters of the Night-Wind view this as a bad omen, capable of bringing about illness and misfortune.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Aphid
introduced.how: Aphids that secrete phlogiston when disturbed, which can be used to track movement
introduced.quote: He's been raising phlogiston Aphids for a long time, and since they were disturbed, they secreted a special type of phlogiston.

introduced.name: Shared-sense spell
introduced.how: Citlali can temporarily transfer her senses to others so they can see phlogiston
introduced.quote: I used a spell to temporarily transfer a portion of my senses to you.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm reached through the Masters' ritual, familiar to the Masters, where souls are held
introduced.quote: However, you're now in the Night Kingdom, a familiar domain to the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: a Fatui leader who used the Masters' ritual to pull the Traveler's soul to the Night Kingdom and set up the meeting
introduced.quote: It was I who tasked Ororon with leaving the traces to lead you here, and I who used the Masters' ritual to bring your soul to the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Kosterlitzky
introduced.how: a Fatui officer who bullies Ororon at the camp
introduced.quote: (A shadow falls over Ororon as Kosterlitzky looms over him)

introduced.name: Coyopa
introduced.how: an official at the Speaker's Chamber who takes Ororon's report and sets the terms of his custody
introduced.quote: Technically, yes. But if Ms. Citlali is willing to serve as your guarantor, then we can release you from custody.

introduced.name: Speaker's Chamber
introduced.how: the city office where Ororon must report and explain his actions
introduced.quote: Also, once we return to the city, come to the Speaker's Chamber with me. I'll need you to explain everything.

introduced.name: Weary Inn
introduced.how: a tavern in the city where Citlali drinks and is known to the staff
introduced.quote: (Enter the Weary Inn)

introduced.name: Chanca
introduced.how: a tavern worker who knows Citlali well and is her distant descendant
introduced.quote: Chanca: Well, given our ages, it'd probably be more accurate for me to call her my great-great-granny, haha.

introduced.name: Three warnings
introduced.how: a tribal teaching on beasts, scammers, and strangers that Citlali taught Ororon as a child
introduced.quote: Be wary of beasts prowling around, scammers looking for their next victim, and strange people who appear out of nowhere.

introduced.name: Spore illusion powder
introduced.how: plant spores ground into powder and sprayed to create an illusion, used by Ororon to escape
introduced.quote: If you grind spores into a powder and spray it in the air, it can be manipulated to create an illusion...

introduced.name: Telepathic link
introduced.how: the spell lets the Traveler and Paimon hear Citlali's thoughts, possibly as a side effect
introduced.quote: Traveler: (So we can now hear her thoughts through telepathy? Wow, this is amazing! Something like this could only happen with Citlali!)

introduced.name: Failed soul ceremony
introduced.how: the Masters tried to use infant Ororon as a vessel to return souls to the Night Kingdom; it failed and he survived
introduced.quote: So, they went ahead with the ceremony... It failed, and Ororon escaped with his life.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon's backup plan
introduced.how: The Captain claims Mavuika has a hidden emergency plan to keep Natlan intact at a painful cost
introduced.quote: But what if I told you she's had another emergency plan all along, the details of which she has chosen to keep hidden from you?

introduced.name: Plan to defeat the Abyss
introduced.how: Mavuika's plan needs two more heroes to appear before the Abyss can be defeated
introduced.quote: In order to defeat the Abyss and save Natlan, she still needs two more heroes to appear.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: a Fatui leader who seeks Citlali and claims a plan to save Natlan
introduced.quote: Okanbi: It's the Fatui. Their leader seems like a big deal! He didn't bring many men with him, but they're all elite warriors.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: Citlali's apprentice and a member of the Masters of the Night-Wind who lives alone in the wild
introduced.quote: Ororon: Citlali is my elder and my teacher. She taught me everything I know. It's my duty to protect her.

introduced.name: Tarko
introduced.how: a Fatui subordinate who addresses The Captain as lord
introduced.quote: Tarko: My lord!

introduced.name: Ifa
introduced.how: a well-known veteran who is close friends with Ororon and carries supplies for Citlali
introduced.quote: Citlali: You guys know Ifa, right? No? Well, he's a pretty famous vet around these parts.

introduced.name: Granny Itztli
introduced.how: the legendary name of Citlali, said to be able to communicate with the Wayob
introduced.quote: "The Captain": Citlali... is said to be the legendary Granny Itztli, someone capable of communicating with the Wayob, and the Wayob are the key to information on the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: beings one can communicate with, and the key to information on the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: "The Captain": Citlali... is said to be the legendary Granny Itztli, someone capable of communicating with the Wayob, and the Wayob are the key to information on the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: a power that would drain souls and memories into a net to protect the Ley Lines, at a heavy cost
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The Gnosis would drain all the souls and memories from the Night Kingdom and weave them into a giant net, which would surround the Ley Lines and protect them against Abyssal corrosion.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm that houses the souls of the dead, plus the Natlan people's memories and legends
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The Night Kingdom not only houses the souls of the dead, but also our memories and legends.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: lines that are protected by a net against Abyssal corrosion and are now weakening
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The Gnosis would drain all the souls and memories from the Night Kingdom and weave them into a giant net, which would surround the Ley Lines and protect them against Abyssal corrosion.

introduced.name: Source Mechanism
introduced.how: an ancient dragon relic the Fatui are digging up; little is known about how to use it
introduced.quote: Chasca: It seems like they're looking for a dragon relic called the "Source Mechanism."

introduced.name: Talisman
introduced.how: a talisman Citlali made to keep Ororon's fragmented soul stable, powered by a gem
introduced.quote: Citlali: Remember how I said Ororon's soul is fragmented? This is the talisman I created to keep it stable.

introduced.name: Memory-copying bag trick
introduced.how: Citlali tampered with the supply bag so touching it copied Ororon's memories onto the old gem
introduced.quote: Citlali: He probably suspected that I tampered with it, but here's the catch — the trick is on the bag.

introduced.name: Loom of Fate
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ah device of unbelievable power that Paimon compares to the Ley Line plan
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, uh... It's kind of hard to explain. Basically, it's a device from Khaenri'ah that has unbelievable power.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh hey, Kachina! Are you feeling better now?

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: He understands the whole situation and is already a familiar face to her.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Piltzin shares intelligence about the Abyss' movements with Katheryne.

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: So, the Pyro Archon suggested that the Scions of the Canopy and the Adventurers' Guild focus on collecting and disseminating intel.

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: After all, you're already a victor of the Night Warden Wars!

assumed.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
assumed.quote: We used her Spiritspeaker Stone to find Kachina's Ancient Name!

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika of all people should know better than anyone, yet she still entrusted the task of forging the Ancient Name to me.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Oh, sounds like the Fatui broke into his house and took him hostage.

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Paimon: (Didn't Kinich say that she's a big name in Natlan? Feels kinda weird to see her so frustrated and helpless like this...)

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: Kinich told us that you were super amazing! No wonder you can sense so many more things than us!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Citlali: An eyewitness claimed to have seen Ororon speaking to some Fatui soldiers here.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: as well as why I mistrust Mavuika, the Pyro Archon.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: In order to defeat the Abyss and save Natlan, she still needs two more heroes to appear.

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: Paimon: Besides, wasn't it you who tried to seize the Gnosis for the Tsaritsa's plan?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Besides, wasn't it you who tried to seize the Gnosis for the Tsaritsa's plan?

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Citlali: Once Ororon is settled, I'll go talk to Xilonen and get started on forging an Ancient Name for you.

assumed.name: Ancient Name
assumed.quote: Citlali: Once Ororon is settled, I'll go talk to Xilonen and get started on forging an Ancient Name for you.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Chanca: Of course I have. Aren't you the ones who saved Kachina and brought her back?

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: Between meditation, advising the chief, and speaking with the Wayob, I actually have a pretty packed schedule, y'know...

assumed.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: If you would like to hear our intel, then find us to the east of the Stadium.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: The Ley Lines were already in a terrible state.

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: Ah, you're already here. I was just about to come get you.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: Kachina, how many people do you have left?

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: They've all made it out!

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: ! Over here! Perfect — our Star Outlander has appeared!

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Citlali: I heard many areas have been attacked by the Abyss, including the Masters of the Night-Wind.

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Citlali: I heard many areas have been attacked by the Abyss, including the Masters of the Night-Wind. I need to head back right away.

assumed.name: Chasca and Chuychu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hehe, this reminds Paimon of when we first met. Except you were the one trying to stop Chasca from doing something dangerous.

assumed.name: Secret Source
assumed.quote: Mavuika: Xilonen, I need you to gather every scholar in Natlan familiar with the Secret Source.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, uh... It's kind of hard to explain. Basically, it's a device from Khaenri'ah that has unbelievable power.

assumed.name: Ancient Name
assumed.quote: Citlali: As for the Ancient Name... Once we handle this crisis, I'll talk to Xilonen right away.

threads.claim: Outlanders cannot receive an Ancient Name because the Night Kingdom records no deeds done by non-Natlanese, even those done in Natlan.
threads.quote: Xilonen: Then those deeds haven't been recorded by the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: Acknowledgment by the Wayob is required before deeds can count, and it is unclear whether one or all six must agree.
threads.quote: Only memories and experiences that have been acknowledged by the Wayob can be used as the basis for an Ancient Name.

threads.claim: There are six heroes, and only some of them have been acknowledged so far.
threads.quote: She mentioned there are six heroes, and that Xilonen is one of four that have already been acknowledged.

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night sleeps and can only be contacted through a trance, and it alone can approve an outlander's Ancient Name.
threads.quote: The Lord of the Night is currently in a deep slumber, and we can only communicate with its consciousness while in a

threads.claim: Citlali reads the Traveler's past and sees experiences beyond what most mortals could dream of.
threads.quote: Those are all things that I could see in you. You've experienced far more than even most mortals could dream of.

threads.claim: Fragments of Night Kingdom souls stuck to the Traveler after their visit, which Citlali removed.
threads.quote: You've just returned from the Night Kingdom, so some fragments of souls were still stuck to your body.

threads.claim: It is unknown whether Ororon joined the Fatui willingly or was coerced.
threads.quote: As of now, we still haven't been able to confirm whether Ororon joined the Fatui voluntarily, or if he was coerced.

threads.claim: Ororon has an incomplete soul that the tribe sees as a bad omen, and a ritual using him as a soul vessel failed.
threads.quote: She also reveals that Ororon is a unique outlier in the tribe, as he has an incomplete soul, something which is taken as a bad omen by the tribe.

threads.claim: Capitano hints at a secret backup plan involving the Gnosis that Mavuika did not reveal.
threads.quote: The Traveler realizes that the backup plan involves the Gnosis, and Capitano states that his plan could be implemented if they reach an agreement.

threads.claim: Mavuika confirms the backup plan would erase the Night Kingdom's history and culture, and she asks the Traveler to keep it secret.
threads.quote: asks if the backup plan was true, which she confirms; but doing so would erase everything from the Night Kingdom, including their history and culture.

threads.claim: Capitano doubts Mavuika's plan will work because the two heroes may not appear and their power may not be enough.
threads.quote: Capitano does not believe Mavuika's plan would be successful, as he is not sure if the two heroes would appear

threads.claim: Capitano proposes rebuilding the Ley Lines to save Natlan, a plan that would affect everyone's memories.
threads.quote: believes that rather than placing a net to stop the damage, the only way to save Natlan would be to reconstruct its Ley Lines.

threads.claim: The Abyss launched a coordinated nation-wide attack on several tribes and outposts at once.
threads.quote: Iansan informs them that the Abyss attacked the Masters of Night-Wind, Children of Echoes, Collective of Plenty and numerous outposts all at once.

threads.claim: Ororon's true reasons for helping The Captain remain hidden, and Citlali demands the truth.
threads.quote: Citlali: Why did you help The Captain? And I want the truth this time!

threads.claim: Ororon admits he aided The Captain willingly, so the claim that the Fatui coerced him was a lie.
threads.quote: Ororon: Because they said they would need my help from there on out.

threads.claim: The Captain promises to reveal his goals and why he distrusts Mavuika, leaving his true aims unresolved.
threads.quote: I will use the opportunity to explain my goals and motivations to you, as well as why I mistrust Mavuika, the Pyro Archon.

threads.claim: The Captain claims Mavuika has a hidden emergency plan with a painful cost that she keeps secret.
threads.quote: But what if I told you she's had another emergency plan all along, the details of which she has chosen to keep hidden from you?

threads.claim: The Captain denies seizing the Gnosis for the Tsaritsa and suggests the Gnosis is tied to the backup plan.
threads.quote: I knew you'd be clever enough to see. That's right — I did not seek to seize the Gnosis for the Tsaritsa.

threads.claim: Mavuika's plan to defeat the Abyss depends on two heroes who have not yet appeared, and its success is doubted.
threads.quote: In order to defeat the Abyss and save Natlan, she still needs two more heroes to appear.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon can hear Citlali's thoughts, possibly because the Traveler has a rare affinity for phlogiston.
threads.quote: Citlali: When I held your hand just now, I could sense that you've got a great affinity for phlogiston. You're extraordinarily gifted.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects part of their soul was forcibly pulled into the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Was my soul forcibly removed from my body just now? That would explain why I couldn't hear Paimon at all.)

threads.claim: The Masters once tried to use Ororon as a vessel to return lost souls to the Night Kingdom, and the ritual failed.
threads.quote: The ceremony would allow lost souls to gather within him.

threads.claim: Ororon feels guilty for surviving the failed ceremony and questions whether Natlan would have been saved had it succeeded.
threads.quote: He knows that, but he still feels guilty.

threads.claim: Damage to the Night Kingdom scatters its souls, which cannot return to the Ley Lines and further weaken both.
threads.quote: When damage occurs to the Night Kingdom, the souls held within disperse and remain adrift, unable to find a way back to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon reveals that the Gnosis can save Natlan but only by sacrificing souls, memories and culture.
threads.quote: Mavuika: I can use the power of the Gnosis to save Natlan, but it comes at a heavy price.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom holds the souls, memories and legends of Natlan, which the Gnosis would consume.
threads.quote: Mavuika: The Night Kingdom not only houses the souls of the dead, but also our memories and legends.

threads.claim: The Captain is a Fatui leader whose motives and allegiance are unexplained, and he is searching for Citlali.
threads.quote: "The Captain": I'm looking for someone who may be known to you. "Citlali" is her name.

threads.claim: The Captain's alternative plan is to rebuild the Ley Lines themselves instead of netting them with the Gnosis.
threads.quote: "The Captain": By reconstructing the Ley Lines themselves.

threads.claim: Ororon senses that the Ley Lines are extremely weak, and the Pyro Archon's plan is in doubt.
threads.quote: Ororon: My soul is more perceptive than others. I can sense that the Ley Lines are extremely weak.

threads.claim: The Fatui are hunting an ancient dragon relic, the Source Mechanism, whose use even Natlan's people do not know.
threads.quote: Chasca: It seems like they're looking for a dragon relic called the "Source Mechanism."

threads.claim: Ororon's soul is fragmented and kept stable by a talisman that needs a gem replacement.
threads.quote: Citlali: Remember how I said Ororon's soul is fragmented? This is the talisman I created to keep it stable.

threads.claim: Citlali's trick copied Ororon's memories onto the old gem, which the party then views as a memory record.
threads.quote: Citlali: He probably suspected that I tampered with it, but here's the catch — the trick is on the bag.

threads.claim: The Captain says Citlali is the legendary Granny Itztli who can talk to the Wayob, which holds the key to Night Kingdom knowledge.
threads.quote: "The Captain": Citlali... is said to be the legendary Granny Itztli, someone capable of communicating with the Wayob, and the Wayob are the key to information on the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: Paimon compares the Ley Line reconstruction to the Loom of Fate, a Khaenri'ah device of great power.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, uh... It's kind of hard to explain. Basically, it's a device from Khaenri'ah that has unbelievable power.

threads.claim: Citlali promises to speak with Xilonen about the Ancient Name once the crisis is handled.
threads.quote: Citlali: As for the Ancient Name... Once we handle this crisis, I'll talk to Xilonen right away.

threads.claim: The party does not know when the final two heroes will appear, leaving the outcome of the plan uncertain.
threads.quote: Kachina: And we still don't know when the final two heroes are going to appear...

threads.claim: The Abyss is attacking several locations at once, and the attacks are increasing in frequency.
threads.quote: Chasca: Yes, and the attacks are increasing in frequency.

introduced.name: Mona
introduced.how: Self-introduction as an astrologist on a mission from her master to retrieve a box
introduced.quote: Mona: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus. But considering that it is most rude to misremember names, I allow others to call me Mona.

introduced.name: Mr. Zhu
introduced.how: Inn owner who lost a jade ring to a slime and offers 20,000 Mora to find it
introduced.quote: Mr. Zhu: Oh, that's not good... that ring was given to me by my mother. But while my back was turned, it was swallowed up by a slime!

introduced.name: Yuhua
introduced.how: Waitress at Wangshu Inn who takes orders and describes the dishes
introduced.quote: Yuhua: Excuse me, what would you like to order?

introduced.name: Huai'an
introduced.how: Wangshu Inn cook who lets the group use the kitchen and gives the Golden Crab recipe
introduced.quote: Huai'an: Hello, how may I help you?

introduced.name: Tyler
introduced.how: Self-described merchant who offers a cart ride but turns out to be a bandit
introduced.quote: Tyler: Oh, my brothers and I are all merchants. We just finished doing business in Liyue, and we're preparing to head back to Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Klee
introduced.how: Young girl who barges in and turns out to be the guardian of the box
introduced.quote: Just then, Klee barges in and greets the Traveler and Paimon.

introduced.name: Goth
introduced.how: Owner of the sealed house who rents it to Mona at a low price
introduced.quote: Oh, I'm Goth, the owner of this house. I passed by the Adventurers' Guild a while back, and Katheryne told me about the matter.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild staff who explains the sealed house and suggests Mona break the seal
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Klee's mother, a friend and rival of Mona's master, skilled in many mystical arts
introduced.quote: Mona: Yes. As well-versed in astrology as she was, my master knew only astrology. Alice, on the other hand, was skilled in a great many other mystical fields.

introduced.name: Mona's master
introduced.how: Unnamed master who sent Mona to retrieve the box and is a rival of Alice
introduced.quote: Mona: I am on a mission from my master to retrieve a certain box from Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Organization the guardian of the box is affiliated with
introduced.quote: Mona states that they are about to meet the guardian - a young woman affiliated with the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild where the Traveler can take commissions in exchange for pay
introduced.quote: Mona: The Adventurers' Guild? Ah, right, you can do commissions for them in exchange for... you know what I mean, don't you?

introduced.name: Stone Gate
introduced.how: Northern route connecting Liyue and Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Now having had their full, Mona tells them to head north to the Stone Gate, as it is the route connecting both Mondstadt and Liyue.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: Restaurant in Liyue where Mona treats the group to a feast
introduced.quote: Mona then states that she will treat the Traveler and Paimon to a feast in gratitude for obtaining the Mora, and suggests to stop by Wangshu Inn to eat.

introduced.name: Golden Crab
introduced.how: Liyue classic dish of crab meat rolled in flour, deep-fried and pan-fried with ginger and garlic
introduced.quote: It's crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep-fried, and then pan-fried together with ginger and garlic.

introduced.name: Elemental Bait
introduced.how: Bait that draws all nearby slimes to one spot
introduced.quote: The Elemental Bait's really strong — it will attract all the slimes in the area.

introduced.name: Astrology
introduced.how: Reads destiny and truth from the stars and can see through lies
introduced.quote: Mona: Lies are worthless before astrology. Destiny and truth are written in the stars.

introduced.name: Hydromancy
introduced.how: Mona's astrology method, using reflections in water to view the starry sky
introduced.quote: Mona: My astrology is based on hydromancy, and as the name suggests, I use the reflections in water bodies to observe the true starry sky.

introduced.name: Fifty-year agreement
introduced.how: Pact Mona's master made with a friend 50 years ago involving a box
introduced.quote: Mona: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago.

introduced.name: Master's diary
introduced.how: A diary belonging to Mona's master from 50 years ago, found in Klee's backpack
introduced.quote: Mona: T—This... So this book, this diary... is that hag's... It's her diary from 50 years ago?!

assumed.name: The Crisis Deepens
assumed.quote: Mona: Does my ability to see through your secrets so easily not evoke any memories?

assumed.name: Meteorites
assumed.quote: As the Traveler and Paimon leave Liyue Harbor, they are greeted by Mona (who they recognize if they had investigated meteorites together).

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Paimon: You remember? The stuff we helped Master Diluc make.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Doesn't that sound like... Lisa?

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Klee: Wow, it's you, Honorary Knight! And Paimon too! You're back!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Mona: Phew. That was tiring, but we're finally in Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Mona's master made a fifty-year agreement with a friend over a box, and its terms are still unfolding.
threads.quote: Mona: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago.

threads.claim: Mona's master and Alice contended in the mystic arts for life without a clear victor.
threads.quote: Mona: My master and her friend contended in the mystic arts all their lives without a clear victor.

threads.claim: Mona's master's rival left Mondstadt and left a successor as the guardian of the box.
threads.quote: Mona: Now, from my predictions, I know that my master's friend has left Mondstadt, leaving her successor as the current guardian of that box.

threads.claim: Alice has gone very far away, and her whereabouts are unexplained.
threads.quote: Klee: That's right! Oh, so you're Mommy's friend! But she's gone very far away...

threads.claim: Mona perceives that the Traveler is not from this world, which the text raises but does not explain.
threads.quote: ???: You're not from this world, are you?

threads.claim: The Traveler's fate is hidden from astrology, which suggests they have a connection to something beyond Teyvat.
threads.quote: Mona: Anything related to you becomes like a fog that even I cannot penetrate.

threads.claim: Mona hints that her astrology could eventually reveal answers about gods and kin.
threads.quote: Mona: Then, I will have answers for you, even regarding such distant and foggy matters as gods and kin.

threads.claim: Mona's master kept a dark secret from her youth in a diary that Klee had been carrying.
threads.quote: Mona: T—This... So this book, this diary... is that hag's... It's her diary from 50 years ago?!

threads.claim: Astrology can see through lies and read the gist of a situation at a glance.
threads.quote: Mona: Though it may take more time to garner the specifics, I can read the gist of a situation at a glance.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: Pyro Archon who sustains the Sacred Flame by sacrificing her own power
introduced.quote: So, until our heroes are ready, I will sacrifice my power to keep it burning.

introduced.name: Kachina
introduced.how: hero who fell in battle against the Abyss and whose Ancient Name is lost in the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Kachina always dreamed of fighting the Abyss, of doing her part to defend Natlan.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: one of the tribes' chosen heroes who volunteers to join the rescue
introduced.quote: Kinich, Iansan and Xilonen, though they now have a fourth with Mualani.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: First of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, who clashes with Mavuika and vows to create new rules for Natlan
introduced.quote: He was a formidable opponent — exactly what I would expect from the First of the Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: organization whose Harbingers, eleven in number, threaten Natlan
introduced.quote: revealed to be Capitano — the first of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers

introduced.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.how: ceremonial artifact tribal chiefs use to communicate with the Wayob and search for Ancient Names
introduced.quote: We call it the Spiritspeaker Stone.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: Masters of the Night-Wind member who created the Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.quote: Citlali of the Masters of the Night-Wind once created an artifact that can be used to communicate with the Wayob.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: group with a technique to extract Ancient Names from Ley Lines
introduced.quote: The Masters of the Night-Wind have a technique that can extract an Ancient Name from the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: name linked to a person that can be used to locate them within the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: If we can find Kachina's Ancient Name, I can use the link between them to pinpoint her position within the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: land of souls that normally only consciousness can enter, though it can be entered in person
introduced.quote: Under normal circumstances, only the consciousness can enter, but there is a way to go there in person.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: not a mindless force but an intelligent enemy whose disasters were tailored to each tribe
introduced.quote: We once thought that the Abyss' desire for destruction was a sort of primal instinct, but its methods are, in truth, marked by intelligence.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: Abyss invasion of Teyvat five hundred years ago that devastated Natlan
introduced.quote: Five hundred years ago, the Abyss invaded Teyvat.

introduced.name: Tenoch
introduced.how: united the tribes during the cataclysm and saved Natlan
introduced.quote: after Tenoch had united the tribes and saved Natlan, the first Pyro Archon laid a foundation of rules

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: foundation of Natlan's resistance against the Abyss, maintained by the Pilgrimage
introduced.quote: The Sacred Flame — the foundation of our resistance against the Abyss.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage
introduced.how: tribal competition that sends teams to fight the Abyss and produces Contending Fire
introduced.quote: If we continue to hold the Pilgrimage and send teams to fight the Abyss, there will likely be more casualties.

introduced.name: Contending Fire
introduced.how: Pyro energy produced through the Pilgrimage that feeds the Sacred Flame
introduced.quote: With fewer participants, the amount of Contending Fire produced will decrease, and the vicious cycle will continue indefinitely.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: item the Fatui Harbingers collect, which drives their goals
introduced.quote: The only purpose that unites them is collecting the Gnoses.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: ceremony in which a fallen hero is revived by the Pyro Archon emerging from the flames with them
introduced.quote: Usually, once the Ode is complete, the Pyro Archon and resurrected person will emerge from the flames

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: tribal spirits that choose name bearers, whose choice signals a tribe's fighting strength
introduced.quote: When the Wayob picked their name bearer, it would be an indication that the tribe was back at fighting strength.

introduced.name: Vichama
introduced.how: experienced guide able to navigate the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: He further refers them to Vichama, who is experienced enough to navigate the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Wayna
introduced.how: Huitztlan figure who gives the group the Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.quote: Wayna is surprised to hear why they need it and complies upon hearing their reason.

introduced.name: Huitztlan tribe
introduced.how: tribe where the group obtains the Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.quote: The group heads to the Huitztlan tribe and Chasca asks Wayna for the stone.

introduced.name: Chuychu
introduced.how: Chasca's younger sister who supports her in entering the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: They return to Wayna, finding Chasca's younger sister, Chuychu.

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: was adopted into Chuychu's family and volunteers to rescue Kachina to atone for failing her
introduced.quote: Wayna explains Chasca's past of being adopted by Chuychu's family to the group, while the sisters argue off to the side over Chasca's decision to venture into the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Mallko
introduced.how: spirit of Vichama's friend who helps the group in the Night Kingdom while his form dissipates
introduced.quote: An unknown entity informs them that they're manifestations of Abyssal power before introducing itself as Mallko, who they recognize as Vichama's friend.

introduced.name: Comonqui
introduced.how: Abyss Lector who watches destruction and disparages the Pyro Archon's power sharing
introduced.quote: an Abyss Lector called Comonqui arrives, having eliminated Mallko's spirit.

introduced.name: Tupac
introduced.how: spectral Wayob-like entity that congratulates Mualani and triggers her memories
introduced.quote: Due to Mualani's actions, a spectral entity called Tupac appears and congratulates her

introduced.name: Tepexpan
introduced.how: crowd member who heckles Kachina's victory and is challenged by Mavuika
introduced.quote: Tepexpan and Tamuin, also present in the crowd, begin to heckle over Kachina's failure

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: tribe whose lands were torn by black winds from the Abyss invasion
introduced.quote: Unrelenting black winds tore across the lands of the Flower-Feather Clan

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: tribe whose territory was overrun by Abyssal sludge during the invasion
introduced.quote: The Children of Echoes' territory was overrun by dangerous sludge surging from underground.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: hospitable group living in the hot springs area, affected by the Abyss
introduced.quote: After spending a short time with the People of the Springs, Paimon remarks on their hospitality

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: highly skilled craftsperson who can forge Ancient Names
introduced.quote: As she is highly skilled, Mavuika is confident Xilonen can find a way to forge an Ancient Name for a non-Natlanese.

introduced.name: Atea's talisman
introduced.how: keepsake Atea sends to Mavuika, carrying fond memories and her strength of will
introduced.quote: Atea was wounded in the fight against the Abyss. She wanted us to give this to you.

introduced.name: Wayna
introduced.how: tribal chief of the Scions of the Canopy who gives the Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.quote: That's Wayna, the tribal chief. Let's head over to him.

introduced.name: Vichama
introduced.how: legendary warrior and scout of the Scions who can guide the Stone
introduced.quote: Vichama — a legendary warrior and scout from our tribe.

introduced.name: Mallko
introduced.how: Vichama's fallen friend, an amazing fighter who died fighting the Abyss years ago
introduced.quote: Mallko was an amazing fighter, capable of knocking out multiple opponents in a single hit, while Vichama excelled at scouting and analyzing the battlefield.

introduced.name: Pisac
introduced.how: Mallko's comrade who died on the same mission, seen in a memory
introduced.quote: Hey, Mallko, got any strength left?

introduced.name: Chuychu
introduced.how: Chasca's younger sister, not related by blood, who often helps the Scions
introduced.quote: Her younger sister, Chuychu's always hanging around our tribe, too.

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: peacekeeper of the Flower-Feather Clan known for resolving tribal conflicts
introduced.quote: Oh, Chasca's a peacekeeper, so she's famous throughout the tribes.

introduced.name: Chasca's upbringing among the Qucusaurs
introduced.how: Chasca was abandoned as a sick child, raised by Qucusaurs, and later adopted by Chuychu's parents
introduced.quote: She was afflicted with a rare disease when she was a child and abandoned in the wild as a result.

introduced.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
introduced.how: a ceremonial stone that links the living world to the Night Kingdom, like an Abyssal Pylon
introduced.quote: it functions almost like an Abyssal Pylon — both connect the Night Kingdom to the living world.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm of concepts where lost Ancient Names drift like fish in a river
introduced.quote: The Night Kingdom is like a river flowing with

introduced.name: Ancient Name fragments
introduced.how: Ancient Names can be conceptualized into fragments that cannot survive long in the real world
introduced.quote: Ancient Name fragments cannot exist in the real world for long.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: the only usual source of Obsidian, needed to store Ancient Names
introduced.quote: Normally, you can only get Obsidian from the Children of Echoes

introduced.name: Pajaten
introduced.how: a merchant who sells Obsidian and explains Vichama's past
introduced.quote: Pajaten: Looking to buy something?

introduced.name: Amauta
introduced.how: a shopkeeper who sells hook-ropes
introduced.quote: Amauta: Anything else I can get you?

introduced.name: Pilgrimage
introduced.how: a contest that determines the strongest person, who then ascends to the divine throne
introduced.quote: By holding the Pilgrimage, we're able to determine the strongest among us, and when that person ascends to the divine throne, their inner flame will awaken.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: the Pyro Archon, shown with her family and past as an ordinary person
introduced.quote: Ah, yes. That's my mother, father, younger sister, and the little Saurians we raised.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: a sports coach and strong warrior of her tribe who also designs nutrition plans
introduced.quote: But, I actually work as a sports coach.

introduced.name: Tenoch
introduced.how: a hero from five hundred years ago who united the six tribes against the Abyss and was exiled before the war
introduced.quote: Ah, that weapon belonged to Tenoch, a hero from five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Kitera
introduced.how: a warrior whose original heavy belt was copied into a lighter version
introduced.quote: So the owner of the original belt, Kitera, commissioned a craftsman to make a copy identical in appearance but far lighter in weight.

introduced.name: Matavaru
introduced.how: a legendary fisherman who fought a corrupted giant fish and gave his tools to Mavuika
introduced.quote: It belongs to a legendary fisherman named Matavaru.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: practitioners of ceremonial tools that help communicate with the Night Kingdom and the Wayob
introduced.quote: No, those belong to the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: a rite that can bring the dead back only if they still hold their Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Ultimately, he perished, and because he had already lost his Ancient Name, the Ode of Resurrection was unable to bring him back.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: grants an Archon knowledge and memory of the land
introduced.quote: In addition, the Sacred Flame will grant them significant knowledge and memory of this land.

introduced.name: Abyssal corrosion
introduced.how: corruption that fuses into internal organs and can never be fully removed
introduced.quote: Once Abyssal corrosion enters the body, a portion will fuse itself to your internal organs.

introduced.name: Dragon-ruled civilization of Natlan
introduced.how: Natlan was once a highly advanced civilization ruled by dragons, before humans rose after their fall
introduced.quote: Natlan was home to an incredibly advanced civilization ruled by dragons.

introduced.name: Yemaya
introduced.how: a Master of the Night-Wind expert who taught Mavuika and passed on tools
introduced.quote: Yemaya is an expert in this field, and she taught me a lot.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: the realm beneath the sky fissure where Kachina is trapped, corrupted by Abyssal power
introduced.quote: Looks like we made it. This is the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: Abyssal power manifests as floating black creatures that are dangerous to the party
introduced.quote: Those are all manifestations of Abyssal power. Be careful.

introduced.name: Mallko
introduced.how: a ghostly friend of Vichama who was lost in the Night Kingdom and now guides the party in an imperfect form
introduced.quote: I'm Vichama's friend, Mallko.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: the six main totem poles represent each tribe's Wayob, with proxy totems extending their consciousness across the realm
introduced.quote: In the Night Kingdom, there are six main totem poles, representing the Wayob of each tribe.

introduced.name: Tupac
introduced.how: a People of the Springs warrior who fought the Abyss five hundred years ago and speaks through Mualani's Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Tupac, a warrior from the People of the Springs. I fought against the Abyss during the invasion five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: a name bestowed by a Wayob that records a bearer's adventures and can carry the memories of past heroes; new ones can be forged
introduced.quote: Possessing an ancient name would mean that your adventures in Natlan are recorded in full.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon's second life
introduced.how: the Pyro Archon sacrificed her life into the Sacred Flame five hundred years ago and was reawakened, explaining her longevity
introduced.quote: Only by dying before my time could I have the chance to wake up again.

introduced.name: Abyssal invasion of Teyvat
introduced.how: five hundred years ago the Abyss invaded all Teyvat nations, and Natlan suffered the worst of it
introduced.quote: Five hundred years ago, all the nations of Teyvat were invaded by the Abyss.

introduced.name: five hundred-year plan
introduced.how: the Archon and tribal heroes devised a five hundred year plan to restore Natlan by reuniting tribes and selecting heroes
introduced.quote: finally came up with a five hundred year-long plan to save Natlan.

introduced.name: Hero selection by Wayob
introduced.how: once a tribe is restored, its Wayob selects a hero to stand beside the Pyro Archon in defense of the nation
introduced.quote: The chosen would then stand by my side in defense of our nation, just like great heroes of old, five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Contending Fire
introduced.how: a power that accumulates in heroes' belongings from battle and can open the boundary between the two worlds when burned
introduced.quote: Over time, they became imbued with a certain amount of Contending Fire from being carried in battle.

introduced.name: hero belongings used as fuel
introduced.how: the items stored in the Weary Inn-area room belonged to past heroes and were burned to open the way out of the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: every item belonged to a hero of Natlan.

introduced.name: Natlan's lack of Ley Lines
introduced.how: Natlan never had stable Ley Lines, which is why it suffered the worst of the invasion
introduced.quote: Unlike the other nations, Natlan never had stable and deep-rooted Ley Lines, so we suffered the worst of the invasion.

introduced.name: Chuychu
introduced.how: Chasca's sister and a doctor who examines the party after the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: I'll make things awkward if I'm around my sister right now.

introduced.name: Hine
introduced.how: a family member of Mavuika who calls her Sis and vows to find a way to meet her across time
introduced.quote: Yeah, mom's right! We'll always believe in you, Sis!

introduced.name: Comonqui
introduced.how: an Abyss enemy who killed Mallko and claims the Pyro Archon's ideals of unity are false
introduced.quote: You may have defeated others of my kind in the past, but underestimate me now, and it will be to your peril.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: the one who will forge a new Ancient Name for the outlander Traveler
introduced.quote: Then I'll reach out to Xilonen right away. She's the one who will forge the Name.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: During the age of Khaenri'ah?

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: You've learned about the concept of Ley Lines during your travels, yes?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: But it sounds like this is about more than the Tsaritsa

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: The team sent out to fight in the Night Warden Wars has returned.

assumed.name: Atea
assumed.quote: Oh, and Atea's snacks were so delicious!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: Looks like I'm just in time.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: Hey, you guys! Sleep well last night?

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: That was the artifact I delivered to the Scions of the Canopy a few days ago.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Mualani: My friend, Kachina, is trapped within the Night Kingdom.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: aren't you from the Flower-Feather Clan, Chasca?

assumed.name: Atea
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, isn't that Atea's talisman?

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: The Pyro Archon said all life within the Night Kingdom eventually becomes one with the sea of souls

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: it functions almost like an Abyssal Pylon

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: I'm sorry, Citlali.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Fatui again! We can't go anywhere without them causing trouble!

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: You're a victor of the Night Warden Wars, a hero of Natlan.

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: The Wayob is being affected by the Abyss!

assumed.name: Tone-Deaf Bard and Holy Lyre
assumed.quote: If only Tone-Deaf Bard was here.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: According to Kinich, it's an important ceremonial artifact

assumed.name: Uthabiti
assumed.quote: It now looks just like the Ancient Name stone of Uthabiti

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: That overflow of energy is probably what trapped Kachina here in the first place.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani!? You made it!

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: The Pyro Archon is supposed to be human.

assumed.name: Ode of Resurrection
assumed.quote: something's wrong with the Ode of Resurrection

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: You're looking for a young girl from the Children of Echoes, right?

assumed.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
assumed.quote: If the Spiritspeaker Stone hadn't become corrupted by the Abyss, we could've done much more.

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: we can finally hold the victory feast and celebrate your team's triumph in the Night Warden Wars.

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: It's a Seelie! The Seelie opened the way for us!

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Victory and defeat are rules, not outcomes.

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: this is most certainly the opportune time to seize the Gnosis...

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: She played an instrumental role in rebuilding the Scions of the Canopy tribe, designing and building many houses.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: I wonder how long before the two final heroes appear, from the Flower-Feather Clan and the Masters of the Night-Wind...

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: If they were allowed to participate in the Pilgrimage

threads.claim: The Abyss may be able to read the memories of the Night Kingdom and plan its attacks with intelligence.
threads.quote: We now believe the Abyss has invaded the Night Kingdom, and has the capacity to read the memories of this land at any given moment.

threads.claim: The Abyss's ultimate goal is to destroy people's faith in the rules of the Ode, not merely to break those rules.
threads.quote: Their ultimate goal isn't to break the rules that make the Ode of Resurrection work.

threads.claim: Kachina's revival failed and her location and Ancient Name are unknown, raising the question of what happened to her.
threads.quote: Mavuika: I could not find Kachina within the Night Kingdom, or locate her Ancient Name.

threads.claim: Kachina is found in the Night Kingdom, explains she was attacked by an Abyssal entity, and returns to her friends.
threads.quote: Kachina appears before the group, initially believing them to be an Abyss trick until she's reassured that they aren't.

threads.claim: The Sacred Flame is dwindling because the Abyss has corroded Pyro energy, and the Pilgrimage is suspended to save strength.
threads.quote: The gradual corrosion caused by the Abyss has resulted in a massive shortage of Pyro energy, and we're currently at the breaking point.

threads.claim: The Wayob chose the Ancient Name bearers, and their destined path will determine how the story ends.
threads.quote: as the Wayob had chosen them and it was up to them to determine how the story would end.

threads.claim: The Traveler appears to be immune to Abyssal contamination, a trait that puzzles the people of Natlan.
threads.quote: Chuychu treats the Natlanese for Abyssal contamination and is fascinated by the Traveler's apparent Abyss immunity

threads.claim: The Captain says Mavuika broke an oath made five centuries ago and that he will create new rules for Natlan.
threads.quote: The Captain: And since the oath made five centuries ago remains unfulfilled

threads.claim: Someone in the Masters of the Night-Wind aided the Fatui Captain, suggesting an internal betrayal.
threads.quote: The power that came to his rescue just now came from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

threads.claim: Mavuika sensed an unusual presence within the Captain that she has yet to understand.
threads.quote: When we exchanged final blows, I sensed an unusual presence within him.

threads.claim: Natlan has less than a year to find the remaining heroes before the nation is destroyed.
threads.quote: they only have less than a year to find the remaining two people before the nation would be destroyed.

threads.claim: The plan to save Natlan began during the cataclysm, as Mualani's memories reveal.
threads.quote: realizes that the plan to save Natlan had begun during the cataclysm.

threads.claim: Comonqui claims the Pyro Archon hoards primordial power and refuses to share it with the people.
threads.quote: claims that the Pyro Archon refuses to share the

threads.claim: Mavuika burned the stored keepsakes, sacrificing their Contending Flame to power herself and save the heroes.
threads.quote: Mavuika reveals that the keepsakes she had shown them before had traces of Contending Flame in them from their previous owners

threads.claim: Xilonen may be able to forge Ancient Names for people who are not Natlanese, such as the Traveler.
threads.quote: As she is highly skilled, Mavuika is confident Xilonen can find a way to forge an Ancient Name for a non-Natlanese.

threads.claim: Entering the Night Kingdom in person is possible but dangerous, since the Night Kingdom and Abyss will resist intruders.
threads.quote: Under normal circumstances, only the consciousness can enter, but there is a way to go there in person.

threads.claim: Atea's talisman holds personal meaning for Mavuika and hints at a bond between them.
threads.quote: Atea was wounded in the fight against the Abyss. She wanted us to give this to you.

threads.claim: Mavuika suspends the Pilgrimage to prevent further casualties while the Kachina matter is investigated.
threads.quote: To prevent further casualties, I have decided to suspend the Pilgrimage until this matter is resolved.

threads.claim: The Spiritspeaker Stone is destroyed by Chasca to end the ritual and protect the group.
threads.quote: this forces Chasca to destroy the stone with her bow to protect everyone

threads.claim: The Spiritspeaker Stone spirals out of control and is destroyed, so the party must face Wayna's displeasure about it.
threads.quote: The only way to stop it was to destroy it.

threads.claim: Ancient Names can be lost forever once they disappear, so a lost name cannot be recovered.
threads.quote: Once your Ancient Name disappears, there's no coming back.

threads.claim: Mallko's Ancient Name cannot be found, so Vichama accepts that his friend is likely gone for good.
threads.quote: I couldn't find Mallko's Ancient Name.

threads.claim: Vichama blames himself for Mallko's death and believes he should have died with him.
threads.quote: I should've died five years ago.

threads.claim: Kachina's Ancient Name is recovered, but she remains trapped and weakened in the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: The Wayob saved me, even though its power is weakening

threads.claim: The Wayob is being weakened by the Abyss, which threatens the Night Kingdom's balance.
threads.quote: The Wayob is being affected by the Abyss!

threads.claim: Abyssal corrosion can fuse into the body and can never be fully eradicated.
threads.quote: Once Abyssal corrosion enters the body, a portion will fuse itself to your internal organs.

threads.claim: Chasca's childhood among the Qucusaurs left a seed of conflict in her that shaped her reputation as a fighter.
threads.quote: That strength of will pushed her to survive, but it also planted a seed of

threads.claim: Chasca has a condition that can make her lose control in dangerous situations, which her sister worries about.
threads.quote: If you're going to waltz into a dangerous situation where you could lose control at any moment

threads.claim: Natlan's ruins hint at an ancient dragon-ruled civilization that predates the human tribes.
threads.quote: Natlan was home to an incredibly advanced civilization ruled by dragons.

threads.claim: Mavuika has lost her power, and the Fatui might exploit this if they find out.
threads.quote: Now that I've lost my power, I won't be able to provide much practical support

threads.claim: The Fatui are active in Natlan and are seen as causing trouble for the tribes.
threads.quote: The Fatui again! We can't go anywhere without them causing trouble!

threads.claim: Mavuika suggests that past, present, and future may all exist at once, not as a straight line.
threads.quote: But, there's also a different theory, one that I believe to be closer to the truth.

threads.claim: The first Pyro Archon was a mortal with no power who created the rules of Natlan after ascending.
threads.quote: At first, he was a mortal man with no special power.

threads.claim: Tenoch was exiled before the Abyss war, and he accepted the punishment as deserved.
threads.quote: That's because even before the disaster with the Abyss broke out, he had already been exiled.

threads.claim: A voice from the Abyss whispers to the party and tells Kachina to abandon the Wayob, suggesting it has hostile intent.
threads.quote: Journey... Lies...

threads.claim: The Traveler appears completely immune to Abyssal power, and no one knows why, though Mavuika expects it to matter later.
threads.quote: It's like you're completely immune to its power.

threads.claim: Natlan may be destroyed in less than a year, and the threat is the result of an Abyss invasion five hundred years ago.
threads.quote: Natlan is on the verge of destruction.

threads.claim: Two or three more heroes are still needed for the plan, and their identities remain hidden.
threads.quote: We are still two heroes short.

threads.claim: Contaminated totem proxies can cause souls to be lost in the Night Kingdom, and the Wayob's communication has been blocked.
threads.quote: But if a proxy were to become severely contaminated, then a soul could become lost within the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon's five hundred-year plan to save Natlan is revealed to involve the heroes, their Ancient Names, and Mavuika's own sacrifice.
threads.quote: finally came up with a five hundred year-long plan to save Natlan.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon's longevity is explained as a second life gained by dying and awakening through the Sacred Flame.
threads.quote: Only by dying before my time could I have the chance to wake up again.

threads.claim: The stored hero items were burned to release Contending Fire and open the boundary between the two worlds.
threads.quote: By burning those items, I was able to activate the Contending Fire stored within them to open the boundary between the two worlds.

threads.claim: Comonqui accuses the Pyro Archon of creating ideals like pride and friendship out of selfishness to hoard power.
threads.quote: The Pyro Archon created those grandiose ideals out of pure selfishness!

threads.claim: Someone plans to seize the Gnosis while the Pyro Archon is weakened, and The Captain hints at a hidden listener.
threads.quote: this is most certainly the opportune time to seize the Gnosis...

threads.claim: Chuychu deliberately picked a fight with Chasca so Chasca would vent her Abyss-fueled impulse on her instead of the party.
threads.quote: picking that fight with her before you left. But, I did it for a reason.

threads.claim: Ancient Names carry the memories of past heroes, and the Traveler will be granted a new Name, a first for an outlander.
threads.quote: We've never forged an Ancient Name for an outlander before, but I trust she'll find a way.

introduced.name: Blazing Heart

introduced.quote: This is the hall of music, and I'm merely its gatekeeper.

introduced.name: Frozen Soul

introduced.quote: Who are you, and what brings you to me?

introduced.how: an alchemist from Mondstadt who visited the island and left notes about its musical design
introduced.quote: He's one of our friends from Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Glacial Spring Water

introduced.quote: With one sip of that, anyone could sing the most beautiful song

introduced.name: giant musical instrument (island chain)
introduced.how: the hollowed mountains resonate with changing water levels and are tuned to play music together at high tide
introduced.quote: the various mountains here have been hollowed out such that changes in their internal water levels will cause them to resound.

introduced.name: water veins
introduced.how: underground water channels linked to plants that carry the island's music system and guide the way to the spring
introduced.quote: According to that flower, the water vein is related to the plants, and the plants will lead us to that spring.

introduced.name: Xinyan's family disapproval
introduced.how: Xinyan's mother opposed her singing dreams and she faced criticism from family and Liyue residents
introduced.quote: Xinyan's own mother had not supported her dreams of becoming a singer

introduced.quote: Mona performs a divination and finds an energy flow leading to Twinning Isle.

introduced.name: Fatui camp
