introduced.quote: The group heads to the island to the north, but finds the Fatui camp completely empty and the strange machine abandoned.

introduced.name: Oz
introduced.how: Fischl's attendant who calls himself her loyal eyes and never leaves her side
introduced.quote: I am your loyal attendant, your eyes, and I will never leave your side.

assumed.name: Kazuha's mirage
assumed.quote: Much like in Kazuha's mirage, the mirage in the hall of music touches on many parts of Xinyan's past

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Mona reveals that, like Kazuha and the Traveler, she was aware of the Fatui presence on the Archipelago

assumed.name: Immernachtreich
assumed.quote: What happened to coming here to restore the glory of the Immernachtreich?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: She said she had some other work to do for the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Xiangling and Yun Jin
assumed.quote: When I entered the room, I found Xiangling and Yun Jin, two of my best friends!

assumed.name: Yun Jin
assumed.quote: When I entered the room, I found Xiangling and Yun Jin, two of my best friends!

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Beidou needs to do something today, so she's asked me to bring some gifts along from her, for you.

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Guoba pulls pranks on me all the time, too.

assumed.name: scryglass
assumed.quote: Ugh... my scryglass is getting clearer, but I still can't see much...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: I think we've arrived at a mountain near Liyue.

assumed.name: squirrel and boat from yesterday
assumed.quote: So did the squirrel from yesterday.

assumed.name: rock garden in the bonsai
assumed.quote: When I touched the rock garden in the bonsai yesterday, we were all transported to another space.

threads.claim: Albedo's note suggests an entire island chain was built as a musical instrument by an unknown designer.
threads.quote: I have never encountered the use of mountains, let alone an entire island chain, as a musical instrument of titanic proportions.

threads.claim: Frozen Soul confirms that the whole island is a giant musical instrument.
threads.quote: This is indeed music. In fact, this whole island is a giant musical instrument.

threads.claim: The man who transformed the island into an instrument long ago is unknown, yet considered one of Teyvat's greatest musicians.
threads.quote: No one knows the name or appearance of the man who transformed this island into a giant musical instrument so many years ago

threads.claim: The strange Fatui machine may be connected to the mirages and could be the cause of hallucinations.
threads.quote: This machine must have something to do with the mirages.

threads.claim: The Fatui at the camp have vanished while their machine remains, and energy is converging toward Twinning Isle.
threads.quote: there are still signs of the camp, and the machine is still here, but all the people have vanished.

threads.claim: Mona senses energy converging into physical form, pointing toward Twinning Isle.
threads.quote: this time, I can sense some sort of energy converging and taking physical form.

threads.claim: Fischl's mirage may hide secrets she does not want anyone to know.
threads.quote: Maybe her mirage conceals some secrets that she doesn't want anyone to know about.

threads.claim: Fischl appears to be struggling with an internal conflict that makes her act oddly.
threads.quote: it seems like she's struggling with some internal conflict.

threads.claim: Fischl says the advent of the Immernachtreich is imminent and that she must prepare a consecration.
threads.quote: The advent of the Immernachtreich is imminent, and I still need to prepare for the consecration.

threads.claim: Fischl and Oz also sense the mirage, suggesting the mirages are linked to Fischl.
threads.quote: if Fischl and Oz can also sense something, then our suspicions are likely to be right

threads.claim: Xinyan's family rejects her dream of singing, and she has long faced disapproval in Liyue.
threads.quote: Xinyan, we're not singers in this family, none of us are.

threads.claim: Xinyan makes a birthday wish to perform with someone completely unexpected, which sets the plot in motion.
threads.quote: Xinyan makes a birthday wish

threads.claim: Xinyan's wish comes true when she performs a duet with the island's original musician.
threads.quote: And now I can say my wish has come true.

threads.claim: Frozen Soul presents music as the force that keeps life flourishing in the world.
threads.quote: As long as there is music, life will continue to flourish in this world.

introduced.name: Elynas
introduced.how: A ghostly Melusine who is the giant body's consciousness and calls the Melusines her children
introduced.quote: Yes. That's my name. Beautiful, isn't it? I love it.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: A man using Abyss power to reverse crystallization, collecting blood for an unclear plan
introduced.quote: Oh, please, do not lump me in with those benighted primitives.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: A group that seeks power, which Jakob says only a few can use and rejects as oppressive
introduced.quote: They are no different from those oppressors — the power they seek is but a tool that only a few can use.

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: An artist who speaks with Elynas and is her child, able to paint with her blood
introduced.quote: Only that child who loves painting still speaks to me, and she even brought her friends — that's how I came to meet you.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: Elynas's children, created as new life from her wounds
introduced.quote: I love them very much, for they are, one and all, my lovely children.

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: A robot, Prototype 4ACV07, built to protect and accompany Mary-Ann
introduced.quote: I am Prototype 4ACV07, designed by *garbled mechanical noises* to accompany and protect my master, Ms. Mary-Ann.

introduced.name: Mary-Ann
introduced.how: Seymour's master, whom he was built to protect and who is now missing
introduced.quote: Ms. Mary-Ann was my master

introduced.name: contamination index
introduced.how: A measure of how poisonous the local environment is to humans
introduced.quote: The local contamination index is now over ten times the human body's endurance threshold.

introduced.name: Elynas's blood paint
introduced.how: Paint made from Elynas's blood, used to make a painting that delivers her message
introduced.quote: That's why I asked Mamere to use my blood to create a painting and give it to you.

introduced.name: Elynas's cells
introduced.how: Cells from Elynas that defend her body and her children, and can attack intruders
introduced.quote: They can help to drive harmful things away from my body and protect my children.

introduced.name: realm of beasts
introduced.how: A place where monsters come from, which Jakob's arrays temporarily opened
introduced.quote: the arrays I activated in those ruins to reverse the crystallization would indeed have temporarily opened the way into the realm of beasts

introduced.name: Elynas's explosion
introduced.how: A past explosion inside Elynas's body that killed many people and metal animals
introduced.quote: In the end, someone triggered an explosion that caused a terrible shockwave.

assumed.name: Marechaussee Hunters
assumed.quote: This would've allowed the plan to go through without alerting the Marechaussee Hunters.

assumed.name: Institute of Natural Philosophy
assumed.quote: the book in the Institute of Natural Philosophy

assumed.name: Mary-Ann
assumed.quote: You were unable to defend Mary-Ann then

assumed.name: prisms
assumed.quote: please activate the prisms to clear them out.

assumed.name: crystallization
assumed.quote: I merely used the power of the Abyss to reverse the crystallization process.

assumed.name: other Melusines
assumed.quote: Why did you have to attack the other Melusines?

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
assumed.quote: Seymour mentioned this place called the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, right?

assumed.name: Breacher Primus
assumed.quote: It's... a Breacher Primus!?

assumed.name: Elynas as Father
assumed.quote: ...Father?

threads.claim: Jakob hints that a foretold moment set by a world-formula is approaching, leaving little time.
threads.quote: There is little time left.

threads.claim: Jakob hints that a greater disaster than the current blood-filled scene is coming.
threads.quote: If I told you that a greater disaster than that will come one day, how would you react?

threads.claim: Jakob refers to an appointed time whose nature remains unexplained.
threads.quote: The appointed time is coming, and I have enough blood to use.

threads.claim: Jakob's group claims to seek liberation of the will and equality, but its aims remain unclear.
threads.quote: Just as my friend said, those who lack weakness of consciousness shall not be subdued either by gods or death.

threads.claim: Elynas says she floated in cosmic darkness before she was born.
threads.quote: Before I was born, I floated in the cosmic darkness.

threads.claim: Elynas says her Mother gave her life and a name, and Mother's identity is left open.
threads.quote: Mother is the most wonderful person in this world.

threads.claim: Elynas's heart was stopped and restarted by Jakob and the Traveler, and she chose to stop it again to protect her children.
threads.quote: Thank you, , for stopping my heart.

threads.claim: Elynas says things she found joyful were terrifying to others, and she regrets it.
threads.quote: But I realized at last that the things I found fun and joyous were terrifying to others.

threads.claim: Elynas explains that her blood-made painting was a way to deliver her message to the Traveler.
threads.quote: That's why I asked Mamere to use my blood to create a painting and give it to you.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann's present location is unknown, leaving her fate an open question.
threads.quote: I cannot ascertain Ms. Mary-Ann's present location, either.

threads.claim: Seymour's memories are damaged, so he does not know where the Narzissenkreuz Ordo is.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, some of my memories remain damaged, so I do not presently know where the Narzissenkreuz Ordo that I must reach is, precisely.

threads.claim: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo is a place the party must find, and its location and entrance are unclear.
threads.quote: Seymour mentioned this place called the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, right?

threads.claim: The Traveler hears a voice tied to red flashes, and Mamere seems to answer a Father the others cannot hear.
threads.quote: The Traveler hears the sound that often accompanies the red flashes

threads.claim: Elynas says the Traveler did not fear her blood, which links them to her consciousness.
threads.quote: You are the second person I have met who did not fear my blood.

threads.claim: Jakob asks who the Traveler really is, and the Traveler refuses to answer.
threads.quote: Could you tell me who you are... exactly?

threads.claim: The blood-filled environment is dangerously contaminated, and its cause remains open.
threads.quote: The local contamination index is now over ten times the human body's endurance threshold.

threads.claim: Seymour's note implies record space collation affects strange recurring issues in the area.
threads.quote: Note: Regular record space collation can decrease the frequency of such issues effectively.

introduced.how: self-introduced literature enthusiast searching for volume six of a novel series
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Apologies my liege, where are my manners? My name is Xingqiu, a humble literature enthusiast who happened to be passing by.

introduced.how: a regional travel guide book series whose Liyue volume the Traveler seeks
introduced.quote: Paimon: Should we ask here if they have a copy of the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide? It's super-duper interesting!

introduced.how: a martial arts novel series that defined its genre, with a rare original sixth volume

introduced.how: thug working for Gentry who threatens Chang and later attacks with Fatui backing
introduced.quote: Before Xingqiu can request to borrow the book, Changhu enters the scene.

introduced.how: an old martial brotherhood in decline that Xingqiu belongs to
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: My liege, I am but one who comes to the aid of this gentleman in his moment of need. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the Guhua Clan.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: an elemental power Xingqiu carries as a pendant, which he tries to avoid using
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Yes, though I try to avoid using it. I dislike the unfair advantage it gives me against my opponents.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: an outside power that backs Gentry's dealings and supplies armed agents
introduced.quote: Changhu: But you picked the wrong time, you little punk! I brought the Fatui to back me up.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a major Liyue commerce guild that oversees much local business
introduced.quote: Paimon: Since we got to Liyue, Paimon keeps hearing people mention it. Seems they oversee a lot of business that goes on around here.

introduced.name: Liuli Pavilion
introduced.how: a guild reception hall with an ocean view where visitors are hosted
introduced.quote: Xu: Please take a seat here in Liuli Pavilion, where you may take some light refreshments while enjoying the ocean view.

introduced.name: Xu
introduced.how: Feiyun Commerce Guild staffer who can decipher the letter and offers help
introduced.quote: At the Feiyun Commerce Guild, the Traveler and Paimon speak with Xu, who deciphers Xingqiu's letter and agrees to help.

introduced.name: Javert
introduced.how: Fatui agent who places an order with Gentry for Cor Lapis
introduced.quote: The agent, Javert, placed an order with Gentry, who hopes to procure the necessary Cor Lapis cheaply from Chang the Ninth.

introduced.name: Xinyue Kiosk
introduced.how: a venue where Gentry meets a special client
introduced.quote: With the use of some threats, they learn that Gentry is meeting a special client at Xinyue Kiosk.

introduced.name: Xingqiu's heir identity
introduced.how: Xingqiu revealed as second son and heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild manager
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Indeed, my liege. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the Guhua Clan and second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild manager, and I make no secret of it.

introduced.name: The Chasm (Subregion)
introduced.how: an area that was sealed off, cutting into the family mining business
introduced.quote: Chang the Ninth: After the Chasm was sealed off, the family mining business started going south.

introduced.name: Sturdy Wu
introduced.how: nervous guard at Gentry's estate who guards entry
introduced.quote: Sturdy Wu: Who goes there?

introduced.name: Feiyun bookmark
introduced.how: a bookmark bearing the Feiyun symbol that falls from the returned book
introduced.quote: (A bookmark bearing the Feiyun symbol falls out of the book...)

assumed.name: Cor Lapis
assumed.quote: Xu: Since Gentry Maocai's business has to do with Cor Lapis, we simply need to buy up all the stock there is in Liyue.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wow, so many Mora! ...With cash like this, Paimon could rent out Liuli Pavilion and eat there for a whole month!

assumed.name: Lord of Geo
assumed.quote: Sturdy Wu: Th—Thank you, thank you! May your business forever be blessed by the Lord of Geo!

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace
assumed.quote: Let us meet at Yujing Terrace in Liyue Harbor in a bit.

threads.claim: The Fatui may be secretly involved in Gentry's purchase of Cor Lapis.
threads.quote: Due to the mage's presence, the Traveler worries that the Fatui are somehow involved in the purchase.

threads.claim: The Fatui agent offers support to Gentry's transaction while pressing him to deliver on time.
threads.quote: Agent: We are willing to lend a certain degree of support to this transaction.

threads.claim: The Fatui agent disowns Gentry's excesses, confirming their ties are limited to business matters.
threads.quote: Agent: Might I remind you that the Fatui's relationship with you extends to business matters only!

threads.claim: Xingqiu may be hiding a more important identity than the book-loving wanderer he presents.
threads.quote: Chang the Ninth: (That little rascal... surely isn't...)

threads.claim: Xingqiu is revealed to be the Feiyun Commerce Guild heir and the second son of its manager.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: Indeed, my liege. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the Guhua Clan and second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild manager, and I make no secret of it.

threads.claim: The Guhua Clan is considered a fallen brotherhood whose reputation has collapsed.
threads.quote: Changhu: There was me thinking that the last granddads of Guhua had keeled over and died by now.

threads.claim: The Guhua art was once esteemed but has faded, and a vicious cycle keeps young talent away.
threads.quote: Chang the Ninth: Actually, the art is centuries old, and was once held in high esteem. But now it has faded beyond recognition.

threads.claim: The original sixth volume of Legend of the Shattered Halberd is extremely rare and was never pawned.
threads.quote: Chang the Ninth: Barely any copies of the first edition were ever printed.

threads.claim: Xingqiu finds the sixth volume so moving that he struggles to express it.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: The way the story develops across the first five volumes — nothing short of exemplary. But the sixth volume... words fail me.

threads.claim: Xingqiu's Vision is hidden as an ordinary pendant and its nature is revealed in battle.
threads.quote: Changhu: I thought that was just a regular pendant you were wearing, not a Vision!

introduced.name: Colter
introduced.how: Former Spina di Rosula member just released from prison; old friend of Melus who served on early missions
introduced.quote: Ah, let me introduce you. This is Colter, another of Spina di Rosula's members.

introduced.name: Romeuf
introduced.how: Leader of a splinter faction that left Spina di Rosula over aquabus funding and now bears a grudge
introduced.quote: Romeuf was the leader of the faction that thought such a vast sum of Mora would be better spent improving the town of Poisson.

introduced.name: Martinat
introduced.how: Leader of Romeuf's men who tailed Navia and openly sought revenge on Spina di Rosula
introduced.quote: We... were looking to get vegeance on Spina di Rosula.

introduced.name: Confrerie of Cabriere
introduced.how: Organization Marcel worked for; now dissolved after his plot was exposed, along with its Sinthe network
introduced.quote: The good news is that the Confrerie of Cabriere is no more.

introduced.name: Marcel (Fontaine)
introduced.how: Former Confrerie figure who plotted to kidnap and dissolve Navia for insane research; exposed
introduced.quote: It's unconscionable to have received all that, and yet still plot to kidnap and dissolve you for his insane research.

introduced.name: Clementine
introduced.how: Navia's late mother, cheerful and a peacekeeping mediator in the Spina; died in childbirth
introduced.quote: While my papa was stiff like a board, my mother was supposedly super cheerful and funny.

introduced.name: Clementine Line
introduced.how: One of three aquabus lines, named after Navia's mother; the three lines are named for Navia's family
introduced.quote: The three aquabus lines are all named after people in your family, right?

introduced.name: Aquabus
introduced.how: Spina-funded boat transit network with no stop near Poisson, so the Spina uses its own boats there
introduced.quote: The aquabus doesn't have a station near Poisson, so we'll use one of the Spina's boats.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Business group Navia now presides over as President; once run by her father Callas
introduced.quote: I am the current President of Spina di Rosula.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: Law enforcement body that arrests and prosecutes offenders
introduced.quote: There won't be any room for negotiation once the Maison Gardiennage gets involved.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: Prison located underwater, where Colter served his sentence
introduced.quote: I dreamed about it every time I had to get a Welfare Meal down there underneath the sea!

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: Town being rebuilt by Spina di Rosula after the flood of the Primordial Sea
introduced.quote: Navia, who is busy overseeing Poisson's reconstruction from the flood of the Primordial Sea.

introduced.name: Primordial Sea flood
introduced.how: Flood that submerged Fontaine and devastated Poisson before the water receded
introduced.quote: Well, I know that Fontaine got flooded, but then the water levels miraculously receded.

introduced.name: Aquabus funding dispute
introduced.how: Major internal Spina dispute over funding aquabus lines that led Romeuf to split off
introduced.quote: there was once a major internal dispute regarding funding the construction of the aquabus lines.

introduced.name: Deaths of Melus and Silver
introduced.how: Melus and Silver died protecting Navia during the flood, along with Melissa and others
introduced.quote: They lost their lives keeping me safe during the flood.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Navia's organization whose duty is to protect everyone, including townspeople who are not official members
introduced.quote: It's the Spina's responsibility to protect everyone as well.

introduced.name: File:Yesterday's Tears, Tomorrow's Light Uniform Item.png
introduced.how: a Spina di Rosula uniform given as a promise that Adele can join once she is old enough
introduced.quote: It's a gift for future you. When you first told me that you were interested in joining the Spina, I was overjoyed.

introduced.name: Adele
introduced.how: a young girl, Coralie's daughter, who wants to join the Spina
introduced.quote: Coralie: Everyone... I'm really grateful that you remembered my daughter's wish, and took it seriously.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: Navia's father, who is dead and was part of the Spina
introduced.quote: Navia: Papa, Mother, and... me...

introduced.name: Clementine
introduced.how: Navia's mother, dead, after whom the Clementine Line is named
introduced.quote: Navia: A name is a way to etch a memory onto the world. Losing the line that bears her name, that I can see every day, would be like losing my mother all over again.

introduced.name: Clementine Line
introduced.how: an aquabus line that runs down the hill above Poisson, named after Clementine
introduced.quote: Navia: If they manage to blow up the aquabus line, all that rubble will come crashing down the hill and straight into Poisson!

introduced.name: aquabus project
introduced.how: a major Fontaine-wide transit project whose construction caused disputes in the Spina
introduced.quote: Navia: The aquabus project was a monumental project that stood to benefit all of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: an authority that takes captured infiltrators into custody
introduced.quote: Florent: Boss, we managed to catch all the infiltrators in the town. The Maison Gardiennage is taking them away as well.

introduced.name: Strangely-Shaped Key
introduced.how: a key that fits a strangely shaped hole in the explosives control mechanism
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? There's a strangely shaped hole here. What is it for?

introduced.name: File:Yesterday's Tears Tomorrow's Light Statue.png
introduced.how: a statue of Callas, Clementine and Navia that the townspeople commissioned as a gift
introduced.quote: Florent: We designed the look for Ms. Clementine based on old Kamera records, as well as personal recollections from the members of the Spina.

assumed.name: Melus
assumed.quote: *sigh* Melus and Silver used to take care of tasks like this.

assumed.name: Silver
assumed.quote: *sigh* Melus and Silver used to take care of tasks like this.

assumed.name: Florent
assumed.quote: Oh hey! Fancy seeing you again, Florent!

assumed.name: Adele
assumed.quote: She was the one that we met while investigating Mr. Callas' case, right?

assumed.name: Callas
assumed.quote: Ugh, and with Papa's stubbornness, I can definitely imagine how it must have gone down...

assumed.name: Fleuve Cendre
assumed.quote: Do we have to stay in the Fleuve Cendre again?

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Florent: Boss, there's no time for this! Stop hesitating and get out of here before you get buried!

assumed.name: Florent
assumed.quote: Florent: Got it, Boss. I'm on it.

assumed.name: Jacques
assumed.quote: Coralie: Oh, it's you two! It has been a while indeed. Thank you so much for your help on Jacques' case.

assumed.name: Silver
assumed.quote: Colter: Clementine died because of you, Callas died because of you, Melus and Silver died because of you... and so many more, dead! Everyone dead, all because of you!

assumed.name: Sinthe business
assumed.quote: Sandino: Even though Boss is still young, we've all seen the work she's put in regarding the whole Sinthe business and the rebuilding of Poisson.

assumed.name: Poisson
assumed.quote: Navia: It's the least we could do. As long as you live in Poisson, even if you're not an official member, you're still part of the family.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Coralie: I've heard that you also helped save all of Fontaine. You're truly just like the great heroes of legend.

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Florent: We designed the look for Ms. Clementine based on old Kamera records, as well as personal recollections from the members of the Spina.

assumed.name: Thierry
assumed.quote: Esmond: I heard from Thierry that even they're your enemies now, they were once a part of Spina di Rosula.

assumed.name: Callas Line
assumed.quote: Navia: , I was actually really scared, you know. I mean, even the Callas Line won't be getting rebuilt anytime soon...

threads.claim: Romeuf and his followers remain at large with unknown whereabouts and a motive for revenge against Navia.
threads.quote: Even though Marcel's faction has been dissolved, we still don't know anything about Romeuf's whereabouts.

threads.claim: The tailing group is revealed as Romeuf's men, confirming the threat is real.
threads.quote: Get revenge? Wait... You're not Romeuf's followers, are you?

threads.claim: Romeuf and his followers are arrested by the Maison Gardiennage as they try to bomb Poisson.
threads.quote: Fortunately, Navia arrives and stops the attack, just as the Maison Gardiennage arrive and apprehend Romeuf and his followers.

threads.claim: Marcel may have been plotting with outside rebels while working at the Confrerie of Cabriere.
threads.quote: But looking at it now, it was probably another one of Marcel's plots while he worked at the Confrerie of Cabriere.

threads.claim: The Confrerie of Cabriere and its Sinthe network are dissolved after Marcel's plot is exposed.
threads.quote: The good news is that the Confrerie of Cabriere is no more.

threads.claim: Someone unseen seems to be following the group, raising doubt about what the Traveler heard.
threads.quote: (I thought I heard something just now. Was it just some small critter?)

threads.claim: The tailers are revealed to be Romeuf's men who wanted to get revenge on Spina di Rosula.
threads.quote: We... were looking to get vegeance on Spina di Rosula.

threads.claim: Romeuf's faction believed Clementine lost her impartiality when pregnant with Navia, a reason for their hostility.
threads.quote: They believed that... Ms. Clementine lost her ability to serve as an impartial mediator when she became pregnant with Callas' child.

threads.claim: Silver taught that names etch memories into the world and give objects new meaning.
threads.quote: Silver once said that a name is a kind of inscription — a way to etch a memory into the world.

threads.claim: Melus, Silver, and Melissa died in the flood, which Colter struggles to accept.
threads.quote: They lost their lives keeping me safe during the flood.

threads.claim: Poisson has no aquabus line despite the Spina funding three lines, which Paimon finds strange.
threads.quote: If you provided the Mora to build the lines, then why isn't there even a dedicated line to Poisson?

threads.claim: Navia refuses to inherit her father's grudges and seeks reconciliation rather than revenge.
threads.quote: I don't want to inherit my father's grudges, too.

threads.claim: The explosives are disabled and the captured infiltrators are taken into custody, ending the immediate threat.
threads.quote: Florent: Boss, we managed to catch all the infiltrators in the town. The Maison Gardiennage is taking them away as well.

threads.claim: Colter blames Navia for the ruin of the Spina and Poisson and swore to kill her.
threads.quote: Colter: Romeuf has lost his patience. I didn't have to be here today, you know, but I swore that I'd kill you, even if it meant being buried with you in the rubble.

threads.claim: Colter reveals that Romeuf promised to leave Poisson alone if Colter killed Navia.
threads.quote: Colter: Romeuf promised me that he would leave Poisson alone if I could just take you out.

threads.claim: Navia dismisses Colter from the Spina but invites him to visit Poisson again after his discharge.
threads.quote: Navia: But once you're discharged from the Fortress again, you're welcome to pay another visit to Poisson.

threads.claim: Colter blames Navia for the deaths of her parents, Melus and Silver, and the decline of the Spina.
threads.quote: Colter: Clementine died because of you, Callas died because of you, Melus and Silver died because of you... and so many more, dead! Everyone dead, all because of you!

threads.claim: Navia privately doubts whether the townspeople's support and kindness are genuine.
threads.quote: Navia: (But is that really why they support me? Is their kindness... real?)

threads.claim: Navia admits she has discovered she is not as strong as she thought and asks the Traveler whether they see her as a partner.
threads.quote: Navia: I used to think I'd never doubt myself, but you could say I've discovered that I'm not as strong as I thought I was.

threads.claim: Florent says the town supports Navia for who she is, not for the glory days, which answers her doubt.
threads.quote: Florent: That we support you and believe in you wholeheartedly. I believe everyone's here for you, not the glory days.

threads.claim: The aquabus project caused a huge fallout between Melus and Colter and split the Spina.
threads.quote: Colter: Back then, because of that aquabus, we had a huge fallout.

threads.claim: Navia suggests Clementine stayed out of the aquabus dispute because the project benefited all of Fontaine.
threads.quote: Navia: I think that's probably why she didn't step in to mediate, or oppose the building of the lines.

introduced.name: Starsnatcher
introduced.how: A masked man who calls himself an adeptus, the Master of Stars, and is revealed as a fraud
introduced.quote: One descended from one's mountain abode to cleanse the world of evil, whereupon fate saw fit that our paths should cross.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Powerful beings whose duty is to cleanse the world of evil
introduced.quote: Cleansing the world of evil is the duty of the adepti.

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: Known as the Vigilant Yaksha and Conqueror of Demons, the last surviving yaksha
introduced.quote: He is the Vigilant Yaksha.

introduced.name: Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti
introduced.how: A book telling the ancient story of the yakshas and their tragic fate
introduced.quote: This is the one! Let's see what it's about, shall we?

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: The ruler who summoned the yakshas to fight demons in ancient Liyue
introduced.quote: Then, Rex Lapis summoned the yakshas to vanquish the demons.

introduced.name: Yakshas
introduced.how: Adepti who fought demons for Rex Lapis and were ruined by karma
introduced.quote: Of the five foremost yakshas, death came to three, while the fourth vanished without a trace.

introduced.name: Sigil of Permission
introduced.how: An adepti keepsake that Starsnatcher used to exorcise demons
introduced.quote: That fake adeptus has a Sigil of Permission. It's what he uses to exorcise demons!

introduced.name: Bane of All Evil
introduced.how: A ritual of Xiao's that cleanses a cavern of karma and demonic influence
introduced.quote: I will use the ritual known as the Bane of All Evil to relieve this place of its karma.

introduced.name: Dream Trawler
introduced.how: An adepti art that separates the soul from the body and can call forth others' spirits
introduced.quote: I possess an art called Dream Trawler.

introduced.name: Pervases
introduced.how: A former junior yaksha, now a shrine protector and ghostly statue who died a thousand years ago
introduced.quote: I was once a junior in the order of the yakshas, bestowed with the name Pervases by Rex Lapis himself.

introduced.name: Mortal Lingering
introduced.how: An adepti art that creates illusions and summons spirits of the dead
introduced.quote: What you witnessed earlier was an illusion, created by the adepti art known as Mortal Lingering.

introduced.name: Censer
introduced.how: A ritual vessel for incense that is also the centerpiece of the Dream Trawler art
introduced.quote: Not only is this censer used to place incense in reverence to the gods, but it is also used as the centerpiece of the Dream Trawler adepti art.

introduced.name: Mist Flower
introduced.how: A plant once used in adepti arts to lower the ambient temperature
introduced.quote: This was once used in adepti arts to lower the ambient temperature.

introduced.name: Grilled Ticker Fish
introduced.how: A dish that was Pervases' favorite and his final wish to taste again
introduced.quote: If only I could taste some authentic Grilled Ticker Fish once more...

introduced.name: Wanwen Bookhouse
introduced.how: A bookhouse in Liyue that sells books and cookbooks
introduced.quote: Why don't we head over to Wanwen Bookhouse and see if they've got any new recipes in?

introduced.name: Verr Goldet
introduced.how: The innkeeper at Wangshu Inn who reports Starsnatcher checked out
introduced.quote: Verr Goldet: He signed in here under the name Wang Ping'an.

introduced.name: Xue Wuliang
introduced.how: A senior adeptus known as Liangzi, quoted by Starsnatcher on how wishes become reality
introduced.quote: There was once a senior adeptus, Xue Wuliang, known to the people as

introduced.name: Wang Ping'an
introduced.how: Starsnatcher's real name, revealed through the inn and his letter
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an, a Sinner

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: We've seen plenty of hilichurls before, and they're always the bad guys

assumed.name: Wangshu Inn
assumed.quote: Uh-oh, this is right by the Wangshu Inn, too.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Use your Elemental Sight and hunt them down!

assumed.name: Jueyun Karst
assumed.quote: Let's part the fog of mystery that hangs over Jueyun Karst

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: the wrathful spirits of the gods defeated during the Archon War can sometimes cause plagues, monsters or mutations

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I think he wants some Mora...

assumed.name: Bubu Pharmacy
assumed.quote: The difference with Bubu Pharmacy's prescriptions was like night and day, I tell you.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The Millelith don't really need to do shifts when the Master of Stars is around, do they?

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: just look at the Rite of Descension!

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: You don't even have a Vision...

assumed.name: Almond Tofu
assumed.quote: No Almond Tofu this time?

threads.claim: Paimon senses something wrong with the masked adeptus, hinting that Starsnatcher may be a fraud.
threads.quote: Hmm, but now that Paimon thinks about it, there's something that's just not right about this guy.

threads.claim: Starsnatcher is exposed as a fraud, then repents and swears to abandon his deceptions.
threads.quote: I swear to turn away from the evil, to live an honest life, and to never again stain from the name of the adepti!

threads.claim: The yakshas were nearly all lost, and only one conqueror of demons remains alive.
threads.quote: In the millennia since, one conqueror of demons remains the sole surviving yaksha in the mortal realm.

threads.claim: The sole surviving yaksha is confirmed to be Xiao, the Vigilant Yaksha.
threads.quote: So Xiao is the final yaksha?

threads.claim: The super-evil hilichurls may be mutations born from the wrath of fallen gods.
threads.quote: Do you think those super-evil hilichurls we saw earlier were the

threads.claim: Xiao admits the monstrous mutations stem from the karma he has accumulated.
threads.quote: That is because the changes that occurred in these monsters stem from me

threads.claim: The Sigil of Permission fails to work, raising the question of why its power has faded.
threads.quote: I don't get it... Why didn't the Sigil of Permission do anything?

threads.claim: The Sigil of Permission is returned to the Traveler and then given to Xiao.
threads.quote: We got the Sigil of Permission back. Do you wanna take it?

threads.claim: Pervases is revealed as a long-dead yaksha whose appearance was an illusion from a ritual.
threads.quote: My physical form ceased to exist over a thousand years ago.

threads.claim: Xiao orders Grilled Ticker Fish in honor of Pervases, showing his lingering grief.
threads.quote: Fish was Pervases' favorite dish...

introduced.name: Huixin
introduced.how: Tian's daughter, worried about her father's health and his possible resignation
introduced.quote: Arriving at Liyue Harbor, the Traveler and Paimon run into Huixin, Tian's daughter.

introduced.name: Uncle Tian
introduced.how: the current Tianshu, who wants to step down and is choosing a successor
introduced.quote: Huixin: *sigh* It's a long story, but my father... He's thinking of stepping down from the Tianshu position due to health issues.

introduced.name: Tianshu
introduced.how: a rare behind-the-scenes Qixing post, not filled by public selection
introduced.quote: Historically speaking, the Tianshu rarely appears in public. We stay behind the scenes, planning and giving advice.

introduced.name: Tianshu succession
introduced.how: the incumbent recommends a successor, and the other Qixing members approve
introduced.quote: For these reasons, the incumbent Tianshu typically recommends their candidate of choice, and this is then approved by the other Qixing members.

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: the group of Liyue leaders of which the Tianshu is one member
introduced.quote: Oh, well, you see, the Tianshu is a rather unique position among the Liyue Qixing.

introduced.name: Yelan
introduced.how: a covert intelligence officer assisting Tian as assessment official
introduced.quote: Jackpot. Uncle Tian here asked me to assess three candidates for him.

introduced.name: Qianwei
introduced.how: a wealthy entrepreneur and one of the three Tianshu candidates
introduced.quote: Qianwei is a wealthy entrepreneur, Mingbo works at the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs, and Zhiyi is focused on study and travel.

introduced.name: Mingbo
introduced.how: a Ministry of Civil Affairs official and Tianshu candidate who is timid in conversation
introduced.quote: Mingbo is not very articulate and comes across as very timid in conversation.

introduced.name: Zhiyi
introduced.how: a poor-born, gifted Tianshu candidate who was once tutored by Tian
introduced.quote: Zhiyi came from a poor family and his parents died when he was very young.

introduced.name: Yuehai Pavilion
introduced.how: the venue where the candidates are assessed
introduced.quote: we'll be assessing them at Yuehai Pavilion in a short while.

introduced.name: Assessment stages
introduced.how: the assessment has a manifesto stage and then a face-to-face interview
introduced.quote: I've split it into two stages: "Current Affairs and Planning" and "Face-to-Face Interview."

introduced.name: Manifesto binding rule
introduced.how: the appointed Tianshu must carry out their submitted manifesto as written
introduced.quote: Whoever is appointed as the new Tianshu will be expected to implement their plan as put forward in their manifesto.

introduced.name: Wenyuan and Shanghua
introduced.how: Yelan's trusted assistants who gather information by word of mouth and trade
introduced.quote: These two are Wenyuan and Shanghua. They work for me.

introduced.name: Wupei
introduced.how: Yelan's colleague who was sent to sea to question fishermen
introduced.quote: this is Wupei. He's Wenyuan and Shanghua's colleague.

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: owner of Wanyou Boutique who heard rumors about Zhiyi at the North Wharf
introduced.quote: why don't we try talking to Bolai, the owner of Wanyou Boutique?

introduced.name: Uncle Sun
introduced.how: a South Wharf fishmonger who buys Zhiyi's ordinary catches
introduced.quote: He fishes at the wharf, and sells what he catches to me on occasion.

introduced.name: Uncle Gao
introduced.how: a South Wharf fisherman who knew Zhiyi as a poor boy
introduced.quote: I know the guy, I can tell you what I know.

introduced.name: Dugu Shuo
introduced.how: a child who passes on street gossip about Zhiyi
introduced.quote: Dugu Shuo: Sure have! You mean that guy that all the grownups are talking about these days?

introduced.name: Iron Shoulder
introduced.how: a Blackcliff Forge worker who describes the newcomers' habits
introduced.quote: Iron Shoulder: I gotta say, these newcomers are in tip-top shape.

introduced.name: Blackcliff Forge
introduced.how: a forge with no powerful faction ties that holds specialized explosives
introduced.quote: They do possess some specialized explosives, but it would seem more trouble than it's worth to put so many resources into a risky project like this.

introduced.name: Linlang
introduced.how: a shopkeeper selling wineware at Xigu Antiques

introduced.quote: There is a certain place with a freezing-cold climate where there's nothing but ice as far as the eye can see.

threads.claim: Tian is stepping down from the Tianshu post for health reasons, and his successor is being chosen through an assessment.
threads.quote: He's thinking of stepping down from the Tianshu position due to health issues.

threads.claim: Yelan warns that Zhiyi's apparent virtue may be a deception hiding his true intentions.
threads.quote: But let me give you a word of advice: Things are not always as they appear.

threads.claim: Yelan repeats her warning, reinforcing that the candidates' surface images may not reflect reality.
threads.quote: Like I said before: Things are not always as they appear.

threads.claim: Zhiyi's sudden popularity began only two or three months ago, which Yelan finds suspicious.
threads.quote: Plus there's the fact that all this praise of Zhiyi has only been happening within the last two or three months.

threads.claim: A powerful faction may be secretly funding Zhiyi to gain influence over the Liyue Qixing.
threads.quote: It could mean a powerful faction is trying to gain influence over the Liyue Qixing.

threads.claim: A rumor holds that a great treasure lies buried beneath Qingxu Pool.
threads.quote: At some point, a rumor began to go around that there is great treasure buried beneath Qingxu Pool.

threads.claim: Zhiyi's manifesto appears to point the Blackcliff Forge toward excavating the Qingxu Pool treasure.
threads.quote: So Zhiyi wants the Blackcliff Forge to excavate the treasure of Qingxu Pool.

threads.claim: Suspicious newcomers at the Blackcliff Forge may be positioning themselves to steal secrets or treasure.
threads.quote: They can copy any secret texts or steal any treasure they find underground.

threads.claim: A Snezhnayan floral scent left by burned documents suggests the Fatui are behind the newcomers.
threads.quote: But it's all I need. Now I know who we're dealing with, I can plan our next move.

threads.claim: Wupei denies that any fisherman knew of a recipe, which conflicts with Tian's account of Zhiyi's fish soup.
threads.quote: I spoke to every single fisherman out there, and none of them mentioned anything about a recipe.

threads.claim: Wupei's sea trip and fall overboard leave his reliability in question.
threads.quote: Then the waves got so choppy I ended up falling overboard.

threads.claim: Yelan openly wants to become the next Tianshu, and Tian agrees to consider her if the candidates fail.
threads.quote: Don't you think I might make a good Tianshu?

threads.claim: Zhiyi's ties to the Fatui are first suspected, raising the question of why he would betray Uncle Tian.
threads.quote: Paimon: So Zhiyi really sided with the Fatui?

threads.claim: Zhiyi is revealed to have colluded with the Fatui to win the Tianshu position.
threads.quote: Zhiyi colluded with the Fatui to try and secure the position of Tianshu.

threads.claim: Uncle Tian's recent illness is suspected to be caused by poison.
threads.quote: Paimon: Did you hear that? It was poison... That's why Uncle Tian hasn't been feeling well recently.

threads.claim: Uncle Tian's poisoning is confirmed and treated, with recovery expected over years.
threads.quote: Baizhu: Ah, there is now no poison left in his system. But recovery from the damage already done will not happen overnight.

threads.claim: The poison used on Uncle Tian was brought from Snezhnaya by the Fatui.
threads.quote: the poison we brought from Snezhnaya is as strong as this wine

threads.claim: Regrator is hinted to be planning something that could drastically change the world.
threads.quote: And what he's planning may very well shake the world to its core.

threads.claim: Regrator is shown to be involved in the Liyue operation, though only as a peripheral concern.
threads.quote: I found out from other sources that the Harbinger "Regrator" got involved.

threads.claim: Theofan disappears along with the evidence, so the plan to take him as a pawn fails.
threads.quote: But when we tried to make contact with Theofan, he was gone... along with all the evidence.

threads.claim: Multiple parties are after the treasure of Qingxu Pool, and it is hinted to be a major prize.
threads.quote: We've seen no progress on the diplomatic front, and everyone has been eyeing up the treasure of Qingxu Pool.

threads.claim: Uncle Tian suggests that self-interest and scheming are dangerous if they become a person's master.
threads.quote: Everyone has self-interest, but you cannot let it be your master.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Reveals he is a pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn who knows Kaeya's Alberich ancestry
introduced.quote: So you remember me. Then we are already acquainted, Kaeya Alberich... descendant of the Abyss Order's founder.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: Founded by the Alberich family, according to Dainsleif
introduced.quote: Dainsleif then states that Kaeya's ancestors, the Alberichs, are the founders of the Abyss Order, leaving everyone surprised.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Lost homeland said to lie deep underground near Sumeru, Kaeya's roots
introduced.quote: And my roots... They're in Khaenri'ah, which is said to have been located deep underground somewhere near Sumeru.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: Known for famous spices and a spiced cocktail reportedly invented at Djafar Tavern
introduced.quote: Sumeru's spices are famous the world over, and it's long been rumored that this fine establishment was where a certain very popular spiced cocktail was invented.

introduced.name: Crepus
introduced.how: Kaeya's adoptive father, who planned merchant trade to Sumeru
introduced.quote: I overheard my adoptive father talk about sending a team of merchants to Sumeru during a business meeting.

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: The family business that took in young Kaeya
introduced.quote: Dawn Winery had only just taken me in.

introduced.name: Eide
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a former Khaenri'ahn, the stranger who runs the house
introduced.quote: my name is Eide. And you are correct — I was once Khaenri'ahn.

introduced.name: Caribert
introduced.how: Eide's illegitimate son, now a hilichurl
introduced.quote: He is Caribert... my illegitimate son.

introduced.name: Chlothar Alberich
introduced.how: Eide is revealed as Chlothar Alberich, the Abyss Order's founder who vanished a century after founding it
introduced.quote: as he had disappeared 100 years after founding the Abyss Order

introduced.name: Curse of immortality
introduced.how: Gods' punishment on pure-blooded Khaenri'ahns, leaving them unable to die
introduced.quote: Upon us, the gods placed the curse of immortality...

introduced.name: Curse of the wilderness
introduced.how: Punishment for those of other ancestry, turning them into hilichurls
introduced.quote: But those whose ancestry belonged to the domains of other gods were punished with the curse of the wilderness as they fled, turning them into monsters.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: Catastrophe that destroyed Khaenri'ah and its people
introduced.quote: The agony of the cataclysm itself was already too much to bear...

introduced.name: The Seven
introduced.how: The gods Khaenri'ah's people were expected to worship, whom Eide opposes
introduced.quote: As far as I'm concerned, humans who do not worship The Seven are nigh extinct...

introduced.name: Nameless Taboo Medicine of the Royal Court
introduced.how: A banned medicine from a Khaenri'ah royal library book, requiring the power of The Seven
introduced.quote: I read about it in a book from the Royal Library of Khaenri'ah. It was banned, since this medicine requires the power of The Seven to work.

introduced.name: Strange Mushroom
introduced.how: Unusual mushroom, a key ingredient for the medicine that Eide grows
introduced.quote: Eide has them fetch some water to grow the strange mushrooms used in the remedy.

introduced.name: Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: Statue where a Khaenri'ahn must pray to gain The Seven's blessing for the medicine
introduced.quote: Which means... we must pay a visit to a Statue of The Seven.

introduced.name: Sinner
introduced.how: A mysterious voice that calls itself a Sinner and speaks inside the Traveler's head
introduced.quote: O dear creature, why do you bow down? For fear of the unknown?

introduced.name: Chlothar Alberich
introduced.how: Eide's real name is Chlothar Alberich, founder of the Abyss Order, cursed with immortality and Caribert's father
introduced.quote: My real name is Chlothar...

introduced.name: Caribert
introduced.how: Caribert is Chlothar Alberich's son, who was transformed by Abyssal power and wore a mask
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: And it seems closely connected to Chlothar Alberich's son, Caribert, and what happened to him...

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: An organization founded by Chlothar Alberich out of his faith in the Abyss
introduced.quote: After founding the Abyss Order, his faith in the Abyss led him to do a great many things.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: A mysterious power that Chlothar Alberich worshiped and that Khaenri'ah's people revered as a wondrous mystery
introduced.quote: To us, you were the Abyss... A wondrous mystery far beyond our imagination and comprehension...

introduced.name: Curse of immortality
introduced.how: A curse that tormented Chlothar Alberich's body and mind for a long time
introduced.quote: But the curse of immortality continued to torment his body and mind, and in the end, neither his faith nor the Abyss he worshiped could save him.

introduced.name: Defiled Statue
introduced.how: A perverse product of Chlothar Alberich's use of Abyssal power during his life
introduced.quote: The Defiled Statue that we encountered previously was just one perverse product of his use of Abyssal power during his life.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: Lines that carry information and memories and were disturbed by the Abyss
introduced.quote: I checked the Ley Lines nearby. It appears that the Abyss tampered with them, and they've been in turmoil ever since...

introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.how: A group that patrols the land, hunts hilichurls, and has its own nation
introduced.quote: Forest Ranger: You...! You're raving mad! You've got some gall, coming here to our nation, insulting the Forest Rangers!

introduced.name: Gandharva Ville
introduced.how: Where the Forest Rangers' superiors are based
introduced.quote: Forest Ranger: Don't go thinking this is over! Our superiors are gonna hear of this when we get back to Gandharva Ville!

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: This is definitely Kaeya's style.

assumed.name: Loom of Fate
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, the Abyss Order's evil plan! We learned about that back in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: believing that as a Captain of the Knights of Favonius, he should be back in Mondstadt

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: You itching for a lecture from Jean?

assumed.name: Defiled Statue
assumed.quote: It's just like the Defiled Statue!

assumed.name: Forest Rangers
assumed.quote: Forest Rangers, perhaps?

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: A Ley Line anomaly, perhaps?

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Since he needs the God of Wisdom's power, should I get Nahida to help?)

assumed.name: Grand Thief
assumed.quote: these worshiping hilichurls remind me a little too much of the Grand Thief

assumed.name: Windblume Festival
assumed.quote: I'd like to chat with you about what happened during last year's Windblume Festival.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: Just you wait, Heavenly Principles!

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: I thought my sibling was the founder...

assumed.name: Abyss Herald
assumed.quote: (An Abyss Herald? No, he doesn't look like someone from the Abyss Order...)

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: remember to come see me at the Angel's Share when next you're in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: Dainsleif: What happened while you were unconscious?

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Chlothar: We once believed that you would bring new strength and hope to Khaenri'ah.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Eide: Have you seen a hilichurl? A hilichurl should have come past this way... have you seen it?

threads.claim: Dainsleif claims the Alberich family founded the Abyss Order, which Kaeya may be tied to.
threads.quote: Dainsleif then states that Kaeya's ancestors, the Alberichs, are the founders of the Abyss Order, leaving everyone surprised.

threads.quote: Eide reveals himself as Chlothar Alberich and addresses the Traveler as his

threads.quote: Dainsleif states that while recovering, he remembered something related to the

threads.quote: This is the first time we've ever been separated.

threads.quote: pick up the mirror and see themselves as their sibling before falling unconscious again

threads.claim: A mysterious voice calling itself a Sinner speaks to the Traveler and seems to know their fate.
threads.quote: O dear creature, why do you bow down? For fear of the unknown?

threads.claim: Eide believes the Sinner is a mighty god, while the Traveler insists it is a Sinner.
threads.quote: But the god we saw in that cave... Now that was a truly mighty god!

threads.claim: Pure-blooded Khaenri'ahns were cursed with immortality by the gods after the cataclysm.
threads.quote: Upon us, the gods placed the curse of immortality...

threads.claim: The Traveler links Eide to Dainsleif as another bearer of the immortality curse.
threads.quote: (So Eide is just like Dain, someone who bears the curse of immortality.)

threads.claim: Khaenri'ahns of other ancestry were cursed into hilichurls, the origin of monsters like Caribert.
threads.quote: But those whose ancestry belonged to the domains of other gods were punished with the curse of the wilderness as they fled, turning them into monsters.

threads.claim: The cataclysm destroyed Khaenri'ah and its people, and its causes remain unexplained.
threads.quote: The agony of the cataclysm itself was already too much to bear...

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders why Khaenri'ah and The Seven could not coexist in peace.
threads.quote: (Why could Khaenri'ah and The Seven not coexist in peace?)

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah is said to lie deep underground near Sumeru, a location still unconfirmed.
threads.quote: which is said to have been located deep underground somewhere near Sumeru

threads.claim: Kaeya suspects his father sent him to Mondstadt to keep him alive and separated from Khaenri'ah's troubles.
threads.quote: Maybe my father left me in the peaceful land of Mondstadt for no other reason than simply to keep me alive...

threads.claim: Kaeya now suspects his father left him in Mondstadt because of the Alberich family's Abyss Order link.
threads.quote: I suppose that was why my father left me in Mondstadt after all...

threads.claim: The medicine may be able to restore Caribert's mind, though it cannot break the curse.
threads.quote: I do not hope to break the curse. I am well aware of my powerlessness against the punishment of the gods.

threads.claim: The first dose fails to wake Caribert, so the treatment may need more doses.
threads.quote: It didn't work.

threads.claim: Caribert wakes after the second dose, following Eide's prayer to the Sinner.
threads.quote: Eide: *gasp* ...Caribert! Oh, my goodness, it worked! It's a miracle!!!

threads.claim: Eide forbids Caribert from ever removing his mask, hinting at a hidden danger.
threads.quote: Eide: Never take off your mask.

threads.claim: Caribert takes off his mask and is overtaken by Abyss power, showing the danger.
threads.quote: they find Caribert imbued with the power of the Abyss as he takes his mask off

threads.claim: The chained crystal in the sanctuary matches the Defiled Statue, tying it to the Abyss Order.
threads.quote: It's just like the Defiled Statue!

threads.claim: Monsters near the house may have been drawn by an unusual Ley Line disturbance.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: I doubt that the appearance of those monsters was wholly random.

threads.claim: Dainsleif confirms the Abyss disturbed the Ley Lines and says he repaired them.
threads.quote: Dainsleif states that the Abyss had messed with the Ley Lines in the area and he fixed it

threads.claim: Dainsleif's memories are eroding, so his leads return only in fragments.
threads.quote: My memories suffer from erosion

threads.claim: Eide rejects The Seven after the miracle and begins to worship the Sinner as a god.
threads.quote: I knew that placing my hope in The Seven was a waste of time...

threads.claim: A divine crystal and the hilichurl worshipers vanished from the Unknown Sanctuary, with no explanation given.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's gone...

threads.claim: Caribert glows with purple energy after unmasking, hinting that the strange power inside him is still active.
threads.quote: (Caribert begins to glow with purple energy)

threads.claim: Eide claims to know the Traveler's true identity, suggesting a hidden past the Traveler does not yet understand.
threads.quote: Eide: Wait, no... Why am I still calling you "Traveler"? I have known your true identity for some time now.

threads.claim: The term Sinner is raised as a possible identity for a figure that may be more than a god, leaving its meaning open.
threads.quote: Eide: Could he really have been a "Sinner," and not a god...?

threads.claim: The term Loom of Fate is introduced as something the Traveler recognizes from memory and does not yet understand.
threads.quote: Traveler: (There's that term again... the "Loom of Fate"...)

threads.claim: Dainsleif confirms the Loom of Fate appeared in that era and is linked to Caribert, but leaves its nature unexplained.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Still, as I'd suspected, the notion of the "Loom of Fate" did indeed rear its head during that time...

threads.claim: Chlothar identifies the power in Caribert and the Sinner as the power of the Abyss, linking the two.
threads.quote: Chlothar: I am positive now... it's the power of the Abyss, isn't it?

threads.claim: A voice heard inside the Traveler's head is tied to a 'he' who may have seen the Traveler, with Dainsleif's identity suspicions unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Yes. I have my suspicions as to his identity, but I need to confirm some other details before I can be sure.

threads.claim: The Traveler believes the bones belong to Chlothar Alberich, and Dainsleif wonders whether he escaped the curse, leaving it unresolved.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Unless... Chlothar Alberich finally found a way to rid himself of the curse.

threads.claim: Alberich lost his mind after a hundred years and was never seen again, showing the curse's fatal effect.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: After a hundred years, he lost his mind completely, and was never seen again.

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: Traveler's contact leading the investigation with siblings Freminet and Lynette
introduced.quote: Lyney, worried for his siblings' safety and mentally reminded of Lynette's kidnapping years earlier

introduced.name: Freminet
introduced.how: Diver sibling chosen to follow Childe's flooded escape route
introduced.quote: Lyney agrees that Freminet would be best suited to dive the flooded tunnel, while Lynette would continue gathering information

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: Sibling gathering intel, who had been kidnapped years earlier and feigned illness at the infirmary
introduced.quote: Lynette had also feigned illness to acquire more information from the infirmary

introduced.name: Childe

threads.claim: Lynette was kidnapped years earlier, which makes Lyney fiercely protective of his siblings.
threads.quote: mentally reminded of Lynette's kidnapping years earlier

threads.claim: Convicts feel marked for life, and some prisoners prefer to stay in the prison after their sentences.
threads.quote: Once a criminal, always a criminal, we're marked for life.

threads.claim: Childe's exact whereabouts are unknown and must be found by tracing his escape route.
threads.quote: We need to find out Master Childe's exact whereabouts.

threads.claim: Childe is found alive and drifting in the Primordial Sea, where he sees a massive narwhal.
threads.quote: Childe can be seen drifting through its depths when he regains consciousness

threads.claim: The infirmary may hide a secret, shown by a movable hatch and suspicious meetings.
threads.quote: Eh? Wait, there seems to be a movable hatch on the ground over there?

threads.claim: Wriothesley asks what secret lies behind Sigewinne and the infirmary people, and the group cannot yet answer.
threads.quote: Wriothesley acknowledges the answer and then asks about the secret behind Sigewinne and the people in the infirmary

threads.claim: The strange meat is Sigewinne's secret cooking meant to restore stamina to overworked prisoners.
threads.quote: meant to help restore stamina to those working non-stop

threads.claim: The red liquid is a Fonta recipe being market-tested on prisoners for consumer feedback.
threads.quote: the liquid is actually a new Fonta recipe the company is market testing on the prisoners for consumer feedback

threads.claim: The sluice gate's gauge is climbing into the red, so the gate may fail and release the Primordial Sea.
threads.quote: It had never moved when he first laid eyes on it, but it had slowly begun to increase in the past year into the red

threads.claim: Neuvillette halts the Primordial Sea and reseals the gate, but the threat is only held back for now.
threads.quote: he uses his powers to halt, and then push the water back and reseal the sluice gate

threads.claim: The group still needs to learn more about the forbidden zone, which may be tied to the infirmary secret.
threads.quote: we still need to make more progress on the investigation of the forbidden zone

threads.claim: Wriothesley reveals the forbidden zone contains a large sluice gate holding back the sea.
threads.quote: When they arrive at the central room, they find a large sluice gate in the middle of the room

threads.claim: Wriothesley knew of the group's hidden motives all along.
threads.quote: learning that Wriothesley had known of their motives

threads.claim: Wriothesley secretly builds a massive ship inspired by Remurian legend, hidden from the prisoners.
threads.quote: after being inspired by Remurian legend

threads.claim: Egeria kept a secret beneath the waves, guarded by exiled criminals.
threads.quote: which she granted by having them guard her secret beneath the waves

threads.claim: A prophecy is unfolding, and the Traveler's party may already be in its next stage.
threads.quote: making Arlecchino realize that they might be in the next stage of the prophecy

threads.claim: Arlecchino suspects Neuvillette might be the Hydro Archon, or at least know where the Gnosis is.
threads.quote: She then entertains the thought that Neuvillette might be the Hydro Archon and/or knew where the Gnosis was.

threads.claim: Neuvillette confirms he is the Hydro Sovereign and asks the group to keep it secret.
threads.quote: confirming that he's the Hydro Sovereign, though asking them to keep it a secret

threads.claim: Furina does not hold the Gnosis, and a curse was sensed on her.
threads.quote: Noting the genuine fear in her eyes and with no Gnosis, Arlecchino left.

threads.claim: The Hydro Archon's Authority can only be returned to Neuvillette, so stopping the prophecy needs other solutions.
threads.quote: unless the Hydro Archon gave his Authority back to him, and thus should look towards other solutions

threads.claim: The contents of the forbidden zone are withheld, leaving an open question about what lies inside.
threads.quote: Traveler: What's inside of it?

threads.claim: Primordial Seawater is leaking into the surrounding sea and its concentration is rising.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...Primordial Seawater is continually leaking into the sea?

threads.claim: If the sluice gate fails, the Primordial Sea will flood Fontaine and dissolve everyone in it.
threads.quote: Traveler: If this gate falls, all of Fontaine will fall with it.

threads.claim: A prophecy warns that the gate's failure will dissolve everyone into the sea.
threads.quote: It's just as the prophecy says. If this gate fails, then everyone will be dissolved into the sea.

threads.claim: The legend of ancient Remuria and its ship the Fortuna is introduced as a story with unresolved relevance.
threads.quote: Then maybe you haven't heard of the story of ancient Remuria.

threads.claim: The Fortress's origin is explained as exiled criminals building it under the Hydro Archon's protection.
threads.quote: There's no single "founder" of the Fortress of Meropide in any traditional sense.

threads.claim: Childe's disappearance remains unexplained, and Wriothesley is also curious where the Harbinger went.
threads.quote: I'm also quite curious about where that Harbinger went, so I figured I might as well let the Fatui do their own investigative work.

threads.claim: Wriothesley hired Clorinde for field work, explaining her presence in the Fortress.
threads.quote: I paid her good Mora to come down to the Fortress for some field work.

threads.claim: Wriothesley describes an impending crisis that he needed an exceptionally capable person to help him survive.
threads.quote: I needed to find an exceptionally capable person to help me get through the impending crisis.

threads.claim: The production zone and Pankration Ring hidden rules are explained as Fonta and Sigewinne's secret schemes.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ah, so that's what was going on... Paimon understands it now. Who would have guessed...

threads.claim: The secret behind the head nurse and her infirmary patients is raised as a final, unanswered question.
threads.quote: Wriothesley: Alright, and here's the final question. What's the secret behind our head nurse, and all of her patients in the infirmary?

threads.claim: Melusines perceive the world and aesthetics differently from humans, which explains why their gifts are misunderstood.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...Unfortunately, Melusines as a race perceive the world differently from humans, and their sense of aesthetics is even more alien to us.

threads.claim: The blood-colored liquid turns out to be an unnamed Fonta trial product rather than something sinister.
threads.quote: Paimon: But really, it's just a bottle of the latest yet-to-be-named-and-packaged new Fonta trial product!

threads.claim: Wriothesley claims the Fatui has been infiltrating the Fortress from the start, driving his response.
threads.quote: From the very beginning, the Fatui has been actively infiltrating my Fortress.

threads.claim: The Knave doubts Furina is the true Hydro Archon and wonders whether Neuvillette is the genuine Archon.
threads.quote: I began to entertain the possibility that she is not the true Hydro Archon

threads.claim: Neuvillette confirms he is the Dragon Sovereign of Water, answering the earlier hints about his identity.
threads.quote: You guessed correctly. I sincerely hope you'll be able to keep this a secret for me.

threads.claim: Neuvillette's grief causes the sky to cloud and rain to fall, linking him to the legend of the weeping Dragon of Water.
threads.quote: (Looking into the air as he speaks, the sky clouds over and heavy rain begins to pour.)

threads.claim: The prophesied moment when the waters burst forth is foreseen as coming, but Neuvillette says it is not yet.
threads.quote: A day may come when the prophecy is fulfilled

threads.claim: The Archons hold dragon power stolen by the First Usurper, and Neuvillette cannot act until an Archon loses their Authority.
threads.quote: I believe I will not be able to do much unless the Archon disappears and returns their elemental Authority to me.

threads.claim: Lyney suspects a secret passageway and a hidden large project in the Fortress that most people never see.
threads.quote: there's probably a secret passageway behind the block in the infirmary

threads.claim: Lyney suspects Wriothesley has a secret plan tied to the changing seawater and a bargaining chip.
threads.quote: If Wriothesley does have a plan, what could it be?

threads.claim: Furina claims her secret plans will only be revealed at the fated time, leaving her real work unclear.
threads.quote: My machinations are just like the prophecy itself — they will only reveal themselves at the fated time.

threads.claim: The Knave senses that the Archon is under some kind of curse and does not seem like a true god.
threads.quote: And I sense that she's under some kind of curse...

threads.claim: Someone other than Furina is using the Oratrice and its Indemnitium to prepare for something.
threads.quote: If I'm not mistaken, someone's using it to prepare for something.

threads.claim: The Knave is searching for the Hydro Gnosis, whose location is unknown.
threads.quote: The Hydro Gnosis is not currently held by the Archon...

threads.claim: Childe's disappearance becomes leverage the House of the Hearth uses to pressure the Fontaine authorities.
threads.quote: Tartaglia's disappearance was not a part of my plan, but I can use it to make a breakthrough.

threads.claim: The Knave plans to meet the Hydro Archon and Neuvillette to pursue her own investigation.
threads.quote: I would like to meet the Hydro Archon and Iudex Neuvillette.

threads.claim: Furina refuses to say whether she has any emergency plan for the coming disaster.
threads.quote: The emergency response plan is also strictly confidential.

threads.claim: Neuvillette temporarily forces back the Primordial Sea, but the crisis is only suppressed for now.
threads.quote: I used my power to force back the Primordial Sea and re-seal the sluice gate.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon feel their freedom has been regained after leaving prison status behind.
threads.quote: It feels like we've regained our freedom.
