introduced.how: animal shelter that runs an overseas adoption program for Fontaine's cat and dog breeds
introduced.quote: Chourei: Ah, the director of the organization explained that, actually. He said a lot of the cat and dog breeds unique to Fontaine are also very popular overseas...

introduced.name: Bernard
introduced.how: director of the Humane Society who came looking for Bonnie
introduced.quote: Lynette: Bernard, the director of the Humane Society, was the man who came looking for Bonnie earlier...

introduced.name: Pierre
introduced.how: unseen mastermind who made Imitation Sinthe and ran the smuggling plan through Bernard
introduced.quote: Bernard: That guy Pierre... He was running the entire show!

introduced.name: Imitation Sinthe
introduced.how: contraband substance smuggled inside sealed bags swallowed by animals, masked by their body odor
introduced.quote: Elodie: The sealed bags combined with an animal's body odor would certainly be enough to mask the scent of Imitation Sinthe...

introduced.name: floating barrels
introduced.how: flotation barrels with animals inside, passed between the smugglers at sea
introduced.quote: Bernard: I would order wooden barrels and flotation devices according to his instructions, and then load the sleeping animals onto a boat.

introduced.name: Lefevere family
introduced.how: infamous Fontaine family whose members were targeted for revenge
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Lefevere family is infamous in Fontaine, and even their innocent scions became targets of revenge.

introduced.name: Lefevere pendant
introduced.how: pattern on the pendant marks its owner as an illegitimate Lefevere child
introduced.quote: Traveler: The pattern on the pendant is proof that its owner is an illegitimate child of the Lefevere family...

introduced.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
introduced.how: Gardes unit whose captain Chevreuse leads it and can declare suspects
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: As the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, I hereby declare you as a suspect in the case.

introduced.name: Lumidouce Harbor
introduced.how: port where ships are logged and cargo is inspected and confiscated
introduced.quote: Lynette: Of course, you did far more than that. Just now, at Lumidouce Harbor... Were you not the person who highlighted the suspicious activities of the Society?

introduced.name: Pierre's secret base
introduced.how: hidden base where the sealed bags were made and animals were drugged and stuffed
introduced.quote: Lynette: The sealed bags we found at the secret base... They were specially made to be corrosion-resistant...

introduced.name: Elodie Lefevere
introduced.how: revealed as a Lefevere infiltrator planted inside the Gardes and the hidden third person
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: The Lefeveres were infamous for using disguise and infiltration to achieve their goals... Who would have thought that they would have planted someone within the Gardes.

introduced.name: Lefevere clan's fall
introduced.how: the clan was purged, and Elodie helped interrogate and arrest its members to clear herself
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: Not only that, but you actively participated in the interrogation, arrest, and judgement of the Lefeveres during their fall, thus clearing yourself of suspicion.

introduced.name: standby mode
introduced.how: Lynette's recharging state, restored by tea and a cat
introduced.quote: Lynette: Mmm... Black tea and a cute kitty. Truly, the best combo for standby mode.

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: Traveler: Furina? You managed to get an invite to the drinks reception, too?

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: He got Freminet to make me a little something for just this situation:

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: We took all the kids from the House of the Hearth out to see a film

assumed.name: The Steambird
assumed.quote: I think I'll go to The Steambird and see about putting an ad in the paper.

assumed.name: Opera Epiclese
assumed.quote: But the next show is at the Opera Epiclese! It's such a huge opportunity...

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Haha, sorry I'm a little late to the show. Work's been keeping me pretty busy lately.

assumed.name: Gillian
assumed.quote: Director Merieux, please! You're not being fair to Lynette...

assumed.name: Merieux
assumed.quote: Lynette... Why on earth would you do this!?

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: From the balcony, Furina lends her applause, before the remaining audience applauds as well.

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: Okay everyone, we all have pretty awkward smiles on our faces in the photo from Hotel Debord.

assumed.name: Fleuve Cendre
assumed.quote: Oh, do you mean when we ran into you at the Fleuve Cendre? And you said some mean things to me?

assumed.name: Sinthe
assumed.quote: We confiscated all the Sinthe on the market, but addiction isn't something that goes away overnight.

assumed.name: Magic Pocket
assumed.quote: Doesn't it look similar to the material used for your Magic Pockets?

assumed.name: Guard Poodles
assumed.quote: they're not something our Guard Poodles would miss.

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: That's what led Lyney and I to join the House of the Hearth.

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: The most likely explanation is that you're a member of the Gardes or some similar organization.

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: This very fact, however, leads me to believe it was indeed the work of that Harbinger.

assumed.name: Bonnie
assumed.quote: Traveler: (The cat that fled from Pierre looks just like the cat that the Humane Society is looking for... Could that really be a coincidence?)

assumed.name: Humane Society
assumed.quote: Traveler: We've encountered that organization before, right?

assumed.name: Chevreuse
assumed.quote: Lynette: Those drugs Chevreuse found at the secret base... She most likely didn't recognize them because they're not used on human beings...

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Traveler: Chevreuse! Lyney!

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Bernard: ...Ah! You're the people from earlier... Wait, you're from... the Gardes!?

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: Bernard: J—Just last night! He said that the Marechaussee Phantom is now after him, so he's planning to go into hiding for some time.

assumed.name: Gardemek
assumed.quote: Elodie: Okay, then let's head to the Humane Society right away and bring that guy to justice! I'll bring a Gardemek to speed up the process.

assumed.name: Maison Ordalie
assumed.quote: Chourei: Oh, we keep them in a storage locker. If they turn out to be something particularly dubious, we'll turn them over to the Maison Ordalie...

assumed.name: Poisson
assumed.quote: Traveler: About what we found in Poisson...

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Traveler: According to Chevreuse's investigations, Pierre has been formally reprimanded for his Sinthe-related research, and can no longer get any materials from the Fontaine Research Institute.

threads.claim: A threat letter demanding Lynette step down from the lead role appears, and its sender is unknown.
threads.quote: Traveler: What!? It's a threat letter!

threads.claim: Lynette privately reveals the letter writer is Ginna, Gillian's sister.
threads.quote: It was Ginna. Gillian's sister.

threads.claim: Lynette senses a contemptuous stare from someone who may be backstage, and she cannot identify them.
threads.quote: Like someone was giving me an evil stare. But I couldn't figure out who it was...

threads.claim: Lynette hears the original script of The Lost Puppet differed greatly from the final show.
threads.quote: We heard that the original script for The Lost Puppet was quite different from the final show.

threads.claim: Furina saw an earlier draft of Merieux's script and found its protagonist more complex.
threads.quote: I did happen to see the original draft of Merieux's script a while back.

threads.claim: The original script's Act IV demands a far more emotional solo performance than the final version.
threads.quote: Yep, that's not something a novice could hope to pull off after just a few months of rehearsals.

threads.claim: Merieux reacts unusually to the mention of Gillian, hinting he is hiding something about the lead role.
threads.quote: I'm actually more concerned about Merieux... When I mentioned Gillian, his reaction was pretty unusual.

threads.claim: Merieux had earlier promised Gillian the lead role, then replaced her with Lynette at Maloney's urging.
threads.quote: There's... been a change of plan, Gillian. The leading role will now be played by Lynette.

threads.claim: Merieux suggests the puppet protagonist mirrors Lynette, a stranger in time who does not belong.
threads.quote: A mechanical puppet with a bumbling body but a sensitive soul...

threads.claim: The fall of the Lefevere family is shrouded in questions, and some suspect the House of the Hearth was involved.
threads.quote: There's always been questions surrounding the fall of the Lefevere family. Some people even believe the House of the Hearth was involved.

threads.claim: Lynette reveals that her adoptive Father orchestrated the fall of the Lefevere family.
threads.quote: Yep. Father was the one who orchestrated the fall of the Lefevere family.

threads.claim: Pierre has fled, and the Gardes and Special Patrol are searching for him.
threads.quote: At that point, however, we discovered that he had already fled. Now, the Gardes and the Special Patrol are all searching for him.

threads.claim: Pierre was probably not acting alone; another person likely handles smuggling the drug across the border.
threads.quote: Let's say for now that he was only in charge of producing the Imitation Sinthe. That would mean there has to be at least one other person involved in the operation

threads.claim: How the Imitation Sinthe was smuggled past port inspections remains unknown.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, we were never able to find out how they managed to get the Imitation Sinthe across the border.

threads.claim: Lynette was kidnapped as a child by the Lefevere family after being tricked into their carriage.
threads.quote: It was at a dinner party. Someone tricked me into boarding the Lefevere family carriage.

threads.claim: Lyney has been secretly investigating something and hiding it from Lynette.
threads.quote: He avoids me for days on end, consumes himself with some secret investigation, and then out of the blue pushes me to do that acting job...

threads.claim: Lynette has energy-consuming modes, hinting she is not an ordinary human.
threads.quote: Ah, I'm so much more at home here in the audience. I get to sit on a comfy seat, and I don't have to activate my energy-consuming modes all the time.

threads.claim: Merieux admits he sacrificed artistic integrity for fame and resolves to return to his art.
threads.quote: Huh... Just like those critics with their dishonest reviews, I became all about the trappings of success, at the expense of the art itself.

threads.claim: Lynette finds freedom in stepping back from fame and watching others perform.
threads.quote: Phew... freedom at last...

threads.claim: Bernard and Pierre were both unaware that a hidden third person was pulling their strings.
threads.quote: Traveler: Even Bernard himself never knew that it wasn't Pierre that had been pulling his strings all along... It was someone else.

threads.claim: The third person was revealed as the one who supplied raw materials and secretly connected the smugglers.
threads.quote: Lynette: And that's how neither the trafficker nor the manufacturer knew there was a third person who supplied the raw materials, and surreptitiously operated between them.

threads.claim: The Lefevere family is notorious, and even its innocent heirs are targeted by revenge.
threads.quote: Traveler: The Lefevere family is infamous in Fontaine, and even their innocent scions became targets of revenge.

threads.claim: Elodie is shown to be a Lefevere planted in the Gardes, confirming the family's infiltration tactics.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: The Lefeveres were infamous for using disguise and infiltration to achieve their goals... Who would have thought that they would have planted someone within the Gardes.

threads.claim: Pierre was ambushed and made to disappear, and his fate remains unresolved.
threads.quote: Traveler: And made him "disappear."

threads.claim: Imitation Sinthe spread on a small scale before growing into a large smuggling scheme, and its early source is unclear.
threads.quote: Lyney: Hmm... Based on information that we found before, Imitation Sinthe was first circulated on a small scale in Fontaine, before becoming a large-scale smuggling scheme.

threads.claim: Alois's nervous and inconsistent behavior hints that he is hiding a real motive for visiting Mondstadt.
threads.quote: This fellow seems suspicious to me.

threads.claim: The rockfalls may have been caused deliberately by someone rather than by natural causes.
threads.quote: The more I think about it, surely nobody could be responsible for something of this scale.

threads.claim: A Stonehide Lawachurl is suspected of being behind the recent rockfalls.
threads.quote: Is that the culprit behind the recent rockfalls?

threads.claim: The hero Vennessa is honored at Windrise, and stories about her are tied to Mondstadt's places.
threads.quote: Symbol of the great hero, Vennessa!

threads.claim: Vennessa and Master Jean carried heavy responsibilities that they no longer carry, hinting at a loss.
threads.quote: the responsibilities they carry — that they carried — those are the heaviest.

threads.claim: Roses carry a meaning Noelle does not fully understand, hinting at a hidden message.
threads.quote: Wait! Do you mean that... roses have some meaning that I don't know about?

threads.claim: The Knights of Favonius was formed because one knight's power is limited, and teamwork is central to the order.
threads.quote: It is precisely because the power of a single knight is limited that the Knights of Favonius was formed.

threads.claim: True strength comes from the intention to protect others rather than from raw power.
threads.quote: It's because protecting others is the source of your strength.

threads.claim: Noelle's relentless duties leave her no time for herself, and others warn that this may cause regret.
threads.quote: If you don't take time out for yourself, you may come to regret it in the future...

threads.claim: Noelle is determined to become a real knight but is repeatedly blocked from passing the selection trials.
threads.quote: No matter how hard I train, I can never pass the selection trials.

threads.claim: Noelle is inexperienced in romance and studies love books, one of which she hides and seems unready for.
threads.quote: I borrowed every book on love from the library that I could find.

threads.claim: Gifts convey intentions, so choosing them carefully matters in relationships.
threads.quote: Gifts convey our intentions, we should choose carefully.

threads.claim: Alois hints he wants to copy Dandelion Wine, then deflects when questioned.
threads.quote: Maybe recipes will be easier to obtain than the brewing process...

threads.claim: Alois confesses he planned to investigate and imitate Dandelion Wine, and the Traveler drives him off.
threads.quote: I was planning to investigate Mondstadt's Dandelion Wine — to see if I could find a way to imitate it!

threads.claim: Alois suspects the gift and meal are a warning, hinting Noelle's hospitality may hide a threat.
threads.quote: So it's... a warning!

threads.claim: Handbook Article 2 and Article 10 appear to conflict over how to treat unfamiliar visitors.
threads.quote: I—It seems the Knights of Favonius Handbook has a bit of an overlap...

threads.claim: Noelle worries she is not yet fit to become a real knight of Favonius.
threads.quote: How can I ever become a real knight of Favonius like this...?

threads.claim: Noelle argues visitors in trouble deserve help even when their story is doubtful.
threads.quote: Isn't it times like these that people need help the most?

threads.quote: Traveler: "This is not the end"...

threads.claim: The Jade of Return is a treasure that could quell the Abyss contamination in Ochkanatlan, and its location is unknown.
threads.quote: Rumor had it that one of the countless treasures aboard the ship was the Jade of Return, and that locating it would quell this Abyss-tainted ancient city.

threads.claim: The Jade of Return is not in the city but in the sky, aboard the Tonatiuh.
threads.quote: But in truth, it's not to be found within this city, but instead, in the sky.

threads.claim: Cocouik's light points the party higher up toward the Tonatiuh.
threads.quote: Look, even Coco's light points to somewhere higher up!

threads.claim: Ancient inscriptions say the path to the Tonatiuh opens once Pyrophosphorite is placed on the Altar of Primal Flame.
threads.quote: The inscriptions on a monument in the ruins say that the winds of the distant past will guide the way to the Tonatiuh

threads.claim: Bona's father left on the search for the Jade and never came back.
threads.quote: My old man set off on a journey for that purpose... but he never returned.

threads.claim: The city became forbidden after the only survivor of her father's squad returned alone.
threads.quote: But the city became a forbidden place for the tribe after that woman returned alone, the sole survivor from my old man's squad.

threads.claim: The golden pattern and the trials in the city may have been left by a Sage of the Stolen Flame.
threads.quote: Was it a hint left behind by that, uh, Sage of the Stolen Flame?

threads.claim: An unnamed adventurer's notes hint at an unresolved riddle involving a name hidden by a redacted block.
threads.quote: or to unravel the final riddle of ██, I must go there

threads.claim: Ochkanatlan may be an ancient city from Natlan's past.
threads.quote: Might the people of Natlan have lived in cities way back when?

threads.claim: Removing the Abyss threat from the tribe is tied to finding the Jade of Return.
threads.quote: But we can remove the Abyss threat against your tribe if we can find it, and that would be amazing, too!

introduced.name: Akademiya Extravaganza
introduced.how: grand Akademiya event with a long history, split into two parts
introduced.quote: So, the Akademiya Extravaganza is a grand event run by the Akademiya with a long and storied history.

introduced.name: Wisdom Gala
introduced.how: annual event where the Darshans run city booths to showcase their schools
introduced.quote: The Gala is held annually. During this time, all six Darshans will set up booths throughout the city

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: event held every four years where each Darshan sends a representative to compete for grand champion
introduced.quote: On the other hand, the Championship is held once every four years. Each Darshan will send a representative to vie for the position of grand champion.

introduced.name: Darshans
introduced.how: six schools of the Akademiya that send booths and representatives
introduced.quote: all six Darshans will set up booths throughout the city and host guests

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: an Akademiya school that has recently lacked new talent
introduced.quote: Vahumana has seen a dearth of new talent lately, and some of its existing ones are not currently at the Akademiya, so I suspect he might have been their only option...

introduced.name: Wiqas
introduced.how: Akademiya Extravaganza planning committee member who explains the event
introduced.quote: My name is Wiqas, a member of the Akademiya Extravaganza Planning Committee.

introduced.name: Diadem of Knowledge
introduced.how: artifact that the winner of the Championship gets to wear, bought and donated by Sachin
introduced.quote: Twenty years ago, a researcher named Sachin bought it for a large sum of Mora before donating it to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Sachin
introduced.how: wealthy researcher who bought the Diadem of Knowledge and sponsored the prizes
introduced.quote: Twenty years ago, a researcher named Sachin bought it for a large sum of Mora before donating it to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Kareena
introduced.how: organizer at the main venue who runs the Championship and sets up commentators
introduced.quote: The main event venue is at the outskirts of the Citadel of Regzar, and the organizer you're looking for is Kareena.

introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.how: Amurta representative in the Championship, introduced with his Darshan and field of biology
introduced.quote: Representing Amurta, Tighnari!

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: Spantamad representative in the Championship, an elementalism student
introduced.quote: Representing Spantamad, Cyno!

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: Rtawahist representative in the Championship, studying illuminationism
introduced.quote: Representing Rtawahist, Layla!

introduced.name: Faruzan
introduced.how: Haravatat scholar and Championship contestant who is a household name in Haravatat
introduced.quote: I am Faruzan, a household name in Haravatat.

introduced.name: Kaveh
introduced.how: Kshahrewar representative in the Championship, studying technology
introduced.quote: Representing Kshahrewar, Kaveh!

introduced.name: Hat Guy
introduced.how: mysterious Vahumana representative who is the Wanderer under an alias
introduced.quote: Finally! Our final contestant is Vahumana's representative: Hat Guy!

introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.how: commentator who announces the rules of each round
introduced.quote: I will now announce the rules for the first round of the competition. Please listen carefully!

introduced.name: Swiftflies
introduced.how: special, faster butterflies hidden among the released butterflies that contestants must find
introduced.quote: Amongst these butterflies, three of them will be special Swiftflies. They have a different appearance and also fly a little faster.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: custom Akademiya camera the commentators use to record the competition
introduced.quote: The first item is a custom Kamera from the Akademiya.

introduced.name: locator
introduced.how: event device that flags contestants' locations and sounds when they finish an objective
introduced.quote: The second is an event-specific locator that will flag all participants' locations.

introduced.name: mechanical bait
introduced.how: mechanical butterflies released to lure real butterflies into the city
introduced.quote: The butterflies within the city will mistake our mechanical bait for one of their own and follow them around.

introduced.name: Lord Sangemah Bay
introduced.how: merchant alias of Dori, the famous Sumeru merchant
introduced.quote: Hehe, well, only the most famous merchant in all of Sumeru — Lord Sangemah Bay!

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali and the sages came up with a plan for the Akademiya to recruit talented people from the desert, starting next year.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ooh, that's right! You want to move out of Alhaitham's—

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Collei, you're here too!

assumed.name: Dehya and Candace
assumed.quote: Paimon: Dehya, Candace! You two are here as well!

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Traveler: So it was Nahida's doing...

assumed.name: Azar
assumed.quote: Well, the atmosphere at the Akademiya has improved immensely since Azar and his ilk were deposed.

assumed.name: Mona Megistus
assumed.quote: Mona Megistus the Astrologist said that those who constantly use astrology to obtain things that shouldn't be theirs will eventually lose the

threads.claim: The Traveler sees a vision of a white-haired man claiming human nature begets conflict and ruin, with no explanation.
threads.quote: ???: Human nature begets conflict, and conflict begets ruin. From the beginning, the seeds of wickedness have been...

threads.claim: Kareena has not seen anyone on stage, so the white-haired man remains unexplained and possibly hidden.
threads.quote: Kareena: Really? I didn't see any such person. Could I ask when you saw him?

threads.claim: The Wanderer has a secret agreement that keeps his reasons for joining the Championship hidden.
threads.quote: Traveler: Hmph, I'll tell you this much: I have an agreement with someone not to reveal my motives.

threads.claim: Nahida's intervention is revealed as the reason the Wanderer was enrolled in Vahumana as Hat Guy.
threads.quote: Traveler: So it was Nahida's doing...

threads.claim: Dori claims to hold hard-to-find secret information about the Extravaganza, which is left unrevealed.
threads.quote: I don't know who you saw just now, but I do have some hard-to-come-by information about the Extravaganza.

threads.claim: Someone suspicious is watching the Traveler in the city, hinting at hidden Eremite activity.
threads.quote: Traveler: I thought I saw someone just now...

threads.claim: Kaveh's father died in the desert after running into quicksand.
threads.quote: Kaveh: ...Not that he'll have the chance to celebrate. My father passed away many years ago. They say he ran into quicksand while traveling in the desert.

threads.claim: Layla's sleepwalking first brought her to Aaru Village, where Candace cared for her.
threads.quote: Layla: Oh, yeah... it has been some time. The first time I ever woke up after sleepwalking, I somehow found myself in Aaru Village.

threads.claim: Using astrology for things not meant for oneself costs the user the blessing from the stars.
threads.quote: Mona Megistus the Astrologist said that those who constantly use astrology to obtain things that shouldn't be theirs will eventually lose the

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali plans for the Akademiya to recruit talent from the desert starting next year.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali and the sages came up with a plan for the Akademiya to recruit talented people from the desert, starting next year.

threads.claim: Layla catches the last Swiftfly and returns it, completing the first round.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: It seems we have a third contestant who has returned with a Swiftfly.

introduced.name: Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala
introduced.how: a poetry festival jointly hosted by Liyue and Mondstadt
introduced.quote: In the spirit of friendship and poetry-sharing, I managed to successfully organize the "Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala"!

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: Liyue's versemonger and co-host of the gala
introduced.quote: We are your hosts: Liyue's versemonger of the darkest alleys, Hu Tao...

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: Mondstadt's liquor-loving bard and co-host of the gala
introduced.quote: ...And Mondstadt's liquor-loving lyricist, Venti the bard!

introduced.name: Mika
introduced.how: a Knight of Favonius sent to maintain order and set up the venue
introduced.quote: We were sent here by the Knights of Favonius to help maintain order and set up the venue.

introduced.name: Noelle
introduced.how: a Knight of Favonius trainee who hauled the venue's tables and chairs from Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Noelle brought all these tables and chairs here from Mondstadt by herself...

introduced.name: Diona
introduced.how: a tavern mixologist sent by The Cat's Tail to represent Mondstadt's wine industry
introduced.quote: That's right. I was specially asked to attend this event on behalf of The Cat's Tail, and I'm also here as a mixologist representing the Mondstadt wine industry.

introduced.name: Chongyun
introduced.how: an exorcist who reports seeing a floating, transparent nonhuman entity
introduced.quote: Basically, while I was training this morning, I suddenly caught sight of a nonhuman entity.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: a funeral parlor whose director Hu Tao donates the prize coupon
introduced.quote: A most generous donation by yours truly as Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

introduced.name: Cecilia
introduced.how: a high-peak flower many Mondstadters regard as the true Windblume
introduced.quote: the Cecilia is held by many Mondstadters to be the true "Windblume."

introduced.name: City of Wine and Song
introduced.how: Mondstadt's nickname
introduced.quote: Mondstadt is the "City of Wine and Song"!

introduced.name: Riddle Me This
introduced.how: the first theme of the gala, a riddle game where guessers earn points
introduced.quote: Let's get right to it! The first theme is... "Riddle Me This"!

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: ...I already told you. I'm not going.

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace
assumed.quote: It took me much trekking across the land to petition Yujing Terrace and contact the Knights of Favonius, but eventually...

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Do you still remember the promise I made to the distinguished Director Hu here during the Lantern Rite?

assumed.name: Windrise
assumed.quote: Remember that time in Liyue when Paimon gave you the first half of a couplet, "Windrise's winds never churn"?

assumed.name: Master Jean
assumed.quote: Anyway, Master Jean did say that as long as we keep on top of our work, we should take a look around while we're here

assumed.name: Miss Lisa
assumed.quote: If I'd known we'd be doing this sooner... I would've asked Miss Lisa to recommend some books on the topic.

assumed.name: Pure-yang spirit
assumed.quote: At first, I thought I'd finally encountered a demon that wasn't repelled by my pure-yang spirit, and immediately prepared to exorcise it.

threads.claim: A transparent, nonhuman entity floats without support and vanishes when approached, and its true nature is unknown.
threads.quote: It was floating in the air without any kind of external aid, and its body was almost transparent.

threads.claim: Venti judges the entity not to be an evil spirit or demon and therefore not dangerous, though its identity remains unresolved.
threads.quote: Hehe, I can't be absolutely certain, but I'm reasonably sure it's not what Liyue would call an "evil spirit" or "demon." So whatever it is, it's not dangerous.

threads.claim: Xiao is bound by karma that makes him avoid the raucous gathering, hinting at a personal burden.
threads.quote: Besides, afflicted with karma as I am, the raucous atmosphere you are cultivating is precisely the kind which I must avoid, as you well know.

introduced.name: Darknight Hero
introduced.how: a wealthy, Vision-wielding vigilante who acts at night and is not affiliated with the Knights
introduced.quote: the Darknight Hero is a wealthy, Vision-wielding vigilante who is not affiliated with the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Diluc
introduced.how: the Darknight Hero is Diluc, the winery owner and bartender at Angel's Share
introduced.quote: Paimon: The Darknight Hero is Master Diluc!?

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: a tavern in Mondstadt where the Darknight Hero rumor is told and where Diluc works
introduced.quote: Inside Angel's Share in the City of Mondstadt, Charles tells the Traveler and Paimon a tale of rumors about a certain Darknight Hero have been circulating around Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Charles
introduced.how: the bartender at Angel's Share who tells the Darknight Hero rumor
introduced.quote: Charles: So you've got a taste for adventure too, huh?

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: a hostile group that declares war on the Darknight Hero and plans an attack on Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Huffman has informed the Traveler that the Abyss Order is waging war against the Darknight Hero through a letter they obtained.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: the official guard organization of Mondstadt, whose residence Lawrence checked for the Hero
introduced.quote: So instead, I headed to the Knights of Favonius' residence.

introduced.name: Huffman
introduced.how: a Knights of Favonius officer who investigates the Darknight Hero and suspects Diluc
introduced.quote: Huffman: Greetings. I thought I heard something, so I came to check it out.

introduced.name: Kaeya
introduced.how: a Knights of Favonius captain who orders Huffman to watch Diluc
introduced.quote: Kaeya: Lately, Master Diluc has been working the bar at the Angel's Share every night.

introduced.name: Landrich
introduced.how: a Hydro Abyss Mage captured at a stronghold who reveals the attack time
introduced.quote: The two infiltrate the stronghold and confront Landrich, a Hydro Abyss Mage and quickly defeat it.

introduced.name: Mist Flower Corolla
introduced.how: a flower gathered for Diluc's plan; its extract attracts slimes
introduced.quote: asks them to bring him some Mist Flower Corolla in the nearby area.

introduced.name: Connor
introduced.how: the winery's master brewer who extracts Mist Flower essence
introduced.quote: Diluc: Allow me to introduce the winery's master brewer—

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: Diluc's winery, which runs its own intelligence network
introduced.quote: Diluc: The Dawn Winery's intelligence network extends beyond commercial matters.

introduced.name: Slimes drawn to elemental energy
introduced.how: slimes are irresistibly drawn to substances that carry elemental energy
introduced.quote: Diluc: Slimes need to extract elemental energy to survive... For them, this substance is simply irresistible.

introduced.name: Donna
introduced.how: a girl once rescued by the Darknight Hero who used to be interested in Diluc
introduced.quote: Donna: But ever since the time I was rescued by the Darknight Hero... I—I just don't know anymore...

introduced.name: Lawrence
introduced.how: a guard who saw the Darknight Hero dealing with a gang at night and fled
introduced.quote: Lawrence: In fact, I'm one of the few who has seen him with my own two eyes.

introduced.name: Margaret
introduced.how: a townswoman who jokingly claims to be the Hero and is revealed to be the boss of the Cat's Tail
introduced.quote: Paimon: Same difference, you are the boss of the Cat's Tail after all...

assumed.name: Cat's Tail
assumed.quote: Paimon: Same difference, you are the boss of the Cat's Tail after all...

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Traveler: A flash of fire... a Vision, perhaps?

assumed.name: Dandelion Wine
assumed.quote: Huffman: I'll have a Dandelion Wine, I suppose.

assumed.name: Abyss Mage
assumed.quote: Abyss Mage: How did you find me here!? Favonian scum!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...Aw, but Paimon forgot to bring her coin pouch! , do you have any Mora on you?

assumed.name: Diluc and Kaeya's past feud
assumed.quote: Diluc: I should have known he would see this as the perfect opportunity to get back at me.

threads.claim: The Darknight Hero is a rumored masked vigilante whose identity nobody knows, and his reasons for hiding are unclear.
threads.quote: Charles: I doubt anyone knows but him.

threads.claim: The Darknight Hero is revealed to be Diluc, the winery owner who works at Angel's Share.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Darknight Hero is Master Diluc!?

threads.claim: Kaeya claims to have a hunch about the Darknight Hero's identity but admits he is sometimes wrong.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Who knows...? It's just a hunch. I've been known to be wrong on occasion.

threads.claim: Kaeya secretly watched the whole Alibi plan unfold, so how he knew the identity remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Kaeya: I just picked a good spot to quietly sit and watch the show.

threads.claim: Parts of the Abyss Order's war declaration are written in a cipher that the Knights cannot read.
threads.quote: Huffman: Indeed. Although this is written in the common tongue, it appears that a cipher has been used in many places.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order plans a march on Mondstadt, and the attack is set for the next night at 10 PM.
threads.quote: Abyss Mage: They... They will march on the Mondstadt at 10 PM tomorrow night.

threads.claim: Diluc has an unspoken past with the Knights of Favonius that he refuses to discuss.
threads.quote: Diluc: What's past is past. I would prefer not to discuss it.

threads.claim: The Knights' offer of protection to the Darknight Hero is a ruse to take exclusive control of the matter.
threads.quote: Huffman: The offer of protection is just a ruse, in order for the Knights of Favonius to take over full — and exclusive — responsibility for this matter.

introduced.name: Illuga
introduced.how: Lightkeeper captain leading the operation, young but among the strongest
introduced.quote: Anleifr: Ahem. Our captain may be young, but he's one of the strongest among us. So don’t use him as your baseline, you hear?

introduced.name: Anleifr
introduced.how: former treasure hunter who lost his wife and fellow hunters to the Wild Hunt, now a Lightkeeper
introduced.quote: Anleifr: My fellow treasure hunters, my wife, I lost them all in that incident... It happened so fast that we couldn't even put up a real fight...!

introduced.name: Rollon
introduced.how: Lightkeeper who was on another assignment during the Kipumaki attack and is Ivar's brother
introduced.quote: Rollon: I'm Rollon. Lets watch each others' backs out there in the field.

introduced.name: Bjorn
introduced.how: Lightkeeper who was pulled from Olsson's squad that night and is mortally wounded by the Evil Eye
introduced.quote: Bjorn: Just call me Bjorn. If the captain chose you, I have faith in your abilities.

introduced.name: Ivar
introduced.how: Rollon's brother, badly injured three years ago and saved by Captain Olsson
introduced.quote: Rollon: My brother and I... we were the lucky ones. My brother's Ivar, by the way. The captain saved him.

introduced.name: Olsson
introduced.how: former captain who held the cliff three years ago and died there
introduced.quote: Illuga: We lost far too many that night... Captain Olsson kept himself together through sheer willpower, but with just the two of us, there was nothing we could do...

introduced.name: Veyde
introduced.how: fallen Lightkeeper who took Bjorn's place in Olsson's squad
introduced.quote: Bjorn: But me? I was pulled from Captain Olsson's squad at the last minute because I suddenly got sick. Veyde took my place, and because of that, he...

introduced.name: Scourge of Endless Decay
introduced.how: undying monster that speaks through fog, manipulates minds, and is hard to kill
introduced.quote: Scourge of Endless Decay: Hoho... I think I'll start with you...

introduced.name: Evil Eye
introduced.how: giant monster that fires Abyssal beams at the barrier altars and Verdant Crests
introduced.quote: Anleifr: That Evil Eye... it attacked before the barrier could be fully deployed! The altar ruins have been wrecked...

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: organized defenders who hold the front line against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: Anleifr: Hey now, none of that, 'aight? I've been a member of the Lightkeepers for three years. I'm an upstanding Ratnik nowadays.

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: Lightkeeper soldiers who were cornered by the Scourge in the field
introduced.quote: (The Traveler, Paimon, and Illuga arrive to find several Ratniki cornered by the Scourge of Endless Decay)

introduced.name: Kipumaki Cliff
introduced.how: cliff that is the front line against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: Anleifr: This is the front line we're holding against the Wild Hunt on Kipumaki Cliff. You shouldn't be here.

introduced.name: Cliffwatch Camp
introduced.how: forward camp the squad must seize and hold as the operation's lifeline
introduced.quote: Illuga: Bjorn, Anleifr, Rollon, return to Cliffwatch Camp at once.

introduced.name: Piramida
introduced.how: city where the Lightkeepers report and the old man directs operations
introduced.quote: Rollon: I don't even know when it all finally stopped. I only remember fighting until I had nothing left... and when I opened my eyes again, I was already back in Piramida.

introduced.name: Hiisi Island
introduced.how: island where Bjorn studied ancient Frostmoon Scions texts
introduced.quote: Bjorn: When I visited Hiisi Island, I borrowed some ancient Frostmoon Scions texts from the current Moonchanter.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: ancient group whose texts and Moonchanter relate to the sealing array
introduced.quote: Bjorn: The sealing array on Kipumaki Cliff was left to us by the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Torchforger
introduced.how: ancient figure who left the sealing array on Kipumaki Cliff
introduced.quote: Bjorn: The sealing array on Kipumaki Cliff was left to us by the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Silver Lampwick
introduced.how: relic whose power restores the barrier on the cliff
introduced.quote: Illuga: To prevent that, we'll use the Silver Lampwick's power to restore the barrier on the cliff.

introduced.name: Verdant Crest
introduced.how: relic focal points of the sealing array that flash in response to the barrier
introduced.quote: Bjorn: While deploying the barrier earlier, I noticed three Verdant Crests on the cliff flashing in response, almost as if they were resonating with it.

introduced.name: sealing array
introduced.how: ancient seal whose foci must be activated to hold back the Abyss
introduced.quote: Bjorn: However, the texts say that the sealing array should have four foci. For some reason, the most important one isn't resonating.

introduced.name: Spiralblade
introduced.how: sacred ancient blade the Torchforger used to seal demons, now seized by the monster
introduced.quote: Illuga: That was likely the Spiralblade, the sacred blade the Torchforger once used to seal demons away.

introduced.name: Professor Rotwang
introduced.how: the Scourge's exalted master who has set out to tear apart the false world
introduced.quote: Scourge of Endless Decay: The Professor... Professor Rotwang... My exalted master... He has already set out...

introduced.name: Alia (Historical)
introduced.how: guardian who preserves a final spark of kuuvahki at the Pillar of Embla
introduced.quote: (An Abyssal fragment enters the top of the tower, corrupting the final spark of kuuvahki preserved by Alia)

introduced.name: Pillar of Embla
introduced.how: tower under threat from the Professor's forces, guarded by Alia
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uh oh... things look reeeeal bad around the Pillar of Embla...

introduced.name: Kipumaki Cliff massacre
introduced.how: three years ago the Wild Hunt on the cliff killed many Lightkeepers and civilians after minds were turned
introduced.quote: Illuga: The Wild Hunt on the cliff may have abilities different from those elsewhere. Three years ago, we paid for that difference in blood.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're adventurers, but we've got a lot of experience fighting the Abyss, so we won't slow you down!

assumed.name: Silver Lampwick retrieval
assumed.quote: Illuga: Before we begin, let me do the introductions. and Paimon are the adventurers I mentioned earlier, the ones who helped retrieve the Silver Lampwick.

assumed.name: Wind-Stirred Ripples meeting with Anleifr and Rollon
assumed.quote: Anleifr: What a coincidence. Didn't think I'd run into you here again...

assumed.name: Aedon
assumed.quote: Illuga: Aedon! Give your help!

assumed.name: Kuuvahki
assumed.quote: (The Traveler and Illuga fire a kuuvahki light blast that destroys the Evil Eye)

assumed.name: Moonlane
assumed.quote: (While riding the Moonlane)

assumed.name: Chasm of Endless Decay
assumed.quote: (Drop down into the Chasm of Endless Decay and approach the marked area)

assumed.name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
assumed.quote: (The Scourge of Endless Decay takes on the form of a Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares)

threads.claim: The Scourge seems to know Illuga's past failures, hinting at a connection between the monster and Illuga's history.
threads.quote: Voice From the Monster: Three years ago... Ten years ago... Always the same. Why not... ask him for some tips? Heh...

threads.claim: Illuga's retreat three years ago, ordered by Olsson, becomes a source of guilt that the Scourge exploits.
threads.quote: Illuga: After that, as the main force of the Wild Hunt pushed in, the captain ordered me to retreat and bring the unconscious, badly injured Ivar back for help.

threads.claim: Professor Rotwang plans to tear apart the veil of this false world, a threat beyond the Scourge.
threads.quote: Scourge of Endless Decay: Soon... very soon... he will tear apart the veil of this false world...

threads.claim: The Professor intends to ascend his tower and open a path to an Elysium beyond.
threads.quote: Scourge of Endless Decay: Soon... very soon... The Professor will ascend his tower... and open the path to the Elysium beyond...

threads.claim: The Abyssal assault on the Pillar of Embla puts Alia's safety in question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is... Is Miss Alia gonna be ok?

threads.claim: The sealing array should have four foci, but the most important one is not resonating, so the seal is incomplete.
threads.quote: Bjorn: However, the texts say that the sealing array should have four foci. For some reason, the most important one isn't resonating.

threads.claim: The Spiralblade fell into the underground ruins and may be the key to striking the monster down.
threads.quote: Illuga: The Spiralblade... It must have fallen into the underground ruins.

threads.claim: The Spiralblade is used with kuuvahki to banish the Scourge and cleanse the cavern.
threads.quote: (The Traveler and Illuga use kuuvahki to launch the Spiralblade at the Abyssal rift, banishing the Scourge of Endless Decay and cleansing the surrounding cavern)

threads.claim: The Scourge escapes into a rift as an Abyssal fragment, leaving open whether it can return.
threads.quote: (The Scourge of Endless Decay dissolves into a fragment of Abyssal energy and flies into the rift on the ceiling)

introduced.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
introduced.how: introduces herself as a yumekui-baku psychologist who works at Aisa Bathhouse
introduced.quote: I'm a yumekui-baku, which is a kind of youkai here in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Yumekui-baku
introduced.how: youkai that eat bad dreams but must be in a dream of their own to digest them
introduced.quote: Baku feast on the bad dreams of human beings — but we need to be in a dream of our own to digest them.

introduced.name: Aisa Bathhouse
introduced.how: a bathhouse staffed by clinical psychologists offering spa, dining, and therapy
introduced.quote: Staffed by clinical psychologists and offering spa and fine dining services, we invite you to bring us your troubles and leave refreshed and renewed

introduced.name: Aikawa Susumu
introduced.how: the bathhouse manager, who explains Mizuki is the major shareholder
introduced.quote: I am, yes, but Miss Yumemizuki is a major shareholder. The business never would've gotten off the ground without her investment...

introduced.name: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
introduced.how: a baku staff member introduced by Mizuki who uses food in therapy
introduced.quote: The panicky little girl is Hyakujitsuhaku Shion, and the lazy lady is Shiba Murasaki. They're both baku, just like me.

introduced.name: Shiba Murasaki
introduced.how: a baku staff member introduced by Mizuki as the lazy-seeming one
introduced.quote: The panicky little girl is Hyakujitsuhaku Shion, and the lazy lady is Shiba Murasaki. They're both baku, just like me.

introduced.name: Little Baku
introduced.how: a small baku companion that is the original form of the baku
introduced.quote: That's what we look like in our original form.

introduced.name: Emura Ichigensai
introduced.how: a rival spiritual counselor who takes away clients' troubles and operates on Narukami Island
introduced.quote: His name is Emura Ichigensai. He operates right here on Narukami Island, and his methods are said to be quite revolutionary.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Mizuki's old friend who became a Guuji and urges her to sell shares
introduced.quote: We've known each other since before I became the Guuji.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publisher Miko recommends investing in
introduced.quote: You could always invest in the Yae Publishing House, you know... Business is always booming.

introduced.name: Susukida
introduced.how: a client of Emura Ichigensai who praises his counselling and calls Aisa Bathhouse a scam
introduced.quote: who praise Emura Ichigensai for taking all their problems away and leaving only happy thoughts

introduced.name: Umihiko
introduced.how: a client of Emura Ichigensai who praises his counselling and calls Aisa Bathhouse a scam
introduced.quote: who praise Emura Ichigensai for taking all their problems away and leaving only happy thoughts

introduced.name: Kanai
introduced.how: the clinic attendant who runs the queue and ticket system
introduced.quote: Pay first, take a ticket, then wait your turn.

introduced.name: Kuroyume
introduced.how: a youkai who claims to be the last of his kind and escapes after possessing Emura Chuuya
introduced.quote: The youkai introduces himself as Kuroyume, who is the last of his kind.

introduced.name: Nightmare monster
introduced.how: the natural enemy of yumekui-baku that lives in nightmares
introduced.quote: Mizuki identifies it as a nightmare monster, the natural enemy of yumekui-baku as they resides in nightmares.

introduced.name: Borderland
introduced.how: a hidden space within Inazuma's collective subconscious where Kuroyume has his hideout
introduced.quote: Kuroyume appears again and he brings them into the borderland, a hidden space deep within Inazuma's collective subconscious

introduced.name: Emura Chuuya
introduced.how: a former patient with a terrible temper, revealed as the real identity of Emura Ichigensai
introduced.quote: suspects Emura Ichigensai is actually Emura Chuuya, a former patient with a terrible temper.

introduced.name: Emura Chuuya's rejection
introduced.how: his past rejection by his father and classmates for wanting to be a writer
introduced.quote: rejection by his father for aspiring to be a writer and from his classmates

introduced.name: Kuroyume
introduced.how: Introduces himself as the last of the nightmare-monsters and a long-lost enemy of the yumekui-baku
introduced.quote: My name is Kuroyume, and I am the last of my kind.

introduced.name: Emura Chuuya
introduced.how: Reveals that the counsellor Emura Ichigensai once went by the name Emura Chuuya, a man who came to Mizuki for therapy
introduced.quote: a guy matching Emura Ichigensai's description came to Mizuki for therapy once

introduced.name: Yumekui-baku
introduced.how: Learns that the yumekui-baku eat human nightmares, which made them natural enemies of nightmare-monsters
introduced.quote: We yumekui-baku eat the nightmares of humans, while they called those nightmares their home.

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: Learns that a youkai is a fearsome nightmare monster that once plagued Inazuma
introduced.quote: A fearsome youkai that was once the bane of Inazuma.

introduced.name: Borderland
introduced.how: Learns the borderland is a dream within a dream hidden in the collective Inazuman subconscious
introduced.quote: A space hidden deep within the collective Inazuman subconscious.

introduced.name: Fall of the nightmare-monsters
introduced.how: Learns that the nightmare-monsters declined because their hosts were fragile and died out
introduced.quote: Ultimately, the fall of the nightmare-monsters was the fault of our hosts.

introduced.name: Sweet dreams
introduced.how: Learns that sweet dreams are a power that can rival nightmares and can be gathered from people
introduced.quote: We need a power to rival his nightmares... the power of sweet dreams.

introduced.name: Emotional fragments
introduced.how: Learns that emotional fragments in a nightmare let the player feel the underlying emotion up close
introduced.quote: Every time we draw near to one of these fragments, we'll experience the underlying emotion on a visceral level.

introduced.name: Dream digestion
introduced.how: Learns that yumekui-baku digest dreams depending on emotional intensity, not just quantity
introduced.quote: Our ability to digest dreams isn't just a matter of quantity.

assumed.name: Tanuki
assumed.quote: Ahh, remember when we chased that tanuki down this way? Good times!

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: You know where we haven't been in a while? Inazuma.

assumed.name: Guuji
assumed.quote: We've known each other since before I became the Guuji.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: the whole reason everyone's coming to this guy is because they're worried about getting scammed out of their Mora.

assumed.name: Sweet dreams
assumed.quote: In a last-ditch effort, the Traveler offers their own sweet dream to Mizuki, restoring her strength.

assumed.name: Emura Ichigensai
assumed.quote: they did say they were gonna get counselling from Emura Ichigensai again

assumed.name: Susukida and Umihiko
assumed.quote: do you still remember visiting Aisa Bathhouse last night for dream regulation therapy?

assumed.name: Aisa Bathhouse
assumed.quote: Mizuki, we're here to book our next therapy appointment

assumed.name: Murasaki and Shion
assumed.quote: Murasaki and Shion are sick, and it's all because of your bad dreams!

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: It's been a while, Lady Guuji.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: To the Grand Narukami Shrine!

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: But I do have a message from the Tenryou Commission to pass on, as it happens.

assumed.name: Yumekui-baku fishing rescue
assumed.quote: The gentleman who your fellow yumekui-baku fished out of the water last night

threads.claim: Emura Ichigensai's background and true identity are a mystery no one can uncover.
threads.quote: Something of a mystery. I tried to look into his background when he first started poaching my customers, but I couldn't find anything.

threads.claim: Emura Ichigensai is revealed to be the former patient Emura Chuuya.
threads.quote: ...It's him. I remember him.

threads.claim: Emura Ichigensai claims he can erase clients' troubles entirely, which raises doubt about his methods.
threads.quote: But I can remove these defective feelings, leaving your mind healthy, whole, and free of distressing thoughts.

threads.claim: Mizuki finds that the troubles of Emura's clients were never removed, only hidden from their conscious minds.
threads.quote: Mizuki promptly enters their subconscious minds and realized that their troubles were never gone, it was only isolated from their conscious minds and will continue to fester.

threads.claim: The Traveler experiences a nightmare of a hostile eye during the wait.
threads.quote: The Traveler fell asleep during the wait and experiences a nightmare of an eye that attacks her.

threads.claim: The entity possessing Emura Chuuya is revealed to be the same eye from the Traveler's nightmare.
threads.quote: At last, the entity possessing Emura Chuuya emerges from him and it is the same eye from the Traveler's nightmare.

threads.claim: Kuroyume, the last of his kind, has found a way to revive his species.
threads.quote: Before they can stop him, he escapes, having already found a way to revive his kind.

threads.claim: The Traveler seems to have no bad dreams despite many buried negative emotions, which Mizuki finds unusual.
threads.quote: You're a unique case, as I suspected.

threads.claim: The Traveler carries significant baggage from their past that is buried deep.
threads.quote: I... do have quite a lot of baggage from my past...

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether forgetting one's troubles would erase who they are.
threads.quote: Would I even still be me?

threads.claim: Mizuki accidentally ate one of the Traveler's good dreams while digesting nightmares.
threads.quote: I ate one of your dreams, but it wasn't a bad one. It was a nice one.

threads.claim: The Traveler gives their own sweet dream to Mizuki to restore her strength in the final battle.
threads.quote: In a last-ditch effort, the Traveler offers their own sweet dream to Mizuki, restoring her strength.

threads.claim: Digesting bad dreams makes Mizuki feel every negative emotion within them, which is why she cries.
threads.quote: When I digest them, I feel them all for myself.

threads.claim: Mizuki and Miko disagree fundamentally about how to make people happy.
threads.quote: Miko and I disagree quite significantly over the question of how to make people happy.

threads.claim: Mizuki admits she feels inferior to Miko, and that feeling has pushed her to persevere.
threads.quote: She admits to feeling inferior to Miko, but those very feelings have given her the strength to persevere.

threads.claim: The Aisa Bathhouse is struggling to attract customers and its finances are in doubt.
threads.quote: We've been struggling to attract customers recently

threads.claim: With Emura Chuuya stopped, the bathhouse's business returns to normal.
threads.quote: With Emura Chuuya no longer posing a threat, business has returned to normal.

threads.claim: Kuroyume claims he has found a way to revive his extinct kind of nightmare-monsters.
threads.quote: But now, I have found a way to revive my kind, and you are too late to stop me!

threads.claim: Mizuki warns that Kuroyume would effectively revive his kind by placing copies of himself in every dream.
threads.quote: If he succeeds, then he'll have effectively revived his kind already...

threads.claim: The counsellor Emura Ichigensai may be the same man who once called himself Emura Chuuya.
threads.quote: a guy matching Emura Ichigensai's description came to Mizuki for therapy once

threads.claim: Emura Ichigensai is confirmed to be Emura Chuuya, the man Mizuki once treated.
threads.quote: Emura Chuuya... So it is you.

threads.claim: The victims of the counselling seem to feel only happiness because their negative emotions were hidden away.
threads.quote: That's why on the outside, the only emotion they appear to feel is happiness.

threads.claim: Kuroyume argues that his happiness is no different from the good that yumekui-baku bring, which Mizuki rejects as a lie.
threads.quote: Both of us bring happiness to humans now.

threads.claim: Mizuki teaches that negative emotions never disappear and are essential to a healthy psyche.
threads.quote: Negative emotions do not just go away — they will always be there. This is true for everyone.

threads.claim: Sweet dreams are presented as a counter-power to nightmares that Mizuki needs to gather.
threads.quote: We need a power to rival his nightmares... the power of sweet dreams.

threads.claim: The Traveler's own dream proves stronger than the monster's power, showing sweet dreams can defeat nightmares.
threads.quote: The power that you have gained by processing everything from your long journey is surely far stronger than any power wielded by that creature.

threads.claim: The borderland connects to every human's dream in the nation, so Kuroyume can place copies of himself in all of them.
threads.quote: This place is connected to the dreams of every human in the nation.

threads.claim: Mizuki wishes that people could deal with their own nightmares so more can have happy dreams, but she has not yet achieved it.
threads.quote: Haha, a naive one, more like. Even though I've run this business for quite a long time now, it still hasn't come true — not even once.

threads.claim: Yae Miko secretly asks the Traveler and Paimon to keep her role in helping Mizuki hidden.
threads.quote: Don't tell Mizuki about our conversation, by the way.

threads.claim: Mizuki reveals she knew Yae Miko had secretly helped her and says Miko is worse at keeping secrets than she is.
threads.quote: Come on, Miko. You've always been worse than me at keeping secrets.

introduced.name: Arama
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an Aranara who is scared of Nara but trusts the Traveler
introduced.quote: I'm Arama. Arana may trust both of you, but everyone here is very scared seeing Nara in Vanarana.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: The Aranara home is a dream copy; the real Vanarana is hidden inside it
introduced.quote: This isn't Vanarana. Ah, actually... This is Vanarana, but not the real Vanarana.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Tiny forest beings who once lived openly with Nara and all creatures
introduced.quote: A long time ago, Aranara walked the earth and made friends with Nara and all living creatures.

introduced.name: Arana
introduced.how: A cherished Aranara friend who guides the Traveler and sends them to Vanarana
introduced.quote: Arana will take care of her. She is a most cherished friend.

introduced.name: Rhythm of the Great Dream
introduced.how: A song that must be played to enter Vanarana
introduced.quote: in order to reach Vanarana, they'll need to play the Rhythm of the Great Dream to enter.

introduced.name: Vintage Lyre
introduced.how: An instrument from a Mondstadt bard that Amadhiah lends to the Traveler
introduced.quote: acquires a Vintage Lyre that Amadhiah got from a bard from Mondstadt that visited the village.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: Made by feeding a Vasoma Fruit to the Ashvattha Tree; origin of the Aranara and needed to heal Rana
introduced.quote: A Bija can be formed by feeding a Vasoma Fruit to the Ashvattha Tree. It's a great tree planted by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, and it's the origin of Aranara.

introduced.name: Festival Utsava
introduced.how: A festival that must be held so the Bija gathers enough energy
introduced.quote: in order to form a Bija that's healthy, strong, and filled with energy, a Festival Utsava is absolutely necessary.

introduced.name: Vasoma Fruit
introduced.how: A fruit full of dreams and energy, weaker than a Bija but still useful
introduced.quote: The Vasoma Fruit is a fruit filled with dreams and energy!

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: Aranara power drawn from memories and dreams, used to help those in need
introduced.quote: Memories and dreams are Aranara's power, their most precious things.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: The name of death, born when the forest and earth came to understand that all things end
introduced.quote: and so, Marana was born. It is the name of death, and those who know it shall die.

introduced.name: Marana's Avatar
introduced.how: Tall, dark, warped heralds of death chosen by Marana who take many forms
introduced.quote: As for the tall, dark, and warped beings, they are the avatars chosen by Marana, the heralds of death.

introduced.name: Silapna
introduced.how: A runed structure that is played to enter or leave the dream of Vanarana
introduced.quote: How rude. "Silapna" isn't a stone.

introduced.name: Aranyaka
introduced.how: A notebook given to the Traveler to record memories and stories of the forest
introduced.quote: called it the Aranyaka because it's the stories of adventures in the forest with us Aranara.

introduced.name: Araja
introduced.how: Village elder who explains how the Bija is made and why the festival is needed
introduced.quote: I haven't seen one in so long. So tall and golden, just like said. Welcome to Vanarana.

introduced.name: Arakavi
introduced.how: Introduced by Arama as an Aranara who shakes hands with the Traveler
introduced.quote: This is Arakavi. You guys shake hands.

introduced.name: Araesha
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an Aranara who sets riddles for Nara
introduced.quote: Nara friend! Arama has told many stories of you. You are a Nara full of courage and wisdom.

introduced.name: Sudabeh's disappearance
introduced.how: Sudabeh was the first child to go missing in the forest while gathering herbs
introduced.quote: Sudabeh was the first to go missing. She went into the forest to gather herbs for Grandpa Amadhiah.

introduced.name: Memory removal of the children
introduced.how: Arana put the missing children to sleep and removed bad dreams so they would not turn bad
introduced.quote: Arana made little Nara sleep and dream, then removed the bad stuff in their dreams.

introduced.name: Destruction of Vanarana
introduced.how: The real Vanarana was destroyed long ago and the Aranara began living in a dream
introduced.quote: But after Vanarana was destroyed once, we started living in this dream.

introduced.name: Tree of Dreams
introduced.how: Araja is the Tree of Dreams and cannot leave the dream of Vanarana
introduced.quote: Araja reveals that he cannot leave Vanarana's dream because he is the

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Forest dream-dwelling folk who made dreams their home and distanced themselves from Nara after a catastrophe
introduced.quote: Since then, Aranara made dreams their home and distanced themselves from Nara.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: The Aranara dreamscape, a realm with no day or night, tranquil and peaceful
introduced.quote: In Vanarana's dreamscape, there is no day and night.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: A fruit made from extracted dreams and memories, a seed of hope that can realize wishes meant to help others
introduced.quote: Bija is a fruit made from extracted dreams and memories — the crystallization of all that is precious to us Aranara.

introduced.name: Festival Utsava
introduced.how: An Aranara festival whose centerpiece is a song duet between a Nara and the Aranara song gatherers
introduced.quote: Yeah, the singing of a Nara friend with Aranara is the most important part of the festival in the story!

introduced.name: Nara Varuna
introduced.how: A past Nara who befriended Aranara, helped heal Vanarana, and never told them their real name
introduced.quote: Um... No idea. Nara Varuna never told us real name.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: A corrupting force that makes trees and flowers speak of death so that they wither
introduced.quote: Marana will speak of the horrors of death to the trees and flowers it corrodes.

introduced.name: Arayasa
introduced.how: An Aranara song gatherer who collects songs and speaks in poetic lines while learning Nara songs
introduced.quote: Yes. Arayasa is one of the "song gatherers" who collect songs of all kinds.

introduced.name: Araji
introduced.how: A past timid Aranara who hid in quiet places and sang softly; his songs can open unknown paths
introduced.quote: Araji is a... timid friend who liked to hide in quiet places and sing softly.

introduced.name: Vasara Tree
introduced.how: Ancient trees that bear Vasoma Fruits and can anchor dreams
introduced.quote: Vasara Trees bear Vasoma Fruits! We should help them, !

introduced.name: Vasoma Fruit
introduced.how: A fruit borne by Vasara Trees, offered at the Fane of Ashvattha to produce Bija
introduced.quote: We're going to offer the Vasoma Fruit at the Fane of Ashvattha. Then we can produce the Bija with Arana!

introduced.name: Vasmrti
introduced.how: The substance needed to make the nursery grow Viparyas, collected from nurseries outside the dream
introduced.quote: To make the nursery grow Viparyas, Vasmrti is needed.

introduced.name: Viparyas
introduced.how: Plants Aranara tend with music and praise; happy Viparyas make lanterns for Festival Utsava
introduced.quote: Happy Viparyas make happy lanterns, and happy lanterns light the happy Festival Utsava...

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: Beings that were once spores, grown stronger with Nara help; they dream and hide from Marana
introduced.quote: Fungi can dream too. When Marana came, many Fungi went hiding in their dreams, shunning Marana.

introduced.name: Gloomy Path
introduced.how: A dream path that opens when Araji's song is sung at the correct place
introduced.quote: Singing Araji's song at the correct place should open the path towards Ashvattha's Concourse.

introduced.name: Ashvattha's Concourses
introduced.how: Hidden dream sites reached through Araji's song that contain a Vasara Tree
introduced.quote: You'll be able to open the path to Ashvattha's Concourse located here.

introduced.name: Rishboland Tiger
introduced.how: Tigers that are friends of the Aranara and play games with them
introduced.quote: The Rishboland Tiger and Aranara are friends, and friends play together.

introduced.name: Aranara flower
introduced.how: A flower given as a symbol of Aranara friendship; accepting it means accepting Aranara friendship
introduced.quote: This type of flower is a symbol of Aranara friendship.

introduced.name: Nara catastrophe
introduced.how: A long-ago disaster that destroyed Vanarana and made Aranara distance themselves from Nara
introduced.quote: A very long time ago, Vanarana was destroyed in that Nara catastrophe.

introduced.name: unknown Aranara
introduced.how: An unnamed, hundreds-of-years-old Aranara who absorbs memories and gives the Traveler a flower
introduced.quote: ???: How nostalgic. It's been hundreds of years since I last saw such a sight...

introduced.name: Arasudraka
introduced.how: introduces self as a song gatherer who collects songs and admires the Golden Nara
introduced.quote: Arama: Yes! Nara and Paimon! Hello! This is Arasudraka.

introduced.name: song gatherer
introduced.how: a kind of Aranara who collects songs of all sorts
introduced.quote: Arama: Yes! Arasudraka is a "song gatherer" and often goes to collect all sorts of songs.

introduced.name: Anemo Archon of Mondstadt
introduced.how: a green-clad archon who is also a bard and could carry songs on the wind
introduced.quote: Paimon: No, no! He is the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt, and also a bard.

introduced.name: Vasara Tree
introduced.how: a tree that bears Vasoma Fruits and whose dream the Traveler can enter
introduced.quote: Paimon: Vasara Trees bear Vasoma Fruits! We should help them, !

introduced.name: Vasoma Fruit
introduced.how: a precious fruit made of gathered dreams and memories that restores an Aranara's strength
introduced.quote: Arama: It is the accumulation of the dreams and memories gathered by the Vasara Tree. It's a precious fruit that can help us restore our strength.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: a corruption that spreads and turns plants and creatures into Fungi and withered ground
introduced.quote: Arama: Yes. Some Fungi are really afraid of Marana, so they hide in Vasara Tree's dreams.

introduced.name: Withering
introduced.how: a withering zone affected by Marana's corrosion
introduced.quote: Paimon: This place is affected by the Withering. Seems like we've hit a dead end...

introduced.name: Ashvattha's Concourses
introduced.how: sites where Nara and Aranara once played together, now left desolate
introduced.quote: Arama: Ashvattha's Concourses used to be where Nara and Aranara played together. But that was a long time ago.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: a product the Ashvattha Tree makes, requiring a large amount of energy supplied by Vasoma Fruits
introduced.quote: Arama: A large amount of energy must be consumed for the Ashvattha Tree to produce a Bija. That is why we must offer Vasoma Fruits.

introduced.name: Sourcesong
introduced.how: the origin of all songs, into which every song eventually converges
introduced.quote: Arasudraka: Just like all the creeks eventually flow into the sea, all the songs eventually converge into one, into the Sourcesong.

introduced.name: Ashvattha's Tree of Dreams
introduced.how: a tree that keeps Aranara's dreams stable and connects them to the Vasara Tree
introduced.quote: Arama: Nara is smart. This tree keeps Aranara's dreams stable. Aranara can enter or exit dreams and are able to connect with the Vasara Tree.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: a people who can enter and exit dreams and are connected to the Vasara Tree
introduced.quote: Arama: Nara is smart. This tree keeps Aranara's dreams stable. Aranara can enter or exit dreams and are able to connect with the Vasara Tree.

introduced.name: runes
introduced.how: a written inscription Nara use to leave marks behind
introduced.quote: Arama: Yes! This is how we leave marks behind. It's a type of inscription!

introduced.name: Arayama
introduced.how: an Aranara who built phantasmal mazes to frustrate a Nara and later befriended them
introduced.quote: Arama: Arayama didn't really like Nara, so he created the phantasmal barrier. He was happy to see the Nara's frustrated faces.

introduced.name: Aradasa
introduced.how: a silent song gatherer who believes singing is better than talking
introduced.quote: Arama: Oh, Aradasa is a "song gatherer" who collects songs of all kinds. He doesn't like talking. He believes singing is way better.

introduced.name: Aramaha
introduced.how: an Aranara who resisted Marana and whose hidden song lies near a Vasara Tree
introduced.quote: Arama: Yes, Aramaha resisted very hard, and kept Marana under control to the side. If not, the nearby forest would have become even more terrible.

introduced.name: the great catastrophe
introduced.how: a horrible past disaster that devastated Vanarana and emptied the concourses
introduced.quote: Arama: After the horrible, horrible catastrophe occurred, Vanarana was devastated, and the concourses were left desolate...

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Rana has been seriously harmed by Marana.

assumed.name: Amadhiah
assumed.quote: Let's return to Vimara Village and see if Grandpa Amadhiah has one!

assumed.name: Vimara Village
assumed.quote: Returning to Vimara Village, the Traveler talks to Amadhiah

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: It looks like... a Mondstadt-style instrument!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: It would be horrible if the Fatui were behind all of this!

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Arama makes it sound even scarier than Stormterror

assumed.name: Whopperflower
assumed.quote: What if it attracts a Whopperflower?

assumed.name: Iotham
assumed.quote: besides the incidents involving Iotham and Alphonso

assumed.name: Kavus
assumed.quote: Next, Kavus went into the forest to meet a friend and discuss Sudabeh's situation, but he went missing too.

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Traveler: We want to save Rana.

assumed.name: Arana
assumed.quote: Traveler: Arana mentioned the power of memory...

assumed.name: Sarva
assumed.quote: Many children returned to Sarva before they were done growing into Vasara Trees.

assumed.name: Aramuhukunda
assumed.quote: It was Aramuhukunda before me, and there will be other song gatherers after me to make it grow.

assumed.name: Valuka
assumed.quote: It's only troublesome in Valuka.

assumed.name: Withering
assumed.quote: We've seen lots of them in the Withering

assumed.name: Aranyaka
assumed.quote: Let Paimon check the Aranyaka real quick...

assumed.name: Fane of Ashvattha
assumed.quote: That sounds like it had something to do with the concourses we visited before.

assumed.name: Arama
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? That's Arama over there, right? Let's go see what he's up to!

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Arama: Before seeds became saplings, we hid in the leaves together and went to the Dendro Archon's big tree.

assumed.name: Vanagni
assumed.quote: Arama: Impressive! Nara is not afraid of Marana and even drove all the monsters away. No wonder you could defeat Vanagni!

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh! We can help you with that once Rana's healed and everything's over!

assumed.name: Araja
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Araja said that we'll need more than one Vasoma Fruit. That means we need to find other Ashvattha's Concourses, right?

assumed.name: Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: Arasudraka: Yes! Good luck, Nara , Paimon, and Arama! I'm going to get ready for Festival Utsava!

assumed.name: Arayasa
assumed.quote: Arama: Thank you! The song is hidden among the roses. But Arayasa and I have looked for hours and hours, and we couldn't find it.

assumed.name: Arana
assumed.quote: Arama: Well... It's because you are helping Arana, and Arana is my friend. So, thank you.

assumed.name: Aranaga
assumed.quote: Arama: I see. Aranaga's song and Aramaha's song have the same source...

threads.claim: Marana was born when the living world came to realize that all things end in death.
threads.quote: and so, Marana was born. It is the name of death, and those who know it shall die.

threads.claim: Marana's Avatar may be behind the harm done to the children of Vimara Village.
threads.quote: They aren't stopping with Aranara and are even harming little Nara...

threads.claim: The Vanarana the Traveler reached may be only a dream-copy of the real Vanarana.
threads.quote: This isn't Vanarana. Ah, actually... This is Vanarana, but not the real Vanarana.

threads.claim: The dream Vanarana is confirmed to be a shadow of the Vanarana outside.
threads.quote: The Vanarana in dreams is a shadow of the Vanarana outside.

threads.claim: Vanarana was destroyed in the past and the Aranara have lived in a dream since.
threads.quote: But after Vanarana was destroyed once, we started living in this dream.

threads.claim: A child of snow in Vimara Village may be connected to the bad Nara.
threads.quote: There is a strange Nara in Vimara Village. He's not a child of the forest, but a child of snow.

threads.claim: Several children of Vimara Village went missing in the forest and lost their memories.
threads.quote: Sudabeh was the first to go missing. She went into the forest to gather herbs for Grandpa Amadhiah.

threads.claim: Arana erased the children's memories and bad dreams to keep them from becoming bad.
threads.quote: Arana made little Nara sleep and dream, then removed the bad stuff in their dreams.

threads.claim: Rana has been seriously harmed by Marana and needs a Bija to recover.
threads.quote: Rana has been seriously harmed by Marana.

threads.claim: The Fatui may be secretly behind the disappearances of the children.
threads.quote: It would be horrible if the Fatui were behind all of this!

threads.claim: Araja is bound to the dream of Vanarana as the Tree of Dreams.
threads.quote: Araja reveals that he cannot leave Vanarana's dream because he is the

threads.claim: Ararycan was investigating something bad near Vimara Village.
threads.quote: He was investigating something bad.

threads.claim: A Bija must be formed to help Rana recover.
threads.quote: We need a Bija to help Rana recover.

threads.claim: The Traveler goes to the Fane of Ashvattha to obtain the Bija after the festival.
threads.quote: offer the Vasoma Fruits at the Fane of Ashvattha and obtain the Bija.

threads.claim: Each Aranara has a distinct tune that identifies who is home.
threads.quote: Every Aranara has their own tune, and every tune is different. That's how we know who's home.

threads.claim: Ararakalari is powered by memories and dreams and can protect those in need.
threads.quote: Memories and dreams are Aranara's power, their most precious things.

threads.claim: The Traveler's quest is to save Rana, a friend of Arana, whose condition is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Arana hopes to save a friend.

threads.claim: Arasudraka reassures the Traveler that Arana's friend will be fine, but the nature of the danger stays unstated.
threads.quote: Your and Arana's friend will be fine.

threads.claim: Marana is a corrupting force that drives trees and flowers toward death and is still spreading.
threads.quote: Marana will speak of the horrors of death to the trees and flowers it corrodes.

threads.claim: Marana's corrosion is spreading from the land into Sarva itself.
threads.quote: The corrosion from Marana is getting worse. It's not just infecting the land. It is here, and even in Sarva.

threads.claim: Bija can realize dreams, but only dreams meant to help others.
