threads.quote: Bija can help to realize dreams, so long as these dreams are meant to help others.

threads.claim: Producing the Bija depends on first offering a Vasoma Fruit at the Fane of Ashvattha.
threads.quote: We're going to offer the Vasoma Fruit at the Fane of Ashvattha. Then we can produce the Bija with Arana!

threads.claim: Aranara can lose their memories and must rely on others' stories to remember their own past.
threads.quote: I no longer remember that. Those stories were all things that Arana and the others told me later.

threads.claim: Araja admits they cannot recall things that they used to know, raising the question of how Aranara memory is kept.
threads.quote: That's probably the case... but I can no longer recall it now.

threads.claim: Nara Varuna's real name is unknown even to the Aranara who knew them.
threads.quote: Um... No idea. Nara Varuna never told us real name.

threads.claim: Araja recalls being told that another Golden Nara would come and bring even better memories to the Aranara.
threads.quote: When we parted, told me that, maybe one day, another Golden Nara would come to us, and would bring us even better memories.

threads.claim: Nara have short lives unlike Aranara, which makes their time together precious.
threads.quote: Yes, but you forgot, Arama, that Nara are not Aranara. Their time is short.

threads.claim: The Traveler has had very few dreams lately, which Arama finds strange.
threads.quote: You have had very few dreams lately, big Nara...

threads.claim: An unnamed Aranara who has lived for hundreds of years knows of the Bija and of Nara Varuna, and invites the Traveler to visit their house.
threads.quote: We will surely meet again. The next time we meet, Nara , Paimon, I hope you will come to my house.

threads.claim: Ararakalari is a principle of Aranara power that the Aranara consider important and only share with trusted friends.
threads.quote: You have become friends with Aranara, so you should have heard about the principle of the Ararakalari. Do you know of it?

threads.claim: Vanarana was destroyed long ago in a catastrophe linked to Nara, which shaped Aranara distrust of Nara.
threads.quote: A very long time ago, Vanarana was destroyed in that Nara catastrophe.

threads.claim: Aranara only slowly regained trust in Nara after the destruction, through Nara Varuna's help.
threads.quote: Only Nara Varuna has always been friends with Aranara and continued helping everyone after the destruction.

threads.claim: Vasmrti must be gathered from twelve nurseries outside the dream world before the Vanarana nursery can grow Viparyas.
threads.quote: Outside the dream world, there are 12 nurseries that condense Vasmrti.

threads.claim: Aranara hibernate as tiny seeds only when facing great danger, and it is isolating.
threads.quote: Aranara "hibernate" only when a great, great danger is present.

threads.claim: The forest and the Aranara are presented as keepers of memory that ensure nothing is lost.
threads.quote: Don't worry, no memories will be lost!

threads.claim: Araja has become a Tree of Dreams that anchors Vanarana's dream and cannot leave it.
threads.quote: A "Tree of Dreams" is required to anchor a dream this big, and I became that tree so everyone would have a home.

threads.claim: Aranara garlands are meant to share the Traveler's nightmares and burdens through dreams.
threads.quote: When Nara wears the garland, we'll be able to share the load on your mind, and we can protect you when you have nightmares.

threads.claim: Arayasa's long-standing promise with Araji is fulfilled when the Traveler plays Araji's song.
threads.quote: Our promise can finally be fulfilled.

threads.claim: The Vasara Tree in the dream agrees to bear a Vasoma Fruit once Marana's influence is removed.
threads.quote: This Vasara Tree has agreed to bear a Vasoma Fruit for us.

threads.claim: Marana is a spreading corruption that threatens the Vasara Tree and the nearby forest.
threads.quote: Arama: Marana's corrosion is getting more serious. Even Ashvattha's Concourse...

threads.claim: Marana keeps infesting new dreams, and the Fungi that fear it are at risk of being corrupted too.
threads.quote: Arama: The terribly terrible Marana wants to infest this place. Once it's gone, the Vasara Tree will be able to bear Vasoma Fruits.

threads.claim: Marana is driven out of this dream, though the corruption is only pushed back for now.
threads.quote: Arama: Yay! Marana, bad Fungi, don't come back.

threads.claim: All songs are said to originate from a single Sourcesong, which remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Arasudraka: Just like all the creeks eventually flow into the sea, all the songs eventually converge into one, into the Sourcesong.

threads.claim: Producing a Bija requires a large amount of energy, which Vasoma Fruits are needed to supply.
threads.quote: Arama: A large amount of energy must be consumed for the Ashvattha Tree to produce a Bija. That is why we must offer Vasoma Fruits.

threads.claim: A past catastrophe devastated Vanarana and left the Ashvattha's Concourses deserted.
threads.quote: Arama: After the horrible, horrible catastrophe occurred, Vanarana was devastated, and the concourses were left desolate...

threads.claim: Ashvattha's Tree of Dreams keeps dreams from drifting away and connects Aranara to the Vasara Tree.
threads.quote: Arama: Nara is smart. This tree keeps Aranara's dreams stable. Aranara can enter or exit dreams and are able to connect with the Vasara Tree.

threads.claim: An Aranara's power grows with shared memories, and Arama is weaker because he has few memories.
threads.quote: Arama: But with memories of adventuring together with Nara and Paimon, my powers will grow!

threads.claim: Rana is injured and needs healing, which the group is working toward.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh! We can help you with that once Rana's healed and everything's over!

threads.claim: Arayama's song disperses illusions because his long game with a Nara has ended.
threads.quote: Arama: Ah! No wonder his song could disperse all those illusions. It's because their game has ended.

introduced.name: Great Mujina Youkai
introduced.how: a mischievous shapeshifting monster that plays pranks on people, as the children describe it
introduced.quote: Matsuzaka: It's a sneaky monster that goes 'round playing tricks on people! It's got magic powers and can even shapeshift into anything it wants!

introduced.name: Matsuzaka
introduced.how: one of three children who are hunting the Great Mujina Youkai
introduced.quote: Wandering around the beaches of Inazuma City, the Traveler and Paimon run into three children who are looking for the Great Mujina Youkai

introduced.name: Iwao
introduced.how: a child who insists the Great Mujina Youkai is real and says Yoimiya tells them stories
introduced.quote: Iwao: Uh-huh, uh-huh! Yoimiya plays with us and tells us stories all the time. She wouldn't tell a lie!

introduced.name: Yoimiya
introduced.how: a fireworks maker who makes weapons for the children and is a Naganohara family member
introduced.quote: Further down the shoreline, Yoimiya explains that children should enjoy their childhood

introduced.name: Naganohara family
introduced.how: a well-known Inazuman family famous for spectacular fireworks
introduced.quote: her family is well known throughout Inazuma for their spectacular fireworks

introduced.name: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
introduced.how: Yoimiya's father, a fireworks shop owner who is deaf after a workplace accident
introduced.quote: At the shop, Yoimiya's father, Ryuunosuke, greets the trio.

introduced.name: Sakujirou
introduced.how: an old customer who smuggled himself back into Inazuma and is wanted by the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Yoimiya tells him that after the fireworks show, she'll find a boat for him to escape Inazuma.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: an Inazuman commission that issued an arrest warrant and polices sea travel
introduced.quote: Despite being Inazuman by birth, the Tenryou Commission put an arrest warrant out for him.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: a decree that makes any seaborne vessel draw Tenryou suspicion and interrogation
introduced.quote: Because of the Sakoku Decree. The Tenryou Commission is really suspicious of any kind of seaborne vessel.

introduced.name: Kouichi
introduced.how: a boatbuilder who long supplied the Naganoharas with fireworks and secretly builds Sakujirou's boat
introduced.quote: Elsewhere in the outskirts of the city, the trio find a man named Kouichi.

introduced.name: Keisuke
introduced.how: the Imatani couple's son, a Tenryou official who led the arrest and was once Sakujirou's friend
introduced.quote: They tell her that he was a good friend of their son Keisuke, until one day they had a terrible argument

introduced.name: Konda Village
introduced.how: a village where the Imatani couple live
introduced.quote: Heading to Konda Village, the trio find the Imatani couple to deliver their fireworks

introduced.name: Yoshitaka
introduced.how: a Tenryou officer who sets a blockade and refuses to let them pass
introduced.quote: On the road out, they run into a blockade set by the Tenryou Commission and inquire with Yoshitaka.

introduced.name: Morihiko
introduced.how: a materials supplier who sets aside ore for Yoimiya
introduced.quote: I put a batch aside just for now. It'll definitely be enough.

introduced.name: Hajime
introduced.how: an apprentice smith at Amenoma Smithy who handles weapon orders
introduced.quote: Hajime: Ah, Yoimiya. If I'm not mistaken, you must be here for some firework materials?

introduced.name: Amenoma Art
introduced.how: a smithing craft whose essence is patience and focus, taught by Amenoma Tougo
introduced.quote: The essence of Amenoma Art is patience and focus.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publisher in Inazuma that prints many fairy tales
introduced.quote: Inazuma is home to the Yae Publishing House, and a lot of people who like to write stories, too.

introduced.name: Naganohara Fireworks Show
introduced.how: a fireworks show hosted by the Naganohara family in Inazuma
introduced.quote: The Naganohara Fireworks Show is just around the corner, and there's still a lot of things to get ready.

introduced.name: Paper slip
introduced.how: a slip holding a firework recipe that lets a customer reorder the same firework years later
introduced.quote: Only people from my inside my family can understand what's written on it. It's the recipe for the fireworks they ordered.

introduced.name: Third Sis
introduced.how: a former guild friend of Kouichi who scolds him and is referred to by a nickname
introduced.quote: Kouichi: Oh, don't worry about paying anything. Third Sis would be sure to scold me if she found out I'd taken Mora from the Naganoharas.

introduced.name: Imatani Kaori
introduced.how: Elderly Konda Village woman, Yoimiya's friend, who asks for help with chores and has a grown son
introduced.quote: Imatani Kaori: Well! If it isn't Yoimiya! Come on in, dear, come and take a seat.

introduced.name: Imatani Saburou
introduced.how: Kaori's elderly husband, a local who welcomes the Naganoharas' help
introduced.quote: Imatani Saburou: Indeed, these are unprecedented times. But seeing as they came all this way, we locals should give them a warm welcome.

introduced.name: Satoru
introduced.how: Konda Village resident who has a daughter living in the city and is friendly with Yoimiya
introduced.quote: Satoru: Same as usual, not much has changed. You're looking full of life, as always.

introduced.name: Imatani Keisuke
introduced.how: The Imatanis' son, a Tenryou Commission officer who grew estranged from his childhood friend Sakujirou
introduced.quote: Imatani Saburou: Keisuke said nothing to me or my wife about the fight.

introduced.name: Sakujirou
introduced.how: Keisuke's childhood best friend who left Inazuma after a fight and has now returned, wanted by the Commission
introduced.quote: Imatani Kaori: He was our boy's best friend when they were young.

introduced.name: Matsuzaka
introduced.how: Local child who is building weapons to scare off the Great Mujina Youkai and whom Yoimiya looks after
introduced.quote: Matsuzaka: Hi, Yoimiya! Are the weapons to scare away the Great Mujina Youkai ready yet?

introduced.name: Morihiko
introduced.how: Villager who overheard the Commission members and identified their leader as Keisuke
introduced.quote: Morihiko: As it happens, I did.

introduced.name: Yoshitaka
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission officer who blocks the road and serves under Keisuke
introduced.quote: Yoshitaka: Sorry, official business. I can't let you pass.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Inazuma enforcement body that Keisuke works for and that is hunting Sakujirou
introduced.quote: Imatani Keisuke: He's a criminal, I work for the Tenryou Commission. There was never any room for discussion.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: Policy that Keisuke enforces by punishing violators and confiscating people's Visions
introduced.quote: Imatani Keisuke: But now, my role is to punish violators of the Sakoku Decree and confiscate people's Visions.

introduced.name: Naganohara Fireworks Show
introduced.how: Annual fireworks show; Saburou proposed to his wife at it fifty years ago
introduced.quote: Imatani Saburou: Well, maybe you're right. 50 years ago, I proposed to my wife at the Naganohara Fireworks Show. We've been together ever since.

introduced.name: Amakane Island
introduced.how: Vantage point from which Yoimiya and the others watch the fireworks
introduced.quote: (Yoimiya, the Traveler and Paimon watch the fireworks from Amakane Island)

introduced.name: Kouichi
introduced.how: Built the boat Sakujirou used, and is a friend of Third Sis
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, for Kouichi, who built that boat for us, and his friend, Third Sis, fireworks commemorate friendship.

introduced.name: Keisuke and Sakujirou's childhood falling-out
introduced.how: Past argument over whether Inazuma was too peaceful that made Sakujirou leave and Keisuke stay
introduced.quote: Imatani Saburou: Sakujirou seemed to feel that Inazuma was too peaceful, and wanted to see what the outside world was like.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: All the grim tales of the Vision Hunt Decree?

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: I mean, I sure can't imagine Inazuma without the Shogun.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: My family has pretty good connections with the Yashiro Commission.

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: I haven't been to Liyue before, but from what I've heard from Miss Beidou, it sounds like a really interesting place.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Traveler: Liyue, the nation of contracts.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: Mondstadt, the City of Freedom.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: We were chased by the Millelith in Liyue, too.

assumed.name: Atsuko
assumed.quote: Makes me think of Atsuko.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: We went through a long bureaucratic process on Ritou.

assumed.name: Hiiragi Chisato
assumed.quote: Even then, we only got through thanks to some help from Miss Hiiragi Chisato of the Kanjou Commission.

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: Traveler: Each archon has their own idea on how to run things.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: She hopes that the show will continue to grow in their hearts as they travel around Teyvat.

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Imatani Keisuke: I truly worship the Raiden Shogun. Her ideas are my personal creed, and I desire nothing more than to see her will done.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Yes, they're travelers from afar. Outsiders have a very difficult time getting into Inazuma nowadays.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Sakujirou: I saw the freedom of Mondstadt, the contracts of Liyue, the wisdom of Sumeru, and the justice of Fontaine... It all left a deep impression on me.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: We sold some fireworks to Liyue a while back, and word is they were a real hit.

assumed.name: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Pops, are you alright? They didn't do anything to you, did they?

assumed.name: Great Mujina Youkai
assumed.quote: Iwao: Oh... So we won't be able to scare off the Great Mujina Youkai anymore?

threads.claim: The Great Mujina Youkai may be a made-up story rather than a real monster.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah... Paimon feels like the Great Mujina Youkai is one of those storybook monsters that doesn't exist in the real world.

threads.claim: Yoimiya admits she invented the monster's traits for the children and that the parents likely made it up to keep kids home.
threads.quote: So I guess now, the kids' impression of the Great Mujina Youkai is mostly influenced by me.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree makes even small boats suspicious to the Tenryou Commission.
threads.quote: Even the smallest ones — they'll stop and interrogate us, demanding to know what we plan on doing with it.

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree is a grim policy that adults hide from children.
threads.quote: All the grim tales of the Vision Hunt Decree? I think it's a bit too early for all of that.

threads.claim: Inazuma seeks eternity, a state of tranquility where very little changes.
threads.quote: Unlike the outside world, what Inazuma seeks is eternity. In other words, a state of tranquility, where very little ever changes.

threads.claim: Yoimiya believes magical stories should not be ruined with bad endings.
threads.quote: If something's magical, it should be kept that way.

threads.claim: Keisuke lets Sakujirou leave Inazuma and promises to help if he ever returns.
threads.quote: Due to this, Keisuke allows Sakujirou to leave Inazuma, but reminds him not to kick the bucket early

threads.claim: Keisuke and Sakujirou had a bitter argument over the outside world before Sakujirou left.
threads.quote: They tell her that he was a good friend of their son Keisuke, until one day they had a terrible argument

threads.claim: Sakujirou learns from his firework that Keisuke lit it, which shows Keisuke's reconciliation.
threads.quote: realizes that it was Keisuke that lit it and weeps at the sight.

threads.claim: Ryuunosuke's deafness is the result of a workplace accident and makes him hard to communicate with.
threads.quote: Yoimiya: Sorry about this — ever since Pops had his accident, his ears don't work too well.

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for a lost sibling and is willing to stay in Inazuma if they return.
threads.quote: Upon hearing that they are looking for their sibling

threads.claim: Naganohara paper slips guarantee an identical firework can be made years later.
threads.quote: If someone shows a Naganohara that paper slip, we guarantee we can make the exact same firework as the original one they purchased

threads.claim: Yoimiya gives the golden firework slip to the Traveler, honoring the family tradition.
threads.quote: Yoimiya hands the Traveler a slip for the golden firework as it was her creation for them.

threads.claim: Sakujirou's exile and Keisuke's enforcement work both trace back to the Sakoku Decree isolating Inazuma.
threads.quote: Sakujirou: I was glad that I'd left Inazuma. But then I happened to hear about the Sakoku Decree.

threads.claim: Keisuke begins to doubt whether enforcing the Sakoku Decree is the right thing to do.
threads.quote: Imatani Keisuke: I do wonder... Am I really doing the right thing?

threads.claim: Sakujirou explains that he came back because he felt lost after seeing the outside world and wanted to bring its good things home.
threads.quote: Sakujirou: The reason I came back is that... I felt lost.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun desires an eternity that fireworks, which vanish in a flash, seem to oppose.
threads.quote: Yoimiya: Fireworks that disappear in a flash of light are probably the furthest thing away from the eternity that our Shogun desires.

threads.claim: Keisuke releases Sakujirou and hands him the boat, ending the childhood feud on a conciliatory note.
threads.quote: Imatani Keisuke: The boat is yours.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests that the reunion of the two childhood friends was fate.
threads.quote: Traveler: I guess this is fate.

introduced.name: Zosimos
introduced.how: stage director who designs sets, writes scripts and sees himself as a storyteller
introduced.quote: Zosimos: A director, my friends, is a storyteller. And the key ingredient to every good story is inspiration!

introduced.name: Lessig
introduced.how: admits he caused the domain's chaos by touching the core water orb and now must make repairs
introduced.quote: Lessig: Yes, and to be completely fair, I'm the one who caused this terrible mess in the first place.

introduced.name: Idyia
introduced.how: self-introduces as an exiled Oceanid who is the domain's caretaker
introduced.quote: Idyia: I am an Oceanid who was exiled here when the former Hydro Archon passed away. My name is Idyia.

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: Idyia's true form, a being exiled to the domain
introduced.quote: Idyia: I am an Oceanid who was exiled here when the former Hydro Archon passed away.

introduced.name: Former Hydro Archon
introduced.how: a past Hydro Archon whose death led to Idyia's exile
introduced.quote: Idyia: I am an Oceanid who was exiled here when the former Hydro Archon passed away.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: self-introduces as the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: My name is Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island...

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolon
introduced.how: can change into any form, including human form
introduced.quote: Since Hydro Eidolons can change into any form... why not human form?

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolon replicas of visitors
introduced.how: residents are Hydro Eidolon replicas made from former human visitors who asked to keep their dreams alive
introduced.quote: Idyia: Before they left, they asked me to make replicas of themselves using Hydro Eidolons.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: the domain whose core is a giant Streaming Projector and is itself one gigantic preprint
introduced.quote: Idyia: Correct. The core of the Veluriyam Mirage is the largest Streaming Projector of all. And this domain is one gigantic preprint.

introduced.name: Streaming Projector
introduced.how: the device at the domain's core that Idyia used to bring visitors' wishes to life
introduced.quote: Idyia: Correct. The core of the Veluriyam Mirage is the largest Streaming Projector of all. And this domain is one gigantic preprint.

introduced.name: Central Hub
introduced.how: the rotating hub built from components that must be placed in the core to restore the domain
introduced.quote: Idyia: The hub consists of these components. All you need to do is place them onto the foundation in the right shape...

introduced.name: Silver Bottle Courtyard
introduced.how: a courtyard in the domain where everyone gathers after the repair
introduced.quote: Returning to Silver Bottle Courtyard, everyone are praising Idyia for her accomplishments

introduced.name: Choo-Choo Cart
introduced.how: a cart that rides up to the top of the big wheel of the domain
introduced.quote: Klee says that she wants to ride the Choo-Choo Cart again and get to the top of the wheel.

introduced.name: Preprints
introduced.how: domain objects that Zosimos uses to build his stage sets, reversing their intended purpose
introduced.quote: The truth is that my sets are composed entirely of preprints

introduced.name: Bottle-lamp
introduced.how: the final component, a lamp inside a bottle that Zosimos gives to the group
introduced.quote: Idyia: Wait, this is Zosimos's bottle-lamp...

introduced.name: Shinrou Casket
introduced.how: a relic that listens to wishes and can restore the domain's power
introduced.quote: it can listen to the wishes of those who come to pray to build up

introduced.name: Shinki
introduced.how: power built up from prayers and wishes that gives the Shinrou Casket its power
introduced.quote: it can listen to the wishes of those who come to pray to build up

introduced.name: Mouun Shrine
introduced.how: the shrine where the Shinrou Casket was once used to make offerings
introduced.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: It was once a ritual vessel used for making offerings in the Mouun Shrine.

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: the shinkirou youkai whose remains were used to make the Shinrou Casket
introduced.quote: It's made from the remains of a youkai called the shinkirou

introduced.name: Last Prefect of Yashiori's death
introduced.how: several centuries ago the Shinrou Casket was lost when the last Prefect of Yashiori died in battle
introduced.quote: Several centuries ago, the relic was lost when the last Prefect of Yashiori died in battle.

introduced.name: Departure of visitors from the Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: visitors who wanted to leave were taken by Idyia to the edge of the desert, leaving gifts behind
introduced.quote: When they wanted to leave, I took them to the edge of the desert...

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Klee: Didn't I do great? I felt like I really was the fiery mage!

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Kaeya: Ah, no detail slips by our General.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Though I do remember that Amber mentioned we should just nod and agree when you act like this...

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Idyia: Haha, then I guess I've finally paid Alice back after all these years.

assumed.name: Maymunah
assumed.quote: and that Maymunah will probably just go back to being a scholar...

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: it's going to be tough for him back in Fontaine.

assumed.name: Ferdinand
assumed.quote: Ferdinand: Look, the wheel's been fixed!

assumed.name: Treasure Compasses
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Sounds just like my Treasure Compasses...)

assumed.name: A Thousand Nights
assumed.quote: in its attempt to pay tribute to the series

threads.claim: Kokomi's sensing of elemental energy in residents hints that Idyia has a hidden true nature and special powers.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Um... Well for one thing, I sensed elemental energy in the residents here, but none of them have Visions.

threads.claim: Idyia reveals she is an Oceanid, confirming the hidden nature and the residents' Hydro Eidolon origins.
threads.quote: Idyia then reveals her true self and transform into an Oceanid.

threads.claim: The Shinrou Casket disappeared into the domain's core, so its location became unknown and its pearl's light died out.
threads.quote: But when, unbeknownst to anyone at the time, the casket disappeared inside the core of the Veluriyam Mirage, the pearl's light died out.

threads.claim: The Shinrou Casket is found in the core and used to restore the domain's Central Hub.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's the relic that Kokomi mentioned earlier! So this is where it's been hiding!

threads.claim: The residents are Hydro Eidolon replicas made at the visitors' request to keep their dreams alive in the domain.
threads.quote: Idyia: Before they left, they asked me to make replicas of themselves using Hydro Eidolons.

threads.claim: Idyia equates every wish with a flame in a bottle, linking the bottle motif to the theme of dreams.
threads.quote: Idyia: ...I just think that every dream, every wish, is like a flame in a bottle.

threads.claim: Idyia admits she feels lonely when visitors leave, though not sad, raising the question of her own longing.
threads.quote: Idyia: ...I feel lonely, at times. But not sad.

threads.claim: Idyia doubts visitors' dreams can be realized in the outside world, yet still hopes they will come true.
threads.quote: Even though I know full well that trying to build a railway in the outside world is just a pipe dream...

threads.claim: The domain's core has been wearing out recently, which is why the Shinrou Casket's pearl could track it.
threads.quote: Idyia: I understand now, too! The core has been wearing out recently...

introduced.name: Setaria
introduced.how: Desert-born scholar and Grand Sage's assistant, burdened by guilt over the sages' work
introduced.quote: She was born in the desert, and was hailed as their greatest genius.

introduced.name: Il Dottore
introduced.how: Calls himself The Doctor, No. 2 of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, revealed as the mastermind behind the crowd
introduced.quote: Il Dottore (The Doctor), No. 2 of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, reveals himself as the mastermind behind this scene.

introduced.name: Akim
introduced.how: Potter whose father was a mason who retired to Port Ormos
introduced.quote: He's a mason by trade, but I picked up an interest in clay while apprenticing for him.

introduced.name: Qishan
introduced.how: Liyue-raised aspiring scholar who failed the Akademiya entrance and studies at a restaurant
introduced.quote: I grew up in Liyue Harbor and spent my entire childhood staring at the ships going in and out of the port.

introduced.name: Nabiya
introduced.how: Fortune-teller whose divinations are secretly voiced by Nahida, with cats Harut and Marut
introduced.quote: My poor lost lambs, have you become troubled over your fates?

introduced.name: Harut and Marut
introduced.how: Nabiya's cats, who seem to sense Nahida's presence and dislike her
introduced.quote: Oho, it would seem that Harut and Marut are quite wary of you.

introduced.name: Rima
introduced.how: Corps of Thirty member whose body the Traveler takes over while she tries to warn Setaria
introduced.quote: A bewildered Setaria flags down Corps of Thirty member Rima to warn her that something strange is afoot

introduced.name: Mass Dream Harvest
introduced.how: Sages' scheme tied to the Sabzeruz Festival repetitions, which Setaria helped design
introduced.quote: I was just one of the designers for the Mass Dream Harvest scheme... which is what happened around the Sabzeruz Festival.

introduced.name: King Deshret's resurrection
introduced.how: Revealed to be an Akademiya misinformation campaign, not a true resurrection
introduced.quote: Even though news of King Deshret's resurrection has been spreading like wildfire, it's all just a misinformation campaign from the Akademiya...

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: Wearing one lets a person share senses and effectively possess a target whose terminal Nahida controls
introduced.quote: As long as you're also wearing an Akasha Terminal, the effect will basically be as if you've possessed them yourself.

introduced.name: Tashfin
introduced.how: mercenary leader of an elite brigade that ambushes the Traveler for a client
introduced.quote: We are an elite brigade that commands the highest commission rate in all of Sumeru.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: government force that the mercenaries sneer at as underpaid lapdogs
introduced.quote: Corps of Thirty? We're nothing like those government lapdogs who don't even get scraps for their work.

introduced.name: Eleazar
introduced.how: Collei's worsening condition that makes intricate tasks harder
introduced.quote: My Eleazar has been progressing at a faster rate lately.

introduced.name: Amurta
introduced.how: Akademiya darshan where Tighnari studied; it runs a research base
introduced.quote: Master Tighnari originally studied in the Amurta Darshan of the Akademiya

introduced.name: Pardis Dhyai
introduced.how: research base with planted rare shrubs and grasses, linked to the Amurta
introduced.quote: Pardis Dhyai is something like the Amurta's research base.

introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.how: Avidya Forest scholar who claims her mind contacted the divine
introduced.quote: She's a scholar we met in the Avidya Forest!

introduced.name: Wall of Samiel
introduced.how: tall wall built to block desert sandstorms
introduced.quote: It's made to block sandstorms from the outside

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: his memories show betrayals by a god, a human and a fledgling, and a plan to empty himself for a Gnosis
introduced.quote: The first to betray me was a god

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: a puppet Nahida used to disguise herself, destroyed in the ambush
introduced.quote: right before the Katheryne puppet was destroyed.

introduced.name: Mind-jumping
introduced.how: Nahida can leap between minds to escape capture
introduced.quote: Luckily, I managed to finish my restorations and mind-jump away from him just as he was about to capture me.

introduced.name: Traveler and Nahida mind swap
introduced.how: the Traveler and Nahida swapped minds and bodies during the fight
introduced.quote: Our minds swapped places.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: the current Dendro Archon, whom the Akademiya has long ignored
introduced.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Dendro Archon... Is she really active in Sumeru?

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: General Mahamatra and head of the matra at the Akademiya
introduced.quote: General Mahamatra Cyno, head of all the matra at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: Akademiya enforcers who hunt scholars who commit academic crimes
introduced.quote: He's a formidable hunter, and the ultimate nightmare for any who have committed academic crimes.

introduced.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: group whose mercenary was driven insane by a Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: Had I been less guarded, I probably would have ended up like that Ayn Al-Ahmar mercenary, incapable of remaining sane for long enough to hold a conversation.

introduced.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: capsule said to come from the desert and to drive users insane
introduced.quote: Everyone says the capsule originated in the desert and was eventually moved to Port Ormos.

introduced.name: Grand Sage Azar
introduced.how: Grand Sage responsible for the falsified project data, who rejected Cyno's audit
introduced.quote: the person responsible for the erroneous data was none other than Grand Sage Azar himself.

introduced.name: Dunyarzad
introduced.how: Dehya's employer, a friend of the Traveler recovering from illness at home
introduced.quote: My employer, Dunyarzad of the Homayani family, is friends with the Traveler and is currently recovering from her illness at home.

introduced.name: Homayani Family
introduced.how: the family that employs Dehya and includes Dunyarzad
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad of the Homayani family

introduced.name: Candace
introduced.how: self-introduced protector of Aaru Village
introduced.quote: Please let me introduce myself. I am Candace, protector of Aaru Village.

introduced.name: Uncle Anpu
introduced.how: self-introduced chief of Aaru Village
introduced.quote: I am the chief of Aaru Village. Everyone usually calls me Uncle Anpu.

introduced.name: Isak
introduced.how: village boy whose parents were Eremite mercenaries and who is searching for the mad scholar he calls grandpa
introduced.quote: Isak's parents were both Eremite mercenaries who rarely returned to the village after finding employment in the city.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: largest desert settlement, a safe haven with many resources
introduced.quote: It's the largest settlement in the desert, so it'll probably have more resources and intel than anywhere else.

introduced.name: Village Keepers
introduced.how: the village's name for exiled mad scholars, who calm down after arriving
introduced.quote: is how Aaru Village refers to mad scholars exiled here by the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Akasha System
introduced.how: Akasha Terminals let the Akademiya monitor exiled scholars, though the main system stops interacting with them
introduced.quote: In theory, they would continue wearing them so the Akademiya could still monitor their activities.

introduced.name: Nascent god
introduced.how: a new god still being born, whose consciousness Haypasia touched
introduced.quote: It's because she made contact with the consciousness of a new god who is still in the process of being born...

introduced.name: Akademiya divine project
introduced.how: a secret sages' project that Tighnari knows relates to restoring Irminsul
introduced.quote: All I know is that that project has something to do with the restoration of Irminsul.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! We meet again, you two.

assumed.name: Sabzeruz Festival
assumed.quote: We ran into her basically every time the Sabzeruz Festival repeated itself.

assumed.name: Irminsul and The Withering
assumed.quote: before focusing her attention on Irminsul and The Withering.

assumed.name: Corps of Thirty
assumed.quote: all the key members of the Akademiya — even the Corps of Thirty guards — intentionally avoid wearing their Akasha Terminals.

assumed.name: Grand Sage
assumed.quote: Isn't she the one who's always trailing behind the Grand Sage of the Akademiya?

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: ever since we last said goodbye to Lesser Lord Kusanali, we haven't heard anything from her...

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Remember Tighnari told us about him.

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: But what are the Fatui after this time? Another Gnosis?

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Umm... That'll depend on the judgment of the Dendro Archon.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Before coming back, we met someone named Alhaitham.

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: Paimon still remembers the smug and mean way she always spoke to Nilou!

assumed.name: Dunyarzad and the Homayani Family
assumed.quote: The Homayanis haven't allowed any visitors after the festival, so we haven't been able to check on her.

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: King Deshret passed away a long time ago...

assumed.name: the Akasha
assumed.quote: the Akasha, her usual source of information

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Collei, it's nice to see you again!

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Speaking of Tighnari, did he go off on patrol?

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Thank goodness, you're okay! We were so worried about you...

assumed.name: Il Dottore
assumed.quote: Sounds like The Doctor.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: But why wouldn't The Doctor just send the Fatui after us?

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: Did we actually just see the Balladeer's memories!?

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Wait, Dehya!?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham!?

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: The Akademiya has always placed far greater importance on the late Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

assumed.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
assumed.quote: Nahida's trapped in the Sanctuary of Surasthana for good this time!

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: More Eremite mercenaries? Who're they working for this time...

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: Last time we met at Port Ormos, didn't you say you were going back to the Akademiya?

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: It seems that curing Irminsul is our only chance...

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: An outcast from the Akademiya?

assumed.name: Avidya Forest
assumed.quote: isn't Tighnari always saying that he never wants to leave the Avidya Forest?

threads.claim: Setaria helped design the Mass Dream Harvest scheme but knows little of its full scope.
threads.quote: But I know very little about the full scope of the overall project.

threads.claim: The Akademiya is revealed to be spreading a misinformation campaign about King Deshret's resurrection.
threads.quote: Even though news of King Deshret's resurrection has been spreading like wildfire, it's all just a misinformation campaign from the Akademiya...

threads.claim: The Akademiya is revealed to be working in cahoots with the Fatui.
threads.quote: Now that The Doctor's in the picture, we're no longer just dealing with the Akademiya — they're in cahoots with the Fatui.

threads.claim: An expelled scholar has returned to Sumeru City, and even the sages are wary of him.
threads.quote: I heard that a scholar who was previously expelled has returned to the city, and even the sages are still quite wary of him...

threads.claim: The expelled scholar is revealed to be Il Dottore, who calls himself The Doctor.
threads.quote: The outcast, expelled from the Akademiya...

threads.claim: The sages closely monitor all activity within the Akasha, so Setaria cannot pass documents through it.
threads.quote: The sages have always closely monitored all activities within the Akasha.

threads.claim: Il Dottore altered citizens' Akasha Terminals to plant false beliefs directly in their subconscious.
threads.quote: I simply made some minor adjustments to their Akasha Terminals

threads.claim: Nahida's strong possession ability is exposed to Il Dottore, who recognizes her as the God of Wisdom.
threads.quote: I see... You appear to have overridden their mental faculties

threads.claim: Eleazar is a manifestation of the Withering in the human body, so curing it requires addressing Irminsul's withering.
threads.quote: since Eleazar is a manifestation of the Withering on the human body

threads.claim: Qishan remembers celebrating the Sabzeruz Festival many times, which the sages' report did not account for.
threads.quote: I celebrated the Sabzeruz Festival so many times that I lost count. That was really weird.

threads.claim: Setaria admits she has been running from guilt over her role in the sages' plans and ignored letters from her homeland.
threads.quote: Guilt over my part in the sages' plans, and from ignoring the letters from the children of my homeland.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether the Akasha can erase the dreams of gods, hinting Nahida's dreams are unusual.
threads.quote: So, the Akasha can't take away the dreams of gods?

threads.claim: Setaria suspects Rima may be more than a believer of King Deshret, perhaps the god himself.
threads.quote: How do you know me so well? Are you truly just a believer of King Deshret, or are you the god himself?

threads.claim: Tashfin's mercenaries were hired by a client known only as The Outcast, whose identity stays hidden.
threads.quote: We're here on the orders of a client known only as

threads.claim: Alhaitham suspects the Traveler knows something about the Divine Knowledge Capsule, based on the Traveler's shocked reaction.
threads.quote: To have that kind of reaction, I think you must have realized something.

threads.claim: The Traveler is shaken by the words world... forget me... heard from the capsule user, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: It must be because I was so shocked to hear those words again

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the sages have been watching them from the very beginning.
threads.quote: The sages were watching me from the very beginning...

threads.claim: Alhaitham confirms he was secretly tasked by the sages with investigating the Traveler.
threads.quote: Yes, I was indeed tasked with investigating the Traveler.

threads.claim: The sages' secret project is undocumented, and its goal linking a new god and Irminsul's restoration remains unknown.
threads.quote: All I know is that that project has something to do with the restoration of Irminsul.

threads.claim: The Traveler claims the Akademiya is turning The Balladeer into a god, based on a nascent god seen in Nahida's body.
threads.quote: The Akademiya is... turning The Balladeer into a god.

threads.claim: Haypasia's atypical symptoms are explained by her contact with a new god still in the process of being born.
threads.quote: That explains why Haypasia's symptoms were different from those of the other scholars who went mad.

threads.claim: The party believes curing Irminsul is the only hope, and the withering of Irminsul is a central problem.
threads.quote: It seems that curing Irminsul is our only chance...

threads.claim: Desert sandstorms and earthquakes are believed to be linked to the withering of Irminsul.
threads.quote: According to an investigator who stayed in the village a while ago, these unusual natural phenomena are related to the withering of Irminsul.

threads.claim: Village Keepers have been disappearing without a trace, and no one in the village has seen them leave.
threads.quote: One by one, the Village Keepers have been mysteriously disappearing without a trace...

threads.claim: The Traveler attributes the village's protection and the calming of mad scholars to Lesser Lord Kusanali's power.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali was actually the one who protected the village.

threads.claim: Cyno doubts that Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Dendro Archon, is actually active in Sumeru.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Dendro Archon... Is she really active in Sumeru?

threads.claim: Cyno concedes that the archon has been among the people of Sumeru all along.
threads.quote: To think, our archon has been among us this entire time...

threads.claim: The Doctor has trapped Nahida's consciousness, so she can no longer travel with the party.
threads.quote: The Doctor has found a way to trap my consciousness, so I can't journey with you anymore.

threads.claim: Nahida's coded message about a moonless night, starlight, and illusions and lies hints at a hidden plan.
threads.quote: But even in a moonless night, a shower of starlight can still drown out illusions and lies.

threads.claim: The Traveler decodes the message: the Moon is Nahida, starlight is the desert people, and illusions are the Akademiya's plans.
threads.quote: refer to the Akademiya's plans.

threads.claim: Nahida has revealed her true identity to the mad scholars, costing the party a trump card.
threads.quote: I gave away my true identity when I restored everyone's minds, which means we've lost another one of our trump cards.

threads.claim: Scaramouche's memories reveal three betrayals and his plan to empty his heart in order to receive a supreme Gnosis.
threads.quote: The first to betray me was a god

threads.claim: Scaramouche's eyes and the words I see you suggest he is watching the Traveler and Nahida after the swap.
threads.quote: On-Screen Text: I see you

threads.claim: Grand Sage Azar rejected Cyno's audit, asserting that the matra's power comes from the sages and that they cannot judge the sages.
threads.quote: The power of the General Mahamatra is granted by the sages.

threads.claim: Nahida's consciousness has left her body, and her whereabouts are unclear after the Traveler and Nahida swapped minds.
threads.quote: Our minds swapped places.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: a phenomenon linked to Abyssal power that brings fog and monsters, lethal to ordinary people
introduced.quote: The Wild Hunt is in fact a phenomenon linked to Abyssal power. Fog and monsters follow in its wake, posing a lethal danger to ordinary people.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: the local force that backs the cannon and monitors Wild Hunt areas
introduced.quote: We Lightkeepers will also keep an eye on those areas, both to monitor the monsters and to prevent people from entering the cannon's blast radius.

introduced.name: Sousi
introduced.how: a Sergeant Major of the Lightkeepers stationed in Nasha Town, a Ratnik
introduced.quote: This is Sousi, Sergeant Major of the nearby Lightkeepers. He's stationed here in this town.

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: Lightkeeper troops who handle the weaker Wild Hunt foes while the cannon takes the rest
introduced.quote: We usually sort our foes ahead of time into ones that our Ratniki will take care of, and ones that we'll target using the cannon.

introduced.name: Aino
introduced.how: the craftswoman behind the Krumkake Craftshop who built the cannon
introduced.quote: You should thank the Krumkake Craftshop — that means me, by the way — for making you such a huge and powerful weapon for such a measly price!

introduced.name: Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Cannon
introduced.how: a huge Lightkeeper weapon built from many factory parts that needs repair before it can fire
introduced.quote: the Lightkeepers are asking Aino to finally begin repair work on the Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Cannon

introduced.name: Beep-Boopitta
introduced.how: a small diagnostic robot (named Birgitta) that runs checks on the cannon
introduced.quote: You can use this Beep-Boopitta to run diagnostics on the cannon. It'll tell you what to do.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: an energy that is the polar opposite of abyssal energy and absorbs it when they clash
introduced.quote: Through the help of some spirits, they eventually realize that kuuvahki and abyssal energy are polar opposites, though the winner would absorb the loser's energy.

introduced.name: Hintsa
introduced.how: a Rossum Workshop mechanic who maintains machines and Sousi's arm
introduced.quote: Hintsa's the name. I help out at the Rossum Workshop in town — they usually put me in charge of making and repairing simple machines.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: a Lightkeeper who is a fae turned toward humanity and who joined after seeing the Lightkeepers fight
introduced.quote: Flins reveals a story about his past; he is a fae who turned his heart towards humanity and experienced loss, wishing to end his own life.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: a piece of Aria's remains that Columbina rejects and that Paimon and the Traveler carry
introduced.quote: Columbina declines, stating that the Moon Marrow is actually a piece of Aria's remains.

introduced.name: Moon Goddess
introduced.how: a moon's goddess whose death, along with the moon's destruction, is what forms a moon marrow
introduced.quote: Columbina explains that such a marrow only forms when a moon is destroyed and its Moon Goddess dies.

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: the phantom revealed as a Five Sinner and the source of the Wild Hunt, who is rebuilding his body from remains
introduced.quote: Rerir's phantom standing in the shoal, explaining that humans did not understand the powers they wielded.

introduced.name: Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: a group that Rerir belongs to
introduced.quote: causing the Traveler and Paimon to realize that their enemy is one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Banquet
introduced.how: an invitation-only gathering at The Flagship that outsiders can only enter with a proper channel
introduced.quote: That is correct. Only those invited to the Banquet may enter.

introduced.name: Roulette Showdown
introduced.how: a drinking game where participants spin a wheel for drinks and points
introduced.quote: The wheel before you is divided into an inner and outer circle. Participants must take turns to spin the pointer of the inner circle.

introduced.name: Korhonen
introduced.how: an informant who sells intel on Wild Hunt features, locations, and Lightkeeper reports
introduced.quote: I can give you three things: The features of the Wild Hunt, the exact locations where it has appeared, and the intel we've received from the Lightkeepers.

introduced.name: Dobrawa
introduced.how: a hide merchant with a tough personality who escaped a Wild Hunt anomaly
introduced.quote: A hide merchant with a tough personality, a knack for bargaining, and a son.

introduced.name: Kauro
introduced.how: a food supplier who is a thrill-seeker addicted to gambling
introduced.quote: A food supplier on good terms with many farmers in Snezhnaya, selling goods of excellent quality.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: a figure who had been following Rerir and introduces himself to him
introduced.quote: Ordering the person to show themselves, the person is revealed to be Varka, who introduces himself to him.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: A Lightkeeper revealed to be a fae who once lived in Snezhnaya and collects ancient curios
introduced.quote: Have you heard of how Snezhnaya was once the realm of the fae?

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: The Rächer of Solnari, a Five Sinner from Khaenri'ah who gained Abyssal power in the Cataclysm and fixated on the moons
introduced.quote: He hailed from Khaenri'ah, gaining Abyssal power during the Cataclysm... and he had a consuming fixation on the moons...

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: Remains of Aria, Goddess of the Eternal Moon, now carried by the Traveler and sought by Rerir
introduced.quote: It is the remains of Aria, Goddess of the Eternal Moon.

introduced.name: Aria
introduced.how: Goddess of the Eternal Moon whose power coalesced into the Moon Marrow after her death
introduced.quote: After Aria's death, her power coalesced into this Moon Marrow...

introduced.name: The Damselette
introduced.how: A former Fatui member and Moon Goddess who holds the Frost Moon's power, also called Columbina
introduced.quote: I can sense that my power belongs to the Frost Moon.

introduced.name: Three Moons
introduced.how: Once three moons ruled the sky, each under a goddess
introduced.quote: There were once three moons in the sky, each belonging to a goddess who ruled over it.

introduced.name: War of Funerary Flame
introduced.how: A conflict that slew the three moon goddesses and shattered two moons
introduced.quote: But after the war of funerary flame, all three lay slain, and two of the three moons were shattered during the conflict.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Lauma's faith-based sect, which the Frostmoon Scions view as rooted in their faith
introduced.quote: Our faith, our sect... all of it is here.

introduced.name: Kuutar
introduced.how: A new deity the Frostmoon Scions expect the Moon Marrow's moon to produce
introduced.quote: As the prophecy stated, this moon would birth a new deity sooner or later

introduced.name: Archon
introduced.how: A god who holds a Gnosis is called an Archon
introduced.quote: Now, a god with a Gnosis is named an Archon

introduced.name: Moon Goddess's Favor
introduced.how: A mark left on everything the Damselette touches
introduced.quote: All things I come into contact with will bear this mark.

introduced.name: False sky
introduced.how: A barrier beyond which the Damselette's moon power and memories lie out of reach
introduced.quote: But it lies beyond the false sky, too distant from me.

introduced.name: Ghostly shadows
introduced.how: Shadows in Wild Hunt anomalies that drag people into black mist unless dispelled with light
introduced.quote: Ghostly shadows haunt this area of the Wild Hunt.

introduced.name: Lightkeeper light source
introduced.how: A special lamp that lights Wild Hunt anomalies and briefly dispels Abyssal fog
introduced.quote: This light source is of special Lightkeeper design. It provides illumination within Wild Hunt anomalies, and can briefly dispel the Abyssal fog within.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki device
introduced.how: A kuuvahki-powered Lightkeeper device that detects people carrying lanterns
introduced.quote: Our Sergeant Major has a kuuvahki-powered device that can be used to detect others who bear a lantern.

introduced.name: Abyssal crystal fragments
introduced.how: Crystals falling from Wild Hunt cores that merge and emit Abyssal energy
introduced.quote: Many moons ago, when on Wild Hunt clearance duty, I shattered one of its cores, only for a special crystalline object to fall out.

introduced.name: Final Night Cemetery
introduced.how: A burial ground founded by survivors who buried fallen heroes after an Abyssal battle
introduced.quote: The survivors and I buried the fallen heroes...

introduced.name: Korhonen
introduced.how: An intel broker who resold Nefer's intel and owes her a debt
introduced.quote: Indeed I am. He's resold my intel quite a few times now, pocketing the difference afterwards.

introduced.name: Sousi
introduced.how: A Lightkeeper Sergeant Major stationed long-term in Nasha Town who fired the cannon
introduced.quote: You might not be familiar with Sergeant Major Sousi, but he put his heart and soul into every mission.

introduced.name: Hintsa
introduced.how: A Nasha Town repairman who keeps records of Lightkeeper maintenance requests
introduced.quote: Got it. Eight days ago, he came to request a round of regular maintenance, but as it happened, I had run out of the required components.

introduced.name: kuuvahki
introduced.how: An energy the Damselette can use to conceal presence within a bubble
introduced.quote: I can teach you to further conceal its presence using kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Rächer of Solnari
introduced.how: Revealed as a Wild Hunt monster who is Rerir's body, scattered in fragments across Wild Hunt sites
introduced.quote: My body was once torn into countless pieces and hurled into the swirling chaos of time itself. But even so, my life and will were not extinguished.

introduced.name: Rerir
introduced.how: Explained as the Wild Hunt figure who disguised himself as Sergeant Major Sousi and framed Flins
introduced.quote: Rerir, disguised as Sousi, left at that point...

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: Learned that kuuvahki is mutually opposed to the Wild Hunt and can destroy small Wild Hunt anomalies
introduced.quote: Kuuvahki and the Wild Hunt are mutually opposed forces.

introduced.name: Aino's cannon
introduced.how: Its kuuvahki ammunition can blast Wild Hunt fragments into oblivion
introduced.quote: Flins mentioned that if the cannon were fired at the Wild Hunt...

introduced.name: Tideseal Stone
introduced.how: Used to seal small Wild Hunt sites so they go inactive
introduced.quote: They could then be sealed directly using a Tideseal Stone... Eh, but why?

introduced.name: Sergeant Major Sousi's funeral
introduced.how: Shown that Sousi has died and is given a funeral and eulogy near Nasha Town
introduced.quote: There's a certain gentleman I'd like to send off on his final journey.

introduced.name: Ryksa
introduced.how: Introduced as a former Hiisi Island resident who left the island to start a new life in Nasha Town
introduced.quote: But you chose to leave the island — you had the resolve and the courage to start a new life.

introduced.name: Hintsa
introduced.how: Described as an engineer who built an integrated controller for the cannon and barrier from random components
introduced.quote: How in the world do you end up creating an integrated controller for the cannon AND the barrier from random components people ask you to fix!?

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: Introduced as a Nasha Town shopkeeper and overseas businesswoman who resents the Curatorium's competition
introduced.quote: Running small overseas enterprises is no mean feat — never mind when such formidable competition exists...

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Self-introduction as Knight of Boreas and Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: The name's Varka. Knight of Boreas, and Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: Learned it is a Fatui facility building a weapon that plays a role in the Tsaritsa's plan
introduced.quote: Have you been to that Experimental Design Bureau of theirs?

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: Paimon explains the Abyss as a force that tries to taint everything
introduced.quote: It's a force that tries to taint everything...

introduced.name: Wild Hunt Phenomena Log files
introduced.how: Archive files in the cemetery that seem to hint at past Wild Hunt incidents and guide the party
introduced.quote: Are we... being given hints? I feel no hostility.

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: While walking around Nasha Town, the Traveler and Paimon overhear a few residents of Nasha Town talking about the recent Wild Hunt incursion.

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Lauma tells them that her people are more proactive, having known the true meaning of their faith, though she feels that it will still take some time for everything to settle.

assumed.name: Hiisi Island
assumed.quote: With the medicine in tow, the Traveler and Paimon return to Hiisi Island to give Lauma the rest of the medicine.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: causing the Traveler to realize that Columbina wanted to talk to them.

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: Remembering the names that Dainsleif had told them, Paimon believes their enemy is Rerir

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: recalls hearing about a man who was fixated on the moons when she joined the Fatui.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Paimon is worried that they could not defeat him and mentions Sandrone, causing Columbina to laugh at the mention of her name

assumed.name: Pulonia
assumed.quote: But before he could attack them, Sandrone and Pulonia arrive.

assumed.name: Lightkeepers
assumed.quote: Now, the Lightkeepers don't want you to know this, but weirdly enough, more Wild Hunt sites have disappeared than their involvement would indicate.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: They're not the only ones fighting the Wild Hunt, after all.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Instances of the Wild Hunt afflicting Nod-Krai in general have increased in frequency

assumed.name: Starsand Shoal
assumed.quote: First, no one else has seen that weird phantom, apart from our encounter on Starsand Shoal.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: We got the Moon Marrow back from the Fatui.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Before I decide, there's a favor I'd like to ask you, Columbina.

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: And even then... He still defeated Marionette...

assumed.name: Dain
assumed.quote: Dain mentioned him, didn't he?

assumed.name: Five Sinners
assumed.quote: One of the Five Sinners!?

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Khaenri'ah? Well, we don't know if the phantom we saw has anything to do with that

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: that power was somewhat similar to Abyssal energies I've encountered before...

assumed.name: Cannon
assumed.quote: Remember that Sousi guy, the Ratnik in charge of firing the cannon?

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey there, Lauma. We're back!

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions (current state)
assumed.quote: The Frostmoon Scions have changed since you last saw them.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: And amidst it all, Flins's name started gaining more and more traction.

assumed.name: Sergeant Major Sousi
assumed.quote: Lightkeeper operations have just about ceased following the Sergeant Major's passing.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: I wouldn't discount Rerir throwing fuel on the fire in secret.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: Are you intent on depriving both the Voynich Guild and the Curatorium of Secrets of even a moment's rest?

assumed.name: Aino and Ineffa
assumed.quote: Works for me. Ineffa and I will take our workshop assistants to deal with one of the sites.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: And we Frostmoon Scions shall deal with the remaining one.

assumed.name: Lady Moonchanter
assumed.quote: It's... It's you, Lady Moonchanter! It's her, everyone. It's her!

assumed.name: Columbina and Marionette
assumed.quote: Columbinaaaa... What did you do that for!?!?

assumed.name: Pulonia
assumed.quote: (Pulonia knocks Rerir back and unleashes a series of attacks at him)

assumed.name: Five Sinners
assumed.quote: I guess they don't call you one of the Five Sinners for nothing.

assumed.name: Luonnotar
assumed.quote: Hey, it's Luonnotar... Should we go after her? Or do you have someone else you'd like to meet?

assumed.name: Eternal Moon Goddess
assumed.quote: the remains of the Eternal Moon Goddess cannot fall into his hands

threads.claim: A mastermind is hiding behind the phantom that drives the Wild Hunt.
threads.quote: concluding that the phantom was a recent sighting and that the mastermind must be hiding behind it.

threads.claim: The phantom can shift shapes and mimic people, making it hard to track.
threads.quote: Just a shame that our mysterious phantom has hidden itself well. Between that and its ability to shift shapes, it will no doubt be a most slippery customer.

threads.claim: The Sousi the group met was actually Rerir, who can mimic external appearance.
threads.quote: This news confirms that the Sousi they met earlier had actually been Rerir and they theorize that he is only able to mimic the external appearance of people.

threads.claim: Rerir's reason for wanting the cannon prepared is unknown.
threads.quote: though the Traveler is unsure as to why Rerir wanted the cannon to be prepared.

threads.claim: Rerir is identified as one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: causing the Traveler and Paimon to realize that their enemy is one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: Rerir is revealed as the origin of the Wild Hunt.
threads.quote: He also reveals to be the origin of the Wild Hunt

threads.claim: Rerir's heart is kept inside Flins' lantern.
threads.quote: with his heart being in Flins' lantern

threads.claim: Flins' lantern holds abyssal power, raising suspicion that Flins is one of Rerir's disguises.
threads.quote: As they investigate, the Traveler remarks about Flins' lantern, which had an abyssal power and in the worst case, believes that he might be one of Rerir's disguises.

threads.claim: Something may be holding Rerir back from full power.
threads.quote: while Columbina theorizes that something is holding Rerir back.

threads.claim: A mysterious dome shield protected Hiisi Island from the cannon's stray bolts, and its source is unknown.
threads.quote: others that travel straight for Hiisi Island are met with a mysterious dome shield that protects it from harm.

threads.claim: The Traveler's spaceship crashed into Nod-Krai at the end of their journey.
threads.quote: where the Traveler spots their spaceship crashing into Nod-Krai as it ends.

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling appeared outside the crashed spaceship, which should have been impossible.
threads.quote: but soon spots their sibling outside of it, which should've been impossible

threads.claim: Columbina's powers came from the Frost Moon, whose missing parts she senses but cannot reach.
threads.quote: She also states that her powers came from the Frost Moon; she could sense the missing parts, but could not reach it.

threads.claim: Columbina's strength is not returning and her time is running out.
threads.quote: Columbina clutches her chest, realizing that her strength wasn't returning and that time was running out.

threads.claim: Varka has been secretly following Rerir.
threads.quote: Elsewhere, Rerir walks across Nod-Krai when he realizes that someone had been following him for some time.

threads.claim: Rerir may be the Rächer of Solnari, a Five Sinner who vanished after falling into the moon's reflection.
threads.quote: The tale of his final fate has it that he fell into the

threads.claim: It is unresolved whether the Traveler, who bears the Moon Marrow, becomes a Moon Goddess.
threads.quote: Since you bear the Moon Marrow, does that make you a

threads.claim: The Moon Marrow rejects the Damselette, so it stays with the Traveler for now.
threads.quote: Nor does it desire to come to me.

threads.claim: The Iridescent Moon's remains are still missing, and the Frost Moon's goddess died but her moon was never broken.
threads.quote: The Iridescent Moon's remains have never been found

threads.claim: A new deity named Kuutar is prophesied to be born from the moon.
threads.quote: As the prophecy stated, this moon would birth a new deity sooner or later

threads.claim: Someone reached the Traveler from outside the sealed spaceship long after landing, which the Traveler cannot explain.
threads.quote: No one left the ship during that time

threads.claim: The false sky hides the Damselette's past and her name, which she cannot recall.
threads.quote: I do not even remember my name...

threads.claim: Wild Hunt anomalies may show familiar faces and illusions, possibly a Rerir trick.
threads.quote: Have you heard of people seeing familiar faces within a Wild Hunt anomaly

threads.claim: Some Ratniki may be hiding the anti-Wild Hunt work they do.
threads.quote: or two, that some Ratniki are not reporting the work they do on purpose.

threads.claim: Flins may be a fabricated entity rather than who he claims to be.
threads.quote: In the worst case scenario, "Flins" might be an entirely fabricated entity...

threads.claim: Flins reveals he is a fae who once lived in Snezhnaya and has been a Lightkeeper since awakening.
threads.quote: Have you heard of how Snezhnaya was once the realm of the fae?

threads.claim: Rerir can take the forms of other humans, so he disguised himself as Sousi and then Flins.
threads.quote: No one has ever seen a phantom that can take the form of other humans within the Wild Hunt.

threads.claim: Rerir disguised as Sousi, then killed the Sergeant Major and took on Flins's form to frame him.
threads.quote: Eight days ago, he had yet to act, but at some point after that, he attacked and imprisoned the Sergeant Major.

threads.claim: Firing the cannon works against Rerir's goal of collecting Abyssal fragments, which leaves his motive unclear.
threads.quote: Assuming he plans to collect the fragments within Wild Hunt anomalies, firing the cannon works against him, since it would blast those fragments to smithereens.

threads.claim: Rerir is after the Abyssal crystal fragments that Flins carried, and they grow stronger over time.
threads.quote: Is that what Rerir claimed belonged to him? That must be what he's after, then.

threads.claim: Rerir's true aim is unclear, and it is a mystery why he needs Flins's fragment so badly.
threads.quote: It begs the question: What makes it so special that he needs it so badly?

threads.claim: Kuuvahki and Abyssal energies may compete, with the stronger side suppressing the weaker, letting Rerir absorb kuuvahki.
threads.quote: It could be that when kuuvahki and Abyssal energies meet, the stronger side will suppress the weaker one.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt's origin is revealed: scattered fragments of Rerir's body gathered and rebuilt him, and he collected more across Wild Hunt sites.
threads.quote: Serendipity guided the fragments to construct an incomplete version of myself, upon which I began collecting more within Wild Hunt sites across the land...

threads.claim: The fragment Flins carried is revealed to be Rerir's heart, which he needs to regain mastery over kuuvahki.
threads.quote: While that which you hold in your hand... was my heart.

threads.claim: Rerir grows stronger after each cannon shot, and the Traveler warns against engaging him.
threads.quote: He's grown much stronger since our last encounter.

threads.claim: Unseen forces seem to be leaving hints in the cemetery files, and their source remains unknown.
threads.quote: Are we... being given hints? I feel no hostility.

threads.claim: Columbina's strength is failing and her time seems to be running out.
threads.quote: It seems my time... is running out...

threads.claim: The Traveler's spaceship seems to have been intentionally hidden, possibly by someone with truths to conceal.
threads.quote: But after our previous attempt, I suspect your spaceship has been intentionally hidden away.

threads.claim: A weapon being built at the Experimental Design Bureau is said to play a key role in the Tsaritsa's plan, whose purpose is unknown.
threads.quote: will play a key role in the Tsaritsa's plan.

threads.claim: The tale of the Lantern Fae is raised again and tied to Sousi's eulogy about a lantern that illuminates others.
threads.quote: I once heard the tale of a Lantern Fae.

threads.claim: Someone has been following Rerir unseen, and this watcher is revealed to be Varka.
threads.quote: You've followed me this far. Why not show your face?

introduced.name: ballista
introduced.how: a remote-guided launch weapon Beidou sells; the upgraded version needs no guidance
introduced.quote: it's actually called a "ballista."

introduced.name: Voynich Guild
introduced.how: takes a cut of whatever vendors sell at the trade expo
introduced.quote: The Voynich Guild gets a cut of whatever I sell.

introduced.name: Alcor-class No. 2
introduced.how: Beidou's ship, a battleship that she docks in Liyue and lets local kids board
introduced.quote: Your vessel... It's a battleship, isn't it?

introduced.name: Ashvapati
introduced.how: Ati and Neb's adoptive guardian, who is not their real uncle and builds toys
introduced.quote: Uncle Ashvapati... isn't our real uncle, but he is our guardian. He adopted us when we were little.

introduced.name: Neb
introduced.how: a curious child in Ashvapati's group who is fascinated by the ballista
introduced.quote: Wow! Can this launch blaster thing really shoot stuff from that far away?

introduced.name: Ati
introduced.how: one of Ashvapati's young wards who has travelled with him since childhood
introduced.quote: We've been traveling from place to place with him for as long as I can remember.

introduced.name: Raya
introduced.how: one of the three children in Ashvapati's care, who reports he has gone missing
introduced.quote: Well, Neb's been obsessed with the ballistas ever since we got here.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: a Fontaine-based group whose members can mobilize in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: I had no idea the Spina di Rosula could mobilize these kinds of numbers outside of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: a group with a reputation for highly effective interrogation
introduced.quote: The Maison Gardiennage has a reputation for... highly effective interrogation tactics.

introduced.name: Eremite arms-dealer band
introduced.how: a band of Eremites that suddenly gained advanced tech, sold weapons, and was destroyed about a decade ago
introduced.quote: About a decade ago, there was a band of Eremites who, seemingly out of nowhere, gained technological capabilities far surpassing those of other groups.

introduced.name: international crime ring
introduced.how: a multinational weapons-trading ring that uses undercover agents
introduced.quote: Turns out, we're dealing with an international crime ring.

introduced.name: ballista fail-safe
introduced.how: prototype ballistas have a built-in lock meant to block unauthorized use
introduced.quote: all the prototypes have a fail-safe designed to prevent unauthorized use

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Let's go check in with Yelan and Chevreuse.

assumed.name: Chevreuse
assumed.quote: (Chevreuse, who is also hiding nearby, gives the group a thumbs up)

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Beidou! Whatcha up to?

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: (Navia is also hiding nearby)

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: This isn't Tabletop Troupe, Navia.

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Here I was hoping the trouble would start and end with you two.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: But as far as our deal with the Curatorium goes, I think that's a wrap.

assumed.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
assumed.quote: The Captain of the Special Patrol will take it from here.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Whenever we're docked back in Liyue to pick up supplies

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Nod-Krai's a big place.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Something like this would only see more use in Fontaine.

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Jahoda needs you back at the expo venue as soon as possible.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: He told us we all came from the same band of Eremites in the desert

assumed.name: Ruin Drake
assumed.quote: (A flashback shows a group of Eremites with Ruin Drakes)

threads.claim: Ashvapati may be secretly tied to the weapons ring despite being the children's guardian.
threads.quote: Is he connected to the crime ring?

threads.claim: Neb insists Ashvapati hates weapons, leaving his guilt contested.
threads.quote: Uncle Ashvapati hates weapons!

threads.claim: Ashvapati has gone missing, and the children cannot reach him.
threads.quote: Ever since this morning, we haven't been able to reach him.

threads.claim: The children may be orphans of the destroyed Eremite arms-dealer band.
threads.quote: From what they've told us, sounds like these kids are orphans from that particular band of Eremites.

threads.claim: The surviving Eremites may have returned to the weapons business.
threads.quote: So, the survivors of that band of Eremites...

threads.claim: Nefer recognizes something in the children's eyes that links them to a past event.
threads.quote: I'm just... reminded of something.

threads.claim: The ballistas' fail-safe may not protect against a skilled tech user such as Ashvapati.
threads.quote: those fail-safes I mentioned might not have our backs after all.

threads.claim: Prototype ballistas have been stolen from the expo storage, risking their fall into criminal hands.
threads.quote: all of them had been stolen.

threads.claim: The crime ring has undercover agents waiting in the wings, ready to scatter if their contact is caught.
threads.quote: they have undercover agents waiting in the wings.

threads.claim: Chevreuse reveals the agents' locations and total count, showing the ring's full reach.
threads.quote: Five at the port, ten on the outskirts of Nasha Town, three near the plaza...

threads.claim: The team is after the leader of the whole crime ring, not just the underling they are meeting.
threads.quote: we're after the leader of the whole ring.

threads.claim: The identity of the mastermind remains unknown and is still to be uncovered.
threads.quote: Once we get someone to reveal who the mastermind behind all this is, that's when the real work begins.

threads.claim: The Spina di Rosula has helped operations in Nod-Krai, extending its reach beyond Fontaine.
threads.quote: Without the Spina's help back in the day, we never would have been able to make it in Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a Rtawahist student at the Akademiya struggling with her thesis
introduced.quote: Anyway, I'm Layla, a Rtawahist student at the Akademiya... for now, at least.

introduced.name: Munirah
introduced.how: Layla's classmate who criticizes her for skipping group work
introduced.quote: I'm one of Layla's classmates. I just came by to say hi.

introduced.name: Rabah
introduced.how: House of Daena visitor who has tried the Seelie and explains how to submit a question
introduced.quote: Heh, you've come to the right person.

introduced.name: Katayoun
introduced.how: House of Daena staff who explains that book checkouts are strictly logged
introduced.quote: Not likely, that would be almost impossible. The House of Daena is extremely strict about the circulation of its books.

introduced.name: Hunayn
introduced.how: House of Daena student who saw a black shadow land there at night
introduced.quote: One time, late at night, a black shadow fell from above and landed in the central area of the House of Daena.

introduced.name: Latifah
introduced.how: Researcher who has studied the Seelie and lists its known traits
introduced.quote: Yes, of course. I've been looking into it for quite a while now.

introduced.name: The Wisdom Seelie
introduced.how: Anonymous legendary entity that answers written questions with riddling clues
introduced.quote: But the Wisdom Seelie is truly amazing and freely shares its endless knowledge.

introduced.name: House of Daena
introduced.how: Strict library where Layla researches and where the Seelie legend is discussed
introduced.quote: I was just looking up some information at the House of Daena...

introduced.name: Puspa Café
