introduced.how: Café in Sumeru where Layla and the Traveler go to rest
introduced.quote: Traveler: How about we head to Puspa Café?

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Organization open to everyone's commissions, useful for finding favors and information
introduced.quote: The Adventurers' Guild is open to everyone's commissions, so she might have some ideas.

introduced.name: Mahamata
introduced.how: Staff who enforce quiet and glare at troublemakers in the House of Daena
introduced.quote: or else you'll get some scary glares from the Mahamata.

introduced.name: Rtawahist
introduced.how: Academic school of research that Layla and the Seelie belong to, marked by an emblem on the stamp
introduced.quote: The red stamp bears the Rtawahist emblem, which is used by a lot of people.

introduced.name: Darshan
introduced.how: Academic class group in which Layla studies and uses the same reference books
introduced.quote: Oh, I know where those are... My Darshan has us use those two books quite often.

introduced.name: blessing from the stars
introduced.how: Layla's name for an unexplained phenomenon in which her chores and papers get finished while she sleeps
introduced.quote: I really don't know what's going on, but for now, I'm calling the phenomenon a

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: An elemental power that Layla possesses, though she cannot yet use it well
introduced.quote: Not exactly. I already had a Vision by that time.

introduced.name: celestial globe
introduced.how: High-precision Akademiya device for researching the stars, which requires a loan application
introduced.quote: The celestial globe is a high precision device used specifically for researching the stars.

introduced.name: talisman
introduced.how: Charm Layla's mother made for her, carried for important tasks, and lost in Sumeru
introduced.quote: It's extremely precious to me. Ever since I was little, I would always carry it with me whenever I'm doing something important.

introduced.name: Elemental Monuments
introduced.how: Structures in the area that can be used to reach high places
introduced.quote: Let's try using the Elemental Monuments in the area.

introduced.name: Chatrakam Cave
introduced.how: One of several sighting locations of the Seelie
introduced.quote: There have been many sightings too, including at Chatrakam Cave, the Avidya Forest, and around the waterfall south of Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Bimarstan
introduced.how: Infirmary where Layla rested after a fracture
introduced.quote: I just got a minor fracture, so I had to rest at Bimarstan for a while.

introduced.name: Sumeru City
introduced.how: Major city where Layla moved to attend the Akademiya
introduced.quote: I had no idea I'd meet someone so nice in Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Seelie special abilities
introduced.how: Reported powers of the Seelie: ice, meteors, and an impervious metal body
introduced.quote: it can freeze water into ice, and it can also summon meteors.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Bandit group that robbed a family in the countryside near Sumeru
introduced.quote: They were a group of Treasure Hoarders, and the family that was being mugged looked completely helpless.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Group whose member rescued Layla from leopards
introduced.quote: Good thing someone from the Eremites heard me shouting for help.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: Guard force that was not watching the House of Daena walls
introduced.quote: while the Corps of Thirty wasn't paying attention.

introduced.name: leopard incident
introduced.how: Layla's first failure: she stepped on a sleeping Avidya Leopard's tail while distracted
introduced.quote: I was distracted and... accidentally stepped on an Avidya Leopard's tail.

introduced.name: muddy observation accident
introduced.how: Layla's equipment toppled at a muddy site, leading to a fracture and debt
introduced.quote: But the equipment was a little heavy, and I didn't notice that the ground was muddy and some spots were unstable.

introduced.name: bandit robbery
introduced.how: Layla fled a robbery instead of helping, and she regrets it
introduced.quote: I could've stepped in to help that family... "Would it have ended differently... if I were just a little braver?"

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: a student researching astrology at the Akademiya who grew up in a rural hometown
introduced.quote: Layla: I grew up in a place like this.

introduced.name: Azzam
introduced.how: an astrology enthusiast and collector of specialized devices who can lend equipment

threads.claim: No one knows whether the Wisdom Seelie is a person or some other being.
threads.quote: No one knows who or what it actually is... It's just known as the Wisdom Seelie.

threads.claim: Layla reasons that if the Seelie is a person, it can be tracked down through its checkout logs.
threads.quote: If the Seelie is a person, then there has to be a way to track them down.

threads.claim: The Seelie is revealed to be Layla's own second self, who has been secretly helping her.
threads.quote: That's right... Though I didn't intend for it to turn out this way, really.

threads.claim: Layla attributes her finished chores and papers to an unexplained blessing she cannot explain.
threads.quote: I really don't know what's going on, but for now, I'm calling the phenomenon a

threads.claim: The blessing from the stars is revealed to be the same entity as the Wisdom Seelie.
threads.quote: They're probably one and the same.

threads.claim: Layla does not know who has been secretly helping her or whether that helper is even a person.
threads.quote: This might sound strange, but I actually don't know who's been helping me.

threads.claim: Layla suspects she might be the Seelie herself while sleepwalking.
threads.quote: For all I know, I could even BE the Seelie.

threads.claim: The Seelie reveals itself as a second Layla who is doing her work while she sleeps.
threads.quote: After all, she and I are one and the same. We're two sides of the same coin.

threads.claim: The Seelie's clue refers to a past failure of Layla's that she has told almost no one.
threads.quote: but how did it know about all these details? I've hardly told anyone about this stuff...

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests the Seelie may be stalking Layla, though Layla finds that frightening.
threads.quote: Is the Seelie stalking you?

threads.claim: Eyewitnesses claim the Wisdom Seelie can freeze water and summon meteors.
threads.quote: it can freeze water into ice, and it can also summon meteors.

threads.claim: The special powers are revealed to be things Layla did while trying to finish her thesis.
threads.quote: As for the special powers... Well, they're just things I did during the process of trying to finish the thesis.

threads.claim: A black shadow was seen infiltrating the closed House of Daena at night, moving with great speed.
threads.quote: One time, late at night, a black shadow fell from above and landed in the central area of the House of Daena.

threads.claim: The House of Daena intrusion is explained as Layla's accident while retrieving an important book.
threads.quote: Infiltrating the House of Daena was a total accident.

threads.claim: Layla's mother's talisman, which calmed her, is lost in Sumeru City, and its absence hints at a bad omen.
threads.quote: Yeah, but when I finally managed to calm myself down, I noticed that the talisman my mother had made for me was missing.

threads.claim: The Wisdom Seelie leaves hidden clues and hints that guide Layla along a trail.
threads.quote: Layla: Here it is, just as I thought. The Seelie must have placed it here in advance.

threads.claim: Layla suspects she might be the Wisdom Seelie herself, possibly acting while she sleepwalks.
threads.quote: Hah, I doubt it... I mean, unless I somehow came here while I was unconscious, and don't remember it.

threads.claim: The blessing from the stars is connected to the help Layla has been receiving.
threads.quote: Traveler: Either way, it's safe to say that it's related to the blessing from the stars.

threads.claim: Layla does not yet understand what the blessing is and wants to learn more about it.
threads.quote: I still don't know anything about the blessing from the stars. Will it never happen again since I don't need its help anymore?

threads.claim: Layla reveals that the blessing is a second self that takes over when she loses consciousness.
threads.quote: Hehe, I suppose that is what she's been calling me.

threads.claim: Layla's poor sleep makes her dizzy and drains her, hinting at a hidden problem.
threads.quote: I'm sorry, I haven't been sleeping very well lately.

threads.claim: Layla's condition may worsen, and the other self may cease to exist.
threads.quote: If her condition grows any worse, it's possible that I might cease to exist as well.

threads.claim: Long-term sleep deprivation causes Layla to lose consciousness, letting the blessing take over.
threads.quote: With her long-term sleep deprivation, whenever her anxiety peaks, she loses consciousness and I take over.

threads.claim: Layla cannot remember her earlier visits to Mundhir or the letter she left behind.
threads.quote: When did I come here last? I don't seem to remember.

threads.claim: Layla reflects on letting go of her childhood as a part of growing up.
threads.quote: There is a purpose for every stage in life.

threads.claim: Pierro is Khaenri'ahn and knows the Tsaritsa's plans but refuses to reveal his identity or motives.
threads.quote: The Traveler recognizes him as Khaenri'ahn by his star-shaped pupils

threads.claim: Paimon has no memories of Pierro even though he seemed to know her.
threads.quote: though she has no memories of him.

threads.claim: Some Khaenri'ahn survived the cataclysm and still live in the world.
threads.quote: There are indeed some Khaenri'ahns left in this world who survived the cataclysm.

threads.claim: A mysterious power is affecting Paimon since she arrived in Snezhnaya, and its source is unknown.
threads.quote: She describes a mysterious power that's been affecting her since arriving in Snezhnaya

threads.claim: Paimon's sense of the mysterious power grows clearer, though she remains too weak to adventure.
threads.quote: Back with Paimon, she senses the mysterious power more clearly now

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae was created to help humanity reach Tomorrow, but its memories and past are damaged and unclear.
threads.quote: I was created so that humanity could reach Tomorrow

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae's mission involves helping people reach the Empty Ark, a destination it has not explained.
threads.quote: help the suffering masses to reach the far shores where the Empty Ark floats

threads.claim: A powerful monster is summoning a bitter snowstorm over Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: a powerful monster having summoned a bitter snowstorm

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa and her Druzhna have gone east to slay the monster behind the snowstorms.
threads.quote: the Tsaritsa and her Druzhna have gone east to slay the monster responsible for the snowstorms

threads.claim: The group is pulled into the Shadow Realm when strange objects appear on the train.
threads.quote: they have been sucked into the Shadow Realm

threads.claim: Snezhnaya's railroads and terrain have changed far beyond the Eye of Graeae's old records.
threads.quote: even the railroads and the terrain itself have changed substantially

threads.claim: Project Stuzha cuts energy use across Snezhnaya, and its real purpose is initially unclear.
threads.quote: The Tsaritsa has implemented Project Stuzha, a plan to lower energy consumption across Snezhnaya in order to redirect it for crucial research

threads.claim: Mitya reveals that Project Stuzha's energy research needs Stellar Linchpins and burns huge amounts of Kristall with little progress.
threads.quote: Mitya reveals that the Armory Palace needs an entirely new energy source drawn from Stellar Linchpins

threads.claim: Sandrone suspects Odette may be Lelek, a skilled infiltrator, based on her backstory.
threads.quote: it leads Sandrone to a theory that Odette herself could be Lelek

threads.claim: Lelek forced Chugunov to change his vote, suggesting Lelek uses threats to end Project Stuzha.
threads.quote: Lelek forced the change through threats or coercion

threads.claim: A shortage of Kresnik Kristall leaves many people unable to heat their homes.
threads.quote: the shortage of Kresnik Kristall means many people have been unable to heat their stoves

threads.claim: The Iskra plant is under investigation for illegal excess energy use.
threads.quote: since reconnaissance confirmed illegal excess energy use at the plant

threads.claim: The purpose of the energy gathered for the Tsaritsa is secret and unknown to the public.
threads.quote: The goal of Project Stuzha is to gather energy for the Tsaritsa, but no one knows where that energy's going.

threads.claim: The Traveler is determined to learn what the Tsaritsa is trying to achieve.
threads.quote: I really need to know what the Tsaritsa is up to.

threads.claim: The Gnoses are tied to the Tsaritsa's ultimate goal, but their role is unexplained.
threads.quote: Her ultimate goal, what the Gnoses mean in all of this...

threads.claim: Project Stuzha was promised to last six months but keeps being extended, hinting the Tsaritsa's plan is failing.
threads.quote: we were told that the project would only last for six months. But time and time again, they keep extending it...

threads.claim: Project Stuzha is expected to continue for a long time.
threads.quote: Project Stuzha isn't going away any time soon.

threads.claim: Pulcinella pressures dissenting voters, so extensions pass despite growing opposition.
threads.quote: But even though opposition has been growing, any detractors end up caving in to political pressure from

threads.claim: The Rokot secretly recruits talented people to work against Project Stuzha and sometimes the Tsaritsa.
threads.quote: Recently, they've been recruiting people with your kind of talent...

threads.claim: The Rokot is a gray-area group that may face a crackdown if the Veche judges it has crossed a line.
threads.quote: The moment the Veche think they've crossed a line, there's sure to be a crackdown...

threads.claim: People pulled into the Shadow Realm rarely return, and those who do are changed.
threads.quote: Most people who get sucked into the Shadow Realm are never seen again...

threads.claim: The Traveler's group escapes the Shadow Realm by reaching its exit at the core.
threads.quote: Whew... Looks like I was right!

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae's creation purpose is tied to something from the Shadow Realm that it cannot currently access.
threads.quote: In fact, the very purpose of my creation was likely to... ... ...from the Shadow Realm.

threads.claim: Key data about the Eye of Graeae is inaccessible for now.
threads.quote: It appears that key data is currently inaccessible.

threads.claim: Hyperborea, the Golden City, is referenced in the Eye of Graeae's activation code as a lost place.
threads.quote: This is what remains of the Golden City, Hyperborea.

threads.claim: The Traveler knows of Hyperborea, and the Eye of Graeae notices it.
threads.quote: Ah, so you have heard of the Golden City before?

threads.claim: The Druzhna is the Tsaritsa's personal guard, fighting alongside her.
threads.quote: I'm sure the Tsaritsa and her personal guard, the Druzhna, won't have any trouble defeating the creature between them.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa is campaigning east against a monster that summons blizzards.
threads.quote: Word is, she's heading east on a campaign to slay a monster.

threads.claim: The monster keeps absorbing everything and growing, so the Tsaritsa treats it as the top threat.
threads.quote: Now, it's so big that the Tsaritsa has deemed it the number one threat.

threads.claim: Energy supplies in Sretomorozsk are being seized for a private stockpile.
threads.quote: I've been doing some digging recently. Turns out, the real reason for the current energy crisis in Sretomorozsk is that some of the supply is being seized for a private stockpile.

threads.claim: Shishkin is exposed as a thief who colluded with the mayor, and the stolen Kristall is found.
threads.quote: You claim this was a one-time mistake, but the real reason there's only one shipment's worth of stolen Kristall in your basement is that you have an accomplice.

threads.claim: Alatyr has been cut off from Kristall deliveries and is in danger of freezing.
threads.quote: Deliveries of Kresnik Kristall have ceased there entirely.

threads.claim: Alatyr is abandoned, and Alyosha wonders why it would need Kristall.
threads.quote: I'm from Alatyr myself, and I can tell you, nobody's lived there in years.

threads.claim: The Traveler's train was found in a cave, and its technology is unusual.
threads.quote: Paimon still can't get over the fact that you just found this tech lying around in a random cave.

threads.claim: The central question is what the Tsaritsa is planning, and everything else is expected to lead back to it.
threads.quote: the million-Mora question is: "What is the Tsaritsa planning?"

threads.claim: The purpose of Project Stuzha is unexplained, and the Traveler wants to know why it matters so much.
threads.quote: But what exactly is this project's purpose? And how can it be so important

threads.claim: Project Stuzha keeps being extended and opposed, and its effects on ordinary people are growing.
threads.quote: Growing opposition to Project Stuzha, and the usual rebuttals are starting to ring hollow.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa leads an army east to defeat a monster, which the Harbingers say shows she still cares about Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: she's currently leading her army on a campaign to the east to defeat the monster that's been causing these brutal blizzards.

threads.claim: A powerful monster is causing the blizzards across Snezhnaya and is still at large.
threads.quote: There's a highly aggressive monster on the prowl.

threads.claim: Snezhnaya is in an energy crisis, and defeating the monster is expected to help solve it.
threads.quote: Striking that monster down will be a significant step in dealing with the present energy crisis.

threads.claim: The Exaiphanes Blade's origins are a mystery to be uncovered in later adventures.
threads.quote: Its origins remain a mystery, and further details may only be uncovered through further adventures.

threads.claim: The Exaiphanes Blade vibrates on its own and reacts to the Statue of The Seven.
threads.quote: This sword seems to be vibrating of its own accord.

threads.claim: The Exaiphanes Blade may be connected to the Statue of The Seven, and Cryo use on the statue makes the blade stronger.
threads.quote: Does this sword have some connection to the statue?

threads.claim: The statue's message hints at a traveler seeking redemption in foreign lands, which may relate to the Traveler.
threads.quote: The traveler journeyed far into foreign lands, all for a slim chance of redemption.

threads.claim: A mysterious snegovik lord is said to dwell on the mountain, and the snegoviks there live in seclusion.
threads.quote: They say this mountain's the domain of a snegovik lord.

threads.claim: Snezhnaya was once the realm of the fae, and its current state is unexplained.
threads.quote: We'd heard that Snezhnaya used to be the realm of the fae.

threads.claim: Nobody practices alchemy in Snezhnograd, and the reason is a historical one that is still unknown.
threads.quote: Apparently, there's some historical reason for it.

threads.claim: Capitano's letter reassigned his subordinates to Tartaglia and was held back by Pierro until after Natlan.
threads.quote: All of his key people were reassigned to Tartaglia.

threads.claim: Capitano was furious about the Liyue situation, which Marionette won't explain and says Tartaglia should.
threads.quote: Normally, it took a lot to get under Capitano's skin, but that time he was furious...

threads.claim: The Jester's recent movements are confidential, and he has gone south without Glupov knowing.
threads.quote: Our director's recent movements are confidential — even we're not in the loop.

threads.claim: The Jester seemed to know who Paimon was, and the Traveler wants to know why.
threads.quote: He seemed to know who Paimon was...

threads.claim: The Rokot is a hidden-identity group that people turn to when they cannot act openly, and the Fatui discourage it.
threads.quote: Members of the Rokot keep their true identities hidden

threads.claim: Odette doubts Project Stuzha because ordinary Fatui do not know what it is, and she cannot keep going along with things that do not make sense.
threads.quote: if things aren't making sense to me, I can't just keep going along with it.

threads.claim: The Traveler defeated Rosalyne in a duel before the throne in Inazuma, which is why Odette is wary of the Traveler.
threads.quote: There was a duel before the throne, in which the Traveler defeated Rosalyne.

threads.claim: Childe holds back dissenting votes in the Veche because the Tsaritsa would not allow it, and Odette admires people who speak out.
threads.quote: I've only held back on casting a dissenting vote in the Veche because the Tsaritsa would never let me get away with it.

threads.claim: Lelek is a masked Rokot figure whose identity and motive for ending Project Stuzha are unknown.
threads.quote: Ending Project Stuzha has become an obsession for him.

threads.claim: Odette is suspected of being Lelek, since her Rokot membership could conceal her identity.
threads.quote: Maybe we should interrogate that assumption.

threads.claim: Lelek is pressuring Veche members, such as Chugunov, into flipping their votes against Project Stuzha.
threads.quote: Chugunov... I see. Lelek strikes again.

threads.claim: The true end goal of Project Stuzha is an open question.
threads.quote: What is the end goal of this project, anyway...

threads.claim: The Armory Palace is developing a new energy source from Stellar Linchpins, with unclear side effects.
threads.quote: The Armory Palace needs a brand-new energy source

threads.claim: Paimon feels a mysterious power affecting her that began only after arriving in Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: It's like there's... some kind of mysterious power affecting Paimon.

threads.claim: The mysterious power seems to come from the same direction as the Armory Palace.
threads.quote: It's pretty faint, so it's kinda hard to tell...

threads.claim: Mitya's scarf behaves as if it is alive, and its nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: It's like it's alive...

threads.claim: Odette's father died during the early stages of Project Stuzha, giving her a possible motive against it.
threads.quote: The reason being, her father passed away during the early stages of the project.

threads.claim: The cause of Odette's conflict with Rosalyne is unknown.
threads.quote: I have no idea where Odette's head is at right now, or what her conflict with Rosalyne was about.

threads.claim: The Rokot has gathered evidence that the Iskra plant exceeds legal energy limits and aims to force an investigation.
threads.quote: Recently, we've done some recon work at the Iskra Manufacturing Plant

threads.claim: Rokot members hide identities and mostly do not know each other.
threads.quote: Members typically don't meet in person or even know each other's identities.

threads.claim: Kristall allocation fairness is a contested public issue that the Veche has yet to resolve.
threads.quote: There needs to be a clear and consistent rationale behind how Kristall is allocated, or we will soon face immense public backlash.

threads.claim: Mitya may have deliberately revealed hints about the energy project to the Traveler.
threads.quote: Did he deliberately mention the new energy source so that we'd overhear it?

threads.claim: Valeriy's unit enforces schedules, and Mitya's timing is being monitored by the Fatui.
threads.quote: One of the main duties of the Special Assignments Battalion is to ensure that important figures stick to their schedules.

introduced.name: Bennett
introduced.how: Self-introduced as a Mondstadt adventurer who envies the Traveler's achievements and has terrible luck
introduced.quote: Bennett: The name's Bennett. I'm your run-of-the-mill adventurer from Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Organization of adventurers that Bennett belongs to and that issues commissions
introduced.quote: The Traveler runs into Bennett, an adventurer from the Adventurers' Guild, who is envious about his achievements.

introduced.name: Fischl
introduced.how: Guild member who works in the Intelligence Department and is Bennett's friend
introduced.quote: Bennett: I mean, I'm not on the same level as Fischl, who is also in the Adventurers' Guild. But that's expected, because she works in the Intelligence Department.

introduced.name: Benny's Adventure Team
introduced.how: Bennett's adventure team, which has effectively collapsed and survives only in name
introduced.quote: Bennett: ...I hate to admit it, but the truth is... it's gone. It remains in name alone.

introduced.name: Royce
introduced.how: Former member of Benny's Adventure Team who left after bad luck struck and is Bennett's old friend
introduced.quote: Bennett: , let me introduce Royce, a former member of Benny's Adventure Team, and... and old friend of mine.

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: Former Benny's Adventure Team member and guild adventurer who comes to fetch Bennett to look after his dads
introduced.quote: Bennett: Haha... yeah. Royce, Heckler, and Jack were all members of Benny's Adventure Team.

introduced.name: With Wind Comes Glory
introduced.how: Shop in Mondstadt that Bennett likes and that sells adventuring goods
introduced.quote: They go to With Wind Comes Glory first, only to see that they're out of stock of what Bennett needs.

introduced.name: Marjorie
introduced.how: Shopkeeper at With Wind Comes Glory who handles Bennett's orders
introduced.quote: Marjorie: Oh, hello, Bennett! I haven't seen you for a long time.

introduced.name: Mondstadt General Goods
introduced.how: General store in Mondstadt run by Blanche that offered a sale
introduced.quote: Lastly, they go to Mondstadt General Goods and are delighted to see that the store is offering 50% off on all items, despite Blanche being nowhere to be found.

introduced.name: Blanche
introduced.how: Owner of Mondstadt General Goods who is usually at her counter
introduced.quote: Bennett: Huh, that's strange... the owner, Blanche, isn't here. Hmm... That's really rare.

introduced.name: Sara
introduced.how: Staff member at Good Hunter who refuses service because of a large order
introduced.quote: Sara: Ah... I'm so sorry, I don't think we'll be able to serve you two today.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A delegation from Snezhnaya is staying at the Goth Grand Hotel and has ordered a large meal service
introduced.quote: Sara: An entire delegation from Snezhnaya has come to stay at the Goth Grand Hotel, and they asked us to provide a meal service.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Group described as arrogant and aggressive, blamed by the Traveler for the trouble
introduced.quote: Bennett: But I have heard that they're arrogant and aggressive.

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: Alchemist who says Alchemist's Goggles do not exist
introduced.quote: Marjorie: I talked to that alchemist, Timaeus... He told me there's no such thing.

introduced.name: Herman's Custom Adventure Map
introduced.how: Custom adventure map drawn by Herman, a great adventurer, listing recommended places
introduced.quote: Bennett: That's right! An adventure map drawn personally by Herman, the great adventurer. It shows loads of recommended places for adventuring, and with his comments, too!

introduced.name: Alchemist's Goggles
introduced.how: Rumored goggles for alchemists that reveal elemental energy, though they may not exist
introduced.quote: Bennett: When you wear them, you can see all the elements, even the slightest traces of elemental energy!

introduced.name: Slime Gel Gloves
introduced.how: Gloves that grip rock when climbing in any weather, sold out at the shop
introduced.quote: Bennett: No matter what the weather, they can grip onto rock when climbing. I call them... non-slip gloves.

introduced.name: Guild Master Cyrus
introduced.how: Guild Master who rescued Bennett and took him back to Mondstadt safely
introduced.quote: Bennett: But, turns out that's not how it went. Instead, according to Guild Master Cyrus who rescued me...

introduced.name: Ominous Dish
introduced.how: Dish Bennett cooks for adventures that is probably spoiled
introduced.quote: Bennett wolfs down his Ominous Dish...

introduced.name: Bennett's bad luck
introduced.how: Bennett is an unlucky person whose misfortune affects those around him
introduced.quote: Bennett: Eh-hehe... Maybe you don't know. I'm a really unlucky person to have around...

introduced.name: Bennett's dads
introduced.how: Older adventurers who raised Bennett after rescuing him as a baby, and whom he now looks after
introduced.quote: Bennett: They were the ones who rescued me from a perilous place when I was just a baby, and together they raised me.

introduced.name: Dandelion meadow
introduced.how: Dandelion-covered meadow Bennett knows around Mondstadt, now stripped of seeds
introduced.quote: Bennett: Oh, I know this gorgeous place. It's sort of a dandelion-covered meadow.

introduced.name: Newly discovered ruins
introduced.how: Mysterious and dangerous ruin found recently and rated between Rank B and Rank A
introduced.quote: Bennett: According to my friend Fischl in the guild, a mysterious and dangerous ruin has recently been discovered...

introduced.name: Ruin mechanisms
introduced.how: Paired mechanisms in the ruin that must be triggered in the correct order and can trap the operator
introduced.quote: Bennett: The things that stand out are the two mechanisms in front of us, one on the left, and one on the right.

introduced.name: Lost Adventure Notebook
introduced.how: Notebook left in the ruin by earlier adventurers, with hints about the mechanisms
introduced.quote: (Opens the Lost Adventure Notebook):

introduced.name: Eric's failed expedition
introduced.how: Earlier adventurers including Eric gave up the ruin after a dangerous mechanism mistake
introduced.quote: Eric can't hold on any longer... We had no choice but to give up.

assumed.name: Stormterror crisis
assumed.quote: Bennett: Of course! You're the mysterious Traveler, the hero who quelled the Stormterror crisis, and the leader of your own adventure team to boot!

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Bennett: How're your adventures going lately? Did you come here to get a new commission from Katheryne, or to get paid?

threads.claim: Bennett is cursed with chronic bad luck that spills onto everyone around him.
threads.quote: Bennett: Eh-hehe... Maybe you don't know. I'm a really unlucky person to have around...

threads.claim: Bennett suspects his bad luck depends on whether he is conscious, which hints at a deeper cause.
threads.quote: Bennett: I wonder if my bad luck is related to whether I'm awake or not. Or in other words, it might be my consciousness that brings me bad luck.

threads.claim: The thunderstorm clears the moment Bennett leaves, hinting his presence is what brings the bad weather.
threads.quote: Paimon: How come the weather suddenly brightened up the second Bennett left?

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests that good luck can still occur even for someone as unlucky as Bennett.
threads.quote: Traveler: But it shows that fortunate outcomes do exist.

threads.claim: Benny's Adventure Team has collapsed and only exists on paper, which raises the question of why its members left.
threads.quote: Bennett: ...I hate to admit it, but the truth is... it's gone. It remains in name alone.

threads.claim: The ruin's mechanisms have a deadly activation sequence that earlier adventurers failed to survive.
threads.quote: Eric can't hold on any longer... We had no choice but to give up.

threads.claim: A mysterious and dangerous ruin has recently been found and is still unexplored.
threads.quote: Bennett: According to my friend Fischl in the guild, a mysterious and dangerous ruin has recently been discovered...

threads.claim: An unseen person is heard inside the ruin, suggesting other people are present there.
threads.quote: ???: What the... What's going on...

threads.claim: Snezhnaya's delegation and the Fatui are presented as a pushy presence in Mondstadt that locals distrust.
threads.quote: Sara: An entire delegation from Snezhnaya has come to stay at the Goth Grand Hotel, and they asked us to provide a meal service.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: consultant of Wangsheng and trusted associate of the Fatui who can help with Rex Lapis's farewell
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce Mr. Zhongli, consultant to an organization known as Wangsheng... and a trusted associate of the Fatui.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: organizes burials so that the dead pass on in peace, with a suspected hidden side business
introduced.quote: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor organizes burials. We ensure that those who pass on do so in peace.

introduced.name: Rite of Parting
introduced.how: a farewell ritual for a deity that lets people see Rex Lapis's form again
introduced.quote: Only by participating in the Rite of Parting will you be able to see the form of Rex Lapis again.

introduced.name: Exuvia
introduced.how: Rex Lapis's vessel, hidden by the Qixing and to be kept at the Golden House before the rite
introduced.quote: Traditionally, we call it the Exuvia.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: another name of Morax, one of the Archons and the Prime of the Adepti
introduced.quote: Archons go by many names. The God of Contracts, the God of Commerce, the Warrior God, Morax, Rex Lapis...

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: ancient beings who are leaving Liyue as mankind rises
introduced.quote: Rex Lapis may be the Prime of Adepti, but he is ultimately an adeptus. Many adepti have left us over the millennia — this is the inexorable trend.

introduced.name: Noctilucous Jade
introduced.how: a mystical stone that lights up darkness, whose quality shows in its Pyro-lit brightness; radiant grade is needed for the rite
introduced.quote: Noctilucous Jade is a mystical stone used to light up the darkness, and so its brightness is the most important thing

introduced.name: Li style and Yue style cooking
introduced.how: two rival cooking traditions in Liyue that have competed for centuries
introduced.quote: There are two styles of cooking in Liyue, known as Li style and Yue style.

introduced.name: Liuli Pavilion
introduced.how: the flagship Li style restaurant, placed at Feiyun Slope to face the Xinyue Kiosk
introduced.quote: The flagship restaurant of the Li style is the Liuli Pavilion.

introduced.name: Xinyue Kiosk
introduced.how: the flagship Yue style restaurant, rival of the Liuli Pavilion
introduced.quote: which is the flagship restaurant of the Yue style.

introduced.name: Jade Mystery
introduced.how: a jade shop run by Shitou that sells Noctilucous Jade
introduced.quote: Shitou: Welcome to the Jade Mystery, my good friends! Would you like to try your luck betting on jade?

introduced.name: Shitou
introduced.how: jade merchant at the Jade Mystery who was saddened by Rex Lapis's passing
introduced.quote: Shitou: Welcome to the Jade Mystery, my good friends! Would you like to try your luck betting on jade?

introduced.name: Madame Ping
introduced.how: elderly guardian of the Cleansing Bell who lives inside a teapot domain
introduced.quote: Madame Ping: Haha, an old lady like me can't afford to buy a place in this city. See this ceramic teapot? My entire household is in here.

introduced.name: Cleansing Bell
introduced.how: a vital implement of the Rite of Parting that rids the deity of impurities as it bids farewell
introduced.quote: A vital implement used in the Rite of Parting.

introduced.name: Golden House
introduced.how: the only mint in Liyue and Teyvat, where all Mora is minted
introduced.quote: The only mint in Liyue... which is to say the only mint in Teyvat. All the Mora that flows throughout the world is minted there.

introduced.name: Silk Flower
introduced.how: a flower with fibrous petals and an elegant scent, used to make perfume for offerings to the gods
introduced.quote: Silk Flower petals contain a fibrous material of good quality, often used in brocade-making.

introduced.name: Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: a statue where perfume is offered, with tradition holding that the deity chooses between scents
introduced.quote: Tradition states that we should decoct perfume from different sub-species of Silk Flower when making an offering to a Statue of The Seven.

introduced.name: Yujing Terrace
introduced.how: the location where the Rite of Parting will be held
introduced.quote: Let's take this jade to Yujing Terrace. That's where we plan to hold the Rite...

introduced.name: Ying'er
introduced.how: perfume maker whom rich families hire for homemade perfume
introduced.quote: Many a rich family's daughter has gotten her to make perfume for them.

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: Silk Flower seller who gives the flowers free to honor Rex Lapis
introduced.quote: Bolai: Since these flowers will be used to glorify our Lord, they're free of charge. Just don't forget to pass on my regards.

introduced.name: Qiming
introduced.how: fortune teller who sets up a stall by the docks and knows of Ying'er's perfume
introduced.quote: Qiming: Since I usually set up my stall by the docks, I avoid perfume like the plague.

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: pharmacist who introduces himself and sells Everlasting Incense for three million mora
introduced.quote: Introducing himself as Baizhu, he learns that they want some Everlasting Incense and offers to sell it for three million mora, which they can't afford.

introduced.name: Everlasting Incense
introduced.how: incense sold at Bubu Pharmacy that the rite requires
introduced.quote: states that they need to get some Everlasting Incense from Bubu Pharmacy.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: young woman who brings Ningguang's invitation to the Jade Chamber
introduced.quote: The woman introduces herself as Ganyu and that Ningguang has extended them an invitation to the Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: the Tianquan who has forbidden anyone from accessing Rex Lapis's vessel
introduced.quote: The Tianquan, Ningguang, has forbidden anyone from accessing Rex Lapis' vessel...

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: the rulers of Liyue, who have hidden the Exuvia
introduced.quote: Liyue is the most prosperous of the seven nations, defended by deities and ruled by the Qixing.

introduced.name: Granny Shan
introduced.how: kite maker who cares about Liyue's old traditions
introduced.quote: Granny Shan is one of the few who appear to care for Liyue's old traditions and appreciates Zhongli's compliments on how well the kites are made.

introduced.name: Kites in Liyue rituals
introduced.how: kites that play symbolic roles in Liyue's rituals, not just toys
introduced.quote: Kites are children's toys, yes, but they also play various symbolic roles in Liyue's rituals.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis's death
introduced.how: Rex Lapis was killed in a deicide that remains unsolved
introduced.quote: Traveler: Well, they do have a deicide to deal with...

introduced.name: Glaze Lilies
introduced.how: flowers said to read human hearts and wilt from slander
introduced.quote: Back in my day, people said that Glaze Lilies can read human hearts.

introduced.name: Meaty Tribe cooking pot
introduced.how: a giant pot in Dadaupa Gorge whose heat shows jade quality
introduced.quote: Observe the Noctilucous Jade: (Who'd have thought the hilichurls' cooking pot in Dadaupa Gorge would be a reliable means of assessing the quality...)

introduced.name: Granny Shan
introduced.how: Kite maker in Liyue who has made kites for forty years
introduced.quote: Granny Shan: I have made kites in Liyue for forty years, and I am intimately familiar with the forms passed down from my ancestors.

introduced.name: Tic
introduced.how: Hired helper who takes odd jobs for Mora and bargains hard
introduced.quote: Tic: Oh? Help? Sure! I, Tic, always put in one hundred percent effort into everything I do!

introduced.name: Tac
introduced.how: Cook-minded hired helper who takes a day's work for a fee
introduced.quote: Tac: A full day of odd jobs at Yujing Terrace? Hmm... No problem.

introduced.name: Toe
introduced.how: Reserve adventurer who takes crystalfly commissions for pay
introduced.quote: Toe: Hiring help? Sure, but let me just say first that I'm a reserve member of the Adventurers' Guild. I take adventuring commissions, but I don't do anything clerical.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Organization that takes adventuring commissions, with reserve members
introduced.quote: Toe: Hiring help? Sure, but let me just say first that I'm a reserve member of the Adventurers' Guild. I take adventuring commissions, but I don't do anything clerical.

introduced.name: Qiqi
introduced.how: Zombie girl working reception who was died and revived by adepti
introduced.quote: Qiqi: Once upon a time, Qiqi died. Then, Qiqi was saved by the adepti. Now, Qiqi is a zombie.

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: Pharmacy run by Baizhu, sells Everlasting Incense
introduced.quote: Qiqi: Welcome to Bubu Pharmacy. I am Qiqi.

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: Boss of Bubu Pharmacy who wears medicinal ingredients
introduced.quote: Baizhu: Ah, how rude of me. I'm Baizhu, boss of the Bubu Pharmacy.

introduced.name: Changsheng
introduced.how: Talking white snake, a living medicinal mascot of the pharmacy
introduced.quote: Baizhu: Hahaha, don't mind Changsheng, she's a good girl, really.

introduced.name: Zombies
introduced.how: Zombies act only within the confines of orders given to them
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Zombies are limited to acting within the confines of their orders. And somehow, in this case, the zombie issues her own orders to herself.

introduced.name: Guizhong Ballista
introduced.how: Ancient crossbow turret on Mt. Tianheng, built by an adeptus to fire at large monsters
introduced.quote: Zhongli: It is a kind of crossbow turret, installed on Mt. Tianheng by an adeptus in the distant past. An early mechanical device.

introduced.name: Tianheng Pass
introduced.how: Pass where the Guizhong Ballista is located and where a supply post lies
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Located in Tianheng Pass, it was designed to automatically fire at large monsters, protecting Liyue from external threats.

introduced.name: Cocogoat
introduced.how: Said to be a legendary adeptibeast, with no known look, location, or origin
introduced.quote: Qiqi: The Cocogoat is a legendary animal. An adeptibeast.

introduced.name: Coconut milk
introduced.how: Milk made from the fruit of the coconut tree, which Qiqi had mistaken for the Cocogoat
introduced.quote: Traveler: It all begins with the fruit of the coconut tree...

introduced.name: Freckle Huang
introduced.how: Leader of the Treasure Hoarders who guards hidden treasure
introduced.quote: Freckle Huang: Ha! Are you blind or something? You're looking at the leader of the Treasure Hoarders, old man!

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Group hunting hidden treasures on the mountain, who disarmed the ballista before
introduced.quote: Freckle Huang: Ha! Are you blind or something? You're looking at the leader of the Treasure Hoarders, old man!

introduced.name: Rite of Parting
introduced.how: Ceremony using seven kites and Everlasting Incense, with helpers and materials needed
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Indeed. These are decorations used in the Rite of Parting. The seven kites represent The Seven.

introduced.name: Everlasting Incense
introduced.how: Costly incense needed for the Rite of Parting, sold at Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Next, we need some Everlasting Incense. For this, we need to go to Bubu Pharmacy, the finest pharmacy in all of—

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: Private room where Ningguang sifts documents with three confidantes and shreds them
introduced.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: They say that when Lady Ningguang ponders important affairs, she retreats to her Jade Chamber with none but her three closest confidantes in tow.

introduced.name: Third-Round Knockout
introduced.how: Hole-in-the-wall harbor restaurant praised across Liyue, with wine and storytelling
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Tonight, I shall take you both to an old hole-in-the-wall, praised throughout Liyue.

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: Liyue body Ningguang leads, with a corporate secretary and emissaries
introduced.quote: Ganyu: Well, in concrete terms, I am the corporate secretary for the Qixing. At the moment, I am serving as Lady Ningguang's special emissary.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Liyue Qixing emissary and corporate secretary at Yuehai Pavilion who delivers Ningguang's invitation
introduced.quote: Ganyu: However, I am an emissary of the Liyue Qixing. My name is Ganyu, secretary at the Yuehai Pavilion, and I have come specifically to meet you.

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Ekaterina: Welcome, , friend of Childe. And congratulations on the first day of your illustrious career with the Fatui.

assumed.name: Ekaterina
assumed.quote: Ekaterina: But back to the matter at hand. Childe tells me that he has upheld his end of your agreement.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: And the Harbingers do not break their promises lightly.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Only the Tsaritsa truly has a will as solid as the permafrost.

assumed.name: Jueyun Karst
assumed.quote: The times have changed — you must have felt it too when you were at Jueyun Karst.

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Rite of Descension took place here, too.

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Since you have had dealings with the Anemo Archon, could I ask you to help me prepare the Geo Archon's last rites?

assumed.name: Geo Archon
assumed.quote: Sure, the Geo Archon's body has been squirreled away by order of the Tianquan Ningguang...

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Which of course you would need to access if you are to achieve your goal of meeting all of The Seven.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: We might get caught by the Millelith.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: I have heard tell of you from Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Traveler: How about the kitchen at Xiangling's place...

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: We've talked about a whole bunch of things while traveling with him...

assumed.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
assumed.quote: Paimon: Well, this is Mr. Zhongli from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, so he's probably well-versed in all these walks of life.

assumed.name: Teyvat Travel Guide
assumed.quote: Zhongli: But, when I say ambiance, I refer to a different sort from the one the Teyvat Travel Guide uses to judge other establishments.

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Granny Shan: I took the liberty of coloring outside the lines when doing the insignia of the Anemo Archon.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Zhongli: The design of this kite displays a firm grasp on the cyclicality and eternity so dear to the Electro Archon.

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, it's Childe!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Childe: All finished then? Splendid. Any leftover cash is yours to keep — a favor for the Fatui should never go unrewarded.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: Are you forgetting what happened in Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace
assumed.quote: Zhongli: Let me see... we are still missing some wooden implements over at Yujing Terrace. They aren't uncommon objects, so I didn't make any special preparations for them.

assumed.name: Golden House
assumed.quote: Paimon: You might as well just rob the Golden House! Oh, but the Qixing have taken it over for now... Security will be tighter than usual.

assumed.name: Exuvia
assumed.quote: Childe: Well, well, well. Ningguang and her Qixing cronies. What else would they be hiding in the Golden House... if not the Exuvia?

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Paimon: Tianquan Ningguang... feels like we're hearing this name a lot.

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: Paimon: Liyue locals talk about her, the Fatui hate her, she's most likely the one who hid the Exuvia, and we saw her at the Rite of Descension...

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: ???: Wait, I am not with the Millelith, nor am I here to claim your bounty!

assumed.name: Jueyun Karst
assumed.quote: ???: At last, I have found you, you who returned from Jueyun Karst.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Zhongli: Indeed. These are decorations used in the Rite of Parting. The seven kites represent The Seven.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's death is a deicide whose killer has not been found.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah, the killer hasn't even been caught yet.

threads.claim: Rumors blame the Fatui, the Qixing, or That Which Lies in the Deep for the death, with no answer yet.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: Some say it was a Fatui plot. Others say that the Qixing made it all up, and still others think that That Which Lies in the Deep is breaking free.

threads.claim: The Qixing hid Rex Lapis's vessel for a reason the player does not yet know.
threads.quote: Someone who can solve the mystery of why the Liyue Qixing would hide the Geo Archon's vessel.

threads.claim: Childe's motive for funding the rite and helping the Traveler is unclear.
threads.quote: Traveler: They must have some ulterior motive...

threads.claim: Zhongli says he does not know or care what Childe gains from the rite.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I neither know nor do I wish to know. As far as I am concerned, the Fatui are merely financial sponsors.

threads.claim: Wangsheng may do illicit work that the Fatui value, despite its public funeral role.
threads.quote: Childe: The Fatui calls many such people friends, but the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor does no dabble in such business... well, ostensibly.

threads.claim: The adepti are leaving Liyue as mankind rises.
threads.quote: As you have seen, the time of the adepti is ending, and the time of mankind is slowly dawning.

threads.claim: Madame Ping may be one of the adepti, a question she leaves to the Traveler.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: As to whether I am one or not, child, surely you already understand?

threads.claim: Zhongli has hidden reasons for his choices and conduct.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Ah, I have certain reasons why I cannot be there in person. Please do this for me.

threads.claim: Asked if he is an adeptus, Zhongli deflects without answering.
threads.quote: Zhongli: An adeptus...

threads.claim: Glaze Lilies are said to feel the harbor's songs and gossip.
threads.quote: Back in my day, people said that Glaze Lilies can read human hearts.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis takes many forms, which hints that he may be unlike the figure people expect.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Rex Lapis has taken on countless forms. Perhaps that really was one of them.

threads.claim: The statue reacts to the third perfume, showing Rex Lapis's choice as tradition predicted.
threads.quote: Traveler: Looks like Rex Lapis really likes this one.

threads.claim: The Qixing may be hiding the Exuvia inside the Golden House, an object the Fatui want.
threads.quote: Childe: Well, well, well. Ningguang and her Qixing cronies. What else would they be hiding in the Golden House... if not the Exuvia?

threads.claim: Childe seeks information from the Traveler in exchange for a bank heist opportunity, hinting at Fatui plans.
threads.quote: Childe: Haha. Well, how does this sound: You give me the information I need, and maybe I'll leave the Northland Bank's vaults open and unattended for half an hour...

threads.claim: Ningguang is a figure Liyue locals admire and the Fatui hate, and her character remains unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon wonders what sort of person she is.

threads.claim: The Fatui and the Qixing are opposed, with the Fatui hating Ningguang.
threads.quote: Paimon: Liyue locals talk about her, the Fatui hate her, she's most likely the one who hid the Exuvia, and we saw her at the Rite of Descension...

threads.claim: Ningguang formally invites the Traveler to the Jade Chamber to meet her as Tianquan.
threads.quote: Ganyu: She invites you to her palace in the sky.

threads.claim: Zhongli senses dark tides and entwining dark threads threatening the land.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I wonder where we will find them amid these dark tides?

threads.claim: The Guizhong Ballista was built to guard against an ancient evil that might return and bring war.
threads.quote: After centuries of peace in the land, should that ancient evil rear its ugly head and plunge the world into war once more

threads.claim: Qiqi was revived by the adepti as a zombie, raising questions about what the adepti can do.
threads.quote: Qiqi: Once upon a time, Qiqi died. Then, Qiqi was saved by the adepti. Now, Qiqi is a zombie.

threads.claim: The legendary Cocogoat turns out to be a mix-up for coconut milk, and Childe reveals the joke.
threads.quote: Childe: Cocogoat! Cocogo— Ahahaow my sides hurt... Oh my goodness, I cannot BELIEVE you fell for that!

threads.claim: The Rite of Parting uses seven kites representing The Seven and Everlasting Incense, and the Traveler must help prepare it.
threads.quote: Zhongli: The Rite of Parting requires helping hands as well as materials. We should be able to find some people near the harbor.

threads.claim: Zhongli knows ancient Archon and adepti lore in unusual depth, hinting at a long past.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Justice flows across the surface of the waters, war rages like a flame, as does that which the Cryo Archon once... yes, these details are masterfully done.

introduced.name: Veronique
introduced.how: Film prop manager who makes the prop muskets
introduced.quote: This is our prop manager, Veronique. She'll be in charge of all the film's props and items.

introduced.name: Bonnot
introduced.how: Film lighting technician who sets each scene's atmosphere
introduced.quote: And this is Bonnot, our lighting technician.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Film director who was once the biggest star in Fontaine
introduced.quote: Heh, well, I was the biggest star in all of Fontaine, after all.

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: Captain of the Special Patrol who grew up in Fleuve Cendre
introduced.quote: That I grew up in Fleuve Cendre.

introduced.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
introduced.how: Fontaine's special patrol force that Chevreuse captains
introduced.quote: On behalf of Fontaine's Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, thank you for your dedication to justice.

introduced.name: Fleuve Cendre
introduced.how: Slum district where many residents own guns and the bar and sewers are located
introduced.quote: Although many people at Fleuve Cendre own guns, few hide the fact from others

introduced.name: Rainbow Rose
introduced.how: Flower the musketeers leave on victims as a signal of their return
introduced.quote: And on each of the victims, they'd place a Rainbow Rose as a signal that they've returned.

introduced.name: The Two Musketeers
introduced.how: Novel about two sisters who grow up to take revenge with guns
introduced.quote: In the story, the main characters grow up to become the two musketeers, always using their guns to carry out their revenge.

introduced.name: Tulipe and Iris
introduced.how: Sisters who are the main characters of the film adaptation
introduced.quote: Chevreuse will be playing the role of the older sister, Tulipe, and Ayaka will be the younger sister, Iris.

introduced.name: Dirge of Coppelia
introduced.how: Mechanical puppets that dance together at the opera house on Erinnyes island
introduced.quote: Two mechanical puppets that were dancing together!

introduced.name: Romaritime Flowers
introduced.how: Flowers that bloom underwater and glow like candles at night
introduced.quote: I loved seeing the Romaritime Flowers blossoming underwater, like little candles lighting up the streets at night.

introduced.name: Blubberbeast
introduced.how: Big underwater fish that call out when they see people
introduced.quote: those big fish that call when they see people...

introduced.name: Hunter's Ray
introduced.how: Underwater fish that shimmer like a sword blade
introduced.quote: Like those fish that shimmer like a sword blade...

introduced.name: Leschots Clockwork Workshop
introduced.how: Clockwork shop selling toys and bulk components to organizations
introduced.quote: Welcome to Leschots Clockwork Workshop. How can I help you?

introduced.name: Livre
introduced.how: Shop clerk at Leschots who says component buyers are bulk organizational customers
introduced.quote: those who buy components are all regular customers who buy in bulk on behalf of their organization.

introduced.name: Estelle
introduced.how: Workshop maker who refuses prop gun orders and sells scrap to Fleuve Cendre
introduced.quote: I only make things here that can do some real heavy lifting.

introduced.name: Emerald
introduced.how: Fleuve Cendre informant who is reluctant to talk and must be paid for information
introduced.quote: I don't know anything.

introduced.name: Tetreaux
introduced.how: Tavern owner in Fleuve Cendre who trades in information
introduced.quote: Information isn't free, you know.

introduced.name: Musket lost at tavern
introduced.how: A gun lost by a drunk man that came back unfired three days later
introduced.quote: One of our men got drunk at dinner about a month ago, and lost his gun.

introduced.quote: The deceased was a resident of Fleuve Cendre. It's said that he was a poor, solitary man.

introduced.how: Author of The Two Musketeers who was looked at as a suspect and has an alibi
introduced.quote: He claims to have spent the whole day at the opera house on the day of the murder, and the staff there have confirmed his account.

assumed.name: Ayaka

assumed.name: Yoimiya

assumed.name: Xavier

assumed.name: Fontaine

threads.claim: The murderer leaves Rainbow Roses on victims just as the musketeers do in the novel.
threads.quote: We've found Rainbow Roses just like in the novel.

threads.claim: A poor, solitary man was murdered in Fleuve Cendre and the killer's identity is unknown.
threads.quote: The deceased was a resident of Fleuve Cendre. It's said that he was a poor, solitary man.

threads.claim: The murderer's message and intended recipient are unknown, and the victim had no enemies.
threads.quote: What message is the killer trying to convey, and to whom exactly?

threads.claim: The killer likely took a lost gun apart and built their own musket to practice and commit the murder.
threads.quote: he used some parts to create his own makeshift musket

threads.claim: A lost gun returned to the tavern unfired, which may suggest someone feared the Gardes would trace it.
threads.quote: It didn't get any new wear and tear on it, and didn't even appear to have been fired.

threads.claim: The novelist is cleared of the murder by an opera house alibi and a lack of motive.
threads.quote: He claims to have spent the whole day at the opera house on the day of the murder, and the staff there have confirmed his account.

threads.claim: Loud gunshots have been heard at night from the southern waterway in Fleuve Cendre.
threads.quote: The noises came from the end of the southern waterway.

threads.claim: Chevreuse grew up in Fleuve Cendre, which complicates how the district treats the Special Patrol captain.
threads.quote: That I grew up in Fleuve Cendre.

threads.claim: Fleuve Cendre residents distrust the Special Patrol, and Chevreuse's old ties there are being tested.
threads.quote: So take my advice, and don't show your face too much around here.

threads.claim: The sisters vow revenge against the aristocrats who killed their mother, delayed for now.
threads.quote: We'll have our revenge, I promise you... just not right now.

threads.claim: The film's theme is siblings supporting each other, which an overbearing older brother would undermine.
threads.quote: the theme of the two supporting and relying on each other isn't conveyed very well.

threads.claim: Useful intel is like remote islands in fog that must be sought out through persistent searching.
threads.quote: As long as you spend enough time sailing through the fog, you'll eventually come across an island.

introduced.name: Sage-Lord of Fungi
introduced.how: self-introduction as a mushroom deity that speaks into the Traveler's head
introduced.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: I am the Sage-Lord of Fungi. Serving me is a great honor, as well as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

introduced.name: Guardians of Tollan
introduced.how: the Collective's hereditary duty to guard the volcano, which brings both disaster and opportunity
introduced.quote: Acatl: Hahaha, that is a duty our people have held for generations.

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: the Natlan tribe that struggled during the Abyss attack and sends reinforcements
introduced.quote: the Collective of Plenty had their own struggles

introduced.name: green mushroom
introduced.how: a special mushroom variety that must be eaten right away, traced to a Sumeru scholar's order
introduced.quote: Atolli: It's an excellent addition to any dish, but there are actually two varieties — red, which is the most common, and green.

introduced.name: Abyss Tumor
introduced.how: Abyss growths on the volcano summit that agitate magma and spawn monsters
introduced.quote: Varesa: There were Abyss Tumors all around the summit, agitating the magma and spawning all kinds of monsters.

introduced.name: Varesa Challenge
introduced.how: a secret second tier of the feast contest that only past regular-challenge winners may attempt
introduced.quote: Acatl: The Varesa challenge is only for people who have completed the regular challenge in the past.

introduced.name: Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel
introduced.how: an aggressive volcanic creature whose back armor shoots phlogiston and runs hot
introduced.quote: Varesa: We call it a "Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel"! It's very aggressive, so be careful!

introduced.name: Avatars of Lava
introduced.how: volcanic monsters whose cores are extremely hot
introduced.quote: Varesa: Hey, there should be some Avatars of Lava somewhere along this path...

introduced.name: Mushwatalli
introduced.how: a red mushroom that transforms into a Fungus and mentions it is a Sumeru monster
introduced.quote: Mushwatalli: Bull warrior compliment? Much appreciate!

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: the Pyro Archon, who once tried the Varesa challenge and failed
introduced.quote: Acatl: Only one other person has come close to beating the Varesa challenge, and that would be the Pyro Archon herself.

introduced.name: Bifrons
introduced.how: the Sage-Lord's human name, revealed as a fungi god
introduced.quote: They destroy the statue and confront the Sage-Lord, who reveals its human name of Bifrons, a fungi god.

introduced.name: Chatraka
introduced.how: a human the Sage-Lord once controlled and who was buried in a volcanic eruption
introduced.quote: Still managing to have enough power to control a single human, the Sage-Lord ordered the human, Chatraka, to bring it somewhere hot.

introduced.name: Fietena
introduced.how: a past tribal hero whom Varesa idolizes and whose mask Varesa copies
introduced.quote: Varesa: Hehe, y'know, you remind me of another hero from our tribe. Her name was Fietena.

introduced.name: Xamaran
introduced.how: a clone of Bifrons in The Chasm that is not a green-cap mushroom
introduced.quote: Varesa then asks Tighnari about Bifron's clones, of which he confirms one in The Chasm named Xamaran.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: a long-past war between Sumeru and the Archons, which the Sage-Lord mistakenly thinks is ongoing
introduced.quote: but Paimon tells them the Archon War ended a long time ago, much to its shock.

introduced.name: Sage-Lord of Fungi
introduced.how: A giant mushroom god who presents himself as a would-be ruler seeking mortal subjects
introduced.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: Of course, I have a goal of my own. Let me reiterate once more: the great Sage-Lord of Fungi — that would be me — is extending you the honor of becoming my subjects.

introduced.name: Bifrons
introduced.how: The Sage-Lord's true name: a god who reveals he is the Sage-Lord in disguise
introduced.quote: Bifrons: You now behold the god, Bifrons! The sole protagonist in this endless carnage!

introduced.name: Soletl
introduced.how: A boy who eats a green mushroom and becomes an adult in the Sage-Lord's visions
introduced.quote: (A little boy, Soletl, faces a Whirling Electro Fungus and a Whirling Pyro Fungus)

introduced.name: Teoxoletl
introduced.how: The adult form Soletl becomes after eating the mushroom, shown in the vision
introduced.quote: (Soletl eats the green mushroom and transforms into an adult man, Teoxoletl)

introduced.name: Chatraka
introduced.how: A human who obeys the Sage-Lord and carries him to a hot volcano in the west
introduced.quote: Chatraka: Yes, my lord!

introduced.name: Xamaran
introduced.how: A huge, speaking mushroom beneath The Chasm whose mind is separate from the mushroom god
introduced.quote: Tighnari: Xamaran is its name. Its mycelium structure is stunning, and it's capable of human speech.

introduced.name: Sage-Lord's power tied to clones
introduced.how: The Sage-Lord's strength grows with his number of clones and shrinks as they are eaten
introduced.quote: Tighnari: His power is tied to his number of clones, so at one point, he possessed a truly fearsome form.

introduced.name: Mushroom mind control
introduced.how: The Sage-Lord can control humans with his power, which weakens as his clones are consumed
introduced.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: Phew, my power is all but spent, but it was still enough to control a single human, at least...

introduced.name: Sage-Lord's relocation from Sumeru to Natlan
introduced.how: After his following grew too large, he moved to a volcano in Natlan to regain strength
introduced.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: Now, all of Sumeru knows how scrumptious my mushrooms are, so if I want to grow... I must relocate.

introduced.name: Green mushroom spores
introduced.how: The mist seen while cooking was spores that sprout into green mushrooms that multiply
introduced.quote: Bifrons: What you saw when you cooked the mushrooms was not mist, but spores... set to sprout into green mushrooms very soon.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: when the Abyss attacked the Natlan, the Collective of Plenty had their own struggles

assumed.name: Iansan
assumed.quote: Iansan: Oh, hey! You're here!

assumed.name: Atolli
assumed.quote: Varesa: Wait, is this... braised meat stew? Thank you, Uncle Atolli!

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari is surprised to see the two in Natlan, but after hearing about the Sage-Lord, agrees to help them.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: They decide to head to the Adventurers' Guild and ask Katheryne for help, who finds Tighnari in the area.

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Paimon: Talking in our heads without permission, spewing a bunch of nonsense... Even Ajaw is better than him!

assumed.name: Acatl
assumed.quote: Paimon: Th—That's Acatl... Chief! We don't know where we are!

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Acatl: Well, that mushroom started it, right everyone? Disrespecting Varesa and our guest of honor...

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: It's been a while, you two.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Katheryne's back! And... isn't that Tighnari!?

assumed.name: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
assumed.quote: (If Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help has been completed)

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Paimon: Pretty sure they're talking about the war against the Abyss...

threads.claim: The Sage-Lord of Fungi's identity and origins are unknown and it hides its true past.
threads.quote: Traveler: We may not know who he is, but we know he exists.

threads.claim: The reason green mushrooms must be eaten immediately is an unexplained mystery.
threads.quote: Varesa: Origins... Wait, YOU'RE the green mushroom!?

threads.claim: A Sumeru scholar gave an unexplained order about green mushrooms that the tribe follows without knowing why.
threads.quote: Varesa: That's just what a scholar from Sumeru said when the orchard first opened.

threads.claim: The Abyss invasion of Natlan brought unusual volcanic activity rather than monster waves, hinting at a hidden purpose.
threads.quote: Acatl: When the Abyss invaded, we weren't hit with large waves of monsters, but the volcano became unusually active.

threads.claim: The Sage-Lord's belief in an ongoing Archon War is shown to be false, while its enemy may have been the Abyss.
threads.quote: but Paimon tells them the Archon War ended a long time ago, much to its shock.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the Sage-Lord is too weak and needs a host, which they must confirm by catching it.
threads.quote: The Traveler has a theory about the Sage-Lord, but needs to catch them in order to prove it.

threads.claim: Bifrons has clones across Teyvat, and at least one (Xamaran) may be less connected to its power.
threads.quote: Varesa then asks Tighnari about Bifron's clones, of which he confirms one in The Chasm named Xamaran.

threads.claim: Varesa's courage is borrowed from Fietena's legacy through a mask, which she fears is a crutch.
threads.quote: Varesa: At the same time, though... I guess it's kind of like a crutch. Kind of like, I'm hiding behind her strength.

threads.claim: Varesa fears losing control and struggles to act alone, but the Traveler urges her to command the truth.
threads.quote: Traveler: You're strong enough to command the truth.

threads.claim: Eating the mushrooms is explained as a sacred ritual that forges a spiritual connection with the Sage-Lord.
threads.quote: Asmu: The act of eating is not only a physical necessity, but also a sacred ritual.

threads.claim: The Sage-Lord's recruitment motive seems off, hinting at a hidden goal.
threads.quote: Traveler: There's something off about his motive.

threads.claim: The heat source the travelers brought was the Sage-Lord's plan to multiply his mushrooms.
threads.quote: Bifrons: And you delivered one to me on a silver platter! That was my plan all along.

threads.claim: The strange mist seen while cooking the mushrooms is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa, the fragrance is so much more intense... And, what's with this weird mist?

threads.claim: The green mushrooms are dealt with after the tribe eats them all.
threads.quote: Acatl: And, with that, we took care of all the green mushrooms!

threads.claim: How the Sage-Lord got from Sumeru to Natlan is an unanswered question.
threads.quote: Varesa: Besides, how did he even get from Sumeru to Natlan? Seems like he's avoiding that subject, too...

threads.claim: The Sage-Lord's vision reveals he left Sumeru to relocate to a volcano.
threads.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: Now, all of Sumeru knows how scrumptious my mushrooms are, so if I want to grow... I must relocate.

threads.claim: Natlan was never part of the Archon War, so its people know little of it.
threads.quote: Acatl: Ah, well... Natlan was never part of the Archon War, so it rarely comes up around these parts.

threads.claim: A huge clone of the mushroom god lies beneath The Chasm.
threads.quote: Tighnari: Oh, yes. There's a huge one beneath The Chasm.

threads.claim: Xamaran's mind has long been separate from the mushroom god.
threads.quote: Tighnari: And, I believe its mind has been separated from the mushroom god for a very long time.

threads.claim: The mushroom may have mind control powers, which raises danger.
threads.quote: Varesa: Wait, but... If everything we saw is true, that means this mushroom has mind control powers or something? That's a recipe for disaster.

threads.claim: The vision confirms the Sage-Lord mind-controlled a human and that his power was limited.
threads.quote: Sage-Lord of Fungi: Phew, my power is all but spent, but it was still enough to control a single human, at least...

threads.claim: The Sage-Lord's power is tied to the number of his clones.
threads.quote: Tighnari: His power is tied to his number of clones, so at one point, he possessed a truly fearsome form.

threads.claim: The Traveler can hear the mushroom god's voice because of a special constitution.
threads.quote: Traveler: And I happen to have a special constitution.

introduced.name: Emilie
introduced.how: Perfumer from Fontaine who introduces herself and helps the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Ah, allow me to introduce myself... I'm Emilie, a perfumer from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Edgar
introduced.how: Famous perfumer, the Flower Expert in charge of the exhibition, and creator of Auguste
introduced.quote: Back when he was still working in Fontaine, "Auguste"... was his creation.

introduced.name: Auguste
introduced.how: Once-popular Fontaine flower and perfume of that name, now extinct as a flower
introduced.quote: It's a kind of flower that was once popular in Fontaine. The perfume made from it also bears the same name...

introduced.name: Perfume Mania
introduced.how: Fontaine perfume craze nearly twenty years ago that inflated prices into a bubble
introduced.quote: The "Perfume Mania" was an event that occurred in Fontaine nearly twenty years ago...

introduced.name: Flower Exhibition
introduced.how: Port Ormos exhibition of flowers and plants from all over Teyvat
introduced.quote: Well, Port Ormos is currently organizing a "Flower Exhibition" featuring flowers and plants from all over Teyvat, so I came to help out.

introduced.name: Emilie's forensic cleaner work
introduced.how: Emilie's line of work clearing away traces left at crime scenes after forensic collection
introduced.quote: Close... I'm actually a "forensic cleaner."

introduced.name: Amber Wine
introduced.how: A perfume Emilie created several years ago, not alcohol
introduced.quote: "Amber Wine" is a perfume I created several years ago.

introduced.name: Sylvain
introduced.how: One of the merchant brothers, revealed as a former co-creator of Auguste convicted with Edgar
introduced.quote: there were four of us at the beginning: Myself, Lucien, Edgar... and a researcher from Sumeru in charge of flower cultivation... Vijava.

introduced.name: Lucien
introduced.how: The other merchant brother, revealed to be using the alias Blaise; a former Auguste co-creator
introduced.quote: But, when I called you "Lucien" just now, the name registered immediately.

introduced.name: Vijava
introduced.how: Sumeru researcher who cultivated the Auguste flower and died in a fire
introduced.quote: there were four of us at the beginning: Myself, Lucien, Edgar... and a researcher from Sumeru in charge of flower cultivation... Vijava.

introduced.name: Kirya
introduced.how: Vijava's younger brother, who ran off and is now the suspect in the attack on Edgar
introduced.quote: Kirya was Vijava's younger brother.

introduced.name: Yelena
introduced.how: Fatuus who created Auguste using a Delusion, wearing down her body
introduced.quote: which was created by a Fatuus named Yelena who utilized a Delusion, wearing down her body.

introduced.name: Glaze Lily
introduced.how: Flower that needs careful handling and is easily damaged by wrong care
introduced.quote: You can't treat a Glaze Lily like a cactus...

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Group Edgar commissions to scout for the Auguste flower
introduced.quote: I commissioned a few Eremites to do some scouting for me.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: Investigators who prosecuted the Auguste partners and went through their books
introduced.quote: Some time down the road, the Marechaussee Phantom came knocking, saddled us with a list of accusations, and started looking into our books...

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: Prison where the convicted Auguste partners were sent
introduced.quote: they were sent to the Fortress of Meropide for falsifying their accounts and destabilizing the market

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: Authority that stepped in to stop the Perfume Mania and jailed profiteers
introduced.quote: Luckily, the Palais Mermonia recognized the danger and intervened before the craze could truly spread.

introduced.name: Slime Condensate mix
introduced.how: Mix that holds in a scent by day and releases it at night, used to hide Auguste
introduced.quote: the mix would prevent the smell from leaking at day time, but would let it release at night

introduced.name: Shyam
introduced.how: Port Ormos sheriff who leads the search for the suspect
introduced.quote: Sheriff, have you received any reports of a suspicious individual fleeing through the bazaar?

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: Tighnari's apprentice, a Forest Ranger who brings updates and is new to Emilie
introduced.quote: Collei... Ah, of course, Tighnari's apprentice! He's mentioned you many times. It's a pleasure to finally meet you!

introduced.name: Yelena
introduced.how: the researcher posing as Vijava; an exiled Fatui from Snezhnaya, not a Sumeru scholar
introduced.quote: Yelena wasn't a scholar from Sumeru. She was an exiled Fatuus from Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Kirya
introduced.how: Yelena's younger brother, who is seeking revenge against Sylvain and Lucien
introduced.quote: Everything she did... it was for her brother, Kirya.

introduced.name: Lucien
introduced.how: Sylvain's younger brother, found dead in his hotel room
introduced.quote: My brother... He's gonna be okay, right?

introduced.name: Sylvain
introduced.how: the older merchant brother, a convicted financial criminal who is now being targeted
introduced.quote: ...After Kirya attacked Edgar, my brother and I were incredibly careful...

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: an organization Yelena defected from, which Snezhnaya is connected to
introduced.quote: Yelena wasn't a scholar from Sumeru. She was an exiled Fatuus from Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Vi:Làn Hương Cuối - Auguste
introduced.how: a perfume that Sylvain and Lucien sold, which contains elemental energy and is poisonous to some people
introduced.quote: My chemical analysis of "Auguste" also went smoothly, although it certainly raised some questions...

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: a source of mutative, distorting power that was used to create the Auguste flower
introduced.quote: The Auguste flower... was created with the mutative and distorting power of a Delusion.

introduced.name: Glaze Lily
introduced.how: a flower that only blooms at night, which the culprit used as a poison trap
introduced.quote: Well, did you know... it only blooms at night?

introduced.name: Spirit Borneol
introduced.how: an incense that scholars in Sumeru use for meditation
introduced.quote: In Sumeru, scholars use Spirit Borneol to aid meditation and stimulate their connection to the Dendro Archon...

introduced.name: Yelena's burning of the flowerbeds
