introduced.how: Yelena burned her flowerbeds and herself to destroy evidence, and to protect Kirya
introduced.quote: Before we could even put our plan in motion... Yelena beat us to it. She burned all her flowerbeds... and threw herself into the fire as well.

introduced.name: Perfume Mania
introduced.how: a past market craze for Auguste that the merchants rushed to profit from
introduced.quote: If we hadn't been in such a hurry to capitalize on the "Perfume Mania" all those years ago, do you think Yelena would have elected to take those risks?

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: A forbidden power that revives Auguste flowers at a cost to the user's body and remaining lifespan
introduced.quote: Using a Delusion comes at a cost... not just time, but the time you have left to live...

introduced.name: Auguste
introduced.how: A famous perfume and flower scent that wealthy Fontainians chased as a status symbol, made by Yelena
introduced.quote: "Auguste" was created over ten years ago.

introduced.name: Yelena
introduced.how: Kirya's older sister, who used a Delusion, set her own Auguste garden on fire in Fontaine, and died
introduced.quote: The reason why you continued to use the Delusion... The reason why you set your garden on fire... It was all because of me!

introduced.name: Edgar
introduced.how: The real Edgar, a Fontaine perfumer, was apparently killed by Kirya, who then took his identity
introduced.quote: ...I've yet to confirm it, but I suspect Kirya killed the real Edgar in Fontaine not long after his release from prison.

introduced.name: Kirya
introduced.how: Revealed as the man posing as Edgar in Sumeru, a perfumer who aged himself with a Delusion to take the identity
introduced.quote: Edgar is the one we're after. He and Kirya are the same person.

introduced.name: Emilie
introduced.how: Revealed as Kirya's former perfumery apprentice who secretly switched his Auguste bottles to bring him down
introduced.quote: Kirya: Did you get all that, Emilie?

introduced.name: Rainbow Roses, Glaze Lilies, and Cecilias
introduced.how: Three flowers whose scents, combined, form the Auguste fragrance
introduced.quote: It was a combination of Rainbow Roses, Glaze Lilies, and Cecilias...

introduced.name: accord
introduced.how: A blend of raw materials that recreates a scent, the basis of perfume-making
introduced.quote: The accord is the basis of perfume-making

introduced.name: language of flowers
introduced.how: A tradition where flowers carry symbolic meanings that vary by person and era
introduced.quote: I'd say it probably has something to do with the language of flowers.

introduced.name: Perfume Mania
introduced.how: A past craze in Fontaine where people bought perfume at any cost as a status symbol
introduced.quote: just like the "Perfume Mania" that captivated the public all those years ago.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Oh? It's you two! It's been a while! What brings you to Port Ormos?

assumed.name: Spirit Borneol
assumed.quote: Remember the first time we met? You fainted after inhaling Spirit Borneol...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: The demand far exceeded the supply, to the point where it once sold for ten million Mora a bottle.

assumed.name: Amurta Darshan
assumed.quote: she has a deeper understanding of human anatomy and pharmacology than most scholars from the Amurta Darshan.

assumed.name: The Steambird
assumed.quote: I've heard a lot about you from The Steambird.

assumed.name: Forest Rangers
assumed.quote: the Forest Rangers haven't received any reports of new plant species recently.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Wonder if Tighnari discovered anything...

assumed.name: Edgar
assumed.quote: things weren't looking good with Emilie's Master yesterday

assumed.name: Emilie
assumed.quote: Emilie: ...Oh, I'm not actually a forensic doctor. I just happen to have some relevant knowledge.

assumed.name: Sheriff Shyam
assumed.quote: Would you be willing to grant that request, Sheriff?

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Edgar, optional)

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: The message said he was looking into some information at the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Maybe her identity as a researcher from Sumeru...

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: It may be true that there are no records of "Auguste" poisoning in Fontaine...

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: If the Marechaussee Phantom discovered the connection between the three

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: send you to the Fortress of Meropide for life

assumed.name: Primordial Seawater unrest in Fontaine
assumed.quote: the Primordial Seawater that caused unrest in Fontaine not too long ago

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: a crime committed in Port Ormos

assumed.name: Nilotpala Lotus
assumed.quote: Ah, like the Nilotpala Lotus!

assumed.name: Forest Rangers
assumed.quote: Just leave the wilderness surveillance to the Forest Rangers.

assumed.name: Oguz
assumed.quote: Innam: Ah! Oguz!

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: If we go any further, we'll be out of Port Ormos!

assumed.name: Sylvain
assumed.quote: Sylvain only inhaled a small amount of poison. He's being detained as we speak.

assumed.name: Shyam
assumed.quote: Shyam: Oguz... You need to calm down and listen to me.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Collei: , Emilie, Paimon... Please, be careful.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: The curator commissioned a flower pot from Kshahrewar

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: But, Kirya betrayed Snezhnaya, abandoned Fontaine, and lived his entire life in Sumeru under the guise of someone else...

assumed.name: Spirit Borneol
assumed.quote: continued to use your "Spirit Borneol" and "Auguste" combination to wreak havoc

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Babak, optional)

assumed.name: Sheriff
assumed.quote: It was all an act you put on with the Sheriff?

threads.claim: A rumor says the extinct Auguste flower has reappeared in Sumeru, stirring the Fontaine perfume market.
threads.quote: Ah, yes. I came to investigate a certain rumor that the Auguste flower has reappeared in Sumeru... It's causing quite the stir in the Fontaine perfume market.

threads.claim: Tighnari says it is unclear whether the Auguste rumor is true.
threads.quote: Based on the information I have so far, it's unclear if the rumor is true.

threads.claim: Blaise insists the Auguste flower must be back, deepening the question of its return.
threads.quote: The Auguste flower is back! It has to be!

threads.claim: The Auguste flower was destroyed in a fire and has not been seen since, so its reappearance is a mystery.
threads.quote: When the bubble popped, all the flowerbeds used for its cultivation were destroyed in a fire. The variety has never been seen since...

threads.claim: Edgar was attacked and forced to ingest a liquid, with the attacker named as Kirya and the substance tied to Auguste.
threads.quote: K—Kirya... "Auguste"...!

threads.claim: The reason Kirya attacked Edgar is unknown and left open as a question.
threads.quote: Why did Kirya attack Edgar?

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Edgar and the merchant brothers are hiding something around the hotel.
threads.quote: But, they're also trying not to arouse suspicion... I'm not just imagining things, am I?

threads.claim: The merchant brothers Eude and Blaise are revealed as Sylvain and Lucien, former Auguste partners using aliases.
threads.quote: But, when I called you "Lucien" just now, the name registered immediately.

threads.claim: Vijava died in the fire that destroyed the Auguste flowerbeds and evidence.
threads.quote: It didn't matter at that point... Because she died in the fire as well.

threads.claim: Auguste may cause long-term harm, a danger the characters have not fully explained.
threads.quote: The flowers and perfume, while not harmful in short and brief moments, could potentially cause harm in the long-term.

threads.claim: Sylvain denies that Auguste is a poison, leaving doubt about its safety.
threads.quote: Poison? No, no... of course not!

threads.claim: Only Edgar or Kirya can say what is in Auguste and how to treat ingesting it.
threads.quote: there are only two people to ask — Edgar... or Kirya himself.

threads.claim: Auguste was created by the Fatuus Yelena using a Delusion that wore down her body.
threads.quote: which was created by a Fatuus named Yelena who utilized a Delusion, wearing down her body.

threads.claim: The hotel was a trap and Kirya had been disguised as Edgar.
threads.quote: They then conclude that the entire hotel was a trap and that Kiyra had been disguised as someone else, who the Traveler realizes is Edgar.

threads.claim: Emilie argues perfume should be valued for its fragrance rather than its price or prestige.
threads.quote: When it comes to perfume, I want people to forget the price and the prestige... and focus on the beauty of the fragrance itself.

threads.claim: The Perfume Mania was an inflated market bubble that was never going to last.
threads.quote: creating an economic bubble that was never going to last.

threads.claim: Kirya is pursuing revenge against those connected to Yelena's death, and he would not give up.
threads.quote: No... He would never give up... not if he's doing all of this for Yelena.

threads.claim: Whether Auguste is harmful over long-term use is disputed, with Sylvain insisting it is harmless and Edgar warning it is not for everyone.
threads.quote: That may be true for most people, but not for everyone.

threads.claim: Auguste's distorting elemental energy comes from a Delusion, tying the poison to the Fatui.
threads.quote: The Auguste flower... was created with the mutative and distorting power of a Delusion.

threads.claim: Yelena burned the evidence and herself to protect her brother Kirya from being exposed and tied to the Delusion.
threads.quote: Everything she did... it was for her brother, Kirya.

threads.claim: Kirya used a Glaze Lily with Auguste sealed inside its petals as a timed poison mechanism, which explains the night deaths.
threads.quote: That's why "Kirya" chose the Glaze Lily as his mechanism...

threads.claim: Kirya is hiding in plain sight under a disguise, which hints that Edgar may be Kirya.
threads.quote: But because he's been disguised as someone else this entire time.

threads.claim: Edgar admits he shares the blame for Yelena's death through the greed of the Perfume Mania.
threads.quote: Even if Yelena's death was her own choice, I wouldn't call myself innocent either.

threads.claim: Edgar has used a dangerous power source, which may be fatal to him in his weakened state.
threads.quote: It would seem Master decided to tap into an ill-advised source of power.

threads.claim: There is still another target from the Yelena affair who has not been dealt with yet.
threads.quote: Then, there's still one target left!

threads.claim: Kirya replaced the real Edgar, aging himself and building a false identity in Sumeru as part of a long revenge plan.
threads.quote: He aged himself decades beyond his years just so he could accomplish his revenge... Is that even worth it?

threads.claim: Using a Delusion shortens the user's life, and its effects are shown to be strong enough to corrupt bodies and environments.
threads.quote: Emilie: I fear that statement is truer than you know, Paimon. Using a Delusion comes at a cost...

threads.claim: Yelena's garden was burned in Fontaine after she used the Delusion, and Kirya's guilt over leaving her behind is revealed.
threads.quote: But, by the time I realized something wasn't right... there was nothing left. The flowers were gone... and so were you...

threads.claim: Emilie resolves to end the mythos around Auguste by deconstructing and exposing it.
threads.quote: It's time for the mythos to fade into obscurity.

threads.claim: The three flowers' meanings combine into the phrase forget the past and keep on living, which Yelena may have intended, though it remains uncertain.
threads.quote: "...Forget the past, and keep on living."

threads.claim: Kirya's life was built around revenge, which he cultivated like a flower and refused to give up.
threads.quote: ...Kirya cultivated his revenge like a flower.

threads.claim: Those with a Vision or elemental power may resist abnormal elemental energy better than others.
threads.quote: This leads me to believe those blessed with a Vision or capable of wielding elemental power are more resistant to the effects of abnormal elemental energy.

threads.claim: Sylvain has concealed crimes from the past that will be exposed in court.
threads.quote: All the crimes he concealed back then will be exposed in a court of law for everyone to see, and all his secrets will be revealed...

threads.claim: Collei recognizes the Delusion-affected environment from earlier experience, hinting at a past encounter.
threads.quote: Collei: This feeling... I've encountered it before...

introduced.name: Kachina
introduced.how: a young Natlan girl who bears an Ancient Name and has no teammates for the Pilgrimage
introduced.quote: Kachina: Oh! Welcome, welcome! I'm Kachina.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: Kachina's tribe, one of the tribes of Natlan
introduced.quote: Kachina: Well, come with me, you two. I'll show you where I grew up, and introduce you to our tribe, the Children of Echoes.

introduced.name: Pacal
introduced.how: chief of the Children of Echoes who insists on checking outsiders' identities
introduced.quote: Kachina: Chief! Oh, let me introduce you. This is Pacal, the chief of our tribe.

introduced.name: Ayo
introduced.how: Kachina's Saurian companion and a member of her family
introduced.quote: Kachina: Allow me to introduce you! This is Ayo, my Saurian companion, and also an important member of my family.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: creatures that hold an important place in every Natlan tribe and are companions rather than pets
introduced.quote: Kachina: Of course! Natlan is not only a nation of heroes, but also a nation of Saurians. They occupy an important place in every tribe.

introduced.name: Tepetlisaurus
introduced.how: Saurian species that is friendly to humans and closely tied to the Children of Echoes
introduced.quote: Kachina: The Children of Echoes have the closest ties to the Tepetlisaurs, which are naturally very friendly to humans.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: beings beneath the earth that protect the tribe, know the past and foresee the future
introduced.quote: Kachina: Sort of... We believe the Wayob dwell beneath the earth, while the Pyro Archon hails from above.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: an inherited title that labels a hero's stories, chosen by the Wayob
introduced.quote: Pacal: You can think of an Ancient Name almost like a label for these stories.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a tournament in team and one-on-one phases that selects warriors and collects Contending Fire
introduced.quote: Kachina: Oh, yeah! It's a competition we hold every so often, where everyone competes to try and get the highest ranking.

introduced.name: Night Warden Wars
introduced.how: the war against the Abyss that Pilgrimage winners are sent to fight
introduced.quote: Mualani: The Pilgrimage chooses the strongest warriors among the tribes, and those warriors fight to repel the Abyss in defense of our homeland.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: the eternal enemy of Natlan, often seen only through its fallout
introduced.quote: Kinich: A war against our eternal enemy, the Abyss.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: a blessing that revives Ancient Name bearers who achieve victory against the Abyss
introduced.quote: Kachina: It's something we call the Ode of Resurrection — which does exactly what it sounds like, basically!

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: the venue for the Pilgrimage and inter-tribal gatherings
introduced.quote: Kachina: Oh, look over there! That's our destination — the Stadium of the Sacred Flame!

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: the flame fueled by Contending Fire that keeps the Abyss out of Natlan
introduced.quote: Cival: That is the fire that fuels the Sacred Flame. Natlan is only safe from the invasion of the Abyss while the Sacred Flame burns eternal.

introduced.name: Contending Fire
introduced.how: fire produced only in battles between Natlanese people, used to fuel the Sacred Flame
introduced.quote: Cival: The purpose of the Pilgrimage is not only to select strong warriors, but also to collect Contending Fire from the battles.

introduced.name: Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: a statue that normally grants elemental powers when touched
introduced.quote: Statue of The Seven: The world opens itself before those with noble hearts.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Chiselith
introduced.how: a device that yields good things when infused with phlogiston, usable only by Natlanese
introduced.quote: Kachina: Oh, we call this a Phlogiston Chiselith. Good things happen if you infuse it with phlogiston.

introduced.name: Toto
introduced.how: a gentle Long-Necked Rhino who gives rides and is a longtime friend of Kachina
introduced.quote: Kachina: We're fine, we're fine! This, here, is Toto!

introduced.name: Long-Necked Rhino
introduced.how: large creatures that roam the plains, with Toto the friendliest of them
introduced.quote: Kachina: Nope, that's a Long-Necked Rhino. There's quite a few of them around here, and Toto's the friendliest and gentlest of the bunch.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: a seaside People of the Springs warrior who offers to help Kachina in the Pilgrimage
introduced.quote: Kachina: My friend Mualani belongs to the People of the Springs, a seaside tribe.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: a seaside tribe of Natlan, Mualani's people
introduced.quote: Kachina: My friend Mualani belongs to the People of the Springs, a seaside tribe.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: one of the six tribes of Natlan, alongside the Masters of the Night-Wind and Collective of Plenty
introduced.quote: Kachina: That just leaves the Flower-Feather Clan, the Masters of the Night-Wind, and the Collective of Plenty.

introduced.name: Cival
introduced.how: the Pilgrimage registration official who refuses outsiders to protect Contending Fire production
introduced.quote: Cival: I'm sorry, but only people from Natlan are eligible to participate.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: a flat, two-dimensional being who scolds Kachina and calls himself a Dragonlord
introduced.quote: Ajaw: Hmph, you would do well to speak with reverence of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw... Lest you live to regret it!

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: the realm of the Wayob between body and mind, life and death, where the fallen can wander
introduced.quote: Kinich: I've actually fallen in battle myself. I spent some time wandering the realm of the Wayob. It was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before.

introduced.name: Tlaco
introduced.how: one of Kachina's former teammates who left her to join a stronger team
introduced.quote: Tlaco: I'm sorry, Kachina. I know it's not right for us to go back on our word like this, but Cempoa and I have to do well during this Pilgrimage.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a tournament with a long history whose prize is the right to serve in the Night Warden Wars
introduced.quote: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is a competition with a long, storied history.

introduced.name: Night Warden Wars
introduced.how: the war the top five Pilgrimage finishers get to take part in
introduced.quote: After many rounds of battle, the contestants with the top five rankings will get the chance to take part in the Night Warden Wars!

introduced.name: Fire Towers
introduced.how: structures contestants search for to collect Contending Fire
introduced.quote: Contestants must search for Fire Towers within the contest grounds, accumulate Contending Fire through combat, and bring a sufficient amount back to the Stadium.

introduced.name: Contending Fire
introduced.how: the fire gathered through combat and brought back to the Stadium to advance
introduced.quote: Contestants must search for Fire Towers within the contest grounds, accumulate Contending Fire through combat, and bring a sufficient amount back to the Stadium.

introduced.name: Team stage
introduced.how: the opening round of the Pilgrimage, fought in teams before individual matches
introduced.quote: Today's tournament begins with the team stage, before advancing into individual competition.

introduced.name: Hot-air balloon transport
introduced.how: teams are carried by balloon to random landing spots on the contest grounds
introduced.quote: Each team will board a hot-air balloon, which will land at a random location.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: the Pyro Archon who opens the tournament
introduced.quote: Now, let us welcome our Archon as she delivers the opening address!

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: the arena where the tournament is held and that contestants cannot leave once it begins
introduced.quote: Entering the Stadium of the Sacred Flame? You won't be able to leave the arena once the tournament begins.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: an inherited name that carries forebears' honor and must be upheld in battle
introduced.quote: Not to mention... the fact that your Ancient Name has survived until now means all your forebears managed to honor its meaning.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: Kinich's tribe, whose members make up most of the Adventurers' Guild
introduced.quote: I was planning on inviting you to visit the Scions of the Canopy. Most of the Adventurers that belong to the Guild come from my tribe, so I figured you might be interested.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: an organization whose many members come from the Scions of the Canopy
introduced.quote: I was planning on inviting you to visit the Scions of the Canopy. Most of the Adventurers that belong to the Guild come from my tribe, so I figured you might be interested.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: Mualani's tribe, which lives alongside the Koholasaurs
introduced.quote: The People of the Springs live alongside the Koholasaurs.

introduced.name: Spiritways
introduced.how: routes people of Mualani's tribe can ride over great distances
introduced.quote: Not sure if you remember, but people from my tribe can ride Spiritways over great distances. It's all smooth sailing from here!

introduced.name: Saurian companion
introduced.how: a partner creature Natlan's warriors bond with and fight alongside
introduced.quote: Everyone has their own unique way of getting along with their Saurian companion.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: a monstrous threat that Natlan's warriors must be able to repel
introduced.quote: If you can't handle a few monsters, how are you supposed to repel the Abyss.

introduced.name: Atea
introduced.how: Mualani's neighbor and an elder warrior who enforces hot spring rules
introduced.quote: Ah, I'm Mualani's neighbor, Atea.

introduced.name: Amina
introduced.how: Chief who organizes the tribe's Abyss patrols
introduced.quote: Chief Amina set up those patrols to guard against the Abyss, and Atea volunteered.

introduced.name: Yelafath
introduced.how: Shop owner who sells party supplies in town
introduced.quote: Hey there, Yelafath. Hope business has been going well.

introduced.name: Abyssal Pylon
introduced.how: A gate created by the Abyss that lets monsters enter the physical world and must be destroyed
introduced.quote: one that allows monsters from the Night Kingdom to enter the physical world.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Realm where Abyss monsters come from
introduced.quote: one that allows monsters from the Night Kingdom to enter the physical world.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: Mualani's tribe, living around the hot springs
introduced.quote: On behalf of the People of the Springs, you have my thanks. We're counting on you.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: A competition with team rounds and individual matches that participants earn points in
introduced.quote: I didn't place too well in this Pilgrimage, so, now that it's over, it's time to get home and get back to work.

introduced.name: Outlanders
introduced.how: Visitors from outside who must first adapt to the artificial hot springs by custom
introduced.quote: Outlanders have to complete a

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: Furina: Partings are inevitable, of course, but distance makes the heart grow fonder, right?

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia: All those obstacles we overcame side by side... Feels like it was just yesterday! Don't be a stranger, now, partner!

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: Clorinde: If you encounter any troubles along your journey, you need only let us know, no matter the distance between us.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Charlotte: Well, I heard you two were about to leave for the next part of your journey. After everything you did for Fontaine, The Steambird simply had to follow up on a scoop like that.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Exactly! Even when Inazuma was completely closed-off, we still managed to run into people from there in other nations...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: Reminds me of our time in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right? It's been ages since that day we first saw Dvalin. We've come so far!

assumed.name: Spina di Rosula
assumed.quote: Navia: Many members of the Spina have visited in the past, too.

assumed.name: Lost in the Woods
assumed.quote: (If Lost in the Woods has been completed)

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich and Ajaw are always like that.

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Says the one who only made it because I was there to get you!

assumed.name: Mualani and Kachina's first meeting
assumed.quote: Oh, yeah! Back when we first met, right?

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Well, you worked so hard to introduce us to Natlan, we wanted to return the favor!

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: If they don't think you deserve to bear your Ancient Name, they can take it up with the Wayob!

assumed.name: Atea
assumed.quote: Our generation's been in decline ever since Atea and the others retired from the frontlines.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're finally here! So, this is your home, Mualani!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: What are your plans, Kinich?

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina likes shiny little trinkets, so whenever I come across something like that, I always buy it for her.

assumed.name: Ancient Name
assumed.quote: Back before I inherited my Ancient Name, she was one of Natlan's most renowned warriors

assumed.name: Dvalin's tears and Mondstadt cleansing
assumed.quote: You used it back in Mondstadt to cleanse Dvalin's tears, didn't you?

assumed.name: Teardrop Crystal
assumed.quote: I also came across a Teardrop Crystal. Can you purify it?

threads.claim: Paimon wonders whether Natlan has any humans left, a question raised but not yet answered.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh, could it be... that there are no humans in Natlan?

threads.claim: Natlan's native people choose to stay home due to local customs, though they welcome outsiders.
threads.quote: Furina: It's just that, because of their local customs, the native people choose not to leave.

threads.claim: The Statue of The Seven fails to grant the Traveler elemental power in Natlan, and the cause is unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Strange... Must be something unique to Natlan.

threads.claim: The Pilgrimage is the method used to choose the Pyro Archon, so anyone can claim the title by proving strength.
threads.quote: Kachina: Oh, I should also mention... The Pilgrimage is actually how we select the Pyro Archon. Anyone can claim the title.

threads.claim: Contending Fire can only be produced in battles between Natlanese, which makes the Sacred Flame depend on exclusion of outsiders.
threads.quote: Cival: Outlander participation would inhibit the production of this Fire, which could, in turn, jeopardize the Sacred Flame.

threads.claim: The Ode of Resurrection only revives Ancient Name bearers who achieve victory, and defeat destroys the Ancient Name.
threads.quote: Kinich: The power of resurrection has its limits. For starters, the Ode only works on those who bear an Ancient Name.

threads.claim: Kachina is unsure why the Wayob chose her to bear an Ancient Name, leaving the Wayob's judgment a mystery.
threads.quote: Kachina: Just like me, hehe! I'm still not sure why our Wayob chose me, of all people...

threads.claim: Kinich was resurrected after falling in battle, and the Night Kingdom of the Wayob is a realm hard to reach.
threads.quote: Kinich: I've actually fallen in battle myself. I spent some time wandering the realm of the Wayob. It was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before.

threads.claim: The Abyss is Natlan's eternal enemy, and its nature and scheming are not yet explained.
threads.quote: Kinich: A war against our eternal enemy, the Abyss.

threads.claim: Ajaw claims to be an Almighty Dragonlord, a title whose meaning is not explained.
threads.quote: Ajaw: Hmph, you would do well to speak with reverence of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw... Lest you live to regret it!

threads.claim: Kachina does not know why the Wayob chose her to inherit an Ancient Name, leaving that choice an open question.
threads.quote: I still don't know why the Wayob chose me to inherit an Ancient Name...

threads.claim: Kachina once described the Pyro Archon as an ordinary person before she took the title, which seems at odds with what Paimon sees.
threads.quote: Didn't Kachina say she was just an ordinary person before becoming the Archon? Sure doesn't seem like it...

threads.claim: The Abyss is an enemy Natlan's warriors are ordered to crush, framing the Pilgrimage as preparation for war against it.
threads.quote: Brave warriors, the following is an order, and also a personal request — go forth and crush the Abyss.

threads.claim: Mavuika suggests Natlan's warriors have made countless sacrifices that must not be in vain for the nation's future.
threads.quote: Pride for you, my brave warriors. You give me faith that our innumerable sacrifices are not in vain, that the future of Natlan shall burn with the brilliance of a blazing fire!

threads.claim: Mualani suggests glory always carries risk, since victory that is assured would not be something anyone could take pride in.
threads.quote: Glory always comes with a risk. If victory was assured, no one would take pride in it.

threads.claim: The Traveler advises that battle is more than strength alone and that observing and studying opponents matters too.
threads.quote: A battle is more than just a contest of strength.

threads.claim: Atea's body still carries Abyssal power that is corroding her organs.
threads.quote: Abyssal power still exists within her body.

threads.claim: Atea reveals her body is failing and she has only a few days left.
threads.quote: It's because my body isn't going to last much longer.

threads.claim: The Traveler can purify Abyssal power, but the corruption inside Atea is too deeply rooted to fully remove.
threads.quote: I did my best to cleanse that power just now, but it's already deeply ingrained within her internal organs, leaving her as fragile as a dried leaf in the wind.

threads.claim: Monsters from the Abyss are described as the Abyss itself rather than as contaminated creatures.
threads.quote: No, they ARE the Abyss. Destroy them.

threads.claim: Abyssal Pylons must be destroyed quickly or endless monsters will overwhelm defenses.
threads.quote: The only way to end the attack is to destroy the Pylon as soon as possible.

threads.claim: Atea has a talisman she wants delivered to the Archon as a relic.
threads.quote: A talisman I've carried with me my whole life.

threads.claim: Death and resurrection are raised as a theme, hinting that the Traveler has been resurrected.
threads.quote: You've never been resurrected, so you might not understand, but death and I? We're old pals by now.

introduced.name: Dvalin
introduced.how: Stormterror is revealed to be the dragon Dvalin, a former one of the Four Winds
introduced.quote: Traveler: That's Stormterror's real name.

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: The green bard introduces himself as Venti, a famous bard of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Venti: I'm Venti the bard.

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: Venti reveals his true identity as Barbatos, the Anemo Archon
introduced.quote: even revealing his true identity as Barbatos, the Anemo Archon

introduced.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
introduced.how: A treasured Mondstadt lyre that Barbatos once played, kept in the Cathedral
introduced.quote: Venti: One of the most treasured items in Mondstadt. It's the lyre that Barbatos used to play.

introduced.name: Teardrop Crystal
introduced.how: Crystals that hold Dvalin's tears, which can be purified to restore the Holy Lyre
introduced.quote: Venti: I also came across a Teardrop Crystal.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: A non-human organization that hates mankind and uses hilichurls as weapons
introduced.quote: Venti: They are from the Abyss Order, an organization comprised of non-human beings. They despise mankind.

introduced.name: Hilichurls
introduced.how: Wild monsters that take orders from the Abyss Order
introduced.quote: Venti: Many hilichurls out in the wild take orders from them and act as their weapons.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Snezhnaya's diplomatic envoys, known as aggressive and infamous
introduced.quote: Jean: Their envoys go by a particular name: The Fatui. Heard of them?

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A nation that follows the God of Cryo and sends the Fatui as delegates
introduced.quote: Jean: Snezhnaya. They choose to follow the God of Cryo.

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: An independent nation, not just a city, that belongs to no other nation
introduced.quote: Jean: In fact, despite being referred to as a city, Mondstadt is a nation.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: A scholar at the library who studies the crystals and is fond of her library work
introduced.quote: Lisa: You can visit whenever you need to look something up.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: Elemental powers that the crystal impurities react to and repel
introduced.quote: Lisa: I see... It appears to react to Visions.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: A title granted to the Traveler by the Knights of Favonius for their help
introduced.quote: Jean: Please accept the title of Honorary Knight... and the gratitude of the Acting Grand Master.

introduced.name: Acting Grand Master
introduced.how: Jean holds this role and cannot make some statements publicly
introduced.quote: Jean: But as Acting Grand Master I obviously cannot make such a statement publicly.

introduced.name: Signora
introduced.how: No. 8 of the Eleven Harbingers, who leads Fatui operations in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Diluc: No. 8 of The Eleven Harbingers. Goes by the name Signora.

introduced.name: The Eleven Harbingers
introduced.how: Top Fatui leaders whose members let the Fatui run freely across the seven nations
introduced.quote: Diluc: The fact the Fatui can run amok across the seven nations like they do is entirely because of The Eleven Harbingers.

introduced.name: Diluc
introduced.how: The owner of Dawn Winery and the Angel's Share tavern, a famous man with a dislike of the Knights
introduced.quote: Venti: He is Master , the boss of... ah, the owner of this tavern.

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: A local tavern where Dawn Winery wine is sold and Diluc works behind the bar
introduced.quote: Diluc: Some of Dawn Winery's wine is sold at Angel's Share, a local tavern.

introduced.name: Starsnatch Cliff
introduced.how: A cliff near the sea chosen as the place to summon Dvalin with the lyre
introduced.quote: Diluc: If you head to where the cliff juts out — that place is known as .

introduced.name: Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero
introduced.how: The great tree in Windrise where Mondstadt's Hero ascended to Celestia
introduced.quote: Venti: But now, before us stands the Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero, the place from which Mondstadt rose.

introduced.name: Dandelion Wine
introduced.how: Mondstadt's famous and prized wine, said to be the best
introduced.quote: Venti: He's very famous. By the way, his dandelion wine is one of my favorites.

introduced.name: Seven nations
introduced.how: The conflicts between the seven nations stem from their respective gods
introduced.quote: Jean: The conflict between Mondstadt and Snezhnaya stems from the conflict between the seven nations and their respective gods.

introduced.name: Gotelinde
introduced.how: A Cathedral sister who refuses to give up the Holy Lyre and doubts Venti's claims
introduced.quote: Gotelinde: May the Anemo God bless you, young bard. How can I help you?

introduced.name: Anemo God
introduced.how: The god of Mondstadt's winds who has been absent from the city for a very long time
introduced.quote: Venti: You speak of the God of Anemo, Barbatos? He already disappeared from Mondstadt a long time ago.

introduced.name: Vial of the Anemo God's breath
introduced.how: A rare relic from the East Temple of the Four Winds that the Fatui want
introduced.quote: Diluc: It was a vial which contained the Anemo God's breath.

introduced.name: Ludi Harpastum
introduced.how: The only event where the Holy Lyre is currently used
introduced.quote: Gotelinde: There are regulations in place for the use of the Holy Lyre. Currently, it's only used in Ludi Harpastum.

introduced.name: Ancient battle over Mondstadt
introduced.how: A past battle in which a dragon was poisoned and put to sleep, then awoke
introduced.quote: Blood of venom sent the sky dragon into slumber,

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Anastasia: If you are unable to promptly deal with the Stormterror threat, then leave the defense of Mondstadt to the Fatui.

assumed.name: The Four Winds
assumed.quote: Jean: I can't think of any reason for Dvalin's betrayal, given it was once one of The Four Winds.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Gotelinde: I know you. You and Amber saved Mondstadt that day.

assumed.name: Cryo God
assumed.quote: Jean: The Cryo God's Fatui have always coveted the Anemo God's power.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: After tracking down the stranger via his footprints with their Elemental Sight

assumed.name: Eye of the Storm
assumed.quote: (An Eye of the Storm appears)

threads.claim: Dvalin's rage is caused by black blood that has been torturing him for years.
threads.quote: Venti: The black blood flowing through his heart has been torturing him for years.

threads.claim: Jean suggests Dvalin was poisoned in the ancient battle and then corrupted by an Abyss Mage.
threads.quote: Jean: However, if it was poisoned in the battle over Mondstadt all those years ago...

threads.claim: The Abyss Order hates humanity and its origins remain unknown.
threads.quote: Venti: I don't know where they come from. All I know is that they hold deep hatred towards the human world.

threads.claim: Diluc has already eradicated one Abyss Mage in one of the Four Winds' temples.
threads.quote: Diluc: I eradicated one not long ago, in one of the Four Winds' temples.

threads.claim: A Cryo Abyss Mage tells Dvalin that the Mondstadt group betrayed him.
threads.quote: Cryo Abyss Mage: Do not be fooled by him, dear dragon...

threads.claim: The Traveler has elemental abilities that the crystal does not harm, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: Lisa: It's strange, though. has elemental abilities as well, but doesn't seem to be affected in the same way.

threads.claim: Jean asks the Traveler about what makes them special, and the Traveler does not know.
threads.quote: Jean: Do you know anything about what makes you special?

threads.claim: The crystal's impurities repel elemental energy, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Lisa: The impurities and the elemental energy we embody repel each other.

threads.claim: Stormterror's changes in size and power are suspicious and unexplained.
threads.quote: Jean: Its change in size and power really is suspicious.

threads.claim: The Anemo God has been absent from Mondstadt for a very long time.
threads.quote: Venti: You speak of the God of Anemo, Barbatos? He already disappeared from Mondstadt a long time ago.

threads.claim: Venti claims to be Barbatos, and the Traveler doubts this claim.
threads.quote: Traveler: I'm sorry— Wait... Did you just say... you're Barbatos?

threads.claim: Jean has known Venti's true identity for some time, confirming he is Barbatos.
threads.quote: Venti: Hehe... You've known my true identity for some time now, haven't you Jean?

threads.claim: Venti's plan is tied to a dear friend brought to mind by the tear.
threads.quote: Venti: Seeing this tear has brought to mind a friend so dear.

threads.claim: Venti reveals Dvalin was once his friend whom he still regards as one.
threads.quote: Venti: Dvalin used to be my friend... I still regard him as such.

threads.claim: A Fatui Harbinger named Signora is operating in Mondstadt and threatens the group.
threads.quote: Diluc: No. 8 of The Eleven Harbingers. Goes by the name Signora.

threads.claim: A figure called the Traveler's Sibling appears to oversee Stormterror's Lair, with Abyss Mages serving them.
threads.quote: (The Traveler's Sibling oversees Stormterror's Lair as two Abyss Mages bow to them.

threads.claim: The Holy Lyre's Anemo power has run dry after a thousand years.
threads.quote: Venti: As you can see, the lyre has been through a thousand years of history. Its Anemo power has run dry.

threads.claim: Purified Teardrop Crystals fully restore the Holy Lyre's Anemo power.
threads.quote: Venti: The lyre's Anemo power seems fully restored. We should be able to use it now.

introduced.name: Jiwani
introduced.how: Sachin's son who hired Eremites to kidnap his father and seize his inheritance
introduced.quote: Jiwani, Sachin's son.

introduced.name: Sachin
introduced.how: Former Vahumana scholar whose consciousness survives as a fragment inside the Diadem
introduced.quote: I am Sachin. Well, to be precise, I am but a fragment of Sachin's mind.

introduced.name: Diadem of Knowledge
introduced.how: Expensive diadem that can preserve part of a person's consciousness; Sachin bought and donated it
introduced.quote: But before I went through with it, a strange twist of fate led me to come into the possession of this diadem, which has the ability to preserve part of one's consciousness.

introduced.name: Mawtiyima Forest
introduced.how: Forest where the third round is held and the Diadem is placed for contestants to find
introduced.quote: In the third round, contestants have to go into Mawtiyima Forest, find the diadem, bring it back, and place it on the stand.

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: Points-based competition across rounds; the round winner most likely wins the whole contest
introduced.quote: Considering how close the scores are between our contestants, whoever wins this round is very likely to be the winner of the whole competition.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: Institution that holds Sachin's fortune in trust under a contract to pass it to a chosen genius
introduced.quote: he went and put his entire fortune in the care of the Akademiya, along with a contract saying that one day he'd pass it all on to a genius he admired.

introduced.name: Lost Darshan
introduced.how: Scholars living deep in the desert who call themselves the Lost Darshan; Sachin sought them out
introduced.quote: sought out the scholars living deep in the desert who call themselves the

introduced.name: Sachin's desert years
introduced.how: Sachin spent eight years in the desert witnessing conflict and then tried, and failed, to find a remedy
introduced.quote: Twenty-eight years ago, I came to the desert and lived there for eight full years.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Desert mercenaries who were hired to kidnap Sachin and were arrested by the matra
introduced.quote: Paimon just heard that the matra have arrested some Eremites who snuck into the city.

assumed.name: Aarav
assumed.quote: Aarav: Ah, you're here. Sorry, I was just about to send someone to inform you.

assumed.name: Kareena
assumed.quote: Kareena: Whew... You're finally back.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: Didn't expect to run into you here.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Nahida: , Paimon, you're already here.

assumed.name: Wanderer
assumed.quote: Paimon: Nahida... oh, and Hat Guy.

assumed.name: Layla
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: Huh, looks like Layla has seized the diadem...

assumed.name: Faruzan
assumed.quote: You were representing the Haravatat Darshan in the Championship...

assumed.name: General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Huh. Well, I guess they must pay you plenty to be General Mahamatra if you're splashing out on things like this...

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Dori: Well, how did it go? I assume that Lord Sangemah Bay's assistance helped you discover something, yes?

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Are you alright? Any physical discomfort?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Cyno: 1 million Mora at the very least.

threads.claim: The Diadem of Knowledge has been behaving strangely since Sachin brought it home, hinting that something is wrong with it.
threads.quote: Weird things started happening after he brought it home, too.

threads.claim: Sachin may have changed after his desert trip, so that the man who returned might not have been the real Sachin.
threads.quote: was a demon from the desert who was wearing his skin.

threads.claim: Sachin's consciousness is preserved inside the Diadem and can speak through it to whoever holds it.
threads.quote: I am Sachin. Well, to be precise, I am but a fragment of Sachin's mind.

threads.claim: Sachin concludes that humanity's nature inevitably produces conflict and destruction, a claim the text leaves open to debate.
threads.quote: Our nature begets conflict, and conflict begets destruction.

threads.claim: Nahida frames truth as partial views, suggesting Sachin's conclusions are only one side of the truth.
threads.quote: Truth, to me, is like a Shroomboar.

threads.claim: Sachin's research materials are stored at a location beginning with A, and the location is left unrevealed.
threads.quote: All of my research materials are being stored at A—

threads.claim: Nahida seals Sachin's research because Kaveh, as its successor, does not want it spread.
threads.quote: Because Kaveh, as the successor of this research, does not wish to see these ideas disseminated, I will seal it up.

threads.claim: Alhaitham's note on Sachin's documents raises a question about whether small choices can defend against nihilism.
threads.quote: Lofty ideals may provide no defense at all against nihilism, but perhaps little decisions can.

threads.claim: Nahida secretly had the Wanderer watch over the competition and intervene if Sachin's successor failed.
threads.quote: So instead, I had Hat Guy here help me keep an eye on things.

threads.claim: Nahida assigns the Wanderer a Vahumana thesis she will personally grade, keeping him tied to the Akademiya.
threads.quote: I will review your final thesis myself. I am expecting great things from you, Mr. Hat Guy.

threads.claim: Kaveh destroys the Diadem, ending Sachin's experiment, while still completing the task and winning the round.
threads.quote: Kaveh may have broken the diadem, but he successfully completed the task prior to that.

threads.claim: Kaveh is in debt to Dori, who refuses to extend his payment and is angered by the lost Diadem.
threads.quote: The interest rate on the Mora he owes me is about to get much higher!

introduced.name: Draff
introduced.how: referee of the Dragonspine race who introduces himself and the event rules
introduced.quote: Draff: My name is Draff, and I'll be serving as referee for today's proceedings by appointment of the organizing committee.

introduced.name: Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge
introduced.how: the cross country relay race held on Dragonspine
introduced.quote: Draff: Contestants, spectators, welcome to the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge!

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: a mountain whose terrain is hazardous, with a danger zone beyond the race course
introduced.quote: The terrain on Dragonspine is hazardous, and the last thing we want is anyone getting injured, or worse.

introduced.name: Soulblazers
introduced.how: the relay team made of contestants from all over Teyvat
introduced.quote: Draff: Last but by no means least, we have a team that brings together contestants from all over Teyvat.... The Soulblazers.

introduced.name: Kenzou
introduced.how: an Inazuman contestant on team Lightning Strike who was rescued on the course
introduced.quote: Confused Inazuman Contestant: Hello. I'm Kenzou, from team Lightning Strike.

introduced.name: Frostarm Lawachurl
introduced.how: hostile monsters roaming the mountain near the course
introduced.quote: Minnie: Monsters! At least they're not on the course... Better steer clear.

introduced.name: Fietena
introduced.how: a comic in which Fietena and Mavuika go into battle together for the first time in volume 2
introduced.quote: Alrani: Let's pose like Fietena and Mavuika! From volume 2, where they go into battle together for the first time.

introduced.name: Moritz and Sherilyn
introduced.how: Minnie's parents, who wait at the finish line and set the terms of her travel
introduced.quote: Varesa: This race is a huge deal for all of us. Minnie's parents are already waiting at the finish line... Our only hope now is...

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, it's not like Varesa and Xilonen to be behind schedule... Okay, we'll go check on them.

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, it's not like Varesa and Xilonen to be behind schedule... Okay, we'll go check on them.

assumed.name: Alrani
assumed.quote: Alrani: Captain is taking the team through a warm-up as planned.

assumed.name: Minnie
assumed.quote: Minnie: I got here a little late 'cause I was coming from home. Are they still warming up? The race is gonna start any minute...

assumed.name: Tang Yigang
assumed.quote: Tang Yigang: I'm sorry... *coughing*... I picked the worst time to get sick, didn't I...

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Amber: What happened? Someone got injured?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: I won't let your trip to Mondstadt be in vain.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Alrani: Let's pose like Fietena and Mavuika! From volume 2, where they go into battle together for the first time.

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Minnie: It's okay, I'll explain. I'm really sorry, Honorary Knight,

threads.claim: Varesa hails the Traveler as Tumaini and Natlan's hero, a title whose origin is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Varesa: Hehe... Tumaini to the rescue once again! You'll always be Natlan's hero, . Wherever you go, we place our pride and our hope in you!

threads.claim: Varesa improvises a Soulblazer saying about help always being at hand, which her teammates question.
threads.quote: Wherever the Soulblazer treads, help is always at hand.

threads.claim: Dragonspine is dangerous beyond the race course, with its terrain hazardous to anyone who strays.
threads.quote: The terrain on Dragonspine is hazardous, and the last thing we want is anyone getting injured, or worse.

threads.claim: Monsters roam the mountain near the course, and a contestant is hurt by one after going off-course.
threads.quote: Minnie: Monsters! At least they're not on the course... Better steer clear.

threads.claim: Minnie's parents have a deal with her about travel, and she accepts it without fighting it.
threads.quote: Minnie: Thank you, Mr. Draff. Mom, Dad... I know what you're gonna say. A deal's a deal, I won't fight it...

threads.claim: Minnie's father grants her freedom to travel abroad as long as she is careful.
threads.quote: ...As long as you promise to be careful, you are free to go traveling abroad.

threads.claim: The Fietena comic is invoked as a model of courage for the team.
threads.quote: Varesa: Don't panic! There's no need to be nervous. Think about Fietena. It's time to show our courage!

threads.claim: Varesa suggests that no one should turn a blind eye to a person in need.
threads.quote: Varesa: How could any of us turn a blind eye to a person in need?

threads.claim: The organizers award the team an honorary medal for putting lives first over the race result.
threads.quote: recognizing your commitment to putting lives first.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Wings
introduced.how: a jetpack worn on the back, steered by a handheld trackball that controls gaseous phlogiston
introduced.quote: Chasca: It's a flying machine worn on the back. To operate it, you just use a hand-held trackball that controls the flow of gaseous phlogiston.

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: saurian flying creatures that carry riders, and Chasca was raised by them
introduced.quote: Chasca: Well, yeah. You know I was raised by qucusaurs.

introduced.name: Coya
introduced.how: a qucusaur who is Chasca's foster sister, raised with her and now hostile to humans
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait, "sister"? That qucusaur is Chasca's sister?

introduced.name: Chimpu
introduced.how: Chasca's qucusaur foster mother, who is also Coya's mother
introduced.quote: Chasca: , Paimon, this is my Mom. Her name is... "Chimpu." In the human tongue, anyway.

introduced.name: Chime
introduced.how: Coya's young child, who was kidnapped by humans
introduced.quote: Chasca: It's Chime, Coya's child... the attackers kidnapped her!

introduced.name: Isidore
introduced.how: a merchant leading the caravan that captures qucusaurs for Tepal
introduced.quote: Isidore: Curses... She's really riled up this time!

introduced.name: Tepal
introduced.how: a craftsman who hired merchants to catch qucusaurs and built the Phlogiston Wings
introduced.quote: Isidore: I—It was Tepal! He told us to catch all the wild qucusaurs we can find!

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: a tribe member who knows Tepal's family and runs a workshop
introduced.quote: Xilonen: *yawn* Ah, it's you... Ugh, okay... Give me a second, I'll come down...

introduced.name: Puma
introduced.how: Tepal's mother, who disowned him and has cut ties with him
introduced.quote: Xilonen: I'm back. Allow me to introduce Tepal's mother, Puma.

introduced.name: Tepal's Tattered Notes
introduced.how: Tepal's notebook of logs, revealing his Cinder City-inspired flying projects and his sky workshop plans
introduced.quote: Paimon: Okay, so this notebook is the only lead we've got now, right? What's in there?

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: an outside craftsmen group from which Tepal came after failing the flying trial
introduced.quote: Allpa: He was a craftsman from the Children of Echoes, but he'd always dreamed of soaring the skies.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: the tribe that holds the flying trials and that the group belongs to
introduced.quote: Paimon: The Flower-Feather Clan should be about ready to hold the new flying trials by now.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: a location near Coya's remote nest, linked to the Cinder City
introduced.quote: They arrive at Coya's nest, located at the outskirts of Ochkanatlan.

introduced.name: Cinder City
introduced.how: the city of Ochkanatlan whose advanced technology inspired Tepal's designs
introduced.quote: Chasca: Ochkanatlan, the Cinder City... Looks like that's where he got his technological inspiration from.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: a lord whose hatred of saurians once threatened the peace and who still sows discord
introduced.quote: nearly destroyed the peace forged by the Pyro Archon...

introduced.name: Mutota
introduced.how: the tribe's chief, a former flying ace
introduced.quote: Chasca: And Mutota. He was quite the flying ace back in the day, too.

introduced.name: Tepal's airborne workshop
introduced.how: a hidden base above the clouds, reached by a balloon, that Tepal's work may be based in
introduced.quote: Chasca: Seems likely. If Tepal's base had been hiding above the clouds this whole time, that would definitely explain why Isidore couldn't find it...

introduced.name: Tepal
introduced.how: researcher behind the Phlogiston Wings whose notebooks record his phlogiston research
introduced.quote: Chasca: Let me see... Looks like a record of his phlogiston research.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Wings
introduced.how: a flight invention Tepal is developing with phlogiston refined from qucusaurs
introduced.quote: Tepal: Log No. 377. Encountered some issues with the new smaller-model Phlogiston Wings.

introduced.name: Airborne workshop
introduced.how: a flying workshop platform that Tepal built and that is powered by a relic
introduced.quote: Paimon: Here it is, the workshop in the sky... You gotta see it to believe it.

introduced.name: Cinder City relic
introduced.how: an ancient relic supplying about eighty percent of the airborne workshop's power
introduced.quote: Tepal: Even though it relies on the relic for eighty percent of its power supply, I've at least taken the first step.

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: saurian creatures that are captured and drained of phlogiston to be too weak to move
introduced.quote: Chasca: Once a qucusaur is drained of phlogiston, it becomes too weak to move...

introduced.name: Gaseous Phlogiston
introduced.how: phlogiston refined from live qucusaurs and used to power the Phlogiston Wings
introduced.quote: Chasca: By the looks of it... Tepal was using these cages to extract phlogiston from the qucusaurs.

introduced.name: Allpa
introduced.how: Tepal's birth mother, an elder of the Flower-Feather Clan who went back to her tribe alone
introduced.quote: Allpa: He started a new family with another traveler who was also looking to return home... and I went back to the Flower-Feather Clan, alone.

introduced.name: Puma
introduced.how: the woman who wrote a letter urging Tepal to visit his dying father and is his adoptive mother
introduced.quote: Paimon: So Puma's not Tepal's real mom? Huh...

introduced.name: Mutota
introduced.how: a tribal leader of the Flower-Feather Clan who was rallying the resistance against Allpa
introduced.quote: Mutota: Cusco, I understand how you must feel...

introduced.name: Cusco
introduced.how: Chasca's parent who scolds her for risky behavior and says her mother works with the Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.quote: Cusco: Anyway. Now you know how we feel when you go off risking life and limb!

introduced.name: Wingless
introduced.how: riders who lose the ability to fly after being rejected by qucusaurs or injured
introduced.quote: Allpa: ...And then, the anguish that overcame me when he was rejected by the qucusaurs and became wingless, just as I had after my injury...

assumed.name: Allpa
assumed.quote: Allpa: Chasca, there's a conflict emerging there... aren't you going to nip it in the bud?

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: nearly destroyed the peace forged by the Pyro Archon...

assumed.name: Cusco
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah, so that's what Uncle Cusco was talking about.

assumed.name: Chuychu
assumed.quote: Chasca: Yeah, I did... but then gradually, everything changed. With a new mom and dad, a new tribe, and Chuychu...

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Cusco tells her that his wife had wrote from the Masters of the Night-Wind scolding him for his inaction and that she'd have come in person if she wasn't so busy.

assumed.name: Elemental Energy
assumed.quote: Isidore: Help! Uh, Elemental Energy suppresses it! Please, someone—

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Isidore: I—I don't know! I mean, he did tell us to spread negative rumors about the qucusaurs, and slip some Mora to anyone opposed to them, but...

assumed.name: Inkanak
assumed.quote: Mutota: If you want to give it a try, check with Inkanak at the trial grounds.

assumed.name: Cinder City
assumed.quote: nor me when I returned injured from the Cinder City

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Chasca: How many times has the Abyss invaded Natlan now?

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Traveler: You really think the Pyro Archon is gonna let you get away with a coup?

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Allpa: ...I had no idea that despite being raised among the Children of Echoes, my child still harbored dreams of the skies.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: Chasca: Your vision is deranged... and the Flower-Feather Clan will never support it!

assumed.name: Chime
assumed.quote: Paimon: And still no sign of Coya's baby...

assumed.name: Coya
assumed.quote: Chasca: ...Coya, remember when we were kids?

assumed.name: Chimpu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Aw! It's Chime and Chimpu, they're here too!

threads.claim: Tepal's identity is uncertain and seems familiar to Chasca, hinting that he may not be who he claims.
threads.quote: Chasca: "Tepal"? Huh, sounds familiar... But where from...?

threads.claim: Allpa suspects someone may have orchestrated the whole conflict behind the scenes.
threads.quote: Allpa: ...This whole situation has unfolded so quickly that it's put us on a back foot. To tell the truth, it makes me a little suspicious...

threads.claim: The true mastermind behind Tepal's name turns out to be Allpa, who was driven by her son's death.
threads.quote: The mastermind is soon revealed to be Allpa, who became angered at the qucusaurs upon learning of her son's death

threads.claim: Phlogiston for the wings may be drawn directly from captured qucusaurs, a suspicion not yet confirmed.
threads.quote: Isidore: This is just a best guess, of course, but we suspect that the gaseous phlogiston stored in the trackballs... is drawn directly from the qucusaurs.

threads.claim: Chasca doubts the wings can be judged by old standards and argues they must first be understood before adoption.
threads.quote: Chasca: We don't have any experience using these wings in battle, nor is it immediately obvious how to incorporate them into the existing systems in our tribe.

threads.claim: The tribe is split over whether qucusaurs are still needed now that the wings exist.
threads.quote: Pixica: Well, now that we have the Phlogiston Wings... Do we even need the qucusaurs anymore?

threads.claim: Coya took Chasca's hesitation as betrayal and flew away, leaving their bond broken.
threads.quote: Chasca: She saw it as a personal betrayal, threw a huge fit, and then flew off. We hadn't seen each other since... until today.

threads.claim: Coya asked Chasca's mother to keep her new nest location secret from Chasca.
threads.quote: Chasca: Not for lack of trying, though. I tried asking Mom where Coya's new nest was so I could talk things out with her.

threads.claim: Chasca learns that Coya had forgiven her after starting a family of her own.
threads.quote: To her surprise, Chasca discovers that Coya had forgiven her when she had started a family of her own.

threads.claim: Coya's child Chime was taken by humans, which is the reason for Coya's attacks.
threads.quote: Chasca: It's Chime, Coya's child... the attackers kidnapped her!

threads.claim: Chime is found alive and held captive in Allpa's extraction cage.
threads.quote: Allpa reveals an extraction cage with Chime in it.

threads.claim: Och-Kan is still sowing discord in Natlan through the Cinder City relic.
threads.quote: Mutota: A relic from the Cinder City? Ugh... so Och-Kan's still managing to sow discord, even after all these years...

threads.claim: The balloon may have started far above the clouds, meaning Tepal's base is hidden in the sky.
threads.quote: Chasca: What if it started off even higher up, above the clouds and out of view, and it only descended to its current height due to some kind of malfunction?

threads.claim: The balloon is heavily remodeled and only dropped below the clouds because of a machinery malfunction.
threads.quote: Chasca: Ah-hah... just as I thought. It might look like a regular hot air balloon from the outside, but up close, it's clearly been heavily remodeled.

threads.claim: Tepal's floating device depended on a Relic from Cinder City, and its loss caused it to fall.
threads.quote: -->The floating device, bereft of the Relic's support, fell quickly. Is that a power output issue or a weight issue?

threads.claim: Tepal's stated goal is a world where the skies are shared by all, a vision the story will test.
threads.quote: Imagine a world where the skies are for all to share!

threads.claim: Chasca argues that the phlogiston extraction betrays the promise of shared skies.
threads.quote: You're not sharing the sky... You're stealing it!

threads.claim: The notebooks suggest a benefactor funded Tepal's project, so the true mastermind is still unknown.
threads.quote: Chasca: Yeah, probably the contact he alluded to in his other notebook... Guess he has a benefactor.

threads.claim: The true ringleader is revealed to be Tepal's birth mother, Allpa.
threads.quote: ???: That's right. Tepal was my child... he was born during my days as a wingless wanderer.

threads.claim: The notebook's later voice and renumbering raise the question of whether Tepal is already dead.
threads.quote: Does that mean that Tepal's already...?

threads.claim: The old, faded notebooks show Tepal had died long before his father's funeral.
threads.quote: It looks like the real reason Tepal didn't attend his father's funeral is because he'd long since passed away himself.

threads.claim: A new voice appears in the notebook, suggesting someone else is continuing Tepal's dream.
threads.quote: Tepal?: All this, we do... to make Tepal's dream a reality.

threads.claim: Log No. 444 is left blank, leaving the results of a secret experiment unrecorded.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Why is this log empty?

threads.claim: Qucusaurs are drained of phlogiston until they are too weak to move, making the extraction deadly for them.
threads.quote: Chasca: Once a qucusaur is drained of phlogiston, it becomes too weak to move...

threads.claim: How Tepal obtained a relic from the Cinder City remains an open question.
threads.quote: how he got his hands on a relic from the Cinder City

threads.claim: The relic suddenly becomes unstable and fires fireballs, and its cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hey! Uh... something's up with this relic!

threads.claim: Allpa claims the Pyro Archon cannot interfere in tribal affairs, hinting at larger political stakes.
threads.quote: As long as the majority supports our vision, even the Pyro Archon cannot meddle in our internal affairs.

threads.claim: Qucusaurs reject riders who become wingless, and Chasca suggests this is to protect riders from death.
threads.quote: Chasca: You're wrong, Allpa... They only reject the Wingless because they don't want to fly anyone to their death.

threads.claim: Chasca challenges Allpa's view that qucusaurs cannot form bonds with humans.
threads.quote: Chasca: ...Allpa, be honest. Do you still think qucusaurs can't form bonds?

threads.claim: Allpa holds Chime hostage to force the group into surrender.
threads.quote: Allpa: Careful, don't make any rash decisions... Unless you want to see her suffer.

threads.claim: Chasca apologizes to Coya for a past falling out, leaving their rift unresolved.
threads.quote: Chasca: ...Coya, I just want to say... I'm sorry for how things went down back then.

introduced.name: Lan Yu
introduced.how: Lan Yan's uncle, introduced as the head of the Lan clan
introduced.quote: Let me introduce you. This is my uncle, the head of the Lan clan.

introduced.name: Lan Junming
introduced.how: the Lan clan's Grandmaster, a remnant soul who wakes once every Moonchase Festival and cannot remember himself
introduced.quote: At first, he introduced himself as our Grandmaster.

introduced.name: Silverwing
introduced.how: an adeptus born from heaven and earth's spiritual energy, who is the wind-borne swallow figure
introduced.quote: Silverwing is an adeptus born from the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.

introduced.name: Eight Adepts
introduced.how: a group of adepti whose exploits the Grandmaster was once part of
introduced.quote: When I was little, the elders often spoke of his exploits as one of the Eight Adepts

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: a Liyue valley once full of swallows and the Lan clan's rise
introduced.quote: They say that Chenyu Vale was still filled with them when it was first sung.

introduced.name: swallow flocks
introduced.how: Silverwing's living embodiments and the source of her adeptal power
introduced.quote: The swallows soaring above were her living embodiments, as well as the very wellspring of her power.

introduced.name: Adeptal Energy
introduced.how: energy that is gathered and channeled to form mystic patterns
introduced.quote: Collect enough Adeptal Energy within the time limit

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: a great war in which Silverwing had to fly from Chenyu Vale to Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.quote: During the Archon War, the journey from Chenyu Vale to Guyun Stone Forest was treacherous beyond measure.

introduced.name: Moonchase Festival
introduced.how: the festival when the Grandmaster's puppet-like figure would appear in Yilong Wharf
introduced.quote: a strange man would occasionally appear in Yilong Wharf during the Moonchase Festival.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: arranges the city's response to evil spirits, dispatching the Millelith and enlisting thaumaturges
introduced.quote: The Ministry of Civil Affairs made preparations well in advance, dispatching the Millelith and enlisting thaumaturges from among the people.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: an organization that carries out operations against evil spirits
introduced.quote: Uncle, I thought you were still assisting with the Millelith's operation.

introduced.name: Mt. Aocang
introduced.how: where Liyue's adepti gather
introduced.quote: Liyue's adepti would be gathering at Mt. Aocang today.

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: There you are!

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: I am merely a humble swordsman serving under Master Chongyun.

assumed.name: Chongyun
assumed.quote: Chongyun: Three great traditions of the mystic arts? Since when have we called them that?

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zhongli! And all the adepti are here too... What a relief!

assumed.name: Mad Lan
assumed.quote: This matter concerns Mad Lan.

assumed.name: Tao Dou affair
assumed.quote: When the affair at Tao Dou came to an end

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: I recall that the war between Rex Lapis and the other gods had yet to reach its end.

assumed.name: Wind Reader
assumed.quote: How much time does the Wind Reader have left?

assumed.name: adepti
assumed.quote: Adepti aren't exactly easy to track down.

assumed.name: thaumaturge
assumed.quote: I'm no thaumaturge, but if you require my help, you need only say the word.

threads.claim: The adepti do not know where Silverwing is, leaving her whereabouts an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon: So even the adepti don't know where she is?

threads.claim: Zhongli reveals that Silverwing's whereabouts are not a place but her continued existence in the swallow flocks.
threads.quote: And so, you now know of Silverwing's true

threads.claim: The Grandmaster's puppet was designed to awaken at every Moonchase Festival, a pattern that raises questions.
threads.quote: If this puppet was created to keep his appointment, then it was by design that he would awaken once every Moonchase Festival.

threads.claim: Lan Yan reveals the Grandmaster has awakened many times over a thousand years and kept returning to sleep.
threads.quote: Actually... this is not the first time Grandmaster has awoken.

threads.claim: The Grandmaster's promise to Silverwing went unfulfilled across many awakenings, which does not add up.
threads.quote: Yet not once did he fulfill his promise... Something about that does not add up.

threads.claim: Lan Yan suggests Silverwing, not the Grandmaster, was the one who failed to keep the promise.
threads.quote: what if the one who failed to keep that promise... wasn't you?

threads.claim: The swallows lost their memory of the promise and of Chenyu Vale as their home.
threads.quote: But by then, the swallows had already forgotten the promise they had made to the mortal.

threads.claim: A new consciousness may emerge from the swallow flock, raising whether it is the same Silverwing.
threads.quote: Given time, a new consciousness will likely emerge from the flock.

threads.claim: Zhongli's ship parable questions whether Silverwing persists when every part of her has been replaced.
threads.quote: Can it truly be said, then, that the ship returning to port is the same vessel that once departed?

threads.claim: Xianyun notes that under mortal stewardship, the adepti no longer get called upon and feel a lingering solitude.
threads.quote: Now, under mortal stewardship, Liyue enjoys peace and security.

threads.claim: The evil-dispelling technique every Liyue thaumaturge learns was once a supreme technique known only to the Grandmaster.
threads.quote: It was once a supreme technique known to you alone.

threads.claim: The soul-binding technique keeping the Grandmaster alive is nearing its limit, so time is running out.
threads.quote: The technique sustaining Grandmaster has already reached its limit.

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: Oceanids were familiars of the former Hydro Archon who fled Fontaine and spread across the world
introduced.quote: the Oceanids were the familiars of the former Hydro Archon.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: Callirhoe's origin land, which the Oceanids fled from long ago
introduced.quote: Actually, I'm... an Oceanid, who flowed here from Fontaine long ago...

introduced.name: Callirhoe
introduced.how: Revealed as an Oceanid and the Spring Fairy, a water being who lost most of her power and memories
introduced.quote: Callirhoe transform back into her human form and reveals that she is an Oceanid who fled Fontaine

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: A serene spring-side settlement where Callirhoe settled and slowly regained her power
introduced.quote: Eventually, I settled in a place called Springvale, where I slowly began to regain my power...

introduced.name: Old Finch
introduced.how: The now-elderly boy from the Heart of Clear Springs story who once met Callirhoe at the spring
introduced.quote: the boy in the story is the now elderly Old Finch, whom she met when he was young.

introduced.name: Heart of Clear Springs
introduced.how: A story about the Spring Fairy and a boy, which Callirhoe wrote a poem named after
introduced.quote: And it will be called... Heart of Clear Springs.

introduced.name: true Heart of Clear Springs droplet
introduced.how: A water droplet condensed from Callirhoe's power, given to Finch so she can meet him in dreams
introduced.quote: This is a droplet of water condensed from my own power.

introduced.name: death of the previous Hydro Archon
introduced.how: The archon's death prompted the Oceanids to flee Fontaine
introduced.quote: They all fled Fontaine after the archon died, and settled across the world...

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Oh? Hey, you're all back! And it looks like you're in much better spirits than before.

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: Miss Callirhoe, are you some kind of adeptus?

assumed.name: Grand Master
assumed.quote: Ah! The Grand Master has mentioned them before

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao's a step ahead. She's already talking about printing a poetry anthology.

assumed.name: Draff
assumed.quote: Ohoho, Draff's daughter is just like him when she's on a mission...

assumed.name: Lochfolk
assumed.quote: But I knew all too well that we Lochfolk face a very different fate from that of humans.

assumed.name: Dihua Marsh
assumed.quote: I saw her on the bridge near Dihua Marsh during my morning training.

assumed.name: Noelle
assumed.quote: Noelle has other duties today, so she asked me to tell everyone not to wait up for her.

assumed.name: hilichurls
assumed.quote: Ah! She's surrounded by hilichurls! Let's go save her!

assumed.name: pure-yang spirit
assumed.quote: Is it also possible that my pure-yang spirit is a gift from some being?

threads.claim: Callirhoe cannot fully recall how she came to Mondstadt, hinting at a hidden journey.
threads.quote: Though, to tell you the truth, I can't even completely recall how I found myself here...

threads.claim: The death of the previous Hydro Archon drove the Oceanids out of Fontaine, an event whose details remain open.
threads.quote: They all fled Fontaine after the archon died, and settled across the world...

threads.claim: Lochfolk face a fate very different from humans, and their differing lifespans shape the bond between them.
threads.quote: But I knew all too well that we Lochfolk face a very different fate from that of humans.

threads.claim: Mika had always thought the spring fairy story was only a local legend, raising doubt about its truth.
threads.quote: I always thought that was just a local legend...

threads.claim: Chongyun wonders whether his pure-yang spirit and Diona's drink-making are gifts from a water being.
threads.quote: Is it also possible that my pure-yang spirit is a gift from some being?

threads.claim: Callirhoe reveals she gave Diona a gift so a part of her would always be with her.
threads.quote: That's why I gave you your gift. So that a part of me could always be with you.

threads.claim: Finch has been standing by the spring every day as if waiting for someone, hinting he still hopes for Callirhoe.
threads.quote: And even though Grandpa Finch loves adventures, he still stands there by the spring, every day, as if he's waiting for something.

threads.claim: Finch understands Callirhoe's situation through her poem, resolving her fear of disappointing him.
threads.quote: It's okay, I understand. Your poem, it... it explains everything...

threads.claim: Callirhoe promises to meet Finch in his dreams whenever he calls for her, and Finch says she is still nearby.
threads.quote: I will always be one with the spring. From this day onwards, if you call me, I will meet you in your dreams.

introduced.name: Apathic Interval
introduced.how: a transitional space where chosen people must give up all desires before being uplifted to the Temple of Space
introduced.quote: a transitional space where individuals chosen to be uplifted to the Temple of Space must relinquish all of their desires before entering.

introduced.name: Maranasati Caskets
introduced.how: overwrought coffins set up by one of the temple mistress's sisters, which hold people in cages
introduced.quote: Maranasati Caskets, I believe they were called.
