introduced.name: Deathmuse Shards
introduced.how: fragments collected from the caskets that can force open a path, given a temporary name
introduced.quote: In which case, let's call the fragments Deathmuse Shards.

introduced.name: Maranasati Meditation Technique
introduced.how: a meditation method for cultivating one's mental state when facing death
introduced.quote: Ah, you mean the Maranasati meditation technique. I know of it, and its use in cultivating one's mental state when facing death.

introduced.name: Heaven of Nothingness
introduced.how: a realm one must be reborn in before entering the state of no-thought
introduced.quote: In Sumeru, we believe that to enter the state of no-thought, one has to be reborn in the Heaven of Nothingness first!

introduced.name: Wall of Lament
introduced.how: a barrier on the way to the hero's pure land of joy that no mortal can climb
introduced.quote: To get to the hero's pure land of joy, one would have to pass the Wall of Lament first.

introduced.name: Melanta
introduced.how: a figure who watches from the Cage of Suchness and turns people into statues and ink or paper figures
introduced.quote: (Melanta is shown as he observes from the Cage of Suchness)

introduced.name: Istoria
introduced.how: a returning figure who has been in the Apathic Interval before and explains how escape works
introduced.quote: Istoria: Once more, we return to this place...

introduced.name: Alara
introduced.how: a former Ascetic who introduces himself and says he was trapped in the Interval for a long time
introduced.quote: Alara: Ah. Well, though I know nothing of your time, my name is Alara. I was once an Ascetic of the Age of Silence.

introduced.name: Age of Silence
introduced.how: an era Alara came from, when ascetics cultivated minds without thought
introduced.quote: I was once an Ascetic of the Age of Silence.

introduced.name: Zeitlind
introduced.how: a person freed from a cage who has suffered a nightmare and is grieving
introduced.quote: Zeitlind: ...I'm fine. I just had a very, very long nightmare.

assumed.name: Dex
assumed.quote: Since Dex is also a Watcher, it might be able to use the power contained within these fragments to force open a path.

assumed.name: Nihilita
assumed.quote: Melanta and Nihilita can move within this place freely, and they usually bring people with them.

assumed.name: Memory Core
assumed.quote: As they try to leave the Memory Core, the sky and all the temple's structures turn red

assumed.name: Temple of Space
assumed.quote: Upon returning to the Temple of Space, they are puzzled to find that Paimon was not drawn into the Interval with them.

assumed.name: Wanderer's Trail
assumed.quote: (The Traveler finds themselves at Stormbearer Coast just like in Wanderer's Trail)

assumed.name: Desert Pavilion
assumed.quote: (Approach the area that resembles the Desert Pavilion)

assumed.name: Zeitlind's family
assumed.quote: Zeitlind: Why is it always me... First Mom and Dad... and now my sister...

threads.claim: The Deathmuse Shards are a temporary name for fragments whose true purpose is still unknown.
threads.quote: Istoria: Though I should say this is a temporary name, since I have no clue what Dex will be using them for either.

threads.claim: Melanta is angry and his motives are still unexplained.
threads.quote: Istoria: Looks like Melanta really is angry now.

threads.claim: Escaping the Interval requires giving up desires, but the Traveler's desires may not be cast aside.
threads.quote: For someone like you who carries the fate of the world on your shoulders, your desires probably can't be cast aside... nor should they be.

threads.claim: Istoria refuses to give up her desires this time, unlike her first escape.
threads.quote: This time, I'm not willing to give any of those up.

threads.claim: Paimon was not pulled into the Apathic Interval, and the reason is unclear.
threads.quote: Istoria: Hmm? Why wasn't Paimon dragged into the Apathic Interval?

threads.claim: The Traveler guesses Paimon was spared because she does not think much beyond eating and sleeping.
threads.quote: She doesn't really think about much at all?

threads.claim: The sky and temple turned red for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: Istoria: What an odd color the sky has become.

threads.claim: Zeitlind has lost her parents and now her sister, and feels cursed by repeated loss.
threads.quote: Zeitlind: Why is it always me... First Mom and Dad... and now my sister...

threads.claim: Cultivating a mind without thought or desire may lead to rebirth in the Unthinking Heaven of Evil.
threads.quote: Alara: So it is true... cultivating a mind without thought or desire leads one to reincarnate in the Unthinking Heaven of Evil...

threads.claim: The Wall of Lament is a barrier that no mortal can climb.
threads.quote: And that wall is a barrier no mortal can climb.

threads.claim: Istoria previously escaped the Interval only after hundreds of years, giving up her pursuit of truth and her longing to see loved ones.
threads.quote: The first time I left this place, it took me hundreds of years.

introduced.name: Floating Hydro Fungus
introduced.how: an elemental life-form disguised as a fungus, from an ancient race
introduced.quote: This Fungus didn't develop from a spore. It's an elemental life-form.

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: the final form elemental life-forms take at the end of their life
introduced.quote: It's the last form we take when we are at the end of our life.

introduced.name: forbidden knowledge
introduced.how: the apocalypse power that corrupts and warps life-forms
introduced.quote: We later found out that humans know the power of the apocalypse, and refer to it as

introduced.name: Apep
introduced.how: the Dendro Dragon, an ancient elemental dragon with a whole world inside it
introduced.quote: Yes. They're both dragons but Apep, the Dendro Dragon, has been around for longer and has accumulated dense elemental power...

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: a Dragon King who drew dragons into a war with outsiders through forbidden knowledge
introduced.quote: The Dragon King Nibelung, who acquired the knowledge from the power of darkness outside Teyvat, led them into a fight with the outsiders.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: a king who gained forbidden knowledge and built his kingdom on Apep's lands
introduced.quote: King Deshret, gaining forbidden knowledge from Nabu Malikata, was allowed by Apep to build his kingdom in its lands

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the order the dragons tried to overcome and that Apep now lives under
introduced.quote: Apep tells Nahida that it and the other dragons sought forbidden knowledge to help them overcome the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: Fire Seed
introduced.how: a crystal needed to save Apep, made with the fungi's kind, that should not be reused
introduced.quote: Nahida asks it what the crystal is, and it tells her that it is a Fire Seed - an item required to save Apep, and it was in good condition.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a murky, limitless depth east of Sumeru that no one returns from
introduced.quote: To the limitless depths east of Sumeru. A murky place that no one can return from.

introduced.name: Celestial Nail
introduced.how: a giant spike that fell from the sky and turned Sumeru's rainforest into desert
introduced.quote: Not at first. That came when a giant spike fell from the sky, turning a huge section of the rainforest into sand.

introduced.name: Heart of Oasis
introduced.how: the core of Apep whose restoration would heal it
introduced.quote: However, if they could restore its Heart of Oasis, it would recover.

introduced.name: Oozing Filth
introduced.how: a stable but dangerous power that hides the altered apocalypse, left behind by the giant spike
introduced.quote: Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus: What the Lord of Dendro means is that the apocalypse was altered by the power of the giant spike and hidden within the Oozing Filth.

introduced.name: Fire Seed
introduced.how: an essential item made by the Lord of Dendro and the Fungi that can save the Dendro Dragon by reviving its Heart of Oasis
introduced.quote: Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom: This... is a Fire Seed. It's an essential item for saving the Dendro Dragon. Thankfully, it appears to be in good condition.

introduced.name: Heart of Oasis
introduced.how: the source of the Dendro Dragon's power, which the Fire Seed can reactivate
introduced.quote: Nahida: So the Heart of Oasis is Apep's source of power...

introduced.name: Apep
introduced.how: the ill, hostile Dendro Dragon that the group finds in the desert
introduced.quote: Nahida: We've found it... Apep, the Dendro Dragon.

introduced.name: Floating Hydro Fungus
introduced.how: elemental life-forms from the Dendro Dragon's homeland who were carried out of it, called the Lord of Dendro's family
introduced.quote: Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus: It's our family.

introduced.name: Dragon King
introduced.how: a figure who took darkness power from outside the world and led the dragons against the outsiders' order
introduced.quote: Apep: The Dragon King acquired the power of darkness from outside of this world and led us in a fight against the order established by the outsiders.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: a would-be ruler who gained forbidden power and built a kingdom in Apep's domain before collapsing
introduced.quote: Apep: Yes. Al-Ahmar eventually obtained this power with the help of Nabu Malikata.

introduced.name: Nabu Malikata
introduced.how: helped Al-Ahmar obtain forbidden power
introduced.quote: Apep: Yes. Al-Ahmar eventually obtained this power with the help of Nabu Malikata.

introduced.name: apocalypse
introduced.how: the catastrophic power that Apep absorbed from Al-Ahmar and that ravaged the world
introduced.quote: Apep: However, what I gained was no benefit... No, I gained the apocalypse.

introduced.name: giant spike
introduced.how: the object that fell from the sky, stopped the apocalypse, and was the only thing able to change its power
introduced.quote: Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom: Only the giant spike that fell from the sky was capable of doing something like that.

introduced.name: Nur
introduced.how: the name given to a Floating Hydro Fungus, meaning light
introduced.quote: Voice in the Memories: It will be your name from now on.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: I noticed that I have some blurry memories after saving Irminsul.

assumed.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
assumed.quote: I found it in the Sanctuary of Surasthana, but I have no recollection of it whatsoever.

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: (It's most likely something that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata left behind...)

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: Mining, fishing, Genius Invokation TCG, and catching Crystalflies.

assumed.name: Crystalflies
assumed.quote: Mining, fishing, Genius Invokation TCG, and catching Crystalflies.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: (Elemental Sight activates, highlighting the unconscious Fungus in green)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on the leading Floating Hydro Fungus, optional)

assumed.name: Bongo-Head
assumed.quote: Bongo-Head is a really nice Fungus, you know.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Like Dvalin?

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: I'll leave the rainforest to the Aranara, and as for the city...

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: as it did not accept the new order following the end of the Archon War

assumed.name: Amun
assumed.quote: Apep calls both her and Amun no different

assumed.name: Buer
assumed.quote: and that Buer would too.

assumed.name: Great Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: But Great Dendro Archon, it's a monster.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus: The Lord of Dendro seems hesitant. I too, would advise caution.

assumed.name: Buer
assumed.quote: Apep: I do not need saving. Especially not by you, Buer.

assumed.name: Amun
assumed.quote: Apep: You are no different from Amun.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Nahida: I'm referring to what was used to fight against the Abyss.

assumed.name: forbidden knowledge
assumed.quote: Traveler: This is definitely connected to forbidden knowledge.

assumed.name: Lumenstone
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yep, we know what to do. We'll just use the Lumenstone on the Oozing Concretion!

assumed.name: The Withering
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wouldn't it already have become The Withering like the others...?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Apep: You will only be reviving the dragon that will destroy Sumeru and the seven nations!

threads.claim: Nahida has hazy memories and a forgotten important task since saving Irminsul.
threads.quote: I almost feel like there's still something extremely important I need to do... But I can't remember what it is.

threads.claim: The fungi believe Nahida made a prophecy-bound agreement to bring their kind home, which she cannot recall.
threads.quote: That the Lord of Dendro will bring us home once the catastrophe comes to an end.

threads.claim: The ancient elemental race has forgotten where its flowing-water homeland is.
threads.quote: My home was filled with flowing water and great mountains.

threads.claim: Purging forbidden knowledge left voids and erased memories in the corrupted life-forms.
threads.quote: So the void of elemental power was left behind from when the forbidden knowledge was purged.

threads.claim: Apep may also have been contaminated by forbidden knowledge, leaving a void inside it.
threads.quote: Doesn't that imply that Apep has also been contaminated by forbidden knowledge?

threads.claim: Apep explains that it and the other dragons sought forbidden knowledge and were corrupted by it.
threads.quote: Apep tells Nahida that it and the other dragons sought forbidden knowledge to help them overcome the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: A family member went east to the Chasm, possibly carrying forbidden knowledge in another form.
threads.quote: To the limitless depths east of Sumeru. A murky place that no one can return from.

threads.claim: The Fire Seed was unstable, so using it again is risky.
threads.quote: It advises them not to use it again as it was not stabilized.

threads.claim: Apep remains hostile toward the gods because it rejects the order that followed the Archon War.
threads.quote: as it did not accept the new order following the end of the Archon War

threads.claim: The Dendro Dragon contains an entire world inside its body.
threads.quote: There is an entire world inside the Dendro Dragon's body.

threads.claim: Life-forms change form with their environment, and such change takes time, which is called growth.
threads.quote: changing form requires energy, and energy comes with time.

threads.claim: Apep reveals he absorbed Al-Ahmar's power and thereby gained the apocalypse, tying its origin to Al-Ahmar's collapsed kingdom.
threads.quote: Apep: However, what I gained was no benefit... No, I gained the apocalypse.

threads.claim: The giant spike that fell from the sky is the only thing that could alter the apocalypse's power, which raises questions about what it is.
threads.quote: Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom: Only the giant spike that fell from the sky was capable of doing something like that.

threads.claim: The group suspects the crystal and the Oozing Filth are connected to forbidden knowledge, which is dangerous to touch again.
threads.quote: Traveler: This is definitely connected to forbidden knowledge.

threads.claim: A Dragon King from outside the world took darkness power and led the dragons in a war that nearly destroyed Teyvat, and his fate is left open.
threads.quote: Apep: The Dragon King acquired the power of darkness from outside of this world and led us in a fight against the order established by the outsiders.

threads.claim: Apep hints that the life dear to the Heavenly Principles may go far, leaving the nature of that order and its life unresolved.
threads.quote: Apep: How far will the life so dear and precious to the Heavenly Principles be able to go? I wonder...

threads.claim: Nahida has lost memories of a past agreement with the Fungus, and it is unclear what she did to protect it.
threads.quote: Nahida: I'm sorry, that portion of my memory is highly unreliable at the moment... I can't seem to remember who you are...

threads.claim: The Fungus says Nahida once made an agreement with it and used her power to protect it, so her memories were tied to a promise.
threads.quote: Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom: You once said that the apocalypse will be completely eradicated and that relevant memories will become unstable.

threads.claim: Nahida offers to shrink into a twig to fuel the Fire Seed, which means losing her emotions and memories.
threads.quote: Nahida: I'll become a blade of grass or a twig. Basically, I'll return to how I was first born.

threads.claim: A silent entity called Void appears and refuses to answer, leaving its nature a mystery.
threads.quote: Void: ...

threads.claim: A voice from the Fungi's memories speaks of a promise and of waiting for someone, hinting at an unknown speaker.
threads.quote: Voice in the Memories: We may never meet again.

threads.claim: Apep finds that his long-standing rage has faded into a feeling of peace, which hints at a change in him.
threads.quote: Apep: I thought that my rage would be kindled once my power returned to me.

threads.claim: The Fungi return home but lose their memories of their journey and of their homeland, so the homecoming costs them their past.
threads.quote: Nahida: Indeed, although they'll still have the chance to be born again, they've lost their memories of their journey and their feelings for their homeland.

introduced.name: Esoptron
introduced.how: a Variable-Response Query Terminal built by the Heavenly Principles that acts for its master within set limits
introduced.quote: This is Esoptron, a Variable-Response Query Terminal. Built by the Heavenly Principles, it is capable of acting on its master's behalf within certain parameters.

introduced.name: Holy Soil
introduced.how: Celestia's final punishment that resets a civilization's land to Light Realm energy and erases everything in sight
introduced.quote: Records describe it as the final punishment Celestia imposes upon a transgressing civilization. Everything is to be reset to Teyvat's original state — that is to say, the Light Realm.

introduced.name: Nail of Retribution
introduced.how: a Celestia tool used to punish transgressors and fight the Abyss, which can start the Hallowing
introduced.quote: It is a tool used by Celestia to punish transgressors and combat the Abyss.

introduced.name: Istaroth
introduced.how: the Ruler of Time who supports the seekers and has forbidden them from interfering in the Snezhnaya and Heavenly Principles conflict
introduced.quote: our supporter Istaroth, the Ruler of Time, has expressly forbidden us from inserting ourselves into the conflict between Snezhnaya and the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: seekers
introduced.how: a group with the duty to guard the world's border and explore the life and knowledge of the universe
introduced.quote: As seekers, we have the right and responsibility of maintaining the world's border and exploring the life and knowledge in the universe.

introduced.name: Ioanna Ivanovna
introduced.how: the first chair of the Snezhnograd Veche, Pulcinella's predecessor, and a Hexenzirkel member
introduced.quote: Pulcinella's predecessor — the first chair of the Snezhnograd Veche.

introduced.name: Temple of Space
introduced.how: Asmoday's territory, where Esoptron is located
introduced.quote: The Temple of Space is Asmoday's territory, making it a perfect venue for us to have our discussion.

introduced.name: Dex
introduced.how: a creature that can reconstruct islands and carry the group quickly across distances
introduced.quote: (Dex uses its power to reconstruct an island in the distance)

introduced.name: Trial of Usurpation
introduced.how: six trials that must be completed to stop the Hallowing, tracked as a state in Esoptron
introduced.quote: Esoptron: Checking Trial of Usurpation completion status... Six trials remaining.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: the Iudex of Fontaine and the Hydro Dragon, whose full authority has been restored
introduced.quote: The Iudex of Fontaine — the Hydro Dragon, with his full authority restored...

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: the Ruler of Death, whose revenge on Snezhnaya is suspected to be behind the Hallowing
introduced.quote: If Ronova, the Ruler of Death, truly wanted to take revenge on Snezhnaya, she could easily have activated only the Nail of Retribution located here.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the divine order that created the Nails of Retribution and enforces Celestia's rule
introduced.quote: The Nails of Retribution are creations of the Heavenly Principles, after all.

introduced.name: Gnoses
introduced.how: the only things able to disrupt the world's order, each held by a different archon

threads.claim: The Holy Soil phenomenon is already in effect and will accelerate within a 30-day countdown unless stopped.
threads.quote: Esoptron: Time until Holy Soil phenomenon is accelerated: 30 days.

threads.claim: The Holy Soil phenomenon is a Light Realm energy surge that makes the land regress to its original state.
threads.quote: Whenever Light Realm energy increases in intensity, causing the land to regress to its original state, this is a manifestation of the Holy Soil phenomenon.

threads.claim: Ronova is suspected of setting the Hallowing in motion in her final moments, but how she did it is unknown.
threads.quote: Our suspicion is that Ronova somehow put this in motion in her final moments.

threads.claim: The six symbols over the nail may be a message, but nobody knows what they mean.
threads.quote: Symbols are used to convey information, like written glyphs or music notation... What if they're trying to tell us something?

threads.claim: The runes resemble angel script but differ from it, and even Nicole cannot read them.
threads.quote: They bear a striking resemblance to the script used by the angels, but it's clearly something different.

threads.claim: Collecting the six runes unlocks Esoptron's query access.
threads.quote: Six runes confirmed. Access granted. Awaiting query.

threads.claim: Six Trials of Usurpation must be completed to stop the Hallowing, and their nature is unknown.
threads.quote: Esoptron: Checking Trial of Usurpation completion status... Six trials remaining.

threads.claim: Figuring out what a Trial of Usurpation is may itself be part of the trial.
threads.quote: Perhaps figuring out what a Trial of Usurpation is, is itself part of the trial.

threads.claim: Destroying a Nail of Retribution might stop the Hallowing but could trigger a worse disaster.
threads.quote: One misstep, and we could trigger an even worse disaster.

threads.claim: Rumors say some lifeforms can convert Light Realm energy back to elemental energy, but this is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Supposedly, there exist certain lifeforms capable of consuming light realm energy and converting it back into elemental energy

threads.claim: Alice's seeker group and Istaroth's orders hide knowledge that Alice will not reveal openly.
threads.quote: What's a seeker, and what the heck does Istaroth have to do with this!?

threads.claim: Asmoday, the owner of the Temple of Space, is missing.
threads.quote: In which case, sorry, Asmoday, but we'll have to step on your toes instead... I doubt she'll mind, though. She's missing, after all.

threads.claim: The Traveler promised their sibling a reunion at the end of the journey, which the Hallowing threatens.
threads.quote: I promised that we would meet again at the end of this journey...

threads.claim: The animosity between dragons and gods has no easy resolution, and Neuvillette feels rancor stirring within him.
threads.quote: There is a staunch animosity to which I see no easy resolution.

threads.claim: The Fatui have not yet located the Pyro Gnosis, which is needed to challenge the Heavenly Principles directly.
threads.quote: Due to roadblocks in our research, we have yet to locate the Pyro Gnosis.

threads.claim: Mavuika can no longer sense the Pyro Gnosis, as if an invisible wall separates them.
threads.quote: But I can no longer sense it. It's like there's an invisible wall separating us.

threads.claim: The Holy Soil aims to remove all life from Teyvat and clear the way for a new civilization.
threads.quote: The goal is to reset Teyvat to its original state, remove all traces of life, and make way for the birth of a new, manageable civilization.

threads.claim: An unknown man watches the beam of light at Port Belovodye and boards a train, hinting at a hidden actor.
threads.quote: (He smiles to himself and the camera pans up to the beam of light, then he is shown boarding a train)

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles may prefer nations to stay isolated so that Celestia's rule prevails.
threads.quote: Our conclusion was that, for the Heavenly Principles, it is far better for the nations to operate in isolation than in unity.

threads.claim: The Eternal Oasis draws power from the Nail of Retribution, and Aaru may hold information about it.
threads.quote: since King Deshret's Eternal Oasis draws power from the Nail of Retribution, Aaru holds some information on the topic

threads.claim: The Fatui once considered persuading the archons peacefully before settling on a performance to secure the Gnoses.
threads.quote: When the Fatui was planning the retrieval of the Gnoses, a peaceful option was tabled

threads.claim: Snezhnaya has unresolved matters from a past conflict with Sara's people that were never addressed.
threads.quote: There is much that we have never addressed since that period of conflict... but it does not mean that we have forgotten.

threads.claim: The Hallowing turns elemental energy into Light Realm energy and causes monster outbreaks, and its cause remains open.
threads.quote: Paimon: Seems like the Hallowing is causing monster outbreaks everywhere...

threads.claim: Six trials must be completed to stop the Hallowing, and what the trials entail is still unknown.
threads.quote: That, we do not yet know.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles' divine plan is the test each civilization must prove, and it may be a curse rather than a plan.
threads.quote: Nahida: Logically speaking, that should mean those who grasp the true meaning of the plan and act in accordance with the Heavenly Principles's will.

threads.claim: Reviving the Sangacorexes may be a route to saving Teyvat, but few remain and it may not be enough.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Still, it gives us somewhere to start. If no better ideas come up, we can go all-in on breeding Sangacorexes.

threads.claim: The Nail of Retribution acts as a capricious judge that both restrains and punishes civilizations.
threads.quote: What a temperamental nail it turned out to be...

threads.claim: Natlan's Nail of Retribution is hidden inside the Night Kingdom, making it hard to reach.
threads.quote: it's hidden away inside the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: Liyue completed its trial by using a Mora coin to prove the contract with Rex Lapis is still valid.
threads.quote: Liyue's trial has been completed without incident.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's contract with the mortal world is still valid and tied to Mora, and Rex Lapis is described as late.
threads.quote: Incidentally, the key to Liyue's proof was Mora, which is made from Rex Lapis's flesh and blood and represents his contract with the mortal world.

threads.claim: Zhongli's sealed form inside the Spiritstone responds to the trial and his Geo blood ties to the people's trust.
threads.quote: I see. So this is the trial

threads.claim: A symbol around the beams of light vanishes when a trial is completed, signaling progress.
threads.quote: Nahida: One of them is gone.

threads.claim: Lang-Gan was destroyed by the Nail of Retribution when it was beset by dark malice.
threads.quote: But the moment that we were beset by the dark malice, the Nail of Retribution was ready to destroy it all.

threads.claim: A god of the desert once researched the Nail of Retribution, and records of his findings still exist.
threads.quote: There was once a god of the desert who researched the Nail of Retribution, and we still have the records of what he had learned.

threads.claim: Humans were denied any choice over their fate and treated protest as a grave sin under heaven's will.
threads.quote: Humans created that civilization, yet they were denied any choice over their fate.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests the whole adventure so far is merely a story, raising doubt about what is real.
threads.quote: Traveler: Paimon, all we experienced so far was just a "story."

threads.claim: The Traveler tells Ann she is not merely a character, since she can think about and remember her situation.
threads.quote: Traveler: You're not merely a character.

threads.claim: The Traveler questions whether the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom exists among the seven nations at all.
threads.quote: Traveler: Is there even a Narzissenkreuz Kingdom amongst the seven nations?

threads.claim: Ann insists Princess Lyris must be somewhere here, while the locals deny ever seeing any princess.
threads.quote: Ann: But she should be here...

threads.claim: Mary-Ann flatly states there is no princess in this place, only the residents.
threads.quote: My apologies, but there is no Princess here. Only us.

threads.claim: Ann begins to recall painful memories she did not want to remember.
threads.quote: Ann: I... I remember something... Even though I really didn't want to.

threads.claim: Ann's memories include a place with deep connections to past events, which she cannot yet name.
threads.quote: My memories contain a place known as the . This place appears to have very deep connections to past events.

threads.claim: Ann says rescuing Princess Lyris is the reason she was born.
threads.quote: But I... still want to rescue "Princess Lyris." That is the reason for which I was born.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann calls the Annapausis a tomb and asks her guests not to stay there.
threads.quote: But the Annapausis is our tomb. I do not wish for you to linger here.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann describes a dream of being a brave Oceanid setting out to save a princess, hinting at her own story.
threads.quote: Before you arrived, I had a dream. I dreamed that I was a small, brave Oceanid, and we set out to save the Princess...

threads.claim: Mary-Ann says she knows what happened in the past and that there is no going back.
threads.quote: But I know what happened in the past. I already know that there's no going back.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann says the real world has already ended, so the guests must say farewell.
threads.quote: In the real world, everything has already ended... so this is farewell.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann recounts a teaching that the body is a prison restricting evolution, and that many have abandoned their bodies.
threads.quote: I have heard something similar said, that the body is a prison that restricts evolution.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann tells a parable of water droplets that gained life and separated, hinting at the cost of unity.
threads.quote: Later, with disturbance, there came ripples, and droplets appeared in those ripples, droplets that had life in them.

threads.claim: Ann still remembers the sacrifice of Al and Petit Chou, who merged into a bubble to help the group.
threads.quote: Ann: Yes. I still remember.

threads.claim: Ann doubts the talking dog is really Mori, hinting that the dog is not what it seems.
threads.quote: But this can't be Mori.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests Paimon and the Traveler are undefined factors that can bring the story to an end.
threads.quote: Traveler: Undefined factors.

threads.claim: Ann asks about the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, a connection the group must investigate to find her next clue.

threads.claim: Nightmare fragments warp the environment around them, so unusual signs point to a nearby fragment.
threads.quote: Oh, be warned, though, the negative energy within the nightmare fragments might affect the surrounding environment.

threads.claim: Homura's nightmare is the root cause behind Popcorn's instability, and it is still unresolved.
