introduced.quote: Mona: Let's see... "Hymn of the Holy Land"? I've never heard of a book by that title.

introduced.name: Arnold
introduced.how: A talkative raven statue who gives directions to the other volumes
introduced.quote: Arnold: Oh, oh, you're asking the right person.

introduced.name: Leon
introduced.how: A self-described knight of the Immernachtreich who is actually a theater actor needing rescue
introduced.quote: My name is Leon, and I am a knight of the Immernachtreich.

introduced.name: Tasraque
introduced.how: A wicked dragon that is Fischl's arch-nemesis and the nightmare that plagued the kingdom
introduced.quote: Tasraque, the wicked dragon, infiltrated the subterranean, crossed the bottom of the sea, and eventually came to roam above the capital.

introduced.name: Immernacht Fischl
introduced.how: A doppelganger of Fischl representing her fear and dark side who claims the Immernachtreich
introduced.quote: Immernacht Fischl: I am your fear, your dark side. I am the nightmare from which you have never escaped in all these years.

introduced.name: Amy
introduced.how: Fischl's real name, used by her parents in memories from her childhood
introduced.quote: Fischl's Father: Amy, come on now, darling. You can't be carrying on like that at this age.

introduced.name: Book of Prophecies
introduced.how: A prophecy text Oz brought to the Immernachtreich that predicts a blessed future
introduced.quote: Immernacht Fischl: As for Oz, despite bringing over that hideous Book of Prophecies, and causing the foolish citizens to fall to their knees worshiping that piece of nonsense...

introduced.name: Soteria
introduced.how: A figure the people pray to in peril, linked to the Prinzessin
introduced.quote: Knowing their peril, the people prayed to The Soteria.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Paimon: C'mon, let's try to contact Venti again.

assumed.name: Tone-Deaf Bard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? That isn't the Tone-Deaf Bard?

threads.claim: An unknown woman cuts off the Traveler's contact with Venti and says they will meet soon.
threads.quote: ???: I know you want to communicate with someone beyond the islands, but you can't do that right now. So I cut off your connection.

threads.claim: The Hymn of the Holy Land is also a book of prophecies that promises a blessed future for the Immernachtreich.
threads.quote: Leon: That prophecy is just as it's described in the book, and predicts a blessed future for the Immernachtreich.

threads.claim: Fischl's parents once indulged her fantasy games, hinting at a childhood past behind her current behavior.
threads.quote: Xinyan: Well, I think it's sweet that Fischl's parents are willing to play along with her.

threads.claim: Fischl's parents later told her to give up fairy tales and dedicate herself to something more meaningful.
threads.quote: Fischl's Mother: You're a big girl now. It's time to forget the fairy tales.

threads.claim: Tasraque may be a symbol of the reality and rejection Fischl refuses to face.
threads.quote: Mona: If that's so... Her arch-nemesis, Tasraque, the wicked dragon, is made up of everything that opposes her and rejects her fantasies.

threads.claim: Immernacht Fischl claims the Immernachtreich is a tomb for those who cannot face reality.
threads.quote: Immernacht Fischl: Listen closely... it is a tomb for those who cannot face reality.

threads.claim: Theater is central to Immernachtreich culture and is seen as a tribute to the Prinzessin.
threads.quote: Leon: I believe it is because Her Highness appreciates true art, and can also sense emotions hidden deep within the souls of humankind.

threads.claim: Oz explains that Immernacht Fischl and Amy are two sides of the same person, Fischl.
threads.quote: Oz: Fischl is you. Both noble and humble, she is a first-rate adventurer with few friends and the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, the Sovereign of the Immernachtreich.

threads.claim: Oz explains that switching sides does not change Fischl's identity, since both selves are Fischl and Oz always follows her.
threads.quote: Oz: As we all know, Oz will always follow Fischl, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung. It should make no difference whose side I am on, because you're both Fischl.

introduced.name: Rana
introduced.how: Rana introduces herself as Arana's best friend, a Nara who wants to travel with her
introduced.quote: My name is Rana. Would you like to be my friend?

introduced.name: Ashvattha Tree
introduced.how: A tree that grows Bija fruit from memories; its presence here is unusual
introduced.quote: An Ashvattha Tree... Strange. The Ashvattha Tree shouldn't be here.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: A fruit that grows from memories and can heal and restore memories
introduced.quote: Bija grows from memories...

introduced.name: Arana's memory sacrifice
introduced.how: Arana gave many memories to the Ashvattha Tree to grow the Bija and help Rana
introduced.quote: Arana gave many memories to the Ashvattha Tree to grow that fruit, to help a friend.

introduced.name: Starshrooms
introduced.how: Starshrooms are the reflections of stars in the sky
introduced.quote: Like how Starshrooms are the reflection of stars in the sky.

introduced.name: Nilotpala Lotus
introduced.how: Seeing the Nilotpala Lotus bloom grants luck until the next moon rises
introduced.quote: Seeing the Nilotpala Lotus bloom will grant you luck until the next moon rises.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Forest beings whose stories were once thought to be children's fairy tales
introduced.quote: I came to think that the stories about Aranara were just fairy tales for children.

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: Rana's home village, protected by Forest Watchers
introduced.quote: I dreamed that I grew up quickly into a reliable Forest Watcher who could protect everyone in Vimara Village.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: A Vision granted by the gods when a wish is recognized, here a Dendro Vision for Rana
introduced.quote: So my wish was recognized by the gods...

assumed.name: The Withering
assumed.quote: I was worried you'd be affected by The Withering.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Oh, and I need to tell Tighnari about my plans to travel.

assumed.name: Iotham
assumed.quote: Iotham, Kavus, and Sudabeh are going to miss you if you leave...

assumed.name: Kavus
assumed.quote: Iotham, Kavus, and Sudabeh are going to miss you if you leave...

assumed.name: Sudabeh
assumed.quote: Iotham, Kavus, and Sudabeh are going to miss you if you leave...

assumed.name: Nara
assumed.quote: You have the Bija, so you must be friends that Arana trusts, and Nara that the Ashvattha Tree recognizes.

threads.claim: The Bija grown from Arana's sacrificed memories heals and wakes Rana, showing memories are the source of its power.
threads.quote: Bija grows from memories...

threads.claim: The Traveler has clues about the unseen villain behind the Withering problem, but no hard evidence yet.
threads.quote: Traveler: I already have some clues about who we're up against.

threads.claim: Rana's forgotten belief suggests Aranara stories were once dismissed as childish fairy tales, questioning whether forest magic is real.
threads.quote: I came to think that the stories about Aranara were just fairy tales for children.

threads.claim: Arana's lost memories leave a void in her heart that can be filled by creating new memories with friends.
threads.quote: But just as Paimon said, we can create our memories together to fill the void in your heart.

threads.claim: Rana's wish is recognized by the gods, granting her a Dendro Vision.
threads.quote: So my wish was recognized by the gods...

threads.claim: A poem Rana heard once hints at a theme of enduring hardship without yielding.
threads.quote: Do not yield to the wind, or the rain. Do not yield to the winter snow, or the summer heat...

threads.claim: Rana expects to meet the Traveler and Paimon again and be stronger by then.
threads.quote: I'm sure we'll meet again someday. And you'll see a stronger me then for sure!

introduced.name: Osse
introduced.how: cat-form ancient Remurian spirit-keeper who explains the symphony books
introduced.quote: Osse: Fascinating, no? These books have all been infused with the mysterious power of the "symphony."

introduced.name: Boethius
introduced.how: self-declared Remurian Harmost of Phobos, a rival who wants Fontaine drowned
introduced.quote: Boethius: "Boethius of Remuria" am I, foremost Harmost of Phobos. You need not introduce yourselves — I have no interest in the titles peddled by primitives.

introduced.name: Cassiodor
introduced.how: an old name of Osse, one of many he has carried
introduced.quote: Paimon: Right! And he called you "Cassiodor" or something, right? But aren't you called Ouran... Oura... something?

introduced.name: Remus
introduced.how: the Sebastos, God King who founded Remuria and was feared as the Dark Lord
introduced.quote: Osse: The Sebastos, Remus, founded a nation above the High Sea that is Fontaine, and the ancestors of the present-day Fontainians named him the "Dark Lord Remus" in their terror.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: ancient nation whose capital sank and lies under these waters
introduced.quote: Osse: Before it sank, this body of water was part of the Great Fontaine Lake and the location where the capital of Remuria was sited.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: grand Symphony melody meant to bring happiness, now being revived
introduced.quote: Osse: At the request of the people, the Sebastos wrote all melodies into the grandest of melodies. This new Symphony would bring us all the greatest of happiness — and its name was "Phobos."

introduced.name: Autoharmonic Reed Pipes
introduced.how: self-playing machines that can only play a few simple chords
introduced.quote: Osse: Ah... Well, as their name implies, they are machines that can play music by themselves.

introduced.name: Blank Score
introduced.how: a blank score that can carry any melody and must be placed in the device to perform
introduced.quote: Osse: If there is nothing there, that means that any melody can be written upon it!

introduced.name: Sybilla
introduced.how: Great Golden Bee prophet who survived the previous cycle and taught the secret of mastering fate
introduced.quote: Osse: In that way, to master the "Symphony" is to master "fate"... This is the secret that the Great Golden Bee Sybilla, the prophet who survived the previous cycle, imparted.

introduced.name: Harmost
introduced.how: superior officers under the Sebastos who alone could alter Phobos's melody
introduced.quote: Osse: Besides the Sebastos himself, only said superiors, the Harmosts, could have changed Phobos's melody.

introduced.name: Fortuna
introduced.how: fate that Remurians sought to escape through the Symphony
introduced.quote: Monsieur Os: His great vision was that we should all grasp the power of the Symphony and thereby escape the shackles of Fortuna, becoming the masters of our own destiny.

introduced.name: Domus Aurea
introduced.how: royal city of Remuria where Boethius awaits the party
introduced.quote: Boethius: I will await you in the royal city of Remuria, in Domus Aurea, where the Sebastos plied his melody.

introduced.name: Meropis
introduced.how: land where the Sebastos first voyaged, guided by Sybilla, depicted in the mural
introduced.quote: Monsieur Os: This piece of music depicts the first legendary voyage of the Sebastos to the land called Meropis, guided by the oracle Sybilla.

introduced.name: Ichor
introduced.how: blood of Remurians, which was used to make their imperishable stone bodies
introduced.quote: Osse: The people of Remuria were not ordinary humans like the Fontainians. Rather, they were a new race, their bodies were cast of stone, with Ichor for blood.

assumed.name: Primordial Sea
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is this because of the Primordial Sea?

assumed.name: Masquerade of the Guilty
assumed.quote: (if the player has completed Masquerade of the Guilty)

assumed.name: Este (Human)
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm. Speaking of which, why isn't Este affected? Is he just, uh, especially gifted?

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's true! We heard about Remuria back in the Fortress of Meropide. Apparently, it was ruled by a god named Remus.

assumed.name: Dark Lord
assumed.quote: Paimon: And what is he exactly? A monster? A ghost? Or... could he be the real Dark Lord?

assumed.name: dream
assumed.quote: Paimon: Seriously? You mean from the dream you had before?

threads.claim: Remuria sank beneath the waves, and its remnants and capital lie in the deep waters.
threads.quote: Osse: And in the end, the entire kingdom sank beneath the waves, as though it had been smote by divine judgment...

threads.claim: Boethius plans to drown Fontaine so that Remuria rises above the sea again.
threads.quote: Boethius: Fontaine's existence is a mistake — one we shall correct. When the oceans swallow it, Remuria shall rise above the sea once again, and its light shall shine over the land!

threads.claim: Boethius claims the return of Phobos is imminent, and the sea's power is surging to bring it about.
threads.quote: Boethius: The power of the sea surges, Cassiodor... The return of Phobos is imminent!

threads.claim: Remus vanished without a trace when Remuria fell, and his fate is unknown.
threads.quote: Monsieur Os: The great waves could not hurt a god, even should their crests scrape the very skies. And yet, the Sebastos disappeared without a trace when our nation fell into the depths...

threads.claim: Boethius's soul is fragmented, and defeating him may require gathering all the fragments into one body.
threads.quote: Monsieur Os: If we are to defeat him... I fear we must await the moment when all his soul fragments have gathered around one body.

threads.claim: Este is unaffected by the chaotic symphony, and Osse knows the reason but withholds it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm. Speaking of which, why isn't Este affected? Is he just, uh, especially gifted?

threads.claim: Osse was separated from the Grand Symphony by the Sebastos and has carried many names and bodies.
threads.quote: Osse: Just as I have traversed many bodies, I have had many names.

threads.claim: Osse is a cat only for now, and his soul and will are not tied to this body.
threads.quote: Osse: I am a cat... "for now." And one's will and soul are more important than one's body, are they not?

threads.claim: The Symphony poured the Sebastos's melodies into Ichor so people could control their fate, and Boethius has turned it to his own ends.
threads.quote: Osse: The Sebastos, who created the "Symphony," poured these melodies into the insoluble Ichor, in hopes that all might control their own fates through playing that music.

threads.claim: Boethius believes history runs in cycles, so the old civilization will resurface and its drama will repeat.
threads.quote: Monsieur Os: It being recorded here means that that fellow believed that the principle of cycles would cause the old civilization to resurface, resulting in the drama playing out over and over again.

threads.claim: Boethius was once a noble Harmost and the sole survivor of the catastrophe, but he turned to a monstrous ritual.
threads.quote: Osse: But back to Boethius... He was not always evil. He was once a noble Harmost of Remuria, and the sole survivor following the great catastrophe that befell.

threads.claim: Fragments of the Sebastos's will and memory remain in the underwater symphony, and Osse hopes they hold answers.
threads.quote: Osse: Long millennia have I searched... and if you could touch some more of these memories, perhaps I may find the answers I have sought all this time...

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: Natlan's Pyro Archon leading the war against the Abyss, who sends for the Traveler
introduced.quote: Mavuika requests the Traveler's presence; believing that their Ancient Name is ready to be forged

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: an engraver who forges Ancient Names and works fast
introduced.quote: Yeah! Xilonen is an amazing engraver! She usually works really fast, but your ancient name is a special case, so I can't say for sure...

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: a Natlan expert on souls and the Lord of the Night who checks the Ancient Name test
introduced.quote: Citlali has Xilonen stop the test and explains that the Traveler's soul was so powerful that it attracted everything nearby

introduced.name: Kachina
introduced.how: a Natlanese friend who invites the Traveler to the feast and leads them to Ayo
introduced.quote: Kachina and Mualani arrive, telling the Traveler that they were extending an invitation to them for a huge feast before the big battle.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: a Natlanese friend who organizes the feast and keeps the group cheerful
introduced.quote: Mualani quickly perks the group back up, knowing that Atea would not want them to be upset and drags Kachina away.

introduced.name: Amina
introduced.how: the People of the Springs chief who handles the party and its supplies
introduced.quote: Amina is worried about the deliveries, as the amount of supplies given were far too much for the party she had originally intended.

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: a saurian hunter who delivers supplies and later investigates the battle dead
introduced.quote: where Kinich arrives with a delivery for Amina.

introduced.name: Atea
introduced.how: a Natlanese leader of the People of the Springs who logistics-ran parties and died after the attack on the tribe
introduced.quote: Mualani: Auntie Atea passed away not long after the attack on our tribe.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: a Stadium doctor and coach who lost her saurian companion in the battle
introduced.quote: As the party kicks off, Iansan remarks about a dream she had about her Saurian companion, who perished during the battle against the Abyss.

introduced.name: Emela
introduced.how: Iansan's Tatankasaur companion who died in the battle
introduced.quote: Iansan: That reminds me of my saurian companion. Her name was Emela.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: a shaman from a dream-reading tribe who offers a ritual to read Capitano's future
introduced.quote: Ororon believes that their case is a natural outlier compared to that provided by the divine throne, and reveals a ritual that could help them learn more about Capitano's future.

introduced.name: Capitano
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger leading soldiers through the wall of light in the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: The First of the Fatui Harbingers doesn't work with just anyone.

introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.how: a Natlan legendary figure and military doctor from five hundred years ago whose soul persists
introduced.quote: Guthred is also a respected figure in our nation. The story of how he sacrificed himself for Natlan is a pretty famous tribal legend.

introduced.name: Thrain
introduced.how: a legendary Natlan hero whom Capitano may be
introduced.quote: He also learned of another name, Thrain, a legendary Natlan hero, though they are not sure if Capitano is actually said hero.

introduced.name: Chuychu
introduced.how: a Natlan figure tied to Chasca who gives the group a qucusaur and iktomisaurus
introduced.quote: Chuychu gives them an iktomisaurus and qucusaur to allow them to reach their destination, and they arrive at a circular arena

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: a peacemaker whose dreams of Chuychu are discussed and who is grieving
introduced.quote: Like Atea, Chuychu had visited Chasca in her dreams and is content with how fast she matured.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: a self-styled Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw, who causes chaos at the feast
introduced.quote: Ajaw: The Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw will not tolerate this stifling hut! We seek a cool place of repose.

introduced.name: Hanwi
introduced.how: a Tepetlisaurus and Ayo's mom who runs off to lead the group
introduced.quote: Continuing further down the path, they encounter a Tepetlisaurus named Hanwi, who Kachina introduces as Ayo's mom.

introduced.name: Ayo
introduced.how: a saurian who is despondent after his grandparents died in the battle
introduced.quote: They soon find Ayo and discover that he's still despondent due to the deaths of his grandparents, not even recognizing Kachina's steak.

introduced.name: Vichama
introduced.how: a hero's soul who died in the battle and was rejected by the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: They approach one soul, discovering it was Vichama.

introduced.name: Gosoythoth
introduced.how: an enemy who transforms into a sword-wielding dragon in the final battle
introduced.quote: Believing they wish for the agony of death, Gosoythoth transforms into a massive, sword-wielding dragon.

introduced.name: Lord of the Night
introduced.how: the ruler of the Night Kingdom who sends seelies to guide the Traveler
introduced.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night, sends several seelies to guide the Traveler to Mavuika.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: a figure who cursed Capitano with immortality and declares her death as payment for her powers
introduced.quote: Ronova states that she has no interest in Teyvat, but as the price for using her powers, declares her death as payment.

introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.how: a device from the Lord of the Night used to forge the Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, yeah! You need the Pilgrim's Chronicle, right? The device the Lord of the Night gave us.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: a name forged for a bearer and tested, the first given to an outlander
introduced.quote: While the Ancient Name forging was simple, Xilonen points out that they need to test it to make sure it works, as it was the first time in Natlan's history that an outlander was given an Ancient Name.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm of souls and memories where mental fortitude outweighs physical strength
introduced.quote: The Night Kingdom is a realm of souls and memories, where mental fortitude outweighs physical strength.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a flame that connects the people's fighting spirit to the battle
introduced.quote: The Sacred Flame will connect us to their fighting spirit.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: a power that brings back casualties regardless of victory or an Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Its great power allowed the Ode of Resurrection to bring back all casualties, independent of the time of victory, or the possession of an Ancient Name.

introduced.name: Divine Throne
introduced.how: a power source Mavuika used to launch a special Night War at the battle's end
introduced.quote: I launched a special kind of Night War by using the power of the divine throne.

introduced.name: Speaker's Chamber
introduced.how: the seat where Mavuika meets with her council and Ancient Name makers
introduced.quote: The Traveler and Paimon head to the Speaker's Chamber, where they find Mavuika alongside Xilonen and Citlali.

introduced.name: Draught of Lucidity
introduced.how: a drug Guthred developed to help people with hallucinations
introduced.quote: He was the one who developed the Draught of Lucidity, a drug that can help people with hallucinations.

introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
introduced.how: a condition that causes hallucinations in people
introduced.quote: So, I've been compiling patient records while helping them overcome the hallucinations.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: a fallen city where a rift connects to the Lord of the Night
introduced.quote: and deduce that the fallen city of Ochkanatlan would be their best bet.

introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.how: a being watching Teyvat through a rift with many eyes
introduced.quote: which Citlali believes is the Ruler of Death keeping an eye on Teyvat.

introduced.name: Five Sinners
introduced.how: a group whose atrocities in Khaenri'ah Capitano and others were blamed for
introduced.quote: as he, like many other Khaenri'ahns, were innocent from the atrocities committed by the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a group that created Guthred as a story, letting him manifest
introduced.quote: Guthred states that he was a story created by the Masters of the Night-Wind, thus allowing him to manifest.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a land where entering means immediate conflict with the Fatui
introduced.quote: She warns the Traveler that setting foot in Snezhnaya will immediately put them in conflict with the Fatui and suggests they prepare for anything.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: the land where the Doctor's stronghold lies, home to a power said to predate the elements
introduced.quote: According to her intel, the Doctor's stronghold is in the land of Nod-Krai near Snezhnaya which is home to a special power which is said to predate the elements

introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
introduced.how: Secret Source Technology relics that appeared as fragments in the sky
introduced.quote: which are Secret Source Technology relics called Ancient Moon's Remnants.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: a Pyro Gnosis that Capitano was assigned to steal
introduced.quote: Capitano had been requesting Tsaritsa to abolish his mission to steal Pyro Gnosis, which was granted

introduced.name: Ayo
introduced.how: a saurian whose family fought the Abyss and whose grandparents died in the battle, leaving him barely sleeping or eating
introduced.quote: Kachina: Yeah. When the Abyss attacked, Ayo's entire family fought to defend our tribe.

introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
introduced.how: a mental disorder from Abyssal contamination that can persist after its power is purified, causing hallucinations and breakdowns
introduced.quote: Paimon: According to The Captain, it's a kind of mental disorder that results from Abyssal contamination, even after its power has been purified.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: the realm of the dead, fully isolated from other nations' Ley Lines and unable to accept foreign souls
introduced.quote: Citlali: Even in its fully functional state, the Night Kingdom can't accept foreign souls. It's completely isolated from the Ley Lines of other nations.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: the connections the soul must link to, which the Night Kingdom and the living rely on and which are damaged by Abyssal power
introduced.quote: Xilonen: Basically, I need to observe whether your soul can connect to the Ley Lines, and make sure there are no signs of rejection.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: a name forged from the river of souls that bears a meaning and is given to a bearer, here 'Tumaini' meaning hope
introduced.quote: Xilonen: "Tumaini"... a name surfaced from the very bottom of the river of souls. It means "hope."

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: a vessel who can perceive souls and travels Natlan trying to return as many as possible
introduced.quote: Citlali: He has a remarkable ability to perceive souls. Even after the failed ceremony, he made it his mission to travel around Natlan and return as many souls as possible.

introduced.name: Lost souls
introduced.how: souls that fail to return to the Ley Lines cannot go back to the Night Kingdom and gradually fade away
introduced.quote: Citlali: Once a soul becomes lost, it can never return to the Night Kingdom. Lost souls can only wander listlessly, gradually fading from existence before disappearing entirely.

introduced.name: Cetan and Hnaska
introduced.how: two saurian souls who are Ayo's grandparents, who refuse to leave him and will fade in days
introduced.quote: Xilonen: That's right, I recognize him, and the two souls next to him should be his grandparents. Kachina told me about what happened.

introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.how: a 'story' figure who was the second-in-command of Khaenri'ah's commander and sacrificed himself 500 years ago fighting the Abyss, remembered as a glorious hero
introduced.quote: Guthred: I was his most trusted second-in-command. Five hundred years ago, we fought against the Abyss together, and I sacrificed myself during battle.

introduced.name: Mallko
introduced.how: a soul who introduces himself and says he helps illuminate the path through the Night Kingdom, having once been rescued with Kachina
introduced.quote: Mallko: We meet again... Remember me? I'm Mallko. We met when you came to rescue Kachina. I could barely hold onto my human form back then.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a tribe whose shamans recorded Guthred's story on a woven scroll and who guide souls
introduced.quote: Guthred: The shamans of the Masters of the Night-Wind recorded my story on a woven scroll. Even now, many in Natlan know my name.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: a tribe whose members were in the battle and who offer blessings, with Vichama as one of them
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait, you're from the Scions of the Canopy! During the battle, your tribe was...!

introduced.name: Iktomisaur
introduced.how: a saurian form the Traveler can indwell to use its Elemental Sight to find a way through
introduced.quote: If you indwell an Iktomisaurus, perhaps you can use their special Elemental Sight to find a way through...

introduced.name: Void Ward
introduced.how: a protective shield of Abyssal power around a monster that can be rapidly dispelled by an attack
introduced.quote: (Guthred casts a attack that rapidly dispels the the Mimiflora's Void Ward)

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: a people who come from afar to offer blessings and whose members invite the Traveler to visit
introduced.quote: Acatl: At the end of the earth lies the primal flame. We have come from afar to offer you our land's blessing and the respect of the Collective of Plenty.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: a clan gathered to make a wish for free and bright skies, with Bona as one of its adventurers
introduced.quote: Mutota: May the skies forever be clear and bright, and may we always be free to spread our wings and soar. For this wish, the Flower-Feather Clan gathers here today.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: a group that offers the Traveler a blessing before the final battle
introduced.quote: Pacal: Your bravery is like an echo through the valley, calling on us to respond in kind. The Children of Echoes offer you our blessing.

introduced.name: Tlazolli
introduced.how: Nechca's mother, who did many bad things in the past but now uses her power for good
introduced.quote: Nechca: You remember Tlazolli, right? She's my mom, and well... She did a lot of bad things.

introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.how: a person who had her real name recovered with the Traveler and Xilonen's help
introduced.quote: Nepecha: Not too long ago, you and Xilonen saved me, and helped me recover my real name.

introduced.name: Hine
introduced.how: Mavuika's sister, an awakened soul from 500 years ago who wrote an architecture manual and sent a paper frog across time
introduced.quote: Hine: Hey, Sis! It's been a long time... This form is probably what I look like in your memories, right?

introduced.name: Coya
introduced.how: a figure with whom Chasca had differences about family and who came to understand Chasca's attachment to human society
introduced.quote: Chasca: We both had to make a difficult choice about family. But, after our adventure together, we finally let go of our differences, and she came to understand my attachment to human society.

introduced.name: Bona
introduced.how: a Flower-Feather Clan adventurer who is accompanied by her companion Coco
introduced.quote: Bona: C'mon, time to teach them a lesson! We're the Flower-Feather Clan's top adventurers! Let's show 'em what we're made of!

introduced.name: Burkina
introduced.how: Kongamato's most trusted partner, who appeared in dreams and asked Kongamato to support the hero of this era
introduced.quote: Kongamato: Recently, I saw him again in my dreams... my most trusted partner, Burkina.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: An angel of the Heavenly Principles who bears witness to deaths and made a deal with Xbalanque
introduced.quote: Hm, cumbersome, but there is nothing to be done — such is the duty of an angel.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: A Khaenri'ah warrior who has carried the souls of the fallen in his heart and seeks his own death to open the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: I have come this far to use my death to open the gates of the Ley Lines to my people.

introduced.name: Gosoythoth
introduced.how: An Abyss-corrupted foe revealed as the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
introduced.quote: Gosoythoth emerges as the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: The one who created Natlan's rules by borrowing power from the Ruler of Death
introduced.quote: Paimon: Right! Xbalanque created the rules of Natlan by borrowing power from the Ruler of Death — that means he's met her before!

introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.how: An elusive Shade whose power is borrowed to make the rules of Natlan and who demands death in return
introduced.quote: According to the Lord of the Night, the Ruler of Death is one of the shining Shades, an extremely elusive figure.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: Cinder City, built on a former Dragon city and known as the first city of the Pyro Archon
introduced.quote: It's very likely. After all, Ochkanatlan was built on the site of a previous Dragon city — it's known as the first city of the Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: A land of souls that could not take in the souls adrift on the surface
introduced.quote: You may wonder why the Night Kingdom, a land of souls, was unable to accept the souls adrift on the surface...

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Angelic powers that created the Ley Lines to protect Teyvat from the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Ley Lines were created by the Heavenly Principles, and it is only with their protection that Teyvat is able to nurture all forms of life.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: A land with a long history not far from Snezhnaya, where the Fatui stronghold is located
introduced.quote: Their stronghold is in Nod-Krai, a land with a long history not far from Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: The Doctor
introduced.how: The leader whose subordinates infiltrated Natlan's borders
introduced.quote: Our investigation revealed them to be subordinates of The Doctor.

introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
introduced.how: Fragments of Secret Source technology from the Ancient Dragon era that appeared in the sky
introduced.quote: relics of Secret Source technology from the era of the Ancient Dragons.

introduced.name: Hine
introduced.how: Mavuika's sister, now remembered only through memory
introduced.quote: Mavuika: To my sister, Hine.

introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.how: A fallen soldier whose soul once possessed Ororon
introduced.quote: When Guthred's soul possessed my body, all I saw was a dark abyss.

introduced.name: Thrain
introduced.how: The Sentinel Knight, an outlander who once fought alongside Natlan's warriors
introduced.quote: When I was little, my father told me about Thrain

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: An outlander homeland whose people were cursed for the Five Sinners' sins
introduced.quote: The people of Khaenri'ah committed grave sins, and for that we were cursed to suffer endless physical torment, cursed to witness the demise of everything we held dear.

introduced.name: Curse of immortality
introduced.how: A curse that gives the Captain endless life and blocks his death
introduced.quote: After all, it's because of her that I bear the curse of immortality, the curse of absolute life.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: Natlan's final Gnosis, which the Captain had been tasked to obtain for the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: After our duel at the Stadium, he asked the Tsaritsa to remove him from the responsibility of obtaining the Gnosis, and his request was granted.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: Spirits that reveal ancient-name mantras to chiefs in dreams
introduced.quote: Usually, the Wayob reveal those mantras to our chiefs in a dream, but yours is still unknown to us.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage
introduced.how: A grand competition that became a chain of war and a source of fear
introduced.quote: The Pilgrimage was an essential part of our struggle against the Abyss — a grand competition full of promise and glory.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: Its effect is mainly moral support, not a literal revival
introduced.quote: The Ode of Resurrection didn't take effect at all.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: An organization in direct conflict with the Traveler's path, whose members infiltrated Natlan
introduced.quote: A direct conflict with the Fatui is unavoidable the moment you step foot in Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Tumaini
introduced.how: legendary ancient name who set themselves aflame to bring light into the universe
introduced.quote: Until someone set themselves aflame.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: the Archon who created a bridge between the life and death sides
introduced.quote: And our Archon, Mavuika, created a bridge between them.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: homeland that has entered a new era of peace after the conflict
introduced.quote: Anyway, the dust has now settled, and Natlan has entered a new era of peace.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: song everyone sang together to send support to the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Everyone gathered at the Stadium and sang the Ode of Resurrection together to send their support to the furthest corner of the Night Kingdom...

introduced.name: life and death war
introduced.how: past conflict where Tumaini fought for life and the Captain fought for death
introduced.quote: fought for "life." The Captain fought for "death."

assumed.name: Toto
assumed.quote: Later, they stop at an area where they first met Toto, though she remarks that he wouldn't be around the area for a while.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Continuing on the path set to them, they wonder if the Night Kingdom would be healed once the Abyss was driven out for good.

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: Mualani: Before the Pilgrimage, we usually hold a huge feast! All you can eat, with meat by the tableful!

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Traveler: (That means the Ley Lines are in an even worse state than the last time I was here.)

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: You're thinking of the Dendro Archon, right?

assumed.name: Star Outlander
assumed.quote: Mualani: That's our Star Outlander's popularity for you!

assumed.name: Despair Engulfs the Heavens
assumed.quote: (If Toto was found during Despair Engulfs the Heavens)

assumed.name: Tumors during the invasion
assumed.quote: Mavuika tells them they needed to split up — much like the tumors during the invasion, the enemy had a core of similar functionality.

assumed.name: Vichama
assumed.quote: Paimon: V—Vichama!? Is that you!?

assumed.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, yeah! Abyssal power kept surging out! If Chasca hadn't destroyed the stone, Vichama would have been consumed by the Abyss.

assumed.name: Lord of the Night
assumed.quote: Citlali: Your connection to the Ley Lines looks good... I can sense the Lord of the Night.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Xilonen: Once all traces of Abyssal power are removed from the Night Kingdom, the Pyro Archon will restore the Ley Lines — that's the final step of her plan.

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh yeah, you said The Captain had a bunch of these kinds of souls with him.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Traveler: Mavuika...

assumed.name: Abyss Tumors
assumed.quote: Mavuika: I'm sure you remember the "Abyss Tumors" from the previous battle.

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Vichama: Back then, I missed my chance at the Night Warden Wars.

assumed.name: Wailing Cacophony
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Wailing Cacophony)

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: Oh, it's because of Ayo. *sigh* Still no change, huh... Poor thing.

assumed.name: Chuychu
assumed.quote: Chuychu: Hey, ! It's me! Chuychu!

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Chasca: War is a heavy burden. And still, we never stopped moving forward.

assumed.name: The battle against the Abyss
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, right... You said Ayo's grandparents died in the battle.

assumed.name: Chuychu
assumed.quote: Chasca: ...Heh, good one, Chuychu.

assumed.name: Atea and Vichama
assumed.quote: I saw Atea, Vichama, Chuychu, and all six heroes from five hundred years ago...

assumed.name: Lord of the Night
assumed.quote: Xilonen: The Lord of the Night was right to place her trust in you. She chose the perfect name.

assumed.name: Source Mechanism
assumed.quote: Could it be where we found the Source Mechanism?

assumed.name: Dain
assumed.quote: No wonder Dain's method of slowing the decay of his body...

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: From this point on, there will be no more Night Warden Wars

assumed.name: Ode of Resurrection
assumed.quote: I pray the Ode of Resurrection will never again need to bring back the fallen.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Pacal, Xilonen, and the other Children of Echoes around her look to Kachina in surprise.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Under guidance, Kachina performed exceptionally well in the Pilgrimage, and earned her chance at the Night Warden Wars...

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: Under guidance, Kachina performed exceptionally well in the Pilgrimage, and earned her chance at the Night Warden Wars...

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Under guidance, Kachina performed exceptionally well in the Pilgrimage, and earned her chance at the Night Warden Wars...

assumed.name: Gosoythoth
assumed.quote: Suddenly, the sky turned dark, the Sacred Flame went out, and Gosoythoth appeared...

assumed.name: Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: Suddenly, the sky turned dark, the Sacred Flame went out, and Gosoythoth appeared...

assumed.name: Night Kingdom
assumed.quote: Everyone gathered at the Stadium and sang the Ode of Resurrection together to send their support to the furthest corner of the Night Kingdom...

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: fought for "life." The Captain fought for "death."

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: So, no one wants to be the Pyro Archon anymore?

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom may only heal once the Abyss is fully driven out.
threads.quote: Continuing on the path set to them, they wonder if the Night Kingdom would be healed once the Abyss was driven out for good.

threads.claim: A wall of light in the Night Kingdom freezes those who pass and holds souls in torment.
threads.quote: They soon find a wall of light, before finding several figures trying to get through it.

threads.claim: Capitano promises to deliver his soldiers to a destined place.
threads.quote: One day, I will deliver you to the place I promised.

threads.claim: Guthred's soul has persisted for hundreds of years and is present within Capitano.
threads.quote: He also realizes that Guthred's soul had persisted for hundreds of years, something which would not normally be possible, and sensed an amalgamation of souls in Capitano's body.

threads.claim: Guthred claims he is a story created by the Masters of the Night-Wind.
threads.quote: Guthred states that he was a story created by the Masters of the Night-Wind, thus allowing him to manifest.

threads.claim: Capitano's true intentions remain unclear and may hinge on Guthred's soul.
threads.quote: It's still too early to tell, but the continued existence of Guthred's soul is likely the key to figuring out The Captain's true intentions.

threads.claim: Capitano fuses his life force with the Lord of the Night, ending his mission in a sacrifice.
threads.quote: Thus, Capitano takes Xbalanque's seat and fuses his life force with the Lord of the Night, preventing her from dying.

threads.claim: The divine throne's power lets the dead reappear in dreams.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Even after the battle, that effect still lingers. That's why those you lost were able to reappear in your dreams.

threads.claim: Mavuika is still slated to die despite the victory.
threads.quote: She explains that despite their act, Mavuika is still slated to die.

threads.claim: Ronova cursed Capitano with immortality that creates a paradox.
threads.quote: Due to the immortality granted to him by her, it would create a paradox that not even she could resolve.

threads.claim: Many Khaenri'ahns were innocent of the Five Sinners' atrocities.
threads.quote: as he, like many other Khaenri'ahns, were innocent from the atrocities committed by the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ahns may be present in the Night Kingdom, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: Citlali is surprised that Khaenri'ahns would be in the Night Kingdom, but decide to look into that later.

threads.claim: Souls that cannot return to the Ley Lines are simply forgotten.
threads.quote: Not all of the souls would return to the Ley Lines and would simply be forgotten, so the group decides to save as many as they can.

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death may be watching Teyvat through a rift.
threads.quote: which Citlali believes is the Ruler of Death keeping an eye on Teyvat.

threads.claim: The Doctor's stronghold in Nod-Krai holds research of extraordinary ambition.
threads.quote: whatever he's planning with all this research must be extraordinarily ambitious.

threads.claim: Fragments in the sky are Secret Source relics that the Doctor's subordinates are investigating.
threads.quote: which are Secret Source Technology relics called Ancient Moon's Remnants.

threads.claim: Capitano's mission to steal Pyro Gnosis was abolished, but another Harbinger may still try.
threads.quote: Capitano had been requesting Tsaritsa to abolish his mission to steal Pyro Gnosis, which was granted

threads.claim: Lost souls who cannot return to the Night Kingdom ask whether their identity still matters, deepening the question of what becomes of the dead.
threads.quote: Poloa: Does it even matter... who I am...?

threads.claim: Vichama was rejected by the Night Kingdom, raising the question of whether the dead can return there.
threads.quote: Vichama: But the Night Kingdom rejected me.

threads.claim: Citlali's ritual restores Vichama's access to the Night Kingdom, answering the rejection.
threads.quote: Citlali: Phew... Looks like this method worked on you.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon's fate appears to point toward death, leaving her survival an open question.
threads.quote: Citlali: And, the Pyro Archon's fate... is pointing toward "death."

threads.claim: Khaenri'ahn souls appear drawn to the Night Kingdom, which should be impossible, suggesting something strange is happening around The Captain.
threads.quote: Citlali: In theory, that means Khaenri'ahn souls shouldn't be drawn to the presence of the Night Kingdom. Something strange is going on...

threads.claim: The Traveler has a dream about The Captain surrounded by lost souls, hinting at The Captain's aims for the dead.
threads.quote: Traveler: That reminds me of the dream I had about The Captain...

threads.claim: Guthred's fragmented memories reveal he was obsessive and cruel, unlike the glorious hero the story remembers.
threads.quote: Guthred: It was in fragmented memories of my life that I finally began to understand the real "me."

threads.claim: An outlander has never received an Ancient Name, so its effect on the Traveler is unprecedented and uncertain.
threads.quote: Citlali: An outlander has never received an Ancient Name before. I wouldn't be surprised if something equally unprecedented happens when you connect to it...

threads.claim: Ayo's insomnia is explained: he sensed his grandparents' presence, and they are reunited with him.
threads.quote: Xilonen: It all makes sense now. Ayo could barely sleep or eat because he sensed the presence of his grandparents.

threads.claim: Zumalli's soul has been corrupted by the Abyss from within, so returning him would make things worse.
threads.quote: Xilonen: The Abyss has corrupted his soul from the inside. Even if we could send him back to the Night Kingdom, it would only make the situation worse.

threads.claim: The final enemy has a core similar to Abyss Tumors, hidden somewhere in the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Our final enemy has a core that possesses similar qualities. It's hidden somewhere in the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: Mavuika's sister Hine reappears as an awakened soul, and the paper frog shows love can transcend time.
threads.quote: Mavuika: You sent your love across time. So, let me say this, Hine — I will love you forever and always.

threads.claim: Ayo's condition may be a delayed effect of Abyssal power, leaving open whether he was contaminated.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's hard to say for sure. Still, Abyssal power was everywhere during the battle. Maybe it affected him indirectly...

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death is an elusive Shade, and very few records of her exist.
threads.quote: Even woven scrolls dating back thousands of years have nearly no mentions of her.

threads.claim: The Captain turns his curse into a challenge against the Ruler of Death's rules.
threads.quote: Forsake one of your rules — the choice is yours.

threads.claim: Mavuika's fate of death has not changed even though the Abyss is defeated.
threads.quote: It's about Mavuika's death — her fate hasn't changed at all.

threads.claim: Mavuika chooses to sacrifice her life in the Sacred Flame to sustain the Lord of the Night.
threads.quote: Yes, my plan is to once again place my life within the Sacred Flame.

threads.claim: The Traveler heard the voices of many souls of the dead during the Ley Lines journey.
threads.quote: In the Ley Lines, I encountered many souls of the dead, and I could hear everyone rooting for me from above.

threads.claim: The Captain carried the souls of fallen comrades within him for five hundred years.
threads.quote: The lives of my comrades, as well as many Natlanese, have been stored here ever since.

threads.claim: The curse of immortality keeps the Captain in place even after his death.
threads.quote: The curse of immortality still exists. Does that mean... The Captain will never move from this place?

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night gains eternal life by fusing her existence with the Captain's.
threads.quote: But, now, I have the chance to live forever.

threads.claim: Mavuika plans to fully restore the Night Kingdom to defend Natlan against the Abyss.
threads.quote: Only by completely restoring the Night Kingdom can we defend against its corrosion in the long run.

threads.claim: After the Night Kingdom is restored, Natlanese people can leave their borders and explore Teyvat.
threads.quote: With the restoration of the Night Kingdom, our people are now free to leave our borders, and many have set their sights on the wonders of Teyvat.

threads.claim: The Abyss's power still exists in worlds beyond Teyvat.
threads.quote: We've eradicated the Abyss from Natlan, but its power remains in worlds beyond Teyvat, tremendous and unyielding.

threads.claim: Fatui subordinates of The Doctor infiltrated Natlan, and their stronghold is in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Our investigation revealed them to be subordinates of The Doctor.

threads.claim: The fragment in the sky is a relic of Secret Source technology from the Ancient Dragon era.
threads.quote: relics of Secret Source technology from the era of the Ancient Dragons.

threads.claim: Most Khaenri'ah people were innocent of the Five Sinners' exploitation of Abyssal power.
threads.quote: But, most of us were innocent. Most of us knew nothing of the Five Sinners' exploitation of Abyssal power... myself included.

threads.claim: Ronova's deal with Xbalanque is concluded through Mavuika's sacrifice.
threads.quote: Thus concludes the deal I made with Xbalanque several thousand years ago.

threads.claim: Mavuika wants the Pilgrimage to shift from war to competition.
threads.quote: Because, I want the Pilgrimage to change.

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night gave the Traveler the words of their ancient name's mantra.
threads.quote: The Lord of the Night gave those words to me.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa is unlikely to accept the situation with the final Gnosis.
threads.quote: But, since this is the final Gnosis, I doubt the Tsaritsa will let the situation stand.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles' modifications to the Ley Lines explain why the Night Kingdom could not accept the souls.
threads.quote: The reason lies in the Heavenly Principles' modifications to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: Gosoythoth's appearance darkened the sky and extinguished the Sacred Flame, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Suddenly, the sky turned dark, the Sacred Flame went out, and Gosoythoth appeared...

threads.claim: The legend says light came into the universe only after someone set themselves aflame.
threads.quote: "In the beginning, there was darkness."

threads.claim: The war between life and death, with Tumaini fighting for life and the Captain for death, is the story's central conflict.
threads.quote: fought for "life." The Captain fought for "death."

threads.claim: Mavuika resolved the war between life and death by creating a bridge between the two sides.
threads.quote: And our Archon, Mavuika, created a bridge between them.

threads.claim: The conflict has ended and Natlan has entered a new era of peace.
threads.quote: Anyway, the dust has now settled, and Natlan has entered a new era of peace.

introduced.name: Atefeh
introduced.how: A traveling merchant from Sumeru introduces herself and wants to become the potion shop's regular supplier
introduced.quote: The name's Atefeh. I'm a traveling merchant from Sumeru. Great to meet you!

introduced.name: Lord Sangemah Bay
introduced.how: Dori is a famous Sumeru merchant, one of Atefeh's idols, and a friend of the Traveler
introduced.quote: Wow! Lord Sangemah Bay is one of my biggest idols. Her business sense and dedication to making Mora has always been one of by greatest inspirations!

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: A region where famous merchants work and where Atefeh is from
introduced.quote: I'm a traveling merchant from Sumeru.

introduced.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
introduced.how: A magnificent palace in Sumeru that Atefeh has visited
introduced.quote: I was even lucky enough to visit the Palace of Alcazarzaray once. It truly is a magnificent sight.

introduced.name: Potion sales deal
introduced.how: Atefeh proposes that the potion shop supply her regularly so she can sell its potions across Teyvat
introduced.quote: The idea's actually pretty simple. You produce the potions, provide me with a regular supply, and I'll help you sell them across Teyvat!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Huh, Paimon's not sure they're from Mondstadt though.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Well, well, well. Your business sure is booming, cuties.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: That's how you make the big Mora.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: news of our humble shop has already spread to all four corners of Teyvat!

threads.claim: Dori is known as a Mora-obsessed merchant, and her reputation for chasing Mora is admired by other merchants.
threads.quote: Paimon can't help but be reminded of a certain other Mora-obsessed merchant...

threads.claim: The general public knows little about alchemical potions, so their market demand is uncertain.
threads.quote: Although the general public still doesn't know much about alchemical potions right now

threads.claim: News of the potion shop is spreading through merchant networks, opening it to wider sales across Teyvat.
threads.quote: news of the potion shop has been spreading to the merchant community

introduced.name: Descenders
introduced.how: Paimon guesses Descenders are people who travel to Teyvat from another world
introduced.quote: does that just mean people like you, who come traveling to Teyvat from someplace else?

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: a Inazuman smelting center that was already central to the industry over 400 years ago
introduced.quote: Even back then, Tatarasuna was already at the center of Inazuma's smelting industry.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: a realm ruled by the Almighty Shogun
introduced.quote: Inazuma is the realm of the Almighty Shogun.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a vast information network intertwined with all of Teyvat
introduced.quote: Irminsul is closely intertwined with the entirety of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
introduced.how: a swordsmith who forged a fine blade and later killed his servant Katsuragi
introduced.quote: Mikoshi Nagamasa had created a fine blade but then threw it into the fire and slew Katsuragi for reasons unknown.

introduced.name: Katsuragi
introduced.how: Nagamasa's loyal servant who was killed by Nagamasa
introduced.quote: and killed his servant, Katsuragi.

introduced.name: Niwa Hisahide
introduced.how: Tatarasuna's armory officer, a distant relative of the Kaedehara Clan
introduced.quote: Full name Niwa Hisahide.

introduced.name: Miyazaki Kaneo
introduced.how: Niwa's second-in-command who handled forging and personnel
introduced.quote: Full name Miyazaki Kaneo. He was Niwa's second-in-command.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Clan
introduced.how: the last practitioners of Isshin Art, now in decline
introduced.quote: So basically, this Niwa was a distant relative of the Kaedehara Clan

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: a swordsmithing tradition upheld by the Niwa Clan and other great clans
introduced.quote: Born to the Niwa Clan, which served as one of the three pillars of the Isshin Art

introduced.name: Kabukimono
introduced.how: an Inazuman word for an eccentric stranger
introduced.quote: This seems to be an Inazuman word for an eccentric stranger

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun
introduced.how: also known as the Electro Archon, who originally passed blade-forging arts to Inazuma
introduced.quote: originally handed down from the Electro Archon, also known as the Raiden Shogun.

introduced.name: Crystal Marrow
introduced.how: a material used to forge Inazuman blades, the reason Tatarasuna was built
introduced.quote: As for Tatarasuna, it was originally established as a means of safely disposing Crystal Marrow.

introduced.name: Escher
introduced.how: a Tatarasuna consultant who is revealed to be Dottore
introduced.quote: Escher is then revealed to be Dottore

introduced.name: Pierro
introduced.how: a royal mage in the Khaenri'ah court who lived with the Traveler's sibling
introduced.quote: who served as a royal mage in the Khaenri'ah court.

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa slays Katsuragi
introduced.how: Nagamasa burned his blade and killed Katsuragi for unknown reasons
introduced.quote: Mikoshi Nagamasa had created a fine blade but then threw it into the fire and slew Katsuragi for reasons unknown.

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: Escher reveals his true identity as a Fatui Harbinger who goes by The Doctor
introduced.quote: I am a Fatui Harbinger. Call me

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: The Doctor's true affiliation is revealed as the Fatui
introduced.quote: ...The... Fatui? Who... What do you want...?

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: Historic forging and smelting operation that was state-of-the-art in its day
introduced.quote: Tatarasuna was home to a state-of-the-art forging and smelting operation in that day

introduced.name: Niwa
introduced.how: Armory Officer overseeing Tatarasuna's furnace, with family ties to the Kaedehara Clan
introduced.quote: overseeing it was the Armory Officer. His surname was Niwa, though he had family ties to the Kaedehara Clan.

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
introduced.how: Adopted son of a youkai killed by the Shogun, seeking to restore his family's honor
introduced.quote: Nagamasa is the adopted son of Mikoshi Torachiyo, the youkai struck down by the Shogun's own hand.

introduced.name: Raiden Gokaden
introduced.how: Five sword-forging clans that were once taught by the Shogun and later declined
introduced.quote: comprised of five branches: Amenoma, Futsu, Isshin, Hyakume, and Senju.

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: One of the forging traditions of the Raiden Gokaden, now carried by Kaedehara Kazuha
introduced.quote: and took up the mantle of the Isshin Art.

introduced.name: Descenders
introduced.how: Beings who come from beyond this world and are not counted as part of Teyvat
introduced.quote: Anyone who comes from beyond this world is not counted as part of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: Keeps records of the world, but holds none on the Descenders
introduced.quote: Irminsul does not keep records on the Descenders.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Was the first destination of the Descenders when they arrived in this world
introduced.quote: Apparently, Khaenri'ah was first destination when arrived in this world.

introduced.name: The Jester
introduced.how: A former royal mage of Khaenri'ah who lived with the Descenders and is now a Fatui Harbinger
introduced.quote: He was a royal mage in Khaenri'ah, and lived with your for a time.

introduced.name: kabukimono
introduced.how: Inazuman term for eccentric people who dress flamboyantly
introduced.quote: Inazuman for those eccentric types, who always go around dressed to the nines.

introduced.name: Katsuragi
introduced.how: Took the kabukimono in and raised him among the people of Tatarasuna
introduced.quote: Katsuragi took the kabukimono to live with the people of Tatarasuna.

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Fontaine technologist researching Tatarasuna's furnace
introduced.quote: My name's Xavier.

introduced.name: Tatarasuna furnace malfunction
introduced.how: A catastrophic furnace failure four hundred years ago in Tatarasuna
introduced.quote: Four hundred years ago, so I'm told, there was a catastrophic malfunction in Tatarasuna's furnace.

introduced.name: Niwa and swordsmith's sacrifice
introduced.how: Niwa and a swordsmith leapt into the furnace together, stabilizing it and dying in the process
introduced.quote: Knowing that they had just one chance to save countless lives, Mr. Niwa and the swordsmith leaped together into the furnace.

introduced.name: Raiden Gokaden massacre
introduced.how: A vengeful bladesmith murdered Gokaden smiths about a hundred years ago
introduced.quote: The Raiden Gokaden were the targets of a murderous rampage by a vengeful bladesmith.

introduced.name: Niwa's heart device
introduced.how: A device into which The Doctor placed Niwa's heart, used to absorb the furnace's filth
introduced.quote: After the events you just saw in that memory, The Doctor put Niwa's heart into the device and handed it to The Balladeer.

introduced.name: Nahida memory reading
introduced.how: Nahida can read memories from a person's mind by touching them
introduced.quote: I read this memory in his mind.

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: a former smithing center in Inazuma, once a major pillar of its forging industry
introduced.quote: The Tatarasuna area has always been a major pillar of Inazuma's smithing industry.

introduced.name: Niwa Hisahide
introduced.how: Armory Officer of Tatarasuna and heir of the Isshin Art, who vanished after the incident
introduced.quote: Full name Niwa Hisahide. He was the inheritor of the Isshin Art, and successor to the Niwa Clan.

introduced.name: Miyazaki Kaneo
introduced.how: Vice Armory Officer, Niwa's second-in-command, a forger and friend of Nagamasa
introduced.quote: Full name Miyazaki Kaneo. He was Niwa's second-in-command.

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
introduced.how: Inspector of Tatarasuna and Mikoshi Clan successor who later killed his subordinate Katsuragi
introduced.quote: The successor of the Mikoshi Clan, adopted son to oni warrior Mikoshi Chiyo, and the younger adopted brother to Mikoshi Michihiro

introduced.name: Katsuragi
introduced.how: loyal subordinate of Nagamasa, saved by him in youth, and later killed by him
introduced.quote: Katsuragi's full name and background remain unknown.

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: a forging-related art passed down through the Niwa Clan and other clans
introduced.quote: Full name Niwa Hisahide. He was the inheritor of the Isshin Art, and successor to the Niwa Clan.

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun
introduced.how: the Electro Archon, from whom Inazuma's blade-forging techniques were said to descend
introduced.quote: According to the data, the blade-forging techniques of Inazuma were originally handed down from the Electro Archon, also known as the Raiden Shogun.

introduced.name: Daitatara Nagamasa
introduced.how: a single nagamaki forged at Tatarasuna, famous enough that it was drawn and later used in a killing
introduced.quote: ...We at last made a single nagamaki. We call it the 'Daitatara Nagamasa'...

introduced.name: The Balladeer
introduced.how: a puppet who tried to become a god with The Doctor's help and then erased himself from Irminsul
introduced.quote: The Balladeer tried to achieve godhood with The Doctor's help. He was unsuccessful, but retained the power to connect with Irminsul.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a record that defines the world, so changes to it reshape Teyvat
introduced.quote: Nahida: Changing the information in Irminsul changes Teyvat.

introduced.name: Tatarasuna incident
introduced.how: Niwa's murder by The Doctor in disguise, followed by the Balladeer's disappearance
introduced.quote: During the Tatarasuna incident, Niwa was murdered by The Doctor, disguised as a mechanic. The Balladeer, then known as the kabukimono, disappeared not long after.

introduced.name: Katsuragi's death
introduced.how: Nagamasa killed Katsuragi at his insistence to end the Tatarasuna incident
introduced.quote: In the original version of events, Katsuragi was ultimately killed by Nagamasa.

introduced.name: Shakkei Pavilion
introduced.how: the place where the Electro Archon placed the Balladeer after his creation
introduced.quote: Wanderer, this is the Shakkei Pavilion. In your Balladeer incarnation, this is where the Electro Archon placed you after your creation.

introduced.name: The Doctor
introduced.how: the scientist behind the Balladeer's experiments and the Tatarasuna murder
introduced.quote: Traveler: He's The Doctor. He's behind all of this.

introduced.name: The Jester
introduced.how: a figure who waits for the Balladeer and urges him to join a rebellion
introduced.quote: The Jester: The long-fated rebellion has begun.

introduced.name: Signora
introduced.how: a sharp-tongued ally in the Balladeer's plan who calls herself a spark in a chaotic nation
introduced.quote: Signora: Hah. What do you have to gain from belittling your subordinates?

introduced.name: Azar
introduced.how: an Akademiya researcher who explains the process of binding the subject to the machine
introduced.quote: Azar: The biological transformation is a lengthy process.

introduced.name: Aqaba
introduced.how: a researcher writing an essay on Tatarasuna's history
introduced.quote: Aqaba: (I'd better make some notes and then get working on my essay.)

introduced.name: Sawada
introduced.how: a writer working on a novel about Tatarasuna, who shares his draft
introduced.quote: Sawada: I presume you'll want to read mine as well? Here.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: a record store where information is kept and can be searched, and the Wanderer dove into its information torrents
introduced.quote: After I dove into the information torrents in Irminsul, why did you go to Inazuma?

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
introduced.how: a figure who died of old age and was chosen as the narrator of Sawada's novel epilogue
introduced.quote: I heard that Mikoshi Nagamasa died at a ripe old age.

introduced.name: Sawada
introduced.how: a writer working on a novel and researching with Aqaba
introduced.quote: I've got it! I can end my novel with some words from Mikoshi Nagamasa.

introduced.name: Aqaba
introduced.how: a scholar writing an essay who researches together with Sawada
introduced.quote: I feel like you've enlightened me. I can finally finish my essay! Hahaha!

introduced.name: Raiden Gokaden
introduced.how: a group whose descendants still live in Inazuma and whose downfall the Traveler caused
introduced.quote: There are still some descendants of the Raiden Gokaden living in Inazuma.

introduced.name: An Appellative Stroke
introduced.how: an item from the Interlude quest that lets the player rename the Wanderer
introduced.quote: You can obtain the item "An Appellative Stroke" from the Archon Quest Interlude: Inversion of Genesis, which will allow you to change "Eons Adrift" Wanderer (Anemo)'s name.

introduced.name: Wanderer's old aliases
introduced.how: the Wanderer previously went by several other aliases besides The Balladeer
introduced.quote: (Any of the Wanderer's old aliases, e.g., "Scaramouche," "Kunikuzushi," "Kabukimono," "Balladeer")

introduced.name: Balladeer erasure plan
introduced.how: the Wanderer's failed goal of total annihilation, aiming to remove The Balladeer from existence and change fate
introduced.quote: What you were looking for is complete annihilation... But this is just a fantasy.

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: After all, we kicked his butt and got him locked up.

assumed.name: Harbingers and Fatui
assumed.quote: Plus, he's a former Harbinger with knowledge of many of the Fatui's sensitive secrets.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: considering you even struck a deal with The Doctor.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: As I told you once before, there's information about your twin in Irminsul.

assumed.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
assumed.quote: As they make their way to the Sanctuary of Surasthana

assumed.name: Shouki no Kami
assumed.quote: the Shouki no Kami emerges to attack

assumed.name: Scaramouche
assumed.quote: A barrier forms around Scaramouche, Paimon, and the Traveler

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Did you get all that, Lesser Lord Kusanali?

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: and he's the same Kazuha I know.

assumed.name: Kamisato Clan
assumed.quote: when he came to the Kaedehara and Kamisato Clans

assumed.name: The Shogun
assumed.quote: He hated the Almighty Shogun for her apparent indifference toward his father's death

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: But that was because I know about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata...

assumed.name: Amenoma Tougo
assumed.quote: Ah, it's been a while.

assumed.name: Amenoma Smithy
assumed.quote: We've made it to Amenoma Smithy!

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: This is the Yashiro Commission's headquarters, so...

assumed.name: Ayato
assumed.quote: Ayato is still the Yashiro Commissioner, Ayaka is still the lady of the house

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Whenever the Commissioner dines at home, Thoma always joins him.

assumed.name: Hirotatsu
assumed.quote: Hirotatsu: , it's been a while.

assumed.name: Furuta
assumed.quote: Miss Kamisato has told me about you.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Paimon: Nahida, we're here.

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: (I hesitated because I witnessed Greater Lord Rukkhadevata erase her own existence, but I can't tell Nahida that.)

assumed.name: Descenders
assumed.quote: The Balladeer agreed to help me look for information about the Descenders, and although he was unsuccessful, he still helped you.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Khaenri'ah was where your twin first came into this world.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: We still don't know how the change to Irminsul will affect the senior ranks of the Fatui, but in all likelihood, they won't even remember their own Harbinger.

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: You and Childe never fail to find ways to complicate things.

assumed.name: Scaramouche
assumed.quote: I suggest you speak to me in a more respectful tone, Scaramouche.

assumed.name: Delusion Factory
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ugh, Paimon knows this place... It's the Delusion Factory in Inazuma!

assumed.name: Crystal Marrow
assumed.quote: Katsuragi: This place is huge... I can't believe the landslide didn't fill it in. I wonder who built it? The Crystal Marrow miners?

assumed.name: Vision

assumed.name: Naphis
assumed.quote: Considering that Amurta's sage, Naphis, refused to join this project, I'll take part in the experiment in his place.

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: Welcome back, , Paimon, Balladeer.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: I'm not planning on returning to the Fatui, and they wouldn't take me back anyway.

assumed.name: The Doctor
