assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: It's like you said, Lesser Lord Kusanali.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: I don't plan to leave Sumeru for the time being.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Unfortunately, the fate of Teyvat cannot easily be changed.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Including the beginning of your twin's journey recorded in Irminsul.

assumed.name: Katsuragikiri Nagamasa
assumed.quote: I guess the sword that entered Mikoshi Nagamasa's memory in his final moments was called Daitatara Nagamasa instead of Katsuragikiri Nagamasa because he still had fond memories of it.

assumed.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
assumed.quote: Talk to Nahida again after returning to the Sanctuary of Surasthana

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: they might not even remember who the sixth is.

threads.claim: The Tatarasuna incident and the missing kabukimono remain an open mystery that scholars cannot fully explain.
threads.quote: My teacher chose this area of research as a personal challenge.

threads.claim: Tatarasuna was confirmed to have been sabotaged.
threads.quote: Well, they guessed right about one thing: Tatarasuna was sabotaged.

threads.claim: The kabukimono was not a human but a puppet.
threads.quote: According to information acquired by Aqaba's teacher, the kabukimono was not a human

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the kabukimono is The Balladeer, which raises the question of what he was doing 400 years ago.
threads.quote: The kabukimono has to be The Balladeer, but... what was he doing 400 years ago in Tatarasuna?

threads.claim: Escher, a Tatarasuna consultant, is revealed to be Dottore, who plans to corrupt Scaramouche through the furnace.
threads.quote: Escher is then revealed to be Dottore

threads.claim: The Tatarasuna furnace is causing worker deaths and black smoke, possibly tied to the new forging technique.
threads.quote: Worker fatigue and casualties are up, and continuing to rise at an alarming rate.

threads.claim: Nahida frees The Balladeer under a deal to search Irminsul, though his motives remain uncertain.
threads.quote: It was my idea to set The Balladeer free. We made a deal, and he's gonna do some investigation in Irminsul for me.

threads.claim: Scaramouche erases himself from time by entering the Irminsul heart, leaving Nahida and the Traveler unable to find him.
threads.quote: heads into the Irminsul heart to erase himself from time

threads.claim: Information about the Traveler's twin may be hidden in Irminsul, and Nahida wants to find it.
threads.quote: As I told you once before, there's information about your twin in Irminsul.

threads.claim: Pierro lived with the Traveler's sibling in Khaenri'ah, linking Pierro to the sibling's past.
threads.quote: they had lived with Pierro for a time

threads.claim: A strange voice hints that the fate of Teyvat is hard to change, suggesting an unseen force at work.
threads.quote: Suddenly, a strange voice tells both the Traveler and Paimon that the fate of Teyvat could not be easily changed

threads.claim: The mechanic Escher is revealed to be Dottore, the Fatui Harbinger behind the Tatarasuna incident.
threads.quote: (Escher's disguise is removed)

threads.claim: Escher says his scheme is a carefully controlled experiment, hinting at a larger plan.
threads.quote: This is all part of a carefully controlled experiment.

threads.claim: Nahida reveals that the whole Tatarasuna affair was a horrific experiment by The Doctor, with The Balladeer as its main test subject.
threads.quote: It was all a horrific experiment planned by The Doctor

threads.claim: The Balladeer believes Niwa betrayed him, a belief that frames his resentment.
threads.quote: He thought Niwa had completely betrayed him, and yet this very betrayal had ensured his survival.

threads.claim: The memory shows Niwa never betrayed the Balladeer and never meant for him to carry the device into the furnace.
threads.quote: But this memory shows that Niwa didn't betray you. He never meant for you to be the one to take the device into the furnace.

threads.claim: Dottore's words imply the puppet lacks a heart and might one day become human.
threads.quote: You're not a puppet. You're a human... you're just missing a heart.

threads.claim: The Balladeer's heart was taken from an innocent man, deepening the question of what a true heart means.
threads.quote: A heart acquired through cold-blooded murder is a cursed thing, but it had protected him from the filth...

threads.claim: An evil force is raging inside the Tatarasuna furnace, a threat that remains unexplained.
threads.quote: I'm here because an evil force is raging inside the furnace

threads.claim: The Balladeer asks whether it is possible to change the past in this world, a question with unknown stakes.
threads.quote: In this world, is it possible... to change the past?

threads.claim: The Balladeer declares that the names Balladeer and kabukimono will cease to exist, hinting at self-erasure.
threads.quote: From this day forth, the names

threads.claim: Paimon no longer remembers The Balladeer, suggesting he has erased himself from history.
threads.quote: Paimon doesn't remember The Balladeer!? That must mean... he actually pulled it off?

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether The Balladeer truly erased himself from history, with unknown consequences.
threads.quote: Did The Balladeer really manage to erase himself from history completely?

threads.claim: The heavens responded to a summoning that brought the Descenders to this world, an origin still unexplained.
threads.quote: Plus, only came to this world because the heavens responded to the summoning.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah was the Descenders' first destination, linking their arrival to that nation.
threads.quote: Apparently, Khaenri'ah was first destination when arrived in this world.

threads.claim: Irminsul has no records of the Descenders, which Nahida takes as confirmation that they are outside Teyvat.
threads.quote: Irminsul does not keep records on the Descenders.

threads.claim: The Raiden Gokaden's history has been changed, with another attacker responsible for the swordsmiths' fall.
threads.quote: The legend of the Raiden Gokaden has changed. Someone else attacked the swordsmiths...

threads.claim: The Raiden Gokaden's decline is explained as a revenge massacre by a vengeful bladesmith descended from Niwa's family.
threads.quote: The Raiden Gokaden were the targets of a murderous rampage by a vengeful bladesmith.

threads.claim: The Traveler knows about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, a secret Paimon does not remember, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: But that was because I know about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata...

threads.claim: The Balladeer has a deal with the Traveler and expects a return favor.
threads.quote: I'll keep my end of the deal.

threads.claim: The Balladeer tried to erase his own names, and the Traveler doubts he could fully erase himself.
threads.quote: Traveler: (The Balladeer said he'd erase two of his names. If he really succeeded, it must have taken all of his might... But still...)

threads.claim: Nahida explains that the Balladeer erased himself from Irminsul to change the past.
threads.quote: Nahida: So this puppet known as The Balladeer erased himself from Irminsul... hoping that he could change the past.

threads.claim: Edits to Irminsul change what the world records and remembers, and only the Traveler keeps the erased memories.
threads.quote: Nahida: Changing the information in Irminsul changes Teyvat.

threads.claim: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata said no one can erase themselves from existence, which the Traveler connects to the Balladeer's fate.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Yes, that was it! Greater Lord Rukkhadevata — she said that no one can erase themselves from existence, not even her.)

threads.claim: Nahida wrote a fairy tale that hides a record that Irminsul cannot alter.
threads.quote: Nahida: I authored this record myself.

threads.claim: The fairy tale is revealed to be the Balladeer's own memories, backed up by Nahida.
threads.quote: Nahida: I remember now. This is not just The Balladeer's story... it is his very own memories.

threads.claim: The Balladeer was experimented on repeatedly while The Doctor tried to make him a god.
threads.quote: The Balladeer tried to achieve godhood with The Doctor's help. He was unsuccessful, but retained the power to connect with Irminsul.

threads.claim: The first Tatarasuna incident is vague, and Aqaba suspects a hidden history behind it.
threads.quote: Two incidents have occurred here, and the details behind the first are vague at best.

threads.claim: Nahida confirms that Niwa was murdered by The Doctor during the Tatarasuna incident.
threads.quote: During the Tatarasuna incident, Niwa was murdered by The Doctor, disguised as a mechanic. The Balladeer, then known as the kabukimono, disappeared not long after.

threads.claim: The Wanderer, as a puppet, believed he was missing a heart and drifted without settling.
threads.quote: Nahida: You drifted from place to place, never able to settle, even where you found status and identity. You adamantly believed that you were missing a heart.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders what the Balladeer wanted to fight against and why he chose to erase himself.
threads.quote: Traveler: (What exactly did he want to fight back against? The betrayals in his life? Or did he wish he'd never existed at all?)

threads.claim: Nahida suggests that giving someone the truth lets them choose their own destiny.
threads.quote: Nahida: When you give someone the truth, you give them a chance to choose their own destiny.

threads.claim: The Jester suggests a long-fated rebellion is underway and invites the Balladeer to join.
threads.quote: The Jester: The long-fated rebellion has begun.

threads.claim: The Balladeer confirmed that Khaenri'ah is where the Traveler's twin first came into the world.
threads.quote: Nahida: Before he vanished, he confirmed an important detail: that Khaenri'ah was where your twin first came into this world.

threads.claim: The Wanderer regains his memories and the dream serves its purpose, though the Balladeer is gone.
threads.quote: Nahida: The memory recovery seems to have been a success. This dream has served its purpose.

threads.claim: The Wanderer's attempt to remove The Balladeer from existence and change the world is shown to have failed.
threads.quote: Even if The Balladeer is removed from existence, the world will not heed your will.

threads.claim: A vase broken during The Balladeer's time still lies broken, which suggests his erasure of the past may be incomplete.
threads.quote: (But The Balladeer erased his existence. He changed the world... So why is this vase still broken?)

threads.claim: A voice says fate is hard to change, though human hearts can change history.
threads.quote: History does not change easily, but human hearts can.

threads.claim: An unidentified voice that knows about the recent events appears to the Traveler and Paimon for the first time, urging them to trust only what they see.
threads.quote: Believe your own eyes. Only that which you see is true. What is unseen is but an illusion.

threads.claim: Nahida plans to keep searching Irminsul for further secrets about the past.
threads.quote: in the future, I'll continue to search Irminsul more deeply, and see what secrets can be uncovered.

threads.claim: What happened before and after the beginning of the Traveler's twin's journey is unknown and remains an open question.
threads.quote: What exactly happened before and after that point? I want to know as well.

threads.claim: The Traveler admits responsibility for the Raiden Gokaden's downfall, and their descendants may learn the truth.
threads.quote: I was the one responsible for the Raiden Gokaden's downfall.

threads.claim: The Doctor's manipulation of the Wanderer is revealed, leading the Wanderer to drop the name tied to him.
threads.quote: After learning about everything The Doctor did, there's no way I can carry on using a name connected to him.

threads.claim: Nahida argues that relationships cannot be balanced like a ledger, and that emotion exists because some losses can never be restored.
threads.quote: Some things in this world can never be brought back, and they can never be changed, which is why there is emotion in the human world.

threads.claim: The Wanderer agrees to follow Nahida and help from behind the scenes, though the path will change only gradually.
threads.quote: Then I guess I'll be helping you from behind the scenes from now on.

threads.claim: Sawada suggests the sword was called Daitatara Nagamasa rather than Katsuragikiri Nagamasa because Mikoshi Nagamasa held fond memories of it.
threads.quote: I guess the sword that entered Mikoshi Nagamasa's memory in his final moments was called Daitatara Nagamasa instead of Katsuragikiri Nagamasa because he still had fond memories of it.

introduced.name: Koolau
introduced.how: the tribe's top-ranked guide, and the only other guide besides the first chief to reach the mysterious island
introduced.quote: Mualani: Oh, he's currently ranked as the number one guide in the People of the Springs.

introduced.name: Viramdra
introduced.how: a scholar from Sumeru who wants to reach the mysterious island for research
introduced.quote: Viramdra: Scholar guy? My name is Viramdra. Please use it!

introduced.name: Karya
introduced.how: Viramdra's companion who asks to join the journey as a traveler
introduced.quote: Karya: Excuse me... Miss Guide. Since we've been referred to you, would it be okay for us to join your journey?

introduced.name: Nuu
introduced.how: Mualani's teacher and the tribe's best guide, who has never reached the island
introduced.quote: Mualani: I learned all my skills as a guide from Uncle Nuu, and he's the best guide in the whole tribe.

introduced.name: Yelafath
introduced.how: a shopkeeper who sells camping tents and equipment
introduced.quote: Yelafath: We've been over this before... the name's Yelafath.

introduced.name: Pakaa Nui
introduced.how: a record shop owner who keeps rare records
introduced.quote: Pakaa Nui: Mualani? Have you finally decided to release a record of your own?

introduced.name: Sprayfeather Gill
introduced.how: a plant whose fragrance resembles a Koholasaur's scent, so its extract can mask travelers
introduced.quote: Mualani: But this plant can help us solve that problem, because its fragrance is very similar to the scent of a Koholasaur.

introduced.name: Spiritway
introduced.how: a path through the sky that the dragons' devices control, originally a natural flow of Phlogiston
introduced.quote: My research indicates that the Spiritway was originally a natural phenomenon caused by the flow of Phlogiston.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Node
introduced.how: a device that must be manually operated to switch the path of a Spiritway
introduced.quote: Mualani: See, look at this... After activating a normal Spiritdoor, we could just go ahead and use it. But this one requires someone to stay and keep operating it here.

introduced.name: mysterious island
introduced.how: the island from the legend, which only those who entrust their lives to each other can reach together
introduced.quote: Viramdra: Yes, I know. According to the legend, only those who are willing to entrust their lives to one another will be able to reach the island together.

introduced.name: first chief
introduced.how: the first chief of the People of the Springs, who returned from the mysterious island and founded the tribe's home
introduced.quote: Mualani: Well, no. It's not a clue at all. He was the first chief of the People of the Springs who came back from the mysterious island and set up this place. It's a monument.

introduced.name: first chief's treasure map
introduced.how: a map left by the first chief, full of symbols, which guides must decipher to find the route
introduced.quote: Mualani: Besides the legend left by the first chief, there's also a map. Well, not just a regular map, it's more like a treasure map...

introduced.name: Nuu's talisman
introduced.how: a talisman Nuu gives Mualani that must be returned when she comes back from the island
introduced.quote: Nuu: It's a talisman. Take good care of it. You must return it to me when you get back from the mysterious island.

introduced.name: night song
introduced.how: a song played at night that tradition says keeps travelers safe
introduced.quote: Mualani: Well, I asked a friend from the Masters of the Night-Wind for some advice once, and apparently, playing this song at night is an effective way to keep travelers safe and sound.

introduced.name: Viramdra
introduced.how: introduces himself as an Akademiya scholar who specializes in ores and minerals
introduced.quote: I'm a scholar from the Akademiya's Spantamad Darshan. I specialize in ores and minerals.

introduced.name: Spantamad
introduced.how: the Akademiya research group Viramdra belongs to
introduced.quote: I'm a scholar from the Akademiya's Spantamad Darshan. I specialize in ores and minerals.

introduced.name: Vulcanite
introduced.how: a rare ore that forms when lava cools quickly and creates the golden glow of the legend
introduced.quote: What it was actually referring to was an extremely rare mineral known as Vulcanite.

introduced.name: Spinel Fruit
introduced.how: a plant that often grows near lava and matches the talisman's fruit
introduced.quote: This is Spinel Fruit, which often grows around places with lava.

introduced.name: First Chief
introduced.how: the founder of the tribe's guiding tradition who left the statue message and the map
introduced.quote: You may have heard legends describing me

introduced.name: The Legend of the Mysterious Island
introduced.how: the legendary island is actually the tribe's present home, not a remote treasure island
introduced.quote: In that case, the mysterious island from the legend is actually where the People of the Springs are living now!

introduced.name: Golden glow warning
introduced.how: the golden glow of Vulcanite also signals an upcoming lava eruption
introduced.quote: The golden glow is an indicator of when the lava will periodically erupt

introduced.name: Statue paint
introduced.how: the statue's paint changes color with volcanic dust, revealing hidden inscriptions only to those who visited the underground space
introduced.quote: There's a special paint on the statue that would change color when it comes into contact with volcanic dust.

introduced.name: Guide ethics
introduced.how: a guide's greatest duty is safely bringing the client to the destination, not treasure hunting
introduced.quote: The greatest responsibility of a guide is to take the client to their destination safely.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's been a while since we last got in touch with Mualani. Wonder what she's up to now...

assumed.name: People of the Springs
assumed.quote: Paimon: After all we've been through recently, it sure feels good to come back to visit the People of the Springs!

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Traveler: She can take us on a tour of Natlan.

assumed.name: Spinel Fruit
assumed.quote: Mualani: Was this made with Spinel Fruit? Hmm, for some reason, this doesn't look like a regular Spinel Fruit to me...

assumed.name: Karya
assumed.quote: Miss Guide, it seems Viramdra has also discovered something...

assumed.name: Koolau
assumed.quote: Paimon remembers that Koolau said that he went to the mysterious island alone, but there's no way he could've been able to use the Spiritways!

assumed.name: Koholasaur
assumed.quote: Where did all these Koholasaurs come from!?

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: The Phlogiston Nodes were recharged by dawn.

assumed.name: Spiritway
assumed.quote: I see... then the Spiritways were affecting lava deep underground.

assumed.name: Nuu
assumed.quote: Uncle Nuu, we're back!

assumed.name: People of the Springs
assumed.quote: Our journey is not yet over. As we agreed, please come back to the People of the Springs with me.

threads.claim: The legend says only people willing to entrust their lives to one another can reach the mysterious island together.
threads.quote: Viramdra: Yes, I know. According to the legend, only those who are willing to entrust their lives to one another will be able to reach the island together.

threads.claim: The first chief returned from the island, gave up his yearning for adventure, and settled down, which founded the tribe.
threads.quote: Mualani: But oddly enough, after returning from the mysterious island, he laid aside his yearning for adventure and chose to settle down. That's how the tribe was founded.

threads.claim: The first chief was reputed to be the first person to befriend the Koholasaurs and map Natlan.
threads.quote: Mualani: It's said that he was the first person to make a map of Natlan, and even the first person to become friends with the Koholasaurs.

threads.claim: Koolau claims to have reached the island and uses his ore as proof, while Nuu has never reached it.
threads.quote: Koolau: The rare ores I brought back are proof that I've been to the island. But as for Nuu? Where's his proof?

threads.claim: Koolau and Nuu's guiding philosophies are in open conflict, and Mualani wants to prove Nuu right.
threads.quote: Mualani: I always felt that my teacher is no less skilled than Koolau, but Uncle Nuu has never been to the island, so Koolau always uses that to push us down.

threads.claim: The first chief's map has several copies passed down the generations, and its symbols must be deciphered to find the route.
threads.quote: Mualani: The chief made several copies of the map, and distributed them to the first members of the tribe.

threads.claim: Nuu's talisman is unusually effective and is tied to the promise that it will be returned after the island journey.
threads.quote: Nuu: Right, which is precisely why it's so effective.

threads.claim: Wild Koholasaurs gather periodically in a valley and disperse when the season changes, and the map marks a herd as a clue.
threads.quote: Mualani: It's almost like how our tribe gathers together for festivals. Still, as soon as the season changes, the herd quickly disperses again.

threads.claim: Mualani believes the path to the island lies inside a massive whirlpool, but Viramdra argues it is dangerous and this is unproven.
threads.quote: Mualani: ...The info I deciphered from the map points to only one possibility... To reach the mysterious island, we must enter that massive whirlpool.

threads.claim: The characters give conflicting answers about the meaning of a journey, from companionship and home to results.
threads.quote: Mualani: So, for the first question... what's the purpose of a journey?

threads.claim: Mualani believes the tribe's ancestral knowledge is preserved in customs, which may hide the purpose of the island journey.
threads.quote: Mualani: My parents told me that most of the valuable experience from our ancestors is hidden in various customs. It's always better to trust our traditions.

threads.claim: Viramdra believes the golden light marks the legendary mysterious island, which the team has not yet confirmed.
threads.quote: Do you see that golden light in the distance? I'm positive that's the mysterious island! That's where we should go next!

threads.claim: The legendary mysterious island turns out to be the tribe's own home, and the journey was a rite of passage.
threads.quote: In that case, the mysterious island from the legend is actually where the People of the Springs are living now!

threads.claim: The First Chief sought results at first but found that his real treasure was his companions and survival.
threads.quote: To me, this is the real mysterious island

threads.claim: The golden glow of the ore is a sign of an impending lava eruption that can destroy any ore taken.
threads.quote: But it was also a warning sign of an impending eruption

threads.claim: Vulcanite appears only at the start of violent lava activity and is swallowed by the lava, so it cannot be recovered.
threads.quote: The principle of Vulcanite formation implies that it will only appear at the start of fierce lava activity

threads.claim: Hidden words appear on the statue after touching it, and their cause is unexplained.
threads.quote: Here, look! Some hidden words appeared on the statue after I touched it.

threads.claim: The inscriptions appear only to people contaminated by volcanic dust from the underground space, due to special paint.
threads.quote: There's a special paint on the statue that would change color when it comes into contact with volcanic dust.

threads.claim: Mualani wonders whether Uncle Nuu once visited the mysterious island, given the matching Spinel Fruit.
threads.quote: Yes, in which case, could Uncle Nuu have been here before?

threads.claim: Nuu confirms he had visited the mysterious island before and chose to keep it secret.
threads.quote: Yes, I have.

threads.claim: Koolau claims to have reached the mysterious island, but Nuu suggests he never completed the trip.
threads.quote: But have you noticed that Koolau, who claims to have been to the island, hasn't actually completed the trip?

threads.claim: Some guides lose their true purpose through greed, becoming thieves like Koolau rather than protectors.
threads.quote: Many guides gradually lose sight of their true beliefs and intentions in the process, and end up becoming like Koolau.

threads.claim: Viramdra's earlier research was stolen, which drives his desperate pursuit of the ore.
threads.quote: After my previous findings were stolen, I began a new area of research

introduced.name: Corridor of Nothingness
introduced.how: space between the Atrium of Suchness and the Hall of Emptiness, powered by the temple
introduced.quote: Istoria: The space separating the Atrium of Suchness at its highest from the Hall of Emptiness is called the Corridor of Nothingness...

introduced.name: Watchers
introduced.how: beings who uphold the temple's rule of departure; originally meant the awakened
introduced.quote: Istoria: The Corridor's power comes from the temple itself. It is the rule of departure, while the Watchers exist to uphold that rule.

introduced.name: Dex
introduced.how: an immature Watcher that can draw power from the spatial rift
introduced.quote: Istoria: Dex is only an immature Watcher, and lacks the authority to control it.

introduced.name: Hilda
introduced.how: Zeitlind's sister who gave up her memories to form the Path to the Heavens
introduced.quote: Istoria: The one who gave up every last memory... was your sister, Lind.

introduced.name: Melanta
introduced.how: a tyrant of the temple who cast souls down by his judgments
introduced.quote: Istoria: She heard of Melanta's increasingly unreasonable tyranny, saw the many souls who had been cast down by his judgments.

introduced.name: Nihilita
introduced.how: a fallen Watcher called a traitor by Melanta who sent Zeitlind's sister up
introduced.quote: Melanta: Nihilita... The traitor, the Fallen One!

introduced.name: Asmoday
introduced.how: the creator whose departure freed all creations
introduced.quote: After being defeated by the Traveler in battle, Melanta finally understands why Nihilita left: all creations were free the moment Asmoday left.

introduced.name: Child of Humanity
introduced.how: those descended from the first ancestor shaped by the lord of all, a divine order category
introduced.quote: Melanta: All who descend from the first ancestor shaped by the lord of all, and those born of that lineage, are called children of humanity.

introduced.name: Path to the Heavens
introduced.how: a stairway made from Hilda's memories, severed by Melanta
introduced.quote: Istoria: No one knows what Melanta said to Hilda. But afterward, in a fit of rage, he severed the Path to the Heavens that had been formed from your sister's memories.

introduced.name: Memory sacrifice
introduced.how: ascending the Path to the Heavens requires giving up one's memories
introduced.quote: Paimon: Then... doesn't that mean someone has to give up all their memories again to get us up there?

introduced.name: Primordial human myth
introduced.how: a heretical parable of light and darkness contending within the primordial human
introduced.quote: Istoria: It tells of the god of light who created a body in its own likeness, only for it to be stolen away by the king of darkness.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: magical spirits who draw power from people's memories
introduced.quote: Paimon: The Aranara do exist! And they draw power from people's memories.

introduced.name: Windrest Peak
introduced.how: site of a past battle against the Abyss where knights fell and the sanatorium's curse story began
introduced.quote: Melanta: ...Once, the Abyss brought disaster to this land. The knights stationed here fought to the last and did not retreat.

introduced.name: Karasawa Eichi
introduced.how: an author of novels Zeitlind has read
introduced.quote: Zeitlind: And here I recall a passage I once read in a novel by Karasawa Eichi:

assumed.name: Memory Core
assumed.quote: Upon returning to the Memory Core, Istoria reveals that Hilda had also once been sent to the temple and, upon witnessing the suffering caused by Melanta, chose to confront him herself.

assumed.name: Temple of Space
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, you said this before, didn't you? With the god of the Temple of Space gone, the Path to the Heavens won't vanish after it's been used once.

assumed.name: Maukie
assumed.quote: He admits that his actions, including exiling "Maukie" and severing the Path to the Heavens, have triggered his self-destruction.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Traveler: About my sibling...

assumed.name: Hello, Thank You, and the Final Goodbye quests
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed "Hello," "Thank You," and the Final "Goodbye")

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling was taken by a god, and Melanta cannot explain why.
threads.quote: Melanta: I cannot answer, because I do not comprehend it myself.

threads.claim: The Traveler stands outside the order of children of humanity, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: Melanta: But you... You stand outside this order.

threads.claim: Hilda left the temple and her whereabouts are unknown, with Zeitlind believing she is still alive.
threads.quote: Zeitlind: It's not a farewell. She must still be alive.

threads.claim: Paimon claims Hilda is traveling the world, a claim the story does not confirm.
threads.quote: Paimon: And your sister's been traveling the world lately, just to clear her head.

threads.claim: Awakening as a Watcher defies the Creator's will and is condemned as a fall from grace.
threads.quote: Istoria: A Watcher who closes their eye can only be swallowed by darkness. Yet awakening itself defies the Creator's will — and is thus condemned as a fall from grace.

threads.claim: Dex may belong to the same species as Melanta and could travel between places like him.
threads.quote: Paimon: Isn't it the same species as that baddie?

threads.claim: Aranara draw their power from people's memories.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Aranara do exist! And they draw power from people's memories.

threads.claim: The primordial human myth of light and darkness is only partly known, and Istoria cannot recall more.
threads.quote: Istoria: It tells of the god of light who created a body in its own likeness, only for it to be stolen away by the king of darkness.

threads.claim: Zeitlind volunteers to give up her memories to restore the Path to the Heavens, repeating her sister's sacrifice.
threads.quote: Zeitlind: Let me do it.

threads.claim: Part of the severed Path to the Heavens may remain and could combine with Zeitlind's memories.
threads.quote: Istoria: The stairway to the heavens manifested from your sister's memories was severed, but part of it should still remain.

threads.claim: A person is a story in motion that does not end when life does.
threads.quote: Istoria: A person is a story in motion. It shouldn't end just because life does.

threads.claim: Melanta understands that Nihilita left because all creations are free once the divine departs.
threads.quote: Melanta: When the divine departs the throne, all creations are free.

threads.claim: The sanatorium curse was not real; the stories concern warriors who fell in battle at Windrest Peak.
threads.quote: Zeitlind: I see. So, there never was a curse — only warriors who fell in battle and slumber on

introduced.name: Eremites

introduced.name: King Deshret

assumed.quote: (Alhaitham's Vision flashes and the Dendro Monument is activated)

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Agreeing to any kind of deal with the Dendro Archon's people is already a huge compromise on my part.

assumed.name: Akasha System
assumed.quote: You might be distrustful of the Akasha, but there's no reason for you to doubt King Deshret's technology.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: And then, someone from the Fatui showed up.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: The withering of Irminsul has been getting worse recently.

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: It will be The Balladeer.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: That's everything we've experienced so far in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
assumed.quote: the Akademiya has abandoned her in the Sanctuary of Surasthana like a lost cause...

assumed.name: Canned Knowledge
assumed.quote: they, um, wanted to extract Canned Knowledge...

threads.claim: Rumors claim King Deshret will soon return to the world.
threads.quote: Sharkan: Have you heard? The mighty King Deshret, the sovereign of our faith, will soon return to this world!

threads.claim: The missing Village Keepers may have been taken as a sacrifice, and their fate is unknown.
threads.quote: they must have been chosen as the final sacrifice for King Deshret's resurrection!

threads.claim: A cloaked man claiming to be King Deshret's envoy is behind the abductions.
threads.quote: Zaki: He, um, that guy, he wears a cloak, and he's always careful to cover his face... Uh, he calls himself King Deshret's envoy.

threads.claim: The Akademiya may have spread the resurrection rumor to get the Village Keepers back.
threads.quote: King Deshret's resurrection is just the Akademiya's misinformation campaign.

threads.claim: Alhaitham is a mole the sages have been monitoring since his conviction.
threads.quote: Cyno wonders how the Akademiya is aware of their plans before Alhaitham tells him that he's the mole, much to his anger.

threads.claim: The Akasha uploads people's activities and can predict them.
threads.quote: Alhaitham found a book detailing his activities and movements which were uploaded to the Akasha on Jnagarbha Day.

threads.claim: Dehya says the Wall keeps desert folk out of Sumeru, not just sandstorms.
threads.quote: It serves a more important purpose — keeping out people like us.

threads.claim: Desert folk hate the Dendro Archon and see King Deshret as superior.
threads.quote: Paimon: The people here really like King Deshret, but dislike the Dendro Archon...

threads.claim: The sages harvest Canned Knowledge from mad scholars for their new god.
threads.quote: harvesting Divine Canned Knowledge from the mad scholars being part of the process to create their new god.

threads.claim: The sages confirm they were trying to create a new god.
threads.quote: The Traveler asks them if the sages were planning to create a new god, which they confirm, much to the group's surprise.

threads.claim: King Deshret sacrificed himself and Rukkhadevata shrank into a child to save the people.
threads.quote: King Deshret chose to sacrifice himself to prevent the knowledge from returning, while Rukkhadevata reverted to a small child.

threads.claim: Shani asks whether King Deshret's resurrection could truly improve Sumeru, raising doubt about it.
threads.quote: Shani: Do you think the resurrection of King Deshret can truly change Sumeru for the better?

threads.claim: The resurrection rumor is revealed to be a false story the Akademiya spread to manipulate the Radicals.
threads.quote: First, the Akademiya spread a false rumor of King Deshret's resurrection

threads.claim: A hidden basement beneath the hospital is found, where the crying seems to originate.
threads.quote: As I thought. There's a hidden structure.

threads.claim: The contents of the Divine Knowledge Capsule remain undeciphered and the process harms its subjects.
threads.quote: I've spent quite some time trying to analyze the contents of the Divine Knowledge Capsule, but to no avail.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's ultimate goal in seeking forbidden divine knowledge is still unknown.
threads.quote: The Akademiya is going out of their way to look for forbidden knowledge, but what is their ultimate goal?

threads.claim: Mad scholars made contact with a divine consciousness in the forest, and the Akademiya is after it.
threads.quote: That's what the Akademiya is after.

threads.claim: The Akademiya has been tracking Cyno's movements through the Akasha for longer than he realized.
threads.quote: The Akademiya has been watching you longer than you think.

threads.claim: The Village Keepers vanished without explanation, leaving Shani too afraid to speak about it.
threads.quote: The Village Keepers who had helped me disappeared with no explanation, and I didn't dare breathe a word about it to anyone

threads.claim: The scholars shift from scholars to missing persons, which makes them easy to use as a resource.
threads.quote: An exile is still patently a living, breathing human being, but when someone becomes a missing person... that is brought into question.

threads.claim: Razak shows the same symptoms as the Eremite who went mad at Port Ormos, pointing to a shared cause.
threads.quote: The symptoms are identical.

threads.claim: The Akademiya is revealed as the instigator, using the Radicals and the missing scholars for its own goals.
threads.quote: Correct. The Akademiya is behind all of this.

threads.claim: Alhaitham admits he acts on personal interest rather than heroism or sympathy for strangers.
threads.quote: Simply put, I don't blindly place my faith into strength or heroism. I do what I want.

threads.claim: Dehya offers her right arm to vouch for her friends and secure the hostages' release.
threads.quote: In that case, I'm willing to vouch for their honesty with my right arm.

threads.claim: Rahman's faction believes Greater Lord Rukkhadevata was a traitor who betrayed King Deshret.
threads.quote: It was all Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's doing!

threads.claim: Rukkhadevata came to King Deshret's rescue and exhausted her power erasing forbidden knowledge, so she was no traitor.
threads.quote: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata came to the rescue of King Deshret and his people

threads.claim: The sages are suspected of trying to create a new god rather than revere the existing ones.
threads.quote: The sages are trying to create a new god, aren't they?

threads.claim: The Akademiya is building a god of its own that will belong to the Akademiya and the people of Sumeru.
threads.quote: They are creating a new god... a god that will belong to them, and to the people of Sumeru.

threads.claim: The sages' new god will not be Rukkhadevata but a figure called The Balladeer.
threads.quote: It will be The Balladeer.

threads.claim: The Akademiya abandoned Lesser Lord Kusanali as a weak god and people forgot she existed.
threads.quote: Slowly but surely, people began to forget about her existence.

threads.claim: Forbidden knowledge from outside this world caused the ruin of King Deshret's civilization.
threads.quote: It was knowledge that did not belong to this world

threads.claim: Dottore of the Fatui brought a Gnosis to the Akademiya and pushed the sages toward creating a god.
threads.quote: The Doctor was previously expelled from the Akademiya.

threads.claim: King Deshret chose to sacrifice himself to end the forbidden knowledge plague.
threads.quote: Chose to sacrifice himself

threads.claim: The Akasha System's reliability and the Akademiya's use of it are open to doubt.
threads.quote: You might be distrustful of the Akasha, but there's no reason for you to doubt King Deshret's technology.

threads.claim: Irminsul is withering, and Sumeru's scholarly progress has stalled since Rukkhadevata's death.
threads.quote: The withering of Irminsul has been getting worse recently.

threads.claim: Rahman has changed sides and now allies with the Traveler's group against the sages.
threads.quote: From here on out, we're allies.

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: a holy blade that cleaves spirit and will, unlike a normal sword that cleaves flesh
introduced.quote: A normal sword can cleave flesh, but the Holy Blade can cleave spirit and will.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Institute
introduced.how: a former assembly hall where children studied together
introduced.quote: This was the assembly hall of the Narzissenkreuz Institute.

introduced.name: Narcissus
introduced.how: a dragon and the evil antagonist of the picture-book tale
introduced.quote: Well, that's the dragon Narcissus. So evil is he that the peace-loving people tremble at the sound of his name — not that he cares about their feelings, though.

introduced.name: Lyris
introduced.how: a beautiful, kind princess who is the main character of the picture book
introduced.quote: A long, long time ago, in a place far, far away, there was once a beautiful and kind Princess named Lyris... and yup, she's our main character!

introduced.name: Basil Elton
introduced.how: a former naval commander who takes up a duty at the institute
introduced.quote: The duty will be taken up by Basil Elton, former naval commander.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team
introduced.how: young heroes who used the wooden sword to defeat all foes in their tales
introduced.quote: When the young heroes from the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team would pick this sword up, they would become able to defeat all foes in their tale.

introduced.name: The Real Annapausis
introduced.how: the true form of the place, revealed by the picture book's illustration
introduced.quote: This is the real "Annapausis."

assumed.name: Ys
assumed.quote: Sometimes, it is the lost Ancient City of Ys. Sometimes, Arcadia. At times, it is even golden Hyperborea.

assumed.name: Arcadia
assumed.quote: Sometimes, it is the lost Ancient City of Ys. Sometimes, Arcadia. At times, it is even golden Hyperborea.

assumed.name: Hyperborea
assumed.quote: Sometimes, it is the lost Ancient City of Ys. Sometimes, Arcadia. At times, it is even golden Hyperborea.

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: listen to tales of the Hydro Archon... and to tales older still.

assumed.name: Fontemer
assumed.quote: Whoa, there's creatures from the Fontemer here! Is this the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom's zoo?

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: What makes you think there'd be secret underground bookstore ruins anywhere in Fontaine?

assumed.name: Karl Ingold
assumed.quote: Linking up with Ingold, Guillotin, and the rest of the old gang will go some way towards solving the dispersion problem.

assumed.name: Emanuel Guillotin
assumed.quote: Linking up with Ingold, Guillotin, and the rest of the old gang will go some way towards solving the dispersion problem.

assumed.name: Sponsian
assumed.quote: I can only hope that they aren't treating my dear old Sponsian too poorly, or let it rust in the harbor...

assumed.name: Al
assumed.quote: Al, Petit Chou, and the others...

assumed.name: Petit Chou
assumed.quote: Al, Petit Chou, and the others...

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: "Ad astra abyssosque," as Katheryne always says!

threads.claim: The adventure seems to repeat in connected loops, and Paimon senses déjà vu.
threads.quote: Wait a minute. Is it just that Paimon hasn't fully woken up yet, or is it déjà vu? Haven't these things already happened before?

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests an unseen force wants the adventure to never end.
threads.quote: "Someone" wants this tale of adventure to never end.

threads.claim: Lyris's treasure reportedly stagnated the tower so that even Narcissus could not enter it.
threads.quote: Didn't you say that when Princess Lyris gave you her treasure, the tower stagnated, and even Narcissus could not enter?

threads.claim: The group was teleported away from the tower, so the Princess may not be where they expected.
threads.quote: We teleported to a different place from the tower.

threads.claim: Ann feels she has been here before and recalls a past she cannot explain.
threads.quote: Also, this place feels very strange. I don't understand. I should never have been here before, but I find myself... recalling, feeling many things.

threads.claim: Ann says the Holy Blade is needed for the adventure team's story to reach its end.
threads.quote: If the story of our adventure team is to reach its end, we will need the blade.

threads.claim: The Traveler finds the sword's power does not come from the blade itself, which is only a wooden toy.
threads.quote: ...Comes not from this blade.

threads.claim: Ann is cast as the villain in Narcissus's version of the story.
threads.quote: 'So, in Narcissus's story, I'm the evil villain?'

threads.claim: Ann's only remaining purpose is one wish to save the Princess, and she will do anything to fulfill it.
threads.quote: Apart from saving the Princess... apart from that one wish, I have nothing at all. I'll do anything to fulfill it!

threads.claim: The illustration reveals a true version of Annapausis that differs from the surroundings the group sees.
threads.quote: This is the real "Annapausis."

threads.claim: A diary mentions an unresolved dispersion problem that old colleagues were meant to help solve.
threads.quote: Linking up with Ingold, Guillotin, and the rest of the old gang will go some way towards solving the dispersion problem.

introduced.name: Kongamato
introduced.how: the Mountain King, a tribal hero whose Abyssal contamination is irreversible
introduced.quote: The Mountain King is a unique case when it comes to Abyssal contamination.

introduced.name: Turnfire Night
introduced.how: a ritual where a flame bearer burns away the Mountain King's Abyssal energy with the sacred flame
introduced.quote: It's quite simple — you just need to use the sacred flame.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: the flame used in the ceremony to burn away Abyssal energy
introduced.quote: Time to light the sacred flame and burn away the filth for a legendary five-hundred-year-old warrior.

introduced.name: Beastly Rift
introduced.how: a hidden Abyssal space full of monsters, of many sizes, that can be cleared and claimed
introduced.quote: Apparently, they're known as "beastly rifts," and there are many of them of all different sizes.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: Enjou's organization, whose lowly clerks are not part of the inner circle
introduced.quote: Kinich reveals that he was aware that the Traveler wished to learn about the Abyss Order, though he had not expected them to know each other.

introduced.name: Sanka
introduced.how: an alias of Enjou, a scholar who tricked Huni and Toba into telling him stories
introduced.quote: Paimon: Sanka! Aha, so YOU'RE glasses guy! You tricked Huni and Toba into telling you a bunch of stories!

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: an ancient Saurian relic bound to Kinich by a contract
introduced.quote: It's true that he's a relic from an earlier Saurian age, but since we're bound to each other by a contract, you can see him as my companion for now.

introduced.name: Nanna
introduced.how: a Saurian companion of a tribe family who recently lost her life
introduced.quote: One of our elders' Saurian companions even lost her life not long ago.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: the tribe, whose male members take pride in moving forward
introduced.quote: As every male Scion of the Canopy knows: Wherever you are and wherever you go, the only way is forwards.

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association
introduced.how: a group of amateur history enthusiasts who collect relics of the Saurian era
introduced.quote: It's a group of amateur history enthusiasts who do research on the ancient Saurian era.

introduced.name: Burkina
introduced.how: a tribal hero of the past, killed by the Mountain King in madness rather than by the Abyss
introduced.quote: Burkina didn't fall to the Abyss — he was killed by the Mountain King in an episode of madness.

introduced.name: Malipo
introduced.how: an ancient name Kinich received on signing a contract, which carries a price
introduced.quote: Then, once I signed the contract, I received the ancient name "Malipo."

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: a major part of Natlan's history where Burkina once fought a campaign
introduced.quote: Before he got tangled up with us, he was looking into the Mare Jivari. That's another major part of Natlan's history.

introduced.name: Turnfire
introduced.how: a heroic symbol whose ancient name bearers have each died of non-natural causes
introduced.quote: Each one of them died of non-natural causes, as if the specter of the Turnfire was always lurking in the background...

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: the realm of the dead where ancestors dwell, to which the Mountain King would be sent
introduced.quote: That's right. He wants to use you to send the Mountain King to the Night Kingdom.

introduced.name: Yupanqui's Turnfire
introduced.how: a widely read scholarly book by Ponche on the history of the Turnfire
introduced.quote: Ponche: I spent years of my life researching that book...

introduced.name: Matthias
introduced.how: a thief who stole Ponche's book and threw it away
introduced.quote: Matthias: What do you want now, you old bum? God, you're a waste of space.

introduced.name: Huni
introduced.how: a young tribesperson whose family misses Nanna and who briefly falls out with Toba
introduced.quote: Huni: Dad just really misses Nanna. And I was really upset that she's gone, too...

introduced.name: Toba
introduced.how: Ponche's nephew, a young tribesperson and friend of Huni
introduced.quote: Ponche: My nephew, Toba's been telling everyone about you.

introduced.name: Thiago
introduced.how: a tribe dancer who gave up Turnfire Night to pursue relic hunting
introduced.quote: Thiago: A rehearsal, for the Turnfire Night dance.

introduced.name: Ponche
introduced.how: a tribal scholar and author of a book on the Turnfire who lost his manuscript
introduced.quote: Ponche: Dear honored guests of our clan... I am but a helpless old student.

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: a hard-to-reach major part of Natlan's history where Burkina once fought
introduced.quote: he was looking into the Mare Jivari. That's another major part of Natlan's history.

introduced.name: Burkina
introduced.how: Kinich's ancestor who fought a campaign with five other heroes
introduced.quote: Our ancestor, Burkina once fought a campaign there alongside the five other heroes.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: a relic from an earlier Saurian age bound to Kinich by contract
introduced.quote: It's true that he's a relic from an earlier Saurian age, but since we're bound to each other by a contract, you can see him as my companion for now.

introduced.name: Malipo
introduced.how: an ancient name Kinich received on signing the contract with Ajaw
introduced.quote: Then, once I signed the contract, I received the ancient name

introduced.name: contract price
introduced.how: Ajaw serves Kinich while alive and takes control of his body after death
introduced.quote: And after I die, Ajaw gets control of my body. That's the price.

introduced.name: Turnfire Night ritual
introduced.how: the ceremony steps: light pillars and braziers in order, never turn back or be sent to start over
introduced.quote: The process isn't complicated, but remember — you mustn't turn back at any point.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame Pillars
introduced.how: pillars that must be lit in turn to perform the ceremony
introduced.quote: See those Sacred Flame Pillars? Once you've lit the fire, go light each one up in turn.

introduced.name: Kongamato
introduced.how: the Mountain King, a king of the Yumkasaurs from five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: Kongamato, king of the Yumkasaurs from five hundred years ago. He's very powerful.

introduced.name: Beastly Rift
introduced.how: a rift that can tear a target apart, used to try to destroy the Mountain King
introduced.quote: We're trying to shove your Locust King into the Beastly Rift!

introduced.name: Flamegranate
introduced.quote: Watch out for the fruits he's spitting out. I can use those against him.

introduced.name: Mountain King's shell
introduced.how: a transparent shell that insulates the Mountain King from Abyssal power, like a scab
introduced.quote: It is somewhat akin to a scab, in that it stops the Abyssal energy within him from bleeding out, while also preventing further Abyssal energy from seeping in and infecting him.

introduced.name: Wayna
introduced.how: the chief of the tribe who leads the Turnfire Night ceremony
introduced.quote: Haha, I may be the chief of this tribe

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: Kinich! Fancy meeting you here! We've actually been looking for you.

assumed.name: Trinidad
assumed.quote: Kinich: I'll get straight to the point. I hear you accepted a proposal from elder Trinidad?

assumed.name: Wayna
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hello, Chief Wayna.

assumed.name: Enjou
assumed.quote: Traveler: I've beaten him up before.

assumed.name: Yupanqui
assumed.quote: Even when Yupanqui the Fire-Bringer stole the Turnfire, it cost him dearly.

assumed.name: Xbalanque
assumed.quote: Given that it first arose in the era of the First Pyro Archon, it might contain remnants of Xbalanque's power.

assumed.name: Trinidad
assumed.quote: Trinidad: Ah, at long last, you're back.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: What happened to getting some rest?

assumed.name: Enjou
assumed.quote: Yeah, that's right. You caught Enjou for us, remember?

assumed.name: Mountain King situation
assumed.quote: We really hope we can resolve the Mountain King situation quickly and smoothly.

assumed.name: Flame Bearer
assumed.quote: They're all eager to meet our new flame bearer.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: The sacred flame only possesses a fraction of the Pyro Archon's power.

assumed.name: Huni
assumed.quote: But I think I saw Huni and the others just now, maybe you should say hi before you start.

assumed.name: Thiago
assumed.quote: I still owe you for that picture you took.

assumed.name: Toba
assumed.quote: Toba: ! You're finally here! I even dragged my uncle out to watch the ceremony.

assumed.name: Ponche
assumed.quote: Although I'd hoped for the Malipo name-bearer to perform this ceremony, that was never anything to do with you.

assumed.name: Sanka
assumed.quote: So in the end, only poor little Huni got the sad ending?

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: Is this the Scions of the Canopy's adventurous spirit in action?

threads.claim: Kinich's contract means Ajaw will take control of his body after he dies.
threads.quote: And after I die, Ajaw gets control of my body. That's the price.

threads.claim: Bearers of the Turnfire name seem to meet violent deaths, hinting at a higher power that demands payment.
threads.quote: Each one of them died of non-natural causes, as if the specter of the Turnfire was always lurking in the background...

threads.claim: Ponche suggests the Malipo name may hold remnants of Xbalanque's power.
threads.quote: Given that it first arose in the era of the First Pyro Archon, it might contain remnants of Xbalanque's power.

threads.claim: Enjou, serving the Great K'uhul Ajaw, intends to seize Kinich's body.
threads.quote: I made a promise to the Great K'uhul Ajaw, and now I'm here to seize your body for his use.

threads.claim: Ponche argues that Burkina's summoning of Malipo at the cost of his life is why the Mountain King still lives.
threads.quote: The key factor is that Burkina summoned the power of "Malipo," at the cost of his own life.

threads.claim: Kinich reveals that Burkina chose not to fight back and passed his blood and power to the Mountain King.
threads.quote: In his final moments, Burkina made the fateful decision to not fight back, and instead pass his blood and power onto the Mountain King.

threads.claim: Kinich believes the Mountain King is suffering and wants to die, yet Kinich refuses to grant that wish.
threads.quote: The Mountain King's mind isn't just disordered. He is suffering, and feels great shame. I believe he wants to be put out of his misery.

threads.claim: Kinich plans to move the Mountain King into a Beastly Rift so he can live without threatening the tribe.
threads.quote: So, if we can locate one of these beastly rifts, clear the monsters out, and move the Mountain King inside...

threads.claim: The device Kinich obtained in a trade is revealed to be bait that draws the rifthounds out.
threads.quote: It's meant as bait, but it'll also stabilize the Abyssal energy.

threads.claim: The Mare Jivari is a dangerous, hard-to-reach part of Natlan's history that Kinich has not yet worked on.
threads.quote: I have yet to take a job that involves the Mare Jivari.

threads.claim: Ajaw's contract means Ajaw will take control of Kinich's body after Kinich dies.
threads.quote: And after I die, Ajaw gets control of my body. That's the price.

threads.claim: The story behind the Malipo name is left for a later time.
threads.quote: But that's a whole other story. We can get into it another time, if you're interested.

threads.claim: Kongamato seems to seek atonement for his past and asks to be used to train future heroes.
threads.quote: Kongamato: I must atone...

threads.claim: Burkina's teaching to keep moving forward without looking back carries into the Mountain King's fate.
threads.quote: Burkina: Keep moving forward

threads.claim: Kongamato's mind seems gone and he no longer responds, though his body still fights.
threads.quote: Yeah. I tried communicating with him again, but he didn't respond.

threads.claim: It is unresolved whether the summoned flame was the true Turnfire, and the chief cannot say.
threads.quote: I cannot answer that question.

threads.claim: Kinich suspects the Mountain King himself summoned the Turnfire and paid its price.
threads.quote: I'd sooner believe that the Mountain King summoned it himself.

threads.claim: Trinidad's willingness to sacrifice himself for the Mountain King exposes his blindness to the tribe's past.
threads.quote: It seems there is only one way to awaken you all from your willful blindness

threads.claim: Trinidad survives his burns and his condition has stabilized.
threads.quote: Trinidad's condition has stabilized.

threads.claim: The Mountain King's Abyssal energy is now stable, so the annual cleansing ceremony is no longer needed.
threads.quote: No longer will we need to perform an annual cleansing ceremony.

introduced.name: Noelle
introduced.how: A maid of the Knights of Favonius still training to become an official knight, who must pass the selection exam
introduced.quote: Noelle: Even though I've already worked for the Knights as a maid for some time, I still need to pass this exam to officially become a Knight.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: The knightly order of Mondstadt whose selection exam Noelle is preparing for
introduced.quote: Noelle: Right, The Knights of Favonius selection exam... *sigh*

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: A guild whose ranking exams make adventurers stronger and whose exams are open only to official members
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Our exams are only available to official members of the Guild.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Receptionist at the Adventurers' Guild who greets visitors and handles commissions and exam applications
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. What kind of commission would you like to take on today?

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Branch Master of the Adventurers' Guild who is drafting a new entrance exam
introduced.quote: Katheryne: However... since you just want to experience what an exam is like, perhaps you can talk to Cyrus, the branch master?

introduced.name: Ad astra abyssosque
introduced.how: The Adventurers' Guild motto, meaning to explore the stars above and the abyss below
introduced.quote: Cyrus: May your days ahead be filled with adventure, and may you boldly explore the stars above and the abyss below! Ad astra abyssosque! Hahaha!

introduced.name: Adventurer's Entrance Exam
introduced.how: A three-part Guild entrance exam (basic knowledge, survival skills, combat) where passing two parts succeeds
introduced.quote: Cyrus: You only need to pass two out of three parts to succeed in the exam... but of course, Noelle should find she has no trouble getting a perfect score.

introduced.name: Roald
introduced.how: A famous adventurer who explored all over Liyue and documented the whole journey in a diary
introduced.quote: Cyrus: There is a famous adventurer who once went exploring all over Liyue, documenting his whole journey.

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: A taboo domain of ashes and deathly silence that Mondstadt adventurers fear
introduced.quote: Cyrus: All that awaits you there is a sea of ashes and the deathly silence in the air... So, what is the name of this taboo territory?

introduced.name: Windwheel Aster
introduced.how: A local plant that mostly grows at Stormterror's Lair, Windrise, and near Statues of The Seven
introduced.quote: Noelle: That's it! The Windwheel Aster mostly grows in Stormterror's Lair, at Windrise, and near Statues of The Seven.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: Chef at Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue who serves the Traveler and Noelle
introduced.quote: Chef Mao: If it isn't the Traveler! What would you like to order today? Wanmin Restuarant will cook it just how you like it!

introduced.name: Black-Back Perch Stew
introduced.how: Wanmin Restaurant's signature Liyue dish, very spicy and eaten with chopsticks
introduced.quote: Chef Mao: Oh? You want to try something with more of a local flavor? Well, in that case, you've got to try our signature dish: Black-Back Perch Stew!

introduced.name: Hanfeng's Ironmongers
introduced.how: A Liyue blacksmith shop with weapons on display where Noelle studies local combat style
introduced.quote: Traveler: You mean Hanfeng's Ironmongers? Sure, follow me.

introduced.name: Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: A local Liyue storyteller who introduces himself and recruits Noelle as source material for a book
introduced.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: Pardon my directness. My name is Iron Tongue Tian, and I was hoping that you could help me out...

introduced.name: Dugu Shuo
introduced.how: A boy in Liyue who calls himself a mighty warrior and dreams of getting a Geo Vision
introduced.quote: Dugu Shuo: Th—That's not true! No greatsword can outshine the mighty Dugu Longsword! And one day... I'm gonna get my Geo Vision!

introduced.name: Outriders
introduced.how: A knight unit whose members scout and lure enemies, as Amber does
introduced.quote: Noelle: But my strengths are not in scouting and luring the enemy, and I'm not as agile as Amber.

introduced.name: Baron Bunny
introduced.how: A decoy made by Outriders that is used to lure enemies away from knights
introduced.quote: Noelle: If I were to use Baron Bunny to lure the enemy away and protect my fellow knights... I suppose I could do it?

introduced.name: Pyro Slime Condensate
introduced.how: An ingredient used as stuffing for a Baron Bunny
introduced.quote: Noelle: Making the stuffing requires Pyro Slime Condensate, and the red dye used to grab the enemies' attention can be made from crushed Valberries.

introduced.name: Master Jean
introduced.how: A pillar of the Knights of Favonius and an inspiration to Noelle who often helps citizens
introduced.quote: Noelle: Master Jean is a pillar of the Knights of Favonius and a great source of inspiration to me...

introduced.name: Charles
introduced.how: Bartender at the Angel's Share who asks Noelle to help out in the tavern
introduced.quote: Charles: I've been a bartender here for more than a decade, and I've never seen a happier crowd of drinkers than the ones who were here tonight.

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: Mondstadt's most popular tavern, known for its atmosphere
introduced.quote: Charles: The Angel's Share has always been Mondstadt's most popular tavern...-->

introduced.name: Payne
introduced.how: Customer who keeps ordering strong drinks and gets drunk at the tavern
introduced.quote: Charles: It's that guy drinking at that table over there... Payne. He keeps ordering refills of our strongest drink, Death After Noon.

introduced.name: Death After Noon
introduced.how: The tavern's strongest drink
introduced.quote: Charles: It's that guy drinking at that table over there... Payne. He keeps ordering refills of our strongest drink, Death After Noon.

introduced.name: Marjorie
introduced.how: Shopkeeper who sells exotic imported items and has lost things before
introduced.quote: Marjorie: Anything like this? Well... It's not completely unheard-of. You know my store — there are all sorts of exotic items...

introduced.name: Missing monocle
introduced.how: A small, fragile monocle imported from Sumeru that Marjorie has lost
introduced.quote: Marjorie: Oh, Noelle! Since you asked... I seem to have misplaced a monocle that I imported from Sumeru.

introduced.name: Sha'yin
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Millelith in charge of garrison and patrol duties
introduced.quote: Sha'yin: Allow me to introduce myself first. My name is Sha'yin, a Millelith responsible for garrison and patrol duties.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Liyue guard force responsible for garrison and patrol duties and arrests
introduced.quote: Sha'yin: Allow me to introduce myself first. My name is Sha'yin, a Millelith responsible for garrison and patrol duties.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Criminal group originally from Mondstadt that has shown up in Liyue
introduced.quote: Sha'yin: Well... Let me fill you in. I just received some intel that a group of Treasure Hoarders, originally from Mondstadt, has shown up in this area recently.

introduced.name: Stone Gate
introduced.how: Area near which the Treasure Hoarders have set up camp
introduced.quote: Sha'yin: According to the intel, they have set up camp near Stone Gate.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Mondstadt's knights; Noelle is their maid and not yet an official Knight
introduced.quote: Noelle: And I am Noelle, maid of the Knights of Favonius... Of course, I am not yet an official Knight.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: Traveler's title as a technically honorary knight
introduced.quote: Traveler: Now you mention it... I am technically an Honorary Knight.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Traveler: Then let's start with knights closer to home. How about an Outrider, like Amber?

assumed.name: Geo Archon
assumed.quote: Noelle: Wow, just from looking at these weapons, I can tell they have great power. This is the nation built by the Geo Archon, after all...

assumed.name: Stormterror crisis
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Ugh, don't get me started... Since solved the Stormterror crisis and became Mondstadt's hero, a whole load of young people got excited

assumed.name: Ruin Guards
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Hunt down three Ruin Guards... Hmm, could it be a little too difficult?

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: I heard earlier from the Millelith that some hilichurls have been wreaking havoc in the countryside.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Noelle: Yes, there does seem to be a large number of Millelith stationed at the harbor.

assumed.name: Captain Kaeya
assumed.quote: Noelle: C—Captain Kaeya? No, I could never manage that...

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders arrest
assumed.quote: I heard that the reason we were able to arrest those Treasure Hoarders last time was thanks to Captain Kaeya's intel.

assumed.name: Captain Kaeya
assumed.quote: Noelle: It appears that Captain Kaeya's way with words does not come the most naturally to me...

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Traveler: With people calling on the knights for so many things, it's no wonder Jean is so busy...

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Noelle: Wait, so... , as well as Stormterror... you defeated an ancient god, too?

assumed.name: Selection exam
assumed.quote: Noelle: I'm sorry... If only I could have passed the selection exam earlier...

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Glory: You are welcome! May you swiftly recover the lost item by the grace of the Anemo Archon.

threads.claim: Noelle has failed the knight exam several times and doubts she can pass it this time.
threads.quote: Noelle: It's just that I've failed several times in the past... I still don't know if I can make it this time...

threads.claim: Noelle's nerves consistently ruin her exam performance, and only the Traveler's presence seems to calm her.
threads.quote: Noelle: Not entirely... whenever I've taken an exam in the past, I always get nervous and I can't control it.

threads.claim: Noelle finds that having the Traveler beside her steadies her during the Guild exam.
threads.quote: Noelle: Somehow, having you by my side is... soothing...

threads.claim: Noelle cannot become an official Knight of Favonius until she passes the selection exam.
threads.quote: Noelle: Even though I've already worked for the Knights as a maid for some time, I still need to pass this exam to officially become a Knight.

threads.claim: Several characters mistake Noelle, a mere maid-in-training, for a fully fledged Knight of Favonius.
threads.quote: Dugu Shuo: ...You must be a fabled Knight of Favonius!

threads.claim: Iron Tongue Tian's dramatized story about Noelle spreads as if it were true, and Noelle is alarmed by it.
threads.quote: Noelle: Is this... about me? What is he talking about...?

threads.claim: Noelle insists she only wants to take the exam for experience and has no plan to join the Adventurers' Guild.
threads.quote: Noelle: I'm very sorry, but... I actually wasn't planning to join the Adventurers' Guild at all.

threads.claim: Cyrus has been drafting a new entrance exam that is not yet approved for official use.
threads.quote: Katheryne: As it happens, he has recently been working on a new entrance exam for the Guild.

threads.claim: Mare Jivari is a dangerous forbidden domain that the Traveler and Noelle will one day cross.
threads.quote: Cyrus: Correct! Keep this name in mind. Some day, you too will pass through this domain!

threads.claim: Dugu Shuo vows that he and Noelle's paths will cross again.
threads.quote: Dugu Shuo: As surely as the hills are green and the rivers flow into the sea... our paths will cross again!

threads.claim: Noelle wants to become an official knight but is not yet one, so her status is left open.
threads.quote: Noelle: And I am Noelle, maid of the Knights of Favonius... Of course, I am not yet an official Knight.

threads.claim: Noelle fears failing her next exam and resolves to become a knight she can be proud of.
threads.quote: Noelle: Yes, there is no need to become someone else, nor worry about failing... As long as I perform better in my next exam than in my previous one...

threads.claim: The Traveler is hinted to have defeated an ancient god alongside Stormterror, a deed never explained here.
threads.quote: Noelle: Wait, so... , as well as Stormterror... you defeated an ancient god, too?

threads.claim: A group of Treasure Hoarders from Mondstadt is hiding near Stone Gate and may try to escape.
threads.quote: Sha'yin: According to the intel, they have set up camp near Stone Gate.

threads.claim: The Millelith detain all the Treasure Hoarders who tried to escape through Stone Gate.
threads.quote: Sha'yin: Thank you! We've successfully detained all the Treasure Hoarders who tried to escape through here.

threads.claim: Marjorie's imported monocle vanished from her stall, and the thief is unknown.
threads.quote: Marjorie: But then, I went to get it after I was done with the stock, and it was gone!

threads.claim: The missing monocle is found in a finch's nest on the rooftop.
threads.quote: Noelle: We found it! This must be Miss Marjorie's missing monocle.

introduced.name: Persikov
introduced.how: Fatui researcher who invented the machine and ran experiments on junior soldiers on the island
introduced.quote: It was invented by the researcher we met earlier, his name is Persikov.

introduced.name: Cognitive Mimicry
introduced.how: a machine that can alter people's brains, modeled on a god's power
introduced.quote: Mona: Just as I thought. This machinery named "Cognitive Mimicry" is capable of altering the state of people's brains.

introduced.name: Persikov's Manuscript
introduced.how: notes that reveal the machine's history, the experiments, and a map of the cores
introduced.quote: Mona: According to the manuscript, the Fatui officials did not support Persikov's research. They believed he had taken the wrong path.

introduced.name: Persikov's experiments on the deserted island
introduced.how: Persikov secretly ran experiments on junior Fatui soldiers who signed waivers
introduced.quote: Mona: Persikov was dead set on carrying out his experiments on this island. Most of his subjects were junior Fatui soldiers who all signed a waiver before the experiment.

introduced.name: crystalline cores
introduced.how: the machine's most important components, which were lost when it broke
introduced.quote: Even its most important component of all — the crystalline cores — got ejected and disappeared.

introduced.name: Roasted Lavender Melon
introduced.how: an Inazuman snack that goes well with fish
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: There is a snack called Roasted Lavender Melon in Inazuma, which goes rather well with fish.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: an opera performer in Liyue who likes making friends
introduced.quote: Xinyan: If you're into opera, you should go see Yun Jin. She's the nicest person, and she likes making friends with new and interesting people.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Isn't that strange? The Fatui is a big organization, but he is the only one left at this camp.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Venti: Well hello there, strangers! You finally called!

assumed.name: Fischl
assumed.quote: Fischl: What a drunkard, hmph.

assumed.name: Oz
assumed.quote: Oz: Oh goodness, the smell of alcohol... Mein Fräulein, please allow me to fan the fumes away with my wings.

assumed.name: Mona
assumed.quote: Mona: Ah, you're all here.

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: I promised Fischl that I'd be her guard. I can help.

assumed.name: Klee's Camp
assumed.quote: Traveler: You mean Klee's camp.

assumed.name: Immernachtreich
assumed.quote: Oz: Then perhaps we should call it the Embassy of the Immernachtreich and Dodoland.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Venti: If you look at it that way, maybe she meant you well. I mean, if she was able to intercept Alice's communication tool, I'm sure she's also plenty capable of attacking you.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Xinyan: Of course! And you should come find me in Liyue when you get the time.

threads.claim: An unknown power surrounding the islands seems to be watching the group, and its source is unclear.
threads.quote: Mona: Although there are some parts in the results that I don't quite understand... it's as if there is some sort of power surrounding us, and it's still watching us.

threads.claim: The mirages may be connected to a god whose power the Fatui tried to copy.
threads.quote: Mona: Does that mean... there's a god connected to these dream-like mirages, and the Fatui found a way to research it?

threads.claim: Fixing the machine did not make the mirages vanish, and they may take time to disappear.
threads.quote: Mona: I've noticed an issue. Although we've fixed the machine, as you can see — the mirages on the islands have still not disappeared.

threads.claim: A voice that speaks directly into the Traveler's mind says it is a little bird watching the islands from afar.
threads.quote: ???: Don't worry, I won't hurt you. I'm just a little bird that sometimes flies by these islands, and am now watching you from far, far away.

threads.claim: Venti suggests the mysterious voice may have meant well and did not harm them.
threads.quote: Venti: As for the mysterious voice, although we don't know who it was, not only did she not harm you, she also helped you to gain a better understanding of each other, right?

threads.claim: A Dendro symbol appears as the voice fades, and the Traveler wonders what the voice meant by meeting in another place.
threads.quote: (A Dendro symbol briefly appears in front of Traveler)

introduced.name: Pedrush
introduced.how: organizer of the A Moment of Dreams dream-sharing group who recruits the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Dreams have become quite the hot topic in Sumeru, and many people are excited to share the dreams they've seen at night.

introduced.name: A Moment of Dreams
introduced.how: a regular event where people share their new dreams, not a drink
introduced.quote: It's the name of an event we started to hold regularly.

introduced.name: Akasha System
introduced.how: a system that let people dream again and was stopped
introduced.quote: now that the people of Sumeru could dream again after the Akasha System was stopped

introduced.name: Nahida
introduced.how: is the Dendro Archon, a warm and open archon who attends the event
introduced.quote: The Dendro Archon is really nice, so please, just go ahead and ask! Otherwise, she'll leave.

introduced.name: Ilman
introduced.how: dream-group member whose deceased wife appears in his dreams
introduced.quote: One of the members, Ilman, remarks about his deceased wife

introduced.name: Maynar
introduced.how: Ilman's deceased wife, who appears to him in dreams
introduced.quote: Ilman sees his wife, Maynar, who walks away.

introduced.name: Haydar
introduced.how: Ilman's daughter whom his wife in the dream always asks about
introduced.quote: I'd tell her about our daughter, Haydar, and she always listened intently.

introduced.name: Ata
introduced.how: dream-group member who wants a different life and wishes to become a Slime in dreams
introduced.quote: My question is simple. My everyday life is very difficult, so I would like to become a Slime in my dreams. How can I do that?

introduced.name: Debbi
introduced.how: dreamer who escapes into a dream of a lost friend and family reality
introduced.quote: Debbi states that the dream allows her to escape the harsh reality

introduced.name: Gaspar and Basimah
introduced.how: Debbi's loved ones presumed dead after their ship sank
introduced.quote: Gaspar and Basimah were on a ship that struck a reef and sank

introduced.name: Professor Aisha
introduced.how: Amurta researcher and adventurer whom Kathya admired and who gave her a plant seed
introduced.quote: Professor Aisha, an Amurta researcher and adventurer she looked up to, who was also extremely talented.

introduced.name: Moseis
introduced.how: the owner of the dream trap, who uses others' Jnana energy to sustain his dream
