introduced.quote: Nahida uses her powers and discovers that Moseis is the owner of the dream.

introduced.name: Emira
introduced.how: Moseis's first creation within the dream, whom he made using Jnana energy
introduced.quote: Emira was his first creation with it.

introduced.name: Jnana energy
introduced.how: energy the Akasha uses that Moseis drew on to power his dream
introduced.quote: Moseis used the Akasha's Jnana energy to power his dream; even a small amount was enough for him

introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: a capsule Nahida uses to extract and transfer consciousness back into a body
introduced.quote: she will use her knowledge of the Akasha to extract his consciousness into a Knowledge Capsule so it can be transferred back into his body

introduced.name: Beynuni
introduced.how: Kshahrewar scholar left unconscious after improper use of the Akasha, cared for at Bimarstan
introduced.quote: Sitt reports back the status of one Beynuni, who became so after improper operation of the Akasha and has been cared for at Bimarstan ever since.

introduced.name: dream fragility
introduced.how: most dreams are fragile and easily disrupted by outside stimuli, so stable dreams are rare
introduced.quote: Most dreams are far more fragile than you could imagine.

introduced.name: Kathya
introduced.how: Aisha's former student, a family friend whose tutor left her a plant and vanished on an adventure
introduced.quote: Kathya: She was a good friend of my parents' and my first real tutor. She was also an outstanding Amurta researcher.

introduced.name: Aisha
introduced.how: Kathya's first tutor, a skilled combatant and Amurta researcher who took Adventurers' Guild work and left to investigate the Abyss
introduced.quote: Kathya: In addition to her extraordinary academic talents, she was also skilled in combat, and would accept lots of work from the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: A Moment of Dreams
introduced.how: a small interest group where dreamers gather, with its staff overwhelmed by the crisis
introduced.quote: Pedrush: "A Moment of Dreams" is just a small interest group... We don't have enough staff members to handle this.

introduced.name: Debbi
introduced.how: a dreamer whose lost friends Basimah and Gaspar never returned from a voyage
introduced.quote: Debbi: And I never heard from Basimah and Gaspar again...

introduced.name: The Steambird sinking
introduced.how: the ship The Steambird struck a reef and sank, and its crew was lost
introduced.quote: Debbi: Yes, the reports from "The Steambird" were true... The ship they were on struck a reef and sank.

introduced.name: Moseis
introduced.how: Beynuni's alias, the scholar who uploaded his consciousness into the Akasha and owns the collective dream
introduced.quote: Moseis: I uploaded my entire consciousness into the Akasha when it was still running.

introduced.name: Emira
introduced.how: a dream-made person Moseis created, who runs a flower shop and is presented as his wife
introduced.quote: Emira: I'm Emira. I run the flower shop here. And this is my husband, Moseis.

introduced.name: Beynuni
introduced.how: the real name of Moseis, a scholar unconscious in Bimarstan after misusing the Akasha
introduced.quote: Sitt: Sorry to keep you waiting, Dendro Archon. We have confirmed that there's a scholar named Beynuni who's been unconscious for a while.

introduced.name: Maynar
introduced.how: Ilman's wife as introduced in the dream, actually a dream-made duplicate
introduced.quote: Ilman: Here, let me introduce everyone. This is Maynar, my wife who I mentioned before, and this is our daughter, Haydar.

introduced.name: Haydar
introduced.how: Ilman's daughter, introduced in the dream, whose duplicate was made by the dream while the real girl waits on the mountainside
introduced.quote: Ilman: Here, let me introduce everyone. This is Maynar, my wife who I mentioned before, and this is our daughter, Haydar.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: Nahida's other title, given as her self-introduction before entering Debbi's dream
introduced.quote: Nahida: Don't worry about that. I'm Lesser Lord Kusanali, after all.

introduced.name: Dream-made people
introduced.how: the dream can create imaginary people who look real and no longer exist in the waking world
introduced.quote: Nahida: This dream has the ability to create imaginary people, which is why people are so unwilling to wake up.

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: (Is she remembering something about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata?)

assumed.name: Kusanali
assumed.quote: and Kusanali's to move on without needing to know.

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: she perished as a result of Eleazar complications.

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: as the Aranara did not have any malicious intent

assumed.name: Chatrakam Cave
assumed.quote: the latter having headed to Chatrakam Cave.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: She then heads to the Akademiya with the Traveler and meets with Sitt

assumed.name: Bimarstan
assumed.quote: has been cared for at Bimarstan ever since.

assumed.name: Rockfond Rifthound
assumed.quote: who transformed into a Rockfond Rifthound

assumed.name: Ilman
assumed.quote: Paimon: She seems to be in the same condition as Ilman earlier.

assumed.name: Akasha
assumed.quote: Nahida: Do you remember how the Akasha can turn dreams into Jnana Energy?

assumed.name: Primeval Rosin
assumed.quote: (Approach the Primeval Rosin receptacle)

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Pawlin: It's the Dendro Archon. She's back!

assumed.name: Nilou and the Sabzeruz Festival
assumed.quote: Paimon: Does that mean there's a "host" of these dreams here like Nilou during the Sabzeruz Festival?

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: Nahida: This has nothing to do with the Aranara, and humans are not capable of creating a collective dream, which means...

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: Moseis: However, Eleazar later took her from me.

assumed.name: Amurta
assumed.quote: Kathya: She was a good friend of my parents' and my first real tutor. She was also an outstanding Amurta researcher.

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Greater Lord Rukkhadevata has already shaped Nahida through her actions.)

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Paimon: Guess "ad astra abyssosque" isn't just a slogan...

assumed.name: Puspa Café
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, this place looks familiar! Isn't it Puspa Café?

assumed.name: Jnana Energy
assumed.quote: Paimon: That means... everyone in the network is providing you with Jnana Energy!

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Nahida: But the collective dream in Sumeru City was created by the Akasha, and now the Akasha has been turned off.

threads.claim: The Traveler decides Nahida should learn that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata once existed, hinting at a forgotten god.
threads.quote: the Traveler decides it would be good that Nahida be made aware that Rukkhadevata did once exist

threads.claim: The Traveler realizes Rukkhadevata shaped Nahida, which proves she existed even though everyone forgot her.
threads.quote: the Traveler realizes that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata had directly shaped Nahida

threads.claim: Nahida suspects someone has turned the Akasha back on, since the collective dream seems beyond ordinary humans.
threads.quote: Nahida realizes that someone might have turned the Akasha back on

threads.claim: Ilman's wife in his dreams is unusually stable and unaffected by outside interference, which should be extremely rare.
threads.quote: But the appearance of your wife seems unusually stable and unaffected by any outside interference.

threads.claim: Nahida suspects vivid, dangerous dreams may be spreading across Sumeru beyond this one event.
threads.quote: But I'm concerned that Ilman's case may not be unique to him

threads.claim: Nahida glimpses an unexplained streak in the sky right before leaving the dream, hinting at an unseen force.
threads.quote: she spots something streaking through the sky and disappears just as fast as it appeared.

threads.claim: Debbi heard a voice luring her deeper into the dream through an entryway, hinting at an outside manipulator.
threads.quote: Debbi also tells them that she had heard a voice trying to bring her deeper into the dream

threads.claim: Nahida reveals that Aisha's plant was cultivated by special means and would never bloom, so her promise was a lie.
threads.quote: Nahida reveals that the plant is not known to the academic world

threads.claim: Moseis secretly used signaling devices in his subjects to link them to Emira, pulling dreamers into his dream.
threads.quote: Moseis planted signaling devices into his subjects' bodies to network them so that Emira could feel their yearning

threads.claim: Nahida plans to extract Moseis's consciousness into a Knowledge Capsule so it can return to his body.
threads.quote: she will use her knowledge of the Akasha to extract his consciousness into a Knowledge Capsule

threads.claim: Nahida gives a Knowledge Capsule to the matra so Beynuni's consciousness can be returned to his brain.
threads.quote: Nahida gives her the Knowledge Capsule to pass on to the matra to import the consciousness back into his brain

threads.claim: Aisha left to investigate the secrets of the Abyss and said she would be gone for a long time.
threads.quote: Kathya: Yes. When I was about ten years old, she told me that she must go look for the secrets of "the Abyss," and that she would be gone for a long time.

threads.claim: Aisha left a seed promising to return if it bloomed, but it never blooms.
threads.quote: Kathya: She left a seed in the letter, telling me that if it sprouted and bloomed, then she'd come back, no matter what sort of risky situation she was in.

threads.claim: The plant can never bloom, showing Aisha had foreseen the danger and never intended to return.
threads.quote: Nahida: It means that this "Professor Aisha" she keeps mentioning might have foreseen the danger, and was prepared to never return.

threads.claim: Some unseen power may be exploiting people's feelings through their dreams.
threads.quote: Nahida: These dreams may not be as pure and beautiful as they seem. Some kind of power may be exploiting your feelings.

threads.claim: The dreams are likely interconnected into one collective dream rather than separate personal ones.
threads.quote: Nahida: Yes, given that so many people have been experiencing these beautiful dreams, I would say it's very likely that they're interconnected.

threads.claim: Moseis, the owner of the dream, is fully awake and trapped in the network after the Akasha shut off.
threads.quote: Moseis: Yes. Because the Akasha was suddenly turned off, I lost all of my Jnana Energy. I became imprisoned in the very network I had constructed.

threads.claim: Paimon asks whether someone restarted the Akasha, which Nahida dismisses as impossible.
threads.quote: Paimon: Eh? So, did someone manage to restart the Akasha?

threads.claim: Ilman and Kathya both lost someone dear, and the dreams exploit that longing.
threads.quote: Nahida: Yes. What's common between Ilman and Kathya's cases is that they've both lost someone dear to them.

threads.claim: The Haydar in the dream is a duplicate created by the dream, since the real Haydar cannot enter it.
threads.quote: Nahida: No, because unlike you, she can't enter this dream.

threads.claim: The Traveler glimpses their sibling in the distance upon entering the dream.
threads.quote: (Upon entering the dream, the Traveler catches a glimpse of their sibling in the distance)

threads.claim: A star falls from the sky as Nahida turns, hinting at an unexplained event.
threads.quote: (Nahida turns to see a star fall from the sky)

threads.claim: Debbi heard a strange voice telling her there is a deeper entrance in the dream.
threads.quote: Debbi: Huh, now that you mention it, I once heard a strange voice tell me that there's an entrance here.

threads.claim: Debbi's lost friends were dream-made, since the real Steambird ship sank and they never returned.
threads.quote: Debbi: Yes, the reports from "The Steambird" were true... The ship they were on struck a reef and sank.

threads.claim: Moseis will be held to account, with his consciousness extracted and his body treated at the Akademiya.
threads.quote: Nahida: He's committed an act that affected the safety of Sumeru. After he wakes up, I'll inform the General Mahamatra of all the details.

threads.claim: Moseis is accused of committing one of the six cardinal sins of the Akademiya.
threads.quote: Nahida: Unfortunately, you've committed one of the six cardinal sins of the Akademiya by "attempting the forbidden and fearing none."

threads.claim: Paimon explains empathy to Nahida, who treats it as valuable knowledge she lacks.
threads.quote: Nahida: "Empathy"? Hmm, I see... This is valuable knowledge indeed.

threads.claim: Nahida admits her understanding covers only a small part of others' pain, and doubts it counts as empathy.
threads.quote: Nahida: I don't think this "one percent" can be seen as an example of what you call empathy.

threads.claim: Nahida feels a warmth from the dream she cannot recall, as if her memories were erased.
threads.quote: Nahida: But when I opened my eyes, the feeling was gone without a trace.

threads.claim: The Traveler believes Nahida's will is proof she existed even though she has been forgotten.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Even if she has been forgotten, Nahida's mind and willpower are the proof that she once existed.)

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: Mercenary bodyguard whose father is Kusayla and who was born of a random encounter
introduced.quote: I was the result of one of those encounters with some random person.

introduced.name: Blazing Beasts
introduced.how: Dehya's small, loyal mercenary brigade
introduced.quote: We're not a large group, but every member is loyal and brave.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Desert mercenary groups with a complex organizational structure
introduced.quote: As you may already know, the Eremites have both a lot of mercenaries and a complex organizational structure.

introduced.name: Deshret's Relics
introduced.how: Large mercenary organization made of many smaller brigades, issuing orders to them
introduced.quote: Deshret's Relics is composed of many smaller brigades like Ayn Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Dakan Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: Violent brigade under Deshret's Relics that has been robbing and killing mercenaries and others
introduced.quote: Unfortunately though, the brigade that's stirring up trouble now is none other than Dakan Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Kusayla
introduced.how: Dehya's father, said to lead Dakan Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: Anyway, the real issue is that Dakan Al-Ahmar is led by my father, Kusayla.

introduced.name: Homayani Family
introduced.how: Family that hires mercenaries and posts jobs
introduced.quote: The Homayanis also still post jobs from time to time.

introduced.name: Shahzaman Homayani
introduced.how: Dunyarzad's father and head of the Homayani family
introduced.quote: Shahzaman Homayani is Dunyarzad's father, and the head of the Homayani family.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: Namesake whose name is used by Deshret's Relics
introduced.quote: King Deshret.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: Currency mercenaries chase, central to their world
introduced.quote: Mercenary life is a dog-eat-dog world where Mora reigns supreme.

introduced.name: Harun
introduced.how: Mercenary of Dehya's crew who first greets the Traveler at Caravan Ribat
introduced.quote: Hey, Dehya, you're back! Are these two friends of yours?

introduced.name: Hisham
introduced.how: Mercenary from Dehya's brigade who rushed to Caravan Ribat to meet her
introduced.quote: We rushed over as soon as we saw you come into Caravan Ribat.

introduced.name: Khalaf
introduced.how: Brigade member who wants Dehya to update the deputy on her schedule
introduced.quote: Oh, one other thing, Dehya. When you're free, why don't you update the deputy about your upcoming schedule?

introduced.name: Sattar
introduced.how: Eremite captured in an ambush who refuses to talk and bites his tongue
introduced.quote: Hmph... You know the code of being a mercenary just like everyone else.

introduced.name: Caravan Ribat
introduced.how: Mercenary meeting place where Dehya's fellow mercs gather
introduced.quote: Our first stop will be Caravan Ribat, where we can catch up a bit with my fellow mercs.

introduced.name: Caravan Accounts
introduced.how: Paper listing a caravan's transactions with Dakan Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: We found a piece of paper with a bunch of names on it!

introduced.name: Kusayla
introduced.how: Dehya's adoptive father and former leader of Dakan Al-Ahmar who once saved Shahzaman's family in the desert
introduced.quote: Shahzaman: Kusayla saved my daughter and me all those years ago in the desert.

introduced.name: Shahzaman
introduced.how: Head of the Homayani family, Dunyarzad's father, meeting the Traveler and Paimon for the first time
introduced.quote: Shahzaman: Ah yes, my daughter has mentioned them from time to time. It's a privilege to finally meet them in person.

introduced.name: Dakan Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: Kusayla's Eremite brigade, which took money from the Homayanis and later turned to revenge
introduced.quote: Shahzaman: Those Eremites were Kusayla's brigade, Dakan Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Deshret's Relics
introduced.how: A violent mercenary organization that forced members to leave blackmail records at its headquarters
introduced.quote: Shahzaman: He was already beyond redemption, but he hoped that he would be able to detach his daughter from the vicious world of mercenary life.

introduced.name: Blazing Beasts
introduced.how: The mercenary brigade Dehya belonged to before becoming the Homayanis' bodyguard
introduced.quote: Dehya: Ah, about that... well, the Homayanis really needed bodyguards, so they reached out to the Blazing Beasts.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: A large group of mercenaries that handles judgment of crimes in the city
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: However, there are plenty of capable mercenaries in the Corps of Thirty.

introduced.name: Records of Deshret's Relics
introduced.how: Members of Deshret's Relics had to leave records of their sins, used as loyalty symbols and blackmail
introduced.quote: Idrisi: Whether it be their deepest sin, some unforgivable act, or their most immoral exploit, the record served both as a symbol of loyalty and the perfect material for blackmail.

introduced.name: Bashar
introduced.how: A brigade member who grew up with Dehya and fights for revenge against Deshret's Relics
introduced.quote: Bashar: We would prefer to call it "taking revenge."

introduced.name: Tikriti
introduced.how: A Dakan Al-Ahmar member who grew up with Dehya and explains the brigade's history
introduced.quote: Tikriti: We all knew he was doing that for you. He wanted to get you out of this world, no matter what it took.

introduced.name: Jawad
introduced.how: A Corps of Thirty member who secretly smuggled weapons to Dakan Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: Dehya: I know what you've been up to. Smuggling weapons to violent brigades in the desert while working for the Corps?

introduced.name: Mishal
introduced.how: A surviving commander of Deshret's Relics who refuses to surrender and says he witnessed its golden age
introduced.quote: Mishal: I witnessed the golden age of Deshret's Relics.

introduced.name: Sattar
introduced.how: A former Dakan Al-Ahmar member who joined to repay Kusayla and now gives himself up
introduced.quote: Sattar: I had joined the cause to repay an old favor from Kusayla.

introduced.name: Dehya's childhood toy sword hidden in the cane
introduced.how: Kusayla's cane hides an old blade that was Dehya's childhood toy sword
introduced.quote: Tikriti: Isn't that the toy sword you played with as a child?

introduced.name: Dragon-slaying play
introduced.how: Kusayla once staged a play with young Dehya about her slaying a dragon
introduced.quote: Kusayla: For Princess Dehya has slain it

introduced.name: Kusayla's death and the Dakan Al-Ahmar fire
introduced.how: Kusayla died after breaking up Dakan Al-Ahmar and setting fire to Deshret's Relics headquarters and its records
introduced.quote: Idrisi: He died a long time ago.

assumed.name: Dunyarzad
assumed.quote: Hello there! It's been quite a while.

assumed.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
assumed.quote: I've heard that you've already crossed paths with Ayn Al-Ahmar?

assumed.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
assumed.quote: Oh, you mean the group that tried to sell us the Divine Knowledge Capsule!

assumed.name: Flame-Mane
assumed.quote: I'm talkin' same level as Flame-Mane here.

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Let's pay another visit to Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: The only potentially large expenditure I can think of would be the treatment costs for Dunyarzad's Eleazar.

assumed.name: Canned Knowledge
assumed.quote: It seems that in the past, they used to receive some Canned Knowledge as well.

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: They could have just as easily bought goods such as food and medicine directly from Caravan Ribat or Port Ormos.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Dehya: We're back, my lady.

assumed.name: Dunyarzad
assumed.quote: Dunyarzad: Ah, you're back a lot sooner than I expected!

assumed.name: Homayani Family
assumed.quote: Dehya: I came here today to support you as the head of the Homayani family.

assumed.name: The Eremites
assumed.quote: When all seemed lost, a group of passerby Eremites lent us their support.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Dehya: He offered me a pile of Mora, so I just signed on...

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Dunyarzad, optional)

assumed.name: Lambad's Tavern
assumed.quote: (Dehya and the Traveler are sitting at one of the outdoor tables at Lambad's Tavern, which is laden with local dishes.)

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: It was against the Akademiya's rules to possess books for personal use.

assumed.name: Grand Bazaar
assumed.quote: Dunyarzad: Why don't we go for a change of scenery once we finish eating? What about stopping by the Grand Bazaar again?

threads.claim: Why Dakan Al-Ahmar suddenly turned so violent is an open question for Dehya.
threads.quote: I just wish I knew what's driven him to do this...

threads.claim: Harun suggests Dakan Al-Ahmar's attacks target other Relics brigades because of an internal power struggle.
threads.quote: Rather than saying they're out to plunder and hoard Mora, it'd probably be more accurate to say that they're experiencing an internal power struggle.

threads.claim: The Homayani head's name on a Dakan Al-Ahmar supply record hints that the family may be involved.
threads.quote: Shahzaman Homayani...

threads.claim: The group suspects Shahzaman may have been funding the brigade's violence through the sale of its loot.
threads.quote: Funding violence and looting. The brigade gets the goods, and he is paid the proceeds from the sale of the loot.

threads.claim: Kusayla is said to lead Dakan Al-Ahmar, yet the Eremites claim he died years ago, raising the question of who commands the brigade.
threads.quote: they reveal to her that he had died several years ago

threads.claim: Dehya's birth mother is unknown and never appeared, leaving her origins an open question.
threads.quote: He told me that he wasn't sure who my mother was, and in any case, she never came to see me.

threads.claim: Deshret's Relics weakening while Dakan Al-Ahmar grew stronger is a puzzling contradiction.
threads.quote: Oh, one last thing we discovered was that over the past few years, as Dakan Al-Ahmar became more and more active, Deshret's Relics as a whole became a lot weaker.

threads.claim: The final caravan transaction lacks a Mora value, an unexplained gap in the records.
threads.quote: Every transaction before the last one was marked with an exact amount of Mora.

threads.claim: Kusayla's letter reveals he was never Dehya's blood father and only found her in the desert.
threads.quote: Heh, I was never your father to begin with.

threads.claim: Kusayla is revealed to have died a few years earlier, after his final trip to headquarters.
threads.quote: Idrisi: He died a long time ago.

threads.claim: The cane Kusayla used conceals a childhood toy sword that belonged to Dehya.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm? Is this a cane? It must be the one that Dehya's father used...

threads.claim: Kusayla's fire destroyed Deshret's Relics records, freeing members who had been bound by blackmail.
threads.quote: Idrisi: His words made no sense to me, but that night, we heard that a massive fire tore through headquarters, and razed everyone's

threads.claim: Dunyarzad questions why her father specifically hired Dehya instead of Corps of Thirty mercenaries.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: However, there are plenty of capable mercenaries in the Corps of Thirty. Why did my father go out of his way to hire Dehya?

threads.claim: Kusayla secretly steered the Homayanis to hire Dehya so she could leave the mercenary life.
threads.quote: Shahzaman: He then suddenly asked me if Dunyarzad, now that she had grown, would need a bodyguard of her own.

threads.claim: Doubt grows over whether King Deshret still stands with his loyal followers.
threads.quote: Mishal: (Is King Deshret no longer on my side?)

threads.claim: Shahzaman warns that knowing the truth may bring anguish and that ignorance can be bliss.
threads.quote: Shahzaman: But knowledge always comes at a price, and sometimes, as they say, ignorance is bliss.

threads.claim: Kusayla loved old hero stories, and his members see his sacrifice as a heroic tale.
threads.quote: Idrisi: Boss always loved his old-fashioned hero stories... those tales about sacrificing yourself to save the world.

threads.claim: Dakan Al-Ahmar members turned themselves in to the authorities after exacting their revenge.
threads.quote: Sattar: Yeah, they told me that they had exacted their revenge, and everyone had turned themselves in to the authorities.

threads.claim: Shahzaman and Dunyarzad await the Corps of Thirty's verdict on his dealings with Dakan Al-Ahmar.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: Yeah... Many people from the Corps of Thirty came over, and I just wrapped up everything with my dad. All I can do now is wait for their verdict...

introduced.name: Mann
introduced.how: a doorman who oversees demolition and heritage work and claims he saw a ghost at the sanatorium
introduced.quote: I'm not just any doorman. I oversee demolition work and cultural heritage preservation.

introduced.name: Hauptmann
introduced.how: Mann's dog, who runs ahead into the sanatorium ruins
introduced.quote: Mann: Hey, hey. Why so worked up, Hauptmann?

introduced.name: Lipphart
introduced.how: an adventurer who hears Mann's story and decides to stay in Dornman Port
introduced.quote: This is Lipphart, an adventurer.

introduced.name: Windrest Peak
introduced.how: a mountain people are warned away from, where the ghost-rumored trouble is linked
introduced.quote: Huffman: As you can see, Old Mann is trying his best to keep people away from Windrest Peak.

introduced.name: Old Sanatorium Site
introduced.how: an old sanatorium in the north of Dornman Port being demolished, rumored to be haunted
introduced.quote: The sanatorium's haunted! Seriously! I saw them ghosts with my own eyes!

introduced.name: Zeitlind
introduced.how: a young woman who looks exactly like the gravestone portrait and is searching for her missing older sister
introduced.quote: Zeitlind: Zeitlind. My name is Zeitlind.

introduced.name: Nihilita
introduced.how: a towering angelic automaton, a Watcher who traps Zeitlind and asks the Traveler to free the Temple of Space
introduced.quote: I am Nihilita, Watcher of Nothingness, the Open-Eyed.

introduced.name: Temple of Space
introduced.how: a seat of governance floating above the skies, reached through the Anemo Archon statue
introduced.quote: This is not some strange place. It is the seat of governance above the skies.

introduced.name: Dex
introduced.how: a disembodied hand summoned by Nihilita as a companion that aids in trials
introduced.quote: Nihilita summons a disembodied hand, which does a finger gun

introduced.name: Istoria
introduced.how: a woman from a distant age who was in the temple, introduces herself and leads the fight against Melanta
introduced.quote: Greetings, newcomers. My name is Istoria. I hail from the age when the Dark Dragon King rent the sky open.

introduced.name: Melanta
introduced.how: the other Watcher who took control of the temple and grew mad, punishing its inhabitants
introduced.quote: The one who remained, Melanta, grew increasingly severe with us.

introduced.name: Josephus
introduced.how: a temple inhabitant and friend of Istoria, freed from the Domain Keepers
introduced.quote: It's Josephus. I came out mainly to rescue him.

introduced.name: Hilda
introduced.how: Zeitlind's older sister, who was in the temple earlier and knew its inhabitants
introduced.quote: More cases like Hilda's, then?

introduced.name: Domain Keepers
introduced.how: temple guards of several types that hunt inhabitants and seize relics
introduced.quote: Organization-type Keepers usually don't harm people either. Unless you try to steal relics, that is.

introduced.name: Memory Core
introduced.how: a spot in the temple where suppression-type guards cannot enter
introduced.quote: It's safer here. I don't know why, but the suppression-type guards can't get in.

introduced.name: Pillar Hall Central Zone
introduced.how: the center of the Pillar Hall of Space, the heart of the temple
introduced.quote: Look. That is the center of the Pillar Hall of Space.

introduced.name: God of Space
introduced.how: the god who created the temple and has since vanished, whose sacred hall it was
introduced.quote: This was once the sacred hall of the God of Space.

introduced.name: Escher
introduced.how: an unlucky, ill-natured painter from long ago, also called Maukie by the temple's inhabitants
introduced.quote: Just an unlucky, ill-natured painter.

introduced.name: Luyang Academy
introduced.how: a preserved academy from ancient Liyue, now devoted to art and painting
introduced.quote: Take, for example, the Luyang Academy from ancient Liyue.

introduced.name: Venipi
introduced.how: a laborer who hauled stone for a royal mausoleum and rebuilt a desert-style complex under orders
introduced.quote: Then there's Venipi, a laborer who once hauled stone for The Mausoleum of King Deshret.

introduced.name: Desert Pavilion
introduced.how: a desert-style complex rebuilt inside the temple by Venipi
introduced.quote: Under orders, he rebuilt a desert style complex called the Desert Pavilion.

introduced.name: Mahavaipulya Chamber
introduced.how: a chamber of ancient texts and new novels written by some of the uplifted
introduced.quote: Last is my personal favorite, the Mahavaipulya Chamber.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: a past civilization whose view of the Blubberbeast is recorded on a temple plaque
introduced.quote: the 'lazy and degenerate lower creature' (as the Remurians once called it) has wandered through the seas far longer than the entirety of Remuria's own civilization endured.

introduced.name: uplifting
introduced.how: the temple selects people and objects from past ages or lost civilizations and preserves them as living memories
introduced.quote: The Temple of Space selects people and objects from a specific historical age or a now-vanished civilization, using them as the smallest possible segments.

introduced.name: Zeitlind's suitcase
introduced.how: a case of her sister's belongings that Zeitlind meant to say goodbye to, later scattered through the temple
introduced.quote: Not really. Just some things I needed to say goodbye to before leaving.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: You scared the old man at the gate last night, so the Knights sent us to investigate.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: A hundred years from now, let's find each other again in the wandering winds of Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: showing the Statue of the Anemo Archon in reversed position

assumed.name: Apathic Interval
assumed.quote: Newcomers who have only recently passed the trial of the Apathic Interval, maybe?

assumed.name: Dark Dragon King
assumed.quote: I hail from the age when the Dark Dragon King rent the sky open.

assumed.name: Remurian Centurion
assumed.quote: do any of you have combat strength on par with a junior Remurian Centurion or higher?

assumed.name: Pankration
assumed.quote: Let's head out and show them what Pankration, or maybe Machaira, means to you.

threads.claim: The Temple of Space is trapped in an inverted fate that the Traveler must free.
threads.quote: I beg that you ascend to the high heavens and free the Aiones of the past from their inverted fates.

threads.claim: Zeitlind's missing sister Hilda's fate and whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Well, I'm just here to look for her.

threads.claim: Hilda had been inside the Temple of Space and knew its inhabitants, deepening the mystery of her disappearance.
threads.quote: More cases like Hilda's, then?

threads.claim: Rumors claim ghosts haunt the sanatorium and that those who go there never return.
threads.quote: The sanatorium's haunted! Seriously! I saw them ghosts with my own eyes!

threads.claim: Paimon dismisses the ghost talk as elemental and scientific phenomena, while hinting that ghosts have been met before.
threads.quote: Eh, true. We've run into ghosts before, too. Most of them were actually pretty easy to talk to.

threads.claim: Time behaves strangely for those who have passed through the temple's realm.
threads.quote: Mm. I'm fine. My sense of time's a bit off, though.

threads.claim: The Traveler has lived through a very long span of time that others do not experience.
threads.quote: About... five hundred years?

threads.claim: The God of Space who ruled the temple has vanished and is nowhere to be found.
threads.quote: This was once the sacred hall of the God of Space. But she is nowhere to be found.

threads.claim: Melanta, driven by longing for his creator, reversed the temple's rules and became mad.
threads.quote: Then Melanta, driven by longing for his creator, reversed all the rules to their original form.

threads.claim: Nihilita is revealed to be a Watcher who fell from grace and departed from the temple.
threads.quote: Correct. The Watcher who introduced Dex to you is one who departed. Nihilita of Nothingness.

threads.claim: Escher, a painter from long ago, is a figure of unclear fame whom the temple's inhabitants nickname Maukie.
threads.quote: Just an unlucky, ill-natured painter.

threads.claim: The temple was meant to preserve human culture as segments, but some uplifted things developed their own functions.
threads.quote: The temple was originally meant to preserve them as segments of human culture, though some gradually developed their own functions.

threads.claim: Those who strayed from the temple's preservation purpose were the first to be punished.
threads.quote: But since the purpose of the Temple of Space is preservation rather than evolution, they were also the first to face punishment.

threads.claim: The Apathic Interval is a trial or exile that the temple's inhabitants can be sent to.
threads.quote: Is this... the process for a repeat exile to the Apathic Interval? But why?

threads.claim: Dex's true identity and the secret signal it sent are unclear.
threads.quote: No. We call it Dex too. But it just sent me a secret signal.

threads.claim: Zeitlind's suitcase was classified as a relic and its contents were scattered across the temple's areas.
threads.quote: Then it's as I suspected. Your suitcase and everything inside it have been classified as relics of this age.

threads.claim: Remuria was an ancient civilization whose extent and fate are hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: the 'lazy and degenerate lower creature' (as the Remurians once called it) has wandered through the seas far longer than the entirety of Remuria's own civilization endured.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A prison where the Traveler and Paimon were held for 45 days and now must complete release papers
introduced.quote: At the Fortress of Meropide, the Traveler and Paimon wake up well-rested in their cell.

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: The Fortress's warden, a Duke, who can tell surface tremors from seafloor ones
introduced.quote: Over the years of serving as the warden here, I've developed a sense for distinguishing between what occurs on the surface and what occurs underwater.

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: Neuvillette's busy headquarters where guests are welcomed into his office
introduced.quote: After seeing the two off, they head to the Palais Mermonia to speak to Neuvillette.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Official who placed the Fortress seal and runs the Palais, handling disaster planning
introduced.quote: Wriothesley reminds them that the seal that Neuvillette had placed earlier would not fail

introduced.name: Sedene
introduced.how: Palais staff member who checks visitors and lets them into Neuvillette's office
introduced.quote: Sedene spots them, but as they're welcomed guests, lets them enter Neuvillette's office.

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: Coastal city hit by a tremor and sudden flooding, now with wounded residents and rescue crews
introduced.quote: The two arrive at Poisson where they find the city devoid of normal activity as Spina di Rosula members rush to aid the wounded.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Organization led by Navia that runs rescue operations in Poisson and has its headquarters there
introduced.quote: Yes, Spina di Rosula's headquarters is there.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: Spina di Rosula leader and her late father's successor, grieving two of her companions
introduced.quote: As my father's successor, I must live up to the hopes he had in me.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: Navia's late father, buried in the cemetery at Poisson
introduced.quote: they had previously requested that she bury them by Callas' side when their time came

introduced.name: Melus and Silver
introduced.how: Navia's close companions and Callas's associates, who died trying to evacuate residents
introduced.quote: I can understand. Besides, the scenery here isn't half bad.

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: A deadly sea whose water dissolves people and that ordinary people cannot normally enter
introduced.quote: Judging from your description, that cannot have occurred in any ordinary waters, but rather, something like the Primordial Sea.

introduced.name: Childe's Vision
introduced.how: A vision in which the group saw a massive narwhal-like entity
introduced.quote: informing him of the narwhal-like entity they saw from Childe's Vision

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: A group whose members see each other as family, and which has ties to Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet
introduced.quote: The House of the Hearth's members see each other as family.

introduced.name: The Knave
introduced.how: A Fatui Harbinger who leads relief work in Poisson and offers the Traveler a ruin-exploration task
introduced.quote: Besides, it never even crossed my mind that a Fatui Harbinger would come looking for me.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: An organization whose soldiers aid Poisson's relief, observe water levels, and stock supplies
introduced.quote: Thanks to The Knave, Spina di Rosula received generous support from the Fatui, which allowed us to complete the rescue and evacuation work so quickly.

introduced.name: Ruins near Poisson
introduced.how: Ancient ruins south of Poisson, discovered by a child, that may relate to the prophecy
introduced.quote: During some recent investigations, a child claimed to have discovered some ruins near Poisson.

introduced.name: The prophecy
introduced.how: A prophecy of impending disaster that The Knave knows of and intends to prevent
introduced.quote: As I've told before, I know of the prophecy, and I intend to prevent the impending disaster.

introduced.name: Primordial Seawater
introduced.how: contaminated water that dissolves anyone who falls into it
introduced.quote: A Fontainian would most likely dissolve the moment they fell in.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Navia's organization, led by her after Callas, which helps the people of Poisson
introduced.quote: As all here know, you are Master Callas's successor, the head of the Spina di Rosula — someone held in high regard by every soul in Poisson.

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: the opera house where Navia's trial is held
introduced.quote: (They arrive at the Opera Epiclese)

introduced.name: Nation of Justice
introduced.how: Fontaine's self-description, where all is measured by collective opinion and consensus
introduced.quote: This is the Nation of Justice, the Nation of Hydro.

introduced.name: Oceanids
introduced.how: people dissolved in the water may become Oceanids that protect others
introduced.quote: I think I saw two Oceanids protecting you.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Hunters
introduced.how: a former Fontaine group that hunted monsters left by King Remus's dynasty, not animals
introduced.quote: Though that was their name, they did not hunt animals, but rather various monsters left behind by the ancient dynasty of King Remus.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of long-lived, extraordinary astrologers and mages to which Mona's master belongs
introduced.quote: The Hexenzirkel members are certainly anything but ordinary.

introduced.name: Mona
introduced.how: a Mondstadt-born astrologist who took the name Megistus as the disciple of Trismegistus
introduced.quote: Well, I was born in Mondstadt, yes.

introduced.name: Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus
introduced.how: Mona's master, a great astrologist and member of the Hexenzirkel
introduced.quote: Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus.

introduced.name: N

introduced.quote: The underwater stronghold, the Fortress of Meropide, has continued in its noble autonomy, but that does not mean that others cannot interact with it.

introduced.name: The Steambird

introduced.quote: Just a while back, The Steambird invited me to take part in a panel and speak about the circulation of the prophecy as an astrologist.

introduced.name: Isadora

threads.claim: Neuvillette wonders how Childe got into the Primordial Sea, which ordinary people cannot normally enter.
threads.quote: Most people wouldn't be capable of entering in the first place. I'm not completely sure how he could have gotten there, myself.

threads.claim: A massive narwhal-like entity seen in a vision is linked to Childe and the Primordial Sea.
threads.quote: A whale of that size and shape cannot usually be found in the waters of Teyvat.

threads.claim: The tremor came from the surface and caused water to rise in Poisson, possibly tied to leaking Primordial Seawater.
threads.quote: If the change in water levels is connected with the leaking Primordial Seawater, then the situation in Poisson may be much worse than it appears.

threads.claim: The Knave knows of a prophecy of impending disaster and intends to stop it.
threads.quote: As I've told before, I know of the prophecy, and I intend to prevent the impending disaster.

threads.claim: Ancient ruins near Poisson may be connected to the prophecy and the coming crisis.
threads.quote: Judging by the dating of the ruins, they may be related to the prophecy and the coming crisis.

threads.claim: The Knave's aim is to change fate rather than accept the prophesied outcome.
threads.quote: So you're one who will try to change fate, then?

threads.claim: A prophecy inscribed on the slates foretells that Fontaine will be destroyed and its people dissolved.
threads.quote: Reason dictates that this nation be destroyed.

threads.claim: Neuvillette finds the slates' contents correspond to the prophecy, and the Traveler doubts whether it will truly play out.
threads.quote: That would fit the circumstances dictated by the prophecy, yes.

threads.claim: Mage N confirms that the prophecy will be fulfilled, calling it the history of the future.
threads.quote: Yes, what has been prophesized will be fulfilled.

threads.claim: The previous Hydro Archon Egeria once had to confess to or apologize for a sin, and Furina may know of it.
threads.quote: My deciphering of the slates indicates that the Hydro Archon Egeria once had to confess to, or apologize for, a certain sin.

threads.claim: Furina has been secretly investigating the prophecy and hides information from her inner circle.
threads.quote: I have long known of your various secret investigations into certain matters.

threads.claim: Mage N hints that the gods' view of fate has blind spots where events may differ from what is prophesied.
threads.quote: Just as prophecies are usually only the future as seen from the perspectives of the gods, could things be happening in hidden corners where the gods' gaze does not fall?

threads.claim: Mona believes fate cannot be swayed, though she still hopes for miracles.
threads.quote: So far as I have seen, it cannot be swayed.

threads.claim: Dissolved people may remain as Oceanids that protect those they cared about.
threads.quote: I think I saw two Oceanids protecting you.

threads.claim: Navia realizes her dead companions keep protecting her even after death.
threads.quote: To think that they'd keep doing so even after death...

threads.claim: A recent disaster in Poisson left many victims, and the Traveler and Neuvillette failed to prevent it.
threads.quote: This is a list of the victims from the recent Poisson incident.

threads.claim: Navia dreams of Melus and Silver alive at a trial, raising doubt about what she actually experienced.
threads.quote: I must have been dreaming... Melus and Silver were still alive, and they were... they were defending me at some insane trial.

threads.claim: A mysterious mage named N speaks through the tea, and the Traveler senses a deliberate clue.
threads.quote: Call me N, a mage who wanders the world.

threads.claim: Fontaine's Nation of Trials treats the majority opinion as absolute justice.
threads.quote: We are the majority, and in the Nation of Trials, the majority is absolute justice.

threads.claim: The prophecy is presented as an unavoidable fate that the Heavenly Principles will enforce.
threads.quote: We cannot make an enemy of the divine. No matter what we do, the will of the Heavenly Principles will have its way, and the prophecy shall be fulfilled...

threads.claim: The prophecy seems to be fulfilling itself through the trial, and the Traveler wonders whether it can be escaped.
threads.quote: Navia: In truth, everything we've done has happened exactly as the prophecy foretold...

threads.claim: Furina may never have been the true Hydro Archon, and the Traveler charges her as a fraud.
threads.quote: Instead, I would like to charge you as a fraud who's never been the Archon in the first place.

threads.claim: The previous Hydro Archon sensed the Oceanids' longing for land and created humans from them.
threads.quote: In the Fontaine of old, the previous Hydro Archon sensed the yearning of her Oceanid familiars for life on land.

threads.claim: Celestia's judgment on the Hydro Archon and her people is recorded as an original sin.
threads.quote: This must be the point when the Hydro Archon and the Fontainians were branded with their "original sin."

threads.claim: The original sin was the Hydro Archon creating humans by appropriating the power of the Primordial Sea.
threads.quote: And thus, the Hydro Archon and all of her creations came to shoulder the original sin of "appropriating the power of the Primordial Sea."

threads.claim: Fontainians are not natural humans but were created from Oceanids by the previous Hydro Archon.
threads.quote: All Fontainians were originally created by the late previous Hydro Archon, with Oceanids as their basis.

threads.claim: A huge whale from the dream is tied to the Primordial Sea and may be the true cause of the disaster.
threads.quote: Traveler: It was both dream and reality.

threads.claim: The whale is a star-traveling monster that has been consuming the Primordial Sea and is now integrated with it.
threads.quote: So, we've met it at last... I understand very well why it has chosen to make an appearance here.

threads.claim: Furina was about to reveal a secret right before the trial, and the Traveler wants to know what it is.
threads.quote: Traveler: (What is her real secret?)

threads.claim: Furina longs to give up and be free from fate, though she rejects that path for now.
threads.quote: It would mean finally coming to terms with fate, but also... for me to finally be free.

threads.claim: The serial disappearances of young women were caused by Vacher dissolving them, linking them to the Oceanid origin of Fontainians.
threads.quote: how all the girls Vacher dissolved were also turned into Oceanids

threads.claim: The earthquake and Poisson house were a staged magic box that carried Furina to the trial stage.
threads.quote: So, in other words... the "earthquake" that we felt within the Giant Magic Box was just a normal tremor from the transportation of the whole house?

threads.claim: The Oratrice invoked the title of the Hydro Archon rather than Furina, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: But now, the Oratrice seems to have deliberately invoked the title of the "Hydro Archon." What does this mean?

threads.claim: The stone slates carry an additional hidden layer of information that Neuvillette has yet to decipher.
threads.quote: they had also been etched with an additional layer of hidden information using a different power source.

threads.claim: The entrance to the Primordial Sea was sealed, but the seal may not hold for long.
threads.quote: Though Neuvillette has sealed it once more, just how long will it last?

threads.claim: Focalors frames the prophecy of Fontaine's dissolution as the pernicious cause of the whole deception.
threads.quote: It's all because of that pernicious prophecy.

threads.claim: The Person in the Mirror confirms the prophecy will come and that Fontaine's disaster is unavoidable without a masquerade.
threads.quote: Disaster will come to Fontaine sooner or later.

threads.claim: Skirk suggests the prophecy is now in full swing after the Narwhal's defeat, undercutting the idea that it was averted.
threads.quote: the prophecy that you have been fretting over should now be in full swing.

threads.claim: The citizens seem to have survived the flood, and the sailor declares the prophecy wrong, though the scene leaves its truth open.
threads.quote: The prophecy was wrong! The prophecy was wrong!

threads.claim: Furina is revealed as the human half of Focalors' divinity, left behind when Focalors became a god.
threads.quote: the human counterpart I left behind, I named

threads.claim: Focalors bids farewell to Furina and asks her to live as a human, closing the split between them.
threads.quote: Thank you, Furina

threads.claim: Focalors deceived the Heavenly Principles by making the prophecy appear fulfilled while saving everyone.
threads.quote: I had to outwit the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Neuvillette states that Focalors has already managed to deceive the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: Focalors has... already managed to deceive the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Lyney reported hearing a human voice inside the Oratrice's core chamber, a clue to a hidden person.
threads.quote: Lyney did mention that he heard a

threads.claim: Focalors was hidden within the Oratrice all along, having become one with the machine.
threads.quote: hidden within the machine all along.

threads.claim: The Oratrice was built to destroy the God of Justice and the divine throne, not to deliver justice.
threads.quote: It is, in fact, a device created to kill the God of Justice.

threads.claim: Focalors spent five centuries accumulating Indemnitium in the Oratrice for the death sentence.
threads.quote: has been to constantly accumulate Indemnitium within the Oratrice.

threads.claim: Almost all the stored Indemnitium now sits inside the Oratrice, ready to destroy the divine throne.
threads.quote: Almost all of it has now been stored within the Oratrice

threads.claim: Focalors frames the return of the Hydro Archon's authority to the Hydro Dragon as the true goal.
threads.quote: the power you ancient dragons possessed

threads.claim: Neuvillette gains enough strength from the dragons' power to separate the Primordial Sea's power from the Narwhal.
threads.quote: I have gained the strength sufficient to deal with it.

threads.claim: Egeria is said to have stolen the power of the Primordial Sea, leaving that theft as a founding sin.
threads.quote: Egeria stole the power of the Primordial Sea

threads.claim: Focalors recasts the theft of the Primordial Sea's might as Fontaine's original sin.
threads.quote: So if the theft of the Primordial Sea's might was Fontaine's

threads.claim: Neuvillette forgives the people of Fontaine's sins after the death sentence is carried out.
threads.quote: People of Fontaine, your sins are forgiven

threads.claim: Furina cannot die under Focalors' curse but is trapped playing the god in the opera.
threads.quote: Under the curse I placed on her, so long as I, Focalors' divinity, continued to exist, she could not die.

threads.claim: Focalors' death lifts the curse, so Furina is left free to live as a human.
threads.quote: Please live happily as a human

threads.claim: A mysterious mirror-self of Furina arranges the masquerade, and her true nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Be not nervous. Be not afraid. I am before you.

threads.claim: The Person in the Mirror warns that the true challenge is contending with humanity rather than pursuing divinity.
threads.quote: your true challenge will not be pursuing

threads.claim: Skirk's master, Surtalogi, is named but remains unknown to the Traveler and Neuvillette.
threads.quote: His name is Surtalogi.

threads.claim: A figure called The Visionary, Vedrfolnir, is hinted at as one of Skirk's master's titles.
threads.quote: Vedrfolnir then?

threads.claim: The Narwhal's instinct to devour makes it hostile and exploitable in the fight.
threads.quote: The All-Devouring Narwhal cannot resist its instinct to

threads.claim: The All-Devouring Narwhal is defeated, though Skirk's remarks suggest it was a pet of a greater master.
threads.quote: After defeating the All-Devouring Narwhal

threads.claim: The Traveler offers to be a witness for Furina, casting them as a spectator of her suffering.
threads.quote: Just share it with me. I'm what you'd call a

threads.claim: Furina suggests Teyvat itself may be a stage and the Traveler merely a spectator.
threads.quote: if Teyvat is, in its entirety, a show on a stage

threads.claim: Furina reveals her loneliness and pain over centuries, which makes her crying and hidden burden central.
threads.quote: I never imagined that it would hurt so much

threads.claim: Skirk suggests the Gnoses are the remains of a Third Descender, raising the question of what they really are.
threads.quote: You should have the "remains of the Third Descender" on your person, yes?

threads.claim: Neuvillette confirms the Gnoses come from the Third Descender, linking them to Descenders.
threads.quote: That means that the Gnoses, which are exceedingly element-compatible and can even enhance elemental abilities, do indeed come from the Third Descender.

threads.claim: Traveler reveals they are the Fourth Descender and that the one before them has died.
threads.quote: I am the Fourth Descender.

threads.claim: Who the Third Descender was and when they died remains unknown.
threads.quote: This Third Descender you refer to. Who are they? And when did they die?

threads.claim: Skirk's master, The Foul, may hold answers about the Third Descender.
threads.quote: If you're interested, though, I could ask him. I'll be sure to pass the answer on to you next time.

threads.claim: Skirk warns that objects of misfortune like the Gnosis could bring disaster, and that the dead's bonds turn to curses.
threads.quote: Regardless, you should probably get rid of objects of "misfortune," to prevent any disasters from befalling you.

threads.claim: Neuvillette gives the Gnosis away because it has lost meaning for Fontaine and he does not need its power.
threads.quote: The Oratrice has ceased to function. The Hydro Archon's divine throne is now no more. And I do not need the Gnosis's power...

threads.claim: The Knave treats his allegiances as masks he switches freely, hinting at hidden loyalties.
threads.quote: Switching my masks is something I've always done.

threads.claim: The Knave says the Fatui's goal concerns the entire world rather than any single place or person.
threads.quote: The goal of the Fatui concerns not a single place or person, but the entire world.

threads.claim: Natlan is a land of dragons who coexist with humans and also a land of endless war.
threads.quote: Unlike ancient dragons such as myself, the dragons of Natlan have undergone long years of development and evolution.

threads.claim: The Captain has joined the war in Natlan, a looming Harbinger threat for the Traveler.
threads.quote: The Harbinger known as The Captain has thrown his hat into the endless ring of war.

threads.claim: Paimon questions whether Focalors' sacrifice and suffering as a human was what she truly wanted, and Neuvillette calls it a mystery of a god's will.
threads.quote: Was that really what she wanted?

threads.claim: Neuvillette's verdict made Fontainians true humans, answering how the people were saved from dissolving.
threads.quote: when I gave my verdict, Fontainians became "true humans,"

threads.claim: Childe's chasm fall awakened the All-Devouring Narwhal, but Neuvillette says that alone should not make him the root cause.
threads.quote: that should not have been enough to consider him the root cause of the disaster.

threads.claim: Furina abdicated as Hydro Archon, handed her duties to Neuvillette, and left the opera house.
threads.quote: She abdicated the post of Hydro Archon and left affairs related to that title to me, before leaving the opera house.

threads.claim: The opera house can no longer produce Indemnitium, which came from faith in the Hydro Archon.
threads.quote: Which is that the opera house shall no longer produce Indemnitium.

threads.claim: Neuvillette's full command of Pneumousia replaces the power source the city's machines lost.
threads.quote: As I am now, I have full command over Pneumousia, and it can serve as a complete substitute

threads.claim: Fontainians' prayers at the Fountain of Lucine were a ritual that blessed Oceanids to become new humans.
threads.quote: Those Oceanids who were blessed within the spring water would later descend as new humans in the coming months.

introduced.name: Jean
introduced.how: the Acting Grand Master who personally oversees the accounts and carries heavy workload
introduced.quote: Acting Grand Master Jean personally goes over all the accounts.

introduced.name: Vennessa
introduced.how: the first Grand Master, a kind but formidable woman who founded the Knights
introduced.quote: Vennessa was the first Grand Master, a kind yet formidable woman.

introduced.name: Dandelion Knight and Lionfang Knight
introduced.how: titles held by Knights of Favonius Masters, originally inherited from Vennessa
introduced.quote: all of the Knights of Favonius' Masters throughout the ages have inherited the title of

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: the order Vennessa founded to spread grace and compassion in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Then, she founded the Knights of Favonius and became known as the Dandelion Knight, spreading grace and compassion throughout the land.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage
introduced.how: a hostile mage that appears from hiding and seeks to exploit Jean's weakness
introduced.quote: (An Abyss Mage shows itself)

introduced.name: Windrise
introduced.how: a place with a huge tree where Jean goes when she feels lost and confused
introduced.quote: Barbara tells them that Jean went off to Windrise, stating that Jean always goes there whenever she's confused.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: a town whose suppliers deliver ingredients along a road to Good Hunter
introduced.quote: the route between here and Springvale, which is used for the delivery of our ingredients, seems to have been occupied by the hilichurls.

introduced.name: Good Hunter
introduced.how: Sara's restaurant that depends on ingredient deliveries from Springvale
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's Sara from Good Hunter!

introduced.name: Prince
introduced.how: Margaret's black cat that has gone missing
introduced.quote: Margaret: I mean little Princey. Prince was just home, now he's gone.

introduced.name: Margaret
introduced.how: a townsperson whose cat Prince has gone missing and who asks for help
introduced.quote: Margaret: My cat's gone missing. Have you seen it?

introduced.name: Charles
introduced.how: a client who needs Jean to send his quarterly tax return forms
introduced.quote: Charles: What do you think this is, kiddo, a fruit juice store?

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: a wealthy winery that is central to Mondstadt's wine trade
introduced.quote: Traveler: And yet the Dawn Winery is somehow so very rich.

introduced.name: Ernest
introduced.how: a winery worker whose delivery was ambushed by hilichurls
introduced.quote: Ernest: In all the time I've been working at the winery, this is the first time I've been robbed by hilichurls. *sigh*

introduced.name: astral iron strings
introduced.how: lyre strings made of astral iron that hold Anemo energy and are rolled into a ball
introduced.quote: These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy.

introduced.name: Sticky Honey Roast
introduced.how: a signature Good Hunter dish that the Knights often order
introduced.quote: That's right, a mainstay of the Good Hunter menu. It's my pride and joy!

introduced.name: Barbara
introduced.how: a healer at the Cathedral who treats Jean's burnout
introduced.quote: Barbara: It's just burnout from work stress. She'll be fine after a good old rest.

introduced.name: Cat's Tail
introduced.how: a tavern where Margaret offers to treat helpers to a brew
introduced.quote: Margaret: Please mention it to Jean for me. I'll treat you to a brew at Cat's Tail later.

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Charles: That's mostly down to Master Diluc's successful business model.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Paimon: So courteous and polite. This isn't the Kaeya Paimon knows.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Paimon: Indeed. Just like Barbatos...

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Barbara: Great! That puts my mind at rest. May the Anemo Archon protect you... and Jean.

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Jean: Oh! It's our Honorary Knight. Sorry, I must have been daydreaming.

assumed.name: Elzer
assumed.quote: It's time to get Elzer onto doing the accounts again

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: Sara also tells them to visit Charles at Angel's Share as he also has a request to submit.

assumed.name: Outrider
assumed.quote: Amber: Oh, hi. Yeah, I was just getting ready. Who better than an Outrider to mop up some hilichurls on the delivery route?

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: why not track him with your Elemental Sight?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: You'd better because I certainly don't have the Mora to replace them.

threads.claim: Jean measures herself against Vennessa and fears she cannot match the first Grand Master's legacy.
threads.quote: Jean: Lady Vennessa, I hope your watch over Mondstadt remains unclouded.

threads.claim: Jean decides she is more a Dandelion Knight, embracing Vennessa's hopes for the future over her past.
threads.quote: Jean: I am definitely more of a Dandelion Knight than a Lionfang Knight.

threads.claim: The Abyss Mages seem to know about Jean's weakness, hinting at an organized plot against the Knights.
threads.quote: Paimon: How did they know about Jean's condition?

threads.claim: Jean ties the wind to Vennessa's watch and to the freedom that will guide the Knights forward.
threads.quote: Jean: Let the Wind lead. The winds of freedom will guide us along the path that lies ahead.

threads.claim: Jean pushes herself too hard and overlooks her own needs, a burden others notice.
threads.quote: Barbara: Jean is not as strong as she comes off. It's so good that you're here for her.

threads.claim: Astral iron is said to contain Anemo energy, hinting at its unusual properties.
threads.quote: These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: Name Engraver and craftsman of the tribe who runs a workshop and forges tools
introduced.quote: The next day, Traveler and Paimon visit Xilonen in her workshop.

introduced.name: Avilix
introduced.how: a tribe member who visits the workshop and is losing her memory
introduced.quote: Avilix mentions that Nechca's birthday is coming soon and asks Xilonen if she's planning to visit her.

introduced.name: Nechca
introduced.how: a young girl whose long illness has kept her in bed for years
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, no. Nechca's illness has kept flaring up over the past few years.

introduced.name: Tlazolli
introduced.how: Nechca's mother and a skilled Name Engraver who has stopped working
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: I was the one who decided to move my workshop to the outskirts of our tribe for work... and I was the one who left her home alone.

introduced.name: Blazegem Inscription
introduced.how: a stone keepsake that can hold engraved wishes and is tied to lost memories
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: They... Are actually accidental byproducts from my first time forging an Ancient Name.

introduced.name: Name Engraver
introduced.how: the forger of Ancient Names who makes Inscriptions and other engraved objects
introduced.quote: This Blazegem Inscription was still made by a Name Engraver, the forger of Ancient Names themselves.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: an engraved forged object that can be adjusted into a working Ancient Name
introduced.quote: By making just a few slight adjustments to the layout and connections of the main pattern, you can pretty much qualify this Blazegem Inscription as a bona fide Ancient Name.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Engraving
introduced.how: a very complex engraving found inside a Blazegem Inscription
introduced.quote: For what's only supposed to be a pretty souvenir, this Inscription contains a Phlogiston Engraving with a truly overkill level of complexity.

introduced.name: Woven scrolls
introduced.how: threaded scrolls that record memories and fade over time unless rewoven
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: Well, generally speaking, forgetting things is like when the woven scrolls would gradually start to fade.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: a dark realm whose monsters and corruption caused Nechca's injuries
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: Nechca's illness actually originates from the Abyss.

introduced.name: Abyss monster attack on the tribe
introduced.how: a night when Abyss monsters attacked the tribe and Nechca vanished
introduced.quote: A horde of monsters from the Abyss suddenly attacked the tribe, so everyone banded together to fight them off.

introduced.name: Embercore Flower
introduced.how: a flower Nechca was holding when found, tied to her request for an Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: She was holding a dried-up Embercore Flower in her hand, and there were traces of Abyssal corruption around her wounds.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: memories are stored in the Ley Lines and Ancient Names need Wayob approval to extract them
introduced.quote: Xilonen: And the reason they must be approved by the Wayob is because the memories they bear are all stored within the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Central Inscription
introduced.how: a master Inscription that controls all the other Blazegem Inscriptions
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: This is the Central Inscription that controls all the other Blazegem Inscriptions...

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: a group whose messengers deliver goods and climb the cliffs near the tribe
introduced.quote: Xilonen: A messenger from the Scions of the Canopy wouldn't be flying here.

introduced.name: Tlapal
introduced.how: a delivery man carrying ingredients who has a Blazegem Inscription
introduced.quote: Tlapal: Hey, you there! Sorry, but does Tlazolli live around here?

introduced.name: Tequil the Brave
introduced.how: a fairy tale book about twin brothers fighting a demon lord, with two published versions
introduced.quote: Xilonen: The premise of the book is pretty straightforward. It's basically about a set of twin brothers working to defeat a demon lord.

introduced.name: Coatlicue
introduced.how: a demon lord and mother of the underworld who is the antagonist of the Tequil story
introduced.quote: Yet the defeat of her evil underlings caught the eye of their master, Coatlicue.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: each Ancient Name is the physical form of a spirit or spiritual will, built from related stories
introduced.quote: Xilonen: In other words, the essence of an Ancient Name is the physical manifestation of a certain spiritual will.

introduced.name: Name Engraver
introduced.how: the job of forging Ancient Names: giving them physical shape and understanding the spirit within
introduced.quote: Xilonen: And as a Name Engraver, when I'm working on a new Ancient Name, I'm not only trying to give it a physical shape...

introduced.name: Central Inscription
introduced.how: Tlazolli's large Inscription holding the blessing she prepared for Nechca, which Xilonen disassembles
introduced.quote: Xilonen: But since it's the Central Inscription... It would be better not to destroy the blessing that Auntie has prepared for Nechca.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Wedges
introduced.how: used to draw an engraving diagram on a cliff or open ground before engraving an Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Xilonen: Before we attempt to engrave the inside pattern of an Ancient Name with phlogiston, we always use this to draw out the engraving diagram on a cliff or open ground.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a substance used to engrave diagrams and flow through internal engravings
introduced.quote: Xilonen: I'm going to use phlogiston to make an engraving circle on the cliff wall. That will allow me to investigate the internals of the Central Inscription.

introduced.name: Names as blessings
introduced.how: a name is a blessing prepared by someone in the past that stays with a person into the future
introduced.quote: Xilonen: From the moment you appeared in this world, some person had already prepared a blessing for you.

introduced.name: Rimac
introduced.how: Tequil's brother who was possessed by Coatlicue but never forgot Tequil
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh... the one who was possessed by Coatlicue but never forgot his brother Tequil. He was also an amazing character!

introduced.name: Coatlicue
introduced.how: the villain of Tequil the Brave who ate Rimac and took his appearance in the old version
introduced.quote: Paimon: But isn't she the villain? In the old version, she even ate Rimac and took on his appearance.

introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.how: the girl Tlazolli took in, who introduces herself by name
introduced.quote: Nepecha: My name's... Nepecha

introduced.name: Abyss attack
introduced.how: an attack that killed the parents of the girl Tlazolli adopted
introduced.quote: Tlazolli: She's a child from my tribe. Her parents were killed in that same Abyss attack, but wouldn't you know it... Her birthday is the same as that of my Nechca.

introduced.name: Blazegem Inscriptions
introduced.how: Absorb people's memories, and those memories return to owners once the inscriptions stop working
introduced.quote: The memories that were absorbed by the Blazegem Inscriptions can be restored to their owners.

introduced.name: Tlazolli
introduced.how: Misused an Ancient Name to commit a crime, so her workshop is being permanently closed
introduced.quote: What I do know is that Tlazolli's workshop will be closed permanently, and any remaining incomplete Blazegem Inscriptions will be completely destroyed.

introduced.name: Tribe forgetting Nechca
introduced.how: Tlazolli's attempt to bring Nechca back made the whole tribe forget her
introduced.quote: In her attempt to get Nechca to come back, Auntie made the entire tribe forget about her.

introduced.name: Nechca
introduced.how: Is gone, and the tribe is about to regain memories of her
introduced.quote: Now, Nechca really is gone, but everyone is about to remember her... What a bizarre turn of events.

introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.how: Has a history that will be officially investigated, and is being taken in by Xilonen
introduced.quote: She's resting in my workshop. I contacted others from the tribe, and told them about my plan to conduct an official investigation into her history.

assumed.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
assumed.quote: Xilonen: How's your Pilgrim's Chronicle been? Run into any issues?

assumed.name: As the Sun Rises and Sets
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed step 12 of As the Sun Rises and Sets)

assumed.name: Lord of the Night
assumed.quote: Good. It was my first time working with the Lord of the Night to forge an Ancient Name, and you're not even from Natlan.

assumed.name: Mualani and Spiritway
assumed.quote: Less than the chances of Mualani accidentally falling off a Spiritway, I'd say.

assumed.name: Iknal and Pacal
assumed.quote: The garden hoe belongs to Iknal and the hammer is Pacal's, so make sure you take the one that's yours.

assumed.name: Cheven
assumed.quote: Sounds just like one of Cheven's schemes...

assumed.name: Erinle
assumed.quote: Maybe I should go talk to Erinle to get some medicine...

assumed.name: Wish Granter
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sounds kinda like a Wish Granter...

assumed.name: Xocoatl
assumed.quote: Xocoatl... What does it taste like?

assumed.name: Volcanic Crystal
assumed.quote: She even wants to use Volcanic Crystal as a forging material

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: Traveler: But Ancient Names must be approved by the Wayob...

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: You know about the woven scrolls that the Masters of the Night-Wind use to record things, right?

assumed.name: Yumkasaur
assumed.quote: Paimon thought we'd see someone come flying down on a Yumkasaur as soon as we came out.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: The last time you came to visit, you were still just a kid. But now you're a pillar of the Children of Echoes... No, of all Natlan even!

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: Let's head back to the tribe first. There are some things I need to get from my workshop.

assumed.name: Tlazolli
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: Ah, Xilonen. It looks like... you've made your decision. Am I right?

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Xilonen: Kachina suffered quite an unfortunate series of events the last time she went inside...

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is that the power of the Children of Echoes?

assumed.name: Pacal
assumed.quote: Xilonen: But once this is all over, you must come with me to see Pacal and discuss everything that happened.

assumed.name: Iknal
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: Let's go look for Iknal. I've had her Blazegem Inscription for a while now, and I'll finally return it to her today.

assumed.name: Apoxpalon
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: Next, let's visit Apoxpalon, he should be close by.

assumed.name: Cheven
assumed.quote: Tlazolli: Right, let's go see Cheven and head back home.

assumed.name: Pacal
assumed.quote: Pacal will have a lot on his plate.

assumed.name: Ancient Names
assumed.quote: Anyway, at least her Ancient Name is fine, otherwise, we'd have a real mess on our hands...

assumed.name: The tribe
assumed.quote: Well, the tribe is still discussing that.

threads.claim: Townspeople carrying Blazegem Inscriptions are forgetting things, possibly linked to Nechca.
threads.quote: Paimon: That's so weird... Why is everyone we've run into today having trouble remembering stuff?

threads.claim: Xilonen notices that everyone wearing Blazegem Inscriptions has varying degrees of memory loss.
threads.quote: Xilonen: It was then that I also noticed that everyone wearing Blazegem Inscriptions had varying degrees of memory loss.

threads.claim: Tlazolli admits she is using Blazegem Inscriptions to extract Nechca-related memories from witnesses.
threads.quote: Tlazolli: I intend to use this method to collate all the memories related to Nechca, and allow her to regain her past again.

threads.claim: Nechca has lost all memories from before she was injured, and the Abyss caused it.
threads.quote: Tlazolli: The doctor said the Abyss has had an irreversible effect on Nechca's soul. She... She's lost all her memories from before she was injured.

threads.claim: Monsters near the tribe have unexpectedly gone berserk, which may be unexplained.
threads.quote: Tlapal: I don't know what happened, but it seems like all the monsters around here have gone berserk.

threads.claim: Ancient Names need Wayob approval because memories are stored within the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Xilonen: And the reason they must be approved by the Wayob is because the memories they bear are all stored within the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: Tlazolli's health is failing and she may collapse before finishing her plan.
threads.quote: Tlazolli: I could collapse tomorrow... or even in the next few moments, but Nechca's Ancient Name is still far from completion.

threads.claim: The book ties remembering a name to a person's continued presence, echoing the theme of memory in Nechca's story.
threads.quote: Remember my name, brother. As long as you remember me, I will never have left.

threads.claim: Coatlicue is introduced as a demon lord who hunts humans and whose defeat remains a story to be resolved.
threads.quote: Yet the defeat of her evil underlings caught the eye of their master, Coatlicue.

threads.claim: Tlazolli has stopped forging Ancient Names and lives away from the tribe, for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: Tlapal: *sigh* Tlazolli doesn't even forge Ancient Names anymore, so why can't she just move back to the tribe?

threads.claim: Xilonen takes the Central Inscription to disassemble it and withholds any promise about Tlazolli's plan.
threads.quote: Xilonen: I'm going to completely disassemble it to confirm its components and uses.

threads.claim: Nechca seems to remember a book she could not have read, hinting she may not be the real Nechca.
threads.quote: Nechca: Thank you for the book, I've already read it several times.

threads.claim: The girl is revealed to be Nepecha, not Nechca, and Nechca speaks through the Inscription as a real person.
threads.quote: Nechca: We've known each other a while, but we've never met

threads.claim: Tlazolli claims Nechca is in the Night Kingdom, an ominous hint that she may be dead.
