threads.quote: Tlazolli: She has stayed in the Night Kingdom for far too long... She's afraid of the dark and cold.

threads.claim: The Traveler asks directly whether Nechca is already dead, pressing the mystery.
threads.quote: Traveler: So... Is Nechca already dead?

threads.claim: Xilonen confirms Nechca is dead, answering the question about the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Xilonen: I'm afraid so.

threads.claim: The absorbed memories were mostly emotions that became gray projections of a sickly Nechca.
threads.quote: Xilonen: You absorbed those emotions into the Blazegem Inscriptions, and solidified them as a piece of her past.

threads.claim: Names are presented as blessings from the past that carry into the future.
threads.quote: Xilonen: From the moment you appeared in this world, some person had already prepared a blessing for you.

threads.claim: Xilonen gives Nepecha a name stone as her first blessing from her parents, so her name stays with her despite her lost memories.
threads.quote: Xilonen: This is your first blessing, the one you received from a pair of people who loved you with all of their hearts.

threads.claim: Tlazolli is not a Wayob, so her body cannot bear the strain of the memory work for long.
threads.quote: Xilonen: But... Aunt Tlazolli is not a Wayob. Her body won't be able to handle the load for long.

threads.claim: Tlazolli admits she wants to use memories to awaken Nechca, revealing her plan.
threads.quote: Tlazolli: So you've figured it out? I want to use memories to awaken my Nechca.

threads.claim: Xilonen says Tlazolli has been clinging to imagined memories and has forgotten the true past, ending her plan.
threads.quote: Xilonen: The reason you haven't felt blessed is because you've forgotten the true past... Auntie, you've been wallowing in memories of your imagination and refused to let go of them.

threads.claim: The old and new versions of Tequil the Brave have different endings, and the older one is said to be more interesting.
threads.quote: Paimon: But the ending in the older version is more interesting. Even if it's hard for kids to, well... completely understand.

threads.claim: Nechca says she already knows the other ending, which she should not have been able to read.
threads.quote: Nechca: Th–That's not true. Actually... I already know the other ending.

threads.claim: Nechca recites the old ending's line, showing she remembers the forbidden version and that the girl is not the real Nechca.
threads.quote: Paimon: That's the line from the old ending! Nechca remembers it!

threads.claim: Nepecha has lost her past and remembers only her own name, raising the question of who she really is.
threads.quote: Nepecha: But, I no longer remember anything about myself now besides my name. What if I never remember my life, and lose all of my past?

threads.claim: The tribe has not yet decided what punishment Tlazolli will face.
threads.quote: Well, the tribe is still discussing that.

threads.claim: Using Ancient Names to commit a crime is rare, and Tlazolli's misuse of them is unusual.
threads.quote: not many have ever used Ancient Names to commit a crime

threads.claim: Memories absorbed by Blazegem Inscriptions will return to their owners once the inscriptions stop working.
threads.quote: Once all the Blazegem Inscriptions stop working, the memories will return to their respective owners.

threads.claim: Nechca is gone, and Tlazolli's attempt to bring her back erased the tribe's memory of her.
threads.quote: Now, Nechca really is gone, but everyone is about to remember her... What a bizarre turn of events.

threads.claim: Nepecha's history is to be officially investigated by the tribe.
threads.quote: told them about my plan to conduct an official investigation into her history.

introduced.name: Three Moons
introduced.how: Teyvat's three moons were made by Nibelung and once protected the planet
introduced.quote: Nicole: Teyvat's three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: the former ruler of Teyvat who created the moons and later turned them into weapons
introduced.quote: Nicole: Teyvat's three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: a power that changed Teyvat's foundations and later fought Nibelung
introduced.quote: Nicole: But when the Heavenly Principles came, they changed the world completely, down to its very foundations.

introduced.name: War of Funerary Flame
introduced.how: the war between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles over dominance
introduced.quote: Nicole: He did, and thus began the war of funerary flame. A battle for dominance between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: ancient people who communicated with the moons and now appear as phantoms
introduced.quote: Nicole: Judging by their clothes, they appear to be phantom Hyperboreans from the distant past.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Night
introduced.how: a festival when a portal to the moon can be opened to send the Moon Goddess home
introduced.quote: Nicole: We need only place the Moon Marrow upon this platform on Moon-Prayer Night, and we shall be able to open a portal to the moon and send our Moon Goddess back home.

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: the item placed on the platform to open a portal to the moon
introduced.quote: Nicole: We need only place the Moon Marrow upon this platform on Moon-Prayer Night, and we shall be able to open a portal to the moon and send our Moon Goddess back home.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a power that runs devices, which stop working when their core is removed
introduced.quote: Nicole: This device was maintaining the door's integrity. Remove the core, and the device stops working.

introduced.name: Frost Moon
introduced.how: the one moon that was not shattered and keeps a link to Teyvat
introduced.quote: Nicole: That is perhaps due to the lingering connection between the Frost Moon, which was not shattered, and this world. You could see it as the three sisters' dying wish.

introduced.name: Shattering of the moons
introduced.how: the Heavenly Principles shattered two moons and flung the third beyond the skies
introduced.quote: Nicole: Regardless of who knew what when, the Heavenly Principles shattered two moons, and flung the other beyond the skies.

introduced.name: Dodoco
introduced.how: innocent free-spirited creatures, sometimes called a fluffier mischievous breed of kuuhenki
introduced.quote: Alice: Oh, that's quite alright! We Dodocos are innocent, happy creatures with a free-spirited nature.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a Hexenzirkel mage known as B who gives Lunar Arcana divinations
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: Greetings, pleased to make your acquaintance. I am the Hexenzirkel member they call "B" — Barbeloth Trismegistus.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: a tarot-like card deck used for festive divination that shows possibilities and trends
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: Hence, I shall use the suitably festive Lunar Arcana to tell your fortune instead. It is more popular with the youth in any case.

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: the villain who ambushes Columbina and seizes the moons' power
introduced.quote: But when Columbina steps into the beam meant to return her home, Dottore ambushes her.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Night
introduced.how: a yearly festival; missing it means waiting a whole year
introduced.quote: Dori: Take your time! But, uh, don't take too long. This event is Moon-Prayer Night only. Miss it, and you'll have to wait a whole year before I'm back.

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Slip
introduced.how: wishes are written on slips and hung on ropes during the festival
introduced.quote: Katya: "I wish for a never-ending supply of Lakkaberries..."

introduced.name: Moon-Prayer Candy
introduced.how: a candy given out during the festival, in flavors such as Smetana
introduced.quote: Traveler: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

introduced.name: Kuuhenki
introduced.how: kuuhenki are the Moon Goddess's familiars, not pets or incarnations
introduced.quote: Traveler: Ehrnrooth: The correct answer is... familiars.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki Concentration
introduced.how: a card-matching game: draw from opponent, discard pairs, loser gets a sticker
introduced.quote: Ineffa: Each player starts with differently colored kuuhenki. Each round, they draw one kuuhenki from their opponent.

introduced.name: Dodoco's Whirly Gig
introduced.how: a merry-go-round ride where you sit on a soft Dodoco
introduced.quote: Jacek: Dodoco's Whirly Gig! Come ride on a soft and furry Dodoco, and embark on an unforgettable adventure!

introduced.name: Ring Toss
introduced.how: a fair game: hold the button to aim, release to toss a ring at prizes
introduced.quote: Hold the Ring Toss button to aim at the prizes. Columbina will toss a ring when the button is released.

introduced.name: Metta
introduced.how: a child who insists a paper frog prize moved during the ring toss
introduced.quote: Metta: You heard me! This paper frog can move! I swear!

introduced.name: Durin
introduced.how: a grown-up dragon whose Simulanka friends still see him as a little dragon
introduced.quote: Padisarah: (It's our little dragon! He's all grown up!)

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: a fairy-tale home of origami animals and clockwork people, which Durin calls home
introduced.quote: Dori: (But how? They're origami animals and clockwork people from a fairy tale! Getting to know them would be quite an arduous task, unless... they share a hometown?)

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: a multifunctional domestic robot who introduces herself at the robot show
introduced.quote: Traveler: Ineffa: I am a multifunctional robot for domestic application, integrating smart cleaning, precision cooking, emotive communication, and various other modules.

introduced.name: Birgitta
introduced.how: a smart assistance unit Ineffa can deploy to protect important people
introduced.quote: Traveler: Ineffa: When necessary, I can autonomously deploy the multipurpose smart assistance unit, "Birgitta," to ensure the safety of important personnel.

introduced.name: Moonlane
introduced.how: a circular ride that appears when kuuvahki is activated
introduced.quote: Traveler: Ineffa: Roger. Amending demonstration program... Moonlane detected. Kuuvahki ready.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: can carry signals like long and short waves or strong and weak lights
introduced.quote: Lauma: I've heard Jahoda say that signals can be sent using long and short waves, or strong and weak lights.

introduced.name: Lady Kuutar
introduced.how: the true guide of souls, whom Lyylikki compares Columbina to
introduced.quote: Lyylikki: The resemblance was uncanny... She seemed like the true Lady Kuutar, the one who guides souls...

introduced.name: Spirit animal
introduced.how: every person has a magical creature in their heart, found through a personality quiz
introduced.quote: Flins: You are quite right, Miss Columbina. Every one of us has a magical creature living in their heart. Would you permit me to help you find yours?

introduced.name: Greeting Card for Columbina
introduced.how: a card drawn by Varka and Albedo as a gift for Columbina
introduced.quote: Paimon: Yeah. We just met Varka, and he said that having everyone draw their own section was kinda boring... so he did your bit for you.

introduced.name: Sapphire
introduced.how: a kitten that has been following Lyylikki
introduced.quote: Kantor: Miss Lyylikki, a kitten's been following you all this time.

introduced.name: Liouba
introduced.how: a bot researcher running synchronization tests on the treasure robots
introduced.quote: Liouba: I'm currently running some synchronization tests on these bots...

introduced.name: Frostfin Whale
introduced.how: a toy-like whale game where stepping on a wrong tooth gets you bitten
introduced.quote: Columbina: Yes. It's some kind of game where you get bitten if you step on the wrong tooth. Seems like fun.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki
introduced.how: a rare floating creature, which Seija says is super rare
introduced.quote: Seija: Whoa, am I seeing things? Where'd you get a kuuhenki!? They're super rare!

introduced.name: Rimehorn Deer
introduced.how: a festival deer whose antlers are its pride; it absorbs and returns kuuvahki in battle
introduced.quote: Jahoda: What the... The Rimehorn Deer's antlers are glowing!

introduced.name: Amazing 'Bot
introduced.how: robot battle partners used in the Moon-Prayer Night duel
introduced.quote: (Three Amazing 'Bots appear in front of her)

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: a land whose people once used the moons to communicate
introduced.quote: Columbina: This is... this is where the people of Hyperborea used to communicate with the moons...

introduced.name: Three Moons
introduced.how: the Eternal, Frost, and Iridescent Moons; their combined power opens the gate to the moons
introduced.quote: Lauma: Eternal Moon, Frost Moon, Iridescent Moon... When the power of all three converge...

introduced.name: Moon Marrow
introduced.how: items placed on altars to power the gate to the moon
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Arlecchino place their respective Moon Marrows on two of the three altars)

introduced.name: Variables
introduced.how: things learned or thought of that one could not otherwise know; stacking them can change destiny
introduced.quote: Alice: Yes — things you heard that you could not otherwise have learned, ideas that would otherwise have never crossed your mind... All these things are "variables."

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a kind of energy the spell senses to locate the moon
introduced.quote: Traveler: The spell senses kuuvahki to detect the moon's location.

introduced.name: Damselette
introduced.how: Columbina's former Fatui Harbinger codename
introduced.quote: The Knave: And in any case, it is not the Fatui Harbinger, "Damselette," who sees us as her friends, but rather, Columbina Hyposelenia.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo who would sacrifice himself for the world
introduced.quote: Marionette: These people... They would sacrifice themselves for the sake of the world — especially Alain Guillotin and Rene.

introduced.name: Moon Gate
introduced.how: a gateway into an unknown place that once tore apart the Rächer of Solnari
introduced.quote: Traveler: (She stepped through the "Moon Gate." No one knows what's inside, but it's a place that tore apart the extremely powerful Rächer of Solnari...)

introduced.name: Hyperborean phantoms
introduced.how: phantoms from Hyperborea who were deceived about their own history
introduced.quote: Traveler: Because the phantoms are the ones who were deceived.

introduced.name: Sword of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: a relic shown to Sandrone, called the Holy Blade
introduced.quote: (The Traveler displays the Sword of Narzissenkreuz for Sandrone)

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Nicole: Hehe. Anyway, I had to go help Alice — it seems like she ran into some trouble.

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: Varka: It's good to know you're all well. Puts me at ease.

assumed.name: Ineffa
assumed.quote: Ineffa: I have confirmed that you are all in good health. With that, my work is now complete. Congratulations are in order.

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ooh, there's a whole bunch of artwork in here... Seems pretty old. Nicole, this is probably your area of expertise — what do all these paintings mean?

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lauma! Your antlers!

assumed.name: Kuutar
assumed.quote: Lauma: Alas, Kuutar's birth came long after the age in which he lived.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Columbina: It went being from a Fatui codename... to "something my friends call me."

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Lauma: The Frostmoon Scions have also prepared various attractions. I believe Aino, Ineffa, and their crew are setting things up as we speak.

assumed.name: Moonlane
assumed.quote: Columbina: Not bad... It reminds me of riding a Moonlane.

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: The Traveler returns to Silvermoon Hall — where they first met — and finds Columbina's fading consciousness.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: disappearing into the same unknown realm where Rerir once fled.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: As the moment of departure arrives, the people of Nod-Krai offer farewells, blessings, and gifts.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Sandrone reluctantly shows her concern and ends up sharing a surprisingly emotional goodbye through their competitive banter.

assumed.name: Columbina's disappearance
assumed.quote: Columbina: ...You know something? I got to see a lot of fascinating things during my "disappearance."

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Columbina: I saw how the Frostmoon Scions act around their families... so different than how they used to act in my presence.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
assumed.quote: Nefer: Of course. Don't forget, the Curatorium has a reputation to uphold.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Jahoda: (Uh-oh! That's... The Fourth Harbinger! ...Although, she's helped us out quite a bit. She's good people, right?)

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: The Knave: (...How peculiar. This would take some getting used to... I wonder if this is what it's like for Lynette?)

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: The Knave: I've seen Lyney and the other children play this game before. It would seem that it's not a bad way to relax once in a while.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: The Knave: I'm sure Sandrone would agree when I say... I like the present version of you better.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Traveler: Looks like Albedo's socialization program has been far more useful to you than all those Vahumana textbooks.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Durin: Reminds me of Good Hunter, a restaurant in Mondstadt... I always have to resist the temptation to go there, unless I'm ordering food.

assumed.name: Elder Almond
assumed.quote: Durin: How has Elder Almond been lately?

assumed.name: Wheel
assumed.quote: Wheel: Ah, the hat-wearing man. I never thought I'd see you again. You seem more determined than when I saw you last on the train.

assumed.name: Aino
assumed.quote: Jahoda: (What's so fun about balloons? I'm not a kid anymore... They're probably more up Aino's alley.)

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Jahoda: ...! Boss! Boss Nef! Thank goodness! You've gotta get me outta here, things are kicking off big time!

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Columbina: Hello, Jahoda.

assumed.name: Lauma (Moonchanter)
assumed.quote: Katya: Hmm? Is that Lauma the Moonchanter...?

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: Flins: Haha... Ah, Varka. Ever the maverick. I see his artistic skills are... truly one of a kind.

assumed.name: Vahumana
assumed.quote: Traveler: Looks like Albedo's socialization program has been far more useful to you than all those Vahumana textbooks.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Columbina: Were you worried about me, Sandrone?

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Columbina: Were you worried about me, Sandrone?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Marionette: Shut up! I'm only here to protect the Fatui's interests in this territory. Running into you was pure bad luck!

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Columbina: Really? But you were the one who asked Arlecchino to help everyone find my name...

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Alice: That Dottore is a crafty one... He distracted the Hexenzirkel by creating a huge fuss at Teyvat's borders.

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: Alice: That Dottore is a crafty one... He distracted the Hexenzirkel by creating a huge fuss at Teyvat's borders.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Columbina: Remember how the Frostmoon Scions used to use milk as invisible ink to write hidden messages?

assumed.name: Rerir and Tholindis
assumed.quote: Nefer: So, Columbina intentionally opened the Moon Gate, and escaped into the same mysterious world as Rerir and Tholindis...

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: Nefer: The Curatorium of Secrets believes in proper farewells. No story should be left without a satisfactory end note.

assumed.name: Lightkeepers
assumed.quote: Varka: I'll get in touch with Flins and Illuga, get them to have a chat with their Starshyna. Couldn't hurt to bring the Lightkeepers on board as well.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Nefer: Leave the intel-gathering to me. Whatever happens within Nod-Krai's borders, when the Curatorium of Secrets wants to be in the know, we always find a way.

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: Traveler: (So that's the power of the three moons? But why wasn't I affected? ...Is it because I'm a Descender?)

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Columbina: This was my happiest night in Teyvat

threads.claim: Columbina may never have had a true name, and she has never accepted either name she was given.
threads.quote: Alice: Neither "Columbina" nor "Kuutar" is her true name, and she's never really accepted either of them.

threads.claim: Columbina takes the chosen full name Columbina Hyposelenia, meaning born beneath the moon, resolving her name search.
threads.quote: Columbina: Columbina Hyposelenia

threads.claim: Columbina can only return to the moon through a portal opened with Moon Marrow on Moon-Prayer Night.
threads.quote: Nicole: We need only place the Moon Marrow upon this platform on Moon-Prayer Night, and we shall be able to open a portal to the moon and send our Moon Goddess back home.

threads.claim: The unshattered Frost Moon's lingering link to Teyvat may explain how Columbina could be born at all.
threads.quote: Nicole: That is perhaps due to the lingering connection between the Frost Moon, which was not shattered, and this world. You could see it as the three sisters' dying wish.

threads.claim: Nibelung made the three moons, then weaponized them and imprisoned their goddesses, and the moons lost their power.
threads.quote: Nicole: Teyvat's three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.

threads.claim: The war of funerary flame was a battle for dominance between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles that ended the moons' role in Teyvat.
threads.quote: Nicole: He did, and thus began the war of funerary flame. A battle for dominance between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Traveler fears the moon may have been corrupted by the Abyss, and that danger is left unresolved.
threads.quote: Traveler: Exactly. It might have been corrupted by the Abyss.

threads.claim: A phantom Hyperborean's mysterious unnamed "he" makes Nicole unsure who is meant, leaving the identity open.
threads.quote: Nicole: Wait, that's odd... Who is... "he"?

threads.claim: Hyperborean phantoms expect a new Moon Goddess to be born, and her name will be known when she arrives.
threads.quote: Xsayazantus: When a new Moon Goddess is born, we will surely know her name.

threads.claim: Dottore uses a false moon and manipulated history to hijack the teleportation ritual and seize the moons' power.
threads.quote: But when Columbina steps into the beam meant to return her home, Dottore ambushes her.

threads.claim: Columbina vanishes into an unknown realm beyond the reach of her friends, where Rerir once fled.
threads.quote: disappearing into the same unknown realm where Rerir once fled.

threads.claim: Barbeloth's divination reveals the Death card, which may mean an agonizing end or rebirth for Columbina's future.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: ...This card is "Death."

threads.claim: Columbina is about to return to the moon, and what she will find there is unknown even to her.
threads.quote: Traveler: (I wonder what Columbina will find on the moon? ...Perhaps even she doesn't know...)

threads.claim: Columbina fears losing her friends the very night she has regained them, as her return to the moon approaches.
threads.quote: Columbina: What I fear now is the end... I fear losing all this the very night I have gained it.

threads.claim: Columbina realizes that the Frostmoon Scions' sincerity comes from trust and being accepted for who they are.
threads.quote: Columbina: Slowly, I came to realize that... it's because they trust one another. They know, deep down, that they'll be accepted for who they are — all of it, the good and the bad.

threads.claim: Once Columbina returns to the moon, the people left behind will be separated from her by a false sky.
threads.quote: Lauma: Once you return to the moon, we will be far apart, and separated by a false sky.

threads.claim: Lauma suggests that Columbina's true love and thoughts will shine through a curtain of lies.
threads.quote: Lauma: So, I'm confident that your thoughts and your love will shine through the curtain of lies. We will know it when we see it.

threads.claim: Someone has been mistaken for the Moon Goddess, and the Jade-Eyed Cat suggests the real one is now visible.
threads.quote: Jade-Eyed Cat: Wait a sec... That's the Moon Goddess. The real Moon Goddess! And she's looking this way...

threads.claim: Dori suspects magic is behind the origami animals' movements and wants answers from the Great Mage Alice.
threads.quote: Dori: (Hmm... I have to get to the bottom of this. Next time I see the Great Mage Alice, I shall demand answers!)

threads.claim: Metta insists a paper frog moved on its own, raising the question of whether real magic exists in this world.
threads.quote: Dori: Dear, oh dear. What are you saying? How could a paper frog move? Unless you believe there really is magic in this world?

threads.claim: The Traveler once helped the Simulanka animals and Wheel, a past event the player does not yet know about.
threads.quote: Wheel: I do say so. The people you once helped see it clearly... it's because you are once again on the right track.

threads.claim: Flins hides a true form and secret identity behind the talking lamp disguise.
threads.quote: Flins: I see Miss Columbina is hiding in plain sight — why should I not do the same? Why miss this rare opportunity to enjoy a special evening in my true form?

threads.claim: Dottore aims to bring all three moons' power together for a final experiment, hinting at a larger plan.
threads.quote: The Doctor: All three moons in one place...

threads.claim: Dottore claims Teyvat's primordial power does not belong to the heavens and that he will take it.
threads.quote: The Doctor: Never did belong to the throne of heaven

threads.claim: Dottore stacked 'variables' to shape events, suggesting knowledge can alter destiny.
threads.quote: Alice: Yes — things you heard that you could not otherwise have learned, ideas that would otherwise have never crossed your mind... All these things are "variables."

threads.claim: Variables Dottore set up even affected phantoms he never met, showing how the plan worked.
threads.quote: Traveler: The "variables" that Dottore put in place were substantial enough that they even affected phantoms that he never met.

threads.claim: Dottore used the knowledge he gathered to create a false moon on Moon-Prayer Night.
threads.quote: Traveler: Then, he harnessed that knowledge on Moon-Prayer Night... to truly create a "false moon."

threads.claim: The savior in Hyperborean history was Dottore's doing, who deceived the phantoms.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's obvious that this was Dottore's doing.

threads.claim: Dottore is said to be trying to transcend his destiny and complete an experiment only a god might finish.
threads.quote: Albedo: According to Miss Alice, he is attempting to transcend his destiny and finish an experiment that only a god might complete.

threads.claim: Teyvat's destiny is said to be fixed, and Varka doubts Dottore is the exception.
threads.quote: Varka: Many have told me that Teyvat's destiny is fixed, and that does appear to be the case. Well, what makes Dottore so sure he'll be the exception?

threads.claim: Columbina is pulled into the Moon Gate and her return home is uncertain.
threads.quote: Columbina: I won't be going home today...

threads.claim: Columbina escaped into the moon's reflection, and her whereabouts remain unknown.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...She escaped into the "moon's reflection."

threads.claim: Columbina may have entered the same mysterious world as Rerir and Tholindis.
threads.quote: Nefer: So, Columbina intentionally opened the Moon Gate, and escaped into the same mysterious world as Rerir and Tholindis...

threads.claim: The gate to the moons is opened by the three altars and Moon Marrows, and its contents are unknown.
threads.quote: Columbina: The gate to the moons shall open.

threads.claim: Kuuvahki is used to locate Columbina and to detect the moon's location.
threads.quote: Lauma: I'll use kuuvahki to investigate Columbina's whereabouts. I'm not ready to give up either.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders if being a Descender is why they were unaffected by the frozen time.
threads.quote: Traveler: (So that's the power of the three moons? But why wasn't I affected? ...Is it because I'm a Descender?)

threads.claim: Hat Guy left alone to investigate, a hunch he keeps to himself.
threads.quote: Durin: He took off with the Dodocommunication Device after we spoke to Alice. He said he had a hunch that he wanted to investigate by himself.

threads.claim: Columbina promises to write messages in moonlight that her friends can read from the moon.
threads.quote: Columbina: Yes. When I miss you all, I shall use moonlight in the same way, to write words that only you can see upon the moon itself.

threads.claim: Columbina repeats that moonlight will always connect her to her friends.
threads.quote: Columbina: And remember... Come night or day, the moonlight shall always connect us.

threads.claim: Harbingers are forbidden from drawing steel against one another, and Arlecchino is ready to defy it.
threads.quote: The Knave: If, even in such extreme circumstances, Her Majesty will not lift the prohibition on Harbingers drawing steel against one another...

introduced.name: Teucer
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a young boy from Snezhnaya searching for his brother in Liyue
introduced.quote: Teucer: My name's Teucer! I came all the way from Snezhnaya to look for my brother in Liyue.

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: Revealed as Teucer's older brother and a Fatui Harbinger who goes by Tartaglia
introduced.quote: Childe: Hah! You're forgetting something about me — I, Tartaglia, spend every second getting stronger.

introduced.name: Daipai
introduced.how: Millelith patrol officer reporting Ruin Guard sightings near Lingju Pass
introduced.quote: Daipai: Be on your guard, Traveler. Now is no time for sightseeing.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Local guard force that patrols the area and must wait for orders before investigating
introduced.quote: In any case, the only sensible strategy in the meantime is to increase Millelith patrols.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: Ancient machines that left their ruin and wandered off on their own
introduced.quote: Daipai: Sergeant sent someone to find out just where these ancient machines might have come from.

introduced.name: Mr. Cyclops
introduced.how: Popular nickname for the powered-down Ruin Guard machines, which are also made into toys
introduced.quote: ???: Um, excuse me? His name is Mr. Cyclops, actually!

introduced.name: Teucer's entertainment fund
introduced.how: A large bag of Mora Childe gives the Traveler to spend on Teucer
introduced.quote: Childe: Then I'm in your debt. Here, take this as Teucer's entertainment fund.

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.how: Liyue's commercial hub and biggest port, where trade ships dock
introduced.quote: Paimon: This place is Liyue's commercial hub, and it's been the biggest port in the seven nations ever since it was decided that Liyue would take on the world through trade.

introduced.name: Dottore
introduced.how: A Fatui Harbinger who tinkers with old things and converted ruins into a research lab
introduced.quote: Childe: Dottore is another one of the Fatui Harbingers. He loves tinkering with old things, it's a... personal passion of his.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: A group of treasure hunters who run a loot cave challenge and recruit members by testing them
introduced.quote: Slippery Wu: Huh! Would you listen to yourself!? You think we just let any old person into the Treasure Hoarders?

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Snezhnayan organization whose new recruits are baptized through the words of the Harbingers
introduced.quote: Felix: Every new batch of recruits must be baptized by the Tsaritsa's will through the words of her Harbingers. This has always been our rule.

introduced.name: Felix
introduced.how: Fatui subordinate who relays orders and summons Childe to the recruits
introduced.quote: Felix: Ah, Master Childe, you're here.

introduced.name: Andrei
introduced.how: Childe's subordinate who arranges Teucer's return boat to Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: Andrei: That's correct. Master Childe instructed me to arrange for young master Teucer's return trip.

introduced.name: Foul Legacy Transformation
introduced.how: Childe's powerful technique that strains his body and is saved for crucial moments
introduced.quote: Childe: It puts a great strain on my body, so it's best saved for crucial moments.

introduced.name: Witch-Ray
introduced.how: A laser trap that would turn someone into a lamb if it hits them
introduced.quote: Childe: It's a Witch-Ray that will turn you into a little lamb if it hits you — so stay out of its way!

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: The ruler of Snezhnaya whom Childe and the Fatui serve
introduced.quote: Childe: The older ones already know that I serve the Tsaritsa.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: Hinted as the source connected to the Ruin Guards, making them enemies of Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: Childe: No. They have much closer connections to the Abyss, so strictly speaking, they're as much our enemies as anyone else's...

assumed.name: Golden House
assumed.quote: as he had not recovered sufficiently during his bout with the Traveler in the Golden House

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Childe: Anyway, I'm no Signora — I don't use lethal force against recruits, come on now...

assumed.name: Diluc and the Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...Was that supposed to be your impression of Master Diluc talking about the Knights of Favonius?

assumed.name: Tonia and Anthon
assumed.quote: Childe: How are the others — sister Tonia and brother Anthon? Is everybody keeping well?

assumed.name: Ekaterina
assumed.quote: Childe: Ah, yes. Ekaterina. I will deal with the issue of that outstanding payment right away.

assumed.name: Childe's earlier bout with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Traveler: I've also come a long way since then.

threads.claim: The reason the Ruin Guards suddenly left their ruin and wandered into the wild remains unknown.
threads.quote: Daipai: As I say, the reason is still unclear. We have very little intelligence at present.

threads.claim: The Ruin Guards come from a Ruin Guard research lab run by Dottore inside the toy institute.
threads.quote: Childe: Based on my limited understanding, I believe this is one of Dottore's research facilities.

threads.claim: The Ruin Guards have close connections to the Abyss, making their origins a hidden threat.
threads.quote: Childe: No. They have much closer connections to the Abyss, so strictly speaking, they're as much our enemies as anyone else's...

threads.claim: Childe hides his Fatui role from his family by posing as a toy seller.
threads.quote: Childe: Shh, look, I only told him that so that he'll look up to me.

threads.claim: Snezhnaya has a darker side that Childe wants to keep his family away from.
threads.quote: Childe: I don't want my family to have anything to do with the Fatui's... or should I say, Snezhnaya's... darker side.

threads.claim: Using the Foul Legacy Transformation while injured strains Childe's body and worsens his recovery.
threads.quote: Childe: I still haven't fully recovered from the injuries I suffered when I used it at the Golden House.

threads.claim: Childe promises a rematch with the Traveler as a Harbinger's matter of honor.
threads.quote: Childe: One other thing: don't forget our promise, now. Let's have a rematch when we get the chance.

threads.claim: Teucer and Childe invite the Traveler to visit Snezhnaya in the future.
threads.quote: Teucer: I'll wait for you back home. You definitely, definitely have to come visit Snezhnaya sometime!

introduced.name: Jalacan
introduced.how: Zuria's family doctor who explains the illness and the household's situation
introduced.quote: This is the residence of Zuria Destree, and I am Jalacan, her family doctor. What did you mean by your question just now? Who else could be my patient?

introduced.name: Lescot Destree
introduced.how: eight-year-old boy who walked into the sea with shells tied to him and never returned
introduced.quote: Delaroche: One hundred percent sure! I've confirmed the account with several veteran fishermen I know. The child was only eight years old... His name was Lescot. Lescot Destree.

introduced.name: Thelxie
introduced.how: prince of the Kingdom of Water Imps who communicates in Morse code
introduced.quote: Zuria Destree: Dr. Jalacan, how can you forget the name of your own patient? His name is Thelxie! He's the prince of the Kingdom of Water Imps!

introduced.name: Kingdom of Water Imps
introduced.how: the realm Thelxie rules, where Lescot's dream returns
introduced.quote: Zuria Destree: Dr. Jalacan, how can you forget the name of your own patient? His name is Thelxie! He's the prince of the Kingdom of Water Imps!

introduced.name: Loneliness Syndrome
introduced.how: illness of loneliness and grief that can make sufferers lose touch with reality
introduced.quote: He explains that Lescot did have the Loneliness Syndrome. But ever since Lescot passed away, Zuria also fell to the same illness because of her grief

introduced.name: guidance therapy
introduced.how: deliberate guidance method, using a picture book, to ease the illness
introduced.quote: She even began discussing with me the idea of using deliberate guidance to ease the illness.

introduced.name: Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures
introduced.how: picture book Zuria made, which is finished as part of the guidance therapy
introduced.quote: The doctor fetch the book and gives it to Freminet, who is determined to finish the story for her and give it a happy ending.

introduced.name: diving helmet transcription module
introduced.how: helmet module that translates Thelxie's Morse code signals into speech
introduced.quote: Freminet: Quick, put on my diving helmet! There's a transcription module in it that's compatible with Thelxie's output signals.

introduced.name: Lescot's inscribed shell
introduced.how: shell Lescot left behind, with words he inscribed on it
introduced.quote: Jalacan: ...She spent a whole night staring at the shell the young master left behind, and the words that he had inscribed onto it...

introduced.name: Deepsea Cyclops
introduced.how: monsters that stole Thelxie's crown and are fought in the underwater ruins
introduced.quote: Paimon: Be careful, brave adventurers! Here come the evil monsters that stole the crown! They're... uhh... the Deepsea Cyclops! Let's beat 'em up!

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: Paimon: Today's the final day of Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures! Let's go find Freminet at his camp.

assumed.name: Delaroche
assumed.quote: After I gave you that commission the other day, I began to get worried and went asking about the boy that went missing...

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: I need to remember the old House of the Hearth, and the children who lived in it...

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: It's said that she left the Court of Fontaine, and no one knows where she has gone.

assumed.name: Water Imps
assumed.quote: The Water Imps, finally returning to their homes, showered the prince with love and applause as he greeted them.

threads.claim: A missing boy who walked into the sea is rumored to be Lescot, and the rumor is mistakenly linked to Freminet.
threads.quote: Delaroche: What I was told is that about a month ago, a child tied a bunch of heavy seashells onto his body and walked into this open stretch of water.

threads.claim: Loneliness Syndrome has spread from Lescot to Zuria through grief, pulling her away from reality.
threads.quote: He explains that Lescot did have the Loneliness Syndrome. But ever since Lescot passed away, Zuria also fell to the same illness because of her grief

threads.claim: Zuria can no longer tell fantasy from reality, so the line between them becomes the story's central question.
threads.quote: Those actions are proof that she can no longer differentiate between fantasy and reality.

threads.claim: The inscribed shells carry cryptic messages that hint at Lescot's fate.
threads.quote: Inscribed Shell (III): The sea goddess hath rung his knell: ding-dong. Hark! Now I hear them — Ding-dong, bell.

threads.claim: Thelxie's Morse code is revealed to be Lescot's real words of love to his mother, decoded through the helmet.
threads.quote: Thelxie: I love you, Maman!

threads.claim: Zuria appears to speak with Lescot's spirit, and the Traveler sees it too.
threads.quote: The Traveler realizes Zuria is talking to Lescot.

threads.claim: Freminet proposes that a fairytale briefly became real and changed the real world, which is left unconfirmed.
threads.quote: A descent of the fairytale world into the real world. At that time, the wondrous fairytale temporarily became reality, and influenced real things in our world.

threads.claim: Zuria feels healed by a mystical power after the crown is placed, which hints that fantasy has real effects.
threads.quote: She felt like at that moment, she was healed by some mystical power, and she was filled with courage from head to toe.

introduced.name: fairgrounds
introduced.how: an abandoned fairground in the forest that Collei and Eula found the day before
introduced.quote: Eula: Yes, Collei and I discovered a fairgrounds in the forest.

introduced.name: Crystal Light
introduced.how: a large light hanging at the top of the tent that fell and trapped the Hydro Eidolons
introduced.quote: Maymunah: Yes, exactly! Something fell from the Central Hub into the tent, and knocked down the Crystal Light that was hanging at the top.

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolons
introduced.how: creatures that were trapped inside the tent when the light fell
introduced.quote: Maymunah: But once the light fell, the tent became a complete mess and the Hydro Eidolons were trapped inside.

introduced.name: Lawrence Clan
introduced.how: a noble family from Mondstadt whose members are proud and cling to old etiquette
introduced.quote: Eula: Yep, he's a member of the Lawrence Clan all right. Even though he's hanging on by thread, he still insists on clinging to meaningless etiquette.

introduced.name: Lessig Lawrence
introduced.how: a Lawrence Clan member trapped in the tent who came to the domain to restore the clan's glory
introduced.quote: Lessig: I, uh... I admit it. Yes, I came here in hopes of finding a way to restore the Lawrence Clan to its former glory.

introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.how: a bustling market with many vendors where Nilou performs a dance
introduced.quote: Collei: The place is bustling with all kinds of vendors! And if you're lucky, you can see Nilou perform her dance.

introduced.name: Shinrou Casket
introduced.how: a relic lost from Watatsumi Island long ago that Kokomi is searching for
introduced.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: The truth is that a relic, known as the Shinrou Casket, was lost from Watatsumi Island long ago.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: introduces herself as the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island who came here searching for a relic
introduced.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Well, I suppose it's time I told you that as the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, I shouldn't actually be here now.

introduced.name: candy box component
introduced.how: a missing component of the tent that is a festival candy box and was used to build the tent
introduced.quote: Maymunah: Yes, people often use this kind of box for candy at festivals.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: the desert domain where the clues led Kokomi searching for the relic
introduced.quote: All the clues leads her to the Veluriyam Mirage.

assumed.name: Idyia
assumed.quote: Maymunah: Thank you, Collei. It's been quite some time since I've seen you, Idyia.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Collei and Eula. Oh, Idyia is here, too!

assumed.name: Eula
assumed.quote: Paimon: By the way Eula, how's your cousin doing now?

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Paimon: A scholar? But what's she doing there, researching the forest's Ley Lines?

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Collei: I have. I've gone there a few times with Master Tighnari.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Collei: But aren't you a scholar in the Akademiya, Maymunah?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Eula: Oh, a dance from Sumeru? I'd like to see that myself.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Lessig: Yes, this has all happened recently. After coming to this domain, I realized the Mondstadt that I want is one where not everyone fears me.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Island
assumed.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: As I made my way from Watatsumi Island to Sumeru, I enjoyed a variety of breathtaking sights.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Traveler: (This is an unusual place, and Idyia would suddenly become very busy from time to time. Plus, she knows Alice...)

threads.claim: A sudden catastrophe flipped the domain upside down and changed its appearance.
threads.quote: Maymunah: But just a few days ago, something happened and it seemed like...

threads.claim: An orb matching the Shinrou Casket began glowing and guiding people toward the relic.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: But recently, an orb matching the relic's description suddenly began emitting light, almost as if it was guiding people to it.

threads.claim: The Veluriyam Mirage domain holds many secrets, and Idyia may be hiding things.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Though I feel that Idyia was not intentionally trying to hide anything from us, this domain does have plenty of secrets.

threads.claim: A massive shadow appeared inside or near the tent, and its nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: Lessig: The shadow... it's massive!!! Ah, wait! The shadow just now, it's... Ah!

threads.claim: Lessig is undergoing a treatment whose side effects leave him disoriented.
threads.quote: Idyia: Ah, you're awake now. Don't worry, that's just a side effect of your treatment, Lessig.

threads.claim: Maymunah had been investigating Ley Lines in the desert before she came to the fairgrounds.
threads.quote: Maymunah: I gave up on myself and resorted to investigating Ley Lines in the desert.

threads.claim: The tent is magical and its interior is much larger than its exterior suggests.
threads.quote: Maymunah: It is a magical tent, after all. The inside is much larger than it appears from the outside.

threads.claim: Lessig realizes that nobody outside Mondstadt cares about the Lawrence Clan's glory.
threads.quote: Lessig: But the peculiar thing is... I realized that nobody knew me out there, and not a single person even cared about the Lawrence Clan.

threads.claim: Maymunah chose her parents' wishes over her own and regrets it, raising the theme of choosing who to become.
threads.quote: Maymunah: When I had the choice between becoming who I wanted to be and who my parents wanted me to be, I ended up choosing the latter... But I was never happy about it.

threads.claim: Raising the Crystal Light sets the trapped Hydro Eidolons free and restores the fairgrounds.
threads.quote: After raising the Crystal Light, the trapped Hydro Eidolons are set free and the fairgrounds are now lively again as it was.

introduced.name: Xiangling
introduced.how: a traveling chef from Liyue Harbor who hunts rare ingredients and cooks on instinct
introduced.quote: My name's Xiangling, I'm from Liyue Harbor. And you?

introduced.name: Allan
introduced.how: a Springvale hunter who scolds the Traveler for hunting in the boars' habitat
introduced.quote: Hey! What do you think you're doing?

introduced.name: Draff
introduced.how: the leader of the Springvale hunters, who stresses respecting the rules of the hunt and later judges the cook-off
introduced.quote: As our leader, he always stresses the importance of respecting the rules of the hunt.

introduced.name: Brook
introduced.how: a Springvale chef, booked solid, who becomes Xiangling's rival in the cook-off
introduced.quote: Sorry, I've taken all the orders I can for the next few days. The earliest I could put you down for is seven days from now, is that okay?

introduced.name: Siegfria
introduced.how: Brook's cooking assistant for the competition
introduced.quote: Brook: I was born ready. Oh, and Siegfria will be my assistant for the competition.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: a Mondstadt community whose reputation rests on top-quality meat products
introduced.quote: Springvale has built its reputation on top-quality meat products, but this reputation is so far limited to Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: a folk-cuisine restaurant in Liyue Harbor run by Xiangling
introduced.quote: She's the one behind Wanmin Restaurant, that one-of-a-kind folk cuisine restaurant in Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Guoba
introduced.how: a bear-shaped accessory Xiangling calls her good friend
introduced.quote: Xiangling: You seem like good friends. I have a good friend too, called Guoba.

introduced.name: Cryo Regisvine
introduced.how: a frost-attacking vine creature found in the ruins, which Xiangling sees as a cooking ingredient
introduced.quote: Olaf: I followed him inside, but ran into a Cryo Regisvine.

introduced.name: Olaf
introduced.how: a frozen hunter who turns out to be Draff's ancestor from 300 years ago
introduced.quote: Draff: Olaf? I'm sure I've seen that on my family tree!

introduced.name: extinct boar
introduced.how: a boar breed extinct for 300 years, hunted for its highly prized meat
introduced.quote: Xiangling: This pattern is unmistakable. It belongs to a breed of boar that went extinct 300 years ago!

introduced.name: Historia Naturalis Liyue
introduced.how: a Liyue reference work that catalogs the extinct boar breed
introduced.quote: Xiangling: Where have I seen this before? Hmm... Aha! It was in the "Historia Naturalis Liyue"!

introduced.name: Jueyun Chili
introduced.how: a spicy chili grown at high altitude in Liyue, with a dry heat
introduced.quote: Then throw in some Jueyun Chilis grown at a high altitude, where the low humidity and varying temperature lends them a unique dry heat.

introduced.name: Qingxin flower
introduced.how: a pungent flower that can be used as a garnish when cooked carefully
introduced.quote: With this cut, I would probably roast it over a hot stone with a little salt, some Jueyun Chili, and Qingxin flower.

introduced.name: cook-off
introduced.how: a cooking contest used to settle a dispute, where the loser must promote the winner's dish
introduced.quote: Xiangling: I declare a cook-off!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: I've always heard about the wide range of ingredients you can find in Mondstadt, and it looks like it's true!

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Xiangling: I'm off to get ingredients — I will see you all in Liyue!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Brook: Hmm... Maybe he feels that Mondstadt cuisine can't compete with that of Teyvat's biggest business hub, Liyue Harbor.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Draff: My goodness... A single mouthful must be worth a hundred thousand Mora!

assumed.name: Slime Condensate
assumed.quote: Xiangling: The issue is... What would you think if I added a bit of Slime Condensate?

assumed.name: hilichurl
assumed.quote: Xiangling: We passed a hilichurl camp on the way here. There'll almost certainly be a campfire there to cook on.

assumed.name: Slimes
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eek! Slimes! Scared the bejeezers out of Paimon!

threads.claim: A hunter was frozen by a Cryo Regisvine in the ruins and his origin is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Olaf: It froze me instantly. When I woke up I ran straight outside, but... I only made it this far before my strength failed me.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests the extinct boar survived because it was cryopreserved for at least 300 years.
threads.quote: The Traveler suggests that the reason it is still alive is because it has been cryopreserved in the cave for at least 300 years.

threads.claim: The Traveler realizes the frozen hunter is also a survivor from 300 years ago.
threads.quote: Traveler: This hunter is also a survivor from 300 years ago.

threads.claim: Draff recognizes the frozen hunter Olaf as one of his own ancestors.
threads.quote: Draff: Olaf? I'm sure I've seen that on my family tree!

threads.claim: Xiangling's bear-shaped friend Guoba has a special meaning to her that is hinted at but not explained.
threads.quote: Xiangling: Hee-hee... Both the snack and my friend have a special place in my heart.

threads.claim: Xiangling's passion for cooking traces back to her father, whose teachings are only hinted at.
threads.quote: Xiangling: The technique doesn't matter — what matters is that you do it with passion! That's what my father taught me.

threads.claim: Xiangling cooks by improvising and refuses to plan dishes in advance.
threads.quote: Xiangling: That's just my style. If I decided in advance exactly how I was going to cook something, there'd be no element of surprise to the dish.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild staffer in Liyue who hands the Traveler and Paimon the commission
introduced.quote: Katheryne: As a matter of fact, there's one that looks perfect for you two.

introduced.name: Uncle Dai
introduced.how: Foreman who hires adventurers to find four missing miners
introduced.quote: Uncle Dai is one of the foremen at Huishan Hall over in Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Kun Jun
introduced.how: Dai's assistant and rock expert who can perceive the memories of ore
introduced.quote: Uncle Dai: Aha! Speak of the devil! Allow me to introduce my assistant, Kun Jun.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: Renowned rock expert and consultant from Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who joins the investigation
introduced.quote: Traveler: This is Zhongli, a consultant from the funeral parlor.

introduced.name: Huishan Hall
introduced.how: Mining company whose foreman Uncle Dai employs the miners
introduced.quote: Uncle Dai is one of the foremen at Huishan Hall over in Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.how: Port city where Uncle Dai meets the group at the dock
introduced.quote: Uncle Dai is one of the foremen at Huishan Hall over in Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: Mine site where the miners vanished, and the wider region around it
introduced.quote: Everyone, follow me to The Chasm. There are men counting on you to find them.

introduced.name: Lingju Pass
introduced.how: Mountain pass north of The Chasm where the miners' trail leads
introduced.quote: Heading north from The Chasm, we'll reach Lingju Pass. If this is indeed the path they chose, there will be traces.

introduced.name: Nantianmen
introduced.how: Settlement the miners and the scholar were heading toward
introduced.quote: I set off from Nantianmen the day before yesterday heading for Lingju Pass.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: Meeting spot where the search party plans to reconvene
introduced.quote: let's reconvene at Wangshu Inn tomorrow evening.

introduced.name: Dragonfall
introduced.how: Rare forging ore that Kun Jun seeks and that was mined to obscurity centuries ago
introduced.quote: A few hundred years ago, they were virtually mined into obscurity.

introduced.name: Cor Lapis
introduced.how: Rock type whose memories are strong and detailed, unlike iron ores
introduced.quote: Cor Lapis and crystal memories are much stronger.

introduced.name: Stone-seeing
introduced.how: Kun Jun can perceive memories recorded in ore by touching it
introduced.quote: Kun Jun: I can... perceive the memories of ore.

introduced.name: Wanyu
introduced.how: Shenglu Hall scholar who studies human culture and civilization and was attacked by monsters
introduced.quote: My name is Wanyu, I belong to Liyue's Shenglu Hall.

introduced.name: Bravo
introduced.how: Miner who stayed behind, fell asleep, and was unaffected by the disappearance
introduced.quote: Bravo: I ended up falling asleep in the shelter inside.

introduced.name: Ling
introduced.how: Witness who saw the miners entranced and following a serious blue-haired girl
introduced.quote: Ling: I caught a glimpse... blue hair, short. I think... I think it was a girl!

introduced.name: Missing Miners
introduced.how: Four miners vanished from the mine six days earlier while the rest were away
introduced.quote: Uncle Dai: Six days ago, a group of us left the site to attend to other matters.

introduced.name: Azhdaha
introduced.how: Corrupted ancient being sealed in a domain beneath the Chasm, who hated Zhongli as Morax's vessel
introduced.quote: Inside, the group is met by Azhdaha, who immediately recognizes Zhongli as Morax's vessel

introduced.name: Morax
introduced.how: Geo deity who tried to save and then sealed his friend Azhdaha
introduced.quote: Despite Morax's attempts to stop the erosion, it ultimately failed and he was forced to seal his old friend away

introduced.name: Erosion
introduced.how: Affliction that made Azhdaha forget his purpose and turn aggressive
introduced.quote: as time passed, he began suffering from

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Lines of energy in the Chasm that humanity disturbed, triggering Azhdaha's split
introduced.quote: because humanity disturbed the Ley Lines of the Chasm, which the benevolent side confirms.

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: Adeptus who helped seal the corrupted Azhdaha
introduced.quote: with the help of his benevolent consciousness, Mountain Shaper, Moon Carver and a third unknown adeptus.

introduced.name: Azhdaha
introduced.how: ancient dragon once sealed underground by Morax, now a possessing force that wants revenge
introduced.quote: Azhdaha was once a friend and ally of the Geo Archon, Morax, with a lifespan far exceeding that of mankind.

introduced.name: Morax
introduced.how: Zhongli's former identity, the Geo Archon who sealed Azhdaha
introduced.quote: So, Morax... you call yourself Zhongli these days?

introduced.name: Geo Archon
introduced.how: the title Morax held as a god of Geo
introduced.quote: Azhdaha was once a friend and ally of the Geo Archon, Morax, with a lifespan far exceeding that of mankind.

introduced.name: Azhdaha fragment
introduced.how: Kun Jun is a split-off fragment of Azhdaha's will, not Azhdaha whole
introduced.quote: Allow me to elaborate. I am not Azhdaha the whole... but a fragment.

introduced.name: Erosion
introduced.how: force that wears away rocks' and beings' memories and consciousness over time
introduced.quote: Erosion is the world's greatest destroyer of memories.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: energy lines that sustained Azhdaha and were damaged by mining
introduced.quote: It was humanity that attacked the Ley Lines that sustained me!

introduced.name: The Chasm (Area)
introduced.how: mine where Azhdaha attacked a thousand years ago and was sealed
introduced.quote: A thousand years ago, Azhdaha attacked The Chasm.

introduced.name: Dragonfall
introduced.how: stone born during the battle that Azhdaha could sense and used to seek Zhongli
introduced.quote: During that battle, Dragonfall was born.

introduced.name: Missing Miners
introduced.how: miners kidnapped by Azhdaha to dig toward the seal
introduced.quote: The missing miners are here!

introduced.name: Uncle Dai
introduced.how: leader of the miners' crew who searched for the missing men and offers help
introduced.quote: So there you are! My men and I found your clues and followed them straight here.

introduced.name: Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: storyteller narrating the legend of Rex Lapis and Azhdaha
introduced.quote: In our last tale, Rex Lapis was walking alone in the mountains.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: the Lord of Geo who found and carved Azhdaha from a stone
introduced.quote: The Lord of Geo took pity on the rock's spirit and carved it into a magnificent work of craftsmanship

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: creator of the tablet naming Azhdaha as a terrible dragon
introduced.quote: This tablet was erected by Mountain Shaper.

introduced.name: Stone Monolith
introduced.how: tablet warning that an evil dragon is sealed here and must not be disturbed
introduced.quote: On this site lies an evil dragon, please do not disturb it.

introduced.name: Kun Jun artisan family
introduced.how: the real Kun Jun comes from a family of famous artisans and is a talented smith
introduced.quote: Kun Jun hails from a family of famous artisans — he too will be famous in time.

introduced.name: Azhdaha and Morax contract
introduced.how: a promise sealing Azhdaha, which Kun Jun presents as the origin of its own existence
introduced.quote: I am your final contract. Witness the promise between Azhdaha and Morax.

introduced.name: Azhdaha's sealing
introduced.how: Zhongli defeated Azhdaha in the Chasm and sealed him underground a thousand years ago
introduced.quote: Finally, I brought him down, and sealed him underground.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: In our last tale, Rex Lapis...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: he'll tell you its value to the nearest Mora at a glance.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: I'd go as far to say that there's not a soul in Teyvat that knows rocks better than him.

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: The Traveler then remembers their travel with Dainsleif

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: asks Zhongli if he knows anything about the fall of Khaenri'ah

assumed.name: Geo Archon
assumed.quote: Azhdaha was a friend of humanity and the Geo Archon.

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: with the help of his benevolent consciousness, Mountain Shaper, Moon Carver and a third unknown adeptus.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Paimon: So, not long ago we met a guy called Dain.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: He told us about Khaenri'ah and the punishment of the gods...

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: Perhaps this is the erosion imposed on me by the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Four miners vanished with only their tools taken, and the cause is an open question.
threads.quote: They learn that the missing men had taken only their pickaxes and mining baskets when they disappeared

threads.claim: A child is seen leading the entranced miners away from the mine.
threads.quote: Kun Jun: I see... four men... following someone out of the mine... it looks like a child.

threads.claim: The malevolent aura takes the form of the little girl who attacks the group.
threads.quote: transforming into the girl who attacks from behind

threads.claim: Azhdaha is sealed in a domain and vows revenge against Zhongli.
threads.quote: declares he will get his vengeance for his supposed

threads.claim: Azhdaha was once a friend of Morax and humanity who split into a corrupted body and a benevolent consciousness.
threads.quote: Kun Jun explains that as a whole, Azhdaha was a friend of humanity and the Geo Archon.

threads.claim: Kun Jun is revealed to be the benevolent fragment of Azhdaha.
threads.quote: He reveals himself to be a fragment of Azhdaha, his benevolent consciousness

threads.claim: Kun Jun cannot remember his purpose or why he is seeking Dragonfall.
threads.quote: I'm having trouble remembering things.

threads.claim: Kun Jun's undisclosed reason for seeking Dragonfall is unclear and may be dangerous.
threads.quote: I'm looking for a precious stone known as Dragonfall.

threads.claim: Dragonfall forms from elemental reactions rather than heat, making its rarity and Kun Jun's interest unusual.
threads.quote: Dragonfall, on the other hand, is formed as a product of elemental reactions.

threads.claim: Zhongli knows about a past incident but is bound by a contract to keep it secret.
threads.quote: Zhongli states that he is aware of the incident, but refuses to disclose anything, as he had been bound by a contract to not speak of it well before the Traveler came.

threads.claim: Zhongli knows of the fall of Khaenri'ah but will not reveal what he knows.
threads.quote: asks Zhongli if he knows anything about the fall of Khaenri'ah

threads.claim: Erosion gradually causes beings like Azhdaha to forget their purpose and become aggressive.
threads.quote: as time passed, he began suffering from

threads.claim: Stones record memories but keep only the most prominent ones, so others are forgotten.
threads.quote: while the rocks hold many memories, they only keep the most prominent ones

threads.claim: Azhdaha may awaken again, and Liyue must be prepared for that possibility.
threads.quote: He worries that no one will be prepared to deal with his corrupted self if he awakens once more,

threads.claim: Zhongli has stepped down as the Geo Archon.
threads.quote: learns that he has stepped down as the Geo Archon.

threads.claim: Kun Jun is revealed to be a human vessel carrying a fragment of Azhdaha's will, answering who is the real Azhdaha.
threads.quote: Traveler: Then... which one is the real Azhdaha?

threads.claim: The real Kun Jun has not yet been met and is apparently sleeping in the body Azhdaha used.
threads.quote: Zhongli: In fact... we have yet to meet the real Kun Jun.

threads.claim: Azhdaha could be awakened a second time, so Liyue must prepare to face him again.
threads.quote: I cannot guarantee that I won't be awoken a second time.

threads.claim: Erosion steadily destroys memories and consciousness, even for gods, and is treated as an unstoppable natural force.
threads.quote: Erosion ground Azhdaha's consciousness into oblivion.

threads.claim: Zhongli suggests the Heavenly Principles impose erosion on him, hinting at a larger cosmic force.
threads.quote: Perhaps this is the erosion imposed on me by the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling is tied to Khaenri'ah events, and Zhongli refuses to reveal what he knows.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I cannot say.

threads.claim: Dain's account links Khaenri'ah and the punishment of the gods to the person the Traveler seeks.
threads.quote: He told us about Khaenri'ah and the punishment of the gods...

threads.claim: Dragonfall was born during Azhdaha's battle, and Azhdaha used its sensing to find Zhongli.
threads.quote: Azhdaha could sense the stone. Subconsciously, he wanted to use it to find me.

threads.claim: Zhongli is Morax, the former Geo Archon who now lives as an ordinary citizen of Liyue.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Today I am just an ordinary citizen of Liyue.

threads.claim: Overmining of the mountains caused the Ley Lines to quake, causing suffering to Azhdaha and driving him to rage.
threads.quote: Overexploitation caused the Ley Lines to quake, which brought untold suffering to

threads.claim: A tablet names Azhdaha as an evil dragon and warns people to stay away from the seal.
threads.quote: On this site lies an evil dragon, please do not disturb it.

introduced.name: Legion of Soulblazers
introduced.how: a comic book fan club whose members share comics, meals and friendship
introduced.quote: Yes, we were initially brought together by a shared interest in comics.

introduced.name: The Soulblazer Saga
introduced.how: a long comic series, told over 12 volumes, adapting Natlan's history
introduced.quote: The tale of The Soulblazer Saga is a long one, told over 12 volumes.

introduced.name: Soulblazers
introduced.how: Natlanese warriors who fought Abyss monsters to protect their nation
introduced.quote: The Soulblazers were warriors who fought against the monsters of the Abyss. Their mission? To protect their nation.

introduced.name: Fietena
introduced.how: the finest Soulblazer warrior, a Natlanese hero and role model who wore masks in combat
introduced.quote: The finest warrior of all the Soulblazers was Fietena. She is our hero, our role model.

introduced.name: Moritz and Sherilyn
introduced.how: Minnie's parents, who oppose her moving abroad to pursue comics work
introduced.quote: My mom and dad don't approve of me moving abroad for work.

introduced.name: Patton
introduced.how: Minnie's much older brother, who works at the tavern
introduced.quote: Hey, everyone. I'm Minnie's much older brother.

introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.how: a Natlanese student of Xilonen who loves Minnie's artwork and organized a fan painting
introduced.quote: So instead, my student Nepecha arranged for them all to make a group painting for Minnie.

introduced.name: Fietena VS Abyss Lector
introduced.how: a standalone Soulblazer special, a comedic eating-contest story
introduced.quote: It's from that standalone special, Fietena VS Abyss Lector: Battle of the Meat Feasters. Right?

introduced.name: The Soulblazer Saga: Armored Assault
introduced.how: a non-canon Soulblazer mecha spinoff with aerial dogfights
introduced.quote: It abandons traditional modes of human combat, instead housing the heroes within giant armored mecha, each the size of the Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: the friendly librarian of the Mondstadt library who takes afternoon breaks
introduced.quote: My my, looks like a lot of visitors snuck in while I was on my afternoon break.

introduced.name: Mondstadt Library
introduced.how: a library where comics and light novels have no dedicated section
introduced.quote: They don't seem to have a dedicated section for comics and light novels here.

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: Varesa's tribe, where Minnie's mask and artwork are famous
introduced.quote: Your mask and artwork are already famous in the Collective of Plenty!

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Also, Mavuika had a cameo in there.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Haha, I can't wait to tell Xilonen the good news!

assumed.name: Alrani
assumed.quote: When I get back to the Akademiya, prepare to be whipped into shape.

assumed.name: Coach Iansan
assumed.quote: Even Coach Iansan has praised me for how fast I can run, and she has high standards!

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: The Pyro Archon has some real cool fight scenes too though!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Thank you, Honorary Knight. It really does ease my mind knowing that you're on the team.

threads.claim: Fietena is presented as the Soulblazers' beloved hero whose example inspires the characters.
threads.quote: The finest warrior of all the Soulblazers was Fietena. She is our hero, our role model.

threads.claim: Fietena's enduring dream and perseverance are the qualities that move the fans most.
threads.quote: I think for me... it's the way they portray Fietena's dream.

threads.claim: The Soulblazer Saga is said to adapt real Natlanese history, with characters based on real people.
threads.quote: That's right. It's an adaptation of Natlan's history. All the characters are based on real people.

threads.claim: Minnie's parents agreed to let her pursue her dream only if her team gets ranked in the contest.
threads.quote: So I made a deal with my parents: If I pull this off and my team gets ranked, they have to start taking me seriously about what I want in life.

threads.claim: Minnie's father affirms the deal and lets her compete, though this is her last time.
threads.quote: But a deal is a deal... This competition clearly means a lot to you. So, give it your best shot. See it through to the end.

threads.claim: Xilonen was saving Nepecha's gift for a final surprise, hinting it could change the situation.
threads.quote: I wasn't expecting Nepecha's gift for Minnie to come in handy so soon.

threads.claim: The fans' group painting, arranged by Nepecha, is revealed and given to Minnie, showing her worth to her parents.
threads.quote: Sorry, Minnie, Nepecha wanted me to give this to you as a surprise after the competition.

threads.claim: Varesa's own parents are warm and supportive, which makes the strained tone of Minnie's parents stand out.
threads.quote: I mean... Whether I'm training, eating, or heading to bed for a nap, they're all smiles.

threads.claim: Love that tries to mold a person into an image can restrict their freedom, and the person may need to leave.
threads.quote: Sometimes, someone can love their idea of another person so much that they'll try to mold them to fit that mental image.

introduced.name: Ashvattha Tree
introduced.how: the oldest Vasara Tree, which is very mighty and older than the Aranara
introduced.quote: This is a very, very mighty tree — the oldest Vasara Tree there is.

introduced.name: Queen Aranyani
introduced.how: a past figure whose song led Ashvattha to produce the Aranara
introduced.quote: Queen Aranyani sang here — thousands of moons ago, or perhaps even more.

introduced.name: Aramuhukunda
introduced.how: the very first Aranara, sprouted from Ashvattha's pomegranate
introduced.quote: That made Aramuhukunda the very first Aranara.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: the forest people descended from Ashvattha, spread like leaves on a tree
introduced.quote: Later, all the seeds grew and Aranara spread like leaves on a tree. We and Nara were both people of the forest.

introduced.name: Vasara Tree
introduced.how: a tree type that needs dreams and memories to flourish
introduced.quote: Just like trees need earth and rain to flourish, dreams and memories are what a Vasara Tree needs.

introduced.name: Vasoma Fruit
introduced.how: fruit from Vasara Trees offered to Ashvattha to help it bear fruit
introduced.quote: That's why we've brought three Vasoma Fruits from Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha as offerings for the Ashvattha Tree to bear great fruit.

introduced.name: Garland
introduced.how: a flower garland that marks the wearer as a child of the forest to Ashvattha
introduced.quote: For as long as you wear this garland, the Ashvattha Tree will recognize you as a child of the forest.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: a corrupting force that turns green land into withered, poisonous ground
introduced.quote: It will imbue the land and Sarva with viper venom until everything green turns brown, every flower has withered, every brook is putrid, and every creature is dead.

introduced.name: Marana's Avatar
introduced.how: Marana's embodiment, imprisoned by seals deep underground
introduced.quote: Marana's Avatar is imprisoned by three seals deep within this place.

introduced.name: Old Vanarana
introduced.how: an ancient sealed place deep within the Fane of Ashvattha where Marana's Avatar lies
introduced.quote: Old Vanarana is sealed deep within the Fane of Ashvattha. That's where we'll find Marana's Avatar.

introduced.name: Fane of Ashvattha
introduced.how: the shrine where the Ashvattha Tree grows and whose dream can be entered
introduced.quote: We're here. This is the Fane of Ashvattha, I can feel it.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: the Aranara's first homeland, lost in the disaster
introduced.quote: Anyway, this was our first homeland. Aranara used to live here before the disaster, and many Nara had visited us.

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: a corruption that spreads as zones and tumors near Marana's Avatar
introduced.quote: Tumors are starting to appear because we're getting close to Marana's Avatar.

introduced.name: Inscriptions of Remembrance
introduced.how: stone inscriptions that must be read to unlock the first seal
introduced.quote: Three Inscriptions of Remembrance are needed to undo the first seal.

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: an Aranara power that comes from a song of praise and can block the Withering
introduced.quote: Ararakalari originated from the song of Aranara that praised Queen Aranyani, Nara, and their own species.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: an ancient race whose survivors are now empty husks, cursed when they fell in love with Nara
introduced.quote: In the ancient stories, Seelies were a great race with wisdom and beauty beyond the pale of this earth.

introduced.name: Aradasha
introduced.how: a legendary figure who imprisoned a mountain-sized metal beast with a stone lock
introduced.quote: But Aradasha bested the beast and imprisoned it with a lock of stone!

introduced.name: Ruin Machine
introduced.how: remnant war machines of the disaster scattered in the tunnels
introduced.quote: Paimon saw many ruin machines while descending... So a fierce battle really did occur here...

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: the fruit the Ashvattha Tree must bear, which needs a new tree once the old one is corroded
introduced.quote: Once we defeat Marana's Avatar, I'll plant a new Ashvattha Tree, and then it'll produce the Bija for us.

introduced.name: Marana's Avatar
introduced.how: a corrupting being that was sealed under the ground by the last war
introduced.quote: They crushed Marana's Avatar and imprisoned it here with the four seals.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: a corrupting power that took over the Vasara Tree and threatens all life on earth
introduced.quote: Marana has corroded the Vasara Tree that was meant to grow atop it and has gained possession of its bodily form.

introduced.name: Aramuhukunda
introduced.how: an Aranara who turned into a tree to suppress Marana's Avatar
introduced.quote: Aramuhukunda turned into this tree to suppress Marana's Avatar.

introduced.name: Tumor of the Withering
introduced.how: the spirit container of Marana's Avatar, which must be destroyed to damage its body
introduced.quote: Ah. So it has shifted its spirit. We must destroy its spirit's container to do damage to its form. Come with me.

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: a corruption spreading through the forest, with monsters that serve dark power and are not natural
introduced.quote: These evil monsters follow the dark power and are vanguards of corruption. They are not natural.

introduced.name: Garland
introduced.how: a flower garland that can transfer energy to friends and strengthen them
introduced.quote: It's the power of the garland. We can use the flowers to transfer energy to our friends.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: beings whose hearts are connected to flowers, and whose bond can help those who wear garlands
introduced.quote: Each flower is connected with the heart of an Aranara.

introduced.name: Mahavanaranapna
introduced.how: a place or state that a woven garland of these flowers can open the door to
introduced.quote: One could even say that a garland of these flowers woven together can form the door to "Mahavanaranapna."

introduced.name: Sarva
