introduced.how: a realm where memories and dreams are kept and can be seen and shared
introduced.quote: With all these memories and energies I've received, I'm now able to see many scenes and stories in Sarva.

introduced.name: Vasoma Fruit
introduced.how: fruits that hold the memories of Aranara and can be absorbed
introduced.quote: Yes, they were once Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha. The Vasoma Fruits are their memories.

introduced.name: Vasara Tree
introduced.how: a tree that an Aranara can grow into after gathering memories over a long time
introduced.quote: I was planning to build up my memories with my own eyes and body for several decades or centuries, and then embrace the land again to grow into a beautiful Vasara Tree.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: a precious item made from an Aranara's memories and dreams, used to grow an Ashvattha Tree
introduced.quote: I will grow into a new Ashvattha Tree, bear the Bija using your memories and dreams, and use my roots to reconnect the corroded bridges between dreams.

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: an Aranara power, with teleportation as one example
introduced.quote: This particular Ararakalari is called "teleportation."

introduced.name: Narana
introduced.how: Arana's friend who shares her name and holds the Ararakalari Arana left with her
introduced.quote: I want to help Narana. She has the same name as Arana. She is Arana's friend.

assumed.name: Arama
assumed.quote: Paimon: Arama!

assumed.name: Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: Aren't you that mysterious Aranara we met during Festival Utsava?

assumed.name: Ashvattha's Concourses
assumed.quote: So we're doing this like we did back in Ashvattha's Concourses, right?

assumed.name: Araji, Arayama, Aramaha
assumed.quote: Thank you, Aramaha, Araji, and Arayama, thank you for guarding the seal.

assumed.name: Arana
assumed.quote: it can resist The Withering, too! Is it a similar Ararakalari?

assumed.name: Aranakin
assumed.quote: Paimon's seen Aranakin talking to mushrooms before...

assumed.name: Arasudraka
assumed.quote: That's the Aranara who was mentioned while we were helping Arasudraka search for that song, right?

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: And we still have to help Rana.

assumed.name: Ruu
assumed.quote: If Ruu were here, Paimon's sure he and Arama would become friends real quick...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: If only everyone from Sumeru had this ability!

assumed.name: Valuka
assumed.quote: There's a very, very huge Valuka outside the forest, and there are Nara in it.

assumed.name: Sarva
assumed.quote: The past and the future meet in Sarva.

assumed.name: Nara Varuna
assumed.quote: Now, I can finally return to Sarva and meet Nara Varuna again.

assumed.name: Arama
assumed.quote: Arama: Come, Nara and Paimon, let's get going.

assumed.name: Arana
assumed.quote: Paimon: Arana... Right, we've gotta use Arana's memories to produce the Bija...

assumed.name: Vimara Village
assumed.quote: Paimon: But isn't Arana around Vimara Village? How are we gonna...

assumed.name: Ashvattha Tree
assumed.quote: Paimon: These monsters... They're the same as the ones in the Ashvattha Tree's dream...

assumed.name: Rhythm of the Great Dream
assumed.quote: Arana: Arana has taught you the Rhythm of the Great Dream. Do you still remember it, Nara ?

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah. Now all we need to do is to give it to Rana, right?

assumed.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
assumed.quote: The forest is even more luxuriant than it was in the time of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

assumed.name: Nara Varuna
assumed.quote: I believe that by then there will once again come someone as golden as the sun, just like Nara and Nara Varuna, so I wouldn't worry about it.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Anyway, Tighnari also said there'll be no new Withering Zones!

threads.claim: The Ashvattha Tree is weakened, which Arama blames on Marana appearing everywhere.
threads.quote: Something's wrong with the Ashvattha Tree. It feels a bit weak...

threads.claim: Marana's corruption has left the Ashvattha Tree unable to bear Bija, so a new tree must be planted.
threads.quote: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded by Marana and cannot bear any Bija.

threads.claim: Arama accepts a coming fate that it expects to arrive sooner than planned, hinting at a sacrifice.
threads.quote: Yes, I understand. I didn't think it would be so soon, but I'm aware that I'll know what to do when the time comes.

threads.claim: Arama has changed after absorbing the Ashvattha Tree's and inscriptions' memories, and the cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Why have you change so much, Arama?

threads.claim: The number of seals imprisoning Marana is inconsistent, with three named earlier and four stated later.
threads.quote: By the way, there are actually four seals imprisoning Marana.

threads.claim: Aramuhukunda is the final seal, keeping watch on Marana's Avatar.
threads.quote: And I am the final seal.

threads.claim: Marana appeared during the disaster, turning grasslands to sand, and the Aranara sealed its avatar underground.
threads.quote: Marana appeared during the disaster too, and many grasslands were turned to sand. That's why we fought Marana and sealed its avatar underground.

threads.claim: The ruin machines are remnants of a fierce battle fought during the disaster.
threads.quote: Paimon saw many ruin machines while descending... So a fierce battle really did occur here...

threads.claim: The text uses Queen Aranyani and the Lord of Verdure interchangeably for the same singer, linked to the Dendro Archon.
threads.quote: The Lord of Verdure sang here — thousands of moons ago, or perhaps even more.

threads.claim: Aramuhukunda and Arana gained their Ararakalari's healing ability by witnessing the Lord of Verdure heal the land.
threads.quote: Aramuhukunda and Arana witnessed the moment when the Lord of Verdure healed the land and transformed the golden lands of death into forests filled with vitality.

threads.claim: A Seelie survivor in the golden desert may hold more stories about the old friendships with Queen Aranyani and the Lord of Verdure.
threads.quote: Perhaps there are more stories to be found in the eternal oasis.

threads.claim: Arama expects to meet Ruu someday.
threads.quote: A day will come when I'll have the honor of meeting this Ruu and becoming friends with him.

threads.claim: Aramuhukunda knew Nara Varuna in a past age and hopes to see them again in Sarva.
threads.quote: Now, I can finally return to Sarva and meet Nara Varuna again.

threads.claim: Arama says events in dreams are as real as events in waking life, a theme the dream-based quest depends on.
threads.quote: But the things that happen in dreams are real.

threads.claim: The Withering is a corruption whose monsters are unnatural and serve dark power.
threads.quote: These evil monsters follow the dark power and are vanguards of corruption. They are not natural.

threads.claim: Marana will wake again in decades or centuries because its memory remains in Sarva.
threads.quote: Marana should fall into slumber now that its avatar has been destroyed. But in a matter of decades, perhaps centuries, it will wake up again.

threads.claim: Marana's memories in Sarva are erased, so it cannot return.
threads.quote: I can sense that all memories about Marana in Sarva have been completely erased.

threads.claim: Defeating Marana's Avatar should allow the Bija to be obtained.
threads.quote: With it defeated, we should be able to obtain the Bija.

threads.claim: The Bija is obtained from Arana's memories and the Rhythm of the Great Dream.
threads.quote: Paimon: We finally got it. The precious Bija...

threads.claim: The garland's power depends on the wearer being kind and honest, linked to Aranara hearts.
threads.quote: It's because Nara is kind and honest, and because Nara is Nara , that the garland could serve its purpose.

threads.claim: Vasara Trees in Ashvattha's Concourses were once Aranara, and their memories are Vasoma Fruits.
threads.quote: Yes, they were once Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha. The Vasoma Fruits are their memories.

threads.claim: Arama has become the seed of a new Ashvattha Tree.
threads.quote: I'm the seed for the new Ashvattha Tree.

threads.claim: Arama has grown into a new Ashvattha Tree, still small with deep roots.
threads.quote: Arama has grown into the new Ashvattha Tree. It's small now, but the roots are deep and strong.

threads.claim: Marana's memory is kept in Sarva, and Sarva holds stories and memories of the forest.
threads.quote: It's because Marana's memory has been left in Sarva.

threads.claim: The Traveler has a past connection with the Aranara that the Garland awakens.
threads.quote: The Traveler's Garland glows yellow and the Traveler remembers the memories with the Aranara

threads.claim: Giving up memories would make Aranara forget people such as Rana and the children of Vimara Village.
threads.quote: Paimon: Arana, you once said that memories and dreams are Aranara's source of strength. If you give those memories up, you'll forget Rana, won't you?

threads.claim: Arana does not recognize the Traveler after the Bija is made, hinting at lost memory.
threads.quote: Arana: ...Who are you?

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Former Spantamad Sage who taught Cyno and Lisa, introduced as a retired old man
introduced.quote: His name is Cyrus, a former Spantamad Sage. He taught both me and Lisa.

introduced.name: Urraca
introduced.how: Sixteen-year-old Akademiya third-year student who wrote the threat letter
introduced.quote: The culprit's name is Urraca. A sixteen-year-old student in the Rtawahist Darshan.

introduced.name: Zaha Hadi
introduced.how: Professor in Kshahrewar and Cyrus's rival neighbor over tomato growing
introduced.quote: Kshahrewar's very own Professor Zaha Hadi!

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: Ancient organization of sages in Sumeru, now mostly a facade at the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Well, to put it simply, it's an organization that has existed in Sumeru for over a thousand years.

introduced.name: Hermanubis
introduced.how: Legendary founder of the Temple of Silence, one of the Seven Pillars and greatest sage
introduced.quote: Historically speaking, the original Temple of Silence is said to have been established by Hermanubis, one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret and the greatest of all sages.

introduced.name: Naphis
introduced.how: Tighnari's master, a sage who called Cyno, Tighnari and Collei to the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Tighnari's master, Sir Naphis, called him and Collei to the Akademiya to help out on a project.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: Busy scholarly institution in Sumeru City where the case unfolds
introduced.quote: Woah, the Akademiya sure is busy during the day!

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: Young man of the Temple of Silence, adopted grandson of Bamoun, who introduces himself
introduced.quote: He introduces himself as Sethos and had already known why they had come.

introduced.name: Bamoun
introduced.how: Leader of the Temple of Silence who orders Cyrus out and reveals the fragment plan
introduced.quote: The leader, Bamoun, eventually arrives and he orders Cyrus out.

introduced.name: Ba Fragments
introduced.how: Shards of Hermanubis's power, given to two children as vessels
introduced.quote: he had come into possession of two Ba Fragments — shards of his power.

introduced.name: Valuka Shuna
introduced.how: Tighnari's ancestral people, with a long history tied to the Temple and Hermanubis
introduced.quote: Tighnari is impressed as while he knew that he was named after his kind, he had never known the extent of their history with the Temple.

introduced.name: Alhaitham's past as Acting Grand Sage
introduced.how: Alhaitham once served as Acting Grand Sage and had access to top-secret documents
introduced.quote: He did a stint as Acting Grand Sage. And kept the pay raise even after he resigned.

introduced.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
introduced.how: Powerful weapon of Cyno's that he offers to the group
introduced.quote: It's a very powerful weapon. Try it.

introduced.name: Rite of Duels
introduced.how: Winner-take-all duel format used to settle who gets the fragments
introduced.quote: a winner-take-all in a Rite of Duels, which Sethos is surprised by but accepts.

introduced.name: Caravan Ribat
introduced.how: Desert outpost where Cyrus and Cyno were seen heading
introduced.quote: Both were heading in the direction of Caravan Ribat.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: Climbable Divine Tree area that Cyno uses as a secret retreat
introduced.quote: Cyno asks the Traveler to follow him to the Sanctuary of Surasthana.

introduced.name: Threat letter
introduced.how: Crude letter demanding ten million Mora from Cyrus, with a coffee stain and scented paper
introduced.quote: This is the letter in question.

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: introduces himself as a Temple of Silence figure who will not answer all questions
introduced.quote: My name is Sethos. I'll be here if you need me, but I'm not planning on answering all of your questions.

introduced.name: Bamoun
introduced.how: introduced as the current leader of the Temple of Silence
introduced.quote: Greetings, one and all. I am Bamoun, the current leader of the Temple of Silence.

introduced.name: Hermanubis
introduced.how: explained as the original founder of the Temple of Silence and the spirit granting Cyno's power
introduced.quote: Hermanubis, the original founder of the Temple of Silence.

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: a hidden desert order guarding secrets and tied to Hermanubis
introduced.quote: The Temple of Silence is a place of quiet and solitude. We don't get too many visitors.

introduced.name: Ba Fragments
introduced.how: explained as shards of Hermanubis that can be implanted into vessels to grant his spirit's power
introduced.quote: Bamoun proposed that we implant Ba Fragments, shards of Hermanubis, into the bodies of suitable vessels.

introduced.name: Rite of Duels
introduced.how: explained as a founding Temple of Silence rite of sparring matches that began the order
introduced.quote: The Rite of Duels. It's where it all began.

introduced.name: Ba Fragment implantation experiment
introduced.how: Cyrus recounts the failed adult trials and the use of a child as a vessel
introduced.quote: Many believers volunteered themselves for the experiment, but we soon discovered that the bodies of grown adults could not withstand Hermanubis's power.

introduced.name: Tulaytullah
introduced.how: explained as the city where Hermanubis arrived and the Temple's ancient home
introduced.quote: Legend has it that when Hermanubis first arrived in Tulaytullah, he sparred with the city's residents.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: explained as an ancient civilization whose secrets the Temple guards
introduced.quote: For many years, we have kept our covenant with Lord Hermanubis by guarding the secrets of King Deshret.

introduced.name: Vessel of Hermanubis
introduced.how: explained that Cyno and Sethos are chosen hosts of Hermanubis's power
introduced.quote: As a fellow vessel of Hermanubis, your ties to the Temple of Silence run deep.

introduced.name: Urraca
introduced.how: explained as a tavern man who asked around for easy money and was used in the letter scheme
introduced.quote: He was asking everyone in the tavern about ways to make some easy money.

introduced.name: Cyrus's past with the Temple
introduced.how: Cyrus recounts being rescued by Bamoun and joining the Temple's plan
introduced.quote: He rescued me from the brink of death once, many years ago in the desert.

introduced.name: Hermanubis fragments
introduced.how: fragments whose holder decides who leads the Temple of Silence, the largest share wins
introduced.quote: Per my grandfather's last wishes, the Temple of Silence should submit to whoever possesses the largest number of Hermanubis fragments.

introduced.name: Rite of Duels
introduced.how: a duel used to settle the Temple's succession and mend ties with the Akademiya
introduced.quote: In that sense, the Rite of Duels was just a means to an end.

introduced.name: Bamoun
introduced.how: Sethos's grandfather, the Temple of Silence's leader, whose succession plan the duel served
introduced.quote: Cyno: Sethos, I would like you to succeed Bamoun as the new leader of the Temple of Silence.

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: a hidden desert organization holding a vast store of knowledge on King Deshret's civilization
introduced.quote: The Temple of Silence has a wealth of information on King Deshret's civilization, more than any other organization in existence today.

introduced.name: Cyrus (Sumeru)
introduced.how: a professor and former sage who once lived with the Temple and was saved by its people
introduced.quote: Cyno: ...It's Professor Cyrus.

introduced.name: Naphis
introduced.how: an Akademiya scholar, Cyrus's former classmate and Tighnari's master
introduced.quote: Paimon: Tighnari's master is really laying into Cyrus

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: an ancient king who chose the sage Hermanubis as his familiar
introduced.quote: The story goes that King Deshret chose the sage Hermanubis from among the Tighnarians, and appointed him as his familiar.

introduced.name: Hermanubis
introduced.how: a sage who became King Deshret's familiar and fought battles alongside Tighnarian companions
introduced.quote: He went on to fight many valiant battles with his Tighnarian companions.

introduced.name: Tighnarians
introduced.how: an ancestral people who served Hermanubis, and whose descendants settled in the rainforest
introduced.quote: The Tighnarians who left Tulaytullah joined their human counterparts in the rainforest.

introduced.name: Tulaytullah
introduced.how: an ancient place that fell, after which its Tighnarians scattered
introduced.quote: from the founding of the Temple of Silence to the fall of Tulaytullah.

introduced.name: Valuka Shuna
introduced.how: the ancestral group Tighnari descends from, linked to Hermanubis's heirs
introduced.quote: You are a descendant of the Valuka Shuna, and we are the heirs to the will of Hermanubis.

introduced.name: General Mahamatra
introduced.how: Cyno's title, a high post at the Akademiya he is needed back for
introduced.quote: I'm the General Mahamatra. I am needed back at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: The Akademiya
introduced.how: the scholarly institution that was once partnered with the Temple and is now being reconnected to it
introduced.quote: This experience has allowed us to become friends, which means that the Akademiya and the Temple of Silence will become partners once more.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: a high terrace in front of the Sanctuary, Cyno's secret base for clearing his head
introduced.quote: (Approach the terrace in front of the Sanctuary of Surasthana)

introduced.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
introduced.how: a tool that reveals characters' inner thoughts
introduced.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Sethos, optional)

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Cyno! It's been so long since we last saw you!

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Welcome back to Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Oh, Kaveh! It's been a while. Zaha Hadi was talking about you last month. How have you been?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Kaveh, Scribe Alhaitham, I'd like to ask you to cover the duties of the House of Daena.

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: It's Genius Invokation time.

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: Anyone would think you were sealing the gates to King Deshret's Mausoleum.

assumed.name: Corps of Thirty
assumed.quote: Collei, could I trouble you to send a message to the Corps of Thirty?

assumed.name: Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Mahamatra Cyno, Sir Cyrus.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Dehya: Oh, also — hey guys! It's been a while!

assumed.name: Candace
assumed.quote: Paimon: Dehya and Candace! So nice to see you!

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: You're trying to retrace Cyrus's steps, aren't you?

assumed.name: Zaha Hadi
assumed.quote: We spoke with Zaha Hadi.

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: It's a good thing that Kaveh noticed the emblem on the letter.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Thank goodness for Kaveh, and for Alhaitham's diligence during his time as Acting Grand Sage.

assumed.name: Naphis
assumed.quote: My master, Naphis, says the same thing — once Cyrus makes up his mind about something, he won't listen to reason.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: He's the General Mahamatra, everyone in Sumeru knows who he is.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Your actions would be seen as a declaration of war against the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Valuka Shuna
assumed.quote: Wait, those ears... So, we have a descendant of the Valuka Shuna in our midst?

assumed.name: Seven Pillars of King Deshret
assumed.quote: since it belongs to one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret

assumed.name: Eremite leaders
assumed.quote: One by one, Eremite leaders took up arms against each other in battles

assumed.name: Al-Ahmar
assumed.quote: To serve the God King, Al-Ahmar

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: I will make a detailed report on all of this to Lesser Lord Kusanali

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Ah, it's this one! I remember that, Lisa took it, didn't she?

assumed.name: Zaha Hadi
assumed.quote: I have got to beat Zaha Hadi!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Let's find a time and pay her a visit in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Collei: Ah, you're back!

assumed.name: Faruzan
assumed.quote: Faruzan: It's not the first time that I've had to talk to you about this sort of thing, either.

assumed.name: Kaveh and Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Am I hallucinating? Or do I see Kaveh and Alhaitham engaged in diligent studying?

assumed.name: Corps of Thirty
assumed.quote: Collei: I need to go say thanks to the Corps of Thirty for their help.

assumed.name: Duel of the Rite
assumed.quote: Were it not for this duel

threads.claim: Cyrus is hiding a secret that someone threatens to expose, hinting at a past tied to the Akademiya.
threads.quote: Cyrus, I have uncovered your secret. If you wish to prevent it from going public, leave ten million Mora at the back door of the café.

threads.claim: Cyrus seems to know something about the real Temple of Silence, which the player is left to wonder about.
threads.quote: Cyrus must know something about the Temple of Silence.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's Temple of Silence office is a facade that hides its true nature from the outside world.
threads.quote: At least, that's what they tell the outside world.

threads.claim: Naphis confirms the Akademiya's Temple of Silence is just a facade and the true Temple was separate.
threads.quote: Also, Naphis admitted that the Temple of Silence in the Akademiya is just a facade.

threads.claim: Cyno's powers came from Hermanubis through trials he no longer clearly remembers, and his origin is unclear.
threads.quote: Cyno admits that he doesn't remember too much about it, but knew that his powers came from Hermanubis after several trials before Cyrus brought him to Sumeru City.

threads.claim: Cyno absorbs the fragment and Hermanubis's power returns, confirming the fragments' true source.
threads.quote: recognizing it as Hermanubis' return and passes away.

threads.claim: Tighnari is recognized as a descendant of the Valuka Shuna, hinting at a hidden bond to the Temple.
threads.quote: Bamoun then recognizes Tighnari as a descendant of the Valuka Shuna before coughing severely

threads.claim: Sethos explains that the Valuka Shuna had a special relationship with Hermanubis.
threads.quote: Sethos then tells Tighnari that Bamoun had been delighted to see a descendant of the Valuka Shuna, explaining their relationship to Hermanubis.

threads.claim: The Temple of Silence emblem appears on the threat letter, which suggests a deeper conspiracy.
threads.quote: It's the emblem of the Temple of Silence.

threads.claim: Sethos is freed from the shackles of the past that bound his grandfather, a theme of breaking from history.
threads.quote: Not shackled to the past like his grandfather, Sethos allows the group to leave apart from Cyrus.

threads.claim: A rumor that Cyrus embezzled desert money circulates, with its source left unidentified.
threads.quote: Urraca mentioned he'd heard a rumor, alleging that Sir Cyrus illegally obtained a large sum of money from the desert before retiring

threads.claim: The Temple of Silence in the Akademiya is a fake, implying a true temple exists elsewhere.
threads.quote: It doesn't surprise me at all that the one in the Akademiya is a fake.

threads.claim: The true Temple of Silence is a hidden building beneath the desert sands near an oasis, preserved by King Deshret's technology.
threads.quote: I never imagined that the true Temple of Silence would be hidden somewhere like this...

threads.claim: Cyrus avoids all talk of the Temple of Silence and Hermanubis, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Professor has never once mentioned the Temple of Silence in conversation.

threads.claim: Cyrus's secret is that he lived among the Temple of Silence and helped its experiments before betraying it.
threads.quote: Bamoun: You recognized our emblem because for many years, you lived among us.

threads.claim: Cyno's childhood memories of the desert are hazy and unclear.
threads.quote: But my memory of that time is hazy. I can't recall much.

threads.claim: Cyno's hazy memories may be caused by the overpowering presence of the Ba Fragments.
threads.quote: My own memories of this place are hazy, though. Probably something to do with the overpowering presence of the Ba Fragments.

threads.claim: Each Ba Fragment of Hermanubis represents something different, and many of its secrets remain unrevealed.
threads.quote: Each Ba Fragment of Hermanubis stands for something different — might, glory... or one of many other secrets that have yet to be revealed.

threads.claim: Hermanubis broke his being into many pieces to bestow his power on followers, and the Temple has been in decline since.
threads.quote: He broke his being into many pieces

threads.claim: The Temple of Silence was driven out of Tulaytullah and wandered in exile between desert and forest.
threads.quote: We have lived in exile for far, far too long...

threads.claim: Sethos differs from his grandfather and sees the Temple's prestige as diminished.
threads.quote: I'm not like my grandfather.

threads.claim: Sethos is not a villain but acts from his own sense of what is best.
threads.quote: I can't shake the feeling that Bamoun cares for many more things than he lets on, and I don't think that Sethos is any kind of villain.

threads.claim: The letter was written to make Cyrus think his secret was exposed, without stating what the secret was.
threads.quote: It didn't say what secret that was.

threads.claim: Tighnari's ears reveal he is a descendant of the Valuka Shuna, which matters to the Temple.
threads.quote: Wait, those ears... So, we have a descendant of the Valuka Shuna in our midst?

threads.claim: The Temple of Silence belongs to one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret.
threads.quote: since it belongs to one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret

threads.claim: Cyno wins the Rite of Duels, taking Sethos's Ba Fragment as the duel's terms require.
threads.quote: I give his glory to you

threads.claim: Bamoun dies after the duel, and the room bows in mourning.
threads.quote: (Recognizing that he has passed on, everyone in the room silently bows their heads)

threads.claim: Tighnari hints that Bamoun may have anticipated how his succession would end.
threads.quote: Perhaps he had an inkling that this would be the way things end.

threads.claim: Cyno suspects Bamoun engineered the duel to force the Ba Fragments into a single successor's hands.
threads.quote: Actually, part of me wonders whether Bamoun's intention from the very beginning was just to create enough pressure to force us towards a duel.

threads.claim: Sethos confirms that he and his grandfather planned the succession from every angle.
threads.quote: You're absolutely right. Grandfather and I considered this from every angle.

threads.claim: Cyno expects the Temple and the Akademiya to become partners again.
threads.quote: That's a much bigger deal than you might think, Sethos.

threads.claim: Sethos declares that the Temple can now work with the Akademiya once more.
threads.quote: From this day on, the Temple of Silence has the chance to work with the Akademiya once more.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests that Hermanubis's power binds its heirs to the Temple of Silence.
threads.quote: As long as Hermanubis's power endures...

threads.claim: Tighnari learns that his ancestors were the Tighnarians who served Hermanubis.
threads.quote: In all likelihood, those were your ancestors.

threads.claim: Cyrus has lasting, dreamlike memories of the desert people who once saved his life.
threads.quote: I dreamt of that place many times after leaving the desert.

threads.claim: Cyrus admits that Bamoun had reason to despise him, hinting at an old wrong.
threads.quote: I can't pretend I'm a good person. Bamoun had every reason to despise me

threads.claim: Cyno admits that he once asked who he was and why he had his power, as Sethos does now.
threads.quote: Back then, I had a lot of the same questions that Sethos was asking: Who am I? Why do I have this power? And what should I be fighting for?

threads.claim: Cyno suggests that one's gifts help one find a rightful place in the world.
threads.quote: Our gifts help us to find our rightful place in the world.

threads.claim: The Temple holds knowledge of King Deshret's civilization that no other organization possesses.
threads.quote: The Temple of Silence has a wealth of information on King Deshret's civilization, more than any other organization in existence today.

introduced.name: Dodo-King
introduced.how: ruler of the Dodo Clan who sets trials and gives hats to Dodocos
introduced.quote: Their job is to help out and protect all the other Dodocos, so the Dodo-King gives them a special hat.

introduced.name: Dodo Clan
introduced.how: Dodocos who earn the Dodo-King's acknowledgment protect other Dodocos
introduced.quote: In the Dodo Clan, only the awesomest and bestest Dodocos in the land can earn the acknowledgment of the Dodo-King!

introduced.name: Dodo-Sorcerer
introduced.how: a Dodoco wearing the special hat becomes a Dodo-Sorcerer who uses spark magic to help people
introduced.quote: The hat makes Dodoco a Dodo-Sorcerer now! She can use special spark magic to help even more people!

introduced.name: Dodoco
introduced.how: Klee's Dodoco must find a red four-leaf clover and pass the Dodo-King's trial to become special
introduced.quote: Well, every Dodoco's gotta find a red four-leaf clover to become a super special Dodoco.

introduced.name: Whispering Woods
introduced.how: forest where the first stage of the Dodoco trial is set, full of hurdles and Hilichurls
introduced.quote: (Arrive at the Whispering Woods)

introduced.name: Starfell Lake
introduced.how: lake of fallen stars on whose banks the final trial is passed
introduced.quote: Dodoco proceeded to the banks of a lake of fallen stars, passed the final trial, and obtained her reward.

introduced.name: Jumpy Dumpty
introduced.how: explosive Klee uses for blast-fishing and blasting through obstacles
introduced.quote: Oh! So, like... when I go blast-fishing with Jumpy Dumpty?

introduced.name: Klee's mom
introduced.how: author of the trial notes, who told Klee the Dodoco trial plan and the Dodo-King rules
introduced.quote: Yup, and it's mom's handwriting again...

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Hey there, Klee!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Honorary Knight! Paimon!

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Well, if Master Jean would just let Klee blow the confinement room up...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius Headquarters
assumed.quote: Hehe, that's gotta be a fun one. We should drop by the Knights of Favonius to go see her when we get the chance!

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Oh, this task is for Klee... And it's from Alice...

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: And why are there so many Hilichurls?

assumed.name: Slimes
assumed.quote: Ah, that's because we cleared out a Hilichurl camp over there, and a bunch of Slimes too.

assumed.name: confinement
assumed.quote: I've been getting sent to confinement less and less these days!

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: a meal at the Good Hunter!

assumed.name: Sweet Madame
assumed.quote: Paimon's been craving some Sweet Madame!

threads.claim: A secret lies buried past the trial's hurdles in the forest, but its nature is left unrevealed.
threads.quote: There, past layer upon layer of hurdles, a secret lay buried, waiting to be uncovered...

threads.claim: The final stage proves less simple than the note suggested, as monsters attack at the lake.
threads.quote: Guess it's not going to be that simple, after all...

threads.claim: The trial's reward turns out to be a hat that makes Dodoco a Dodo-Sorcerer.
threads.quote: A hat for Dodoco!

threads.claim: Klee's mom wrote the trial notes, and her role in the trial is left open.
threads.quote: Yup, and it's mom's handwriting again...

introduced.name: Sebas
introduced.how: a talking cat who is Rhinedottir's creation, serves as butler of her house, and is Albedo's elder
introduced.quote: I'll have you know that I alone keep that giant house in order as its butler.

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Albedo's master and creator of Albedo and Sebas, who sends messages through Sebas
introduced.quote: Sebas: But considering that you've completed Master Rhinedottir's final task, I suppose you deserve a break.

introduced.name: Rhinedottir's final task
introduced.how: a task Rhinedottir set for Albedo, whose completion means finding an answer Albedo can accept
introduced.quote: in regard to that task I set for you, your discovery of an answer that you can accept is most delightful.

introduced.name: Albedo's habit of drawing Sebas
introduced.how: Albedo draws portraits, often of Sebas, to let his subconscious sort out his thoughts
introduced.quote: Whenever I need to think, I turn to drawing, and let my subconscious take over.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Albedo's over there. Wonder what he's doing...

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Albedo: Sucrose has been advancing swiftly in her studies, too.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius don't have any duties for me at the moment, either...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: But, unfortunately for me, Mondstadt seems perfectly problem-free at the moment...

assumed.name: A Child Wandering the World
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed A Child Wandering the World)

assumed.name: Durin
assumed.quote: (He must be talking about Durin...)

assumed.name: Sebas's earlier meeting with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Traveler: Nice to see you again.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir holds that questions are more interesting than answers and urges Albedo to pose his own.
threads.quote: After all, questions have always been more interesting than answers, and much better for passing the time.

threads.claim: A cryptic message calls Albedo a seed of dreams and hints at a larger cosmic tree and fruit imagery.
threads.quote: But you, O seed of dreams, do not settle for being the king of a universe confined to its flesh.

threads.claim: Sebas was born recently, yet Rhinedottir long foresaw his task, hinting at how her creations were made.
threads.quote: Although his "birth" was rather recent, Master Rhinedottir has long foreseen what his "task" should be.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir warns against building a self whose only purpose is to pose or ponder questions, saying she tried it and it failed.
threads.quote: don't attempt to create a 'self' whose sole purpose is to pose or ponder questions. I've tried it, and it doesn't work.

threads.claim: Durin is a figure connected to Mondstadt whom the Traveler is expected to recognize, though he is not explained here.
threads.quote: (He must be talking about Durin...)

threads.claim: Albedo's answer to Rhinedottir's task is confirmed as a successful completion of that task.
threads.quote: in regard to that task I set for you, your discovery of an answer that you can accept is most delightful.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Geo Archon, god of Liyue, called by this name in place of Morax; killed at the Rite of Descension
introduced.quote: Paimon: So we should refer to the Geo Archon by the name Rex Lapis, like the people of Liyue do.

introduced.name: Morax
introduced.how: Original name of the Geo Archon, considered impolite for outsiders to use
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, right. About the Geo Archon, "Morax"...

introduced.name: Rite of Descension
introduced.how: Yearly ceremony where Rex Lapis gives a divine prediction guiding Liyue's governance for the year
introduced.quote: Linlang: Once a year, Rex Lapis bestows upon us his divine prediction, guiding us on how to run Liyue for the coming year.

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: Seven leaders of Liyue's seven enterprises who hold day-to-day control of Liyue
introduced.quote: Paimon: The Liyue Qixing — the seven leaders of the seven enterprises of Liyue — hold true control over Liyue.

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: Member of the Liyue Qixing, called the Tianquan, who summons Rex Lapis at the ceremony
introduced.quote: Ivanovich: Ah, look! That's Ms. Ningguang of the Liyue Qixing!

introduced.name: Yujing Terrace
introduced.how: Highest point in Liyue Harbor, where the Rite of Descension is held
introduced.quote: Guanhai: It's the highest place in the harbor — sounds like the best place for trying to communicate with deities, no?

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Liyue guards who arrest suspects and pursue the Traveler
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh no, the Millelith! Looks like they're nabbing suspects who got too close.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis's assassination
introduced.how: Rex Lapis falls from the sky apparently dead during the ceremony, and the Qixing orders suspects seized
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Rex Lapis has been killed! Seal the exits!

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: Young Hydro user and Fatui envoy from Snezhnaya who rescues the Traveler and offers help
introduced.quote: Childe: But... regrettably, given I'm a Fatui envoy from Snezhnaya... there's no way I'd be trusted after something of this magnitude.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Organization from Snezhnaya whose envoy Childe is; Childe is a Harbinger
introduced.quote: Childe: But... regrettably, given I'm a Fatui envoy from Snezhnaya... there's no way I'd be trusted after something of this magnitude.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: Bank in Liyue opened by Snezhnaya, where Childe meets the Traveler
introduced.quote: Childe: Correct. This bank was opened here in Liyue by Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Sigil of Permission
introduced.how: Keepsake that keeps adepti from harming its holder, given by Childe and used to gain audience with adepti
introduced.quote: Childe: All I know is that it's a sigil.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Immortal beings who live hidden on the outskirts of Liyue and protect it through fighting
introduced.quote: Verr Goldet: So for many millennia, it has instead been humans who have led Liyue, whilst the adepti have lived hidden away on the outskirts.

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: Stone forest said to be the abode of the adepti, which mortals avoid entering
introduced.quote: Childe: If you head north from the harbor, then west from Guili Plains, you will eventually reach a stone forest known an Jueyun Karst.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: Adeptus who guards Jueyun Karst and sends the Traveler to the other adepti
introduced.quote: Moon Carver: He before you is the mighty and illuminated adeptus, Moon Carver. Speak, traveler. What business have you here?

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: Adeptus who builds mechanical puzzle domains and tests visitors with a crane form
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: The one before you is the adeptus, Cloud Retainer. Now, speak of the matter which brings you here.

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: Adeptus of Mt. Hulao who guards the mountain and punishes trespassers
introduced.quote: Mountain Shaper: Rex Lapis charged the adepti with the protection of Liyue, and we have always honored this duty.

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: Conqueror of Demons, a Guardian Yaksha adeptus who lives at Wangshu Inn
introduced.quote: Moon Carver: There exists a Conqueror of Demons, a Guardian Yaksha. Go to Wangshu Inn. There you shall seek him.

introduced.name: Verr Goldet
introduced.how: Boss of Wangshu Inn who knows the adepti are secretly staying there
introduced.quote: Verr Goldet: Say any more and you'll be divulging my little secret.

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: Chef of Wangshu Inn, a former notorious bandit now frightened by ghosts
introduced.quote: Verr Goldet: Hehe... Scared of something so insignificant. Hard to believe he was once a notorious bandit.

introduced.name: Dusky Ming
introduced.how: Mischievous child ghost haunting Wangshu Inn, possessing people, who agrees to stop
introduced.quote: Dusky Ming: Dusky Ming won't tease the travelers at the inn anymore.

introduced.name: Witness Sigil
introduced.how: Calligraphy painting in Wangshu Inn over a thousand years old, used to persuade the ghost
introduced.quote: Verr Goldet: There is a calligraphy painting in the inn known as the Witness Sigil. It's been in circulation for over a thousand years. Go take a look at it.

introduced.name: Exuvia
introduced.how: Another name for the Geo Archon, Prime of the Adepti, who is also God of Contracts
introduced.quote: Childe: The Geo Archon is also the God of Contracts, and is also known as the Exuvia, Prime of the Adepti.

introduced.name: Liyue founding
introduced.how: Liyue was founded by the Geo Archon and the adepti, though built by force
introduced.quote: Childe: Liyue was founded by the Geo Archon and the adepti — of course, it was built by force.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Childe: Signora gave you quite the bad impression huh? Tsk, that woman... Can't say I'm a fan either.

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Paimon: You're Fatui! One of the Harbingers!

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah well, poorer nations don't seem the type to have diplomats that come around acting the way yours do towards the Knights of Favonius.

assumed.name: Wagner
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa, this chef guy's service is about as good as that Wagner guy's back in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Guizhong
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: In fact, even Guizhong and Rex Lapis themselves found one's technological accomplishments to be worthy of commendation.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis appears to have been assassinated at the Rite of Descension, an event the rest of the story keeps returning to.
threads.quote: Ningguang: Rex Lapis has been killed! Seal the exits!

threads.claim: Childe believes the Traveler is innocent and that someone else was behind Rex Lapis's death.
threads.quote: Childe: And because I had my eye on you the whole time, I know it wasn't you. Someone else was clearly behind it.

threads.claim: Childe suspects the Liyue Qixing may be hiding the true culprit or something else entirely.
threads.quote: Childe: Or... to hide something else. Hard to say.

threads.claim: The Liyue Qixing bar anyone from paying respects to Rex Lapis's body, an unexplained restriction.
threads.quote: Childe: They've announced that, as the true killer has not yet been found, they are not allowing anyone to pay their respects to the Exuvia.

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for a group called The Seven, which Childe finds significant and offers to help find.
threads.quote: Childe: Oh? You're trying to find The Seven? And just why might that be, pray tell?

threads.claim: Childe is acting out of his own hidden motives, offering help while planning to find someone who can break the stalemate.
threads.quote: Childe: Time... to find someone.

threads.claim: Liyue was founded by the Geo Archon and the adepti through force, hinting at a violent origin for the nation.
threads.quote: Childe: Liyue was founded by the Geo Archon and the adepti — of course, it was built by force.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's Sigil of Permission has mostly lost its power and now serves only as a keepsake.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Most of the sigil's power has long since worn off... It is but a keepsake now.

threads.claim: Xiao explains that the ghost is a harmless spirit who could not yet move on, which is why she was kept at the inn.
threads.quote: Xiao: When conquering demons, on occasion, you can come across spirits who have never hurt anyone, yet are also not yet able to be moved on.

threads.claim: Mountain Shaper explains that the amber trapping people is alive, produced by a planted flower that traps intruders.
threads.quote: Mountain Shaper: The majority of the plant is hidden underground. When stepped on, it produces amber to trap the invader.

introduced.name: Great Wolf King of the North
introduced.how: Boreas is revealed as the giant, stubborn Great Wolf King of the North, the wolf lord
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey, isn't that Razor over there with... Whoa, the Great Wolf King of the North!

introduced.name: Rifthounds
introduced.how: Dark wolves carrying the scent of the Abyss, roaming Wolvendom and threatening the forest
introduced.quote: (Razor recalls Rifthounds roaming through Wolvendom, carrying the scent of the Abyss)

introduced.name: Wolvendom
introduced.how: The wolves' forest land, which Rifthounds roam and which must be purified
introduced.quote: (Razor recalls Rifthounds roaming through Wolvendom, carrying the scent of the Abyss)

introduced.name: Dark wolf pack
introduced.how: The enemy wolf pack that has taken land, is growing stronger, and is Razor's target
introduced.quote: Razor: We hunt... enemies. The dark wolf pack. Strange scent coming from land they took. Getting stronger...

introduced.name: Lupical
introduced.how: A bond of care among the wolves and their friends; anyone who cares for the pack counts as Lupical
introduced.quote: Paimon: We're here because we care about you, just like you do us! That's what makes us Lupical, right?

introduced.name: Hunting Trap
introduced.how: Traps used to lure the dark wolves in and pin them down during the hunt
introduced.quote: Razor: We set trap. Chase dark wolves here. Into trap.

introduced.name: Boreas's earlier warning
introduced.how: Boreas once told Razor not to get involved, since the wolves must settle matters themselves
introduced.quote: Paimon: "Razor, you must not get involved. This is for the wolves to settle between themselves."

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Razor: *sniff* Familiar scent. Ah, you two.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lisa taught you how to talk to him...?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: (Razor recalls Rifthounds roaming through Wolvendom, carrying the scent of the Abyss)

threads.claim: The dark wolf pack may rip open the sky and could return to attack again.
threads.quote: Razor: No... Dark wolf pack, rip open sky. They... could come again.

threads.claim: The forest is being corrupted by the Abyss and must be purified by hunting the enemies.
threads.quote: Razor: We must hunt enemies to purify the forest.

threads.claim: Razor's hunt is a task he earned by learning how to persuade Boreas, taught by Lisa.
threads.quote: Razor: It's okay. I know Lupical means no harm. Besides, teacher taught me how to talk to wolf lord.

threads.claim: Boreas may have agreed to let the pack help because he understands Razor's heart.
threads.quote: Traveler: Maybe Lupus Boreas agreed to let the pack help...

threads.claim: Lupical is a bond of care rather than a matter of being a wolf.
threads.quote: Razor: I am human, but I do not need to be wolf to be "Lupical." I... just want to help them.

threads.claim: A distant howl calls for Razor, hinting at an unseen wolf presence.
threads.quote: Distant Howl: Awoo!

threads.claim: Razor realizes he does not have to protect Lupical alone, since the Travelers and wolves stand together.
threads.quote: Razor: Thank you... for helping. I thought protecting Lupical was up to me.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publisher that commissions the Traveler for a job
introduced.quote: Yae Publishing House has a commission for you, . An editor is here to discuss the details in person.

introduced.name: Mr. Nine
introduced.how: a famous author of the Shattered Halberd and Flowers for Princess Fischl novels whose identity is unknown
introduced.quote: Onodera: Now, have you heard of the author, Mr. Nine? He's famous for writing the "Legend of the Shattered Halberd."

introduced.name: Onodera
introduced.how: Zhenyu's editor who holds the commission from Lady Yae
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait, you're Xing— Uh, Zhenyu's editor, Onodera!

introduced.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd
introduced.how: a famous novel by Mr. Nine
introduced.quote: Onodera: Now, have you heard of the author, Mr. Nine? He's famous for writing the "Legend of the Shattered Halberd."

introduced.name: Flowers for Princess Fischl
introduced.how: another novel by Mr. Nine, the work he is best known for
introduced.quote: Fischl: Flowers for Princess Fischl. That's what Mr. Nine is actually famous for!

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a remote region where Mr. Nine sent a letter for help and is in trouble
introduced.quote: He sent a letter from Nod-Krai asking for help, and he seems to be in bad shape.

introduced.name: Chang the Ninth
introduced.how: a Qingce Village author who won a best new author award
introduced.quote: Onodera: Chang the Ninth? Ah, I've heard of him.

introduced.name: First Apprentice of Guhua
introduced.how: a novel by Chang the Ninth that won a best new author award
introduced.quote: He won a best new author award for the "First Apprentice of Guhua."

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a Seelie-like figure who orchestrated Mr. Nine by sending a Seelie friend to find authors
introduced.quote: Nicole: So, I tracked down an old Seelie friend of mine, and told her all the stories I was imagining.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: a being that possesses sleeping people to write stories through them
introduced.quote: Nicole: Oh, it's fine. She did it while they were sleeping.

introduced.name: Angel
introduced.how: a being that works like a flash of inspiration in a person's head
introduced.quote: Nicole: And anyway, an angel has always functioned like a sort of... flash of inspiration in someone's head.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: money Mr. Nine has been splitting as royalties and burying in Chang's yard
introduced.quote: I've been splitting the royalties with him 90-10 — his share's been buried in his yard all these years.

introduced.name: Oz's creation from a half-truth
introduced.how: Fischl used a half-true metaphor from Mr. Nine's novels to create Oz
introduced.quote: Oz: Mein Fräulein is speechless. So, if I may ask in her stead... did she manage to use one of these "half-truths" in Mr. Nine's novels to create me?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey there, Katheryne! Oh, and Oz and Fischl are here too! What a coincidence!

assumed.name: Zhenyu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, you're Xing— Uh, Zhenyu's editor, Onodera!

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, and when we were here with Xingqiu that one time

assumed.name: Lady Yae
assumed.quote: I come here today with a commission from Lady Yae

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: In that case, it'd be a free trip to Mondstadt where one needs only pass some information along...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh. Could Mr. Nine be from Liyue, then?

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: He's only ever communicated with us via letter, from addresses all over Teyvat.

threads.claim: Mr. Nine turns out to be Nicole with a Seelie ghostwriting his stories, and Nicole reveals he is right there.
threads.quote: Nicole: Ah, I see. Well, "Mr." Nine... is right here.

threads.claim: An unseen voice asks what the Traveler is doing, hinting at a hidden speaker.
threads.quote: ???: Hmm? What are you doing here?

threads.claim: Nicole explains she sent a Seelie to possess authors so they would write her stories.
threads.quote: Nicole: So, I tracked down an old Seelie friend of mine, and told her all the stories I was imagining.

threads.claim: Oz senses threads of fate on Fischl, the manuscript and Chang, tied to Mr. Nine.
threads.quote: Oz: It's a peculiar signature — the same threads of "fate" I sensed on you, Mein Fräulein, and on the manuscript.

threads.claim: Oz detects the same fate signature again near the Seelie in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Oz: Hmm, and it bears the same signature I sensed before.

threads.claim: Oz has vaguely sensed something unusual about his own origin since the beginning.
threads.quote: Oz: Well... I suppose I've vaguely sensed this since the beginning.

threads.claim: Oz was created by Fischl using a half-true creation metaphor from Mr. Nine's novels.
threads.quote: Nicole: We just never imagined someone would actually manage to use it... until you came along, young lady.

threads.claim: The Immernachtreich is a hidden realm where Mr. Nine has buried a personal treasure.
threads.quote: Mr. Nine: Feel free to come search for my personal stash someday. I've buried it at the furthest end of the Immernachtreich.

threads.claim: Nod-Krai is dangerous, and Mr. Nine was sent there to monitor the situation.
threads.quote: Mr. Nine: Nicole sent me to monitor the situation in Nod-Krai, and it's super dangerous, okay?

threads.claim: Mr. Nine has been secretly splitting royalties with Chang the Ninth, burying his share in Chang's yard.
threads.quote: I've been splitting the royalties with him 90-10 — his share's been buried in his yard all these years.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a Hexenzirkel mage who eavesdrops on the conversation and keeps a dictionary of prophecies
introduced.quote: Venti: Hahaha, Barbeloth has always been a reasonable person, and I believe she heard my request.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of mages known for having many tricks
introduced.quote: Venti: Well, she is a Hexenzirkel mage. They all have quite a few tricks up their sleeves.

introduced.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
introduced.how: a dictionary of prophecies kept by Barbeloth that may record things about the Traveler
introduced.quote: Venti: There's not a single prophecy about you in that dictionary.

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: Venti reveals he is Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, whose duty is to intervene in times of need
introduced.quote: Venti: It's the Anemo Archon's duty to intervene in times of need. As such, I, Barbatos, will bring forth a wind strong enough to disperse whatever storm lies ahead.

introduced.name: Nameless Island
introduced.how: an island where Time and Wind met long ago, favored by Time and hiding its nature from the outside world
introduced.quote: Venti: This is the place where Time and Wind met in the distant past.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: named as the Ruler of Death who faced the Pyro Archon
introduced.quote: Venti: I've heard about the Pyro Archon's face-off with the Ruler of Death, Ronova, and what happened to the Fatui Harbinger, The Captain.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Venti: Hahaha, I have a feeling the wind is gonna be pretty strong today. We should head back to Mondstadt and tell people to hold onto their hats.

assumed.name: Thousand Winds Temple
assumed.quote: (While passing over the Thousand Winds Temple)

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Venti: I've heard about the Pyro Archon's face-off with the Ruler of Death, Ronova, and what happened to the Fatui Harbinger, The Captain.

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Venti: I've heard about the Pyro Archon's face-off with the Ruler of Death, Ronova, and what happened to the Fatui Harbinger, The Captain.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Venti: And that's not even mentioning how Abyssal activity has been encroaching closer and closer to Mondstadt.

assumed.name: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!
assumed.quote: (If A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night! has not been completed)

assumed.name: Time
assumed.quote: Venti: Well, it was because of Time's help that those first winds of freedom were able to blow so strongly.

threads.claim: Barbeloth's dictionary holds prophecies, and the Traveler has none recorded, so the Traveler's future is unclear.
threads.quote: Venti: There's not a single prophecy about you in that dictionary.

threads.claim: Venti is revealed to be Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, who plans to summon a great wind.
threads.quote: Venti: It's the Anemo Archon's duty to intervene in times of need. As such, I, Barbatos, will bring forth a wind strong enough to disperse whatever storm lies ahead.

threads.claim: Time and Wind once met on Nameless Island, and the meaning of that meeting is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Venti: This is the place where Time and Wind met in the distant past.

threads.claim: Venti summoned the first winds of freedom for Mondstadt with Time's help, and those winds were later made gentler.
threads.quote: Venti: Well, it was because of Time's help that those first winds of freedom were able to blow so strongly.

threads.claim: Time's influence on Nameless Island is hidden from ordinary people and shielded by a boundary.
threads.quote: Venti: Time's impact on things isn't limited to what the eye can see. Think of it like... a ripe Sunsettia.

threads.claim: Abyssal activity is creeping closer to Mondstadt, and a larger crisis may be coming that humans alone cannot solve.
threads.quote: Venti: And that's not even mentioning how Abyssal activity has been encroaching closer and closer to Mondstadt.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon fought Ronova, and the Fatui Harbinger known as The Captain met an unexplained fate.
threads.quote: Venti: I've heard about the Pyro Archon's face-off with the Ruler of Death, Ronova, and what happened to the Fatui Harbinger, The Captain.

introduced.name: Durin
introduced.how: A being born from a storybook who is learning the rules of this world.
introduced.quote: I was born from a storybook, so I felt that these books might be able to teach me more about the

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Durin's mom's friend and the mother of the earlier dragon who existed in Durin's place.
introduced.quote: Rhinedottir is my mom's friend... And the mother of the dragon that once existed in my stead.

introduced.name: Sebas
introduced.how: A talkative butler who can imitate voices and is Albedo's elder.
introduced.quote: I am Sebas, a simple butler.

introduced.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
introduced.how: A book that teleports whoever opens it to another place.
introduced.quote: The pages of The Little Witch's Dictionary flips open, then it teleports the group somewhere

introduced.name: Imaginarium Theater
introduced.how: A place the dictionary can transport the group to, where Sebas appears.
introduced.quote: (After being teleported, the group finds themselves in the Imaginarium Theater)

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: The earlier dragon-child whose power overwhelmed him and sealed his fate.
introduced.quote: Yet this power was beyond what he could withstand, and so it twisted him, consumed him, thus sealing his ultimate fate.

introduced.name: tainted blood
introduced.how: Durin's blood carries a dark power inherited from the dragon line.
introduced.quote: Albedo claims that you have transcended this tainted blood, becoming a being much like himself.

introduced.name: sealing technique
introduced.how: A technique Rhinedottir prepared to seal Durin's dark power, at the cost of weakening his bond to the world.
introduced.quote: After hearing about you, I prepared a technique that would seal the dark power in your blood.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon find Durin in Albedo's Office)

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: So we're here at the Hexenzirkel's behest...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: So, after I learned the Mondstadt script, he told me I could come here and read.

assumed.name: M
assumed.quote: But seeing you now, it appears my concerns were misplaced. M was a terrific mother, and a far more capable one than I.

assumed.name: Old Friends and New Knowledge
assumed.quote: (If Old Friends and New Knowledge has been completed)

assumed.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
assumed.quote: Did this stupid dictionary transport us to some weird place again?

threads.claim: Durin was born from a storybook, which raises questions about what his nature is.
threads.quote: I was born from a storybook, so I felt that these books might be able to teach me more about the

threads.claim: Durin took the fate that should have belonged to an earlier dragon-child.
threads.quote: I supplanted him — took the fate that should have been his.

threads.claim: Durin's blood holds a dark power that could corrupt him as it did his predecessor.
threads.quote: Albedo claims that you have transcended this tainted blood, becoming a being much like himself.

threads.claim: Durin's power surges during the fight, and he gains more control over it once the enemies are defeated.
threads.quote: The power within me is surging to the surface...

threads.claim: Sealing the dark power would keep Durin existing in Teyvat but weaken his connection to this world.
threads.quote: While it would maintain your existence in Teyvat, it would also weaken your connection to this world.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir views Durin as a new experiment that may reveal unexpected answers.
threads.quote: I've never conducted an experiment like this before. As such, you may yet hold the key to some unexpected answers.

threads.claim: Sebas is revealed to be an alchemical being rather than an ordinary cat.
threads.quote: In fact, from a biological standpoint, I am no cat at all, but rather, an alchemical being.

threads.claim: Durin senses his mother's scent in the Imaginarium Theater, hinting she is connected to this place.
threads.quote: My mom's scent... I sense it here.

threads.claim: Durin struggles to understand the meaning behind words and jokes, a theme of learning human rules.
threads.quote: Well, ever since I've had more chances to interact with the people of Mondstadt, I've been having trouble telling when people are joking.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: Mona's old master and teacher, who sends the letters and sets the task
introduced.quote: I just know it's going to be torture, though. I know that old hag all too well.

introduced.name: Gate of Everlasting Mourning
introduced.how: a gate that leads to the ancient kingdom of Khaenri'ah and is reached by teleport
introduced.quote: So, this is the gate to the ancient kingdom of Khaenri'ah...

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: an ancient underground kingdom with large subterranean lakes that reflect the true stars
introduced.quote: The records of this ancient kingdom state there are several large subterranean lakes in Khaenri'ah, clear and calm as mirrors, whose surfaces reflect the true stars.

introduced.name: Sign of Apaosha
introduced.how: a celestial mark that burns in response to a strong desire for truth, also called the Sign of Truth
introduced.quote: there is a phenomenon in this land known as the 'Sign of Apaosha.'

introduced.name: False sky
introduced.how: a barrier that hides the real stars and the outer universe, which the Sign of Truth can bypass
introduced.quote: This is because the 'Sign of Truth' created in the water is able to bypass the false sky and connect to the outer universe.

introduced.name: Abyssal creatures
introduced.how: monsters that roam beyond the false sky
introduced.quote: And of course, as my student, I felt sure you would have the chops to deal with the Abyssal creatures that roam beyond the false sky.

introduced.name: Scryglass
introduced.how: a device whose practical use reduces disturbances caused by the false sky
introduced.quote: The practical application of the Scryglass has also reduced disturbances caused by the false sky.

introduced.name: Mona Megistus
introduced.how: introduces herself as the Astrologist who invokes Hydro in her ritual
introduced.quote: Traverse the twisted paths of the cavernous void. I, Mona Megistus, the Astrologist, invoke the power of Hydro to balance the scales.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Hah, I'd like to see Alice try and top that!

assumed.name: Hydro phantom
assumed.quote: Remember when I would chase you, and you would run for dear life, trying to use that Hydro phantom of yours to distract me?

assumed.name: Tenebrous Mimiflora
assumed.quote: (Three Tenebrous Mimiflora appear around them)

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Head to Sumeru and search for the gate to an underground kingdom.

threads.claim: The false sky hides the real stars, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: To observe the gravitational forces and influence of celestial bodies, one must be able to see past the false sky.

threads.claim: The Scryglass reduces false sky disturbances, hinting that the false sky can be countered.
threads.quote: The practical application of the Scryglass has also reduced disturbances caused by the false sky.

threads.claim: The Sign of Apaosha, a celestial mark that answers a desire for truth, is raised as a mystery.
threads.quote: It is a celestial mark that burns in response to an all-too-ardent desire for the truth.

threads.claim: Lakes of stars make space in Khaenri'ah unstable, so breaking the firmament by non-physical means is more likely to work.
threads.quote: Khaenri'ah was home to several lakes of stars, rendering the fabric of space in that area comparatively unstable.

threads.claim: Abyssal creatures roam beyond the false sky, implying a hidden world past it.
threads.quote: And of course, as my student, I felt sure you would have the chops to deal with the Abyssal creatures that roam beyond the false sky.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah is hinted to hold secrets and tragedies behind its gate.
threads.quote: I'm sure a lot of secrets and tragedies lie behind it.

threads.claim: Cosmic parameters are said to let one predict the fate of the world, raising what that foresight is for.
threads.quote: Only by obtaining these cosmic parameters can one predict the fate of this world.

threads.claim: Mona's grasp of hydromancy is growing, and she plans to test it further.
threads.quote: I have a better grasp of hydromancy now... and the perfect test subjects to test it on.

introduced.name: Lohen
introduced.how: a captain who wants to get stronger by challenging the world's most powerful foes and is compiling a fieldbook of them
introduced.quote: Lohen: Ugh, that's enough! I didn't invite you both here to listen to you bicker.

introduced.name: Slazhnev
introduced.how: a member of the expedition from Nod-Krai who boasts about their captain's strength
introduced.quote: Paimon: ...Lohen? And isn't that...Leifhelm and Slazhnev?

introduced.name: Leifhelm
introduced.how: a combatologist from Nod-Krai who argues over power rankings with Slazhnev
introduced.quote: Leifhelm: C—Captain Lohen! I'm not trying to be uncooperative, it's just that the word "formidable" is far too vague.

introduced.name: Formidable Foes Fieldbook
introduced.how: a fieldbook Lohen is compiling to record the strongest opponents, with help from the combatologists
introduced.quote: Lohen: Hah... I heard there were a couple of "combatologists" in Nod-Krai, so I invited them over to help me compile a "Formidable Foes Fieldbook".

introduced.name: Aino
introduced.how: a lively girl who travels with Ineffa and asks her to record and collect things
introduced.quote: Aino: Ineffa! Ineffa! Did you see that windmill!? I need you to make a record of how it works!

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: a machine companion who assesses situations and records data for Aino, and is revealed to be a machine with a notable history
introduced.quote: Lohen: Such fluid movements... I'd never have guessed you were a machine.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: a giant robot in Mondstadt that can be defeated and stripped for mechanical parts
introduced.quote: Lohen: If I help you deal with the Ruin Guards, that should clear up your schedule, right?

introduced.name: Durin
introduced.how: a figure who recites a prophecy-styled script about power and dragons, later revealed to be reading from a paper
introduced.quote: Durin: ...Seeker of Power, Follower of Fate, you are here at last.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a current angel who wrote the scripted prophecy performance and is revealed to be behind it
introduced.quote: A pleasure to meet you, Lady Nicole. I've read your script, and I have to say, I was very impressed.

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: the place where the final trial and prophecy are to take place, formerly the domain of a storm god
introduced.quote: Durin: W—Wait! Y—Young human, the trial you seek is far from here. You must venture to Stormterror's Lair and face the final prophecy!

introduced.name: Decarabian
introduced.how: the God of Storms who once ruled Stormterror's Lair and could conjure storms to shut out the world
introduced.quote: Before this place was known as Stormterror's Lair, it was the God of Storms, Decarabian's domain.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: routes that let someone travel very quickly across long distances, such as from Nod-Krai to Mondstadt
introduced.quote: He used the Ley Lines to travel all the way from Nod-Krai to Mondstadt in less time than it takes you to tie your shoelaces

introduced.name: Angels
introduced.how: beings who guide humanity toward the future, and a former angel's fall caused a calamity that a current angel had to fix
introduced.quote: Since that was a calamity caused by a former angel, it naturally fell on a current angel to set things right...

introduced.name: Ursa the Drake
introduced.how: a monster that was once an angel and fell into ruin
introduced.quote: Lohen: And Ursa too, the monster who had once been an angel.

introduced.name: Mirror of the Dawning Morn
introduced.how: a group that was once lost to confusion and doubt before finding strength beyond mere power
introduced.quote: The Mirror of the Dawning Morn, Durin... For a time, they too were lost to confusion and doubt.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Leifhelm: Dragons, huh... Here in Mondstadt, you'd have to be talking about Dvalin or Ursa the Drake, or else those legends about Dragonspine... Hmm, what else is there?

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: Leifhelm: Dragons, huh... Here in Mondstadt, you'd have to be talking about Dvalin or Ursa the Drake, or else those legends about Dragonspine... Hmm, what else is there?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: He can hold back the Abyss with pure physical power alone!

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Leifhelm: Never mind regular monsters — even the power gap between the Archons is huge.

assumed.name: Dragon
assumed.quote: Lohen: ...Dragons?

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: (Paimon pictures the silhouettes of Neuvillette and Cacucu)

assumed.name: Cacucu
assumed.quote: (Paimon pictures the silhouettes of Neuvillette and Cacucu)

assumed.name: Barbeloth
assumed.quote: Traveler: (That sounds like something Barbeloth would say...)

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh yeah! In Wolvendom, when you were delivering letters for Varka!

assumed.name: Wolvendom
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh yeah! In Wolvendom, when you were delivering letters for Varka!

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Durin: Uhm, I think Albedo said he needed help with an experiment, so I'd better be heading back now.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Nicole: Do you remember dealing with Dottore and the poison left behind by Ursa in Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Disaster and Remorse
assumed.quote: (Lohen begins to approach while holding Disaster and Remorse)

assumed.name: Dornman Port
assumed.quote: (Approach the marked location in Dornman Port)

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Leifhelm: Dragons, huh... Here in Mondstadt, you'd have to be talking about Dvalin or Ursa the Drake

threads.claim: Barbeloth's prophecy says a lost human must face the dragon three times before understanding the true meaning of strength.
threads.quote: Lost human, thrice shall you face the might of the dragon. Then, and only then, will you comprehend the true meaning of strength.

threads.claim: Stormterror's Lair was once the domain of the storm god Decarabian, and the final prophecy is set there.
threads.quote: Before this place was known as Stormterror's Lair, it was the God of Storms, Decarabian's domain.

threads.claim: Ursa was once an angel who fell into a monster, and the poison and calamity she left behind were dealt with by a current angel.
threads.quote: Since that was a calamity caused by a former angel, it naturally fell on a current angel to set things right...

threads.claim: Decarabian's storm power could not stop a yearning for freedom from growing within his own walls.
threads.quote: But the mighty god who could conjure storms to shut out the world couldn't stem the yearning for freedom within his own walls of wind.

threads.claim: The story suggests that true strength comes from more than power alone, which the Mirror of the Dawning Morn found.
threads.quote: What led them to strength was more than just power.

threads.claim: Humanity's future is becoming less predictable now that angelic guidance is no longer the only force leading it.
threads.quote: The guidance of angels is no longer the only thing leading them toward the future.

threads.claim: Ineffa has an extraordinary history that Lohen did not know about, and it is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Back when the expedition was in Nod-Krai, I had no reason to suspect you had such an extraordinary history.

introduced.name: Prune
introduced.how: a Witch Hunter with a hammer who is hostile to Alice and whose voice is heard via phonographs
introduced.quote: Paimon: Prune isn't exactly Alice's biggest fan...

introduced.name: Witch's Homework
introduced.how: a challenge Alice sends that, once activated, leads to a magical space and a debate test
introduced.quote: congratulations on successfully activating your Witch's Homework Challenge!

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: a grand theatre of the dramatic arts that Alice's magical space imitates
introduced.quote: Welcome to the pinnacle of the dramatic arts in all of Teyvat — the Opera Epiclese... or rather, a magical facsimile of it!

introduced.name: Phonograph
introduced.how: a device that repeats 'I'm an idiot' and is used by Alice to play loading music across the city
introduced.quote: Phonograph: I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot!

introduced.name: Klee
introduced.how: Alice's daughter who loves fish blasting and has been placed in solitary confinement before
introduced.quote: Alice: Do you dispute that Klee loves fish blasting? How could any good kid enjoy such a terrible pastime?

assumed.name: Dodoco
assumed.quote: Alice appears on a nearby rooftop in her Dodoco form

assumed.name: Dodo-King
assumed.quote: prepare to bow down before the Dodo-King!

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: She's quite the superstar in Fontaine, y'know!

assumed.name: Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur)

assumed.name: Witch Hunter
assumed.quote: Prune: And second things second, I'm a Witch Hunter, and I won't forget my duty!

threads.claim: Alice keeps staging challenges as pranks and runs away before they can be resolved.
threads.quote: Don't you dare run away again! Not after I finally tracked you down.

threads.claim: Alice's elaborate tests may hide a sincere purpose, such as gauging Prune's feelings about Klee.
threads.quote: Prune: Hold it right there... You're not about to say something corny like

threads.claim: The debate raises whether Klee's behavior comes from her heredity or from the people raising her.
threads.quote: Prune: Nurture has shown a far greater influence than nature.

threads.claim: Alice seems to have pushed Klee into trouble, such as fish blasting, which implicates Alice in Klee's misbehavior.
threads.quote: Her own mother, no less!

threads.claim: Alice's Dodoco form is a doll she hides behind, and her true whereabouts remain unknown.
threads.quote: come out here and stop trying to fool me with that stupid doll.

threads.claim: Prune sees herself as a Witch Hunter bound by a duty she will not forget.
threads.quote: Prune: And second things second, I'm a Witch Hunter, and I won't forget my duty!

introduced.name: Sucrose
introduced.how: alchemist who runs the growth serum experiment and has other research topics
introduced.quote: Sucrose: Yes. It aligns with other research topics I've been working on, so it hasn't been too much extra work.

introduced.name: Botanical Augmentation Reagent Type IV, Iteration VII
introduced.how: growth serum formula Sucrose has tested seven times without success
introduced.quote: Sucrose: That is to say, the formulation of "Botanical Augmentation Reagent Type IV, Iteration VII" — as you can probably guess, this is my seventh time running the experiment.

introduced.name: Sweet Flower
introduced.how: flower the serum is meant to grow to 16 times normal size
introduced.quote: Sucrose: One meant to develop a potion that can transform Sweet Flowers into a variant 16 times its normal size.

introduced.name: Whopperflower
introduced.how: plant that absorbs the potion and grows huge, looking like a Sweet Flower but not one
introduced.quote: Sucrose: Careful! I—It's a Whopperflower! It must have absorbed some of the potion.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: source of high-quality spring water used as the potion base
introduced.quote: Sucrose: The high quality of Springvale's waters makes for a stable potion-making ingredient.

introduced.name: Whopperflower Nectar
introduced.how: nectar that tastes exactly like Sweet Flower nectar
introduced.quote: Sucrose: So, in that sense, accidentally making a Whopperflower 16 times bigger comes with a hidden benefit, because Whopperflower Nectar...

introduced.name: Limits of this world
introduced.how: a fixed specification in the law governing all things caps how large plants can grow
introduced.quote: Sucrose: It's like... a "specification" etched into the law that governs all things. Part of the purpose of doing multiple experiments is to determine if this "specification" is stable.

introduced.name: Cauldron potion concocting
introduced.how: ingredients are stacked on squares in the cauldron and the tuning rate determines the finished potion
