introduced.quote: Each time you concoct a potion, there will be squares on which ingredients may be stacked within the cauldron.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Sucrose: My "task"... Oh, you mean the one Mr. Albedo told me about? The one from the Hexenzirkel?

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: Sucrose: My "task"... Oh, you mean the one Mr. Albedo told me about? The one from the Hexenzirkel?

assumed.name: Eye of the Storm
assumed.quote: Sucrose: I need spring water from Springvale to use as the base, as well as Eye of the Storm fragments... But, that last one could be tricky.

assumed.name: Sunsettia
assumed.quote: Sucrose: Oh, that's simple. Both Sunsettias and Sweet Flower nectar taste sweet.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hehe, just think about it... Paimon could probably beat a whole gang of Treasure Hoarders to a pulp if she were 16 times bigger!

threads.claim: The experiment task was passed to Sucrose by Albedo and comes from the Hexenzirkel.
threads.quote: Sucrose: My "task"... Oh, you mean the one Mr. Albedo told me about? The one from the Hexenzirkel?

threads.claim: This world has limits, and flowers cannot grow past a certain size no matter how the formula is adjusted.
threads.quote: Alchemy seeks mastery over matter, but this world has its limits.

threads.claim: The 16-times-size Whopperflower may mean the world's limits and laws are changing due to an unknown factor.
threads.quote: Perhaps the limits and laws of this world are changing due to some unknown factor...

threads.claim: The failed Sweet Flowers showed the growth limit continues to exist, which is why failure was a valid result.
threads.quote: Exactly. It proves that the limit "continues to exist."

threads.claim: The Whopperflower grew far larger than any earlier case, and the cause is unexplained.
threads.quote: Wait. But that's happened before, and it's never gotten this big, either. Can this mean...?

threads.claim: The oversized Whopperflower may be due to the potion maker or to something special about this particular plant.
threads.quote: That said, it could also be an effect of the person who made the potion.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Teppei leads the Traveler to Watatsumi Island, where Kokomi's resistance is based
introduced.quote: Teppei takes the Traveler to Watatsumi Island for their meeting with Sangonomiya Kokomi.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: Resistance leader on Watatsumi Island who accepted anonymous supplies in exchange for fighting the Shogunate
introduced.quote: She tells them how she recently accepted an anonymous letter's offer to provide the Resistance with material so long as they continue to fight the Inazuma Shogunate.

introduced.name: Swordfish II
introduced.how: A special operations unit of Watatsumi Island elite soldiers that the Traveler is made captain of
introduced.quote: I hereby appoint you as captain of the Watatsumi Island special operations unit: Swordfish II.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: A decree that is causing civil war and is opposed by the Resistance, with unexplained origins
introduced.quote: The mere existence of the Vision Hunt Decree is baffling.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: A phenomenon that emerged after Orobaxi's death, causing poor health and a strange atmosphere
introduced.quote: explains that the strange atmosphere they are feeling is caused by the Tatarigami, a phenomenon which emerged after the death of Orobashi

introduced.name: Orobaxi
introduced.how: A god and guardian deity of Watatsumi Island's ancestors, slain during the Archon War
introduced.quote: Orobaxi was the one who brought our ancestors from Enkanomiya up to the surface.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: A past war in which Orobaxi invaded Yashiori Island and was slain
introduced.quote: but during the Archon War, Orobaxi invaded Yashiori Island.

introduced.name: Delusion
introduced.how: A secret weapon that drains the user's life force and is produced by the Fatui
introduced.quote: A Delusion drains the user's life force.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: The secret sponsor of the Resistance, revealed to be the Fatui who supply Delusions
introduced.quote: revealing the Resistance's mysterious 'sponsor' is none other than the Fatui.

introduced.name: The Balladeer
introduced.how: One of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers who mocks the Traveler and sets the trap at the factory
introduced.quote: face-to-face with The Balladeer, one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Rescues the Traveler from The Balladeer and offers guidance and training
introduced.quote: As the Traveler succumbs to the Tatarigami and falls unconscious, Yae Miko arrives at the scene.

introduced.name: Ei and Plane of Euthymia
introduced.how: Ei is the true Raiden Shogun who lives in her inner world, the Plane of Euthymia; the Shogun ruling Inazuma is her puppet
introduced.quote: the true Raiden Shogun who dwells within her inner world known as the Plane of Euthymia.

introduced.name: Kujou Takayuki
introduced.how: Head of the Kujou Clan and Sara's adoptive father, who has secretly betrayed the Shogunate
introduced.quote: Kujou Takayuki, Sara's adoptive father and head of the Kujou Clan, has betrayed the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Signora
introduced.how: A Fatui Harbinger who defeats Sara and duels the Traveler at Tenshukaku
introduced.quote: the Fatui Harbinger Signora is meeting with the Shogun at Tenshukaku

introduced.name: Musou no Hitotachi
introduced.how: The Shogun's most powerful technique, used to slay Orobaxi and execute Signora
introduced.quote: The Raiden Shogun came out in person and slew Orobaxi with the Musou no Hitotachi.

introduced.name: Musoujin Gorge
introduced.how: A gorge created by the Shogun's single slash against Orobaxi
introduced.quote: That same slash also formed what later became known as Musoujin Gorge.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
introduced.how: Resonates with his late friend's Masterless Vision to block the Shogun's attack
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha miraculously resonates with his late friend's Masterless Vision

introduced.name: Electro Gnosis
introduced.how: A Gnosis that Miko gave The Balladeer to secure the Traveler's release, entrusted to her by Ei
introduced.quote: she rescued them from The Balladeer by giving him the Electro Gnosis.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: A decree that requires Delusions to be produced within Inazuma's borders
introduced.quote: The Sakoku Decree is still in force, so their Delusions must be produced within Inazuma's borders.

introduced.name: Nathan
introduced.how: Presented as a Resistance member but revealed to be a Fatui mole sent to sabotage them
introduced.quote: supposed Resistance member Nathan is actually a Fatui mole sent to sabotage them.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: The next destination, where knowledge is managed as a resource
introduced.quote: knowledge is managed as a resource in Sumeru

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah cataclysm
introduced.how: Ei witnessed the Heavenly Principles destroy Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: witnessing the Heavenly Principles' destruction of Khaenri'ah

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine who rescues the Traveler and plans the Shogun intervention; described as the Electro Archon's familiar
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Hmm, you mean me?

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Shogun's Army commander and Kujou Clan member, loyal to the Shogun, who is persuaded to turn against the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara: Don't move a muscle! You've got some nerve showing up here in the shrine when there's an active warrant for your arrest!

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: Shuumatsuban ninja of the Yashiro Commission, a sleepy mujina who infiltrates the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Sayu: Not a tanuki... I'm a mujina... *snore*...

introduced.name: Kujou Takayuki
introduced.how: Head of the Kujou Clan who admits dealings with the Fatui and secretly betrays the Shogunate
introduced.quote: Kujou Takayuki: Hmph... Yes, I have dealings with the Fatui. And yes, the report you saw was penned by my hand.

introduced.name: Thoma
introduced.how: Confined at Komore Teahouse; helps plan the distraction with fireworks
introduced.quote: Thoma: Did you meet with the resistance? How's the battle going? Is it safe for me to come out yet?

introduced.name: Yoimiya
introduced.how: Fireworks maker who gives the Traveler a powerful firework for the distraction
introduced.quote: Yoimiya: "Extra-large firework"?

introduced.name: Motosuke
introduced.how: Subordinate of Kujou Sara who points spears at the Traveler
introduced.quote: Motosuke: Affirmative!

introduced.name: Sue Yoshitaka
introduced.how: Subordinate of Kujou Sara who leaves with Motosuke
introduced.quote: Sue Yoshitaka: As you wish.

introduced.name: Signora
introduced.how: Snezhnayan diplomat and Harbinger who is revealed as the Fatui figure behind the Vision Hunt Decree; she is executed by the Raiden Shogun
introduced.quote: Kujou Takayuki: The Shogun is at receiving a Snezhnayan diplomat — the Harbinger by the name of "Signora."

introduced.name: Ei
introduced.how: The true Raiden Shogun, who meditates in the Plane of Euthymia; the puppet is a separate body
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Her name is "Ei."

introduced.name: Plane of Euthymia
introduced.how: Ei's inner world, a space only she is allowed to exist in, reachable by defeating her there
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: The Plane of Euthymia. Essentially, the world inside her mind. A place that typically only allows her existence.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Domestic military commission that the Traveler learns has secretly colluded with the Fatui
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Now, we also know that every aspect of the Vision Hunt Decree's promulgation and execution has been enthusiastically spearheaded by the Tenryou Commission from the outset.

introduced.name: Shuumatsuban
introduced.how: Secret ninja unit under the Yashiro Commission under Kamisato Ayato
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: It belongs to the Yashiro Commission. A secret unit under Kamisato Ayato.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: Commission described as betraying the Shogunate and colluding with the Fatui
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Kanjou Commission betrayed the Shogunate long ago.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: Shogunate decree of Vision confiscation, revealed as a Fatui-engineered trap to manipulate the Shogun
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: The Vision Hunt Decree was obviously devised as a means of manipulating the Shogun, the ones behind it knowing full well her susceptibility as a puppet with a single-minded focus on eternity.

introduced.name: Delusions
introduced.how: Items the Fatui distribute from the shadows, causing harm and a ban is issued on their use across the army
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: The Delusions... they're still on your mind, aren't they?

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori (Blind Loyalty, Reckless Courage)
introduced.how: Protective charm from Yae Miko that sparkles and helps the Traveler resist defeat in the Plane of Euthymia
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: The omamori from the Grand Narukami Shrine are very potent indeed. I thought I'd put one aside for you.

introduced.name: Official Tenryou Commission Document
introduced.how: Report kept from the Shogun that omits the resistance and front-line losses, proof of the Commission's betrayal
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara: I don't understand... Not a single word about the resistance, Sangonomiya, or the situation on the front line...

introduced.name: Musou no Hitotachi
introduced.how: The Raiden Shogun's devastating combat technique that can kill on contact
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: If you get hit by the Musou no Hitotachi, that's it. It's game over. I would get training if I were you.

introduced.name: Anti-Raiden Shogun Training
introduced.how: Training program Yae Miko creates from her memory of the Shogun's combat moves
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Think of it as a catalyst that can reproduce the Raiden Shogun's combat moves. I made it from my own memory, which means it should be perfectly accurate

introduced.name: Duel Before the Throne
introduced.how: Trial by combat in Tenshukaku where the loser must die; the Traveler challenges Signora
introduced.quote: Signora: You are aware... that the loser must die? Are you sure this is what you want?

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Ideal of progress that Ei says destroyed a nation that strode forward, reasoning for her eternity
introduced.quote: Ei: And lose everything to the Heavenly Principles

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: Tales retold in the shade of Thunder Sakura tied to Ei's past loss and the lost "her"
introduced.quote: Ei: In the shade of every Thunder Sakura

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: small chess-piece-like object that keeps The Seven connected to Celestia
introduced.quote: Gnoses belong to The Seven — they're what keep them connected to Celestia!

introduced.name: The Seven
introduced.how: hold Gnoses that tie them to Celestia
introduced.quote: Gnoses belong to The Seven — they're what keep them connected to Celestia!

introduced.name: The Balladeer
introduced.how: No. 6 Harbinger, stronger than Signora, and the prototype puppet who now holds the Gnosis
introduced.quote: The Balladeer is No. 6 of the Fatui Harbingers. In terms of strength, he is superior to Signora.

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: ranked Fatui elite numbered by strength
introduced.quote: The Balladeer is No. 6 of the Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Shogun puppet
introduced.how: Ei's puppet vessel built with lost technology
introduced.quote: After Ei created her puppet vessel, she no longer had anywhere to put it.

introduced.name: Prototype puppet
introduced.how: Ei's test puppet, later a human-seeming wanderer in Inazuma until the Fatui modified him
introduced.quote: Later, this puppet wandered Inazuma as an ordinary human male with his own consciousness, until... the Fatui took an interest in him.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: fought and won by the twin gods Baal and Beelzebul together
introduced.quote: They won the Archon War together, and when Baal established the Shogunate

introduced.name: Beelzebul
introduced.how: Ei's former identity as Baal's twin and body double
introduced.quote: Beelzebul is Ei, with whom we are now both acquainted.

introduced.name: Makoto
introduced.how: Baal's personal name; a gentle god who died hundreds of years ago
introduced.quote: Baal's name was "Makoto."

introduced.name: Makoto's death
introduced.how: Makoto died several hundred years ago in a war, after which Ei took the Shogunate
introduced.quote: Makoto died several hundred years ago in a war that I was not personally involved in.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: land of the God of Wisdom, devoted to endless pursuit of knowledge
introduced.quote: Sumeru is the land of the God of Wisdom, where the quest for wisdom and knowledge is never-ending.

introduced.name: Knowledge as a resource
introduced.how: Sumeru manages knowledge holistically as a resource
introduced.quote: In Sumeru, knowledge is holistically managed as a resource.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: the deity Sumerians worship, known by a term of endearment
introduced.quote: "Lesser Lord Kusanali" is the deity in whom the people of Sumeru place their faith.

assumed.name: Teppei
assumed.quote: Aha, , there you are, good to see you.

assumed.name: Crux Fleet
assumed.quote: you've spent time with the Crux Fleet in the past

assumed.name: Shogun's Army
assumed.quote: the conflict between us and the Shogun's Army getting more intense by the day

assumed.name: Shuumatsuban
assumed.quote: the Shuumatsuban ninja Sayu can easier infiltrate the Tenryou Commission

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: so they can survive the Electro Archon's attacks

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: to meet with Kamisato Ayaka and Thoma.

assumed.name: Scaramouche
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right! Paimon was so focused on the Traveler that Paimon didn't notice what you did to get Scaramouche off our backs...

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: What if I told you it was a secret art from the Grand Narukami Shrine, and that I had The Balladeer down on his knees begging for mercy in an instant... Would you believe me?

assumed.name: Watatsumi Island
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: You needn't worry. The leader of Watatsumi Island took some troops to clear the place out.

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Well anyway, that Sangonomiya Kokomi, she really outdid herself this time.

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Traveler: You mean the Raiden Shogun?

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Traveler: Zhongli also mentioned erosion.

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: You mean Morax? It's been a while since I last saw him.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Perhaps it's because... I'm the Electro Archon's familiar.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Paimon: What!? Like Dvalin is to Barbatos? Never would have guessed by looking at you...

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Paimon: What!? Like Dvalin is to Barbatos? Never would have guessed by looking at you...

assumed.name: Shogun's Army
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: The Shogun's Army haven't given up on their search for you yet

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Ah, I must say, I would relish the opportunity to watch the Fatui getting a taste of their own medicine...

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: I see. You have been through a lot since we last met.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Yashiro Commission!

assumed.name: Kujou Clan
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: And your masters, the Kujou Clan of the Tenryou Commission — they are the ones keeping the truth from reaching the Shogun.

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Considering even their Visions have been taken from them and embedded in the Statue, they are ultimately quite helpless.

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: Traveler: For Venti's Gnosis...

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why are they doing it... Why are the Harbingers collecting all the Gnoses?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Signora: The Tsaritsa's dream is the noblest and purest thing in all the world.

assumed.name: Crimson Witch of Embers
assumed.quote: Signora: Pale flame, lay waste to this frozen shell and witness my suffering.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Traveler: And for the people of Liyue you imperiled...

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: You want to save the people of Inazuma from the Vision Hunt Decree. So do I.

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: Kujou Takayuki: The Shogun is at receiving a Snezhnayan diplomat

assumed.name: Teppei
assumed.quote: Traveler: Teppei...

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Resistance
assumed.quote: Sangonomiya Resistance Member: Charge!

assumed.name: Ayaka
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ayaka was saying that every time they submitted a petition against the Vision Hunt Decree, the Tenryou and Kanjou Commissions would veto it straight away with no negotiation.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Way back in Ritou, Lady Hiiragi said something about the Kanjou Commissioner meeting with an arrogant-sounding woman...

assumed.name: Kazuha
assumed.quote: (The Masterless Vision on Kazuha crackles and gains the Electro color and symbol)

assumed.name: Gorou
assumed.quote: Gorou: Attack!

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Considering even their Visions have been taken from them and embedded in the Statue, they are ultimately quite helpless.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Catching up with an old friend I hadn't seen in years was truly delightful.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Defeating Signora head-on in a duel means that your strength exceeds my expectations.

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: As her erstwhile closest friend... Ei handed it over to me, and I've kept it in the Grand Narukami Shrine ever since.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Ugh, not the Fatui!

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: I've kept it in the Grand Narukami Shrine ever since.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: the time has come for the Inazuma leg of your trip to come to an end

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: So... you mean there are three Raiden Shoguns!?

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Perhaps the reason you do not possess a Vision is that such an ambition has yet to be engendered within you...

assumed.name: Shuumatsuban
assumed.quote: I will also borrow some of Ayato's people from the Shuumatsuban.

assumed.name: Omamori
assumed.quote: do you still have the omamori I gave you?

threads.claim: The Tatarigami seems to be stronger in the ruins, and its effects on health are being felt more.
threads.quote: It could be that the Tatarigami is more palpable here, I guess.

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission's support for the Vision Hunt Decree appears to have come out of nowhere, a mystery left open.
threads.quote: The Tenryou Commission's zealous support for the decree seemed to come out of nowhere.

threads.claim: Ei agrees to abolish the Vision Hunt Decree after Miko persuades her, though she needs time to reconsider her rule.
threads.quote: Conceding to Miko's point, Ei agrees to abolish the Vision Hunt Decree

threads.claim: The Shogun's indifference to the civil war the Decree has caused is an unexplained contradiction.
threads.quote: And the Shogun seems completely indifferent to the fact that it has effectively caused a civil war...

threads.claim: The Fatui deliberately engineered the Vision Hunt Decree to create conflict and a market for Delusions.
threads.quote: Good news is, our hard work is finally paying off. Generating conflict creates a big market for Delusions.

threads.claim: The anonymous sponsor's motives are doubted by Kokomi, and the true identity is left unknown until revealed as the Fatui.
threads.quote: I am not without my doubts about the whole affair... but Watatsumi Island is hardly affluent, and these supplies are a much-needed lifeline for us.

threads.claim: Ei was aware of the Fatui's involvement all along and tacitly allowed it.
threads.quote: Ei turns out to have been aware of the Fatui's involvement all along

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles destroyed Khaenri'ah, a past event that shaped Ei's view of eternity.
threads.quote: witnessing the Heavenly Principles' destruction of Khaenri'ah

threads.claim: Ei's pursuit of eternity is shown to cause suffering, and Miko persuades her to reconsider.
threads.quote: Miko eventually persuades her that her idea of eternity is bringing too much suffering and loneliness to even herself

threads.claim: The Traveler's lack of a Vision may be because they have not yet found a strong enough ambition.
threads.quote: Miko speculates that the Traveler's lack of a Vision may actually be because they have not yet found an ambition strong enough for them to receive one.

threads.claim: The Balladeer was Ei's prototype puppet, recruited into the Fatui and augmented to become the Sixth Harbinger.
threads.quote: The Balladeer was Ei's prototype puppet who was recruited into the Fatui and augmented until he was strong enough to become the Sixth Harbinger;

threads.claim: The Shogun lost something very dear to her during the Archon War, a hint left unexplained.
threads.quote: They say the shogun lost something very dear to her along the way too.

threads.claim: Kazuha's late friend's Masterless Vision can respond to Kazuha, with unexplained power.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha miraculously resonates with his late friend's Masterless Vision

threads.claim: Takayuki confirms his betrayal of the Shogunate and reveals his selfish reasons for accepting the Fatui's proposals.
threads.quote: he confirms all that they have read, revealing his selfish reasons for accepting the Fatui's proposals.

threads.claim: Knowledge is managed as a resource in Sumeru, and it is unclear whether Lesser Lord Kusanali or the Sages decided this.
threads.quote: knowledge is managed as a resource in Sumeru

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun met earlier is a puppet while the true Ei meditates inside her sword.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Since the physical body will eventually turn to dust, she replaced hers with that of a puppet.

threads.claim: Yae Miko explains that Ei placed her consciousness in her sword and left the outside world to a puppet focused on eternity.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: She shuts herself off in her inner world, leaving all the affairs of the outside world to be dealt with by a puppet who has a singular focus on the pursuit of eternity...

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree was a Fatui trap, confirmed by the Balladeer and the Tenryou Commission's collusion.
threads.quote: Traveler: The Balladeer confirmed this.

threads.claim: Kujou Takayuki admits dealings with the Fatui and the Tenryou Commission's betrayal is revealed.
threads.quote: Kujou Takayuki: Hmph... Yes, I have dealings with the Fatui. And yes, the report you saw was penned by my hand.

threads.claim: Ei lost someone she loved, and the loss still aches; the identity of "her" is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Ei: In the end, I even lost her

threads.claim: Ei says that the wounds left on the nation by that loss still ache and that the Heavenly Principles caused a nation's ruin.
threads.quote: Ei: But the wounds left on our nation by that terrible loss

threads.claim: Ei's pursuit of eternity is a reaction to progress causing loss, a conflict Yae Miko challenges.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: So, are we to just abandon the notion of progress... for the sake of wishful thinking?

threads.claim: Ei agrees to abolish the Vision Hunt Decree but says she needs time to decide the nation's future.
threads.quote: Ei: But with regards to eternity and the question of whether this nation should move forward, I need time to give it some thought.

threads.claim: Yae Miko and Ei were close friends, and Ei left without saying goodbye, leaving their relationship unresolved.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: You know, Ei never said goodbye to me before she stepped into the Plane of Euthymia.

threads.claim: Yae Miko and Ei reunite in the Plane of Euthymia, and Ei admits seeing Yae Miko again is a nice surprise.
threads.quote: Ei: *sigh* Seeing you again is a change to eternity... and a very nice surprise.

threads.claim: The people's ambitions are presented as precious and capable of surpassing gods' expectations.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: It is precisely because of their helplessness, because their Visions have been taken from them, that their will is all the more precious.

threads.claim: The Traveler takes on the people's ambitions and shows that human ambition can overcome divine will.
threads.quote: Traveler: When people move forward with all their might...

threads.claim: Signora, the Fatui Harbinger, is executed by the Raiden Shogun after losing a duel.
threads.quote: (The Raiden Shogun executes Signora with the Musou no Hitotachi)

threads.claim: The Harbingers are collecting Gnoses for an unknown purpose, raising a question about their goal.
threads.quote: Paimon: Why are they doing it... Why are the Harbingers collecting all the Gnoses?

threads.claim: Ei calls the Traveler the furthest thing from eternity and admits to being intrigued by them.
threads.quote: Ei: There seems to be limitless uncertainty in you. To put it another way, you are the furthest thing from eternity.

threads.claim: Kujou Sara turns against the Kujou Clan after seeing the forged-looking proof of betrayal, pledging to tell the Shogun the truth.
threads.quote: Kujou Sara: So, I'm going to tell the Shogun the truth about all this. If nothing else, my conscience will be clear!

threads.claim: The sky inside Ei's inner world was once dark but is now glowing again, hinting at a change in her state.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Tell me this. Why is the sky here that was once so dark glowing again? Why now?

threads.claim: The Balladeer has taken possession of the Gnosis that Yae Miko had kept, and the Gnosis is now lost to the Traveler.
threads.quote: The object of divine creation is the one who has now taken possession of the Gnosis...

threads.claim: The prototype puppet was secretly unsealed and modified by the Fatui into a more formidable being.
threads.quote: Later, this puppet wandered Inazuma as an ordinary human male with his own consciousness, until... the Fatui took an interest in him.

threads.claim: Baal and Beelzebul were twin gods who ruled Inazuma jointly, and the public was never told there were two.
threads.quote: There were two twin gods, Baal and Beelzebul.

threads.claim: Makoto's death several hundred years ago in a war is an event that shaped Ei and her role as Shogun.
threads.quote: Makoto died several hundred years ago in a war that I was not personally involved in.

threads.claim: Makoto's death and Ei's change are tied to Khaenri'ah, though the link is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Khaenri'ah...

threads.claim: Ei began to change after losing Makoto, and the reason for the change is not yet explained.
threads.quote: That was when Ei began to change.

threads.claim: Ei voluntarily gave up her Gnosis and severed her ties with Celestia.
threads.quote: she voluntarily gave up her Gnosis long ago, severing her ties with Celestia in the process.

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling is missing, and Yae Miko promises to investigate their whereabouts.
threads.quote: As for your 's whereabouts, I will use all the resources at my disposal to investigate it

threads.claim: The Traveler lacks a Vision because a suitable ambition has not yet formed within them.
threads.quote: Perhaps the reason you do not possess a Vision is that such an ambition has yet to be engendered within you...

threads.claim: The Traveler doubts Ei is the god they seek, but Yae Miko insists the doubt is misplaced.
threads.quote: Having met her, I don't believe she was the one.

introduced.name: Lan Junming
introduced.how: Learns he is the founder of the Lan Clan, a soul fragment from the past now reawakened
introduced.quote: You are the founder of the Lan Clan, after all.

introduced.name: Wind Reader
introduced.how: Learns Wind Reader is one of the Eight Adepts, a legendary thaumaturg
introduced.quote: Are you Wind Reader? One of the Eight Adepts?

introduced.name: Gaming
introduced.how: Learns Gaming is a cargo escort who was attacked by monsters on the road
introduced.quote: I was escorting a shipment from Yilong Wharf to Liyue Harbor today, but right as we passed through here, a whole pack of monsters rolled up

introduced.name: Chongyun
introduced.how: Learns Chongyun comes from a thaumaturge family and sees demon slaying as his duty
introduced.quote: Chongyun hails from a thaumaturge family. He regards the slaying of demons and evil spirits as his duty.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: Learns Xingqiu learned his Raincutter technique at the Guhua Clan
introduced.quote: It is where I learned my Raincutter technique.

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: Learns the Guhua Clan is a martial school in Liyue that teaches swordsmanship
introduced.quote: If we are speaking of real martial schools, then my Guhua Clan would naturally come foremost.

introduced.name: Tianheng Thaumaturges
introduced.how: Learns Chongyun belongs to the Tianheng Thaumaturges, an order that exists
introduced.quote: Chongyun is indeed a member of the Tianheng Thaumaturges, which do, in fact, exist.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: Learns Hu Tao is called Director Hu and helps defeat monsters on the road
introduced.quote: If it weren't for Director Hu and company, man, the whole run might've gone belly up.

introduced.name: Old Man Wuwang
introduced.how: Learns Old Man Wuwang was a foremost thaumaturg and master of Qihuang Sigils, rival of the Wind Reader
introduced.quote: Back then, Old Man Wuwang and the Wind Reader were two of Liyue's foremost thaumaturges — the former a master of Qihuang Sigils, and the latter excelling in the Qimen Arts.

introduced.name: Yunlai Angler
introduced.how: Learns the Yunlai Angler was a famous title held by Fish Creel, a master the Lan Junming knew
introduced.quote: He had another title, one better known to the world.

introduced.name: Jiangxue
introduced.how: Learns Jiangxue is a descendant of Fish Creel who wants to avoid Mad Lan
introduced.quote: Count me out. My ancestor's instructions were clear: Stay well away from anyone like Mad Lan.

introduced.name: Silverwing
introduced.how: Learns Silverwing is an adeptus who takes the form of a swallow and was Lan Junming's old companion
introduced.quote: (Silverwing lands on the railing nearby in her swallow form)

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: Learns the war between Rex Lapis and the other gods still rages and adepti fight in it
introduced.quote: The war between Rex Lapis and the other gods is not yet over.

introduced.name: Soul-Binding technique
introduced.how: Learns Lan Junming used a Soul-Binding technique with a seal to keep a remnant of himself alive
introduced.quote: I must have placed a seal upon the Soul-Binding technique to prevent this remnant of me from fading.

introduced.name: Moon-Viewing Gathering
introduced.how: Learns the Moon-Viewing Gathering is a centuries-old festival with climbing, moon-gazing, wine and poetry
introduced.quote: For centuries, their customs have remained unchanged — climbing to a high place, admiring the moon, drinking wine, and composing poetry.

introduced.name: Moonchase Festival custom
introduced.how: Learns seeing off the autumn swallow is a Moonchase Festival custom that Lan Junming and Silverwing shared
introduced.quote: That was how seeing off the autumn swallow became our own Moonchase Festival custom

introduced.name: Eight Adepts
introduced.how: Learns the Eight Adepts first came together by chance at a roadside tea stop
introduced.quote: Chance brought us to the same tea stop.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: Learns Wangshu Inn is packed during the Moon-Viewing Gathering
introduced.quote: Wangshu Inn is always packed during the Moon-Viewing Gathering.

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: Learns Smiley Yanxiao runs the inn kitchen and calls in extra chefs during the festival
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao can't handle the rush on his own, so he calls in a few extra chefs to help out.

introduced.name: Guoba
introduced.how: Learns Guoba is Xiangling's companion
introduced.quote: Grandmaster, this is Guoba. He's Miss Xiangling's companion.

introduced.name: rattan figure
introduced.how: Learns rattan figures are controlled along a route to collect energy and dispel miasmic energy
introduced.quote: During this process, you must control a rattan figure along a designated route

introduced.name: Staff of Homa banner
introduced.how: Learns the banner is charged by defeating fiends and gives everyone an edge in the fight
introduced.quote: The elders of my clan taught me how to use it.

introduced.name: Errant Balefires
introduced.how: Learns Errant Balefires are formed from condensed miasmic energy and leave balefire along the route
introduced.quote: are formed from condensed miasmic energy, which leave lingering balefire all along the route.

introduced.name: Empowerment Gate
introduced.how: Learns passing an Empowerment Gate grants the Protection status
introduced.quote: while passing through an Empowerment Gate grants you the Protection status for some time.

introduced.name: evil spirits possessing monsters
introduced.how: Learns evil spirits born from dead gods' remnants possess monsters and jump to new ones when they fall
introduced.quote: The malign spirits possessing those monsters were born from the remnants of dead gods.

assumed.name: Lan Yan
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's time to meet up with Lan Yan.

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: having spent the past few days wandering Chenyu Vale once again

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, that's Xiao! And... the fisherman?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: There was no summons from Rex Lapis, nor any noble banner for us to rally beneath.

assumed.name: The Sanctification of Tao Dou
assumed.quote: I first heard about The Sanctification of Tao Dou from a storyteller when I was looking for work in Liyue Harbor.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The Millelith and the thaumaturges accompanying them are preparing to advance toward Stone Gate.

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: Shenhe is, so there's nothing to worry about!

assumed.name: Huai'an
assumed.quote: Speak with Huai'an at once.

assumed.name: Teatree Slope
assumed.quote: We chose a pavilion east of Teatree Slope as our meeting place.

threads.claim: Lan Junming's soul fragment is sealed and may be lost if the seal breaks or the journey ends.
threads.quote: If this journey is what breaks the seal and lets this fragment of my soul return, then that old soul will tarry no longer in the world of the living.

threads.claim: Xiao warns that the Soul-Binding seal must be released or Lan Junming's remaining soul will wear away.
threads.quote: Release the seal now, or what remains of your soul will eventually be worn away.

threads.claim: Silverwing vanished long ago and nobody in the group knows where she went.
threads.quote: She vanished long ago, without leaving so much as a trace.

threads.claim: The Moonchase Festival swallow custom was a private promise between Lan Junming and Silverwing, explaining the lost memory.
threads.quote: That was how seeing off the autumn swallow became our own Moonchase Festival custom

threads.claim: Lan Junming's memories of the past are slipping away, and recalling them stirs deeper troubles.
threads.quote: Yet whenever I try to grasp them, I find that so much has already slipped away.

threads.claim: The war between Rex Lapis and the other gods still continues, drawing adepti into it.
threads.quote: The war between Rex Lapis and the other gods is not yet over.

threads.claim: Evil spirits born from the remnants of dead gods are possessing monsters across Liyue.
threads.quote: The malign spirits possessing those monsters were born from the remnants of dead gods.

threads.claim: Lan Junming believes a Tianheng Sect should exist in Liyue, but the others say it does not, hinting at altered history.
threads.quote: In Liyue, things ought not be this way...

threads.claim: Lan Junming and Silverwing planned a yearly renewal of ward sigils to keep evil spirits suppressed.
threads.quote: Once each year, we will need to join forces and renew the sigils' power.

threads.claim: Wind Reader is a title bestowed on Lan Junming after his passing.
threads.quote: Merely a title, bestowed after my passing.

threads.claim: The Eight Adepts began as a chance meeting at a tea stop, not a summons.
threads.quote: Chance brought us to the same tea stop.

introduced.name: Mahavaipulya Chamber
introduced.how: a library-like chamber whose inhabitants were pressed into paper; also called the Mahavaipulya Hall or Archives
introduced.quote: This place is called the Mahavaipulya Chamber. You can call it the Mahavaipulya Hall or the Mahavaipulya Archives, whichever you prefer.

introduced.name: Restoration Core
introduced.how: the key device Dex uses to unfold space and restore people from paper; it is split into parts across the library
introduced.quote: The thing that Dex just touched is the key. Whenever space is manipulated, it leaves a residual trail of its own reversal.

introduced.name: Okikuni
introduced.how: a youkai-era scholar who was turned into a paper person for writing novels
introduced.quote: My name is Okikuni. As later generations would account it, I should be from the era when youkai roamed the lands, before Narukami unified the thundering archipelago.

introduced.name: Calcerius
introduced.how: a Remurian-era writer trapped in a page who swaps novels with Okikuni
introduced.quote: I'm Calcerius. I'm from the Remurian era.

introduced.name: Yu Huangyi
introduced.how: a Liyue-era figure from the time of Shanhui Fort who acts as guide through the library
introduced.quote: And I am Yu Huangyi. I come from the era when Shanhui Fort stood at the foot of Mt. Tianheng, and the Guili Assembly had not yet been founded.

introduced.name: Melanta
introduced.how: the antagonist who classified the library's stories as pollutants and controls the area
introduced.quote: Melanta classified our work as a pollutant. He claimed that it blurred the line between fact and fiction, sullying what should be a pure and proper cultural landscape.

introduced.name: Bosch
introduced.how: a painter who taught Hilda to paint with Daozi at the academy
introduced.quote: After restoring the academy, they meet Bosch, who reveals that he and Daozi taught Hilda how to paint during her stay with them.

introduced.name: Daozi
introduced.how: a painter trapped in ink at Luyang Academy who mistakes Zeitlind for Hilda
introduced.quote: After rescuing a painter called Daozi, who mistakes Zeitlind for her sister Hilda, they gradually restore the academy to its original state.

introduced.name: Hilda
introduced.how: Zeitlind's sister, shown through a photo from a Liyue trip
introduced.quote: Zeitlind finds one of the items from her suitcase: A photograph of her sister in front of Wangshu Inn during a trip to Liyue.

introduced.name: Venipi
introduced.how: a Desert Pavilion figure who recognizes Zeitlind as Raumhilda's younger sister
introduced.quote: In the Desert Pavilion, the group meets Venipi, who recognizes Zeitlind as Raumhilda's younger sister.

introduced.name: Istoria
introduced.how: a long-time resident of the temple who has witnessed its history and knew Hilda
introduced.quote: I am one who lived to witness what came before, and who continues to learn of what follows from those who come after.

introduced.name: Dex
introduced.how: a juvenile Watcher who can carry living people between the Pillar Hall and the surface
introduced.quote: It is a Watcher in juvenile form, and that limitation is part of its nature.

introduced.name: Path to the Heavens
introduced.how: a climb that requires giving up one's memories to reach the Atrium of Suchness
introduced.quote: One must construct the Path to the Heavens with their own memories and wisdom. Only then can they encounter the sacred beyond.

introduced.name: Atrium of Suchness
introduced.how: the highest point of the temple, where gods and Watchers dwell and hidden truths are kept
introduced.quote: The highest point of the temple, the Atrium of Suchness, is where gods and Watchers dwell. It's said that certain hidden truths are kept within its walls.

introduced.name: Pillar Hall
introduced.how: a place once cut off from the surface, with no way in or out until Nihilita fell
introduced.quote: This place used to be completely cut off from the world above. There was no way in and no way out.

introduced.name: Hilda's sanatorium stay
introduced.how: Hilda was sent to a mountain sanatorium after her fiance left, which Zeitlind says was steeped in curses
introduced.quote: So much that she was sent to a sanatorium in the mountains — this very place beneath our feet. A place steeped in curses.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: an era when adeptal arts scattered across the mortal realm and split into traditions
introduced.quote: It covers the era of the Archon War, when the adeptal arts were scattered across the mortal realm, leading to the development and evolution of three distinct traditions.

introduced.name: Apathic Interval
introduced.how: a harsh realm of torment that erodes will and desire, where the trapped were held
introduced.quote: Though the relentless torment and tempering within the Apathic Interval sought to erode our will and desire, it somehow aligned with the ancient art of severing the Three Deadly Selves.

introduced.name: Zeitlind
introduced.how: introduces herself as Hilda's sister
introduced.quote: I'm Zeitlind, her sister.

introduced.name: Zeitlind
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Hilda's younger sister, a searcher for lost belongings
introduced.quote: I'm her younger sister, Zeitlind.

introduced.name: Daozi
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Daoxuan, meaning Profound Way, a painter who was trapped in a painted cage
introduced.quote: There's a reason some people also call me Daoxuan, for "Profound Way."

introduced.name: Escher
introduced.how: Figure calling himself Maukie claims a birth name of Escher and says he is a painter
introduced.quote: Hello, my name is Escher. I'm a painter.

introduced.name: Melanta
introduced.how: Punishes people by sealing them into paintings and turning them into ink blots
introduced.quote: This is how Melanta delivers punishment: Sealing people into paintings and smushing them into ink blots.

introduced.name: Venipi
introduced.how: Former worker on King Deshret's mausoleum, thrown into the Apathic Interval and later trapped in the Desert Pavilion
introduced.quote: My name is Venipi, and I come from an era when King Deshret's divine form still walked among us.

introduced.name: Kshama
introduced.how: Self-introduction as a trapped person from Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's era
introduced.quote: My name is Kshama, and I come from Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's era.

introduced.name: Hilda
introduced.how: Revealed as Zeitlind's older sister, a painter who had a Kamera-related vacation and who has died
introduced.quote: Zeitlind: She's my older sister.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: A device that creates pictures more lifelike than the most realistic paintings
introduced.quote: Back then, your sister told us of something capable of creating pictures even more lifelike than the most realistic paintings.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: A destroyed military power where rank depended on musical mastery
introduced.quote: But in truth, the greater your musical mastery, the higher your rank in the Remurian military.

introduced.name: Ichor
introduced.how: Inner circles of Remuria were transformed into semi-immortal golems called Ichor
introduced.quote: By the way, I don't know if you've heard of this, but everyone in the Remurian inner circles was transformed into "Ichor," becoming semi-immortal golems.

introduced.name: Apathic Interval
introduced.how: A period after which people could no longer receive Visions, and people were plucked out of time into it
introduced.quote: After enduring the Apathic Interval, we could no longer receive Visions... But anyway, back to our story.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: A power people can receive, which determines selection into arts like the Guhua Clan's
introduced.quote: Of course, he wouldn't have been selected if he had one in the first place.

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: A clan with secret arts whose successors are lacking
introduced.quote: He then spoke harshly, lamenting a lack of successors to the Guhua Clan's secret arts and the withering of talent on the vine in his era.

introduced.name: Nihilita
introduced.how: Explained as one of two names, meaning nothingness, alongside Melanta's meaning of melancholy
introduced.quote: Yes. They mean "melancholy" and "nothingness," don't they?

introduced.name: Temple of Space
introduced.how: A site from which the Temple of Space once ascended, now beneath a sanatorium
introduced.quote: I wouldn't have thought anyone audacious enough to build a sanatorium atop the site from which the Temple of Space had ascended.

introduced.name: Punisher of Gomorrah
introduced.how: The only known method to stop people turning to sand is to defeat it
introduced.quote: So, it seems we're back to the only known method: defeating the Punisher of Gomorrah.

introduced.name: sand-turning punishment
introduced.how: People are punished by being turned into sand statues, still alive
introduced.quote: Those are people — all of them. They were punished by being turned into sand.

assumed.name: Yakshas
assumed.quote: By the way, Zeitlind, which of the five Yaksha generals do you like the most?

assumed.name: Nihilita
assumed.quote: But after Nihilita fell, Dex seems to have gained the ability to carry people of the living world between the Pillar Hall and the surface.

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: He'd joke about it sometimes, blame the Anemo Archon for planning Mondstadt too well, so even a family like his never faded out.

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: Mora, as in... Morax. I see. A destiny decreed by heaven.

assumed.name: Windrest Peak
assumed.quote: Then I came to the temple beneath Windrest Peak and saw her gravestone, perched on a lonely mountain, in a strange and distant land.

assumed.name: Phobos
assumed.quote: The Apathic Interval has stripped away my faith in Phobos, but I still get the urge to write every once in a while.

assumed.name: Vritras
assumed.quote: She said Vritras was her favorite.

assumed.name: Istoria
assumed.quote: This must be the "Luyang Academy" that Istoria was talking about.

assumed.name: Luyang Academy
assumed.quote: This must be the "Luyang Academy" that Istoria was talking about.

assumed.name: Dex
assumed.quote: Dex, did you understand any of that?

assumed.name: Domain Keeper
assumed.quote: (Two Domain Keepers spawn)

assumed.name: Azhdaha
assumed.quote: But leveling mountains, you say... That would make you just as powerful as Azhdaha.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: It is indeed fabulous, comparable to the finishing touch from Rex Lapis's hand, which brought stone to life.

assumed.name: Kanou
assumed.quote: Kanou, Yoshitoshi, Bosch, you've all come back to life!

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: I'll give you the coin King Deshret awarded me... So please! Tell me this is just a nightmare.

threads.claim: Istoria suggests Hilda may still be alive despite her gravestone.
threads.quote: Your sister may still be alive.

threads.claim: Istoria believes Hilda survived because she did something important in the temple.
threads.quote: I do. Because she did something here.

threads.claim: Hilda's final letter announced she was going somewhere far away, leaving her fate unclear.
threads.quote: She said she was going somewhere far away.

threads.claim: Only those who give up all their memories may enter the Atrium of Suchness.
threads.quote: Only those who choose to abandon all their memories are permitted to enter that hall.

threads.claim: Part of an old Path to the Heavens survives as a stairway, which may be made whole again for others to use.
threads.quote: Melanta's fury destroyed half of it, but the remaining half, the stairway to heaven, is still vaguely visible.

threads.claim: Melanta has tampered with the library's texts and filled them with malice, and he controls the temple's crises.
threads.quote: Melanta has reviewed and tampered with this text. It's filled with a great deal of unwarranted malice.

threads.claim: Paimon wonders whether Dex is the same kind of being as Nihilita.
threads.quote: You're saying Dex is the same kind of being as Nihilita?

threads.claim: Zeitlind hears the Watcher of Nothingness speak but does not understand it, and the Watcher seems tied to something that matters to the Traveler.
threads.quote: I don't understand what the Watcher of Nothingness was saying, but I can tell that there's something in this place that matters to you.

threads.claim: Memories gathered in the temple are wiped away on return to the mortal realm, which Istoria argues is an emotional burden.
threads.quote: Your memories are supposed to be wiped the moment you return to the mortal realm.

threads.claim: The god who designed the Path to the Heavens may not be the mistress of the temple.
threads.quote: The god who designed the Path to the Heavens was not the mistress of the temple.

threads.claim: Istoria calls himself a coward who never dared to climb the path, hinting at his past failure.
threads.quote: I'm just a coward at heart, after all. I never dared to make the climb.

threads.claim: The mountain sanatorium is described as a place steeped in curses.
threads.quote: A place steeped in curses.

threads.claim: The group finally assembles a complete Restoration Core after searching the library.
threads.quote: Alright, we finally got ourselves a complete core!

threads.claim: Realistic paintings in this place hide secrets and can cage spirits.
threads.quote: As such, expect hidden secrets lurking behind any realistic paintings you find here.

threads.claim: The figure calling himself Maukie may not be who he claims, and Paimon suspects a prior connection.
threads.quote: Wait, Paimon just remembered... Have we met before?

threads.claim: The fake Escher is revealed as Melanta working behind the scenes.
threads.quote: Hmph. This must be Melanta working from behind the curtain.

threads.claim: Melanta regards people's names as meaningless numbers and reshapes them.
threads.quote: To him, names are nothing but a string of numbers slapped onto us when we arrive here.

threads.claim: Zeitlind's older sister Hilda is missing and the group is searching for her.
threads.quote: The main goal of our adventure is to find lost sibling.

threads.claim: Hilda is revealed to have died, and her tombstone is at the sanatorium.
threads.quote: I saw my sister's tombstone back at the sanatorium.

threads.claim: The Punisher of Gomorrah hides its true form, making it hard to find.
threads.quote: But there's no way to find the Punisher of Gomorrah. It has hidden its form.

threads.claim: Defeating the Punisher destroys the inverted mirage and restores the Desert Pavilion.
threads.quote: (Dex destroys the Punisher and the upside-down mirage of the Desert Pavilion crumbles)

threads.claim: The Apathic Interval took away people's Visions, a loss the group does not fully understand.
threads.quote: After enduring the Apathic Interval, we could no longer receive Visions... But anyway, back to our story.

threads.claim: Remuria was destroyed and its remnants still shape the story's world.
threads.quote: Ah, this goes back to how a certain border fortress rose to prominence when Remuria was destroyed.

threads.claim: Remurian inner circles were turned into semi-immortal golems called Ichor.
threads.quote: By the way, I don't know if you've heard of this, but everyone in the Remurian inner circles was transformed into "Ichor," becoming semi-immortal golems.

threads.claim: The legend of a finishing touch bringing Azhdaha to life is said to be a later invention.
threads.quote: As such, the so-called "finishing touch" that brought the dragon to life was nothing more than a legend, the invention of later generations.

threads.claim: The One above named her creations nothingness and melancholy because she cannot deal with them.
threads.quote: Why would the great One above who rules over sky and space name her own creations "nothingness" and "melancholy"?

threads.claim: Hilda spoke of a Kamera and the group wonders what it would look like.
threads.quote: It's a shame that she didn't have a Kamera, nor did she have a picture painted by it on hand.

threads.claim: Istoria raises whether life has meaning if everything returns to nothingness.
threads.quote: If we one day discover that everything is destined to return to nothingness in the far future, would our lives now still hold meaning?

threads.claim: People are being punished by being turned into sand statues, and the cause is unexplained.
threads.quote: Those are people — all of them. They were punished by being turned into sand.

threads.claim: Zeitlind recovers her lost belongings, including the brooch.
threads.quote: I've found my stuff. Let's keep helping Daozi out, shall we?

threads.claim: Albedo is convicted of murder and illegal disposal of remains, but the Traveler doubts the verdict.
threads.quote: Jean: The evidence is conclusive. On the charges of murder and unlawful disposal of human remains, the court finds the defendant... guilty.

threads.claim: Albedo is a synthetic human made by Rhinedottir, a secret that could be used against him.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Albedo told me his secret once — that he was a synthetic human created through alchemy. Could that have something to do with this case?)

threads.claim: Albedo's letter hints at research into human transmutation and creating life.
threads.quote: the materials and arcane formation required for human transmutation.

threads.claim: Albedo's correspondence claims death is the material for creating new life.
threads.quote: The mystery of human birth is often linked to death. As such, death is the most suitable material for the creation of new life.

threads.quote: The formations in these records likely originate from the Khaenri'ahn art of Khemia.

threads.claim: Spawns of Durin's life force can mimic other beings, and using their power destabilizes them.

threads.claim: Miles is sleepwalking at night and may have seen something he was not meant to see.
threads.quote: Miles: I started sleepwalking out of nowhere.

threads.claim: Strange behavior is spreading through Mondstadt during the festival, hinting at a wider problem.
threads.quote: a lot of strange things have been happening in Mondstadt

threads.claim: Phonia reappears after being missing for over half a year, and her reason for hiding is unknown.
threads.quote: The person, Phonia, appears, but Jean immediately questions her on her actions, since she had been missing for over half a year.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir devoured Naberius, the Ruler of Life, and Albedo believes the two are now one.
threads.quote: He also reveals that she had devoured Naberius, the Ruler of Life, but he believes that the two are now one.

threads.claim: Albedo's true identity is a synthetic human, and the Traveler hints that the truth is being kept from others.
threads.quote: As his friend, I shouldn't reveal the truth about his identity.

threads.claim: Albedo admits his origins would destroy public trust in him, which explains why the truth stayed hidden.
threads.quote: if my true identity got out, the public's trust in me would be gone.

threads.claim: Durin is a long-dead dragon whose remains still carry an unusual life energy.
threads.quote: Deep within the mountain lies the remains of an even more mysterious creature — Durin.

threads.claim: Durin is kept alive by alchemy, and his heart keeps growing stronger.
threads.quote: His heart still beats and grows more revitalized by the day.

threads.claim: Staying in Dragonspine too long leaves people quietly under Durin's influence.
threads.quote: Humans who venture into Dragonspine for too long are also bound to fall under Durin's influence.

threads.claim: Durin's absorbed knowledge and emotions give him a childlike anger and rivalry toward his creations.
threads.quote: I picked up on anxious voices and a child's anger.

threads.claim: Albedo's map marks three hidden body sites, and the third one does not match the other two.
threads.quote: Albedo marked these three locations on the map found in the hidden compartment.

threads.claim: Albedo confirms the map is his and that he hid bodies at all three locations.
threads.quote: The map does belong to me, and I did hide things at those three locations.

threads.claim: A man who looks exactly like Albedo may have been encountered on Dragonspine.
threads.quote: Wait a second! Someone who looks exactly like him...

threads.claim: Albedo's 'killing' on Dragonspine was of a lookalike creature, not a person.
threads.quote: But, I never said that someone was a

threads.claim: The fake Hertha is revealed as Subject Two, a monster that has met the Traveler before.
threads.quote: The fake Hertha — Subject Two — has met you on Dragonspine before.

threads.claim: Subject Two came from the Homunculus Project and was absorbed by Durin, who gained his knowledge.
threads.quote: My imposter on Dragonspine was a failed specimen abandoned in Durin's stomach, an unsuccessful iteration of the Homunculus Project.

threads.claim: A figure called Subject One exists, and Subject Two was made in an effort to replace him.
threads.quote: In his pursuit to replace Subject One

threads.claim: An informant inside the Knights of Favonius leaked internal information to Durin's monsters.
threads.quote: There's an informant among our ranks.

threads.claim: Barbatos has located the informant, who cannot hear the group's private talk.
threads.quote: Barbatos already tracked her down.

threads.claim: Miles is disoriented and cannot recall the battle, hinting he is under the imposters' influence.
threads.quote: No! I... Argh! My head... It hurts...

threads.claim: Diluc suspects Kaeya of hidden motives because Kaeya never appears nervous.
threads.quote: No. You weren't nervous enough.

threads.claim: Varka hides a secret stash of drinks, but the location is cut off before it is revealed.
threads.quote: Oh, and I still owe you for those drinks, don't I? Just take it from my stash.

threads.claim: The Tripartite Conference is reconvened to make Albedo's new request.
threads.quote: so I need the conference to convene once again.

threads.claim: The events of the trial and the monster attack were all part of a plan set up in advance.
threads.quote: Second, the events of the past few days were all part of a plan.

threads.claim: Durin's heart keeps beating after death, so he will eventually return to life.
threads.quote: Albedo: Durin's heart has continued to beat ever since the day he died.

threads.claim: Albedo removes Durin's core so the dragon's body should finally die for good.
threads.quote: Albedo: This time, Durin's body should finally die for good.

threads.claim: Albedo claims alchemy can turn Mini Durin into a human.
threads.quote: Mini Durin: Albedo said he can use alchemy to turn me into a human.

threads.claim: Mini Durin now appears in human form after the ritual.
threads.quote: Paimon: Really? So... Mini Durin looks like a human now?

threads.claim: Mini Durin doubts whether a true self exists without a complete soul.
threads.quote: Maybe, without a complete soul, there was never really a "me" to begin with...

threads.claim: Mini Durin and Albedo are the only two alchemical creations living in human form.
threads.quote: Mini Durin: We will be the only two of our kind in the whole world — alchemical creations allowed to live in human form.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir devoured Naberius, the Ruler of Life, and found some peace.
threads.quote: Albedo: Since devouring Naberius, it would seem she has finally found a modicum of peace.

threads.claim: Naberius is not gone, because Rhinedottir and Naberius are now one.
threads.quote: Albedo: As for the "Ruler of Life," all I truly know is this: Naberius is not gone.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir sent Albedo to Mondstadt to find the truth of the world.
threads.quote: Albedo: A long time ago, she sent me to Mondstadt, with the instruction to complete a task of monumental importance: to find the truth of the world.

threads.claim: The Hexenzirkel gave the Traveler a mysterious item whose secret will be revealed later.
threads.quote: Venti: The Hexenzirkel wants you to have this. It contains something entirely one of a kind — a secret of sorts.

introduced.name: Yanfei
introduced.how: Liyue legal adviser secretly working at The Chasm
introduced.quote: Doubt it, Yanfei is a legal adviser, after all.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: self-declared boss of the Arataki Gang, from Inazuma
introduced.quote: Of course I'm the boss. To the four corners of Teyvat, there is only one boss of Hanamizaka's legendary Arataki Gang. Me!

introduced.name: Kuki Shinobu
introduced.how: Arataki Gang member who handles most of the gang's work
introduced.quote: Hey there, I'm with the Arataki Gang, Kuki Shinobu. Nice to meet you!

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: Itto's gang from Inazuma, with Shinobu as its capable member
introduced.quote: Let me introduce you to Shinobu, the pride and joy of the Arataki Gang!

introduced.name: Yelan
introduced.how: mysterious Liyue official who monitors The Chasm
introduced.quote: This is Yelan. Liyue's uh... Well, let's just say she works in the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the government office Yelan works for
introduced.quote: This is Yelan. Liyue's uh... Well, let's just say she works in the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Tongwen Academy
introduced.how: Liyue school where Shinobu studied law
introduced.quote: Yes, I studied law at the Tongwen Academy in Liyue.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: Inazuma travel restriction that was recently lifted and stranded Shinobu at home
introduced.quote: You know that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted recently in Inazuma, right?

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a mysterious Liyue area sealed off for years after a mining accident
introduced.quote: The Chasm is regarded as a mysterious area in Liyue. It was sealed off for years due to a mining accident.

introduced.name: Chasm Nail
introduced.how: a mysterious nail-like structure at the bottom of The Chasm that the group returns to investigate
introduced.quote: return to where they found the mysterious Chasm Nail.

introduced.name: Fantastic Compass
introduced.how: a magical device sought in the will, lost in The Chasm
introduced.quote: I came to The Chasm in search of the Fantastic Compass, which is mentioned in the will.

introduced.name: Ushi
introduced.how: auxiliary member of the Arataki Gang who can sense spirits and direction
introduced.quote: This is Ushi, an auxiliary member of the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Bosacius
introduced.how: Xiao's missing brother-in-arms who may have been in The Chasm
introduced.quote: he is looking for his missing brother-in-arms, Bosacius

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: former Geo Archon who knew of Xiao's trip into The Chasm
introduced.quote: thus making the former Geo Archon aware of the trip.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: illusory labyrinth-like trial spaces the group must clear
introduced.quote: They enter the Domain within and explore it.

introduced.name: bake-danuki
introduced.how: Inazuma legend of a trickster that traps travelers in circles
introduced.quote: There's a legend in Inazuma about a merchant who was tricked by a bake-danuki one evening and kept circling around the same place the whole night.

introduced.name: exorcism catalyst
introduced.how: the compass is a device made to repel demons with human magic and adepti power
introduced.quote: Yanfei realized that from the compass is an exorcism catalyst made to repel demons using human's magic art and adepti's power combined.

introduced.name: Yelan
introduced.how: Qixing agent who serves Ningguang and handles Liyue's biggest secrets
introduced.quote: I serve Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Qixing. The scope of my work includes some of Liyue's biggest secrets.

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: powerful Liyue figure who would silence anyone prying into her secrets
introduced.quote: She's someone who won't let you walk out of The Chasm alive if she finds out that you're prying into her secrets.

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: group of officials in Liyue led by Ningguang as Tianquan
introduced.quote: I serve Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Qixing.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: gang where members enjoy total freedom and roam the streets
introduced.quote: Though the list of annoying things to deal with is practically endless, I am totally free in the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: nation whose dark beasts invaded Teyvat 500 years ago
introduced.quote: 500 years ago, a wave of dark beasts from Khaenri'ah attacked the seven nations of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Liyue army that held the frontline near The Chasm in the old war
introduced.quote: Under Rex Lapis's command, the Millelith fought hard to hold the frontline near The Chasm.

introduced.name: Oni
introduced.how: demon-like beings that people drive away by throwing beans
introduced.quote: People throw beans to drive out oni. Boss is an oni, so they throw beans at him to get rid of him.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: shrine where Kuki's family wants her to work as a shrine maiden
introduced.quote: I've already found you a perfectly good job as a shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

introduced.name: Kuki's mother
introduced.how: strict parent who wants Kuki to become a shrine maiden in Inazuma
introduced.quote: That voice was my mother...

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: sealed underground area with hidden secrets, recently unsealed
introduced.quote: The day The Chasm was unsealed, I put in a request to be transferred here so I could finally learn the truth of what happened back then.

introduced.name: Domain as chaotic space
introduced.how: the domain is a space where time and space are thrown into chaos
introduced.quote: This is a place where time and space are thrown into chaos.

introduced.name: Spatial rift
introduced.how: small rift where separate spaces intersect, letting sound through
introduced.quote: It's a spatial rift!

introduced.name: Bosacius
introduced.how: Xiao's missing fellow Yaksha, the eldest of the Five, who vanished underground and whose body was never found
introduced.quote: But Bosacius was the eldest of us. He once told us, as Yakshas we will experience countless wars.

introduced.name: Yakshas
introduced.how: Yakshas handle god's remains and become tainted by karma, which drives them toward madness
introduced.quote: Yakshas deal with god's remains all the time, and we become tainted by karma.

introduced.name: Five Yakshas
introduced.how: Bosacius led the Five Yakshas under Rex Lapis's command
introduced.quote: Xiao: Bosacius was the leader of the Five Yakshas under Rex Lapis's command. He could control Electro energy.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Its beasts invaded The Chasm five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: Xiao: Did you know that five hundred years ago, the beasts of Khaenri'ah invaded The Chasm?

introduced.name: Fantastic Compass
introduced.how: A large seal device that sealed this domain off from The Chasm and can be reactivated by a mortal and an adeptus together
introduced.quote: Yanfei: Look at that huge disc in the distance... Hold on, is that the Fantastic Compass?

introduced.name: Boyang
introduced.how: Yelan's ancestor, a thaumaturge who fought in The Chasm and never returned
introduced.quote: Yelan: Boyang was... one of my ancestors. The one who didn't make it back.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Soldiers who went to The Chasm and stayed behind; their letters were found in the domain
introduced.quote: Yelan: It looks like these were letters written by the Millelith soldiers who stayed here.

introduced.name: last will and testament
introduced.how: A written final wish that adepti and mortals leave so others will carry it out after they die
introduced.quote: It's known as a last will and testament.

introduced.name: Pervases
introduced.how: A younger Yaksha who died in the Archon War, honored by a temple built in his memory
introduced.quote: Xiao: The temple up ahead was built to remember Pervases.

introduced.name: Note of Unknown Origin
introduced.how: A written record of the soldiers' fate, left in the domain by Boyang
introduced.quote: (Yelan shares the content of Note of Unknown Origin with everyone.)

introduced.name: Ruin Serpent
introduced.how: A giant snake outside the domain that is a remnant of Khaenri'ahn civilization and is weak to crystals
introduced.quote: Yelan: That snake is probably a remnant of Khaenri'ahn civilization...

introduced.name: Alatus
introduced.how: Xiao's yaksha name, and Menogias's name is General Kapisas
introduced.quote: Xiao: I am Alatus, and Menogias is General Kapisas.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah! Oh, it's Xiao!

assumed.name: Oni
assumed.quote: It's the one and oni Itto.

assumed.name: Lavender Melon
assumed.quote: Flying Lavender Melon? Ohhh that's it, Paimon's mad!

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: It just so happens that Madame Ping gave me some nice tea.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: as she works for Ningguang and thus is privy to many Liyue secrets.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: All these twists and turns remind Paimon of the adepti domains we've been to before.

assumed.name: The Abyss and the Traveler's missing sibling
assumed.quote: only to find themselves in the darkness of the Abyss that took their sibling away.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: they find Yelan and the Fatui, who the two easily dispatch.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: That sounds like Xiao! Could he be in trouble?

assumed.name: Arataki Itto
assumed.quote: Yo yo, thought I heard you chatting over here.

assumed.name: Ushi
assumed.quote: Ushi, you sure you can't find a way back to that door again?

assumed.name: Lady Guuji
assumed.quote: From what we know about Lady Guuji, it seems being a shrine maiden is a pretty cushy job.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Under Rex Lapis's command, the Millelith fought hard to hold the frontline near The Chasm.

assumed.name: The Abyss
assumed.quote: The darkness of the Abyss that took my twin away.

assumed.name: Traveler's twin
assumed.quote: The darkness of the Abyss that took my twin away.

assumed.name: Yakshas
assumed.quote: Is a yaksha who never lowers his guard capable of having dreams?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: The whole reason I came to study in Liyue was because I didn't want to become a shrine maiden.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: What are people from Inazuma doing in a place like this anyway?

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: But he is an adeptus, this kind of situation should be no trouble for him.

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Yanfei: Traveler, it looks like the Conqueror of Demons is awake.

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Yanfei: Yelan, you're back.

assumed.name: Arataki Itto
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Did someone say a strong enough strike can break us outta this place?

assumed.name: Arataki Gang
assumed.quote: Whenever we get into an argument in the Arataki Gang, he always goes and does something shocking to calm everyone down.

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Yanfei: Madame Ping says that you usually base yourself at Wangshu Inn to guard the main road through Dihua Marsh.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Xiao: I wonder what Rex Lapis would think... if he saw what had become of the First Yaksha.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Zhongli: ...This trip may be dangerous

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: Neither of them had Visions, so they wouldn't have been able to resist its effects for very long.

assumed.name: The Abyss
assumed.quote: Yelan: It has the feel of the Abyss.

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: Xiao: Pervases died in the Archon War thousands of years ago.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: how about you let me take you to Liyue Harbor for some sightseeing and a proper meal?

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I promise I'll take good care of your friends from Inazuma.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: now I feel like a million Mora.

threads.claim: The Chasm was sealed off after a mining accident, hiding whatever lies beneath it.
threads.quote: It was sealed off for years due to a mining accident.

threads.claim: The domain beneath The Chasm is very old, having existed for a long time.
threads.quote: This domain must have existed for quite some time now.

threads.claim: Yanfei is hiding her presence at The Chasm for reasons tied to a secret mission.
threads.quote: If anyone happens to ask about me or my present whereabouts, just tell them you haven't seen me!

threads.claim: Yelan warns that The Chasm holds secrets the group should not pursue.
threads.quote: You didn't see anything, you didn't hear anything, and you're not gonna ask any questions.

threads.claim: A Fantastic Compass was lost in The Chasm after being given to someone ambitious.
threads.quote: I came to The Chasm in search of the Fantastic Compass, which is mentioned in the will.

threads.claim: The compass was used before, and its hidden contents are revealed to concern a past figure.
threads.quote: Yelan activates the compass and discovers that someone had used it before.

threads.claim: Boyang's fate is hidden inside the compass and is unknown to the group.
threads.quote: Yelan informs the group that the only thing hidden inside was about Boyang's fate

threads.claim: Xiao is searching for someone who may be trapped inside The Chasm.
threads.quote: ...I'm looking for someone.

threads.claim: Xiao is searching for his missing brother-in-arms Bosacius, believed to be inside The Chasm.
threads.quote: he is looking for his missing brother-in-arms, Bosacius

threads.claim: Bosacius is confirmed to be the Nameless Yaksha who took part in the Chasm events.
threads.quote: confirming Xiao's suspicions that Bosacius was the Nameless Yaksha that participated in the Chasm.

threads.claim: The domain is a chaotic space with its own rules that might be turned against it.
threads.quote: She theorizes that the area must be a chaotic space where normal logic does not apply

threads.claim: Xiao plans to spend his remaining power to save the group, staying behind himself.
threads.quote: Xiao proposed that he'll used up his powers to get the group back to the surface at the cost of him being left behind

threads.claim: Zhongli was informed of Xiao's plan in advance and arrives to rescue him.
threads.quote: thus making the former Geo Archon aware of the trip.

threads.claim: The Traveler's missing sibling is linked to the Abyss, which the domain draws on.
threads.quote: only to find themselves in the darkness of the Abyss that took their sibling away.

threads.claim: The domain is a chaotic space where time and space are thrown into disorder.
threads.quote: This is a place where time and space are thrown into chaos.

threads.claim: The players' bodies are suspended in time, which is why they feel no hunger or fatigue.
threads.quote: And we don't feel hungry because the state of our bodies is suspended.

threads.claim: The domain seems to change to target the party and may read their minds.
threads.quote: It's constantly changing, and its changes seem to be targeted at us.

threads.claim: The door shows whatever the person behind it fears most.
threads.quote: It shows us whatever we fear the most.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the door leads back to Inazuma.
threads.quote: The question is, does this door lead to Inazuma?

threads.claim: A spatial rift lets separate spaces intersect and carry sound and contact between them.
threads.quote: It's a spatial rift!

threads.claim: Xiao's soul is sullied by darkness that is harmful to mortals.
threads.quote: The darkness that sullies my soul is harmful to mortals.

threads.claim: Xiao is injured and warns that something is wrong with the domain.
threads.quote: Something's wrong with this domain... Leave, now! Get out of there!

threads.claim: Xiao was fighting an unknown opponent in another space.
threads.quote: Don't make me... fight you!

threads.claim: It is surprising that a yaksha like Xiao can dream.
