threads.quote: Is a yaksha who never lowers his guard capable of having dreams?

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah sent a monster invasion 500 years ago that Liyue fought and that left a mystery behind.
threads.quote: 500 years ago, a wave of dark beasts from Khaenri'ah attacked the seven nations of Teyvat.

threads.claim: Liyue's biggest secrets lie within the scope of Yelan's work for Ningguang.
threads.quote: I serve Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Qixing. The scope of my work includes some of Liyue's biggest secrets.

threads.claim: Yelan transferred to The Chasm to learn what happened there after it was unsealed.
threads.quote: The day The Chasm was unsealed, I put in a request to be transferred here so I could finally learn the truth of what happened back then.

threads.claim: The Abyss took the Traveler's twin away, and the Traveler is haunted by it.
threads.quote: The darkness of the Abyss that took my twin away.

threads.claim: Kuki values complete freedom over a settled, conventional life.
threads.quote: I need complete freedom and space.

threads.claim: Yanfei learned Yelan's method for breaking illusions and used it to find the rift.
threads.quote: I secretly learned Yelan's illusion-breaking method without her knowing.

threads.claim: Bosacius's fate is unknown because his body was never found, and Xiao has sought him out.
threads.quote: But Bosacius's body is the only one that was never found.

threads.claim: Bosacius is found fighting underground as a mad illusion, and his fate is confirmed.
threads.quote: Bosacius: I am Bosacius

threads.claim: A brave yaksha fought in the Khaenri'ah war without anyone knowing his name.
threads.quote: But no one knew the yaksha's name.

threads.claim: The nameless yaksha of the legends is revealed to be Bosacius.
threads.quote: Xiao: He fought here. The nameless yaksha from the legends... it was him.

threads.claim: Karma from god's remains drives yakshas toward madness over time.
threads.quote: Over time, it inevitably drives us to madness...

threads.claim: Bosacius and Boyang sealed off the domain together using the Fantastic Compass.
threads.quote: Yelan: That's their voices from when they made the seal. Bosacius and my ancestor... they sealed off this space at the top together.

threads.claim: The Fantastic Compass only fully activates when a mortal and an adeptus combine their powers.
threads.quote: Yanfei: Only when a mortal and an adeptus combine their powers can the Fantastic Compass be fully activated.

threads.claim: The domain reads minds and turns memories and wishes into illusions.
threads.quote: the whole time, it's been reading our minds and responding to us in the form of illusions.

threads.claim: A voice in the domain says it will record what it sees in the compass, and it is unclear who it is.
threads.quote: Mysterious Voice: ...I will record... thing I see... and... in the... compass...

threads.claim: The Ruin Serpent is a remnant of Khaenri'ah whose opposing force may have caused the ground to split.
threads.quote: Yelan: That snake is probably a remnant of Khaenri'ahn civilization...

threads.claim: Yelan suspects her arrow and the crystal set off an opposing reaction that split the ground.
threads.quote: Yelan: If so... I'm extremely sorry, everyone. It looks like I might be the one responsible for all of this.

threads.claim: The Abyss causes emptiness and is connected to the Traveler's memory.
threads.quote: Traveler: Of emptiness. That's the power of the Abyss.

threads.claim: The Traveler's twin was taken by the Abyss.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...That the Abyss took my twin away.

threads.claim: Xiao's past as one of the Five Yakshas is revealed, including their roles and names.
threads.quote: Xiao: Bosacius was the leader of the Five Yakshas under Rex Lapis's command. He could control Electro energy.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis, appearing as Zhongli, saved Xiao from the collapsing platform.
threads.quote: Xiao: If Rex Lapis hadn't saved me in that moment, I don't think I would've been able to escape.

threads.claim: Xiao accepts that the fallen are heroes and resolves that heroes will look out for each other.
threads.quote: Xiao: I accept your advice. From this day on, heroes will always look out for each other.

introduced.name: Petrichor
introduced.how: a town whose residents are dazed and mad, with a mountain ruin behind it
introduced.quote: I never imagined I'd find nothing but dazed stares and mad ramblings all around.

introduced.name: Este
introduced.how: introduces himself as a Daydream Club member and the only one present
introduced.quote: Anyway, allow me to reintroduce myself. Call me Este. I'm a member of the town's Daydream Club — I'm the only member present right now, though.

introduced.name: Daydream Club
introduced.how: a town club that has researched hypnosis
introduced.quote: The Daydream Club has researched hypnosis before, but something like this is far, far beyond our capabilities.

introduced.name: Bellringer
introduced.how: the clock tower bellringer who guides travelers to the Eternal City
introduced.quote: I am the bellringer at the intersection clock tower — the guide that welcomes travelers to the Eternal City.

introduced.name: Osse
introduced.how: Ouranides of Ouranopolis, a spirit-keeper of the ancient realm in cat form
introduced.quote: "Ouranides of Ouranopolis" is my name, a spirit-keeper of the ancient realm.

introduced.name: Remus
introduced.how: the Sebastos and Imperator whom enemies call the Dark Lord
introduced.quote: That is indeed a blasphemous title with which they besmirch the Sebastos Remus, our mighty Imperator.

introduced.name: Symphony
introduced.how: a power that takes souls and grants borrowed identities and memories
introduced.quote: because the "Symphony" has temporarily granted them identities and memories to fill the void left behind.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: a Symphony-linked force that weaves the path of fate
introduced.quote: "Phobos" shall weave the path of fate on our behalf, leading us forward on the path of justice.

introduced.name: Fortuna
introduced.how: fate, whose curse binds the people and their souls
introduced.quote: our souls are still bound by the shackles of "Fortuna."

introduced.name: Faded Castle
introduced.how: a legendary castle whose true form lies deep underwater, not the surface ruins
introduced.quote: These are but scraps on the surface. The true castle lies deeper underwater.

introduced.name: Music box
introduced.how: lets anyone play the Symphony by placing a score in it
introduced.quote: As long as you place the score into the music box, the box shall play its tune all on its own.

introduced.name: Scores
introduced.how: the harp strings from the ruins are the recorded scores of the Symphony
introduced.quote: Remember the strings we got from the harp in the ruins? Those were, in truth, the "scores" on which the "Symphony" was recorded.

introduced.name: Seal
introduced.how: a seal blocking the hidden path to the ancient realm beneath a spring
introduced.quote: The road to the ancient realm lies beneath this spring you see before you. I have caused the seal on the hidden path to manifest.

introduced.name: Machimos
introduced.how: where the townsfolk went, under the Sebastos's protection
introduced.quote: Why, everyone has gone to Machimos already. I imagine that they now dwell under the protection of the Sebastos.

introduced.name: Golden Troupe (Faction)
introduced.how: a group of adventurers who came looking for the Faded Castle and destroyed its statues
introduced.quote: And whether it's because the impression the name "Golden Troupe" conjures up is nothing more than poetic imagery

assumed.name: Marechaussee Hunters
assumed.quote: Your valor would not know shame, even should it stand in the company of the Marechaussee Hunters of old.

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: for the sake of Paimon's tummy-tum, stand tall and move with haste to buy her some Fonta!

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: Of course, eventually, even the Court of Fontaine will be consumed if the "chosen hero" cannot restore harmony to the chaotic melody.

assumed.name: Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: One of the Yae Publishing House's novels, the ones with the "He Was Our Companion in the Last Life, but Only He Inherited the Memories" kind of plot?

assumed.name: Fontainians
assumed.quote: With his aid, we infiltrated the Dark Lord's fell keep, and reclaimed the treasures he and his minions plundered from us Fontainians!

assumed.name: Golems
assumed.quote: The Dark Lord's golems are each mighty beyond measure.

assumed.name: Prophecy of Fontaine
assumed.quote: That prophecy, then, Imperator? It is precisely to prevent it from happening, to fight against inevitable fate, that we are here today.

threads.claim: The chaotic Symphony must be stilled to save the lost souls, leaving its nature an open question.
threads.quote: We must still the chaotic "Symphony" if we are to save the lost souls.

threads.claim: The townsfolk's souls were taken and their bodies filled with Symphony-given memories, and restoring them is unresolved.
threads.quote: The inhabitants of Petrichor have had their souls taken away.

threads.claim: Anyone can operate the Symphony through the music box, raising the risk of misuse.
threads.quote: Anyway, even those who lack any musical knowledge can freely operate the power of the "Symphony" using this box.

threads.claim: The harp strings from the ruins are revealed to be the Symphony's recorded scores.
threads.quote: Those were, in truth, the "scores" on which the "Symphony" was recorded.

threads.claim: Este suspects something abnormal inside the ruins caused the townsfolk's hypnotic state.
threads.quote: My hypothesis is that something abnormal has occurred within the ruins.

threads.claim: Remus is called a Dark Lord by some and the Sebastos by others, so his true identity is an open question.
threads.quote: Oh, so they're both the same Remus!

threads.claim: The Traveler is addressed as Imperator and seems tied to Remus and a past promise, a hint of a past life.
threads.quote: You're finally awake, Imperator.

threads.claim: A past promise between the Traveler and Remus is hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: Do you still remember our promise...

threads.claim: Fortuna's curse is said to be upon the people and the Traveler, an open question about fate.
threads.quote: The curse of Fortuna is upon your people, and upon you.

threads.claim: Remuria is named as a people or realm that will be freed from fate, left unexplained.
threads.quote: and soon, Remuria... No, all of humanity, will be freed from the unconscionable tyranny of fate

threads.claim: Este may have been turned into a golem after the bandits left him behind.
threads.quote: Like as not we'd all have been turned into golems already, just like Este probably was

threads.claim: Este escaped the ruins alive and reports that the bandits destroyed the statues.
threads.quote: Ah, I see you escaped with your life! Fabulous!

threads.claim: The Golden Troupe bandits destroyed statues and boxed them up in the ruins.
threads.quote: they began destroying statues and stuffing them into boxes like people possessed!

threads.claim: The golems may climb up from the underwater ruins, so their origin is an open question.
threads.quote: Perhaps that golem you defeated earlier climbed up from here.

threads.claim: The legend of the Faded Castle is real, but the true castle is underwater rather than the surface ruins.
threads.quote: These are but scraps on the surface. The true castle lies deeper underwater.

threads.claim: A place even deeper underwater is hinted to hold lingering Symphony power.
threads.quote: It was once an entrance to a place deeper underwater still, where the power of the "Symphony" yet lingers.

threads.claim: Osse cannot fully control the cat body, and its true nature stays unclear.
threads.quote: It appears that I cannot command this body as I wish, to the extent that bestial behaviors may even overbear me from time to time

threads.claim: Este recognizes the cat's collar as an accessory he has seen before, a hint about the cat's origin.
threads.quote: Hmm. How odd. That, err, collar? Pendant? I could swear I've seen that accessory before...

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests they may be the ones dreaming, leaving reality versus dream an open question.
threads.quote: Who knows? We could be the ones dreaming.

introduced.name: Scylla
introduced.how: A soul dwelling within Ichor, a former Dragonborn who once led vishaps and was given Remus's final symphony
introduced.quote: Scylla: I fear that was not up to me. I am but a soul that dwells within the Ichor, and though that Remus did give me his final symphony...

introduced.name: Symphony
introduced.how: Scattered musical power that can reconstruct the aqueducts and awaken engraved scores
introduced.quote: Scylla: If we can use the power of the scattered Symphony, we can reconstruct the aqueducts as they once were.

introduced.name: Golden Bee
introduced.how: A golden bee that guides the Traveler to the next fragment of the symphony
introduced.quote: Scylla: Follow this Golden Bee forward. It shall guide you to the next fragment of the

introduced.name: Golden Aqueducts
introduced.how: Channels that once carried Phobos's will through Remuria and can open Domus Aurea's gates when reconnected
introduced.quote: Scylla: Once upon a time, the will of Phobos flowed through golden aqueducts into every corner of Remuria.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: A powerful symphonic force whose will once flowed through Remuria and now protects Domus Aurea
introduced.quote: Scylla: Once upon a time, the will of Phobos flowed through golden aqueducts into every corner of Remuria.

introduced.name: Domus Aurea
introduced.how: A palace built from a giant ship, designed as a titanic instrument to broadcast the symphony
introduced.quote: Monsieur Os: Of course. This palace was fashioned from a giant ship. It was designed to be a titanic instrument on which the symphony was to be played.

introduced.name: Boethius
introduced.how: A former Remuria figure who hid in the palace for millennia, mastered Phobos, and now seeks to become a god
introduced.quote: Boethius: Remus proved unworthy to reign supreme from the moment he uttered that perverse command.

introduced.name: Cassiodor
introduced.how: Monsieur Os's true name; one of the new humans Remus crafted, and Boethius's kin and rival
introduced.quote: Boethius: Cassiodor and I... We were new humans crafted by Remus's own hand, and we are the final survivors.

introduced.name: Requiem
introduced.how: Remus's final symphony, an order for Phobos to self-destruct so the stone-bound subjects could be freed
introduced.quote: Scylla: The final symphony Remus gave me, or the Requiem, is an order for the Phobos to self-destruct.

introduced.name: Dragonborn
introduced.how: Scylla's kind, whose strength lies in powerful flesh
introduced.quote: Scylla: The chief strength of Dragonborn lies in our powerful flesh.

assumed.name: Remus
assumed.quote: Remus's will protects this place still, just as I expected.

assumed.name: Remuria
assumed.quote: Boethius: I serve no god, no king. Only mighty Remuria, and our noble ideals.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: I do recall that an envoy from Fontaine was once imprisoned here by Boethius

assumed.name: Petrichor
assumed.quote: Traveler: To save the people of Petrichor...

assumed.name: Initium Iani
assumed.quote: Monsieur Os: And so you betrayed him. You shut the Initium Iani

assumed.name: Faded Castle
assumed.quote: Monsieur Os: Just like those in the Faded Castle, the murals here were painted using the power of the

assumed.name: Ichor
assumed.quote: Scylla: Besides, I could not help you even if I came with you, for I am but a temporary occupant of this Ichor-made body.

assumed.name: Mistress of Waters
assumed.quote: Monsieur Os: They... We once had a choice. So long as we discarded our old grudges, the Mistress of Waters agreed to accept us into a new nation.

assumed.name: Usurper of the Many Waters
assumed.quote: Scylla: You once promised the Usurper of Many Waters that you would use the pure water she granted you

assumed.name: Wonderchime Flowers and Allochromatic Anemones
assumed.quote: (Talk to Monsieur Os by the Wonderchime Flowers, optional)

threads.claim: Boethius gradually mastered Phobos's power over the long millennia he hid in the palace.
threads.quote: Monsieur Os: And over those long years, he gradually mastered the power of Phobos...

threads.claim: Boethius claims Remus was the real traitor who betrayed both the nation and Phobos, contradicting Os.
threads.quote: Boethius: Will you not open your eyes to the truth? It was Remus who betrayed us, betrayed Phobos. That was the true prelude to tragedy.

threads.claim: Remus's plan was to have Phobos self-destruct, freeing his subjects from stone bodies and ending racial barriers.
threads.quote: Scylla: He was to sacrifice himself to unleash the symphony's power, and it would fall to me to control the primordial, savage energies that he would awaken.

threads.claim: The Requiem may release the trapped souls of Remus's former subjects after Phobos is defeated.
threads.quote: Scylla: We can use the Requiem to give their souls release, allowing them to return to the High Sea, to the eternal cycle of life and death.

threads.claim: A mysterious voice offers aid, hinting at an unseen ally inside the symphonic palace.
threads.quote: Someone's Voice: Fear not, I wish to aid you...

threads.claim: The mysterious ally is revealed as Cassiodor, who is Monsieur Os in another form.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: Cassiodor, you mean! I believe you might have met me in the Sebastos's memories, though I suppose this is our first time meeting in this manner.

threads.claim: Scylla hints at past regrets she hopes to amend once Boethius is defeated.
threads.quote: Scylla: When that time comes, perhaps I too shall have the chance to make amends for my past regrets.

threads.claim: Scylla joins the fight to make amends for millennia of regret.
threads.quote: Scylla: Indeed. That is why I have come here with you. To make amends for millennia of regret.

threads.claim: Boethius plans a ritual in Domus Aurea to take on flesh in a mighty body, gathering scattered symphony into it.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: He has prepared a mighty form for himself in the real world, and plans to initiate a ritual within Domus Aurea that will have him

threads.claim: The Traveler is an exception that Phobos's melody and Boethius cannot influence.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: You are the exception to all that is planned.

threads.claim: Remus's ideal was for all humans to become gods and seize their own destinies.
threads.quote: Boethius: But ah, Cassiodor, you forget! Was Remus's ideal not for all humans to become gods? To seize their own destinies?

threads.claim: If Boethius gains reality-surpassing power, Fontaine could revert to its appearance thousands of years ago.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: When that happens, his delusions will replace the real world, and Fontaine will revert to its appearance from thousands of years ago.

threads.claim: Reconnecting the broken aqueducts may let the Traveler open Domus Aurea's gates.
threads.quote: Scylla: Though these paths and pipes have been destroyed, if you can connect the section that lies before you once more...

threads.claim: The Traveler reconnects the waterways, restoring the path forward.
threads.quote: Paimon: Alrighty, looks like the waterways are reconnected!

introduced.name: Eggie
introduced.how: A mysterious kuuhenki who lost memories after waking, was rescued by Columbina on the moon, and lured the Traveler and Paimon onto the spaceship
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ugh... You tricked us, and that makes you a bad egg in Paimon's books! From now on, she's gonna call you, uhm... Eggie!

introduced.name: Silvermoon Hall
introduced.how: A place of healing where Columbina took the kuuhenki to recover
introduced.quote: Mysterious Kuuhenki: She took me to... a place of healing...

introduced.name: Dragon
introduced.how: Makers of the ancient moon base and spaceship, with Secret Source Automatons and advanced technology
introduced.quote: It looks like the base and the spaceship were made by the dragons.

introduced.name: Archaeolune Ripples
introduced.how: A power fired at objects to activate devices, pushing them aside, and detonated to make objects weightless
introduced.quote: Hold to launch Archaeolune Ripples. Press again to detonate the ripples, making objects within its range weightless.

introduced.name: Archaeolune Energy
introduced.how: A power Columbina bestows on the Traveler, letting them activate ancient mechanisms
introduced.quote: {{Tutorial|Archaeolune Energy and Archaeolune Ripples

introduced.name: Three Moons
introduced.how: Three moons represented by spheres around a central sphere in the mechanism; Trilune coordinates can be viewed through the terminal
introduced.quote: surrounded by three other spheres representing the Three Moons.

introduced.name: Main Control Hall
introduced.how: The base room where moon landing preparations are made, reached by a route map
introduced.quote: Please proceed to the Main Control Hall for moon landing preparations.

introduced.name: Backup Power Generator
introduced.how: The device that must be activated to restore the base's power
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh. This thing... doesn't really look very mechanical, but given where we found it, it must be the key to getting the power on somehow.

introduced.name: Dunanna Forward Station
introduced.how: An underground ruin station where the search for Columbina leads, containing a disassembled mechanism
introduced.quote: They follow her to the Dunanna Forward Station and search for her.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey! Columbina! Where are you going!?

assumed.name: Frost Moon
assumed.quote: Traveler: (But Columbina has taken me to the Frost Moon before... Why would she need this device?)

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why's she here? Paimon thought she'd be at Silvermoon Hall...

assumed.name: Nicole's telepathy
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...What's wrong? Are you trying to use telepathy, like Nicole? Just so you know, we aren't hearing anything!

assumed.name: Secret Source Automatons of the dragons
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! This... looks like one of the dragons' Secret Source Automatons! Could this place have something to do with them?

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? That sounds a lot like Phlogiston... Could this be dragon technology?

assumed.name: Dawn Winery
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's like going out for a bit and coming back to find your little house has suddenly turned into the Dawn Winery!

assumed.name: Kuuhenki
assumed.quote: Paimon: Where are those kuuhenki going?

assumed.name: Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Shimura's
assumed.quote: Paimon: *sob*... Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Shimura's... Will we ever meet again?

threads.claim: Columbina is silent and unresponsive, suggesting something has gone wrong with her.
threads.quote: Paimon: Agh, she's gone too far out. She can't hear us.

threads.claim: The Columbina the party has been following is revealed to be a black kuuhenki impostor, so who is real remains open.
threads.quote: Traveler: That's not Columbina!

threads.claim: Eggie is a kuuhenki who lost most of its memories and says it belongs on the moon, its identity still unclear.
threads.quote: Mysterious Kuuhenki: When I woke up... I was very weak... I forgot... many things...

threads.claim: Eggie has a mission on the moon that it has forgotten, hinting at a larger purpose.
threads.quote: Mysterious Kuuhenki: ...There lies... my mission...

threads.claim: The moon base and spaceship were built by the dragons, raising questions about their role in the ancient moon.
threads.quote: It looks like the base and the spaceship were made by the dragons.

threads.claim: Columbina grants the Traveler an Archaeolune Energy power the Traveler has never seen her use, deepening the mystery of her abilities.
threads.quote: Traveler: (And the power she just gave me is completely new. I've never seen her use it before...)

threads.claim: The Trilune terminal only connects to the Frost Moon, and the reason the moon coordinates are needed remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa, it actually found the Frost Moon... But why would they need those coordinates anyways?

threads.claim: Eggie claims Columbina rescued it on the moon, implying Columbina has a past connection to the moon that is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Mysterious Kuuhenki: Columbina... rescued me... on the moon...

introduced.name: Freda
introduced.how: Logistics Company knight who handles all future supplies for the shop
introduced.quote: My name is Freda. I'm a knight from the Logistics Company.

introduced.name: Logistics Company
introduced.how: Knights' branch that provides all future supplies for the potion shop
introduced.quote: And the Logistics Company is handling the provision of all future supplies.

introduced.name: Alchemy research gap
introduced.how: Knights' alchemy research stays in labs, so the public knows little about alchemy
introduced.quote: But, most of that research has been carried out in a laboratory setting. The public's knowledge of alchemy is quite minimal.

introduced.name: Bio-alchemical processing
introduced.how: A method that infuses herbs with new effects and properties
introduced.quote: Bio-alchemical processing can infuse herbs with different effects and properties.

introduced.name: Potion shop initiative
introduced.how: Knights open a public potion shop to share alchemy and gather feedback
introduced.quote: So, I thought the best way to do that would be to open up a potion shop!

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you, cutie! To what do I owe the honor of your visit?

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: It's been a while since we last visited the Knights of Favonius!

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Paimon wonders what Jean and Lisa have been up to recently.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: The last time I was this consumed with research must have been way back at the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Albedo and Sucrose
assumed.quote: Albedo and Sucrose provided the ingredients and equipment needed to brew the potions.

assumed.name: Acting Grand Master
assumed.quote: My orders from the Acting Grand Master are to support your business in any way I can.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: The owner of a Mondstadt flower shop is looking to have their fresh flowers more lushly and extend the time they are in bloom.

threads.claim: The Knights' alchemy research has little contact with ordinary people, which the potion shop is meant to address.
threads.quote: But, most of that research has been carried out in a laboratory setting. The public's knowledge of alchemy is quite minimal.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects Lisa is handing her work to the Traveler and Paimon, a doubt the text leaves unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon still thinks you're just looking for a way to pawn off your work...

threads.claim: Different herbs used in brewing change the effects of the resulting potion.
threads.quote: Using different herbs in the brewing process will, in turn, alter the effects of the potion.

threads.claim: The Acting Grand Master is directing Knights' support for the Traveler and Paimon's business, a figure not yet explained.
threads.quote: My orders from the Acting Grand Master are to support your business in any way I can.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon's heroic exploits are widely known among the Knights and are spreading across the land.
threads.quote: Having heard of the Traveler and Paimon's heroic story, Freda excitedly introduced herself to them

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Hydro Archon, who introduces herself as Focalors and welcomes the pair to Fontaine
introduced.quote: I, Focalors, hereby welcome you to the nation of Hydro and acknowledge the value and significance of your trip.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Chief Justice of Fontaine's court, described as just and honorable
introduced.quote: And as for your worries about whether the cases are treated with due reverence, we have the absolutely just and honorable Chief Justice Neuvillette...

introduced.name: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale
introduced.how: a machine made by the Archon that helps ensure fair trials
introduced.quote: As well as the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, a machine created by the Archon.

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: Fontaine's Court of Justice, which doubles as the opera house
introduced.quote: Fontaine Court of Justice is called the Opera Epiclese, or more commonly known as just

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: a magician who introduces himself and his sister Lynette
introduced.quote: Ah, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Lyney, and this is my sister, Lynette.

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: Lyney's sister and magic assistant who rarely speaks
introduced.quote: Haha, I just know a few simple tricks I use to make a living. Lynette is my assistant.

introduced.name: Prophecy of Fontaine
introduced.how: a prophecy that everyone is born with sin and the water will rise to drown the people
introduced.quote: It says that every person in Fontaine is born with

introduced.name: Magic Pocket
introduced.how: a magical item with huge capacity used to help people move their belongings
introduced.quote: This is a magical item known as a

introduced.name: Hydro Dragon
introduced.how: a legendary creature said to have lived in Fontaine, whose weeping causes rain
introduced.quote: He tells Paimon he heard story that the Hydro Dragon used to live in Fontaine.

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: a reporter for The Steambird who covers the opera house trials
introduced.quote: I'm Charlotte, a reporter for The Steambird.

introduced.name: Aquabus
introduced.how: a water transport linking key locations around Fontaine
introduced.quote: It allows people to travel between several key locations around Fontaine.

introduced.name: Serial disappearances of young women
introduced.how: a case of girls vanishing over about twenty years, with no one ever found
introduced.quote: That's right. The first missing girl case happened almost twenty years ago.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: an investigation organization whose members include Navia, Silver and Melus
introduced.quote: She introduces herself as Navia, and alongside Silver and Melus, they are members of the Spina di Rosula, an investigation organization.

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: revealed as one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, with Hydro weapons
introduced.quote: Truand then realizes that Childe is actually one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, but Childe suddenly loses control of his Hydro weapons and they vanish.

introduced.name: Arlecchino
introduced.how: also known as the Knave, who believed in the prophecy and leads the House of the Hearth
introduced.quote: Lyney reveals that the Knave, who is also known as Arlecchino, believed in the prophecy.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: a Fatui-linked group that orphans like Lyney and Lynette joined
introduced.quote: They explain that, as orphans, their goals aligned with the House of the Hearth and the Knave.

introduced.name: Indemnitium
introduced.how: a power source made from the trials at the court that runs machines
introduced.quote: Estelle tells her that the machine runs on Indemnitium, a source of power made from the trials at the court.

introduced.name: Champion Duelist
introduced.how: official duelists the accused must beat to have charges dropped before trial
introduced.quote: Childe explains that before going to court, the accused are given one chance to redeem their honor in a duel against a Champion Duelist

introduced.name: Skirk
introduced.how: the teacher who took Childe as an apprentice during his time in the Abyss
introduced.quote: Childe then tells them about his time in the Abyss, including his meeting with Skirk, who took him as an apprentice

introduced.name: Liliane
introduced.how: the woman who was actually the thief and the missing girl, not Halsey
introduced.quote: She confesses to the entire crime and reveals that she is actually Liliane, not Halsey.

introduced.name: Freminet
introduced.how: Lyney introduces his younger brother, a phenomenal diver who is shy
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce you to my little brother, Freminet. He is a phenomenal diver.

introduced.name: Estelle
introduced.how: Workshop owner who makes Magic Pockets and greets the party
introduced.quote: Oh, hello there. New customers? Looking to buy, or do you need something made?

introduced.name: Beaumont Workshop
introduced.how: Workshop where the Magic Pocket materials are delivered to its owner
introduced.quote: Perhaps we could trouble to help us take these materials to the Beaumont Workshop and deliver them to the owner there?

introduced.name: Magic Pockets
introduced.how: Items made from collected materials, ordered by Lyney in bulk
introduced.quote: Ah, these must be for Magic Pockets. I could tell right away, I've already made several orders' worth now.

introduced.name: Indemnitium
introduced.how: Energy produced from trials that powers most of Fontaine's city
introduced.quote: But basically, everything we usually use here in the city is powered by Indemnitium. It's a type of energy that's produced from trials.

introduced.name: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale
introduced.how: Machine that harvests belief in justice during trials and converts it into energy
introduced.quote: When a trial is in session, the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale harvests people's belief in justice, and converts it into energy to be used all around Fontaine.

introduced.name: Pneumousia
introduced.how: A second energy type, not from the Archon, that is unstable and not yet widely usable
introduced.quote: It isn't produced by the power of the Archon, but it is unstable by nature. Even now it still cannot be widely used by civilians.

introduced.name: Fountain of Lucine
introduced.how: Fountain where all of Fontaine's flowing water converges; newlyweds visit to wish for children
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Fountain of Lucine. All the water flowing through Fontaine converges here.

introduced.name: Dragon of Water
introduced.how: Fontaine legend of a dragon whose weeping makes it rain
introduced.quote: It's said that a Dragon of Water once resided in Fontaine. Though we don't know where the dragon went, every time it weeps, the skies will cloud up and pour out rain.

introduced.name: Erinnyes
introduced.how: Island reached by aquabus where the Opera Epiclese stands
introduced.quote: On the day of the performance, just ride the aquabus to the island of Erinnyes.

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: Opera house where trials are held and where the magic show takes place
introduced.quote: It often rains on days when there are trials being held in the opera house, but don't worry, it'll clear up soon enough.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Introduced as Fontaine's Chief Justice, the symbol of justice and honesty
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce you to Fontaine's Chief Justice. That seat is always reserved for him.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Paimon identifies her as the Hydro Archon sitting in the VIP seats
introduced.quote: Huh? Oh, it's Furina, the Hydro Archon. She sure has a smug and satisfied look on her face.

introduced.name: Cowell
introduced.how: Lyney's troupe assistant, found dead in the magic box
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, the person who was in the magic box has been pronounced dead. His name was Cowell, one of the assistants in Lyney's magic troupe.

introduced.name: Skirk
introduced.how: Childe's quiet, mysterious master who trained him after he fell into the abyss
introduced.quote: The one who took me under her wing and taught me was named Skirk.

introduced.name: Childe's abyss fall
introduced.how: Childe fell into an unknown abyss at fourteen, where he learned most of his abilities
introduced.quote: I can't remember if I've ever mentioned it before, but when I was fourteen, I fell into some unknown abyss...

introduced.name: Champion Duelist
introduced.how: Fontaine's system where a criminal may request a duel to defend their honor before trial
introduced.quote: In Fontaine, before a criminal goes to court, they're given one chance to defend their honor by requesting a duel with an official Champion Duelist.

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: Described as the strongest of the Champion Duelists, whom Childe is meeting
introduced.quote: Apparently the one I'm meeting today, Clorinde, is the strongest of the Champion Duelists.

introduced.name: Confrerie of Cabriere
introduced.how: Debt-collecting group that pressures people over Mora owed to Northland Bank
introduced.quote: If Confrerie of Cabriere wants to poach clients from Northland Bank, that's fine, but I'm afraid you still owe the bank a hefty sum of Mora.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: Snezhnaya bank that Childe works for and that has lent money out to clients
introduced.quote: Fine, though the bank told me not to get rough with our clients...

introduced.name: Serial disappearances case
introduced.how: Ongoing case of young women vanishing, which Neuvillette links to the incident
introduced.quote: And there are many indications that it is connected with the case of the serial disappearances of young women.

introduced.name: Esmond
introduced.how: Investigator who warns the Traveler to stay out of the case and walks them through the crime scene
introduced.quote: Listen, I'll be perfectly honest with you... I'd avoid getting mixed up in this whirlpool of a mess if I were you.

introduced.name: Cowell
introduced.how: Lyney's assistant, a recently joined troupe member who was killed by the falling water tank
introduced.quote: The deceased is one of Lyney's assistants, named Cowell.

introduced.name: Halsey
introduced.how: Painter from Fontaine who vanished from the audience seat during the show and has no link to the troupe
introduced.quote: Her name is Halsey. She's a painter from Fontaine who's made a bit of a name for herself.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: Self-introduced president of Spina di Rosula, who joins the investigation and wants to be called Navia
introduced.quote: And I, Navia, have the honor of being its renowned president...

introduced.name: Silver
introduced.how: Navia's attendant who introduces herself
introduced.quote: I'm Silver, her attendant. Pleased to meet you.

introduced.name: Melus
introduced.how: Navia's attendant who handles her daily affairs, introduced by name and role
introduced.quote: And I'm Melus. Demoiselle's various daily needs and affairs are under my purview.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Fontaine group that mediates disputes, protects people and solves puzzles for clients
introduced.quote: From mediating disputes and providing protection, to solving conundrums — you name it, Spina di Rosula does it.

introduced.name: Tristane
introduced.how: Security guard at the opera house entrance who enforces the ban on entering or leaving
introduced.quote: Sorry, but no one can freely enter or exit the opera house at the moment.

introduced.name: Molly
introduced.how: Official assigned to monitor Lyney and Lynette and take notes on them
introduced.quote: Just so you're aware, I will be monitoring your actions and making notes as necessary.

introduced.name: Maurice
introduced.how: Investigator who explains the cordoned-off site, the missing woman's identity and the prior disappearances
introduced.quote: Oh, this location has also been cordoned off because the magic troupe members are currently considered prime suspects.

introduced.name: Esildor
introduced.how: Onlooker with his own theory about the thud heard during the countdown
introduced.quote: I see that you're investigating the area.

introduced.name: Quentin
introduced.how: Investigation team member who reports the faulty random number selector
introduced.quote: The investigation team has some new findings.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: Organization that Furina accuses Lyney and Lynette of belonging to, which the twins later confirm
introduced.quote: Aren't you and Lynette actually from the House of the Hearth?

introduced.name: Oratrice
introduced.how: Machine that hears both sides of a trial and acts as a judge with its own will
introduced.quote: To put it simply, it's as if the Oratrice has its own will, and is a judge in its own right.

introduced.name: Indemnitium
introduced.how: Substance that the Oratrice produces, as explained in passing by Navia
introduced.quote: This is how Indemnitium is produced.

introduced.name: Random number selector
introduced.how: Machine used to pick a random audience member, found to always choose the same seat number
introduced.quote: The machine picks that same number every time.

introduced.name: Box-swap trick
introduced.how: The magic act in which an audience member is moved between two boxes via a tunnel and trolley
introduced.quote: The inner box would descend after the audience member was put inside and be moved along on the trolley

introduced.name: Serial disappearances
introduced.how: Earlier cases of young women vanishing with no link to each other or to the troupe
introduced.quote: Simply put, she wasn't related to the magic troupe at all, which matches the features of the previous serial disappearances.

introduced.name: Voice in the Oratrice core chamber
introduced.how: Lyney reports hearing a voice in the room housing the Oratrice's core, which should have been empty
introduced.quote: As soon as I reached that room and was about to investigate, I heard someone's voice.

introduced.name: Oratrice core
introduced.how: The Oratrice's core is stored in a room beneath the machine in the opera house basement
introduced.quote: During our investigations, we learned that the machine's core is beneath it.

introduced.name: Tunnel vent
introduced.how: Air vent built during tunnel construction that links to the opera house basement
introduced.quote: That air vent was created during the construction of the tunnel specifically to execute this step.

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: Fatui leaders described by Lyney as having varied personalities and goals within a very large organization
introduced.quote: But our organization is very, very large, and the Harbingers have very different personalities and goals.

introduced.name: Liliane
introduced.how: Self-introduction: the woman posing as Halsey is really Liliane, a thief from Mondstadt who stole a ticket
introduced.quote: Firstly, my name isn't Halsey. It's Liliane, and I'm originally from Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Water from the Primordial Sea
introduced.how: Explained as a fluid that dissolves people from Fontaine, with notes on its safe use
introduced.quote: The notes also state that these dissolution properties work exclusively on people from Fontaine. It's likely that Halsey was chosen as some sort of test subject.

introduced.name: Cowell
introduced.how: Revealed as the actual perpetrator of the serial disappearances, who was Lyney's assistant and died in the tunnel
introduced.quote: The actual perpetrator of the serial disappearances, Cowell, selected his next victim from the audience reservation list.

introduced.name: Vaughn
introduced.how: Introduced as a Garde who was secretly Cowell's accomplice and planted evidence against Lyney
introduced.quote: Thank you, Your Honor. We were just inspecting the luggage of the other people involved in this case...

introduced.name: The Knave
introduced.how: Explained as Lyney's 'father' figure who leads the House of the Hearth and recruited him and his sister
introduced.quote: The Knave? The one who controls the House of the Hearth? She's your "father"?

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: Explained as an organization that takes in orphans whose interests align with its goals, and whose members have roots in Fontaine
introduced.quote: The House of the Hearth welcomes you, for your interests align with ours. Here, none will ever betray you.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: Explained as a prison
introduced.quote: He even mentioned the Fortress of Meropide. That's a prison, isn't it?

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: Explained as a power the Knave plans to obtain and use, with Tsaritsa's permission, to break the prophecy
introduced.quote: She has gained permission from the Tsaritsa to first use the Gnosis' power once she obtains it.

introduced.name: Prophecy of Fontaine
introduced.how: Explained as a crisis the House of the Hearth works to break in order to save Fontaine
introduced.quote: She plans to use it to find a way to break the prophecy and save Fontaine.

introduced.name: Lyney and Lynette's noble adoption
introduced.how: Revealed that a noble took in the siblings for Lyney's talent, and that the Knave killed the noble after he gave Lynette away
introduced.quote: All I saw was the moonlit ground covered in blood... and The Knave, standing there in the darkness.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Nahida's consciousness had been trapped by The Doctor, but we followed the clues she left behind to help her!

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Oh, it's Dehya!

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Seeking out The Seven is probably still our best source for information at this point.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Our journey is to find my sibling...

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Could my Vision finally be showing me some favor?

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: I didn't think I'd run into you here in Fontaine. What are the chances!?

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: You didn't want to stay in Snezhnaya?

assumed.name: Venti and Nahida
assumed.quote: Well, Venti and Nahida both said...

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: Oh, yeah! So that means the Hydro Archon relies on the machine to take the energy created by belief and turn it into power for all of Fontaine, right?

assumed.name: Delusion
assumed.quote: Besides, I always have my Delusion in case I need it.

assumed.name: Tonia and Teucer
assumed.quote: The last time I took Tonia and Teucer ice fishing, Teucer said...

assumed.name: Furina and Traveler's first duel
assumed.quote: You know, the Traveler and I already had a duel the first time we met.

assumed.name: Charlotte's earlier mention of the disappearances
assumed.quote: Ah, that's the case that Charlotte mentioned before!

assumed.name: Father
assumed.quote: Everyone is getting busier now that "Father" will be returning soon.

assumed.name: Hydro Vision
assumed.quote: (Childe's Hydro Vision loses its glow)

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: We're Lyney and Lynette's attorneys.

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: We're Lyney and Lynette's attorneys.

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: You must be the traveler that Lady Furina mentioned.

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: Sounds more like you just don't trust the Hydro Archon.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: They're... Fatui?

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Plus Childe is here in Fontaine along with other House operatives

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Lyney's still talking to the Gardes.

assumed.name: Chief Justice
assumed.quote: Yes, after the Chief Justice gave the order, everyone coming in or out must undergo a strict inspection.

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: Paimon thought Neuvillette called the shots!

assumed.name: Prophecy of the nation's crisis
assumed.quote: We must know all we can about this nation's secrets in order to deal with that prophesied crisis.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: by the looks of it, you're not from Fontaine.

assumed.name: Halsey
assumed.quote: but Halsey's disappearance is very real.

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: Now it's time to refute the Hydro Archon's previous reasoning.

assumed.name: Oratrice
assumed.quote: The scales of the Oratrice rebalance

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: it does seem that the famed Fatui is quite the cold-blooded and ruthless organization...

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Gardes, please step into the lounge and examine the personal effects of the deceased, Cowell.

assumed.name: Magic Pockets
assumed.quote: So from small deeds like distributing Magic Pockets to huge schemes like stealing a Gnosis, everything is aimed at dealing with that prophecy...

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: She has gained permission from the Tsaritsa to first use the Gnosis' power once she obtains it.

assumed.name: Chief Justice of Fontaine
assumed.quote: as the Chief Justice of Fontaine, I shall once again repeat the full sequence of events.

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: Lynette was in the magic box onstage the entire time.

assumed.name: Coupon-town
assumed.quote: unless you want to earn yourself a one-way ticket to coupon-town.

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: why don't we return to the Court of Fontaine and head to the Hotel Debord?

threads.claim: Lyney explains a prophecy that every Fontainian is born with sin that only the rising waters can wash away.
threads.quote: No matter how the Nation of Justice holds trial after trial, this sin cannot be absolved.

threads.claim: Lynette hints that the water is swallowing memories and places, and that the people will be swallowed too.
threads.quote: But now the water is gradually swallowing our memories...

threads.claim: Lyney says Fontaine's water levels have actually begun rising in recent years, making the prophecy seem real.
threads.quote: in the last few years, the water levels in Fontaine have actually started rising.

threads.claim: The reason Fontainians are born with sin is unexplained, and only guesses about it exist so far.
threads.quote: Some say that the ancestors of Fontaine stole the power of the seas, and stirred its wrath.

threads.claim: Young women have vanished for about twenty years in a pattern that no suspect has ended.
threads.quote: And ever since, after a period of time, another girl disappears.

threads.claim: Furina claims to know everything about visitors without being told, which raises the question of how she knew they were coming.
threads.quote: All it takes is a flick of my finger for me to know everything about you.

threads.claim: Nahida described the Hydro Archon as having a unique personality, and the Archon's true nature is left unclear.
threads.quote: Nahida said that she has

threads.claim: Fontainians like the Archon but do not revere her, suggesting a gap between her image and public respect.
threads.quote: But they don't appear to revere her.

threads.claim: Childe feels something stirring inside him, and Paimon links it to his weakening Hydro Vision.
threads.quote: Childe tells them that he has been in a bad mood recently and began to feel something stirring inside him.

threads.claim: The performers' hidden ties to the Fatui House of the Hearth surface, showing their goals were tied to the Knave.
threads.quote: They explain that, as orphans, their goals aligned with the House of the Hearth and the Knave.

threads.claim: The Traveler hears a mysterious voice near the Fountain of Lucine, a hint of something unseen.
threads.quote: Heading to the Fountain of Lucine, the Traveler hears a mysterious voice as Lynette appears to greet them.

threads.claim: A legend says a Dragon of Water left Fontaine and its tears make the skies rain, with its whereabouts unknown.
threads.quote: It's said that a Dragon of Water once resided in Fontaine. Though we don't know where the dragon went, every time it weeps, the skies will cloud up and pour out rain.

threads.claim: Calling to the Hydro Dragon fails, and Lyney suggests it cannot be comforted by strangers.
threads.quote: It might be because we've never met the Hydro Dragon. Perhaps it can't be comforted by the words of strangers.

threads.claim: Rain in Fontaine is tied to trials held in the opera house.
threads.quote: It often rains on days when there are trials being held in the opera house, but don't worry, it'll clear up soon enough.

threads.claim: The Traveler hears an unexplained voice calling a name from the fountain.
threads.quote: Whose voice was that just now...?

threads.claim: Lynette suggests the voice is the emotion of tears collected by the fountain, though the Traveler doubts it.
threads.quote: I suspect that what you heard is a result of your hypersensitivity to the Hydro element.

threads.claim: It is unclear how unreliable human belief could become a stable energy source for machines.
threads.quote: How could something unreliable like people's beliefs be turned into a stable power source for these machines?

threads.claim: The gods rely on belief to obtain power, linking Oratrice energy to the gods.
threads.quote: The gods rely on belief to obtain power.

threads.claim: Pneumousia is an unstable energy source not produced by the Archon and not usable by civilians.
threads.quote: It isn't produced by the power of the Archon, but it is unstable by nature. Even now it still cannot be widely used by civilians.

threads.claim: Childe feels a restless power stirring within him that he cannot explain.
threads.quote: But recently, there seems to be some sort of restless power stirring inside of me...

threads.claim: Childe's Hydro Vision suddenly lost control at a critical moment, which he cannot explain.
threads.quote: It's as if I suddenly lost control of my Hydro powers when I needed them. Maybe there's something wrong with my Vision?

threads.claim: Skirk said Childe had awakened something called "it" and that traces of it remain on him.
threads.quote: She said that all my combat training would be useful in the future.

threads.claim: Childe's whale attack comes from a dream of the abyss, which the Traveler links to his power.
threads.quote: The power inside you is connected to your incident in the abyss.

threads.claim: Childe fell into an unknown abyss at fourteen and has never been able to find it again.
threads.quote: I can't remember if I've ever mentioned it before, but when I was fourteen, I fell into some unknown abyss...

threads.claim: Years of searching have turned up no trace of Skirk or the abyss.
threads.quote: But it's been years now and I've still found nothing.

threads.claim: Fontaine is rumored to have a death penalty, though no one is known to have been sentenced to it.
threads.quote: Though it's rumored that Fontaine has a death penalty, from what I can tell, no one has ever been officially sentenced to death.

threads.claim: Lynette vanished from a sealed water tank in a way no one in the audience could explain.
threads.quote: Whoa! What in the world just happened!? How did he do that!? Paimon didn't see him do anything!

threads.claim: It is unknown why Cowell was in the box instead of the audience volunteer.
threads.quote: As of now, we are still not sure why we found Cowell in the box rather than the guest from the audience.

threads.claim: The missing girl from the audience cannot be found, tying the show to the disappearance case.
threads.quote: And after an initial search of the area, the Gardes have confirmed that the girl is nowhere to be found.

threads.claim: Furina publicly names Lyney the prime suspect in the disappearances.
threads.quote: I say that our powerful magician, Mr. Lyney, is now the prime suspect for the serial disappearances case.

threads.claim: Charges are pressed against Lyney, and the Traveler is named his attorney for a trial a day later.
threads.quote: Charges have now been pressed, and as such, a trial is in order.

threads.claim: Furina and the Traveler's first duel is disputed, with Paimon saying Furina clearly lost.
threads.quote: Huh? It wasn't a draw, she obviously lost last time...

threads.claim: The Oratrice's core lies hidden beneath the machine, and its location is a secret worth investigating.
threads.quote: During our investigations, we learned that the machine's core is beneath it.

threads.claim: Why the Oratrice has a consciousness and how it delivers accurate sentences is an open question.
threads.quote: We've been trying to find out how the Oratrice operates. We want to know why it has a consciousness?

threads.claim: A voice that seemed to recognize Lyney spoke from the Oratrice core chamber, and its identity is unknown.
threads.quote: That voice seemed to recognize me and tried to speak to me.

threads.claim: The House of the Hearth and the Fatui have members operating inside Fontaine, and their aims are not uniform.
threads.quote: But our organization is very, very large, and the Harbingers have very different personalities and goals.

threads.claim: A series of disappearances of young women with no obvious connection has been occurring in Fontaine.
threads.quote: Simply put, she wasn't related to the magic troupe at all, which matches the features of the previous serial disappearances.

threads.claim: A prophesied crisis threatens the nation and drives the twins' interest in the Oratrice's secrets.
threads.quote: We must know all we can about this nation's secrets in order to deal with that prophesied crisis.

threads.claim: Someone may have been turned into water to escape, an idea raised but dismissed as implausible.
threads.quote: (Wait. Could it have been the water...?)

threads.claim: Navia has an interest in the disappearance cases rooted in an old matter from her father's time.
threads.quote: my interest stems from a matter back from my father's time.

threads.claim: Halsey's disappearance and Cowell's death are inexplicable with the current evidence.
threads.quote: Halsey's disappearance and Cowell's death are both quite inexplicable.

threads.claim: The random selector was rigged, so Lyney knew in advance which audience member would be chosen.
threads.quote: In other words, Lyney knew who would be sitting where from the very beginning.

threads.claim: The loud thud during the countdown may have been a sign of an accomplice or a struggle backstage.
threads.quote: I'm of the opinion that it may have been the sound of Lyney's accomplice — Lynette perhaps — jumping atop the water tank, or something like that.

threads.claim: Lyney claims he stayed in the audience-side box during the trick, which is challenged as an alibi.
threads.quote: You ran to, and remained hidden within, the magic box in the audience stands once the trick began, and thus could not have committed the crime. Is this correct?

threads.claim: Lyney's absence from the box and tunnel explains why he did not hear the thud, undermining his alibi.
threads.quote: That's right! Lyney wasn't in the box or in the tunnel. That's why he didn't hear anything strange during the performance.

threads.claim: Cowell is proposed as the person who tampered with the props and died in his own trap.
threads.quote: Um, the killer was, in fact, Cowell, the deceased!

threads.claim: An audience member suspects the dissolution case echoes a certain prophecy, raising the question of its link to the case.
threads.quote: Wait a moment, this reminds me of a certain prophecy.

threads.claim: The dissolution of people from Fontaine is said to support the prophecy, and the House of the Hearth is working to counter it.
threads.quote: Today's case has also proven that people from Fontaine can indeed dissolve into some sort of water, thus further supporting the prophecy.

threads.claim: The Water from the Primordial Sea can also be diluted into a potion that causes intense exhilaration, so its trade is profitable.
threads.quote: It can also be made into a potion which, when extremely diluted, can cause people to experience unforgettable exhilaration.

threads.claim: The Knave is pursuing the Gnosis as part of her plan to break the prophecy.
threads.quote: The Knave is after the Gnosis, isn't she?

threads.claim: The Fatui's plan to frame Lyney and the boss behind the disappearances are revealed, though the boss is not identified.
threads.quote: Our boss discovered that the Water can cause people to dissolve.

threads.claim: The disappearances were ordered by a boss who is not yet named, hinting at a larger figure behind the crimes.
threads.quote: The disappearances were also the boss' idea.

threads.claim: The serial disappearances are a case that has gone cold for decades, leaving an open question about who is responsible.
threads.quote: are you sure we're the ones who can crack a case that's been cold for decades now?

threads.claim: Cowell is identified as the actual perpetrator of the serial disappearances, though he is dead.
threads.quote: The actual perpetrator of the serial disappearances, Cowell, selected his next victim from the audience reservation list.

threads.claim: The Traveler remains unsure whether Lyney can be trusted despite his help and his personal story.
threads.quote: But I still can't completely trust you.

threads.claim: Lyney explains that he joined the Fatui because the House of the Hearth's goals match his own as an orphan.
threads.quote: As for why I'm a Fatuus, it's because the goals of the House of the Hearth align with those of an orphan like me.

introduced.name: Alia (Historical)
introduced.how: Guardian of the Silver Lampwick at the Pillar of Embla, revealed as an ordinary human from the past rather than a fae
introduced.quote: I'm no fae. I'm... just an ordinary human.

introduced.name: Illuga
introduced.how: Captain of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, introducing himself and his unit
introduced.quote: I'm Illuga, captain of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. It's a pleasure to meet you.

introduced.name: Silver Lampwick
introduced.how: One of three sacred relics that can deploy a barrier against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: The relic we're searching for is the Silver Lampwick, one of three sacred artifacts

introduced.name: Aedon
introduced.how: A gold bird that can fly and uncover hidden paths, once Solovei's nightingale
introduced.quote: He was once Solovei's nightingale, following him from their homeland to this bitter frontier.

introduced.name: Solovei
introduced.how: Alia's former companion whose family name was the Nightingale, who sealed the serpent long ago
introduced.quote: Later, when Solovei resolved to cast aside the Nightingale family name, he meant to drive the bird away.

introduced.name: Torchforger
introduced.how: Founder of the Lightkeepers about five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: Do you mean the Torchforger? He founded the Lightkeepers about... five hundred years ago now.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: Guardians who patrol and defend the region against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: I'm Illuga, captain of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. It's a pleasure to meet you.

introduced.name: Nightmare Orioles
introduced.how: Illuga's Lightkeeper investigation squad
introduced.quote: I'm Illuga, captain of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. It's a pleasure to meet you.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: Monsters from Kipumaki Cliff that attack in packs and may manipulate minds
introduced.quote: What we just faced was the Wild Hunt from Kipumaki Cliff. They're an odd lot. Not only do they attack living beings in packs, but word is that they can even manipulate minds...

introduced.name: Kipumaki Cliff
introduced.how: Forbidden cliff area where the sealed fiend lies and the Wild Hunt outbreak is centered
introduced.quote: Anyhow, there's been a large-scale Wild Hunt outbreak in the northern Kipumaki Cliff area.

introduced.name: Piramida
introduced.how: A tall lighthouse-like city that serves as Lightkeeper headquarters
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, Piramida is such a tall city! From afar, it really does look like a giant lighthouse.

introduced.name: Pillar of Embla
introduced.how: A tower that is not a divine miracle but the site where the serpent was first slain
introduced.quote: For just as I am no fae worthy of worship, this tower you call the Pillar of Embla is no divine miracle.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: The land that the serpent's scheme would have consumed to fuel his ascent
introduced.quote: Had his scheme succeeded, all of Nod-Krai — its soil and every living being upon it — would have become fuel for his ascent.

introduced.name: Sampo Mill
introduced.how: A device the serpent wanted to use to siphon the land's power, which Alia ignited with her own blood
introduced.quote: He sought to use the Sampo Mill to siphon the land's power

introduced.name: Professor
introduced.how: The serpent fiend sealed in Kipumaki Cliff five hundred years ago, now freed again
introduced.quote: do you mean the fiend who was sealed within Kipumaki Cliff five hundred years ago by the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions?

introduced.name: Barrier Core
introduced.how: Core structures that must be recharged with kuuvahki to restore the area's barriers
introduced.quote: Let's start with the barrier core nearby. Once we're close, we just need to channel the kuuvahki into it.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: A pure energy in the tower that can disperse corruption and guide the way
introduced.quote: The tower's presence allows the kuuvahki here to remain in its purest form

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: A corrupting force whose pitch-black impurities are more dangerous than they look
introduced.quote: These pitch-black impurities are far more dangerous than they look.

introduced.name: Evil Eye of Blightseep
introduced.how: A great evil eye that spills monsters beyond the cordoned zone
introduced.quote: the great evil eye and countless monsters have come spilling out beyond the cordoned zone.

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: Lightkeeper soldiers who follow a captain and swear vows
introduced.quote: Anleifr: Oh! Hello, I'm Anleifr, a Ratnik. So you two are adventurers...

introduced.name: Anleifr
introduced.how: A Ratnik who warns the travelers about the Wild Hunt outbreak
introduced.quote: Oh! Hello, I'm Anleifr, a Ratnik. So you two are adventurers... I'm afraid you've come to the wrong place.

introduced.name: Rollon
introduced.how: Anleifr's companion who is taken over by the Wild Hunt during the encounter
introduced.quote: S-sorry... I'm alright.

introduced.name: Vlaicu
introduced.how: A Lightkeeper who warns of Wild Hunt sightings and advises caution
introduced.quote: Vlaicu: There've been Wild Hunt sightings here.

introduced.name: Nikita
introduced.how: A long-serving Ratnik who introduces himself and asks the travelers to find the Silver Lampwick
introduced.quote: I am Nikita, an ordinary Ratnik who has been stationed in this remote land for years.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: A lighthouse-posted Ratnik and volunteer who speaks with Nikita about the ancient being
introduced.quote: You know I wouldn't call myself a regular volunteer, but are you certain my aid is not warranted this time?

introduced.name: Three-years-ago ambush at the seal
introduced.how: Illuga and senior Ratniki were ambushed while investigating the seal, forcing the mission to be called off
introduced.quote: We were hit by an ambush none of us expected... Our losses were severe, and the mission had to be called off.

assumed.name: Alia (Historical)
assumed.quote: Was that... Alia, the fae, calling to us?

assumed.name: Aila
assumed.quote: We heard something like that from Aila back when we were in the Frostmoon Scions' sanctum with Verna...

assumed.name: Verna
assumed.quote: We heard something like that from Aila back when we were in the Frostmoon Scions' sanctum with Verna...

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: We heard something like that from Aila back when we were in the Frostmoon Scions' sanctum with Verna...

assumed.name: Belyi Tsar
assumed.quote: We met at the Belyi Tsar's court, even. No garden-variety viper was he.

assumed.name: Starshyna
assumed.quote: Do I seem like the sort of Ratnik who would disrespect his Starshyna by not even checking in?

assumed.name: Old man in Piramida
assumed.quote: The old man back in Piramida told us about you, and we even saw you there!

threads.claim: Alia denies being a fae and claims she is an ordinary human stranded across time, unlike the legends about her.
threads.quote: I'm no fae. I'm... just an ordinary human.

threads.claim: A prophecy says the undying serpent will rise twice and be struck down thrice, with the final burial by the heroes of the sublunary sphere.
threads.quote: Twice shall that undying serpent rise again, but thrice shall he be struck down...

threads.claim: Alia and Illuga frame the present as the third and final moment when the serpent must be buried for good.
threads.quote: And now we stand at the third and final time — the moment when that serpent must be buried for good.

threads.claim: The serpent's obsession with reaching the Elysium beyond the sky persists even after his death.
threads.quote: Even in death, that fixation has never faded.

threads.claim: The Pillar of Embla is revealed as the site where Alia first slew the serpent, not a divine miracle.
threads.quote: This is the place where I slew that serpent for the first time — yet failed to consign him to hell for good.

threads.claim: Alia reveals she sacrificed her own flesh and blood to ignite the Sampo Mill and stop the serpent's plot.
threads.quote: With no other recourse, I cast myself into the Sampo Mill and used my own flesh and blood to ignite it, thwarting that serpent's plot.

threads.claim: Aedon's transformation is explained as a result of being pulled into the Sampo Mill and carried across five hundred years.
threads.quote: I could never have foreseen that this small act would see it pulled into the Sampo Mill and carried across five hundred years

threads.claim: The Silver Lampwick is somehow both present and absent, and Alia cannot reach it while the tower is corrupted.
threads.quote: How should I put this... it both is and isn't.

threads.claim: Alia says the Lampwick's power will gather at the tower's peak once the corruption is cleared, so the travelers must come find her then.
threads.quote: Once you've cleared the corruption and the strength I've lost gathers at the tower's peak once more... Come find me then.

threads.claim: The kuuvahki guide is flickering because of both Abyssal corruption and Alia's deliberate intention to hide her presence.
threads.quote: I'd say it's half the Abyssal corruption, and half her intention.

threads.claim: Alia vows to use all her remaining power to hold the serpent in place while the travelers go after him.
threads.quote: I will use everything I have to hold him here.

threads.claim: Illuga blames himself and his squad for negligence in the failed mission three years ago.
threads.quote: isn't this situation... the result of negligence on our part?

threads.claim: Illuga's squad suffered severe losses in an ambush at the seal three years ago, which the squad has not forgotten.
threads.quote: We were hit by an ambush none of us expected... Our losses were severe, and the mission had to be called off.

threads.claim: The prophecy was given by Aila, a person from the past who is just like Alia, and it is more a plea than a fated outcome.
threads.quote: After all, the one who gave that prophecy was just like me — she was someone from the past.

threads.claim: A great evil eye is spilling monsters out beyond the cordoned zone, and its origin is still unexplained.
threads.quote: the great evil eye and countless monsters have come spilling out beyond the cordoned zone.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt is rumored to manipulate minds and press people into their service once their will wanes.
threads.quote: but word is that they can even manipulate minds...

threads.claim: Rollon turns hostile after the evil eye's image appears, hinting that the Wild Hunt can take control of people.
threads.quote: (The image of a huge purple eye flashes on screen, and Rollon suddenly becomes hostile)

threads.claim: Flins recalls meeting the serpent at the Belyi Tsar's court and remembers eyes just like the evil eye's.
threads.quote: I recall those eyes of his. They were exactly like the ones staring at us right now.

threads.claim: Nikita reveals that his remaining time is running out and that he has little time left to help Illuga.
threads.quote: Yet my time is running out... Little remains of the years I bought for him

threads.claim: The Torchforger left behind a bow and arrow, and Nikita has Flins retrieving a relic tied to the first Moonchanter.
threads.quote: Let us witness the power of the bow and arrow bequeathed to us by the Torchforger...

introduced.name: Zuria Destree
introduced.how: Thelxie's mother, who draws the picture book
introduced.quote: Zuria Destree: Are you seeing this, my son? Are you feeling inspired by this as well?

introduced.name: Thelxie
introduced.how: the child prince at the center of the adventure, who communicates through codes
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey! Thelxieeee!

introduced.name: Kingdom of Water Imps
introduced.how: the underwater ruins Freminet found are the Kingdom of Water Imps, not ruins
introduced.quote: Traveler: This is the Kingdom of Water Imps, Paimon, not ruins...

introduced.name: Rainbow glory
introduced.how: a blessing from the goddess meant to fill the prince's future with light
introduced.quote: Paimon: And as for this prince... the goddess will also bestow upon you the rainbow glory, so your future will always be filled with light!

introduced.name: Coronation ceremony
introduced.how: Thelxie's planned coronation is the intended end of the adventure and needs a crown
introduced.quote: Freminet: Speaking of which, Zuria just told me that she wants to end the adventure with a coronation ceremony.

introduced.name: Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures
introduced.how: a picture book Zuria draws page by page to chronicle the adventure
introduced.quote: Before heading out, Zuria draws the first page for Thelxie's picture book.

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zuria! Freminet! We're here.

assumed.name: Thelxie's illness
assumed.quote: Zuria Destree: Thank you for your concern, Freminet. His condition is fairly stable. The family doctor said we might be able to take him out for a stroll today.

assumed.name: Freminet as a crafter who takes commissions
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, Paimon knew that you didn't often take commissions from others... But Paimon had no idea you'd be so dedicated once you're on the job.

threads.claim: Thelxie is a sick child whose condition is only fairly stable, and his recovery is hoped for.
threads.quote: Zuria Destree: Thank you for your concern, Freminet. His condition is fairly stable.

threads.claim: Thelxie only speaks in ciphers and Morse code, whose meanings the player must decode.
The goddess grants a rainbow glory that is meant to bring the prince light and hope.
threads.quote: Paimon: And as for this prince... the goddess will also bestow upon you the rainbow glory, so your future will always be filled with light!

threads.claim: The companions defeat the monsters and reclaim the Kingdom of Water Imps for the prince.
threads.quote: Zuria Destree: Yes, it should now be time for us to attend Thelxie's coronation ceremony...

threads.claim: The monsters ran off with the prince's crown, which must still be reclaimed in a later fight.
threads.quote: Freminet: No... The crown was within the Prince's reach, but the monsters took it with them as they fled.

threads.claim: Freminet has a personal reason for his work that he does not finish explaining.
threads.quote: Freminet: It's because... I hope...

threads.claim: Freminet hopes that people trapped in dark places can see beauty and experience a miracle.
threads.quote: Freminet: ...I hope that everyone who's found themselves in a dark place would be able to see something beautiful, and experience a miracle for themselves...

introduced.name: Scylla
introduced.how: A fell dragon who once served the Sebastos, subdued and sealed in the sea by Boethius
introduced.quote: Scylla, a fell dragon who once served the Sebastos. He was subdued and sealed here by Boethius.

introduced.name: Boethius
introduced.how: A commander whose legions shut the Initium Iani and sealed Scylla, now said to be waiting at Domus Aurea
introduced.quote: Boethius and his legions used this fact to shut the Initium Iani, thus finally sealing the evil dragon.

introduced.name: Sebastos
introduced.how: The Remurian Imperator who created Phobos and led the nation
introduced.quote: The Sebastos created Phobos to free us from our servitude to destiny, but the people's blind faith has led us into enslavement more frightful still.

introduced.name: Monsieur Os
introduced.how: A Remurian dragon-kin who goes by the name Monsieur Os, also called Dominus Cassiodor
introduced.quote: Err, actually, Paimon's not sure what you'd know him by, but we call him Monsieur Os!

introduced.name: Este (Golem)
introduced.how: A stone Remurian Este whose statue holds the memories of the ancestor of the town Este
introduced.quote: So you mean that the Este here is Town-Este's ancestor

introduced.name: Este (Human)
introduced.how: A Fontainian townsman who is a descendant of Remurians
introduced.quote: The Este you met in town must be a descendant of Remurians.

introduced.name: Sybilla
introduced.how: A prophet whose calculation powers support Phobos and whose prophecy was validated
introduced.quote: There should be no issues, not when we have the aid of Sybilla's nearly limitless powers of calculation...

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: A former nation that sank beneath the sea after its war with the Fontainians
introduced.quote: Afterward, the evil dragon sank alongside Remuria, and the Sebastos too was lost, remaining so to this very day...

introduced.name: Capitolium
introduced.how: The inner city of the Remurian capital where the Sebastos resided
introduced.quote: Scylla led the brutal Dragonborn to Machimos, intent on breaching the inner city, Capitolium, where the Sebastos resided.

introduced.name: Machimos
introduced.how: The outer city of the Remurian capital
introduced.quote: is the outer city of the capital, but should the fell dragon wish to enter the inner city, he must pass through the Initium Iani.

introduced.name: Initium Iani
introduced.how: A barrier with golden waterways separating the inner and outer capital
introduced.quote: That is the barrier separating the inner and outer parts of the capital

introduced.name: Domus Aurea
introduced.how: The destination city where Boethius is said to be waiting
introduced.quote: He said that he'd wait for us within Domus Aurea...

introduced.name: Dragonborn
introduced.how: Brutal dragon-kin forces that Scylla led against the capital
introduced.quote: Scylla led the brutal Dragonborn to Machimos, intent on breaching the inner city, Capitolium, where the Sebastos resided.

introduced.name: Vishap
introduced.how: Lesser dragon-kin, with a fell dragon being only a stronger vishap
introduced.quote: it was no more than a vishap that was a teensy bit stronger than normal.

introduced.name: Hydro Dragon
introduced.how: A water dragon role that is only reborn after the Mistress of Many Waters hibernates
