introduced.quote: no new Hydro Dragon could be born so long as the Mistress of Many Waters hibernated in the deep seas.

introduced.name: Symphony
introduced.how: A golden melody that covered Remuria, influences sea creatures and traps souls
introduced.quote: the Symphony weaved by the Sebastos and the musicians which covered all of Remuria passed through the Initium Iani and its golden waterways.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: A divine melody-guided system that directs Remurian people's actions and happiness
introduced.quote: It should have guided our every move, but since coming here, there have been many times when we could not hear its melody.

introduced.name: Harmost
introduced.how: An esteemed official who follows the Sebastos and carries out Phobos's directives
introduced.quote: A Harmost as esteemed as he follows the directives of the Sebastos in all things.

introduced.name: Legio IX
introduced.how: A Remurian legion whose members are guarding and looting the chains and treasure
introduced.quote: Are you of Legio IX? What are you doing here?

introduced.name: Fort Charybdis
introduced.how: A Remurian fortress where the frontline legions were ordered to retreat
introduced.quote: Should you all not have been ordered to retreat to Fort Charybdis?

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: The newborn nation that Remurian survivors followed into and where many settled
introduced.quote: In later days, he followed me into the newborn Fontaine and was laid to rest there.

introduced.name: Ouranopolis
introduced.how: A new city name the Traveler gives to a Remurian group as the city of the future
introduced.quote: Ouranopolis, the city of the future...

introduced.name: Fortuna
introduced.how: A fate or destiny that the Remurians fought to break free from
introduced.quote: Did the Sebastos not say that he wanted to lead us to break the shackles of

introduced.name: Ichor
introduced.how: A substance used to cleanse polluted waters in Remuria
introduced.quote: the polluted waters were cleansed by Ichor.

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's right! Neuvillette's the Hydro Dragon, isn't he?

assumed.name: Mistress of Many Waters
assumed.quote: no new Hydro Dragon could be born so long as the Mistress of Many Waters hibernated in the deep seas.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: that bit where he kicked up a storm in Mondstadt while under the influence of a curse.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Traveler: Well, there was that time with Dvalin...

assumed.name: Azhdaha
assumed.quote: Traveler: We had that little run-in with Azhdaha...

assumed.name: Apep
assumed.quote: Traveler: We encountered Apep in the desert...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Right, she even went on about wanting to destroy Sumeru...

assumed.name: Petrichor
assumed.quote: Sounds like when we first arrived in Petrichor...

assumed.name: Aremorica
assumed.quote: I heard that the Sebastos had sent him to Aremorica.

assumed.name: Fontainians
assumed.quote: Yeah, and he's stolen the souls of a whole bunch of Fontainians, too!

threads.claim: The fate of the Sebastos is unknown, and he has been lost since Remuria sank.
threads.quote: Afterward, the evil dragon sank alongside Remuria, and the Sebastos too was lost, remaining so to this very day...

threads.claim: The Traveler has heard the Sebastos voice in a dream and cannot recall his name.
threads.quote: Traveler: I've heard this voice in a dream before...

threads.claim: The Traveler is addressed as Imperator, hinting that the Traveler may be the Sebastos.
threads.quote: Imperator, Imperator, are you alright? Are you dreaming again?

threads.claim: Scylla accuses Boethius of being the true traitor who lured him into a trap, leaving the betrayal disputed.
threads.quote: Hmph! If it is betrayal you speak of, then Boethius was the true traitor!

threads.claim: Scylla claims the attack on the capital was part of Remus's secret plan, which the others find hard to believe.
threads.quote: My leading an army of vishaps to assault the capital was, in fact, part of Remus's final, secret plan.

threads.claim: Phobos's melody has been failing for some Remurians, and the Traveler suspects it rejects them.
threads.quote: Traveler: Phobos's silence signifies rejection.

threads.claim: The melody of Phobos keeps being interrupted, causing the people to fear chaos and question its reliability.
threads.quote: Recently, the melody of Phobos has been interrupted many times, and so they have many concerns regarding this.

threads.claim: The prophet Sybilla may have hidden something, and her prophecy's veracity is in question.
threads.quote: Could it be that the prophet had hidden something from us? Impossible.

threads.claim: The Remurians aimed to break free of Fortuna, the fate that binds them, and it is unclear if that is possible.
threads.quote: Did the Sebastos not say that he wanted to lead us to break the shackles of

threads.claim: The souls of the Fontainians are trapped by the Symphony and bound by Boethius's obsession, and peace depends on defeating him.
threads.quote: If we can defeat Boethius, perhaps they too can at last find peace...

threads.claim: The pendant Monsieur Os carries is a fragment of the Symphony that limits Boethius's control.
threads.quote: As long as this remains, Boethius cannot be said to have complete mastery over the Symphony.

threads.claim: The statue Este is the ancestor of the town Este, a Remurian whose memories lingered in the melody.
threads.quote: The Este you met in town must be a descendant of Remurians.

threads.claim: Boethius claims to be waiting at Domus Aurea, which is the goal of the journey.
threads.quote: He said that he'd wait for us within Domus Aurea...

threads.claim: The seals on the Initium Iani must be shattered one by one to open the path to Domus Aurea.
threads.quote: Now we simply need to break these revealed seals one by one.

threads.claim: The Traveler frees Scylla from his chains, and he takes a debt of gratitude toward them.
threads.quote: Ahhh! Such warm ocean currents! Free at last!

threads.claim: A new Dragon of Water has been born, so the Hydro Dragon lineage has changed since the old Mistress passed.
threads.quote: A new Dragon of Water has already been born?

introduced.name: Ninnin
introduced.how: Ninnin is Nin-Kiggia, a moon researcher whose recorded imprint at the moon's core introduces herself and her role
introduced.quote: Nin-Kiggia's Mark: I'm Nin-Kiggia. You can call me Ninnin. That's what people usually call me.

introduced.name: Lusalim
introduced.how: Lusalim is the chief architect and executor of Project Moongazer, and Ninnin's teacher
introduced.quote: To the chief architect of Project Lunar Veil, the designer of the Nin-Kiggia's Game of Life, the executor of Project Moongazer

introduced.name: Maagees
introduced.how: Maagees is a researcher who uncovered that the astral visitor was a data-based lifeform
introduced.quote: Nin-Kiggia's Mark: Next, we must say thank you to Madam Maagees, who uncovered the nature of our astral visitor — a data-based lifeform.

introduced.name: Ibni-Belum
introduced.how: Ibni-Belum is the first Moongazer who led people to the moon
introduced.quote: Nin-Kiggia's Mark: Then came the first Moongazer, Ibni-Belum, who led us to the moon, opened our eyes, and tirelessly gazed into the brilliant starry skies.

introduced.name: Ungien
introduced.how: Ungien is a researcher who sacrificed his life to relay the astral civilization's final message
introduced.quote: Nin-Kiggia's Mark: And we have Ungien, who sacrificed his life to relay the final message that our guest's civilization sent out into the stars.

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: The Lord of Darkness who built the base is identified as the returning dragon king Nibelung
introduced.quote: Traveler: It's probably the returning dragon king, Nibelung.

introduced.name: Lord of Darkness
introduced.how: A dragon ruler whose will created the base, which was meant to turn the moon into a space-based weapon
introduced.quote: Eggie: The data indicates that the existence of this base... stems from the will of this "Lord of Darkness."

introduced.name: Project Moongazer
introduced.how: Project Moongazer is the whole journey's larger plan: a message sent into the universe, using Ninnin and the moon's researchers
introduced.quote: Columbina: In truth, our whole journey so far has been a part of it.

introduced.name: Ancient moon energy
introduced.how: An endless stream of energy from the moon's core that powers the base
introduced.quote: Eggie: An endless stream of ancient moon energy surges from the fissure — it's what powers this base.

introduced.name: Lusalim's Laboratory
introduced.how: The lab inside the base where Lusalim's records are kept
introduced.quote: Eggie: I've located Lusalim's research lab. It's inside this base.

introduced.name: Moon's core
introduced.how: The core of the moon, a dark space of very high ancient moon energy where the seat of the moon's will lies
introduced.quote: Columbina: This is the moon's core. Beautiful, isn't it?

introduced.name: Warden of the Flame
introduced.how: A guardian mechanism at the launch silo that the group must defeat
introduced.quote: Warden of the Flame, Sebu-Nis-Ili-Rabuti-Lu-Tamati

introduced.name: Three Moon Sisters
introduced.how: Beings who permitted the researchers to borrow creation power from the moon's origin
introduced.quote: Nin-Kiggia's Mark: First, please thank the Three Moon Sisters, who permitted our transgression and allowed us to borrow the power of creation from the moon's very origin.

introduced.name: Lunar Veil Laboratory
introduced.how: An earlier facility of Lusalim's, now part of the lunar sea
introduced.quote: Columbina: This is Lusalim's final facility — the one before was the Lunar Veil Laboratory, which is now the lunar sea.

assumed.name: Moon Goddess
assumed.quote: Columbina: And to minimize risks, I will also use my power as the Moon Goddess to shield any message that Ninnin might send.

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: Columbina: We also often chat and play games together... You know, in Silvermoon Hall.

assumed.name: Kuuvahki
assumed.quote: Columbina: No, I've only scouted the outskirts using kuuvahki, so I don't know where this feeling is coming from.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: However, that primordial ruler ultimately met defeat at the hands of the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Eye of Ibni-Belum
assumed.quote: Paimon: If that's all there was to it, couldn't they just have used the Eye of Ibni-Belum?

assumed.name: Archaeolune Ripples
assumed.quote: Use Archaeolune Ripples to distract the security searchlights

assumed.name: Dragon
assumed.quote: Traveler: That's dragon-tech for you.

assumed.name: False sky
assumed.quote: Columbina: The false sky used to conceal Teyvat has also been opened more than once.

assumed.name: Aether and Lumine's Spaceship
assumed.quote: Columbina: Last time we sat on your ship, we were looking at Teyvat. Let's look at the stars this time.

assumed.name: Ancient Moon's Fount
assumed.quote: Traveler: You mean the Ancient Moon's Fount?

threads.claim: The purpose of Project Moongazer is unknown and the terminal has no data on it.
threads.quote: Eggie: Searching for Project Moongazer... No data.

threads.claim: The whole journey is revealed to be part of Project Moongazer, a message sent into the universe.
threads.quote: Columbina: In truth, our whole journey so far has been a part of it.

threads.claim: Eggie has no memories of her origins and wonders why.
threads.quote: Eggie: I... I don't know... I don't have these memories... Why don't I have them?

threads.claim: Columbina vanishes without explanation, and the group suspects the base holds the cause.
threads.quote: Paimon: She's gone!

threads.claim: Columbina was swept into the moon's core after touching its ancient energy while using kuuvahki.
threads.quote: Columbina: When I suffused this base with kuuvahki, I accidentally came into contact with it and was swept into the moon's core.

threads.claim: Columbina feels an unexplained sense of familiarity with the base.
threads.quote: Columbina: Hmm, it certainly feels cold and sterile, but for some reason, I feel an... odd sense of familiarity.

threads.claim: The familiarity Columbina felt is linked to the moon's core, where she has been drawn.
threads.quote: Columbina: This is the moon's core. Beautiful, isn't it?

threads.claim: A Lord of Darkness who returned from the Sea of Stars built the base as a space weapon.
threads.quote: Eggie: Retrieving other data... Huh? "The Lord of Darkness Who Returned From the Sea of Stars"?

threads.claim: The Lord of Darkness was a dragon ruler defeated by the Heavenly Principles, and the weapon is no longer a threat.
threads.quote: However, that primordial ruler ultimately met defeat at the hands of the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Lusalim confesses to having betrayed dragonkind by surrendering research to a sovereign from beyond this world.
threads.quote: I have sinned against dragonkind. I capitulated to that terrifying sovereign who was not of this world

threads.claim: Researchers' data is merged in the moon's ocean, and they are reborn in forms like Eggie's to repeat the mission.
threads.quote: Columbina: All the researchers who once explored the starry sky have had their data merged into this ocean.

threads.claim: Sending a signal may draw the attention of the darkness among the stars, though the Abyss may not be watching.
threads.quote: Columbina: There are many possibilities. Perhaps the Abyss isn't constantly watching this place, or perhaps the great ruler of the firmament has taken other measures...

threads.claim: The Traveler's ship once received a message that was too corrupted to read fully.
threads.quote: Traveler: Almost all of its meaningful content was lost.

threads.claim: The sealed data reveals the original reply sent to the Traveler and their sibling, which praises the signal as a bonfire in a dark forest.
threads.quote: Terminal: ...We are travelers... who have traversed the universe alone for a long time... and your voices... it is as if a bonfire has suddenly lit up a dark forest...

threads.claim: The Traveler's birthplace is far away and destroyed, and they plan to return to it someday.
threads.quote: Columbina: Your birthplace... It's out there too, isn't it?

introduced.name: Credit Coupons
introduced.how: prison currency used to buy goods at shops like the Rag and Bone Shop
introduced.quote: You've got a set schedule, guaranteed food and board, and you can even buy all kinds of stuff with Credit Coupons.

introduced.name: Faissolle
introduced.how: a prisoner who hid in a box after losing his brown hat and is shy around the Duke
introduced.quote: It's a soft and brown hat, with a bit of a brim. Nothing fancy.

introduced.name: Chamboduc
introduced.how: a prisoner minding the Rag and Bone Shop who admires the Traveler and waives the hat's cost
introduced.quote: Hahaha, I'm just standing in for Mr. Alvard while he's off restocking the shop.

introduced.name: Alvard
introduced.how: the Rag and Bone Shop's owner, a friend of the Duke who lets staff take goods instead of payment
introduced.quote: After all, I also only joined up here because I'd heard Mr. Alvard was a good friend of the Duke.

introduced.name: Rag and Bone Shop
introduced.how: a prison shop stocked with all kinds of goods
introduced.quote: Why don't we check out the Rag and Bone Shop? If memory serves, they've got all kinds of stuff in there!

introduced.name: Beret Society
introduced.how: a group of prisoners who wear berets and are model prisoners who work hard
introduced.quote: In fact, members of the Beret Society are model prisoners.

introduced.name: Dougier
introduced.how: leader of the Beret Society who runs it as his own domain
introduced.quote: Not too far off from the cafeteria is the Beret Society, where they're greeted by Dougier.

introduced.name: Censure
introduced.how: a thorn-based punishment Dougier uses to control Society members
introduced.quote: a method that allows Dougier to control the members

introduced.name: Avice
introduced.how: Faissolle's lover and a Society member who asks Wriothesley for help
introduced.quote: Some time passes before a woman named Avice enters and asks Wriothesley to help her lover, Faissolle, claiming that he's in danger.

introduced.name: Guelet
introduced.how: a guard who reports finding smuggled contraband in a cargo shipment
introduced.quote: Your Grace, after following your instructions, we were able to find a box of undeclared contraband in the latest shipment of cargo.

introduced.name: Wolsey
introduced.how: the cafeteria cook who prepares Welfare Meals and serves drinks to VIPs
introduced.quote: Welcome, Your Grace, and the Traveler. Would you like three orders of today's Welfare Meal?

introduced.name: Coupon Cafeteria
introduced.how: the prison cafeteria where Wolsey serves meals and drinks
introduced.quote: First, they stop at the Coupon Cafeteria, where Wolsey offers them drinks in place of a Super Deluxe meal due to their unexpected arrival.

introduced.name: Wyler
introduced.how: a Society member who admits Dougier ordered them to kill a guard
introduced.quote: One of the members, Wyler, admits that Dougier had ordered them to eliminate the guard when they appeared.

introduced.name: Dougier's "Kingdom"
introduced.how: Dougier's secret headquarters full of members and Gardemeks
introduced.quote: Infiltrating Dougier's "kingdom", they find more members and Gardemeks

introduced.name: Gardemeks
introduced.how: combat machines Dougier uses to attack the Duke
introduced.quote: calling on a large group of Gardemeks to eliminate them.

introduced.name: Clockwork Meka
introduced.how: machines that went missing from Dougier's stockpile
introduced.quote: confirming Wriothesley's suspicions on mysterious decommission requests and missing Clockwork Meka

introduced.name: Aqua Doloris
introduced.how: a fear solution Dougier uses to terrorize members
introduced.quote: Dougier orders Avice to inject Faissolle with the fear solution "Aqua Doloris", but Wriothesley and the Traveler interrupt the scene.

introduced.name: Wriothesley's conviction
introduced.how: he was convicted and sent to the prison at a young age, then rose to lead it
introduced.quote: I was convicted and sent here at an early age.

introduced.name: Wriothesley's adoptive parents
introduced.how: his adoptive parents were traffickers who sold or disposed of children, which led him to kill them
introduced.quote: However, he soon learned that his adopted parents were actually traffickers, who sold them for money

introduced.name: the gem
introduced.how: a dark gem in the smuggled box that triggers bad memories when touched

introduced.quote: With one shout, you can release all the fatigue, resentment and unpleasantness from your lungs, and return to the day with all the optimism in the world!

introduced.name: Faissolle
introduced.how: Member who lost his hat, is terrified of Dougier, and flees the gathering place
introduced.quote: Hey, isn't that the guy who lost his hat? Did you come here to relax, too?

introduced.name: Avice
introduced.how: Faissolle's lover who secretly hides a clue and begs Wriothesley for help against Dougier
introduced.quote: Yes, my lover Faissolle told me all about you.

introduced.name: Censure

introduced.quote: Censure is Dougier's method of establishing control, as well as the thing we all fear the most.

introduced.name: Fear liquid
introduced.how: The black gem contains a highly concentrated solution of fear that can be injected into a person's mind
introduced.quote: this liquid is probably a highly concentrated solution of "fear."

introduced.name: Thorn

introduced.quote: It's long, slender, and conical, it's hollow on the inside, and looks something like a cross between a nail and a thorn.

introduced.name: Lost Hair Clip
introduced.how: Avice's hair clip, which hid the thorn and was the real evidence she passed to Wriothesley and the Traveler
introduced.quote: She did so to remove her hair clip.

introduced.name: The Ring
introduced.how: Boxing venue in the Fortress where prisoners fight and even Wriothesley sometimes fights
introduced.quote: I'm not sure if you knew this, but even His Grace sometimes fights in the ring.

introduced.name: Wriothesley's investigation of the Society

introduced.quote: I arranged for a meeting out of curiosity, but then... I noticed some faint hints of dissonance.

introduced.name: Vi:"Hội Mũ Nồi" Đáng Tự Hào

introduced.quote: Ah, this should be the Society's real rulesbook.

introduced.name: Dougier's "Kingdom"

introduced.quote: Yeah, these are all former work areas.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a prison fortress where convicted people like Wriothesley are exiled
introduced.quote: I was convicted for my crimes, and exiled to the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: surveillance port

introduced.quote: This is a surveillance port. With this, Dougier would be able to remotely monitor everything that's happening at the gathering place.

introduced.name: surveillance terminal
introduced.how: a console where data from the surveillance ports is collected
introduced.quote: This is a surveillance terminal. The information collected by the surveillance ports we found previously will be sent here.

introduced.name: hollow thorn

introduced.quote: they all have a hollow thorn inserted into a wound on their head.

introduced.name: Avice

introduced.quote: Hehe, you could say we managed to make the best out of a bad situation.

threads.claim: Wriothesley sees a hidden threat behind the Beret Society's cheerful front and expects a confrontation.
threads.quote: He then states that confrontation is inevitable, confusing Paimon, but he tells the Traveler to head back to check themselves.

threads.claim: Dougier controls Society members through a punishment called censure.
threads.quote: a method that allows Dougier to control the members

threads.claim: The thorn wounds hidden under the berets confirm that censure was used on the members.
threads.quote: Wriothesley notes that they all have wounds from the thorns on their heads hidden by the barets, a reminder of the "censure" that Dougier had inflicted on them.

threads.claim: The liquid from the hair clip may be a concentrated solution of fear.
threads.quote: which causes Wriothesley to believe that the liquid is actually a highly concentrated solution of "fear" due to how Fontainans perceive water.

threads.claim: Dougier is shown forcing a fear solution called Aqua Doloris on a member.
threads.quote: Dougier orders Avice to inject Faissolle with the fear solution "Aqua Doloris", but Wriothesley and the Traveler interrupt the scene.

threads.claim: Touching the dark gem draws out bad memories from the person holding it.
threads.quote: Paimon remembered a lot of bad things when she picked it up...

threads.claim: Wriothesley takes the gem to investigate its properties after it affects him.
threads.quote: I'll take this gem, then, and run a thorough investigation on its properties.

threads.claim: Touching the gem floods the Traveler with memories of the Abyss and their sibling.
threads.quote: causing them to be flooded with memories of the Abyss and their sibling.

threads.claim: Wriothesley was convicted and sent to the prison at an early age.
threads.quote: I was convicted and sent here at an early age.

threads.claim: Wriothesley was an orphan whose adoptive parents trafficked children, which explains his anger at Dougier.
threads.quote: However, he soon learned that his adopted parents were actually traffickers, who sold them for money

threads.claim: Censure is a feared control method whose nature the members refuse to explain, leaving its mechanism a mystery.
threads.quote: Rather than listening to me explain what it is, Your Grace, please just let me show it to you...

threads.claim: Censure turns out to be a thorn that injects the gem's fear liquid directly into a person's brain.
threads.quote: Dougier would be able to "censure" others.

threads.claim: The black gem has a true purpose that no one with knowledge of it has yet revealed.
threads.quote: The other is the true purpose of the black gem.

threads.claim: The gem is a container for a concentrated solution of fear.
threads.quote: this liquid is probably a highly concentrated solution of "fear."

threads.claim: The Society's hats are hiding a secret, though the hat itself appears harmless.
threads.quote: The hats are definitely being used to hide a secret.

threads.claim: The hats may be covering wounds, and the secret may be bigger than the hats.
threads.quote: So... was the hat meant to cover up their wounds?

threads.claim: The real evidence was a hair clip holding the thorn, showing the hats were not the hiding place.
threads.quote: She did so to remove her hair clip.

threads.claim: Something is wrong at the Beret Society, shown only by faint hints of dissonance behind its cheerful front.
threads.quote: I noticed some faint hints of dissonance.

threads.claim: Members' brief fear behind their cheerful facade confirms the Society is hiding something.
threads.quote: The "dissonance" I mentioned earlier was precisely that fleeting moment of fear behind the cheerful facade.

threads.claim: Dougier is suspected of using coercive methods to keep members upbeat and loyal.
threads.quote: He certainly seems to be using some coercive methods to turn his members into the most upbeat and motivated group of people you've ever seen.

threads.claim: Wriothesley admits he took Faissolle's hat on purpose to start the investigation.
threads.quote: And that is precisely why I took his hat.

threads.claim: Faissolle has been pulled back under Dougier's control, so his fate remains uncertain.
threads.quote: We've brought him back to our place, so there's no need to worry.

threads.claim: Dougier's Kingdom is a front, and his real headquarters and remaining members are still hidden elsewhere.
threads.quote: Their real headquarters are elsewhere.

threads.claim: Dougier used hidden surveillance ports to watch his members at all times, raising questions about how far his control reaches.
threads.quote: This is a surveillance port. With this, Dougier would be able to remotely monitor everything that's happening at the gathering place.

threads.claim: Dougier has bought off Fortress guards, including possibly the overseer, which suggests an inside informant.
threads.quote: He must be in Dougier's pocket.

threads.claim: The Society's rules turn prisoners against each other through group punishment and rewards for informing.
threads.quote: Members are not permitted to speak to each other, or to leave without formal permission...

threads.claim: Society members have hollow thorns lodged in their heads, and it is unclear whether these can be removed.
threads.quote: they all have a hollow thorn inserted into a wound on their head.

threads.claim: Doctors say the hollow thorns can be extracted, so the members should be able to recover.
threads.quote: After taking a look, the doctors have let me know that it shouldn't be too difficult to extract the thorns.

threads.claim: Wriothesley was raised by adoptive parents who sold children as livestock, and he killed them and was exiled for it.
threads.quote: So, in the end, I killed them, and set all of the remaining children free.

threads.claim: Wriothesley presents the Fortress as a place of rebirth as well as confinement, a belief the story will test.
threads.quote: The Fortress is not only a place for confinement, but also a place for rebirth.

threads.claim: Wriothesley argues that prisoners keep the freedom to choose their own path and that fear destroys it.
threads.quote: they should always retain the freedom to choose their own path once they've reflected on their past misdeeds!

threads.claim: Wriothesley leaves Dougier in suspense about the timing and details of his punishment, which he will carry out in a creative way.
threads.quote: He'll be left in the dark with regards to both the dates and the details of his punishment.

threads.claim: The strange decommission requests and the missing Gardemeks are explained by Dougier's preparations for a confrontation with Wriothesley.
threads.quote: That would explain the strange decommission requests I received, as well as account for all the Gardemeks that had mysteriously gone missing.

threads.claim: Ei's pursuit of Eternity is presented as a value that outweighs mortal concerns.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Ei seeks eternity. To her, mortal lives come and go in the blink of an eye.

threads.claim: Ei admits she is still struggling to define the form Eternity should take.
threads.quote: As I said, I need to think about Inazuma's Eternity. And thinking takes time.

threads.claim: Ei suspects she may have been holding on to Eternity too tightly.
threads.quote: Perhaps... perhaps I've been holding on to everything too tightly.

threads.claim: The thunderstorm is said to represent the Shogun's will, and its change hints at her state.
threads.quote: Traveler: I hear that storm represents the Shogun's will.

threads.claim: Ei states the storm is a minor error that a small modification to the Shogun should fix.
threads.quote: It's just a minor error. This kind of thing was bound to happen. A small modification to the Shogun should fix it.

threads.claim: Since her defeat, the Shogun's temperament has reportedly changed drastically.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Since the battle, the Shogun has been greatly troubled and her temperament has changed drastically.

threads.claim: Yae's account blames the Shogun's outburst on losing desserts and books, which she disputes is credible.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Oh, the poor thing. Without desserts and books to console herself with, she was so angry she quite simply lost it.

threads.claim: Ei is running the Shogun puppet on old rules she wants to change, so their wills may diverge.
threads.quote: Ei: But the Shogun is still running based on her old rules. I can't allow her to make any more mistakes while I am working things out.

threads.claim: Ei explains the Shogun has a robust safeguard against modification, which is why she disables functions instead.
threads.quote: That's why the Shogun has a robust system to safeguard against modification.

threads.claim: Ei chose to isolate herself long ago, and the world has changed since then.
threads.quote: Back when I decided to isolate myself in the Plane of Euthymia, there was no Yae Publishing House, and certainly no stories of this kind.

threads.claim: Ei concedes that Inazuma's food and stories have changed despite her wish for an unchanging nation.
threads.quote: But the fact is that both the food and the stories have changed with time...

threads.claim: Ei accepts that human lives changing for the better need not be stopped by her pursuit of Eternity.
threads.quote: I do not wish for my pursuit of Eternity to stop human lives from changing for the better.

threads.claim: Ei is one being who can exist in many forms, including the Shogun and the photo.
threads.quote: I am me. There is only one of me, but I can exist in many different forms.

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission is in deep internal instability after the Kujou Clan lost control over other clans.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, the reality is that the Tenryou Commission is facing huge internal instability at the moment.

threads.claim: Ei decides to give the Kujou and Takatsukasa leaders more time despite still intending to punish them.
threads.quote: While she is still intent on punishing them, she decides to give them additional time.

threads.claim: Kujou Takayuki colluded with the Fatui, and his trial is still pending.
threads.quote: The Kujou Clan is still awaiting the Shogun's trial for colluding with the Fatui and nearly destroying the whole of Inazuma.

threads.claim: Paimon hints that Ei, like the Traveler, lacks Mora, a detail left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait a second. Ei... are you saying you don't have any Mora either?

threads.claim: Ei fears that the erosion of time is the greatest threat to eternity, and that she herself may change.
threads.quote: The greatest threat to eternity is still the erosion that comes with time.

threads.claim: Ei distinguishes herself from the Shogun, who never errs, by speaking as Ei when she apologizes.
threads.quote: The Shogun does not make mistakes — she is incapable of doing so. But I, as Ei, would like to offer my apologies.

threads.claim: The Shogun has a system that protects her against modification, and changing a puppet's operating rules is very hard.
threads.quote: As I said, the Shogun has a robust system to protect her against modification.

threads.claim: Ei seems to have begun understanding what form eternity should take, after the trip.
threads.quote: So. From what you were saying, it seems that she has finally begun to comprehend what form eternity should take?

threads.claim: Something more powerful than the gods may exist, possibly the human heart, which even The Seven cannot overcome.
threads.quote: there are things that even The Seven can't do when faced with something even more powerful than themselves.

threads.claim: Ei claims she needs no company, but Yae Miko says she secretly gets lonely.
threads.quote: She would never admit to it, but she does, in fact, get quite lonely.

threads.claim: Ei appoints the Tenryou Commissioner through a duel, and the succession is now an urgent matter.
threads.quote: The search for a successor to the role of Tenryou Commissioner is indeed a matter of great urgency...

threads.claim: The Kujou Clan's punishment is postponed, and Ei says she will give them a little more time.
threads.quote: Still... I will give them a little more time.

threads.claim: The Fatui once fed Ei deceptive information to flaw her judgment, a tactic others might try again.
threads.quote: if you still think you can copy the Fatui's strategy of providing me with deceptive information to produce flaws in my judgment...

threads.claim: Yae Miko says the Traveler does not belong to this world, and may be the company Ei needs.
threads.quote: But you don't belong to this world. Perhaps you are just the company she needs.

threads.claim: Ei senses something that does not belong in the outpost, and the Traveler is treated as an anomaly in eternity.
threads.quote: I feel something that doesn't belong here... I sense danger.

introduced.name: Boethius
introduced.how: Antagonist who claims to be a god of a new world and conducts the Symphony
introduced.quote: Boethius: Did you repair the broken aqueducts to celebrate my birth as the god of ancient days?

introduced.name: Harmost
introduced.how: Title of the conductor of the symphony, held by Boethius and formerly by Cassiodor
introduced.quote: Boethius: Why!? I am a Harmost! The conductor of the symphony! How? How did you...

introduced.name: Cassiodor
introduced.how: Former Harmost who turns against Boethius; the player learns he is the Monsieur Os figure
introduced.quote: Cassiodor: Have you forgotten? Before the Sebastos cut me away, I too was a Harmost!

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: Ancient nation of humans who became immortal and fell through arrogance
introduced.quote: Cassiodor: Are you not human yourself, Boethius? We Remurians were all ordinary Fontainians once.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: The Symphony's persona, an aggregate of all wishes that absorbed Boethius
introduced.quote: "Phobos": Thus, she entrusted her wisdom to Remus, and with the addition of the power that Remus possessed, the "Symphony" was created. That is to say, me.

introduced.name: Sybilla
introduced.how: Survivor of the last deluge who wished for human happiness and became Phobos's origin
introduced.quote: "Phobos": "Phobos," or should I say that-which-was-once-Sybilla, was originally a survivor of the last deluge that swallowed the earth.

introduced.name: Remus
introduced.how: Created the Symphony with Sybilla's wisdom and tried to destroy Phobos
introduced.quote: "Phobos": Remus... Yes, he did attempt to destroy me. But why?

introduced.name: Symphony
introduced.how: The great governing Symphony that controls all, formed from Sybilla's wisdom and Remus's power
introduced.quote: Cassiodor: "Phobos"... So, the great Symphony that governs all has a persona?

introduced.name: Domus Aurea
introduced.how: Golden palace-like machinery whose gates open when the melody is played
introduced.quote: Scylla: The gates of Domus Aurea shall swing open wide, just as they did when the golden waterways rang with song,

introduced.name: Scylla
introduced.how: Dragon of the waterways who was once a prince among Hydro Vishaps
introduced.quote: Scylla: Though, as one who was a prince amongst Hydro Vishaps, I should go forth and seek an audience with him...

introduced.name: Hydro Vishaps
introduced.how: Dragon kind to which Scylla once belonged as a prince
introduced.quote: Scylla: Though, as one who was a prince amongst Hydro Vishaps, I should go forth and seek an audience with him...

introduced.name: Osse
introduced.how: A cat that remains after Cassiodor vanishes, now called Osse
introduced.quote: Paimon: Whoa, big guy! You scared Osse!

introduced.name: Requiem
introduced.how: The final musical movement that sends trapped souls back to the High Sea
introduced.quote: Scylla: Perform this final movement, this final Requiem.

introduced.name: Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box
introduced.how: Device whose UI unlocks the sixth score, Lacrimosa, after the harp is played
introduced.quote: (Opens the Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box UI and unlocks the sixth score, "Lacrimosa")

introduced.name: Imperator
introduced.how: Ruler of Remuria, also called the Sebastos, who sacrificed himself to free his people from the Symphony
introduced.quote: Cassiodor: The Imperator aimed to free everyone from the Symphony, from hatred and strife, through his sacrifice.

assumed.name: Fortuna
assumed.quote: Cassiodor: We did not wish to be judged by Fortuna, much less to become your slaves.

assumed.name: Ichor
assumed.quote: Scylla: Now that the aqueducts are fixed, we simply need to release the stored Ichor in here, and the waterways shall be linked once more!

assumed.name: Remus's memories
assumed.quote: Paimon: Is this the place you saw in Remus's memories?

assumed.name: Monsieur Os
assumed.quote: Paimon: We don't know what's become of Monsieur Os, either...

assumed.name: Golden Hunter
assumed.quote: This world shall no longer have Cassiodor, nor shall it have the Golden Hunter.

assumed.name: Praetorian Golem
assumed.quote: (Several Praetorian Golems are activated and surround the wounded Boethius before executing him)

assumed.name: Masquerade of the Guilty
assumed.quote: (if the player has completed Masquerade of the Guilty)

assumed.name: Dragonborn
assumed.quote: Though it is hard to say if I still count as Dragonborn now.

assumed.name: Mr. Este
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, right! We should get back to Mr. Este to tell him that everything's fine now.

threads.claim: Phobos claims to be the aggregate of all wishes and says it absorbed Boethius, raising questions about its nature.
threads.quote: "Phobos": Well, he's become "us," of course. Or, put in a way you might understand, I ate him!

threads.claim: Remus tried to destroy Phobos, and Phobos claims it had no choice, leaving the true motive open.
threads.quote: "Phobos": Remus... Yes, he did attempt to destroy me. But why?

threads.claim: Completing Remus's final symphony is shown to send the trapped souls back to the High Sea.
threads.quote: Scylla: So long as we complete Remus's final symphony, we shall be able to send their souls back to the present, back to the High Sea...

threads.claim: Sybilla, a survivor of the last deluge, is revealed as the origin of Phobos and the Symphony.
threads.quote: "Phobos": "Phobos," or should I say that-which-was-once-Sybilla, was originally a survivor of the last deluge that swallowed the earth.

threads.claim: Monsieur Os is revealed as Cassiodor, who then vanishes along with Boethius and Phobos.
threads.quote: Paimon: Cassiodor... Monsieur Os, he... he's disappeared... along with Boethius and Phobos...

threads.claim: The cat Osse's connection to Monsieur Os and what he should be called remain unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon: And there's Osse, too... Hmm, what should we call him now? This could get complicated...

threads.claim: Remurians resented being judged by Fortuna, hinting at a larger fate-based conflict.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: We did not wish to be judged by Fortuna, much less to become your slaves.

threads.claim: Cassiodor frames the Imperator's golden ideal as the freedom to grasp one's own fate.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: The justice that our Sebastos... the Imperator gave unto us, that golden ideal, was for us to follow the melody of our hearts and obtain the freedom to grasp our fate.

threads.claim: Cassiodor says Remuria fell because its people forgot their origins and felt superior to other humans.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: But we forgot that. We forgot where we came from. Believed ourselves superior to other humans. That is why Remuria fell.

threads.claim: A new, true dragon has been born to Scylla's kindred, possibly linked to the Masquerade of the Guilty.
threads.quote: Scylla: As for my kindred and descendants, it seems that a new, true dragon has been born to us.

threads.claim: The Imperator's sacrifice to free everyone from the Symphony is shown to be carried out by Cassiodor.
threads.quote: Cassiodor: The Imperator aimed to free everyone from the Symphony, from hatred and strife, through his sacrifice.

introduced.name: Yuehui
introduced.how: A miner with a Mining Permit for The Chasm who posted the commission
introduced.quote: I'm Yuehui, a miner, and I received a Mining Permit for The Chasm just recently.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Former captain of Khaenri'ah's Royal Guard, known as the Twilight Sword, who witnessed the homeland's destruction
introduced.quote: Twilight Sword was my title as captain of the Royal Guards when I witnessed the destruction of my entire homeland firsthand.

introduced.name: Halfdan
introduced.how: A young Royal Guard elite from the cataclysm era who is now a spirit among the Knights
introduced.quote: I knew him as a young man, an elite in the Royal Guard of old... His name is "Halfdan."

introduced.name: Black Serpent Knights
introduced.how: Former Khaenri'ah Royal Guard now corrupted by the curse into mindless fighters
introduced.quote: Black Serpent Knights. They once belonged to the Royal Guard of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Inteyvat
introduced.how: Khaenri'ah's national flower, a symbol of a wanderer far from home
introduced.quote: So the Inteyvat is a symbol for a wanderer far from home, signifying the tenderness of the homeland.

introduced.name: Inverted City
introduced.how: An ancient upside-down city floating beneath The Chasm, older than Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: A whole city that's... floating in the air... upside down!?

introduced.name: Yujing Terrace
introduced.how: The authority that now permits limited ore mining in The Chasm near the surface
introduced.quote: Yes, the folks over at Yujing Terrace finally came to their senses and are now allowing a limited amount of ore mining near the surface.

introduced.name: Abyss portal network
introduced.how: Abyss portals connect to a network where exit points are chosen, not fixed
introduced.quote: I can only conclude that the Abyss's portals are not simply pathways from point A to point B, but gateways to an entire network.

introduced.name: Curse of immortality
introduced.how: The curse denies death to Khaenri'ah's people but slowly erodes body and soul
introduced.quote: The curse of "immortality" denies death to those afflicted with it...

introduced.name: Ancient water pool
introduced.how: A relic of an ancient civilization at the ruins' summit that weakens the curse
introduced.quote: The pool must be part of the entire city structure, a relic of this ancient civilization.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah's cataclysm
introduced.how: A divine catastrophe that destroyed Khaenri'ah and cursed its people, leaving only their national identity
introduced.quote: Against the might of the gods, the only identity that mattered was being from Khaenri'ah.

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: I'm inclined to think the Abyss Order is involved.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: When Dainsleif chased the Traveler's Sibling into a portal the last time they saw each other, the same thing happened to him then.

assumed.name: Teleport Waypoints
assumed.quote: Sounds kinda similar to how Teleport Waypoints work...

assumed.name: Defiled Statue
assumed.quote: The Defiled Statue.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah curse
assumed.quote: Oh! Paimon remembers, last time you guys were saying that Khaenri'ah's people were cursed to immortality or something...

assumed.name: Stormterror's Lair
assumed.quote: back in the ruins known as Stormterror's Lair.

assumed.name: Field Tiller
assumed.quote: whatever happened to the eye of the first Field Tiller?

assumed.name: Abyss Herald
assumed.quote: I came upon the trail of another Abyss Herald recently, and began pursuing it.

assumed.name: Loom of Fate
assumed.quote: The "Loom of Fate" operation is still underway.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: In focusing single-mindedly on confronting the Heavenly Principles, we neglected our original mission: the revival of the homeland.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order is revealed to be building a device to cleanse the hilichurls' curse and revive Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: It appears as if the Abyss Order plans to use this location to cleanse the hilichurls of their curse and restore them to the way they once were...

threads.claim: The curse of immortality erodes body and soul without true death, and cannot be undone.
threads.quote: The curse of "immortality" denies death to those afflicted with it...

threads.claim: Dainsleif intends to uncover the truth of the Loom of Fate operation before the Abyss Order can use it.
threads.quote: You can be sure that I will learn the truth of the "Loom of Fate" operation sooner than it could ever fall into the Abyss Order's hands.

threads.claim: Dainsleif and the Traveler's Sibling were travel partners searching for their fates but never finished the journey together.
threads.quote: We were travel partners.

threads.claim: Abyss portals form a network where the exit point is chosen by the Abyss rather than the traveler.
threads.quote: I can only conclude that the Abyss's portals are not simply pathways from point A to point B, but gateways to an entire network.

threads.claim: Halfdan's soul reveals that Khaenri'ah did not fall, so there is no need to revive the homeland.
threads.quote: Khaenri'ah... didn't fall, did it? Since you're still here...

threads.claim: The Traveler's Sibling has shifted focus to confronting the Heavenly Principles over the revival of the homeland.
threads.quote: In focusing single-mindedly on confronting the Heavenly Principles, we neglected our original mission: the revival of the homeland.

threads.claim: The eye of the first Field Tiller is in Dainsleif's possession, hidden in a safe place.
threads.quote: It's in a safe place.

threads.claim: A Black Serpent Knight has kept self-awareness for 500 years, which Dainsleif finds impossible without the curse's usual effect.
threads.quote: How could he have retained self-awareness for 500 years without... it?

threads.claim: The Inteyvat symbolizes the homeland, and its petals only soften again when returned to Khaenri'ah's soil.
threads.quote: So the Inteyvat is a symbol for a wanderer far from home, signifying the tenderness of the homeland.

threads.claim: The Inverted City may belong to a civilization older than Khaenri'ah, not the Abyss Order.
threads.quote: The closer we draw, the more I am inclined to conclude that these ruins belong to a more ancient civilization still.

threads.claim: The Black Serpent Knights keep fighting out of loyalty to Halfdan's final order to protect Khaenri'ah's people.
threads.quote: Inform all Black Serpent Knights to protect the people of Khaenri'ah at all costs.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: a brash, vocal oni with a street reputation, wanted for theft and kidnapping
introduced.quote: This particular oni is quite vocal and audacious, so he already has quite the reputation on the streets.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the authority that issued the arrest warrant and dispatched doushin to apprehend suspects
introduced.quote: The Tenryou Commission recently issued an arrest warrant for a young oni by the name of Arataki Itto.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: a gang led by Itto that is known on the streets
introduced.quote: This oni also happens to hold a Vision and is the leader of an organization known as the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Granny Oni
introduced.how: the old oni who raised Itto and is like family to him
introduced.quote: The old lady was Granny Oni. She's the one that took me in and raised me.

introduced.name: Daisuke
introduced.how: a boy Itto took in recently, who is part of his family
introduced.quote: And the kid's name is Daisuke, I took him in just a while back.

introduced.name: Sango
introduced.how: a detective who sells information and has already investigated for the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Oh, him again... Sure, I have answers.

introduced.name: Oni
introduced.how: horned people who are hard to get along with, with blue and crimson horn colors and a shared bloodline
introduced.quote: An oni? You mean those big tough-looking guys with horns on their heads?

introduced.name: Crimson and blue oni fairytale
introduced.how: a story of two oni friends, one who befriended humans by being chased off by the other
introduced.quote: There lived a crimson oni and a blue oni. They were the best of friends

introduced.name: Oath of the crimson and blue oni
introduced.how: the leaders swore an oath so the blue oni would play the evil oni and the crimson oni could integrate with humans, with two conditions
introduced.quote: Over drinks, they swore an oath. The blue oni would play the role of evil oni to help the crimson oni integrate into human society.

introduced.name: Oni factions split
introduced.how: the oni divided into crimson (friendly with humans) and blue (stubborn, keeping apart) factions
introduced.quote: Over time, the oni eventually split into two factions.

introduced.name: Onikabuto beetle fighting
introduced.how: a game where one beetle tries to flip the other onto its back
introduced.quote: The grand game of beetle fighting is a match where your beetle tries to flip the other beetle onto its back.

introduced.name: Oni allergy to beans
introduced.how: oni avoid beans, and Itto is so allergic that touching one incapacitates him
introduced.quote: In fact, all oni will avoid beans, but especially Itto.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: the Tenryou Commission confiscated Itto's Vision during this decree, which led to his revenge
introduced.quote: we, ahem, confiscated his Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree.

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: a way to track a Vision holder by revealing their footprints
introduced.quote: Why not see if you can track him down using Elemental Sight?

introduced.name: Masato
introduced.how: a merchant robbed by ronin who hid at the Watatsumi Army camp and is afraid of oni
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Yo! You must be Masato?

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: self-introduces as a descendant of the crimson oni who is hunting the blue oni
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: It's me. Arataki Itto, descendant of the crimson oni!

introduced.name: Blue oni
introduced.how: oni who are born knowing their fate is self-sacrifice and have lived hidden from the world
introduced.quote: Takuya: From the day we are born, every blue oni knows their purpose. We all know our fate is one of self-sacrifice.

introduced.name: Crimson oni
introduced.how: the oni who live openly in human society, of whom Itto is a descendant
introduced.quote: There lived a crimson oni and a blue oni

introduced.name: Ao
introduced.how: the blue oni friend of the crimson oni, who hid from him after leaving
introduced.quote: Dear Ao, I've made lots of human friends now

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the official force that detains criminals in human society and arrests oni
introduced.quote: Takuya: You're the ones in charge of detaining criminals in human society, right?

introduced.name: Ishizaki
introduced.how: a Tenryou Commission officer who leads the pursuit and makes the arrests
introduced.quote: Ishizaki: Takuya, based on the findings of our investigation...

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: Itto's gang of outcasts and misfits who follow him and act as his boys
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: As boss of the Arataki Gang, being rescued by my own boys feels... pretty humiliating.

introduced.name: Akira
introduced.how: an Arataki Gang member known for snoring
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Take Akira, for example, he snores like you wouldn't believe...

introduced.name: Genta
introduced.how: an Arataki Gang member with a bad temper
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Take Akira, for example, he snores like you wouldn't believe... Or Genta, he's got a serious temper problem...

introduced.name: Mamoru
introduced.how: an Arataki Gang member who is colorblind
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Take Akira, for example, he snores like you wouldn't believe... Or Genta, he's got a serious temper problem... And Mamoru, well, he's colorblind...

introduced.name: Granny Oni
introduced.how: the woman who took in Itto as a child and got her name from the townsfolk for it
introduced.quote: Granny Oni: Back when I took him in, everyone thought I was most unusual indeed. They started calling me Granny Oni.

introduced.name: Nogata
introduced.how: a ronin leader who rigs the hideout with explosives and claims it is his home turf
introduced.quote: Nogata: Bet you think you've won, don't ya?

introduced.name: Misuzu
introduced.how: Daisuke's mother, who was held hostage and searches for her son
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, you must be Daisuke's parents!

introduced.name: Sugimoto
introduced.how: Daisuke's father, who was held hostage with his family
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, you must be Daisuke's parents!

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: a small beetle that kids play with and fight, which Granny Oni compares Itto to
introduced.quote: Granny Oni: If you ask me, I'd say he's like one of those little Onikabuto you kids are playing with all the time.

introduced.name: paper charm
introduced.how: a rare paper charm whose torn half sets off the hideout's explosives
introduced.quote: Nogata: I'll tell you. It's now the critical component of a mechanism, and when it gets torn, this place goes up in smoke!

introduced.name: Fort Fujitou
introduced.how: a fort where the Watatsumi Army has a camp that gives shelter to Masato
introduced.quote: (Upon reaching Masato at the Watatsumi Army camp at Fort Fujitou)

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: an area where the ronin are often active
introduced.quote: Masato: I have no clue, but I think they're pretty active in the Tatarasuna area.

introduced.name: Nazuchi Beach
introduced.how: a beach that the ronin pass through
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: They gotta pass through here some time.

introduced.name: Yashiori Island
introduced.how: an island where Daisuke is being looked after after his rescue
introduced.quote: Someone's looking after him now on Yashiori Island.

introduced.name: blue oni sacrifice
introduced.how: the blue oni gave up their place so the crimson oni could live in human society and then went into hiding
introduced.quote: Takuya: The blue oni gave up everything! Just so the crimson oni could live peacefully in human society!

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Hi Katheryne, it's us!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: The Adventurers' Guild has recently received a commission directly from the Tenryou Commission.

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: also happens to hold a Vision

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: He's never had a Mora to his name his entire life

assumed.name: Doushin
assumed.quote: When the Tenryou Commission dispatched a doushin to apprehend him

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: If you wanted the Raiden Shogun's protection, you had to have a good relationship with the humans.

assumed.name: Kujou Sara
assumed.quote: we had to enlist the help of Kujou Sara to finally secure his Vision.

assumed.name: Sangonomiya troops
assumed.quote: The Tenryou Commission is unable to enter territory controlled by Sangonomiya troops.

assumed.name: Ronin
assumed.quote: He was the one I managed to save from the ronin after I sent them running from the scene.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Usually, you just hand over some Mora and they'll leave you alone.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: you let them get your Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree.

assumed.name: bean attack
assumed.quote: But I still haven't completely recovered from the bean attack earlier...

assumed.name: Oni
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Because we are oni, that's why. We share the same blood, brother.

assumed.name: pact between the oni factions
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: You remember the pact, don't ya? We're not supposed to suck up to the humans. We're supposed to earn their respect.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: the Inazuma of today wouldn't see you as a villain just because of the color of your horns.

assumed.name: Kairagi
assumed.quote: Ishizaki: We've dealt with the Kairagi and the people they took captive.

threads.claim: Sango says the blue oni disappeared long ago and are assumed extinct, which leaves their fate open.
threads.quote: Nobody knows how long it's been since the blue oni disappeared. We can only assume that they have long since died out

threads.claim: Itto reveals the blue oni clan may have survived, overturning the assumption that they were extinct.
threads.quote: Not once did I ever imagine that the blue oni clan had actually survived...

threads.claim: Itto reverses his earlier confession and now claims he did not commit the crimes, covering for someone else.
threads.quote: It wasn't me. Any of it.

threads.claim: Itto hints that a dangerous group stands behind the crimes, not just a single blue oni.
threads.quote: There's more to this than just one blue oni — there's a dangerous group behind everything that's been going on.

threads.claim: Sango suggests the oni bloodline carries volatile traits that may someday take over Itto.
threads.quote: But there are still some volatile personality traits in the oni bloodline.

threads.claim: Itto says the fairytale is not historically accurate and leaves out a harsher truth.
threads.quote: But the other details aren't historically accurate. Fairytales are nice stories, but there's something they leave out...

threads.claim: Itto explains that oni pride forbids wrongdoing, which is central to the blue oni's conditions.
threads.quote: Our pride does not allow for any wrongdoing.

threads.claim: The horn colors are explained as signs of which faction an oni belongs to, though they are one family.
threads.quote: We just paint our horns different colors to show which side we belong to.

threads.claim: Itto's Vision was confiscated in the Vision Hunt Decree, which may be the root of his grudge.
threads.quote: we, ahem, confiscated his Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree.

threads.claim: Daisuke's parents were taken by ronin, and Itto is working to get them back.
threads.quote: By the time he came back, his parents had been taken.

threads.claim: The blue oni were thought gone but have survived to the present, and Itto is determined to find them.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: No, you're wrong. I never knew that the blue oni had survived to this day — and the moment I found out, I was determined that I would find you.

threads.claim: The blue oni are fated from birth to sacrifice themselves for the crimson oni.
threads.quote: Takuya: From the day we are born, every blue oni knows their purpose. We all know our fate is one of self-sacrifice.

threads.claim: Takuya believes only his own sacrifice can restore his lost oni pride, while Itto insists sacrifice is the coward's way out.
threads.quote: Takuya: I've tarnished our oni pride and abandoned our ancestors' oath. Only sacrifice can restore my pride now!

threads.claim: The oni oath means earning human respect rather than deferring to humans, a principle Itto upholds.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: You remember the pact, don't ya? We're not supposed to suck up to the humans. We're supposed to earn their respect.

threads.claim: Takuya robs humans to feed and clothe the cut-off blue oni community, which he says is his real purpose.
threads.quote: Takuya: I've given everything that I've stolen from humans to my community.

threads.claim: One horned oni in the ronin gang secretly protected and fed the hostages, hinting he is not purely a villain.
threads.quote: Sugimoto: Um... No, actually, because one of the guys — the one with oni horns on his head — has always shielded us so far.

threads.claim: The crimson oni finds the hidden Ao, ending the long search and reuniting the two old friends.
threads.quote: Suddenly, he jumped: The crimson oni was right behind him!

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission pursues the oni and is ready to seize them.
threads.quote: Ishizaki: There they are! Seize them!

threads.claim: Takuya and Itto are formally arrested by the Tenryou Commission, ending the pursuit.
threads.quote: Ishizaki: Takuya, based on the findings of our investigation... I hereby announce that you are officially under arrest

threads.claim: Itto credits the blue oni sacrifice for letting oni and humans live side by side in Inazuma.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: It's only because of them that we have survived to see today, and built a world where oni and humans can live side by side.

threads.claim: The Traveler's unique circumstances are mentioned by the Tenryou Commission, implying they are special and possibly known to the authorities.
threads.quote: Ishizaki: But, given your unique circumstances, and in light of the complexity of this case, we won't press charges this time.

threads.claim: Granny Oni vows to take care of the blue oni herself, widening her role as a caretaker of oni.
threads.quote: Granny Oni: As for the blue oni, just leave them to me.

threads.claim: Granny Oni accepts the blue oni as more oni to look after, closing her part in the story.
threads.quote: Granny Oni: It looks like Granny Oni's about to get a few more oni to look after.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: A remnant of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's master now speaks, and the Traveler learns who he is
introduced.quote: Ann: Well, allow me to introduce Narzissenkreuz. Or, rather, what's left of Narzissenkreuz.

introduced.name: Rene
introduced.how: Narzissenkreuz's true name, revealed as he takes on a new identity
introduced.quote: Narzissenkreuz: ...Yes, I am Rene. This is who I am now.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Fontaine's leading engineer who designed Seymour
introduced.quote: Seymour: Indeed. My designer, Alain Guillotin, is Fontaine's leading engineer, and the components I am made of represent the best of the nation's material science and craftsmanship.

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: An artist who is Seymour's owner and mistress
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann: Perhaps not. We will be taking a trip to explore this world. And Ms. Mamere is an artist, isn't she?

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Institute
introduced.how: The former home of Mary-Ann and Rene
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann: The Narzissenkreuz Institute was our home. Why did things turn out this way?

introduced.name: Genesis of a Certain Micro-Universe
introduced.how: A self-built universe Narzissenkreuz made inside himself to resist his fate
introduced.quote: Narzissenkreuz: During the years that followed, I used that potent will to construct a universe within myself to resist my coming fate. That is how I held on.

introduced.name: Annapausis
introduced.how: Mary-Ann's dream-home, a place the Traveler can reshape
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann: Please, stop! I'm begging you! Stay away! This is our Annapausis.

introduced.name: Will to Resist
introduced.how: A hard barrier made of will that blocks the way inside
introduced.quote: Narzissenkreuz: This barrier is composed of an extremely hard and resistant will.

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: A blade that can cut through any will that comes from water
introduced.quote: Paimon: If Paimon remembers correctly, the Holy Blade should be able to cut through any will that comes from water...

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: A village of Melusines who can understand Mamere's new paintings
introduced.quote: Mamere: I think it will be easier to understand! Even the Melusines of Merusea Village can tell what I'm painting now, rather than just saying "Oh, how lovely!"

introduced.name: Ann's dream-character origin
introduced.how: Ann was a character in someone's dream, and her powers come from that origin
introduced.quote: Ann: Even after learning the truth — that I was just a character in someone's dream — I have no regrets.

introduced.name: Red Empress
introduced.how: A dreamer whose dream Liddell and others are figments of
introduced.quote: Ann: Liddell is also nothing more than a figment of the Red Empress' dream. And this time, it's time to wake up.

introduced.name: Lyris
introduced.how: A past Oceanid persona whose memories Mary-Ann carries
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann: And I must slowly step away from the looming shadow of my past. Neither Lyris's memories nor Mary-Ann Guillotin's represent who I am now.

assumed.name: Ann
assumed.quote: Ann: Are you ready to leave?

assumed.name: Caterpillar
assumed.quote: Caterpillar: I knew you'd come back in one piece.

assumed.name: Seymour
assumed.quote: Paimon: And we're glad that you and Seymour are okay!

assumed.name: Mary-Ann
assumed.quote: Paimon: Alright! Let's go find Mary-Ann!

assumed.name: Director
assumed.quote: Narzissenkreuz: Ah, so that's what happened to the Director and Mary-Ann.

assumed.name: Oceanid
assumed.quote: Narzissenkreuz: Oceanid Ann — can you do what I said?

assumed.name: Narcissus
assumed.quote: Paimon: Uh, if we can't get in, then we can't get to that dizzying corridor and room, and can't jump down to that place where we fought Narcissus...

assumed.name: Jakob
assumed.quote: Mary-Ann: Just like when you and Jakob would tell me about what you saw in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Mass Annihilation Mode
assumed.quote: Ann: Silly dog, you're not going to initiate your Mass Annihilation Mode again, are you?

threads.claim: Ann's origins are a truth that must be uncovered at Annapausis.
threads.quote: Traveler: Please take Ann to find out the truth about her origins.

threads.claim: Ann learns she was a character in someone's dream, and accepts it.
threads.quote: Ann: Even after learning the truth — that I was just a character in someone's dream — I have no regrets.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz's true identity is withheld and interrupted.
threads.quote: Narzissenkreuz: That is correct. I am Narzissenkr—

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz reveals himself as Rene.
threads.quote: Narzissenkreuz: ...Yes, I am Rene. This is who I am now.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann may be Lyris, and her identity is unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: You know, sometimes you say "I" and sometimes you say "we"... Are you really Mary-Ann, or are you Lyris, the Oceanid they're always talking about?

threads.claim: Mary-Ann chooses to live as herself, accepting her past without being defined by it.
threads.quote: Mary-Ann: I will live on as myself and see what the world you risked everything to save is like, Rene.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz questions whether the world has meaning and urges the Traveler to imbue it with meaning.
threads.quote: Narzissenkreuz: Some believe the world to be only a prison of suffering, devoid of meaning. But you wield power over this place. So, rewrite it — imbue it with meaning.

threads.claim: Becoming the master of one's own fate is posed as a goal for Seymour.
threads.quote: Mary-Ann: Yes. Seymour, I hope you can become the "master of your own fate" — that in the future, you will do what you "want" to do, and what you think is right.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says mastering one's fate means always doing what one wants.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: If you always do what you want to do, you'll become the master of your fate.

threads.claim: Caterpillar is unsure whether he is the butterfly or the butterfly is him, hinting at a past life.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: There were times when I wondered whether the butterfly became me, or I became the butterfly.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz is running out of power and cannot last much longer.
threads.quote: Narzissenkreuz: I have expended too much of my power. I shall not remain able to maintain myself for long.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz gives up his remaining strength and leaves the Traveler and Ann.
threads.quote: Narzissenkreuz: I grow weary. Ann, please leave me here.

threads.claim: Seymour struggles to choose between staying with Mary-Ann and accompanying Mamere.
threads.quote: Seymour: I wish to remain by your side, Ms. Mary-Ann. But I also wish to accompany Ms. Mamere. However, I calculate that the spatial requirements of those two wishes are incompatible.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: is revealed to be the Archon Rex Lapis who sealed gods with spears at Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Guyun Stone Forest, where I sealed many gods with my spears...

introduced.name: Kliment
introduced.how: a Snezhnaya archaeological researcher who claims to be a legitimate, non-threatening outsider
introduced.quote: Kliment: Ugh... There's no need to overreact, now. I'm simply an archaeological research from Snezhnaya, I'm not here for trouble.

introduced.name: Wanyan
introduced.how: not a real archaeologist but a salt-industry member of Yinyuan Hall under the Qixing
introduced.quote: Wanyan: You're right. I'm not a scholar of archaeology. I come from one of the Eight Trades under the jurisdiction of the Qixing — Yinyuan Hall of the salt industry.

introduced.name: Hanxue
introduced.how: a self-described professional archaeologist writing a treatise on the first Mora
introduced.quote: Hanxue: This good sir seems to not appreciate the almighty power of the Lord of Geo. As a professional archaeologist, I am to correct some of his erroneous views.

introduced.name: Havria
introduced.how: the God of Salt, described as a kind god whose followers revered her, killed by Morax according to Wanyan
introduced.quote: Wanyan: The God of Salt, Havria, was a very kind god, but she encountered Morax one day in battle...

introduced.name: Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: rock formations that are remnants of stone spears Rex Lapis hurled into the sea at the Overlord of the Vortex
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Legend has it that Rex Lapis threw spears made of large rock into the sea here, piercing and crushing the Overlord of the Vortex.

introduced.name: Sal Terrae
introduced.how: a cave area once the home of the God of Salt's people, named after her, with a sealed ruin
introduced.quote: Wanyan: About that, I know there's a ruin deep in this cave here. It's related to the God of Salt, which is actually how the area originally got its name of Sal Terrae.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the Liyue body where outside researchers register their surveys
introduced.quote: Kliment: But this time, I registered with the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs. I could show you official documentation if you want to see it.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: a business that employs Zhongli out as a paid consultant
introduced.quote: Kliment: I heard that Wangsheng Funeral Parlor had a consultant named Zhongli with immense knowledge of ancient history and archaeology.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: a catalyst used in mystic arts to enhance weapons, as well as currency
introduced.quote: Hanxue: Mora is a catalyst — this we all know. Even today, Mora is used in the mystic arts for its curious properties of weapon enhancement.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: an ancient war among the gods for control of Teyvat that ravaged Liyue
introduced.quote: Zhongli: During the Archon War, the gods of this world used all their strength and cunning to vie for control of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Salinized followers
introduced.how: the white salt statues are actually Havria's followers turned to salt, not statues
introduced.quote: Zhongli: No. These are people.

introduced.name: Osial
introduced.how: Overlord of the Vortex, a defeated god returned to the ocean prison of sealed gods
introduced.quote: Zhongli: This includes Osial, Overlord of the Vortex, who the Jade Chamber most recently returned to this ocean prison...

introduced.name: Wrath of the Rock
introduced.how: Rex Lapis's decree that those who break contracts will suffer the Wrath of the Rock
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Rex Lapis once said: "Ones who break their contracts shall suffer the Wrath of the Rock."

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Fatui say that every time.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Zhongli: That's not an ancient teacup. It's part of Ningguang's collection, it must have fallen here along with the Jade Chamber. So unless you want to mess with the Qixing...

assumed.name: Qixing
assumed.quote: Wanyan: For example, perhaps the Qixing who control Liyue use it in some kind of unknown ceremony they hold when they come to power...

assumed.name: Lord of Geo
assumed.quote: Paimon: This doesn't sound like something the Lord of Geo would do, though...

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Zhongli: Guyun Stone Forest is actually the perfect place to be if you wish to learn about the Archons or the history of the Archon War.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Zhongli: It is a story from before the rise of The Seven...

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Zhongli: But this legend has been around for ages. With the countless scrap collectors and Treasure Hoarders in the area, there probably aren't many valuable things left here.

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Wanyan: When I investigated this seal last time, I had someone with a Vision accompany me.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Zhongli: The adepti have presently handed Liyue over to mortals, and Havria's time was even further in the past.

threads.claim: The whereabouts and nature of the world's first Mora are disputed, with Hanxue claiming it enhanced a dagger and a sword.
threads.quote: Hanxue: We are discussing the whereabouts of the first Mora.

threads.claim: Zhongli argues the first Mora was just an ordinary coin that was spent, contradicting Hanxue's theory.
threads.quote: Zhongli: The world's first Mora is probably just an ordinary coin created by Rex Lapis. As for its fate? The same as all Mora, I suspect — it was simply spent somewhere.

threads.claim: Wanyan claims Morax treacherously assassinated Havria, a accusation the Traveler cannot yet verify.
threads.quote: Wanyan: Morax used a rather underhanded trick to... assassinate her.

threads.claim: The broken sword is revealed as the weapon used to kill Havria, deepening the question of what really happened.
threads.quote: Zhongli: This sword is not a relic belonging to the God of Salt... but is instead the murder weapon used to kill her.

threads.claim: A ruin in Sal Terrae is sealed by an unknown power, and its origin and purpose are unknown.
threads.quote: Wanyan: However, the ruin entrance has been sealed by a mysterious power. Nobody has been able to break the seal.

threads.claim: The seal is broken by activating the monuments in the riddle's order, revealing the ruin's hidden truth.
threads.quote: Wanyan: Look! The seal really was broken! Mr. Zhongli is indeed quite remarkable!

threads.claim: The salt statues are unexplained and their cause remains hidden.
threads.quote: Zhongli: No. These are people.

threads.claim: The salinized followers are explained as transformed by the power released when Havria was slain.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Those who could not flee were thus transformed.

threads.claim: Zhongli hints that he is the ancient Archon Rex Lapis who sealed gods long ago.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Guyun Stone Forest, where I sealed many gods with my spears...

threads.claim: History can be changed over time, and Zhongli seeks a better way to preserve the truth.
threads.quote: Zhongli: History records, but history may be changed. This incident proved that. Time is a mighty force, and histories twist in its flow...

threads.claim: Zhongli enlists the Traveler to preserve Teyvat's history in their memory as a backup.
threads.quote: Zhongli: As long as a Traveler like you is able to record what happened, then a backup of sorts will exist for times and tides of Teyvat.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's rule that contract-breakers suffer the Wrath of the Rock is a recurring theme of justice and contracts.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Rex Lapis once said: "Ones who break their contracts shall suffer the Wrath of the Rock."

threads.claim: Osial is sealed in the sea and could one day regain strength, though Zhongli believes he would be defeated again.
threads.quote: Zhongli: If a day comes when he should recover his strength and return... Ha, I believe that even so, he will be defeated once more.

introduced.name: Nabil
introduced.how: A Matra in the Akademiya who asks for help with the smuggling case
introduced.quote: My name is Nabil, I'm a matra in the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: The Akademiya's order of officials, whose members handle cases like this
introduced.quote: The person introduces himself as Nabil, a Matra.

introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.how: Knowledge Capsules that deliver knowledge instantly, banned and smuggled, with risks of overuse
introduced.quote: But with Canned Knowledge, one may simply skip all the hassle and get whatever they need to know immediately.

introduced.name: Court of Desolation
introduced.how: An ancient ruin from King Deshret's age that is said to let people see beyond life and death, with research banned
introduced.quote: Rumor has it that it's a site of ruins from the age of King Deshret.

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: A merchant who used to sell Canned Knowledge and knows the smuggling trade
introduced.quote: I see, I see... So that's the latest scoop! Heh, good thing you didn't rat me out.

introduced.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
introduced.how: Where Dori is usually found
introduced.quote: If Paimon remembers correctly, she's usually at the Palace of Alcazarzaray.

introduced.name: Desert auction
introduced.how: A planned auction in the desert selling Canned Knowledge tied to the Court of Desolation
introduced.quote: Word on the street is that there'll be an auction taking place in the desert.

introduced.name: Jhuba
