introduced.how: A hired Eremite leader who warns Cyno off and attacks to stop him entering the desert
introduced.quote: Hold it right there. Heading to the desert, are we?

introduced.name: Taj Radkani
introduced.how: A well-respected Matra, Cyno's former superior, injured on a past mission and now in an administrative role
introduced.quote: His name is Taj Radkani, a very well-respected matra. You will have the chance to meet him someday.

introduced.name: Murtada Radkani
introduced.how: Taj's only son, who investigated the Court of Desolation, was imprisoned, and later died by suicide
introduced.quote: Utayba tells them that Murtada was Taj's only son and was sent to prison for investigating the Court of Desolation.

introduced.name: Bahari
introduced.how: A smuggler caught at the auction site who then explains his family's situation
introduced.quote: Bahari admits having returned to take whatever he could as everyone fled upon learning that Cyno was coming, having believed that he had been working alone.

introduced.name: Simin
introduced.how: Bahari's daughter, who has a chronic illness and is shy of strangers
introduced.quote: This is my daughter, Simin. She can be a little shy of strangers.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: A group whose unlicensed tracking devices were used to follow the Traveler
introduced.quote: A miniature tracking device made by the Kshahrewar.

introduced.name: Miniature tracking device
introduced.how: A Kshahrewar device planted on the Traveler that reveals approximate location
introduced.quote: They can use this to discern your approximate location.

introduced.name: Restricted Repository
introduced.how: a heavily guarded archive where dangerous forbidden research files are kept as warnings to later researchers
introduced.quote: Such information is kept in the Restricted Repository, which is heavily guarded.

introduced.name: matra
introduced.how: the Akademiya's investigators who stop dangerous research and track down criminals
introduced.quote: It's the job of the matra to find the truth and track down criminals.

introduced.name: Court of Desolation
introduced.how: a hidden ruin that scholars have secretly researched despite repeated bans, with unknown location
introduced.quote: Despite repeated prohibitions, research on the Court of Desolation in the past decade has increased without ceasing.

introduced.name: Entering the Court of Desolation comes at the price of one's life.
introduced.how: an ancient inscription that scholars interpret as a key to entry or a requirement for the Court to appear
introduced.quote: Entering the Court of Desolation comes at the price of one's life.

introduced.name: Murtada Radkani
introduced.how: Taj's only son, a researcher who was caught studying the Court of Desolation
introduced.quote: Murtada Radkani was Taj's only son.

introduced.name: Taj Radkani
introduced.how: a veteran matra with a great reputation, once Cyno's partner, who retired to administrative work
introduced.quote: He used to be Cyno's only partner.

introduced.name: Murtada's arrest and suicide
introduced.how: Taj jailed his son for studying the Court of Desolation, and Murtada took his own life in prison
introduced.quote: Taj arrested his son and put him behind bars.

introduced.name: seven scholars arrest
introduced.how: seven Akademiya researcher, including Murtada, were arrested, stalling Court of Desolation research
introduced.quote: seven scholars — including Murtada Radkani — were arrested

introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.how: forbidden research files converted into a form that can be understood instantly, which lets people restart research outside the Akademiya
introduced.quote: However, if the files were made into Canned Knowledge, they could be understood immediately.

introduced.name: smuggling organization
introduced.how: a large secret organization of people from every walk of life, with members inside the Akademiya, funding dangerous research
introduced.quote: People from every walk of life are involved.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: an Akademiya research group whose members used to sell scrap machines to traveling merchants
introduced.quote: The Kshahrewar used to often sell scrap machines to traveling merchants

introduced.name: paralysis pollen trap
introduced.how: a plant-based trap that grows rapidly and releases paralyzing pollen when thrown into mud
introduced.quote: This is a type of trap I've been working on which uses plants.

introduced.name: Court of Desolation collapse
introduced.how: Taj sacrifices himself, and the Court collapses and is buried under sand
introduced.quote: Sand pours in, completely burying Taj and the rest of the Court of Desolation

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: (Approach the marked area in the Akademiya)

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Nabil: Currently, Cyno is out investigating a case involving smuggled Canned Knowledge.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Amainu: 150k. Show us the Mora, and you'll get the goods.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: (After defeating the Eremites)

assumed.name: Caravan Ribat
assumed.quote: Cyno: If you manage to learn anything, you can find me at Caravan Ribat.

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: Cyno: Partially. It was a secret place built by a dark sect from the age of King Deshret.

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Nabil: Last we heard from Cyno, he was investigating somewhere outside Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: The Traveler soon finds Cyno with Tighnari, who gives him some paralyzing traps in the future should he need them, as he had no use for them.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Tighnari also reveals to the Traveler and Paimon that he sent Collei out for some ad hoc lectures about the dangers of Canned Knowledge to increase awareness.

assumed.name: Nabil
assumed.quote: Hello, we meet again.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Oh, so you were able to find Cyno, after all! I hope he's doing alright.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Granted, the Akademiya is very supportive when it comes to research.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Trying to single-handedly bring 300 people to justice must feel pretty exhilarating.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Collei has always been a little wary of you, and your stern expression certainly isn't helping.

assumed.name: Simin
assumed.quote: Cyno asked me to collect some medicinal herbs to treat a girl named Simin.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: A few Eremites showed up looking for Taj yesterday, and he met with them in his office.

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: Why don't you play more Genius Invokation TCG, huh?

assumed.name: Avidya Forest
assumed.quote: the three of you can find me in the Avidya Forest

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: someone was about to escape to Fontaine

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: pouring countless Mora into secret research

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: He lives just on the outskirts of Sumeru City.

threads.claim: The Court of Desolation is said to grant sight beyond life and death, and its research is banned.
threads.quote: Rumor has it that it's a site of ruins from the age of King Deshret.

threads.claim: Legends say the Court's treasures could even resurrect the dead, drawing researchers despite the ban.
threads.quote: Cyno: After all, legends claim that whoever obtains the treasures inside can see beyond life and death, or even resurrect the dead.

threads.claim: Someone inside the Akademiya may be enabling the smuggling of Canned Knowledge.
threads.quote: Cyno: Small producers couldn't possibly support such a large quantity of goods. Hmm, could the Akademiya have a hand in this?

threads.claim: A matra is revealed to be behind the smuggling, since the matra seal let goods leave without a second inspection.
threads.quote: Cyno: Hmph, no wonder they don't want me to investigate. It turns out that a matra is behind this.

threads.claim: Taj's son Murtada died by suicide after being imprisoned for investigating the Court, leaving Taj devastated.
threads.quote: He then committed suicide shortly afterwards, leaving Taj devastated.

threads.claim: The tracking device was unlicensed, raising the question of whether someone in the Kshahrewar is involved.
threads.quote: Cyno: But this device wasn't licensed for mass production. Where did they get it...

threads.claim: Large amounts of Canned Knowledge may have serious consequences that most people have not realized.
threads.quote: According to some research, using large amounts of Canned Knowledge could lead to some serious consequences, and unfortunately, most people have yet to realize that.

threads.claim: Excess use of Knowledge Capsules dulls the mind and makes flawed knowledge hard to correct.
threads.quote: Dori: And second, excess use of Knowledge Capsules over an extended time diminishes your ability to think.

threads.claim: Some smugglers sell Canned Knowledge out of desperation, as a means of paying for medical care.
threads.quote: Bahari: There are many others like me. Smuggling Canned Knowledge might seem like an unforgivable crime to you, but to us, it's a means of survival.

threads.claim: Bahari's daughter has a chronic illness that the smuggling money pays to treat.
threads.quote: Bahari: My daughter was born with a chronic disease, so she has a relatively weak heart and lungs.

threads.claim: Mercenaries hired by the smugglers may return to ambush Cyno and his companions.
threads.quote: Jhuba: You're in over your head, Cyno. There will be others coming for you. You'll regret it!

threads.claim: Legends say treasures inside the Court of Desolation can bring the dead back to life.
threads.quote: According to the legends, the treasures inside the Court of Desolation could allow someone beyond life and death, or even bring the dead back to life, right?

threads.claim: Cyno rejects the revival claim and calls the treasures myths and legend.
threads.quote: In the end, the treasures you seek are nothing but myths and legend.

threads.claim: Taj is suspected of being the culprit behind the smuggling of Canned Knowledge.
threads.quote: But if you claim that the Canned Knowledge was originating from the Akademiya, then Taj is indeed a suspect.

threads.claim: Taj's apparent guilt was a deliberate test and staged act to bring the organization to justice.
threads.quote: So you pretended to be the one behind all this as a test for me?

threads.claim: Taj's sacrifice appears to fulfill the inscription's price of life needed to open the Court of Desolation.
threads.quote: To open the Court of Desolation, one must sacrifice their life

threads.claim: Taj seals the Court of Desolation by burying it in sand, ending its cycle of tragedy.
threads.quote: Let it be buried beneath the sand forever.

threads.claim: A massive organization of over 300 people, including celebrities, is running a smuggling operation.
threads.quote: The whole operation involves more than 300 people, including dozens of celebrities!

threads.claim: Cyno warns the organization will search for another target once its Court of Desolation effort fails.
threads.quote: it won't be long before they continue searching for another target.

threads.claim: Cyno brings over 300 suspects to judgment on his own.
threads.quote: He brought over 300 suspects to judgment all on his own.

threads.claim: Taj's grief and regret over Murtada drive his plan to reunite with his son at the Court.
threads.quote: Finding this place was his biggest wish.

threads.claim: Cyno questions whether people can change and whether his own change will come slowly.
threads.quote: I just hope my own change will come slowly, so that I can press on a little further...

threads.claim: Canned Knowledge is still sought by curious people even after the criminals were caught.
threads.quote: Although we've apprehended all the criminals behind the recent smuggling case, there are many people who are still curious and seek Canned Knowledge.

threads.claim: A merchant demanded 1,250,000 Mora from Cyno for an unexplained Desert Travel Kit.
threads.quote: A merchant approached me and requested that I cover the cost of a "Desert Travel Kit." One million, two hundred and fifty thousand Mora.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: a society with membership levels whose members pursue its teachings and research
introduced.quote: Madam M. Laveaux, formal Narzissenkreuz Ordo member, Level 4.

introduced.name: Institute of Natural Philosophy
introduced.how: a scholarly institute that later disbanded, whose historian joined the Ordo
introduced.quote: A famous historian from the Institute of Natural Philosophy who has dabbled in the study of various ancient civilizations.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: an ancient civilization whose script researchers are trying to decipher
introduced.quote: This time, we unearthed a great number of antediluvian bronze slates and stone tablets, which all use ancient Remurian script...

introduced.name: clockwork meka
introduced.how: old security automatons left in the tower when it was sealed, which can still be activated
introduced.quote: These must be the security installations that were left behind when the tower was sealed.

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz (Search in the Algae Sea)
introduced.how: a relic believed to be the key that opens the final Seal
introduced.quote: If the design from back then is accurate, the Holy Blade itself is the key that will open the final Seal.

introduced.name: Fortuna
introduced.how: an ancient subject known only from myth and poetry, not from hard evidence
introduced.quote: Myth, proverbs, and poetry are all that we have compiled so far in connection to "Fortuna."

introduced.name: True Will
introduced.how: an ancient spiritual state closest to the perfect freedom of divinities
introduced.quote: Among these, the state that came closest to the perfect freedom that divinities possessed was named "True Will"...

introduced.name: Tower of Ipsissimus
introduced.how: a tower that sinks to the sea floor once its mechanism is activated
introduced.quote: (A short cutscene plays — the Tower of Ipsissimus continues to sink until it reaches the sea floor)

introduced.name: red and yellow principles
introduced.how: red is the foundational goal, the philosopher's stone, while yellow stands for gold and temptation
introduced.quote: "Red" is the foundational principle, the philosopher's stone, while "yellow" represents gold and mortal temptation.

assumed.name: Petit Chou
assumed.quote: After learning the truth, I can never go back to Petit Chou and Al.

assumed.name: Al
assumed.quote: After learning the truth, I can never go back to Petit Chou and Al.

assumed.name: Mary-Ann
assumed.quote: If I can see Ms. Mary-Ann again, I hope...

assumed.name: Jakob
assumed.quote: The chime of a bell holds a special meaning even for people like Jakob and Narzissenkreuz.

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz
assumed.quote: The fact is, however, that Mr. Ingold and Master Narzissenkreuz always get the "lucky" reward whenever they purchase her scones and cookies

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Traveler: Will you go see Lanoire once this is all over?

assumed.name: Canotila and the Book of Revealing
assumed.quote: After listening to what Jakob said, I did recall a "Book of Revealing" related to their activities in their early years.

assumed.name: Mamere
assumed.quote: I hope she will agree to visit Mamere with me, and then the three of us can travel the world together.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: However, Khaenri'ah would likely seek the truth for gold's sake before turning that truth into a bread production pipeline...

assumed.name: Gardemeks
assumed.quote: Traveler: About the Gardemeks...

assumed.name: Golden Troupe (Faction)
assumed.quote: Most of the texts previously discovered in older Golden Troupe ruins and legacy copies we got from collections were all from Fontaine's early nation-building stage or later.

assumed.name: Caterpillar
assumed.quote: Caterpillar: There are some of Narzissenkreuz's notes and books here. Interesting as they may be, none of them have a conclusion.

assumed.name: Seymour
assumed.quote: Seymour: Everyone, the door to the next level seems to be locked.

assumed.name: Ann
assumed.quote: Ann: Both Caterpillar and Seymour are helping out, but I don't seem to be of any use now.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann and Narzissenkreuz are described as living in dreams, and waking from a dream is framed as a choice.
threads.quote: Paimon: Mary-Ann weaves a dream encircling everyone, and Narzissenkreuz is living in his dream of saving the world.

threads.claim: The chime of a bell or clock is hinted to signal the end of the world or of the dream.
threads.quote: When the clock chimes, all shall end.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann may have been the same person as Liddell, not a separate figure.
threads.quote: Mary-Ann, whom people often mistake Liddell for... But could it not be that they were, at first, one and the same?

threads.claim: Caterpillar hopes the Book of Revealing will show clues about their own past.
threads.quote: Maybe I'll be able to find some clues about myself in there.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz's version of salvation may differ from the world's and be dangerous.
threads.quote: Or perhaps Narzissenkreuz's version of salvation?

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah's pursuit of truth is tied to alchemical gold and a final red goal.
threads.quote: However, Khaenri'ah would likely seek the truth for gold's sake before turning that truth into a bread production pipeline...

threads.claim: The ancients pursued True Will, yet could not escape what appeared to be their preordained fate.
threads.quote: Despite this remarkable achievement, they were unable to escape their fate, which appeared preordained...

threads.claim: Fortuna is known only through myth and poetry, and researchers doubt the ancients' beliefs about it.
threads.quote: Myth, proverbs, and poetry are all that we have compiled so far in connection to "Fortuna."

threads.claim: Researchers have made a first step in deciphering Remurian script but have a long way to go.
threads.quote: It's the first step in a long journey, but we have already surpassed all previous scholars of the esoteric...

threads.claim: The ancients believed moral decay chained the will to the body and enslaved humanity to flesh.
threads.quote: Following moral decay, the will became shackled to bodily form...

threads.claim: The Holy Blade is said to be the key that opens the final Seal.
threads.quote: If the design from back then is accurate, the Holy Blade itself is the key that will open the final Seal.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz's reason for sealing the tower and leaving it behind is hinted but left unexplained.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: Why he simply closed the door and quietly left.

threads.claim: The clockwork meka below may or may not activate, and their state is uncertain.
threads.quote: Seymour: At that point, around 60% of them will activate successfully.

threads.claim: Seymour has permissions that would let them act against official armed forces if attacked.
threads.quote: Seymour: When the two of you are attacked, my permissions will activate, authorizing me to take action against official armed forces.

threads.claim: The key found in the tower resolves the locked door blocking the lower level.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: Indeed, and Seymour's already used sonic imaging to do a rough analysis. It really is the key to that door.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Liyue Qixing General Secretary; half-adeptus with qilin blood who feels unwelcome in Liyue
introduced.quote: Baiwen: It has been several days since Ganyu left for Jueyun Karst. She's the General Secretary of the Liyue Qixing.

introduced.name: Baixiao
introduced.how: one of Ningguang's private secretaries, who covers Ganyu's work
introduced.quote: Baixiao: Ahem... We are Ms. Ningguang's private secretaries, not servants.

introduced.name: Baishi
introduced.how: one of Ningguang's private secretaries, overwhelmed by Ganyu's workload
introduced.quote: Baishi: Well... It's because of this absurd workload of hers!

introduced.name: Baiwen
introduced.how: one of Ningguang's private secretaries who asks the Traveler to find Ganyu
introduced.quote: Baiwen: Have you seen Ms. Ganyu, Traveler?

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: adeptus in Mt. Aocang who sets Ganyu's training and shares her childhood
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Who disturbs the peace of these mountains?

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: the Conqueror of Demons, a stern loner who runs Ganyu's final trial at Nantianmen
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh! So it's Xiao! That cold-hearted loner? How come he's prepared a trial for you?

introduced.name: Xin Cheng
introduced.how: a materialistic pilgrim who asks the adepti for luck, wealth and a career
introduced.quote: Xin Cheng: Great! My name's Xin Cheng. I came to ask for your merciful blessings, O adepti! I beg of you, please grant me luck, wealth, and a good career!

introduced.name: Uncle Tian
introduced.how: a veteran Qixing member who keeps his identity secret and strolls the harbor unguarded
introduced.quote: Uncle Tian: Hush, now... I must ask for your discretion concerning my identity.

introduced.name: Huixin
introduced.how: Uncle Tian's daughter, a Yuehai Pavilion secretary and Ganyu's junior
introduced.quote: Ganyu: Yes, she works at Yuehai Pavilion, and she's my junior. How can I help her?

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: owner of Wanyou Boutique who is rivals with Dongsheng
introduced.quote: Ganyu: Let's start with Wanyou Boutique. The owner's name is... Bolai, isn't it?

introduced.name: Dongsheng
introduced.how: owner of Second Life who is caught evading taxes on furniture bought from Fanmu Carpenter's
introduced.quote: Bolai: Ugh... That rascal Dongsheng, he's stealing all of my customers.

introduced.name: Master Lu
introduced.how: carpenter at Fanmu Carpenter's who keeps old invoices in a warehouse
introduced.quote: Master Lu: Ah, welcome, welcome. How can an old carpenter like me help you?

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: Liyue's governing council, which sent Ganyu as envoy to the adepti
introduced.quote: Baixiao: They commissioned Ganyu as their envoy to deliver a letter to Jueyun Karst and bring the adepti the latest news about the crisis.

introduced.name: Tianshu
introduced.how: a title held by a Qixing member, the secret rank Uncle Tian holds
introduced.quote: Uncle Tian is a member of the Liyue Qixing, the "Tianshu."

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: powerful beings who denounced Liyue and later made peace with the Qixing
introduced.quote: Ah, even though the Qixing have made peace with the adepti after the latter had denounced Liyue, they still want to pay their respects to the illuminated ones

introduced.name: Qilin
introduced.how: the most benevolent of the adepti, who drink only spring water
introduced.quote: Most benevolent among all adepti are the Qilin

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: mountainous home of the adepti, where Ganyu went to think
introduced.quote: But perhaps the mountainous dwellings of adepti in Jueyun Karst

introduced.name: Yuehai Pavilion
introduced.how: the Qixing office where secretaries handle the commercial port
introduced.quote: Ah, I shouldn't... I have left the human world. Please contact the Yuehai Pavilion regarding matters concerning the commercial port.

introduced.name: Second Life and Wanyou Boutique
introduced.how: two rival shops whose tax records show irregularities
introduced.quote: If I remember correctly, Second Life and Wanyou Boutique are old business rivals, competing for market share due to their similar wares.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: a quiet village of old people near Fanmu Carpenter's
introduced.quote: I'm here alone and Qingce Village is nothing more than a retirement spot for old people.

introduced.name: Osial
introduced.how: an attack on the harbor that left the Fatui's reputation in Liyue at rock bottom
introduced.quote: Ever since Osial attacked the harbor, the Fatui's reputation in Liyue has reached rock bottom.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Paimon: Aren't you Ningguang's servants? How come you're here?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Xin Cheng: Oh—Oh heavens! Blessed be Rex Lapis, I've finally come upon the adepti!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh! Paimon sees them, too. It's one of the Fatui!

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Traveler: Go back to Liyue Harbor with us.

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Ganyu: Our... Uh... Our exchange only represents my personal views. If you wish it so, you can file a complaint to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Master Lu: Don't forget to drive those hooligans away. It'll save me the trouble of asking for the Millelith's help too.

threads.claim: Ganyu's qilin blood makes her feel unwelcome in Liyue, opening a question about where she belongs.
threads.quote: Ganyu: My adepti blood makes me unwelcome in Liyue Harbor.

threads.claim: Ganyu's sense of separation from humans and adepti deepens and is tested by the pilgrim's words.
threads.quote: Ganyu: But being questioned by him made me realize that I...

threads.claim: Ganyu finds a human connection in Liyue through people who rely on her, easing her inner conflict.
threads.quote: Ganyu: You've made me realize that I share another connection with the people of Liyue Harbor, apart from my contract with Rex Lapis.

threads.claim: Ganyu believes she has been replaced by the secretaries, and whether that is true is left open.
threads.quote: Ganyu: I delivered the letter and came back to Liyue Harbor only to discover that I had been replaced by Baiwen, Baixiao, and Baishi...

threads.claim: The Traveler insists the replacement was only a misunderstanding, not a firing.
threads.quote: Traveler: You haven't been fired. It's a misunderstanding.

threads.claim: Ganyu feels loneliness in both the mountains and the human city, hinting she feels she does not belong to the human world.
threads.quote: "Even lonelier than Jueyun Karst"

threads.claim: The Fatui's standing in Liyue has collapsed since Osial's attack on the harbor, a thread that continues beyond this unit.
threads.quote: Ganyu: Ever since Osial attacked the harbor, the Fatui's reputation in Liyue has reached rock bottom.

threads.claim: Uncle Tian hides his real rank as Tianshu, suggesting the Qixing keeps secrets from ordinary people.
threads.quote: Uncle Tian: Hush, now... I must ask for your discretion concerning my identity.

threads.claim: Uncle Tian's long-running tricks have kept his place in the Qixing secure for decades.
threads.quote: Ganyu: That's how Uncle Tian managed to keep his position in the Qixing secure for so many years.

threads.claim: Adepti do not grant blessings freely, and Ganyu insists that people must earn their fortune through effort.
threads.quote: Ganyu: Dear... pilgrim, you shouldn't jump to conclusions. Adepti don't help every pilgrim for free.

threads.claim: Xiao promises that Ganyu's training will become harder, leaving her further trials open.
threads.quote: Xiao: From tomorrow on, I'll start raising the difficulty of your training, so you'll have to...

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: Oceanids are sentient Fontaine creatures that can create Oceanid creatures through mimicry and transformation
introduced.quote: Oceanids are sentient creatures unique to Fontaine, and they can create Oceanid creatures through mimicry and transformation.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: mystical philosophy in which the temple is a microcosm, members stand in for gods, and holy oil is tempered willpower
introduced.quote: In the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's brand of mystical philosophy, the temple is a microcosm of the universe, the members are stand-ins for the gods, and the holy oil is tempered willpower.

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: a blade representing 'reason' that can only be born from consummate human will
introduced.quote: The Holy Blade, on the other hand, is "reason," that which cuts everything open. It can only be born out of consummate human will.

introduced.name: Persona
introduced.how: one of four reproduced substances (Memory, Wish, Soul, Persona) needed to forge the Holy Blade
introduced.quote: And thus, four types of substance came into being: Memory, Wish, Soul, and Persona.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Institute
introduced.how: an orphanage whose director was Lyris, later destroyed in the calamity
introduced.quote: The Narzissenkreuz Institute.

introduced.name: Lyris
introduced.how: a registered Oceanid appointed director of an orphanage, later a core Ordo member
introduced.quote: Lyris is a registered Oceanid. She is not eligible to be stationed in the waters outside Fontaine and has become...

introduced.name: Red Empress
introduced.how: title of Lyris as an Ordo member who dissolved members' egos to make them holy
introduced.quote: Yes, Lyris. The Red Empress of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo from back then, the Red Empress who loves to take heads.

introduced.name: Mary-Ann Guillotin
introduced.how: an orphan from the Narzissenkreuz Institute, adopted by Emanuel Guillotin, whom Seymour must protect
introduced.quote: Alain and Mary-Ann were orphans in the care of the Narzissenkreuz Institute before the Marechaussee Hunter, Emanuel Guillotin, took them in.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Mary-Ann's older brother who designed Seymour (4ACV07)
introduced.quote: She is the younger sister of Alain Guillotin, the one who designed me, 4ACV07.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: Ordo member who has taken the Holy Blade components and wants to reforge the blade
introduced.quote: Simple — He too wants to reforge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. The dream of the Ordo remains unrealized.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: the leader of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.quote: Simply put, the leader of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo.

introduced.name: Orthants
introduced.how: four orthants whose merging gives birth to 'reason', needed for the Holy Blade
introduced.quote: The birth of "reason" requires the merging of the four orthants. If we can get the rest of them, we still have a chance.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: the hunter organization whose files Seymour holds, which spent its time hunting the Ordo
introduced.quote: These are all Marechaussee Phantom files that Mr. Alain Guillotin recorded for testing light sensitivity while designing me.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: secret society whose members, including Jakob, are the source of the group's troubles
introduced.quote: Anyways, for myself and the others gathered here, though the Narzissenkreuz Ordo is the source of all our troubles...

introduced.name: Tower of Gestalt
introduced.how: a former Ordo building, once called the Tower of Ipsissimus, now the Tower of Gestalt
introduced.quote: That building was once known to the Narzissenkreuz Ordo as the "Tower of Ipsissimus," but we would later call it the "Tower of Gestalt."

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: a ceremonial sword used in the Ordo's ritual to remove ego and will, and a wooden sword bearing its name
introduced.quote: As I've said before, the Narzissenkreuz Ordo once had a ceremony to remove the ego and will.

introduced.name: Doomsday Clock
introduced.how: the Ordo's countdown to the apocalypse, calculated by the world-formula
introduced.quote: To be more precise, it's the apocalypse as calculated by the world-formula.

introduced.name: Seal of Chymical Marriage
introduced.how: an ancient Fontainian ritual meant to seal off the source of life, with several seals across Fontaine
introduced.quote: The Seal of Chymical Marriage was an ancient Fontainian ritual meant to seal off the source of life.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: an Ordo member and aide to the Master who sets traps and asks to be called Jakob
introduced.quote: ...I've told you, just call me Jakob.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: the Ordo's Master, whose world-formula calls for a second deluge and who plans to gather all wills into himself
introduced.quote: Indeed. According to his world-formula, the second deluge is looming before us. When it comes, only he will be able to save the world.

introduced.name: Rene
introduced.how: the Master's real name, revealed as the one who will return
introduced.quote: Now, it is time for our Master... No, for Rene to return!

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: a machine-like being who is the guardian of Mary-Ann
introduced.quote: Matching traits detected. That is Mary-Ann, my ward.

introduced.name: Ann
introduced.how: an entity formed from the merged wills of Lyris and Mary-Ann
introduced.quote: If Lyris and Mary-Ann's wills created Ann... And if the old me was placed in some Hilichurl's body...

introduced.name: Memory, Wish, Soul, and Persona pieces
introduced.how: four experiential substances made from Fontaine traditions and ancient underground technology, needed to forge the Holy Blade
introduced.quote: And thus, four types of substance came into being: Memory, Wish, Soul, and Persona.

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: beings said in legend to come from the first tear shed by the previous Hydro Archon
introduced.quote: There's a legend that says that Oceanids came from the first tear shed by the previous Hydro Archon.

introduced.name: Persona section
introduced.how: a sealed section of the Ordo base holding the persona cut out by Narzissenkreuz himself, opened only by Oceanid water
introduced.quote: I believe the "Persona" section to be the most important, for there lies the persona excised by Master Narzissenkreuz himself.

assumed.name: Elynas
assumed.quote: We had an altercation with him inside Elynas once...

assumed.name: Petit Chou
assumed.quote: I actually had to get to know Petit Chou, Al, and the others first.

assumed.name: Mamere
assumed.quote: Even Mamere forgave you, so we have no right to stay angry.

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: you helped me rescue Lanoire.

assumed.name: Osial
assumed.quote: Maybe Osial can create water creatures, but it's extraordinary to be able to imagine creatures with rich personalities.

assumed.name: Rhodeia
assumed.quote: I'm afraid perhaps only one as powerful as Rhodeia could do it.

assumed.name: Elynas
assumed.quote: I'm afraid the Elynas operation was probably never more than a red herring with the goal of leading you and Guillotin away to buy him more time to execute his true plans.

assumed.name: Alain Guillotin
assumed.quote: Guillotin may have disappeared, but here his successors come, self-assured, thinking themselves totally infallible.

assumed.name: Lyris
assumed.quote: It was the same for Jakob, Lyris, and many others in the Ordo.

assumed.name: Mary-Ann
assumed.quote: We should be able to separate Lyris and Mary-Ann.

assumed.name: Red Empress
assumed.quote: The Red Empress who dreams in a place unknown, the dreamer who never says what they mean.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: When the thugs and dogs of Fontaine surrounded us and attempted to wipe us out, he descended alone into the abyss below.

assumed.name: wooden sword
assumed.quote: Ann: It's the wooden sword we found during our adventures.

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Back in the Fortress of Meropide, the Primordial Sea was...

threads.claim: Who the Mary-Ann in Annapausis is and whether she is the Oceanid behind Annapausis is an open question.
threads.quote: What is the Mary-Ann in the Annapausis, exactly?

threads.claim: The group reasons that the Mary-Ann in Annapausis may be Lyris and holds the same powers, though her identity remains contradictory.
threads.quote: If so, then "Mary-Ann" is Lyris. Another piece of evidence we have is that they can both use Oceanid powers to control Annapausis.

threads.claim: Ann's birth may be connected to a hidden secret about Mary-Ann and Lyris.
threads.quote: So, Knight , is this the secret of my birth?

threads.claim: The mechanism by which Oceanids reproduce is unknown and raises questions about how Ann came to be.
threads.quote: Speaking of... Just how do Oceanids reproduce again?

threads.claim: Caterpillar proposes that Oceanid reproduction may happen through imagination and mimicry driven by regret.
threads.quote: What if, by some chance, this mysterious method of Oceanid reproduction is accomplished through imagination and mimicry?

threads.claim: Lyris's fate after the orphanage's destruction is unclear, as she wanders the ruins consumed by guilt.
threads.quote: They say she failed to understand the link between the disaster, the orphans fleeing, and her own conduct, and so she wanders the ruins, drowning in guilt and expectation.

threads.claim: A voice from Mary-Ann is heard waiting for the orphans to return, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: They won't come back, no matter how long I wait...

threads.claim: Jakob's plan to reforge the Holy Blade shows the Ordo's goal is still active and contested.
threads.quote: Simple — He too wants to reforge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. The dream of the Ordo remains unrealized.

threads.claim: Seymour fears he can no longer fulfill his order to protect Mary-Ann after his defeat.
threads.quote: Does this mean that I shall no longer able to fulfill my orders to protect Mary-Ann?

threads.claim: The fate of Seymour's master is uncertain after the battle that damaged Seymour.
threads.quote: Evidently, that was the battle that damaged you, and it was an incredibly fierce one.

threads.claim: The leader Narzissenkreuz's involvement in the Elynas operation is unknown to Seymour.
threads.quote: However, my memory does not contain any intelligence regarding his involvement.

threads.claim: The Doomsday Clock is the Ordo's countdown to the apocalypse, and its meaning is raised as a question.
threads.quote: Remember the Doomsday Clock I mentioned?

threads.claim: The Doomsday Clock's giant hand falls and strikes its final hour.
threads.quote: The giant clock hand crashes to the ground, sending up a huge plume of dust

threads.claim: Seymour dismisses the apocalypse as a paranoid delusion, leaving whether it is real open.
threads.quote: I believe this to be a pathological delusion caused by paranoia.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says Narzissenkreuz acted because he calculated the apocalypse and wants to save the world.
threads.quote: He only took the actions he did because he calculated the coming of the apocalypse. He wishes to save the world.

threads.claim: Caterpillar has found four seals tied to the Seal of Chymical Marriage, and their purpose is unexplained.
threads.quote: While investigating alone, I found a map of the Seal of Chymical Marriage. You could say that I've found four seals.

threads.claim: Jakob reverses the Seal of Chymical Marriage and reforges the Holy Blade of Reason.
threads.quote: I have reversed the Seal of Chymical Marriage and reforged the Holy Blade of Reason.

threads.claim: The party must find the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz to stop the Ordo's plans and undo the merged wills.
threads.quote: I suppose we must find the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz.

threads.claim: The wooden sword the party already carries may be the Holy Blade, a possibility Paimon raises.
threads.quote: Hmm... Wait a minute. Didn't we already find the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz?

threads.claim: The wooden sword glows and takes on the Holy Blade's power, indwelling a form of significance.
threads.quote: Weren't you listening? Caterpillar just explained that the Holy Blade can indwell any form that holds significance.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says the Holy Blade may undo the merging of wills between Lyris and Mary-Ann.
threads.quote: Not only will it help us stop Narzissenkreuz's plans, but its unique powers may be able to undo the merging of wills.

threads.claim: Ann refuses to absorb the Ordo's persona and says she will persuade the part of Lyris within her.
threads.quote: I do not wish to do so. And I will persuade that part of Lyris, too.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz descended alone into the abyss beneath the Tower and may still be alive.
threads.quote: In the deepest depths beneath us. When the thugs and dogs of Fontaine surrounded us and attempted to wipe us out, he descended alone into the abyss below.

threads.claim: Jakob says Narzissenkreuz plans to gather everyone's wills into himself through the Holy Blade.
threads.quote: Only by forging the Holy Blade can he continue his unfinished work, gathering the wills of everyone in Fontaine, the continent, and even the entire planet unto himself.

threads.claim: Jakob promises the party they will meet again in the new world.
threads.quote: It may take Master a little time to find my will in the new world. But do not worry. We will meet there again!

threads.claim: Jakob vanishes when the floor collapses, leaving his fate unknown.
threads.quote: The dust clears to reveal a gaping hole in the floor, with Jakob nowhere to be found

threads.claim: Part of the Red Empress is said to be within Ann, and she rejected the future.
threads.quote: Part of the Red Empress is within you, so you should know that she rejected the future.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says the old self was placed in a Hilichurl's body, leaving its true nature a mystery.
threads.quote: If Lyris and Mary-Ann's wills created Ann... And if the old me was placed in some Hilichurl's body...

threads.claim: Jakob calls Caterpillar a machine with memories carved on gemstones and wisdom simulated by gears and pipes.
threads.quote: And you, machine. Your memories are nothing but carvings on gemstones, your wisdom just a simulation created by tape, gears, and crystalline pipelines.

threads.claim: The sealed entrance's riddle asks for the answer to "the first droplet," which the party cannot yet solve.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... The answers from before were "shadow," "life," and "love."

threads.claim: Ann offers Oceanid as a possible answer to the riddle, though the party is unsure.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is the answer an "Oceanid" then?

threads.claim: Jakob says the primordial sea returns and the devourer of all darkens the sky, a threat left unexplained.

threads.claim: The story asks whether people can defy a fate that seems to have already been decided for them.
threads.quote: My dear audience, I ask you this: Do you believe in fate? If fate decreed that your life was to end in tragedy, what would you do?

threads.claim: Kaeya argues that people always have a choice and can leave the script they were given.
threads.quote: If you don't like the script, just walk off the stage and join the audience. You always have a choice.

threads.claim: Kaeya suggests a god may be deciding people's fates, though he later calls this a figure of speech.
threads.quote: Perhaps there's an inept god out there deciding everyone's fates...

threads.claim: Gundafar argues that a destroyed people will survive beneath the surface and return, hinting at future revival.
threads.quote: Come the spring, it is all but inevitable that fresh green shoots will rise up from the ashes.

threads.claim: The king's intaglio is a royal seal of Qubad's status, and his claim to be his father's son depends on it.
threads.quote: If Qubad still wishes to be my son, and hold the intaglio I bestowed upon him as proof of his royal blood, then he must obey my command.

threads.claim: Qubad throws away the intaglio to break from his father and fate, and Kaeya later gives it to the Traveler.
threads.quote: I shall discard this intaglio, and rid myself of the shackles of fate.

threads.claim: Klee is locked behind a sturdy door and is repeatedly grounded for mischief.
threads.quote: (Klee's voice is, as usual, muffled behind the sturdy door.)

threads.claim: Albedo says Klee will be released at some point, and the group expects her to visit later.
threads.quote: When Klee's next... well, released, I'll bring her to see you sometime.

threads.claim: The lamp may once have housed a very powerful Jinni, though the merchant may be exaggerating.
threads.quote: this lamp in particular once housed a very powerful Jinni.

threads.claim: A man posing as Dr. Baizhu's master may be a fraud, and Dr. Baizhu says his master has died.
threads.quote: He told me that his master has already passed away...

threads.claim: Captain Wu's medicine deal turns out to be a scam, confirmed when he sees the real Dr. Baizhu.
threads.quote: Yeah, I saw Dr. Baizhu... Looks like it was a scam after all.

threads.claim: Kaeya keeps favor-owing contacts he calls informants, and Captain Wu is left choosing between friend and informant.
threads.quote: Hehe, there are two kinds of people who owe me favors. One is my friends, and the other, my informants.

threads.claim: Kaeya's favors ledger is a joke, but his debts and obligations keep growing.
threads.quote: Hey, you didn't think I was being serious, did you? Do I really strike you as the kind of person to keep track of favors in a notebook?

threads.claim: The Traveler's claimed Guhua Clan membership is a cover story, and Kaeya finds the clan obscure.
threads.quote: This is the first I'm hearing of them... I guess they're one of these obscure ones who keep to themselves.

threads.claim: The hero of the storytelling tale sacrifices himself, and it is unclear whether he had second thoughts.
threads.quote: But it leaves you wondering how he really feels about the whole thing. Did he ever have second thoughts? Only he can know, I suppose.

threads.claim: Kaeya's lucky coin can be made to show a chosen side, and the final coin toss stays unresolved.
threads.quote: Kaeya just put the coin back in his pocket...

threads.claim: Connor nearly exposed the Darknight Hero, hinting that Diluc has a secret nighttime identity.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Connor almost exposed the Darknight Hero...)

threads.claim: Elzer's throat problem keeps returning and causes breathing difficulty, which he downplays.
threads.quote: Elzer: My throat is a bit raspy is all. It got better after I began taking medicine, but recently... *cough* ...It flared up again.

threads.claim: A doctor says Elzer has nothing to worry about and only needs rest.
threads.quote: Elzer: The doctor said there was nothing to worry about, I just need some rest.

threads.claim: Kaeya was a gentle, honest child who has since become a tricky liar.
threads.quote: Adelinde: The Captain Kaeya of today never bats an eye when he lies, but he wasn't like that at all when he was young... Ah, goodness, how did I get into this...

threads.claim: Kaeya is Crepus's adopted son and Diluc's brother, though he no longer lives at the winery.
threads.quote: Kaeya: I am Master Crepus's adopted son, and Master Diluc's brother. However, as a serving Captain with the Knights of Favonius, I am rarely at the winery.

threads.claim: Barbatos is the God of Freedom, and Venti claims he would welcome people singing however they like.
threads.quote: Venti: Besides... he is the God of Freedom. Surely he'd prefer to hear Mondstadters sing their hearts out however comes naturally to them.

introduced.quote: Hello. I'm Xavier, a film director and producer from Fontaine.

introduced.quote: Citlali: No, I was hired to man the front desk.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide

introduced.quote: Besides, the inmates are the ones who keep it in good shape.

introduced.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol

introduced.quote: Under the stringent supervision of the Special Patrol, of course.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: group that used the Third Descender's remains to create the seven Gnoses to consolidate the archon system
introduced.quote: Yes, the Heavenly Principles used the remains of the Third Descender to create the seven Gnoses as a means to consolidate the archon system.

introduced.name: Third Descender
introduced.how: figure whose remains were used to make the Gnoses and whose impurities relate to Stellar Linchpins
introduced.quote: We knew his remains were used to create the Gnoses

introduced.name: Gnoses
introduced.how: seven artificial objects made from the Third Descender's remains to consolidate the archon system
introduced.quote: create the seven Gnoses as a means to consolidate the archon system

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: elemental power tools that channel elemental energy and stem from the archon system
introduced.quote: For those that wield them, Visions serve as a means to channel elemental power.

introduced.name: Stellar Linchpin
introduced.how: rare kind of Vision that grants unusual power from beyond Teyvat, cause of manifestation unknown
introduced.quote: You can think of it as a rare kind of Vision.

introduced.name: Fontaine law on excavating underwater ruins
introduced.how: law forbidding unauthorized people from digging up underwater ruins, so Sandrone needs a fishing permit
introduced.quote: But Fontaine law prohibits unauthorized individuals and organizations from excavating underwater ruins.

introduced.name: Fontaine's rising water levels
introduced.how: centuries-long rise of water that has submerged former land and homes in Fontaine
introduced.quote: Did you forget that the water levels have been rising for centuries?

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: former town now underwater, once above sea level
introduced.quote: Poisson isn't too far from here, right?

introduced.name: Beryl Region
introduced.how: area where Alain lived in seclusion after leaving the Research Institute
introduced.quote: Alright, our first stop is the Beryl Region.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Lord-Artificer who revolutionized clockwork meka, invented pneuma-ousia annihilation energy, and founded the Research Institute
introduced.quote: Well, he revolutionized clockwork meka, and invented pneuma-ousia annihilation energy.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: research body founded and first directed by Alain Guillotin
introduced.quote: He was also the founder and first Director of the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: revealed as a Fatui Harbinger, an automaton revived after Dottore destroyed her core, using the alias Guillotin
introduced.quote: Besides, I'm a Fatui Harbinger.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: puppet created by Sandrone as an imitation of Alain's design
introduced.quote: I attempted to imitate it when I created Katheryne, but in the end, she turned out to be nothing more than a superficial replica.

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: computational machine that Sandrone studied, which sacrificed its energy to protect the core
introduced.quote: Pulonia is essentially a computational machine

introduced.name: kuuvahki
introduced.how: substance Columbina uses to perceive her surroundings, heightened in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Columbina relies on kuuvahki to perceive her surroundings.

introduced.name: The Final Gift
introduced.how: built-in second chance Alain left Sandrone, activated after her core reboot
introduced.quote: so he left me a chance to start over.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: revealed to have once been the Hydro Archon
introduced.quote: Nefer did mention that Miss Furina was once the Hydro Archon, though...

introduced.name: Lepine-Pauline
introduced.how: director who used to outsource Kamera work and knows Xavier from the industry
introduced.quote: I met Director Xavier back during my Kamera outsourcing days, so I got to know the industry a bit.

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: actress and usually Kamera operator on Lepine-Pauline's crew
introduced.quote: I'm, uh... usually the one behind the Kamera

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Destroyed by that bastard Dottore? That's right.

assumed.name: Descending Moon
assumed.quote: Dottore's final attack on her left in Descending Moon

assumed.name: Musketeer Pictures
assumed.quote: our friends at Musketeer Pictures

assumed.name: The Two Musketeers
assumed.quote: Think about the difficulties we faced with "The Two Musketeers."

assumed.name: Wriothesley
assumed.quote: Wriothesley, it's been a while!

assumed.name: Veronique
assumed.quote: Does that mean Veronique and her brother will be at the festival?

assumed.name: Chevreuse
assumed.quote: Oho, sounds like our trusty musketeer is as popular as ever.

assumed.name: Iudex
assumed.quote: and I cleared it with the Iudex.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: this is Columbina, a friend we met in Nod-Krai.

assumed.quote: How much does Xavier know about the whole Moon Goddess situation

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: ...Sandrone? You... You're here!?

assumed.name: Seventh Harbinger
assumed.quote: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers?

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Did you keep my Kamera too?

threads.claim: A Stellar Linchpin manifested in Sandrone for an unknown reason, and its trigger remains an open question.
threads.quote: Marionette: (But why now? What activated it?)

threads.claim: Alain secretly left Sandrone a built-in second chance called the Final Gift.
threads.quote: so he left me a chance to start over.

threads.claim: Alain also left other hidden items in the house he shared with Sandrone, which she now wants to recover.
threads.quote: Alain left me a few other things that are stored in the house we shared together.

threads.claim: Sandrone's survival is explained: the Final Gift only triggered because a Stellar Linchpin manifested.
threads.quote: without it, the "Gift" Alain left me

threads.claim: Dottore may have returned from death, threatening the group again.
threads.quote: Even if he did crawl back from the grave to make us all miserable again...

threads.claim: Columbina is searching for a best friend who has died, by visiting the friend's homeland.
threads.quote: Sadly, she said her best friend was gone.

threads.claim: Sandrone asks how many living Moon Goddesses hold the Trilunar Authority, an unresolved question.
threads.quote: How many living Moon Goddesses are there in possession of the Trilunar Authority?

threads.claim: Columbina has merged with the Moon Sisters, a change Sandrone is still assessing.
threads.quote: Things might be a bit different now that she's merged with the Moon Sisters

threads.claim: Columbina senses Sandrone's presence even though Sandrone is hiding from her.
threads.quote: Columbina: ...Sandrone?

threads.claim: Columbina's perception depends on kuuvahki, which is heightened in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Columbina relies on kuuvahki to perceive her surroundings.

threads.claim: Fontaine's rising waters have submerged former homes and sites, raising questions about what lies beneath.
threads.quote: Did you forget that the water levels have been rising for centuries?

threads.claim: Alain lived in seclusion near the Beryl Region after leaving the Research Institute.
threads.quote: After Alain left the Fontaine Research Institute, he lived in seclusion somewhere around there.

threads.claim: The name Guillotin suggests a link between the Lord-Artificer Alain and the Harbinger using his name.
threads.quote: I feel like I've seen it somewhere recently.

threads.claim: Furina was once the Hydro Archon, a fact hinted at but not yet explained.
threads.quote: Nefer did mention that Miss Furina was once the Hydro Archon, though...

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles used the Third Descender's remains to make the Gnoses, linking Visions to him.
threads.quote: We knew his remains were used to create the Gnoses

introduced.name: Nora
introduced.how: a child who plays with an imaginary friend
introduced.quote: Arriving in the City of Mondstadt, the Traveler and Paimon find Nora playing around with an imaginary friend.

introduced.name: nirnama detector
introduced.how: a monocle-like device that reveals imaginary friends
introduced.quote: Venti: That's right! Looks like a monocle, but actually it's called a nirnama detector.

introduced.name: Flora
introduced.how: a girl whose imaginary friend is a Bloatty Floatty
introduced.quote: Flora: Mr. Floatty is my bestest friend. We grew up together!

introduced.name: Bloatty Floatty
introduced.how: a flying plant that is Flora's imaginary friend
introduced.quote: Venti: There it is. Behold, a floaty imaginary friend for floaty-headed Flora: A Bloatty Floatty!

introduced.name: Timmie
introduced.how: a child whose imaginary friend is a Ruin Guard and who likes pigeons
introduced.quote: Timmie: If anyone tries to shoot my pigeons, I'll get my friend on 'em! Piew-piew! Boom-boom! Bang!

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: a tavern where Diluc and others drink together
introduced.quote: (Behind Angel's Share, you find Diluc, Kaeya, Hardworking Silio, and Reckless Pallad sitting together)

introduced.name: Diluc
introduced.how: a stern man who runs the tavern and has a family past
introduced.quote: Diluc: Just... drink responsibly on my premises, okay?

introduced.name: Kaeya
introduced.how: a jovial drinker who needles Diluc
introduced.quote: Kaeya: The thing about wine is, you have to drink it at the tavern or you miss out on half the fun.

introduced.name: Ellin
introduced.how: a young trainee who wants to become a knight
introduced.quote: Ellin: I—I mean, obviously I want to become a knight! ...And if I got to go on an adventure with Jean herself... Well, even better!

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: a new adventurer and Ellin's friend whose parents oppose him
introduced.quote: Ellin: He's a friend of mine. Recently started as an adventurer.

introduced.name: Stanley
introduced.how: a self-styled legendary adventurer of Mondstadt who brags about his exploits
introduced.quote: Stanley: What!? Do you know who I am? I am Stanley, renowned adventurer of Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Hans Archibald
introduced.how: Stanley's real name, revealed by Venti
introduced.quote: Venti: Hans Archibald?

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: Venti's true identity, revealed to Stanley
introduced.quote: Seeing no other way to bring Stanley back to his normal self, Venti reveals himself as Barbatos, calling Stanley by his real name, Hans Archibald.

introduced.name: Vennessa
introduced.how: Mondstadt's greatest hero, whose weapons Jack wants
introduced.quote: Jack: The weapons he took on his adventure all those years ago... they were none other than those once wielded by Mondstadt's greatest hero, Vennessa herself!

introduced.name: Sword of Brilliant Valor
introduced.how: a legendary sword once owned by Vennessa, now lost
introduced.quote: Jack tells the three that he wishes to claim the Sword of Brilliant Valor and Shield of Magnificent Honor as they were once Vennessa's

introduced.name: Shield of Magnificent Honor
introduced.how: a legendary shield once owned by Vennessa, now lost
introduced.quote: Jack tells the three that he wishes to claim the Sword of Brilliant Valor and Shield of Magnificent Honor as they were once Vennessa's

introduced.name: Anemo Crystalfly
introduced.how: a glowing creature found in the open country around Mondstadt City
introduced.quote: Venti: Hmm... say, Jack, have you ever seen an Anemo Crystalfly? They're found in the open country around Mondstadt City.

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: a windless place of ashes where Stanley's partner died
introduced.quote: Jack: You and your partner reached the Mare Jivari! A famously terrifying place with not a wisp of wind!

introduced.name: Old Mondstadt
introduced.how: the former city sealed off by a tyrant's hurricane, now Stormterror's Lair
introduced.quote: Venti: At that time, Old Mondstadt was ruled by a tyrant, who sealed off the city's perimeter with a ferocious hurricane. Even the birds couldn't get in or out.

introduced.name: Nameless Bard
introduced.how: Venti's friend who died liberating Mondstadt from Decarabian
introduced.quote: Paimon inquires as to what happened to Venti's friend, but the Traveler is able to deduce that the friend, the Nameless Bard, had died while liberating Mondstadt from Decarabian.

introduced.name: Stanley's partner's death in the Mare Jivari
introduced.how: the real Stanley, not the fake, died saving the storyteller in a windless land
introduced.quote: Venti: But the real adventurer, the real Stanley — that was his partner. Not him.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Venti: Traveler! Fancy meeting you here.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Venti: Come now, that's no way to speak about the elegant Miss Lisa!

assumed.name: Stormterror incident
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Temple of the Lion... We explored this place once before, didn't we? During the Stormterror incident.

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Timmie's imaginary friend is a R—Ruin Guard!?

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Paimon: Jean! What is Jean doing here?

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, that bunch of hilichurls... are they holding some kind of ceremony?

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Venti: It was about twenty-six hundred years ago, before the world had come under the rule of The Seven.

assumed.name: City of Freedom
assumed.quote: Venti: Fitting, isn't it? That the City of Freedom should be home to children with such boundless powers of imagination.

threads.claim: Imaginary friends seem to vanish as people grow up, and the age at which they disappear is an open question.
threads.quote: Venti: Hmm... This raises an interesting question: At what age, exactly, do people's imaginary friends disappear?

threads.claim: The nirnama detector lets people see imaginary friends that others cannot see.
threads.quote: Venti: That's right! Looks like a monocle, but actually it's called a nirnama detector.

threads.claim: The Stanley in the tavern is revealed to be a fraud, while the real Stanley was his partner who died in the Mare Jivari.
threads.quote: Venti realizes that Stanley's exploits and tragedy was real, but Stanley in the story was the real one, while the one before them is a fake.

threads.claim: Stanley's imaginary friend is a scarred warrior that looks like an idealized version of Stanley himself.
threads.quote: Venti: It seems his imaginary friend is a seasoned warrior... covered in scars from head to foot, and a look of staunch determination on his face.

threads.claim: Stanley has been trapped his whole life by the image of the battle-scarred warrior he fixated on.
threads.quote: Venti: Instead, he's become fixed on the image of him as that battle-scarred warrior... and that image has held him captive his entire life.

threads.claim: The Mare Jivari is a windless land where the spirit of the dead cannot be recovered, which Stanley fears above all.
threads.quote: Stanley: But the one thing I can never forget... is that he died in a windless land, where his spirit can never be recovered!

threads.claim: Venti takes the spirit of Stanley's dead friend, letting it move on in peace.
threads.quote: Venti: Will you hand me your old friend's spirit?

threads.claim: Venti is revealed to be the god Barbatos, who uses a human form.
threads.quote: Seeing no other way to bring Stanley back to his normal self, Venti reveals himself as Barbatos, calling Stanley by his real name, Hans Archibald.

threads.claim: Venti was once a wisp of the wind with no human form and took his current form from a friend.
threads.quote: Venti: Back then, I was but a wisp among the thousand winds. I wasn't a god of anything — I didn't even have a human form...

threads.claim: Venti's friend, the Nameless Bard, died while liberating Mondstadt from Decarabian.
threads.quote: Paimon inquires as to what happened to Venti's friend, but the Traveler is able to deduce that the friend, the Nameless Bard, had died while liberating Mondstadt from Decarabian.

threads.claim: The Sword and Shield said to be Vennessa's are actually junk and a wine barrel piece, so the legendary weapons are not what they seem.
threads.quote: Venti: (Ahh... Seems somebody tossed an old sword into a pile of spoils these hilichurls were already celebrating...)

introduced.name: Chongyun
introduced.how: Self-introduced as a local Liyue exorcist hunting evil spirits
introduced.quote: I'm Chongyun, a local exorcist from Liyue.

introduced.name: Evil spirits
introduced.how: Exorcists' term for all demons and monsters, which have existed since ancient times and cause trouble in Liyue
introduced.quote: Those versed in the arts of exorcism refer to all forms of demons and monsters as

introduced.name: Yaksha
introduced.how: Guardians of Liyue who work in plain sight alongside exorcists in secret
introduced.quote: For generations, yakshas and exorcists have been protecting Liyue together, one in plain sight and the other in secret.

introduced.name: Pure-yang spirit
introduced.how: A rare constitution making Chongyun easily stirred up and emotionally unstable but useful against evil spirits
introduced.quote: This tendency of getting stirred up easily is what people call a

introduced.name: Test of Courage
introduced.how: A couples' scare event at Wuwang Hill where participants pretend-fear ghosts for fun
introduced.quote: That's what the Test of Courage is all about.

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill
introduced.how: A gloomy, murky hill where the Test of Courage is held and evil spirits gather
introduced.quote: Although, once it became the murky place you see now, it also began to attract more evil spirits.

introduced.name: Popsicles suppressing yang energy
introduced.how: Chongyun's popsicles calm his excess yang energy and are a special item for him
introduced.quote: I never expected that something I use to suppress my yang energy would be so appealing to kids.

introduced.name: Dalong
introduced.how: A poor boy who admires Chongyun's popsicles and wants one for his sister
introduced.quote: My sister just loves food. She's always super happy whenever we get some tasty snacks.

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: Restaurant where Chongyun special-orders his popsicles
introduced.quote: I usually get my popsicles from Wanmin Restaurant on special order.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: Restaurant chef who makes Chongyun's popsicles and is usually too busy to take orders
introduced.quote: Chef Mao is usually too busy to take my order.

introduced.name: Uncle Jia
introduced.how: Test of Courage staff who offers a yang-boosting drink before entry
introduced.quote: This drink will boost the yang energy inside your body and lift your courage.

introduced.name: Yin and yang energy
introduced.how: Ghosts are full of yin energy, which yang energy deters
introduced.quote: Ghosts are said to be full of

introduced.name: Zhouliang
introduced.how: Event staff member who pretends to be a ghost at the Test of Courage
introduced.quote: I work here pretending to be a ghost, but now's my break time, so I took off my costume.

introduced.name: Fu San'er
introduced.how: Another event staff member who plays a ghost to scare participants psychologically
introduced.quote: Yes, I have one, but it's too hot to wear

introduced.name: Yuyan
introduced.how: Dalong's mother, who is out on errands and scolds him over the popsicles
introduced.quote: Sure, but please keep an eye on your sister.

introduced.name: Cold Noodles with Mountain Delicacies
introduced.how: A cold dish Chongyun invented because he cannot eat warm food
introduced.quote: So I came up with my own variation called

introduced.name: Cryo Slime Condensate and Cryo Whopperflower Nectar
introduced.how: Potent ingredients that could suppress Chongyun's yang energy when popsicles fail
introduced.quote: Like Cryo Slime Condensate, or Cryo Whopperflower Nectar, for example...

introduced.name: Lu Zheng
introduced.how: A man at the Test of Courage who brought his girlfriend and says she was frightened
introduced.quote: I brought my girlfriend here to have some fun, but instead, she got frightened by all this spooky atmosphere.

introduced.name: Junjun and Chan'er
introduced.how: A couple on a date at the Test of Courage who argue about entering
introduced.quote: This is supposed to be a date, you know?

introduced.name: Qianqian
introduced.how: A frightened spirit who asks for help against the exorcist and whom the Traveler reveals to be a young ghost
introduced.quote: Um, that exorcist... with that blue hair... is so scary!

introduced.name: Little Le
introduced.how: Dalong's younger sister who loves food and calls the travelers heroes
introduced.quote: Thank you for the popsicle. It was so cool and delicious.

introduced.name: Chongyun
introduced.how: an exorcist with a pure-yang spirit who practices thaumaturgy and has never yet seen a demon
introduced.quote: But to this very day, despite the many exorcisms I have performed, I have yet to see a single demon, not to mention one that I needed to defeat using thaumaturgy.

introduced.name: pure-yang spirit
introduced.how: Chongyun's yang energy scares off evil spirits, so he rarely gets to fight them
introduced.quote: Like I mentioned before, my yang energy tends to just scare away evil spirits.

introduced.name: thaumaturgy
introduced.how: the exorcism practice Chongyun trains in, which he needs for defeating spirits that resist his yang energy
introduced.quote: But if I renounced my practice my thaumaturgy, and one day met an evil spirit that didn't fear my yang energy, then I may not be able to exorcise it.

introduced.name: Vigilant Yaksha
introduced.how: the masked, pole-wielding figure seen near Guili Plains; Chongyun says he is not an enemy
introduced.quote: Oh! That must be the Vigilant Yaksha. Don't worry, he's not an enemy.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: Chongyun's well-read, helpful friend who supplied many of the clues
introduced.quote: Oh, many of these are from my friend, Xingqiu. He's well-read and very knowledgeable.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: the beings who govern Jueyun Karst and would act against any such threat there
introduced.quote: Jueyun Karst is the territory of the Adepti. If there were such a thing, the Adepti would certainly take action...

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: a karst region that is the territory of the Adepti
introduced.quote: Jueyun Karst is the territory of the Adepti. If there were such a thing, the Adepti would certainly take action...

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill
introduced.how: a location with abnormal weather and constant rumors, where the clues point
introduced.quote: Wuwang Hill's unusual weather and peculiar surroundings are a source of constant rumors, most of which are untraceable and can never be proven.

introduced.name: evil spirit mist
introduced.how: a thick, lasting mist left by an evil spirit that contaminates the area and creatures in it
introduced.quote: Once it contaminates monsters such as hilichurls, it could even make them more aggressive and dangerous to anyone nearby.

introduced.name: contaminated hilichurls
introduced.how: hilichurls near the strange smoke turn aggressive once contaminated by the mist and must be defeated
introduced.quote: Once it contaminates monsters such as hilichurls, it could even make them more aggressive and dangerous to anyone nearby.

introduced.name: exorcist
introduced.how: the role of hunting and cleansing evil spirits, which Chongyun and the Traveler perform together
introduced.quote: We've done our jobs as exorcists.

assumed.name: Ruin Hunter
assumed.quote: The shadow in Guili Plains sounds like it may be a Ruin Hunter.

assumed.name: Vigilant Yaksha
assumed.quote: I get it, that's what the Vigilant Yaksha fights against, right?

assumed.name: Thaumaturgy
assumed.quote: I mostly spend my time purging evil spirits and practicing thaumaturgy.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: you're using them to make Mora regardless of the participants' safety.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: They proceed to defeat the hilichurls that around the smoke, but are unable to chase after the evil spirit.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Even I can tell that this is talking about Xiangling's little Guoba, not some demon...

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Even I can tell that this is talking about Xiangling's little Guoba, not some demon...

assumed.name: Test of Courage
assumed.quote: If we include the Test of Courage rumor from before, there are already two clues pointing there.

assumed.name: hilichurls
assumed.quote: I suspected that there would be hilichurls here.

assumed.name: Violetgrass
assumed.quote: At the foot of Mt. Qingce is a Violetgrass that has turned into a gigantic, man-eating monster.

threads.claim: Chongyun insists evil spirits are real and hunts for them, raising whether they actually exist in Liyue.
threads.quote: Evil spirits have existed since ancient times. They lurk among the shadows in the lands of Liyue

threads.claim: Flyers and reports hint that something strange is happening at the Test of Courage.
threads.quote: The Test of Courage is now being held on Wuwang Hill.

threads.claim: The Test of Courage is revealed to be entertainment with a staff member pretending to be a ghost, not real evil spirits.
threads.quote: No, I only saw an event staff member pretending to be a ghost.

threads.claim: A huge flying shadow in Guili Plains summoning fireballs is reported as a possible threat with unknown identity.
threads.quote: A huge shadow has appeared in Guili Plains. It flies and swirls, summons down fireballs

threads.claim: Strange smoke left at Wuwang Hill is claimed to be traces of an evil spirit that Chongyun cannot catch.
threads.quote: Hmm, these are traces left by an evil spirit, no doubt about it!

threads.claim: The cause of Wuwang Hill's gloomy aura is rumored but uncertain.
threads.quote: There have been many rumors regarding the cause of Wuwang Hill's gloomy aura, but nothing is certain.

threads.claim: The text introduces yin and yang energy as opposing forces that ghosts and exorcism depend on.
threads.quote: Ghosts are said to be full of

threads.claim: Chongyun's pure-yang constitution risks losing control, and yang-boosting drinks or spicy popsicles make it worse.
threads.quote: If I lose control, I fear that I'll be the one endangering everyone here, not evil spirits.

threads.claim: A frightened spirit asks the Traveler for help, hinting at a ghost that Chongyun sees as a threat.
threads.quote: Um, that exorcist... with that blue hair... is so scary!

threads.claim: The Traveler reveals the wandering ghost is a child who is not malignant, and Chongyun lets her be.
threads.quote: She's a ghost, but she's also just a kid.

threads.claim: Evil spirits and demons are reported across Liyue, and Chongyun is hunting them as an exorcist.
threads.quote: There is a vigilant demon adept at concealing itself in mist. Recently, people have found traces of it in Mingyun Village, Guili Plains, and Yaoguang Shoal.

threads.claim: The Vigilant Yaksha is a masked figure seen near Guili Plains whose identity and purpose remain unexplained.
threads.quote: A strange man wearing a mask and wielding a pole was once seen in the distance around Guili Plains. There's something eerie about his presence.

threads.claim: Wuwang Hill has abnormal weather and peculiar surroundings that may hide something real.
threads.quote: I've also noticed that the weather in Wuwang Hill has been very abnormal recently. Let's go and have a look. We might just find something useful.

threads.claim: A thick, persistent evil-spirit mist on Wuwang Hill shows that the rumors have a real source.
threads.quote: It's very thick and never disperses. The evil spirit may have been here recently.

threads.claim: Chongyun's pure-yang spirit frightens spirits off, so he cannot actually use his thaumaturgy against them.
threads.quote: I may not be able to exorcise it.

threads.claim: The evil spirit fled Wuwang Hill at speed after sensing Chongyun, leaving it still at large.
threads.quote: It must have sensed me as a threat from a long way off. That's why it ran with such haste.

threads.claim: Not every rumor is false, so the Traveler and Chongyun must check the clues in the field.
threads.quote: Not all rumors are not necessarily fake. Let's have a look around.

threads.claim: Experiences and events met on the journey are rewards as valuable as the gains and losses.
threads.quote: We shouldn't focus only on the gains and losses of our journey. The things you see and the events you encounter along the way are equally important rewards.

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: court figure who upholds Fontaine's law and order and duels for honor, with a private life away from that role
introduced.quote: Clorinde: I maintain a clear boundary between my professional and personal lives. The me you see at court represents the law and order of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: self-introduction as a former wanderer who was adopted by a Hunter

introduced.quote: Protector of Justice and Order...

introduced.quote: The names you recited all belonged to the bravest Hunters.

introduced.quote: That's because the Marechaussee Hunters of ages past would often imbue their weapons with special enchantments to suppress the monsters.

introduced.name: Secret Vault

introduced.quote: I never expected the weapons we picked up from that vault would have that kind of effect.

assumed.quote: Clorinde: What about Chiori and Charlotte? I feel like both of them would be more than up to it.

assumed.quote: Inheritor of Cassiodor's will

assumed.quote: Those in the court manipulated by the sorcerer also recognized the errors of their ways...
