assumed.quote: That's certainly very different from the path of a magician.

threads.claim: Evil sorcerers are secretly working with the monsters and have corrupted the court ministers with malicious magic.
threads.quote: Anxious Man: They're actively working with the monsters, and have corrupted the court ministers with malicious magic.

threads.claim: A Remurian sorcerer's golem-army ambition may be the real-world model for the script's evil sorcerer.
threads.quote: Navia: Now wait a second! Don't tell me that guy was the inspiration for the evil sorcerer in the script!

threads.claim: The seal that once held the monsters back may have lost its power, and the cause is still unknown.
threads.quote: Perhaps the seal that kept them at bay has lost its power, or perhaps an evil sorcerer has been meddling in our affairs.

threads.claim: Monsters began to appear after the Remurian dynasty fell and aimed to block humanity's new social order.
threads.quote: Clorinde: The land of Fontaine once played host to an ancient dynasty known as Remuria. After that dynasty fell, monsters began to appear, intent on obstructing humans from establishing a new social order.

threads.claim: The legend of the Marechaussee Hunters is fading, and many people now doubt the old tales.
threads.quote: Anxious Man: To be perfectly honest, I was starting to think all those stories were just tall tales, but now that I've seen you in person, I finally know that it was true!

threads.claim: The Hunters were ordinary mortal fighters whose only distinction was their sword techniques passed down over the centuries.
threads.quote: Clorinde: No, all Marechaussee Hunters were ordinary mortal fighters. The only thing that set them apart were the special sword techniques passed down over the centuries.

threads.claim: Rumor says the nobles in the palace may be secretly in league with the monsters.
threads.quote: Gruff Merchant: Who knows? Maybe they've been in cahoots with the monsters all along.

threads.claim: The monster siege is causing food and supply shortages that could leave the city starving.
threads.quote: Gruff Merchant: We have limited reserves within the city, so if this continues, we're all going to be in big trouble.

threads.claim: Egeria, the ex-Hydro Archon, once called warriors to fight the monsters alongside Cassiodor.
threads.quote: Clorinde: Responding to Egeria's call, a number of warriors followed Cassiodor into battle against the monsters.

threads.claim: Clorinde's master Petronilla had a past connection with Navia's family that something happened to end.
threads.quote: Navia: Absolutely. Ms. Petronilla and my father were good friends. Back in the day, she would often bring Clorinde over to play. But then...

threads.claim: Clorinde's private self may be more emotional than her court persona suggests, and Furina doubts she has ever seen her cry.
threads.quote: Furina: Well, you say that, but for all the time I've known you, I don't think I've ever seen you cry...

threads.claim: Even the game master does not know how the script's story will end.
threads.quote: Navia: Hehe, and it's got a real healthy amount of suspense, right? I mean, even the GM doesn't know how the story will end!

threads.claim: Clorinde's master vanished the night Clorinde turned ten, leaving no explanation.
threads.quote: She suddenly disappeared the night I turned ten years old.

threads.claim: Clorinde believes her master had a reason for leaving and did not vanish for no reason.
threads.quote: I don't believe Master would suddenly disappear for no reason.

threads.claim: The Protector of Justice and Protector of Order were both codenames of Clorinde's night-active master.
threads.quote: Oh, she had a bunch of codenames.

threads.claim: A stone door pattern reminds Clorinde of something her master once mentioned, hinting at a hidden connection.
threads.quote: A pattern on a stone door... That's something Master mentioned before...

threads.claim: The Devorator is a monster that amplifies obsessions and can overtake people entirely.
threads.quote: I heard it has the power to amplify the obsessions and desires in people's hearts

threads.claim: A powerful sorcerer secretly controls the palace guards and golems behind the scenes.
threads.quote: His faction is too powerful. The guards are all under his control, and he's even stationed a number of golems in various rooms throughout the palace.

threads.claim: The sorcerer may be hiding in the kingdom's church and reacts with fear to the treasure.
threads.quote: I believe he's currently hiding out at the church in the kingdom.

threads.claim: Florian felt an angry presence in his heart that did not seem to belong to him.
threads.quote: I just always felt like there was something in my heart that didn't belong to me

threads.claim: Florian confesses that the sorcerer brainwashed him into luring the party into the cave.
threads.quote: I confess... I was brainwashed by the evil sorcerer.

threads.claim: Four Hunter keys are needed to form the final key, and the party has collected three of them.
threads.quote: It is said that four keys in total are required to form the final, complete key.

threads.claim: The vault door opens once the final key is assembled, revealing the treasure inside.
threads.quote: Before you, the door to the treasure, sealed and undisturbed for more than a hundred years, finally swings open.

threads.claim: Past Hunters left a treasure in the vault with the power to defeat the sorcerer.
threads.quote: the Marechaussee Hunters of the past left behind a treasure with the power to defeat the sorcerer.

threads.claim: The vault treasure is a stone tablet and old weapons, representing the Hunters' legacy rather than riches.
threads.quote: The contents of that room... they represent the true legacy the Hunters left behind.

threads.claim: Florian complains that the world forgot the Hunters and gave them no recognition.
threads.quote: and a world that forgot all about him.

threads.claim: The tablet was made so Hunters would be remembered by each other, not by the public.
threads.quote: this tablet was created not so that the Hunters would be remembered by the people, but so that they would be remembered by each other.

threads.claim: The short sword's craftsmanship looks several hundred years old, which puzzles the party.
threads.quote: the craftsmanship doesn't appear to resemble anything from this era.

threads.claim: Clorinde thinks the sword is an heirloom passed down over time, not proof her master is ancient.
threads.quote: I'd say the sword was most likely an heirloom passed down over time.

threads.claim: After the duel, Clorinde and Navia could not face each other, and the sword was given to Navia.
threads.quote: There was a period of time where we simply didn't know how to face each other.

threads.claim: Clorinde and Navia have since found their way back to each other.
threads.quote: The most important thing is that you two found your way back to each other

threads.claim: The Devorator can take over a host's body and mind, and Florian offers himself as its target to draw it out.
threads.quote: I intend to lure it into my body.

threads.claim: The Devorator came from the same era as the Hunters and reacted to their names, linking it to the old Hunters.
threads.quote: This particular Devorator probably hailed from the same era as the Hunters we saw in the room.

threads.claim: The names of the bravest past Hunters on the vault tablet hold power that summons their aid against monsters.
threads.quote: Every name on that tablet made the same choice.

threads.claim: The Hunters serve the city while their accomplishments may be forgotten, and Clorinde chooses not to have her identity remembered.
threads.quote: even should all memory of their accomplishments be forgotten by the very people they serve.

threads.claim: The sorcerer behind the monsters and the phantoms is defeated.
threads.quote: And so, the monsters were eradicated, and the sorcerer was defeated.

threads.claim: Florian's error let the Devorator break free, and it is unclear how the Devorator was released.
threads.quote: This monster broke free due to my error.

threads.claim: The events of the play were improvised by the cast rather than being a real scripted story.
threads.quote: It's probably more accurate to say this was never a real scripted story to begin with.

threads.claim: A certain catastrophe five hundred years ago severed the Tsaritsa's ties with Venti completely.
threads.quote: Venti: You see, a certain catastrophe happened five hundred years ago, and after that, she cut off all ties with me.

threads.claim: Venti does not know what the Tsaritsa is thinking or planning after five hundred years apart.
threads.quote: Venti: The Tsaritsa... I haven't seen her in five hundred years. What is she thinking? What's her plan?

threads.quote: Venti: But as for which of The Seven took your ... I'm sorry, I don't know.

threads.claim: Mondstadt is a city without a king and is known as the City of Freedom.
threads.quote: Venti: Mondstadt is a romantic city, without the reign of a king.

threads.claim: Venti argues that freedom demanded by an archon is no freedom at all.
threads.quote: Venti: Freedom, if demanded of you by an archon, is really no freedom at all.

threads.claim: The Traveler realizes the Anemo voice heard earlier was Venti's.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon set out to search the seven nations for clues and to meet The Seven.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks it's time to leave Mondstadt, and keep looking through the seven nations until we find clues about .

threads.claim: Venti has become the weakest of The Seven because of his long absences from Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Venti: Without a doubt, I am now the weakest archon among The Seven!

introduced.quote: In Inazuma City, Yoimiya and her father Naganohara Ryuunosuke are talking about a trip

introduced.quote: Sumeru... I've heard of it. It has a ton of trees, a super impressive school, and a massive desert!

introduced.quote: There's also a division of the school that specializes in studying the stars.

introduced.quote: For example, we'll be looking for someone from Rtawahist. They know a lot about stars and stuff.

introduced.quote: This is our current best-seller, the Aranara Carving.

introduced.quote: Welcome to Acara Crafts! Feel free to have a look around.

introduced.name: Meteor showers respond to wishes
introduced.how: meteor showers are summoned by people's wishes rather than wished upon
introduced.quote: Meteor showers appear in response to people's wishes.

introduced.name: Aranara growing up

introduced.quote: Everyone says you can't see Aranara anymore once you become an adult.

introduced.quote: Well, I can't summon a real meteor shower, but if it's in a dream, I can help out.

introduced.name: Naganohara meteor-shower inspiration
introduced.how: a long-ago Naganohara ancestor created new fireworks after watching a meteor shower
introduced.quote: A long time ago, the Naganoharas were inspired to create new fireworks after watching such a meteor shower.

introduced.name: Ahangar

introduced.quote: I chatted with him a bit when Avin was showing me around. He seems really knowledgeable.

introduced.name: Urstone
introduced.how: a legendary forging ore that blacksmiths revere and that no one has seen
introduced.quote: We call it Urstone, but in truth, neither I nor my colleagues have ever seen it.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: a group identified by their green scarves who help watch the city
introduced.quote: Haha, you mean the Corps of Thirty? Don't worry, I got it.

introduced.name: Niousha
introduced.how: Avin's mother, worried about her depression and disappearance
introduced.quote: I'm Avin's mother.

introduced.name: Avin
introduced.how: a young wheelchair-bound girl who lost her Aranara friend and is slowly forgetting him
introduced.quote: Oh, her? Her name is Avin.

introduced.name: Arapurva
introduced.how: an Aranara who can bring people to see other Aranara
introduced.quote: Arapurva: I can bring you all to see Arashani.

introduced.quote: Arapurva: I remember Nara Avin and Arashani.

introduced.name: Sadegh
introduced.how: Ahangar's supplier who knows the comings and goings on Treasures Street
introduced.quote: He's my supplier.

introduced.name: Devantaka Mountain

introduced.quote: Needing a new change of scenery, the group heads to Devantaka Mountain.

introduced.name: Avin

introduced.quote: Avin: But I'll never be able to stand again. Even if I can recover, I don't know how long that'll take.

introduced.name: Arapurva
introduced.how: a guide who led them through the dream and says dreams are tied to the heart

introduced.name: Yoimiya

introduced.quote: Yoimiya: Don't worry, I'll make you some fireworks that you'll never forget!

introduced.name: dream realm

introduced.quote: Paimon: Not our first time in one. Ah, no wonder Arapurva said not to worry... Avin can move freely in this dream.

introduced.name: Urstone
introduced.how: a rare ore that symbolizes a person's aspirations and dreams and can be seen once what was lost is found
introduced.quote: Yoimiya: It's a very rare ore that symbolizes a person's aspirations and dreams.

introduced.quote: Avin: That's not what they're for. Let me show you!

assumed.name: Saika

assumed.name: Arataki Gang

assumed.quote: Yoimiya listens with rapt attention as you tell her of the events following the Vision Hunt Decree and of your various adventures in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Nilou

threads.claim: Avin insists the Aranara are real beings, not just fairy-tale characters.
threads.quote: But they aren't! They're real! They couldn't be more real!

threads.claim: Aranara seem to be lost to people once they become adults.
threads.quote: Everyone says you can't see Aranara anymore once you become an adult.

threads.claim: Arapurva explains that Nara grow up and say goodbye to their younger selves, and few manage to prepare for it.
threads.quote: All Nara grow up, and when they do, they will say goodbye to their young selves.

threads.claim: Aranara only appear to people they trust, which is why the Traveler's trust matters.
threads.quote: Aranara trust Golden Nara. If that were not so... I would not have appeared.

threads.claim: Meteor showers are said to be summoned by people's wishes, not by wishing on shooting stars.
threads.quote: Meteor showers appear in response to people's wishes.

threads.claim: Yoimiya theorizes that fireworks symbolize the past while shooting stars symbolize the future wishes people carry.
threads.quote: In other words, fireworks symbolize the past.

threads.claim: Rtawahist research says meteor showers arise from tangled fates and cannot be reliably predicted.
threads.quote: According to current Rtawahist research, a meteor shower is a celestial phenomenon that occurs due to the interference between many intricate fates.

threads.claim: Nahida can create a meteor shower within a dream, so the Traveler and Paimon must stage a fake one.
threads.quote: Well, I can't summon a real meteor shower, but if it's in a dream, I can help out.

threads.claim: Urstone is a legendary ore that no smith in Sumeru has ever seen, pursued as a dream and a warning.
threads.quote: We call it Urstone, but in truth, neither I nor my colleagues have ever seen it.

threads.claim: Avin's Aranara best friend has gone missing, and Avin cannot remember his name or face.
threads.quote: My bestest friend... He went missing...

threads.claim: Arapurva offers to bring the group to Arashani in Mawtiyima Forest once Avin is prepared.
threads.quote: Arapurva: I can bring you all to see Arashani.

threads.claim: Avin's illness is causing her to lose memories of running and of her friend.
threads.quote: But the longer I sit, the cloudier those memories get.

threads.claim: Yoimiya has a personal wish for the meteor shower that she is keeping secret.
threads.quote: As for what my wish is... Hehe, it's a secret for now.

threads.claim: The Traveler and their sibling are estranged, and Yoimiya expects them to reconcile after their journey.
threads.quote: I believe that you two will come to an understanding once your journey is over.

threads.claim: Yoimiya argues that every legend depends on belief, which is what makes the meteor shower possible.
threads.quote: But there's a premise to every legend, and that's belief!

threads.claim: Dreams are connected to the heart rather than the body, hinting that Avin's healing depends on her inner state.
threads.quote: Arapurva: Such worries are not needed here. Nara Avin, you must remember. Dreams are connected to your heart, not your body.

threads.claim: The Urstone is needed to make the purest lens, and Avin's Urstone glasses are offered to help find one.
threads.quote: Yoimiya: Oh, um, we have to look for one of our own later — to make the purest lens.

threads.claim: Yoimiya had known from the start that the events were a dream and was unbothered by it.
threads.quote: Traveler: You already knew that it was a dream.

threads.claim: The Aranara do not usually like something, hinting at friction between them and outsiders.
threads.quote: Paimon: Um, by the way... the Aranara, they don't usually like...

threads.claim: Arashani refuses to enter the city, suggesting a reason the Aranara keep away from human settlements.
threads.quote: Arashani: Arashani does not dare enter the city. Arashani did not see Nara Avin, so Arashani thought you had made new friends.

threads.claim: Wood carvings of the Aranara seem to have inspired the dream, hinting at a link between carvings and the Aranara.
threads.quote: Yoimiya: Yeah. If we hadn't seen those wood carvings, then we wouldn't have dreamed of such cute Aranara.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: decree that seizes Visions, which the resistance seeks to repeal
introduced.quote: I presume you've heard that the goal of the resistance is to defeat the Shogun's Army and repeal the Vision Hunt Decree.

introduced.how: public ceremony marking the 100th Vision seized under the decree, with Thoma as the target
introduced.quote: The Raiden Shogun is holding a Vision Hunt Ceremony at the Statue of the Omnipresent God today, to mark the 100th Vision seized under the decree.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: Visions are rare, and the decree makes Vision bearers rarer still
introduced.quote: Vision bearers are few and far between as it is, and because of the Vision Hunt Decree, they're rarer than ever.

introduced.name: resistance
introduced.how: anti-decree resistance founded by Kokomi and led in the field by Gorou
introduced.quote: The resistance was founded by Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Shogun's Army
introduced.how: Shogunate army enforcing the decree, backed by the general Kujou Sara's strong force
introduced.quote: To this end, they have the support of the Tenryou Commission's general, Kujou Sara, who commands an exceptionally strong force.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission general commanding the Shogun's Army
introduced.quote: To this end, they have the support of the Tenryou Commission's general, Kujou Sara, who commands an exceptionally strong force.

introduced.name: Gorou
introduced.how: Kokomi's subordinate who leads the resistance in its war against the Shogun's Army
introduced.quote: Currently, it's her subordinate, Gorou, who leads them in their war against the Shogun's Army.

introduced.name: Teppei
introduced.how: resistance soldier of the Gobious Platoon who introduces himself
introduced.quote: I'm Teppei of the Gobious Platoon. I'm with the resistance.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: resistance organizer and Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: I am Sangonomiya Kokomi, organizer of the resistance, and also the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: home front of the resistance, governed by the Divine Priestess
introduced.quote: To put it simply, I'm the person currently in charge on Watatsumi Island, which is also the home front of the resistance.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Ayaka's organization, neutral and not on close terms with the resistance
introduced.quote: However, the Yashiro Commission is not on especially close terms with the resistance.

introduced.name: fight of honor
introduced.how: ceremonial single combat before battle, giving a boost to the weaker side's morale
introduced.quote: Before the battle begins, each side chooses their finest warrior for a match of single combat.

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: wild bug ground into powder to make a fast-healing wound dressing
introduced.quote: All you need to do is grind Onikabuto into powder, and it makes a very effective dressing.

introduced.name: Kazuha's friend's execution
introduced.how: Kazuha's friend lost a duel before the throne and was executed by the Raiden Shogun; Kazuha fled with the friend's Vision
introduced.quote: At that time, his friend was defeated in a duel before the throne... and executed by the Raiden Shogun.

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Highly unusual, considering that the Raiden Shogun appeared in person...

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: On the way here, I heard that Thoma had been taken away by the Tenryou Commission.

assumed.name: Komore Teahouse
assumed.quote: As usual, it's the first stop, Komore Teahouse.

assumed.name: Taroumaru
assumed.quote: What's got Taroumaru so worked up today? He's always such a good boy...

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: He is my friend! To think that not long ago, we were... all eating hotpot together...

assumed.name: Musou no Hitotachi
assumed.quote: I mean, we've all heard of the Musou no Hitotachi, right? Haha.

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: We meet again, old friend

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: But wherever you might end up, you'll always be part of Captain Beidou's crew.

assumed.name: Alcor
assumed.quote: I guarantee you, only the Alcor could pull off an ambush as quietly as that.

assumed.name: Tatarasuna
assumed.quote: Go to Tatarasuna and find the resistance.

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree remains in force and has not been repealed, with the Tenryou Commission and Raiden Shogun showing no sign of stopping.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun treats the Traveler's Vision-less use of elemental energy as an anomaly she must verify.
threads.quote: You are an exception, it appears

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun regards exceptions as enemies of Eternity, the goal the Shogun's Army claims to uphold.
threads.quote: Exceptions... the enemy of Eternity

threads.claim: Using elemental powers without a Vision raises the question of whether the Traveler is immune to the Vision Hunt Decree.
threads.quote: Are you serious!? That's... incredible. And I guess that means you're immune to the Vision Hunt Decree?

threads.claim: The Musou no Hitotachi is hinted to be a force that can withstand the Raiden Shogun, though its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: The Musou no Hitotachi... Are there truly those who can withstand it?

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun promises to strike the Traveler again next time.
threads.quote: Raiden Shogun: Next time, I will strike twice

threads.claim: Teppei suspects an informant inside the resistance camp is feeding the Shogun's Army intelligence.
threads.quote: Unless... we have a traitor in our midst.

threads.claim: Kazuha's return to Inazuma is explained by his friend's execution by the Raiden Shogun after a duel, and his flight with the friend's Vision.
threads.quote: Kazuha came to visit the resistance as he was fleeing Inazuma with his friend's Vision.

introduced.quote: Paimon: Chongyun is one-in-a-million: He has a pure-yang spirit! So, as soon as he gets close, evil spirits run and hide!

introduced.name: Callirhoe
introduced.how: a traveler from Fontaine who was attending the poetry event
introduced.quote: Callirhoe: That's right! I was traveling in the area, and just happened to see there was a poetry event being held at Stone Gate.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, introduced as a poetry expert judging the second day
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce you all to Zhongli, a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

introduced.name: pairing couplets
introduced.how: a Liyue poetry game where you write a matching second line to a given line
introduced.quote: Based on a given line of poetry, you must create the second line to form a pair

introduced.name: inspiration walk
introduced.how: an outing into the wild to take in scenery and gather poetic thoughts
introduced.quote: By inspiration walk, we simply mean wandering around in the wild, taking in the scenery, and pocketing any poetic thoughts.

introduced.name: Heart of Clear Springs
introduced.how: a tragic story about a spring fairy who leaves a boy who loves her
introduced.quote: Diona: My dad told me the story once. It's about a spring fairy and a young boy.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Mika: Please don't say that, Mr. Chongyun. Master Jean ordered us to work with you however we can to improve cooperation.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Noelle: Besides, investigating any strange occurrences near Mondstadt and making a report to the Knights of Favonius is also part of our job.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Chongyun: Are those really fit for human consumption? This is starting to sound like something Xiangling would make...

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Oh ho, but my dear dear Paimon, it seems you are not yet aware.

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Chongyun: Conqueror of Demons?

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Mika: ...So, Miss Callirhoe, are you from Fontaine?

assumed.name: Stone Gate
assumed.quote: Venti: The sun is shining bright today! As soon as that leaf floats past Stone Gate, we shall reveal today's poetry theme!

assumed.name: the investigation
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, is it that thing from yesterday?

threads.claim: Xiao hints that Chongyun's rare pure-yang constitution is valuable and should be treasured.
threads.quote: Xiao: Your physical constitution is far rarer than the techniques still passed down by exorcists today. You should treasure it.

threads.claim: The anomaly Chongyun saw may not have been an evil spirit, and it may have already left.
threads.quote: Xiao: I have already patrolled the area and found nothing amiss. Either the anomaly you encountered was no evil spirit, or perhaps it already left.

threads.claim: Xiao senses something special in Diona, suggesting she has an adeptal affinity.
threads.quote: Xiao: In Liyue, we might say this child has adeptal affinity.

threads.claim: Xiao secretly keeps watching the poetry venue from a mountain peak.
threads.quote: Xiao is once again watching from a mountain peak nearby.

threads.claim: The anonymous leaf poem seems to be a lost love written by someone who may never have been reunited with their beloved.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... It sounds like the author is writing about the first time they met their true love...

threads.claim: Xiao doubts the poem's purpose, and the group chooses to send a reply upstream to reach the writer.
threads.quote: Xiao: I just hope this isn't all in vain.

threads.claim: An unnamed woman on a bridge is first met as a stranger before she is revealed to be Callirhoe from Fontaine.
threads.quote: ???: Hello. Are you here on your inspiration walk too?

threads.claim: Callirhoe poses the question of whether the spring fairy should return to the boy she left.
threads.quote: Callirhoe: Well... Do you think she should go back and see that boy again, if she ever had another chance?

threads.claim: Venti frames freestyle poetry as unrestricted, as free as the winds, with no limits on genre or content.
threads.quote: Venti: It's as free as the winds that blow, and there's nothing freer!

introduced.name: Mirage
introduced.how: Stable mirages can be built from the hallucinations of people with strong willpower
introduced.quote: However, Kazuha, Xinyan, Fischl, and Mona were able to construct stable mirages out of their hallucinations.

introduced.name: Fatui machine
introduced.how: A strange machine in a Fatui camp that affects people differently depending on their willpower
introduced.quote: Kazuha reveals to everyone that he and the Traveler had found a strange machine in a Fatui camp

introduced.name: Astrology
introduced.how: Divination reads the stars, which record a person's life events along their path and show their fate
introduced.quote: As your stars move across the sky, they record all your life events in their path.

introduced.name: Mona's early divinations
introduced.how: Mona's first divinations made clients resent her honest, harsh predictions and left her miserable
introduced.quote: It felt as if I was being stabbed with razor-sharp knives formed by their disappointment.

introduced.name: Adventurer's divination
introduced.how: Mona warned an adventurer three years ago that he would die within two years unless he quit, and he refused
introduced.quote: I advised him to give up adventuring as soon as possible, otherwise he could meet his end within the next two years.

introduced.name: Mirage shards
introduced.how: Shards collected from the location reflected in a pool are needed to enter the mirage
introduced.quote: We can't enter the mirage without 'em.

assumed.name: Oz
assumed.quote: Oz: What mein Fräulein means is that she is ready to take on the next challenge.

assumed.name: Fischl
assumed.quote: Fischl: Huh, we've returned here once more.

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Is everyone awake now? Mona says that she has something important to tell everyone.

assumed.name: Xinyan
assumed.quote: Xinyan: Everyone, over here!

assumed.name: Immernachtreich
assumed.quote: Fischl: The first glimmering daybreak after the return of the Immernachtreich most certainly revitalizes one's innermost spirits.

assumed.name: Megistus
assumed.quote: Fischl: Who would've thought! Even Megistus the Court Archmage was not spared of vexatious times in her career.

assumed.name: Scryglass
assumed.quote: Mona: I just peeked into my scryglass, and there's a new mirage forming on the island over there.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: We found a strange machine there, as well as some disoriented Fatui.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Oz: The area appears to be the mountains of Mondstadt. Wait, have we been sent back to Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Archipelago
assumed.quote: The group leave the mirage, returning to the Archipelago.

threads.claim: A damaged Fatui machine seems to cause both madness and mirages, with the effect depending on willpower.
threads.quote: Kazuha reveals to everyone that he and the Traveler had found a strange machine in a Fatui camp

threads.claim: Mona suspects the machine can influence the human brain, so it must be handled carefully.
threads.quote: If my guess is correct, that machine is capable of influencing the human brain.

threads.claim: Someone deliberately brought the mirages into being, and they are side products rather than clues.
threads.quote: Someone did something to bring the mirages into being.

threads.claim: A transparent crystal bird that became a star hints at a hidden meaning in the stars.
threads.quote: There was a transparent bird made of crystal

threads.claim: Mona accepts that fate cannot be altered or reversed and resolves to seize her own destiny.
threads.quote: Fate is called such precisely because it cannot be altered or reversed.

threads.claim: Astrology is a disdained profession because it reveals truths that many people cannot accept.
threads.quote: Which is why astrology is a disdained profession!

threads.claim: The adventurer from Mona's divination is presumed dead, confirming her grim prediction.
threads.quote: That was the only time I ever saw him. And that was more than three years ago, which means... he's no longer alive.

threads.claim: Entering the mirage requires collecting shards from locations reflected in pools.
threads.quote: Instead of making a scene, why don't you go collect the other fragments in the new location reflected by the pool?

introduced.name: Gorou
introduced.how: Watatsumi Island general who is embarrassed by Yae Miko and introduces himself as a high-ranking general
introduced.quote: I'm a high-ranking general of Watatsumi Island, how could I do such a thing!

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: teasing figure who makes Gorou uneasy and whom he finds hard to deal with
introduced.quote: I've never been good at dealing with people like her.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Gorou's home island, which signed a peace treaty with the Shogunate
introduced.quote: Since Watatsumi Island signed a peace treaty with the Shogunate, we've had much closer contact than we did before.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: power that rules the area around Narukami Island
introduced.quote: I also wanted to come and see what things are like in an area ruled by the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: publisher of the monthly magazine That's Life, which has an advice column
introduced.quote: They run a monthly magazine called "That's Life," which has an advice column.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: decree that angered Narukami islanders and drove some to join the resistance
introduced.quote: I couldn't turn a blind eye to the Vision Hunt Decree, and my anger drove me to join the resistance.

introduced.name: resistance
introduced.how: armed group Gorou leads as general, opposing the Shogunate
introduced.quote: I am a high-ranking military officer of Watatsumi Island and the general of the resistance.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: gang of thieves who stole from Komore Teahouse and buried loot at Nazuchi Beach
introduced.quote: Not long ago, we received a commission concerning a theft by Treasure Hoarders at Komore Teahouse.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: holds recovered stolen items and takes commissions, including the Treasure Hoarders case
introduced.quote: For now, all we can do is hold all related items at the Adventurers' Guild until such a time as we have caught the group of Treasure Hoarders in question.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild staffer who explains the case and the held box
introduced.quote: Hmm, I'm afraid that will be a little difficult...

introduced.name: Komore Teahouse
introduced.how: establishment that is actually a hot pot restaurant and was robbed by Treasure Hoarders
introduced.quote: It's actually a hot pot place.

introduced.name: Taroumaru
introduced.how: dog who overheard the thieves and whom Gorou seems to understand
introduced.quote: Gorou: He says he knows where the Treasure Hoarders are hiding.

introduced.name: Kousuke
introduced.how: leader of the Treasure Hoarders gang
introduced.quote: the leader's name is Kousuke, and the second-in-command is called Yasuhisa.

introduced.name: Taroumaru's No. 2 Reserve Fund
introduced.how: the stolen box of funds that was recovered from the Treasure Hoarders
introduced.quote: It was Taroumaru's No. 2 Reserve Fund that they stole.

introduced.name: Nazuchi Beach battle
introduced.how: past defeat where the resistance retreated and Gorou buried a box of soldiers' belongings
introduced.quote: The odds were stacked against us that day, and the resistance was forced to retreat.

introduced.name: Hiroaki
introduced.how: resistance soldier who asks Gorou for permission to leave the resistance
introduced.quote: I would like to request permission to leave the resistance, Sir!

introduced.name: Ms. Hina
introduced.how: advice columnist of That's Life whose identity is hidden and who is admired by a fan club
introduced.quote: Ms. Hina is the person in charge of "That's Life" magazine's advice column.

introduced.name: Mysterious Flyer
introduced.how: pamphlet advertising Ms. Hina as Teyvat's Big Sister
introduced.quote: Gentle and kind, she answers all your questions

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: island nearby where outlander merchants are based
introduced.quote: I heard all the outlander merchants are based there, so it might help to create the right atmosphere.

introduced.name: personal items of fallen soldiers
introduced.how: water bottles, towels and knee guards with soldiers' names, kept as keepsakes for their families
introduced.quote: Some personal items that once belonged to troops under my command.

introduced.name: Miwa
introduced.how: Sangonomiya Shrine staffer said to be good with interpersonal matters, whom Gorou's group goes to for advice
introduced.quote: I heard that Miwa from Sangonomiya Shrine is also in the area.

introduced.name: Shuuhei
introduced.how: older army comrade of Gorou's who offers advice on dealing with intense people by going through the motions
introduced.quote: Based on my experience, the easiest way to deal with people like that is just go through the motions.

introduced.name: Kuroda
introduced.how: Yae Publishing House staff member who explains how manuscripts are screened and approved
introduced.quote: Greetings. Here to buy some books?

introduced.name: Maki
introduced.how: Grand Narukami Shrine attendant who offers fortune slips to visitors
introduced.quote: Hello there. You look like you have something weighing on your mind.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: publishing house where manuscripts are screened and sent for approval before publication
introduced.quote: Well, first, we screen all manuscripts, filter out the bad ones, and write synopses for the rest.

introduced.name: Guuji Yae
introduced.how: name Yae Publishing House staff use for the figure who gives final approval on books; a publishing identity tied to Yae Miko
introduced.quote: Then, we send those to Lady Guuji for final approval.

introduced.name: That's Life
introduced.how: magazine published by Yae Publishing House that Lady Guuji saved with a new marketing plan
introduced.quote: Take "That's Life" magazine, for example.

introduced.name: General Operational Directives
introduced.how: guidance documents from Sangonomiya Kokomi in three parts covering deployment, logistics, and social situations
introduced.quote: Her Excellency handed me the General Operational Directives in three parts

introduced.name: Fortune Slip
introduced.how: divination slips drawn at the shrine, each with one of four fortunes
introduced.quote: There are four possible fortunes for each Fortune Slip: Great Fortune, Good Fortune, Misfortune, and Great Misfortune.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: shrine that is Yae Miko's lair and where fortune slips are drawn
introduced.quote: So this is the Grand Narukami Shrine... it's the first time I've been to this place.

assumed.name: Her Excellency
assumed.quote: The real reason I'm here at Yae Publishing House is to buy some books for Her Excellency.

assumed.name: Lady Guuji
assumed.quote: Pardon me. Lady Guuji, we have completed the matter you instructed us about previously.

assumed.name: Kazuha
assumed.quote: Kazuha once told me that the bonds between people whose paths have crossed can never be broken, even after they part ways.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: I've dealt with Fatui before, but I always end up against those big stocky guys who are much taller than me.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: I don't see any Tenryou Commission soldiers roaming the streets

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: Taroumaru says he heard the Treasure Hoarders conspiring to hide out at the beach directly below Tenshukaku.

assumed.name: Gorou
assumed.quote: Phew, I feel more at ease on Watatsumi Island.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: You can't be too careful when you're going up against Yae Miko.

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
assumed.quote: Her Excellency updated her General Operational Directives recently.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Island
assumed.quote: When I think about it, I'm a general of Watatsumi Island.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Army
assumed.quote: Many of my army comrades are older than me

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: I shouldn't let some Narukami Island fortune slip hold me back.

assumed.name: Swordfish II
assumed.quote: General Gorou, and the Captain of Swordfish II... What are you doing here?

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree angered Narukami islanders and pushed some of them into the resistance.
threads.quote: I couldn't turn a blind eye to the Vision Hunt Decree, and my anger drove me to join the resistance.

threads.claim: Gorou questions whether keeping soldiers in the resistance is any different from the Vision Hunt Decree.
threads.quote: But, if making them stay causes them pain... how are my actions any different from the Vision Hunt Decree?

threads.claim: Some former resistance members have grown disillusioned with the Shogunate and feel torn about their homeland.
threads.quote: The resistance has treated me well, and I've long been disillusioned by the Shogunate

threads.claim: The advice columnist Ms. Hina's true identity is concealed from readers and the public.
threads.quote: Although the editor chose to conceal her name, gender, and other details, we all see her as an empathetic older sister figure

threads.claim: The Traveler resembles Ms. Hina, and the Traveler is hiding something about her from Gorou.
threads.quote: Something about you looks awfully similar to Ms. Hina...

threads.claim: Ms. Hina's encouragement has influenced soldiers like Hiroaki to change their lives.
threads.quote: Thanks to Ms. Hina's encouragement, I was finally able to find the courage to talk to you about it.

threads.claim: Gorou can partly understand what Taroumaru says, in a way he compares to a regional dialect.
threads.quote: It's like listening to a regional dialect.

threads.claim: Gorou suspects Yae Miko may be plotting against him and feels uneasy around her.
threads.quote: Could she be plotting something?

threads.claim: Gorou's fear of Yae Miko comes from her knowing smile and piercing gaze, which make him feel his secrets are exposed.
threads.quote: I think that maybe what I'm really afraid of is her knowing smile and her piercing gaze.

threads.claim: Gorou buried an important box at Nazuchi Beach during the retreat from the Shogun's Army.
threads.quote: I had to abandon the box, but I managed to quickly bury it first.

threads.claim: The buried box holds personal keepsakes of fallen soldiers that Gorou recovers and returns to their families.
threads.quote: Some personal items that once belonged to troops under my command.

threads.claim: Gorou blames himself for failing to lead his soldiers to victory at Nazuchi Beach.
threads.quote: My soldiers trusted me, but I failed to lead them to victory that day.

threads.claim: Bonds between people who have met are presented as lasting even after they separate.
threads.quote: Kazuha once told me that the bonds between people whose paths have crossed can never be broken, even after they part ways.

threads.claim: Denjirou believes soldiers will always return to Watatsumi Island and support each other in times of danger.
threads.quote: all of us will be straight back here if Watatsumi Island is ever in danger.

threads.claim: Gorou tells Hiroaki he is free to go wherever he wants and will remain his comrade.
threads.quote: There is no need to limit yourself to a specific place — just do what you want to do.

threads.claim: Yae Miko is portrayed as the most mysterious person, whose true thoughts no one can read.
threads.quote: Just my opinion, but she's the most mysterious person I've ever met!

threads.claim: Yae Miko's constant smile hides her real thoughts, so she always holds the advantage.
threads.quote: It's because she always has that same smile on her face, so no one ever knows what she's really thinking.

threads.claim: Yae Miko personally runs marketing at Yae Publishing House, linking her to the Guuji Yae name.
threads.quote: I didn't realize Yae Miko personally handled the marketing for Yae Publishing House.

threads.claim: Gorou seems to recognize the That's Life magazine, hinting at a personal connection to it.
threads.quote: Gorou: "That's Life"? Wait, isn't that...

threads.claim: Shuuhei suggests that an admirable habit of taking everyone seriously makes a person easy to manipulate.
threads.quote: But the other side of the coin is that it makes General Gorou's friend very susceptible to falling for the other party's verbal traps and being led by the nose.

threads.claim: Yae Miko's tail-based teasing turns out to be a bluff, since she has no tail at all.
threads.quote: I don't have a tail at all.

introduced.name: Diona
introduced.how: Nimrod introduces her as the best bartender in Mondstadt who runs The Cat's Tail
introduced.quote: Well, that shouldn't be a problem, Diona will be there. She's the best bartender in all of Mondstadt!

introduced.name: The Cat's Tail
introduced.how: a tavern full of cats, famous for unusual specialty drinks
introduced.quote: The Cat's Tail is renowned for its incredible specialty drinks.

introduced.name: Nimrod
introduced.how: a drunk patron who recommends The Cat's Tail
introduced.quote: Mmm... drinks at The Cat's Tail. Not bad... not bad at all...

introduced.name: Margaret
introduced.how: tavern management at The Cat's Tail who gives Diona tasks
introduced.quote: I'll leave you to it. In the meantime, I'll keep an eye on things here at the tavern.

introduced.name: Roger, Nelson, and Paisley
introduced.how: three tavern cats that snuck out and must be brought back
introduced.quote: The three cats that snuck out are Roger, Nelson, and Paisley.

introduced.name: Kätzlein bloodline
introduced.how: a lineage Diona and Draff belong to, which Draff claims lets them roam freely
introduced.quote: he kept saying that he's a descendant of the Kätzlein bloodline and that he could come and go as he pleases in a place like this.

introduced.name: Draff
introduced.how: Diona's father, a hunter who drinks heavily and leads a hunting team
introduced.quote: Huh, so if you're here, that means my father is also somewhere nearby.

introduced.name: Allan
introduced.how: a hunting team member who explains that Draff rushed into the gorge
introduced.quote: Yeah, my name is Allan. I'm part of the hunting team that Draff leads.

introduced.name: Dadaupa Gorge
introduced.how: a gorge deep with hilichurl tribes where a special drink base can be found
introduced.quote: Dadaupa Gorge is just up ahead. We should be able to find a special drink base there.

introduced.name: Hilichurl tribe in Dadaupa Gorge
introduced.how: a hilichurl tribe deep in Dadaupa Gorge that cooks herbal soup in its pots
introduced.quote: An adventurer who visited the tavern told me that he once ventured deep into Dadaupa Gorge and discovered a type of drink inside the cooking pots of a hilichurl tribe who lived there.

introduced.name: Samachurl Herbal Soup
introduced.how: a potent herbal soup made by samachurls, with an overpowering smell
introduced.quote: The drink is actually a herbal soup made by samachurls using a variety of ingredients.

introduced.name: Hilihog
introduced.how: a huge forest-boar-like creature that hunters chase
introduced.quote: Ha! You don't know a hilihog? It's like a forest boar...

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: a winery Diona sees as the center of an alcohol-selling scheme
introduced.quote: And Dawn Winery is the heart of it all. They have no boundaries when it comes to selling alcohol.

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: a rival tavern to The Cat's Tail with many loyal patrons
introduced.quote: Given that the Cat's Tail and Angel's Share are competitors, it would be rather inappropriate if you were to mix drinks there.

introduced.name: Connor
introduced.how: a bartender tied to Dawn Winery who is considered inferior to Diona
introduced.quote: I myself know a thing or two about mixing drinks, but Elzer tells me that my drinks can't even compare to Diona's...

introduced.name: Elzer
introduced.how: a Dawn Winery figure who has repeatedly pressed Diona to collaborate with the winery
introduced.quote: Don't you know? Elzer used to always show up at the Cat's Tail.

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: an alchemist who recommended alchemy ingredients for flavoring drinks
introduced.quote: The ones we picked up today were primarily from an alchemist named Timaeus, he's recommended many ingredients to me.

introduced.name: Blanche
introduced.how: a supplier who fills Diona's orders for flavoring ingredients
introduced.quote: Hmm... let's go visit Blanche first. I placed an order for some flavoring ingredients that should be ready by now.

introduced.name: Lizard Tail
introduced.how: a bitter ingredient that can be used as drink flavoring
introduced.quote: Lizard Tail's bitter nature will ruin the alcohol's texture and taste.

introduced.name: Frog Mucus
introduced.how: an ingredient that can make a drink's texture very thick
introduced.quote: I have, however, always wanted to try Frog Mucus.

introduced.name: Butterfly Dust
introduced.how: a flavoring ingredient bought in vials from Blanche
introduced.quote: Yes... fifteen Lizard Tails, seven vials of Butterfly Dust...

introduced.name: Fresh Fish Scales
introduced.how: fish scales with a strong grassy scent that are soaked in mucus to preserve them
introduced.quote: First we need to scrape off the scales oh, and make sure you also collect the mucus on the fish...

introduced.name: Fresh Slime Condensate (The Cat and the Cocktail)
introduced.how: a sticky ingredient that gives a drink a dense, sticky texture
introduced.quote: Hm! I think Slime Condensate will intensify the taste and texture of the drink, hehehe...

introduced.name: Dandelion Wine
introduced.how: a wine used as a drink base in the mixing exchange
introduced.quote: I've also prepared a top-shelf bottle of Dandelion Wine to use as a drink base.

introduced.name: Diona's anti-alcohol mission
introduced.how: Diona aims to make the worst drink to expose alcohol's harms
introduced.quote: My mission is to make the worst drink ever, and to wake people up and free Mondstadt from the jaws of alcoholism.

introduced.name: Draff's drunken hunt
introduced.how: after drinking at a hunt, Draff rushed alone into Dadaupa Gorge to find a hilichurl tribe's item
introduced.quote: But after a few drinks, Draff started saying that he wanted to go get something from a hilichurl tribe in the depths of Dadaupa Gorge.

introduced.name: Exchanging Pointers
introduced.how: a mixing contest staged by Connor and Elzer to lure Diona to the winery
introduced.quote: Elzer, your timing couldn't be any more perfect. I'm about to have a little mixing competition with Diona here...

introduced.name: Roger
introduced.how: a cat who is almost always at the tavern and loves cat toys
introduced.quote: Diona: Let's pay a visit to Marjorie at With Wind Comes Glory. Roger broke his cat toy recently and I ordered him a new one there.

introduced.name: Nelson
introduced.how: a cat who eats constantly, is not fond of people, and is lured by Dried Fish and cat food
introduced.quote: Diona: He's the one that always eats the most. And even though he's always eating, he somehow weighs the lightest. I really have no idea what he's up to all the time...

introduced.name: Paisley
introduced.how: a self-centered cat who ignores strangers and does whatever he is in the mood for
introduced.quote: Diona: To sum it up, he's just a self-centered little cat.

introduced.name: Marjorie
introduced.how: the shopkeeper at With Wind Comes Glory who makes cat toys
introduced.quote: Marjorie: Oh, hello Diona. You must be here for the cat toy you ordered?

introduced.name: Sara
introduced.how: works at Good Hunter and has the kitchen make Nelson's cat food
introduced.quote: Diona: Let's head over to see Sara at Good Hunter, she always makes Nelson's cat food.

introduced.name: Margaret
introduced.how: tavern staff at The Cat's Tail who settles fees and greets the returning cats
introduced.quote: Margaret: Oh, it looks like the kitties are back, as well as our customer.

introduced.name: The Cat's Tail
introduced.how: a tavern where the cats live and Diona makes cocktails
introduced.quote: Diona: Well, obviously! The Cat's Tail is a tavern after all.

introduced.name: Good Hunter
introduced.how: a restaurant run by Sara where cat food is made
introduced.quote: Diona: Let's head over to see Sara at Good Hunter, she always makes Nelson's cat food.

introduced.name: With Wind Comes Glory
introduced.how: Marjorie's store where custom cat toys are ordered
introduced.quote: Diona: Let's pay a visit to Marjorie at With Wind Comes Glory.

introduced.name: Cat Toy
introduced.how: a toy that Roger loves, which Diona had made durable at Marjorie's store
introduced.quote: Diona: Hey, you've got a pretty good memory. That's right, cat toys are Roger's favorite.

introduced.name: cat food
introduced.how: food that Nelson loves and Sara makes at Good Hunter
introduced.quote: Diona: That's right! Nelson loves eating this stuff, the cat food will definitely make him happy.

introduced.name: Dried Fish
introduced.how: an ingredient that makes Nelson do whatever you say
introduced.quote: Diona: Nelson's not usually very fond of people, but as soon as he smells some Dried Fish, he'll do anything you say.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Well, that shouldn't be a problem, Diona will be there. She's the best bartender in all of Mondstadt!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: You're... Oh! You're the Honorary Knight!

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: I was about to report to the Knights of Favonius if you took any longer.

assumed.name: Springvale
assumed.quote: Oh, I bet he drank too much again after the hunt and fell asleep somewhere, waiting for someone to drag him back to Springvale.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: This soup was meant to give hilichurls energy.

assumed.name: Diona
assumed.quote: Diona: Hmm, their tracks end here... looks like they ran off somewhere else.

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: Traveler: Why didn't you just go to Angel's Share to work instead?

threads.claim: Diona has never managed to make a bad drink no matter what ingredients she uses.
threads.quote: Ugh, however... up until now, I haven't been able to make a single bad drink, no matter what ingredients I use!

threads.claim: Diona says her drinks are always good for now and she is searching for a solution.
threads.quote: However, that's just the way it is for now. I've been searching for a solution, and the herbal soup is one of the ingredients that I've been searching for.

threads.claim: Draff claims that Kätzlein descent lets him come and go freely in dangerous places like Dadaupa Gorge.
threads.quote: he kept saying that he's a descendant of the Kätzlein bloodline and that he could come and go as he pleases in a place like this.

threads.claim: Diona says she too is of the Kätzlein bloodline and is a quick mover.
threads.quote: I'm also of the Kätzlein bloodline, and I'm much better on my feet than he is.

threads.claim: Draff charged into Dadaupa Gorge for an unknown item, possibly a valuable treasure.
threads.quote: What could Draff be looking for that made him just charge straight in like that? Maybe some kind of valuable treasure?

threads.claim: Draff's errand turns out to be the samachurl herbal soup he found and kept in his flask.
threads.quote: Well I found it! ...Just for you! It's all here in my flask, hahaha... Look, it's full of soup, or... whatever this stuff is!

threads.claim: Diona believes Dawn Winery sells alcohol through schemes to keep people drinking and fill its own pockets.
threads.quote: Their one and only goal is to make sure that people keep drinking, and that their own pockets get filled with Mora.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Connor and Elzer have been secretly planning to draw Diona to the winery.
threads.quote: Traveler: (These two have been planning this all along.)

threads.claim: Elzer openly says the winery wants to hire Diona as its resident bartender.
threads.quote: Elzer: Great job, keep it up. We'll definitely be able to hire Diona as resident bartender here!

threads.claim: Diona secretly plans to make the most disgusting drink ever to turn Mondstadt away from alcohol.
threads.quote: Diona: Nothing good comes of alcohol, it makes people foolish, lazy, and ugly. That's why I plan on making the most disgusting drink there ever was.

threads.claim: Diona admits she has not yet found the recipe for her disgusting drink, and her bartending is part of the plan.
threads.quote: Diona: Although, I haven't discovered how yet, but I will!

threads.claim: Nelson eats the most yet weighs the least, and nobody understands how he stays so light.
threads.quote: Diona: Go ahead, pick him up. He doesn't weigh much. I really have no idea how he stays so light...

introduced.name: Sage of the Stolen Flame
introduced.how: a mysterious figure whose messages marked the path and who may be the strange person
introduced.quote: All the messages we encountered along the way were left by him.

introduced.name: Golden Entreaty
introduced.how: a token the group carries and has collected as one of several tokens
introduced.quote: Sorry, Bona! We're taking the Golden Entreaty with us for now.

introduced.name: volcano
introduced.how: the destination where the mysterious person can be found and the mystery solved
introduced.quote: Then, it's time to go to the volcano and find

introduced.name: strange person in dream

introduced.quote: saw you and a strange person together in a dream.

assumed.name: Tonatiuh
assumed.quote: Did you run into any such strange people onboard the Tonatiuh?

assumed.name: Bona
assumed.quote: What about Bona though? Where did she go?

assumed.name: Between Pledge and Forgettance
assumed.quote: If Between Pledge and Forgettance has been completed

assumed.name: Bona's unfinished adventure
assumed.quote: We completed her unfinished adventure, at least.

threads.claim: A strange person seen in a dream or memory with the Traveler remains unidentified.
threads.quote: saw you and a strange person together in a dream.

threads.claim: The mysterious figure who left messages may be the Sage of the Stolen Flame.
threads.quote: could that guy have been the Sage of the Stolen Flame?

threads.claim: The mysterious figure can take different guises, so the Traveler may have met him without recognizing him.
threads.quote: He also said he takes on different guises, so even if we have run into him, we might not have recognized him...

threads.claim: A golden pattern left along the path by an unknown person hints at a guiding presence.
threads.quote: The one who left that golden pattern all along our path, maybe?

threads.claim: Bona may be a character from a story rather than a real person who lived through the events.
threads.quote: Perhaps Bona was merely a character from a story.

threads.claim: Ordinary people cannot live for hundreds of years, which raises doubt about Bona's nature.
threads.quote: Ordinary people can't live for hundreds of years...

threads.claim: The group completed Bona's unfinished adventure.
threads.quote: We completed her unfinished adventure, at least.

threads.claim: The group plans to lift someone's curse at the volcano.
threads.quote: help lift 's curse to boot.

threads.claim: The group has now gathered all the tokens needed to head to the volcano.
threads.quote: Now that we've got all the tokens, let's head to the volcano

introduced.name: Fontinalia Film Festival
introduced.how: a film festival proposed by the Fontaine Film Association this year
introduced.quote: The Fontinalia Film Festival is an event proposed by the Fontaine Film Association this year.

introduced.name: Lochknights
introduced.how: legendary group that searched for the Oceanids and is commemorated by the Fontinalia Festival
introduced.quote: The Fontinalia Festival was established to commemorate the legendary Lochknights who went on a quest to search for the Oceanids, and eventually welcomed the Hydro Archon Egeria.

introduced.name: Furina Award
introduced.how: prize given by the film association to the highest-scoring festival entry, named after Furina
introduced.quote: The Furina Award. You know, after the Hydro Archon?

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Fontaine's former Hydro Archon who is still a major public star
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Isn't that the name of Fontaine's Hydro Archon? My brother has already informed me about what happened here in Fontaine.

introduced.name: Chiori
introduced.how: direct, forceful clothing designer and Xavier's helper with international actors
introduced.quote: Xavier: How to describe her... Uh, well, she tends to be pretty direct, and can be very forceful when it comes to dealing with people.

introduced.name: Chioriya Boutique
introduced.how: clothing store in the Court of Fontaine run by Chiori
introduced.quote: Traveler: Chioriya Boutique...

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: film director and producer trying to finish his movie
introduced.quote: Xavier: Lady Furina, please allow me to introduce myself. I am Xavier, a film director.

introduced.name: Morris
introduced.how: investor who backed out of funding Xavier's film due to financial trouble
introduced.quote: Xavier: It has to do with the film's investor, Mr. Morris.

introduced.name: The Two Musketeers
introduced.how: suspense thriller novel, a number-one bestseller, that Xavier is adapting into a film
introduced.quote: Furina: Huh? Wait, you mean the suspense thriller novel that was a number-one bestseller?

introduced.name: Aeval
introduced.how: Melusine who works on the aquabus and describes Merusea Village
introduced.quote: Aeval: We Melusines live in Merusea Village. The only way to enter is from underwater!

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: Melusine village reachable only by swimming from underwater
introduced.quote: Aeval: We Melusines live in Merusea Village. The only way to enter is from underwater!

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Inazuma delegation sent to Fontaine on a cultural survey
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayato: Indeed, you could say that's the real reason why the Yashiro Commission agreed to come to Fontaine.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: head of the Kamisato Clan visiting Fontaine as an Inazuma actor
introduced.quote: Xavier: It's an honor to have the head of the Kamisato Clan visit us.

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: eye-patched captain of the Special Patrol who runs a stakeout disguised as reading
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: I am Chevreuse, Captain of Fontaine's Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

introduced.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
introduced.how: Fontaine's special patrol that works with muskets and arrests criminals
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: I am Chevreuse, Captain of Fontaine's Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: investigating body running the secret murder investigation, which is at a standstill
introduced.quote: The Marechaussee Phantom hasn't yet released any information to the public, because the investigation is currently at a standstill.

introduced.name: Sinthe
introduced.how: illegal substance whose production was halted, with leftover batches still circulating
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: Now that Vacher has been brought to justice, no new shipments of Sinthe will be made and distributed to sellers.

introduced.name: Vacher
introduced.how: figure who was brought to justice and whose Sinthe operation was shut down
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: Now that Vacher has been brought to justice, no new shipments of Sinthe will be made and distributed to sellers.

introduced.name: clapper loader
introduced.how: crew role that uses the clapperboard to log each shot when filming starts
introduced.quote: The clapper loader is responsible for using the clapperboard to record and organize the information of each shot when the Kamera operator begins shooting.

introduced.name: Fontinalia Mousse
introduced.how: dessert that is one of Furina's favorites and is used as a gift
introduced.quote: Oh! Is this Fontinalia Mousse? It's one of my favorites!

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: If Neuvillette were to hear of this, he could charge you with underpaying your labor!

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: Me? Hmm... if this was before, I could have simply asked Clorinde. But it's already been some time since I last talked to her.

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Traveler: The way Navia's wardrobe comes together is really exceptional.

assumed.name: Kirara
assumed.quote: Traveler: The concept behind Kirara's outfit is really original.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Ah, Chiori! You sure have changed a lot. This is the first time we've seen you since you left Inazuma.

assumed.name: Yoimiya
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Hehe, but I'm not an actress. Sir Kamisato and Lady Ayaka are the real actors here!

assumed.name: Egeria
assumed.quote: The Fontinalia Festival was established to commemorate the legendary Lochknights who went on a quest to search for the Oceanids, and eventually welcomed the Hydro Archon Egeria.

threads.claim: Furina has given up the Hydro Archon title, yet Fontaine still treats her as its star.
threads.quote: Furina: There's no more Hydro Archon, you know... And it's still a little early to celebrate.

threads.claim: A recent musket murder copies the methods of The Two Musketeers, and the Marechaussee Phantom is keeping it secret.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: There's been a recent murder case involving muskets. The perpetrator's methods appear to be very similar to what is described in the novel.

threads.claim: Chevreuse suspects the murders are connected to the novel and is investigating out of personal interest.
threads.quote: I'm concerned about the similarity between the crimes and the story.

threads.claim: Sinthe production has stopped after Vacher's arrest, but leftover batches still circulate on the market.
threads.quote: Now that Vacher has been brought to justice, no new shipments of Sinthe will be made and distributed to sellers.

threads.claim: Chiori has hidden dealings with the Special Patrol that she refuses to explain.
threads.quote: Your work is becoming more and more mysterious...

threads.claim: Chevreuse values stories and work where justice prevails over evil.
threads.quote: Stories where justice prevails over evil never get old for me.

threads.claim: Furina demands full freedom to rewrite the script as she sees fit.
threads.quote: Furina: Good. Then I'm free to alter the script as I see fit?

threads.claim: Inazuma is reopening its borders and wants stronger cultural and diplomatic ties with Fontaine.
threads.quote: Inazuma has only recently reopened its borders, and needs to strengthen its relations and cultural ties with other nations.

threads.claim: Fontaine's court process is so slow that suing an investor would take months.
threads.quote: Even if I were to take him to court, I'm afraid it would take months before the case could even be heard.

threads.claim: The film's funding collapses when investor Morris backs out, leaving the production in crisis.
threads.quote: Morris: *sigh* I'm afraid that there's really nothing I can do. I'm really facing a crisis, my hands are tied!

threads.claim: The funding gap is answered when Ayato and Ayaka offer to perform for free.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayato: Mr. Xavier, if Ayaka and I were willing to perform for free, would that resolve the problem you are currently facing?

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: Introduced as the Liyue official announcing the Jade Chamber rebuild and running the contest
introduced.quote: Ningguang: I have gathered everyone here today to make an important announcement.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: A floating structure being rebuilt as a contest project
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Perhaps some of you will have heard the news already. I am, in fact, planning to rebuild the Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Sunset Vermillionite
introduced.how: A large Plaustrite stone that rises into the air when activated and lets the Jade Chamber float
introduced.quote: This stone is what allows the Jade Chamber to float.

introduced.name: Wonder Cores
introduced.how: Central mechanical components of the Jade Chamber
introduced.quote: Wonder Cores, meanwhile, are the central components of the mechanical structure of the Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Adepti Sigils
introduced.how: Devices that integrate mechanical parts with adepti art
introduced.quote: Adepti Sigils serve as a means of integrating the mechanical devices with adepti art.

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: A young woman who introduces herself by name and is later shown to have unusual strength and appetite
introduced.quote: Shenhe: My name.

introduced.name: Scar Liu
introduced.how: A broker trying to swindle a woman to pay off gambling debts
introduced.quote: So what? She's loaded! How are we ever going to repay those gambling debts if we just let money walk away from us, huh?

introduced.name: Qiang the Brave
introduced.how: A broker partner of Scar Liu who is anxious about the scheme
introduced.quote: Qiang the Brave: Boss, I got a bad feeling about this.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: Guild holding the one piece of Sunset Vermillionite for auction
introduced.quote: The truth is, the Feiyun Commerce Guild is in possession of some Sunset Vermillionite, but only one piece.

introduced.name: Sea Gazer
introduced.how: A deceased adeptus whose abode was rumored to hold Sunset Vermillionite
introduced.quote: Shenhe: Sea Gazer was once very close to Mountain Shaper. But if I am not mistaken, he has already passed away.

introduced.name: Lisha
introduced.how: The area where Sea Gazer's lost abode is believed to be
introduced.quote: I'm now fairly certain that it is situated in the Lisha area.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: Reveals herself as Shenhe's master and caretaker and explains how she found her
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: One first found Shenhe by chance in a cave.

introduced.name: Shenhe's human upbringing
introduced.how: Shenhe is human, not an adeptus, though raised among the adepti
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: On this latter point, you are correct. However... Shenhe is human.

introduced.name: Red ropes
introduced.how: Bindings placed on Shenhe's soul to suppress her homicidal instinct, with side effects on her emotions
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: The red ropes have indeed served to keep her calmer and more content, but also seem to have rendered her somewhat... inexpressive.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: An adeptus who made a divination about Shenhe's fate and curse
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Moon Carver once performed a divination for her.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: Joins the contest to find a venue for her opera and befriends the group
introduced.quote: Yun Jin, who has joined the contest in order to ask Ningguang about an appropriate venue for her new opera

introduced.name: The Divine Damsel of Devastation
introduced.how: An opera by a Liyue playwright based on legends about Shenhe
introduced.quote: a playwright in Liyue Harbor wrote an opera based on the legends told about her.

introduced.name: Master Zhang
introduced.how: Smith of Hanfeng's Ironmongers who forged the Wonder Cores for the first Jade Chamber
introduced.quote: They discover that Master Zhang had forged the Wonder Cores for the first Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Subrosium
introduced.how: A mineral needed for the Wonder Cores, hard to find
introduced.quote: However, he doesn't know where to find the Subrosium, citing that the people around that area had some trick that allowed them to collect the mineral.

introduced.name: Mingjun
introduced.how: A villager who knows the clues to the Subrosium and remembers Shenhe's past
introduced.quote: Mingjun is silent when the group tries asking him for clues, however he is surprised to learn that Shenhe is alive and that the rumors were true.

introduced.name: Baiwen
introduced.how: Ningguang's secretary overseeing the building site and judging materials
introduced.quote: Baiwen: Ah, so you're the ones behind this. No wonder. The rarest talent turns in the rarest Plaustrite specimen.

introduced.name: Beisht
introduced.how: A giant monster, the wife of Osial, who returns to attack Liyue
introduced.quote: a large monster appears once again; this time it is Beisht, the wife of Osial.

introduced.name: Guizhong Ballista
introduced.how: An adepti siege weapon; the new version is a mass-producible, weaker copy
introduced.quote: This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power

introduced.name: Plaustrite
introduced.how: A stone that stays heavy until activated, then rises into the heavens
introduced.quote: Shenhe: Plaustrite doesn't float until it's activated.

introduced.name: Shenhe's father leaving her to die
introduced.how: A past memory that Shenhe recalls during the battle
introduced.quote: she suddenly remembers a flashback of her father leaving her to die and Cloud Retainer's words.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: a huge floating structure being rebuilt in the sky, built in two phases
introduced.quote: Given the enormous scale of the Jade Chamber, we split the construction work into two phases to make sure the structure remains balanced.

introduced.name: Plaustrite
introduced.how: a rare material needed to lift the partly built Jade Chamber to altitude
introduced.quote: Once the Plaustrite is ready, we place it into the keel and let the partially-constructed Jade Chamber rise up to the height of the surrounding mountain peaks.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber contest
introduced.how: a material procurement contest where the first three teams win a question for Ningguang
introduced.quote: Lady Ningguang said that the first three contestants to procure all three materials will be awarded the chance to ask a question.

introduced.name: Wonder Core
introduced.how: a component that must be forged, needing special ore
introduced.quote: Matter of fact, I made some for Lady Ningguang back when she was building the original Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Adepti Sigil
introduced.how: an adepti-made sigil that the Jade Chamber needs, delivered by Shenhe
introduced.quote: In fact, I came specifically to deliver Adepti Sigils.

introduced.name: Starsplinter Iron
introduced.how: one of the two ores needed for Wonder Cores, found near Mt. Tianheng
introduced.quote: Sure. Well, you'll need two kinds: Starsplinter Iron and Subrosium.

introduced.name: Subrosium
introduced.how: a rare stone whose engraved magic lasts; some believe it bridges the living and the dead
introduced.quote: Some believe the stone to be a bridge between the living and the dead.

introduced.name: Mt. Tianheng
introduced.how: a mountain where adepti often go and where the opera legend is set
introduced.quote: I hear the view there is quite spectacular. A favorite destination of the adepti, in fact.

introduced.name: The Divine Damsel of Devastation
introduced.how: an opera by Yun Jin's father based on a legend of an evil spirit and an adeptus
introduced.quote: The opera is a labor of love by my father. He wrote it based on a popular urban legend about an evil spirit and an adeptus.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: a famous Liyue opera performer and singer
introduced.quote: This is the renowned Ms. Yun, or Yun Jin, probably the most famous figure in the Liyue opera scene.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: captain of The Crux, a sea captain who enters the contest
introduced.quote: Pleasure to meet you, I'm Beidou, Captain of The Crux.

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: a white-haired woman raised by adepti, once a villager's child, whom the legend's divine damsel resembles
introduced.quote: I tried explaining to them that I wasn't an adeptus, just an ordinary person who came from this village.

introduced.name: Master Zhang
introduced.how: a smith at Hanfeng's Ironmongers who knows how to make Wonder Cores
introduced.quote: We will head into town and seek advice from Master Zhang of Hanfeng's Ironmongers.

introduced.name: Mingjun
introduced.how: an old friend of Shenhe's father who knows the deserted village
introduced.quote: I was a very close friend of your father's.

introduced.name: Shenhe's father's summoning
introduced.how: the father summoned a god in a ritual and offered his daughter to it
introduced.quote: I could have stopped him from performing the summoning ritual

introduced.name: Ragged Notebook
introduced.how: the father's diary revealing the true story behind the opera
introduced.quote: Just now, in the village, we found your father's diary...

introduced.name: Records of a Changing Village
introduced.how: a village record describing an evil god's remains and the exorcist family's tragedy
introduced.quote: It has been confirmed that traces of an evil god's remains were found in the village.

introduced.name: Curse of calamity
introduced.how: a fate that makes Shenhe a source of harm to those close to her
introduced.quote: I'm told my fate is to bear the curse of calamity, so my master bound my soul with red ropes to curb my aggression.

introduced.name: Red ropes
introduced.how: ropes binding Shenhe's soul that curb aggression and dampen her emotions
introduced.quote: But it also dampened my emotions, making me dispassionate like the adepti.

introduced.name: Beisht
introduced.how: a sea monster, Osial's wife, rising from a vortex to threaten Liyue
introduced.quote: Osial's wife

introduced.name: Overlord of the Vortex
introduced.how: a sea power whose final follower is Beisht
introduced.quote: Final follower of the Overlord of the Vortex

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: an adeptus who has been secretly observing Ningguang and Shenhe
introduced.quote: One saw you secretly venture out from the mountains a few years ago, and noticed the air of dejection in which you returned.

introduced.name: Sea threat
introduced.how: a danger stirring in the sea near Guyun Stone Forest that Ningguang is preparing for
introduced.quote: Yes. Ningguang said there's something bad in the sea.

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Just then, Beidou arrives and asks if preparations are done, replying to Paimon that she was forced to help the Tianquan, who reassures her that preparations are done.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Xingqiu! Glad you're here!

assumed.name: Baizhu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Baizhu! What are you doing out here?

assumed.name: Ganyu
assumed.quote: Save for Ganyu, who spends the majority of her time in Liyue Harbor, all the adepti living today are acquainted with Shenhe to some degree.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Keqing: Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.

assumed.name: Mountain Shaper
assumed.quote: Shenhe: Sea Gazer was once very close to Mountain Shaper.

assumed.name: Adepti
