assumed.quote: Shenhe: They call me an adeptus, treat me with great deference and respect, as if I'm set apart from the common folk.

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: Just then, Beidou arrives and asks if preparations are done, replying to Paimon that she was forced to help the Tianquan, who reassures her that preparations are done.

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Maybe I can find out more about my ...)

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Qiqi! What are you doing here?

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Lady Ningguang is most grateful and looks forward to seeing more of your work.

assumed.name: Guyun Stone Forest
assumed.quote: I heard a good few of my comrades have been sent over to Guyun Stone Forest.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: I heard that Lady Keqing has gone to Guyun Stone Forest.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: You're the one who fought against the Fatui and Osial, right?

assumed.name: Osial
assumed.quote: You're the one who fought against the Fatui and Osial, right?

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The wound dressings are ready and the Millelith have set up an ambush.

assumed.name: Guizhong Ballista
assumed.quote: One has observed your adaptation of the Guizhong Ballista, and finds oneself compelled to admit that you have evidenced some degree of novel thinking.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Have they found a solution to the danger in the sea?

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: While the position of Tianquan remains mine, I will always ensure Liyue's safety.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: At that time, I dreamed that one day the Jade Chamber's shadow would be seen in all seven nations of Teyvat.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Adepti wander oft where mortals seldom stride.

threads.claim: The Traveler's search for their sibling continues, and Ningguang has no leads to offer.
threads.quote: she says with disappointment that she hasn't found any leads regarding their sibling

threads.claim: Shenhe is a human raised by adepti, not an adeptus, which the group only learns later.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: On this latter point, you are correct. However... Shenhe is human.

threads.claim: Shenhe's homicidal instinct was prophesied as a curse of calamity and is restrained by red ropes.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Moon Carver once performed a divination for her.

threads.claim: Shenhe is unsure whether she will stay in Liyue or return to the mountains.
threads.quote: Shenhe: Because I'm not sure whether I will remain here in the future.

threads.claim: Ningguang's claimed contract between Liyue and humans will be tested, and the adepti may seize control if she fails.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Ningguang once made a bold assertion that this is to be the era of the contract between Liyue and the humans

threads.claim: Shenhe's past includes being abandoned by her father, a memory that drives her in the battle.
threads.quote: she suddenly remembers a flashback of her father leaving her to die and Cloud Retainer's words.

threads.claim: The opera's damsel is revealed to be Shenhe herself, and she was forced into the role rather than being brave.
threads.quote: Yun Jin collects the first part of the father's diary and is surprised to realize that the damsel was actually Shenhe herself.

threads.claim: Sea Gazer's abode holding Sunset Vermillionite was lost after his death, and its location is a mystery.
threads.quote: After Sea Gazer passed, the abode was abandoned, and its location was lost to time.

threads.claim: Beisht returns as a monster, and Beidou had warned Beisht months before.
threads.quote: a large monster appears once again; this time it is Beisht, the wife of Osial.

threads.claim: Shenhe is said to carry a curse of calamity that brings harm to those close to her.
threads.quote: The god said her fate was to bear the curse of calamity and that she was prone to bring harm to those close to her.

threads.claim: Shenhe's soul is bound by red ropes to curb the curse, which also dampened her emotions.
threads.quote: I'm told my fate is to bear the curse of calamity, so my master bound my soul with red ropes to curb my aggression.

threads.claim: Shenhe doubts she can ever fit into Liyue Harbor.
threads.quote: Lady Ningguang... do you think I can ever fit in in Liyue Harbor?

threads.claim: Shenhe reports feeling happier in Liyue than she expected.
threads.quote: I feel happier than I expected.

threads.claim: Shenhe's master says she must use her strength for others to become part of human society.
threads.quote: How to use your strength for the good of others

threads.claim: The opera's heroic legend may not match the facts.
threads.quote: The opera is a labor of love by my father.

threads.claim: Shenhe doubts the little girl in the opera deserves her praise.
threads.quote: I'm not sure she deserves all the praise she is given.

threads.claim: The true story is revealed to be darker than the opera, with the girl sacrificed by her own father.
threads.quote: The truth is even more lamentable than the opera.

threads.claim: Shenhe's father summoned a god and offered a sacrifice to save his dying wife.
threads.quote: I took it and followed its instructions to summon a god and offer a sacrifice...

threads.claim: Yun Jin concludes the father summoned an evil god's remains while believing it was benevolent.
threads.quote: So it seems that Shenhe's father thought he was summoning a benevolent deity using a magic incantation

threads.claim: Traces of an evil god's remains were found in the abandoned village and may still be a danger.
threads.quote: It has been confirmed that traces of an evil god's remains were found in the village.

threads.claim: Yun Jin wonders what link Shenhe has with Mingjun.
threads.quote: Still, I do wonder what the connection is between Shenhe and Mingjun.

threads.claim: Mingjun admits he was a close friend of Shenhe's father and failed to stop the ritual.
threads.quote: I was a very close friend of your father's.

threads.claim: Subrosium is thought to bridge the living and the dead, and is only found at a precise time and place.
threads.quote: Some believe the stone to be a bridge between the living and the dead.

threads.claim: A great wrath is brewing in the sea, source unknown.
threads.quote: The zombie called Qiqi is right. A great wrath brews in the sea.

threads.claim: Shenhe reports the sea monster has been dealt with after being injured.
threads.quote: It's been dealt with. She was injured before entering the water.

threads.claim: Beisht is the last follower of an Overlord of the Vortex, hinting at a larger sea power.
threads.quote: Final follower of the Overlord of the Vortex

threads.claim: Ningguang rebuilt the Jade Chamber to lure out Beisht, whom Beidou had warned about.
threads.quote: As a way of drawing her out

threads.claim: Ningguang declares the crisis averted after the sea monster is dealt with.
threads.quote: Good. So the crisis has been safely averted.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer will keep observing Ningguang and her trials in the future.
threads.quote: Do not suppose that one will not continue observing you hereafter.

threads.claim: Ningguang asserts she holds the Tianquan position and will protect Liyue.
threads.quote: While the position of Tianquan remains mine, I will always ensure Liyue's safety.

threads.claim: Xiao has a secret contingency plan to defend Liyue if things get out of control.
threads.quote: But these things can be unpredictable. I have a contingency plan of my own.

threads.claim: The Traveler compares Shenhe's protective act to the heroine of the opera.
threads.quote: Just like the hero in the story.

threads.claim: Shenhe rejects being a hero and says she only wanted to protect others.
threads.quote: I wasn't trying to be a hero, though. I just wanted to protect you.

introduced.name: Novokitezhgrad
introduced.how: underground mining city in Snezhnaya, a relatively unique location
introduced.quote: Novokitezhgrad is a relatively unique location.

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: very important mined resource, the main product of Novokitezhgrad
introduced.quote: Bear in mind that this is the main production site of Kresnik Kristall, which is a very important resource throughout Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Grand Duke Alvis
introduced.how: late ruler of Novokitezhgrad, a Domovoy who imposed stricter public security laws
introduced.quote: the late Grand Duke Alvis, a Domovoy.

introduced.name: Koshkin
introduced.how: former mine foreman of Novokitezhgrad who knows the city well
introduced.quote: Haha, I was only a mine foreman here for a couple of years.

introduced.name: Glinin
introduced.how: Zapolyarny Palace hydrological surveyor visiting Novokitezhgrad for the first time
introduced.quote: Only as a hydrological surveyor.

introduced.name: Danica
introduced.how: agent who delivers a weapon gift from the Tsaritsa and helps fight the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: Every cleanup job requires the right tools.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: a dangerous domain that breaks out into the city, often thought to be tall tales
introduced.quote: I've never seen one before... I thought they were just tall tales!

introduced.name: Nail of Retribution
introduced.how: a pillar of light with unclear connection to the Heavenly Principles threat
introduced.quote: The Nail of Retribution... A threat from the Heavenly Principles, which has been looming over Snezhnaya for a very long time.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: a long-standing threat looming over Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: A threat from the Heavenly Principles, which has been looming over Snezhnaya for a very long time.

introduced.name: Snezhnograd
introduced.how: a distant city in Snezhnaya that is far from Novokitezhgrad by train
introduced.quote: Looks pretty far away from Snezhnograd...

introduced.name: Old Kitezhgrad
introduced.how: the old city destroyed by a calamity from Chernabog about five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: after Old Kitezhgrad was struck by the calamity unleashed by Chernabog five hundred years ago

introduced.name: Kristall growth
introduced.how: the underground Kristall veins keep expanding, causing constant tremors
introduced.quote: And that's because the underground veins are still expanding to this day.

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: fae live in Novokitezhgrad and built the city alongside humans
introduced.quote: the fae and the humans here built this city.

introduced.name: Thrud
introduced.how: Grand Duke Alvis's daughter, who is grieving and has not been seen publicly
introduced.quote: I am grieving my father's passing, yes, but it hasn't taken a toll on my health.

introduced.name: Sadunova
introduced.how: Vila who was the captain of the Grand Duke's personal guard and now enforces lockdown
introduced.quote: She... was the captain of the Domovoy Grand Duke's personal guard.

introduced.name: Prime Ice Pickaxe
introduced.how: a tool Koshkin crafts from Prime Ice to break through rock
introduced.quote: We'll need proper tools... Here, I'll help make you a pickaxe.

introduced.name: Multipurpose Excavation and Hauling Cutter
introduced.how: a mining machine that needs a power module to cut Kristall pillars
introduced.quote: The machine itself is still intact, but its power module is missing.

introduced.name: Charodeeva
introduced.how: young miner who introduces herself and her companion Lunin
introduced.quote: I'm Charodeeva, and this is Lunin.

introduced.name: Light-Focusing Pedestal
introduced.how: a pedestal hidden under Prime Ice that focuses light
introduced.quote: Knew it! So there was a light-focusing pedestal in the middle of all that ice...

introduced.name: Miners' protest
introduced.how: miners plan a public protest at the Grand Duke's residence over decrees
introduced.quote: They're planning a public protest.

introduced.name: Grand Duke Alvis's death
introduced.how: the Grand Duke's death caused miner dissatisfaction and city unrest
introduced.quote: ever since Grand Duke Alvis passed away, the miners have been dissatisfied

introduced.name: The One
introduced.how: an entity whose whispers Sadunova follows and whose gospel she spreads
introduced.quote: Sadunova: You... can hear it? You can actually hear it? The whispers of the One...?

introduced.name: Notes on Novokitezhgrad
introduced.how: a notebook Glinin gives the Traveler to record discoveries
introduced.quote: (Opens Notes of Novokitezhgrad)

introduced.name: Glinin
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a hydrology surveyor sent by Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.quote: My name's Glinin, and I'm a surveyor sent here by Zapolyarny Palace to do some hydrological surveys.

introduced.name: Thrud
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Alvis's daughter, a princess of the Domovoy
introduced.quote: I am Thrud, daughter of the Grand Duke of the Domovoy, Alvis, though perhaps you were already aware.

introduced.name: Alvis
introduced.how: Former Grand Duke of the Domovoy, Thrud's father, known for disliking humans and mining mastery
introduced.quote: After all, the former Grand Duke Alvis was famous for his

introduced.name: Domovoy
introduced.how: A people whose princess is Thrud, known for their craftsmanship
introduced.quote: that's Domovoy craftsmanship for you!

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: Glinin's employer, which sent him to survey hydrology
introduced.quote: My name's Glinin, and I'm a surveyor sent here by Zapolyarny Palace to do some hydrological surveys.

introduced.name: Teplo Oasis
introduced.how: An artificial warm oasis in the permafrost, built by Alvis and growing rye
introduced.quote: That oasis was created by my father while he yet lived, carving out a warm haven amid the permafrost.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: Ruler who had Alvis build the artificial oasis
introduced.quote: That is the artificial oasis that the Belyi Tsar bade my father build while he yet reigned.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: Current ruler who took the throne and suppresses the Abyss
introduced.quote: Ever since Her Majesty the Tsaritsa took the throne, the Abyss has been constantly suppressed.

introduced.name: Knyazhna
introduced.how: Distillery worker at Teplo who meets the party and describes the earthquake
introduced.quote: I never imagined you would still remember my name after only meeting me at a banquet once, all those years ago...

introduced.name: Pyatkin
introduced.how: Mine runner who has run the Kresnik Kristall mine in Koshkin's absence
introduced.quote: He's been running the mine since I left Novokitezhgrad

introduced.name: Novokitezhgrad underground river
introduced.how: The underground river feeding the city's waterfall, now blocked
introduced.quote: Novokitezhgrad's underground river is rather special, and we're looking for the source of this most special river.

introduced.name: Blightkristall
introduced.how: Corrupted Kresnik Kristall that grows without limit and swallows surroundings
introduced.quote: lots of Kresnik Kristall deposits were corrupted and became Blightkristall.

introduced.name: Old Kitezhgrad
introduced.how: A city overrun by Blightkristall during the earlier Abyssal corruption
introduced.quote: Old Kitezhgrad was the main battlefield against the Abyssal corruption at the time, and it was almost entirely overrun by the speed of the Blightkristall eruption.

introduced.name: Blightkristall calamity 500 years ago
introduced.how: A past invasion of dark beasts that corrupted Kresnik Kristall across Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: The first recorded instance was 500 years ago.

introduced.name: Chernabog
introduced.how: A folk tale name that Thrud says is another name for the Abyss
introduced.quote: In truth, Chernabog is another name for the Abyss...

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: Artificial lifeforms originally created by the Hyperboreans
introduced.quote: fae are artificial lifeforms, originally created by the Hyperboreans.

introduced.name: Hyperborea
introduced.how: A past civilization whose survivors took refuge in the underground sanctuary
introduced.quote: At one point, survivors of Hyperborea lived here, seeking refuge from the scourge of Blightkristall

introduced.name: Secret script
introduced.how: A fae-only syllabary engraved into walls, hidden from humans
introduced.quote: This is a secret script once used by fae, a special syllabary that is engraved into walls with special strokes and materials.

introduced.name: Luminous Beam
introduced.how: A focused light that can halt nascent Blightkristall, effective only on fissured growths
introduced.quote: Give praise, for the luminous beam held back the nascent crystal scourge...

introduced.name: Luminous Lamp Crystal
introduced.how: A glowing lamp crystal made from Prime Ice that can be placed on pedestals to focus light
introduced.quote: So the glowlamp should be those lamp crystals we can make with Prime Ice!

introduced.name: Treeheart
introduced.how: The sacred core of the crystal tree that drew energy to destroy Blightkristall
introduced.quote: The crystal tree was once able to draw energy from the treeheart and use it to destroy the cores of nearby Blightkristall deposits

introduced.name: Crystal tree
introduced.how: A huge hollow crystal tree in the sanctuary that once shielded its inhabitants
introduced.quote: Look! Seems like we can get into the crystal tree from over there.

introduced.name: The Shimmering One
introduced.how: Introduces itself as a crystalline being that wants to open a passage hidden in the mountain
introduced.quote: I rather like the sound of that. Still, I would prefer... "The Shimmering One."

introduced.name: Sadunova
introduced.how: Reveals she serves only the Shimmering One and seeks to restore fae rule
introduced.quote: I have served one master, and one master alone, all along.

introduced.name: Natalia
introduced.how: A past fae leader, the Burner of Cities, whose followers nearly overthrew the human nation
introduced.quote: My ancestors once followed the great Natalia, the Burner of Cities, and came within a hair's breadth of overthrowing this wretched nation.

introduced.name: Cryo Dragon
introduced.how: A dragon whose flesh and blood the fae claim to carry, the basis of their claim to rule
introduced.quote: We fae carry the Cryo Dragon's flesh and blood within us.

introduced.name: fae
introduced.how: A people of primal blood who see themselves as the rightful rulers of this land
introduced.quote: a realm that should know only the rule of the fae.

introduced.name: Alvis
introduced.how: Former Grand Duke of the Domovoy, once a trusted retainer of the Belyi Tsar, later doubted and feared by his researchers
introduced.quote: Alvis... He was one of His Majesty the Belyi Tsar's most trusted retainers during the Pale Star Court era.

introduced.name: Hvergelmir
introduced.how: A research organization that Alvis and Aksinya once belonged to
introduced.quote: He was also a member of Hvergelmir for a time.

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: A woman who offered help to the researcher, claimed revenge was her goal, and is a Hvergelmir member
introduced.quote: It was then that a woman calling herself Aksinya appeared.

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: A companion device that detects, archives and prints firearm blueprints and can recall history
introduced.quote: Eye of Graeae: Collectable firearm accessory blueprint detected...

introduced.name: Rapid-Fire Autocannon
introduced.how: A mounted cannon the Traveler can operate to drive back enemy waves
introduced.quote: Traveler: Operate Rapid-Fire Autocannon

introduced.name: Light-Focusing Pedestal
introduced.how: A pedestal that focuses the Luminous Beam to activate light-based mechanisms
introduced.quote: (Operate the Light-Focusing Pedestal)

introduced.name: Luminous Lamp Crystal
introduced.how: A lamp crystal the Traveler can take and install to light glowing walls
introduced.quote: (Take the Luminous Lamp Crystal and continue onward)

introduced.name: Blightkristall Fissure
introduced.how: A weak point in Blightkristall that can be shot to clear a blocked path
introduced.quote: (Shoot the two Blightkristall Fissures and investigate the device again)

introduced.name: Freeze Mark
introduced.how: A mark the Traveler can use to freeze the terrain and reach higher or blocked areas
introduced.quote: (Shoot the Blightkristall Fissure and use the Freeze Mark)

introduced.name: Apsat's Mountain Hunt
introduced.how: A new gun the Traveler obtains from the printed firearm blueprint
introduced.quote: (Opens Apsat's Mountain Hunt's Weapon Tutorial)

introduced.name: Hollow of the Ancient Scaled One
introduced.how: The wing-shaped mountain's interior, full of Kresnik Kristall and light mechanisms
introduced.quote: (Approach the Teleport Waypoint in the Hollow of the Ancient Scaled One)

introduced.name: usurper from the heavens
introduced.how: A past usurper who erased the name of the dying being whose will the fae still follow
introduced.quote: That accursed usurper erased even its name, but its will still lives on in our blood and bones.

introduced.name: Experiment Conductor's Notes
introduced.how: A research journal revealing the plot involving Alvis, Aksinya and Kristall energy conversion
introduced.quote: Alvis grows old and decrepit.

assumed.name: Prime Ice
assumed.quote: Look at the center of the Prime Ice!

assumed.name: Goggles
assumed.quote: Oh, you have a new railroad map, Goggles?

assumed.name: Eye of Graeae
assumed.quote: Eye of Graeae: Connecting to the Novokitezhgrad rail transit hub.

assumed.name: Kresnik's Torches
assumed.quote: Hahaha, before the Kresnik's Torches, Kristall was already commonly used to make sculptures.

assumed.name: Druzhna
assumed.quote: Her Majesty has already sent the Druzhna to investigate.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: What, did Her Majesty the Tsaritsa finally boot you out?

assumed.name: Zapolyarny Palace
assumed.quote: Shouldn't you be working as an official at Zapolyarny Palace?

assumed.name: Aksinya
assumed.quote: Could that be Aksinya?

assumed.name: Pulcinella
assumed.quote: before Lord Pulcinella gets his turn

assumed.name: Zarechnaya
assumed.quote: wasn't Zarechnaya just parachuted in as interim chairperson?

assumed.name: Lady Vesna
assumed.quote: compared to Lady Vesna, she's infinitely more insufferable.

assumed.name: Belyi Tsar
assumed.quote: lived through the Belyi Tsar's western expedition

assumed.name: Energy Commission
assumed.quote: The Energy Commission's old head just died recently, didn't he?

assumed.name: Koshkin
assumed.quote: I believe you two are friends of Koshkin's?

assumed.name: Vila
assumed.quote: Uh, Princess Thrud, you should watch out for that Vila...

assumed.name: Sadunova
assumed.quote: That is why neither Sadunova nor the other members of my personal guard would allow me to leave the Grand Duke's residence without permission.

assumed.name: Kresnik Kristall
assumed.quote: Oh, right! Kresnik Kristall!

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: the appearance of these growths might be related to the changes in the Ley Lines wrought by Abyssal incursions.

assumed.name: Fatui Harbingers
assumed.quote: The Fatui Harbingers even step in themselves at times...

assumed.name: Shadow Realm
assumed.quote: Ugh... that Vila! We were just trying to save her, and she goes and dumps us straight into the Shadow Realm?!

assumed.name: Goggles
assumed.quote: Well, Goggles should be able to make it in the future...

assumed.name: Old Kitezhgrad
assumed.quote: (Approach the left path into Old Kitezhgrad)

assumed.name: Shadow Realm
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh. Is this... the Shadow Realm again?

assumed.name: Sadunova
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sadunova!

assumed.name: Thrud
assumed.quote: Give Thrud back right now, you... you crystal brute!

assumed.name: Kresnik Kristall
assumed.quote: Looks like they've been turning Kresnik Kristall into those dark crystals for quite a while.

assumed.name: Blightkristall
assumed.quote: (Opens Blightkristall in Notes on Novokitezhgrad)

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Shimmering One: Who sent you? The Tsaritsa... or that woman?

assumed.name: Notes on Novokitezhgrad
assumed.quote: (Open Previous History in Notes on Novokitezhgrad, optional)

assumed.name: Jack Frost
assumed.quote: A stunted floating Jack Frost like you could never understand...

assumed.name: Domovoy
assumed.quote: Alvis... the Grand Duke of the Domovoy... Wait, Goggles, do you know anything about him?

assumed.name: Grand Duke's court
assumed.quote: You turned against the Grand Duke's court...

threads.claim: A voice calling itself the One is heard for the first time, urging followers to heed it.
threads.quote: For the revival of ... For the children of ... Heed me! Heed me!

threads.claim: The Traveler can hear the strange voice while Sadunova, unlike the Traveler, appears to be a follower.
threads.quote: Traveler: I can hear... a strange voice.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles are a long-standing threat over Snezhnaya that may be linked to recent activity.
threads.quote: I fear that the recent activity must have something to do with the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Nail of Retribution is a pillar of light whose nature and connection to the threat remain unclear.
threads.quote: Her Majesty has sent the Druzhna to stand guard near the Nail of Retribution.

threads.claim: A hooded white-haired woman linked to a secret meeting with Sadunova may be a figure named Aksinya.
threads.quote: Could that be Aksinya?

threads.claim: Grand Duke Alvis's death is suspected to involve murder, possibly by Sadunova.
threads.quote: Besides, we suspect she had something to do with Grand Duke Alvis's death as well.

threads.claim: Thrud has not been seen since the funeral, and rumors claim she is under house arrest.
threads.quote: We have reason to believe you've placed Lady Thrud under house arrest...

threads.claim: Thrud denies being under house arrest, but questions about her absence and the decrees remain.
threads.quote: As you can see, I am not under house arrest.

threads.claim: Sadunova's faction holds a violent view that humans must be purged, hinting at deep fae and human conflict.
threads.quote: Humans are filth that must be purged.

threads.claim: Sadunova reveals she is behind the Kristall quake and Shadow Realm plan to cover all of Novokitezhgrad.
threads.quote: Everything's running smoothly. Soon, all of Novokitezhgrad will be covered...

threads.claim: A dark red-glowing Kristall ore appears in the mine and may be linked to the earthquakes.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? This dark stuff that's glowing red... Could it be Kristall ore, too?

threads.claim: Novokitezhgrad has been unstable lately, and the cause of the Shadow Realm breakout is unknown.
threads.quote: Novokitezhgrad has been unstable lately.

threads.claim: The earthquake has cut off the underground river and the waterfall, an unprecedented event for the city.
threads.quote: The underground river got cut off?

threads.claim: The Kristall growth quakes have become stronger and unusual, with collapses and aftershocks beyond the normal pattern.
threads.quote: Actually, not in decades... perhaps even centuries

threads.claim: Blightkristall keeps growing without limit and swallows everything unless it is stopped.
threads.quote: According to the records, if left to their own devices, the crystals will keep growing without limit, swallowing everything around them.

threads.claim: Someone may have deliberately hidden the underground river area from all survey records.
threads.quote: Unless... Did someone deliberately conceal this whole underground area?

threads.claim: Alvis is suspected of having concealed the Blightkristall information and the underground area.
threads.quote: The late Grand Duke does indeed stand out as the most likely candidate for the one who concealed the information about Blighkristall.

threads.claim: Alvis may not have truly died, and Glinin feels he is forgetting something important.
threads.quote: I'm even starting to wonder if the duke really did pass away...

threads.claim: Thrud suffers from a strange sickness that makes her fall into unexplained sleep.
threads.quote: If only I hadn't been stricken with that strange sickness...

threads.claim: Thrud's condition worsened after Alvis died, and her sleeps are growing longer.
threads.quote: My condition suddenly grew much worse after my father passed away.

threads.claim: Only the greatest ancient fae could hear whispers within the crystals, and Thrud can hear them.
threads.quote: This isn't something just any fae can hear.

threads.claim: The Traveler can also hear the crystal whispers, raising the question of whether they are an ancient fae.
threads.quote: Does that mean 's even greater than the ancient fae?

threads.claim: Knyazhna fears that Chernabog has returned and is crawling up from the underworld.
threads.quote: Chernabog is returned, and is trying to crawl up from the underworld through that crack

threads.claim: Thrud dismisses Chernabog as a folk tale and equates it with the Abyss.
threads.quote: Nothing more than a folk tale.

threads.claim: Paimon claims Vila is behind the massive quake that shook the city.
threads.quote: And she's definitely the one behind that massive quake that shook the whole city!

threads.claim: A black crystal core in the Shadow Realm is linked to the black crystals and the quakes.
threads.quote: Another quake! So that core-like thing really is connected to those black crystals.

threads.claim: Destroying the black crystal core makes the Blightkristall in the area subside.
threads.quote: (The Blightkristall in the area subsides)

threads.claim: Thrud vows to punish Sadunova for her betrayal once the crisis is over.
threads.quote: Once all of this is over, I shall see to it that she receives the punishment she deserves...

threads.claim: Koshkin concludes Sadunova lied and betrayed Novokitezhgrad and Thrud's trust.
threads.quote: I knew it. Whatever her reasons, she's turned her back on us...

threads.claim: The crystal tree's treeheart once protected the area from Blightkristall but was removed.
threads.quote: The crystal tree was once able to draw energy from the treeheart and use it to destroy the cores of nearby Blightkristall deposits

threads.claim: Returning the treeheart to the crystal tree restores its protection and clears the black crystals.
threads.quote: Now that the treehart has been returned to the center of the crystal tree

threads.claim: The blocked river will cause a flash flood that could sweep away half of Novokitezhgrad.
threads.quote: The blocked water will keep accumulating, and if we don't clear the obstruction soon, it'll eventually reach a tipping point and burst out as a flash flood, causing far more damage.

threads.claim: Clearing the Blightkristall ends the waterfall blockage and restores the river.
threads.quote: And that takes care of the waterfall blockage!

threads.claim: Fae were made as tools and were denied the right to live as equals with humans.
threads.quote: Fae, made to be tools... I'm afraid the right to live as equals alongside humans would have been difficult to obtain.

threads.claim: Thrud suggests the fae-human conflict could have been avoided with mutual respect.
threads.quote: Had each shown the other but a little more respect... perhaps many of those tragedies could have been averted.

threads.claim: Glinin senses he has forgotten something very important.
threads.quote: I think I'm forgetting something very important...

threads.claim: The mountain and land may be the remains of a giant buried beast that the fae serve.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... It feels like we're walking up the body of some giant beast, don'cha think?

threads.claim: A usurper from the heavens erased a dying being's name and the fae still follow its will.
threads.quote: That accursed usurper erased even its name, but its will still lives on in our blood and bones.

threads.claim: The Shimmering One was once a different being and was transformed, and its original identity is unknown.
threads.quote: But then... who was it originally...?

threads.claim: The Shimmering One is revealed to have written the Experiment Conductor's Notes.
threads.quote: So that crystal monster wrote all this!

threads.claim: Alvis may have been killed by the researcher and Aksinya, but this is only speculation.
threads.quote: Did he and Aksinya kill Alvis together?

threads.claim: Hvergelmir research connects Alvis, Aksinya and a strange object that fell out of the Shadow Realm.
threads.quote: It had something to do with the research at the Hvergelmir.

threads.claim: A fragment of the Eye of Graeae's power was taken by Alvis and is now gone, apparently with Aksinya.
threads.quote: Whatever the case, that fragment is no longer here.

threads.claim: Thrud's location and what the Shimmering One knows about her remain unresolved.
threads.quote: And we've still gotta find out what it knows about Princess Thrud!

threads.claim: The fae plan to expel humans and outsiders and rebuild the nation for those of primal blood.
threads.quote: To drive every human and outsider from this land and rebuild a nation for those of the primal bloodline!

threads.claim: The Shadow Realm and Blightkristall have spread over the whole mountain.
threads.quote: But now the whole mountain's in the Shadow Realm...

threads.claim: The Shimmering One is gaining power by converting Blightkristall and Kresnik Kristall into itself.
threads.quote: Vast stores of Blightkristall are being converted and drawn into me...

threads.claim: The Shimmering One's door is shattered and a hidden passage in the mountain is revealed, leading the Traveler deeper below.
threads.quote: The Traveler is sucked into the broken door and falls down into the Palace of Glacial Reflections

introduced.name: Ippei
introduced.how: Kujou Kamaji's servant who was worried when Kamaji went missing
introduced.quote: Next to him is Ippei, Kujou Kamaji's servant.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: head of the Kamisato Clan and Yashiro Commissioner, introducing himself
introduced.quote: I am head of the Kamisato Clan, and Yashiro Commissioner — Kamisato Ayato

introduced.name: Thoma
introduced.how: housekeeper of the Kamisato Estate who handles the household while Ayato is away
introduced.quote: Having my sister attend public events in my stead and having Thoma as housekeeper has also been a great help, and allowed me to focus.

introduced.name: Hisashi
introduced.how: a trusted Shuumatsuban member who has been quietly watching the group
introduced.quote: This is one of my most trusted members of the Shuumatsuban. He's been quietly watching out for us this whole time.

introduced.name: Shuumatsuban
introduced.how: Ayato's covert watch group that monitors people and gathers information
introduced.quote: This is one of my most trusted members of the Shuumatsuban. He's been quietly watching out for us this whole time.

introduced.name: Tri-Commission
introduced.how: the three Commissions that serve as the Shogun's servants and represent the Shogun to the people
introduced.quote: The Tri-Commission are the servants of the Shogun, and we should look out for one another.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: presides over cultural and ceremonial affairs, including weddings
introduced.quote: Since the Yashiro Commission presides over cultural and ceremonial affairs, it closely involves us, too.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: one of the Tri-Commission, currently the least stable since its head Shinsuke is imprisoned
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke is still in prison, meaning the Kanjou Commission is the least stable in the Tri-Commission.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Clan
introduced.how: clan in the Kanjou Commission whose leader is imprisoned, leaving Chisato as its only remaining pillar
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato is the sole remaining pillar of her clan, but now she plans to marry into the Kujou Clan.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
introduced.how: Chisato's father, the imprisoned Hiiragi head who strongly opposes Kamaji
introduced.quote: Lady Hiiragi's father, Hiiragi Shinsuke, is still in prison.

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: acting head of the Tenryou Commission's Kujou Clan, trying to stabilize it after the Takatsukasa incident
introduced.quote: I'm still acclimating to the position of acting head of the Clan.

introduced.name: Tomoki
introduced.how: owner of a creative drink stall in Ritou whom Ayato regularly visits
introduced.quote: I always order one of his creative drinks whenever I pass the stall.

introduced.name: Dango Milk
introduced.how: a creative drink where customers choose and mix their own ingredients into milk or tea
introduced.quote: I've decided to give complete creative control to the customer.

introduced.name: forged letter
introduced.how: the letter supposedly sent by Chisato to Kamaji that prompted his proposal, which Chisato says she never wrote
introduced.quote: when I formally proposed to her in person, she denied having ever written that letter

introduced.name: Matsuura
introduced.how: a Kanjou Commission member who is preparing the wedding and is part of the scheme
introduced.quote: Matsuura: There is still much to prepare for the wedding.

introduced.name: Shinnojou
introduced.how: A Kanjou Commission retainer who was caged and nearly thrown into the sea, and who warns of a wedding scheme
introduced.quote: Shinnojou: It was terrifying... They said they were gonna throw the cage into the sea with me still inside...

introduced.name: Kubo
introduced.how: A guard who takes orders from his Master, not from the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: Kubo: Hmph! Well, we take orders from our Master, no one else.

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: Proxy Clan Head of the Tenryou Commission and groom in the announced marriage
introduced.quote: Shogunate Announcement: Sir Kujou Kamaji, Proxy Clan Head of the Tenryou Commission,

introduced.name: Hiiragi Chisato
introduced.how: Proxy Clan Head of the Kanjou Commission and bride in the announced marriage
introduced.quote: Shogunate Announcement: And Lady Hiiragi Chisato, Proxy Clan Head of the Kanjou Commission,

introduced.name: Hideo
introduced.how: A Kanjou Commission informant and retainer of Matsuura who reports to his Master
introduced.quote: Hideo: The news is spreading fast, but it appears Master's fears may be well-placed.

introduced.name: Okabayashi
introduced.how: A Tenryou Commission guard posted on the road to Ritou, explaining the escort duty
introduced.quote: Okabayashi: We are here to clear the way for Lady Hiiragi.

introduced.name: Hatanaka
introduced.how: A Tenryou Commission guard leading the escort to Ritou, who reports the stalemate
introduced.quote: Hatanaka: We arrived here two days ago to escort Lady Hiiragi to Inazuma City.

introduced.name: Almighty Shogun
introduced.how: The ruler whom Commissioners serve, who despises power games and is the Commissioners' superior
introduced.quote: The Almighty Shogun has always despised these pathetic power games.

introduced.name: Ayato's younger sister
introduced.how: Kamisato Ayato's sister, whom he has to care for and who is mentioned as a host at the Kamisato Estate
introduced.quote: I shall have to host you at the Kamisato Estate when my sister is next available.

introduced.name: Tri-Commission
introduced.how: The three-party governing body of Inazuma's Commissions, whose parties are meant to restrain one another
introduced.quote: All I have tried to do is make sure the three parties to the Tri-Commission serve to restrain each other.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: A town where the Hiiragi Clan is based and where the Tenryou Commission has gathered
introduced.quote: If you're curious to find out, you can visit the Hiiragi Clan in Ritou in a couple of days.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan crisis
introduced.how: The Kamisato Clan's past grave errors, the father's death from overwork, and years of smear campaigns and survival
introduced.quote: My father worked incredibly hard to compensate for the grave errors made by the Kamisato Clan long ago and restore our reputation.

introduced.name: long-tongued bird allegory
introduced.how: A bird with a very long tongue that should be silenced by cutting out its tongue, used as an allegory
introduced.quote: For instance, a merchant from abroad once told me about a curious kind of bird with the most extraordinarily long tongue.

introduced.name: fake intel campaign
introduced.how: Ayato's plan to feed false intelligence through Matsuura's informants across Inazuma City
introduced.quote: What we need to do is to use these informants as a breeding ground for our fake intel.

assumed.name: Shinnojou
assumed.quote: Shinnojou, who the Traveler and Paimon remember as being infatuated with Chisato

assumed.name: Hiiragi Chisato
assumed.quote: Back when we first arrived in Inazuma, we escorted Hiiragi Chisato out of Ritou with him.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: Back when we first arrived in Inazuma, we escorted Hiiragi Chisato out of Ritou with him.

assumed.name: Ayaka
assumed.quote: Right! If Ayaka knows about it, that means it's a sure thing!

assumed.name: Almighty Shogun
assumed.quote: We tried his Dango Milk a while back with the Almighty Shogun in Inazuma City.

assumed.name: Takatsukasa Clan incident
assumed.quote: Since the incident with the Takatsukasa Clan, things in the Tenryou Commission have slowly started to stabilize.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: Kubo: It's the Yashiro Commissioner...

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: There's not been a dull moment since I took up my post in the Yashiro Commission.

assumed.name: Matsuura
assumed.quote: Matsuura: Well, if it isn't the Yashiro Commissioner.

assumed.name: Kanjou Commission
assumed.quote: Matsuura: Even if she marries into the Kujou Clan, Lady Hiiragi will always be the daughter of the Hiiragi Clan and the most distinguished member of the Kanjou Commission.

assumed.name: Kujou Clan
assumed.quote: Matsuura: Even if she marries into the Kujou Clan, Lady Hiiragi will always be the daughter of the Hiiragi Clan and the most distinguished member of the Kanjou Commission.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Yamaue: The Tenryou Commission has sent a load of people to Ritou.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: But what if we were to imagine for a moment that since the affairs of the Vision Hunt Decree, the Tenryou Commission has been planning to make a move against the weakened Kanjou Commission...

assumed.name: Inazuma City
assumed.quote: Let's see how things are in Inazuma City. Then I'll take you through the details of my plan.

assumed.name: Kamisato Estate
assumed.quote: We'll head off to the Kamisato Estate shortly, and beseech him to help us with the utmost sincerity.

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Thoma: Looks like everything's resolved.

threads.claim: The letter that prompted the marriage may have been forged, since Chisato denies writing it.
threads.quote: when I formally proposed to her in person, she denied having ever written that letter

threads.claim: Ayato suspects the letter is mysterious and misleading and was written by someone else.
threads.quote: This person is presumably also responsible for the mysterious and misleading letter.

threads.claim: Someone inside the Kanjou Commission may be engineering the wedding to weaken the Hiiragi Clan.
threads.quote: it is someone from within the Kanjou Commission.

threads.claim: The perpetrators are hidden and manipulate others as pawns, so they cannot be easily caught.
threads.quote: The perpetrators are manipulating everything from the shadows, letting unsuspecting pawns do their work.

threads.claim: Matsuura comes forward to apologize, showing the plot's organizers were exposed.
threads.quote: Matsuura returns and apologizes to the Traveler, asking they accompany him to the Kamisato Estate to apologize to Ayato.

threads.claim: Hiiragi Shinsuke remains in prison, leaving the Hiiragi Clan and Kanjou Commission unstable.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke is still in prison, meaning the Kanjou Commission is the least stable in the Tri-Commission.

threads.claim: Someone was secretly listening to the conversation with Chisato, and an informant is tracked in the city.
threads.quote: Someone was eavesdropping on our conversation with Chisato the entire time.

threads.claim: Shinnojou was taken away by the plotters after objecting to the wedding.
threads.quote: Did they take one of the Kanjou Commission officers away?

threads.claim: Ayato argues that personal freedom should outweigh tradition in marriage.
threads.quote: Tradition should give way to freedom in this case.

threads.claim: Ayato believes that seeking the full truth behind strange events is less important than whether the outcome harms anyone.
threads.quote: If the outcome is positive, and no one was deceived or harmed in the process, then it is acceptable.

threads.claim: Ayato has dealt with situations like this before, hinting at a past he has not explained.
threads.quote: Sort of. I have to take this approach, or the work of the Yashiro Commissioner would never be done.

threads.claim: The plotters want to turn Chisato into an asset, making her position and authority the central stake.
threads.quote: they could still change it to their advantage by turning Chisato from a burden to an asset.

threads.claim: Shinnojou claims the wedding is part of a scheme by someone using it for their own ends.
threads.quote: Shinnojou: Oh... Wait, you have to listen to me! Lady Chisato's wedding, they... It's all part of a scheme! Someone's trying to use the wedding for their own ends!

threads.claim: The Shogunate reveals the wedding announcement was released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission.
threads.quote: Shogunate Announcement: Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error

threads.claim: Ayato declares that his previously neutral stance has ended because the stability of Inazuma is at stake.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayato: This situation has consequences for the whole Tri-Commission, and the stability of all of Inazuma is at stake. My hitherto-neutral stance ends now.

threads.claim: Asked if he acted only for Chisato, Ayato hints his true priority is his own Yashiro Commissioner role and stability.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayato: Hahaha, well, the fact is that I am first and foremost the Yashiro Commissioner.

threads.claim: Ayato's confidence hints he has handled situations like this before, though the past is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayato: This is not my first time.

threads.claim: Ayato applies the bird allegory to Matsuura, saying the long-tongued must be silenced for good.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayato: And as for the ones with excessively long tongues, well they're so insufferable that they can't be kept as pets at all... But it doesn't take a moment to cut out their tongues and silence them for good.

threads.claim: Commissioners are servants of the Almighty Shogun, and Ayato acts on her behalf against power games.
threads.quote: As a Commissioner, I am a servant of the Shogun, and it is therefore my duty to handle these tiresome matters on her behalf.

threads.claim: Ayato reveals his family's past disgrace and his father's death, explaining why he is guarded and protective.
threads.quote: My father worked incredibly hard to compensate for the grave errors made by the Kamisato Clan long ago and restore our reputation.

threads.claim: Chisato feels unsettled about her marriage and senses that her future may not be bright after all.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: I used to tell myself things like this to avoid having to think about it.

threads.claim: Chisato resolves to take over the Hiiragi Clan's responsibilities and become her own person before deciding on marriage.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: It is time for me to make a stand, and become my own person.

introduced.name: Prune
introduced.how: self-introduces as Alice's friend and a self-described hunter investigating witches
introduced.quote: My name's Prune, and I'm Alice's... friend! Yeah, friend.

introduced.name: Yaoyao
introduced.how: introduces herself as a little witch from Liyue who just joined the Little Hexenzirkel
introduced.quote: I'm little witch Yaoyao from Liyue. I just joined the Little Hexenzirkel, and I'm looking forward to learning a lot!

introduced.name: Qiqi
introduced.how: introduces herself as a little witch with a habit of writing things down to remember
introduced.quote: Mhm. I am little witch Qiqi. That's all.

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: introduces herself as a little witch who is often sleepy
introduced.quote: Oh, and our new friend here. I'm little witch Sayu.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: an auntie who made a safety-lesson toy for Yaoyao and Qiqi after hearing they were going to Inazuma
introduced.quote: Oh! This is the toy Auntie Cloud Retainer made for us. She built a lot of fun adeptal arts into it.

introduced.name: Tuantuan
introduced.how: Qiqi's imaginary friend, a chubby finch that can fly higher now
introduced.quote: She's a cute little finch, just as adorable as Qiqi herself! Her name is Tuantuan.

introduced.name: Yuegui
introduced.how: Yaoyao's imaginary friend, started after she received a mechanical Yuegui
introduced.quote: Oh, right. Just in case you're confused, Yuegui is also my imaginary friend.

introduced.name: Dodoco
introduced.how: Klee's imaginary friend from the Dodo Clan, who lives in a different place most of the time
introduced.quote: The Dodo Clan has lots of Dodocos.

introduced.name: Dodo Clan
introduced.how: a group of Dodocos who often live in a different, made-up world and visit adventures
introduced.quote: The Dodo Clan has lots of Dodocos. Some are like me, and like going on exciting adventures in new places.

introduced.name: Gena
introduced.how: Sayu's imaginary friend, invisible to most people
introduced.quote: Oh, Gena's my imaginary friend by the way. She's invisible to people most of the time, so I never introduced you.

introduced.name: Popcorn
introduced.how: Klee's new friend, a strangely colored Forest Boar that talks and was found wandering lost
introduced.quote: This is Popcorn, my new friend.

introduced.name: Dough King
introduced.how: drew a help-request card and found Popcorn wandering alone, then investigates with the Little Hexenzirkel
introduced.quote: we found the Dough King's request for help! So, we followed the trail and found the Dough King and Popcorn.

introduced.name: Homura
introduced.how: Popcorn's human, who is hurt and missing
introduced.quote: Homura must be his human, then... What happened to her? How can we help?

introduced.name: Little Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of little witches led by Klee that accepts new members by invitation
introduced.quote: The Little Hexenzirkel, reporting for duty!

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a witch organization whose members include Klee's mom and several aunties
introduced.quote: Oh, um... Well first, there's Mom. She's just like me and loves going on big adventures with her friends!

introduced.name: Forest Boar
introduced.how: a rumored crazed boar wreaking havoc around the outskirts of Chinju Forest
introduced.quote: I heard there's a crazed Forest Boar wreaking havoc around the outskirts of Chinju Forest.

introduced.name: imaginary friends
introduced.how: kid-made companions that most people cannot see and that exist only while a child imagines them
introduced.quote: Imaginary friends don't exist without a kid thinking them up, right?

introduced.name: introduction magic
introduced.how: magic that passes a little witch's self-introduction to someone, chosen by the person who knows them best
introduced.quote: Mom says the content of the introduction is super important, 'cause it's kinda like a first impression.

introduced.name: fairytale pages
introduced.how: magical loose pages that turn written fairytales into real places
introduced.quote: magical pages that transform whatever's written on them into a real place.

introduced.name: witch's bell
introduced.how: a floating bell that rings when it senses unusual magical power surges nearby
introduced.quote: Unusual power surges. There must be one nearby!

introduced.name: Dango Milk
introduced.how: a cold, coconut-milk-like drink that Qiqi likes
introduced.quote: Dango Milk is cold, like coconut milk. I like it.

introduced.name: recruitment card
introduced.how: a card calling children with imaginary friends to find the Dough King
introduced.quote: Calling all children with imaginary friends. Do you wanna accomplish something great together? If so, go off and find the Dough King.

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Paimon: Find any good toys to bring, Klee?

assumed.name: Sayu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sayuuu! You're sleeping again? Are you really that tired?

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: With a little time, I'll be able to take down Alice with my own two hands!

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sure looks like the real deal! You even have introduction magic, just like Alice and Nicole!

assumed.name: Simulanka
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, so like Simulanka? We went there ages ago.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Back in Mondstadt, Prune showed me a picture book about it.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: And before, we used Lisa's monocle detector thing...

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: a well-read, high-level student at the Akademiya.

assumed.name: adeptal arts
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, we were only able to meet your imaginary friends thanks to magic, adeptal arts, and ninjutsu.

assumed.name: Spantamad
assumed.quote: Eighty years ago, this was the defining Spantamad text! It's a true classic.

assumed.name: Dodoco
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh... But, you usually carry Dodoco with you, don't you? We met ages ago, remember?

assumed.name: Jumpy Dumpty
assumed.quote: The toy makes it so that Jumpy Dumpty doesn't explode, so I can use it all I want without getting sent to confinement.

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Klee: Huh? Honorary Knight! Paimon! And Prune!

threads.claim: Prune doubts that imaginary friends should be visible to others in the real world, raising why they can be seen.
threads.quote: We shouldn't be able to see other people's imaginary friends in the real world.

threads.claim: Popcorn's human Homura is hurt and missing, leaving an open question of what happened to her.
threads.quote: Homura must be his human, then... What happened to her? How can we help?

threads.claim: Popcorn may have amnesia, so his memories of Homura are unreliable.
threads.quote: The Dough King said Popcorn probably has amnesia and can't remember much.

threads.claim: The recruitment card may be part of a scheme to lure children using their imaginary friends.
threads.quote: A plot to lure in children using the things they love the most.

threads.claim: The card turns out not to be a trap, and the Dough King is investigating Popcorn's situation as an ally.
threads.quote: That card we found wasn't a trap.

threads.claim: Prune reveals a hidden plan to surpass Alice in combat, hinting at tension between them.
threads.quote: With a little time, I'll be able to take down Alice with my own two hands!

threads.claim: Prune suspects Alice of running schemes against children, and the Traveler doubts Alice is being fully honest.
threads.quote: Hmph, another one of her schemes.

threads.claim: The Traveler thinks Alice was telling the truth about the witch bell but not the whole truth.
threads.quote: ...But probably not the whole truth.

threads.claim: Magical fairytale pages can turn written stories into real places, raising questions about what they can create.
threads.quote: magical pages that transform whatever's written on them into a real place.

threads.claim: The Dodo Clan's home is described as a made-up world for kids, tying imaginary worlds to real places.
threads.quote: She said that place is a... made-up world for kids, and Dodoco is my imaginary friend.

threads.claim: Prune's bell detects unusual magic surges, suggesting a witch may be nearby, though its reliability is uncertain.
threads.quote: Unusual power surges. There must be one nearby!

threads.claim: Prune wonders whether the Little Hexenzirkel takes orders from the main Hexenzirkel, leaving its origins open.
threads.quote: Does this organization take orders from the main Hexenzirkel...?

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: a journalist who interviews people about the Phantom Weasel
introduced.quote: Well, not to worry — you're in good hands, because I'm a professional! The story goes like this...

introduced.name: Phantom Weasel
introduced.how: a masked thief ten years ago who stole from rich and poor alike and was never caught
introduced.quote: Ten or so years ago, a phantom thief became active in the Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Cesar
introduced.how: a magician who died in a botched escape and was later wrongly named as the Phantom Weasel
introduced.quote: A magician named Cesar fell to his death in a botched high-altitude escape performance.

introduced.name: Garde
introduced.how: authorities who searched Cesar's belongings and found the stolen goods
introduced.quote: while investigating his belongings, the Gardes found the stolen goods

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: a magician who offers to help investigate and is the twin brother of Lynette
introduced.quote: My name is Lyney, and this is my sister Lynette.

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: Lyney's sister, also a performer and part of the investigation
introduced.quote: My name is Lyney, and this is my sister Lynette.

introduced.name: Jemma
introduced.how: Cesar's fiancée who visits his grave often and is hiding something
introduced.quote: And if we're investigating Cesar, his fiancée, Jemma, is a good place to start.

introduced.name: Lorenzo
introduced.how: a former magician and apprentice of Cesar's who is now a businessman
introduced.quote: When they arrive at Hotel Debord, they meet up with Lorenzo, a former magician and apprentice of Cesar's who had since retired from the career and is now a businessman.

introduced.name: Rainbow Rose
introduced.how: a flower magicians use to symbolize passion and romantic encounters
introduced.quote: For example, magicians often use "Rainbow Roses" in their flower-related performances to represent "passion" and "romantic encounters."

introduced.name: Lumidouce Bell
introduced.how: a flower that alludes to separations in floral symbolism
introduced.quote: But you used a Lumidouce Bell, which, if I'm not mistaken, allude to "separations."

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: the opera house where the warning letter was posted and where Lyney performs
introduced.quote: and pasted it on the gate of the Opera Epiclese for all to see!

introduced.name: Thieves versus magicians
introduced.how: magicians make things reappear while thieves only make them disappear
introduced.quote: Thieves make precious things disappear, but only magicians make them reappear.

introduced.name: Warning letter
introduced.how: a letter threatening to steal what people hold dear at the opera house in three days
introduced.quote: Three days from now, when evening falls, I shall take from you that which you hold most dear at the opera house, just as you did to me ten years ago.

introduced.name: Lorenzo
introduced.how: Cesar's former pupil and assistant who inherited his magic and became a wealthy businessman
introduced.quote: Today, we'll be looking into a guy named Lorenzo, Cesar's former pupil and assistant.

introduced.name: Cesar
introduced.how: famous magician who died ten years ago, whose stolen goods were confiscated after his death
introduced.quote: When Cesar passed away, all the stolen goods discovered in his home were confiscated and returned to their rightful owners.

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: Lyney's sister, who is also a magician
introduced.quote: "Smoothface" Paccino: So you're Lyney? And where's your sister, ain't she with you today?

introduced.name: Jemma
introduced.how: Cesar's former fiancée, who has been threatened by Lorenzo's men
introduced.quote: Maybe you were in love with Jemma, but she was engaged to Cesar.

introduced.name: Edmondo
introduced.how: Lorenzo's business associate who introduces himself and warns against prying into Lorenzo's affairs
introduced.quote: Edmondo: Oh, hey. I'm Edmondo.

introduced.name: The Phantom Weasel
introduced.how: thief whose warning letter appeared at the opera house, and who was believed to be Cesar
introduced.quote: Lyney: Yesterday morning, a warning letter from The Phantom Weasel appeared on the entrance to the opera house.

introduced.name: Fleuve Cendre
introduced.how: dangerous district where Cesar's sealed workshop is located
introduced.quote: Jemma: The Fleuve Cendre. But the place was sealed up by the police after his death, and no one's been there since.

introduced.name: Cesar's Magic Workshop
introduced.how: Cesar's workshop full of his personal effects and trick gadgets, with a hidden room
introduced.quote: I've heard that Cesar used to have a magic workshop where he kept a lot of his personal effects.

introduced.name: High-altitude escape
introduced.how: stage illusion where a magician vanishes from a suspended box and a dummy falls in their place
introduced.quote: First, the magician slots themselves into a magic box in full view of the audience.

introduced.name: Cesar's death in the high-altitude escape
introduced.how: Cesar fell from the opera house roof during his trick, not the dummy, and died
introduced.quote: Cesar was the one who fell out, and not the dummy.

introduced.name: Wishlists
introduced.how: cards children wrote wishes on at Cesar's shows, which he fulfilled with his fake hat machine story
introduced.quote: Cesar's Diary: As a joke, I told the kid that the hat has a built-in wish-granting machine...

introduced.name: Two children studying magic with Cesar
introduced.how: two young prodigies who asked Cesar to teach them magic and later left him
introduced.quote: Cesar's Diary: Two children came to talk to me after today's show.

introduced.name: Cesar
introduced.how: Famous magician who taught Lyney and Lynette magic and was framed as The Phantom Weasel after his fatal fall
introduced.quote: Paimon: No wonder. Cesar was a famous magician, too.

introduced.name: The Phantom Weasel
introduced.how: Master thief who terrorized Fontaine's Court for years and framed Cesar as a scapegoat
introduced.quote: Lyney: Let's go back to the very beginning. A decade ago, when The Phantom Weasel was terrorizing the Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Lorenzo
introduced.how: Cesar's aggrieved pupil who was persuaded to tamper with Cesar's magic box
introduced.quote: Lynette: But as she was considering how to make her move, she noticed Cesar's aggrieved pupil, and a new thought entered her mind:

introduced.name: Jemma
introduced.how: Cesar's fiancée revealed as the real Phantom Weasel, shaped by a bitter, neglected childhood
introduced.quote: Jemma: Left to fend for herself after her parents died young. Betrayed. Scorned. Beaten...

introduced.name: The Phantom Copycat
introduced.how: Alias Lyney used when he posted the warning letter outside the opera house
introduced.quote: Jemma: Lyney... Or should I call you The Phantom Copycat now? You were the one who posted that letter outside the opera house.

introduced.name: Rainbow Rose
introduced.how: A rare flower Lyney conjures in his tricks, which Paimon identifies by name
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, there it is! This is a different flower from the one last time, right? This one's called... oh yeah, a Rainbow Rose!

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: Newspaper where Charlotte writes her special column about the Phantom Weasel case
introduced.quote: I'm gonna go through my notes and put it all together into the most spectacular special column piece to ever grace the pages of The Steambird!

introduced.name: Cesar's ten days of teaching the twins
introduced.how: Lyney and Lynette sought Cesar out for training and spent ten short days learning from him while hiding their true motives
introduced.quote: Lyney: In all, we only spent ten short days together, but he was very good to us.

introduced.name: Cesar's staged death
introduced.how: Lorenzo tampered with Cesar's magic box at the Weasel's urging, and the Weasel then ruined Cesar's reputation
introduced.quote: Lynette: At her encouragement, Lorenzo tampered with Cesar's magic box, causing him to fall to his death.

introduced.name: Cesar's fatal high-altitude escape trick
introduced.how: The stunt Cesar died attempting ten years ago, which Lyney re-performed as his finale
introduced.quote: Robert Houdin: I'm sure you all remember the magician Cesar. This was the very trick that led to his fatal fall, after which he was dubbed The Phantom Weasel.

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's been a while, Lynette!

assumed.name: Bruno and Lori
assumed.quote: After taking him out, he admits his crimes to Bruno and Lori and is taken away.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: After being taken in by Arlecchino, he and Lynette approached Cesar with an agenda in mind.

assumed.name: Vision bearer
assumed.quote: After a brief scuffle, the pursuers realize that they can't handle a Vision bearer and flee

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Lyney: Over here.

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Any altercation in the city will attract the Gardes...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Ugh, if I had a Mora for every time you've said that man's name...

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: not without a Vision, at least.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: And with his reputation in Fontaine, it was too risky for me to go it alone.

assumed.name: Charlotte
assumed.quote: Charlotte told us that The Weasel would steal whatever people valued, no matter how much it was worth.

assumed.name: Bruno
assumed.quote: Bruno: Lyney has told me the whole story.

assumed.name: Lori
assumed.quote: Lori: Hmph. Look who's finally developed a conscience.

assumed.name: Gracia
assumed.quote: Gracia: ...I've spoken many choice words about Cesar over the years.

assumed.name: Dolora
assumed.quote: Dolora: I can't believe Lorenzo was intimidating Jemma all this time...

assumed.name: Baltasar
assumed.quote: Baltasar: Thank you all for clearing Cesar's name.

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lyney changed the topic back in the workshop, so we didn't get a chance to bring it up.

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: Lynette: Not this time. My brother's going solo today.

assumed.name: Charlotte
assumed.quote: Charlotte: Here I am, as we agreed!

assumed.name: Robert Houdin
assumed.quote: Robert Houdin: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen! I hope everybody's ready, because the show is about to begin!

assumed.name: Garde
assumed.quote: Charlotte: But just as dawn broke, I suddenly received news that Cesar's fiancée, Jemma, had contacted the Gardes and confessed to having been the real Phantom Weasel all along!

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: Lyney: After I joined the House of the Hearth.

threads.claim: Abagnale suggests the Phantom Weasel faked his death ten years ago using a body double.
threads.quote: He must have faked his own death ten years ago using a body double!

threads.claim: Lyney sets out to determine whether Cesar was really the Phantom Weasel.
threads.quote: The first thing we need to look into is who Cesar really was.

threads.claim: Jemma is revealed to have been the true Phantom Weasel all along.
threads.quote: Lynette reveals that Jemma was the true Phantom Weasel, surprising Paimon.

threads.claim: Gracia raises the possibility that Cesar was framed for being the Phantom Weasel.
threads.quote: What if this Weasel's the real deal, and Cesar was framed?

threads.claim: Cesar's name is cleared and the true suspect is caught.
threads.quote: Lyney informs them that Cesar's name has been cleared and the true suspect apprehended.

threads.claim: Lyney discovers that someone sabotaged Cesar's performance, leading to his death.
threads.quote: while reading his notes, discovered that someone had intentionally sabotaged his play and resulted in his death.

threads.claim: Lorenzo confesses to killing Cesar out of resentment.
threads.quote: Lorenzo admits to killing Cesar, as he loathed him for self-perceived poverty

threads.claim: Lynette insists Jemma is lying and knows something about Cesar.
threads.quote: She's lying. She definitely knows something.

threads.claim: Jemma's hidden connection to the Phantom Weasel is exposed.
threads.quote: Lynette reveals that Jemma was the true Phantom Weasel, surprising Paimon.

threads.claim: The warning letter claims the Phantom Weasel will strike at the opera house in three nights.
threads.quote: The Phantom Weasel claims he's planning something in three nights' time at the opera house.

threads.claim: Lyney wrote the warning letter himself to draw out Jemma.
threads.quote: Lyney reveals that she didn't; he did in order to draw her out, as they felt indebted to Cesar and wanted to restore his legacy.

threads.claim: Rumors suggest Cesar used children's wishlists to learn what people valued in order to steal it.
threads.quote: But after he died, there were also rumors that he used the wishlist to find out what was precious to people, with the intent to steal it later.

threads.claim: Cesar's diary suggests the twins once trained under him as children.
threads.quote: Paimon believes the two kids he was talking about were actually Lyney and Lynette, so they ask Lyney about it.

threads.claim: Lyney and Lynette admit they hid many secrets from Cesar during their training.
threads.quote: During the ten days they spent together, Cesar treated them well, yet they hid many secrets from him.

threads.claim: Lyney keeps the method of his flower trick secret.
threads.quote: Lyney: Hehe... I'm afraid that's my little secret.

threads.claim: Lyney vows to uncover the true identity of The Phantom Weasel and what really happened ten years ago.
threads.quote: Lyney: I want to find out The Phantom Weasel's true identity. I have to know for myself what really happened ten years ago.

threads.claim: Lyney deduces Cesar was left-handed and that his box's secret button was switched, suggesting murder.
threads.quote: Lyney: But here's the strange thing: Most of the devices in this workshop have the mechanism on the left-hand side, including this box right here.

threads.claim: Lorenzo confesses he killed Cesar out of jealousy and to escape Cesar's exposure of his money-making magic.
threads.quote: Lorenzo: I had to kill him... There was no other way. He had to go.

threads.claim: Lorenzo admits he was The Phantom Weasel and framed Cesar for its crimes.
threads.quote: Lorenzo: ...I am.

threads.claim: Jemma says she hates the men who keep threatening her whenever she looks into Cesar's death.
threads.quote: Jemma: It's been ten long years... And still, every time I try to look into Cesar's death, they show up and warn me not to "do anything stupid"...

threads.claim: Cesar's diary hints the two child prodigies have a secret 'Father' and 'mission' and a hidden past.
threads.quote: Sounds like their parents have other plans for them.

threads.claim: Paimon connects Cesar's child students to Lyney and Lynette, suggesting they knew Cesar as children.
threads.quote: Paimon: Sounds a lot like he was writing about Lyney and Lynette, don't you think?

threads.claim: Lorenzo has been watching Jemma from a distance at Cesar's grave, and Jemma never asked him to leave.
threads.quote: She must've known, but she never asked him to leave. I wonder why that is.

threads.claim: Edmondo warns that people who pry into Lorenzo's affairs or cross him come to bad ends.
threads.quote: Don't go prying into Lorenzo's personal affairs... Bad things happen to people who ask too many questions or make an enemy out of him.

threads.claim: Cesar tells the children the world is full of lies, so people must find their own truth.
threads.quote: It's full of lies and falsehoods, and that is why we must find our own truth.

threads.claim: Lyney explains that the essence of magic is making people believe a lie.
threads.quote: Lyney: The essence of magic is getting people to believe a lie.

threads.claim: Lyney's upcoming opera house magic show is being held in Cesar's honor.
threads.quote: We're holding it in Cesar's honor.

threads.claim: The Phantom Weasel is revealed to be Jemma, who hid behind her role as a grieving widow.
threads.quote: Lyney: Who would suspect for one second that the lovely young lady always seen weeping in front of Cesar's grave was actually the mastermind behind his demise?

threads.claim: Lorenzo's overly eager confession suggests he is hiding something more than guilt.
threads.quote: He was too forthcoming with his confession — as if there was something else he was trying to hide.

threads.claim: Lorenzo confessed falsely to protect Jemma, driven by guilt over having killed Cesar himself.
threads.quote: Jemma: Having killed Cesar with his own hands, Lorenzo was plagued by overwhelming guilt.

threads.claim: Cesar taught that the world is full of lies, and that each person must find their own truth.
threads.quote: Lyney: Cesar once told me that even though the world is filled with lies and falsehoods, we must find our own truth.

threads.claim: Lyney suggests Jemma is not truly free, despite her confession and Lorenzo's admission.
threads.quote: Do you really think so?

threads.claim: Lyney's use of Rainbow Roses carries a personal meaning that Lynette does not understand.
threads.quote: Lynette: I don't recall ever having received a Rainbow Rose from you myself. Is this supposed to mean that they're more important to you than your own sister?

threads.claim: Lyney re-performs Cesar's fatal escape trick as a tribute, with a tweak to the original setup.
threads.quote: Traveler: The trick that Cesar died attempting...

introduced.name: Kuki Shinobu
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a Liyue-trained law graduate who is a key organizer of the gang
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Hello, it's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Kuki Shinobu, I studied law in Liyue, so while I couldn't claim to be an expert, I do have a rudimentary grasp of the basics.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: Shinobu claims the gang is a legitimate international organization, though it is really a street gang that posts flyers and causes trouble
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: It's actually a legitimate international organization.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: Gang boss and face of the organization, described as a genius and an oni
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Ahem! Mr. Arataki is a pioneering genius and the face of our organization.

introduced.name: Gang Bylaws
introduced.how: The gang's written rules with numbered articles and set penalties, enforced by Shinobu
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Listen carefully. From now on, you must strictly abide by the Gang Bylaws of the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: Mountain shrine where disrespect is treated as disrespect to the Shogun herself
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: This is the Grand Narukami Shrine, after all. Ultimately, their actions here are tantamount to disrespecting the Shogun herself...

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Shrine head, addressed as Lady Guuji, who sets the terms of the gang's apology
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Well hello there, little one. Oh? I see you've brought a special guest.

introduced.name: Miyuki
introduced.how: Shinobu's sister, a shrine maiden assigned to clean up the flyers
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: She is your sister, after all.

introduced.name: Norika
introduced.how: A merchant doing business between Inazuma and Liyue, negotiating with the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Norika: Hmm, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Norika, a merchant who does business between Inazuma and Liyue.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Official who recruits Shinobu as a legal consultant and vouches for her ability
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara: I can assure you that she is exceptionally capable. All the Doushin from the Police Station have vouched for her abilities.

introduced.name: Amano
introduced.how: Police officer (Doushin) who detains the gang over the flyers
introduced.quote: Amano: So sorry, Madam Norika. I'm just stopping some hooligans from posting flyers...

introduced.name: Uesugi
introduced.how: Police officer who handles the gang's case and lets them off on Shinobu's word
introduced.quote: Uesugi: Huh, even the Traveler is here to vouch for the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Aoi
introduced.how: Owner of Tsukumomono Groceries
introduced.quote: Aoi: Welcome to Tsukumomono Groceries. What can I do for you?

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: The national government; the tengu official Sara is described as its general
introduced.quote: Genta: Well, duh! That tengu is the Shogunate's general! So that other lady has gotta be someone ridiculously high-up.

introduced.name: Doushin
introduced.how: Police officers at the Police Station
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Out of the city? A Doushin from the Police Station told me that things have been getting pretty rough out there recently...

introduced.name: Mamoru
introduced.how: Gang member who posted flyers and gets scolded by Shinobu
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Mamoru and the others probably believed that they would be able to reach more people in need this way.

introduced.name: Genta
introduced.how: Gang member who posted flyers and was arrested with the others
introduced.quote: Genta: What uuuup! The Arataki Gang is back in town!

introduced.name: Akira
introduced.how: Gang member who tries to hide from Shinobu in a box
introduced.quote: Akira: Hey, hey! I knew Shinobu wouldn't abandon us!

introduced.name: Hanamizaka
introduced.how: Local area where Shinobu can be found and where the gang members wait
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: If, on closer inspection, you do find any damage, please come to Hanamizaka and ask for me.

introduced.name: Takuma
introduced.how: a worried visitor nearly drawn into a investment scam
introduced.quote: Takuma: *sigh* Should I take the risk, or... Huh, who are you?

introduced.name: Hayato
introduced.how: a writer out of ideas who came to the shrine to pray for inspiration
introduced.quote: Hayato: *sigh* I, on the other hand, am all out of ideas. So I came to the shrine to pray for inspiration...

introduced.name: Asami
introduced.how: an elderly visitor whose granddaughter is going abroad and who has poor eyesight
introduced.quote: Asami: Oh, it's okay, there's no need to rush...

introduced.name: Inagi Hotomi
introduced.how: a senior shrine maiden who handles visitors and omamori requests
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: Please wait a moment, Ma'am. We'll work something out for you as soon as possible...

introduced.name: Maki
introduced.how: a shrine maiden who keeps the paper slips for omamori
introduced.quote: Maki: You need paper slips for omamori blessings? I have a few right here.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
