introduced.how: the head of Yae Publishing House who pays the shrine maidens and offers editor jobs
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Would you be interested in continuing to work as shrine maidens? Or perhaps you'd like to work as editors at Yae Publishing House instead?

introduced.name: Kaito
introduced.how: a Kairagi member who angrily blames Akira for losing the supplies
introduced.quote: Kaito: You little brat! Where are the supplies? What did you do with them?

introduced.name: Akira
introduced.how: a junior Arataki Gang member who lost the smuggled supplies
introduced.quote: Akira: Ah! W—Wait, you'd better not mess with me! I'm, I'm from the Arataki Gang!

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: a gang whose members Kuki is associated with and whose bylaws govern them
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: In the Arataki Gang... nobody's a nobody.

introduced.name: Kairagi
introduced.how: smugglers who hide stolen supplies in the area
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: I just spoke to a Doushin. Apparently, the Kairagi are smuggling some supplies, and they've hidden them in this area.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publishing house that employs editors and hires shrine maidens
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Would you be interested in continuing to work as shrine maidens? Or perhaps you'd like to work as editors at Yae Publishing House instead?

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: the shrine where the visitors come for fortune slips and blessings
introduced.quote: Takuma: You're shrine maidens? They sure dress different these days, I suppose this is the Grand Narukami Shrine, after all...

introduced.name: Gang Bylaws
introduced.how: the gang's rules, including Article 3 requiring members to help each other in trouble
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Listen and learn. Gang Bylaws, Article 3: When one of us is in trouble, all of us come to their aid.

introduced.name: Omamori
introduced.how: a blessing charm built from brocade bags, knots, and blessed paper slips
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: You should be able to find the brocade bags and knots on both sides of the shrine. For the paper slips that go inside, just ask Maki.

introduced.name: Salary Bag
introduced.how: a sealed package of wages that Yae Miko says must not be opened until leaving the shrine
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: You mustn't open the package until after you leave the shrine. Otherwise... you will be cursed with bad luck.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang Flyer
introduced.how: flyers the gang posts around, which get stomped on and scattered
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Wait. Is that... one of the flyers they made?

introduced.name: Kuki's mask
introduced.how: Kuki wears a mask to keep people from recognizing her
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: I wear this mask to stop people from recognizing me, because I don't want them to pry into my personal affairs.

introduced.name: Shrine maiden
introduced.how: a shrine job with duties like helping visitors and making omamori
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: This is a job for a real shrine maiden, like Inagi. I wouldn't be suited to it.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: We paid top Mora to hire a professional artist for this, and while the finished product is a little... um, avant-garde...

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: As a further security, all of the offending member's gang assets, including Onikabuto and Genius Invokation TCG cards, will be frozen until the loan is repaid in full...

assumed.name: Onikabuto
assumed.quote: As a further security, all of the offending member's gang assets, including Onikabuto and Genius Invokation TCG cards, will be frozen until the loan is repaid in full...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Knights of Favonius have a handbook...

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Millelith also abides by a strict contract...

assumed.name: Shogun
assumed.quote: Ultimately, their actions here are tantamount to disrespecting the Shogun herself...

assumed.name: Yoimiya
assumed.quote: Souta: Oh, I know! We can get Yoimiya to set off some fireworks and scare off the guy that took our spot!

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Tsk... Well, given that this way is Tenshukaku and the Police Station, you can bet they'll have fled in the opposite direction!

assumed.name: Police Station
assumed.quote: by the time we'd recovered our wits, we were already at the Police Station...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: What's this I've been hearing from visitors that you've joined some sort of gang since returning from Liyue?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: which is very popular in Mondstadt right now, and also incorporates elements from Liyue's ink wash paintings.

assumed.name: Tatarasuna
assumed.quote: Miyuki: I've been dealing with something down in Tatarasuna for a while, so I hadn't seen Lady Yae in a long time.

assumed.name: Kairagi
assumed.quote: Traveler: Kairagi might show up.

assumed.name: Lavender Melons
assumed.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Last month, you almost got the fire brigade out when you were roasting Lavender Melons.

assumed.name: Mamoru
assumed.quote: Mamoru: You kidding me? He was mad about losing, so he robbed a kid?

assumed.name: Genta
assumed.quote: Genta: Yeah! Everyone knows, don't hate the player, hate the game!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Kuki Shinobu: So these Kairagi were just pawns of the Fatui. Didn't see that coming.

assumed.name: Doushin
assumed.quote: Kuki Shinobu: I just spoke to a Doushin.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Kuki Shinobu: If we pass this information to the Tenryou Commission, it might go a long way towards making up for our past crimes.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Inagi Hotomi: I pray that the Electro Archon will bless that lady and her granddaughter...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Here, these are your wages, as promised. Not a single Mora short.

assumed.name: Shogun's Army
assumed.quote: Akira: You don't wanna get on the wrong side of my boss! Even the general of the Shogun's Army doesn't dare to challenge him!

threads.claim: Shinobu strongly denies being a sufferer of the instability she describes, hinting she has a personal stake in the gang.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: ...Oh but — no no no, not me. I'm not a sufferer.

threads.claim: Shinobu insists she joined the gang of her own free will, which her family doubts.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: No, I joined of my own free will.

threads.claim: Shinobu's family is worried about her, and rumors of her joining the gang have reached them.
threads.quote: Miyuki: Aw, really... The whole family's worried about you.

threads.claim: Shinobu's legal skills are sought by Sara and Norika, raising the question of whether she will leave the gang.
threads.quote: Norika: Cross-border trade is a complicated affair, but fortunately, Madam Kujou Sara was able to bring in a legal consultant proficient in the laws of both nations.

threads.claim: Yae Miko's accommodating demands look like a scheme, which the Traveler suspects.
threads.quote: Traveler: (That's a devilish grin...)

threads.claim: A group of Kairagi roams outside the city, a danger the gang has been warned about.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: I heard from the Police Station about a group of Kairagi on the prowl outside the city...

threads.claim: The Traveler is given the title of Chief Advisor of the Arataki Gang as part of a cover story.
threads.quote: Also, as of right now, you're

threads.claim: The Traveler asks to join the Arataki Gang and says they like its people and culture.
threads.quote: Traveler: I'd like to join the Arataki Gang.

threads.claim: Shinobu seemed to be recruited by the Shogunate, but Norika reveals she is a merchant doing a business deal, not a government official.
threads.quote: Mamoru: *sniff*... Huh? A merchant? Wait, so... you're not a Shogunate official?

threads.claim: Gang members clean up and apologize to the neighborhood, suggesting they have turned over a new leaf.
threads.quote: Shimura Kanbei: Sure did. Ah, it looks like at long last, they've turned over a new leaf...

threads.claim: Kuki hides her face behind a mask so people will not recognize her or pry into her affairs.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: I wear this mask to stop people from recognizing me, because I don't want them to pry into my personal affairs.

threads.claim: A past shrine maiden who spoke little sounds exactly like Kuki, and several visitors seem to recognize Kuki as someone they met before.
threads.quote: Asami: Although, this is very strange, you sound exactly like another shrine maiden I remember. She didn't talk much, but I remember her voice very well...

threads.claim: The Arataki Gang has committed past crimes that they hope to make up for.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Making up for our past crimes is one thing. But you really need some more hands-on training...

threads.claim: The Kairagi were acting as pawns of the Fatui in the smuggling scheme.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: So these Kairagi were just pawns of the Fatui. Didn't see that coming.

threads.claim: Yae Miko warns that opening the wage package early brings bad luck, and the package holds something odd.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: You mustn't open the package until after you leave the shrine. Otherwise... you will be cursed with bad luck.

threads.claim: The wage package contains something unexpected, a single thin sheet, and the Traveler reacts to it without explanation.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: That's weird, it's just a single thin sheet...

threads.claim: Kuki suggests that mortals sometimes can only turn to the gods, yet she despises people who rely on gods for everything.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: The only people I can't stand are the ones who don't think for themselves and at least try to solve their own problems.

threads.claim: The gang's bylaws were newly established by Kuki in the moment, so their existence is questionable.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: We do now.

introduced.how: a wushou dancer and guard who is Yip Tak's estranged son
introduced.quote: Ah yes, that is the name of the Wushou dancer who has been performing around Liyue Harbor recently, is it not?

introduced.name: Yip Tak
introduced.how: a tea merchant and Gaming's father, who opposes his son's dancing and guard work
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh! So you're Gaming's father. It's nice to meet you!

introduced.name: Houzhang
introduced.how: one of two staged bandits who ambush the group
introduced.quote: Houzhang: ...It appears that one's movements were overly conspicuous.

introduced.name: Jiehu
introduced.how: the second staged bandit, who demands the goods
introduced.quote: Jiehu: Present your exquisite ornaments at once!

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: a Fontainian reporter who wants to interview Yip Tak and buy his tea
introduced.quote: Charlotte: My name is Charlotte, and I am a reporter from Fontaine.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: the Fontaine publication where Charlotte writes
introduced.quote: You can find me writing for The Steambird.

introduced.name: Xianyun
introduced.how: a master who secretly orchestrates the plan to reconcile Gaming and his father
introduced.quote: Xianyun: Perfect. The time is nigh for us to make an appearance.

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: Xianyun's disciple who joins the scheme with awkward talk
introduced.quote: Shenhe: They're gone, Master.

introduced.name: Shuyu
introduced.how: a young girl who owns a suanni kite and is with Gaming's father at the end
introduced.quote: Shuyu: No need! No need! Master is waiting for me right over there.

introduced.name: Zhenyuan
introduced.how: a kite-stall owner who gives the Traveler a free device for their kite
introduced.quote: Zhenyuan: Welcome back! I see you've returned from your trip.

introduced.name: Mechanical Vertical Lifting Device
introduced.how: a Fontaine-made gadget that is installed on a kite to lift it
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, we already have a kite. We wanted to buy one of those, um... device thingies from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Xianyun's plan
introduced.how: a scheme to stage a demonstration that helps Gaming and his father reconcile
introduced.quote: Shenhe: Yes, Master. We aim to give them a demonstration of familial love.

introduced.name: Wushou dance
introduced.how: a performance art that has grown in popularity in Liyue Harbor and involves hardships
introduced.quote: Wushou dancing has become more well-known in Liyue Harbor recently.

introduced.name: Suanni
introduced.how: a dance tradition whose spirit Gaming embodies, with hidden hardships for its dancers
introduced.quote: He truly encapsulates the spirit of the suanni.

introduced.name: Kite-flying competition
introduced.how: a contest during the Lantern Rite in which the Traveler's group enters a kite
introduced.quote: Good luck in the kite-flying competition. I'll be rooting for you!

assumed.name: Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: (All is going to plan...)

assumed.name: Longzhou
assumed.quote: Longzhou: Ah! Perfect, you're all here! There's an important commission I need your help with.

assumed.name: Secure Transport Agency
assumed.quote: Paimon: Everyone at the Secure Transport Agency says as much.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zhongli!? Oh no, what is he doing here

assumed.name: Xiao

assumed.name: Hu Tao

assumed.name: Director Hu
assumed.quote: Xiao: (A ghostly kite? Could that elusive Director Hu be coming to Wangshu Inn once again?)

assumed.name: Rex
assumed.quote: Given her relationship with Rex... well, Zhongli, I might as well go pay my respects.

assumed.name: Menogias
assumed.quote: Menogias was the only yaksha among us who had an interest in matters of ornamentation and design.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: as Ningguang would say.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: If there are indeed bandits in the area, then we should inform the Millelith at once.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: A recommendation from Xiangling, perhaps?

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Shenhe: Recently, I've been conversing with Guoba in the kitchen at night.

assumed.name: Pervases' Temple
assumed.quote: come find me near Pervases' temple if you have the time.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Lantern Rite is as festive as ever!

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon's even seen him take down a dozen or so Treasure Hoarders all by himself!

threads.claim: Gaming's long-running conflict with his father is presented as the central unresolved tension.
threads.quote: Gaming: But this conflict between us has been going on for a long time.

threads.claim: Yip Tak's regret over introducing his son to wushou dancing hints at the root of his opposition.
threads.quote: Yip Tak: I often regret introducing him to Wushou dancing as a kid.

threads.claim: Yip Tak finally changes his mind and openly accepts Gaming's dream of dancing professionally.
threads.quote: Yip Tak: All I really want to say is, I've changed my mind...

threads.claim: Xianyun is secretly directing a plan that the group carries out without fully explaining it.
threads.quote: Shenhe: Yes, Master. We aim to give them a demonstration of familial love.

threads.claim: Xianyun confirms that the reconciliation plan succeeded despite unforeseen variables.
threads.quote: Xianyun: Not at all. Certain unforeseen variables may have presented themselves along the way... but the outcome proved favorable. The plan was a success.

threads.claim: Shenhe has a troubled past that others already know about but that the text hints at without explaining.
threads.quote: Shenhe: You already know of my past circumstances.

threads.claim: Xiao's remark hints at a relationship between Hu Tao and a figure named Rex that is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Given her relationship with Rex... well, Zhongli, I might as well go pay my respects.

threads.claim: Director Hu is portrayed as an elusive figure whose whereabouts and motives are uncertain.
threads.quote: Xiao: (A ghostly kite? Could that elusive Director Hu be coming to Wangshu Inn once again?)

threads.claim: Zhongli reveals that Director Hu sent him to buy supplies and to test the kites.
threads.quote: Zhongli: In truth, I'm here because Director Hu dispatched me to purchase some items in preparation for Lantern Rite.

threads.claim: Zhongli appears to understand the staged scheme and is quietly playing along with it.
threads.quote: Traveler: (He must have figured it all out by now. Is he just playing dumb on purpose...)

threads.claim: Xiao's reference to Menogias as a fellow yaksha hints at a shared past among the yaksha that is not explained.
threads.quote: Menogias was the only yaksha among us who had an interest in matters of ornamentation and design.

introduced.name: Xinyan
introduced.how: introduces herself as a Liyue musician who likes rock and roll and good times
introduced.quote: Hey! I'm Xinyan, from Liyue. I like rock 'n' roll, sunny days, and good times.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
introduced.how: introduces himself as a wanderer from Inazuma
introduced.quote: I am Kaedehara Kazuha from Inazuma. It is an honor to meet you all.

introduced.name: Mona
introduced.how: introduces herself as an astrologist
introduced.quote: Pleasure to meet you. I'm Mona, an astrologist.

introduced.name: Fischl
introduced.how: is presented as a princess from a faraway land travelling with her retinue
introduced.quote: there's a princess from a faraway land and her retinue, who're also coming on this trip...

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: is revealed as Klee's mother, an ageless mage and the likely author of the letter
introduced.quote: The unaging mage was taking her teeny-tiny knight on a vacation, and I happened to run into them.

introduced.name: Klee
introduced.how: is identified as the Spark Knight and a friend of Fischl's who met her outside the city
introduced.quote: Mona: The truth is that yesterday, Her Highness encountered the Spark Knight, Klee outside of the city.

introduced.name: Persikov
introduced.how: is a Fatuus who explains he built an energy generator to test on the island
introduced.quote: It's a new kind of energy generator that I invented.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: are the Cryo Archon's minions, a capable crew
introduced.quote: Ahaha, the Cryo Archon's minions are a capable crew.

introduced.name: Dodocommunication Device
introduced.how: a prototype communicator from Alice that lets people talk over vast distances with limited uses
introduced.quote: and it allows people to stay in touch over vast distances.

introduced.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
introduced.how: the masterless island named in the letter as the promised land
introduced.quote: Amid the seas under a far-flung sky may the Golden Apple Archipelago be found.

introduced.name: Immernachtreich
introduced.how: Fischl's fallen homeland, which she claims will reappear
introduced.quote: Upon hearing the tragic tale of the fall of Her Highness's homeworld, the tender-hearted Spark Knight inquired, with tears welling up in her eyes...

introduced.name: Dodoco
introduced.how: small creatures that dive into the sea at birth and some drift to Mondstadt
introduced.quote: When a Dodoco is born, it dives into the water.

introduced.name: Iridescence Tour
introduced.how: a music festival that keeps getting canceled
introduced.quote: Anyway, it's supposed to be a music festival.

introduced.name: Drink-Till-You-Sink Champion-Ship
introduced.how: a booze-fueled party Beidou held last month where Xinyan ran the music and met Kazuha
introduced.quote: Last month, Beidou held a big booze-fueled party called

introduced.name: Cat's Tail
introduced.how: a tavern run by a cat-eared woman, competing with Six-Fingered José's place
introduced.quote: I promised a young lady with cat ears and a cat tail that I'd sing in her tavern to boost business and beat the competition.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're here! Tone-Deaf Bard! ...Huh!?

assumed.name: Oz
assumed.quote: Oz: Traveler, Paimon, it's a pleasure to see you again. Mein Fräulein and I extend to you our most sincere greetings.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ah, Traveler. It so happens that a friend of yours asked me to pass on a voice message when I saw you.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Traveler: Okay, I'll report this to the Knights of Favonius immediately!

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Kaeya's mind works in mysterious ways, but no one in Mondstadt has ideas that boggle the mind quite like...

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Master Jean? Or... Lisa?

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Master Jean? Or... Lisa?

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Xinyan: What a... unique little thing. Looks kinda like Guoba, doesn't it?

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Last month, Beidou held a big booze-fueled party called

assumed.name: Mint
assumed.quote: Isn't there a single place in this world without Mint, Sweet Flowers, and Fatui?

assumed.name: Sweet Flower
assumed.quote: Isn't there a single place in this world without Mint, Sweet Flowers, and Fatui?

threads.claim: Fischl insists her fallen homeland, the Immernachtreich, is near Mondstadt and will reappear, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: The Immernachtreich is near Mondstadt!

threads.claim: Mona suspects Alice and her master are behind the letter because Klee is involved.
threads.quote: Klee is involved in this, which means her mother is probably involved

threads.claim: Paimon suspects Venti and Alice are working together, and Venti denies it.
threads.quote: Sounds like the two of you are in cahoots over this...

threads.claim: Venti confirms Alice wrote the letter, showing he was in on her plan.
threads.quote: As I'm sure you've already guessed, that letter is most definitely written by Alice.

threads.claim: Alice's communicator is said to be inspired by another world, a hint about her origins.
threads.quote: I heard that the inspiration for this comes from another world...

threads.claim: Persikov's Fatui team is testing an energy generator on the Archipelago, and its purpose and sponsor remain unknown.
threads.quote: It's a new kind of energy generator that I invented.

threads.claim: Kazuha finds the Fatui presence on the island suspicious and suspects a deeper motive.
threads.quote: Whatever their reasons, it's likely more complicated than we might think.

threads.claim: Xinyan suspects the Iridescence Tour organizers tricked the group into this trip, a question left open.
threads.quote: canceling the Iridescence Tour after people already made the trip

threads.claim: Paimon senses the island is familiar, hinting at an earlier visit that is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Paimon: This island looks kinda familiar...

threads.claim: Venti's tale frames summer as a time for freedom and fun, a theme about freedom raised here.
threads.quote: Summer is the season of love. It is the time for freedom and fun.

introduced.name: Takatoshi
introduced.how: A townsperson who spreads the rumor of a wish ritual that grants wishes
introduced.quote: Takatoshi: Looks like you guys really aren't in the loop. This, my friends, is the next big thing. A highly effective wish ritual, guaranteed to make your wishes come true!

introduced.name: Kiyoto
introduced.how: A student worried about an exam who is skeptical of the wish ritual
introduced.quote: Kiyoto: But the exam's next week... If I fail again, I'm seriously done for. I'm better off wishing that my exam goes smoothly.

introduced.name: Shigeru
introduced.how: Junkichi's companion who doubts the ritual but goes along with it
introduced.quote: Shigeru: Junkichi is trying it out, to be specific. He's hit a bit of a creativity block recently, so I'm helping him make a wish so that he can move past it.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Described by Paimon as the expert on light novels and the supernatural who can be consulted at the shrine
introduced.quote: Paimon: She's the expert when it comes to both light novels and the supernatural!

introduced.name: Kuroda
introduced.how: A Yae Publishing House staffer who reports that the rival book is outselling them
introduced.quote: Kuroda: I'm here to report on Yae Publishing House's sales for the last month. All the numbers are here, please take a look.

introduced.name: Katou Youhei
introduced.how: Introduces himself and explains that his brother is in danger after a duel and a strange change
introduced.quote: Katou Youhei: Here's what happened. My name is Katou Youhei, and my brother is Katou Shingo.

introduced.name: Katou Shingo
introduced.how: Youhei's brother, who wanted to be a swordmaster, was turned away by Domon, then defeated a disciple and began acting strangely
introduced.quote: Katou Youhei: Here's what happened. My name is Katou Youhei, and my brother is Katou Shingo.

introduced.name: Urakusai
introduced.how: Revealed as a powerful Daiyouko youkai and friend of Miko who is the spirit behind the book
introduced.quote: Miko recognizes the spirit as Urakusai, a powerful Daiyouko youkai and a friend of hers.

introduced.name: Tomoyuki
introduced.how: The failed light novelist who wrote the spirit book while possessed
introduced.quote: Miko had managed to track down the author of the spirit book, Tomoyuki, a failed light novelist who had been possessed by a spirit.

introduced.name: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
introduced.how: A self-published novel containing incantations that people believe grant wishes and that spread through Inazuma
introduced.quote: Junkichi: No, it's most likely a self-published title. It just appeared out of nowhere and took Inazuma by storm.

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: Spirit beings who differ from humans in power and can fly themselves
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Human beings don't have powers like us youkai.

introduced.name: Oni
introduced.how: The type of spirit that possessed Shingo and gave him sword skills
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ah! Paimon's got it! It was an oni!

introduced.name: Mysterious wish ritual
introduced.how: A rumored midnight incantation ritual on the land that supposedly makes wishes come true
introduced.quote: Takatoshi: Heh, I didn't believe it at first, either. But that changed when it worked for someone I know.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publishing house that holds writers' submission events and whose chief editor is Yae Miko
introduced.quote: Nakano Shino: The Yae Publishing House has held many writers' submission events to date.

introduced.name: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
introduced.how: the hottest light novel in Inazuma, full of kaidan tales and incantations that seem real
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits" is the hottest light novel right now.

introduced.name: The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune
introduced.how: a newer light novel of incantations that readers are eager to try on a moonless night
introduced.quote: Kyouta: No one's talking about that anymore. "The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune" is the new hit thing.

introduced.name: Shigeru
introduced.how: an experienced editor who partners with the author Junkichi
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Shigeru is an experienced editor and Junkichi is the author he's partnered with.

introduced.name: Satomi
introduced.how: Yae Publishing House's ace who writes many different stories under secret pen names
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Satomi is Yae Publishing House's ace in the hole.

introduced.name: Ms. Hina
introduced.how: a popular writer of a Q&A column in That's Life magazine whom Inazumans adore
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: She runs a regular Q&A column in "That's Life" magazine.

introduced.name: Kuroda
introduced.how: a Yae Publishing House staffer who handles Ms. Hina's endorsement requests
introduced.quote: Kuroda: Ms. Hina doesn't usually do endorsements.

introduced.name: Uyuu Restaurant
introduced.how: the restaurant where Yae Miko assembles her team and works while eating
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: I'll be at Uyuu Restaurant — find me there when you're done.

introduced.name: Nakano Shino
introduced.how: the event staffer who explains the writers' submission event and its prizes
introduced.quote: Nakano Shino: The winner gets a huge amount of publicity. It's been the ticket to fame for a lot of authors!

introduced.name: Kyouta
introduced.how: a long-time light novel reader who likes big original fantasy works
introduced.quote: Kyouta: I've been reading light novels for long time now.

introduced.name: Oosuke
introduced.how: a reader who believes illustrations are the key to a successful light novel
introduced.quote: Oosuke: The key to a successful light novel is having good illustrations.

introduced.name: Tetsuo
introduced.how: a reader who enjoys fast, action-packed light novels for cheap thrills
introduced.quote: Tetsuo: I'll be honest. I read light novels for the cheap thrills.

introduced.name: Urakusai
introduced.how: the kitsune author of the book, now a memory that possesses bodies, and a former companion of Yae Miko
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Hehe, allow me to formally introduce the author of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," Urakusai.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: a source from which human and youkai memories leak, and where youkai memories wander
introduced.quote: Urakusai: Ah, spirits, memories... they're just different words to describe the same thing. Something that comes from the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: youkai memories
introduced.how: youkai memories outlast human ones in the world and can still shape themselves into visible forms
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Typically, youkai memories survive longer in the world than those of humans.

introduced.name: Hyakkiyakou
introduced.how: a youkai gathering where drunk youkai once flew into the sky and blocked out the moon
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: It might sound ominous, but to put it simply, the Hyakkiyakou is just a gathering of the youkai.

introduced.name: summoning ritual
introduced.how: a ritual that lets a dead spirit possess a living person's body
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Yes, the whole point of a summoning ritual is for a dead person's spirit to possess a living person's body.

introduced.name: Maki
introduced.how: a shrine maiden who evacuates the shrine on Lady Guuji's orders
introduced.quote: Maki: Lady Guuji's never allowed anyone else to be in her presence when she's conducted rituals like this in the past.

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: the origin of a fish found exclusively in its surrounding waters
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: You have to try this fish. It's found exclusively in the waters around Seirai Island.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Takatoshi: Come on, this is a no-brainer, man! There's only one thing worth wishing for — and that is a ton of Mora!

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Paimon: We haven't been to the Yae Publishing House in a while. Paimon wonders if they have any new books in? The one we read with Ei that time was pretty cool...

assumed.name: Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: Paimon: We haven't been to the Yae Publishing House in a while.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: Paimon then suggests to the Traveler they visit Miko at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

assumed.name: Mt. Yougou
assumed.quote: She also has them make sure that none of the monsters try to climb up Mt. Yougou as the concentrated youkai energy would likely rile them.

assumed.name: Rifthounds and Sacred Sakura
assumed.quote: Urakusai's memories were evoked as a result of the rifthounds gnawing away at the Sacred Sakura before;

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Hmm... Why don't you take a guess?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ohh, right! So maybe we can take inspiration from our time in Mondstadt and Liyue!

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ohh, right! So maybe we can take inspiration from our time in Mondstadt and Liyue!

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Paimon: "The strict Principal Raiden of the Inazuma Academy decided to confiscate all light novels."

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Traveler: "Took a Trip to Liyue, Tour Guide Turned Out to Be Rex Lapis"

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Alright, well... let's just hope Zhongli doesn't mind.

assumed.name: Geovishap Hatchling
assumed.quote: Paimon: "The protagonist awakes to find themselves turned into a Geovishap Hatchling surrounded by countless adventurers."

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Traveler: Paycheck... hmm, speaking of "Mora"...

assumed.name: Sacred Sakura
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Do you remember that recent incident when the rifthounds were gnawing at the Sacred Sakura's roots?

assumed.name: rifthounds
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Do you remember that recent incident when the rifthounds were gnawing at the Sacred Sakura's roots?

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: And even Ei is finally starting to come to her senses.

assumed.name: Hakushin
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: "Oh, Hakushin, cause of this enchantment"

assumed.name: oni samurai
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: You saw what happened to that oni samurai's spirit.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: When the time comes, they will gather in the sky above the Grand Narukami Shrine.

assumed.name: Inazuma City
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lights are coming from Inazuma City!

threads.claim: The question of who wrote the dangerous summoning book and why is raised, with a possible bigger safety risk.
threads.quote: Paimon: But who wrote this book, and why? Don't we think there might be a bigger safety risk here?

threads.claim: Urakusai, a youkai, possessed Tomoyuki and wrote the incantation so spirits could enjoy life and leave without regrets.
threads.quote: He had no malicious intentions with the book, as he had written the incantation so that other youkai spirits could enjoy life and leave without regrets,

threads.claim: A rumored midnight wish ritual is said to grant wishes, and people are sceptical but spreading it.
threads.quote: Takatoshi: Heh, I didn't believe it at first, either. But that changed when it worked for someone I know.

threads.claim: The ritual truly works, summoning spirits and granting wishes, though at a cost of possession.
threads.quote: Katou Youhei: Just like the book described, we drew the magic symbol, stepped inside it barefoot at midnight, said the incantation, and lo and behold — spheres of light appeared all around us!

threads.claim: Humans are said to be too weak to keep a summoned spirit for long, so possession is temporary.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Ugh, even then, humans only have so much strength. Even if they do successfully summon a spirit with the incantation, it won't stay with them for very long.

threads.claim: Miko explains that without intervention Shingo would have grown too weak to host the spirit, which would have left on its own.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Even if we'd done nothing at all, Shingo would have eventually become too weak for his body to host the spirit, and it would have left of its own accord.

threads.claim: Ei is hinted to be dead, and Miko suggests he would have fit into the current era had he lived.
threads.quote: Miko remarks on how she's always been content and that even Ei has changed, stating that he would fit in this era were he still alive.

threads.claim: Urakusai asks for a Hyakkiyakou ritual before he leaves, and Miko promises to perform it.
threads.quote: Urakusai wishes for himself and the others to do a "Hyakkiyakou" before they leave which Miko promises before they leave the Traveler's body.

threads.claim: Miko performs the Hyakkiyakou ritual at the shrine, sending the youkai memories off.
threads.quote: Returning to the Grand Narukami Shrine, the Traveler meets Miko who is about to start the ritual.

threads.claim: A moonless night is planted as an important future element that Paimon has forgotten.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Hehe, this is something that will become very important to us further down the line.

threads.claim: Miko confirms the moonless night is when the convocation ritual will take place.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: When my bell rings, it means the moonless night is upon us.

threads.claim: The moonless night arrives with a huge black cloud over Mt. Yougou, and the novel's wishes fail.
threads.quote: Tetsuo: Yeah, that huge black cloud over Mt. Yougou that night. It just seemed to form out of nowhere!

threads.claim: Youkai memories long to hold another Hyakkiyakou.
threads.quote: Urakusai: Everyone's quite content in many ways, but they still can't help but ask: "Are we ever going to have another Hyakkiyakou?"

threads.claim: Miko promises that arrangements are being made for another Hyakkiyakou.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Hehe, don't you worry about that, Urakusai. Arrangements are being made.

threads.claim: Recent rifthound attacks on the Sacred Sakura hint at strange leaking forces.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Do you remember that recent incident when the rifthounds were gnawing at the Sacred Sakura's roots?

threads.claim: Human memories leak from the Ley Lines, implying youkai memories leak too.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: You witnessed human memories leaking from the Ley Lines, didn't you? Well, since there are human memories, of course there are going to be youkai memories, too.

threads.claim: Youkai memories leaking from the Ley Lines are now weak and can no longer fly.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: But now, the youkai memories that leak from the Ley Lines are weak.

threads.claim: Paimon raises the open question of whether summoned possession has lasting negative consequences.
threads.quote: Paimon: Are we positive that summoning a spirit to possess isn't gonna have any lasting negative consequences?

threads.claim: The oni samurai's spirit could only hold its form briefly after leaving its host.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: You saw what happened to that oni samurai's spirit.

threads.claim: Traveler wakes from the possession with intact memory and no lasting harm.
threads.quote: Traveler: I remember everything pretty clearly.

threads.claim: Urakusai recalls Miko as a little girl hanging off his shoulders centuries ago.
threads.quote: Urakusai: Mmm... I remember when you were just a little girl, always hanging off my shoulders. A few hundred years later, and you're all grown up.

threads.claim: The author is revealed to be the youkai Urakusai, who really was a kitsune.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: Hehe, allow me to formally introduce the author of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," Urakusai.

threads.claim: Miko admits she feels lonely as the youkai memories depart.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: I can't help but feel a little lonely

threads.claim: Miko hints that Ei has been fixed in her thinking, which sets up a later conflict.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: And even Ei is finally starting to come to her senses.

threads.claim: Ei sends Miko a stern letter criticizing the convocation ritual as going too far.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: I know she can be pig-headed, but it still took me by surprise when she wrote me a long and sternly worded letter about it

threads.claim: The ritual chant invokes Hakushin as the cause of the enchantment.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: "Oh, Hakushin, cause of this enchantment"

introduced.name: Ayu
introduced.how: Ayu introduces himself as the boy searching for his lost father
introduced.quote: No, I'm not! Um, my name's Ayu, and I'm here because—

introduced.name: Jialiang
introduced.how: Ayu identifies Jialiang as his father, a forgetful man from west of Qingce Village
introduced.quote: Your name is Jialiang, and you live just west of Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Jiangli
introduced.how: Baizhu identifies Jiangli as Ayu's mother and an old acquaintance
introduced.quote: She was indeed. We studied medicine together under the same master near Chenyu Vale.

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: Baizhu introduces himself as the doctor of Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.quote: Baizhu, of Bubu Pharmacy. I do believe I've had the pleasure before.

introduced.name: Changsheng
introduced.how: Changsheng is a talking snake bound by contract to Baizhu's line of doctors, and is shown to be ancient
introduced.quote: These days, she has to enter a contract with a mortal and share their life force just to sustain her own life.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: Founded to fight the vengeful wrath of defeated gods, and tasked with burning remains
introduced.quote: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor was first founded to fight back against the vengeful wrath of gods defeated in war.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: A village built over a buried god's remains, founded after Rex Lapis sealed the Chi
introduced.quote: It is true that a god's remains are buried beneath the foundations of Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Chi
introduced.how: A vile serpent-like monster that once ravaged the land before being subdued
introduced.quote: A vile monster known as the Chi once wrought havoc over this land, before it was subdued by Rex Lapis

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Sealed the Chi's remains with statues in his likeness, cleansing the land
introduced.quote: The land was finally cleansed of poison when Rex Lapis used statues in his likeness to seal the serpent's remains.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: The place where Baizhu's master and great-uncle met a pharmacist and changed their lives
introduced.quote: They ended up at Chenyu Vale, where they met a pharmacist.

introduced.name: Baizhu's Master
introduced.how: Hu Tao's great-uncle, a former deputy director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who became a doctor
introduced.quote: Baizhu's master was my grandpa's younger brother, a former deputy director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

introduced.name: god remains
introduced.how: Dangerous to humans, who have no natural defense against them
introduced.quote: God remains are extremely dangerous to be around, because humans have no natural defense against them.

introduced.name: mother and minor lodes
introduced.how: Ancient poisons where minor lodes are offshoots controlled by a mother lode that can be purged
introduced.quote: This ancient class of poisons consists of

introduced.name: Changsheng's contract
introduced.how: Doctors in Baizhu's line sign a contract with Changsheng to use her secret art to treat patients
introduced.quote: My predecessors in medicine forged a contract with Changsheng. Every successor to this contract is able to use Changsheng's secret art to treat patients.

introduced.name: congenital heart condition
introduced.how: Jialiang's rare heart illness requires ongoing treatment, and the poison was in fact his medication
introduced.quote: Jialiang has a rare congenital heart condition, and ongoing treatment is essential to maintaining healthy functioning of his heart meridian.

introduced.name: Changsheng
introduced.how: Revealed as a white snake whose power is nearly spent, the source of the contract's secret art.
introduced.quote: But found only a white snake, its breathing weak and its power all but spent

introduced.name: Baizhu's Master
introduced.how: Explained as the past doctor who inherited the contract and first pledged to end plagues.
introduced.quote: Long ago, when plagues ravaged the land

introduced.name: Changsheng's contract
introduced.how: Explained that the contract lets life force and toxins pass between bodies, and that hosts die young.
introduced.quote: Besides life force, Changsheng's secret art also allows for the transfer of toxins and diseases

introduced.name: Elixir of Immortality
introduced.how: Explained as a crude poison-based imitation of adeptus art that holds a dying person between life and death.
introduced.quote: Of course, this is but a crude imitation of an adeptus art

introduced.name: God remains
introduced.how: Explained as corrupting remains whose destruction would end the poison that keeps Jialiang alive.
introduced.quote: The poison within Jialiang's body is inextricably linked to the god remains here

introduced.name: Jiangli's poison
introduced.how: Shown as the poison Jiangli made to hold back Jialiang's heart condition.
introduced.quote: I told Jiangli to give me the poison

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: Named as the home of the Herblord legend and of the healers who follow the contract.
introduced.quote: Legends told of an Herblord in Chenyu Vale

introduced.name: Herblord
introduced.how: Explained as a legendary healer who could cure any illness known to mankind.
introduced.quote: Who could cure any illness known to mankind

introduced.name: Mother lode
introduced.how: Hinted as a source whose influence pulls Jialiang and leaks Chi blood; Baizhu destroys it at the end.
introduced.quote: The mother lode's influence is growing stronger

introduced.name: Monster-repelling incense
introduced.how: Explained that the censer burned repelling incense days before the group arrived.
introduced.quote: I believe this censer was used to burn a monster-repelling incense

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Gui, Qiqi, are there any pressing matters in the pharmacy at the moment?

assumed.name: Herbalist Gui
assumed.quote: Herbalist Gui: Qiqi and I need to clear up the shop front first, but once that's taken care of, we'll be right out to help you with the search!

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: ...Ugh. My worst nightmare.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Xiao: Our paths have crossed once before.

assumed.name: Millelith guards
assumed.quote: I asked the Millelith guys to go find him, but he said they won't be able to send that many people.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Mr. Gui, I wanna go to the Adventurers' Guild and get them to help look for my mom.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: I remembered that the owner of Bubu Pharmacy always runs a clinic in Qingce Village during the Lantern Rite.

assumed.name: adepti
assumed.quote: Didn't you use to be on good terms with the adepti, though?

assumed.name: Jialiang
assumed.quote: It's just like the day I went missing...

assumed.name: Jiangli
assumed.quote: Jiangli is still waiting for me...

assumed.name: Ayu
assumed.quote: Dad! Are you awake?

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: All I wanted was to help Jialiang find his missing wife as soon as possible

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Before we set off, I asked Qiqi to prepare an

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: From the looks of it, you've already tracked down the location of the source?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Maybe it was the Treasure Hoarders that dug this tunnel?

assumed.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
assumed.quote: If I'd known this was coming, I'd have whisked him off to the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor

assumed.name: Chi blood
assumed.quote: because the leakage of Chi blood is growing more severe

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: a great blessing from Rex Lapis

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: he even got the Adventurers' Guild to search for you

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: He took me all the way to Liyue Harbor to see the doctor

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: We're going to Natlan!

assumed.name: Herbalist Gui
assumed.quote: Qiqi, Gui, and all the friends who have grown fond of you

assumed.name: Mt. Yaojun
assumed.quote: I suppose I'd spend my final moments taking a nice nap on Mt. Yaojun

threads.claim: Jiangli has gone missing after leaving to gather herbs, and her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: She went out a few days ago to gather some herbs for my dad, but she still hasn't come back...

threads.claim: The search for the missing Jiangli is taken on as a goal alongside the cure.
threads.quote: As well as investigating Jialiang's exposure to the poison, we should also keep an eye out for Ayu's missing mother... my fellow disciple, Jiangli.

threads.claim: Someone with the skill to make a poison from god remains is behind the poisoning, and Jiangli is the suspect.
threads.quote: Look at the facts, though. How many people in the entirety of Liyue have the ability to concoct a poison from god remains?

threads.claim: The poison was in fact Jialiang's medication for his heart condition, made by Jiangli to keep him alive.
threads.quote: Though it was created from god remains, this formula is not a poison in Jialiang's case. Rather, it's his medication.

threads.claim: A god's remains, the Chi, lie buried under Qingce Village and may be leaking.
threads.quote: It is true that a god's remains are buried beneath the foundations of Qingce Village.

threads.claim: The leaking god remains must come from a cave beneath the village, which the group needs to find.
threads.quote: If the god remains are leaking from underground, Jiangli must be paying a visit to a subterranean cave

threads.claim: Baizhu is hiding something from Hu Tao and others about his methods.
threads.quote: But even that says to me that he definitely has something to hide.

threads.claim: Baizhu did not cure Jialiang but transferred his own life force to hold the poison back.
threads.quote: Instead, he transferred some of his own life force to his patient to temporarily subdue the poison in his system.

threads.claim: Baizhu is obsessed with immortality, and his reasons for it are unclear.
threads.quote: One thing I do know about Baizhu is that he's obsessed with the idea of immortality

threads.claim: Xiao warns that immortality may not be the blessing Baizhu imagines it to be.
threads.quote: ...Immortality may not be the blessing that you imagine it to be.

threads.claim: Baizhu's late master wished him to save Jialiang, a patient tied to the master's past.
threads.quote: Besides... it was my late master's dying wish to be able to save this patient in particular.

threads.claim: Baizhu's master told him to help Jiangli's family, but never explained the quarrel behind it.
threads.quote: Nor did Master ever explain it to me. All he would say is that, should I ever encounter Jiangli or her family in the future... I should do everything in my power to help them.

threads.claim: Jialiang suffers memory loss, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Wait, why do I need to see the doctor...?

threads.claim: Jialiang's memory loss is explained as the poison accumulating and affecting his cognition.
threads.quote: As time passed, and the poison accumulated in his system, it began to impact his cognition.

threads.claim: Changsheng's contract imposes strict requirements on hosts, and none have ever been exempted.
threads.quote: None of her hosts have ever been exempted from these rules.

threads.claim: Changsheng's contract is passed down to each successor of Baizhu's line.
threads.quote: My predecessors in medicine forged a contract with Changsheng. Every successor to this contract is able to use Changsheng's secret art to treat patients.

threads.claim: Qiqi is hiding from someone who is still around, and her hiding is unexplained.
threads.quote: Phew... she's finally gone.

threads.claim: Hu Tao suspects Baizhu has hidden Qiqi away from her.
threads.quote: Aha! What if... Baizhu knew I'd be on the lookout for her, and hid her away in advance?

threads.claim: Changsheng suggests that many others have sacrificed themselves for others, and calls it the course of fate.
threads.quote: Perhaps this is the inevitable course of fate...

threads.claim: Baizhu wonders whether the mother lode's growing influence comes from the source or from worsening Chi blood leakage.
threads.quote: But is it because we're getting closer to the source, or because the leakage of Chi blood is growing more severe?

threads.claim: Jialiang feels an inner pull guiding him toward the source, suggesting a hidden link to the source.
threads.quote: It's as if something inside me is trying to guide me somewhere...

threads.claim: Jialiang cannot recall what Jiangli told him about the cave's method, leaving the cost of the cure unexplained.
threads.quote: why can't I remember what she said?

threads.claim: The Traveler finds the censer is not the Treasure Hoarders' work, hinting someone else was in the cave.
threads.quote: I don't think this was left here by the Treasure Hoarders.

threads.claim: The censer belongs to Jiangli, showing she once brought Jialiang to this cave to obtain the poison.
threads.quote: This censer — it belongs to Jiangli! Yes, this was the place!

threads.claim: The poison keeping Jialiang alive is tied to the god remains, so purging the remains ends his life.
threads.quote: If the source is purged, the poison in his system will stop having any effect.

threads.claim: Every mortal bound to Changsheng's contract has died young, a cost the contract imposes on its hosts.
threads.quote: Every single mortal I've ever contracted with, including Baizhu and Jiangli's Master, has passed away at a young age.

threads.claim: Baizhu's irises change to yellow with vertical pupils, hinting that Changsheng's nature is passing into him.
threads.quote: (Baizhu opens his eyes to reveal that his irises have changed from red to yellow with vertical pupils)

threads.claim: Baizhu vows to become Changsheng's final host so the contract ends with him.
threads.quote: This contract... will end with me

threads.claim: The Herblord legend is revealed to be Changsheng, a white snake whose power is nearly spent.
threads.quote: But found only a white snake, its breathing weak and its power all but spent

threads.claim: Baizhu's Master leaves unanswered whether the contract is medicine or poison.
threads.quote: What is this contract to us? Medicine, or poison?

threads.claim: Baizhu argues that disease and poison are both mechanisms of the body, blurring the line between them.
threads.quote: When it comes down to it, are not both mechanisms that affect the operations of the human body?

threads.claim: Baizhu suggests the true Elixir of Immortality might be a kind of poison, reframing illness as deviation from normal function.
threads.quote: perhaps the true Elixir of Immortality could in fact be a kind of poison?

threads.claim: Xiao has been guarding the evil presence and warns the Traveler to act quickly before he intervenes.
threads.quote: I cannot simply look the other way when evil spirits are involved.

introduced.name: Ilyas
introduced.how: introduces himself as a scholar who was kidnapped and urgently needs to speak to a matra
introduced.quote: Ilyas: I'm Ilyas. I have to talk to a matra about something important...

introduced.name: Siraj
introduced.how: a renowned Vahumana researcher rumored to be a future sage, who kidnapped Ilyas for experiments
introduced.quote: Aarav: Siraj? That name sounds familiar. Isn't he a Vahumana researcher?

introduced.name: Aarav
introduced.how: a matra investigator who runs the lie detector test and leads the investigation
introduced.quote: Aarav: Let me bring you up to speed. First things first, Ilyas passed the lie detector test.

introduced.name: Narendra
introduced.how: a Kshahrewar researcher who sold lab components that Siraj wanted
introduced.quote: Aarav: No, it's the Kshahrewar researcher who has dealings with him. His name is Narendra.

introduced.name: Janaki
introduced.how: a researcher who turned down Siraj's invitation and is angry at Ilyas
introduced.quote: Janaki: Siraj did extend an invitation to me, and I was also interested in his project.

introduced.name: Chandra
introduced.how: an Akademiya researcher who explains why people have stopped starting new research
introduced.quote: Chandra: Well, with the downfall of the sages not long ago, many of the projects that they led were put on hold while they were being investigated.

introduced.name: Makesh
introduced.how: an Akademiya staff member who handles research expenses and paychecks
introduced.quote: Makesh: Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham, I've sent this period's research expenses report to your office.

introduced.name: Izebel
introduced.how: a member of Ilyas's family in Gandharva Ville who calms the others down
introduced.quote: Izebel: Hey, hey, that's enough, you two. Ilyas isn't feeling well.

introduced.name: Azar
introduced.how: a former sage who was one of the thesis advisers and has been removed from office
introduced.quote: Rancho: Well, Azar was one of your thesis advisers

introduced.name: Acting Grand Sage
introduced.how: a temporary top Akademiya post filled while new sages are being chosen
introduced.quote: Rancho: Acting Grand Sage? That sounds like a new thing.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: a system that answered researchers' knowledge requests, and it has now shut down
introduced.quote: Chandra: Well... because the Akasha Terminal shut down.

introduced.name: Six cardinal sins
introduced.how: six forbidden acts, including touching on human evolution, that guide Akademiya rules
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: From violating matters regarding human evolution to attempting the forbidden and fearing none, the six cardinal sins are the origin of all evil in this world.

introduced.name: Collective consciousness
introduced.how: Siraj's plan to merge many minds into one organization-like being to drive human evolution
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Siraj believed that by achieving three objectives, he could create a collective consciousness in human society and drive humans toward their ultimate evolution.

introduced.name: Overmind
introduced.how: the top-ranked member who divides tasks among the collective in Siraj's plan
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: This Overmind would then divide tasks into numerous modules and delegate them to the collective's members, based on their assigned number.

introduced.name: Lambad's Tavern
introduced.how: a tavern where Siraj's trade with Narendra was planned
introduced.quote: Ilyas: Oh, I heard they conduct business in the tavern. We have to hurry...

introduced.name: Research Preparation Center
introduced.how: an Akademiya office where Ilyas worked part-time and got his monthly paycheck
introduced.quote: Ilyas: Now, I do remember that I worked part-time at a place in the Akademiya called the Research Preparation Center.

introduced.name: Gandharva Ville
introduced.how: the home town of Ilyas's family, where he sends his earnings
introduced.quote: Ilyas: The first is to get my paycheck from the Akademiya and give it to my younger sister in Gandharva Ville.

introduced.name: Siraj's cave
introduced.how: the hidden lab where Siraj kidnapped and experimented on Ilyas
introduced.quote: Ilyas: He kidnapped me, tied me up, and took me to that horrible cave... Experimental equipment everywhere...

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: a scholarly group whose researchers are among the most renowned
introduced.quote: Aarav: Yes, one of their most renowned, in fact. I hear he's as daring as he is intelligent.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: the investigators Ilyas trusts to handle serious crimes, separate from the sages
introduced.quote: Ilyas: No. I have to tell them myself. They are the only ones I can trust...

introduced.name: Raju's death after Ilyas's report
introduced.how: Raju jumped to his death after Ilyas reported Jani, which angered Janaki and Jaap
introduced.quote: They then get another vision where Raju jumped to his death as a result of Ilyas reporting Jani, which in turn angered Janaki and Jaap as their studies were at risk.

introduced.name: Siraj
introduced.how: Introduces himself as the researcher behind the Hive who offers Ilyas a way to merge into a collective
introduced.quote: Ah, where are my manners? My name is Siraj.

introduced.name: Jani
introduced.how: Is explained as a researcher who steals and takes credit for Raju's project research through academic fraud
introduced.quote: Everyone knows that Jani is stealing your research.

introduced.name: Raju
introduced.how: Is explained as a researcher whose thesis Jani used and who later jumped to his death
introduced.quote: Are you saying you don't care that Raju jumped to his death!?

introduced.name: Hive
introduced.how: Is explained as a collective consciousness that links members into a single mind for shared work
introduced.quote: The collective consciousness links all of us into a single mind, showcasing our individual strengths as we work together.

introduced.name: Overmind
introduced.how: Is explained as the leader role of the collective who directs its members and their emotions
introduced.quote: That's why you, as the Overmind, synchronized your hatred of me into the collective, prompting them to create and execute a plan to eliminate me.

introduced.name: Hive numbering system
introduced.how: Learns that members are assigned numbers and given tasks in the experiment
introduced.quote: I assigned numbers to everyone and divided the experiment's tasks amongst themselves.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: Learns Akasha Terminals were modified to let users share memories and emotions, which enabled the collective
introduced.quote: I modified Akasha Terminals to allow users to share memories and emotions.

introduced.name: Alhaitham's Home
introduced.how: Is shown as Alhaitham's home, which Kaveh also lives in
introduced.quote: (Enter Alhaitham's Home)

introduced.name: Kaveh
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Alhaitham's housemate and asks the group to keep his living arrangement secret
introduced.quote: My name is Kaveh.

introduced.name: Akademiya ban on human evolution research
introduced.how: Learns the Akademiya prohibits research into human evolution, which Siraj's thesis was about
introduced.quote: The first, as I've already said, was that his research was on human evolution, a subject prohibited by the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Alhaitham's resignation as Acting Grand Sage
introduced.how: Learns Alhaitham has already submitted his resignation and will return to being a scribe
introduced.quote: Yes. I've already submitted my resignation to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Ilyas's memory deletion
introduced.how: Learns Ilyas chose to delete his memories of being Siraj Number 36 to build a convincing disguise
introduced.quote: I... chose to delete those memories.

introduced.name: Karwan, Goli, and Pouyan
introduced.how: Are revealed as Akademiya researchers who were test subjects duped into the Hive plot and then apologize
introduced.quote: Karwan: Oh no, oh no... I was involved in all these plans to get rid of the Acting Grand Sage?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Paimon: Y'know, Paimon's heard that Alhaitham's been made Acting Grand Sage, but with that personality of his... hoo boy.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh wait, Cyno should be back at the Akademiya! Let's go find him!

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Rancho, optional)

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why don't we go to the Akademiya and ask around?

assumed.name: Aaru Village
assumed.quote: Paimon: He's the same as ever... Casually ignoring people, just like he did back at Aaru Village!

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Inside, they also find Kaveh, who is surprised and embarrassed to see guests.

assumed.name: Jani
assumed.quote: As they head deeper inside, they get a vision of Ilyas' past, where he was asking Raju why he wouldn't report Jani.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Paimon: Cyno! What are you doing here?

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Cyno, optional)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: all for a measly 20,000 Mora?

assumed.name: Matra
assumed.quote: Because of your recklessness, the matra are putting Jani on trial.

assumed.name: Grand Sage
assumed.quote: A year ago, Siraj presented his thesis to the Grand Sage, who offhandedly asked for my opinion.

assumed.name: Fall of the sages
assumed.quote: The fall of the sages and the shutdown of the Akasha Terminals deeply affected the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: It was only at Gandharva Ville that the second thing I must do occurred to me: Bring you all here.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: There are researchers at the Akademiya who engage in dangerous research in extreme environments, while others become idle and listless.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: There's no need for that. Let's keep moving.

assumed.name: House of Daena
assumed.quote: (There's dust on the bookshelves. I should tidy them up sometime and bring any unused books to the House of Daena.)

assumed.name: Jnana Energy
assumed.quote: It is meaningless to judge individuals based solely on their Jnana Energy

threads.claim: Siraj's collective consciousness project is introduced as a dangerous plan to merge many minds.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: Siraj believed that by achieving three objectives, he could create a collective consciousness in human society and drive humans toward their ultimate evolution.

threads.claim: The collective turns against Siraj and the system collapses, ending his hivemind project.
threads.quote: Defeating the monsters, the collective begins to question Siraj to the point that the system completely collapses.

threads.claim: Ilyas has lost most of his memories of the kidnapping and of his past.
threads.quote: Ilyas: All I remember is Siraj walking towards me, and then my head started feeling... weird.

threads.claim: Alhaitham says the sealed memories can be restored with the right stimulus.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: However, these memories aren't truly lost, but merely sealed away. They can be restored with the appropriate stimulus.

threads.claim: Ilyas recovers his memories, including where Siraj's cave is.
threads.quote: Ilyas: Ah... I see. I remember now. Don't worry, I remember now.

threads.claim: Visions reveal that Ilyas's report led to Raju's death and angered Janaki and Jaap.
threads.quote: They then get another vision where Raju jumped to his death as a result of Ilyas reporting Jani, which in turn angered Janaki and Jaap as their studies were at risk.

threads.claim: Ilyas has a second task he cannot remember, and it stays unresolved in this unit.
threads.quote: Ilyas: ...I can't remember. Sorry, there's just so much I can't recall...

threads.claim: Ilyas's assigned number 36 may not match his real talent, which suggests Siraj's ranking was flawed.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: You were only designated as number 36? What a shame. From what I can see, your talents merit a smaller number.

threads.claim: Siraj ranked people using Jnana Energy records the sages had extracted through the Akasha.
threads.quote: Janaki: They left a document that records the amount of Jnana Energy that the Akasha had extracted from each person.

threads.claim: Alhaitham's appointment as Acting Grand Sage is controversial among scholars.
threads.quote: Rajkumar: They're really out of their minds, making Alhaitham the Acting Grand Sage...

threads.claim: Alhaitham resigns from the Acting Grand Sage post to return to his original duties.
threads.quote: he submitted his resignation paper for that role as he wanted to return to his original duties.

threads.claim: The Akasha Terminal shut down, leaving researchers unwilling to do manual work.
threads.quote: Chandra: Well... because the Akasha Terminal shut down.

threads.claim: Siraj's thesis was rejected for touching on human evolution, one of the cardinal sins.
threads.quote: Alhaitham rejected the paper as it touched human evolution, one of the cardinal sins in the Akademiya.

threads.claim: A mysterious shadow is said to wander Pardis Dhyai at night, though the case was closed.
threads.quote: There are witnesses that say that there is a mysterious shadow wandering around Pardis Dhyai at night.

threads.claim: A rumor says a student can write the Heaven-Sent Thesis, and the case is still under investigation.
threads.quote: Recently, there is a new rumor that a student has the ability to write'the Heaven-Sent Thesis.'

threads.claim: Ilyas feels a strange sense of freedom from losing his memories.
threads.quote: Ilyas: But amidst all that... It also feels like I've been set free, somehow...

threads.claim: Ilyas feels an unexplained familiarity with Alhaitham, although they have never met.
threads.quote: Ilyas: Well, for some reason, I felt a sense of familiarity when I met you for the first time.

threads.claim: Ilyas admits the feeling was really loathing, and he now finds Alhaitham less disliked than he expected.
threads.quote: Ilyas: I said there was a sense of familiarity, but what I really meant was a sense of loathing.

threads.claim: The Hive is claimed to be finished long ago, contradicting Ilyas's story that it was still incomplete.
threads.quote: It's clear that this place isn't a work in progress. The Hive has long been finished.

threads.claim: The Hive shuts down when Alhaitham's sword destroys its terminal, ending the collective.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Hive... shut down?

threads.claim: Setbacks and doubt weaken the Overmind's authority, and Alhaitham explains the collective's negative emotions can spread through it.
threads.quote: Setbacks in the plan further amplify doubt, which diminishes the Overmind's influence.

threads.claim: Ilyas says only the Hive lets him be free, framing the collective as a refuge from social pressure.
threads.quote: Only here can I truly be free.

threads.claim: Ilyas concludes the collective he tried to fit into was less powerful than he thought, and hopes to stop caring what others think.
threads.quote: wasn't as powerful as I had imagined.

threads.claim: Kaveh and Alhaitham were once friends but no longer are, and the reason is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Okay, well, we used to be. But we're not anymore.

threads.claim: Alhaitham plans to resign as Acting Grand Sage and return to being a scribe once the official sage selection begins.
threads.quote: Yes. I've already submitted my resignation to the Akademiya.

threads.claim: Siraj is taken away to stand trial at the Akademiya, and his associates are arrested.
threads.quote: (Siraj walks off with Aarav)

threads.claim: Monsters have been integrated into the collective, and the player senses something unnatural about them.
threads.quote: Paimon: And, something feels off about them...

threads.claim: Alhaitham secretly left symbols and a letter to Cyno, hinting at a prearranged plan.
threads.quote: I left a simple picture in my letter to him, and I made several similar symbols on the way here.

threads.claim: Alhaitham reveals he knew from the start that Ilyas was bait to destabilize the Hive.
threads.quote: I knew it from the moment I saw him.

threads.claim: The fall of the sages and the shutdown of the Akasha Terminals have shaken the Akademiya, with the causes left open.
threads.quote: The fall of the sages and the shutdown of the Akasha Terminals deeply affected the Akademiya.

threads.claim: Jani's academic fraud is moving toward a trial with the matra, and the consequences for Raju's project remain uncertain.
threads.quote: Because of your recklessness, the matra are putting Jani on trial.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: Captain of the Crux Fleet who sends for the Traveler and carries them to Inazuma
introduced.quote: Captain Beidou sent me to come get you. We'll weigh anchor as soon as you're aboard.

introduced.name: Crux Fleet
introduced.how: Fleet that has never been delayed in years of sailing, led by Beidou
introduced.quote: Beidou: All these years, come rain or storm, the Crux Fleet has never suffered a delay. If it were anyone else, I might've set sail already.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: A storm-wracked nation that the Traveler sails toward
introduced.quote: Beidou: We set sail for the land engulfed by storm and tempest... The nation of "eternity"!

introduced.name: Thoma
introduced.how: Beidou's trade partner and Ritou's fixer who helps the Traveler
introduced.quote: Beidou: Now then, let me introduce everyone. This is Thoma, a trade partner that I've gotten to know recently.

introduced.name: Kazuha
introduced.how: A wanted fugitive who is hidden on board Beidou's ship
introduced.quote: The Captain leaves the pair to his care since she can't stay around for too long with Kazuha on board, who is still a wanted fugitive.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: Law closing Inazuma to the outside world, with outlanders barred from leaving
introduced.quote: Thoma: Haha, don't underestimate the reaches of the Sakoku Decree. You wouldn't be able to avoid inspection even if you tried.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: An island where outlanders are kept and have their own settlement
introduced.quote: Thoma: Not even on Ritou, where they've established an Outsider Settlement.

introduced.name: Outlander Affairs Agency
introduced.how: Office on Ritou that checks entry and handles residency for outlanders
introduced.quote: Thoma: They only check entry permits here. If you want to remain on Ritou, there's a process you have to go through with them.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: Ritou's administration that makes the local rules and taxes
introduced.quote: Thoma: Most of the current rules were put in place by the administration of Ritou — the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Tri-Commission
introduced.how: Three branches governing Inazuma, with Kanjou handling the nation's wealth
introduced.quote: Thoma: Yes, one branch of the Tri-Commission of Inazuma. Responsible for growing and managing the nation's wealth. Um... you really haven't heard of it before?

introduced.name: International Trade Association
introduced.how: Association of outlander merchants formed to survive on Ritou
introduced.quote: Thoma: Yep, and as well as advancing commercial interests, the association provides help, support, and structure for outlanders trying to survive on Ritou.

introduced.name: Kurisu
introduced.how: President of the International Trade Association and Thoma's friend
introduced.quote: Thoma: The head of the association is called Kurisu, and he's a good friend of mine. Go talk to him, I'll wait for you here.

introduced.name: Werner
introduced.how: Mondstadt-born former association member who now sells Crystal Marrow
introduced.quote: Thoma: That's right, Werner was born in Mondstadt, then went into the shipping business, trading between Liyue and Inazuma.

introduced.name: Keijirou
introduced.how: Tax-collection ashigaru who runs the Crystal Marrow scheme
introduced.quote: Werner: It's a scheme by the tax-collection ashigaru. Keijirou and his companions.

introduced.name: Harrison
introduced.how: Outlander shopkeeper furious at the tax injustice
introduced.quote: Harrison: So that's it!? My shop's been closed for weeks now — I've even had to ask my friends to help bail me out! What about my losses!?

introduced.name: Katsuie
introduced.how: The Chief who orders the merchants seized
introduced.quote: Keijirou: Ah, Chief. You've arrived.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Branch of the Tri-Commission that manages ceremonial and cultural affairs
introduced.quote: Thoma: Correct. The Kamisato Clan is the head of the Yashiro Commission, who manage ceremonial and cultural affairs.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: Clan that heads the Yashiro Commission and employs Thoma
introduced.quote: Thoma: I belong to the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission on Narukami Island. I'm an attendant of the Shirasagi Himegimi.

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: Island where the Kamisato Clan and Yashiro Commission are based
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Hehe, well if that's how you feel, why not come and find me when you arrive? I'll be awaiting you on Narukami Island.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: Current head of the Kamisato Clan and Ayaka's older brother
introduced.quote: Thoma: Her fame even somewhat eclipses that of her older brother, Kamisato Ayato, despite the fact that he is the current head of the clan.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: Decree by the Raiden Shogun that seizes people's Visions
introduced.quote: Ayaka has heard of their feats and is expecting their arrival, hoping that they can change the tides — the Vision Hunt Decree.

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun
introduced.how: Inazuma's most revered deity who reigns on high
introduced.quote: Thoma: After all, the Raiden Shogun is the most exalted and revered one in all of Inazuma. She is a deity who reigns on high, while all other life gazes up in awe.

introduced.name: Statue of the Omnipresent God
introduced.how: Statue under construction whose embedded gems are seized Visions
introduced.quote: There, Thoma explains about how the Raiden Shogun declared the Vision Hunt Decree and that the "gems" embedded on the statue are the seized Visions.

introduced.name: Konda Village
introduced.how: Village where the old couple and Tejima live
introduced.quote: At the first location, Konda Village, the Traveler finds an old couple, Mahiru and Kenjirou trying to persuade a younger man Tejima not to leave.

introduced.name: Tejima
introduced.how: Former samurai who became Visionless and wanted to leave the village
introduced.quote: Inquiring the man, Tejima was a samurai who become Visionless.

introduced.name: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
introduced.how: Samurai who lost his Vision and is accused of withholding rations
introduced.quote: Two men are accusing a samurai, Kurosawa Kyounosuke, of withholding emergency rations from them.

introduced.name: Tadao
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarder leader who tries to recruit the Traveler
introduced.quote: After beating them up, Tadao tries to recruit them, but the Traveler refuses and inquires about Kurosawa.

introduced.name: Aoi
introduced.how: Owner of Tsukumomono Groceries who was owed Kurosawa's debts
introduced.quote: Opening the box, they are surprised to find that it only contains IOUs, all addressed to a Miss Aoi of Tsukumomono Groceries, and the Hoarder gang leaves.

introduced.name: Domon
introduced.how: Swordmaster of the Meikyou Shisui Art who seems possessed after losing his Vision
introduced.quote: Their sensei, Domon, is believed to be possessed and is recovering, explaining his history and that he took a turn for the worse when his Vision was taken.

introduced.name: Meikyou Shisui Art
introduced.how: Swordsmanship art that Domon is known for
introduced.quote: a swordmaster known for the Meikyou Shisui Art who is also in the city.

introduced.name: Anzai
introduced.how: Domon's oldest former disciple who passed on his aspirations
introduced.quote: He reveals himself to be Anzai, the oldest disciple of his sensei in the art until Domon surpassed both him and their master.

introduced.name: Lady Yae
introduced.how: Expert who examines Domon and finds he is not possessed
introduced.quote: Yae inspects Domon and states that he is not possessed, much to the disciples' surprise.

introduced.name: Masakatsu
introduced.how: Craftsman who made fake Visions and was arrested by the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: One of their operations, creating fake Visions, was halted when the craftsman responsible for making them, Master Masakatsu, had been arrested.

introduced.name: Yoimiya
introduced.how: Famous fireworks maker who evaded having her Vision taken
introduced.quote: The woman, Yoimiya, is known throughout Inazuma for her fireworks

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission official who reprimands guards and spares Masakatsu
