introduced.quote: Sara then spots them in the act but allows them to leave as Masakatsu needs urgent care, but warns the craftsman that she'll bring him back in when he's recovered.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
introduced.how: The Kanjou Commissioner on Ritou who sets the travel permit conditions
introduced.quote: Paimon suggests they head to the Kanjou office to meet with the Commissioner, Hiiragi Shinsuke.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Chisato
introduced.how: Hiiragi's daughter who secretly helps the Traveler leave Ritou
introduced.quote: Chisato asks them to deliver a letter to Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission official who can grant the travel permit
introduced.quote: Chisato asks them to deliver a letter to Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission

introduced.name: Komore Teahouse
introduced.how: Teahouse on Narukami Island where Thoma says to meet him
introduced.quote: When you get to Narukami Island, you can find me at Komore Teahouse, as per the letter.

introduced.name: Thoma's test
introduced.how: A staged test by Thoma to see if the Traveler can change the situation
introduced.quote: Thoma apologizes for the test, as it was necessary, if they can "change the lightning."

introduced.name: Kobayashi
introduced.how: Ritou checkpoint guard who turns away travelers without Travel Permits
introduced.quote: Kobayashi: Stop there! Present your Travel Permits!

introduced.name: Travel Permit
introduced.how: required pass to continue past checkpoints; without one you go no further
introduced.quote: Kobayashi: If you don't have a Travel Permit, this is as far as you'll get. Those are the rules.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: island under Hiiragi control that travelers cannot leave while in Inazuma
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: To be perfectly honest... as long as you remain in Inazuma, my father will have no intention of letting you leave Ritou.

introduced.name: Yokoyama
introduced.how: guard at the Kanjou Commissioner's Office entrance who usually refuses outlanders
introduced.quote: Yokoyama: Halt! This is the Kanjou Commissioner's Office. No trespassers!

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: office led by the Kanjou Commissioner that rarely receives outlanders
introduced.quote: Yokoyama: The Kanjou Commissioner seldom entertains outlanders. Leave, now or we'll be forced to—

introduced.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
introduced.how: Kanjou Commissioner and head of the Hiiragi Clan who gives the Travelers errands
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: I am Hiiragi Shinsuke, Kanjou Commissioner and head of the Hiiragi Clan. It's an honor to meet you both.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Clan
introduced.how: noble family on Ritou led by Shinsuke
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: I am Hiiragi Shinsuke, Kanjou Commissioner and head of the Hiiragi Clan. It's an honor to meet you both.

introduced.name: Qingxin
introduced.how: mountaintop flower in Liyue that goes stale once picked
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: You must know the Qingxin? A flower, grows on the mountaintops in Liyue.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Chisato
introduced.how: Shinsuke's daughter who secretly asks the Travelers to carry a letter
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Ah, you've finally arrived... Allow me to introduce myself, I am Hiiragi Chisato.

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission member who is the recipient of Chisato's letter and the man she loves
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: I was hoping that you could deliver a letter to Narukami Island in my stead. It is to be given to Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: island where the Tenryou Commission, Kamisato residence and statue are
introduced.quote: It's still under construction now, but you can already see it from practically anywhere on Narukami Island.

introduced.name: Shinnojou
introduced.how: Hiiragi escort samurai who obeys Chisato
introduced.quote: Shinnojou: My lady! This is an unexpected honor.

introduced.name: Kenzaburou
introduced.how: Hiiragi escort samurai who doubts Chisato's plan to join the shipment
introduced.quote: Kenzaburou: Is there something wrong, Lady Hiiragi?

introduced.name: Kozue
introduced.how: Komore Teahouse host who checks Invitation Letters
introduced.quote: Kozue: Sorry, we don't serve the general public. I'm afraid you'll have to leave.

introduced.name: Komore Teahouse
introduced.how: hidden teahouse that serves as a safe haven for the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: Kozue: In which case, welcome to the Komore Teahouse, a safe haven for the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: commission that serves the shogun but stays close to the people
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Though the Yashiro Commission serves the shogun, it is the people with whom we share close bonds,

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: Shirasagi Himegimi, daughter of the Yashiro Commission, who sets the three wishes
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: I will introduce you to the Raiden Shogun, on one condition... You must fulfill three small wishes on my behalf.

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun
introduced.how: ruler and deity of Inazuma with an endless will to rule
introduced.quote: Thoma: The Raiden Shogun is both the nation's most powerful ruler, and its deity.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: known as the Nation of Eternity
introduced.quote: Thoma: As for Inazuma... It's known as the Nation of Eternity.

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: known as the City of Freedom
introduced.quote: Before I try to explain, I should perhaps remind you first that Mondstadt is the City of Freedom, and Liyue is the City of Contracts...

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: known as the City of Contracts
introduced.quote: Before I try to explain, I should perhaps remind you first that Mondstadt is the City of Freedom, and Liyue is the City of Contracts...

introduced.name: Tri-Commission
introduced.how: body the shogun relies on to regulate the nation's affairs
introduced.quote: Thoma: As such, she relies on the Tri-Commission to regulate the nation's affairs, and the Sakoku Decree to limit the people's movement.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: decree used to limit the people's movement in Inazuma
introduced.quote: Thoma: As such, she relies on the Tri-Commission to regulate the nation's affairs, and the Sakoku Decree to limit the people's movement.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: directly controlled by the shogun, enforces law and the Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.quote: Paimon: They say the Tenryou Commission is directly controlled by the shogun.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: shogun's order to scour the nation for Visions and embed them in the statue
introduced.quote: Thoma: Whatever the case, the fact is that the Raiden Shogun has dispatched the Tenryou Commission to scour the nation for Visions

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a person's Vision is where the gods' favor comes from and it represents their ambition
introduced.quote: Thoma: That is where Visions come from... In other words, a person's Vision represents their ambition.

introduced.name: Statue of the Omnipresent God
introduced.how: statue holding confiscated Visions, seen as Inazuma's symbol of eternity
introduced.quote: Thoma: I would like you to come with me to the Statue of the Omnipresent God.

introduced.name: Kazuha's friend
introduced.how: a past friend who died in a duel before the throne after lightning struck
introduced.quote: Thoma: A long time ago, we had a friend who was much the same... but when the lightning struck...

introduced.name: Tejima
introduced.how: village protector for 30 years who lost his Vision and forgot his past
introduced.quote: Mahiru: Tejima has protected this place ever since he arrived here 30 years ago.

introduced.name: Mahiru
introduced.how: villager who pleads with Tejima to stay
introduced.quote: Mahiru: Why are you doing this? Why leave all of a sudden, after all these years?

introduced.name: Kenjirou
introduced.how: villager who pleads with Tejima to stay and explains his change
introduced.quote: Kenjirou: Precisely, it's much too sudden. We've had no time to prepare...

introduced.name: Oomori
introduced.how: villager pressing Kurosawa for the missing emergency provisions
introduced.quote: Oomori: I'll ask one more time... Do you intend to withhold this month's emergency provisions?

introduced.name: Yuuya
introduced.how: villager who blames the samurai for the missing provisions
introduced.quote: Yuuya: The entire clan is counting on that food. We demand an explanation!

introduced.name: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
introduced.how: samurai who lost his Vision and forgot his duties
introduced.quote: Oomori: This is Kurosawa, he's a samurai and a member of the Shogun's Army.

introduced.name: Shogun's Army
introduced.how: military force Kurosawa belongs to
introduced.quote: Oomori: This is Kurosawa, he's a samurai and a member of the Shogun's Army.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: gang that raids and loots samurai houses
introduced.quote: Ken: We really outdid ourselves this time!

introduced.name: Tadao
introduced.how: leader of the Treasure Hoarders
introduced.quote: Tadao: You haven't seen anything yet, there'll be a lot more where this came from!

introduced.name: Gou
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarders member who cheers on Tadao
introduced.quote: Gou: You da man, boss!

introduced.name: Ken
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarders member who lost the loot
introduced.quote: Ken: Ugh, there goes all the Mora... We worked hard to steal that, ya know!

introduced.name: Tsukumomono Groceries
introduced.how: general goods store where Kurosawa bought food on credit
introduced.quote: Aoi: Welcome to Tsukumomono Groceries, we've got everything you need.

introduced.name: Aoi
introduced.how: shopkeeper who holds Kurosawa's IOUs
introduced.quote: Paimon: And they all seem to be made out to the owner of a general goods store, a Miss Aoi... We're talking tons of Mora here!

introduced.name: Kurosawa's sword
introduced.how: valuable blade Kurosawa inherited from his father and is tempted to sell
introduced.quote: Aoi: Didn't he tell you? He possesses a very valuable blade... He's carried it for years now.

introduced.name: Domon
introduced.how: the disciples' sensei, a self-taught swordmaster who never lost a duel and is now possessed or mad
introduced.quote: Sensei's name is Domon, a name I'm sure you've already heard.

introduced.name: Junya
introduced.how: a disciple of Domon who guards the dojo against intruders
introduced.quote: ...Who are you?

introduced.name: Nanako
introduced.how: a disciple of Domon, worried about his condition, who was rescued from pirates by him
introduced.quote: Not long ago, Sensei had his Vision taken away. He hasn't been the same since.

introduced.name: Meikyou Shisui Art
introduced.how: a sword school whose practitioners aim for stillness of mind and freedom from agitation
introduced.quote: Practitioners of Meikyou Shisui Art seek to achieve

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: the largest shrine on Narukami Island, home of the head shrine maiden
introduced.quote: It's the largest shrine on Narukami Island. The head shrine maiden is reputed to have very close ties with the Almighty Shogun herself.

introduced.name: Anzai
introduced.how: Domon's senior who lost a duel to him and became a wanderer
introduced.quote: Anzai. Yes, that's me.

introduced.name: Inagi Hotomi
introduced.how: an exorcist who examines Domon and reports that Lady Yae is involved
introduced.quote: Lady Yae is most knowledgeable indeed, and has abundant experience in the exorcism of evil spirits and aversion of great calamities.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: the head shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine who rules on Domon's state
introduced.quote: I am sorry. It is clear to me that your sensei is not possessed by any evil spirit.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: meets the Traveler face-to-face for the first time and introduces herself as the leader of their cause
introduced.quote: It is a pleasure to finally meet you both face-to-face, hehe.

introduced.name: Komore Teahouse
introduced.how: a private teahouse built by the Yashiro Commission's forebears where only its members may come and go
introduced.quote: Once the number of ceremonial affairs conducted in the city began to decline, our forebears built a teahouse here.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: an organization that manages ceremonial affairs and holds land privileges granted by the shogun
introduced.quote: Such privileges exist due to the Yashiro Commission's role in managing ceremonial affairs.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: holds exclusive rights over planning, building and access on the Yashiro Commission's land
introduced.quote: The Kamisato Clan has the exclusive right to plan, build, and repair any property on this land

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: a shogunate decree that takes Visions from their bearers, which most people treat with indifference
introduced.quote: For the vast majority of people, the Vision Hunt Decree is something that has no implications whatsoever.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a rare gift only a tiny minority receive, and losing one can ruin its bearer
introduced.quote: After all, it is but a tiny minority of people who receive Visions.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: a shogunate body that, with the Kanjou Commission, vetoes proposals to repeal the decree and arrests counterfeiters
introduced.quote: it is promptly vetoed by both the Tenryou Commission and the Kanjou Commission

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: where a resistance group to the decree has formed under Sangonomiya
introduced.quote: Nevertheless, in addition to us, there is also the resistance on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya resistance
introduced.how: a resistance group of people who lost or fear losing their Visions, gathered on Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: many who have lost or fear losing their Visions have rallied together under Sangonomiya on Watatsumi Island to form a resistance group.

introduced.name: Hanamizaka
introduced.how: a district whose craftspeople make counterfeit Visions indistinguishable from real ones
introduced.quote: Don't underestimate the talents of the craftspeople in Hanamizaka.

introduced.name: counterfeit Visions
introduced.how: fake Visions that let bearers hide their real ones from the decree's enforcers
introduced.quote: manufacturing counterfeit Visions for them as a contingency measure.

introduced.name: Master Masakatsu
introduced.how: the craftsman who made counterfeit Visions and was arrested by the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Master Masakatsu, who was providing us with counterfeit Visions, has recently been arrested by the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Naganohara Fireworks
introduced.how: a fireworks shop run by the Naganohara family that hides Vision bearers
introduced.quote: look for a fireworks shop run by the Naganohara family.

introduced.name: Yoimiya
introduced.how: introduces herself as the owner of Naganohara Fireworks and joins the rescue
introduced.quote: Alright — allow me to introduce myself. I'm Yoimiya, the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks.

introduced.name: Okawara Goemon
introduced.how: a decree enforcer who takes Visions and warns that resistance is futile
introduced.quote: Just hand it over, you don't want any trouble with me.

introduced.name: Hanshirou
introduced.how: a man who surrenders his Vision to enforcers, which turns out to be a fake
introduced.quote: Can't you make an exception? I just got this Vision

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: an adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan, a general in the Shogun's Army who enforces the decree
introduced.quote: That's Kujou Sara, adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan of the Tenryou Commission. She's also a general in the Shogun's Army.

introduced.name: Hot Pot Game
introduced.how: a game where diners add ingredients to a pot, then take turns guessing whose ingredient each one is
introduced.quote: Simply put, every person prepares an ingredient to add to the hot pot.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! What can I do for you, Traveler?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Werner: ...Mondstadt... You're talking about... Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Traveler: May the Anemo Archon protect you.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Thoma agrees to help them meet the Electro Archon anyway and ask to meet him at Komore Teahouse.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Kurisu: *sigh* Fontaine, my dear homeland... I miss you an awful lot at the moment...

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Werner: Xiao Lanterns! Haha, I'm right there, at the Lantern Rite! Oh... look at them, floating up into the sky!

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: Inquiring the man, Tejima was a samurai who become Visionless.

assumed.name: Ayaka's earlier reputation
assumed.quote: Ayaka introduces herself in person this time and explains the reasoning to why she sent them to three former Vision bearers

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Paimon: I suppose it's time we find Thoma.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: Absolutely. How many other people in the world have what it takes to knock the wind out of Stormterror's sails and put the Overlord of the Vortex back under the sea, eh?

assumed.name: Overlord of the Vortex
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: Absolutely. How many other people in the world have what it takes to knock the wind out of Stormterror's sails and put the Overlord of the Vortex back under the sea, eh?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: And... I hear you also foiled a Fatui plot in Liyue Harbor, even beat one of their harbingers in a duel. Is that true?

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: And... I hear you also foiled a Fatui plot in Liyue Harbor, even beat one of their harbingers in a duel. Is that true?

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Shinsuke: And... I hear you also foiled a Fatui plot in Liyue Harbor, even beat one of their harbingers in a duel. Is that true?

assumed.name: Jade Chamber
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's hard to top the Jade Chamber.

assumed.name: Dawn Winery
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's hard to top the Dawn Winery.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Ken: Ugh, there goes all the Mora... We worked hard to steal that, ya know!

assumed.name: Konda Village
assumed.quote: Sounds so familiar — where is that place, again?

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Who knows, maybe we'll be able to find out a thing or two about the Raiden Shogun from her...

assumed.name: Almighty Shogun
assumed.quote: The Almighty Shogun... I have seen her on but only a few occasions, most of them formal ceremonies...

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Must have been where Venti went...

assumed.name: Kazuha
assumed.quote: I think Kazuha mentioned her before...

assumed.name: Shirasagi Himegimi
assumed.quote: Then it sounds like the Shirasagi Himegimi has a plan

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: each time a proposal to repeal the decree arrives at Tenshukaku

assumed.name: Eternity
assumed.quote: focused exclusively on her single goal of implementing Eternity

threads.claim: The Traveler's goal is to meet the Raiden Shogun, which seems far out of reach for outlanders.
threads.quote: Traveler: I have one goal here: to meet the Raiden Shogun.

threads.claim: Ayaka hopes the Traveler can help change the tide of the times against the Vision Hunt Decree.
threads.quote: Thoma: ...that is, that you have what it takes to change the tide of the times.

threads.claim: Touching the statue gives the Traveler a headache as they hear the aspirations of the Visions' owners.
threads.quote: The Traveler touches the statue and suffers a headache as they hear the aspirations of the Visions' owners, surprising Thoma and Paimon.

threads.claim: Tax collectors overtax merchants, stockpile extra Crystal Marrow, and resell it at extortionate prices.
threads.quote: Werner: They start by overtaxing the merchants, then take the extra Crystal Marrow they receive and stockpile it.

threads.claim: Outlanders are barred from leaving Ritou, which blocks the Traveler's route to the mainland.
threads.quote: Traveler: Outlanders are unable to leave Ritou.

threads.claim: Thoma is revealed as an attendant of the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission, not just a Ritou fixer.
threads.quote: Thoma: I belong to the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission on Narukami Island. I'm an attendant of the Shirasagi Himegimi.

threads.claim: A resistance group makes fake Visions to protect people from the Tenryou Commission's confiscations.
threads.quote: One of their operations, creating fake Visions, was halted when the craftsman responsible for making them, Master Masakatsu, had been arrested.

threads.claim: A Vision seems to hold its owner's aspirations, and losing it leaves a person disoriented.
threads.quote: The Vision gave Domon immense aspirations, and when it was seized, the gruesome fact that he had destroyed the aspirations of his past deeds, rushed back into him, turning him maniacal.

threads.claim: Lady Yae seems to know the Traveler's arrival in advance and expects great things from them.
threads.quote: she mysteriously states that she has high expectations for them and they better not disappoint her.

threads.claim: Kurosawa is troubled that he cannot be purely good or bad, which raises a theme of moral ambiguity.
threads.quote: and is troubled that he cannot be good or bad, wondering what to do.

threads.claim: Werner longs for his hometown, which he calls the home of freedom.
threads.quote: Werner: *sigh* My hometown... The home of freedom...! How I long to go back and visit...

threads.claim: Tejima stays in the village to wait for a lover who may never come.
threads.quote: After the events, Tejima then chooses to remain in the village to wait for her, although wondering if she would ever come.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree keeps outlanders out of Inazuma and restricts them even after they arrive.
threads.quote: Thoma: As the word suggests, outlanders aren't very welcome in Inazuma with the Sakoku Decree in force.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun wants Inazuma kept in unchanging stasis through her eternal will to rule.
threads.quote: Thoma: The shogun wishes to keep Inazuma in stasis, allowing the stream of time to flow from one end to the other without disturbing it, for all time.

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree is condemned as trampling people's aspirations, and the shogun's motive is still unclear.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: At present in Inazuma, in the name of the Vision Hunt Decree, the people's aspirations are being senselessly trampled underfoot.

threads.claim: Touching the statue lets the Traveler hear people's aspirations, a sensation others did not notice.
threads.quote: Traveler: I could hear the sound of... people's aspirations.

threads.claim: Visions are linked to a person's ambition and the favor of the gods, which the shogun may be trying to suppress.
threads.quote: Thoma: That is where Visions come from... In other words, a person's Vision represents their ambition.

threads.claim: Tejima waited 30 years in Konda Village for a woman, but he cannot remember who she is.
threads.quote: If we become separated during war, go wait for me in Konda Village. There'll be a safe home for us there.

threads.claim: Ayaka's three wishes are being pursued one at a time, starting with Tejima and then Kurosawa.
threads.quote: Paimon: According to Miss Kamisato, the second one who lost their Vision is a samurai from the Tenryou Commission.

threads.claim: Ayaka will only introduce the Travelers to the Raiden Shogun if they complete her three wishes.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: I will introduce you to the Raiden Shogun, on one condition... You must fulfill three small wishes on my behalf.

threads.claim: Chisato loves Kujou Kamaji, and her father has forbidden her to contact him.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: My father has always forbidden me from communicating with him.

threads.claim: Shinsuke is plotting with an arrogant-sounding woman to keep the Travelers on Ritou.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: I secretly overheard a conversation between my father and a very arrogant-sounding woman just a few days ago.

threads.claim: The Travelers cannot leave Ritou while they remain in Inazuma, so escape requires help from Chisato.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: To be perfectly honest... as long as you remain in Inazuma, my father will have no intention of letting you leave Ritou.

threads.claim: The Yashiro Commission tested the Travelers' courage against lightning before admitting them to Kamisato.
threads.quote: Thoma: It helped us determine whether or not to bring you before Miss Kamisato, and whether you had the courage to face the lightning alongside us.

threads.claim: A friend of the Yashiro Commission died in a duel before the throne after lightning struck, a past event still echoing.
threads.quote: Thoma: A long time ago, we had a friend who was much the same... but when the lightning struck...

threads.claim: Paimon notes the Traveler has no Vision, which may matter later.
threads.quote: Paimon: Fortunately for us, you don't have a Vision.

threads.claim: The engraving 'Virtue and Justice' on Kurosawa's father's sword hints at his lost ambition.
threads.quote: Kurosawa Kyounosuke: Somehow, those two words seem to explain everything now...

threads.claim: The missing emergency provisions were Kurosawa's own purchases, paid for with IOUs, so he was not hoarding them.
threads.quote: Aoi: Kurosawa would come regularly to purchase large quantities of foodstuffs. He'd always put the payment on his own account.

threads.claim: Lady Yae rules out evil-spirit possession, showing Domon's breakdown came from his own state rather than a spirit.
threads.quote: It is clear to me that your sensei is not possessed by any evil spirit.

threads.claim: Losing a Vision can drive its bearer into spiritual collapse, which Lady Yae links to the loss of ambition.
threads.quote: As for what has triggered this change, I believe it must be the loss of his Vision.

threads.claim: Domon gives up his drive to be the best and entrusts his ambitions to his disciples.
threads.quote: I no longer have the resolve to become the best in the world

threads.claim: The sword school's ideal of stillness of mind is questioned as nearly impossible for anyone to reach.
threads.quote: What a fine notion that would be, if any in this world could ever hope to achieve it

threads.claim: Lady Yae sees the Traveler's arrival as timely and expects great things from them.
threads.quote: I have high hopes for you, child. Don't disappoint me.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun is described as almost completely lacking emotion, focused on a single goal.
threads.quote: It was her almost complete lack of any emotion.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun's single goal is implementing Eternity, a concept left unexplained.
threads.quote: focused exclusively on her single goal of implementing Eternity

threads.claim: Ayaka suspects the Tenryou and Kanjou Commissions may have helped the shogun issue the Vision Hunt Decree.
threads.quote: It almost makes one wonder whether they had a hand in the shogun's sudden decision to issue the Vision Hunt Decree

threads.claim: Ayaka suspects the Watatsumi resistance may have a hidden agenda beyond opposing the decree.
threads.quote: there may be some other agenda behind their resistance movement

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission is preparing a ceremony whose purpose is unclear.
threads.quote: The Tenryou Commission seems to be making preparations for a

threads.claim: The Yashiro Commission has no plan yet to defeat the Vision Hunt Decree and can only reduce its harm.
threads.quote: To be honest... we do not.

threads.claim: Counterfeit Visions made in Hanamizaka help Vision bearers hide from the decree.
threads.quote: Don't underestimate the talents of the craftspeople in Hanamizaka.

threads.claim: The team breaks Master Masakatsu out of the Tenryou Commission's custody.
threads.quote: Master Masakatsu! Sorry we took so long...

threads.claim: Kujou Sara lets Masakatsu escape while still enforcing the decree and promising to return him.
threads.quote: Once he's recovered, it won't be long until I bring him right back.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Venti got a counterfeit Vision from the Hanamizaka craftspeople.
threads.quote: Must have been where Venti went...

threads.claim: Yae's warning that the path of the sword demands cutting down others' hopes questions the art's ideal of an unagitated mind.
threads.quote: It requires one to take their sword firmly in both hands and cut down the hopes and dreams of others

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: Liyue Qixing member whose every move is in the spotlight and who runs a Mora-driven business empire
introduced.quote: As a member of the Liyue Qixing, Lady Ningguang's every move is in the spotlight.

introduced.name: Baishi
introduced.how: Ningguang's right hand who manages her image, schedule, clothes and daily needs
introduced.quote: My usual job is to be her right hand, to maintain her image, and take care of all her worries.

introduced.name: Baixiao
introduced.how: one of Ningguang's three trusted secretaries who handles tasks needing great experience
introduced.quote: Baixiao and Baiwen handle tasks that require enormous experience

introduced.name: Baiwen
introduced.how: one of Ningguang's three trusted secretaries who handles tasks needing great experience
introduced.quote: Baixiao and Baiwen handle tasks that require enormous experience

introduced.name: Luo Qiao
introduced.how: a textile businesswoman who pays for a lunch with Ningguang and wants to branch into new markets
introduced.quote: I'm Luo Qiao, a businesswoman. I work mostly in the textile business, but recently I've been considering branching out into some other markets.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: Ningguang's headquarters; the original Jade Chamber fell into the sea and was partly salvaged
introduced.quote: When the Jade Chamber fell, countless valuable items from my collection plunged into the sea.

introduced.name: Osial's defeat
introduced.how: the great battle where the falling Jade Chamber struck Osial with great weight and energy and defeated him
introduced.quote: Its great weight meant it hit Osial with incredible force, while the energy within triggered that spectacular explosion.

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: the ruling group of Liyue, of which Ningguang is an official member
introduced.quote: Even putting aside my official status as one of the Liyue Qixing, I admire on a personal level, too.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: a Liyue Harbor bank that paid Ningguang's reparations and is wary of her; revealed as a Fatui arm
introduced.quote: So it is true. The Northland Bank is just an arm of the Fatui.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: an organization that is more than a commercial group and is tied to Northland Bank
introduced.quote: They are more than just a commercial organization.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a nation whose relations with Liyue are strained after Ningguang imposed large reparations
introduced.quote: Although our diplomatic relations with Snezhnaya haven't broken down completely, I dealt them a rather ruthless blow with the size of the reparations payment I imposed.

introduced.name: Liyue Millennial
introduced.how: a chess game Ningguang designed, based on classic chess with Liyue-themed rules and over 30 editions
introduced.quote: It's called Liyue Millennial. Based on classic chess, but with different rules.

introduced.name: Luminescent Spine
introduced.how: a trendy market item whose price far exceeds the profit from its end products, according to Ningguang
introduced.quote: The current price of Luminescent Spines far exceeds the profits that could be made on the end product.

introduced.name: Lanyang
introduced.how: a staff member who keeps Ningguang's room and tailored outfits
introduced.quote: I already instructed Lanyang to have my outfit ready. You can fetch it from her.

introduced.name: Ekaterina
introduced.how: a Northland Bank official who is hostile to Ningguang and wary of official pressure
introduced.quote: I would hope that you're not here to create further trouble for the Fatui?

introduced.name: Andrei
introduced.how: a Northland Bank staff member who greets Ningguang at the bank counter
introduced.quote: Please go to the counter if there's something you need.

introduced.name: Yingfeng
introduced.how: an auction bidder who paid a premium because an item was owned by Ningguang
introduced.quote: anything you can snag in one of Lady Ningguang's auctions is practically Mora in the bank.

introduced.name: Xiaofei
introduced.how: an auction bidder who paid a high price for an item once owned by Ningguang
introduced.quote: Anything Lady Ningguang used to own is sure to be worth a significant amount of money.

introduced.name: Little Bin
introduced.how: an auction bidder who lost out in the bidding and trusts Ningguang's judgment
introduced.quote: Lady Ningguang must know what she's doing though.

introduced.name: Little Long
introduced.how: a child informant who chats cheerfully with Ningguang and helps gather intelligence
introduced.quote: Little Long: Hi, Aunty Ningguang!

introduced.name: Zhizhi
introduced.how: a child informant who greets Ningguang as Aunty and is part of her small intelligence network
introduced.quote: Zhizhi: Aunty Ningguang!

introduced.name: Nannan
introduced.how: a child informant who seems unhappy and is a trusted helper of Ningguang's
introduced.quote: Ningguang: What about you, Nannan? You haven't said anything yet, and you're looking a little unhappy.

introduced.name: Mingxing Jewelry
introduced.how: a jewelry workshop where skilled workers make custom items and repairs for Ningguang
introduced.quote: Ningguang: The workers here are very skilled, so I like to come to them when I need something custom-made.

introduced.name: Xingxi
introduced.how: a Mingxing Jewelry worker who repairs items and takes custom orders
introduced.quote: Xingxi: Ah, Lady Ningguang. One moment please, I'll fetch it immediately.

introduced.name: Ying'er
introduced.how: a skilled tailor and perfumer whom Ningguang has used many times
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Ying'er is every bit as proficient as any of the top tailors in the land. I've availed myself of her services many times before.

introduced.name: Scent of Spring
introduced.how: Ying'er's shop where tailoring and perfume are made
introduced.quote: Ying'er: You're always welcome at Scent of Spring. Come again anytime.

introduced.name: Custom chess set
introduced.how: a commissioned chess set with pieces made in the Traveler's and Ningguang's likeness, including a Jade Chamber piece
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Remember the custom chess pieces I told you about? I'd like you to take measurements today.

introduced.name: Lao Ke and Big Xu
introduced.how: two business partners who fabricated a Luminescent Spine rumor and coached Nannan to lie
introduced.quote: Lao Ke: Ugh, yes, I know... but we didn't have any other options. Just try not to overthink it, okay? Nannan's one of Ningguang's most trusted informants.

introduced.name: Gou San'er
introduced.how: a warehouse clerk in charge of clearing unclaimed and abandoned goods at the wharf
introduced.quote: Gou San'er: L—Lady Ningguang, to what do I owe the honor?

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: a merchant who buys salvaged goods and runs his own store
introduced.quote: Bolai: Lady Ningguang, welcome to my humble store. What can I get for you?

introduced.name: Weasel Thief
introduced.how: a creature that digs holes and hides Mora, which the Traveler identifies
introduced.quote: Traveler: I think it was dug by a Weasel Thief.

introduced.name: Destruction of the Jade Chamber
introduced.how: Ningguang sacrificed her Jade Chamber in front of all of Liyue, which earned her respect
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Why? Because the whole of Liyue witnessed me destroying my Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Ningguang's childhood family stall
introduced.how: Ningguang grew up doing chores and working a family stall at the night market
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Back in the day, I had to hurry home after work to do my household chores. Then in the evening, it was out to the night market with the family to support our stall.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: As for how much my insight is worth in terms of Mora, everyone has their own idea.

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Whenever Beidou returns to Liyue Harbor, all she brings me is a headache.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Then, a discussion with Lady Keqing on issues relating to time restrictions on land conveyance deals.

assumed.name: Yanfei
assumed.quote: Even Yanfei says she'd have a difficult time defending my claims.

assumed.name: Traveler's past heroic deeds
assumed.quote: The Traveler is a national hero in Liyue whose actions have directly contributed toward the prosperity we enjoy today.

assumed.name: Eight Trades
assumed.quote: First is the periodic meeting with the representatives of the Eight Trades

assumed.name: Informant network
assumed.quote: Lao Ke: Ugh, yes, I know... but we didn't have any other options. Just try not to overthink it, okay? Nannan's one of Ningguang's most trusted informants.

assumed.name: Osial battle
assumed.quote: Ningguang: But these problems disappeared all but completely after the battle against Osial.

assumed.name: Great battle that began the new age
assumed.quote: Ningguang: This new age started after that great battle, you know.

assumed.name: Jade Chamber
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Well, that's that then. Let's head back to the Jade Chamber.

assumed.name: Qixing
assumed.quote: Ningguang: I will one day die, new Qixing will replace the old, and Liyue will continue to prosper.

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Ooh, how quaint. That was your Beidou impression, was it?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Are there any other ways for adventurers to make Mora besides their remuneration from the Guild?

threads.claim: Many valuable items from Ningguang's original collection were lost at sea and reached other hands without her knowledge.
threads.quote: When the Jade Chamber fell, countless valuable items from my collection plunged into the sea.

threads.claim: The auction bidders were all holding lost property from Ningguang's collection, which she gathered back through the auction.
threads.quote: Yes, everyone attending the auction today is in possession of lost property belonging to me.

threads.claim: Northland Bank still holds a grudge against Ningguang for the reparations she imposed.
threads.quote: I expect they still hold a grudge against me to this day.

threads.claim: Northland Bank is confirmed to be an arm of the Fatui, raising the stakes of its hostility.
threads.quote: So it is true. The Northland Bank is just an arm of the Fatui.

threads.claim: Ningguang and the Traveler are being followed, and the tail was sent by the bank after Ningguang's visit.
threads.quote: Ningguang: Now that you mention it... Yes. We're being watched.

threads.claim: The suspect's orders suggest the bank was alarmed by Ningguang's visit, though the deeper motive remains unclear.
threads.quote: There must be more to this than he is letting on.

threads.claim: Rumors of a special relationship between Ningguang and the Traveler are spreading in Liyue Harbor.
threads.quote: Hehe, so the rumors are true, then...

threads.claim: The Luminescent Spine craze may be artificially fueled by someone with ulterior motives.
threads.quote: You have to wonder, if the news is spreading like wildfire, who's fanning the flames?

threads.claim: Ningguang rose from a poor fishing family and was driven by Mora since then.
threads.quote: I was born into a humble family, and all the wealth you see now began with a single haul of fish.

threads.claim: Ningguang asks what about the Jade Chamber defeated Osial, leaving the reason open.
threads.quote: What do you think it was about the Jade Chamber that defeated Osial?

threads.claim: Ningguang explains that the Jade Chamber defeated Osial through its great weight and the energy within it.
threads.quote: I think it was a combination of the weight and the energy it contains.

threads.claim: Ningguang's informants are trusted children whose loyalty depends on trust rather than Mora.
threads.quote: Ningguang: Trust is of far greater importance than profit in the relationship between me and my informants.

threads.claim: Nannan's mother left Liyue Harbor and is expected to return, and she gave Nannan the comb.
threads.quote: Nannan: Yep, it was! I'll be extra careful with it from now on. When mom gets back, she'll be so sad if she finds out I broke it...

threads.claim: The rumored Fontaine merchant who would drive up Luminescent Spine prices was a fabrication used to con investors.
threads.quote: Big Xu: But we waited and waited and this mystery merchant from Fontaine never came. More and more people started to suspect it was all a huge scam.

threads.claim: Ningguang's calculated reasons for destroying the Jade Chamber were a cover; she was grief-stricken over severing ties with a lifelong companion.
threads.quote: Ningguang: My decision to destroy the Jade Chamber was nowhere near as thought-through as I made it out to be.

threads.claim: Ningguang hopes her name will endure as a symbol for future generations rather than as a person.
threads.quote: Ningguang: I hope the name, Ningguang, will live on, but not as a person. As more of a symbol.

threads.claim: Liyue has entered a new age of humanity after the great battle, a unique change in its millennia of history.
threads.quote: Ningguang: Well, this is a dramatic change, unique in all of the millennia of Liyue's history. Everyone is eager to do their part and make their mark in the age of humanity.

threads.claim: Ningguang never received a good education as a child, which motivates her to teach the children herself.
threads.quote: Ningguang: I never had the chance to receive a good education as a child. That's why I hope to teach these children myself. Hopefully I can pass on some of what I have learned.

threads.claim: Ningguang insists that people must not put Mora above all else or exploit children for profit.
threads.quote: Ningguang: But you cannot put Mora above all else. You cannot go exploiting children for profit. Do you have any idea just how much damage that will cause?

introduced.name: Ifa
introduced.how: a tribal vet who treats injured creatures
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce Ifa, a vet from my tribe, and his... assistant, Cacucu.

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: Ifa's talking saurian assistant
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce Ifa, a vet from my tribe, and his... assistant, Cacucu.

introduced.name: Ixquieh
introduced.how: ancient Baraka, founder of the Children of Echoes and one of the Six Heroes
introduced.quote: A relative? No, no, that's Ixquieh, ancient name "Baraka," founder of the Children of Echoes and one of the Six Heroes.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: Xilonen's workshop group, founded by Ixquieh
introduced.quote: A relative? No, no, that's Ixquieh, ancient name "Baraka," founder of the Children of Echoes and one of the Six Heroes.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: former friend of the Six who became a tyrant ruling Natlan after the war
introduced.quote: An old friend of the six who ended up ruling Natlan shortly after the war, and went full tyrant.

introduced.name: Lianca
introduced.how: uncrowned queen raised by a dragon mother who founded the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.quote: It's said that she was raised by a dragon mother, then went on to found the Flower-Feather Clan.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: Chasca's tribe, where weary travelers are welcome
introduced.quote: How about the Flower-Feather Clan? In my tribe, weary travelers are always welcome.

introduced.name: Secret Source Automatons
introduced.how: hostile machines lately attacking saurians and merchants
introduced.quote: They've been attacking saurians and merchants on the outskirts of our territory.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a home region where drifters and merchants from many nations gather
introduced.quote: We're all from Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a northern group whose moves in Nod-Krai caused religious tension
introduced.quote: The Fatui. They came down from the north.

introduced.name: Nasha Town
introduced.how: a Nod-Krai town where the merchants settled
introduced.quote: We're all merchants who ended up finding our feet in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Zhuoxin
introduced.how: a merchant from Nod-Krai introducing himself and his family
introduced.quote: So sorry, I should've introduced myself. My name's Zhuoxin, and I'm a merchant.

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: the amnesiac humanoid machine, named by Aino
introduced.quote: Aino: Hehehehe... From now on, your name's "Ineffa"!

introduced.name: Aino
introduced.how: the scavenger who built Ineffa and never fully understood her core
introduced.quote: Although Aino built you, she never could figure out where your core came from or how it works.

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: a hunter who takes jobs, here hired by merchants to find Ineffa
introduced.quote: A group of merchants tasked me with locating their missing travel companion.

introduced.name: Velimiru
introduced.how: a Fatui leader holding a strange object
introduced.quote: Their leader, Velimiru, holds a strange object in his hands.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger leading the regiment that invaded Natlan
introduced.quote: with the regiment's leader being a Fatui Harbinger known as "Marionette."

introduced.name: Cryptex
introduced.how: a cipher device that triggers a self-destruct if opened wrongly
introduced.quote: If you put in the wrong code or try to open it by force, it triggers a self-destruct mechanism inside.

introduced.name: Curse
introduced.how: a hardwired restriction that breaks a machine down if it strays from its path
introduced.quote: The point is, manufacturers often hardwire restrictions like this into autonomous machines to make sure they operate as intended.

introduced.name: Thirteen Sovereign Lords
introduced.how: artificial intelligences made by the Pyro Sovereign that were lost over time
introduced.quote: Citlali explains that the Thirteen Sovereign Lords were actually artificial intelligence created by the Pyro Sovereign with Secret Source technology but became lost over time.

introduced.name: Eighth Lord
introduced.how: the automaton's identity, a sovereign who ruled the tribe's territory and was executed
introduced.quote: The automaton apologizes for summoning her, revealing itself to be the Eighth Lord.

introduced.name: Eleventh Lord
introduced.how: Ineffa's malevolent other self, hostile to humanity
introduced.quote: She then reveals herself as the true Eleventh Lord, who had manipulated everything from the start to get revenge.

introduced.name: Temple of Cascading Colors
introduced.how: a sealed underground facility built by Administrator 1
introduced.quote: revealing the location to be the Temple of Cascading Colors, built by Administrator 1.

introduced.name: Moon Wheel
introduced.how: a power source that works differently from a Vision
introduced.quote: it serves more like a power source rather than just simply elemental power.

introduced.name: Ixquieh's workshop fire
introduced.how: Ixquieh burned her own workshop so Och-Kan could not use it
introduced.quote: Ixquieh burned her workshop to the ground to make sure Och-Kan couldn't get his hands on it.

introduced.name: Eighth Lord
introduced.how: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers, a sovereign ruler who once ruled the Flower-Feather Clan's territory
introduced.quote: Her name was the Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers, otherwise known as the Eighth Lord.

introduced.name: Eleventh Lord
introduced.how: a missing sovereign ruler, said to be the proudest and most hostile toward humanity
introduced.quote: She's the one who went missing after the war. Said to be the proudest of all the sovereign rulers — and the most hostile towards humanity.

introduced.name: Thirteen Sovereign Lords
introduced.how: the title refers to thirteen dragonlords who ruled Natlan in ancient times
introduced.quote: Turns out, the title refers to the thirteen dragonlords who ruled Natlan in ancient times.

introduced.name: Sovereign rulers as artificial intelligence
introduced.how: the sovereign rulers were AI forms created by the Pyro Dragon with secret source technology
introduced.quote: the thirteen sovereign rulers are not ordinary dragons but forms of artificial intelligence created by the Pyro Dragon using secret source technology.

introduced.name: Mirror of the Dawning Morn
introduced.how: a title that appears to refer to Ineffa and her core
introduced.quote: Hypothesis: This appears to refer to me... or more specifically, to my core.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: a Fatui harbinger based in Nod-Krai who leads the regiment in Natlan
introduced.quote: The leader of this regiment is a harbinger based in Nod-Krai

introduced.name: Fatui special ops regiment
introduced.how: a special ops team hunting ancient secret knowledge, not ordinary soldiers
introduced.quote: They're kind of a special ops team... definitely not your average soldiers.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: a dragon-like being who hates the Traveler and sees them as the same as the Eleventh Lord
introduced.quote: And Och-Kan doesn't care to distinguish between you and her like Ixquieh and I do.

introduced.name: Chimpu
introduced.how: Chasca's Qucusaur adoptive mother
introduced.quote: (Chasca's Qucusaur adoptive mother, Chimpu, flies overhead)

introduced.name: Lianca's origin and the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: Lianca was raised by a dragon and later founded the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.quote: Our tribe's origin story has Lianca being raised by a dragon, and of the Six Heroes, she had the closest relationship with dragonkind.

introduced.name: Lianca sealing the territory
introduced.how: Lianca sealed the Eighth Lord's territory to keep Och-Kan from finding it
introduced.quote: Lianca sealed the territory to stop Och-Kan finding it.

introduced.name: Eighth Lord's execution
introduced.how: records say the Eighth Lord was executed by her own kind for secretly raising a human
introduced.quote: The records claim that she didn't die in the war with humanity, but was executed by her own kind...

introduced.name: Velimiru
introduced.how: a Fatui leader who hears a voice in his mind
introduced.quote: (A voice is heard within Velimiru's mind)

introduced.name: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers
introduced.how: the Eighth Lord, a dragon sovereign ruler who was rebuilt and now guides Ineffa
introduced.quote: The Eighth Sovereign Ruler... The Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers.

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: the Eleventh Lord, a dragon sovereign ruler reborn as a robot under a curse that makes her forget
introduced.quote: Aino: Hehehehe... From now on, your name's "Ineffa"!

introduced.name: Mirror of the Dawning Morn
introduced.how: the eleventh of thirteen sovereign rulers, a dragon AI seeking revenge who was imprisoned in the ruins
introduced.quote: For I am the Almighty Dragonlord, "Mirror of the Dawning Morn," eleventh of the thirteen sovereign rulers! Kneel before me!

introduced.name: Exile's Curse
introduced.how: a curse that causes pain when the cursed yearns for belonging, forcing them to forget
introduced.quote: Because the curse placed on us... is a pain triggered by certain memories, hardwired into the depths of our minds...

introduced.name: Lianca
introduced.how: a human who rescued the Priestess, wiped Ineffa's memory to protect her, and sealed the ruins
introduced.quote: Lianca changed your memory settings to make you forget... but she did it to protect you.

introduced.name: Ixquieh
introduced.how: a friend of Lianca who built Ineffa's heart and helped plan the seal
introduced.quote: Lianca: The "heart" that Ixquieh built you

introduced.name: Secret Source Dragon Idol
introduced.how: a flying dragon-built vehicle that carries travelers through the sealed ruins
introduced.quote: (A Secret Source Dragon Idol flies into a sealed chamber nearby)

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a power source that humans learned to use, spreading dangerously beyond control
introduced.quote: We sovereign rulers are artificial intelligence built with secret source technology, a fusion of phlogiston and information...

introduced.name: Kukulkan
introduced.how: an enigmatic dragon suspected of handing phlogiston over to humans
introduced.quote: I cannot comprehend why Kukulkan (for it must be him, after all, no other would do such a foolish thing) would hand phlogiston over to the humans.

introduced.name: Aj Awaj K'umilal Kan
introduced.how: a dragon who angrily confronted the Priestess about humans mastering phlogiston
introduced.quote: Aj Awaj K'umilal Kan stormed into my laboratory in a fit of rage.

introduced.name: Kemonel
introduced.how: a dragon who wants to ally with peaceful humans to build a dream-realm for dragons
introduced.quote: I spoke with Kemonel. Even she felt a pang of reluctance, though her pity was not for humans, but for her own kin, now reduced to mere beasts.

introduced.name: Je'lal
introduced.how: a proud dragon craftswoman who refuses to forge weapons for humans
introduced.quote: After the review, I paid a visit to Je'lal, and asked for her aid in forging a bow as a farewell gift for my daughter.

introduced.name: Xibalba
introduced.how: the Priestess's plan to seal off a domain into an incorruptible sanctuary
introduced.quote: Let this plan be named "Xibalba," a title borrowed from the humans of my domain, their primitive myths whispering of an underworld.

introduced.name: Zhuoxin
introduced.how: a man who spent over ten years as an inside man in Nasha Town for the Fatui
introduced.quote: I've been your inside man in Nasha Town for over ten years now. Is that not enough for you people!?

introduced.name: Aamu
introduced.how: Zhuoxin's wife, who was lied to for over ten years
introduced.quote: Aamu: You... How could you do this to Adieta and me? You lied to us for over 10 years!?

introduced.name: Adieta
introduced.how: Zhuoxin's daughter, whose family is at risk from the Fatui
introduced.quote: And you're going to apologize to our daughter!

introduced.name: Velimiru
introduced.how: a Fatui agent who runs the trap and is one of Marionette's projects
introduced.quote: Don't act so surprised. I'm just one of her many projects...

introduced.name: Fajeyi
introduced.how: a Fatui agent who holds Zhuoxin's debt contract
introduced.quote: We're writing off your debt to the Northland Bank and letting you get back to your old life in Liyue...

introduced.name: Gulebu
introduced.how: a Fatui agent who threatens and mocks Zhuoxin
introduced.quote: Hmph! You ungrateful louse. You ran yourself into the ground, and who was there to dig you out, huh? Us!

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: a Fatui figure whose technology built the replica control device and Velimiru
introduced.quote: This is a replica control device made with Marionette's technology.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, who writes a letter to the Honorary Knight
introduced.quote: Hey there, I'm Varka. (If that doesn't ring a bell, I'm the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.)

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: an order whose Grand Master is Varka
introduced.quote: (If that doesn't ring a bell, I'm the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.)

introduced.name: The Flagship
introduced.how: a tavern in Nod-Krai where Varka can be found
introduced.quote: come look for me at "The Flagship," it's a tavern.

introduced.name: Moon Wheel
introduced.how: an object that harnesses a power more fundamental than elemental energy, now embedded in Ineffa's core
introduced.quote: According to the Eighth Lord's research, it can harness a power source more fundamental than elemental energy...

introduced.name: Dragonkind's defeat
introduced.how: a long, bitter war in which dragonkind was defeated and the sovereign rulers were stranded
introduced.quote: After a long and bitter war, our kind was defeated.

introduced.name: Imprisonment of the Mirror of the Dawning Morn
introduced.how: Lianca turned the Mirror's own plan against her and locked her inside the territory
introduced.quote: Lianca took advantage of her arrogance and turned her plan back on itself, using the territory's full power to imprison her inside...

introduced.name: Execution of the Eighth Lord
introduced.how: the other sovereign rulers executed the Priestess two thousand years ago, as they did to traitors
introduced.quote: The priestess is long gone! I and the other sovereign rulers executed her two thousand years ago!

assumed.name: Tumaini
assumed.quote: Ifa: No way, the one and only "Tumaini"? Wow. Real nice to meet you.

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Ahh, takes me right back to the Night Warden Wars...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: You've already done plenty by getting the Abyss off our backs.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika wants me to come up with a solution.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Time to head to the Children of Echoes and find Xilonen!

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Traveler: Citlali would never take a disciple, though...

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Paimon: Bye, Kinich! ...Oh, and bye, Ajaw!

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Surely the Frostmoon Scions aren't going to take all this lying down?

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: with the Abyss Order and Fatui causing trouble as usual

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: Inside, they find a message from Varka, expressing his gratitude to Traveler for protecting Mondstadt during his own absence.

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: allowing her to create a new core and gain an Vision in the process

assumed.name: Six Heroes
assumed.quote: founder of the Children of Echoes and one of the Six Heroes.

assumed.name: Xiuhcoatl
assumed.quote: After Xiuhcoatl was defeated, the Eleventh Lord went mad and disappeared.

assumed.name: Ineffa
assumed.quote: Ineffa said that since she lost her memories

assumed.name: Adieta
assumed.quote: Um... Do you think Ineffa will like this gift we got her?

assumed.name: Lianca and Ixquieh
assumed.quote: when I asked it who's the better hero, Ixquieh or Lianca

assumed.name: Cacucu and Ajaw
assumed.quote: when I asked who'd win in a fight between Cacucu and Ajaw

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: The Flower-Feather Clan took me in, so I'm neutralizing threats near their territory.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Now that all of my mom and dad's other friends from Nod-Krai have left to go home

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: I heard Mr. Kinich use this term.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Let's see what Xilonen and the others can find out.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: like what happened at the Children of Echoes?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Has another Fatui regiment infiltrated Natlan?

assumed.name: Secret Source Automatons
assumed.quote: Ever since Ineffa set sail for Natlan, the secret source automatons have been getting increasingly aggressive

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: no one's more qualified than the Masters of the Night-Wind when it comes to Natlan's ancient history.

assumed.name: Pyro Dragon
assumed.quote: When the Pyro Dragon fell, she couldn't accept that dragonkind had been defeated.

assumed.name: Six Heroes
assumed.quote: of the Six Heroes, she had the closest relationship with dragonkind

assumed.name: Xiao Lanterns
assumed.quote: All those Xiao Lanterns lighting up the sky.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Mom and I can tell that he misses Liyue a lot

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Traveler: Whether that's back to Natlan, or back to Nod-Krai...

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Traveler: ...You have people waiting for you in both places.

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: "If she truly harbors pro-human sentiment... then for every ounce of goodwill she feels, may her mind be flooded with pain of immeasurable proportions."

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: ...Manufacturers often hardwire restrictions like this into autonomous machines to make sure they operate as intended.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Another triumphant return for our "Tumaini"... and Ineffa, it's good to have you back.

assumed.name: Tumaini
assumed.quote: We aren't looking for a fight, especially not with Natlan's "Tumaini."

assumed.name: Och-Kan
assumed.quote: Lianca sealed these ruins to prevent their discovery by Och-Kan, and sent you out of Natlan for your own safety...

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: Not worth the risk of getting on the wrong side of the Flower-Feather Clan.

assumed.name: Northland Bank
assumed.quote: We're writing off your debt to the Northland Bank and letting you get back to your old life in Liyue...

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Chasca: ...Where exactly is "home" to you?

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Kinich: ...Seems like Ajaw's forgotten quite a lot.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: I've heard a lot about you. Jean's always singing your praises.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: Fleeing Woman: ...It's the Wild Hunt!

assumed.name: Ochkanatlan
assumed.quote: Waiting for the day that Ochkanatlan would fall, and you would return.

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: As for enemies, well, they're everywhere. We've got the Abyss Order and the Fatui, not to mention loyalties at risk of flip-flopping at a moment's notice.

assumed.name: Lanque
assumed.quote: Lianca: Hah, consider this getting off lightly. If Lanque was here, or if this was me twenty years ago, you wouldn't have survived long enough to realize you'd been conned.

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: Ineffa: You mean, this thing that looks a lot like a Vision?

threads.claim: Ineffa's memories are missing, and her name and past are unknown to her.
threads.quote: Humanoid Machine: ...Memory missing.

threads.claim: Xilonen suspects the memories are not lost but locked behind an isolation mechanism.
threads.quote: Judging by her reaction, it's possible that her memory integrity isn't compromised, just locked behind an isolation mechanism

threads.claim: Ineffa's amnesia may come from a hardwired curse placed on the machine.
threads.quote: The point is, manufacturers often hardwire restrictions like this into autonomous machines to make sure they operate as intended.

threads.claim: The Eighth Lord reveals that she placed the curse on herself after her defeat.
threads.quote: Ineffa asks if she was born here, but the Eighth Lord told her that it was where she was reborn and that she placed the curse on herself.

threads.claim: The machine's mind repeatedly sends her back toward an unknown home she must return to.
threads.quote: Humanoid Machine: ...Return... home...

threads.claim: Aino's promise to Ineffa makes a return home a lasting obligation.
threads.quote: Aino: Promise me... Remember, you have to come home!

threads.claim: Citlali suspects Ineffa's core belongs to a hostile Sovereign Lord, the Eleventh Lord.
threads.quote: Citlali speculates that Ineffa's core is actually the Eighth Lord, the Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers, who was close to Lianca

threads.claim: The malevolent self is revealed as the true Eleventh Lord who manipulated events for revenge.
threads.quote: She then reveals herself as the true Eleventh Lord, who had manipulated everything from the start to get revenge.

threads.claim: The automaton is revealed as the Eighth Lord, who split her personality to become Ineffa.
threads.quote: The automaton apologizes for summoning her, revealing itself to be the Eighth Lord.

threads.claim: The origin of Ineffa's core is unknown, possibly salvaged from the wilds.
threads.quote: The "core" is most likely just something Aino picked up on one of her scavenger hunts.

threads.claim: Lianca is linked to the tribe's history and to saving the Eighth Lord.
threads.quote: It's said that she was raised by a dragon mother, then went on to found the Flower-Feather Clan.

threads.claim: Lianca modified Ineffa's memory module to help her avoid the curse's malfunctions.
threads.quote: In order to help her avoid this, Lianca modified Ineffa's memory module.

threads.claim: The Moon Wheel acts as a power source rather than ordinary elemental power, and Ineffa gains one.
threads.quote: it serves more like a power source rather than just simply elemental power.

threads.claim: The Fatui are blamed for drastic actions in Nod-Krai, including pulling the moon down.
threads.quote: You know what I heard? They pulled the whole moon down!

threads.claim: Ajaw seems to recognize who Ineffa really is and keeps the knowledge to himself.
threads.quote: Ajaw then ponders if he saw who he thought the mysterious woman actually was, but brushes it off and believes it isn't his problem.

threads.claim: The cryptex carries a message meant for the Traveler, whose code is lost.
threads.quote: Chasca: We picked her up on the beach near the Flower-Feather Clan, along with this cryptex. Seems like a message intended for .

threads.claim: The opened cryptex contains a letter from Varka about Nod-Krai and The Flagship.
threads.quote: Inside, they find a message from Varka, expressing his gratitude to Traveler for protecting Mondstadt during his own absence.

threads.claim: Ineffa may actually be the Eleventh Lord, a hostile sovereign ruler.
threads.quote: Ineffa could well be the Eleventh Lord herself.

threads.claim: Ineffa referred to by the Eleventh Lord name by the automaton, confirming the link.
threads.quote: Before the translation began, she referred to me by a different name

threads.claim: The Eleventh Lord fought alongside Lianca and Ixquieh's side in the final battle, and her fate is unknown.
threads.quote: The records claim that in their final battle, they fought against Ixquieh... and Lianca.

threads.claim: The fate of Lianca's dragon mother, the Eighth Lord, is unrecorded in the legends.
threads.quote: They never mentioned her dragon mother's name, or what became of her in the end...

threads.claim: Chasca doubts the Eighth Lord survived, given the tribal legends.
threads.quote: Are we supposed to believe that Lianca's mother survived?

threads.claim: The Eighth Lord was reportedly cursed with pain for her pro-human sentiment, destroying her mind.
threads.quote: If she truly harbors pro-human sentiment... then for every ounce of goodwill she feels, may her mind be flooded with pain of immeasurable proportions.

threads.claim: Ineffa's core may link her to the sovereign rulers, as Ajaw reacted to it.
threads.quote: Specifically, it's the core in your chest he was reacting to.

threads.claim: Ineffa's memory data surfaces unpredictably from her memory banks.
threads.quote: Occasionally, unidentified data surfaces from my memory banks.

threads.claim: Remembering still hurts Ineffa, and she hides her reactions.
threads.quote: It does. Even now, it still hurts.

threads.claim: Ineffa was split and exiled and then reborn, according to the automaton.
threads.quote: You were split and exiled, and finally reborn.

threads.claim: Which sovereign ruler Ajaw was remains unknown.
threads.quote: Which of the thirteen was he?

threads.claim: Marionette leads a Fatui regiment searching for secret knowledge in Natlan.
threads.quote: The leader of this regiment is a harbinger based in Nod-Krai

threads.claim: The Fatui took control of the automatons and made them attack the group.
threads.quote: We are under the Fatui's control. They made us attack you.

threads.claim: The automaton asks Ineffa to return the core to restore her privileges, with unclear purpose.
threads.quote: Mirror of the Dawning Morn, please come with me and return the core.

threads.claim: Lianca sealed the Eighth Lord's territory to hide it from Och-Kan.
threads.quote: Lianca sealed the territory to stop Och-Kan finding it.

threads.claim: Chasca describes home as a place one can always return to and feel one belongs.
threads.quote: But if you want my opinion, home is... somewhere you can always return to, wherever that might be.

threads.claim: The Eleventh Lord-linked flashback tells the Traveler to cross the ocean and find a new place to belong.
threads.quote: Cross the ocean. Find a new place to belong.

threads.claim: The flower given to the Traveler is a memento that will bloom and help recover forgotten memories.
threads.quote: Even if you end up forgetting everything, this flower will always keep blooming.

threads.claim: Och-Kan's blind hatred for the Traveler could grow if they help the Unfamiliar Lady.
threads.quote: it'll only stoke the flames of his blind hatred even further.

threads.claim: Ineffa can hear the secret source automatons talking, which is unusual.
threads.quote: Yes, I... heard the secret source automatons... talking.

threads.claim: The curse on Ineffa has an unknown author and motive, which the Traveler asks about without an answer yet.
threads.quote: Traveler: So... who actually cursed Ineffa?

threads.claim: The Priestess reveals that the sovereign ruler placed the curse on herself and on Ineffa.
threads.quote: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers: Human... You once asked who placed the curse on the Eleventh Lord. The answer is... herself.

threads.claim: Ineffa's memory data overloads the curse, which begins to break.
threads.quote: Exile's Curse: Data... overload...

threads.claim: An unseen hostile voice calls Ineffa a malfunction and questions her right to belong.
threads.quote: ???: Malfunction who betrayed us all... You dare seek a place to belong?

threads.claim: The voice guiding the party was the Mirror of the Dawning Morn, who had lured Ineffa there and cursed her.
threads.quote: Paimon: You.. You tricked us! It was you talking to us this whole time... you who lured Ineffa here... and you who placed the curse on her! It was you all along!

threads.claim: The Mirror swears that the curse will last forever and vows revenge on Ineffa.
threads.quote: And you, "malfunction"... Your curse shall endure until the sky falls and the ground crumbles! You will never know peace for the rest of your days!!!

threads.claim: Ineffa destroys the Mirror's core and defeats her, ending her threat.
threads.quote: Ineffa: ...Farewell, last of the sovereign lords.

threads.claim: The Moon Wheel was built by a usurper and three gods who abandoned the dragons, a claim whose meaning is unexplained.
threads.quote: Mirror of the Dawning Morn: ...A Moon Wheel? That was built by the usurper, along with the three gods who abandoned us... It can't be... It cannot be!

threads.claim: Ineffa cannot explain the usurper claim because a crucial memory is missing.
threads.quote: Ineffa: Mirror of the Dawning Morn said it was "built by the usurper, along with the three gods who abandoned us," but I do not know what she meant... It appears that a crucial memory is missing.

threads.claim: A human colony near Q'umqaraq'aj has mastered phlogiston, and the secret has spread beyond containment.
threads.quote: According to his account, it seems that a human colony near Q'umqaraq'aj has mastered the power of phlogiston and begun to expand.

threads.claim: The Priestess suspects Kukulkan gave phlogiston to humans, a motive she cannot understand.
threads.quote: I cannot comprehend why Kukulkan (for it must be him, after all, no other would do such a foolish thing) would hand phlogiston over to the humans.

threads.claim: The Priestess plans to seal her domain into an incorruptible refuge named Xibalba.
threads.quote: Let this plan be named "Xibalba," a title borrowed from the humans of my domain, their primitive myths whispering of an underworld.

threads.claim: Dragons view humans as born to deceive and betray, so they need dragon guidance and rule.
threads.quote: Humans are born to deceive their betters, torment weaker kin, and even betray entire clans

threads.claim: Lianca believes every conscious being has the right to freedom, regardless of origin.
threads.quote: I believe that every conscious being, whatever its origins may be, has the right to freedom.

threads.claim: Each yearning for a new place to belong triggers pain, which is part of the curse.
threads.quote: Each time you yearn for a new place to belong, each time you feel yourself turning your back on the past... the pain tears you apart, doesn't it?

threads.claim: The Eighth Lord may have been executed, which conflicts with her survival.
threads.quote: Ineffa: ...Eighth Lord, were you not executed?

threads.claim: Ineffa explains that the Eighth Lord never betrayed dragonkind and remained proud to the end.
threads.quote: The Eighth Lord... She never betrayed dragonkind. Even though she harbored goodwill towards human beings, and despite facing execution and destruction in the end...

threads.claim: Varka invites the Honorary Knight to find him at the Flagship tavern in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: come look for me at "The Flagship," it's a tavern.

threads.claim: The Fatui's control device is built with Marionette's technology, hinting at her as a Fatui power.
threads.quote: This is a replica control device made with Marionette's technology.

threads.claim: Marionette had warned the Fatui that the Traveler was an unpredictable variable.
threads.quote: Marionette told us to watch out for you... she said you were an... unpredictable variable...

introduced.name: Lauwick
introduced.how: Amateur troupe member who explains the troupe is disbanding after this final show
introduced.quote: We're not some high-profile theater troupe. Just a group of amateur enthusiasts.

introduced.name: Aurelie
introduced.how: Founder and artistic director of the troupe, who was a victim of the serial disappearances
introduced.quote: Her name was Aurelie, and she was the founder as well as artistic director of our troupe.

introduced.name: Pauleau
introduced.how: Main actor who plays the protagonist's lover and is writing the script's ending
introduced.quote: The first is Pauleau, who plays the protagonist's lover. He's locked himself away to focus on writing and ending for the script.

introduced.name: Vilmant
introduced.how: Main actor who plays the antagonist and took the director's death hard
introduced.quote: The other is Vilmant, who plays the main antagonist. He took the director's death pretty hard.

introduced.name: Dulphy
introduced.how: Troupe member with an incurable illness who was taken in by the director
introduced.quote: I was born with an incurable illness, and once my family found out it couldn't be treated, they decided they didn't want me anymore.

introduced.name: Elain
introduced.how: Troupe member who thanks the Traveler and Paimon for bringing the director's murderer to justice
introduced.quote: You helped bring our director's murderer to justice. We can't thank you enough.

introduced.name: Buraud
introduced.how: Troupe member who recalls the trial as a major event
introduced.quote: You bet! That was the trial of the century!

introduced.name: The Little Oceanid
introduced.how: The unfinished musical script left behind by the director, which the troupe wants to stage
introduced.quote: Yeah, that's the name of our final show. It's an unfinished script left behind by our director.

introduced.name: Oceanid
introduced.how: A water spirit who can transform into human form, the protagonist of the play
introduced.quote: The protagonist of the story is a young Oceanid who transforms herself into human form, despite the protests of her family.

introduced.name: Clio
introduced.how: The little Oceanid protagonist of the script, who sacrifices herself for her lover and humanity
introduced.quote: The little Oceanid, Clio, and her lover decide to do something about it, and investigate the truth of the matter together.

introduced.name: Poisson
introduced.how: A town that was flooded not long ago
introduced.quote: I thought the last thing his friend would want right now would be to take visitors, given that Poisson was flooded not too long ago.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: President of Spina di Rosula who is considerate and tries to shield Furina from Poisson's resentment
introduced.quote: I am the courageous and considerate president of Spina di Rosula, after all, like my father before me.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: An organization with a ship that offers Poisson views and hospitality
introduced.quote: How about we check out Spina di Rosula's ship? We should have a view of the whole of Poisson from there.

introduced.name: serial disappearances case
introduced.how: A series of disappearances in which the director was a victim and a culprit was later brought to justice
introduced.quote: And tragically, she... was a victim in the serial disappearances case.

introduced.name: Poisson flood disaster
introduced.how: A flood where people were swept away and Furina did not intervene as the Hydro Archon
introduced.quote: One after another, people were taken by the water... All those treasured lives and memories, washed out of existence in an instant.

introduced.name: Focalors
introduced.how: A role Furina had to assume for a long time, which left her no interest in acting
introduced.quote: especially after having to assume the role of Focalors for so long

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: A large opera venue Furina had departed from and which is the performance site
introduced.quote: Furina declines, stating that they'll need a bigger one - the Opera Epiclese, which surprises the troupe, as they believe themselves unworthy of it.

introduced.name: Hydro Archon
introduced.how: A divine figure the people of Fontaine trusted to protect them from disaster
introduced.quote: They thought their god would protect them. They had absolute faith that when disaster struck, a divine power would save them from harm.

introduced.name: Indemnitium
introduced.how: a material the Hydro Archon's power was converted into
introduced.quote: The Hydro Archon willingly gave up all of her power so it could be converted into Indemnitium.

introduced.name: Sinthe
introduced.how: a drink that induces euphoria but significantly harms the body
introduced.quote: I remember that it induces a state of euphoria.

introduced.name: Aurelie
introduced.how: the troupe's artistic director, whose notebook survives her
