threads.quote: Nahida: Once Dunyarzad could no longer bear the Akasha harvesting her dreams, her consciousness began to dissipate — but this also meant it escaped the Akasha's control.

threads.claim: Rukkhadevata's residual message in Irminsul remains undeciphered and dangerously contaminated.
threads.quote: Nahida: ...I still haven't managed to decipher it. Even the Akasha isn't currently capable of doing that.

threads.claim: Deciphering the Irminsul message is believed to be the key to saving Irminsul.
threads.quote: Nahida: But I believe this is the key to saving Irminsul. That's why I've kept trying to decipher it.

threads.claim: Rukkhadevata vanished after the Khaenri'ah disaster, and the timing lines up with the Traveler's vision.
threads.quote: Nahida: As you two probably know, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata disappeared after the disaster in Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: Nahida is revealed to be Lesser Lord Kusanali, the Moon who has been hinting all along.
threads.quote: Traveler: You are Lesser Lord Kusanali.

threads.claim: Nilou is revealed as the dream host, and her awareness of the dream is what breaks the samsara.
threads.quote: Paimon: Th—They disappeared! So Nilou's the host. What a surprise!

threads.claim: Leaving the city may erase the Traveler's memories, which hints that something is hidden outside.
threads.quote: Traveler: Leaving the city might trigger disruptions to our memories...

threads.claim: Nahida calls herself the Moon and says the real Sun is long gone, hinting at a deeper hidden story.
threads.quote: Nahida: In the end, I'm just the Moon. The real Sun is long gone.

introduced.name: Ann
introduced.how: Member of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team who leads the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: My name is Ann, a member of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team
introduced.how: Group of rebels trying to rescue Princess Lyris and reclaim the kingdom
introduced.quote: We banded together to rescue Princess Lyris and reclaim the realm.

introduced.name: Narcissus
introduced.how: Fell dragon who conquered the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom and has designs on the Princess's treasures
introduced.quote: But later, the kingdom fell to the predations of Narcissus, a fell dragon who had designs on the Princess and her treasures.

introduced.name: Petit Chou
introduced.how: Member of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team, captured by Narcissus's minions
introduced.quote: I am Petit Chou, a member of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team.

introduced.name: Princess Lyris
introduced.how: Princess of the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom who is trapped in a tower by Narcissus
introduced.quote: We banded together to rescue Princess Lyris and reclaim the realm.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Kingdom
introduced.how: Kingdom conquered by the fell dragon Narcissus
introduced.quote: Hmm? Well, after the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom was conquered by Narcissus the fell dragon...

introduced.name: Annapausis
introduced.how: Name given to the fallen kingdom in remembrance of the stagnant Princess
introduced.quote: Princess Lyris hid herself away in a high tower and entered a deep slumber.

introduced.name: Reconquista
introduced.how: Campaign to retake the kingdom from Narcissus, opposed by Narcissus's creatures
introduced.quote: That which we just defeated was an evil being born from those waters, an entity that opposes the Reconquista.

introduced.name: Aegis of Four Orthants
introduced.how: Protective power Narcissus gave his subordinates that blocks the team's powers
introduced.quote: Narcissus has girded his subordinates with the Aegis of Four Orthants, so our powers are unable to overcome them.

introduced.name: Al
introduced.how: Petit Chou's older brother and a team member who covered the team's retreat
introduced.quote: let's go help my brother Al!

introduced.name: Jak
introduced.how: Member of Orchestre Jak who rejects royal titles and argues with Al
introduced.quote: Hmm. As I thought, you were the ones who emptied the water out. Excellent, excellent!

introduced.name: Orchestre Jak
introduced.how: Collective of people who act on personal ability, opposed to hierarchy
introduced.quote: In that case, welcome to Orchestre Jak.

introduced.name: Colonel Kate
introduced.how: Commander of Kate's Resistance Front who orders the bubble cannons attacked
introduced.quote: It seems that Colonel Kate is still here.

introduced.name: Kate's Resistance Front
introduced.how: Militia led by Colonel Kate that aims to fight for the Princess and the Reconquista
introduced.quote: It's a pleasure to have new blood like you in Kate's Resistance Front.

introduced.name: Ney
introduced.how: Former older brother who dissolved into the waters while hiding the Princess's treasure
introduced.quote: Before, we had another older brother... Ney.

introduced.name: Mori
introduced.how: Talking Forest Boar dog who guards the statue of the Princess
introduced.quote: Mori is Mori. Must protect the princess.

introduced.name: Three Royal Blades of Narcissus
introduced.how: Three leaders who guard Narcissus's Bubble Formations
introduced.quote: I am but the weakest among the Three Royal Blades of Narcissus...

introduced.name: Bubble Formation
introduced.how: Water-powered bubble cannons that bombard intruders from afar and must be destroyed
introduced.quote: They are underhanded contraptions powered by that can bombard intruders from a great distance...

introduced.name: Four Divine Kings of Narcissus
introduced.how: Elite henchmen of Narcissus who guard the tower seals
introduced.quote: It's the notorious Four Divine Kings of Narcissus! Let us help you, Al!

assumed.name: Temples of the Four Winds
assumed.quote: After fighting the dragon, we were sent off to the temples of the Four Winds...

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Like Mondstadt's Dvalin...

assumed.name: Azhdaha
assumed.quote: Like Liyue's Azhdaha...

assumed.name: Apep
assumed.quote: Like Sumeru's Apep...

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: is an Honorary Knight, but got it in Mondstadt for heroically doing battle with Stormterror!

assumed.name: Hydro Abyss Mages
assumed.quote: That sounds like the trick those Hydro Abyss Mages pull...

assumed.name: Oceanid
assumed.quote: Is this some kind of Oceanid magic?

threads.claim: Narcissus may not be a dragon at all, since the thing above the tower looks like an Oceanid.
threads.quote: Look up, above Princess Lyris's tower — that is Narcissus.

threads.claim: Narcissus's evil has taken the form of an image on the tower, which appeared once the waters drained.
threads.quote: Narcissus's evil has melded with the waters, which is why his wicked intent crystallized into that image once the waters were drained.

threads.claim: Princess Lyris is asleep in a stagnant tower, and her fate is unresolved.
threads.quote: Princess Lyris hid herself away in a high tower and entered a deep slumber.

threads.claim: The statue Mori guards is not the Princess, and the real Princess is still sealed in her tower.
threads.quote: This is just a statue of the Princess. She's still in the tower.

threads.claim: Princess Lyris gave her time as a treasure to the team, and the loss of that time froze the kingdom.
threads.quote: At that time, when all seemed lost, the Princess gave her greatest treasure to us

threads.claim: The treasure is a pocketwatch holding Lyris's time, which the team recovers and uses to unseal the tower.
threads.quote: This is... full of Princess Lyris's precious time.

threads.claim: Ney hid the treasure in a purified patch of water in the sky before dissolving.
threads.quote: Before Ney dissolved, he used the last of his strength to purify a patch of water in the firmament.

threads.claim: Ney died in the waters while protecting the team and carrying the treasure.
threads.quote: he dissolved into the waters while covering us.

threads.claim: Jak believes royal titles and hierarchy are oppressive and that a more rational world needs no kings or princes.
threads.quote: If the universe was a more rational one, there would be no gods, no kings, and certainly no princes or princesses.

threads.claim: Al argues that purpose defines essence rather than category, which leaves the nature of dragons unsettled.
threads.quote: Our purpose defines our essence.

threads.claim: The Annapausis seems to distort categories, so that a boar can be a dog and an Oceanid can be an evil dragon.
threads.quote: In this Annapausis, a boar is a dog, an Oceanid is an evil dragon, and the evil dragon turned out to be a statue...

threads.claim: The Traveler has defeated dragons in the past, hinting at an earlier knightly deed.
threads.quote: Well, I have defeated a dragon in the past.

threads.claim: The library's children's stories never truly end, as new adventures always follow.
threads.quote: Yet it will not end. There will be another adventure, and another, and another one after that

threads.claim: Mori stays behind to protect the Princess, who once played with him and the team.
threads.quote: Only the Princess remains. So I protect her.

threads.claim: Alain left the team, and Ann is troubled by what changed him.
threads.quote: Alain split with them.

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: a disguised adeptus who goes by Houzhang in the mortal realm
introduced.quote: the two reveal themselves as Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver, taking on the names Houzhang and Jiehu.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: a disguised adeptus who goes by Jiehu in the mortal realm
introduced.quote: You stand in the presence of the mighty and illuminated adeptus, Moon Carver.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: a proud adeptus mechanic who left the mountains to live in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer is of a proud and arrogant disposition. She holds the belief that her skill in mechanics surpasses that of all others.

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: the mountain home Cloud Retainer left for Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Jueyun Karst has been unusually quiet

introduced.name: Streetward Rambler
introduced.how: an adeptus whose horticultural skill is the best among the Adepti
introduced.quote: Among all the Adepti, her horticultural skill is preeminent.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: powerful immortal beings people credit with summoning the wind
introduced.quote: whenever a kite blew away, people would say it was the Adepti that summoned the wind to take it away as an offering.

introduced.name: Supreme Cuisine Machine
introduced.how: a cooking device owned by Cloud Retainer, used to make Bamboo Shoot Soup
introduced.quote: made use of Cloud Retainer's Supreme Cuisine Machine to prepare Bamboo Shoot Soup.

introduced.name: Gaming
introduced.how: a cheerful Secure Transport Agency guard who also performs Wushou dancing
introduced.quote: He works for the Secure Transport Agency, one of our sub-organizations.

introduced.name: Communications Office
introduced.how: handles shipments and transports around Liyue
introduced.quote: The Communications Office handles shipments and transports around Liyue.

introduced.name: Secure Transport Agency
introduced.how: a Liyue sub-organization of guards and delivery work
introduced.quote: He works for the Secure Transport Agency, one of our sub-organizations.

introduced.name: Longzhou
introduced.how: a Communications Office official who hires guards to deliver goods
introduced.quote: Wonderful. I'll pack them up and get a guard to deliver the goods to Yilong Wharf for you.

introduced.name: Zhenyuan
introduced.how: a kite seller at the harbor stalls
introduced.quote: Zhenyuan: Welcome! Are the two of you looking to buy a kite? Would you like me to go over the different designs?

introduced.name: Zhigui
introduced.how: Gaming's uncle who runs the Secure Transport Agency
introduced.quote: Gaming: Hey, Uncle Zhigui. These are my friends, , and Paimon.

introduced.name: Yilong Wharf
introduced.how: a small wharf town reached by boat from Qiaoying Village
introduced.quote: Paimon: Yilong Wharf? Oh, wonder what that place is like during Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Qiaoying of the Sacred Mountain
introduced.how: the village where the Sunglo tea is sourced
introduced.quote: We only sell teas of the finest quality, sourced directly from Qiaoying Village.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: raiders who intercept deliveries, which is why guards are needed
introduced.quote: Yeah, it's not uncommon for deliveries to get intercepted. That's why this job needs guards like us.

introduced.name: Wushou dancing
introduced.how: a performance art famous in Chenyu Vale, sometimes hired for business openings and holidays
introduced.quote: Wushou dancing is famous in Chenyu Vale.

introduced.name: Sunglo Tea
introduced.how: a famous tea stashed at the Secure Transport Agency
introduced.quote: I know the Secure Transport Agency has some great "Sunglo Tea" stashed around here somewhere.

introduced.name: Mechanical Vertical Lifting Device
introduced.how: a Fontaine kite technology now combined with Liyue kite-making
introduced.quote: In the end, we decided to combine Liyue's traditional art of kite-making with Fontaine's "Mechanical Vertical Lifting Device."

introduced.name: Floating Toting Device
introduced.how: a Cloud Retainer invention that makes a box float and follow its owner
introduced.quote: One calls it the "Floating Toting Device."

introduced.name: Jade Chamber kite design
introduced.how: a new kite design said to bring wealth to whoever flies it
introduced.quote: Zhenyuan: Of course. The Jade Chamber symbolizes wealth and abundance.

introduced.name: Kite symbolism
introduced.how: kite designs and colors carry traditional meanings like freedom and good fortune
introduced.quote: kites in the shape of a butterfly typically symbolize freedom, happiness, or the desire to break free.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite kite theme
introduced.how: this year's Lantern Rite is themed around kites
introduced.quote: Keqing: It seems you haven't heard yet. The theme of this year's Lantern Rite is "Kites."

introduced.name: Liyue under human rule
introduced.how: Liyue is now governed by humans rather than the Adepti
introduced.quote: Exactly. Liyue is now a nation ruled by humans after all.

introduced.name: Charbonnier
introduced.how: a Fontaine toy merchant selling clockwork toys in Liyue
introduced.quote: Charbonnier: I'm a toy merchant from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Fenglian
introduced.how: a tea seller running Lantern Rite discounts on Sunglo tea
introduced.quote: Welcome! Please have a look around. We only sell teas of the finest quality, sourced directly from Qiaoying Village.

introduced.name: Gaming's relatives
introduced.how: Gaming's large family, whom he avoids and who worry about him
introduced.quote: Granny: Gaming! When did you get here? Oh, you've lost even more weight.

introduced.name: Bosu
introduced.how: a boatman and friend of Gaming who ferries people to the wharf
introduced.quote: Thanks for the ride, Uncle Bosu. You take care of yourself now.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Keqing: Nice to see you again, and Paimon.

assumed.name: Charlotte
assumed.quote: Charlotte: Not at all. I wasn't in the middle of an interview or anything.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Keqing: So, Ningguang organized a private meeting with Miss Charlotte to ask for her help in fostering cooperation with the right people.

assumed.name: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
assumed.quote: Charlotte: Yeah, remember my "business meeting" with Tianquan Ningguang the last time I was in Liyue Harbor? That's what it was about.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: The Traveler and Paimon realize that another year has passed since the last Lantern Rite

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: we gathered at Mt. Hulao with Rex Lapis and made use of Cloud Retainer's Supreme Cuisine Machine to prepare Bamboo Shoot Soup.

assumed.name: Mt. Hulao
assumed.quote: one planted karst crawlers around Mt. Hulao.

assumed.name: Qixing
assumed.quote: The Qixing do attract a lot of attention.

assumed.name: Yaoyao
assumed.quote: The young lass, Yaoyao, keeps no secrets from Cloud Retainer.

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: One might as well give some to Morax and Ping too.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: we'll go straight to the Millelith and have you arrested for impersonating Adepti!

assumed.name: Baizhu
assumed.quote: Gaming personally went all the way to Bubu Pharmacy to get some medicine for him from Dr. Baizhu

threads.claim: Jueyun Karst has gone strangely quiet since Cloud Retainer moved to Liyue Harbor, hinting something is wrong.
threads.quote: Jueyun Karst has been unusually quiet

threads.claim: The adepti suspect Cloud Retainer has shut herself away and buried herself in her own creations.
threads.quote: One surmises that she has shut herself away, refused all company, and buried herself in the study of her own creations...

threads.claim: Liyue is embracing foreign technology, which the Qixing believe will strengthen its own culture.
threads.quote: The Qixing believes it would benefit Liyue to build on our own cultural foundation by embracing the technologies of other nations.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer scorns the imported mechanical lifting device as crude next to her own craft.
threads.quote: 'Tis nothing but a crude piece of mortal machinery.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer has built a box that floats and follows its owner, an unexplained invention.
threads.quote: One calls it the "Floating Toting Device."

threads.claim: Adepti are walking the mortal world in disguise, and their reasons for coming down are not yet explained.
threads.quote: For the purpose of this foray into the mortal realm, however, you may address one as Houzhang.

threads.claim: Gaming is estranged from his family, and the reason is a story he has not yet told.
threads.quote: Besides, the thing between me and my family... It's a long story. It might take some time to tell.

threads.claim: Gaming's uncle hopes he can reconcile with his family, but the rift remains unresolved.
threads.quote: Gaming is a good kid. I just wish he could reconcile with his family.

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders keep ambushing deliveries during Lantern Rite, so guards are needed.
threads.quote: Yeah, it's not uncommon for deliveries to get intercepted. That's why this job needs guards like us.

threads.claim: Kite designs carry meanings such as freedom and the desire to break free.
threads.quote: kites in the shape of a butterfly typically symbolize freedom, happiness, or the desire to break free.

introduced.name: Asmoday
introduced.how: a white-clad god who blocks the twins' path and seals the Traveler and sibling
introduced.quote: Asmoday: Outlanders, your journey ends here.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Asmoday claims to be the sustainer of heavenly principles
introduced.quote: The sustainer of heavenly principles.

introduced.name: Outlanders
introduced.how: the Traveler came from another world and fell into Teyvat
introduced.quote: Paimon: So... what you're trying to say is that you fell here... from another world?

introduced.name: Amber
introduced.how: introduces herself as an Outrider of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: Amber: I am Amber, Outrider for the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Kaeya
introduced.how: introduces himself as the Knights' Cavalry Captain
introduced.quote: Kaeya: Ehe... My apologies. I'm Kaeya, Cavalry Captain for the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Jean
introduced.how: introduced as Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: Jean: I am Jean, Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. This is Lisa, our resident Librarian.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: introduced as the Knights' librarian and mage
introduced.quote: Lisa: I'm Lisa, the librarian. Do you need anything, cutie?

introduced.name: Grand Master
introduced.how: the Grand Master is away on an expedition, leaving Jean in charge
introduced.quote: Kaeya: The Grand Master is currently off leading an expedition, so the Master, Jean, has stepped in to oversee the Knights while he's gone.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: the city's protective knightly order that Amber, Kaeya and Jean belong to
introduced.quote: Amber: Travelers under the protection of the Knights of Favonius — Welcome to Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: a city of wind, dandelions and freedom under Knights' protection
introduced.quote: Amber: Let me officially introduce the city of wind, dandelions, and freedom —

introduced.name: Stormterror
introduced.how: a huge dragon the locals call Stormterror that is wrecking orchards and the market
introduced.quote: Amber: But because the dragon — Stormterror — has been around a lot more recently, our orchards have been destroyed and the local market has been affected as well.

introduced.name: Dvalin
introduced.how: Stormterror's real name is Dvalin, which most in Mondstadt have forgotten
introduced.quote: Lisa: The Dragon of the East, Stormterror — its real name, is Dvalin.

introduced.name: Four Winds
introduced.how: the four wind guardians of Mondstadt, the Dragon, Lion, Wolf and Falcon, tied to Barbatos
introduced.quote: Lisa: They are the Four Winds of Mondstadt, affiliated with Barbatos, the God of Anemo.

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: the God of Anemo whose Four Winds protect Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Lisa: They are the Four Winds of Mondstadt, affiliated with Barbatos, the God of Anemo.

introduced.name: Temples of the Four Winds
introduced.how: temples where Stormterror draws its power from, which must be cleared
introduced.quote: Lisa: Stormterror's ability to whip up these kinds of storms can be attributed to it drawing power from the temples.

introduced.name: Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: statues scattered across the land showing The Seven's protection, one controls wind
introduced.quote: Paimon: There are a few of these statues scattered across the land to show The Seven's protection over the world.

introduced.name: Anemo
introduced.how: the wind element the Traveler receives by touching the statue
introduced.quote: Paimon: Seems all you had to do was just touch the statue and you got the power of Anemo!

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a gem used by the chosen to draw on elemental powers
introduced.quote: Lisa: It's used by the chosen to draw on elemental powers.

introduced.name: Anemoculus
introduced.how: solidified wind that people offer to statues in exchange for blessings
introduced.quote: Paimon: In Mondstadt, people call them "Anemoculi."

introduced.name: Wind Glider
introduced.how: a glider Outriders and Mondstadt people use to ride the wind
introduced.quote: Amber: Outriders use them to ride the wind, and the people of Mondstadt love using them too.

introduced.name: Hilichurl
introduced.how: monsters that have been setting up camps near the city
introduced.quote: Amber: These monsters have been getting too close to the city recently.

introduced.name: Dvalin's hatred for Mondstadt
introduced.how: Dvalin's hatred drove it to become the storm dragon Stormterror
introduced.quote: Lisa: Hatred drove it to become something more powerful than the wind itself — to become Stormterror.

assumed.name: Sticky Honey Roast
assumed.quote: Traveler: I just heard about that one!

assumed.name: Anemo God
assumed.quote: Paimon'll take you to the Anemo God's place first, and there's a reason why~

assumed.name: Pyro Slime
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's the smell of burnt Pyro Slimes.

assumed.name: Electro-Charged
assumed.quote: Lisa: Chain lightning can be set off between Electro-Charged opponents.

assumed.name: Abyss Mage
assumed.quote: (A Hydro Abyss Mage reveals itself)

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Lisa: Simply put, Mondstadt's elemental sphere and ley lines are now akin to a yarn ball in the paws of a kitten.

threads.claim: The Traveler's twin sibling was taken by Asmoday and the Traveler is determined to find them.
threads.quote: (Traveler): Wait! Don't go! Give my back!

threads.claim: A seal cast by the god stripped the Traveler of their powers and trapped them in Teyvat.
threads.quote: (Traveler): Some kind of seal was cast upon me, and I lost my power.

threads.claim: The Traveler is from another world, and their origin is what makes them different from people of Teyvat.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ah-ha, it's because you're not from this world to begin with.

threads.claim: Asmoday claims a higher heavenly order that defines who counts as mankind, hinting at a hidden cosmic power.
threads.quote: The sustainer of heavenly principles.

threads.claim: The Traveler channels elemental power without a Vision, and the reason remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Traveler... Unless I'm mistaken, you don't seem to have a Vision.

threads.claim: The Anemo God may know something about the Traveler's lost sibling, but this is only a hope.
threads.quote: Paimon: So perhaps, because you got power from the God of Anemo, you can find some clues there.

threads.claim: A strange red crystal from Stormterror's area is dangerous and its nature is unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: There's some kind of shiny red thingy on the big rock over there...

threads.claim: A boy calmly speaks to the dragon and vanishes using Anemo powers, a mystery about his link to the dragon.
threads.quote: ???: ...Don't be afraid.

threads.claim: A mysterious voice claims to be guiding the Traveler's wind-riding, deepening the question of who is helping them.
threads.quote: Mysterious Voice: I'm preventing your fall with the power of a thousand winds.

threads.claim: Stormterror was once one of the Four Winds, which raises the question of how a guardian became a threat.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Stormterror was once one of The Four Winds.

threads.claim: Dvalin's hatred for Mondstadt is what drove it to become Stormterror, though the reason is still hard to say aloud.
threads.quote: Lisa: Hatred for Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Stormterror can only draw on three of the Four Winds' powers, and the reason is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Jean: I trust everyone understands why we are only dealing with three.

threads.claim: Dvalin can only channel three winds because it has been consuming itself from the beginning.
threads.quote: Lisa: So now you know why Dvalin is only able to channel three of the Four Winds' power.

threads.claim: An Abyss Mage was secretly pulling strings behind the hilichurl ambush and the temple defenses.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Thus YOU were behind this.

threads.claim: An unfamiliar red-headed man appears and easily defeats the Abyss Mage, suggesting he is a hidden power.
threads.quote: (A red-headed man defeats the Abyss Mage)

threads.claim: The Grand Master has left on an expedition, leaving the Knights stretched thin under Jean.
threads.quote: Kaeya: The Grand Master is currently off leading an expedition, so the Master, Jean, has stepped in to oversee the Knights while he's gone.

threads.claim: Mondstadt is called the City of Freedom, a theme of freedom tied to the city's identity.
threads.quote: Paimon: If we keep heading west from here, we'll eventually reach Mondstadt, the City of Freedom.

threads.claim: Kaeya's wind-gliding style seems familiar and he hides a past, implying a secret history.
threads.quote: Kaeya: You're not bad with that wind glider. Your gliding style seems familiar...

threads.claim: Nobody makes offerings to the Four Winds anymore, yet the old winds never vanish.
threads.quote: Kaeya: No one makes offerings to The Four Winds anymore, yet the old winds never vanish...

introduced.name: Kaedehara Yoshinori
introduced.how: Kazuha's great-grandfather, who confronted the culprit on the beach and later wrote a letter about it
introduced.quote: I, Kaedehara Yoshinori, have been held to a certain secret throughout my entire life.

introduced.name: Kunikuzushi
introduced.how: the eccentric stranger behind the tampered diagram, who defeated the group and gave his name
introduced.quote: Tell her this. My name is Kunikuzushi.

introduced.name: The Five Kasen
introduced.how: legendary poets from ancient Inazuma whose stories became subjects of many tales
introduced.quote: The Five Kasen are legendary figures from ancient Inazuma, famous for their works of poetry.

introduced.name: Kuronushi
introduced.how: one of The Five Kasen, with no dedicated chapter in the stories
introduced.quote: I learned from existing sources about those stories that the character of Kuronushi is the deepest and most differing of The Five Kasen.

introduced.name: Isshin Art
introduced.how: the Kaedehara family's sword-forging art, which failed to produce the required blade
introduced.quote: forging an important Goshintou according to an ancient forging diagram

introduced.name: Goshintou
introduced.how: an important sacred blade the Isshin Art was tasked with forging
introduced.quote: forging an important Goshintou according to an ancient forging diagram

introduced.name: Ancient Forging Blueprint
introduced.how: the forging diagram that was later found to have been tampered with, kept by the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: I heard yesterday that the Yashiro Commission has still kept the diagram ever since the failed forging all those years ago.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Clan
introduced.how: Kazuha's family, which was punished and declined after the forging failure
introduced.quote: The Kaedehara Clan was severely punished for the swordsmiths that had escaped, and the family gradually fell into decline.

introduced.name: Kaedehara Yoshinori's Letter
introduced.how: a letter, revealed by water, in which Yoshinori tells of the framing and the culprit
introduced.quote: It is a letter written by my great-grandfather.

introduced.name: Special water-revealed ink
introduced.how: ink that only shows up when exposed to water, used to hide messages
introduced.quote: the secret behind the ink, the kind that would only appear when exposed to water.

introduced.name: Niwa
introduced.how: the surname of Yoshinori's father, which the culprit asked about
introduced.quote: sternly asked if I had any connection with the name "Niwa."

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: revealed as the Balladeer, the one behind the trouble from years ago
introduced.quote: So he was the one behind the trouble all those years ago!

introduced.name: Flowerpot with hidden compartment
introduced.how: a dead bonsai pot left by Yoshinori that hid the letter in a compartment
introduced.quote: This flowerpot was in my house for a long time.

introduced.name: Beach confrontation with Kunikuzushi
introduced.how: Yoshinori and the Kamisato head were defeated by a lone stranger on the shore
introduced.quote: It was night, and after the clues led us down to shore, I waited for the culprits to show themselves.

introduced.name: Death of the Kamisato head
introduced.how: the Kamisato head was wounded by fleeing smiths and died soon after
introduced.quote: Moreover, I heard that the head of the Kamisato Clan was injured by the fleeing swordsmiths, which, combined with his advanced age, caused him to pass away shortly thereafter.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: Greetings Traveler, Paimon.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Please come meet me at the Kamisato Estate later.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Kazuha, since the items are scattered throughout the building, I propose we split up and look for clues.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Hmm, there must be some around here somewhere...

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you. Unfortunately, I have yet to find anything of value here.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Well, hello everyone.

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Hmm, Thoma sure is taking his sweet time...

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: The Kaedehara Clan and Yashiro Commission then conducted an investigation.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: After I became a wanted criminal, the Tenryou Commission seized my family's last remaining estate, which contained all of my family's old belongings.

assumed.name: Raiden Gokaden
assumed.quote: He then threatened to destroy the Raiden Gokaden.

assumed.name: Shuumatsuban
assumed.quote: I sent a member of the Shuumatsuban to keep watch over the warehouse.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: the person who tried to furtively search for the secret was a Fatui spy

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: You're Kaedehara Kazuha, a wanted criminal during the Vision Hunt Decree.

assumed.name: Sakoku Decree
assumed.quote: It was just after the Shogun announced the abolition of the Sakoku Decree.

assumed.name: Irodori Festival
assumed.quote: Today's the final stage of the Irodori Festival.

assumed.name: Kanjou Commission
assumed.quote: soldiers from the Kanjou Commission guarding against possible intruders.

assumed.name: Kujou Sara
assumed.quote: Madam Kujou has already informed me of the situation.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: let's head back to Ritou.

threads.claim: The culprit who framed the Kaedehara Clan calls himself Kunikuzushi, and his identity and motive remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Tell her this. My name is Kunikuzushi.

threads.claim: Albedo confirms the forging diagram was tampered with, showing the Kaedehara Clan was framed.
threads.quote: Kazuha, this is clear evidence that this chart was indeed tampered with. Someone framed the Kaedehara Clan all those years ago.

threads.claim: The Balladeer is revealed as Scaramouche, the one responsible for the trouble in the past.
threads.quote: So he was the one behind the trouble all those years ago!

threads.claim: Ayato is revealed as the one who left the Five Kasen stories to guide the group toward the Kaedehara secret.
threads.quote: Ayato! you're the one behind the stories of The Five Kasen!

threads.claim: Ayato asks which part of Yoshinori's experiences was the secret to protect, and he leaves the question unanswered.
threads.quote: Which part of Kaedehara Yoshinori's experiences was the secret that needed to be protected?

threads.claim: Albedo notes Yoshinori's phrasing was odd, hinting that he knew the diagram had been tampered with.
threads.quote: But instead he said, "If you can't find the secret within."

threads.claim: A Fatui spy secretly searched the Kaedehara warehouse for a secret and left without finding it.
threads.quote: the person who tried to furtively search for the secret was a Fatui spy

threads.claim: Kazuha suggests people can let go of their burdens and then follow the wind freely.
threads.quote: And when they finally let go, they are free to follow the wind as they please.

threads.claim: The answer to Kunikuzushi's identity is hidden in Albedo's Kuronushi portrait and appears only when it is splashed with water.
threads.quote: The answer is actually hidden in the portrait of Kuronushi.

threads.claim: The culprit asks about the Niwa surname and speaks of a "her" to be told his name, leaving both unexplained.
threads.quote: sternly asked if I had any connection with the name "Niwa."

threads.claim: Ayato says his ancestors failed to protect the Kaedehara, so the duty now falls on him.
threads.quote: The Kaedehara Clan used to be subordinates of the Kamisato Clan. It was my ancestors who were unable to protect them all those years ago.

introduced.name: Badawi
introduced.how: a desert client who commissions a building and keeps rejecting Kaveh's designs
introduced.quote: Badawi: I've taken a look at your proposal. It's much better than the ones you showed me before, but I'd still like to make some changes...

introduced.name: Lambad
introduced.how: the tavern owner who serves Kaveh his drinks
introduced.quote: Lambad: Wine and a glass of juice, coming right up.

introduced.name: Lambad's Tavern
introduced.how: the tavern where Kaveh goes to drink after the argument
introduced.quote: (The Traveler watches Kaveh go straight into Lambad's Tavern.)

introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.how: a longtime friend Kaveh has argued about ideals with for years
introduced.quote: I've known Alhaitham for many years now, and discussed my ideology with him for nearly as long.

introduced.name: Mehrak
introduced.how: Kaveh's mechanical toolbox, built from an ancient mechanical core, that helps with tasks
introduced.quote: My toolbox. I built it using an ancient mechanical core. It's not too smart, but it's super useful, and can help me with a variety of tasks.

introduced.name: Setaria
introduced.how: the official in charge of desert educational assistance programs
introduced.quote: My name is Setaria, and I'm currently the person in charge of promoting educational assistance programs here in the desert.

introduced.name: Zaha Hadi
introduced.how: a famous Kshahrewar scholar and garden design expert who taught Kaveh's mother
introduced.quote: Huh, you've really never heard of her? She's a famous Kshahrewar scholar, and leading expert in formal garden design.

introduced.name: Alkami
introduced.how: Kaveh's former senior classmate who no longer takes private commissions
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Hold on! I just remembered that I used to have a senior classmate by the name of Alkami.

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: a shrewd, greedy merchant who might introduce them to sponsors
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Her? Hard pass. With her shrewd and greedy personality, she would never put Mora into something like this.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: a desert mercenary group that Badawi joined young and fought with
introduced.quote: Badawi: I joined the Eremites when I was young, and won many battles with them.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: a desert village chosen as the site for the library
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Okay, then we can pay a visit to Aaru Village.

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: an Akademiya contest Kaveh's father lost, after which he took a desert research post
introduced.quote: Kaveh: When I was young, I encouraged my father on a whim to take part in the first Interdarshan Championship hosted by the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Kaveh's father's death
introduced.how: Kaveh's father vanished in the desert and is said to have died in quicksand
introduced.quote: Kaveh: I never saw him again. Word has it that he got caught in quicksand.

introduced.name: Kaveh's mother's notebook
introduced.how: a locked notebook of Kaveh's mother whose password Kaveh never guessed
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Ah, this is my mother's notebook. She used to write and sketch in it all the time.

introduced.name: Kaveh's desert scam
introduced.how: Kaveh once lost a large sum of Mora to a desert client who hired mercenaries to ambush him
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Just a hunch. A while ago, I accepted an offer to work on a project in the desert, and was also scammed out of a large sum of Mora.

introduced.name: Kaveh's mother
introduced.how: an architect whose drawings Kaveh admired as a child, now living abroad
introduced.quote: Kaveh: My mother is also an architect. I've always adored her drawings, and when I was young, I used to sit next to her and watch her bring all kinds of buildings to life on paper.

introduced.name: House of Daena
introduced.how: Akademiya reading space where Kaveh drew designs and scholars annotated books
introduced.quote: I created many designs that I thought were beautiful in the House of Daena.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: scholarly institution whose rules let scholars annotate any physical book
introduced.quote: The Akademiya also had a rule that allowed scholars to annotate any physical books they came across.

introduced.name: First meeting of Kaveh and Alhaitham
introduced.how: Kaveh and Alhaitham first met at the House of Daena
introduced.quote: the House of Daena is where Alhaitham and I first met.

introduced.name: Kaveh and Alhaitham's research collaboration
introduced.how: they once collaborated as students but parted ways before finishing the project
introduced.quote: When I was still a student at the Akademiya, I once collaborated with Kaveh on a research project.

introduced.name: Ex-Grand Conservator
introduced.how: former Grand Conservator who complained about Kaveh's annotations and had the books moved
introduced.quote: Leave any words of thanks you may have to the ex-Grand Conservator.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: harbor city that existed long before, later expanded into two levels by Kaveh's project
introduced.quote: Port Ormos had already existed since I was still a young child.

introduced.name: Arch bridge of Port Ormos
introduced.how: bridge in Port Ormos that is one of Kaveh's designs, splitting the city into two levels
introduced.quote: The arch bridge over there, for example... That was one of my designs.

introduced.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
introduced.how: Kaveh's magnum opus, the building that left him deep in debt, and where Dori lives
introduced.quote: I got into a huge pile of debt building the Palace of Alcazarzaray...

introduced.name: The Dune of Magma
introduced.how: desert site Kaveh visits to clear his mind, filled with Primal Constructs
introduced.quote: Isn't this place great? I often come here to clear my mind when I'm dealing with a difficult situation.

introduced.name: Primal Constructs
introduced.how: enemy constructs that gathered at the Dune of Magma and must be cleared
introduced.quote: Who would have thought that so many Primal Constructs could have congregated here while I was gone...

introduced.name: Kaveh's mother
introduced.how: an architect whose career path Kaveh says he followed
introduced.quote: You could probably say I've followed in the path of my mother.

introduced.name: Lord Sangemah Bay
introduced.how: alias of Dori, presented as the most famous merchant in Sumeru
introduced.quote: Would the kind and generous Lord Sangemah Bay really do such a thing?

introduced.name: Tippu
introduced.how: Dori's business associate, a merchant who refuses to fund the desert library
introduced.quote: Dori gave us a brief introduction about the two of you.

introduced.name: Rubab
introduced.how: Dori's business associate, a merchant who weighs the reputation value of sponsorship
introduced.quote: They are Dori's associates, after all.

introduced.name: Qasimi
introduced.how: Dori's business associate, a cautious merchant who doubts the long-term profit
introduced.quote: Hmm, then the commission fees will likely be very low. You should be careful.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: desert village that is the prime site for an education and culture complex
introduced.quote: If we were to build a library and a school near Aaru Village

introduced.name: Desert library commission
introduced.how: Kaveh was commissioned to build a public library in the desert but lacks funding
introduced.quote: I've been commissioned to build a library in the desert, with the intended goal of allowing the desert-dwellers to have more access to reading materials.

introduced.name: Dori as Kaveh's creditor
introduced.how: Dori is the creditor Kaveh owes money to, and he charges fees for introductions
introduced.quote: You might want to remember who your creditor is before you start talking like that, Kaveh.

introduced.name: Alkami
introduced.how: Kaveh's former classmate who now runs a training center teaching architecture for pay
introduced.quote: Ah, Kaveh, it's you! It's been a while

introduced.name: Alkami's training center
introduced.how: A new architecture school that accepts anyone who can pay and promises quick entry into the field
introduced.quote: I recently opened up a training center with the goal of educating people in architecture design.

introduced.name: Fakhr
introduced.how: A moneylender who lends students and their families money for Alkami's classes
introduced.quote: Oh? I don't think I've ever seen you guys before. Here for business?

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: A matra official at the Akademiya who handles investigations like this one
introduced.quote: My vacation just ended not too long ago, so I'm going over some cases at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: Investigators who probe crimes, closed the training center, and arrested Fakhr
introduced.quote: A matra investigation has indicated that Alkami, the owner of this training center, coerced the families of his students to take on usurious loans with the intent of making huge profits.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: The architecture school that admits only people who pass a hard entrance exam
introduced.quote: After all, the Akademiya only admits those that can pass its entrance exam

introduced.name: Thirty percent interest limit
introduced.how: Charging interest above thirty percent is a crime
introduced.quote: Charging an interest rate over thirty percent indeed constitutes a crime.

introduced.name: Matra tip reward
introduced.how: The Akademiya pays a monetary reward to people who help resolve a case
introduced.quote: If Alkami's case can be successfully resolved, you'll be eligible for a monetary reward from the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Alkami's loan scheme
introduced.how: Alkami steered students' families to Fakhr's loans to pay the tuition
introduced.quote: Mr. Alkami was the one who reached out to my parents.

introduced.name: Uzayr
introduced.how: A student whose family is poor and borrowed money to pay for the class
introduced.quote: Truth be told, my family's not very well-off, so we couldn't really afford the tuition for this class.

introduced.name: Tanisha
introduced.how: A student who dreams of getting rich through architecture like Alkami
introduced.quote: My biggest dream is to become someone like Mr. Alkami.

introduced.name: Waiz
introduced.how: A student who admits they are in it to make Mora, not art
introduced.quote: we just want to make some Mora.

introduced.name: Shurayh
introduced.how: A student from the training center who is unsure of their next step after it closes
introduced.quote: After all those classes I took at the training center... What should I do now?

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: an ex-sage and Cyno's adoptive father, living in the city
introduced.quote: He's an ex-sage and Cyno's adoptive father.

introduced.name: Zaha Hadi
introduced.how: a retired professor and old scholar who taught Kaveh and Faranak, and runs a vegetable growing contest
introduced.quote: A few of us old scholars got bored in our retirement

introduced.name: Faranak
introduced.how: Kaveh's mother, an architect who left him her notebook and moved to Fontaine
introduced.quote: My mother left her notebook to me, but it has a password and I haven't figured out what it is yet.

introduced.name: Kaveh's father
introduced.how: an unnamed blonde man who stayed beside Faranak and supported her through her career
introduced.quote: But despite that, he still stayed next to her, listening to her joys and sharing in her sorrows.

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: Tighnari's student, who has finished the first phase of her studies and was a trainee forest ranger
introduced.quote: She's been a trainee forest ranger for so long, she'll definitely be good with her hands.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: a city whose architecture training produces notable architects, where Kaveh studied
introduced.quote: very few genius architects of Kshahrewar ever found happiness for themselves.

introduced.name: Darshans
introduced.how: six schools of the Akademiya that students can choose to enroll in
introduced.quote: There are only two other Darshans left.

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Kaveh: I mean, it's not like it's some kind of secret. You probably already know some bits and pieces of my past.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Kaveh: A library...? Funded entirely by yourself? Shouldn't this be the responsibility of the Akademiya?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Kaveh: And if I want to make Mora, I should finish that ridiculous commission... But I really can't find it in me to go back and talk to him right now.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Lambad: The meaning of art? Really, my friend, who in Sumeru understands art better than you?

assumed.name: Vahumana
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Maybe it's just like what those Vahumana scholars often say — it's hard for people to truly understand themselves.

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Kaveh's feeling a little...

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham!? Why are you here?

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Ugh, I knew you wouldn't be interested in something like this.

assumed.name: Haravatat
assumed.quote: A group of Haravatat scholars were chatting near him, but he looked as if he was too lazy to join them.

assumed.name: Kshahrewar
assumed.quote: As the leading genius of Kshahrewar, Kaveh should have both the right and the confidence to reject any unreasonable demands.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Mora is extremely valuable, you see.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: practically all of Teyvat has heard of you by now.

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Dori, optional)

assumed.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
assumed.quote: I heard that you were the genius behind the Palace of Alcazarzaray?

assumed.name: Light of Kshahrewar
assumed.quote: having the Light of Kshahrewar as one of my instructors

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Even the Dendro Archon herself couldn't find fault in any part of my business.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Ah, Eremites? Hmph, I've already fought off more than my fair share of them when I was working in the desert.

assumed.name: Mehrak
assumed.quote: Mehrak, you're up!

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you! Good to finally see you again.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Cyno: Cheer up, Kaveh. I'll tell you a new joke.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Hmph, that guy? He's never been a fan of social gatherings.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Even during her time in the Akademiya, she was a thorough perfectionist.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Zaha Hadi, optional)

assumed.name: Jannat
assumed.quote: why don't we talk about you sneaking into Jannat's garden the other night

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: I'll be heading back to Gandharva Ville for now.

threads.claim: Kaveh's mother's locked notebook remains unopened, and the password is still unknown to Kaveh.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Hah, if only I could... I never managed to guess the password.

threads.claim: Kaveh's mother left Sumeru, remarried, and has become estranged from Kaveh.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Unfortunately, I've barely had any contact with her since she remarried and moved abroad...

threads.claim: Kaveh and Alhaitham disagree on whether idealists are doomed to be dragged under by others' struggles.
threads.quote: Kaveh: He told me a long time ago that no matter how strong of a swimmer you may be, you'll still get dragged under by the others who are drowning once you run out of stamina.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's support for desert education may not last, so the educational gap between regions could persist.
threads.quote: Badawi: And what's more... I don't know if the Akademiya would ever reverse its stance in the future.

threads.claim: Badawi is elderly and in failing health, and feels he has little time left to contribute to his homeland.
threads.quote: Badawi: I don't have much longer left on this world, so I just want to use whatever time I have to contribute something to my homeland.

threads.claim: Badawi appears to be hiding something about himself and his purpose.
threads.quote: Traveler: Why do I feel like he's hiding something?

threads.claim: Badawi reveals his true purpose and that he has been concealing his desert origins.
threads.quote: Badawi: Alright, there's no point hiding anything anymore.

threads.claim: Badawi reveals he grew up as an Eremite mercenary who worked in the desert his whole life.
threads.quote: Badawi: Oh, you won't have to worry about that. I grew up as an Eremite mercenary, and worked in the desert my entire life. My body's still in great shape.

threads.claim: The desert library project advances with a revised design and plans to seek sponsors from wealthy merchants.
threads.quote: Kaveh: In the meantime, let's look forward to the day when this building is completed and can finally open its doors.

threads.claim: Kaveh has an unresolved question about whether art is a divine gift or a product of existential struggle.
threads.quote: Remember that question I brought up before? The one about whether I should see art as a divine gift of inspiration from the gods, or as a product of my own existential struggle?

threads.claim: Kaveh admits he still has no answer to his question about the nature of art.
threads.quote: I still haven't found an answer to that yet, but if art wasn't inherently paradoxical and enigmatic, then people probably wouldn't be drawn to it.

threads.claim: Kaveh and Alhaitham's past collaboration ended in differences that remain unresolved.
threads.quote: We had a number of differences, and they remain unresolved even today, but there's no point going into that right now.

threads.claim: A rumor says a big-name merchant has secretly bought much of Aaru Village.
threads.quote: I heard a rumor a while back saying a lot of land and buildings in Aaru Village have already been secretly purchased by a big name merchant.

threads.claim: Dori reveals that he has been the one buying up the land around Aaru Village.
threads.quote: Oh my, did I not tell you about that? Yep, yours truly has been buying up all the land.

threads.claim: A figure called Lord Sangemah Bay is presented as a generous, famous merchant.
threads.quote: The most benevolent Lord Sangemah Bay makes your dreams come true.

threads.claim: Lord Sangemah Bay is revealed to be Dori himself.
threads.quote: Huh!? So you meant yourself all along?

threads.claim: Kaveh fell into heavy debt while building the Palace of Alcazarzaray, and Dori is his creditor.
threads.quote: I got into a huge pile of debt building the Palace of Alcazarzaray...

threads.claim: Kaveh promises to repay every coin he still owes Dori.
threads.quote: I'll pay back every last coin that I still owe you, but that's a completely different matter.

threads.claim: Lingering tensions exist between the desert and the rest of Sumeru, though interaction is growing.
threads.quote: Although there are still many lingering tensions between the two regions, the amount of interaction has been steadily increasing

threads.claim: Kaveh's family life was shaken when he was young, and he struggled in school.
threads.quote: My family life got shaken up quite a bit when I was young, I struggled in school

threads.claim: Alkami's friendly image may hide a scheme, since Kaveh finds his sudden kindness surprising.
threads.quote: Who would have thought that he'd be so nice and friendly?

threads.claim: The traveler senses that the training center is not what it seems.
threads.quote: Something doesn't feel right about all of this.

threads.claim: Alkami admits he profits from student tuition rather than from architecture.
threads.quote: In comparison, earning tuition from a training center is far easier.

threads.claim: Some students seem too poor to afford the tuition, which raises the question of where their money comes from.
threads.quote: Not everyone should be able to pay such exorbitant tuition fees.

threads.claim: Students' families are signing loan contracts with hidden, very high interest.
threads.quote: It only listed the amount that you'll have to repay every day, which gives the false impression that the amount hasn't actually increased by all that much.

threads.claim: The authorities plan to return recovered money to the victims of the scheme.
threads.quote: All recovered funds will be returned to the victims after confirmation with the relevant individuals.

threads.claim: Kaveh has personal experience with debt, which hints at his own past money troubles.
threads.quote: I know very well just how miserable living in debt can be.

threads.claim: Cyno hints that Kaveh's life has become a mess, which suggests Kaveh's money problems are not settled.
threads.quote: your life wouldn't be the mess it currently is.

threads.claim: Alkami argues that art is just another business and that devotion to art is foolish.
threads.quote: Only fools will see art as revered and sacred. In the end, art is just another business.

threads.claim: Kaveh refuses to give up his creative dreams for comfort, because doing so would end his career as an artist.
threads.quote: The voice in my heart would just keep repeating one thing: the moment I turn away from my dreams would be the moment my career ends.

threads.claim: Faranak's notebook is locked by a password that Kaveh cannot yet crack.
threads.quote: My mother left her notebook to me, but it has a password and I haven't figured out what it is yet.

threads.claim: The password is companionship, which opens the notebook and reveals Faranak's written messages to Kaveh.
threads.quote: Huh, it worked!

threads.claim: Faranak's drawing shows unfamiliar people, and the Traveler feels they look familiar.
threads.quote: From the dates in the notebook, she probably drew this more than thirty years ago. I hadn't even been born yet.

threads.claim: Faranak's diary describes a past gathering where her husband was friends with a man with long ears.
threads.quote: My husband seems to be friends with the man with long ears.

threads.claim: Kaveh's father is a blonde man whose identity is still unclear.
threads.quote: This blonde man was probably my father... But who are the other people in the picture?

threads.claim: Faranak believed true art is hard to understand, and that artists suffer when no one grasps their work.
threads.quote: True art cannot be understood, but as an artist, I wish some people could understand its meaning and value.

threads.claim: Faranak's final message says companionship is the most important thing, which is the key to her notebook.
threads.quote: Never forget that companionship is the most important thing of all.

threads.claim: Tighnari doubts Collei can keep up with the harder second phase of her studies.
threads.quote: I'm actually not so confident that the second phase will go as well as the first.

introduced.name: Sanhaj
introduced.how: a past Masters of the Night-Wind hero whose Ancient Name Ororon inherits
introduced.quote: Sanhaj: You are the inheritor of my name, the hero from the Masters of the Night-Wind who shall fight for this generation.

introduced.name: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night
introduced.how: ruler of the Night Kingdom, a soul-realm kept awake by limited power
introduced.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night: I preside over a realm of souls. Due to my limited power, sleep is the only way I can extend my existence.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm of souls rebuilt from fragments of Natlan's old Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Mavuika: To aid the people of Natlan, the Lord of the Night used the fragments of the old Ley Lines to reconstruct a similar network. That's how the Night Kingdom was born.

introduced.name: Source Mechanism
introduced.how: an ancient device that can reconstruct the Ley Lines and is the key to the Fatui plan
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Their plan hinges entirely on a single element — the Source Mechanism. If we leverage our forces, we can destroy it. And then, success is ours.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: the devolved form of the Angels, a creature the Lord of the Night says remain in Natlan
introduced.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night: But, adventurers like you are probably more familiar with our devolved form... Seelies.

introduced.name: Angel
introduced.how: the ancient form of the Seelies, once worshipped as lords in the past
introduced.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night: The people of Natlan worship me, and call me their "lord"... In the ancient past, before we died out, we were also known by a different name... "Angels."

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: a name bestowed by a spirit hero that can be forged and bound to a bearer, costing the Name Engraver's life
introduced.quote: (An Ancient Name descends from the sky and begins to glow)

introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.how: a hidden Shade who helped Natlan establish its rules and guided the Night Kingdom's creation
introduced.quote: She helped Natlan establish the rules. It was also under her guidance that I created the Night Kingdom...

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: a group that used phlogiston to create Elemental energy to counter the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles used phlogiston as a basis for the creation of Elemental energy

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: Teyvat's primordial form of energy, the basis of Elemental energy
introduced.quote: Phlogiston is Teyvat's primordial form of energy.

introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.how: a parchment that records the Traveler's deeds in Natlan, past and future
introduced.quote: The Lord of the Night creates the Pilgrim's Chronicle, a parchment that would record the Traveler's deeds in Natlan, both past and future.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: a homeland destroyed by the Abyss, whose survivors carry its trauma
introduced.quote: Because I am a survivor of Khaenri'ah. I've witnessed the devastation and terror of the Abyss with my own eyes.

introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.how: a foreign soul that insults Ororon and plans to take his body after he dies
introduced.quote: Guthred: Why struggle? It's a miracle you were even born. Just close your eyes and wait for death.

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: a Pyro Archon-established rule that aids the fight against the Abyss and still survives
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, strengthened that realm and established the rules that aid our fight against the Abyss

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: a power whose use sacrifices memories and history, which Mavuika refuses to repeat
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Just like the consequences of using the Gnosis, that is a price I refuse to accept.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: a figure whose ancient battle with the dragons devastated the world and let the Abyss in
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The ancient battle between the Descender and the dragons destroyed the corner of the world, allowing the Abyss to invade.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: A Khaenri'ah soldier who fled to Natlan after the Abyss destroyed his homeland and has fought for Natlan ever since
introduced.quote: I failed to save Khaenri'ah from the rampage of the Abyss. When the situation became unsalvageable, I fled to Natlan with the remainder of my platoon.

introduced.name: Ayizu
introduced.how: Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind, who was kind to The Captain and told him the secret of the Gnosis before dying
introduced.quote: I defended this land for quite some time and, in the process, met the chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind, Ayizu.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: The Captain's former homeland, lost to the Abyss and blamed by many for the tragedy
introduced.quote: I'm sure many people viewed Khaenri'ah as the cause of the tragedy, but Ayizu was kind to me all the same, and even helped me in my time of need.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: A tragedy about five hundred years ago in which Khaenri'ah fell and Natlan was also ravaged by the Abyss
introduced.quote: That story begins with the cataclysm five hundred years ago...

introduced.name: Source Mechanism
introduced.how: An ancient device the Fatui located by combining three scholars' research, and a guarded alternative plan
introduced.quote: We tracked down three scholars — Aberewaa, Bosomtwe, and Cuxtal, and combined the results of their research to locate this ancient device.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: A god older than any Archon, an emissary of the Heavenly Principles who controls the power of death and orchestrated Natlan's rules
introduced.quote: Ronova is a god whose existence predates any Archon. You can think of her like an emissary of the Heavenly Principles. She controls the power of death.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: A group with a ceremony that can glimpse the future, which is taboo to use on the Pyro Archon
introduced.quote: The Masters of the Night-Wind have a ceremony that can be used to glimpse the future.

introduced.name: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night
introduced.how: The Night Kingdom's ruler who forges Ancient Names and is fading as her time runs out
introduced.quote: Forging an Ancient Name is an act of creation. It involves taking disparate concepts throughout the Night Kingdom and condensing them into a heroic epic.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: A heroic name forged into the Night Kingdom to record a hero's deeds, which costs the craftsman's life
introduced.quote: So, it's true. Forging an Ancient Name consumes the life of the craftsman...

introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.how: A gift from the Lord of the Night that records the Traveler's adventures and shows what she wants them to see
introduced.quote: It's not a concrete medium. It reflects the Lord of the Night's will, and shows what she wants you to see.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: Messengers who travel Natlan and compile intel into battle reports
introduced.quote: Messengers from the Scions of the Canopy are traveling all around Natlan. Update them once you've completed your mission, and they'll compile the information into a battle report.

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: A shelter hub where evacuees from surrounding lands are guarded and sent for safety
introduced.quote: Guards are present around the clock to ensure that those who have evacuated here from the surrounding lands may safely enter the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

introduced.name: Abyssal Pylons
introduced.how: Monster-propagating structures that must be destroyed to stop monsters from spawning
introduced.quote: Nearby warriors are searching for any monster-propagating Abyssal Pylons.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: The sovereign of the Fatui who lets Harbingers pursue their own purpose, even against her orders
introduced.quote: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa allows every Harbinger the freedom to pursue the meaning of their existence.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Harbingers' soldiers who now operate under the Pyro Archon's command by The Captain's order
introduced.quote: Yes. Per his order, we're now under the Pyro Archon's command.

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: A figure The Captain knew only by name in Khaenri'ah, who carries pain and hatred and somehow slowed his body's decay
introduced.quote: He carries a degree of pain and hatred that far surpasses my own.

introduced.name: Wayna
introduced.how: Chief of the Scions of the Canopy who recruits Couriers for the growing battle report workload
introduced.quote: Wayna, chief of the Scions of the Canopy, is recruiting new Couriers to deal with the ever-increasing battle report workload.

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: main refuge where evacuated civilians gather under the Sacred Flame
introduced.quote: Evacuated civilians have gathered in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, but their movements have been marked by the Abyssal monsters.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: flame at the Stadium that repels Abyssal energy
introduced.quote: That's where the sacred flame is, which seems to be the one thing that well of Abyssal energy is afraid of.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Fatui under the Pyro Archon's command are stationed in Natlan to aid travelers
introduced.quote: The Fatui transferred to the Pyro Archon's command have been stationed nearby to provide aid to passing merchants and travelers.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: guard outposts that shelter the hurt and recruit Couriers, led by Wayna
introduced.quote: Wayna, chief of the Scions of the Canopy, is recruiting new Couriers to deal with the ever-increasing battle report workload.

introduced.name: Battle reports
introduced.how: Couriers' reports track civilians and Abyss attacks in each area
introduced.quote: Battle reports indicate that many civilians have been surrounded here even as the Abyss's attacks rapidly intensify.

introduced.name: Abyssal Pylon
introduced.how: Abyssal structures that anyone with a Vision can destroy
introduced.quote: Yeah, at least with regular Abyssal Pylons, anyone with a Vision can destroy them.

introduced.name: Abyss Tumor
introduced.how: new invulnerable growth that spawns Abyssal Pylons and monsters
introduced.quote: Whatever it is, it seems like it can spawn Abyssal Pylons — and with them, a never-ending stream of Abyss monsters.

introduced.name: Abyss's Source
introduced.how: the origin of the Abyssal power appears in the sky above Natlan
introduced.quote: The origin of the Abyssal power has appeared in the skies above.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: self-declared Dragonlord who joins fights and mocks the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw is trying to rest.

introduced.name: Archon
introduced.how: Archon status is earned by proving one's strength
introduced.quote: Plus, she told us you can only become the Archon by proving your strength.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Saurians are companions who fight and evacuate alongside the tribes
introduced.quote: A team of warriors from the People of the Springs are helping their Saurian companions retreat toward the Stadium.

introduced.name: Menilek
introduced.how: golden figure from Chasca's ancient name who speaks of her journey, from 500 years ago
introduced.quote: How unfair life can be... She's had the odds stacked against her from the very beginning, and each step forward has been an agonizing one.

introduced.name: Chuychu's death
introduced.how: Chuychu, a doctor, died and could not save herself
introduced.quote: Sadly, in the end, the one person she couldn't save was herself.

introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Level
introduced.how: a percentage meter tracking how far the Abyss has spread
introduced.quote: !colspan=3|Abyssal Corrosion Level: 46%

introduced.name: Mayahuel
introduced.how: older medic who treats the wounded at the Stadium
introduced.quote: My age means I can't charge to the frontlines, but I can handle things here.

introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.how: Fatui commander leading his unit to fight large monsters, reachable through Ley Line communication
introduced.quote: The Captain is leading his Fatui to defeat large monsters out in the wild. You can use the power of the Ley Lines to communicate with him.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: Self-declared Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw, a boastful Natlanese ally
introduced.quote: Miserable dregs of the Abyss, kneel before the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: A Shade whose domain is death, who lends power at a great price
introduced.quote: My domain is death, and its power comes at a great price... The question is, are you prepared to pay?

introduced.name: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night
introduced.how: Lord of the Night who gives ancient names and takes special care of the Traveler
introduced.quote: Plus, your ancient name is a special case, so the Lord of the Night will take special care of you.

introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.how: Special names bestowed on warriors, with bearers able to draw on the Ode of Resurrection
introduced.quote: I'm the first one of us to get an ancient name — and not just any ancient name, but Malipo!

introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.how: Sacred flame power that guides fallen warriors back until the war ends
introduced.quote: Henceforth, all who sacrifice themselves will be guided back by the Ode of Resurrection until the war's end.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Deep realm where the Abyss retreated, long corrupted by Abyssal energy
introduced.quote: The Abyss has retreated to the depths of the Night Kingdom, a place that has long since been corrupted by Abyssal energy...

introduced.name: Abyss Tumor
introduced.how: Abyss growth that must be destroyed, shielded by Abyssal Pylons
introduced.quote: The Abyss Tumor is shielded by Abyssal Pylon(s) that must first be destroyed.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: Mavuika holds the Pyro Archon role and can aid in destroying Abyss Tumors
introduced.quote: With the aid of the Pyro Archon, Mavuika, you are finally able to destroy the Abyss Tumor.

introduced.name: Night Wars
introduced.how: Mavuika formally declares a war against the Abyss under the Pyro Archon's name
introduced.quote: In the name of the Pyro Archon, Haborym, I declare the Night Wars underway!

introduced.name: False Sky
introduced.how: Sky split with hidden fragments behind it, never observed in other nations
introduced.quote: However, from what the Adventurers' Guild tells me, neither the split-sky phenomenon nor the fragments have ever been observed in any other nation.

introduced.name: Six Heroes
introduced.how: The figures seen were snapshots of the Six Heroes made by Ancient Name engravers 500 years ago
introduced.quote: That wasn't their souls we saw, but a snapshot of them in time.

introduced.name: Divine throne
introduced.how: Source of the Pyro Archon's temporary surge of power that her body cannot sustain
introduced.quote: Oh, that was the divine throne unleashing my full potential, and it was only temporary.

introduced.name: Chasca's suppressed beast
introduced.how: Chasca's suppressed beast, which breaks loose in combat and frightens her allies
introduced.quote: Chasca's unleashed her suppressed beast... Whew, she's even scarier than the monsters we're fighting...

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Lines of power that let the Traveler communicate with companions in battle
introduced.quote: You can use the power of the Ley Lines to communicate with them.

introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Level
introduced.how: Meter tracking how far the Abyss has corroded Natlan
introduced.quote: Abyssal Corrosion Level: 78%

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: Flame whose stored knowledge passes to the Pyro Archon and may change her personality
introduced.quote: I heard that the Pyro Archon inherits the knowledge stored in the Sacred Flame, and apparently, it can change your personality...

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: Iansan's group, located furthest from the Abyss's entry point
introduced.quote: The Collective of Plenty was the furthest from the Abyss's entry point, so they didn't have as many monsters to deal with.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Huh, I thought the Pyro Archon would choose a frontal assault.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: In the meantime, you shall have the aid of all the Fatui under my command.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: All other warriors are working to push back the Abyss on the frontlines.

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: Paimon then asks if he knew about Dainsleif, as he didn't appear to be having as much of an issue.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Paimon: Xilonen! Citlali! Is there a reason you're up so early?

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: Oh! Thank goodness you're here! The Abyss attacked again, and it's really bad!

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: Oh, someone's calling us!

assumed.name: Ororon
assumed.quote: Citlali: Ororon.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: I see. I'll send reinforcements to those two locations.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Kinich: Well, at least the Pyro Archon's plan advanced a step further.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: Kinich! You made it back in one piece!

assumed.name: Xbalanque
assumed.quote: It's a power that Xbalanque gained from Ronova.

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: I need the power of a Descender.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Kinich! You're back!

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Traveler: Where is Mavuika?

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Monsters infest both flanks of the valley around the Children of Echoes.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: The Pyro Archon is guarding the flame. As long as that continues, we still have hope.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: But the worst-affected region was the Flower-Feather Clan's.

assumed.name: Chasca and Chuychu
assumed.quote: Paimon: What? Isn't that... Chasca's tribe? She said she was gonna take Chuychu home to rest for a while...

assumed.name: Toto
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...Toto? Toto, is that you?

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Don't worry, it'll be just like another Night Warden War. We'll force the Abyss back if it's the last thing we do.

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: And I used to fight in the Pilgrimage when I was a younger man.

assumed.name: Stadukhin
assumed.quote: Stadukhin: It's dangerous to rely solely on others. You also need to look after your own safety.

assumed.name: Pacal
assumed.quote: Kachina: Pacal gave the order for everyone to evacuate.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: Ah, it's you guys. Things are bad here — something fell out the sky that's impervious to our attacks.

assumed.name: Chimalli
assumed.quote: Chimalli: This is the second time you've had to come to our rescue... I'm a little ashamed.

assumed.name: Tepoz
assumed.quote: Traveler: How's your son doing?

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani and Amina are taking part as well.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: In the past, my impression of the Fatui wasn't exactly positive, but this has really changed my perspective.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: You and I, together, finally putting an end to the ever-looming threat of the Abyss...

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: Seems like winning the Pilgrimage gave you a real boost.

assumed.name: Spiritway
assumed.quote: Wheeeeee! This is just like riding a Spiritway!

assumed.name: Chuychu
assumed.quote: Alright, give 'em hell! Vengeance for Chuychu!

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Unless he's just a good guy who wants to avoid another Khaenri'ah?

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: My guess is that the Heavenly Principles wants them kept a secret.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: We did something much crazier back in Fontaine, and we're still here...

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: I'm guessing the Night Warden Wars are over for the foreseeable future?

assumed.name: Vuka
assumed.quote: In the spirit of Vuka, I have to rise above it.

threads.claim: A false sky is briefly exposed by Mavuika's attack, but no one pays it attention.
threads.quote: though no one appears to pay much attention to it.

threads.claim: A soul from outside Natlan and the Night Kingdom tried to take refuge in Ororon and its origin remains a mystery.
threads.quote: However, this soul does not hail from Natlan or the Night Kingdom. Its origins remain a mystery to me.
