threads.claim: The Lord of the Night would rebuild the Ley Lines at the cost of her own existence.
threads.quote: Such as rebuilding the Ley Lines once more... at the cost of my own existence.

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death is a hidden Shade whose existence is known only to a few.
threads.quote: Even so, her existence remains unknown to all but a select few.

threads.claim: Mavuika is slated to die because she used Ronova's powers, and the Traveler may be able to stall it.
threads.quote: Citlali intercepts them, telling them that despite their valiant efforts in defending the nation, Mavuika's use of Ronova's powers meant that she was still slated to die.

threads.claim: Chasca's Ancient Name appears after Chuychu's death, making her the sixth and final hero.
threads.quote: The bearer, Menilek, remarks on the pain Chasca was suffering, thus making her the final hero for Mavuika's plan.

threads.claim: Damage to a soul is dangerous, and Ororon's damaged soul made him vulnerable to the cry.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Damage to the soul is a tricky thing.

threads.claim: Capitano's losses in Khaenri'ah still haunt him after five hundred years.
threads.quote: It is an unforgettable pain, one that no amount of time could ever dull... not even five hundred years.

threads.claim: Using the Gnosis or reconstructing the Ley Lines would erase memories and history.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Giving up our memories and history would mean rewriting everything.

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night originally built Natlan's Ley Lines, which became the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Because I was the one who originally constructed Natlan's Ley Lines... otherwise known as the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: The Loom of Fate is a device that may weave Ley Lines, but its nature is unclear.
threads.quote: The device is capable of weaving and creating Ley Lines, you say?

threads.claim: The Gnosis and its secret remain central, and Mavuika refuses to use it while The Captain failed to obtain it.
threads.quote: My decision regarding the Gnosis will not change... So let's focus on the Abyss for now.

threads.claim: Mavuika has never heard of the three scholars who found the Source Mechanism, which suggests her investigation missed key people.
threads.quote: ...Huh, I've never heard those names before.

threads.claim: Using the Ruler of Death's power to defeat the Abyss requires Mavuika to give up her own life.
threads.quote: The Ruler of Death's power will allow Mavuika to triumph over the Abyss. But, she must offer her own life in the process.

threads.claim: Fate can only shift the timing of an event, while death is a rule that guarantees it will occur.
threads.quote: Fate indicates what will happen in the future — the time, manner, and place are all predetermined.

threads.claim: Citlali used a taboo ceremony to glimpse the future and saw Mavuika's death.
threads.quote: Death.

threads.claim: Citlali believes the Traveler's power as a Descender may be able to change Mavuika's fate.
threads.quote: I can't just ignore what I saw. That's why I need the Traveler's power. I need the power of a Descender.

threads.claim: Mavuika does not recognize The Captain, who has changed greatly from the past and wears a mask.
threads.quote: You knew him, and you fought for Natlan all those years ago... Why don't I recognize you?

threads.claim: The Captain is cursed with immortality yet his flesh still decays.
threads.quote: Even with the curse of immortality, the flesh still rots.

threads.claim: Dainsleif has found a way to slow the decay of his body, and The Captain does not know how.
threads.quote: I don't know how Dain managed to slow the deterioration of his body.

threads.claim: Bringing all six heroes together will unleash a one-time power to thwart the Abyss.
threads.quote: We will unleash a great power that can be used to thwart the Abyss — but only once.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa lets Harbingers pursue their own purpose, which can override her orders and explain why methods differ.
threads.quote: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa allows every Harbinger the freedom to pursue the meaning of their existence.

threads.claim: Forging an Ancient Name costs the craftsman's life, which becomes the protective shell for the new name's growth.
threads.quote: If the Ancient Name is like a seed, then the life of the craftsman is the outer shell, serving as its protection.

threads.claim: The Abyss is attacking more intensely because it knows the heroes are one hero short of the needed power.
threads.quote: It knows we're only one hero short.

threads.claim: Fatui forces have been placed under the Pyro Archon's command, and some do not fully accept the decision.
threads.quote: Yes. Per his order, we're now under the Pyro Archon's command.

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night is nearly out of time and refuses to extend her life.
threads.quote: My time is running out. It is my honor to witness humanity in this moment of absolute determination.

threads.claim: The Sacred Flame keeps Abyssal energy at bay, making the Stadium the last hope.
threads.quote: That's where the sacred flame is, which seems to be the one thing that well of Abyssal energy is afraid of.

threads.claim: The origin of the Abyss has appeared as a huge presence in the sky above Natlan.
threads.quote: The origin of the Abyssal power has appeared in the skies above.

threads.claim: The heart of the Abyss itself has joined the invasion, which the Natlanese cannot match.
threads.quote: The crux of the issue is that the heart of the Abyss itself has joined the invasion.

threads.claim: The Abyss Tumor is invulnerable and spawns endless Abyssal Pylons and monsters, unlike ordinary pylons.
threads.quote: Whatever it is, it seems like it can spawn Abyssal Pylons — and with them, a never-ending stream of Abyss monsters.

threads.claim: The Abyss attack is now a full-scale invasion of all of Natlan.
threads.quote: This is a full-scale invasion of Natlan.

threads.claim: The characters insist the crisis is war, not a natural disaster.
threads.quote: This is war.

threads.claim: Becoming the Archon requires proving one's strength, a path Mavuika has followed.
threads.quote: Plus, she told us you can only become the Archon by proving your strength.

threads.claim: The Pyro Archon is pursuing a plan that the Traveler is bound to support until it succeeds.
threads.quote: Until the Pyro Archon succeeds in her plan...

threads.claim: The Captain leads Fatui soldiers rescuing people across Natlan.
threads.quote: The Captain's soldiers running around Natlan rescuing people...

threads.claim: Chasca survived Abyssal contamination, which leaves her in constant agitation and prone to losing control.
threads.quote: The fact that you survived an Abyssal contamination was a miracle, but it also left you in a constant state of agitation...

threads.claim: Chasca briefly loses control of Abyssal energy and then reins it back in.
threads.quote: Chasca managed to rein it in.

threads.claim: Chasca's ancient name, Menilek, asks what she will find beyond her pain: light or a void.
threads.quote: Maybe the glorious light of the sun, or maybe a dark, empty void. There is only one way to find out.

threads.claim: Chuychu died in the invasion, and Chasca's struggle with her Abyssal contamination is tied to Chuychu's sacrifice.
threads.quote: Sadly, in the end, the one person she couldn't save was herself.

threads.claim: The sky is split with hidden fragments behind it, and its cause is still unexplained.
threads.quote: I think there is a lot of investigating to be done to understand what the fragments behind the sky are, and why they were hidden in the first place.

threads.claim: The Six Heroes' images were snapshots, and their souls were reborn in Natlan in new forms.
threads.quote: Their souls returned to the Night Kingdom long ago, and will have been reborn in Natlan since, albeit in a different form.

threads.claim: Using the Ruler of Death's power demands Mavuika's death, and Citlali seeks a way to save her.
threads.quote: Natlan must pay the price for Mavuika's use of the Ruler of Death's power. That price is death, and only Mavuika's death can clear the debt.

threads.claim: The Traveler agrees to look for a way to save Mavuika from the price of the divine throne.
threads.quote: I'll see what I can do.

threads.claim: Xbalanque secretly struck a deal with Ronova, and she will deny involvement if questioned.
threads.quote: Keep this a secret.

threads.claim: The Captain has a hidden final foe and a deeper purpose for helping Natlan that remains unexplained.
threads.quote: I too have a final foe to face.

threads.claim: Chasca's suppressed beast breaks loose in battle, and she struggles to control it.
threads.quote: Chasca's unleashed her suppressed beast... Whew, she's even scarier than the monsters we're fighting...

threads.claim: The Ode of Resurrection is limited and not fully restored, though it will work reliably on the Traveler.
threads.quote: Not completely — after all, the Night Kingdom is still plagued by Abyssal corruption.

threads.claim: Restoring the Ley Lines is necessary to end the Abyss threat for good.
threads.quote: If we don't finish them off and restore the Ley Lines, the threat they pose to Natlan will remain.

threads.claim: The Traveler must go to the final battle without Paimon, who stays behind.
threads.quote: You'll need to stay behind.

threads.claim: The Traveler has deep ties to Natlan, which the Lord of the Night recognizes.
threads.quote: The outlander with deep ties to this land returns... and this time, he is alone?

threads.claim: The Six Heroes' lasting presence gives the phrase no one fights alone a deeper meaning.
threads.quote: I think that gives another layer of meaning to the phrase,

threads.claim: Mavuika's 500-year plan is nearly complete, with only the final battle against the Abyss left.
threads.quote: My 500-year plan has almost come to fruition.

threads.claim: Mavuika plans to strike the Abyss in its lair alone, since its energy would be lethal to others.
threads.quote: I will launch my final counterattack. I shall strike them in their lair and wipe them out for good.

introduced.name: Iudex
introduced.how: Neuvillette became Fontaine's Iudex over 400 years ago and began reforms
introduced.quote: A little more than four hundred years ago, I became the Iudex of Fontaine and initiated a series of institutional reforms.

introduced.name: Carole
introduced.how: Melusine who was one of Neuvillette's trusted subordinates and is now dead
introduced.quote: I had two subordinates who were exceptionally trustworthy and capable: Carole, a Melusine, and Vautrin, leader of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

introduced.name: Vautrin
introduced.how: leader of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol who was exiled after Carole's death
introduced.quote: The incident resulted in Carole taking her own life and Vautrin being exiled.

introduced.name: Kiara
introduced.how: Melusine who received a threat letter and is now under protection
introduced.quote: A Melusine named Kiara received a threat letter.

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: Melusines have special eyes that see residual bloodstains and other anomalies humans cannot
introduced.quote: Neuvillette says that us Melusines have special eyes that can see things people can't.

introduced.name: Eloffe
introduced.how: boutique owner who hires Kiara as a model for a children's outfit
introduced.quote: I'm planning to release an outfit for children next month and wanted to hire you as my model.

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: journalist who wanted to interview Neuvillette and agreed to keep the secret
introduced.quote: Interviewing him is every journalist's dream.

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: Neuvillette's employee who comes to protect Kiara
introduced.quote: Technically speaking, he and I are under an employer-employee relationship.

introduced.name: Callas
introduced.how: boss of the Spina di Rosula who died after losing a duel
introduced.quote: Callas, boss of the Spina di Rosula, was defeated in the duel and died of serious injuries.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: group that offers to help investigate the threat case
introduced.quote: She offers to have the Spina di Rosula help, which Neuvillette accepts.

introduced.name: Domenico
introduced.how: boss who ordered Esseim to send the threat letter and is now imprisoned
introduced.quote: his boss Domenico had told him to and that he couldn't disobey.

introduced.name: Esseim
introduced.how: smuggling case suspect released for good behavior who admits writing the letter
introduced.quote: Noting that a person named Esseim was released for good behavior

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: figure at the Fortress of Meropide who helps the group and finds Domenico
introduced.quote: The three head to the Fortress of Meropide where they're greeted by Wriothesley, who had learned of the reason of their visit.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: prison where Domenico and other criminals are held
introduced.quote: Neuvillette clarifies to Navia that Domenico's now in the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Mutual Aid Network
introduced.how: group whose members wear a badge, with core values of mutual help and justice
introduced.quote: The network's core values were to help each other, promote justice and not detesting just judgement.

introduced.name: Medal of Peace
introduced.how: award Carole and Vautrin received, whose design the network badge copies
introduced.quote: who tells her that Carole's was lost in a fire and thus Vautrin had the other one

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: courtroom where Neuvillette tried Vautrin for murder
introduced.quote: Upon entering the Opera Epiclese, a trial begins with Neuvillette charging Vautrin for murder, as he had killed the suspects to get revenge for Carole.

introduced.name: Fountain of Lucine
introduced.how: fountain where all of Fontaine's waters converge and hold strong memories and emotions
introduced.quote: The Fountain of Lucine is where all of Fontaine's waters converge. It is the vessel of countless memories and emotions.

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: Neuvillette lost memories of his connection to it when he was born
introduced.quote: The Primordial Sea, for example. I can only vaguely recall its connection to me, but I am unaware of what that connection is exactly.

introduced.name: Smuggling case
introduced.how: past smuggling case solved by the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.quote: The smuggling case was solved by the joint forces of the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom.

introduced.name: Vautrin's revenge killings
introduced.how: Vautrin killed the hardliners who framed Carole, and was tried for it
introduced.quote: he decides to get revenge for her by killing the suspects, asking Rastignac for the list of their names and nothing else

introduced.name: Hydro Dragon Sovereign
introduced.how: Neuvillette's true identity as a dragon and Hydro Sovereign
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Hydro Dragon Sovereign...

introduced.name: Regional water flavors
introduced.how: waters from different regions have distinct flavors that Neuvillette can tell apart
introduced.quote: Distinct differences exist between the waters of each area.

introduced.name: Carole
introduced.how: Melusine who joined the Marechaussee Phantom and wants to help
introduced.quote: Hello! I'm Carole, a Melusine! Is there anything you need help with?

introduced.name: Vautrin
introduced.how: captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, Neuvillette's subordinate
introduced.quote: If you run into any trouble, I suggest that you inform Vautrin, the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: Fontaine's detective force that Melusines can join
introduced.quote: I am certain you'll become an indispensable part of Fontaine's detective force.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: a species with special sight, brought to Fontaine by Neuvillette and distrusted by humans
introduced.quote: Melusines' special sight makes them especially suited for joining the Marechaussee Phantom.

introduced.name: Medal of Peace
introduced.how: medal Neuvillette awards to Carole and Vautrin for helping Melusines gain human trust
introduced.quote: Medals of Peace, awarded to you and Vautrin.

introduced.name: Fountain of Lucine
introduced.how: fountain where emotions and memories boil over when Neuvillette's Hydro power stirs it
introduced.quote: I tried my best to suppress the power of Hydro within myself, but it seems like it still caused the emotions within the Fountain of Lucine to boil over.

introduced.name: Neuvillette's water emotion sensing
introduced.how: Neuvillette can sense emotions in all Fontaine waters, including rivers, lakes and rain
introduced.quote: I can sense emotions from all waters in Fontaine. Rivers, lakes... and even the rain.

introduced.name: Hydro Dragon Sovereign identity
introduced.how: Neuvillette is the Hydro Dragon Sovereign, still feeling like an outsider
introduced.quote: (As the Hydro Dragon Sovereign, Neuvillette still thinks of himself as an outsider due to his identity...)

introduced.name: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale
introduced.how: judgment machine whose scales and lights deliver verdicts in trials
introduced.quote: According to the judgment of the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, Mr. Vautrin will be declared... guilty.

introduced.name: Mutual Aid Network
introduced.how: long-standing prisoner group in the Fortress of Meropide that helps each other and seeks just dealings
introduced.quote: Helping each other is our purpose. At the same time, we seek to maintain just dealings as far much possible.

introduced.name: Beret Society
introduced.how: a shady group that was dissolved a while back
introduced.quote: Oh, you mean the group that was dissolved a while back? Rest assured, we're completely different.

introduced.name: smuggling case
introduced.how: case solved by Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom, leading to the arrest of Domenico and others
introduced.quote: The smuggling case was solved by the joint forces of the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom.

introduced.name: Domenico
introduced.how: smuggler who ran goods for a generous sum and was imprisoned in Meropide
introduced.quote: I only intended to do some small business at first.

introduced.name: Esseim
introduced.how: suspect from the smuggling case who wrote the threatening letter to Kiara
introduced.quote: Yes, that's me.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: prison where criminals are held and Wriothesley presides
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Fortress of Meropide, dear esteemed guests.

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: the Duke who runs the Fortress of Meropide
introduced.quote: Ooh, and a greeting from none other than the Duke himself!

introduced.name: threatening letter to Kiara
introduced.how: letter Domenico had Esseim write to force Kiara to resign from the Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.quote: I requested that he write a threat letter to Kiara and force her to resign from the Marechaussee Phantom...

introduced.name: Illaria
introduced.how: Vautrin's little sister who died when he was young
introduced.quote: I had a little sister named Illaria who passed away when I was very young.

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: I would appreciate it if you could take it to Lady Furina.

assumed.name: Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: Paimon: There's the Gardes, the Marechaussee Phantom, and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol!

assumed.name: Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur)

assumed.name: Masquerade of the Guilty
assumed.quote: (After completing Masquerade of the Guilty)

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: He seems like the type of person who'd own an entire winery... Y'know, like Diluc!

assumed.name: Rastignac
assumed.quote: Outside the Opera Epiclese, Vautrin meets up with Rastignac

assumed.name: Sigewinne
assumed.quote: Sigewinne brings them to the infirmary where they find several criminals wearing a strange badge.

assumed.name: Thibert and Suavegothe
assumed.quote: Thibert and Suavegothe successfully lure Carole to a crime scene and frame her as the suspect

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia appears, telling them that word of the case had spread all across Fontaine.

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Get away from here! I'm calling the Gardes!

assumed.name: Palais Mermonia
assumed.quote: Is he the person I met in the Palais Mermonia earlier?

assumed.name: Spina di Rosula
assumed.quote: So I told the Spina di Rosula to keep an eye out for leads.

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia! Nice to see you again!

assumed.name: Kiara
assumed.quote: You talked to Kiara, but didn't ask her to keep things secret.

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: Clorinde is protecting her as we speak.

assumed.name: Sigewinne
assumed.quote: Typical Sigewinne, concerned about everyone's health as always...

assumed.name: Charlotte
assumed.quote: So that's what Charlotte meant...

assumed.name: Callas
assumed.quote: (Navia mourns at Callas's grave)

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: If I've told you once, I've told you a thousand times — You should follow my example and go out more often. You need to get to know your people better!

assumed.name: Chief Justice
assumed.quote: As Chief Justice, every single one of your trials makes an impact on Fontaine...

assumed.name: Eloffe
assumed.quote: I promised to model for Eloffe!

threads.claim: Neuvillette lost his memories and does not know what his connection to the Primordial Sea is.
threads.quote: The Primordial Sea, for example. I can only vaguely recall its connection to me, but I am unaware of what that connection is exactly.

threads.claim: Neuvillette does not know why he was born human or where his long life should lead him.
threads.quote: I neither know why I was born in this form, nor do I understand where my long life should take me.

threads.claim: Neuvillette's emotions resonate with humans, which he hopes will reveal the meaning of his existence.
threads.quote: My emotions easily resonate with those of others... even I don't have the slightest idea what they mean.

threads.claim: Neuvillette is flooded with memories from 500 years ago, a clue to his past.
threads.quote: He is then rushed by a flood of memories coming from 500 years ago before returning to his senses.

threads.claim: Carole wants Melusines to learn and cooperate with humans, but humans respond to her with fear.
threads.quote: While Neuvillette reminds her of the dangers of the surface world, Carole is insistent on learning and cooperating with humans, though they responded to her with fear.

threads.claim: Kiara is roughly 400 years old and remembers Carole from long ago.
threads.quote: they learn that she's roughly 400 years old as she remembers her time with Carole.

threads.claim: The threat letter to Kiara reveals nothing about its writer, so the sender remains hidden.
threads.quote: Neither the handwriting nor the content itself reveals anything about the writer's intentions.

threads.claim: Domenico confesses to orchestrating the threat letter to get revenge on Neuvillette.
threads.quote: Domenico admits to orchestrating the letter, as he wanted revenge against Neuvillette

threads.claim: Carole's death was caused by hardliners who used her identity to stir unrest against Neuvillette's reforms.
threads.quote: The reforms damaged the interests of some, and the more conservative faction took advantage of Carole's identity to instigate political unrest.

threads.claim: Vautrin kills the framed suspects out of revenge for Carole and is found guilty by Neuvillette.
threads.quote: he decides to get revenge for her by killing the suspects

threads.claim: The Mutual Aid Network's badge links its founder to Carole and Vautrin.
threads.quote: making her realize who their founder was

threads.claim: The Fountain of Lucine holds strong memories that Neuvillette can reach with his power.
threads.quote: accidentally bringing the Traveler back to a scene roughly 400 years ago when he first brought Carole to the surface.

threads.claim: Neuvillette calls himself an outsider in Fontaine because his position keeps him from forming bonds.
threads.quote: However, since I am technically an outsider in Fontaine, a lot of trouble could be avoided if I personally took on the case.

threads.claim: Neuvillette can taste the origin of water, hinting that his Hydro nature gives him unusual senses.
threads.quote: Distinct differences exist between the waters of each area.

threads.claim: Neuvillette's Hydro power lets him sense and be affected by emotions carried in water, spilling memories onto others.
threads.quote: Apologies, it seems like my memories got the better of me.

threads.claim: Rumors claim Melusines were born from calamity and bring danger, an origin left unexplained.
threads.quote: There have been rumors saying that you were born from calamity... and that you inherently bring danger to those around you.

threads.claim: Four hundred years ago the public sided with the old regime and turned its resentment on the Melusines.
threads.quote: Four hundred years ago, they chose to side with the old regime and direct their resentment towards the Melusines.

threads.claim: A plot is set to frame the Melusines for a murder so Neuvillette will lose his excuse.
threads.quote: I've already planned out the murder.

threads.claim: Neuvillette suspects a hidden conspiracy behind the Melusine threats and the Vautrin case.
threads.quote: You should now understand why I believe there to be a conspiracy behind all this...

threads.claim: Wriothesley suggests Neuvillette may be overthinking, and Domenico's plot appears to be his own.
threads.quote: You might be overthinking this.

threads.claim: Vautrin vows that only bloodshed can repay the debt owed by those who targeted Carole.
threads.quote: Only through bloodshed can their debt be repaid.

threads.claim: Neuvillette declares Vautrin guilty for abusing authority and conducting informal executions.
threads.quote: Therefore, you will be declared... guilty.

threads.claim: Wriothesley suggests Vautrin's displayed resentment at trial was an act to show Neuvillette's justice.
threads.quote: Perhaps he had been putting on an act.

threads.claim: Carole reportedly sacrificed herself to calm the mob, though her fate remains unclear.
threads.quote: Miss Carole... chose to sacrifice herself to pacify the situation.

threads.claim: Kiara has lost memories of her shared dreams with Carole, a loss left unexplained.
threads.quote: I can't remember what our dreams were anymore, and I don't know why, but I felt really happy too.

threads.claim: Neuvillette personally crafted the Medals of Peace for Carole and Vautrin, and only Vautrin's survives.
threads.quote: I personally crafted two of them myself. They were awarded to Carole and Vautrin.

threads.claim: The Mutual Aid Network was founded by a powerful first president whose identity is withheld.
threads.quote: The first president of our network was an amazing person.

threads.claim: The Mutual Aid Network's founder is revealed to be Vautrin, who was imprisoned in the Fortress.
threads.quote: I've looked into their founder — Vautrin — who once stood trial and was sentenced to imprisonment in the Fortress.

threads.claim: Vautrin's dead sister Illaria shaped his protective bond with Carole.
threads.quote: I had a little sister named Illaria who passed away when I was very young.

threads.claim: The police emblem was redesigned to commemorate a Melusine's sacrifice, an event not yet explained.
threads.quote: The emblem was redesigned later on to commemorate a Melusine's sacrifice.

threads.claim: Focalors claims to be the spokesperson for Fontaine's past and foretells a future judgment role for the Traveler.
threads.quote: As the spokesperson for Fontaine's past

threads.claim: Someone plans to reanimate a monster, which must be reported to the Chief Justice.
threads.quote: They're planning to reanimate the monster...

threads.claim: Neuvillette still feels like an outsider despite his high status and his own search for answers.
threads.quote: Despite my social status, I'm still an outsider.

threads.claim: Wriothesley says Neuvillette is no longer the outsider he once was, since society has come to accept him.
threads.quote: You're no longer that outsider you were before.

threads.claim: Neuvillette begins to realize that time and lived lives have changed him in ways he is still trying to understand.
threads.quote: The answer that I've been searching for amongst all those lives... perhaps it's life itself.

threads.claim: Esseim confesses he wrote the threat letter to Kiara on Domenico's orders.
threads.quote: I—I did. But I was just following orders...

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a mage who takes over supervising the homework and was once an angel
introduced.quote: Nicole: Leaving already? Hey, Barbie! Aren't you forgetting something? Like a whole bunch of stuff you were supposed to give...

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a mage (called Barbie) who makes prophecies and assigns homework, and appears as a Dodoco
introduced.quote: (Barbeloth's Dodoco form is briefly seen on the table before disappearing)

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: a mage who maintains Teyvat's borders and helps write the homework and notes
introduced.quote: Nicole: As much as I'd like to erase the whole thing and keep on casually observing the world, Alice is busy maintaining Teyvat's borders

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of mages (including Octavia and Rhinedottir) who each have their own duties
introduced.quote: Nicole: Octavia didn't bother to come back, and you can forget about Rhinedottir... The other mages all have their own affairs to attend to, so the duty of supervising this homework has fallen to me.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: guides who travel by Seelie Courts and whose guidance ends when they return to their court
introduced.quote: Nicole: You've followed Seelie before, right? Only when a Seelie returns to its Seelie Court does its guidance come to an end.

introduced.name: Seelie Court
introduced.how: a travel point that can be used to move quickly between places
introduced.quote: Nicole: Did I use it to get us here faster? You bet I did! These Seelie Courts are connected to the Ley Lines, and nobody really uses them.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: the lines that Seelie Courts connect to, used for fast travel
introduced.quote: Nicole: Did I use it to get us here faster? You bet I did! These Seelie Courts are connected to the Ley Lines, and nobody really uses them.

introduced.name: dictionary
introduced.how: a record in which mages inscribe homework and stories
introduced.quote: Nicole: In any case, as long as I finish my homework, my story will be officially inscribed in the dictionary.

introduced.name: homework
introduced.how: assignments from the mages that must be delivered and completed to count
introduced.quote: Nicole: Alright. I gather you're here to deliver my "homework" — the one that Barbie prophesied?

introduced.name: Angel
introduced.how: Nicole and the Seelie were once angels
introduced.quote: Nicole: Besides, the Seelie and I used to be angels, so we're old colleagues. I'm sure they won't mind me borrowing their homes every once in a while.

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Traveler: We'll have to bring Varesa next time...

assumed.name: Collective of Plenty
assumed.quote: Nicole: Is she the champion eater from Natlan's Collective of Plenty? Alice mentioned her to me once — apparently, she's a fascinating young lady.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Nicole: As much as I'd like to erase the whole thing and keep on casually observing the world, Alice is busy maintaining Teyvat's borders

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Traveler: Venti and I once performed a duet on that island in the distance.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Nicole: Yes, I read about that in the dictionary. Based on how it ended, you and Lord Barbatos must have played quite a beautiful tune. Such a shame that Barbie couldn't hear a single note.

assumed.name: Tales of Time and Wind
assumed.quote: Traveler: Venti and I once performed a duet on that island in the distance.

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! Where did all those wolves jump out from!? Hey... We're not here to hurt you! We're friends with Razor...

assumed.name: With Lupical...
assumed.quote: Traveler: Razor and I once fought here together.

assumed.name: Wolvendom
assumed.quote: (The player is teleported to Wolvendom)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Nicole: Alright. That first sentence was clearly written by Barbie, but I'd bet my bottom Mora it was Alice who added the second.

assumed.name: Anya
assumed.quote: Nicole: It's a nice touch, but it feels like... the ending to a story written on the fly. If Anya were here, I'm sure she'd have come up with something more clever...

assumed.name: Witch's Lodge
assumed.quote: Nicole: No wonder Alice wanted to borrow the lodge key... She said she wanted to set up a tea room, even though I told her I already had one...

threads.claim: Barbeloth's prophecies are said to foresee the Traveler's arrival and the homework, but Nicole admits she is not sure what counts as a prophecy.
threads.quote: Nicole: Nonsense, your arrival is more or less in line with Barbie's prophecy... Though to be honest, I did think you'd be here a little later.

threads.claim: Barbeloth's prophecy may be little more than a spoiler of the ending written in advance, blurring what a prophecy is.
threads.quote: Nicole: Hmm... You make a fair point, but then what's the difference between a prophecy and a spoiler anyway?

threads.claim: A bard is said to come and call back the thousand winds that wander the ages, a hint of a future event.
threads.quote: Nicole: We're early. In but a short while, a bard will come to sing odes of old and call back the thousand winds that wander the ages...

threads.claim: Nicole and the Seelie were once angels, hinting at a lost past for the mages.
threads.quote: Nicole: Besides, the Seelie and I used to be angels, so we're old colleagues. I'm sure they won't mind me borrowing their homes every once in a while.

threads.claim: A child is said to overcome any foe while standing beside his lupical, an unexplained companion tied to the wolves' story.
threads.quote: Nicole: Shh. Has that child not arrived yet? Perhaps we've come too early again. Not to worry, as long as he stands beside his "lupical", he can overcome any foe.

threads.claim: A door appears with Alice's note promising a surprise, and Nicole senses it leads somewhere familiar and unexpected.
threads.quote: Nicole: Hurry home? Wait a second, why does this door look so familiar? There's no way it could lead to...

threads.claim: The Seelie Court chair symbolizes the completion of guidance, the end of a journey, and the fulfillment of prophecy.
threads.quote: Nicole: It symbolizes "the completion of guidance," "the end of a journey," and "the fulfillment of prophecy."

threads.claim: Nicole's homework is completed when she sits on the Seelie Court chair, and her story is formally inscribed in the dictionary.
threads.quote: Nicole: Ahem... And it seems my story has been formally inscribed in the dictionary.

introduced.name: Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge
introduced.how: a race challenge on Dragonspine with teams from several nations, and spectators welcome
introduced.quote: The Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge is about to kick off!

introduced.name: Heinz
introduced.how: Field Officer of 1st Company, Knights of Favonius, and an organizing committee staffer handling tickets
introduced.quote: Heinz: Field Officer Heinz, 1st Company, Knights of Favonius. It's an honor to meet you both.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: co-runs the contest's organizing committee with the Knights of Favonius, handling refereeing and support
introduced.quote: while the Springvale team is responsible for refereeing and support.

introduced.name: Varesa
introduced.how: a Natlan contestant and team captain, described with pink hair, horns, and a big appetite
introduced.quote: there's this one contestant with pink hair and a really impressive pair of horns on her head.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: Natlan team vice captain with a striped yellow-and-black tail, shown as cool and sharp-tongued
introduced.quote: Then there's the girl with the stripy yellow-and-black tail.

introduced.name: Alrani
introduced.how: self-introduces as an aspiring herbad at the Akademiya, currently a driyosh
introduced.quote: I'm Alrani, an aspiring herbad at the Akademiya... Technically just a driyosh in the meantime, hehe...

introduced.name: Tang Yigang
introduced.how: self-introduces as a member of the Legion of Soulblazers who speaks in comic quotes
introduced.quote: And I, Tang Yigang, will show you the light.

introduced.name: Legion of Soulblazers
introduced.how: a comic book fan club with founding tenets taken from The Soulblazer Saga
introduced.quote: The series you speak of is a bible to us, the Legion of Soulblazers.

introduced.name: The Soulblazer Saga
introduced.how: a comic book series that the fan club treats as its scripture
introduced.quote: They probably hit you with a barrage of quotes from The Soulblazer Saga, a comic book series published by the Yae Publishing House.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: publishes The Soulblazer Saga comic book series
introduced.quote: They probably hit you with a barrage of quotes from The Soulblazer Saga, a comic book series published by the Yae Publishing House.

introduced.name: Minnie
introduced.how: a young artist and pen pal of Nepecha who suggested the Dragonspine meetup and contest
introduced.quote: But more to the point, though, it was one of their members, Minnie, who suggested they hold their next meeting here.

introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.how: a Legion member and Xilonen's relative who is unwell and could not come, so Xilonen attends for her
introduced.quote: It's because I'm not a member of their fan club. Nepecha is. I'm sort of standing in for her.

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: Varesa's coach
introduced.quote: You'll be fine! I do the same thing with my coach, Iansan.

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: Varesa's homeland, located right next to a huge volcano that erupts with fireballs
introduced.quote: Where I'm from, in the Collective of Plenty, we live right next to a huge volcano!

introduced.name: Fietena
introduced.how: the new recruit protagonist of The Soulblazer Saga, facing her first battle
introduced.quote: Fietena: There's no backing out now. Let's do this!

introduced.name: Wanjiru
introduced.how: a fighter in The Soulblazer Saga who advises Fietena to wait for the right moment
introduced.quote: Wanjiru: Patience, Fietena. Timing is everything. Our victory depends on it.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: a comic book character who teaches Fietena how to judge the right moment in battle
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Wanjiru is right. This is your first lesson, Fietena: How to decide when the moment is right.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait! Look, it's Amber!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Amber: Ah! Honorary Knight, Paimon! Sorry, I was chatting away and didn't even notice you arrive.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: International means there's gonna be people from all over Teyvat taking part...

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: This year's event will see teams from Natlan, Sumeru, Inazuma, Liyue, and Mondstadt vying for the winner's crown.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The organizing committee's a joint effort between the Knights of Favonius and representatives from Springvale.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Fietena: The Pyro Archon will face down the leader while we mop up the minions.

threads.claim: Mondstadt is described as the land of freedom, which Minnie feels pulled away from but hesitates to leave.
threads.quote: Varesa: You totally should! Mondstadt's supposed to be the land of freedom, right? So... what's stopping you?

threads.claim: Minnie has a private deal with her parents about training and race results that she did not mention earlier.
threads.quote: If nothing else, I have to make good on the deal with my parents: train hard, and get a good race time.

threads.claim: Nepecha is in poor health and cannot take part in extreme sports, a condition her friends already know about.
threads.quote: But... She is in no condition for extreme sports, and well, she knows it.

threads.claim: The Soulblazer Saga Volume 2 ends mid-battle, leaving Fietena's story unresolved and the next volume unread.
threads.quote: Ugh, why'd it have to end there?

introduced.name: Jean
introduced.how: Knights leader who assigns the Traveler a discreet task and calls Mondstadt's safety her first priority
introduced.quote: but as you know, Mondstadt's safety must always be my first priority.

introduced.name: Schubert
introduced.how: Lawrence noble who introduces himself as a blood descendant of the nobility and is hard to deal with
introduced.quote: I'll have you know that you are speaking with the Schubert Lawrence, a blood descendant of the magnanimous nobility.

introduced.name: Lawrence Clan
introduced.how: former aristocratic family that oppressed Mondstadt and is the Knights' long-standing enemy
introduced.quote: The aristocrats, that had oppressed the people of Mondstadt, were none other than the Lawrence Clan.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: order founded after Vennessa's revolution overthrew the old aristocratic system
introduced.quote: established the Knights of Favonius, leading Mondstadt to become the city that you see today.

introduced.name: Vennessa
introduced.how: first Dandelion Knight who led the revolution that overthrew the aristocracy
introduced.quote: The first Dandelion Knight, Vennessa, spearheaded the revolution that overthrew the old aristocratic system

introduced.name: Eula
introduced.how: Lawrence family member who is captain of the Knights' 4th Company and seen as a traitor by her clan
introduced.quote: Not only is she from the Lawrence Clan, but she's also Captain of the Knights of Favonius 4th Company.

introduced.name: Sara
introduced.how: Good Hunter restaurant owner who explains why Eula is disliked despite being a good person
introduced.quote: Sara explains that Eula is prejudiced because of her family name

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: foreign group of ruffians with power that Schubert is secretly dealing with as business partners
introduced.quote: Hmph, nothing more than foreign ruffians with power and the ability to flaunt it... But they are favorable business partners.

introduced.name: Ley Line Monolith
introduced.how: activatable monolith that attracts nearby monsters during battle
introduced.quote: There's a Ley Line Monolith just up ahead that will attract nearby monsters.

introduced.name: Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut
introduced.how: sour old-aristocrat dish that is off the menu and unpopular today, given as a gift to Schubert
introduced.quote: Because of the sour flavor of the sauerkraut, not too many people are fond of it these days.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: the Traveler's title as an honorary member of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: This is the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Aristocratic rule of Mondstadt
introduced.how: dark period when the aristocracy ruled the city and slavery spread, ended by Vennessa's revolution
introduced.quote: There was a dark period in Mondstadt's history when the aristocracy ruled over the city.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Fatui! Again!?

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Amber: Well, if it isn't the Honorary Knight! I'm just on my way out to gather some intel.

assumed.name: Decarabian
assumed.quote: The hard-won freedom that followed with the fall of Decarabian was lost once again, as slavery spread throughout the land.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Let's pay Sara a visit at Good Hunter.

assumed.name: Springvale
assumed.quote: He has a small camp at the top of the mountain near Springvale.

assumed.name: Acting Grand Master
assumed.quote: Besides, if it's the Acting Grand Master's assignment, and Amber's the one who recommended me, I should comply.

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: But thanks to Grand Master Varka and the unwavering attitudes of others in the Knights of Favonius, they were able to quell the unrest.

threads.claim: Jean suspects a Lawrence Clan member is secretly dealing with the Fatui, with no solid evidence yet.
threads.quote: I have recently received multiple reports from the Knights of someone within the Lawrence Clan having close dealings with the Fatui.

threads.claim: Schubert is shown meeting Fatui in a hideout and handing over a diagram of Mondstadt's northern defenses.
threads.quote: Schubert then hands Sergei a diagram of the northern wall of Mondstadt and patrol routes.

threads.claim: Schubert plans to overthrow the Knights and restore Lawrence rule over Mondstadt with Fatui backing.
threads.quote: Once this is over, I shall stand atop the Favonius Headquarters and rebuke their pathetic rule over Mondstadt.

threads.claim: A mysterious woman vows vengeance against the Traveler and Paimon for taking her targets.
threads.quote: Ugh... mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

threads.claim: Eula keeps tallying the Traveler's transgressions and her threats of revenge, which may be partly playful.
threads.quote: We've only just met, and you've already given me three causes for vengeance.

threads.claim: Eula reveals her vengeance was a cover for protecting the city, having followed them to recover the diagram.
threads.quote: I came to exact my vengeance. You tried to do my job for me, and I'm here to return the favor.

threads.claim: The Lawrence name carries a bitter reputation among Mondstadt's common folk.
threads.quote: the name Lawrence carries too much weight with it.

threads.claim: Eula is judged by her family name, so her good deeds are dismissed by ordinary citizens.
threads.quote: So no matter what Eula tries to do, it's seen as a wrongdoing.

threads.claim: Eula's blunt manner hides a kind character who quietly helps people.
threads.quote: She's actually a very good person.

threads.claim: Mondstadt's hard-won freedom was lost once before when slavery spread under the aristocracy.
threads.quote: The hard-won freedom that followed with the fall of Decarabian was lost once again, as slavery spread throughout the land.

threads.claim: Eula claims to understand what freedom means to the people of Mondstadt and rejects the Lawrence family's pursuit of glory.
threads.quote: But I am capable of discerning right from wrong, and I deeply understand what "freedom" means to the people of Mondstadt.

threads.claim: The Fatui are secretly planning something against Mondstadt, and Eula doubts they would start an open war.
threads.quote: The Fatui are dishonest, but they wouldn't go as far as to start an open war.

threads.claim: Vennessa led a revolution that overthrew the aristocracy and founded the Knights of Favonius.
threads.quote: The first Dandelion Knight, Vennessa, spearheaded the revolution that overthrew the old aristocratic system

introduced.name: Irodori Festival
introduced.how: an Inazuma festival honoring The Five Kasen, revived with light novels
introduced.quote: The Irodori Festival was also developed as a result to show appreciation for their works which so greatly enriched our lives.

introduced.name: The Five Kasen
introduced.how: five legendary ancient Inazuman poets gifted in song and verse
introduced.quote: Legend has it that there were five poets in ancient Inazuma who were supremely gifted in singing and writing poetry.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: a past policy that closed Inazuma off, now lifted
introduced.quote: But now that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted, Inazuma is no longer the same nation that once resisted change tooth and nail.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: the body responsible for festival preparations, led by Ayato
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayato, who's helping Miko with the festival as head of the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Arrival Schedule
introduced.how: a timetable of guest ships and the times to meet them at the docks
introduced.quote: This Arrival Schedule includes the details of the ships on which the guests will be arriving.

introduced.name: Outlander Affairs Agency
introduced.how: the festival's main light novel exhibition area, where editors will stay
introduced.quote: During the festival, most of the Yae Publishing House's editors will be staying near the Outlander Affairs Agency.

introduced.name: light novels
introduced.how: the entertainment format Yae Miko promotes for the festival
introduced.quote: But nowadays, the entertainment format of choice is light novels.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: a body that investigates crimes such as cargo theft and illegal entry
introduced.quote: The Tenryou Commission was concerned about potential cargo theft, so they contacted everyone who was renting space in the warehouse.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: Yae Miko's publishing business in Hanamizaka
introduced.quote: Lady Yae is currently at Yae Publishing House in Hanamizaka, so there's no need to go all the way to the shrine.

introduced.name: Calx
introduced.how: Albedo's pen name in Inazuma, under which he paints the portraits
introduced.quote: Just so you're aware, I'll be using my pen name in Inazuma, Calx.

introduced.name: Zhenyu
introduced.how: author of A Legend of Sword, said to be a second son of a Liyue merchant family
introduced.quote: I have not met him personally, but the editors said that he is actually the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild family in Liyue.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a Liyue merchant family whose second son is the author Zhenyu
introduced.quote: I have not met him personally, but the editors said that he is actually the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild family in Liyue.

introduced.name: A Legend of Sword
introduced.how: a light novel by Zhenyu, illustrated by Albedo, with a new volume for the festival
introduced.quote: Just last month, to ensure the latest book of A Legend of Sword would be finished for the Irodori Festival, I had to complete the final chapter's illustrations the same day I received the manuscript.

introduced.name: Mr. Hirayama
introduced.how: editorial director at Yae Publishing House who was to supply the Five Kasen materials
introduced.quote: Well, Mr. Hirayama was supposed to meet with me and give me some reference materials about The Five Kasen today.

introduced.name: Suikou
introduced.how: one of The Five Kasen, a poet whose tale is told in the papers
introduced.quote: The poet Suikou made his way to Tenshukaku

introduced.name: Aoi no Okina
introduced.how: a moniker used for one of The Five Kasen, not their real name
introduced.quote: Monikers such as "Suikou" and "Aoi no Okina" aren't the real names of The Five Kasen.

introduced.name: Dandelion Wine
introduced.how: Mondstadt wine shipped in crates to Inazuma
introduced.quote: It was then that I happened upon a cargo ship bound for Inazuma transporting Dandelion Wine, so, naturally, I decided to set sail with them.

introduced.name: Invitation Letter
introduced.how: a required document issued by the Yashiro Commission for guests to enter Inazuma legally
introduced.quote: Although he claims to be a special guest for the Irodori Festival, he's failed to present his Invitation Letter.

introduced.name: theft of A Legend of Sword volumes
introduced.how: the latest copies of the novel vanished from a festival warehouse
introduced.quote: It was then that we realized that the latest copies of A Legend of Sword had suddenly gone missing!

introduced.name: Suikou's trial
introduced.how: Suikou was questioned and pleaded guilty over a page torn from Aoi no Okina's works
introduced.quote: Suikou pleaded guilty

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Hehe, you know Miko...

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: At last, we meet again, Traveler and Paimon.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: We've been apart for so long, and the moment we meet again

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Greetings, and Paimon.

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Honorary Knight! Paimon!

assumed.name: Kujou Sara
assumed.quote: As I have told you, you are a suspect.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Hey, isn't that Xingqiu's pen name?

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: But because everyone in the Knights of Favonius has been really busy these days

assumed.name: archon
assumed.quote: Even though Venti no longer rules over Mondstadt, he's still an archon.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: We'd better go to Grand Narukami Shrine and see what she needs us to do.

assumed.name: Tri-Commission
assumed.quote: This festival requires the full cooperation of the Tri-Commission

threads.claim: The Suikou paper was left in the crate by an unknown person who may be the thief or a witness.
threads.quote: The person who left this paper could quite possibly be the criminal or even a witness to the theft.

threads.claim: Suikou vaguely recalled a mysterious figure approaching him while he was drunk, and the figure's identity is left open.
threads.quote: And vaguely recalled a mysterious figure approaching while he was intoxicated

threads.claim: Venti feels he has lived through the Suikou story himself, hinting at an unexplained connection.
threads.quote: Huh, this story sounds familiar to my ear, where have I heard it...

threads.claim: The novel thieves are a team with insider access who had been watching the books for some time, still unidentified.
threads.quote: whoever took the novels is not a spur-of-the-moment burglar

threads.claim: Kuronushi, one of The Five Kasen, has no chapter in any of the known stories.
threads.quote: It appears that throughout all the stories, there is never a chapter dedicated to Kuronushi.

threads.claim: The original stories of The Five Kasen can no longer be verified, so their true history is lost.
threads.quote: Though there were once many stories regarding each of The Five Kasen, the validity of their contents can no longer be verified in present times.

threads.claim: Only the first of four known Five Kasen chapters has been found, so more chapters remain to be discovered.
threads.quote: According to the reference materials I was given, we've only found the first of a total of four chapters.

threads.claim: The author Zhenyu is revealed to be Xingqiu, answering the question of who wrote the novel.
threads.quote: Isn't that Xingqiu?

threads.claim: Inazuma is changing now that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted and it is reopening to the world.
threads.quote: But now that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted, Inazuma is no longer the same nation that once resisted change tooth and nail.

threads.claim: The tension between traditional Inazuman culture and modern entertainment is raised as a theme.
threads.quote: Speaking of which, don't you think that the concept of "focusing on the now" perfectly suits the current Inazuma?

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: Cocouik's true identity: a former Python King and ruler of Ochkanatlan, turned into a dragon by poison
introduced.quote: The voice reveals that its soul was corrupted by poison and transformed into a dragon, and asks for help in purging the corruption.

introduced.name: Kukulkan
introduced.how: the dragon-trickster who fabricated the Jade of Return legend and set the trap on the Tonatiuh
introduced.quote: The memories further reveal that the legend of the Jade of Return was fabricated by Kukulkan.

introduced.name: Taika
introduced.how: Bona's father, who led an expedition up the Tonatiuh in search of the Jade of Return and fell into Kukulkan's trap
introduced.quote: Within the memories, the Traveler also sees Taika and his expedition team made up of Copan, Titu, and Legba ascend the Tonatiuh

introduced.name: Copan
introduced.how: expedition member with Taika, seen in Och-Kan's memories
introduced.quote: Copan: Yo, looks like our hero's back.

introduced.name: Titu
introduced.how: expedition member with Taika, seen in Och-Kan's memories, who calls Taika the number-one adventurer
introduced.quote: Titu: And we owe all that to our hero, the number-one adventurer in the Flower-Feather Clan, eh?

introduced.name: Legba
introduced.how: expedition member with Taika, seen in Och-Kan's memories
introduced.quote: Legba: By the way, where's our young mystic Liriwu gone off to? I didn't see her when I got up this morning.

introduced.name: Golden Entreaty
introduced.how: a powerful but dangerous item that can cleanse Abyssal filth at a cost; two must be taken to the sacred mountain
introduced.quote: Och-Kan explains that the Golden Entreaty is a powerful yet dangerous item capable of cleansing Natlan's Abyssal filth, albeit at a cost

introduced.name: Jade of Return
introduced.how: the treasure the group recovers from the rock, which Paimon initially mistakes for a food platter
introduced.quote: which Paimon notes looks like a food platter.

introduced.name: Firestones
introduced.how: special flame-infused variants of Pyrophosphorite found across the Tonatiuh, used to activate the altar
introduced.quote: Using Firestones, special variants of Pyrophosphorite found across the Tonatiuh, the group activates the Altar of Primal Flame

introduced.name: Altar of Primal Flame
introduced.how: a mechanism that lets the group travel between floating islands and is needed to break the rock
introduced.quote: Bona: Well, how about it? We can use this mechanism to freely travel between the floating islands.

introduced.name: Flamelord's Blessing
introduced.how: an inherited blessing shared by Och-Kan and the Little One, both a gift and a curse that only another Golden Entreaty can lift
introduced.quote: Our bloodlines have both inherited the Flamelord's Blessing... It is both a gift and a curse.

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: the city once ruled by Och-Kan, now filled with Abyssal filth
introduced.quote: As the Traveler approaches the unconscious dragon, they hear a voice identifying itself as Och-Kan, the former ruler of Ochkanatlan.

introduced.name: Tonatiuh
introduced.how: a floating-island place reached by the group, where the Jade of Return is sealed in a rock
introduced.quote: They soon reunite with Bona, who reveals that they have reached the Tonatiuh.

introduced.name: Huitzilopochtli
introduced.how: a thing that Kukulkan wants activated by combining Golden Entreaties, promising a new civilization
introduced.quote: Kukulkan proposes activating Huitzilopochtli by combining the Golden Entreaties

introduced.name: Liriwu
introduced.how: a young mystic who joined the expedition and was left hiding in a tower
introduced.quote: Legba: By the way, where's our young mystic Liriwu gone off to? I didn't see her when I got up this morning.

assumed.name: Bona
assumed.quote: Bona: Hey! Hey! Over here!

assumed.name: Cocouik
assumed.quote: prompting the Traveler and Paimon to give chase alongside Cocouik.

assumed.name: Pyrophosphorite
assumed.quote: Paimon: What's this? It looks like Pyrophosphorite, but it's all shiny and flam-ey and stuff.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: I'm the ace adventurer of the Flower-Feather Clan.

assumed.name: Sage's ruins
assumed.quote: identical to the one they found in the Sage's ruins.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Hmm. Can this thing really suppress the filth of the Abyss in Ochkanatlan?

assumed.name: Manqu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Can that mark be removed? So this is the token that Manqu told us about before, then?

assumed.name: Xbalanque
assumed.quote: accuses him of betraying both dragonkind and Xbalanque's oath to Kukulkan

assumed.name: Yohualtecuhtin
assumed.quote: Be it humans or Yohualtecuhtin, the world will fall into peril again and again because of their inability to resist the dark foe.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Ten years back, when disaster came to Teyvat, even the Pyro Archon sacrificed her life for the cause...

threads.claim: Bona suspects the Tonatiuh treasures and the Jade of Return legend are made up by tribal storytellers.
threads.quote: For my part, I'd bet on our so-called Tonatiuh treasures being made up by tribal storytellers!

threads.claim: The memories reveal that Kukulkan fabricated the Jade of Return legend as a trap.
threads.quote: The memories further reveal that the legend of the Jade of Return was fabricated by Kukulkan.

threads.claim: Bona concludes that the Jade of Return legend is a bunch of bunk and the object is hazardous, not a cure.
threads.quote: Bona: The Tonatiuh laden with treasure, a Jade of Return that can cleanse filth... It's all a bunch of bunk.

threads.claim: Bona seems to have been to the Tonatiuh before, and knows how to use the altar without explanation.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ooh... Wait, Bona, how do you know all this? It's almost like you've been here before.

threads.claim: Bona appears to have awakened Och-Kan hundreds of years ago, which conflicts with her youth.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, do you mean that Bona awakened you hundreds of years ago?

threads.claim: Bona is possessed or manipulated, saying she should be long gone and that she has been here before.
threads.quote: Bona: Something's not right... I'm sure I've been here before, the Tonatiuh, and the Jade of Return...

threads.claim: Cocouik is revealed to be Och-Kan, the former Python King, awakened in full.
threads.quote: the dragon awakens as Och-Kan, retaining memories from both its past and its time as Cocouik.

threads.claim: The Little One shares the Flamelord's Blessing with Och-Kan, which may put it in danger.
threads.quote: Our bloodlines have both inherited the Flamelord's Blessing... It is both a gift and a curse.

threads.claim: The Golden Entreaty is dangerous, and its true purpose is unclear until it is taken to the sacred mountain.
threads.quote: A Golden Entreaty is as important as it is dangerous, so you have to take it to the sacred mountain

threads.claim: Removing the blessing requires two Golden Entreaties to be brought to the sacred mountain.
threads.quote: To remove this blessing, two Golden Entreaties must be brought to the sacred mountain.

threads.claim: Kukulkan wants to combine the Golden Entreaties to activate Huitzilopochtli and bring a new civilization through destruction.
threads.quote: Kukulkan proposes activating Huitzilopochtli by combining the Golden Entreaties

threads.claim: Kukulkan says he will return to collect Och-Kan's soul as part of his experiment.
threads.quote: as part of my experiment, I will return to collect your soul.

threads.claim: Someone unknown is behind the lure of the group to the Tonatiuh and is manipulating events.
threads.quote: Bona: The one behind this, whoever you are... I don't know why you've lured all of us here...

threads.claim: The mysterious speaker is the one who invented the Jade of Return legend and wore masks to test humans.
threads.quote: Och-Kan's betrayal taught me that I still have much to learn when it comes to humans, after all.

threads.claim: The mysterious speaker claims evolution is a concept belonging only to dragons, and humans only adapt by changing environments.
threads.quote: Evolution... has always been a concept that belongs to dragons, and dragons alone.

threads.claim: The Little One may be in danger, so the Traveler and Paimon head back to the Tonatiuh.
threads.quote: As they are returning, the Traveler and Paimon realize that the Little One may be in danger and decide to return to the Tonatiuh.

introduced.name: Montluson
introduced.how: Fontaine publisher and merchant who hires the bodyguards and wants to publish a book on the battle
introduced.quote: Montluson: Precisely! Montluson, at your service. I work in the publication business.

introduced.name: Grudoc
introduced.how: Fatui mercenary leader hired as Montluson's bodyguard, described as unsociable
introduced.quote: Ahem! This is Grudoc — I hired him to be my bodyguard in Natlan. As you can see, he's not the sociable type. I'm sorry for any offense.

introduced.name: Allier
introduced.how: Fontaine Research Institute researcher who studies ancient ruins and joins Montluson's team
introduced.quote: Allier: Of course! I don't often have an eager audience for this kind of thing... Nice to meet you. The name's Allier — I'm a Researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: Great shaman who lives over two hundred years and is feared by tribe youth as Granny Itztli
introduced.quote: Citlali: I'm Granny Itztli — a mere mention of my name, and kids burst into tears. Love and respect? Heh, no one has the guts for that.

introduced.name: Huitzilin
introduced.how: Color mystic shaman from over two hundred years ago, most skilled in her tribe's color technique
introduced.quote: Allier: Yes. According to local records, she was a color mystic who lived over two hundred years ago, the most adept in her tribe at using that particular technique.

introduced.name: Battle of Seven Colors
introduced.how: Ancient battle against an Abyss invasion, reportedly won by Huitzilin's special color, most celebrated of her exploits
introduced.quote: Out of all her exploits, her most celebrated is

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: Natlan tribe said to keep a tradition of recording past events
introduced.quote: Montluson: That's why I'm here. The Masters of the Night-Wind are said to have a tradition of recording past events, so I wanted to consult their records.

introduced.name: Obsidian Altar
introduced.how: Tribal site holding sacred records that outsiders are rarely allowed to access
introduced.quote: Montluson: But, I was refused access to the Obsidian Altar. Application after application, and all I received were a few ordinary woven scrolls with nothing to offer.

introduced.name: woven scrolls
introduced.how: Sacred relics that serve as the tribe's historical records
introduced.quote: Allier: According to my research, their scrolls are considered sacred relics in addition to historical records.

introduced.name: Tlapo
introduced.how: Iktomisaur elder who was once Huitzilin's saurian companion and now holds a high tribal position
introduced.quote: Citlali: Claw was only this big when we first met. He was Huitzilin's saurian companion back then.

introduced.name: Chicomostoc Cave
introduced.how: Name given in Etchemin's family account for where the battle took place
introduced.quote: in the version I heard, the battle took place in a location known as "Chicomostoc Cave."

introduced.name: The Valley of Fog
introduced.how: Present-day name for the cave that was called Chicomostoc Cave two hundred years ago
introduced.quote: Citlali: That location is now known as The Valley of Fog. Chicomostoc Cave is what it was called two hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power
introduced.how: Light novel that was the first major hit of the isekai genre, with rare first editions
introduced.quote: Citlali: It's the first major hit of the isekai genre. Several editions have gone to print, but copies of the first edition are exceedingly rare and valuable.

introduced.name: Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?
introduced.how: Light novel sister work that opened a new genre by Yae Publishing House
introduced.quote: It was Yae Publishing House's attempt at gauging the new market trends.

introduced.name: mind-reading spell
introduced.how: Citlali's sense-sharing spell that went wrong and lets her hear the Traveler's thoughts
introduced.quote: Citlali: Oh, and that spell I used to transfer my senses to you... You're not still, uh, experiencing the side-effects, are you?

introduced.name: graduation trial
introduced.how: Huitzilin's school requires students to defeat Citlali, later changed to lasting long enough, before graduating
introduced.quote: Citlali: All students from Huitzilin's school of shamanism must pass an extremely difficult trial before graduation — defeating me in battle.

introduced.name: Pantalone
introduced.how: Fatui Harbinger who hired or directed the bodyguards and wanted to disrupt Fontaine's economy
introduced.quote: but are confronted by the group of Fatui bodyguards who reveal that they are subordinates of the Fatui Harbinger Pantalone who was interested in disrupting Fontaine's economy.

introduced.name: realm of memory
introduced.how: Dimension inside the cave maze where memories and colors are used to navigate
introduced.quote: end up in a different dimension that Citlali calls a "realm of memory".

introduced.name: Huitzilin
introduced.how: Citlali's old rival and teacher, revealed as a memory fragment left in a space she built
introduced.quote: Citlali: ...No, it's just a trace of her consciousness left behind after creating this space.

introduced.name: Montluson
introduced.how: Fontainian book merchant who is secretly a printing magnate plotting to erase the Battle of Seven Colors
introduced.quote: Montluson: But, make no mistake — I'm no lowly merchant. I am the future owner of the largest printing company in all of Teyvat!

introduced.name: Allier
introduced.how: Fontainian researcher who introduces himself and wants to share Natlan's stories with the outside world
introduced.quote: Allier: Please, call me Allier... After questioning, the tribe absolved me of any serious wrongdoing, so here I am.

introduced.name: Grudoc
introduced.how: Fatui agent hired for Mora who collects debts and sets explosives in the cave
introduced.quote: Grudoc: United in the pursuit of Mora, we travel the land to collect debts. Our loyalty is to Regrator, his interests, and his wealth.

introduced.name: Regrator
introduced.how: A Harbinger whose Fatui subordinates serve his interests, not The Captain's
introduced.quote: Montluson: Haha, The Captain means nothing to them. They serve a different Harbinger altogether, Regrator!

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Mercenary-like group that travels collecting debts and serves Harbinger Regrator
introduced.quote: Grudoc: United in the pursuit of Mora, we travel the land to collect debts. Our loyalty is to Regrator, his interests, and his wealth.

introduced.name: Battle of Seven Colors
introduced.how: Legendary battle in which every Natlan tribe fought, which the team investigates for evidence
introduced.quote: Allier: There are weapons here from every tribe in Natlan. The battle must have encompassed the entire nation.

introduced.name: realm of memory
introduced.how: A space built from memories that is not reality, where maze-like structures exist
introduced.quote: Citlali: Hold on, the quality of this space... This isn't reality. It's a realm of memory!

introduced.name: color of memory
introduced.how: A special color that carries memory and is the core of the technique, found in the ancestors' work
introduced.quote: Huitzilin: That color is the core of the technique, but it isn't my invention. It's something I discovered in the work of our ancestors.

introduced.name: Grainfruit
introduced.how: Kernels used to decorate scrolls so the dead can enjoy the harvest
introduced.quote: Huitzilin: We decorate them with kernels of Grainfruit so the dead can still enjoy the abundance of our harvests.

introduced.name: woven scroll
introduced.how: Colorful scrolls used to record the tribe's history, colored with memory dye
introduced.quote: Huitzilin: We give our scrolls an orange hue so the dead can still feel the warmth of the setting sun.

introduced.name: shared-senses memory link
introduced.how: Sharing senses links two people's memories so they can hear each other's thoughts
introduced.quote: Citlali: Sharing senses allows communication to occur between the consciousness of different people. Naturally, memories are also involved in that process.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? What are the Fatui doing here?

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Traveler: Well, considering what The Captain did for Natlan...

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Montluson: Your exploits in Fontaine have all the makings of a best-selling series!

assumed.name: Tlapo
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hi there, Elder Tlapo!

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Montluson: , Great Shaman, sorry to keep you waiting. Shall we head out?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Citlali: When the Abyss first began to corrode the Ley Lines, they took every opening they could get.

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, aren't you subordinates of The Captain? Why are you helping someone who wants to erase Natlan's history!?

assumed.name: Elder Tlapo
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, it's Elder Tlapo and a group of iktomisaurs! They caught Montluson!

assumed.name: Granny Itztli
assumed.quote: Montluson: Ah, the wrath of Granny Itztli... Like I said, our interests aren't at odds.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Montluson: That's right! I didn't pay all that Mora for nothing!

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Allier: There are weapons here from every tribe in Natlan. The battle must have encompassed the entire nation.

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Montluson: Haha, The Captain means nothing to them. They serve a different Harbinger altogether, Regrator!

threads.claim: Some people dispute whether the Battle of Seven Colors ever happened, and no definitive evidence has been found.
threads.quote: Montluson: Even within the Masters of the Night-Wind, people dispute the legitimacy of the story. Some believe it to be a myth.

threads.claim: A family's version places the battle in Chicomostoc Cave, but Montluson suspects the battle is entirely made up.
threads.quote: Etchemin: Well, it's Huitzilin's personal account of the events, so it's a lot more detailed.

threads.claim: Huitzilin's techniques were split among students, and one shaman family may have inherited some of them.
threads.quote: Caholom: Actually, I know of a shaman family that inherited some of master's techniques.

threads.claim: Montluson believes Citlali and Huitzilin were close friends, while Citlali describes a rivalry.
threads.quote: Montluson: I heard that the great shaman, Huitzilin, was a friend of yours. You two must have been close...

threads.claim: Huitzilin was a rival who nonetheless claimed to be Citlali's friend, and Citlali still feels the loss.
threads.quote: Citlali: She only came to my place to fight me. But, at the same time, she always claimed to be my friend.

threads.claim: Citlali's sense-sharing spell has gone wrong, letting her hear the Traveler's thoughts.
threads.quote: Citlali: Then, why do I hear 's thoughts in my head?

threads.claim: Attempts to undo the spell only make the mind-reading link persist and get worse.
threads.quote: Citlali: That was just to help with the spell... Shoot, I still hear you...

threads.claim: Huitzilin built the maze from the memories of many Natlanese warriors, connected through her special color.
threads.quote: Huitzilin explains that the maze the group previously encountered used the memories of many different Natlanese warriors;

threads.claim: The Traveler's special constitution and link to the Night Kingdom let them see the color of memories without knowing it.
threads.quote: Huitzilin explains that due to the Traveler's special constitution and connection to the Night Kingdom, the Traveler is unknowingly also able to see the color of memories,

threads.claim: The Traveler may have a very long lifespan and ancient memories, which hints at an unexplained origin.
threads.quote: Traveler: I have some truly ancient memories...

threads.claim: Citlali's long life means losing friends repeatedly, which leads her to avoid closeness.
threads.quote: Citlali: Getting close means losing friend after friend for hundreds of years... until the weight of their memories crushes my soul.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon have a sacred duty from the tribe to help weave a special scroll.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah, we were given a sacred duty to help your tribe weave a special scroll!

threads.claim: Citlali completes the special scroll, which shows the Traveler and Mavuika side by side.
threads.quote: She completes the coloring, producing a woven scroll of the Traveler and Mavuika side-by-side.

threads.claim: Whether the Battle of Seven Colors actually happened is unproven, since no evidence of colors or a maze has been found yet.
threads.quote: Montluson: But, all we can really say is that a battle took place here. There's still no evidence of any colors or some elaborate maze.

threads.claim: The special dye is treated as the most direct evidence that the Battle of Seven Colors took place.
threads.quote: Citlali: I would say this is the most direct evidence that the Battle of Seven Colors actually took place.

threads.claim: Memories have color, and cherished memories are more vivid, so color is a vehicle for the power of memory.
threads.quote: Huitzilin: The more cherished the memory, the more vivid its color.

threads.claim: The essence of the special color is memory, and making the scroll means searching for color within one's memories.
threads.quote: Citlali: The essence of that color is memory.

threads.claim: Citlali realizes the technique at the center of the maze is the same one Huitzilin taught her long ago.
threads.quote: Citlali: After what I saw in the maze and everything you just told me, I'm certain the technique at the center of all this... is the same one you taught me all those years ago.

threads.claim: Passing the technique on means sharing memories with another person, which explains why Citlali never taught anyone.
threads.quote: Citlali: Passing the technique on to someone means sharing your memories with them.

threads.claim: The Traveler can see the special color, which is unusual.
threads.quote: Traveler: I saw the special color.

threads.claim: The Traveler can see the color of memory without training because of a strong connection to the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Huitzilin: Although he doesn't know how to wield it, he unknowingly left behind a trace of color in your memories.

threads.claim: Citlali is fated to live far longer than Huitzilin, and Huitzilin worries about her being left with a blank memory.
threads.quote: Huitzilin: You are fated to live a far longer life than me, Citlali. I couldn't bear the thought of all those years existing as a blank canvas in your memory...

threads.claim: Citlali has carried the scroll duty alone for two centuries because she has all the time in the world.
threads.quote: Citlali: It was her final wish, so I kind of resigned myself to taking on the burden forever. After all, I have all the time in the world.

threads.claim: Citlali and the Traveler can hear each other's thoughts, and Citlali may be hiding that the link is still active.
