threads.quote: Citlali: (So, after everything we just went through, I bet you can hear me again.)

threads.claim: Shared senses create a memory connection that lets consciousnesses communicate, and that connection is what caused the mind-reading.
threads.quote: Citlali: Sharing senses allows communication to occur between the consciousness of different people. Naturally, memories are also involved in that process.

threads.claim: Citlali was the source of the scroll gifts from the spirits, using illusions to hide her role from the appointed.
threads.quote: Citlali: Well, it's not like I wanted to interact with the appointed, so whenever I delivered the scroll, I used illusions to confuse them.

threads.claim: A Harbinger named Regrator lies behind the Fatui mercenaries and their contracts.
threads.quote: Montluson: Haha, The Captain means nothing to them. They serve a different Harbinger altogether, Regrator!

threads.claim: The Fatui's loyalty to Regrator's wealth means their actions align with his plans for Fontaine's economy.
threads.quote: Grudoc: This man has the potential to become a giant in the printing industry and disrupt Fontaine's economic system. This aligns with Regrator's interests.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom holds Natlan's memories, and the Traveler's connection to it is unusually strong.
threads.quote: Huitzilin: The Night Kingdom harbors Natlan's memories, and the Traveler's connection to that realm is incredibly strong, surpassing even the shamans who worship the Lord of the Night.

threads.claim: Montluson plans to use the printing industry to erase the Battle of Seven Colors from history.
threads.quote: Montluson: And in my version, I can erase the Battle of Seven Colors. You can be the one to have all the glory!

threads.claim: The misinformation campaign is exposed and Montluson's crimes are recorded for Fontaine authorities.
threads.quote: Biram: We now have a record of his crimes and will begin working with Fontaine authorities in a few days.

threads.claim: Elder Tlapo went missing, and no one in the tribe knows why.
threads.quote: Besuci: Speaking of Elder Tlapo, I heard he went missing yesterday! Do you know what happened?

threads.claim: Elder Tlapo's departure is said to have a meaning that the priests cannot yet grasp.
threads.quote: Chogan: Elder Tlapo works in mysterious ways. The meaning of his departure will become clear in time, but for now, we cannot hope to fathom it.

introduced.name: Fontinalia Film Festival
introduced.how: the festival is the first Fontinalia Film Festival, where a Furina Award is given for the winning film
introduced.quote: And the winner of the Furina Award for the first Fontinalia Film Festival is—

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: one of the lead actors in the film, and the Captain of the Special Patrol who escorts culprits
introduced.quote: She's one of the lead roles, after all.

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: the film's producer
introduced.quote: the producer of "The Two Musketeers," Mr. Xavier!

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: a visitor from Inazuma who was once taught to hold a musket by Chevreuse
introduced.quote: It feels like it was only yesterday when you were teaching me to hold a musket.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a place where accused culprits are escorted to be held
introduced.quote: the culprits of the musket murder case will be personally escorted today by the Captain of the Special Patrol to the Fortress of Meropide

introduced.name: musket murder case
introduced.how: a criminal case whose culprits are being taken to the Fortress of Meropide
introduced.quote: the culprits of the musket murder case will be personally escorted today by the Captain of the Special Patrol

introduced.name: The Two Musketeers
introduced.how: the film that wins the festival's top award, made by Xavier's crew

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild contact who gives the Traveler a commission
introduced.quote: Traveler, you've come at a good time.

introduced.name: Tighnari

introduced.how: sick boy in Gandharva Ville whom Tighnari treats
introduced.quote: Yara: Tighnari... Everything's spinning...

introduced.name: Asha

introduced.quote: Asha: Mr. Forest Watcher, how is my son?

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: Tighnari's apprentice who helps prepare medicine
introduced.quote: Collei: Master, I prepared the pharmaceutical equipment. Do you need me to help grind the medicine?

introduced.name: Mahir
introduced.how: merchant whose mechanical parts were stolen and who explains the closure
introduced.quote: Mahir: I'm sorry, Mr. Forest Watcher, but we've been closed for the past few days.

introduced.name: Vasanti Grass
introduced.how: expensive desert plant that can soothe the mind and is used for medicine
introduced.quote: Tighnari: If memory serves, a plant called Vasanti Grass can help soothe the mind.

introduced.name: Mechanical Crab
introduced.how: huge mechanical crab that steals mechanical parts and retreats into the contaminated region
introduced.quote: Fine, the thief that stole our parts was a huge, mechanical crab!

introduced.name: Jasar
introduced.how: herb picker who wandered into the contaminated region and is terrified of the crab
introduced.quote: Jasar: Help! Heeelp!

introduced.name: Sumeru Rose
introduced.how: flower also called the Ley Line Lodestar whose brightness signals dangerous Ley Line activity
introduced.quote: They're sensitive to Ley Lines and emit varying amounts of light in response.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: energy lines whose leaking effluence is causing the contamination and illness
introduced.quote: The contaminated region currently appears to have a critical efflux of Ley Line energy, which is probably the root cause of the patients' cognitive disturbances.

introduced.name: Purification Device
introduced.how: device Tighnari built to absorb excess Ley Line energy and temporarily stabilize an area
introduced.quote: A Purification Device I made. It can absorb excess Ley Line energy and temporarily stabilize an area.

introduced.name: Contaminated region
introduced.how: section of Avidya Forest affected by Ley Line effluence, where people fall ill and animals flee
introduced.quote: I've been studying this contaminated region recently, and I have a hypothesis of my own.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: research institution that banned research on mechanical life forms
introduced.quote: The Akademiya has banned mechanical life form research for years, so the origin of these creatures is very suspect.

introduced.name: Research ban on mechanical life forms
introduced.how: past ban after researchers performed cruel experiments on animals
introduced.quote: Research on mechanical life forms was thus banned.

introduced.name: Tighnari leaving the Akademiya
introduced.how: Tighnari left the Akademiya over disagreements with researchers' attitudes
introduced.quote: These are the points of contention I have with some researchers, and why I left the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Abattouy
introduced.how: deceased researcher who built the mechanical crab and the Ley Line extractors, whom Tighnari knew at the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Tighnari realizes that the man has been long dead and begins to investigate.

introduced.name: Karkata
introduced.how: name of the mechanical crab, revealed through Abattouy's tape recordings
introduced.quote: Karkata would likely be disassembled and put in storage.

introduced.name: Karkata
introduced.how: a mechanical crab companion introduced in the tape recordings and named as the mechanical crab
introduced.quote: Paimon: Karkata is the mechanical crab, right?

introduced.name: Abattouy
introduced.how: a researcher who introduces himself and whose experiments with mechanical life forms are revealed
introduced.quote: Abattouy: I, Abattouy, will unleash my talents here and amaze those ancient fossils at the Akademiya!

introduced.name: Ley Line Extractor
introduced.how: a device that drains Ley Line energy without end and disrupts the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Tighnari: This device... It's extracting energy from the Ley Lines without end.

introduced.name: Spantamad
introduced.how: an institution that developed experiment-recording tape devices, and where Tighnari took a course
introduced.quote: Yes. The Spantamad created a device that visually records experiments and consolidates the final production into a tape.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an institution that bans mechanical life form research and requires all research products to be destroyed
introduced.quote: What I meant was, according to the Akademiya's policies, all products of research must be destroyed.

introduced.name: mechanical life form
introduced.how: a machine that must resemble a living organism in structure, emotion and independent thought to count as alive
introduced.quote: Tighnari: To Abattouy, for a machine to truly be considered a mechanical life form, it must possess features similar to any other living organism...

introduced.name: Ley Line effluence
introduced.how: a contamination of Ley Line energy caused by the extractor and its mechanical monsters draining power after Abattouy's death
introduced.quote: Tighnari: I see, so the Ley Line effluence was an accident.

introduced.name: Forest Watcher of the Avidya Forest
introduced.how: Tighnari's role as the forest's guardian, with a duty to protect all life there
introduced.quote: I am the Forest Watcher of the Avidya Forest. I have a duty to protect all life in the forest.

introduced.name: Abattouy's death
introduced.how: Abattouy died of illness after his extractor malfunctioned, leaving the machines to keep draining Ley Line power
introduced.quote: Tighnari: After Abattouy's unexpected death, the mechanical monsters were driven by their "instincts" and continuously drew out power from the Ley Line Extractor.

assumed.name: Withering Zone
assumed.quote: Contaminated? You mean... a new Withering Zone?

assumed.name: Commission from the Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, this sounds like... another commission?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Running out of energy and Mora, however, he decided to create the Ley Line extractors as a power source.

assumed.name: Suna
assumed.quote: Yara: And tell Suna that I'm sorry for breaking her toy.

assumed.name: Elemental power resistance
assumed.quote: Good. It's as I predicted: Elemental power confers a degree of resistance against the contaminated region's influence.

assumed.name: Ruin Machines
assumed.quote: where they find some Ruin Machines and defeat them

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Ready yourselves. We're going in.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: I see. Thank you for your hard work.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Tell the Adventurers' Guild that the incident has been resolved, and then get some sleep. We can discuss matters tomorrow.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: We'll put up an announcement on the bulletin board about the dangers of entering the contaminated region, and for symptomatic individuals to find Collei.

assumed.name: Purification Devices
assumed.quote: The Purification Devices will handle the rest.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Ley Line energy is spilling out from here.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Even if I scrimped and saved, the Mora I have wouldn't last for long.

threads.claim: A section of Avidya Forest has become contaminated, and people who cross it suffer strange effects whose cause is unknown.
threads.quote: I hear that strange things are happening to people who cross through that region.

threads.claim: The new contamination is not a Withering Zone, though its nature is still unclear.
threads.quote: Doesn't seem like one. Whether you look at scale, internal conditions, or resultant effects, they're completely different.

threads.claim: Tighnari suspects the contamination comes from Ley Lines, but he cannot yet confirm it.
threads.quote: I can't confirm that right now, but I think that is the case.

threads.claim: Tighnari suspects an unseen owner is directing the mechanical crab, and that someone disrupted the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: My suspicion is less towards the crab, and more directed to its unrevealed owner.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the mechanical crab truly understands language or only responds to programmed triggers.
threads.quote: We can't be certain yet. Its excitement may be a simple, programmed response upon seeing mechanical components.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's banned research on mechanical life forms may be connected to the origin of these creatures.
threads.quote: The Akademiya has banned mechanical life form research for years, so the origin of these creatures is very suspect.

threads.claim: Tighnari believes all life must be respected and criticizes researchers who treat knowledge as a tool for domination.
threads.quote: Life is not an expendable commodity, and knowledge should not be wielded like a scepter.

threads.claim: Purification Devices can only delay the expansion of the contamination, so the source must be dealt with.
threads.quote: At best, they can only prevent the contaminated region from expanding temporarily.

threads.claim: The contamination was caused by Abattouy's Ley Line extractors, which he overcharged before dying.
threads.quote: having overcharged them, he succumbed to the Ley Line energy before he could shut the extractor down.

threads.claim: Abattouy aims to create a mass-producible mechanical life form that surpasses anything existing.
threads.quote: I'm going to make a mechanical life form that can be mass-produced. The technology will be unlike anything else that exists.

threads.claim: Tighnari cannot rigorously prove that Karkata is a real life form, though he is willing to believe it.
threads.quote: From a more rigorous perspective, it is impossible to conclude that Karkata is a real life form, but the possibility exists — I am willing to believe in that.

threads.claim: Karkata seems to care for Abattouy more than for itself despite being unable to speak.
threads.quote: Karkata can't speak, and yet it cares about Abattouy far more than it does about itself.

threads.claim: Karkata may have formed its own wish to repair Abattouy, overriding the instincts he installed.
threads.quote: Tighnari: Yes, but the important thing is that it formed the thought of "wanting to repair Abattouy."

threads.claim: Someone is draining Ley Line energy in a way that will stop the Ley Lines from repairing themselves.
threads.quote: Who in the world would do this without considering the consequences? The Ley Lines won't be able to repair themselves if their flow is perpetually disrupted like this.

threads.claim: Once the extractor is shut off, the Ley Lines can begin to repair themselves.
threads.quote: Tighnari: Without an external force damaging the Ley Lines, they should start to slowly repair themselves.

threads.claim: Abattouy's work draws on research the Akademiya had banned.
threads.quote: Inspiration from the ruins, and the research that the Akademiya had banned... I hope everything can start anew from this place.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's policies require research to be destroyed, so the site must be kept hidden from it.
threads.quote: That's why we can't let the Akademiya discover that place.

threads.claim: Abattouy's health is failing while he runs the extractor alone.
threads.quote: Abattouy: Strange... I feel weak...

threads.claim: Abattouy died of illness, leaving the machines to drain Ley Line energy unchecked.
threads.quote: Tighnari: After Abattouy's unexpected death, the mechanical monsters were driven by their "instincts" and continuously drew out power from the Ley Line Extractor.

threads.claim: Tighnari's duty as Forest Watcher is to protect all life in the forest.
threads.quote: I am the Forest Watcher of the Avidya Forest. I have a duty to protect all life in the forest.

introduced.name: Ellin
introduced.how: Knights of Favonius training ground staffer whose father made the large training dummy
introduced.quote: Ellin: My father made this as a special collector's edition! I'm sure it'll prove worthy of your skills!

introduced.name: Timmie
introduced.how: Young kid in Mondstadt who idolizes Varka and feeds the pigeons on the bridge
introduced.quote: Timmie: Hey! You've scared off all the pigeons...

introduced.quote: Diona: ...That old boozehound!

introduced.quote: Diona: ...In the end, Prince ran off before he could finish.

introduced.quote: 'Least he gave that old boozer a nice big scratch on the way out! Hahahaha!

introduced.name: Expeditionary force return

introduced.quote: Diona: So, you know how he returned recently with some of the expeditionary force, right?

assumed.name: Mondstadt City
assumed.quote: (Approach the marked location in Mondstadt City)

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Varka: My task... is to make the finest wine Teyvat has ever seen.

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel conference
assumed.quote: Paimon: Y'know, since it was Varka who came up with the whole idea of holding a "conference" with the Hexenzirkel, how come we never found out what task they gave him?

assumed.name: Domain

assumed.name: Knights of Boreas

assumed.name: Defeating a god

assumed.name: Spring fairy

threads.claim: Varka's task from the Hexenzirkel is blank, leaving its content and reason an open question.
threads.quote: Traveler: But yours seems to be blank.

threads.claim: Alice reveals Varka's task was to change the fate reflected in the scryglass, which he had already done by setting off on his expedition.
threads.quote: Alice: Hah! Well, if you really must know, yours was to "change the fate reflected in the scryglass."

threads.claim: Varka's vision of all the previous Knights of Boreas hints at a past lineage of knights that the story leaves unexplained.
threads.quote: Varka: ...For a moment there, I could've sworn I saw all the previous Knights of Boreas standing right here in front of me...

threads.claim: Paimon's remark implies Varka once defeated a god, a past feat left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Come on! You didn't defeat a god just to bite the dust here!

threads.claim: A spring fairy's blessing is named as the missing ingredient, a hint at a mysterious figure left unexplained.
threads.quote: Varka: Aha, so the missing ingredient was actually the spring fairy's blessing... Haha, never would've guessed!

threads.claim: The hilichurls surrender their cauldron to Varka in fear without any exchange, and the reason is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Ella Musk: Unbelievable... Since when were hilichurls so amenable to reason?

introduced.name: Sigewinne
introduced.how: Melusine doctor and Beauty Association leader who keeps a human form and runs the infirmary
introduced.quote: Hello there, and Paimon. I hope you're keeping yourselves fit and healthy?

introduced.name: Fontaine Beauty Association
introduced.how: beauty association that runs the magazine Beautes en fleurs and Sigewinne holds a leading role in
introduced.quote: and it's run by the Fontaine Beauty Association.

introduced.name: Beautes en fleurs
introduced.how: beauty magazine where Sigewinne writes skincare articles under a pen name
introduced.quote: I've done lots of articles about skincare for them, using the pen name

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: non-human people who view humans by cuteness and have a different aesthetic
introduced.quote: Actually, Melusine aesthetics are very different from human ones.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: city district where the beauty promotion and the opening scene take place
introduced.quote: Walking around the Court of Fontaine, the Traveler and Paimon discover a beauty promotion occurring outside a store.

introduced.name: Rawat
introduced.how: researcher who invented the skin lotion and introduces himself at the sale
introduced.quote: Hello everyone, I'm Rawat, and I developed Butterfly Dew.

introduced.name: Butterfly Dew
introduced.how: new skin lotion sold at the Court of Fontaine that Sigewinne rates as first-rate
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce our newest skin lotion, Butterfly Dew.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: research body where Rawat works
introduced.quote: please welcome Mr. Rawat, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Calcagni
introduced.how: host who runs the product sale on behalf of the skincare partner
introduced.quote: Attention customers! Thank you all for waiting.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: prison where Sigewinne runs the infirmary and treats inmates
introduced.quote: As for me, it's probably time I got back to the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Erick
introduced.how: inmate who claims to have seen his doppelganger and is examined by Sigewinne
introduced.quote: Please, you have to believe me! I saw it with my own eyes last night, another me!

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: guard official who explains the doppelganger report and hands the case to Sigewinne
introduced.quote: Ah, it's you two. Indeed it has.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: investigating force that has made arrests and requested Wriothesley's help
introduced.quote: The Marechaussee Phantom has requested my cooperation on a case, otherwise I'd deal with this myself.

introduced.name: Potton
introduced.how: serious offender with a melting face who treats his illness and is later revealed as the gang member
introduced.quote: Don't patronize me! Do I look like a kid to you?

introduced.name: Odilon
introduced.how: guard who escorts inmates and explains the major case and arrests
introduced.quote: Sigewinne, we've brought him — and he seems to have taken a turn for the worse again.

introduced.name: Luc
introduced.how: young boy who refuses his bitter medicine and is scared into drinking it
introduced.quote: Hey Doc, it's me. I'm only here 'cause my mom won't stop pestering me about it

introduced.name: Wolsey

introduced.quote: Ah, Head Nurse! Got some extras for me?

introduced.name: Courbevoie
introduced.how: guard who reports Erick's sudden recovery late at night
introduced.quote: I'm sorry to disturb you this late at night, but I think you'll agree this is urgent.

introduced.name: Morgane
introduced.how: Marechaussee officer who leads the raid and questions the case
introduced.quote: Morgane orders Dupont to stand guard at the entrance with other guards, telling him to call reinforcements if they didn't return.

introduced.name: Ceasth
introduced.how: Marechaussee member who realizes the criminals stole Rawat's research and opens the mother's door
introduced.quote: Ceasth states that they would have spotted any changes.

introduced.name: Melusine witch and potion story
introduced.how: Sigewinne tells how a Melusine drank a potion for human form to save a sick girl
introduced.quote: Long ago, humans rejected Melusines, and Melusines feared humans

introduced.name: Butterfly Dew production plant
introduced.how: the lotion is revealed to be made in a hidden secret facility
introduced.quote: they realize that it was actually a production plant for

introduced.name: Potton
introduced.how: Gang member and face-switcher who hides behind other identities and is later revealed to be Rawat
introduced.quote: Potton: Look. My plan got you all out of prison, didn't it?

introduced.name: Houilles
introduced.how: Escaped inmate in the gang, who insists he is not Gascon
introduced.quote: I'm not Gascon, I'm Houilles!

introduced.name: face-changing potion
introduced.how: A potion that can completely change a person's appearance and evade Melusine detection
introduced.quote: Sigewinne: Hmm... Actually, there is a potion that can completely change someone's appearance.

introduced.name: Rawat
introduced.how: Fontaine Research Institute researcher who developed a skincare product and reported the gang
introduced.quote: I believe his name is Rawat.

introduced.name: Butterfly Dew
introduced.how: Rawat's popular skincare product, which contains a hidden active ingredient
introduced.quote: Yeah, kinda. "Butterfly Dew," or whatever he calls it.

introduced.name: Audree
introduced.how: Researcher who once confessed feelings to Rawat and is dismissive of him
introduced.quote: Audree: That's me. What is it?

introduced.name: Rawat's mother
introduced.how: Rawat's ill, housebound mother whom he raised alone and visits regularly

introduced.how: Coatings researcher who wanted to license Rawat's findings and was refused

introduced.how: Former collaborator of Rawat who says they split over commercial motives

introduced.name: two Erick impostors

introduced.quote: Traveler: There's two Ericks.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: Melusines are a people whose duties include spotting criminals in disguise
introduced.quote: one of the explicit duties of the Melusines in the Marechaussee Phantom is to identify criminals in disguise.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A prison with an infirmary where inmates receive medical care under guarded escort
introduced.quote: I authorized him to leave the Fortress for medical treatment under guarded escort.

introduced.name: Primordial Seawater
introduced.how: A substance Fontainians once dissolved in, which is now unusable for them since the flood
introduced.quote: Oh, I doubt it. After all, Fontainians can no longer dissolve in Primordial Seawater.

introduced.name: the great flood
introduced.how: A flood after which Fontainians became true humans and lost their former physiology
introduced.quote: But since the flood, Fontainians have become true humans.

introduced.name: Potton
introduced.how: A man who discovered the potion while helping a criminal gang produce Sinthe, then disguised himself as Rawat to sell the diluted formula as a skincare product
introduced.quote: Apparently, the formula was something he discovered by chance while helping the criminal gang produce Sinthe.

introduced.name: Vacher
introduced.how: The gang's supplier and leader of a criminal network whose evidence Potton's operation helped dispose of
introduced.quote: Their supplier was Vacher — but you could also argue that they were the ones doing him a favor.

introduced.name: Butterfly Dew
introduced.how: A skincare product made from the diluted potion, safe only when unmodified, sold on the market and then recalled and disposed of
introduced.quote: Unless modified, Butterfly Dew is an excellent skincare product that's completely safe to use.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A prison where Sigewinne served a sentence hundreds of years ago and later stayed on as staff
introduced.quote: Sigewinne served a sentence in the Fortress of Meropide hundreds of years ago, and after she did her time, she decided to stick around.

introduced.name: Egeria
introduced.how: An ancient figure linked to the old law, who may have imposed it to keep her people ignorant of the truth
introduced.quote: a way for Egeria to ensure that her people would remain insulated from the truth

introduced.name: Fontaine's ancient anti-transformation law
introduced.how: An old law forbidding any attempt to transform another species into a human, which Sigewinne broke
introduced.quote: Long before I became Iudex, there was an ancient law in Fontaine that prohibited any attempt to transform another species into a human.

introduced.name: Melusine prejudice
introduced.how: In the past many people held prejudices against Melusines, so few would take one on as a student
introduced.quote: In those days, many people harbored prejudices against Melusines.

introduced.name: The Witch
introduced.how: Sigewinne's former teacher, a doctor who experimented on herself, gave Sigewinne the potion, and then died
introduced.quote: I had no choice but to experiment on myself to find a cure, but I hit a wall — and as you can see, it took a wretched toll on me.

introduced.name: Transformation potion
introduced.how: An accidental discovery from the Witch's study of a strange disease, left behind as a parting gift that transforms the user into a human
introduced.quote: I will leave you a parting gift — an accidental discovery, happened upon through my study of this strange disease.

introduced.name: Old Woman
introduced.how: An elderly woman who says Sigewinne saved her years ago and thanks her for changing how people treat Melusines
introduced.quote: I still remember, you know. It was you who saved me that night

assumed.name: Duke
assumed.quote: The Duke insists I take regular vacations in the Court of Fontaine.

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: when they were discovered by Neuvillette, where the Melusine befriended a human girl.

assumed.name: Primordial Seawater
assumed.quote: without relying on Primordial Water, which gets his attention.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Hmph, of course you'd bring up Mora... Fine, Paimon'll pay out of her own pocket

assumed.name: Previous meeting with Sigewinne
assumed.quote: It's been a while.

assumed.name: Earlier malingering case
assumed.quote: I thought you did a pretty good job last time...

assumed.name: Wriothesley
assumed.quote: Wriothesley: Remember the case I mentioned yesterday?

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: The one brought to me by the Marechaussee Phantom?

assumed.name: Erick
assumed.quote: do you remember Erick from the other day?

assumed.name: Sigewinne
assumed.quote: Let's go find Sigewinne.

assumed.name: Rawat's skincare promotion
assumed.quote: Paimon: Rawat? Isn't that the handsome guy we met at that skincare promotion?

assumed.name: Sinthe business
assumed.quote: for being in the Sinthe business

assumed.name: Iudex
assumed.quote: Big news, everyone: The Iudex is out of his office on important business.

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: After reading the Marechaussee Phantom's reports, I had a feeling a trip here might be in order.

assumed.name: Primordial Seawater
assumed.quote: Since the flood cut off their supply of Primordial Seawater, they've been forced to resort to riskier methods — like using their private reserve to attack people on the street.

assumed.name: Dissolution of Fontainians
assumed.quote: I fear Sigewinne only understood the full story after the truth about the dissolution of Fontainians was uncovered.

threads.claim: A Melusine took a witch's potion to gain human form, losing what attracted her friend, and this was a secret kept by Sigewinne.
threads.quote: In desperation, the Melusine approached the frightening witch

threads.claim: Sigewinne's teacher turns out to have been the witch from the story who gave the potion.
threads.quote: they realize that her teacher was actually the

threads.claim: A flood reduced the supply of Primordial Seawater, pushing the gang to desperate and violent acts.
threads.quote: After the flood reduced the supply of Primordial Seawater

threads.claim: Neuvillette suspects Egeria is hiding the true origins of Fontainians.
threads.quote: which he believed was Egeria wanting to keep the true origins of Fontainians a secret

threads.claim: Fontainians were dissolved and their remains used for the lotion before Neuvillette removed their sins.
threads.quote: the lotion was made from the remains of dissolved Fontainians prior to Neuvillette abstaining them of their sins

threads.claim: A potion exists that not even a Melusine can detect, letting criminals swap identities.
threads.quote: Sigewinne reveals that there is a possibility of them having used a potion that not even a Melusine could detect.

threads.claim: Erick reports seeing his exact double, a claim that may be a mental problem or something real.
threads.quote: Please, you have to believe me! I saw it with my own eyes last night, another me!

threads.claim: Erick admits the doppelganger was stress-induced hallucination from overwork.
threads.quote: Erick admits that he had been overworking himself and had a slight breakdown, apologizing to Sigewinne.

threads.claim: Potton's face is melting off after taking a potion, and the cause is unexplained.
threads.quote: Did his... face melt!? What happened to him?

threads.claim: The researcher Rawat is revealed to be Potton, who used a potion to change his appearance.
threads.quote: Potton claims to be Rawat, much to Morgane's chagrin

threads.claim: Appearance shapes how people are treated and what they can do, a theme running through the story.
threads.quote: Our actions are at the mercy of our appearance, and we slowly become the very person that the outside world sees us as.

threads.claim: The face-changing potion is made from fluid left by dissolved Fontainians, which Sigewinne explains as the key to the face-swapping.
threads.quote: Sigewinne: The key component of the face-changing potion is the fluid left behind by dissolved Fontainians.

threads.claim: Rawat is revealed to be Potton, the gang member who used the potion to change his face.
threads.quote: Listen to me! I'm Rawat! That's my mother in there!

threads.claim: Before the flood Fontainians were Oceanids, and the flood made them true humans who can no longer supply the potion's ingredient.
threads.quote: Sigewinne: Before the flood, all Fontainians were Oceanids, physiologically speaking.

threads.claim: The supply of the source fluid used for face-changing is drying up, and the gang is struggling to get it.
threads.quote: Been receiving less and less of the source fluid.

threads.claim: Sigewinne confirms she used the potion herself, which is why she has a human appearance.
threads.quote: Sigewinne: Yes, you're right.

threads.claim: Melusines faced discrimination because of their appearance, and Potton says that pushed Sigewinne to use the potion.
threads.quote: It was either carry on living in the gutters as part of an alien race cast out by humanity

threads.claim: A criminal Sinthe business exists in Fontaine and is punished by the Gardes.
threads.quote: If you get caught by the Gardes for being in the Sinthe business, you ain't ever seeing the light of day again!

threads.claim: Potton denies that he was coerced and says he chose to keep working with the gang for profit.
threads.quote: Back when I was being coerced, everyone thought I was colluding of my own free will.

threads.claim: The Witch suspected a hidden disease that every Fontainian suffers from, and no one would believe her without proof.
threads.quote: I discovered a strange disease, one I suspect that every Fontainian suffers from.

threads.claim: The full truth about the dissolution of Fontainians was uncovered only after the events of Sigewinne's transformation.
threads.quote: I fear Sigewinne only understood the full story after the truth about the dissolution of Fontainians was uncovered.

threads.claim: The ancient anti-transformation law may have been a deliberate tool to keep Fontainians ignorant of the truth.
threads.quote: a way for Egeria to ensure that her people would remain insulated from the truth

threads.claim: The Witch gambled on one final experiment that would decide whether she could save everyone, or be beyond saving.
threads.quote: Then I shall make one more final gamble... and see my experiment through to its end.

threads.claim: The Witch's experiment ended with her self-sacrifice, as the Traveler concludes from the story.
threads.quote: Her teacher sacrificed herself.

threads.claim: Vacher and his accomplices are destined to be stopped, though their crimes are still ongoing.
threads.quote: Make no mistake, the crimes of Vacher and his accomplices will come to an end. It's only a matter of time.

threads.claim: The last transformation potion is given to the Traveler and Paimon, who choose to destroy it.
threads.quote: Yeah, let's just destroy this thing.

threads.claim: Respect for Sigewinne is questioned as something that depends on whether she looks human or Melusine.
threads.quote: Does it really matter if you're human or Melusine?

threads.claim: The Old Woman reveals that Sigewinne saved her long ago, showing the warmth of her palm was a lasting kindness.
threads.quote: I still remember, you know. It was you who saved me that night

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: Introduced as the eldest daughter of the Kamisato Clan who asks the Traveler for a personal favor
introduced.quote: Let's not forget that I am the eldest daughter of the Kamisato Clan.

introduced.name: Tsubaki
introduced.how: Mysterious person named in the late mother's notebook, unknown to Ayaka and her brother, described as lively and fun-loving
introduced.quote: Someone with a lot of personality, who liked to have fun.

introduced.name: Kamisato Kayo
introduced.how: Ayaka's late mother, revealed to be the person behind the Tsubaki identity
introduced.quote: When I become Tsubaki, I stop being Kamisato Kayo and become the most ordinary woman in the world.

introduced.name: Ogura Mio
introduced.how: Shopkeeper of Ogura Textiles & Kimonos who explains the silk shortage
introduced.quote: Welcome to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos. Are you here to purchase fabric, or for tailored garments?

introduced.name: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos
introduced.how: Tailoring shop where Ayaka commissions a silk kimono
introduced.quote: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos is our first stop.

introduced.name: Kiminami Restaurant
introduced.how: Local eatery run by Kiminami Anna, next to her family's home
introduced.quote: a humble local eatery called Kiminami Restaurant.

introduced.name: Kiminami Anna
introduced.how: Restaurant owner who has known the Kamisato Clan for years and reveals Ayaka has few friends
introduced.quote: Over the years we've been in business, we've gotten to know the Kamisato Clan quite well.

introduced.name: Kurisu
introduced.how: Distressed merchant from the International Trade Association whose stolen silk drives the plot
introduced.quote: *whimpering* What am I going to do...

introduced.name: International Trade Association
introduced.how: Association that brings together merchants from around the world and imports goods such as silk
introduced.quote: after all, the association brings together merchants from all over the world.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: Authority that looks down on foreign merchants and refuses to help them
introduced.quote: The Kanjou Commission don't want to give us the time of day

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Body responsible for maintaining public order, which treats festivals as a challenge
introduced.quote: each festival, in turn, brings a fresh challenge to the task of maintaining public order...

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: One of the most illustrious clans in the land, to which Ayaka belongs
introduced.quote: belongs to one of the most illustrious clans in the land

introduced.name: Ronin
introduced.how: Vagrant thieves who stole the silk and demanded payment to return it
introduced.quote: You think you can get your stuff back with this bunch? You must be dreaming.

introduced.name: Silk Flower silk
introduced.how: High-grade silk needed for the kimono design, made from the Silk Flower
introduced.quote: silk made from the Silk Flower

introduced.name: Inazuma lockdown
introduced.how: Inazuma is under a strict lockdown that cuts off imports of high-grade fabric
introduced.quote: As you well know, Inazuma is currently under a strict lockdown.

introduced.name: Fox envoys
introduced.how: Supernatural beings from Inazuma legend; Guuji Yae is one of them
introduced.quote: fox envoys are nothing new. Stories have been told about them in Inazuma since ancient times.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Supernatural beings in Liyue living in the sky, underground, and water
introduced.quote: They have lots of supernatural beings there, like the adepti.

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.how: Foreign port that supplies most of Inazuma's silk
introduced.quote: The majority of Inazuma's silk is imported from Liyue Harbor

introduced.name: Xiangling
introduced.how: Talented chef friend of the Traveler's from Liyue with unusual tastes
introduced.quote: A friend of ours who's a really talented chef, though she has some strange tastes...

introduced.name: Pizza
introduced.how: Overseas dish of toppings and sauce on bread, chosen as a gift for Tsubaki
introduced.quote: It's an assortment of toppings and sauce spread over a bread base and cooked in the oven.

introduced.name: Shirasagi Himegimi
introduced.how: Title of the Traveler meaning white heron princess
introduced.quote: Speaking of white herons, that's what your title means, doesn't it? Shirasagi Himegimi.

introduced.name: White heron hairpin
introduced.how: Hairpin Ayaka gives the Traveler as a thank-you gift
introduced.quote: It's a hairpin in the style of a white heron.

introduced.name: Crane and white rabbit verse
introduced.how: Ritual verse in the notebook describing a crane, a white rabbit, and calling out Tsubaki's name
introduced.quote: A crane brings fresh flower in its beak to decorate my hair, while a white rabbit sews a hemline from rays of moonlight.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: a prominent Inazuman clan that leads the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: The Kamisato Clan leads the Yashiro Commission. It's one of the most well-known clans in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: an organization led by the Kamisato Clan and well known across Inazuma
introduced.quote: The Kamisato Clan leads the Yashiro Commission. It's one of the most well-known clans in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Sanden
introduced.how: a mask stall vendor who recognizes Ayaka and gives the group masks for free
introduced.quote: Sanden: Hey! Isn't that Miss Kamisato?

introduced.name: Shimizu
introduced.how: a fortune slip stall vendor whose uncle once dealt with the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: Shimizu: Miss Kamisato, hello there!

introduced.name: Murakami
introduced.how: a food stall cook who shares a Sakura Mochi recipe and is friends with the Kiminami Restaurant owner
introduced.quote: Murakami: Alright, coming right up!

introduced.name: Yoshikawa
introduced.how: the Prayer Plaque seller who explains how to write or draw a wish and hang it up
introduced.quote: Yoshikawa: Oh, welcome! Looking for Prayer Plaques?

introduced.name: Prayer Plaque
introduced.how: a pentagonal wooden plaque on which a wish is drawn or written and hung on a Prayer Rack, an Inazuman tradition
introduced.quote: This stall sells Prayer Plaques. It's an Inazuman tradition — you draw your wish onto a pentagonal piece of wood called a Prayer Plaque

introduced.name: fortune slips
introduced.how: a cylinder draw that gives a fortune slip whose outcome, such as Great Fortune, has a stated meaning
introduced.quote: Shimizu: Draw a slip and reveal your fortune!

introduced.name: festival masks custom
introduced.how: wearing masks is a traditional, now optional, way to dress up at Inazuman festivals
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: That used to be the custom, yes, and today, it's still a popular way to dress up during festivals. But it's not a hard-and-fast rule.

assumed.name: Kamisato Clan
assumed.quote: This is not coming from the Yashiro Commission or the Kamisato Clan.

assumed.name: Ayato
assumed.quote: Ayato and I took over responsibility for the affairs of the clan.

assumed.name: Guuji Yae
assumed.quote: You must have met Guuji Yae before?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: our friends in Mondstadt wouldn't mind us sharing this dish with Inazuma.

assumed.name: Kurisu's earlier rescue by the Traveler
assumed.quote: Thanks again for your help last time.

assumed.name: Kiminami Restaurant
assumed.quote: Well, it was you who gave Kiminami Restaurant that recipe for an overseas dish, wasn't it?

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Sounds similar to the way people in Liyue release lanterns during Lantern Rite.

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ayaka, what did you draw? Is that Tenshukaku?

assumed.name: Ayaka's brother and his shared duties
assumed.quote: You're too kind. My brother and I simply go where we must fulfill our duties.

assumed.name: Ayaka and her brother taking over the Kamisato family's affairs
assumed.quote: back when Master and Miss Kamisato had just taken over the family's affairs

assumed.name: Ayaka's father's past dealings with Shimizu's uncle
assumed.quote: it was when your father was around, I think he dealt with it personally.

assumed.name: the Traveler's missing sibling
assumed.quote: Sometimes, I feel like I can relate to the determination you must have.. to get your back.

threads.claim: Ayaka has never heard of Tsubaki, a person her mother wrote about often, which raises the mystery of who Tsubaki is.
threads.quote: it is one that I have never heard before

threads.claim: Ayaka suspects Tsubaki is a fox envoy, hinting that unknown supernatural beings may live among ordinary people in Inazuma.
threads.quote: maybe there are fox envoys out there in Inazuma that people just don't know about

threads.claim: Tsubaki turns out to be Ayaka's mother herself, not a fox envoy, as the notebook reveals.
threads.quote: ...is my mother herself.

threads.claim: The notebook shows Tsubaki is not a fox envoy after all.
threads.quote: Not a fox envoy, no.

threads.claim: The notebook's ritual verse may be a code rather than a literal fairytale, leaving its meaning open.
threads.quote: I have a feeling that it could be some sort of code...

threads.claim: Paimon reveals Liyue is full of supernatural beings, suggesting such beings may exist in Inazuma too.
threads.quote: Whoa, so Inazuma also has supernatural beings?

threads.claim: The Kanjou Commission is hostile toward foreign merchants and refuses to help them, hinting at tension between authorities and outsiders.
threads.quote: The Kanjou Commission don't want to give us the time of day

threads.claim: Ayaka envies people who can do as they please and wants to see how people live beyond Inazuma.
threads.quote: I admire those who are able to do as they please.

threads.claim: Ayaka resolves to live each day without regrets rather than pursue the alter ego her mother used.
threads.quote: I think I will set myself a new goal: To live each day without regrets.

threads.claim: Inazuma is under a strict lockdown that has cut off trade and foreign goods.
threads.quote: As you well know, Inazuma is currently under a strict lockdown.

threads.claim: The closed nation has stopped people from trying new foods and goods from abroad.
threads.quote: Since we became a closed nation, people haven't had the chance to try anything new.

threads.claim: Ayaka has few friends because her high standing makes ordinary people hesitant to approach her.
threads.quote: Apparently, Miss Kamisato doesn't have a lot of friends.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon offer Ayaka friendship, showing she has begun to form real bonds.
threads.quote: You've got a friend in me.

threads.claim: The Traveler's journey is driven by the search to find a missing family member.
threads.quote: Traveler: Finding is the whole reason for my journey.

threads.claim: Ayaka encourages the Traveler to keep searching and never give up, reinforcing the quest to find the lost family member.
threads.quote: You will find . Come what may, you must never give up.

threads.claim: Ayaka and her brother are bound by official duties to the Yashiro Commission that shape their public lives.
threads.quote: You're too kind. My brother and I simply go where we must fulfill our duties.

threads.claim: Ayaka has never attended a festival before, suggesting her life has been confined by her clan obligations.
threads.quote: Today was the first time in my life that I've ever been to a festival.

threads.claim: Ayaka presents family bonds as unbreakable and the most important foundation in life.
threads.quote: Family bonds are inseparable — no one can break them... They are the most important roots we have in this world.

threads.claim: Ayaka reveals she brought the Traveler out because she genuinely wanted to spend time with them, not for official business.
threads.quote: I brought you here because... because I genuinely wanted to spend time with you.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Paimon introduces him as the Iudex of Fontaine
introduced.quote: Oh, right! This is Neuvillette, the Iudex of Fontaine. And this is Columbina and Sandrone.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Sandrone's creator, a Fontaine Lord-Artificer whose grave she visits and who she calls family
introduced.quote: Marionette: Yes. Here lies "Lord-Artificer," Alain Guillotin. This is his grave.

introduced.name: Hydro Tulpa
introduced.how: a monster formed from wandering souls, impurities and resentment
introduced.quote: Add a bunch of souls with nowhere to go, a touch of malicious energy, a few impurities, and a whole lot of resentment, and that's what you get.

introduced.name: world-formula
introduced.how: Sandrone's world-formula principle of divergence, which can be reversed for convergence
introduced.quote: The principle behind the world-formula is "divergence." Starting from a point of origin, it deconstructs and reconstructs the possibilities of the world to find certain answers.

introduced.name: Tzitzimitl
introduced.how: Citlali's helper spirits with inauspicious stars sealed inside them
introduced.quote: Citlalin and Itzpapa are Tzitzimitl! They have inauspicious stars sealed within them, and they're my helpers, not toys!

introduced.name: Musketeer Pictures
introduced.how: a film studio whose crew made the movie in the quest
introduced.quote: Veronique is the prop manager for Musketeer Pictures! And Mr. Baptiste is the author of "The Two Musketeers"!

introduced.name: Gateau Debord
introduced.how: a limited daily Fontaine cake considered a must-try
introduced.quote: I'll treat you to some Gateau Debord for the trouble!

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: Alain's invention, which Sandrone says was badly damaged in battle
introduced.quote: Pulonia... received irreparable damage in battle. I should have taken better care of your invention. I'm sorry.

introduced.name: Wingalet
introduced.how: a ship that prison inmates maintain and that has an aquarium
introduced.quote: Do you mind if I leave up some of the installations so the people back at the Fortress can also enjoy the aquarium?

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a prison, as Sandrone's reply makes clear
introduced.quote: Columbina: That's amazing, Sandrone. We should go hang out at the Fortress of Meropide later, then!

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: a Duke who runs the prison and lets inmates work on the ship
introduced.quote: Thanks to Duke Wriothesley and Nurse Sigewinne looking out for us, not too bad actually.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: a film director on the Musketeer Pictures crew
introduced.quote: Columbina: Yes. Director Furina and Miss Chiori think a tragic ending where the two never meet would be more poignant.

introduced.name: Lepine-Pauline
introduced.how: the director leading the Musketeer Pictures crew
introduced.quote: Lepine-Pauline: Alright, Musketeer Pictures. Everyone ready?

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Waah! C—Columbina! You, uh, sure know how to make an entrance... What are you doing here?

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Paimon: Time to meet up with Sandrone! Wonder if Citlali was able to pinpoint the location...

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
assumed.quote: Marionette: The place the souls were severed... Is that the source of the resentment? Or is it the Narzissenkreuz Ordo in general?

assumed.name: Rene and Jakob
assumed.quote: Wandering Souls' Resentment: Curse you... Rene! Jakob!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Marionette: Heh, I wouldn't be so sure. I'll be heading back to the Fatui soon enough. You two are too trusting sometimes...

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Furina: (Hehe, I can't believe I'm casually sipping tea with three Harbingers... or are some of them former Harbingers? Who knows...)

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Marionette: Oh, looks like Arlecchino's here. C'mon, Columbina. Let's go have ourselves a tea party.

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Citlali: (Ugh... If this was the Masters of the Night-Wind, these kids wouldn't have even had the guts to say my name, let alone pester me like this...)

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Columbina: Hehe... This is nice, Sandrone. It reminds me of the happy times back in Snezhnaya. When things were so lively...

assumed.name: Spina di Rosula
assumed.quote: Navia: Hehe! Our effects were pretty over-the-top, right? Some of the extras in the big scenes were actual members of the Spina di Rosula!

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Paimon: You helped everyone out a bunch in Nod-Krai, too! Kinda seems like you're just a good person at heart!

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: I can make you whole again and return you to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo is tied to the souls' suffering and to Sandrone's past, and its messes remain to be cleaned up.
threads.quote: Wandering Souls' Resentment: Wretched... Narzissenkreuz Ordo!

threads.claim: Sandrone plans to return to the Fatui, which raises the question of where her loyalties lie.
threads.quote: Marionette: Heh, I wouldn't be so sure. I'll be heading back to the Fatui soon enough. You two are too trusting sometimes...

threads.claim: Sandrone shows that the wandering souls can be separated from the malice and returned to the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Marionette: All I did was separate the original souls from the rest of the filth, allowing them to be accepted by the current rules of the world.

threads.claim: Reversing the world-formula produces convergence and restoration rather than divergence.
threads.quote: Marionette: So, it would follow that reverse-calculating the world-formula allows us to achieve convergence and restoration instead.

threads.claim: Alain Guillotin is dead, and Sandrone regrets not visiting his grave sooner.
threads.quote: Marionette: I'm sorry... Alain. I'm sorry this is the first time I've been back since leaving Fontaine.

threads.claim: Pulonia, Alain's invention and family to Sandrone, was badly damaged in battle.
threads.quote: Pulonia... received irreparable damage in battle. I should have taken better care of your invention. I'm sorry.

threads.claim: Sandrone owes her existence to Alain, who created her and gave her a life.
threads.quote: Marionette: I never said this to you back then, but... thank you for creating me, for giving me the chance to experience life.

threads.claim: Sandrone had been avoiding Columbina, and the reason is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Columbina: You avoided me. Why?

threads.claim: Sandrone's return brings the reunion with Columbina that the film was built around.
threads.quote: Columbina: You're back? You didn't tell me

threads.claim: Arlecchino is referred to as Father by Lyney and Lynette, hinting at a family bond.
threads.quote: Lyney: You're too kind, Lady Sandrone. I'm sure just your visit alone would make "Father" more than happy.

threads.claim: Wandering souls belong to the Ley Lines, which hints at a hidden world-system behind the souls.
threads.quote: I can make you whole again and return you to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: Citlali's Tzitzimitl carry inauspicious stars sealed inside them, a mystery left unexplained.
threads.quote: Citlalin and Itzpapa are Tzitzimitl! They have inauspicious stars sealed within them, and they're my helpers, not toys!

threads.claim: Sandrone says she has changed and now values reaching out and seeking something new.
threads.quote: Marionette: Me too. I've realized that holding on to what matters doesn't just mean protecting what you already have.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Sandrone's maker and father-like figure, revealed through his memory and letter
introduced.quote: You are my proudest masterpiece. I told you that long ago. But to me, you have never been a creation or a machine.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Introduces himself in a memory of Sandrone's past
introduced.quote: Hello. My name is Alain Guillotin. Can you hear me?

introduced.name: Rene
introduced.how: Narzissenkreuz researcher who devised soul-severing to save Fontaine
introduced.quote: Yes. It's called soul-severing. Rene of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo came up with it.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: Group whose members Rene and Jakob conducted soul research
introduced.quote: Jakob, another member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, sought to carry on Rene's legacy and restore his physical form.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: Narzissenkreuz member who continued Rene's work using severed souls on test subjects
introduced.quote: Jakob, another member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, sought to carry on Rene's legacy and restore his physical form.

introduced.name: Soul-severing
introduced.how: A method that splits souls apart, the first step of Rene's research
introduced.quote: Yes. It's called soul-severing. Rene of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo came up with it.

introduced.name: Fountain of Lucine
introduced.how: Where Fontaine's water and the emotions within it gather
introduced.quote: The Fountain of Lucine is where all the water in Fontaine gathers, so that's where the emotions within the water converge as well.

introduced.name: Pulonia
introduced.how: Clockwork companion built alongside Sandrone by Alain
introduced.quote: It's where both Pulonia and I were brought to life.

introduced.name: Pagoda Stack
introduced.how: Gear-stacking puzzle with the rule that bigger gears cannot sit on smaller ones

introduced.quote: Here, I want you to have this.

introduced.name: Anomaly

introduced.quote: That is the source of what you refer to as the 'anomalies' within you.

introduced.name: Heart
introduced.how: The heart is the soul, the core that makes a person unique
introduced.quote: It's also referred to as someone's soul, or likened to free will.

introduced.name: Fontaine flooding

introduced.quote: Alain, much like Rene, had long predicted that the water levels in Fontaine would rise.

assumed.name: Sandrone

assumed.name: Furina

assumed.name: Charlotte

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Of all my days with the Fatui... The times I spent with you, Arlecchino, and Rosalyne... They were my favorite.

assumed.name: Childe

assumed.name: Capitano

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Oh, Arlecchino gave it to you, didn't she.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Well, look who we have here. Good thing I brought extra desserts.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Even though I haven't reported back to Snezhnaya yet, I'm not planning to leave the Fatui anytime soon.

assumed.quote: Even though I haven't reported back to Snezhnaya yet, I'm not planning to leave the Fatui anytime soon.

assumed.name: Neuvillette

assumed.name: Iudex

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: No wonder I kept running into officers from the Marechaussee Phantom earlier!

assumed.name: Mary-Ann Guillotin

assumed.name: Citlali

assumed.name: Opera Epiclese

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: After the Festival, this ship will be returned to the Fortress of Meropide, and this aquarium will be no more.

assumed.name: Clockwork meka
assumed.quote: Don't put too much trust in clockwork meka.

assumed.quote: After you saved Fontaine by turning Fontainians into true

threads.claim: Alain's formula lets Sandrone face the anomaly inside her core, setting up its resolution.
threads.quote: a formula that will allow you to come face to face with the 'anomaly' inside of you.

threads.claim: Sandrone accepts her emotional side and embraces her anomaly, so the two become one.
threads.quote: Because we've been one all along...

threads.claim: Lost souls in Fontaine's waters are resentful and seem to exist outside fate.
threads.quote: Huh? Resentful lost souls?

threads.claim: The lost souls were split apart by soul-severing, Rene's first research step.
threads.quote: Yes. It's called soul-severing. Rene of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo came up with it.

threads.claim: Fontaine faces an impending doom that Rene tried to prevent through soul research.
threads.quote: After learning of Fontaine's impending doom, Rene thought if he could find a means for the soul to live on in perpetuity, it might ensure the world's salvation.

threads.claim: Alain predicted that Fontaine's water would rise and prepared protections in advance.
threads.quote: Alain, much like Rene, had long predicted that the water levels in Fontaine would rise.

threads.claim: Alain regretted failing to help Rene when he needed it most, hinting at a rift between them.
threads.quote: He said he sometimes regretted not helping his friend when he needed it most.

threads.claim: The Stellar Linchpin may have appeared because of Sandrone's wish, an open question.
threads.quote: Maybe the Stellar Linchpin appeared because of me.

threads.claim: Sandrone's inner self has a wish that she refuses to reveal, leaving it an open question.
threads.quote: Heh, you think that's something you can just ask, and I'll tell you? Think again.

threads.claim: Pulonia has died fighting the Heretic of the False Moon, leaving Sandrone as the last family member.
threads.quote: Even Pulonia is no longer with us.

threads.claim: A person is born twice, first into life and then into a soul they choose for themselves.
threads.quote: I believe a person should be born twice over in their lifetime. First, there's the birth that grants us life, then the birth of the soul.

introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.how: A scholar who ignores the Traveler and leads them into a cave while training to connect to Irminsul
introduced.quote: they ask passing scholar Haypasia for directions, only to find themselves completely ignored.

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: A Trainee Forest Ranger who introduces herself and cares for the Traveler after they collapse
introduced.quote: My name is Collei. I'm a Trainee Forest Ranger.

introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.how: A Forest Watcher and chief officer of the rangers in Gandharva Ville, who is also Collei's master
introduced.quote: Oh, this is my master, Forest Watcher Tighnari. He is chief officer over all the rangers here in Gandharva Ville.

introduced.name: Gandharva Ville
introduced.how: A rainforest settlement built by Sumeru scholars and now the Forest Rangers' base of operations
introduced.quote: This is Gandharva Ville. It was originally built by scholars from Sumeru as a place to rest in the rainforest.

introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.how: Rainforest rangers who patrol roads, maintain facilities and handle dangers such as Withering Zones
introduced.quote: Now it's mainly used by the Forest Rangers as a base of operations.

introduced.name: Spirit Borneol
introduced.how: An incense Sumeru scholars use in meditation, which can strongly affect the mind of some people
introduced.quote: they use a certain incense known as Spirit Borneol to help calm their minds as they enter a state of deep rumination.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: A giant tree deep underground that stores memories and knowledge, and which is now diseased
introduced.quote: Irminsul is a tree located deep beneath the surface.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Roots of Irminsul that carry the world's memories up from a cavern deep underground
introduced.quote: They're like the roots of Irminsul, spreading and extending from a massive cavern deep underground all the way up to the surface.

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: A rainforest anomaly that withers plants and is lethal to wildlife and people, said to originate from the depths of the world
introduced.quote: There's a unique type of anomaly that occurs in the Sumeru rainforest.

introduced.name: Withering Zone
introduced.how: An area afflicted by The Withering that only people with elemental powers can safely enter and clear
introduced.quote: Even with elemental powers, once you step inside the Withering Zone, you may experience extreme discomfort.

introduced.name: Tumor of the Withering
introduced.how: The core of a Withering Zone that must be destroyed, along with its branches, to restore the area
introduced.quote: Once inside, we'll need to look for what we call Tumors of The Withering.

introduced.name: Eleazar
introduced.how: A disease unique to Sumeru that hardens the skin into scales and progressively immobilizes the body
introduced.quote: Yes, it's a disease unique to the lands of Sumeru. It is characterized by dark and hardened scales that form on the body.

introduced.name: Il Dottore
introduced.how: A Fatui Harbinger who once suppressed Collei's Eleazar symptoms, through experiments that traumatized her
introduced.quote: Her symptoms were once successfully suppressed by Dottore, one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers

introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.how: Sumeru's first Dendro Archon, who created the rainforests and the Wall of Samiel and died in a calamity
introduced.quote: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata was Sumeru's first Dendro Archon.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: The current Dendro Archon, found as a newborn after the calamity and brought back to Sumeru
introduced.quote: According to what Master has told me, the sages later found the newly born Dendro Archon and whisked her back to Sumeru.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: The place where the sages let the reinstated Dendro Archon reside
introduced.quote: let her reside in the Sanctuary of Surasthana.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's familiars who told the rangers' ancestors about Irminsul but know no cure for it
introduced.quote: not even the Aranara, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's familiars who informed Tighnari's ancestors of all of this, know how to cure Irminsul

introduced.name: God of Wisdom
introduced.how: The title of the Dendro Archon, whose consciousness is directly connected to Irminsul
introduced.quote: The Dendro Archon is known as the God of Wisdom because her consciousness is directly connected to it.

introduced.name: Nilotpala Lotus
introduced.how: A water plant with large petals that is used to help Eleazar patients recover energy
introduced.quote: We'll be looking for a plant known as the Nilotpala Lotus. It's often used to help those afflicted with Eleazar recover their energy.

introduced.name: Dusk Bird
introduced.how: Haypasia's designated courier bird for urgent news
introduced.quote: This Dusk Bird is Haypasia's designated courier for urgent news.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: A device that gives access to Sumeru's knowledge-granting Akasha System
introduced.quote: a device used to access Sumeru's knowledge-granting Akasha System.

introduced.name: Dunyarzad
introduced.how: A follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali who wants to revive the Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: The two are approached by a follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali's named Dunyarzad.

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: Dunyarzad's bodyguard, who first tries to bring her home and then helps her
introduced.quote: Dehya, Dunyarzad's bodyguard, interrupts them

introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.how: A follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali who will perform the Dance of Sabzeruz
introduced.quote: Nilou, another follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali's who will perform the Dance of Sabzeruz, the centerpiece of the event.

introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.how: An obscure celebration of Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad hopes to revive the Sabzeruz Festival, an obscure celebration of Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday.

introduced.name: Padisarah
introduced.how: A vibrant purple flower that went extinct when the Goddess of Flowers died thousands of years ago
introduced.quote: a vibrant purple flower which went extinct after the Goddess of Flowers died thousands of years ago.

introduced.how: A port where the stolen Akademiya item was taken and where Eremite and Akademiya figures meet
introduced.quote: At Port Ormos, the Traveler and Paimon learn that some extremist Eremite groups

introduced.quote: some extremist Eremite groups, including one known as Ayn Al-Ahmar, are spreading rumors

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: A long-deceased god that extremists believe Greater Lord Rukkhadevata betrayed and will revive
introduced.quote: the long-deceased King Deshret — a god whom they believe Greater Lord Rukkhadevata betrayed to gain control of Sumeru

introduced.name: Alhaitham
