introduced.quote: a man from the Akademiya named Alhaitham

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: A shrewd merchant who refuses to deal with anyone affiliated with the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Dori, a shrewd merchant who refuses to do business with anyone affiliated with the Akademiya due to the nature of her wares.

introduced.name: Mizri
introduced.how: The leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar who obtains the Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: Ayn Al-Ahmar's leader, Mizri, has obtained it

introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: An Akademiya item used to obtain knowledge beyond the Akasha's limitations
introduced.quote: the missing item is a Knowledge Capsule, used to obtain knowledge beyond the Akasha's limitations

introduced.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: A stronger Capsule that Alhaitham wants to study to learn what divine knowledge is
introduced.quote: a Divine Knowledge Capsule, which Alhaitham intends on studying to find out what

introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.how: Akademiya researcher raised as a scholar who meditates to connect with Irminsul
introduced.quote: I was born into a family of scholars in Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: small timid creatures that appear to people, induce dreams, and have ties to the Dendro Archon
introduced.quote: Ah, so that's what they're called... An Aranara.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: source of the Dendro Archon's power and divine knowledge that researchers tap through meditation
introduced.quote: my consciousness was able to form a connection with Irminsul.

introduced.name: Spirit Borneol
introduced.how: incense whose plant ingredients heighten senses to the Dendro Archon's power, letting people connect with Irminsul
introduced.quote: The ingredients used to make Spirit Borneol primarily consist of plants created by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: Akademiya-made device that gives access to the Akasha knowledge within Sumeru's borders
introduced.quote: It's called an Akasha Terminal. It's a tool produced by the Akademiya that utilizes the legacy of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's legacy, a vast store of collected knowledge
introduced.quote: It's our beloved Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's lasting legacy, a treasure trove of collected knowledge.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: Dendro Archon found as a newborn deity by sages five hundred years ago, now residing in the Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.quote: Five hundred years ago, the sages found a newly born deity from within some scorched ruins...

introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.how: late God of Wisdom who founded Sumeru and gifted the Akasha
introduced.quote: In their eyes, she was the one who founded Sumeru and gifted us with the Akasha.

introduced.name: Dunyarzad
introduced.how: self-introduced follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali who was comforted by a voice in childhood
introduced.quote: I am Dunyarzad, one of Lesser Lord Kusanali's faithful followers!

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: Eremite bodyguard hired by Dunyarzad's family, who ends up working for Dunyarzad
introduced.quote: I'm Miss Dunyarzad's bodyguard, here to see that she returns home safe and sound.

introduced.name: Asfand
introduced.how: retired adviser of the Corps of Thirty with weight in mercenary circles
introduced.quote: Asfand, an adviser with the Corps of Thirty, maintains good relations with the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Rohawi
introduced.how: Amurta Darshan researcher adept at gathering information
introduced.quote: He's from the Amurta Darshan and is adept at gathering information.

introduced.name: Sage Naphis
introduced.how: leader of the Amurta Darshan known for a legendary temper
introduced.quote: In the Amurta, our leader is Sage Naphis.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: numerous mercenary groups across Sumeru that gather intelligence through their contracts
introduced.quote: there are numerous active mercenary groups, collectively known as the Eremites.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: oldest Eremite brigade that guards Sumeru City and coordinates the other brigades
introduced.quote: An Eremite brigade called the Corps of Thirty is in charge of Sumeru City's defenses.

introduced.name: Six Great Sages
introduced.how: six top sages, one per Darshan, who lead the Akademiya, with one chosen as Grand Sage
introduced.quote: One Grand Sage is chosen from among the six sages to serve as the head of the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Citadel of Regzar
introduced.how: headquarters of the Corps of Thirty
introduced.quote: you can find him at the Corps of Thirty's headquarters, the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.how: where Lesser Lord Kusanali has stayed since returning to Sumeru
introduced.quote: she's never left the Sanctuary of Surasthana or made a public appearance.

introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.how: holiday celebrating Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday, originally held for Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.quote: It is Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday, which is the day that she was found by the sages.

introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.how: Legend says it began as the Goddess of Flowers' birthday celebration for the Greater Lord
introduced.quote: According to legend, the Sabzeruz Festival was originally the Goddess of Flowers' birthday celebration for the Greater Lord.

introduced.name: Goddess of Flowers
introduced.how: A goddess who danced at a divine banquet and is honored by the festival
introduced.quote: so the Goddess of Flowers began to dance.

introduced.name: Padisarah
introduced.how: Purple flowers that bloomed where the Goddess of Flowers danced and are now extinct
introduced.quote: countless beautiful Padisarahs began to bloom wherever she stepped.

introduced.name: Dance of Sabzeruz
introduced.how: The most important performance at the Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: She'll be dancing the Dance of Sabzeruz, the most important performance at the Sabzeruz Festival.

introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.how: A Sumeru City market where residents love song and dance and festival snacks are sold
introduced.quote: Some festival snacks are only offered here in the Grand Bazaar.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: Sumeru's largest commercial port, reached by following the river south from Sumeru City
introduced.quote: It's the largest commercial port in all of Sumeru.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Desert natives in Port Ormos who are less friendly to outsiders and some of whom are extremists
introduced.quote: the Eremites there aren't nearly as friendly as those here in Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: An Eremite group that sells information and devotes itself to King Deshret
introduced.quote: They're called Ayn Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Djafar Tavern
introduced.how: Where Ayn Al-Ahmar sets up shop to sell information
introduced.quote: I've heard that Ayn Al-Ahmar likes to set up shop at the Djafar Tavern.

introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: A vessel storing a fixed amount of Canned Knowledge, like a miniature Akasha, illegal to possess or trade in Sumeru
introduced.quote: This is a Knowledge Capsule. To put it simply, it's a vessel that can store a fixed quantity of Canned Knowledge.

introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.how: Knowledge stored in capsules, leaked from the Akademiya and traded by Eremites
introduced.quote: Over the past century, a wide variety of Canned Knowledge has been leaked from the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: A system that heavily regulates who can access what information
introduced.quote: Unlike the Akasha, which heavily regulates who can access what information, Knowledge Capsules confer their contents without any requisites.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: The source of knowledge, described as the root of Dendro power
introduced.quote: That's because knowledge originates from Irminsul, the root of Dendro power itself.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: The Akademiya's regulatory body that polices illegal Canned Knowledge trade and is razor-sharp in pursuit
introduced.quote: They belong to the Akademiya's regulatory body.

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: A traveling merchant who sells quality Knowledge Capsules and distrusts Akademiya people
introduced.quote: I need you to find someone named Dori, a traveling merchant.

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: An ability that shows Knowledge Capsule quality, since brighter capsules are more valuable
introduced.quote: Rumor has it that higher-quality Knowledge Capsules generally appear brighter when viewed through Elemental Sight.

introduced.name: Tariq
introduced.how: An Ayn Al-Ahmar member who sells fake information and preaches about King Deshret
introduced.quote: Huh, who are you? What do you want?

introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.how: An Akademiya man who exposes the Eremites' scam and recruits the Traveler to investigate the Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: Not just yet. This man is a fraud.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: Hired mercenaries who are not officially overseen by the Akademiya but share the job of protecting the city
introduced.quote: The Corps of Thirty isn't officially overseen by Akademiya

introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.how: Described by Eremites as a traitor who betrayed King Deshret and destroyed his civilization
introduced.quote: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, yes! That shameless wretch destroyed King Deshret's civilization

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: Described as the rightful God of Wisdom who was betrayed and stripped of his title by a companion
introduced.quote: King Deshret was the rightful God of Wisdom, but he was betrayed by a companion he trusted

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: A deity whose followers celebrate her birthday at the Sabzeruz Festival and whom the Traveler wants to meet
introduced.quote: Nilou will be thrilled to hear that there are more people interested in Lesser Lord Kusanali.

introduced.name: Eymen
introduced.how: Restaurant owner in Port Ormos who is pressured by the Eremites
introduced.quote: Please, I beg you, don't provoke them.

introduced.name: The Caracal Battalion
introduced.how: A rival mercenary group competing with Ayn Al-Ahmar for Mora and deals
introduced.quote: Our main rival now is The Caracal Battalion.

introduced.name: Farris
introduced.how: The Knight of Flowers who hands out candy at the Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: the best part is when Farris, the Knight of Flowers, passes out candy to everyone!

introduced.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: rumored artifact that supposedly grants the wisdom of the gods when used, and is extremely precious
introduced.quote: It's supposedly a Divine Knowledge Capsule — use it, and you'll gain the wisdom of the gods.

introduced.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: Eremite group that believes the Divine Knowledge Capsule holds King Deshret's power and will bring him back, and resorts to foul methods for funds
introduced.quote: They adamantly believe that the Divine Knowledge Capsule contains King Deshret's power, and that he will return to this world when they obtain it.

introduced.name: Mizri
introduced.how: leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar who bought the Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: The Divine Knowledge Capsule was purchased yesterday by a certain Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: a deity who exists outside Sumeru's administration and is hard to find or contact
introduced.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali appears to exist outside of Sumeru's entire administration. Most of the time, you wouldn't know she exists at all.

introduced.name: God of Wisdom
introduced.how: the deity the Traveler and Paimon want to meet, also called the Dendro Archon
introduced.quote: Yeah, just wants to meet the God of Wisdom and ask her about something important.

introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.how: item holding a skill's knowledge that is imprinted into the user's memory when activated

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: worn device that monitors and records a person's physical parameters during combat
introduced.quote: While you fight, we can use an Akasha Terminal to monitor your various physical parameters.

introduced.quote: Well, Wikala Funduq is under the Akademiya's control, so naturally, the Akademiya has people working here.

introduced.name: Port Ormos

assumed.quote: I believe that being able to see them is a sort of blessing from the Dendro Archon.

assumed.name: Withering Zones
assumed.quote: combat the effects of Withering Zones

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Hah! I take it you all know each other already?

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: It was taking you so long that I assumed you got trapped at home

assumed.name: Dunyarzad
assumed.quote: I saw her leaving the other day with a nervous look on her face

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Oh, hey, it's the Traveler and Paimon. What's shakin'?

assumed.name: Asfand
assumed.quote: We met this morning after the Adventurers' Guild pointed us to Asfand for more info.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon's only ever seen her behind the counter at the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: The Akademiya looks down on performers like us.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Thank the Dendro Archon for Dunyarzad!

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: When people mention the gods, they always think of the Archon War

assumed.name: Grand Sage
assumed.quote: The Grand Sage recently ordered Sumeru City to begin bolstering its defenses

assumed.name: Rukh Shah
assumed.quote: So where's Rukh Shah?

assumed.name: Zubayr
assumed.quote: Mr. Zubayr was worried sick!

assumed.name: Homayani family
assumed.quote: I've got plenty of work to do here for the Homayani family.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Let's head to Wikala Funduq and meet up with Alhaitham.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Our dealings with Dori went smoothly enough.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: As you know, the Eremites in Port Ormos also have their eyes on it.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: Oh yeah, you mean how some researchers go insane after getting knowledge from Irminsul?

assumed.name: Haypasia
assumed.quote: Traveler: Speaking of which, Haypasia did mention...

assumed.name: Sabzeruz Festival
assumed.quote: Aah, it's almost the day of the Sabzeruz Festival!

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Let's return to Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Satyavada Life
assumed.quote: I've heard of numerous incidents of researchers in Satyavada Life going insane.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: This is Mora for when you ask Dori for information.

assumed.name: Matra
assumed.quote: Relax, no one here is interested in anything we say, and the matra won't come here.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Huh!? What in Teyvat just happened?

threads.claim: A feminine voice in the Traveler's vision says 'World... Forget me...', a phrase left unexplained.
threads.quote: ...World... Forget me...

threads.claim: Mizri also mutters the same words while being taken into custody, linking the phrase to other people.
threads.quote: As he is being led away, Mizri mutters

threads.claim: Tighnari reveals the vision was a real memory in Irminsul, only partly explaining the phrase's meaning.
threads.quote: When you passed out, your consciousness had connected directly with Irminsul. What you witnessed were actually real memories contained within Irminsul itself.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the red sky in the vision may be connected to Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: Could it have been Khaenri'ah?

threads.claim: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata vanished in a calamity centuries ago, a story that resembles other past disasters.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, she disappeared in a great calamity that occurred a few hundred years ago.

threads.claim: Who the Dendro Archon statue depicts, and what Lesser Lord Kusanali is like, remains unclear.
threads.quote: Maybe Lesser Lord Kusanali?

threads.claim: The new Archon's lack of presence has gone unquestioned by Sumeru's people.
threads.quote: so the new Archon's lack of presence has gone unquestioned by the people of Sumeru.

threads.claim: Irminsul is diseased, and no one knows how to cure it.
threads.quote: Huh? You mean Irminsul is sick?

threads.claim: Withering Zones are appearing more often and leave lasting damage to the rainforest ecosystem.
threads.quote: Recently, the rate at which Withering Zones appear has been increasing.

threads.claim: Eleazar has no true cure, so Collei's treatment only controls the disease.
threads.quote: However, there is, unfortunately, still no true cure for Eleazar.

threads.claim: Collei's Eleazar grows more serious as Withering Zones increase in frequency.
threads.quote: as the appearances of Withering Zones have started to increase, Collei's case of Eleazar has also become more serious.

threads.claim: Collei's time with the Fatui left her traumatized and afraid of being touched.
threads.quote: the agonizing experiments she was subjected to traumatized her and made her touch-averse.

threads.claim: Tighnari appears to have concealed the truth about the Traveler's vision.
threads.quote: He probably wasn't telling us the truth.

threads.claim: Tighnari admits the visions were real and that he tested the Traveler before revealing the truth.
threads.quote: That's correct, those weren't hallucinations at all, though I don't intend to apologize for deceiving you...

threads.claim: Sumeru adults cannot dream, which the Sages attribute to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's protection, while the Aranara can control dreams.
threads.quote: which the Sages claim is Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's way of protecting her people from the irrationality and disorderliness of dreams.

threads.claim: Connecting consciousness to Irminsul is hard, and many researchers have lost their minds doing it.
threads.quote: Given that connecting to Irminsul is the purpose of Haypasia's training

threads.claim: Alhaitham compares Mizri's madness to researchers driven insane by Irminsul, implying the Capsule is no real source of power.
threads.quote: Alhaitham compares Mizri's state to that of researchers who have gone insane after connecting to Irminsul

threads.claim: Mizri obtains the Divine Knowledge Capsule and goes berserk after using it.
threads.quote: Mizri goes berserk after using the Divine Knowledge Capsule

threads.claim: Extremist Eremites spread rumors that the long-dead King Deshret will return.
threads.quote: spreading rumors that the long-deceased King Deshret

threads.claim: The stolen Knowledge Capsule promises knowledge beyond the Akasha, and its true purpose is still unknown.
threads.quote: the missing item is a Knowledge Capsule, used to obtain knowledge beyond the Akasha's limitations

threads.claim: Irminsul holds divine knowledge that can destroy a researcher's mind if touched without preparation.
threads.quote: Sages have said that Irminsul contains divine knowledge, and touching such knowledge without the proper preparations and abilities will only lead to one's mind caving in on itself.

threads.claim: Sumeru's leaders believe a cure for Irminsul is needed and that the Traveler's help is pivotal to finding it.
threads.quote: As Sage Khajeh clearly stated, your presence and guidance in Sumeru City is pivotal in finding a cure for Irminsul.

threads.claim: A memory seen through Irminsul includes the cryptic phrase "world... forget me," whose meaning is unknown.
threads.quote: Hmm... "world... forget me..." What could that possibly mean?

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for a sibling, and an enemy claims that bond has been lost.
threads.quote: The bonds of love and family which drive you to find your sibling are utterly gone!

threads.claim: The Abyss Herald taunts the Traveler by claiming a higher power has abandoned them.
threads.quote: Highness has long since forsaken you.

threads.claim: The Traveler has a dream-like episode that they cannot fully remember, with an unexplained cause.
threads.quote: It feels like I was just dreaming for a moment there, but I can't remember what I saw...

threads.claim: Aranara have the curious power to make people dream.
threads.quote: they're clearly an envoy of the God of Wisdom herself, and they have the curious power to make people dream.

threads.claim: Aranara pull people into dreams only to buy themselves time to run away from them.
threads.quote: They only do so to give themselves a chance to run away.

threads.claim: Adults in Sumeru never dream, which is considered a blessing from the God of Wisdom.
threads.quote: Only children can dream in Sumeru. Adults, however, never do.

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali has stayed hidden in her sanctuary and makes no public appearances, leaving her location unclear.
threads.quote: ever since Lesser Lord Kusanali returned to Sumeru, she's never left the Sanctuary of Surasthana or made a public appearance.

threads.claim: Dunyarzad believes the childhood voice that comforted her was Lesser Lord Kusanali, though this is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: That voice sparked a desire for wisdom — it had to have been the Dendro Archon.

threads.claim: The Akasha does not answer every query and tailors knowledge to each person's identity and experience, so outlanders may be denied answers.
threads.quote: The Akasha doesn't unconditionally respond to every query.

threads.claim: The Akademiya treats Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's death as settled and resists celebrating Lesser Lord Kusanali's birth.
threads.quote: Maybe they see Lesser Lord Kusanali's birth as confirmation of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's death, so they're reluctant to celebrate it.

threads.claim: The Sabzeruz Festival has lost public interest and funding because of Akademiya influence.
threads.quote: But because of the Akademiya's influence, people have gradually lost interest in the festival.

threads.claim: A legend says the Dendro Archon's avatars are present in all of nature and in those who keep thinking and seeking.
threads.quote: Along your journey, we were in every flower and blade of grass, every ray of sparkling sun, and every breath of dancing wind.

threads.claim: Tighnari seeks to understand how The Withering relates to Collei's disease.
threads.quote: I'll find a way to understand the relationship between The Withering and her disease.

threads.claim: Collei has a worsening condition that she has hidden from Amber and from the Traveler.
threads.quote: I should have told you both about my condition when we first met.

threads.claim: Tariq claims King Deshret is not truly dead and that an Oracle has prophesied his resurrection.
threads.quote: King Deshret isn't truly dead. The voice of the Oracle has been heard in the desert, prophesying his resurrection!

threads.claim: Asfand dismisses the rumors of King Deshret's return as ridiculous, while Eremites keep spreading them.
threads.quote: King Deshret's been dead for thousands of years.

threads.claim: Eremites claim Greater Lord Rukkhadevata betrayed King Deshret and conspired with the Akademiya to hide the truth.
threads.quote: she conspired with the Akademiya to cover up the truth of her actions

threads.claim: Forbidden Canned Knowledge has been leaking from the Akademiya and is being traded by Eremites in Port Ormos.
threads.quote: Over the past century, a wide variety of Canned Knowledge has been leaked from the Akademiya.

threads.claim: A convoy carrying an important Akademiya package from Aaru Village was robbed, and the item is now thought to be in Port Ormos.
threads.quote: The Akademiya recently sent a convoy to pick up an important package from Aaru Village.

threads.claim: The Traveler learns the stolen item is a Knowledge Capsule and that it is tied to the Akademiya's loss.
threads.quote: Seems like it's a Knowledge Capsule?

threads.claim: Some people resent the destiny the Akasha assigns them and seek to change their fate through forbidden knowledge.
threads.quote: there will always be those in this world who are dissatisfied with life as designed for them by the Akasha, and wish to change their fate.

threads.claim: Dehya says Dunyarzad knows the Traveler is seeking a way to meet Lesser Lord Kusanali, and the meeting remains unresolved.
threads.quote: My lady knows you're looking for ways to meet Lesser Lord Kusanali

threads.claim: Dunyarzad has run away from her family and would have been dragged back home without the Traveler's help.
threads.quote: If wasn't for you two, she probably would've been caught and dragged back much earlier.

threads.claim: A wealthy benefactor has spent large amounts of Mora to revive the Sabzeruz Festival, hinting that Dunyarzad is this benefactor.
threads.quote: a wealthy benefactor stepped in this year and brought the festival back to life

threads.claim: Several Eremite mercenary groups in Port Ormos are close to open conflict with each other.
threads.quote: Several Eremite mercenary groups are nearly in open conflict

threads.claim: Knowledge comes from Irminsul and is measured by Dendro energy, which the Traveler can perceive with Elemental Sight.
threads.quote: That's because knowledge originates from Irminsul, the root of Dendro power itself.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's authority does not reach Port Ormos, which makes the port a haven for illegal knowledge trade.
threads.quote: The Akademiya's grip isn't long enough to reach all the way to Port Ormos

threads.claim: Alhaitham is curious about what the Divine Knowledge Capsule truly is, which leaves its nature an open question.
threads.quote: I am investigating because I'm curious as to what the Divine Knowledge Capsule truly is.

threads.claim: The capsule is linked to the gods, but Alhaitham says it grants no divine wisdom or power despite the rumors.
threads.quote: This Divine Knowledge Capsule does appear to be linked to the gods, but beyond that, it doesn't seem anything like the rumors suggest.

threads.claim: Ayn Al-Ahmar believes King Deshret will return to the world if they obtain the Divine Knowledge Capsule.
threads.quote: They adamantly believe that the Divine Knowledge Capsule contains King Deshret's power, and that he will return to this world when they obtain it.

threads.claim: The Traveler recognizes Mizri's breakdown as something heard before at Irminsul, hinting at a connection.
threads.quote: Traveler: (That's exactly what I heard before at Irminsul...)

threads.claim: Mizri's dying words repeat a message ('World' and 'Forget me') that echoes what the Traveler heard at Irminsul.
threads.quote: Mizri: ...Forget me...

threads.claim: Researchers in Satyavada Life have gone insane after gaining knowledge, and Mizri's state suggests a similar cause.
threads.quote: I've heard of numerous incidents of researchers in Satyavada Life going insane.

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali exists outside Sumeru's administration and remains a mystery that is hard to reach.
threads.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali appears to exist outside of Sumeru's entire administration. Most of the time, you wouldn't know she exists at all.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon seek a meeting with the God of Wisdom, which has not yet been achieved.
threads.quote: Yeah, just wants to meet the God of Wisdom and ask her about something important.

threads.claim: The Akasha is the Akademiya's symbol of the deity's wisdom, and scholars have little reason to contact the deity directly.
threads.quote: Moreover, since the Akademiya possesses the Akasha, a symbol of our deity's wisdom, scholars have no reason to desire to make contact with the deity herself anyway...

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Self-introduces as the Hydro Archon of Fontaine, Focalors, the God of Justice
introduced.quote: Look, I am the Hydro Archon of Fontaine, Focalors. The God of Justice, who is loved and adored by many...

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Introduced as the Chief Justice who has a situation to discuss and wants the full story heard first
introduced.quote: Neuvillette tells them that he has a situation on his hands, but wants the Traveler to get the full story first before deciding whether or not they wish to help him in the matter.

introduced.name: The Knave
introduced.how: A Snezhnayan Harbinger born in Fontaine who wants a diplomatic meeting and requests Childe's custody
introduced.quote: The Snezhnayan Harbinger known as The Knave wants a diplomatic meeting with you, correct?

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: A convicted Snezhnayan Harbinger held at the Fortress, who has now vanished from the prison
introduced.quote: According to reports from the Fortress of Meropide, Childe recently disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: An underwater prison outside court jurisdiction, once an autonomous gathering place for exiles
introduced.quote: The Fortress of Meropide may seem like a prison, but it should in fact be regarded as a gathering place for exiles.

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: The administrator of the Fortress, honored with the title Duke, the highest-ranking manager there
introduced.quote: Correct. He is the highest ranking manager of the underwater prison.

introduced.name: Credit Coupons
introduced.how: The prison's currency, used inside the Fortress
introduced.quote: Inside the fortress, the Traveler and Paimon are escorted by Deakin, who explains about life in the prison, mostly the Credit Coupons which serve as the prison's currency.

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: The Knave's child who entered prison via a theft performance and pretends not to know the Traveler
introduced.quote: During the tour, they run into Lyney, though he pretends not to know them.

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: The Knave's other child, falsely accused and sent to prison alongside Lyney
introduced.quote: I'm not referring to when my children Lyney and Lynette were falsely accused by you, please don't misunderstand.

introduced.name: Sigewinne
introduced.how: Head nurse of the prison infirmary
introduced.quote: Finally, they head to the infirmary and meet head nurse Sigewinne, concluding the tour.

introduced.name: Vidoc
introduced.how: A prison inmate who warns newcomers about the hidden rules
introduced.quote: Vidoc heads to them, telling them not to break any "hidden rules" and that they should speak to him when they get more coupons.

introduced.name: Madeleine
introduced.how: A guard who processes and escorts the new convicts down into the Fortress
introduced.quote: I'm here, Monsieur Neuvillette. These two are the newest convicts, I presume?

introduced.name: Marette
introduced.how: Prison staff who registers new inmates, reads charges and takes mugshots
introduced.quote: Let me confirm your charges and sentence. Let's see, you two are charged with...

introduced.name: Deakin
introduced.how: A guard who escorts new inmates and explains prison life
introduced.quote: Inside the fortress, the Traveler and Paimon are escorted by Deakin, who explains about life in the prison, mostly the Credit Coupons which serve as the prison's currency.

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: A journalist who wants an exclusive article about the Fortress's warden
introduced.quote: If I could write an exclusive article about him, I bet it would sell a boatload of papers!

introduced.name: Fatui Harbingers
introduced.how: Snezhnayan diplomats who serve as colleagues and attorneys for one another
introduced.quote: As we are both diplomats from Snezhnaya as well as Fatui Harbingers, Childe and I have always been colleagues...

introduced.name: Prison hidden rules
introduced.how: Unwritten prison rules, such as mystery meat for working three days straight and no betting on two fighters
introduced.quote: During their investigation, they learn two of the "rules"; working for three days straight would result in being served mystery meat and that it was not allowed to bet on two fighters in a match.

introduced.name: Isadora
introduced.how: A messenger from the Palais Mermonia who summons the Traveler to Neuvillette
introduced.quote: It's an honor to meet you both. I was sent from the Palais Mermonia.

introduced.name: Early Fontaine exile punishment
introduced.how: Early Fontaine punished criminals with exile rather than imprisonment, and exile still applies today
introduced.quote: Early in Fontaine's history, criminals were punished with exile, not imprisonment.

introduced.name: Credit Coupons
introduced.how: Credit Coupons are the only currency in the Fortress and replace Mora there
introduced.quote: Deakin: Mora means nothing here. Here, we use Credit Coupons.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: an underwater prison on the seafloor of Fontaine where criminals serve sentences and also run a machine factory
introduced.quote: Wriothesley: Therefore, the Fortress of Meropide is not only a place where criminals serve their sentences, but also a giant machine factory.

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: the Duke and administrator, the warden of the Fortress of Meropide
introduced.quote: Paimon: So this is the Duke... He sure looks a lot younger than Paimon imagined!

introduced.name: Deakin
introduced.how: an inmate who welcomes newcomers for extra coupons and greets the Duke nervously
introduced.quote: Deakin: Oh, I'm actually an inmate like you two. Welcoming newcomers is a job I've picked up to earn some extra coupons.

introduced.name: Sigewinne
introduced.how: the head nurse of the Fortress infirmary
introduced.quote: Sigewinne: Hello, new faces! They call me the head nurse, but I actually handle all the nurse-related work all by myself down here!

introduced.name: Wolsey
introduced.how: the chef who runs the Coupon Cafeteria and its meal lottery
introduced.quote: Wolsey: Haha, but that's not how it was! Back in the day, it'd cost you Reward Coupons just to get a cup of water here.

introduced.name: Fitzroy
introduced.how: a nervous guard or staff member who reports to the Duke
introduced.quote: Fitzroy: Ah, Y—Your Grace! Good morning... I mean, good afternoon! ...No wait, what time is it again?

introduced.name: Fielding
introduced.how: a guard who assigns the new inmates their bunks
introduced.quote: Fielding: Your bunks are right over there. Follow me.

introduced.name: Grainville
introduced.how: the production zone supervisor who gives instructions on widget processing
introduced.quote: Grainville: Ah, you must be the catch of the day. Looks like you've got some luck, getting assigned this space...

introduced.name: Vidoc
introduced.how: an old inmate who sells hidden-rules information from the Rag and Bone Shop
introduced.quote: Vidoc: I'm usually around the Rag and Bone Shop. Just call me Vidoc. Bye bye now.

introduced.name: Pankration Ring
introduced.how: a dedicated fighting venue where inmates can fight for extra coupons
introduced.quote: Wriothesley: This place is known as the "Pankration Ring."

introduced.name: Coupon Cafeteria
introduced.how: where inmates claim one free welfare meal each day
introduced.quote: Wriothesley: Now, we've arrived at a very important place: the Coupon Cafeteria. You can come here and claim one welfare meal each day.

introduced.name: production zone
introduced.how: the workshop area where inmates work shifts producing clockwork machines
introduced.quote: Wriothesley: In the Fortress of Meropide, criminals usually spend most of their time in either the production zone or the sleeping areas.

introduced.name: widgets
introduced.how: parts processed by machines in the production zone and exchanged for coupons
introduced.quote: Grainville: Your job is to use the machine over there to process widgets.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: the House that Lyney, Lynette and Freminet belong to, which works for The Knave
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, right! Lyney and Lynette are from the House of the Hearth! They work for The Knave, so they could be here to investigate, too!

introduced.name: The Knave
introduced.how: the leader called Father by the House of the Hearth, who sent Lyney and Lynette to investigate
introduced.quote: Lyney: We were instructed by the "Father" of our House, The Knave, to come here and conduct an investigation.

introduced.name: forbidden zone
introduced.how: a restricted area inside the Fortress that guards confirmed exists
introduced.quote: Lyney: Most people just clammed up and wouldn't talk, but after asking the right questions, we were able to confirm the existence of the forbidden zone from the guards.

introduced.name: hidden rules
introduced.how: unwritten prisoner rules that breaking can lead to something worse than death
introduced.quote: Vidoc: But what they don't tell you is that the rules aren't exactly what they pretend to be — the rules for being a prisoner.

introduced.name: Rowan
introduced.how: coworker who has worked the production zone for almost 15 years and warns about hidden rules
introduced.quote: Haha, that's right. The name's Rowan. These past few days I couldn't help but notice the new faces working nearby, I guess we were destined to meet.

introduced.name: Grainville
introduced.how: foreman who assigns the widget-processing job and expects coupons in return
introduced.quote: Your job is to use the machine over there to process these widgets.

introduced.name: Collins
introduced.how: runs the Pankration Ring game and explains that strong competitors are barred from official fights
introduced.quote: Sorry, mate, but competitors as strong as you are prohibited from participating.

introduced.name: Pankration Ring
introduced.how: venue where a paid target game earns coupons and matches can be bet on
introduced.quote: The game costs 300 Credit Coupons to have a go. So, you up for it?

introduced.name: Roussimoff
introduced.how: sells tickets for Pankration matches, with no refunds
introduced.quote: Hmm? Are you two here to buy tickets? Better be quick about it, another match is about to start!

introduced.name: Le Grappleur
introduced.how: reigning Pankration champion and crowd favorite
introduced.quote: Even though Le Grappleur is the crowd favorite, Demon Horde is a first-class dark horse with incredible potential...

introduced.name: Credit Coupons
introduced.how: prison currency earned by working and spent on games, meals and skipping work
introduced.quote: Coupons aren't a resource in particularly short supply.

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: coupon-giving inmate who says she has been here longer than the Traveler
introduced.quote: Oh wonderful! I was worried that you'd be busy trying to earn Reward Coupons all the time, but it seems like you haven't neglected your investigation work after all.

introduced.name: hidden rules
introduced.how: secret prison rules whose breaking brings bad things
introduced.quote: Truth is, you two keep workin' like this, you might be puttin' yourselves in danger.

introduced.name: three-day rule
introduced.how: working three days straight with nothing but work and sleep brings something bad at lunch on day three
introduced.quote: If you work continuously in the production zone for three days, and if all you do besides eating and sleeping is just work...

introduced.name: Fonta Co.
introduced.how: drink company that sponsors the Pankration tournaments and wants to sell products in the Fortress
introduced.quote: Oh, so it's the company that manufactures Fonta sponsoring the events?

introduced.name: Duke
introduced.how: head of the Fortress who rejected the promoter's Fonta proposal
introduced.quote: Ugh, I'm so upset... It's all because of that Duke.

introduced.name: overworld and underworld
introduced.how: the Fortress is in the underworld, and the Traveler is from the overworld
introduced.quote: The former is because you are from the overworld, that's understandable and I don't blame you for that.

introduced.name: Fonta promoter
introduced.how: Fonta Co. promoter stuck at the Fortress after his proposal was refused
introduced.quote: I'm a promoter for Fonta Co., and I'm usually responsible for promoting our drink products.

introduced.name: masked boxer
introduced.how: legendary masked fighter who refused to unmask and vanished, tied to the ticket rule
introduced.quote: However, in the final match, the organizers told him to take off his mask.

introduced.name: vanished worker
introduced.how: a hard-working worker who disappeared after three days of nonstop work
introduced.quote: He disappeared into thin air, as if he'd evaporated.

introduced.name: strange meat
introduced.how: bizarre welfare meat served at lunch on the third day
introduced.quote: Is this stuff... meat? But it looks and feels so bizarre... What kind of chef would make food like this?

introduced.name: strange blood-colored fluid
introduced.how: bottle of liquid that looks like blood, delivered in a mysterious package
introduced.quote: And the liquid in the bottle obviously looks like blood...

introduced.name: cannibal group
introduced.how: rumored group that meets at night and preserves human remains in the Fortress
introduced.quote: Every month, they meet a few times in the dead of night.

introduced.name: drainage pipes
introduced.how: Fortress pipes that make strange sounds and are cleaned on scheduled days
introduced.quote: They just conduct regular cleaning of the Fortress' drainage facilities.

introduced.name: pipe-cleaning days
introduced.how: three scheduled days a month when night work in the pipes happens
introduced.quote: There are three pipe-cleaning days per month...

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: a different species that sees the world differently from humans
introduced.quote: See, we Melusines are a different species, and we see the world very differently from humans.

introduced.name: Sigewinne
introduced.how: Melusine who is supposed to be the infirmary nurse
introduced.quote: Sigewinne? Aren't you supposed to be in the infirmary? What are you doing in the production zone?

introduced.name: Wolsey
introduced.how: in charge of the free meal numbers who brushes off the meat concern
introduced.quote: Hmm, what is it? I'm about to go report the numbers for today's free meal, so you'd better make it quick.

introduced.name: Fielding
introduced.how: guard who delivers the mysterious package
introduced.quote: Hey, Traveler, Paimon! Package here for ya.

introduced.name: Vidoc
introduced.how: convict who hints at cannibal rumors and hidden secrets
introduced.quote: Oho, seeing you at this time must mean you've already saved up a lot of Credit Coupons.

introduced.name: Childe's crew
introduced.how: Childe's followers in the Fortress who spread the cannibal rumor to cover his escape
introduced.quote: And as his crew, if the boss wants something, then it's our job to get it done.

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia said something about having a place ready for us there, didn't she?

assumed.name: Silver
assumed.quote: Even without Silver standing guard, we can just completely relax!

assumed.name: Serial disappearances case
assumed.quote: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, no one's going to come after us for anything.

assumed.name: Fruity Trio
assumed.quote: gives them a Fruity Trio cake sitting on his desk as thanks.

assumed.name: Hydro Gnosis
assumed.quote: "Father" was able to confirm that Furina did not have the Hydro Gnosis

assumed.name: Gardemeks
assumed.quote: the three are greeted by a large number of Gardemeks and Wriothesley himself

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: who threw themselves in prison with a small "theft" performance to do so along with Freminet.

assumed.name: Iudex
assumed.quote: there's no need to introduce the nation's revered Iudex to me.

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, you know about our connection with Neuvillette?

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Paimon: Bingo! The Knave has been applying a lot of pressure. She wants to know what happened to Childe, so we came here to investigate...

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lyney! Mr. Magician! Where are you? This had better not be some disappearing act!

assumed.name: Lynette
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Lynette! You're here too! You two really are inseparable.

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: Lyney: Uh, it's not just Lynette, Freminet is also here. Do you still remember him?

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Traveler: Have you seen a Harbinger from Snezhnaya?

assumed.name: Gnosis
assumed.quote: Paimon: So it's all about the Gnosis again.

assumed.name: Focalors
assumed.quote: Lyney: "Father" has somehow managed to confirm that Focalors does not have Fontaine's Gnosis.

assumed.name: Gardemeks
assumed.quote: ???: When I heard that you were friends of Monsieur Neuvillette, I had the Gardemeks come and wait in formation.

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Traveler: I dreamed of Childe...

assumed.name: Childe's Vision
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah.... Childe's Vision! So you had it with you this whole time...

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: Paimon: When you said you knew a diver, you were talking about Freminet, right?

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Traveler: And how's Lyney holding up?

threads.claim: Childe vanished from the Fortress under mysterious circumstances with no sighting outside, suggesting something else is behind it.
threads.quote: I suspect that there's something else behind Childe's disappearance.

threads.claim: Childe's past hints show he heard a voice again and left through the pipes, which the Traveler's visions connect to his escape.
threads.quote: One day, he told them he had to leave as he heard that "voice" again, escaping through the pipes, though he had not returned for some time.

threads.claim: The Traveler's vision reveals that Childe used the pipes to escape, answering how he left.
threads.quote: where the Traveler gets a vision of Childe and realizes that he used the pipes to escape.

threads.claim: The prison has hidden rules and a forbidden zone that Lyney says hide a secret.
threads.quote: reveals that the prison hides a secret and that "Father" was able to confirm that Furina did not have the Hydro Gnosis, though they are unaware how she did so.

threads.claim: The hidden rules turn out to be a farce created by the inmates to protect Childe.
threads.quote: admit that the "hidden rules" were a farce to protect Childe.

threads.claim: Furina does not possess the Hydro Gnosis, but how the Knave's side confirmed this is unknown.
threads.quote: "Father" was able to confirm that Furina did not have the Hydro Gnosis, though they are unaware how she did so.

threads.claim: Furina acts strangely whenever The Knave comes up, suggesting she is hiding something.
threads.quote: I also noticed that Lady Furina acts a little odd and unnatural whenever I bring up matters related to The Knave...

threads.claim: The Knave's request for Childe's custody and her insistence on a meeting hint at a deeper motive behind her visit.
threads.quote: So now, in my capacity as his attorney, I request that Childe be turned over to Snezhnaya.

threads.claim: Wriothesley rarely leaves the Fortress but is aware of everything happening inside and outside it.
threads.quote: He is "quiet," but not "unaware," so please bear that in mind.

threads.claim: The Fortress operates outside Fontaine's courts and its administrator has autonomy that limits what the Chief Justice can do.
threads.quote: The Fortress of Meropide has always been completely autonomous. Even we have no authority to interfere there, and diplomatic issues do not suffice as an excuse.

threads.claim: Lyney pretends not to know the Traveler inside the prison, hinting at a hidden purpose for his imprisonment.
threads.quote: During the tour, they run into Lyney, though he pretends not to know them.

threads.claim: The Fortress of Meropide hides a secret that some say the whole fortress exists to protect.
threads.quote: Lyney: As for what we're investigating... Perhaps you haven't heard, but the Fortress of Meropide hides a secret.

threads.claim: The Fortress contains a forbidden zone that the guards have confirmed exists.
threads.quote: Lyney: Most people just clammed up and wouldn't talk, but after asking the right questions, we were able to confirm the existence of the forbidden zone from the guards.

threads.claim: Childe's disappearance may be connected to the forbidden zone or the hidden rules of the Fortress.
threads.quote: Paimon: A forbidden zone...? Could that be where Childe disappeared to? You're right, we'll definitely keep that in mind.

threads.claim: Visions of Childe inside the Fortress appear at the end of the unit, hinting he was there.
threads.quote: (A Hydro Vision appears and visions of Childe in the Fortress of Meropide can be seen)

threads.claim: The Fortress has hidden prisoner rules that can lead to a fate worse than death if broken.
threads.quote: Vidoc: The truth is, this place has a lot of "hidden rules"...

threads.claim: The House of the Hearth believes Fontaine's Gnosis may be inside the Fortress and tied to its secret.
threads.quote: Lyney: It was this information that led us to suspect that Fontaine's Gnosis might be in the Fortress of Meropide, and is related to that "secret."

threads.claim: The Fortress is supposedly independent of Fontaine's court system, yet its warden has ties to Neuvillette.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm? But isn't the Fortress of Meropide independent from Fontaine's court system? What do you two have to discuss?

threads.claim: The Duke may already know the Travelers' true purpose in coming to the Fortress.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Is it possible that he knows we're here on a mission? Or is Paimon overthinking things?

threads.claim: The House of the Hearth has long investigated the Fortress, and its informants vanished recently.
threads.quote: Lyney: The House of the Hearth has been investigating this for a very long time, trying to uncover its mysteries...

threads.claim: The Fortress offers inmates a rebirth and claims coupons can change fate itself, raising questions about fate and fairness.
threads.quote: Deakin: Coupons can get you almost anything in the Fortress of Meropide. Desires? Fulfilled. You want power? No problem. Coupons can even change fate itself.

threads.claim: Childe went missing and the Traveler starts searching for where he went.
threads.quote: So what did you see in the dream? Do you know where Childe went?

threads.claim: The Traveler dreams of being Childe, which may be linked to Childe's Vision.
threads.quote: Maybe the Vision connected Childe's consciousness to yours?

threads.claim: The Traveler keeps having dreams of Childe that reveal his experiences.
threads.quote: I saw Childe in my dream again.

threads.claim: Childe's crew says the pipe he entered is believed to be a dead end that is now flooded.
threads.quote: Because as far as we know, the pipe he went into isn't actually an exit... It should be a dead end.

threads.claim: The Traveler's dream reveals that Childe escaped through the pipes.
threads.quote: Childe escaped via the pipes.

threads.claim: Pipe-cleaning days are linked to nighttime activity that the Fortress keeps hidden.
threads.quote: There are three pipe-cleaning days per month...

threads.claim: The Fortress has hidden rules that bring disaster when broken, and the Traveler starts investigating them.
threads.quote: Truth is, you two keep workin' like this, you might be puttin' yourselves in danger.

threads.claim: Vidoc hints that the truth behind the dark secrets may be dangerous to know.
threads.quote: Hehe, you two look pretty skeptical. No matter, learning the truth behind dark secrets isn't necessarily a good thing.

threads.claim: After three days of nonstop work, lunch brings strange meat, but the expected danger is not yet clear.
threads.quote: Haven't we been working nonstop for three days now? And now it's lunchtime!

threads.claim: Vidoc says cannibals may be connected to the people who disappeared in the Fortress.
threads.quote: Every month, they meet a few times in the dead of night.

threads.claim: The cannibal rumor was invented by Childe's crew to give him a better chance to escape.
threads.quote: We just wanted to give him a better chance of escaping on a night after the pipes had been cleaned.

threads.claim: The welfare meals contain strange meat, which hints at something sinister in the Fortress.
threads.quote: Is this stuff... meat? But it looks and feels so bizarre... What kind of chef would make food like this?

threads.claim: Vidoc claims the cannibals transform leftover remains and keep them in the Fortress.
threads.quote: Since they have no way to dispose of the leftover remains, they have ways to transform them into other forms and keep them in the Fortress forever.

threads.claim: A bottle of blood-colored liquid arrives after the rumor of a missing boxer.
threads.quote: And the liquid in the bottle obviously looks like blood...

threads.claim: Sigewinne is never in the infirmary right before lunch, and nobody knows where she goes.
threads.quote: Yeah, the rumors say that there's never anybody in the infirmary in the half hour before lunch, and nobody knows where Sigewinne gets off to.

threads.claim: The masked boxer's identity is unknown and he may have been taken away by the organizers.
threads.quote: No, he was always wearing a mask, like he was intentionally trying to hide his identity.

threads.claim: A past worker vanished after working nonstop, and his friends deny ever knowing him.
threads.quote: Later, some people went and asked some of his past friends about him, but they said...

threads.claim: Fonta Co. sponsors the Pankration tournaments to promote its products in the Fortress.
threads.quote: They reached out to us first, hoping to promote Fonta products in the Fortress of Meropide.

threads.claim: The Duke rules the Fortress absolutely and rejects outside proposals that might cause trouble for him.
threads.quote: I'm on his turf, after all. His house, his rules.

threads.claim: The Fortress is in the underworld, which sets it apart from the overworld the Traveler comes from.
threads.quote: The former is because you are from the overworld, that's understandable and I don't blame you for that.

threads.claim: The upper exit of the pipe is sealed off and the lower route is flooded, so only a skilled diver could follow Childe.
threads.quote: The way up from here has been sealed off. It's impossible to get through.

threads.claim: Childe's crew agreed to cover for him and wait for his return on pipe-cleaning nights.
threads.quote: So we told him that we'd pretend as if he never existed while he was gone.

introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.how: a dancer and theater representative who wants to save Zubayr Theater
introduced.quote: Nilou: Mr. Zubayr, our manager, always says that celebrations aren't just for fun

introduced.name: Sheikh Zubayr
introduced.how: the theater's manager, who is responsible for its operations and documentation
introduced.quote: Mr. Zubayr, our manager, always says that celebrations aren't just for fun

introduced.name: Zubayr Theater
introduced.how: a Grand Bazaar theater that performs for the people and hosts celebrations
introduced.quote: Nilou: After Inayah ran away from home, I brought her here, to Zubayr Theater.

introduced.name: Sharif
introduced.how: an Akademiya official who threatens to demolish the theater within thirty days
introduced.quote: Since Zubayr Theater has long violated the Akademiya's policies and orders, we have decided to demolish it.

introduced.name: Inayah
introduced.how: Sharif's daughter who ran away from home and now lives and works at the theater
introduced.quote: After Inayah ran away from home, I brought her here, to Zubayr Theater.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: a scholarly institution that disapproves of the theater's shows and seeks its demolition
introduced.quote: The Akademiya has never liked us, and they've never respected our work.

introduced.name: Farhad
introduced.how: a professional porter who helps carry the goods
introduced.quote: I'm a porter by trade, so this is what I'm best at.

introduced.name: Rekhar
introduced.how: a prop engineer and housekeeper at the theater, and a former adventurer
introduced.quote: My name is Rekhar. Najia and I are this theater's prop engineers.

introduced.name: Khasani
introduced.how: a long-time theater resident who watches performances and questions the nature of art
introduced.quote: I've been staying here for a long time.

introduced.name: Safwan
introduced.how: an Akademiya official who serves as the debate's adjudicator
introduced.quote: Two days later, the debate begins with Safwan of the Akademiya serving as the debate's adjudicator and taking an oath of impartiality.

introduced.name: Tahchin
introduced.how: a baked cake-like dish of rice and meat with special spices
introduced.quote: Tahchin is a mixture of rice and meat that's baked into a cake-like shape.

introduced.name: Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: a creature that eats and gnaws on goods, sometimes out of habit rather than hunger
introduced.quote: Sumpter Beasts sometimes eat not because they're hungry, but because they like gnawing on things.

introduced.name: Debate as conflict resolution
introduced.how: the Akademiya favors settling disputes through formal debate
introduced.quote: Differences can be settled through a debate.

introduced.name: Miniature Zubayr Theater
introduced.how: a mini-replica of the theater crafted by the troupe as a keepsake
introduced.quote: She also gives the Traveler a mini-replica of the theater that the troupe crafted themselves

introduced.name: Safwan
introduced.how: Introduces himself as an Akademiya scholar serving as the debate's adjudicator
introduced.quote: Safwan: Hello and welcome, everyone. I am Safwan, a scholar from the Akademiya, and I will serve as this debate's adjudicator.

introduced.name: Sharif
introduced.how: Akademiya debater who argues the theater's shows lack enlightening value and must be defeated in the debate
introduced.quote: Sharif: Since you so desperately demand an explanation, I will expound on the Akademiya's stance.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: Scholarly body that ordered the theater shut and claims to guide Sumeru's residents toward wisdom and enlightening art
introduced.quote: Sharif: However, the truth is that the Akademiya wishes for every resident of Sumeru to be afforded opportunities to grow and cultivate their wisdom.

introduced.name: Zubayr Theater
introduced.how: A theater that is the home and community of its performers, staff and supporters, not merely a venue
introduced.quote: Nilou: Zubayr Theater isn't simply a performance venue to us — it means more than that. It's been our home for a long time.

introduced.name: Sheikh Zubayr
introduced.how: The theater's manager, who has run it for years while following all permits and procedures
introduced.quote: Sheikh Zubayr: I have meticulously managed this theater's affairs for years, and I have abided by every procedure and obtained every permit.

introduced.name: Khasani
introduced.how: A former art connoisseur who gave up fame and now lives at the theater after finding its meaning of art
introduced.quote: Khasani: I once stood in the spotlight, but I relinquished fame and acclaim for the freedom I enjoy today.

introduced.name: Rekhar
introduced.how: A former adventurer and widow who now lives at the theater with her children
introduced.quote: Rekhar: I can't do things like that anymore, but those were some of the best times of my life.

introduced.name: Sohrin
introduced.how: Rekhar's son who just passed his theater exam and will soon join the troupe
introduced.quote: Rekhar: Look at us now: Sohrin and Abhi are happy, and Sohrin has also just passed his theater exam. He can start acting soon.

introduced.name: Inayah
introduced.how: A shy dancer who fled her demanding father's household and found shelter at the theater
introduced.quote: Inayah: My father is an extremely demanding man.

introduced.name: Nilou's teacher
introduced.how: A retired dancer who taught Nilou and held that dance is a creation of human hands rather than a divine gift
introduced.quote: Nilou: My teacher. She was an excellent dancer, but she's retired now.

introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.how: A district whose people support the theater and can rally to help in the debate
introduced.quote: Jut: There are always more solutions than problems. If you need help during the debate, just shout and the entire Grand Bazaar will be at your beck and call.

introduced.name: Miniature Zubayr Theater
introduced.how: A model of the theater made by the troupe as a parting gift for the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Nilou: So we made you a little something. Hope you'll like it!

introduced.name: Inayah's third-place exam and rejected gift
introduced.how: Inayah earned third place, gave her father an embroidered gift, and he angrily flung it aside, sparking a family fight
introduced.quote: Inayah: For one exam, I earned the third-highest score.

introduced.name: Demolition order
introduced.how: The Akademiya ordered the theater shut within thirty days with demolition to follow
introduced.quote: Nilou: Yes. He told us that we have to shut down the theater within thirty days, and that it's going to be demolished...

introduced.name: Public debate with the Akademiya
introduced.how: A debate between Nilou and Sharif that decides whether the theater can be saved, which the troupe is told is nearly impossible
introduced.quote: Sheikh Zubayr: Trying to best the Akademiya in a debate is attempting the impossible.

assumed.name: Dunyarzad
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Speaking of, since we last met her in her dream...)

assumed.name: Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies
assumed.quote: (If the player has not completed Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies)

assumed.name: Nahida (Lesser Lord Kusanali)
assumed.quote: Traveler: I can ask Nahida to lend a hand.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Nilou: Plus, if the Dendro Archon were to intervene... Then, it wouldn't feel like our victory was earned.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Safwan: I ask for both parties to stand. May the Dendro Archon also serve as a witness to this duel of wits.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...But where should we start? Sumeru is huge!

assumed.name: Adventurer
assumed.quote: Rekhar: Have faith in the resilience of an adventurer. We can always figure something out.

threads.claim: The Akademiya threatens to demolish Zubayr Theater within thirty days, starting a conflict.
threads.quote: Since Zubayr Theater has long violated the Akademiya's policies and orders, we have decided to demolish it.

threads.claim: The debate ends inconclusively, with the adjudicator judging Sharif's claims unsupported and his threat rash.
threads.quote: Safwan declares the victor inconclusive, since Sharif failed to provide any information to support his claims

threads.claim: Sharif is suspended at his own suggestion after his debate loss, so the demolition threat is set aside for now.
threads.quote: They then spot Sharif himself, who explains that he is currently suspended at his own suggestion, as his loss at the debate hurt the Akademiya's image.

threads.claim: Sharif behaves mysteriously, and his remark that it is a relief hints at hidden feelings.
threads.quote: Sharif mysteriously states that it's a relief before walking away.

threads.claim: Sharif's curiosity about the theater is piqued, though his true intentions remain unclear.
threads.quote: While he does not understand the theater's intentions, his curiosity was piqued.

threads.claim: Inayah ran away from her family, and her relationship with her father Sharif is strained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Father? They're family!?

threads.claim: Inayah confronts her father and accuses him of being unable to understand relationships.
threads.quote: Inayah: Does your audacity know no limits, Father!?

threads.claim: Sharif gives Inayah a framed embroidery he made, hinting at a slow reconciliation.
threads.quote: Sharif gifts Inayah a framed piece of amateur embroidery he'd made, demonstrating that he'd not forgotten about her gift.

threads.claim: Khasani asks whether art is created or a naturally existing resource, a question left open.
threads.quote: Is art a product that we create and bring forth, or is it a naturally existing resource?

threads.claim: Khasani says art is already all around us, including the theater, Nilou, and humanity itself.
threads.quote: Art is already all around us.

threads.claim: The theater is presented as a place of belonging where everyone has found a new life.
threads.quote: To counter his statement, Nilou explains that the theater is a place of belonging, since everyone has found a new life there.

threads.claim: Dunyarzad is recovering and cannot attend, and Nilou hopes she will celebrate with them later.
threads.quote: Nilou: She'll be better soon, and then we can celebrate together at the theater!

threads.claim: Taking and giving freebies is a norm in the bazaar, where people repay each other by helping out.
threads.quote: This has become our norm, and no one keeps track of the back and forth anymore.

threads.claim: Inayah's strained relationship with her demanding father is set up as an unresolved conflict.
threads.quote: Inayah: My father is an extremely demanding man.

threads.claim: Inayah reveals she has given up on ever being understood by her father, deepening the rift.
threads.quote: Inayah: I've completely given up. We're destined to never understand each other.

threads.claim: Inayah and her father finally agree to a heart-to-heart after he offers her the embroidery she once gave him.
threads.quote: Inayah: Let's have a heart-to-heart, Father

threads.claim: Sharif may have acted out of mercy rather than cruelty, which the Traveler suspects but cannot confirm.
threads.quote: Traveler: I think he intentionally gave us a chance.

threads.claim: Sharif admits he cannot forget Inayah's perseverance and that she has hit a weak spot of his.
threads.quote: Sharif: I still cannot forget that young lady's perseverance. Inayah would almost certainly mature in the presence of such a person.

threads.claim: Sharif's debate loss led to unrest within the Akademiya and his temporary suspension from duty.
threads.quote: Sharif: My loss at the debate caused quite the loss of face for the Akademiya, so there was a period of unrest.

threads.claim: Khasani asks what art truly means, a question the unit keeps returning to.
threads.quote: Khasani: What do you think is the meaning of art?

threads.claim: Khasani concludes that art's meaning comes from its audience, not its creators.
threads.quote: Khasani: The meaning of art comes not from its creators, but from its audience.

threads.claim: The Traveler questions whether the theater exists only for art and performance, hinting at a deeper purpose.
threads.quote: Traveler: Is it only for art and performance?

threads.claim: Nilou answers that the theater is a bond that connects its members and the people it touches.
threads.quote: Nilou: Zubayr Theater is our reason for coming together. It connects us all in unique ways.

threads.claim: Sheikh Zubayr hints that Nilou is becoming like a former figure, raising questions about her past teacher.
threads.quote: Sheikh Zubayr: You're becoming more and more like her...

threads.claim: Nilou's teacher taught that dance is born from human toil rather than a gift from the gods.
threads.quote: Nilou: Yeah. She said, "Dance is an art born from toil. It isn't a gift from the gods, but a creation by our own hands."

threads.claim: The Akademiya's order to shut and demolish Zubayr Theater creates a threat to the theater's future.
threads.quote: Nilou: Yes. He told us that we have to shut down the theater within thirty days, and that it's going to be demolished...

threads.claim: After the debate Sharif leaves and the theater is left free of immediate trouble from the Akademiya.
threads.quote: Sheikh Zubayr: Terrific work, Nilou and Inayah. They likely won't cause any more trouble for us.

threads.claim: Rekhar's husband has died and her adventuring life ended, a past hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: Rekhar: I can choose to believe that my life ended with my husband's death, or I can choose to believe that it was a blessing in disguise for Sohrin and Abhi.

threads.claim: Rekhar argues that good and bad are human-made concepts that depend on how one chooses to see things.
threads.quote: Rekhar: "Good" and "bad" are all human-made concepts. It all depends on how we choose to see things.

threads.claim: Nilou passes on Rekhar's teaching that the most important thing about an experience is how one interprets it.
threads.quote: Nilou: She told me that the most important thing about an experience is how you choose to interpret it.

introduced.name: Lohen
introduced.how: Vice Captain of the 5th Company of the Knights of Favonius, a member of the expedition
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company of the Knights of Favonius and a member of the expeditionary force.

introduced.name: Varka
introduced.how: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius who led the Nod-Krai expedition and planned a succession
introduced.quote: If I don't make it back from this expedition, you'll have to assume the mantle of Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Andrius
introduced.how: an ancient wolf god, the Wolf King, whose soul split and whose remnants survive
introduced.quote: The Wolf King, Andrius, was particularly adept in this art — otherwise, no remnants of his soul would have survived till the present day.

introduced.name: Wolf of the North
introduced.how: the surviving spirit of an ancient god, the Wolf of the North
introduced.quote: the Wolf of the North is the surviving spirit of an ancient god.

introduced.name: Knight of Boreas
introduced.how: a title passed through the Knights of Favonius as intermediary between the Wolf and humans
introduced.quote: And the Knight of Boreas serves as an intermediary between him and humanity.

introduced.name: Wandering Knight
introduced.how: the first Knight of Boreas, who arrived in Mondstadt a thousand years ago with a wolf
introduced.quote: The first wandering knight to claim the title arrived in Mondstadt a thousand years ago, along with his wolf companion.

introduced.name: Ravenwood
introduced.how: an informal disciple of the first Knight of Boreas who earned the Wolf Spirit's recognition
introduced.quote: But he had an informal disciple — a knight named Ravenwood, who admired the Knight of Boreas greatly.

introduced.name: Roland
introduced.how: Rostam's disciple, once the White Knight, now the Bloodstained Knight who vanished
introduced.quote: He was the perfect knight. Righteous, principled... His name was Roland, the "Bloodstained Knight."

introduced.name: Rostam
introduced.how: the Wolf Pup, a Knight of Boreas-recognized warrior and Roland's mentor
introduced.quote: Of those who have, the best known are the first Knight of Boreas, Ravenwood, the "Wolf Pup" Rostam, and... hmph... Varka himself.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: an ancient kingdom where Roland went after severing his connection to Boreas
introduced.quote: It was the ancient kingdom of "Khaenri'ah," as you call it.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: channels through which Boreas poured his power to become the North Wind of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Boreas chose to pour his power into the Ley Lines... with that, he became the North Wind of Mondstadt

introduced.name: Wolf Spirit
introduced.how: a token of a wolf god's power and thoughts, housed in steel claws or weapons
introduced.quote: It is a Wolf Spirit. It contains my power and thoughts.

introduced.name: Abyssal calamity
introduced.how: a calamity 500 years ago in which Roland lost his comrades and mentor
introduced.quote: But he lost countless comrades during the Abyssal calamity five hundred years ago... including his tutor and mentor, Rostam.

introduced.name: Boreas lineage near-extinction
introduced.how: the Knight of Boreas lineage nearly died out twice in Mondstadt's history
introduced.quote: The lineage of the Knights of Boreas has nearly been extinguished twice in Mondstadt's history.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: the knightly order in Mondstadt where the Boreas title was passed down
introduced.quote: From then on, the title of Knight of Boreas was passed down from generation to generation within the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: an automaton guarding the Thousand Winds Temple that fires missiles
introduced.quote: In fact, all that awaited him were moss-covered walls and an angry Ruin Guard.

introduced.name: Andrius
introduced.how: A god who slumbered by Amsvartnir and was seized by the Abyss as the Wild Hunt's new leader
introduced.quote: The replica corrupted and took control of Andrius as he slumbered by the bank of Amsvartnir, ultimately manifesting as the giant beast that you all witnessed.

introduced.name: Roland
introduced.how: The Bloodstained Knight whose mirror image now leads the Wild Hunt as an Abyssal replica
introduced.quote: That new leader is a mirror image of Roland, the Bloodstained Knight.

introduced.name: Rostam
introduced.how: A Knight of Boreas who died in the Abyssal calamity, leaving Roland to wander Teyvat
introduced.quote: After Rostam lost his life in the Abyssal calamity, Roland left Mondstadt to wander Teyvat.

introduced.name: Vedrfolnir
introduced.how: The Visionary, who gave Roland a revelation underground that led him to surrender to the Abyss
introduced.quote: So that's what happened. After leaving Mondstadt and wandering the land, Roland ventured underground and saw a revelation from The Visionary.

introduced.name: Wolf Spirit fragment
introduced.how: Remnants of Boreas's soul left scattered along his journey, which can strengthen the decision to merge with the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: However, since his form was unstable during his journey with the first Knight of Boreas, many Wolf Spirit fragments were left behind along the way...

introduced.name: Ferrous Shadow
introduced.how: A token from Boreas that glows and calls forth his memories when offered to Varka
introduced.quote: (The Traveler offers Varka the Ferrous Shadow, which begins to glow with blue light)

introduced.name: Abyssal Pylon
introduced.how: A hidden source in the mist that lets the Wild Hunt summon reinforcements, which must be destroyed
introduced.quote: That's their source — it was hidden in the mist! If we destroy that, the Wild Hunt won't be able to summon any more reinforcements!

introduced.name: Logistics Company
introduced.how: A squad of logistics troops with explosives that Varka can command to set ambushes
introduced.quote: A logistics squad carrying a large cache of explosives.Varka can command them to set ambushes, using the terrain to strike enemy units that have strayed from their group.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Channels through which memories flow and which the Abyss used to fashion a new Wild Hunt leader
introduced.quote: the Abyss harnessed the memories that flow throughout the Ley Lines to fashion a new one, fit for the present circumstances.

introduced.name: Compensation mechanisms
introduced.how: The body's way of offsetting lost function, used as an analogy for the Wild Hunt's replacement leader
introduced.quote: Are you familiar with compensation mechanisms?

introduced.name: Dead god danger
introduced.how: A dead god releases catastrophic power and wrath that can persist for thousands of years, so Andrius cannot be killed now
introduced.quote: We can't kill him right now, because a dead god may prove more dangerous than a living one.

introduced.name: Unsent letter from Rostam
introduced.how: An old letter meant for Roland that Varka hopes can anchor Roland's thoughts
introduced.quote: But trying to track Roland down was like chasing a shadow. He never did find him. And so, this letter has been sitting at the Knights of Favonius headquarters ever since.

introduced.name: Boreas's final thoughts
introduced.how: Boreas gave his power to the Ley Lines to protect Mondstadt, which is why it was spared his god remains
introduced.quote: That was Boreas's final thoughts before merging with the Ley Lines. It's the reason Mondstadt remains unharmed by his god remains.

introduced.name: Storing souls in objects
introduced.how: Boreas can store his soul inside objects, which can be transferred into a sword
introduced.quote: I once got Boreas to explain to me how he stores his soul inside objects. All I need to do is transfer it to my sword.

introduced.name: Andrius
introduced.how: God of the North Wind whose heart Varka reaches, dominated by the Abyss
introduced.quote: This is the heart of Andrius — God of the North Wind.

introduced.name: Wolf Spirit
introduced.how: soul sealed in the sword was a decoy; the true memories were carried in Varka's heart
introduced.quote: The Wolf Spirit within the sword was merely a decoy... the true thoughts and memories were carried within your heart.

introduced.name: Barbeloth's scryglass
introduced.how: a scrying tool that reflects glimpses of the future
introduced.quote: I glimpsed a reflection of the future in Barbeloth's scryglass.

introduced.name: Abyssal calamity in the North
introduced.how: a future catastrophe in the north that may now have been averted
introduced.quote: You saw an Abyssal calamity in the North, right?

introduced.name: Nod-Krai stronghold
introduced.how: a northern knights' stronghold that stays staffed on rotation
introduced.quote: A few knights will remain on rotation at the Nod-Krai stronghold, but everyone else will be sent home in waves.

introduced.name: Roland
introduced.how: the Roland met here is only an imperfect image cast by the Abyss, not the real Roland
introduced.quote: the Roland you see is but an imperfect image cast by the Abyss.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: a destination a soul returns to, here Boreas's soul heading for the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Return to... the Ley Lines...

introduced.name: Longing blessings
introduced.how: blessings from a sword grant elemental energy and sustain the wielder
introduced.quote: The blade brings the blessing of the gentle wind, filling you with life and elemental energy...

introduced.name: soul-vessel method
introduced.how: a god's soul can be stored in a mortal heart instead of a sword
introduced.quote: There are other ways to store a soul.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: So I'm guessing the Wild Hunt is a thing of the past now that you've defeated the Rächer of Solnari?

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: The Rächer of Solnari and The Doctor... Truly a tale for the ages!

assumed.name: The Doctor
assumed.quote: We were kinda focused on dealing with The Doctor, though.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: And after such a grand adventure in Nod-Krai, you must have gathered quite a few stories along the way, yes?

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: The "Tumaini" of Natlan?
