assumed.name: Eroch
assumed.quote: regarding your late father and the incident with Eroch.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: But compared to Rerir, our current foe clearly has a better understanding of how to exploit Nod-Krai to his advantage

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: You experienced the turmoil caused by Dvalin, the East Wind's actions for yourself.

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: The Wild Hunt is no longer under the Rächer of Solnari's control, but it has been reborn from the ashes and is now launching widespread attacks.

assumed.name: Rerir
assumed.quote: No disturbances have been detected in the space where Rerir resides.

assumed.name: Lightkeepers
assumed.quote: Flins: And since the Wild Hunt is involved, the Lightkeepers will provide their full support.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: Lastly, our friend from the Curatorium of Secrets will provide intel and relay battlefield communications.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: She went to see Lauma and Columbina at the Frostmoon Scions.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: These Knights of Favonius are paying me a pretty nice sum to deliver a few simple messages...

assumed.name: Stormterror's Lair tower collapse
assumed.quote: (Like when the tower fell in Stormterror's Lair...)

assumed.name: Sal Terrae salt event
assumed.quote: (Or when the humans turned to salt beneath Sal Terrae...)

assumed.name: Night Kingdom
assumed.quote: Eh, this Wolf Spirit fragment is like a puddle compared to the Night Kingdom — no need for a boat.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah's fate
assumed.quote: Once he had learned of Khaenri'ah's fate, he saw the gods' judgment as the greatest injustice...

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: In Natlan, the passing of the Pyro Archon's flame is a common occurrence throughout history

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: That eye... Dainsleif? No... It bore a striking resemblance, but that wasn't him.

assumed.name: Grand Master Arundolyn
assumed.quote: Grand Master Arundolyn had wanted to deliver this letter to him...

assumed.name: Roland
assumed.quote: ...! Roland!

assumed.name: Boreas
assumed.quote: Lupus Boreas, if you still harbor love for humanity, then you must surely know...

assumed.name: Ravenwood
assumed.quote: Ravenwood: The title of Boreas... must find an heir.

assumed.name: Rostam
assumed.quote: ...You must deliver it...

assumed.name: Wandering Knight
assumed.quote: This is not where your path ends. You must continue on.

assumed.name: Ferrous Shadow
assumed.quote: Is this... the Ferrous Shadow? It doesn't look like an imitation...

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: the Wild Hunt won't be able to consolidate their forces for the foreseeable future.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Initially, I was planning to have Barbatos carry out that step.

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: You may already have learned of this from Barbatos or the Hexenzirkel

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Albedo and Durin will come back with the first wave

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: (Venti talks to the Traveler as they ride on Dvalin's back with the letters)

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius will always welcome you

assumed.name: Arundolyn
assumed.quote: Rostam and Arundolyn... They never forgot you.

threads.claim: Andrius split his soul, leaving one remnant in Nod-Krai while the other became Boreas in Mondstadt.
threads.quote: I am but one remnant of the god, Andrius's soul.

threads.claim: Andrius has not found peace, which left his remnant open to exploitation by the Abyss.
threads.quote: I fear Andrius has not found peace in his heart even to this day.

threads.claim: Roland's fate after he went to Khaenri'ah is unknown.
threads.quote: Beyond that, I know not if he lived or died.

threads.claim: No one knows where Roland ended up after leaving the Knights of Favonius.
threads.quote: To this day... no one knows his final whereabouts.

threads.claim: The blood-reeking scent Boreas sensed is confirmed to come from Roland.
threads.quote: The Traveler asks if this scent was from Roland, which Boreas confirms.

threads.claim: The connection between the blood scent, Khaenri'ah and the Abyss is an open question.
threads.quote: And what is its connection to Khaenri'ah and the Abyss?

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the enemy is a god corrupted by the Abyss or a legendary knight.
threads.quote: whether he's a god corrupted by the Abyss, or a legendary knight

threads.claim: Without the Rächer of Solnari leading them, the Wild Hunt remnants act only on a primal urge to destroy.
threads.quote: Without the Rächer of Solnari to direct them, it seems like all that's left is their primal urge to destroy.

threads.claim: The Knight of Boreas lineage nearly died out twice, the second time five hundred years ago.
threads.quote: The lineage of the Knights of Boreas has nearly been extinguished twice in Mondstadt's history.

threads.claim: Varka's contingency plan has Jean become Grand Master and train the next Knight of Boreas if he never returns.
threads.quote: This is all just a contingency plan in the event that I'm unable to return.

threads.claim: Boreas developed the technique of imbuing weapons with his soul to protect his human companions.
threads.quote: That's why Lupus Boreas developed the technique of imbuing weapons with his soul.

threads.claim: The Abyss sought a replacement for Rerir and chose Roland, who corrupted Andrius' remains.
threads.quote: when Rerir was removed, the Abyss sought to find a replacement, doing so in the form of Roland, who then corrupted Andrius' remains.

threads.claim: Wolf Spirit fragments left along Boreas's journey hold the power needed to strengthen the decision to merge with the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: However, since his form was unstable during his journey with the first Knight of Boreas, many Wolf Spirit fragments were left behind along the way...

threads.claim: Varka absorbs the final Wolf Spirit fragment, but Roland's replica is waiting to challenge him.
threads.quote: (Varka brings out his claymore and absorbs the final Wolf Spirit fragment)

threads.claim: The reason the Abyss chose Roland to mimic, and how it managed to do so, is still unknown.
threads.quote: exactly why the Abyss chose Roland to mimic — and indeed, how it was able to do so — remains unclear.

threads.claim: Roland surrendered himself to the Abyss after a revelation from the Visionary showed him Khaenri'ah's fate and the gods' judgment.
threads.quote: So that's what happened. After leaving Mondstadt and wandering the land, Roland ventured underground and saw a revelation from The Visionary.

threads.claim: The Visionary is thought unlikely to intervene directly, leaving open what role it plays in the conflict.
threads.quote: The Visionary is unlikely to intervene directly.

threads.claim: Gods' remains persist for thousands of years and endanger the land after death.
threads.quote: We can't kill him right now, because a dead god may prove more dangerous than a living one.

threads.claim: Ineffa notes that some gods die naturally with no ill effects, which complicates the danger of god remains.
threads.quote: there also appear to be cases of gods dying naturally with no ill effects.

threads.claim: Boreas merged his soul with the Ley Lines to protect Mondstadt, and his final thoughts explain why it was spared.
threads.quote: That was Boreas's final thoughts before merging with the Ley Lines. It's the reason Mondstadt remains unharmed by his god remains.

threads.claim: Varka has a plan he has not fully revealed to his allies, which Flins suspects.
threads.quote: Maybe I'm overthinking this, but I suspect there is more to Mr. Varka's plan than what he's revealed to us so far.

threads.claim: Varka says he glimpsed fate's reflection and foresaw an Abyssal calamity in the North.
threads.quote: As a matter of fact, I did — I caught a glimpse of fate's reflection.

threads.claim: Roland shatters Varka's sword and says the Wolf Spirit's thoughts have nowhere left to dwell.
threads.quote: It's over. Your sword lies shattered. The Wolf Spirit and the thoughts you blindly placed your faith in have nowhere left to dwell

threads.claim: Rostam's unsent letter is used as an anchor to draw out Roland's memories from the Wolf Spirit.
threads.quote: Varka: Well... Maybe you could try this?

threads.claim: The Traveler grasps the Abyssal energy and begins separating Roland's part from the Wolf Spirit, revealing his memories.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...Got him!

threads.claim: Varka stored Boreas's soul in his own heart, merging it with his body rather than the sword.
threads.quote: Here's my answer: You get the wolf to swallow the heart.

threads.claim: Boreas's soul is returning to the Ley Lines, and a soul merged with another can be pulled back out.
threads.quote: Boreas... is returning to the Ley Lines? But why?

threads.claim: The Roland Varka fought is only an image cast by the Abyss, not the real Roland.
threads.quote: the Roland you see is but an imperfect image cast by the Abyss.

threads.claim: Andrius is being dominated by the Abyss and might be freed from it.
threads.quote: How long will you allow yourself to suffer the domination of the Abyss?

threads.claim: A future Abyssal calamity in the north may have been changed by the Traveler's actions.
threads.quote: I believe we may have changed the course of the future — thanks in no small part to you.

threads.claim: Roland argues that fate ordains injustice and mortals cannot resist it.
threads.quote: before the great injustice of fate, a mere mortal can but bow their head.

threads.claim: Varka answers Roland's doubt about mortal legacy by saying new fires rise from dying ones.
threads.quote: From the embers of a dying flame, a new fire arises, burning bigger and brighter than ever before!

threads.claim: The Ferrous Shadow blade appears genuine and is tied to Roland's shadow.
threads.quote: Is this... the Ferrous Shadow? It doesn't look like an imitation...

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt cannot regroup now that Roland's shadow has been defeated.
threads.quote: the Wild Hunt won't be able to consolidate their forces for the foreseeable future.

threads.claim: Rostam's letter to Roland is delivered and the fallen knights are remembered.
threads.quote: Rostam and Arundolyn... They never forgot you.

introduced.name: Ashvapati
introduced.how: a former Akademiya weapons researcher who confesses to designing weapons and then hiding from the authorities
introduced.quote: Ashvapati: My lifelong goal has always been to become a foremost expert on all kinds of weapons so I can invent even more advanced ones!

introduced.name: Ati, Neb, and Raya
introduced.how: children Ashvapati has raised since the oasis attack, who are waiting for him
introduced.quote: Ashvapati: I've been raising them ever since, while attempting to hunt down the men who made them orphans in the first place.

introduced.name: Khaemwaset
introduced.how: an Eremite leader who takes in strays and runs a desert oasis group
introduced.quote: Khaemwaset: No, son. Just still trying to figure out why I've got such a soft spot for strays like you... Here, give me your canteen.

introduced.name: Sennedjem
introduced.how: an Eremite who sells weapons to desert bands for Mora and later poses as a Fontainian philanthropist
introduced.quote: Sennedjem: Me and my men can get you what you need. In return, all you gotta do is bring this sketch to life.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: a scholarly group whose researchers are skilled with gadgets and weapons, and who are sent into exile
introduced.quote: Ashvapati: It all started with a Kshahrewar researcher, expelled from the Akademiya for violating a taboo.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an institution with strict rules that expels researchers who break them
introduced.quote: Sennedjem: The rules and red tape that got you kicked out of the Akademiya... They don't exist in the desert.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: desert bands that live at oases and protect their water sources from sandstorms and rival groups
introduced.quote: Khaemwaset: Our group is lucky. Our ancestors learned how to protect the oasis from the sandstorms to prevent it from drying up.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a place with a long, formal legal process for judging whether a person is guilty
introduced.quote: Navia: In Fontaine, we have a long and complicated process in place just to make sure we get the right answer to that question.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: the currency Eremite bands pay to buy weapons
introduced.quote: Sennedjem: It's a win-win. You provide the goods, and I earn enough Mora from these people to fund the research of your dreams!

introduced.name: Ruin Drake
introduced.how: ancient mechanical beasts scattered across Sumeru whose technology no one has analyzed or reproduced
introduced.quote: Ashvapati: I often found myself flipping through my collection of blueprints and sketches. The Ruin Drakes scattered around Sumeru were of particular interest to me.

introduced.name: Guizhong Ballista
introduced.how: a ballista whose display model matches a stolen prototype and which can fire at range
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: It's the display model that goes with the prototype... Guess that does make him our thief.

introduced.name: Oasis sandstorm
introduced.how: a giant sandstorm hit the oasis and led Sennedjem to flee the group
introduced.quote: Eremite Guard: You hated this place! After that giant sandstorm, when everyone else was trying to figure out how to help, you got out of dodge the first chance you could get!

introduced.name: Oasis attack by Ruin Drakes
introduced.how: Ruin Drakes burned the Eremite camp after Sennedjem sold the weapons to the tribe's enemies
introduced.quote: Sennedjem: It was the perfect excuse to drive up the price, that's why.

assumed.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
assumed.quote: Ashvapati: To the officers of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol and the Liyue Qixing. You certainly live up to your reputation.

assumed.name: Liyue Qixing
assumed.quote: Ashvapati: To the officers of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol and the Liyue Qixing. You certainly live up to your reputation.

assumed.name: Spina
assumed.quote: Navia: So, I chose a few promising young Spina members to help out.

assumed.name: Criminal gang and its cover
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: Remember when I said this group's cover was ironclad? They were always careful never to leave a trail leading back to them...

assumed.name: Maison Gardiennage
assumed.quote: Sennedjem: The Maison Gardiennage...

threads.claim: Ashvapati lured the officers to Nod-Krai on purpose and is driven by revenge against the men who orphaned the children.
threads.quote: Yelan: He's after the same target as us... and he's out for revenge.

threads.claim: Sennedjem has a history of betraying his allies, and the oasis attack was not the first time.
threads.quote: Ashvapati: It was only later that I found out, this wasn't the first time Sennedjem and his men had turned around and stabbed their allies in the back.

threads.claim: The technology inside Ruin Drakes has never been analyzed or reproduced, which hints at a hidden secret.
threads.quote: Ashvapati: As far as I knew, no one had been able to analyze or reproduce the technology within those mechanisms.

threads.claim: Yelan argues that peace came from weapons and that people, not weapons, are responsible for evil.
threads.quote: Yelan: The peace we enjoy today isn't because we chose to make toys instead of weapons.

threads.claim: The officers promise the children a fair trial, and the outcome will shape how they understand justice.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: Regardless, it's a promise we have to keep. After all, when the children get their answer, it will shape their understanding of what justice means.

threads.claim: Ashvapati asks the officers to help the children find loving parents, since they deserve a real family.
threads.quote: Ashvapati: I know I'm in no position to make requests, but... please help them find loving parents to take them in. Above all else, they deserve a true family.

threads.claim: Ashvapati believes he must atone for the weapons he built, which he sees as bringing death and destroying the children's home.
threads.quote: Ashvapati: I don't deserve them... I have to atone for the things I've done.

threads.claim: The ballista is turned from a weapon into a fireworks display that intercepts Ashvapati's projectiles.
threads.quote: Ashvapati: I never imagined the Guizhong Ballista could be used for something so beautiful...

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: a tree that absorbs and purifies filth from Inazuma's Ley Lines to keep the land stable
introduced.quote: For a long time, the Sacred Sakura has been absorbing filth from Inazuma's Ley Lines to maintain stability in the land.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: channels through which filth flows and which the Sacred Sakura purifies
introduced.quote: Ei: The Sacred Sakura can absorb and purify the filth in the Ley Lines. After the rifthounds attacked, some of this filth leaked out through the cracks in the trunk and formed a physical entity.

introduced.name: Rifthounds
introduced.how: monsters that tear open passages through space and act as advance guards for stronger beasts
introduced.quote: Ei: Their duty was to tear open a passage through space with their claws and teeth, and then call in even more powerful beasts.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: a now-fallen kingdom whose 500-year-old catastrophe also brought monsters to Inazuma
introduced.quote: Ei: Yes. Inazuma was facing many great crises at that time. Some were local in origin, while others... others came from the now-fallen kingdom of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: a body already working to protect civilians and the Sacred Sakura from the rifthounds
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Their main priority is to protect the civilian population.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: the client that commissioned the job and tends the Sacred Sakura's roots
introduced.quote: Ei: We are lucky... the damage is not too serious. The Yashiro Commission will be able to nurse the root system back to health.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: an organization that assists the Tenryou Commission and offers commissions to adventurers
introduced.quote: Katheryne: The Adventurers' Guild is one of the key parties assisting the Tenryou Commission with their work.

introduced.name: Kitsune Saiguu
introduced.how: Ei's friend who led Inazuma's defense 500 years ago
introduced.quote: Ei: But my friend, Kitsune Saiguu, reassured me that I had nothing to worry about.

introduced.name: Raiden Makoto
introduced.how: the former Electro Archon and Ei's sister, whose tea-master was Furuyama
introduced.quote: Ei: So in the vast majority of cases, the one he made tea for was the former Electro Archon... who was also my sister. Raiden Makoto.

introduced.name: Furuyama
introduced.how: a blind tea master and member of Ei's retinue, now a memory
introduced.quote: Ei: Allow me to introduce Furuyama. He is a tea master and a member of my retinue.

introduced.name: Kitamura
introduced.how: a ghostly samurai memory from 500 years ago who warned of monsters
introduced.quote: Kitamura: Run, quick, while you still can! The monsters will be back...

introduced.name: Fujiki
introduced.how: a samurai memory from the Khaenri'ah-era fighting who leads a squad of yoriki
introduced.quote: Fujiki: We, the Shogunate samurai, will defend the Shogun until the very end!

introduced.name: Fukami
introduced.how: a samurai memory who fights alongside Fujiki and reveres the Shogun
introduced.quote: Fukami: Come on, men! They're coming back for more, let's get them!

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun puppet
introduced.how: a puppet body that is the assistant and rules guardian of Ei's consciousness
introduced.quote: Raiden Shogun: This body is an assistant to the one within. But it is also the guardian of the rules.

introduced.name: Realm of consciousness
introduced.how: an inner space where a person's consciousness exists independently of their body
introduced.quote: Ei: But inside a realm of consciousness, I exist independently of her. She cannot affect me in this way.

introduced.name: Musou Isshin
introduced.how: Ei's sword, in which Makoto placed a fragment of her consciousness
introduced.quote: Just then, the Musou Isshin begins to glow and spawns a fragment of Makoto's consciousness, which she had placed in the sword and would only be evoked when Ei drew out its full power.

introduced.name: Visions
introduced.how: divine powers the gods grant to humans, which samurai call on in hard times
introduced.quote: Fujiki: It certainly is. I know the gods are omnipotent, and their willingness to grant their power to humans means that they have high expectations for us.

introduced.name: Purified filth as memory
introduced.how: filth that is purified appears as a memory that soon dissipates into the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Ei: An entity formed with strong filth would be highly aggressive. But when purified, it presents in the form of a memory.

introduced.name: Dreams versus ambitions
introduced.how: Makoto's view that dreams are abstract and eternal, while ambitions are finite and concrete
introduced.quote: Ei: An "ambition" is a yearning for something material, or a concrete outcome.

introduced.name: Erosion
introduced.how: a gradual degradation of will by time that the Shogun is built to resist
introduced.quote: Raiden Shogun: Every action undertaken is for the sake of resisting erosion.

introduced.name: Death of Raiden Makoto
introduced.how: Makoto went alone to Khaenri'ah and died there, and Ei arrived too late
introduced.quote: Ei: Yes. She went to Khaenri'ah alone, without telling me.

introduced.name: Raiden Makoto
introduced.how: Former Electro Archon who failed her duties, left Inazuma to Ei, and left a fragment of her will in Musou Isshin
introduced.quote: I am Raiden Makoto, the previous Electro Archon, who failed in my duties and left you all to pick up the pieces.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Ei's familiar who can sense Ei's whereabouts and keeps the Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.quote: Luckily, I'm Ei's familiar, so I can sense her rough whereabouts.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: Shrine where Yae Miko is based and where the Sacred Sakura lies within her care
introduced.quote: The Sacred Sakura is within my purview at the shrine, so obviously I get to prune it exactly how I like it.

introduced.name: Realm of Consciousness
introduced.how: An abstract space where Ei is, reached by placing one's consciousness in a physical object, and where chaos can sweep travelers away
introduced.quote: To the outsider, the realm of consciousness is a very abstract concept.

introduced.name: Plane of Euthymia
introduced.how: A realm entered by placing your consciousness in a physical object first to avoid being swept away
introduced.quote: This is precisely why when entering the Plane of Euthymia, it's much safer if you place your consciousness in a physical object first.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: A miracle tree that blesses the people, grown from a seed Makoto gave Ei and tied to the realm of consciousness
introduced.quote: The miracle tree that blesses the people, in this moment new to the world and yet to be known.

introduced.name: Musou Isshin
introduced.how: A blade Ei inherited from Makoto that holds a fragment of Makoto's will and can unleash new power
introduced.quote: The blade that I inherited from Makoto seems to be trying to guide me... to encourage me.

introduced.name: Raiden Shogun
introduced.how: The enforcer of eternity's rules that was Ei's past self, now to become her assistant and shadow
introduced.quote: You used to represent my past, but from today onward, you are me.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: A policy keeping Inazuma closed off, which Ei plans to abolish
introduced.quote: After that... I will abolish the Sakoku Decree.

introduced.name: Eternity and time
introduced.how: Eternity is tied to time, and touching on it makes time murky; the realm's time is not ordinary
introduced.quote: Eternity is a concept intimately connected with time. When you begin to touch on eternity, the concept of time becomes murky.

introduced.name: Duel of centuries
introduced.how: The long duel between Ei and the Raiden Shogun began 500 years ago and was a conclusion of rules and will
introduced.quote: Then let this be our final duel, the conclusion to that which began 500 years ago.

assumed.name: Hanachirusato
assumed.quote: Paimon: Keeping the Sacred Sakura safe was Hanachirusato's greatest wish, and now these mangy mutts are trying to destroy it.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission crisis
assumed.quote: Ei: It has been a long time. We have not seen each other since the resolution of the Tenryou Commission crisis.

assumed.name: Tatarigami
assumed.quote: Though I could conquer Tatarigami and vanquish monsters, I was helpless against the ravages of time, powerless to keep the ones I cherished alive.

assumed.name: Dusky Ming
assumed.quote: Traveler: The same thing happened to Dusky Ming.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is this the "loss" that Yae Miko mentioned?

assumed.name: Plane of Euthymia
assumed.quote: Ei: When you came charging into the Plane of Euthymia, I saw human aspirations light up the sky far above in the form of countless stars.

assumed.name: Commissioner Kamisato
assumed.quote: Ei: Be at ease, I'm not here to see Commissioner Kamisato.

assumed.name: Traveler's family
assumed.quote: Ei: ? Hmm... I had heard that you were looking for your family.

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, yeah, yeah! Something really big's happened! It's Ei, she... she...

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Did you know what was about to happen in Khaenri'ah?

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: finally free from the clutches of the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions
assumed.quote: I will be sure to remind the Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions of their duties in this regard.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: There's plenty more besides memories held in the Ley Lines.

assumed.name: Cataclysm
assumed.quote: Without the Sacred Sakura, Inazuma would likely have been completely swallowed up centuries ago by that disaster and the filth.

assumed.name: Kitsune
assumed.quote: We have the loving care of kitsune over the ages to thank for how it appears today.

threads.claim: The 500-year-old Khaenri'ah catastrophe also brought monsters to Inazuma and is still unresolved in Ei's memory.
threads.quote: Traveler: Five hundred years ago... Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: Ei remembers the Sacred Sakura suddenly appearing on Mt. Yougou, while everyone else says it always existed.
threads.quote: Ei: That's exactly what everyone back then told me as well. That it had existed since time immemorial.

threads.claim: Makoto died in Khaenri'ah without telling Ei, and Ei saved her consciousness realm before it collapsed.
threads.quote: Ei: The events of 500 years ago not only robbed me of my friend, Kitsune Saiguu... they also took Makoto away from me for good.

threads.claim: Ei believes Makoto's consciousness caused the Sacred Sakura to appear, though this is not fully confirmed.
threads.quote: Ei: In the end, I simply had to accept that it was a miraculous effect of Makoto's consciousness.

threads.claim: Kitsune Saiguu died protecting Inazuma's people during the 500-year-old crisis.
threads.quote: Ei: Indeed. Countless monsters suddenly appeared throughout all of Inazuma. In the end... Kitsune Saiguu sacrificed her life to protect the people.

threads.claim: Filth in the Ley Lines takes aggressive form when tainted and memory form when purified, and purified memories fade quickly.
threads.quote: Ei: Purified filth quickly dissipates and will be absorbed by the Ley Lines shortly afterwards.

threads.claim: The Shogun suspects Ei is suffering from irreversible erosion because of her changed views.
threads.quote: Raiden Shogun: But have you really been enlightened with new ideas? Or have you been degraded by irreversible erosion?

threads.claim: The Shogun puppet guards the rules of eternity and opposes any change to them.
threads.quote: Raiden Shogun: Should the one within wish to stray from the rules, this body shall stand in her way.

threads.claim: Makoto's concept of eternity rests on innate human dreams rather than concrete ambitions, and Ei's view has changed.
threads.quote: Ei: Makoto was more concerned with the force that drives humans to constantly generate new ambitions in the first place.

threads.claim: Ei's body is being controlled by the Shogun puppet, which limits what Ei can do with it.
threads.quote: Ei: It looks like "she" will no longer allow me to do with this body as I please.

threads.claim: Ei defeats the Shogun, who accepts that Ei is not eroded and lets her keep control.
threads.quote: Ei manages to defeat the Shogun, who finally acknowledges that she is not suffering from erosion and allows her to remain in control.

threads.claim: Ei vows to return to Inazuma one day after leaving to resolve her inner conflict.
threads.quote: Ei: I vow to the subjects of Inazuma that I shall one day return. This is my oath. Please be my witness.

threads.claim: Ei hands the governance of Inazuma to Miko during her absence.
threads.quote: Ei: During my absence, I place everything in Miko's hands.

threads.claim: The Traveler's family may have been involved in the Khaenri'ah disaster, but Ei cannot help find them.
threads.quote: Ei: I'm sorry. I wasn't there for the whole thing. By the time I arrived, the worst of the fighting was already over.

threads.claim: Furuyama may have known there were two Raiden Shoguns and pretended not to, a question left open.
threads.quote: Observe Teacup: (How much did he actually perceive, and how much did he let on?)

threads.claim: Makoto's will is hidden in Musou Isshin and is what released her when the blade's full power was unleashed.
threads.quote: I left a faint fragment of my will in Musou Isshin, so that in the moment that you unleashed its full power, I too would be released.

threads.claim: The Sacred Sakura had not yet been planted in the past, which explains why Ei could not link it to Makoto's consciousness earlier.
threads.quote: No, but I understand why now. It was because the Sacred Sakura hadn't even been planted then.

threads.claim: Eternity is linked to time, and the realm's time behaves in ways ordinary logic cannot explain.
threads.quote: Eternity is a concept intimately connected with time. When you begin to touch on eternity, the concept of time becomes murky.

threads.claim: The realm of consciousness has anomalies in the flow of time that disrupted the search for Ei.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: At that time, I could sense Ei's whereabouts, but I also sensed anomalies in the flow of time within that space.

threads.claim: Makoto knew of a danger about to happen in Khaenri'ah, which Ei asks about without a full answer.
threads.quote: I had some sense of it. That place... was not somewhere that any archon could afford to ignore.

threads.claim: The Sacred Sakura is said to free the world from the Heavenly Principles, a force not yet explained.
threads.quote: finally free from the clutches of the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Ei intends to abolish the Sakoku Decree now that she no longer pursues a stasis-based eternity.
threads.quote: After that... I will abolish the Sakoku Decree.

threads.claim: The Raiden Shogun is revealed to be Ei's past self, and from now on she and Ei are one.
threads.quote: You used to represent my past, but from today onward, you are me.

threads.claim: Yae Miko's words about placing her god in the Traveler's hands are hinted at and then denied, leaving her divine nature unclear.
threads.quote: Traveler: Yae Miko said she was placing her god—

threads.claim: Ei worries that more than monsters may escape from the Sacred Sakura through the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Ei: It's not only the monsters that I am worried about. I'm concerned about what else might escape from the Sacred Sakura.

threads.claim: Makoto says goodbye to Ei for the last time after her parting gift has been given.
threads.quote: This time, it really is goodbye, Ei.

introduced.name: Ryuuji
introduced.how: A Bantan Sango Detective Agency detective who takes on the Tenryou Commission's commission
introduced.quote: Owada: Uh, well... Madam Kujou Sara... because we couldn't locate Doushin Shikanoin, we commissioned Detective Ryuuji from the detective agency...

introduced.name: Sango
introduced.how: President of Bantan Sango Detective Agency, who openly dislikes Heizou
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: It's from Sango, the president of Bantan Sango Detective Agency. I assume you've met her before?

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: A general of the Tenryou Commission, named as the supposedly missing person in Ryuuji's and Sango's rumor
introduced.quote: Sango: Kujou Sara. That's right, the general has gone missing.

introduced.name: Shikanoin Heizou
introduced.how: A special detective of the Tenryou Commission, introduced by himself as the missing person
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Ahem! The name's Shikanoin Heizou, special detective of the Tenryou Commission. It's a pleasure to meet you, Traveler.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Organization that entrusts the agency with discreetly finding a missing key member
introduced.quote: Ryuuji: The Tenryou Commission has entrusted us to find this person discreetly because it would be a hassle for them to look for this person openly, for a variety of reasons.

introduced.name: Police Station
introduced.how: Where Heizou works as a special detective and is highly regarded
introduced.quote: Ryuuji: He works as a special detective at the Police Station. Although his rank is merely a Doushin, he is quite competent and held in high regard by the Police Station.

introduced.name: Doushin
introduced.how: A police rank that Heizou holds at the Police Station
introduced.quote: Ryuuji: He works as a special detective at the Police Station. Although his rank is merely a Doushin, he is quite competent and held in high regard by the Police Station.

introduced.name: Shibata
introduced.how: Watch officer on Watatsumi Island who oversees the area
introduced.quote: Shibata: Oh, it's you...! The captain of Swordfish II! My name is Shibata. I'm in charge of the watch here.

introduced.name: Nobushi
introduced.how: Hostile armed group that captures a tourist on Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: Nobushi: Just shut up and stay put!

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: A decree that kept Inazuma locked off from the outside world, though stories about the Traveler still reached it
introduced.quote: ???: Though the Sakoku Decree managed to keep the country locked up, it wasn't able to stop the incredible stories about you.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: An external magical focus that Heizou compares to a Voice
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: A Vision is an external magical focus, right? Well, similarly, a Voice is an external voice box.

introduced.name: Voice
introduced.how: An external voice box, Heizou's term for a person who speaks on another's behalf
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: A Vision is an external magical focus, right? Well, similarly, a Voice is an external voice box.

introduced.name: Kujou Takayuki
introduced.how: Former head of the Tenryou Commission who had Heizou investigate Sangonomiya's military during the war
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Kujou Takayuki, who was head of the Tenryou Commission at the time, had secretly asked me to investigate the military capabilities of Sangonomiya.

introduced.name: Heizou Talks Fraud
introduced.how: An anti-fraud public awareness event, staged as a short play, that Heizou organizes
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: It's an anti-fraud public awareness event. Basically, think of it as a short play about fraud.

introduced.name: Kano Nana
introduced.how: Heizou's cousin, who keeps an eye on his behavior
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: Hello there, Traveler. I must apologize for my cousin — he must have been causing you all kinds of trouble?

introduced.name: Etsu
introduced.how: A former fraud convict doing community service at the Grand Narukami Shrine, who Heizou arrested
introduced.quote: Etsu: That's right. I was careless and found myself caught up in a case of fraud. Detective Heizou arrested me and I was sentenced to prison.

introduced.name: Iba
introduced.how: A former commercial scammer and elderly figure who confessed to Heizou and is now a play candidate
introduced.quote: Iba: Oh, well if it isn't Heizou! Thanks to you, I haven't kicked the bucket yet.

introduced.name: Iba Trading Guild
introduced.how: A trading guild Iba once led, once bigger than the International Trade Association
introduced.quote: His Iba Trading Guild was even bigger than the current International Trade Association.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: A boisterous Onikabuto-loving prisoner and gang leader who bullies kids in Hanamizaka
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Huh? Paimon, and my compadre! This is a nice surprise, what brings you out this way?

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: Beetles used in winner-takes-all Onikabuto battles
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: ...Oh, except that there's this Onikabuto Battle Royale tomorrow night I was planning on going to...

introduced.name: Kuki Shinobu
introduced.how: Itto's assistant who asked Heizou to look out for him
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Yeah, that was me, but it was only because your assistant, Kuki Shinobu, asked me to look out for you...

introduced.name: Cyclone
introduced.how: Prisoners' nickname for Heizou, a force of nature criminals cannot escape
introduced.quote: Iba: Heizou's nickname. It's what all the prisoners call him, haven't you heard it before?

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: a gang leader who was conned by a cheap street trick
introduced.quote: But how am I gonna protect my gang if even I get fooled by such cheap tricks?

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: a figurine sold by a street vendor whose advertising was false
introduced.quote: I was duped by the Onikabuto vendor's false advertising.

introduced.name: Sango
introduced.how: a detective who runs her own agency and writes complaint letters to the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: pursuing the truth is the reason I started this agency.

introduced.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
introduced.how: Sango's detective agency, formerly co-run with Heizou
introduced.quote: which at the time was called the "Bantan Sango & Heizou Detective Agency."

introduced.name: Ryuuji
introduced.how: an orphan who worked for Takatsukasa Isamu and was convicted of his murder
introduced.quote: Ryuuji was an orphan, you know.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the official body that Ryuuji, Sara and Heizou work for
introduced.quote: I was still working at the Tenryou Commission then

introduced.name: Police Station
introduced.how: the station where Isamu was manager and where the murder happened
introduced.quote: a terrible murder took place in the Police Station.

introduced.name: Ryuuji Case
introduced.how: the murder of Takatsukasa Isamu, in which Ryuuji was the top suspect
introduced.quote: Due to various factors, I was deemed to be the top suspect, which is why it's called the "Ryuuji Case."

introduced.name: Takatsukasa Isamu
introduced.how: Police Station manager murdered with poison, younger brother of Takatsukasa Susumu
introduced.quote: His name was Takatsukasa Isamu, the younger brother of Takatsukasa Susumu, head of the Takatsukasa Clan.

introduced.name: Takatsukasa Clan
introduced.how: a clan that has long assisted the Kujou Clan in the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: you may be unaware that the Takatsukasa Clan has always been assisting the Kujou Clan in the Tenryou Commission

introduced.name: Kujou Clan
introduced.how: a rival clan suspected of wanting Isamu removed
introduced.quote: So naturally, the Kujou Clan saw him as a potential threat.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: a principled Tenryou Commission official who signed both convictions
introduced.quote: She's the most principled person in the entire Tenryou Commission, for goodness' sake.

introduced.name: Kujou Takayuki
introduced.how: a Kujou Clan figure suspected of framing Ryuuji to remove Isamu
introduced.quote: Kujou Takayuki must have been planning it all along, that rascal.

introduced.name: Shiroyama
introduced.how: a forensic doctor who poisoned Isamu, framed Ryuuji, and then took his own life
introduced.quote: The guy was a forensic expert who worked in the station named Shiroyama.

introduced.name: Uesugi
introduced.how: a young officer who pushes Kujou Clan conspiracy theories
introduced.quote: Hey c'mon, Yoriki Owada, there's nothing to see! It's obvious that the Kujou Clan did it!

introduced.name: Yoriki Owada
introduced.how: a veteran officer who worked on the Ryuuji Case years ago
introduced.quote: why don't you go and chat with Yoriki Owada over there? He worked on this case too back in the day.

introduced.name: Takatsukasa Chika
introduced.how: Isamu's young daughter, who never met her father
introduced.quote: Uncle Ryuuji, was my daddy handsome? I've never seen what he looked like.

introduced.name: White powder
introduced.how: an odorless synthetic toxin that dissolves only in water and killed Isamu
introduced.quote: Tentative name: "white powder."

introduced.name: Fish-liver paste
introduced.how: a nutritional supplement that became a key ingredient of the poison
introduced.quote: small volume of fish-liver paste residue, the main ingredient of which is highly-concentrated fish-liver extract, a valuable nutritional supplement

introduced.name: Forensic Office Research Log Excerpt
introduced.how: torn-out pages describing how the poison was made from Sunsettia and fish liver
introduced.quote: Acidic nutrients extracted from the Sunsettia were mixed with the oil extracted from the fish liver.

introduced.name: International Trade Association
introduced.how: a gathering place for merchants from all over, where the poison was supposedly bought
introduced.quote: The International Trade Association is a gathering place for merchants from all over.

introduced.name: Shikanoin Heizou
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Tenryou Commission detective who is also a tourist
introduced.quote: It's a pleasure to meet you, General Gorou. I'm Shikanoin Heizou of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Shikanoin Heizou's organization, which polices illegal trade under the Shogunate
introduced.quote: Hello, Todoroki. I'm Shikanoin Heizou, special detective of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Sango Pearl
introduced.how: A precious, highly valued trade commodity from Watatsumi
introduced.quote: Crystal Marrow is a rare material for crafting weapons and Sango Pearls are an even more precious commodity.

introduced.name: Crystal Marrow
introduced.how: A rare material used for crafting weapons
introduced.quote: Crystal Marrow is a rare material for crafting weapons and Sango Pearls are an even more precious commodity.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: A poor-soiled island whose fragile economy depends on trading special resources
introduced.quote: Due to Watatsumi's poor soil, the island's economy is quite fragile and heavily reliant on the trade of these special resources.

introduced.name: Nobushi
introduced.how: Bandits who raid caravans and camps and hold stolen Watatsumi goods
introduced.quote: Oh, these goods were all seized from the hands of Nobushi and Treasure Hoarders.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Shrine
introduced.how: Watatsumi's administrative center where caravan news and orders are handled
introduced.quote: If we go ask around at the Sangonomiya Shrine, we can find out if there have been any recent instances of caravans being plundered...

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
introduced.how: Watatsumi's leader, called Her Excellency, who launched the economic measures and caravans
introduced.quote: Her Excellency has recently launched several measures to boost the economy, including the development of trade routes and establishing our own caravans.

introduced.name: Todoroki
introduced.how: A former radish farmer now running Watatsumi's caravans
introduced.quote: Yeah, he's proven to be quite capable. Even though he was just a farmer before, he's now successfully running the caravans.

introduced.name: Tokuda
introduced.how: An injured veteran reassigned to work under Todoroki's caravans
introduced.quote: So as injured veterans, we've been reassigned to Todoroki.

introduced.name: Masashi
introduced.how: An injured veteran reassigned to Todoroki who once fainted on the front lines
introduced.quote: Captain, you may not be aware, but Masashi previously fainted on the front lines.

introduced.name: Godot
introduced.how: An International Trade Association merchant who receives the stolen goods
introduced.quote: Their reports indicated that the stolen goods were being delivered to a merchant of the International Trade Association named Godot.

introduced.name: International Trade Association
introduced.how: A trade organization based on Ritou, outside Watatsumi's jurisdiction
introduced.quote: Given that Ritou, the island where the International Trade Association is located, is not part of your territory.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: An island outside Watatsumi's territory where the International Trade Association is based
introduced.quote: Given that Ritou, the island where the International Trade Association is located, is not part of your territory.

introduced.name: Inazuma Shogunate
introduced.how: The central authority whose investigation could expose the cover-up
introduced.quote: If the Shogunate decides to investigate, we won't be able to hide the truth.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: The body drafting a new commodity tax bill
introduced.quote: It's a new commodity tax bill currently being drafted by the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Commodity tax bill
introduced.how: A new bill exempting taxes on goods scarce on Watatsumi, due to pass in a few months
introduced.quote: The bill exempts taxes on goods that are in short supply on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Qingxin
introduced.how: A valuable raw ingredient for medicine, found smuggled in the goods
introduced.quote: These are valuable raw ingredients for producing medicine.

introduced.name: Irodori Festival
introduced.how: A festival on Narukami Island that Kokomi attended before the bill push began
introduced.quote: I was invited to attend the Irodori Festival on Narukami Island with Her Excellency a while back.

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: Where Kokomi met the Kanjou Commission and a commodity bill push began
introduced.quote: Following her return, we began our attempts at boosting commercial activity, and it wasn't long before there was a push for a new commodity bill on Narukami Island...

assumed.name: Kujou Kamaji
assumed.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Oh? Have they approved it already? Huh, the Tenryou Commission certainly has become more efficient ever since Kujou Kamaji took office.

assumed.name: Temple of Truth
assumed.quote: According to Sango, Heizou was an obstacle in her path to the

assumed.name: Swordfish II
assumed.quote: Shibata: Oh, it's you...! The captain of Swordfish II!

assumed.name: Miko
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ooh! If we're going to the Grand Narukami Shrine, are you planning to recruit Miko for your play?

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Kano Nana: Heizou, what are you doing here, you little brat? Oh, and the Traveler, too. So I assume you're here to see Lady Yae?

assumed.name: Sangonomiya
assumed.quote: Ryuuji: I heard you have a good standing with Sangonomiya.

assumed.name: Her Excellency
assumed.quote: Shibata: Her Excellency had assigned me to keep a close eye on him at the time

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: You mean the Great Serpent? Well, that's an interesting answer, but the Electro Archon hasn't abandoned this place.

assumed.name: International Trade Association
assumed.quote: His Iba Trading Guild was even bigger than the current International Trade Association.

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Iba: It's the Almighty Shogun! Ahem... We cannot let Her Excellency come to harm...

assumed.name: Shikanoin Heizou
assumed.quote: Welcome back, Mr. Heizou. I'm glad you're alright!

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: We've gotta report this to Ei.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: Of course, I only learned all of this after the Vision Hunt Decree came to an end.

assumed.name: Gorou
assumed.quote: Hey, ! It's been a while, I've missed you.

assumed.name: Swordfish II
assumed.quote: As the captain of Swordfish II, it's my duty to help Watatsumi.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Went to see Lady Yae.

assumed.name: Teppei
assumed.quote: Teppei brought you to see us, and helped find medicine for us.

assumed.name: Watatsumi war
assumed.quote: With the recent end of the war, trade and commerce have now become an important component of Watatsumi Island's development.

threads.claim: Ryuuji doubts that the general Kujou Sara is really missing, since the Commission would otherwise have searched everywhere.
threads.quote: Ryuuji: *sigh* ...If the general was really missing, the Tenryou Commission would have flipped Inazuma on its head by now.

threads.claim: Heizou's dream whispers that something vital is missing from Watatsumi Island, a mystery left unresolved.
threads.quote: Something vital is missing on this island...

threads.claim: Heizou first had a recurring dream on his first night on Watatsumi Island.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: But guess what, the first night I arrived on Watatsumi Island, I had a dream.

threads.claim: The same dream kept recurring, but stopped once Heizou left the island.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: After that, I had the same dream over and over again.

threads.claim: Heizou argues dreams are flashes of intuition rather than divine messages, leaving the source of his dream open.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: However, if you ask me, dreams have nothing to do with the gods. Instead, they are flashes of intuition.

threads.claim: Heizou's uncanny detection skills hint at a sense beyond the five senses, possibly divine favor.
threads.quote: Ryuuji: His skills are amazing, it's almost as if he relies on something other than just his five senses...

threads.claim: Heizou felt the Nobushi were peculiar and staged his capture to uncover leads.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Who knows... I felt there was something peculiar about them, so I pretended to get captured to see if there were any leads

threads.claim: Heizou was secretly sent by former Commission head Kujou Takayuki to investigate Sangonomiya's military during the war.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Kujou Takayuki, who was head of the Tenryou Commission at the time, had secretly asked me to investigate the military capabilities of Sangonomiya.

threads.claim: A complaint letter has been filed against Heizou, and its source is unknown at first.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: That can't be right, why would there be a complaint letter?

threads.claim: The complaint letter against Heizou is revealed to come from Sango of Bantan Sango Detective Agency.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: It's from Sango, the president of Bantan Sango Detective Agency. I assume you've met her before?

threads.claim: Sango openly despises Heizou and would be glad if he vanished forever.
threads.quote: Sango: Let me put it this way, it wouldn't bother me at all if he disappeared forever. That's my issue.

threads.claim: Heizou suspects the Traveler is a Voice, an external voice box for someone else, and calls it a new concept.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: A Vision is an external magical focus, right? Well, similarly, a Voice is an external voice box.

threads.claim: Heizou argues that preventing fraud is harder than solving it but more worthwhile.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: It's hard to say. Preventing crimes is more difficult than solving them, there's no doubt about that... but prevention is also a more worthwhile cause.

threads.claim: Ryuuji was convicted of murdering his boss Isamu, and Sango doubts the official account.
threads.quote: Due to various factors, I was deemed to be the top suspect, which is why it's called the "Ryuuji Case."

threads.claim: The murderer is revealed to be Shiroyama, and Ryuuji was framed.
threads.quote: Traveler: Sango was wrong about Heizou, and the murderer was indeed Shiroyama.

threads.claim: Uesugi suspects Kujou Takayuki orchestrated the frame-up to remove Isamu.
threads.quote: Kujou Takayuki must have been planning it all along, that rascal.

threads.claim: Evidence in Takayuki's secret warehouse shows he was behind Shiroyama's poisoning plot.
threads.quote: It was in Kujou Takayuki's secret warehouse.

threads.claim: Takayuki lost his grip on power after the Vision Hunt Decree ended.
threads.quote: Kujou Takayuki had lost his grip on power, and the Tenryou Commission was undergoing a general reshuffle.

threads.claim: Sara signed Ryuuji's conviction within a week, which fuels suspicion that she was pressured.
threads.quote: Moreover, it was signed by Madam Kujou Sara.

threads.claim: Sara had secretly lowered Ryuuji's sentence from death to temporary incarceration before signing.
threads.quote: Before she signed it, she changed Ryuuji's conviction from the death sentence to temporary incarceration.

threads.claim: The Forensic Office research log has been torn out, and its contents are hidden.
threads.quote: (It's blank. Looks like someone tore out a few pages.)

threads.claim: The torn-out pages reveal the poison recipe and were hidden by Takayuki.
threads.quote: Alright, here's the secret I've been keeping all along: the torn-out pages from the Research Log of the Office of Forensic Science.

threads.claim: Heizou keeps repeating that the Police Station lacks some information, hinting he has his own evidence.
threads.quote: Because you're trying to hint that there is other information that the Police Station doesn't have.

threads.claim: Heizou admits the missing evidence is his own, found in Takayuki's warehouse.
threads.quote: Reason being... it's my own evidence.

threads.claim: Heizou left the detective agency to join the Police Station, and his reasons remain unclear.
threads.quote: Heizou wasn't a part of the Police Station back then, he was a detective at the agency

threads.claim: Heizou left because some things matter more than the truth, meaning protecting Ryuuji from it.
threads.quote: Some things will always be more important than the truth.

threads.claim: Heizou hid the truth to protect Ryuuji and asks the Traveler to decide whether to expose it.
threads.quote: My biggest worry is that Ryuuji would struggle to cope if he knew the truth.

threads.claim: The toxicology report finds no sales record for the poison, so its source is a mystery.
threads.quote: The station has investigated the ledgers of all domestic commerce guilds, no transaction record for such an item was found.

threads.claim: The poison was invented by Shiroyama.
threads.quote: That's correct! The white powder was Shiroyama's invention.

threads.claim: Owada says Isamu was expecting a child who was never born.
threads.quote: Isamu was expecting a child of his own later, but unfortunately he was killed before the child was ever born...

threads.claim: Isamu's daughter Chika is alive and has never met her father.
threads.quote: Uncle Ryuuji, was my daddy handsome? I've never seen what he looked like.

threads.claim: Heizou senses that something missing from Watatsumi Island is present in Gorou.
threads.quote: Yes. Whatever is missing on this island, I sense it in him...

threads.claim: Heizou frames the island's missing element as the key question he must answer.
threads.quote: The question of what important thing this island is missing...

threads.claim: Heizou concludes the missing element is the true vitality of the land, which lives on in its people.
threads.quote: Which is... the true vitality of this land.

threads.claim: Heizou suspects General Gorou is lying and covering up a secret.
threads.quote: My intuition tells me that General Gorou is lying.

threads.claim: Gorou admits he hid the truth to keep outside parties from getting involved in the stolen goods affair.
threads.quote: I'm sorry for not telling you the truth earlier. It's a serious matter, and I didn't want outside parties to become involved.

threads.claim: Gorou suspects bigger players stand behind the merchant Godot, with Watatsumi's resources as their target.
threads.quote: We suspect that there are bigger players behind Godot, and that their target is none other than Watatsumi Island's valuable resources.

threads.claim: Heizou suspects the Godot lead on Ritou is a decoy that will yield nothing.
threads.quote: I surmise that investigating the merchant Godot on Ritou will yield no results.

threads.claim: A pirate captain described as a woman with an eye patch may be someone Paimon recognizes.
threads.quote: *gasp* A pretty lady with an eye patch!?

threads.claim: Someone unknown is pushing the new commodity bill, and nobody on Watatsumi seems to have connections to the Kanjou Commission.
threads.quote: aren't you curious about who's been pushing for the new commodity bill?

threads.claim: Kokomi visited the Kanjou Commission to see Lady Yae during her trip, with the meeting kept out of the public eye.
threads.quote: She went to the Kanjou Commission to see Lady Yae — purportedly for a book review, but there were other items on the agenda, too.

threads.claim: Gorou publicly credits the Traveler as the hero who saved Watatsumi Island.
threads.quote: Todoroki, here is the hero who saved Watatsumi Island.

threads.claim: Heizou asks that the Traveler's freedom not be limited, and Gorou promises not to restrict it.
threads.quote: I would never dream of limiting freedom.

threads.claim: Heizou argues that what evaporates is not gone but has changed its state, applying this to the island's vitality.
threads.quote: Because even something that evaporates is not gone. It's still there, just in a different state of being.

threads.claim: The ending presents the memories of the journey as lasting even though the journey itself ends.
threads.quote: The journey will end, but the memories will remain.

introduced.name: Sucrose
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Albedo's assistant who handles alchemy questions at the store
introduced.quote: I'm Sucrose, Albedo's assistant. If you have any alchemy-related queries, you could always ask me. I'd... do my best to help.

introduced.name: Albedo
introduced.how: A master alchemist and the Knights of Favonius' Chief Alchemist, teacher to Timaeus and Sucrose
introduced.quote: Albedo is the Knights of Favonius' Chief Alchemist. He's also Timaeus' and my teacher.

introduced.name: Rosaria
introduced.how: Self-introduced member of the Favonius Church who is wary of the Traveler and Albedo
introduced.quote: I'm a member of the long-standing Favonius Church.

introduced.name: Barbara
introduced.how: A church sister trying to bring Rosaria to choir practice for a commemorative event
introduced.quote: Arriving at the base of the mountains, they find Barbara with Rosaria, the former trying to bring the latter in for choir practice.

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: Albedo's assistant who gathers and analyzes the experiment data
introduced.quote: My assistant Timaeus here is helping me with my research. I'm guessing you may have met in Mondstadt already?

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Mondstadt's knightly order, which Albedo serves as Chief Alchemist
introduced.quote: Albedo is the Knights of Favonius' Chief Alchemist. He's also Timaeus' and my teacher.

introduced.name: Church of Favonius
introduced.how: The church Rosaria and Barbara belong to, which holds a commemorative event
introduced.quote: I'm a member of the long-standing Favonius Church.

introduced.name: Teyvat
introduced.how: The world where alchemists from everywhere come to Albedo for help
introduced.quote: Sucrose explains how Albedo is a master alchemist and that everyone from across Teyvat comes to him for answers.

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: Mountain area where Albedo and Timaeus are conducting research
introduced.quote: She states that Albedo is likely to reward them if they help him, and that he can be found with Timaeus at Dragonspine.

introduced.name: Starsilver Catalyst
introduced.how: Starsilver ore is needed as a catalyst for the potion, and only some of it is suitable
introduced.quote: It's a type of ore known as Starsilver, but unfortunately not all of it is suitable.

introduced.name: Experimental Potion
introduced.how: An alchemy potion that channels elemental power into the body and can cause a reaction
introduced.quote: This potion channels elemental power into the body. Under normal circumstances, a repelling reaction is to be expected.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: In Teyvat, manipulating the elements requires a Vision, which the Traveler appears not to have
introduced.quote: In this world, manipulating the elements requires a Vision, though I can't see anything resembling one on your person.

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: A rarely seen ability to perceive elemental traces, though it exists in Teyvat
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, though Elemental Sight is seldom seen, it is not unheard of in Teyvat.

introduced.name: Slime
introduced.how: Slimes are elemental life forms made entirely of the elements
introduced.quote: Not bad for a point of entry, but strictly speaking, slimes are elemental life forms. In other words, beings consisting entirely of the elements.

introduced.name: Hilichurl
introduced.how: Primitive creatures that become alarmed and attack when approached
introduced.quote: They soon find Albedo sketching dangerously close to a group of hilichurls, who become alarmed by their presence and attack.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: Seelies are a common sight in the mountains and are used in a puzzle
introduced.quote: Seelie like these are a common sight in the mountains.

introduced.name: Otherworldly seed
introduced.how: A seed from another world that has produced no results under Albedo's method
introduced.quote: However, I have a particular seed in my possession. The method I'm talking about has produced no results.

introduced.name: Traveler from another world
introduced.how: Albedo deduces the Traveler came from another world, which explains their abilities
introduced.quote: I'll skip to the conclusion, there's only one possibility after all. You came from afar — from another world. Correct?

introduced.name: Script symbols
introduced.how: Unknown script found across Teyvat that has never revealed its meaning
introduced.quote: To the best of my knowledge, these belong to a script of some kind. They can be found all over Teyvat, but they've never given up their secrets.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: Currency paid as a reward
introduced.quote: But if Albedo wants to pay Paimon back for helping him, a few Mora might settle the score.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Hey, aren't you the legendary Traveler? The one who repelled Stormterror?

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: The Honorary Knight that saved us from Stormterror.

assumed.name: Timaeus
assumed.quote: Huh, looks like Timaeus isn't here today...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: But if Albedo wants to pay Paimon back for helping him, a few Mora might settle the score.

threads.claim: Albedo fears he may lose control and destroy Mondstadt and everything he holds dear.
threads.quote: If one day, I lose control... destroy Mondstadt... destroy everything...

threads.claim: Rosaria suspects Albedo may be a risk to Mondstadt.
threads.quote: In the distance, Rosaria is spying on the two, wondering if Albedo is a risk to Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Rosaria warns the Traveler not to trust Albedo and calls the Traveler's choices rash.
threads.quote: Don't be so quick to trust Albedo, and don't repeat the same mistakes that you did this time.

threads.claim: A sediment forms in the vial that Albedo did not expect, hinting at a deeper meaning in his and the Traveler's nature.
threads.quote: But what was that sediment I saw forming at the bottom of the vial? It should not have been there... What could it mean?

threads.claim: Albedo contrasts beings born of earth with those born of chalk and suggests he and the Traveler share an undefined substance.
threads.quote: Those born of earth are bound by its imperfections, but those born of chalk are free of impurities...

threads.claim: Albedo holds a seed from another world that will not grow under his current method.
threads.quote: However, I have a particular seed in my possession. The method I'm talking about has produced no results.

threads.claim: With the Traveler's help Albedo makes a flower bloom from the otherworldly seed, though only briefly.
threads.quote: The transition from nothing into something, from shoot to stem... And now to fruition.

threads.claim: Albedo states that peculiar people have an essence different from ordinary people.
threads.quote: Albedo states that the essence of peculiar people are different to that of ordinary people.

threads.claim: Albedo says peculiar people lack the shared understanding ordinary people have because their life's essence is fundamentally different.
threads.quote: They don't have much recourse for the things we take for granted. The essence of their life is fundamentally different.

threads.claim: Albedo suspects the natural laws of Teyvat may be limiting the Traveler's unique abilities.
threads.quote: Unless... Could it be that the natural laws of this world are limiting your unique abilities?

threads.claim: Albedo suggests Teyvat may have a natural hostility to outlanders, and that the Traveler's ability to converse with him unharmed is a small miracle.
threads.quote: Have you ever considered that the world of Teyvat may have a natural hostility to outlanders?

threads.claim: The script found behind the drains is a widespread mystery whose secrets have never been revealed.
threads.quote: To the best of my knowledge, these belong to a script of some kind. They can be found all over Teyvat, but they've never given up their secrets.

threads.claim: Rosaria copies the symbols and marks the site as a location of interest that will be patrolled.
threads.quote: This is now a location of interest — regular patrols should be set up here.

threads.claim: Albedo admits his fascination fades once the unknown becomes understood, leaving him uninspired.
threads.quote: The essence of the investigative process is enthralling, but such feelings are inevitably fleeting in nature.

introduced.name: Hotel Debord
introduced.how: the restaurant where Navia waits and where the chefs work
introduced.quote: Arriving at Hotel Debord, the Traveler and Paimon find Navia sitting outside the hotel.

introduced.name: Savanna
introduced.how: the current head chef of Hotel Debord who overworks her staff
introduced.quote: Her name is Savanna. She's the new head chef at Hotel Debord.

introduced.name: Monica
introduced.how: a chef scolded by Savanna and sent out of the kitchen
introduced.quote: as one chef, Savanna, scolding another, Monica, telling her not to return until she got her act straight.

introduced.name: Firmin
introduced.how: a chef who collapsed from illness after overwork under Savanna
introduced.quote: He's the chef that fell ill from stress.

introduced.name: Escoffier
introduced.how: the former head chef of Hotel Debord who was sent to prison and is now a fry chef in the Fleuve Cendre
introduced.quote: Navia explains that Escoffier was the previous head chef of the Delbord.

introduced.name: Hilaire
introduced.how: Firmin's son, a young cook scolded by Escoffier
introduced.quote: until they spot Escoffier scolding Hilaire for wasting mushroom and cream.

introduced.name: Leone
introduced.how: a hostess who delivers Monica's apology candy
introduced.quote: Leone then appears and gives Navia a candy made from Monica.

introduced.name: Fleuve Cendre
introduced.how: an underground city where Escoffier now cooks at the Spina's tavern
introduced.quote: Navia recognizes the name and tells them to follow her to Fleuve Cendre.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: the prison where Escoffier was sentenced for the food incident
introduced.quote: was sentenced to the Fortress of Meropide for a short duration.

introduced.name: Gateau Debord
introduced.how: a limited cake that needs three chefs and is sold in small numbers
introduced.quote: Even the legendary Gateau Debord was made with an ingredient discovered during one of these adventures, resulting in the cake's limited availability.

introduced.name: Codex Debord
introduced.how: Modeste's recipe and adventure book, granted only to current and former head chefs
introduced.quote: The codex contained all of Modeste's recipes and was only granted to both current and former head chefs.

introduced.name: Modeste
introduced.how: the hotel's founding culinary genius who died in his prime
introduced.quote: Safe to say, she's the most renowned head chef in the Hotel Debord's history after the culinary genius Modeste himself.

introduced.name: Savelli
introduced.how: Modeste's close friend and co-founder of Hotel Debord who explored with him
introduced.quote: Back in the day, he and his good friend Savelli explored far and wide, partly adventuring, partly looking for new ingredients and developing new recipes.

introduced.name: Vaneigem
introduced.how: the hotel's boss who proposes the cook-off
introduced.quote: Suddenly, the hotel's boss, Vaneigem, arrives and suggests the two have a cook-off.

introduced.name: Renaud
introduced.how: a customer whose meal Monica ruined
introduced.quote: There, they find her apologizing to a customer named Renaud.

introduced.name: Lumiline
introduced.how: a drug from Lumitoile that sharpens the senses but causes mood swings and nerve damage, and was banned
introduced.quote: A new drug from the Fontaine Research Institute, produced from an extract of the Lumitoile.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: an ancient civilization whose ruins hold a public bathhouse where food and drinks were served
introduced.quote: Escoffier recognizes it as a public Remurian bathhouse where food and drinks were served.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: the group Navia works for, which is mediating Firmin's case and runs a tavern
introduced.quote: At his family's request, the Spina di Rosula is trying to mediate on his behalf.

introduced.name: cooking contest tradition
introduced.how: Modeste and Savelli settled all their disputes through cooking contests
introduced.quote: According to legend, the founders of Hotel Debord, Modeste and Savelli, used this method to resolve all of their disputes!

introduced.name: Savelli
introduced.how: Savelli is Modeste's former friend and co-founder of the Hotel Debord, whose falling-out with Modeste is explained
introduced.quote: Yes, with his good friend and co-founder of the Hotel Debord, Savelli.

introduced.name: Modeste
introduced.how: Modeste is explained as a culinary genius who unveiled the Gateau Debord and was hailed as a genius
introduced.quote: The story goes that after Modeste unveiled his Gateau Debord and was hailed as a culinary genius, he was admired and adored by all...

introduced.name: Monica
introduced.how: Monica is revealed as a descendant of Modeste's line who has been pursuing the Treasure of Remuria
introduced.quote: It was the same story with Savelli and my ancestor!

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: Remuria is an ancient civilization whose public bath ruins lie underwater, and which developed a war-related drug
introduced.quote: a public bath from the time of Remuria.

introduced.name: Treasure of Remuria
introduced.how: A substance that stimulates the senses but dulls them over time, which Modeste and Savelli used in Gateau Debord
introduced.quote: The Treasure of Remuria stimulates the senses — taste included — and invigorates the spirit.

introduced.name: lumiline
introduced.how: A substance that at high doses causes serious nervous and sensory harm, and at low doses can alter a person's mood
introduced.quote: High doses pose a risk of serious nervous and sensory complications

introduced.name: lumiline incident
introduced.how: A food safety incident in which contaminated lumiline entered the kitchen and led to Escoffier's jailing
introduced.quote: I was the one who caused the food safety incident that one time.

introduced.name: Codex Debord
introduced.how: Modeste's adventure logs and recipe book, which record the places he explored
introduced.quote: Ah! Of course, from the Codex... They're all places that Modeste explored on his adventures!

introduced.name: Snow-Winged Goose
introduced.how: A migratory bird whose lead position rotates among the flock, used by Fontaine poets as a symbol of genius
introduced.quote: Every year, they migrate long distances in search of a suitable home.

introduced.name: Blubberbeast
introduced.how: Shy creatures in the ruins that can be fed and that sing when they receive food
introduced.quote: Some Blubberbeasts have come to join the party

introduced.name: Modeste and Savelli's falling-out
introduced.how: Modeste and Savelli's friendship soured and ended without reconciliation after Modeste died suddenly
introduced.quote: And that was it. They neither had a decisive split, nor got the chance to properly reconcile.

introduced.name: Modeste's death by Treasure overdose
introduced.how: Modeste consumed the last Treasure of Remuria, lost his sense of taste, and took his own life
introduced.quote: Finally, in despair, he took his own life.

introduced.name: lumiline
introduced.how: a substance that amplifies whatever feelings about taste are already present
introduced.quote: That stuff can only amplify what's already there.

introduced.name: Treasure of Remuria
introduced.how: was likely a lumiline substance extracted by the Remurians, and is now worth little
introduced.quote: The so-called Treasure of Remuria was most likely a substance that the Remurians extracted from Lumitoiles... better known to us as lumiline.

introduced.name: Lumitoile
introduced.how: the source the Remurians extracted lumiline from
introduced.quote: The so-called Treasure of Remuria was most likely a substance that the Remurians extracted from Lumitoiles... better known to us as lumiline.

introduced.name: Remurians
introduced.how: an ancient people who extracted lumiline from Lumitoiles
introduced.quote: The so-called Treasure of Remuria was most likely a substance that the Remurians extracted from Lumitoiles... better known to us as lumiline.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: makes lumiline, now sold as a drug
introduced.quote: But these days, it's just another drug from the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Gateau Debord origin
introduced.how: Escoffier created the Gateau Debord recipe after years of perfecting it
introduced.quote: I came up with this recipe. You don't think that might have something to do with it?

introduced.name: Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
introduced.how: a tweaked Gateau Debord recipe Escoffier gives the Traveler
introduced.quote: It's a recipe for Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version.

introduced.name: Remuria jar
introduced.how: a jar from the Remuria ruins, reported as ancient and very valuable
introduced.quote: Freshly unearthed from the ruins of Remuria! A magnificent jar thought to be over a thousand years old!

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Is that Navia over there? It's been a while, let's go say hi!

assumed.name: Snow-Winged Goose

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I definitely got my Mora's worth today!

assumed.name: Romaritime Flowers

assumed.name: Savanna
assumed.quote: Savanna, I've brought the original copy of the Codex you asked for.

assumed.name: Firmin
assumed.quote: But you must promise me that you'll apologize to Firmin, and compensate him for everything you put him through!

assumed.name: Alphonse
assumed.quote: Alphonse, Gaspard, get to work! Do not disappoint me!

assumed.name: Gaspard
assumed.quote: Alphonse, Gaspard, get to work! Do not disappoint me!

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Come on, Escoffier! Come on, !

assumed.name: Vaneigem
assumed.quote: Haha! Looks like our two head chefs are raring to go!

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: a legendary contest of mastery over Hotel Debord's legendary dish, the Gateau Debord

assumed.name: Spina di Rosula
assumed.quote: That's mission accomplished for the Spina.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: I could make a killing by selling it to the Treasure Hoarders or the Fatui!

assumed.name: Leone

assumed.name: Harmost
assumed.quote: Following the exalted Harmost (...) order

assumed.name: Remus
assumed.quote: Praise be... to Lord Remus!

assumed.name: Café Lutece
assumed.quote: or we could just grab a cup of coffee from Café Lutece

assumed.name: Escoffier
assumed.quote: Hmph, let's not be too quick to blame everything on the lumiline.

assumed.name: Savanna

assumed.name: Monica
assumed.quote: But that was mostly Monica's fault, wasn't it?

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: Haha! Sounds like we won't need another changing of the guard in the Hotel Debord kitchen any time soon.

assumed.name: Gateau Debord

assumed.name: Modeste
assumed.quote: Genius or not, everyone makes mistakes. Modeste did, Savelli did, everyone does.

assumed.name: Savelli

threads.claim: The original Gateau Debord supposedly used a rare secret ingredient that Modeste found on his adventures.
threads.quote: For instance, legend has it that the original Gateau Debord was made using a special secret ingredient that Modeste discovered on one of his adventures.

threads.claim: Escoffier suspects the secret ingredient was lumiline, which was only hyped because sugar was scarce.
threads.quote: Escoffier believes that the secret ingredient in the original Gateau was actually lumiline

threads.claim: Modeste died young in his prime, and the reason is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Then, Modeste passed away while he was still in his prime...

threads.claim: Modeste took his own life after losing his sense of taste, which the secret ingredient caused.
threads.quote: Modeste eventually committed suicide when his sense of taste was lost, which was caused by the secret ingredient.

threads.claim: Modeste and Savelli parted ways shortly after their rise to fame.
