threads.quote: Anyway, never mind centuries — Savelli and Modeste parted ways not even ten years after their rise to fame.

threads.claim: Savelli framed himself as the culprit and erased evidence to protect Modeste's legacy.
threads.quote: he had to frame himself as the culprit, erasing all evidence that could implicate him.

threads.claim: Savanna was once gentle and timid, so her current cruelty is a mystery.
threads.quote: Well... She was a much gentler person back then. A little timid, even...

threads.claim: Savanna realizes she is the problem and breaks down after the cook-off.
threads.quote: Savanna realizes that she's the problem and breaks down, while the rest decide to come back later.

threads.claim: Monica may be secretly trying to bring Escoffier back to deal with Savanna.
threads.quote: Navia believes that Monica wanted Escoffier to return and handle the matter.

threads.claim: Monica is revealed as the true mastermind behind the sabotage and threats.
threads.quote: Their discretion is correct, as Savanna confronts the true mastermind behind the events, Monica.

threads.claim: Lumiline was secretly added to the food at a banquet, and no one knows who did it.
threads.quote: With so many moving parts, there's no way of knowing how that lumiline ended up in the food we served.

threads.claim: Monica laced Firmin's tea with lumiline, confirming she was the saboteur.
threads.quote: it was Monica, who laced his tea with lumiline

threads.claim: Firmin collapsed and feels he does not deserve to be a chef, and the cause is unclear.
threads.quote: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... It's all my fault... I don't deserve to be a chef...

threads.claim: Firmin realizes Monica, not Savanna, drugged him, changing how he sees what happened.
threads.quote: After reading the threat letter, he realized that it was not Savanna who had hurt him

threads.claim: Escoffier thinks the Codex may hide something that explains Savanna's obsession with it.
threads.quote: Something I hadn't noticed before, that might explain why Savanna's so desperate to get her hands on it

threads.claim: Escoffier finds nothing hidden in the original Codex, so the mystery deepens.
threads.quote: But I can't find anything.

threads.claim: A map with circled spots suggests someone has gathered Modeste and Savelli's travel locations.
threads.quote: they found a map with circled spots on it.

threads.claim: The circled spots match Modeste and Savelli's travels, but how the full map was obtained is unknown.
threads.quote: Escoffier realizes that these were the spots that Modeste and Savelli had traveled, but wonders how the full map was acquired

threads.claim: The ruins are a Remurian site, hinting at an ancient civilization tied to the secret ingredient.
threads.quote: Escoffier recognizes it as a public Remurian bathhouse where food and drinks were served.

threads.claim: The Remurian relic jar is a historical treasure that was ruined when Monica smashed it.
threads.quote: the Remurian relic would have been infinitely more valuable had it not been smashed to pieces.

threads.claim: Escoffier was punished for the food incident and lost her head chef role to Savanna.
threads.quote: was sentenced to the Fortress of Meropide for a short duration.

threads.claim: Escoffier left the Debord because of the food safety incident and because the restaurant could no longer support her.
threads.quote: Escoffier explains she left the Debord for two reasons; the food safety incident, and realizing that the restaurant could no longer support her.

threads.claim: Modeste's sudden death is presented as an acute illness, leaving its true cause unexplained.
threads.quote: Everything came to an abrupt end when Modeste, still in the prime of his life and still hailed as a genius, suddenly died from an acute illness.

threads.claim: Savelli reveals that Modeste took his own life after the Treasure of Remuria left him unable to taste.
threads.quote: Finally, in despair, he took his own life.

threads.claim: A rumor holds that Savelli killed Modeste out of jealousy, though no basis for it is confirmed.
threads.quote: One rumor had it that Savelli actually killed Modeste out of jealousy, even as the latter was hoping to make amends...

threads.claim: Savelli admits he destroyed Modeste's records to protect his name, accepting that he may be suspected of his death.
threads.quote: It may lead his family to suspect me of having a hand in his demise, but if that's the price of destroying all evidence of my crimes... Then, so be it.

threads.claim: Contemporary records never mention the Treasure of Remuria, which suggests someone erased it from history.
threads.quote: Also, neither the Codex nor any other contemporary records make any mention of the Treasure of Remuria. It's almost as if... someone deliberately erased it from history.

threads.claim: The jar of Treasure in the ruins is empty because Savelli destroyed the last of it to prevent future harm.
threads.quote: So he came here after his friend's death, and destroyed every last shred that remained!

threads.claim: A letter claims Escoffier deliberately hid the secret recipe, planting suspicion that the Codex is incomplete.
threads.quote: She was the one who concealed the secret recipe in the first place!

threads.claim: The Codex turns out to contain no secret recipes, disproving Savanna's suspicion that Escoffier hid them.
threads.quote: That's... that's it? No secrets, no nothing?

threads.claim: Monica's family has kept fragments of Modeste's diary for generations, hinting at her lineage and motives.
threads.quote: Some fragments of his diary escaped your clutches, and we have held onto them for generations!

threads.claim: Escoffier had personal reasons for leaving the Hotel Debord beyond the lumiline incident, left unexplained.
threads.quote: I had my own reasons for leaving the Hotel Debord, this wasn't the only factor.

threads.claim: Savanna says Monica blackmailed her with the lumiline incident, complicating who was responsible.
threads.quote: That's because you threatened to expose me for the lumiline incident!

threads.claim: Firmin's illness is traced to lumiline secretly mixed into the tea Monica gave him every night.
threads.quote: And as it turns out... She was lacing it with lumiline the whole time.

threads.claim: Firmin may not have been Monica's only victim, hinting at further poisonings.
threads.quote: We believe that... Firmin was likely not Monica's only victim.

threads.claim: Lumiline is blamed for amplifying taste, and its true origin as a Remurian treasure is left open until later.
threads.quote: That stuff can only amplify what's already there.

threads.claim: The Treasure of Remuria is revealed to be a lumiline substance from Lumitoiles that is now nearly worthless.
threads.quote: The so-called Treasure of Remuria was most likely a substance that the Remurians extracted from Lumitoiles... better known to us as lumiline.

threads.claim: Savelli destroyed the Treasure of Remuria, so little of it survives.
threads.quote: Even if Savelli hadn't destroyed it all, I doubt it'd be worth that much these days.

threads.claim: Monica tampered with the kitchen ovens to sabotage the cooking contest.
threads.quote: But by this point, it's pretty obvious that Monica must have tampered with them.

threads.claim: Monica's lifelong pursuit of the treasure ends in futility.
threads.quote: Her life's work became a grand exercise in futility.

threads.claim: The jar that once held the Treasure of Remuria has been broken, leaving its value in doubt.
threads.quote: Wait... Isn't that the jar they used to hold the Treasure!?

threads.claim: Escoffier is leaving Hotel Debord to explore new flavors with an unnamed chef from Liyue.
threads.quote: A while back, I got to know a fellow chef from Liyue, and in her, I saw so many new possibilities...

threads.claim: Modeste and Savelli had an adventurous spirit in their youth that a new chef is said to share.
threads.quote: She has that same adventurous spirit that Modeste and Savelli had in their youth.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: Mondstadt librarian who seems bored with her job but becomes lively when she spots the Traveler
introduced.quote: The Traveler and Paimon pay a visit to the Mondstadt Library and find Lisa, who appears to be slightly bored with her job.

introduced.name: Donna
introduced.how: flower shop worker who had borrowed a library book that has now gone missing
introduced.quote: Lisa learns from Donna that the book she had borrowed is missing and has possibly been stolen.

introduced.name: Sara
introduced.how: waitress at Good Hunter who also borrowed a library book and forgot to return it
introduced.quote: Sara: Welcome to Good Hunter. Table for two?

introduced.name: Good Hunter
introduced.how: restaurant run by Sara, known for its Steak signature dish
introduced.quote: Sara: Welcome to Good Hunter. Table for two?

introduced.name: Marjorie
introduced.how: shopkeeper selling souvenirs and relics, who carries an overdue library book everywhere
introduced.quote: Marjorie: Haha... Well, if it's a souvenir you're after, you're in the right place. I'm sure you'll find something that strikes your fancy, Lisa.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: adventurers known for exploring underground ruins and retrieving relics
introduced.quote: Lisa: It's not unlike them, in the sense that they are known for darting around amongst underground ruins.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: group Lisa suspects the book thief belongs to, tied to hidden ruins and seals
introduced.quote: The trio eventually arrive at the ruins the book thief is apparently living in, which leads Lisa to deduce that the book thief is part of the Abyss Order.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage
introduced.how: magic users who build seals and hidden strongholds in ruins
introduced.quote: Investigating further, they find a Cryo Abyss Mage named Emery who is surprised by their presence.

introduced.name: Emery
introduced.how: Cryo Abyss Mage who hides in the ruins and claims the book holds a secret
introduced.quote: Investigating further, they find a Cryo Abyss Mage named Emery who is surprised by their presence.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage Stronghold
introduced.how: well-hidden underground ruin where the Abyss Mages live and keep the stolen book
introduced.quote: Abyss Mage: How did you find this place!? It's... so well hidden!

introduced.name: Teyvat Travel Guide
introduced.how: serial travel guide that is not part of the library's formal collection; Lisa gives copies as rewards
introduced.quote: Lisa: Hehe... The is a serial publication. It is not part of the library's formal collection.

introduced.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies
introduced.how: storybook that the stolen book turns out to be, apparently an ordinary copy
introduced.quote: The Traveler then discovers the book, which appears to be an entirely normal copy of the storybook The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies.

introduced.name: The Boar Princess
introduced.how: library book Sara borrowed and forgot to return
introduced.quote: Lisa: No thank you, we're quite satisfied. But I'm afraid I must ask you about "The Boar Princess"—

introduced.name: Northern Border Wind Investigation
introduced.how: a set of three lost scrolls; Lisa is surprised to find one at the shop
introduced.quote: Lisa: My goodness... This is one of the three lost scrolls that make up the "Northern Border Wind Investigation"... What is it doing here!?

introduced.name: elemental markers on library books
introduced.how: every library copy has a unique elemental marker that lets it be traced if stolen
introduced.quote: As there are elemental markers on every library copy to prevent them from going missing, Lisa, Paimon, and the Traveler are able to follow the trail the book thief has left.

introduced.name: elemental seals
introduced.how: magic seals guarding ruin entrances, made by Abyss Mage magic and breakable with strong lightning
introduced.quote: Lisa: Also... There is an elemental seal at the entrance. It looks like the result of an Abyss Mage's magic.

introduced.name: stolen library book
introduced.how: Donna's borrowed book vanished from her bedside table, likely stolen
introduced.quote: Donna: It's like somebody stole it... It should have been there, on my bedside table. Right where I left it.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Lisa: I mean, other than Jean, who really works that earnestly anyways?

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Lisa: I suppose it's not completely useless... I'll let Razor borrow it when it's time for his enhancement training.

assumed.name: Vennessa
assumed.quote: Marjorie: Oh, so you're a fan of the gallant Lady Vennessa too? Why didn't you say so?

assumed.name: The Legend of Vennessa
assumed.quote: Lisa: Goodness, is that the time? Marjorie, one last thing — about "The Legend of Vennessa"—

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Lisa: Stealing books is hardly the hilichurls' style.

assumed.name: Cryo
assumed.quote: Lisa: Huh? These flowers are saturated with Cryo energy. They could be very dangerous for me.

assumed.name: Electro
assumed.quote: Donna: It's just that Lisa seems to use Electro quite a lot. Things could get a little bit dangerous...

assumed.name: Witch of Purple Rose
assumed.quote: Lisa: I can see you put a lot of thought into this, have you ever heard of the Witch of Purple Rose before?

threads.claim: The book thief belongs to the Abyss Order, a group whose larger aims are left unexplained.
threads.quote: The trio eventually arrive at the ruins the book thief is apparently living in, which leads Lisa to deduce that the book thief is part of the Abyss Order.

threads.claim: The Abyss Mage claims the book contains a secret that the Abyss Order wants, hinting at a hidden meaning.
threads.quote: Abyss Mage: After all, it contains... the secret...

threads.claim: The book looks like an ordinary storybook, so the secret it supposedly holds remains a mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah... It seems like just an average storybook.

threads.claim: One of three lost scrolls from the Northern Border Wind Investigation has resurfaced, raising the question of how it got there.
threads.quote: Lisa: My goodness... This is one of the three lost scrolls that make up the "Northern Border Wind Investigation"... What is it doing here!?

threads.claim: The Witch of Purple Rose is mentioned as a legend that is never explained.
threads.quote: Lisa: I can see you put a lot of thought into this, have you ever heard of the Witch of Purple Rose before?

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: Dragon King who raised the three moons, from whom the Moon Goddesses were born
introduced.quote: It was the Dragon King Nibelung who raised the three moons into the heavens, and thus were the Moon Goddesses born.

introduced.name: Moon Goddesses
introduced.how: Shadows of the planet born to wield Nibelung's authority and oversee the world for him
introduced.quote: They were shadows of the planet, born to wield Nibelung's authority and oversee the world on his behalf.

introduced.name: Rächer of Solnari
introduced.how: Former fighter revived by Dottore from collected body fragments; he is Rerir, a former Khaenri'ah figure
introduced.quote: He'd been collecting fragments of my body for a long time. All so that he could resurrect me at the moment of his choosing.

introduced.name: Tholindis
introduced.how: Former Khaenri'ah researcher at the Universitas Magistrorum who tried to use the reversed-time space to change the past
introduced.quote: I'm... I used to be a researcher at the Universitas Magistrorum in Khaenri'ah, researching the Iridescent Moon's Marrow.

introduced.name: Sonnet
introduced.how: Introduces herself as one of the Three Moons, the Iridescent Moon goddess with a power similar to Canon's
introduced.quote: Call me Sonnet. Hmm... You have the same power as Canon...

introduced.name: Aria
introduced.how: Introduced as the goddess of the Eternal Moon, one of the three sisters imprisoned in the moon's reflection
introduced.quote: This is Aria, the goddess of the Eternal Moon.

introduced.name: Canon
introduced.how: Introduced as the goddess of the Frost Moon, one of the three sisters imprisoned in the moon's reflection
introduced.quote: And this is Canon, goddess of the Frost Moon. Canon, don't you think Hyposelenia's power is similar to yours?

introduced.name: Wanderer
introduced.how: Revealed to be a Khaenri'ah-made puppet whose core drives him
introduced.quote: Khaenri'ahn, to be precise. I'm what they would have called a puppet.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: The Wanderer's core is built from silver-white wood, making it a small piece of Irminsul
introduced.quote: It was built using wood from a silver-white tree, which makes it a small part of Irminsul.

introduced.name: golden energy
introduced.how: Golden energy in the reversed-time space that is believed to carry travelers forward faster
introduced.quote: Based on my past research and my observations since coming here, I believe they carry you forward faster.

introduced.name: world-formula
introduced.how: Sandrone's formula to connect to Columbina, which handles about 90% of the work to bring her back
introduced.quote: Sandrone's formula would handle establishing a connection to Columbina, approximately 90% of the work.

introduced.name: Aether & Lumine's Spaceship
introduced.how: The Traveler's ship, revealed to have been placed on the Frost Moon by the Heavenly Principles
introduced.quote: she reveals that it was placed on the Frost Moon by the Heavenly Principles, either because something was incompatible with Teyvat

introduced.name: Canon
introduced.how: one of the three moon sisters, a moon goddess who lived peacefully with the Dragon King's people before he changed
introduced.quote: Canon: We co-existed in peace. They were like a guest in our home.

introduced.name: Aria
introduced.how: one of the three moon sisters, a moon goddess who saw the Dragon King's growing desire to dominate the world
introduced.quote: Aria: Slowly, however, we came to realize that our guest had a growing desire to change and dominate the world.

introduced.name: Sonnet
introduced.how: one of the three moon sisters, a moon goddess who was against the Dragon King's rules from the outset
introduced.quote: Sonnet: So death finally came for us in the end...

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: the Dragon King, the original master of the world, who returned and was later destroyed in the war
introduced.quote: Aria: But just when we had decided to take countermeasures, the Dragon King, Nibelung returned.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the group that won the war of funerary flame and still rules Teyvat
introduced.quote: Columbina: As far as I know, the Heavenly Principles won, although it came at a great cost. They remained in Teyvat, where they continue to rule to this day...

introduced.name: War of funerary flame
introduced.how: a great war, fought after Nibelung returned, which the Heavenly Principles won at great cost
introduced.quote: Columbina: And so began the war of funerary flame...

introduced.name: Celestial Nail
introduced.how: a manifestation of the Heavenly Principles' power, cast down to punish the civilizations below
introduced.quote: Canon: They would even cast down celestial nails as manifestations of their power, to punish the civilizations of the world below.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a unique elemental energy found in Nod-Krai that can make small changes to reality
introduced.quote: Columbina: You don't know? It's... a unique kind of elemental energy found only in Nod-Krai, the land from which the moons arose.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: the land from which the moons first rose, where kuuvahki is found
introduced.quote: Columbina: (So this is why Nod-Krai was not always home to kuuvahki...)

introduced.name: Frost Moon
introduced.how: the only moon still remaining, cast beyond the false firmament by the Heavenly Principles
introduced.quote: Columbina: ...Only the Frost Moon remains. But it has been cast beyond the false firmament by the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: Eternal and Iridescent Moons
introduced.how: two moons that were shattered during the war of funerary flame
introduced.quote: Columbina: The Eternal and Iridescent Moons were both shattered during the war...

introduced.name: Trilune authority
introduced.how: the combined power of the three moons, which is not mutually compatible and is painful to concentrate into one goddess
introduced.quote: Canon: The three moons' powers are not mutually compatible. Concentrating them into one goddess will be a very painful process...

introduced.name: Trilune Goddess
introduced.how: the title given to Columbina as the one and only moon goddess after the sisters transfer their authority
introduced.quote: Canon: From this moment on, she is the Trilune Goddess, the one and only moon goddess of this world.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: a soul fragment Columbina left in the future that serves as an anchor to pull her soul back
introduced.quote: Columbina: When the time comes, I believe that she can serve as an anchor to pull my soul from here back to the future reality...

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: Nefer's organization, which Jahoda is promised to run if Nefer loses her sight
introduced.quote: Nefer: We spoke about this once, a long time ago. Do you remember what I said, Jahoda? The day I lose my sight, the Curatorium of Secrets will be yours to run.

introduced.name: Dodocommunication Device
introduced.how: a device used to communicate over distance, operated through an information channel
introduced.quote: Marionette: I'll share the data with you. Nicole's agreed to let me use her information channel, so we just need to use the Dodocommunication Device like so, and...

introduced.name: Moon Sisters' prison
introduced.how: a realm Nibelung built to stop the moon goddesses from interfering in his war, which traps divinity but not bodies
introduced.quote: Aria: Nibelung constructed this realm specifically to prevent us from using our powers to interfere in his war.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Sandrone's creator, seen in a flashback with her
introduced.quote: (A flashback to Sandrone's time with her creator begins)

introduced.name: world-formula
introduced.how: Sandrone's formula that can get the group 90 percent of the way to connecting with Columbina
introduced.quote: Sandrone: My formula can get us 90% of the way

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Columbina's kindly friends in the future, descended from people the moon sisters tried to save
introduced.quote: Canon: You cannot imagine how happy I am to hear of the future world you describe... the Frostmoon Scions, your lovely, kindly friends...

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: a robot built by Aino who helped Maika's family escape Nod-Krai and get home
introduced.quote: She helped us get safely out of Nod-Krai, and she helped us get back home, too. She's the best!

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: chosen as a young Moonchanter who brings messages from the Frostmoon Scions' goddess
introduced.quote: She was so young when they chose her to be the Moonchanter... From then on, the Frostmoon Scions looked to her to bring messages from their goddess.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the power that hid the spaceship on the Frost Moon
introduced.quote: the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.name: Frost Moon
introduced.how: a moon beyond the sky where the spaceship was hidden
introduced.quote: Yes. Your spaceship. All this time, it has been hidden on the Frost Moon, which lay beyond the sky.

introduced.name: Kresnik's Torch
introduced.how: a wondrous heat source around which every Snezhnaya city is built
introduced.quote: Every city in Snezhnaya is built around one of those.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a land that is home to a wondrous heat source and railway trains
introduced.quote: In fact, it is home to quite a wondrous heat source... I think they call it

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a group whose members such as Regrator, The Rooster and The Jester control much of Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: Between them, they control a lot of what happens in Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Korolevskiy Troupe
introduced.how: a performance troupe in Snezhnograd that gives regular shows
introduced.quote: I also recommend the Korolevskiy Troupe in Snezhnograd. They give performances quite regularly, and entry was free for Harbingers... I liked them a lot.

introduced.name: League
introduced.how: a Nod-Krai alliance uniting formerly competing groups to solve the disaster together
introduced.quote: I'm surprised that all these competing groups are actually coming together to try and solve things together. Definitely a first for Nod-Krai.

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: a formula-maker who hid the real formula in Pulonia's body and gave her life in the battle
introduced.quote: Sandrone's the one who completed a seemingly impossible formula and turned the tide of the entire battle... even giving her life in the process.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a mage who has lived in Teyvat since the time of the Three Moon Sisters
introduced.quote: I only recently learned that she has lived in Teyvat since the time of the Three Moon Sisters.

introduced.name: Traveler's spaceship flight
introduced.how: the ship flew over Teyvat once long ago before drifting through space and crash-landing in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: But the logs show that our spaceship flew over the skies of Teyvat once before. A long, long time ago.

introduced.name: Foreign talents
introduced.how: Columbina lifted world restrictions on the Traveler's elements, unlocking new talents
introduced.quote: I lifted some of the restrictions this world placed on you. I trust this will help in your future adventures?

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Columbina: Do you mean... Dottore?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: You think we, the Fatui, were worried about you!?

assumed.name: Dainsleif
assumed.quote: And then, in the final moment before I was thrown into this space, I got to see an old friend...

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: So that's why the Wild Hunt suddenly became so active in Nod-Krai.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Things aren't looking good for Nod-Krai.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: You know that Dori went back to Sumeru, right?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: There are even moments where I can sense something that feels like Abyssal energy...

assumed.name: kuuvahki
assumed.quote: It must be partly because of this new body, and partly because of all the kuuvahki I absorbed in Nod-Krai.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: I'll get to that. First, tell me — what do you think of Sandrone?

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sandrone! How are things going?

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Traveler: Dottore!

assumed.name: Rächer of Solnari
assumed.quote: Nefer: This is the Columbina who fought alongside us against the Rächer of Solnari, and with whom we celebrated Moon-Prayer Night.

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: Nefer: This is the Columbina who fought alongside us against the Rächer of Solnari, and with whom we celebrated Moon-Prayer Night.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Flins: Truly astounding, Miss Nefer. Your eyes have glimpsed the very ends of the world, and yet they remain as sharp as ever.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Varka: Albedo's theory says that elemental energy can dilute the Light Realm's power...

assumed.name: Light Realm
assumed.quote: Varka: Albedo's theory says that elemental energy can dilute the Light Realm's power...

assumed.name: Hexenzirkel
assumed.quote: Nicole: You were the very picture of confidence back when you approached the Hexenzirkel.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Marionette: That might sound harsh to you, but close supervision is a common practice in the Fatui.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Columbina: (I wish I could tell her not to give in to the Abyss, not to be afraid... But is this really what I should say at this moment?)

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Or is it... about what Dottore said to you?

assumed.name: Luonnotar
assumed.quote: Luonnotar disappeared after Columbina came back.

assumed.name: Hat Guy
assumed.quote: You're here too, Hat Guy? Are you heading back together?

assumed.name: Grand Master
assumed.quote: I'm sure you must be missing Mondstadt after all these years away, Grand Master.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
assumed.quote: Heh, try telling Boss Nef that.

assumed.name: Starshyna Nikita
assumed.quote: That is precisely why Starshyna Nikita felt safe delegating such important work to you.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: They're quite similar to the protective talisman that Alice gave Dori, but with some very special enhancements!

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: We found ourselves allied in this instance with both The Knave and Marionette (may she rest in peace).

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: Also... I saw your sibling's story.

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali is gonna need help dealing with all the chaos Dottore left in his wake.

assumed.name: Columbina's missing prologue
assumed.quote: Do you remember me telling you about my missing prologue back when we'd just met?

assumed.name: Palestar Edict
assumed.quote: the Tsaritsa has revoked the Palestar Edict.

threads.claim: Columbina travels along a path through time flowing in reverse, and the question of where that path ends is left open.
threads.quote: It sounds like she's on a specific path through time, just traveling in the opposite direction to us.

threads.claim: The endpoint of Columbina's reversed-time road depends on where that reversed river of time began, which is still unknown.
threads.quote: But where Miss Columbina will end up along this road... That depends on where this particular river of reversed time began.

threads.claim: The Moon Goddesses vanished suddenly after being created, and nobody knew where they went.
threads.quote: But then one day, they disappeared just as suddenly as they had once been brought into being. Nobody knew where they had gone.

threads.claim: The Moon Goddesses likely perished in the war of funerary flame, and a new Moon Goddess was later born from the Frost Moon.
threads.quote: The moons themselves were also destroyed at that time — save for the Frost Moon, from which a new Moon Goddess was later born.

threads.claim: The two generations of Moon Goddesses seem to have different birthplaces, and the reason is unexplained.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Why do their birthplaces differ? What's the difference between the two generations of Moon Goddesses?)

threads.claim: Dainsleif and Rerir were once friends, and Dainsleif's betrayal and remorse hint at a shared past that is still unexplained.
threads.quote: He said that you betrayed him. But he also felt great remorse at never having understood what you were truly going through.

threads.claim: Dottore secretly collected Rerir's remains and planned his resurrection for a moment of his choosing.
threads.quote: He'd been collecting fragments of my body for a long time. All so that he could resurrect me at the moment of his choosing.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles and the first Descender are hinted at as part of the moon goddesses' history, with their role still unexplained.
threads.quote: Day and night, we fulfilled our duty in the heavens... until the day that the first Descender arrived...

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles placed the Traveler's spaceship on the Frost Moon for reasons that remain unknown.
threads.quote: she reveals that it was placed on the Frost Moon by the Heavenly Principles, either because something was incompatible with Teyvat

threads.claim: Abyssal power was already present in the reversed-time space before Rerir entered, suggesting an external source.
threads.quote: But there was already a degree of Abyssal power here, before I entered. And like a venomous snake baking in the merciless sun, it tried to slither into my shadow.

threads.claim: Golden energy in the reversed-time space may carry travelers forward faster, a property not yet explained.
threads.quote: Based on my past research and my observations since coming here, I believe they carry you forward faster.

threads.claim: Sandrone secretly placed the real formula in Pulonia and a false one in herself, fooling Dottore at the cost of her life.
threads.quote: They iterate that Sandrone had fooled Dottore by placing the real formula in Pulonia and a false one in herself, even though it meant her death.

threads.claim: The moons may not be what they seem, since the Moon Marrows and the moons may be different things.
threads.quote: Marionette: ...Why? It says three moons still exist in Teyvat, even after excluding the Moon Marrows... But we know for a fact that two of them are dead!

threads.claim: The question of how dead moons could still live is raised, with Luonnotar's role left unexplained.
threads.quote: Nefer: How can the dead moons still live? And Luonnotar... hmm...

threads.claim: The moon's reflection may be the prison where Nibelung trapped the Three Moon Sisters.
threads.quote: Nefer: So, you think that the moon's reflection might be where Nibelung imprisoned the Three Moon Sisters?

threads.claim: Columbina may have found a way to return, which depends on help from her sisters and the future.
threads.quote: Columbina: (...I think I might know how to get back. But... I will need my sisters' help.)

threads.claim: Columbina returns to life in front of the Frost Moon and rejoins her friends.
threads.quote: Columbina: It's been too long. I'm back

threads.claim: Kuuvahki did not exist in the world before the sisters were imprisoned, which is a puzzle.
threads.quote: Canon: How curious... This kuuvahki certainly did not exist anywhere in the world before we were imprisoned.

threads.claim: Kuuvahki appears in Nod-Krai because Columbina's body was poured out there and it answers her soul.
threads.quote: Columbina: (Kuuvahki responds to me, because... it is me. My body, answering the call of my soul...)

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles won the war and still rule Teyvat, leaving their power unresolved.
threads.quote: Columbina: As far as I know, the Heavenly Principles won, although it came at a great cost. They remained in Teyvat, where they continue to rule to this day...

threads.claim: The false sky is broken and the Frost Moon completes its descent into Teyvat.
threads.quote: (After a brief moment, however, the false sky shatters as the Frost Moon completes its descent)

threads.claim: Sandrone's past with her creator hints at a desire she has always known the shape of, but not the goal.
threads.quote: Sandrone: But I've always known... what I don't want!

threads.claim: The Frost Moon has entered the false sky and Columbina now calls herself the Trilune Goddess.
threads.quote: The Frost Moon has now entered the false sky, and I am the Trilune Goddess.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles hid the spaceship on the Frost Moon, and their motive is still unknown.
threads.quote: Perhaps your ship contains something that is incompatible with Teyvat.

threads.claim: The Traveler's spaceship visited Teyvat long before the Traveler, and someone may have left it earlier than the Traveler did.
threads.quote: (Could this mean that left the ship long before I did? Maybe even... during our first pass over Teyvat?)

threads.claim: The Traveler's sibling watched the Traveler from afar with guilt in their eyes.
threads.quote: But... I did notice that back when you first set out on your journey, would often appear nearby, gazing at you from afar with a guilty look in eyes.

threads.claim: Dottore is dead.
threads.quote: What, now that Dottore's dead and gone?

threads.claim: Sandrone died in battle, and her core and Pulonia's are to be delivered to the Fontaine Research Institute as she requested.
threads.quote: Sandrone's passing has left a great wound in all of our hearts.

threads.claim: Sandrone hid the real formula as a backup plan, and the Traveler wonders whether her last wish is one too.
threads.quote: Is it also some kind of

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's true intentions remain unknown and her power is unfathomable.
threads.quote: But until we can ascertain the Tsaritsa's true intentions, the future remains uncertain.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa revoked the Palestar Edict because Columbina's arrest warrant was Dottore's ploy.
threads.quote: the Tsaritsa has revoked the Palestar Edict.

threads.claim: The Rooster and Regrator appear friendly but secretly work against each other.
threads.quote: And theirs is not a friendly rivalry.

threads.claim: The term Mistilteinn keeps coming up in connection with Project Stuzha.
threads.quote: often seemed to come up in connection with Project Stuzha

threads.claim: Nicole warns that the embers of chaos must not be rekindled.
threads.quote: We have to remain vigilant and ensure that the embers of chaos are not rekindled.

threads.claim: Nicole hints that the substance from which Angels were formed is an important part of the story.
threads.quote: Of course, to give you the full picture, I'd have to start with the substance from which Angels were formed...

threads.claim: The disaster has made Teyvat easier to detect from the outside universe.
threads.quote: The disruption caused by this disaster has made Teyvat easier to detect from the outside universe.

threads.claim: Columbina's missing prologue was hidden in the future, and she found it through the moon.
threads.quote: I realized that my prologue was really hidden in the future.

threads.claim: The world had placed restrictions on the Traveler's elemental power, and Columbina lifted some of them.
threads.quote: I lifted some of the restrictions this world placed on you.

threads.claim: Columbina chose Nod-Krai as her home, and home is shaped by the friends who make it.
threads.quote: I realized that it was I who chose Nod-Krai to be my future home.

threads.claim: Columbina believes stories have no endings, so the journey continues.
threads.quote: I don't believe in endings.

threads.claim: The League unites Nod-Krai's rival groups, and its success is still uncertain.
threads.quote: I'm surprised that all these competing groups are actually coming together to try and solve things together. Definitely a first for Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: Nicole has lived in Teyvat since the time of the Three Moon Sisters.
threads.quote: I only recently learned that she has lived in Teyvat since the time of the Three Moon Sisters.

introduced.name: Klee
introduced.how: a small girl who introduces herself and is a Knight of Favonius
introduced.quote: My name is Klee.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: the Traveler's title as a helper of Mondstadt, recognized by Klee
introduced.quote: You're the Honorary Knight who helps Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: a hostile force in Mondstadt that has been unusually active
introduced.quote: In fact, the Abyss Order is a hostile force in Mondstadt which has been unusually active lately.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage
introduced.how: enemies of the Abyss Order who are the bad guys and hostile to humanity
introduced.quote: Abyss Mages are the bad guys.

introduced.name: Spark Knight
introduced.how: the title Klee holds within the Knights of Favonius
introduced.quote: she holds the title of Spark Knight within our ranks.

introduced.name: Ludi Harpastum
introduced.how: an upcoming celebration that Klee is allowed to attend
introduced.quote: I will allow you to take part in the next Ludi Harpastum.

introduced.name: Survival rules
introduced.how: a parchment of rules Klee must never break, written for her by Kaeya
introduced.quote: Rules that I must absolutely never break under any circumstances.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius Headquarters
introduced.how: the Knights' headquarters where Jean is and where Klee turns herself in
introduced.quote: Go back to the Knights' headquarters and report to Jean

introduced.name: Stanley
introduced.how: named by Jack as the finest adventurer in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: In my opinion, that would be the finest adventurer of them all — Stanley.

introduced.name: Darknight Hero
introduced.how: a popular candidate for strongest fighter who once rescued a citizen from the Abyss Order
introduced.quote: Apparently, he once rescued a city dweller from the Abyss Order.

introduced.name: Stormbearer Mountains girl incident
introduced.how: a little girl in red reportedly caused massive destruction in the Stormbearer Mountains
introduced.quote: I witnessed the most powerful destructive force I have ever seen in my life!

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: The Traveler and Paimon return to Diluc's tavern, Angel's Share

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: That would be Jean, obviously!

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: I heard it from Amber...

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Ah, well, Razor and Albedo seem really busy recently.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Mr. Kaeya wrote these down for me, um... they're, um... survival rules.

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: Guild Master Cyrus is up there with the toughest, too

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: she can take out a Ruin Guard with just a few slashes of her sword.

assumed.name: Dadaupa Gorge
assumed.quote: wipe out the three hilichurl tribes at Dadaupa Gorge

assumed.name: Starfell Lake
assumed.quote: Were you trying to blow up the fish in Starfell Lake again?

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: Must be someone who can floor a whole gang of hilichurls with just one punch!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I've heard that the Adventurers' Guild has its own set of rules.

assumed.name: Dandelion Knight
assumed.quote: One is the Dandelion Knight

threads.claim: A rumor says the little girl in red has a secret treasure nobody else knows about.
threads.quote: I think she has a treasure nobody else knows about.

threads.claim: Klee's treasure is revealed to be a bomb that destroys the Abyss Mage who touches it.
threads.quote: Wait, so Klee's treasure is a bomb!?

threads.claim: Klee plans another bomb disguised as a Ludi Harpastum, so the treasure keeps being a bomb.
threads.quote: I'm making an extra-special new treasure... the Ludi Harpastum version!

threads.claim: Mondstadt's residents are debating who is the strongest fighter, with no consensus.
threads.quote: Recently, all the customers at the tavern have been debating the exact same topic

threads.claim: The Knights have no official ranking table, so the strongest fighter question stays unanswered.
threads.quote: Paimon. There is no ranking table.

threads.claim: Klee is rumored to be the strongest fighter in Mondstadt, tying the debate to her treasure.
threads.quote: No wonder Klee was rumored to be the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.

threads.claim: An Abyss Order mage is secretly active near Mondstadt, and the Knights are wary.
threads.quote: Recently, one of the Abyss Order's Mages has been active near the city

threads.claim: Jean admits the Knights do not yet know why the Abyss Order has been so active.
threads.quote: We must investigate further to find out why the Abyss Order has been so active lately.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order is said to hate all people, with humanity itself as its enemy.
threads.quote: Their enemy is... humanity itself.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order learned of Klee's powerful treasure through gossip and came to take it.
threads.quote: We learned that your little red friend had in her possession the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Klee has a background Jean withholds, hinting at a deeper story to come.
threads.quote: In short, you will understand her more as time goes by.

threads.claim: Kaeya wrote Klee's survival rules, hinting at a link between Kaeya and Klee.
threads.quote: Mr. Kaeya wrote these down for me, um... they're, um... survival rules.

introduced.name: Kaveh
introduced.how: introduces himself as the Akademiya scholar leading the Aaru project
introduced.quote: Good afternoon, I'm Kaveh, and these two are Termezi and Naysaburi.

introduced.name: Termezi
introduced.how: a scholar on the Aaru project, from Vahumana
introduced.quote: Good afternoon, I'm Kaveh, and these two are Termezi and Naysaburi.

introduced.name: Naysaburi
introduced.how: a scholar on the Aaru project
introduced.quote: Good afternoon, I'm Kaveh, and these two are Termezi and Naysaburi.

introduced.name: Thoth
introduced.how: Alhaitham identifies him as the Ibis King, one of the Seven Pillars
introduced.quote: This is Thoth, the Ibis King, and everyone knows these two.

introduced.name: Sobek
introduced.how: named as the Crocodile King, a former rival who became a minister
introduced.quote: Paimon: Whoa! It's Sobek the Crocodile King!

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: introduced as the successor to the Temple of Silence and an heir to Bamoun
introduced.quote: Nefer: You must be Sethos, the successor to the Temple of Silence. Hello.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: a former Vahumana student who left the Akademiya and became an intel broker in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: She's a former Vahumana student who dropped out of the Akademiya and went to Nod-Krai to work as an intel broker.

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: a scholarly school whose students value veracity
introduced.quote: I'm from Vahumana. It's, well... veracity.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: an ancient structure that was the original inspiration for the Akasha system and stores souls
introduced.quote: If the manual is to be believed, Aaru was in fact the original inspiration for the Akasha system.

introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.how: an Akademiya knowledge system created by the Dendro Archon to give people access to knowledge
introduced.quote: Created years ago by the Dendro Archon to help her people access knowledge

introduced.name: Nabu Malikata
introduced.how: the Goddess of Flowers who brought life, oases and knowledge to Sumeru and was burned for seeking Celestia's secrets
introduced.quote: In the beginning, Nabu Malikata, the Goddess of Flowers, descended upon Sumeru.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: a floating island in the sky whose technology inspired Aaru
introduced.quote: she pried into the secrets of Celestia, and for this was burned to ashes by the flames of wrath.

introduced.name: first and greatest alliance
introduced.how: a covenant between three gods that promised wisdom would be shared with all
introduced.quote: It was the first and greatest alliance.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: a king whose grand plans for Aaru were cut short by his death
introduced.quote: King Deshret had grand plans, but he perished before they could come to fruition.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: a god who listed the Dendro Dragon among the Seven Pillars without consulting her
introduced.quote: Al-Ahmar was always a wishful thinker where the Dendro Dragon was concerned

introduced.name: Seven Pillars
introduced.how: former rivals of King Deshret who submitted and served as his ministers
introduced.quote: Ibis, Goatie and I were no match for him, and so we chose to submit and serve as his ministers.

introduced.name: Apep
introduced.how: the Dendro Dragon, a god of life who hates the Seven Pillars and Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: Well, I'll be... Is that Apep!?

introduced.name: King Deshret's final act
introduced.how: Deshret tricked the Dendro Dragon into swallowing him whole to end his life
introduced.quote: At the end of his life, King Deshret tricked the Dendro Dragon into swallowing him whole, leaving her to bear the torment of his sins...

introduced.name: Irminsul tree emergence
introduced.how: a massive Irminsul tree rises in Sumeru City, tied to Dottore's experiment
introduced.quote: a massive tree emerges in Sumeru City, revealed to be an Irminsul tree.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: routes through which souls can access Irminsul
introduced.quote: the only security measure she could have had was to block free access to the Ley Lines for all souls

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: non-human forest folk who are terrified of crowds of humans
introduced.quote: The Aranara are terrified at the sight of so many humans as some approach

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: the home of the Aranara, protected by a Vasara Tree
introduced.quote: Araja is a Vasara Tree. Vasara Trees protect Vanarana, so that means Araja is protecting Vanarana.

introduced.name: Pantalone
introduced.how: revealed as the Ninth of the Fatui Harbingers, who works with Dottore
introduced.quote: The man acknowledges the loss and is revealed to be Pantalone, the Ninth of the Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: the organization whose Harbingers include Pantalone
introduced.quote: The man acknowledges the loss and is revealed to be Pantalone, the Ninth of the Fatui Harbingers.

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: the erased former identity of Wanderer
introduced.quote: revealing that he knows Wanderer's erased identity as Scaramouche

introduced.name: Pyro Gnosis
introduced.how: a Pyro power held by Mavuika that Nahida asks to take ownership of
introduced.quote: She asks if they can claim ownership over her Pyro Gnosis, as the situation has become too dire to simply borrow it.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: the Natlan figure whose Pyro Gnosis is handed over, connected to the Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Mauvika arrives on the Natlan side and states the same.

introduced.name: Ronova, Istaroth and Naberius
introduced.how: three Shades who guard Irminsul and ask whether Nahida truly wants to destroy it
introduced.quote: Nahida finds herself with the three Shades: Ronova, Istaroth and Naberius

introduced.name: Qanafiya
introduced.how: Sumeru mercenary suspected of taking a bribe, carrying an unmarked gold coin
introduced.quote: (Approach Qanafiya)

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: Ancient tree refashioned after the Heavenly Principles arrived into a device that records and preserves all information
introduced.quote: After the Heavenly Principles arrived, the power of the Light Realm was divided into elemental energy, and Irminsul was refashioned as a device that records and preserves all information.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Ley Lines are the root system of Irminsul, and souls return to them after death
introduced.quote: Irminsul's root system is what comprises the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Power-granting order that created nearly everything in Teyvat and set rules for Irminsul
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles created almost everything that exists in Teyvat today.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: Al-Ahmar's legacy, the only thing in Sumeru that rivals Irminsul, which scholars are renovating
introduced.quote: The only thing in Sumeru capable of rivaling Irminsul in terms of overall function and performance is Al-Ahmar's legacy — Aaru.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: Devices that give Sumeru citizens access to the Akasha, the most powerful wisdom dissemination system
introduced.quote: The Akademiya declared the Akasha to be the most powerful and comprehensive wisdom dissemination system in history.

introduced.name: Primal Constructs
introduced.how: Constructs in King Deshret's Mausoleum that are dismantled for rare materials needed for terminals
introduced.quote: Right now, the best place to source these locally is from the Primal Constructs within King Deshret's Mausoleum.

introduced.name: Chess Trial
introduced.how: Board-game challenge in Aaru that must be completed before the structure can be overwritten
introduced.quote: Heryshaf: Visitors, everything is ready. Only by completing the challenge on the board in accordance with the rules will you be permitted to overwrite Aaru.

introduced.name: Pyro Gnosis
introduced.how: A god's Gnosis that acts as an Elemental energy enhancer, which Mavuika gives up
introduced.quote: As far as I'm concerned, a Gnosis is basically an Elemental energy enhancer.

introduced.name: Sumeru isolation barrier
introduced.how: Barrier the Heavenly Principles set to cut off Sumeru when Irminsul is in grave danger
introduced.quote: The Heavenly Principles established a rule that when Irminsul is plunged into grave danger, a portion of power will be reserved to isolate Sumeru.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Place where Mavuika's records are kept instead of the Ley Lines, keeping her hidden from Irminsul
introduced.quote: My records will be preserved in the Night Kingdom rather than the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Dendro Archon
introduced.how: Nahida's title, which carries a duty to protect Irminsul
introduced.quote: As the Dendro Archon, I have a duty to protect Irminsul.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: The Pyro Archon, whom Sumeru cannot host with a grand reception due to the isolation
introduced.quote: So regretfully, we won't be able to give the Pyro Archon Mavuika the grand reception that she deserves.

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: Familiar with the layout of King Deshret's Mausoleum and assists the mission
introduced.quote: Mr. Sethos is quite familiar with the layout of King Deshret's Mausoleum.

introduced.name: The Doctor
introduced.how: Enemy who has infiltrated Irminsul and can spy on the world through it
introduced.quote: Irminsul has been infiltrated by The Doctor.

introduced.name: Descender
introduced.how: Traveler's status means Irminsul holds no records of them, so it cannot impede them
introduced.quote: Since is a Descender, Irminsul contains no records of , and thus has no way to impede .

introduced.name: Information hazard
introduced.how: Knowledge of Light Realm energy conversion is classified because just knowing it exposes one to danger
introduced.quote: It's an information hazard — we're exposed to danger just by knowing the facts...

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: A place once thought to be a legend that Nahida plans to visit
introduced.quote: The Eternal Oasis? I thought that was just a legend... so it does exist after all.

introduced.name: Pantalone
introduced.how: Flashback reveals him speaking in an experiment named after blasphemy, honoring Dottore's will
introduced.quote: (A flashback to Pantalone begins)

introduced.name: Elemental energy amplifier
introduced.how: A project Dori is overseeing with the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Following up on the elemental energy amplifier we discussed...

introduced.name: Zandik
introduced.how: the original Dottore whose soul was copied into Segments; the Segments are versions of him
introduced.quote: Zandik is you, and you are Zandik. Zandik created the Segments — yet you, a Segment yourself, reject him.

introduced.name: Segments
introduced.how: copies of Zandik's soul made at different ages, created by freezing time and splitting the soul
introduced.quote: To achieve this, he had to freeze time and part with a portion of his soul.

introduced.name: Satyavada Life
introduced.how: a practice where scholars connect their consciousness to Irminsul through meditation
introduced.quote: In academic language, scholars who reach that stage are said to have entered Satyavada Life.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminals
introduced.how: terminals that share architecture and technology with Aaru
introduced.quote: The architecture and functionality of the Akasha Terminals overlap considerably with Aaru.

introduced.name: Safhe Shatranj
introduced.how: a chessboard in the desert that powers Thoth's chess set and its ceremonies
introduced.quote: Thoth's chess set gains its power from the chessboard laid out in the desert by King Deshret and ourselves.

introduced.name: Seven Pillars
introduced.how: King Deshret's device that can move a whole unit across the material plane using a chessboard
introduced.quote: The power of King Deshret's Seven Pillars is truly remarkable. With just a chessboard, you can move an entire unit across the material plane.

introduced.name: Bennu
introduced.how: a spirit whose image is carved on Candace's shield and who can appear wherever she likes
introduced.quote: Because the image on her shield is one of me, and I, of course, can appear wherever I wish to.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: a network where Dottore's data backup can be stored
introduced.quote: Dottore, I've placed your final data backup into the Ley Lines as per our contract.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: a bank with a secure vault that holds part of Dottore's soul
introduced.quote: The remainder of your soul was split in two, with one half sent to Nod-Krai and the other stored in the most secure vault of the Northland Bank.

introduced.name: Regrator
introduced.how: a Harbinger-linked banker who appears as a decoy and is revealed as Pantalone in disguise
introduced.quote: Exposing my true identity in a situation like this would only serve to destroy diplomatic relations between Snezhnaya and Sumeru.

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: a group Regrator says he joined on his own merits
introduced.quote: I became a Harbinger on my own merits.

introduced.name: Pyro Gnosis
introduced.how: a gnosis that Mavuika gave to the Traveler, which is later extracted and destroyed in Irminsul
introduced.quote: (Mavuika tosses the Pyro Gnosis to the Traveler outside the Sumeru border)

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: the power that Irminsul is said to serve in maintaining fate
introduced.quote: It is the means by which the Heavenly Principles maintains fate itself.

introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.how: the original tree of Teyvat that stores wisdom, supports the Archons, and can be shut down by overloading it
introduced.quote: Irminsul is the original tree of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: a Jinn who was punished for past evil deeds and now seeks to release the Goddess of Flowers' remains
introduced.quote: Even if you have heard the stories about me, all you would know is that I was rightly punished for the many evil deeds I committed.

introduced.name: Jinn
introduced.how: beings who exist because of the Lord of Flowers and revere her
introduced.quote: Yet I am a Jinn. We exist because of the Lord of Flowers. We revere and love her.

introduced.name: Goddess of Flowers
introduced.how: a god whose remains were lodged inside Collei and who is the source of the Jinn
introduced.quote: Long ago, I sensed that the god remains inside Collei had come from the Goddess of Flowers, but I kept it a secret.

introduced.name: Temple of Silence
introduced.how: a sacred site founded by Hermanubis, where displaced gods and servants can stay
introduced.quote: Well, the Temple was founded by Hermanubis, so I guess to them, that's exactly what it is...

introduced.name: Hermanubis
introduced.how: the founder of the Temple of Silence
introduced.quote: Well, the Temple was founded by Hermanubis, so I guess to them, that's exactly what it is...

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: the current leader of the Temple of Silence
introduced.quote: Nahida: Once Sethos, the current leader of the Temple of Silence, returns, you can discuss the matter of staying here with him.

introduced.name: Thoth
introduced.how: an old servant of King Deshret who was locked away for centuries
introduced.quote: See? Retirement has always been a problem, especially for old timers like us who've been locked away all these years.

introduced.name: Heryshaf
introduced.how: another servant of King Deshret who has just returned to the mortal world
introduced.quote: What better place for the servants of King Deshret to appear in the mortal world?

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: an angel who guards all of Teyvat and can transfer divine connections
introduced.quote: Hehe. All of these trivial matters get left to me. It's because I'm an angel, and angels are, in a way, the guardians of all Teyvat.

introduced.name: The Rooster
introduced.how: a Fatui Harbinger who sent a letter from Snezhnaya about Dottore
introduced.quote: The Fatui Harbinger "The Rooster" sends us his sympathies, along with all the usual pleasantries...

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: Snezhnaya's ruling body, which disowns Dottore's actions as a rogue element
introduced.quote: This madness was the act of a rogue element, one who cannot be seen to represent the Zapolyarny Palace.

introduced.name: Irminsul burning
introduced.how: the corrupted Irminsul was burned by the Pyro Gnosis and its flames lasted seven days
introduced.quote: The Pyro Gnosis burned down the corrupted Irminsul. The flames blazed for seven days and seven nights before they finally subsided.

introduced.name: Aaru
introduced.how: now carries the responsibilities that once belonged to Irminsul
introduced.quote: Now, Aaru shoulders the responsibilities that once belonged to Irminsul.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a lively land where people exercise at all hours and Mavuika lives
introduced.quote: Nahida: Natlan is such a lively place!

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: a Natlan figure who sensed the Pyro Gnosis vanish and thanked the Traveler's group
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Because the Pyro Gnosis has vanished? Mm, I sensed its loss.

introduced.name: Pyro Gnosis
introduced.how: a Pyro force that burned Irminsul and then vanished without a trace
introduced.quote: Despite scouring through the remnants of Irminsul, we couldn't find any sign of the Pyro Gnosis... not even any trace of it burning to ash.

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a Natlan location where Nahida and the others meet Mavuika
introduced.quote: (After the transition to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame)

assumed.name: Sorush
assumed.quote: ...Sorush?

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: Liloupar: Hah, you think this is a mere story? Well, many would also say that the journey you shared with your father is naught but a tale.

assumed.name: Heryshaf
assumed.quote: It's a pleasure, Dendro Dragon. Had you arrived but a little sooner, you might have attended a meeting of the Seven Pillars.

assumed.name: Hermanubis
assumed.quote: I miss Hermanubis. It's not a real reunion without him here.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: with the tree's emergence being tied to Dottore

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: Fortunately, Nicole transmits her voice from the Eternal Oasis and guides them out of the maze

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: She's studying with Nicole. I'm not sure how she's getting along... but she seems to be in good spirits, at least.

assumed.name: Forest Rangers
assumed.quote: I had assumed that you both volunteered for this project, like us Forest Rangers

assumed.name: Zaha Hadi
assumed.quote: Well, that's the fate that I certainly didn't manage to escape, saddled as I am with you... and Zaha Hadi.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Paimon: But didn't Dottore die in Nod-Krai? How is he still able to do all this?

assumed.name: Nod-Krai crisis
assumed.quote: Nahida: Teyvat has seen many upheavals in the last few years. The most recent of these was a major crisis in Nod-Krai, which forced Sumeru to be even more vigilant than usual.

assumed.name: Zandik
assumed.quote: Thoth: Zandik... So it was him. I saw him in the desert once...

assumed.name: Azar
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: You mean, with Azar and his accomplices? ...Yes and no.

assumed.name: Sachin and A Parade of Providence
assumed.quote: This is one of the lines Althaitham wrote in his notes while investigating Sachin during A Parade of Providence.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Nefer: Everyone is heading for the desert, per the evacuation order. Anyone willing to turn back at this stage is almost certainly with the Fatui.

assumed.name: Hermanubis
assumed.quote: Heryshaf: As for Hermanubis, may he rest in peace. We remember him with great fondness.

assumed.name: Apep
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh no... So even Apep's power didn't work?

assumed.name: Dendro Dragon
assumed.quote: Nahida: Don't worry about me. The Dendro Dragon's life force will sustain me.

assumed.name: Al-Ahmar
assumed.quote: Heryshaf: Though Al-Ahmar is no longer with us, the alliance between the three gods remains in force.

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: Nefer: I'm certain. Besides, it's extremely rare for me to have had any direct contact with Sumeru mercenaries besides Jeht.

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Cyno: A juicer? Did Sucrose send that to you?

assumed.name: Tumaini
assumed.quote: Mavuika: I won't try to quantify it, but trust me — handing over the Gnosis to Tumaini is far from the craziest idea I can think of.

assumed.name: Vahumana Darshan
assumed.quote: Nicole: I've always found the perspective of the Vahumana Darshan to be a particularly incisive one.

assumed.name: Spantamad
assumed.quote: Cyno: All the more reason that you should apply for Spantamad. Tighnari fiercely opposes the idea, though.

assumed.name: Kaveh and Alhaitham's past library interrogation
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Hmph, I still vividly remember the way you interrogated me in the library after the fact...

assumed.name: Collei's past victimization
assumed.quote: Collei: Miss Nicole said that... the same god remains which were once used to inflict so much pain upon me have now become a weapon with which I can protect everyone.

assumed.name: Scaramouche
assumed.quote: It's been a while, Scaramouche.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai defeat
assumed.quote: The other half of your soul suffered a crushing defeat in Nod-Krai, you know.

assumed.name: Akasha
assumed.quote: Accessing Irminsul via the Akasha is no longer feasible at this stage.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: I had the rare honor of being summoned before the Tsaritsa with Pulcinella to answer for myself.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: The first flame...

assumed.name: Cyno as Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Very clever, General Mahamatra Cyno.

assumed.name: Seven Archons
assumed.quote: The Seven Archons should honor and revere it, for their authority was bestowed upon them by the Heavenly Principles.

assumed.name: Dottore
assumed.quote: Everything Dottore said to you was a way to manipulate your mind. Fortunately, you're no longer under his sway.

assumed.name: Al-Ahmar
assumed.quote: Originally, it was merely Al-Ahmar's lie, but now it has become reality.

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Collei: Sucrose! It's been so long! How have you been?

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Albedo: Sucrose, you might want to try asking your questions one at a time...

assumed.name: Seven Pillars
assumed.quote: Word is that two of the other Seven Pillars, Shesepankh and Bennu, might also be dropping by.

assumed.name: Ibis King
assumed.quote: I heard the Goat King and the Ibis King decided to pay us a visit. How about you?

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Look at all of this... It's going to take me forever to tidy up! I suppose living below the Akademiya doesn't always work out to your advantage.

assumed.name: Sumeru City devastation
assumed.quote: Such devastation visited on Sumeru City... So many houses destroyed or damaged in the fighting.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: This batch is from Nod-Krai, so the scent won't be quite the same.

assumed.name: Vahumana
assumed.quote: You're from the Vahumana, and you're asking ME what the truth is?

assumed.name: Lord Thoth's help to Layla
assumed.quote: After all, Lord Thoth, you helped me so much in the desert, and I still haven't properly thanked you.

assumed.name: Windblume Festival
assumed.quote: Hey, do you still remember that time we all got together? You know, when we all went to the Windblume Festival.

threads.claim: Aaru is the original inspiration for the Akasha, and the two systems share a technological origin.
threads.quote: If the manual is to be believed, Aaru was in fact the original inspiration for the Akasha system.

threads.claim: Aaru's basis came from technology taken from the floating island Celestia.
threads.quote: It was after learning of the technology from that floating island in the sky that he first conceived of

threads.claim: King Deshret swore an eternal covenant with the gods that restrained his ambitions.
threads.quote: Since we share an eternal covenant, I shall never be your enemy.

threads.claim: Aaru was both a prison and a monument, a constraint born of the gods' alliance.
threads.quote: This explains why Aaru was both a prison and a monument, and why the answer to the three questions was

threads.claim: The artisans who built Aaru feared Deshret would silence them and left escape blueprints.
threads.quote: the artisans did leave details of their plans to survive, including blueprints for their escape route.

threads.claim: Apep's hatred of Al-Ahmar and the Seven Pillars is rooted in their long rivalry, and she will not change.
threads.quote: Nothing will change her hatred towards humanity and gods.

threads.claim: Deshret ended his life by tricking the Dendro Dragon into swallowing him, leaving her to bear his sins.
threads.quote: At the end of his life, King Deshret tricked the Dendro Dragon into swallowing him whole, leaving her to bear the torment of his sins...

threads.claim: The emergence of an Irminsul tree in Sumeru City is linked to Dottore's deranged experiment.
threads.quote: a massive tree emerges in Sumeru City, revealed to be an Irminsul tree.

threads.claim: Irminsul is in a state that makes access through normal means impossible.
threads.quote: with the state that Irminsul is currently in, it's impossible to access via traditional means.

threads.claim: Souls can reach Irminsul through the Ley Lines, which is how the attacker entered.
threads.quote: the only security measure she could have had was to block free access to the Ley Lines for all souls

threads.claim: Pantalone is one of Dottore's Segments, and his original is held in Northland Bank.
threads.quote: Pantalone states that nothing would have gone wrong after one of his Segments was held in Northland Bank

threads.claim: The Pyro Gnosis is transferred from Mavuika to the Traveler to be used against Irminsul.
threads.quote: She asks if they can claim ownership over her Pyro Gnosis, as the situation has become too dire to simply borrow it.

threads.claim: Dottore knows Wanderer's erased identity is Scaramouche and does not intend to restore it.
threads.quote: revealing that he knows Wanderer's erased identity as Scaramouche

threads.claim: Liloupar was commanded by Al-Ahmar to choose a king from among the people.
threads.quote: Al-Ahmar once commanded me to select a king from among the people

threads.claim: Nahida believes a God of Wisdom should not rule by force.
threads.quote: A God of Wisdom is not meant to rule by force.

threads.claim: Irminsul has become a tree of unbridled greed, signaling that a deranged experiment has advanced to a new stage.
threads.quote: It has become a tree of unbridled greed... a clear sign that a deranged experiment has advanced to a new stage.

threads.claim: Irminsul is mutating and evil branches are beginning to grow, with things from outside the world materializing.
threads.quote: Furthermore, Irminsul seems to be undergoing some kind of mutation. Evil branches are beginning to grow...

threads.claim: Pantalone's voice speaks of honoring Dottore's will through a blasphemous experiment, tying the crisis to Dottore.
threads.quote: But if we are to honor Dottore's will, this is what we must do.

threads.claim: Nahida is certain the Irminsul crisis is connected to Dottore, though it is unclear how he wields such influence.
threads.quote: The birth of this tree proves to me beyond doubt that this incident is connected to him.

threads.claim: Paimon questions whether Dottore really died in Nod-Krai, since he appears to still be acting.
threads.quote: Paimon: But didn't Dottore die in Nod-Krai? How is he still able to do all this?

threads.claim: The spy Cyno caught was likely planted long ago, and the Fatui may have never intended to follow through with him.
threads.quote: This spy must have been planted long ago.

threads.claim: Traveler theorizes the mole was written off from the start, and that his contact's silence reflects a planned cut-off.
threads.quote: I didn't think it was wise to state this out in the open. But my theory is, the mole wasn't cut off after he was caught. They wrote him off from the beginning.

threads.claim: The intruder entered Irminsul through death, the one route that cannot be protected against.
threads.quote: ...By entering Irminsul through death.

threads.claim: A barrier has cut Sumeru off from the rest of the world, and its purpose is unclear.
threads.quote: Traveler: But why? Why separate you from the rest of the world now, specifically?

threads.claim: The barrier is a Heavenly Principles rule that reserves power to isolate Sumeru when Irminsul faces grave danger.
threads.quote: The Heavenly Principles established a rule that when Irminsul is plunged into grave danger, a portion of power will be reserved to isolate Sumeru.

threads.claim: Irminsul was polluted once before, and it may have been a pollution that the forbidden knowledge eliminated.
threads.quote: Traveler: And if I'm not mistaken... Irminsul was polluted once before, wasn't it?

threads.claim: Irminsul predates the Heavenly Principles and its pollution did not threaten the tree itself, so Sumeru's sickness was not critical to it.
threads.quote: So even when the people of Sumeru became ill because of pollution, it was not a critical issue from the perspective of Irminsul itself.

threads.claim: The conversion between Light Realm energy and Elemental Energy is highly classified, yet scholars shared it anyway.
threads.quote: Master told me in private that the conversion process between Light Realm energy and Elemental Energy involves highly classified knowledge that shouldn't be disseminated too widely.

threads.claim: Nahida cannot fully recover until the problem with Irminsul is resolved, since she is closely tied to it.
threads.quote: The issue is how closely I am tied to Irminsul. Until the problem with it is resolved, there's no way I can fully recover.

threads.claim: A riddle inscribed in Aaru suggests the answer lies in a chessboard, though its meaning is unclear.
threads.quote: Humans may not 'read' what is written by the gods, except by not reading.

threads.claim: The riddle of Aaru is solved as a chessboard, leading to the Chess Trial.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: ...A chessboard.

threads.claim: Nahida originally meant only to borrow the Pyro Gnosis, but the situation grew far graver, so she asks Mavuika to give it to Sumeru.
threads.quote: Originally, I only intended to borrow it, but the situation is far graver than I foresaw... So instead, what I ask of you is... to please give the Pyro Gnosis to Sumeru.

threads.claim: Irminsul's effects depend on the records it holds, so a Descender with no records is immune to its barriers.
threads.quote: Since is a Descender, Irminsul contains no records of , and thus has no way to impede .

threads.claim: The Eternal Oasis, long thought a legend, is real and part of the upcoming journey to Natlan.
threads.quote: The Eternal Oasis? I thought that was just a legend... so it does exist after all.

threads.claim: Paimon feels useless when real danger comes, and she wants to become a friend who is actually useful.
threads.quote: Paimon doesn't want to be a burden. Paimon wants to be a friend who's actually useful.

threads.claim: The Traveler advises that doubt demands a choice between giving up and changing, and that one must move forward oneself.
threads.quote: When you start doubting yourself, you have two choices — give up, or change.

threads.claim: Sumeru's people face the coming disaster together regardless of faith, gender, or wealth, a moment of unprecedented unity.
threads.quote: Regardless of faith, gender, wealth, skin color, or eye color, everyone in Sumeru knows what will happen tomorrow.

threads.claim: Dottore is Zandik's Segment, and the relationship between Zandik and his Segments is central to Dottore's identity.
threads.quote: Zandik is you, and you are Zandik. Zandik created the Segments — yet you, a Segment yourself, reject him.

threads.claim: Dottore plans to create a new world inside the existing one by controlling Irminsul.
threads.quote: No, it never was. I am glad to be able to control Irminsul from within... Now, I shall attempt to create a new world inside the existing one.

threads.claim: Irminsul is shut down and its corruption is stopped.
threads.quote: Success! The evil Irminsul tree has stopped growing!

threads.claim: The Traveler's past as Scaramouche is hinted at, and Dottore says the Traveler erased every trace of their existence.
threads.quote: Yet you managed to erase every trace of your existence.

threads.claim: Zandik's elixir of immortality failed to grant immortality, and his body still aged.
threads.quote: But this was not immortality. Even with backup Segments, his body would still age

threads.claim: Angels who draw too close to humanity lose their wings and fall to earth.
threads.quote: If angels draw too close to humanity, our wings burn away in the bright flame of awareness, and we fall to the earth.

threads.claim: Mavuika gave the Pyro Gnosis to the Traveler and entrusted them with its use, and Nahida extracts it during the fight.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Do with it as you see fit

threads.claim: Irminsul is tied to the Heavenly Principles, which maintain fate.
threads.quote: It is the means by which the Heavenly Principles maintains fate itself.

threads.claim: Nahida invokes her authority as keeper of Irminsul and decides to destroy it.
threads.quote: I invoke my supreme authority as the keeper of Irminsul

threads.claim: Nahida defeats the Doctor by exposing his experiments and ends his schemes, though she says they will meet again.
threads.quote: Here is where your journey comes to an end. All that is yet unknown belongs to those of us who will carry on living.

threads.claim: Dottore's fate is left open, with the Fatui disowning him but Nahida expecting to cross paths with him again.
threads.quote: The matter of Dottore can be seen as settled for now. We are sure to cross paths again in the future, and in that light, Snezhnaya would do well to uphold their responsibilities and keep a tight rein over their actions.

threads.claim: Nahida has kept secret that the god remains in Collei came from the Goddess of Flowers, and says they are not harming her.
threads.quote: Those remains weren't hurting Collei, not as she is now — they simply exist. Besides, I could sense a deep yearning within her.

threads.claim: Liloupar removes the Goddess of Flowers' remains from Collei, yet Collei feels no different afterward.
threads.quote: (Liloupar begins to remove the remains of Goddess of Flowers from Collei)

threads.claim: Liloupar's centuries-old wish is granted and she departs at peace, carrying the blessing of flowers.
threads.quote: My wish will be fulfilled, and I can die happy.

threads.claim: Collei says goodbye to her old self and feels she has begun growing into a new person.
