threads.quote: I came to say goodbye to my old self. I know that after this, she'll be gone.

threads.claim: Irminsul's functions have moved to Aaru after its destruction, reshaping the flow of Teyvat's knowledge.
threads.quote: Now, Aaru shoulders the responsibilities that once belonged to Irminsul.

threads.claim: The Pyro Gnosis left no trace after the Irminsul fire, which raises an open question about where it went.
threads.quote: Despite scouring through the remnants of Irminsul, we couldn't find any sign of the Pyro Gnosis... not even any trace of it burning to ash.

threads.claim: With Irminsul burned, fate has opened to many new possibilities that Nahida will watch closely.
threads.quote: With Irminsul burned, the flow of fate now carries many more possibilities. I will be watching carefully.

threads.claim: Snezhnaya says it will hold Dottore's subordinates accountable under its law, though it admits no blamelessness.
threads.quote: The letter goes on to say that even so, Snezhnaya cannot claim to be blameless.

threads.claim: The servants of King Deshret have returned to the mortal world after long imprisonment and are now seeking a place to live.
threads.quote: especially for old timers like us who've been locked away all these years.

threads.claim: Angels such as Nicole can perform feats beyond mortals, including transferring a divine connection from Irminsul to Aaru.
threads.quote: Thanks to Nicole's extraordinary talents, my connection to Irminsul has been severed and transposed onto Aaru.

introduced.name: Linnea
introduced.how: self-introduced Adventurers' Guild advisor who runs lectures at Speranza and has a partner Lumi
introduced.quote: My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Lumi
introduced.how: Linnea's Jack Frost partner from the northern tundra
introduced.quote: Linnea introduces her partner as Lumi, a Jack Frost fae from the northern tundra.

introduced.name: Jack Frost
introduced.how: one of six common tundra fae types, and Lumi belongs to it
introduced.quote: There are six types of fae commonly found in the tundra.

introduced.name: Lumi's bullying past
introduced.how: Lumi was bullied by other Jack Frosts for looking different and hid under a painted cardboard box
introduced.quote: I discovered that some other mean Jack Frosts were ganging up and bullying her because she looked different.

introduced.name: Aguara
introduced.how: a small Natlanese tepetlisaur who wants to enter the competition with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Linnea: Oh, neat! A Natlanese tepetlisaur! Aw, it's so small and cute!

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: self-introduced Natlanese saurian contestant with her companion Mamala
introduced.quote: Hey there! I'm Mualani.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: self-introduced leader of the Arataki Gang of Inazuma who enters the competition
introduced.quote: head honcho of the world-famous Arataki Gang of Inazuma!

introduced.name: Mamala
introduced.how: Mualani's saurian companion entered in the competition
introduced.quote: having brought their respective companions, Mamala and Crimson Staff.

introduced.name: Celaeno
introduced.how: mysterious new competitor revealed as Linnea's sister and a fae
introduced.quote: discovers that Celaeno is her sister.

introduced.name: Haemus
introduced.how: Celaeno's Radiant Bladehorn companion, unusually calm for its kind
introduced.quote: Linnea is shocked to discover that Celaeno's companion is a Radiant Bladehorn named Haemus, given how aggressive Radiant Beasts were.

introduced.name: Radiant Beasts
introduced.how: aggressive and territorial beasts that fight each other when lured into each other's territory
introduced.quote: some adventurers have found they can use the territorial nature of Radiant Beasts to their advantage.

introduced.name: Augury Birds
introduced.how: rare fae who can foresee their own future, fewer than five exist
introduced.quote: they are one of the less common fae known as the Augury Birds, who are able to foresee their own future and less than five exist, including both of them.

introduced.name: changeling
introduced.how: Linnea's status as a human-raised fae with wings on her head due to unnatural features
introduced.quote: revealing her status as a changeling due to her unnatural features.

introduced.name: Speranza
introduced.how: a restaurant that was Linnea's home and where she used to be boss
introduced.quote: Simple — this was once my home.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: group that advocates coexistence with nature and hosts the animal sparring event
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions have always advocated coexistence with nature, encouraging their followers to build positive relationships with the beasts of the wild.

introduced.name: Spirit Envoy Championship
introduced.how: friendly sparring tournament to find the strongest human-animal pair, now open to all of Teyvat
introduced.quote: The "Spirit Envoy Championship" is designed to find the strongest human-animal pair by means of friendly sparring.

introduced.name: Browncap Mushroom
introduced.how: harmless-looking mushroom that causes hallucinations if eaten
introduced.quote: This here is a Browncap Mushroom. It looks harmless enough, but eating it will give you hallucinations.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild clerk who explains the Spirit Envoy Championship
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! How can the Adventurers' Guild help you today?

introduced.name: Jurva
introduced.how: Speranza's cook who once worked under Linnea as a boss
introduced.quote: Jurva finishes their order and explains that Linnea used to be their boss until she grew up and had to leave.

introduced.name: Ilze
introduced.how: opponent in Linnea's qualifier, partnered with Iku-Turso
introduced.quote: a Floating Hydro Fungus named Iku-Turso.

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: event official who keeps order in the arenas and treats Linnea's collapse
introduced.quote: Lauma: This is the biggest turnout we've ever had by far.

introduced.name: Czeslawa
introduced.how: self-introduced host of the qualifier matches
introduced.quote: Welcome, spectators! I'm your host, Czeslawa.

introduced.name: Linnea
introduced.how: Introduces herself and her backstory as a changeling raised in the Conch Gang
introduced.quote: Come to think of it, I haven't told you my story yet.

introduced.name: Conch Gang
introduced.how: Home of children from broken homes who support each other; Linnea grew up with them
introduced.quote: All of these kids are from broken homes, but everyone supports each other, and they still live life to the fullest.

introduced.name: Changelings
introduced.how: Fae folklore where Snowland Fae swap their child with a human baby
introduced.quote: The story goes that some of the Snowland Fae will secretly switch their own child with a human baby

introduced.name: Bird fae wings
introduced.how: Linnea's wings on her head prove she is not human
introduced.quote: They're proof that I'm not human.

introduced.name: Jurva
introduced.how: Chef at Speranza who once served under Linnea as the Conch Gang's boss
introduced.quote: Besides, only the best for our old boss.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: Self-introduces as an intimidating oni-like guardian of The Flagship
introduced.quote: Oh, I'll tell you who the heck I am.

introduced.name: Celaeno
introduced.how: Introduced as a hostile contestant facing the reigning champion
introduced.quote: Someone called Celaeno versus the reigning champion, Jahoda.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: Reigning champion and friend of the group
introduced.quote: Jahoda's a friend of ours, so we should be there to cheer her on.

introduced.name: Radiant Bladehorn
introduced.how: Hostile wild beasts classed as monsters, though not uncommon and tamable
introduced.quote: Technically speaking, Radiant Bladehorns are classed as monsters... but they are beasts of the wild, and they're not exactly uncommon.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: Contestant who uses feints and misdirection with her partner Mamala
introduced.quote: Mualani uses clever tricks in combat, causing Mamala to perform feints.

introduced.name: Fluffy the Flower King
introduced.how: Haniyyah's Sumpter Beast with high endurance that rests and becomes vulnerable
introduced.quote: Fluffy the Flower King has high endurance but will occasionally stop to rest.

introduced.name: Shaggy Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: Beasts renowned for endurance that cross rainforests and deserts and can kick up dust
introduced.quote: Sumpter Beasts are renowned for their endurance.

introduced.name: The Golden Beagle
introduced.how: Linnea's research ship, which sank many years ago
introduced.quote: It's been many long years since the Golden Beagle sank.

introduced.name: Match rules
introduced.how: Championship battles use Quick Attack, Defensive Counterattack and Charged Strike; read opponent moves to counter
introduced.quote: Observe your opponent's moves and counter!

introduced.name: Research vessel dream
introduced.how: Linnea's goal is to buy a research ship and sail to explore the world
introduced.quote: I wanna buy a huge ship for scientific research, then take my friends on a voyage of discovery to explore all the mysteries of the world!

introduced.name: Celaeno
introduced.how: Linnea's fae sister, an Augury Bird who resents her and foresees her own fate
introduced.quote: Who are you to me? Are you... Are you my sister?

introduced.name: Augury Birds
introduced.how: Rare fae who can see crossroads in fate, but only their own
introduced.quote: We can only see our own fates.

introduced.name: Changeling switch
introduced.how: Augury Birds were sent to grow up among humans so their visions would awaken later
introduced.quote: If an Augury Bird is sent far from the fae to grow up among humans, the awakening of their prophetic abilities can be delayed.

introduced.name: Haemus
introduced.how: Celaeno's Radiant Bladehorn partner, once a lost baby she looked after
introduced.quote: Haemus was still a baby then — must've gotten separated from his parents.

introduced.name: Little One
introduced.how: A mysterious Tepetlisaur Whelp that secretly helps Aguara train in Natlan
introduced.quote: (The whelp, revealed to be the Little One, approaches Aguara and successfully channels the weapon out of Geo essence)

introduced.name: Geo rock hammer
introduced.how: Lumi's signature Geo weapon, which Aguara learns to channel for the finals
introduced.quote: Now then, Aggie, it's time for you to learn one of Lumi's signature finishers.

introduced.name: Viliana
introduced.how: A Snezhnograd semifinalist who fights with a partner named Gorynishche
introduced.quote: please welcome Viliana, from Snezhnograd.

assumed.name: Kuki Shinobu
assumed.quote: Mualani: Shinobu...? Ah! I remember now! Kuki Shinobu, right? She's mentioned the Arataki Gang before.

assumed.name: Vedrfolnir
assumed.quote: which prompts the Traveler to recall Vedrfolnir's words regarding the same situation.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Traveler: Do you actually have any Mora left?

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: Next thing you know, he was trying to foxtrot with the Wild Hunt...

assumed.name: Demyan
assumed.quote: Once when Paimon was eating some yummy food there, Demyan mentioned that one of the drinks in their Roulette Special has Winter Icelea in it.

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: Well, it can't be another Moon-Prayer Night...

assumed.name: ratniki
assumed.quote: Although the ratniki's main duty is to deal with the Wild Hunt, you can always ask them for help if you run into serious trouble.

assumed.name: The Flagship
assumed.quote: The group goes their separate ways, with the Traveler heading to the Flagship for a rest.

assumed.name: Lumi
assumed.quote: Lumi: Ya-ho!

assumed.name: Aguara
assumed.quote: Aguara has learned new skills through its training with Lumi, with an increase in ATK and HP!

assumed.name: Haniyyah
assumed.quote: Haniyyah: Hey, Golden Comet and Silver Companion! Good to see you again.

assumed.name: Beast Tamers Tournament and Nilotpala Cup
assumed.quote: We met her at the Beast Tamers Tournament in Sumeru...

assumed.name: Mikko
assumed.quote: Mikko's birthday is coming up, so we're pooling our money to get him some new clothes.

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: I'll go get Lauma!

assumed.name: Kowalska
assumed.quote: Kowalska: You've been really down the last couple of days.

assumed.name: Speranza
assumed.quote: Approach the marked location at Speranza

assumed.name: Speranza
assumed.quote: Do you remember when we were at Speranza, and I told you guys about my childhood?

assumed.name: Conch Gang
assumed.quote: somehow getting by with a rag-tag bunch of kids in the Conch Gang.

assumed.name: Granny Citlali
assumed.quote: I wonder if I should take some back for Granny Citlali?

assumed.name: Vedrfolnir
assumed.quote: "The Visionary" Vedrfolnir once said something similar.

assumed.name: Mom and Dad (fae parents)
assumed.quote: Mom and Dad would sneak over to Nod-Krai to see you sometimes.

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: As a Descender, my fate is my own.

assumed.name: Jack Frosts and Lumi
assumed.quote: I've figured out why Lumi is different from other Jack Frosts!

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: So, Aguara comes from Natlan, right?

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: There's plenty of natural Phlogiston around, which will help keep the little one's stamina up.

threads.claim: Linnea senses she can predict opponents' moves, hinting at her fated foresight.
threads.quote: Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move.

threads.claim: Celaeno says the future cannot be changed, and the foreseen future went blank when Lumi attacked.
threads.quote: Celeano then wonders if Linnea had truly defied fate, as the future she saw went blank when Lumi's hammer was about to fall on them.

threads.claim: Linnea argues the future was likely set but that she need not accept it as is.
threads.quote: Linnea tells Celeano her answer; while the future was likely set, it didn't mean she had to accept it as is.

threads.claim: Linnea is searching for what makes Lumi different from other Jack Frosts.
threads.quote: and Linnea has been trying to figure out what made Lumi special.

threads.claim: Linnea suspects Lumi is a mutation, an atavism, or cursed, but has no answer yet.
threads.quote: I'm thinking it's either a mutation or an atavism — or maybe some sort of curse?

threads.claim: Lumi's consumption of Geo is what sets her apart from other Jack Frosts.
threads.quote: her consumption of Geo was what made her different from other Jack Frosts

threads.claim: Linnea wants to learn about her birth parents and her past.
threads.quote: Linnea also reveals her dream to learn more about Lumi's origins and her birth parents.

threads.claim: Linnea remembers only a lullaby from her early life, which may have been meant to keep her from her past.
threads.quote: She does not recall much outside of a lullaby, which she felt was meant to discourage her from going after her past.

threads.claim: Linnea's Augury Bird parents had her raised among humans to delay their abilities.
threads.quote: The Augury Birds lived with this burden until Linnea was born, with her parents deciding to have her live among humans so their abilities could be delayed.

threads.claim: Something in the tundra makes Linnea feel instinctively that she must leave.
threads.quote: In spite of this, Linnea traveled to the tundra but quickly felt something wrong, with every instinct telling her to leave.

threads.claim: An unseen woman watches Linnea and seems to know a truth that Linnea does not.
threads.quote: ???: Ignorance really is bliss, isn't it Linnea... But it won't last forever...

threads.claim: Celaeno's hat blows off, revealing she is a fae like Linnea.
threads.quote: the strong currents blow Celaeno's hat off, revealing her to be a fae, much to Linnea's shock.

threads.claim: Celaeno is revealed to be Linnea's sister and explains that Linnea's dreams show the future.
threads.quote: Celaeno tells her to go to the tundra with her one last time to say goodbye to their parents, explaining that everything she's "dreaming" is actually the future.

threads.claim: A saurian watching from a cliff may be the Traveler's former companion who helped Aguara.
threads.quote: the Traveler notices a Saurian looking at them from a cliff and realizes that it was their former companion.

threads.claim: Linnea wants to find her birth parents and learn what she truly is.
threads.quote: Of course, there are other questions I hope to get answers to along the way.

threads.claim: Lumi's identity and origin are unknown and must be uncovered.
threads.quote: But most importantly, we have to figure out who you are and where you came from.

threads.claim: Linnea's crystal skin suggests she is a changeling taken from the Snowland Fae.
threads.quote: I mean, just look at the crystals on my skin. No humans have those. It's a dead giveaway.

threads.claim: Fae lullabies urged Linnea to seek humans rather than chase her origins, hinting at a hidden reason.
threads.quote: Make your way to the villages and towns and seek kinship with the humans.

threads.claim: The tundra feels unwelcoming to Linnea despite being her supposed home.
threads.quote: It's odd — that place is supposed to be my home, but it feels like I'm unwelcome there.

threads.claim: Linnea can sometimes predict her opponents' moves before she thinks about them.
threads.quote: Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move.

threads.claim: Celaeno's reactions are so precise that Linnea suspects she can read minds.
threads.quote: She can read her opponent's mind!

threads.claim: Celaeno seems strangely hostile toward Linnea, though Linnea does not know her.
threads.quote: there was something strangely hostile about her demeanor

threads.claim: Celaeno is revealed to be Linnea's sister, bringing news about their parents.
threads.quote: Celaeno? She's my sister!?

threads.claim: Celaeno has long imagined Linnea sharing the pain she feels.
threads.quote: I've been through this moment so many times in my head... Imagining you sharing the same pain I feel.

threads.claim: Celaeno says Linnea glimpsed the future while unconscious, blurring past and future.
threads.quote: Remember? When you passed out during that competition? You saw it all as you lay there unconscious.

threads.claim: The dream sequences turn out to be Linnea's own death rather than a dream.
threads.quote: So it wasn't a dream after all... It's all...

threads.claim: The Golden Beagle sank long ago, and the loss still weighs heavily on Linnea.
threads.quote: It's been many long years since the Golden Beagle sank.

threads.claim: Linnea entrusts an unknown future reader with filling the blank pages of her nature atlas.
threads.quote: Whoever you are, I entrust the task of filling those blank pages to you.

threads.claim: A mysterious woman quietly listens to and watches Linnea throughout her story.
threads.quote: A mysterious woman can be seen behind Linnea, sitting at the adjacent table

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir claims fate is immutable, so seeing the future only brings suffering.
threads.quote: Fate is an immutable force. I can but lament as the inevitable unfolds.

threads.claim: Celaeno says that defying fate and failing is where the real suffering begins.
threads.quote: Wait till you've tried to defy fate and found how powerless you are to change it... That's when the real suffering begins.

threads.claim: Linnea argues that her feelings and thoughts lie beyond fate and belong to her alone.
threads.quote: But my feelings, my thoughts, everything I've seen... all that exists beyond the reach of fate.

threads.claim: Celaeno's vision of the future went blank when Lumi's hammer fell, raising the question of whether fate was cheated.
threads.quote: (When that hammer started to fall, the future I once saw went blank before my eyes...)

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether anchoring fate in place is truly the best solution.
threads.quote: (Is anchoring fate in place truly the best solution? Maybe one day, I can—)

threads.claim: Augury Birds lived under a shared burden until the parents devised the changeling solution.
threads.quote: Generation after generation of Augury Birds lived with this burden... until you were born, and our parents found the only solution they could think of.

threads.claim: The human child who was switched had a rare disease that only fae life could save, and she now lives with her birth parents.
threads.quote: She was born with a strange, rare disease that humans cannot cure.

threads.claim: Celaeno declares she dislikes Linnea, with no reason given.
threads.quote: I meant exactly what I said. I don't like you.

threads.claim: Celaeno admits her jealousy of Linnea's carefree life in Nod-Krai and her pretended well-wishing.
threads.quote: I was torn apart by jealousy, but I had to pretend that nothing was wrong — even that I wished you well.

threads.claim: Linnea reads Celaeno's resentment as loneliness, and Celaeno admits she wanted to share the family bond.
threads.quote: But I understand now. That feeling you had? It wasn't resentment... You were just lonely.

threads.claim: Linnea's visions showed her the end of her own life, leaving her shaken.
threads.quote: Even the very end of my life, when I finally had to bid farewell to the world...

threads.claim: Linnea hypothesizes that Lumi's Geo features come from her diet rather than birth.
threads.quote: What if Lumi wasn't born different at all? What if it's all a consequence of her diet?

threads.claim: An unidentified saurian voice helps Aguara train, raising the question of who it is.
threads.quote: ???: Rawr.

threads.claim: The Traveler spots the Little One on a mountaintop, hinting at its identity.
threads.quote: (The Traveler spots the Little One standing at the mountaintop)

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir questions whether giving someone future-sight only crushes their spirit.
threads.quote: I do wonder whether giving a man the power to see the future does nothing more for him than slowly crush his spirits...

threads.claim: Haemus is portrayed as a freedom-loving creature whom Celaeno wants to release to the wild.
threads.quote: Sounds like Haemus is a real freedom-lover.

introduced.name: Ungien's Circle
introduced.how: a moon facility that Eggie calls the home of life and realm of life
introduced.quote: Eggie: That's Ungien's Circle... the home of life...

introduced.name: Space Lifeform Capture Station
introduced.how: a station in space above Ungien's Circle, reached by the Skymount, where the dragons tried to capture space creatures
introduced.quote: Eggie: It's the destination of the Skymount we just rode... the Space Lifeform Capture Station...

introduced.name: Ungien
introduced.how: a life-sciences researcher who designed Ungien's Circle and believed mysterious creatures lived among the stars
introduced.quote: Eggie: Its designer was named... Ungien... a researcher in the field of life sciences...

introduced.name: Maagees-Geti
introduced.how: Ungien's beloved and a dragon researcher on Project Moongazer, later seen as a Mega Kuuhenki
introduced.quote: "To my mentors, Ungien and his beloved Maagees-Geti — your contributions to Project Moongazer shall not be forgotten."

introduced.name: Maggie
introduced.how: a Mega Kuuhenki who lives in the lunar sea and is Maagees-Geti in her changed form
introduced.quote: Columbina: Mmhmm. Her name's Maggie, and the lunar sea is her home.

introduced.name: Ungie
introduced.how: a second Mega Kuuhenki, Maggie's companion, whose fight with her stirred up the lunar sea
introduced.quote: Columbina: Yes, but Ungie's been very irritable lately. He got into a fight with Maggie, the aftershocks of which stirred up the lunar sea and caused the storm.

introduced.name: Mega Kuuhenki
introduced.how: giant kuuhenki variants created by high concentrations of lunar energy
introduced.quote: Paimon: It looks like a giant kuuhenki! Do you think it's some sort of... Mega Kuuhenki?

introduced.name: Ninnin
introduced.how: Eggie's other name; a black kuuhenki-like being of unknown kind who took on Columbina's form
introduced.quote: Eggie: My name is... Ninnin...

introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Fount
introduced.how: the source of energy at the center of the lunar sea, which Columbina plans to extract to calm the storm
introduced.quote: Columbina: So I plan to extract the Ancient Moon's Fount at the center of the lunar sea, which lies at the heart of the energy storm.

introduced.name: Archaeolune Storm
introduced.how: a storm of highly concentrated ancient moon energy caused by Maggie and Ungie's fight in the lunar sea
introduced.quote: Columbina: No, that's due to the upheaval in the lunar sea. It kicked off an Archaeolune Storm, which in turn spread highly concentrated ancient moon energy all the way here.

introduced.name: Storm Occlusion Field
introduced.how: a field that holds back storms temporarily, as long as the player stays within the generator's range
introduced.quote: Eggie: But don't worry... this occlusion field can temporarily hold the storms back... so long as we don't exit the generator's range...

introduced.name: Skymount
introduced.how: an elevator-like lift up to the Space Lifeform Capture Station that needs power to run
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? "Skymount" must mean this elevator, right? Looks like they're really struggling for energy up here on the moon...

introduced.name: Knotted Moonlight Vines
introduced.how: vines that seal terminals and grow where ancient moon power is in turmoil; cleared with Moonlight Dash
introduced.quote: Eggie: These are Knotted Moonlight Vines... I've seen information about them in the terminals...

introduced.name: Eye of Ibni-Belum
introduced.how: a tower first built as a deep-space signal station and later turned into a lunar surface monitoring station
introduced.quote: Eggie: The work logs record that... it is a lunar surface monitoring station... capable of monitoring the entire lunar surface.

introduced.name: Ibni-Belum
introduced.how: a dragon pioneer who led researchers to the moon and received a deep-space signal
introduced.quote: Eggie: It starts with a dragon pioneer named Ibni-Belum...

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: the Dragon King who journeyed out into the sea of stars and is believed to have sent the signal
introduced.quote: Eggie: And that king's name... was Nibelung.

introduced.name: Project Moongazer
introduced.how: a hidden, encrypted project file tied to Ibni-Belum's work that responds to Eggie's data but cannot be opened yet
introduced.quote: Eggie: There is a hidden module... "Project Moongazer"... It responded to me...

introduced.name: Terminal
introduced.how: ancient moon-powered terminals that store records and information
introduced.quote: Eggie: ...It's at the entrance... It has... information...

introduced.name: High-speed transit lane
introduced.how: a fast transit line running on ancient moon power that links stops such as the Eye of Ibni-Belum and Ungien's Circle
introduced.quote: Eggie: It's the entrance to the high-speed transit lane... it runs on the ancient moons' power...

introduced.name: Ninnin consuming her kin
introduced.how: Ninnin unconsciously absorbed other kuuhenki, which Columbina says helped awaken her
introduced.quote: Columbina: After bringing her back to the surface, I found that she began subconsciously consuming her kin — only then did she slowly awaken.

introduced.name: Lusalim
introduced.how: a researcher and student of Ungien and Maagees who designed the Lunar Veil project
introduced.quote: This is an energy entity created by a researcher named... Lusalim...

introduced.name: Lunar Veil Laboratory
introduced.how: the lunar sea was once Lusalim's laboratory for the Lunar Veil
introduced.quote: This lunar sea... once used to be... Lusalim's Lunar Veil Laboratory.

introduced.name: Project Moongazer
introduced.how: a dragon project whose Lunar Veil component was designed by Lusalim and then suspended
introduced.quote: Lusalim had designed... the Lunar Veil as a crucial part of Project Moongazer... but it had to be suspended...

introduced.name: Lunar Veil
introduced.how: a planned massive generator meant to conceal the entire moon, tested in miniature
introduced.quote: A massive Veil generator... was built here... One that could conceal the entire moon...

introduced.name: Ungien
introduced.how: a life scientist who piloted the Moongazer toward a deep-space signal
introduced.quote: But Ungien, the life scientist, chose to pilot a spaceship named Moongazer and set out for those coordinates nonetheless.

introduced.name: Maagees
introduced.how: Ungien's wife and a life scientist who examined the Moongazer and later converted Ungien
introduced.quote: Ungien's wife, Maagees, was the first to enter the spaceship, but she only found a round, black, spiky creature inside...

introduced.name: Ungie
introduced.how: an artificial kuuhenki created by Maagees from Ungien's remains, now the boss attacking the group
introduced.quote: She saved his body... and created Ungie, the first artificially-birthed kuuhenki on the moon.

introduced.name: Eggie
introduced.how: Ninnin, a moon-born kuuhenki sent far from home on a personal mission
introduced.quote: She was born on the moon, and I was the one who, out of worry, sent her to a place thousands of miles away from home.

introduced.name: Moongazer
introduced.how: a cloaked spaceship that rammed the Capture Station and held Ungien's fusion creature
introduced.quote: Yes... It was the Moongazer. Though why it was cloaked is a mystery.

introduced.name: Eye of Ibni-Belum
introduced.how: the Moongazer Tower that captured coordinates of the second deep-space signal
introduced.quote: But even so, the Moongazer Tower he designed — the Eye of Ibni-Belum — captured the coordinates of that second signal.

introduced.name: Space Lifeform Capture Station ramming
introduced.how: the station was rammed by an unknown object, later revealed as the cloaked Moongazer
introduced.quote: Years later, the Space Lifeform Capture Station was suddenly rammed by an unknown object.

introduced.name: Moongazer disappearance
introduced.how: Ungien flew the Moongazer into deep space and no messages were received afterward
introduced.quote: He disappeared into the sea of stars, and the dragons did not receive any messages from Moongazer thereafter.

introduced.name: Knotted Moonlight Vines
introduced.how: vines entangling Ungie's body and driving him into a frenzy
introduced.quote: His body... seems to be entangled in Knotted Moonlight Vines...

introduced.name: kuuhenki
introduced.how: small moon creatures that can mimic the forms of other creatures such as jellyfish and whales
introduced.quote: Since a school of kuuhenki can mimic jellyfish... Do you think they could mimic that whale over there, too?

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Columbina! It's really you this time! Finally, we've found you!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Paimon: Look! Over there... It's Teyvat!

assumed.name: Dragons
assumed.quote: Paimon: They've gotta be the dragons' doing, too, right? After all, they built a whole moon base... It's so amazing.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: Columbina: I lent her my power so the Frostmoon Scions wouldn't worry if they suddenly discovered a black kuuhenki but couldn't find me.

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: Columbina: Yes, I had my concerns as well, so I brought her back to Silvermoon Hall to keep her away from her kin for the time being.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Columbina: Yes... Kuuhenki would never do this. I believe only certain Abyssal creatures would... but the power that flows through Ninnin does not derive from the Abyss.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Paimon: "To Mr. Alhaitham — thank you for your contributions to Paimon's studies," or something like that...

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Columbina: Maggie, please show my friends the way.

assumed.name: Maggie
assumed.quote: Paimon: Maggie's been shot down!

assumed.name: Ancient Moon's Fount
assumed.quote: Traveler: You take care of Maggie. We'll grab the Ancient Moon's Fount.

assumed.name: Archaeolune Storm
assumed.quote: The Archaeolune Storm is closing in. We'll need to pass through it quickly.

assumed.name: Ungien's Circle
assumed.quote: The Archaeolune Storm is closing in on Ungien's Circle, and there are many little creatures living there.

assumed.name: dragons
assumed.quote: Whoa, all these guys— err, all these dragons sure had big dreams!

assumed.name: phlogistonization
assumed.quote: Oh! That sounds a lot like the dragons' phlogistonization!

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: It was... destroyed by a Descender from beyond the heavens...?

assumed.name: great ruler of the firmament
assumed.quote: The great ruler of the firmament...

assumed.name: false sky
assumed.quote: A veil that could obscure the moon... That sounds very similar to the false sky.

threads.claim: A mysterious signal from deep space was received by the dragon pioneer, and its origin and meaning remain unknown.
threads.quote: Eggie: Then, one day... while in the circumlunar zone, he received a... mysterious signal from deep space...

threads.claim: The dragon researchers could not decipher the signal, and the signal never appeared again.
threads.quote: Eggie: The researchers couldn't decipher the signal's meaning...

threads.claim: The pioneer believed the signal was a message from the Dragon King Nibelung, who journeyed into the sea of stars.
threads.quote: Eggie: But the pioneer believed... it was a message sent back... by their king who had journeyed out into the sea of stars...

threads.claim: Ungien wanted to overturn Ibni-Belum's theory and believed the signal came from a creature beyond the stars.
threads.quote: Eggie: Because he wanted to overturn... Ibni-Belum's theory...

threads.claim: Ungien believed many mysterious creatures beyond the stars remain undiscovered, and he built a station to capture them.
threads.quote: Eggie: He believed that among the stars... live many mysterious creatures we haven't discovered...

threads.claim: The real Project Moongazer file is encrypted, and Eggie cannot open it with the data she has.
threads.quote: Eggie: The real project file is encrypted... I can't open it...

threads.claim: The Moongazer startup fails because there is not enough energy to run it.
threads.quote: Not enough energy. Startup failed.

threads.claim: Columbina does not know what Ninnin and her kind are, and Ninnin's power does not come from the moon or the Abyss.
threads.quote: Columbina: Soon, I discovered some things I did not understand. Ninnin was one of them. I still don't know what she and her kind are.

threads.claim: Ninnin consumed her own kin in the past and cannot remember doing so.
threads.quote: Eggie: I... consumed others of my kind? I... don't remember...

threads.claim: Eggie has a mission she cannot fully remember and is unsure what it is.
threads.quote: Eggie: I don't know... what my mission is...

threads.claim: Eggie insists she must reclaim her mission, which Columbina does not know about.
threads.quote: Eggie: I am sorry... but... I must reclaim my mission.

threads.claim: Ungie may be Ungien in a changed form, a link that is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Paimon: So she turned into a Mega Kuuhenki!? What's going on? Then the second one... Ungie... Could that be...

threads.claim: Eggie thinks the second Mega Kuuhenki is most likely Ungien, though this is not confirmed.
threads.quote: Eggie: I don't know what to make of this either... but that's most likely Ungien...

threads.claim: A storm of concentrated ancient moon energy was triggered by a fight in the lunar sea and threatens living beings.
threads.quote: Columbina: No, that's due to the upheaval in the lunar sea. It kicked off an Archaeolune Storm, which in turn spread highly concentrated ancient moon energy all the way here.

threads.claim: The Eye of Ibni-Belum detected an unknown individual without an identification code, which may be Columbina.
threads.quote: Eggie: ...The appearance of an unknown individual lacking an identification code...

threads.claim: Ungien's Circle does not look naturally formed, and it may have been built by someone.
threads.quote: Traveler: This place doesn't look like it formed naturally...

threads.claim: Ungien's Circle looks empty from outside, but Eggie says the outside view is deceiving.
threads.quote: Eggie: That is because Paimon's eyes... have been deceived...

threads.claim: A mysterious deep-space signal reappeared years after the dragon pioneer's death and its coordinates were captured by the Eye of Ibni-Belum.
threads.quote: But even so, the Moongazer Tower he designed — the Eye of Ibni-Belum — captured the coordinates of that second signal.

threads.claim: The exact purpose and nature of Project Moongazer remain unexplained and are raised as an open question.
threads.quote: So what exactly is Project Moongazer?

threads.claim: The message the creature passed to the dragons through Ungien is missing from the records and is considered key to Project Moongazer.
threads.quote: There is no information about this.

threads.claim: The reason the Moongazer was cloaked is an unexplained mystery.
threads.quote: Yes... It was the Moongazer. Though why it was cloaked is a mystery.

threads.claim: Ungien was not attacked by the creature but chose to fuse with it, which explains how the message reached the dragons.
threads.quote: The ship's log showed that the creature emitting the signal didn't attack Ungien.

threads.claim: Columbina suspects Lusalim survived and that his research continued under the ruler of the heavens.
threads.quote: My guess is just the opposite — that Lusalim didn't perish, and that his research survived.

threads.claim: Columbina suspects the great ruler of the firmament destroyed Lusalim's research facility.
threads.quote: In that case, I fear the great ruler of the firmament is the likely culprit...

threads.claim: The Lunar Veil project is compared to the false sky, suggesting a link between the two.
threads.quote: That sounds very similar to the false sky.

threads.claim: The moon is not hidden because an entity from beyond the stars pierced the Lunar Veil before it could take shape.
threads.quote: That is because... before the Veil could take shape... an entity from beyond the stars pierced it.

threads.claim: Eggie has a personal mission tied to Project Moongazer that sets her apart from her carefree kind.
threads.quote: Among your kind, only you have a mission you seek to fulfill.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: Self-described savior whose quest is to save the world, which may spare some people
introduced.quote: If you have heard my name, then you know of my quest to save the world, and there is a chance that you can be saved.

introduced.name: Ann
introduced.how: Introduces herself by name to Narzissenkreuz
introduced.quote: My name is Ann.

introduced.name: Holy Blade
introduced.how: Sacred blade Narzissenkreuz wants; it cuts through the universal will around him and guides the Traveler
introduced.quote: The Holy Blade is not on my side. With each swing, it cuts through the universal will that surrounds me.

introduced.name: Kreuz Criss-Cross Cut
introduced.how: Name for the Holy Blade's special attack, christened by Paimon
introduced.quote: Righto! It's hereby christened the "Kreuz Criss-Cross Cut!"

introduced.name: Primordial Sea
introduced.how: Sea-like realm Narzissenkreuz was controlling and has now lost control of
introduced.quote: And I have lost all control of the Primordial Sea.

assumed.name: Masquerade of the Guilty
assumed.quote: (If Masquerade of the Guilty has been completed)

assumed.name: Lyris and Mary-Ann
assumed.quote: Director Lyris does not know what has happened. She just holds onto Mary-Ann, who herself still clings to life.

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz heroes
assumed.quote: I, too, wish to return to the very beginning — to the time before the Narzissenkreuz heroes set off on their journey.

assumed.name: All-Devouring Narwhal
assumed.quote: The person fated to see the all-consuming whale put to flight. The one who shall witness all.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz claims an apocalypse is coming that his rites would prevent.
threads.quote: Why are you so determined to oppose me? Do you not know that the apocalypse is nigh?

threads.claim: The world is shown to be saved despite Narzissenkreuz's failed mission.
threads.quote: My mission has failed, but the world has been saved nonetheless.

threads.claim: The four orthants have been reversed and the tree of flowing is incomplete, a hint of cosmic disorder.
threads.quote: I can sense that the four orthants have been reversed. But the tree of flowing is not yet complete.

threads.claim: Someone has seized the life-force and someone has opened the beast-realm, hinting at hidden actors.
threads.quote: Someone has seized control of the life-force, and someone has opened the beast-realm.

threads.claim: An outside 'variable' has descended on the world and changed its formula values, and the Traveler is that variable.
threads.quote: A "variable" has descended upon this world.

threads.claim: The Traveler is foretold as the one fated to witness all and see the whale put to flight.
threads.quote: The person fated to see the all-consuming whale put to flight. The one who shall witness all.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz calls the Traveler the witness, recorder, and designer of all, worthy of a world.
threads.quote: The witness of all, the recorder of all, the designer of all.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz says he knows the two colors that mix in Ann's soul, hinting at her hidden nature.
threads.quote: Names are just labels. But yes, I am most familiar with the two colors that mix in your soul.

threads.claim: Lyris clings to the past and Mary-Ann clings to life, unable to face the present and future.
threads.quote: She cannot understand such a complex present and future, and hopes just to retain the past.

threads.claim: Reason is presented as a source of power that Narzissenkreuz pursues.
threads.quote: Is "Reason" that which grants you such strength?

threads.claim: Paimon urges Narzissenkreuz to wake from his dream, echoing the unit's title theme.
threads.quote: Paimon reckons you're the one who should try waking up from your dream.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz says people are not masters of their own fate and cannot even control their dreams.
threads.quote: We are not masters of our own fate.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Island where the Victory Feast takes place and where Kokomi governs as Divine Priestess
introduced.quote: Arriving on Watatsumi Island to partake at the Victory Feast following the end of the Vision Hunt Decree

introduced.name: Gorou
introduced.how: Resistance general leading soldiers on Watatsumi Island who plans to burn a Fatui ship
introduced.quote: Gorou inspects some tracks with two soldiers and believes that a Fatui ship is moored nearby.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Remnant enemy forces still causing trouble on Watatsumi Island after the war
introduced.quote: Despite the end of the war, the Fatui still intend to cause problems.

introduced.name: Denjirou
introduced.how: Resistance soldier who notes people on the island are on edge after the sudden victory
introduced.quote: On the way to the village, they encounter Denjirou, who is surprised to see their return.

introduced.name: Arisawa
introduced.how: Islander who keeps to himself and is content with the peace
introduced.quote: They then encounter Arisawa, who tells them he doesn't know anything as he keeps to himself and is content with the peace.

introduced.name: Yoshihisa
introduced.how: Soldier who distrusts the Tenryou Commission and opposes the peace talks

introduced.name: Kabasawa

assumed.quote: (If Let's spark things up a little was selected and enemies were inflicted with Electro-Charged)

threads.claim: Rumors claim the Tenryou Commission is secretly coordinating with the Fatui to continue attacks, and the matter stays unresolved.
threads.quote: I heard they've been secretly coordinating with the Fatui and plan to continue their attacks.

threads.claim: Kokomi is stumped by the alleged collusion and the soldiers' insistence that something is going on.
threads.quote: Take this alleged collusion between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui, for example. I'm still completely stumped.

threads.claim: Soldiers who stole the goods and met Fatui confess that Fatui approached them to restart the war, though the Tenryou guards were involved.
threads.quote: They admit that some Fatui met them and wanted to restart the war

threads.claim: Kokomi suspects the peace talks may be a trap, with the Kujou Clan and Kamisato Clan possibly involved in a plot to destroy the island.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi: If that is the case, then the peace talks are likely a trap. Even the Kamisato Clan could be involved...

threads.claim: Resistance soldiers struggle to return to normal life after a sudden victory, and some miss the fight.
threads.quote: Victory's declared and all of a sudden, the fighting's over — but people can't just snap back into normal life again.

threads.claim: Kokomi forms a new corps to protect the island, showing that the soldiers' fighting will is given an outlet.
threads.quote: announces the formation of a new corps to protect the island

threads.claim: Relations between Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate have soured since the Shogun slew the protector deity Orobashi, and the shrine was abandoned.
threads.quote: But after she struck down our protector deity, the shrine was abandoned.

threads.claim: Yuna argues that reconciliation with the Shogun's Army would make the protector god's sacrifice meaningless.
threads.quote: If we reconcile with them, the god who once protected us will have died in vain...

threads.claim: Kokomi is exhausted by her role as Divine Priestess, which she never wanted, and needs rest.
threads.quote: To be honest, I'm not really cut out to be a leader.

threads.claim: After a nap and reading, Kokomi recovers her energy and feels ready for the peace talks.
threads.quote: Should be enough to see me through the peace talks.

threads.claim: Fatui remnants remain active on Watatsumi Island despite the war's end, and the soldiers are hiding something.
threads.quote: Recently, the remnants of the Fatui forces have been unusually active.

threads.claim: The resistance destroys the Fatui ship and remaining Fatui skirmishers are defeated, though the Fatui are not fully gone.
threads.quote: Fatui Skirmisher: They leave us no choice but to attack! Comrades, let's make them regret it!

threads.claim: Kouzen says the rumors were fake and that the conspirators want war again because they cannot cope with their comrades' deaths; he claims it is too late to stop them.
threads.quote: He is defeated and reveals that the rumors were fake and that they simply want war again

threads.claim: A rumor that the Tenryou Commission colludes with the Fatui threatens the peace talks and must be investigated.
threads.quote: I still have no further leads regarding the issue of potential collusion between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui.

threads.claim: The collusion story was fabricated by Kouzen, though a few Tenryou samurai did receive a Fatui approach.
threads.quote: Kouzen: We made it up. The story about the Tenryou Commission colluding with the Fatui... It didn't happen.

threads.claim: Remaining Fatui agents seek revenge and may try to reconnect with Inazuma factions to stir up turmoil.
threads.quote: I suspect that before long, they will attempt to reestablish contact with your people in the hope of procuring some assistance.

threads.claim: Kouzen's cryptic claim that it is too late to stop them is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Too late? What do you mean?

threads.claim: Kokomi suspects a pro-war co-conspirator has infiltrated the guards to restart hostilities during the talks.
threads.quote: I highly suspect that one of Kouzen's pro-war co-conspirators will have infiltrated the guards with an intent to reignite hostilities tomorrow during the negotiations.

threads.claim: The resistance treats the warrior's will as its central value, and that value drives their refusal to accept peace.
threads.quote: We are the resistance! Everything hinges on our warrior's will!

threads.claim: Kokomi admits she taught soldiers to nurture a warrior's will but never to let it go, reframing the theme.
threads.quote: It was largely an oversight on my part: I taught you to nurture a warrior's will, but never how to let it go.

threads.claim: Pro-war soldiers distrust the Tenryou Commission and fear betrayal even as peace talks proceed.
threads.quote: What's to stop the Tenryou Commission from stabbing us in the back?

threads.claim: Arisawa's absent friend, who was meant to sing at the feast, hints at a loss from the war.
threads.quote: If only he were still here...

threads.claim: Kokomi's pre-written scenario list lets her pick a response to a changing situation at the talks.
threads.quote: The last one... but hold off for the moment.

threads.claim: Kokomi admits she still struggles in crowds and feels far from the standard expected of a Divine Priestess.
threads.quote: Today was a reminder that I don't cope well in situations with lots of people.

introduced.name: Delaroche
introduced.how: Fishing Association representative who asks the Traveler and Paimon to investigate missing fish
introduced.quote: Oh? No, it's nothing... I'm Delaroche, the representative of the Fontaine Fishing Association. How can I help you?

introduced.name: Thelxie
introduced.how: a local fairytale Water Imp said to lure and eat lonely children, with varying appearances
introduced.quote: Our local fairytales often speak of a terrifying underwater creature called Thelxie.

introduced.name: Water Imps
introduced.how: fairytale abductors that parents use to keep children away from the water
introduced.quote: Simply put, parents came up with a story painting Water Imps as scary abductors in an effort to convince their children to stay away from the water.

introduced.name: Erinnyes Forest
introduced.how: an island with an opera house, a Fountain of Lucine, Water Vein sources and mysterious mist
introduced.quote: Both the opera house and the Fountain of Lucine were built there, and the sources of many Water Veins can be traced to the island as well.

introduced.name: Freminet
introduced.how: diver in a helmet who builds clockwork penguins and is secretly commissioned to make Thelxie
introduced.quote: Freminet emerges from the water all of a sudden in his diving helmet, surprising them.

introduced.name: Zuria Destree
introduced.how: Freminet's employer, a mother commissioning Thelxie for her son's picture book therapy
introduced.quote: Freminet's employer Zuria Destree is waiting for him and he introduces the Traveler and Paimon as his trustworthy companions to help him with Thelxie.

introduced.name: Loneliness Syndrome
introduced.how: a rare mental disorder causing deep loneliness, loss of interest, and loss of fantasy-reality distinction
introduced.quote: Mhm, it's a type of mental disorder. Those affected by it often feel extremely lonely, and lose interest in many mundane activities.

introduced.name: Water Imp Kingdom
introduced.how: an underwater ruin on the seabed of Salacia Plains to be used as the fairytale kingdom
introduced.quote: There are some ruins on the seabed of the Salacia Plains.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: an institution where Freminet saw many cases of Loneliness Syndrome under a previous Director
introduced.quote: I've just seen many cases of it at the House of the Hearth, back when we lived under the previous Director.

introduced.name: Penguin Town
introduced.how: a peaceful penguin town of clockwork toymakers, Freminet's made-up fairytale world
introduced.quote: Anyway, Penguin Town is a peaceful place with lots of penguin residents.

introduced.name: Pers
introduced.how: the triumphant hero of Penguin Town who quietly protects the town, Freminet's fairytale companion
introduced.quote: And Pers is the town's triumphant hero, as well as the one who quietly protects the whole place.

introduced.name: Echoing Conch
introduced.how: a device that detects special reflection waves underwater for exploration
introduced.quote: We call this thing the Echoing Conch.

introduced.name: picture book
introduced.how: Zuria's book retelling Thelxie's story, meant to guide her son's fantasy toward hope
introduced.quote: What we should do now is help him complete this picture book.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: as long as you pay us a little bit of Mora!

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Oh, speaking of which, you're both already pretty used to Fontaine's underwater environment, right?

assumed.name: vishaps
assumed.quote: the rumor that the vishaps on the island can understand human language

assumed.name: Ley Line
assumed.quote: I've heard everything from heredity factors and one's state of mind to environmental factors and even Ley Line disorder effects.

assumed.name: Water Veins
assumed.quote: Just like how a Water Vein always has a source.

threads.claim: Delaroche suggests the Water Imp fairytale may be based on a real-life event rather than being pure fiction.
threads.quote: But what if the fairytale was inspired by a real-life tale?

threads.claim: Rumors say a child walked into the water as if called by a Water Imp, and it is unclear whether the child was eaten.
threads.quote: They say that someone recently saw a child walk into the water as if he was possessed by something.

threads.claim: Freminet's testing of his clockwork Thelxie explains the penguin rumor and the fish disappearance, and he suspects the child was himself diving.
threads.quote: Well, it was probably because of me.

threads.claim: Freminet's Thelxie can only output pre-written messages because the language module was never installed.
threads.quote: I wanted to install a language output module, but due to time constraints, I had to give up on the idea.

threads.claim: An inscribed shell hints that Thelxie died and his bones became coral.
threads.quote: Full fathom five Thelxie lies; Of his bones are coral made.

threads.claim: Zuria's son was diagnosed with Loneliness Syndrome at eight and has since developed delusions.
threads.quote: He was actually diagnosed with Loneliness Syndrome when he was only eight years old...

threads.claim: Outcomes of Loneliness Syndrome are rarely positive, and in the worst cases patients can die.
threads.quote: And from the cases I've seen, there weren't many positive outcomes.

threads.claim: Zuria's son can no longer tell fantasy from reality and sees himself as Thelxie.
threads.quote: To put it simply, he can no longer differentiate between fantasy and reality, and spends all his time in his fantasy world...

threads.claim: Freminet believes fairytale worlds must exist somewhere, blurring the line between imagination and reality.
threads.quote: I just believe that the fairytale world of my dreams must also exist somewhere.

threads.claim: Freminet says diving in a helmet sometimes reveals wondrous things, as if a fairytale became real.
threads.quote: In those moments, it's possible to see some... truly wondrous things, as if a fairytale has become reality.

threads.claim: Freminet is secretly working on a commission from a private employer whose identity and purpose he withholds.
threads.quote: She has commissioned me to make a special toy.

threads.claim: Some people believe Loneliness Syndrome may be caused by contamination from god remains.
threads.quote: Some even say it could be caused by contamination from god remains...

threads.claim: Penguin Town is described as a fairytale-like place Freminet refuses to fully explain.
threads.quote: It's not really anywhere famous or important. Don't worry about it.

threads.claim: Rumors claim the vishaps on Erinnyes can understand human language.
threads.quote: the rumor that the vishaps on the island can understand human language

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: Revealed as the Twilight Sword, a royal guard of Khaenri'ah who failed to prevent its destruction
introduced.quote: That man, Dainsleif, was the "Twilight Sword," one of the royal guards of the final dynasty of Khaenri'ah. 500 years ago, he failed to prevent the destruction of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: An ancient human nation destroyed about 500 years ago
introduced.quote: Both originate from an ancient nation that was destroyed 500 years ago — Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Destruction of Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: Gods destroyed Khaenri'ah 500 years ago, which had never had a god
introduced.quote: 500 years ago, the gods descended upon the world and brought desolation to Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: Modern name for ancient machines; Khaenri'ah called them Field Tillers
introduced.quote: "Ruin Guard" is the name modern people have given these machines. No one called them that 500 years ago.

introduced.name: Field Tiller
introduced.how: Khaenri'ah's code name for its masterless combat machines
introduced.quote: These "Ruin Guards" were known as "Field Tillers" by the people of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: First Field Tiller
introduced.how: The prototype machine whose eye is the key component; the Ruin Guards are replicas of it
introduced.quote: All of the Ruin Guards today are just replicas of this machine. As the prototype, its combat capability was unrestricted.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: Group that keeps seeking Khaenri'ah's remnants despite being far from human
introduced.quote: Only the Abyss Order has consistently sought out the remnants of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Abyss Mages
introduced.how: Abyss Order members who explore the ruins and search Ruin Guards for a valuable object
introduced.quote: In fact, I was nearby investigating precisely because Abyss Mages often come out from that ruin to explore.

introduced.name: Osial
introduced.how: A god called Overlord of the Vortex, the target of the Abyss Order's first phase
introduced.quote: In short, the first phase of the plan is related to Osial, Overlord of the Vortex.

introduced.name: Defiled Statue
introduced.how: Inverted Statue of The Seven that the Abyss Order plans to use as a base for a mechanized god
introduced.quote: The talisman's message states that they will use "the Defiled Statue" as a base, attaching Osial's limbs to construct a mechanized god.

introduced.name: Loom of Fate
introduced.how: Keyword of a large Abyss Order operation found on a talisman
introduced.quote: The keyword here is "Loom of Fate."

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Thieves who plan a heist on the Abyss Order's ruins
introduced.quote: Anyway, the Treasure Hoarders discovered some previously unexplored ruins that the Abyss Order has been secretly guarding in the shadows.

introduced.name: Big Sis of the South
introduced.how: Head of the Treasure Hoarders in Liyue, with Raptor of the North as a big-time thief
introduced.quote: Yes, they're known as "Big Sis of the South" and "Raptor of the North."

introduced.name: Grand Thief
introduced.how: A highly respected thief recruited from Fontaine to oversee the heist
introduced.quote: The Grand Thief is highly respected in the Treasure Hoarders, in the same way that we adventurer's look up to great adventurers.

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: The place formerly called Old Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Oh, this refers to a time of great danger that engulfed Old Mondstadt, the place now known as Stormterror's Lair.

introduced.name: The Tyrant's Final Fury
introduced.how: Fireballs rained on anyone approaching Old Mondstadt for about a year, once blamed on the God of Storms
introduced.quote: People at that time believe that it was a curse laid down by the God of Storms, so they referred to it as "The Tyrant's Final Fury."

introduced.name: Lost Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: A Statue of The Seven vanished from the Church one night and was never found
introduced.quote: A long time ago, there was indeed one Statue of The Seven that disappeared one night without a trace.

introduced.name: Andrius
introduced.how: An Anemo Archon companion who died long ago, whose spirit guards Wolvendom
introduced.quote: The Abyss Herald may just be targeting the spirit of Andrius in an attempt to garner some information from one of the Anemo Archon's old companions.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: The Seven, dragons, gods... no ancient artifacts that relates can escape their greedy ambitions.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Could it be the same as with Dvalin?

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: (But, the next time I see Venti or Zhongli...)

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: (But, the next time I see Venti or Zhongli...)

assumed.name: Boreas

assumed.name: Jean

assumed.name: Razor
