assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Ahh! Raptor! Paimon remembers he tried to run away from Amber in Mondstadt...

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Just like the famous adventurer, Alice?

assumed.name: Stanley
assumed.quote: Just like the great adventurer, Stanley?

assumed.name: Stormterror incident
assumed.quote: Those monsters that tried to attack Mondstadt last time, during the Stormterror incident.

assumed.name: Church of Favonius
assumed.quote: Should we ask the Church of Favonius about it?

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: That statue... It looked like the Anemo Archon...

assumed.name: Jade Chamber
assumed.quote: It was just crushed by the Jade Chamber...

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: At the Rite of Descension in Liyue, your decision was very similar to what Dain would do...

assumed.name: Abyss Herald
assumed.quote: The one Dain spoke of...

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: (Celestia...)

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: Although no match for a god, it was stronger than even many who wield Visions.

assumed.name: Traveler's sibling
assumed.quote: (We've been separated for so long...)

threads.claim: The gods' destruction of Khaenri'ah 500 years ago is raised as a central historical mystery.
threads.quote: 500 years ago, the gods descended upon the world and brought desolation to Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: The Traveler wants to hear the gods' explanation for destroying Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: (I need to hear what explanation the gods have for their actions.)

threads.claim: The Traveler has memories of Khaenri'ah, which is unexplained.
threads.quote: Because I have memories of Khaenri'ah.

threads.claim: The Abyss Herald seems to recognize the Traveler, hinting at a hidden connection.
threads.quote: (It seemed to... know me.)

threads.claim: The Traveler's long-separated sibling reappears among the Abyss Order.
threads.quote: I've finally found you!

threads.claim: The sibling's goal of engulfing the thrones and waging war with destiny is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Until the Abyss has engulfed the thrones, my war with destiny will see no end...

threads.claim: Dainsleif carries a curse of immortality that forced him to watch his people become monsters.
threads.quote: A curse of immortality was laid upon him, to forever wander the wilderness... while he watched the people he was supposed to protect turn into of the Abyss.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order may be the transformed people of Khaenri'ah, a claim the player must weigh.
threads.quote: You're trying to tell Paimon that the Abyss Order is not only related to Khaenri'ah but is actually the people of Khaenri'ah themselves!?

threads.claim: The Abyss Order's aim to destroy The Seven's nations is tied to Khaenri'ah's destruction by gods.
threads.quote: The destruction of the nation of Khaenri'ah by the gods... is the reason why the Abyss Order now seeks to destroy the nations watched over by The Seven.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order plans to fuse Osial's body with Field Tiller technology to create a mechanized god.
threads.quote: They won't just corrupt Osial's mind. They also plan to use the ancient technology behind the "Field Tillers" to completely transform Osial's body.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order's Loom of Fate operation is an unexplained large plan.
threads.quote: The keyword here is "Loom of Fate."

threads.claim: The eye of the first Field Tiller is revealed as the core the Abyss Order seeks, and Dainsleif takes it.
threads.quote: The very thing the Abyss Herald has been seeking all along — the eye of the first Field Tiller.

threads.claim: Barbara suggests the Tyrant's Final Fury may have been caused by something other than a curse.
threads.quote: Perhaps it was something else that caused the disaster.

threads.claim: The Tyrant's Final Fury is explained as missiles fired by the damaged Field Tiller.
threads.quote: So "The Tyrant's Final Fury" was really just missiles fired from the Field Tiller after it ran from Wolvendom!

threads.claim: A Statue of The Seven vanished from the Church long ago and was never found.
threads.quote: Nearly every member of the Church joined the search for it, but it was never found.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's advice to distrust gods without hunting them hints at deeper conflict with The Seven.
threads.quote: Always be on your guard when around gods.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's hostility toward gods is tied to the failings of his forebears.
threads.quote: Lest I repeat the failings of my forebears.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether Dainsleif hates The Seven or protects them.
threads.quote: Does Dain hate The Seven, or is he protecting them?

threads.claim: The Abyss Order's plan aims to topple the divine thrones of Celestia, a goal left unexplained.
threads.quote: (Celestia...)

introduced.name: Barbara
introduced.how: Deaconess of the Church of Favonius who sings for Mondstadt and is mobbed by fans
introduced.quote: Besides, I'm the Deaconess of the Church of Favonius, and this is the Knights of Favonius' Honorary Knight.

introduced.name: Victoria
introduced.how: Sister at the Cathedral who worries about Barbara and sends the Traveler to find her
introduced.quote: Victoria: I sure hope Sister Barbara is okay...

introduced.name: Albert
introduced.how: Leader of the Barbara Fan Club who searches Wolvendom for Barbara
introduced.quote: Albert, the leader of the Barbara Fan Club.

introduced.name: Barbara Fan Club
introduced.how: Group of Barbara's Mondstadt supporters who clean the Cathedral and help citizens
introduced.quote: It's a group of my Mondstadt... supporters.

introduced.name: Wolvendom
introduced.how: Forest area outside Mondstadt where Barbara goes to pick herbs and hide from fans
introduced.quote: After hearing Sister Victoria's concerns about Barbara's whereabouts, the Traveler goes to Wolvendom to find her.

introduced.name: Wolfhooks
introduced.how: Herb picked for Tunner's cough medicine, with a red variety
introduced.quote: The reason I came here was not only to find Wolfhooks for making Tunner's cough medicine

introduced.name: Tunner
introduced.how: Sick man recovering at Dawn Winery whom Barbara looks after
introduced.quote: Ah yes, now that we're here, I'd like to go to Dawn Winery and check on Tunner's condition.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Order that Barbara's sister serves in and that handles crowd control and crime
introduced.quote: And besides, my sister works in the Knights of Favonius...

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: Title held by the Traveler, which Barbara and others treat as a special status
introduced.quote: Barbara: Of course! You are the Honorary Knight, after all. Feel free to find me for healing anytime!

introduced.name: Grand Master Varka
introduced.how: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius who left on an expedition
introduced.quote: Barbara: That's right! The Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. I'm sure you've heard his name mentioned before.

introduced.name: Seamus Pegg
introduced.how: Barbara's father, Cardinal of Daybreak and Seneschal of the Church, who left with Varka
introduced.quote: Barbara: Seamus Pegg... Cardinal of Daybreak and the Seneschal of the Church of Favonius.

introduced.name: Cardinal Calvin
introduced.how: Church official who took over Pegg's duties and rarely leaves his room
introduced.quote: Barbara: He also turned over all his responsibilities in the Church to Cardinal Calvin.

introduced.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
introduced.how: Church relic that was stolen, then repaired by a bard
introduced.quote: Barbara: The only time I've seen him recently was when the Holy Lyre der Himmel was stolen.

introduced.name: Cat's Tail
introduced.how: Drink shop in Mondstadt promoting a new special drink
introduced.quote: Barbara: Oh, I've just remembered that the Cat's Tail is promoting a special drink recently.

introduced.name: Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea
introduced.how: New special drink sold at the Cat's Tail that people line up for
introduced.quote: Miss Margaret said that the name of the drink is

introduced.name: Chilibrew
introduced.how: Barbara's home-made drink, a spicy brew she makes with Jueyun Chilis and Sweet Flowers
introduced.quote: If you'd rather not stand in line, I could make you a glass of my very own Chilibrew.

introduced.name: Jueyun Chilis
introduced.how: Spicy ingredient needed for Chilibrew, gathered around Stone Gate
introduced.quote: Alright, let me think... to make this drink, we'll need some fresh Jueyun Chilis and Sweet Flowers.

introduced.name: Sweet Flowers
introduced.how: Chilibrew ingredient; high-quality ones are rare and grow in Whispering Woods
introduced.quote: Though they're easy to find, high-quality Sweet Flowers are few and far between...

introduced.name: Whispering Woods
introduced.how: Woodland near Mondstadt where Sweet Flowers grow and Barbara gathers ingredients
introduced.quote: we can meet up just south of the Whispering Woods.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Criminal group that preys on travelers and merchants around Mondstadt
introduced.quote: I've heard a lot about the criminal methods of the Treasure Hoarders around Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Caishan
introduced.how: Liyue merchant rescued from Treasure Hoarders on the road to Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Caishan: I'm a merchant from Liyue. I was on my way to Mondstadt...

introduced.name: Uwe
introduced.how: Wounded man who asks for healing, later revealed as a Treasure Hoarder
introduced.quote: Uwe: The truth is... I am a Treasure Hoarder. My plan was to feign injury in order to take advantage of the situation...

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: Hunting town that Uwe falsely claims to be from
introduced.quote: I'm a... I'm a Hunter, from Springvale!

introduced.name: Small Lamp Grass
introduced.how: Herb Barbara gathers to treat serious wounds
introduced.quote: Okay, I'm going to look for some Small Lamp Grass in the area.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: Power that lets Barbara heal physical wounds, though not sadness
introduced.quote: I can use the power of my Vision to heal physical wounds, but it's no use on someone afflicted by sadness.

introduced.name: Idol
introduced.how: A performer who spreads love and hope through song and dance, as described in a magazine
introduced.quote: In the magazine, it said that an idol was... a person that spreads love and hope through song and dance.

introduced.name: Barbara Fan Club
introduced.how: Albert leads it; it is the biggest club of Barbara's fans in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Oh, you can't be serious! It's only the biggest club for Barbara-sama fans in all of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Wolfhook
introduced.how: a berry; the red kind is needed to make Tunner's cough medicine
introduced.quote: The reason I came here was not only to find Wolfhooks for making Tunner's cough medicine, but also to have some quiet time alone...

introduced.name: Wolvendom
introduced.how: a large, monster-filled area outside the city where Barbara went to pick berries
introduced.quote: Wolvendom is a large area, it would be difficult for you to cover it alone.

introduced.name: Barbara's fame
introduced.how: Barbara sings for crowds across Teyvat and is so popular that fans constantly crowd her
introduced.quote: In Mondstadt, I often perform songs for people.

introduced.name: Uwe
introduced.how: a Treasure Hoarder who had an ulterior motive and was defeated and wounded by the Traveler
introduced.quote: Fine, you caught me! Like I said, I'm already l—leaving!

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Barbara: Jean... must really believe in you to grant you this title.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Victoria: Oh, I see... Thank Barbatos that she's alright.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: I heard Amber say that you're traveling far and wide, looking for your sibling. Is that true?

assumed.name: Holy Lyre theft and repair
assumed.quote: Barbara: Speaking of which, you still remember that day, right?

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: Barbara: She also mentioned that it's her secret weapon to beating Angel's Share in drink sales.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: In Mondstadt, I often perform songs for people.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: here's some Mora!

assumed.name: Sara
assumed.quote: Hehe, that's what Sara said...

assumed.name: Albert
assumed.quote: Oh, Paimon remembers him! Isn't that Albert?

assumed.name: Barbara
assumed.quote: Barbara-sama... Are you here?

assumed.name: Victoria
assumed.quote: I was originally planning to give her some herbs at the Cathedral, but Sister Victoria told me she had gone out to attend to some matters.

assumed.name: Huffman
assumed.quote: Hehe, even Huffman's a member now!

assumed.name: Tunner
assumed.quote: The reason I came here was not only to find Wolfhooks for making Tunner's cough medicine, but also to have some quiet time alone...

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: And we mustn't forget that Barbatos also knows.

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Heh... It's no wonder you've become the Honorary Knight, you certainly give it your all — *cough*

assumed.name: Chilibrew
assumed.quote: *sigh* It looks like Chilibrew isn't in the cards this time. I'll have to get around to making one for you next time.

assumed.name: Deaconess
assumed.quote: Besides, as a deaconess, I could never simply ignore such a matter.

threads.claim: Barbara's fame means fans constantly interrupt her, leaving her exhausted and unable to say no.
threads.quote: Now, people always stop me on the street when I go shopping, or when I go out for personal matters...

threads.claim: Victoria says the fans are well-meaning but too many, so Barbara must report her plans in case she needs rescuing.
threads.quote: Although the citizens here may only be acting out of good intention, there are too many of them, and Sister Barbara can't handle it all

threads.claim: The usual red Wolfhooks have mysteriously vanished from Wolvendom, suggesting someone gathered them first.
threads.quote: But the strange thing is, there should be lots of them here... and I can't seem to find any.

threads.claim: Barbara wonders whether someone already collected all the red Wolfhooks, and the question stays unanswered.
threads.quote: I wonder if someone had already gathered them all...

threads.claim: The Holy Lyre der Himmel was stolen and repaired by a bard, and the Traveler seems to be hiding something about it.
threads.quote: Barbara: Is there something wrong with the Holy Lyre der Himmel?

threads.claim: Grand Master Varka's expedition has no known purpose and no known return date.
threads.quote: Barbara: But it's been some time since I last saw him, and I'm still uncertain of when Grand Master Varka's expedition will finally be finished.

threads.claim: Cardinal Calvin is secretive and rarely seen, having taken over the Church during the absence of Pegg and Varka.
threads.quote: He's so busy that he seldom ever leaves his room.

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for a sibling across the world, a quest others already know about.
threads.quote: I heard Amber say that you're traveling far and wide, looking for your sibling. Is that true?

threads.claim: A group of Treasure Hoarders is harassing travelers and a merchant near Whispering Woods.
threads.quote: Long story short... I was picking Sweet Flowers, and suddenly a group of Treasure Hoarders appeared.

threads.claim: Uwe, a wounded man who asked for healing, is revealed to be a Treasure Hoarder who feigned injury to exploit travelers.
threads.quote: Uwe: The truth is... I am a Treasure Hoarder. My plan was to feign injury in order to take advantage of the situation...

threads.claim: There is a known idol who once stopped a war with singing, a legend that hints at what song can achieve.
threads.quote: Traveler: There was once an idol who stopped a war with their singing.

threads.claim: Barbara was hiding from Albert to get some quiet, and the Traveler sends Albert away so she can return to the city.
threads.quote: Whew, thank you! Although... I guess I'm not being very polite towards him...

threads.claim: Barbara feels constantly overwhelmed by her fans and craves a private, peaceful life away from them.
threads.quote: Now, people always stop me on the street when I go shopping, or when I go out for personal matters...

threads.claim: Uwe may have had a hidden plan, and Barbara worries there could be accomplices still lurking nearby.
threads.quote: Whatever the case, if he does have others lurking about, we're probably still in danger.

threads.claim: Barbara hints that the god Barbatos is aware of the hidden events, suggesting he watches over Mondstadt.
threads.quote: And we mustn't forget that Barbatos also knows.

introduced.name: Xu
introduced.how: Feiyun Commerce Guild member who introduces himself and says he is traveling with calligraphers, painters, and Theater Mechanicus players
introduced.quote: Xu: Haha. Yes, in fact, we have. I am Xu from Feiyun Commerce Guild.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: guild that Theater Mechanicus's inventor approached for investment and that sent Xu and Master to Inazuma to evaluate the game
introduced.quote: Xu: The inventor of Theater Mechanicus previously came to the Feiyun Commerce Guild seeking investment.

introduced.name: Theater Mechanicus
introduced.how: a game whose inventor sought investment and which is demonstrated to visitors at the Irodori Festival
introduced.quote: Xu: We heard that they'd be demonstrating the game and letting people try Theater Mechanicus at the Irodori Festival.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: self-introduced as the author of A Legend of Sword under the pen name Zhen, now asking to be called by his real name
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: You must be Calx, it's a great pleasure to finally meet you. I am the author of A Legend of Sword, Zhen...

introduced.name: Albedo
introduced.how: introduces himself by his real name, which he offers to Xingqiu in exchange for using real names
introduced.quote: Albedo: And you may call me Albedo, then.

introduced.name: Calx
introduced.how: illustrator for Xingqiu's novels who is known for fast and skilled artwork
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Calx is not only a skilled artist, but he also carries out his craft with great alacrity.

introduced.name: A Legend of Sword
introduced.how: novel by Xingqiu whose illustrations Calx drew and which sells well in Inazuma
introduced.quote: Paimon: Also, we heard that Calx did illustrations for your A Legend of Sword novel.

introduced.name: Poem Hunt
introduced.how: a search for hidden Five Kasen story pieces, with the finder possibly becoming a model for a portrait
introduced.quote: Paimon: If you can find one of the stories and give it to this friend of ours, then there's a chance you'll become the model for the next portrait!

introduced.name: Irodori Festival
introduced.how: a festival whose last phase releases new publications, with visitors from Liyue attending
introduced.quote: Youta: The last phase of the Irodori Festival is when they release all the new publications.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission official who arrested the suspected book thief
introduced.quote: Venti: I just bumped into Kujou Sara a moment ago.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: authority that apprehended the suspect who stole the copies of A Legend of Sword
introduced.quote: Venti: I just bumped into Kujou Sara a moment ago. She said that the Tenryou Commission has apprehended the criminal who stole all those copies of A Legend of Sword.

introduced.name: Onodera
introduced.how: editor who proposed selling signed copies of new novels for the festival and was arrested over the missing books
introduced.quote: Onodera: For the Irodori Festival, I recommended the idea of selling newly released novels signed by the authors.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: publisher of Xingqiu's novels, where Onodera works and which has requested author autographs before
introduced.quote: Onodera: Not only was this the first major project that I was in charge of since joining the Yae Publishing House, but Lady Yae also gave me a lot of support.

introduced.name: Aoi no Okina's coerced theft
introduced.how: Aoi no Okina was forced by an unnamed person to take back a poem and did not know their true intentions
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: This turn of events had begun with an unnamed individual

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Oh... *yawn* It's and Paimon. I presume you are guests in Inazuma as well? It seems fate has destined our paths to cross once again.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Tone-Deaf Bard, what are you doing here...?

assumed.name: Kanjou Commission
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Ah yes, now that we've arrived, the Kanjou Commission will likely wish to inspect our invitation letter.

assumed.name: Guhua Clan
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Haha, it was nothing I couldn't handle. Don't forget, I'm proficient in the arts of the Guhua Clan.

assumed.name: Suikou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Suikou lost Aoi no Okina's poem in a drunken stupor, so Aoi no Okina recovered the poem and gave it to some mysterious person...

assumed.name: The Five Kasen
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, that's it! A friend of ours is on Ritou to paint portraits of The Five Kasen...

assumed.name: Hirayama
assumed.quote: Hirayama: Onodera? What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be on leave these few days?

assumed.name: Kuroda
assumed.quote: Onodera: No need to worry, Zhenyu! I've just explained everything to Madam Kujou, and Kuroda has testified for me.

assumed.name: Lady Yae
assumed.quote: Onodera: Not only was this the first major project that I was in charge of since joining the Yae Publishing House, but Lady Yae also gave me a lot of support.

assumed.name: Shimura Kanbei
assumed.quote: Shimura Kanbei: A few days ago, a handsome young fellow came here to eat.

threads.claim: An unseen person has been leaving story pieces that guide the guests, and Paimon wonders if they are hiding nearby.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, hellooo! Mr. story writer! Are you here? Uh, could you please help Xingqiu with something?

threads.claim: The mysterious person is thanked for leaving important information, and a sound during the scene suggests someone is secretly listening.
threads.quote: Venti: We also owe a special ode of gratitude to the mysterious person who has been leaving important info for us along the way.

threads.claim: The hidden listener stays concealed, as the sound turns out to be only a cat.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hehe, it was just a cat. Looks like we can't make them reveal themselves that easily.

threads.claim: Aoi no Okina was forced by an unnamed person to steal back a poem, and that person's true intentions remain unknown.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: The poem had to do with an old acquaintance, Akahito

threads.claim: Xingqiu admits he had already come to Inazuma earlier to handle matters, explaining his earlier lie.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: I did in fact come to Inazuma early to handle some things.

introduced.name: The Crux
introduced.how: an armed fleet that works like a maritime guard-for-hire and carries goods for income
introduced.quote: You may be aware that as an armed fleet, The Crux is kinda like the maritime equivalent of a Guard for Hire.

introduced.name: The Shield of The Crux
introduced.how: the support team for the fleet that learns survival, navigation, and rescue skills
introduced.quote: They will serve as the support team for the fleet, ensuring safe navigation.

introduced.name: The Spear of The Crux
introduced.how: the armed crew team trained in naval warfare that also handles cargo deals
introduced.quote: They will make up the armed portion of our crew.

introduced.name: The Alcor
introduced.how: the fleet's main ship, used only to deter or destroy, with negotiation preferred
introduced.quote: The Alcor serves only two purposes, to deter or to destroy.

introduced.name: Skirmish Boat
introduced.how: older small armed attack craft kept as backup on The Alcor for training
introduced.quote: These are some older Skirmish Boats that we keep on The Alcor as backup.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: a Liyue authority that keeps watch lists and approves trade paperwork as a security precaution
introduced.quote: In their words, it's a security precaution to prevent people like us from causing unnecessary trouble.

introduced.name: Mora-Grubber
introduced.how: Beidou's accountant who oversees the trade side of the fleet's business
introduced.quote: Did you figure it out yet? That's right, Mora-Grubber, the accountant.

introduced.name: coded trade names
introduced.how: the fleet's illicit deals use code names like bass and fishmonger shops as cover
introduced.quote: The bass, obviously, is the code name for the goods.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a gang of treasure diggers in Guili Plains
introduced.quote: Oh, it's a bunch of Treasure Hoarders... I guess the treasure's for real, then.

introduced.name: Golden Alligator
introduced.how: the leader of the Treasure Hoarders who surrenders to Beidou and later asks to reform
introduced.quote: Keep digging, boys! Once we have our hands on the treasure, everyone gets a share!

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: a bank where a check can be exchanged for Mora
introduced.quote: To us, this is just a check that you can exchange at Northland Bank for some Mora.

introduced.name: Minamoto Kotomi
introduced.how: the elderly mother of the dead Inazuman sailor, living alone in Guili Plains
introduced.quote: Her name is Minamoto Kotomi, and she lives in the Guili Plains.

introduced.name: Sakura Blooms
introduced.how: flowers from Inazuma that the Traveler collected to send home
introduced.quote: I have some Sakura Blooms that I picked up in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Furong
introduced.how: a Crux crew member who greets the Traveler and was told the Traveler was invited to the homecoming
introduced.quote: Ahoy there, Traveler. Hah, so Captain really did invite you to join the homecoming celebration!

introduced.name: shipwreck treasure map
introduced.how: a Liyue treasure map found in a shipwreck near Ritou, which led to the Guili Plains hunt
introduced.quote: So after we dropped you off in Ritou, we found a shipwreck nearby.

introduced.name: Yinxing
introduced.how: The Crux's surgeon at sea who treats sailors' health problems
introduced.quote: Hello, Traveler. I am Yinxing, The Crux's surgeon at sea.

introduced.name: Huixing
introduced.how: The Crux's navigator, presented as a skilled chart reader
introduced.quote: I'm not just blowing smoke, you're looking at the most talented navigator in Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Xu Liushi
introduced.how: A lookout for The Crux who teaches marine meteorology and waterspout warning signs
introduced.quote: Hello, Traveler. Are you here to learn about marine meteorology?

introduced.name: Mora-Grubber
introduced.how: The Crux's bookkeeper who handles the fleet's finances
introduced.quote: Do you know what Mora-Grubber, our bookkeeper, calls this?

introduced.name: Juza
introduced.how: Crew member who keeps the training schedule and reports to the Captain
introduced.quote: let's stick to the training schedule drawn up by Juza.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: Elder of Qingce Village who asks Beidou to settle the villagers' disputes
introduced.quote: Ah, Beidou! Wow, and the Traveler... my goodness, what's the occasion?

introduced.name: Wenjing
introduced.how: Qingce Village farmer whose crops were ruined by Ji's finches
introduced.quote: Oh, thank goodness, it's Captain Beidou! You couldn't have come at a better time.

introduced.name: Ji
introduced.how: Qingce Village man who fed wild finches until they became a flock that raided crops
introduced.quote: Captain, I'm innocent... they're not even my finches!

introduced.name: Ren
introduced.how: Qingce Village man whose tree blocks his neighbor's sunlight, planted as his late father's wish
introduced.quote: Captain Beidou, you gotta believe me, I didn't intend to block the sunlight, but there's nothing I can do about it now.

introduced.name: Pops Xing
introduced.how: Qingce Village neighbor who wants the sunlight back from Ren's tree
introduced.quote: I've been having some real trouble with that neighbor of mine, Ren.

introduced.name: Changping
introduced.how: Qingce Village man who plowed up a treasure chest while helping Defu
introduced.quote: Huh? Beidou!? You're just in time. Defu is being completely unreasonable!

introduced.name: Defu
introduced.how: Qingce Village landowner who claims the treasure chest found on his field
introduced.quote: I got Changping to help me plow my land, because it's the busy season.

introduced.name: The Crux
introduced.how: A fleet with a captain, navigator, surgeon, lookouts and bookkeeper, training newcomers at sea
introduced.quote: It's worth mentioning that under my direction, The Crux is using these advanced kinds of charts!

introduced.name: The Shield of The Crux
introduced.how: A newcomer training program the Traveler must pass to qualify as crew
introduced.quote: You sound confident, but don't underestimate The Shield of The Crux.

introduced.name: Convalescence Payments
introduced.how: A fixed yearly fund that compensates injured crew members who served the fleet
introduced.quote: Regardless of the fleet's income, those who have fought alongside us will certainly receive their compensation every year.

introduced.name: Downriver
introduced.how: A deserted fishing village near Wangshu Inn where Beidou grew up
introduced.quote: Now, Upriver is long gone and Downriver is all but deserted.

introduced.name: Beidou's childhood in Downriver
introduced.how: Beidou arrived there as a homeless child of about five or six and was taken in by villagers
introduced.quote: I was only about five or six years old when I first arrived here.

introduced.name: Beidou's expulsion from Downriver
introduced.how: Villagers blamed Beidou for the village's decline and drove her out
introduced.quote: Then some of the villagers started shouting and drove me out of the village.

introduced.name: Beidou constellation and the Alcor omen
introduced.how: Beidou's name comes from a constellation, and its star Alcor was seen as an omen of death
introduced.quote: It wasn't until then that I realized that Beidou was a constellation, and the Alcor, one of its stars, was an omen of death.

introduced.name: Favors as bonds
introduced.how: Beidou's view that favors and mutual debts link people into a safety net
introduced.quote: But the way I see it, favors are what keep people connected to one another.

introduced.name: Treasure chest at Qingce Village

threads.claim: Clervie's true identity is left unexplained, as she is a phantom child the House has been hunting.
threads.quote: Lyney is unaware of anyone named Clervie, only to realize that she's the

threads.claim: Arlecchino explains that Clervie is a shadow formed from the power in her veins, left behind by what she consumed.
threads.quote: Arlecchino explains that she had a certain power in her veins that left behind shadows of everything they consumed.

threads.claim: The House's darkness is said to be deeper than imagined, and no one can get out of it alive.
threads.quote: The darkness in the House runs deeper than you can imagine. No one can get out alive.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses that the House's inescapable darkness cannot be as simple as it looks.
threads.quote: The Traveler recalls her earlier words about how no one can get out alive once they enter the House.

threads.claim: Arlecchino is not really Fontainian, and she has hidden this from others for convenience.
threads.quote: She reveals that she herself is not an actual Fontainian, though she misled others into believing so for convenience.

threads.claim: Arlecchino reveals her past at a ruin, including the events that made her a Harbinger.
threads.quote: At some nameless ruins at Mont Esus East, Arlecchino reveals her past to the two.

threads.claim: Project Stuzha is raised as a plan that Childe dislikes and that Arlecchino is involved with.
threads.quote: Arlecchino then mentions "Project Stuzha" with Regrator, which Childe is not eager to participate in.

threads.claim: Lyney suspects Project Stuzha is causing the tensions inside the House, though he is unsure.
threads.quote: While Lyney believes some of the claims are false, he believes that Project Stuzha is playing a role in the dissonance.

threads.claim: Dottore once proposed working with Arlecchino, and the Traveler wonders whether they cooperated.
threads.quote: Dottore had proposed that the two work together, though she quickly rejected all his plans but one.

threads.claim: Inside the House, some members are treated as family while others are merely test subjects.
threads.quote: In this House, some people are "family" and other people... are just "test subjects."

threads.claim: Clervie's wish is to go outside where the sun can find her, a longing for freedom from the House.
threads.quote: Where the sun can find me.

threads.claim: Arlecchino releases Clervie from the House at dawn, fulfilling her wish to leave the nightmare.
threads.quote: as dawn rises, Arlecchino releases Clervie from the House, fulfilling her dream of leaving the nightmare.

threads.claim: A list of executions may show whether Clervie was ever a member of the House.
threads.quote: Lynette tries to look for the list she mentioned earlier.

threads.claim: The execution list is obtained, but Clervie's name is not on it, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Lynette was successful in obtaining the execution list, though they are not able to find her name on it.

threads.claim: Members of the House often feel haunted and hear voices, a sign of spirits in the House.
threads.quote: That feeling of being "haunted," of hearing voices... It's happened many times in the House of the Hearth.

threads.claim: Freminet concludes that the voice he heard came from Clervie, the spirit of the House.
threads.quote: Unless there are other spirits roaming around the House of the Hearth, I don't think there's any other possibility.

threads.claim: Clervie vanishes when pulled into sunlight, hinting she is not fully corporeal.
threads.quote: But as I led her out of the shadows and into the sunlight, she vanished.

threads.claim: Clervie appears only in shadows and may be a spirit whose nature is still unclear.
threads.quote: She's a spirit. It could be anything.

threads.claim: The Knave is said to have betrayed the House of the Hearth once, and the truth is left open.
threads.quote: Well, you've already betrayed the House of the Hearth once, haven't you?

threads.claim: The Knave says she posed as a Fontainian to protect children, but her past remains unresolved.
threads.quote: I was trying to protect the children born in Fontaine.

threads.claim: Clervie accuses The Knave of treating her children as test subjects, a claim left unresolved.
threads.quote: Does The Knave really treat her children like test subjects?

threads.claim: Clervie claims members who lose value are handed to The Doctor for experiments.
threads.quote: Lose your value... and you're handed over to The Doctor, experimented on, and given a fate worse than death.

threads.claim: Betraying the House is punished by death, which Lyney presents as a firm House rule.
threads.quote: So, if you do try to leave, you pay with your life.

threads.claim: Project Stuzha comes up repeatedly while its details remain unknown to the Traveler.
threads.quote: I heard Regrator's involved too.

threads.claim: The House has been given a key but dangerous role in Project Stuzha, which the members feel as an inconvenience.
threads.quote: Because the House of the Hearth was so successful in obtaining the Gnosis, we now have the honor of playing a key role in Project Stuzha.

threads.claim: Filliol and Nanteuil are suspected of plotting against the House, and The Knave is aware of it.
threads.quote: Although there's that situation with Filliol and Nanteuil as well...

threads.claim: The Knave refuses to explain why members call her Father, leaving the title's meaning open.
threads.quote: Telling you the answer to that question would only serve to undermine that success

threads.claim: The Doctor once proposed a secret experiment to the House, which may be linked to Clervie's accusations.
threads.quote: It had to do with some sort of secret experiment.

threads.claim: Perrie is a missing girl Clervie is searching for, and her fate is left unknown.
threads.quote: But I can't find her.

threads.claim: The Knave intends to withdraw from Fontaine and let her family's rivers reach their own destinations, using a water analogy.
threads.quote: I would hope that each river that flows from the source will eventually reach the ocean.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses the Newsboy looks familiar, hinting he may be someone known.
threads.quote: He looks kind of familiar for some reason...

threads.claim: The Knave asks the Traveler to help the House when the time comes, without defining when.
threads.quote: When the time comes, make the choice that you deem most appropriate in the situation, and lend your help to the House of the Hearth.

threads.claim: Neuvillette asks whether assassinations like Tartuffe's will stop crossing his desk, and the Knave deflects.
threads.quote: in the future, cases similar to the Tartuffe assassination will cease to cross my desk?

threads.claim: Neuvillette cannot sense the Knave's emotions and calls her a very dangerous individual.
threads.quote: Either scenario, however, suggests she is a very dangerous individual.

threads.claim: Clervie is a shadow left behind by the Knave's flames, trapped as her six-year-old self with most of her memories lost.
threads.quote: Clervie died when she was sixteen years old, but what emerged from the flames was her six-year-old self.

threads.claim: Clervie's shadow resets and dissolves at dawn, ending her trapped existence.
threads.quote: But, a shadow's memories reset at dawn.

threads.claim: The Knave hints that a crimson moon will rise during the winter blizzards, a plan still to come.
threads.quote: a crimson moon shall rise amid the frigid blizzards of winter.

threads.claim: The Knave has a power in her veins that works like a curse, leaving shadows of whatever her flames consume.
threads.quote: You see, a certain power runs through my veins. It's not unlike a curse.

threads.claim: The Knave offers House children freedom to leave with their memories wiped, but only to those who earn it.
threads.quote: I've tried to give them the most basic of freedoms — the freedom to choose their own fate.

threads.claim: Perrie, the friend Clervie mentioned, is revealed to be the same person as the Knave.
threads.quote: It was you all along.

threads.claim: Clervie and Peruere promised to see the aurora together in Snezhnaya, a promise left unfulfilled.
threads.quote: we promised each other we would go to Snezhnaya to see it together.

threads.claim: The Knave saw the aurora in Snezhnaya and wished she could have told Clervie it was as beautiful as the pictures.
threads.quote: I wanted to tell her that the aurora I saw in Snezhnaya was just as beautiful as the ones in the pictures.

threads.claim: The House's principle is that only the survivors get to write the rules.
threads.quote: It's one of the principles of the House — only those who survive get to write the rules.

threads.claim: Losing memories alters a person's sense of self, and the bottled flames are used to erase the House past from members.
threads.quote: Losing a portion of your memories will alter your sense of self.

threads.claim: Lyney doubts he deserves the throne, and the Knave says conviction and strength are what matter.
threads.quote: I just... never understood what you saw in me... what made you believe I was deserving of that throne.

threads.claim: Crucabena died a year after Clervie, killed by Peruere, and the Knave burned her files afterward.
threads.quote: Crucabena died a year after Clervie.

introduced.name: Chiori's vow to Inazuman masters

introduced.quote: Chiori: I was angry and frustrated, so before I left, I swore to all those

introduced.how: the two were once young designers who worked together in Fontaine before splitting up
introduced.quote: When I first came to Fontaine, we were both fledging designers who longed to gain a foothold in the world of fashion.

introduced.name: Fashion Week

introduced.name: Chioriya Boutique

introduced.name: Charlotte

introduced.quote: It's my pleasure! Bringing the truth to light is a journalist's duty.

assumed.name: Navia

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I still have a certain partiality to Inazuma-made fabrics.

assumed.quote: Or Treasure Hoarders?

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: How about a game of Genius Invokation TCG?

assumed.quote: Chiori: Tsk... Uther again...

assumed.name: Eloffe

assumed.name: Charlotte

assumed.name: Chiori

assumed.name: Eloffe
assumed.quote: I've handed the rest over to Eloffe.

assumed.name: Navia

assumed.name: Spina di Rosula
assumed.quote: The Spina's way ahead of you in that regard!

assumed.name: Steambird
assumed.quote: You can expect the article in tomorrow's Steambird, along with the evidence gathered!

assumed.name: Monsieur Verite
assumed.quote: Going forward, feel free to custom-order any accessories you need for Monsieur Verite.

assumed.name: Wenger
assumed.quote: I ran into Wenger on the way here. He had a message for you.

assumed.name: Emilie
assumed.quote: Thank you, Ms. Chiori, for your feedback on the fragrances.

assumed.name: Pers

assumed.name: Natlan

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Snezhnayan designs can be used as reference for winter wear...

threads.claim: Uther hired bandits to intercept Chiori's delivery and is trying to ruin her name.
threads.quote: Kirara then tells them that the person who ordered the hit was Uther, who Chiori recognizes.

threads.claim: Uther refuses to accept his defeat and threatens that the feud is not over.
threads.quote: ...We'll see about that.

threads.claim: Uther's factory is exposed as producing clothes under unsanitary conditions with harmful chemicals.
threads.quote: they discover that Uther was producing clothes from unsanitary conditions and using chemical processes

threads.claim: Someone paid tabloids to run the same false article across the city to smear Chiori before Fashion Week.
threads.quote: Someone had paid them to publish the same article at once, dropping them at every home in the city.

threads.claim: Rumors claim Chiori's fabric came from underground factories, which may hint at real wrongdoing.
threads.quote: the fabric she uses was provided by underground factories

threads.claim: Chiori's rival is shown running an illegal underground factory, confirming the rumors had a basis.
threads.quote: they discover that Uther was producing clothes from unsanitary conditions and using chemical processes

threads.claim: A secret elevator in Uther's factory leads deeper, guarded by mechanical Meka.
threads.quote: guarded by Clockwork Meka

threads.claim: Chiori was a spoiled, troublesome child whose needlework talent led to tailoring training she resented.
threads.quote: she was raised as a seemingly spoiled and troublesome child by her parents

threads.claim: Chiori held back against Uther out of their former partnership, and her quitting-free persistence set them apart.
threads.quote: Having held back because of their former partnership, Chiori proclaims that she'll show him the true meaning of her business

threads.claim: Chiori owes Chevreuse favors and keeps collecting on a trade of information for protection.
threads.quote: Chiori asks Chevreuse for a future favor.

threads.claim: Chiori asks Chevreuse for yet another favor, showing their favor exchange continues.
threads.quote: there's another favor I'd like to ask of you today.

threads.claim: Chiori argues fashion represents the spirit of the times and that a brand's vision draws its patrons.
threads.quote: is just a representation of the spirit of the times.

threads.claim: Chiori aims to make her brand famous across all of Teyvat.
threads.quote: My goal is to make the Chioriya brand renowned throughout all of Teyvat.

threads.claim: Chiori suspects Uther orchestrated the trap that framed her, including the staged attack and the tabloid article.
threads.quote: Chiori: Tch... I should have seen it from the beginning. Uther knows me too well. Everything that happened yesterday... was just a trap.

threads.claim: Tabloids spread the claim that Chioriya Boutique works with criminals, and the truth of it remains open.
threads.quote: Weis: Haven't you heard? Chioriya Boutique has been exposed for having close ties with criminals. It's all over the papers!

threads.claim: Wenger's father once served time in the Fortress of Meropide, a past that is being used against the Wenger family.
threads.quote: They even dug up the fact that my father once served time in the Fortress of Meropide.

threads.claim: Leeann cancelled her gown order for a hidden reason that she will not explain to the Traveler or Paimon.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is it just Paimon, or was she acting a bit strange just now... Wonder why she wouldn't tell us why she was cancelling her order...

threads.claim: Laetitia reveals she cancelled the order because her family lost money, and Chiori promised to still deliver the dress.
threads.quote: Laetitia: Yes... When I came to cancel the order, she asked if something happened, and I told her everything...

threads.claim: Chiori's vow to Inazuman masters to make her brand famous drives her refusal to back down.
threads.quote: Chiori: I was angry and frustrated, so before I left, I swore to all those

threads.claim: What happened between Chiori and Uther after their split, and why he turned hostile, remains unexplained.
threads.quote: I don't know the exact details of what happened after that. All I know is, after I opened Chioriya Boutique, he's harassed me every year since.

threads.claim: Uther gave up on his dream and now seems driven by bitterness and regret.
threads.quote: You gave up on your dream, but that wasn't enough, was it?

threads.claim: Uther's factory may be tied to a clandestine illicit deal involving a judge.
threads.quote: The Gardes suspect the judge... clandestine illicit deal.

threads.claim: An employee overheard a deal between a superior and someone in the store, suggesting a wider conspiracy.
threads.quote: Maison Gardiennage... employee... speaking in the store of a deal between their superior and... tone was conclusive...

threads.claim: A wanted criminal may have been seen coming and going, though the sighting may only be a rumor.
threads.quote: Someone... witnessed a wanted criminal... coming and going. I fear that is just a rumor...

threads.claim: The evidence gathered from Uther's factory is set to be published, exposing his operation.
threads.quote: You can expect the article in tomorrow's Steambird, along with the evidence gathered!

threads.claim: Kirara's departure from Fontaine is being planned, with the Spina preparing a vehicle to help her leave.
threads.quote: Actually, that reminds me... When will you be leaving, Kirara?

threads.claim: Wenger has sent Chiori an apology message that she has chosen not to hear yet.
threads.quote: I ran into Wenger on the way here. He had a message for you.

threads.claim: Fashion is presented as an aspiration toward an ideal that each designer must define for themselves.
threads.quote: Fashion is about aspiring towards a certain ideal, but it's up to you to decide what it is.

threads.claim: Chiori argues that those who chase their dreams, even foolishly, are braver than those too afraid to try.
threads.quote: But more pitiful still are cowards who are too afraid to even attempt what the fool is brave enough to try.

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: Self-introduces as Captain of the Special Patrol who is pursuing Morris for murder
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: I'm Captain Chevreuse of the Special Patrol

introduced.name: Morris
introduced.how: Introduced as the film's original investor and revealed as the man who hired Elisa's killer
introduced.quote: Xavier: The original investor of our film, Mr. Morris.

introduced.name: Veronique
introduced.how: Revealed as the film's prop manager who shot at Morris and is Baptiste's sister seeking revenge
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: Prop Manager Veronique

introduced.name: Baptiste
introduced.how: Revealed as Veronique's brother who falsely confessed to the killing to cover for her
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: He confessed faster than any criminal I've ever met, but he didn't say a single word about you.

introduced.name: Elisa
introduced.how: Explained as a former maid whom Morris got pregnant and later had murdered
introduced.quote: Morris: She once worked as a maid on my family's estate. She was very beautiful, and after some time I fell for her.

introduced.name: Elisa's murder
introduced.how: Morris admits hiring an assassin to kill Elisa twenty years earlier to hide his affair
introduced.quote: Morris: I hired an assassin to murder Elisa.

introduced.name: Special Patrol
introduced.how: Presented as the police-like force Chevreuse belongs to that makes arrests and handles cases
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: I'm Captain Chevreuse of the Special Patrol

introduced.name: Fontaine as Nation of Justice
introduced.how: Explained that Fontaine's identity rests on its laws and standardized code of justice
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: Fontaine is founded on a set of laws and a standardized code of justice. That is why we are the Nation of Justice.

introduced.name: The Two Musketeers
introduced.how: Explained as the film entered in the Festival, written by Morris and filmed by the crew
introduced.quote: Furina: I would like to officially announce that our entry to the Festival, "The Two Musketeers," has now concluded filming!

introduced.name: Chevreuse's childhood sea swim
introduced.how: Told that her father forced her to swim across icy water as a child, shaping her resolve
introduced.quote: Chevreuse: One winter, the chilly wind felt almost like knives on my skin, and the seawater was so frigid that it numbed my toes the moment I stepped in.

assumed.name: Yoimiya
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Goooood morning! Ayaka and I were just talking about you!

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: We were also planning on having a victory feast once we're all finished filming. You can join us, right?

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Huh? But that's such a pity... Director Furina said that we've only got a few small scenes left before wrapping up the entire thing!

assumed.name: Chiori
assumed.quote: Chiori: I'm afraid that can't be helped. Those Special Patrol folks are like phantoms when they've got a case on their hands.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: That's right. Ayato should be here any minute.

assumed.name: Xavier
assumed.quote: Paimon: Xavier! Feels like it's been ages since we last saw you.

assumed.name: Bonnot
assumed.quote: Bonnot: Director! Director!! We have a problem!

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh wait... Wouldn't Yae Miko get upset if that happens? That would be stealing some of her business.

assumed.name: Fontaine Fashion Week
assumed.quote: Chiori: Not particularly, but this is still better than Fontaine Fashion Week.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: So the next time we visit, we'll be doing so in our capacities as the representatives of the Yashiro Commission.

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Person Chatting in the Street: I heard that the chief of the Gardes is so mad about not catching the culprit that he's about to explode!

assumed.name: Wriothesley
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: If I had to guess, they'll probably all be sent to the Fortress of Meropide. I'll make sure to give Wriothesley a heads-up about it.

assumed.name: Letellier
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: Thank you so much, Yoimiya. Letellier, Turenna, please take them away.

assumed.name: Turenna
assumed.quote: Chevreuse: Thank you so much, Yoimiya. Letellier, Turenna, please take them away.

threads.claim: The film's Kamera and lens were tampered with, and the sabotage's culprit is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Veronique: The people at the workshop told me that the part which holds the lens in place seemed to have fallen off. That's super strange... It was perfectly fine just yesterday.

threads.claim: Morris is revealed to have caused the film's mishaps to sabotage the production because he wanted it to fail.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: With the killer in custody, he figured it was safe to act. And so he came to visit the set today, just as I expected.

threads.claim: Veronique is exposed as the hidden second musketeer who acted alongside Baptiste.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: I should call you... "The Second Musketeer"?

threads.claim: Baptiste's confession was false, a decoy so his partner could strike at Morris.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: Based on that, I determined that he was not acting alone. He only surrendered himself to draw our attention and create a moment of opportunity for his partner.

threads.claim: Veronique wants personal revenge while Chevreuse insists that justice must come through law rather than vengeance.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: Because that should never be how justice is carried out in this world!

threads.claim: Fontaine's identity as the Nation of Justice is tied to its codified laws, which Chevreuse defends.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: Fontaine is founded on a set of laws and a standardized code of justice. That is why we are the Nation of Justice.

threads.claim: Elisa secretly raised two children from Morris's affair, and their identities and fates are left open.
threads.quote: Morris: But then years later, she sent me a letter. There were photos of two children, and she even asked if I could find some time to visit them...

threads.claim: The Rainbow Roses blooming at Baptiste's house raise the question of their significance to the case.
threads.quote: Chevreuse: The Rainbow Roses in the garden... They're in full bloom now.

introduced.quote: Paimon remembers you! You're Childe's master! Sk... ork?

introduced.name: Ajax

introduced.quote: Ajax... Oh, right! That's Childe's real name.

introduced.name: Surtalogi
introduced.how: Skirk's master, a figure who inspired Skofnungr to fight for his life and later left for the stars
introduced.quote: until he met Surtalogi, who told him to fight for his life.

introduced.name: Stella Fortuna
introduced.how: Stars believed to correspond to powerful individuals, evolving into constellations when those individuals fall

introduced.name: god remains
introduced.how: Remnants of fallen gods buried in the earth, carrying a warped will and a dark curse

introduced.name: dream-mirroring
introduced.how: Sharing another person's dream, seeing everything they see, think and feel
introduced.quote: It means experiencing whatever the other person is dreaming. Everything they see, think, and feel.

introduced.name: Skirk's inner world
introduced.how: Abyssal space where Skirk lives, where time passes far slower than outside
introduced.quote: This is where I live. I suppose it's the closest thing I have to a "home" here.

introduced.name: Ronova's curse on Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: After a cataclysm, Ronova cursed the people of Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: After the cataclysm, when Ronova cursed the people of Khaenri'ah, Surtalogi met with Skofnungr a final time

introduced.name: Skirk
introduced.how: A sword and elemental trainer who reveals her Abyssal powers and is later revealed to be a visitor from another planet
introduced.quote: Skirk: Your training will be split into three stages, testing your bladework, elemental abilities, and reasoning skills.

introduced.name: Surtalogi
introduced.how: Skirk's master and an expert in Abyssal power
introduced.quote: Skirk: My master, Surtalogi, is a true expert in that area.

introduced.name: Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah

introduced.how: The realm that is the source of Abyssal power
introduced.quote: Skirk: Abyssal power, yes. Also known as the power of the Void Realm.

introduced.name: Light Realm
introduced.how: The realm that is the source of Teyvat's elemental energy, opposed to the Abyss
introduced.quote: The elemental energy of Teyvat, on the other hand, is derived from the power of the Light Realm.

introduced.name: Seven-Shifting Serpent

introduced.quote: It can extract power from anything, dead or alive, as long as it manages to make physical contact.

introduced.name: Starcrystal Suit
introduced.how: Skirk's outfit that stores concentrated Abyssal energy she can draw on
introduced.quote: Skirk: It stores concentrated Abyssal energy that I can draw from on the go.

introduced.name: Abyssal rift
introduced.how: Portals Skirk opens to reach hidden Abyssal domains
introduced.quote: Skirk: Just follow me. I'll open an Abyssal rift close to the culprit's location.

introduced.name: Skirk's village fire
introduced.how: Skirk's childhood village is attacked and burned by soldiers, and her parents are wounded while she flees
introduced.quote: (Skirk finds her village on fire)

introduced.name: Ajax
introduced.how: Skirk's former student, the young man who is Childe
introduced.quote: Skirk: When Ajax trained with me, he once told me he was

introduced.name: Alice

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: A doctor who treated the Traveler and offers them rooms at the pharmacy

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: A pharmacy whose back rooms the party uses to rest
introduced.quote: (Enter the back room of Bubu Pharmacy)

introduced.name: Strange Creature
introduced.how: A creature that appears in Skirk's dreamscape and leads the Traveler through her memories
introduced.quote: Traveler: (What a strange-looking creature — where did it come from? ...I think it wants me to follow it. Might as well see where it leads.)

introduced.quote: But Skirk said the dream-mirroring would kick in when I fall asleep

introduced.name: Skirk's inner world

introduced.name: Surtalogi

introduced.name: Skofnungr

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah

threads.claim: A fragment of the Traveler's soul was stolen by an unknown entity hiding in the Abyss.
threads.quote: The thief who stole that fragment of your soul is hiding there.

threads.claim: Skirk extracts the stolen soul fragment from the culprit and returns it to the Traveler.
threads.quote: though she crushes it and extracts the stolen soul fragment, returning it to the Traveler.

threads.claim: A parasitic entity is stealing power from across the world, including god remains and stars.
threads.quote: Something has been leeching power from this world like a parasite steals nutrients from a host.

threads.claim: Stella Fortuna are disappearing from the sky at an alarming rate.
threads.quote: Forty-two of them have died out in the past few months alone.

threads.claim: The Traveler's damaged soul bears traces of Abyssal corrosion, a mystery left unexplained.
threads.quote: Part of your soul is damaged, and the wound bears traces of Abyssal corrosion. Need I say more?

threads.claim: Abyssal power may be a dangerous force or a controllable tool, depending on perspective.
threads.quote: Floods and hurricanes take countless lives too, but if one day you gained the power to control them, what was once a calamity is now just another tool in your arsenal.

threads.claim: Skirk's past involves a merchant ship and the destruction of her village, hinting at why she distrusts others.
threads.quote: Skirk was obsessed with the outside after a merchant ship arrived on their planet, and went out to gaze at the stars.

threads.claim: Surtalogi is a powerful figure whose strength Skirk seeks to surpass, and the culprit knows him.
threads.quote: She then realizes that the entity must know Surtalogi and calls him by his title

threads.claim: A cataclysm led Ronova to curse the people of Khaenri'ah, a past event still unexplained.
threads.quote: After the cataclysm, when Ronova cursed the people of Khaenri'ah, Surtalogi met with Skofnungr a final time

threads.claim: The culprit is revealed to be Skofnungr, a Khaenri'ahn man who absorbed narwhal flesh.
threads.quote: This results in the entity's armor shattering, revealing a Khaenri'ahn man inside it.

threads.claim: Skofnungr gained power by grafting narwhal flesh into his heart, which also caused him pain.
threads.quote: Skofnungr then coughs after finishing his story, stating that despite his curse, the powers he absorbed still brought him pain.

threads.claim: The Traveler's ability to purify Abyssal energy made them a target for the culprit.
threads.quote: their ability to "purify" Abyssal energy was significant

threads.claim: Skirk accepts her suppressed emotions after the Traveler helps her face them.
threads.quote: Skirk ultimately accepts her emotions and the Traveler offers to assist her in her fight against Surtalogi if the time came.

threads.claim: Young Skirk wonders what lies beyond the stars and longs to meet others who ask the same questions.
threads.quote: But, what lies beyond the stars?)

threads.claim: Skirk reveals she is from a different planet and once journeyed through the stars.
threads.quote: Skirk: No, I'm not from Teyvat. I'm from a different planet, and there was a time when I journeyed through the stars — a lot like you, in some ways.

threads.claim: The cause of the fire that destroyed Skirk's village and wounded her parents is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Skirk: Fire... There's fire everywhere! What happened?

threads.claim: Surtalogi hints that the people of Skirk's homeland were destroyed by enemies who wanted them gone.
threads.quote: Surtalogi: I now understand why these people sought to destroy your homeland.

threads.claim: Skirk's sole goal is to follow Surtalogi's path and find a way to defeat him.
threads.quote: To do that, I need to follow in his footsteps, walk the path he once walked. And somewhere along the way, I'll find out how to defeat him.

threads.claim: The hidden culprit reacts strongly to Surtalogi's name, hinting he knew the master.
threads.quote: ???: Surta... logi...!

threads.claim: Skirk deduces the culprit must have known Surtalogi because only he could have given the thief the Narwhal's power.
threads.quote: Which leaves one possibility — you know my master,

threads.claim: The culprit took part of the Traveler's soul and must be found to get it back.
threads.quote: Skirk: Second, I've located the culprit we've been searching for.

threads.claim: Skirk retrieves the Traveler's soul fragment from the spike and returns it to them.
threads.quote: Skirk: There. I got it back.

threads.claim: Skirk will only allow Ajax to meet her again once he is strong enough on his own.
threads.quote: Skirk: Once Ajax has enough strength in his own right, I will allow us to meet again.

threads.claim: Childe has searched for years for Skirk and the unknown abyss where he met her.
threads.quote: Childe: You make it sound so easy. Ever since the incident I experienced there, I've never stopped searching for Master Skirk and that unknown abyss.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Skirk's calm answers hide her real feelings.
threads.quote: Traveler: (She makes it sound like the decision has everything to do with Childe and nothing to do with her. But, what does she actually feel about it?)

threads.claim: Skirk claims she has no desire to connect with the world and thinks the weak have no right to remember her.
threads.quote: Skirk: Unlike you, I have no desire to establish a connection with the world.

threads.claim: Skirk lost some of her power when the spike stabbed her, and she recovers more slowly than before.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Skirk was stabbed by one of the spikes while retrieving the fragment of my soul, and in the process, some of her power was stolen.)

threads.claim: Skirk doubts that the Traveler's purification truly removes Abyssal power, since power does not simply disappear.
threads.quote: But... Is "purification" really what's going on there?

threads.claim: The culprit used the Traveler's ability to purify Abyssal power to break through Skirk's defenses and steal her power.
threads.quote: It's also because of your ability to, as you put it,

threads.claim: The Traveler can use elements without a Vision because their power does not need the gods' approval.
threads.quote: It means your aspirations need no approval from the gods.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects dream-mirroring works both ways and that they might be seeing into Skirk's mind.
threads.quote: Maybe I'm seeing inside her mind while she's exploring mine?

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders what the Strange Creature is and why it is in Skirk's inner world.
threads.quote: What is that thing? What is it doing in Skirk's inner world?

threads.claim: Disembodied voices in Skirk's mind taunt her and keep her from resting.
threads.quote: Bewitching Voice: Pathetic... You're not even trying.

threads.claim: The Traveler sees that Skirk trains alone while disembodied voices speak to her.
threads.quote: Right! In that dream I witnessed, Skirk was training alone, but there were disembodied voices talking to her.

threads.claim: Surtalogi vows to destroy the life Skirk rebuilds, keeping her in fear of him.
threads.quote: One day, I will take the life you work so hard to rebuild and reduce it to ashes

threads.claim: The true cause of the childhood disaster and Surtalogi's motives for saving Skirk remain unexplained.
threads.quote: What really happened with the disaster back then?

threads.claim: Skirk's people were destroyed because outsiders feared their latent ability to adapt to any environment.
threads.quote: Because she and her people were seen as a "threat."

threads.claim: The stars lost their light when Skofnungr stole Skirk's power and regained it once that power was returned.
threads.quote: Yes, the power Skofnungr stole has been returned. So, the stars have regained their light.

threads.claim: The sky above is a fabricated illusion whose beauty still brings Skirk a fleeting peace.
threads.quote: It's not real, and yet... it is for that very reason that I can look upon it and enjoy the momentary peace it brings.

threads.claim: Vedrfolnir prophesied that Surtalogi's disciple would make the stars bow in her honor.
threads.quote: All Vedrfolnir said was that, one day, "the stars shall bow in her honor."

threads.claim: Surtalogi views freedom as letting even the wicked make their own choices.
threads.quote: Freedom means even the wicked get to make their own choices.

threads.claim: Skirk's reliance on reason over emotion is challenged by her suppressed emotional self.
threads.quote: Emotion gives warmth to the cold expanse of space. It gives meaning to the world around us.

threads.claim: Skofnungr's immortality curse sustains him through power he cannot control, and Skirk offers a way to heal him.
threads.quote: The impurities will dissipate, and under the curse of immortality, your mind and body will regenerate.

introduced.name: Danica

introduced.quote: This is Danica, my Head Maid and trusted personal attendant.

introduced.name: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya

introduced.quote: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya

introduced.name: Vesna

introduced.quote: This is Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna, and a fae of the Vila race.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: The Tsaritsa's palace, standing solemnly amid wind and snow
introduced.quote: Zapolyarny Palace stands there solemnly amid the wind and snow... It looks truly majestic.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A cold, inhospitable tundra whose people pushed technology to its limits
introduced.quote: Snezhnaya has been a cold and inhospitable tundra since ancient times.

introduced.name: Gnoses
introduced.how: Relics with strong elemental affinity that amplify their bearers' power and are being collected by the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: The Gnoses possess a powerful elemental affinity, and are capable of amplifying their bearers' power.

introduced.name: Third Descender
introduced.how: Being whose remains form the Gnoses and who was killed by the Heavenly Principles
introduced.quote: They do not originate from within the system of Teyvat, but from the Third Descender.

introduced.name: Seal left by the Third Descender
introduced.how: A crystalline seal hidden in a basement that only reacts to Gnoses and holds an unknown secret
introduced.quote: A seal left behind by the Third Descender.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: Anastasya's predecessor who guarded the seal
introduced.quote: The original custodian was my predecessor, the Belyi Tsar.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: Forces that set the limits of what is permitted and threaten annihilation for pushing past them
introduced.quote: In many fields, we reached the boundary of what is permitted by the Heavenly Principles long ago.

introduced.name: Four Shades
introduced.how: The Shades of the Heavenly Principles, Life, Death, Time, and Space, described as ubiquitous
introduced.quote: You will be aware by now that the Shades of the Heavenly Principles, Life, Death, Time, and Space, are ubiquitous.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: Monitors the Shades' actions only periodically while the Heavenly Principles slumber
introduced.quote: But during this period of slumber, Celestia only monitors our actions periodically.

introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.how: A cautious operator who rarely leaves traces of her actions
introduced.quote: The Ruler of Death is a cautious operator. She rarely leaves a trace of her actions, making it extremely difficult to infer much about her.

introduced.name: Ruler of Life
introduced.how: A power the Archangel stole in the Hyperborean era, later entrusted to the Vila
introduced.quote: During the Hyperborean era, the former Archangel stole a small portion of the Ruler of Life's power

introduced.name: Curse of Death
introduced.how: A curse that kills whenever research makes progress, with victims revived before the next monitoring period
introduced.quote: By casting a curse of death and establishing a precise trigger condition, we can render their efforts futile at the first sign of any substantial progress.

introduced.name: Mirror of Remembrance
introduced.how: A enlarged prism that stores memories and can pull them from nearby people and events
introduced.quote: We call it the Mirror of Remembrance.

introduced.name: Transcription Prism
introduced.how: A prism that records daily memories and is unaffected by Teyvat's laws, carrying Third Descender power
introduced.quote: Much like the Stellar Linchpin, a transcription prism contains the power of the Third Descender.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: A Ruler of Death whose schemes with Rhinedottir are revealed in a memory
introduced.quote: A blurry memory shows Ronova speaking with Rhinedottir

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Revives those Ronova kills, and is shown agreeing to help her plan
introduced.quote: Rhinedottir resurrecting them before the Shades could be caught.

introduced.name: Naberius
introduced.how: A Four Shades member who speaks into Rhinedottir's mind
introduced.quote: Naberius speaks in Rhinedottir's mind

introduced.name: Seal of Life
introduced.how: A memory bubble extracted from a person that could defy death if enough are gathered
introduced.quote: finding that some information on the Seal of Life program has been leaked to the public

introduced.name: Project Mistilteinn
introduced.how: Research halted because the Ruler of Death's curse made it futile until Ronova is dealt with
introduced.quote: their work on Project Mistilteinn was to be halted until Ronova could be dealt with.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: A bank holding Mora and the seals, with compensation for donations
introduced.quote: The Northland Bank estimates we have suffered direct economic losses exceeding 500 thousand Mora.
