assumed.name: Project Stuzha
assumed.quote: It's just like during Project Stuzha.

assumed.name: Snezhnograd
assumed.quote: a rumor began circulating in the dark corners of Snezhnograd.

assumed.name: Veche
assumed.quote: Don't think I won't report this to the Veche!

assumed.name: Fatui Internal Affairs
assumed.quote: The culprit should be handed over to Fatui Internal Affairs.

assumed.name: House of the Hearth
assumed.quote: Why dress in my finest when it would only make me a target for the House of the Hearth?

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Would you believe me if I said... Harbinger high?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Tsaritsa has granted me free access to Zapolyarny Palace.

assumed.name: Ruler of Life
assumed.quote: This is the Ruler of Life's doing!

assumed.name: Ruler of Death
assumed.quote: The Ruler of Death must have sent her minion to foil our plan!

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Lyney! And Lynette and Freminet, too! Hey there, it's been ages!

assumed.name: Danica
assumed.quote: Huh? Danica and Vesna? You're here too?

assumed.name: Asmoday
assumed.quote: I have information on Asmoday.

assumed.name: Ronova
assumed.quote: As your conflict with Ronova escalates, it is inevitable that you would try to win me over.

assumed.name: The Jester
assumed.quote: She went to the Armory Palace to meet with The Jester and discuss our next steps.

assumed.name: A Divergence Leading to Oneself
assumed.quote: The Traveler recalls Pantalone's words during A Divergence Leading to Oneself

assumed.name: Sretomorozsk
assumed.quote: I'm planning to head back to Sretomorozsk.

assumed.name: Svetloledovka
assumed.quote: Looks like we won't need to make another trip to Svetloledovka.

assumed.name: Alyosha's past work with the group
assumed.quote: We made a great team before. We can do it again.

threads.claim: Anastasya's divine authority is love, which she claims is corrupted and which she refuses to use.
threads.quote: Anastasya: It is "love."

threads.claim: Gods' love for humanity is said to be a curse imposed by the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: Perhaps you are unaware of this, but the love held by gods for humanity is the result of a curse by the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Third Descender sealed a secret that only the collected Gnoses can unlock, and its contents remain unknown.
threads.quote: Whatever the Third Descender sought to protect at the very end, it must be of vital importance.

threads.claim: The Pyro Gnosis's fate is disputed: Mavuika sensed it returned to the Ley Lines, while Nahida found no evidence it was destroyed, and Anastasya believes it will be found.
threads.quote: According to Nahida in , neither her nor Mavuika were able to find evidence of the Pyro Gnosis being reduced to ash.

threads.claim: Anastasya is collecting the Gnoses to gain power enough to face the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: It is a necessary step towards facing the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: Freedom demanded by an archon is not true freedom, a theme echoed by Venti.
threads.quote: Venti: ...Freedom, if demanded of you by an archon, is really no freedom at all.

threads.claim: Memories cannot be fully trusted, so the Tsaritsa records each day's memories in a prism that is immune to Teyvat's laws.
threads.quote: The Jester: ...Her Majesty is of the belief that memory cannot be completely trusted.

threads.claim: Anastasya lacks happy memories, hinting at a hidden personal history.
threads.quote: noting that Anastasya doesn't have any happy memories at all.

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death's curse kills anyone who makes progress against her, and relocating research does not escape it.
threads.quote: The curse afflicts us directly. Wherever we go, death will follow us.

threads.claim: Ronova exploits the Heavenly Principles' periodic monitoring by killing and resurrecting people between monitoring periods.
threads.quote: The dead must be resurrected before the next monitoring period arrives.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir agrees to help Ronova's death-and-resurrection scheme while staying out of view.
threads.quote: Rhinedottir: Fine. I will agree to help you, Lady Ronova.

threads.claim: Pantalone is accused of embezzling the missing seals, though Anastasya rules him out and Pantalone denies it.
threads.quote: he reveals that Pantalone might be responsible for the missing seals.

threads.claim: Anastasya offers Rhinedottir information on Asmoday to win her over.
threads.quote: Anastasya tells her that she has information on Asmoday and invites her to reconvene in seven days.

threads.claim: Vesna carries a fragment of the Ruler of Life's power, inherited from the first Vila.
threads.quote: Vesna inherited the blood of the first Vila, and this power along with it.

threads.claim: Anastasya's call to collect the seals was a deliberate lure to force Rhinedottir to appear.
threads.quote: It is later revealed that Anastasya had called for the collection of seals in order to force Rhinedottir to appear.

threads.claim: The Traveler must eventually choose where they stand between the Tsaritsa's rebellion and the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: After that... I must choose where I stand.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's Seal of Life holds no memories yet her life force persists, an unexplained mystery.
threads.quote: Vesna: (There are no memories within Her Majesty's Seal of Life! Just an endless expanse of white snow, like standing alone on the tundra...)

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death is the enemy the collected Seals of Life are meant to help defeat.
threads.quote: Mitya: Will these Seals of Life be enough? Let's not forget, we're fighting the Ruler of Death...

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa orders research into applying life force against the Ruler of Death as the top priority.
threads.quote: Anastasya: You will conduct research into applications of life force and how it may be used to fight the Ruler of Death. This is now our single most important task.

threads.claim: The real purpose for collecting Seals of Life is kept confidential from the public.
threads.quote: Belozersky: With regards to the purpose for which the Seals of Life are being collected, this must remain confidential for the time being.

threads.claim: The public does not know the Ruler of Death is involved, and the leak of the rumor may have been deliberate.
threads.quote: Traveler: (It seems the part about the Ruler of Death hasn't been leaked.

threads.claim: The Veche has stayed silent this time, suggesting an unusual crisis.
threads.quote: Traveler: Svetilova: But this time, they've remained silent... It seems a new crisis is upon us after all.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles' rules have lost their efficacy and are doomed to end.
threads.quote: The rules laid down by the Heavenly Principles have lost their efficacy. They are destined for demise.

threads.claim: Danica doubts the Tsaritsa's claims about her benevolence and the choices she has made.
threads.quote: Danica: ...If Her Majesty were truly as she claims, why would she have allowed me to follow my own wishes back then?

threads.claim: Danica vows to create a new storm that will demolish the Old World.
threads.quote: We will create a new storm... one that will rage until the Old World has been utterly demolished.

threads.claim: Danica accuses the great ruler of the firmament and its agents of ignoring the suffering of many.
threads.quote: They hold such great power in the palms of their hands, yet they turn a blind eye to the suffering of so many.

threads.claim: The Captain hinted at leaving embers behind, implying he planned his departure long in advance.
threads.quote: We didn't know what he meant at the time, but it's clear now that he must have been planning for his departure for a long time.

threads.claim: Vesna's life-extraction power was originally entrusted to the Vila to help humanity.
threads.quote: this power was entrusted to the Vila to help humanity, yet the first time I actually use it, it's to ask humans to help me

threads.claim: Rhinedottir's power appears on the train, hinting at her presence.
threads.quote: (A thread of Rhinedottir's power is shown behind a nearby seat, before quickly disappearing)

threads.claim: Rumors of a prophecy of doom and destruction circulate in Fontaine.
threads.quote: Aside from all the overt and covert threats, rumors of a prophecy of doom and destruction circulated in the streets.

threads.claim: Desert scholars argue that armed conquest is the only real truth in Teyvat.
threads.quote: They made a great case for why armed conquest is the only real truth in Teyvat...

threads.claim: The Veche confirms the Druzhna donated Seals of Life as an organized operation.
threads.quote: Belozersky: We can confirm that the Druzhna has indeed donated Seals of Life as part of an organized operation.

threads.claim: Someone has stolen the Seals of Life and may be selling them through a mysterious contact.
threads.quote: Someone stole the Seals of Life?

threads.claim: The returned Seals of Life come back to their owners once Rhinedottir snaps her fingers.
threads.quote: Rhinedottir snaps her fingers, and the Seals of Life begin returning to their owners

threads.claim: The Ruler of Life appears to be behind the monster that absorbs the Seals of Life.
threads.quote: This is the Ruler of Life's doing!

threads.claim: Rhinedottir is revealed to be the Ruler of Life.
threads.quote: We meet at last, Ruler of Life.

threads.claim: Regrator may be involved in embezzling the Seals of Life, as a Harbinger tied to the bank.
threads.quote: You mean Regrator's involved in this?

threads.claim: Regrator's flashback shows that he planned for the bank to leak news of the Seals collection to draw the Ruler of Life out.
threads.quote: The Northland Bank will leak the news that Her Majesty is collecting Seals of Life to all corners of Snezhnaya.

threads.claim: Traveler suspects Regrator is Pantalone and that he lacks loyalty to the Tsaritsa.
threads.quote: If I'm right, and Pantalone is who I think he is

threads.claim: Vesna glimpses hidden memories of the Tsaritsa, suggesting they are not entirely blank.
threads.quote: They're not completely blank after all...

threads.claim: Anastasya claims a chance encounter with Asmoday, which intrigues Rhinedottir.
threads.quote: I have information on Asmoday.

threads.claim: Anastasya and Rhinedottir agree to negotiate again in seven days.
threads.quote: Shall we meet in seven days?

threads.claim: Anastasya says she has a bargaining chip to force the Ruler of Life to show herself.
threads.quote: Do not worry. I have the bargaining chip I need. Now, we simply need her to show herself.

threads.claim: Rhinedottir says she released a failed experiment to destroy something that should not exist, so she can stay uninvolved.
threads.quote: That's why I released my failed experiment to destroy that which should not exist

threads.claim: The power of Life was given to Vila ancestors under a contract with the Ruler of Life.
threads.quote: When that lady gave this power to my ancestors

threads.claim: Vesna loses the power of Life to its owner but is told it never belonged to her.
threads.quote: That power never belonged to me in the first place.

introduced.name: Amber
introduced.how: Outrider and examiner who oversees the gliding exam, and is the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Amber: Today I'm here as an examiner, to oversee 's official gliding exam!

introduced.name: Otto
introduced.how: Knight of Favonius who arrests people for gliding without a license
introduced.quote: Otto: I am Otto of the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Raptor
introduced.how: Known criminal who uses a wind glider to commit crimes and is nicknamed for it
introduced.quote: Otto: A known criminal in Mondstadt. He always uses a wind glider to commit his crimes, so people started calling him Raptor.

introduced.name: Gliding license
introduced.how: A license required by law to glide legally in Mondstadt, earned by passing an exam
introduced.quote: Amber: Isn't it obvious? You gotta have a gliding license to legally glide in Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Organization with strict rules that issues gliding licenses and enforces the law
introduced.quote: Amber: No way! The Knights of Favonius Headquarters have strict rules.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: Area where Raptor was last seen, near a road with Hilichurl camps
introduced.quote: Amber: This is Springvale. There must be some clues about Raptor 'round here.

introduced.name: Farrah
introduced.how: Merchant whose fruit carts were attacked by Hilichurls while travelling the road
introduced.quote: Farrah: I can't believe it but... the hilichurls attacked our carts. Luckily I outran them.

introduced.name: Anemo Slime
introduced.how: Airborne creatures that leave no marks unless stomped on for a take-off
introduced.quote: Amber: Anemo Slimes are airborne creatures. They don't leave marks on the ground, unless someone stomped on one to take-off.

introduced.name: Anemo markings
introduced.how: Secret elemental markings the Sisters put on an artifact to track Raptor, which fade over time
introduced.quote: Otto: Fortunately, one of the Sisters put some secret markings on the artifact using elemental magic!

introduced.name: Anemo God
introduced.how: A deity in the fairytale that answers the birds' questions about flight
introduced.quote: They asked the Anemo God:

introduced.name: Wind Gliding Championship
introduced.how: Upcoming gliding competition that Amber signs the Traveler up for
introduced.quote: Amber: Oh — and I'll sign you up for the next Wind Gliding Championship!

introduced.name: Outrider
introduced.how: Title of Knights of Favonius gliding officers such as Amber
introduced.quote: Amber: Reading that gave me the courage to glide, to become an Outrider, and to become the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Wind glider
introduced.how: Glider Amber gave the Traveler, used for gliding around Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Amber: Hey ! I've been looking for you everywhere! How's that wind glider I gave you last time?

introduced.name: Gliding manual
introduced.how: Knights' rulebook for gliding, with rules such as one rider per glider and weight limits
introduced.quote: Amber: Here. Take this gliding manual. No need to memorize it, just be familiar with everything in there.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Amber: I gave you your wind glider, so this is my responsibility — at least, that's what Acting Grand Master Jean would say.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Amber: Anyway, be sure to read it, okay? I had to read a load of big, thick books too when Lisa was teaching me magic...

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Amber: I mean... The whole city saw how well you flew the day that Stormterror attacked, so I'm sure you'll have no problems!

assumed.name: Baron Bunny
assumed.quote: Traveler: It got eaten by Baron Bunny...

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Paimon: , can you see anything with your Elemental Sight...? No? Oh, okay... Never mind...

assumed.name: Windrise
assumed.quote: Amber: Great. Come find me when you're done, I'll be at Windrise.

threads.claim: Raptor escaped with a stolen artifact, leaving the Knights hunting an unknown criminal glider.
threads.quote: Otto: ...But he escaped with the artifact.

threads.claim: Amber captures Raptor at his hideout, ending the chase for the stolen artifact.
threads.quote: Amber: Alright! I got him!

threads.claim: It is unclear how Raptor crossed the chasm to his hideout, since no mechanism or anchor is visible.
threads.quote: Paimon: So how did HE get across?

threads.claim: Amber reveals that a single wind current across the chasm let her glide over, implying how Raptor could have crossed.
threads.quote: Amber: I only noticed the wind current from in the air — and it's the only one.

threads.claim: The elemental markings on the artifact wear off, so the trail goes cold and the chase is harder.
threads.quote: Amber: The elemental power on the artifact must have worn off.

threads.claim: The fairytale says that courage, not wind, is what lets birds fly, a theme the story keeps returning to.
threads.quote: What you lacked was not wind, but courage

threads.claim: Amber describes gliding as mostly courage, reinforcing the fairytale's message.
threads.quote: Amber: At the end of the day, gliding is seven parts technique, three parts instinct — and then 90 parts courage.

threads.claim: Amber says the fairytale gave her the courage to glide and become a champion, showing how it shaped her.
threads.quote: Amber: Reading that gave me the courage to glide, to become an Outrider, and to become the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt.

threads.claim: The Anemo God is a deity who answers the birds' questions, hinting at a larger role in the world.
threads.quote: They asked the Anemo God:

threads.claim: Amber's gliding licenses keep getting revoked, so she has retaken the exam many times.
threads.quote: Amber: *sigh* Every time I get my license it keeps getting revoked. I must have taken the exam about 15 times altogether...

threads.claim: Amber plans to enter the Traveler in the next Wind Gliding Championship, setting up a future match.
threads.quote: Amber: Oh — and I'll sign you up for the next Wind Gliding Championship!

introduced.name: Rana
introduced.how: Forest Watcher who introduces herself and offers to guide the Traveler to Vimara Village
introduced.quote: As for my name, it's Rana.

introduced.name: Forest Watchers
introduced.how: guardians who protect the forest, assist travelers, and keep the ecosystem balanced
introduced.quote: a Forest Watcher's duty is to protect the forest, assist travelers, and provide guidance.

introduced.name: Withering Zone
introduced.how: a Sumeru disaster that emerges in an area and kills all living things within it
introduced.quote: It's a force that emerges in an area and kills all living things within.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a power needed to survive Withering Zones and control the elements; those without one are at risk
introduced.quote: for someone like me, who doesn't have a Vision and cannot control the elements

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: a village near the forest road where Rana patrols and where children have been going missing
introduced.quote: This is Vimara Village. Let me say hi to Grandpa Amadhiah.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: mythical small, round, plantlike forest fairies that most villagers dismiss as just a tale
introduced.quote: Small, round, plantlike fairies. They are denizens of the woods and guardians of trees.

introduced.name: Amadhiah
introduced.how: Rana's grandfather figure, an elderly village man with failing eyesight
introduced.quote: Grandpa Amadhiah is getting old, and his eyes are starting to fail him

introduced.name: Alphonso
introduced.how: village resident who came from Fontaine as an apprentice and stayed; dependable and worried about the children
introduced.quote: I came as an apprentice from Fontaine, but ended up staying because I really like it here.

introduced.name: Iotham
introduced.how: an energetic village child who loves dragon stories and wanders into the woods
introduced.quote: Iotham: I picked a bunch of Starshrooms for you, Rana!

introduced.name: Kavus
introduced.how: a village child who dreams of becoming a sailor and loves sea monster stories
introduced.quote: When I grow up, I want to be a sailor, going on seven voyages and discovering uncharted islands and lands!

introduced.name: Sudabeh
introduced.how: a village child who wants stories about a distinguished, powerful lady
introduced.quote: Sudabeh: I want to hear some tales from the woods, Rana!

introduced.name: Iosaphat
introduced.how: village fisherman who watches over Kavus and Sudabeh and shares his catch
introduced.quote: Iosaphat: You know it! When you see the kids, tell them a feast is waiting.

introduced.name: Collei
introduced.how: a young Forest Watcher who has been unwell but works hard to fight The Withering, under Tighnari's care
introduced.quote: Rana: Collei hasn't been very well, but she still works hard to protect the forest and eliminate The Withering.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Snezhnaya-based armed mercenaries operating in the forest, dangerous even to Rana
introduced.quote: you got the Fatui from Snezhnaya with their armed mercenaries operating in the forest.

introduced.name: Shroomboar
introduced.how: round green forest beasts used to sniff out precious mushrooms, only found in Sumeru forests
introduced.quote: They are round, green beasts that live in the forest. We'd use them to find precious mushrooms.

introduced.name: Arana
introduced.how: a member of the Aranara met in a strange hut, who says Rana was sickened by Marana and needs a Bija
introduced.quote: they meet Arana, a member of the Aranara

introduced.name: Missing children incident
introduced.how: village children vanish into the woods and return days later with no memory of what happened
introduced.quote: Anyway, some of the children in Vimara Village have gone missing recently.

introduced.name: Rana's sickness
introduced.how: Rana fell gravely ill after brief exposure to a Withering Zone, since she has no Vision
introduced.quote: the short and brief exposure has caused Rana to fall sickly ill

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: round plantlike forest guardians tied to the Dendro Archon who bridge people and trees and can enter dreams
introduced.quote: The Aranara are related to the Dendro Archon and are the guardians of the forest.

introduced.name: Arana
introduced.how: a talking Aranara who calls the Traveler a child of the dandelion and vows to protect Rana
introduced.quote: Arana: Not vegetable, Arana. Arana is friend, Aranara.

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: a green Dendro sphere that protects people from Marana's corrosion
introduced.quote: Iotham: That was Ararakalari... It can protect people from the corrosion of Marana.

introduced.name: Marana's Avatar
introduced.how: Marana is revealed to be The Withering, a corrupting force that spawns big black monsters
introduced.quote: Rana: Mm... How did I know that Marana is The Withering...? Dang it... everything's spinning...

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: a dream-world entered by singing the Rhythm of the Great Dream, where Bija can be gathered
introduced.quote: To heal Narana, we need Bija. Nara must go to Vanarana and ask everyone to help get Bija.

introduced.name: Bija
introduced.how: the only thing that can heal Rana's corrosion, found in Vanarana
introduced.quote: Only Bija can make Narana better.

introduced.name: Iotham
introduced.how: a young child raised by Granny Jehiet after being abandoned in Vimara Village
introduced.quote: Then there's Iotham. I'm more worried about him. He was raised by Granny Jehiet after being abandoned in the village.

introduced.name: Kavus
introduced.how: the oldest of the village children, who dreams of travelling the world by boat
introduced.quote: The oldest one is Kavus. He wants to travel the world by boat when he grows up.

introduced.name: Sudabeh
introduced.how: Kavus's little sister who wants to be just like Rana
introduced.quote: Sudabeh is his little sister, she says she wants to be just like me.

introduced.name: Alphonso
introduced.how: a newcomer to Vimara Village who acts as an older brother and organized the child search party
introduced.quote: Oh, him? He's like an older brother to them. We've treated him like family since he arrived in the village a few years ago.

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: the village where Rana, Iotham and the children live, and where the missing children reappeared
introduced.quote: The kids said that they were in the woods, and the next thing they knew, they were in Vimara Village.

introduced.name: Spinocrocodile
introduced.how: alligator-like creatures that have become unusually manic and spread into other territories, so they must be culled
introduced.quote: Not only have they been invading other animals' territories, but they're reproducing at a faster rate.

introduced.name: Forest Watchers
introduced.how: forest guardians who patrol to protect the ecosystem and the children
introduced.quote: Forest Watchers are also tasked with protecting the ecosystem.

introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.how: their origins lie in the forest king's royal guards, who once walked forests with real tigers
introduced.quote: The origins of the Forest Rangers go way back. The earliest rangers were the forest king's royal guards!

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: its fall began the era of darkness, and the cataclysm left few documents behind
introduced.quote: Later, Khaenri'ah fell, and thus began the era of darkness.

introduced.name: Starshroom
introduced.how: said to be reflections of the stars, changing state when hit by Electro or Pyro
introduced.quote: Starshrooms are said to be the reflections of the stars in the sky.

introduced.name: Nilotpala Lotus
introduced.how: a flower that blooms only when the moon is high, said to bring a day of luck
introduced.quote: Oh, this is a Nilotpala Lotus. It blooms only when the moon is hanging high above the sky.

introduced.name: Harra Fruit
introduced.how: a fruit whose ground powder is used to make curry
introduced.quote: This is Harra Fruit. You can ground it, use the powder and add some other ingredients to make delicious curry!

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Traveler: She should know Tighnari, right?

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Rana, optional)

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: As the Traveler and Paimon leave Gandharva Ville, they hear a cry for help

assumed.name: A Forest of Change
assumed.quote: (If player has completed A Forest of Change)

assumed.name: Chronic Illness
assumed.quote: (If the player has not completed Chronic Illness)

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is it Amber?

assumed.name: Sinbadacus
assumed.quote: When I grow up, I want to be a great sailor like Sinbadacus!

assumed.name: Electro
assumed.quote: Sudabeh: Electro is good. It makes plants stronger and bear more fruit.

assumed.name: Port Ormos and Sumeru City
assumed.quote: It's smooth sailing from there to either Port Ormos or Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Starshroom
assumed.quote: Iotham: I picked a bunch of Starshrooms for you, Rana!

assumed.name: Gator Raja
assumed.quote: Kavus: Did you catch the Gator Raja this time, Rana?

assumed.name: Miss Lisa
assumed.quote: Paimon can go with the story of Miss Lisa, but Paimon'd prefer another one...

assumed.name: Princess Cinnamon
assumed.quote: Like Princess Cinnamon who left her palace with a tiger in the fairytale!

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Some Eremites appear chasing him, but they drive them off before heading into the caves

assumed.name: Fungi
assumed.quote: The Fungi and beasts have been growing aggressive

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Rana: Okay! You made clean work of those Withering Zones before, but they're still dangerous.

assumed.name: Withering Zone
assumed.quote: Rana: The Withering Zones are appearing so quickly now, and Tighnari and the others are too busy to deal with them in time.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Rana: When I was a trainee, Tighnari taught us to pay attention to the light shining from this type of rose.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: It is said to be related to something about Ley Lines...

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Rana, optional)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's the Fatui! Where did they come from?

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Or at least, that's what the Akademiya researchers say.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: Does the Dendro Archon punish people who cut down trees?

threads.claim: The mysterious creatures seen on arrival in Sumeru may be the Aranara, a legend most people dismiss as a tale.
threads.quote: Paimon remarks about the mysterious creatures they saw earlier when they arrived in Sumeru.

threads.claim: The children seem to know about the Aranara but refuse to say what they know.
threads.quote: Iotham: No, I heard nothing about Aranara.

threads.claim: Children keep vanishing into the woods and returning days later with no memory, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Anyway, some of the children in Vimara Village have gone missing recently.

threads.claim: Some children have a secret friend living in the forest whom they will not describe.
threads.quote: Kavus: Yeah, a friend to everyone, lives in the forest.

threads.claim: Kavus refuses to say what the forest friend is like because he made a pact with the other children.
threads.quote: Kavus: I can't tell you. I'm sorry. Although we're friends, I made a pact with Sudabeh and Iotham.

threads.claim: Iotham's slip of the tongue hints that Arana is someone the children know and are hiding.
threads.quote: Iotham: Uh, I mean Rana! Rana would find them and take them home!

threads.claim: Rana has been sickened by something called Marana and needs a Bija to be restored.
threads.quote: explains that Rana was sickened by

threads.claim: Withering Zones are multiplying around Vimara Village and the forest, and they are more dangerous to those without a Vision.
threads.quote: It's only been a few days and a new Withering Zone has popped up already.

threads.claim: Fatui mercenaries from Snezhnaya are operating in the forest near Vimara Village.
threads.quote: you got the Fatui from Snezhnaya with their armed mercenaries operating in the forest.

threads.claim: The Traveler can control the elements, unlike Rana, which makes the Traveler able to handle Withering Zones.
threads.quote: Traveler: I can control the elements.

threads.claim: Marana is a corrupting entity tied to The Withering, and its true nature is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Uh-huh. It does bad things in the world for Marana... It's a big black thing...

threads.claim: Marana's corrosion withers trees and fruit and is now spreading through the forest and onto Rana.
threads.quote: Narana got corroded by Marana, very serious. Bad bugs are biting tree roots. Trees will wither, fruits will rot.

threads.claim: Bija is the only cure for Rana's corrosion and must be gathered from Vanarana.
threads.quote: Only Bija can make Narana better.

threads.claim: Withering Zones are appearing faster than the Watchers can handle.
threads.quote: The Withering Zones are appearing so quickly now, and Tighnari and the others are too busy to deal with them in time.

threads.claim: Withering Zones keep expanding, and even the Traveler is warned about their danger to the body.
threads.quote: This Withering Zone's expanding...

threads.claim: Rana has a half-remembered, precious memory that she cannot recover.
threads.quote: Eh? Oh... I felt like I almost remembered something that was lost in my memories for a long time.

threads.claim: Rana's memory is failing, and she cannot recall a story about a traveler's person.
threads.quote: ...Nope, I can't remember. I'm sure someone told me a story about a before...

threads.claim: A half-remembered saying that the forest will remember recurs in Rana's memory.
threads.quote: In the end, the forest will remember.

threads.claim: Children vanished into the forest and reappeared in the village with no memory of what happened.
threads.quote: The kids said that they were in the woods, and the next thing they knew, they were in Vimara Village.

threads.claim: Rana senses the disappearances and memory loss are wrong and is guarding Iotham.
threads.quote: And with the whole memory loss situation... something about this whole thing just doesn't feel right...

threads.claim: The Aranara seem to be hiding something about the missing children.
threads.quote: They said they didn't know, but they were acting like they were hiding something about the

threads.claim: Arana claims to protect Rana from Marana, while Rana stays weakened and her cure remains out of reach.
threads.quote: Thank you, you good Nara. She is Arana's very important friend. So, Arana will protect her.

threads.claim: The fall of Khaenri'ah began an era of darkness whose events are lost, as few documents survived.
threads.quote: But not many documents have survived the cataclysm, so no one really knows what exactly happened.

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for someone, and Rana vaguely recalls hearing of that person.
threads.quote: Traveler: Well, I'm actually traveling to find someone...

threads.claim: Alphonso has mentioned the Fatui, hinting he knows more about them than he says.
threads.quote: Rana: Huh? So, these are the Fatui that Alphonso mentioned? State your business.

introduced.name: Korolevskiy Theater
introduced.how: The theater where the preview is held and where the Traveler arrives
introduced.quote: The Traveler arrives at the Korolevskiy Theater, where Kulish notes the chilly weather before asking to see the Traveler's ticket.

introduced.name: Kulish
introduced.how: Diligent theater staff member who checks tickets at the entrance and admires Odette
introduced.quote: Exceptionally diligent and reliable, he rarely makes mistakes. Regular theatergoers know him well, as he has long been responsible for checking tickets at the entrance.

introduced.name: Tonia
introduced.how: Tartaglia's younger sister, first met in person, in poor health and prone to coughing
introduced.quote: The younger sister of Tartaglia. He talks about her so often that this is the first time you've actually met her in person.

introduced.name: Chugunov
introduced.how: Owner of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant and a Snezhnograd Veche member
introduced.quote: Owner of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant and a member of the Snezhnograd Veche.

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: Energy Commission expert and prominent military figure with a talkative manner
introduced.quote: An expert with the Energy Commission and a prominent figure in the military, he has an exceptional command of all manner of energy-related technologies.

introduced.name: Valeriy
introduced.how: Head of the Special Assignments Battalion assigned to protect Mitya
introduced.quote: Head of the Special Assignments Battalion, Armory Palace Royal Grenadier Guards, First Regiment.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: Prima donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, a mysterious Rusalka with captivating singing
introduced.quote: The prima donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe. A mysterious Rusalka whose extraordinary singing has captivated countless audiences.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: Principal ballerina, Fatui member, and candidate to become the next Harbinger
introduced.quote: The principal ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe. Also a member of the Fatui and a candidate to become the next Harbinger

introduced.name: Rampana
introduced.how: Theater staff member who announces performances and hosts events
introduced.quote: A staff member at the Korolevskiy Theater. Drawn there by dreams of a celebrity lifestyle, she now handles duties such as announcing performances and hosting events.

introduced.name: Shram
introduced.how: Self-introduced independent mercenary who takes odd jobs for rich folks
introduced.quote: The name's Shram, and I'm a mercenary. The kind that gets paid to do odd jobs for rich folks.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: Hunter from Alatyr and Rokot member who takes part-time theater jobs
introduced.quote: Alyosha, a hunter from Alatyr and a member of the Rokot.

introduced.name: Soboleva
introduced.how: Wealthy businesswoman who married into a prominent family
introduced.quote: A wealthy businesswoman who began her career selling fashionable cold-weather clothing.

introduced.name: Torgov
introduced.how: Wealthy energy-industry businessman whose firm grew with Northland Bank support
introduced.quote: A wealthy businessman who made his fortune in the energy industry.

introduced.name: Traveler
introduced.how: The player's character is the Fourth Descender, a traveler from beyond the stars
introduced.quote: Me. The Fourth Descender. A traveler from beyond the stars.

introduced.name: Lelek
introduced.how: A suspected secret identity of Odette that operates from the shadows
introduced.quote: She is additionally suspected of having another identity, "Lelek," who operates from the shadows.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: The higher-ups who transferred Mitya to the Armory Palace; Odette's organization
introduced.quote: The higher-ups in the Fatui transferred me from the Energy Commission to the Armory Palace because they wanted me to...

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: A group that Vodyanitsa belongs to and that cares for ordinary people
introduced.quote: A member of the Rokot, she cares deeply about the welfare of ordinary people.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: The military base where Mitya and Valeriy are based
introduced.quote: Mitya: Um, so... are you expecting us to go back to the Armory Palace wrapped in blankets, too?

introduced.name: Spirit Seeker
introduced.how: A classic Snezhnayan ballet being revived in this rehearsal
introduced.quote: watch the rehearsal of the classic Snezhnayan ballet, "Spirit Seeker."

introduced.name: Curse of Death
introduced.how: Triggered by technological breakthroughs that threaten Celestia; kills everyone nearby and erases memory
introduced.quote: whenever there's a technological breakthrough that can threaten Celestia, the Curse of Death would trigger

introduced.name: Black mist cult
introduced.how: Cultists who believe being swallowed by the black mist brings everlasting peace
introduced.quote: The black mist cultists believe that being swallowed by the black mist leads to everlasting peace.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: Recognized as the Ruler of Death from the red eye mark
introduced.quote: The Traveler recognizes this as the mark of Ronova, the Ruler of Death.

introduced.name: Project Mistilteinn
introduced.how: An anti-Celestia weapon whose energy harms beings of Celestia like Paimon
introduced.quote: as Project Mistilteinn is an anti-Celestia weapon, the energy it produces was making Paimon, a being of Celestia, ill

introduced.name: Valeriy
introduced.how: military officer who takes charge of the investigation as Major
introduced.quote: I simply made an executive decision that someone needed to take control of this situation on the military's behalf. Does this offend you?

introduced.name: Chugunov
introduced.how: wealthy merchant who found the bodies and accuses Lelek of the murders
introduced.quote: I got up early, because I wanted to see if the snow had stopped...

introduced.name: Soboleva and Torgov
introduced.how: two wealthy local merchants found dead in a theater room
introduced.quote: The camera shifts to reveal Soboleva and Torgov's motionless forms on the floor

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: group opposed to Project Stuzha that works through lone agents like Lelek
introduced.quote: Member of the Rokot, anti–Project Stuzha, always works alone.

introduced.name: Lelek
introduced.how: codename of a Rokot agent whose identity is Odette
introduced.quote: Yes, I'm Lelek, and no, I'm not the murderer.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: ballerina and Fatui member who is secretly Lelek
introduced.quote: She's my coworker — specifically a ballerina — and also a Fatuus, a member of the Rokot, now Lelek...

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: organization Odette was forced to join as a child
introduced.quote: When I was a child, I had to join the Fatui for the sake of my mother and me.

introduced.name: Rosalyne
introduced.how: ruthless Harbinger who trained Odette and is now dead
introduced.quote: She was utterly ruthless in pursuing her goals. That kind of person should be hard to miss.

introduced.name: Cor Ignis
introduced.how: flame sealed in ice given as a mark of favor that also lets its giver watch recipients
introduced.quote: This is her flame sealed within ice. A symbol of her favor, yes, but also her way of keeping an eye on people.

introduced.name: Project Stuzha
introduced.how: energy experiment whose goal is a weapon for the final battle
introduced.quote: The ultimate goal of this energy experiment is to create a weapon for the final battle.

introduced.name: Pierro
introduced.how: Lord who oversees the weapon's development and is called The Jester
introduced.quote: The weapon's development and all the related experiments are overseen by Lord Pierro, "The Jester," and the lab is located deep within the Armory Palace.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: location of the deep lab where the weapon experiments happen
introduced.quote: the lab is located deep within the Armory Palace.

introduced.name: Water Imp
introduced.how: Vodyanitsa's people communicate emotions through song rather than facial expressions
introduced.quote: We Water Imps tend to communicate our emotions to each other by singing rather than with facial expressions.

introduced.name: Stars' Envoy
introduced.how: title Odette gives herself in the stairwell
introduced.quote: I'm the Stars' Envoy.

introduced.name: Star Key
introduced.how: a star-like light above the stairwell that the climbers try to reach
introduced.quote: Ever since we noticed that... that thing above our heads — what was it called again?

introduced.name: black mist
introduced.how: hungry mist that rises and devours people
introduced.quote: The black mist has stopped rising. Its hunger is satisfied for now, having devoured your two companions.

introduced.name: Mr. Door
introduced.how: Valeriy's alias; a guardian who fights monsters and claims he is only a door
introduced.quote: Valeriy: If you must call me something, call me Mr. Door. The black mist is coming. You need to go.

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: a scientist driven by curiosity who turns to the paranormal when science fails
introduced.quote: Mitya: Haha... I got into scientific research because of my insatiable curiosity.

introduced.name: Shram
introduced.how: a human bodyguard hired by a Water Imp family who fell in love with their daughter
introduced.quote: Shram: I was just a bodyguard hired by her family, but the stars must have aligned, because sparks began to fly between me and their daughter...

introduced.name: Litiya Ozerova
introduced.how: Shram's lover, a Water Imp who survived and went on to have children
introduced.quote: Litiya Ozerova. Do you know what happened to her?

introduced.name: Water Imp
introduced.how: fae aristocrats were driven out of Snezhnaya long ago and few remain there
introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: Because her Water Imp parents belonged to the aristocracy, who were driven out of Snezhnaya by the Tsaritsa long ago.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: ruler who expelled the fae aristocracy, founded the Fatui, and suppressed humans with her power
introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: All people know is that the Tsaritsa founded the Fatui, drove out most of the fae aristocracy without explanation, then used her terrifying power to suppress the humans.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: an organization founded by the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: All people know is that the Tsaritsa founded the Fatui, drove out most of the fae aristocracy without explanation, then used her terrifying power to suppress the humans.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: lines that can attract and devour souls, linked to the theater's haunting
introduced.quote: Mitya: The Ley Lines have a powerful ability to attract and devour souls.

introduced.name: Trapped souls in the theater
introduced.how: the theater's Ley Lines were altered so some souls cannot return and may wander forever
introduced.quote: Traveler: The theater's Ley Lines have been modified to block souls within its grounds from returning to them. Some souls can even wander this place forever.

introduced.name: Death note
introduced.how: an unsigned note tucked into the investigation report that reads death is near
introduced.quote: Mitya: How unnerving... It was tucked inside the report, so it must be a note left by the author.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: Snezhnaya's most classified building, where Mitya's lab is
introduced.quote: Traveler: That must be basically the most classified place in Snezhnaya...

introduced.name: On-duty logbook
introduced.how: the theater's record of audience numbers and incidents, kept by Kulish at the entrance
introduced.quote: Odette: It's the on-duty logbook for the theater. Kulish was the main person to use it.

introduced.name: Fae and human civil war
introduced.how: the last major civil war in Snezhnaya was over four hundred years ago, when the Tsaritsa took the throne
introduced.quote: the last significant civil war in Snezhnayan history was over four hundred years ago, when Her Majesty the Tsaritsa had just taken the throne

introduced.name: Attack on the Water Imps at the theater
introduced.how: extremists burst into a performance and forced Water Imps out, targeting even the uninvolved
introduced.quote: Shram: All of a sudden, a group of people burst into the theater, shouting for all the Water Imps to get out... performers and audience members included.

introduced.name: Double murders at the theater
introduced.how: two double murders with no cause of death found, with the victims asleep on stage
introduced.quote: Valeriy: The situation is identical to that of the two casualties yesterday. We cannot ascertain the cause of death.

introduced.name: Night Prayer
introduced.how: A spirit that attacks in the dark, and light subdues her
introduced.quote: The light subdues her, but she'll attack without a second thought in the dark.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa's guardian spirit role
introduced.how: Vodyanitsa is a guardian spirit who can resurrect others
introduced.quote: Sure I do! I'm your guardian spirit, after all.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Souls must return to the Ley Lines to complete death
introduced.quote: After the physical body dies, the soul must return to the Ley Lines for that person's

introduced.quote: I am no such tired cliche. Mortals should address me as the

introduced.quote: You simply met the criteria to trigger my Curse of Death.

introduced.name: Water Imp
introduced.how: Water Imps express emotions through singing
introduced.quote: Like I said before, singing is a Water Imp's primary mode of expression. It's how we convey our emotions.

introduced.name: Frostblight
introduced.how: A partly genetic, cold-climate illness that can be fatal, called snow cough locally
introduced.quote: The reason I'm always coughing is because I got sick with Frostblight. The locals usually call it the snow cough.

introduced.name: Frostfairy Flower
introduced.how: Its leaves were once used to brew medicine for snow cough
introduced.quote: The snow cough used to be an incurable illness. I would pick Frostfairy Flower leaves to brew medicine for Iskra, too.

introduced.name: Iskra
introduced.how: Chugunov's daughter, who died of snow cough at six
introduced.quote: My daughter's name was Iskra.

introduced.name: Ptashka
introduced.how: Tonia's true identity, a dead girl who introduces herself and leaves into the snowstorm
introduced.quote: My name is Ptashka. It was nice meeting you all.

introduced.name: Death is near note
introduced.how: The note in the investigation report actually meant everyone was already dead
introduced.quote: The note simply meant that all of us were already dead.

introduced.name: Grim Reaper folk tale
introduced.how: A Snezhnayan tale where the Grim Reaper appears as a familiar face, and recognizing him ends your life
introduced.quote: And as soon as you recognize his face, your life is over.

introduced.name: Angels of the past
introduced.how: Ancient angels reworked the Ley Lines in the theater, causing the obstruction
introduced.quote: Those angels from the past are to blame for their reckless renovation of the Ley Lines here.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Natlan's afterlife guiding system, which Ronova helped create
introduced.quote: It provided a convenient means of guiding the souls of Natlan.

introduced.quote: But the year after my daughter passed away, The Jester of the Fatui announced that a cure for Frostblight

introduced.quote: From the moment that staff member named Dymov walked into the snowstorm, the incident had already begun.

introduced.name: First-night deaths of Torgov and Soboleva
introduced.how: Torgov and Soboleva were taken by the Ley Lines on the first night
introduced.quote: The Ley Lines devoured Torgov and Soboleva on the first night.

introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.how: The Ruler of Death, who deliberately claims souls and is recorded in the player's Guiding Notes
introduced.quote: Ronova: I kill merely because your deaths are necessary

introduced.name: The Jester
introduced.how: Pierro, the Fatui director known as The Jester, whose authority over the Fatui is absolute
introduced.quote: Fatui Soldier: He's the director of the Fatui. His authority supersedes all others and cannot be questioned.

introduced.name: Armory Palace
introduced.how: A deep, hidden Fatui top-secret research facility
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Armory Palace is hidden this deep in? This place is much bigger than I imagined.

introduced.name: Curse of Death
introduced.how: Triggered when technological progress happens, killing all life nearby and resurrecting people with amnesia
introduced.quote: Mitya: So the nature of the curse seems to be something like... when moments of technological progress occur, all life in the vicinity is taken away.

introduced.name: Deceased souls
introduced.how: Some souls linger in the theater as 'deceased' and can be the ones who die or depart
introduced.quote: Traveler: Later, we discovered that there seemed to be "an extra person" among us... and subsequently discovered the existence of the "deceased."

introduced.name: Project Stuzha
introduced.how: A series of Fatui measures to consolidate national resources, serving Project Mistilteinn
introduced.quote: The Jester: As you know, Project Stuzha is a series of measures enacted to consolidate our nation's resources, the greater purpose of which... is to serve Project Mistilteinn.

introduced.name: Project Mistilteinn
introduced.how: A Fatui weapons and energy project meant to challenge the Heavenly Principles
introduced.quote: The Jester: As you know, Project Stuzha is a series of measures enacted to consolidate our nation's resources, the greater purpose of which... is to serve Project Mistilteinn.

introduced.how: A Nod-Krai bureau whose kuuvahki research was a cover for building Mistilteinn
introduced.quote: The Jester: This includes the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau in Nod-Krai. Researching kuuvahki was merely a facade.

introduced.name: Tonia

introduced.quote: Childe: Oh, right, lemme introduce you. This is my little sister, Tonia.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: Paimon is explained to be one of its creations who descended from the sky
introduced.quote: The Jester: ...Is because she comes from Celestia herself. More specifically, she is one of its creations.

introduced.how: Energy obtained by reverse engineering Stellar Linchpins, intended to counter the Heavenly Principles
introduced.quote: The Jester: You could say that by reverse engineering the Stellar Linchpins to extract the energy within, we have obtained a source of "anti-Celestia energy."

introduced.how: A shadowy organization that operated under the Lelek codename and negotiated penalties for its actions

introduced.quote: The Jester: The Gnoses will undoubtedly serve as a key bargaining chip when she confronts the Heavenly Principles.

introduced.how: Arlecchino's flames that can burn away memories
introduced.quote: Arlecchino: The "Two Worlds' Flames" can burn away memories

assumed.quote: I didn't even find out that she'd gone to Mondstadt until a while after she'd left.

assumed.name: Childe

assumed.quote: He's arguably the first friend we made after arriving in Snezhnaya.

assumed.quote: The Fatui have honed quite an array of enhanced interrogation techniques since they were founded.

assumed.quote: Dreams can't explain everything, and this isn't the Sabzeruz Festival.
