assumed.quote: The Jester: Otherwise, the fate of the people of Khaenri'ah and Hyperborea is a cycle doomed to repeat itself.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Traveler: I remember hearing the term "Mistilteinn" from Columbina.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Signora: I've seen Spirit Seeker performed many times, including by your mother.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The Jester: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa has embarked upon an expedition to vanquish a monster.

assumed.name: Chugunov
assumed.quote: Odette: So, Chugunov really is going to shut down the factory.

assumed.name: Snezhnograd Veche
assumed.quote: Vodyanitsa: I've never seen the Snezhnograd Veche so lively before.

assumed.name: Mitya
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Mitya...! Is this the laboratory he works in? What happened here to trigger the Curse of Death again so soon?)

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Odette is Lelek but postpones raising the question with her.
threads.quote: Traveler: (I think I'll leave the Lelek question until after the show's over. Then, I'll go find Odette.)

threads.claim: Odette admits she is Lelek and plans to reveal her identity publicly.
threads.quote: Initially silent, Odette responds after Vodyanitsa defends her innocence, admitting she is Lelek and, to the three's surprise, intends to reveal her identity publicly.

threads.claim: Mitya's work is tied to Project Stuzha, which he is told not to discuss.
threads.quote: Traveler: So, Mr. Mitya, is your work related to Project Stuzha?

threads.claim: Alyosha senses the snowstorm is unnatural and possibly tied to recent events and the monster.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Actually... I take that back — I don't think I've seen snow this bad even in the wild. This is... something else. It's not normal.

threads.claim: Tonia's illness is hinted at and Childe's care for her is noted, though he never mentioned it.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Childe must take great care of his sister. He's never mentioned Tonia's illness, though.)

threads.claim: A black mist cult believes being swallowed by the mist brings peace, while Mitya rejects this and the mist keeps chasing survivors.
threads.quote: The black mist cultists believe that being swallowed by the black mist leads to everlasting peace.

threads.claim: A red eye mark is linked to Ronova, the Ruler of Death, hinting she is among them.
threads.quote: The Traveler recognizes this as the mark of Ronova, the Ruler of Death.

threads.claim: Mitya suggests everyone is dead and living in an afterlife theater.
threads.quote: Mitya then shares a disturbing conclusion: they are all dead, dwelling in an afterlife theater.

threads.claim: Odette claims Mitya is dead, though he has no memory of dying.
threads.quote: Odette reveals that Mitya is actually dead, much to his disbelief, as he has no memory of dying, unlike Shram.

threads.claim: The Curse of Death triggers whenever a technology threatens Celestia, killing people and erasing their memories.
threads.quote: whenever there's a technological breakthrough that can threaten Celestia, the Curse of Death would trigger

threads.claim: Project Mistilteinn is an anti-Celestia weapon that harmed Paimon, and Mitya cured her with other energy.
threads.quote: as Project Mistilteinn is an anti-Celestia weapon, the energy it produces was making Paimon, a being of Celestia, ill

threads.claim: Shram is revealed to be a ghost from the past, explaining why he had no ticket.
threads.quote: This revelation leads to the conclusion that Shram is a ghost from the past, explaining his lack of a ticket.

threads.claim: Paimon is at least 500 years old and was pulled from Celestia to Khaenri'ah, though she lacks memories of it.
threads.quote: This reveals Paimon's age of at least 500 years, despite her lacking memories of it.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa and the Fatui aim to challenge the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: Pierro reveals that the Tsaritsa and Fatui's goal is to challenge the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Traveler holds a theory about Lelek's true identity and withholds it, suspecting Odette.
threads.quote: I'm probably the only one here with a compelling theory about Lelek's true identity.

threads.claim: Odette confirms she is Lelek but denies being the murderer.
threads.quote: Yes, I'm Lelek, and no, I'm not the murderer.

threads.claim: The cause of the deaths of Soboleva and Torgov remains unexplained, with no wounds or poison signs.
threads.quote: The cause of death, however, remains unclear. No wounds on the bodies, no signs of a struggle

threads.claim: The Traveler felt they foresaw the deaths but cannot recall how.
threads.quote: And the strange thing is that somehow, I knew this was going to happen. I knew that they would be the ones to die...

threads.claim: Odette wonders whether Rosalyne left last words or settled their differences before dying.
threads.quote: Rosalyne... In her final moments, did she have any... last words or anything...?

threads.claim: Odette denies the reconciliation Sandrone described, leaving Rosalyne's last visit unresolved.
threads.quote: Huh. No, she didn't. I didn't even find out that she'd gone to Mondstadt until a while after she'd left.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Paimon's illness is caused by the energy research behind Project Stuzha.
threads.quote: I'm beginning to suspect that Paimon's mystery illness is being caused by the energy research behind Project Stuzha.

threads.claim: Odette does not know why the experiment would make Paimon ill and suggests going to the lab in person.
threads.quote: I'm not sure why this experiment would be making Paimon feel unwell, though.

threads.claim: Project Stuzha's energy experiments aim to arm a finished weapon for the final battle.
threads.quote: The ultimate goal of this energy experiment is to create a weapon for the final battle.

threads.claim: Odette calls herself the Stars' Envoy, a role whose meaning is not yet explained.
threads.quote: I'm the Stars' Envoy.

threads.claim: Kulish suspects the star above the stairwell may be a collective illusion that can never be reached.
threads.quote: But I'm not sure it's real at all... it may just be a collective illusion.

threads.claim: The star is revealed to be Odette's Cor Ignis, but its purpose as a starting point remains unclear.
threads.quote: The "star" is revealed to be Odette's Cor Ignis

threads.claim: The black mist stops rising after devouring the two companions, its hunger sated for now.
threads.quote: The black mist has stopped rising. Its hunger is satisfied for now, having devoured your two companions.

threads.claim: The Traveler finds the mysterious stairwell strangely familiar, hinting at a past connection.
threads.quote: I don't know where this is, and yet it feels strangely familiar...

threads.claim: An unsigned note in the report warns that death is near, but its meaning is unclear.
threads.quote: Mitya: How unnerving... It was tucked inside the report, so it must be a note left by the author.

threads.claim: The note's death is explained as a long-dead ghost among the group, not a new killing.
threads.quote: Mitya: In short, there's a dead person among us. The extra person we've been searching for is a ghost from the past.

threads.claim: The theater's connection to the Ley Lines is partly blocked, and the cause is still unknown.
threads.quote: However, evidence shows that the connection between the theater area and the Ley Lines has been obstructed, though only partially, not completely severed.

threads.claim: The report says the true focus is finding out why the Ley Lines were obstructed.
threads.quote: Uncovering the reason why the Ley Lines have been obstructed is the true focus of this inquiry.

threads.claim: The report hints that an angel civilization once tried to renovate the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: the existence of an angel civilization and its preliminary attempts at Ley Line renovation.

threads.claim: A fae and human civil war ended over four hundred years ago when the Tsaritsa took the throne.
threads.quote: the last significant civil war in Snezhnayan history was over four hundred years ago, when Her Majesty the Tsaritsa had just taken the throne

threads.claim: Valeriy suggests the Tsaritsa made herself the enemy to calm the conflict between humans and fae.
threads.quote: Valeriy: It seems to me like the Tsaritsa chose to make herself the enemy. She downplayed the conflict, directing whatever animosity both sides had for each other at herself instead.

threads.claim: Odette says she found Mitya dead in the Armory Palace, yet he appeared alive later.
threads.quote: Odette: Before all of this, the last time I saw him... He was dead.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether Mitya truly came back from the dead.
threads.quote: Traveler: Unless he really did come back from the dead.

threads.claim: Odette planned to threaten Mitya, the tech lead for the experiment behind Project Stuzha, to make him back out.
threads.quote: Odette: Well, when I found out the tech lead for the experiment behind Project Stuzha was Mitya, I immediately started planning to track him down and threaten him to back out.

threads.claim: Valeriy's Mr. Door persona is strange, as he insists he is only a door with a duty to fulfill.
threads.quote: Valeriy: There's no need to try and get to know me. I'm just Mr. Door. I have to find the door that belongs to me.

threads.claim: Valeriy stays behind at a door to hold back the black mist, saying it is where his duty lies.
threads.quote: Valeriy: I am a door. This is where my duty lies.

threads.claim: A black mist is rising and chasing the group up the stairwell.
threads.quote: Valeriy: If you must call me something, call me Mr. Door. The black mist is coming. You need to go.

threads.claim: Four victims in two days have died with no leads on the killer or cause of death.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Four victims in just two days, and we still don't have a single lead...)

threads.claim: Valeriy suggests the victims' souls may have been devoured by the Ley Lines, explaining the missing cause of death.
threads.quote: Valeriy: That could explain why we weren't able to determine a cause of death. If you're right, and their souls were devoured by the Ley Lines... it does make some sense.

threads.claim: The logbook shows an extra person among the audience, whose identity is unknown.
threads.quote: Odette: Apparently... we have an extra person among us.

threads.claim: Mitya concludes the extra person is Shram, a soul who died in the theater long ago.
threads.quote: Mitya: Mr. Shram must be one such soul, who died in the theater a long time ago. In which case... that also makes him our extra person.

threads.claim: Tonia has a persistent cough and plans to get a Frostfairy Flower tonic from her brother.
threads.quote: Tonia: Yeah. I'll be fine once I see my brother. He's gonna pick some Frostfairy Flower leaves and brew a tonic for me.

threads.claim: The Grim Reaper was Ronova disguised as Alyosha, who calls herself the Ruler of Death.
threads.quote: I am no such tired cliche. Mortals should address me as the

threads.claim: The death-is-near note was a misleading clue that everyone in the theater was already dead.
threads.quote: Seems like we misunderstood what it meant after all.

threads.claim: Mitya suggests that everyone in the theater has been dead from the start, in the afterlife.
threads.quote: Yes. I think that... this is probably the afterlife.

threads.claim: The two deceased were Shram and Ptashka, whose lingering resentment drew the Ley Lines to pull in the living.
threads.quote: Then there was the issue of the two lost souls you called the

threads.claim: The obstruction in the theater's Ley Lines limits how many souls can be received each day.
threads.quote: Due to the obstruction in the theater's Ley Lines, there is a hard limit on the number of souls they can receive each day

threads.claim: Ronova cursed the group with the Curse of Death, and the cause remains only partly explained.
threads.quote: You simply met the criteria to trigger my Curse of Death.

threads.claim: Another death-related curse, the Curse of Immortality, is hinted at as a known but unexplained thing.
threads.quote: I know about the Curse of Immortality...

threads.claim: Night Prayer is a ghost-like spirit that attacks in the dark, and her origin is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Is... Is she a ghost?

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa's requiem song guides dead souls home, and it pulled Mitya back from the snowstorm.
threads.quote: That song is meant to guide the souls of the dead...

threads.claim: A guardian spirit's resurrection ability is finite, and Vodyanitsa fades away once it is used up.
threads.quote: A guardian spirit's skills are finite. I can only resurrect someone so many times.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects being a Descender explains why they feel like a spectator in this world.
threads.quote: To be honest, I used to feel like I was just a spectator in this world

threads.claim: Past angel civilization's reckless renovation of the Ley Lines caused the theater's obstruction.
threads.quote: Those angels from the past are to blame for their reckless renovation of the Ley Lines here.

threads.claim: The Jester's announced Frostblight cure seems to have been ineffective, and old treatments were no better.
threads.quote: It turned out that all previous treatments were completely ineffective, no better than random concoctions.

threads.claim: The girl called Tonia is revealed to be Ptashka, a dead girl who was never really Childe's sister.
threads.quote: My name is Ptashka. It was nice meeting you all.

threads.claim: Mitya's missing memories from the afternoon of his death suggest that the dead do not always notice their own deaths.
threads.quote: Some of my memories from that afternoon... are missing.

threads.claim: Ronova helped create the Night Kingdom in Natlan as a way of guiding the souls of Natlan.
threads.quote: It was I who supported the creation of the Night Kingdom.

threads.claim: The Traveler feels detached from the world and misses Paimon, a theme of feeling like a spectator.
threads.quote: I'm trying to overcome this sense of detachment, but... I really miss Paimon.

threads.claim: Ronova kills deliberately, and her true reasons for subjecting people to death remain unknown.
threads.quote: Traveler: If nothing else, I think it shows that killing us wasn't her ultimate goal. We still don't know her true reasons for subjecting us to death.

threads.claim: It is unknown what triggers the Curse of Death and why the dead are resurrected.
threads.quote: Mitya: This leaves me with a couple big questions. What are the conditions that trigger this so-called Curse of Death? And why are we resurrected after we die?

threads.claim: Any research or experiment leading to technological progress triggers the Curse of Death, though why resurrection happens stays open.
threads.quote: Mitya: So, any ideas, research, or experiments that lead to technological progress can trigger the curse.

threads.claim: People resurrected from the Curse of Death forget what happened while they were dead, explaining earlier amnesia cases.
threads.quote: ...Just with one catch: They forgot what happened while they were dead.

threads.claim: Time in the afterlife runs far faster than in the real world, so days there pass as minutes outside.
threads.quote: Anyway, clearly the few days we spent in the afterlife probably only amounted to a few short minutes in the real world.

threads.claim: Descenders are not bound by Teyvat's rules and can only die through the most violent means.
threads.quote: Ronova: For a Descender like you, who is not bound by Teyvat's rules, your death can only be brought about through the most violent of means...

threads.claim: Ronova can only temporarily separate a soul from its body because the Ley Lines of Teyvat would not accept the Traveler.
threads.quote: Ronova: That just leaves you, . My power only allows me to temporarily separate your soul from your body. The Ley Lines of Teyvat would not accept you.

threads.claim: Columbina has mentioned Mistilteinn, a project the Traveler does not yet understand.
threads.quote: Traveler: I remember hearing the term "Mistilteinn" from Columbina.

threads.claim: Mistilteinn is a weapon meant for the final battle against the Heavenly Principles, built on Project Stuzha and the Kuuvahki bureau.
threads.quote: The Jester: As you know, Project Stuzha is a series of measures enacted to consolidate our nation's resources, the greater purpose of which... is to serve Project Mistilteinn.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa seeks to seize the Heavenly Principles' authority to reconstruct the world and free humanity from curses.
threads.quote: The Jester: If she can seize their authority, she will reconstruct the entire world... and when that time comes, humanity will be completely liberated from curses and lies.

threads.claim: The Jester claims all the rules of the world are made of curses, including a god's love for humanity.
threads.quote: The Jester: Furthermore... Hm, perhaps this is still somewhat difficult for you to understand. Are you aware that all the rules of this world are made up of "curses"?

threads.claim: Ronova hints that Paimon is a creation of Celestia who lacks Celestia's power.
threads.quote: Ronova: That thing may be a creation of Celestia

threads.claim: Paimon is revealed to be a creation of Celestia who descended from the sky during the Vinster King's era.
threads.quote: The Jester: ...Is because she comes from Celestia herself. More specifically, she is one of its creations.

threads.claim: Paimon has no memory of Khaenri'ah or her earlier centuries of existence.
threads.quote: Paimon: But Paimon doesn't remember any of that! Falling from the sky, being given away as a gift... None of it!

threads.claim: The Fatui obtained anti-Celestia energy by reverse engineering Stellar Linchpins to challenge the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: The Jester: You could say that by reverse engineering the Stellar Linchpins to extract the energy within, we have obtained a source of "anti-Celestia energy."

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa collects Gnoses for an unexplained purpose tied to the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: The Jester: The Gnoses will undoubtedly serve as a key bargaining chip when she confronts the Heavenly Principles.

threads.claim: The Two Worlds' Flames can burn away memories, which may explain Odette's forgetting.
threads.quote: Arlecchino: The "Two Worlds' Flames" can burn away memories

threads.claim: Odette shatters her Cor Ignis, and the flames released from the ice burn her letter away.
threads.quote: (The flames inside the ice are released and burn the letter before transforming into crimson moths and disappearing)

threads.claim: Odette's Cor Ignis may have guided the Traveler's soul back to their body, though this is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Did Odette intentionally use her Cor Ignis to guide my soul? I feel like something similar happened in a dream I had before...)

threads.claim: Ronova intends to reclaim Paimon, setting up a future confrontation.
threads.quote: Ronova: It's worthless, anyway... I'll reclaim it next time

threads.claim: The Ruler of Death's symbol is carved into Mitya's soul and is visible only to those who remember the afterlife.
threads.quote: Mitya: Does that mean I... carved this symbol into my soul? What an unsettling thought.

introduced.name: Meng
introduced.how: new undertaker intern at the parlor, childhood friend of Big G
introduced.quote: Big G was one of them. We were the best of friends, inseparable really.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: self-introduced as the 77th director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.quote: I'm Hu Tao, the current director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, responsible for... well, trifling matters having to do with mortality.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: funeral parlor whose job is to guard the border between life and death
introduced.quote: The job of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is to "guard the border between life and death."

introduced.name: Big G
introduced.how: Meng's dead childhood friend, now a spirit lost in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: But one day there was an accident, and that was the end of him.

introduced.name: Luocheng
introduced.how: young man who fears he is cursed by a demon
introduced.quote: My name's Luocheng. I've had this awful feeling recently, like something's staring at me.

introduced.name: Little Wu
introduced.how: childhood friend of Meng and Big G who cooks
introduced.quote: Yes, we grew up together. We still keep in touch even now.

introduced.name: Mumu
introduced.how: childhood friend of Meng and Big G who runs a business
introduced.quote: Here, take this. It's a top-of-the-line toy box we all dreamed of owning as kids.

introduced.name: Congzi
introduced.how: childhood friend who makes Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: I make artisan Xiao Lanterns down by Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Lan
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild branch manager who rejects Hu Tao's business deal
introduced.quote: Ugh, you again... Look, I told you, we're not interested in the kind of cooperation you describe.

introduced.name: Ferrylady
introduced.how: figure who warns that too much knowledge is bad for ordinary folk
introduced.quote: Too much knowledge isn't good for ordinary folk.

introduced.name: Ley Line Monolith
introduced.how: old device that is really a monster attractor, used as a fake exorcism prop
introduced.quote: it's just an old Ley Line Monolith, deceptively effective at attracting monsters.

introduced.name: Yaksha plague
introduced.how: ancient plague born from Yaksha resentment, mistaken for a divine curse
introduced.quote: That resentment turned into a pestilence spreading amongst the ordinary folk.

introduced.name: Wooden tile client grades
introduced.how: client importance is ranked as wicker, bamboo, wood, or marble
introduced.quote: We have four levels: "wicker," "bamboo," "wood," and "marble."

introduced.name: Border between life and death
introduced.how: a real place between living and dead that the parlor travels into
introduced.quote: Hu Tao tells them that they are about to travel into the "border" between life and death.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: war that tipped the balance between life and death toward death
introduced.quote: during the Archon Wars, the balance between life and death was imbalanced towards the latter.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: annual rite where friends release lanterns together
introduced.quote: during the annual Lantern Rite, we all release a lantern like this.

introduced.name: Jueyun Chili Chicken
introduced.how: extra-spicy dish that Big G loved as a child
introduced.quote: His favorite meal was extra-spicy Jueyun Chili Chicken.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: handmade lantern that Congzi crafts as a keepsake
introduced.quote: I make artisan Xiao Lanterns down by Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: Founded in the Archon War era as a kind of doctor's office for the dead, tasked with guarding the border between life and death
introduced.quote: As I explained, Wangsheng Funeral Parlor was, once upon a time, more akin to a doctor's office than an actual funeral parlor.

introduced.name: border between life and death
introduced.how: An ordinary but little-known place between the living and the dead where spirits gather and the Ley Lines go haywire
introduced.quote: All of it exists within the border between the living and the dead, an ordinary place, really.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: Lines whose flow can go haywire, making the border region strange
introduced.quote: This is just a place where the Ley Lines tend to go a little bit haywire.

introduced.name: Lanxi
introduced.how: A spirit at the farewell ceremony site who has waited a long time for someone
introduced.quote: My name is Lanxi, I've been waiting for someone for a long time now, exactly how long I couldn't really say.

introduced.name: Zhu Ming
introduced.how: A newcomer spirit at the farewell site who has just arrived and finds the scenery pleasant
introduced.quote: Zhu Ming: Are you new here? What a coincidence, so am I!

introduced.name: Little Wu
introduced.how: One of the five childhood friends in the Lantern Rite memory; now a chef, as the friends' later lives are shown
introduced.quote: Paimon: Little Wu's become a chef, Mumu's a successful businessman, and Congzi makes great Xiao Lanterns.

introduced.name: Mumu
introduced.how: One of the five childhood friends whose Lantern Rite wish was to get rich; now a successful businessman
introduced.quote: Paimon: Little Wu's become a chef, Mumu's a successful businessman, and Congzi makes great Xiao Lanterns.

introduced.name: Congzi
introduced.how: One of the five childhood friends who wished to become a lantern artisan; now makes Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: Paimon: Little Wu's become a chef, Mumu's a successful businessman, and Congzi makes great Xiao Lanterns.

introduced.name: Big G
introduced.how: A departed friend among the five whose spirit must be sent off across the border
introduced.quote: that's the only way to send Big G off.

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill
introduced.how: The place where the spirit leaves for the afterlife and where Meng says she will not return
introduced.quote: Either way, I don't think I'll ever return to Wuwang Hill.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: A past war that left corpses across the wilderness and spread disease and death
introduced.quote: During the Archon War, piles of corpses covered the wilderness.

introduced.name: remnants of the defeated gods
introduced.how: The leftover legacy of defeated gods that once ravaged the world and nearly brought on its extinction
introduced.quote: By that, I mean the remnants of the defeated gods that ravaged the world.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: A yearly festival where lanterns are released and wishes are made
introduced.quote: Little Wu (Memory): It's the Lantern Rite again. Wouldn't it be cool if we got to see the lanterns ourselves one day?

introduced.name: wish-yelling tradition
introduced.how: A custom that a wish made by yelling it loudly during the festival will come true
introduced.quote: as long as you yell it really loud, your wish will come true in the future.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Zhongli is a consultant there.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: We don't need another clash with the Millelith.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Worth in Mora is not what's important here.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: First things first, Wangsheng Funeral Parlor will prioritize the Adventurers' Guild requests above all others.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: The Traveler repels attacking hilichurls

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Oh! You're back already? Sooner than I expected!

assumed.name: Meng
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Of course not. After all, you were caught up in all this already, just like Meng.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I imagine Adventurers' Guild members are good at making order of things?

assumed.name: Uncle Zhang
assumed.quote: Shu'yang: By the way, have you seen Uncle Zhang recently?

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Yeah, that way we don't need to go to Liyue Harbor to release Xiao Lanterns!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: What in Teyvat is going on?

threads.claim: The Traveler claims to have come from beyond the heavens, which others find strange.
threads.quote: I came from beyond the heavens.

threads.claim: Legends say spirits of gods who fell in the Archon War return to curse mortals.
threads.quote: The vengeful spirits of the gods who fell in the Archon War return to cast their evil curses upon mortals...

threads.claim: The Yaksha's resentment fueled an ancient plague that the parlor's founders helped end.
threads.quote: The pioneers of these practices were, you guessed it, the founders of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

threads.claim: The parlor guards a border between life and death that ordinary people cannot see.
threads.quote: The job of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is to "guard the border between life and death."

threads.claim: Meng fears his dead friend Big G has become a vengeful spirit.
threads.quote: Meng is worried that Big G has turned into a vengeful spirit, despite Hu Tao's insistence that she rarely encountered evil spirits in her line of work.

threads.claim: Big G proves not to be an evil spirit and only wanted to visit his old friends.
threads.quote: Meng is relieved that Big G has not turned into a vengeful spirit.

threads.claim: Hu Tao hints she can perceive spirits that ordinary people cannot see.
threads.quote: Do you see anyone else around here? ...Well, you probably wouldn't see them if there was.

threads.claim: Hu Tao senses whether the people she visits are haunted by spirits.
threads.quote: But having seen them, I didn't sense the presence of anything otherworldly.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon are searching for someone they have not yet found.
threads.quote: Ah, we're looking for someone! We've asked a lot of people, but nobody seems to have a clue where they are.

threads.claim: The search for the person the Traveler wants is still unresolved after the Big G affair.
threads.quote: Hu Tao tells them that based on the Traveler's reaction, she knew that they did not find what they were looking for.

threads.claim: Hu Tao claims she can ask the dead for information.
threads.quote: I can even inquire with "the ones who no longer speak" for you.

threads.claim: Hu Tao asked the dead for help, but the information was not useful.
threads.quote: She had also asked the dead for information to help the Traveler, but none of the information offered was worth investigating further.

threads.claim: Hu Tao has never seen former directors in the border, which suggests they died without regrets.
threads.quote: She did not spot any of the previous directors there in all of her visits, so she knows that they all died without regrets.

threads.claim: The parlor believes ordinary people should be kept ignorant of spirits and the afterlife.
threads.quote: Too much knowledge isn't good for ordinary folk.

threads.claim: Hu Tao deliberately keeps frightened people in the dark and uses staged fixes to calm them.
threads.quote: Because you can't guarantee that telling an ignorant person the truth will improve the situation instead of exacerbating it.

threads.claim: The childhood friends made promises they have not kept, and their keepsakes symbolize those promises.
threads.quote: They show that we will never forget our promise.

threads.claim: Hu Tao withholds the full story of the border between life and death, hinting that its truth is dangerous to learn.
threads.quote: Not a chance! Curiosity can be perilous, you know. Don't forget my warning, the less you know, the better.

threads.claim: The defeated gods' remnants nearly ended the world, and Hu Tao refuses to explain the full details of that crisis.
threads.quote: I won't go into specifics of that situation

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon's search for a person remains unresolved, as Hu Tao has found no useful leads.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, I didn't find any leads worth pursuing either.

threads.claim: The childhood wishes made at the Lantern Rite came true for the friends who are still living.
threads.quote: Traveler: They've come true.

threads.claim: Big G and Meng's shared wish from the Lantern Rite has not come true, leaving it an open thread.
threads.quote: Big G: I'm sorry. Of all the wishes we yelled that day, only ours hasn't come true.

threads.claim: Some spirits choose to move on from the farewell site, and Uncle Zhang did so without saying where he went.
threads.quote: Mo: That guy? I remember him saying it was time for him to move on.

threads.claim: The spirits near the border are the dead who still long for the world of the living.
threads.quote: The spirits we saw near the border are the dead that still long for the world of the living.

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: A small ninja who skips duties to nap; she is hiding from her supervisor and wants the Traveler's help
introduced.quote: Aw, you saw right through my disguise...

introduced.name: Shuumatsuban
introduced.how: A ninja group that handles matters inconvenient to the higher-ups, sometimes including ambushes
introduced.quote: So you know I'm in the Shuumatsuban, right? Well, it's our job to take care of matters that are

introduced.name: Kano Nana
introduced.how: The shrine maiden assigned to supervise Sayu and also take on Shuumatsuban work
introduced.quote: Though I am the shrine maiden, it is also part of my duties to take on work from the Shuumatsuban.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: A Yashiro Commission official who takes responsibility for the forged orders and oversees Sayu's training
introduced.quote: However, it concerns me that those forged orders went as far as they did, it's my responsibility to look into such matters.

introduced.name: Ogawa
introduced.how: An official who passes Yashiro Commission orders to the Shuumatsuban and is the one who forged the ambush order
introduced.quote: Sayu: Oh, but there is one official guy who is responsible for delivering orders from the Yashiro Commission to the Shuumatsuban.

introduced.name: Kairagi
introduced.how: A hostile group that kidnaps Ogawa's daughter and coerces him into forging the ambush order against the Traveler
introduced.quote: I was starting to get worried when a Kairagi appeared at my door and told me they'd taken her.

introduced.name: Inou
introduced.how: A Kairagi leader who holds Kotomi hostage and blackmails Ogawa
introduced.quote: Oh? You really don't get it, do you?

introduced.name: Kotomi
introduced.how: Ogawa's young daughter, kidnapped by the Kairagi and rescued by the Traveler and Sayu
introduced.quote: Ogawa: Yes, that's right! Kotomi is already safe. Quick, you must apprehend him immediately!

introduced.name: Kiminami Anna
introduced.how: A restaurant worker who asks for help against Treasure Hoarders harassing her staff
introduced.quote: Kiminami Anna: Welcome to Kiminami Restaurant! What can I get for the two of you?

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: A rowdy group that ambushes restaurant staff while they gather ingredients in the wild
introduced.quote: Recently, we've been running into a group of rowdy Treasure Hoarders whenever we go into the wild to gather ingredients.

introduced.name: Sayu's sensei
introduced.how: A former ninja who taught Sayu, measured her height on the tree, and left suddenly; even Sayu never learned their name
introduced.quote: Sensei told me that all I need to do is grow big and tall. I remember that...

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: a ninja who naps in hiding and is constantly hunted by the shrine maiden
introduced.quote: Sayu: Time to put our ninjutsu to good use!

introduced.name: Pyro Slimes
introduced.how: slimes that threaten to set the forest on fire
introduced.quote: Sayu: I suppose the good news is that we got rid of these slimes before the whole forest went up in flames.

introduced.name: ninja gadget
introduced.how: sharp caltrop-like traps that deter intruders, hurt when stepped on, and are used in ninja training
introduced.quote: Sayu: Oh, now I recognize it. It's meant to keep intruders at bay, but is also often used for ninja training. It really hurts if you step on one, so be careful.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: a shrine up a mountain with a big tree where Sayu naps
introduced.quote: Sayu: Yeah. She'd never expect to find me sleeping in the big tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

introduced.name: Kano Nana
introduced.how: an investigator hunting Sayu who checks with the Yashiro Commission about an ambush operation
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: After I returned from checking with the Yashiro Commission concerning the ambush operation, I discovered that you and Sayu had already left the forest.

introduced.name: ambush operation
introduced.how: an ambush order whose origin is being investigated and was not the Yashiro Commission
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: I did manage to confirm that the ambush order did not originate from the Yashiro Commission. An investigation is already underway. It seems we'll have more information soon enough, you needn't worry.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: Sayu: Who do you want to talk to? Someone in the Yashiro Commission?

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Then it's decided. I'll contact the Kairagi as well as the Tenryou Commission.

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Or... perhaps you feel bolder now because you've already ratted on me to the Shogunate? Hmm!?

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: I was too anxious about growing and now I'm being punished by the archons.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Why don't you come with me and see if the Adventurers' Guild has any commissions for us to handle?

assumed.name: Chinju Forest
assumed.quote: so you shall return with me to Chinju Forest.

assumed.name: Shimura
assumed.quote: I heard that Shimura's added a delicious new dish to their menu.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: Sayu: Huh? Forget the shrine maiden, this place is crawling with members of the Yashiro Commission. What are they all doing here?

assumed.name: Guuji
assumed.quote: Sayu: Whew, good thing they didn't notice us. That scary Guuji lady doesn't seem to be around either.

assumed.name: kitsune
assumed.quote: Sayu: Hehe, see? Even the kitsune are thanking us now.

assumed.name: Konda Village
assumed.quote: Traveler: How about Konda Village?

assumed.name: Amakane Island
assumed.quote: Traveler: How about Amakane Island?

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: Traveler: How about Tenshukaku?

threads.claim: The ambush order against the Traveler looks wrong, since Sayu says she never receives such missions.
threads.quote: Sayu: I don't get it, they never assign me this kind of mission. There's loads of other suitable operatives.

threads.claim: Ogawa admits he forged the ambush order under Kairagi coercion to save his daughter.
threads.quote: Yes, I was the one who forged the ambush mission, but I had good reason to!

threads.claim: The Kairagi plan to keep Kotomi hostage and extort more favors from Ogawa even after the ambush.
threads.quote: I only said that it was over for her unless you do as I say. I never said anything about returning the little brat to you.

threads.claim: Sayu's sensei is a mysterious former ninja whose name and background even Sayu never learned.
threads.quote: Sensei's name was... Uh, what was it now...?

threads.claim: Sayu's sensei suddenly left, and Ayaka was asked to watch over Sayu in their absence.
threads.quote: Before her sensei suddenly decided to leave, they insisted that I watch over her progress.

threads.claim: Sayu is obsessed with growing taller through sleep and food, yet she has not gained any height.
threads.quote: Even though I've been getting more sleep recently, I haven't gained any height at all. Any ideas?

threads.claim: The shrine maiden relentlessly hunts Sayu's napping spots and goes to extreme lengths to catch her.
threads.quote: Sayu: But it's hard to say for sure... The shrine maiden will go to extreme lengths to catch me.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the shrine maiden is behind the Pyro Slimes that appeared in the forest.
threads.quote: Traveler: Do you think she's also the one behind the slimes we ran into earlier?

threads.claim: The ambush order did not come from the Yashiro Commission, and its true origin is still under investigation.
threads.quote: Kano Nana: I did manage to confirm that the ambush order did not originate from the Yashiro Commission. An investigation is already underway. It seems we'll have more information soon enough, you needn't worry.

threads.claim: Members of the Yashiro Commission are gathering at the Grand Narukami Shrine for an unexplained reason.
threads.quote: Sayu: Huh? Forget the shrine maiden, this place is crawling with members of the Yashiro Commission. What are they all doing here?

threads.claim: Kano Nana suspects something is hidden in the branches of the tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.
threads.quote: Kano Nana: It seems to be concerned about the tree here... I wonder if there's something in the branches.

introduced.name: Iaune
introduced.how: A junior Gestionnaire at the Maison Gestion who is overworked and handles a Kamera-leak policy proposal
introduced.quote: Huh? Hello, hello. It looks, though, you are not a member of the staff here at the Maison Gestion.

introduced.name: Roialte
introduced.how: Iaune's superior at the Maison Gestion who assigns and oversees his work
introduced.quote: I shall leave this to you. Have them sign the document, just like I taught you, and return it to me before the weekend.

introduced.name: Gattineo
introduced.how: A Gestionnaire whose office reviews documents and assigns security classifications
introduced.quote: Even though all the matters he deals with are of utmost importance, he still handles each matter with aplomb.

introduced.name: Difor
introduced.how: Head of the office in charge of Maison Gestion staff matters, known for a short temper
introduced.quote: But Mr. Roialte says that I should ask Difor, as he is in charge of all matters related to the staff of the Maison Gestion.

introduced.name: Semaine
introduced.how: A former court assistant secretary transferred to the Maison Gestion who is skilled at balancing responsibilities
introduced.quote: Hello, Traveler. I am Semaine, it is a pleasure to meet you.

introduced.name: Carsix
introduced.how: A senior official whose speeches are written entirely by others and who gives public speeches
introduced.quote: Carsix never writes his own speeches! The entire text of every draft is written for him by someone else!

introduced.name: Cornelia
introduced.how: A Maison Gestion staff member who handles reimbursement requests and office paperwork
introduced.quote: Should you have any inquiries, please ask Ms. Cornelia. She's right over there.

introduced.name: Thales
introduced.how: Maintains the new automatic stamping machine at the Maison Gestion
introduced.quote: In any case, I've heard that Mr. Thales has introduced a brand-new type of machine for affixing stamps.

introduced.name: Estelle
introduced.how: A shopkeeper who sells typewriter keycaps and other goods
introduced.quote: Of course, but typewriters have so many different keys! Take a look and see which one you need a keycap for.

introduced.name: Maison Cardinalice
introduced.how: The office that approves expense reports and salary payments for the Maison Gestion
introduced.quote: and then submit everything to the Maison Cardinalice for approval at the end of the month.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: The Chief Justice, who may personally need to sign off on expense reports
introduced.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette... Wait, isn't that your Chief Justice?

introduced.name: Choiseul
introduced.how: A Fontaine Research Institute official who controls letter delivery and insists on proper procedure
introduced.quote: However, you can't simply come over and take any document. That does not conform with our letter delivery regulations.

introduced.name: Desnos
introduced.how: Runs the Institute's Qualifications Review Representative Office from the ruins and has copies of the Institute letter
introduced.quote: Traveler: Is Desnos in charge of the office?

introduced.name: Mary-Ann Memorial Park
introduced.how: A park in the Institute area, now overrun by out-of-control meka
introduced.quote: Uh, is this the Mary-Ann Memorial Park? I can't tell it's a park at all...

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: A research institute that is planning to rebuild after damage and works with the Maison Gestion on resources
introduced.quote: As you may know, the Institute is making plans to rebuild, right?

introduced.name: Maison Gestion
introduced.how: A large Fontaine government bureaucracy with many offices and strict procedures
introduced.quote: There is no office in the entire Maison Gestion that is directly charged with managing Kameras.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: A camera that staff are forbidden to bring into the Maison Gestion to photograph documents
introduced.quote: Would someone really take a Kamera into the Maison Gestion itself, and simply strut about taking pictures of everyone and anything?

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: A newspaper whose reporters publish internal Maison Gestion information quickly
introduced.quote: Perhaps my information is a step behind yours since I haven't had a chance to read The Steambird yet today.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: A group that mocks and criticizes the Maison Gestion
introduced.quote: The people of the Court of Fontaine never miss an opportunity to mock and deride the Maison Gestion, and we must act with caution.

introduced.name: security classification system
introduced.how: Documents at the Maison Gestion are reviewed by Gattineo's office, which assigns and stamps their secrecy level
introduced.quote: All the documents here have to be reviewed by them. They decide the security classification of the document and stamp it.

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: A venue where Carsix gave a public speech about recent performances
introduced.quote: Last week, Carsix went to the Opera Epiclese for a speech, and talked about recent performances.

introduced.name: Autostamper 3000
introduced.how: An automatic stamping machine that needs a key and is recorded with a Kamera
introduced.quote: Autostamper 3000: (The machine replies to you with complete silence...)

introduced.name: Academic Assembly Hall
introduced.how: A ruined hall at the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: This place is called... the Institute's Academic Assembly Hall.

introduced.name: Honorary Senior Researcher
introduced.how: A title the Institute granted to the Traveler for unspecified achievements
introduced.quote: the Institute has granted the title of Honorary Senior Researcher.

introduced.name: fish-memo Kamera leak
introduced.how: A staff member photographed a memo complaining about fish dinners, which a reporter then published
introduced.quote: The next day, that blasted memo complaining that only fish gets served for dinner here, day in and day out, was all over The Steambird!

introduced.name: Carsix minutes leak
introduced.how: Carsix used a Kamera to photograph his office and gave the photos to reporters, exposing meeting minutes that contradict his speeches
introduced.quote: He used a Kamera to take multiple photos of his office, and then distributed them to reporters.

introduced.name: out-of-control meka
introduced.how: Meka robots running wild around the Fontaine Research Institute and attacking visitors
introduced.quote: Those meka look like they are out of control. I noticed as soon as I arrived.

assumed.name: Traveler's earlier visit to the Maison Gestion
assumed.quote: Traveler, glad to see you've come back for another visit. Coffee?

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: And if you want to hide a glass of Fonta?

assumed.name: Institute's earlier disaster
assumed.quote: Who could've foreseen so many hardships for the Institute?

assumed.name: Maneval
assumed.quote: If it must be my office that is forced to take charge of this, then let Maneval come down and tell me so in person!

threads.claim: Kamera use inside the Maison Gestion is raised as a source of secret leaks that officials treat as a serious problem.
threads.quote: Would someone really take a Kamera into the Maison Gestion itself, and simply strut about taking pictures of everyone and anything?

threads.claim: Staff are told a new document will specifically address secrets leaked through Kameras, and Thales fears being made an example.
threads.quote: Recently, someone said that there's going to be a new document promulgated here at the Maison Gestion, that specifically addresses secrets leaked through Kameras.

threads.claim: Carsix, the official who warned staff against Kameras, is caught leaking his own office's minutes with a Kamera.
threads.quote: He used a Kamera to take multiple photos of his office, and then distributed them to reporters.

threads.claim: Gattineo's office stamps every document as secret, so the classification system is shown to be indiscriminate.
threads.quote: Difor: But noooo, even so, Gattineo still just has to classify it as "secret."

threads.claim: Difor says Gattineo's office stamps every trivial document as secret, so the actual secrets cannot be told apart.
threads.quote: To Gattineo, the best way to protect secrets is to make absolutely every trivial little thing a secret.

threads.claim: Carsix's speeches are ghostwritten, and his minutes contradict what he says publicly.
threads.quote: Carsix himself hasn't got the foggiest notion of what he's going to say, and doesn't even have his own ideas. He is completely reliant on being reminded by his subordinates.

threads.claim: Iaune asks the Traveler what the point of his overwhelming work is, raising the question of meaning in bureaucratic labor.
threads.quote: Perhaps you could tell me, as an objective observer... What's the point of it all?

threads.claim: Roialte says the question is too grand to answer simply and that Iaune will understand it someday.
threads.quote: Such a grand topic can't be easily explained in just a few words.

threads.claim: Bureaucratic procedure makes even simple purchases and document handling absurdly complicated.
threads.quote: Even buying something is such a pain...

threads.claim: Maison Cardinalice claims everything comes from Neuvillette himself, and Iaune doubts that claim.
threads.quote: As if! The Maison Cardinalice says everything is

threads.claim: Out-of-control meka are running wild around the Fontaine Research Institute and the Institute is doing nothing about them.
threads.quote: Those meka look like they are out of control. I noticed as soon as I arrived.

threads.claim: The Institute is in ruins and rebuilding is planned, with the Traveler noting that little is left intact.
threads.quote: Traveler: Intact is all it has left.

threads.claim: The Traveler holds the Institute's Honorary Senior Researcher title, but the achievements behind it are left unexplained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Bingo. I even have the certificate.

threads.claim: A backup stamp is kept in a locked box in Carsix's office, hinting at possible misuse of the official seal.
threads.quote: Hmm... Well, it'll still be okay. I have a backup key.

introduced.name: Durin
introduced.how: Albedo's ward, a young charge he looks after who is learning social skills and independence
introduced.quote: Seeing as you're practically his guardian, I thought he would be unable to stray too far from your side.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Albedo's research was of great help to me in Nod-Krai. I really ought to thank him in person.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: It's a rare occasion indeed when Miss Sandrone finds the time to visit Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Albedo's research was of great help to me in Nod-Krai. I really ought to thank him in person.

assumed.name: numerological array
assumed.quote: You provided such invaluable help when I was researching the numerological array. I wanted to thank you in person.

assumed.name: Grand Master Varka
assumed.quote: Typically, after a meeting with Grand Master Varka, I'll take Durin to visit Sucrose and help with her research.

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Typically, after a meeting with Grand Master Varka, I'll take Durin to visit Sucrose and help with her research.

assumed.name: Acting Grand Master Jean
assumed.quote: But if he's spent too long with Acting Grand Master Jean, we'll pay a visit to Klee so he can rediscover how to relax.

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: But if he's spent too long with Acting Grand Master Jean, we'll pay a visit to Klee so he can rediscover how to relax.

threads.claim: Albedo and Sandrone collaborated on a numerological array that Sandrone credits as a team effort, hinting at an unexplained project.
threads.quote: You provided such invaluable help when I was researching the numerological array. I wanted to thank you in person.

threads.claim: Sandrone suggests that a good-natured person always returns to their true self no matter how much outside influence they face.
threads.quote: But it seems to me that if someone's good by nature, no matter how much they're influenced, they'll always return to their true self.

threads.claim: Durin is making progress with social skills and being encouraged toward independence, after past habits of picking up strong personalities' traits.
threads.quote: But recently, he's been making headway with his social skills, so I've been trying to encourage him to be a bit more independent.

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: a newly built trial-phase resort that invites adventurers to a free getaway
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort!

introduced.name: Tenochtzitoc
introduced.how: the location of the resort, a region where guests are invited for an extraordinary getaway
introduced.quote: to experience an extraordinary getaway in Tenochtzitoc.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: a shop owner and tour guide who is a surfer and a friend of Chasca
introduced.quote: I'm Mualani — when I'm not around running my shop, I'm out and about being a tour guide.

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: a Peacemaker who flies and fights and comes from the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.quote: And this here is Chasca, Peacemaker of the Flower-Feather Clan.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: Chasca's clan, whose members have saurian family and hold their own sacrifices
introduced.quote: And this here is Chasca, Peacemaker of the Flower-Feather Clan.

introduced.name: Benny's Adventure Team
introduced.how: Bennett's small adventurer group, which he admits is a team of one
introduced.quote: in reality, it's a team of one.

introduced.name: Asha
introduced.how: special Monetoo that roam freely in the resort area and serve as its mascots
introduced.quote: They roam freely around these parts, which is why they were chosen as mascots for the Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

introduced.name: Dreambow Drift
introduced.how: a hot air balloon ride over the canyon offered as an attraction
introduced.quote: Dear visitors, welcome to Dreambow Drift! Kick back, relax, and take in the stunning views of the canyon from our hot air balloon.

introduced.name: Miztli
introduced.how: an attendant who runs the Dreambow Drift balloon boarding
introduced.quote: Whenever you're ready, just let me know, and we'll have you aboard in no time!

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: a reclusive granny in Tenochtzitoc said to be linked to its spiritual energy
introduced.quote: According to Granny Citlali, Tenochtzitoc's full of spiritual energy.

introduced.name: Ukucha
introduced.how: resort staff who checks guests in and briefs them on the resort
introduced.quote: I'll get you all checked in to your accommodations.

introduced.name: Colorfall Cliffs
introduced.how: one of the four main resort areas, with the Foamflower Fields
introduced.quote: The resort is made up of four main areas: Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, Wavey Bay, and Tete Isle.

introduced.name: Guiztli Ridge
introduced.how: one of the four resort areas, where the town offers head-to-head challenges
introduced.quote: I'm leaning more towards Guiztli Ridge.

introduced.name: Wavey Bay
introduced.how: a resort area full of water activities
introduced.quote: For me, it's gotta be Wavey Bay! There's so much to do out there on the water.

introduced.name: Tete Isle
introduced.how: a resort area with a bar and mead brewing that is closed for construction until the end
introduced.quote: Due to ongoing construction, Tete Isle is temporarily closed.

introduced.name: Commemorative photo album
introduced.how: a guest album filled by photographing each area's main challenge, to claim a final prize
introduced.quote: please take this map, along with a special commemorative photo album we prepared for all our guests.

introduced.name: Final prize
introduced.how: a reward given after collecting all four album photos
introduced.quote: Once you've collected all four photos, come back here to claim your final prize.

introduced.name: Sun offering ritual
introduced.how: a Tenochtzitoc ritual where people light a sun-shaped bundle of fruit as an offering
introduced.quote: As it burns, the smoke carries their wishes straight to the gods.

introduced.name: Nataba
introduced.how: a vendor selling offering bundles called suns
introduced.quote: Hey there, little visitor! Could I interest you in buying a

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: Bennett's travel buddy and a bard who introduces himself casually to the group
introduced.quote: You can just call me Venti. I like to keep things casual.

introduced.name: Dance-Off Stage
introduced.how: a Xilonen-designed stage on Tete Isle for the opening ceremony
introduced.quote: Ta-da! This is the Dance-Off Stage!

introduced.name: Aphimead
introduced.how: Tete Isle's mead, brewed with aphids guided to gather honeydew and refined by tatankasaurs
introduced.quote: Aphids play the central role in the brewing of Tete Isle's Aphimead.

introduced.name: Takhar
introduced.how: a Tete Isle brewing staff member who explains how Aphimead is made
introduced.quote: Ah, you must be the guest in green I've been hearing about

introduced.name: Me & Dew
introduced.how: a little bar on Tete Isle where the group regroups
introduced.quote: Oh, I know a place — a little bar called Me & Dew.

introduced.name: The Dewdrop
introduced.how: a bar where Venti is found drinking
introduced.quote: your friend's at a bar called The Dewdrop

introduced.name: Chasca's qucusaur family
introduced.how: saurian relatives Chasca comes to scope out the resort for
introduced.quote: Chasca's here to scope out the resort for her qucusaur family, too.

introduced.name: Tecpatl's Flintblades
introduced.how: Adventure team of friends from different tribes whose goal was fame across Teyvat
introduced.quote: Bennett: A group of friends from different tribes, united by a single goal — to make the name of their Adventure Team, the Tecpatl's Flintblades, known throughout all of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Bennett's infancy with the Flintblades
introduced.how: Bennett was the baby from the Flintblades' final journey
introduced.quote: Paimon: So that baby from Tecpatl's Flintblades turned out to be Bennett...

introduced.name: Aroni
introduced.how: Bennett's mother, a Flintblades member lost in this place and turned Asha
introduced.quote: Aroni: That's right. We strayed into this place all those years ago... and never made it out.

introduced.name: Macani
introduced.how: Bennett's father and Flintblades team leader, also lost to the Domain
introduced.quote: Macani: Be sure to thank them, son, on behalf of myself and the rest of Tecpatl's Flintblades. Haha, just look at us, together like this!

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: An Abyssal land; the Domain was an unstable simulation of it that is now gone
introduced.quote: Bennett: She told me that the Domain we entered was an Abyssal simulation of the Mare Jivari. It was extremely unstable, and now it's completely gone.

introduced.name: Windless Land
introduced.how: Venti blew the Mare Jivari off the timeline five hundred years ago to contain its corruption
introduced.quote: Venti: ...I blew it off the timeline, turning it into the "Windless Land."

introduced.name: Asha origin
introduced.how: Souls who could not return to Mondstadt merged with the Monetoo to become the Asha
introduced.quote: Venti: Some souls were unable to return to Mondstadt as a result... while others stayed to settle in this land, merging with the Monetoo to become the Asha we see today.

introduced.name: Time
introduced.how: A primordial being who records all people, events and farewells in her memory
introduced.quote: Venti: Long, long ago, "Time" began to write the story of this world.

introduced.name: Venti's encounter with Time
introduced.how: Venti, as an Anemo spirit, met Time at the Thousand Winds Temple and was given fragments of her power
introduced.quote: Venti: Back then, as an Anemo spirit, I had a chance encounter with "Time" at the Thousand Winds Temple.

introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.how: The current Pyro Archon, who opened a rift to the Mare Jivari for Venti
introduced.quote: Venti: Correct. I'm here to collaborate with the current Pyro Archon, Mavuika.

introduced.name: Miniature "Sun" candle
introduced.how: A candle whose lit flame serves as a guiding signal
introduced.quote: Venti: Yes. Light it up, and the "sun" will guide him.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: Natlan's Ley Lines connect people to luck; Bennett was cut off from them

introduced.name: Natlan

threads.claim: The Asha may be a mysterious spiritual phenomenon tied to Tenochtzitoc's energy, which no one has fully explained.
threads.quote: I guess it follows that the Asha must be some kind of mysterious spiritual phenomenon.

threads.claim: One Asha has taken an unusual liking to Bennett and will not leave his side, a bond that may have a spiritual cause.
threads.quote: he seems to have taken a special liking to Bennett! Won't even leave his side!

threads.claim: Bennett's sudden run of good luck has an unexplained source.
threads.quote: And my luck's been so unreal lately!

threads.claim: Venti hints he may be behind Bennett's lucky streak but refuses to confirm it.
threads.quote: Hehe, who's to say?

threads.claim: The lucky streak traces to a shopkeeper who suggested lake blue, which the Traveler recognizes as Mualani.
threads.quote: I think I know who you're talking about.

threads.claim: Venti has a mysterious friend in Natlan who he refuses to name, possibly Mavuika.
threads.quote: It's a secret, and I expect anyone who's guessed the answer to keep it that way.

threads.claim: An unidentified figure is secretly watching the group from around a corner.
threads.quote: being observed by someone unknown from around a corner

threads.claim: Natlan suffered a terrible war not long ago that left its tribes in pain and loss.
threads.quote: I heard there was a terrible war in Natlan not too long ago

threads.claim: Venti is a former teacher of Bennett who taught a love poem crash course, a past that remains only partly explained.
threads.quote: I hope I get the chance to hold another love poem crash course

threads.claim: Completing the resort challenges will lead to a final prize whose nature is unknown.
threads.quote: Once you've collected all four photos, come back here to claim your final prize.

threads.claim: The resort's invitations went out to adventurers across Teyvat, and the reason behind the invitation is unexplained.
threads.quote: This is one of the invitations that was sent out to adventurers all over Teyvat.

threads.claim: The resort is still unfinished and was only just announced, which raises questions about why it was kept quiet.
threads.quote: How come we're only hearing about this now?

threads.claim: The photos in the album have changed on their own, and no one can explain how.
threads.quote: Bennett: All four photos have changed.

threads.claim: Aroni was secretly following the group and swapped in photos of their adventures.
threads.quote: Aroni: From the moment I saw your group, I've been following you around, taking all kinds of photos of your adventures.

threads.claim: The Tecpatl's Flintblades disbanded after a final journey that the group's notes describe.
threads.quote: Bennett: The Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team...

threads.claim: The baby from the Flintblades' final journey was Bennett, and his parents are the Flintblades members.
threads.quote: Paimon: So that baby from Tecpatl's Flintblades turned out to be Bennett...

threads.claim: The Rota Calamitas in the sky grows darker, hinting at a looming threat.
threads.quote: Mualani: Um, is it just me or did those weird stars just get darker? I've got a bad feeling about this...

threads.claim: A mysterious voice claims Bennett is fated to die and that his parents' legacy has faded.
threads.quote: Voice That Echoes: Those who would have saved you are long gone. Behold, even your so-called "Wheel of Fate" lies in ruins.

threads.claim: Venti reframes fate as a rolling wheel and says Bennett's worst hardship is behind him.
threads.quote: Venti: If fate is a giant wheel rolling down the road, then I'd say, for Bennett, the bumpiest stretch is behind him.

threads.claim: The Mare Jivari disappeared from Tenochtzitoc decades ago, and another person knows how.
threads.quote: Venti: If you're asking about how the Mare Jivari disappeared from Tenochtzitoc two or three decades ago, there may be someone else better suited to tell that story.

threads.claim: The corruption of the Mare Jivari is tied to time itself and present in every moment.
threads.quote: Venti: The corruption of the Mare Jivari is tied to time itself. To put it another way, it is a calamity present in every moment that will ever be.

threads.claim: Time wrote the world's story and entrusted Venti with fragments of her power.
threads.quote: Venti: Long, long ago, "Time" began to write the story of this world.

threads.claim: Becoming Asha erased the memories and identities of those who were lost in the Domain.
threads.quote: Aroni: I should probably explain... After becoming Asha, we lost our memories, and our minds became so hazy we couldn't even remember who we were.

threads.claim: Souls that could not return to Mondstadt merged with the Monetoo and became the Asha.
threads.quote: Venti: Some souls were unable to return to Mondstadt as a result... while others stayed to settle in this land, merging with the Monetoo to become the Asha we see today.

threads.claim: The lit candle was the signal that let Venti and Mavuika open the rift to the Mare Jivari.
threads.quote: Venti: Correct again. The flame was our signal.

threads.claim: Bennett's bad luck is blamed on his cut-off connection to Natlan's Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...Which must be why he's always been so unlucky... until he finally came back!

threads.claim: Venti shares a love of freedom with Mavuika, a theme that runs through his past choices.
threads.quote: Venti: I was glad to discover that she shares my love for fine wine and freedom. We got along great.

threads.claim: Venti's wish is that everyone who wishes to stay in Mondstadt can freely choose their own path.
threads.quote: Venti: I suppose... to protect Mondstadt, and that everyone who wishes to stay there has the freedom to choose their own path.

introduced.name: Fangjin
introduced.how: Introduces himself as the leader of a Millelith platoon
introduced.quote: I am Fangjin, leader of this Millelith platoon.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: The Traveler is listed as an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius with captain-level authority in crises
introduced.quote: Our reports also list you as an Honorary Knight in the Knights of Favonius, granted captain-level authority in times of crisis.

introduced.name: Sergeant
introduced.how: The Traveler is addressed as Sergeant, a title given through the Honorary Knight status
introduced.quote: Therefore, it seems only appropriate to address you as Sergeant.

introduced.name: Ley Line disturbance
introduced.how: A Ley Line disturbance re-enacts past historical battles inside a domain and releases monsters outside
introduced.quote: In short, this anomaly is a vestige of a past Ley Line disturbance.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: Anyone who touches an active Ley Line deposit is transported into a strange domain
introduced.quote: anyone who comes into contact with it is transported to a strange domain.

introduced.name: Domain rules
introduced.how: The domain has rules that block reaching its core and weaken those inside
introduced.quote: there seems to be a strange set of rules at play in the domain.

introduced.name: Sal Terrae
introduced.how: A location where a Ley Line deposit has caused a monster surge and the Millelith have closed the area off
introduced.quote: there's something strange going on at Sal Terrae, and loads of monsters have shown up...

introduced.name: Mondstadt Ley Line disturbance
introduced.how: A similar disturbance in Mondstadt's recent past was worn down through attrition and ended
introduced.quote: My sources tell me that Mondstadt has experienced a similar phenomenon in the recent past.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Keqing: It's been a while, you two. I see you're still chasing danger.

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: A few hours? I'm sorry, I would've taken my time if I'd known the Lady Yuheng wanted to catch up with in private...

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Let's fight side by side with the Millelith and send those monsters packing — just like old times!

assumed.name: Su Ding
assumed.quote: Staff Officer Su Ding has mentioned you before, and had nothing but praise for your extraordinary talents.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Our reports also list you as an Honorary Knight in the Knights of Favonius, granted captain-level authority in times of crisis.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Latest news from the Adventurers' Guild

assumed.name: Guili Plains
assumed.quote: all units are elite officers who have served in the Guili Plains.

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: I'll need to contact Ningguang and request additional funding for our defenses.

assumed.name: Kaiyang
assumed.quote: I'll reach out to the Kaiyang to discuss manpower.

assumed.name: Qixing

assumed.name: Qiyong
assumed.quote: The enemies in that Domain can't be understood like we would common foes.

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace
assumed.quote: We received a response from Yujing Terrace.

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: Both the Tianquan and the Kaiyang have agreed to establish a long-term partnership

assumed.name: Darknight Hero
assumed.quote: a certain Honorary Knight and Darknight Hero to keep the monsters at bay.

assumed.name: Archon War

assumed.name: Cataclysm
assumed.quote: The Khaenri'ahn cataclysm, perhaps?

threads.claim: The reason the Ley Line deposit suddenly became unusually active is unknown.
threads.quote: However, for reasons we have not yet determined, it recently became unusually active, which has led to an alarming surge in monster attacks.

threads.claim: The root cause of the disturbance remains unresolved and another surge is expected.
threads.quote: For now, at least. We haven't eliminated the root cause.

threads.claim: Entering the domain weakens the Ley Line disturbance, though the root problem remains.
threads.quote: And although you didn't eliminate the root of the problem, it's plain to see you've weakened the Ley Line disturbance considerably.

threads.claim: The Ley Line disturbance might be turned to the garrison's advantage.
threads.quote: Thanks to your tireless efforts, we may even be able to turn this Ley Line disturbance to our advantage.

threads.claim: Someone resistant to Ley Line interference must study the domain's rules, which are still unknown.
threads.quote: My verdict is, we need to find someone highly resistant to Ley Line interference who can look into the domain's rules undisturbed.

threads.claim: Monsters inside the domain show traits never seen before, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Some of them even showed traits we've never observed before.

threads.claim: The specific historical battle being re-enacted in the domain is an open question.
threads.quote: Which major historical battle do you think is being re-enacted here?

threads.claim: The Ley Lines are re-enacting major historical battles inside the domain.
threads.quote: I was able to confirm that the Ley Lines are currently re-enacting major historical battles inside the domain.

threads.claim: The Mondstadt disturbance was ended when the Ley Line exhausted its stored information and returned to normal.
threads.quote: This eventually depleted all the information stored in the Ley Line, after which it returned to normal.

threads.claim: The Traveler does not remember past deeds as an Honorary Knight, raising questions about their history.
threads.quote: I don't remember that... Maybe I really do work when Paimon's asleep!

threads.claim: The Traveler wants to learn more about the Honorary Knight who fought the Mondstadt disturbance.
threads.quote: Traveler: Tell me more about this

threads.claim: Ley Lines hold secrets that people wish could be uncovered.
threads.quote: If only there was a way to grab them and shake all the secrets out...

assumed.name: Mora

assumed.name: ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: is an adventurer too, ad astra abyssosque and all that jazz!

threads.claim: The Liliacruces Forum's vast fortune was never found, leaving its location an open question.
threads.quote: However, this wealth was never found.

threads.claim: The promised treasure vault turns out to hold no treasure, exposing Virgil's lie.
threads.quote: There's no treasure here, but there are lots of experiments on machinery and energy.

threads.claim: Greedy goons are hunting Virgil over the Forum's secret treasure, and he is hiding from them.
threads.quote: There are many greedy goons who are also after the Liliacruces Forum's secret treasure.

threads.claim: Virgil deliberately led the Traveler and Paimon into a trap, and the Traveler suspected it.
threads.quote: So you knew, and still decided to step into my trap?

threads.claim: The site's true identity as a Forum or an Institute is unclear and records disagree.
threads.quote: Eh? Aren't we investigating the Forum? So is it a forum, or an institute?

threads.claim: Fontaine's water levels have risen before and will rise again, possibly flooding the whole city.
threads.quote: The water levels of Fontaine have risen before.

threads.claim: The rising water has already caused serious damage to Fontaine's underwater buildings.
threads.quote: It looks like the rising water levels have caused a lot of damage to Fontaine.

threads.claim: The Forum gathered mechanisms from many nations, raising questions about where they came from.
threads.quote: Well, since this order brought all kinds of mechanisms from other nations to this place

threads.claim: Sinthe is a harmful drink that is smuggled and sold, damaging Fontaine's citizens.
threads.quote: What about your conscience as you watch our countrymen turn into husks of themselves from this drink?

threads.claim: Sonny's organization follows its own justice code and forbids certain trades.
threads.quote: Our organization has a justice code all on our own

threads.claim: Virgil is caught and begs for mercy after Sonny and Luca confront him.
threads.quote: Ahh, it was my fault, it was all my fault... Please, have mercy...

threads.claim: Fontaine's citizens see their city as the center of the world, a theme of civic pride.
threads.quote: It's not the people of Fontaine who should go out and see the world

threads.claim: Virgil dismisses any duty to Fontaine's future generations, a theme of civic responsibility.
threads.quote: What do the people and Fontaine of the future have to do with me?

threads.claim: Virgil frames the Forum's pursuit of knowledge as the source of its power and ambition.
threads.quote: This is especially true for the Liliacruces Forum.

threads.claim: The Traveler's fame has reached Fontaine, so people there know of them before they arrive.
threads.quote: With your fame and accomplishments, it is only natural that news of your arrival would reach us as soon as you stepped foot in Fontaine.
