threads.quote: Traveler: Perhaps it was comprised of the Snegovik's wishes...

threads.claim: The giant made a promise to meet someone and is driven to keep it.
threads.quote: Gentle Male Voice: I... I've made a promise. I cannot just...

threads.claim: A statue hints the young woman waited for a beloved who may never have returned.
threads.quote: That her beloved will return safely from the battlefield... or that they will appear at the place they promised to meet?

threads.claim: Pavlina forbade the girl from meeting the giant, and her reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Compassionate Voice: Lady Pavlina has ordered... not to allow that human girl to meet him... but that's too much. It's too cruel...

threads.claim: The giant's power ran out of control and the chains hold him back.
threads.quote: Cold Voice: Your power has gone out of control, my friend.

threads.claim: The giant is heading toward a lighthouse for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is the place he's trying to get to... Is that a lighthouse?

threads.claim: The giant's light ignites the lighthouse lamp, ending his journey there.
threads.quote: (The light in his chest pulses, and the camera focuses on the lighthouse lamp)

threads.claim: Man-made monsters are present in the snow, with their origin unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, what's this man-made monster doing here...?

threads.claim: The Shadow Realm can trap beings in chains and its nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ah, chains have appeared in the Shadow Realm and trapped that big guy!

threads.claim: A soldier's farewell song and phonograph hint at a lost love.
threads.quote: Gentle Male Voice: If I do not return from battle... then... put it ... just as I once sang for you...

introduced.name: Huni
introduced.how: Natlan youth who snuck out alone to find the lost baby Saurians
introduced.quote: Hi! I'm Huni, are you here to help find the baby Saurians?

introduced.name: Toba
introduced.how: Huni's friend who searches with her and knows many local stories
introduced.quote: And I'm Toba. You must be the helpers that we've been waiting for!

introduced.name: Nanna
introduced.how: Huni's dad's Saurian, injured in the unrest, who has three babies
introduced.quote: Her name's Nanna, and she has three little babies.

introduced.name: baby Saurians
introduced.how: Nanna's three frightened babies who ran off and hid on the cliff
introduced.quote: After what happened to Nanna, her babies were so scared that they ran off and hid.

introduced.name: Trinidad
introduced.how: Huni's father, an elder of the Scions of the Canopy with local influence
introduced.quote: I'm Trinidad. Apparently, you helped my daughter today, so if there's anything you need, just ask.

introduced.name: Sanka
introduced.how: Glasses-wearing stranger who tricked Huni into telling stories and then posed as their contact
introduced.quote: We met at the foot of this cliff, so... beneath the peaks...

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: Legendary Saurian-hunter who holds the Malipo ancient name
introduced.quote: Aw man, I'm so jealous! I've never even spoken to him. He's so cool! He's the Saurian-hunter, and he has a really awesome ancient name.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: Self-proclaimed K'uhul Ajaw, a haughty dragon ruler of the Nation of Flame
introduced.quote: We are the dragon supreme! Sovereign ruler of the Nation of Flame!

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: Abyssal power can corrupt creatures so they attack their own kin
introduced.quote: See this little lizard? Its mother, a medium-sized lizard, came under the influence of Abyssal power.

introduced.name: Turnfire
introduced.how: Transparent fire that burns from behind and must never be looked back at
introduced.quote: Turnfire is different from normal fire.

introduced.name: Turnfire Night
introduced.how: Annual Scions of the Canopy ceremony honoring Burkina and cleansing the Mountain King's Abyssal power
introduced.quote: It is a traditional ceremony among the Scions of the Canopy, in which we remember our ancestor, Burkina, and his companion, Kongamato the Mountain King.

introduced.name: Yupanqui
introduced.how: Legendary ancestor hero who stole the Turnfire and was burned after looking back
introduced.quote: The hero was called Yupanqui. He's the ancestor of our tribe.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: Tyrant who used the Turnfire to rule Natlan in the Grand Alliance era
introduced.quote: It was used by the tyrant Och-Kan to rule over Natlan and oppress anyone who opposed him.

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: First Pyro Archon, a friend of Yupanqui
introduced.quote: Yupanqui was friends with Och-Kan the tyrant and also Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: Power whose sacred flame offshoots are used in the ceremony
introduced.quote: They contain the power of the Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.how: Flame that burns away Abyssal filth and is used in the ceremony
introduced.quote: More to the point though, the Sacred Flame is able to burn away Abyssal filth, so that's why we use it in the ceremony.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: Tribe whose settlement lies down a path from the cliffs, with elders and a warm welcome for guests
introduced.quote: I promise, you'll get a big Scions of the Canopy welcome!

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: Deathly dark realm where the Turnfire fell and where the dead go to be reborn
introduced.quote: The grown-ups say that it lights up the path that leads to the next life.

introduced.name: Kongamato
introduced.how: Yumkasaur warrior called the Mountain King, Burkina's companion who fought the Abyss
introduced.quote: Burkina was a hero who bore the ancient name Malipo, and Kongamato was a powerful yumkasaur warrior.

introduced.name: Burkina
introduced.how: Hero who received the Malipo name and is celebrated on Turnfire Night
introduced.quote: Sure has! It went to Burkina, the hero that we celebrate on Turnfire Night.

introduced.name: Malipo
introduced.how: Ancient name passed down through heroes, now held by Kinich
introduced.quote: There's a story behind every ancient name.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: Entities that bestow ancient names on people
introduced.quote: I'm convinced the Wayob got hit on the head and took a wrong turn the day it chose to give that ancient name to him.

introduced.name: Yumkasaur
introduced.how: Long-lived reptilian warrior kind that normally lives under a century
introduced.quote: Normally, yumkasaurs never live longer than a century.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: Organization Sanka claims membership in, hinting at Abyss ties
introduced.quote: Speaking as a member of the Abyss Order, that's music to my ears

introduced.name: Abyss incident near Huitztlan
introduced.how: Abyssal outbreak that drove a mother lizard to attack her tribe and offspring
introduced.quote: If you must know — our humble servant begged us to investigate an Abyss incident near Huitztlan, and we chose to grant his request.

introduced.name: Ancestral Temple
introduced.how: Former Scions home, now a training place for youths to develop courage
introduced.quote: Now, it has become a place where our youths go to develop courage and kindle a spirit of adventure.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame Pillars
introduced.how: Pillars that the flame bearer must light by grappling into the sky
introduced.quote: First, the flame bearer must collect a kindling of the Sacred Flame from the starting point, then use a grappling hook to fly up into the sky and light each of the Sacred Flame Pillars.

introduced.name: flame bearer
introduced.how: Role of carrying the Sacred Flame through the ceremony route, which the tribe needs filled
introduced.quote: we need to find a suitable flame bearer

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: You're not from Natlan, right? 'Cause your clothes look different than ours.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: All we ask for is one million Mora.

assumed.name: When All Becomes a Monument
assumed.quote: I heard that two mysterious travelers from afar helped the Pyro Archon to solve the crisis our nation was facing.

assumed.name: Kinich prior meeting
assumed.quote: But we have met him before, and one time we had a meal together.

assumed.name: Ajaw prior meeting
assumed.quote: You're somehow managing to be even more annoying than the last time we met.

threads.claim: The Mountain King is dangerous and his hibernation is fragile, so the tribe's problem remains unresolved.
threads.quote: The Mountain King problem still hasn't been solved...

threads.claim: The Mountain King has awakened again and nearly reawakened unpredictably, with a makeshift ceremony only barely containing him.
threads.quote: He has. We managed to contain the situation by performing a makeshift ceremony right away, but it was a close call.

threads.claim: Nanna was injured in the unrest, hinting at a larger tribal crisis.
threads.quote: There's been a lot of unrest in the tribe lately, and my dad's Saurian got injured...

threads.claim: Nanna was contaminated by the Abyss after the Mountain King attacked her during the ceremony.
threads.quote: She became contaminated by the Abyss as a result, and...

threads.claim: Kinich demands a price for his help and may have hidden motives behind it.
threads.quote: And then I'll name my price.

threads.claim: Kinich's mercenary reputation is confirmed when he refuses to help without an exceptional price.
threads.quote: An exceptional ceremony? I'll have to charge an exceptional price.

threads.claim: Sanka is secretly probing the tribe's lore and ancient names for an unknown purpose.
threads.quote: You see, I'm very interested in the lore of your tribe.

threads.claim: Ajaw senses Abyssal energy and warns of a hidden evil sorcerer nearby.
threads.quote: Hm, we sense a faint Abyssal energy... An evil sorcerer must be lurking nearby, but they are well-hidden.

threads.claim: Abyss contamination keeps returning in the area, and the Sacred Flame must repeatedly cleanse it.
threads.quote: Ugh, the Abyss contamination is back... No surprises there.

threads.claim: Turning back toward the Turnfire is fatal, a rule with unexplained consequences.
threads.quote: And whatever you do, you mustn't turn back to look at it!

threads.claim: The ceremony repeats the rule that the flame bearer must never turn back, with the risk of getting burned.
threads.quote: The only thing you're not allowed to do is turn back.

threads.claim: Yupanqui's fate raises the question of whether his death was the price of theft or of looking back.
threads.quote: The question is, was this the price he paid for stealing the Turnfire? Or the price of turning back?

threads.claim: The Turnfire story may be only a legend, and its literal truth is left open.
threads.quote: I dunno... I think it's just a story.

threads.claim: The Turnfire still burns in the Night Kingdom, linking the dead to the fire.
threads.quote: The grown-ups say that it lights up the path that leads to the next life.

threads.claim: The Sacred Flame is treated as a ceremonial stand-in for the legendary Turnfire, which cannot be retrieved.
threads.quote: Heh, for ceremonial purposes, at least.

threads.claim: Ancient names are bestowed by the Wayob, a power whose choices seem arbitrary.
threads.quote: I'm convinced the Wayob got hit on the head and took a wrong turn the day it chose to give that ancient name to him.

threads.claim: The tribe may be forced to relocate again if the Mountain King threat is not contained.
threads.quote: If we fail to keep the threat posed by the Mountain King at bay, it might not be long before we have to move again, and find a new home...

threads.claim: The Scions were once forced from their ancestral home, hinting at a past upheaval.
threads.quote: There was a time, long before the age of Burkina and the Mountain King, when we Scions of the Canopy called that our home.

introduced.name: Wanderer
introduced.how: the hat-wearing figure who once entrusted the speaker with his computational core
introduced.quote: That hat guy... He entrusted me with his computational core before.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: a puppet who has accepted errors in her core and believes puppets must take many detours to find their heart
introduced.quote: Regardless, it takes a good many detours before a puppet can find its heart. At least, it did for me.

introduced.name: Marionette's creator
introduced.how: the puppet's creator, who helped and guided her in life and after
introduced.quote: I did. He gave me a lot of help and guidance, both in life... and after.

assumed.name: numerological array
assumed.quote: I just wanted to thank you for the core processing unit you provided for the numerological array.

assumed.name: Wanderer's computational core entrusted earlier
assumed.quote: He entrusted me with his computational core before.

assumed.name: earlier meeting between Wanderer and the Marionette
assumed.quote: Even compared to our last meeting, I feel like you've changed a lot.

threads.claim: Wanderer once entrusted the Marionette with his computational core, and she now repays him with tea and thanks.
threads.quote: He entrusted me with his computational core before.

threads.claim: The Marionette says her only change was accepting errors in her core and seeing things clearly, hinting at an unexplained transformation.
threads.quote: the only changes I've undergone are to accept the errors in my core and open my eyes to see a few things clearly.

threads.claim: Puppets must take many detours before finding a heart, a theme the Marionette claims to have lived.
threads.quote: Regardless, it takes a good many detours before a puppet can find its heart. At least, it did for me.

threads.claim: The Marionette's creator guided her in life and after, and her bond with him differs fundamentally from Wanderer's.
threads.quote: In that regard, there's a fundamental difference between us.

threads.claim: Wanderer admits he has taken too many detours and must walk a longer path to make up for his past errors.
threads.quote: It's just that I've taken too many detours already. I need to walk an even longer path to make up for them all.

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: a Frostmoon Scion who wants to take the first step toward friendlier ties with the Fatui
introduced.quote: It still feels like there's quite a gap between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui... But at the very least, I can be the one to take the first step.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Lauma's group, with its own tea-brewing customs and a troubled history with the Fatui
introduced.quote: Did you brew this the Frostmoon Scions' way? Most outsiders I've met don't like our tea.

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: the Marionette, a figure who protected Nod-Krai and welcomed back the Moon Goddess, and who leads Fatui subordinates
introduced.quote: I'm grateful for your efforts in protecting Nod-Krai and welcoming back the Moon Goddess, Miss Sandrone.

introduced.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
introduced.how: a portable table that can be placed in a location to hold a tea party
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in Frostmoon Enclave and take a seat)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: I'm afraid that... is because there's far too much history between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui.

assumed.name: Moon Goddess
assumed.quote: The return of the Moon Goddess has strengthened our resolve to walk our given path.

assumed.name: Idol of the New Moon
assumed.quote: (Sandrone looks over to her left at the refurbished Idol of the New Moon)

assumed.name: Frostmoon Enclave
assumed.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in Frostmoon Enclave and take a seat)

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: I'm grateful for your efforts in protecting Nod-Krai and welcoming back the Moon Goddess, Miss Sandrone.

threads.claim: A long and painful history lies between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui, and it blocks friendly relations.
threads.quote: there's far too much history between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui.

threads.claim: The Fatui have stopped trying to take from the Frostmoon Scions, and Sandrone has told her subordinates to stop making trouble for them.
threads.quote: But the Fatui no longer seek to take anything from the Frostmoon Scions, and I have reminded my subordinates not to make things difficult.

threads.claim: The Moon Goddess has returned, and her return has strengthened the Frostmoon Scions' resolve to follow their path.
threads.quote: The return of the Moon Goddess has strengthened our resolve to walk our given path.

threads.claim: Sandrone hopes the Scions and the Fatui, as neighbors, can at least treat each other with mutual respect, even without perfect harmony.
threads.quote: even if we can't coexist in perfect harmony, it would be nice if we could at least treat each other with mutual respect.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: a Great Shaman who helped the Traveler a lot during the Fontinalia Festival
introduced.quote: Great Shaman Citlali helped me a lot during the Fontinalia Festival.

introduced.name: Fontinalia Festival
introduced.how: a festival Citlali agreed to help out with, which Sandrone thanks her for
introduced.quote: Besides, I wanted to thank you for agreeing to help out during the Fontinalia Festival.

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: a robot who was involved in an incident with Sandrone's subordinate
introduced.quote: The incident involving the robot, Ineffa...

introduced.name: Citlali's gift
introduced.how: a limited-edition collector's book in Citlali's favorite genre, given by Sandrone as an apology
introduced.quote: Th—This... It's a limited edition... No, a collector's edition!? And it's my favorite genre!?

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: (Sandrone beams with pride at presenting Citlali's gift)

assumed.name: Sandrone's past trouble with Citlali (her subordinate's incident)
assumed.quote: Ah... That business with your subordinate? The incident involving the robot, Ineffa...

threads.claim: Sandrone has caused Citlali trouble in the past, and the details of that conflict are left unexplained.
threads.quote: Well... Although you were gracious enough not to bring it up last time, I'm well aware I've caused you trouble in the past.

threads.claim: The incident involving the robot Ineffa and Sandrone's subordinate is a past event that is hinted at but not explained.
threads.quote: Ah... That business with your subordinate? The incident involving the robot, Ineffa...

threads.claim: Citlali and Sandrone, once enemies, now have a friendly relationship that Citlali finds strange.
threads.quote: Isn't life strange? You might suddenly find yourself friends with your former enemy's boss...

threads.claim: Citlali's flustered and jealous reactions to Sandrone's shopping trip hint at unresolved personal feelings between them.
threads.quote: ...There'd better not be a next time!!!

introduced.name: Alyosha's silver dog (later named Lyumina)
introduced.how: A silver guard dog that greets the Traveler and is later named Lyumina by Alyosha
introduced.quote: (A silver dog runs towards Traveler)

introduced.name: Lyumina
introduced.how: Alyosha's dog, whose name is revealed when she returns to the station
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Lyumina? Oh... Hah. Good girl. You managed to wait for .

introduced.name: Alyosha's station
introduced.how: An abandoned station Alyosha is restoring for the local community
introduced.quote: Alyosha: I want to fix up this abandoned station.

introduced.name: Furnace
introduced.how: The station's heat source, which provides stable heat and energy once running
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Yeah. Once the furnace starts up, it provides a stable source of heat and energy.

introduced.name: Power core
introduced.how: A special component the furnace needs before it can start; the technicians said so
introduced.quote: Alyosha: I had the technicians from the Rokot check it out. They said this kind of furnace needs a certain power core. Without that, it won't start.

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: Alyosha's group with technicians, which stands for principles without resorting to violence
introduced.quote: Alyosha: But that's fine by me. It's one way I can stand up for what the Rokot believes in without having to reach for my gun.

introduced.name: Fae gangs
introduced.how: Gangs secretly digging up Shadow Realm relics, possibly holding the needed power core
introduced.quote: Alyosha: I remember them saying that the gangs are secretly excavating various Shadow Realm relics. They could well have what we're looking for.

introduced.name: Restaurant Zorya
introduced.how: Vodyanitsa's restaurant at the station, set to open once more staff are hired
introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: It actually looks like the real deal! In a few days' time, once we've hired a few more staff members, Restaurant Zorya can officially open for business.

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: A man who hides in the restaurant to avoid Valeriy and is tested by Vodyanitsa
introduced.quote: ???: Ah, a restaurant. Perfect, just perfect. There's no way Valeriy will find me here...

assumed.name: Alyosha
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, if it isn't Alyosha!

assumed.name: Odette
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Ah. Guessing you've already been here with Odette or Vodyanitsa.

assumed.name: Vodyanitsa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Wonder if Vodyanitsa and the others are in town... How would we find them, though? This place isn't exactly small...

assumed.name: Atop the Floating Snow
assumed.quote: (If either Atop the Floating Snow or Awaiting the Dawn has been completed)

assumed.name: Awaiting the Dawn
assumed.quote: (If either Atop the Floating Snow or Awaiting the Dawn has been completed)

assumed.name: Disputes Without Honor and Humanity
assumed.quote: (If Disputes Without Honor and Humanity was already completed)

assumed.name: Tugarin
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Haha... Tugarin will definitely be happy to see this.

assumed.name: Rytova
assumed.quote: Paimon: Looks like Rytova's already started teaching the Domovoy to dance... Hehe, let's check it out on Odette's behalf later.

assumed.name: Domovoy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Looks like Rytova's already started teaching the Domovoy to dance... Hehe, let's check it out on Odette's behalf later.

assumed.name: Valeriy
assumed.quote: ???: Ah, a restaurant. Perfect, just perfect. There's no way Valeriy will find me here...

assumed.name: Snezhnograd
assumed.quote: Vodyanitsa: You won't get the chance to stick stickers wherever you please back in Snezhnograd!

assumed.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
assumed.quote: Paimon: This must be the Finchball arena that Vodyanitsa's been working on. Looks like it's ready! We should play a game when we have some free time.

assumed.name: Zharkoye

assumed.name: Rimecurrant Ice Cream
assumed.quote: (Alyosha gestures to five tall glasses of Rimecurrant Ice Cream on the counter)

threads.claim: Gangs are secretly excavating Shadow Realm relics, which may hold the sought-after power core.
threads.quote: Alyosha: I remember them saying that the gangs are secretly excavating various Shadow Realm relics. They could well have what we're looking for.

threads.claim: The crystal obtained from the fae gang is placed in the furnace, which starts up and provides heat.
threads.quote: (The crystal floats from Alyosha's hand into the furnace)

threads.claim: The government is focused on some grander plan and is ignoring the small station and its community.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Unfortunately, our government's too busy executing some grander plan to notice this little spot. So it's up to citizens like me to step up.

threads.claim: Alyosha's Rokot membership leads them to stand up for their beliefs through civic effort rather than violence.
threads.quote: Alyosha: But that's fine by me. It's one way I can stand up for what the Rokot believes in without having to reach for my gun.

threads.claim: Mitya is hiding from someone named Valeriy and wants to avoid being found at the restaurant.
threads.quote: ???: Ah, a restaurant. Perfect, just perfect. There's no way Valeriy will find me here...

threads.claim: Mitya fails Vodyanitsa's test by denying her performance, suggesting he is not being honest about his presence.
threads.quote: Mitya: You... you... Hey! You're joking, right? There was no performance yesterday, hahaha...

introduced.name: Huang the Third
introduced.how: Guhua Clan elder who introduces himself and invites the Traveler to Wangshan Hall
introduced.quote: Huang the Third of the Guhua Clan, at your service.

introduced.name: Wen the Fourth
introduced.how: Huang's junior brother, a guard of Wangshan Hall known as the Snowstriding Sword
introduced.quote: This is my junior brother, known in our circles as Wen the Fourth, and by the people as the Snowstriding Sword.

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: martial clan once called the Guhua Brotherhood, now declining
introduced.quote: The Guhua Clan was once known as the Guhua Brotherhood.

introduced.name: Wangshan Hall
introduced.how: the clan's main hall, now ruined, where Grand Master Guhua attained enlightenment
introduced.quote: Wangshan Hall is the main house of the Guhua Clan and where Grand Master Guhua attained enlightenment.

introduced.name: Grand Master Guhua
introduced.how: clan founder, a wandering hero who never meant to start a clan
introduced.quote: The grand master was a wandering hero who brought peace and justice to the people while traveling the world.

introduced.name: 12 Secret Chambers
introduced.how: hidden chambers in Wangshan Hall said to hold treasures lost to the world
introduced.quote: Grand Master Guhua secretly established 12 Secret Chambers within the Hall upon the Clan's founding

introduced.name: Cloudpiercing Arrow
introduced.how: Huang the Third's youthful moniker, a name the Traveler has heard
introduced.quote: Cloudpiercing Arrow...? So you're a talented archer?

introduced.name: Plumwatcher Piles
introduced.how: stone piles used by Grand Master Guhua for training, used as the first trial
introduced.quote: Behold the Plumwatcher Piles, passed down by Grand Master Guhua himself!

introduced.name: Trial of Spear and Sword
introduced.how: the second entry trial, held in the practice arena with dummies
introduced.quote: This is the second trial, the Trial of Spear and Sword!

introduced.name: Life Ender
introduced.how: one of the clan's ultimate techniques, a fusion of sword and spear
introduced.quote: Life Ender is a unique fusion of sword and spear, and it is why the Guhua Clan is known to have mastery over both.

introduced.name: Three Guhua Greats
introduced.how: the clan's three ultimate techniques: Light Piercer, Rain Cutter, and Life Ender
introduced.quote: The Guhua Clan has three ultimate techniques — Light Piercer, Rain Cutter, and Life Ender.

introduced.name: Yingmin the Piercing Blade
introduced.how: an 11th Master who simplified the ultimate techniques into entry-level ones
introduced.quote: Yingmin, the one known as the Piercing Blade, felt that these techniques were too difficult to master

introduced.name: Master Baixuan
introduced.how: a follower who founded the Guhua Brotherhood in the founder's name
introduced.quote: Boxuan... better known as Master Baixuan, who once received his favor

introduced.name: Lingmeng Chamber
introduced.how: the earlier name of Wangshan Hall
introduced.quote: This place wasn't always known as Wangshan Hall, instead being known as the

introduced.name: Yilong Wharf
introduced.how: a nearby town reached by following the road from the hall
introduced.quote: If you're lost... keep following that road over there, it'll take you to Yilong Wharf.

introduced.name: Arcane Archive
introduced.how: a locked library of the clan's secret texts, open only to disciples
introduced.quote: Haha, this is the Arcane Archive, where all the ancient mysteries and secrets of the Guhua Clan are hidden, so only our own disciples are allowed within.

introduced.name: Soaring Swallow
introduced.how: the clan's secret movement technique
introduced.quote: this is the Guhua Clan's secret movement technique — Soaring Swallow!

introduced.name: Guhua Treasure Chamber
introduced.how: a legendary treasure chamber said to be recorded in old legends
introduced.quote: could this be the actual "Guhua Treasure Chamber" recorded in the legends?

introduced.name: Twelve Secret Chambers
introduced.how: Huang the Third mentioned a set of twelve secret chambers, possibly with identical mechanisms
introduced.quote: didn't Huang the Third mention something about "12 Secret Chambers"?

introduced.name: Mechanism on the glowing platform
introduced.how: a mysterious mechanism on a platform that glows and may hold treasure
introduced.quote: Could it be a... mechanism?

introduced.name: Key from Huang the Third
introduced.how: a key Huang the Third gave the party that opens a door in the hall
introduced.quote: Huh? So this door can be opened using the key Huang the Third gave us too!?

introduced.name: Engraved Inscription monument
introduced.how: a stone monument left to pose a question to future generations about dead ends
introduced.quote: This monument was left to ask this of future generations.

introduced.name: Ancient Swordsman
introduced.how: a past swordsman whose inscriptions boast of slaying dragons and tigers and mention his sword
introduced.quote: ...Caressing the blade, singing I go, to cleave dragons and drink their blood.

introduced.name: Ancient Engraver who left recipes
introduced.how: an ancient person who left recipes in place of food that would spoil
introduced.quote: I originally wanted to leave behind some delicacies here.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Isn't Xingqiu a member of the Guhua Clan?

assumed.name: Bookworm Swordsman
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Bookworm Swordsman)

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: our disciples are scattered all over Liyue.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: we cannot leave everything to Rex Lapis.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Even the realm of the adepti pales in comparison to Wangshan Hall!

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Don't get the Millelith involved, please!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon's never heard of the Guhua Clan cheating people of their Mora either!

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Could it be trying to say that we should use Elemental Sight?

assumed.name: Wind glider
assumed.quote: Does using a wind glider count as a technique?

assumed.name: Qinggong
assumed.quote: So that's real qinggong in action, eh...

assumed.name: Huang the Third
assumed.quote: Paimon doesn't think Huang the Third knew about this place either

assumed.name: Guhua
assumed.quote: Is this... is this another one of Guhua's trials?

assumed.name: Wangshan Hall
assumed.quote: there's only ever been one key to all of Wangshan Hall this whole time!?

assumed.name: Teleport waypoint
assumed.quote: (Approach the room beyond the teleport waypoint)

threads.claim: Wangshan Hall may hold treasures lost to the world, a lure the Traveler doubts.
threads.quote: Would it not be a shame if the treasures housed still within Wangshan Hall will remain thus neglected

threads.claim: Huang admits the relic exists but that the disciples do not know where it is.
threads.quote: but the relic really does exist! We modern disciples just don't know where it is.

threads.claim: Finding the puzzle's solution leaves the Guhua treasure question open, with the group wondering if they found it.
threads.quote: Did we... Did we actually find the Guhua Clan's treasure after all?

threads.claim: Wen doubts Huang's precise knowledge of the 12 chambers.
threads.quote: Did you count those chambers specifically...?

threads.claim: Huang's admission suggests the 12 Secret Chambers claim was exaggerated.
threads.quote: Besides, I wasn't lying...

threads.claim: Wen laments the clan's fall, hinting at a lost former glory.
threads.quote: I never expected our clan to end up in such a state

threads.claim: The three ultimate techniques lost power over time as the clan declined.
threads.quote: our three ultimate techniques gradually became legendary, yet their power was ever-weakening.

threads.claim: Wen hopes the promising junior Xingqiu will restore the clan's former glory.
threads.quote: My only consolation is a promising junior — Xingqiu.

threads.claim: Life Ender is described as a legendary technique that no one present has seen.
threads.quote: It is said that Life Ender could slice wind, split waves, and destroy mountains.

threads.claim: The founder's notes record that the Life Ender technique was passed down.
threads.quote: Passed down the Life Ender technique... Recorded here.

threads.claim: Wen hints the trials hold a deeper meaning the Traveler will learn later.
threads.quote: ...You will understand soon enough.

threads.claim: Huang's insistence on payment hints the clan is in need of money.
threads.quote: I'm not asking for a penny!

threads.claim: Huang admits he used tourists' Mora to maintain the buried relics.
threads.quote: To be honest, the tourists from before paid in Mora, which I used to maintain the things buried here.

threads.claim: The Arcane Archive holds ancient secrets reserved for the clan's disciples.
threads.quote: Haha, this is the Arcane Archive, where all the ancient mysteries and secrets of the Guhua Clan are hidden, so only our own disciples are allowed within.

threads.claim: Huang grants the Traveler the library key and permission to take books.
threads.quote: Take any that catch your eye.

threads.claim: The notes hint at observing with an unnamed sense, which Paimon links to Elemental Sight.
threads.quote: Look with the , and combine with , then...

threads.claim: Solving the bookshelf puzzle drains the water and opens the way forward.
threads.quote: Whoa, the water level's dropping!

threads.claim: The Traveler vaguely recognizes the Guhua Clan's name, hinting at a prior connection.
threads.quote: Now, where did I hear about it...?

threads.claim: The legendary Guhua Treasure Chamber may be hidden in Wangshan Hall.
threads.quote: could this be the actual "Guhua Treasure Chamber" recorded in the legends?

threads.claim: The party finds no valuable treasure in the hidden chamber, and the last Guhua engraving says the man took nothing with him.
threads.quote: After all this, we didn't find a single valuable treasure.

threads.claim: Twelve identical Guhua mechanisms may exist, raising doubt about their creation.
threads.quote: Those Guhua people didn't really create twelve identical mechanisms, did they!?

threads.claim: A single key may be the only key to all of Wangshan Hall.
threads.quote: there's only ever been one key to all of Wangshan Hall this whole time!?

threads.claim: Decayed inscriptions pose riddles whose answers are unknown.
threads.quote: What may pierce light?

threads.claim: A monument asks what one should do when reaching a dead end.
threads.quote: When you have reached a dead end, what shall you do?

threads.claim: A later ancient engraving says the answer is already known, but does not state it.
threads.quote: You already know the answer.

threads.claim: The inscriptions suggest the heavens are unfaithful and fate is capricious.
threads.quote: The heavens are unfaithful, and those who seek its blessing and gain audience are rare.

threads.claim: The Ancient Swordsman's inscriptions describe his deeds and his sword, and a faint engraving of a spear or sword appears nearby.
threads.quote: ...Caressing the blade, singing I go, to cleave dragons and drink their blood.

threads.claim: An ancient engraver left recipes behind instead of perishable food.
threads.quote: I originally wanted to leave behind some delicacies here.

threads.claim: The Traveler offers to cook a meal, suggesting the recipes may be used.
threads.quote: It's okay. I'll make you something to eat.

threads.claim: A crooked engraving hints that the final stand of its author was meant to be a monument.
threads.quote: May my final stand... be a monument...

threads.claim: The Traveler interprets the crooked engraving as meaning the man took nothing with him.
threads.quote: They roughly mean that he didn't take anything with him.

introduced.name: Ineffa
introduced.how: Aino's calm, logical companion whose core is far more advanced than the sorting bots'
introduced.quote: Aino: There's no way they have awareness like Ineffa. Their cores aren't even a fraction as advanced as hers...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group that stole from the Fatui and fled into Aino's workshop at night
introduced.quote: Ineffa: Do not be alarmed. It's a group of Treasure Hoarders on the run after stealing from the Fatui.

introduced.name: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
introduced.how: Aino's workshop, where brawling people crashed in at night
introduced.quote: Aino: Oh, it's nothing major. People keep getting into fights around here, and last night they crashed right into my workshop!

introduced.name: Prospector bots
introduced.how: Aino's sorting robots that separate useful treasure from junk and only have preset voice phrases
introduced.quote: Aino: No, it's not possible... I mean, my prospector bots do have a voice function, but it's all pre-set phrases...

introduced.name: Strange Prospector Bot
introduced.how: a prospector bot that suddenly talks and acts hostile, with a core from elsewhere
introduced.quote: Strange Prospector Bot: Hmph, wouldn't you like to know!

introduced.name: Chard Lombro
introduced.how: the personality preserved in the bot's core, a simulation of a person's data, given a name by Aino
introduced.quote: Then, it's decided: You're Chard Lombro from now on! No complaining, alright?

introduced.name: clockwork meka
introduced.how: a Fontaine machine whose core was swapped into the prospector bot
introduced.quote: Ineffa: The bot has the wrong core. It is not the one Aino installed originally, but the core of a clockwork meka from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the origin of the advanced core, whose technology is little known
introduced.quote: Ineffa: The core originates from Fontaine, but little is known about this technology.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Aino: You know what happened the day before it started malfunctioning? The Fatui chased a group of Treasure Hoarders straight into my workshop.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Paimon: Treasure Hoarders? Dipping into the Fatui's pockets? Wow, the Nod-Krai faction's pretty bold.

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: Ineffa: Several of Marionette's subordinates were robbed on their way back to Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Ineffa: Several of Marionette's subordinates were robbed on their way back to Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Aino: Eh, who cares. Jahoda said they're just a bunch of small fry, anyway.

assumed.name: kuuvahki
assumed.quote: (Use kuuvahki to pull out the "bad little bot")

assumed.name: Ineffa's past absence
assumed.quote: Aino: You really think so? You know, Ineffa, you've gotten a lot better at comforting people since you went away.

threads.claim: One sorting bot is malfunctioning and delivering useless items, suggesting sabotage.
threads.quote: Ineffa: Correct. The sorting bots delivered several items of no utility this morning. The ratio of useful to non-useful items suggests that one of the bots has malfunctioned.

threads.claim: The malfunction is explained: the bot carries the wrong core, a Fontaine clockwork meka core.
threads.quote: Ineffa: The bot has the wrong core. It is not the one Aino installed originally, but the core of a clockwork meka from Fontaine.

threads.claim: Someone replaced the bot's original core with a hi-tech one, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Aino: Who replaced the original core with this one, and why? I mean, even though it's damaged, the research value is off the charts.

threads.claim: Aino theorizes the Treasure Hoarders stole the core from the Fatui and hid it in the bot.
threads.quote: Aino: I'm thinking, the Treasure Hoarders stole the core from the Fatui and needed a place to hide it.

threads.claim: A word, Chard, was recovered from the deepest protected part of the core, its meaning unknown.
threads.quote: Aino: Yeah, but it's not all bad news! Hehe, I managed to extract a useful bit of information from the data I could salvage. One word: Chard.

threads.claim: The core went through a massive explosion, damaging nearly all its modules.
threads.quote: Aino: No idea. What I can tell is that this core went through a massive explosion at some point.

threads.claim: The prospector bot can speak in full sentences, which should not be possible for it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh!? You... You can talk!? Aino, is he supposed to do that?

threads.claim: The bot's speech is a simulation of preserved data from a person, since its core is badly damaged.
threads.quote: Aino: Because its core was destroyed six ways to Sunday! So, right now, its tone and mannerisms are all just a simulation of whatever data has been preserved.

threads.claim: The advanced core comes from Fontaine, but its technology is poorly understood.
threads.quote: Ineffa: The core originates from Fontaine, but little is known about this technology.

threads.claim: The bot's memory of the Fortress of Meropide is confused, hinting at lost or altered data.
threads.quote: Strange Prospector Bot: It's, it's... It's... Huh? What is it again...?

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders are recent arrivals and likely outsiders rather than locals.
threads.quote: Ineffa: Actually, this group has only been active recently. The Curatorium suspects them to be outsiders not local to this area.

threads.claim: Ineffa keeps Aino-related data in the deepest, best-protected part of her core.
threads.quote: Ineffa: In the event that my core sustained damage, that's where I would move all Aino-related data to keep it intact.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: Ifa's older bro and an elder who recruits aphids for the staff and fights for causes
introduced.quote: Ifa: You see, this is my bro's first time getting a formal invitation like that, and as you can probably tell, he's very, um... committed.

introduced.name: Ifa
introduced.how: Ororon's bro who works at the resort and has a way with animals
introduced.quote: Ifa: Yeah, that bro spun a stick around and it ended up pointing at this pond.

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: a playful saurian who acts like a big brother but loves to play
introduced.quote: Ifa: Cacucu might act like a mature, big brother type of saurian. But, deep down, he's just a little guy who likes to play.

introduced.name: Capybara King
introduced.how: a large, angry capybara nicknamed by Ororon who calms down after eating cookies and leaves a gift egg
introduced.quote: Ororon: Hello, Capybara King. Do you want something to eat? I have a fresh batch of Ifa's cookies here.

introduced.name: Cacasha
introduced.how: an Asha who can talk and disguise himself, allied with Cacucu in hide-and-seek
introduced.quote: Ororon: Cacucu is fast, and Cacasha can disguise himself... So, we face a crafty enemy indeed.

introduced.name: Asha
introduced.how: a small creature that scampers off and can disguise itself
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hold on... is that... an Asha?

introduced.name: aphids
introduced.how: small creatures who are part of the resort staff and can be communicated with
introduced.quote: Ororon: The aphids are part of the staff, too. You missed that part.

introduced.name: Capybara
introduced.how: gentle creatures that live around the resort pond
introduced.quote: Ororon: Of course! Capybaras are gentle creatures, so we're good. Besides, when life gives you water, you fish. That's what Granny taught me.

introduced.name: Bennett
introduced.how: a famous adventurer from Mondstadt whose luck pointed the group to the pond
introduced.quote: Ororon: Since it was suggested by a friend, of course. He's a famous adventurer from Mondstadt with incredible luck. If he says it'll work, who are we to argue?

introduced.name: Challwa
introduced.how: a vendor running the gift egg stall at the Easybreeze Market
introduced.quote: Challwa: Ahem... Step on up, dear patrons! Pick an egg, any egg! Let this be your lucky day!

introduced.name: Easybreeze Market
introduced.how: a market at the resort where the gift eggs are sold
introduced.quote: Ororon: Found it! We were right about the Easybreeze Market!

introduced.name: Gift Eggs
introduced.how: prize eggs offered free at the market that give random dishes or items
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, so this is where the picture was leading us. This must be where the Gift Eggs come from.

introduced.name: Sing Your Heart Out
introduced.how: a Flower-Feather Clan specialty dish won from a gift egg
introduced.quote: Paimon: Whoa, it's the Flower-Feather Clan specialty, "Sing Your Heart Out"... Guess that ritual actually worked...

introduced.name: Mini Asha Pockets
introduced.how: the most exclusive grand prize from the gift eggs
introduced.quote: Challwa: In addition to these Mini Asha Pockets — our most exclusive prize — we're pleased to award Mr. Cacucu with a serving of every dish available from our gift eggs!

introduced.name: Cacucu's anniversary
introduced.how: the anniversary of when Ifa met Cacucu, used as the reason for the celebration
introduced.quote: Ifa: ...So, now you know! It just happened to be around the anniversary of when I met Cacucu, and I wanted to do something special for him.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Ororon: Since it was suggested by a friend, of course. He's a famous adventurer from Mondstadt with incredible luck.

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa, it's the Flower-Feather Clan specialty, "Sing Your Heart Out"... Guess that ritual actually worked...

assumed.name: Granny
assumed.quote: Ifa: Ah, another one of Granny's pearls of wisdom.

assumed.name: Coach Iansan
assumed.quote: Ororon: It's your own fault for not going to Coach Iansan's fitness class.

assumed.name: Traveler's protege
assumed.quote: Traveler: Hehe, takes me back to when I took in my protege...

threads.claim: Some aphids chose not to join the resort staff, and Ororon respects their decision.
threads.quote: Ororon: No, not just the staff. There are aphids who didn't want to join, you know. I understand their feelings, of course, and I respect their decision.

threads.claim: Bennett is a famous adventurer whose luck guided the group to the pond.
threads.quote: Ororon: Since it was suggested by a friend, of course. He's a famous adventurer from Mondstadt with incredible luck. If he says it'll work, who are we to argue?

threads.claim: The gift egg pictures may be part of a secret treasure hunt hidden around the resort.
threads.quote: Ororon: Huh? Is this some kind of secret treasure hunt, hidden around the resort? I have to see it through!

threads.claim: Ifa admits he secretly set up the fishing, hide-and-seek, and gift egg events for Cacucu.
threads.quote: Ifa: And, yeah, I organized everything with the pictures so that Cacucu could play with the Asha and capybaras. And I set up the gift egg thing, too.

threads.claim: The Capybara King was upset because he thought the group was stealing the gifts Ifa prepared for Cacucu.
threads.quote: Ifa: My guess is that he thought we were trying to steal the things I prepared for Cacucu, and that's why he was upset.

threads.claim: Cacucu's real birthday is unknown, so the group celebrates on an anniversary instead.
threads.quote: Ororon: We don't know when Cacucu's actual birthday is, so we've always just used the anniversary as an excuse to celebrate it.

threads.claim: The Traveler once took in a protege, a past event hinted at but not explained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Hehe, takes me back to when I took in my protege...

introduced.name: Julien
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a renowned artist from Fontaine who came to Sumeru for inspiration
introduced.quote: I'm a renowned artist from Fontaine, and I'm here in Sumeru to gather inspiration for my work. Call me Julien.

introduced.name: Pepper
introduced.how: Julien's dog, which guards his belongings and has a name, though Julien first denies owning it
introduced.quote: Wonderful, Pepper... Taken to growling at me, have you?

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: A trusted friend of Julien who sent him on the pilgrimage and granted his drawing ability
introduced.quote: A friend... a most reliable friend of mine.

introduced.name: Bird Egg
introduced.how: A mysterious egg said to help ward off a day's worth of misfortune
introduced.quote: It is said that eating the egg can help you deflect a day's worth of misfortune.

introduced.name: Oceanids' pilgrimage path
introduced.how: A path the Oceanids took, said to end in Sumeru where a cure can be found
introduced.quote: Caterpillar told me that this is the path that the Oceanids took, and that the end of that path was Sumeru

introduced.name: Julien's counterfeiting conviction
introduced.how: Julien served a sentence for counterfeiting before resolving to become a legitimate artist
introduced.quote: Of course, I didn't become a famous artist of any sort, but I did become a real dab hand at counterfeiting.

introduced.name: Julien's copying gift
introduced.how: A friend's power lets Julien draw anything exactly as it appears, but he cannot tell colors apart
introduced.quote: With the help of... a friend's powers, I am now able to draw anything exactly as it appears

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Julien, optional)

assumed.name: Gray Crystal wall
assumed.quote: (If the Gray Crystal wall had been removed prior to the Daily Reset)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: You're actually a Fatui mole, aren't you?

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: When I passed through Chenyu Vale on my way here

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: (A mob of hilichurls appears)

assumed.name: Rifthound
assumed.quote: I'd rather adopt a Rifthound.

assumed.name: Cicin
assumed.quote: I wound up running through the maze like a headless Cicin

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Is this a picture taken by some special kamera?

threads.claim: Julien's mysterious friend who sold him tea and shaped his path is introduced as a source of doubtful advice.
threads.quote: A friend of mine sold it to me.

threads.claim: Caterpillar is revealed to have granted Julien a powerful but troubling drawing ability tied to his color blindness.
threads.quote: If Caterpillar had not been the one to grant it to me, I would have named it a curse.

threads.claim: A dream of Caterpillar at the end of the pilgrim's path points toward a cure hidden in Sumeru.
threads.quote: In my dream, Caterpillar was standing at the end of the pilgrim's path, waving at me

threads.claim: The pilgrimage path is left unconfirmed, and Julien decides that finding it matters little.
threads.quote: I think that my ability or lack thereof to find it is unimportant either way.

threads.claim: A mysterious egg said to ward off misfortune is hinted at as a tempting but dubious item.
threads.quote: It is said that eating the egg can help you deflect a day's worth of misfortune.

threads.claim: Julien regrets not buying the mysterious bird eggs, which he thinks could help adventurers.
threads.quote: If only I had bought those mysterious bird eggs...

threads.claim: Julien's identity and motives are questioned, hinting he may be a Fatui agent with a hidden past.
threads.quote: You're actually a Fatui mole, aren't you?

threads.claim: Julien admits to a past counterfeiting crime and a prison sentence, revealing why he lied about himself.
threads.quote: Of course, I didn't become a famous artist of any sort, but I did become a real dab hand at counterfeiting.

threads.claim: Julien describes his drawings as a broken camera's mismatched colors, hinting at a hidden flaw in his art.
threads.quote: I'm like a broken Kamera that can only create pictures with mismatched colors...

threads.claim: Julien comes to accept that he simply sees things differently and that colors are a matter of perception.
threads.quote: I just see something different, that's all.

threads.claim: Pepper is found guarding Julien's belongings on the beach, hinting it protects what matters to him.
threads.quote: Strange. Why would there be a dog here? And it seems to be guarding something, too.

threads.claim: Paimon suggests Pepper still cares deeply about Julien despite its unruly behavior.
threads.quote: Paimon thinks that it still cares a lot about you.

threads.claim: Julien begins to feel a sense of freedom in Sumeru's open landscapes, away from his confined past life.
threads.quote: (Is this what freedom feels like...)

introduced.name: Fusilier
introduced.how: special investigator from the Institute leading the Arkhium Kinetic Core case
introduced.quote: Raimondo: This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.

introduced.name: Arkhium Kinetic Core
introduced.how: unstable prototype stolen from the Institute that could explode
introduced.quote: Raimondo: But our main objective is still to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible. It's an extremely unstable prototype.

introduced.name: Lumidouce Harbor
introduced.how: harbor area under Chaussivert's protection where the search leads
introduced.quote: Chaussivert: This entire Lumidouce Harbor is under my protection. Anyone causing trouble around here is my business.

introduced.name: Loillier
introduced.how: smuggler working with Snezhnayans who transports Fontaine goods outward
introduced.quote: Chaussivert: He's always with the Snezhnayans, and all he cares about is transporting Fontaine's goods to the outside for his own benefit.

introduced.name: Concini
introduced.how: Snezhnayan major buyer sending goods and equipment to the harbor
introduced.quote: Chaussivert: All I know is that he's a major buyer, and he's been purchasing all kinds of goods and equipment and sending them to the harbor.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: the Snezhnayans linked to Loillier and Concini
introduced.quote: Chaussivert: I used to think that way, too, but I really don't know what's going on with that Concini guy from Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
introduced.how: former Institute researcher presumed dead in the explosion, found alive at his house
introduced.quote: Paimon: Aren't you supposed to have died in the explosion at the Institute!?

introduced.name: Institute explosion
introduced.how: explosion at the Institute that Edwin is suspected of causing and Nacker framed
introduced.quote: Fusilier: It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.

introduced.name: Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device
introduced.how: stun-type device personally modified by Edwin and carried by Fusilier and Lemarcq
introduced.quote: Fusilier: Don't worry. He has the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device, which was personally modified by Mr. Edwin himself. He'll be fine.

introduced.name: Arkhium energy detection device
introduced.how: detector that senses residual Arkhium energy flow to track the core
introduced.quote: Fusilier: This device is capable of detecting Arkhium energy flow. If Covault told the truth, we should be able to detect residual Arkhium energy here.

introduced.name: Field Generator
introduced.how: device Nacker built and plans to synchronize with the core
introduced.quote: Nacker: You can both stay here... and help me test the effectiveness of my Field Generator!

introduced.name: Covault
introduced.how: former drunkard worker under Chaussivert who was hired by Loillier
introduced.quote: Chaussivert: Sure, I remember him. He used to be the most famous drunkard working under me, but I kicked him out of the outfit because of his habit of nicking this and that.

introduced.name: The Rusty Rudder
introduced.how: tavern in Lumidouce Harbor where Covault spends his days
introduced.quote: Lemarcq: Well... He's now a regular at The Rusty Rudder.

introduced.name: Pitot
introduced.how: boss of The Rusty Rudder tavern
introduced.quote: Paimon: From what Chaussivert and the others said, the boss's name is... Pitot?

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: couriers hired to move the shipments
introduced.quote: Paimon: Why are we eavesdropping again? But this time, we're eavesdropping on the Treasure Hoarders...

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Chaussivert's criminal organization whose affairs the Institute avoids
introduced.quote: Fusilier: I'm a special investigator from Fontaine Research Institute! We don't mean to intervene in Spina di Rosula's affairs.

introduced.name: Lemarcq
introduced.how: Chaussivert's associate who explains the case and watches the ship
introduced.quote: Lemarcq: I think she's trying to tell you that some idiot stole something from the Institute, and that thing might explode at any moment.

introduced.name: Choiseul
introduced.how: Institute figure concerned about journalists and the scandal
introduced.quote: Raimondo: Mr. Choiseul won't be able to deal with so many journalists for long on his own...

introduced.name: Arkhium
introduced.how: energy source that binds and self-heats, leaving detectable residue
introduced.quote: Fusilier: It's the self-heating effect generated by bound Arkhium. Mr. Edwin's talked about it before.

assumed.name: Raimondo
assumed.quote: Fusilier: Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...

assumed.name: Honorary Senior Researcher
assumed.quote: Raimondo: It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Fusilier: I'm a special investigator from Fontaine Research Institute! We don't mean to intervene in Spina di Rosula's affairs.

assumed.name: Fatuus
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Paimon's never heard of him. C—Could he be a Fatuus?

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Traveler: Will they stay in the Fortress of Meropide all their life?

threads.claim: The Institute's initial explosion may have been caused by someone who framed Edwin.
threads.quote: Fusilier: It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.

threads.claim: Edwin, presumed dead in the Institute explosion, is revealed to be alive.
threads.quote: Paimon: Aren't you supposed to have died in the explosion at the Institute!?

threads.claim: Fusilier formally accuses Edwin of blowing up the Institute, though his own denial is left unresolved.
threads.quote: Fusilier: Edwin Eastinghouse! You, you are the one who blew the Institute up!

threads.claim: The stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core is an unstable prototype that could explode at any time.
threads.quote: Raimondo: But our main objective is still to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible. It's an extremely unstable prototype.

threads.claim: The core's backpack carrier is warm and buzzing, suggesting it is the core being smuggled.
threads.quote: Covault: Well, he had a large backpack on his back, and nobody was allowed to look at it... But... it was very strange. It was warm, and it kept on buzzing...

threads.claim: The core is recovered and taken back to the Institute after Nacker is defeated.
threads.quote: Chaussivert: , help me tie him up and take that core or whatever. It's time we head back.

threads.claim: Loillier tried to recruit Chaussivert to smuggle a person out of Fontaine, and his real intentions are unclear.
threads.quote: Chaussivert: Some time ago, he came asking for my help in smuggling a person out of Fontaine on the down low.

threads.claim: Loillier hired Covault to escort Nacker to a hidden location in Lumidouce Harbor.
threads.quote: Covault: Yes, yes! He hired me to escort someone to a certain location in Lumidouce Harbor. I don't know who the person is.

threads.claim: Loillier's meeting with Chaussivert was a setup to eliminate him, with Pattyn and Morgen bought off for an ambush.
threads.quote: Chaussivert: Hmm. That can only mean that he had that meeting so he could eliminate me. Hmph. Brutal, but that sounds like him, alright.

threads.claim: Concini's business and the goods he buys remain unknown and suspicious.
threads.quote: Chaussivert: All I know is that he's a major buyer, and he's been purchasing all kinds of goods and equipment and sending them to the harbor.

threads.claim: Concini and Nacker are working together, with Concini delivering Nacker to a location inland from the harbor.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's clear that Concini and Nacker are working together, and that the former has delivered the latter to a location somewhere inland from Lumidouce Harbor.

threads.claim: Edwin speaks in riddles about the number five, hinting at how to open Nacker's hideout.
threads.quote: Edwin Eastinghouse: Listen up. There are five doors to endless inspiration, and you have to turn each handle five times... Five! You hear? Five times!

threads.claim: Nacker and Edwin openly resent each other over research rivalry and jealousy.
threads.quote: Nacker: Edwin... I knew it! You lured them over... You've always been jealous of me! Afraid that my research would surpass yours!

introduced.name: Frostfin Whale
introduced.how: a rare whale only recently discovered, whose skin color may shift with environmental changes
introduced.quote: I heard it was only discovered recently. Considering its size, I suspect environmental changes cause the shift in its skin color.

introduced.name: Frostfin Whale luck legend
introduced.how: belief that anyone who sees a Frostfin Whale has their wishes come true and gains good luck
introduced.quote: I hear that anyone who sees the Frostfin Whale can have their wishes come true.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera, owned by Helka, used to photograph the whales
introduced.quote: Why not stay on shore and use the Kamera to capture them having fun?

introduced.name: Linnea
introduced.how: self-introduced as an advisor with ecological knowledge, working for the Adventurers' Guild
introduced.quote: My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: self-introduced as a traveling painter from Fontaine
introduced.quote: My name is Mamere. I'm a traveling painter from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: a talking machine and Mamere's good friend who enforces rules
introduced.quote: This is Seymour. He's a good friend of mine.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: Mamere's homeland, whose citizens are protected by strict statutes
introduced.quote: Miss Mamere is a citizen of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: an organization that Linnea works for as an advisor
introduced.quote: I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: a tiny, rare fairy-like creature that is quick in the water
introduced.quote: Whoa! A real Melusine!

introduced.name: Fontaine statutes on contact
introduced.how: unauthorized physical contact with a Fontaine citizen can bring serious legal penalties
introduced.quote: Unauthorized physical contact may lead to misunderstandings and could carry serious legal consequences

assumed.name: Helka
assumed.quote: Linnea! Yes, I'm back. But my archive isn't quite complete yet, so our showdown will have to wait.

assumed.name: Maisie
assumed.quote: Did you come to see the Frostfin Whale too?

assumed.name: Kuuvahki
assumed.quote: Like the concentration of kuuvahki in the area, for example...

assumed.name: Speranza
assumed.quote: bring you back to Speranza, safe and sound.

threads.claim: The legend that seeing a Frostfin Whale brings luck is left unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Whether the legend's true or not

threads.claim: Linnea becomes convinced that the Frostfin Whale really does bring good luck.
threads.quote: That Frostfin Whale really does bring good luck!

threads.claim: The Frostfin Whale's skin color shift may be caused by environmental factors, which remains unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Considering its size, I suspect environmental changes cause the shift in its skin color.

threads.claim: Kuuvahki concentration in the area may affect the local ecology and its creatures.
threads.quote: Like the concentration of kuuvahki in the area, for example...

threads.claim: Melusines are rare sightings, and Linnea is astonished to find one behind the rocks.
threads.quote: Whoa! A real Melusine!

introduced.name: Mary-Ann
introduced.how: Alain's sister and a traveling companion of Ann, who recognizes Marionette from a festival poster and reunites with her
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann? Is it really her? It seems she recognized me from a Fontinalia Festival poster... I should go and meet her.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: Alain's creation, made in Mary-Ann's image and going by Sandrone, who hosts tea parties
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann: Then do you... resent Alain? Because he created you... in Mary-Ann's image.

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: Prototype 4ACV07, one of Alain's earliest creations, who now serves as Mary-Ann's guardian
introduced.quote: Prototype 4ACV07? One of Alain's earliest creations? That's incredible...

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: Seymour's companion who enjoys tea parties and is connected to the group
introduced.quote: Mamere: Hehe, Seymour wouldn't stop telling me how much he missed you.

introduced.name: Ann
introduced.how: Mary-Ann's traveling companion who is close to Seymour and Mamere and calls herself the big sister of the family
introduced.quote: Ann: Seymour! It's been so long! And Mamere too!

introduced.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
introduced.how: A portable tea table Marionette places in a location to host tea-party invitations
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in Hidden Dwelling and take a seat)

assumed.name: Rene
assumed.quote: That's right, and Rene was no different.

assumed.name: Jakob
assumed.quote: Jakob and I were the only ones who could properly spruce up a room

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz
assumed.quote: All of us share some connection to the Narzissenkreuz.

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: Like the difference between the tea leaves of Chenyu Vale and the Beryl Region's Bulle Fruit.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann and Alain apparently slept and woke late, so they could not visit Marionette sooner.
threads.quote: Hmm... If we had woken up earlier, maybe we could have visited you and Alain.

threads.claim: Alain and Marionette once believed Mary-Ann had already died.
threads.quote: You know, back then, both Alain and I thought you'd already left this world.

threads.claim: Alain chose painful reality over a sweet dream, and his hero's wish is framed as something his companions still regret.
threads.quote: Maybe that's why he was the only one of us who chose painful reality over the illusion of a sweet dream.

threads.claim: Marionette calls wishes a hollow word, raising the question of whether anyone can truly get what they want.
threads.quote: Marionette: "Wish" is such a hollow word. Can you ever have whatever you want?

threads.claim: Marionette was built in Mary-Ann's image, which raises the question of whether she resents her creator.
threads.quote: Mary-Ann: Then do you... resent Alain? Because he created you... in Mary-Ann's image.

threads.claim: Alain insisted Marionette was her own person and free to choose her own life, not merely a copy.
threads.quote: He always made it clear that I'm my own person

threads.claim: Ann, Mary-Ann, Mamere and Seymour all share some unexplained connection to the Narzissenkreuz.
threads.quote: All of us share some connection to the Narzissenkreuz.

threads.claim: Seymour's primary directive is to accompany and protect Mary-Ann on Alain's behalf.
threads.quote: My primary directive is to accompany and protect Miss Mary-Ann on behalf of Alain Guillotin.

threads.claim: Marionette sees the group as a family bound by a long shared history.
threads.quote: I feel like we're all family on some level, with a long, shared history.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: a small plant-shaped creature that may be invisible to the naked eye and can be caught by children talking to it
introduced.quote: Find and secure a small plant-shaped creature known as the

introduced.name: Siman Farrokhzad
introduced.how: the employer who signed the orders and is Agha Farrokh's daughter, sending the Eremites on a commission
introduced.quote: completing a commission that Agha Farrokh's daughter has personally entrusted to you

introduced.name: Aragaru
introduced.how: an Aranara who introduces herself and has forgotten the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Uh... Ahem, I'm Aragaru!

introduced.name: Khayyam
introduced.how: an elderly Javan whose memories and names are fading with age
introduced.quote: My memories are getting blurry, and names just fade after a while.

introduced.name: Javans
introduced.how: a group of brave young members that Khayyam was part of
introduced.quote: We were the Javans

introduced.name: Mawtiyima
introduced.how: a benevolent figure who gives memories a chance to resurrect
introduced.quote: Yes, because benevolent, Mawtiyima is. So, she gives memories a chance to resurrect.

introduced.name: Academia
introduced.how: the organization that the employer's orders want the Aranara delivered to
introduced.quote: bring it back to the Academia in perfect shape

introduced.name: Dried flower
introduced.how: a dried flower that may be the key to communicating with the Aranara
introduced.quote: It may be the key to communicating with the creature know as the 'Aranara.'

introduced.name: Aranara revival ritual
introduced.how: a ritual with a song that revives dried flowers and memories
introduced.quote: So... Aranakin, Aragaru, let's start the ritual.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: The Eremites! What are they doing here?

assumed.name: Azrul
assumed.quote: (Fight Azrul)

assumed.name: Farrokhzadan
assumed.quote: The Farrokhzadan: Ah, it's you. Greetings from Lunja!

assumed.name: Lunja
assumed.quote: Greetings from Lunja!

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Khayyam, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Khayyam, optional

threads.claim: Aragaru has forgotten the Traveler and Paimon even though she once knew them and received a flower from them.
threads.quote: I can't remember, but I somehow want to believe you

threads.claim: Aranara may have forgotten the humans they once knew, and Khayyam wonders whether they still remember him.
threads.quote: do the Aranara still remember me?

threads.claim: The Traveler states the Aranara have forgotten, and Aranaga explains that memories are shared with the forest rather than with individuals.
threads.quote: Because, memories don't belong to you and me

threads.claim: The Traveler flatly confirms that the Aranara forgot the old friendship with Khayyam and the Javans.
threads.quote: They forgot.

threads.claim: The dried flower from the Eremites may be the key to communicating with the Aranara.
threads.quote: It may be the key to communicating with the creature know as the 'Aranara.'

threads.claim: Aragaru recognizes the dried flower and feels a connection to the person it belonged to.
threads.quote: I have seen the flower before... The person, I should know...

threads.claim: The Eremites are working for a hidden employer rather than acting alone.
threads.quote: So there's someone behind these bad guys...

threads.claim: The Aranara may not be visible to the naked eye, which makes them hard to find and catch.
threads.quote: This life-form may not be visible to the naked eye.

threads.claim: Khayyam believes only a miracle can save him now, and he can only wait for it.
threads.quote: Perhaps a miracle is my only hope...

threads.claim: Mawtiyima's ritual brings dried flowers back to life, showing that memories can be resurrected.
threads.quote: The dried flowers came back to life

introduced.name: Varesa
introduced.how: a tribe member and guide who is excited to meet the Traveler and Paimon and offers to lead them to the tribe
introduced.quote: Ah, right! The name's Varesa. Nice to meet you!

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: the home tribe the Traveler and Paimon are heading to, located near a volcano
introduced.quote: That's my home tribe, actually. I can take you the rest of the way, if you want.

introduced.name: Pulverite
introduced.how: rocks the volcano sends crashing into the area, which can be smashed open to reveal treasure
introduced.quote: Oh, just a heads up — the volcano sometimes sends rocks crashing into this area. We call them "Pulverite."

introduced.name: Resonating Arena
introduced.how: the tribe's arena, a bull-head-shaped platform where all the tribe's competitions are held
introduced.quote: Hehe, that's the Resonating Arena! It's where we hold all our competitions.

introduced.name: Acatl
introduced.how: the chief of the Collective of Plenty and Varesa's uncle
introduced.quote: Uncle Acatl is our chief, by the way! Who better than the chief to introduce you to the tribe, right?

introduced.name: Iansan
introduced.how: Varesa's coach and a victor of the Pilgrimage who trains tribe members
introduced.quote: Wait, but... You're the coach! And a victor of the Pilgrimage!

introduced.name: Vanana
introduced.how: a Tatankasaurus that guards Varesa's orchard and attacks those it doesn't trust
introduced.quote: Oh, this is Vanana. She keeps watch over the orchard when no one's here.

introduced.name: Orchard
introduced.how: Varesa's family orchard near the tribe's main entrance, which sells fruit to other tribes
introduced.quote: Anyway, this is my family's orchard. C'mon, I'll show you around.

introduced.name: Berryshrooms
introduced.how: fruity-tasting mushrooms that grow fast without water or fertilizer and appeared in the orchard unplanted
introduced.quote: They grow really fast and don't require any water or fertilizer. Oh, and the flavor is amazing!

introduced.name: Epic Feast Showdown
introduced.how: a speed eating contest the tribe prepares ingredients for, which the Traveler and Paimon can sign up for
introduced.quote: Oh, and there's an Epic Feast Showdown in a few days, so we're providing a bunch of the fruit for the desserts.

introduced.name: Hilichurls
introduced.how: monsters blocking the road in and out of the tribe that the tribe plans to clear out
introduced.quote: Looks like they're blocking the road in and out of the tribe, so we'll have to get rid of them sooner or later.

introduced.name: Pilgrimage
introduced.how: a team competition with stages that fighters can advance through or fail to clear
introduced.quote: *sigh* I've never placed, or even made it out of the team stage. I'm not good at fighting actual people.

introduced.name: Atolli
introduced.how: Varesa's uncle who creates new recipes for the tribe's mushrooms
introduced.quote: Uncle Atolli has been coming up with new recipes like there's no tomorrow...

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: You're the ones helping Kachina, right?

assumed.name: Abyss invasion
assumed.quote: During the Abyss invasion, we asked Iansan if the Collective of Plenty needed any help, but she said that Varesa had it all under control.

assumed.name: Tumaini
assumed.quote: I've heard the story of "Tumaini!" so many times, I can practically recite it by heart!

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: You're a huge deal to everyone in Natlan!

assumed.name: Stadium
assumed.quote: I think I've seen you around the Stadium before.

assumed.name: Graffiti design
assumed.quote: Wait, we've seen that graffiti design before!

threads.claim: The volcano sometimes hurls rocks and boulders down onto the area around the tribe.
threads.quote: Oh, just a heads up — the volcano sometimes sends rocks crashing into this area. We call them "Pulverite."

threads.claim: Such rockfalls are described as a rare phenomenon that many adventurers never see.
threads.quote: Well, not "at any moment"! It's a pretty rare phenomenon. Many adventurers come here and never even get to see it. So, I wouldn't worry too much.

threads.claim: The volcano's proximity makes the tribe's soil unusually fertile.
threads.quote: Being so close to the volcano makes the soil extra fertile. So, everything that grows around here is amazing.

threads.claim: The berryshrooms appeared in the orchard unplanted, and their origin is unexplained.
threads.quote: Oh, that kind of mushroom? They kind of appeared out of nowhere when we first planted the orchard.

threads.claim: Varesa's metabolism and strength are described as a natural gift that sets her apart.
threads.quote: I suppose you could say Varesa is among the select few who have a natural gift.

threads.claim: Varesa is afraid of fighting people and worries she will hurt someone.
threads.quote: But, I'm useless when it comes to fighting other people. I'm scared I'll hurt someone...

threads.claim: Varesa has never placed in the Pilgrimage and has not gotten past the team stage.
threads.quote: *sigh* I've never placed, or even made it out of the team stage. I'm not good at fighting actual people.

threads.claim: Hilichurls block the road in and out of the Collective of Plenty and must be removed.
threads.quote: Looks like they're blocking the road in and out of the tribe, so we'll have to get rid of them sooner or later.

threads.claim: Vanana guards the orchard and uses strength rather than judgment to sort out visitors.
threads.quote: Some people good, some people bad. Sometimes hard to tell, so I use strength instead.

threads.claim: The tribe suffered damage during the Abyss invasion and has finished repairing it.
threads.quote: We finished our repairs, so now it's just a matter of helping out the other tribes.

introduced.name: Ascension Challenge
introduced.how: a duel against Prince that, when won, grants a new player rank
introduced.quote: Congratulations on completing the Ascension Challenge.

introduced.name: Advanced player
introduced.how: the first player rank, earned by winning one Ascension Challenge
introduced.quote: It only takes one challenge to become an Advanced player?

introduced.name: Expert player
introduced.how: a higher rank that unlocks challenging other players and buying special cards
introduced.quote: as an Expert player, you, dear , have now gained the privilege to buy some truly amazing-looking cards

introduced.name: Master player
introduced.how: a rank showing technique beyond many serious players, which makes invited players take games more seriously
introduced.quote: Being a Master player means... that your technique has surpassed that of many people who have been studying the game.

introduced.name: Legend player
introduced.how: the highest rank in this sequence, described as an admirable title
introduced.quote: A Legend player, what an admirable title...

introduced.name: Invitation board
introduced.how: a board where players can post to let others challenge them to duels
introduced.quote: you are allowed to post on the invitation board

introduced.name: Tavern cats
introduced.how: the other cat players in the tavern who hold their own card games and are not to be underestimated
