introduced.quote: Of course, they, just like me, are cats in this tavern.

assumed.name: Prince
assumed.quote: When the player defeats one of Prince's Character Cards

assumed.name: Shuyun
assumed.quote: I'll have Shuyun set up the challenge for you immediately.

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: may the fun be with you in the world of Genius Invokation TCG!

assumed.name: Elemental Burst
assumed.quote: When Prince uses an Elemental Burst

assumed.name: Deck adjustments
assumed.quote: perhaps make some adjustments to your deck before your next attempt.

threads.claim: The other cats in the tavern are presented as hidden, formidable players.
threads.quote: Of course, they, just like me, are cats in this tavern. But they are not to be underestimated.

threads.claim: Some strange players in the tavern only accept challenges after a player becomes Master.
threads.quote: There are such strange guys in the tavern as well.

threads.claim: The game is played for fun by most people, but serious dedication is still worthwhile.
threads.quote: there are only a few people who are serious about the game, but even if it's just for fun, it's worth some serious dedication too.

threads.claim: Players should remember why they started playing the game.
threads.quote: don't forget why you started playing in the first place

threads.claim: Casual players do not understand why serious players devote so much time to the game.
threads.quote: they fail to understand why we would spend so much time on a game that they just play for fun

threads.claim: Winning a challenge quickly advances a player through ranks, which raises a question about how seriously ranks should be taken.
threads.quote: It only takes one challenge to become an Advanced player?

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: Moonchanter who can understand animal speech and works with the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: I was overjoyed when I first discovered that I could understand animal-speech, but I quickly realized that it came with a downside...

introduced.name: Longplume Ibis
introduced.how: bird that watches from the sky and relays mechanism positions to Lauma
introduced.quote: It will keep me updated on where you are and which mechanism is in front of you.

introduced.name: Weasel Thief
introduced.how: young, talkative treasure-hunting weasel that helps with the Moon Mirror job
introduced.quote: Relax. That weasel's only a child, it means no harm. It's just... more talkative than most.

introduced.name: Moon Mirror
introduced.how: mirror-enclosed sealed structure holding the Lunar Semblance
introduced.quote: Here we are. What you see now is the Moon Mirror, within which the Lunar Semblance is sealed.

introduced.name: Lunar Semblance
introduced.how: statue sealed inside the Moon Mirror and retrieved by the pair
introduced.quote: Here we are. What you see now is the Moon Mirror, within which the Lunar Semblance is sealed.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: group that owns the Grand Library and treats the statue as a treasure
introduced.quote: But to the Moonchanter of that era, and to the Frostmoon Scions of today, it is a priceless treasure.

introduced.name: Grand Library
introduced.how: Frostmoon Scions library, renovated to be open to humans and animals
introduced.quote: The Grand Library is open to humans and animals alike. Since we have furniture for humans to sit down on, there should naturally be some for the animals too.

introduced.name: animal-speech ability
introduced.how: Lauma understands animal speech constantly and cannot switch it off
introduced.quote: This ability is always active, and I cannot control it.

introduced.name: seal by previous Moonchanter
introduced.how: an earlier Moonchanter sealed a storage room using the Moon Mirror
introduced.quote: This job involves breaking into a storage room by undoing the seal created with the Moon Mirror by a previous Moonchanter.

introduced.name: paired mechanisms
introduced.how: two mechanisms in separate places must be activated at once to free the statue
introduced.quote: To retrieve the Lunar Semblance, we need to activate pairs of mechanisms in two different locations. So, it's a two-person job.

assumed.name: Moonchanter
assumed.quote: This is one of my duties as Moonchanter. I would not call it hard work.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Each time I ask it for help, I have to pay it one Mora more the next time we meet.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions Meeting Point
assumed.quote: (After reaching level 5 in the Frostmoon Scions Meeting Point)

assumed.name: Aisa Bathhouse
assumed.quote: Hehe, kinda sounds like an Aisa Bathhouse for animals.

assumed.name: Hiisi Island
assumed.quote: Even if you summoned every ibis on Hiisi Island, I still don't think you'd be able to move the Moon Mirror.

assumed.name: Sniffer Mole
assumed.quote: I had to ask a sniffer mole who I'd just been chatting with to invite the weasel thief over.

threads.claim: The Lunar Semblance sealed inside the Moon Mirror is an object of hidden value that draws the Traveler into the search.
threads.quote: Here we are. What you see now is the Moon Mirror, within which the Lunar Semblance is sealed.

threads.claim: Lauma says the retrieved statue holds no mystical power and that its value lies in the stories behind it.
threads.quote: Hehe, well, it's just a plain old statue — a historical relic. It doesn't hold any kind of mystical power.

threads.claim: An earlier Moonchanter placed a seal using the Moon Mirror, hinting at older Moonchanter history.
threads.quote: This job involves breaking into a storage room by undoing the seal created with the Moon Mirror by a previous Moonchanter.

threads.claim: Lauma wants the Traveler to find old texts about the Frostmoon Scions, hinting at lost history of the group.
threads.quote: On your future travels, if you ever come across any texts about the Frostmoon Scions, could I borrow them and make a copy with which to enrich our library?

threads.claim: Lauma holds that relics matter for the stories behind them, which she digs up and verifies.
threads.quote: The real value lies in the stories behind it... My job is to dig those stories up wherever they might be hiding, verify them, and then share them with the people.

threads.claim: Lauma's animal-speech never turns off, so she can never find quiet anywhere she goes.
threads.quote: But no matter where I go, I... can never find peace and quiet.

threads.claim: Lauma believes humans hide their true feelings more than animals do, which harms them.
threads.quote: But humans are less forthcoming than animals. Too often, they hide their true feelings in the deepest corners of their hearts.

threads.claim: Lauma renovated the Grand Library to bring human and animal minds together so people might open their hearts.
threads.quote: So I had an idea. I thought, what if I could find a way to bring complicated human minds and straightforward animal ones together?

introduced.name: Iktomisaur
introduced.how: a baby Iktomisaur that summons the Traveler and Paimon into the tribe's hidden space
introduced.quote: Aw, it's a baby Iktomisaurus. So cute... although, why is it staring at us?

introduced.name: Caholom
introduced.how: a tribal priest who introduces himself and explains the Elder and the scroll teleport
introduced.quote: Some introductions are in order. I am Caholom, one of the priests of our tribe.

introduced.name: Tlapo
introduced.how: the Iktomisaur Elder, a living totem alive for centuries, also called Elder Tlapo
introduced.quote: And this is our Iktomisaur Elder, the Great Tlapopoctiztetl. A living totem among the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Biram
introduced.how: the tribe's chief, a reform-minded leader who studies the tribe's mysteries and appoints the scroll-weavers' tests
introduced.quote: So, you two are the appointed ones? I am Chief Biram.

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a mysterious tribe known for arcane practices and graffiti in Natlan
introduced.quote: Masters of the Night-Wind... and by the looks of it, masters of nightlife too.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a land where major events are recorded on special scrolls
introduced.quote: However, when a major event occurs that affects all of Natlan, we record it on a different kind of scroll used for this exact purpose.

introduced.name: Woven scrolls
introduced.how: the tribe's traditional method of recording history and the legends of other tribes
introduced.quote: Our tribe has an old tradition of recording history in the form of woven scrolls.

introduced.name: Scroll-weaver appointment
introduced.how: the Iktomisaur Elder appoints scroll-weavers, and only tribe members were chosen before the Traveler
introduced.quote: Throughout our history, only members of the Masters of the Night-Wind have been appointed to undertake these tasks.

introduced.name: Gift from the spirits
introduced.how: past appointees claimed their scrolls were a gift from the spirits, not their own work
introduced.quote: Yet each of them claimed it was not their own work, but a "gift from the spirits."

introduced.name: Soul-Shielding Cloak
introduced.how: a ceremonial garb and cultural relic handed down by generations of chiefs, worn only for certain ceremonies
introduced.quote: This garb is one of our important cultural relics, handed down by generations of chiefs.

introduced.name: Hidden space
introduced.how: a sealed testing space that traps anyone who touches the scroll without permission
introduced.quote: Do you see this scroll? If you touch it, you will enter a hidden space.

introduced.name: Huitzilin
introduced.how: a great shaman from two hundred years ago who built the trapping security measure and was a skilled scroll artist
introduced.quote: Centuries ago, a great shaman by the name of Huitzilin put in place a security measure

introduced.name: Mysterious color
introduced.how: a color most people cannot detect, which only those with a natural ability can perceive
introduced.quote: It is a most mysterious color that most people cannot even detect.

introduced.name: Iktomisaur's Special Elemental Sight
introduced.how: the Traveler's ability, used while indwelling an Iktomisaur, to see hidden things
introduced.quote: Observe your surroundings using the Iktomisaur's Special Elemental Sight...

introduced.name: Toltec
introduced.how: a tribal guide who explains the sealed cave and the fruit dye
introduced.quote: Call me Toltec. The chief asked me to be your guide for the day.

introduced.name: Kuntur
introduced.how: a hero whose story is depicted in the cave's graffiti artwork
introduced.quote: According to her, the artwork tells the story of a hero by the name of Kuntur...

introduced.name: Dye fruit
introduced.how: a fruit growing in the cave whose juice makes an excellent dye
introduced.quote: Apparently, there's a certain fruit that grows in this cave, the juice of which can be processed to make an excellent dye.

introduced.name: Sealed cave
introduced.how: a cave with a barrier that only the appointed ones may pass, holding ancestors' graffiti
introduced.quote: This is as far as I can take you. Only the appointed ones may proceed from here.

introduced.name: Chamber of Weaving
introduced.how: a room where woven scrolls made by ancestors are kept and displayed
introduced.quote: (Enter the "Chamber of Weaving")

introduced.name: Obsidian Altar
introduced.how: the place where the chief can be found, reached by the priests' scroll teleport
introduced.quote: You can use this scroll to go directly to the Obsidian Altar, where the chief is.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: When the Iktomisaur Elder senses a major change in the Ley Lines, it will issue a formal declaration to appoint a creator for this scroll.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Given the stakes involved for our tribe, I was thinking a substantial sum of Mora would be appropriate

assumed.name: Kuntur's Pursuit
assumed.quote: (If Kuntur's Pursuit was not completed)

assumed.name: Teleport waypoint
assumed.quote: (Approach Biram near the teleport waypoint on top of "Masters of the Night-Wind")

threads.claim: Past scroll-weavers attributed their work to spirits, a puzzle that remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Yet each of them claimed it was not their own work, but a "gift from the spirits."

threads.claim: Biram finds the reliance on spirit gifts for recording major events deeply unsettling.
threads.quote: The notion that we have to rely on esoteric things like "gifts from the spirits" to record historical events of such great importance... it is unsettling.

threads.claim: Since Huitzilin's death, every later appointee has relied on the spirit gift.
threads.quote: Sadly, since she passed away, all of our Iktomisaur Elder's subsequent appointees have had to rely on the "gift from the spirits" to complete their work.

threads.claim: A mysterious color invisible to most people is central to the scrolls and the cave.
threads.quote: It is a most mysterious color that most people cannot even detect.

threads.claim: The Traveler's perception of the color is linked to the Elder's choice of appointees.
threads.quote: Which leads me to believe that our Iktomisaur Elder can sense this ability in people, and that it appoints a scroll-weaver on this basis.

threads.claim: Huitzilin's trapping seal still exists, and the chief has not deciphered how it works.
threads.quote: It exists to this day, and although I have not managed to decipher how it works, I have at least found out how to turn it on and off.

threads.claim: Elder Tlapo holds secrets that even the priests cannot explain.
threads.quote: Elder Tlapo has been alive for many centuries, and harbors secrets that even we priests are at a loss to explain, so your reaction is entirely natural.

threads.claim: The cave artwork tells a hero's story about Kuntur, whose full meaning is left open.
threads.quote: According to her, the artwork tells the story of a hero by the name of Kuntur...

threads.claim: Paimon questions why the tribe uses woven scrolls instead of writing.
threads.quote: Why don't you just write it down instead?

threads.claim: Biram explains that recording history through woven scrolls is a heritage the tribe must not abandon.
threads.quote: Since the very beginnings, our tribe has always sought to bring color to history, and I have a deep sense that this is one part of our heritage that we should not give up.

threads.claim: The dyeing attempt failed, so the revival of the colored scroll tradition is unresolved.
threads.quote: That color isn't showing up... The dyeing has failed.

threads.claim: Biram hopes the colored scroll tradition will be revived, but the outcome is left open.
threads.quote: Then let us hope that when we next meet, we succeed in reviving this tradition.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: a Nod-Krai-linked contact who discusses business with Sandrone over tea
introduced.quote: Mm, delicious tea and delectable snacks. Thank you for your hospitality, Miss Sandrone.

introduced.name: Ashru
introduced.how: a cat who loves laps and was won over to trust Sandrone after she worked nearby
introduced.quote: He won't stop curling up in my lap just because I've changed my outfit and made a few upgrades to my body, right?

introduced.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
introduced.how: a portable tea table that can be placed to host a tea party
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in Curatorium of Secrets and take a seat)

introduced.name: numerological array
introduced.how: an array Sandrone once worked on at the Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.quote: Small animals are usually wary of machines. It took a lot of work to get Ashru to trust me when I was here working on the numerological array.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: I hope your warm feelings for Nod-Krai and the Curatorium of Secrets will prove beneficial to our future cooperation.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
assumed.quote: I take my dealings with the Curatorium of Secrets very seriously!

assumed.name: Nefer's earlier enquiry about a matter
assumed.quote: Also, regarding that matter I enquired about before...

threads.claim: Sandrone and Nefer have pending business about an earlier enquiry whose details are withheld.
threads.quote: Also, regarding that matter I enquired about before...

threads.claim: Sandrone's past work on a numerological array at the Curatorium of Secrets is hinted at but not explained.
threads.quote: Small animals are usually wary of machines. It took a lot of work to get Ashru to trust me when I was here working on the numerological array.

introduced.name: Magnifico
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Magnifico, a noble Fontainian and former detective turned photographer
introduced.quote: Magnifico de la Magnificans. Just "Magnifico" will do. As you can see, I am of noble Fontainian stock.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: Fontaine's special police force where Magnifico once worked as a detective
introduced.quote: I once worked at the Marechaussee Phantom as a detective for a few years, working on several major cases with Inspector Frank Drebin.

introduced.name: Frank Drebin
introduced.how: A retired Marechaussee Phantom inspector, depicted as a vigorous white cat
introduced.quote: (The biography of Frank Drebin, retired Inspector of Fontaine's Marechaussee Phantom special police force. Yep, the Inspector is a vigorous white cat.)

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: The nation Magnifico is photographing in, described as home to dazzling elemental life forms
introduced.quote: That is why I am here in Natlan — home to the most shockingly dazzling elemental life forms!

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Creatures with unique personalities under hardened shells that can be photographed and tamed
introduced.quote: Truly fascinating creatures they are, each with unique personalities beneath their hardened shells.

introduced.name: Poacher
introduced.how: Hostile group that hunts Sumpter Beasts and flees when defeated
introduced.quote: Poacher: Who the...!? They're after the Sumpter Beasts!

introduced.name: Indwelling
introduced.how: The Traveler can take control of a Saurian by indwelling it
introduced.quote: (The Traveler, indwelling an Iktomisaurus, gets on the box)

assumed.name: Saurian tamer
assumed.quote: I mean, you are a Saurian tamer famed throughout Natlan, are you not?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: We're super cool, so Mora up front.

assumed.name: Tepetlisaur
assumed.quote: You see, I'm taking a photo of a Tepetlisaurus this time... Shh. Careful now, we don't want to disturb it.

assumed.name: Qucusaurus
assumed.quote: I need to take photos of a Qucusaurus diving toward the water's surface at this waterfall.

assumed.name: Iktomisaurus
assumed.quote: Haha, I see, so that was an Iktomisaurus trick... Just one of the reasons I'm here, if you must know.

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: (If the light is placed in front of the kamera, optional)

assumed.name: Desert Sumpter Beast
assumed.quote: Magnifico: Huh? Is there a... Sumpter Best in that cage? Why would one even be here?

assumed.name: Hydro Amber
assumed.quote: (If the player breaks the Hydro Amber)

assumed.name: Simeon and Carbuncle
assumed.quote: Ah... Simeon and Carbuncle... I never get tired of their music... But speaking of which, I lost my last job on their account.

threads.claim: Magnifico suspects Natlan's atmospheric elemental concentration differs from Fontaine's and may have broken his lighting machine.
threads.quote: I'm sorry, but perhaps the atmospheric elemental concentration here differs from that in Fontaine. Something must've gone wrong with the machine...

threads.claim: Magnifico lost his previous job because of Simeon and Carbuncle and came to Natlan on a risky venture, a story he defers.
threads.quote: I lost my last job on their account. That's why I ended up here, taking this blasted risk...

threads.claim: Research Institute staff were reportedly rehearsing a production titled Remuria, hinting at an unexplained play or event.
threads.quote: Later, the chief of police told me that they were Research Institute administrative staff rehearsing "Remuria."

threads.claim: Poachers are hunting Sumpter Beasts in Natlan, and the threat to the beast is raised.
threads.quote: Poacher: Who the...!? They're after the Sumpter Beasts!

threads.claim: Magnifico decides to take the rescued Sumpter Beast with him, resolving the caged beast's fate.
threads.quote: Why, I suppose I'll just have to take it in.

threads.claim: Magnifico frames his repeated meetings with the Traveler as fate rather than his own choice.
threads.quote: Well, our meeting wasn't for me to decide. T'was fate — yes, fate! — that brought us together.

introduced.name: Guijarro
introduced.how: a nervous detective novelist who becomes paranoid and sees murder in everyday things
introduced.quote: Guijarro: I've been working hard on a detective novel recently, but I still don't know what methodology the criminal should use to commit their crime!

introduced.name: Hung Fan
introduced.how: a local woman in Qiaoying Village who was hired as a porter and advises Guijarro on folklore
introduced.quote: Guijarro: Yes. When I came here, it was this lady who I hired to help me carry my baggage. I also consulted her regarding all manners of folklore.

introduced.name: Arouet
introduced.how: the proprietor of the café who objects to talk of poisoned coffee
introduced.quote: Arouet: Coffee? Poisoned? Please do not make such jests in my establishment!

introduced.name: Xuanwen Beast
introduced.how: a mythical beast from Qiaoying Village legends that looks like a young cat and senses good and evil
introduced.quote: Guijarro: According to the legends, these strange beasts appear like young cats and can sense good and evil, concealing themselves at night and rising with the sun

introduced.name: Gardemek
introduced.how: a meka unit whose sudden loss of control Guijarro fears could kill people
introduced.quote: Guijarro: That is exactly what makes me so scared! A meka that is operating normally suddenly losing control, and some poor unfortunate sop suddenly losing their life...

introduced.name: The Courtcraft of Fontaine
introduced.how: Guijarro's detective novel about a cowardly detective, his sister, and a Crime Museum
introduced.quote: Guijarro: Let's see... it's about a cowardly detective and his fearless little sister, who's also acting as his assistant.

introduced.name: Bedazzled!
introduced.how: a tabloid whose article spread the Xuanwen Beast rumors Guijarro is relying on
introduced.quote: Guijarro: Anyway! That's what the article in "Bedazzled!" said, at least!

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: a village far from Fontaine, known for its folk tales and tea business
introduced.quote: [Qiaoying, the Village of Many Tales]

introduced.name: Café Lutece
introduced.how: a café in Fontaine where Guijarro goes to drink coffee and write
introduced.quote: Guijarro: That's it! Inspiration has struck! Quickly, quickly, to the café! I must write this down!

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Traveler: We're not in Fontaine anymore. You're quite a ways from home.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Paimon: Feels like the next thing you know, you'll introduce some Adepti into the story...

assumed.name: aquabus
assumed.quote: Guijarro: I was about to ride the aquabus into the city for a cup of coffee, but when I saw aquabus running...

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Traveler: Well, time to hone my Kamera skills some more, I guess...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Guijarro: To borrow the local Liyue lingo, this would be...

threads.claim: Guijarro suspects a cat in Qiaoying Village may be a young Xuanwen Beast, leaving open whether such beasts exist there.
threads.quote: Guijarro: Still... Do you think that this kitten could be the young form of the mythical beast, lying low here in Qiaoying Village till it is fully grown

threads.claim: Hung Fan insists Xuanwen Beasts do not appear in the village and warns that they are dangerous.
threads.quote: Hung Fan: If I've told you once, I've told you countless times that Xuanwen beasts won't appear here, but you just won't believe me.

threads.claim: Guijarro's paranoia makes her imagine plots to kill her, raising the question of whether any of these fears are real.
threads.quote: Guijarro: Oh! ...I've got it! It must be because I discovered your secret, right?

threads.claim: The feared aquabus danger proves unfounded, yet Guijarro keeps suspecting hidden threats.
threads.quote: Guijarro: Phew... Nothing happened, and I'm still alive. Wonderful!

introduced.name: Verenata
introduced.how: introduces herself as a potioneer's assistant who needs testers for her potions
introduced.quote: Her name is Carabosse, and I, Verenata, still have much to learn from her.

introduced.name: Carabosse
introduced.how: is the Master Potioneer whose formulas Verenata follows
introduced.quote: Not yet! I'm just an assistant to a Master Potioneer.

introduced.name: Topyas
introduced.how: introduces herself as a musician from Merusea Village
introduced.quote: Oh, I see now... Hello, I'm Topyas, a musician from Merusea Village!

introduced.name: Tailleferre
introduced.how: introduces herself as a musician who reads ancient scores
introduced.quote: Hello. My name is Tailleferre.

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: Melusines are hardy people who do not get poisoned by odd potions
introduced.quote: We Melusines are quite hardy, and won't be in any danger just from drinking something odd.

introduced.name: Super-Duper Potion
introduced.how: a potion meant to make the drinker strong, tested by the Traveler
introduced.quote: This one's called the Super-Duper Potion, and it'll make you super strong! Well... in theory, at least.

introduced.name: Coasty-Toasty Potion
introduced.how: a potion meant to keep the drinker warm against cold
introduced.quote: Theoretically, this Coasty-Toasty Potion will spare you from the effects of the cold and keep you warm! Yeah. Probably.

introduced.name: Truesight Potion
introduced.how: a potion said to let people see what cannot be seen
introduced.quote: It is a potion that allows one to see what cannot be seen.

introduced.name: sealed cave
introduced.how: an underwater cave sealed off long ago, said to hold a lost score
introduced.quote: If we enter through here, we'll reach the cave where the legendary lost music is hidden!

introduced.name: Melody of Vesta
introduced.how: a legendary lost song whose score is said to transport listeners to a dreamland
introduced.quote: I've heard that when that melody is played, the listeners will be transported into a fantastical dreamland...

introduced.name: conch harp
introduced.how: an instrument played with a huge conch, which draws strange creatures when played
introduced.quote: If you're asking about conch harps, then yes, that is indeed an instrument.

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: an ancient music-centered civilization that ruled these waters before the Court of Fontaine
introduced.quote: Remuria is the name of the ancient civilization that controlled these waters before the foundation of the Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: phonetic notes
introduced.how: a Remurian writing system used to record music rather than language
introduced.quote: Phonetic notes were a writing system used by the Remurians, but rather than recording languages, they were used to record music.

introduced.name: Boethius
introduced.how: a great Fontaine musician who served as Harmost for the Remurian court
introduced.quote: He himself served as the Harmost for the court of Remuria itself.

introduced.name: Remurian flood
introduced.how: a great flood thousands of years ago destroyed Remuria in a single day
introduced.quote: But thousands of years ago, a great flood destroyed all of this in a single day.

introduced.name: truth
introduced.how: the truth is described as objective and existing independently of any viewer
introduced.quote: It objectively exists there, and it just is.

assumed.name: Mamere
assumed.quote: But I really don't have much time to prepare, and I want to give Mamere her gift as soon as possible...

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Long time no see, Katheryne!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Fontaine is full of artists, and if the Adventurers' Guild helps us, we can definitely find someone who can read it.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: It should be fine if we go and find Katheryne in the Court of Fontaine!

assumed.name: Tidalga
assumed.quote: A Tidalga slurry, the crushed innards of Lumitoile, and a little

assumed.name: Lumitoile
assumed.quote: the crushed innards of Lumitoile

assumed.name: Sternshield Crab
assumed.quote: (Open the chest guarded by the Sternshield Crab, optional)

assumed.name: Pyro Slimes
assumed.quote: Traveler: Aquatic animals...? Weren't those Pyro Slimes?

assumed.name: Armored Crabs
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! Here comes a whole bunch of Armored Crabs!

assumed.name: commissions
assumed.quote: Are you here for new commissions today?

threads.claim: The Truesight Potion is said to reveal the truth, and Verenata admits she does not know what that means.
threads.quote: I'm not sure how to put this, but Carabosse says that it can help people understand the truth.

threads.claim: Truth is described as objective, yet the Master Potioneer claims it can also be created through dreams and memories, which seems contradictory.
threads.quote: I don't quite get it, and it seems like a contradiction to me... but I'm trying my best to understand.

threads.claim: The Traveler glimpses a semi-transparent boat that looks cut in half by something huge, leaving its nature unexplained.
threads.quote: I saw... half of a semi-transparent boat?

threads.claim: The potion test of the ghost boat is inconclusive, so the sighting remains unexplained.
threads.quote: So... *sigh* The results of this experiment are inconclusive.

threads.claim: A legend says the Melody of Vesta's score lies in a sealed underwater cave and that no Melusine has ever retrieved it.
threads.quote: Though no Melusine has ever successfully entered the cave and retrieved the score

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon find a bronze plate that seems to be the lost score, though its notation is unreadable at first.
threads.quote: Hmm... I haven't seen its contents yet, but this bronze plate should be the lost score for the

threads.claim: The conch harp performance is beautiful but does not carry listeners into a dreamscape as the legend claimed.
threads.quote: Even though it can't carry people off into a dreamscape like the legend says, it is truly beautiful music.

threads.claim: A great flood destroyed the Remurian civilization in a single day, thousands of years ago.
threads.quote: But thousands of years ago, a great flood destroyed all of this in a single day.

threads.claim: Topyas stopped playing the conch harp because it always drew strange creatures to her performances.
threads.quote: I would always attract a bunch of strange creatures whenever I played it.

threads.claim: The conch harp draws an army of Armored Crabs when the token is placed, confirming why its performances became impossible.
threads.quote: No wonder Conch Harp performances became impossible... C'mon, let's help them clean this up!

threads.claim: After drinking the Truesight Potion, the Traveler can see hidden crystal devices that open the sealed cave.
threads.quote: I see crystal devices I couldn't before.

threads.claim: Topyas is making a farewell song for Mamere, who may leave the village again soon.
threads.quote: Wooow! Since you're Mamere's partners, you must be really reliable!

introduced.name: Chulkaturin
introduced.how: a lone last scion of an old snowfield-dwelling nobility, a ghost of history who has lived in a cabin on ice for centuries
introduced.quote: Please forgive this excess personage, please absolve this last scion of old snowfield-dwelling nobility, doomed to be forgotten by time, whose name is Chulkaturin.

introduced.name: Prime Ice Construct
introduced.how: Prime Ice devices placed around the floe that pull the cabin toward shore
introduced.quote: Please look for Prime Ice devices around you and place them in suitable spots. They will then pull the cabin in.

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: an old people of the snowfield whose era Chulkaturin belongs to and who were uprooted from their land
introduced.quote: I am a ghost of the past, long-forgotten, a relic of an era that still belonged to the fae.

introduced.name: Snow Poplar Wood
introduced.how: felled snow poplars were the timber used to build Chulkaturin's cabin
introduced.quote: I used felled snow poplars to construct it, and have since allowed it to carry me along, across lakes and rivers alike.

introduced.name: fae uprooting from the snowfield homeland
introduced.how: more than three hundred years ago the fae were driven from their land and the old era ended
introduced.quote: More than three hundred years ago, we were utterly uprooted from this land. The curtain fell on the old era, and there is no longer any place for us here.

assumed.name: Snezhnayan land
assumed.quote: never to set foot on Snezhnayan land

assumed.name: prior rescue of Chulkaturin by the travelers
assumed.quote: You saved me once before, good travelers, and it appears we meet again, as I thought we might.

threads.claim: The fae were uprooted from their homeland over three hundred years ago and the old era ended, leaving the survivors with no place in the world.
threads.quote: More than three hundred years ago, we were utterly uprooted from this land. The curtain fell on the old era, and there is no longer any place for us here.

threads.claim: The snow poplars that were the fae homeland's glory were cut down, and their felled wood became Chulkaturin's home.
threads.quote: They lie in the snow, cut down to the last.

threads.claim: Chulkaturin has given his fate to the drifting house rather than choose between the two roads open to him.
threads.quote: I could not choose between those two roads, and so I entrusted my fate to this home on ice...

threads.claim: Chulkaturin doubts whether any choice remains his if he steps onto land with an unpredictable future, and he refuses to leave the sinking house.
threads.quote: Should I step on land... should I tread upon soil estranged and step into its unknowable future

threads.claim: Chulkaturin has refused for centuries to set foot on Snezhnayan land, a refusal whose reason is not yet explained.
threads.quote: never to set foot on Snezhnayan land

threads.claim: Chulkaturin chooses to stay on the sinking house and accepts his fate, asking the travelers to leave him there.
threads.quote: This is the fate I have awaited all these years.

introduced.name: Rosalyne
introduced.how: a dancer with a fiery passion who taught Odette
introduced.quote: Rosalyne danced with a fiery passion, whereas Odette is as frosty and opaque as a block of solid ice.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a ballerina whose performances keep improving and who is seen as cold and resolute
introduced.quote: Despite learning her craft under Rosalyne, their temperaments and styles couldn't be more different.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: a ruler in Snezhnaya whose plans are underway
introduced.quote: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's plans have made some initial progress, but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

introduced.name: Project Stuzha
introduced.how: a difficult undertaking in Snezhnaya that is proving hard to carry out
introduced.quote: but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

introduced.name: La Signora
introduced.how: a title rumored to be Odette's likely inheritance
introduced.quote: No wonder there are rumors that she's the favorite to inherit the "La Signora" title.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Arlecchino has helped me a lot in the past. I should invite her to tea party. Hopefully she has the time to spare...

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Thanks for the invitation, Sandrone. This food tastes just like I remember. It really brings back memories.

assumed.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
assumed.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau and take a seat)

assumed.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
assumed.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table in the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau and take a seat)

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Marionette: You're welcome. If you like, we can get together more often when I'm back in Snezhnaya. It'll be just like the old days.

assumed.name: Korolevskiy Troupe
assumed.quote: The Knave: Though we should still have time to stop for a cup of tea every now and then, or even catch a performance by the Korolevskiy Troupe.

assumed.name: the Mayor
assumed.quote: but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

threads.claim: Odette seems to carry a heavy burden and may have sealed away hidden hurts.
threads.quote: Or perhaps she's sealed such things away where no one will see them.

threads.claim: Project Stuzha in Snezhnaya is an ambitious plan that is harder to carry out than expected.
threads.quote: but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

threads.claim: Rumors suggest Odette is the favorite to inherit the La Signora title.
threads.quote: No wonder there are rumors that she's the favorite to inherit the "La Signora" title.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's plans in Snezhnaya are making initial progress.
threads.quote: Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's plans have made some initial progress, but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: a large building that crashed into the sea and was destroyed, leaving floating wreckage
introduced.quote: Kun: Those fragments ended up floating on the ocean, with some larger pieces even blocking the path of passing ships...

introduced.name: Kun
introduced.how: Ministry of Civil Affairs worker under a sergeant who needs help clearing ocean flotsam
introduced.quote: Kun: Our sergeant said that I could look for some people to help out, but who would want to do this job, anyway...

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: government body that organizes cleanup of the Jade Chamber wreckage
introduced.quote: Kun: The Ministry of Civil Affairs organized a cleanup, which got rid of all the larger pieces.

introduced.name: Baiwen
introduced.how: Yuehai Pavilion official who identifies Jade Chamber items and handles its business
introduced.quote: Baiwen: Yes, this does indeed come from the Jade Chamber.

introduced.name: Yuehai Pavilion
introduced.how: where Baiwen attends to business and where orders are sent
introduced.quote: Kun: She's currently attending to some business at Yuehai Pavilion. Perhaps she might know what it is.

introduced.name: Meadow of Gems
introduced.how: a book the Jade Chamber rebuild requires, hard to find in stock
introduced.quote: Kun: Let me see... Hmm, they first want a book called "Meadow of Gems," and some small bamboo ornaments.

introduced.name: Jifang
introduced.how: shopkeeper who sells goods but does not have the requested book in stock
introduced.quote: Jifang: Hi. Would you like to buy anything?

introduced.name: Qingzhou
introduced.how: extremely well-read poet who once read the Meadow of Gems
introduced.quote: Jifang: Perhaps you can look for Qingzhou instead. He is extremely well-read — perhaps he might know where a copy of "Meadow of Gems" might be found.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: inn where Qingzhou often lodges
introduced.quote: Jifang: If my memory serves, Qingzhou often lodges at the Wangshu Inn. You can try looking for him there.

introduced.name: Master Lu
introduced.how: bamboo ornament maker who works at Fanmu Carpenter
introduced.quote: Kun: You can ask Jifang about the book. As for the bamboo ornaments, I believe that Master Lu of Fanmu Carpenter's makes them.

introduced.name: Fanmu Carpenter
introduced.how: workshop where Master Lu makes bamboo ornaments
introduced.quote: Kun: You can ask Jifang about the book. As for the bamboo ornaments, I believe that Master Lu of Fanmu Carpenter's makes them.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Woah, this is a ton of Mora! C—Can we keep it?

assumed.name: Jade Chamber crash
assumed.quote: Kun: You recall that it was completely destroyed when it crashed, right?

assumed.name: The Crane Returns on the Wind
assumed.quote: Available after completing The Crane Returns on the Wind.

threads.claim: The Jade Chamber is scheduled for reconstruction, though it has not yet begun.
threads.quote: Kun: Oh, it's you. Do you still remember the affair with the Jade Chamber? Baiwen came over some days ago, saying that a schedule's already been drawn up for its reconstruction.

threads.claim: Rebuilding the Jade Chamber faces a material shortage that Baiwen does not yet explain.
threads.quote: Baiwen: Not to mention our biggest material headache, which we have yet to find a solution to...

threads.claim: Salvaged Jade Chamber documents include an unreviewed announcement, surprisingly well preserved.
threads.quote: Baiwen: Well, the contents consist of several documents and an announcement that has yet to undergo review.

threads.claim: The Meadow of Gems holds more meaning than its surface suggests, according to Qingzhou.
threads.quote: Qingzhou: Though this passage still speaks of the mercantile way, it reveals quite a fair amount more meaning upon closer reading...

threads.claim: Boars have unexplainedly taken over the bamboo forest that Master Lu gathers from.
threads.quote: Master Lu: There is one problem, though: the bamboo forest that I frequently gather materials from has suddenly become occupied by a great many boars, for reasons unknown to me.

introduced.name: Linnea
introduced.how: plant expert with deep knowledge of local ecology who teaches Speranza's children
introduced.quote: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. , with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

introduced.name: Hexadecatonic Mandragora
introduced.how: a dangerous plant that has surprised adventurers face to face
introduced.quote: I remember a certain fresh-faced adventurer saying something similar, right before coming face-to-face with a Hexadecatonic Mandragora...

introduced.name: Winter Icelea
introduced.how: a hardy, cold-resistant plant tied to the King of Winter Icelea legend and seen as a Lightkeepers symbol
introduced.quote: What's more, due to Winter Icelea's hardiness and resistance to the cold, it's also considered to be a symbol of the Lightkeepers.

introduced.name: Midsommar Berries
introduced.how: the symbol of the King of Midsommar Oak, brother of the King of Winter Icelea
introduced.quote: Midsommar Berries are the symbol of the "King of Midsommar Oak", brother to the "King of Winter Icelea."

introduced.name: King of Winter Icelea
introduced.how: a twin king who fights his brother endlessly, dying and being reborn, and rules winter
introduced.quote: They each take turns killing the other, only to be resurrected once more. Each rules their own season, with this cycle of death and rebirth continuing until the end of time.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: a group that dresses in black and stands firm against hardship, symbolized by Winter Icelea
introduced.quote: just like Winter Icelea, the Lightkeepers stand tall in the face of hardships as fierce as the icy wind.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: the group whose two sisters are the subject of a legend about the Nocturnal Blossom
introduced.quote: There's another legend that claims the opposing colors of the Nocturnal Blossom represent two sisters from the Frostmoon Scions...

introduced.name: Nocturnal Blossom
introduced.how: a flower in red and blue whose two joined blooms symbolize two sisters
introduced.quote: Otherwise, why would people use the Nocturnal Blossom with its two flowers joined together to represent them?

introduced.name: language of flowers
introduced.how: a Fontaine tradition in which flowers carry secret meanings, described in a handbook
introduced.quote: She told me about the language of flowers.

assumed.name: Speranza
assumed.quote: (Approach Speranza)

assumed.name: Katya
assumed.quote: Don't worry, I'll let you in on a secret — Katya's prepared enough sugar sculptures for everyone.

assumed.name: Aino
assumed.quote: Katya and Aino both make delicious Midsommar Torte...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: That's exactly what the scholars of Snezhnaya think this story represents.

assumed.name: Voidsea Outlook
assumed.quote: there's another notable variety of plant that can be found near Voidsea Outlook...

assumed.name: Helka
assumed.quote: Helka sent me a handbook, all the way from Fontaine.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Helka sent me a handbook, all the way from Fontaine.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Nocturnal Blossoms aren't the only things we've seen in Nod-Krai that are red and blue.

assumed.name: kuuvahki
assumed.quote: It must be the extraordinary power of kuuvahki!

assumed.name: Conch Gang
assumed.quote: We're not like that in the Conch Gang.

threads.claim: The twin Kings of Winter Icelea and Midsommar Oak fight endlessly and are reborn, each ruling a season.
threads.quote: They each take turns killing the other, only to be resurrected once more. Each rules their own season, with this cycle of death and rebirth continuing until the end of time.

threads.claim: Scholars of Snezhnaya read the twin-king legend as a representation of the changing seasons.
threads.quote: That's exactly what the scholars of Snezhnaya think this story represents.

threads.claim: Why Nocturnal Blossoms come in both red and blue is posed as an open riddle.
threads.quote: Why do Nocturnal Blossoms come in both red and blue?

threads.claim: The red-and-blue riddle is answered as kuuvahki, which Linnea calls common knowledge in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: You're... correct!

threads.claim: Kuuvahki is common knowledge in Nod-Krai but unfamiliar to outsiders, hinting at a deeper phenomenon.
threads.quote: It's common knowledge for those of us who live in Nod-Krai, but not so much for adventurers visiting from afar.

threads.claim: A legend of two Frostmoon Scions sisters is raised, and whether they reconcile is left unresolved.
threads.quote: I bet the sisters make up in the end, right?

threads.claim: The Lightkeepers are linked to black clothing and to standing firm against icy hardship, as Winter Icelea does.
threads.quote: The Lightkeepers... They're the ones who dress in black, right?

threads.claim: Fontaine flowers are said to carry secret meanings recorded in a handbook.
threads.quote: She told me about the language of flowers.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Director Furina, a former Hydro Archon who is now a relaxed director and once a beloved stage superstar
introduced.quote: Director Furina feels quite different from when she was Hydro Archon.

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: the Marionette called Miss Guillotin, a former Fontaine resident who left the nation and now visits Furina for tea
introduced.quote: Marionette: Truth be told, when I still lived in Fontaine, even I knew who you were — the universally beloved superstar, Furina.

introduced.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
introduced.how: a portable tea table used to host tea parties with Furina
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table near the Fountain of Lucine and take a seat)

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the homeland Sandrone left and still loves, calm like still water yet full of novel change
introduced.quote: I've always liked Fontaine, and it's always felt like home.

assumed.name: Fountain of Lucine
assumed.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table near the Fountain of Lucine and take a seat)

assumed.name: Fontinalia Film Festival
assumed.quote: This is the least I can do after your recent support during the Fontinalia Film Festival.

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: Director Furina feels quite different from when she was Hydro Archon.

assumed.name: Furina's past performances
assumed.quote: Ugh, please don't! Whatever you do, don't say you

threads.claim: Furina has changed greatly since her time as Hydro Archon, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Director Furina feels quite different from when she was Hydro Archon.

threads.claim: Furina is reluctant to return to performing on stage and prefers working behind the scenes.
threads.quote: Well... Never say never... But, uh... right now, I prefer working behind the scenes.

threads.claim: Sandrone left Fontaine and saw Furina in an earlier era, hinting at why she departed.
threads.quote: I just wanted to say that when I left Fontaine, I had the honor of seeing you as you were back then.

threads.claim: Furina says she is enjoying life much more now, and Sandrone notes she seems more relaxed than before.
threads.quote: Hehe... Thank you for saying so. I actually am enjoying life a lot more these days.

introduced.name: Imix
introduced.how: Cheven's young assistant who minds the shop with her
introduced.quote: Do you mind watching the store, Imix? I'll be right back.

introduced.name: Cheven
introduced.how: a gem artisan who introduces herself and runs a store
introduced.quote: Ah, sorry, let me introduce myself. I'm Cheven, a gem artisan.

introduced.name: Tlazolli
introduced.how: a former Ancient Name artisan and Nechca's mother
introduced.quote: Tlazolli is a former Ancient Name artisan, and Nechca is her daughter.

introduced.name: Nechca
introduced.how: Tlazolli's daughter, recovering from a serious illness
introduced.quote: Tlazolli is a former Ancient Name artisan, and Nechca is her daughter.

introduced.name: Iengu
introduced.how: Tlazolli's Tepetlisaur companion who helped with digging
introduced.quote: Tlazolli has a Tepetlisaur companion. If I remember right, its name is... Iengu?

introduced.name: Shadow Pin
introduced.how: a mountain landmark that crashed down, leaving a huge crater
introduced.quote: It's all because the Shadow Pin suddenly came crashing to the ground and left behind a massive crater.

introduced.name: Volcanic Crystal
introduced.how: a valuable crystal ore with exceptional purity found near the Shadow Pin
introduced.quote: a new seam of Volcanic Crystal near the Shadow Pin

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: bandits who attacked Cheven on the mountain
introduced.quote: I ended up running into those bandits... You showed up in the nick of time.

introduced.name: Ancient Names
introduced.how: a forging art Tlazolli once practiced and that the gift's techniques derive from
introduced.quote: The techniques used to make it are all rooted in Ancient Name forging.

introduced.name: Blazegem Inscription
introduced.how: an erosion-resistant crystal ornament engraved with words, made by Tlazolli
introduced.quote: Well, it's a Blazegem Inscription. I made it from the purest ore, so it's almost completely resistant to erosion.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen's in that line of business too.

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: Hey, the Pyro Archon said she contacted Xilonen about that already.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: "the finest artisan in Natlan"... You'll never hear the end of it.

assumed.name: Tepetlisaur
assumed.quote: Looks like a Tepetlisaur nest.

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: You'll end up losing all your Mora!

threads.claim: The Shadow Pin crashed to the ground, leaving a crater and riling up monsters.
threads.quote: It's all because the Shadow Pin suddenly came crashing to the ground and left behind a massive crater.

threads.claim: Characters credit the Wayob, a spirit, with protecting people and shaping their luck.
threads.quote: Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

threads.claim: Tlazolli gave up Ancient Name forging to care for Nechca and may miss it.
threads.quote: I know Tlazolli misses the days when she used to forge Ancient Names.

threads.claim: Nechca is recovering from a serious illness but remains very weak.
threads.quote: She's still very weak. The shock and the cold wind certainly didn't help, so she ended up with a slight fever.

threads.claim: The wrecked house is explained as Nechca having snuck out alone to find flowers.
threads.quote: Well, she snuck out and ran off by herself.

threads.claim: A Tepetlisaur found atop the mountain may not be Iengu, hinting at more wandering creatures.
threads.quote: Might not be Tlazolli's companion, though...

threads.claim: Blazegem Inscriptions are said to keep their words from deteriorating or being distorted, unlike word of mouth.
threads.quote: But the words inscribed on these crystals will stand the test of time.

threads.claim: Nechca writes letters to Xilonen and dreams of becoming an Ancient Names forger.
threads.quote: She often writes to Xilonen, apparently.

threads.claim: Tlazolli promises to have the Traveler engrave a Blazegem Inscription personally once it is ready.
threads.quote: Then, I'll have you do the inscription yourself.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: A hunter who is secretly working against fae gangs and is trying to make a living from hunting
introduced.quote: Alyosha: ? Shh! I'm hunting. Keep your voice down — don't spook the prey.

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: Criminal gangs that operate outside legitimate organizations and are dangerous to cross
introduced.quote: Alyosha: They aren't legitimate organizations like the Fatui, but their roots run just as deep.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A harsh, cold land where the wilds hold dangerous prey and hunters must work hard to survive
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Here in Snezhnaya, most things considered "prey" are dangerous to get involved with, but a hunter has to make a living.

introduced.name: Huntsman's Cabin
introduced.how: A cabin in the snowfields that the gang has been guarding and using to hide its Kristall stash
introduced.quote: (Approach the Huntsman's Cabin)

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: A valuable, heat-giving power resource that gangs hoard and smuggle while villagers freeze
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Rumor has it that some of these gangland folks have connections at the Energy Commission, and they've got a real hoard of Kresnik Kristall.

introduced.name: Tugarin
introduced.how: Alyosha's trained dog who responds to commands and helps in fights
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Good boy. Sit. Are there "horns" inside?

introduced.name: Old Sire
introduced.how: A dead fae gang leader whose rules on sharing treasure still govern the gangs
introduced.quote: Hulking Fae: Old Sire is dead — or were you hoping Zmei would pick up where he left off, huh? Didn't think so. Now beat it!

introduced.name: access card
introduced.how: A card found in a chest that may unlock the Shadow Realm barrier
introduced.quote: Alyosha: A key and a... card? What do you think they're for?

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: A device that detects Shadow Realm barriers and can be unlocked with the right access card
introduced.quote: Eye of Graeae: ...Shadow Realm barrier device detected. With the right access card, it may be possible to unlock it.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: A place where gangs dig up ancient artifacts, guarded by barriers that require access cards
introduced.quote: Hulking Fae: Nowadays, we risk our necks digging stuff up in the Shadow Realm...

introduced.name: Kresnik's Torch
introduced.how: A prototype Kristall-powered furnace that is far stronger than ordinary furnaces and can warm a whole area
introduced.quote: Alyosha: It really is unique. I've seen a lot of Kristall-powered furnaces, and this one is stronger than any of them. It can warm up this whole area.

introduced.name: Firearm Accessory Blueprint
introduced.how: An ancient blueprint from the Belyi Tsar's era that is related to the Traveler's gun
introduced.quote: Alyosha: I remember now. Not long ago, a fae gang was going around buying up blueprints from the Belyi Tsar's time.

introduced.name: Rokot
introduced.how: An organization Alyosha belongs to, which values keeping a low profile
introduced.quote: Alyosha: Because I'm a member of the Rokot. Keeping a low profile is a matter of principle.

introduced.name: Chaplina
introduced.how: A villager who keeps the shelter's Kristall furnace running and manages its supplies
introduced.quote: Chaplina: Yeah. It was a little unstable at first, but Kresnik Kristall burns much more efficiently with this design.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Alyosha: They aren't legitimate organizations like the Fatui, but their roots run just as deep.

assumed.name: Energy Commission
assumed.quote: Hulking Fae: Don't tell me you're after this technology too? ... Oh, I get it. Some other group sent you, huh? Who was it, the Energy Commission? Or Luchkin?

assumed.name: Project Stuzha
assumed.quote: Alyosha: All for smuggling, of course. They won't appear on Project Stuzha's ledger, so no officials will investigate even if they get stolen.

assumed.name: Druzhna
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Once the Kristall has been distributed to freezing villagers, do you really think they'd dare go door-to-door to take it right back under the Druzhna's nose?

assumed.name: Izmaylov family
assumed.quote: Short Fae: The Izmaylov family will get their fair share, for Old Sire's sake. But the rest? We've earned it.

assumed.name: Lady Voronina
assumed.quote: Short Fae: What about Lady Voronina? You sayin' you're not scared of her either?

assumed.name: Zmei
assumed.quote: Hulking Fae: Old Sire is dead — or were you hoping Zmei would pick up where he left off, huh? Didn't think so. Now beat it!

assumed.name: Luchkin
assumed.quote: Hulking Fae: Don't tell me you're after this technology too? ... Oh, I get it. Some other group sent you, huh? Who was it, the Energy Commission? Or Luchkin?

assumed.name: High Table
assumed.quote: Hulking Fae: Don't play games with me! After the old man died, the High Table decided we'd outlived our usefulness.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Alyosha: You're the most famous member of the Adventurers' Guild, after all. Monumental events always seem to find you, don't they?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Alyosha: We can't just hand antiques out to the villagers directly, though. We'll have to find a way to trade them in for Mora...

assumed.name: Incomplete Data Block
assumed.quote: Traveler: That thing we picked up in the Shadow Realm earlier...

assumed.name: Belyi Tsar
assumed.quote: Alyosha: I remember now. Not long ago, a fae gang was going around buying up blueprints from the Belyi Tsar's time.

threads.claim: Fae gangs operate outside legitimate structures and are dangerous to cross.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Well, all you need to know is that these aren't fae you wanna mess with.

threads.claim: Gangs may have connections inside the Energy Commission that help them smuggle Kristall.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Rumor has it that some of these gangland folks have connections at the Energy Commission, and they've got a real hoard of Kresnik Kristall.

threads.claim: Hoarded Kristall is scarce and dangerous to possess, so gangs hide their stashes.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Makes sense if you think about it. Hoarding Kristall is dicey business right now, so they'd wanna keep their stash well hidden.

threads.claim: The prototype furnace stabilizes heating so villagers no longer risk freezing despite limited Kristall stock.
threads.quote: Chaplina: Kristall is still in short supply, but if we pool together the limited stock we have, there's actually more than enough.

threads.claim: Lady Voronina is a powerful figure whom the fae gangs fear and who enforces their rules.
threads.quote: Short Fae: What about Lady Voronina? You sayin' you're not scared of her either?

threads.claim: The High Table has dropped the fae gangs and profits from the artifacts they dig up.
threads.quote: Hulking Fae: Don't play games with me! After the old man died, the High Table decided we'd outlived our usefulness.

threads.claim: Shadow Realm barriers are guarded by devices that require special access cards.
threads.quote: Eye of Graeae: ...Shadow Realm barrier device detected. With the right access card, it may be possible to unlock it.

threads.claim: Gangs are digging up artifacts from an ancient era that no one fully understands yet.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Tch... "Antiques" was right — none of this is from the present era. I don't know much about these ancient artifacts.

threads.claim: The access card is tied to the Shadow Realm and to the artifacts, and its purpose remains unclear.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Clearly, this card is very important to them. They couldn't afford to let it fall into the wrong hands...

threads.claim: The Traveler's gun is connected to ancient blueprints from the past.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's related to my gun.

threads.claim: Alyosha contrasts hunters who turn back after the hunt with adventurers who always push further.
threads.quote: Alyosha: With the sprawling wilderness before them, a hunter turns back after catching their prey, but an adventurer always goes that extra step further.

threads.claim: The Traveler is a famous Adventurers' Guild member whom monumental events seem to follow.
threads.quote: Alyosha: You're the most famous member of the Adventurers' Guild, after all. Monumental events always seem to find you, don't they?

threads.claim: Alyosha belongs to the Rokot and deliberately keeps a low profile.
threads.quote: Alyosha: Because I'm a member of the Rokot. Keeping a low profile is a matter of principle.

introduced.name: Ms. Qiu
introduced.how: leader of a three-person tea-village filmmaking group from Qiaoying Village
introduced.quote: Ms. Qiu: Hello there, adventurer. You must be here for the commission to help us get our Film Kamera back, right?

introduced.name: Xingye
introduced.how: group member who is a former store helper turned filmmaker, complaining about their situation
introduced.quote: Xingye: The skilled helpers we had at the store left one by one to work elsewhere, so if we just stuck to making tea, we'd be starving.

introduced.name: Yifeng
introduced.how: group member who worries about the film and the equipment
introduced.quote: Yifeng: In truth, there are too many people in the tea business, and we just couldn't compete.

introduced.name: Film Kamera
introduced.how: a film camera the group uses, which was lost to monsters and recovered by the Traveler
introduced.quote: Yifeng: Yeah, but our half-finished film is still in the Kamera.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: a tea-growing village in Liyue where the group is from
introduced.quote: Ms. Qiu: Let's keep it brief. We three are from Qiaoying Village in Liyue.

introduced.name: Geisert
introduced.how: a lighting expert and master filmmaker the group has come to Fontaine to learn from
introduced.quote: Geisert: I'm just someone who's somewhat familiar with the uses of lighting for filmmaking.

introduced.name: Geisert's lighting theory
introduced.how: the idea that manipulating lighting is manipulating emotion, using lighting to express narrative
introduced.quote: Geisert: Yeah. In my lighting theory, I believe that the manipulation of lighting is the manipulation of emotion.

introduced.name: dokumentari films
introduced.how: documentary-style promotional films the group makes to help village tea vendors
introduced.quote: Ms. Qiu: So, we changed professions and started filming dokumentari films to help promote tea vendors in the village.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a foreign region where the group came to seek advice from master filmmakers
introduced.quote: Ms. Qiu: So that's why we're in Fontaine. We're trying to seek advice from master filmmakers!

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: an organization where commissions are posted for adventurers, with a prepaid posting fee
introduced.quote: Xingye: We did that yesterday. The guild said they can return us our prepaid commission posting fee today.

introduced.name: waterproof film box
introduced.how: a sealed box holding the group's films, which fell into the water and had to be retrieved by diving
introduced.quote: Ms. Qiu: No problem. Our box is waterproof. All we need to do is dive down and fetch it...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Ms. Qiu: This pot is pretty strange. Hmm... but it should be used the same way as the ones in Liyue.

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Ms. Qiu: Thank the Archons. I thought we were gonna have to start shooting all over again.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Ms. Qiu: We've made plenty of Mora shooting these tea dokumentaris in the village.

assumed.name: Marcotte
assumed.quote: Xingye: Boss, I got the veggies, but they're all out of Marcotte.

threads.claim: The group's Film Kamera is lost with their half-finished film, leaving the shoot in jeopardy.
threads.quote: Xingye: What're we gonna do now, Boss? The filming's not done and the Kamera's lost...

threads.claim: The Traveler recovers the Film Kamera and its film intact from the monsters.
threads.quote: Ms. Qiu: Great! The Film Kamera is intact, and the film hasn't been destroyed...

threads.claim: Competition in Qiaoying Village's tea trade is pushing villagers toward promotional films, and the group is losing ground.
threads.quote: Yifeng: But recently, some others in the village have also started to shoot their own promotional films.

threads.claim: Geisert's lighting theory is unrecognized by Fontaine's film industry, and its value is still in question.
threads.quote: Geisert: But... How should I put this... My theories have yet to be regarded in Fontaine's film industry.

threads.claim: Geisert once worked as a journalist before turning to filmmaking, hinting at a past beyond film.
threads.quote: Geisert: Who said a tea vendor can't be a director? I was just a journalist before.

threads.claim: Ms. Qiu reacts to Geisert's journalism past with a hint of an unstated motive.
threads.quote: Ms. Qiu: Huh... Just as well...

threads.claim: The box of films fell into the water, putting the group's work at risk.
threads.quote: Xingye: It's purely because the box we put our films in fell into the water.

threads.claim: The Traveler retrieves the underwater box, saving everything inside it.
threads.quote: Ms. Qiu: If it weren't for you, everything inside the case would have been lost.

introduced.name: Broglie
introduced.how: entry-level researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute who formerly monitored hydrology data
introduced.quote: My name is Broglie, and I'm an entry-level researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute, and I was previously responsible for monitoring Fontaine's hydrology data.

introduced.name: Hydrology data
introduced.how: all recorded data on water properties such as temperature, level, current flow and impurities, used to detect water quality changes early
introduced.quote: Simply put, it is all the data related to the various properties of water.

introduced.name: Oceanid departure from Fontaine
introduced.how: Broglie claims a water quality change drove the Oceanids away from Fontaine
introduced.quote: that's one of the reasons those lovely Oceanids left Fontaine.

introduced.name: Central Laboratory accident
introduced.how: a lab accident blew up the Central Laboratory and also sank a hydrology observation station
introduced.quote: As ill-luck would have it, that lab accident also sunk the hydrology observation station here.

introduced.name: Department of Hydrology and Aquatic Life Conservation
introduced.how: newly established department Broglie was moved into after the station sank, replacing the old monitoring department
introduced.quote: I was transferred to the newly established Department of Hydrology and Aquatic Life Conservation!

introduced.name: Blubberbeast
introduced.how: a creature kept in an office by a woman that bites people
introduced.quote: there's a woman who keeps a Blubberbeast in the office.

introduced.name: Punched Tape
introduced.how: waterproof paper tape holding recorded station data that needs special machinery to decipher
introduced.quote: Punched tape retrieved from the water. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

introduced.name: Hydrology observation stations
introduced.how: three observation stations plus one central processing station, each with independent datasets
introduced.quote: We have three observation stations and one central processing station in total, each with their own independent datasets.

introduced.name: Central processing station
introduced.how: the site where hydrology research data is analyzed, reached with a key from the supervisor
introduced.quote: This is the central processing station, where our hydrology research data is analyzed!

introduced.name: Pate de Fruit
introduced.how: one of the observation stations, now taken over by Fatui
introduced.quote: I'll mark the locations of the Pate de Fruit Station and Crepes Suzette Station on your map now!

introduced.name: Crepes Suzette
introduced.how: one of the observation stations, where the Fatui platoon leader Shumilov was seen
introduced.quote: I'll mark the locations of the Pate de Fruit Station and Crepes Suzette Station on your map now!

introduced.name: Conch Madeleine
introduced.how: a sunken observation station where the team used to take tea breaks
introduced.quote: By the way, this place is the Conch Madeleine Station.

introduced.name: Fixed Storage Device and Energy Transfer Device
introduced.how: energy storage device below the main console that must be online and recharged to power the console
introduced.quote: Confirm the energy storage device below the main console is online

introduced.name: Malinovskyi
introduced.how: commanding officer of the 34th Independent Investigative Squad who occupied the stations to slack off
introduced.quote: I'm Malinovskyi, commanding officer of the 34th Independent Investigative Squad.

introduced.name: 34th Independent Investigative Squad

introduced.name: Benoit Leroy

introduced.quote: Morticia isn't my daughter by blood. I took her in half a year ago. That said, she may as well be my own trueborn daughter.

introduced.quote: Right, I forgot to mention, but Nana's my cat — you know, the one by the door.

introduced.how: Child who visits Benoit to do good deeds for a homework essay
introduced.quote: Mama says that I should do one good deed every day, and my tutor wants me to submit an essay this week about good people and good things.

introduced.quote: Hello? Anyone there? Do you still want your newspaper? Hey! Anybody there?

introduced.quote: That's right. His old place over in the Fleuve Cendre.

introduced.quote: Perhaps I should grill a few more cookies for the children?

threads.claim: Benoit may be coerced or endangered by his adopted children, the Traveler suggests.
threads.quote: Benoit's daughter is coercing him.

threads.claim: The couple who appeared as Benoit's children may be outsiders with hidden motives.
threads.quote: This couple became his children.

threads.claim: Benoit had a poor reputation when he was younger, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Although his reputation when he was younger was less than stellar

threads.claim: Benoit has been unseen for days, and his household has grown strangely silent.
threads.quote: Whenever I delivered here, he would always at least reply, but recently, I haven't seen hide nor hair of him at all.

threads.claim: Autumn Leroy was rumored to have murdered her second husband and was sent to prison, possibly because Benoit refused to testify.
threads.quote: Wait, you don't know, Officer? She murdered her second husband.

threads.claim: The merchant Brandt was reportedly murdered rather than drowned, with the report possibly misleading.
threads.quote: Guess what? According to the paper, it turns out he didn't drown after all, but was in fact murdered and thrown into the lake.

threads.claim: Boxes near Benoit's house hold stolen or recently moved goods, with a receipt and a strong smell of fish.
threads.quote: Where'd this horrible stench come from, then? Did some new stuff get dumped here?

threads.claim: Appearances may deceive, and what people see or hear may not be real or true.
threads.quote: sometimes, what you see or hear is neither real nor true.

threads.claim: Benoit's secret note says he is held captive and asks for rescue, suggesting a signal plan.
threads.quote: Their plan was revealed, and now they've got me trapped in my own home, hoping to coerce me into submission!

threads.claim: A mysterious voice recites a rhyme about a cradle and a breaking stem, hinting at an unseen rescuer.
threads.quote: ???: When the flow combs...

threads.claim: Benoit claims to know where Autumn's child is but refuses to reveal it.
threads.quote: Benoit Leroy: Well, I do happen to know where she is, hehe! But I won't tell you, nope! I'll never tell!

threads.claim: Autumn learns her child was adopted and is shaken that she was not told.
threads.quote: Autumn: So she's been adopted... Why didn't you tell me?

threads.claim: Molli looks like Autumn and shares her lavender eyes, raising the possibility that Molli is Autumn's child.
threads.quote: Autumn: ...You look just like her. And you even have lavender eyes...

threads.claim: Molli notes that Autumn has the same lavender eyes, reinforcing the resemblance.
threads.quote: Molli: The lady really liked me, and she has the same eyes as I do! Our eyes are both lavender.

threads.claim: Athos hints that Benoit has gone somewhere he belongs, implying a violent or fatal end.
threads.quote: Athos: I mean to say, he has gone to where he belongs.

threads.claim: Molli reports a rumor that Benoit fell while climbing a mountain, leaving his fate unclear.
threads.quote: Molli: The Steambird said that Mr. Leroy fell from a very high place while climbing a mountain, and went tumbling down.

threads.claim: Athos's friends from the Fortress of Meropide are hunting Benoit and want to meet him.
threads.quote: Athos: I met quite a few friends in the Fortress of Meropide, and before this trip to the Court of Fontaine, many of them expressed a keen interest in meeting you.

threads.claim: The Rainbow Rose given to the Traveler carries a warning not to change one's mind.
threads.quote: Athos: Right now, it symbolizes a warning. A warning not to change your mind about what you just said.

threads.claim: Autumn wavers between taking revenge on Benoit and letting him go.
threads.quote: Autumn: I... I don't know... I...

threads.quote: Your journey's also changed many people's fates.

threads.claim: Outcomes of choices cannot be known until the time comes, and fate is fickle.
threads.quote: Nobody can say what choices lead to what outcomes until the time comes.

threads.claim: The Traveler has been to Springvale, which hints at the Traveler's past travels.
threads.quote: It's the same, I've been there.

introduced.name: Joel
introduced.how: a child searching for his missing father, who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Ah, I... Hello... I—I can't find my daddy...

introduced.name: Joserf
introduced.how: Joel's father, who went missing on Dragonspine
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce Joserf. He's Joel's father.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Uncle Cyrus, who leads the search and sends Joel news
introduced.quote: Ah, if it isn't the Traveler! Joel sent you, I'll wager.

introduced.name: Reckless Pallad
introduced.how: a search adventurer who found a silhouette on a cliff during a blizzard
introduced.quote: I'm very sure, Mr. Cyrus.

introduced.name: The Boar Princess
introduced.how: a book series whose Volume 6 was found in the note-writer's backpack
introduced.quote: in my backpack. Joel must've sneaked it in there.

introduced.name: Summit cave
introduced.how: a cave near the summit where a man was trapped by a snowstorm and collapsing rock
introduced.quote: I barely had enough time to duck into this cave.

introduced.name: Fox feeding bowl
introduced.how: a bowl near the summit cave for feeding the foxes that kept a trapped man company
introduced.quote: please put some food into that feeding bowl for those foxes.

introduced.name: Joserf's memory loss
introduced.how: Joserf lost his memory, possibly from head trauma, and remembers nothing of who he is
introduced.quote: I'm sorry, I have no recollection.

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: If you're going up Dragonspine, could you help me look for Daddy?

assumed.name: Knight of Favonius
assumed.quote: But I didn't find Daddy here, either. That Knight of Favonius over there said that he'd headed off for the mountain's summit...

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Back to the Guild we go!

threads.claim: Joel's father vanished while climbing Dragonspine, and his fate is unknown.
threads.quote: Where has Daddy gone...

threads.claim: Joserf is found alive at the camp and reunited with Joel.
threads.quote: Daddy's right here, Joel. Daddy's right here.

threads.claim: Joserf has lost his memory, and the cause of this is uncertain.
threads.quote: Maybe it's because of the head trauma? I'm not sure...

threads.claim: A blurred silhouette on a cliff hints at a lost person who may be Joserf.
threads.quote: I saw a blurred silhouette on a cliff.

threads.claim: The silhouette turns out to be Joserf, who had tumbled down the mountain.
threads.quote: I didn't realize that this was the person I was looking for at first.

threads.claim: The cave entrance collapsed for an unexplained reason, trapping the note-writer.
threads.quote: I don't know why, either, but the rocks above the cave collapsed suddenly

threads.claim: The foxes that kept the trapped adventurer company near the summit cave are tied to a feeding bowl the player is asked to fill.
threads.quote: please put some food into that feeding bowl for those foxes.

threads.claim: The Boar Princess book and the foxes may be linked to Joserf's lost memories, which he cannot recall.
threads.quote: The Boar Princess, feeding the foxes...?

threads.claim: Joserf's promise to take Joel to see the snow is a motive that drives his survival and return.
threads.quote: I promised Joel that I'd take him to see the snow.

introduced.name: The Korolevskiy Theater
introduced.how: a lively arts theater that is the site of the midnight ghost rumors
introduced.quote: The Korolevskiy Theater sure is lively... It's a real bastion of the arts.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a dancer who secretly uses a private lounge inside the theater
introduced.quote: Yes, this area belongs to me. Doesn't it look the part?

introduced.name: Music box
introduced.how: a swan-shaped music box, a childhood birthday gift from Odette's mother, that is the source of the eerie sound
introduced.quote: It's a music box. It was a birthday gift from my mother when I was little.

introduced.name: Theater ghost rumor
introduced.how: rumor that a ghost plays eerie music and dances in the theater at midnight
introduced.quote: The moment it strikes midnight, eerie music echoes from the theater.

assumed.name: Mistilteinn
