assumed.quote: (If the player has not completed Mistilteinn)

assumed.name: Ley Line Disorder
assumed.quote: hasn't the Ley Line Disorder here already been resolved?

assumed.name: Vodyanitsa
assumed.quote: Vodyanitsa said fans would do anything for a peek behind the scenes.

assumed.name: Traveler's reputation for helpfulness
assumed.quote: That's what they say about you.

threads.claim: A ghost haunts the Korolevskiy Theater at midnight, with eerie music and a dancing shadow that people claim to have seen.
threads.quote: The moment it strikes midnight, eerie music echoes from the theater.

threads.claim: The theater ghost turns out to be a broken music box that Odette has been secretly trying to repair.
threads.quote: This is the true form of said

threads.claim: The Ley Line Disorder at the theater was supposedly already resolved, which makes the ghost rumors puzzling.
threads.quote: hasn't the Ley Line Disorder here already been resolved?

threads.claim: Odette has drifted apart from her mother and hopes repairing the music box might help restore their relationship.
threads.quote: might I be able to restore a relationship I wore away with my own hands?

introduced.name: Terminal
introduced.how: an ancient screen that answers the Traveler and runs self-diagnostics for the storage array
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm... that screen's still lit up over there, isn't it?

introduced.name: Ia-Ilimmu Storage Array
introduced.how: an ancient storage facility used to regulate the Engraving and hold research resources
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Ia-Ilimmu Storage Array.

introduced.name: Engraving
introduced.how: a system whose operation the storage array regulates
introduced.quote: This array is primarily used to regulate the operation of the Engraving and to store various research resources.

introduced.name: Secret Source Dragon Idol
introduced.how: a giant dragon idol that the Traveler can climb and that is tied to the Terminal's controls
introduced.quote: (A Secret Source Dragon Idol appears)

assumed.name: Nin-Kiggia
assumed.quote: Please contact Nin-Kiggia for maintenance.

assumed.name: Xiuhcoatl
assumed.quote: Welcome back, Master of Flame and Wisdom, Your Majesty Xiuhcoatl.

assumed.name: Natlantea
assumed.quote: Welcome back, The Sovereign Ruler of Natlantea, Your Excellency Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk Ch'ule-L

assumed.name: Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk
assumed.quote: Your Excellency Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk Ch'ule-L.

assumed.name: Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon
assumed.quote: Your Excellency Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L.

assumed.name: Ancient Moon's Remnant
assumed.quote: (Raise the Ancient Moon's Remnant to level 5)

threads.claim: The Terminal cannot verify who the Traveler is, so the Traveler's true identity remains unknown.
threads.quote: The identification sequence is currently unable to verify the visitor.

threads.claim: The Traveler has visited this array before, and a long span of cycles has passed since that last visit.
threads.quote: Since your last visit, a total of cycles have elapsed.

threads.claim: The Traveler once held royal titles, including Sovereign Ruler of Natlantea and companion to Xiuhcoatl.
threads.quote: Welcome back, The Sovereign Ruler of Natlantea, Your Excellency Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk Ch'ule-L

threads.claim: The array's central module is damaged or missing, causing critical component failure and service anomalies.
threads.quote: Central module damaged or missing.

threads.claim: The array's primary energy system is disconnected and needs either Nin-Kiggia's help or an auxiliary power source.
threads.quote: Primary energy system not connected. Please contact Nin-Kiggia for assistance, or provide an auxiliary power source.

threads.claim: A lockdown placed on the array is deactivated after the Traveler repairs the Terminal, though its cause stays unexplained.
threads.quote: Deactivating lockdown...

threads.claim: Once the self-diagnostic finishes, the lockdown is fully lifted and the array's services open to the Traveler.
threads.quote: Self-diagnostic complete. Lockdown lifted.

threads.claim: The Secret Source Dragon Idol appears to be the thing controlled from the Terminal screen, and it needs manual recalibration.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Is this the thing we were controlling on the screen?

introduced.name: Data Storage Cassette
introduced.how: a device for recording data, which the Fatui want retrieved from three surface sites
introduced.quote: What's this? It looks like something to record data with...

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: an energy-harnessing mechanism that powers the barrier generator
introduced.quote: Kuuvahki energy-harnessing mechanism successfully established. The feasibility of high-density energy barrier generation has been experimentally verified.

introduced.name: barrier generator
introduced.how: a device that produces protective energy barriers in various shapes, under secret experiment
introduced.quote: To test the stability of the new barrier generator when generating protective barriers in various settings.

introduced.name: Design Bureau
introduced.how: a military facility with restricted zones and classified projects, now on high alert
introduced.quote: Due to the recent increase in suspicious activities around the Design Bureau, Command has decided to raise the alert level effective immediately

introduced.name: underground lab
introduced.how: a secret Fatui research lab deep underground, with three experiment sites on the surface
introduced.quote: It looks like they really were doing experiments here, but this isn't the only place. There are three more sites up on the surface.

introduced.name: Kholodov
introduced.how: a Fatui officer who confronts the travelers as criminals in the lab
introduced.quote: Kholodov: Let's see which filthy rat has snuck in this time... You!? You're the criminals who ruined the experiment site! And now you dare come here!?

introduced.name: Weasel Thief
introduced.how: a thieving creature that snatches Mora, here a rare white one
introduced.quote: Paimon: ...Wow! Is that a white Weasel Thief? Paimon's never seen one that white before!

introduced.name: landcruiser accident
introduced.how: an experiment was moved and a Landcruiser was damaged in an operational error, causing chaos
introduced.quote: The experiment was relocated to a different site, but a Landcruiser became damaged due to an operational error. Chaos ensued.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: What are the Fatui doing, placing these things so deep underground?

assumed.name: Cutting Edge All-Purpose Storm Landcruiser
assumed.quote: (After defeating the Cutting Edge All-Purpose Storm Landcruiser)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: P—Paimon's Mora! Stop right there, you thief!

assumed.name: Nod-Krai Hot Dog
assumed.quote: Otherwise, it'll sit in Paimon's head like having a belly full of Nod-Krai Hot Dogs that just won't go down!

assumed.name: Helka
assumed.quote: Maisie: I wish we could keep it. That way, when Helka comes back, we can show her a rare Weasel Thief!

assumed.name: Katya
assumed.quote: Jurva: Okay, okay, but what should we do with it...? Let's figure that out with Katya later.

assumed.name: Linnea
assumed.quote: Jurva: Maybe it's a rare species? Linnea might know.

threads.claim: The Fatui are running secret experiments with kuuvahki deep underground, and their purpose is unknown.
threads.quote: Traveler: There must be an evil experiment going on inside...

threads.claim: Kuuvahki is an energy source that powers barrier generators, and its nature is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: So many jars! And inside them... could it be kuuvahki?

threads.claim: Prolonged barrier generator use may cause overheating and energy leakage, with long-term risks still uncertain.
threads.quote: Prolonged, high-intensity generator operation can cause overheating and material fatigue.

threads.claim: A highly classified project at the Design Bureau is closed to most staff and its purpose is hidden.
threads.quote: That project is highly classified, with access granted to only a select few.

threads.claim: The Data Storage Cassettes hold data the Fatui were trying to retrieve from the surface sites.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Wait a minute, was that stuff we picked up earlier the data the Fatui were trying to retrieve?

threads.claim: The results of the Fatui experiments remain unseen, leaving what they discovered an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ugh, all that and we still didn't get to see the results...

threads.claim: A rare white Weasel Thief steals from the travelers and its unusual color is unexplained.
threads.quote: Maisie: I've never seen a Weasel Thief this white before. Do you think it might be ill...?

introduced.name: Book of Revealing
introduced.how: a book whose pages open into a mind-world when the reader focuses on them
introduced.quote: But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.

introduced.name: Meditation
introduced.how: the practice of focusing that lets the Traveler enter the Book of Revealing's world
introduced.quote: Maybe she's in that mysterious place again! Should we start meditating?

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: a village where Melusines live, where Canotila wants to live
introduced.quote: I want to live with everyone in Merusea Village.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: a people to which Canotila belongs, with other Melusines living in Merusea Village
introduced.quote: I even tried to get help from the other Melusines, but no one knew what to do...

introduced.name: Canotila
introduced.how: a Melusine girl who wandered into the Book's world and needed rescuing
introduced.quote: Canotila: Huh? ... Who are you? I thought no one could get in here besides me.

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: an old companion of the Traveler, stuck behind a barrier in the book's world
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: I remember now. Yes, we escaped from the prison under the sea with her — a good thing, too.

introduced.name: Rescue from the undersea prison
introduced.how: the Traveler and Caterpillar once freed Lanoire from a prison under the sea
introduced.quote: Yes, we escaped from the prison under the sea with her — a good thing, too.

introduced.name: Puppy
introduced.how: a dog-like being who is only a memory of a friend left in the Book's world
introduced.quote: Puppy: But those are their stories and not mine. I'm just a memory that they have of their friend.

introduced.name: Looking Glass
introduced.how: a painting-like mirror that lets people meditate similarly to the Book of Revealing
introduced.quote: I'm trying to find clues to the Looking Glass. It looks like a painting, and lets people meditate in a similar manner to the Book of Revealing.

introduced.name: Memories as books
introduced.how: memories can be converted into a book and the book's contents written back into memories
introduced.quote: Since memories can be made into a book, if we reverse that logic, the contents of the book can also be written directly into memories...

introduced.name: Time inside the book
introduced.how: time inside the Book's world passes far more slowly than outside, as Paimon sees only a blink
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm, just the blink of an eye.

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
assumed.quote: Are you a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo?

assumed.name: Guillotin
assumed.quote: Or... Are you one of Guillotin's people?

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz
assumed.quote: Traveler: Defeating Narzissenkreuz?

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Traveler: Rescuing Lanoire?

assumed.name: Serene
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Lie) Serene sent me to find you.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: She didn't go become a guard in the Court of Fontaine, did she?

assumed.name: Golden butterfly
assumed.quote: Ah, The golden butterfly. As shiny as the sun itself...

assumed.name: Tower of Gestalt
assumed.quote: About the four orthants and the painting in the Tower of Gestalt...

threads.claim: Canotila has vanished into the Book of Revealing's world and her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: Canotila doesn't seem to be here. Maybe she's in that mysterious place again! Should we start meditating?

threads.claim: Canotila is brought back out of the Book's world and returned to the outside.
threads.quote: Paimon: Alright! Our little troublemaker's back! Canotila, you made really worried, you know?

threads.claim: The world inside the Book of Revealing may be more dangerous than the Traveler expected.
threads.quote: Traveler: It may be more dangerous than we imagined.

threads.claim: Caterpillar warns that the place is very dangerous and that people who went there lost their minds.
threads.quote: This place is very dangerous... You should turn around now.

threads.claim: Caterpillar came to the book's world looking for something important and cannot recall what it is.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: I came here to look for something important. Do you know what it is I'm looking for?

threads.claim: The Traveler and Caterpillar had a shared past involving rescuing Lanoire.
threads.quote: Traveler: Rescuing Lanoire?

threads.claim: Caterpillar confirms they escaped an undersea prison with Lanoire, a child who should live under the sun.
threads.quote: Yes, we escaped from the prison under the sea with her — a good thing, too.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz is an entity or group tied to the Traveler's past and to Guillotin's people.
threads.quote: Are you a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo?

threads.claim: A golden butterfly is linked to light and the sun, and its significance is left open.
threads.quote: Ah, The golden butterfly. As shiny as the sun itself...

threads.claim: Canotila says the golden butterfly has returned, implying it is part of the book world's changes.
threads.quote: Um, right! The golden butterfly has returned. I need to go and see it! Goodbye!

threads.claim: Puppy describes the butterfly becoming a cocoon and a larva that returns to the void, revealing its fate.
threads.quote: The butterfly became a cocoon, and a larva emerged from the cocoon.

threads.claim: Puppy asks what it appears to be in the Traveler's eyes, hinting that its true nature is unclear.
threads.quote: Puppy: ...Can you understand what I'm saying? I see. Let me ask you... What am I in your eyes?

threads.claim: Puppy reveals it is only a memory of a friend, a shadow left behind by the masters of the imaginary world.
threads.quote: Puppy: But those are their stories and not mine. I'm just a memory that they have of their friend.

threads.claim: Canotila is searching for clues to the Looking Glass, a painting-like mirror that allows meditation.
threads.quote: I'm trying to find clues to the Looking Glass. It looks like a painting, and lets people meditate in a similar manner to the Book of Revealing.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests the Looking Glass's painting may be in the Tower of Gestalt, linking it to the four orthants.
threads.quote: Traveler: About the four orthants and the painting in the Tower of Gestalt...

threads.claim: Creating a book from memories requires viewing emotions as precious, and its effects on readers are uncertain.
threads.quote: The creator of this book must've only been able to do this because they viewed the emotions in their memories as the most precious thing in the world.

threads.claim: The world inside gets darker and its garden, palace and trees vanish as the monster approaches.
threads.quote: The world got a little darker whenever the monster came near.

threads.claim: Puppy explains the world was collapsing because an outsider who should not be there shook its foundations.
threads.quote: This world was going to disintegrate, because someone who shouldn't be here arrived, shaking the foundations of this world.

threads.claim: Time inside the Book passes differently, as the Traveler wonders how long they were gone.
threads.quote: Traveler: If it was just a blink of an eye to you...

threads.claim: Canotila reports that the wait outside felt endless, confirming time moved more slowly for her.
threads.quote: Canotila: Do you have any idea how long you were inside? It felt like the waiting would never end...

introduced.name: Talochard
introduced.how: Agent from the Marechaussee Phantom investigating a case at The Steambird, who is actually an evidence clerk and not an official investigator
introduced.quote: I'm Agent Talochard from the Marechaussee Phantom, investigating a case at The Steambird.

introduced.name: Jenck
introduced.how: Editor at The Steambird who is accused of driving away a missing employee
introduced.quote: And what about your attitude, Agent Talochard?

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: A newspaper that publishes news and fantastical stories, with a steambird mascot
introduced.quote: We also publish fantastical stories, you see...

introduced.name: Sir Arthur
introduced.how: A mechanical steambird mascot of The Steambird newspaper that stands by the door and announces news; it has gone missing
introduced.quote: Sir Arthur is the steambird that gives The Steambird its name. Our symbol, our mascot.

introduced.name: Euphrasie
introduced.how: Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird who takes charge of recovering Sir Arthur
introduced.quote: Ah, Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie, Agent Curve, you've returned.

introduced.name: Curve
introduced.how: A lie-detecting investigations drone belonging to the Marechaussee Phantom, remotely operated from the office, that introduces itself as Talochard's assistant
introduced.quote: Agent Curve is a special investigations drone belonging to the Marechaussee Phantom.

introduced.name: Mosso Protocols
introduced.how: Rules in Curve's core programming that force it to answer questions with complete honesty
introduced.quote: the Mosso Protocols require me to answer all of Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie's questions honestly.

introduced.name: Dr. Mosso
introduced.how: Curve's creator, a top scientist who added the honesty rules and died 30 years ago
introduced.quote: My great creator, Dr. Mosso, added some rules to my core programming to ensure the accuracy of my lie detection.

introduced.name: Rocher
introduced.how: A drunken vagrant who used to be respectable and is suspected of the theft; he hid in a chest
introduced.quote: You are right, I am Rocher.

introduced.name: Lombroso
introduced.how: A freed puppy with an excellent sense of smell who belongs to Rocher and helps track scents
introduced.quote: Lombroso has an excellent sense of smell.

introduced.name: Kevin
introduced.how: A problem child who visits Sir Arthur and is Madeleine's son
introduced.quote: Madeleine: Oh, I sewed that on for Kevin just recently.

introduced.name: Madeleine
introduced.how: Kevin's mother, whose family button was found at the scene
introduced.quote: Oh, I sewed that on for Kevin just recently.

introduced.name: Baulande
introduced.how: Kevin's absent father, a mechanical engineer as Madeleine says, whom Kevin calls a criminal
introduced.quote: Baulande! That's his name. You should arrest him too!

introduced.name: Intrepid Valberry
introduced.how: A debt collector hunting Rocher for unpaid debts
introduced.quote: Men! Rocher has to be hiding here somewhere. He owes, so he has to pay! Find him for me!

introduced.name: Elegant Tableware Confrerie
introduced.how: A team of scam artists who conned Rocher and were exposed by The Steambird a month ago
introduced.quote: A month ago, The Steambird reported on a team of scammers, the Elegant Tableware Confrerie.

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: The place where Rocher once worked, through his wife's connections
introduced.quote: But I used to work at the Palais Mermonia...

introduced.name: Waterstained Dinner Knife
introduced.how: A rusting high-end table knife recovered from the sea that may match the notch on the pedestal
introduced.quote: A waterstained dinner knife. It looks like high-end silverware, but for some reason, it shows signs of rusting.

introduced.name: Notch on the Pedestal
introduced.how: A notch in Sir Arthur's empty pedestal left by a short knife or dagger
introduced.quote: A notch left behind by a sharp weapon, as though cut by a short knife or dagger.

introduced.name: Talochard's Investigation Notes
introduced.how: The Case Record notebook where clues and testimonies are stored for review
introduced.quote: Let's record this in our investigation notes first!

introduced.name: Dr. Mosso's death and conviction
introduced.how: Dr. Mosso died in a duel 30 years ago while trying to prove his innocence after a court found him guilty
introduced.quote: Relevant information retrieved: Dr. Mosso died in a duel attempting to prove his innocence, after a court found him guilty.

introduced.name: Talochard
introduced.how: Agent of the Marechaussee Phantom who cooks, is overconfident, and leads the investigation
introduced.quote: Talochard: Morning! Morning!

introduced.name: Curve
introduced.how: Mechanical companion whose core is aging and who records lies through a lie-learning module
introduced.quote: "Curve": Moisture has seeped into the motherboard. Motherboard temperature: Below warning line. Core functionality: 19%.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: Investigative agency that Talochard works for and that takes on cases like the theft
introduced.quote: Talochard: Hmph! The Marechaussee Phantom is more capable than you think!

introduced.name: Poissonchant Pie
introduced.how: Talochard's unappetizing special pie, which can be used as a sabotage item
introduced.quote: Talochard: That's my special Poissonchant Pie. It's even tastier than the usual recipe.

introduced.name: Waterstained Dinner Knife
introduced.how: Clue knife traced to the Elegant Tableware Confrerie, once exposed by The Steambird
introduced.quote: Based on Agent Talochard's analysis, this item belongs to the "Elegant Tableware Confrerie," an association that was once exposed by The Steambird as a gang of swindlers.

introduced.name: Old Clockwork Locket
introduced.how: Antique locket holding a yellowed portrait of a girl that Curve cannot identify
introduced.quote: Old Clockwork Locket: (An archaic clockwork locket. It looks quite old.)

introduced.name: Diary of a Valiant Struggle
introduced.how: Diary in which Director 42 admits to a plan against The Steambird
introduced.quote: Knife those stupid birds straight through! This should be a good enough warning for them?

introduced.name: Intrepid Valberry
introduced.how: Self-described Director 42 of a criminal gang who later turns on his boss
introduced.quote: Intrepid Valberry: I'm up next! I'm Intrepid Valberry! Director 42 of a criminal gang!

introduced.name: Rocher
introduced.how: Debtor who was kicked out by his wife and was swindled by the Confrerie
introduced.quote: Rocher: I'm Rocher, a middle-aged man who was kicked out by his wife.

introduced.name: Kevin
introduced.how: Problem child who went to the paper's office to steal Sir Arthur
introduced.quote: Kevin: It's finally Paimon's turn! I'm Kevin, a problem child!

introduced.name: Baulard
introduced.how: Self-described peripheral intelligence officer who found the threatening letter at the scene
introduced.quote: Baulard: I'm Baulard, a peripheral intelligence officer. What "peripheral" means is that I'm not very important.

introduced.name: Mosso Lombroso
introduced.how: Scientist who built Curve and a lie detector, convicted and dead after a duel
introduced.quote: Talochard: Dr. Mosso's true goal was to create a machine that would gradually become human by understanding lies and humanity. That's Curve's ultimate form!

introduced.name: Jenck
introduced.how: Editor at The Steambird who once complained that Talochard sounded like a crow
introduced.quote: Baulard: Correct. That's why I contacted one of their editors, Jenck, hoping to get the inside scoop.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: Newspaper that publicized the lie detector and exposed the Confrerie and Dr. Mosso
introduced.quote: Talochard: Well, not long after the existence of Dr. Mosso's lie detector was made public, The Steambird published several articles on it and quickly drew the public's attention.

introduced.name: Euphrasie
introduced.how: Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird, named as the one who asked the Marechaussee for help
introduced.quote: Talochard: Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie was right to ask for your help. I should just take off this uniform and leave.

introduced.name: Hotel Debord
introduced.how: Hotel where Curve and Dr. Mosso held their first public test thirty years ago
introduced.quote: "Curve": Thirty years ago, Dr. Mosso and I performed our first public test in Hotel Debord.

introduced.name: Fleuve Cendre
introduced.how: Crowded district where the party searches for the Fatui-dressed man
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, we're at the Fleuve Cendre now. Now, where to begin our search?

introduced.name: Mosso Protocols
introduced.how: Rules that stop Curve from lying, which Curve must overcome to learn humanity
introduced.quote: Talochard: So he created a no-lying protocol. If Curve learns to lie like humans one day...

introduced.name: lie-learning module
introduced.how: Part of Curve's core that studies human lies and can make him produce nonsense when enabled
introduced.quote: Talochard: It's the lie-learning module. It resides in Curve's core, and once it's enabled, it makes Curve spew a bunch of illogical nonsense...

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Legendary Fontainian scientist who built a thinking machine hundreds of years ago
introduced.quote: Talochard: Legends say that a Fontainian scientist called Alain Guillotin created an amazing thinking machine hundreds of years ago, and Dr. Mosso seemed to want to surpass that.

introduced.name: Melo Lombroso
introduced.how: Unnamed-looking woman who watches the party and then goes up to The Steambird
introduced.quote: (Unbeknownst to them, a woman — Melo Lombroso — glances in their direction before continuing up the stairs to The Steambird.)

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Research site that the Callas Line once served before service was suspended after an incident
introduced.quote: It used to travel to the Fontaine Research Institute, but service was suspended due to the incident.

introduced.name: Crow or Blackbird?
introduced.how: Anonymous sender of the threatening letter that claims to have taken Sir Arthur
introduced.quote: Baulard: Are you done? The one who signed it "Crow or Blackbird?" is the criminal you're looking for.

introduced.name: Mosso Lombroso
introduced.how: Dr. Mosso, a scientist whose lie detector work was secretly shaped to fail, is revealed as the real architect of the scandal
introduced.quote: Curve is my life's work, so I can't afford any more missteps.

introduced.name: "Curve"
introduced.how: Dr. Mosso's lie detector machine, named Curve, with a core and lie-learning module
introduced.quote: That's it. I'll name my lie detector 'Curve.'

introduced.name: Mosso scandal
introduced.how: Mosso's downfall 30 years ago was caused by articles Mosso himself initiated, not the paper
introduced.quote: But the truth is, those articles were not initiated by the paper, but by Dr. Mosso himself...

introduced.name: Mosso Protocols
introduced.how: Test protocols inside Curve's core that Mosso modified hundreds of times
introduced.quote: The Mosso Protocols within my core have been modified hundreds of times.

introduced.name: Dr. Mosso's research base
introduced.how: Mosso's hidden base, now found completely submerged underwater
introduced.quote: So the base is completely submerged! No wonder no one knew where it was.

introduced.name: Self-destruction system
introduced.how: A self-destruct mechanism built into the base's walls and cables
introduced.quote: 2. The self-destruction mechanism and cables are located within the walls.

introduced.name: Melo Lombroso
introduced.how: Dr. Mosso's granddaughter, who recently returned to the Court of Fontaine
introduced.quote: This is Dr. Mosso's granddaughter, Madame Melo Lombroso.

introduced.name: Rocher
introduced.how: Melo's estranged husband, who took her surname and sold her grandfather's jewelry to pay debts
introduced.quote: Actually, Melo Lombroso is my wife.

introduced.name: Baulande
introduced.how: Kevin's father and a Fatui agent working under the codename Baulard
introduced.quote: We only just found out that Baulard is a codename. He's actually Kevin's father, Mr. Baulande!

introduced.name: Madeleine
introduced.how: Kevin's mother, revealed to be a Fatui member
introduced.quote: Madame Madeleine and Kevin's father are both members of the Fatui.

introduced.name: Jenck
introduced.how: A Steambird editor who staged the threats, took Curve's materials, and plotted to take over the paper
introduced.quote: I've already made a deal with Baulard's supervisor — I find Dr. Mosso's inheritance for them, and they help me take over The Steambird.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: The newspaper at the center of the case, whose reputation is threatened
introduced.quote: To The Steambird.

introduced.name: Sir Arthur
introduced.how: The Steambird's mascot, a pelican
introduced.quote: A pelican.

introduced.name: Harbinger
introduced.how: Fatui Harbingers have a backer role in Jenck's scheme
introduced.quote: Plus, Baulard's supervisor serves a real VIP — a Harbinger, hehe...

introduced.name: Old Clockwork Locket
introduced.how: Melo's locket with a photo and a hidden map to the base
introduced.quote: Look, there's a line of text under the photo...

introduced.name: Duelists' Ring duel
introduced.how: Mosso planned to propose a duel in the Duelists' Ring after his conviction
introduced.quote: As soon as I am convicted, I shall propose a duel.

assumed.name: Melusine
assumed.quote: A Melusine from the Marechaussee Phantom...

assumed.name: Gardemek
assumed.quote: (Euphrasie and a Gardemek walk up)

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: By the Hydro Archon! As if a person of my standing would do such a thing.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I don't have any Mora. Not a single coin!

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: I didn't know Fontaine had such advanced technology.

assumed.name: The Maison
assumed.quote: Just don't tell the Maison that we're here on the sly...

assumed.name: Ancient Colors
assumed.quote: (If Ancient Colors has been completed)

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: How dare you! 'Fess up, or you'll be enjoying plenty of privacy in the Fortress of Meropide.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: So, is this Mosso guy some top scientist at the Fontaine Research Institute?

assumed.name: Robot dog who could swim
assumed.quote: You know what? We've already met a robot dog and he could swim!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Fatui? Them again?

assumed.name: Sir Arthur
assumed.quote: Talochard: Hey! Redhead! Hurry up and fess up! Where's Sir Arthur?

assumed.name: Seymour
assumed.quote: Paimon: (A thinking machine made by Alain Guillotin? Could that be... Seymour?)

assumed.name: Order of the Fruit
assumed.quote: After getting the boot from the Order of the Fruit, I was really down in the dumps.

assumed.name: Bulle Fruit
assumed.quote: Paimon: All this Bulle Fruit... Maybe they really like them? Could we try chucking some way far away to distract them?

assumed.name: Kevin
assumed.quote: Kevin! What are you doing here?

assumed.name: Euphrasie
assumed.quote: Euphrasie! We're here!

assumed.name: Talochard
assumed.quote: Curve, let's go!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Uh oh, they're fighting the Fatui! We've gotta go help out!

assumed.name: Marechaussee Phantom
assumed.quote: Agent Talochard, I know that the Marechaussee Phantom has a file on the case, but believe me, there are things that even you don't know.

assumed.name: Opera Epiclese
assumed.quote: Earlier this morning, Jenck was left in the Opera Epiclese, all trussed up...

assumed.name: Maison Gardiennage
assumed.quote: The Maison Gardiennage folks took him in.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: She only returned last night from her hometown to the Court of Fontaine

threads.claim: Sir Arthur, the steambird mascot, vanished overnight and its thief is unknown.
threads.quote: Sir Arthur disappeared last night, so there should still be clues to be found!

threads.claim: Rocher denies stealing Sir Arthur and says he slept at the entrance and woke to find it gone.
threads.quote: I slept by The Steambird's entrance last night, that's all.

threads.claim: Curve is a lie detector bound by rules that force it to answer every question honestly.
threads.quote: the Mosso Protocols require me to answer all of Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie's questions honestly.

threads.claim: The honesty rules mean Curve must answer any question it is asked, which Talochard exploits to limit what it reveals.
threads.quote: Those rules require me to answer all questions with complete accuracy and honesty.

threads.claim: Dr. Mosso died 30 years ago in a duel after being convicted, and the reason for his conviction is still unknown.
threads.quote: Relevant information retrieved: Dr. Mosso died in a duel attempting to prove his innocence, after a court found him guilty.

threads.claim: Curve has been held as evidence for a 30-year-old case, and that case's true nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: Curve is a vital piece of evidence in a case dating back 30 years.

threads.claim: Kevin says he found a knife stuck in Sir Arthur's pedestal, which may be the weapon behind the notch.
threads.quote: He said he'd found it stuck in the steambird's pedestal.

threads.claim: The waterstained knife may match the pedestal notch, but it is an ordinary table knife with no clear owner.
threads.quote: Huh, this could match up with the notch on the pedestal.

threads.claim: The knife is recovered from the sea where Kevin threw it, confirming the pedestal link.
threads.quote: Nice! This has gotta be the knife, right? Let's take it to the others.

threads.claim: The Elegant Tableware Confrerie is a team of scam artists who conned Rocher and may be tied to the case.
threads.quote: A month ago, The Steambird reported on a team of scammers, the Elegant Tableware Confrerie.

threads.claim: Talochard suspects the Elegant Tableware Confrerie is responsible for Sir Arthur's disappearance, without proof.
threads.quote: Hah! They must be responsible!

threads.claim: Talochard suggests humans lie constantly, a theme of deception that runs through the characters.
threads.quote: For example, you still don't know that humans lie constantly. Your mother, your father, even you.

threads.claim: Kevin says his mother is a practiced liar, which supports the theme of deception within families.
threads.quote: My mother's a very experienced liar. She practices on me every day, you see, so you wouldn't be able to tell.

threads.claim: Madeleine's claim that Baulande is a posted mechanical engineer is disputed by Kevin, who calls it a lie.
threads.quote: Haha. I can explain that. She was lying. Pop doesn't know a spring from a spanner.

threads.claim: Sir Arthur speaks, but Kevin says its speech is programmed in advance.
threads.quote: You haven't realized, I guess, that everything it says is programmed in advance.

threads.claim: A small figure was seen running away from The Steambird the night Sir Arthur vanished.
threads.quote: Someone very small, running away... That's suspicious, right?

threads.claim: Curve's core functionality is at 20 percent, which limits what it can do, such as diving.
threads.quote: Motherboard temperature: Below warning line. Core functionality: 20%.

threads.claim: Dr. Mosso was accused of falsifying lie-detector results and died in a duel before the truth was settled.
threads.quote: Talochard: The doctor refused to admit it of course, and so he died defending himself in a duel.

threads.claim: Talochard suspects Dr. Mosso was wrongly accused while Curve is genuinely reliable.
threads.quote: Talochard: Well, I think Curve is the real deal... and Dr. Mosso was wrongly accused...

threads.claim: Whether The Steambird's evidence against Dr. Mosso was falsified or simply mistaken is an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Then was the evidence presented by the paper falsified? Or did they make a mistake?

threads.claim: The Mosso Protocols may have been secretly modified, leaving a hidden trap.
threads.quote: "Curve": "...It must be noted that as the Mosso Protocols are man-made, there is a possibility of them being modified. This may prove to be a well-concealed trap..."

threads.claim: The threat letter's sender is tied to Dr. Mosso's death thirty years ago and wants revenge on The Steambird.
threads.quote: Mosso's death 30 years ago is still on my mind.

threads.claim: A woman named Melo Lombroso is watching the investigation and may be connected to the Lombroso name.
threads.quote: (Unbeknownst to them, a woman — Melo Lombroso — glances in their direction before continuing up the stairs to The Steambird.)

threads.claim: Curve's core is aging rapidly and he will enter hibernation, so he may stop moving forever.
threads.quote: his core is aging rapidly, so he will go into hibernation mode soon...

threads.claim: Curve's lie-learning module suggests that lies can shape reality and may help him become human.
threads.quote: "Curve": ...But such lies have a chance to mold reality.

threads.claim: Dr. Mosso wanted to surpass Alain Guillotin's legendary thinking machine.
threads.quote: Talochard: Legends say that a Fontainian scientist called Alain Guillotin created an amazing thinking machine hundreds of years ago, and Dr. Mosso seemed to want to surpass that.

threads.claim: Intrepid Valberry says someone took Sir Arthur before he arrived, so the true thief is still unknown.
threads.quote: "Intrepid Valberry": I know it's strange, but someone got to it before me. So I just stuck the knife there as a warning.

threads.claim: Curve's analysis clears Valberry, which narrows the suspects and leaves the thief unidentified.
threads.quote: "Curve": Based on my analysis of Mr. Valberry's data, he's telling the truth.

threads.claim: A man dressed as a Fatui was also trying to sneak into The Steambird's office, linking the Fatui to the theft.
threads.quote: "Intrepid Valberry": But wouldn't you know, I ran into someone there who was also trying to find a way to sneak into the paper.

threads.claim: Mosso's death 30 years ago still haunts the case and the paper's reputation.
threads.quote: Mosso's death 30 years ago is still on my mind.

threads.claim: Mosso himself initiated the articles that ruined him, and the paper was not the originator.
threads.quote: But the truth is, those articles were not initiated by the paper, but by Dr. Mosso himself...

threads.claim: The threat letters are signed with a question, Crow or Blackbird?, whose meaning is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Talochard: Hmm. Then it would seem that "Crow or Blackbird?" is a question from her.

threads.claim: Mosso's hidden clue points to the different ways lies can exist, a concept left unexplained.
threads.quote: Relevant information retrieved: "The different ways in which lies can exist."

threads.claim: Curve's breakthrough and the reason Mosso falsified results remain unanswered.
threads.quote: The data on this question is unresolved. My lie-learning module cannot provide an answer.

threads.claim: Mosso believed a seed of life had sprouted within Curve, hinting at Curve's inner growth.
threads.quote: I believe that the seed of life has sprouted within him.

threads.claim: Mosso forged the evidence and took the blame himself to protect Curve from being destroyed.
threads.quote: Dr. Mosso didn't forge anything, other than the "forged evidence," which he forged and gave to the newspaper, so he'd take all the heat.

threads.claim: Mosso's notes reveal a self-destruct mechanism built into the base's walls.
threads.quote: 2. The self-destruction mechanism and cables are located within the walls.

threads.claim: Jenck triggers the base's self-destruct, and Curve's claim that he could shut it down was a lie.
threads.quote: Ha, the self-destruction system. How perfect! It just takes a little time to get going...

threads.claim: Curve's blueprint and maintenance materials were torn out of the diary, so someone removed them.
threads.quote: Did someone take all the materials related to Curve!?

threads.claim: Jenck admits he took Dr. Mosso's materials and learned the self-destruct details from them.
threads.quote: I'm the one who took Dr. Mosso's materials, you know, so I learned all about the base's self-destruct system.

threads.claim: A Fatui Harbinger is backing Jenck's scheme, and its identity is hidden.
threads.quote: Plus, Baulard's supervisor serves a real VIP — a Harbinger, hehe...

threads.claim: The specific Harbinger behind Jenck remains unidentified, and the apology note hints at a backer.
threads.quote: Paimon remembers Jenck said that he had a deal with a Fatui Harbinger... but which one?

threads.claim: Jenck was found mentally broken and tongueless, with an apology note from an unknown backer.
threads.quote: The Maison Gardiennage folks took him in. When they examined him, they found that his tongue was missing...

threads.claim: The puppy answers to both Baulande and Lombroso, leaving its true owner and identity ambiguous.
threads.quote: Wait, so... are you Baulande or Lombroso?

threads.claim: The hidden research base is finally located underwater, though its key materials are gone.
threads.quote: So the base is completely submerged! No wonder no one knew where it was.

introduced.name: Trapeznikov
introduced.how: introduces himself as Alyosha's friend and a Shadow Realm tech expert
introduced.quote: Hey there. I'm Trapeznikov, a friend of Alyosha's.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: the pedestal's technology comes from the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: Well, for starters, I can definitely confirm that it's Shadow Realm technology.

introduced.name: Pedestal
introduced.how: a device for browsing information on ancient technology, locked behind permissions
introduced.quote: Looks to me like some sort of device for browsing information. But you need the right access to unlock it...

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: a summonable device the Traveler uses to establish user permissions and unlock systems
introduced.quote: (The Traveler summons the Eye of Graeae)

introduced.name: Firearm Accessory Archive
introduced.how: an archive of technological creations opened with the Eye of Graeae, holding gun add-ons
introduced.quote: (Opens the Firearm Accessory Archive)

introduced.name: Shadow Realm Vault Access Card
introduced.how: the Traveler's access card activates the pedestal and opens barriers
introduced.quote: This access card of yours is really quite something, . It activated this pedestal, opens barriers...

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: a past ruler whose era the ruins' artifacts date back to, who ordered excavation of Shadow Realm tech
introduced.quote: Based on my recent observations, all the artifacts here date back to the Belyi Tsar's era.

introduced.name: Mysterious excavation organization
introduced.how: a group rumored to have been tasked by the Belyi Tsar with excavating Shadow Realm artifacts
introduced.quote: Rumor has it that during his reign, he tasked a mysterious organization with excavating technological artifacts from the Shadow Realm and putting them to use.

introduced.name: Ashamez's Thunder
introduced.how: a weapon whose blueprint is obtained from an alcove in the ruins
introduced.quote: (Obtain the blueprint for Ashamez's Thunder)

assumed.name: Alyosha
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Remember when I said I was gonna bring someone I know from the Rokot? This is the guy. He's a real expert on Shadow Realm tech.

assumed.name: The Rokot
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Remember when I said I was gonna bring someone I know from the Rokot? This is the guy. He's a real expert on Shadow Realm tech.

assumed.name: Alyosha's rifle
assumed.quote: Alyosha: Cool, that's a lot of stuff... Nothing compatible with my rifle, though, by the looks of it. Shame.

threads.claim: Ancient technology in the ruins is confirmed to be Shadow Realm technology, raising questions about its origin and use.
threads.quote: Well, for starters, I can definitely confirm that it's Shadow Realm technology.

threads.claim: The access card's symbols may be the key to unlocking the higher clearance needed for the pedestal.
threads.quote: I bet it involves the symbols on the card in some way...

threads.claim: A rumored mysterious organization under the Belyi Tsar excavated Shadow Realm artifacts for use.
threads.quote: Rumor has it that during his reign, he tasked a mysterious organization with excavating technological artifacts from the Shadow Realm and putting them to use.

threads.claim: The ruins appear to be connected to the Belyi Tsar-era excavation work, though the link is only suspected.
threads.quote: These ruins must have been connected to the excavation work.

threads.claim: The pedestal lets the Traveler look up information on the ancient technological creations, answering what it does.
threads.quote: Looks like we can use this pedestal to look up information on those technological creations.

introduced.name: Henri
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a grateful man buried in sand who will never forget his rescuers
introduced.quote: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you so much! You are my saviors! I, Henri, will never forget your kindness!

introduced.name: Hunter
introduced.how: One of the two suspicious 'walker duo' who claim to be out for a walk
introduced.quote: Hunter: ...Hello.

introduced.name: Turner
introduced.how: The other member of the 'walker duo', who also insists they are only taking a walk
introduced.quote: Turner: What a beautiful day.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Explained as the organization whose devices monitor and optimize water quality
introduced.quote: Turner: The machines you dismantled were devices used by the Fontaine Research Institute to monitor and optimize water quality.

introduced.name: Boss
introduced.how: Henri's employer, a rich-people middleman who orders the mysterious cores
introduced.quote: Dear Henri, how are things going?

introduced.name: Mysterious Cores
introduced.how: Learns the cores come from strange machines that glow, and must be collected from them
introduced.quote: Henri: Such strange machines have been deployed above ground and underwater. It's easy to spot such machines — they all produce a peculiar light around them.

introduced.name: Henri's past debt to the Boss
introduced.how: Learns Henri was poor and depressed until a man gave him a healthy drink and he decided to repay him by working for the Boss
introduced.quote: A long time ago, I lived a poor and miserable life. I was really depressed. Then, I met a guy who gave me a healthy drink that lifted my spirits.

introduced.name: Barrel
introduced.how: Learns the walker duo put a barrel on Henri's chest, which kept sand from crushing him
introduced.quote: The barrel that the walker duo put around Heneri's chest before he was buried.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Fontainians sure are a strange bunch!

assumed.name: Fountain of Lucine
assumed.quote: The Fountain of Lucine, for instance, is a pretty good place.

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Oh, Archons, no! We're alright. Of course we are!

threads.claim: Henri does not know how the strange machines harm the environment, leaving their true purpose unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmmm, but what do these machines do?

threads.claim: The machines are revealed to be Fontaine Research Institute devices that monitor and optimize water quality.
threads.quote: Turner: The machines you dismantled were devices used by the Fontaine Research Institute to monitor and optimize water quality.

threads.claim: The walker duo's claim to be ordinary walkers is shown to be a lie, hinting at who they really are.
threads.quote: Traveler: They are obviously not taking a walk.

threads.claim: Henri's employer, the Boss, appears to know the walker duo, hinting at a hidden connection.
threads.quote: Henri: Wait? You know each other? Great! So, this is how things went...

threads.claim: Henri refuses to explain why the walker duo wanted him to stop working, leaving the motive unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, why do they want you to stop working hard?

threads.claim: Henri admits he broke the machine, which explains why the walker duo buried him.
threads.quote: That's right. I was the one who broke the machine!

threads.claim: Henri frames his protest around freedom and labor, raising the theme of workers' rights.
threads.quote: Henri: Freedom! Ahhh, the sweet taste of freedom! Though not as satisfying as roast chicken is, freedom sure is sweet!

threads.claim: Henri's protest is made explicit as a demand for labor rights.
threads.quote: Henri: What do I want? Labor rights! When do I want them? Now!

introduced.name: Tabletop Troupe
introduced.how: a tabletop roleplay game where players invent characters, often letting teammates write their backstories
introduced.quote: First, everyone needs to decide what character they want to be.

introduced.name: Vampires
introduced.how: a race that survives by drinking human blood
introduced.quote: They're a race that survives by drinking human blood.

introduced.name: Vampire-human coexistence setting
introduced.how: the story's era and city where vampires and humans live side by side
introduced.quote: This is an era where vampires and humans coexist.

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia and Miss Clorinde invited Columbina and me to join them before.

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: Don't worry, there's no pressure.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Ah! Miss Columbina, Miss Sandrone! Thank you for taking the time to join our Tabletop Troupe!

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Then you can decide my character, Sandrone, and I'll think up the perfect role for you.

assumed.name: Where Does Her Name Rest?
assumed.quote: if Where Does Her Name Rest? has been completed.

threads.claim: Relations between humans and vampires are strained, and a murder has upset their fragile balance.
threads.quote: Now, a murder in the dead of night has completely shattered the delicate balance...

threads.claim: The character called The Damselette takes the name Columbina only after the Where Does Her Name Rest? quest is completed.
threads.quote: if Where Does Her Name Rest? has been completed.

threads.claim: The two characters' introductions suggest Columbina and Sandrone may end up as sworn enemies.
threads.quote: But based on these introductions, it seems like Miss Columbina and Miss Sandrone's characters should be sworn enemies!

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Iudex of Fontaine, a figure the player has a few questions for
introduced.quote: The Iudex of Fontaine. Hmm... There are a few things I'd like to ask him about.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: Lord-Artificer who was once Neuvillette's earnest young subordinate and became withdrawn after losing family and friends
introduced.quote: Ah, you must be talking about Mr. Alain Guillotin? The great Lord-Artificer.

introduced.name: Marionette
introduced.how: a Guillotin family member who makes a personal visit to Neuvillette to ask about Alain
introduced.quote: It's a pleasure to share stories of the past with one of his family.

introduced.name: Lord-Artificer
introduced.how: a title granted to Alain Guillotin in a ceremony
introduced.quote: At the ceremony where he was given the title of Lord-Artificer, all he said was the following:

introduced.name: Tower of Gestalt
introduced.how: a tower that Neuvillette and Alain ordered searched, connected to Alain's later loss
introduced.quote: When he and I signed the order to search the tower, he appeared... helpless.

introduced.name: losing family and friends
introduced.how: a loss that changed Alain dramatically and made him more taciturn
introduced.quote: He changed dramatically after losing his family and friends.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Does the Fatui have some official business that you wish to discuss?

assumed.name: Tower of Gestalt
assumed.quote: The Tower of Gestalt? And Elynas...

assumed.name: Elynas
assumed.quote: The Tower of Gestalt? And Elynas...

threads.claim: Alain's loss of family and friends is tied to the Tower of Gestalt, and he may have felt guilty about it.
threads.quote: It was the estrangement and alienation of the past that led to all that. He must have felt guilty, too.

threads.claim: Elynas is named alongside the Tower of Gestalt but its connection to the tragedy is left unexplained.
threads.quote: The Tower of Gestalt? And Elynas...

threads.claim: Alain's late-life speech about a quiet, humble life hints at a private epiphany behind his withdrawal.
threads.quote: I guess he wasn't just saying that to the crowd. He was saying it to himself.

threads.claim: Marionette refuses to follow or imitate Alain's ideals, asserting that she is her own person.
threads.quote: But I have no intention of either following his path or of imitating his ideals. I'm my own person.

threads.claim: Marionette, linked to the Fatui, makes a supposedly personal visit to probe Alain's past, and her real purpose is left open.
threads.quote: Not at all. This is a strictly personal visit.

introduced.name: Puca
introduced.how: a Melusine who collects rocks and whose sister runs a gemstone workshop
introduced.quote: Puca: Though I don't run a gemstone workshop like my sister and don't know much about appraisals or processing...

introduced.name: File:Item Strange Ore.png
introduced.how: a strange, pretty ore found in the local ore veins that looks valuable but is ordinary to locals
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's stuck to a really strange hunk of ore! Paimon's never seen a rock like this before...

introduced.name: Chesil
introduced.how: a gem merchant in the Court of Fontaine who buys ore and wants to make accessories from it
introduced.quote: Chesil: Welcome, welcome. Our store offers the most extensive selection of precious gems in the entire Court of Fontaine. We also have a wide range of craft goods on sale.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: a city where merchants trade gems and craft goods
introduced.quote: Chesil: Welcome, welcome. Our store offers the most extensive selection of precious gems in the entire Court of Fontaine. We also have a wide range of craft goods on sale.

introduced.name: Elynas
introduced.how: a region where the strange ore is found and where people rarely go prospecting
introduced.quote: Chesil: You got it from Elynas, huh? Yeah, people wouldn't normally go prospecting there...

introduced.name: Sluasi
introduced.how: a gemstone workshop owner, apparently Puca's sister
introduced.quote: Puca: If I were better at finding real gemstones, maybe I could open my own gemstone workshop, just like Sluasi!

introduced.name: File:Item Special Clock.png
introduced.how: a waterproof mechanical clock whose moving parts are made from the strange ore
introduced.quote: Chesil: Look at this new mechanical clock — it was made using that very ore.

introduced.name: Puca's token
introduced.how: a very important token Puca lost near the rock-picking spot
introduced.quote: Puca: I didn't run off, Paimon and ... I'm just looking for my token...

introduced.name: Puca's trap at the rock spot
introduced.how: Puca got trapped by monsters at the rock-collecting spot earlier and dropped her token there
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm... You might've dropped it when you got trapped there before.

assumed.name: Melusine
assumed.quote: Paimon: You do have a point! People don't normally go mining in a Melusine village, which means they've probably never seen anything like this... Great thinking, !

threads.claim: The strange ore is unique to this region, so its value and origin are an open question.
threads.quote: Puca: It's true that you won't find anything like this in other places, but they're everywhere in nearby ore veins!

threads.claim: The ore loses its glow when cut and polished, so it fails as a gemstone.
threads.quote: Chesil: And that's not even the worst part. Who could have imagined that after being cut and polished, the ore would lose all its original glow?

threads.claim: The ore's abrasion resistance makes it useful for clock components, a practical use found after the gem plan failed.
threads.quote: Chesil: I was surprised to discover that thanks to the ore's high resistance to abrasion, it is superior to materials traditionally used for the moving components of clocks.

threads.claim: The lost token is recovered from the marked spot and returned to Puca.
threads.quote: Puca: Ohh, yes, this is the one! Thank you so much!

threads.claim: Puca finds humans hard to understand, hinting at a gap between Melusines and outsiders.
threads.quote: Puca: Huh? People outside really thought that it was a precious gemstone? But I've even shown it to my sister before... Humans really are hard to understand...

threads.claim: Ordinary rocks turn out to have value and purpose, which lifts Puca's sense of herself.
threads.quote: Traveler: Everything has its value and purpose.

introduced.name: Masseira
introduced.how: Tadhla's father and elder hunter who asks the Traveler for help finding his Falcon
introduced.quote: Masseira: Ah, , esteemed Master of the Jinni. To what do I owe the pleasure?

introduced.name: Tadhla
introduced.how: Masseira's Falcon, a tall tanned hunter in danger who is captured by the Fatui
introduced.quote: Masseira: Haha, nothing serious. It's just my Falcon, Tadhla. I think she's in danger.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: a Jinni whose soul is split into fragments that the Traveler can recover
introduced.quote: Liloupar: It is my soul, my fragments... One is around here...

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: the desert tribe that Masseira and Tadhla belong to, led by elders
introduced.quote: Thus does Masseira the Hunter, elder of Tanit, warn you.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: enemy skirmishers who ambush and capture Tadhla in the cave
introduced.quote: Traveler: It's the "Fatui."

introduced.name: Jinni
introduced.how: spirits whose fragments can power places like the oasis
introduced.quote: Tadhla: This place is a habitat for flying serpents. Seems this oasis is powered by one of the Jinni's fragments and has become an ecosystem for them...

introduced.name: Falcon
introduced.how: a title for tribe hunters who are trained to track and hunt prey for their master
introduced.quote: Tadhla: I am a Falcon. I am only allowed to learn about my prey, not any other way around.

introduced.name: coming-of-age ceremony
introduced.how: a hunt that a young Falcon must complete to qualify for the tribe
introduced.quote: Masseira: Simply put, this is about Tadhla's coming-of-age ceremony. Please witness her growth for me.

introduced.name: Red Vulture
introduced.how: the first hunt target, a careful and wicked predator that collects shiny things
introduced.quote: Tadhla: There are three targets for this hunt: the Red Vulture, the Scorpion, and the Flying Serpent.

introduced.name: Scorpion
introduced.how: a dangerous night-active predator whose toxin can be lethal
introduced.quote: Tadhla: Scorpions are only active under the veil of night. There is still some time before the night falls.

introduced.name: Flying Serpent
introduced.how: the last hunt target, which lives in a cave ecosystem fed by a Jinni fragment
introduced.quote: Tadhla: This place is a habitat for flying serpents.

introduced.name: Fool's Gold
introduced.how: shiny commonplace alloys like brass and bronze that Red Vultures collect
introduced.quote: Tadhla: "Fool's Gold." Red Vultures love collecting shiny stuff.

assumed.name: Gurabad
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's... Gurabad. Again...

assumed.name: Babel
assumed.quote: Fatui Skirmisher No. 1: It's the guests of that tribe woman. Ugh! What is Babel up to?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: paying us a large sum of Mora, and treating us to a big meal

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Masseira, optional)

threads.claim: Liloupar's soul is split into fragments that the Traveler must find and recover.
threads.quote: Liloupar: It is my soul, my fragments... One is around here...

threads.claim: The Traveler recovers one of Liloupar's fragments and experiences a Jinni's memories.
threads.quote: (Obtain Liloupar's fragment)

threads.claim: The fall of Gurabad is hinted to be a larger catastrophe that Liloupar has only begun to reveal.
threads.quote: Liloupar: The fall of Gurabad... is just a prologue. I merely revealed what torments await.

threads.claim: Masseira's flight from the tribe suggests a larger conflict is coming for the Tanit.
threads.quote: This hunt is not yet over. This is just the beginning of the storm.

threads.claim: Masseira privately judges Tadhla's growth as too slow, hinting at hidden expectations.
threads.quote: Masseira: (...Tadhla... your growth is... too slow...)

threads.claim: Tadhla describes Masseira as her father and herself as his Falcon, complicating their bond.
threads.quote: Tadhla: He is my father. I am his "Falcon."

threads.claim: Tadhla's identity as a Falcon rather than a person is raised as a central conflict.
threads.quote: Tadhla: I am a Falcon. I am only allowed to learn about my prey, not any other way around.

threads.claim: Tadhla chooses to leave the Falcon life behind and become a friend instead.
threads.quote: Liloupar: This is the choice of her own will: To no longer live as a Falcon, but as a friend.

threads.claim: The chessboard at Safhe Shatranj is incomplete and requires missing chess pieces.
threads.quote: Liloupar: Good catch... What we lack are some "chess pieces."

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Assigns Jahoda commissions and acts as her boss
introduced.quote: Nefer: Hehe, in that case, you're the perfect candidate for this commission.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: A treasure hunter who takes commissions and investigates the ghost reports
introduced.quote: I don't believe in all that, so I came here to see what the deal is

introduced.name: Ilmari
introduced.how: A fisherman near the Atlas wreck who knows the local rumors
introduced.quote: I'm just a fisherman — what use would I be in a fight?

introduced.name: Atlas
introduced.how: A famous pirate ship that sank long ago near the Eye of Kratti
introduced.quote: the Atlas is plenty famous.

introduced.name: Lovisa
introduced.how: A Shieldmaiden-nicknamed enforcer aboard the Atlas who keeps crew in line
introduced.quote: Lovisa caught them red-handed

introduced.name: Grettir
introduced.how: A Lunatic-nicknamed Atlas captain who negotiated with a northern ship
introduced.quote: Grettir decided to draw us near and say hello.

introduced.name: Hark
introduced.how: The last surviving member of the Atlas's pirate crew, called Hark the Crackjaw
introduced.quote: One of those who made it back to shore was Hark, the Crackjaw.

introduced.name: Reed Miller's Great Treasure
introduced.how: A treasure said to be reachable through a token from the Atlas
introduced.quote: the most valuable treasure on it was a token that could lead someone to Reed Miller's

introduced.name: Proof of the Cognoscenti
introduced.how: A legendary item found hidden in the Atlas's captain's compartment
introduced.quote: Inside was the legendary Proof of the Cognoscenti.

introduced.name: Derwent
introduced.how: A hermit whose identity Hark took over after killing him
introduced.quote: The real hermit, Derwent, is likely dead, and the man living in his hut is the bounty target, Hark, the Crackjaw.

introduced.name: Juhani
introduced.how: A former pirate of lesser renown whom Hark accused of theft
introduced.quote: Juhani, who was once a pirate, albeit one of significantly less renown, remained free from suspicion.

introduced.name: Atlas wreck ghost attacks
introduced.how: Treasure hunters at the Atlas wreck reported being attacked by ghosts
introduced.quote: were attacked by a ghost while plundering the wreckage of a pirate ship

introduced.name: Hark bounty
introduced.how: A bounty has been placed on Hark at The Flagship in Nasha Town
introduced.quote: Word is that someone's put a bounty on his head over at The Flagship in Nasha Town.

assumed.name: Hark bounty (unresolved)
assumed.quote: We finally found a lead on our unresolved bounty.

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: Then he must have stirred up some fuss in Nasha Town

assumed.name: Peripatetic Circle
assumed.quote: But what about once he joined the Peripatetic Circle?

assumed.name: Leszek
assumed.quote: you can take the bounty proof to Leszek, as arranged.

threads.claim: Ghost rumors at the Atlas wreck are raised as an open question.
threads.quote: There's ghosts here, alright.

threads.claim: The attacks are revealed to be by Hark, a living man rather than a ghost.
threads.quote: We already know that he returned to the wreckage of the Atlas and attacked the treasure hunters who came looking for treasure.

threads.claim: Reed Miller's Great Treasure is said to be undiscovered and its token has been lost.
threads.quote: I've also heard that no one's found it yet.

threads.claim: The Proof of the Cognoscenti is a feather whose link to the great treasure is unclear.
threads.quote: how a feather is supposed to lead us to some

threads.claim: A traveler with golden hair and a companion in white took the token away.
threads.quote: Not long back, there was a traveler with golden hair and a companion dressed in white who passed through here

threads.claim: Hark killed the real hermit Derwent and took over his identity.
threads.quote: After dispatching Derwent, he took over the hermit's identity.

threads.claim: A merchant has gone missing and may already be dead.
threads.quote: As for the missing merchant, the worst-case scenario is that he's already dead.

threads.claim: Hark's grudge against Juhani over the theft drives his first mistake.
threads.quote: He accused Juhani there and then, but no one believed him.

threads.claim: Hark's return to crime shows he has fallen back into his old ways.
threads.quote: It shouldn't come as a shock that Hark has returned to his old ways.

threads.claim: Whether the Atlas sank near this spot is raised as a question.
threads.quote: But I heard it sank way back when.

threads.claim: The question of whether bad people can change for good is raised.
threads.quote: Does this mean bad people can't mend their ways?

threads.claim: Hark is defeated and the bounty job is completed.
threads.quote: Here's to a job well done.

introduced.name: Karya
introduced.how: Scholar from Sumeru who introduces herself and her senior Viramdra
introduced.quote: Yes, I'm Karya, and this is my senior, Viramdra.

introduced.name: Viramdra
introduced.how: Karya's senior, a researcher who seeks a key to his work on the mysterious island
introduced.quote: Viramdra believes the key to his research can be found there.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: Tribe whose legends concern the mysterious island and whose guides are respected
introduced.quote: There's a legend from the People of the Springs that mentions a mysterious island

introduced.name: Mysterious island
introduced.how: Legendary island that treasure hunters seek, linked to a tribal legend
introduced.quote: The fact of the matter is that we're searching for a mysterious island from a certain legend.

introduced.name: Amina
introduced.how: Chief of the People of the Springs who stays informed about threats to Natlan
introduced.quote: As chief of the tribe, I must stay informed about everything that could have a significant impact on Natlan.

introduced.name: Kaulu
introduced.how: Self-described qualified guide from the People of the Springs who offers to lead the group
introduced.quote: In that case, as a qualified guide, I certainly cannot allow you to embark on such a dangerous journey.

introduced.name: Ata
introduced.how: Elder Koholasaur respected by the tribe, said to have visited the island before
introduced.quote: Ata is the elder Koholasaur my senior here is responsible to serve.

introduced.name: Kaeho
introduced.how: Man at the Koholasaur site who charges Mora for consulting Ata
introduced.quote: Ahem! That'll be 10,000 Mora per person.

introduced.name: Legend of the first chief
introduced.how: First chief of the tribe, a top guide, searched for the island and left clues rather than claiming treasure
introduced.quote: It is said that the first chief of the People of the Springs was the most outstanding guide in all of Natlan.

introduced.name: Tourist scam ring
introduced.how: Tribe members who pose as trustworthy guides to swindle visitors seeking the island
introduced.quote: I'll be honest, there are some among the tribe who are of rather base character.

introduced.name: Koholasaur language
introduced.how: Koholasaurs communicate in a language only trained guides can interpret
introduced.quote: In the language of the Koholasaurs, of course.

introduced.name: Amina's Coin Pouch
introduced.how: Pouch of marked Mora Amina gives the group to use as bait money
introduced.quote: Item Amina's Coin Pouch.png

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Judging from your clothes, you must be scholars from Sumeru, right?

assumed.name: Koholasaurs
assumed.quote: And we can even see some Koholasaurs here and there!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Whoa, that's a lot of Mora!

assumed.name: Spiritdoor
assumed.quote: (Amina turns to look at the nearby Spiritdoor)

assumed.name: Upper Sanctum
assumed.quote: (If the hidden island in the Upper Sanctum has already been unlocked)

assumed.name: Into Eternal Night
assumed.quote: (If Into Eternal Night has not been completed)

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Oh! We can go find Mualani!

threads.claim: The legendary mysterious island is still undiscovered, and its location clues are described as hard to decipher.
threads.quote: The fact of the matter is that we're searching for a mysterious island from a certain legend.

threads.claim: The Koholasaur elder Ata may have visited the mysterious island, so Ata may hold its route.
threads.quote: They say that Ata has actually visited the mysterious island before.

threads.claim: The guides' island turns out to be a fake site with wooden signs and artificial lights, not the real mysterious island.
threads.quote: look at these wooden signs and artificial lights. Even we can tell it's fake!

threads.claim: Whether any treasure actually lies on the mysterious island remains unanswered, since the treasure is part of the legend.
threads.quote: All that stuff about treasure is just part of the legend

threads.claim: Reaching the mysterious island requires making the journey with one's closest friends, whom one would trust with one's life.
threads.quote: Therefore, the requirement to reach the island is journeying with your closest friends... The kind of friends you would trust with your life.

threads.claim: Ruins on the island may hide a way to reach the sky.
threads.quote: The elders once told me that beneath these very ruins lies a way to reach the sky!

threads.claim: The guide Kaulu and his group are exposed as scammers who swindled tourists, and the scam is confirmed.
threads.quote: Yes, it was all a scam.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild notebook
introduced.how: a new notebook for recording the people and events met while traveling
introduced.quote: Whereas this notebook is for recording the marvelous people and wonderful events you encounter on your travels.

introduced.name: Adventurer Handbook
introduced.how: records completed commissions and intel on monsters
introduced.quote: The Adventurer Handbook is for recording details of your completed commissions and intel on all sorts of monsters.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: shrine recently renovated, where a new wish-making service is being set up
introduced.quote: (Approach Yae Miko at the Grand Narukami Shrine)

introduced.name: wish-making service
introduced.how: visitors write a wish and hang it at the shrine, where it may come true
introduced.quote: See this offering box beside me? There's going to be another place to make wishes here soon.

introduced.name: prayer plaque
introduced.how: written wishes are attached to a plaque and hung on a rack
introduced.quote: Now then, close your eyes, make a wish, write it down on a prayer plaque, then hang it up on this rack here, and maybe your wish will come true.

introduced.name: fortune slips
introduced.how: used for telling fortunes, unlike wish-making
introduced.quote: That's different. Fortune slips are about telling fortunes, whereas this... is about making wishes.

introduced.name: fortune paper
introduced.how: leftover paper from writing fortune slips, given to write a wish on
introduced.quote: It's left over from writing fortune slips. You can have it.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ah, , you've come at just the right time — I have something for you.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Ah, little one, you're just in time.

assumed.name: Commissions
assumed.quote: An escort commission, or a search and rescue?

assumed.name: Guuji
assumed.quote: Powerless Guuji that I am, I can only help you in mortal matters.

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Safe travels, . Ad astra abyssosque!

threads.claim: Whether a wish comes true is decided by the gods who watch over everyone, not by the shrine.
threads.quote: Of course. But as for which wishes come true... That is up to the gods who watch over us all.

threads.claim: Yae Miko says she is powerless over the gods and can only help with mortal matters.
threads.quote: Powerless Guuji that I am, I can only help you in mortal matters.

threads.claim: The Traveler wishes to be reunited with old friends, and the wish might be granted.
threads.quote: I'd like to be reunited with some old friends...

threads.claim: Yae Miko hints that the person the Traveler wishes to meet may be found nearby, at a noodle stand.
threads.quote: After all, the person you wish to meet might just be sitting at some noodle stand, having themselves a lovely bowl... And bring me back one while you're at it.

threads.claim: The Traveler's journeys are meant to be recorded, including the people and events they meet.
threads.quote: Whereas this notebook is for recording the marvelous people and wonderful events you encounter on your travels.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: Military-style group running camps and lighthouses, with patrols keeping supply roads clear
introduced.quote: Not only must we shore up our bases themselves, we also need to ensure that the roads are clear

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: Soldiers dispatched at regular intervals to patrol vast areas of land
introduced.quote: which entails dispatching Ratniki at regular intervals to patrol vast areas of land

introduced.name: Moonwagon
introduced.how: Lightkeeper transport vehicles made by modifying Snezhnayan machines and powered by kuuvahki
introduced.quote: They're transportation tools we made by modifying Snezhnayan mechanical vehicles.

introduced.name: kuuvahki
introduced.how: Plant-derived substance refined into a special oil that fuels lighthouses
introduced.quote: we need a special kind of oil refined using kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: Monstrous outbreaks that suddenly appear and keep growing in strength, causing havoc
introduced.quote: The real danger lies with those Wild Hunt outbreaks that suddenly just appear out of nowhere.

introduced.name: Mandragoras
introduced.how: Plant-like beings sensitive to environmental shifts that block paths and trap intruders behind barriers
introduced.quote: the barrier created by these Mandragoras can't be broken from inside

introduced.name: Lunar Conflux Barrier
introduced.how: Barrier made by Mandragoras that cannot be broken from inside
introduced.quote: (After melting the Lunar Conflux Barrier)

introduced.name: Valdis
introduced.how: Meticulous transport officer in charge of supply runs who loves studying insects and plants
introduced.quote: Valdis is in charge of transport, and he's always been meticulous, so it's unlikely that he got careless

introduced.name: Piramida
introduced.how: Home city of Illuga where people from every corner of the world live, and where supplies are sourced
introduced.quote: The people of Piramida come from every corner of the world, so there's a wide variety of palates to cater for.

introduced.name: lighthouse
introduced.how: Beacon the Lightkeepers are building at the camp to guide travelers through the night
introduced.quote: Still, it'll be bright enough to serve as a beacon to guide travelers through the night.

introduced.name: investigation squad
introduced.how: Traveler and Paimon have been made members of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad
introduced.quote: But since you're both part of the investigation squad now, I won't treat you like outsiders.

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey there, Illuga. Why's everyone gathered here at the entrance?

assumed.name: Anleifr
assumed.quote: Anleifr: What now, Boss? Forget our brothers and sisters over at the lighthouse, waiting to get to work...

assumed.name: Egle
assumed.quote: Egle: Yeah. We gotta think of something, Squad Leader.

assumed.name: Rollon
assumed.quote: Rollon: Squad Leader, I've compiled what data we have on the bases we can still control.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Our comrades in the east seem to have butted heads with the Fatui.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Flins did send word from the south that the strongest Wild Hunt anomaly we know of has been destroyed with your help.

assumed.name: Gramps
assumed.quote: Such tasks are all handled by Gramps, Flins, Olav, and those guys.

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: We've been to prison in the Fortress of Meropide as well...

assumed.name: Final Night Cemetery
assumed.quote: It won't be as impressive as the one at Final Night Cemetery, that's for sure.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt keeps growing stronger and spreading havoc even after its strongest anomaly was destroyed.
threads.quote: It is indeed. As you've seen for yourselves, it's continued to grow in strength.

threads.claim: Strange murmurs were heard before Wild Hunt monsters manifested, possibly sensed early by Mandragoras.
threads.quote: I myself heard some strange murmurs on the way here.

threads.claim: Mandragoras sensed Wild Hunt monsters early and trapped Valdis inside a barrier to protect him.
threads.quote: Valdis, I think these Mandragoras trapped you inside the barrier to protect you.

threads.claim: The kuuvahki fuel supply that should have arrived for the lighthouse has gone missing.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, though, there's been no sign of the supplies that should have arrived last night.

threads.claim: The missing fuel problem is resolved and the lighthouse's fuel stocks are replenished.
threads.quote: Alrighty. That's the issue resolved, and our fuel stocks replenished.

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: A feral child raised by qucusaurs who grew into the tribe's strongest warrior
