introduced.quote: Allpa: ...Back then, no one imagined this feral child would grow up to be the strongest warrior of the Flower-Feather Clan.

introduced.name: Coyllur
introduced.how: A flying candidate who failed the rider trial and is struggling with confidence
introduced.quote: Chasca: Coyllur has spent years training for her most recent attempt, but unfortunately she didn't pass... So it's not hard to see why she's so upset.

introduced.name: Cusco
introduced.how: Chasca's adoptive father who worries about her Abyss checkups
introduced.quote: Cusco: Who am I? Tsk, only her father!

introduced.name: Chuychu
introduced.how: Chasca's sibling who followed her to the front lines and has died
introduced.quote: Cusco: *sigh* ...In the past, she always had Chuychu to keep an eye on her. Now Chuychu's gone, and I just... I don't want to lose another daughter.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: A proud warrior tribe with an elite qucusaur flying squad
introduced.quote: Chasca: Well, in the Flower-Feather Clan there's an elite flying squad made up of qucusaur riders.

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: Proud flying creatures that carry riders and must approve of them
introduced.quote: Chasca: Well, in the Flower-Feather Clan there's an elite flying squad made up of qucusaur riders.

introduced.name: Wingless
introduced.how: Candidates who gave up on flying after repeated failed trials but remain respected
introduced.quote: Chasca: Sometimes, after multiple failed attempts to pass the flying test and win the qucusaurs' approval, people get so disheartened that they give up on their dream to soar the skies.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Companion creatures the tribe calls by whistling or horn-blowing
introduced.quote: Chasca: Yeah, people from my tribe call to their saurian companions by whistling or blowing a horn. So it sounds like Coyllur was trying to summon a qucusaur to practice her flying.

introduced.name: Flying trial
introduced.how: A selective test of flying skill and qucusaur approval needed to become a rider
introduced.quote: Chasca: But it's an extremely selective squad. To become a rider, you need to undergo a trial where you not only demonstrate mastery of the relevant skills, but also win the approval of the qucusaurs.

introduced.name: Chasca's Abyss exposure
introduced.how: Chasca was exposed to Abyssal energy as a child, abandoned, and raised by wild qucusaurs
introduced.quote: Cusco: *sigh* Yes, she got exposed to Abyssal energy as a young child... Then her birth parents abandoned her.

introduced.name: Inkanak
introduced.how: Trial arena inspector who reports the blockages and their cause
introduced.quote: Inkanak: Hmm, well, the inspection revealed numerous blockages all over the trial arena. It looks like they're the result of ley line disorders caused by repeat Abyss invasions.

introduced.name: Ley Line Disorder
introduced.how: Disturbances caused by repeated Abyss invasions that block the arena spouts
introduced.quote: Inkanak: Hmm, well, the inspection revealed numerous blockages all over the trial arena. It looks like they're the result of ley line disorders caused by repeat Abyss invasions.

introduced.name: Gaseous Phlogiston
introduced.how: Substance that fills the trial arena once spout blockages are cleared
introduced.quote: Inkanak: Theoretically, we just need to clear those obstacles, and the arena will fill up with gaseous phlogiston again. But that's proving difficult to achieve in practice, for all sorts of reasons...

introduced.name: Phlogiston Wings
introduced.how: Valuable merchant goods that are a flying device
introduced.quote: Isidore: Ahh, thank you so much for coming to our rescue. These Phlogiston Wings are our most prized goods. If anything happened to them, it would ruin us...

introduced.name: Volcano Cake
introduced.how: A food sold by Yatlan's family shop
introduced.quote: Yatlan: ! My family's shop makes the best Volcano Cake, you gotta try it!

introduced.name: Isidore
introduced.how: Merchant who asks for help after a qucusaur attack on his group
introduced.quote: Isidore: ...You're from the Flower-Feather Clan, right? Please, come quick, you've got to help us!

introduced.name: Mutota
introduced.how: Pixica's former boss who urges her to reconsider her Wingless status
introduced.quote: Mutota: ...Are you sure you don't want to reconsider, Pixica?

introduced.name: Pixica
introduced.how: A Wingless warrior who now manages the Floating Target Balloons
introduced.quote: Allpa: Huh... Well, much obliged. Chasca, the remaining Wingless are all people you know. Let's see... Pixica now manages the Floating Target Balloons...

introduced.name: Huascar
introduced.how: A former fierce warrior, now Wingless, who plays Eyes on the Feathered Prize
introduced.quote: Chasca: He used to be a fierce warrior, actually. But fighting spirit alone won't win you the qucusaurs' approval.

introduced.name: Zhunan
introduced.how: A Wingless rider who spends her days staring at Ochkanatlan from the flying platform
introduced.quote: Chasca: Hey, Zhunan. Gazing out at Ochkanatlan again, huh?

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Paimon: So what are you doing here? Paimon figured you'd all be off fighting in the Night Warden Wars by now.

assumed.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, you're that fan favorite from the Stadium of the Sacred Flame! Ch... Ch...

assumed.name: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
assumed.quote: Allpa: Besides, we still owe you for your help during the war. Without you, we would have suffered far worse at the hands of the Abyss...

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Confused Investigator: Could be from the Children of Echoes...? Maybe it got swept up here due to the Ley Line disturbances.

threads.claim: A bloodstained feather at the end hints at something dark about Chasca or the tribe.
threads.quote: Chasca: A bloodstained feather...

threads.claim: A hot air balloon high above the arena has an unknown owner and unexplained technology.
threads.quote: Bold Investigator: Huh? Oh, THAT one... No, I've got no idea who that belongs to. Or how they got it up so high...

threads.claim: A qucusaur attacked merchants unprovoked, which is unusual for the species.
threads.quote: Chasca: So why do you think it attacked these people in the first place? Was it after the food?

threads.claim: An unseen whistler summoned a qucusaur to Coyllur, and the source is unknown.
threads.quote: Coyllur: Huh? That sounded like a whistle... Is someone else trying to summon a qucusaur?

threads.claim: Chasca whistled to free the Traveler from the qucusaur situation, revealing who summoned it.
threads.quote: Chasca: looked very flustered when Coyllur asked for a ride. So I whistled to give a chance to escape.

threads.claim: Chasca's Abyss exposure requires regular checkups, and her condition is a source of worry.
threads.quote: Cusco: *sigh* Yes, she got exposed to Abyssal energy as a young child... Then her birth parents abandoned her.

threads.claim: Chasca's recklessness and missed checkups deepen concern about her Abyss condition.
threads.quote: Cusco: Chasca's been increasingly reckless since Chuychu passed. It's like she's trying to make up for it somehow...

threads.claim: Chuychu has died, and Chasca's recklessness since then is tied to that loss.
threads.quote: Cusco: *sigh* ...In the past, she always had Chuychu to keep an eye on her. Now Chuychu's gone, and I just... I don't want to lose another daughter.

threads.claim: The tribe holds that Wingless members remain valued and that qucusaurs and warriors both must accept their children.
threads.quote: Chasca: Besides, every qucusaur falls from its nest before it learns to fly. It's practically a rite of passage.

threads.claim: Allpa's past failed expedition to Ochkanatlan left her injured and doubting her own strength.
threads.quote: Allpa: I came back empty handed and seriously injured.

threads.claim: Allpa becomes intrigued by the Phlogiston Wings, hinting at their future significance.
threads.quote: Allpa: Oh, really? ...Now I'm intrigued.

threads.claim: Repeated Abyss invasions have disturbed the ley lines and blocked the arena.
threads.quote: Inkanak: Hmm, well, the inspection revealed numerous blockages all over the trial arena. It looks like they're the result of ley line disorders caused by repeat Abyss invasions.

introduced.name: Flins
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Kyryll Chudomirovich Flins, guardian of the tombs who once collected the fallen Lightkeepers from the battlefield
introduced.quote: Flins: My dear Ratniki, I am Kyryll Chudomirovich Flins. Once upon a time, it was I who retrieved your fallen bodies from the battlefield.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: Guardians whose tombs lie on the island, who fought many battles against the Wild Hunt
introduced.quote: Flins: Most of the camps on this isle have been removed, and only the lighthouse remains, symbolizing the many battles the Lightkeepers have fought against the Wild Hunt.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: A threat that watches from the darkness and ambushes travelers who lose their way in fog
introduced.quote: Wandering Phantom: Well, that's because the Wild Hunt watches us from the darkness.

introduced.name: Ghosts
introduced.how: Ghosts are echoes of the living, fragments of thoughts and memories that did not pass into the Ley Lines at death
introduced.quote: Flins: Ghosts are the echoes of living souls — a portion of their thoughts and memories that, for certain reasons, fails to enter the Ley Lines at the moment of their death.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: The place where souls go at death, which ghosts fail to enter
introduced.quote: Flins: Ghosts are the echoes of living souls — a portion of their thoughts and memories that, for certain reasons, fails to enter the Ley Lines at the moment of their death.

introduced.name: Lighthouse
introduced.how: A historic lighthouse on the island that once guided ships and now stands dark and neglected
introduced.quote: Flins: In the past, it guided people on their way to and from the island... but all those people now lie beneath our feet in eternal rest.

introduced.name: Lamp signals
introduced.how: The lighthouse sends five light-flash signals: distress, warning, guidance, summoning, and all safe
introduced.quote: Paimon: There are five signal types: Distress, warning, guidance, summoning, and all safe.

introduced.name: Lamp Signal Handbook
introduced.how: A handbook listing the lighthouse signal patterns, with the warning signal entry illegible
introduced.quote: Paimon: The handbook says that we've gotta aim the lamp in the right direction, then control the brightness according to the signaling rules.

introduced.name: Blue lantern
introduced.how: A legendary blue light that appears to the lost or to those fighting the Wild Hunt, said to guide them
introduced.quote: Wandering Phantom: They say it only appears if you run in to the Wild Hunt, or if you can't find your way at night.

introduced.name: Aimo
introduced.how: A ghost who moved fuel and loved telling tales of the blue lantern, named by Flins
introduced.quote: Flins: At the very least, I know now that the gentleman who moved fuel and loved to tell the tale of the blue lantern was named

introduced.name: Eetu
introduced.how: The comrade Aimo always called out to, named by Flins
introduced.quote: and the comrade he always called out to was named

introduced.name: Sumrak
introduced.how: A special support squad HQ would send to reinforce the Lightkeepers when a warning signal goes off
introduced.quote: HQ will send us, the special support squad

introduced.name: Lightkeeper oath
introduced.how: The oath's line about using bones and blood as fuel to make life greater than death
introduced.quote: Our bones and blood we shall use as fuel, we shall make life greater than death.

introduced.name: Lighthouse light extinguished in conflict
introduced.how: The lighthouse light was snuffed out decades ago in a battle with the Wild Hunt, and most of the island's troops died
introduced.quote: Flins: But alas, the light of this historic outpost was snuffed out in a conflict against the Wild Hunt several decades ago.

introduced.name: Nikita
introduced.how: A friend who writes letters arranging supplies and offering a dog for company
introduced.quote: Letter: Signed, Your Friend Nikita

assumed.name: The Ashen-White Order Burns
assumed.quote: (Before completing The Ashen-White Order Burns)

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: Letter: I have received your supply request, and HQ has approved it. I'll get Illuga to send it to you at the next opportunity.

assumed.name: Starshyna
assumed.quote: I'll bet that's why the Starshyna wants to make offerings to it on the island, haha.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: My granddad says it's one of the fae that used to live in Nod-Krai in ancient times

assumed.name: Ratnik
assumed.quote: How you made the cut as a Ratnik, I'll never know.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt lurks in darkness and fog, waiting to ambush those who lose their way.
threads.quote: Wandering Phantom: Well, that's because the Wild Hunt watches us from the darkness.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt is a never-ending threat while the Lightkeepers are few in number.
threads.quote: Flins: After all, the Wild Hunt is a never-ending threat, while our numbers are limited.

threads.claim: The nature of the blue lantern is unknown, but it seems to be on the Lightkeepers' side.
threads.quote: Wandering Phantom: Whatever it is, the blue lantern seems to be on our side — the side of the Lightkeepers.

threads.claim: The blue lantern can help destroy what remains of the Wild Hunt but cannot save the dead.
threads.quote: Flins: He can help you destroy what remains of the Wild Hunt, but he cannot save you.

threads.claim: Lighting the lighthouse has changed the behavior of the ghosts for reasons not yet clear.
threads.quote: Flins: This can only mean that lighting the lighthouse has somehow caused a change in them.

threads.claim: The lighthouse's light went out for an unexplained reason, leaving a question about its past.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah, that was the first thing we saw when we arrived. So it's a lighthouse, huh? What happened to the light?

threads.claim: The lighthouse light was extinguished in a battle with the Wild Hunt decades ago.
threads.quote: Flins: But alas, the light of this historic outpost was snuffed out in a conflict against the Wild Hunt several decades ago.

threads.claim: Ghosts are only the memories of people who once lived, and those people are long gone.
threads.quote: Flins: Ghosts are but the memories of people that once were.

threads.claim: The memories of the ghosts are dispersed and will later return to their usual state.
threads.quote: Flins: Some of their memories and thoughts have been dispersed.

threads.claim: The Lightkeeper oath strikes at the core of their principles about sacrifice for the survival of life.
threads.quote: Flins: It is a line that strikes at the very heart of our principles.

threads.claim: Lighting the lighthouse has set time in motion again, so the island's endless night begins to lift.
threads.quote: Flins: I never had any intention of changing this, but it seems that by lighting the lighthouse, you have set time in motion once again.

introduced.name: Cyrus (Mondstadt)
introduced.how: city official who handles commissions and organizes the adventurers
introduced.quote: Thank you. I will be handling commissions here...

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: handles careful investigation of monster activity in the wild
introduced.quote: Conducting careful investigations into the activities of monsters in the wild falls within the purview of the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: thieves who sneak into the city during chaos to steal goods and fence them
introduced.quote: it seems as though some Treasure Hoarders managed to sneak in amid the chaos.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarder camps map
introduced.how: a map marking the thieves' camps around the city
introduced.quote: Hey, it's a map! But what could these circled placed be? Could it be their camps?

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Bah, Stormterror was defeated, just like that? We didn't even get the chance to take the stage...

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Oh, if it isn't the Honorary Knight.

assumed.name: Knights
assumed.quote: When that storm from before had just appeared, the Knights and the Adventurers' Guild sprang into action.

assumed.name: Whispering Woods
assumed.quote: Could I trouble you to go to the Whispering Woods and see to the situation there?

assumed.name: Pyro Slime
assumed.quote: Look at all those barrels of Pyro Slime!

assumed.name: Large force that attacked Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Wasn't the large force that attacked Mondstadt defeated previously?

threads.claim: The monsters' renewed numbers in the wild may mean they are following some other plan.
threads.quote: Could they have some other plans? ...I must gather the adventurers and re-issue our commissions.

threads.claim: Stormterror's defeat ends the storms that had hit Mondstadt.
threads.quote: The storms have ceased, and Stormterror has been defeated.

threads.claim: The monsters seem to be using bonfires and camps for an unknown purpose.
threads.quote: Paimon's got a bad feeling about this bonfire. Wonder what they could be using it for?

threads.claim: Thieves exploited the storm chaos to steal from the city and fence the loot.
threads.quote: these bandits will take it. Why, if this storm hadn't subsided so quickly, I doubt there'd be anything left in Mondstadt to steal.

threads.claim: The Traveler clears all the Treasure Hoarder camps, ending their raids.
threads.quote: Got them all.

introduced.name: Soraya
introduced.how: a scholar who studies ruins and is recruiting the Traveler to search for inscriptions
introduced.quote: And masochistic scholars, like me, who in spite of all the risks just can't resist the idea of how much research value these ruins have to offer.

introduced.name: Guili Assembly
introduced.how: a once-prosperous settlement, now ruins, wiped out for unclear reasons
introduced.quote: This place we are in is called the Guili Assembly.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group that, like hilichurls, frequents the Guili ruins
introduced.quote: The only ones who come here are the hilichurls, the Treasure Hoarders...

introduced.name: Stone tablets
introduced.how: ancient inscribed stone slabs in ruins that hold written history
introduced.quote: Yes, keep your eyes peeled for stone pillars and stone tablets.

introduced.name: Guizhong
introduced.how: a god with power over Dust who descended and watched over the Guili people
introduced.quote: A god named Guizhong descended, whose dominion was over Dust

introduced.name: Guizhong's Four Commandments
introduced.how: four moral maxims laid down by Guizhong that also hide a treasure riddle
introduced.quote: A treasure lies in Guili, and Guizhong's Four Commandments shall guide those in generations to come who aspire to find it

introduced.name: Guili Plains
introduced.how: a plain where the treasure is said to be and where a great battle was fought
introduced.quote: and there they fought upon the Guili Plains, where black dust choked the heavens

introduced.name: Jade plates
introduced.how: plates with commandment-related writing found in ruins around Guili Plains
introduced.quote: I once came across a strange plate with some writing on in one of the ruins around here.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: a long war between gods competing for seats on the divine thrones
introduced.quote: A protracted war erupted between the gods, each of whom coveted a seat at one of the seven divine thrones in Celestia.

introduced.name: Celestia
introduced.how: the realm where the seven divine thrones of the gods are located
introduced.quote: A protracted war erupted between the gods, each of whom coveted a seat at one of the seven divine thrones in Celestia.

introduced.name: Fall of the Guili Assembly
introduced.how: the total destruction of the Guili settlement, with several possible causes
introduced.quote: But for various reasons, the whole place was wiped out.

introduced.name: Battle on the Guili Plains
introduced.how: a huge battle on the plains that is thought to have destroyed the Guili Assembly
introduced.quote: That must have been the battle in which Guili Assembly fell.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: How many secrets does Liyue truly hold?

assumed.name: Geo Archon
assumed.quote: All the more so in the domain of the Geo Archon.

assumed.name: Wangshu Inn
assumed.quote: Let's head back to Wangshu Inn.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: You shouldn't pay any heed to those tall tales you hear in Liyue Harbor.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: It seems that none in Teyvat escaped the reach of that all-consuming war.

threads.claim: The cause of the Guili Assembly's destruction is unknown, with conflicting stories of divine conflict, human war, or natural disaster.
threads.quote: Some stories put it down to conflict between the gods, other people say it was a war between humans.

threads.claim: Even two watchful gods could not prevent the destruction, suggesting a power beyond the gods.
threads.quote: Which means whatever happened was beyond even the gods' powers to withstand...

threads.claim: The fate of the two gods who protected Guili is unknown and they may have vanished.
threads.quote: But what happened to them? They can't have just... disappeared?

threads.claim: Soraya states that Guizhong died and her people lost their home when the Assembly fell.
threads.quote: Failed? I suppose you're right, she died in the end

threads.claim: A second, unnamed god of Geo co-ruled the Guili Assembly alongside Guizhong and brought its people to the place.
threads.quote: Then another god descended, whose dominion was over Geo, and who brought the people of Liyue to this place.

threads.claim: A rumor suggests Guizhong may have had a close or hidden relationship with the other god, which Soraya dismisses.
threads.quote: Maybe Guizhong and one of the other gods...

threads.claim: The stone tablet records differ in places from the written documents, so the true history is uncertain.
threads.quote: That which is recorded on these stone tablets seems to differ in some places from those in some documents.

threads.claim: Guizhong's Four Commandments hide a treasure riddle that must be deciphered.
threads.quote: But it's also supposed to contain some sort of clues to a hidden treasure...

threads.claim: Each jade plate clue explains one of the four commandments, and their relation to the riddle is still unclear.
threads.quote: Each of these clues expounds upon the meaning of one of the Four Commandments.

threads.claim: The treasure is found at the place where the four clue locations converge.
threads.quote: Yes, it was about where they

threads.claim: Whoever designed the riddle revered Guizhong and deliberately used treasure to preserve her commandments.
threads.quote: Whoever designed this riddle must have truly revered Guizhong.

threads.claim: Soraya suggests that gentle gods once protected their people but were ultimately powerless against the wars and disasters of the age.
threads.quote: But it was the gentle gods who were ultimately powerless to protect their people.

threads.claim: The Archon War, a war among gods over divine thrones, may be connected to the Guili Assembly's fall.
threads.quote: Maybe it's to do with the Archon War.

threads.claim: The name Guili was formed from syllables of the names of the two gods who ruled the assembly.
threads.quote: And the assembly was named Guili after the names of the two gods...

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: Paimon realizes the mage Nicola Coco is Nicole, who is telling the story and running the renovation
introduced.quote: Correct. What do you think of my story?

introduced.name: Nicola Coco
introduced.how: the fictional Great Mage Everlasting whose lodge the player is building, presented as the story's mage
introduced.quote: This is the secret home of Nicola Coco, the Great Mage Everlasting.

introduced.name: Mr. Nine
introduced.how: a writer who helps refine Nicole's story and takes over its next section
introduced.quote: Mr. Nine can always refine it later.

introduced.name: Alynas
introduced.how: a new mage who signs a contract with the youngster and later turns out to be a rival princess
introduced.quote: a new mage by the name of Alynas appeared.

introduced.name: King Meowtres the Third
introduced.how: ruler of Planet Meow, father of Nicola Coco in the story
introduced.quote: Her true identity was the first daughter of King Meowtres the Third of Planet Meow.

introduced.name: Planet Meow
introduced.how: the alien world Nicola Coco comes from, which plans to make the world worship it
introduced.quote: She had come disguised as a mage as part of a secret plot to trick the entire world into worshiping Planet Meow!

introduced.name: Angels
introduced.how: once tasked with guiding humans, but a rebellious part of them was punished and the race suffered
introduced.quote: We angels are a case in point. Once, we were tasked with guiding human beings, but because some of us chose a different path, our entire race was punished.

introduced.name: Witch's Lodge
introduced.how: the mage's home under renovation, which the player helps build and decorate with statues
introduced.quote: The mage's lodge is under renovation.

introduced.name: Statue carving puzzle
introduced.how: numbers on blocks show how many blocks per row to keep, and Trim Excess and Preserve Shape skills are used to carve a statue
introduced.quote: The number on each block indicates how many blocks in that row must be kept.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: After spending the last of Mora, trod through the cold of winter, shivering in threadbare clothes...

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: If even the Heavenly Principles can't fully control their own creations... What chance do I stand?

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: I'm sure Nefer would know how to deal with them much better than I do.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: I would guide them out of this place to the nearby Curatorium of Secrets.

assumed.name: Mandragora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Is that... a Mandragora?

threads.claim: Nicola Coco is revealed to be the mage persona in Nicole's own story, answering who the mage is.
threads.quote: Correct. What do you think of my story?

threads.claim: Nicole's voice reaches the Traveler remotely, implying she can contact them while they are in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: if you can hear my voice, I assume that means you're currently in Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: Angels were once tasked with guiding humans, and their whole race was punished after some chose a different path.
threads.quote: We angels are a case in point. Once, we were tasked with guiding human beings, but because some of us chose a different path, our entire race was punished.

threads.claim: Creations eventually escape their creator's control, a theme tied to the story changing shape and to the Heavenly Principles.
threads.quote: All creations escape the controlling grasp of their creator eventually.

threads.claim: Even the Heavenly Principles cannot fully control their own creations, raising doubt about who controls the story and its characters.
threads.quote: If even the Heavenly Principles can't fully control their own creations... What chance do I stand?

threads.claim: Nicola Coco is an alien whose secret plot is to make the world worship Planet Meow.
threads.quote: She had come disguised as a mage as part of a secret plot to trick the entire world into worshiping Planet Meow!

threads.claim: Alynas secretly helped the youngster to incite Nicola Coco's sister to treason, aiming to usurp Nicola's place in the succession.
threads.quote: Alynas had been Meowtres the Third's second daughter all along.

threads.claim: Nicola Coco's statues appear to be people who opposed her and were turned to stone, a threat that may be real.
threads.quote: These are all those who opposed me. They underestimated the power of a mage, and thus were turned to stone.

threads.claim: The petrification threat is revealed as a joke, with the statues just a way of capturing moments in time.
threads.quote: I was merely joking. These statues are just my way of capturing a certain moment in time.

threads.claim: Nicole states that those who seek to reap without sowing should pay the price, a theme on earned versus unearned reward.
threads.quote: Those who seek to reap without sowing ought to pay the price, don't you think?

threads.claim: Nicole would send troublesome seekers to the Curatorium of Secrets, where Nefer deals with them.
threads.quote: I'm sure Nefer would know how to deal with them much better than I do.

threads.claim: The story Nicole tells ends with the youngster turned cat and the mage living happily in peace after foiling the king's plot.
threads.quote: They lived happily ever after...

introduced.name: Atzilli
introduced.how: A winemaker at the Me & Dew who introduces herself as "Mad-Eye" Atzilli
introduced.quote: By the way, I'm "Mad-Eye" Atzilli, a winemaker at the Me & Dew.

introduced.name: Me & Dew
introduced.how: A drink establishment run by Atzilli's sister, where Atzilli makes wine
introduced.quote: By the way, I'm "Mad-Eye" Atzilli, a winemaker at the Me & Dew.

introduced.name: Brewblossom
introduced.how: A flower that absorbs spiritual energy from the land and produces a dream-sensitizing nectar
introduced.quote: That's because Brewblossoms draw in spiritual energy from the land and produce a special nectar that heightens one's sensitivity to dreams.

introduced.name: Dance of Erzulie
introduced.how: The wriggling reaction Brewblossoms show to people with strong clairvoyance affinity
introduced.quote: The flowers only react this way when someone with a strong affinity for clairvoyance draws near.

introduced.name: clairvoyance affinity
introduced.how: A natural spiritual affinity some people are born with, which draws Brewblossoms to them
introduced.quote: They're born with a natural spiritual affinity.

introduced.name: Dream Extractor
introduced.how: A tool for collecting the purest pollen from Brewblossoms
introduced.quote: This one here is the "Dream Extractor," we can collect the purest pollen from the Brewblossoms.

introduced.name: Glowing Hornshroom
introduced.how: An ingredient that guides the soul back to the body after a dream-death
introduced.quote: The Glowing Hornshroom lights the way for the soul back to the body,

introduced.name: Brilliant Chrysanthemum
introduced.how: A spicy ingredient that snaps the senses awake and pulls the drinker back from the dreamscape
introduced.quote: the Brilliant Chrysanthemum's wicked kick snaps your senses awake

introduced.name: Sir Briannus
introduced.how: A self-proclaimed knight who guards the Brewblossoms, a talking dog who challenges intruders to duels
introduced.quote: I am Sir Woofington Briannus, knight of this realm!

introduced.name: Dambara
introduced.how: A self-described "Dambara the Pale" cat guarding the northernmost Brewblossom, who is dramatic and pollen-obsessed
introduced.quote: I'm "Dambara the Pale," but you can just call me Dambara.

introduced.name: Papa Witch Doctor
introduced.how: A shaman tale spirit who guides the spirits of the unlucky dead and toys with the living through nightmares
introduced.quote: They say Papa Witch Doctor guides the spirits of those who were unlucky and didn't die in glorious battle.

introduced.name: Hallowing
introduced.how: A spreading calamity whose aftershocks destroy ancient seals and threaten lands across Teyvat
introduced.quote: The spread of the Hallowing has destroyed many of the seals left behind by our predecessors.

introduced.name: Wingalet
introduced.how: A ship that picks up people in need of refuge across Teyvat and carries them to safety
introduced.quote: The Wingalet is picking up those in need of refuge all across Teyvat.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: Said to be the flesh and blood of Rex Lapis, and used by an adeptus to quell the disaster
introduced.quote: It's said that Mora is the flesh and blood of Rex Lapis.

introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.how: A communications network that covers the entire Sumeru region during the operation
introduced.quote: The Akasha system will remain active for the duration of the operation.

introduced.name: Adina
introduced.how: A lost child ghost searching for her parents, who is named by her own words
introduced.quote: Don't leave Adina here alone... *sobs*

introduced.name: Khorin Family Grave
introduced.how: Adina's family grave, where her parents rest
introduced.quote: This is Adina's family grave. Her parents rest eternally beneath this soil.

introduced.name: Danuta and Hamalainen
introduced.how: Adina's parents, whose spirits are found and who wait for her at home
introduced.quote: We've found Danuta and Hamalainen.

introduced.name: Ley Line anomalies
introduced.how: Anomalies whose basic properties have been studied, with desert samples more volatile than rainforest ones
introduced.quote: we've managed to ascertain the basic properties of the Ley Line anomalies.

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: I fear we won't get much else out of her.

assumed.name: Sigewinne
assumed.quote: Sigewinne: Understood. Bring the severely injured to me first.

assumed.name: Wriothesley
assumed.quote: Wriothesley: Make sure the injured get priority.

assumed.name: Clorinde
assumed.quote: We've got more people on our hands than expected.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Although the Adepti have helped us temporarily weather this crisis

assumed.name: Ningguang and Zibai
assumed.quote: Ningguang, Madam Adeptus... You're back from Snezhnaya already?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: To think that, despite having been gone for so long... he's still protecting Liyue in some shape or form.

assumed.name: Sethos
assumed.quote: Oh, and Sethos headed out to the House of Daena to move some books

assumed.name: Grand Sage Naphis
assumed.quote: While the Dendro Archon and Grand Sage Naphis are occupied

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: The Dendro Archon put you in charge, right, Cyno?

assumed.name: Kaveh
assumed.quote: Kaveh: Everyone, ready your terminals... How's that? Do you read me?

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: All communications are in place.

assumed.name: Rahman
assumed.quote: Rahman mentioned that if the Corps of Thirty is short on people, he can spare a few.

assumed.name: Spantamad
assumed.quote: Sometimes I forget you graduated from Spantamad with honors.

assumed.name: Ibis King
assumed.quote: The Ibis King can rest assured about that.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Can't go to Natlan's aid on an empty stomach.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: ...Let the departed rest in peace.

assumed.name: Windblume Festival
assumed.quote: The numbers and scale are far worse than the incident during the Windblume Festival, I'm afraid.

assumed.name: Durin
assumed.quote: The last time Mondstadt looked like this... was the night before Durin came to life.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Varka: Knights of Favonius, with me! Charge!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Boguchwal: I'll give you one thing — the Fatui army is certainly well-organized...

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Even after all this time, it would seem you're just as warm-hearted and giving as ever, Lady Moonchanter.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: I'm not surprised the Fatui are evacuating Snezhnayans to the less-affected parts of Nod-Krai...

assumed.name: Chinju Forest
assumed.quote: I wanna go back to Chinju Forest...

assumed.name: Tetsunosuke
assumed.quote: Tetsunosuke: They're gonna keep coming? Mmm... I... I wanna go back to Chinju Forest...

assumed.name: Ginkaku
assumed.quote: Mm! Stupid Ginkaku! Now's not the time for depressing talk!

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: But why hilichurls? That's strange...

threads.claim: The Hallowing keeps spreading and destroying old seals, so true peace remains out of reach.
threads.quote: As long as it persists, we will never see true peace.

threads.claim: One rune in the sky has suddenly disappeared, and people hope erasing all runes will end the chaos.
threads.quote: You must be referring to the sudden disappearance of one of the runes in the sky.

threads.claim: A mysterious adeptus quelled Liyue's disaster with a single Mora, and their identity remains unknown.
threads.quote: Liyue was only able to overcome this "trial" so quickly thanks to that "mysterious adeptus."

threads.claim: Rex Lapis may still be protecting Liyue through Mora despite having been gone for so long.
threads.quote: he's still protecting Liyue in some shape or form.

threads.claim: Some people are born with spiritual affinities that draw Brewblossoms to them.
threads.quote: They're born with a natural spiritual affinity.

threads.claim: Papa Witch Doctor is a twisted spirit who toys with the living through eerie nightmares.
threads.quote: always crafting eerie nightmares to toy with the living who catch his eye.

threads.claim: Dreaming of digging treasure with Hilichurls hints at a strange, unexplained connection.
threads.quote: But why hilichurls? That's strange...

threads.claim: Ley Line anomalies are being studied, and their samples vary between regions.
threads.quote: we've managed to ascertain the basic properties of the Ley Line anomalies.

threads.claim: Natlan is severely affected by the crisis, and Sumeru is sending a team to help.
threads.quote: with Natlan so severely affected by this crisis

threads.claim: Concepts of friend and foe shift as circumstances change.
threads.quote: As change, so too does our conception of friend and foe.

threads.claim: A chant mentions a false moon and crossroads, hinting at a hidden power behind the possessions.
threads.quote: The scalding treasures lie beneath the light of the false moon...

threads.claim: Adina is a lost child ghost who cannot find her parents and is afraid to be left alone.
threads.quote: Don't leave Adina here alone... *sobs*

threads.claim: Adina finds her way home to her parents' ghosts at the Khorin family grave.
threads.quote: It's home! I've found the way back!

introduced.name: Pingxi
introduced.how: self-introduced as the God of Fortune who runs the Lantern Rite arrangements
introduced.quote: Pingxi: I'm the God of Fortune!

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: festival where people release Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: Pingxi: Let me think... Hm... Got it! First things first — you have to release Xiao Lanterns. It's Lantern Rite after all.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: lanterns on which people write wishes and release during Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: It's kinda like how we write wishes on Xiao Lanterns and release them during Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Auspicious Treasure Tree
introduced.how: trees in Liyue Harbor whose pruned branches yield Fortune Coins
introduced.quote: Pingxi: And then, we also set up a bunch of Auspicious Treasure Trees around Liyue Harbor. As long as you prune their branches properly, the Fortune Coins inside are yours.

introduced.name: Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer
introduced.how: an old Chenyu Vale myth of a giant toad that eats the moon
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: It's an old myth from Chenyu Vale about a giant toad in the sky that eats the moon.

introduced.name: White Horse Adeptus
introduced.how: legendary adeptus said to live on the moon, descend in a jade carriage and grant wishes
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: The White Horse Adeptus would descend from the moon in her jade carriage and grant people's wishes.

introduced.name: Baiju Guesthouse
introduced.how: guesthouse named after the White Horse Adeptus, run by Lu Weng's family
introduced.quote: Lu Weng: That's right! And that's because one of my ancestors was once blessed by the White Horse Adeptus.

introduced.name: Lu Weng
introduced.how: owner of Baiju Guesthouse who tells his ancestor's story of the White Horse Adeptus
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: Oh, Mr. Lu from the Baiju Guesthouse! But... How do you know that for sure?

introduced.name: Lu Xiangxiang
introduced.how: self-proclaimed archaeologist who caused a scene at Wanmin Restaurant and claims a photo of the eclipse
introduced.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: I, Lu Xiangxiang, am on the verge of becoming one of the most renowned archaeologists in all of Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: region where the ancient Chenyu Vale people migrated from and where the relics were excavated
introduced.quote: Ningguang: That's interesting because... the ancient people of Chenyu Vale migrated there from the Chasm area.

introduced.name: Linlang
introduced.how: owner of Xigu Antiques who organized the exhibition
introduced.quote: Keqing: Plus, the exhibition is being organized by Linlang, the owner of Xigu Antiques.

introduced.name: Crux Fleet
introduced.how: fleet that Beidou leads as captain
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: You're too modest, Captain. You're the leader of the Crux Fleet. That takes far more skill than just fists and punches.

introduced.name: Six Ritual Jades
introduced.how: six jade ritual pieces each used to honor a direction or Heaven or Earth
introduced.quote: Zhongli: The Bi is used to honor Heaven, the Cong to honor Earth, the Gui to honor the East, the Zhang to honor the South, the Hu to honor the West, and the Huang to honor the North.

introduced.name: Frost Moon
introduced.how: the true moon the Traveler and a companion brought back to Teyvat from Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Word has it, you accomplished quite the feat in Nod-Krai. You and your friend... brought the Frost Moon back to Teyvat.

introduced.name: Three Deadly Selves
introduced.how: the three selves Zibai severed, each holding a fragment of her soul
introduced.quote: Zhongli: The Three Deadly Selves is a practice used by those engaged in spiritual cultivation.

introduced.name: Ziju
introduced.how: Zibai's First Deadly Self, now one with the shadowmoon and holding the Heavenly Soul
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Indeed. The being you encountered was Zibai's First Deadly Self, Ziju.

introduced.name: Zizhi
introduced.how: Zibai's Second Deadly Self, sleeping beneath The Chasm and holding the Earth Soul
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Her Second Deadly Self is called Zizhi. After Zibai's death, she fell into a slumber deep beneath the earth in what is now known as The Chasm.

introduced.name: Ziqiao
introduced.how: Zibai's Third Deadly Self, who hid in the mountains after the Archon War and holds the Human Soul
introduced.quote: Zhongli: The Third Deadly Self is Ziqiao. The essence within her is the Human Soul — also known as Youjing, Zibai's shade.

introduced.name: Istaroth
introduced.how: avatar of Time revealed as the one who preserved Zibai's soul before her death
introduced.quote: Zhongli: ...It was the avatar of Time.

introduced.name: shadowmoon
introduced.how: the fake moon that was a projection and prison confining Zibai, now disintegrating
introduced.quote: Zhongli: Indeed, it was false — its true nature nothing but a projection of the moon. It also happens to be the prison that confines Zibai to this day.

introduced.name: Lu Xiangxiang
introduced.how: A patient who vanished from Bubu Pharmacy and is sought for questioning
introduced.quote: Ningguang asked me to investigate a patient named Lu Xiangxiang.

introduced.name: Deadly Selves
introduced.how: Malevolent beings born of human desires that threaten the form and mind of the living
introduced.quote: Deadly Selves are born of malevolent human desires, and naturally, pose a great risk to the form and mind of all living beings.

introduced.name: Zizhi
introduced.how: The Second Deadly Self of the White Horse Adeptus, who possesses people
introduced.quote: You must be Zizhi, the Second Deadly Self.

introduced.name: White Horse Adeptus
introduced.how: A mysterious white mare adeptus who aided Rex Lapis in the Archon War
introduced.quote: The White Horse Adeptus? You mean, the mysterious white mare that aided Rex Lapis during the Archon War?

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Gods that Liyue people pray to for solutions to their problems
introduced.quote: When the people of Liyue need a solution to a problem, their first thought would be to pray to the gods and the adepti.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: Lanterns on which people write wishes in hopes the adepti will grant them
introduced.quote: If her wish is to become famous, she might write it on a Xiao Lantern in the hopes that the fabled White Horse Adeptus might make it come true.

introduced.name: Mighty Mythical Beasts
introduced.how: A group struggling to recruit members for Wushou Dancing
introduced.quote: the Mighty Mythical Beasts are seriously struggling with recruitment...

introduced.name: Wushou Dancing
introduced.how: A physically demanding dance art that takes hard work to master
introduced.quote: Wushou Dancing is super physical and takes a lot of hard work to master, so it's not easy to find people.

introduced.name: Gaming
introduced.how: A Wushou Dancer who wants to recruit apprentices
introduced.quote: So, I'm hoping to find a few apprentices and teach 'em the art of Wushou Dancing.

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: A relaxing holiday resort in Natlan with ocean and activities
introduced.quote: We know just the place — the Easybreeze Holiday Resort in Natlan!

introduced.name: Asha
introduced.how: Cute little creatures that live in Natlan near the resort
introduced.quote: You've got the beautiful ocean and tons of cute little creatures called Asha!

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: An adept, shown in adeptal form, who was sent to watch Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Hahahaha, many years it has been since a being has dared speak to us in such a manner.

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: An adept who joins Mountain Shaper to watch over Liyue Harbor for Rex Lapis
introduced.quote: Now, let us see what evildoer has sought to use you as its puppet, young one.

introduced.name: Lang-Gan
introduced.how: An ancient people who honored Zibai and whose descendants live across Liyue
introduced.quote: A Trilunar Syzygy adorns the night sky as the people of Lang-Gan gather to honor Zibai

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: An adeptus who taught the people of Lang-Gan farming, weaving and building, and is the God of Soil and Grain
introduced.quote: According to Mom and Dad, the adeptus Zibai

introduced.name: Istaroth
introduced.how: A figure who governs Time and orders Lang-Gan purified as heaven's will
introduced.quote: Istaroth: All places tainted by the Abyss need to be purified

introduced.name: Three Deadly Selves
introduced.how: Zibai's soul was split into three Deadly Selves by Istaroth
introduced.quote: who splits her soul into the Three Deadly Selves

introduced.name: Celestial Nail
introduced.how: A celestial weapon poised over Lang-Gan during its destruction
introduced.quote: A Celestial Nail appears in the sky above, pointed directly at Lang-Gan

introduced.name: Fall of Lang-Gan
introduced.how: Tainted celestial battle remnants devastated Lang-Gan, and the heavens ordered it cleansed
introduced.quote: Remnants of the battles, tainted with cursed power, fell from on high and devastated Lang-Gan.

introduced.name: Ziqiao
introduced.how: Zibai's severed Deadly Self, a white horse who insists she is the real White Horse Adeptus
introduced.quote: Geo Lord, the ancient affairs of Lang-Gan have nothing to do with me, for I am but one of her Deadly Selves, severed before her demise.

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: Envoy of the Lunar Palace, an old friend of Zhongli whose soul was split and is now reawakening
introduced.quote: Oh, yes... the Envoy of the Lunar Palace. My name... is Zibai indeed.

introduced.name: Lang-Gan
introduced.how: An ancient nation whose people were ancestors of some modern Chenyu Vale inhabitants and whose jade is in Liyue
introduced.quote: Our findings show that they date back to the era of Lang-Gan, an ancient nation whose people are said to have been the ancestors of some of the modern-day inhabitants of Chenyu Vale.

introduced.name: Deadly Selves
introduced.how: Parts of a divine being formed from impure vapors that cannot survive long without a soul fragment
introduced.quote: A Deadly Self is formed from the body's impure vapors — so naturally, it cannot survive long in this world.

introduced.name: Three Souls of Zibai
introduced.how: Zibai's Heavenly, Earthly and Human Souls are scattered and must be gathered to revive her
introduced.quote: In other words, the Heavenly Soul is set to return.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: A yearly festival where people release Xiao Lanterns carrying wishes
introduced.quote: Celebrating Lantern Rite, of course! And those lights up in the sky, those are all Xiao Lanterns. This year, each and every one of them carries a little wish inside.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: Ancient lanterns lit to guide fallen warriors home, now released as festival wish lanterns
introduced.quote: In ages past, when the gods waged war and the world was in turmoil, these lanterns were lit to guide fallen warriors back to their homes.

introduced.name: Moonchase Rite
introduced.how: An ancient adeptal ritual meant to communicate with the moon, performed by Rex Lapis and later abandoned
introduced.quote: According to Cloud Retainer, the Moonchase Rite was originally a ritual meant for communicating with the moon.

introduced.name: Li Cuisine and Yue Cuisine
introduced.how: Liyue's two main cooking styles, one mountain-based and one seafood-based
introduced.quote: There are two main cooking styles in Liyue — Li Cuisine, which is all about mountain delicacies, and Yue Cuisine, which is centered on seafood.

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: A affordable, down-to-earth restaurant serving simple dishes in many styles
introduced.quote: Yup! Nothing fancy-schmancy there — just tasty dishes made with simple ingredients in a variety of different styles.

introduced.name: Xiangling
introduced.how: A cook at Wanmin Restaurant who introduces herself and is Chef Mao's daughter
introduced.quote: By the way, I'm Xiangling! I cook here at Wanmin Restaurant.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: The restaurant's chef and Xiangling's father, who welcomes guests
introduced.quote: Oh, hello there! What a surprise to see you two! Welcome, welcome!

introduced.name: Lu Xiangxiang
introduced.how: A young archaeologist who apologizes for vandalizing the restaurant and is grounded by her father
introduced.quote: Hello, Miss Xiangling... It's me, Lu Xiangxiang. The one who broke some stuff here at your restaurant a few days ago.

introduced.name: Baiju Guesthouse
introduced.how: A guesthouse in Liyue Harbor owned by Lu Xiangxiang's family, along with tea fields
introduced.quote: All we own are a few tea fields in Qiaoying Village and a guesthouse in Liyue Harbor...

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: Introduces herself as director of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe
introduced.quote: Oh, leaving so soon? Before you go, allow me to introduce myself... I am Yun Jin, director of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe. May I ask your name in return?

introduced.name: Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: A storyteller performer who practices tongue twisters and enjoys roleplaying
introduced.quote: What a tongue twister... Phew, I'd have made a complete fool of myself if I'd tried to say it on stage without practicing it first.

introduced.name: Storytelling performances
introduced.how: Liyue entertainment where performers tell old legends aloud, like operas
introduced.quote: Y'know, like... listening to people telling stories! They're usually based on old Liyue legends, just like their operas.

introduced.name: Odes of Lang: Zibai
introduced.how: The true title of the ancient poem, a blessing ode to the moon and the White Horse Adeptus
introduced.quote: Ha, of course not! Its real title is "Odes of Lang: Zibai."

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Introduces herself and shares news of the Moonchase Rite
introduced.quote: Oh, and by the way, I'm Ganyu.

introduced.name: Yanfei
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a fan of the White Horse Adeptus who studies her legends
introduced.quote: Greetings, Miss Ziqiao. My name is Yanfei

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: A group whose Nod-Krai library holds records of a divine envoy living on the moon
introduced.quote: on my recent trip to Nod-Krai, I came across something really fascinating in the Frostmoon Scions' library.

introduced.name: Yujing Terrace
introduced.how: A high terrace in Liyue Harbor with a panoramic sea view
introduced.quote: In that case, if you're looking for a spot with a panoramic view, I'd recommend Yujing Terrace.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale and Mt. Qingce campaign
introduced.how: Zibai and Rex Lapis's past campaign that subdued Chenyu Vale and pacified Mt. Qingce, sealing their contract
introduced.quote: Together, we first subdued Chenyu Vale, then brought peace to Mt. Qingce. It was for this cause that the contract between us was made.

introduced.name: Lunar eclipse
introduced.how: A dark circle covers the moon during the festival, causing alarm
introduced.quote: Whoa, is this the lunar eclipse?

introduced.name: Photo
introduced.how: A device that records moments in an instant, taken as a group picture
introduced.quote: It's this awesome invention that lets you record moments in the blink of an eye! Except, you've gotta try not to actually blink...

introduced.name: Wenji
introduced.how: An artist making hand-drawn festival souvenirs for visitors
introduced.quote: I've heard so much about you — what an honor to finally meet you.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: The government body that issued a notice saying the moon's disappearance poses no danger and plans festival venues
introduced.quote: The Ministry of Civil Affairs has issued a notice stating that, although it is true that the moon may disappear tonight, we should be in no danger.

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: Zibai is the White Horse Adeptus, now using the name Zibai, who has lost most of her memories
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hehehe, the White Horse Adeptus has a name now! You can call her Zibai!

introduced.name: Shenhe
introduced.how: Crane Adeptus who works at Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.quote: Shenhe: My name is Shenhe. I work here at Wanmin Restaurant.

introduced.name: Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: Self-declared kindred spirit of Zibai who is fond of cosplaying as Rex Lapis
introduced.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: Hurry along then, oh and don't forget to come back and check out my Rex Lapis cosplay when you're done!

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: Restaurant in Liyue where Shenhe works and Zibai eats
introduced.quote: Iron Tongue Tian: I just saw her head toward Wanmin Restaurant. I was wondering why she was eating alone, but then you two showed up hot on her heels.

introduced.name: Fenglian
introduced.how: Tea vendor running a shop that sells teas sourced from Qiaoying Village
introduced.quote: Fenglian: Welcome! Please have a look around. We only sell teas of the finest quality, sourced directly from Qiaoying Village.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: Mountain village of tea farmers with houses built along the mountain contours
introduced.quote: Zibai: Indeed, the houses here are quite different from those in Liyue Harbor. They follow the natural contours of the mountains, forming unique, elegant structures.

introduced.name: Lu Xiangxiang
introduced.how: Young woman grounded by her family, who must raise a tea seedling and works on archaeology
introduced.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: Yeah, though they're not confining me to my room. Instead, I have to personally nurture a tea seedling until it grows big enough to be sold at market.

introduced.name: Lu Weng
introduced.how: Elderly grandfather of Lu Xiangxiang who opposed his son renaming the Baiju Guesthouse
introduced.quote: Lu Weng: For my idiot son to finally come to his senses and not change Baiju Guesthouse's name — which he has!

introduced.name: Baiju Guesthouse
introduced.how: Guesthouse run by the Lu family where Zibai takes a long-term room
introduced.quote: Zibai: If you still have doubts, you can find me at the Baiju Guesthouse. I'll be taking up residence there for a while.

introduced.name: Lil' Li
introduced.how: Child from Qingce Village who wants to plant cucumbers in the family's field
introduced.quote: Lil' Li: Yeah! Dad gave us a small plot of land to grow our own crops. He said we can keep all the Mora we get from selling them.

introduced.name: Lil' Tian
introduced.how: Child from Qingce Village who wants to plant canola for oil
introduced.quote: Lil' Tian: We should plant canolas! We can press the seeds for oil — it smells good and sells for a good price.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: Zhongli's boss, who leads the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh! That's his boss, Hu Tao! It's about time she realized the problem and put a stop to his spending sprees.

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: The Conqueror of Demons, who senses presences at Wangshu Inn and meets Zibai there
introduced.quote: Xiao: Not at all — I sensed an unusual presence long before you arrived, though I didn't expect it to be you in a flying chariot.

introduced.name: Guilan
introduced.how: Vendor who runs a mini-game stall and explains the game's rules
introduced.quote: Guilan: Step right up and take a look! Play a round of "Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won" and ring in a year of good luck!

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: Released the mini-game Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won
introduced.quote: Guilan: Oh, it's the brand new mini-game released by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won
introduced.how: Brand new Lantern Rite mini-game where skill brings good fortune
introduced.quote: Guilan: Step right up and take a look! Play a round of "Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won" and ring in a year of good luck!

introduced.name: Prosperity Pouch and Charm Coins
introduced.how: Items used in the Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won mini-game
introduced.quote: Guilan: With the "Prosperity Pouch" and "Charm Coins," just a little skill is all it takes to bring you luck and good fortune!

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Zhongli's past identity as the Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star
introduced.quote: Zibai: In days of yore, he was... the Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star.

introduced.name: Bune
introduced.how: God of the underworld who could pacify the forces of life and death, sealed in Tao Dou
introduced.quote: Zibai: Hmm... Bune, the god of the underworld, who could pacify the forces of life and death...

introduced.name: Angel
introduced.how: Race tasked with guiding humanity, of which Zibai was once a member
introduced.quote: Zibai: I was once an angel — a member of a race tasked with guiding humanity. Then, graced by serendipity, I became a moon envoy.

introduced.name: Moon envoy
introduced.how: A job title that any angel or non-angel can hold
introduced.quote: Zibai: As you would understand it, a moon envoy is a job title. Any angel — or non-angel — can become a moon envoy.

introduced.name: Lunar chariot
introduced.how: Flying chariot Zibai recreated from memories of the lunar palace
introduced.quote: Zibai: Hehe, I created it from my memories of the chariot of the lunar palace.

introduced.name: Lang-Gan
introduced.how: Land whose poems honor the moon, with cultural artifacts excavated by archaeologists
introduced.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: I mean, I helped excavate cultural artifacts from Lang-Gan, so I contributed to the revival of these poems, too, right?

introduced.name: Five grains
introduced.how: The five staple grains that are the heart of the people's table
introduced.quote: Zibai: The five grains are life's staples, the heart of the people's table.

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill
introduced.how: Spooky hill where Tao Dou's remains are sealed
introduced.quote: Paimon: Whoa! We've arrived at Wuwang Hill! The atmosphere just turned spooky...

introduced.name: Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array
introduced.how: Ancient array that seals away the remains of a fallen god
introduced.quote: Paimon: You might have a connection to that place, too. There's an ancient array that seals away the remains of a fallen god!

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: Towering inn in Dihua Marsh with striking architecture and views
introduced.quote: Zibai: Hehe, this inn's architecture is incredible, and the surrounding countryside radiates a picturesque charm.

introduced.name: Wangshu
introduced.how: Originally means the goddess who rides the bright moon's chariot, and can also refer to the moon
introduced.quote: Xiao: The goddess who rides the bright moon's chariot.

introduced.name: Three Deadly Selves
introduced.how: Impure emotions and desires that can be severed through self-cultivation
introduced.quote: Xiao: Paimon, as you do not practice self-cultivation, I cannot help you fully understand, but you can think of them simply as emotions and desires.

introduced.name: Shattering Atmagraha
introduced.how: Sumeru's name for a practice similar to severing the Three Deadly Selves
introduced.quote: I believe other nations have similar practices — in Sumeru, it is known as Shattering Atmagraha.

introduced.name: Flavor of Spring
introduced.how: Spring dish from Lang-Gan that Zibai remembers and cooks
introduced.quote: Zibai: Among the dishes served, there was one that could be found in every household throughout Lang-Gan at the start of spring — a dish called "Flavor of Spring."

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Zhongli: Greetings. I trust you've been well since last we met.

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: Chongyun: Aunt Shenhe would have noticed if she was possessed.

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Oh!? Oh!?

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Xiangling: Oh! and Paimon! Perfect timing, I have something amazing to show you!

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Huh, I didn't expect you to know the story of Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer, Paimon.

assumed.name: Chongyun
assumed.quote: Chongyun: Whoa...

assumed.name: Yaoyao and Qiqi
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey Yaoyao! Hey Qiqi!

assumed.name: Baizhu
assumed.quote: Qiqi: Dr. Baizhu has patients who got hurt walking at night...

assumed.name: Changsheng
assumed.quote: Qiqi: Changsheng told me about it, but now... I forgot...

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Traveler: So Madame Ping has never met the White Horse Adeptus either?

assumed.name: Yanfei
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: Nope! Kinda unbelievable, right? Yanfei said the White Horse Adeptus might even be a made-up legend, just like Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer.

assumed.name: Granny Shan
assumed.quote: Traveler: Thanks, but I prefer to buy them from Granny Shan.

assumed.name: Liu Su
assumed.quote: Baofei: I can't imagine what the moon would look like while being eaten... but in Liu Su's story, the monsters chew it down slowly, piece by piece — kind of like how we work through a pancake.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Traveler: (The moonlight's guidance... Does she mean... Columbina?)

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: The elders of Qingce Village believe that during the Archon War, a white horse leapt from a clear spring, transforming into an adeptus who aided Rex Lapis in battle.

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: Zhongli: She lent me her aid during the Archon War a thousand years ago. But later, as her powers waned, she retreated into the mountains.

assumed.name: Eight Adepts
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Wait, I thought she was the Gold-Eyed Celadon Mare of the Eight Adepts?

assumed.name: Sea of stars
assumed.quote: Zhongli: You are someone who once traveled through the boundless sea of stars.

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Hey, it's Yelan! Fancy seeing you here!

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Unless... Lyney decided to take his act to Liyue?

assumed.name: Dr. Baizhu
assumed.quote: According to Dr. Baizhu, the patient vanished right under his nose

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Happy Lantern Rite, Paimon! You're as lively as I remember.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: By the order of Rex Lapis, we were supposed to make haste to the Harbor to stand watch.

assumed.name: Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: Alas, why must Cloud Retainer inflict such woe upon us, Moon Carver?

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: during the Archon War?

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Two Millelith escort Lu Xiangxiang away

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: We know you attacked those people at Wanmin Restaurant.

assumed.name: Chiwang Terrace
assumed.quote: What about the photo you took near Chiwang Terrace...

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Have you other concerns, Conqueror of Demons?

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Ah, . It has been quite some time.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Perhaps your time in Nod-Krai left you with the blessing of the newborn Moon Goddess

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Xiao, Cloud Retainer, Madame Ping! We're here! Any news on Zhongli?

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Hehe, well, Xianyun banned Mountain Shaper from Mt. Aocang for three days.

assumed.name: Xianyun (Cloud Retainer)
assumed.quote: Wow, that's pretty harsh, Cloud Retainer!

assumed.name: Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver
assumed.quote: Oh... Then what about Moon Carver?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: We have news of Rex Lapis.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Hey, it's Zhongli! We've been looking for you everywhere... We thought you might've gone missing!

assumed.name: Hu Tao
assumed.quote: Kinda putting Hu Tao in a tough spot here, Paimon...

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Ohhh yeah, didn't Keqing mention that before? It's got something to do with Lang-Gan, right?

assumed.name: Granny Shan
assumed.quote: Even Granny's never met her, y'know.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Got your lanterns ready, everyone?

assumed.name: Gaming
assumed.quote: Whoa, is this the lunar eclipse?

assumed.name: Qiqi and Yaoyao
assumed.quote: (Qiqi hands Yaoyao a bamboo basket to go with her new outfit)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon's sure we can afford to spend a little more of her Mora, at least...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Get ready to find out why they call Paimon the best travel guide in all of Teyvat!

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Looks like Zhongli hasn't stopped by for tea today...

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah! There's a local legend about a white horse leaping from a pure spring to follow Rex Lapis into battle!

assumed.name: Xiangling and Chef Mao
assumed.quote: Shenhe: Xiangling and Chef Mao aren't here right now. What can I help you with?

assumed.name: Crane Adeptus
assumed.quote: Zibai: Shen... he... Shenhe...? Are you that Crane Adeptus who loves planting Mint?

assumed.name: Mint and Qingxin
assumed.quote: Shenhe: Mint? I don't know anything about Mint... but I am familiar with Qingxin and Glaze Lilies.

assumed.name: Yilong Wharf
assumed.quote: Paimon: Weren't we going to Yilong Wharf? How did we end up on this mountain?

assumed.name: Lu Xiangxiang's trouble in Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: There's no doubt they care, but they think that since I caused all that trouble in Liyue Harbor, it shows I can't be trusted on my own.

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Does that mean Lauma could take that job? She can turn into a deer, and Moonchanters are some sorta lunar envoy anyway, right?

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: Paimon: Well, Morax certainly finds us often enough. He even sought us out in person this Lantern Rite...

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh! Yeah, Chenyu Vale does have a lot of jade...

assumed.name: Qiqi and Yaoyao
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: Qiqi, the Lantern Rite is almost over. Do you remember how to make a Xiao Lantern?

assumed.name: Dr. Baizhu
assumed.quote: Yaoyao: Hey, it's Paimon! Hehe, Dr. Baizhu gave this to me as a gift. How does it suit me?

assumed.name: Broken jade token from the antiques exhibition
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey! It's that broken jade token from the antiques exhibition!

assumed.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and Eight Adepts
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Huh? Miss Zibai, you know about the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and the Eight Adepts?

assumed.name: Smiley Yanxiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zibai, you can see the whole of Dihua Marsh from up there — the view's amazing! Plus, you can sample Smiley Yanxiao's cooking!

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Shenhe: , Paimon... It's been a long time. Happy Lantern Rite.

assumed.name: Zibai's lost memories and Three Deadly Selves
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! Have you got all your memories back!?

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Zibai: Conqueror of Demons... Are you looking to learn about Rex Lapis's past from me?

threads.claim: A strange eclipse covers the moon from its center, and its cause is an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh!? What the— Part of the moon is blacked out! Was it really eaten by a giant toad!?

threads.claim: The recent eclipses are revealed to be caused by the fake moon fading away.
threads.quote: Traveler: So, the recent lunar eclipse... It was the fake moon, wasn't it?

threads.claim: Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer may be only a myth, yet the moon really seems eclipsed.
threads.quote: Yaoyao: It's just a story! It's not like there's actually a giant toad in the sky.

threads.claim: The moon that hung in the sky for thousands of years may not have been the real moon.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Tell me, did you ever wonder about the other moon, the one that hung in its place for thousands of years?

threads.claim: The fake moon was a projection that imprisons Zibai.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Indeed, it was false — its true nature nothing but a projection of the moon. It also happens to be the prison that confines Zibai to this day.

threads.claim: Someone insists the White Horse Adeptus really exists, challenging the skeptics.
threads.quote: ???: You're mistaken, children. The White Horse Adeptus really does exist.

threads.claim: Zibai has long since passed away, and her presence survives only in fragments.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Very well. The first secret I must reveal is that Zibai has long since passed away. The being within the shadowmoon is merely one of the Three Deadly Selves she severed before her death.

threads.claim: Someone preserved the fragments of Zibai's soul, and their identity is unknown.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Because in the moment before her death, someone preserved the shattered essence of her soul, and placed the fragments within her Three Deadly Selves.

threads.claim: The soul fragments were preserved by Istaroth, the avatar of Time.
threads.quote: Zhongli: ...It was the avatar of Time.

threads.claim: Zibai's soul fragments are split among three Deadly Selves that must be gathered to restore her.
threads.quote: Zhongli: If we retrieve the three fragments of her soul, there is a chance we can restore her presence in the mortal realm.

threads.claim: Zizhi may have emerged from The Chasm with the excavated artifacts.
threads.quote: Zhongli: It's possible the return of the Frost Moon awakened her, and she emerged from the Chasm alongside that batch of ancient artifacts.

threads.claim: Lu Xiangxiang may have been haunted by an ancient ghost, a suspicion raised as a joke.
threads.quote: Hu Tao: What if she raided a tomb and dug up some super special relic, then got herself haunted by an ancient ghost!

threads.claim: Zhongli suspects a Deadly Self has possessed someone in Liyue Harbor.
threads.quote: Zhongli: It's possible she has possessed someone and is meandering the bustling streets of Liyue Harbor as we speak.

threads.claim: People's wishes may be what trigger the moon's periods of disintegration.
threads.quote: Zhongli: My hypothesis is that people's wishes could be what trigger the periods of disintegration.

threads.claim: The shadowmoon is expected to collapse on the night of Lantern Rite, creating a deadline.
threads.quote: Zhongli: On the night of Lantern Rite, countless Xiao Lanterns — and the wishes written upon them — will be released into the sky. I estimate that this event will trigger the shadowmoon's collapse.

threads.claim: Zhongli is reluctant to draw the Traveler deeper into Teyvat's secrets, hinting at his own agenda.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I must admit a certain... reluctance to implicate you in more of Teyvat's secrets. Often, the deeper one's knowledge of such matters, the harder it becomes to extricate oneself from them.

threads.claim: The White Horse Adeptus avoided the adepti in the past for a reason that remains unknown.
threads.quote: She always avoided us back then, and I never knew why.

threads.claim: Deadly Selves are born of malevolent human desires and threaten all living beings.
threads.quote: Deadly Selves are born of malevolent human desires, and naturally, pose a great risk to the form and mind of all living beings.

threads.claim: Zizhi is a trace of impure energy from Zibai's body, and Istaroth split her soul into the Three Deadly Selves.
threads.quote: who splits her soul into the Three Deadly Selves

threads.claim: Taking the soul fragment from Zizhi frees her from her shackles.
threads.quote: By taking away this fragment of her soul, you take away my shackles as well.

threads.claim: Zizhi refers to a curse of time tied to the memories of the White Horse Adeptus, left unexplained.
threads.quote: The curse of time... The memories this body holds...

threads.claim: Madame Ping suggests that Time takes more from those who dwell long in this world.
threads.quote: Time does not treat everyone equally. The longer you dwell in this world, the more it takes from you...

threads.claim: The Traveler experiences the curse of Time as a river of time sweeping across the prison.
threads.quote: This... must be the curse of Time.

threads.claim: Istaroth, the one who governs Time, is named as a mysterious figure tied to Zizhi.
threads.quote: Was it... Istaroth?

threads.claim: Istaroth orders Lang-Gan purified and then splits Zibai's soul, despite Zibai's objections.
threads.quote: Istaroth: All places tainted by the Abyss need to be purified

threads.claim: Zizhi hints that traces of a past catastrophe at Lang-Gan may still remain in the world.
threads.quote: Could it be that traces of what happened back then still remain in this world...?

threads.claim: Heavenly decree in a war ordered Lang-Gan cleansed of tainted filth at any cost.
threads.quote: The heavens decreed that the tainted filth had to be cleansed... no matter the cost.

threads.claim: Zizhi reveals the memories of Lang-Gan's destruction that have haunted her.
threads.quote: Now, you know the truth. These are the memories that suffocate me where I stand, and crush me under their weight.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis left on a recent trip whose details he withheld, and its link to the White Horse Adeptus is unclear.
threads.quote: Rex Lapis' recent trip seems to be related to this person as well.

threads.claim: Xiao suspects Rex Lapis withheld his trip details for a reason similar to Zibai's secret history.
threads.quote: It would seem, then, that Rex Lapis had a similar reason for withholding the details of his recent trip.

threads.claim: The Traveler may carry a blessing from the newborn Moon Goddess gained during their time in Nod-Krai.
threads.quote: Perhaps your time in Nod-Krai left you with the blessing of the newborn Moon Goddess

threads.claim: Zizhi asks that her name be placed on the banner of any future war against the heavens.
threads.quote: let my name be set upon its cloth.

threads.claim: Zhongli plans to gather Zibai's three soul fragments so an old friend can return.
threads.quote: My intention is to gather all three together so that an old friend may finally make her return.

threads.claim: The Human and Earthly Soul fragments are sent up toward the moon in a Xiao Lantern.
threads.quote: (The Traveler places the Human and Earth Souls within a Xiao Lantern Zhongli is holding and they release it, sending the fragments of Zibai's soul up towards the moon)

threads.claim: Zibai's soul fragments reunite and she awakens with the colors of all three Deadly Selves.
threads.quote: (Zibai awakens, and her eyes briefly flash with the colors of all three Deadly Selves)

threads.claim: Zibai has lost her memories, and how long her recovery will take is unknown.
threads.quote: That, I cannot say for certain. Perhaps a few days, perhaps a few years.

threads.claim: Zibai begins recognizing people and her identity but her mood and memory are still unstable.
threads.quote: Who you are? Hmm, who are you... Ah, yes, I remember now.

threads.claim: Ziqiao insists she is not Zibai, only a separate Deadly Self who looks like the White Horse Adeptus.
threads.quote: Sorry to break it to you, but you seem to have found yourself the wrong white horse.

threads.claim: Ziqiao declares she and Zibai are now separate beings, not the same person.
threads.quote: Ha... I think you'll find that we are now as separate and distinct as any two beings ever were.

threads.claim: Ziqiao dissolves into a golden sphere once Zibai's soul remnant is removed, ending her existence.
threads.quote: (Ziqiao's form dissolves, leaving behind a golden sphere of energy)

threads.claim: The moon is said to disappear during the festival, raising fear that the Ministry says is unfounded.
threads.quote: Is the moon really gonna disappear?

threads.claim: The eclipse ends as Zibai's canopy melts away and the full moon reappears.
threads.quote: (Zibai's Jadelight Canopy appears in the sky before melting away, revealing the full moon beneath)

threads.claim: The Moonchase Rite may have been an attempt to reach the White Horse Adeptus all along.
threads.quote: The moment Cloud Retainer saw it, it suddenly dawned on her that the Rite might have been an attempt to reach the White Horse Adeptus all along...

threads.claim: Lang-Gan fell to a heaven-sent fate, and the cause of its downfall is left open.
threads.quote: For all its splendor, do not forget that in the end, even Lang-Gan could not escape its heaven-sent fate.

threads.claim: Zibai denies being the one who defied the heavens, leaving her guilt in doubt.
threads.quote: Tch. As I have stated, time and again, it was not I who defied the heavens.

threads.claim: The relic writing called An Ancient Poem was initially undecoded and of unknown meaning.
threads.quote: When we first saw it, we couldn't figure out what it all meant

threads.claim: The poem's real title is Odes of Lang: Zibai, and it is a blessing ode to the moon and the White Horse Adeptus.
threads.quote: Ha, of course not! Its real title is "Odes of Lang: Zibai."

threads.claim: Records in Nod-Krai describe another divine envoy living on the moon, possibly related to the White Horse Adeptus.
