threads.quote: I found records in their collection of another divine envoy living on the moon!

threads.claim: Keqing has ideas she is following up on concerning the moon's obscuring and the Moonchase Rite.
threads.quote: This is probably what Keqing was referring to that day when she mentioned there were some ideas she wanted to follow up on...

threads.claim: Zibai bears marks inflicted by the Ruler of Time that Zhongli treats with caution.
threads.quote: Thus must I meet the marks wrought upon her by the Ruler of Time with great caution.

threads.claim: Adepti who leave their mountain refuges are always drawn back to mortal ways.
threads.quote: But once we leave our mountain refuge, we find ourselves drawn back to mortal ways all the same.

threads.claim: Ziqiao urges Lu Xiangxiang to find what she truly delights in rather than endure hardship for status.
threads.quote: Whatever delights you should not feel like a burden.

threads.claim: Zibai's past as a former angel and moon envoy is revealed, but her memories remain hazy.
threads.quote: Zibai: I was once an angel — a member of a race tasked with guiding humanity. Then, graced by serendipity, I became a moon envoy.

threads.claim: Moon envoys are a job title open to any angel or non-angel, and some may take animal forms.
threads.quote: Zibai: As you would understand it, a moon envoy is a job title. Any angel — or non-angel — can become a moon envoy.

threads.claim: Zibai's eye color shifts with her personality and mental state, from red to gold to blue.
threads.quote: Paimon: Look! Her eyes turned blue! That's gotta be a first...

threads.claim: Zibai's three spirits recently merged, and the Three Deadly Selves have shaped her temperament and memories.
threads.quote: Xiao: Hmm, the White Horse Adeptus's remnant spirit was attached to the Deadly Selves for a long time...

threads.claim: Zhongli was once the Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star, and his past remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Zibai: In days of yore, he was... the Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star.

threads.claim: Zibai claims she is certain Zhongli remembers his past, though she herself cannot recall it.
threads.quote: Zibai: Why not ask Rex Lapis himself? Whether I've forgotten might be up for debate, but I am certain he remembers.

threads.claim: Zhongli suggests Zibai was not from Liyue but may become a person of Liyue.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I believe she was not, but perhaps she will be.

threads.claim: The overnight growth of the tea tree was revealed to be Zibai transplanting a mature tree, not the Adeptus's miracle.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hey! You just transplanted a tea tree from over there!

threads.claim: Tao Dou's sealing is tied to the Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array, and Tao Dou was also known as Bune, god of the underworld.
threads.quote: Zibai: Hmm... Bune, the god of the underworld, who could pacify the forces of life and death...

threads.claim: Zibai hints at ancestors like the Wuwang Kid and the Lone Butterfly of the Crimson Flame tied to Hu Tao's family lineage.
threads.quote: Zibai: ...Are you heir to the Wuwang Kid... or perhaps the Lone Butterfly of the Crimson Flame?

threads.claim: Zibai recalls attending a distant feast where the Lord of Geo was present, a memory she has not fully recovered.
threads.quote: Zibai: In the distant past, there was a feast, which I attended. I faintly recall the Lord of Geo also being present that day...

threads.claim: Zibai offers to craft the broken jade token into a new trinket that may prove useful on the journey.
threads.quote: Zibai: I could try to craft it into a little trinket for you. One that might prove useful on your journey.

threads.claim: Zibai's lunar chariot is built from her memories of the chariot of the lunar palace.
threads.quote: Zibai: Hehe, I created it from my memories of the chariot of the lunar palace.

threads.claim: The people of Lang-Gan once revered Zibai as the God of Soil and Grain, linking her to farming and their lore.
threads.quote: Zibai: What's so strange about that? The people of Lang-Gan called me the "God of Soil and Grain." Are the fields not made of soil? Is rice not one of the five grains?

introduced.name: The Chasm: Underground Mines
introduced.how: a mining area whose caverns and mines are now leaking dark mud
introduced.quote: For reasons unknown, some dark mud-like substance has come pouring out of the caverns and mines of The Chasm lately.

introduced.name: Dark mud
introduced.how: a dangerous dark mud-like substance flowing out of The Chasm's mines
introduced.quote: For reasons unknown, some dark mud-like substance has come pouring out

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: a researcher who asked the Adventurers' Guild for help with the dark mud
introduced.quote: As such, Khedive has asked the Adventurers' Guild to send help...

introduced.name: Hosseini
introduced.how: self-introduction as an Akademiya researcher working on the Energy Amplifier
introduced.quote: I am Hosseini, a researcher at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Energy Amplifier
introduced.how: a device Hosseini has been working on
introduced.quote: I've been working on a device known as the Energy Amplifier

introduced.name: Pursina's Spike
introduced.how: a device that releases energy that disrupts the Ley Lines
introduced.quote: A device that can release energy that disrupts the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: lines through which outside elements enter, with openings that can be disrupted or sealed
introduced.quote: So, we can use the Spike to disrupt or even close the openings that allow the Ley Lines here to access external elements, which will stop the dark mud.

introduced.name: Tu
introduced.how: a miner who calls himself the Mining Superstar
introduced.quote: am I not Tu the Mining Superstar?

introduced.name: Hao (The Chasm)
introduced.how: a miner, introduced alongside Tu, who is affected by the mud
introduced.quote: The two miners, Tu and Hao, have headed back to rest.

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus Prize
introduced.how: an Akademiya prize for young researchers chosen by sages' votes
introduced.quote: This is a prize that the Akademiya gives out specially to young researchers.

introduced.name: House of Purbiruni
introduced.how: a school of researchers that Khedive belongs to
introduced.quote: Hosseini: Do you know of the Purbiruni? Khedive is from that school of researchers.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: the research institution Hosseini works for
introduced.quote: I am Hosseini, a researcher at the Akademiya.

assumed.name: Hosseini
assumed.quote: Oh, come on, didn't we just meet a short while ago?

assumed.name: Ruin Grader
assumed.quote: our observations of that special Ruin Grader on Tsurumi Island

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I even went to Inazuma to do some reference work there.

assumed.name: Electro
assumed.quote: I modified it such that it could only charge and operate through the use of Electro.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: The Mora will still go to them as compensation.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Khedive says that he's found a researcher from Sumeru who can help him out

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: I must say that Liyue's miners are made of stern stuff.

threads.claim: The cause of the dark mud pouring out of The Chasm is unknown.
threads.quote: For reasons unknown, some dark mud-like substance has come pouring out of the caverns and mines of The Chasm lately.

threads.claim: The dark mud is likely connected to anomalies in the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Well, they did appear based on anomalies in the Ley Lines, so it is very likely that they are related.

threads.claim: Sealing Ley Line openings rather than merely disrupting them is an untested method.
threads.quote: This is the first time I'm using the Spikes to "seal" them.

threads.claim: Sealing the Ley Line openings resolves the dark mud problem.
threads.quote: Our problem is, therefore, solved.

threads.claim: The dark mud is the Pursina's Spike's intended power source.
threads.quote: In fact, this dark mud is its power source.

threads.claim: Theories must be grounded and proven in reality, since the test run failed on unaccounted rock.
threads.quote: Indeed, theory is not a mere matter of imagination. Instead, it must be grounded and proven in reality.

threads.claim: The real entry point of the mud may lie somewhere other than the expected opening.
threads.quote: I don't think that such an opening would have been this easy to clear out, so the true entry point must be elsewhere...

threads.claim: The mud's entry point appears to be in the tunnels.
threads.quote: this means that the point through which the dark mud is flowing in is in the tunnels.

threads.claim: Dark mud attracts monsters, which may be affected by its energies.
threads.quote: Those monsters in The Chasm were attracted by the dark mud. I suspect that they must be affected by its energies.

threads.claim: Long-term exposure to the dark mud has severe consequences for people.
threads.quote: Long-term exposure to this mud will have severe consequences.

threads.claim: Hao touched the mud and feels lasting cold effects, with the outcome unknown.
threads.quote: I just hope there won't be any long-lasting side effects...

threads.claim: Hosseini owes Khedive a favor from earlier research funding.
threads.quote: I owe him a favor regarding research funds from way back...

threads.claim: Hosseini repays the favor, citing help he received from the Purbiruni school.
threads.quote: When I was at the Akademiya, I received quite a lot of help from that school, and so you can consider this a returning of that favor.

introduced.name: Archaeological Zones
introduced.how: replica relics are buried around Sumeru City and called Archaeological Zones
introduced.quote: Daneh: We have placed a lot of replica relics and buried them all around Sumeru City, and we term those places, at least for now, our Archaeological Zones.

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: a Darshan running an archaeology-themed game for the Gala
introduced.quote: Daneh: That's right. Vahumana is running an archaeology-themed game this time!

introduced.name: Bahador
introduced.how: a student from Spantamad who researches alchemy and the elements and runs the Domain event
introduced.quote: Bahador: Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Bahador from Spantamad, and our research lies in the field of alchemy, the elements, and topics like that...

introduced.name: Spantamad
introduced.how: a Darshan whose champions are numerous in Interdarshan history
introduced.quote: Huvishka: Aside from his skills as the General Mahamatra, looking back at the tournament's history, the Spantamad Darshan has the highest percentage of champions.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: an unexplored area the event sends players into, not a simple game
introduced.quote: Bahador: Well, I say it's an event, but really, it's... a Domain that awaits exploration.

introduced.name: Farbal
introduced.how: a Rtawahist student who makes a star-arranging astrolabe puzzle
introduced.quote: Farbal: You're... the Traveler, aren't you? I'm Farbal, from Rtawahist.

introduced.name: Darshan
introduced.how: academic groups inside the Akademiya, each with its own specializations
introduced.quote: Farbal: We study the stars... though that's not a very precise way of putting it. We do have a lot of specializations within the Darshan itself.

introduced.name: Haravatat
introduced.how: a Darshan that researches languages and runs a riddle game
introduced.quote: Bahar: That is what we research here at Haravatat.

introduced.name: Paz
introduced.how: an Amurta student who runs the animal-behavior imitation game
introduced.quote: Paz: In this game, I will introduce you to the behavioral patterns of certain animals.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: a Darshan that studies mechanics and architecture and runs the road-building game
introduced.quote: Daya: We study mechanics and architecture, yes.

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: an information seller who sells exclusive reports for Mora
introduced.quote: Dori: Have you decided to buy information from me?

introduced.name: Diadem of Knowledge
introduced.how: a valuable diadem only the champion could wear
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon remembers that only the champion was entitled to wear the diadem. It seemed very valuable!

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: a competition held in three rounds, the last one outside the city
introduced.quote: Kashmer: The Interdarshan Championship was also held that year. There were three rounds, the last of which was outside the city.

introduced.name: Kashmer
introduced.how: a man who as a six-year-old was lost outside the city and saw the diadem
introduced.quote: Dori: There's a young fellow named Kashmer from the suburbs. If you're interested in delving further, you could ask him.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: strange creatures that found a lost child and led him to the competition
introduced.quote: Kashmer: That's when I saw some strange creatures... I can't remember what they looked like.

introduced.name: Avidya Forest
introduced.how: a forest where the diadem may have been hidden
introduced.quote: Kashmer: It's probably in the Avidya Forest, but I've been back a few times, and I haven't found anything.

introduced.name: Arakasyapa
introduced.how: a person named in a hidden note who was taught to read by Nara
introduced.quote: Paimon: "The good Nara taught Arakasyapa how to read. Arakasyapa must protect the good Nara..."

introduced.name: Sachin
introduced.how: a Vahumana scholar who sponsored the Akademiya Extravaganza and gave the diadem
introduced.quote: Paimon: The guy who sponsored the Akademiya Extravaganza! Paimon heard that the prize money and Diadem of Knowledge came from him.

introduced.name: Sachin's Article
introduced.how: a personal travel journal signed by Sachin, held by Suhayb
introduced.quote: Suhayb: It seems like you guys really don't know. Some time ago, I had the article appraised. Turns out, it's nothing more than a personal travel journal, and is of little value.

introduced.name: Valley of Dahri
introduced.how: a desert valley where an Eremite commander is usually found
introduced.quote: Wiqas: If you're interested, you can find the Eremite commander in the desert. He's usually in the Valley of Dahri.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: a village where a man with a changed personality was seen
introduced.quote: Dori: Well, it looks like someone saw him in Aaru Village. I wonder where he ended up?

introduced.name: Rishti
introduced.how: an Aaru Village resident who recalls a young man who helped the village twenty years ago
introduced.quote: Rishti: Twenty years ago... a young man did appear here.

introduced.name: Wiqas
introduced.how: a planning committee member who was five years old when the incident happened
introduced.quote: Wiqas: Not exactly. I was five years old when it happened. How could I know?

introduced.name: Huvishka
introduced.how: a former student who recalls his friend who competed in the Championship
introduced.quote: Huvishka: At that time, my friend also participated in the game, and I went there to cheer for him.

introduced.name: Vasudeva
introduced.how: a man who reminisces about the Championship as a stage for young talent
introduced.quote: Vasudeva: Alas, seeing these young children, I can't help but reminisce about the past.

introduced.name: Suhayb
introduced.how: a fierce man who keeps Sachin's article after his father was hired to guard Sachin
introduced.quote: Suhayb: He hired my father to keep him safe. That Sachin fellow would often walk, ask, write, and mumble.

introduced.name: Kaveh
introduced.how: a man whose father was tied to Sachin's estate and the diadem
introduced.quote: Kaveh: Twenty years ago, the Akademiya had just received Sachin's estate. To celebrate the huge investment, the Akademiya Extravaganza that year was grander than usual.

introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.how: a scholar who debates Kaveh about Sachin's research
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: I don't recall being obligated to report my whereabouts to you.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Dori: I'll sell it to you for the fixed price of one million Mora!

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: Dori: Well, well, if it isn't and Paimon, yet again!

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Huvishka: For this year's Interdarshan Championship, my favorite has to be Cyno.

assumed.name: Elemental Reactions
assumed.quote: Bahador: And there was no way we could run some demonstration of Elemental Reactions.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Bahador: In the end, I had to ask the Adventurers' Guild for help, and it was with their aid that I found this Domain.

assumed.name: Alhaitham and Kaveh's rivalry
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: That's fine. We've been arguing over this for years, and I don't hold any hope of you understanding.

threads.claim: Sachin's reason for sponsoring the Akademiya Extravaganza is raised as an open question.
threads.quote: Dori: Well... Here's some food for thought. Why did Sachin sponsor the Akademiya Extravaganza?

threads.claim: The Diadem of Knowledge was lost once before after being donated to the Akademiya, and this is kept secret.
threads.quote: Dori: Yet this very diadem, after it was donated to the Akademiya, was lost by them once before!

threads.claim: A senior colleague claims he lost the diadem briefly and covered it up.
threads.quote: Wiqas: I only remember that he said that he lost the Diadem of Knowledge for a while.

threads.claim: Kaveh says he destroyed the diadem, ending its story.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Don't worry. I... I destroyed the diadem. There will never be another tragedy like this again. Never again...

threads.claim: A hidden account of an incident twenty years ago is offered, with witnesses.
threads.quote: Dori: Of course, this information doesn't come from nowhere. I've got witnesses, too.

threads.claim: Kashmer saw an Aranara dragging the crown and hiding it in a hollow tree.
threads.quote: Kashmer: Just when I was disheartened, I suddenly saw one of those strange creatures slowly dragging a crown along.

threads.claim: The Aranara are linked to the lost child and the competition.
threads.quote: Kashmer: They took me to the competition.

threads.claim: A hidden note links Nara and Arakasyapa in an unexplained duty to protect.
threads.quote: Paimon: "The good Nara taught Arakasyapa how to read. Arakasyapa must protect the good Nara..."

threads.claim: Sachin's notes claim everyone is both victim and perpetrator, raising a theme about human nature.
threads.quote: Everyone is a victim, but everyone is also a perpetrator.

threads.claim: A survivor's account says people are the most terrifying animals in the world.
threads.quote: ...people are the most terrifying animals in this world.

threads.claim: Kaveh's father left for the desert and was lost to quicksand after Sachin's influence.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Later, he left home, saying that he wanted to do some investigating in the desert... The quicksand got him not long after that...

threads.claim: Kaveh realizes his father went into the desert because of Sachin's influence.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Hah. So that's why he thought I looked familiar. My father must've gone into the desert due to his influence...

introduced.how: mysterious medicine said to multiply strength
introduced.name: Smoldersleet Elixir
introduced.quote: This is a sort of mysterious medicine that has emerged of late.

introduced.how: title for the artisan who made the Smoldersleet Elixir
introduced.name: Elixir Artificer
introduced.quote: Aren't only big shot artisans called something fancy like an "artificer?"

introduced.how: ancient perfume specialist who is the Elixir Artificer
introduced.name: Ying'er
introduced.quote: The "Smoldersleet Elixir" you seek is just an ancient perfume that is my specialty.

introduced.how: southern part of Liyue Harbor
introduced.name: Chihu Rock
introduced.quote: the southern part of Liyue Harbor is known as Chihu Rock

introduced.how: harbor whose southern area houses the Elixir Artificer
introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: someone who lives in the southern area of Liyue Harbor.

introduced.how: blend of perfume-making and alchemical potions
introduced.name: Smoldersleet Potion
introduced.quote: They're a combination of your perfume-making techniques and the features of alchemical potions together

introduced.how: local resident who does not know the Elixir Artificer
introduced.name: Brother Qian
introduced.quote: I'm afraid someone of my station wouldn't know anyone like that.

introduced.how: neighbor who knows proper recorded names
introduced.name: Hongyi
introduced.quote: I'm not very familiar with the nicknames that my neighbors have, only their proper recorded names.

assumed.name: Timaeus
assumed.quote: It's you two! It's been a while, hasn't it?

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: produce results that Mr. Albedo will acknowledge!

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: How about asking Sucrose?

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: You could ask Lisa.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Our help lies not in Mondstadt... but in Liyue.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Liyue, huh... That's a long way out.

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: Better watch out, because Paimon's gonna eat every signature dish at Wanmin Restaurant.

threads.claim: The Smoldersleet Elixir may be a powerful alchemical medicine from Liyue.
threads.quote: According to the author, the Smoldersleet Elixir originates in Liyue, and it can cause the strength of its user to multiply.

threads.claim: The Smoldersleet Elixir is actually an ancient perfume, not an alchemical medicine.
threads.quote: The "Smoldersleet Elixir" you seek is just an ancient perfume that is my specialty.

threads.claim: A poem hints the Elixir Artificer lives in the southern part of Liyue Harbor.
threads.quote: The artificer amidst quiet doors hides, the scented wind in the harbor abides.

threads.claim: The Elixir Artificer is Ying'er.
threads.quote: Does this mean that Ms. Ying'er *is* the Elixir Artificer?

threads.claim: Timaeus seeks Albedo's acknowledgment to become his assistant.
threads.quote: I might even be able to become his assistant and stay with him at his encampment permanently

threads.claim: Combining ancient perfume-making with alchemy creates the Smoldersleet Potion.
threads.quote: It's a success! I finally succeeded in combining ancient perfume-making with alchemical agents!

threads.claim: Adepti elixirs may exist as comparably powerful elixirs.
threads.quote: Why, it's almost as if they had truly used an adepti elixir.

threads.claim: The Smoldersleet Potion now works only within a set area such as a Domain.
threads.quote: we must somehow contain the sublimated substances within a set area.

threads.claim: Timaeus plans to thank Ying'er with a letter instead of speaking to her.
threads.quote: Maybe I'll have to ask you to help me deliver a letter.

threads.claim: Aromas can affect a person's temperament and character.
threads.quote: human temperament and character can be affected by being steeped in aromas and lovely scents.

threads.claim: Liyue has uninhabited domains suitable for testing the potion.
threads.quote: I've heard that Liyue has some domains in which no one sets foot.

introduced.name: Vinkel
introduced.how: new Guild recruiter on his first official job, eager to impress
introduced.quote: This is my first official job in the Guild, and I'm determined to leave a perfect impression!

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: Guild figure who named the event and set its test-based rationale
introduced.quote: Jack has named the event "Across the Wilderness."

introduced.name: Across the Wilderness
introduced.how: Guild event where adventurers collect balloons within a time limit for rating and rewards
introduced.quote: The more Wilderness Balloons one collects within the time limit, the higher the rating and the greater the rewards will be.

introduced.name: Wilderness Balloons
introduced.how: special balloons that resist arrows and pop only at close range
introduced.quote: These balloons are no ordinary balloons. They can withstand arrows from afar and will only be popped from close range.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: The Adventurers' Guild is holding an event?

assumed.name: Master Cyrus
assumed.quote: I'm sure Jack and Master Cyrus will be thrilled!

threads.claim: Past similar events saw adventurers repeatedly popping balloons with arrows, prompting the Guild to customize new balloons.
threads.quote: When similar events were held before, the first thing most adventurers did when they saw the balloons was to pop them with their arrows.

threads.claim: Jack frames the event as a test of observation, fundamentals, and discipline, and Vinkel does not fully understand his reasoning.
threads.quote: Searching for the balloons is a test of the adventurers' observation skills, while venturing forward in different situations is a test of their fundamentals...

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: organizes the Test of Courage event and offers prizes to participants
introduced.quote: The Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage event! They've even prepared rewards for participants who can pass the event's challenges!

introduced.name: Test of Courage (Event Quest)
introduced.how: a team game in Chinju Forest meant to test courage, played over three rounds of item hunts
introduced.quote: As its name implies, the event is a game designed to put one's courage to the test.

introduced.name: Chinju Forest
introduced.how: the forest where the Test of Courage venue is set up
introduced.quote: The venue for the event will be set up in the Chinju Forest.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: one of three backers of the event, providing the grounds
introduced.quote: Merchants raised event funding, the Kamisato Clan provided the grounds, and the Grand Narukami Shrine provided consulting services.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine (Faction)
introduced.how: one of three backers, consults on the event and provides the grand prize
introduced.quote: If a participant manages to find all three items, then they shall receive the grand prize provided by the Grand Narukami Shrine.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: a gang led by Itto whose members are not keen on the event
introduced.quote: As leader of the Arataki Gang, it's my duty to find new and tantalizing experiences for everyone.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: leader of the Arataki Gang who wants to scare people at the event
introduced.quote: Huh, Paimon knows that voice... It's Itto! What are you doing here?

introduced.name: Dango Milk
introduced.how: the round-one item, a drink hidden in the forest and supplied by Tomoki
introduced.quote: Tomoki was kind enough to provide us with his Dango Milk and it has been hidden somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

introduced.name: Akitsu Yuugei
introduced.how: a mysterious flipper-and-ball game that appeared on the beach with no owner
introduced.quote: That's right. Some time ago, a peculiar game was discovered on the beach.

introduced.name: Akitsu Hazura
introduced.how: a festival game of hitting a ball toward a target with hagoita paddles, the origin of Akitsu Yuugei
introduced.quote: It's a game where you use hagoita to hit a ball towards a set target.

introduced.name: Heizou
introduced.how: an investigator sent by a commission to look into the beach game
introduced.quote: The truth is, I was commissioned to come here for an investigation.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: wanted to close the beach to investigate the rumors
introduced.quote: The Tenryou Commission wanted to close the beach in order to investigate the situation and dispel the rumors

introduced.name: Hyakkiyakou
introduced.how: a youkai community that once thrived in Inazuma but is now gone
introduced.quote: Hyakkiyakou was still around at that time, and nights in Inazuma were much more lively than they are now.

introduced.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
introduced.how: a youkai festival of drinking, music and games in the past
introduced.quote: Yes. The youkai called their celebration the "Mikawa Flower Festival."

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: spirit-like beings who held festivals in the past
introduced.quote: The youkai would hold festivals from time to time, gathering to drink, laugh, and play music...

introduced.name: Youko
introduced.how: Introduced as one of three youkai who planned the festival and says they are little youkai in the wilderness
introduced.quote: Youko: Ahem, well, the truth is... we were planning a festival.

introduced.name: Kappa
introduced.how: Kappa explains that youkai in the wilderness are attacked by monsters until human adventurers drove them off
introduced.quote: Kappa: Mm-hmm. You see, we live in the wilderness and are frequently attacked by monsters.

introduced.name: Hitotsume Kozou
introduced.how: Hitotsume Kozou admits the youkai built the Akitsu Yuugei game and set up stalls in the forest
introduced.quote: Hitotsume Kozou: Yep, that was us! Have you tried it yet? Isn't it fun?

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: Itto identifies the three ghostly figures as youkai from a field guide
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: There's Youko, Kappa, and Hitotsume Kozou! They're all youkai.

introduced.name: Oni
introduced.how: Legends say oni are grouchy, extremely strong, and crush other youkai to eat them
introduced.quote: Hitotsume Kozou: According to legends, oni are grouchy, extremely strong, and crush other youkai into balls to eat them up!

introduced.name: Hyakkiyakou
introduced.how: Described as a past era of powerful youkai that has long since ended
introduced.quote: Youko: The times of Hyakkiyakou are long gone, we're just a bunch of little youkai living in the wilderness.

introduced.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
introduced.how: A festival once hosted by top youkai, which the youkai aspire to recreate
introduced.quote: Youko: The Mikawa Flower Festival is meant to bring happiness to all who attend, and Akitsu Hazura is a symbol of friendship.

introduced.name: Akitsu Hazura
introduced.how: A legendary youkai game and symbol of friendship, now lost to time
introduced.quote: Hitotsume Kozou: We drew inspiration from the legendary Akitsu Hazura. It took a lot of youkai power to set it up.

introduced.name: Akitsu Yuugei
introduced.how: A game the youkai made as a version of Akitsu Hazura, based on a merchant's description
introduced.quote: Youko: Unfortunately, the real Akitsu Hazura has been lost to time. What we created is a version of the game we heard about from a wandering merchant, so we changed the name to Akitsu Yuugei.

introduced.name: Kamai Kenji
introduced.how: A prominent youkai in a legend who invites a human samurai to join the festival
introduced.quote: Kamai Kenji: This is our festival, and the point is to have fun!

introduced.name: Yanagibashi Takuto
introduced.how: A human samurai from the legend who is traveling to find strong opponents and agrees to a duel rivalry
introduced.quote: Yanagibashi Takuto: Yes, I'm currently traveling the world in search of formidable opponents

introduced.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a wandering samurai who escaped Inazuma with help from the Kamisato Clan
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Yes, that's me, but I'm afraid that I'm no lord... just a wandering samurai.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: Introduced as Kazuha's helper from the Kamisato Clan, the sister of its head
introduced.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: The head of the Kamisato Clan also lent me his assistance at the time. By the way, this is his sister.

introduced.name: Heizou
introduced.how: Presented as a detective who sees his job as uncovering the truth behind mysteries
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Fear arises from mystery, and it's a detective's job to unearth the truth from the mystery.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Heizou is identified as belonging to the Tenryou Commission
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Hmm? Oh, you're the Tenryou Commission's...

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: Itto reveals he leads his own gang whose members each have a special title
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Oh — I should mention that, uh, I even have my own gang, and every member has a special title!

introduced.name: Test of Courage (Event Quest)
introduced.how: A contest with rounds where players need partners and must find an item in a haunted forest
introduced.quote: Shrine Maiden: Mwahahaha... Congratulations on winning the first round of the Test of Courage.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine (Faction)
introduced.how: Its special prize requires winning all three rounds of the Test of Courage
introduced.quote: Thoma: You've probably already heard that to win the Grand Narukami Shrine's special prize. You have to win all three rounds.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Provided the staff for the event and chose the fan item
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: The Dango Milk was chosen by the merchant who funded the event, and the fan was chosen by the Yashiro Commission, which provided the staff.

introduced.name: Dango Milk
introduced.how: An item hidden in the event that was chosen by the merchant who funded it
introduced.quote: Yoimiya: By the way, I heard you were the winners. Impressive! I eventually found the hidden Dango Milk too, but it was already too late.

introduced.name: Fan
introduced.how: The item to find in round two, with fireworks printed on it, hidden in Chinju Forest
introduced.quote: Shrine Maiden: Correct. The fan was personally selected by the Yashiro Commissioner himself, and has been placed somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

introduced.name: Chinju Forest
introduced.how: The dark forest where the Test of Courage's second round takes place
introduced.quote: Shrine Maiden: Correct. The fan was personally selected by the Yashiro Commissioner himself, and has been placed somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: A strong creature that Yoimiya collects for a tournament
introduced.quote: Yoimiya: And pretty strong ones, from the looks of it. I'll hold on to them! Hehe, they'll come in real handy for the next Onikabuto tournament!

introduced.name: Legend of the youkai and samurai festival
introduced.how: A story of a human samurai and youkai who made friends and dueled at a festival hundreds of years ago
introduced.quote: Youko: It's the story of youkai meeting a human during a festival hundreds of years ago.

introduced.name: Hanyuuda Chizuru
introduced.how: Self-introduction: she is a youkai who now goes by the name Chizuru
introduced.quote: Hanyuuda Chizuru: ...Don't bother. You may call me Hanyuuda Chizuru, that is the name I go by now.

introduced.name: Tsukumogami
introduced.how: A youkai born from an object that takes a human form away from its body, with power that weakens with distance
introduced.quote: You're a youkai that emerged from an object and assumed a human form outside of your own body...

introduced.name: Hagoita
introduced.how: A pair of battledore paddles that is Chizuru's original form, used by Kamai and the samurai in Akitsu Hazura
introduced.quote: The pair of hagoita used by Kamai and the human samurai to play Akitsu Hazura hundreds of years ago.

introduced.name: Akitsu Hazura
introduced.how: A hagoita paddle game that Kamai and the samurai played together
introduced.quote: The pair of hagoita used by Kamai and the human samurai to play Akitsu Hazura hundreds of years ago.

introduced.name: Yanagibashi Takuto
introduced.how: The samurai who befriended Kamai; founder of the Souran Isshin Art
introduced.quote: That samurai's name was Yanagibashi Takuto, who also happens to be the founder of the Souran Isshin Art.

introduced.name: Souran Isshin Art
introduced.how: A swordsmanship school founded by Yanagibashi Takuto, shaped by his duel with Kamai
introduced.quote: That samurai's name was Yanagibashi Takuto, who also happens to be the founder of the Souran Isshin Art.

introduced.name: Tominaga Masanari
introduced.how: Third-generation heir of the Souran Isshin Art who befriended Kamai and fought beside him
introduced.quote: It is believed that Takuto developed this style of swordsmanship while dueling with Kamai, who had also befriended the third-generation heir of the Souran Isshin Art, Tominaga Masanari.

introduced.name: Kamai and the samurai's friendship
introduced.how: The full story of the friendship across decades, from first meeting and rivalry to the samurai's old age and farewell
introduced.quote: The samurai was about twenty-five years old when they met at the festival

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: Youkai live longer than humans and have different natures, yet share the world and interact with humans
introduced.quote: We youkai are different from humans, we have longer lifespans and different natures... But we share the same world, we interact with one another, we are drawn to one another, and will eventually part ways.

introduced.name: Sleeping powder
introduced.how: A powder Chizuru scattered that made people dizzy when inhaled while tense
introduced.quote: Because you were already tensed up, you were breathing more rapidly and inhaled a lot of sleeping powder that she had sprinkled around the area.

introduced.name: Shade cloth
introduced.how: Black cloth that blocks light, used for stage settings; here used as a prop to create the scare
introduced.quote: Ah, this is a piece of shade cloth.

introduced.name: Staged Test of Courage
introduced.how: The Test of Courage's frightening events were arranged by Lady Yae as a plan, not real hauntings
introduced.quote: Shrine Maiden: I apologize for causing you concern. It was actually Lady Yae's idea...

assumed.name: Ayato
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ayato~!

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Oh, and Paimon! Greetings!

assumed.name: Gorou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Gorou!

assumed.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
assumed.quote: Paimon: Kazuha!

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Oh, hello. Miko told me about the Test of Courage event taking place here.

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ei?

assumed.name: Ushi
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: It's time, Ushi! Let's give 'em a scare! Heeheehee.

assumed.name: Makoto
assumed.quote: Makoto also enjoyed playing Akitsu Hazura when she was alive.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Island
assumed.quote: I would like to buy some to bring back to Watatsumi Island.

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: I shall return to Tenshukaku.

assumed.name: Lady Guuji
assumed.quote: As for its true value, I'm afraid you'll have to win the event first and ask Lady Guuji yourself.

assumed.name: Heizou
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm, Paimon wonders if the shrine maiden knows anything about what Heizou told us... Let's go ask her.

assumed.name: Arataki Itto
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Hey, you guys finally made it!

assumed.name: Yoimiya
assumed.quote: Yoimiya: Heya , Paimon! I had a feeling you two would be here!

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Thoma! Wait, were you also a contestant in the first round?

assumed.name: Sayu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Sayu! Are you here for the Test of Courage, too?

assumed.name: Ushi
assumed.quote: Paimon: A big bull-headed beast... Wait, that sounds like Ushi!

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah, the festival that Ei mentioned!

assumed.name: Ayato
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Oh, so my bro Ayato is here for the Test of Courage, too?

assumed.name: Gorou
assumed.quote: Kappa: I'm not sure why, but I feel so relaxed when talking with you, General Gorou.

assumed.name: Her Excellency
assumed.quote: Gorou: Those were Her Excellency's remarks in the directive.

assumed.name: Lavender Melon
assumed.quote: Sayu: Ah! It's a... Lavender Melon ghost!

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Paimon: When it comes to having connections in Inazuma, nobody can beat Paimon and !

assumed.name: Shikanoin Heizou
assumed.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: I'd like your assistance with this investigation, since you two are the only ones who have seen the alleged ghost.

assumed.name: Test of Courage
assumed.quote: please let me be your partner for the final round of the Test of Courage.

assumed.name: Kamai Kenji
assumed.quote: Youko: We long admired the friendship between Lord Kamai and the Samurai.

assumed.name: Akitsu Yuugei
assumed.quote: we had a great time playing Akitsu Yuugei together, didn't we?

assumed.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
assumed.quote: Youko: Which is why we want to hold the Mikawa Flower Festival, to return the favor we once received from the humans.

assumed.name: Chinju Forest
assumed.quote: The Chinju Forest covers a large area, so it'd be great to have more help in the investigation.

assumed.name: Arataki Itto
assumed.quote: Paimon: Itto! What are you doing here?

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayato: It would have been uninteresting had I told her what was going to happen ahead of time.

assumed.name: Kitsune Saiguu
assumed.quote: I followed Kitsune Saiguu around the Mikawa Flower Festival one year and saw her play Akitsu Hazura.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Yae Miko: Excellent work. You've figured it all out.

threads.claim: Test of Courage events are said to attract strange rumors and stories, hinting that the forest may hold real spooky things.
threads.quote: Test of Courage events tend to give rise to a variety of strange rumors and stories, so please, be sure to exercise caution.

threads.claim: The travelers encounter apparently ghostly figures and begin to wonder whether the strange rumors are true.
threads.quote: So all the strange rumors about the Test of Courage are true...

threads.claim: Some of the eerie hidden voices are staff members paid to scare participants, which answers part of the ghost question.
threads.quote: Shh! Please, not a word of this to anyone! Otherwise, they'll dock my pay.

threads.claim: The beach game operates on its own with no one supervising it, raising the question of who runs it.
threads.quote: And stranger yet, it could operate normally without anyone supervising it.

threads.claim: The Yashiro Commission may have helped hide the beach game's true origin, and its motive is unclear.
threads.quote: Who set up the game on the beach? And why did the Yashiro Commission help them cover it up?

threads.claim: The Yashiro Commission appears to have known about the spooky events yet still held the Test of Courage, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Wait, so the Yashiro Commission were fully aware of all the spooky stuff going on, but they still decided to hold their event here?

threads.claim: A player was reportedly trapped on the beach, unable to leave and unseen by friends nearby.
threads.quote: According to his own account, he kept returning to the same location no matter which way he went, and even though his friends were nearby, they couldn't see him.

threads.claim: Heizou is secretly investigating the beach game and its connection to the Yashiro Commission.
threads.quote: I need to uncover the truth, so I'm here to investigate.

threads.claim: A mysterious spirit warns that staying in the forest will trap souls forever.
threads.quote: If you value your lives, you must leave immediately. Otherwise, your souls will be trapped here forever.

threads.claim: The lively past of Hyakkiyakou and the youkai festivals has largely vanished from Inazuma.
threads.quote: Sadly, the past has all but vanished.

threads.claim: A mysterious woman dressed as a youkai who threatened the group earlier is identified, but the youkai deny knowing her, suggesting she may be a ghost.
threads.quote: Youko: *gulp* I—I'm not sure who it was you met...

threads.claim: The Traveler recalls meeting a lady dressed up who may not be a youkai at all.
threads.quote: Traveler: Wait a minute, we did meet some lady who was all dressed up...

threads.claim: Someone was reportedly trapped inside Akitsu Yuugei, and the youkai deny having caused it.
threads.quote: Traveler: We heard that someone had been trapped in Akitsu Yuugei.

threads.claim: The blue-haired man who watched the youkai at the game is suspected to be Ayato, who may have known about them.
threads.quote: Traveler: It must have been Ayato.

threads.claim: Itto raises the question of whether real ghosts are haunting the Chinju Forest after the youkai deny the strange events.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: But if it wasn't you guys... does that mean there are real ghosts out here!?

threads.claim: Paimon concludes the strange events were caused by the little youkai rather than ghosts.
threads.quote: Paimon: Well anyway, seems like all the strange things we saw earlier were caused by these little youkai, not ghosts. What a relief...

threads.claim: The shrine maiden has vanished, leaving a hurried message on the bulletin board that hints at a possible disappearance.
threads.quote: Paimon: Uhh, hellooo? Miss shrine maiden...? Strange, she isn't here.

threads.claim: The third-round item is a hagoita whose significance to the Grand Narukami Shrine is unexplained.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: So, does the hagoita, which should have been chosen by the Grand Narukami Shrine, have any unique significance?

threads.claim: Statues in the forest seem to turn toward the group, an unexplained phenomenon.
threads.quote: Paimon: W—W—Wait a minute! Was that statue always facing this way?

threads.claim: Kamai Kenji and Yanagibashi Takuto agreed to a duel every ten years, a promise that may recur later.
threads.quote: Kamai Kenji: We meet for a duel every ten years, whaddya say?

threads.claim: The legend of the youkai and samurai friendship is presented as a model for bonds between youkai and humans.
threads.quote: Youko: And you also have a great friendship. Just like Lord Kamai and the samurai...

threads.claim: Heizou says it is not yet possible to tell whether the woman is really a ghost.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: Of course, we cannot conclude whether the woman is actually a ghost or not at this point.

threads.claim: Heizou concludes the woman is not a ghost but a person using props and sleeping powder to scare people.
threads.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: I'm almost certain that the woman you encountered was not a ghost.

threads.claim: Heizou suspects Chizuru's true form is a pair of hagoita, which is still unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Your true form is this pair of hagoita, isn't it?

threads.claim: Heizou explains Chizuru gained sentience from youkai power and is rotting after hundreds of years.
threads.quote: You gradually developed sentience after being influenced by great youkai power.

threads.claim: Chizuru says the youkai do not know the entire story of Kamai and the samurai.
threads.quote: But they don't actually know the entire story.

threads.claim: The story shows the samurai aging while Kamai stays young, and their friendship turning into regret.
threads.quote: Kamai discovered that the samurai was already sixty-five years old

threads.claim: Yae Miko reveals Kamai's regret was resolved when Tominaga fought beside him and inherited Yanagibashi's sword.
threads.quote: Five hundred years ago, Kamai and Tominaga fought side by side until their final moments, and the sword Tominaga wielded was passed down from Yanagibashi.

threads.claim: Chizuru asks whether it is worthwhile for youkai to interact with humans, given the pain of parting.
threads.quote: Is it really worthwhile for us youkai to interact with humans?

threads.claim: Yae Miko says friendship between youkai and humans is not broken by parting but carried on in a new form.
threads.quote: However, the bond formed by friendship will not be broken, but rather, carried on in a new form.

threads.claim: Chizuru reveals she was hiding on the beach, waiting for the last of her days.
threads.quote: I was hiding on this beach, waiting for the last of my days.

threads.claim: Chizuru vanishes after the festival, leaving her fate unresolved.
threads.quote: (Chizuru disappears, leaving the Traveler standing alone by the shore)

threads.claim: Heizou notes the client was stranded on the beach by an unusual power that props alone could not explain.
threads.quote: The person who commissioned my investigation did become stranded on the beach as a result of some unusual power.

threads.claim: Chizuru admits she used her youkai power on a greedy thief who wanted to steal festival decorations.
threads.quote: That's why I used my youkai power to teach him a lesson.

threads.claim: Yae Miko senses Chizuru's youkai power on the beach and recalls her as a youkai seen at a past festival.
threads.quote: I went for a stroll on the beach some time ago and sensed a familiar youkai power.

threads.claim: Yae Miko reveals she arranged the Test of Courage to help Chizuru face her regret.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: When Ayato approached me about holding the Test of Courage event, it dawned on me that this would be the perfect opportunity to help Chizuru face her problem.

threads.claim: Chizuru recalls that the loser of Akitsu Yuugei grants the winner a wish, and she once wished never to cross paths again.
threads.quote: When we played Akitsu Yuugei, Paimon said the loser would have to grant the winner a wish.

threads.claim: Chizuru makes her final wish that the Traveler's journey be filled with joy like a festival.
threads.quote: I wish that every day of your journey ahead will be filled with joy like a festival.

introduced.name: alchemical potions shop
introduced.how: A shop selling alchemical potions, run with the Traveler, whose sales data feeds Lisa's research
introduced.quote: we've already collected enough sales data for our research

introduced.name: alchemical potions industry
introduced.how: Potions could become a major new revenue source for all of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: the potions industry could end up becoming a new revenue stream for the entire region of Mondstadt

introduced.name: Lisa's earlier research career
introduced.how: Lisa did research in the past and has now returned to it for this venture
introduced.quote: Plus, it was fun to get back into research.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: , Paimon, it's been a long time.

assumed.name: Lisa's library
assumed.quote: Seeing you cooped up in that library all the time, I was worried you might be bored.

assumed.name: Knights
assumed.quote: All the help from the Knights and really helped to lessen the load.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I never imagined that you'd be able to bring in so much Mora in such a short amount of time...

assumed.name: headquarters
assumed.quote: was just about to go report back to you at headquarters.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: for the entire region of Mondstadt

threads.claim: Alchemical potions may grow into a major economic force for Mondstadt.
threads.quote: the potions industry could end up becoming a new revenue stream for the entire region of Mondstadt

threads.claim: Lisa has a past in research that she misses and occasionally revisits.
threads.quote: It's nice to relive those days every once in a while.

threads.claim: Lisa invites the Traveler to keep running the shop, leaving its future open.
threads.quote: if you're interested in continuing to run the shop, you'd make me a very happy Lisa.

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: a beetle used in duels that can be huge and can flip an opponent's beetle over
introduced.quote: Mamoru: He used a ridiculously huge Onikabuto and flipped Boss's beetle over in a matter of seconds.

introduced.name: Electro affinity
introduced.how: an Onikabuto's Electro affinity is the source of its power and matters more than its paint color
introduced.quote: Elyctra: Pathetic! You can paint your Onikabuto any color you want... the only thing that counts in battle is their Electro affinity — the source of their power.

introduced.name: Crimson Staff
introduced.how: Itto's red Onikabuto, trained for years, whose special qualities are kept secret
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Next up, time to show you my invincible Onikabuto, "Crimson Staff."

introduced.name: Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King
introduced.how: a title for the top beetle fighter that a challenger can win by defeating its holder
introduced.quote: Akira: Some little phony was going around calling himself the "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King," and Boss couldn't put up with that. So Boss challenged him and said whoever wins gets the title.

introduced.name: Grandmaster Hanakado
introduced.how: a self-styled beetle fighter who challenged Itto and beat his beetle quickly
introduced.quote: Mamoru: That's right. Some poser calling himself "Grandmaster Hanakado" challenged the Boss in a brief moment of exhaustion after an intense beetle battling session.

introduced.name: Elyctra
introduced.how: one of Grandmaster Hanakado's generals who fights beetle battles and values Electro affinity
introduced.quote: Elyctra: What a puny opponent... And what a garish Onikabuto...

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the body where events must be registered to get a permit
introduced.quote: Akira: Based on our experience with the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, we'll need to register the event with the Tenryou Commission and obtain a permit... and I think we also need proof of a venue rental.

introduced.name: Hanamizaka
introduced.how: the beetle-battling scene where Itto first competed against the pros
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Gets me thinking about myself, back in the day, when I first entered the Hanamizaka beetle-battling scene... taking on the pros for the first time...

introduced.name: Ramen voucher
introduced.how: a coupon for one free bowl of ramen daily from Hanakado's family stall, given for returning the title
introduced.quote: Mamoru: But the kid offered Boss a "One Free Bowl of Ramen Daily" coupon from his family's ramen stall in exchange for giving the title back in two months.

introduced.name: Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl
introduced.how: Itto's planned beetle-fighting event that the gang must organize
introduced.quote: Akira: But we don't know when Shinobu's coming back. Where do we even start with organizing the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl?

assumed.name: Kuki Shinobu
assumed.quote: Akira: But we don't know when Shinobu's coming back.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Off to the Adventurers' Guild we go, . Who knows, maybe Katheryne already has something lined up.

assumed.name: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival
assumed.quote: Akira: Based on our experience with the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, we'll need to register the event with the Tenryou Commission and obtain a permit... and I think we also need proof of a venue rental.

assumed.name: Irodori Festival
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: I heard this is the spot where they held the sword-fighting contest during the Irodori Festival. That makes this the ideal venue for Onikabuto duels!

assumed.name: Arataki Gang
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Where's your Arataki Gang attitude? Come on, I'll find a way to deal with this, easy-peasy lavender-melon-squeezy!

assumed.name: Naganohara Fireworks
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Maybe I can hit up my usual beetle-fighting crowd... Or maybe I can visit Naganohara Fireworks and see if I can rope that gal into it...

threads.claim: Itto won the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King title after a marathon fight, but the title is to be returned in exchange for ramen.
threads.quote: Akira: After 92 brutal rounds of beetle-battling that lasted one full day and night, the Boss finally emerged victorious!

threads.claim: Shinobu is away on unfinished business for an unspecified time and is not available to help organize events.
threads.quote: I have yet to complete my business, so I won't be back for a while.

threads.claim: Shinobu's letter suggests Hanakado is a kid she met who might join the Arataki Gang and was sent to find Itto.
threads.quote: I gave him the addresses of some of your usual haunts so that he can find you himself.

threads.claim: Itto is hiding what makes Crimson Staff special, implying a secret behind the beetle's strength.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: Haha! Go ahead, feast your eyes! But I'm afraid I can't tell you what makes Crimson Staff such a special specimen. That's my little secret!

threads.claim: A familiar smell from Crimson Staff hints that Valberry Jam is connected to the beetle's secret.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? That smells so familiar, what is that... wait, Valberry Jam?

threads.claim: Elyctra asserts that an Onikabuto's Electro affinity, not its appearance, decides battles, raising whether this is true.
threads.quote: Elyctra: Pathetic! You can paint your Onikabuto any color you want... the only thing that counts in battle is their Electro affinity — the source of their power.

threads.claim: Itto and Hanakado dispute their round totals, and Hanakado claims the home-venue advantage makes his win superior.
threads.quote: Grandmaster Hanakado: No, I won 571 rounds, so I'm ahead. Also, you have the home advantage.

threads.claim: The location of the ramen stall tied to the voucher is unknown to the group.
threads.quote: Paimon: Bull-Chucker didn't tell us which ramen stall this voucher's meant to be used at...

introduced.name: Phlogiston Honey Pearl
introduced.how: a patterned jewel made by Phlogiston Aphids that has been circulating in the market
introduced.quote: This is a Phlogiston Honey Pearl with peculiar patterning that's been making the rounds recently in the market.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Aphid
introduced.how: insects that normally produce Phlogiston Honey Pearls
introduced.quote: They're usually produced by Phlogiston Aphids. Pretty common, really.

introduced.name: Abyssal energy
introduced.how: low-concentration Abyssal energy can be sealed inside a honey pearl's shell, making it hard to detect
introduced.quote: I thought so too, and so I smashed one open... and discovered that it contained some Abyssal energy.

introduced.name: Cheven
introduced.how: a gemstone shop owner whose customers fell ill from the pearls
introduced.quote: Most of them were customers of Cheven's gemstone shop.

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: a skilled investigator who found Aphids carrying Abyssal contamination
introduced.quote: I went to look for Kinich, since he's got the better head for investigating between us.

introduced.name: Numberry
introduced.how: a berry that grows where Aphids gather and contains a toxin that paralyzes them
introduced.quote: The berry contains a toxin that can paralyze the Aphids, so if we spread them on the net, it'll stop the Aphids from struggling.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: someone who lives alongside the Aphids and tracks them by Numberry bushes
introduced.quote: Then I gather the Honey Pearls they produce and take care of them, and then use more Numberries to bring them back.

introduced.name: Hundred Percent Sweetness
introduced.how: a named Aphid that Ororon raises, one of several she names
introduced.quote: Aphids? Oh! So you were the ones who kidnapped Hundred Percent Sweetness...

introduced.name: Aphid Abyssal energy consumption
introduced.how: Aphids deliberately eat Abyssal energy and bind it into pearls to purify their home
introduced.quote: They're smart little creatures who chose to eat the Abyssal energy.

introduced.name: extra-large insect net
introduced.how: a large net used to catch the oversized contaminated Aphids
introduced.quote: Still, I've specially prepared an extra-large insect net to make sure everything goes smoothly.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Xilonen! Didn't expect to see you here.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: (Talk to Xilonen in the Children of Echoes)

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Later, however, I heard Kachina say that some people got sick.

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Right, and Kinich also notified Mualani.

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy and People of the Springs
assumed.quote: There are also traces of their presence near the Scions of the Canopy and the People of the Springs.

assumed.name: Chief
assumed.quote: I already explained the situation to our Chief, and asked him to collect and destroy all the strange Honey Pearls on the market.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Looks like there are all sorts of lingering Abyss-related issues, huh?

assumed.name: Slimes
assumed.quote: We've met lots of people scared stiff by Slimes, so it's not like we can ignore it just because it isn't dangerous for us, right?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Mora! It's gotta be Mora!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Uh... Paimon never expected some kinda Fatui... or Treasure Hoarder...

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Just think of it like a memento, something to remember these tiny warriors who fight for Natlan by.

assumed.name: Bugbuster Squad
assumed.quote: Paimon: Bugbuster Squad, move out!

threads.claim: Honey pearls bought from the market may have caused illness among customers and people in the tribe.
threads.quote: Later, however, I heard Kachina say that some people got sick.

threads.claim: The sick patients recovered over the following days.
threads.quote: I already heard from the tribe that the patients have taken a turn for the better over the last few days.

threads.claim: The Aphids appear polluted with Abyssal power, and the source of that contamination is unclear.
threads.quote: An Aphid, polluted with the power of the Abyss.

threads.claim: The Aphids were not infected; they chose to eat Abyssal energy to clean their home.
threads.quote: They're smart little creatures who chose to eat the Abyssal energy.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects a hidden mastermind is behind the Aphids being infected.
threads.quote: Could someone be behind them getting infected with the Abyss!?

threads.claim: The suspected human conspiracy is disproven; the berries simply grow naturally near the Aphids.
threads.quote: Your conspiracy theory turned out to be just that, Paimon.

threads.claim: Abyssal traces appear near several Natlan tribes, suggesting the contamination spreads beyond one area.
threads.quote: There are also traces of their presence near the Scions of the Canopy and the People of the Springs.

threads.claim: The Aphids seem to know their land is being invaded by the Abyss.
threads.quote: So they know the land is being invaded, too.

threads.claim: The Aphids are actively fighting the Abyssal invasion of their territory.
threads.quote: Yes, Hundred Percent Sweetness and the rest have been fighting hard!

threads.claim: Numberry bushes grow from seeds the Aphids excrete, which explains where the berries come from.
threads.quote: So that's what was going on with the Numberries!

introduced.name: Kuki Shinobu
introduced.how: Arataki Gang member and Tongwen Academy alumna who organizes the reunion and keeps Itto's spending in check
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Recently, some old classmates from the Tongwen Academy got in touch and said they were organizing a get-together.

introduced.name: Grandmaster Hanakado
introduced.how: A beetle-battling ally of the Arataki Gang who trains Onikabuto and wants to learn cooking and mechanics
introduced.quote: Yanfei: That other kid you guys brought with you, though — what was his name again...? Oh yeah, Grandmaster Hanakado. He seems like a smart cookie!

introduced.name: Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon
introduced.how: One of the Arataki Gang's top beetle fighters, who fights Shinobu in the tutorial battle
introduced.quote: Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon is one of the Arataki Gang's top beetle fighters, but even she isn't in the same league as moi.

introduced.name: Crimson Staff
introduced.how: Itto's Onikabuto beetle, which he trains and fights with
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Go, Crimson Staff! Dodge the limbs and tail, wait for an opening, and aim for the...

introduced.name: Geovishap Hatchling
introduced.how: A rolling vishap nicknamed Crystal Tornado that attacks anyone who sets foot on its island and beat Ironclad Beetle King in one hit
introduced.quote: Xiangling: It's always rolling around on a nearby island.

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: Beetles bred and trained as warriors for beetle battles
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: A hard shell, a whole bunch of legs, looks like a born warrior — the Crab is the Onikabuto of the sea!

introduced.name: Tongwen Academy
introduced.how: The school that Kuki Shinobu, Yanfei and their old classmates attended
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Recently, some old classmates from the Tongwen Academy got in touch and said they were organizing a get-together.

introduced.name: Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: A region where Crabs are gathered and Guyun Geovishaps roam
introduced.quote: Yanfei: I think they're out looking for crabs at Guyun Stone Forest right now, with Miss Xiangling and Mr. Guoba...

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: Itto's gang of beetle-fighters, which sends members to Liyue and funds its events from Mora
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: And don't think for one second I'll be abandoning you or the rest of the Arataki Gang neither!

introduced.name: Bloom Pruner
introduced.how: A gardening machine that can take the form of any creature, which Guoba is given to fight as an Onikabuto
introduced.quote: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery: The Bloom Pruner can transform into the shape of any creature to blend into its environment.

introduced.name: Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl
introduced.how: A past beetle brawl that nearly ended in catastrophe and made Hanakado an ally of the Arataki Gang
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: After the near-catastrophe that was the Beetle Brawl, Hanakado became an ally of the Arataki Gang.

introduced.name: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp
introduced.how: The beetle-training event Itto and Hanakado plan to hold for Guoba's tutelage
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: This is the moment! It's time for the long-awaited "Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp"!

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...Hey, you know where we haven't been in the longest time? Wanmin Restaurant.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Traveler: Was Xiangling's cooking too hot to handle?

assumed.name: Yanfei
assumed.quote: Yanfei: ? Paimon? You're here too?

assumed.name: Chef Mao
assumed.quote: Yanfei: Chef Mao was pretty wiped out by the end, but he had a huge smile on his face.

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey Xiangling, hey Guoba!

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Paimon: Xiangling's master is Madame Ping, so Madame Ping's friend... Aha! Of course!

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: It'll be fine! I'll just, uhhhh... I'll work like a horse when I get back to Inazuma!

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Yanfei: According to The Comprehensive Compendium of Liyue Law, we just need to notify the relevant office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and they'll issue a permit pretty much right away.

threads.claim: Guoba may secretly have a power to command shelled creatures, as Hanakado suspects after Crystal Tornado retreats.
threads.quote: Grandmaster Hanakado: I must say, I concur... I don't know how, but Guoba-san simply commanded that hard-shelled beast to stand down and retreat at once.

threads.claim: The vishap appears to understand Guoba and leaves when he speaks, which deepens the mystery of his power.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait... the vishap can understand Guoba? Huh, it just upped and left!

threads.claim: Crystal Tornado was knocked unconscious after its earlier fight with Guoba and its full story is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Xiangling: But then, Tornado fell unconscious, and apparently wasn't seen for weeks afterwards. I guess he's finally recovered from his injuries.

threads.claim: Crystal Tornado defeats the Arataki Gang's beetle quickly, so the rematch Itto wants remains an open challenge.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: Okay, listen up, Grandmaster! The glorified pet rock is clearly tougher than it looks.

threads.claim: The Bloom Pruner is a surprisingly high-tech machine that can take any creature's shape, hinting at hidden capability.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...That's pretty hi-tech for a gardening appliance.

threads.claim: The Bloom Pruner's real power is far greater than a tenth of a percent, showing how much stronger the machine can be.
threads.quote: Xiangling: Guoba, remember the plan? In this round, we wanna increase the Bloom Pruner's power output from a tenth of a percent to one percent, okay?

threads.claim: The Arataki Gang has run out of Mora, forcing Itto to find work to pay for his plans.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: No, you can't. Our funds have run out.

threads.claim: Itto may study in Liyue as a second Arataki Gang member, a plan whose cost and feasibility are still unresolved.
threads.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Thinking of becoming the second Arataki Gang member to study in Liyue are you, Boss?

introduced.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
introduced.how: a detective agency that needs help investigating missing small animals
introduced.quote: Bantan Sango Detective Agency is in need of manpower

introduced.name: Sango
introduced.how: the agency's brains, who deduces cases and does not like to do the legwork
introduced.quote: Ah, ah, don't forget. I'm the brains of the party here.

introduced.name: Ryuuji
introduced.how: an agency investigator who searches the field and tracks the missing animals
introduced.quote: I've been on the trail of the missing animals these past few days

introduced.name: Black Shadow
introduced.how: a mysterious dog that guards the animal camps and defeated Ryuuji
introduced.quote: This dog is the "dark shadow" that took me out in one go.

introduced.name: Kageroumaru
introduced.how: the scarred dog guarding the camps, revealed through a letter as a trained ninken
introduced.quote: He has a scar on his face that we got when he was young, and he holds himself in manner evidently different from other dogs.

introduced.name: ninken
introduced.how: ninja dogs trained by a secret organization
introduced.quote: I've heard tell of a secret organization that trains ninken, or ninja dogs.

introduced.name: Inujin
introduced.how: a legendary ninken said to have destroyed monsters threatening Inazuma from the shadows
introduced.quote: They say that one such dog, code-named Inujin, destroyed countless monsters that threatened Inazuma in the shadows...

introduced.name: Ubiquity Net
introduced.how: a net Sango designed to capture small animals, given to the Traveler
introduced.quote: I read a lot of old books and wound up designing this net, even commissioning a friend to construct it.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: thieves who steal dogs to train them as Treasure Hunting Hounds
introduced.quote: Sango told me that they were planning to steal dogs and train them to become Treasure Hunting Hounds.

introduced.name: Naku Weed
introduced.how: a plant a suspect sold, which became a clue to his location
introduced.quote: Later, I heard, entirely by chance, that our suspect had sold some Naku Weed the day before.

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: the island where the suspect lives, reached only by boat
introduced.quote: Our suspect lives on Narukami Island.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: an authority strict about boat travel under the Sakoku Decree
introduced.quote: Additionally, the Tenryou Commission is very touchy about the use of boats due to the Sakoku Decree.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: a decree restricting boat travel between islands
introduced.quote: Additionally, the Tenryou Commission is very touchy about the use of boats due to the Sakoku Decree.

introduced.name: Shikanoin Heizou
introduced.how: a Tenryou Commission official whose mind is hard to follow and who worked with the agency before
introduced.quote: Someone from the Tenryou Commission. We had the privilege of making his acquaintance on a previous case.

introduced.name: ninken contract
introduced.how: a ninja must defeat a ninken to earn its acknowledgment
introduced.quote: However, they do say that a ninja must defeat a ninken to receive its acknowledgment.

introduced.name: smoke dispensers
introduced.how: devices Ryuuji placed to divert the dog's attention
introduced.quote: I was unable to save the animals while evading its case, but while I was casing the joint, I did find the time to place a few smoke dispensers nearby.

introduced.name: missing small animals
introduced.how: many pets vanished at once, prompting a flood of commissions
introduced.quote: Many people have had their pets disappear, which has seen many commissions come our way in one go.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Hey, I mean, I beat Stormterror way back when...

assumed.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
assumed.quote: Well, back when we tried stealing the Holy Lyre der Himmel...

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: We did avoid capture that one time at the Rite of Descension...

assumed.name: Taroumaru
assumed.quote: Exactly! Paimon thought about him, too! We even originally thought that he could speak.

assumed.name: Komore Teahouse
assumed.quote: You speak of Komore Teahouse's owner?

assumed.name: Sanbongatana Kinpachi
assumed.quote: You know, I'm curious about what happened with Sanbongatana Kinpachi...

assumed.name: Weasel Thieves
assumed.quote: Like the Weasel Thieves?

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: But there's Naku Weed around the Grand Narukami Shrine, isn't there?

assumed.name: Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: Should just ask someone from Yae Publishing House next time, I think.

threads.claim: The Black Shadow dog's identity and its connection to the legendary ninken remain an open question.
threads.quote: Of course, this is just a legend. Still, I wonder if this Black Shadow could be the legendary ninken...

threads.claim: The Black Shadow is revealed to be Kageroumaru, the dog left behind by a ninken trainer.
threads.quote: This fellow who brought us here, I guess.

threads.claim: Some of the stolen animals are still unaccounted for, with no explanation yet.
threads.quote: One moment... Huh. There's still some missing.

threads.claim: Only about half of the missing animals have been found, so the full scale of the theft is still unclear.
threads.quote: Comparing these to the commissions we received, we should have found around half the missing animals.

threads.claim: The letter's method for forming a ninken contract was cut out, leaving the procedure a mystery.
threads.quote: The writer canceled the most important bit out!

threads.claim: Kageroumaru acknowledges the Traveler as master after being defeated, suggesting a contract was formed.
threads.quote: Unless I miss my guess, Kageroumaru is now 's ninken.

threads.claim: Sango deduces that Kageroumaru stole and protected small animals to train them into stronger companions.
threads.quote: He must have been trying to make the other animals stronger.

threads.claim: The details of the Sanbongatana Kinpachi case are withheld, hinting at a hidden past event.
threads.quote: If Ryuuji's that opposed to me discussing that matter, I'll refrain.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree restricts boat travel and shapes how suspects can move between islands.
threads.quote: Additionally, the Tenryou Commission is very touchy about the use of boats due to the Sakoku Decree.

threads.claim: Shikanoin Heizou is presented as a uniquely perceptive Tenryou Commission figure who can follow Sango's reasoning.
threads.quote: To be honest, only Shikanoin is able to keep up with her train of thought...

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders train stolen dogs as Treasure Hunting Hounds, and they have a history of similar failed schemes.
threads.quote: Sango told me that they were planning to steal dogs and train them to become Treasure Hunting Hounds.

threads.claim: Police missives are growing more urgent, hinting that war may be approaching.
threads.quote: War has not broken out yet, but the Police Station's missives have become more urgent.

introduced.name: Darwish
introduced.how: a researcher leading the test who explains the project's purpose
introduced.quote: Darwish: Now, let me introduce our research here. Hmm, how best to explain...

introduced.name: Atashye
introduced.how: a researcher who studies the effects of diet and environment on creatures
introduced.quote: Darwish: Atashye is researching the effects of diet and environment on all kinds of creatures, while Fadaweh is constructing the "simulated development" model.

introduced.name: Fadaweh
introduced.how: a serious mathematician who builds the simulated development model
introduced.quote: Atashye: Then I'll hand that data over to Fadaweh so she can construct her model... *sigh* The only problem is that the data she wants is a little too detailed...

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: Atashye's home region, where she is from
introduced.quote: Atashye: It's a long story... But basically, I'm from Kshahrewar, and my current research topic is using fruit — or fruit peel fibers — as construction material...

introduced.name: Companion Caper Chronicles
introduced.how: a simulated battle game for children built from real-world deductions
introduced.quote: Darwish: Observe — the "Companion Caper Chronicles," based on genuine real-world deductions!

introduced.name: Companion Pieces
introduced.how: the pieces used to recruit and fight in battles
introduced.quote: Darwish: First, you'll need to rely on Companion Pieces to fight...

introduced.name: Companion leveling
introduced.how: three identical companions can be merged to level up, usually to Level 3
introduced.quote: Darwish: However, so long as we have three identical companions...

introduced.name: Species Features
introduced.how: companions of the same species work better together
introduced.quote: Darwish: Companions who share the same "Species" will work better together.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Darwish: However, Fadaweh, we don't require an exceedingly precise model this time. Our research isn't aimed at those stuffy old scholars at the Akademiya...

assumed.name: Corps of Thirty
assumed.quote: Darwish: And they should be able to help the Corps of Thirty, too...

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Darwish, optional)

assumed.name: Amurta Darshan
assumed.quote: Atashye: Darwish, you're from the Amurta Darshan, back me up here, will you?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Darwish: You mean the adventure narratives? Haha, we're Akademiya students, after all. Naturally, stories based on the tales of Sumeru pack a more exciting punch...

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Darwish: Yes, precisely! I mean, we cannot simply let children freely interact with real-world Fungi, Eremites, and such...

threads.claim: An unseen scholar marked with question marks is heard for the first time, and their identity remains unrevealed.
threads.quote: ???: Atashye! I've tried my best to remain calm, but these reports you keep handing in are useless!
