threads.claim: A mysterious 'certain someone' is hinted at, whose identity is deliberately withheld.
threads.quote: Fadaweh: A—Ah, of course, Darwish... Clear-headed and organized as always! Unlike a certain someone...

threads.claim: The simulated game is suggested to serve as a reference for real-world battles once accurate data is available.
threads.quote: Darwish: And as long as we can prove our format works, it could still serve as a valuable reference for real-world battles, despite being a simulation...

threads.claim: Fadaweh's intense attachment to Darwish is hinted at, including her jealousy over him teaching children.
threads.quote: Fadaweh: Only I'm allowed to watch Darwish teaching the children! You can't watch him! Don't you dare go and watch him!

introduced.name: Basima the Fifth
introduced.how: introduces herself as an Amurta researcher and rising merchant star
introduced.quote: I, Basima the Fifth, Amurta researcher, rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike

introduced.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
introduced.how: a tabletop game Basima promotes, with rewards for high scores
introduced.quote: I'm currently promoting this tabletop game. Those who get high enough scores can even win rewards!

assumed.name: Amurta
assumed.quote: Amurta researcher

assumed.name: Grand Bazaar
assumed.quote: rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike

threads.claim: Value and superiority are subjective, and people hold dear what others may dismiss.
threads.quote: There are no absolute "bests" in this world.

threads.claim: Paimon senses she has had this same conversation before, hinting at a repeated or forgotten event.
threads.quote: Hang on, Paimon's getting a sense of déjà vu.

introduced.name: Basima the Fifth
introduced.how: introduces herself as an Amurta researcher and rising merchant star
introduced.quote: Passing Travelers, I, Basima the Fifth, Amurta researcher

introduced.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
introduced.how: a tabletop game Basima promotes, where high scores earn rewards
introduced.quote: I'm currently promoting this tabletop game. Those who get high enough scores can even win rewards!

assumed.name: Amurta
assumed.quote: Amurta researcher, rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike

assumed.name: Grand Bazaar
assumed.quote: rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike

assumed.name: Romaritime Harbor
assumed.quote: rising mercantile star of the Grand Bazaar and Romaritime Harbor alike

threads.claim: Basima suggests that people who fear disapproval and lose confidence in themselves never become their best selves or find someone who truly sees them.
threads.quote: Those who are afraid of disapproval and who lose confidence in themselves will never become their best selves, and they'll never find someone who truly sees them!

threads.claim: Paimon senses she has had this conversation before, hinting at a forgotten prior encounter.
threads.quote: Hang on, Paimon's getting a sense of déjà vu. It feels like we've had this conversation before...

introduced.name: Hajanad
introduced.how: an alchemist who meets the Traveler again and introduces herself as a normal plebeian who owes them her research
introduced.quote: Ah, so you've forgotten me. But I understand. I am but a normal plebeian, while you — you are living legends!

introduced.name: Remelting Tablets
introduced.how: alchemical potions designed to aid people in combat, which the Traveler helped test in the past
introduced.quote: A long time back, you aided my experiments with my great creation, the Remelting Tablets — alchemical potions designed to aid people in combat.

introduced.name: Shock-Boiling Device
introduced.how: a combat support device that activates automatically and records combat data
introduced.quote: I even added periodic activation and recording functions to the device.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: an organization doing security work in Sumeru that has used Hajanad's research
introduced.quote: The results of my research have also been of aid to some members of the Corps of Thirty in their work regarding Sumeru's security...

introduced.name: Traveler and Paimon's past meeting with Hajanad on a cliffside in the rainforest
introduced.how: the pair previously met Hajanad during a combat-potion research job
introduced.quote: Ooh, Paimon remembers! We met this person on a cliffside in the rainforest! What was her name again...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: As long as this person doesn't plan on doing any bad things, and the Mora is good, we can definitely consider helping out!

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: prove to the Akademiya that this is the alchemical potion's strongest form!

assumed.name: Great Red Sand
assumed.quote: I discovered a temperature-related weakness in the Remelting Tablets I was testing in the Great Red Sand.

assumed.name: Flaming Flower
assumed.quote: You could sit in front of a Flaming Flower for an entire day, and you would still be able to use potions to aid you in battle.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon have forgotten an earlier meeting with Hajanad.
threads.quote: Paimon doesn't remember having this nickname, though!

threads.claim: Paimon recalls that the group met Hajanad on a cliffside in the rainforest, though the Traveler still needs prompting to recall her name.
threads.quote: Ooh, Paimon remembers! We met this person on a cliffside in the rainforest! What was her name again...

threads.claim: Hajanad wants to prove her potion's worth to the Akademiya to gain standing.
threads.quote: prove to the Akademiya that this is the alchemical potion's strongest form!

threads.claim: The Corps of Thirty works on Sumeru's security and has taken interest in Hajanad's research.
threads.quote: Even the Corps of Thirty expressed a certain amount of interest.

threads.claim: A heat weakness in the Remelting Tablets led Hajanad to create the Shock-Boiling Device.
threads.quote: I discovered a temperature-related weakness in the Remelting Tablets I was testing in the Great Red Sand.

threads.claim: Hajanad's original mentor dismissed her work, and her essay on the Remelting Tablets surpassed him and let her leave his tutelage.
threads.quote: As it turns out, my original mentor wasn't taking me seriously at all, even though he wasn't a big deal himself.

introduced.name: Budanova
introduced.how: a Frost Operative who greets the Traveler and Paimon warmly and hosts the snowball fight
introduced.quote: My, my... To think I'd actually run into you two here in Snezhnaya. What a delightful surprise.

introduced.name: Bublik
introduced.how: a cheerful child-like organizer of the snowball fight who knows Ajax and Tonia
introduced.quote: Oh, oh! You're big brother Ajax's friends, the ones Tonia told us about! Budanova, do you know them too?

introduced.name: Snowball fight tournament
introduced.how: a quick-reflex tournament open to adults and kids alike, where top players win prizes
introduced.quote: This snowball fight tournament is all about quick reflexes. As long as you're fast enough, it doesn't matter whether you're a grown-up or a kid!

assumed.name: Frost Operative
assumed.quote: But wait... what's a Frost Operative doing here?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Um... Miss Fatui, have we met before? Paimon doesn't really remember you, either...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: My, my... To think I'd actually run into you two here in Snezhnaya. What a delightful surprise.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Have we met before in Nod-Krai?

assumed.name: Technical Martial Challenge
assumed.quote: Hmm... Oh! Paimon remembers now! It was at the Technical Martial Challenge!

assumed.name: Ajax
assumed.quote: Oh, oh! You're big brother Ajax's friends, the ones Tonia told us about! Budanova, do you know them too?

assumed.name: Tonia
assumed.quote: Oh, oh! You're big brother Ajax's friends, the ones Tonia told us about! Budanova, do you know them too?

assumed.name: Chichikova
assumed.quote: Hehe, don't underestimate us! We've got the super-strong Chichikova on our side!

threads.claim: Budanova claims to have met the Traveler and Paimon before, but neither of them remembers her.
threads.quote: I don't really remember you...

threads.claim: A Frost Operative's presence in Snezhnaya is unexplained and raises questions about Budanova's purpose.
threads.quote: But wait... what's a Frost Operative doing here?

threads.claim: Budanova invites the travelers to forget their worries, hinting at an ulterior purpose behind her friendliness.
threads.quote: Come have some fun with the children and forget your worries for a while.

introduced.name: Candace
introduced.how: Introduces herself as the guardian of Aaru Village investigating the robbery
introduced.quote: Candace: I'm Candace, the guardian of Aaru Village. I'm trying to learn more about the robbery that took place this morning.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: A village under Candace's guardianship
introduced.quote: Candace: I'm Candace, the guardian of Aaru Village. I'm trying to learn more about the robbery that took place this morning.

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: A merchant who deals in information and sells intel for Mora
introduced.quote: Ooh! You're in the market for some intel! Well, you've come to the right place! I love dealing in information.

introduced.name: Carriage Parade
introduced.how: A parade whose final stop is Port Ormos, drawing vendors and crowds
introduced.quote: Candace: This is the final stop of the Carriage Parade, so many of the vendors decided to set up their stalls in advance.

introduced.name: Flower Carriage
introduced.how: The parade float the Dendro Archon rides on during the festival
introduced.quote: Kaveh: When the Dendro Archon passes by on the Flower Carriage. Once we receive the signal, we'll launch it, and... KABOOM!

introduced.name: Dendro Archon
introduced.how: The Archon whose birthday is being celebrated and who loves candy
introduced.quote: Tighnari: This one is extra special. I heard from Master that the Akademiya is planning a grand birthday celebration for the Dendro Archon.

introduced.name: Haft-Mewa Feast
introduced.how: A birthday meal planned to follow the Carriage Parade
introduced.quote: Dehya: We're also planning a birthday meal after the Carriage Parade! So, we'll have a Haft-Mewa Feast as well.

introduced.name: Mehrak
introduced.how: A mechanical creature Kaveh built and maintains, which has gone missing
introduced.quote: No, that's impossible... I created Mehrak myself, and I perform regular maintenance every week.

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: Introduces himself as on business investigating an unusual robbery case
introduced.quote: Cyno: I'm here on business, investigating an unusual robbery case.

introduced.name: Jahangir
introduced.how: A stall owner whose wind generator stove has broken down before
introduced.quote: Jahangir: *cough*... It's certainly possible. I had a similar problem not too long ago.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Desert group whose members can wield elemental energy and sometimes attack caravans for Mora
introduced.quote: The same is true for the Eremites. Some use that power to attack caravans and earn some quick Mora.

introduced.name: Yakup
introduced.how: Leader of a caravan carrying goods to desert tribal camps
introduced.quote: Yakup: To some tribal camps in the desert. Everybody's looking to celebrate with the Sabzeruz Festival coming up.

introduced.name: Prophecy gem
introduced.how: A peculiar gem Candace bought that seems to give visions of the future
introduced.quote: Candace: I bought a rather peculiar gem this morning, and I have the name of the merchant who sold it to me.

introduced.name: Nameless ruin
introduced.how: A poorly preserved desert ruin where the gem's ore was retrieved
introduced.quote: Candace: Yes. According to the local gem merchants, the ore was retrieved from a nameless ruin in the desert several months ago.

introduced.name: Caravan robbery
introduced.how: A caravan was robbed on a remote desert path that morning
introduced.quote: Candace: Funny enough, I heard a caravan was robbed just this morning, in a remote part of the desert.

introduced.name: Rocking Carriage minigame
introduced.how: Steering the Flower Carriage around obstacles while collecting flowers
introduced.quote: While the Flower Carriage is in motion, you can change its route to avoid obstacles.

introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.how: a dancer whose Dance of Sabzeruz is a key part of the Festival
introduced.quote: The Dance is a key part of the Festival. If someone was trying to sabotage the celebrations, Nilou would be a natural target.

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: a Pari the group met before, described as nice but blunt in speech
introduced.quote: Sorush is a Pari we met in the Vourukasha Oasis. She's really nice.

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: a wanderer who stepped in during the caravan attack and later became Sorush's guide
introduced.quote: The name's Sethos. I was out for a walk when I heard the commotion, so I came to check it out.

introduced.name: Rashnu
introduced.how: a Pari who was meant to carry Nilou's message and tends to fall asleep
introduced.quote: The Pari that was supposed to pass on my message.

introduced.name: Arasaka
introduced.how: a Nara who is friends with the Traveler but has been told not to talk much
introduced.quote: Arasaka is friends with the Golden Nara, but... Arapas said Arasaka can't talk to too many people right now.

introduced.name: Dharmakirti
introduced.how: a Dastur from Amurta who asks for the Traveler's help with dreamscape research
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Dharmakirti, a Dastur from Amurta.

introduced.name: Masud
introduced.how: the Phantom Toy Master who invites the Traveler to play the Rocking Carriage game
introduced.quote: I, the Phantom Toy Master, shall be pleased to invite you to play a new game

introduced.name: Safi
introduced.how: a folklorist from Vahumana planning a film about the Knight of Flowers
introduced.quote: This is a folklorist from Vahumana, Safi.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: a Lesser Lord celebrating her birthday in the city, whose familiars are the Pari
introduced.quote: I heard Lesser Lord Kusanali is currently celebrating her birthday in the city.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: Kusanali's familiars, with Sorush as Bloomguard of Khvarena
introduced.quote: Excuse you! I, Sorush, am a noble Pari, and the Bloomguard of Khvarena!

introduced.name: Wedjat Eye
introduced.how: a cracked gem-relic given to Kusanali that records past events, now split in two
introduced.quote: Lady Malikata gave her the Khvarena to protect the rainforest, and Lord Al-Ahmar gave her the Wedjat Eye to record the moments they shared together.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: a relic given to Kusanali for protecting the rainforest, later becoming a divine bird
introduced.quote: Lady Malikata gave her the Khvarena to protect the rainforest

introduced.name: First Sabzeruz gift legend
introduced.how: King Deshret and Lady Malikata gave Kusanali surprise gifts at the first Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: Legend has it that King Deshret and the Goddess of Flowers, Lady Malikata, both prepared surprise gifts for Lesser Lord Kusanali during the first Sabzeruz Festival.

introduced.name: Caravan robbery case
introduced.how: a caravan was robbed, its goods were lost, and one gem was sold to a buyer in the desert
introduced.quote: We interrogated the people in charge of the caravan on the day of the incident...

introduced.name: Knight of Flowers
introduced.how: a role the Akademiya asks each Darshan to fill for the Parade, chosen from its representatives
introduced.quote: The Akademiya wants the representatives from each Darshan to nominate someone to serve as the Knight of Flowers for the Parade.

introduced.name: Rocking Carriage
introduced.how: a Festival game where children ride a Flower Carriage on adventures to find a thousand blooming flowers
introduced.quote: Riding in their carriage, the children shall embark on unique adventures, encountering and overcoming danger, and finding the greatest treasure, a thousand blooming flowers...

introduced.name: Flower Carriage
introduced.how: a decorated carriage each child with a good heart receives during the Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: Smart or not, nice or naughty, every child with a good heart will receive their own Flower Carriage during the Sabzeruz Festival celebrations...

introduced.name: Shared dreamscapes
introduced.how: a new technology for entering shared dreams, used to treat psychological disorders
introduced.quote: The technology to enter shared dreamscapes is still rather new, and advancements are mainly thanks to the many improvements made by the Dendro Archon.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Oh, and again, please be careful. The last thing we want is for her to find out about our plan.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Dehya: ! Paimon! Fancy seeing you here.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Collei: Oh, it's you two. Ah... You scared me half to death! Just like when I lose focus in class, and Master Tighnari suddenly shows up behind me, but even scarier!

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Tighnari: This one is extra special. I heard from Master that the Akademiya is planning a grand birthday celebration for the Dendro Archon.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ahh, so exciting! This is gonna be the best birthday surprise Nahida could ask fo—

assumed.name: Sabzeruz Festival
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, it's almost time for the Sabzeruz Festival, right? It's always so lively!

assumed.name: Eye of Prophecy
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Eye of Prophecy...

assumed.name: Candace's amber eye
assumed.quote: Candace: I don't think it's related to my amber eye.

assumed.name: Lord Sangemah Bay
assumed.quote: Dori: Well, now you're just asking the impossible! These kinds of things tend to be trade secrets. It won't be easy to get that information, even for the great Lord Sangemah Bay.

assumed.name: General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Sounds like something the General Mahamatra should know about.

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: I'm needed at the House of Daena. See you later.

assumed.name: Faruzan
assumed.quote: Faruzan: Nice of you to finally show up! All young and capable, and yet not one of you could get here before a senior such as myself.

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: Nahida: Oh, Nilou! Did you need something?

assumed.name: Dunyarzad
assumed.quote: Dehya: Oh, well... It was just something that occurred to me while talking with Dunyarzad.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Traveler: Sorry to keep you waiting, dear Archon.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Dehya: You're finally back! I was so worried! I was THIS close to sending some mercs after you!

assumed.name: Alhaitham
assumed.quote: Alhaitham: I see. So, the Wedjat Eye is now under the custody of the Temple of Silence.

assumed.name: Hermanubis
assumed.quote: It's not like Hermanubis would call on you and not me...

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: Genius Invokation this, and Genius Invokation that...

assumed.name: Cataclysm in Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: But, the Wedjat Eye was lost after the cataclysm in Khaenri'ah, buried deep beneath the sands.

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: Traveler: (It probably belonged to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, actually. But, given what happened to Irminsul...)

assumed.name: Farris
assumed.quote: with an aura that can compare to the legendary Farris himself.

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: When you called out the Aranara, Paimon nearly fell out of the sky in shock!

threads.claim: Candace is seeing visions that come true seconds later, with no known cause.
threads.quote: Candace: But, ever since this morning, I've been seeing things that don't match with reality, and after a few seconds, they actually come to pass...

threads.claim: The conditions and actions needed to trigger the gem's power remain unclear.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: The conditions and actions required to trigger this power are still unclear.

threads.claim: The craftsman made a second gem from the same cracked ore, and its whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Apparently, the craftsman made another gem just like this one.

threads.claim: One bandit was seen carrying a green stone like the gem Candace has.
threads.quote: Although, I did notice that one of the bandits had this green stone...

threads.claim: Witness accounts of the robbery conflict, with Hizir describing bombs and vines.
threads.quote: Hizir: Bombs started falling from the sky!

threads.claim: Eremites may use elemental power to attack caravans for profit.
threads.quote: The same is true for the Eremites. Some use that power to attack caravans and earn some quick Mora.

threads.claim: The gem's ore came from a badly damaged, unnamed ruin in the desert.
threads.quote: Candace: Yes. According to the local gem merchants, the ore was retrieved from a nameless ruin in the desert several months ago.

threads.claim: Overheard plans mention an explosion set off when the Flower Carriage passes by.
threads.quote: ???: ...when... passes by on the Flower Carriage... we'll launch it...

threads.claim: The eavesdropped explosion plot was Kaveh's harmless candy tower for the birthday surprise.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Not the dangerous kind of explosion, though. It's supposed to look like fireworks.

threads.claim: Mehrak has not returned after being sent out for coffee, and its absence is unexplained.
threads.quote: Kaveh: I think I'm allowed some dramatics! Mehrak hasn't come back since I sent it out for coffee!

threads.claim: Mehrak returns, having gone to look for more coffee beans.
threads.quote: Kaveh: Hm? Mehrak!? Where have you been!?

threads.claim: Nahida senses her friends are hiding something and suspects a plot.
threads.quote: Nahida: (Hmm... They're definitely up to something.)

threads.claim: The faint voices Candace heard in a vision may be from Al-Ahmar and the Goddess of Flowers, hinting the Wedjat Eye records the past.
threads.quote: Could it actually have been Lord Al-Ahmar and the Goddess of Flowers?

threads.claim: The Wedjat Eye's recordings resonate only with the descendants of King Deshret, and it still holds scenes from the past.
threads.quote: Its power seems to only resonate with the people of Al-Ahmar, also the descendants of King Deshret.

threads.claim: The Wedjat Eye was lost in the cataclysm in Khaenri'ah and buried beneath the sands.

introduced.name: Elemental life forms
introduced.how: creatures constantly powered by elements whose core energy is used as the final production input
introduced.quote: Elemental life forms are constantly being powered by the elements.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Traveler and Paimon, you're right on cue!

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Don't tell Paimon that you want us to look for things or drive hilichurls off.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I'll sell each toy for thousands of Mora.

assumed.name: Doushin
assumed.quote: But the Doushin from the Tenryou Commission still confiscated my toys without a second thought...

assumed.name: Kurisu
assumed.quote: Anyways, if my plan still fails in the end, I'll pay off my debt by giving all the toys to Kurisu.

threads.claim: Fontaine's special energy system may not be sustainable, and alternative energy must be found before it collapses.
threads.quote: The energy system there is very special, and no one knows how long it can be sustained.

threads.claim: Bertrand intends to return to Fontaine someday once he finds a good energy solution.
threads.quote: And then I shall return to Fontaine.

threads.claim: Elemental life forms are continuously powered by elements, and their motive force can be harvested for energy.
threads.quote: Elemental life forms are constantly being powered by the elements.

threads.claim: The Great Machine is a product of Bertrand's alternative energy research and remains unstable and at risk of exploding.
threads.quote: The Great Machine, too, is a product of that research, which is why it remains somewhat unstable and at risk of exploding if not handled with the utmost care...

threads.claim: Bertrand was arrested by the Tenryou Commission over his explosive toys, and the reason for his confinement is hinted at.
threads.quote: I was once arrested by the Tenryou Commission due to a small accident...

threads.claim: The Traveler has been a wanted criminal more than once, which Bertrand has heard of.
threads.quote: More than once, actually...

introduced.name: Nusta
introduced.how: a dancer who met the Traveler and Paimon at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and now hosts the dance exchange
introduced.quote: After we took a picture together, I went off to an inconspicuous corner to watch dance while munching on my Saurus Crackers.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: a joyful dancer from the Sumeru group visiting the Natlan camp
introduced.quote: Mualani's here too, by the way. Definitely the most joyful dance rep among us.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: hosts the Sumeru visitors together with the Children of Echoes and People of the Springs
introduced.quote: it was decided that the Flower-Feather Clan would host them together with the Children of Echoes and People of the Springs.

introduced.name: Desert of Hadramaveth
introduced.how: the desert area whose southern edge is where the red vultures attacked the group's barbecue
introduced.quote: So, we were having a barbecue party at the southern edge of the Desert of Hadramaveth when this bunch of vicious red vultures showed up and attacked us, right when we were too stuffed to even move...

introduced.name: Red Vulture
introduced.how: a flock of vicious vultures that attacked and wore down the Natlan group using terrain tactics
introduced.quote: And they were using all these really sneaky tactics.

introduced.name: The Eremites
introduced.how: mercenaries who performed a war-dance that made the vultures back off
introduced.quote: To our surprise, we ran into a group of mercenaries while pulling back, and they started up this mysterious war-dance right in front of the vultures...

introduced.name: Uncle Scimitar
introduced.how: an Eremite who led the intimidating war-dance that scared off the Consecrated Red Vultures
introduced.quote: Are you talking about the intimidating actions that Uncle Scimitar and the others used to scare off the Consecrated Red Vultures the first time Nusta met him?

introduced.name: Taraneh
introduced.how: a famous local dancer hired by The Eremites to lead and advise the Sumeru group, who coaches rhythm
introduced.quote: Besides, our friends from The Eremites have gone all out and hired one of their famous local dancers to lead and advise the Sumeru group.

introduced.name: The Duet of Flame-Mane and Heron's Guard
introduced.how: the name of the war-dance that Uncle Scimitar's group performed against the vultures
introduced.quote: I like that name — conveys both grace and power!

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: a Blazing Beasts member who, with Candace, fought the red vultures on a caravan trip to Aaru Village
introduced.quote: Some time ago, a caravan that was carrying Dehya and Candace back to Aaru Village encountered that very same flock of red vultures.

introduced.name: Candace
introduced.how: a Blazing Beasts member who, with Dehya, fought the red vultures on a caravan trip to Aaru Village
introduced.quote: Some time ago, a caravan that was carrying Dehya and Candace back to Aaru Village encountered that very same flock of red vultures.

introduced.name: Blazing Beasts
introduced.how: a group with a sumpter beast caravan whose members' mimicked moves make the vultures take off
introduced.quote: Since then, whenever a member of the Blazing Beasts mimics their actions, those vultures simply take off.

introduced.name: Sumeru and Natlan dance exchange
introduced.how: a planned tradition of the peoples of Sumeru and Natlan visiting each other to swap dance styles
introduced.quote: I hope we can take turns to visit each other and make this dance exchange a regular tradition in the future!

introduced.name: dance cues
introduced.how: moves are timed to drumbeats and a spotlight, and the dancer repeats the moves when the spotlight is on the player
introduced.quote: Take your cues from the drumbeats and the spotlight and follow my movements!

assumed.name: Sumeru

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: So, will the saurians of Natlan be able to do blade-dances like The Eremites do?

assumed.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: That's because I saw having such a good time dancing at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame!

assumed.name: People of the Springs
assumed.quote: Are the People of the Springs holding some kind of event?

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: it was decided that the Flower-Feather Clan would host them together with the Children of Echoes and People of the Springs.

assumed.name: Saurian
assumed.quote: our newcomers and... the new saurians who have come to try it out are struggling to find their rhythm.

assumed.name: Nilou
assumed.quote: And here I thought we were already exceptionally fortunate to have Miss Nilou with us.

assumed.name: Iansan
assumed.quote: Of course, I've learned from Master Iansan that double-kicking the bass drum is always better.

threads.claim: The war-dance that drove off the red vultures is a mysterious secret the group wants to learn.
threads.quote: We were really curious about the secret of that dance too!

threads.claim: The vultures flee the war-dance because Dehya and Candace once beat them, and Blazing Beasts members now mimic those moves.
threads.quote: Since then, whenever a member of the Blazing Beasts mimics their actions, those vultures simply take off.

threads.claim: The Sumeru and Natlan dance exchange is meant to continue through reciprocal visits.
threads.quote: This is the beginning of that.

threads.claim: The dance exchange is spreading Sumeru and Natlan dance styles across Teyvat.
threads.quote: I can already see our dances spreading across Teyvat!

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: venue where the People of the Springs, Children of Echoes, and Flower-Feather Clan hold a party
introduced.quote: It says that the People of the Springs, Children of Echoes, and the Flower-Feather Clan are organizing a party at Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: contrasted with Natlan as a place with convoluted, elaborate law enforcement procedures
introduced.quote: Natlan isn't like Fontaine, with all those convoluted... ahem, "elaborate law enforcement procedures"!

introduced.name: Enghiene
introduced.how: a guest from the Fontaine tour group who joins the party with three companions
introduced.quote: And we've got new participants too: Ms. Enghiene from the Fontaine tour group, along with her three companions!

introduced.name: Tumaini
introduced.how: the lead dancer; the Traveler is revealed to be the great Tumaini
introduced.quote: Hold on, Nusta called you "Tumaini"... So you're THE Tumaini, ?

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: a young warrior from this group taught Enghiene to dance and named Tumaini as her master
introduced.quote: The young warrior of the Children of Echoes who taught me to dance said her master is the great Tumaini of Natlan — and an amazing dancer too...

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: pays well for jobs such as clearing monster nests
introduced.quote: And the Flower-Feather Clan pays pretty well.

introduced.name: Marine
introduced.how: a worker who earns extra money in Natlan by clearing monster nests while on vacation
introduced.quote: Made some extra money too.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: In Natlan, fighting and dancing are equally exhilarating.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Natlan's couriers have left us a message at the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Maison Gardiennage
assumed.quote: I'm no longer a member of the Maison Gardiennage. Under confidentiality regulations, Turenna can no longer report her work to me either.

assumed.name: Turenna
assumed.quote: Under confidentiality regulations, Turenna can no longer report her work to me either.

assumed.name: Saurian
assumed.quote: I already rounded up the remaining Saurian poachers earlier.

assumed.name: Melusine
assumed.quote: A Melusine and... Nusta?

assumed.name: Special Patrol Officer
assumed.quote: Guess the Special Patrol Officer's intel network has limits too, huh?

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Also, thanks to our "Uthabiti," Kachina, and the idol from Mondstadt, the Fontaine guests and the Ashas here have all learned brand-new dance moves!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Also, thanks to our "Uthabiti," Kachina, and the idol from Mondstadt, the Fontaine guests and the Ashas here have all learned brand-new dance moves!

assumed.name: Asha
assumed.quote: So besides everyone from before and the little Saurians, there are Melusines and... Ashas joining the stage too?

assumed.name: Aeval
assumed.quote: I even saved enough to get a gift for Aeval.

assumed.name: Disco Dynamism
assumed.quote: After reaching 6000 Disco Dynamism

assumed.name: first dance party
assumed.quote: First things first — big news! Our second dance party is now underway!

threads.claim: Enghiene hints she still holds untold tricks and may write a memoir for law enforcement.
threads.quote: Feels like I still have a few tricks I haven't shared with the people who could use them... Maybe I should just write a memoir?

threads.claim: The Traveler is revealed to be the great Tumaini, the master Enghiene's Children of Echoes teacher spoke of.
threads.quote: So after all that roundabout talk... it was you!

threads.claim: Nusta plans to wipe out smugglers to the north, hinting at ongoing criminal activity in Natlan.
threads.quote: I'll use your method and wipe out the smugglers to the north in one fell swoop.

threads.claim: Natlan's looser law enforcement differs from Fontaine's elaborate procedures, and Nusta intends to exploit that.
threads.quote: Natlan isn't like Fontaine, with all those convoluted... ahem, "elaborate law enforcement procedures"!

threads.claim: Enghiene suggests that knowing too much can harm a person, so intel must be carefully managed.
threads.quote: Knowing too much can mess with your head, you know? It's all about managing your information load.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses that the Melusine and Nusta are discussing something dangerous.
threads.quote: Sounds like they're talking about something pretty dangerous...?

threads.claim: Monster nests prove far more dangerous than estimated, with seven times the expected number of monsters.
threads.quote: Just didn't expect the nest to have seven times the estimated number of monsters.

threads.claim: Nusta proposes making dance parties a monthly tradition in Natlan.
threads.quote: I'm all for making it a monthly tradition!

introduced.name: Costentin
introduced.how: A self-described writer who approaches the Traveler and Paimon and introduces himself
introduced.quote: What luck that two fine-looking adventurers such as yourselves have run into me, Costentin, here today.

introduced.name: Lafeinte
introduced.how: A legendary Blade Dancer who likened combat to a dance of blades and was the subject of stories Costentin read
introduced.quote: I only got the urge to put myself to the test after coming across stories about a certain "Blade Dancer" called Lafeinte while reading through some reference materials.

introduced.name: Blade Dance
introduced.how: Combat treated as an elegant art form, staged in arenas built for performances
introduced.quote: He likened combat to a dance of blades, and with the help of a certain talented engineer, had multiple arenas built where exquisite performances were held...

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: A dangerous sealed area containing monsters and powerful foes that must be reported
introduced.quote: I'm sure you've vanquished many powerful foes, and equally certain that you'll be very interested to hear about the one that resides in the Domain behind me...

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: The authority in Fontaine that must be told about dangerous Domains and weapon use
introduced.quote: Upon discovering such a dangerous Domain, you should have reported it straight back to the Maison Gardiennage

introduced.name: Enghiene
introduced.how: A veteran member of the Gardes who introduces herself and arrests the group's trespass
introduced.quote: Ahem, my name is Enghiene and I am a veteran member of the Gardes with years of experience out in the wilds.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: An organization that adventurers register with after passing physical tests
introduced.quote: I didn't have what it takes to pass their physical tests...

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: A nation with borders where weapons may not be used without advance declaration to the Maison Gardiennage
introduced.quote: Then presumably you informed the Maison Gardiennage in advance that you planned on using weapons within the borders of Fontaine?

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: A hidden camera that records the fight inside the Domain
introduced.quote: I've hidden a Kamera in the Domain that will capture all of your heroics.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: Well, we're already quite some distance from the Court of Fontaine.

assumed.name: aquabus
assumed.quote: Wrong! We jumped off the aquabus!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Even if it's just a fine, I'm afraid that I have but little Mora to give you...

assumed.name: Gardemeks
assumed.quote: Waving weapons around like toys without a permit, you're lucky that the Gardemeks didn't treat you like an intruder!

assumed.name: A-listers
assumed.quote: Oh? It's you two! You're both A-listers!

threads.claim: Lafeinte, a Blade Dancer, was forced to flee Fontaine after running afoul of the Maison Gardiennage.
threads.quote: Though he ended up in the Maison Gardiennage's bad books and had to flee Fontaine, stories of such legendary deeds make for gripping reading.

threads.claim: The Domain holds one of the arenas Lafeinte had built, tying the present fight to his past.
threads.quote: This must have been one of the arenas that the "Blade Dancer" built back in the day.

threads.claim: Combat is presented as an art of elegance and natural instinct rather than mere violence.
threads.quote: I'm talking about an ode to your inner passion, an artistic appreciation of the expression of your natural instincts!

threads.claim: Dangerous Domains in Fontaine must be reported to the Maison Gardiennage before anyone investigates or fights there.
threads.quote: Upon discovering such a dangerous Domain, you should have reported it straight back to the Maison Gardiennage

threads.claim: The Gardes will send a colleague later to clean up the Domain after the monsters are dealt with.
threads.quote: Another member of the Gardes will be over later to get this Domain properly cleaned up...

threads.claim: Using weapons within Fontaine's borders requires advance declaration to the Maison Gardiennage.
threads.quote: Then presumably you informed the Maison Gardiennage in advance that you planned on using weapons within the borders of Fontaine?

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staff who offers the Traveler a commission
introduced.quote: Hello there, Traveler. Great timing: we have a commission that I believe would best be taken up by you.

introduced.name: Honglang
introduced.how: leads the investigation of the Domain and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Honglang, who is in charge of this investigation, says that he needs the assistance of a highly adaptable adventurer.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: runs investigations into the unknown Domain and sends people to study it
introduced.quote: Though the Guild has undertaken extensive investigations into that Domain, we have yet to achieve results of any particular value.

introduced.name: unknown Domain
introduced.how: a newly found Domain that has resisted investigation
introduced.quote: Well, it involves a hitherto unknown Domain.

introduced.name: strange large door
introduced.how: a gate in the wild that leads into the Domain
introduced.quote: some time back, a team of adventurers found this strange, large door out in the wild... You're looking at it right now, naturally.

introduced.name: Domain that transforms by wishes
introduced.how: the Domain changes its form based on people's wishes
introduced.quote: This Domain transforms based on people's wishes.

introduced.name: first adventurers' empty room
introduced.how: the first team found the Domain to be only an empty room
introduced.quote: According to the first batch of adventurers, the Domain was just an "empty room" when they first entered it.

introduced.name: 52-pace barrier
introduced.how: a 52-pace square cannot be crossed and deep gray smoke lies beyond it
introduced.quote: For 52 paces either way, the area was an ordinary stone-tiled floor, but all the areas beyond were filled with a deep gray smoke.

introduced.name: grumbling adventurer's wish
introduced.how: a past team's shared complaint turned the place into an ordinary Domain
introduced.quote: If this was an ordinary Domain, we would've finished exploring it long ago.

introduced.name: trigger mechanism
introduced.how: a mechanism that only lets the Domain change when touched, dreamed up by an adventurer
introduced.quote: Well, you see that mechanism over there? That's a "trigger" that we put in place.

introduced.name: Adventure Coin
introduced.how: a golden coin created by willpower that the Traveler must grab as a test
introduced.quote: See that golden "Adventure Coin" over there? That's a little something we created using our willpower as well.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Wow! Does this mean that it could create, say, the entire Liyue Harbor in here?

assumed.name: ordinary Domains and ruins
assumed.quote: Isn't this just an ordinary ruin? Y'know, the ones we visit all the time?

threads.claim: The Domain transforms according to people's wishes, and the rules governing those changes are unknown.
threads.quote: This Domain transforms based on people's wishes.

threads.claim: The Domain reacts to the strongest thoughts when many people enter, but how it picks among them remains unclear.
threads.quote: If many people enter the Domain at once, then it will react to the person with the strongest thoughts.

threads.claim: Attempts to create Liyue Harbor failed, suggesting the strength of desire matters, but the limits remain unknown.
threads.quote: We've tried this, but to no avail. Perhaps our desire to create Liyue Harbor just wasn't strong enough.

threads.claim: The first adventurers found an empty room, and the reason it changed into an ordinary Domain is unexplained.
threads.quote: According to the first batch of adventurers, the Domain was just an "empty room" when they first entered it.

threads.claim: The empty room became an ordinary Domain when a team's shared wish gathered enough agreement, which explains the change.
threads.quote: And as more people began to concur, the team suddenly found themselves in "an ordinary Domain."

threads.claim: A 52-pace area cannot be crossed and gray smoke lies beyond it, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Whatever the case, it was impossible to cross this 52-pace area.

threads.claim: The trigger mechanism limits changes to when it is touched, and its dreamer must be periodically invited back to maintain it.
threads.quote: The Domain answered these wishes, but to ensure that this mechanism remains here, we have to periodically invite him back...

threads.claim: The Guild's extensive investigations have produced little, leaving the Domain's purpose and nature unknown.
threads.quote: Though the Guild has undertaken extensive investigations into that Domain, we have yet to achieve results of any particular value.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: Domains keep creating things based on the imaginations of those who enter them
introduced.quote: It still creates various things based on the imaginations of those who enter it.

introduced.name: Domain enemies
introduced.how: Domain-made enemies can attack and cause real pain, like a real battle
introduced.quote: They would attack us, and we actually felt real pain when they did.

introduced.name: earlier Domain investigation
introduced.how: An earlier Domain was investigated with the Traveler's help, yielding important data
introduced.quote: Thanks to your help in investigating that other Domain, we were able to obtain all manner of important data.

assumed.name: Honglang
assumed.quote: Traveler? What a coincidence! I didn't expect you to be here...

assumed.name: earlier Domain
assumed.quote: Is this the same sort of Domain as that other one you were investigating?

assumed.name: Guild
assumed.quote: Not for lack of trying by the Guild, but still.

threads.claim: The Domain vanished and then reappeared in Mondstadt, and its reasons for moving are unexplained.
threads.quote: And that was the last we heard of it until it showed up today in Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Domains have started creating enemies that can genuinely hurt people, and some foes overwhelm adventurers.
threads.quote: However, some of them conjured foes they could not beat, and wound up needing help to beat them...

threads.claim: The Guild has struggled to gather useful information on Domains from outside, so their inner workings remain a mystery.
threads.quote: However, there wasn't any way of getting more useful information on that Domain from the outside.

introduced.name: Klee

introduced.name: Ematol

threads.claim: A criminal called the Card Snatcher is stealing cards at the tournament, and his identity and motive are unknown.
threads.quote: There's a criminal who's been slinking around the competition venue, and his name is the Card Snatcher!

threads.claim: Charlotte suspects a second suspicious person may be a Card Snatcher, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm? *gasp* You mean, there are two Card Snatchers!?

threads.claim: Kaeya doubts that cards are really what the Card Snatcher is after.
threads.quote: But, one question, Paimon... Are you sure that cards are really what this "snatcher" is after?

threads.claim: The snatcher seems to be after Mondstadt card backs, though the reason he cares so much remains unknown.
threads.quote: So it seems we have an answer to Kaeya's question from earlier: What the Card Snatcher's really after is these card backs.

threads.claim: A stranger paid Adrian far above the card back's price, hinting the card backs are valuable for a reason.
threads.quote: This guy offered me three times what I'd paid for it, and handed me the Mora right then and there.

threads.claim: Charlotte senses that the card backs are only part of a larger, hidden story.
threads.quote: My gut tells me that there's more to this story than the card back alone.

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarder activity near Mondstadt is rising and worrying the Knights of Favonius.
threads.quote: Treasure Hoarder activity has been increasingly rampant lately.

threads.claim: The inventors of Genius Invokation TCG are almost never seen and have no known public presence.
threads.quote: But hardly anybody has ever seen them.

threads.claim: The Card Snatcher was seen beating Chongyun for a card back, marking him as a mysterious thief.
threads.quote: Hu Tao: I saw him playing a match against Chongyun this morning.

threads.claim: Every treasure-chest card back on the Liyue market was bought up overnight, tying a rare-item hoard to the thief.
threads.quote: Ningguang: I quickly learned that every card back with that particular design had been scooped up overnight.

threads.claim: Ningguang's intelligence network reaches so far that it seems to know everything happening across Liyue.
threads.quote: Baiwen: Lady Ningguang likes to stay informed. Nothing slips through her intelligence network.

threads.claim: Charlotte's truthful exclusive reporting has angered hidden powers, which is why she was sent abroad.
threads.quote: Baiwen: She also understands that in revealing the truth through your exclusive news, you have offended some interested parties

threads.claim: Kirara can change back into her original form, a hint that her youkai nature is more than a joke.
threads.quote: Kirara: Sometimes when I'm running late, I even have to change back into my original form and climb over walls to make sure the parcel's on time.

threads.claim: The Millelith stands guard in Liyue against evil, and Keqing will alert them to the thief.
threads.quote: Yong'an: I'll be alright. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never... ATCHOO! ...Prevail.

threads.claim: Wuwang Hill is full of yin energy, making it an unsafe place to play or wander.
threads.quote: Chongyun: But Wuwang Hill is full of yin energy. You shouldn't be playing in a place like this, understand?

threads.claim: Card games are presented as a way to forge friendship, a theme the story returns to.
threads.quote: Kaedehara Kazuha: Hmm, forging friendship through card-based combat does sound quite delightful.

threads.claim: Ningguang says that whatever games differ, they all bring friends together, extending the theme.
threads.quote: Ningguang: But when it comes down to it, whatever differences there may be between the various games around, they all share one important thing in common: They bring friends together.

threads.claim: A thief called the Card Snatcher is being tracked across nations, with few details known.
threads.quote: I interviewed a few people around Ritou, but no more details on the Card Snatcher, unfortunately.

threads.claim: The stolen card backs were being shipped to Sumeru inside Kirara's deliveries, solving the package clue.
threads.quote: (Kirara's deliveries contain the treasure chest card backs!)

threads.claim: Kirara's package pickup in Mondstadt predates the Card Snatcher sighting, so the timing does not fit one thief.
threads.quote: Kirara picked up her package in Mondstadt before we encountered the Card Snatcher. The timing doesn't make sense.

threads.claim: Kokomi concludes that more than one thief is involved and the tracked person is only one member of the group.
threads.quote: The way I see it, there's more than one thief involved.

threads.claim: The objective of the thieves and a hidden secret behind the card backs remain unknown.
threads.quote: What is the thieves' objective? What kind of secret is hidden behind these card backs?

threads.claim: Some people in Inazuma still fear Ei's lightning even though the land is at peace.
threads.quote: it seems that some people continue to fear the "divine light" just as before.

threads.claim: Watatsumi and Narukami are at peace, but war's wounds still linger in some people's hearts.
threads.quote: Though the islands are on peaceful terms now, the dark clouds of war still linger in some people's hearts.

threads.claim: Fans speculate about who really wrote King of Invokations and who truly invented the game, with no answer given.
threads.quote: Some people have even speculated that the author of King of Invokations is the boy who was possessed

threads.claim: Why a kitsune like Yae Miko would be interested in Fried Tofu is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Okay, then maybe you could help explain why a kitsune would have any interest in Fried Tofu.

threads.claim: Some people have never seen the Anemo Archon, hinting at a mystery about the archons.
threads.quote: Huh, now that I think about it, I've actually never seen the Anemo Archon, either.

threads.claim: Sangonomiya Kokomi defeats Yae Miko in the Inazuman regional final of the King of Invokations Grand Prix.
threads.quote: Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess from Watatsumi Island!

threads.claim: The mysterious inventors of Genius Invokation TCG remain unseen and unknown to the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: If anything, Paimon regrets that we didn't get to see the mysterious inventors of Genius Invokation TCG.

threads.claim: Gulab and Garvipidam are revealed as the two creators of Genius Invokation TCG.
threads.quote: He's one of the creators of Genius Invokation TCG!?

threads.claim: The card-back hunt was the Treasure Hoarders secretly coordinating a nationwide heist through card backs.
threads.quote: So in the end, it turned out that the group of card snatchers we were tracking was the Treasure Hoarders all along.

threads.claim: Gulab's gift, the Casket of Tomes, may have been left unused in a corner.
threads.quote: I imagine the Casket of Tomes I gave you

threads.claim: Garvipidam has kept the Casket of Tomes with him all along, treasuring Gulab's gift.
threads.quote: I've always kept your Casket of Tomes with me...

threads.claim: Eleazar is a progressive illness that worsened and left Gulab bedridden and unable to continue research.
threads.quote: But before long, the Eleazar got worse and led to some serious complications.

threads.claim: Kirara may be a youkai whose intuition guides her actions, though she is unsure of it herself.
threads.quote: Would you say that was your youkai intuition kicking in?

threads.claim: Gulab's friendship lives on through Garvipidam, who returns to playing the game they created together.
threads.quote: They stay with us in another form.

introduced.quote: The people of that time knew this as the False Hanamizaka Incident

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: Homeland of the bake-danuki and the Traveler's starting region across the sea
introduced.quote: That's Inazuma.

introduced.name: Anemo Archon
introduced.how: Mondstadt's god, represented by a large stone statue
introduced.quote: The Anemo Archon is Mondstadt's god, just like the Electro Archon is Inazuma's.

introduced.name: Electro Archon
introduced.how: Inazuma's god, whom Kichiboushi fears
introduced.quote: just like the Electro Archon is Inazuma's.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Ancient powers who defend Liyue
introduced.quote: The adepti are ancient powers who defend Liyue.

introduced.name: Amber
introduced.how: Substance Mountain Shaper's flowers create to trap intruders
introduced.quote: Mountain Shaper has flowers that can create amber to trap bad things that invade his land inside them.

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: An adeptus whose abode is at Mt. Hulao and who makes amber
introduced.quote: Mountain Shaper has flowers that can create amber to trap bad things that invade his land inside them.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: An adeptus who loves gourmet food and can fly
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer really loves gourmet food as well!

introduced.name: Liuli Pavilion
introduced.how: Restaurant serving Li Cuisine, where seats are hard to get
introduced.quote: We were planning to try the pinnacles of Li Cuisine and Yue Cuisine before returning to Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Xinyue Kiosk
introduced.how: Restaurant serving Yue Cuisine, booked alongside Liuli Pavilion
introduced.quote: So we booked seats at Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk a few months back...

introduced.name: Geri
introduced.how: A diner who introduces himself and books restaurant seats with Freki
introduced.quote: Sure. I'm Geri.

introduced.name: Sweet Madame
introduced.how: A Mondstadt dish described as crispy outside and tender inside
introduced.quote: crispy on the outside, tender on the inside!

introduced.name: Jueyun Guoba
introduced.how: A dish from Liyue, identified by Sara
introduced.quote: Are you referring to Jueyun Guoba, that dish from Liyue...?

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: Liyue restaurant known for its food, visited for Black-Back Perch Stew
introduced.quote: Next stop — Wanmin Restaurant!

introduced.name: Crystalfly
introduced.how: Creatures whose Crystal Cores can be captured, with varying colors by element
introduced.quote: It can be done, but we can only capture its Crystal Core.

introduced.name: Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: Place where Rex Lapis defeated Osial with stone spears
introduced.quote: This is Guyun Stone Forest!

introduced.name: Osial
introduced.how: The Overlord of the Vortex, a many-headed water snake defeated and sealed long ago
introduced.quote: Osial, the Overlord of the Vortex!

introduced.name: The Alcor
introduced.how: A ship that carried the Traveler from Mondstadt to Inazuma
introduced.quote: That's because The Alcor is a ship.

introduced.name: Captain Beidou
introduced.how: Captain of The Alcor and its crew, described as steady
introduced.quote: Captain Beidou is a real steady hand, and so are the rest of her crew.

introduced.name: Sucrose and Albedo
introduced.how: Described by Paimon as very smart and strong people who might know about Crystalflies
introduced.quote: Very smart and strong people!

introduced.name: Photo
introduced.how: A picture made by human magic, explained as a kind of drawing that captures a moment
introduced.quote: That's a "photo," and it's a kind of drawing.

introduced.name: Kichiboushi
introduced.how: a bake-danuki who was sealed in stone for a long time and is now learning to speak and train with the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: When I was sealed in stone, always standing.

introduced.name: Ioroi
introduced.how: a renowned bake-danuki still held in a stone seal who set Kichiboushi's training across eight places
introduced.quote: If I were free from this stone seal, it would be a thing of ease to have you understand tanuki speech all the time...

introduced.name: Bake-Danuki
introduced.how: a tanuki-like people who can take many forms and are not attacked by forest hilichurls
introduced.quote: Forest hilichurls do not attack bake-danuki.

introduced.name: Tanuki meal
introduced.how: a meal that let the Traveler and Paimon understand tanuki speech, wearing off over time
introduced.quote: It has been some time. The effects of the tanuki meal must have worn off.

introduced.name: Dvalin
introduced.how: Stormterror's real name, revealed as a dragon who was injured, tricked, and then cleared of being bad
introduced.quote: Stormterror actually had a name of his own, just like Kichiboushi, Paimon, and — and his name is Dvalin.

introduced.name: Stormterror
introduced.how: a dragon once called bad by Mondstadt who is a good friend of the Anemo Archon and was injured in a battle
introduced.quote: Stormterror is the archon's good friend! Long ago, the Anemo Archon was from this city, too...

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: a grim walled city ringed by storm-walls made of wind, with a tower where Stormterror rested
introduced.quote: We can't pass through these storm-walls. We've got to go around!

introduced.name: Dihua Marsh
introduced.how: a marsh whose waters connect to the sea, though it is not itself the sea
introduced.quote: Its waters are connected to the sea, though...

introduced.name: Utamarou
introduced.how: an artist who painted the tanuki sealed in Chinju Forest and left drafts behind
introduced.quote: There was once this fellow called Utamarou who painted the tanuki sealed in Chinju Forest and left some drafts behind.

introduced.name: Pyro Regisvine
introduced.how: a huge fire-flower creature that starts spewing flames when it sees the party
introduced.quote: I mean the Pyro Regisvine, of course.

introduced.name: Ioroi's eight-place training
introduced.how: Ioroi's request for the Traveler and Paimon to take Kichiboushi to eight places to train
introduced.quote: Oh yeah, speaking of which, Ioroi's goal was to take Kichiboushi to eight places to train

introduced.name: Anemo Archon's battle with an evil dragon
introduced.how: the Anemo Archon and Stormterror long ago fought an evil dragon to protect Mondstadt
introduced.quote: A long, long time later, the Anemo Archon and his friend Stormterror fought a big battle against an evil dragon to protect Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Hide-and-seek with hilichurls in Chinju Forest
introduced.how: Kichiboushi once played hide-and-seek with forest hilichurls when first meeting the Traveler in Chinju Forest
introduced.quote: Then, was playing Hide-and-Seek with the hilichurl.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: It's probably Kaeya's fault.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: We should probably ask someone knowledgeable like Lisa about this stuff in the future.

assumed.name: Reizenbou
assumed.quote: that fellow who learned magic from Reizenbou

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: together with a Fatui Harbinger and Rex Lapis himself!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Special delivery for the Fatui!

assumed.name: Sara
assumed.quote: Hi, Sara!

assumed.name: Baron Bunny
assumed.quote: Some new Baron Bunny model...?

assumed.name: Francis
assumed.quote: I wonder how Francis always manages to get seats at Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk.

assumed.name: Chef Mao
assumed.quote: Hey here, Chef Mao!

assumed.name: Dendro
assumed.quote: All hail the power of Dendro!

assumed.name: Shogun
assumed.quote: didn't he eventually receive the Shogun's acknowledgment and become the Protector of the Grove?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: those Treasure Hoarders who were trapped in amber

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: The Rite of Descension only happens once a year!

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Atop Ningguang's Jade Chamber

assumed.name: Sacred Sakura
assumed.quote: Things fall from Sacred Sakura

assumed.name: Sneaky kitsune
assumed.quote: everything is that sneaky kitsune's fault...

assumed.name: Dusky Ming and Changchang
assumed.quote: Like Dusky Ming and Changchang...

assumed.name: Vermeer
assumed.quote: Vermeer! Don't you remember the time we helped him place those glowing pearls into two giant statues?

assumed.name: Chinju Forest
assumed.quote: Hmm, when we first met in Chinju Forest...

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Do you still remember that Anemo Archon statue we saw in Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Mon-Mon
assumed.quote: Storm-Storm protects Mondstadt like Mon-Mon protects Liyue.

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: So Kichiboushi thinks to be an adeptus, so is an adeptus?

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Something Venti would truly love.

assumed.name: Traveler's lost relative
assumed.quote: the goal of our journey is to help you find your lost relative

threads.claim: Ioroi is stuck in stone under a seal that the Traveler hopes can be lifted soon.
threads.quote: Hope your seal can be lifted soon.

threads.claim: Kichiboushi vows to use stronger magic to free Ioroi from stone, but the question stays open.
threads.quote: With stronger magic, Kichiboushi can make Ioroi not-stone!

threads.claim: Kichiboushi's speech is incomprehensible to the Traveler and Paimon, and it is unclear why.
threads.quote: We can't understand what Kichiboushi says, so wouldn't traveling together be kinda tough?

threads.claim: Ioroi says a bake-danuki meal lets humans understand tanuki speech, and humans can speak to them through it.
threads.quote: Through the power of the bake-danuki meal made by mine own hands, you, too, may speak to the little tanuki.

threads.claim: What bake-danuki food is made from is left mysterious, and the Traveler discourages asking.
threads.quote: Some questions are best left unasked, Paimon.

threads.claim: Kichiboushi claims bake-danuki food is made from leaves, which Paimon finds odd and unconvincing.
threads.quote: Bake-danuki is made from leaves, Kapow!

threads.claim: Ioroi blames a sneaky kitsune for his troubles and for the meal, hinting at an old rivalry.
threads.quote: everything is that sneaky kitsune's fault...

threads.claim: Ioroi reveals he once competed with the kitsune and was seen through in the False Hanamizaka Incident.
threads.quote: Back when I was competing with that sneaky kitsune, I once transformed myself into Hanamizaka

threads.claim: Ioroi saw a high mountain across the ocean and still wonders what that place was.
threads.quote: I still wonder, even today, what that place was.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests the mountain Ioroi saw is probably Dragonspine, though Ioroi's fear of it is unexplained.
threads.quote: From the direction you're referring to, that's probably Dragonspine.

threads.claim: What snow is made of and why Dragonspine is so cold remains an open question.
threads.quote: What do you think snow's actually made of

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon offer guesses involving Hydro and Cryo, but nothing is settled.
threads.quote: Cryo, most likely.

threads.claim: Kaeya has placed a suspiciously large order, hinting he is planning something.
threads.quote: Captain Kaeya put in a very expensive order for several dozen people at the Goth Grand Hotel.

threads.claim: Chef Mao confirms Kaeya's huge order and wonders how he will return the dishes, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Not that I have any idea how that guy is going to take all those dishes back...

threads.claim: Ioroi's sealing in stone has a hinted cause, a stolen comb, that is never fully explained.
threads.quote: You got sealed because you stole that comb...

threads.claim: Kichiboushi says Ioroi and Otogi King sealed the Four Oni of Ogata in paper, adding to the tangle of past sealings.
threads.quote: Later, Ioroi and Otogi King threw them into paper and sealed them.

threads.claim: Why Geo Crystalflies' cores are not gold is a question the Traveler cannot answer.
threads.quote: I honestly don't know the answer to that question.

threads.claim: Paimon hints that Barbara may have discovered something about the Holy Lyre der Himmel, unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders if Barbara's discovered the thing with the Holy Lyre der Himmel

threads.claim: Ioroi was nearly chopped in the past, an incident hinted at but not explained.
threads.quote: He was nearly chopped.

threads.claim: Kichiboushi claims tanuki who leave the path explode, a rule that might not be literally true.
threads.quote: Tanuki who leave the path... explode.

threads.claim: Paimon doubts Ioroi's warning and thinks he is fibbing about tanuki leaving the path.
threads.quote: Paimon's pretty sure that Ioroi's fibbing.

threads.claim: Ioroi and Tsukumo both made a pilgrimage across eighteen sites, leaving the purpose of the route unexplained.
threads.quote: I traced the footsteps of the great bake-danuki Tsukumo across eighteen famous sites

threads.claim: Kichiboushi and Ioroi were both held in stone seals, and Kichiboushi's experience of being sealed is tied to a wider sealing of the bake-danuki.
threads.quote: When I was sealed in stone, always standing.

threads.claim: The tanuki meal that let the party understand Kichiboushi's speech has worn off, explaining why understanding stopped.
threads.quote: It has been some time. The effects of the tanuki meal must have worn off.

threads.claim: Stormterror, named Dvalin, was poisoned and tricked by bad people, and was cleared after the Traveler and allies purified his blood.
threads.quote: Later, we beat those bad people and helped the Anemo Archon purify the blood that was tainting him.

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon's fate is left unclear: he was gone when Stormterror woke, and no one remembered him.
threads.quote: He slept for a long, long time, and when he woke up, no one remembered him anymore. His friend, the Anemo Archon, was also gone.

threads.claim: Boundaries and categories such as sea and not-sea are man-made constructs without inherent meaning, and are what one believes them to be.
threads.quote: These concepts are all man-made constructs. They don't have inherent meaning.

threads.claim: Companions who adventure together grow together, and the bond between Kichiboushi, the Traveler, and Paimon is a recurring theme.
threads.quote: Companions who adventure together, grow together.

threads.claim: The Traveler's journey aims to find a lost relative, a goal that is left open in this unit.
threads.quote: the goal of our journey is to help you find your lost relative

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: an struggling alchemist who asks the Traveler for help with a new experiment
introduced.quote: Timaeus: Okay, so... I'm sorry about this, but... there's something I really need your help with.

introduced.name: Elemental Crucible
introduced.how: a new alchemical furnace that holds pure elemental energy and generates elemental reactions
introduced.quote: Timaeus: Well, basically, it's a vessel that can hold pure elemental energy and generate elemental reactions.

introduced.name: elemental energy
introduced.how: alchemy usually uses items infused with elemental energy, not pure elemental energy, which adds impurities and cost
introduced.quote: Timaeus: For a number of reasons, alchemy is mostly performed using items infused with elemental energy, rather than pure elemental energy itself.

introduced.name: bio-alchemy
introduced.how: a branch of alchemy that other researchers already study
introduced.quote: Timaeus: There's nothing particularly new about bio-alchemy. There are already people researching that.

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: Timaeus: Unfortunately, this all creates extra costs for those who wish to perform alchemy without using Visions.

assumed.name: alchemy
assumed.quote: Timaeus: Do you know what the most important factor in alchemy is? It's the elements.

threads.claim: The Traveler lacks a Vision yet is said to be able to manipulate elemental energy, an unexplained ability.
threads.quote: Timaeus: I've heard you can manipulate elemental energy even though you don't have a Vision. Is that right?

threads.claim: Timaeus refuses to study the alchemical arts of the ancients, leaving that origin of alchemy unexplored.
threads.quote: Timaeus: You mean study the alchemical arts of the ancients? No, that's not something I'd be able to get involved in...

threads.claim: The Elemental Crucible is set up at the Thousand Winds Temple and is about to be tested for the first time.
threads.quote: Timaeus: Let's fire it up and see if it works.

threads.claim: Timaeus hopes the Elemental Crucible will be his big alchemical breakthrough, which is not yet resolved.
threads.quote: Timaeus: I really hope this will be my big breakthrough in alchemy...

introduced.name: Irade

introduced.name: Tradition of selecting new warriors from tribal youth

introduced.quote: While we've asked "Malipo" Kinich and "Vuka" Chasca to deal with those of the Scions of the Canopy and the Flower-Feather Clan,

assumed.name: Archon

assumed.name: The unattainable horizon

threads.claim: The Archon oversees the training of tribal patrol squads, but the text does not explain who the Archon is.

threads.claim: Warriors from the tribes are periodically chosen to join the patrol squads, and veterans face tougher tests.
