introduced.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
introduced.how: a festival youkai once celebrated, revived as a human-youkai event
introduced.quote: When the youkai still roamed the land, they celebrated an event known as

introduced.name: Ioroi
introduced.how: Kakushigami of the bake-danuki, sealed in a statue in Chinju Forest
introduced.quote: E—Excuse you! I am Ioroi, the Kakushigami of the bake-danuki!

introduced.name: Chinju Forest
introduced.how: Ioroi's territory, where the Test of Courage was held
introduced.quote: Oh, Chinju Forest is supposed to be Ioroi's territory, right? No wonder he's so mad...

introduced.name: bake-danuki
introduced.how: tanuki youkai who excel at transformation, rivaling kitsune
introduced.quote: In Inazuma, only the bake-danuki can hope to match the kitsune in that area.

introduced.name: Kitsune Meal
introduced.how: a meal that lets youkai speak with humans
introduced.quote: It will give you the ability to speak to humans.

introduced.name: Kichiboushi, Shousei and Gyoubu Koban
introduced.how: young bake-danuki cubs under Ioroi's care who speak in simple phrases
introduced.quote: Now, Kichiboushi, Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, while you're out there, always listen to—

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: Yae Miko's publishing company, sponsoring the festival
introduced.quote: Yae Publishing House is going to great lengths for this occasion, both in time and personnel.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: normally supplies the festival official alongside the Guuji
introduced.quote: the role was usually given to the Guuji, or an individual from the Yashiro Commission.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: provides most personnel and supplies and receives half the festival proceeds
introduced.quote: The other half is going to the Shogunate — that is not up for negotiation.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: responsible for festival security
introduced.quote: They're in charge of festival security, so that should take precedence.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission officer overseeing festival security
introduced.quote: It is the Tenryou Commission's responsibility to maintain security and order throughout the entirety of the proceedings.

introduced.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
introduced.how: introduces herself as a yumekui-baku, a youkai who eats dreams
introduced.quote: Nice to meet you, Gyoubu Koban. My name is Yumemizuki Mizuki. I'm a yumekui-baku. We're youkai, just like you.

introduced.name: Aisa Bathhouse
introduced.how: bathhouse chain considering a branch on Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: We were discussing the potential of opening a new branch of the Aisa Bathhouse on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: island lacking natural hot springs, where a bathhouse branch is considered
introduced.quote: I'm afraid there are no natural hot springs on Watatsumi island.

introduced.name: Gorou
introduced.how: works on the That's Life column for Yae Publishing House and handles Watatsumi business
introduced.quote: You work on the That's Life column?

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: Ayaka's brother who oversees the festival teams with the Guuji
introduced.quote: I apologize for not greeting you upon arrival. The Lady Guuji and I were discussing something urgent.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayaka
introduced.how: organizes the festival logistics and is Ayato's sister
introduced.quote: For large events like the Test of Courage, Brother usually does most of the organizing.

introduced.name: Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder
introduced.how: collectible statue sold at the festival, of which Sara owns five
introduced.quote: All Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder being sold at this event are an old model.

introduced.name: Tanuki Game Award
introduced.how: trophy for the winning game team, with Mora and a Yae Publishing House sponsorship
introduced.quote: The winning team will be awarded the Tanuki Game Award!

introduced.name: Akitsu Harpastum
introduced.how: Thoma's game combining Akitsu Yuugei with Mondstadt's Ludi Harpastum
introduced.quote: It's pretty simple, actually. Just swing the racket to hit the balls back where they came from.

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: a ninja who loves sleep and insists she is human, not a youkai
introduced.quote: She's a ninja, not a youkai.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the Shogun's investigative force handling the strange incident
introduced.quote: Yesterday, the Tenryou Commission received a report that the team was found unconscious in the field.

introduced.name: Doppelganger folk tale
introduced.how: a common Inazuma folk belief that seeing your doppelganger means being replaced within three days
introduced.quote: Takitoh: You know what they say... Anyone who sees their doppelganger will be replaced by them within three days..

introduced.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
introduced.how: a festival meant to bring humans and youkai together
introduced.quote: Ei: The purpose of festival is to bring humans and youkai together. We cannot allow the culprit to endanger anyone.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: small, friendly youkai from Sumeru said to give good dreams
introduced.quote: Yoimiya: No, it's not a food! The Aranara are like, um... small youkai from Sumeru. They're super friendly and cute, and can give you good dreams...

introduced.name: Ei (Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder)
introduced.how: the Shogun is revealed as the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder, presented to the festival
introduced.quote: Yae Miko: Please welcome, Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder!

introduced.name: Nightmare disaster five hundred years ago
introduced.how: a dark disaster after which a Nightmare engulfed Inazuma and soldiers fought dark creatures
introduced.quote: Ei: ...You're correct. Following the dark disaster five hundred years ago, a Nightmare engulfed Inazuma.

introduced.name: Musou no Hitotachi
introduced.how: a weapon Ei used to strike down a person during the past Nightmare
introduced.quote: Ei: I... unleashed Musou no Hitotachi and struck her down.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Hiroshi
introduced.how: introduced the Snezhnayan Blast Furnace to Inazuma five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: But, the plans were set in motion only after Hiiragi Hiroshi introduced the Snezhnayan Blast Furnace to Inazuma, and that was five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: its members were once friends with Makoto and the Kitsune Saiguu
introduced.quote: Ei: The members of the Kanjou Commission were once friends with Makoto and the Kitsune Saiguu.

introduced.name: Yumekui-Baku
introduced.how: dream-eating youkai who relieve nightmares, whose legacy Mizuki carries
introduced.quote: Ei: Even so, relieving the pain of the nightmares is no small feat. You honor the legacy of the Yumekui-Baku.

introduced.name: Bake-danuki transformation weakness
introduced.how: bake-danuki disguises crumble when the one transformed is frightened
introduced.quote: Shikanoin Heizou: This kind of transformation is said to have a particular weakness... If the subject is frightened, the disguise starts to crumble.

introduced.name: Ioroi
introduced.how: the Protector of the Grove, whom Ei has not met in five hundred years, now a statue
introduced.quote: Ei: The Protector of the Grove... It's been five hundred years since our last meeting.

introduced.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
introduced.how: A human who came to hunt the bake-danuki and drove them into hiding
introduced.quote: When the human, Kamuna Harunosuke, came to hurt us...

introduced.name: Mikoshi Chiyo
introduced.how: An oni warrior turned by nightmare who attacked the Almighty Shogun and lost an arm and horn
introduced.quote: Tainted by darkness, the oni warrior raised her sword against the Almighty Shogun.

introduced.name: Nightmare Fragment
introduced.how: A piece of a nightmare that can take physical form and spread its corruption to whoever hides from fear
introduced.quote: If the horn contained the fragment of a nightmare, using its power to hide would spread the nightmare to them.

introduced.name: Nightmares feed on fear
introduced.how: Nightmares are nourished by fear and anxiety, which can make them take physical form
introduced.quote: Nightmares feed on fear and anxiety.

introduced.name: Jibakurei
introduced.how: An earthbound spirit that moves through Ley Lines and is bound to them
introduced.quote: An earthbound spirit. They move through the Ley Lines, but are also bound by them.

introduced.name: Horn of youkai power
introduced.how: A horn filled with youkai power that the bake-danuki dug up and used to hide, and which is tied to Chiyo's nightmare
introduced.quote: That's when we uncovered a horn filled with youkai power! It was the will of the great bake-danuki Giichiro made manifest!

introduced.name: Musou Isshin
introduced.how: A power that can split an enemy in two, used to defeat nightmarish foes
introduced.quote: And an enemy that can be killed... is one that can be split in two by the power of Musou Isshin.

introduced.name: Plane of Euthymia
introduced.how: A separate realm where Ei pulls enemies to fight them
introduced.quote: (Ei pulls the Traveler and the Fragments into the Plane of Euthymia)

introduced.name: Mt. Yougou
introduced.how: A mountain where the nightmare's traces have appeared and where Chiyo fought Ei
introduced.quote: That's why the traces of this entity appeared intermittently, and never outside of Mt. Yougou.

introduced.name: Ioroi's comb theft
introduced.how: Ioroi stealing a comb led to the bake-danuki being sealed away
introduced.quote: Besides, the bake-danuki were only sealed away back then because Ioroi stole that comb...

assumed.name: Test of Courage
assumed.quote: We hosted a version of it during the Test of Courage. Unfortunately, due to time constraints, we weren't able to put on a large celebration.

assumed.name: Akitsu Yuugei and Akitsu Haneasobi
assumed.quote: Wait, kind of like Akitsu Yuugei and Akitsu Haneasobi? Those games were really fun!

assumed.name: Ioroi
assumed.quote: Hmm... Chinju Forest. Let's pay a visit to our old friend, Ioroi.

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: That Ei... When did she reprogram you to argue back like this?

assumed.name: Hitotsume Kozou
assumed.quote: Hitotsume Kozou and the others did all the work, Bull-chucker.

assumed.name: Arataki Gang
assumed.quote: Man, the Arataki Gang really hard-carried the last one.

assumed.name: Ludi Harpastum
assumed.quote: For many years after leaving Mondstadt, the only place I could experience Ludi Harpastum was in my dreams...

assumed.name: Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho
assumed.quote: Wait, but what about the Statue of the, uh... Almighty... Narukami, uh... Ogo— Eh, you know the one.

assumed.name: Kitsune Meal
assumed.quote: Oh, but before I forget, you should eat this Kitsune Meal first.

assumed.name: Sayu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, looks like Sayu's team is already here.

assumed.name: Kichiboushi
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sayu and Yoimiya seem the same as ever! Kichiboushi, too. How should we test them...?

assumed.name: Shogun (Ei)
assumed.quote: Traveler: Those orders come from the Shogun, don't they...

assumed.name: Akitsu Yuugei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait a second, Hitotsume Kozou and the others should be Akitsu Yuugei experts.

assumed.name: Ioroi
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Because he's trapped in a statue, I'm guessing...?)

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey! It's not like Dvalin's the one behind every single gust of wind!

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Miko! And Mizuki!

assumed.name: Ioroi
assumed.quote: Kinkaku: Ioroi! The humans really did seal you away!

assumed.name: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
assumed.quote: Wait, this must be... Kinkaku... Ginkaku.... and Tetsunosuke? You weren't sealed away?

assumed.name: Yumekui-Baku
assumed.quote: ...The Yumekui-Baku already tried that five hundred years ago.

assumed.name: Hitotsume Kozou
assumed.quote: The Investigation Team working for a better future? Attacked... Hitotsume Kozou and his friends, kind enough to lend a helping hand? Attacked...

assumed.name: Lady Guuji
assumed.quote: I assembled all the key information into booklets, Lady Guuji, and the incantation for the ritual has been distributed along with them.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Remarkably efficient, Ayato. How are things with the Tenryou Commission?

assumed.name: Aisa Bathhouse
assumed.quote: A little birdie told me you went to Aisa Bathhouse last night!

assumed.name: Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: That's great news! We might even beat Yae Publishing house this month...

assumed.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
assumed.quote: ...The Mikawa Flower Festival!

threads.claim: A mysterious dream-like attacker appears at night, and Ei seems to be watching the nightmare returning to Inazuma.
threads.quote: ...Has a "Nightmare" returned to Inazuma once again?

threads.claim: Thunder struck in the waking world, unexplained, and the Traveler wonders whether it was part of the dream.
threads.quote: Also, what was with that thunder just now? It came out of nowhere, and it's not even raining!

threads.claim: Ioroi remains sealed inside a statue, and the reason is left unexplained.
threads.quote: So, still sealed in that statue, then? I suppose it can't be helped...

threads.claim: Dreams are framed as a shared human and youkai capacity, tying the festival theme to the dream-eating and nightmare threads.
threads.quote: One thing we all share... is our capacity to dream.

threads.claim: The Kitsune Meal grants speech, and Ioroi suspects a lingering Bake-Danuki Meal effect may explain understanding.
threads.quote: Does that mean the Bake-Danuki Meal from last time is still working...?

threads.claim: Yae Miko repeatedly uses bargaining and misdirection to get what she wants, and the Traveler suspects her motives.
threads.quote: Wait, so earlier... you were just trying to shortchange us!

threads.claim: Thoma's childhood in Mondstadt has changed beyond recognition, and his game is rooted in that lost past.
threads.quote: For many years after leaving Mondstadt, the only place I could experience Ludi Harpastum was in my dreams...

threads.claim: A doppelganger folk tale and strange doppelganger sightings are spreading panic and may be linked to the investigation.
threads.quote: Takitoh: You know what they say... Anyone who sees their doppelganger will be replaced by them within three days..

threads.claim: A Nightmare that engulfed Inazuma five hundred years ago may be connected to the current nightmares.
threads.quote: Ei: ...You're correct. Following the dark disaster five hundred years ago, a Nightmare engulfed Inazuma.

threads.claim: Ei carries a painful past of having struck down someone with Musou no Hitotachi and keeps it to herself.
threads.quote: Ei: I... unleashed Musou no Hitotachi and struck her down.

threads.claim: Long ago, orders from the Shogun led soldiers to exterminate youkai, which the bake-danuki remember as a nightmare.
threads.quote: Kiritani: ...By order of the Shogun, we are to exterminate all youkai that cross our path!

threads.claim: The bake-danuki have been hiding for centuries and may have known Ioroi, who may still be alive.
threads.quote: Tetsunosuke: This smell... is Ioroi! Ioroi is alive?

threads.claim: The nightmare creature cannot be perceived at its source, leaving its nature and origin unexplained.
threads.quote: Yumemizuki Mizuki: It's strange... I can't perceive his nightmare. It's almost like... he's not there at all.

threads.claim: The culprit left a wooden stand-in disguised as Kappa while the replaced contestants hid in Inazuma City.
threads.quote: Paimon: K—Kappa is... Kappa is made of wood!?

threads.claim: The Traveler can purify nightmares by acting against the Abyss, freeing the bake-danuki from their nightmare memories.
threads.quote: Traveler: If the nightmares come from the Abyss...

threads.claim: The horn full of youkai power may be the source of the nightmares that frighten the bake-danuki.
threads.quote: A horn full of youkai power... Could that be the source of the nightmares? The reason the bake-danuki are so afraid of humans?

threads.claim: Chiyo's battle trauma never left her, and it fed a nightmare that twisted her life.
threads.quote: Though she escaped the belly of the beast alive... That battle never left her.

threads.claim: The nightmare fragment on the horn is revealed to come from Chiyo's nightmare.
threads.quote: And, subsequently, uncovered by three bake-danuki... That means the fragment on the horn... comes from Chiyo's nightmare.

threads.claim: The Nightmare Fragment hates all joy and good things, and it may be as dangerous as the one from the past.
threads.quote: It would seem the fragment of this Nightmare is no different from the one back then... It hates all joy and every good thing in this world.

threads.claim: Nightmare Fragments can be defeated, though the cost of doing so is unclear.
threads.quote: ...But, both possibilities prove something... Nightmare Fragments can be defeated.

threads.claim: Yae Miko may be shaping the story and asking others to back her claims about the bake-danuki.
threads.quote: If you don't believe me, ask Mizuki and . I'm sure they've encountered similar cases during their extensive travels...

threads.claim: Ei realizes Miko's claim that striking the nightmare could endanger the bake-danuki may have been a lie.
threads.quote: ...After all, you claimed striking down the nightmare could endanger the bake-danuki. Unless... that was a lie?

threads.claim: Archons feel the same emotional turmoil as humans and youkai, and the dead's emotions do not vanish with them.
threads.quote: (Mizuki said Archons suffer from the same turmoil as the rest of us... The dead may be gone, but that doesn't mean our emotions die with them...)

threads.claim: Ei feels the consequences of her choices more since leaving the Plane of Euthymia.
threads.quote: ...Since leaving the Plane of Euthymia, I seem to experience this feeling more and more, whether in the markets of Inazuma or before the Sacred Sakura...

threads.claim: Chiyo is freed from her nightmare and passes peacefully, with Ei granting her sweet dreams.
threads.quote: This time... only sweet dreams await

introduced.name: Hosseini
introduced.how: a scholar who introduces himself and his research on the Energy Amplifier
introduced.quote: I'm Hosseini, a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya. After a great many tribulations, I finally reached Inazuma to conduct research there.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: the academic institution Hosseini works for, which acknowledged his earlier Energy Amplifier research
introduced.quote: I'm Hosseini, a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya.

introduced.name: Energy Amplifier
introduced.how: a precious ancient artifact that strengthens its user by drawing on ley lines
introduced.quote: But the Energy Amplifier is a precious ancient artifact that can use the ubiquitous ley lines to strengthen its user.

introduced.name: ley lines
introduced.how: ubiquitous energy lines that the Energy Amplifier can use to strengthen its user
introduced.quote: But the Energy Amplifier is a precious ancient artifact that can use the ubiquitous ley lines to strengthen its user.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: islands where Hosseini went to conduct research, which proved too restrictive
introduced.quote: After a great many tribulations, I finally reached Inazuma to conduct research there.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: a newly discovered, never-traversed domain full of monsters stronger than those in the wilds, suggested as a test site
introduced.quote: I've heard passing adventurers mention that they've discovered some strange new Domain of late.

assumed.name: Ritou meeting
assumed.quote: We met on Ritou, remember?

assumed.name: earlier Energy Amplifier affair
assumed.quote: Now, I'm not sure if you remember that whole affair...

assumed.name: prior Akademiya acknowledgment of Energy Amplifier research
assumed.quote: And so I thought — why not return to the topic of the Energy Amplifier, my efforts in which the Akademiya had acknowledged prior?

assumed.name: Traveler's previous performances
assumed.quote: I mean, your previous performances... *cough* I must say that they've been very impressive indeed.

threads.claim: The Energy Amplifier's workings are not yet fully understood and its research is still preliminary.
threads.quote: Much work remains to be done if we are to understand the workings of the Energy Amplifier in their entirety.

threads.claim: Hosseini's earlier report was only a preface, and the Amplifier's recorded data is the limiting factor in his research.
threads.quote: it is the data recorded by the Energy Amplifier that has been the limiting reactant here.

threads.claim: The Energy Amplifier is an authentic ancient relic whose loss or damage would cause trouble for Hosseini.
threads.quote: However, do note that this is an authentic ancient relic. You will land me in no small amount of hot water should you lose it or break it.

threads.claim: A strange new domain that no one has ever traversed lies nearby, and it is teeming with monsters stronger than those in the wilds.
threads.quote: No one has ever traversed this terrain before, and it is teeming with monsters that are stronger than the ones you see wandering about in the wilds.

threads.claim: The Traveler finds Hosseini suspicious and doubts his intentions in asking for volunteers.
threads.quote: You still seem shady to me...

threads.claim: Hosseini denies being a villain or a mad scientist and insists his research is legitimate.
threads.quote: Oh, come on! Do I look like some mad scientist who grabs passersby to use for human experimentation?

threads.claim: Hosseini trusts the Traveler's strength and says he has full faith they will be fine with the test.
threads.quote: I have full faith that you'll be fine... *cough*

introduced.name: Hosseini
introduced.how: a researcher from Sumeru Akademiya who wants the Irminsul Fruit for his thesis
introduced.quote: This gentlemen's name is Hosseini. He is a researcher from the Sumeru Akademiya.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: a scholarly body that commissioned the Guild and treats the fruit as a research priority
introduced.quote: Basically, Sumeru Akademiya commissioned the Adventurers' Guild to investigate on their behalf, and we found an Irminsul Fruit.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: a group that takes investigation commissions and can be hired by clients like the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Recently, the Adventurers' Guild was commissioned by the Akademiya to investigate a ruin, where we found a perfectly preserved Irminsul Fruit.

introduced.name: Irminsul Fruit
introduced.how: a perfectly preserved ancient fruit of high research value that holds great power
introduced.quote: Recently, the Adventurers' Guild was commissioned by the Akademiya to investigate a ruin, where we found a perfectly preserved Irminsul Fruit.

introduced.name: Energy Amplifier
introduced.how: an ancient device that conducts and amplifies energy and can be used on fragments
introduced.quote: It's a genuine slice of ancient history! An object that can conduct and amplify energy. It's another object of my research.

introduced.name: Irminsul Fruit explosion
introduced.how: a transported fruit was attacked by Treasure Hoarders and exploded, which surprised even the Guild
introduced.quote: One of them attacked the cart carrying the Irminsul Fruit and... it exploded.

introduced.name: Irminsul Fruit fragments
introduced.how: the blast scattered fragments into dangerous areas and some were carried far away by monsters
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, the force of the explosion sent some of the fragments into dangerous areas, where even Guild members are hesitant to venture.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: My sole purpose in coming all this way to Liyue was to retrieve this Irminsul Fruit.

assumed.name: God of Wisdom
assumed.quote: fortunate enough to undergo a... prolonged period of scrutiny by the God of Wisdom.

assumed.name: Soraya
assumed.quote: I'm not educated by any description, but I think Soraya from Wangshu Inn told me something about this...

assumed.name: Map
assumed.quote: you will find many on your Map that we have yet to investigate.

assumed.name: domain
assumed.quote: head to a domain that we previously discovered and conduct a practical test.

threads.claim: Irminsul Fruits can explode unexpectedly, which even the Guild did not know before it happened.
threads.quote: Apparently so... This was also news to us when it occurred.

threads.claim: The Irminsul Fruit's great power draws monsters, and an unusually energy-rich fragment raises questions about how it was obtained.
threads.quote: If my theory is correct, a fragment like this should have attracted a whole horde of dangerous monsters...

threads.claim: Hosseini hints that the Energy Amplifier may become the focus of his research and thesis.
threads.quote: Hmm, although.... maybe there's still time to change direction and focus on the Energy Amplifier in my thesis...

threads.claim: Akademiya scholars undergo prolonged scrutiny by the God of Wisdom, a hidden arrangement hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: fortunate enough to undergo a... prolonged period of scrutiny by the God of Wisdom.

threads.claim: The Guild and Akademiya are hunting scattered Irminsul Fragments, and the Traveler is asked to gather them through domain testing.
threads.quote: Traveler, could I trouble you to please gather any further Irminsul Fruit fragments you come across during your travels?

introduced.name: Félix Yogue
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Félix Yogue, a visitor from the Court of Fontaine
introduced.quote: Yogue! Félix Yogue. Salutations to you, Honorary Knight! Long have I heard of your many exploits.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: Yogue is from the Court of Fontaine, where The Steambird is popular
introduced.quote: Well, allow me to introduce you. This man here is from the Court of Fontaine...

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: A rather popular newspaper in the Court of Fontaine
introduced.quote: Ah, you don't know? It's a... Ah, let's say it's a rather popular newspaper in the Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Kinesis Core
introduced.how: A clockwork device that provides motive force for a long time when wound
introduced.quote: Simply put, a Kinesis Core is a form of clockwork device.

introduced.name: Evermotion Mechanical Painting
introduced.how: A perpetual-motion toy powered by a Kinesis Core, made by Yogue to show off the core
introduced.quote: I even created a sort of perpetual-motion toy powered by the Kinesis Core to show off its capabilities. I call it the Evermotion Mechanical Painting.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: The passion of Mondstadt is well-founded, I say.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: even their hilichurls are so very lively.

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Your battle against Dvalin in Mondstadt made headlines in The Steambird for three whole weeks!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Huh? Honorary Knight? Ah, wonderful! Just the person I wanted to see!

assumed.name: Xavier
assumed.quote: I'm sure Xavier would love it...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius have a never-ending backlog of work.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Front-page, full-length, expert interviews up the wazoo, and the best hand-drawn illustrations Mora could buy!

threads.claim: The Evermotion Mechanical Painting has scattered components, and the count given is 19.
Monsters have divided the device into many pieces and are playing with the components.
threads.quote: At the moment, they must have divvied my device up into many pieces in a manner most unfriendly, playing around with each component...

threads.claim: The finale reunites the scattered parts into one painting, though the count given is six rather than 19.
threads.quote: Ah, bravo! All six Evermotion Mechanical Painting parts, now returned to us! Now then, all we need to do is to splice them together again...

threads.claim: Kinesis Cores are clockwork devices that run for a long time once their mainspring is wound.
threads.quote: As long as its mainspring is wound from time to time, these cores can provide motive force for a long period of time.

threads.claim: The Steambird's headlines have made the Traveler famous through sensational coverage.
threads.quote: Your battle against Dvalin in Mondstadt made headlines in The Steambird for three whole weeks!

threads.claim: Yogue calls the Steambird reporters' sensational stories ridiculous exaggerations.
threads.quote: Ah, how ridiculous and foolish those reporters were! How much ado they made about so little!

threads.claim: Yogue's creative work depends on inspiration that comes and goes unpredictably.
threads.quote: It's a matter of inspiration, you understand? What shall I do when inspiration strikes?

introduced.name: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
introduced.how: a new beast-taming tournament where contestants capture and command Fungi in combat
introduced.quote: The first ever Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament is about to begin! We anticipate your arrival!

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: monsters that can be captured, trained and commanded in battle; they can be aggressive and dangerous
introduced.quote: But Fungi are monsters! We can't let this go ahead! It's way too dangerous...

introduced.name: Wisdom Orb
introduced.how: a device that captures, stores and controls Fungi, developed by the Akademiya
introduced.quote: The Wisdom Orb can capture and store Fungi. It also serves as a controller.

introduced.name: Kautilya
introduced.how: a senior Amurta researcher who organizes the tournament and built the Wisdom Orb
introduced.quote: I am Kautilya, a senior Amurta researcher and the organizer of today's tournament.

introduced.name: Elchingen
introduced.how: a wealthy Fontaine businessman who sponsors the tournament with sixty million Mora
introduced.quote: this event is sponsored by Mr. Elchingen, a renowned businessman from Fontaine who has generously provided a grand total of sixty million Mora for our prize fund!

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: a former Eremite-affiliated beast tamer and contestant who teaches the Travelers and later reveals she wants to exterminate Fungi
introduced.quote: The name's Haniyyah. I used to work for the Eremites, taming grumpy Sumpter Beasts.

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: a Rtawahist Darshan student with a congenital sleep disorder who is entering the tournament to take Fungi home
introduced.quote: Um... my name is Layla. I'm just a student in the Rtawahist Darshan

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: a light novel editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House, from Inazuma, who is also entering the tournament
introduced.quote: I'm Yae Miko, a light novel editor — purely out of personal interest, and right now, what I'm most interested in is you... Nice to meet you.

introduced.name: Souka
introduced.how: an up-and-coming author at Yae Publishing House, nervous and dedicated to her craft, also a contestant
introduced.quote: Yes, Chief Editor!

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: the Almighty Merchant of the Grand Bazaar who supplies Layla's ingredients and passes on suspicious items
introduced.quote: Every vendor and customer in the Grand Bazaar knows that Lord Sangemah Bay possesses the widest and most magical range of goods.

introduced.name: Ajilenakh Dash
introduced.how: a contestant who loses to the Traveler and Paimon in the qualifiers
introduced.quote: Hah! Didn't know they put the bar for entry so low.

introduced.name: Baron Bigfoot
introduced.how: a contestant with an all-Cryo Fungi team who loses in the round of 16
introduced.quote: Now, prepare to witness the power of my all-Cryo Fungi team!

introduced.name: Floral Jelly
introduced.how: a power-up material that boosts Fungi abilities, suspected of containing special ingredients
introduced.quote: The next step is to use the "Floral Jelly" provided by the organizers to boost your Fungi's abilities.

introduced.name: Floating Anemo Fungus
introduced.how: a Fungus that circles and attacks people, shown harassing Layla
introduced.quote: (A Floating Anemo Fungus is seen circling Layla)

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: a group that referees the tournament and enforces its rules
introduced.quote: The Corps of Thirty will referee the competitors to ensure that all rules are followed.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: a scholarly institution that hosts the tournament through Amurta and can punish rule violations
introduced.quote: Also, hosted by an Akademiya scholar, huh? Whoa, pretty official.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: the arena location where the tournament's activity areas are set, with main roads that Fungi may roam
introduced.quote: Activity areas only include areas around the arena and the main roads of Port Ormos.

introduced.name: Wikala Funduq
introduced.how: a public area where Fungi are forbidden to be brought
introduced.quote: Please do not bring your Fungi to the following public areas: Wikala Funduq, shops, and restaurants.

introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.how: a marketplace where vendors and customers trade, home to the Almighty Merchant
introduced.quote: Every vendor and customer in the Grand Bazaar knows that Lord Sangemah Bay possesses the widest and most magical range of goods.

introduced.name: Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: grumpy beasts that Haniyyah used to tame while working for the Eremites
introduced.quote: I used to work for the Eremites, taming grumpy Sumpter Beasts.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publishing company from Inazuma whose editors are attending the tournament to gather material for a bestseller
introduced.quote: They even handed out flyers in front of Yae Publishing House.

introduced.name: Amurta
introduced.how: a research body in the Akademiya whose researchers, including Kautilya, work on the Wisdom Orb
introduced.quote: I am Kautilya, a senior Amurta researcher and the organizer of today's tournament.

introduced.name: Rtawahist
introduced.how: a darshan (academic discipline) that Layla belongs to, in contrast with the Amurta Darshan
introduced.quote: But I'm from the Rtawahist Darshan. The kind of information I'm gathering now would only be of any use to someone in the Amurta Darshan.

introduced.name: Bongo-Head
introduced.how: Paimon's captured Fungus, a Floating Hydro Fungus that likes water and becomes a key team member
introduced.quote: Traveler: Bongo-Head is a Floating Hydro Fungus.

introduced.name: Sido
introduced.how: A Corps of Thirty officer on a secret mission who later arrests the conspirators by the General Mahamatra's order
introduced.quote: I'm here on a mission. I'm sorry, but that's all I'm able to disclose.

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: A fierce beast-tamer who distrusts Fungi because her ancestors were attacked by them
introduced.quote: These are my ancestors' records. They were attacked by a horde of Fungi in the rainforest, and many people were seriously injured.

introduced.name: Hardy Two-Blades
introduced.how: A rude rival beast-tamer who mocks the Traveler and claims to follow Haniyyah's philosophy
introduced.quote: It's you. The uncultured swine of the Nilotpala Cup.

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: A contestant who loves her Fungus Twirly-Whirly and wants to take it home to live with her
introduced.quote: I just wanna be able to take Twirly-Whirly back to live with me, that's all.

introduced.name: Twirly-Whirly
introduced.how: Layla's Fungus, a strong fighter that has faced tough challenges before
introduced.quote: Twirly-Whirly and team have weathered plenty of tough challenges already, and they know how to put up a good fight!

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: A novelist who entered the tournament for fun while gathering material for a novel with Souka
introduced.quote: I've barely had any time at all to spend with Souka and the others gathering source material for the novel.

introduced.name: Blitzara
introduced.how: Yae Miko's Fungus, which lost to Haniyyah in a short fight
introduced.quote: All it took was a few short, sharp strikes for Blitzara and I...

introduced.name: Pyro-1
introduced.how: Haniyyah's Fungus that she follows everywhere and that leaves elemental traces
introduced.quote: Pyro-1 follows her everywhere. We should be able to track her down through its elemental traces!

introduced.name: Kindlejoy
introduced.how: The new name Haniyyah gives to her Fungus Pyro-1 after she changes her attitude
introduced.quote: That's Pyro-1's new name.

introduced.name: Elchingen
introduced.how: The tournament's sponsor, who is revealed as a Fatui plotting to use the tournament to build an army of Fungi
introduced.quote: So I bought his loyalty and organized this tournament to expand the reach of his technology.

introduced.name: Kautilya
introduced.how: A researcher who claims credit for the Wisdom Orb and bribed people with Elchingen's money to hide his scheme
introduced.quote: Kautilya made use of his status and Elchingen's funds to bribe relevant personnel.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: The organization Elchingen belongs to, revealed when he is exposed as a secret agent
introduced.quote: This whole time you were just another lousy Fatui!

introduced.name: Wisdom Orb
introduced.how: A device that suppresses Fungi aggression and makes them obedient, but only temporarily and with health side effects
introduced.quote: Even this new Wisdom Orb can only suppress the Fungi's aggressive nature temporarily.

introduced.name: Withering Potion
introduced.how: A potion that made Fungi go berserk and was used by the earlier researchers
introduced.quote: But the Withering Potion made them go berserk.

introduced.name: Capturing Device
introduced.how: An earlier device that made captured Fungi calm and approachable

threads.claim: The Wisdom Orb's technology may be more than it appears, and Kautilya may hold unknown technology.
threads.quote: Traveler: (What makes the Wisdom Orb so effective? Is Kautilya in possession of some great technology unknown to other scholars?)

threads.claim: Yae Miko suspects the Wisdom Orb only calms Fungi rather than controlling them, and Layla's test hints at it.
threads.quote: Perhaps the Wisdom Orb's technology doesn't allow people to "control" the Fungi at all... Maybe it simply adjusts the Fungi's temperaments

threads.claim: The Floral Jelly and Wisdom Orb may contain hidden special ingredients that the organizers are concealing.
threads.quote: But even if they added some "special ingredients"...

threads.claim: Kautilya is plotting something suspicious and wants to wipe out old technology in an upgrade.
threads.quote: Just one more set of combat data, and I'll be able to wipe every last trace of the old technology in the next upgrade!

threads.claim: Scraps from the tournament suggest the organizers tried to destroy evidence tied to the Wisdom Orb and Floral Jelly.
threads.quote: I'm told that this is a device and some documents that the organizer attempted to destroy.

threads.claim: Haniyyah plans to use the Wisdom Orb to exterminate Fungi on a large scale.
threads.quote: The Wisdom Orb is the perfect tool for exterminating Fungi on a large scale.

threads.claim: Haniyyah's hatred of Fungi and the Eremite-era suffering behind it is hinted at as a motive.
threads.quote: Luckily, I remembered my family's stern warnings, and the suffering that previous generations once endured, so I kept my distance.

threads.claim: Fungi are dangerous wild animals whose nature is debated, and coexistence is a recurring theme.
threads.quote: Fungi may look adorable, but they carry potent elemental energy inside their bodies.

threads.claim: Elchingen claims beast-taming could allow humans and dangerous creatures to coexist.
threads.quote: I have spent a considerable amount of time in my life searching for a way for humans and dangerous creatures to coexist.

threads.claim: Elchingen's sponsorship and fortune hinge on a condition to continue the tournament, which may hide a motive.
threads.quote: The only other condition is that the winner must agree to carry on Mr. Elchingen's legacy by hosting the "Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament" in the future...

threads.claim: Elchingen is quietly amassing a fortune and watches Kautilya, hinting he is more involved than he seems.
threads.quote: (Elchingen appears from behind a stall, appearing to be watching Kautilya. He smiles)

threads.claim: Yae Miko knows about potential liabilities and suggests a secret investigation before sunrise.
threads.quote: As for the potential liabilities we didn't have time to discuss earlier... One good place to start might be the Fungi power-up materials.

threads.claim: Yae Miko is aware of hidden dangers and uses the Traveler and Paimon to investigate while she is on a light novel vacation.
threads.quote: Yae Miko: I'm comforted to know that you didn't lose your heads amidst the hype, and you're not just in this to have some fun.

threads.claim: Haniyyah refuses to be persuaded and says the Fungi cannot understand human sentiments, so she will defeat rivals to pursue her plan.
threads.quote: It will never understand human sentiments.

threads.claim: Wild Fungi are attacking people because the tournament has made people careless, an unforeseen consequence.
threads.quote: Haniyyah: People never used to be under any illusion about how dangerous the Fungi can be. But this Nilotpala Cup is changing people's perceptions

threads.claim: Haniyyah believes aggressive Fungi cannot live alongside humans, raising whether peaceful coexistence is possible.
threads.quote: I don't believe highly aggressive creatures like the Fungi can co-exist with humans.

threads.claim: The bond between tamers and Fungi proves stronger than the Wisdom Orb's control, answering the coexistence question.
threads.quote: The trust that these four Fungi place in their beast-tamers, and the bond they now share, have grown stronger than the Wisdom Orb.

threads.claim: Haniyyah's family history of a Fungi attack is presented as a source of her hostility, with its real cause left unexplained.
threads.quote: These are my ancestors' records. They were attacked by a horde of Fungi in the rainforest, and many people were seriously injured.

threads.claim: The Fungi attacked Haniyyah's ancestors only because the Withering Potion had driven them berserk.
threads.quote: The Fungi only attacked Haniyyah's ancestors because of what that potion did to them

threads.claim: Elchingen reveals that Kautilya secretly built a backdoor into the Wisdom Orbs that lets him take control of Fungi.
threads.quote: Kautilya added a handy little backdoor in the Wisdom Orbs.

threads.claim: Yae Miko exposes the backdoor as poorly designed, and it fails to hold the Fungi under Elchingen's control.
threads.quote: Not to mention that shoddily designed backdoor command... Did you honestly believe that no one would notice the litany of vulnerabilities in your grand plan?

threads.claim: Haniyyah suggests Kautilya is only chasing his research and influence, leaving his true intentions open.
threads.quote: As you'll be well aware by now, all Kautilya cares about is his precious research.

threads.claim: Elchingen's private remark about his Master hints that he serves someone else and is not the tournament's ordinary sponsor.
threads.quote: (What a pleasant surprise... If Master knew this, I'm sure he would treat me differently.)

threads.claim: Elchingen is exposed as a Fatui who was using Kautilya all along, not the other way around.
threads.quote: This whole time you were just another lousy Fatui!

threads.claim: Elchingen reveals that he once served Dottore, who left him, and that he wants Dottore's respect.
threads.quote: my dear master Dottore, who left because of you, will finally realize that I can still be worth something to him...

threads.claim: The Traveler notices Elchingen's past service to Dottore and presses him on it.
threads.quote: Traveler: You've worked for Dottore before...

threads.claim: Paimon suspects that Layla's coughing may be caused by the Wisdom Orb, raising a health concern.
threads.quote: Wait, Layla's been coughing a lot lately... Could that be because of the Wisdom Orb?

threads.claim: The Wisdom Orbs are confirmed to be harmful to the health of people nearby, which explains the risk.
threads.quote: However, unfortunately the Wisdom Orbs currently have a harmful effect on their surrounding environment, so they pose a risk to people's health.

threads.claim: Haniyyah's notes suggest that researchers planned to use a capturing device on aggressive Fungi, hinting at a hidden origin for the Wisdom Orb.
threads.quote: The researchers seem to be planning to use some kind of capturing device to control the aggressive Fungi.

threads.claim: The Wisdom Orb and Floral Jelly are confirmed to be derived from earlier Amurta devices and potions, not Kautilya's invention.
threads.quote: The Wisdom Orb and Floral Jelly were indeed derived from the

threads.claim: Sido says the General Mahamatra's investigation of Kautilya is moving forward, hinting at outside observers.
threads.quote: Mahamatra Cyno will be able to move all the more quickly with his investigation.

threads.claim: Cyno has been secretly investigating the same conspiracy at the same time as the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: So Cyno's been keeping an eye on this competition, too.

threads.claim: Hardy Two-Blades invokes Haniyyah's philosophy of beast-taming, presenting it as a rival ideal to the Traveler's.
threads.quote: You make a mockery of the philosophy of the greatest beast-tamer of all, the mighty Haniyyah.

threads.claim: Yae Miko says the Traveler offered companionship based on mutual understanding instead of a master-servant relationship.
threads.quote: I thought that the story between you and the Fungi would follow a master-servant paradigm, but you offered something even better: companionship, based on mutual understanding.

introduced.name: Jami
introduced.how: an Akademiya researcher whose thesis troubles have made him a rumored figure in Port Ormos
introduced.quote: Paimon: Jami? Oh, so that's your name.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: a scholarly institution with courses where researchers study under mentors and must pass thesis proposals
introduced.quote: The courses at Akademiya have a tight schedule already, and I have to get my thesis proposal passed in time.

introduced.name: Publishing independent research
introduced.how: scholars prove they are capable by publishing independent research, which lets them graduate and gain renown
introduced.quote: Jami: Publishing independent research is how we prove that we are capable, self-sufficient scholars.

introduced.name: Amurta
introduced.how: where the seniors who formulated the Fayz Potion work
introduced.quote: and it was formulated by my seniors at Amurta.

introduced.name: Fayz Potion
introduced.how: a costly potion that makes the drinker subjectively feel time slowing down, to aid observation
introduced.quote: Here's how it works: you will subjectively feel that time will slow down in a very extreme manner after taking the "Fayz Potion."

introduced.name: Spinocrocodile
introduced.how: a monster that pounces and lunges with claws at close range
introduced.quote: For example, if you quaff a Fayz Potion as a Spinocrocodile pounces on you but you aren't agile enough to dodge its lunging attack...

introduced.name: Weaknesses in creature defenses
introduced.how: creatures expose weak spots in their defenses when they make certain movements in combat, and Jami is collecting these for research
introduced.quote: Some weak spots, which should have been well protected, will end up exposed when they make certain movements. And those are the Weaknesses I'm collecting for my research.

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: Paimon: Y'know, when we first heard that there was an Akademiya researcher in Port Ormos who groans all day...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: That way, we can travel to places in Teyvat in the name of collecting research material, with research grants sufficient to cover even fine food and drink!

assumed.name: Sumeru and Liyue
assumed.quote: And that's why I started by researching creatures from Sumeru and Liyue...

assumed.name: Shroomboar
assumed.quote: was the first one. I actually thought that one was pretty good...

assumed.name: Floating Hydro Fungi
assumed.quote: The Ecological Environment and Aquaculture of Floating Hydro Fungi

assumed.name: Rishboland Tiger
assumed.quote: I should just go feed myself to a Rishboland Tiger!

assumed.name: Vimara Village
assumed.quote: Maybe I should drown myself in the river near Vimara Village instead.

threads.claim: Akademiya scholars must publish independent research and pass thesis proposals to graduate from their mentors.
threads.quote: Jami: Publishing independent research is how we prove that we are capable, self-sufficient scholars.

threads.claim: A mentor has assigned the study of every living being in Teyvat, which Jami calls an impossible task.
threads.quote: my mentor wanted me to observe every living being in Teyvat.

threads.claim: Creatures in combat reveal weak spots in their defenses when they move, and Jami is researching these weaknesses.
threads.quote: Some weak spots, which should have been well protected, will end up exposed when they make certain movements.

threads.claim: The Fayz Potion makes time feel extremely slow to the drinker, which may aid detailed observation.
threads.quote: Here's how it works: you will subjectively feel that time will slow down in a very extreme manner after taking the "Fayz Potion."

threads.claim: The Fayz Potion's slowed perception does not make the body faster, so an agile-lacking user may still be unable to dodge attacks.
threads.quote: But your body may not be able to keep up if you aren't agile enough...

threads.claim: The Spinocrocodile example shows concretely that a drinker can perceive the attack slowly yet be unable to move away from it.
threads.quote: Then you will see how its claws are ever so close to your face, yet your body just won't move out of the way...

introduced.name: Jami

introduced.name: Jami's mentor

assumed.name: Mora

assumed.name: Jami's past ill intentions

threads.claim: Jami has had ill intentions toward others before, a past hinted at but left unexplained.

threads.claim: Jami extends the Fayz Potion research into a long-lasting version meant to give ordinary people practical protection.

introduced.name: Frejus
introduced.how: an inventor of the cannon who offers to explain the situation
introduced.quote: Hello, you two. Please allow me to explain the situation...

introduced.name: Chenee
introduced.how: a Gardes member who briefs the Traveler and suggests improvements to the cannon
introduced.quote: Why don't you take a breather? I can brief these two.

introduced.name: Marine
introduced.how: a former unit member who returned to her village and now leads the relief force
introduced.quote: Back in the unit — and after I returned to the village, too — everyone said you two could take care of anything.

introduced.name: Gardes
introduced.how: the group running the containment zone around the ruins
introduced.quote: We Gardes have set up a containment zone to prevent their escape.

introduced.name: Gardemek
introduced.how: a mech whose target identification module can be fitted to the cannon so it operates autonomously
introduced.quote: Next time, I can try fitting it with a Gardemek's target identification module! That way, it should be able to operate autonomously.

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: an agent who operates the cannon at the ruins' entrance remotely to keep monsters in check
introduced.quote: The cannon at the entrance to the ruins is operated remotely — she can keep most of the monsters in check without getting anywhere near them.

introduced.name: Ruins containment incident
introduced.how: workers unearthed ruins nearby and disturbed monsters sleeping inside, forcing a containment zone
introduced.quote: Recently, a group of workers unexpectedly unearthed some ruins nearby, disturbing the monsters slumbering within...

introduced.name: Cannon
introduced.how: a customized cannon at the ruins that the player can fire to blast monsters
introduced.quote: Hey! Want to have a go on the cannon? Opportunities like this don't roll around often

assumed.name: Automatic Breakfast Oven
assumed.quote: After all, your Automatic Breakfast Oven works wonders.

assumed.name: Fleet destruction
assumed.quote: Opportunities like this don't roll around often, at least, not since the fleet was destroyed.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I don't care much for Mora, but I wouldn't say no to some fermented Tidalga

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: Sure — we can just swap the alcohol with Fonta! That'll do the trick!

assumed.name: Marine previous meeting
assumed.quote: So you do remember me! I applied for a position at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon may have met Marine before, but neither clearly remembers it.
threads.quote: Traveler: I feel like we've met before...

threads.claim: Paimon also half-remembers the earlier meeting with Marine, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon thinks she maybe remembers that...

threads.claim: Monsters sleeping in newly unearthed ruins were disturbed and now threaten to spread.
threads.quote: Recently, a group of workers unexpectedly unearthed some ruins nearby, disturbing the monsters slumbering within...

threads.claim: Frejus assures that the monsters cannot escape the ruins under the current containment.
threads.quote: Based on the current situation, there's no way those monsters can escape the ruins.

threads.claim: A fleet was destroyed in the past, and its loss has changed what kinds of opportunities arise now.
threads.quote: not since the fleet was destroyed. It'll be a blast from centuries past!

threads.claim: Marine hints that Frejus and Chenee have an unresolved awkwardness between them.
threads.quote: On the other hand, those two over there are reliable enough, but there's something a little... awkward between them.

threads.claim: A Melusine agent is operating the cannon remotely and has been exhausted by the long fight.
threads.quote: She's very reliable, but this operation's dragging on now, and she must be exhausted.

threads.claim: The team plans to make the cannon aim and fire automatically using a Gardemek targeting module.

introduced.quote: Even the Special Patrol's previous marksmanship instructor, Enghiene, was barely able to pass...

introduced.name: Churldric

introduced.quote: Churldric had taken an unused Domain and reshaped it into a place to drill his battle formations.

introduced.name: Samachurl statue
