introduced.name: observation grenade
introduced.how: visualizing grenade for long-range reconnaissance that lets a shooter see through the round in flight
introduced.quote: meant for long-range reconnaissance, so a shooter can gather information from a position of safety.

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: flying mounts ridden by Saurian riders in the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.quote: our Saurian-riders often have difficulty determining the effects of shots we make while riding our Qucusaurs.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: Natlan warriors skilled at firing while in flight who joined the wargame
introduced.quote: The Flower-Feather Clan warriors are skilled at firing while in flight

introduced.name: Ballistic Wargame
introduced.how: routine joint wargame between Fontaine and Mondstadt to sharpen battlefield planning
introduced.quote: between Fontaine and Mondstadt — aimed at sharpening combatants' battlefield-planning capabilities on all sides.

introduced.name: long-term study exchange of representatives
introduced.how: planned exchange where Flower-Feather Clan warriors train in Fontaine and Special Patrol fighters train in Natlan
introduced.quote: we've decided to start a "long-term study exchange of representatives" within three months.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: custom-made by Xilonen, we agreed that...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: and a Knight of Favonius?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Many of the planned courses also rely on excellent equipment from our Mondstadt allies.

assumed.name: Fontinalia Film Festival
assumed.quote: I did notice during the Fontinalia Film Festival that you're quite a crack shot

assumed.name: Special Patrol
assumed.quote: And the Special Patrol's clockwork-stable functioning would be unimaginable without

assumed.name: Liyue overhead surveillance devices
assumed.quote: combined it with the design principles of Liyue's overhead surveillance devices

assumed.name: Dadaupa Gorge statue appearance
assumed.quote: Do you remember the strange Samachurl statue that once appeared in Dadaupa Gorge?

assumed.name: Honorary Knight's past defeat of Churldric's shadow
assumed.quote: The Honorary Knight defeated one of Churldric's lingering shadows back then

threads.claim: The Eyes of Upano scattered into the open after Churldric's Domain collapsed, leaving their whereabouts an open question.
threads.quote: scattered out into the open.

threads.claim: The Traveler's memory of the Samachurl statue is hazy, suggesting a past connection that is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Don't remember. Doesn't matter, does it?

threads.claim: Paimon suspects the grenade has a real history with the Traveler and Paimon, hinting at an unexplained link.
threads.quote: It does feel like this grenade thing has real history with us.

threads.claim: Hedwig explains the statue was made by an ancient Samachurl and its technology led to the observation grenade.
threads.quote: that statue was the work of an ancient Samachurl.

threads.claim: Churldric's lingering shadows suggest his influence has not fully ended even after his Domain fell.
threads.quote: defeated one of Churldric's lingering shadows back then

threads.claim: Chevreuse hints that the Traveler's marksmanship has been developing over the years, implying a shared past.
threads.quote: how much your marksmanship's improved over the years

threads.claim: Turenna notes the Traveler is an inspired crack shot, deepening the Traveler's reputation for marksmanship.
threads.quote: I did notice during the Fontinalia Film Festival that you're quite a crack shot

threads.claim: A long-term exchange of representatives among the Special Patrol, Flower-Feather Clan, and Knights of Favonius is proposed to begin within three months.
threads.quote: we've decided to start a "long-term study exchange of representatives" within three months.

threads.claim: Chevreuse and Chasca agree on a joint training memorandum, and Hedwig says the Knights will reply formally after consulting headquarters.
threads.quote: As for sending representatives for study, please let me convey this back to our headquarters

introduced.name: Ji Tong
introduced.how: A Kamera buyer whose camera is not printing properly and who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Ji Tong: How very strange... What is the matter with this Kamera?

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: A camera that can print photos in a special hue and add special effects, bought from a seller
introduced.quote: Ji Tong: Supposedly, it can print photos in a special hue and add in some special effects, or something. So I bought one to try it out.

assumed.name: Kamera Konnoisseur
assumed.quote: Ji Tong: So, how about you? Much of a Kamera Konnoisseur yourself?

assumed.name: Jueyun Chilis
assumed.quote: Ji Tong: Oh, you know... Really bright colors, like red Jueyun Chilis, blue Mist Flower...

assumed.name: Mist Flower
assumed.quote: Ji Tong: Oh, you know... Really bright colors, like red Jueyun Chilis, blue Mist Flower...

threads.claim: The Kamera seems faulty or misused, and its special-hue printing fails for an unknown reason.
threads.quote: Ji Tong: But try as I might, I can't get it to print out photos properly. I don't know whether I'm using it wrong, or if it's just faulty.

threads.claim: The seller of the Kamera may be responsible for the defect, and the dispute is left unresolved.
threads.quote: Ji Tong: And if I can't, I'll take the photos to the seller and see what he has to say. With the photos as hard evidence, he won't be able to dismiss the issue.

introduced.name: Xinyan
introduced.how: a Liyue rock musician whose music resists stereotypes and who fights with a fire-shooting guitar
introduced.quote: Xinyan, a rock musician based in Liyue, uses her music as a form of resistance against societal stereotypes.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: a Feiyun Commerce Guild family member who escorts the guild's supplies and fights thieves
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Family rules stipulate that the supplies must be personally escorted by a family member.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a merchant guild that sends supplies to villages outside Liyue Harbor every Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: Ah yes, allow me to explain. It so happens that every year during the Lantern Rite, the Feiyun Commerce Guild transports supplies to various villages outside of Liyue Harbor.

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: the body that now leads Liyue's people since the adepti handed the city to mortals
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Ever since the adepti left Liyue Harbor in the hands of mortals, we Qixing have taken up the responsibility of leading the people.

introduced.name: Keqing
introduced.how: a Qixing member in charge of the Lantern Rite fireworks show, known for overwork
introduced.quote: Ningguang: I've left Keqing in charge of the fireworks show. If you're interested, why don't we pay her a visit together?

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who advises on people's feelings
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks he's still a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Let's go see if he's there!

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: the funeral business where Zhongli works as a consultant and Hu Tao is director
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks he's still a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Let's go see if he's there!

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: the director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who goes out doing promotion
introduced.quote: Ferrylady: The director said that they were going for a walk.

introduced.name: Yanfei
introduced.how: a consultant with clients who works through the festival and rarely takes holidays
introduced.quote: Yanfei: That's right. There are no holidays in my line of work. I have to be ready whenever my clients need me.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: a secretary working at Yujing Terrace who introduces herself and handles many city matters
introduced.quote: Ganyu: Oh— Hello, I'm Ganyu. I work at Yujing Terrace.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: a secluded adeptus of Mt. Aocang who loves gadgets and is skeptical of human rule over Liyue
introduced.quote: Keqing: (Cloud Retainer... although she is not outwardly opposed to us, she is still skeptical of Liyue being ruled by humans.)

introduced.name: Moon Carver
introduced.how: an adeptus who wanted to oversee Liyue Harbor and then left traveling
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Moon Carver has been most anxious to see how Liyue Harbor fares.

introduced.name: Mountain Shaper
introduced.how: an adeptus who left in search of new treasures to defend his mountain
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Mountain Shaper, however, is more open-minded.

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: the Conqueror of Demons who patrols against evil, dislikes crowds, and lives at Wangshu Inn
introduced.quote: Xiao: Eradicating demons is my duty. You don't have to thank me.

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: a doctor who runs Bubu Pharmacy and gathers herbs for it
introduced.quote: Baizhu: Bubu Pharmacy always runs out of digestive herbs during the festival seasons.

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: a pharmacy that stocks digestive herbs and runs short during festivals
introduced.quote: Baizhu: Bubu Pharmacy always runs out of digestive herbs during the festival seasons.

introduced.name: Pengyi
introduced.how: a fireworks worker under Keqing who arranges the launches and makes launch tubes
introduced.quote: Pengyi: Here, Traveler, this is a Launch Tube. Lady Keqing said you may be interested, so she had me keep one to give to you.

introduced.name: Launch Tube
introduced.how: a tube used with good handicraft to design and launch one's own fireworks
introduced.quote: Pengyi: Someone with good handicraft skills should be able to use this to design their very own fireworks.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: an elder of Qingce Village who reports the fireworks theft and worries for the villagers
introduced.quote: Granny Ruoxin: *sigh* The villagers here are worried too. The fireworks missing can only mean that there are thieves about.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: the guard force that patrols Liyue and is stretched thin during the festival
introduced.quote: Pengyi: However, everyone's short-handed during Lantern Rite. The Millelith are already stretched thin and don't even have enough people to fill their regular patrols.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the body that approves funding and sets festival guard rules for Liyue
introduced.quote: Keqing: If you think the current budget will not suffice, then we'll simply have to apply for more funding from the Ministry of Civil Affairs and wait for their approval.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: an annual festival that began as a way to drive evil spirits away from the city
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: This festival is now known as the Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Fireworks in Liyue
introduced.how: fireworks were developed in Liyue and first used as firecrackers to ward off beasts and signal
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Fireworks were originally developed alongside many other inventions here in Liyue.

introduced.name: Evil spirits of ancient Liyue
introduced.how: spirits were drawn to festival crowds and plagued the city's fringes in ancient times
introduced.quote: Xingqiu: In ancient times, Liyue was plagued by evil spirits.

introduced.name: Original Jade Chamber sinking
introduced.how: the original Jade Chamber sank into the sea, destroying most of Ningguang's collection
introduced.quote: Ningguang: All the literature, furniture, and ornaments I had collected followed the original Jade Chamber to its watery grave...

introduced.name: Carmen
introduced.how: a Treasure Hoarder leader Beidou knows personally, who surrenders the goods when called out
introduced.quote: Carmen: Hehe... Cap'n Beidou, it's been a while.

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: the region where the adepti live, including Cloud Retainer and others
introduced.quote: Madame Ping: I presume you mean Cloud Retainer and the others? Yes, they should be over in Jueyun Karst.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: an inn with a rooftop terrace where Xiao is usually found
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, then he's probably not in Jueyun Karst. Let's go look for him in his usual spot at Wangshu Inn.

introduced.name: Shadow Lantern
introduced.how: Yuan Rong's new invention: rotate the objects inside so the shadows merge into images
introduced.quote: Yuan Rong: You two look like you're out to have some fun! Care to check out the Shadow Lantern? My latest invention, made to amaze and amuse!

introduced.name: Yuan Rong
introduced.how: inventor and vendor running the Shadow Lantern booth, explaining how it works
introduced.quote: Yuan Rong: It's very simple — all you have to do is rotate the objects inside the Shadow Lantern, get all the shadows to merge in a certain way

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: notoriously cunning bandits who have been stealing and stockpiling fireworks
introduced.quote: Keqing: The Treasure Hoarders are notoriously cunning, and they may even have lookouts.

introduced.name: Xingxiu
introduced.how: the Treasure Hoarders' boss, who plans to steal fireworks for a city robbery
introduced.quote: Xingxiu: Hah! Are you kidding? This ain't nowhere near enough!

introduced.name: Pengyi
introduced.how: fireworks supplier worried the show will fall short without the stolen fireworks
introduced.quote: Pengyi: There are not many fireworks in the second batch that I brought, so I'm worried that we can't achieve the show's desired effect.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: young opera performer who is open to advice and has an appointment with Xinyan
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: No, I'm afraid that's not always the case. Though I am still young, I can be quite arrogant at times.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: a private viewing spot with a better view of the fireworks, chosen for talking
introduced.quote: Keqing: Traveler and Paimon, let's go to the Jade Chamber. The view there is nicer and it's much more private, perfect for talking.

introduced.name: Opulent Splendor
introduced.how: a fancy imported-style outfit Ningguang had tailored for Keqing
introduced.quote: Keqing: Ningguang had her personal tailor

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Welcome back. I trust Beidou is making good progress on salvaging the items?

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: I just can't tell whether Beidou will be able to fish out everything herself.

assumed.name: Sea Drake
assumed.quote: Beidou: Based on the original plan, Sea Drake's boat should be coming past here at some point.

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: This voice... Is it Shenhe?

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Paimon: Qiqi! Oh, and the weird guy with the snake around his neck!

assumed.name: Osial
assumed.quote: Xiao: The Yuheng... Yes, I saw you when we battled Osial. You are fierce with your blade.

assumed.name: Rite of Parting
assumed.quote: Keqing: Mr. Zhongli, I didn't expect to see you here. Thank you for all your assistance during the Rite of Parting.

assumed.name: Verr Goldet
assumed.quote: Keqing: Let's ask Verr Goldet where the Conqueror of Demons may be.

assumed.name: Hongxing
assumed.quote: Hongxing: Yes, young master!

assumed.name: Liuliu
assumed.quote: Liuliu: I mean, what does it look like? We got lucky. Found some treasure floating around in the ocean.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Liyue Harbor was under the gracious protection of Rex Lapis, so the spirits dared not enter the city.

assumed.name: Yuheng
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: (The Yuheng of the Qixing? Here? Most fascinating...)

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Keqing: Good. I've made some progress in my investigation as well.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Rest assured, all is quiet here in Qingce Village. Chongyun is guarding the outside, and I'm guarding the inside.

assumed.name: Chongyun
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Rest assured, all is quiet here in Qingce Village. Chongyun is guarding the outside, and I'm guarding the inside.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Keqing: I've asked the Millelith on guard at Qingce Village to report this to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Jingcheng: Oh, I see... Yes, Lady Keqing is quite thorough. A squad of Millelith came by just now. I believe they were sent by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

assumed.name: Yuheng
assumed.quote: Xingxiu: Y—You're... Lady Keqing, the Yuheng!

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Xingxiu: Hey, don't worry about it. The Millelith are swamped with Lantern Rite, they won't have time to come out here.

assumed.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Why the hurry to get back to the Feiyun Commerce Guild? Don't tell us you have work to do, too...

assumed.name: Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: Paimon: Okay! Let Paimon think... What did Cloud Retainer say?

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Paimon: Now Paimon gets why Lady Ningguang is so worried about Keqing.

assumed.name: Captain Beidou
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Only a true treasure catches the eye of Captain Beidou

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, is that who Paimon thinks it is...

assumed.name: Third-Round Knockout
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zhongli said he'd wait for us at Third-Round Knockout. Let's go find him!

threads.claim: Zhongli hints that he was once the mighty Rex Lapis and now lives as an ordinary consultant.
threads.quote: Zhongli: If I were still the mighty Rex Lapis, I might be able to help her see reason. But alas, I'm now nobody but an ordinary consultant.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer is skeptical of Liyue being ruled by humans under the Qixing.
threads.quote: Keqing: (Cloud Retainer... although she is not outwardly opposed to us, she is still skeptical of Liyue being ruled by humans.)

threads.claim: Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper left the adepti's mountains without word and have not returned.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Thereafter, he left, claiming to have gone traveling. He has not returned since.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders have a hidden boss called Big Sis who may be watching the salvage operation.
threads.quote: Beidou: If both Carmen and Liuliu were here... Then I wonder if that other "boss" of theirs, Big Sis, is snooping around?

threads.claim: Rebuilding the Jade Chamber drew out a massive monster.
threads.quote: Paimon: Who would've guessed that rebuilding the Jade Chamber would draw out such a massive monster!

threads.claim: The stolen Qingce Village fireworks may be tied to the Treasure Hoarders and their accomplices.
threads.quote: Keqing: It's very likely that this thief is related to the recent fireworks theft in Qingce Village. Make sure they have someone question him thoroughly.

threads.claim: Keqing has been overworking for days, and Ningguang worries about the long-term effects.
threads.quote: Ningguang: I'm concerned about the effects it may have in the long run.

threads.claim: Evil spirits once plagued Liyue and may still lurk around the city and its festivals.
threads.quote: Xingqiu: In ancient times, Liyue was plagued by evil spirits.

threads.claim: Traveler knows Zhongli has a true identity that must not be revealed, while Zhongli presents himself as an ordinary person.
threads.quote: Traveler: (I wouldn't dare reveal his true identity.)

threads.claim: Zhongli modestly calls himself an ordinary person who has had the honor of meeting the Traveler, which hints at a hidden status.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I am flattered, Ms. Yun. It is an honor for an ordinary person like myself to have met the Traveler.

threads.claim: Zhongli argues that pushing oneself is never good, and that rest matters greatly.
threads.quote: Zhongli: Rest is always of great importance. Although we may come across various difficulties in our lives, pushing ourselves is never a good modus operandi.

threads.claim: Keqing privately admits she wishes she could slow down time and enjoy the city and the fireworks.
threads.quote: Keqing: Deep down inside, I wish I could slow down time.

threads.claim: The hoarders are puzzled about how the Millelith tracked down their scouts so quickly.
threads.quote: Junming: How did the Millelith find us so fast?

threads.claim: The Millelith got a captured Treasure Hoarder to talk, which explains how they found the hoarders.
threads.quote: Keqing: It appears that the Millelith managed to get the captured Treasure Hoarder to talk.

introduced.name: Shriya
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an Amurta graduate specializing in desert biology and ecology
introduced.quote: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Shriya, an Amurta graduate with a specialization in desert biology and ecology.

introduced.name: Vinayak
introduced.how: Introduces himself by name, a Kshahrewar researcher and Shriya's former classmate
introduced.quote: ...I'm Vinayak. Thanks a lot for earlier.

introduced.name: Wenut
introduced.how: Learns they are a swarm of monsters that recently became violent and hide in sandstorms to ambush travelers
introduced.quote: Fodil: A swarm of Wenut. For some reason, they have recently become unusually violent, hiding in sandstorms to attack unsuspecting prey passing by.

introduced.name: Wenutslayer Cannon
introduced.how: Learns it is the graduation project machine built to shoot down Wenut, and is being assembled and tested
introduced.quote: Ah, I forgot to tell you. They're for the Wenutslayer Cannon, our graduation project.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: Learns the Akademiya assigned Shriya and Vinayak to handle the unruly Wenut
introduced.quote: That's why the Akademiya sent Vinayak and me to deal with these unruly Wenut.

introduced.name: Amurta
introduced.how: Learns Shriya graduated from Amurta, a place of study tied to her desert biology specialty
introduced.quote: an Amurta graduate with a specialization in desert biology and ecology

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: Learns Vinayak is a Kshahrewar researcher specializing in applied mechanics
introduced.quote: This machine-obsessed doofus over here is a Kshahrewar researcher with a specialization in applied mechanics.

introduced.name: Kunar
introduced.how: Learns Kunar is Shriya's mentor's mentor who sent them to handle the Wenut problem
introduced.quote: A person named Kunar was supposed to take care of this matter.

introduced.name: Elemental Energy
introduced.how: Learns that chaotic Elemental Energy disrupts the ecological balance and drives Wenut behavior
introduced.quote: The chaotic Elemental Energy disrupts this balance, which makes the Wenut extremely active...

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Shriya, optional)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Let's go over the details and see where all that Mora went!

assumed.name: Experimental Device No. 2
assumed.quote: Shriya: ...Is that why you tested Experimental Device No. 2 until it exploded that other year?

assumed.name: Experimental Device No. 3
assumed.quote: Shriya: So it really did go off without a hitch... I thought it was going to end up like Experimental Device No. 3...

threads.claim: The sudden violence of the Wenut is unexplained and raises the question of why they changed.
threads.quote: Fodil: A swarm of Wenut. For some reason, they have recently become unusually violent, hiding in sandstorms to attack unsuspecting prey passing by.

threads.claim: Shriya asks what caused the Wenut to act out and says the environmental parameters are off.
threads.quote: Shriya: ...But why is there a deviation in the environmental parameters? What caused the Wenut to suddenly act out?

threads.claim: Frequent underground Wenut activity disturbed Elemental Energy, which in turn made the Wenut run amok.
threads.quote: Shriya: The frequent activity of the Wenut underground had caused a disturbance in the Elemental Energy in this region.

threads.claim: Shriya has calculated that the strongest Elemental Energy node is nearby and must be located to redirect the flow.
threads.quote: Shriya: I've already calculated the location of the node. It's somewhere around here.

threads.claim: The Wenutslayer Cannon channels the surrounding Elemental Energy, and the environment returns to normal after the firing.
threads.quote: Vinayak: Sure enough, the charging unit is running more smoothly... As you said, the elemental environment in this area is returning to normal.

threads.claim: Shriya and Vinayak's strained relationship breaks down again after a café meeting ends in a fight and she sends him away.
threads.quote: Vinayak: I criticized her for wasting time when we should be working on the report, and then she flew into a rage! She said she'd write the report herself and made me leave!

threads.claim: Vinayak's past experimental devices exploded or failed, and the group's history of accidents recurs in this story.
threads.quote: Paimon: How many accidents happened that year...? Well, anyway, this experiment was a success, and that's all that matters!

introduced.name: Balfour
introduced.how: Previous tournament's chief staff organizer, now promoting Fungus Mechanicus
introduced.quote: Paimon: We met Haniyyah then, and Balfour was the previous event's most responsible staff member.

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: Beast tamer who saved money from training Sumpter Beasts and cares for the Fungi
introduced.quote: Haniyyah: I still have quite a large amount of savings left over from my work training Sumpter Beasts for merchant caravans.

introduced.name: Souka
introduced.how: Yae Publishing House writer who came to Sumeru to write
introduced.quote: Paimon: Souka's one of Yae Publishing House's new writers.

introduced.name: Najah
introduced.how: Amurta researcher who makes the Marvelous Jellies
introduced.quote: Haniyyah: Not to worry, I commissioned Ms. Najah from the Amurta to make these, and they serve as rations for the Fungi.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: Publisher that Souka writes for
introduced.quote: Paimon: Souka's one of Yae Publishing House's new writers.

introduced.name: Fungus Mechanicus
introduced.how: New game Balfour and Haniyyah built, currently in play-testing
introduced.quote: Haniyyah: We call it "Fungus Mechanicus."

introduced.name: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
introduced.how: Past tournament where the Traveler and Paimon played with the Fungi
introduced.quote: Paimon: We took part in the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament, didn't we? It was great fun hanging out with our shroom buddies!

introduced.name: Marvelous Jellies
introduced.how: Nutritional rations made for the Fungi, flavored to their tastes
introduced.quote: Haniyyah: Not to worry, I commissioned Ms. Najah from the Amurta to make these, and they serve as rations for the Fungi.

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: Shroom-like companions that come in elemental types such as Pyro
introduced.quote: Paimon: C'mon, Kindlejoy's a Pyro Fungus. Just think about it. Pyro Fungi are like, super shiny!

introduced.name: Haniyyah's campsite
introduced.how: Hidden rainforest camp where Haniyyah keeps the Fungi
introduced.quote: Souka: I searched in the rainforest for some time before finally finding Haniyyah's campsite.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Haniyyah, optional)

assumed.name: Layla
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, that's right! Layla, Cyno, or the researchers responsible should inform us if there's any progress, right?

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, that's right! Layla, Cyno, or the researchers responsible should inform us if there's any progress, right?

assumed.name: Wisdom Orb
assumed.quote: Balfour: Previously, the two of you declared that the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament should be suspended for a time while the Akademiya improves the design of the Wisdom Orb.

assumed.name: Bongo-Head
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, have you forgotten Bongo-Head and Twirly-Whirly too?

assumed.name: Twirly-Whirly
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, have you forgotten Bongo-Head and Twirly-Whirly too?

threads.claim: Kautilya is said to have left a stain on the field of Fungus Studies that Najah intends to cleanse.

threads.claim: Souka is writing a light novel that features the Traveler and Paimon as characters.

threads.claim: A letter hints that purple is linked to a figure familiar to Inazuman readers, without naming them.

threads.claim: The Fungus Mechanicus play-test concludes with the collected game data used to plan improvements.

introduced.name: Hughes
introduced.how: introduces himself as an adventurer who researches wind gliders

introduced.quote: Someone who put on a pair of wind gliders can soar with the birds, but others... Well, they don't get very far.

introduced.name: Lepine-Pauline
introduced.how: Photographer and Graph Adversarial Technology specialist who recruits the Traveler and Paimon to fight disguised criminals
introduced.quote: And I, Lepine-Pauline, specialist in Graph Adversarial Technology, am determined to do my part towards a crime-free future for Fontaine!

introduced.name: Gardemek
introduced.how: City law enforcers who try to identify criminals using image recognition
introduced.quote: Common sense says that if Gardemeks want to fight crime, the first thing they need to do is identify who's a criminal and who isn't. Right?

introduced.name: Graph Adversarial Technology
introduced.how: A field of tech used to fight criminals' disguises through image recognition
introduced.quote: And I, Lepine-Pauline, specialist in Graph Adversarial Technology, am determined to do my part towards a crime-free future for Fontaine!

introduced.name: target recognition
introduced.how: Law enforcement problem of telling criminals from innocent people
introduced.quote: Well, it all has to do with an important problem in law enforcement that often gets overlooked: target recognition.

introduced.name: Clockwork meka
introduced.how: Gardemek machines that can be fitted with the recognition module to spot disguised criminals
introduced.quote: Any clockwork meka installed with this module will instantly be able to recognize people wearing disguises and accurately assess the criminal threat they pose.

introduced.name: Image Recognition Sample Collector
introduced.how: Equipment given to the Traveler to gather disguise image samples
introduced.quote: Okay, take this — it's an Image Recognition Sample Collector.

introduced.name: Blubberbeast disguise thefts
introduced.how: Thieves disguised as Blubberbeasts committed thefts that Gardemeks ignored because of a detection flaw
introduced.quote: Several keen-eyed thieves who noticed a flaw in the Gardemeks detection systems disguised themselves as Blubberbeasts during the commission of their crimes

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Let's take a walk around Fontaine, maybe buy some souvenirs and grab a tasty snack!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: How does one-and-a-half million Mora sound?

assumed.name: Blubberbeast
assumed.quote: or maybe even a Blubberbeast, because why the heck not?

assumed.name: The Steambird
assumed.quote: a recent report in The Steambird

assumed.name: Palais Mermonia
assumed.quote: the Palais Mermonia will jump at the chance to have these installed on every Gardemek in the city

threads.claim: Criminals are disguising themselves as harmless animals and creatures to evade Gardemek detection.
threads.quote: Several keen-eyed thieves who noticed a flaw in the Gardemeks detection systems disguised themselves as Blubberbeasts during the commission of their crimes

threads.claim: Gardemek image recognition systematically ignores certain animals, creating an exploitable blind spot.
threads.quote: Their image recognition system actually ignores them completely.

threads.claim: Criminals' disguises and law enforcement image recognition are in an ongoing technological contest.
threads.quote: It's turned into an ongoing tug-of-war between their disguises and our image recognition capabilities.

threads.claim: The Palais Mermonia is expected to buy recognition modules for Gardemek machines.
threads.quote: And if all goes to plan, the Palais Mermonia will jump at the chance to have these installed on every Gardemek in the city

introduced.name: Port Ormos

introduced.quote: Fayez: This is a prototype we made to get an idea of how they would react.

introduced.name: Aranara

introduced.quote: Fayez: So for context, Aranara are magical creatures in Sumeru fairytales that live in the forest.

introduced.quote: Mamdouh: "Uncle Tanger" is a famous children's author here in Port Ormos.

introduced.how: Fayez's young child who loves Tanger's stories
introduced.quote: Fayez: That's right. My little Ghafari loves his stories too.

introduced.quote: Razi: Hi, Miss Forest Ranger! I'm Razi. Don't mind me, I know the way back to Gandharva Ville.

introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.how: forest guardians who protect lost travelers and patrol the rainforest
introduced.quote: Collei: Well, helping children who are lost in the rainforest is all part of a Forest Ranger's duty.

threads.claim: Collei has a private secret she hides in writing in tree hollows.
threads.quote: Collei: *sob* If I'd known, I would have just told the tree hollow instead of writing it down!

threads.claim: Aranara's Vow carries a theme that appearances can deceive but the heart cannot.
threads.quote: Alia: Uncle Tanger said in "Aranara's Vow" that you can deceive the eyes, but you can't deceive the heart.

threads.claim: The Traveler has vanished without warning before, and the Guild fears it may happen again.
threads.quote: We merely wished to keep you from vanishing without warning again.

threads.claim: The Traveler's name carries great weight across the Adventurers' Guild in ways they do not fully realize.
threads.quote: In truth, your name carries much weight throughout the Adventurers' Guild than you realize.

threads.claim: Headquarters appears to keep a detailed file on the Traveler's travels.
threads.quote: I admit, it must look as though I have been keeping a careful file on you.

threads.claim: Lemta may be stepping back from the field, though this is only an assumption.
threads.quote: most people assumed she was stepping back from the field.

threads.claim: Stronger adventurers may still be hidden and could step forward at any time.
threads.quote: You never know when a hidden master might step forward...

threads.claim: Ranks above S-rank may exist, since S-rank is the highest only because no higher one was created.
threads.quote: But ? is only S-rank because nobody bothered to invent a higher one!

threads.claim: Discussions among Guild branches reached a standstill with no side willing to yield.

threads.claim: The Traveler's vote alone can approve or veto Guild proposals and can offer revisions.

threads.claim: Forcing rules by decree without regard to regional members would erode the trust holding the Guild together.

introduced.name: Adelinde

introduced.quote: Of course I can, and no deposit necessary!

introduced.quote: The same reason as ever. Just stopping another Abyss Order plot.

introduced.quote: my little Klee once made a complete mess of your vineyard while she was trying to catch Crystalflies there

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius

assumed.name: Captain Pyro
assumed.quote: So this is Captain Pyro when he's in top form, huh!

assumed.name: Lisa

assumed.quote: unlike Lisa, he is not especially close with the Acting Grand Master.

assumed.name: Jean

assumed.name: Crepus

assumed.name: Good Hunter

threads.claim: The ley lines hold secrets that ordinary people do not understand.

threads.claim: Unidentified voices (???) speak to the Traveler and Paimon before any speaker is revealed.
threads.quote: How about we explore the area ahead of us later?

threads.claim: The strange events suggest the Traveler and Paimon are already inside someone's event, though the creator has not appeared.
threads.quote: We must already be inside her event.

threads.claim: The strange events are explained as a memory-based magic bubble world created by Alice and Nicole.
threads.quote: All that to say, the things you saw weren't real. They only exist within this bubble.

threads.claim: A Statue of The Seven at Starfell Lake looks different from the usual one, raising the question of why.
threads.quote: Look, there really is something wrong with this Statue of The Seven!

threads.claim: The altered Klee statue was intentional, placed by Alice as a personal touch in her world.
threads.quote: Oh, no no, Paimon. That one was entirely intentional.

threads.claim: Venti's identity as Lord Barbatos is being concealed from the public.
threads.quote: Ah, and before it's all said and done, we'll be sure to cover up your identity, Venti.

threads.claim: Kleiner is stuck on another planet and Dottore is causing trouble on the border between worlds.
threads.quote: Dottore starts causing trouble...

threads.claim: A Teleport Waypoint in the area cannot be used, which is strange.
threads.quote: I'm not sure... But it's weird. I can't seem to use it...

threads.claim: Dvalin was once tainted by the Abyss, and his earlier healing attempt was interrupted.
threads.quote: Back then, Dvalin was tainted by the Abyss, and Tone-Deaf Bard was about to heal his wounds.

threads.claim: Revisiting the beginning of the journey is presented as a nostalgic experience that brings memories back.
threads.quote: It's not every day you get to relive the beginning of your journey.

threads.claim: The Traveler's feat of reeling in the true moon from beyond the false firmament is hinted to matter for hydromancy and the false sky.
threads.quote: Hydromancy uses the false stars to reflect true fate within the water.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa is steadily gathering Gnosis, and only the Pyro Gnosis remains out of her grasp.
threads.quote: The Tsaritsa's plans have continued to advance. Now, only the Pyro Gnosis remains free from her grasp.

threads.claim: Signora's downfall is attributed to the same violent methods she used to take Gnosis.
threads.quote: In the end, though, it was those same methods that led to her end.

threads.claim: Signora obtained the Geo Gnosis through a contract with Morax rather than force.
threads.quote: But we would be mistaken to ignore the fact that Signora did not win the Geo Gnosis using force.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses they are getting closer to a truth that is still unrevealed.
threads.quote: I'm getting closer to the truth. I can feel it.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt is presented as a looming threat to Mondstadt that the Traveler's actions in Natlan helped reduce.
threads.quote: Not to mention, the Wild Hunt would have reached our borders sooner or later.

threads.claim: The Traveler's ability to purify Abyssal corruption was unknown even to the Traveler until the moment it was needed.
threads.quote: I didn't even know I could do that until that moment.

threads.claim: Delusion may be involved in the Fatui's strange behavior, as the Traveler suspects.
threads.quote: Delusions might also be involved somehow.

threads.claim: Mona's predicament is tied to Klee and Barbeloth, and Mona has a long-running grudge with the Hexenzirkel's old mage.
threads.quote: Even though her daughter is, in some part, responsible for my predicament, that was a long time ago

threads.claim: The Holy Lyre's lock requires an unknown condition beyond defeating a Fatui Agent.
threads.quote: Perhaps we haven't met a certain condition, then?

threads.claim: The Traveler may formally meet the Tsaritsa in Snezhnaya sooner than expected.
threads.quote: Perhaps a chance to formally meet her in Snezhnaya might come sooner than we think.

threads.claim: The power of the Abyss appearing inside the bubble is unexplained and seems impossible.
threads.quote: How would the power of the Abyss even get in there?

threads.claim: The bubble's Abyssal power was a nascent form that grew from unchosen fates rather than coming from outside.
threads.quote: What developed in the bubble was a nascent form of Abyssal power that, if left unchecked, would evolve into the real thing.

threads.claim: Alice asks why the unchosen fates must disappear, leaving the question open.
threads.quote: Why must these fates be the ones to disappear?

threads.claim: Dvalin's tears keep summoning Abyssal monsters and the disaster will not end unless they are dealt with.
threads.quote: If left unchecked, they will continuously summon Abyssal monsters, and this disaster will never end.

threads.claim: Dvalin is too corrupted by the Abyss to be purified, so purifying him would mean killing him.
threads.quote: Purifying him now, in this state, is no different than sentencing him to death.

threads.claim: Varka saw a prophecy of an alternate version of events through the mages' scryglass.
threads.quote: Yeah, it was a kind of... prophecy.

threads.claim: The bubble's strange events happened because Dvalin was never purified, creating a causal link between events.
threads.quote: And so, because Dvalin was never purified, we've encountered a major bug.

assumed.quote: (Opens Clash of Lone Blades menu)

assumed.name: Yasuhiko Tarou's earlier defeat
assumed.quote: Previously, if I had not looked down on our fourth contestant, I would not have suffered such a terrible defeat.

threads.claim: Dodoco is said to be born riding the wind and setting off on a big adventure.
threads.quote: My mom says that when a Dodoco is born, it rides the wind and goes off on a big adventure.

threads.claim: Dodoco's adventure in Inazuma is written up and printed as a book for the festival.
threads.quote: Look, Honorary Knight! Aunty Aratani brought us Dodoco's story!

threads.claim: Yoimiya was once left waiting at a festival her father forgot to take her to, a memory that still hurts her.
threads.quote: I remember this one time when I was little, pops said he'd take me to the festival, but he was so busy with work that he forgot all about it.

threads.claim: Yoimiya's childhood disappointment drives her to make sure Klee does not feel the same way.
threads.quote: I don't want Klee to feel the same way.

threads.claim: Yoimiya has been in a poor mood recently for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: She seems like she hasn't been in a great mood recently, but maybe seeing you will cheer her up.

threads.claim: Klee regards her mother as the greatest person in the world, and her mother is a famous adventurer.
threads.quote: For me, the best and most awesome person in the world is my mom!

threads.claim: Fireworks are banned in Inazuma during the Irodori Festival, which upsets Yoimiya.
threads.quote: The folks from the Yashiro Commission specifically warned me that no fireworks are allowed in Inazuma during the Irodori Festival.

threads.claim: Albedo warns that Klee could get into trouble with explosions or fire in Inazuma, so she must be kept safe.
threads.quote: if there were an explosion somewhere in the city, Klee could very well get in trouble...

threads.claim: A shop assistant forged sales records and swapped cash for stones while hoarding statues to resell at inflated prices, and Seigou was arrested.
threads.quote: in the cash box, there are two bags in which most of the cash has been replaced with stones.

threads.claim: Watatsumi Island is about to begin formal talks with the Shogunate over Inazuma's future development, and the meeting with Miko is a preliminary step.
threads.quote: Watatsumi Island will soon hold formal talks with the Shogunate on Inazuma's future development.

threads.claim: Yae Miko and Sangonomiya Kokomi, who seem to be on opposite sides, are secretly meeting under the cover of a pen-pal book review.
threads.quote: Who holds a book review in the Kanjou Commission? You seriously expect anyone to believe that!?

threads.claim: Ei says she never heard about the statue craze from Miko, hinting at an unexplained gap in communication between Ei and Yae Miko.
threads.quote: I'm surprised Miko never mentioned it to me.

threads.claim: Inazuman poets rarely write about freedom or the wind, a theme that Lenne's poem and Ootomo's work touch on.
threads.quote: Few of them write about freedom or the wind, though.

threads.claim: The Yashiro Commission has banned weapons and fighting during the Irodori Festival, which blocks Yasuhiko Tarou's duels.
threads.quote: This is all the Yashiro Commission's fault, what with their

threads.claim: Yae Miko deliberately gives Gorou a favor and a letter that sets up a playful trap, showing her manipulative streak.
threads.quote: Ah yes, I'm sure that by this point you must be feeling ever so grateful for my kindness and are looking for a way to repay me, yes?

threads.claim: Ookubo Sanzaemon is preparing to duel an unnamed mightiest warrior and refuses to explain who that is.
threads.quote: I shall take this as a rehearsal for my duel against the "mightiest warrior."

threads.claim: The mightiest warrior turns out to be Taroumaru the dog, who is the fourth duel opponent.
threads.quote: The "mightiest warrior" is Taroumaru!

threads.claim: Shirasagi Himegimi wants more people to understand and practice ikebana, and has spent her own savings to publicize it.
threads.quote: She once expressed her frank desire for more people to understand ikebana and to drum up more interest in it such that more might want to practice this art.

threads.claim: Sakuya is shy in crowds and finds it hard to focus on her work at busy events like the festival.
threads.quote: She said that it would be difficult to quiet down and focus on her work in such an environment.

threads.claim: A big shot is coming to assess the business prospects of Theater Mechanicus, and its outcome is left open.
threads.quote: I heard that some big shot would be attending to assess the business prospects of Theater Mechanicus.

threads.claim: Komakata hopes the festival visit will help the big shot's assessment and make the game successful in Inazuma.
threads.quote: I've even heard that some big shot will be attending to assess its business prospects, so this might be our chance to make it big!

threads.claim: Komakata and Ruijin jointly developed the Stage of Brilliance ruleset through correspondence.
threads.quote: Either way, after some back and forth between us, we've come up with the newest version of Theater Mechanicus, which we call the "Stage of Brilliance."

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests their journeys and the sights they have seen are the source of their artistic inspiration.
threads.quote: Don't worry, our journey will continue.

threads.claim: Paimon's remark implies that the festival sponsor Shirasagi Himegimi is Ayaka.
threads.quote: So Ayaka did so much for Inazuma's floral arts...

introduced.name: Kayabuki Ikkei
introduced.how: a novelist who lures the Traveler in, aiming to win a publishing contest with an epic fighting novel
introduced.quote: In truth, my goal here is to write the most epic fighting novel ever and use it to take first prize in Yae Publishing House's "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest...

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki
introduced.how: a secret free-for-all fighting tournament held to celebrate or to get rid of bad luck, open to monsters, adventurers and warriors
introduced.quote: They would engage in a hearty fight to celebrate, or simply to eliminate bad luck.

introduced.name: Tengu-Kin
introduced.how: a group that imitated tengu and originated the Hyakunin Ikki practice, now banned for breaking public order and morals
introduced.quote: This practice used to circulate amongst the Tengu-Kin, who imitated the tengu.

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki Dojo
introduced.how: a hidden fighting venue in the city entered through a suspicious door
introduced.quote: You can enter the Hyakunin Ikki Dojo by stepping through this... rather suspicious door.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publisher that runs a novel contest called This Novel Is Amazing! and has a store
introduced.quote: In truth, my goal here is to write the most epic fighting novel ever and use it to take first prize in Yae Publishing House's "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest...

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki: Greatest Battle Chapter
introduced.how: a fighting novel Ikkei is writing, in which the blond outlander is the star
introduced.quote: I'm calling it "Hyakunin Ikki: Greatest Battle Chapter."

assumed.name: Tengu
assumed.quote: This practice used to circulate amongst the Tengu-Kin, who imitated the tengu.

assumed.name: Hyakunin Isshu
assumed.quote: Don't you mean the Hyakunin Isshu?

threads.claim: Hyakunin Ikki is being secretly revived by unnamed people in the city.
threads.quote: recently, some people have organized a Hyakunin Ikki in secret again.

threads.claim: The Tengu-Kin were banned for breaking public order and morals, yet the tournament still continues.
threads.quote: Though the Tengu-Kin have long been banned for flouting public order and morals, some still hold the Hyakunin Ikki free-for-all tournament from time to time.

threads.claim: A hidden dojo for the tournament exists behind a suspicious door in the city.
threads.quote: You can enter the Hyakunin Ikki Dojo by stepping through this... rather suspicious door.

introduced.name: Kayabuki Ikkei
introduced.how: A writer and spectator who admires the Traveler's fighting and runs the tournament's gate
introduced.quote: Kayabuki Ikkei: Hello there, blond-haired outlander...

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki
introduced.how: A free-for-all tournament festival where martial artists and monsters fight to celebrate or ward off bad luck
introduced.quote: It's a free-for-all tournament whereby people engage in a hearty fight to celebrate, or simply to eliminate bad luck.

introduced.name: Golden Whirlwind
introduced.how: The nickname given to the Traveler for their fighting style at the previous Hyakunin Ikki
introduced.quote: Ah yes! You are the eye-catching Golden Whirlwind from the Hyakunin Ikki last time...

introduced.name: Kouranka Daitatsumaki
introduced.how: A technique regarded as forbidden even among ancient martial arts, which the Traveler used in the last tournament
introduced.quote: the blond-haired outsider was unleashing Kouranka Daitatsumaki, a technique that was deemed forbidden even amongst ancient martial arts

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki tournament venue
introduced.how: The arena reached through a suspicious-looking gate where this year's Hyakunin Ikki is held
introduced.quote: Once we enter this suspicious-looking gate, we'll be in the tournament venue for this iteration of Hyakunin Ikki.

assumed.name: Previous Hyakunin Ikki
assumed.quote: Ah yes! You are the eye-catching Golden Whirlwind from the Hyakunin Ikki last time...

assumed.name: Kayabuki Ikkei's earlier encounter with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Kayabuki Ikkei: Hello there, blond-haired outlander...

threads.claim: The identities of the Hyakunin Ikki organizers and sponsors are a mystery, and the event is not openly discussed.
threads.quote: The identities of the organizers and sponsors are still shrouded in mystery though.

threads.claim: Kayabuki hints that the tournament is a sensitive topic and must not be discussed openly.
threads.quote: Whatever the case, this is not a topic to be discussed out in the open.

threads.claim: Monsters and martial artists set aside their grievances and identities to fight together at Hyakunin Ikki.
threads.quote: It's a festival where both martial artists and monsters put their grievances aside and forget their identities, just to enjoy the sheer excitement of fighting.

threads.claim: Kouranka Daitatsumaki is a forbidden ancient technique that the Traveler has used.
threads.quote: the blond-haired outsider was unleashing Kouranka Daitatsumaki, a technique that was deemed forbidden even amongst ancient martial arts

introduced.name: Kayabuki Ikkei
introduced.how: a recorder who chronicles the Traveler's battle heroics and guides them to the tournament
introduced.quote: Huh? You don't remember me? Ah, sorry, perhaps I was so busy recording your heroics in battle during the last Hyakunin Ikki that I didn't cheer loudly enough...

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki
introduced.how: a festival brawl where warriors and monsters fight to celebrate events or cope with loss
introduced.quote: Hyakunin Ikki was originally a festival organized by the Tengu-kin to celebrate memorable events or make peace with loss through a good old-fashioned brawl.

introduced.name: Tengu-kin
introduced.how: the group that originally organized the Hyakunin Ikki festival
introduced.quote: Hyakunin Ikki was originally a festival organized by the Tengu-kin to celebrate memorable events or make peace with loss through a good old-fashioned brawl.

introduced.name: Narukami Arena
introduced.how: the tournament venue behind a suspicious door where this round of Hyakunin Ikki is held
introduced.quote: Once you enter this rather suspicious-seeming door, you'll be in the tournament venue for this round of Hyakunin Ikki.

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki free-for-all rules
introduced.how: warriors and monsters fight regardless of origin, setting aside prejudice
introduced.quote: During the festival, be it warriors or monsters, everyone can cast aside their preconceived notions with no questions asked about their origins in a pure, hot-blooded free-for-all.

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki treasure rewards
introduced.how: warriors who win the festival can earn treasures
introduced.quote: They say that warriors who emerge from the festival victorious can also win all kinds of treasures...

introduced.name: Tengu-kin crackdown
introduced.how: a past crackdown on the Tengu-kin that left the festival organizers and rewards uncertain
introduced.quote: That said, since the crack-down on the Tengu-kin, I'm not too sure who's organizing the festival this time or where the rewards will come from.

introduced.name: Hyakunin Ikki bring-friends rule
introduced.how: participants may bring friends and companions, and more people make it better
introduced.quote: And of course, just like last time, feel free to bring your friends and companions!

assumed.name: last Hyakunin Ikki
assumed.quote: perhaps I was so busy recording your heroics in battle during the last Hyakunin Ikki that I didn't cheer loudly enough...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Monsters, adventurers, and warriors from across Teyvat, who share a common yearning for battle, will quench their thirst on this festival stage through passionate combat.

assumed.name: prior meeting with Kayabuki Ikkei
assumed.quote: Traveler: We meet again.

threads.claim: Someone is secretly organizing another Hyakunin Ikki, and the organizers are unknown.
threads.quote: it would seem that some people have been secretly organizing another Hyakunin Ikki.

threads.claim: The crackdown on the Tengu-kin has left the festival's future and its organizers in doubt.
threads.quote: That said, since the crack-down on the Tengu-kin, I'm not too sure who's organizing the festival this time or where the rewards will come from.

threads.claim: The source of the festival's treasure rewards is uncertain now.
threads.quote: where the rewards will come from.

threads.claim: The Traveler does not remember a past meeting with Kayabuki Ikkei.
threads.quote: Huh? You don't remember me?

threads.claim: The Traveler's valor has drawn growing crowds who want to join the fights.
threads.quote: Perhaps your valor in battle has attracted even more people.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: Citlali's grandson, a member of the Masters of the Night-Wind who is asking for help
introduced.quote: And on top of that, I'm her grandson. Which means I get a double dose of despair.

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: Ororon's grandmother, a genius and High Priestess who is a formidable spirit-worker
introduced.quote: Leyla! Obey my command, and return to the land where the sun shines. Return to your own path!

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: A tribal group whose spells and problem-solving methods are based on dealing with spirits
introduced.quote: The spells of the Masters of the Night-Wind are all based on dealing with spirits, and so are all our problem-solving methods.

introduced.name: Leyla
introduced.how: A young man who got lost in a clairvoyance session and whose spirit is missing
introduced.quote: Yeah — Leyla's his name. He got into some trouble during a clairvoyance session.

introduced.name: Sanhaj Kompore
introduced.how: A legendary Border Master of the tribe and one of the six heroes from five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: That's right. He was not only one of the six heroes, but also a legendary Border Master of our tribe.

introduced.name: Tenoch
introduced.how: Leader of the tribal coalition forces who gave his life in the battle
introduced.quote: As far as I understand, both Sanhaj and Tenoch, the leader of the tribal coalition forces, gave their lives to activate this spell.

introduced.name: Kokuchuu
introduced.how: A man in Inazuman attire who befriended Leyla and tinkered at a camp with him
introduced.quote: Yeah, some guy who goes by the name "Kokuchuu." Dressed in what looked like Inazuman attire.

introduced.name: Matla
introduced.how: A healer who checks on patients in the tribe
introduced.quote: We need to get you to Matla's for a checkup.

introduced.name: Clairvoyance
introduced.how: A spell that lets a spirit leave the body to access secret knowledge
introduced.quote: It's a kind of spell that lets your spirit leave your body, so you can access secret knowledge.

introduced.name: Spirit-duffer
introduced.how: A person with no spiritual sensitivity who cannot sense or control spirits or use spells
introduced.quote: Someone with no spiritual sensitivity whatsoever. Spirit-duffers can't sense or control spirits, much less use spells on them.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: The spirit realm; a Border Master can expand its borders into the real world
introduced.quote: The most powerful Border Masters can expand the borders of the Night Kingdom, and temporarily manifest part of it in the real world.

introduced.name: Hypersensitization therapy
introduced.how: A method of soaking a non-sensitive person in spiritually rich substances to force sensitivity, which the tribe once used and later outlawed
introduced.quote: Based on my studies of the ancient texts, hypersensitivity is usually treated with desensitization therapy.

introduced.name: Spiritloom
introduced.how: A device that records the fragments seen during clairvoyance
introduced.quote: , just over there is my spiritloom, which will record the fragments I see during clairvoyance.

introduced.name: Projection censer
introduced.how: A censer that must be used first to enable clairvoyance
introduced.quote: It only works if you use this projection censer first though, so don't forget that step.

introduced.name: Sanhaj relic shard
introduced.how: A broken shard that is a Sanhaj weapon piece from the Battle of the Mare Jivari, used as a medium
introduced.quote: ...Yes, it's the weapon Sanhaj used in the Battle of the Mare Jivari. I guess that proves it — this shard is a bona fide Sanhaj relic.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: A land with tribes; the Mare Jivari's last-known location is at its remote westernmost part
introduced.quote: At the westernmost part of Natlan. It's a very remote location, far away from any of the tribes.

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: A former ashen battlefield full of dangers that vanished from the world about twenty or thirty years ago
introduced.quote: The Mare Jivari was reduced to a desolate wasteland after that big battle.

introduced.name: Battle of the Mare Jivari
introduced.how: A battle five hundred years ago in which Sanhaj's border mastery turned the tide
introduced.quote: They say his border mastery was what turned the tide in the Battle of the Mare Jivari five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Disappearance of the Mare Jivari
introduced.how: The Mare Jivari suddenly vanished from the world, cause unknown, after a dark creature was reported roaming it
introduced.quote: And then, shortly after that, the whole region just completely disappeared. Nobody knows how, but that infamously ominous place just vanished from the face of the world.

assumed.name: Ancient Name
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? You mean, THAT Sanhaj? Ororon's ancient name hero guy?

assumed.name: Six heroes
assumed.quote: Citlali: Now that you're one of the six heroes, you think you can do as you please, do you? Hmm?

assumed.name: Light novels
assumed.quote: Ororon: You know how much Granny loves to drink, nap, and read light novels, right?

threads.claim: Ororon feels a connection between the relic and his ancient name, hinting he bears a link to past bearers.
threads.quote: Ororon: Wait, there's something else... It feels so familiar... I think this is somehow connected to my ancient name...

threads.claim: The relic may have belonged to a previous bearer of Ororon's ancient name.
threads.quote: Ororon: No... More like, I think this item might have belonged to a previous bearer of my ancient name.

threads.claim: The Mare Jivari vanished from the world for reasons nobody knows.
threads.quote: Nobody knows how, but that infamously ominous place just vanished from the face of the world.

threads.claim: The map shows where the Mare Jivari used to be before it disappeared.
threads.quote: Anyway, if I'm not mistaken, the place indicated on this map is where it used to be before it disappeared.

threads.claim: Kokuchuu may have had hidden motives beyond treating Leyla.
threads.quote: Kokuchuu must have had his own motives beyond just treating Leyla's condition.

threads.claim: Kokuchuu's real goal was to locate the Mare Jivari, using Leyla's clairvoyance as the means.
threads.quote: This whole time, all you wanted was to find the location of the Mare Jivari.

threads.claim: Citlali has marked Kokuchuu so she can track him if he returns.
threads.quote: But I left a mark on him! So if he comes around here again, I'll be able to track his every move.

threads.claim: Sanhaj and Tenoch died activating a spell during the battle that ended the dark calamity.
threads.quote: As far as I understand, both Sanhaj and Tenoch, the leader of the tribal coalition forces, gave their lives to activate this spell.

threads.claim: Citlali invokes the title Ah K'ulbatil during the ritual, hinting at a figure beyond her own identity.
threads.quote: I am Citlali, hear my command. I am the shepherd of doomsday, I am Ah K'ulbatil.

threads.claim: The Traveler has been counted among the six heroes, a group tied to the ancient past.
threads.quote: Citlali: Now that you're one of the six heroes, you think you can do as you please, do you? Hmm?

threads.claim: A mad sage is napping behind a wall in the hideout, and waking him could cause trouble.
threads.quote: Yeah, he's napping right behind that wall. We'd have a whole new situation on our hands if we woke him up.

introduced.name: Jala
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an Unchained Hunter, a special environmental protection consultant hired by the Maison
introduced.quote: Jala: More accurately, the Maison has hired me as a special environmental protection consultant — an "Unchained Hunter."

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: Law-enforcement body that hires Jala and arrests the suppliers of invasive fish
introduced.quote: Jala: This is Enghiene of the Maison Gardiennage. She has already arrested the supplier behind The Unchained.

introduced.name: Enghiene
introduced.how: Officer of the Maison Gardiennage who arrested the supplier behind The Unchained
introduced.quote: Jala: This is Enghiene of the Maison Gardiennage. She has already arrested the supplier behind The Unchained.

introduced.name: The Unchained
introduced.how: Merchants with strange beliefs who released invasive fish into Fontaine's waters, supplied by a now-arrested supplier
introduced.quote: Jala: These invasive species were let loose by some merchants who hold strange beliefs.

introduced.name: Invasive fish species
introduced.how: Fish that are aggressive, reproduce fast, or were raised on special feed, harming local aquatic life
introduced.quote: Jala: Some of the fish are extremely aggressive, others reproduce incredibly fast, and others were raised on special feed.

introduced.name: Fonta
introduced.how: A drink whose flavor could change quickly, making tainted water a serious economic threat
introduced.quote: Jala: The impact on Fontainians' health might be something we'd only feel in the future. But the flavor of a drink like Fonta could change instantly, and that'll spell untold trouble for the economy.

introduced.name: Capture zone
introduced.how: A set-up area where bait is used to lure invasive fish for the player to catch
introduced.quote: Jala: I've already set up a capture zone into which we can lure all those invasive fish using bait...

assumed.name: Mondstadt invasive-species incident
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right! Paimon thinks we heard about something like that back in Mondstadt...

assumed.name: Wrangler Points
assumed.quote: (Approach Jala after earning 3000 Wrangler Points)

assumed.name: Grand Chef Supreme of Valor
assumed.quote: Enghiene: You're clearly a very capable hunter! It's not just anyone who can enlist the help of , the Grand Chef Supreme of Valor...

assumed.name: Prior meeting with Enghiene
assumed.quote: Traveler: Have we worked together before, officer?

assumed.name: Fisherman's Toast
assumed.quote: Traveler: Anything to keep those seabirds off my Fisherman's Toast...

threads.claim: The Unchained merchants with strange beliefs deliberately released the invasive fish into Fontaine's waters.
threads.quote: Jala: These invasive species were let loose by some merchants who hold strange beliefs.

threads.claim: The supplier behind The Unchained has been arrested by Enghiene.
threads.quote: Jala: This is Enghiene of the Maison Gardiennage. She has already arrested the supplier behind The Unchained.

threads.claim: The fishing effort has clearly reduced the number of invasive species, though the problem is not yet fully solved.
threads.quote: Jala: And it looks like your fishing spree's had the desired effect — there's been a clear reduction in the number of invasive species in these waters...

threads.claim: Paimon vaguely recalls a past invasive-species event in Mondstadt that the Traveler may have forgotten.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon's memory is fuzzy, but we heard about something like that in Mondstadt ages ago, she's sure of it...

threads.claim: The health effects of the invasive fish on Fontainians may only be felt in the future.
threads.quote: Jala: The impact on Fontainians' health might be something we'd only feel in the future.

threads.claim: Jala's strong sense of responsibility may stem from someone in her past who deeply affected her.
threads.quote: Enghiene: Well, I guess... there must have been someone in her past with a really strong sense of responsibility, who had a profound effect on her... It's easy to see how she feels.

threads.claim: Enghiene seems familiar to Paimon, and she implies she and the Traveler have worked together before.
threads.quote: Paimon: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Officer Enghiene looks a little familiar...

introduced.name: Windblume Festival
introduced.how: a Mondstadt tradition celebrating love and freedom, with parties and offering Windblumes
introduced.quote: Flora: The Windblume Festival is a Mondstadt tradition — a festival of love and freedom. It's a time of celebration and partying in the city.

introduced.name: Windblume
introduced.how: the festival's symbol, a flower representing freedom and the spirit of the wind
introduced.quote: Flora: The Windblume is the symbol of this festival, a flower that represents freedom and the spirit of the wind...

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: the Anemo Archon to whom Windblumes are offered in reverence
introduced.quote: Flora: At this time of year, we offer Windblumes to the great Anemo Archon, Barbatos, as a sign of reverence and love.

introduced.name: Windwheel Aster
introduced.how: a flower Quinn argues is the true Windblume, a symbol of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Quinn: No, no — I'm just here to set the record straight. Windblume doesn't mean the dandelion, but the Windwheel Aster.

introduced.name: Iris (Dragonspine Adventurer Camp)
introduced.how: a commissioner who hires the Traveler to photograph two scenic Dragonspine spots
introduced.quote: Iris: Specifically, I'd like you to take pictures of two places on Dragonspine. I'll mark the exact locations for you on your map.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: the Mondstadt knights who host the festival celebrations
introduced.quote: Athos: The Windblume Festival celebrations have always been hosted by the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Jean
introduced.how: Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, who patrols during the festival
introduced.quote: Ellin: I wanna offer some flowers to the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, Jean.

introduced.name: Kaeya
introduced.how: a Knights captain who takes over Jean's administrative duties during the festival
introduced.quote: Athos: Captain Kaeya takes over her administrative duties during that period.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: a librarian-clerk who joins the Knights on festival patrol
introduced.quote: Lisa: Rarely, but this is the Windblume Festival, and they need all hands on deck. Even the humble clerical staff, like me.

introduced.name: Barbara
introduced.how: a beloved singer at the Church of Favonius, idolized by fans
introduced.quote: Albert: I—I'm just such a huge fan of Mondstadt's idol... Barbara-sama...! You must have heard of her? She's the super cute one at the Church of Favonius!

introduced.name: Rosaria
introduced.how: Barbara's sister
introduced.quote: Barbara: ...My sister!

introduced.name: Quinn
introduced.how: a fruit stall vendor who champions the Windwheel Aster
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's Quinn from the fruit stall! Wanna join us?

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: a title held by the Traveler, which the people of Mondstadt trust
introduced.quote: Venti: Come on now, you're Mondstadt's Honorary Knight, the people trust you!

introduced.name: Venti's hand gestures
introduced.how: gestures signal whether students should act boldly, play safe, or give up
introduced.quote: Venti: Now listen up, if you see me make this gesture... it means I think they should forge ahead and seize the opportunity.

introduced.name: Bullseye Balloons
introduced.how: a shooting game where shooting targets quickly and accurately earns high scores and rewards
introduced.quote: Lizzie: The name itself is pretty self-explanatory, isn't it? Shoot the targets as quickly and as accurately as you can to reach a high score.

introduced.name: Venti's love poetry class
introduced.how: a paid class where Venti teaches people to compose love poems
introduced.quote: Venti: They're looking to learn the secrets of love, so they came to me to learn how to compose love poems.

introduced.name: Small Lamp Grass
introduced.how: a wild plant that only grows outside the city, needed for crafting
introduced.quote: Those only grow in the wild, could I ask you to retrieve them? I need two stems of Small Lamp Grass.

introduced.name: Nimrod
introduced.how: Kaeya's drinking buddy from the tavern, a married man who wants a gift for his wife
introduced.quote: Kaeya: His name is Nimrod, he's never far from the tavern.

introduced.name: Starsnatch Cliff
introduced.how: a stargazing spot where Marvin and Marla meet
introduced.quote: Whenever we want to meet, we go stargazing at Starsnatch Cliff.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: the town where Marla lives, far from Marvin

introduced.name: Marla

introduced.quote: Marvin: Marla... She's cute and hardworking — always helping her family out with the farm work.

introduced.name: Helen
introduced.how: a singer who declines to join the Guild because she protects Mondstadt with her song
introduced.quote: Helen: Oh, that... I did see a notice, but it doesn't interest me. I can protect Mondstadt with my song, I don't need to become an adventurer.

introduced.name: Albedo

introduced.quote: Albedo: Greetings, I'm Albedo the alchemist.

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: reveals he is a bard
introduced.quote: Venti: Venti will do just fine, but yes, I am a bard.

introduced.name: Venti as professor

introduced.quote: Venti: All the poems from the fast-track class have now been collected!

introduced.name: Windblume recipe
introduced.how: an alchemy recipe Sucrose copied from a damaged ancient book
introduced.quote: Sucrose: It's a Windblume recipe I transcribed from an ancient book.

introduced.name: Tetratanic Sweet Flower
introduced.how: a Sweet Flower species with seeds four times bigger than ordinary ones
introduced.quote: Sucrose: The seeds of the Tetratanic Sweet Flower are four times bigger than those of ordinary Sweet Flowers, and the Sweet Flowers that grow from them are, well, Tetratanic Sweet Flowers.

introduced.name: Windblume
introduced.how: a flower-symbol that means something different to each person and is a spirit of freedom
introduced.quote: Venti: If you want my perspective, Windblumes don't exist. Yet they are all around us nonetheless.

introduced.name: Windblume Festival
introduced.how: the festival is said to originate in Mondstadt, the City of Freedom
introduced.quote: Paimon: Guess it's no surprise that the type of flower given by the City of Freedom to it's deity is in itself an expression of freedom.

introduced.name: Barbatos

introduced.quote: Jean: I suppose you heard? You're this year's Windblume Star. You will be making an offering of Windblumes to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, on behalf of the whole of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Windblume Star
introduced.how: a major Mondstadt honor given to someone who has helped the city, who chooses the festival's Windblume offering
introduced.quote: Kaeya: The Windblume Star is one of Mondstadt's greatest honors, normally only bestowed upon those who have made enormous sacrifices for Mondstadt...

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: a title given to the Traveler, used as their address
introduced.quote: Jean: Traveler! Ah — excuse me. I should address you as Honorary Knight under the circumstances.

introduced.name: Benny's Adventure Team

introduced.name: Brook

introduced.name: Chilled Meat

introduced.quote: Brook: I specially commissioned an adventurer to help me go to Dragonspine and obtain some Chilled Meat for this dish.

introduced.quote: Brook: I commissioned Allan to help me go to Brightcrown Canyon to hunt for the freshest meat

introduced.quote: I was originally commissioned to come here to obtain some Chilled Meat

introduced.quote: Plauen: It's the Windblume Festival at the moment, so we made a few modifications to the interior to turn it into a unique challenge before opening it to the public.

introduced.quote: Ella Musk: My apologies... That's because the library's been so loud recently that I can't study Hilichurlian in peace.

introduced.quote: Vile: Well, more accurately, "that gentleman" would like your help in this matter.

introduced.name: Floral Whisper

introduced.quote: Flora: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Do you need anything?

introduced.quote: Sayid: I'm currently writing a research report, and I believe that descriptions alone will not suffice.

introduced.name: Sumeru

introduced.quote: Sayid: Seeing such lovely sights reminds me of the festivals in my hometown, Sumeru...

introduced.name: Fatui

introduced.quote: They usually hide in their kennel and only show up when I put food in their bowl.

introduced.name: Margaret
introduced.how: proprietor developing a non-alcoholic festival drink with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Margaret: Oh, it's you. Actually, I was just considering pushing out a new special beverage based on the Windblume Festival.

introduced.name: Nimrod
introduced.how: wine-loving patron who tests the new drink and says it lacks alcohol
introduced.quote: Nimrod: Oh, you want me to test it, do you? Hahaha! No problem, none at all! I'm an old hand when it comes to wine.

introduced.name: Aramis
introduced.how: guard on duty who cannot drink but tries the non-alcoholic drink
introduced.quote: Aramis: My apologies, but I'm on duty at the moment. I can't drink.

introduced.name: Nora

introduced.quote: Nora: Do you wanna play with me?

introduced.name: Tea Break Pancake Cooked by Lily

introduced.quote: Lily: Alright, it's done! I've got three pancakes right here. One for you, one for me, and one for Mister Fatooey!

introduced.name: Windblume Festival
introduced.how: city festival where people have fun, eat and drink, and where flowers are given
introduced.quote: Margaret: Everyone's going to be having fun in the city during this time, and I'm sure that they wouldn't mind having some food and drink to go along with that.

introduced.quote: Margaret: I'll go collect some Windwheel Asters as well
