threads.claim: The true meaning of the Windblume is a mystery, with the dandelion and Windwheel Aster both claimed.
threads.quote: Paimon: It sounds like such a happy festival! Even if the whole Windblume thing is still a total mystery...

threads.claim: Locals disagree about the Windblume, and even the Mondstadt people cannot agree on its definition.
threads.quote: Quinn: Did I say something wrong? Eh... Windblume is as Windblume does, what can I say...

threads.claim: A threatening letter claims something precious to Barbara has been buried in the wilderness.
threads.quote: I've stolen the thing most precious to you and buried it.

threads.claim: The buried threat turns out to be a fan's gift, a Windwheel Aster Wreath, not real intimidation.
threads.quote: Venti: Hmm... looks like our "perpetrator" is really just one of Barbara's fans.

threads.claim: Bennett recalls the Thousand Winds Temple as the likely place of Barbara's precious thing.
threads.quote: Bennett: Aha! I've got it! The Thousand Winds Temple!

threads.claim: Venti uses hidden hand gestures to signal advice, and the Traveler must learn to read them.
threads.quote: Venti: Now listen up, if you see me make this gesture... it means I think they should forge ahead and seize the opportunity.

threads.claim: Kaeya's ability to speak Hilichurlian is hinted at as an unexpected hidden skill.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait... so we're just gonna gloss over the fact that Kaeya can speak Hilichurlian? Weird.

threads.claim: The Adventurers' Guild is struggling to recruit members, and its methods are questionable.
threads.quote: Cyrus: Ah, you don't understand the state the Guild's in.

threads.claim: Iris hopes the Guild will recruit new members so Cyrus can return to adventuring with her.
threads.quote: Iris: Still, if he is working so hard, it's about time the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild recruited some new members.

threads.claim: Nimrod's heavy drinking strains his marriage, and he tries to make amends with a handmade gift.
threads.quote: Nimrod: ...I—I'm afraid I'm a bit of a drunkard, I'm nearly always in the tavern. My wife hates me drinking, so we're constantly arguing.

threads.claim: Marvin's conservative father opposes his romance with Marla, creating a family conflict.
threads.quote: Marvin: *sigh* Let's just say that our families are quite different. My father objects to us being together.

threads.claim: A suspicious figure is seen during festival patrols, hinting at a hidden threat.
threads.quote: Kaeya: I just caught sight of a suspicious figure, I must go and investigate.

threads.claim: The Traveler asks what Windblumes are and what they mean to Barbatos, an open question.
threads.quote: Venti: I know your question. What are Windblumes, exactly? And what do Windblumes and the Windblume Festival mean to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon?

threads.claim: Windblumes have no single fixed definition; every individual decides what their own Windblumes are.
threads.quote: Venti: Flowers of blessings, flowers of respect, flowers of love. Every individual has their own Windblumes and every individual has the right to define them.

threads.claim: The ancient recipe is described as extremely precious and is written in an unknown language, hinting at a hidden purpose.
threads.quote: Sucrose: The author mentioned in the notes that the recipe was extremely precious. Timaeus and I are completely unable to decipher the content.

threads.claim: Albedo doubts the recipe makes a Windblume and says the real thing must be seen to reach a conclusion.
threads.quote: Albedo: Even so, I don't believe this is a recipe for a Windblume.

threads.claim: Sucrose claims to have seen the Windblume in her dreams, a hint of a personal or supernatural link.
threads.quote: Sucrose: Wah! It's just like the Windblume in my dreams!

threads.claim: Sweet Flowers existed in antiquity and the species has a long history.
threads.quote: Albedo: There were indeed Sweet Flowers in antiquity. This species has a long history.

threads.claim: The word Windblume was a secret code used by people of Old Mondstadt to resist in hiding.
threads.quote: It was a code word that the people used to stay in contact and mount resistance in secret.

threads.claim: The cell at the Thousand Winds Temple is an ancient mechanism that must be found and triggered to escape.
threads.quote: Venti: Huh, what a superior design... and presumably an ancient mechanism is involved somehow?

threads.claim: The Traveler solves the cell mechanism and frees Bennett and Razor.
threads.quote: Venti: Aaaand open sesame!

threads.claim: Dvalin is absent from the festival but is sensed to be returning soon.
threads.quote: Venti: He's not here, but I sense he'll be back soon.

threads.claim: Dvalin apparently found and accepted the gift prepared for him at Stormterror's Lair.
threads.quote: Venti: Haha, I guess Dvalin found the gift we prepared for him.

threads.claim: Windblumes embody the yearning for freedom and the courage to follow the wind.
threads.quote: Venti: They are the spirit of yearning for freedom, the courage to follow the wind wherever it may lead...

threads.claim: Ella Musk speaks Hilichurlian, hinting at a scholarly interest in the language.
threads.quote: Ella Musk: Ye ika gusha mosi!

threads.claim: The Peculiar Wonderland domain appears only at specific times, leaving its origin an open question.
threads.quote: Plauen: According to our records, it seems to only appear at specific times.

threads.claim: Sayid misses the Akademiya and home traditions in Sumeru, hinting at a larger Sumeru story.
threads.quote: I wonder how things are at the Akademiya nowadays...

threads.claim: The Traveler has been chosen as Windblume Star and must choose the flower offered to Barbatos.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Traveler, the Windblume is always chosen by the Windblume Star. So the flower offered to the Anemo Archon for this year's celebrations... is entirely up to you.

threads.claim: Bennett has gone missing and his whereabouts are unknown, prompting a search at the Thousand Winds Temple.
threads.quote: Barbara: Something terrible's happened. Bennett's gone missing!

threads.claim: Viktor insists he and the Fatui are villains, which contrasts with his kind treatment of Lily.
threads.quote: I'm with the Fatui. We're villains, got it? No bleeding hearts around here.

threads.claim: Viktor hints that the world may not divide cleanly into good and evil, complicating his villain image.
threads.quote: Viktor: If the world was so easily divided into good and evil, then many things would...

threads.claim: Lily believes a Fatui member can become good again if he changes, raising whether redemption is possible.
threads.quote: Lily: But even if that Fatooey's done a lot of bad, bad things, he can become a good person again if he changes, right?

threads.claim: Viktor refuses to tell stories about the Fatui, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Viktor: *cough* I... No, it's... Those stories aren't very interesting, you know? I'll think of something better, just you wait!

threads.claim: Rudolf has secretly ordered a huge bouquet for Jilliana, hinting at the important business Lily's parents are handling.
threads.quote: Flora: Well, Rudolf has actually ordered a huge bouquet to give to Jilliana...

introduced.name: The Cat's Tail
introduced.how: A tavern in Mondstadt where Diona serves special drinks
introduced.quote: Miss Diona at Cat's Tail Tavern would be away on a business trip for quite some time...

introduced.name: free-roaming color paint
introduced.how: A rare color paint that moves around constantly and is hard to catch
introduced.quote: It's a kind of free-roaming paint.

introduced.name: secret realm
introduced.how: A hidden realm where the colorist Ashas found a very special color paint
introduced.quote: The colorist Ashas have discovered a very special color paint in some secret realm...

introduced.name: Bennett's dads
introduced.how: Bennett's fathers who vacationed at the resort and then returned to Mondstadt early
introduced.quote: So, rather than extend their vacation, they decided to return to Mondstadt as originally planned.

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Oh hey, it's and Paimon! Hello!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Hmm, looks like that meal's got to wait till you two come over to Mondstadt again.

assumed.name: Bennett's past letter
assumed.quote: might recall that I wrote you two a letter to let you know that...

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: My dads were really pleased to see that my streak of bad luck has almost fully ended at Natlan!

assumed.name: Crystalfly
assumed.quote: And like the Crystalfly, these colors are always moving around, all over the place.

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: Maybe the colors of Phlogiston, the moon, or the depths of the starry sky?

threads.claim: The colorists have a free-roaming paint they cannot catch, which raises the question of how they will obtain it.
threads.quote: The colorists have no idea how to catch them...

threads.claim: The colorist Ashas finish the event stages and become satisfied, implying the paint hunt succeeded.
threads.quote: Looks like our colorist Ashas are very much satisfied now.

threads.claim: The colorist Ashas will create a masterpiece that players may see on a future visit.
threads.quote: Maybe the next time we come by, we'll be able to see the colorist Asha's masterpiece.

threads.claim: Bennett's streak of bad luck has almost fully ended, though it has not entirely disappeared.
threads.quote: My dads were really pleased to see that my streak of bad luck has almost fully ended at Natlan!

threads.claim: Diona will be away on a long business trip, so Bennett's dads left the resort early.
threads.quote: Miss Diona at Cat's Tail Tavern would be away on a business trip for quite some time...

threads.claim: The colors of Phlogiston, the moon, and the starry sky are hinted as inspiration for future colorist art.
threads.quote: Maybe the colors of Phlogiston, the moon, or the depths of the starry sky?

introduced.name: Xinyan
introduced.how: Liyue musician who introduces herself as a rock 'n' roll player and asks for help with her travel permit
introduced.quote: Oh, so you're a Mondstadter! Pleasure to meet ya, I'm from Liyue myself. The name's Xinyan, and the name of the game is rock 'n' roll!

introduced.name: Iridescence Tour
introduced.how: Fontaine music festival that was supposed to be held in Inazuma but was canceled, leaving Xinyan without a permit
introduced.quote: The organizers told me it was a music festival from Fontaine that was famous throughout Teyvat, but it seemed like nobody in Liyue had ever heard of it before.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: Commander who leads Tenryou Commission troops and gives orders to the samurai
introduced.quote: Formations! Follow the vanguard and assemble outside the city!

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: Inazuma's samurai force that is currently redeploying its defenses across Inazuma
introduced.quote: As you can see, the times have changed. The Tenryou Commission is currently redeploying its defenses all across Inazuma.

introduced.name: Domain
introduced.how: Dangerous monster-filled zones that can suddenly appear, such as a nameless one in the Araumi region
introduced.quote: Recently, a nameless Domain has appeared in the Araumi region. Monsters with incredible strength have been pouring into the area.

introduced.name: Mystic Onmyou Chamber
introduced.how: The Domain at the Araumi site, overseen by Shiki Taishou
introduced.quote: This Domain is called the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. I'm the overseer in charge here.

introduced.name: Shiki Taishou
introduced.how: Shikigami overseer of the Domain who has lost some memory and introduces himself
introduced.quote: My name is Shiki Taishou, and I'm sorry you have to see me like this on our first meeting.

introduced.name: Shikigami
introduced.how: Paper cut-outs imbued with magic that follow their masters and can banish evil or repel monsters
introduced.quote: They say in Inazuma there are paper cut-outs imbued with magical power that follow their masters wherever they go.

introduced.name: Onmyoudou
introduced.how: Inazuma magic art that can expel evil and repel monsters when used wisely
introduced.quote: Onmyoudou can expel evil and repel monsters. When used wisely, it can be of great help to martial artists.

introduced.name: Shikifuda
introduced.how: Magic charms placed throughout the Domain, with nine recognized as high magic
introduced.quote: Over a thousand types of shikifuda were once placed here, nine of which are recognized as high magic.

introduced.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
introduced.how: First onmyouji of Inazuma and master of charm magic who created Shiki Taishou and the Domain
introduced.quote: He was the first onmyouji of Inazuma and a master of charm magic. He created me and this Domain, and lived here in seclusion for a very long time.

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: Combat-loving adventurer who also goes by Tartaglia and is known to Paimon and the Traveler
introduced.quote: He also goes by Tartaglia.

introduced.name: Watanabe
introduced.how: Tenryou Commission samurai who reports that the monsters ambushed the camp and escaped
introduced.quote: We were ambushed by monsters at the entrance as soon as we started to investigate.

introduced.name: Monster breakout
introduced.how: Monsters escaped the Domain and fled southeast, forcing the Commission to split up and chase them
introduced.quote: We were able to push most of them back into the Domain, but... some of them escaped to the southeast...

introduced.name: Shikigami replica
introduced.how: Mass-produced paper copies of Shiki Taishou that carry his power and possibly some of his memories
introduced.quote: It's a replica of me — a mass-produced shikigami based on my design.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: a Tenryou Commission general arriving to take control of the area and plan the assault
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara has arrived. She's right over there.

introduced.name: Shiki Taishou
introduced.how: self-introduced as the first shikigami and overseer of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber
introduced.quote: I am Shiki Taishou, the first shikigami, ally of martial artists, and forevermore the overseer of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the authority that now controls the area and would normally have jurisdiction over Domains like this
introduced.quote: It took some time, but the Tenryou Commission has assumed full control of this area.

introduced.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
introduced.how: the man who founded the onmyou chamber, rallied samurai and created Shiki Taishou
introduced.quote: Later, he rallied all samurai with the will to serve in protecting the nation, and created me and this onmyou chamber...

introduced.name: Mystic Onmyou Chamber
introduced.how: a Domain built as a combat training ground, not for practicing onmyoudou or harnessing evil
introduced.quote: This realm is not for practicing onmyoudou, nor is it for harnessing evil.

introduced.name: shikigami
introduced.how: artificial beings created by onmyouji, partnered with samurai and holding fragmented memories
introduced.quote: I am just a shikigami, created by an onmyouji, with nothing more than a few fragmented memories to my name.

introduced.name: Shiki Koshou
introduced.how: a replica gift that keeps communicating with Shiki Taishou wherever it is taken
introduced.quote: You can call it Shiki Koshou.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: the adepti of Liyue, whose arts Harunosuke went abroad to study
introduced.quote: He made his way across the ocean to seek the adepti of Liyue, and went on to study the adepti arts.

introduced.name: onmyoudou
introduced.how: the earliest form of this art was founded by Harunosuke by combining adepti techniques with transcension
introduced.quote: He combined those subtle techniques with the art of transcension that he himself had practiced over the years, and founded the earliest version of onmyoudou.

introduced.name: mirror monsters
introduced.how: monsters created from defeated-monster data and used as training targets for samurai
introduced.quote: Upon returning to the Domain, that information would be channeled into the creation of mirror monsters — training targets for the samurai.

introduced.name: Musou no Hitotachi
introduced.how: a god whose mighty warriors swept the land and removed the hidden evils, making the samurai's work obsolete
introduced.quote: Even as we trained, the god with the power of the Musou no Hitotachi swept across the land with a force of diligent and mighty warriors.

introduced.name: Fatui Harbinger
introduced.how: Childe explains that Harbingers each pursue their own agendas, and his is seeking combat
introduced.quote: My agenda as a Harbinger is to seek out combat, and nearly every Fatui Harbinger has an agenda of their own too.

introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.how: an item Scaramouche possesses, with contact with him now lost
introduced.quote: Scaramouche is in possession of a certain Gnosis, and we happen to have lost contact with him... I don't suppose it's a coincidence.

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: a figure who holds a Gnosis and whose sudden silence Childe finds suspicious
introduced.quote: Scaramouche is in possession of a certain Gnosis, and we happen to have lost contact with him... I don't suppose it's a coincidence.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time.

assumed.name: Yata Kouki
assumed.quote: Yata Kouki: Huh? You again? I thought I told you we're busy already! You'll have to wait.

assumed.name: Childe's past actions in Liyue
assumed.quote: (Wait, Xinyan doesn't know what Paimon's talking about...! And knowing Xinyan, if she found out about Childe's actions in Liyue... Oh boy...)

assumed.name: Childe's history with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Childe: It's been a long time, Traveler. You're getting bolder.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Xiangling made me up a special packed lunch to wish me well!

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: I even asked Beidou to ferry me out here ahead of time to scout the place out and make sure everythin' goes perfect.

assumed.name: Almighty Shogun
assumed.quote: But even the Almighty Shogun has recognized your abilities, Traveler.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sounds a bit like all that sigil and adepti art stuff they have over in Liyue...

assumed.name: Xinyan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm, let's go meet up with Xinyan!

assumed.name: Childe
assumed.quote: Childe: As a comrade and old rival, you should know that unexpected combat situations are my bread and butter.

assumed.name: Red
assumed.quote: Xinyan: Not to mention Red. Traveler, we gotta go back and save him, right?

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Xinyan: Besides, thanks to the Traveler, Kujou Sara, and Beidou, gettin' over to Inazuma just got a whole lot easier.

assumed.name: Mystic Onmyou Chamber
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's been a while now, do you think the Mystic Onmyou Chamber has finished rearranging yet?

assumed.name: The Balladeer
assumed.quote: I originally came to this Domain because I thought that it might have something to do with The Balladeer. As it turns out, he's not here.

assumed.name: Domain
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait... the Domain already rearranged itself. The route we discovered is useless now!

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I hope you can use this time to really get to know Inazuma.

threads.claim: Nobody yet knows who built the Domain or why it holds so many monsters.
threads.quote: Besides, we still don't know who built this Domain, or why there are so many monsters inside. We need to get more of an understandin'.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou has lost part of his memory and cannot remember his origin or master.
threads.quote: Actually... it seems like I may have suffered some memory loss in the process.

threads.claim: Fragments return to Shiki Taishou, revealing the name of his master, Kamuna Harunosuke.
threads.quote: My master, Kamuna Harunosuke.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Shiki Taishou might be a tool meant to create monsters.
threads.quote: If its purpose is to create monsters...

threads.claim: Childe suggests the Domain's monsters came from shikigami that went out of control.
threads.quote: But, he couldn't foresee that something would go wrong with the Domain, that he would lose control of the onmyoudou, and that his shikigami would turn into monsters.

threads.claim: Childe proposes that Kamuna Harunosuke may be evil and built the Domain to make monsters into weapons.
threads.quote: What if Kamuna Harunosuke is evil, and created this Domain to enhance his onmyoudou?

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou insists his master would never have been so careless or irresponsible.
threads.quote: With his ability, there's no way Kamuna would have made an error like this with his onmyoudou.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Childe knows more about the Domain and is searching for something there.
threads.quote: (He must know something.)

threads.claim: The Domain blocks outsiders from re-entering after the group leaves.
threads.quote: Oh no... we can't get back in. It's stoppin' outsiders from enterin'.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou reveals that a disguised door mechanism rearranges the rooms whenever someone touches it.
threads.quote: The door just now must have actually been a disguised mechanism. As soon as anyone touches it, all the rooms inside the onmyou chamber are rearranged.

threads.claim: The Iridescence Tour may be a fake, since its organizers were unknown in Liyue and a stranger was recruiting for it.
threads.quote: There was a guy standing on the side of the road calling out, like he was selling Sunsettias or somethin'...

threads.claim: Music can carry a hidden language that reveals a listener's inner nature.
threads.quote: The language I spoke was hidden in the music.

threads.claim: Something big has recently stretched the Tenryou Commission thin and it cannot deal with smaller problems.
threads.quote: Something big happened recently and the Tenryou Commission is spread thin — we don't have the resources right now.

threads.claim: The Domain was once a site of battles, and the reason people fought there is unknown.
threads.quote: But why did people want to do battle in this Domain?

threads.claim: The group considers hiding the Commission's campaign against the Domain from Shiki Taishou.
threads.quote: I need to ask a favor. Can you guys keep the Tenryou Commission's campaign against the Domain a secret from Shiki Taishou?

threads.claim: Scaramouche holds a Gnosis and has gone out of contact, which Childe suspects is connected to his own investigations.
threads.quote: Scaramouche is in possession of a certain Gnosis, and we happen to have lost contact with him... I don't suppose it's a coincidence.

threads.claim: Childe suspected The Balladeer was linked to the Domain, but the lead turned out to be empty for now.
threads.quote: I originally came to this Domain because I thought that it might have something to do with The Balladeer. As it turns out, he's not here.

threads.claim: Traveler asks whether Kamuna Harunosuke might have evil intentions toward Inazuma, leaving his motives in doubt.
threads.quote: Traveler: If Kamuna has evil intentions...

threads.claim: The flashback shows Harunosuke's lifelong aim was to assist descendants and guard the territory, not to harm Inazuma.
threads.quote: Kamuna Harunosuke: All I ever wanted... was to assist her descendants and guard this territory

threads.claim: Xinyan wonders whether Harunosuke left the Domain and is still alive.
threads.quote: Xinyan: Left? Meanin'... he's still alive?

threads.claim: Paimon speculates that Harunosuke may have become immortal through the adepti arts and transcension.
threads.quote: Paimon: If Kamuna Harunosuke learned the power of the adepti arts and transcension, isn't it possible that he became immortal?

threads.claim: Harunosuke voluntarily set out again in search of a new purpose, though whether he still lives is left open.
threads.quote: Kamuna Harunosuke: I will set out again

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou's memories are still incomplete, and the missing parts drive the story forward.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: My memory is still incomplete, but there's less and less gaps to fill.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou recovers all of his memories and learns the true origin and purpose of the Domain.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: My memories, fragmented for so long... are finally complete.

threads.claim: The Domain keeps rearranging itself, making known routes useless and placing its control in question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait... the Domain already rearranged itself. The route we discovered is useless now!

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou regains full control of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber, so escaping mirror monsters is no longer possible.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: I've regained full control of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. No mirror monsters will be able to escape this Domain from now on.

threads.claim: Childe predicts the Tenryou Commission will launch a lethal assault on the Domain that could destroy its memories.
threads.quote: Childe: In that case, knowing their style, they're probably planning a lethal assault on the Domain to crush everything in their path.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou explains the situation to the Tenryou Commission, which accepts that the chamber and he are innocent.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: I explained the situation to the Tenryou Commission and showed them the original documentation. In the end, they believed that the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and I were innocent.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou fears that a weapon discarded by its creator has no purpose left.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: But this Domain was abandoned. The only people to have come here since are yourselves. What use does a weapon discarded by its owner have to offer...

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou finds his purpose in assisting fighters, independent of Harunosuke.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: There was value in everything Harunosuke did... and my purpose is my assignment.

threads.claim: Childe says he does not care for allegiance, affiliation, duty or destiny, and seeks only the thrill of battle.
threads.quote: Childe: This may come as an unpleasant surprise to Miss Xinyan and Shiki Taishou, but I'm not someone who cares for allegiance and affiliation.

threads.claim: Shiki Taishou describes his bond with Harunosuke as one of responsibility and duty, contrasting with Childe's view.
threads.quote: Shiki Taishou: Our bond is one of trust. My bond with Harunosuke... is one of responsibility.

threads.claim: A divine power swept the land and ended the need for the samurai's training, leaving its nature to be explored.
threads.quote: Even as we trained, the god with the power of the Musou no Hitotachi swept across the land with a force of diligent and mighty warriors.

threads.claim: Childe reveals that Fatui Harbingers each pursue their own agendas, hinting at hidden motives.
threads.quote: My agenda as a Harbinger is to seek out combat, and nearly every Fatui Harbinger has an agenda of their own too.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite Festival
introduced.how: yearly first-full-moon festival in Liyue honoring past heroes, with lanterns released at night
introduced.quote: On the first full moon of the first month each year, Liyue celebrates the Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: the land whose people celebrate the Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: On the first full moon of the first month each year, Liyue celebrates the Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: small lanterns released into the night sky during the festival, believed to guide heroes home
introduced.quote: After dark, the people release Xiao and Mingxiao Lanterns into the night sky.

introduced.name: Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.how: huge communal lantern built by all of Liyue Harbor for the festival
introduced.quote: But there's also a huge one, a joint effort by all the people of Liyue Harbor. That one is called the Mingxiao Lantern.

introduced.name: Plaustrite
introduced.how: floating stone that is the main component of the Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: Mm-hmm, plaustrite is the main component of any Mingxiao Lantern.

introduced.name: Xiao Market
introduced.how: street market whose profits fund the Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: Almost every business in Liyue has a booth at the annual Xiao Market

introduced.name: Skybracer
introduced.how: adeptus whose story inspires this year's Mingxiao Lantern, shown as a giant deer
introduced.quote: This year's Mingxiao Lantern is dedicated to Skybracer...

introduced.name: Mt. Tianheng
introduced.how: mountain that still stands because Skybracer propped it up with his antlers
introduced.quote: Thanks to him, Mt. Tianheng still stands tall and proud to this day.

introduced.name: Bishui River
introduced.how: river said to have formed from Skybracer's blood
introduced.quote: And the blood that he lost in the battle turned into the Bishui River.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: Liyue government body overseeing the festival and funding most of its costs
introduced.quote: Hold up! This is the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: cross-border criminal organization whose symbol the suspect left behind
introduced.quote: This is the symbol of the cross-border criminal organization you know as the Treasure Hoarders.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: inn near Liyue Harbor with a view of the Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: If you're looking for somewhere to stay, I suggest you go to the Wangshu Inn.

introduced.name: Guili Plains
introduced.how: wilderness where elderly flightless people use Plaustrite to stay airborne
introduced.quote: In Guili Plains, old who have lost the power of flight use to keep themselves airborne.

introduced.name: Azurite
introduced.how: rare blue variety of Plaustrite that the festival lacks
introduced.quote: (Actually, they're just blue and red varieties of Plaustrite... Gemstone merchants only gave them fancy names to try and impress their customers...)

introduced.name: Vermillionite
introduced.how: rare red variety of Plaustrite that the festival lacks
introduced.quote: (Actually, they're just blue and red varieties of Plaustrite... Gemstone merchants only gave them fancy names to try and impress their customers...)

introduced.name: Letter to the Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: anonymous letter received by the Treasure Hoarders' Liyue branch
introduced.quote: Also, the Treasure Hoarders' organization in Liyue recently received an anonymous letter.

introduced.name: Nimrod
introduced.how: Kaeya's undercover informant inside the Treasure Hoarders
introduced.quote: I can put you in touch with an informant on the inside.

introduced.name: Bei'er
introduced.how: a petty Treasure Hoarder who admits the gang is no serious threat
introduced.quote: As you well know, we Treasure Hoarders are no serious threat to anyone.

introduced.name: Changchang
introduced.how: a young girl who donated her ragdoll Dolly to the Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: I'm Changchang, I just donated Dolly. She's my ragdoll.

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: a small-time Liyue merchant who hints the floating city may be real
introduced.quote: I'm just a small-time merchant anyway, I don't deal in rare and exotic treasures.

introduced.name: Verr Goldet
introduced.how: innkeeper who explains the festival and its lantern meaning
introduced.quote: Lantern Rite is nearly here, why don't we decorate the inn this year...

introduced.name: Madame Ping
introduced.how: storyteller who recounts Skybracer's sacrifice
introduced.quote: Whether you believe the story or not, I'm just happy you're willing to listen to me tell it.

introduced.name: Wang'ya
introduced.how: Liyue official helping run the festival and its stalls
introduced.quote: I'm just taking care of a few small things.

introduced.name: Jiangzhou
introduced.how: official tracking construction of the Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: I'm Jiangzhou. Recently, I've been tracking progress on the construction of the Mingxiao Lantern.

introduced.name: Jingming
introduced.how: craftsman who teaches how to make Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: I'll be happy to teach you. There's no one way to make a Xiao Lantern

introduced.name: Jiayi
introduced.how: Ministry of Civil Affairs official who handles the festival's security reports
introduced.quote: Hold up! This is the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Xinghuo
introduced.how: officer in charge of keeping the Lantern Rite safe
introduced.quote: I'm in charge of keeping the Lantern Rite safe.

introduced.name: Yi'nian
introduced.how: cook running a food stall with Grilled Tiger Fish
introduced.quote: Ah, customers. Take a look and decide for yourself.

introduced.name: Huai'an
introduced.how: Verr Goldet's companion who builds a stall below the inn and plans the feast
introduced.quote: I'd go as far as to say, it'd be easier bringing the festival to him than the other way around...

introduced.name: Ruijin
introduced.how: inventor who runs a tabletop game stall
introduced.quote: Theater Mechanicus is a kind of tabletop game invented by yours truly.

introduced.name: Theater Mechanicus
introduced.how: tabletop game invented by Ruijin, played for a Xiao Lantern
introduced.quote: Theater Mechanicus is a kind of tabletop game invented by yours truly.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: could you... try to convince Xiao to go with you?

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Well, well, long time no see, !

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: the very essence of Rex Lapis' divine power

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: you ought to be looking forward to Mondstadt's Ludi Harpastum.

assumed.name: Pervases
assumed.quote: That's the one Pervases loved to eat, isn't it?

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius certainly does not have dealings with its enemies.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Liyue has the adepti looking after it, doesn't it?

assumed.name: Ruin Hunters
assumed.quote: Don't go looking for Ruin Hunters unprepared though, they can be quite deadly.

assumed.name: Windrise
assumed.quote: A little later, make your way over to Windrise.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: If it gets any busier over there, I'm going to have to bring the Millelith to keep things orderly.

assumed.name: Smiley Yanxiao
assumed.quote: I'll have a word with Smiley Yanxiao.

threads.claim: A fabled floating city in the clouds may actually exist.
threads.quote: It's big enough to make you wonder... if the fabled floating city in the clouds really does exist...

threads.claim: Skybracer's sacrifice saved the mountains and the villagers, though the story's truth is left open.
threads.quote: He used those blood-drenched antlers as a wedge to prop up the mountain.

threads.claim: Xiao has a long past of slaughter and suffering that makes him shun the festival.
threads.quote: Too long have I spent slaughtering, accompanied by the burden of suffering that follows in its wake.

threads.claim: Xiao refuses to attend the Lantern Rite, keeping his distance from the crowds.
threads.quote: I have no interest in Lantern Rite.

threads.claim: Xiao finally agrees to join a miniature festival held below the inn.
threads.quote: So be it. I shall accept your proposal.

threads.claim: Xiao senses a malign influence threatening the festival.
threads.quote: I sensed a malign influence here. I'm here to investigate.

threads.claim: An anonymous letter has reached the Treasure Hoarders and may be part of a plot.
threads.quote: Also, the Treasure Hoarders' organization in Liyue recently received an anonymous letter.

threads.claim: Kaeya secretly keeps an informant inside the Treasure Hoarders, a link to his own loyalties.
threads.quote: This is my own personal informant. Nothing to do with the Knights of Favonius.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders are unlikely to be behind the festival threat, according to their informant.
threads.quote: I do not think this is the work of the Treasure Hoarders.

threads.claim: Highly flammable festival supplies may be targeted by someone up to no good.
threads.quote: All highly flammable materials!

threads.claim: The suspicious person was a thief after the Plaustrite, not an arsonist.
threads.quote: I just wanted to nab me the biggest chunk of Plaustrite in twenty years is all...

threads.claim: The letter's sender turns out to be a lowly apprentice thief who admires the Treasure Hoarders.
threads.quote: I'm just a lowly apprentice thief who really looks up to the Treasure Hoarders...

threads.claim: Wishes carved onto Plaustrite and given to the Lantern Rite are believed to come true.
threads.quote: Dolly's wish will come true now, won't it?

threads.claim: Lanterns are believed to guide bygone heroes back to their homeland.
threads.quote: We believe they act as the beacons in the night, guiding bygone heroes back to their homeland.

introduced.name: Tiantian
introduced.how: A Guild member who designs a gliding track using Xiao Lanterns and asks the Traveler to test it
introduced.quote: Simply put, I wanted to use some Xiao Lanterns to mark out a gliding track.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: A lantern with a bamboo frame and rock insides that floats into the sky after being released with a wish
introduced.quote: Xiao Lanterns have bamboo frames and insides made of rocks. They float in the sky after release.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite
introduced.how: A festival in which people release Xiao Lanterns and make wishes
introduced.quote: We send Xiao Lanterns because we'd like for everyone to be able to release one and make their own wishes.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Uniformed guards who keep order and keep the city safe during the celebrations
introduced.quote: There are still essential workers who can't just take a break — for example, those in charge of keeping order during the celebration, like the Millelith.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: An office that coordinates festival work and sends gifts to the Millelith
introduced.quote: The Ministry of Civil Affairs usually sends them gifts to acknowledge their hard work around the Lantern Rite season

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: A pharmacy whose medicine demand peaks during the Lantern Rite as people overeat
introduced.quote: The number of people requiring medicine from Bubu Pharmacy always peaks during the Lantern Rite period.

introduced.name: Herbalist Gui
introduced.how: A pharmacist at Bubu Pharmacy who asks the Traveler to deliver medicine and later wants to release a lantern
introduced.quote: Traveler, if it's alright with you, could you help me deliver some medicine?

introduced.name: Qiqi
introduced.how: A Bubu Pharmacy worker who went out to gather herbs and has a poor memory
introduced.quote: Qiqi went out to gather some herbs and still isn't back yet...

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: A doctor at Bubu Pharmacy who is busy with medical research
introduced.quote: As for Dr. Baizhu, I think he's probably doing some medical research or something else of that nature.

introduced.name: Guanhai
introduced.how: A man with indigestion who boasts of his strong stomach and drinking
introduced.quote: I'll have you know that I have an iron stomach

introduced.name: Wang'ya
introduced.how: A Ministry of Civil Affairs staffer who coordinates Xiao Lantern deliveries and is overworked
introduced.quote: it's my turn this year to coordinate the Xiao Lantern delivery.

introduced.name: Qingzhou
introduced.how: A famous poet who makes lantern riddles for children in Qingce Village
introduced.quote: Qingzhou... Do you mean that famous poet?

introduced.name: Mr. Bohuan
introduced.how: A calligrapher invited to Qingce Village to write on Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: My calligraphy is actually in great demand.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: A village now home mostly to elderly people and children, far from Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.quote: Especially for the children and elderly folks who live in Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Zhi
introduced.how: A Qingce Village resident who prepares herbal remedies each year and asks for help gathering herbs
introduced.quote: I always like to prepare a little more medicine than usual around this time each year.

introduced.name: Lantern Riddle
introduced.how: A riddle written on a Xiao Lantern; whoever solves it gets the lantern
introduced.quote: Each Xiao Lantern has a short riddle inscribed upon it. The person who solves the riddle can take the lantern it was written on.

introduced.name: Cai Le
introduced.how: A Millelith soldier whose Xiao Lantern got stuck in a tree and who asks for help retrieving it
introduced.quote: I'm just wondering how to climb up that tree and retrieve that Xiao Lantern.

introduced.name: Siyu
introduced.how: A woman who wants to send a Xiao Lantern to her childhood playmate Wrench Wang
introduced.quote: So, I'd like to give him a Xiao Lantern as a gift.

introduced.name: Wrench Wang
introduced.how: A hardworking man known as The Wrench, childhood playmate of Siyu, who overworks himself during the festival
introduced.quote: Even now, he helps me out all the time — he's almost like a real brother to me.

introduced.name: Hammer Li
introduced.how: Wrench Wang's friend who cooks meals for him and worries about his overwork
introduced.quote: I'll be preparing some food in a bit.

introduced.name: Iron Ingot
introduced.how: A young man who wants to win Ziwei over with a poem written on a Xiao Lantern
introduced.quote: I've even been learning how to write poetry, too.

introduced.name: Ziwei
introduced.how: A stargazer who names constellations and wants to watch the stars away from the lanterns
introduced.quote: The Xiao Lanterns are so bright that they obstruct my view of the stars.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: owner of Wanmin Restaurant, busy feeding festival crowds
introduced.quote: What am I doing? Why, I'm running Wanmin Restaurant, of course! Haha.

introduced.name: Xiangling
introduced.how: Chef Mao's daughter, who has returned to help the restaurant
introduced.quote: Once Xiangling gets back, we can release the lantern together as father and daughter.

introduced.name: Atsuko
introduced.how: a girl from Inazuma living by the docks, waiting on a food delivery
introduced.quote: She's the girl from Inazuma down by the docks.

introduced.name: Guanhai
introduced.how: dock worker who loves fish and is working through the festival
introduced.quote: I really love the taste of fish.

introduced.name: Zhihua
introduced.how: dock worker who plans to release Xiao Lanterns with Qiming
introduced.quote: As soon as I'm finished with work, I'll go release Xiao Lanterns with Qiming...

introduced.name: Wrench Wang
introduced.how: overworked dock worker who partners with Hammer Li
introduced.quote: I'll never finish all this work...

introduced.name: Hammer Li
introduced.how: dock worker who wants a rest to enjoy the festival
introduced.quote: Let's finish this up so we can finally have a rest and enjoy the festival...

introduced.name: Huangshan
introduced.how: hired guard who escorts cargo outside the city and rarely celebrates
introduced.quote: You up for an escort job?

introduced.name: Francis
introduced.how: a merchant from Fontaine who ordered a large batch of Xiao Lantern goods
introduced.quote: His name is Fran, uh... Francis.

introduced.name: Mr. Zhu
introduced.how: innkeeper struggling to attract guests during the festival
introduced.quote: First, I need to get the inn squared away for more guests.

introduced.name: Dummy
introduced.how: helper at Mr. Zhu's inn who makes Xiao Lanterns from materials
introduced.quote: just give them to Dummy and he'll take care of the rest.

introduced.name: Minghua Bank
introduced.how: a bank whose employee and companion are travelling during the festival
introduced.quote: That's right, this lady is from Minghua Bank, and I'm one of the bank employees.

introduced.name: Huachu
introduced.how: a traveller who is homesick and journeys with Jianqiu
introduced.quote: I'm afraid she feels a little homesick...

introduced.name: Mengmeng
introduced.how: a child who wants to make a Xiao Lantern for her friend Yu
introduced.quote: Xiao Lanterns are soooo hard to make...

introduced.name: Yu
introduced.how: a boy who minds his family's tea shop and has no time to play
introduced.quote: Yu always has to look after the tea shop, so he never has any time to play or to make a lantern.

introduced.name: Freki
introduced.how: a Mondstadter in Liyue who wants to release a lantern and scatter dandelion seeds
introduced.quote: Oh, it's you, Traveler. And yes, we were thinking about doing just that.

introduced.name: Geri
introduced.how: Freki's Mondstadter companion who wants to catch the festive spirit
introduced.quote: W—Well, yes! I mean, you have to immerse yourself in the festive spirit first, then eat some festive food.

introduced.name: Linling
introduced.how: a poet who writes literary wishes for Xiao Lanterns for patrons
introduced.quote: I'm helping some people think of suitable things to write on their Xiao Lanterns.

introduced.name: Degui
introduced.how: a drink seller whose festive wish is written by Linling
introduced.quote: I know him best by the drinks he sells in his shop...

introduced.name: Bibo
introduced.how: a seller involved in mysterious business, who gets a verse from Linling
introduced.quote: I've heard that he's always involved in some mysterious business, but he's quite a nice guy...

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: shop worker who is short-staffed as many people leave for the city
introduced.quote: Lots of people have headed back to the city to spend the festive period there, so we're short-staffed.

introduced.name: Verr Goldet
introduced.how: a boss who knows about the lonely child Dusky Ming
introduced.quote: But I do feel bad for that child.

introduced.name: Dusky Ming
introduced.how: a lonely child who starts trouble at festive times and plays hide-and-seek in the woods
introduced.quote: Whenever a festive period rolled along in the past, she'd get lonelier as the inn grew livelier.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: an elderly Qingce Village resident who organizes the village's festival
introduced.quote: The Lantern Rite is here once again...

introduced.name: Ms. Bai
introduced.how: a young woman preparing a large festival feast in Qingce Village
introduced.quote: The young lady said that she wanted to prepare a table full of food for everyone

introduced.name: Pops Kai
introduced.how: a shopkeeper who supplies tables and chairs for the village feast
introduced.quote: I never expected that you'd come all the way here to help me.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: a village whose elderly residents are left behind as young workers leave
introduced.quote: But in Qingce Village, the elderly are too old and the young are too young.

introduced.name: Dandelion Seeds
introduced.how: seeds that must be scattered from high ground to fly far, a Mondstadt custom
introduced.quote: Dandelion Seeds need to be scattered from a high vantage point to fly far, but Liyue's architecture is very different from Mondstadt's

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: lanterns Liyue people release during the festival, carrying written wishes
introduced.quote: We native of Liyue have a tradition of releasing Xiao Lanterns during the Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite
introduced.how: a festival in Liyue when people go out, eat, and release lanterns
introduced.quote: Things have been getting busy with everyone going out to eat during the Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.how: a large lantern released in the city during the festival that people want to see
introduced.quote: They'll release the Mingxiao Lantern in the city

introduced.name: Transport Balloon
introduced.how: a cargo balloon carrying fragile lantern-making materials
introduced.quote: so you just need to escort this one Transport Balloon.

introduced.name: Ms. Bai
introduced.how: Runs the family tofu mill in Qingce Village after inheriting it from her late father
introduced.quote: I inherited the mill when my father passed away.

introduced.name: Qingzhou
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a poet who is also seeking inspiration for a poem about the Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: My name is Qingzhou, my liege. I might add that I consider myself a poet, if I may be so bold.

introduced.name: Vermeer
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a painter trying to depict Liyue Harbor during the Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: Well, I'm a painter and I'm looking for some scenic spots nearby to help give me some inspiration.

introduced.name: Jiangcheng
introduced.how: Elderly villager who once made Xiao Lanterns and seems confused about his memory and his wife
introduced.quote: Do you remember, Dear? I used to make great Xiao Lanterns back in the day.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: Remote village far from the city, mostly inhabited by children and the elderly
introduced.quote: It's pretty far off from the city. Most of the villagers are either children or the elderly.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: Each year sends a representative to bring essentials to Qingce Village and recovers Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: So each year around the Lantern Rite, the Ministry of Civil Affairs delegates a representative to bring them some essentials.

introduced.name: Mr. Bohuan
introduced.how: Described as a calligrapher who could help villagers write wishes on Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: He's a pretty good calligrapher.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: Introduced as the person in charge of the village
introduced.quote: Let's go ask the person in charge around here.

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: The chef at Wangshu Inn who is overwhelmed during the festival
introduced.quote: Ha, that chef is a thoughtful man indeed.

introduced.name: Jiangxue
introduced.how: A man who usually fishes near Wangshu Inn and has a past with Yanxiao
introduced.quote: He can usually be found fishing near the inn.

introduced.name: Hongyu
introduced.how: Assigned by the Ministry to collect Xiao Lanterns that break or get stuck after the festival
introduced.quote: So the Ministry of Civil Affairs usually delegates the responsibility of recovering Xiao Lanterns to a specific person.

introduced.name: Plaustrite
introduced.how: Material inside a Xiao Lantern that can scatter when a poorly made lantern breaks mid-air
introduced.quote: If its lampshade is poorly made, a lantern will break mid-air, leaving only a chunk of Plaustrite that flies all over the place.

introduced.name: Skybracer
introduced.how: A past adeptus said to be the model for this year's Mingxiao Lantern and believed dead
introduced.quote: I've heard that this year's Mingxiao Lantern is modeled after an adeptus named Skybracer.

introduced.name: Mt. Tianheng
introduced.how: Mountain legendarily held up by Skybracer's antlers, now full of monsters
introduced.quote: it has been stated that this adeptus once held Mt. Tianheng up with their own antlers.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Named as an adeptus who fought alongside Skybracer in a legendary battle at Mt. Tianheng
introduced.quote: this adeptus also fought alongside Rex Lapis for a time.

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: Former clan whose disciples once released lanterns together, now nearly gone
introduced.quote: We would craft our lanterns, then an older disciple would bring us here.

introduced.name: Sun Yu
introduced.how: A Guhua disciple trying to revive the clan and who asks the Traveler for lantern materials
introduced.quote: my junior and I were just considering the matter of releasing a Xiao Lantern.

introduced.name: Zhiruo
introduced.how: A former Guhua disciple who remembers the clan's lantern release spot and reveals she left the clan
introduced.quote: None but the members of the Guhua Clan know of this spot, and yet your faces are unfamiliar...

introduced.name: Guhua Clan's demise
introduced.how: The Guhua Clan has ended, and few or no disciples remain
introduced.quote: Sadly, the Clan has since met its demise.

introduced.name: Cor Lapis
introduced.how: Powdered ingredient that makes ink characters shine gold
introduced.quote: Powdered Cor Lapis dissolved in ink makes the characters shine with the most radiant shade of gold.

introduced.name: Qingxin
introduced.how: Flower juice that gives ink a flowery fragrance, also used to scent Xiao Lanterns
introduced.quote: Qingxin juice, on the other hand, adds a delicate, flowery fragrance to the natural scent of ink.

introduced.name: Pyro Whopperflower Nectar
introduced.how: Nectar gathered from a Pyro Whopperflower and used to mix special paint
introduced.quote: Oh, I'll need you to collect Whopperflower Nectar from a Pyro Whopperflower.

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern release tradition
introduced.how: During the Lantern Rite, people release Xiao Lanterns and often write wishes on them
introduced.quote: It's a tradition to release Xiao Lanterns during Liyue's Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Lantern riddles
introduced.how: Riddles written on Xiao Lanterns that children try to solve during the festival
introduced.quote: It's nothing, really. I just came up with some lantern riddles to entertain these kids.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: the Guild was looking to hitch a ride on the festive cheer

assumed.name: Wind Glider
assumed.quote: open up their wind glider and follow the Xiao Lanterns as they fly

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: take in the beautiful sights of Liyue

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: For Archon's sake... How do I get there?

assumed.name: Vermeer
assumed.quote: What about your competition with Vermeer?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: I'll be thankful to Rex Lapis already.

assumed.name: Mr. Adeptus
assumed.quote: I wonder if Mr. Adeptus will come to Lantern Rite...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Back in Mondstadt, we'd tell the dandelions what was on our minds

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I wonder how things are back in Inazuma...

assumed.name: Qiming
assumed.quote: I'll go release Xiao Lanterns with Qiming...

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Ugh, why are the hilichurls being such a pain?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: monsters and Treasure Hoarders pass this way from time to time, too.

assumed.name: Samachurl
assumed.quote: There's a samachurl on that slope!

assumed.name: Dusky Ming's past incident
assumed.quote: She's been quite well-behaved since that incident.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: The city folk from Liyue Harbor often come to the village just to buy our Tofu.

assumed.name: Wang'ya
assumed.quote: Traveler? What a coincidence! I didn't expect you to be here...

assumed.name: Wangshu Inn
assumed.quote: I shall await your presence at Wangshu Inn once you have completed your... painting.

assumed.name: Yuhua
assumed.quote: Where's that Yuhua run off to...

assumed.name: Rex Lapis and the adepti
assumed.quote: The tales say that Rex Lapis and many adepti took part in that battle, and very nearly caused Mt. Tianheng to collapse.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Liyue is large and its households are many.

threads.claim: A riddle-related phrase called the Verses of Equilibrium is raised as an unexplained mystery.
threads.quote: But what the heck are the "Verses of Equilibrium"...

threads.claim: Qingzhou is stuck in a competition with the painter Vermeer and cannot find inspiration.
threads.quote: But no matter where I look, I cannot seem to find even an ounce of inspiration.

threads.claim: Young people have left Qingce Village for unexplained reasons, leaving mostly elderly and children.
threads.quote: For a variety of reasons, most of the young people from Qingce Village have moved to Liyue Harbor, leaving only the old people and young children behind.

threads.claim: Wang'ya is unable to go home to her family during the festival, hinting at a theme of separation from family.
threads.quote: But as for me... Haha, I'm a bit of an exception. I don't get to go home during the festive period.

threads.claim: Wrench Wang made the same wish last year, suggesting an unresolved personal burden.
threads.quote: He made the same wish last year as well...

threads.claim: Ziwei dislikes the Xiao Lanterns because they block her view of the stars, a hint of her preference for solitude.
threads.quote: The Xiao Lanterns are so bright that they obstruct my view of the stars.

threads.claim: Dusky Ming is a lonely child whose festival behaviour has caused trouble before, hinting at a deeper story.
threads.quote: Whenever a festive period rolled along in the past, she'd get lonelier as the inn grew livelier.

threads.claim: A lantern hung in the woods by the player disappears, adding an eerie unexplained element to Dusky Ming's hide-and-seek.
threads.quote: L—Look! That lantern is gone!

threads.claim: Mr. Zhu wonders whether the Minghua Bank travellers are connected to something bigger, leaving their identity unclear.
threads.quote: Hmm... was it Minghua Bank you said? Does that mean—

threads.claim: The travellers seem lost and uncertain of their route, and their attire is odd, suggesting they are not ordinary guests.
threads.quote: When I met them earlier, it was clear from their expressions that they didn't know which way to go.

threads.claim: Huachu doubts her Xiao Lantern wish will ever come true, hinting at a sorrowful reason for her journey.
threads.quote: I don't know if it could ever come true.

threads.claim: Villagers talk of Mr. Adeptus as someone they hope will attend the festival, raising an open question about who he is.
threads.quote: If we release enough Xiao Lanterns, maybe Mr. Adeptus will come...

threads.claim: Several characters feel homesick during the festival, showing that many people are far from home.
threads.quote: All the festivities for Lantern Rite have been making me feel a little homesick...

threads.claim: Freki postpones any return to Mondstadt, leaving the Mondstadters' homecoming an open question.
threads.quote: Let's leave it a while longer. It wasn't that long ago that we left...

threads.claim: Young workers have left Qingce Village for the city, leaving the village's festivals thin and the elderly lonely.
threads.quote: All those young workers that have since flocked to the big city

threads.claim: Traveler doubts that Mr. Zhu's inn can see the Mingxiao Lantern, hinting that the innkeeper's promise is false.
threads.quote: There's no way you'll be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here...

threads.claim: Legends say Skybracer held Mt. Tianheng up with antlers, which may be a real event worth investigating.
threads.quote: Local legends hold that Skybracer held Mt. Tianheng up with their own antlers...

threads.claim: The soil at Mt. Tianheng shows nothing special, so the antler legend remains unconfirmed.
threads.quote: As I thought, legends are just that, legends... Or has so much time passed since that battle that all traces of it have long since vanished?

threads.claim: An unknown person left a Xiao Lantern with a wish for world peace at the Mt. Tianheng site, hinting at someone who knows the legends.
threads.quote: May all the world be at peace.

threads.claim: Sun Yu hopes to revive the Guhua Clan, which implies it has declined.
threads.quote: It falls on us to revive the Guhua Clan to its former glory.

threads.claim: Zhiruo reveals that the Guhua Clan's lantern gatherings once drew lanterns from across the mountain, but the clan has since dwindled.
threads.quote: When I left the Guhua Clan, there were barely any disciples left.

threads.claim: Zhiruo describes how Xiao Lanterns from the whole mountain once merged in the sky during Guhua releases.
threads.quote: Back then... Xiao Lanterns from all over the mountain would merge into one in the sky.

threads.claim: A talented young Guhua disciple vanished, and Zhiruo has given up on his return.
threads.quote: But he was difficult to track down, and no one would see a glimpse of him for long periods...

threads.claim: Sun Yu evades Little Que'er's questions about his relationship with Zhiruo, suggesting something unspoken between them.
threads.quote: Brother, you and Zhiruo... what's your relationship, exactly?

threads.claim: Little Que'er's sudden headache seems to be a convenient excuse to avoid the climb, which raises doubts about her motives.
threads.quote: Uh, I've got a headache coming on.

threads.claim: Jiangcheng's memory is failing, and he seems to mix up the Traveler with his absent wife.
threads.quote: Eh... When was that? ...Dear, perhaps you remember...

threads.claim: Ms. Bai's father has died, and she continues his mill and lantern traditions out of nostalgia.
threads.quote: I often recall the many things that my father used to tell me, especially during this time of the year...

threads.claim: Ms. Bai hopes her late father can see the Xiao Lantern she releases.
threads.quote: But I hope... he'll be able to see it.

threads.claim: The poet questions whether Liyue's grandeur can be captured in any painting or poem.
threads.quote: Furthermore, could the grandeur of a land as magnificent as Liyue ever possibly be captured in a painting?

threads.claim: Qingzhou concludes that the festival itself may be the poem he sought, so the competition ends in a draw.
threads.quote: Perhaps... this experience is the very poem I sought.

threads.claim: Hongyu questions whether the endless cycle of releasing and recovering Xiao Lanterns has any point.
threads.quote: Am I the only one who sees no point in this?

threads.claim: Jiangxue and Yanxiao have a shared past, and Yanxiao has changed since they first met.
threads.quote: He's... changed a great deal since our initial meeting.

threads.claim: Jiangxue admits he still cannot fully let go of something from the past.
threads.quote: Time slips by, and yet here I am, still unable to wholly let go.

introduced.name: Vigee
introduced.how: Runs the interactive woven scroll game and offers it to the Traveler
introduced.quote: Do you want to try out this interactive woven scroll I've created with the children?

introduced.quote: Simply put, it's a game that combines Liyue's paper theater, Inazuma's comics, and Fontaine's film technology.
