introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera that Paimon presents as a legendary old model used for taking photos
introduced.quote: Paimon: According to the mysterious shopkeeper, this was the Kamera used by that super famous Fontainian photographer from a few decades ago: the legendary Pierre Leblanc!

introduced.name: Pierre Leblanc
introduced.how: a famous Fontainian photographer from a few decades ago whose Kamera is the gift
introduced.quote: Paimon: According to the mysterious shopkeeper, this was the Kamera used by that super famous Fontainian photographer from a few decades ago: the legendary Pierre Leblanc!

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: a newspaper whose front page often featured photos taken by Leblanc
introduced.quote: Paimon: Rumor has it that the photos he took with this Kamera were all smash hits, and they'd often make it onto the front page of The Steambird!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: If you use this legendary Kamera, your photos will be like... doubly legendary! And then we can sell them for Mora!

assumed.name: Earlier journey through other nations
assumed.quote: Now that we've arrived in a new nation, let's put this Kamera to good use

threads.claim: The Kamera's origin is doubted, raising the question of whether it was obtained from shady merchants.
threads.quote: Traveler: You didn't run into any shady merchants, did you, Paimon?

threads.claim: An engineer's check and an engraving with Leblanc's initials confirm the Kamera really belonged to Leblanc.
threads.quote: Paimon: But wait, there's more! When the engineer opened it up, they found a tiny engraving inside with Leblanc's initials! That's hard evidence right there, hehe!

threads.claim: Leblanc is presented as a legendary master photographer whom the Traveler is measured against.
threads.quote: Are we any closer to getting the better of the legendary Pierre Leblanc?

threads.claim: Photos are framed as carriers of irreplaceable shared memories between the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: Traveler: There's a memory behind every picture.

threads.claim: Paimon and the Traveler promise to keep making memories together on future adventures.
threads.quote: Yeah! It's a promise, then! Our next photo album will be bigger, better, and full of even more special memories!

introduced.name: Turenna
introduced.how: a Special Patrol Garde who reviews the Traveler's foreign companions and supports the event
introduced.quote: Turenna: Thank you for your cooperation. The review has been completed, and your companions are all very safe.

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: a foreign merchant and Fungi caretaker hosting the game preview, who was once met by the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Paimon: Are you... Haniyyah? The same Haniyyah who's been taking care of Bongo-Head and the other Fungi for us?

introduced.name: Souka
introduced.how: a light novelist helping Haniyyah run the Fungi game and take care of the Fungi
introduced.quote: Paimon: Souka? Isn't that the light novelist who's been following you to gather material and helping you take care of the Fungi after being defeated by us?

introduced.name: Enghiene
introduced.how: Turenna's former drillmaster who loves the squishy Fungi and challenges the Traveler
introduced.quote: Enghiene: I'm Enghiene, and I was Turenna's drillmaster before she entered the Special Patrol!

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: the species Enghiene belongs to
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uh, so this super arrogant Melusine... used to be Turenna's drillmaster?

introduced.name: Special Patrol
introduced.how: the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol that Turenna recently joined as a newbie
introduced.quote: Turenna: As a newbie in the Special Patrol, I'm obligated to monitor foreign creatures, provide the highest levels of assistance to special guests

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: an executive agency funded by tax money that employs the Gardes
introduced.quote: Turenna: I—It can't be helped! The Maison is an executive agency funded by tax money, so of course the pay wouldn't be that high...

introduced.name: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
introduced.how: a past Sumeru tournament where the Traveler defeated Haniyyah and became its decision-maker
introduced.quote: ???: A long time ago, the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament was held in Sumeru. I participated with some prejudiced thoughts and the intent to do something dangerous...

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: foreign species whose presence in Fontaine is carefully reviewed by the authorities
introduced.quote: Turenna: The Maison Gardiennage rarely comes into contact with foreign Fungi species, so proceeding with caution was necessary.

introduced.name: Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta
introduced.how: a tabletop-based preview game that Haniyyah and Souka are testing in Fontaine
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon sorta gets it now... So the preview event, Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, is this tabletop game?

introduced.name: Fungus Mechanicus
introduced.how: an earlier tabletop game where players direct Fungi to defeat the Mechanici
introduced.quote: Haniyyah: In Fungus Mechanicus, you'd direct your Fungi to defeat all the Mechanici.

assumed.name: Golden Comet and Silver Companion
assumed.quote: Haniyyah: Yeah, that's me! Long time no see, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!

assumed.name: Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces
assumed.quote: Turenna: You're Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces after all, and Miss Haniyyah is an important foreign merchant, so you can just leave any odd jobs to ordinary Gardes!

assumed.name: Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hehe, Paimon was right! That's Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy!

threads.claim: Fontaine has a formal law and review process governing foreign species such as the Fungi.
threads.quote: Turenna: As stated in the Fontaine Foreign Species Management Act and the Quartier Lyonnais Code of Business Conduct, you may proceed with your event.

threads.claim: Rumors about the Golden Comet and Silver Companion are circulating in Fontaine.
threads.quote: Turenna: If the rumored Golden Comet and Silver Companion are spotted, the Gardes will notify them and ask them to meet you here...

threads.claim: The rumored Golden Comet and Silver Companion turn out to be the Traveler and Paimon, who arrive on the spot.
threads.quote: ???: Ah, it seems that won't be necessary anymore. They are already here.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon have forgotten an earlier meeting with Haniyyah, whom they barely recognize.
threads.quote: ???: Hmm... Your failure to remember me is my mistake. I should have done my best to maintain contact and sent a few more letters.

threads.claim: Paimon recognizes Haniyyah as the caretaker of the Fungi, confirming she is the same person from the past.
threads.quote: Paimon: Are you... Haniyyah? The same Haniyyah who's been taking care of Bongo-Head and the other Fungi for us?

threads.claim: The Nilotpala Cup changed Haniyyah, and the Traveler became the tournament's ultimate decision-maker.
threads.quote: ???: After the event, you became the ultimate decision-maker of the tournament, and I promised that I would do my best to continue running the event...

threads.claim: Haniyyah once hated Fungi but was persuaded by the Traveler to seek coexistence with them.
threads.quote: ???: You woke me up and made me change. You helped me stop hating my kind, Fungi buddies and seek the right path toward coexisting with them.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon prefer to wander freely and refuse to settle into a fixed job, a stance Haniyyah says they hold to travel Teyvat.
threads.quote: Paimon doesn't want to be woken up early in the morning and made to work either... It's best to stay free and go wherever our feet might take us.

introduced.name: Ulman
introduced.how: A treasure hunter who recruits the Traveler to partner with him and his Seelie
introduced.quote: Oh, so it's you, Traveler... It's nothing, just a small problem.

introduced.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
introduced.how: A Seelie that guides its partner to treasure, found by Ulman trapped in a ruin
introduced.quote: I picked this fellow up inside a ruin.

introduced.name: Treasure-hunting with the Seelie
introduced.how: The Seelie does not reveal treasure's exact spot; it twinkles to hint whether treasure is near or far
introduced.quote: It won't lead you to the spot where treasure is hidden, but it will give you hints as to whether treasure is nearby or far away.

introduced.name: Iron Coins
introduced.how: An ancient currency that most merchants refuse, exchangeable with Ulman for rewards scaled to the amount held
introduced.quote: Most merchants won't take this ancient currency, but you can give them to me instead.

introduced.name: Ulman's companions
introduced.how: Greedy associates Ulman distrusts and does not want to work with
introduced.quote: Bunch of greedy churls, they are.

introduced.name: Treasure map book
introduced.how: A book from Ulman marking locations he believes hold treasure, based on his research
introduced.quote: The locations marked out in this book most certainly have treasure

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: Well, this Treasure-Seeking Seelie is different. from other Seelie...

assumed.name: Seelie communications
assumed.quote: I'm no expert in Seelie communications...

threads.claim: The Seelie has stopped attending to Ulman and seems to be seeking a new partner.
threads.quote: If you ask me... I think it's looking for a new partner.

threads.claim: The Seelie reacted strongly to the Traveler on sight while ignoring Ulman's companions.
threads.quote: this Treasure-Seeking Seelie took a real shine to you the moment it saw you.

threads.claim: The reason the Seelie stopped paying Ulman attention is unexplained.
threads.quote: But for whatever reason, the Seelie's stopped paying me any mind as of late.

threads.claim: The Seelie stopped listening to Ulman before he could recover the treasures his book marks.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie stopped listening to me before I could find these treasures.

threads.claim: Ulman has undisclosed uses for the ancient Iron Coins.
threads.quote: I have my uses for them.

threads.claim: Treasure hunters are portrayed as greedy and untrustworthy.
threads.quote: Bunch of greedy churls, they are.

introduced.name: Ulman
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a treasure-hunter who once teamed up with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Ulman: Come on, it's me, Ulman! We teamed up to look for treasure before, remember?

introduced.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
introduced.how: Learns these Seelie are companions of treasure-seekers and help them find buried treasure
introduced.quote: Ulman: A treasure-Seeking Seelie, to be precise. As the name suggests, they are the best buddies of people who seek treasure.

introduced.name: Iron Coins
introduced.how: Learns Iron Coins are ancient currency that buyers pay for, and that they are found buried as treasure
introduced.quote: Ulman: If you find any of that ancient currency, please bring them to me.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: Learns Inazuma is a closed country that outsiders must sneak into
introduced.quote: Ulman: But of course, Inazuma's a closed country, right?

introduced.name: Ulman's shipwreck
introduced.how: Learns Ulman's boat was struck by lightning on the way to Inazuma and he washed ashore
introduced.quote: Ulman: And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Ulman: I had them sold off and made a tidy sum of Mora myself... Hehe. Thanks for that, by the way.

assumed.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie from the first partnership
assumed.quote: Ulman: ...Right, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie! You remember that at least, right?

threads.claim: Ulman jokingly suspects he attracts Seelie, a pattern that may have a deeper cause.
threads.quote: Ulman: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?

threads.claim: Ulman suspects something on his person may be what draws the Seelie to him.
threads.quote: Ulman: Or maybe there's something on my person that attracts them? I don't really get it either...

threads.claim: A Seelie unexpectedly stops helping its partner after finding a few treasure sites, for reasons no one understands.
threads.quote: Ulman: But for reasons I can't understand, it just decided to quit on me after finding a few treasure sites.

threads.claim: Another Seelie also tires of searching and keeps circling Ulman instead of working.
threads.quote: Ulman: But like the previous bunch, it also got tired after searching a few sites with treasures in them, and now it just circles around me over and over...

threads.claim: The weather near Inazuma grows unnaturally violent, with lightning striking ships approaching the country.
threads.quote: Ulman: *sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...

threads.claim: Inazuma is closed to outsiders, yet people still find ways in.
threads.quote: Ulman: But of course, Inazuma's a closed country, right?

threads.claim: Ulman got into Inazuma through unexplained contacts who arranged a boat for him.
threads.quote: Ulman: Now, where was I? Right. So I made arrangements with those "friends" of mine and got my hands on a boat for a fee.

threads.claim: Ancient Iron Coins are hidden among treasures and buyers want them, hinting at their deeper significance.
threads.quote: Ulman: But there's a chance that you'll unearth some Iron Coins while you're looking for treasure...

introduced.name: Ulman
introduced.how: treasure hunter who lures Seelies and pays for antiques, recruiting the Traveler as a partner
introduced.quote: Ulman: I'm duped by it, again... Let me give you a rundown from the beginning.

introduced.name: Seelies
introduced.how: small creatures that follow Ulman and are easily drawn to him
introduced.quote: Ulman: For starters, you may not believe Seelies are somehow easily drawn to me.

introduced.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelies
introduced.how: a Seelie kind that excels at locating buried treasure
introduced.quote: Ulman: They excel at treasure-seeking. With their help, I dug up a lot of treasures and made a profit with them.

introduced.name: Ancient Iron Coins
introduced.how: a valuable antique coin Ulman wants, worth more Mora than ordinary Iron Coins
introduced.quote: Ulman: Simply put, it's a kind of antique.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: a land full of ruins and antiques where treasure can be found
introduced.quote: Ulman: They say ruins and antiques are everywhere in Sumeru. So I came to look for my fortune.

introduced.name: Ulman's notebook
introduced.how: a notebook recording hidden treasure sites Ulman found earlier
introduced.quote: Ulman: Take this notebook. I recorded on it some hidden treasure sites I found before but haven't had a chance for a dig.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Ulman: The land of Sumeru is strewn with treasures. Mora everywhere.

assumed.name: Previous Lost Riches event
assumed.quote: Traveler: Last time we met, you didn't have that silver tongue.

assumed.name: Iron Coins
assumed.quote: Traveler: "Iron Coins" again?

assumed.name: Traveler's past deeds
assumed.quote: Ulman: What troubles are you gonna fix this time in Sumeru?

threads.claim: Treasure-Seeking Seelies suddenly lose interest in Ulman and wander off, and a pile of dirt starts moving unexpectedly.
threads.quote: Ulman: But they ignored me again not long after I scooped up some dirt...

threads.claim: The Traveler cannot understand the Seelies' language, leaving communication with them an open question.
threads.quote: Traveler: I don't know their language...

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: small creatures that bounce around and dive to point people toward buried things
introduced.quote: Normally, they start bouncing around to tell me "something's buried here!"

introduced.name: Ancient Iron Coins
introduced.how: buried items the player finds and sells to Ulman for a good price
introduced.quote: Just like before, find the Ancient Iron Coins, bring them to me, and I'll buy them off of you at an excellent price.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a friendly, passionate, kind nation with powerful currents and underwater dangers
introduced.quote: A friendly, passionate, kind nation that you never ever feel like leaving. Ha. Ha. Ha.

introduced.name: Fontainian flowery speech
introduced.how: locals speak in a dramatic, flowery style full of terms of address, metaphors and adjectives
introduced.quote: The dramatic, flowery way some Fontainians talk, I just can't take it anymore!

introduced.name: Ulman's notebook
introduced.how: a notebook marking the spots where the Seelie has led Ulman
introduced.quote: Take this notebook, I've marked the spots where the little guy has taken me.

assumed.name: Ulman
assumed.quote: Ulman! You came to Fontaine too?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: With so many Ancient Iron Coins, I'm sure I can make a pretty pile of Mora! Thanks a ton, and Paimon.

assumed.name: middleman
assumed.quote: But seriously, I really don't want to get tangled up with that middleman from before. He takes a huge cut every time.

threads.claim: Seelies lead people to buried treasure, and they keep diving deeper into the water where Ulman cannot follow.
threads.quote: But... It keeps diving into the water, deeper and deeper...

threads.claim: Fontaine's waters are said to have powerful currents and other dangers that make diving hazardous.
threads.quote: I've heard other people saying that the waters here not only have powerful currents, but also all kinds of other dangers...

threads.claim: Ancient Iron Coins are buried items that can be found by following Seelies and then sold for Mora.
threads.quote: Just like before, find the Ancient Iron Coins, bring them to me, and I'll buy them off of you at an excellent price.

threads.claim: A middleman takes a large cut and is slow to pay, and Ulman distrusts him and has no other reliable partners.
threads.quote: Not only that, but it takes forever for him to get my money to me. I haven't got a clue what he's doing...

introduced.name: Lunar Leviathan
introduced.how: legendary fish said to grant people's wishes
introduced.quote: According to the legends, it has the power to grant people's wishes.

introduced.name: Kujirai Momiji
introduced.how: Inazuman fisherwoman who is hunting the Lunar Leviathan
introduced.quote: I'm Kujirai Momiji, an Inazuman fisherwoman.

introduced.name: Jiawei
introduced.how: fisherman who was on the lost voyage and later settled down with a family in Liyue
introduced.quote: I heard once he returned to Liyue he never left again.

introduced.name: Nantuck
introduced.how: former fisherman who now writes marine biology books
introduced.quote: As for Nantuck, I heard he started writing books about marine biology.

introduced.name: Fishing Association
introduced.how: recommended the Traveler to Momiji
introduced.quote: I heard about you from the Fishing Association.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: sent the Traveler out as a fisherman
introduced.quote: You must be the fisherman sent by the Adventurers' Guild, huh?

introduced.name: Old-School Qi
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarder who found the fossil in the ore and led the group to its camp
introduced.quote: Old-School Qi: This round rock should be a gem, right? Well, bring it back to camp first!

introduced.name: Fleein' Lin
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarder who identifies the rock as a fossil worth a fortune
introduced.quote: Fleein' Lin: Oh please, what do you mean by shabby rock, have you touched a book before in your life?

introduced.name: Klutzy Bazi
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarder at the camp who wonders about the fossil's value
introduced.quote: Klutzy Bazi: Really? Is it worth that much? Then, with what we have in the camp, wouldn't we be really weather?

introduced.name: Fossil
introduced.how: round rock hidden in ore that is worth a fortune and looks like a turtle shell
introduced.quote: Not only is it worth a fortune, this alone can buy half of Liyue Harbor!

introduced.name: Fossil Bag
introduced.how: bag the Traveler obtains from the Treasure Hoarders that holds the fossil
introduced.quote: (After obtaining the Fossil Bag)

introduced.name: Araumi
introduced.how: ruins with dangerous monsters where the special ore is mined
introduced.quote: Were they mined at Araumi?

introduced.name: Magical Crystal Ore
introduced.how: ore needed for the special bait, which must come from the Araumi ruins
introduced.quote: My father's log mentioned that the Magical Crystal Ore must be mined from the ruins at Araumi.

introduced.name: Special Bait Formula
introduced.how: fish bait recipe mixing Seagrass and Magical Crystal Ore, found in the father's sailing log
introduced.quote: There's an appendix in there that mentions a special fish bait formula they had developed.

introduced.name: Kujirai's father
introduced.how: famous Inazuman fisherman who chased the Lunar Leviathan for decades and vanished at sea
introduced.quote: But after the next trip to sea...he never came back.

introduced.name: Kujirai family
introduced.how: fishing lineage whose name and methods Momiji carries on
introduced.quote: I will carry on the name of the Kujirai family of fishermen.

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: area where ancient turtle ancestors lived and where fossils can be found
introduced.quote: Their ancestors were active in the Dragonspine area and you can even find fossils of them today.

introduced.name: Moonfin
introduced.how: glowing fish that gather in a school and look like the Lunar Leviathan
introduced.quote: What a big school of fish! They're glowing, they seem to like our drifting bottles!

introduced.name: Drifting bottle wish ritual
introduced.how: writing wishes into a drifting bottle and throwing it into the sea so they may come true
introduced.quote: Do you have any wishes? Let's do this together, write down your wishes, stuff them into a drifting bottle, and throw it out with all your might.

introduced.name: Giant sea turtle book
introduced.how: Nantuck's bestselling book claiming the Lunar Leviathan is a giant sea turtle
introduced.quote: I published my findings in a book, I heard it's doing well recently.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: ancient guardian that ambushes the bait site and scares the Lunar Leviathan away
introduced.quote: Paimon: Help, it's a Ruin Guard!

introduced.name: Lost voyage
introduced.how: the storm-tossed voyage where the three fishermen were lost and led home by a glowing shape
introduced.quote: But the journey was turbulent. We encountered a violent thunderstorm.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: He's stayed in Mondstadt all this time, it's said that he's writing a book?

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Not only is it worth a fortune, this alone can buy half of Liyue Harbor!

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: You don't understand, our family comes from a long lineage of fishermen, and my father is also a famous fisherman in Inazuma.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarder
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eh?! Is that...a Treasure Hoarder?

assumed.name: Glowgrass Bait
assumed.quote: Traveler: I ran out of Glowgrass Bait.

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why is it this guy!

threads.claim: Whether the Lunar Leviathan is a real legendary creature is an open question that Momiji insists is real.
threads.quote: Kujirai Momiji: Hmph, even though everyone believes they are just legends...I believe it's real.

threads.claim: Nantuck claims the creature seen that night was a pregnant giant sea turtle carrying bioluminescent plants.
threads.quote: Nantuck: That night, what we saw was a giant sea turtle with long bioluminescent plants growing on its back.

threads.claim: The Lunar Leviathan is revealed to be a school of Moonfins glowing together like a moon.
threads.quote: Paimon: When these guys gather together, it's like a big moon in the sea!

threads.claim: The Lunar Leviathan is said to grant wishes, raising the question of whether wishes truly come true.
threads.quote: According to the legends, it has the power to grant people's wishes.

threads.claim: Moonfins seem drawn to wishes poured into drifting bottles, hinting the wish-granting may be tied to them.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hehe, maybe they like the wishes that people pour into the bottles.

threads.claim: Momiji's father vanished at sea after chasing the Lunar Leviathan, and the reason is left unknown.
threads.quote: But after the next trip to sea...he never came back.

threads.claim: Momiji's father's bait formula fails on the Ruin Guard attempt, so the formula alone is not enough to catch the creature.
threads.quote: How...how did this happen, even my father's bait formula didn't work?

threads.claim: Paimon says Momiji surpassed her father by becoming the most famous fisherwoman in Inazuma.
threads.quote: Paimon: Kujirai Momiji became the most well-known fisherwoman in Inazuma and did what her father could not

threads.claim: Momiji's personal wish is to become a fisherman who surpasses her father.
threads.quote: But my wish is to become a fisherman who surpasses my father.

threads.claim: The round fossils look like turtle shells, lending physical support to Nantuck's giant sea turtle claim.
threads.quote: Paimon: Well... these round fossils do look a bit like turtle shells! Could Nantuck be telling the truth...

threads.claim: Jiawei's wish is left unfinished and unrevealed, leaving the characters' wishes a mystery.
threads.quote: Jiawei: As for Kujirai, she also did not forget. Her wish was... Uh... Um, uhh...

threads.claim: Ruin Guards at the Araumi beach interrupt attempts to lure the Lunar Leviathan with bait.
threads.quote: Paimon: Help, it's a Ruin Guard!

introduced.name: Armand
introduced.how: nervous, stammering shopkeeper who introduces himself as Armand and gets anxious around crowds
introduced.quote: H—H—Hello, you t—two... My name is... is... A—A—Armand...

introduced.name: Caron
introduced.how: shop owner who introduces himself as Caron and sells clockwork toys
introduced.quote: Hello, dear customers. I'm Caron, the owner of this shop. What can I do for you?

introduced.name: Livre
introduced.how: owner of the rival clockwork workshop who introduces himself as Livre
introduced.quote: I'm Livre, the owner of this shop. Welcome.

introduced.name: Bennett
introduced.how: unlucky Mondstadt adventurer whose botched meal delivery inspired Caron's toy
introduced.quote: I met an adventurer in Springvale when I was about to leave Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: Chief Justice of Fontaine's judges
introduced.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette, naturally.

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: the Hydro Archon, who is said to sit in the Chief Justice's chair at the judges' table
introduced.quote: why is our dear Hydro Archon sitting in Monsieur Neuvillette's chair?

introduced.name: Justices
introduced.how: the judges who sit at Fontaine's judges' table
introduced.quote: The Justices, of course.

introduced.name: Champion Duelist
introduced.how: Fontaine institution where a crime suspect can duel a Champion Duelist to clear their name and avoid trial
introduced.quote: They are a special institution in Fontaine.

introduced.name: Champion Duelist Plan
introduced.how: Livre's plan to make clockwork toys with Champion Duelists as the stars
introduced.quote: It is a plan to use champion duelists as the main characters, the development centerpiece, and the focus of our advertising for a new line of clockwork toys.

introduced.name: Lepaute Horlogerie
introduced.how: watchmaker next door that secretly makes toys and is the rival of Arbon and Alberre's shop
introduced.quote: We were talking about Lepaute Horlogerie, the watchmaker next-next door.

introduced.name: Northland Bank
introduced.how: bank sitting between the two shops, whose spot Livre transferred to it
introduced.quote: Have you noticed how this shop is separated from Lepaute Horlogerie by the Northland Bank?

introduced.name: Leschots Clockwork Workshop
introduced.how: Livre's clockwork toy shop, the rival store to Caron's
introduced.quote: (Approach Leschots Clockwork Workshop)

introduced.name: Caron and Livre are brothers
introduced.how: the two shop owners are brothers whose family feud split them apart
introduced.quote: My brother owns that shop, and I know him, and what he'd do.

introduced.name: adventure toy
introduced.how: Caron's clockwork toy based on Bennett's story, available to try at his shop
introduced.quote: A toy, to be precise — the one at the entrance.

introduced.name: Automated Comeditron
introduced.how: a comedy-generating machine Arbon and Alberre plan to build with lines from Armand
introduced.quote: We call it the Automated Comeditron.

assumed.name: Arbon
assumed.quote: Welcome, dear guests, we meet again.

assumed.name: Alberre
assumed.quote: My, are you so eager to begin work already?

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: I don't have a Vision, nor am I an adventurer.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Fatui love to meddle in other people's business, but this sort of meddling's a first for sure!

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: Are you referring to a Harbinger?

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: The greatest toy salesman in Snezhnaya

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: As expected of people recommended by the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: or just happening to have enough Mora to buy what you'd like to.

threads.claim: Bennett is presented as an adventurer whose bad luck is part of his character and inspiration.
threads.quote: The world is full of all sorts of people — and maybe I just happen to be the unluckiest.

threads.claim: Bennett's courage gives him access to sights only he can see, a theme of personal adventure.
threads.quote: But thanks to that, I've also become the bravest person — and that's given me access to sights only I can see.

threads.claim: Livre adopts the idea that everyone has sights only they can see, closing the theme.
threads.quote: The world is full of all sorts of people, and they all have sights that only they can see.

threads.claim: A family fight over the clockwork business split the brothers, with Livre leaving to strike out on his own.
threads.quote: My brother had a big fight with our father over that, and he went to strike out on his own.

threads.claim: The brothers finally speak again, and Caron notes their father would be pleased.
threads.quote: I'm sure father would be pleased that my brother and I finally spoke.

threads.claim: Champion Duelists are a Fontaine institution where a duel can clear a criminal charge and avoid trial.
threads.quote: They are a special institution in Fontaine. If you commit any crime, as you face your trial, you may apply for a duel against a Champion Duelist.

threads.claim: The toy Champion Duelists are revealed to be play-acting adventurers rather than real Duelists.
threads.quote: But those aren't real Champion Duelists!

threads.claim: The Northland Bank stands between the two shops and may be a mediator in their rivalry.
threads.quote: Have you noticed how this shop is separated from Lepaute Horlogerie by the Northland Bank?

threads.claim: A past Mondstadt fleet was lost near these islands, which never seemed to get closer.
threads.quote: Lisa: Many years ago, a fleet from Mondstadt encountered some islands at sea.

threads.claim: The archipelago was once called the Haar Islands, hinting at a renamed past.
threads.quote: Venti: So now they're called the Golden Apple Archipelago, huh? They used to be known as the Haar Islands.

threads.claim: Dodo-King is an unknown ruler who sent a challenge letter to Klee.
threads.quote: Klee: A very bad, bad, bad guy! He's called Dodo-King!

threads.claim: The machine on the island is not Dodo-King, so the real Dodo-King is still hidden elsewhere.
threads.quote: Klee: This isn't Dodo-King. The real Dodo-King is somewhere else.

threads.claim: The letter may be a prank, though the group cannot be sure who wrote it.
threads.quote: Traveler: I also suspect it's a prank.

threads.claim: Jean and Barbara doubt a prank would be sent to a child, so the letter's purpose stays unclear.
threads.quote: Barbara: I suspected as much too, but who would send a prank letter to a child?

threads.claim: Dense fog surrounds the islands and only briefly opens at set times.
threads.quote: A short-lived gap sometimes appears in the fog over the northeasterly island.

threads.claim: Lighting the four devices clears the fog around the group, showing the fog can be dispelled.
threads.quote: Klee: The fog's gone!

threads.claim: The letter demands lighting four beacons before a trialist's gate can be reached.
threads.quote: Barbara: Four beacons? Does that mean he wants us to find something that emits light?

threads.claim: All four devices are lit, but what the trials are remains unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: We've found all the devices! Let's go to get a view of our surroundings.

threads.claim: Buoys appeared overnight in the sea, and Klee assumes Dodo-King placed them.
threads.quote: Klee: Dodo-King must have put them there!

threads.claim: After the buoys are destroyed, the land rises from the sea, revealing more islands.
threads.quote: Barbara: This whole stretch of land just rose out of the water!

threads.claim: Jean suspects a large machine under the sea raises the islands.
threads.quote: Jean: Before the ground started shaking, I heard the sound of machinery. I believe there may be an immense mechanical structure under this region of the ocean.

threads.claim: The humanoid machine's Inazuman clothing and its origin raise a question tied to Inazuma's situation.
threads.quote: Jean: But given Inazuma's current situation, how could something like this occur...?

threads.claim: Some past human presence once existed in these waters, though its nature is unknown.
threads.quote: Jean: Everything we've seen here indicates that there was once a human presence in these waters.

threads.claim: A mural shows people preparing to board a ship, hinting at a departure from the islands.
threads.quote: Paimon: It looks like people are getting ready to board a ship.

threads.claim: Klee wonders whether the Dodo Clan is Dodoco's family, a question left unanswered.
threads.quote: Klee: But... He said he's the strongest of the Dodo Clan. Ohh... Could the Dodo Clan be Dodoco's family?

threads.claim: The letter hides faint elemental traces that act as a hint.
threads.quote: Lisa: This letter contains faint elemental traces that seem more like a hint than anything else.

threads.claim: Using Elemental Sight reveals a drawing of the archipelago on the back of the letter.
threads.quote: Lisa: The information on the reverse page is now clear.

threads.claim: Venti's true role as one of the Four Winds is a secret he asks the group to keep.
threads.quote: Venti: This is a secret between us here, so don't tell anyone else.

threads.claim: Dodo-King's identity and purpose remain unknown, though he lured the group here with personalized letters.
threads.quote: I don't believe this so-called Dodo-King exists. But there is someone or something with a reason for luring us here together.

threads.claim: The riddle letter hints at three colored keys guarded by a strange fish.
threads.quote: Keys of three colors guarded by a strange fish, the secret lies here, do you dare to proceed?

threads.claim: The three crystals may answer the riddle, but the fish is still unidentified.
threads.quote: It looks like these three crystals might be the answer to this whole riddle.

threads.claim: The original inhabitants of the archipelago disappeared, and the answer about how the machine arrived vanished with them.
threads.quote: It seems the answer to that question disappeared with the people that used to inhabit this archipelago.

threads.claim: A shipwrecked group from Inazuma drifted here, linking the wreck to the earlier inhabitants.
threads.quote: It seems the boat was full of people that left Inazuma, but then encountered some problems at sea

threads.claim: An Inazuman machine turned up in a land closed off by the Sakoku Decree, and its route here is unexplained.
threads.quote: How could such a massive piece of offensive weaponry have found its way here?

threads.claim: The machine's appearance confirms it is from Inazuma, though how it got here is still open.
threads.quote: Its outward appearance confirms its Inazuman origin.

threads.claim: Someone left stones and flowers to commemorate the machine, hinting at a grateful past relationship with it.
threads.quote: It sounds like someone wanted to commemorate the machine.

threads.claim: The shipwrecked boat carried unknown cargo, and a Defense Mechanism may be connected to it.
threads.quote: Is that the thing that those people carried with them on the boat? How strange...

threads.claim: The crystals are made from a rare transparent ore and have a function that is not yet known.
threads.quote: I believe they must have a specific function.

threads.claim: An Abyss Order stronghold may be hidden among the deserted islands.
threads.quote: There is an Abyss Order stronghold among the deserted islands. Make haste.

threads.claim: Barbara spent a summer on the archipelago with friends in the past.
threads.quote: The Golden Apple Archipelago is full of many games that involve harpasta, and I and my friends spent a most wonderful summer here.

threads.claim: Venti, a famous bard, may secretly be able to summon dragons.
threads.quote: Who knew that everyone's favorite bard had the power to summon dragons?

threads.claim: Kaeya's eyepatch is tied to a family history his grandfather passed on, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: the eyepatch that my grandfather left me

threads.claim: Dodo-King is revealed to be Alice, Klee's mother, who used the alias to invite the group.
threads.quote: Because Dodo-King is me, your mother, Alice!

threads.claim: Alice is far away traveling and secretly sneaks back to check on Klee and the others unseen.
threads.quote: Actually, whenever I have a moment to spare, I sneak back to check on you and everyone else.

threads.claim: Albedo seems to know Alice well and may have known about her return visits from the start.
threads.quote: Aunt Alice, the same as ever.

threads.claim: Sayid partly decodes the murals as a story of shipwreck, rescue and departure across islands, leaving some meaning unresolved.
threads.quote: The story the murals tell should be as such.

threads.claim: The five-cup mural hints at a change of state, possibly of seawater, which is never fully explained.
threads.quote: Just like five cups of water, with each containing a different amount of it.

threads.claim: The archipelago may be a fourth crystal, the Summer Crystal, tied to the three known crystals.
threads.quote: Perhaps from Alice's perspective, this archipelago is the natural fourth crystal.

threads.claim: Klee and Alice are of a long-lived race, and their lifespans differ from humans around them.
threads.quote: Klee, just like Mom, you are of a race blessed with longevity.

threads.claim: Alice praises Mondstadt's freedom as the ideal place for her daughter to grow up.
threads.quote: The reason why I like the city of Mondstadt is that its freedom is exactly what my daughter and I could every hope for.

threads.claim: Razor experiences a warm feeling of mother love, reinforcing parental love as a recurring theme.
threads.quote: This is... mother feeling?

threads.claim: The tides keep rising on the islands, threatening the people who once lived there.
threads.quote: The tides are getting higher by the year.

threads.claim: The island people had to flee the tide and leave a family heirloom behind in a locked chest.
threads.quote: It was a choice between that and getting everyone to safety

threads.claim: The locked heirloom chest is finally opened, though its contents are only hinted at here.
threads.quote: Phew... finally got the chest open.

threads.claim: The weather on the island is unnatural and seems tied to the sealed chest and monsters.
threads.quote: The weather here's so weird. It doesn't seem natural.

threads.claim: Defeating the monsters calms the weather, confirming they are behind the unnatural weather and sealed chest.
threads.quote: Looks like that sealed chest and the weather on this island really do have something to do with these monsters...

threads.claim: The journal's mark matches a mural, suggesting the journal and murals were left by the same people.
threads.quote: Maybe that journal and the mural were left by the same group of people!

threads.claim: A Seelie carried debris from a distant island back to Mondstadt, and how it got there remains a mystery.
threads.quote: So how did it get to that island, then? So many questions...

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staff who offers the Traveler a commission to deal with hilichurl trouble
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Apologies, but I need a moment of your time. Would you be interested in taking on a new commission?

introduced.name: Guild
introduced.how: the organization that dispatches adventurers and receives reports of hilichurl trouble
introduced.quote: Katheryne: The situation is this. The Guild has recently received several reports that the hilichurls in the wild are once again starting to band together and disrupt the merchant route.

introduced.name: Ella Musk
introduced.how: a scholar compiling a dictionary of hilichurl language who ends up in danger in the field
introduced.quote: Ella Musk: It looks like my vocabulary compilation work for the dictionary is going to have to be postponed once again...

introduced.name: Unusual Hilichurl
introduced.how: a special hilichurl seen among hilichurl groups that the Guild wants captured or driven off
introduced.quote: Katheryne: So, we require someone to capture the Unusual Hilichurl, or at the very least chase it away.

introduced.name: Hilichurl handbook
introduced.how: Ella's book for translating hilichurl requests and phrases, still unverified
introduced.quote: Ella Musk: If you encounter any communication difficulties, you'll be able to resolve them simply by consulting this book! ...In principle, at least.

introduced.name: Hilichurl commissions
introduced.how: hilichurls who want help can be approached, their requests understood, and their commissions completed to reveal the Unusual Hilichurl's timing and locations
introduced.quote: Go with Ella to look for hilichurls who are willing to talk, attempt to understand their requests, and complete their .

introduced.name: Hilichurl disturbances on the merchant route
introduced.how: hilichurls have begun banding together again and disrupting the merchant route
introduced.quote: Katheryne: The situation is this.

assumed.name: hilichurls
assumed.quote: Katheryne: The situation is this. The Guild has recently received several reports that the hilichurls in the wild are once again starting to band together and disrupt the merchant route.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Library
assumed.quote: Katheryne: On a related note, Ella Musk is waiting for you in the library.

threads.claim: The Unusual Hilichurl appears among hilichurl groups and may be behind recent disturbances.
threads.quote: Katheryne: So, we require someone to capture the Unusual Hilichurl, or at the very least chase it away.

threads.claim: Hilichurl phrases hint that the Unusual Hilichurl's appearance is tied to a specific time.
threads.quote: Paimon: ... Paimon thinks that has something to do with time. You should definitely check that in the handbook.

threads.claim: The cause of the disturbances remains unexplained after the Unusual Hilichurl escapes.
threads.quote: Katheryne: Although you were unable to capture the Unusual Hilichurl and we still cannot ascertain the reason for the recent spate of disturbances...

threads.claim: Ella suspects the Unusual Hilichurl was only seeking friends in an unfamiliar land.
threads.quote: Ella Musk: But from the linguistic corpus I have managed to assemble thus far, it seems likely that it was simply looking to make some friends in an unfamiliar land.

threads.claim: Ella's research aims to show that humans and hilichurls can coexist harmoniously.
threads.quote: Ella Musk: Well! Either way, my dictionary has been further refined, and we've obtained more evidence to support my thesis that harmonious coexistence between human and hilichurl kind is viable.

threads.claim: Hilichurl families and tribes may be dying out, which troubles Ella.
threads.quote: Ella Musk: Families change, tribes die out. And friends... Does friendship mean nothing!?

threads.claim: Hilichurlian is only partly understood, and the handbook offers only uncertain translations.
threads.quote: Traveler: But I don't understand a word they're saying...

introduced.name: Supreme Cuisine Machine
introduced.how: a cooking machine that finds ingredients by scent, automates processing and cleaning, and runs on adeptal power
introduced.quote: Upon activation, it will automatically search for suitable ingredients nearby, and will mark their scent out, all the better for chefs to track them to their source.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: a self-described builder of the Supreme Cuisine Machine who runs the cooking course
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Ah, Traveler. Fine timing. Only recently has one finished setting this device up.

introduced.name: adeptal flame

threads.claim: The Stove God's identity is disputed because the few written records about it are confusing.
threads.quote: Very few written records make mention of the Stove God, and those that do are notoriously confusing.

threads.claim: Two sources give contradictory accounts of the Stove God, one god or many, raising doubt about which is true.
threads.quote: This is a radically different account from the one given in

threads.claim: The giant stone is unbreakable, suggesting it hides something important.
threads.quote: Clearly, there's more to it than meets the eye.

threads.claim: The stone may be the Stove God shrine slab that went missing in transit long ago.
threads.quote: This stone here has all the same features, so I suspect it could be the one that went missing all those years ago.

threads.claim: Moonchase Festival may descend from an ancient Stove God tribute festival, though this is unproven.
threads.quote: After many years of researching ancient texts, my grandfather came to believe that the practice of paying seasonal tribute to the Stove God may be best described as a festival

threads.claim: The stone's timing hints that a divine will may be behind the events.
threads.quote: maybe a divine will is at work behind all of this.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis has passed on and Liyue has entered the age of humankind.
threads.quote: Now that Rex Lapis has passed on and Liyue has entered the age of humankind

threads.claim: The Supreme Cuisine Machine cannot yet move itself across mountain roads, an unsolved problem.
threads.quote: this issue of how a stove may trek across treacherous mountain roads by itself has yet to be resolved.

threads.claim: The machine still lacks automatic ingredient gathering and automatic heat control.
threads.quote: The ability to automatically gather ingredients, for one. Or automatic heat control, for that matter

threads.claim: Ningguang, who came up with the festival theme, is described as full of mystery.
threads.quote: I heard it was Ningguang that came up with it. She's so amazing... and so full of mystery.

threads.claim: Anemo Slimes swallow ingredients, and the reason they do so is unexplained.
threads.quote: Did those Slimes steal the Bamboo Shoots? What do they need 'em for?

threads.claim: A cracked stone holds the lost Statue of the Stove God, and what is inside is still unknown.
threads.quote: Keqing: A crack has appeared in one corner. But we still can't tell what's inside.

threads.claim: The stone opens and reveals that Guoba is the Stove God the group was seeking.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: Hehe, indeed it does. After all, Guoba is the deity you've been searching for: God of the Stove.

threads.claim: The Stove God draws power from the actions and passions of the masses, so the statue may awaken with the festival.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: This is because the Stove God draws power from the actions of the masses.

threads.claim: Passion alone is not enough to awaken the Stove God; it takes desire.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: You asked me if a sufficiently festive atmosphere would be enough to reawaken the Stove God. And my answer is this: Yes and no.

threads.claim: The statue awakens when Keqing's deep desire is fulfilled by tasting the childhood dish, revealing the desire-based mechanism.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: But just now, when Keqing ate this dish she had longed for, a deeply held desire was fulfilled.

threads.claim: Guoba once had a different, more powerful role, and the group does not yet know what happened to him.
threads.quote: Xiangling: Glory days? Wait... what happened? Did Guoba used to be different from now?

threads.claim: Guoba was once the Patron God of the Soil and surrendered his wisdom and power to the soil.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: But all the wisdom and power he had then, he has since surrendered to the soil itself.

threads.claim: Mortals no longer remember the Stove God, though he was once the closest adeptus to common folk.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: You mortals no longer remember him. But back in the age when you did, he was the closest of all the adepti to the common folk.

threads.claim: Keqing and her grandfather once debated whether Rex Lapis was real or only legend.
threads.quote: We'd read the classics together, then debate how much of it was actually genuine, and whether Rex Lapis was real or not...

threads.claim: Keqing's view of Rex Lapis has shifted from myth to reality.
threads.quote: My views on Rex Lapis have changed in this time, too, from myth to reality.

threads.claim: Keqing's grandfather researched the Stove God, and Keqing now continues that research.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: Keqing's grandfather once researched the Stove God, and now she follows in his footsteps...

threads.claim: The recipe Keqing received from her grandfather's notes was not his own creation.
threads.quote: Keqing: About that... I do not believe that this recipe was my grandfather's creation.

threads.claim: The cornbread buns recipe came from Xiangling's family, as her father taught her how to make it.
threads.quote: Xiangling: Uh-huh. My dad taught me how to make it.

threads.claim: Ganyu has a secret from her childhood that she fears Cloud Retainer may have revealed.
threads.quote: Ganyu: I noticed Cloud Retainer was here for quite a while. Did she say anything about... m—me? When I was young?

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer has unveiled a supreme cuisine machine whose nature will only be revealed later.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Patience! One's purpose here today is to meet and to greet, nothing further. All shall be revealed before your very eyes when the time arrives.

threads.claim: Xiao answers when his name is spoken and keeps the promises he makes.
threads.quote: Xiao: When I make you a promise, I will honor it.

threads.claim: The Stove God's people built the Guili Assembly long ago, and a flood took their home.
threads.quote: Madame Ping: Alas, their home was taken by a flood

threads.claim: The Stove God gave all his power to the land and vanished, leaving his fate and whereabouts unclear.
threads.quote: For he placed all of his power into the land itself

threads.claim: Guoba is revealed to have been born from the Stove God after his departure.
threads.quote: The Stove God departed and Guoba was born

threads.claim: Guoba has lost his past memories and speech, yet still recognizes familiar food.
threads.quote: Though he did not remember the past, he was profoundly moved

threads.claim: Zhongli has a long shared history with Guoba and the people of Liyue that the Traveler may not yet understand.
threads.quote: Hello there, old friend.

threads.claim: Madame Ping and Rex Lapis received teachings from the Stove God about cooking and the secrets of the flame.
threads.quote: He told Rex Lapis and I of the dishes that bring joy and of the secrets of the flame

threads.claim: The Moonchase Festival is tied to memory, gratitude, and the endurance of Liyue's history.
threads.quote: All these things and more... they are why people chase the moon.

threads.claim: Liyue's way of life has persisted through disasters and centuries of change.
threads.quote: In Liyue, things have always been this way

threads.quote: Xiangling, you have an adeptal affinity.

introduced.how: Millelith Staff Officer who invites the Traveler to the Wargame and introduces himself
introduced.quote: I, Staff Officer Su Ding of the Millelith, hereby formally invite you to participate in the Wargame of Five Armies and assume the post of senior consultant therein. What say you to this proposal?

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Liyue military whose General Staff builds the monster gamepieces and runs the Wargame
introduced.quote: the Millelith General Staff has created tabletop gamepieces based on all kinds of monsters in order to simulate hostile confrontations

introduced.name: Wargame of Five Armies
introduced.how: Tabletop simulation where neighboring armies use monster gamepieces to test ways of suppressing the monster threat
introduced.quote: For this iteration of the Wargame, we've invited members serving in various combat units to utilize their own radically different mindsets and perspectives to control the gamepieces

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: Shogunate unit whose representative is a strong swordsman who leads troops from the front
introduced.quote: The Shogunate representative is from the Yashiro Commission, and has outstanding swordsmanship.

introduced.name: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol
introduced.how: Fontaine firearms unit known for disciplined volley fire, sent to the Wargame as Turenna's unit
introduced.quote: The representative sent by Fontaine's Special Security and Surveillance Patrol belongs to an exceptional firearms unit.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: Sumeru mercenary branch within the Eremite organizations, lightly armed and skilled in harsh environments
introduced.quote: As for the representative from Sumeru's Corps of Thirty, he is adept at handling extreme environments from the desert to the rainforest

introduced.name: Phonia
introduced.how: Former Signals Officer of the Investigative Team who tests alchemical instruments for Albedo
introduced.quote: I'm Phonia, formerly a Signals Officer of the Investigative Team.

introduced.name: Turenna
introduced.how: Special Patrol sharpshooter who calls the Traveler Proto-Boss and reports on the Wargame
introduced.quote: Turenna of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, reporting to Proto-Boss!

introduced.name: Sido
introduced.how: Corps of Thirty delegate and mercenary from Sumeru who speaks of the Flame-Mane
introduced.quote: I represent the Corps of Thirty delegation.

introduced.name: Kuromaro
introduced.how: Yashiro Commission member and former platoon leader who values balancing bravery and strategy
introduced.quote: I am a member of the Yashiro Commission, and it was my great honor to have heard the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato speak of your deeds.

introduced.name: Frederica Gunnhildr
introduced.how: Veteran Mondstadt commander, described as the Acting Grand Master's mother and a famous front-line fighter
introduced.quote: Commander Frederica is the Acting Grand Master's mother, and is famous throughout Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Beisht attack at Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: Past battle where Millelith forces deployed Guizhong Ballistae against Beisht's attack
introduced.quote: I was once a frontline soldier, and followed Lady Yuheng to the Guyun Stone Forest to deploy our mass-produced Guizhong Ballistae against Beisht's attack.

introduced.name: 7th Company of the Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Reorganized Knights of Favonius company that combines knights with varied ranged and melee capabilities
introduced.quote: Captain Albedo applied to have me assigned to the reorganized 7th Company.

introduced.name: Millelith General Staff
introduced.how: Reorganized Millelith command created after the Beisht battle to bring advisers together
introduced.quote: After the battle with Beisht, Lady Yuheng conferred with the other Qixing officers and decided it was high time to reorganize the Millelith's chain of command.

introduced.name: scenario-based training
introduced.how: Lady Yuheng's method of combining intel into manuals that test a soldier's ability to organize, deploy and command
introduced.quote: It's a concept that the Lady Yuheng has been promoting, a product of synthesizing intel from multiple sources...

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: I personally witnessed the entire battle in which you and Adeptus Shenhe repelled Beisht.

assumed.name: Lady Yuheng
assumed.quote: Lady Yuheng sent letters of invitation to the armed services of our neighboring nations in order to deepen our cooperation

assumed.name: Lord Kaiyang
assumed.quote: Lord Kaiyang proposed holding this Wargame to Lady Tianquan.

assumed.name: Ayato and Ayaka
assumed.quote: Is that really what Ayato and Ayaka said about me...?

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Isn't that also Jean's last name...?

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Captain Albedo applied to have me assigned to the reorganized 7th Company.

assumed.name: Chevreuse and Grosrochard
assumed.quote: Captain Chevreuse and Captain Grosrochard's assessment of you!

assumed.name: Flame-Mane and General Mahamatra
assumed.quote: Hello, friend of the General Mahamatra and the Flame-Mane.

assumed.name: Port Ormos
assumed.quote: You once participated in a commercial event in Port Ormos, and assisted the Corps of Thirty in arresting a crafty criminal and his scholarly accomplice.

assumed.name: Ematol
assumed.quote: Perhaps Ematol could make us some miniature explosives

assumed.name: Lumidouce Harbor and Yilong Wharf
assumed.quote: As you know, Lumidouce Harbor and Yilong Wharf are just across the sea from each other

assumed.name: Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta
assumed.quote: When I was playing Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta before, you gave me the gift of your insight...

assumed.name: General Kujou
assumed.quote: The Commissioner and General Kujou discussed it thoroughly before selecting myself as the representative of the delegation.

threads.claim: Large numbers of monsters still roam Teyvat and cannot be eradicated quickly, which motivates the military cooperation.
threads.quote: As you have seen, large numbers of monsters still roam the wilderness of Teyvat, and they cannot be eradicated in any sort of short timeframe.

threads.claim: The Wargame gives the participants new lessons, showing that analyzing monster scenarios can reveal ways to win.
threads.quote: The longer we spent doing it, the more we felt we learned.

threads.claim: Beisht is an enemy so powerful that ordinary soldiers need better tactics and weapons to defeat it.
threads.quote: With sufficient preparation, even an enemy as powerful as Beisht can be dealt with.

threads.claim: The Millelith reorganized its command after the Beisht battle, creating a new department of advisers.
threads.quote: After the battle with Beisht, Lady Yuheng conferred with the other Qixing officers and decided it was high time to reorganize the Millelith's chain of command.

threads.claim: Lady Yuheng is promoting scenario-based training, whose full nature is only partly explained.
threads.quote: It's a concept that the Lady Yuheng has been promoting, a product of synthesizing intel from multiple sources...

threads.claim: The Traveler has met several people before, including Su Ding, but has forgotten those encounters.
threads.quote: Our paths have crossed before, but it is unlikely you paid me much heed.

threads.claim: Commander Frederica may become the Captain of the new 7th Company.
threads.quote: When the time comes, the expeditionary force's No. 2 — the venerable Commander Frederica Gunnhildr might become our Company's Captain.

threads.claim: Leaders must balance personal bravery with strategy, since leading charges can cause a battle to collapse.
threads.quote: Therefore, strategy and bravery must be balanced.

introduced.name: Mika

introduced.quote: Isn't that Varka? The leader of that legendary expedition!?

introduced.name: The Captain

introduced.quote: In the past couple of months, we received an unexpected visitor: the Fatui Harbinger known as 'The Captain.'

introduced.name: Cider Lake

introduced.name: Wine Market
introduced.how: Traditional festival market that began as a trading place for wine ingredients and now sells wines, fruit drinks, food and handicrafts
introduced.quote: Well, originally it was simply a place where winemakers and farmers would come to trade in raw ingredients for wine-making.

introduced.name: Wolvendom

introduced.quote: By contrast, Razor grew up in Wolvendom and has had very limited contact with human society...

threads.claim: The expedition is driven by a dangerous secret from days long past that Varka refuses to disclose.
threads.quote: I once told you that the purpose of this expedition was related to a dangerous secret from days long past.

threads.claim: The Captain hides his face and his past behind a mask, so his origins are unknown.
threads.quote: The man hides everything under the mask he wears, so no one can know his past or his origins.

threads.claim: The Captain was sent toward Natlan, and his non-hostile behavior toward the expedition remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Our scouts have confirmed that The Captain received orders to head for Natlan three days ago.

threads.claim: Varka's connection to Razor's real parents goes back much further than Razor's upbringing in Wolvendom.
threads.quote: No, the connection between them goes back much further.

threads.claim: Razor's parents' box holds only junk at first, but Razor recognizes their scent, hinting at a personal link.
threads.quote: Razor: *sniff* There is a scent.

threads.claim: Razor's parents left a bottle of Thousand-Wind Wine, a clue to their past that Lisa says they brewed themselves.
threads.quote: In fact, it looks like your parents brewed this bottle themselves.

threads.claim: The rhyme about Thousand-Wind Wine gives no brewing details, so its ingredients stay a mystery that must be solved by making the wine.
threads.quote: If you want to know the secret behind this sweet scent, you might have to start by rolling up your sleeves...

threads.claim: Mondstadt is described as a sweet dream of freedom, and Venti says freedom is the key to the wine's rewards.
threads.quote: Freedom is the key here. It's not as hard as you might think.

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon sleeps after the west wind dies down, so Weinlesefest is the feast before his winter slumber.
threads.quote: the Anemo Archon goes into a slumber after the west wind dies down, leaving the north wind to blow during the winter.

threads.claim: Rosaria is secretly nearby observing the Traveler and Razor's conversation with Venti.
threads.quote: (Camera pans to show Rosaria hidden nearby)

threads.claim: Razor's fear of the unknown holds him back from wanting to learn who his real parents were.
threads.quote: His fear of the unknown is overwhelming everything else he's feeling.

threads.claim: Razor's search for his birth parents deepens as a vision shows them and the unfinished wine they left for him.
threads.quote: May as well leave it for our son

threads.claim: Venti hints at a hidden identity by winking and summoning his powers while others are distracted.
threads.quote: who winks and places a finger to his lips

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon fails to appear at the toast, leaving his return an open question that the wind later hints at.
