assumed.name: Ochimusha
assumed.quote: From slimes to ochimusha, and even to those outlander warriors from Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Ley Line Disorders
assumed.quote: I can even simulate the wind direction, weather, mechanisms and even Ley Line Disorders using Shinryuu.

threads.claim: Shinryuu's imagined weapons are so real that they can injure practitioners.
threads.quote: My Shinryuu is a little too... real, to the point where my disciples can become injured when fighting their imaginary foes.

threads.claim: Imagined blades and muskets from Shinryuu can cut and shoot through the body.
threads.quote: Even an imaginary blade created by Shinryuu can slice your hands and feet.

threads.claim: Shousen suggests the Traveler is fated to use Shinryuu.
threads.quote: Perhaps fated to use it, even.

threads.claim: Shinryuu is hinted to be truly ruthless to those who train with it.
threads.quote: Shinryuu can be truly ruthless.

threads.claim: The Electro Crystalfly is described as the mightiest creature in the world, and even a skilled challenger barely survived against one.
threads.quote: He barely lasted ten seconds.

introduced.name: Vigee
introduced.how: Leads the Combat Simulator project and plans a sixteen-team tournament
introduced.quote: Vigee: Next, we'll use the Combat Simulator to run a large-scale tournament, with sixteen teams of warriors and monsters facing off one-on-one until only one victor remains.

introduced.name: Liliuo
introduced.how: Helps build the simulator's predictive model by supplying extra information
introduced.quote: Wislawa: Miss Liliuo then provided a lot of additional information, correcting several of my assumptions.

introduced.name: Wislawa
introduced.how: Analyst who assessed warrior and monster combat strength for the simulator
introduced.quote: Wislawa: Miss Vigee interviewed me and asked me to briefly assess various combinations of warriors and monsters, then estimate their combat strength...

introduced.name: Tumaini
introduced.how: Swordsman who charges in and wins fast by intuition rather than analysis
introduced.quote: Liliuo: From what I understand, Tumaini, you don't usually spend much time analyzing the situation in battle.

introduced.name: Combat Simulator
introduced.how: Predictive simulator that recreates bizarre battles between warriors and monsters
introduced.quote: Liliuo: And just like that, we had ourselves a "Combat Simulator," capable of recreating all kinds of bizarre combat scenarios.

introduced.name: Sixteen-team tournament
introduced.how: Large one-on-one simulated tournament that players will predict each day
introduced.quote: Vigee: Next, we'll use the Combat Simulator to run a large-scale tournament, with sixteen teams of warriors and monsters facing off one-on-one until only one victor remains.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Isn't that the Saurian warrior from the Masters of the Night-Wind who fought Kachina? And there's a guest from Fontaine, and...

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Isn't that the Saurian warrior from the Masters of the Night-Wind who fought Kachina? And there's a guest from Fontaine, and...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: A Fatui soldier!?

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Liliuo: A squad of the Eremites from Sumeru against Fontaine's Gardemeks, for example, or tribal warriors taking on a Consecrated Beast...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Liliuo: A squad of the Eremites from Sumeru against Fontaine's Gardemeks, for example, or tribal warriors taking on a Consecrated Beast...

assumed.name: Gardemek
assumed.quote: Liliuo: A squad of the Eremites from Sumeru against Fontaine's Gardemeks, for example, or tribal warriors taking on a Consecrated Beast...

assumed.name: Consecrated Beast
assumed.quote: Liliuo: A squad of the Eremites from Sumeru against Fontaine's Gardemeks, for example, or tribal warriors taking on a Consecrated Beast...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Wislawa: I'll take a batch of our finished products back to Snezhnaya and give it to our officers for further study, all the better to put it to practical use.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Wislawa: You know, information doesn't come cheap. In Nod-Krai, getting intelligence like this from the Curatorium of Secrets would cost us half a company's worth of wages.

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets
assumed.quote: Wislawa: You know, information doesn't come cheap. In Nod-Krai, getting intelligence like this from the Curatorium of Secrets would cost us half a company's worth of wages.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Wislawa: Besides, once the Combat Simulator is complete, it won't only benefit the Fatui and the tribal warriors. Miss Vigee also intends to share the results with the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Commission
assumed.quote: Wislawa: As it happens, some Adventurers' Guild branches are currently refining their commission-rating systems, assigning more precise difficulty ratings to commissions.

assumed.name: Grainfruit Chips
assumed.quote: Liliuo: Even trivial matters like "not finishing that serving of Grainfruit Chips in the morning" could cause a failure to realize your full potential in battle and thus lose.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Liliuo: Please do drop by the Adventurers' Guild counter often and check for any messages from Natlan, alright?

threads.claim: Liliuo suggests the Traveler's intuition may be reliable enough to predict outcomes that calculations miss.
threads.quote: Liliuo: At least to us tribal warriors, your intuition seems exceptionally reliable.

threads.claim: Paimon proposes combining intuition with careful analysis to spot battle outcomes at a glance.
threads.quote: Paimon: Maybe if we combine the two, you could spot the outcome at a glance — even when no one else can figure it out.

threads.claim: The Traveler says factors beyond control and small variables can have large effects on outcomes.
threads.quote: Traveler: Factors beyond our control can have a significant impact.

threads.claim: The team aims to raise the simulator's accuracy to at least eighty percent over time.
threads.quote: Wislawa: I think that, in time, we could increase our accuracy to at least eighty percent.

threads.claim: Liliuo asks the Traveler and Paimon to watch for messages from Natlan, hinting at a future connection.
threads.quote: Liliuo: Please do drop by the Adventurers' Guild counter often and check for any messages from Natlan, alright?

introduced.name: Kesean
introduced.how: a biology researcher turned jellyfish breeder who sold the glowing jellyfish and is now facing ecological charges
introduced.quote: You see, I was trained as a researcher in biology, and during one of my recent experiments, I accidentally bred a batch of glowing jellyfish.

introduced.name: Augereau
introduced.how: an official who pronounced Kesean guilty of ecological destruction and set his conditions
introduced.quote: The evidence is conclusive, and the defendant has been declared guilty of the crime of ecological destruction.

introduced.name: Violetglow Jellyfish
introduced.how: a cultivated glowing jellyfish that gathers in clusters and disrupts local underwater ecosystems when released
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, these jellyfish that I specially bred are incompatible with the local ecosystem, especially due to their tendency to gather and glow in clusters...

introduced.name: Gardes
introduced.how: authorities who investigate ecological crimes and release-related cases, and who enforce sentences
introduced.quote: The Gardes will continue to investigate those who released them without permission.

introduced.name: Fluorescent Mucus
introduced.how: a substance jellyfish release when startled, harmless in cultivated Violetglow Jellyfish
introduced.quote: When jellyfish are startled, they can sometimes release their mucus that can help them escape or paralyze their enemies.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I've got to put up a commission at the Adventurers' Guild or hire a diver...

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: I also hope that the next time we meet, it won't be in the Fortress of Meropide.

assumed.name: mora
assumed.quote: I thought I could sell them as pets for some quick mora...

threads.claim: Humans breeding creatures in labs and releasing them into the wild can upset the natural ecosystem.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, these jellyfish that I specially bred are incompatible with the local ecosystem, especially due to their tendency to gather and glow in clusters...

threads.claim: The Gardes may waive sanctions if the offender retrieves the released creatures in time.
threads.quote: If the defendant could retrieve all Violetglow Jellyfish within the designated waters within a certain time limit, certain sanctions may be waived.

threads.claim: Kesean's jail sentence is waived after the Traveler helps retrieve the jellyfish.
threads.quote: Ha! Speaking of which, thanks to you, the Gardes have now waived my jail sentence.

threads.claim: The Traveler senses the Fluorescent Mucus is following them, and Kesean is curious about it but unresolved.
threads.quote: I feel like the mucus is following me...

threads.claim: Buyers credit their sudden good fortune to releasing the jellyfish, a belief that clashes with Kesean's own bad luck.
threads.quote: They thought it must have been a blessing from the heavens for doing a good deed!

threads.claim: Releasing captive creatures is treated as a tempting but harmful act that the characters argue over.
threads.quote: W—Woah, wait! Don't you dare to think about releasing them!!!

threads.claim: Kesean describes his freedom as depending on the Traveler's success in the jellyfish retrieval.
threads.quote: My freedom is completely in your hands now!

introduced.name: Melies
introduced.how: a filmmaker who pitches partnerships with a structured, script-like approach
introduced.quote: A business partnership should be like a film script. It needs a proper structure, with a beginning, middle, and end!

introduced.name: Petit Lumiere
introduced.how: a film-minded partner who runs street surveys on public interest in Flash Cuts
introduced.quote: According to a street survey I had The Steambird run, people don't seem all that enthused about the art form that is Flash Cuts.

introduced.name: Flash Cuts
introduced.how: short films designed for quick viewing that anyone can make or watch on the move
introduced.quote: Not only that, unlike regular short films, Flash Cuts are designed for quick viewing — between tasks or while you're on the move.

introduced.name: Film Kamera
introduced.how: a film camera Melies supplies for shooting Flash Cuts
introduced.quote: I also have the Film Kamera, props, and post-production lined up as well.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: the most popular entertainment medium in Fontaine
introduced.quote: the most popular form of entertainment in Fontaine has to be The Steambird.

introduced.name: Experimental Studio
introduced.how: Melies's debut film, which was a flop
introduced.quote: To be frank, Miss Melies, that might hold a little more water if your debut film, "Experimental Studio," hadn't been such a flop.

assumed.name: Film Fantasyland
assumed.quote: Besides, you tried to approach back at Film Fantasyland, didn't you?

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: And that means we need someone whose name is known in every corner of Teyvat!

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: the most popular form of entertainment in Fontaine has to be The Steambird.

threads.claim: Eye-catching content tends to win public attention over long setups, a recurring theme of spectacle versus substance.
threads.quote: people care more about the eye-catching parts than a long-drawn-out setup.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: a Liyue inn that is hiring a temporary chef
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wangshu Inn now hiring... urgently seeking 1 temporary chef, willing to pay top Mora, salary negotiable...

introduced.name: Huai'an
introduced.how: the innkeeper of Wangshu Inn
introduced.quote: Paimon: The notice says interested parties should go upstairs and talk to the innkeeper, Huai'an. Should we go and see what's up?

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: the inn's chef, who burned his hand while plating a dish during the Lantern Rite rush
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: ...Boss, there's really no need for this. It's just a little burn, that's all. It won't get in the way of my work.

introduced.name: Lyney
introduced.how: one of three siblings who are performers visiting Liyue on vacation
introduced.quote: Paimon: Lyney, Lynette, Freminet! It IS you!

introduced.name: Lynette
introduced.how: Lyney's sister, who is greedy for food and pokes fun at Lyney
introduced.quote: Lynette: Right! Besides, if anyone's to blame, it's Lyney. So busy being a greedy culture vulture that he lost track of time...

introduced.name: Freminet
introduced.how: Lyney's brother, who is also part of the traveling trio
introduced.quote: Freminet: What should we do...? It doesn't look like anyone's here... Ah, if only we'd gotten here a bit sooner...

introduced.name: Black-Back Perch Stew
introduced.how: a Liyue fish dish with a bland-sounding name that is actually very spicy
introduced.quote: Lynette: That fish one with the misleading name. Sounds bland, but it's drowning in hot chilis.

introduced.name: The Palace Jewels
introduced.how: a crab and shrimp stir-fry whose name comes from crab roe looking like gold pearls and shrimp like jade
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Heh, this is where it gets interesting. They call it "The Palace Jewels." The crab roe is supposed to look like pearls of gold, and the shrimp meat like chunks of jade.

introduced.name: Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds
introduced.how: a quick but expert stir-fry of several shredded meats that sells for thirty thousand Mora
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: , as it happens, I know a recipe for something called "Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds."

introduced.name: Humbly Enough
introduced.how: a hearty-looking Liyue dish that is actually tofu made to look and taste like meat
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Down to earth...? Oh... Well, we do a mean "Humbly Enough."

introduced.name: Dori
introduced.how: a merchant who bought a new navigation-equipped boat from Fontaine and hired staff for test runs
introduced.quote: Dori: I got my hands on a new boat from Fontaine a while ago, equipped with cutting-edge navigation technology.

introduced.name: Faruzan
introduced.how: a scholar who now works as an on-board consultant on Dori's boat
introduced.quote: Faruzan: Hah! I'm not here to sightsee. Exemplary scholars like myself are highly sought after by cruise operators

introduced.name: Layla
introduced.how: Faruzan's student, hired to fine-tune the compass and equipment on Dori's boat
introduced.quote: Layla: Madam Faruzan and me were hired to fine-tune the compass and other equipment.

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: a boisterous Inazuman who loves food, beetle battles and his friends, nicknamed Bull-Chucker
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Dude! What up, bro!? I didn't know you were in Liyue too!

introduced.name: Kuki Shinobu
introduced.how: Itto's companion who corrects him and passed Liyue's senior culinary exam
introduced.quote: Kuki Shinobu: Almost. I think you meant "fellow Inazuman abroad," Boss.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: an Inazuman who came to Liyue after hearing of an Onikabuto-fighting contest
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayato: ...Not too long ago, I heard a rumor that someone was hosting an Onikabuto-fighting contest in Liyue.

introduced.name: Amber
introduced.how: an Outrider whose grandfather cooked Liyue dishes and trained her
introduced.quote: Amber: He used to make Liyue dishes all the time. I'd do my Outrider training with him until the evening, and then wait patiently at the dinner table...

introduced.name: Eula
introduced.how: a captain who leads the group on a merchant escort mission
introduced.quote: Mika: But Captain Eula brought up the fact that none of us have eaten Liyue cuisine for quite some time.

introduced.name: Mika
introduced.how: a member of the escort group who has been on a caravan mission
introduced.quote: Mika: We just finished an escort mission for a merchant caravan.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: But the Lantern Rite's only just finished, and we're still getting tons of guests... Now's not a good time for me to rest.

assumed.name: Masterful Chefs tournament
assumed.quote: Huai'an: But he's not wrong. Yanxiao was one of the favorites in the Masterful Chefs tournament.

assumed.name: Father
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...Anyway, so that's how we ended up here. But what about you guys? Don't tell us... "Father" sent you on another mission?

assumed.name: Liuli Pavilion
assumed.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: This isn't Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk, this is Wangshu Inn.

assumed.name: Adeptus' Temptation
assumed.quote: Faruzan: Hmm... I had my eye on Adeptus' Temptation, Bamboo Shoot Soup, and Golden Shrimp Balls, but I suppose they'll have to wait for the next time.

assumed.name: Shroomboar
assumed.quote: Layla: Is this... fowl? Wait, no, the texture is more like Shroomboar...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Dori: ...Once I'm back in Sumeru, I'll be sure to find someone to help me recreate the dish.

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: Now, as for the leftover tofu... yes, I'm sure Thoma will dispose of it as he sees fit.

assumed.name: Grandmaster Hanakado
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: ...Oh, and while we're here, we were also gonna see if Grandmaster Hanakado's okay, and whatnot.

assumed.name: Kshahrewar
assumed.quote: Faruzan: Heh, I couldn't resist an offer like that, so I offered to join for the lowest possible pay to undercut all my Kshahrewar competitors.

assumed.name: Arataki Gang
assumed.quote: They've all heard so much about you and are huge admirers of the Arataki Gang, so they will be devastated to learn that they missed out on this opportunity.

assumed.name: Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayato: I'd expect no less of the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King himself.

assumed.name: Haravatat
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Paimon almost forgot that you're also from Haravatat...

threads.claim: Yanxiao's hand burn from a kitchen accident keeps him off the line and raises the question of when he will recover.
threads.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Well, you know what they say... Play with fire long enough, and you're bound to get burned.

threads.claim: Yanxiao's burns have almost healed and he is ready to return to the kitchen.
threads.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: ...How time flies. My burns are almost healed now, so I should be ready to take back the kitchen tomorrow.

threads.claim: Huai'an keeps a mental list of people who can fight, hinting at a past that he has not explained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Why are you even keeping a mental list of people who can fight?

threads.claim: Lyney and his siblings take missions from a figure they call Father, who recently gave them a rest.
threads.quote: Freminet: "Father" said we deserved some rest after everything that happened recently.

threads.claim: Amber's grandfather cooked Liyue dishes for her, and the Traveler's cooking brings those memories back.
threads.quote: Amber: Yeah... That food you cooked for us just now — it reminded me of the meals my grandfather used to make for me.

threads.claim: Eula may have shared those family dinners with Amber and their grandfather, and she may have suggested the inn for that reason.
threads.quote: Amber: Sometimes we'd have Eula around for dinner, and even though she'd always find something to complain about, I could tell she really enjoyed the food.

threads.claim: Mika served on an expedition with the Grand Master and often cooked crude meals during it.
threads.quote: Mika: Back when I was on the expedition with the Grand Master, I was often put in charge of cooking.

threads.claim: The story treats a chef's passion for making customers feel at home as the real secret ingredient of cooking.
threads.quote: Mika: So in other words... the secret ingredient is "passion"?

threads.claim: The Traveler knows special cooking techniques that they have not explained, which hints at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Traveler: I know some special cooking techniques.

threads.claim: Faruzan may be over a hundred years old, which raises questions about her long life.
threads.quote: If she's really over a hundred years old, I don't understand how she keeps going...

introduced.name: Souka
introduced.how: a light novelist and writer the Traveler and Paimon met at the Fungi tournament, now seeking help with a new novel
introduced.quote: Souka's a writer we met during the Fungi tournament.

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: a figure who helps run the Fungi tournament and looks after the Fungi buddies, and who bought Souka clothes
introduced.quote: But weren't you previously helping Haniyyah prepare for the next tournament?

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: a publisher whose editors constantly press Souka to submit her work
introduced.quote: I'm being hunted down by Yae Publishing House's editors.

introduced.name: Fungi tournament
introduced.how: a past tournament where Souka was met and where Fungi buddies were involved
introduced.quote: Souka's a writer we met during the Fungi tournament.

introduced.name: Imaginary Maze of True Heroes Domain in Mondstadt
introduced.how: a Domain in Mondstadt full of mysterious mechanisms and traps that Souka investigates
introduced.quote: I just so happened to hear talk of a Domain in Mondstadt filled with all kinds of mysterious mechanisms,

introduced.name: Labyrinth of Legend: A Hero's Journey
introduced.how: Souka's planned avant-garde novel, a hero's journey through an evil sorcerer's labyrinth
introduced.quote: The title of this all-new, avant-garde work of mine is "Labyrinth of Legend: A Hero's Journey."

introduced.name: Old folk legend of the labyrinth
introduced.how: an old folk legend tied to the Domain and the book, which Souka uses as her only lead
introduced.quote: Why else would I have come all this way to Mondstadt with nothing more to go on than an old folk legend?

assumed.name: Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor
assumed.quote: But for you two, the famous "Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor," that won't be a problem at all!

assumed.name: Traveler's prior friendship with Souka
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's been too long, old friend!

assumed.name: Fungi buddies
assumed.quote: But I couldn't bring myself to rush through the story of my Fungi buddies just to get it finished.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: And you, , are the most experienced, well-connected, and popular person in all of Teyvat... that I can think of!

threads.claim: Souka has come to the place where the story of the two legends, the Twin Stars, began, hinting at a fated reunion.
threads.quote: After everything, I've finally made it to the place where the story of those two legends began.

threads.claim: The old folk legend and the book on the table may be the key to the Domain's secrets.
threads.quote: So this folk legend's the key?

threads.claim: The Domain's puzzle solutions remain unknown, and the novel's plot depends on them.
threads.quote: but I haven't managed to think of any ingenious solutions to the puzzles yet, without which the plot still feels pretty weak...

threads.claim: Souka's investigation of the Domain yielded enough intel to draft some important sections of her story.
threads.quote: Still, I came out with just enough intel to draft a few important sections.

threads.claim: The Traveler does not remember Souka, despite a past meeting.
threads.quote: Traveler: Wait, uh... Who are you again?

threads.claim: Paimon explains that the Traveler may have forgotten Souka from the Fungi tournament, resolving who she is.
threads.quote: Paimon: ，you might have forgotten, but Souka's a writer we met during the Fungi tournament.

introduced.name: commercials
introduced.how: sponsor-funded marketing films by filmmakers, faster-paced than narrative films
introduced.quote: Yes, ever since film became popular, many merchants and organizations have developed a taste for this new innovative marketing method.

introduced.name: commercial editing with Xavier
introduced.how: Traveler and Xavier will make a commercial together by editing footage Xavier already shot
introduced.quote: I shot all the needed material beforehand, so you won't have to run around filming new scenes.

assumed.name: Xavier
assumed.quote: Ho, we meet again, my gallant adventurer friend!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Same as always, working for the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: If you'd prefer not to dine in Fontaine, that's fine too!

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Lambad's Tavern, and the like...

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Lambad's Tavern, and the like...

assumed.name: Lambad's Tavern
assumed.quote: Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Lambad's Tavern, and the like...

assumed.name: world-walker
assumed.quote: Tracking down a world-walker like yourself is no less challenging than pulling stars out of the sky.

threads.claim: Xavier's sponsors give contradictory and unreasonable demands, and his funding is unstable.
threads.quote: Some give contradictory suggestions, while others are befuddlingly unreasonable...

threads.claim: The Traveler is hard to track down as a world-walker, so meetings with friends are rare and unpredictable.
threads.quote: Tracking down a world-walker like yourself is no less challenging than pulling stars out of the sky.

threads.claim: Friends who go separate ways may never meet again, so every meeting could be the last.
threads.quote: we can never know if any given meeting might be our last.

introduced.name: Remnant Records
introduced.how: Pages of notes left by a Fatui researcher, the only surviving remnants of lost records
introduced.quote: Many records are lost, and these pages are all that remain.

introduced.name: device
introduced.how: A mysterious device, assembled from spare parts, that extracts memories and builds challenges from them
introduced.quote: The device could even extract information from my memories and create more complex segments from them.

assumed.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
assumed.quote: Feels like the Golden Apple Archipelago is pretty different from how it looked the last time.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Is that Fatui gear?

threads.claim: The Golden Apple Archipelago has changed since the last visit, hinting at hidden secrets.
threads.quote: Feels like the Golden Apple Archipelago is pretty different from how it looked the last time.

threads.claim: The Fatui may be behind the device, and its purpose may be a hidden scheme.
threads.quote: If this is Fatui business, then there's gotta be some scheme afoot!

threads.claim: Fatui factions or members may be in conflict over destroying their own device.
threads.quote: Maybe there's some conflict between factions.

threads.claim: A personal dispute may be the reason the Fatui want the device destroyed.
threads.quote: Maybe it's because of some personal beef.

threads.claim: The device's mechanism is unexplained and not described in the notes.
threads.quote: But the mechanism wasn't mentioned in the notes at all. What on earth is that...

threads.claim: The challenges were virtual images the device generated from the Traveler's memories.
threads.quote: The mechanism we saw and the challenges we triggered using it were all virtual images created by the device based on our memories, then?

threads.claim: The device affects people's memories and mental state, causing confusion and headaches.
threads.quote: I'm probably under the influence of something.

threads.claim: The researcher's records suggest he cannot remember writing them, hinting at memory loss.
threads.quote: Why don't I remember writing all this?

threads.claim: The researcher destroyed most records, possibly to cover something up.
threads.quote: It's almost as if he was covering something up...

threads.claim: The fate of the Fatui soldier who wrote the records is unknown.
threads.quote: But where did the Fatui soldier end up going?

threads.claim: The researcher may have fled, erasing records and leaving in fear.
threads.quote: I'd better erase all records and leave, just in case.

threads.claim: People may see different things depending on their state of mind, so the visions vary.
threads.quote: Maybe people see different things, depending on their state of mind.

threads.claim: The device is to be buried in the sea sand, where its energy should drain away.
threads.quote: Once buried in the sea sand, its energy should quickly drain out.

threads.claim: The buried device is not very dangerous and should stop working soon.
threads.quote: As for the device buried in the seashore, it's not all that dangerous, and it should stop working soon.

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: Natlan host who loves extreme sports and keeps a water-party tradition from her tribe
introduced.quote: It's a tradition in my tribe, and we're gonna have a blast!

introduced.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
introduced.how: Practitioner with patients and a clinic, who has a Natlan branch and recently returned from Inazuma
introduced.quote: That's right! My friends in Natlan are like family to me.

introduced.name: Xilonen
introduced.how: Service-provider and designer who takes commissions and had been having dreams about them
introduced.quote: Well, I've had some weird dreams lately...

introduced.name: Chief Amina
introduced.how: Chief who cautions that the party should avoid high-adrenaline activities
introduced.quote: But, according to Chief Amina... *ahem*...

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: Place hosting a music festival and party, and home to Mizuki's clinic and Mualani's tribe
introduced.quote: It says... the People of the Springs are hosting a... music festival?

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: Homeland where Mizuki has friends and a branch of her practice
introduced.quote: My friends in Natlan are like family to me.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: Region Mizuki recently came back from, where Akitsu Haneasobi comes from
introduced.quote: You're back from Inazuma already!

introduced.how: Crocodile King, Captain of Captains, a valiant commander with dominion over weapons of war

introduced.quote: And our king... He was such a proud, solemn man in those days...

introduced.name: Seven Pillars of King Deshret
introduced.how: wise retainers who served King Deshret and guided their people toward the limits of wisdom
introduced.quote: Legend has it, King Deshret ruled the desert at the head of several wise retainers, guiding their people to pursue the limits of wisdom.

introduced.name: Aaru

introduced.quote: So it was, then, that King Deshret had Croco, Goatie, and I locked up within Aaru, where we remain to this day.

introduced.name: Great Vayuvyastra
introduced.how: a device that creates strong winds, used to blow dust off stone slabs
introduced.quote: Oh! I've seen this before. It can create strong winds — just what we need to clean off the slab.

introduced.name: three questions gift test

introduced.quote: I have the power to grant gifts inaccessible to the masses. The only requirement is answering a question...

introduced.quote: The author of those notes we found? The student named Zandik?

introduced.quote: When Hermanubis founded that city, he took in many who had nowhere else to go.

introduced.how: an ancient device that measures human brain power and can flood the mind with knowledge
introduced.quote: You two were quite unlucky, bumping into a device King Deshret once used to measure human brain power.

assumed.name: Faruzan

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Phew... I was kinda worried, since Master Tighnari isn't around to help this time.

assumed.name: Layla

assumed.name: Dehya

assumed.name: Cyrus

assumed.name: Cyno

assumed.quote: Oh, hello to you too, Mehrak! Well, looks like your assistant is raring to go, Kaveh.

threads.claim: Layla is haunted by a repeated question about how many moons there are, hinting that something about the sky is wrong.
threads.quote: The moons... The moons... Exactly how many are there...

threads.claim: Layla's memory of the phrase deepens into doubt about whether the sky has only one moon.
threads.quote: (Isn't there... just one?)

threads.claim: Djer heard a mysterious voice in the ruin that told him not to eat Ajilenakh Nuts, and its identity is unknown.
threads.quote: It was a man's voice saying, "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."

threads.claim: Djer suspects the mysterious voice may have been a cat rather than a man.
threads.quote: Strangely enough... I'm starting to think the voice belonged not to a man, but a cat.

threads.claim: A cat's sound appears to guide people out of the ruin, raising the question of what the cat is.
threads.quote: Just as my mind was reaching its breaking point, I could've sworn I heard the sound of a cat guiding me to exit.

threads.claim: The ruin's voice mentions Tulaytullah and the people who still endure there, hinting at a link to Djer's ancestry.
threads.quote: As I followed the cat noises, the voice said something else: "So, there are those from Tulaytullah who still endure..."

threads.claim: The quicksand in the desert is unnatural and leads to hidden ruins, suggesting a deliberate trap.
threads.quote: Later, it became obvious it wasn't normal quicksand, because instead of sinking to my death, I fell into an undiscovered ruin.

threads.claim: Layla suggests her blank memories might come from sleepwalking, leaving the cause of her amnesia open.
threads.quote: Maybe my memories are blank because I was sleepwalking at the time?

threads.claim: Other Layla was in control during the ruin incident, which explains Layla's memory gap.
threads.quote: Layla was already in bad shape, stressing about her new study topic, focusing on the stars instead of her surroundings...

threads.claim: Students report that the desert is full of objects that do strange things, and touching them can cause serious trouble.
threads.quote: I've heard fellow students talk about it before... how the desert is full of objects that do strange things.

threads.claim: Text in the Deshret Script floods the screen inside the ruin, suggesting the ruin is actively affecting visitors' minds.
threads.quote: (Text in the Deshret Script begins to flood onto the screen)

threads.claim: Layla's symptoms resemble those of researchers in the Satyavada Life state, hinting at a known but unexplained condition.
threads.quote: Her symptoms are kind of similar to researchers in the Satyavada Life state

threads.claim: Mechanical beings may feel homesick, and Mehrak's core came from the desert, hinting at a deeper origin.
threads.quote: Mechanical life forms might also feel homesick from time to time.

threads.claim: Kaveh looks troubled at the mention of quicksand, hinting at a personal history with the desert.
threads.quote: Hearing the word "quicksand," Kaveh begins to look troubled...

threads.claim: Thoth's release from Aaru depends on humans answering three questions that King Deshret received from the Mistress of Flowers.
threads.quote: Of course, my questions were given unto me by King Deshret, who in turn received them from the Mistress of Flowers. There are three, and no more.

threads.claim: Thoth, Sobek and Heryshaf remain imprisoned in Aaru, and Thoth still hopes to be freed.
threads.quote: So it was, then, that King Deshret had Croco, Goatie, and I locked up within Aaru, where we remain to this day.

threads.claim: Zandik's note warns that the Ibis King cannot be trusted and that his gifts come at a cost.
threads.quote: Of course, for anyone after me who falls for the temptations he offers, remember this at least: do not trust the Ibis King.

threads.claim: One of the Seven Pillars was never really part of the group, since the Dendro Dragon Sovereign rejected Al-Ahmar's claim to include her.
threads.quote: Although there were Seven Pillars, one was forever absent.

threads.claim: Layla is revealed to be a descendant of Tulaytullah, which may connect her ancestry to Zandik's companion.
threads.quote: Zandik's companion had the same blue hair and pointed ears as you.

threads.claim: Thoth explains that the device caused Layla and Djer's memories to be replaced with repeating simpler information.
threads.quote: So, I replaced that knowledge with simpler, repetitive information.

threads.claim: Mehrak is a remodeled mechanical device once used by King Deshret, and its original name has been forgotten.
threads.quote: King Deshret was quite partial to it.

threads.claim: Zandik declined Thoth's third gift, and Thoth tricked him into staying so that he could not escape easily.
threads.quote: So, I tricked him.

introduced.name: Effendi

introduced.how: Hub where residents and visitors take on commissions
introduced.quote: Greetings! Welcome to the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.quote: Spantamad recently initiated a research project on the Ley Lines and is looking for paid volunteers.

introduced.name: Ley Lines

introduced.quote: There are several researchers in Spantamad who specialize in studying Ley Lines, so there is a great demand for Ley Lines data.

introduced.name: Domains
introduced.how: Dangerous areas researchers must enter to investigate Ley Line Disorders
introduced.quote: Researchers often need to enter Domains to investigate Ley Line Disorders.

introduced.name: Gafoor

introduced.quote: You'll have to find Gafoor for more details about the job.

introduced.name: Puspa Café
introduced.how: Café where Gafoor meets visitors and can be found when a visitor is shown around
introduced.quote: he will most likely bring the visitor to the Puspa Café.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: Scholarly institution where Lisa studied and Gafoor and Cyrus work
introduced.quote: I studied in the Spantamad Darshan at the Akademiya for two years.

introduced.name: Lisa's past at the Akademiya
introduced.how: Lisa studied at the Akademiya for two years, then left for Mondstadt to become a librarian
introduced.quote: But instead of staying at the Akademiya after graduation, I went back to Mondstadt to become the librarian for the Knights of Favonius.

introduced.name: Lisa
introduced.how: Librarian in Mondstadt who was once a Spantamad researcher
introduced.quote: Wow, so Lisa used to be a Spantamad researcher? Paimon's never heard her mention it before.

introduced.name: Cyrus (Sumeru)
introduced.how: Akademiya professor and Lisa's teacher who valued her work and invited her to major projects
introduced.quote: When I first came to the Akademiya, Professor Cyrus really appreciated my work and invited me to participate in several major projects.

introduced.name: Mawtiyima Forest
introduced.how: Location where Gafoor asks the volunteers to meet him
introduced.quote: please come see me later in the Mawtiyima Forest when you're free.

introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.how: The God of Wisdom, whose information the Traveler came to Sumeru to find
introduced.quote: So you came to Sumeru in search of information on Lesser Lord Kusanali, the God of Wisdom.

introduced.name: Lisa's reason for leaving the Akademiya
introduced.how: Lisa quit after Akademiya projects pursuing wisdom beyond mortal understanding failed
introduced.quote: I didn't want any part of that lunacy, so I left.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I do have some relatively simple requests from residents that will pay several thousand Mora.

assumed.name: Elemental Reactions
assumed.quote: I know a lot about Elemental Reactions.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: I heard that you're currently the librarian for the Knights of Favonius in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Of course, Jean gave me an extended paid vacation.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Giving up my life in Mondstadt and returning to the Akademiya as a Spantamad researcher... The price of seeking wisdom is no longer something I'm willing to pay.

assumed.name: Herbad
assumed.quote: With your wisdom and intellect, had you stayed in the Akademiya, you would have become a Herbad by now.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Lisa, optional)

assumed.name: A Toast to Victory
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed A Toast to Victory)

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: It's a pity I didn't even have time to visit that child in Gandharva Ville yet.

threads.claim: Abnormal Ley Line fluctuations in Sumeru Domains require regular monitoring by sending people into them.
threads.quote: because abnormal fluctuations often occur in Sumeru Domains, we must regularly send people deep into various Domains to record the situation with the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: Lisa's real reason for leaving the Akademiya is withheld, and her teacher supposedly knows it.
threads.quote: Our teacher knows exactly why I left the Akademiya after only two years.

threads.claim: Lisa left because Akademiya projects pursued wisdom beyond mortal understanding and failed, and she rejected that approach.
threads.quote: I didn't want any part of that lunacy, so I left.

threads.claim: Akademiya research pursued wisdom beyond mortal understanding, a pursuit Lisa considers doomed.
threads.quote: To be honest, they went too far trying to achieve wisdom beyond mortal understanding, so failure was only to be expected.

threads.claim: Seeking wisdom has a price that Lisa is no longer willing to pay.
threads.quote: The price of seeking wisdom is no longer something I'm willing to pay.

threads.claim: Gafoor's recruitment of Lisa may be his own agenda, possibly hidden from Cyrus.
threads.quote: ...Is that so? You know, Professor Gafoor, it isn't a good idea to lie to people.

threads.claim: The Traveler seeks information on Lesser Lord Kusanali, the God of Wisdom, leaving her role open.
threads.quote: So you came to Sumeru in search of information on Lesser Lord Kusanali, the God of Wisdom.

threads.claim: Lisa mentions an unvisited child in Gandharva Ville, hinting at a personal connection left unexplained.
threads.quote: It's a pity I didn't even have time to visit that child in Gandharva Ville yet.

introduced.name: Jeroney
introduced.how: a dreamer who brainstormed the Choo-Choo Cart and loves stargazing from high up
introduced.quote: So Jeroney brainstormed the Choo-Choo Cart and the rails, all for the love of the sky and heights.

introduced.name: Choo-Choo Cart
introduced.how: a rail cart that can only run within the Veluriyam Mirage and is used to reach areas
introduced.quote: But it can only exist in the Veluriyam Mirage.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: a high floating region whose stars are a shadow of the outside sky and whose edge is reached by rail
introduced.quote: There isn't even a rail line here, and it's way high up at the very edge of the Mirage.

introduced.name: Basima
introduced.how: an Amurta researcher who runs an amusement game at the Mirage
introduced.quote: Passing Travelers, I, Basima, Amurta researcher, beseech thee not to leave too hastily...

introduced.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
introduced.how: a tabletop game by Basima that gives score-based rewards at the Mirage
introduced.quote: Once you've tried my tabletop game "Bing-Bang Finchball", I'm sure you wouldn't hesitate to shout out "Finches are the cutest!"

introduced.name: Guy Verhaecht
introduced.how: an arrogant painter whose diary pages and mural are found in the Mirage
introduced.quote: I, Guy Verhaecht, am confident that one day people will compete just to read my ideation notes.

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolon
introduced.how: gem-colored, pudding-like creatures that are friendly, called Water Droplets by Paimon, and that fix the mural
introduced.quote: One might feel creeped out upon first encountering these flexible, pudding-like creatures with the beautiful color of gems.

introduced.name: Idyia
introduced.how: a benevolent Oceanid fairy who rules the Mirage's domain and gave the painter a magical drawing board
introduced.quote: The benevolent and powerful Oceanid asked that I call her Idyia.

introduced.name: Streaming Projector
introduced.how: a device whose seal is broken and that Hydro Eidolons use to restore the mural
introduced.quote: Hmm... the Water Droplet broke the seal on another Streaming Projector...

introduced.name: Elemental Monument
introduced.how: Hydro, Pyro and Cryo monuments that must be lit together to lower the water in a puzzle
introduced.quote: Ugh, it happened again! One monument lights up, and another goes dark...

introduced.name: Chatillon
introduced.how: head of the Spino Blaster project, a naval battle simulation attraction
introduced.quote: I'm Chatillon, head of project "Spino Blaster"! This project simulates naval battles, but much more fun and casual!

introduced.name: Crococannon
introduced.how: the water blasting cannon of Spino Blaster, nicknamed by Paimon
introduced.quote: It's called the Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-Armored Heavy Naval Battleship-Style Recreational Water Blasting Cannon!

introduced.name: Lafeinte
introduced.how: self-described Blade Dancer who runs the Dance of Flashing Thought combat trial
introduced.quote: I am Lafeinte, the Blade Dancer. Might I be so bold as to inquire by which esteemed names you are known?

introduced.name: Dance of Flashing Thought
introduced.how: a combat trial where opponents appear as Phantoms, as explained by Lafeinte
introduced.quote: Thanks to Miss Idyia, during the "Dance of Flashing Thought," various opponents will appear as Phantoms, trying to smash you into pieces.

introduced.name: Returning Curios
introduced.how: an old tradition where guests bury Mementos with ciphers for later guests to decipher and find
introduced.quote: Idyia: This is "Returning Curios" — Deciphering ciphers to reveal the treasures of guests' past! And then, passing down our own stories.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: a revitalized place where lost fantastical items are swept by a vortex and end up
introduced.quote: Idyia: "Returning Curios," as the name indicates, refers to the multitude of fantastical items that have been swept into the vortex and funneled into the Veluriyam Mirage.

introduced.name: Idyia
introduced.how: the keeper of the Mirage who knows every part of it and runs the Returning Curios tradition
introduced.quote: Idyia: If it's answers about Veluriyam Mirage that you seek, then you've come to the right person. I know Veluriyam Mirage like the ripples on my palm.

introduced.name: Mementos
introduced.how: treasures guests bury in the Mirage, each holding a story and matched to a cipher
introduced.quote: Idyia: Anyway, he buried his most prized possessions in the place that touched him most deeply. Those were his "Mementos" — three pocket watches made of Mora.

introduced.name: Mora Pocketwatch
introduced.how: the legendary Mora pocket watches buried by a veteran adventurer that were never recovered
introduced.quote: Idyia: Unfortunately, though they searched the whole Veluriyam Mirage, they were still unable to find the treasure trove hidden by the cipher.

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolons
introduced.how: gentle water creatures that can gather, transform, and befriend visitors
introduced.quote: Idyia: The child didn't find her finches and Crystalflies, but she had a wonderful time playing with the gentle Hydro Eidolons, who became her squishy new friends.

introduced.name: Clusterleaf of Cultivation
introduced.how: a high sealed structure that Water Droplets can gather together to unlock
introduced.quote: Paimon: We were right! The Water Droplets can gather together to unlock the seal of the Clusterleaf of Cultivation!

introduced.name: Sweet Flower
introduced.how: a flower used in many of Paimon's favorite dishes and picked at the journey's start
introduced.quote: Paimon: You're right, many of Paimon's favorite dishes use Sweet Flowers.

introduced.name: Madiha
introduced.how: a self-styled Phantom Toy Master, broke and in need of help testing her toy
introduced.quote: Madiha: That is the trade secret of turning the tides that I, the Phantom Toy Master Madiha, am bestowing upon you in return for your aid.

introduced.name: Barking Fox
introduced.how: a toy flyer with a hot air balloon for lift and a hidden jet for propulsion
introduced.quote: Madiha: Anyway, a small hot air balloon provides lift for the Barking Fox while the hidden jet provides propulsion, so it has excellent maneuverability.

introduced.name: Mr. Hideie
introduced.how: an old man from Inazuma who arrived with the Shinrou Casket and wished to be sent to a past battlefield
introduced.quote: Idyia: The old man was from Inazuma. His first question upon arriving here was whether this Domain fulfills wishes, and he wanted to be sent to a battlefield of the past...

introduced.name: Flight envelope test challenges
introduced.how: tests Madiha set up from past adventurers' experiences to refine the Barking Fox
introduced.quote: Madiha: Time is money! Let's get to it. I sought help from a few adventurers in the past and set up a few flight envelope test challenges based on their experiences.

introduced.name: Lost student
introduced.how: a student who woke in the desert, found the Mirage, and rested in a vine-sealed cave
introduced.quote: Idyia: She was a lost student who woke up one day and found herself in the middle of the desert. She stumbled across the Veluriyam Mirage whilst searching for landmarks.

introduced.name: Disciplined warrior
introduced.how: a battle-scarred warrior who left the first treasure after a bitter struggle in the desert
introduced.quote: Idyia: The traveler who left this first chest was a disciplined warrior.

assumed.name: Ferdinand
assumed.quote: Hey, don't give me that "you ran away from home after arguing with Ferdinand again" look!

assumed.name: Idyia
assumed.quote: Even Idyia... Heh, I doubt she even knows this place exists.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I remember Inazuma has a saying that goes something like, "only idiots and smoke like to rise up high"...

assumed.name: Golden Shrimp Balls
assumed.quote: Paimon would never say something like "Golden Shrimp Balls are the most delicious food!" if Paimon was a researcher.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Oh no! The Water Droplet over there is surrounded by hilichurls!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: After spending several months in the desert, I ran out of Mora and began to question the existence of the fairy.

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: even those that the fastest Kamera lens or pen could not hope to capture...

assumed.name: Shinrou Casket
assumed.quote: Traveler: It seems related to the Shinrou Casket?

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? You mean take a picture with the Kamera?

assumed.name: Finches
assumed.quote: Idyia: The child didn't find her finches and Crystalflies, but she had a wonderful time playing with the gentle Hydro Eidolons, who became her squishy new friends.

assumed.name: Crystalflies
assumed.quote: Idyia: The child didn't find her finches and Crystalflies, but she had a wonderful time playing with the gentle Hydro Eidolons, who became her squishy new friends.

assumed.name: Starfell Valley
assumed.quote: Paimon: While we were in Starfell Valley, we picked a few Sweet Flowers without really thinking about it.

assumed.name: Silver Bottle Courtyard
assumed.quote: Traveler: Someplace high up in the Silver Bottle Courtyard?

threads.claim: Jeroney grieves for someone who could never see the stars he loves, hinting at a past loss.
threads.quote: If only we had technology like this back then, then... then he would have been able to see this beautiful sight whenever he wanted.

threads.claim: The Mirage's stars are only ephemeral shadows of a sky outside the Mirage.
threads.quote: I know the stars here are merely an ephemeral shadow from outside the Mirage, but they're pretty enough for me.

threads.claim: Technology like the Choo-Choo Cart and photos may one day be used outside the Mirage.
threads.quote: With technology like this, maybe one day we will also be able to build a Choo-Choo Cart outside the Mirage.

threads.claim: Guy Verhaecht's fate after his diary ends is unknown and left open.
threads.quote: But this diary doesn't say much, Paimon is kinda curious about what happened to him after that...

threads.claim: Paimon hopes the painter may return to see his friends and mural, keeping his fate open.
threads.quote: Maybe someday, that painter will return to visit their friends and look at their masterpiece!

threads.claim: The mural can lose its shape and shift, which the painter recorded in his diary.
threads.quote: There's still something that confuses Paimon. He mentioned in the diary that the mural can lose its shape and shift.

threads.claim: The Hydro Eidolons restore the mural using the Streaming Projectors and the mural is made whole again.
threads.quote: Voila! All done!

threads.claim: Idyia is a benevolent fairy-like being who knows human hearts and hints at deeper nature.
threads.quote: This name, Idyia, has indeed been mentioned in many legends and fairy tales, and it has largely represented a benevolent soul who knows human intents and hearts well.

threads.claim: The Hydro Eidolons protected the painter's mural out of loyalty to their friend.
threads.quote: They protected their friend's mural.

threads.claim: Lafeinte's Dance of Flashing Thought trial features Phantoms and is tied to Idyia.
threads.quote: Thanks to Miss Idyia, during the "Dance of Flashing Thought," various opponents will appear as Phantoms, trying to smash you into pieces.

threads.claim: The text frames the true value of a treasure as the story hidden inside it rather than its worth.
threads.quote: Idyia: Anyway, it's not about the value of the treasure or the watch, but the stories hidden inside the treasures!

threads.claim: The three Mora pocket watches buried by the veteran adventurer were never found by the searching guests.
threads.quote: Idyia: Unfortunately, though they searched the whole Veluriyam Mirage, they were still unable to find the treasure trove hidden by the cipher.

threads.claim: A Mora pocket watch turns up later in the park, and Idyia admits she forgot where it had been buried.
threads.quote: Idyia: Actually, it never occurred to me that someone would find this pocket watch... After all, even I forgot where it was buried.

threads.claim: Idyia cannot recall the watches or the cipher and has to check records, hinting she is an unreliable keeper of the Mirage's history.
threads.quote: Idyia: I only remember the stories he wanted to tell. Uh, right... what was the cipher again? Give me a moment, let me check to see if there are any records...

threads.claim: The old man from Inazuma wished to be sent to a past battlefield, and Idyia recreated it from his memories with the bottle's mirage.
threads.quote: Idyia: So, I used the bottle's mirage to recreate the battlefield from his mind.

threads.claim: A letter found in the park is a will and chronicle tied to the old man who brought the Shinrou Casket.
threads.quote: Idyia: And based on its contents, it's closer to a will and a chronicle than a letter.

threads.claim: The lost student's sudden waking in the desert hints at a pattern that may parallel the Traveler's own arrival.
threads.quote: Paimon: But waking up in a strange place... that sounds familiar.

threads.claim: Madiha believes taking ever-bigger loans is how to reverse a failing fortune, hinting at future financial trouble.
threads.quote: Madiha: The more your cash flow dries up, the bigger the loan you take out!

threads.claim: Water Droplets, which are Hydro Eidolons, can gather together to unlock the seal of the Clusterleaf of Cultivation.
threads.quote: Paimon: We were right! The Water Droplets can gather together to unlock the seal of the Clusterleaf of Cultivation!

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon join the Returning Curios tradition by burying their own Memento for future guests to find.
threads.quote: Paimon: Let's help continue this tradition too! We can bury a story here that belongs only to us, then we can think about what Memento and cipher to leave while we search!

introduced.name: Tsurumi Island
introduced.how: fog-shrouded island far off the beaten track, the commission's investigation area
introduced.quote: The area to be investigated is on Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Inazuma Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: the Guild that posts commissions and keeps contact with branches across Teyvat
introduced.quote: We of the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild are normally in contact with the other branches throughout Teyvat.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staff member who offers the investigation commission and reports the situation
introduced.quote: Your recent commission completion record has been stellar indeed.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: the academic institution Hosseini, the commission poster, belongs to
introduced.quote: the person who posted this commission appears to be a researcher from the Sumeru Akademiya.

introduced.name: Ruin Grader
introduced.how: autonomous machine met on Tsurumi Island that can revive itself
introduced.quote: A Ruin Grader? Huh, so Tsurumi Island's got these things too.

introduced.name: Anomalous Ruin Grader model
introduced.how: a special, far more advanced Ruin Grader that regenerates and draws power externally
introduced.quote: We could consider it a special anomalous model, even!

introduced.name: Hosseini
introduced.how: Akademiya researcher who posted the commission and explains his research on Tsurumi's fog and the Ruin Grader
introduced.quote: When I came to Inazuma, I was fascinated by the ever-foggy Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Chaos Cores
introduced.how: the power cores that drive ordinary Ruin Graders and stop them when damaged
introduced.quote: Ruin Graders are autonomous machines powered by Chaos Cores.

introduced.name: Pursina's Spikes
introduced.how: ancient tools that disrupt ley line energy flow and can cut power to the anomalous Ruin Grader
introduced.quote: Among them are a few ancient tools known as Pursina's Spikes.

introduced.name: Ayesha's Chaos Prospector
introduced.how: device that alerts the user to ancient relics and ley line distortions, used to find spike components
introduced.quote: This device here is known as Ayesha's Chaos Prospector.

introduced.name: Pursina
introduced.how: skilled ancient maker of precise instruments such as the Spikes
introduced.quote: I truly do look up to Pursina and Ayesha, who were able to make such precise instruments.

introduced.name: Ayesha
introduced.how: ancient maker of precise instruments such as the Prospector
introduced.quote: I truly do look up to Pursina and Ayesha, who were able to make such precise instruments.

introduced.name: Residence Permits
introduced.how: Inazuma law requires them for free movement, so Hosseini cannot place the spikes himself
introduced.quote: people who lack Residence Permits like myself cannot move about freely.

introduced.name: Ancient machines that function in perpetuity
introduced.how: ancient records describe machines that could run forever, possibly linked to the anomalous model
introduced.quote: According to the texts, there were once machines that could function in perpetuity.

assumed.name: Mondstadt and Liyue
assumed.quote: Your exploits in Mondstadt and Liyue are known to us.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: We of the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild are normally in contact with the other branches throughout Teyvat.

assumed.name: Ley lines
assumed.quote: which I strongly believe might be the ley lines.

assumed.name: Ruin Guards and Ruin Hunters
assumed.quote: its function seem vastly different from your ordinary wandering Ruin Guards or Ruin Hunters.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: First, I couldn't secure long-term residence in Ritou

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: Agh, Archon... What a colossal waste! No, it's a colossal error!

threads.claim: A Ruin Grader revives itself after being destroyed, which no one has seen before.
threads.quote: What's going on? This Ruin Grader's... reviving itself! That's one Paimon's never seen before!

threads.claim: The commissioner gave no warning of the revival, and Hosseini suspects a self-repair module powered from outside.
threads.quote: I believe this Ruin Grader to have some kind of self-repair module built into it.

threads.claim: Disabling the spikes cuts the anomalous Ruin Grader off from its power, and the Traveler defeats it for good.
threads.quote: Traveler: Our problem has been solved.

threads.claim: The anomalous Ruin Grader may draw its power from the ley lines rather than from a Chaos Core.
threads.quote: Its power comes from an external source, which I strongly believe might be the ley lines.

threads.claim: Tsurumi Island is shrouded in fog all year round, and its weather is unusual.
threads.quote: The weather on the island can be considered quite unique, and it is shrouded in fog all year around.

threads.claim: Every attempt to go deeper into the fogged island has failed, and an unfogged island was found nearby.
threads.quote: each one of my attempts to go deeper into the island have ended in abject failure.

threads.claim: The Guild's previous adventurer abandoned the commission soon after arriving, without explaining why.
threads.quote: the adventurer we sent canceled the commission soon after arriving on Tsurumi Island.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects the reviving Ruin Grader is why the previous adventurer gave up.
threads.quote: Actually, is *this* why the previous adventurer gave up?

threads.claim: The anomalous Ruin Grader was an experimental model, and its original creator's purpose is unknown.
threads.quote: Why did its initial creator make it in the first place?

threads.claim: Ancient texts describe machines that could operate in perpetuity, possibly reflected in the anomalous model.
threads.quote: According to the texts, there were once machines that could function in perpetuity.

threads.claim: The anomalous Ruin Grader might be an important product of ancient energy research, if the records are reliable.
threads.quote: If such records are reliable, this special Ruin Grader could have been an important product of the ancients' research into energy.

threads.claim: Hosseini argues that inherited ancient knowledge is the most valuable resource and made the solution possible.
threads.quote: it is knowledge that is the most valuable resource in the world.

threads.claim: Pursina and Ayesha are celebrated ancient craftspeople whose precise instruments deserve study.
threads.quote: I truly do look up to Pursina and Ayesha, who were able to make such precise instruments.

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: an alchemist whose research focus is different from Sucrose's and Albedo's
introduced.quote: Take us for example — Timaeus, Albedo, and I all have very different research foci.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: is holding a winter training camp on Dragonspine
introduced.quote: The Adventurers' Guild is holding winter training on Dragonspine.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: leads the Adventurers' Guild winter training plan and is the branch master
introduced.quote: You're the branch master! You're awesome!

introduced.name: Joel
introduced.how: a lost kid from the camp whose father went missing
introduced.quote: when I was patrolling the perimeter of Dragonspine, I found a lost kid named Joel.

introduced.name: Eula
introduced.how: Spindrift Knight and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company
introduced.quote: This is Eula, the Spindrift Knight and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company...

introduced.name: Gerald
introduced.how: introduces himself as a new adventurer
introduced.quote: My name is Gerald, I'm a new adventurer...

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: several knights stepped in as instructors for the winter event
introduced.quote: A few people from the Knights of Favonius stepped up in order to help support the event.

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: a cold mountain where adventurers train and where Durin died
introduced.quote: Dragonspine is an excellent place for budding adventurers to challenge themselves and improve

introduced.name: Albedo
introduced.how: a synthetic human created by alchemy, who lives for academic knowledge
introduced.quote: I am a synthetic human being... a human forged by human hand.

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Albedo's creator and teacher, a researcher from Khaenri'ah also known as Gold
introduced.quote: her name is Rhinedottir — a researcher from Khaenri'ah, also known as

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: a nation that had already been destroyed before Albedo came into being
introduced.quote: But when I came into being, Khaenri'ah had already been destroyed.

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: a venomous dragon created by Rhinedottir alongside Albedo, who died on Dragonspine
introduced.quote: the other is the venomous dragon, Durin, who died here.

introduced.name: Starsilver
introduced.how: ore that can be refined into high-quality silver paint, though impurities lower its quality
introduced.quote: Starsilver can be used to make high-quality silver paint.

introduced.name: Benny's Adventure Team
introduced.how: Bennett's team, with Bennett as its leader and only actual member
introduced.quote: as the leader of Benny's Adventure Team as well as the only actual member, I had to come on my own.

introduced.name: Bennett
introduced.how: introduces himself as a veteran adventurer who came to help the rookies
introduced.quote: It's me, Bennett!

introduced.name: Key (The Snowy Past)
introduced.how: the key to Bennett's cage, which the Fatui were carrying
introduced.quote: The key should be someplace nearby, please help me find it!

introduced.name: Albedo's stolen alchemy notes
introduced.how: alchemy notes were stolen from Albedo's campsite, with the campsite torn up
introduced.quote: Some of my alchemy notes are missing.

introduced.name: Albedo impostor
introduced.how: someone was impersonating Albedo and attacked Joel and Eula
introduced.quote: Eula, it sounds like you met an impostor. Someone who was impersonating me.

introduced.name: Fellflower
introduced.how: a mutated whopperflower that disguised itself as Albedo and can turn into a plant
introduced.quote: Paimon: What in the world was that thing!? One moment it was human, the next it was a plant...

introduced.name: Whopperflower
introduced.how: a mimicking plant monster that imitates the plants near it and can disguise itself as a human
introduced.quote: Albedo: Whopperflowers are masters of mimicry, and those we encounter in the wild often appear in the vicinity of the plants they impersonate.

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: a venomous dragon whose remains lie on Dragonspine
introduced.quote: Albedo: This mountain is home to the remains of Durin, the venomous dragon.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarder Insignia
introduced.how: a two-sided insignia that Bennett flips to guess his luck
introduced.quote: Bennett: It has two sides, so there is a 50-50 chance of me getting it correct.

introduced.name: Gerald
introduced.how: a new rookie whom Eula has set to physical training
introduced.quote: Eula: Fortunately, I made advance arrangements for Gerald to remain in a safe location and conduct some basic physical training exercises.

introduced.name: Albedo's artificial origin
introduced.how: Albedo is artificially created, and his diamond-shaped mark is the sign of this
introduced.quote: Albedo: This mark is a sign of my artificial origins, and proof of my imperfection as a human.

introduced.name: Primordial Human Project
introduced.how: a failed project whose abandoned specimen Albedo describes himself as being
introduced.quote: Albedo: The failure of the Primordial Human Project...

introduced.name: Subject One
introduced.how: a synthetic human created by an alchemist who passes as a normal human
introduced.quote: A great alchemist once created Subject One.

introduced.name: Subject Two
introduced.how: a failed experiment, resurrected by a dragon, who plots to replace Subject One
introduced.quote: Subject Two was one such failed experiment.

introduced.name: Subject Three
introduced.how: a copy Subject Two made of Subject One to draw him out
introduced.quote: he also created a third entity: Subject Three.

introduced.name: Joserf
introduced.how: Joel's father, found after losing his memory
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce Joserf. He's Joel's father.

introduced.name: Reckless Pallad
introduced.how: a reckless adventurer who found Joserf after falling down a slope
introduced.quote: Pallad is the hero of the hour this time!

introduced.name: Powdered rime
introduced.how: a powder that keeps a snowman from melting
introduced.quote: It's powdered rime — just add it to your snowman, and it will never melt.

introduced.name: Neck mark on synthetic humans
introduced.how: the neck mark on synthetic humans is a symbol of imperfection
introduced.quote: for these marks were symbols of imperfection.

introduced.name: Mimic plant
introduced.how: a plant with mimicry powers, transformed with dragon blood and alchemy
introduced.quote: Then, he found a plant with mimicry capabilities and transformed it using dragon blood and alchemy.

introduced.name: Dragon resurrection
introduced.how: a dragon swallowed failed experiments and later revived one on a snowy mountain
introduced.quote: He was swallowed by a great dragon that came to rest upon a snowswept mountain.

introduced.name: Buried fruit on Dragonspine
introduced.how: fruit buried on Dragonspine stays fresh for a long time
introduced.quote: Fruit buried on Dragonspine will stay fresh for much longer.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: before Albedo showed up, everyone in Mondstadt thought alchemy was useless.

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Hello, you two! It's been a long time!

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Hey, Traveler and Paimon! Fancy meeting you all the way out here.

assumed.name: Fischl
assumed.quote: we originally asked Fischl to be an instructor, but she was busy with something outside of Mondstadt

assumed.name: Lawrence name
assumed.quote: he doesn't know what the Lawrence name means to people in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: We drove off the Fatui.

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Didn't Razor wanna come with you?

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: hilichurl break-ins and other such incidents are not unheard-of on Dragonspine.

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: Eula: I'm quite familiar with Dragonspine by now.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Albedo: I made a few dishes based on some popular Mondstadt recipes. This is no Good Hunter, but there should be enough to go around.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Amber: Hmm, sure is! Give me a Sticky Honey Roast from Good Hunter any day!

assumed.name: Sara
assumed.quote: Amber: I used to take Eula to Good Hunter a lot back when we first met. Before long, Sara would start cooking our usual orders as soon as she saw us coming.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Amber: In a hostile environment like this, even a knight of Favonius has to keep their eyes open and keep their wits about them at all times.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sounds great! But we still have to help out the Adventurers' Guild...

assumed.name: Pallad
assumed.quote: Bennett: We ran into Pallad earlier. You know, the, uh... kind of a reckless sort of guy? You know the one?

assumed.name: Joel
assumed.quote: Amber: Joel's been doing pretty good. Having people to play with has put him in a good mood.

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: Amber: Cyrus doesn't seem to be here... He must have headed up the mountain. Let's wait for him here.

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Bennett: Haha, you know me, same old Bennett... unlucky as ever.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Albedo: It is a wondrous and beautiful art form. Alice says that these marks are seen as proof of the maker's fine handiwork, the only flaw in an otherwise perfect work of art.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Paimon: Guess what? Paimon's story is finished! Let's go see Albedo again!

assumed.name: Eula
assumed.quote: Eula: Thought we might find you here.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, is that Amber?

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: We're here to deliver a message from Cyrus.

assumed.name: Joel
assumed.quote: Joel: Dad! This is that traveler I was telling you about.

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Bennett: Uh-oh...

assumed.name: Timaeus
assumed.quote: Maybe we should try Timaeus again.

assumed.name: Sunsettias
assumed.quote: Nooo, but Paimon's Sunsettias are gonna go to waste without it!

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: But you can never let your guard down on Dragonspine.

assumed.name: Durin
assumed.quote: Monsters mutated with Durin's power and blood are also creatures of Rhinedottir, just like me.

assumed.name: Rhinedottir
assumed.quote: Monsters mutated with Durin's power and blood are also creatures of Rhinedottir, just like me.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I thought he must have been someone from the Adventurers' Guild here for the event.

threads.claim: Albedo has secrets he cannot fully explain, and he says he did not wish to deceive the Traveler.
threads.quote: while I did not wish to deceive you, there were certain things I could not go into detail on.

threads.claim: Albedo reveals he is a synthetic human created by Rhinedottir, answering the question of his secret.
threads.quote: I am a synthetic human being... a human forged by human hand.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah was destroyed before Albedo was created, and Albedo has no memories of it.
threads.quote: But when I came into being, Khaenri'ah had already been destroyed. I have no memories of it.

threads.claim: Durin's life force is strange and tenacious, even after death.
threads.quote: A strange and tenacious life force.

threads.claim: Durin's power may drive people to madness, which Albedo treats as a guess.
threads.quote: Perhaps, Durin's power drives people to madness... But that's merely crude conjecture.

threads.claim: An impostor is impersonating Albedo, and it is unclear whether he is also the thief.
threads.quote: Eula, it sounds like you met an impostor. Someone who was impersonating me.

threads.claim: Strange noises and a feeling of being watched on Dragonspine may come from a hidden presence.
threads.quote: On the way here, we kept hearing weird noises and it felt like someone was watching us the whole time...

threads.claim: The stolen alchemy notes are valuable to someone who understands alchemy, and the thief's motive is unknown.
threads.quote: But for someone who knows what they're doing... the knowledge contained in those notes is more valuable than any treasure.

threads.claim: Joel's father has gone missing, and Joel is lonely on Dragonspine.
threads.quote: Joel's father went missing.

threads.claim: A false Albedo is suspected of being behind the group's troubles.
threads.quote: Paimon: Could it be the impostor?

threads.claim: The impostor is revealed as a whopperflower that mimics plants and disguises itself as humans.
threads.quote: Albedo: Whopperflowers are masters of mimicry, and those we encounter in the wild often appear in the vicinity of the plants they impersonate.

threads.claim: Albedo was secretly protecting the group, which explains why no one was injured in the fall.
threads.quote: Albedo: If you're referring to having fallen down the mountain and avoided injury, well, that's because I was secretly protecting you.

threads.claim: Dragonspine seems to be growing more dangerous than before.
threads.quote: Eula: Why do I feel that Dragonspine has become more dangerous than it used to be... I hope it's just my imagination...

threads.claim: Dragonspine holds the remains of the venomous dragon Durin.
threads.quote: Albedo: This mountain is home to the remains of Durin, the venomous dragon.

threads.claim: Dragon's blood in the land may have accelerated monster mutation through the ley lines.
threads.quote: Albedo: Perhaps the dragon's blood seeped into the land, then was passed to the monsters via the ley lines, accelerating their rate of mutation.

threads.claim: Albedo's diamond mark marks him as artificially created, which makes him imperfect as a human.
threads.quote: Albedo: This mark is a sign of my artificial origins, and proof of my imperfection as a human.

threads.claim: Albedo may be an abandoned failed experiment of the Primordial Human Project.
threads.quote: Albedo: The failure of the Primordial Human Project...

threads.claim: Albedo was made by a master and was a failed specimen left in the dragon's belly.
threads.quote: Albedo: Master's failed specimen in the dragon's belly

threads.claim: Alchemy could be used to create living beings.
threads.quote: Albedo: With enough research and experimentation, this same technique can even be used to create living beings.

threads.claim: Albedo is troubled by questions about the nature of life and creation.
threads.quote: Albedo: Recently, certain questions have been occupying my mind... questions about the nature of life, and creation.

threads.claim: Albedo's own origin as a synthetic human is hinted through the Subject story and his admission that he knows what he is.
threads.quote: Albedo: I'm glad to hear that. It's okay. I know what I am.

threads.claim: Albedo's neck mark appears and vanishes, leaving the Traveler unsure whether it is real or a prank.
threads.quote: (The mark on Albedo's neck reappears)

threads.claim: Albedo questions whether creation is arrogant and what makes creators worthy of the title of gods.
threads.quote: Albedo: Is creation an arrogant act, Traveler?

threads.claim: Albedo admits he feels grief when he remembers taking out the impostor, a sign of his inner conflict.
threads.quote: Albedo: ...Whenever I think about it, I feel a twinge of grief.

threads.claim: Joserf's memory only partly returns on seeing Joel, and his past remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Joserf: My memory has still not fully recovered, but Joel and his mother... they are the only ones that I will not... no, that I cannot forget.

threads.claim: Paimon asks Joserf about the Boar Princess and foxes, a hint of a past memory that goes unanswered.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Boar Princess, feeding the foxes...?

threads.claim: Monsters mutated with Durin's power and blood are linked to Rhinedottir, just as Albedo is.
threads.quote: Monsters mutated with Durin's power and blood are also creatures of Rhinedottir, just like me.

threads.claim: A dragon's mysterious power revived a failed experiment, a mystery the story leaves unexplained.
threads.quote: Many years later, he was resurrected by the dragon's mysterious power.

threads.claim: Albedo suggests life may take unthinkable forms in harsh environments, hinting at a wider theme of life and creation.
