threads.quote: Life may exist in all kinds of unfathomable forms and in all manner of unthinkable environments.

introduced.name: Lamiya
introduced.how: Akademiya researcher from Amurta Darshan who runs the animal-vision challenge
introduced.quote: Though the two of you cannot tell, I am a researcher from the Amurta Darshan of the Akademiya. My name is Lamiya.

introduced.name: Amurta
introduced.how: A Darshan of the Akademiya where Lamiya works, with matra who can vouch for her
introduced.quote: I really am from Amurta, if you doubt me, just ask any matra!

introduced.name: Inscribed Mirror
introduced.how: Tool that shows the view of the animal wearing Lamiya's device
introduced.quote: Anyway, take this first! It's a tool I invented, I call it the Inscribed Mirror.

introduced.name: Animal-vision equipment
introduced.how: Devices attached to animals that let people see through their eyes, built by Lamiya
introduced.quote: By combining the equipment I developed with the mature tech of the Akasha, we can see the world through the eyes of various animals.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: Rival researchers pursuing similar animal-observation results using tiny machines
introduced.quote: but those fools at Kshahrewar managed to see the promise in such research, and are planning to achieve similar results with tiny machines!

introduced.name: Animal-catching challenge
introduced.how: Find device-equipped animals using the Inscribed Mirror and catch them for a reward
introduced.quote: Just use the images shown in the Inscribed Mirror to figure out where the animals with the devices attached are, then catch them to earn your reward!

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Um, it's actually really obvious, since you're wearing Akademiya clothing.

assumed.name: Akasha
assumed.quote: By combining the equipment I developed with the mature tech of the Akasha, we can see the world through the eyes of various animals.

assumed.name: matra
assumed.quote: Should we report this to the matra?

assumed.name: Weasel Thief
assumed.quote: if you can borrow the vision of a Weasel Thief, you can explore ruins quite quickly.

threads.claim: Lamiya's stated reasons for the challenge slip and hint at hidden motives such as funding.
threads.quote: Ah! No, sorry, I spoke too quickly!

threads.claim: The animal-vision tech records every use, raising the question of whether it could be misused for spying.
threads.quote: Each time the tech is used, everything is recorded. If you use it for anything naughty, you'll immediately be caught and punished.

threads.claim: A rival group at Kshahrewar is racing Lamiya to produce similar animal-observation results with machines.
threads.quote: Anyway, the point is that if I can't produce results ASAP, those Kshahrewar dolts will certainly beat me to the punch!

threads.claim: Lamiya sets living animal observation against cold machines as a rival philosophy of research.
threads.quote: Compared to cute little animals, who wants cold machines!?

threads.claim: Lamiya's research interest began with a childhood story written from an animal's perspective.
threads.quote: This is actually all related to a story I read when I was a child, about a boy who turns into a cat and has all kinds of adventures in the land of cats!

introduced.name: Ninette
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Lepine-Pauline's apprentice and a photographer
introduced.quote: I'm Ninette, and my master is Lepine-Pauline.

introduced.name: Lepine-Pauline
introduced.how: Ninette's master, a photographer who took her on and developed the Shutterflash lens
introduced.quote: It was right then that I met Master Lepine-Pauline.

introduced.name: Shutterflash lens
introduced.how: A new camera lens that captures fast movement and expressions perfectly
introduced.quote: It captures every movement and expression perfectly, even when the subject's moving really fast!

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: Camera equipment Ninette bought with her savings for her photography career
introduced.quote: I wanted to make it on my own someday, so I spent all my savings on the best Kamera equipment I could afford.

introduced.name: Ninette's failed street photography
introduced.how: Ninette's earlier attempt to sell photos on the street failed because she froze when talking to people
introduced.quote: But... when I actually went out on the streets and saw people, I got so nervous that I couldn't get a single word out.

assumed.name: Lepine-Pauline's past rumor-chasing
assumed.quote: Don't tell Paimon you heard another wild rumor and went all in again!

threads.claim: Lepine-Pauline is secretly working on a big money-making plan that the Traveler doubts is safe.
threads.quote: Traveler: (That doesn't sound entirely convincing...)

threads.claim: Lepine-Pauline refuses to reveal the big plan and promises the Traveler will be the first to try it.
threads.quote: Hmph, if I tell you now, it'll ruin the surprise.

threads.claim: The Shutterflash lens is still in final testing and needs real-world data before it is reliable.
threads.quote: But... it's still in the final testing phase, so we need to take a lot of real-world photos to gather data and make sure it works properly.

threads.claim: The Traveler's photos show the Shutterflash lens works well in testing.
threads.quote: The "Shutterflash" lens worked great.

threads.claim: Ninette freezes up when speaking to strangers, which keeps holding back her photography work.
threads.quote: Whenever I tried to talk to someone I didn't know, I got all flustered and couldn't make any sense...

threads.claim: Ninette works up the courage to approach passersby on her own and takes photos herself.
threads.quote: So I worked up the courage to ask a few passersby for help, and I even managed to take quite a few shots myself!

introduced.name: Bayda Harbor
introduced.how: the city where a new shop and later the Lil' Fungi Playground are located
introduced.quote: Come to think of it, someone left a message at the Adventurers' Guild asking us to visit a new shop in Bayda Harbor...

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: creatures that are dangerous when wild unless they have been trained
introduced.quote: Normally, it's pretty dangerous to have Fungi wandering around the city, right?

introduced.name: Haniyyah
introduced.how: a longtime friend of the group, met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament, who keeps Fungi friends
introduced.quote: It really is Haniyyah and Bongo-Head! We met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. They're longtime friends of ours!

introduced.name: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
introduced.how: the beast-taming tournament where the group first met Haniyyah and Bongo-Head
introduced.quote: It really is Haniyyah and Bongo-Head! We met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. They're longtime friends of ours!

introduced.name: Souka
introduced.how: Haniyyah's teacher and partner who guides her and co-owns the playground
introduced.quote: It's all thanks to Souka's guidance. She encouraged me to follow the students' lead and challenge myself to master the skills I needed to learn.

introduced.name: Stormstress
introduced.how: Souka's own Fungi friend, which was knocked out by the group in the round of 32
introduced.quote: This is my very own Fungi friend, Stormstress! You and Bongo-Head knocked us out back in the round of 32.

introduced.name: Lil' Fungi Playground
introduced.how: a commercial district bought and converted by Haniyyah and Souka into a base for Fungi friends in Bayda Harbor
introduced.quote: Haniyyah and I have purchased this commercial district and transformed it into the Lil' Fungi Playground!

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a special camera given to Bongo-Head by a grateful merchant, sealed to work underwater
introduced.quote: Bongo-Head once saved a merchant's child who had gotten lost in the southern part of the Apam Woods. Out of gratitude, the merchant gave Bongo-Head many gifts, including this Kamera.

introduced.name: Helene
introduced.how: an equipment specialist who waterproofed the Kamera's casing
introduced.quote: I found an equipment specialist, Miss Helene, who sealed the Kamera's casing so it can work in the damp environments Bongo-Head loves...

introduced.name: Marvelous Jelly
introduced.how: special food for Fungi that stays fresh even in heat
introduced.quote: The latest improved version tastes even better and stores well, too. No matter how hot the environment gets, there's no need to worry about it going bad.

introduced.name: Marine
introduced.how: a Melusine who is picking Tidalga for a village pickled batch
introduced.quote: I'm picking Tidalga for this year's pickled batch.

introduced.name: Tidalga
introduced.how: an ingredient gathered by Melusines for pickling
introduced.quote: I'm picking Tidalga for this year's pickled batch.

introduced.name: Palace of Alcazarzaray
introduced.how: a Sumeru palace covered in plants that the group visits to see the scenery
introduced.quote: Feast your eyes on the Palace of Alcazarzaray — pretty plants as far as the eye can see!

introduced.name: beast taming theory
introduced.how: Haniyyah's systematic knowledge of beast taming and Fungi, which she has written up and printed as books
introduced.quote: We've also consolidated our past experiences and organized our knowledge about beast taming and Fungi into a more systematic theory, and tried printing a few books.

assumed.name: Bongo-Head
assumed.quote: Paimon: No wonder that message felt so familiar... Guess that means the bond between Paimon and Bongo-Head is still as strong as ever!

assumed.name: Golden Comet and Silver Companion
assumed.quote: We meet again, Golden Comet, Silver Companion. It's been a long time.

assumed.name: Kindlejoy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Souka's here too! There's also Kindlejoy, and... Who's this?

assumed.name: Marine
assumed.quote: Traveler: Good to see you again, Marine.

assumed.name: Port Ormos and Court of Fontaine past meetings
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon remembers that we saw them near Port Ormos and in the Court of Fontaine afterwards, too. It's been so long already...

assumed.name: first Fungi Tournament
assumed.quote: After the first Fungi Tournament, Paimon thought of sooo many ideas for playing together with Bongo-Head.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Souka: Don't worry, Mora isn't an issue for us right now!

assumed.name: Yumkasaur
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yup! Looks like our Fungi buddies really did find some interesting spots nearby, and they're super curious about the little Yumkasaurs too!

threads.claim: The Traveler cannot quite remember Haniyyah and Bongo-Head, hinting at a gap in their memories.
threads.quote: Traveler: Though I can't quite remember... Hello to you both!

threads.claim: The Traveler's memories begin to return as they reunite with old friends.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's all starting to come back to me now...

threads.claim: Only trained, well-behaved Fungi are safe to have wandering among people, which raises questions about how training works.
threads.quote: Unless we're talking about the special cases, the super well-behaved ones that have undergone training...

threads.claim: Fungi cannot eat human food, and their lives may become dull as a result.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, our Fungi friends can't enjoy our food. From their perspective, perhaps, life might be getting boring.

threads.claim: Haniyyah begins researching ingredients that both Fungi and humans can eat.
threads.quote: My goal is to identify ingredients that both Fungi and humans can eat, so our buddies don't have to live off every flavor of Marvelous Jelly all year long.

threads.claim: Bongo-Head loves capturing images, and its Kamera was earned by saving a lost child.
threads.quote: Haniyyah: Bongo-Head really loves the images it captures. So, you can also use it on this trip to preserve these memories.

threads.claim: Bongo-Head shows real talent at photography, taking the group's photos.
threads.quote: Paimon: Speaking of which, Bongo-Head is really talented at taking photos!

threads.claim: Souka hints that a surprise is coming sooner than expected.
threads.quote: Souka: Who knows? The surprise might arrive even sooner than you expect.

introduced.name: World Food Fair
introduced.how: an international food fair with cuisine from four nations, held at Yilong Wharf during Moonchase
introduced.quote: Xiangling: Yep! It's a chance to try amazing food from four different nations all in one place!

introduced.name: Escoffier
introduced.how: a Fontaine culinary representative competing at the World Food Fair
introduced.quote: Xiangling: Representatives from Mondstadt, Fontaine, and Sumeru have all come to take part. Ms. Escoffier is here as the representative of Fontaine's culinary scene.

introduced.name: Masterful Chefs
introduced.how: a Moonchase culinary tradition that was later folded in as custom
introduced.quote: Masterful Chefs is but one example of such.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: an official Liyue force that mobilizes against evil spirits and coordinates with thaumaturge clans
introduced.quote: The Millelith have already mobilized. My reason for coming is to coordinate their efforts with those of the Lan clan.

introduced.name: Thaumaturges
introduced.how: Liyue practitioners of mystical arts who pass them down and guard against evil spirits
introduced.quote: Liyue is home to many gifted individuals who study the mystical arts.

introduced.name: Evil spirits and malevolent forces
introduced.how: malevolent forces gather each year around Moonchase, possessing monsters and causing trouble
introduced.quote: Around this time each year, malevolent forces tend to gather, stirring up trouble across Liyue.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: a thaumaturge institution whose founder is a notable thaumaturge
introduced.quote: The founder of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the Wuwang Kid, and the ancestor of the Lan clan, the Wind Reader, are two notable examples.

introduced.name: Lan clan
introduced.how: a renowned old thaumaturge clan of which Lan Yan is a member
introduced.quote: Lan Yan belongs to a renowned old thaumaturge clan.

introduced.name: Wuwang Kid
introduced.how: a notable thaumaturge alongside the Wind Reader
introduced.quote: The founder of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the Wuwang Kid, and the ancestor of the Lan clan, the Wind Reader, are two notable examples.

introduced.name: Wind Reader
introduced.how: the ancestor of the Lan clan and a notable thaumaturge
introduced.quote: The founder of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the Wuwang Kid, and the ancestor of the Lan clan, the Wind Reader, are two notable examples.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: a place whose associations organize the Moonchase Festival events
introduced.quote: Chenyu Vale's associations are in charge of organizing this year's Moonchase Festival events.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: Ningguang's place where she receives guests with tea
introduced.quote: When you have time, do come to the Jade Chamber so we can catch up properly.

introduced.name: Paper Showdown
introduced.how: an interactive paper play created by Jiewu and Baofei
introduced.quote: Baofei: Why don't you come and try "Paper Showdown"? It's a fun way to work off your meal!

introduced.name: Banner Exorcism
introduced.how: a paper play story about a thaumaturge who lays fallen warriors to rest and drives out evil spirits with a banner
introduced.quote: Jiewu: It tells of a thaumaturge who traveled from nation to nation, laying the wandering souls of fallen warriors to rest.

introduced.name: Jiewu
introduced.how: co-creator of Paper Showdown who had Baofei adapt the story
introduced.quote: Jiewu: So I brought Baofei in and had her give the story and presentation a little makeover in the style she knows best.

introduced.name: Baofei
introduced.how: co-creator of Paper Showdown who gave the story its presentation
introduced.quote: Jiewu: So I brought Baofei in and had her give the story and presentation a little makeover in the style she knows best.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor whose verses inspired Paper Showdown
introduced.quote: Jiewu: I heard a few of Director Hu's verses, and they left quite an impression on me.

introduced.name: Lan Ying
introduced.how: Lan Yan's young cousin who makes Warding Figures
introduced.quote: Lan Ying: Um... technically speaking, Big Sis Lan Yan is my cousin.

introduced.name: Yaolu
introduced.how: a stall-runner who was sick from evil energy and now sells Warding Figures at cost
introduced.quote: Yaolu: So I brought her here to set up a stall on the food street. We're selling Warding Figures at cost!

introduced.name: Warding Figures
introduced.how: a rattan figure with a Qimen Art core that gathers and seals away lingering evil energy
introduced.quote: Yaolu: It has a special Qimen Art core mechanism inside, which makes it capable of gathering and sealing away lingering evil energy.

introduced.name: Qimen Art
introduced.how: an art used in the core mechanism of Warding Figures to seal away evil energy
introduced.quote: Yaolu: It has a special Qimen Art core mechanism inside, which makes it capable of gathering and sealing away lingering evil energy.

introduced.name: Adeptal Energy
introduced.how: energy that Warding Figures can absorb to deal with smaller evil clumps
introduced.quote: They can absorb Adeptal Energy and make it easier for everyone to deal with the smaller clumps of evil energy...

introduced.name: Smaller evil energy clumps
introduced.how: minor clumps of evil energy that appear whenever a big evil spirit does and can sicken people
introduced.quote: I heard that whenever a big bad evil spirit appears, these smaller clumps start popping up too, causing trouble everywhere.

introduced.name: Mowang
introduced.how: a designer who helps thaumaturges and built the sigil kaleidoscope
introduced.quote: Wenxun: And that's not all! Mowang designed this one herself, with all sorts of clever little image mechanisms hidden inside.

introduced.name: Wenxun
introduced.how: Mowang's partner in designing the sigil kaleidoscope game
introduced.quote: Wenxun: Is your head spinning too, Mowang? I feel like the whole world is whirling around me...

introduced.name: Sigil kaleidoscope
introduced.how: a kaleidoscope with a barrage game showing thaumaturges using sigils against monsters
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's a kaleidoscope. You hold it up to your eye, and all sorts of pretty patterns appear inside.

introduced.name: Sigil barrage game
introduced.how: a game portraying thaumaturges using sigils to defeat monsters, meant to build public support
introduced.quote: Mowang: So I modified this kaleidoscope to show a simple portrayal of thaumaturges using sigils to defeat monsters.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Paimon: Xiangling sent us a letter saying she wants us to head over to Yilong Wharf.

assumed.name: Lan Yan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lan Yan — and Ningguang too! Long time no see!

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Paimon: Lan Yan — and Ningguang too! Long time no see!

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zhongli?

assumed.name: Chongyun
assumed.quote: Lan Yan: Actually, if it weren't for Director Hu and Chongyun...

assumed.name: Silverwing
assumed.quote: Zhongli: I suspect the same was true for Wind Reader. At first, he simply took a liking to Silverwing's eyes.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Ningguang: Liyue enjoys the protection of the Adepti, certainly, but that is no reason for us mortals to sit idly by, dependent upon them.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Lan Ying: You're friends with Big Sis Lan Yan, so you can have it for free! No Mora needed!

threads.claim: Malevolent forces gather around the same time every year and empower monsters across Liyue.
threads.quote: Around this time each year, malevolent forces tend to gather, stirring up trouble across Liyue.

threads.claim: An unseen force, traced to Lan Yan's art, suddenly suppressed the evil spirits and let the Millelith finish early.
threads.quote: The evil spirits causing turmoil across Liyue were suddenly suppressed by an unseen force.

threads.claim: Silverwing's eyes captivated Wind Reader, and the reflected landscape of Liyue became impossible to forget.
threads.quote: Zhongli: I suspect the same was true for Wind Reader. At first, he simply took a liking to Silverwing's eyes.

threads.claim: Lan Yan's art calmed the frantic swallows, so they may return to Chenyu Vale to nest again.
threads.quote: Zhongli: After you cast your art last night, swallows across Liyue seemed to be affected by it.

threads.claim: Lan Yan suggests Moonchase may someday have nothing to do with food, so its identity remains open.
threads.quote: Lan Yan: That's hard to say. After everything these past few days, I'm sure you know Moonchase events are always changing.

threads.claim: Liyue relies on the Adepti, but Ningguang insists mortals should not depend on them passively.
threads.quote: Ningguang: Liyue enjoys the protection of the Adepti, certainly, but that is no reason for us mortals to sit idly by, dependent upon them.

threads.claim: Mowang believes the thaumaturges work quietly and that the public hardly knows what they have accomplished.
threads.quote: Mowang: So I modified this kaleidoscope to show a simple portrayal of thaumaturges using sigils to defeat monsters.

threads.claim: Hu Tao's verses inspire new creative works, extending her influence beyond the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.
threads.quote: Traveler: Who knew Hu Tao has this much influence...

threads.claim: The thaumaturge's banner exorcism tale is unfinished, with its next chapter still undecided.
threads.quote: Baofei: We haven't figured out where the story goes from here, so that's where it ends for now.

introduced.name: "Saury-Saury Scout"
introduced.how: A mechanical scout built from a Scouting Buddy core and a saurian toy, used for monster recon and terrain survey
introduced.quote: We're here to get the word out about something called the Saury-Saury Scout.

introduced.name: Mika
introduced.how: A junior knight newly working on device development for the Reconnaissance Company
introduced.quote: This is actually my first time taking part in a development project, so I'm a little nervous.

introduced.name: Yanfei
introduced.how: A professional who has previously helped with civil lawsuits in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: I've helped with several civil lawsuits here before...

introduced.name: Bold Bang Bouldern
introduced.how: A fighter who roams the wild seeking tough opponents to practice against
introduced.quote: I was just wandering about in the wild, looking for some new tough opponents to practice against.

introduced.name: The Soulblazer Saga
introduced.how: A popular comic series with a large fanbase across several nations
introduced.quote: Have you ever heard of The Soulblazer Saga?

introduced.name: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey/Snowtrace
introduced.how: A special hide-and-seek game played in the snowy mountains
introduced.quote: They taught us a new game called Snowtrace.

introduced.name: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey/Jade Pitching
introduced.how: A snowball mini-game meant to help guests relax and relieve stress
introduced.quote: and it's designed to help our guests from far and wide to unwind and ease their stress.

introduced.name: Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge
introduced.how: A race event held at Dragonspine that draws guests and adventurers
introduced.quote: the opening of the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge

introduced.name: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey/Trial of Valor
introduced.how: An Adventurers' Guild-style trial of clearing monsters, copying heroes' combat styles, and exceeding one's limits
introduced.quote: And that's exactly what the Trial of Valor is about: clearing monsters, emulating various heroes' combat styles, and transcending your own limits!

assumed.name: Eula
assumed.quote: Eula detests rigid, stuffy people the most!

assumed.name: Captain Albedo
assumed.quote: I don't envy Captain Albedo, having to create purpose-built devices from scratch...

assumed.name: Sumire
assumed.quote: And didn't that awfully serious Miss Sumire say that spending more time in the snowy mountains would be good for your skills, Sayu?

assumed.name: Ninken
assumed.quote: or even to that super Ninken

assumed.name: Scouting Buddy
assumed.quote: Scouting Buddy... Oh, yeah, Paimon remembers!

assumed.name: Reconnaissance Company
assumed.quote: build some useful stuff for the Reconnaissance Company

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: in line with usual practice at the Adventurers' Guild

assumed.name: Windtrace
assumed.quote: From the name alone, this game sounds like an upgraded version of Windtrace, huh?

assumed.name: Collective of Plenty
assumed.quote: Now that's the kind of thinking you'd expect from the Collective of Plenty!

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights have granted me permission to take action and deal with monsters as I see fit.

assumed.name: Goulash
assumed.quote: I came up with a new Goulash recipe using Jueyun Chili and ground pepper

threads.claim: The Traveler's deeds are spreading through many nations, making people like Mika feel nervous around them.
threads.quote: your deeds are getting more and more exceptional...

threads.claim: The Soulblazer Saga has a surprisingly large readership across several nations, including Inazuma and Natlan.
threads.quote: The Soulblazer Saga is super popular in Inazuma, but I totally wasn't expecting to find so many people that read it.

threads.claim: The Knights have cleared most monsters around the Cross Country Challenge venue, but a few stragglers remain.
threads.quote: there are only a few stragglers wandering about at this point.

introduced.name: Ranjit
introduced.how: self-introduction as a chef of creative cuisine who wants to befriend monsters
introduced.quote: I'm Ranjit, a chef of cuisines creative. I've been looking to get along nicely with a Pyro Regisvine, but it seems uninterested in my company...

introduced.name: Pyro Regisvine
introduced.how: grumpy plant creature that spits fireballs and slams the ground
introduced.quote: Spitting fireballs and slamming the ground...

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: distant land Ranjit recently visited, where he made friends and was impressed by its novelty
introduced.quote: Actually, it's because of my trip to Natlan not long ago...

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: creatures that Natlan people dress in imitation of and treat as close companions
introduced.quote: the people of Natlan, especially their warriors, dress in imitation of their Saurians

introduced.name: Primo Geovishap
introduced.how: creature resembling the Tepetlisauri that adventurers meet on the route from Sumeru to Natlan
introduced.quote: If you travel to Natlan from Sumeru like I did, I reckon they'll be one of the first things you'll meet.

introduced.name: Geovishap Hatchling
introduced.how: young Geovishap that rolls quickly and lacks the round tummy of adults
introduced.quote: Geovishap Hatchlings don't have round tummies.

introduced.name: Jadeplume Terrorshroom
introduced.how: fungal creature that pours out spores when provoked and is a target for taming
introduced.quote: Barely avoided drowning in the spores it poured forth.

introduced.name: Millennial Pearl Seahorse
introduced.how: flying seahorse described as proud and noble, one of the Fontemer Aberrant overlords
introduced.quote: the Millennial Pearl Seahorse is described as being "proud" and "noble."

introduced.name: Emperor of Fire and Iron
introduced.how: fierce, cruel, heavily-armored crab-like being, a brutal opponent
introduced.quote: the Emperor is a heavily-armored crab...

introduced.name: Slimes
introduced.how: elemental creatures that can surround and immobilize adventurers
introduced.quote: We often see newbie adventurers and ordinary passers-by rendered immobile by Slimes who've surrounded them.

introduced.name: Kuntur
introduced.how: legendary unlucky warrior hated by the sun who earned his tribe's respect through hard work
introduced.quote: I heard this tale about an unlucky fellow named Kuntur while in Natlan.

introduced.name: protagonist
introduced.how: the central adventurer role in a tale, which Ranjit wants the Traveler to play
introduced.quote: You're the "protagonist," yes?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: If you travel to Natlan from Sumeru like I did, I reckon they'll be one of the first things you'll meet.

assumed.name: Sumpter Beast
assumed.quote: A Sumpter Beast companion's really nothing to brag about.

assumed.name: Tepetlisauri
assumed.quote: Primo Geovishaps are quite like the Tepetlisauri, after all.

assumed.name: Forest Watchers
assumed.quote: When I'd ask the Forest Watchers, they'd make troubled faces, tell me not to snoop in risky places.

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: just like the Aranara of legend.

assumed.name: Iktomisaurus
assumed.quote: earning the recognition of an Iktomisaurus comrade

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Ranjit, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Ranjit, optional)

assumed.name: Fontemer Aberrant
assumed.quote: Perhaps you've heard the story of the two Fontemer Aberrant overlords?

assumed.name: Shroomboar
assumed.quote: It's easy to forget, sometimes, that Fungi are a completely different species from Shroomboars.

threads.claim: Ranjit casts the Traveler as the protagonist of a tale, and he wishes he could take that role himself.
threads.quote: The real pity is that I can't be the "protagonist" myself... Calming these beasts that rage day and night is no easy task, let me tell you!

threads.claim: Ranjit hopes his befriending efforts will make him a protagonist of his own tale.
threads.quote: enough to qualify as the "protagonist" of my very own tale.

threads.claim: Natlan's people dress like their Saurians, hinting at a deep bond between humans and Saurians.
threads.quote: Bet you didn't know this, but the people of Natlan, especially their warriors, dress in imitation of their Saurians

threads.claim: Natlan was once a land of ancient dragons and is now shared by humans and Saurians.
threads.quote: Just like Natlan was once the land of ancient dragons, and is now a land where humans and Saurians put mutual trust in one another

threads.claim: Ranjit once saw Aranara but later lost the ability to see them and forgot them, a memory left unexplained.
threads.quote: When did I stop being able to do so? When did I start forgetting them?

threads.claim: The Forest Watchers reacted with troubled faces when asked about risky places, hinting at real danger.
threads.quote: When I'd ask the Forest Watchers, they'd make troubled faces, tell me not to snoop in risky places.

threads.claim: Ranjit realizes as an adult why the Forest Watchers had worried, confirming the danger they hinted at.
threads.quote: When I became an adult, I finally understood why the Forest Watchers had made those faces they did...

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests that befriending monsters requires a fight, a theme of friendship through combat.
threads.quote: What do they say again? "No friends without a fight?"

threads.claim: Ranjit admits that making friends with monsters is a long-term process that cannot be rushed through battle.
threads.quote: Cultivating friendships is a long-term process, and you need to spend more time after making your pick

threads.claim: Ranjit's childhood dream was to ride a Jadeplume Terrorshroom across Sumeru, a dream he gave up as a child.
threads.quote: it's always been my dream to ride a Jadeplume Terrorshroom all through Sumeru...

threads.claim: Ranjit still longs to ride a flying seahorse, keeping his childhood dream alive but unfulfilled.
threads.quote: Still, if I could only ride it, even once...

threads.claim: Kuntur is hated by the sun because of his father's mistake, a legend that Ranjit uses as inspiration.
threads.quote: He became the target of the sun's hatred due to a mistake his father made.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staff member who briefs the Traveler on the Specter investigation
introduced.quote: Nonetheless, let me begin by explaining the situation.

introduced.name: Specters
introduced.how: rare elemental creatures whose sightings are suddenly rising
introduced.quote: This is usually a very rare sort of elemental creature.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: organization that commissions the Traveler, gathers Specter data, and pays rewards
introduced.quote: The Adventurers' Guild thanks you for your services!

introduced.name: Expeditions
introduced.how: Spectral Secrets Expeditions menu for dispatching companions to Specter sightings by element
introduced.quote: you should get optimal results so long as you follow the elemental guidelines recommended by the Guild when dispatching your companions.

assumed.name: Expeditions
assumed.quote: The form these investigations will take is very similar to the Expeditions you've undertaken in the past.

assumed.name: commissions
assumed.quote: You've done such commissions before? That's great, then.

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer. We're thankful for your arrival.

threads.claim: Specter sightings are surging suddenly at an alarming rate.
threads.quote: Recently, eyewitness reports concerning "Specters" have been increasing at an alarming rate.

threads.claim: The reason behind the sudden Specter resurgence is unexplained and presumed to be special.
threads.quote: As such, there must be some special reason behind their sudden resurgence.

threads.claim: The state of Specters and the danger they pose to people are unknown.
threads.quote: we know little about the state of these Specters or the amount of danger they pose to people.

threads.claim: After the investigation, Katheryne says Specters no longer threaten ordinary people.
threads.quote: I believe that you need not worry about Specters threatening the ordinary people going forward.

threads.claim: The Guild's understanding of Specters is still very lacking.
threads.quote: The Guild's understanding of these creatures is still very lacking, so we are currently mobilizing for an all-hands-on-deck investigation.

threads.claim: The investigation gathered enough Specter data to pass on to professional researchers.
threads.quote: I will organize the intelligence we've gathered and submit them to professional researchers for study.

introduced.name: Nazafarin
introduced.how: introduces herself as a worried visitor from Sumeru who needs the Traveler's help
introduced.quote: And what a pleasure it is to meet you both! I'm Nazafarin!

introduced.name: Parvaneh
introduced.how: Nazafarin's ambitious friend, who is developing a special seasoning
introduced.quote: I have a very ambitious friend named Parvaneh.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: Nazafarin and Parvaneh come from Sumeru, where Nazafarin stayed while Parvaneh travelled
introduced.quote: And I, her friend, could do little from the sidelines in Sumeru...

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: Liyue is the place Nazafarin has come to, and it is famous for gourmet food
introduced.quote: That's why I've come to Liyue, famous as it is for gourmet food!

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: a Sumeru organization of mercenary warriors, some with unusual powers
introduced.quote: They are an organization of warriors-for-hire in Sumeru.

introduced.name: Seasoning that brings happiness
introduced.how: Parvaneh's planned seasoning, which is said to make food delicious and bring happiness
introduced.quote: She once told me that she would manufacture a seasoning that would bring happiness to all people.

introduced.name: Parvaneh's overseas trip
introduced.how: Parvaneh travelled overseas to find what she needed to create the seasoning
introduced.quote: She went on a trip overseas just so she might be able to create that seasoning...

introduced.name: Specially made pot
introduced.how: a pot made by a Sumeru artisan that Nazafarin gives to the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Please, take this pot that I had specially made by an artisan in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Kusanali be blessed. Are you two the great heroes who have come to rescue poor Nazafarin?

assumed.name: Help O'Clock
assumed.quote: Let's go over and have a look!

threads.claim: Parvaneh is making a seasoning said to bring happiness to all people, which is a mystery still unexplained.
threads.quote: She once told me that she would manufacture a seasoning that would bring happiness to all people.

threads.claim: Nazafarin plans to gather feedback on test seasonings to help Parvaneh finish her seasoning.
threads.quote: I believe that the feedback that people will give regarding these seasonings shall help Parvaneh to create the seasoning of her dreams!

threads.claim: Parvaneh is very busy with travel and research, which keeps her from finishing the seasoning.
threads.quote: But she has been incredibly busy with work, what with her traveling and doing research at the same time.

threads.claim: The Eremites include members with bizarre and formidable powers, a hint that their secrets are not yet revealed.
threads.quote: There are some among them who even use bizarre yet formidable powers.

introduced.name: Nazafarin
introduced.how: Sumeru researcher who studies condiments and wrote a report on Liyue's condiment market
introduced.quote: So this is the issue. After you rescued me previously, I returned to Sumeru and wrote a report about the condiment market in Liyue.

introduced.name: Lord Sangemah Bay
introduced.how: merchant who offered to buy Nazafarin's condiments and fund her further research
introduced.quote: Unexpectedly, I was approached by Lord Sangemah Bay, who expressed interest in purchasing the condiments that were the results of my research.

introduced.name: Parvaneh
introduced.how: Nazafarin's dear friend who gave her full support for the research deal
introduced.quote: I then sent my dear friend Parvaneh a letter regarding this, and she gave me her full support.

introduced.name: condiments
introduced.how: secret seasonings Nazafarin researches, which can be added to dishes and offered to customers for tasting
introduced.quote: We will make the condiments, add them to dishes, and invite your friends to try them!

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali! Do you not recognize me anymore?

assumed.name: Sara
assumed.quote: Hello, Sara, Nazafarin.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: I've been thinking that perhaps we could ask Jean to help.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: (Approach the Good Hunter)

assumed.name: past rescue and seasoning development
assumed.quote: After you rescued me previously

assumed.name: Liyue condiment market
assumed.quote: wrote a report about the condiment market in Liyue.

threads.claim: Nazafarin's condiment research is stalled because Sara's restaurant cannot risk its standards, so the Traveler and Paimon agree to help test the condiments.
threads.quote: We shall do it as we did previously. We will make the condiments, add them to dishes, and invite your friends to try them!

threads.claim: Nazafarin describes her own presence as weak and easily blown away, hinting that her state of being may be fragile or fading.
threads.quote: Perhaps my presence is too weak, like a speck of dust that might be blown away by a gust at any time...

threads.claim: A wealthy merchant, Lord Sangemah Bay, has offered to fund Nazafarin's condiment research, raising questions about his motives.
threads.quote: This most charitable merchant even offered to support any further research on my part!

introduced.name: Brest
introduced.how: introduces herself as a former naval artillery engineer, now unemployed, who tinkers with a water cannon for a planned water park
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Brest, and I am a former naval artillery engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute's armaments research team, currently unemployed.

introduced.name: Improved Crococannon
introduced.how: a water-blasting cannon Brest modified from Chatillon's blueprints; it needs no loading and can switch ammunition types
introduced.quote: Based on the blueprints left behind by Monsieur Chatillon, I've made a few targeted optimizations. The new model no longer requires loading, and can even switch between ammunition types!

introduced.name: Chatillon
introduced.how: a legendary watercannon designer whose blueprints Brest used
introduced.quote: Monsieur Chatillon!? You know of the legendary watercannon designer Chatillon!? ...That means you two must truly be experts in the field!

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a nation that once had an impressive navy and is now run by clockwork meka
introduced.quote: Fontaine is now a nation of clockwork meka, and the Palais Mermonia has no plans to rebuild the fleet.

introduced.name: Fontaine fleet destruction
introduced.how: Fontaine's fleet was utterly annihilated in a massive battle, ending the need for naval cannons
introduced.quote: after a massive battle, the fleet was utterly annihilated

assumed.name: Veluriyam Mirage
assumed.quote: we saw the Crococannon back in the Veluriyam Mirage!

assumed.name: Spinocrocodile
assumed.quote: it looks like a Spinocrocodile...

threads.claim: Fontaine's once-impressive armada was destroyed in a massive battle and the navy is not being rebuilt.
threads.quote: after a massive battle, the fleet was utterly annihilated

threads.claim: Chatillon left blueprints behind that Brest is building on, hinting at Chatillon's lasting influence.
threads.quote: Based on the blueprints left behind by Monsieur Chatillon

threads.claim: The Crococannon was seen at Veluriyam Mirage operated by someone other than Chatillon, an unresolved connection.
threads.quote: But the person operating it... doesn't look like Mr. Chatillon?

threads.claim: The Traveler does not recall having seen this cannon before, though Paimon believes they have.
threads.quote: I don't really recall, so let's just say it's our first time seeing it.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: a government body with a duty to the people that Sara serves on
introduced.quote: The Tenryou Commission bears a great responsibility to the people.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: a Tenryou Commission member who rarely relaxes because of her duty
introduced.quote: As a member, I cannot afford to relax most of the time.

introduced.name: Chevreuse
introduced.how: captain of a Maison Gardiennage squad who is always on duty
introduced.quote: Our officers operate on a rotating schedule, but as the captain of the squad, I'm always on duty.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: an employer that requires staff to use all vacation time by year's end
introduced.quote: The Maison Gardiennage stipulates that all employees are required to use our vacation time by the end of the year.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: soldiers who deploy mobile units to help people in the city and wilds
introduced.quote: just think of it as a team of Millelith soldiers who provide help wherever they go.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite gift envelope tradition
introduced.how: locals include a custom envelope with gifts during Lantern Rite, made by the giver
introduced.quote: I heard that, during Lantern Rite, locals like to include one of these envelopes with their gifts.

introduced.name: Candace
introduced.how: a woman who stayed behind to protect her village
introduced.quote: Said she had to stay behind to protect the village.

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: a caravan escort who came to Liyue with Candace's gift plans
introduced.quote: I had to escort a caravan to Liyue, anyway, so she might as well come along.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: a village known for its tea and scenery
introduced.quote: She said the scenery is beautiful, and the village is known for their tea.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the body organizing this year's Lantern Rite street fair
introduced.quote: I heard the Ministry of Civil Affairs is putting on a street fair with loads of cool stuff to do.

introduced.name: Immortal Combat
introduced.how: a street fair game where players duel with rattan figures
introduced.quote: This is a game for the street fair, where you duel with rattan figures.

introduced.name: Eight Adepts
introduced.how: eight legendary people with adeptus-like abilities who gave the group its title
introduced.quote: eight legendary people said to have had adeptus-like abilities

introduced.name: Tao Dou
introduced.how: a giant tree-god on a divine mountain in Liyue during the Archon War era
introduced.quote: It's said that during the Archon War period, there was a divine mountain in Liyue with a giant tree on its summit.

introduced.name: The Sanctification of Tao Dou
introduced.how: the Eight Adepts laid a magic array to purify Tao Dou during a crisis
introduced.quote: The Eight Adepts rose up to solve the crisis, and laid down a great magic array to purify Tao Dou.

introduced.name: Border between life and death
introduced.how: Tao Dou's remains became a border in the Ley Lines separating the living from the dead
introduced.quote: Tao Dou's remains sank into the Ley Lines and became a border, separating the living of Liyue from the dead.

introduced.name: Wind Reader
introduced.how: a Guizang Hermit and founder of the ancient art of Qimen Divination
introduced.quote: said to be the founder of the ancient art of Qimen Divination.

introduced.name: Lan clan
introduced.how: descendants of Wind Reader who kept Qimen Divination alive
introduced.quote: His descendants became the Lan clan, and kept the art of Qimen Divination alive.

introduced.name: Yunlai Swordsmanship
introduced.how: a sword style whose roots lie in the Yunlai Angler's rod techniques
introduced.quote: You may have heard of Yunlai Swordsmanship, which is the style I trained in.

introduced.name: Wuwang Kid
introduced.how: a child-form Guizang Hermit who used Qihuang sigils to catch demons and heal
introduced.quote: That would be the Wuwang Kid... also known as Old Man Wuwang.

introduced.name: Sage Hu and Sage Jian
introduced.how: the Two Sages of Lianshan, practitioners of a secret art
introduced.quote: One was Sage Hu, a master of gourd crafts, and the other was Sage Jian, an expert in bronze mirrors.

introduced.name: Hidden Palace of Lianshan Formula
introduced.how: a hidden palace in the mountains south of Stone Gate where the Lianshan Sages retreated
introduced.quote: I heard there's a hidden palace deep in the mountains south of Stone Gate.

introduced.name: Three Beasts of Tao Dou
introduced.how: the three non-human members of the Eight Adepts, retreating at Mt. Tao Dou, with Ganyu named as one
introduced.quote: As their title suggests, those three were not humans.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: revealed as one of the Three Beasts of Tao Dou
introduced.quote: They were... Ganyu?

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: a funeral business whose founders studied under the Wuwang Kid and still practice a secret art
introduced.quote: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor should be best acquainted with his story, since their founders were said to have studied under the Wuwang Kid.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: the director of the funeral parlor, whom the player has likely not met
introduced.quote: She's the director at the funeral parlor.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: a village the Liyue clinic team visits every Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: Yes, we visit there every year during Lantern Rite to run a clinic.

introduced.name: Pentad Rattan
introduced.how: a cursed rattan figure with a talisman that drains a person's good fortune
introduced.quote: That cursed thing must have been put there to steal his good fortune... it's destroying his health, wealth, and every other good thing in his life!

introduced.name: Fortune Coins
introduced.how: special-edition coins from the Coinage Office used as gift envelope contents
introduced.quote: These are special-edition Fortune Coins issued by the Coinage Office.

introduced.name: Launch Tubes
introduced.how: new street fair toys that shoot fireworks
introduced.quote: They're toys that shoot fireworks!

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: the funeral parlor's consultant, who is close to Hu Tao
introduced.quote: You might want to talk to our consultant, Zhongli. He's closer to her than I am.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a prosperous merchant family whose patriarch is a funeral parlor client
introduced.quote: You don't want the public speculating about why the Feiyun Commerce Guild couldn't seem to afford a proper funeral.

introduced.name: An Su
introduced.how: a butler arranging a funeral for the Feiyun family
introduced.quote: So in other words, Butler An, you'd like to go without the drums?

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: a man who fell ill suddenly after arriving to spend the festival with Ying'er
introduced.quote: A few days ago, he said he wanted to come and spend the festival with me, but he started to feel unwell as soon as he arrived last night

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: a pharmacy where Timaeus was taken to see a doctor
introduced.quote: I was about to take him to Bubu Pharmacy to see the doctor

introduced.name: Dr. Baizhu

introduced.quote: I'm prescribing a nutritious soup to be taken every night before bed.

introduced.name: Chef Mao
introduced.how: Xiangling's father, who runs Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.quote: Dad, I brought some friends over! I'm cooking today!

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: a Liyue restaurant run by Chef Mao and Xiangling
introduced.quote: The first meal I ate in Liyue Harbor was at Wanmin Restaurant.

introduced.name: Lan Yan
introduced.how: a master craftswoman from the Chenyu Vale Artisans Association
introduced.quote: everyone, this is Madame Lan Yan, a master craftswoman from the Chenyu Vale Artisans Association.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: home of the Twelve Tribes, renowned for mystic arts
introduced.quote: Your ancestors hailed from the Twelve Tribes of Chenyu Vale, and were renowned for their proficiency in the mystic arts.

introduced.name: Red Dust Under Rolling Clouds
introduced.how: a scent used exclusively for ritual purposes
introduced.quote: If I'm not mistaken, it's used exclusively for ritual purposes.

introduced.name: Jade-Plumed Silverwing
introduced.how: a hairpiece identifying its wearer with Tao Dou's Three Immortals
introduced.quote: It's the Jade-Plumed Silverwing, one of the Three Immortals of Tao Dou.

introduced.name: Gloomwood
introduced.how: a flame-, water-, and insect-resistant wood used for caskets
introduced.quote: Gloomwood is a good choice. Flame-resistant, water-resistant, and insect-resistant.

introduced.name: Hidden Palace of Zhou Formula
introduced.how: a hidden palace in the Qingce mountains said to have suppressed evil spirits, including Tao Dou
introduced.quote: the book told of a hidden palace in the Qingce mountain range

introduced.name: Lan family of Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: Lan Yan's clan is a distant branch of the Chenyu Vale Lans who practice Qimen arts
introduced.quote: But my family are only distant relatives — we branched off from the main family line long ago.

introduced.name: Qimen arts
introduced.how: Qimen arts are a magical tradition practiced by the Lan clan for generations
introduced.quote: Yes, the Qimen arts have been practiced in my clan for many generations

introduced.name: Fortune Coin
introduced.how: Fortune Coins bearing exorcism sigils have recently become a customary gift
introduced.quote: A Fortune Coin. It has recently become customary to give them as gifts, so in the spirit of the season, this is my gift to you.

introduced.name: Rex Coin
introduced.how: Rex Coins are rare coins that once belonged to Rex Lapis, the Lord of Geo
introduced.quote: This is a Rex Coin, which means it once passed through the hands of the Lord of Geo himself!

introduced.name: Sign of Vaisravana
introduced.how: Vaisravana is one of the four main exorcism sigils and is auspicious, not cursed
introduced.quote: This is the Sign of Vaisravana, one of the four main exorcism sigils.

introduced.name: Eight Adepts
introduced.how: The Eight Adepts were a group of powerful figures who purified Tao Dou in the past
introduced.quote: Even though the eight had remarkable powers, purifying a god of Tao Dou's caliber was no mean feat.

introduced.name: Three Beasts of Tao Dou
introduced.how: The Three Beasts of Tao Dou, also called Three Immortals, were auspicious beasts able to take human form
introduced.quote: Three auspicious beasts, all with the power to take on human form.

introduced.name: Lone Butterfly
introduced.how: The Lone Butterfly of the Crimson Flame gave her life during the purification of Tao Dou and vanished
introduced.quote: The Lone Butterfly gave her life during the purification spell...

introduced.name: Jade-Plumed Silverwing
introduced.how: Silverwing was a swallow who wandered with Wind Reader after purifying Tao Dou
introduced.quote: Legend holds that after purifying Tao Dou, Silverwing and Wind Reader went wandering together, but the white horse retreated into seclusion.

introduced.name: Gold-Eyed Celadon Mare
introduced.how: The Celadon Mare was a white horse who retreated into seclusion after Tao Dou was purified
introduced.quote: Silverwing was a swallow, and the Celadon Mare was a white horse.

introduced.name: Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array
introduced.how: A secret art the Eight Adepts used to purify Tao Dou by obfuscating one gate
introduced.quote: They had to resort to a secret art called the Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array.

introduced.name: Old Man Wuwang
introduced.how: Old Man Wuwang took up the Lone Butterfly's mantle and kept her legacy alive
introduced.quote: According to the legend, Old Man Wuwang, another one of the eight who looked up to her a lot, took up her mantle and kept her legacy alive.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor has a duty to balance life and death in Liyue
introduced.quote: But as the director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, she has a solemn duty to balance the forces of life and death in Liyue.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: Hu Tao is the eccentric director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who takes her work seriously
introduced.quote: I've known Hu Tao for a while now, and for all her eccentricities, she takes pride in what she does.

introduced.name: Border between life and death
introduced.how: The border is a boundary world dividing the realms of life and death, kept by the funeral parlor
introduced.quote: Yep. It's a demarcation line: life on side, death on the other.

introduced.name: Fetor
introduced.how: Fetor is a deadly miasma that leaks out when the border is disrupted
introduced.quote: But since the border has been disrupted, fetor is leaking out.

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill
introduced.how: Wuwang Hill is a place in the Qingce mountain range where herbs are gathered and the border was disturbed
introduced.quote: Wuwang Hill, in the Qingce mountain range.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: The Ministry noticed a spike in sick elderly people in Qingce Village and investigates the disturbance
introduced.quote: About a month ago, the Ministry of Civil Affairs noticed an unusual spike in the number of elderly people seeking medical care in Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Conqueror of Demons
introduced.how: Xiao, the Conqueror of Demons, can guide travelers to the border and sense fetor
introduced.quote: You can seek assistance from the Conqueror of Demons at Wangshu Inn. He will show you the way.

introduced.name: Lan Yan
introduced.how: Lan Yan is a Qimen crafter who makes rattan figures and illusions and is a distant Lan relative
introduced.quote: Put it like this — my grandpa makes a living telling fortunes in Yilong Wharf, but I'm making more than him just selling my handmade arts and crafts.

introduced.name: Qiqi
introduced.how: Qiqi is a herb-gatherer and zombie whose body absorbs fetor in unusual ways
introduced.quote: Qiqi's a zombie, so her joints are stiff.

introduced.name: Rattan figures
introduced.how: Lan Yan's rattan figures are sigil-engraved charms that absorb misfortune for their owner
introduced.quote: It's engraved with an exorcism sigil to absorb inauspicious energy in their owner's place, so they won't come to harm.

introduced.name: Hu Tao's father
introduced.how: Hu Tao's father was a former funeral director who died in a failed ritual on Wuwang Hill
introduced.quote: Yeah, my dad and my grandpa.

introduced.name: Wuwang Hill Disaster
introduced.how: A border incident on Wuwang Hill about a dozen years ago killed many and wiped out a village
introduced.quote: There was a border incident on Wuwang Hill about a dozen years ago.

introduced.name: Eight gates of Liyue's Ley Lines
introduced.how: The eight gates are key nodes in Liyue's Ley Lines that direct their energy
introduced.quote: The eight gates refer to eight key nodes in Liyue's Ley Lines: Life, Death, Repose, Concealment, Initiation, Terrain, Fright, and Injury.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: The Night Kingdom in Natlan is a true realm of the dead, unlike Liyue's border
introduced.quote: But as far as I understand, the Night Kingdom is a true realm of the dead, while the border is more of a boundary world between life and death.

introduced.name: Qimen arts
introduced.how: Qimen arts hold that Ley Line states are tied to human activity and can shift
introduced.quote: the Qimen arts teach that the state of the Ley Lines is intricately linked to human activity.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: the eight gates are key nodes in Liyue's Ley Line network
introduced.quote: the gates are basically eight key nodes in Liyue's Ley Line network.

introduced.name: Homa Altar
introduced.how: altars placed at each gate to channel the funeral parlor's purifying art
introduced.quote: set up a Homa Altar at each of the gates.

introduced.name: Gate of Life
introduced.how: symbolizes growth and revitalization and is the most auspicious gate
introduced.quote: The Gate of Life symbolizes growth, prosperity, and revitalization.

introduced.name: Gate of Injury
introduced.how: symbolizes wounds and loss and is one of three gates of great misfortune
introduced.quote: The Gate of Injury symbolizes wounds and loss.

introduced.name: Gate of Fright
introduced.how: long known as a gate of great misfortune that appears where fear and desolation gather
introduced.quote: Since ancient times, the Gate of Fright has been known as a gate of great misfortune.

introduced.name: Gate of Concealment
introduced.how: a refuge of peace and good fortune where adepti live in seclusion
introduced.quote: This Gate is a place of refuge, peace, and good fortune.

introduced.name: rattan figure
introduced.how: absorbs evil energy in its owner's place to protect them
introduced.quote: they work by absorbing evil energy in their owner's place, so they won't come to harm.

introduced.name: fortune coins
introduced.how: Lantern Rite coins engraved with symbols that carry wishes for the recipient
introduced.quote: They're fortune coins engraved with the yardstick symbol.

introduced.name: Rex coin
introduced.how: a sigil coin that symbolizes good fortune and may serve as a protective charm
introduced.quote: It is indeed a Rex coin. It symbolizes good fortune, and may offer some use as a protective charm.

introduced.name: fetor
introduced.how: a sickness-causing evil that spreads through people's bodies and can kill them
introduced.quote: as long as we solve the core problem, the fetor in people's bodies will dissipate, and they'll make a speedy recovery.

introduced.name: Zombie
introduced.how: Qiqi says she is a zombie and that zombies cannot get sick
introduced.quote: I am a zombie. Zombies can't get sick.

introduced.name: Tao Dou
introduced.how: a god who was neither friend nor enemy to mortals, now the border
introduced.quote: The god Tao Dou was not our friend, but neither was he our enemy.

introduced.name: Tao Dou's sanctification
introduced.how: Tao Dou volunteered to sanctify himself to pacify the underworld and became the border
introduced.quote: When he became the border, he likely never imagined that mortals would preserve and maintain his new form this far into the future...

introduced.name: Yaksha
introduced.how: Yelan's ancestors fought alongside them and died saving Liyue in a past disaster at the Chasm
introduced.quote: My ancestors fought alongside the Yakshas, and gave their lives to save Liyue from peril.

introduced.name: Wind Reader
introduced.how: the founding master of Qimen Divination and Lan Yan's ancestor
introduced.quote: I'd have to pick Wind Reader. After all, he was the founding master of Qimen Divination.

introduced.name: Hu Tao's Father
introduced.how: Hu Tao's late father, who appears in the border to reassure her
introduced.quote: Father: We're proud of you, little lady. But we only came to see you because we've missed you.

introduced.name: Old Hu
introduced.how: Hu Tao's late grandfather, who appears in the border and tells her it is not yet her time
introduced.quote: Grandfather: Our little girl is the best.

introduced.name: Yun-Han Opera Troupe
introduced.how: the opera troupe Yun Jin directs, shown when she takes the stage in Yilong Wharf
introduced.quote: Whoa! Isn't that the director of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe?

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Klee said she really wanted a Lantern Rite gift envelope

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: I need to report back to the Knights!

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Lady Ningguang has arrived, and she would be most grateful if you could join her at Yujing Terrace.

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace
assumed.quote: Lady Ningguang has arrived, and she would be most grateful if you could join her at Yujing Terrace.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: , Paimon, it's been a long time.

assumed.name: Changsheng
assumed.quote: Baizhu wasn't speaking the whole truth just now.

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: This morning, I sent Qiqi to Mt. Qingce to look for a certain herb.

assumed.name: Jiangli and Jialiang
assumed.quote: I suppose you're remembering the events with Jiangli and Jialiang from last time?

assumed.name: Chi blood
assumed.quote: we assumed the god remains in question were the chi blood

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: When the Archon War arrived, Tao Dou was dragged into the fighting, disturbing the realm of the dead.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: They're not actual adepti, but eight legendary people said to have had adeptus-like abilities

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: once I'm back in Sumeru, I'll be sure to send you something in return.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Liyue Harbor is huge, and there are so many tourists coming in from all over the world.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: What're all these Mora for? They're huge! And so shiny.

assumed.name: Yun Jin
assumed.quote: It's been too long, old friends. Are you here for the opera?

assumed.name: Yuheng
assumed.quote: I meant no offense, Lady Yuheng.

assumed.name: Pentad Fortune Conveyance
assumed.quote: Well, I've heard they practice Qimen magic in Chenyu Vale. Pentad Fortune Conveyance, Fate Transference, and the like...

assumed.name: Yujing Terrace (Ningguang's meeting place)
assumed.quote: Lady Ningguang has arrived, and she would be most grateful if you could join her at Yujing Terrace.

assumed.name: Timaeus
assumed.quote: In that case, there's a good chance Madame Lan also purposely left this behind to keep Timaeus safe and well.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: You'd sooner convince Paimon that Rex Lapis was a slime...

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: Let me guess, the Tianquan sent you?

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Wait, Gaming... the last we heard, Baizhu was still trying to figure out a way to help Xingqiu's great-grandfather.

assumed.name: Moonlit Bamboo Forest
assumed.quote: Have you ever read Moonlit Bamboo Forest?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Maybe it's the Abyss?

assumed.name: Natlan crisis
assumed.quote: Ah yes, I've heard a little about the crisis there.

assumed.name: Crux Fleet
assumed.quote: Captain Beidou has agreed to take the Crux Fleet to guard the Gate of Fright.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? Oh, Xiangling! What are you doing here?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: I guess this place checks all the boxes, with all the demons Rex Lapis suppressed here.

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: Even though on the surface, this incident looks negligible compared to the disasters of the Archon War

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: reached Natlan, and took a trip to the land of the dead while there.

assumed.name: Old Man Wuwang and the Lone Butterfly
assumed.quote: The greatest of all were obviously Old Man Wuwang and the Lone Butterfly.

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: thanks to the Tianquan's efforts, we now have the locations of all eight gates.

assumed.name: Eight Adepts
assumed.quote: We're debating who's the best out of the Eight Adepts.

assumed.name: Yelan's past exploration
assumed.quote: I'm sure you still remember the time we explored the depths of this place together...

threads.claim: Timaeus and the great-grandfather are both aging at an accelerated rate, with the cause unknown.
threads.quote: The truth is, they are both aging at an accelerated rate.

threads.claim: A book suggests a god's remains in Mt. Qingce may be causing the mysterious illness.
threads.quote: Wait, so... Tao Dou's remains!? That's what's causing this mystery illness?

threads.claim: Baizhu and Changsheng doubt god remains are the cause, so the true source remains open.
threads.quote: I highly doubt that god remains are the cause.

threads.claim: An icy, spell-marked rattan figure was found under the patriarch's bed, suggesting a sinister curse.
threads.quote: It was icy-cold to the touch, and made the whole room chilly...

threads.claim: Tea Master Liu Su links the rattan figure to a Pentad Fortune Conveyance curse draining the patriarch's fortune.
threads.quote: That cursed thing must have been put there to steal his good fortune... it's destroying his health, wealth, and every other good thing in his life!

threads.claim: The Feiyun Commerce Guild patriarch has fallen gravely ill, and rumors tie it to a cursed rattan figure.
threads.quote: the patriarch of the Feiyun Commerce Guild has fallen gravely ill.

threads.claim: Whether the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor truly has a secret art is an open question.
threads.quote: So it's true? The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor really does have a secret art?

threads.claim: Xiangling hints that Hu Tao holds a flaming staff with cleansing powers, which may or may not be true.
threads.quote: I heard from Hu Tao that she has a flaming staff handed down by her forebearers.

threads.claim: Hu Tao has not been herself lately and seems to be hiding a problem.
threads.quote: But just so you're aware... Hu Tao's not really been herself lately.

threads.claim: Hu Tao admits she struggles with a work-related problem and has trouble sleeping and dreaming.
threads.quote: It's just, I've been struggling with a... work-related thing.

threads.claim: Hu Tao has been having trouble sleeping and dreaming more than usual.
threads.quote: She said she's had trouble sleeping, and has been dreaming more than usual.

threads.claim: Lan Yan's rattan figure carries a sigil and was left behind at the perfume shop, hinting at a hidden purpose.
threads.quote: Plus, it has a sigil on it for some reason...

threads.claim: Tao Dou's remains formed a border in the Ley Lines separating life from death, and its nature is unclear.
threads.quote: Tao Dou's remains sank into the Ley Lines and became a border, separating the living of Liyue from the dead.

threads.claim: The Three Beasts of Tao Dou were not human, hinting that Ganyu's past is connected to the legends.
threads.quote: As their title suggests, those three were not humans.

threads.claim: Hu Tao's recurring phrase about living and dying may hint at a deeper theme.
threads.quote: a phrase that Hu Tao always says has been on my mind a lot

threads.claim: The border between life and death is disturbed and may fail, and Ningguang and Hu Tao are alarmed by it.
threads.quote: A couple of weeks later, Director Hu came to report a potential disturbance in the border.

threads.claim: If the border fails, souls will pour out and life and death will mix chaotically.
threads.quote: So if the border fails, souls will pour out, and the whole thing becomes a chaotic mix of life and death.

threads.claim: The Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array may require obfuscating one participant, which could mean a sacrifice.
threads.quote: But doesn't it involve obfuscating one of the people involved?

threads.claim: Lan Yan doubts Hu Tao's claim that nobody has to die for the array to work.
threads.quote: Mm... I certainly hope that's true, but I can't help but feel uneasy about it.

threads.claim: Hu Tao argues the sacrifice was only a tradition based on the Lone Butterfly's death, not a requirement.
threads.quote: That's the traditional interpretation, but people just assumed that because the Lone Butterfly sacrificed herself.

threads.claim: Hu Tao may be hiding her private thoughts and plans from her friends.
threads.quote: I get the sense that she prefers to keep the truth bottled up sometimes.

threads.claim: Hu Tao is troubled by recurring dreams of people from her past who are no longer around.
threads.quote: the people in this picture keep appearing in my dreams lately

threads.claim: Ningguang suspects the current border crisis is linked to the Wuwang Hill Disaster from over a decade ago.
threads.quote: Do you believe that today's border crisis could have anything to do with the Wuwang Hill Disaster from over a decade ago?

threads.claim: Lan Yan suspects the Wuwang Hill disaster involved more than a flood and may be tied to the border.
threads.quote: But that doesn't explain how Wuwang Hill became the dark and gloomy place it is today.

threads.claim: Hu Tao reveals her father's failed ritual on Wuwang Hill caused the disaster that killed much of the village.
threads.quote: His mistake didn't just cost him his own life — it took most of the village out, and left lasting changes on Wuwang Hill itself.

threads.claim: Zhongli's Rex Coin is probably a replica, so its real power is in doubt.
threads.quote: This is simply a curio I picked up from a street vendor, Master Liu. Almost certainly a replica.

threads.claim: Xiao confirms the coin is a counterfeit that carries only the Rex Lapis symbol and none of his power.
threads.quote: That coin is clearly a counterfeit — it carries only the symbol of Rex Lapis, and none of his power.

threads.claim: Qiqi has a unique condition that makes her absorb fetor differently, and Hu Tao hints it is unusual.
threads.quote: Qiqi's condition is certainly... unique.

threads.claim: Liu Su questions why the Lans of Chenyu Vale would have a grievance with the Feiyun Commerce Guild.
threads.quote: Why would the Lans of Chenyu Vale have a bone to pick with the Feiyun Commerce Guild?

threads.claim: Lan Yan's grandfather's divinations showed everyone's longevity was failing, which drove the Lans to seek out Hu Tao.
threads.quote: Because Grandpa's readings have gone sideways recently.

threads.claim: The array may require one person to be obfuscated, and the Gate of Death means Hu Tao is at risk.
threads.quote: it looks likely that the obfuscation of one person is mandatory after all

threads.claim: The gates' locations change over time as human activity changes the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: In other words, the gates' locations are subject to change over time.

threads.claim: The cause of the fetor crisis remains unknown.
threads.quote: But we still do not know what caused the crisis in the first place.

threads.claim: Natlan's recent Ley Line and life-and-death events may connect to Liyue's crisis on a deeper level.
threads.quote: the nation of Natlan has recently endured some major events relating to the Ley Lines and to issues of life and death.

threads.claim: The Rex coin may be a fake, since the Conqueror of Demons sensed no Rex Lapis power in it.
threads.quote: It's a Rex coin — although, probably not the genuine article, 'cause the Conqueror of Demons told us he couldn't sense Rex Lapis's power in it.

threads.claim: The Ley Lines hold no information about the Traveler, so they cannot connect to the array.
threads.quote: It's true that the Ley Lines do not contain any information about me.

threads.claim: The critical letter about the gates appeared in Yujing Terrace from an untraceable source, hinting at Ningguang's hidden helpers.
threads.quote: a letter with all the critical information suddenly appeared in Yujing Terrace on the day when we needed it.

threads.claim: The tree shaped like Tao Dou in the border has cracks that seem to lead somewhere far away.
threads.quote: they seem to lead to somewhere far away.

threads.claim: The border holds the spirits of the dead, and Hu Tao's family tells her she must not die yet.
threads.quote: Grandfather: Live in life, and die in death.... My child, your time has not yet come.

threads.claim: Hu Tao's father made a mistake that she is determined not to repeat.
threads.quote: But this time, I must not repeat my dad's mistake.

threads.claim: Hu Tao's final words link her to the butterfly, and Zhongli's verse suggests she is the Lone Butterfly.
threads.quote: If you see a butterfly

threads.claim: Yelan's ancestors died in a past disaster at the Chasm alongside the Yakshas.
threads.quote: My ancestors fought alongside the Yakshas, and gave their lives to save Liyue from peril.

threads.claim: The Traveler pulls Hu Tao out of the border and absorbs her fetor, sparing her death.
threads.quote: absorbing the last of the fetor damage from her in the process

introduced.name: Banu
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a child who came looking for the Future Stars
introduced.quote: Hmm, alright! I'm Banu and I came here following the map to look for the Future Stars. There are altogether six of them!

introduced.name: Future Stars
introduced.how: Six stars that must all be found to summon the Great Future Star
introduced.quote: Hmm, alright! I'm Banu and I came here following the map to look for the Future Stars. There are altogether six of them!

introduced.name: Great Future Star
introduced.how: Summoned after all six Future Stars are collected; can be unexpectedly dangerous
introduced.quote: Whoever finds all the Future Stars can summon the Great Future Star, which is super duper amazing!

introduced.name: Banu's Wisdom
introduced.how: Item that runs for a while, needs rest, and points to Future Star locations
introduced.quote: It's a very important item because it can help you locate the Future Stars.

introduced.name: 50 Things Every Traveling Scholar Should Know
introduced.how: Book with a map marking the Future Star locations, written by Shalmar

introduced.name: Ayesha's Chaos Prospector
