introduced.quote: Ah, I get it. It's like that thing from the Akademiya's dumpster! I call it "Banu's Wisdom," but everyone else calls it "Ayesha's Chaos Prospector."

assumed.name: The Eremites
assumed.quote: It's a well-dressed stranger instead of someone from The Eremites or Treasure Hoarders.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: stay away from the Treasure Hoarders and any Eremite strangers.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: You can find them anywhere on the beaches of Liyue!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: should we start seeing the Mints in your bag as Mora?

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: before she starts a new life in the Akademiya

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Since I am somewhat acquainted with both Ley Lines and mechanics, I've made some special arrangements regarding the mechanisms around these parts.

threads.claim: The Future Stars are presented as real and must be collected to summon the Great Future Star, though their nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: But the Future Stars are real! I'm not imagining things.

threads.claim: Banu and Shalmar present invented settings as if they were real, leaving it unclear which parts of the story are true.
threads.quote: Hmm... I think this setting was just made up.

threads.claim: The Great Future Star is revealed to be a Starconch that Shalmar renames within his invented setting.
threads.quote: In the settings that many people imagine, this is known as a Starconch, and it dwells in the sea.

threads.claim: Shalmar presents freedom to talk nonsense and to see the world in new ways as a central value.
threads.quote: and yet I have the freedom to talk nonsense — something that those prestigious sages can only dream of.

threads.claim: Monsters keep appearing suddenly around the mechanisms, and Shalmar denies summoning them, calling them accidents.
threads.quote: They... were all accidents.

threads.claim: Shalmar has made special arrangements with the mechanisms around these parts through his knowledge of Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Since I am somewhat acquainted with both Ley Lines and mechanics, I've made some special arrangements regarding the mechanisms around these parts.

threads.claim: Banu is about to start a new life at the Akademiya, and Shalmar worries about the strain of study on her health.
threads.quote: before she starts a new life in the Akademiya

threads.claim: Shalmar calls himself Banu's biological father but describes their bond as an equal friendship, hinting at a deeper family story.
threads.quote: Being a father is but the very most insignificant of my identities, and I much prefer being her friend to being her father.

introduced.name: Bresson Cartier
introduced.how: a photographer who introduces himself and asks the Traveler for help underwater
introduced.quote: I, Bresson Cartier, modified the Kamera personally.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera Bresson modified, with a lens said to be superior to others
introduced.quote: The lens is countless times better than those you'll find on any other Kameras.

introduced.name: Kamera Club
introduced.how: a group of photographers who dismiss Bresson's tool-based techniques
introduced.quote: But those people in the Kamera Club... They don't care about my new techniques at all.

introduced.name: Guild
introduced.how: a body whose rules set the Traveler's pay for jobs
introduced.quote: I'll need remuneration according to Guild rules.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a region the Traveler's companion is asked about, and where Bresson works in photography
introduced.quote: And you're from Fontaine, aren't you?

assumed.name: Guild
assumed.quote: I'll need remuneration according to Guild rules.

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: After which I shall be dragged into the watery depths, never to be seen again... I... Oh, Archons...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Not every person from Liyue can cook, and not every Mondstadter's a poet!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Not every person from Liyue can cook, and not every Mondstadter's a poet!

threads.claim: The Kamera Club argues that photographic skill matters more than equipment, a debate Bresson wants to win.
threads.quote: They claim that the key to photography lies in the skill of the photographers themselves, and not their tools...

threads.claim: The future of photography in Fontaine is presented as hanging on Bresson's underwater work and new equipment.
threads.quote: the future of photography in Fontaine would have gone down the... water!

introduced.name: Almond
introduced.how: Elder of the Forest of Blessings who introduces himself and says he has waited for the Hero of Prophecy
introduced.quote: I'm an elder of the Forest of Blessings. I've been waiting here for the Hero of Prophecy to arrive.

introduced.name: Forest of Blessings
introduced.how: Forest of talking paper creatures where the Goddess of Creation founded the community
introduced.quote: I'm an elder of the Forest of Blessings

introduced.name: Hut of Blessings
introduced.how: Home of the Forest Fairy, where the forest's books are kept
introduced.quote: For now, why don't you come with me to the Hut of Blessings? Our Forest Fairy lives there.

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: The name of this world, created by three goddesses
introduced.quote: A long, long time ago, three goddesses created this world, and named it

introduced.name: Goddess of Creation
introduced.how: Goddess who presides over matter and magic, created the mountains and rivers, and gave life
introduced.quote: The Goddess of Creation, who presides over matter and magic, created the mountains and rivers, and gave us life.

introduced.name: Goddess of Prophecy
introduced.how: Goddess of the stars and fate whose statue stands in Constellation Metropole
introduced.quote: After the Goddess of Creation came the Goddess of Prophecy, with dominion over the stars and the course of fate itself.

introduced.name: Goddess of Fate
introduced.how: Goddess who reigns over tales and wishes, to whom residents tell their dreams
introduced.quote: The final Goddess was the Goddess of Fate, she who reigns over all treasured tales and dearest wishes.

introduced.name: Magic Tonic
introduced.how: Potion gifted by the Goddess of Creation that keeps forest residents vital
introduced.quote: Magic Tonic. It was gifted to the forest by the Goddess of Creation herself

introduced.name: Fading Disorder
introduced.how: Illness from lacking Magic Tonic that makes bodies brittle and erases memory
introduced.quote: Maybe the Fading Disorder occurs when the ink within the body dries up

introduced.name: Calligraphy Tavern
introduced.how: Forest tavern that supplies the Magic Tonic, closed since the dragon attack
introduced.quote: Ever since the attack, the Calligraphy Tavern in the forest has been closed.

introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.how: The Forest Fairy who introduces herself and was dreamt into this forest
introduced.quote: Nice to meet you, Padisarah. I'm Nilou, the Fairy of this Forest.

introduced.name: Firecracker
introduced.how: Band member and conductor whose name comes from her fiery temper
introduced.quote: Your name, for instance — it's kinda hard to forget that you're named after your fiery temper.

introduced.name: Stream
introduced.how: Band singer who has lost his singing voice to the Fading Disorder
introduced.quote: Yeah, because I've got a great singing voice.

introduced.name: Ginkgo
introduced.how: Forest resident who disassembled the Tavern's pipes and claims his grandfather saw creation
introduced.quote: Hey...! I just wanted to inspect each pipe!

introduced.name: Chestnut
introduced.how: Ginkgo's friend who helps run the Tavern's pipe repairs
introduced.quote: we have my careless friend to thank for that.

introduced.name: Citrus
introduced.how: Tall bartender of the Calligraphy Tavern who adds fruit to the Magic Tonic
introduced.quote: This is the bartender of the Calligraphy Tavern, Miss Citrus.

introduced.name: Padisarah
introduced.how: Paper creature given life by Nilou's words and named by her
introduced.quote: Your name shall be Padisarah. May you bloom in this world as beautifully as the flower I love.

introduced.name: Paper Frog
introduced.how: Talking origami frogs that hop away from the travelers on the road
introduced.quote: Traveler: I saw some talking paper frogs...

introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.how: Place in the real world where Nilou was reading before she was dreamt here
introduced.quote: I remember I was reading a book at the Grand Bazaar

introduced.name: Cliff of Prophecy
introduced.how: Where the Hero of Prophecy is said to descend into this world
introduced.quote: The Hero who shall save this world will descend upon the Cliff of Prophecy.

introduced.name: Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: Simulanka's most prosperous city across the sea, home of the Goddess of Prophecy's statue
introduced.quote: Hmm, I would say your next stop should be Constellation Metropole. It's Simulanka's most prosperous city, just across the sea.

introduced.name: Maritime Express
introduced.how: Transport needed to reach Constellation Metropole
introduced.quote: if Constellation Metropole is where you're heading, you'll need to take the Maritime Express.

introduced.name: Evil dragon attack on the Forest
introduced.how: A dragon in black mist descended on the forest and left footprints in the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells
introduced.quote: I will never forget the day the evil dragon descended upon our Forest

introduced.name: Nilotpala Lotuses
introduced.how: Ingredient for the Magic Tonic, named as the answer to Nilou's riddle along with sunsettias and snapdragons
introduced.quote: Traveler: She means sunsettias, snapdragons, and Nilotpala Lotuses.

introduced.name: Ink and paper legend
introduced.how: Legend that the Goddess of Fate wrote tales in ink and the Goddess of Creation brought them to life
introduced.quote: The Goddess of Fate used ink to compose her stories on paper, and the Goddess of Creation used her power to bring those tales to life.

introduced.name: Abracadabra magic
introduced.how: Book says magic in this world works through words and anyone can wield it
introduced.quote: This is a world made of words, where fantastical powers can be wielded by all.

introduced.name: Kirara
introduced.how: a nekomata from Inazuma who works as a courier for Komaniya Express
introduced.quote: Kirara is a nekomata from Inazuma. She works as a courier for Komaniya Express.

introduced.name: Wheel
introduced.how: a toy-man conductor of the Maritime Express who introduces himself
introduced.quote: My name is Wheel, and I'll be the conductor for your journey today.

introduced.name: Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: a city whose residents look very different from the Forest folk, run by toy-like people
introduced.quote: But yes, generally speaking, the residents of Constellation Metropole look quite different from us.

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: the name of the world the group has been pulled into
introduced.quote: Simulanka? So, that's what it's called.

introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.how: introduces herself as a member of Zubayr Theater who performs in Sumeru City's Grand Bazaar
introduced.quote: Ah, nice to meet you! I'm Nilou, a member of Zubayr Theater. You can usually find us performing in Sumeru City's Grand Bazaar.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: introduces herself as the President of Spina di Rosula, based in Poisson, and is now King of the Metropole
introduced.quote: Nice to meet you, Miss Nilou! I'm Navia, the President of Spina di Rosula.

introduced.name: Spina di Rosula
introduced.how: Navia's organization, which she names as the group she leads and later founds in Simulanka
introduced.quote: Nice to meet you, Miss Nilou! I'm Navia, the President of Spina di Rosula.

introduced.name: Goddess of Prophecy
introduced.how: a goddess who rules the natural course of things and grants the Metropole its protection magic
introduced.quote: Basically, this is a gift bestowed upon Constellation Metropole by the Goddess of Prophecy, who rules over the natural course of all things.

introduced.name: Goddess's protection magic
introduced.how: a gift that activates in disasters and pulls people who have strayed back onto their proper path
introduced.quote: It helps those who have deviated from their proper path to get back on track.

introduced.name: Bleufond
introduced.how: a Metropole resident who explains the Goddess's magic and the tracks and gears of the city
introduced.quote: Bleufond: Help me! Help... Oh Goddess of Prophecy above, could you kind souls please help us?

introduced.name: Gear Sky Ladder
introduced.how: a platform reached by a short walk from the station that leads up to Metropole Square
introduced.quote: It's a short walk from here to the Gear Sky Ladder, which will take you right to Metropole Square.

introduced.name: Toy people of Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: the toy-like residents of the city, unlike the origami animals of the Forest
introduced.quote: Paimon: Whoa... it's a little toy man!

introduced.name: Origami animals
introduced.how: paper-made folk of the Forest, unsuited to difficult train maneuvers
introduced.quote: The more difficult maneuvers are a little too complicated when you're made of paper.

introduced.name: Maritime Express
introduced.how: a sea train built for mine workers and abandoned since the dragon attack
introduced.quote: Yes. It was originally built to serve the workers commuting to the toytanium mines, but it has been abandoned since the dragon attack.

introduced.name: Aerial Express
introduced.how: a flying train blessed by the Goddess to protect the Metropole's skies, unused for about a hundred years
introduced.quote: This train has been blessed by the Goddess of Prophecy. Its whole purpose is to protect the Metropole's skies.

introduced.name: Oracle Pillar
introduced.how: a pillar used with the Magic Thread to pray to the Goddess
introduced.quote: You need to use it to pray to the Goddess...

introduced.name: Goddess Statue
introduced.how: the Goddess's statue at the top of the castle, which answers questions as an oracle
introduced.quote: Well, the Goddess's statue is indeed at the top of the castle. I can take you up there.

introduced.name: Dragon stealing the stars
introduced.how: an evil dragon flew up and snatched the stars from the sky above the city, then dropped them
introduced.quote: Literally just flew up and starting snatching them out of the sky!

introduced.name: Scattered stars
introduced.how: the sky stars the dragon dropped, now scattered across the Metropole and needing to be recovered
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, though, he dropped them before he flew off. Now they're scattered all around the Metropole.

introduced.name: Dragon's fog island
introduced.how: after the dragon broke out of the toytanium mines it spat fog over an island, and no one who went returned
introduced.quote: After that, it spat out a strange fog that surrounded a whole island.

introduced.name: Olivier
introduced.how: a Metropole resident who guards the celestial gear and fears its turning
introduced.quote: Olivier: No! Nobody touch the celestial gear!

introduced.name: Bizerte
introduced.how: a Metropole resident who admits fear of losing the Goddess's protection
introduced.quote: Bizerte: Some of us... we just aren't ready to lose that protection.

introduced.name: Montagne
introduced.how: a royal guard officer under Navia who is trapped by the Goddess's magic
introduced.quote: Montagne: Drat... I can't move...

introduced.name: Celestial gear
introduced.how: the gear connected to the starry sky, which when pushed will return the city's tracks to the stars
introduced.quote: Go, and push the gear that connects up to the starry sky.

introduced.name: Durin
introduced.how: the 'evil dragon' is revealed to be named Durin, a dragon who wishes never to have been born
introduced.quote: ...Durin. That's his name.

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: a world the Goddesses created by way of M's fairytale
introduced.quote: So I got B involved, and with M's consent, created the world of Simulanka.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of Mages that M belonged to
introduced.quote: One of the Mages of the Hexenzirkel.

introduced.name: M
introduced.how: a Mage of the Hexenzirkel and the Goddess of Fate's origin, who wrote Durin's story
introduced.quote: She created the story of Durin.

introduced.name: Goddess of Fate
introduced.how: a Goddess who grants wishes and whose study the party enters
introduced.quote: That's right. It belongs to the Goddess of Fate.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: the Goddess of Creation who helped found Simulanka and sent the book
introduced.quote: Yep, that's right! But although it's the most impressive-sounding of the three, to be honest, we all made an equal contribution toward the founding of this world.

introduced.name: Goddess of Prophecy
introduced.how: a Goddess who mapped out the fates of all living things in Simulanka
introduced.quote: Barbie loves looking into the future, so she used her powers to map out the fates of all living things in Simulanka.

introduced.name: Mini Durin
introduced.how: Durin's new form after the Traveler and friends bless him
introduced.quote: In fact, you look so different that perhaps... I should call you

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: the Traveler is a student there, as Nilou explains
introduced.quote: He's a student at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Vahumana Darshan
introduced.how: the Traveler represented this Darshan at the Interdarshan Championship
introduced.quote: He was representing the Vahumana Darshan.

introduced.name: Interdarshan Championship
introduced.how: a competition where Nilou and the Traveler met
introduced.quote: We met during the last Interdarshan Championship.

introduced.name: Hero's Sword
introduced.how: a sword that always reappears and is meant for the hero to wield
introduced.quote: meant to be wielded by the hero... I know, me of all people, right?

introduced.name: Dragon scale
introduced.how: a scale that turns anything it touches into hard toy blocks
introduced.quote: It turns everything it touches into something hard, almost like a toy block.

introduced.name: Toytanium
introduced.how: a material mined in toytanium mines where residents once worked
introduced.quote: Some of the residents used to work in the toytanium mines

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: Paimon recalls the Dragonspine dragon slain by Dvalin and made into a mountain by Rhinedottir
introduced.quote: Wait, that's the name of the dragon from Dragonspine, right?

introduced.name: Durin's curse
introduced.how: Durin's body turns everything he touches into toy blocks and ruins the land he steps on
introduced.quote: Everything I touch will be turned into toy blocks...

introduced.name: Stolen stars
introduced.how: the dragon flew off with the stars of Constellation Metropole
introduced.quote: The stars! It flew away with the Metropole's stars!

introduced.name: Dragon's fog
introduced.how: the fog around the area is the dragon's work
introduced.quote: Apparently, it's the work of that dragon.

introduced.name: Ways out of Simulanka
introduced.how: the Broken Sea and the Cliff of Prophecy are ways to leave the world
introduced.quote: You can either take the at the Broken Sea, or touch the at the Cliff of Prophecy.

introduced.name: Dragon's memories
introduced.how: the visions in the mist are memories of the dragon, not hallucinations
introduced.quote: What we saw in the mist weren't hallucinations, but the dragon's memories...

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Sends an invitation to Jean and Klee for a vacation in Simulanka, a fairyland
introduced.quote: We received a letter of invitation from Miss Alice, proposing that we take Klee for a vacation in fairyland when work dies down.

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: A reflected world based directly on Teyvat's fate, made by the creator inside a mirror or lake
introduced.quote: It looks like fate in Simulanka is directly based on Teyvat.

introduced.name: Mini Durin
introduced.how: A small dragon who caused trouble in Simulanka and later formally apologized at the Metropole
introduced.quote: Ah, you mean the one that caused all that trouble? I haven't seen him for myself, but I heard that he came to the Metropole not long ago to formally apologize for his actions.

introduced.name: Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: A city in Simulanka where Mini Durin and Hat Guy went after building the tree houses
introduced.quote: Supposedly, after building the houses, they went to somewhere called, uh... Constellation Metropole? Did I say that right?

introduced.name: Goddess of Prophecy
introduced.how: The creator-goddess of Simulanka, who shaped the reflected world and is Mona's master
introduced.quote: The more I scried, the more familiar everything looked... It's her work, there's no doubt about it.

introduced.name: Origami residents of the Forest of Blessings
introduced.how: Animals in the forest are origami creations, with tree houses built by a small dragon and a hat-wearing guy
introduced.quote: I still can't get over the fact that they're all someone's origami handiwork!

introduced.name: House of Daena
introduced.how: A library where borrowers may annotate the books they take out
introduced.quote: As I'm sure you know, the House of Daena allows borrowers to annotate the books they take out.

introduced.name: Reasoning Knows Not Time of Day, but Suspense Always Follows a Blizzard
introduced.how: A badly written detective novel full of circled names that has become the talk of Sumeru
introduced.quote: It's called "Reasoning Knows Not Time of Day, but Suspense Always Follows a Blizzard."

introduced.name: Circled names in the book
introduced.how: Names in the detective novel were circled by several people, sparking rumors of hidden secrets or treasure
introduced.quote: Most importantly, all the names of people in the book have been circled. Not only that, many of them are adapted from famous figures in Sumeru's history.

introduced.name: Sethos
introduced.how: A newcomer who is friends with Cyno and tried to buy the book, and who sets a memory contest
introduced.quote: You're that new kid Sethos, right? I know you're a friend of Cyno's.

introduced.name: Katayoun
introduced.how: House of Daena staff who keeps borrower identities confidential and handles the two copies of the book
introduced.quote: Katayoun: There are two copies of this book — one's been marked up, the other hasn't.

introduced.name: Clanche
introduced.how: a flying squirrel who runs a wind-current flying challenge called Boreal Flurry
introduced.quote: Clanche: Ah, two more brave warriors step up to the plate! Are you here to play Boreal Flurry?

introduced.name: Devitt
introduced.how: a game designer making a game called Flying Hats, with three gameplay modes
introduced.quote: Devitt: I've also designed three completely different gameplay modes for it... Don't worry, don't worry, the rules aren't too complicated!

introduced.name: Xudi
introduced.how: a paper-model maker who runs the Forest of Blessings and its Fabricator
introduced.quote: Xudi: Welcome, honored guests! Welcome to the Forest of Blessings!

introduced.name: Forest of Blessings
introduced.how: a forest area where Xudi greets visitors and the Rainsong Pond competition is held
introduced.quote: Xudi: Welcome, honored guests! Welcome to the Forest of Blessings!

introduced.name: Fantastical Fabricator
introduced.how: a machine that holds all of Xudi's paper models and produces one when its handle is turned with coins
introduced.quote: Xudi: Please, look over here! Have a look at this Fantastical Fabricator. Every Paper Model I've made up to this moment is inside.

introduced.name: Paper Models
introduced.how: paper toys made in the likeness of real people, which Xudi shares with others
introduced.quote: Xudi: They were all generous enough to let me make paper models based off them, that I might share these interesting toys with everyone!

introduced.name: Starsail Coin
introduced.how: a coin used to operate the Fantastical Fabricator
introduced.quote: Xudi: Alright then. Grab these Starsail Coins — consider them a welcome gift.

introduced.name: Kirara
introduced.how: a nekomata and Komaniya Express-style package courier who joins the Traveler's investigation
introduced.quote: Kirara: I've delivered packages all over, but I've never seen a mysterious fairytale world like this before!

introduced.name: Narrator
introduced.how: a meta narrator who comments on the story and sets up the Future Marquis' Abode-To-Be scenes
introduced.quote: Narrator: Hear me out, alright? I'm sorry for resorting to extreme measures, but I'm trying to help here.

introduced.name: The Future Marquis' Abode-To-Be
introduced.how: a secret stone room said by legend to await a foretold marquis, with a chair that must not be sat on
introduced.quote: Narrator: At the end of the path, the motley crew would soon spot a secret stone room. A prophecy had once foretold of a marquis who shall one day venture inside, and thus it is named: The Future Marquis' Abode-To-Be.

introduced.name: Cappet
introduced.how: a bard-speaking member of the clan of strength, one of three historical supervisors
introduced.quote: Cappet: This place is sacred to my clan. It is where our brave forefathers once took up arms against the dragon of old.

introduced.name: Albizzi
introduced.how: a member of the clan of empathy, who explains the clan's growth serum
introduced.quote: Albizzi: Mine is the clan of empathy, and our key contribution is... growth serum!

introduced.name: Boborano
introduced.how: a member of the clan of wisdom, who claims his clan outwitted the dragon of old
introduced.quote: Boborano: My clan's claim to fame is that we outwitted the dragon of old and stole its treasure.

introduced.name: Three great clans of Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: three clans (strength, empathy, wisdom) that each claim a different history and serve as historical supervisors
introduced.quote: Albizzi: We represent the three great clans of this realm, having been selected as its authorized historical supervisors.

introduced.name: Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: the city where news travels and where the three clans and the clockwork key are located
introduced.quote: Devitt: News travels quickly to, from, and through Constellation Metropole.

introduced.name: Great Clockwork Key
introduced.how: a key that must be pulled from a lodge and wound up to turn back time at the clan sites
introduced.quote: Narrator: -Marquis prepares to insert the great clockwork key into the nearby keyhole.

introduced.name: Oracle Pillars
introduced.how: pillars raised with the clockwork key and connected by a family crest puzzle
introduced.quote: Use Great Clockwork Key ×1 to raise to Oracle Pillar?

introduced.name: Family crests (Shape of Valor, Wisdom, Empathy)
introduced.how: clan crests whose shapes are the original magic array configurations that must be joined in the right order
introduced.quote: Cappet: Ah, well the general shapes of the configurations have been passed down over the ages. They now form the family crests of each of our clans.

introduced.name: Goddess of Fate
introduced.how: the goddess who created the world and whose manuscripts are its blueprint
introduced.quote: Cappet: She is the Goddess of Fate, the creator of all of this. And all these manuscripts are her grand design.

introduced.name: Goddess's Manuscripts
introduced.how: three manuscripts from the clans, each bearing the Goddess's signature and recording a clan's history
introduced.quote: Cappet: The manuscript that tells the truth of the historical record, the blueprint to all of creation, the work of the great mage themselves

introduced.name: Witness Pact
introduced.how: an old pact among the three tribes to stop harming each other and to honor the clockwork key's truth
introduced.quote: -->In the name of the elders of our three tribes, we hereby form this pact

introduced.name: Dragon of old
introduced.how: an ancient dragon the clans say was defeated long ago; separate from the current dragon
introduced.quote: Cappet: ...He means, a dragon that would be really, really old if it was still with us today, but it was defeated in ancient times.

introduced.name: Honorary Marquis
introduced.how: the title given to the Traveler for removing the clockwork key from its lodge
introduced.quote: Cappet: The moment you removed the key from where it was lodged, you became the Honorary Marquis.

introduced.name: Radiant Charter
introduced.how: a goddess-granted law protecting the valiant and forbidding forced duels
introduced.quote: -->The 'Radiant Charter' states that

introduced.name: Giant Guard
introduced.how: a towering guard of the clan of strength who blocks the sacred site
introduced.quote: Giant Guard: Well, we weren't told anything about that this morning. Get out of here. Leave us alone.

introduced.name: Winston
introduced.how: Albizzi's former friend who guards the guards' headquarters and is hostile to Albizzi
introduced.quote: Winston: Hahaha, so, you come crawling back... I told you, I am your only friend in this world.

introduced.name: Detective
introduced.how: a detective who investigates the poisoned-looking Cappet incident at Pendulum Lane
introduced.quote: Detective: Don't worry, Boborano. I don't consider you a suspect, nor do I have the authority to charge anyone with a crime.

introduced.name: Galileo and Alberto
introduced.how: two friends in the manuscript who drank magic cider and talked with the dragon
introduced.quote: -->Galileo and Alberto did many good deeds

introduced.name: Antonio
introduced.how: a wise villager in the manuscript who out-reasoned the dragon with a riddle duel
introduced.quote: -->Wise Antonio, in the basement

introduced.name: Detective
introduced.how: reveals himself as the narrator who has been guiding the player all along
introduced.quote: Time to come clean. I am the narrator, the one who's been guiding you all this time.

introduced.name: Narration Footnotes
introduced.how: footnotes are a separate voice that can never cross into the narrative
introduced.quote: The line that separates footnotes from narrative can never be crossed. Never the two shall meet.

introduced.name: Cimest
introduced.how: princess of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells who hosts the Guardian selection trials
introduced.quote: Oh, greetings to both of you, and welcome to the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells.

introduced.name: Kingdom of Breezes and Bells
introduced.how: a kingdom that holds a Guardian selection trial to choose its protector
introduced.quote: Oh, greetings to both of you, and welcome to the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells.

introduced.name: Guardian of the Kingdom selection trial
introduced.how: a wind-current flying trial where a candidate guides a squirrel companion to choose a Guardian
introduced.quote: Simply put, in this trial, the candidate must help their squirrel companion fly in the right direction by guiding them along the wind currents.

introduced.name: Relic
introduced.how: a sacred relic claimed only by passing the trial, which must acknowledge the Guardian
introduced.quote: The relic is down there. Pass the trial, and you may claim it.

introduced.name: Paladins of Breezes and Bells
introduced.how: title Cimest grants the Traveler and Paimon as Paladins of the kingdom
introduced.quote: As Princess of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells, I hereby declare...

introduced.name: Saborn and Souffache
introduced.how: kingdom ministers who stay behind to run the kingdom while Cimest leads the trial
introduced.quote: Souffache: Hear, hear! And then the Guardian who passes our selection process can retrieve the relic for us — two birds, one stone!

introduced.name: Paper Squirrels
introduced.how: squirrel folk who guard the trial and leave gifts for guests
introduced.quote: Traveler: Paper Squirrel A: This is a gift for our guests!

introduced.name: Paper Frogs
introduced.how: frog folk at Rainsong Pond who are holding a contest to find a champion
introduced.quote: Saborn: Wait! But Your Highness, they're all paper frogs over there!

introduced.name: Rainsong Pond
introduced.how: where paper frogs are choosing a champion through a contest
introduced.quote: Traveler: They're currently choosing a champion over at Rainsong Pond...

introduced.name: Great Clockwork Key
introduced.how: a key set in place by the three clans' ancestors that the clans have never removed together
introduced.quote: The great clockwork key was originally put in place jointly by the ancestors of the three clans.

introduced.name: Toytanium
introduced.how: an ore mined in toytanium mines, which special pickaxes are built not to cut
introduced.quote: To keep the toytanium ore intact, we use specially designed pickaxes that can't cut through it.

introduced.name: Special Pickaxe
introduced.how: a pickaxe designed not to damage toytanium, which was used as the weapon in the assault
introduced.quote: this kind of pickaxe is designed not to damage toytanium, so it couldn't cause any superficial damage to residents here.

introduced.name: Growth serum
introduced.how: a bottle of growth serum stolen from a shop, considered as a possible weapon
introduced.quote: A bottle of growth serum has gone missing.

introduced.name: Owl Musician
introduced.how: a popular story whose rhythm is built into guard training
introduced.quote: Since everyone liked it so much, adding elements of the story into our training would make it more enjoyable.

introduced.name: Alof
introduced.how: guard trainer in Constellation Metropole who runs a rhythm-based training Domain
introduced.quote: My work, specifically, is to train the guards, that their skills may prove worthy of their duty.

introduced.name: Three origin stories of Constellation Metropole
introduced.how: the city has three origins because the Goddess of Fate's drafts were crumpled together
introduced.quote: The reason why Constellation Metropole has three origin stories is that the Goddess of Fate wrote three drafts, and couldn't decide which one she liked best.

introduced.name: Dragon attack on the kingdom
introduced.how: a giant dragon passed through the kingdom and trampled the trial ground and relic site
introduced.quote: As I mentioned, not long ago, a giant dragon passed through our kingdom.

introduced.name: Fairytale world
introduced.how: the Detective claims the world is a fairytale written by the Goddess of Fate
introduced.quote: And I've known for a long time that this whole world is just a fairytale, written by the Goddess of Fate.

introduced.name: Supreme Clan election
introduced.how: the three great clans were gathering to elect a Supreme Clan, which the detective found pointless
introduced.quote: The only reason the three great clans wanted to find out the truth was for the pointless task of electing the Supreme Clan.

introduced.name: Marquis of Carabas
introduced.how: a role title the player played in the case, which must be formally dropped
introduced.quote: To bid farewell to the title of Marquis of Carabas once and for all, you can bring things to a close with a touch of formality.

introduced.name: Cimest
introduced.how: Princess of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells who seeks a Guardian for her kingdom
introduced.quote: Thank you for coming, my honorable Paladin. We seem to have run into a rather peculiar problem...

introduced.name: Faurobert
introduced.how: paper frog champion jumper of Rainsong Pond who doubts himself
introduced.quote: Mr. Faurobert is indeed the champion jumper — that much is indisputable.

introduced.name: Kingdom of Breezes and Bells
introduced.how: Cimest's kingdom, bound by a calling to find a Guardian; many kingdoms before it have fallen
introduced.quote: Prior to the current era of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells, this land has known many kingdoms.

introduced.name: Rainsong Pond
introduced.how: home of a jumping contest whose frogs wait to save a princess
introduced.quote: But the trial he passed was Rainsong Pond's jumping contest, and when he was acknowledged as champion, it was a committee that declared him so.

introduced.name: Cave of Eerie Murmurs
introduced.how: cave where past princesses searched for the answer and never returned
introduced.quote: Oh, it's nothing out of the ordinary. Simply put, it's where those princesses of past kingdoms searched for the "answer."

introduced.name: Relic
introduced.how: relic that acknowledges Guardians and lights up when one is chosen
introduced.quote: To be safe, I'll bring the relic along with us. Who knows, it might just come in handy.

introduced.name: Calling
introduced.how: each kingdom's sacred duty to find a Guardian acknowledged by the relic
introduced.quote: Our kingdom exists for its "calling"... It is also the only way we can save it.

introduced.name: Guardian
introduced.how: a figure the relic acknowledges, needed to save a kingdom
introduced.quote: Just like us, their "calling" was to find a "Guardian of the Kingdom" who would be acknowledged by the relic.

introduced.name: Paper frogs
introduced.how: the paper frog champions of Rainsong Pond who compete in jumping contests
introduced.quote: They just aren't designed for paper frogs.

introduced.name: Saborn
introduced.how: Cimest's advisor who worries about the kingdom's calling
introduced.quote: What are we to do...? If we can't complete our "calling"...

introduced.name: Souffache
introduced.how: Cimest's advisor who explains the fates of past kingdoms
introduced.quote: Since the Princess herself has acknowledged you as the "Paladin of Breezes and Bells," it is only right that I tell you about such matters.

introduced.name: Horellou
introduced.how: Rainsong Pond committee member who explains the cost of the contest
introduced.quote: Oh! Pleasure to meet you, hahaha! It seems you're a popular one indeed — even Her Highness Princess Cimest knows of you!

introduced.name: Estampe
introduced.how: Rainsong Pond champion who strolls about and is Faurobert's friend and rival
introduced.quote: Oh, that good fellow? He said he was going for a stroll to get some fresh air.

introduced.name: Cibrelus
introduced.how: past paper frog champion who won seven times, then retired and vanished from the records
introduced.quote: This paper frog, whose name was Cibrelus, once won the championship seven times in a row. No frog was his equal.

introduced.name: Ceoya
introduced.how: princess who put her kingdom to sleep and vanished in the cave while awaiting a Guardian
introduced.quote: The princess, whose name was Ceoya, therefore made a decision...

introduced.name: Aged Manuscript
introduced.how: manuscript voice of the old champion Cibrelus, speaking from the cave
introduced.quote: Another paper frog, just like me. Another useless champion, squandered years, and a pair of worthless, withered wings...

introduced.name: Flying Squirrels
introduced.how: the flying people of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells
introduced.quote: If every flying squirrel were to become a Guardian someday, then no matter what difficulties the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells faced, we could overcome them together.

introduced.name: Vanished kingdoms
introduced.how: past kingdoms failed their calling and faded, with subjects losing voices or water
introduced.quote: In some cases, the subjects of the kingdom suddenly lost their voices, while in others, the kingdom's water supply dried up overnight...

introduced.name: Voices of fallen kingdoms
introduced.how: lamenting voices of princes and princesses from fallen kingdoms, heard in the cave
introduced.quote: To be precise, both princesses and princes. What they have in common is... They are all voices from fallen kingdoms.

introduced.name: Lotus Head Bangle
introduced.how: ornament Faurobert carries that binds him to his duty as champion
introduced.quote: Now that I carry the Lotus Head Bangle, I will not... I cannot shirk my duty.

introduced.name: Waterspout
introduced.how: puzzle element that can be dropped or raised to move things in the trials
introduced.quote: Faurobert: That should get those waterspouts to come down a bit.

introduced.name: Horellou
introduced.how: Referee and announcer of the paper frog jumping contest at Rainsong Pond
introduced.quote: Horellou: Well done, my fine, hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, well done indeed!

introduced.name: Faurobert
introduced.how: Once the greatest jumper in the pond, now a contestant struggling with nerves and failure
introduced.quote: Estampe: That's right. Faurobert is... was, the best frog in our pond.

introduced.name: Estampe
introduced.how: Faurobert's friend and fellow contestant who was declared champion
introduced.quote: Horellou: Just a moment ago, we saw Estampe the Fearless show his awesome might!

introduced.name: Rainsong Pond
introduced.how: Pond where the paper frogs hold their jumping contests
introduced.quote: Excited Paper Frog: Nonetheless... Welcome to Rainsong Pond. May your legs be limber!

introduced.name: Paper frog jumping contest
introduced.how: Tiered jumping contests (qualifiers, group, elimination, finals) to choose a frog to rescue the princess
introduced.quote: Excited Paper Frog: As you have seen and heard, this contest is to decide the frog who's best at jumping.

introduced.name: Esnoir
introduced.how: Lighthouse keeper of Brickstacks who introduces himself and the fallen lighthouse
introduced.quote: Esnoir: Ah, yes. I've forgotten to introduce myself. Esnoir is my name, and I am the lighthouse keeper.

introduced.name: Brickstacks Lighthouse
introduced.how: Village lighthouse that guides returning venturers home, now knocked down
introduced.quote: Esnoir: Why, that is their prerogative! No matter what, the radiance of the Brickstacks Lighthouse shall shine upon the distant places where the stars fall.

introduced.name: Venturers
introduced.how: Explorers and wayfarers from the village who travel far abroad and return by the lighthouse's light
introduced.quote: Esnoir: Ah. You two must be new here. They are explorers, wayfarers — those willing to leave everything behind and travel far abroad.

introduced.name: Rozel
introduced.how: Boldest venturer from the village, who sailed on a windmill ship and has not returned
introduced.quote: Esnoir: Rozel was my neighbor. We'd chat, have tea, and play games together every day.

introduced.name: Panuelle
introduced.how: Villager who tends a tree and is estranged from her friend Chauvigne
introduced.quote: Panuelle: Chauvigne... Why are you still angry? *sigh* Perhaps you really shouldn't have ventured outside...

introduced.name: Chauvigne
introduced.how: Former venturer who returned changed and now lives as a flower in a pot
introduced.quote: Panuelle: That's right. Chauvigne is presently a flower in a pot.

introduced.name: Whispering Isle
introduced.how: Island with three goddess statues where gifts are offered to make wishes
introduced.quote: Panuelle: The Whispering Isle is not far from here. If a gift is offered unto the goddess on that island, she will grant the supplicant their wish...

threads.claim: Almond has waited for the Hero of Prophecy and wonders whether the Traveler and Paimon are those Heroes.
threads.quote: Could it be... you're the Heroes I've been waiting for all along?

threads.claim: Almond recovers his memory of witnessing the prophecy atop the Cliff of Prophecy.
threads.quote: I was the one who went to the top of

threads.claim: Almond states that the Goddess of Prophecy's words always come true, supporting the Heroes' role.
threads.quote: As expected, the words of the Goddess of Prophecy always come true.

threads.claim: Without Magic Tonic, residents' bodies crumble and they lose their memories and names.
threads.quote: Our bodies will gradually crumple and become brittle, until they eventually disintegrate entirely.

threads.claim: Stream's loss of singing ability is tied to the Fading Disorder.
threads.quote: So he is a victim of the Fading Disorder, too...

threads.claim: Almond regains his color after drinking the restored Magic Tonic, curing his fading.
threads.quote: Almond drinks some of the tonic and regains his color

threads.claim: The Magic Tonic tastes like ink, a clue to what it is made of.
threads.quote: It's sticking to Paimon's tongue!

threads.claim: The transparent bottle under the Tavern is an ink bottle that supplies the Magic Tonic.
threads.quote: Transparent and clinking... Oh! I've got it!

threads.claim: A hollowed-out space beneath the Tavern holds no magic, hinting that it is linked to the closure.
threads.quote: But for some reason, there's a hollowed-out space beneath the Tavern where I couldn't sense anything at all...

threads.claim: Magic in this world is said to work through words that anyone can wield.
threads.quote: This is a world made of words, where fantastical powers can be wielded by all.

threads.claim: Nilou brings Padisarah to life by speaking wishes aloud, suggesting magic lives in words.
threads.quote: Maybe the magic is in the words, themselves, just like the book said!

threads.claim: An evil dragon attacked the forest and left footprints in the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells.
threads.quote: its gigantic footprints can still be seen in the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon say they will also resolve the dragon problem as they travel.
threads.quote: We can also help resolve your dragon problem along the way.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon are stranded in this world and seek a way back to their own.
threads.quote: We're trying to find a way back to our world...

threads.claim: Paimon and the Traveler woke up in this world with no memory of how they got here.
threads.quote: No idea... Paimon just woke up, and then we were here...

threads.claim: Nilou heard a voice in a dream that named her Fairy of the Forest before she arrived here.
threads.quote: And, in my dream, someone spoke to me.

threads.claim: Ginkgo's grandfather claims to have seen the Goddess of Creation give life to a paper frog.
threads.quote: He said that one day, after he finished work, he saw the Goddess of Creation grant us life with his own eyes.

threads.claim: The world follows fairytale logic, where riddles and wishes can solve problems.
threads.quote: Haha, you've got to use fairytale logic, Paimon.

threads.claim: The Goddess's prophecy names a Hero from another world and their companions as the ones who will restore peace.
threads.quote: The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world...

threads.claim: The Goddess may be taking back her protective gift and ending her prophecies about the future.
threads.quote: Why do you think she might decide to take back her gift, and stop revealing further prophecies about the future?

threads.claim: The prophecy says the Goddess will return the city's tracks to the stars, which means taking back the gift.
threads.quote: That's what the prophecy seems to be saying, yes.

threads.claim: Metropole residents are said to have the freedom to live their own lives, even as the Goddess's magic steers events.
threads.quote: Of course, all residents of the Metropole have the freedom to live their own lives.

threads.claim: Bizerte's choice to turn the gear shows the people gaining courage and choosing their own path.
threads.quote: But maybe losing the gift isn't what this is about anymore. Because we've gained something, too... you have given us courage.

threads.claim: The Goddess's protection magic is misfiring, freezing some residents and trapping others in loops.
threads.quote: Some residents find themselves getting stuck in place and unable to move

threads.claim: The dragon has stolen the stars from the sky and scattered them across the city.
threads.quote: Literally just flew up and starting snatching them out of the sky!

threads.claim: The party recovers the scattered stars and the sky is restored.
threads.quote: Alright! Adding in the ones we picked up on the way here, I think that's all of them!

threads.claim: The dragon's fog has surrounded an island, and no one knows what lies beyond it.
threads.quote: After that, it spat out a strange fog that surrounded a whole island.

threads.claim: The end of the world is reachable only by the Maritime Express, and the party must travel there to face the dragon.
threads.quote: There's only one way to reach the end of the world, and that's by taking the Maritime Express.

threads.claim: The city's stars and gears form a huge music box, explaining the Metropole's design.
threads.quote: Nilou: So the stars hanging in the sky... they're music notes!

threads.claim: Almond's Fading Disorder is cured, and Cedule is shown to be fully recovered.
threads.quote: Oh, you remember my name now, do you? Then it seems like you're all better

threads.claim: Someone may have tampered with the wine or tonic at the forest tavern.
threads.quote: That might be because someone put... into your cup...

threads.claim: Kirara is trying to find a way back home and the Traveler wants to know how to leave this world.
threads.quote: I was trying to find a way to get back home.

threads.claim: Kirara senses something strange about a place in the city that she wants to investigate.
threads.quote: Mhm, I took a walk around yesterday and it felt like there was something weird about it.

threads.claim: Durin's touch turns everything into toy blocks, a curse he believes he cannot escape.
threads.quote: Everything I touch will be turned into toy blocks...

threads.claim: The blessings lift Durin's curse, so he can touch things without changing them.
threads.quote: They're... They're not changing! I can touch things without changing them!

threads.claim: A voice speaks inside the Traveler's head, pointing toward a purpose.
threads.quote: But it seemed like someone was talking in my head just now.

threads.claim: The Traveler's arrival was framed by a voice telling them to save the dragon.
threads.quote: When I first came to this world, a voice spoke to me and said

threads.claim: Some characters dislike stories where fate is fixed, hinting that fate may be challenged.
threads.quote: I just don't like that kind of story...

threads.claim: M believed that a story turned real should be free to choose its own path.
threads.quote: Every story has an ending, but if the story becomes reality, it should have the right to choose its own path.

threads.claim: The party believed they were the heroes of a prophecy, but the Traveler is the Hero of this world.
threads.quote: we thought we were the heroes of the prophecy

threads.claim: The party received a strange book from an unknown sender before arriving in Simulanka.
threads.quote: We'd just received a strange book, and we had no idea who sent it.

threads.claim: Alice admits she sent the book that brought the party to Simulanka.
threads.quote: Oh, is that what happened? Hahaha, yes, that does sound like me, doesn't it?

threads.claim: M says she will become a star after death and watch over Durin from the sky.
threads.quote: Once I'm gone, I will become a star in Simulanka, and watch over you from above.

threads.claim: Durin took the stars because he missed his mother, explaining his earlier theft.
threads.quote: So that's why you took the stars... Because you missed your mom.

threads.claim: Simulanka's Durin is linked to the Dragonspine dragon of the same name, slain by Dvalin.
threads.quote: Wait, that's the name of the dragon from Dragonspine, right?

threads.claim: The visions in the mist reveal the dragon's past, and the party learns Durin's history.
threads.quote: What we saw in the mist weren't hallucinations, but the dragon's memories...

threads.claim: Alice reveals that the party could have left Simulanka all along through the Broken Sea or the Cliff of Prophecy.
threads.quote: Don't you realize you've been able to leave all along?

threads.claim: The dragon's fog surrounds the area and is linked to the dragon's presence.
threads.quote: Apparently, it's the work of that dragon.

threads.claim: Simulanka is a mirror-like reflection of Teyvat created by the goddess, which raises questions about its nature.
threads.quote: Or in layman's terms... basically, the creator made this world inside a mirror, or a lake, and this world is the reflection.

threads.claim: The Goddess of Prophecy is confirmed as the creator of Simulanka, and her grand design is shown to be far more complex than expected.
threads.quote: Even so, everything's far more complex than I'd imagined. Trying to decipher it all is giving me quite a headache.

threads.claim: Albedo hints that the three Goddesses may have intended something beyond fairytale whimsy.
threads.quote: If there is any meaning to be read into the actions of the three Goddesses beyond fairytale whimsy alone, I can only boldly speculate that...

threads.claim: A prophecy says the child of Durin's mate will one day rise from the dead, hinting at Durin's return.
threads.quote: R's child... will one day rise from the dead.

threads.claim: Durin's heart is slowly growing in vitality, which seems to support the prophecy of his return.
threads.quote: Durin's heart has slowly but surely been growing in vitality. The process is extremely slow, but the trend is clear...

threads.claim: Albedo suggests the fate of Simulanka may have a reciprocal effect on the real world.
threads.quote: The fate of this reflected world may have a reciprocal effect upon our own world.

threads.claim: Mini Durin wants to leave Simulanka and visit Teyvat, raising the question of whether residents can cross between worlds.
threads.quote: Remember how Mom's friend said I should be able to leave this world? Well... I want to pay a visit to your world. Just a quick trip! Can we?

threads.claim: Locals were wary of Mini Durin because of his past trouble, and the Forest is only beginning to accept him.
threads.quote: Ah, you mean the one that caused all that trouble?

threads.claim: The circled names in the detective novel have sparked rumors that it conceals secrets or treasure.
threads.quote: Because of the strange marks drawn over all the pages, people are saying that it must be concealing secrets.

threads.claim: Tighnari found the book already circled by two different people and decided to add false marks to hide the murderer.
threads.quote: The problem was, there were already two names circled in the book I borrowed, and the style each circle was different.

threads.claim: The treasure was a fiction: the circles were the friends' own doing, and Cyno revealed the chain of annotations.
threads.quote: So there's no treasure at all, it was just you guys all along!

threads.claim: An unnamed client who wanted the book seemed to be hiding an ulterior motive.
threads.quote: A client had asked me to get her the book, but her attitude seemed off somehow, so I didn't take the commission.

threads.claim: Paimon hints that Kaveh is hunting for Mora to pay off a debt, a secret Kaveh wants kept.
threads.quote: He must be after Mora! That's gotta be it, so he can hurry up and pay off his debt to...

threads.claim: The Afterword frames the Hero's deeds as a legend future generations will retell.
threads.quote: Thus would epics of later generations speak of this time:

threads.claim: A voice says the goddess of fate left three riddles for the kingdom she created before she died.
threads.quote: ???: ...There once was a goddess who ruled over fate. Before she died, she left three riddles for the kingdom she'd created.

threads.claim: The party hears a voice they have never heard before, whose identity is unknown.
threads.quote: Albizzi: We've never heard that voice before. But he sounds like he'd be good at reading bedtime stories to children.

threads.claim: The narrator questions whether the outside world is itself a dream or a novel, raising doubt about which world is real.
threads.quote: Narrator: Hear, hear. Who can be sure that the outside world isn't just a dream? And that when the dreamer wakes up, they won't just find themselves inside a novel?

threads.claim: The clockwork key is said to be able to turn back time and make the past reappear.
threads.quote: Albizzi: And that clockwork key you have in your hand can turn back time, and make the past reappear.

threads.claim: The Traveler is named the Honorary Marquis, fulfilling an old prophecy of a marquis.
threads.quote: Cappet: The moment you removed the key from where it was lodged, you became the Honorary Marquis.

threads.claim: The long-lost dragon of old may have returned, though the narrator then dismisses the sighting as a cloud or bird.
threads.quote: Narrator: Then, suddenly, the long-lost dragon of old flew across the sky!

threads.claim: The current giant dragon is a recurring nuisance that visits and blows over shelves in the Forest of Blessings.
threads.quote: Xudi: Do remember to avoid the giant dragon, who can come knocking at any time! Don't let him get in the way of your travels!

threads.claim: Boborano predicts that all three clans' histories are true, so the contradictory histories may all be real.
threads.quote: Boborano: It seems likely that the claims made by each of our clans regarding their history and virtue are all true.

threads.claim: The clans' histories are recorded in manuscripts that are the blueprint of creation, written by the Goddess of Fate.
threads.quote: Cappet: The manuscript that tells the truth of the historical record, the blueprint to all of creation, the work of the great mage themselves

threads.claim: All three clan manuscripts bear the same unforgeable signature, so each is confirmed genuine.
threads.quote: Cappet: Feast your eyes, rejoice, and cheer. For this is the unquestionable truth! Look at the signature — nobody is capable of forging that!

threads.claim: The Radiant Charter is a goddess-granted law that restricts forced duels and allows riddle duels.
threads.quote: -->The 'Radiant Charter' states that

threads.claim: Starsail Coins run out and the player must find other ways to get more, which the friends can help with.
threads.quote: Xudi: Once you use these coins up, though, you'll have to find a way to get some more on your own — if you want to continue turning that Fabricator handle, that is.

threads.claim: The shelf is the true reason Xudi made the Fabricator and Paper Models, and its story is still untold.
threads.quote: Xudi: Strictly speaking, it is this shelf that was the true impetus for my creation of the Fantastical Fabricator and Paper Models...

threads.claim: Cappet's last words name Boborano as his murderer, setting up a question of who attacked him.
threads.quote: Cappet: I swear, if I wind up dead one day, the murderer was Boborano. Let those be my last words.

threads.claim: The detective concludes that Cappet was not attacked but collapsed and was faking it.
threads.quote: Detective: Well, that clears it up. Cappet was walking along the street, then he suddenly collapsed. He was faking it.

threads.claim: The Detective insists fairytales are not merely fiction, raising whether the world is real.
threads.quote: I refuse to believe that fairytales are just fictional stories, and nothing more.

threads.claim: A divine voice declares that the world within fairytales is real and so are the people in it.
threads.quote: But let there be no doubt: The world within fairytales is as real as can be.

threads.claim: The Detective asks whether the inhabitants of the world are real.
threads.quote: And I have to figure out, once and for all, while you real people from the outside world are still here: Are we real?

threads.claim: The footnote speaker has never been heard by the Traveler, hinting at a hidden voice behind the narrative.
threads.quote: This is why you have never heard my voice before.

threads.claim: The footnote voice can only be heard as an echo when the player breaks free from the story near a cat.
threads.quote: But now, you wish to break free from the story — and there's a cat nearby — so you can hear my echo.

threads.claim: Constellation Metropole's three origins are explained as a fairytale accident, raising questions about the city's true nature.
threads.quote: The reason why Constellation Metropole has three origin stories is that the Goddess of Fate wrote three drafts, and couldn't decide which one she liked best.

threads.claim: The relic fails to light up for Cimest, leaving unexplained why it does not acknowledge a Guardian.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, the relic has yet to acknowledge me.

threads.claim: Cimest chooses to acknowledge the challengers herself, setting a precedent for future rulers.
threads.quote: Then let us create a precedent for future rulers to follow.

threads.claim: An inscription on the relic speaks of cyclical stories that must follow their own course, with unknown meaning.
threads.quote: Stories follow rules, unfolding in cyclical patterns, but each should follow its own course.

threads.claim: A disembodied voice speaks in riddles about existence and eternity, unexplained.
threads.quote: ...I am a voice, but not life...

threads.claim: The voice speaks again, describing a time and eternity with no place to stand, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: ...Time is uninhabitable, and there is no place to stand within eternity...

threads.claim: A dragon wrecked the kingdom's sacred site and its trial ground, leaving its motives open.
threads.quote: As I mentioned, not long ago, a giant dragon passed through our kingdom.

threads.claim: Cimest suspects the dragon was driven into rage by the kingdom's hasty action and plans to visit it.
threads.quote: Perhaps in driving the dragon away, we also drove it into a rage.

threads.claim: The three clans have never tried to remove the clockwork key together, raising why they have not cooperated.
threads.quote: Over all these years, not once have they ever tried removing it together.

threads.claim: The question of the Supreme Clan is left unanswered after the crime is solved.
threads.quote: With the Supreme Clan question left unanswered

threads.claim: Those who act against the trial rules may be cursed, though the nature of the curse is unexplained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Those who act in defiance of the rules shall be cursed.

threads.claim: The relic may acknowledge a hero who has not yet been found, so the search for a Guardian is open.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders if she's found a hero that the relic would acknowledge yet... Let's go pay her a visit.

threads.claim: The relic lights up for a Guardian worthy of acknowledgment, answering who it accepts.
threads.quote: The fact that the relic has lit up means that it has found a "Guardian" worthy of acknowledgment.

threads.claim: Princesses who entered the Cave of Eerie Murmurs were never seen again, even as their kingdoms vanished.
threads.quote: But even until the day their kingdoms vanished utterly, those princesses were never seen again.

threads.claim: The vanished princes and princesses are revealed to be voices that waited so long they became manuscripts.
threads.quote: So long that they turned into manuscripts.

threads.claim: Kingdoms that fail their calling decline and vanish, losing their future.
threads.quote: Having lost their "future," all of these kingdoms eventually faded into oblivion.

threads.claim: Breezes and Bells may suffer the same fate if it cannot fulfill its calling.
threads.quote: If we cannot fulfill our "calling"... this will be our fate too.

threads.claim: A recurring line about stories following rules keeps reappearing, suggesting hidden meaning.
threads.quote: Why does this line keep reappearing...

threads.claim: The line that stories follow rules but each follows its own course is the key to the relic lighting up.
threads.quote: Heh, it's just as the last line of the story says: "Stories follow rules, unfolding in cyclical patterns, but each should follow its own course."

threads.claim: The world may be authored by a goddess who wrote all the stories about its people.
threads.quote: Sometimes, I can't help but think... That it would be best if this world really did have a "goddess" who wrote all the stories about us.

threads.claim: The characters are part of a story, yet the goddess left no ending for them.
threads.quote: Alright... Now we've really become characters in a story. But seeing as that Goddess wrote us in, why didn't she give us an ending?

threads.claim: The events are declared to be a story written by the Goddess of Fate.
threads.quote: So basically, everything we've been through... is a story written by the Goddess of Fate.

threads.claim: A voice quoting the carved story speaks from the air, and the speakers may be more than they seem.
threads.quote: "Once upon a time, there was a paper frog who wished he had a pair of wings."

threads.claim: The voice that addressed Faurobert matches the manuscript claiming to be Cibrelus.
threads.quote: It was the same as the voice of the manuscript that claimed to be Cibrelus in the Cave of Eerie Murmurs!

threads.claim: The cave's voices insist that only waiting brings answers, a view that is questioned.
threads.quote: Keep waiting, keep waiting. There are no answers here, only question after question.

threads.claim: Meaning is found by seeking in the unknown rather than by waiting.
threads.quote: No, Your Highness. Meaning lies in the unknown.

threads.claim: The cause of kingdoms falling into decay and why a Guardian is needed remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Why did we need to find a Guardian, and why would a kingdom fall into decay by itself?

threads.claim: Princess Ceoya put her kingdom into a deep slumber and sealed its land while she waited for a Guardian.
threads.quote: She let the kingdom's people fall into a deep slumber and sealed off all its land except the tower, where she alone remained to await the coming of the Guardian...

threads.claim: Rainsong Pond's calling to save a princess has cost generations of champions their lives and memories.
threads.quote: From the moment we are born, our "calling" is to practice jumping and save the princess...

threads.claim: Rainsong Pond is freed to enjoy jumping for its own sake rather than a fruitless calling.
threads.quote: Now, we can simply enjoy jumping for jumping's own sake!

threads.claim: Some places in the world have no wind, which the kingdom will have to face.
threads.quote: After all, there are bound to be places in this world where the wind doesn't blow.

threads.claim: The paper frogs' plan to rescue a princess from a high tower is questioned because she can apparently fly and needs no saving.
threads.quote: Horellou: Hmm... You may be right, but this is quite strange. The princess does live in a high tower, and yet she needs no frog to save her.

threads.claim: Faurobert believes his mistakes will not rest and will return to hurt him, a theme about failure and doubt.
threads.quote: Faurobert: But they will not rest, my friend. They will await their opportunity, for a chance to come back to bite you.

threads.claim: Faurobert's daring leap after his failure shows he can rise again, answering the question of whether he has given up.
threads.quote: Estampe: I knew you had it in you, Faurobert! I believed in you!

threads.claim: Returned venturers have changed and obsess over value, and Rozel suggests their experiences have colored them in ways that are neither good nor bad.
threads.quote: Esnoir: Rozel says that it is because the many things venturers have seen color them, like ponds into which paint has been thrown.

threads.claim: Rozel set off on a windmill ship and may have become lost, with no word from him after his planned return.
threads.quote: Esnoir: My friend, Rozel, just set off a few days ago. He must surely have gotten utterly lost now, just like all our other venturers.

threads.claim: The lamp keeps shining even after being removed from the lighthouse, a mystery left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Eh? Huh. You're right. But why is it still shining even after being removed?

threads.claim: Chauvigne has become a flower in a pot after his travels and refuses to leave it, hinting that his change is tied to venturing.
threads.quote: Panuelle: But he always says that no matter where he goes, he must be sure of his place, something he learned from his venturing... and that pot is his place.

threads.claim: The goddess of the Whispering Isle once favored the brave, but Panuelle's wish was not granted, raising doubt that she still hears wishes.
threads.quote: Panuelle: I've been to that island to offer gifts, but my wishes were not granted. Perhaps something's gone wrong somewhere...

threads.claim: The dragon scale glowed before the goddess statue yet remains stuck to the statue, suggesting the goddess accepted the gift without granting the wish.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hrrgh... Nope, it's no use. The scale won't come off. Guess the goddess liked the gift after all.

threads.claim: The dragon that wrecked the village may not be evil; the Traveler suggests it simply wants to be friends and that the villagers misunderstood it.
threads.quote: Traveler: Mini Durin's no evil dragon!

threads.claim: A sword-like dragon horn is lodged in the toytanium mine, offered as a clue to what the goddess wants as a gift.
threads.quote: Paimon: Look at that! Is that... a sword? No, it can't be. There wouldn't be swords like that...

threads.claim: The place where the sword and horn were found is mysterious and holds clues the travelers have not yet fully understood.
threads.quote: This sure is a mysterious place... But either way, we've got the sword, so all's well.

threads.claim: The travelers have not yet found the clues they need to explain the dragon's items and the goddess's requests.
threads.quote: Not that we've found any other clues, anyway.

threads.claim: Venturers come back changed, obsessing over the monetary value of goods instead of their beauty or craftsmanship.
threads.quote: They fret about the "value" of carpets and hats... but not at all about which is more beautiful or intricately made...

threads.claim: Dragons crashed into the village and waterfall, and the village's situation is still unexplained to Rozel.
threads.quote: What happened to your lighthouse, Esnoir? What happened to this place? What exactly did I miss?

threads.claim: Many far-off places remain unexplored and await venturers.
threads.quote: After all, there all many "far off places" that await their exploration still.

threads.claim: The light the travelers created reached Rozel's ship and saved it from being lost at sea.
threads.quote: Had that radiance not reached my ship, I'm sure I would have been utterly lost at sea.

introduced.name: Mamesuke
introduced.how: a bake-danuki who speaks in fragments and is named by Paimon's introduction; Shibasuke's companion lost on the islands
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmph, Paimon's got this one! It says its name is Mamesuke!

introduced.name: Shibasuke
introduced.how: Mamesuke's look-alike bake-danuki companion who has gone missing and is later found trapped in a cage
introduced.quote: Paimon: Eh? Is that Shibasuke? It looks just like Mamesuke...

introduced.name: bake-danuki
introduced.how: a shapeshifting prankster creature found in Inazuma's forests
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, , you've never seen one before? They're called bake-danuki!

introduced.name: Dragon of the play (Wicked Dragon)
introduced.how: an evil dragon in the play that devours human dreams like gold
introduced.quote: Narrator: Upon hearing of human dreams precious as gold, an insatiable evil dragon descended upon the kingdom.

introduced.name: Princess (play)
introduced.how: the princess in the play who sets out to defeat the dragon
introduced.quote: Narrator: Oblivious to this ill, the king and his princess continued to debate the content of their meal.

introduced.name: Servant A
introduced.how: Attendant A, a self-proclaimed world-famous fighter among the play's three warriors
introduced.quote: Narrator: The forger of great legacies, the world famous fighter, Attendant A.

introduced.name: Servant B
introduced.how: Attendant B, an over-cautious tactician in the play
introduced.quote: Narrator: The often indecisive and over-cautious tactician, Attendant B.

introduced.name: Servant C
introduced.how: Attendant C, a self-described dragon-slayer in the play
introduced.quote: Narrator: And finally, our preeminent dragon-slayer, Attendant C.

introduced.name: Twilight Theater
introduced.how: a theater troupe on the islands whose head presents the play
introduced.quote: Twilight Theater Head: I am the world-famous Head of Twilight Theater!

introduced.name: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess
introduced.how: a five-act stage play with two scenes per act, performed on the islands
introduced.quote: Twilight Theater Head: There are five acts in this play, each with two scenes...

introduced.name: Arnold
introduced.how: a real guard who longs to perform on stage and joins the play as a replacement actor
introduced.quote: Arnold: If only it was me! I've always wanted to perform in a show, but I never got the chance...

introduced.name: Leon
introduced.how: an actor who plays the Loyal Servant in the play
introduced.quote: Leon: I had quite a sizeable role this time.

introduced.name: Geovishap
introduced.how: a creature in Liyue that inflicts excruciating pain when it hits
introduced.quote: Traveler: There are Geovishaps there that inflict excruciating pain when they hit you.

introduced.name: Jueyun Chili
introduced.how: a Liyue food that makes you spew flames
introduced.quote: Traveler: There are Jueyun Chilis there that make you spew flames.

introduced.name: Flaming Flower
introduced.how: a fiery plant that must be extinguished with water or ice before it can be safely picked
introduced.quote: Paimon: There's a trick to picking Flaming Flowers! You have to extinguish them first to pick them safely.

introduced.name: Pyro Slime
introduced.how: a fire slime that explodes and is more dangerous than Flaming Flowers
introduced.quote: Paimon: Pyro Slimes are much more dangerous than Flaming Flowers because they explode.

introduced.name: Sunsettia
introduced.how: a fruit that grows on Cuihua Wood, varying by location, distinct from Lavender Melons
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's a Sunsettia. Actually, both of them grow on Cuihua Wood, but the fruit varies according to the location!

introduced.name: Lavender Melon
introduced.how: a purple fruit that Mamesuke and Shibasuke long for
introduced.quote: Mamesuke: Lavender Melon, purple, tasty!

introduced.name: Anemo Amber
introduced.how: an amber that creates a wind current when destroyed
introduced.quote: Paimon: There's Anemo Amber here, which is perfect. It'll create a wind current once destroyed. C'mon, , show them how it's done!

introduced.name: Hydro Amber
introduced.how: an amber that creates rain, used to extinguish Flaming Flowers
introduced.quote: Paimon: You'll need water or ice on a sunny day, and it's even easier if there's a Hydro Amber nearby.

introduced.name: wind barrier
introduced.how: a barrier of wind that vanishes once the thing it protects is taken
introduced.quote: Traveler: Well, the thing they're protecting is gone, so...

introduced.name: bonsai pot
introduced.how: a pot whose layout switches the island's mountain styles
introduced.quote: Paimon: We should be able to find Shibasuke if we switch the mountains to resemble Mondstadt's.

introduced.name: pressure plate
introduced.how: a weight-activated mechanism that opens a chest when a heavy object is placed on it
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, that! It's a mechanism activated by weight! Actually, there are some in Inazuma, too.

introduced.name: Windrise
introduced.how: a location near Mondstadt city with more even terrain, chosen as the first destination
introduced.quote: Paimon: Mondstadt seems like the better choice for our first destination... Let's go to Windrise! The terrain is more even, and it's close to the city.

introduced.name: bake-danuki meal
introduced.how: a meal that lets people understand bake-danuki for a time before its effects wear off
introduced.quote: Paimon: We could understand Kichiboushi before because we'd had a bake-danuki meal, but its effects didn't last that long...

introduced.name: Miitoboru
introduced.how: a talking pirate ship that drifted to the islands and asks the Traveler to help find its missing body
introduced.quote: Ahoy there! You're finally here. I've been waiting for a long time. Even my deck is getting burrs.

introduced.name: Ako Domeki
introduced.how: a notorious pirate fleet and its commander Zaemon, feared across the seas and defenders of Seirai
introduced.quote: Ako Domeki Zaemon? Defender of Seirai? The name of the most feared pirate ever to sail the seas...

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: the homeland where the ship's wood was harvested and where the pirates fought
introduced.quote: My hull is made of the best wood found on Seirai Island.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: the rival power the Ako Domeki fleet fought in a sea battle
introduced.quote: The sea battle between Ako Domeki and the Shogunate. And then the lightning that came at the end of the battle...

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a device that takes pictures of scenes
introduced.quote: We didn't paint this. We took it using a Kamera.

introduced.name: Caulk
introduced.how: a rubbery filler pressed between planks to keep water out of a ship during maintenance
introduced.quote: Caulk is the stuff we use to fill the gaps between the planks to stop water from leaking into the ship.

introduced.name: Kosekimaru
introduced.how: the ship's real name, given by the Shrine Maiden of Asase, with its crew from Koseki Village
introduced.quote: The wood of Seirai made my flesh and bones, and the Shrine Maiden of Asase gave me my name.

introduced.name: Koseki Village
introduced.how: the hometown of most of the ship's crew, which the Shrine Maiden hoped the ship would return them to
introduced.quote: Most of my mates were from Koseki Village, and she hoped I could take them back to their hometown...

introduced.name: Zaemon
introduced.how: the Ako Domeki commander who fished with a barbed spear and once seized a sword-wielding Maguu
introduced.quote: When he had free time, Zaemon would take us out fishing.

introduced.name: Maguu
introduced.how: a sword-wielding being that Zaemon captured and that drifted to the islands with the crew
introduced.quote: Zaemon once seized a sword-wielding Maguu with his barbed spear.

introduced.name: Wooden Sword
introduced.how: a children's toy sword carved from the ship's broken timber, made by local children after the Maguu
introduced.quote: This wooden sword... is made from my broken timber...

introduced.name: Mirage contraption
introduced.how: a machine that let the ship talk and communicate with the Traveler and Paimon, and is now wearing off
introduced.quote: So it's because of some contraption that I became your Waverider and could communicate with you

introduced.name: Mirage
introduced.how: a device-made state where the island within the lake shows its original form, so changes made there do not alter the past
introduced.quote: The buildings within the lake reflect their original appearance...

introduced.name: Wolfgang
introduced.how: an adventurer whose notes in secret chambers on Minacious Isle reveal he got trapped and wants to reach Dragonspine
