introduced.quote: Paimon really gets why this Wolfgang guy misses it!

introduced.name: Sweet Madame
introduced.how: a dessert from Mondstadt that Wolfgang longs for
introduced.quote: Heh, I really wish I could eat some Sweet Madame from Mondstadt... Just let me have one Sweet Madame...

introduced.name: Bella
introduced.how: a tuxedo cat in Mondstadt who would step on Wolfgang's plate at restaurants
introduced.quote: That's when I thought of that little tuxedo cat from Mondstadt, Bella...

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: a cold, dangerous region full of hilichurls that Wolfgang plans to visit
introduced.quote: Dragonspine's super cold and is filled with hilichurls... Not to mention The Great Snowboar King!

introduced.name: The Great Snowboar King
introduced.how: a dangerous creature said to be found in Dragonspine
introduced.quote: Dragonspine's super cold and is filled with hilichurls... Not to mention The Great Snowboar King!

assumed.name: Kichiboushi
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey! You're just like Kichiboushi! Anyway, it's not Flying White Fur. The name's Paimon!

assumed.name: Ioroi
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ioroi once mentioned that bake-danuki can understand humans, but we can't understand them.

assumed.name: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas
assumed.quote: (If the player has participated in Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Traveler: That sounds mighty like the Fatui.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Paimon: It is said that they enjoy disguising themselves and pulling pranks on people in Inazuma's forests.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, it's just a wind barrier! Hehe! We've seen many of these in our adventures across Mondstadt, haven't we, ?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Traveler: Maybe we can switch to the mountain style of Liyue.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh... Is the Electro Archon a god who likes Lavender Melons? It's hard to imagine that...

assumed.name: Ei
assumed.quote: Paimon: Would Ei enjoy a Lavender Melon? It's pretty hard to imagine that happening...

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Katheryne: I've heard that you once visited the Good Hunter with a bake-danuki from Inazuma, so I thought you might be friends.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: , Paimon, have you met two bake-danuki recently, by any chance?

assumed.name: Dandelions
assumed.quote: Paimon: Furry grass? You mean the Dandelions?

assumed.name: Anemo
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's a leaf that contains the power of Anemo. Huh, speaking of those...

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah, that's a Ruin Guard! Paimon doesn't think Mamesuke and Shibasuke can handle that!

assumed.name: The Five Kasen
assumed.quote: Twilight Theater Head: Well... It's just like how The Five Kasen are usually portrayed in four poems...

assumed.name: Seirai Stormchasers: Part IV
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Seirai Stormchasers: Part IV)

assumed.name: Thunderbird
assumed.quote: What's left of the Thunderbird's wrath...

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Those lights are from Inazuma.

assumed.name: The Catch
assumed.quote: You have "the Catch" with you, don't you?

assumed.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
assumed.quote: because the Golden Apple Archipelago is under the effects of that device

threads.claim: The sudden ability to understand bake-danuki is unexplained and hints at a strange power on the islands.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ugh, forget it... Wait! Why are we suddenly able to understand bake-danuki?

threads.claim: The ability to understand bake-danuki ends once the Traveler leaves the islands.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's because we've left the islands...

threads.claim: Mamesuke hints that switching mountain layouts is how Shibasuke will find the way home.
threads.quote: Mamesuke: Shibasuke find way home, mountain kaboom!

threads.claim: Paimon connects Mamesuke's mountain kaboom remark to the bonsai mountains switching.
threads.quote: Paimon: Mountain kaboom? Oh! Is he referring to the mountains switching...

threads.claim: Shibasuke has been separated from Mamesuke and is lost on the islands.
threads.quote: Traveler: So you got separated from Shibasuke. Is that it?

threads.claim: Shibasuke is found trapped in a cage and reunited with Mamesuke.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hey! Mamesuke! We brought Shibasuke back!

threads.claim: The Fatui may have brought the bake-danuki to the islands on their ship.
threads.quote: Traveler: That sounds mighty like the Fatui.

threads.claim: A dragon that devours human dreams threatens the kingdom in the play.
threads.quote: Narrator: Upon hearing of human dreams precious as gold, an insatiable evil dragon descended upon the kingdom.

threads.claim: The princess personally defeats the dream-devouring dragon and restores peace.
threads.quote: Narrator: Finally, the princess personally defeated the dragon, and peace returned to the kingdom.

threads.claim: The play presents courage in the heart as more important than the sword in the hand.
threads.quote: Twilight Theater Head: Well, anyway, the important thing is not the sword in the hand, but the courage in the heart!

threads.claim: Paimon wonders whether the bake-danuki will ever meet the Traveler again.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hehe, looks like their journey's off to a good start! Paimon wonders if we'll ever meet again...

threads.claim: The lightning that wrecked the ship may be a remnant of the Thunderbird's wrath.
threads.quote: What's left of the Thunderbird's wrath...

threads.claim: The thunderstorm from the battle was the cause of the ship drifting to these waters.
threads.quote: Wait... So that thunderstorm was the reason I... the reason I drifted here.

threads.claim: The new thunderstorm and Inazuman lights resemble the one from the day of the battle, hinting the ship is connected to the storms.
threads.quote: This thunderstorm is just like the one on that day... And so were the Inazuman lights we saw, too.

threads.claim: The ship has lost its memory of its name and past.
threads.quote: I still can't recall my name...

threads.claim: The ship recovers its name Kosekimaru and its connection to Koseki Village.
threads.quote: First of all, I've remembered my name...

threads.claim: Kosekimaru has a second message to share that is left unrevealed.
threads.quote: Kosekimaru: Hahaha, I thought you'd already forgotten. I'll tell you when you come back!

threads.claim: The ship's ability to talk may be tied to a machine that is being turned off, and its effects are fading.
threads.quote: Is it because the machine was turned off...

threads.claim: The ship has lost its ability to speak, confirming its voice depended on the machine's effects.
threads.quote: Kosekimaru can't speak anymore...

threads.claim: Zaemon's current whereabouts are unknown to the ship.
threads.quote: I do wonder where he is now...

threads.claim: The ship's old crewmates who drifted with it are unaccounted for and their fate is uncertain.
threads.quote: I wish I could know how they're doing.

threads.claim: The old crewmates found their way back home, though the ship could not go with them.
threads.quote: So they found a way back...

threads.claim: The Ako Domeki fought the Shogunate to protect Seirai Island and its people, and the battle ended in tragedy.
threads.quote: We made an enemy of the Shogunate for the sake of Seirai Island, and in the end... Oh, Shrine Maiden... Why...

threads.claim: Wolfgang plans to go to Dragonspine, a dangerous destination.
threads.quote: Now that I've cleared this particular trial... Next stop, Dragonspine!

threads.claim: The Traveler's warning does not stop Wolfgang from heading toward Dragonspine.
threads.quote: But we adventurers exist precisely because of perils like Dragonspine.

threads.claim: Wolfgang will never reach Dragonspine because his fate was already fixed in the past.
threads.quote: Wolfgang will never make it to Dragonspine...

threads.claim: The Mirage shows the lake island as it once looked, implying the past can be seen and reached.
threads.quote: The buildings within the lake reflect their original appearance...

threads.claim: Changes made in the Mirage do not alter what actually happened in reality.
threads.quote: That won't change what happened in reality...

introduced.name: Sigewinne
introduced.how: Head Nurse who came to the aquarium as a marine consultant, invited by Miss Guillotin
introduced.quote: Miss Guillotin mentioned you've been running an aquarium. Naturally, I accepted her invitation to come serve as a marine consultant!

introduced.name: Alain
introduced.how: inventor of the mechanical piano, who fell ill and could no longer bear to hear it
introduced.quote: When Alain fell ill, he couldn't bear to listen to the piano anymore, so I got rid of it for him.

introduced.name: Piano Chassis
introduced.how: a mechanical piano invented by Alain that can be played by hand or automatically
introduced.quote: It's a mechanical piano that Alain invented. It can be played by hand, but it also works automatically.

introduced.name: Fontainian unclaimed property law
introduced.how: sunken cargo becomes unclaimed property once its owner accepts an insurance payout
introduced.quote: According to Fontainian law, if an owner of sunken cargo accepts an insurance payout, the cargo becomes unclaimed property.

introduced.name: Underwater mobility device
introduced.how: a device Sandrone built to help the Traveler and Paimon fish and flee underwater
introduced.quote: It's an underwater mobility device I've been working on.

introduced.name: The Wingalet
introduced.how: a boat rented by Sandrone that hosts the aquarium
introduced.quote: Sandrone is the one renting this boat, after all...

introduced.name: Fisharium opening
introduced.how: the aquarium is opened to visitors as the Wingalet Gloop-Gloop Funderwater Fisharium
introduced.quote: Woohoo! The Wingalet Gloop-Gloop Funderwater Fisharium is officially open for business!

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Hey, Columbina! Are you admiring the fish in our aquarium?

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Oh, look at that fish. Don't you think it looks just like Sandrone?

assumed.name: Furina
assumed.quote: I just wrapped up a scene, so I'm taking time out to admire your aquarium.

assumed.name: Chevreuse
assumed.quote: Look at the color of its tail. It's the most fashionable thing in the whole aquarium.

assumed.name: Chiori
assumed.quote: The colors are a bit loud for my taste, but alright, I'll take it as a compliment.

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: That busy-looking one over there reminds me of Lauma.

assumed.name: Lady Nefer
assumed.quote: that one in the coral seems to be quietly observing everything, just like Lady Nefer.

assumed.name: Freminet
assumed.quote: Mmhmm... Things down there have been a bit hectic lately.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Huh. Arlecchino sure is thoughtful! If you've got any pretty-looking ornaments that nobody wants anymore, we could use them to decorate the aquarium.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: No, though I saw a few fish tanks in Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: They salvage things others have lost, and sell them for Mora back on dry land...

assumed.name: Pantalone
assumed.quote: I'm not stingy like Pantalone.

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: I'd best head back and meet up with Lyney and the others.

assumed.name: Blubberbeast
assumed.quote: They often resort to barbaric means to drive away fish and Blubberbeasts, just to gain access to valuable salvage...

threads.claim: The piano Alain invented ended up broken in the sea, and its origin and fate are still unexplained.
threads.quote: I guess whoever ended up with it played it till it broke, but didn't know how to fix it.

threads.claim: The piano is missing components, and the Traveler must find them to restore it.
threads.quote: Hmm... Looks like it's missing some components, though. You'll need to find the rest if you hope to restore it to working order.

threads.claim: With the recovered components, Sandrone can finally repair the piano.
threads.quote: Well, I'll be. With these components, I can finally fix the piano.

threads.claim: Sandrone is reluctant to play the restored piano for the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: How about... we leave the performance on hold for today! There's plenty of time for me to play for you later.

threads.claim: Shipwrecks and illegal waste dumping have littered the seabed and are behind the fish's aggression.
threads.quote: Over the years, there have been plenty of shipwrecks, and even some absolute scoundrels illegally dumping waste in the sea...

threads.claim: Man-made junk piling up on the seabed destroys habitats and provokes the fish.
threads.quote: A huge amount of man-made junk has sunk to the seabed, piling up and destroying natural habitats.

threads.claim: The divers have removed the major underwater junk, ending the cleanup.
threads.quote: Fantastic... That's pretty much all of the major junk retrieved.

threads.claim: Wild fish have become unusually aggressive, attacking creatures, divers and boats.
threads.quote: The word from Officer Ceasth is that certain wild fish have been getting unusually aggressive lately.

threads.claim: The aggressive fish are being treated and will be returned to the wild.
threads.quote: we'll be able to return them back to the wild.

threads.claim: Pollution threatens to fade the Romaritime Flowers and may cause other awful things.
threads.quote: If the underwater pollution gets any worse, the colors of the Romaritime Flowers will fade...

threads.claim: Unclaimed sunken cargo law leads some divers to chase profit by harming marine life.
threads.quote: According to Fontainian law, if an owner of sunken cargo accepts an insurance payout, the cargo becomes unclaimed property.

threads.claim: Fontaine's waters contain dangerous predators as well as harmless ornamental fish.
threads.quote: The waters of Fontaine are home to more than just harmless, ornamental fish. There are plenty of predators who could do you some real harm.

threads.claim: Freminet is still shy about expressing himself, though he intends to keep working on it.
threads.quote: I'm sorry... I'm still a little bit shy. But don't worry... I—I'll keep working on it.

introduced.name: Gaasira
introduced.how: former shooting instructor in the Flower-Feather Clan who now wants to teach children marksmanship through games
introduced.quote: That's right. I used to be a shooting instructor back in the tribe, had my hands full teaching folks about aerial marksmanship techniques.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: a tribe whose people practice aerial marksmanship and battlefield combat
introduced.quote: That's right. I used to be a shooting instructor back in the tribe, had my hands full teaching folks about aerial marksmanship techniques.

introduced.name: Huilu
introduced.how: a storyteller who offers to share a tale about traveling, friends, and family
introduced.quote: Hello there, ! Do you have a moment? I've got a story I want to share...

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: a community that the famous traveler Akamai returned to after his journeys
introduced.quote: In the People of the Springs, there was once a famous traveler by the name of Akamai.

introduced.name: Akamai
introduced.how: a famous traveler from the People of the Springs who journeyed across Natlan with a companion
introduced.quote: In the People of the Springs, there was once a famous traveler by the name of Akamai.

introduced.name: Kau Kau
introduced.how: Akamai's Koholasaurus companion on a long journey of tasting foods and collecting stones
introduced.quote: Together with his Koholasaurus companion, Kau Kau, he embarked on a long journey.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a land that Akamai and Kau Kau set out to traverse and whose delicacies they sought
introduced.quote: Their quest: To traverse all of Natlan and feast on all its delicacies.

introduced.name: Pusaq
introduced.how: an artist who runs a graffiti spray painting game for the Traveler
introduced.quote: Well, hello, ! You're just in time. Up for a game of graffiti spray?

introduced.name: Graffiti spray game
introduced.how: a beginner-friendly painting game where the focus is on the process of spraying rather than a finished masterpiece
introduced.quote: Up for a game of graffiti spray?

introduced.name: Mushroom drink
introduced.how: a drink made with mushrooms and wild root vegetables that people dance to and drink at the festival
introduced.quote: In with the mushrooms... and now some wild root veggies...

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: I can— I can see the hilichurls... They're dancing beside me...

threads.claim: The mushroom drink leaves people in a stupor seeing things like hilichurls, hinting that the drink has an unsettling effect.
threads.quote: Some folks danced themselves into a stupor earlier. Even when they were being carried away, they were mumbling something barely coherent...

threads.claim: Gaasira's former students became battlefield legends, but only their achievements returned, hinting at lost lives and a tribe that kept her from fighting.
threads.quote: ...It's just a pity that their glorious achievements were the only things that ever came back...

threads.claim: Akamai and Kau Kau's journey across Natlan gathered stones and delicacies, and their many tales are still being told.
threads.quote: Their culinary journey brought them to countless places, filled their backpacks with innumerable beautiful stones, and stuffed their bellies with myriad delectable dishes.

introduced.name: Elowen
introduced.how: A Reconnaissance Company member and rookie who admires the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: And this is Elowen. A member of the Reconnaissance Company, just like me.

introduced.name: Tres
introduced.how: A cartography trainee sent by Vice Captain Lohen to learn surveying from Mika
introduced.quote: This is Mr. Tres. Vice Captain Lohen sent him here to compare notes and learn some cartography skills with me

introduced.name: Reconnaissance Company
introduced.how: Mika and Elowen are members of this group
introduced.quote: And this is Elowen. A member of the Reconnaissance Company, just like me.

introduced.name: Surveying and Searching challenge
introduced.how: A survey-route training challenge designed to be learnable by novices
introduced.quote: Our goal is to design a survey route that even a novice can grasp on their first try.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Are the Knights of Favonius having a picnic?

assumed.name: Vice Captain Lohen
assumed.quote: they probably would have ended up in Vice Captain Lohen's display case of unidentified objects

assumed.name: Koch
assumed.quote: the gunsmiths of the 8th Coy... especially Koch, would parade me around as the poster child for hard work

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: After all, these dishes were designed specifically for long-term duty near the Dragonspine area.

assumed.name: Nations
assumed.quote: we received help from allied troops from different nations this time.

assumed.name: last joint exercise
assumed.quote: Thanks to the connections we've made during our last joint exercise

threads.claim: Mika's perfectionism is tied to the idea that cartography results affect other people, a theme Tres repeats.
threads.quote: This is because you're not the only person affected by the results.

threads.claim: The Traveler is hailed as the world's best knight with a commanding presence.
threads.quote: I'm just a rookie, and the world's best knight is standing right in front of me!

introduced.name: Hajanad
introduced.how: self-introduction as a Spantamad alchemist aiming to become a famous researcher
introduced.quote: Hajanad: I, Hajanad, am Spantamad's Star of Tomorrow! Just you wait!

introduced.name: Remelting Effect
introduced.how: Hajanad's named process of vaporizing and mixing two potion flakes by explosion to spread potion vapor across an area
introduced.quote: Hajanad: I call this process the "Remelting Effect," the device the "Remelting Device," and the potion "Remelting Tablets."

introduced.name: Remelting Device
introduced.how: alchemy device sealed under high pressure that is ignited with small explosives to release potion vapor
introduced.quote: Hajanad: When you need to use the potion, you just ignite the small explosives inside the device.

introduced.name: Remelting Tablets
introduced.how: potion made by compressing two concentrated potions into divided crystallized flakes that mix when the device explodes
introduced.quote: Hajanad: I have compressed two types of highly concentrated potions into crystallized flakes and divided them into equal pieces.

introduced.name: Alchemy battle support
introduced.how: alchemy potions can support and strengthen fighters in battle, and alchemists strive to explore their full potential
introduced.quote: Hajanad: Supporting battles is one of the most essential services alchemy has to offer.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's not as if we're lacking Mora or anything.

assumed.name: Spantamad
assumed.quote: Hajanad: I, Hajanad, am Spantamad's Star of Tomorrow! Just you wait!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Hajanad: Of course. There are tons of alchemists around Teyvat just like me, and we strive to explore the full potential of alchemy.

assumed.name: Adventure commission
assumed.quote: Paimon: Well... This one can't be harder than a regular adventure commission, so let's just go and test this device out in that domain, shall we?

assumed.name: Domain
assumed.quote: Hajanad: There's a domain nearby, actually. According to feedback from other adventurers, it's suitable for the combat tests we wish to conduct.

threads.claim: Hajanad's obsession with research may stem from being bullied in the past, hinting at a personal backstory.
threads.quote: Hajanad: This is so out of the blue that I'm not sure either... Maybe it's just because I was bullied in the past that I got obsessed.

threads.claim: Hajanad is living in severe poverty, eating only once a day and rarely having three meals a week.
threads.quote: Hajanad: I'm used to eating once a day by now. Sometimes I only have three meals in a week, so this shouldn't be a problem.

threads.claim: Hajanad insists the Remelting Tablets are safe, a claim the party doubts and that remains untested.
threads.quote: Hajanad: Not a problem. I have done the necessary experiments many times, so I can guarantee that it is safe!

threads.claim: The Remelting Device's explosion is not accurate enough, making potion effects unstable and requiring redesign.
threads.quote: Hajanad: The current explosion is not accurate enough to control the exact potion mix, so the effects can be unstable.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects Hajanad has bad intentions, leaving her true motives in question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Plus, Paimon think she has bad intentions. Maybe it's just her eagerness toward her studies that made her a bit weird.

threads.claim: Hajanad recognizes her social shortcomings and resolves to work on her emotions and expressions after meeting the travelers.
threads.quote: Hajanad: But since I've met you guys, I've been doing some self-reflection, and I believe that I should really work on my emotions and expressions.

introduced.name: Arataki Gang
introduced.how: an unauthorized gang of festival organizers led by Itto
introduced.quote: Paimon: It's the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, organized by the Arataki Gang!

introduced.name: Arataki Itto
introduced.how: the gang's boss who organizes the festival
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: I invited you all here to attend the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival! A highly important festival, I might add.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: designates Amakane Island as a cheap, simple venue for community festivals
introduced.quote: Kimura: Which is a venue designated by the Yashiro Commission for use in all kinds of festivals, big and small.

introduced.name: Amakane Island
introduced.how: a festival venue with a simpler, cheaper application process
introduced.quote: Kimura: Anyway, if you are looking for the Arataki Gang, you could try going to Amakane Island.

introduced.name: Hirohiko
introduced.how: a Yashiro Commission representative on Amakane Island
introduced.quote: Paimon: There should be a Yashiro Commission representative here. Let's go and ask him.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: a Tenryou Commission official who has also visited Amakane Island
introduced.quote: Hirohiko: Yep, Madam Kujou Sara of the Tenryou Commission and Yoimiya of Naganohara Fireworks have both been here so far.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: an official body that posts notices and suspends festivals
introduced.quote: Mamoru: Just now, someone from the Tenryou Commission came to post a notice on the bulletin board saying our festival has to be suspended.

introduced.name: Yoimiya
introduced.how: owner of Naganohara Fireworks who was delivering fireworks to Amakane Island
introduced.quote: Hirohiko: Yoimiya noticed them getting the venue ready when she was here to deliver some fireworks.

introduced.name: Naganohara Fireworks
introduced.how: Yoimiya's fireworks business, which may supply fireworks to the festival
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: Looks like the Arataki Gang should make sure to keep good ties with Naganohara Fireworks in the future.

introduced.name: Genta
introduced.how: the festival's Welcome Ambassador who checks the hand drum
introduced.quote: Genta: I'm Genta, the Arataki Drumalong Festival Welcome Ambassador. Are you ready for your Drumalong performance?

introduced.name: Shinobu
introduced.how: a gang member billed as the festival's star, handing out flyers
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey! Shinobu's supposed to be the star of the show, isn't she?

introduced.name: Singalong Hill
introduced.how: a hill on the island where guests can stand and sing over the sea
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: See that hill over there? That's Singalong Hill. Stand at the top, look out over the sea, and sing your heart out.

introduced.name: Drumalong hand drum
introduced.how: the hand drum used in the festival's Drumalong performance
introduced.quote: Arataki Itto: But of course, the highlight of this festival is the Drumalong. Here, feast your eyes on this.

introduced.name: Festival and Culture Center
introduced.how: a facility on Amakane Island with first-rate equipment for venues
introduced.quote: Akira: The venue is situated against the backdrop of Amakane Island, where you can enjoy exclusive access to the Festival and Culture Center's first-rate equipment.

assumed.name: Irodori Festival
assumed.quote: Kimura: Ah yes! The same Arataki Gang who made a scene at the Irodori Festival?

assumed.name: Boss's earlier arrest
assumed.quote: Mamoru: Boss got arrested again!

assumed.name: Shogun
assumed.quote: Akira: Hmm... Well, I think Boss is right. The Almighty Shogun would definitely wanna come to the festival.

assumed.name: Okuzumeshuu
assumed.quote: Mamoru: Anyway, the boss was arrested on the spot by the Okuzumeshuu.

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: And these boxes. Plenty of space whether you wanna play Genius Invokation TCG or a-battle some beetles.

assumed.name: Lavender Melon
assumed.quote: Arataki Itto: Hmph, trust a puny little flying Lavender Melon to stoop to the level of childish name-calling!

threads.claim: Itto is arrested again and the charge against him is reduced to a misdemeanor.
threads.quote: Mamoru: Then Madam Kujou Sara changed it to obstructing the public order.

threads.claim: Itto vows to defeat Kujou Sara after she posts a warning bulletin at the venue.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: One day, I'm gonna defeat that tengu fair and square, in broad daylight, in the middle of the street! She'll get what's coming to her!

threads.claim: Genta blames Kujou Sara for charging Itto, and she is shown to be the one who downgrades the charge.
threads.quote: Genta: Ahhhhh, that despicable Kujou Tengu! How can she get away with charging Boss with a felony over something like this!

threads.claim: Shinobu is the festival's star and the festival is meant to celebrate her graduation.
threads.quote: Mamoru: Secondly, it's to celebrate Shinobu's graduation!

threads.claim: Shinobu is handling the legal case against Itto while the festival is suspended.
threads.quote: Mamoru: Shinobu's probably on the case by now.

threads.claim: The gang hopes the Shogun will attend the festival after flyers were sent to Tenshukaku.
threads.quote: Mamoru: He did say that the Shogun would definitely not wanna miss the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, after all!

threads.claim: The hand drum may be damaged and overpriced, raising doubts about its origin and value.
threads.quote: Arataki Itto: I spotted the damage on the edge right away.

threads.claim: Nobody in the gang knows whether the hand drum is in tune, so it must be tested before performing.
threads.quote: Genta: Since none of us really know if it's in tune or not, please test it out first.

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission suspends the festival after the gang is arrested.
threads.quote: Mamoru: Just now, someone from the Tenryou Commission came to post a notice on the bulletin board saying our festival has to be suspended.

introduced.name: Sucrose
introduced.how: Alchemy researcher and Albedo's student who is eager to uncover his secret
introduced.quote: Timaeus and I are both passionate researchers of alchemy.

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: Sucrose's fellow alchemy researcher, who feels outshone by Albedo at data work
introduced.quote: Timaeus and I were helping Albedo organize research data.

introduced.name: Albedo
introduced.how: Alchemist and Sucrose's teacher who may be hiding a secret
introduced.quote: But isn't he your teacher? What would a teacher have to hide from his students?

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: Snowy mountain where snow never melts and where Durin crashed
introduced.quote: Snow gathers atop this mountain and never melts, which is a most curious phenomenon.

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: Black dragon that menaced Mondstadt, defeated and crashed on the mountain
introduced.quote: After a fierce battle, the vanquished Durin crashed to ruin here, falling into the thick snow.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Bandit group that smuggles goods and robs adventurers on the mountain
introduced.quote: Not long ago, the Knights caught a band of Treasure Hoarders outside the city.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Group hunting the sword, rather than merely named
introduced.quote: I think the Fatui are looking for this sword.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Adventurer leader who guides newcomers up the mountain
introduced.quote: Yes, perhaps it is too soon to ask our greenhorns to come adventuring here...

introduced.name: Reckless Pallad
introduced.how: Hotheaded Mondstadt adventurer who got lost and frozen in the snow
introduced.quote: Isn't that the hotheaded adventurer from Mondstadt? Did he come here with Cyrus to explore the Snowy Mountain, too?

introduced.name: Vadim
introduced.how: Fatui agent who demands the sword and plans to gift it to Signora
introduced.quote: We won't let you go unless you give us that sword.

introduced.name: Cursed magical sword
introduced.how: Legendary sword forged by a blacksmith who vanished; only the Traveler can wield it safely
introduced.quote: This ancient-looking weapon once passed through the hands of a now-deceased blacksmith. It is a legendary magical sword.

introduced.name: Durin's remains
introduced.how: Dragon's eyes, claws and scales ground into dust and coated on the blade
introduced.quote: The dragon's eyes, claws, and scales, ground into dust before being used to coat the blade.

introduced.name: Durin's corruption
introduced.how: Dragon's venom and corruption that empowers the sword and poisons wielders
introduced.quote: Durin's corruption and venom entered into the sword, and became the source of its power.

introduced.name: Ley line disorder
introduced.how: Area with unusual ley lines that strengthen nearby monsters
introduced.quote: Its ley lines flow differently from any other.

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: The Fatui are collecting things related the archons.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: It seems plausible that Barbatos would think of such a method.

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: we did hear Master Diluc say that.

assumed.name: Dvalin's Tears
assumed.quote: You've purified Dvalin's Tears before, which is a very rare ability indeed.

assumed.name: Harbinger Signora
assumed.quote: This sword will make a fine gift for Her Excellency, Harbinger Signora!

assumed.name: Rhinedottir
assumed.quote: Rhinedottir... Master... Is this your creation, the giant dragon Durin?

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: This place may be infested with wicked hilichurl bandits and knee-deep snow

assumed.name: Cryo Regisvine
assumed.quote: That Regisvine...

threads.claim: Albedo is concealing a secret from his students and the Traveler.
threads.quote: I feel like Albedo is... concealing something from myself and Timaeus.

threads.claim: Albedo admits some things cannot be explained in detail.
threads.quote: But I will not deceive you. There are some things I cannot go into detail on.

threads.claim: Durin's remains are hidden in the sword and somewhere on the mountain.
threads.quote: In fact, I believe that the very sword in your hand has Durin's remains in it.

threads.claim: Durin's power may itself be a curse that holds the mountain's monsters.
threads.quote: The dragon's mysterious power... may itself be a form of curse.

threads.claim: It is unclear whether Durin's fall to the mountain was chance or intent.
threads.quote: Was Durin's fall here purely by chance, or was it intent?

threads.claim: The blacksmith who forged the sword vanished, and the sword was lost to time.
threads.quote: It is said that the smith vanished not long after creating this weapon, with the weapon subsequently becoming lost to time.

threads.claim: The Fatui collect archon-related items and want the sword.
threads.quote: The Fatui are collecting things related the archons.

threads.claim: The sword absorbs energy from fallen enemies and grows stronger.
threads.quote: Each time this sword absorbs power from the bodies of fallen enemies, it will resonate with Durin's remains, hidden somewhere on this mountain.

threads.claim: Albedo has a link to Rhinedottir and the dragon Durin's creation.
threads.quote: Rhinedottir... Master... Is this your creation, the giant dragon Durin?

threads.claim: Albedo implies he is an unusual, lonely person like the Traveler.
threads.quote: Lonely individuals... Those who aren't like ordinary people. Just like... you and me.

threads.claim: Albedo questions whether meeting the Traveler was a good thing.
threads.quote: Was the two of us meeting really a good thing?

threads.claim: The Traveler's purification ability protects them from corruption and poison.
threads.quote: This ability has protected you from being corrupted or poisoned, and you can completely eliminate their effects.

threads.claim: Purified dragon life force can revive withered plants and empower them.
threads.quote: The dragon's power... the dragon's life force can revive withered plants and empower them to such a degree...

threads.claim: Albedo extracts the sword's purified life force, ending his experiment.
threads.quote: I've already obtained the results of the experiment.

introduced.name: Qingxing
introduced.how: A townsperson who chats with the Traveler about the paper play and is a fan of it
introduced.quote: Qingxing: Yes, there's going to be a paper play. Are you guys here for it, too?

introduced.name: Hesheng
introduced.how: A bystander at the paper play who keeps Qingxing quiet and wants to see a specific scene
introduced.quote: Hesheng: Qingxing! The show is about to begin. Be quiet, or you'll affect the performance.

introduced.name: Yinggong
introduced.how: The narrator and sole performer of the paper play who explains the art form
introduced.quote: Yinggong: I am the narrator, but I am no actor. You will meet the three paper actors in just a moment.

introduced.name: Paper play
introduced.how: A form of opera where paper figures pasted on silk act on a paper screen instead of live actors on a wooden stage
introduced.quote: Yinggong: As you may know, the characters in Liyue Operas are portrayed by real people in the flesh, the actors in our performances, however, are portrayed with paper figures pasted on silk.

introduced.name: Bravebeard (Huanguang)
introduced.how: A man who dwelt in the mountains, became an adeptus's disciple, and is known as the Bravebeard
introduced.quote: Yinggong: There was once a man named Huanguang, suffering from human injustice, who resorted to dwelling amongst the mountains and rivers.

introduced.name: Yibing
introduced.how: The Bravebeard's sister, left alone and helpless at home
introduced.quote: The poor sister, Yibing, was now alone and helpless.

introduced.name: Nanfeng
introduced.how: An honest gentleman who is a supporting character in the Bravebeard's romance scene
introduced.quote: There is also a lonely girl named Yibing and an honest gentleman named Nanfeng.

introduced.name: Dvorak
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a musician from Fontaine and an organizer of music festivals
introduced.quote: Dvorak: I'm Dvorak, a musician from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Yaoyao
introduced.how: A young girl who introduces herself, rescues Dvorak from the water, and is a Liyue local
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: Greetings, everyone. My name is Yaoyao. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

introduced.name: Iridescence Tour
introduced.how: One of the biggest music festivals in Fontaine, which its organizers want to hold in every nation
introduced.quote: Dvorak: The Iridescence Tour is one of the biggest music festivals in Fontaine.

introduced.name: The Lady Overlooking the Lake
introduced.how: A Fontaine local legend about a fairy lady who saved Dvorak's ancestor from drowning
introduced.quote: Dvorak: The story's become something of a local legend in Fontaine.

introduced.name: Dvorak's ancestor's rescue
introduced.how: Dvorak's ancestor fell into a lake, heard a beautiful tune, and was pulled ashore by a mysterious woman
introduced.quote: Dvorak: The story goes that my ancestor, who was also a traveler, once slipped and fell into a lake during his travels.

introduced.name: Anemo Archon as music patron
introduced.how: Mondstadt is the City of Song and Freedom, and the Anemo Archon is a patron deity of music
introduced.quote: Dvorak: I'd always known that Mondstadt is the City of Song and Freedom.

introduced.name: Nascent Bamboo Shoots
introduced.how: A seasonal, tender and sweet variety of bamboo shoot prized by Zhongli for cooking
introduced.quote: Zhongli: I had planned to take a walk to Qingce Village and gather some nascent Bamboo Shoots, which are currently in season.

introduced.name: Lantern Rite
introduced.how: Liyue's most important festival, held once a year with a big celebration
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, we are here during Lantern Rite, after all! It only comes once a year, so they always have a big celebration.

introduced.name: Lotus Flower Crisp
introduced.how: A Liyue snack that Yaoyao carries and shares, a crisp that Paimon loves
introduced.quote: Yaoyao: I still have some Lotus Flower Crisps left in my backpack. Why don't we split them between the four of us?

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Scam artists who spread fake legends to swindle gullible people out of Mora
introduced.quote: It sounds a bit too much like one of those fake legends told by those treasure hoarder guys to scam gullible grannies from Qingce Village

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: Says she is part-human and part-qilin and is related to the adepti; works closely with the Qixing
introduced.quote: Ganyu: To tell you the truth, Mr. Dvorak, I am somewhat related to the adepti myself. I am part-human and part-qilin.

introduced.name: Keqing
introduced.how: Introduces herself by name and says she will oversee the concert on the Qixing's behalf
introduced.quote: Keqing: Greetings, , Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak. Call me Keqing.

introduced.name: Madame Ping
introduced.how: An elder of Liyue who knows the city's cultural traditions and is Yaoyao's Master
introduced.quote: Paimon: You're an elder of Liyue, and you know all about Liyue's cultural traditions.

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: A well-known opera singer in Liyue who could support the concert
introduced.quote: Xinyan: My friend Yun Jin is a well-known opera singer in Liyue.

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: A hard-to-reach area of Liyue that is easy to enter but very difficult to leave
introduced.quote: Like Jueyun Karst itself. There's nothing specifically stopping you from going there, but getting in and out of there is quite an ordeal.

introduced.name: Sea Gazer
introduced.how: A legendary adeptus remembered as free-spirited, cheerful, and a loyal friend, modeled by this year's Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.quote: Ningguang: Legend holds that he was free-spirited and easy-going. People described him as a cheerful soul and a loyal friend.

introduced.name: Mingxiao Lantern
introduced.how: This year's festive lantern at the docks, modeled on an adeptus
introduced.quote: Ningguang: I trust you saw this year's Mingxiao Lantern at the docks when you arrived at the city?

introduced.name: Bandit horn tune
introduced.how: A folk story of bandits who sounded a horn to terrify villagers into fleeing their homes
introduced.quote: Yelan: A long time ago, there used to be a group of bandits in the Liyue countryside who would sound a horn every time they were about to raid a village.

introduced.name: Fujing
introduced.how: A Treasure Hoarder who confesses to copying the bandit horn tune to rob a house
introduced.quote: Fujing: I remember the tune, so I... I figured I'd try it for myself.

introduced.name: Yelan
introduced.how: Presents herself as one of the best trackers in the business who is investigating the crime
introduced.quote: Unfortunately for them, I'm one of the best trackers in the business.

introduced.name: Baiwen
introduced.how: Works for Ningguang gathering intelligence outside the city and reports the strange melody
introduced.quote: Per Lady Ningguang's orders, I've been gathering intelligence outside of the city with the goal of uncovering and dispatching any trouble ahead of the festival.

introduced.name: Guizhong
introduced.how: Another name of Haagentus, the God of Dust; extroverted and fond of gatherings and inventions
introduced.quote: Guizhong is another name of Haagentus, the God of Dust. She was extroverted in nature, and adored social gatherings and inventions alike.

introduced.name: Streetward Rambler
introduced.how: The adeptus known today as Madame Ping, who rescued the drowning man
introduced.quote: That would be Ping.

introduced.name: Sea Gazer
introduced.how: Old friend and rival of Cloud Retainer who showed off treasures he dug up
introduced.quote: Sea Gazer would always bring out his latest treasure and place it upon the table.

introduced.name: Marchosius
introduced.how: Stove God who brought delicious dishes to the gatherings
introduced.quote: Marchosius would bring his delectable dishes to the table.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Impartial adeptus who judged the creations and confiscated the bell; the man called Zhongli is him
introduced.quote: she realized that the man was none other than Rex Lapis, and that he had made an enormous decision.

introduced.name: Cleansing Bell
introduced.how: Mechanical bell composed on by Guizhong, later given to Streetward Rambler for ceremonies
introduced.quote: Rex Lapis granted her the Cleansing Bell for safekeeping

introduced.name: Obscuro Vulpes Mechanism
introduced.how: Guizhong's mechanism that Rex Lapis judged superior
introduced.quote: That Guizhong's Obscuro Vulpes Mechanism was superior

introduced.name: Guili Plains
introduced.how: Former prosperous assembly site that became a battlefield in the war between the gods
introduced.quote: War broke out between the gods, and soon engulfed the Guili Plains

introduced.name: Guizhong's death
introduced.how: Guizhong was overpowered and fell in battle during the war between the gods
introduced.quote: Guizhong was overpowered by the enemy, and fell in battle

introduced.name: Iridescence Tour
introduced.how: Music performance tour stage where Xinyan and Hu Tao perform at the festival
introduced.quote: I'm honored to be here on the Iridescence Tour stage!

introduced.name: Yun-Han Opera Troupe
introduced.how: Liyue opera troupe where Yinggong works on wardrobe and props
introduced.quote: After this, I will return to the Yun-Han Opera Troupe to handle the wardrobe and props.

introduced.name: Yinggong
introduced.how: Backstage troupe member who does paper plays as a hobby and handles props
introduced.quote: You see, doing paper plays for kids is actually a hobby of mine.

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild dispatched by the Ministry of Civil Affairs to clear monsters and bandits during the festival
introduced.quote: we of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild have been dispatched by the Ministry of Civil Affairs to help with some tertiary tasks.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Group primarily responsible for patrolling the city during the festival
introduced.quote: The Millelith are primarily responsible for patrolling the city and other key areas.

introduced.name: Launch Tube
introduced.how: Miniature launcher used to fire fireworks that mark an area as cleared
introduced.quote: please take this miniature Launch Tube.

introduced.name: Shenhe's training life
introduced.how: Shenhe trains with her Master in summer and winter and learns to live in Liyue Harbor the rest of the year
introduced.quote: During the summer and winter, I continue to train with Master.

introduced.name: Xinyue Kiosk
introduced.how: a restaurant with a very long waitlist where the dinner meets
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oooh, and we'll be meeting at... Xinyue Kiosk! It's the place with a reaaaally long waitlist!

introduced.name: Xiao
introduced.how: the Conqueror of Demons, whom exorcists have worked with for generations
introduced.quote: we exorcists have worked in close collaboration with the Conqueror of Demons for many generations

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: introduces himself as working at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and living as a mortal
introduced.quote: Zhongli: I'm Zhongli, currently working at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. It's a pleasure to meet you, new friend.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: Zhongli's true identity as an archon, revealed by Xiao
introduced.quote: Xiao: Or perhaps I should say Zhong... Rex Lapis is really good at adapting to human life.

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: described as the Anemo Archon, a free-spirited bard
introduced.quote: Xiao: The Anemo Archon is a free spirit, and his temperament is as carefree as the music he plays on the flute.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: group that purified the diseased and sent off the spirits of the dead in the war
introduced.quote: and Wangsheng Funeral Parlor was responsible for purifying the diseased and sending off the spirits of the dead.

introduced.name: Archon War
introduced.how: past war of plague, demons, and disaster that the adepti and Millelith fought
introduced.quote: In the time of the Archon War, disputes were frequent, and disaster overtook the land.

introduced.name: Hu Tao
introduced.how: introduces herself as Zhongli's boss at the funeral parlor
introduced.quote: Hu Tao: Mm-hmm, and I'm his boss. Oh, and if there's anything unsatisfactory, let me know anytime!

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: introduces himself as Xiangling and Chongyun's friend
introduced.quote: I'm Xingqiu, Xiangling and Chongyun's friend.

introduced.name: Zhenyu
introduced.how: Xingqiu's pen name as a light novel author, which Venti nearly reveals
introduced.quote: Traveler: (Oh no, he's gonna give Xingqiu's pen name away...)

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: one of the largest commerce guilds in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: surely the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild counts? It's one of the largest commerce guilds in Liyue Harbor!

introduced.name: adepti
introduced.how: ancient beings who each have specialties and are often proud and arrogant
introduced.quote: The adepti all have their specialties, making most of them proud and arrogant.

introduced.name: Tiantian
introduced.how: introduces herself as a recruiter who hangs out at Feiyun Slope
introduced.quote: Tiantian: I'm Tiantian. I usually hang out around the Feiyun Slope, looking to recruit new people into the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: organization that recruiters like Tiantian try to fill with new members
introduced.quote: looking to recruit new people into the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Huixing
introduced.how: introduces herself as the navigator of the Crux fleet
introduced.quote: Huixing: I'm Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet. I'm also responsible for fleet-related events for this Lantern Rite.

introduced.name: Crux fleet
introduced.how: a sea fleet whose navigator runs its Lantern Rite events and training
introduced.quote: I'm Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: government body that organizes sailing training courses and qualifications
introduced.quote: The Ministry of Civil Affairs organizes most of the training courses.

introduced.name: Vigilance at Sea
introduced.how: an intensive navigation training examination for sailors
introduced.quote: I'm currently getting ready for my training examination

introduced.name: Soraya
introduced.how: a Sumeru scholar researching the past whom Zhongli once spoke with
introduced.quote: I once had a pleasant chat about the past and present with a Sumeru scholar named Soraya

introduced.name: Lantern Rite music festival
introduced.how: a music festival hosted in Liyue during this year's Lantern Rite
introduced.quote: I heard that Liyue will be hosting a Lantern Rite music festival this year.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eh? Zhongli! What a pleasant surprise meeting you here!

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon votes we go say hi to Xiangling first...

assumed.name: Xinyan
assumed.quote: Xinyan: Hey, everyone! Fancy meeting you all here! What a nice surprise.

assumed.name: Ganyu
assumed.quote: Paimon: You know what, it's been a minute since we saw Ganyu, too.

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Madame Ping: Ah, look who it is. Visiting friends during the Lantern Rite, are we?

assumed.name: Ningguang
assumed.quote: Paimon: No need to be so formal with us, Ningguang! We've known each other for a long time now.

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yelan!? How did you sneak up on us like that?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ugh, not the Treasure Hoarders again!

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Traveler: If we use Elemental Sight...

assumed.name: Liyue Opera
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is it a Liyue Opera?

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Dvorak: Are you telling me... all the rumors of the Liyue adepti are real? So it's not just artistic license?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: And anyway, you only got scammed if you handed over Mora, right?

assumed.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
assumed.quote: Ganyu: ...and when you meet with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, please remind them that the festivities are not an excuse to procrastinate their work.

assumed.name: Mr. Dvorak's contract
assumed.quote: I promised I'd help Mr. Dvorak, and now that I've made the contract, I can't be having second thoughts.

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Madame Ping possesses vast knowledge and great wisdom.

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: Once the Archon War came to an end, I stayed behind in Liyue Harbor to honor my contract.

assumed.name: Zhongli
assumed.quote: Zhongli said he wasn't in a hurry, so if we went now, there's probably still time, right?

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: We could always just go pester Masterful Chef, Xiangling.

assumed.name: Yun Jin
assumed.quote: Was that... from the opera that Yun Jin sang?

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Shenhe, and the Conqueror of Demons...

assumed.name: Yanfei
assumed.quote: Granny!

assumed.name: Tianquan
assumed.quote: The Tianquan footing the bill? I can't miss out on that

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Happy Lantern Rite, Shenhe.

assumed.name: Guoba
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hu Tao was the one who invited us, but she's not here! And, oh, where's Guoba?

assumed.name: Xinyan
assumed.quote: Xiangling: Me too. I've seen Xinyan perform before, but this is the first time I've watched something like this.

assumed.name: Yun Jin
assumed.quote: She's more busy than ever, and Yun Jin's gonna help her.

assumed.name: Masterful Chefs competition
assumed.quote: Xiangling: He helped try my dishes during the Masterful Chefs cook-off!

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: The only heir of the famous Wanmin Restaurant, a good old friend of mine.

assumed.name: Captain Beidou
assumed.quote: Huixing: I heard about your stories from Captain Beidou.

assumed.name: Streetward Rambler and Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: I heard that during the Lantern Rite music festival, you conferred with Streetward Rambler and Cloud Retainer.

assumed.name: General Kapisas
assumed.quote: Xiao: General Kapisas always said that we should live in the present and enjoy every pleasant surprise.

assumed.name: Brother Bosacius
assumed.quote: Brother Bosacius never tried to hide his distaste in front of him.

assumed.name: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
assumed.quote: Traveler: Xiao, don't pull any Lemniscatic Wind Cyclings on us.

assumed.name: Tone-Deaf Bard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh! It's the Tone-Deaf Bard!

assumed.name: Wangshu Inn
assumed.quote: Hu Tao: Guardian of Wangshu Inn! Hero of Dihua Marsh!

assumed.name: Guardian Yakshas
assumed.quote: I talked about the funeral parlor's past relationships with the Guardian Yakshas

assumed.name: Iridescence Tour
assumed.quote: The Iridescence Tour has finally been held successfully for once, so I had to congratulate him.

assumed.name: Chef Yanxiao
assumed.quote: Zhongli: I had a pleasant chat with Chef Yanxiao and received some spices from him.

threads.claim: The woman who saved Dvorak's ancestor had an almost divine aura and vanished without a word, leaving her identity a mystery.
threads.quote: Dvorak: When he finally came to, he found that he had already been brought ashore. Not too far from him stood an unfamiliar woman with an almost divine aura.

threads.claim: Ganyu suggests the lady who saved the ancestor may have been an adeptus.
threads.quote: I wonder if this lady your ancestor met might have been an adeptus.

threads.claim: Ningguang hears that the Traveler will search for the descendants of the fairy lady, extending the mystery.
threads.quote: Ningguang: I heard that you'll be going on a search with Ganyu to find the descendants of a fairy lady from a Fontaine legend.

threads.claim: A wind carrying leaves westward toward Stone Gate is said to guide Dvorak toward Liyue, a hint that the wind points to the lost lady.
threads.quote: I noticed a cluster of leaves being blown in the wind, further and further west, towards Stone Gate.

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon is revealed to be a patron deity of music, a hint of divine involvement in the music theme.
threads.quote: Dvorak: I'd always known that Mondstadt is the City of Song and Freedom.

threads.claim: Ganyu is part-human and part-qilin, related to the adepti, and has personally searched for where she belongs.
threads.quote: trying to find out where I belonged

threads.claim: Paimon affirms that the rumors of the adepti are real, though they are hard to track down.
threads.quote: Paimon: You bet they're real! Trying to track them down is tough, though...

threads.claim: A strange melody has been heard along the coast, and the Traveler is asked to investigate it.
threads.quote: I am told that a strange melody was heard somewhere along the coast.

threads.claim: The melody is revealed as a copycat crime: a Treasure Hoarder reused the bandits' horn tune to scare a family out of their home.
threads.quote: I remember the tune, so I... I figured I'd try it for myself.

threads.claim: Music can be used for crime, and the emotions tied to a tune depend on the ill will of whoever plays it.
threads.quote: Traveler: Their bad deeds influenced the emotions associated with the music.

threads.claim: The Bravebeard's sister Yibing is left alone, and the story of his return home is held back for later.
threads.quote: As to what happened next...

threads.claim: The Iridescence Tour has suffered a string of failed attempts to put on shows, raising doubt about its prospects.
threads.quote: We've had a string of terrible luck recently, and every time we've tried to put on a show, something or other has come up to stop our plans from materializing

threads.claim: Keqing and the Qixing approve Ganyu's proposal, so the Iridescence Tour gets a concert at the Lantern Rite.
threads.quote: The Qixing have approved Ganyu's proposal.

threads.claim: Dvorak asks what music means to people and promises to revisit the question after the concert.
threads.quote: Let's revisit this question after the concert.

threads.claim: Keqing quotes a saying that the one who returns after three moons is no longer the one who left, hinting at change in returning travelers.
threads.quote: Be it but three moons from the start, he who returns is not he that departs.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer reveals that Guizhong died in battle during the war between the gods, answering how she was lost.
threads.quote: Guizhong was overpowered by the enemy, and fell in battle

threads.claim: Madame Ping has only played her melody once and promises to play it again later, leaving the tune unheard.
threads.quote: As for that melody, I will play it for you all another time.

threads.claim: Zhongli is hinted to be Rex Lapis, the old friend who gave up the bell and made a major decision.
threads.quote: she realized that the man was none other than Rex Lapis, and that he had made an enormous decision.

threads.claim: Guizhong's unfinished manuscripts remain in the Realm of Clouds, hinting at unrealized work.
threads.quote: Her manuscripts still lie unfinished in the Realm of Clouds

threads.claim: The bell's origin is revealed as one of Guizhong's proudest works, explaining Madame Ping's earlier claim about an old friend.
threads.quote: That Cleansing Bell was one of Guizhong's proudest works

threads.claim: Adepti normally do not age, but Madame Ping has chosen to grow old, raising questions about adeptus lifespans.
threads.quote: Normally, adepti don't age at all!

threads.claim: Streetward Rambler suggests that adepti are no different from mortals, who are like lanterns that burn briefly before going out.
threads.quote: We think of human life as like a lantern that's lit one minute and extinguished the next, but are we adepti so different?

threads.claim: Ganyu admits she has not felt integrated into Liyue's human community and has begun to change that view.
threads.quote: So I haven't been able to integrate into their community, and be a part of their lives.

threads.claim: Madame Ping says grief eases with time and that life goes on, a theme repeated by Ganyu and Yinggong's loss.
threads.quote: even if one wished to mourn for an eternity, it would be a nigh-impossible feat.

threads.claim: Zhongli is revealed to be the archon Rex Lapis living as a mortal, and Xiao slips the name in front of others.
threads.quote: Xiao: Or perhaps I should say Zhong... Rex Lapis is really good at adapting to human life.

threads.claim: Venti's identity as the Anemo Archon is hinted through Xiao's comments on a free-spirited god who plays the flute.
threads.quote: Xiao: The Anemo Archon is a free spirit, and his temperament is as carefree as the music he plays on the flute.

threads.claim: A mysterious voice speaking from the wind is heard for the first time, and Paimon finishes its saying.
threads.quote: Seeds of story, brought by the wind

threads.claim: Xiao says an old friend's help before Lantern Rite has made his life much more stable, pointing to a figure not yet identified.
threads.quote: Xiao: Thanks to his help, things have been a lot more stable than before.

threads.claim: The Archon War is described as a time of plague and demons, when adepti and the funeral parlor kept the border between life and death.
threads.quote: That is how the border between life and death was maintained during the war, and it effectively prevented further incidents from happening.

threads.claim: Xiao's involvement with the exorcists and his karma is hinted as a matter he must handle carefully and cannot fully control.
threads.quote: Xiao: This matter is out of my control, so I need to be cautious.

threads.claim: Human legends about the gods are presented as incomplete, since gods have multiple sides and some are misremembered.
threads.quote: In the legends recorded by humans, some gods were depicted as arrogant and condescending, while others were kind and capable.

threads.claim: Soraya's research into the past is said to be very close to the truth, suggesting the real history is still being uncovered.
threads.quote: From the evidence she found and the conclusions she made, her area of research is already very close to the truth.

threads.claim: The music festival was not planned beforehand, which raises a question about why Venti arrived in Liyue.
threads.quote: (Huh, but the music festival wasn't planned beforehand...)

threads.claim: Xiao finds ordinary gatherings with friends strangely novel and struggles with his place among people, a theme of belonging.
threads.quote: Whenever I think of the ordinary conversations I've had with you, it feels... strangely novel.

introduced.name: Macadell
introduced.how: researcher with the Fontaine Research Institute who is trying to finish a stalled project
introduced.quote: Oops, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Macadell, a researcher with the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: the research body Macadell works for, now in turmoil after an explosion
introduced.quote: Oops, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Macadell, a researcher with the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: organization that takes commissions and sells adventurer services, which Macadell has an accord with
introduced.quote: Did you publish a commission with the Guild?

introduced.name: Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device
introduced.how: prototype power device that Macadell's team built and that now powers the Impactor
introduced.quote: I wanted to use the prototype Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device as the core to create a Pressurized Impactor.

introduced.name: Pressurized Impactor
introduced.how: machine powered by the storage device that crushes rocks at high output and struggles at low output
introduced.quote: When the output is high, this machine can easily crush rocks. But when output is low, even drilling a hole in mud is challenging.

introduced.name: Institute explosion
introduced.how: a huge blast at the Institute that killed the project leader and most of the project team
introduced.quote: The project leader and most of the members of the project team perished in the blast.

assumed.name: Institute explosion
assumed.quote: Then... Well, like everyone knows, a huge explosion occurred at the Institute.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Judging by your look... You're not from the Adventurers' Guild.

threads.claim: A huge explosion at the Institute killed the project leader and most of the team, and its cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Then... Well, like everyone knows, a huge explosion occurred at the Institute.

threads.claim: Power from the storage device fluctuates wildly, and Macadell does not know whether the cause is the design or the energy method.
threads.quote: The power going from the Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device to the Pressurized Impactor always fluctuated wildly.

threads.claim: Macadell insists the device is totally reliable and that an explosion is impossible, a claim the player may doubt.
threads.quote: That's absolutely not possible. I added a lot of safety and monitoring devices, so the worst case scenario that it doesn't have enough output. An explosion is impossible.

threads.claim: Macadell and the Adventurers' Guild reached an accord on the project, yet the Guild has not sent anyone to help.
threads.quote: So, after consulting with all parties, the Adventurers' Guild and I reached an accord.

threads.claim: Turmoil within the Institute pressures Macadell to prove the project's value quickly to keep it alive.
threads.quote: But... given the turmoil within the Institute, I must demonstrate its value as soon as possible in order to keep the project alive.

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: a Pari newly granted the Twin-Horned Chaplet and title of Bloomguard, proud and sharp-tongued, with a strange way of speaking
introduced.quote: Was because I am a Pari worthy of the Twin-Horned Chaplet.

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: the eldest Pari at the Vourukasha Oasis and Sorush's elder who sets her training
introduced.quote: The best among them is one called Zurvan.

introduced.name: Vourukasha Oasis
introduced.how: a flowery oasis with flowing water, home of the Pari and free of Dev's demons
introduced.quote: The place before us — covered with flowers and flowing water — is the Vourukasha Oasis.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: the winged people who were born from the Harvisptokhm's Amrita and live at the Oasis
introduced.quote: and is the home of the Pari.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: a human group of researchers and historians that was founded to help after the catastrophe and keeps archives
introduced.quote: Elder Zurvan clearly associated with the Order of Skeptics when they were first established, but after my birth, all contact seemed to be lost between them.

introduced.name: Harvisptokhm
introduced.how: the big stump at the Oasis, a god that the Pari emerged from
introduced.quote: Nourished by the Amrita, the Harvisptokhm and the Pari emerged.

introduced.name: Twin-Horned Chaplet
introduced.how: a crown Sorush won that is said to hold knowledge about a Bloomguard's duties
introduced.quote: No, the Chaplet possesses a great deal of knowledge, I need but contemplate for a moment before I am greeted with answers...

introduced.name: Bloomguard
introduced.how: a title that requires competence and insight and carries training tasks and duties
introduced.quote: As for all those who bear the title of Bloomguard, extraordinary competence and keen insight are necessities.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: small forest familiars bonded to plants who can walk the mud and have their own festival
introduced.quote: Indeed. The ones long called the Aranara.

introduced.name: Festival Utsava
introduced.how: the Aranara's day of celebration, a carefree gathering that the Pari lack an equivalent of
introduced.quote: But they do have their own festival. On that arrival of the day of celebration, the Aranara will gather together and enjoy a carefree time as one.

introduced.name: Wenut
introduced.how: a huge creature frozen in crystal inside a cave, sealed there and slowly decaying over centuries
introduced.quote: Indeed. The Wenut must've been frozen in an instant. As it has been crystallized, its form remains in perpetuity.

introduced.name: Amrita
introduced.how: a divine substance that nourished the Pari's birth and is the last gift of the divine
introduced.quote: As such, all the Amrita here is the last gift from the divine.

introduced.name: Tunigi Hollow
introduced.how: the epicenter of the disaster, full of huge crystals
introduced.quote: The Tunigi Hollow... this was the epicenter of the disaster.

introduced.name: Barsom
introduced.how: a tree that Rashnu is the familiar of
introduced.quote: As you behold, this tree is called Barsom, and Rashnu is its familiar, though she is absent right now.

introduced.name: Rashnu
introduced.how: a sleepy, quiet Pari who is hard to wake and is the familiar of the Barsom
introduced.quote: She always has that sleepy look on her face, and she didn't seem too happy when we woke her using the Kory Drums.

introduced.name: Mihir
introduced.how: a stained, long-suffering Pari who performs cleansing pilgrimages with thorny companions
introduced.quote: Her? Bah. For such a figure, one stained and still struggling thusly, I'd say she would only be worth any merit after another ten cleansing pilgrimages.

introduced.name: Oceanids
introduced.how: people from Fontaine who came to Sumeru after the catastrophe and walk a long holy pilgrimage
introduced.quote: After the catastrophe, a great number of Oceanids came from Fontaine to Sumeru, with the path they walked becoming their so-called holy path.

introduced.name: cleansing pilgrimage
introduced.how: a symbolic rise-and-return ritual, not really measured by distance
introduced.quote: It is more of a symbolic affair, showcasing a rise and return to form.

introduced.name: Nagarjuna
introduced.how: the leader of the first Order of Skeptics, a former forest researcher who settled to aid after the catastrophe
introduced.quote: Indeed. Their leader was Nagarjuna. He once was a researcher who worked in the depths of the woods, but he put roots down here to help alleviate the aftershocks of the catastrophe.

introduced.name: Simurgh
introduced.how: a divine bird who made a sacrifice and became a model for Pari heroism
introduced.quote: Just as Simurgh became the divine bird through her sacrifice, I will become the Bloomguard by my deeds and hear my name rightfully sung in praise of my service.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: an authority whose approval grants the Bloomguard title and whose choice is final
introduced.quote: Usually, the Khvarena's choice is final.

assumed.name: Yasnapati
assumed.quote: Yasnapati. And Floater. Bear witness to my heroic feats.

assumed.name: Kory Drums
assumed.quote: Haven't you already seen them in use?

assumed.name: Dev
assumed.quote: This place isn't infested by the demons of Dev, and is the home of the Pari.

assumed.name: Satyavada Life
assumed.quote: They said the researchers in the forest experienced a "Satyavada Life" or something like that.

assumed.name: Sign of Apaosha
assumed.quote: I believe that with their aid, the extinguishing of the Sign of Apaosha will be no difficult task.

threads.claim: A looming threat called the Sign of Apaosha must be extinguished, hinting at a future danger the Bloomguard must handle.
threads.quote: I believe that with their aid, the extinguishing of the Sign of Apaosha will be no difficult task.

threads.claim: Zurvan may have planned Sorush's entire training in advance for a purpose not yet revealed.
threads.quote: Seems like Zurvan had this training regimen all planned out a long time ago.

threads.claim: The Order of Skeptics' official records contain errors, so the archives cannot be fully trusted.
threads.quote: The Order of Skeptics even constantly makes mistakes in its official documents...

threads.claim: The Skeptics' archives have turned from truthful records into embellished, subjective accounts.
threads.quote: The Order of Skeptics's archives were no longer simple truthful records.

threads.claim: The catastrophe's crystallizing effect spread to the strongest creatures, which perished in the event.
threads.quote: Just as we saw of the Setekh Wenut, even the strongest creatures were crystallized, perishing during the event.

threads.claim: A possible hidden connection between the Oceanids and the Pari, through the Harvisptokhm, is raised but left open.
threads.quote: But what's the potential relationship between the Oceanids and the Harvisptokhm...?

threads.claim: Mihir's cleansing pilgrimage and her stained past are introduced as a figure whose worth is still disputed.
threads.quote: Her? Bah. For such a figure, one stained and still struggling thusly, I'd say she would only be worth any merit after another ten cleansing pilgrimages.

threads.claim: Sorush appears to be hiding something about Rashnu, the Barsom, and the Kory Drums.
threads.quote: Feels like you are hiding something... Right, about the Kory Drums...

threads.claim: Zurvan's remark that the Khvarena's choice cannot be changed is ambiguous, hinting she might still control the outcome.
threads.quote: Oh, ho ho... You really think so?

threads.claim: Simurgh's sacrifice is described as noble and no longer needed, leaving its meaning open to interpretation.
threads.quote: noble sacrifices like the one made by the divine bird, Simurgh, were no longer needed.

threads.claim: The Pari have no festival equivalent to the Aranara's Festival Utsava, a gap Sorush wants filled.
threads.quote: Sometimes I wonder, if the Aranara have their own day, why do we Pari possess nothing of equivalence?

threads.claim: Nothing on this land can endure time, and even memory and memorials may vanish, raising the theme of being forgotten.
threads.quote: However, no being on this land can overcome time.

threads.claim: Sorush questions whether forgotten efforts over centuries amount to anything.
threads.quote: If her existence and her efforts over these centuries are forgotten, then what was it all for?

introduced.name: Theater Mechanicus
introduced.how: a board game that Komakata explains, first invented in Liyue by Ruijin
introduced.quote: In short, it is a game that can be played on a board.

introduced.name: Ruijin
introduced.how: Ms. Ruijin, the inventor of Theater Mechanicus in Liyue who sends Komakata the game and instructions
introduced.quote: It was first invented by Ms. Ruijin from Liyue.

introduced.name: Komakata
introduced.how: a local representative and overseas agent for Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma
introduced.quote: according to Ms. Ruijin, I'm a local representative of Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Outlander Affairs Agency
introduced.how: an authority that confiscated the game when it came from overseas
introduced.quote: Although it initially got confiscated by the Outlander Affairs Agency...

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: the region where Komakata runs the local Theater Mechanicus business
introduced.quote: I'm a local representative of Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Ms. Ruijin told me that she promoted the game during the Lantern Rite...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: You must've played it in Liyue before.

threads.claim: The Outlander Affairs Agency confiscates goods coming from overseas, hinting at restrictions on outside items.
threads.quote: They'll confiscate anything from overseas...

threads.claim: Theater Mechanicus was made in Liyue and spread to Inazuma through Ruijin's overseas distribution.
threads.quote: After I obtained... umm... the distribution rights, Ms. Ruijin sent me a complete set of Theater Mechanicus

introduced.name: Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri
introduced.how: the island's most important ceremony, hosted by Kokomi
introduced.quote: Not long ago, I hosted the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. It's the most important ceremony on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Eboshi
introduced.how: self-introduction as Erebos, a Sangonomiya auxiliary in Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: My name is Erebos. In the Inazuman tongue, that would be Eboshi. I am an auxiliary of Sangonomiya, one of the shrine maidens of Enkanomiya.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya
introduced.how: a shrine-maiden group serving Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: I am an auxiliary of Sangonomiya, one of the shrine maidens of Enkanomiya.

introduced.name: Enkanomiya
introduced.how: deep realm with a cave system leading up to Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: The depths of Enkanomiya play host to a natural cave system that leads to Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: island reached through a cave system from Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: The depths of Enkanomiya play host to a natural cave system that leads to Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Omikami
introduced.how: divine ancestor who opened the gate to Enkanomiya's depths
introduced.quote: We must begin with Watatsumi Omikami opening the gate to the depths.

introduced.name: Sinshades
introduced.how: phenomenon that makes Enkanomiya's past and truth endure
introduced.quote: Due to the phenomenon known as Sinshades

introduced.name: The Three Great Martial Trials
introduced.how: trial path meant to limit who learns the whole truth
introduced.quote: The trial to obtain the branch was intended to limit the number of people coming after us who could know the whole truth of the matter.

introduced.name: Serpent's Heart
introduced.how: site where clues to a second set of trials are hidden
introduced.quote: You can go to the place they call the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: The Emanant Skylight
introduced.how: target of light pillars that must be unsealed to reach the trial
introduced.quote: These pillars point unto The Emanant Skylight.

introduced.name: Yabe
introduced.how: self-introduction; a mystery-loving man who seeks the Bunkoku Puzzle
introduced.quote: I'm not sure if you remember my name, but I'm Yabe.

introduced.name: Bunkoku
introduced.how: traitorous second Prime Minister of Byakuyakoku who hid a treasure
introduced.quote: One version says that Bunkoku was the second Prime Minister in Byakuyakoku's history.

introduced.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: site that hides a secret treasure chamber
introduced.quote: After that, he hid his treasure in a secret chamber inside the Dainichi Mikoshi.

introduced.name: Bunkoku's Secret Treasure
introduced.how: treasure hidden by Bunkoku, unlocked by stone slates
introduced.quote: Though it appears to be a mere stone slate, I believe it's the key to finding Bunkoku's Secret Treasure.

introduced.name: Sunfire Phantasms
introduced.how: mechanisms that conceal the treasure chamber, guarded by vengeful spirits
introduced.quote: Finally, he concealed the treasure chamber using the Sunfire Phantasms and summoned vengeful spirits and tainted beings from the Ley Lines to guard it.

introduced.name: Damaged Stone Slate
introduced.how: eight slates needed to open the treasure chamber
introduced.quote: It also says that there are eight stone slates in total. So far, we've only recovered one.

introduced.name: Koyanagi
introduced.how: Shade of Tokoyo guarding the chamber who denies being Bunkoku
introduced.quote: Don't you dare take me for that despicable, craven traitor! My name is Koyanagi.

introduced.name: Mysterious Stone Slate (Event Item)
