introduced.how: a ninth slate that is the final fragment
introduced.quote: Wait, this is... a final fragment! But why is there a ninth?

introduced.name: Tsumi
introduced.how: masked shrine maiden who treats wounded soldiers in Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: They say a shrine maiden who calls herself Tsumi has been helping to treat the wounded.

introduced.name: Imaizumi
introduced.how: wounded soldier rescued by Tsumi who vouches for her
introduced.quote: I was one of the first people that she rescued.

introduced.name: Ueno
introduced.how: self-introduction as acting captain of Swordfish I
introduced.quote: Greetings, my name is Ueno, acting captain of Swordfish I.

introduced.name: Swordfish I
introduced.how: unit evacuating the wounded in Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: Greetings, my name is Ueno, acting captain of Swordfish I.

introduced.name: Stingray III
introduced.how: unit sent into Enkanomiya to investigate
introduced.quote: The news from Stingray III was that

introduced.name: Holy Soil
introduced.how: bleaching process that makes land infertile
introduced.quote: It's a bleaching process that slowly turns the earth to

introduced.name: Sangacorallia
introduced.how: creatures that turn raw elemental energy into milder human-realm energy
introduced.quote: They are creatures that break down raw, primitive elemental energy into the milder elemental energy of the human realm.

introduced.name: Vassals of Watatsumi
introduced.how: half-human half-snake familiars of Omikami who long vanished
introduced.quote: The first familiars of the Watatsumi Omikami were the Vassals of Watatsumi.

introduced.name: Sentou Ceremony
introduced.how: ritual that keeps a light burning in Enkanomiya's center
introduced.quote: But she held something called a Sentou ceremony, which managed to keep a small area in the very center of Enkanomiya brightly lit.

introduced.name: Bokuso Box
introduced.how: box that collects light and dispels Void darkness nearby
introduced.quote: The Bokuso Box collects light. It can dispel the darkness from the Void within a small radius.

introduced.name: Void Realm
introduced.how: realm of darkness invading Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: The Void Realm is invading. The people of Byakuyakoku believe that there are three realms: the Vishap Realm, the Human Realm, and the Void Realm.

introduced.name: Vishap Realm
introduced.how: realm of pure primordial elemental beings
introduced.quote: In fact, the Vishap Realm is the realm of pure, primordial elemental beings.

introduced.name: Light Realm
introduced.how: the Vishap Realm's name in most books
introduced.quote: It's actually referred to as the Light Realm in most books.

introduced.name: Seven Sovereigns
introduced.how: seven foremost elemental dragons of the Light Realm
introduced.quote: The Seven Sovereigns of the Light Realm are the seven foremost elemental dragons at the pinnacle of the raw and primitive elemental forces.

introduced.name: Towers of the Void
introduced.how: three towers at Enkanomiya's corners spreading Abyssal energy
introduced.quote: They are Towers of the Void, restored to their original form by a certain Abyss adherent.

introduced.name: Light Realm Chisel
introduced.how: device at a tower's top that lets Light Realm energy in
introduced.quote: To get rid of the darkness, you need to climb to the very top of the Towers of the Void and activate the Light Realm Chisel, which will let in the energy of the Light Realm.

introduced.name: Enjou
introduced.how: Abyss adherent behind the towers and the darkness
introduced.quote: He's a purveyor of incessant nonsense. Somehow, he found out about the Three Realms and the three corners, and brought those things in using Abyssal technology.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: group that Enjou serves and that planned passage through vishap lands
introduced.quote: In return, they'd allow the Abyss Order safe passage through their territory and help me rebuild the three towers.

introduced.name: Bathysmal Vishaps
introduced.how: highly intelligent, fast-evolving dragon-kind
introduced.quote: The Bathysmal Vishaps are a highly intelligent and fast-evolving kind.

introduced.name: Vishap-people
introduced.how: vishaps that imitate humans and hide behind human looks
introduced.quote: Eventually, this gave rise to a line of vishaps who were indistinguishable from humans except for their pupils.

introduced.name: Fragmented Accessory (Three Realms Gateway Offering: The Eve)
introduced.how: one of three pendant pieces given to three bloodlines
introduced.quote: The three pendants were given to the Dainichi Mikoshi, the Sangonomiya line, and the Vassals of Watatsumi.

introduced.name: Kurai
introduced.how: self-introduction as Jibashi Kurai, who captured thunder orbs
introduced.quote: I am the Jibashi Kurai. Are you here to help solve the problem of these small orbs of thunder?

introduced.name: Electro Seele
introduced.how: thunder orbs that numb people and fly about
introduced.quote: I think the academic name for it is an Electro Seele.

assumed.name: Tsuyuko
assumed.quote: Haven't we had a fruitful partnership?

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
assumed.quote: Hey, Kokomi! How've you been?

assumed.name: Raiden Shogun
assumed.quote: Speaking of which, you're quite the hotshot, aren't you? Taking on the Raiden Shogun first and then braving the darkness of Enkanomiya.

assumed.name: Bloodbranch Coral
assumed.quote: That I have appeared before you must mean that the Bloodbranch Coral is in Watatsumi's hands.

assumed.name: Byakuyakoku
assumed.quote: Well, the name is all I know, as not many detailed accounts of Byakuyakoku have survived through Watatsumi Island's history.

assumed.name: Stingray III
assumed.quote: This is the correspondence from Stingray III.

assumed.name: Swordfish II
assumed.quote: Ah, Captain of Swordfish II. Glad to have you back on Watatsumi Island.

assumed.name: Yougou Cleansing
assumed.quote: I don't want to see another masked shrine maiden disappear...

assumed.name: Naki
assumed.quote: Or I may have to have you and Naki switch posts next year

assumed.name: Enjou
assumed.quote: Paimon knows exactly who you're talking about.

threads.claim: Enkanomiya's past and truth endure, so great effort was made to make people forget them.
threads.quote: As such, great effort was expended, not that we might remember, but that we might

threads.claim: Eboshi supports keeping written records of the truth despite the wish to forget.
threads.quote: As for me, I supported leaving records of the truth.

threads.claim: Bunkoku's hidden treasure may be unlocked by stone slates that are the key to a puzzle.
threads.quote: Though it appears to be a mere stone slate, I believe it's the key to finding Bunkoku's Secret Treasure.

threads.claim: A ninth slate appears, so the number of slates no longer matches the note.
threads.quote: Wait, this is... a final fragment! But why is there a ninth?

threads.claim: The Bunkoku Puzzle is cracked, revealing the chamber was guarded by vengeful spirits that controlled minds.
threads.quote: The Bunkoku Puzzle has finally been cracked, and I'll be sure to let the whole world know once I get back!

threads.claim: Tsumi's unusual appearance raises the question of whether she is really human.
threads.quote: You are... different from all the others. Are you human?

threads.claim: Enjou claims Tsumi is a disguised Vishap-person pretending to be human.
threads.quote: That Reptilian seems to be doing a pretty good job of human imitation.

threads.claim: Tsumi is revealed to be the last Vassal of Watatsumi, lost as an infant.
threads.quote: But the records do mention the very last of the vassals...

threads.claim: Tsumi wears a mask hiding the upper half of her face, which raises suspicion.
threads.quote: It was mentioned that she wears a strange mask that covers the upper half of her face.

threads.claim: Tsumi's mask hides snake-like pupils, which the soldiers connect to the Vassals of Watatsumi.
threads.quote: Her eyes have snake-like pupils. Thin vertical lines.

threads.claim: Enjou introduces a legend of vishaps who disguised themselves as humans and took high posts.
threads.quote: These were the Vishap-people.

threads.claim: Kokomi says Vishap-people and Reptilians are pure fiction with no evidence in the classified records.
threads.quote: But Vishap-people and Reptilians... they're pure fiction.

threads.claim: Tsumi's pendant may be a broken piece that completes a set when joined with others.
threads.quote: Number two, some kind of pendant fell out of her sleeve when she was bandaging me up.

threads.claim: The three pendants were given to the three groups as a relic of mutual accountability.
threads.quote: The three pendants were given to the Dainichi Mikoshi, the Sangonomiya line, and the Vassals of Watatsumi.

threads.claim: The Bloodbranch Coral ritual paused the Holy Soil phenomenon rather than reversing it, which has never happened before.
threads.quote: But it didn't reverse the Holy Soil phenomenon as expected. Instead, it just... paused.

threads.claim: The Void darkness is suppressing the Light Realm and Human Realm, causing them to stall.
threads.quote: The darkness from the Void Realm seems to be suppressing things in the Light Realm and the Human Realm, causing them to come to a standstill.

threads.claim: Enkanomiya is engulfed in a darkness that cannot be dispelled, with an unknown cause.
threads.quote: All of Enkanomiya is engulfed in a darkness that cannot be dispelled.

threads.claim: Tsumi says the Void Realm is invading Enkanomiya.
threads.quote: The Void Realm is invading.

threads.claim: Tsumi describes an Abyss adherent who spreads toxic energy through the towers for unclear reasons.
threads.quote: He's a purveyor of incessant nonsense.

threads.claim: Enjou admits he allied with the vishaps and then betrayed them.
threads.quote: I formed an alliance with the vishaps.

threads.claim: Enjou hints that the Abyss Order serves a figure called Highness.
threads.quote: Unlike those who are falling over themselves to serve our Highness, I'm interested in more inconsequential things.

threads.claim: Tsumi says the conflict between vishaps and humans will go on forever.
threads.quote: The conflict between our two kinds will go on forever.

threads.claim: Tsumi chooses to leave with the vishaps, saying she belongs with them.
threads.quote: I am a vishap, not a human. So I'm going back to where I belong.

threads.claim: A second set of trials exists, tied to the truth rather than Watatsumi Island's survival.
threads.quote: One unrelated to Watatsumi Island's survival, but instead, related to the truth.

threads.claim: Eboshi was allowed to add a trial path leading to knowledge of the secrets.
threads.quote: As such, Watatsumi Omikami permitted me to add another trial path that, if passed, would lead to knowledge of our secrets.

introduced.name: Muzhen
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Chief Technical Officer of the Alcor who stays below deck
introduced.quote: I'm Muzhen, Chief Technical Officer of the Alcor.

introduced.name: Crux Fleet
introduced.how: A merchant fleet that trades on routes such as to Inazuma
introduced.quote: And secondly... well, we are a merchant fleet, after all.

introduced.name: Alcor
introduced.how: Ship that Muzhen serves on as Chief Technical Officer
introduced.quote: Chief Technical Officer of the Alcor.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: Captain whose journey the Traveler helps prepare for, and who usually handles such duties
introduced.quote: Well, I've got some technical preparation-related errands that you can run to help prepare for the next leg of Captain Beidou's journey.

introduced.name: Ruin machines
introduced.how: Ancient mechanical organisms hidden across Inazuma's islands whose components are valuable samples
introduced.quote: According to the eyewitness reports this particular employer sent us, these machines... or organisms, are hidden throughout the islands of Inazuma... Very fascinating beings.

introduced.name: Electro anomalies
introduced.how: Strange Electro phenomena in some island regions that occur far more often there than elsewhere
introduced.quote: However, we've discovered strange Electro phenomena occurring in some regions of the islands.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: A great disaster five hundred years ago that rumor links to the Ruin machines
introduced.quote: Word is that they're related to the disaster that happened five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Nimbus Gem
introduced.how: Gem that links to characters, giving buffs that grow with more links
introduced.quote: has a unique mechanic known as the Nimbus Gem that will release electric pulses to link up with characters who are or .

introduced.name: Thunder Dwelling
introduced.how: Mechanism that charges from Electro sources and then releases a damaging Thunder Shock
introduced.quote: Once the Thunder Dwelling is fully charged, it will release a Thunder Shock, dealing Electro DMG to all characters and opponents present on the battlefield.

introduced.name: Thunder Sphere
introduced.how: Sphere that pulls characters carrying Electrograna or affected by Electro toward it at great speed
introduced.quote: Characters carrying Electrograna or affected by Electro in proximity to a Thunder Sphere can move towards the Thunder Sphere at great speed.

threads.quote: Thanks to the clues you brought back, I'm now able to pinpoint the location of the Ruin machines.

threads.claim: Electro anomaly growth ages may reveal the origin of the ancient Ruin organisms.
threads.quote: These origins, of course, are the targets we're looking for: the ancient, mysterious Ruin organisms!

threads.claim: Strange Electro phenomena cluster in certain island regions and may lead to the Ruin machines.
threads.quote: However, we've discovered strange Electro phenomena occurring in some regions of the islands.

threads.claim: The crystals from Electro anomalies seem to come from recent crystallization rather than long ago.

threads.claim: The Ruin machines may be tied to the great disaster that happened five hundred years ago.
threads.quote: Nonetheless, I believe these ruins to be related to the great disaster that occurred five hundred years ago...

introduced.name: Milray
introduced.how: A young Tepetlisaur who fought in the war and now falls seriously ill
introduced.quote: That's right. We'd never normally send such a young Tepetlisaur into battle, but we couldn't stop him.

introduced.name: Ifa
introduced.how: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who treats Milray and introduces himself
introduced.quote: The name's Ifa, a vet from the Flower-Feather Clan. This here's my assistant, Cacucu. Dude's all about copying what others say.

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: Ifa's assistant who tends to copy what others say
introduced.quote: This here's my assistant, Cacucu. Dude's all about copying what others say.

introduced.name: Naiyan
introduced.how: Milray's childhood friend who grew up with him
introduced.quote: Naiyan, who he grew up with, is here too. We're all really worried about him.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: A tribe of saurian-keeping vets to which Ifa belongs
introduced.quote: The name's Ifa, a vet from the Flower-Feather Clan. This here's my assistant, Cacucu. Dude's all about copying what others say.

introduced.name: Ocean Zephyr
introduced.how: A rare herbaceous perennial needed to cure Milray that grows almost anywhere
introduced.quote: Though they can grow practically anywhere, they're exceedingly rare.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame Crystal
introduced.how: A purer, rarer form of Sacred Flame that may be the second ingredient for the cure
introduced.quote: From the name, I'd say we're lookin' for a rarer, purer form of Sacred Flame.

introduced.name: Contending Spark
introduced.how: Sparks from the Sacred Flame collected during the Pilgrimage team stage that feel warm to carry
introduced.quote: Apparently they're sparks from the Sacred Flame itself. They even make you feel all warm and fuzzy while you carry them!

introduced.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: A tribal event that produces Sacred Flame and has become a tournament for warriors since the war
introduced.quote: Since the war ended, the Pilgrimage has become more like a tournament for our warriors to compete in and keep themselves in shape

introduced.name: Bloomflower Trials
introduced.how: An ancient joint combat exercise of the six tribes that once yielded purer Sacred Flame and has since lapsed
introduced.quote: It was a combat exercise held jointly by the six tribes that was even more intense than the Pilgrimage, so they occasionally yielded an even purer form of Sacred Flame.

introduced.name: Six tribes
introduced.how: The six tribal chiefs who govern Natlan's tribes together
introduced.quote: Whoa, all six tribal chiefs in one place! Not something you see every day...

introduced.name: Qucusaur informant
introduced.how: A mysterious Qucusaur who warned the saurians that Sacred Flame Crystals are dangerous
introduced.quote: A mysterious Qucusaur we met while fighting those big monsters... He was the one who told us.

introduced.name: Medicine Born of Guilt
introduced.how: A family saying about vet medicine, and the idea that guilt over failed treatments drives healers
introduced.quote: Who knows? After he passed, there wasn't anybody else I could ask. I figure it's because guilt gnaws at anyone practicing medicine.

introduced.name: Main matches and exhibition matches
introduced.how: The two formats of Bloomflower Trials matches: two-tribe main matches and three-versus-three exhibition matches
introduced.quote: Each main match will pit two different tribes against one another, while the exhibition matches will see three tribes going up against another three.

introduced.name: Offensive and Defensive Battles
introduced.how: The two categories of Bloomflower Trials, with defense meaning stopping attacks on the tribe
introduced.quote: Defensive battles are simple, just stop your opponents from attacking the tribe.

introduced.name: Ritual items
introduced.how: Special items attackers charge to break defenders' barriers in the Trials
introduced.quote: To spice things up, we've added special ritual items into the mix. Attackers can charge them up to destroy the defenders' special barriers.

introduced.name: Ballo
introduced.how: A Bloomflower Trials official who gives a rundown of the competition rules
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Bloomflower Trials! I heard from our chief that you're here to sign up for the competition?

introduced.name: Antu
introduced.how: Nampole's saurian companion, a Qucusaur chick who fell ill; his spirit lingers after death
introduced.quote: Nampole: I mean, Antu means the world to me. I promised to stay by his side until the day he's fully grown, ready to spread his wings and soar freely through the skies.

introduced.name: Nampole
introduced.how: Imara's brother, a healer who searched for a cure for his saurian Antu; Ifa's ancestor
introduced.quote: Nampole: Indeed I have. As far as I can tell, we need Ocean Zephyrs and Sacred Flame Crystals. That's about it.

introduced.name: Imara
introduced.how: Chief of the Flower-Feather Clan who ran the last Bloomflower Trials and hoarded the Crystals
introduced.quote: Imara: Hah, seems like I've still got lots to learn, despite being Chief... So, how can we use them?

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: Ifa's assistant who sometimes translates for other saurians
introduced.quote: Citlali: Ahh, Ifa's assistant Cacucu must have told you, right? I heard he sometimes translates for the other saurians.

introduced.name: Iolana
introduced.how: Self-described born hunter with hawk-like eyes, part of the exhibition match group
introduced.quote: Iolana: Haha, sounds like it's my time to shine. As Kinich will tell you, I'm a born hunter with the eyes of a hawk.

introduced.name: Bloomflower Trials
introduced.how: A competition the tribes once held to obtain Sacred Flame Crystals
introduced.quote: Nampole: Sacred Flame Crystals are born from inter-tribal conflict. Back when the tribes were somewhat united, they would occasionally hold Bloomflower Trials in order to obtain them.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame Crystal
introduced.how: Crystals said to treat chronic phlogiston-related illnesses; their use is uncertain
introduced.quote: Nampole: What we know for sure is that they can be used to treat certain chronic phlogiston-related illnesses.

introduced.name: Ocean Zephyrs
introduced.how: A rare ingredient needed, along with Sacred Flame Crystals, to cure a saurian's illness
introduced.quote: Nampole: Indeed I have. As far as I can tell, we need Ocean Zephyrs and Sacred Flame Crystals. That's about it.

introduced.name: Remnants of the Secret Source
introduced.how: A cave near the Night Kingdom where Antu's spirit may have rested
introduced.quote: Traveler: (Could he mean the Remnants of the Secret Source? That's the closest place to the Night Kingdom...

introduced.name: Six tribes of Natlan
introduced.how: Natlan had six tribes whose relations were complex and constantly shifting
introduced.quote: Seems like in the Natlan of six or seven centuries past, relations between the six tribes were incredibly complex and constantly shifting.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: The Pyro Archon usually works to prevent inter-tribal disputes from escalating
introduced.quote: Citlali: Usually, the Pyro Archon tries their best to prevent inter-tribal disputes from escalating.

introduced.name: Archon mortality
introduced.how: Archons live only as long as mortals, so transitions between them can be difficult
introduced.quote: Citlali: Also, given that our Archons live only as long as mortals, the transitional periods can be fraught with challenges.

introduced.name: Spell of Unity
introduced.how: a staged ritual, cast with Antu, meant to cleanse the Crystals' bad vibes and restore everyone's senses
introduced.quote: Ifa: Then, we'll bring Antu over and cast a "Spell of Unity" to cleanse all the bad vibes within the Sacred Flame Crystals and bring everyone back to their senses.

introduced.name: Antu
introduced.how: a young Qucusaur who believed the Sacred Flame Crystals held an evil power behind the tribal conflicts
introduced.quote: Ororon: And that little Qucusaur, Antu, believed that the Sacred Flame Crystals harbored some kind of evil power that lay at the root of these inter-tribal conflicts.

introduced.name: Sacred Flame Crystals
introduced.how: crystals that some believed carried an evil power, and that are gathered to cure Milray
introduced.quote: Ororon: And that little Qucusaur, Antu, believed that the Sacred Flame Crystals harbored some kind of evil power that lay at the root of these inter-tribal conflicts.

introduced.name: Cacucu
introduced.how: a Qucusaur Ifa found wounded and bullied in the wild, who became Ifa's assistant
introduced.quote: Ifa: First time I saw this dude, he was out in the wild, being bullied by other saurians because of his unusual appearance.

introduced.name: Nampole
introduced.how: Antu's brother, waiting for him in the Night Kingdom to reunite
introduced.quote: (As they return to the crowd, Antu turns around to see the Night Kingdom where Nampole is waiting for him)

introduced.name: Ifa's ancestor
introduced.how: a physician ancestor of Ifa who could not cure the saurian disease
introduced.quote: Ifa: Thanks a ton, everyone. With your help, I've been able to do what my ancestor could not.

introduced.name: Tribal bloodshed flashback
introduced.how: a past clash where the tribes fought over the Crystals and Antu tried to stop them
introduced.quote: Shanga: Fine by me! Let's settle our old scores today, once and for all!

introduced.name: Six tribes past conflict
introduced.how: the six tribes once argued and fought heavily before becoming united
introduced.quote: Kachina: But reading through those old scrolls, I realized that the six tribes haven't always been so united. They used to argue a lot, and even got into big fights...

introduced.name: Medicine Born of Guilt
introduced.how: Ifa's medicine, developed from guilt over Cacucu's near death, to spare others that guilt
introduced.quote: Ifa: Your "medicine born of guilt"... Don't sweat it. We'll keep improving it as we go. You have my word.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: Hey! It's been a while, you two. Are you here about the Bloomflower Trials too?

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: after all, we'll still need the Pyro Archon's final approval.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Developed a real knack for sneaking past us and running off to the frontline to fight the Abyss.

assumed.name: Sacred Flame

assumed.name: Natlan

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Yay, you're here too, Xilonen!

assumed.name: Milray

assumed.name: Naiyan
assumed.quote: Naiyan: Huh? You want to make friends with him too?

assumed.name: Ayo

assumed.quote: Kachina: Granny Citlali! H—Hello!

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Citlali: Mavuika was right. Even if trouble does come our way, she'll handle it.

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: Kachina: Despite losing the Pilgrimage so many times, what kept me going was the belief that someday I'd win and earn a spot in the Night Warden Wars.

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Kachina: Despite losing the Pilgrimage so many times, what kept me going was the belief that someday I'd win and earn a spot in the Night Warden Wars.

assumed.name: Night Kingdom
assumed.quote: I mean, things didn't exactly go as planned, and you and the others had to rescue me from the Night Kingdom...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: This must have been after the final battle against the Abyss.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Kachina: Wait, shouldn't he have returned to the Ley Lines? Haven't they been fixed...?

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Let's head back to the Children of Echoes and ask Naiyan for more details.)

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: Citlali: Since you're concerned, why don't we look into it? I'm sure we'll still be able to find scrolls from back then over at the Masters of the Night-Wind.

assumed.name: Mutota
assumed.quote: Kachina: Chief Mutota!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: What about you guys? You seem like you're in a hurry — has something happened?

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: But as for the details... those will have to stay a secret! After all, we'll be competing against you this time!

assumed.name: Tuqllaki
assumed.quote: Tuqllaki: I haven't got anywhere else to be, either.

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Varesa: Feeling hungry? I just picked these from the orchard.

assumed.name: Iansan
assumed.quote: Iansan: Go on, have some. Taking care of a patient like you're doing is hard work.

assumed.name: Idukan's Trove
assumed.quote: (Enter Idukan's Trove)

assumed.name: Stadium
assumed.quote: Ifa: Let's meet up at the Stadium in two days. We'll spread the word and see who's willing to play along.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Mualani: Yeah... I blame Kachina, being all mysterious about some gathering to discuss "something important."

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: Didn't sleep well?

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: Nope, you're right on time. So, Ifa, now that everyone's here, shall we begin?

assumed.name: Ifa
assumed.quote: Ifa: *ahem*... Actually, today we have a big favor we'd like to ask of all of you.

assumed.name: Milray
assumed.quote: Mavuika: That said, Antu will naturally sense that something's off once we've collected enough Sacred Flame Crystals and cure Milray, won't he?

assumed.name: Mavuika (Archon)
assumed.quote: Mualani: Oh, you're joining too, Archon?

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Ajaw: *yawn*... So sleepy. Why didn't you wake me up this morning, Kinich?

assumed.name: Bloomflower Trials
assumed.quote: Mavuika: After centuries, we're holding the Bloomflower Trials once more. I hope that this time, we can bring them to a close free from regret.

assumed.name: Ocean Zephyrs
assumed.quote: Iansan: I'll stay and help the saurians search for Ocean Zephyrs.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Mavuika: Even without the threat of the Abyss, we're still as close as family.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Iansan: Excellent, we've secured the Children of Echoes' base. Time to head up the mountain.

assumed.name: Pilgrimage
assumed.quote: Chasca: Judging from my experience with the Pilgrimage, things are pretty quiet for a few days after competitions.

threads.claim: Milray warns that Sacred Flame Crystals can beguile human hearts and turn friends into enemies.
threads.quote: Yes, very dangerous. They can beguile human hearts, turn friends into enemies... The humans must be very careful...

threads.claim: Mavuika dismisses the rumor that Sacred Flame Crystals beguile hearts as unbelievable, while the Traveler suspects hidden risks.
threads.quote: Hmm... I've never heard such a rumor before. And rationally speaking, it just doesn't even seem possible.

threads.claim: The Traveler wonders whether using Sacred Flame Crystals carries unknown risks the chiefs did not mention.
threads.quote: Could there be unknown risks associated with using Sacred Flame Crystals?

threads.claim: A mysterious Qucusaur who knows things others cannot explain warned the young saurians about the crystals.
threads.quote: A mysterious Qucusaur we met while fighting those big monsters... He was the one who told us.

threads.claim: Something happened the last time the Bloomflower Trials were held, and its details are unknown.
threads.quote: Something seems to have happened the last time they were held, but it was so long ago that I don't know the specifics.

threads.claim: The Trials were last held far longer ago than anyone living could recall, reinforcing their lost history.
threads.quote: Guess that means they were last held at least 500 years ago...?

threads.claim: Milray's illness is a rare pathological change that developed during the war and went untreated.
threads.quote: As a result, he developed a rare pathological change. The initial symptoms might not have been obvious, but he's gone untreated for so long that his condition is now very serious.

threads.claim: Ifa has no record of any patient with this illness being cured, so Milray's recovery is uncertain.
threads.quote: I don't recall ever seeing a record of any patient with his malady who was successfully cured, so maybe Milray will be the first.

threads.claim: Kachina seems troubled by something she has not shared, hinting at a personal concern.
threads.quote: She's been a bit off since the exhibition match ended...

threads.claim: Ifa's family practices medicine out of a guilt that stems from an unknown origin.
threads.quote: Who knows? After he passed, there wasn't anybody else I could ask. I figure it's because guilt gnaws at anyone practicing medicine.

threads.claim: The people of Natlan once knew how to make special Sacred Flame Crystals, but the method is unclear.
threads.quote: I'm not sure exactly how they did it, but the other chiefs might know something... I'll go ask them.

threads.claim: A rumor says the Sacred Flame Crystals are dangerous and can bewitch human hearts.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Ah, so that's what this is about... I was worried that the Sacred Flame Crystals might be dangerous.

threads.claim: Antu believes the Crystals bewitched his friends and turned them against each other.
threads.quote: Antu: As soon as they got their hands on them, even the closest of friends would get into the most vicious arguments.

threads.claim: The strife came from human greed and scheming, not from any power of the Crystals.
threads.quote: It wasn't the power of Sacred Flame Crystals to bewitch human hearts, but rather, human greed and scheming.

threads.claim: A light and floaty Qucusaur is hard to find and seems to be hiding from people.
threads.quote: Naiyan: He's really easy to spot — if you see one that looks all light and floaty, that's him.

threads.claim: The mysterious Qucusaur is revealed to be the spirit of the saurian Antu.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...A saurian ghost!?

threads.claim: Antu's spirit stands alone on the hillside, detached from both heaven and earth.
threads.quote: Traveler: (The spirit of the Qucusaur chick Antu stands quietly on the hillside.

threads.claim: Antu recalls being in pain and searching for Nampole before waking in a cave.
threads.quote: Antu: I remember being in a lot of pain. I remember how worried my good friend Nampole was.

threads.claim: Antu's guilt over the Crystals is revealed through Nampole's scroll.
threads.quote: Nampole: (In Antu's eyes, the only reason they'd started collecting Sacred Flame Crystals in the first place had been to save his life.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects a deeper mystery behind saurian indwelling that is not yet explored.
threads.quote: This might not be the best time to dive into the whole saurian indwelling mystery.

threads.claim: Antu asks how the Traveler can take a human form, hinting at indwelling's nature.
threads.quote: Antu: Wait... Is this your real form? You can turn yourself into a human? That's amazing!

threads.claim: There must be a hidden story behind why the Bloomflower Trials were stopped.
threads.quote: Citlali: Still, there must be a story behind the Bloomflower Trials being stopped.

threads.claim: The scrolls are unusually sparse about the last Trials, which suggests something was hidden.
threads.quote: Citlali: Strange... It's very unusual for such records to be so sparse on details.

threads.claim: The last Trials were left unrecorded because of a scandal that tainted all six tribes.
threads.quote: Citlali: No wonder there weren't any records of the last Bloomflower Trials.

threads.claim: Milray is in a deep sleep and needs Sacred Flame Crystals to be cured.
threads.quote: Kachina: Milray's been in a deep sleep this whole time... It's just as Ifa said. We'll need to gather all the Sacred Flame Crystals before we can help him.

threads.claim: Antu fell ill with the same sickness and now Milray has it too, which Antu fears for.
threads.quote: Antu: I wanted to, but then Milray came down with the same illness I had, and I was so worried for him...

threads.claim: Nampole is revealed as Ifa's ancestor and the former companion of the Qucusaur spirit.
threads.quote: Paimon: So, the Nampole from the scrolls was Ifa's ancestor?

threads.claim: Tensions between the tribes persist, though they have lessened over the centuries.
threads.quote: Citlali: There will always be tensions, but the intensity has changed.

threads.claim: Archons are mortal, so transitions between Archons can bring serious challenges.
threads.quote: Citlali: Also, given that our Archons live only as long as mortals, the transitional periods can be fraught with challenges.

threads.claim: Antu believes the Sacred Flame Crystals hold an evil power that drives the tribal conflicts.
threads.quote: Ororon: And that little Qucusaur, Antu, believed that the Sacred Flame Crystals harbored some kind of evil power that lay at the root of these inter-tribal conflicts.

threads.claim: The evil power and magic in the Crystals are revealed to be staged, not real.
threads.quote: Ifa: Of course, neither the evil power or the magic are real, but we've gotta make the lil' dude think he's done

threads.claim: Antu blames himself for the past fighting and wishes he had never fallen ill.
threads.quote: Antu: (It's all my fault... If only I'd never fallen ill in the first place...)

threads.claim: Antu is reunited with his brother and his final wish is fulfilled, closing his regret.
threads.quote: Ifa: His final wish was to be reunited with his bro, and he's done that.

threads.claim: Bloodshed between the tribes was an everyday occurrence in the past.
threads.quote: Iansan: Bloodshed between the tribes... That seems almost unthinkable today, but it was an everyday occurrence in that era.

threads.claim: Old scrolls show the six tribes once fought heavily, deepening the history of their conflicts.
threads.quote: Kachina: But reading through those old scrolls, I realized that the six tribes haven't always been so united. They used to argue a lot, and even got into big fights...

threads.claim: Milray's phlogiston-related illness is treated with the Crystals, and the Crystals' rumors trouble him.
threads.quote: Ifa: Besides, Milray already heard the rumors about the Sacred Flame Crystals from him. If we don't dispel the "curse" right in front of him, he might refuse to take the medicine.

threads.claim: Milray's disease is cured by the Crystal's flame.
threads.quote: (Milray's disease is cured and everyone cheers)

threads.claim: Ifa's ancestor failed to cure the saurian disease, which Ifa has now accomplished.
threads.quote: Ifa: Thanks a ton, everyone. With your help, I've been able to do what my ancestor could not.

threads.claim: The Abyss is a threat that the Natlan tribes have faced together.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Even without the threat of the Abyss, we're still as close as family.

introduced.quote: I'm usually over in the Masters of the Night-Wind's lands, prepping for the construction of the Graffiti Alliance's headquarters.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Is that the key to Natlan's artistic uniqueness?

assumed.name: Children of Echoes

introduced.how: Fatui agents are also investigating the meteorites and have Harbingers nearby

introduced.name: Immernachtreich
introduced.how: Fischl's claimed long-lost homeland, unknown to most mortals
introduced.quote: Fischl: I hail from a distant and long-lost land known as the Immernachtreich...

introduced.name: Mona
introduced.how: Traveling astrologer who uses hydromancy and reads the stars
introduced.quote: Mona: Mere mortal!? Do you have any idea who you're talking to? I am a highly accomplished astrologist, thank you very much!

introduced.name: Stella Fortuna
introduced.how: Constellation star groups that are real celestial bodies, not just notional patterns
introduced.quote: Mona: The stars that make up a constellation — the Stella Fortuna — are genuine celestial bodies in the depths of space. They are not simply notional.

introduced.name: Godwin
introduced.how: Knight of Favonius who stayed outside Mondstadt to clear monsters, hiding private reasons
introduced.quote: Godwin: I can't return to Mondstadt for various reasons, but I can still stay here and help out.

introduced.name: Glory
introduced.how: Godwin's friend in Mondstadt who has been worried about him
introduced.quote: Glory: Godwin? D—Do you know where he is? I haven't heard from him in a good long while, and I've been worried.

introduced.name: Huffman
introduced.how: Knights officer in Mondstadt who wants the outside knights recalled to the city
introduced.quote: Huffman: I'd like to recall all the knights who are currently attending to duties outside so we can settle matters within these four walls first.

introduced.name: Orders
introduced.how: Official Knights orders instructing field knights to return to the city
introduced.quote: Will: Really? Let me see them! Wow... these really are the official Orders of the Knights!

introduced.name: Mack
introduced.how: Knight guarding two children who refuse to return to the city
introduced.quote: Mack: Um, so, I could go back to the city, but those two children simply don't want to do the same.

introduced.name: Will
introduced.how: Child who wants to watch the meteorites fall from a high place
introduced.quote: Will: I know, that's why we came out here — to see the meteorites. Don't worry, we'll go back once we've seen them.

introduced.name: Jill
introduced.how: Child who went out with Will to watch the meteorites
introduced.quote: Jill: Will said he knew a good spot to watch them, so we came here.

introduced.name: Harry
introduced.how: Knight who stays in the Stormbearer Mountains to clear monsters and gather intelligence
introduced.quote: Harry: Still, I can't return just yet. Other than these monsters, there are still more roaming about in the Stormbearer Mountains.

introduced.name: Jinglun
introduced.how: Millelith officer defending Qingce Village from monster attacks
introduced.quote: Jinglun: It's about Qingce Village again. Those meteorites that came down have caused the monsters around the village to go wild.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: Village surrounded by monsters that the Millelith must guard
introduced.quote: Jinglun: While no major harm will befall Qingce Village so long as we guard it, the supplies we get from the city need to come in from the outside.

introduced.name: Qingzhou
introduced.how: Liyue poet who wants to observe meteorites up close for inspiration
introduced.quote: Qingzhou: How do you fare this day, my liege? My name is Qingzhou. I might add that I consider myself a poet, if I may be so bold.

introduced.name: Tiancheng
introduced.how: Guard at the disaster relief tents who checks visitors
introduced.quote: Tiancheng: Halt! Who are you?

introduced.name: Jiayi
introduced.how: Millelith member redeployed in Liyue, father of Little Liu
introduced.quote: Jiayi: Traveler, could you help me send this letter to a girl named Little Liu who lives in Qingce Village?

introduced.name: Little Liu
introduced.how: Girl in Qingce Village whose father Jiayi is unable to visit her
introduced.quote: Jiayi: She's my daughter, and I'd agreed to go back to spend a few days with her.

introduced.name: Ivanovich
introduced.how: A merchant who wants to hack pieces off meteorites and sell them as jewelry
introduced.quote: Ivanovich: I want to find one of those meteorites, hack a few pieces off it, and bring them back.

introduced.name: meteorites
introduced.how: Meteorites have been falling from the sky, and people who touch them faint
introduced.quote: Ivanovich: I suppose you know of those meteorites that fell from the sky?

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: A village hit by meteorites that block its crops and access roads
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hello, we're from the Adventurers' Guild. Can you tell us if Qingce Village has been affected by the meteorite strike?

introduced.name: Jinglun
introduced.how: A Millelith soldier at Qingce Village who needs help removing meteorites
introduced.quote: (Talk to the Millelith soldier Jinglun)

introduced.name: Gao the Sixth
introduced.how: A sleeping victim who woke starving and described being driven to climb a snowy mountain
introduced.quote: Gao the Sixth: Food... Need food...

introduced.name: Sweet Flowers
introduced.how: Ordinary-looking flowers found beside a meteorite, one of which attacks gatherers
introduced.quote: Paimon: We found the Sweet Flowers! But wait... Why does Paimon have a strange feeling about this place?

introduced.name: Pyro Whopperflower
introduced.how: A flower monster that ambushes people gathering Sweet Flowers
introduced.quote: (A Pyro Whopperflower appears)

introduced.name: shared snowy-mountain dream
introduced.how: Every meteorite victim sleeps and dreams of the same snowy mountain
introduced.quote: Mona: Based on what you've told me, it seems that all victims of the meteorites fell into a deep sleep, and all of them dreamed of a snowy mountain.

introduced.name: mind control
introduced.how: The sleepers' urge to climb is a planted idea, a sign of mind control
introduced.quote: Oz: An idea not autonomously generated by the individual, but that appeared within the subconscious... Yes, the signs do indeed point towards mind control.

introduced.name: Oz
introduced.how: Fischl's retinue member who gives reconnaissance reports to the Guild
introduced.quote: Fischl: To be honest, most of the other adventurers in the Guild only ever talk to me when they wanna hear Oz's reconnaissance reports...

introduced.name: Ritter der Verurteilung
introduced.how: Fischl's retinue, charged with leading people out of the darkness
introduced.quote: Fischl: Ahem! Most indeed... My dear attendants, I hereby charge the Ritter der Verurteilung with leading you out from the darkness, back into the realm of light.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: A faction that researches the meteorites and may have summoned them
introduced.quote: Scaramouche: Continue to research the meteorites

introduced.name: Leonard
introduced.how: An adventurer who lived two thousand years ago, whose will is carried by the meteorites
introduced.quote: Mona: Just as I thought, Leonard was an adventurer who lived two thousand years ago.

introduced.name: Pilos Peak
introduced.how: The mountain Leonard failed to climb, now a small island in the sea
introduced.quote: Mona: His lifelong dream was to reach the summit of a mountain called Pilos Peak.

introduced.name: Of Mountains and Seas
introduced.how: Leonard's adventurer guidebook, faded and missing pages
introduced.quote: Paimon: Found it! A Guide for Adventurers, written by Leonard!

introduced.name: Wings of Incompletion
introduced.how: Leonard's glider designs, left to his friend
introduced.quote: Leonard: My dear friend, I leave you my designs for the "Wings of Incompletion".

introduced.name: meteorite core
introduced.how: A core meteorite holding a crystal with Leonard's spirit, which causes the sleep
introduced.quote: Mona: And if I'm guessing correctly, there should be some sort of core meteorite among the bunch, within which is a crystal that harbors Leonard's spirit.

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: The Anemo Archon who blew ice and snow off the land, reshaping Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Mona: I once read somewhere that the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, once used his divine power to mobilize the winds and blow the ice and snow from the face of the earth.

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: Cyrus has already gathered and commissioned quite a few adventurers.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, and travel companion Paimon

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: How do you do, Honorary Knight?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Those fellows would do anything for a little Mora.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Use your Elemental Sight and have a look around!

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: May the Anemo Archon spare you from the effects of the meteorites.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Covering the entire countryside of Mondstadt and Liyue

assumed.name: Thousand Winds Temple
assumed.quote: thinking to go to the Thousand Winds Temple for a stroll

assumed.name: Springvale
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Yep, same situation as in Springvale.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon: We've been commissioned by the Adventurers' Guild to investigate the meteorite strike. Do you mind if we take a quick look at this victim?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Fischl: Katheryne, the hour of destiny is upon you! I have invoked the sacred covenant between us, and now you must respond to the call.

assumed.name: Silk Flowers
assumed.quote: Qingzhou: That seems a fair choice. Even with the skies as they are, the Silk Flowers still bloom as they always have.

assumed.name: Beyond This World's Stars
assumed.quote: (If Beyond This World's Stars has been completed)

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Paimon: And Paimon is an Honorary Knight of the Knights of the Favonius's best friend.

assumed.name: Mona
assumed.quote: Mona: Remember how I was saying that the meteorites belonged to someone's constellation?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Our records show that there have been many adventurers by that name over the years, it is impossible to know which one you refer to.

assumed.name: Northland Bank
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Northland Bank is a maximum-security facility, you know.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Traveler: Will the Millelith even let you go?

assumed.name: Wangshu Inn
assumed.quote: Oz: That said, I suspect that the Millelith will have turned that area into a site where victims can receive medical attention, much as they did at Wangshu Inn.

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: Mona: Now, we may not know which mountain this was — but we can safely assume that it's not Dragonspine. Otherwise, someone would have recognized it, right?

assumed.name: Fischl
assumed.quote: Fischl: What ho! We meet again, vagrant of Inazuma.

assumed.name: the Jester
assumed.quote: Scaramouche: What was the Jester thinking?

threads.claim: Meteorites put anyone who touches them into a deep sleep that no one can wake them from.
threads.quote: whoever touches one of those meteorites will fall into a deep sleep

threads.claim: The sleeping victims dream of cold mountains and seem lured into something, hinting at a curse.
threads.quote: He said he dreamed he was on top of a mountain, and it was very cold there.

threads.claim: Removing the meteorite shards wakes the victims, showing the shards cause the sleep.
threads.quote: Thanks to your efforts, two of the victims have already awoken.

threads.claim: The meteorites' origin and danger are unknown, and even the Guild has never seen anything like them.
threads.quote: Truth be told, we have never encountered anything like this before.

threads.claim: A mysterious gentleman has secretly arranged the trap against the Treasure Hoarders.
threads.quote: that gentleman has apprehended the Treasure Hoarders who were scouting us out previously

threads.claim: The mysterious gentleman is an old acquaintance who fought alongside the Traveler, but his name is withheld.
threads.quote: He says that you even fought side by side for a time.

threads.claim: Fatui agents are stuck in Mondstadt for unexplained reasons and Viktor is hiding what he was doing.
threads.quote: All I do is stand here in Mondstadt, unable to leave or move.

threads.claim: Fischl claims to come from a realm beyond the known world called Immernachtreich, which the Traveler has never heard of.
threads.quote: Never heard of that place before.

threads.claim: Meteorite shards are infused with elemental energy, and Visions respond to them, so the energy may trace back to a source.
threads.quote: The question is, are these shards of meteorite, which are infused with elemental energy

threads.claim: Monsters near the meteorite landing sites have become abnormally strong and aggressive.
threads.quote: Their strength, movements, and a whole host of other things are totally abnormal

threads.claim: Mondstadt has been spared direct meteorite strikes, which people attribute to the Anemo God's protection or luck.
threads.quote: Thanks to the Anemo God's protection... or maybe just blind good luck, none of them have hit the city so far.

threads.claim: The people of Mondstadt are portrayed as fiercely free-spirited, refusing to obey even in danger.
threads.quote: The people of Mondstadt are as free as the wind, indeed.

threads.claim: Meteorite times may stir the seas into storms, which the nuns at Stormbearer Point are watching for.
threads.quote: it wouldn't be surprising if a storm were to churn the seas again.

threads.claim: A meteorite striking the Thousand Winds Temple might open a path to unexplored chambers beneath it.
threads.quote: may yet present us with an opportunity to get deeper inside the Thousand Winds Temple

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders are opportunists drawn to Mondstadt's chaos for Mora, with their activity already seen near the city.
threads.quote: Those money-grubbing Treasure Hoarders have surely made plans to slip through those gaps

threads.claim: Fischl asserts the meteorites are a curse placed on the mortal realm, which the Traveler finds worth questioning.
threads.quote: Fischl: This menace is neither monster nor magic... It is a curse, a curse has been placed upon the mortal realm.

threads.claim: Fischl suggests the curse stems from a vengeful spirit left by someone who died in agony, and that a killer must be found.
threads.quote: Fischl: Only one who died the most agonizing of deaths could leave behind such a vengeful spirit...

threads.claim: Mona's divination traces the meteors to constellations, but why the stars suddenly fell remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Mona: The strange thing is that they turned into meteors all of a sudden, and fell from the sky... Why this happened I am not yet sure. I need some time.

threads.claim: Mona insists the Stella Fortuna stars are genuine celestial bodies, which makes their transformation into meteors all the more puzzling.
threads.quote: Mona: The stars that make up a constellation — the Stella Fortuna — are genuine celestial bodies in the depths of space. They are not simply notional.

threads.claim: The Fatui and their Harbingers are also investigating the meteorites, hinting at a larger hidden agenda.
threads.quote: Fatui Skirmisher: Grr... This doesn't end here! A Harbinger is nearby, you'll get what's coming to you soon enough!

threads.claim: Fischl claims to come from the Immernachtreich, a realm almost no one knows of, leaving its reality open.
threads.quote: Fischl: Alas, precious few mere mortals know of the Immernachtreich.

threads.claim: Fischl claims to have traveled a thousand worlds and journeyed to the stars, deepening the question of where she comes from.
threads.quote: Fischl: I, Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, have traversed a thousand worlds — and yet, never before have I faced such a formidable foe.

threads.claim: The party assumes removing the meteorites wakes the sleepers, so the link between the meteorites and the sleep is still unproven.
threads.quote: Paimon: From what we've seen so far, all you need to do is get rid of the meteorites and the sleepers wake back up again.

threads.claim: After the meteorites are cleared, the victims wake up, supporting the idea that the meteorites cause the sleep.
threads.quote: Recuperated Victim 2: Now I'm awake, can I go home? I just want to go home...

threads.claim: The sleepers' dreams may hold clues, as Paimon hints at a dream about a mountain in ice and snow.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon wonders what he's dreaming about? Hmm... Probably that one about the mountain in the ice and snow.

threads.claim: Fischl links the nightmarish slumber to the Valley of Demonbone, a place the player has yet to learn about.
threads.quote: Fischl: One has witnessed with one's own Auge der Verurteilung the nightmarish slumber that proceeds fourth from the Valley of Demonbone...

threads.claim: Godwin has private troubles that keep him from returning to Mondstadt and from asking the Knights for help.
threads.quote: Godwin: Ask the Knights for— Well... Suffice it to say that I have my own private troubles.

threads.claim: The Grand Master is far away on an expedition, and Godwin hopes for his return to solve the crisis.
threads.quote: Godwin: *sigh* If only the Grand Master could return right now — this problem would be solved in no time at all.

threads.claim: Something always seems to interrupt Jiayi's requests for leave, hinting at a recurring misfortune.
threads.quote: Little Liu: It's so strange. Something seems to happen every time Daddy says he'll take leave and spend time with me...

threads.claim: Scaramouche claims the stars and sky are a gigantic hoax, which Paimon dismisses.
threads.quote: Scaramouche: The stars, the sky... It's all a gigantic hoax. A lie.

threads.claim: Oz concludes the sleepers' urge is a planted idea and that mind control is likely.
threads.quote: Oz: An idea not autonomously generated by the individual, but that appeared within the subconscious... Yes, the signs do indeed point towards mind control.

threads.claim: The victims all share the same dream, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Traveler: How can they all be having the same dream?

threads.claim: A constellation from two thousand years ago was somehow pulled down from the sky.
threads.quote: Mona: Somehow, for some reason, this constellation was summoned down from the sky.

threads.claim: The Fatui may be behind summoning the meteorites, and their motive is unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: What interest could the Fatui have in the meteorites?

threads.claim: Scaramouche refers to a Jester who may have known what the mission would uncover.
threads.quote: Scaramouche: What was the Jester thinking?

threads.claim: Fischl's formal manner slips, hinting she is not quite what she appears to be.
threads.quote: Fischl: (Yikes!!! What am I doing? I totally broke form...)

threads.claim: A name, Leonard, comes out of a reading and means nothing to Paimon yet.
threads.quote: Paimon: "Leonard..." Paimon's never heard that name before.

threads.claim: Pilos Peak has become a small island that anyone can reach by boat.
threads.quote: Paimon: Even so, Paimon thinks that the most surprising thing of all was how Pilos Peak turned into a teeny-tiny little island!

threads.claim: Leonard's will is revealed in a cutscene, and the Traveler wonders whether his wish has been fulfilled.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Leonard, is your wish now fulfilled?)

threads.claim: Destroying the core meteorite ends the sleep, so the victims should begin to wake.
threads.quote: Paimon: The victims should finally start waking up now that we've dealt with the core.

introduced.name: Navia
introduced.how: Loud, sociable traveler who calls herself a Boss
introduced.quote: Navia: Well of course it is! After all, I am a Boss.

introduced.name: Clorinde
introduced.how: Former subordinate of Furina, traveling with Navia
introduced.quote: Furina: I mean, you're not my subordinate anymore. You don't need to look after me...

introduced.name: Furina
introduced.how: Fontaine's biggest star and actress who returned to the stage
introduced.quote: Furina: Now that Fontaine's biggest star has returned to the stage, I figured it's about time the industry enjoyed a breath of fresh air!

introduced.name: Neuvillette
introduced.how: The Iudex of Fontaine, head of its highest court
introduced.quote: Traveler: He's the fair and impartial Iudex of Fontaine, head of the highest court in the land.

introduced.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
introduced.how: Funeral business whose services Furina enlisted, run by Hu Tao
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uh... Well, you know, with you enlisting the services of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and all...

introduced.name: Juanshu
introduced.how: Apprentice Storyteller who tells tales of the group's fireworks run
introduced.quote: Juanshu: Esteemed guests, I, the apprentice Storyteller Juanshu, must humbly request you cease your steps for a moment—

introduced.name: Wenxun
introduced.how: Painter and maker of a paper theater, a food-loving regular
introduced.quote: Wenxun: Oh my! Guests! Welcome, welcome, and allow me, Wenxun, to be the first to wish the two of you a joyous Lantern Rite!

introduced.name: Xiaqing
introduced.how: Creator of the Just Wushou Dance game who practices Wushou
introduced.quote: Xiaqing: It just so happens I've created a fresh new game, hot off the press!

introduced.name: Tiantian
introduced.how: Adventurer who ran a speedrun challenge the group joined last year
introduced.quote: Juanshu: Perhaps you have already forgotten, but this time last year, you accepted a commission from the Adventurer Tiantian and participated in a special speedrun challenge.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild that many people joined after the fireworks challenge
introduced.quote: Juanshu: And it is not just me! Many were moved by your splendid silhouettes, joining the Adventurers' Guild and finding new direction in life!

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: Area with a strange carp that lets you travel swiftly
introduced.quote: Juanshu: There are many wondrous things here in Chenyu Vale, including a strange carp whose power allows you to travel most swiftly.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: Village known for tea and dim sum, far from the city
introduced.quote: Paimon: Qiaoying Village is known for its tea. But you know what else they have with tea? That's right, dim sum!

introduced.name: Lantern Rite
introduced.how: Liyue holiday marking the start of the new year
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: Lantern Rite marks the start of the new year in Liyue.

introduced.name: Paper theater
introduced.how: Short, interactive stage-style game based on paper plays
introduced.quote: Wenxun: Paper theater and paper plays also have very different styles. Paper theater focuses on simple, short stories that'll bring a smile to the audience.

introduced.name: Wushou Dance
introduced.how: Demanding traditional dance art that is hard to learn
introduced.quote: Xiaqing: Authentic Wushou Dance is downright devilish to learn!

introduced.name: Just Wushou Dance!
introduced.how: Dance game with changed rules and props, a simplified Wushou Dance
introduced.quote: Xiaqing: So, I changed the rules for one style of Wushou Dance, switched out some props, and boom! This game was born.

introduced.name: Guoba
introduced.how: Playful companion who cooks, shown playing with Yuegui
introduced.quote: Wenxun: When Yaoyao brings Yuegui along to see Xiangling, Guoba and Yuegui end up playing together.

introduced.name: Yuegui
introduced.how: Cute companion who sways and shakes, a paper theater star
introduced.quote: Wenxun: Ahh, it's wonderful! No matter how exhausting work is, just watching them shake and sway is enough to sweep all your cares away!

introduced.name: Wanmin Restaurant
introduced.how: Restaurant where Wenxun eats most of her meals
introduced.quote: Wenxun: Hehe, how could I not? You're looking at one of Wanmin Restaurant's regulars, you know!

introduced.name: Legal codex
introduced.how: Stone slab engraved with scales of justice, an old form of law record
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: While that is an apt description, it is, in actuality, a legal codex.

assumed.name: Navia
assumed.quote: Navia: Ah! Well if it isn't my dear partners!

assumed.name: Neuvillette
assumed.quote: Neuvillette: Oh, it's you. It has been some time since our last meeting.

assumed.name: Wriothesley
assumed.quote: Clorinde: Oh, it's not for me. I lost a bet with Wriothesley, and now I have to buy him something.

assumed.name: Sigewinne
assumed.quote: Clorinde: And some tea-flavored hard candies. They're for Sigewinne.

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Paimon: If you bought that much stuff, where did it all go? Into one of Lyney's Magic Pockets?

assumed.name: Gaming
assumed.quote: Paimon: Didn't Gaming say something about dim sum being eaten in the morning? Paimon wonders if we can still get some at this time of day.

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Wenxun: Anyway, I get to see Guoba and Xiangling pretty much every week, and sometimes even little Yaoyao.

assumed.name: Yaoyao
assumed.quote: Wenxun: Anyway, I get to see Guoba and Xiangling pretty much every week, and sometimes even little Yaoyao.

assumed.name: Charlotte
assumed.quote: Navia: Didn't Charlotte publish an article on the Liyue tea industry recently?

assumed.name: The Steambird
assumed.quote: Navia: See! I told you that something good was going to happen during our travels today! I have to say, sometimes The Steambird's astrology column is spot on.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Navia: Hey, I'm hardly reckless with my Mora. I'll have you know, all the purchases I made today were well within my budget.

assumed.name: Palais Mermonia
assumed.quote: Furina: Just tell him the Palais Mermonia isn't going to fall apart if he disappears for a few days.

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Clorinde: He even offered to deliver my gifts to the Fortress of Meropide for me once he's done with the day's work.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Furina: But seeing as you're a hero who's been all over Teyvat, it makes sense that you would be well-traveled and well-connected.

threads.claim: Unexplained voices shout strange words about Bulle Fruit and good vibes from a mountain top.
threads.quote: ???: ...Cream! Gummies! Bulle Fruit!

threads.claim: The shouted words turn out to be meaningless, and the shouting was simply a mountain-top stress release.
threads.quote: Clorinde: No, it's not a code. The words are meaningless.

threads.claim: Furina seems to be hiding something about a past event in Fontaine that Zhongli may know about.
threads.quote: Furina: (Given his breadth of knowledge on both academic and worldly matters, there's no way he hasn't heard about what happened in Fontaine...)

threads.claim: Zhongli may have been deliberately avoiding Neuvillette during the visit.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Could Zhongli have been avoiding him on purpose?)

threads.claim: Neuvillette has a true identity that the Traveler suspects connects to Zhongli's behavior.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Judging by how Zhongli is acting... And taking into consideration Neuvillette's true identity...)

threads.claim: Neuvillette's lifespan is far longer than ordinary human time, which Paimon does not grasp at first.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: First, I should clarify that I was referring to my lifespan rather than the time at my disposal on any given day.

threads.claim: Furina implies Neuvillette has lived for thousands of years.
threads.quote: Furina: (If I remember correctly, he's already several thousands of years old...)

threads.claim: Clorinde once worked under Furina, implying Furina held a leadership role in the past.
threads.quote: Hu Tao: By the way, did I hear you mention that Clorinde used to work under you?

threads.claim: Furina gave up leadership and now values the freedom to come and go as she pleases.
threads.quote: Furina: I prefer how things are now. I can come and go as I please, and get to enjoy the sweet taste of freedom.

threads.claim: Neuvillette rarely leaves his duties to engage with the human world, a point others remark on.
threads.quote: Hu Tao: He doesn't get out much, does he?

threads.claim: Neuvillette realizes the human world holds many interesting places after taking a trip out of his routine.
threads.quote: Neuvillette: But now I see that the human world is indeed full of many interesting places to discover.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild staffer who passes on commissions and picks adventurers for them
introduced.quote: Recently, the Adventurers' Guild has received a rather important commission. Judging from my experience, you are the best person for the job.

introduced.name: Patrice
introduced.how: Fontaine researcher who posted the commission and wants assistants for his studies
introduced.quote: The person who gave this commission out is named Patrice, and he is a researcher from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Fontaine legal system
introduced.how: Researchers using public funds without results can be judged as criminals and face severe charges
introduced.quote: Independent researchers must apply for funding to conduct their studies, but using them means that you'll be assuming the social responsibility that comes with their use.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: Area outside which Patrice is inspecting for his research
introduced.quote: He is presently inspecting the outskirts of The Chasm.

introduced.name: Vibro-Crystal Harmonics
introduced.how: Research into stimulating gem elemental energy to use as an energy source
introduced.quote: Simply put, this is the process of stimulating the elemental energy within gems and crystals, and using this elemental power as a source of energy.

introduced.name: Vibro-Crystals

introduced.quote: When the Transmitter Crystal half of the Vibro-Crystal set has been stimulated in a certain way, it will release a certain energy

introduced.name: Steles mounted with Vibro-Crystal sets

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild

assumed.name: Past commissions with Katheryne
assumed.quote: Well, this sounds familiar.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Wait, you aren't plainclothes Millelith, are you? Are you here to kick me out?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: So is that why you put up so much Mora for assistants to help you?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Liyue truly is an excellent place, filled with high-quality ore and highly-reliable adventurers!

threads.claim: Fontaine treats misused research funds as criminal, and hidden additional factors seem to threaten the innocent with guilt.
threads.quote: The thing in my way is what one might call... additional factors.

threads.claim: Patrice says the guilt system grants conveniences to the innocent, showing Fontaine's legal system has mixed benefits.
threads.quote: And yet they have their uses. As long as you are not considered guilty, you can enjoy all manner of conveniences.

threads.claim: The harmonics hypothesis is still unverified and must be tested through battles at the steles.
threads.quote: I've chosen a suitable area that has a great many steles in it mounted with Vibro-Crystal sets.

threads.claim: Patrice denies entering restricted areas while under inspection, leaving the accusation unresolved.
threads.quote: I swear to you, I did not enter any restricted areas!

introduced.name: Anatole
introduced.how: introduces himself as an engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: I am Anatole, an engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Patrice
