introduced.quote: I have a colleague who entered the Institute at the same time as me and has been researching minerals and elemental energy.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: an organization focused on research into machines and energy, not administration or education
introduced.quote: The Institute is an organization dedicated to the study of machines and energy, though I do wish that we would have a Gourmet Department.

introduced.name: Vibro-Crystals
introduced.how: paired minerals whose Transmitter and Receiver halves create harmonics that produce energy and resonance
introduced.quote: We can judge from the records Patrice left for us that there exist minerals known as Vibro-Crystals.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: founder of the research center, regarded as a genius whose designs are still manufactured
introduced.quote: the Academy is a research center founded by Alain Guillotin

introduced.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
introduced.how: a Senior Technician whose Arkhium experiment caused the explosion and who has never been found
introduced.quote: It seems to have occurred when Senior Technician Edwin Eastinghouse was conducting an experiment using Arkhium that was aimed at dealing with the waterline crisis.

introduced.name: Institute explosion
introduced.how: a massive explosion once rocked the Institute during a catastrophic experimental failure
introduced.quote: The Institute was once rocked by a massive explosion during a particularly catastrophic experimental failure.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: he went to Liyue directly and set his experiment up here

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Everyone said that he had finally gotten tired of the Institute and upped and left with the Mora.

assumed.name: Bamboo Shoot Soup
assumed.quote: Yes, maybe some Bamboo Shoot Soup might do!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: the invaluable aid of the local Adventurers' Guild

assumed.name: Sumeru Akademiya
assumed.quote: It and the Sumeru Akademiya are very different organizations.

assumed.name: Arkhium and the waterline crisis
assumed.quote: using Arkhium that was aimed at dealing with the waterline crisis

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: But as some guy from Fontaine, isn't your presence here even more suspicious?

threads.claim: Patrice vanished one day with his funds and equipment, and his reason and whereabouts remain unexplained.
threads.quote: One day, he took all his remaining funds and experimental equipment and vanished.

threads.claim: Patrice returned alive with experimental results after working in Liyue, though his account is disputed.
threads.quote: In any case, he finally returned alive and well a while ago, and with experimental results to boot.

threads.claim: Patrice's experimental data is so complete that reviewers suspect it came from no ordinary source.
threads.quote: it is almost as if it were simply spun out of thin air...

threads.claim: Patrice credits the Adventurers' Guild for his data's completeness, which the Institute refuses to believe.
threads.quote: Patrice insisted over and over that the data's completeness was due to the invaluable aid of the local Adventurers' Guild

threads.claim: Edwin Eastinghouse has never been found since the explosion, leaving his fate an open question.
threads.quote: To this day, they haven't found all the p... I mean, they haven't found Eastinghouse.

threads.claim: The Institute's redundant processes and complicated management survived the explosion and returned changed.
threads.quote: that explosion did not take the strange and redundant processes and the overly complicated management systems with it

threads.claim: Vibro-Crystal harmonics produce an energy that affects specific targets, but the mechanism is only vaguely understood.
threads.quote: It seems that these harmonics can produce... a certain energy and some sort of resonance, that will... affect some specific targets.

threads.claim: Whether Patrice's research is verified depends on the player completing the reproduction experiment.
threads.quote: Can Patrice escape the pickle he is currently in? This experiment shall decide that.

introduced.name: Patrice
introduced.how: Fontaine Institute researcher running Vibro-Crystal experiments who is short on funding
introduced.quote: Patrice: I'll leave the next experiment to you, then.

introduced.name: Anatole
introduced.how: Patrice's colleague who handles the experiment budget and finances
introduced.quote: Anatole: Oh, and now you're putting it upon your colleagues to save Mora on your behalf?

introduced.name: Vibro-Crystals
introduced.how: Ores found in Liyue that produce effects when stimulated, studied by the Institute
introduced.quote: Patrice: We're working on ores known as Vibro-Crystals. We discovered them in Liyue previously while studying the different properties of ore in the region.

introduced.name: Transmitter and Receiver Crystals
introduced.how: Vibro-Crystals come in two types that work as a pair
introduced.quote: Patrice: They can be divided into two types: Transmitter and Receiver Crystals.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Research body that has lost interest in ores and demands economically profitable projects
introduced.quote: Anatole: Which is an interesting phenomenon, albeit one that... Let's just say that the Fontainian Research Institute isn't nearly as interested in ores as it used to be.

introduced.name: Institute economic benefits directive
introduced.how: Approval rules require Institute projects to produce technology with greater economic benefits
introduced.quote: Patrice: You mean the one on the approval document that says "this project should produce technology that provides greater economic benefits"?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Patrice: They just want to know if it can be sold for Mora, don't worry about that!

assumed.name: Mr. Raimondo
assumed.quote: Anatole: Mr. Raimondo's also been clear that it lacks

assumed.name: Northland Bank
assumed.quote: Patrice: I thought that I could at least use the title to guarantee an interim loan from the Northland Bank...

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles
assumed.quote: Traveler: Well, I'll have you know that I'm an Honorary Senior Researcher. (If the player has completed Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles)

threads.claim: Vibro-Crystals release a specific energy when the Transmitter Crystal is stimulated, which resonates with the Receiver Crystal.
threads.quote: Patrice: When the Transmitter Crystal is stimulated in a certain way, it will release a specific energy that resonates with the Receiver Crystal half, generating unique effects.

threads.claim: Vibro-Crystals were first found in Liyue while researchers studied the region's ore properties.
threads.quote: Patrice: We're working on ores known as Vibro-Crystals. We discovered them in Liyue previously while studying the different properties of ore in the region.

threads.claim: The Institute prioritizes economically profitable research, so ore studies are being starved of funding.
threads.quote: Anatole: We don't have that much funding left.

threads.claim: Patrice believes the research project's prospects will prove valuable, though the marketable invention is still undecided.
threads.quote: Patrice: No, no, not that kind of prospect at all. That said, I do believe that my research project's "prospects" will turn out to be just as valuable...

introduced.name: Geovishap
introduced.how: ancient dragon-like creatures that were only known from old texts until they suddenly began appearing again
introduced.quote: Up till recently, the only known Geovishap sightings were those recorded in ancient texts.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: organization that receives sighting reports, runs expeditions, and ranks them by time and risk
introduced.quote: The Guild will rank these expeditions based on the time required and the amount of risk involved.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: a peacekeeping group whose duty is as important as the Guild's
introduced.quote: Keeping the peace is a duty of equal importance to them, after all.

introduced.name: Geovishap investigation expeditions
introduced.how: Guild expedition-style leads on Geovishap whereabouts, already partly investigated, which the Traveler follows to locate them
introduced.quote: The key difference between these expeditions and the normal ones is that the Guild has already conducted some preliminary investigations.

introduced.name: Geovishap Hatchlings
introduced.how: a smaller, less aggressive creature that adult Geovishaps resemble
introduced.quote: They look quite similar to Geovishap Hatchlings, but they are very aggressive and possess far more destructive power.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome, Adventurer. I've been waiting for your arrival.

assumed.name: Guild expedition system
assumed.quote: I'm sure that you're familiar with the Guild's expedition system.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: In the past few days, the Adventurers' Guild has received many eyewitness reports of Geovishaps.

threads.claim: Geovishaps were recorded in ancient texts, so their modern reappearance connects to a deeper past.
threads.quote: Up till recently, the only known Geovishap sightings were those recorded in ancient texts.

threads.claim: The reason Geovishaps suddenly appear again is unknown to everyone, including the Guild.
threads.quote: No one know why they are suddenly making an appearance now.

threads.claim: Even after the investigation closes, the reason the ancient creatures began appearing remains unanswered and under study.
threads.quote: As for why these ancient creatures suddenly began appearing, we will continue to investigate.

threads.claim: Adult Geovishaps look like hatchlings but are far more aggressive and destructive.
threads.quote: They look quite similar to Geovishap Hatchlings, but they are very aggressive and possess far more destructive power.

introduced.name: Tadatsune
introduced.how: a Kono Ittou Art disciple dueling his senpai over an entry ticket
introduced.quote: Tadatsune: After all these years, senpai... I was hoping it would never come to settling this with real swords...

introduced.name: Tadaaki
introduced.how: a Kono Ittou Art disciple who challenges Tadatsune and later gives up the ticket
introduced.quote: Tadaaki: Yeah, we're disciples of the Kono Ittou Art, and are about to settle things with a duel.

introduced.name: Kono Ittou Art
introduced.how: a sword school whose disciples compete in Inazuma
introduced.quote: Tadaaki: Yeah, we're disciples of the Kono Ittou Art, and are about to settle things with a duel.

introduced.name: Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition
introduced.how: a swordfighting competition whose entry tickets are contested
introduced.quote: Paimon: Let Paimon see here... "Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Competition... hosted by the Yashiro Commission."

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: the organization hosting the Warrior's Spirit competition
introduced.quote: Paimon: Let Paimon see here... "Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Competition... hosted by the Yashiro Commission."

introduced.name: Madarame Hyakubei
introduced.how: a retainer at the Kamisato Estate who answers questions about the competition
introduced.quote: Madarame Hyakubei: Traveler, Paimon, good to see you. Unfortunately, both the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato are out on business for the day.

introduced.name: Kamisato Estate
introduced.how: the Kamisato home where the Commissioner and Ayaka are based
introduced.quote: Madarame Hyakubei: Traveler, Paimon, good to see you. Unfortunately, both the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato are out on business for the day. They are not here at the estate.

introduced.name: Hirotatsu
introduced.how: a Kamisato retainer who challenges the Traveler and is later defeated
introduced.quote: Hirotatsu: Why hesitate when faced with such a great opportunity?

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: the island where Ayaka and Chisato prepare the competition
introduced.quote: I didn't get a chance to tell you just now, but Miss Kamisato left for Ritou today to discuss competition matters with Miss Hiiragi Chisato.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Chisato
introduced.how: a Kanjou Commission official organizing the competition with Ayaka
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: What a coincidence. We just finished talking about the Archon's Emissary and whether the Traveler would be interested in the exhibition.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: the organization whose indoor training area hosts the arena preparations
introduced.quote: Madarame Hyakubei: Miss Kamisato should have arrived on Ritou by now. She went to discuss competition matters with Miss Hiiragi Chisato of the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Archon's Emissary
introduced.how: the role of a true swordsman who fights the Shogun's duel on her behalf
introduced.quote: the "Divine Familiar" will be fulfilled by a true swordsman, a role also known as the "Archon's Emissary."

introduced.name: Warrior's Spirit origin
introduced.how: an ancient legend where champions dueled the Almighty Shogun with an emissary's help
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Warrior's Spirit originated from ancient Inazuman legends.

introduced.name: Almighty Shogun
introduced.how: a power far beyond humans who sends familiars and envoys to the duel
introduced.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: However, the Almighty Shogun was far more powerful than any human being.

introduced.name: Onodera
introduced.how: an event organizer from Yae Publishing House who proposed the outfit vote
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Oh, and by the way, this is Onodera from Yae Publishing House. He specializes in organizing events and was sent to assist us.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: the publisher that sent Onodera to assist the competition
introduced.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Oh, and by the way, this is Onodera from Yae Publishing House. He specializes in organizing events and was sent to assist us.

introduced.name: Outfit vote
introduced.how: audience ballots choose the seasonal or novel-themed outfit Ayaka wears
introduced.quote: Onodera: People can vote on one of the four seasonal styles, such as cherry blossoms or autumn leaves. Miss Kamisato will wear whichever outfit receives the most votes.

introduced.name: Mizuta
introduced.how: a staffer who mixed up the two voting boxes
introduced.quote: Mizuta: I'm terribly sorry, I was the one who mixed up the two voting boxes!

introduced.name: Vote mix-up
introduced.how: the ballot boxes were confused, so novel outfits were announced as the winners
introduced.quote: Mizuta: I'm terribly sorry, I was the one who mixed up the two voting boxes! By the time Mr. Onodera came back from his business trip, the results had already been announced...

introduced.name: Miss Orith
introduced.how: a fierce, prankish detective from a bestselling novel whose outfit is on the ballot
introduced.quote: Yuu: Well... Miss Orith is fiercely competitive, but loves to play pranks on others, which is nearly the complete opposite of Miss Kamisato.

introduced.name: Maguu Kengou
introduced.how: the Shogun's chosen envoy, an autonomous humanoid opponent in the exhibition match
introduced.quote: versus the Almighty Shogun's chosen envoy, an autonomous humanoid known as the "Maguu Kengou."

introduced.name: Akatsuki Saemon Juuzou
introduced.how: a samurai the Traveler defeats in the arena
introduced.quote: Akatsuki Saemon Juuzou: Your skills are superb. I've been thoroughly bested.

introduced.name: Kujou Sara
introduced.how: an official ordered by the Almighty Shogun to observe the competition
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara: I was ordered by the Almighty Shogun to observe this competition.

introduced.name: Tenshukaku
introduced.how: the place where Sara reports to the Almighty Shogun
introduced.quote: Kujou Sara: I must return to the Tenshukaku and report on what happened at the exhibition match to the Almighty Shogun.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Traveler, Paimon, nice to see you again. Welcome back to Inazuma.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Traveler, Paimon, nice to see you again. Welcome back to Inazuma.

assumed.name: Yashiori Island
assumed.quote: That name sounds similar to that troublesome one we encountered on Yashiori Island.

assumed.name: Visions
assumed.quote: tomorrow's match doesn't prohibit the use of Visions.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: the book's illustrations of Fontaine outfits are also really unique.

assumed.name: Liyue and Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler, not long after we met, I remember you mentioning that Liyue, Mondstadt... and every nation has their own unique fashion.

assumed.name: Outlander Affairs Agency
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa, now this is an arena... Paimon had no idea the Outlander Affairs Agency would have a place like this.

assumed.name: Shirasagi Himegimi
assumed.quote: Though the Shirasagi Himegimi attends some festival ceremonies from time to time, it's not often that we get to see her excellent swordsmanship up close.

assumed.name: Past shared help between Traveler and Ayaka
assumed.quote: You've helped me many times before, and you've always lent me your ear when I speak about my troubles.

threads.claim: The Almighty Shogun has an emissary who fights on her behalf, and the duel tradition has a divine origin.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Therefore, the Almighty Shogun would send one of her familiars as an emissary to the martial artist, who would then provide assistance and protection in the fight against the Shogun.

threads.claim: The Shogun still sends a special envoy, the Maguu Kengou, to display her divine strength.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Yes. Nowadays, the Almighty Shogun won't attend the exhibition match in person, but she will still send a special envoy to fight on her behalf to display her divine strength.

threads.claim: The Maguu Kengou resembles a troublesome foe the party met on Yashiori Island, hinting at a past encounter.
threads.quote: That name sounds similar to that troublesome one we encountered on Yashiori Island.

threads.claim: The Maguu Kengou's overwhelming presence proves it is worthy of the Shogun's chosen envoy role.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: What an overwhelming presence... Certainly worthy of being the Almighty Shogun's chosen envoy.

threads.claim: Ayaka once sent a letter that brought the Traveler back to Inazuma, and its contents are unclear.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Oh, you've never heard of it? Didn't you come rushing back to Inazuma because of Miss Ayaka's letter?

threads.claim: Ayaka wrote a letter seeking advice about the Emissary role but ultimately did not send it.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Yes, I know. But that's probably why I didn't send the letter in the end.

threads.claim: The outfit choices oddly switched from seasonal styles to novel cosplay, raising a question about what went wrong.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hold on, didn't they say the choices were gonna be between the four seasons of Inazuma? When did they switch to cosplay outfits from light novels?

threads.claim: The ballots were mixed up because the poll was left untitled, and Ayaka accepts the novel outfit anyway.
threads.quote: Onodera: *sigh* In an effort to keep things confidential, we specifically didn't mark the ballots with the title of the poll.

threads.claim: Ayaka's late mother was curious about foreign outfits, and Ayaka hopes to fulfill her mother's dream.
threads.quote: Kamisato Ayaka: Besides, my mother was always curious about outfits from other countries when she was alive.

threads.claim: The Kono Ittou Art disciples admit they are outmatched and that someone always stronger exists, as their master taught.
threads.quote: Tadaaki: *sigh* Master did always tell us that no matter how strong you may become, there is always someone stronger.

introduced.name: Ting Zhi
introduced.how: sets up the Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites game and explains it is his responsibility
introduced.quote: Ting Zhi: I'm setting up the game I'm responsible for... Have you heard of "Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites"?

introduced.name: Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites
introduced.how: a seated rite game where participants throw Darts into pots to a musical rhythm
introduced.quote: Ting Zhi: The traditional rules dictate that all participants in this game must be sitting down, as part of the rites.

introduced.name: Darts
introduced.how: the items thrown into the pots during the rites game
introduced.quote: Ting Zhi: From their sitting positions, the participants must follow the music's rhythm and "throw" the "Darts" into the distant "pots."

introduced.name: Dart scoring terms (First, Streak, Piercing, Valiant)
introduced.how: named ways of landing a Dart in the pot, from the traditional rules
introduced.quote: Ting Zhi: For example, the first Dart to land in the pot is called the "First." If the subsequent Dart also lands in the vessel, it's called a "Streak."

introduced.name: Inspiration Eruption
introduced.how: a drinking-and-poetry game Buies designed to mirror how poets create poems
introduced.quote: Buies: Look here. I'm calling this game "Inspiration Eruption."

introduced.name: Batlo
introduced.how: introduces himself as a painter and art conservator
introduced.quote: Batlo: I am Batlo, a painter... You should be quite familiar with this profession, no?

introduced.name: Art conservator
introduced.how: a job that restores damaged paintings to their original state
introduced.quote: Batlo: But in addition to being a painter myself, I am also an art conservator.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera used to photograph the marked landmarks in a painting's scenery
introduced.quote: Batlo: All you need to do is to find the location and take photos of the marked objects with this Kamera, and you're done!

introduced.name: Artistic hallucination
introduced.how: Batlo's view that art is a hallucination an artist captures and expresses objectively
introduced.quote: Batlo: You are correct. To me, art... is a type of hallucination...

assumed.name: Mondstadt and Liyue
assumed.quote: Batlo: These old paintings come from Mondstadt and Liyue. They include landscapes, figures, animals, and even... crayon drawings from children...

threads.claim: Poets cannot pinpoint where inspiration lies, yet it has already left its mark in their minds.
threads.quote: Buies: This is the most challenging part, since we cannot pinpoint where inspiration lies.

threads.claim: The Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites come from an ancient book and their traditional rules were simplified for play.
threads.quote: Ting Zhi: I learned about this game from an ancient book. Let me briefly walk you through it...

threads.claim: Restoration must reproduce a painting exactly, which separates true conservation from mere copying.
threads.quote: Batlo: Hahaha! Of course not. Were I to just repaint them exactly as they were, that would be called "copying."

threads.claim: Batlo frames art as a hallucination that an artist must capture in detail and express objectively.
threads.quote: Batlo: What an artist must do is capture the hallucination in detail and express it objectively.

introduced.name: Ashvapati
introduced.how: Revealed to have joined the Guild under a false agenda, lied about nearly everything, and kept his desert origins
introduced.quote: I joined the Voynich Guild with my own agenda and nearly ruined their reputation

introduced.name: Ati
introduced.how: One of the desert children who calls Ashvapati uncle
introduced.quote: Ati: Uncle Ashvapati, we, uh...

introduced.name: Raya
introduced.how: One of the desert children who still wants Ashvapati as their uncle despite his past
introduced.quote: we still want you as our uncle.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: A renowned mage who created the magical gemstone and set its price
introduced.quote: created by none other than the renowned mage Alice herself!

introduced.name: Nod-Krai Trade Expo
introduced.how: A trade expo where things are sold and where the children earned Mora
introduced.quote: They always say you can find everything at the Nod-Krai Trade Expo.

introduced.name: Arms-dealing operation
introduced.how: A desert arms-dealing operation that Yelan helped shut down
introduced.quote: with the arms-dealing operation closed down, I've achieved my strategic objective.

introduced.name: Ashvapati's weapons research
introduced.how: Ashvapati's past weapons research, which Chevreuse says was not the crime itself
introduced.quote: your crime wasn't the weapons research itself.

introduced.name: Desert oasis hometown
introduced.how: The oasis the children once called home, now believed buried by sandstorms
introduced.quote: I'm sure the sandstorms will have buried any last trace of that oasis by now.

introduced.name: Magical gemstone
introduced.how: A gemstone that makes a spring and oasis grow when planted in the ground, even in deserts
introduced.quote: Simply plant it in the ground and a spring will instantly start growing.

assumed.name: Voynich Guild
assumed.quote: Given your association with the Voynich Guild, I suspect the boss of the Curatorium might raise some objections

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)
assumed.quote: Given your association with the Voynich Guild, I suspect the boss of the Curatorium might raise some objections

assumed.name: Chevreuse
assumed.quote: I appreciate your flexibility. I'll need all of them in my custody to proceed with the case files.

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Yelan: Understood... Well, there's been no serious harm to me or any of my compatriots

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: The Voynich Guild won't be responsible for any disputes remaining after this meeting.

assumed.name: Dori
assumed.quote: (Dori looks over from her booth with a smile)

assumed.name: Fontaine authorities
assumed.quote: I'm happy to let the Fontaine authorities process the culprits from here on.

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: destroy a certain signboard in Nasha Town.

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: With Lesser Lord Kusanali at the helm, who knows where the possibilities end?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: The Sumeru of today is a different world than what it once was.

threads.claim: Ashvapati's real identity and full backstory are revealed, answering who he truly was.
threads.quote: So I was interested to learn who the real Ashvapati was.

threads.claim: The desert may finally have a chance at lasting peace after this story.
threads.quote: Maybe there really is hope for peace in the desert.

threads.claim: Sumeru under Lesser Lord Kusanali is changing into a very different world.
threads.quote: The Sumeru of today is a different world than what it once was.

threads.claim: Alice's gemstone can create oases even in arid deserts, a powerful and mysterious artifact.
threads.quote: created by none other than the renowned mage Alice herself!

threads.claim: The final chapter of this story caused the Guild considerable trouble.
threads.quote: the final chapter caused us a fair amount of trouble

threads.claim: The desert arms-dealing operation was shut down, ending the threat it posed.
threads.quote: with the arms-dealing operation closed down, I've achieved my strategic objective.

threads.claim: Ashvapati's crime was misusing weapons knowledge rather than the research itself.
threads.quote: your crime wasn't the weapons research itself.

introduced.name: Charlotte
introduced.how: A reporter for The Steambird who keeps pursuing exclusive interviews
introduced.quote: Maybe not, but it'd be an even better world for me if Mr. Kinich here would agree to another exclusive interview with The Steambird...

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: A Fontainian tabloid newspaper sold at newsstands
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey, there's a newsstand over there. Wanna grab a copy of The Steambird?

introduced.name: Kinich
introduced.how: A man from Natlan who testified as a key witness in the smuggling trial
introduced.quote: Hello there, I'm Kinich.

introduced.name: Ajaw
introduced.how: A small, noisy self-proclaimed Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw, forebear of ancient wisdom
introduced.quote: I shall have you know that I am K'uhul Ajaw, forebear of ancient wisdom!

threads.claim: Kinich claims even fabricated tabloid stories are rooted in some grain of reality.
threads.quote: All I'm saying is, even the wildest leaps of the human imagination are always rooted in reality.

threads.claim: Fontaine's ban on flying objects in early months is a law that affects Ajaw.
threads.quote: Apparently, it's forbidden to release flying objects within Fontaine city limits during the first three days of each month.

threads.claim: Ajaw claims to be an ancient being who lived for eons before anyone else.
threads.quote: I lived for eons long before any of you were born!

threads.claim: An ancient Natlan weapon from a dragon ruin has turned up in Fontaine.
threads.quote: It's most likely an old weapon dug up from some ancient dragon ruins.

threads.claim: The gun may be linked to the smuggling case and may have slipped through the cracks.
threads.quote: I suspect this gun might have something to do with that smuggling case — it might've slipped through the cracks.

threads.claim: Investigators plan to question prisoners after realizing a suspect may have been overlooked.
threads.quote: We should begin by questioning the prisoners in custody.

threads.claim: Cacucu repeats set phrases, and Neuvillette can understand his words without grasping their meaning.
threads.quote: I can understand his words, just... not what they mean.

threads.claim: People from Natlan are expected to start appearing all over the world.
threads.quote: I know you mentioned a while back that people from Natlan would soon start showing up all over the world, but I hadn't expected anything like this.

threads.claim: Cacucu is found safe at the Palais Mermonia, where he must sign a confidentiality agreement.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ororon, Ifa! We found Cacucu!

threads.claim: A ban on flying objects restricts Cacucu's movement in Fontaine.
threads.quote: The ban on flying objects should be over by now.

threads.claim: Cacucu is officially ruled not to be a flying object and may move freely around Fontaine.
threads.quote: it has been determined that Mr. Cacucu should not, in fact, be classified as a flying object.

threads.claim: Precious Natlanese relics may be secretly smuggled out of Natlan to Fontaine.
threads.quote: Could they be secretly smuggling precious items out of Natlan...?

threads.claim: Angoulvant is arrested as a suspect in the illicit trade of Natlanese relics.
threads.quote: The Special Patrol will take this criminal off your hands now.

threads.claim: The gun is a relic from Natlan's ancient dragon civilization.
threads.quote: This is a relic left behind by Natlan's ancient dragon civilization.

threads.claim: The seller of the relic hides his identity and keeps the deal secret.
threads.quote: The gun was placed in a locked box and hidden away. Clearly, the seller wanted to keep their identity a secret.

threads.claim: The seller has never been met in person and knows the buyer's name and address, leaving him still unidentified.
threads.quote: As for the seller of this particular item... Well, I've never met him in person.

threads.claim: Angoulvant's claimed Natlan origins are doubted, raising the question of whether he is really a Natlander.
threads.quote: I bet you're just a Fontainian pretending to be from Natlan.

threads.claim: Kinich's father was a gambler whose losses cost Kinich in the past.
threads.quote: In the past, I also ended up paying a price for my father's gambling losses.

threads.claim: Kinich argues that gambling's apparent free gains always hide an unseen cost.
threads.quote: But we all know that even when it looks like you're getting something for free, there's always an unseen cost.

threads.claim: A prophecy about floods in Fontaine influences property decisions in the city.
threads.quote: The prophecy about the floods meant it never seemed like a worthwhile investment.

threads.claim: Navia hints that the Traveler has already shaped some of Teyvat's biggest business ventures in the past.
threads.quote: I'd even go as far as to say you've shaped some of Teyvat's biggest business ventures!

threads.claim: Navia suggests the Traveler's intuition has been guiding the park's progress, hinting at an underlying talent.
threads.quote: Your intuition's been guiding the way, mostly!

threads.claim: Escoffier reads the Traveler's hands and sword to find inspiration for a theme dish, implying an unusual way inspiration can be transferred.
threads.quote: Your hands are callused from wielding your sword, but still quite delicate.

threads.claim: Escoffier's theme dish menu is kept secret, with a hint at a hidden Chef's Surprise dish that many restaurants now offer.
threads.quote: To get the most out of this strategy, the menu can't be made public.

introduced.how: Reveals herself as a legendary mage known as A, with a soft spot for sincerity
introduced.quote: I hope no one would take offense — it's just that I, Alice, or "A" for short, have always had a soft spot for those with sincerity and candor.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: A secret society of mages who once met for tea parties and pledged not to fight
introduced.quote: Ever heard of the Hexenzirkel? As the spooky name suggests, it's a secret society

introduced.name: Rhinedottir
introduced.how: Known as R and Gold; the mage who could create a flower species that does not yet exist
introduced.quote: This is the signature of R, full name Rhinedottir, also known as "Gold."

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: Known as N; a mage who studies world direction and order and can speak in people's minds
introduced.quote: The "guide who will never get lost" is N, otherwise known as Nicole.

introduced.name: J
introduced.how: A mortal mage who left the Hexenzirkel to marry and has since died, passing on her title
introduced.quote: J was also a mortal who aged and passed on, leaving her title to her students and followers.

introduced.name: M
introduced.how: A human writer whose prose taught Alice about grief
introduced.quote: M was an exceptional human writer who used her prose to teach me the meaning of grief.

introduced.name: The Boar Princess
introduced.how: A storybook written by M that Alice counts among her favorites
introduced.quote: You may not know M in person, but you've likely encountered one of her works.

introduced.name: Barbatos
introduced.how: The Anemo Archon, who was entrusted with the Lantern
introduced.quote: And if I recall correctly, we left this lantern in the care of the Anemo Archon, Barbatos... Hmm, you must be commended for uncovering an artifact entrusted to the God of Wind himself.

introduced.name: Lantern of Utmost Joy
introduced.how: A lantern that the prophecy says must be tested with answers; it lights up as a signal
introduced.quote: Hmm, according to the prophecy, once we've figured out the answer, we should test it at the Lantern of Utmost Joy...

introduced.name: Prophecy letter sent to J
introduced.how: The prophecy was really a letter the mages sent to J as a group before her wedding, inviting her to a get-together
introduced.quote: The truth is, that prophecy was actually just a letter that we sent to J as a group the day before her wedding.

introduced.name: four riddles
introduced.how: Each of the four prophecy descriptions stands for one individual mage
introduced.quote: These four descriptions signify four individual mages.

introduced.name: Windblume Festival
introduced.how: Mondstadters give flowers to the people most important to them during Windblume
introduced.quote: During Windblume, Mondstadters offer flowers to the people most important to them... you three are family to me.

introduced.name: Ying'er
introduced.how: A Liyue woman who helped Timaeus with potion research and corresponds with him by letter
introduced.quote: Well basically, she helped me out a lot with my research into potion-making once, and we've stayed in touch through letters ever since...

introduced.name: Cecilia flower
introduced.how: Said to represent a once-wayward heart transformed by the power of love
introduced.quote: The Cecilia flower is said to represent a once-wayward heart transformed by the power of love.

introduced.name: Breath of Joy
introduced.how: A breath sealed in a test tube for Sucrose's research
introduced.quote: Collei, can you exhale once into this test tube? I will save this breath of joy, and use it in my research.

introduced.name: Timaeus's vow
introduced.how: Timaeus vowed to never say an insincere word until he wins Ying'er's heart
introduced.quote: A few months ago, I made a vow to the heavens that I will be true to myself and never utter an insincere word until the day that I've managed to win Miss Ying'er's heart!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, doesn't Mondstadt celebrate the Windblume Festival around this time of year?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey there, Katheryne!

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Paimon: What is wrong with you? That's no way to greet a friend we haven't seen in so long!

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Venti: Oho, it's been a while!

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Collei: Oh, well, Lisa once told me that the Windblume Festival is one of Mondstadt's biggest events of the year.

assumed.name: Calx
assumed.quote: Paimon: Calx? Uh, isn't that...

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Paimon: Um... and Paimon will take to Good Hunter to order some starters.

assumed.name: Sweet Madame
assumed.quote: Paimon: Just treat Paimon to a Sweet Madame, then you'll get your last Breath of Joy.

assumed.name: Sucrose
assumed.quote: Sucrose, we're here!

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Personally, I would still go with Albedo for this one.

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: (Ah yes, his secret alter ego: the Darknight Hero. He must have to deny it if anyone asks. In that sense, he has a complicated relationship with the truth.)

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: when the Traveler and Paimon first came to Mondstadt, she was actually the one who gave us directions.

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: Her Eleazar being cured was a huge milestone in her life.

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Hey there, and Paimon! It's been a while. How've you been?

assumed.name: Razor
assumed.quote: Teacher is... not at the usual place.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Huh? Even Lisa's here?

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Oh, Tone-Deaf Bard! Are you here for some food as well?

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Have faith in the Knights of Favonius!

assumed.name: Starsnatch Cliff
assumed.quote: Let's head over to Starsnatch Cliff next!

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Acting Grand Master Jean? She has a good name in that regard...

assumed.name: Cat's Tail
assumed.quote: Please feel free to pay a visit to Cat's Tail any time.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Apparently, Tighnari and Cyno both went out, but she stayed behind because she wanted to help us.

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Except me. I'm not here for information.

assumed.name: Eula
assumed.quote: Relax, you two. There's no need to be so courteous

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Klee, what are you doing here? Are you planning to blast some fish?

assumed.name: Darknight Hero
assumed.quote: Ah yes, his secret alter ego: the Darknight Hero.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Collei: Master Tighnari! Cyno!

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: Cyno: If your friendship was forged in a test tube, does that make you "test friends forever"?

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Venti's note here says we should look up and seek the answer from the sky.)

assumed.name: Varka
assumed.quote: The nicest lie I've ever come up with is the one I told Varka: That I didn't want to stay in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey... you're that outlander we met the other day at Good Hunter.

assumed.name: Marjorie
assumed.quote: I was there when you snuck your way into Marjorie's place.

assumed.name: Fischl
assumed.quote: my friend Fischl and her friend Mona the astrologist are both very knowledgeable and brave.

threads.claim: A found prophecy note sets four riddles whose completion unlocks a lantern's supreme blessing.
threads.quote: If you can do these things, you may light the lantern of utmost joy and receive a supreme blessing.

threads.claim: The prophecy's author is described as very powerful, leaving open whether the prophecy is real.
threads.quote: The person who wrote this prophecy is very powerful. If you manage to solve the riddle, good things are sure to happen.

threads.claim: The wind reportedly confirms the prophecy is real, deepening the mystery of its origin.
threads.quote: The wind said that the prophecy is real, and that your idea is a really good one.

threads.claim: Venti knows where the lantern is and will reveal its location once the four things are found.
threads.quote: Also... I happen to know where this lantern is.

threads.claim: The first riddle asks for a flower that is not of this world, a clue whose meaning is unresolved.
threads.quote: Find a flower that is not of this world. Find a guide who will never get lost. Find one who would never lie. Find a legend that never ends.

threads.claim: The Windblume has no fixed definition, so it may be the flower the riddle means.
threads.quote: The Windblume doesn't refer to a specific flower. Everyone defines what it means for themselves.

threads.claim: Albedo has previously created a flower beyond this world through alchemy, a possible answer to the riddle.
threads.quote: Traveler: Albedo did make something like that once.

threads.claim: Albedo reveals he is the writer Calx, answering the question of who Calx is.
threads.quote: Having my new friends address me by my pen name feels somewhat unusual. Please, just call me Albedo.

threads.claim: Collei was cured of an illness and once received much help from Mondstadt residents long ago.
threads.quote: So ever since my Eleazar got better, I've been looking out for an opportunity to come back to Mondstadt and tell them all the news that I've been cured...

threads.claim: Collei privately feels shy and lacks self-confidence, which makes making friends hard for her.
threads.quote: Collei: (I wish I had a little more self-confidence. Then I'd find it much easier to make friends with people...)

threads.claim: The collected Breaths of Joy are intended as raw materials for an alchemical creation that may be miraculous.
threads.quote: I believe these Breaths of Joy will serve as valuable raw materials for alchemical transmutation.

threads.claim: Sumeru has undergone major recent changes that have kept its officials busy.
threads.quote: Sumeru's been through some major changes recently, and things at work have only just started to calm down.

threads.claim: The prophecy's four riddles form a puzzle whose answers are people, with each riddle tied to a different field of knowledge.
threads.quote: I believe that each of the four things in the prophecy refers to a different field of knowledge.

threads.claim: Venti offers a map and an incantation that point to the lantern holding the answer to the prophetic puzzle.
threads.quote: Simply head to the location marked on the map, and you'll find the lantern you've been looking for.

threads.claim: Scarlett, a stranger from another land, wants the prophecy's answer for reasons tied to Mondstadt itself.
threads.quote: Not so much the prophecy itself, but Mondstadt as a nation. That's what I'm interested in.

threads.claim: Scarlett hints that someone she knows once lived in Mondstadt and that her visit is tied to that person.
threads.quote: As it happens, someone I know has an anniversary coming up soon, so I figured this would be a good time to come here and see all the sights that she once saw.

threads.claim: Rosaria secretly follows Scarlett after she recites the prophecy, hinting at a hidden agenda.
threads.quote: I never thought I'd have someone secretly following me even in a free city like Mondstadt.

threads.claim: The prophecy's honest figure is hard to identify, and Diluc's secret identity complicates who can be trusted to tell the truth.
threads.quote: Seems like it would be pretty difficult for someone in his position to avoid having to lie.

threads.claim: Mondstadt is presented as a city of romance and freedom, a theme of liberty that recurs.
threads.quote: It certainly lives up to its name as the city of romance and freedom.

threads.claim: Collei's rough early life changed her, a past that is hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: she had a very rough start in life, and it changed her.

threads.claim: Collei admits she was once immature and pushed people away, and that Amber was the one who never gave up on her.
threads.quote: The first time I came to Mondstadt, I was really immature. I didn't wanna let people in, and I was generally pretty awful to everyone...

threads.claim: The Lantern prophecy may not be a real prophecy, raising doubt about its origin.
threads.quote: Collei: Huh? But why? Then... does that mean... this wasn't a real prophecy after all?

threads.claim: The prophecy was actually a group letter the mages sent to J before her wedding, inviting her to a reunion.
threads.quote: The truth is, that prophecy was actually just a letter that we sent to J as a group the day before her wedding.

threads.claim: The Lantern may be a simple signal rather than an ancient mechanism.
threads.quote: Although the instructions had come from an old and enigmatic prophecy, it is in fact nothing like the ancient mechanism that we had all imagined it to be.

threads.claim: Someone may be watching the group from nearby without being seen.
threads.quote: But there's a strange aura to this place. It's almost as if someone has been staring at me as soon as we stepped foot in here.

threads.claim: Another person is confirmed to be following the group, and the watcher is still unclear.
threads.quote: Albedo: Oh, is that so? Then why do I spy yet another person following in your shadow?

threads.claim: Nicole can speak directly into people's minds without warning.
threads.quote: She has a tendency to... suddenly speak in someone's mind without any warning.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects Nicole may be the voice that spoke to them earlier.
threads.quote: (Huh! Could she have been the one who spoke to me while we were investigating ...?)

threads.claim: Alice has never acknowledged J's successors, and Scarlett wants to meet her.
threads.quote: Alice... You've never acknowledged any of J's successors.

threads.claim: Scarlett is drawn to becoming a mage and to the purpose of the Hexenzirkel.
threads.quote: My interest has been piqued, and I'm now even more drawn towards the idea of becoming a mage.

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon Barbatos was entrusted with the Lantern and once challenged the mages.
threads.quote: And if I recall correctly, we left this lantern in the care of the Anemo Archon, Barbatos...

threads.claim: Alice is revealed as the one who would never lie, answering the third riddle.
threads.quote: The "one who would never lie" is... me.

threads.claim: The prophecy has no right answer, since anyone sitting in the chair lights the Lantern.
threads.quote: We've just proven that there is no "right answer" for this prophecy.

threads.claim: Sucrose's research into collected breath of joy produces a strange cloud of happiness.
threads.quote: It was like a little cloud of happiness, but now it flew away...

threads.claim: A cloud in the sky appears to resemble Sucrose's test tube, hinting at the breath collected.
threads.quote: Doesn't it look... just like your test tube?

threads.claim: Rhinedottir may be able to create flower species that do not exist yet.
threads.quote: If there's anyone in this world who could create a flower species that does not yet exist, it would be her.

introduced.name: Windtrace
introduced.how: a game about Mondstadt's history, inspired by a past rebellion
introduced.quote: Windtrace is a game that's all about Mondstadt's history!

introduced.name: Mondstadt aristocrats
introduced.how: former rulers of Mondstadt City who were tyrants with brutal rule
introduced.quote: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...

introduced.name: Mondstadt resistance
introduced.how: a group of citizens who formed an underground resistance against the aristocrats
introduced.quote: To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.

introduced.name: Mondstadt rebellion
introduced.how: the rebels fought many duels with aristocrat lackeys across Mondstadt after the aristocrats trained henchmen to suppress them
introduced.quote: And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?

threads.claim: The aristocrats who once ruled Mondstadt were tyrants whose oppression drove citizens to rebel.
threads.quote: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal.

threads.claim: The aristocrats responded to the resistance by training henchmen to suppress the rebels, sparking ongoing duels.
threads.quote: But the aristocrats retaliated, quickly training up their own team of henchmen to suppress the rebels.

introduced.name: Gygax
introduced.how: the game's maker who invites travelers to try Windtrace
introduced.quote: Gygax: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

introduced.name: Aristocrats of Mondstadt
introduced.how: tyrannical nobles who once ruled Mondstadt City
introduced.quote: Gygax: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?

introduced.name: Rebels
introduced.how: an underground citizen resistance fighting the aristocrats, a side in Windtrace
introduced.quote: Gygax: To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.

introduced.name: Hunters
introduced.how: the side in Windtrace that searches for and pursues the rebels
introduced.quote: Either it was Rebels claiming that they had few escape options, or it was the Hunters complaining that they couldn't find anyone.

introduced.name: Mondstadt rebellion against the aristocrats
introduced.how: a past uprising where rebels fought the aristocrats' henchmen across the city
introduced.quote: Gygax: And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Welcome, adventurer. How have your travels been going thus far?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Traveler: Does this have anything to do with the Adventurers' Guild?

assumed.name: Commissions
assumed.quote: Traveler: Are there any new commissions?

assumed.name: Mondstadt City
assumed.quote: Gygax: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?

threads.claim: The aristocrats of Mondstadt were tyrants whose brutal rule was resisted by an underground rebel movement.
threads.quote: Gygax: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...

threads.claim: Windtrace was once popular but young people have lost interest in it, so its maker is trying to revive it.
threads.quote: Gygax: Sadly, yes. Young people these days don't seem very interested in the game...

introduced.name: Gygax
introduced.how: Runs Windtrace playtests and invites players to share feedback on the game
introduced.quote: *sigh* I don't know who to listen to, so I decided to invite another batch of people to play-test the game and share their feedback.

introduced.name: Windtrace
introduced.how: A game about Mondstadt's history, inspired by a past uprising, that Gygax is trying to revive
introduced.quote: Windtrace is a game that's all about Mondstadt's history!

introduced.name: Aristocrats of Mondstadt
introduced.how: Former tyrannical rulers of Mondstadt who oppressed its citizens
introduced.quote: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal.

introduced.name: Rebels
introduced.how: Citizens who formed an underground resistance against the aristocrats
introduced.quote: To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.

introduced.name: Hunters
introduced.how: The aristocrats' henchmen, trained to suppress the rebels and hunt them down
introduced.quote: But the aristocrats retaliated, quickly training up their own team of henchmen to suppress the rebels.

introduced.name: Mondstadt rebellion
introduced.how: Rebels and aristocrats' lackeys fought many duels across Mondstadt in a past uprising
introduced.quote: And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in the city of Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Previous Windtrace play by the Traveler
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you! I was really impressed with the technique you exhibited the last time you played Windtrace.

threads.claim: The aristocrats who once ruled Mondstadt were brutal tyrants whose oppression caused great suffering.
threads.quote: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...

threads.claim: A citizen resistance fought the aristocrats across Mondstadt, becoming a major threat to them.
threads.quote: These valiant rebels engaged in operations throughout the city, becoming a major thorn in the side of the aristocrats.

introduced.name: Connor
introduced.how: Winery contact who knows about the bitter water and handles the case
introduced.quote: For more details, please speak with Connor at the winery.

introduced.name: Endora
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a Lochfolk, a water-dwelling life-form
introduced.quote: I am Endora. I am a Lochfolk.

introduced.name: Lochfolk
introduced.how: Water life-forms that once spread through rivers and ponds as Fontaine's spies
introduced.quote: We Lochfolk once spread far and wide to rivers, streams, and ponds all over the continent, and we largely served as Fontaine's spies.

introduced.name: Rhodeia
introduced.how: Renowned Lochfolk scout who fled Fontaine and turns water bitter
introduced.quote: She is the most renowned of us Lochfolk scouts, and also the strongest. But she fled Fontaine, harboring a longing for the previous Hydro Archon.

introduced.name: Old Finch
introduced.how: Elderly believer in the Springvale spring fairy
introduced.quote: This guy is supposed to be one of the real believers in the spring fairy's existence.

introduced.name: Springvale
introduced.how: Spring whose water is sweet and that Endora heads to for sweet water
introduced.quote: There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the water from Dragonspine or Springvale.

introduced.name: Spring Fairy
introduced.how: Legendary spring being that Old Finch believes in and Endora resembles
introduced.quote: doesn't Springvale have a legend of a spring fairy or something?

introduced.name: Oceanid Creatures
introduced.how: Small water animals that carry messages and can be merged with to learn
introduced.quote: They... carry messages. Learn... by joining with them.

introduced.name: Lochfolk merging
introduced.how: Lochfolk gain abilities and knowledge by joining with water bodies and animals
introduced.quote: Powerful water... changes shape into animals. Very dangerous. But joining with them... we learn new things.

introduced.name: Previous Hydro Archon
introduced.how: Former Hydro Archon whose goal was to connect everyone like water; her passing split the Lochfolk from Fontaine
introduced.quote: The previous Archon had no plan to speak of. She merely wished to connect everyone in the world, in much the same way as all water is connected.

introduced.name: Life Flows On poem
introduced.how: A short Springvale poem whose meaning Endora decodes and Old Finch recognizes
introduced.quote: It's a little melancholic. A short but enigmatic poem. I don't understand it.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Compared to previous major incidents, this one is not the most peculiar.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Connor: Are you the people sent by the Adventurers' Guild?

assumed.name: Hydro Slime
assumed.quote: Paimon: These Hydro Slimes are behaving a bit oddly, aren't they?

assumed.name: Oceanid Creatures
assumed.quote: We saw some Oceanid Creatures 'round here here once, didn't we?

assumed.name: Draff
assumed.quote: I'm sure Draff would have agreed — goodness knows what he'd do without wine, after all.

assumed.name: Mist Flower
assumed.quote: Endora: This would happen to Endora too... Mist Flowers... strongest in Teyvat.

threads.claim: The cause of the bitter water is an unexplained mysterious elemental phenomenon.
threads.quote: I suspect it must be some mysterious elemental phenomenon.

threads.claim: Rhodeia turned the water bitter to kill Endora, whom she mistook for a Fontaine assassin.
threads.quote: she stretched forth her enmity, which turned the water bitter, in order to slay me.

threads.claim: The spring fairy is still present in Springvale but refuses to answer Endora, and her name is unknown.
threads.quote: She is still here. Name... unknown. She will not answer Endora.

threads.claim: Old Finch wonders why the spring fairy no longer speaks, and Endora cannot understand her strange words.
threads.quote: She is real, after all. But why does she no longer speak?

threads.claim: The spring fairy sends a farewell message through Endora about meeting again when the stars go out, but she still does not speak directly.
threads.quote: Thus, she says this:

threads.claim: Rhodeia and other Lochfolk still long for the previous Hydro Archon and refuse to accept the new one.
threads.quote: they did not recognize the new Hydro Archon and desired only to keep the dreams of yesteryear alive.

threads.claim: Paimon asks what the Hydro Archon is planning, hinting that the Lochfolk served as spies for a hidden purpose.
threads.quote: Spies!? What's the Hydro Archon planning?

threads.claim: The previous Archon had no grand plan; the Lochfolk's network was meant only to connect the world.
threads.quote: The previous Archon had no plan to speak of.

threads.claim: The Springvale poem's meaning is unclear to Endora, and the poem is presented as enigmatic.
threads.quote: It's a little melancholic. A short but enigmatic poem. I don't understand it.

threads.claim: Old Finch recognizes the poem, connecting it to the spring fairy's words and his own past.
threads.quote: I know this poem.

threads.claim: Endora gains language and understanding by merging with Oceanid Creatures, so Lochfolk grow through joining other life-forms.
threads.quote: My grasp of language has expanded from merging with those Oceanid Creatures.

threads.claim: Endora rejects both Rhodeia's and the spring fairy's paths and chooses to travel with the Traveler.
threads.quote: I've decided to embark on a path that no others before me have.

introduced.name: Kukulkan
introduced.how: The Sage of the Stolen Flame is revealed to be Kukulkan, a sage who has taken many names
introduced.quote: Traveler: You're... the Sage of the Stolen Flame?

introduced.name: Heart of the Sacred Mountain
introduced.how: The true inner site where Xiuhcoatl's brother created Huitzilopochtli and the world's blueprints are recorded
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: This is the true "Heart of the Sacred Mountain"... The place where my great brother created Huitzilopochtli. The blueprints for the world of old are recorded here.

introduced.name: Tonatiuh
introduced.how: A former sky-cable city beneath the false sky, later modified and used to hide a Golden Entreaty
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: Ah, Tonatiuh... Now that is a fine name. Before the false sky enveloped the world, the city that lay beneath it could have rivaled Tollan itself.

introduced.name: Huitzilopochtli
introduced.how: A Natlan Phlogistonization Array that would convert all of Natlan into phlogiston
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: The Natlan Phlogistonization Array... That is to say, a device that can transform all Natlan into

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: An atom that can carry transcribed information and imitate any form, so it can change shape
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: Phlogiston is an atom upon which information may be transcribed, and is itself a form of

introduced.name: Xiuhcoatl
introduced.how: The master of the first flame and Kukulkan's great brother, who once wielded all light, heat, and wisdom
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: Xiuhcoatl was the master of the first flame, wielder of all light, heat, and wisdom. He controlled the primal flame, and could even plunge his entire body into it.

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: Slew Xiuhcoatl by exploiting his weak point, then was reborn as the Pyro Archon
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: Yes. Xbalanque was undoubtedly slain at that time... But he was reborn then, and thus became the so-called god of fire, the Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Golden Entreaties
introduced.how: Split control hub that can reactivate the Sacred City, with one piece hidden on Tonatiuh
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: Enter, then, the Golden Entreaties — the control hub that could be used to reactivate this place, split in two between us for safekeeping.

introduced.name: Flamelord's Blessing
introduced.how: A disordered power in saurians that can kill them unless guided correctly; the earlier removal was a half-truth
introduced.quote: One Who Speaks Coldly: Only one of omission. If not guided correctly, this disordered power would indeed kill most saurians who bear the Blessing.

introduced.name: Nibelung
introduced.how: A Dragon King who was called forth by the Abyss and woke from a long dream, then was destroyed by the reaver
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: But when the Dragon King Nibelung descended from beyond the circles of this world, he was called forth by the Abyss and awoke from his long dream.

introduced.name: Dragonborn
introduced.how: Dragons shaped from primal flame by the first Pyro Sovereign, who adapted to survive in present-day Natlan
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: He used the primal flame to mold and shape the Dragonborn, the first of which he gifted with an offshoot of that same fire...

introduced.name: Xiuhcoatl's false death
introduced.how: The reaver froze Xiuhcoatl in lava, sending him into a false death
introduced.quote: Kukulkan: The reaver from beyond the skies once froze Xiuhcoatl in lava, causing him to fall into a false death...

introduced.name: Chosen of Dragons
introduced.how: Refers to both the chosen dragon and the chosen human who brings the dragon to the Sacred City
introduced.quote: One Who Speaks Coldly: Refers to both the chosen dragon, and the chosen human who brings the dragon here.

assumed.name: Sage of the Stolen Flame
assumed.quote: Paimon: Thinking back on it, we sure have done tons of stuff on this journey... and cleared loads of trials created by that Sage of the Stolen Flame guy...

assumed.name: Och-Kan
assumed.quote: Paimon: We even had a bust-up with Och-Kan, that super famous tyrant... Well, he turned out to be Coco in the end, and not as bad a guy as we thought...

assumed.name: Flamelord
assumed.quote: One Who Speaks Coldly: Open your eyes, descendant of the Flamelord.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Kukulkan: The Abyss shall never again be allowed even to gaze upon this realm.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Kukulkan: Turning all Natlan into a realm composed solely of primal flame.

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Kukulkan: There shall be neither Ley Lines nor substantive bodies...

assumed.name: Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: Huitzilopochtli: Ignite the Sacred Flame to cleanse creation.

assumed.name: Sweeping Skyfire
assumed.quote: Huitzilopochtli: Entering trigger sequence. Three rounds of confirmations will be required to either activate or deactivate the Sweeping Skyfire...

threads.claim: The Sage of the Stolen Flame is revealed to be Kukulkan, who created the legend and the trials.
threads.quote: Traveler: You're... the Sage of the Stolen Flame?

threads.claim: The earlier removal of the Flamelord's Blessing was a lie of omission, and the Blessing's power could kill saurians if misguided.
threads.quote: Traveler: So the removal of the Blessing was a lie you made up...

threads.claim: The Chosen of Dragons is explained as both the chosen dragon and the human who brings it, and the human's duty has already ended.
threads.quote: One Who Speaks Coldly: It's just that, once you were brought here, the human's duty had already ended...

threads.claim: The Traveler has a sense of forgotten memories that are important and stirring.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Hmm... Strange. I feel like I've forgotten something very important...)

threads.claim: Kukulkan plans to turn all of Natlan into phlogiston lifeforms to defeat the Abyss at the cost of bodies and birth or death.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Huitzilopochtli will burn everything, and all that information will be logged and replicated by that ocean of phlogiston units...

threads.claim: The Traveler chooses to cancel the activation of Huitzilopochtli, refusing the plan.
threads.quote: Traveler: Cancel activation!

threads.claim: The Abyss is a shadowy enemy that Kukulkan's plan is meant to defeat permanently.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: The Abyss shall never again be allowed even to gaze upon this realm.

threads.claim: Paimon's fate is left uncertain if Huitzilopochtli is activated.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Perhaps and that little emissary by side will live. Perhaps they will not.

threads.claim: The Traveler has no known way back from the Sacred City to Paimon.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: You do not even know where they are, nor is there any way back from this place.

threads.claim: The Traveler vows to create a way back to Paimon rather than accept being stranded.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...Then I'll make one.

threads.claim: Activating the plan may end the evolution of life, raising a question about what is lost.
threads.quote: Traveler: Even if doing so means the end of evolution?

threads.claim: The tribes depend on their so-called Archon as a crutch, and Kukulkan blames this for their failure to advance.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Until today, they lean on the authority of their so-called

threads.claim: Authority over the primal flame will return naturally to draconic phlogiston lifeforms once Natlan is fully phlogistonized.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: When Natlan is fully philogistonized, the very concept of life will be rewritten. That authority will then return naturally.

threads.claim: Xbalanque was reborn after slaying Xiuhcoatl and became the Pyro Archon, the god of fire.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Yes. Xbalanque was undoubtedly slain at that time... But he was reborn then, and thus became the so-called god of fire, the Pyro Archon.

threads.claim: A Jade of Return once existed on Tonatiuh but is now gone, which raises a question about where it went.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Hahaha, what an interesting response... Alright, now, let's head to Tonatiuh to search for that now non-existent Jade of Return, shall we?

threads.claim: The Traveler briefly achieved a mature dragon form after the power was channeled with guidance, and the Traveler returns to a smaller form.
threads.quote: One Who Speaks Coldly: You have briefly achieved the form of a "mature dragon" after your power was channeled with the proper guidance.

threads.claim: Kukulkan admits a lingering hope to believe in the dragons and humans despite the plan's failure.
threads.quote: Kukulkan: Perhaps... deep down, I still wished... to believe.

introduced.name: Affan
introduced.how: elderly villager who grows flowers at a nursery outside Aaru Village and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: I'm fine! I don't need the other villagers to worry about me.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: the village Affan lives near, which the travelers are not from
introduced.quote: You're mistaken. We're not from Aaru Village, and we're not here to laugh at you.

introduced.name: Withering Zone
introduced.how: black withering ground that destroys soil and must be cleared in combat
introduced.quote: No wonder Grandpa Affan mentioned some strange black stuff — there's a Withering Zone here!

introduced.name: Golden Rose
introduced.how: a precious rose variety, far more valuable than the Sumeru Rose
introduced.quote: This type of flower is called the Golden Rose. It's much more precious than the Sumeru Rose.

introduced.name: Shafaqat
introduced.how: Uncle Shafaqat, the late old ghost, an exiled researcher from Sumeru City who cultivated the Golden Rose
introduced.quote: I heard from my elders that his name was Shafaqat. He left Sumeru City when he was young and came to our village.

introduced.name: Sabbah
introduced.how: an exiled Amurta researcher who is introduced as someone who can help with the roses
introduced.quote: I know an Amurta researcher named Sabbah.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: distant region the travelers crossed mountains, lakes and seas to reach
introduced.quote: We've climbed many, many mountains, and crossed lakes and seas to get to Sumeru.

introduced.name: Rose folk song
introduced.how: a village folk song composed by Shafaqat, passed down through generations, about roses and a wish
introduced.quote: The village has a rose folk song that has been passed down, and it was originally composed by Uncle Shafaqat.

introduced.name: Shafaqat's notes
introduced.how: his notebooks, left in his house, with his life story, exile regrets and plans for the roses
introduced.quote: On the title page is a name in big letters: Shafaqat.

introduced.name: Petrified seeds
introduced.how: rose seeds that have turned to stone shells and will not sprout normally
introduced.quote: Based on my observations, these seeds appear to have gone through petrifaction.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Affan

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Affan

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: In the past, when I was in the Akademiya, everyone would politely call me

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Mora can't buy these flower seeds.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: I almost left with the Eremites, but then I thought about it

assumed.name: Sumeru Rose
assumed.quote: As in, Sumeru Roses?

assumed.name: Geo
assumed.quote: The second possibility is that this breed has a strong affinity for Geo.

assumed.name: Dendro
assumed.quote: After applying Dendro to the flowers

threads.claim: The rose seeds may have turned to stone and Affan wonders whether he has been planting stones all along.
threads.quote: Have I really been planting stones all along?

threads.claim: Sabbah proposes that the seeds have a Geo-based stone shell that could be preserved or broken open.
threads.quote: That is to say that they can gather enough Geo elements while in seed form to form a stony shell over their exteriors.

threads.claim: Breaking the stone casings and awakening the seeds lets the Golden Roses finally sprout.
threads.quote: They're finally sprouting! Finally...

threads.claim: The rose folk song carries a wish and hints at a hidden meaning in the stone roses.
threads.quote: Roses, oh roses, grant me my wish.

threads.claim: Sabbah reads the song as a hint that breaking the stone shell will let the seeds sprout.
threads.quote: As the song hinted, perhaps breaking the stone shell will let the seeds sprout from the stones.

threads.claim: The last stanza of the song about surpassing time and withering is recalled as the roses bloom.
threads.quote: Songs shall defy my fate, and overcome my destiny.

threads.claim: Shafaqat wanted his roses to grow everywhere, and Affan vows to fulfill that wish.
threads.quote: He wrote in his notes that he wanted these roses to grow everywhere.

threads.claim: Affan completes Shafaqat's wish by blooming the Golden Roses at the nursery.
threads.quote: Uncle Shafaqat, I've helped you fulfill your wish.

threads.claim: The villagers fear the old ghost, and outsiders ask about who he really was.
threads.quote: Only outsiders ask about the old ghost.

threads.claim: The old ghost is revealed as Shafaqat, a former researcher exiled to the village.
threads.quote: I heard from my elders that his name was Shafaqat.

threads.claim: Exile is described as a cruel punishment that erases a researcher's life work.
threads.quote: To researchers, exile is truly a cruel punishment that renders decades of hard work meaningless.

threads.claim: Sabbah sees her own future in Shafaqat's exile and fears she will end up the same way.
threads.quote: That's probably how all of us exiles will end up.

threads.claim: Black withering stuff appeared from the ground and destroyed the nursery without warning.
threads.quote: I knew something was off when so much black stuff just appeared out of the ground.

threads.claim: The Traveler clears the Withering Zone and the soil returns to normal.
threads.quote: Aaaand the soil's back to normal!

threads.claim: Affan has an unfulfilled dream from his life that the Traveler's ability reveals.
threads.quote: The dream he never got to fulfill when he was alive... Allow me to realize it for him.

threads.claim: Affan feels his life has finally meant something after the roses bloom.
threads.quote: I finally did something right in the end.

threads.claim: Sabbah says she used to feel lonely in Aaru Village but now has friends and roses to share her life with.
threads.quote: I used to feel lonely staying in Aaru Village, but I feel differently now.

introduced.name: Aranakin
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a singing Aranara who guides the group to the Zohrah Mushroom
introduced.quote: Aranakin is Aranakin!

introduced.name: Aragaru
introduced.how: Introduces himself as an Aranara who knows the Traveler and Paimon and asks for help
introduced.quote: Golden Nara and White Floaty, you are here! I am Aragaru!

introduced.name: Aranaga
introduced.how: Described as the eldest Aranara who presides over the Arahaoma ritual in Mawtiyima Forest
introduced.quote: Aranaga is the eldest and most interesting of us three!

introduced.name: Lunja
introduced.how: Introduces herself as the leader of the Farrokhzadan mercenary group
introduced.quote: Hi, call me Lunja, of The Farrokhzadan, even though technically, I'm a Farrokhdokht, haha!

introduced.name: Minum
introduced.how: Introduces himself by name as one of Lunja's Eremite men
introduced.quote: Minum: ...Minum.

introduced.name: Ziri
introduced.how: Introduces himself by name as one of Lunja's Eremite men
introduced.quote: Ziri: Ziri.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Lunja explains her group are desert folk who are not used to the rainforest
introduced.quote: They're from the desert and haven't gotten used to the rainforest.

introduced.name: Anqa and Isan
introduced.how: Introduced as Eremite fighters who try to stop the group at the cave
introduced.quote: I apologize, but please stop here.

introduced.name: Kusava
introduced.how: Explained as a bitter fruit that holds Aranara memories and makes them strong
introduced.quote: Kusava holds memories and dreams. It is chubby, bitter, and full of power.

introduced.name: Barsam Flower
introduced.how: Explained as an Aranara friend born to be the source of the Arahaoma potion
introduced.quote: Barsam Flower is Aranara's good friend and is born for Arahaoma.

introduced.name: Zohrah Mushroom
introduced.how: Described as a shiny-spotted mushroom needed for the Arahaoma ritual
introduced.quote: Zohrah Mushroom, is little shiny spots, just like my songs!

introduced.name: Yajna Grass
introduced.how: Explained as a plant destined to become Arahaoma
introduced.quote: destinated to turn into Arahaoma. Very cute and pitiful.

introduced.name: Arahaoma
introduced.how: Explained as a memory elixir that drives away death and wakes Jamikayomars
introduced.quote: The essence of memory, messenger that drives away death, the elixir Arahaoma is.

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: Explained as a growing blight that is devouring forests and making them afraid
introduced.quote: Marana is growing, bigger and bigger.

introduced.name: Mawtiyima Forest
introduced.how: Described as the forest garden that Aranaga watches over and that Marana threatens
introduced.quote: Aranaga is right in the gardens of the Mawtiyima Forest, watching over Mawtiyima.

introduced.name: Jamikayomars
introduced.how: Explained as the guardian gate of Mawtiyima that must be awakened with Arahaoma
introduced.quote: Nara Varuna's memory cup grows here, so the name is Jamikayomars.

introduced.name: Nara Varuna
introduced.how: Introduced as a past figure whose tears formed the forest and whose stones remain
introduced.quote: Nara Varuna came here and cried for them.

introduced.name: Realm of Khab
introduced.how: Described as the Barsam Flower's dream-place where it sleeps on water
introduced.quote: That's the Barsam Flower's dream, where the Flower can sleep on water

introduced.name: Withering Zone
introduced.how: Lunja says the cave holds a dangerous zone that kills everything
introduced.quote: We discovered a Withering Zone inside.

introduced.name: Naravaluka
introduced.how: Aragaru warns these roaming beings are called sand and cannot be trusted
introduced.quote: There are Naravaluka roaming about there.

introduced.name: Walking Shroom-Kin
introduced.how: Explained as fungal creatures that multiply and compete for nutrients
introduced.quote: We have to hurry and drive them off or they will multiply and compete against everyone for nutrients!

introduced.name: Ad Oblivione
introduced.how: Described as a living-memory flower that cannot be blown away, and a device that takes away dreams
introduced.quote: Cannot blow him away, the Ad Oblivione; cannot destroy him, the device that takes away dreams.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Explained as beings whose memories can be stored in tubers, seeds and leaf veins
introduced.quote: Aranara memories can store in tubers, in seeds, can flow in leaf veins

introduced.name: Grandmaster of Verdure
introduced.how: Described as the figure who cultivated wisdom in Nara and guided them to the glimmering water cave
introduced.quote: The Grandmaster of Verdure cultivated the bud of wisdom in the hearts of brave Nara

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Lunja, optional)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: And as you can see, a young and charming woman like me really needed Mora.

assumed.name: Elemental Monument
assumed.quote: (Activate the Elemental Monument)

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: (After leading the two Seelie back to their courts)

assumed.name: Ruin Grader and Ruin Defenders
assumed.quote: (Defeat the Ruin Grader flanked by two Ruin Defenders)

assumed.name: Akademiya
