assumed.quote: A rich old man in the Akademiya hired us, the Eremites, to find the Zohrah Mushroom in the forest.

assumed.name: Starry Night Chapter
assumed.quote: (If Starry Night Chapter has not been completed)

assumed.name: The Withering
assumed.quote: But the place is all affected by The Withering. How are we supposed to get close?

assumed.name: Agha Farrokh
assumed.quote: Agha Farrokh will never forget your offense, and you will get it when the table is turned.

assumed.name: Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: We're still going to play together at Festival Utsava!

threads.claim: Marana is a growing blight that spreads through the forest and makes plants sick, and its origin is left open.
threads.quote: Marana is growing, bigger and bigger.

threads.claim: Marana came from the moon's shadows and devoured Mawtiyima after many moons, with walking Shroom-Kin following it.
threads.quote: But after many, many more moons, Marana came out of the moons' shadows and devoured Mawtiyima.

threads.claim: Defeating the Withering Branches and the Tumor of the Withering removes Marana from Mawtiyima.
threads.quote: The Marana here has dissipated.

threads.claim: Nara Varuna is a figure of the distant past whose memories and tears shaped the forest, and the full story is still unknown.
threads.quote: Nara Varuna came here and cried for them.

threads.claim: The Aranara admit they have forgotten much about the Nara and that their shared memories are scattered or blurred.
threads.quote: The three of us all have lots of things we can't remember.

threads.claim: Aranaga suggests death is only a loss of memory, and the Aranara seem to be fading from the Traveler's memory.
threads.quote: Death is just a loss of memory.

threads.claim: After the ritual the Aranara say they are fading and may forget the Traveler, which the Traveler questions.
threads.quote: You guys will forget, won't you?

threads.claim: Jamikayomars guards the path into Mawtiyima and will only open it once it remembers, after Arahaoma is offered.
threads.quote: He will open the path for us, once Jamikayomars remembers it all, then we go in and rescue Mawtiyima.

threads.claim: A remark about the garden of freedom and a device that extracts living memory hints at an outside force that takes dreams for domination.
threads.quote: Because the garden of freedom, the source of power, dreams and memories, not only for Aranara, but also for Nara.

threads.claim: The Aranara describe a grinding mechanism that takes living memory for dominion and domestication, which they oppose.
threads.quote: Taking away living memory, grinding and crushing to extract its juice

threads.claim: An unnamed rich old man in the Akademiya hired the Eremites to find the Zohrah Mushroom, and the reason for the job is unclear.
threads.quote: A rich old man in the Akademiya hired us, the Eremites, to find the Zohrah Mushroom in the forest.

threads.claim: The Eremites say the old man claimed the Zohrah Mushroom is the key to eradicating The Withering.
threads.quote: That old man did mention the Zohrah Mushroom is the key to eradicating The Withering

threads.claim: The walking Shroom-Kin are a frightening threat that moves in and feeds on the forest's nutrients.
threads.quote: They came too, the walking Shroom-Kin, not afraid of Marana, but very frightening.

threads.claim: Kusava holds Aranara memories and can wake plants and vines, but using it causes pain to the plants.
threads.quote: The Kusava can temporarily wake up plants tainted by Marana

threads.claim: After the Marana is cleared, Mawtiyima is free of the burden and recovering.
threads.quote: Free of the burden of Marana, Mawtiyima is.

introduced.name: Arapacati
introduced.how: Aranara who sends the Traveler to find her brothers and explains the brothers are not missing
introduced.quote: Arapacati's big brothers have not returned to Vanarana. We siblings can't celebrate Festival Utsava together if they don't return...

introduced.name: Arachatora
introduced.how: Aranara brother who introduces himself and his mushroom cooking training
introduced.quote: Kind Nara, I'm Arachatora. You are?

introduced.name: Arasaka
introduced.how: Aranara brother introduced by name, guarding Zaytun Peaches and seeking the taste of happiness
introduced.quote: The Traveler finds the four brothers, Arachatora, Arapas, Arasaka and Araphala and help them in their cooking

introduced.name: Arapas
introduced.how: Aranara brother who makes soup and is obsessed with water quality
introduced.quote: From underground! Forget that, why are you drinking my soup? Arapas worked very hard on that!

introduced.name: Araphala
introduced.how: Aranara brother who introduces himself after waking from a long sleep
introduced.quote: My name is Araphala! Hehe, I remember now...

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: Aranara home forest where Festival Utsava is held and where the brothers trained
introduced.quote: They used to do cooking training in Vanarana. But they made lots of smoke, so Arapacati kicked them out.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: forest spirits who absorb things to recover their senses and eat by cooking
introduced.quote: But Aranara are spirits of the forest. So, we can recover and regain our senses by absorbing .

introduced.name: Festival Utsava
introduced.how: a festival where Nara cook food for Aranara and Aranara cook for Nara
introduced.quote: It happened in the last Festival Utsava. Nara made lots of food for Aranara to try.

introduced.name: Nara Varuna
introduced.how: a Golden Nara friend from long ago who taught Aranara how humans eat
introduced.quote: A friend of Aranara from a long, long time ago. A Golden Nara just like Nara .

introduced.name: Marana
introduced.how: a spreading withering corruption that takes over habitats and is dangerous
introduced.quote: Marana has been spreading rapidly. Even the Head Mushroom's habitat has been taken over.

introduced.name: Head Mushroom
introduced.how: a large fragrant mushroom Arachatora has been waiting to cook
introduced.quote: The Head Mushroom is a head of mushroom.

introduced.name: Zaytun Peaches
introduced.how: peaches Arasaka grew from seed and guards jealously
introduced.quote: Great. Hehe... I grew these Zaytun Peaches little by little, ever since they were seeds...

introduced.name: taste of happiness
introduced.how: a treat Arasaka seeks, revealed to be sugar
introduced.quote: Isn't it just "sugar"!?

introduced.name: Iaanesh
introduced.how: a traveling merchant in Gandharva Ville who sells sugar
introduced.quote: My family has always been a merchant group on the move, from The Chasm to Sumeru.

introduced.name: Living Spring
introduced.how: a special cold clean water source Arapas wants for his soup
introduced.quote: After collecting water samples as numerous as the leaves on a tree, I finally found the best

introduced.name: Apshvaana
introduced.how: water creatures Aranara say have four legs, a tail and bite, which turn out to be crocodiles
introduced.quote: They live in the water, and they have four legs, a tail, and they bite.

introduced.name: Unrivaled Fresh Fruits
introduced.how: fruits that only strong trees bear and that Araphala treats as the best ingredient
introduced.quote: Only strong trees can bear Unrivaled Fresh Fruits. Strong trees sing first when the wind blows.

introduced.name: hibernation into seeds
introduced.how: Aranara hibernate in danger and compress memories and dreams into a seed
introduced.quote: We hibernate when we are in grave danger, and we compress our memories and dreams into a seed.

introduced.name: Recipe: Selva Salad
introduced.how: a recipe Arasaka gives the Traveler after the sugar dish
introduced.quote: (Obtain Recipe: Selva Salad)

assumed.name: Arama
assumed.quote: Arapacati not afraid. Nara is good Nara, just like the Nara in the stories. Nara and Paimon have helped us a lot.

assumed.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
assumed.quote: Since Nara could heal me with the power of Lesser Lord Kusanali, then removing the effect of Marana shouldn't be a problem.

assumed.name: Ruin Sentinel
assumed.quote: (Defeat the 2 Ruin Sentinels and activate the mechanism first to lower the water level inside the cave)

assumed.name: Withering Zone
assumed.quote: Ah, the Withering Zone... Paimon hopes Rana is doing okay.

assumed.name: Dendro
assumed.quote: (After applying Dendro to the Aranara)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Iaanesh, optional)

assumed.name: Arabalika
assumed.quote: Even if Arama and Arabalika were there, it would take them some effort to tear it apart.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Paimon doesn't think anything can be scarier than Stormterror.

assumed.name: Varuna Contraption
assumed.quote: Arapas, of all places, you had to go to the Varuna Contraption.

assumed.name: Bija
assumed.quote: Nara is going to help Arana to form a Bija.

assumed.name: Fresh Harra Fruits
assumed.quote: I finally managed to make this pot of soup, but while I was away picking Fresh Harra Fruits, you...

threads.claim: Nara Varuna visited the Aranara and left them with feelings that were both happy and sad.
threads.quote: Nara Varuna looked happy and sad at the same time.

threads.claim: Nara Varuna's words shaped the Aranara's family bonds and their cooking habits.
threads.quote: Nara Varuna said this was great. We should cherish our family.

threads.claim: Marana is spreading quickly and corrupting the forest's habitats, including the Head Mushroom's.
threads.quote: Marana has been spreading rapidly. Even the Head Mushroom's habitat has been taken over.

threads.claim: The Aranara siblings are not actually related by blood, which raises questions about how they became family.
threads.quote: Nope.

threads.claim: The siblings chose to become brothers and sister after hearing Nara Varuna speak of family.
threads.quote: We thought it was great, so Arapacati and brothers decided to become brothers and sister.

threads.claim: Aranara eat by cooking ingredients, a habit they learned from Nara Varuna.
threads.quote: Humans cook ingredients into food, and the children of the forest can also make ingredients into food.

threads.claim: Arasaka has a Nara friend from long ago who has changed and can no longer hear him.
threads.quote: I have a Nara friend living inside. But a long, long time has passed. He's changed now and can't hear my voice.

threads.claim: Iaanesh also had a childhood friend in Gandharva Ville whom he cannot remember.
threads.quote: I can't remember his name, or what he looked like...

threads.claim: The taste of happiness turns out to be ordinary sugar, and Arasaka cannot recapture the feeling of his first taste.
threads.quote: But for some reason, I don't feel as happy as the first time I tasted it...

threads.claim: Aranara hibernate by compressing their memories and dreams into seeds, which raises questions about what they lose.
threads.quote: We hibernate when we are in grave danger, and we compress our memories and dreams into a seed.

threads.claim: The brothers are absent and the Festival Utsava is approaching, so the siblings must prepare for it.
threads.quote: Nara is going to help Arana to form a Bija. So, we will prepare for Festival Utsava together.

threads.claim: Arapacati expects the Festival Utsava to be grand, and the brothers' cooking is set to be shown there.
threads.quote: Arapacati is looking forward to it. This Festival Utsava will be really great and amazing!

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: a Jinni bound to a bottle who guides the Traveler and speaks of her past with Gurabad
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Ha... Alright, that's enough jokes for now. All you have to do, my master, is to hold me and touch the chess piece.

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: a city once swallowed by the earth, now lying exposed in a large cavern
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Behold Gurabad. Once, it was swallowed by the very earth itself — now, it lies before you.

introduced.name: Ormazd
introduced.how: a former shepherd raised to king by the Jinni's love, once Liloupar's lover
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Ormazd was once the lover of the one called Liloupar. It was by the Jinni's love that he rose from a lowly shepherd to become a king amongst mortals.

introduced.name: Parvezravan
introduced.how: a vain ruler who sought unlimited power and was given machines by Liloupar
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Vain Parvezravan, my dear child... He wanted unlimited power, and so I gave it to him.

introduced.name: Shirin
introduced.how: Parvezravan's queen and elder sister by blood, one of Liloupar's kin
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Kisra Parvezravan, Shirin, they are my blood... It was by schemes of blood, honeyed execution, and raging ambition that I punished them all.

introduced.name: Shiruyeh
introduced.how: the brass-masked king Khorramdin, who led the commoners and slaves to their doom
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Yes, Shiruyeh, brass-masked Khorramdin. The smallfolk and the slaves saw him as an emissary of my mistress, as a savior to them in their misery.

introduced.name: Jinni
introduced.how: spirits bound to a master, who chooses their master rather than being chosen
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Generally speaking, the master doesn't choose the Jinni. Instead, the Jinni chooses their master.

introduced.name: Fall of Gurabad
introduced.how: the city and its people were swallowed into a dark chasm by the earth
introduced.quote: The earth swallowed them whole, and they fell into a dark chasm together with the entire city.

introduced.name: Jinn-driven machines
introduced.how: machines powered by remnants of Jinn spirits that produced artificial goods and harmed laborers
introduced.quote: I designed for him machines driven by the remnants of Jinn spirits

introduced.name: Chess piece
introduced.how: a chess piece that connects to Liloupar's bottle and transports the group to Gurabad
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Please connect me with that chess piece.

assumed.name: Primal Constructs
assumed.quote: (While fighting the primal constructs)

assumed.name: First visit to the valley
assumed.quote: Isn't this the valley we first went to?

assumed.name: The Mistress
assumed.quote: Thanks to your company, I was able to return to my mistress's garden...

assumed.name: Bottle bond and holding the Jinni
assumed.quote: Liloupar: Please... hold me close to your ear once more.

assumed.name: The Brass Mask
assumed.quote: Traveler: You refer to Shiruyeh...

threads.claim: Strange tremors from deep underground hint at something stirring beneath the land, dismissed as a drill.
threads.quote: I feel some strange tremors from deep underground.

threads.claim: The chess-piece device is old and its coordinates unreliable, hinting at a failing ancient mechanism.
threads.quote: Perhaps the device is showing its age...

threads.claim: Gurabad was swallowed by the earth, and its nothingness is hinted at as a lingering loss.
threads.quote: There's nothing left. Nothing at all...

threads.claim: The city and its people fell into a dark chasm together with the earth that swallowed them.
threads.quote: The earth swallowed them whole, and they fell into a dark chasm together with the entire city.

threads.claim: Liloupar treats Gurabad as a fated land she must return to, hinting at a destined end.
threads.quote: Gurabad is, for me, a fated land.

threads.claim: Liloupar expects fate to reunite her with the Traveler, leaving the outcome open.
threads.quote: But I know that fate will arrange for us to meet again.

threads.claim: Liloupar's departure is confirmed as she goes to Gurabad, which awaits her.
threads.quote: Gurabad... It awaits her.

threads.claim: Liloupar once trusted Ormazd, but her affection for him was a mistake she later regrets.
threads.quote: I once believed that he was no mere mortal companion.

threads.claim: Ormazd's vanity and selfishness as a king led him to betray Liloupar's trust.
threads.quote: But the vanity and selfishness that kings are wont to have seized him in the end.

threads.claim: Liloupar sought to punish those she hated with the dark abyss, and believes the punishment will return to her.
threads.quote: I thought I could use the dark abyss to punish that which I hated...

threads.claim: The power of darkness is growing stronger, and only a mother's power is said to be able to face it.
threads.quote: The power of the darkness is growing stronger...

threads.claim: Liloupar's children remain in Gurabad, and Shiruyeh is among those she left behind.
threads.quote: But my children are still there.

threads.claim: Shiruyeh, the brass-masked king, was seen by the commoners and slaves as a savior.
threads.quote: Yes, Shiruyeh, brass-masked Khorramdin.

threads.claim: Shiruyeh led his followers to embrace justice and death, dooming them with the city.
threads.quote: So he led them to embrace justice... To embrace death.

threads.claim: The Jinni chooses their master, and the bond between them is hard to sever.
threads.quote: Generally speaking, the master doesn't choose the Jinni. Instead, the Jinni chooses their master.

threads.claim: Liloupar believes the Traveler has an incorruptible quality, suggesting a reason for her choice.
threads.quote: You possess an incorruptible quality.

threads.claim: Parvezravan forced his queen Shirin to create malformed Jinn, and Liloupar was empowered by her suffering.
threads.quote: to create Jinn, mindless and malformed

threads.claim: Liloupar designed machines powered by Jinn spirits that Parvezravan used to gain wealth.
threads.quote: I designed for him machines driven by the remnants of Jinn spirits

threads.claim: The Jinn-driven machines enriched the rulers while robbing laborers and farmers of their lives and property.
threads.quote: They brought him untold wealth, but they also robbed the laborers of their lives and the farmers of their property.

threads.claim: Liloupar's bottle light fades and she speaks no more, confirming she has left the Traveler.
threads.quote: She's gone...

introduced.name: Genius Invokation TCG
introduced.how: a popular card game invented by an Akademiya scholar
introduced.quote: Paimon: Apparently it's a game that was invented by a scholar in the Akademiya. People from all over are playing it now!

introduced.name: Sucrose
introduced.how: Albedo's assistant who answers alchemy questions and is shy around strangers
introduced.quote: Sucrose: Hi, I'm Sucrose, Albedo's assistant. If you have any alchemy-related queries, you could always ask me.

introduced.name: The Cat's Tail
introduced.how: tavern where the TCG community gathers to play and trade cards
introduced.quote: Timaeus: Yep, that's the place. It's where everyone in the community goes to play when they have time.

introduced.name: Prince
introduced.how: a cat who is a top TCG player and speaks through Shuyun
introduced.quote: Margaret: Hmm... my mistake. So it seems I haven't introduced you yet... This is Prince and Shuyun.

introduced.name: Shuyun
introduced.how: Prince's assistant who translates his meows and mixes drinks at the tavern
introduced.quote: Margaret: Hmm... my mistake. So it seems I haven't introduced you yet... This is Prince and Shuyun.

introduced.name: Crocodile King
introduced.how: an ancient TCG player whose soul was sealed in a Casket of Tomes, from a light novel
introduced.quote: Timaeus: It turns out that the Crocodile King was King Deshret's viceroy, who battled an opponent named the Ibis King.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: ruler whose viceroy was the Crocodile King
introduced.quote: Timaeus: It turns out that the Crocodile King was King Deshret's viceroy, who battled an opponent named the Ibis King.

introduced.name: Ibis King
introduced.how: opponent who tricked the Crocodile King and sealed him away
introduced.quote: Timaeus: It turns out that the Crocodile King was King Deshret's viceroy, who battled an opponent named the Ibis King.

introduced.name: Casket of Tomes
introduced.how: card case for a deck that senses other nearby cases
introduced.quote: Shuyun: Heh, well... actually, all card cases in Genius Invokation TCG are called Caskets of Tomes.

introduced.name: Character Card
introduced.how: a deck needs three; at least two are needed to switch between during play
introduced.quote: Diona: Okay, lemme think... To learn the game, you'll need at least two Character Cards to switch between...

introduced.name: Elemental Dice
introduced.how: dice rolled each Round and spent to perform actions
introduced.quote: Diona: These dice correspond to elemental energy! We'll be spending these dice to perform actions!

introduced.name: Adventure Challenge
introduced.how: single-player mode with a fixed deck, designed for new players
introduced.quote: Diona: What we just played was an Adventure Challenge, designed specially for new players.

introduced.name: Genius Invokation TCG Society
introduced.how: body that officially recognizes TCG players who pass the test
introduced.quote: Shuyun: Sobering words from Prince there... But I'm afraid he's right. To become official players recognized by the Genius Invokation TCG Society, you have to pass the test.

introduced.name: Swan
introduced.how: guard on duty at the Mondstadt entrance who is also an official TCG player
introduced.quote: Swan: If you're ready, let's not drag this out. I'm supposed to be standing guard...

introduced.name: Fischl
introduced.how: self-styled Prinzessin who challenges the Traveler to a duel
introduced.quote: Fischl: Who else but the Prinzessin?

introduced.name: Oz
introduced.how: Fischl's familiar, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, who is summoned in the game
introduced.quote: Fischl: With three Electro Dice, I summon my eternal familiar, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, to my side. Heed my invokation!

introduced.name: Diluc
introduced.how: winery owner whose business collaborates with The Cat's Tail and who has played the game
introduced.quote: Diluc: The Cat's Tail is a player in Mondstadt's alcohol industry. Naturally, you have some collaboration with my winery.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Timaeus: If your package contains anything like that, then maybe you should check with Albedo first and see what he thinks.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Hey, aren't you the legendary Traveler? The one who repelled Stormterror?

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Traveler: That's Kaeya...

assumed.name: Margaret
assumed.quote: Traveler: That's Margaret's place...

assumed.name: Diona
assumed.quote: How about this... Diona!

assumed.name: Guard Captain
assumed.quote: Diona: Gah, I was trying to give the opposite description, but I just ended up giving it away. Sorry, Guard Captain...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Paimon: We didn't know it had made it all the way to Mondstadt. Must be pretty popular, huh?

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh, a package from an Akademiya scholar? Then there could be anything inside.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Sucrose: Yes. I believe it's from a Sumeru scholar who came here to study in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Angel's Share
assumed.quote: Every now and then, I'll sit down and play a game with the customers in Angel's Share.

assumed.name: Barbatos
assumed.quote: Diona: You know where the door is! Don't let the door hit ya where Lord Barbatos split ya!

threads.claim: A strange package from a Sumeru scholar is first feared to be dangerous.
threads.quote: Timaeus: So, Sucrose, the package you mentioned that you received before... It's not dangerous, is it?

threads.claim: The package turns out to hold harmless cards, which are Genius Invokation TCG cards.
threads.quote: Sucrose: There wasn't anything dangerous inside, just a bunch of strange cards.

threads.claim: A customer left Character Cards behind at the tavern and never came back for them.
threads.quote: Diona: Eh, it's already been a few days and he still hasn't come back to claim them. Who knows, maybe he left them here on purpose...

threads.claim: Diluc finds the abandoned Character Card with his image very intriguing and wants an explanation.
threads.quote: Diluc: I was hoping we could play a game... But this issue of someone leaving a Character Card with my image at The Cat's Tail is... very intriguing.

threads.claim: Sucrose has a secret research project that requires materials from The Cat's Tail staff, which is hinted but unexplained.
threads.quote: Margaret: I'm afraid I've already told you before: Fur from The Cat's Tail staff is not for sale, no matter how much Mora you offer.

threads.claim: Prince the cat seems to communicate clearly, raising the question of how this is possible.
threads.quote: Sucrose: Hmm, it seems he really is capable of communicating with the cat. Could this be the result of some modification to the language center of his brain?

threads.claim: A Casket of Tomes may hold the soul of an ancient TCG player.
threads.quote: He opens it, and discovers that the soul of an ancient TCG player called the Crocodile King has been captured inside.

threads.claim: Shuyun explains that Caskets sense each other through a Sumeru mechanism, not trapped souls.
threads.quote: No, the real reason that it can sense other Caskets is because it holds a nifty little mechanism invented by Sumeru scholars...

threads.claim: The origin of Genius Invokation TCG is traced to an Akademiya scholar.
threads.quote: Paimon: Apparently it's a game that was invented by a scholar in the Akademiya. People from all over are playing it now!

threads.claim: Becoming an official TCG player requires winning three duels against different opponents.
threads.quote: Shuyun: Basically, to become an official and recognized TCG player, you have to best three opponents in a duel.

threads.claim: The Traveler wins three duels and becomes an official TCG player, with Sucrose also winning two.
threads.quote: Sucrose: Congratulations! You've won three duels now. That makes you an official TCG player!

introduced.name: Brother Qian
introduced.how: Game-maker who runs the Illumiscreen puzzle and hands out treasure prizes
introduced.quote: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.

introduced.name: Illumiscreen
introduced.how: Lantern-and-screen puzzle where three rotated lanterns cast images that combine into a full picture
introduced.quote: Illumiscreen. What do you say? Come on, it's really simple.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild that commissioned the lanterns and prepared the treasure sites across Liyue
introduced.quote: When you align the images and shine them onto the map, you'll find treasure specially prepared by the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: You may or may not have noticed that those screens have a map of Liyue painted on them.

assumed.name: Lantern Rite
assumed.quote: Alright then, happy Lantern Rite. Have a good one.

assumed.name: Mt. Aocang
assumed.quote: (Upon arriving at the Mt. Aocang location)

assumed.name: Guyun Stone Forest
assumed.quote: (Upon reaching the spot at Guyun Stone Forest)

threads.claim: The Adventurers' Guild secretly set up many treasure sites across Liyue for adventurers to find.
threads.quote: The Guild had a lot of people working at full tilt to set up all the treasure sites.

threads.claim: The Guild offers an extra-special gift to an accomplished adventurer who finds all the treasure.
threads.quote: The Guild has prepared an extra-special gift for you on account of you being such an accomplished adventurer.

introduced.name: Little One
introduced.how: the rescued young Saurian companion who is to be given a name
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ah... Are you alright there, little guy?

introduced.name: Rifthound
introduced.how: floaty ghostly dogs from the Abyss that attack the group
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh no, it looks really weak. Ugh, seriously! Those floaty ghostly dogs are always up to no good... In fact, make that all things floaty!

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: the dragon-like creatures Natlan calls Saurians, including the companion
introduced.quote: Paimon: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Natlan is the "nation of dragons"... So, does that mean that... wait, they call little guys like this 'Saurians' around here, right?

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a nation of dragons where the group has arrived
introduced.quote: Natlan is the "nation of dragons"

introduced.name: Phlogiston Chiselith
introduced.how: an inactive trap rock that releases the creature once infused with Phlogiston
introduced.quote: (The rock shatters to reveal an inactive Phlogiston Chiselith)

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: a major hub in Natlan where people may know about the companion
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Paimon's heard that there's a place called the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, and it's a major hub in Natlan.

introduced.name: Tepetlisaur
introduced.how: the Saurian species the companion belongs to
introduced.quote: ???: Heh... Sorry, but is this little Tepetlisaur your companion?

introduced.name: Manqu
introduced.how: a Saurian Relics Association researcher who studies past tribal customs
introduced.quote: ???: Sorry. All this talk, and I haven't even introduced myself! Manqu's the name.

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association
introduced.how: the organization Manqu works for, studying tribal customs
introduced.quote: I am a researcher for the Saurian Relics Association

introduced.name: Flamelord's Blessing
introduced.how: a red horn mark that grants Saurians great power but endangers them
introduced.quote: Manqu: That is not a mark that an ordinary Saurian would bear. In truth, records indicate this to be the "Flamelord's Blessing".

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: a tribe Manqu suggests should take care of the Saurian
introduced.quote: Manqu: Perhaps, I believe, you should deliver him to the Children of Echoes. They will deal with the matter appropriately.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm that refuses to accept Saurians bearing the blessing mark
introduced.quote: Manqu: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.

introduced.name: Pacal
introduced.how: the chief of the Children of Echoes tribe
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, there's our Relics Association guy. And that over there... Is that the chief of the tribe?

introduced.name: Uchu
introduced.how: Pacal's Saurian companion who fights the Traveler
introduced.quote: Pacal: Let the battle commence! Go get 'em, Uchu!

introduced.name: Reaffirmed Accord of Appellation
introduced.how: an item that lets the player rename the Little One
introduced.quote: You can obtain the item "Reaffirmed Accord of Appellation" from "Lost in the Woods," which will allow you to change "Little One"'s name.

introduced.name: Sage of the Stolen Flame
introduced.how: a legendary first human to use phlogiston who left a token in the ruins
introduced.quote: Manqu: Well, he was the first human to use phlogiston... and who knows what fate came upon such legendary figures?

introduced.name: Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan
introduced.how: the official name of the token proof that Pacal grants
introduced.quote: Manqu: The Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan... the Sage of the Stolen Flame.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: the first Pyro Archon, revived from the flames, who also brought back a token
introduced.quote: Pacal: Yeah, I can never memorize that name, but I do remember that after the Pyro Dragon Sovereign's death, and after the first Pyro Archon was revived from the flames...

assumed.name: Titu
assumed.quote: Pacal: Manqu, look at me. Didn't you hear what Titu said? No one's attempted this feat in almost 500 years.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Traveler: Can you give me a discount on those for Mora?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Manqu: What's going on? Why are there monsters from the Abyss here?

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: Traveler: I suspect that would only go down well at Good Hunter...

assumed.name: Vishap
assumed.quote: Paimon: Come to think of it, Paimon does see some resemblance to vishaps.

assumed.name: Dragon
assumed.quote: Manqu: This is the power of the far more ancient dragons, and Natlan's Saurians can no longer withstand it today.

assumed.name: Ochkanatlan
assumed.quote: Pacal: Still, how long did this Sage live anyway, Manqu? I feel like there are tales of him from the tribal era to that of Ochkanatlan...

assumed.name: Shadow Pin
assumed.quote: Pacal: ...And even around the Shadow Pin.

assumed.name: Ancient Name
assumed.quote: Manqu: He obtained no Ancient Name, but Pacal is not to be taken lightly... so long as he's kept his training up these last few years.

assumed.name: Phlogiston
assumed.quote: Pacal: Hahaha! Unyielding, resolute, yet passionate. Your hearts blaze like fine phlogiston.

assumed.name: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm
assumed.quote: (If Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm was completed)

threads.claim: A message calling the Traveler a 'Chosen of Dragons' hints at a dragon's involvement with them.
threads.quote: Traveler: Ah. "Chosen of... Dragons..." Could that mean...?

threads.claim: The Traveler suddenly enters the body of the Saurian, and the reason remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Why's the big guy so energetic, all of a sudden...? Wait, is that you, ? You're... inside its body?

threads.claim: No one in Natlan is known to turn into a Saurian, making the Traveler's transformation even stranger.
threads.quote: Paimon: Still, , Paimon's never heard of anyone in Natlan who can turn into a Saurian... This is kinda weird.

threads.claim: The Flamelord's Blessing is a dangerous dragon power that Natlan's Saurians can no longer withstand.
threads.quote: Manqu: This is the power of the far more ancient dragons, and Natlan's Saurians can no longer withstand it today.

threads.claim: The Golden Wolflord grows stronger after absorbing power, suggesting the Flamelord's power may have awakened.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa, it looks like just got stronger! Did something awaken, maybe? Like the power of the Flamelord or something...?

threads.claim: The Sage of the Stolen Flame may actually be a dragon rather than a human, which is unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, so that means... that the Sage of the Stolen Flame is actually a dragon? Right?

threads.claim: The mural leaves open which of the Sage and the first Pyro Archon was the dragon.
threads.quote: Paimon: *sigh* But if that was really the case... doesn't that mean that of the Sage of the Stolen Flame and the first Pyro Archon... that one of them was a dragon? But which one of them?

threads.claim: The ancient scrolls' inscriptions about humans and Saurians are shown to be true after the seal opens.
threads.quote: Manqu: It worked. So the ancient scrolls were right...

threads.claim: The Sage and the first Pyro Archon each brought back one token, and both are needed to purge curses at the volcano.
threads.quote: Pacal: The Sage and the Archon each brought back one token from the volcano, and whomsoever obtains both may enter the cleansing fire within the volcano and purge all curses and calamities.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon obtain both tokens, moving closer to curing the Little One at the volcano.
threads.quote: Paimon: Okay, that's both tokens... Now should have the right to get cured at the volcano, right?

threads.claim: Legends say the Sage's body and spirit became phlogiston, leaving his fate and any later successors an open mystery.
threads.quote: Manqu: Some say both his body and spirit turned into phlogiston, becoming one with Natlan's winds, lands, and flowers

threads.claim: The Traveler recognizes a golden seal and freezes at a stone tablet, hinting at a buried memory.
threads.quote: Traveler: A golden seal... Engraved on a white disc...

threads.claim: The Traveler sees something at the mural that is hard to explain, while Paimon sees nothing.
threads.quote: Traveler: What I saw might be kinda hard to explain...

threads.claim: Monsters from the Abyss appear in the ruins without explanation.
threads.quote: Manqu: What's going on? Why are there monsters from the Abyss here?

threads.claim: The Little One's home and family are unknown, leaving its origin an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, do you not know where your home is?

threads.claim: The Sage believed humans could guide Saurians, a hope that humans and Saurians could live as equals.
threads.quote: Manqu: The Sage of the Stolen Flame seemed to have strongly believed that humans could guide and lead Saurians

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: an angel who runs the Witch's Lodge, hides treasure for adventurers, and is known for her grand self-image
introduced.quote: Nicole: Nicole, the Magnificent Massive Mage, propping up the heavens while crouching down to talk? No, thank you! I'm quite happy with my current size.

introduced.name: Witch's Lodge
introduced.how: Nicole's secret lodge, a house of rooms full of puzzles, seals, and treasure
introduced.quote: Nicole: You two — stop by my lodge if you have the time. I'll put the kettle on, and we can have some tea.

introduced.name: Simulanka
introduced.how: a realm where words have magical power, shaping platforms and stairs
introduced.quote: Traveler: In Simulanka, words are magic.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a circle of mages who hold tea-table discussions and whom Nicole considers joining
introduced.quote: Nicole: On that day, I didn't attend in person — mostly because, back then, I still hadn't decided whether I really wanted to join the Hexenzirkel or not.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel's Island in the Sky
introduced.how: the floating tea-table island where the mages meet, reached through a painting
introduced.quote: (They find themselves atop the Hexenzirkel's Island in the Sky)

introduced.name: Anya
introduced.how: a former Hexenzirkel member and writer whose stories inspired Nicole
introduced.quote: Nicole: Well, on the subject of my literary enlightenment, my greatest inspiration of all... is none other than Lady Anya herself.

introduced.name: Mandragora
introduced.how: a stone statue that Nicole animates into a living creature that fights
introduced.quote: Mandragora: Click... Clack...

introduced.name: Forest of Blessings
introduced.how: a Simulanka location reached through a painting of its emblem
introduced.quote: (They find themselves in the Forest of Blessings)

introduced.name: Princess of the Morning Star
introduced.how: a princess who was drawn to forbidden knowledge and defied the gods with a traveler
introduced.quote: Nicole: One day, he traveled to a silver tree to visit the Princess of the Morning Star.

introduced.name: first angel's betrayal
introduced.how: a forbidden romance and defiance of the gods that ended with the gods destroying the lovers' home
introduced.quote: Nicole: They sent down thunder and fury, destroying the lovers' home.

introduced.name: Angels
introduced.how: beings entrusted with loving all living things, who guided humans and were stripped of their wisdom over time
introduced.quote: Nicole: We were entrusted with the mission to love all living beings on this land, but unlike the gods who came after...

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Nicole: It all started the first time the mages challenged the Anemo Archon...

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Just so long as Alice doesn't hear about this, there's no reason for anyone to laugh...

assumed.name: Barbeloth
assumed.quote: Nicole: Hmm... Alice takes three sugars, Anya prefers one, and Barbeloth likes hers without...

assumed.name: Irminsul
assumed.quote: Nicole: Oh, this painting here? You're clearly no strangers to the white trees...

assumed.name: Dodo-King
assumed.quote: Nicole: (Hmm, come to think of it, having a tiny little Mandragora statue play the role of the Dodo-King does seem a little... underwhelming.)

assumed.name: Dodoco
assumed.quote: Nicole: (Steady the candlesticks, brew a steaming pot of tea, and let the Dodocos enjoy this happy gathering in our stead!)

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: I've opened a stall in Fontaine selling sculptures.

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: I'm going to guide you all the way to the Fortress of Meropide!

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: Nicole: However, recently I've resolved to make an effort, even if it's just to spare myself reproaches from a certain old Seelie friend of mine.

assumed.name: Mr. Nine
assumed.quote: (The scene briefly cuts to Mr. Nine)

assumed.name: Rhinedottir
assumed.quote: Nicole: Which brings us to the bet between Barbeloth and Alice, Rhinedottir's forbidden creations, Ivanovna's political machinations...

assumed.name: The Witch's Garden
assumed.quote: (Approach the Witch's Lodge at The Witch's Garden)

threads.claim: Words have literal magical power in Simulanka, which the player can use to create platforms.
threads.quote: Traveler: In Simulanka, words are magic.

threads.claim: Nicole insists the story of the Princess of the Morning Star and the first angel's betrayal is true, hinting at a hidden origin.
threads.quote: Nicole: It sure is, and that's the scariest part.

threads.claim: Angels were created to love all living beings but were given crude emotion and simply obeyed orders, and they lost their wisdom over time.
threads.quote: Nicole: It all started with the birth of the angels...

threads.claim: Guidance was the angels' primary mission, and completing it gave them a joyous relief that explains Nicole's excitement.
threads.quote: Nicole: Upon completing our missions, we gained a certain sense of joyous relief.

threads.claim: Nicole is an angel whose true identity is secret, known only to Alice among the Hexenzirkel.
threads.quote: Nicole: Alice was the only one there who knew my true identity.

threads.claim: Nicole privately agreed to join the Hexenzirkel after a telepathic talk with Alice.
threads.quote: Nicole: So I had a private little word with Alice inside her head — just me and her — and I agreed to join the Hexenzirkel, right there and then.

threads.claim: The Hexenzirkel discusses forbidden creations by Rhinedottir and political schemes by Ivanovna, hinting at hidden conflicts.
threads.quote: Nicole: Which brings us to the bet between Barbeloth and Alice, Rhinedottir's forbidden creations, Ivanovna's political machinations...

threads.claim: Nicole once lived as an angel in a shrine, unlike her current home in the Witch's Garden.
threads.quote: Nicole: Unlike the current Witch's Garden, I stayed in this shrine when I was still an angel.

threads.claim: Nicole addresses the angel statues as sisters and says the humans of today live comfortable lives.
threads.quote: Nicole: (Rest assured, sisters. The humans of today live comfortable lives.)

introduced.name: Fujin
introduced.how: Introduced as the local Adeptus who rules the teapot realm of Chenyu Vale and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: One's name is Fujin, the local Adeptus, and this is the tiny little teapot realm one calls home for now.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: A famous tea land known since ancient times for its cool, fragrant waters
introduced.quote: This land has been famous for its cool, fragrant waters since ancient times.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: The tea village of Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: I presume the two of you have heard of the tea village of Chenyu Vale, Qiaoying Village?

introduced.name: Grandpa Lu
introduced.how: A tea-farming elder of Qiaoying Village who blames the soil and water for the poor tea
introduced.quote: Lu I am surnamed, and all in the village call me Grandpa Lu

introduced.name: Uncle Luo
introduced.how: Village Chief Luo, who trusts machines and techniques over the soil theory
introduced.quote: Village Chief Luo is a good person

introduced.name: Jin
introduced.how: A workshop worker who is scolded by Uncle Luo over the tea processing machine
introduced.quote: Uncle Luo, this batch still isn't any good!

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: The village's biggest tea customers, whose representatives are expected to visit
introduced.quote: They are our biggest customers, after all.

introduced.name: Hautemontagne
introduced.how: A Fontaine Research Institute researcher who maintains the village tea cauldron
introduced.quote: Just call me Hautemontagne. I'm a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute!

introduced.name: Little Mao
introduced.how: A child who is a friend of Mountain and knows the mountains well
introduced.quote: I'm Little Mao, a friend of Mountain's!

introduced.name: Yilong Wharf
introduced.how: A port to the west of Qiaoying Village, smaller than Liyue Harbor, where goods are shipped
introduced.quote: The port to the west, haha... It's much smaller than Liyue Harbor, eh?

introduced.name: Rainjade Rite
introduced.how: An ancient ritual needed to drive out the miasma and restore the water veins and soil
introduced.quote: In the end, we must perform the ancient Rainjade Rite once more, dispelling the miasma that has settled over the mountains and fields and into the rivers

introduced.name: Golden Carp (Fujin's alternate form)
introduced.how: A golden carp that guides the Traveler and turns out to be Fujin in another form
introduced.quote: The carp is revealed to be Fujin, who was guiding them through her alternate form.

introduced.name: Jademouth
introduced.how: A massive jade ring visible in the distance, said to have been thrown by an adeptus
introduced.quote: he points out the massive jade ring in the distance, known as the Jademouth, which was presumably thrown by an adeptus

introduced.name: Bishui River
introduced.how: A river that ran crimson red during a past war
introduced.quote: with so much bloodshed that even the Bishui River turned crimson red.

introduced.name: Ancient war between two factions
introduced.how: A past great war that caused heavy bloodshed in the vale, shown on a mural
introduced.quote: there was a great war between two factions

introduced.name: Bosu
introduced.how: A boatman who explains the history of the Jademouth during the ride
introduced.quote: They then flag down a boatman, Bosu

introduced.name: Lingyuan
introduced.how: Bluey, a Solitary Suanni whose true name is Lingyuan, was disrupting the soil and water
introduced.quote: Bluey, or its true name Lingyuan, was responsible for disrupting the soil and water.

introduced.name: Demons of old and the barren hill
introduced.how: Long ago Qiaoying was a barren hill, and Fujin defeated the demons there and had tea trees planted
introduced.quote: Many, many years ago, Qiaoying Village was nothing but a barren hill.

introduced.name: Bad god's flood attempt
introduced.how: A bad god tried to drown the Millelith by redirecting the river, and the carp and white snake stopped her
introduced.quote: a bad god tried to redirect the river to drown the Millelith

introduced.name: Beasts remember, humans forget
introduced.how: As a beast Fujin remembered the past everything, while humans forgot it
introduced.quote: she reveals that as a beast, she remembered everything, while humans forgot.

introduced.name: Little Mao
introduced.how: local boy from Chenyu Vale who guides the Traveler and Paimon to ancient sites
introduced.quote: Here, over here!

introduced.name: Fujin
introduced.how: Golden Carp adeptus who explains she is an adeptus and can take any form
introduced.quote: One is indeed an adeptus, and as such, can take forms as one pleases.

introduced.name: Votive Rainjade
introduced.how: a jade piece swollen with adeptal energy that can calm rivers and improve weather, but also cause harm
introduced.quote: The Votive Rainjade can calm rivers, improve the weather... But it can also be a thing of death and slaughter.

introduced.name: Rainjade Rite
introduced.how: an ancient ritual of casting jade into the river to pray for good omens and fertile land, now being revived
introduced.quote: Once, the Rainjade Rite was a day of great celebration, where we would commemorate the year of abundance

introduced.name: Jademouth
introduced.how: a huge jade formation in the river that Little Mao says an adeptus threw into the water
introduced.quote: That huge thing is the Jademouth, a legendary "jade ring" that an adeptus threw into the water!

introduced.name: adeptal energy
introduced.how: the power the Traveler uses to move platforms, clear moss and open paths, which comes from Fujin
introduced.quote: My "adeptal energy" comes from Adeptus Fujin.

introduced.name: adeptus
introduced.how: a title that is not inherent to a being and can be given or dropped, like any ordinary word
introduced.quote: The word "adeptus" is just like any other word, such as "hero," "villain," or "idiot"...

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: ancient armored warriors led by the Lord of Geo who fought in the river wars
introduced.quote: And the Millelith, led by none other than the Lord of Geo himself, were even tougher!

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: bandits who guard the northeast shrine and resist the Adeptus, and dig up antiques for Mora
introduced.quote: Aren't you the Treasure Hoarders!?

introduced.name: Bluey
introduced.how: Little Mao's mysterious, wild mountain friend who is afraid of strangers and questions the Traveler
introduced.quote: I usually call her Bluey, because I don't really know her name.

introduced.name: Herblord
introduced.how: a wild, beast-like adeptus who was one of Fujin's old friends and servants of the same god
introduced.quote: The Herblord and I were both servants of another god

introduced.name: Golden Carp
introduced.how: a Golden Carp creature that carries adeptal energy and can carry travelers over hazardous water
introduced.quote: the Golden Carp Fish will get you through safely.

introduced.name: Sacred Simulacra
introduced.how: ritual spirit statues used in ancient times to protect homes, which must be placed correctly for the Rite
introduced.quote: Those were ritual spirits often used by people in ancient times to protect their homes.

introduced.name: Adeptus's Repose
introduced.how: a sanctuary Fujin and Herblord built, with Sacred Simulacra as its staff
introduced.quote: Well... I suppose you could consider this a place that the Herblord and I made?

introduced.name: Bosu
introduced.how: a boatman at Yilong Wharf who ferries the group to Jademouth and tells its legends
introduced.quote: Someone coming aboard? ...Wait, is that Little Mao?

introduced.name: spirit veins
introduced.how: channels through which adeptal energy and power spread across the land
introduced.quote: Much of its power has dissipated into the surrounding area through the spirit veins.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: said by some to have been the first lord of Liyue, who marched through Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: Some people believe that the first lord of all Liyue was Rex Lapis.

introduced.name: Bishui flood
introduced.how: Fujin's lord caused the Bishui River to flood in a desperate gamble against Morax
introduced.quote: she caused the Bishui River to flood, hoping to destroy everything downstream.

introduced.name: ancient river war
introduced.how: a baddie god tried to drown the Millelith by redirecting the river, opposed by a snake and a Carp
introduced.quote: In those days, a baddie god tried to redirect the river to drown the Millelith stationed on both of the banks in Chenyu Vale

introduced.name: Fujin
introduced.how: Golden Carp Adeptus, a former guardian of Chenyu Vale who was sealed in a teapot and is now revealed in fish form
introduced.quote: In truth, you've already found it, as with the previous one. That's how I was able to appear before you.

introduced.name: Lingyuan
introduced.how: Fujin's old friend, a wild beast who controls the spirit veins and causes the storm and miasma; Little Mao calls her Bluey
introduced.quote: The opportunity to speak will come, but it is not now.

introduced.name: Little Mao
introduced.how: a child who roams the mountains and was once rescued by Lingyuan, now befriending Fujin and Lingyuan
introduced.quote: We came across this kid during our adventures.

introduced.name: Votive Rainjade
introduced.how: a jade pendant storing adeptal energy, thrown into the flood to make the earth swallow the rivers
introduced.quote: It was simply the release of the adeptal energies stored within the jade pendant

introduced.name: Rainjade Rite
introduced.how: a ceremony that Fujin performs to restore the land's water and soil, last held thousands of years ago
introduced.quote: It's been thousands of years since we last performed it, and the mountains, rivers, and spirit veins have all changed a great deal.

introduced.name: Carp's Rest
introduced.how: the place where Fujin was trapped for ages, reminiscing about the outside world
introduced.quote: At first, I was trapped at Carp's Rest, and could only reminisce about the outside world through the scent of the tea offerings.

introduced.name: Chiwang Terrace
introduced.how: a sacred area on the mountain that the ritual gate opens into, where Lingyuan has gone
introduced.quote: I will perform a ritual and open up the way to Chiwang Terrace.

introduced.name: spirit veins
introduced.how: channels in the land that converge on the sacred mountain and carry adeptal energy through Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: That is where the spirit veins of Chenyu Vale converge.

introduced.name: miasma
introduced.how: a corruption spreading through the land, caused by Lingyuan disrupting the spirit veins
introduced.quote: Her disruption of the spirit veins has caused the miasma to propagate

introduced.name: Miasmic Simulacra
introduced.how: enemies that appear in sets of four; must be destroyed with adeptal energy to stabilise the spirit veins
introduced.quote: Use our adeptal energy to destroy those Miasmic Simulacra!

introduced.name: Mt. Laixin
introduced.how: the sacred mountain where the spirit veins converge and Lingyuan once ruled as master
introduced.quote: Behold, the sacred mountain.

introduced.name: Herblord
introduced.how: a former ally who defended Chenyu Vale with Fujin and Lingyuan, and who fought against the mistress
introduced.quote: She, Herblord, and I once defended Chenyu Vale together.

introduced.name: tea trees on Mt. Laixin
introduced.how: tea planted by Fujin on Lingyuan's former mountain and given to humanity
introduced.quote: You planted tea on my mountain and gave that land to the humans.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: a village whose tea-leaf and soil problems the Traveler helped solve
introduced.quote: Qiaoying Village will be there to lend you a hand!

introduced.name: Grandpa Lu
introduced.how: an elder of Qiaoying Village who argues with Uncle Luo and cares for Little Mao
introduced.quote: How did it go? Well, I trust? Tell us all about it!

introduced.name: Uncle Luo
introduced.how: a Qiaoying Village elder who greets the Traveler after the ritual and thanks them
introduced.quote: You're back! We were just saying that good rainfall's bound to bring good tidings!

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Should the waters under Yilong Wharf breach the dikes and flood, Liyue Harbor would aid the villagers.

assumed.name: Lord of Geo (Morax)
assumed.quote: The Lord of Geo would not stand idly by as disaster befell.

assumed.name: Conqueror of Demons
assumed.quote: Were the sky to collapse, the Conqueror of Demons and other Adepti would do their utmost to support it.

assumed.name: Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper
assumed.quote: Ooh, they must also be formidable adepti, like Moon Carver or Mountain Shaper!

assumed.name: Guhua Clan
assumed.quote: I am but one who comes to the aid of the oppressed in their moment of need, a disciple of the Guhua...

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: a bad god tried to redirect the river to drown the Millelith

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Careful! There're hilichurls here too!

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: There are Seelie here too!

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: The Archon War?

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Khaenri'ah...

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: Either way, she lacked the power to overcome Morax.

assumed.name: Mt. Xuanlian
assumed.quote: Near Mt. Xuanlian, I believe.

assumed.name: Carp's Rest
assumed.quote: After leaving Carp's Rest, I can only appear in places in which my power remains

assumed.name: Qiaoying Village
assumed.quote: the tea leaves in Qiaoying Village are gonna turn out worse and worse

assumed.name: Grandpa Lu
assumed.quote: Back on the bamboo raft, Grandpa Lu also mentioned that the offerings of tea were to a certain Carp adeptus.

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Yeah, there was that time in Liyue Harbor when we fixed Madame Ping's teapot for her!

assumed.name: Mountain Shaper
assumed.quote: true adepti like Mountain Shaper and the rest

assumed.name: Mt. Lingmeng
assumed.quote: This must be the stuff that happened before the mural on Mt. Lingmeng was made!

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Liyue Harbor is... not what I imagined.

assumed.name: Mistress of Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: Herblord fought against our mistress, while I climbed Mt. Lingmeng

assumed.name: past adventure of the trio
assumed.quote: Hehe, didn't Little Mao tell you how it all ended?

assumed.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
assumed.quote: Oh my, as one would expect of the of the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

assumed.name: Adeptus
assumed.quote: So you met the legendary Carp Adeptus!?

assumed.name: Lantern Rite Festival
assumed.quote: we'd still be tealess come next year's Lantern Rite!

threads.claim: The water, soil, and tea of Chenyu Vale have begun to change for an unexplained reason.
threads.quote: The waters and soil of Chenyu Vale have begun to change recently, as has the scent of its tea...

threads.claim: Fujin confirms the soil and water imbalance is the true cause of the tea decline, while others suspected the cauldron.
threads.quote: Fujin reveals that Lu is correct with the tea problem

threads.claim: Fujin's golden carp form is hinted at but her warning is cut off before she explains it.
threads.quote: Ah, I forgot something important! If you see a golden... Can you hear me...

threads.claim: The golden carp guiding the Traveler is revealed to be Fujin in her alternate form.
threads.quote: The carp is revealed to be Fujin, who was guiding them through her alternate form.

threads.claim: Fujin has unnamed adeptus friends whose whereabouts she evades.
threads.quote: It's just that... those two friends are probably busy taking care of their own affairs right now.

threads.claim: The early history of Chenyu Vale is known to few people today.
threads.quote: Even among locals, few remember.

threads.claim: Fujin remembers the past as a beast, while humans have forgotten it.
threads.quote: she reveals that as a beast, she remembered everything, while humans forgot.

threads.claim: The Rainjade Rite must be performed to repel the miasma, but its method is withheld.
threads.quote: Thus, they must perform the Rainjade Rite to repel the miasma settled across the vale, though she does not tell them how to do it until they reach it before leaving.

threads.claim: Fujin refuses to explain how to perform the ritual yet.
threads.quote: Oh, nothing. As for the ritual, it's still a bit early for that.

threads.claim: Gathering the golden carps restores Fujin's power so she can perform the rite.
threads.quote: The Traveler finds all the carps and brings them to Fujin, allowing her to perform the rite.

threads.claim: The new tea's decline is blamed on the disappearance of a better tea, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Bluey learns of the reason of their visit and claims that the new tea leaves were better before inexplicably disappearing.

threads.claim: Lingyuan is revealed as the one who disrupted the soil and water.
threads.quote: Bluey, or its true name Lingyuan, was responsible for disrupting the soil and water.

threads.claim: The Jademouth jade rings were thrown into the river by a carp to pin it down and prevent flooding.
threads.quote: but a giant white snake and carp disobeyed her orders and the carp threw the jades into the river

threads.claim: A great war between two factions in the past bloodied the region's river.
threads.quote: with so much bloodshed that even the Bishui River turned crimson red.

threads.claim: A friend of Little Mao wants to restore nature and has told her stories about Chenyu Vale's past.
threads.quote: That's right — a friend who's always taking care of me told me! She wants to restore nature too.

threads.claim: Fujin cannot yet answer the Traveler's question about her views on humanity.
threads.quote: she is unable to give an answer, but promises to do so at their next meeting.

threads.claim: Little Mao's mysterious mountain friend Bluey is a nature-aligned being who questions the Traveler's power to suppress nature.
threads.quote: "Bluey": I know. I've seen. Answer me this one thing. Where did you gain the power to suppress nature?

threads.claim: Bluey's idea of restoring nature differs from Fujin's goal of nursing Chenyu Vale's soil and water.
threads.quote: "Bluey": ...Not the same.

threads.claim: Fujin, Herblord and a third wild friend once were close, and Fujin and Herblord defected from their lord, leaving the third bitter.
threads.quote: Later, Herblord and I defected together, and she most likely died too.

threads.claim: Fujin knows little of the Khaenri'ah wars, hinting that a larger conflict lies behind the Archon War.
threads.quote: Sorry, I am merely a minor adeptus of Chenyu Vale. I fear I know little about any wars concerning this "Khaenri'ah."

threads.claim: Fujin lost her original form and her memories of how she died have grown foggy.
threads.quote: My memories of that have grown foggy.

threads.claim: The Rainjade Rite fails because Fujin is too weak, so she needs more power from the Golden Carp.
threads.quote: It seems I am too feeble in my current state.

threads.claim: Fujin sends the group to find Golden Carp to restore her power, and another one lingers near Mt. Xuanlian.
threads.quote: I believe that you will have to go to Yaodie Valley. There will be a cavern there with a Golden Carp hidden within.

threads.claim: The eternal whirlpool described in the folksong appears once the shrines are activated, as the song predicted.
threads.quote: Quick, look! The whirlpool's appeared, just like the song said!

threads.claim: The malicious fog is a sign of environmental disorder caused by the land moving against the flow of time.
threads.quote: Huh, so that miasma-like thing is a manifestation of environmental disorder...?

threads.claim: The Rainjade Rite originated as a ritual of casting jade into the river to pray for good omens after the ancestors lost contact with the heavens.
threads.quote: Henceforth, they began to take jade, which glowed as gently as the light of the moon, and cast it into the river.

threads.claim: The people of Chenyu Vale once talked to the heavens through an emissary, and lost that guide after some change.
threads.quote: The emissary of the gods would lead them and protect them.

threads.claim: A piece of the mural is missing and was taken elsewhere, and its meaning is unclear.
threads.quote: Didn't the gap in the middle of that mural originally have something that went with the Golden Carp mural in it?

threads.claim: Fujin's lord lost a war against Morax and turned to flooding Bishui River in a desperate attempt.
threads.quote: Either way, she lacked the power to overcome Morax.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders are excavating antiques for profit at the Jademouth, causing unrest.
threads.quote: Everyone got really worked up when they heard our comrades excavating and shipping antiques already made big Mora.

threads.claim: Being an adeptus is a title that can be laid down, and Fujin has come to see it as a matter of history.
threads.quote: In any case, my days of being called an adeptus are now consigned to history, just like this place has been.

threads.claim: The Traveler's adeptal energy comes from Fujin, which hints at a connection between the Traveler and the adepti.
threads.quote: My "adeptal energy" comes from Adeptus Fujin.

threads.claim: Lingyuan wants to return the land to its ancient wild state, which sets her against Fujin.
threads.quote: I want to change this land. I want to make it like it was all those millennia ago.

threads.claim: The miasma is traced to Lingyuan's disruption of the spirit veins.
threads.quote: Her disruption of the spirit veins has caused the miasma to propagate

threads.claim: Lingyuan confirms the miasma was a side effect of her spirit vein manipulation.
threads.quote: Correct. Side effects.

threads.claim: Fujin experiences time differently from humans, hinting at her limited lifespan and strength.
threads.quote: After all, your sense of time and mine are not the same.

threads.claim: Fujin spends her accumulated energy to restore the land and can no longer keep her favored form.
threads.quote: I have completely used up the energy I accumulated recently, and I can no longer maintain my favored form.

threads.claim: Lingyuan argues that humans and nature are separate, and that Fujin has forgotten her natural origins.
threads.quote: You have walked with humans for too long. You have forgotten that you, I, and the snake all came from nature.

threads.claim: The Traveler asks how Lingyuan views humanity, and she defers the answer to a later meeting.
threads.quote: No, I need to give this question more thought. Next time we meet, I will give you my answer.

threads.claim: Fujin completes the ritual and opens the gate to Chiwang Terrace.
threads.quote: The ritual is complete. The gate to Chiwang Terrace is now open!

threads.claim: Fujin's soul has returned to her home after she perished alongside humans in an earlier era.
threads.quote: in the end, my soul returned to my home

threads.claim: Lingyuan once saved Little Mao from beasts, which puzzles him about her nature.
threads.quote: If humans and beasts can't be friends, and you're a beast, you shouldn't have helped me!

threads.claim: The tea of the past no longer exists, and Lingyuan remembers Fujin's tea promise.
threads.quote: But that sort of tea no longer exists.

threads.claim: Lingyuan asks whether humans can also turn against their own principles, which parallels her own choices.
threads.quote: Will humans also go against humanity, against the principles they initially followed, for certain reasons?

introduced.name: Ehecatl
introduced.how: A mechanical body that took the name Ehecatl from a list of the fallen and asks the Traveler to follow it
introduced.quote: Well, this body's name is Ehecatl, and you may so call it, but such things as names hold little meaning here...

introduced.name: Tollan
introduced.how: The ruined first Sacred City, now lit up around the Traveler
introduced.quote: No matter. Welcome to the first Sacred City, Tollan.

introduced.name: Heart of the Sacred Mountain
introduced.how: The goal deep inside the volcano, sealed and cut off from its power since the war
introduced.quote: And so, you must reach the Heart of the Sacred Mountain... But alas, the Mountain's power was cut off during the war.

introduced.name: Amaru
introduced.how: A Secret Source Servant that took the name of a fallen lord, later described as arrogant and brainless
introduced.quote: You may simply name it 'Amaru.'

introduced.name: Secret Source Servant
introduced.how: A prototype information-recording machine built to assist Lord Xiuhcoatl
introduced.quote: I am a prototype created to assist Lord Xiuhcoatl with information recording, so I have no name.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: The main energy that powers Source Mechanisms, a condensed form resembling light
introduced.quote: Phlogiston is the main form of energy that powers Source Mechanisms, albeit in a condensed form that closely resembles light.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Unit
introduced.how: A restored data carrier that counts as one unit of energy, and three are needed for the idols
introduced.quote: The data carrier you retrieved counts as a single Phlogiston Unit...

introduced.name: Coagulation Pearl
introduced.how: An item that creates solid platforms in areas rich in Phlogiston
introduced.quote: Take the 'Coagulation Pearl.' In environments with abundant Phlogiston, it can create solid platforms beneath your feet.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: A shadowy corrupting force whose creatures are invading Tollan like a pestilence
introduced.quote: Indeed... Abyssal creatures invade the Sacred City of Tollan like an irremediable pestilence.

introduced.name: Secret Source Dragon Idol
introduced.how: A guardian statue that stands over the Heart and needs a permit and energy to be activated
introduced.quote: and the first Secret Source Dragon Idol stands guard over it.

introduced.name: Chamber of Deliberation
introduced.how: The place where an application for the permit to the Heart is submitted
introduced.quote: Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.

introduced.name: permit to the Heart
introduced.how: A permit that anyone entering the Heart must obtain, granted only after application
introduced.quote: Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a

introduced.name: Xiuhcoatl
introduced.how: A lord who excavated Tollan's center to build a weapon against the Abyss and whose edicts govern entry
introduced.quote: When recreating Tollan's city center, Lord Xiuhcoatl excavated downward in order to create a stable experimental environment...

introduced.name: Astral Assemblage
introduced.how: Giant fireball constructs that must be activated and stabilized to counter corruption, and that are corrupted by the Abyss if left alone
introduced.quote: Nay, they may only trigger mutual annihilation on contact with the Abyss.

introduced.name: Iridescent Inscription
introduced.how: A flame-engraved light that can activate the permit scale
introduced.quote: There it is, the engraving light that can activate the scale.

introduced.name: Dragonborn-human war
introduced.how: A past war that destroyed the city and in which the original master of flame was killed
introduced.quote: the war in which the original master of flame was killed...

introduced.name: Thirteen Lords
introduced.how: A congress of lords and princes who once called for a sacred judgment and later fell in the city's collapse
introduced.quote: The Thirteen Lords and Three Princes, who before could not stop speaking, hastily withdrew their words

assumed.name: Qucusaur
assumed.quote: This... is the statue that Qucusaur had.

assumed.name: Source Mechanisms
assumed.quote: Well, it does look like those Source Mechanisms.

assumed.name: Kimosi and Nzaya
assumed.quote: didn't Ehecatl turn out to be the statue Kimosi and Nzaya were searching for?

assumed.name: Investigator of Ancient Ruins
assumed.quote: (If Investigator of Ancient Ruins has not been completed)

assumed.name: Rifthounds
assumed.quote: Hey, hey, what's with all these Rifthounds?

assumed.name: Oozing Cores
assumed.quote: (While chasing the two runaway Oozing Cores)

assumed.name: Mimifloras
assumed.quote: (Approach the Mimifloras on the way to the next pool)

assumed.name: Spiritway
assumed.quote: We've heard that Spiritways were created by the ancient dragons, but still...

assumed.name: Pulverite
assumed.quote: (Destroy the Pulverite near the pool)

assumed.name: Koholasaurus
assumed.quote: Indwell a Koholasaurus, and dive into the flaming pool

threads.claim: It is left open whether the voice speaking through the Ehecatl body is Ehecatl itself or someone else.
threads.quote: Was that really Ehecatl talking, or was someone else speaking through it?

threads.claim: Ehecatl's existence is said to have dissipated long ago, deepening the mystery of who has been speaking.
threads.quote: I am not. Ehecatl's existence has dissipated in full... not long ago, in fact.

threads.claim: Names and designations are presented as meaningless here, with bodies renamed from lists of the fallen.
threads.quote: Designation changed to one from a list of the fallen

threads.claim: Humans reaching this deep into the city is unprecedented, hinting at a larger mystery about why they are here.

threads.quote: the war in which the original master of flame was killed...

threads.claim: The master of light and flame was only feigning death, and the true king later appeared in the flesh.
threads.quote: the master of all light and flame was simply feigning death, but when the true king

threads.quote: Only then can you truly activate the Celestial Axis in the center...

threads.quote: When the Abyss swallowed the Dark-Winged Lord, and the Celestial Nail reshaped the world and the laws that governed it...

threads.claim: Activating an Astral Assemblage shows the Traveler and Paimon glimpses of past events from its creation.
threads.quote: Did we just see something that happened when this fireball was made?

threads.claim: Entry into the Heart requires a permit obtained by application, which the rest of the story will need to resolve.
threads.quote: Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a

threads.quote: A device made from a single scale, bereft of any information concerning its owner, cannot be converted into a permit.

threads.claim: The Secret Source Dragon Idol's power source has been corrupted and must be reactivated somehow.
threads.quote: But the power source of the Idol has also been corrupted. We must find some way to reactivate it...

threads.claim: The idol is given the permit and a replacement energy source, and it awakens and dives into the hole.
threads.quote: Perhaps we should give it the permit and the replacement

threads.quote: Authority is power, and an obsession with power is what led to the situation you now see.

threads.claim: Astral Assemblages may be corrupted and enveloped by the Abyss unless they are kept stable and used correctly.
threads.quote: Otherwise, they will instead be corrupted and enveloped by the dark...

threads.claim: A Secret Source Servant is said to be the only intelligent one without a master, which leaves its origin unclear.
threads.quote: I am the only intelligent Secret Source Servant without a master.

introduced.name: Daiya
introduced.how: Daiya is revealed to be not a person but the whole system that creates and controls the show
introduced.quote: not a person, but the entire system itself, creator and controller of the show.

introduced.name: Daiya's Three-Day Reverie
introduced.how: an attraction of interactive stage plays where guests act onstage as characters
introduced.quote: Like having guests act onstage in a play.

introduced.name: Zosimos
introduced.how: the passionate Director who founded Daiya's Three-Day Reverie and trained the Hydro Eidolons
introduced.quote: Long story short, Daiya's Three-Day Reverie started with the passionate Director Zosimos.

introduced.name: Hydro Eidolons

introduced.quote: As he spent more time with the Hydro Eidolons, he discovered their intelligence and rich emotions.

introduced.name: Veluriyam Mirage
introduced.how: the region where the Daiya's Three-Day Reverie attraction is located
introduced.quote: just wants to see what kind of mystery attraction is deserving of such a special spot in the Veluriyam Mirage!

introduced.name: Broadcasting Station

introduced.quote: cordially invite them to claim the gift at the Broadcasting Station in the middle of the Thinkers' Theater!

introduced.name: Fake Playwright

introduced.quote: The one called Fake Playwright here collects stories from visitors, and enhances our ideas with those.

introduced.name: Captain Will

introduced.quote: Attention on deck! Captain Will's arrived!

introduced.name: Black Nacre

introduced.quote: Experienced adventurers set foot on the deck of the Black Nacre.

introduced.name: Chief Mate

introduced.quote: I'm the Chief Mate of the Black Nacre! You'll be working with me on this voyage, savvy?

introduced.name: Kraken
introduced.how: a greedy sea monster that demands ever more treasure as tribute from towns
introduced.quote: We all know how greedy the Kraken is. No matter how much treasure we shove down its filthy gob, it'll always ask for seconds!

introduced.name: Cliff Keepers
introduced.how: a tribe of lookouts living on high cliffs who guard against floods and storms
introduced.quote: Over the years, the lookouts on the high cliffs became a unique tribe

introduced.name: Miraculous Architect
introduced.how: a renowned architect hired to save the floating town from falling
introduced.quote: I happen to be a master of cost control.

introduced.name: Warden Elder
introduced.how: the Elder leading the Cliff Keepers and their floating town
introduced.quote: each day our town continues to descend lower in the sky

introduced.quote: We're all gonna get smashed! We're all gonna get smashed to smithereens!

introduced.name: Wraiths

introduced.quote: Please, help me... someone help me! I don't want to abandon my friends...

assumed.name: Idyia

threads.claim: The origin of the name Three-Day Reverie is questioned.
threads.quote: Why is it called

introduced.name: Netochka

introduced.quote: I must retrieve the Proof of the Cognoscenti from them and find Reed Miller's Great Treasure

introduced.quote: all other ill-gotten gains stolen from the Frostmoon Scions, right this instant!

introduced.quote: We're both from Novokitezhgrad, so it's not that strange that we know each other, right?

introduced.quote: When we get back to Nasha Town, I'll introduce you.

introduced.how: Fatui facility where the chest was taken and the fight happens
introduced.quote: So long as you're an accomplice of the thief illegally infiltrating the Experimental Design Bureau, this place will be your grave too.

introduced.name: Stalanov
introduced.how: Police Chief, Netochka's father and Raskolnikov's former teacher
introduced.quote: I never expected Police Chief Stalanov's daughter to end up playing thief in this godforsaken place.

introduced.name: Hidimbi
introduced.how: con artist who gave Netochka fake clues and said she had chosen her
introduced.quote: Back in Nasha Town, Hidimbi gave me some clues on the Proof of the Cognoscenti and said I was special

introduced.name: The Flagship
introduced.how: establishment that keeps a wanted list and where Bakunin drinks
introduced.quote: on The Flagship's wanted list for fraud

introduced.name: Moonstriders
introduced.how: gear that lets the user jump from lightning strikes up to high places
introduced.quote: with the Moonstriders, it should be easy to jump from where the lightning strikes to the top level.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: ruler the Fatui say the Great Treasure belongs to
introduced.quote: it belongs to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.

introduced.how: Zhorik's wife, traveling back to Novokitezhgrad from Nasha Town
introduced.quote: These two are Mr. and Mrs. Shesternin, who are on their way back to Novokitezhgrad from Nasha Town, I believe.
