introduced.how: Danyusha's husband, a collector who survived a past shipwreck and is hostile to the Traveler
introduced.quote: I'm a collector, so of course I'm interested in the Proof of the Cognoscenti, but I won't play along with your childish games.

introduced.name: Papa Wrench
introduced.how: a machinist who lost his memory in an accident and is now dead, famous for his craft
introduced.quote: Although he lost his memory due to an accident, his skill in crafting and maintaining machinery is as remarkable as ever.

introduced.how: a sick child for whom Papa Wrench built machines to cheer her up; she died
introduced.quote: He built all the mechanical devices here for a child called Tinet.

introduced.how: the region where Blue Amber Lake lies and where the Proof is said to be
introduced.quote: The Proof of the Cognoscenti that can lead you to the Great Treasure is at the Blue Amber Lake in Nod-Krai

assumed.quote: (Ride the Moonlane)

assumed.name: Sniffer Mole
assumed.quote: (Interact with either Sniffer Mole hole before interacting with Huginn, optional)

assumed.name: Snezhnograd
assumed.quote: I do believe it's a gift the caravan leader brought from Snezhnograd.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: The Abyss gobbled it all up

assumed.name: Skirk
assumed.quote: Traveler: So that's what's going on. Maybe Skirk knows more...

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: It's like those novels in Nasha Town

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: aliens coming to invade Teyvat

assumed.name: Solovei
assumed.quote: Young Solovei tried to stop it, and Brahe, who impersonated Reed Miller.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: he is also an old acquaintance of the newly appointed priestess of the Frostmoon Scions

assumed.name: Amurta
assumed.quote: besides the Amurta scholars in Sumeru

assumed.name: Great Treasure
assumed.quote: This means we're one step closer to the Great Treasure!

assumed.name: Proof of the Cognoscenti
assumed.quote: P—Proof of the Cognoscenti!? What's that doing in a place like this...

threads.claim: Netochka believes Reed Miller's Great Treasure is real and worth chasing.
threads.quote: so that his name, now forgotten, will be held in esteem once more throughout the world!

threads.claim: The Proof of the Cognoscenti is a prize contested between thieves and the Fatui.
threads.quote: Now we can focus on finding the Proof of the Cognoscenti.

threads.claim: Raskolnikov gives up the Proof and Netochka lets the Traveler keep it.
threads.quote: I'll let you take the Proof this time. You've earned it.

threads.claim: Hidimbi's talk is exposed as a con, and Netochka may not have been her only target.
threads.quote: But now that I think about it, how could I possibly have been the only one? She must have had other motives.

threads.claim: Raskolnikov yields the Proof easily, hinting he may have lost on purpose.
threads.quote: Did you lose to us on purpose?

threads.claim: Raskolnikov suggests the Traveler has deep ties with the Harbingers.
threads.quote: Losing to an opponent who has deep ties with the Harbingers brings no shame upon me.

threads.claim: The Fatui hammers are powered by kuuvahki devices that can be switched off.
threads.quote: It looks like they're powered by kuuvahki...

threads.claim: A strange lightning strike can be used with Moonstriders to reach high places.
threads.quote: Oh! I've heard about this strange lightning before.

threads.claim: Netochka is revealed to be Police Chief Stalanov's daughter, with a past tied to Raskolnikov.
threads.quote: I never expected Police Chief Stalanov's daughter to end up playing thief in this godforsaken place.

threads.claim: Netochka admits she once admired Raskolnikov and wanted to be like him.
threads.quote: I used to admire him too. I wanted to be like him...

threads.claim: Netochka feels she is an insignificant character and longs to be a protagonist.
threads.quote: I just... suddenly realized that, compared to Raskolnikov and all of you, I'm just an insignificant character in the story, like I've always been...

threads.claim: Netochka has seen no fae in Nod-Krai, unlike at home.
threads.quote: But then I ended up in Nod-Krai and haven't even seen a single one of them.

threads.claim: The Great Treasure is said to be hidden east of the moon and west of the sun, and its secret requires the five Proofs.
threads.quote: They say that the key to unlocking its secret lies within the five

threads.claim: Ilmari repeats the rumor that the Great Treasure lies east of the moon and west of the sun, questioning if it is real.
threads.quote: lies east of the moon and west of the sun... Doesn't take much to know this isn't the place to find it.

threads.claim: Many treasure hunters are rushing after the Great Treasure, believing the stories.
threads.quote: Still, a lot of treasure hunters seem to believe the stories. They're all rushing after it like crazy.

threads.claim: Collecting five of the feathers or Proofs is said to uncover the Great Treasure.
threads.quote: A trader I know once said that if you collect five

threads.claim: Papa Wrench is no longer alive, and his death is tied to grief and illness.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, he's no longer with us.

threads.claim: A shipwreck years ago caused Papa Wrench's memory loss and Zhorik's survival is tied to it.
threads.quote: And the very accident that caused his memory loss, that shipwreck from many years ago...

threads.claim: Papa Wrench had a strange look on seeing an obituary about the Shesternins' shipwreck and could not recall the details from ten years ago.
threads.quote: He had a strange look on his face, so I asked him about the matter.

threads.claim: Tolfin sent a messenger to lure Zhorik into the treasure hunt, revealing a hidden scheme.
threads.quote: So, I sent a messenger to tell a story.

threads.claim: One of the five Proofs of the Cognoscenti, a goblet, is in the Fatui's possession.
threads.quote: But as far as I know, that one is in the Fatui's possession.

threads.claim: The Traveler reveals the goblet Proof was in their own backpack all along.
threads.quote: Ooh, and would you look at that? It's right here in my backpack.

threads.claim: Salme has apparently transformed into a monster, a change that no one can explain yet.
threads.quote: She... She's become a monster...

threads.claim: Salomea confessed to locking her twin sister in a cargo crate, a dark act hidden in the diary.
threads.quote: It was Salomea! It was Salomea who locked her sister in that dark prison of a cargo crate!

threads.claim: Salomea claims Salme is the child of a fae who wants to return to their world, and this is not confirmed.
threads.quote: Though, are there not fae that can transform?

threads.claim: Sailors claim one-eyed Kratti fought a sea serpent near the Eye of Kratti.
threads.quote: They swore it was one-eyed Kratti, a monster that could swallow the moon.

threads.claim: Lost souls are said to wander beneath the waves, and Ilmari doubts these stories.
threads.quote: People claim those lost souls still wander nearby, but I say it's all just stories meant to frighten kids.

threads.claim: A former fishing buddy heard strange singing from the Eye of Kratti and never returned.
threads.quote: I used to have a fishing buddy who came out here, too, but he said he kept hearing strange singing.

threads.claim: The strange tree at the Eye of Kratti lights up and releases glowing creatures, showing it is connected to something otherworldly.
threads.quote: The tree just lit up all of a sudden, and these little things... Too bad they're not fish.

threads.claim: Rare shiny things appear occasionally in these waters.
threads.quote: Then there are those little shiny things that appear every now and then, rare as you like, those are.

threads.claim: Spirits of the Atlas crew linger at the Eye of Kratti and insist their ship will not sink.
threads.quote: No, the Atlas won't sink. It doesn't end for us like this...

threads.claim: The Atlas's records describe the ship finding a Proof of the Cognoscenti and a dead Longplume Ibis, hinting at a mysterious fate.
threads.quote: We discovered a Longplume Ibis on the stern deck, dead. This isn't...

threads.claim: Tolfin hides his true intentions and may let Zhorik find the Proof first as part of a plan.
threads.quote: Though if your conscience permits, you can let him find it first before taking it off his hands.

threads.claim: The strange events around the Eye of Kratti may trace back to rocks falling from the sky.
threads.quote: Tracing it back, it all started with those rocks falling from the sky...

threads.claim: The bunker's recordings warn of an impending apocalypse whose nature is left unclear.
threads.quote: Traveler: Nothing scary, just that the apocalypse is coming.

threads.claim: The apocalypse turns out to be an Abyssal monster and contamination rather than a world-ending event.
threads.quote: After all that, there never was an

threads.claim: The bunker's system speaks of monsters beyond the sky's veil, while Paimon suspects they are at the bottom of the sea.
threads.quote: Paimon: Uhm, beyond the sky's veil? Aren't we at the bottom of the sea?

threads.claim: The Traveler states that the bunker's residents are actually at the bottom of the sea, not in a world beyond the sky.
threads.quote: Traveler: The world hasn't been destroyed. You're at the bottom of the sea.

threads.claim: The Ultimate Calamity insists the world was destroyed, while the Traveler disputes this claim.
threads.quote: Traveler: You think the world has been destroyed?

threads.claim: The Traveler claims Rotwang is dead, while the Ultimate Calamity insists he can never die, leaving his fate unresolved.
threads.quote: Traveler: Rotwang is dead, and you're next.

threads.claim: Morozov allegedly deceived the staff so Rotwang's plan could move forward, hinting at a larger scheme.
threads.quote: Everything Morozov said was a lie... From the very beginning, he only meant to have us killed, so Rotwang's plan could move forward...

threads.claim: Brahe quietly escorted the surviving children out of the facility to protect them.
threads.quote: Mr. Brahe Reed Miller has quietly escorted the children who were still alive out of the facility.

threads.claim: Grazina's fate is unknown after the bunker events.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders what happened to her...

threads.claim: The supervisor planned to release monsters into an experimental area to test plant strains, hiding the facility's true purpose.
threads.quote: before eliminating those detestable monsters, I intend to release them into our experimental area to test the purifying effects of your new plant strains

threads.claim: Kuuvahki and the Spireblooms can hold back Abyssal corruption, which the player uses to defeat monsters.
threads.quote: Hmm, looks like these flowers can hold back Abyssal corruption...

threads.claim: The Spireblooms in the Supervisory Office appear to have changed, a hint about the Mandragoras' power.
threads.quote: Do those Spireblooms over there look different to you?

threads.claim: The Ultimate Calamity is asked whether it is the apocalypse, leaving its true identity open.
threads.quote: Traveler: Are you the

threads.claim: Reed Miller's note suggests the Proof of the Cognoscenti leads toward the Great Treasure.
threads.quote: This means we're one step closer to the Great Treasure!

threads.claim: Brahe's identity is contested, as he is shown to be impersonating Reed Miller.
threads.quote: Brahe' and 'Reed Miller' are not meant to be used together

introduced.name: Eboshi
introduced.how: introduces herself as Erebos/Eboshi, a Sangonomiya auxiliary and shrine maiden of Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: My name is Erebos. In the Inazuman tongue, that would be Eboshi.

introduced.name: Daimon
introduced.how: Jibashiri member who guards the Kunado trial and acknowledges the Traveler
introduced.quote: I am Daimon of the Jibashiri. I know not how you entered this place, but please leave.

introduced.name: Uda
introduced.how: Jibashiri member in charge of the wisdom trial
introduced.quote: I am Uda of the Jibashiri. Unrelated people may not enter.

introduced.name: Eki
introduced.how: Jibashiri member in charge of the insight trial
introduced.quote: I am Eki of the Jibashiri. Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.

introduced.name: Jibashiri
introduced.how: trial guardians who represent Watatsumi's will and recognize worthy challengers
introduced.quote: Ah, you have been recognized by all the Jibashiri. They represent the will of Watatsumi, and so have you obtained the right to learn everything.

introduced.name: Sinshades
introduced.how: a phenomenon that keeps the past, history and truth of Enkanomiya from fading
introduced.quote: Due to the phenomenon known as Sinshades

introduced.name: The Emanant Skylight
introduced.how: a sealed structure reached by teleporter; three light pillars at night point to it
introduced.quote: At night, you can see three pillars of light that descend from the dome above. These pillars point unto The Emanant Skylight.

introduced.name: Flames of the High Gate
introduced.how: flames the Traveler must release or return by clearing each trial
introduced.quote: Simply defeat all the opponents here and release the Flames of the High Gate, and you shall be allowed passage.

introduced.name: Enkanomiya
introduced.how: a depths region with a natural cave system leading to Watatsumi Island
introduced.quote: The depths of Enkanomiya play host to a natural cave system that leads to Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Omikami
introduced.how: a deity who fell into Enkanomiya beyond heaven's jurisdiction and aided its people
introduced.quote: Watatsumi Omikami, due to ill-fortune, fell into this place, beyond the jurisdiction of the heavenly order.

introduced.name: Bathysmal Vishaps
introduced.how: intelligent primordial elemental beings living deep underwater who have long fought the people
introduced.quote: They are primordial elemental beings, unbent and unbowed by the power that came from the heavens owing to their living deep underwater.

introduced.name: Holy Soil
introduced.how: the expansion of the Vishaps' habitat, raising the primordial elemental power of the three realms
introduced.quote: The Holy Soil phenomenon is, in fact, the expansion of their habitat.

introduced.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: a powerful device built by Abrax that brings light to the dark depths
introduced.quote: The Dainichi Mikoshi was constructed by the Sage Abrax. It has the power to bring light to the dark depths.

introduced.name: Abrax
introduced.how: the Sage who constructed the Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.quote: The Dainichi Mikoshi was constructed by the Sage Abrax.

introduced.name: Bloodbranch Coral
introduced.how: the coral obtained by the Traveler, now believed to be in Watatsumi's hands
introduced.quote: That I have appeared before you must mean that the Bloodbranch Coral is in Watatsumi's hands.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: a land that once existed before falling into the deep sea, home of the people of Byakuyakoku
introduced.quote: Before Byakuyakoku fell into the deep sea, the whole world had a single unified culture.

introduced.name: The Three Great Martial Trials
introduced.how: three trial subareas rise from the fog after the Traveler accepts Eboshi's challenge
introduced.quote: The three trial areas have been prepared.

assumed.name: Tsuyuko
assumed.quote: After handing over the Bloodbranch Coral to Tsuyuko

assumed.name: Sangonomiya
assumed.quote: Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.

assumed.name: Narukami
assumed.quote: At Omikami's instruction, we learned the culture of Narukami, and we established foreign relations with many different nations.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: Only thus could the people of Byakuyakoku be allowed to live under the rule of The Seven.

assumed.name: Sunfire Phantasms
assumed.quote: It should be said that all these foes are illusions, born from the Sunfire Phantasms and the great enemies you know of in your heart.

assumed.name: Divine Priestess
assumed.quote: To be honest, these words are praises that the Divine Priestess used to bestow upon skilled youths.

assumed.name: Tower of the Three Realms
assumed.quote: I will await your completion of the challenge at the Tower of the Three Realms above.

threads.claim: Sinshades make the past, history and truth of Enkanomiya endure even when left alone.
threads.quote: Due to the phenomenon known as Sinshades

threads.claim: Lady Sangonomiya favored forgetting the past, and great effort was spent on forgetting rather than remembering.
threads.quote: As such, great effort was expended, not that we might remember, but that we might

threads.claim: The trial for the branch was designed to limit how many outsiders could learn the whole truth.
threads.quote: The trial to obtain the branch was intended to limit the number of people coming after us who could know the whole truth of the matter.

threads.claim: Enkanomiya holds secrets that are revealed only after the trials are completed.
threads.quote: Only when you have completed the trials can I tell you all of our secrets.

threads.claim: Eboshi and Lady Sangonomiya disagreed about remembering the truth, and Watatsumi mediated.
threads.quote: Lady Sangonomiya and I had a disagreement, which resulted in the current arrangement, following Watatsumi Omikami's mediation.

threads.claim: Eboshi is also called Erebos, a name that hints at a deeper identity.
threads.quote: My name is Erebos. In the Inazuman tongue, that would be Eboshi.

threads.claim: The Emanant Skylight must be unsealed to reach the trial site, through riddle-like clues.
threads.quote: Release the seal on The Emanant Skylight.

threads.claim: The Bathysmal Vishaps have a long war history with the people and may have evolved into new forms.
threads.quote: They would even evolve into different elemental forms throughout the history of their war against us.

threads.claim: Holy Soil is explained as the Vishaps' expanding habitat, which raises the three realms' elemental power.
threads.quote: The Holy Soil phenomenon is, in fact, the expansion of their habitat.

threads.claim: Watatsumi Omikami was forced by heaven to sacrifice itself after learning a truth from its contact with the people.
threads.quote: Thus, it was forced by heaven to sacrifice itself.

threads.claim: The people searched for a way back up from the depths and found no road of return.
threads.quote: We searched and searched for a road of return, but there was none to be found.

threads.claim: Heaven's prohibitions weakened over time, which let Watatsumi Omikami fall into Enkanomiya.
threads.quote: Much, much later, heaven's powers of prohibition would gradually weaken.

threads.claim: A great war capsized the heavens and sank Byakuyakoku into the deep ocean, after a unified world culture.
threads.quote: Later, a great war broke out, in which the heavens capsized and the earth was ripped asunder.

threads.claim: The Dainichi Mikoshi has more functions beyond lighting the depths, left unspecified.
threads.quote: It has quite a few other functions, to boot.

introduced.name: Furuta
introduced.how: a loyal housekeeper at the Kamisato Estate who gossips about Xavier and worries over Koharu
introduced.quote: Whatever answer you have in mind, all you need to know is that we're absolutely loyal to the Yashiro Commission and the Kamisato Clan.

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: a Fontaine-born engineer turned filmmaker who is making a new film and wants the Traveler as lead
introduced.quote: My dearest, most adored good friend, you're closer to me than a sibling, so I'll tell you something about me: I'm an engineer.

introduced.name: Koharu
introduced.how: a trained servant of the Kamisato Clan who is hot-tempered and acts in Xavier's film
introduced.quote: She's always strictly obeyed the commands of the master and lady and would never deliberately disobey an order, but that child lacks training and composure.

introduced.name: Sasano
introduced.how: a hired actor in Xavier's film who was paid only a meal and quits after the bad shoots
introduced.quote: I was called in to participate in the shooting before, though I was only paid the price of a meal.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: the commission for humanities and arts that Xavier asked for help and that oversees the film
introduced.quote: But he wanted to stick with it, so he came to us, the commission in charge of the humanities and arts, for help.

introduced.name: Kamisato Clan
introduced.how: a clan whose household servants Koharu and Furuta are, serving the master and lady
introduced.quote: Isn't Koharu a servant of the Kamisato Clan?

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the body that funded Xavier's earlier film and was unsatisfied with the result
introduced.quote: It sounded like he had received funds from the Tenryou Commission and finally managed to make a film, but the commission wasn't satisfied with the result.

introduced.name: Okazaki Rikuto
introduced.how: the proprietor of Uyuu Restaurant who tells a story and advises Xavier on his script
introduced.quote: Have you heard about the legend of Seishimaru? I heard about it only a while ago from the owner of Uyuu Restaurant.

introduced.name: Uyuu Restaurant
introduced.how: a restaurant in Inazuma where Xavier drinks and gets script advice
introduced.quote: I left my friend in the restaurant after completely forgetting about them!

introduced.name: Komore Teahouse
introduced.how: a teahouse with a private room where the new script is read and the first scene is shot
introduced.quote: As for the set, I've decided to shoot the first scene in the Komore Teahouse.

introduced.name: Nazuchi Beach
introduced.how: a beach location where the film's next scene is shot with extras
introduced.quote: Xavier, finally satisfied with the scene moves onto filming the next one at Nazuchi Beach.

introduced.name: Kayabuki Ikkei
introduced.how: an author whose submissions were always rejected by Yae Publishing House and who self-published unsold novels
introduced.quote: Hold on, I only know one Kayabuki Ikkei, and everything he submitted to the Yae Publishing House always got rejected.

introduced.name: Seishimaru legend
introduced.how: a tale of a samurai who seeks revenge on the Wakayama family and then vanishes
introduced.quote: Seishimaru was born to samurai parents who worked for powerful people.

introduced.name: Yano Machiko
introduced.how: a tea seller who is saved by Seishimaru and joins him
introduced.quote: M—My apologies, good samurai, I—I'm just a tea seller, and my name is Machiko.

introduced.name: Wakayama Keisuke
introduced.how: the head of the Wakayama Clan and former friend of Seishimaru who refuses to seek revenge
introduced.quote: Now, I've been the head of the Wakayama Clan since my father passed away.

introduced.name: Kurotani Seishimaru
introduced.how: an adopted samurai seeking vengeance for his parents' execution
introduced.quote: I was adopted anyway. The family name means nothing to me.

introduced.name: Wakayama Kojuurou
introduced.how: Keisuke's younger brother who vows to take revenge on Seishimaru
introduced.quote: Then I, his younger brother, Wakayama Kojuurou, am willing to take his place.

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayato
assumed.quote: The lead role hasn't been decided yet, but thanks to Lord Kamisato's generosity, the funds, props, and nearly all the other early-stage problems have already been taken care of.

assumed.name: Thoma
assumed.quote: So, Mr. Thoma has asked the owner of the teahouse for a favor and fortunately, we can borrow a private room there.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Fatui who dumped a bunch of work on me and those non-communicative samurai don't count.

assumed.name: Villain Nobushi
assumed.quote: Hehe, back in the day, I would track thieves practically day and night, clean up Villain Nobushi, things like that.

threads.claim: The Seishimaru legend's ending is left vague, with his fate after vanishing unknown.
threads.quote: Whichever ending you wish to believe, no one ever saw Seishimaru again.

threads.claim: The feud between the Kurotani and Wakayama families carries on through the younger Wakayama brother's vow of revenge.
threads.quote: Then I, his younger brother, Wakayama Kojuurou, am willing to take his place.

threads.claim: Koharu's lack of training and composure may lead her to lose control again.
threads.quote: Koharu can be quite stubborn. If she really does fail to control herself...

threads.claim: Koharu returns after her outburst, committed to film acting as training and ready to risk her life for it.
threads.quote: Please rest assured that I will treat film acting as an important form of training, and I am ready to risk my life for it.

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commission silently disapproved of Xavier's earlier film, a rejection he refuses to accept.
threads.quote: They didn't come right out and say it, but they were totally silent, which means they didn't approve.

threads.claim: Other inventors in Fontaine have built similar film machines and are disputing the patent.
threads.quote: I've heard that some of my colleagues have also come up with machines with functions similar to the Film Kamera.

threads.claim: Xavier believes the Traveler made an earlier agreement with him that the Traveler may not remember.
threads.quote: If you don't mind, could I ask if you maybe, possibly, at all remember our agreement from before?

threads.claim: Xavier's claim that Kayabuki Ikkei is a renowned author conflicts with Sasano's account of his rejected, unsold novels.
threads.quote: Hold on, I only know one Kayabuki Ikkei, and everything he submitted to the Yae Publishing House always got rejected.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: the Institute's former status as the Court's technology center and its destruction in an explosion
introduced.quote: Before the... explosion, it was the technological center of the entire Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: introduces herself as the Adventurers' Guild receptionist who handles the Institute commission
introduced.quote: As the receptionist of the Adventurers' Guild, I know what you're capable of.

introduced.name: Desnos
introduced.how: self-introduction as a former Institute assistant researcher now doing preliminary reviews
introduced.quote: Oh, sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Desnos, a member of the Fontaine Research Institute, an assistant researcher... Or so I used to be.

introduced.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
introduced.how: the researcher whose Arkhium field generator project caused the Institute's destruction
introduced.quote: Mr. Edwin Eastinghouse was once within, trying to develop a field generator using Arkhium.

introduced.name: Nacker
introduced.how: a senior researcher who once worked under Edwin and now escorts adventurers
introduced.quote: Mr. Nacker's a senior researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute who once even did research under Edwin, so he's got some sway in the institute.

introduced.name: Chronie
introduced.how: self-introduction as a political affairs journalist for The Steambird
introduced.quote: I'm Chronie, a journalist for the political affairs section of The Steambird.

introduced.name: Choiseul
introduced.how: explained as one of the two leaders who now hold the Director's responsibilities
introduced.quote: And today, the heavy responsibilities that belong to the post of Director, including a lifelong stipend and private dwelling, must be borne by the likes of Choiseul and Raimondo.

introduced.name: Raimondo
introduced.how: explained as a project leader whose team was moved to the preliminary review site
introduced.quote: This is where Mr. Raimondo's project team was originally located, a place far enough from the center of the explosion to not be greatly impacted by it.

introduced.name: Arkhium
introduced.how: an energy-bearing ore that turns inert once removed from its catalytic environment
introduced.quote: After leaving its catalytic environment, Arkhium immediately returns to an inert state.

introduced.name: Survey Anchor
introduced.how: a device that monitors Arkhium energy flow and must be retrieved with proper tools
introduced.quote: retrieve a Survey Anchor, which we can use to monitor the strength of the energy flows...

introduced.name: Experimental Field Generator
introduced.how: Edwin's device that can deactivate the gravity-altering field around the ruins
introduced.quote: That's the Experimental Field Generator that Mr. Edwin developed.

introduced.name: Central Laboratory
introduced.how: the floating Institute building at the heart of the explosion, now in ruins
introduced.quote: What you're seeing now is the Central Laboratory of the Fontaine Research Institute... Or should I say, what was once the Central Laboratory.

introduced.name: Academic Assembly Hall
introduced.how: the Institute venue for showcasing its research products to the public
introduced.quote: That is the Fontaine Research Institute's Academic Assembly Hall, and is dedicated to the purpose of displaying the fruits of our research.

introduced.name: Executive Office
introduced.how: the Institute office where administrative documents are kept and filed
introduced.quote: According to the schedule, there's a document we need to get at the institute's Executive Office.

introduced.name: Mary-Ann Memorial Park
introduced.how: a damaged park near the Institute where recoverable papers were searched for
introduced.quote: This is the Mary-Ann Memorial Park.

introduced.name: Tri-State Arkhium
introduced.how: a new, stable inert variant of Arkhium used to power the generator
introduced.quote: the energy source we're using is the completely new and stable Tri-State Arkhium.

introduced.name: Allogravity-Condensed Water Body
introduced.how: a water patch that lets people ascend the ruins safely, described as anti-gravity diving
introduced.quote: we can ascend the ruins of the Institute safely and efficiently.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin Research Institute
introduced.how: the former site of the Institute now used for the final review
introduced.quote: The location of your final review is the former location of the Alain Guillotin Research Institute, and now the current residence of the Institute.

introduced.name: Maison Gestion
introduced.how: an authority whose stamps are required on review documents
introduced.quote: Some of them even require stamps from the Maison Gestion.

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: a newspaper whose journalists are blamed for leaking Institute news
introduced.quote: Ugh, must've been some journalists from The Steambird with nothing better to do...

introduced.name: Institute explosion
introduced.how: the Institute blew up after Edwin's mistake, leaving most of it destroyed
introduced.quote: Paimon remembers! Someone named Edwin made a mistake, and there was an explosion at the Fontaine Research Institute, right?

introduced.name: Fonta
introduced.how: a legally profitable Institute research product tied to Fontainian identity
introduced.quote: Fonta may be the only scientific achievement that remains legally profitable.

introduced.name: Clockwork meka
introduced.how: Institute-built mechanical monsters that were used for monitoring and are now out of control
introduced.quote: These were probably the clockwork meka that the Institute used before to monitor energy flow, as they're equipped with Arkhium energy flow monitoring devices.

introduced.name: Artificed Dancers
introduced.how: combat-capable Institute research products shown at the Assembly Hall
introduced.quote: Such as the combat-capable Artificed Dancers, the gramophone, and Turbine-Powered Glider, among others.

introduced.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
introduced.how: a brilliant Institute scientist, Nacker's and Raimondo's former boss, who built the Generator
introduced.quote: Raimondo: He was a genius in the field of scientific research. It's no exaggeration to say that his talent was only second to our first director, Alain Guillotin.

introduced.name: Experimental Field Generator
introduced.how: a machine that rapidly changes gravity in the area around it
introduced.quote: Nacker: Once the Experimental Field Generator is activated, it will rapidly change the gravity in the surrounding area.

introduced.name: Arkhium
introduced.how: an ore that becomes unstable and explosive when its energy is disrupted
introduced.quote: Raimondo: The suppression system shut down, and the ore is presently in an excited state. That is what caused the explosion.

introduced.name: Arkhium Kinetic Core
introduced.how: the Institute's most advanced device, a joint Raimondo-Edwin invention that powers the Generator
introduced.quote: Raimondo: This Arkhium Kinetic Core is the most cutting-edge technology created by the Fontaine Research Institute to date.

introduced.name: Pneumousia Cores
introduced.how: backup energy cores inside the Generator, used to power the inhibitor
introduced.quote: Raimondo: I'm about to remove the two backup Pneumousia Cores in the Experimental Field Generator and use them to supply energy to the inhibitor.

introduced.name: Gravity Fields
introduced.how: the Generator's gravity fields hold Arkhium fragments gathered beneath the ruins
introduced.quote: Raimondo: With the use of Gravity Fields... they were all restrained and gathered... beneath our feet.

introduced.name: Controllable hazard removal directional blast
introduced.how: the earlier small blasts were a planned way to clear Arkhium fragments
introduced.quote: Raimondo: It basically means to use small, controlled blasts to quickly remove Arkhium fragments.

introduced.name: Institute of Clockwork Applications
introduced.how: a former clockwork research facility, originally run by Butor and now abandoned
introduced.quote: Nacker: I believe this place was originally Butor's "Institute of Clockwork Applications."

introduced.name: Survey Anchor
introduced.how: a device adventurers retrieve as part of the Institute's qualification review
introduced.quote: Nacker: Of course, and there were quite a few. This Survey Anchor retrieval test is part of the qualification review.

introduced.name: Choiseul
introduced.how: an Institute official in charge of funds, visitors and administrative affairs
introduced.quote: Choiseul: Raimondo is responsible for getting scientific work and research back on track, and I'm responsible for everything apart from that.

introduced.name: Raimondo
introduced.how: a Senior Technician who takes responsibility for the Institute's operation
introduced.quote: Raimondo: I am a Senior Technician of the Fontaine Research Institute, and the responsibility for this matter falls squarely on me, and me alone.

introduced.name: Honorary Senior Researcher
introduced.how: a rare Institute honorary title given to the Traveler
introduced.quote: Raimondo: Honorary titles must remain limited in quantity and stay relatively rare. Otherwise, how would we get sponsors and support through awarding them?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Traveler: Did someone not pass the Guild review?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is a Mondstadt flying license acceptable?

assumed.name: Adventure Handbook
assumed.quote: The list includes your current and previous Adventure Handbooks, your commissions from the last eighty days, and more.

assumed.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon remembers! Someone named Edwin made a mistake, and there was an explosion at the Fontaine Research Institute, right?

assumed.name: Dendro Slime
assumed.quote: Traveler: A Dendro Slime on fire.

assumed.name: Wind glider
assumed.quote: glide in from the highest mountain using a wind glider.

assumed.name: Nacker
assumed.quote: Nacker: No one in the Institute can control this big guy as freely as I can... Not even Raimondo.

assumed.name: Chronie
assumed.quote: Chronie: I was born to do this. It's the reason I exist.

assumed.name: The Steambird
assumed.quote: Chronie: Your words, deeds, and all the facts concealed by the Institute will be reported on in the next issue of The Steambird. Good day, gentlemen.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: Choiseul: Ms. Chronie, everything we do is in the best interests of the people of the Court of Fontaine.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Choiseul: As for the former site of the Institute, we will keep it preserved forever and rebuild it as the Fontaine Research Institute Safety Education Center.

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Chronie: Weren't you guys going to take a photo together? I just so happen to have a Kamera with me.

assumed.name: Arkhium Inhibitor
assumed.quote: Raimondo: We really can't catch a break here. Not only did the explosion break off the condensing components of the device, but it also destroyed the self-sustaining system of the inhibitor.

assumed.name: Central Laboratory explosion history
assumed.quote: Chisseray: Punched Tape? Now? The Central Laboratory blew up again!

threads.claim: The Institute explosion is blamed on Edwin's mistake, leaving its true cause open to question.
threads.quote: Paimon remembers! Someone named Edwin made a mistake, and there was an explosion at the Fontaine Research Institute, right?

threads.claim: Edwin's failed experiment left most of the Institute in ashes and cost him the chance to become Director.
threads.quote: Of course, had Mr. Edwin not left two-thirds of the Fontaine Research Institute in ashes, he would've been a shoo-in for the post of the next Director.

threads.claim: The explosion is attributed to the Arkhium ore powering the core driver rather than the generator itself.
threads.quote: The thing that exploded wasn't this machine but the Arkhium ore that powers its core driver, the Arkhium Kinetic Core.

threads.claim: Chronie doubts that Arkhium is harmless and asks whether the uncontrolled ore radiates or contaminates its surroundings.
threads.quote: Will the uncontrolled Arkhium radiate energy? Will it contaminate the surrounding environment?

threads.claim: Chalmet's warning that exposed Survey Anchors leave Arkhium traces contradicts Nacker's assurance that the energy is harmless.
threads.quote: Exposed Survey Anchors radiate with Arkhium energy traces, and the place we are in now has also been affected somewhat.

threads.claim: The Institute introduces Tri-State Arkhium as a stable new variant, but Chronie suspects it is only a rhetorical rename.
threads.quote: How does that differ from normal Arkhium? Does the new word in front of it mean anything?

threads.claim: Chronie suspects the Institute is hiding something and plans to confront Choiseul with evidence.
threads.quote: I have to question Choiseul with evidence in hand. That way, he won't be able to beat around the bush like last time.

threads.claim: Research materials are being sold off illegally from the Institute, and the involved party is left unnamed.
threads.quote: the ongoing criminal activity of selling off research materials from within the Institute?

threads.claim: Survey Anchors keep being stolen, so the Institute locked them up and claims they are dangerous to take.
threads.quote: However, the Anchors continue to be stolen, and thus we've had no choice but to lock them up in a room

threads.claim: The Traveler shows an unusually strong innate tolerance for Arkhium energy flow, which may matter for the review.
threads.quote: you clearly have an extremely strong innate tolerance of the energy flow

threads.claim: Clockwork meka are attacking people in the wilds around the Institute, and their designer is unknown.
threads.quote: Desnos: Darn it... Who in the world designed these meka here?

threads.claim: The out-of-control meka are drawn to Arkhium energy flow, which explains why they converge on the Anchors.
threads.quote: Although they're now out of control, they still automatically converged here upon detecting the energy flow from Arkhium...

threads.claim: Raimondo plans to use the Experimental Field Generator to safely land the Central Laboratory ruins, which Chronie links to Edwin's Arkhium project.
threads.quote: But wasn't this device also within said ruins? And wasn't it also a work of Edwin Eastinghouse that used... Arkhium as its energy source...?

threads.claim: The Institute's back areas hide classified secrets, which Nacker refuses to explain.
threads.quote: Some areas in the back contain Insitute secrets, and you're not allowed to have any exposure to them.

threads.claim: The explosion at the Central Laboratory ruins is publicly dismissed by Choiseul, leaving its real cause unexplained.
threads.quote: Choiseul: I... don't believe that was an explosion. All things considered, uh... it was probably a controllable...

threads.claim: Raimondo explains that the blast was a small Arkhium fragment resonance triggered by energy flow.
threads.quote: Raimondo: That explosion just before was a small one caused by a small part of Arkhium in the ruins that was affected by energy flow.

threads.claim: Nacker's location and survival are unknown after the explosion.
threads.quote: Paimon: If he's not here, where could he have gone?

threads.claim: Raimondo doubts Nacker is dead and openly suspects him of causing the blast.
threads.quote: Raimondo: I do, in fact, hope that both he and that Arkhium Kinetic Core were obliterated in that explosion.

threads.claim: Raimondo's hypothesis is that Nacker stole the Arkhium Kinetic Core and triggered the blast to cover his theft.
threads.quote: Raimondo: What I can tell you now, based on my hypothesis, is that... Mr. Nacker stole the Arkhium Kinetic Core and triggered this small explosion.

threads.claim: Chronie suspects the Institute is hiding that the ruins could explode again at any time.
threads.quote: Chronie: Of course, I know that what the Institute really wants to hide — the fact that the Central Laboratory ruins can explode again at any time.

threads.claim: The Arkhium is only stabilized for now, so the danger it poses is not fully resolved.
threads.quote: Raimondo: Finally, it's stabilized. The Arkhium has transformed into an inert state... We and the Fontaine Research Institute are safe, for now.

threads.claim: Raimondo and Edwin disagreed on how fast to pursue the Arkhium core, and their conflict shaped what followed.
threads.quote: Raimondo: But then Edwin and I had a disagreement. I offered a up a more conversative proposal, but he wanted... to solve the problem rather more quickly.

threads.claim: Raimondo admits he is a suspect in the theft but argues Nacker is more likely guilty.
threads.quote: Raimondo: Even if I am listed alongside him as a suspect... his chances of being convicted are certainly greater than mine.

threads.claim: Choiseul promises a Code of Conduct to regulate funds and research ethics, a rule set not yet shown.
threads.quote: Choiseul: It will include principles on the use of funds, research asset management methods... and ethical standards that should be observed in scientific research and work.

threads.claim: Nacker argues that researchers should not sleep because it breaks their thinking, a view Chronie rejects.
threads.quote: Nacker: Sleeping completely cuts your train of thought short, and that's just not acceptable for our research work.

threads.claim: Butor's clockwork program was marginalized and disbanded after bad luck, hinting at Institute politics.
threads.quote: Nacker: Anyway, Monsieur Butor's program was slowly being marginalized at the Institute. His funding was cut, and he struggled to recruit researchers.

introduced.name: Escoffier
introduced.how: A Fontainian chef who breaks down the technique behind a dish in a single bite and is known for helping friends
introduced.quote: Escoffier: Miss Xiangling, tasting an opponent's dish and offering critique is a necessary part of culinary exchange, isn't it? That was my reason for stepping in.

introduced.name: Savanna
introduced.how: Head chef of Hotel Debord from Fontaine, under heavy work stress, who came to Liyue for a break
introduced.quote: Xiangling: You know her? I heard she's the head chef at Hotel Debord. She's been under a lot of work stress lately, so Escoffier brought her here to take a breather.

introduced.name: Stone Harbor Delicacies
introduced.how: A basic Liyue dish that every Liyue chef is expected to know well
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: (Impressive... Stone Harbor Delicacies is just a basic dish, sure, but she dissected the whole technique in a single bite!)

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild
introduced.how: A confectionery guild in Chenyu Vale that helps organize the Moonchase festivities
introduced.quote: Guild Member: This is the president of the Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild.

introduced.name: Guildmaster
introduced.how: President of the Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild and a main organizer of the Moonchase Festival who demands a Five-Nut cake contest
introduced.quote: Guild Member: This is the president of the Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild.

introduced.name: Five-Nut Wangxiao Cake
introduced.how: A Wangxiao Cake variety that was originally made from pooled ingredients to share at festivals and later became fancy gift-box filler
introduced.quote: In those days, we just pooled whatever good ingredients we had on hand and saved the cakes to share with our families during the festival.

introduced.name: Moonchase Festival
introduced.how: A festival where Wangxiao Cakes are eaten together with family
introduced.quote: Escoffier: Besides, my friends from Liyue tell me that Wangxiao Cake is a treat meant to be enjoyed together with family during the Moonchase Festival.

introduced.name: Celestial Tea Crisp
introduced.how: The joint full-sized Wangxiao Cake made by Escoffier and the Liyue chefs, with a clean tea-flavored filling
introduced.quote: Escoffier: Here is the joint masterpiece of our food street — the Celestial Tea Crisp.

introduced.name: Lu Xiangxiang
introduced.how: A young Chenyu Vale resident whose family connections supply the finest tea leaves for the cake
introduced.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: This should be the finest tea you'll find in all Chenyu Vale. I never thought my family's connections would come in handy one day...

introduced.name: Fullmoon Cakes
introduced.how: An ancient pastry that Wangxiao Cakes are said to have evolved from
introduced.quote: Xiangling: Huh. Speaking of that, my dad did say that today's Wangxiao Cakes evolved from an ancient pastry.

introduced.name: Liyue cuisine
introduced.how: Liyue cooking relies largely on each chef's accumulated experience rather than fixed measurements
introduced.quote: It seems Liyue cuisine is built largely on the chef's own accumulated experience.

assumed.name: Shenhe
assumed.quote: Paimon: Shenhe! You're here too?

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Paimon: Xiangling, what are they doing?

assumed.name: Smiley Yanxiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Well, Paimon can't really argue with that... Wait, what are Yanxiao and the others up to over there?

assumed.name: Chef Mao
assumed.quote: Shenhe: Besides... I accidentally punched a hole through a wok with my spatula while practicing cooking recently. Chef Mao thought it best if I stayed away from the kitchen for a while.

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: Traveler: Ooh! Qiqi and Yaoyao. You're here too, huh?

assumed.name: Yaoyao
assumed.quote: Traveler: Ooh! Qiqi and Yaoyao. You're here too, huh?

assumed.name: Zibai
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ooh, hey there, Zibai! Are you checking out the food street too?

assumed.name: Xianyun
assumed.quote: Paimon: One of Xianyun's cooking machines, maybe?

assumed.name: Wanmin Restaurant
assumed.quote: Lu Xiangxiang: Miss Shenhe really looked out for me last time at Wanmin Restaurant, so I have to do my part this time.

assumed.name: Glaze Lily
assumed.quote: Qiqi: Glaze Lilies for Shenhe, and... I forgot.

threads.claim: Zibai claims to have tasted Fullmoon Cakes roughly a few thousand years ago, hinting she is far older than she appears.
threads.quote: Zibai: Indeed, I have. I'd say that was roughly a few thousand years ago.

threads.claim: Zibai reflects that the scene of people sharing food has not changed across the passage of years, reinforcing her long history.
threads.quote: Zibai: Still, this scene, with everyone gathering to share good food... That hasn't changed in the slightest, despite the passage of years.

threads.claim: Wangxiao Cakes may descend from ancient Fullmoon Cakes, but Zibai says the two pastries are now vastly different.
threads.quote: Zibai: And yet, its ingredients and craftsmanship are vastly different from Fullmoon Cakes.

threads.claim: Festival cakes were locked away in decorative gift boxes as living standards rose, so they stopped being shared at family tables.
threads.quote: As living standards improved, the fillings became fancier and fancier, but the cakes ended up locked away in decorative gift boxes, never actually making it to the family table.

threads.claim: The Guildmaster's longing for the shared warmth of festival cakes is answered by the team's cake meant to be shared.
threads.quote: Guildmaster: What I missed... was the warmth of everyone coming together to enjoy the cake.

introduced.name: Enjou
introduced.how: self-introduced as a researcher and scholar assisting the trial, later revealed as an impostor
introduced.quote: Let me introduce myself: I'm a researcher who has come to assist you. Call me Enjou.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: the real name of Enkanomiya, a nether realm without light and the ancient land of the Golden Bridle
introduced.quote: That's right, Byakuyakoku. That's the real name of this place.

introduced.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: the central tower of the trial, whose name means chariot of the sun and which is protected by a barrier
introduced.quote: That's the heart of the trial, a building known as Dainichi Mikoshi

introduced.name: Golden Bridle
introduced.how: Byakuyakoku's national treasure, a device needed to break the barrier and the core of the Reins
introduced.quote: According to related literature, it's a device that is less than an armful in size.

introduced.name: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep
introduced.how: the key required to open the gate so the trial and its contents activate
introduced.quote: Without the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep to open the gate, the trial and its contents will not activate.

introduced.name: Reins of Revival
introduced.how: a national treasure that commands the spirits of the nether to speak, assembled from the Golden Bridle and three fragments
introduced.quote: The Reins of Revival are a national treasure that can be used to command the spirits of the nether to speak, and they are made of the same material as the Dainichi Mikoshi.

introduced.name: Shades of Tokoyo
introduced.how: afterimages of past Byakuyakoku people, formed from powerful emotions, also called Sinshades
introduced.quote: Thus, these unique ley line phenomena are known as

introduced.name: Sunfire Phantasms
introduced.how: a ley line phenomenon where energy gathers and disperses as the land shifts between day and night, hiding or revealing objects
introduced.quote: There is also a type of ley line phenomenon here known as Sunfire Phantasms.

introduced.name: Whitenight and Evernight
introduced.how: the artificial day and night cycle of Byakuyakoku, alternated by the rulers using the tower and devices
introduced.quote: the rulers of Byakuyakoku could adjust a solar and lunar cycle, thus alternating between Whitenight and Evernight.

introduced.name: Abyss Lector
introduced.how: the Abyss Order's exegetes, who can transform into fire-flinging monsters; Enjou is one
introduced.quote: I believe that you refer to our exegetes as

introduced.name: Bathysmal Vishaps
introduced.how: primordial elemental wild spirits, once rulers of the land, whose bodies carry Bloodbranch Coral
introduced.quote: Pure, primordial elemental creatures, wild spirits who never bent the knee to any god or worldly power.

introduced.name: Jibashiri
introduced.how: the special officer corps Chthonios, armed judges of the nether who set up the trial
introduced.quote: The special officer corps Chthonios, the armed judges of the nether in Byakuyakoku.

introduced.name: Aru
introduced.how: a Sinshade who explains the trial, formerly Argos of Byakuyakoku, now a guide for the heroes
introduced.quote: My Watatsumi name is Aru, and my original Byakuyakoku name is Argos.

introduced.name: The Narrows
introduced.how: one of three locations hiding a Reins fragment around the Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.quote: These would be The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: Evernight Temple
introduced.how: one of three locations hiding a Reins fragment, whose gates open only at night
introduced.quote: These would be The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: Serpent's Heart
introduced.how: an altar-holding sealing site, once called The Heart of Ouroboros, that hides a Reins fragment
introduced.quote: The Serpent's Heart is home to an altar that is considered the heart of the Cosmic Serpent.

introduced.name: Bloodbranch Coral
introduced.how: a coral absorbed into the Bathysmal Vishaps under the tower, which must be retrieved by defeating them
introduced.quote: The Bloodbranch Coral needs to be retrieved from the body of special Bathysmal Vishaps, which are right under the Dainichi Mikoshi

introduced.name: Before Sun and Moon
introduced.how: the ancient era before the tower was built, when no gods walked the earth and one civilization ruled the land
introduced.quote: These chronicles are known to the people here as the times

introduced.name: Three realms of Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: the belief that Byakuyakoku lies between the Vishap Realm, Human Realm and Void Realm, held up by three towers
introduced.quote: They believed that Byakuyakoku was the intersection between three realms: the Vishap Realm, the Human Realm, and the Void Realm.

introduced.name: Great Serpent
introduced.how: the being that saved the people of Byakuyakoku and let them return to the light above the depths
introduced.quote: The people of Byakuyakoku were saved by the Great Serpent, and thus re-attained the light of heaven.

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: Hey! It's the Abyss Order.

assumed.name: Abyss Mages
assumed.quote: the one where Abyss Mages pull hilichurls out of thin air?

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Paimon bets these hilichurls were brought down here by the Abyss Order!

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Shrine
assumed.quote: Sangonomiya Shrine couldn't possibly be so shorthanded that they're only sending one person, right?

assumed.name: Tsuyuko
assumed.quote: that Tsuyuko was referring to?

assumed.name: Madam Kokomi
assumed.quote: It seems like something that Madam Kokomi did not anticipate occurred.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Island
assumed.quote: Wow! Paimon never thought that there'd be such a huge place underneath Watatsumi Island!

assumed.name: Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri
assumed.quote: it will soon come time for her to see to the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

assumed.name: Archon War
assumed.quote: Well, Watatsumi Island was a product of the Archon War.

assumed.name: Watatsumi Omikami
assumed.quote: they can accept fragments of Watatsumi Omikami's Bloodbranch Coral without experiencing any rejection.

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: Proof that the gods and Celestia came from beyond this world.

threads.claim: Enjou's search for a hidden book of pre-tower records hints at a lost ancient history of Byakuyakoku that remains unresolved.
threads.quote: That book contains records of things that happened in Byakuyakoku before the Dainichi Mikoshi was constructed.

threads.claim: The Great Serpent was sentenced to death by Celestia for reading a forbidden book, a hint about the origins of the sealed depths.
threads.quote: The only thing I do know at the moment is that the Great Serpent was sentenced to death by Celestia for accidentally reading this book.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order seeks proof that the gods and Celestia came from beyond this world, an open claim about divine origins.
threads.quote: Proof that the gods and Celestia came from beyond this world.

threads.claim: Enjou is revealed as an Abyss Lector who fought the heroes, resolving his disguise as a clerical staff member.
threads.quote: (Enjou transforms into an Abyss Lector)

threads.claim: Aru warns that Enjou carries a special art that could disrupt the ritual or make Aru dissipate.
threads.quote: He also has some kind of special art on his person that may be able to disrupt the ritual or cause me to dissipate.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order has infiltrated the Enkanomiya trial, a grave threat to the Watatsumi Sangonomiya side.
threads.quote: It was someone from the Abyss Order.

threads.claim: The Byakuyakoku principle that to know sin is to be free of it introduces a recurring theme of sin and freedom.
threads.quote: But bear in mind the principle that

threads.claim: Shades of Tokoyo will dissipate once they realize they are only shadows, a hint about what these afterimages are.
threads.quote: The moment they realize that they are shadows of their former selves, they will dissipate.

threads.claim: The Lector hints that Paimon may someday betray the Traveler, a seed of distrust among the party.
threads.quote: Perhaps you shall someday face betrayal from that corner too.

threads.claim: The Bathysmal Vishaps were altered to accept Bloodbranch Coral, hinting at Watatsumi's manipulation of the dragons.
threads.quote: The Vishaps locked beneath it have been adjusted specifically such that they can accept fragments of Watatsumi Omikami's Bloodbranch Coral without experiencing any rejection.

threads.claim: Watatsumi Omikami is said to be about to carry all transgressions and go to its death, an open question about the god's fate.
threads.quote: Its meaning is that Watatsumi Omikami is about to carry all our transgressions and go to its death.

threads.claim: Sunfire Phantasms can hide or reveal objects as the land shifts between day and night, setting up puzzle mechanics tied to lore.
threads.quote: This can cause objects to be hidden or become visible.

threads.claim: The Reins hold control over things returning from beyond the grave, giving the bearer mastery over both light and gloom.
threads.quote: The one who bears the Reins may master both the light and the gloom.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Saurians are companion creatures ridden by a rider in flight training
introduced.quote: Here, we aim to have Saurian and rider stride toward improvement together.

introduced.name: Pakpaka Flying School
introduced.how: a flight school that trains riders and their Saurians, with a training course and races
introduced.quote: I doubt Pakpaka Flying School is the place for you to show off your skills.

introduced.name: Temach
introduced.how: flight school staffer who runs the training course and promotes it
introduced.quote: if you're interested in our flying training, I recommend that you try our training course!

introduced.name: Lamizana
introduced.how: self-described senior at the flight school who claims to be a mentor and is hosting the prizes
introduced.quote: As your senior, your older brother, even, let me teach you how to fit in and become popular.

introduced.name: Taruka
introduced.how: a young flight school student who is Lliwa's brother and rides a Qucusaurus named Oberon
introduced.quote: Taruka and his Qucusaurus are partners, but they don't get along very well.

introduced.name: Oberon
introduced.how: Taruka's Qucusaurus, a restless Saurian fond of Saurus Crackers
introduced.quote: By the way, can you stop giving Oberon crackers?

introduced.name: Lliwa
introduced.how: Taruka's older sister, a competitive racer at the flight school
introduced.quote: That guy must have an ulterior motive for fawning over my sister Lliwa time and again...

introduced.name: Paran
introduced.how: flight school staffer who runs the preparations and is Hawka's nephew, with a Carrewoof companion
introduced.quote: Paran: Ah, so this is where you are. Wonderful!

introduced.name: Quilla
introduced.how: a traveling merchant who recently arrived and deals in many goods
introduced.quote: Ms. Quilla is a traveling merchant who showed up recently.

introduced.name: Hawka
introduced.how: a notorious Saurian trafficker active in the area and Paran's exiled uncle
introduced.quote: there's been a Saurian trafficker who's been active in the area recently — the notorious Hawka.

introduced.name: Furball
introduced.how: a large Saurian Quilla commands in battle
introduced.quote: Go get them, Furball!

introduced.name: Air race
introduced.how: an upcoming flying race at the flight school that Lamizana is hosting
introduced.quote: We'll be holding an air race soon.

introduced.name: Paran's family exile
introduced.how: Paran's family was exiled because some members did something terrible
introduced.quote: His family was exiled because some of his family members did something terrible.

introduced.name: Lamizana's plan
introduced.how: Lamizana's secret scheme to stage a fake Saurian attack during the race to look heroic
introduced.quote: At first, it was the perfect ploy to start with.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Paimon wishes that the Adventurers' Guild's commissions were all as easy as this!

assumed.name: Adventurer Handbook
assumed.quote: I have an Adventurer Handbook, but Paimon doesn't.

assumed.name: Saurus Crackers
assumed.quote: Taruka: How many Saurus Crackers did that Lamizana feed you...

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: There's a lot I have to do before I can become the best adventurer in the Flower-Feather Clan.

assumed.name: Ochkanatlan
assumed.quote: You've gotta become stronger with me, Oberon, or we won't be able to venture into Ochkanatlan together!

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: The things in this world that courage alone cannot change outnumber the sand grains of Sumeru.

assumed.name: Beast Trap
assumed.quote: Also, don't you think it's a bit too late to set Beast Trap now?

assumed.name: Soncoyoc
assumed.quote: Also, have you decided on Soncoyoc's replacement?

threads.claim: Lamizana is secretly plotting something dangerous with an outsider tied to the air race.
threads.quote: He was discussing dangerous stuff with some outsider on the sly.

threads.claim: Lamizana admits he had a staged-attack plan that Taruka would not have liked.
threads.quote: It's true that I had a plan, and it's one that Taruka wouldn't have liked.

threads.claim: Saurians may be forced by someone using vile means to control them.
threads.quote: Unless someone else has used some kind of vile means to control and forced them to do that.

threads.claim: A letter reveals a trafficking operation that delivers goods to clients who want more command types.
threads.quote: The last batch of goods was high quality, and the clients were very satisfied.

threads.claim: Hawka is a notorious Saurian trafficker who may be targeting Oberon.
threads.quote: If you ask me, his target is Oberon rather than Taruka.

threads.claim: Paran reveals Hawka is his uncle, exiled from the tribe long ago.
threads.quote: Hawka is my uncle. He was exiled from our tribe a long time ago, and I've barely ever had any contact with him.

threads.claim: Hawka's letter confirms he is directing the trafficking and wants to pull Paran in.
threads.quote: that useless nephew of mine, please let me know

threads.claim: Quilla may be hiding behind a merchant front while using false information against others.
threads.quote: using false information to mislead us

threads.claim: Quilla is revealed as the mastermind behind the trafficking and the staged plot.
threads.quote: So Quilla was the mastermind, just like Paimon thought!

threads.claim: Paran's voice sounds familiar, hinting he was present at a secret meeting.
threads.quote: there was something familiar about Paran's voice. Have we heard it somewhere recently?

threads.claim: Paimon connects Paran's familiar voice to the earlier camp, deepening suspicion.
threads.quote: No wonder Paran's voice felt familiar back then...

threads.claim: A Tepetlisaurus with a horn pattern was seen at the camp, pointing at the Traveler's companion.
threads.quote: On the night after we discussed the details, I saw a little Tepetlisaurus in the camp.

threads.claim: The party sneaks into the camp and is accused of being Saurian trafficking accomplices.
threads.quote: So you admit that you sneaked into my camp? That's terrifying.

threads.claim: Taruka and Oberon were abducted by Saurians during the race.
threads.quote: He was abducted, along with Oberon.

threads.claim: Taruka escapes on his own after figuring out the guards' movement patterns, while Oberon stays behind.
threads.quote: After figuring out the movement patterns of the Saurian guards, I realized there was an opening I could use to escape.

threads.claim: Lliwa's Saurian suddenly performs badly during the race, hinting at outside interference.
threads.quote: Huh? That's odd, something's wrong with my Saurian...

introduced.name: Bonifaz
introduced.how: Mondstadt merchant in Aaru Village who rented Sumpter Beasts to the researchers
introduced.quote: You can tell? My name's Bonifaz.

introduced.name: Tirzad
introduced.how: Akademiya researcher who hired the mercenaries and went looking for ruins in the desert
introduced.quote: Tirzad — that's the researcher's name. He took two mercenaries with him to look for some ruins, probably for some archaeological research.

introduced.name: Nachtigal
introduced.how: Bonifaz's associate who went along with the expedition to handle the Sumpter Beasts
introduced.quote: Nachtigal, my associate, was worried that they'd struggle to steer the Sumpter Beasts, so he decided to go with them.

introduced.name: Jeht
introduced.how: Eremite mercenary, Jebrael's daughter, hired by Tirzad; found trapped in the pit
introduced.quote: I'm Jeht. Tirzad... sort of hired me.

introduced.name: Jebrael
introduced.how: Jeht's father, a mercenary who once lived in the desert and left it with his family
introduced.quote: father used to live in the desert, but he left the desert with me before I was old enough to remember anything.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: one of the Sumpter Beasts rented out to the expedition
introduced.quote: Yes, Cyrus is the name of one of the Sumpter Beasts I rented to them.

introduced.name: Dusk Bird
introduced.how: the messaging method the group used to stay in touch with Bonifaz
introduced.quote: We originally arranged to use a Dusk Bird to send messages every once in a while

introduced.name: Benben
introduced.how: a floating strange machine found in the ruins that can communicate and joins the group
introduced.quote: I'll call you Benben!

introduced.name: Scarlet Sand Slate
introduced.how: a stone slate Tirzad inherited from a relative's abandoned research project
introduced.quote: this Scarlet Sand Slate was actually the research project of a relative of mine

introduced.name: Mondstadt freedom
introduced.how: Mondstadters value freedom above all, as the local saying goes
introduced.quote: What we Mondstadters value most of all is freedom.

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: outpost town in the desert where Bonifaz is staying
introduced.quote: The commissioner is named Bonifaz, and he's still in Aaru Village now.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: academic institution that issues research permits and sent Tirzad into the desert
introduced.quote: We're in the desert on the request of a researcher from the Akademiya.

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: ancient ruler the academic community considers a self-destructive tyrant
introduced.quote: the academic community has long since concluded that he was just another self-destructive tyrant

introduced.name: Golden Slumber
introduced.how: a dreamland paradise at the throne room only open to those who know King Deshret's secrets
introduced.quote: a dreamland paradise only allowed to those who gain the knowledge of King Deshret

introduced.name: Khaj-Nisut
introduced.how: desert site where King Deshret's throne room is, reachable only after three trials
introduced.quote: the throne of King Deshret at Khaj-Nisut, where only the worthy can kneel before it

introduced.name: Ufairah
introduced.how: Jeht's mother, a researcher who knew the desert and King Deshret and was killed by Samail
introduced.quote: how Jeht's mother Ufairah was valuable to Samail due to her knowledge of the desert and King Deshret

introduced.name: Samail
introduced.how: leader of the Eremites who once knew Jebrael and seeks King Deshret's treasures
introduced.quote: The leader of the Eremites, Samail, is revealed to have known Jebrael personally back when he was in Thutmose.

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: Jebrael's original tribe, where Jeht plans to go
introduced.quote: she will go back to her father's original tribe, the Tanit

introduced.name: Jeht
introduced.how: Jebrael's daughter, raised without family traditions and without memory of her mother
introduced.quote: Jeht: I don't have family traditions, and I don't even remember my mother's face. I only have you, and you only have me.

introduced.name: Jebrael
introduced.how: Jeht's father, who once lived in the desert and gave up a secluded path
introduced.quote: Jeht: Father seems a little... Maybe he's recalled his past life in the desert. If only he'd tell us some stories of his past at night.

introduced.name: Tirzad
introduced.how: an Indoorsology researcher leading the expedition and hiring the group
introduced.quote: Jeht: Right, Tirzad's an Indoor... an Indoorsology researcher, eh? Wow, that sounds so lame.

introduced.name: Nachtigal
introduced.how: a traveling merchant who, with Bonifaz, runs a caravan from the north
introduced.quote: Nachtigal: I mean, just look at Bonifaz and I. We weren't born as traveling merchants, and no one in our families has even been to Sumeru...

introduced.name: Dusk Bird
introduced.how: a bird the merchants use to send letters to people far away
introduced.quote: Nachtigal: Let's take this opportunity to inspect our supplies... We've gotta use the Dusk Bird to send Bonifaz a letter and tell him we're safe now.

introduced.name: Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: pack animals the merchants keep, one of which is named Dandelion
introduced.quote: Nachtigal: Speaking of "Dandelion," that's also the name of one of our Sumpter Beasts.

introduced.name: Khemenu Temple
introduced.how: a huge desert ruin that Tirzad wants to explore for research
introduced.quote: Tirzad: O—Of course! This huge ruin is right before me. It must be the Khemenu Temple! As a researcher, I must go in and have a look, right?

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: an ancient ruler whose civilization is recorded in the ruins and murals
introduced.quote: Tirzad: The sun and the eye symbolize King Deshret.

introduced.name: Seven Pillars
introduced.how: the seven figures beneath King Deshret who hold up his pyramid of authority
introduced.quote: Tirzad: The sun and the eye symbolize King Deshret. Beneath him are the "seven pillars," so we call them, that hold up King Deshret's pyramid of authority.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an academic body that reviews and approves research papers
introduced.quote: Tirzad: Let me put it like this: I want my paper to get approved by the Akademiya's review... It's like love!

introduced.name: Stone Slate
introduced.how: a clue-bearing stone slate that once lit up in response to Benben
introduced.quote: Tirzad: Oh, right! It was the clues on the Stone Slate that led me here. How did I stray so far off my plan?

introduced.name: Primal Torch
introduced.how: torches on each side of a door that must both be lit to open it
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, this side has lit up! Hmm... Do we need to get the other side to light up to open this door, then?

introduced.name: Large Fan Blades
introduced.how: a strong fan mechanism whose wind blocks movement until it dies down
introduced.quote: Paimon: We can only move when the wind dies down.

introduced.name: Orchard of Pairidaeza
introduced.how: a place the dead spirit is said to return to, according to an inscription
introduced.quote: The golden sandstorm and burning sun will exorcise the darkness on your behalf, guiding you who perished here and returning your spirit to the Orchard of Pairidaeza.

introduced.name: Tirzad
introduced.how: A researcher hired to study the ruins, shown as arrogant and eager for academic fame
introduced.quote: I'm just an ordinary researcher. I've come here to solve academic problems, not to fight!

introduced.name: Jebrael
introduced.how: A desert man who speaks in riddles and knows the ruins; Jeht's father and Tirzad's guide
introduced.quote: All questions have an answer, and all answers slumber here.

introduced.name: Jeht
introduced.how: Jebrael's daughter, who travels with the group and cares deeply for Benben
introduced.quote: Father, what do you think? I'm sure you know something, right?

introduced.name: Benben
introduced.how: A mechanical creation that beeps, can open huge doors, and seems tied to the ruins
introduced.quote: Oh, that mechanical creation?

introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.how: A tyrant ruler whose huge mausoleum is in the desert
introduced.quote: If the records are correct, they should be King Deshret's Mausoleum. It's where the tyrant is buried.

introduced.name: Samail
introduced.how: Jebrael's former comrade who leads a Fatui and Eremite group and calls Jebrael a traitor
introduced.quote: Ha! I was wondering when you would get here, my dear Jebrael.

introduced.name: Thutmose
introduced.how: An Eremite band that wants the secrets of Al-Ahmar; Jebrael and Samail both belonged to it
introduced.quote: Just like him, I was a member of the Eremite band named

introduced.name: Ufairah
introduced.how: A capable researcher, Jebrael's wife and Jeht's mother, who is now dead
introduced.quote: Ufairah was a capable researcher, and the Thutmose coveted her wisdom.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: A desert figure whose secrets and puzzle the Thutmose want to unlock
introduced.quote: The secrets of Al-Ahmar belong to the Thutmose!

introduced.name: Khaj-Nisut
introduced.how: A hidden ruin where Al-Ahmar's throne lies, the group's final destination
introduced.quote: Our destination tomorrow, Khaj-Nisut, is where Al-Ahmar's throne lies.

introduced.name: Golden Slumber
introduced.how: A paradise of eternal peace that Al-Ahmar promised to those who gain the throne's wisdom
introduced.quote: They say anyone who gains King Deshret's wisdom is permitted to enter the Golden Slumber, and enjoy eternal peace and happiness there.

introduced.name: Scarlet Sand Slate
introduced.how: A stone slate that lights symbols and opens new passages, described as a key
introduced.quote: The stone slate is the key, but it cannot open all doors.

introduced.name: Hindi Clan
introduced.how: The clan Tirzad belongs to as a researcher
introduced.quote: you are one of the researchers from the Hindi Clan.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: Desert mercenaries and bandits who work for Samail and are hostile to the group
introduced.quote: Are those... Eremites? Are they Samail's flunkies?

introduced.name: Nachtigal
introduced.how: A merchant hired by Tirzad, traveling with a partner named Bonifaz
introduced.quote: What? You're a merchant. You should know the value of trust!

introduced.name: Golden Slumber
introduced.how: Al-Ahmar's promised paradise; believers enter by the correct prayer on a one-way trip
introduced.quote: Jebrael: Those who offer the correct prayer to Al-Ahmar will be granted entry into the Golden Slumber, but it's a one way trip.

introduced.name: Eternal Dreamland
introduced.how: a realm no one can freely leave for reality; Samail's consciousness now exists there
introduced.quote: Jebrael: No one can move freely between the Eternal Dreamland and reality. It seems like Ufairah was right. Samail is gone forever.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: the figure whose promise is the Golden Slumber; his wisdom and authority can be absorbed by others
introduced.quote: Jebrael: Is it Samail...? Oh no! If he gained Al-Ahmar's wisdom, then even if it's just for an instant, he would have gained Al-Ahmar's authority...

introduced.name: Thutmose
introduced.how: a group of twin blades dedicated to uncovering the secrets of the Golden Slumber, to which Jebrael and Samail belonged
introduced.quote: Samail: I knew it... I knew it! We are the twin blades of Thutmose, our lives dedicated to uncovering the secrets of the Golden Slumber...

introduced.name: Samail
introduced.how: Jebrael's former twin-blade partner who betrayed him and now is consumed by Al-Ahmar's power
introduced.quote: Samail: Your betrayal was like a blade in my chest. But I obtained Al-Ahmar's wisdom, and that wound I thought would never heal is nothing but a memory now.

introduced.name: Tirzad
introduced.how: a scholar on an archaeological expedition under a commission, writing a paper on it
introduced.quote: Tirzad: ...Hah, all's well that ends well, eh? I, Tirzad, hereby announce that this archaeological expedition has been completed successfully and has yielded great results!

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: the tribe Jeht's father came from; Jeht plans to seek them out
introduced.quote: Jeht: I found out that my father is from this tribe called "Tanit"... So, I plan to look for them... Perhaps they can tell me about my father...

introduced.name: Ufairah
introduced.how: Jeht's mother, a researcher who deciphered the prayer from Al-Ahmar's texts
introduced.quote: Tirzad: Jebrael, you mentioned that Jeht's mother deciphered it from Al-Ahmar's texts... I didn't expect it to be used here...

introduced.name: Stone slate with the prayer
introduced.how: the prayer slate; Tirzad made a replica and asked the Traveler to keep the original safe
introduced.quote: Tirzad: I've prepared a replica for reference. As for the original... I hope you'll keep it safe for me.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: We'll do it for the Mora.

assumed.name: Wind glider
assumed.quote: We have a wind glider.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: We're with the Adventurers' Guild...

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on ???, optional

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: I guess I was favored by the Anemo Archon.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: find Tirzad, Jeht, and Jebrael surrounded by Fatui agents

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: The leader of the Eremites, Samail, is revealed to have known Jebrael personally

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Jeht: So, , I heard from Nachtigal that you beat up Stormterror and were made an Honorary Knight for that achievement?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Tirzad: What do you mean coveting? I'm doing legitimate research, approved by the Akademiya! Don't you dare compare me to Treasure Hoarders!

assumed.name: Vahumana
