assumed.quote: Tirzad: Now, I won't hear any buts. Everything I have said has been proven by prior research... and this mural will become part of Vahumana too.

assumed.name: Benben lighting the stone slate earlier
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, , do you remember how Benben somehow made the stone slate light up?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Over there! It's the Fatui! Jeht and the others are there too!

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Jebrael, optional)

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: They may be precious relics to you researchers from the Akademiya

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: why don't we just return to Sumeru City now?

assumed.name: Aaru Village
assumed.quote: I'll inform the boss once I'm back in Aaru Village.

assumed.name: Bonifaz
assumed.quote: If Bonifaz had Jebrael's wisdom, then perhaps our business would be doing much better than it currently is.

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: Wonderful, Cyrus seems to be in a good mood.

assumed.name: Jebrael
assumed.quote: Jebrael: We must leave immediately!

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: Jeht: Father! What's going on? That prayer...

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Aim at Tirzad with Nahida's All Schemes to Know, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Aim at Jebrael with Nahida's All Schemes to Know, optional)

assumed.name: Khaj-Nisut
assumed.quote: (A challenge begins Flee Khaj-Nisut!)

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Bonifaz: To think that something like that happened... Anemo Archon bless us all...

assumed.name: Bonifaz
assumed.quote: Bonifaz: *sigh* I'm really sorry about what happened to Jebrael. But at least all of you returned safely.

assumed.name: Nachtigal
assumed.quote: Nachtigal: I think we may have to reconsider our career as traveling merchants...

assumed.name: Aaru Village
assumed.quote: Tirzad: Actually, it isn't over. I mean, the minimum requirement in the commission was to escort me safely back to Aaru Village, right?

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Nachtigal: I believe Tirzad will be returning to Sumeru City.

assumed.name: Sumpter Beast
assumed.quote: Nachtigal: What are you talking about? We're Sumpter Beast merchants. What are we going to eat if our Sumpter Beasts don't work?

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: Traveler: I want to talk about King Deshret.

assumed.name: Omid and Mirsad
assumed.quote: Bonifaz: Where are Omid and Mirsad? Are they...

assumed.name: Benben
assumed.quote: Benben: Bee-eep! Beep...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Tirzad: If you make new discoveries during this time... Wouldn't we make the perfect team? The thesis material shall be mine, and the Mora yours...

threads.claim: A strange floating machine in the ruins reacts to the Scarlet Sand Slate, hinting it has a hidden link to the slate.
threads.quote: Ooh! Benben seems to be reacting to Tirzad's stone slate!

threads.claim: The Scarlet Sand Slate lights up partially when activated, leaving its purpose unexplained.
threads.quote: A small portion of the slate lit up. What does it mean?

threads.claim: Tirzad's relative abandoned her research to elope into the desert, leaving the slate behind, which raises who she was and where she went.
threads.quote: she left the family behind and eloped with some wild boy from who knows where

threads.claim: Jebrael refuses to talk about his past in the desert, hinting at a hidden history.
threads.quote: That's all in the past, there's nothing worth talking about.

threads.claim: Jebrael reveals that Samail killed Jeht's mother Ufairah while searching for King Deshret's treasures.
threads.quote: he explains that Jeht's mother, a researcher, was killed by Samail

threads.claim: Entering the Golden Slumber is described as a one-way trip from which one may never return.
threads.quote: Jebrael states that it is a one-way trip and those who enter it may never return to the real world.

threads.claim: Jebrael challenges the Akademiya's view of King Deshret as a tyrant, suggesting the people's faith is overlooked.
threads.quote: he knows little of the faith the people had in King Deshret

threads.claim: The Fatui are working with the Eremites and have taken Benben, linking the two groups.
threads.quote: They find the main camp of the Fatui, who are working with the Eremites and have taken Benben.

threads.claim: Only those who clear three trials may see King Deshret's throne, a restricted secret.
threads.quote: only those who have cleared three trials may see the throne of King Deshret

threads.claim: Mondstadters place freedom above all other values, a theme the story keeps returning to.
threads.quote: What we Mondstadters value most of all is freedom.

threads.claim: Samail, leader of the Eremites, has a personal history with Jebrael and is hunting King Deshret's treasures.
threads.quote: The leader of the Eremites, Samail, is revealed to have known Jebrael personally back when he was in Thutmose.

threads.claim: Benben seems to react to the ruins and understand things beyond ordinary beeping, which nobody can explain.
threads.quote: Jeht: Wait, Benben's acting a little strange.

threads.claim: Benben's behavior actually opens the Khemenu door, though the reason it can do so stays unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa! It's actually opening up!

threads.claim: The Khemenu Temple entrance is sealed and the group cannot yet figure out how to open it.
threads.quote: Jeht: Huh? I thought it would be smooth sailing this time, but we still have to figure out a way to get the door open...

threads.claim: The sealed Khemenu door finally opens after Benben's interaction with the mechanism.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa! It's actually opening up!

threads.claim: King Deshret's secrets are hard to uncover and are kept by the desert and its ruins.
threads.quote: Jebrael: King Deshret's secrets rarely reveal themselves to mortals.

threads.claim: The meaning of King Deshret's rule is disputed: Tirzad reads tyranny, Jeht reads order, and Jebrael reads the people's hope.
threads.quote: Jebrael: It was their hope which tied the people of the sand to King Deshret.

threads.claim: Jebrael once followed a secluded path that he gave up for a better one, tying him to his desert past.
threads.quote: Jebrael: I gave up the path of seclusion, not because it's a mistaken path, but because I found a better path.

threads.claim: Jeht has no memories of the desert yet feels she has returned home, hinting at a hidden connection to the place.
threads.quote: Jeht: The strange thing is that I have no memories of the desert, but coming here makes me feel like I've returned home all the same.

threads.claim: The stone slate has lit up once and is expected to be fully activated later, so its clues remain unresolved.
threads.quote: Jebrael: That stone slate has lit up once. We'll definitely find a way to make it light up completely.

threads.claim: Inscriptions in the ruins say the dead are guided to the Orchard of Pairidaeza, a place of afterlife.
threads.quote: The golden sandstorm and burning sun will exorcise the darkness on your behalf, guiding you who perished here and returning your spirit to the Orchard of Pairidaeza.

threads.claim: Jebrael claims the desert holds only the past with no future, a theme that the group will have to test.
threads.quote: Jebrael: The desert holds only the past. It has no future.

threads.claim: Jeht frames her own life of no family and no set objective as a kind of freedom.
threads.quote: Jeht: No family, no objective... But what we are is pretty free. Haha!

threads.claim: Benben seems to have a hidden connection to the ruins and its doors, and its nature is an open question.
threads.quote: Then explain to me how this thing... Benben opened the door. What's the logic behind that?

threads.claim: The Scarlet Sand Slate is a key to the ruins, but its full purpose is unclear.
threads.quote: The stone slate is the key, but it cannot open all doors.

threads.claim: Lighting the slate's symbols opens new passages, confirming it works as a key.
threads.quote: So it really is a key.

threads.claim: The stone slate must receive acknowledgment before it works, a hint of a deeper mechanism.
threads.quote: Even the key must first receive

threads.claim: King Deshret built vast monuments to make subjects feel small and control them.
threads.quote: Building huge spectacles to instill the idea that his subjects are small and insignificant into them

threads.claim: King Deshret may have prepared illusions to mislead intruders, so the apparent contents may be false.
threads.quote: He even went so far as to prepare illusions like this to mislead us.

threads.claim: The Golden Slumber is a paradise promised to those who gain King Deshret's wisdom.
threads.quote: They say anyone who gains King Deshret's wisdom is permitted to enter the Golden Slumber, and enjoy eternal peace and happiness there.

threads.claim: Jebrael wants to see the Golden Slumber that Al-Ahmar promised, tying it to his personal goal.
threads.quote: If I have a chance to look upon the Golden Slumber that Al-Ahmar promised...

threads.claim: Ufairah deciphered a song from Al-Ahmar's texts that matters to Jebrael's family.
threads.quote: It's a song that Ufairah deciphered from Al-Ahmar's texts.

threads.claim: The song is revealed to be the key to the throne's secret, which Samail recognizes.
threads.quote: That prayer is the key... But of course you know that!

threads.claim: Ufairah has died, and the reason for her absence is left unexplained.
threads.quote: It's a pity that Ufairah will never get to see this...

threads.claim: Jebrael reveals that Samail killed his wife Ufairah.
threads.quote: My wife, Jeht's mother, was killed by him.

threads.claim: Jebrael is accused of betraying the Thutmose, and his true allegiance is in doubt.
threads.quote: You betrayed all of us grains of sand!

threads.claim: Jebrael admits he betrayed both Samail and Thutmose and explains that his motives were personal.
threads.quote: I betrayed him and Thutmose both.

threads.claim: Samail is a dangerous schemer who will ambush the group, and his plans remain unknown.
threads.quote: Remember, I am the viper in the vault. I will be lurking behind every shadow...

threads.claim: Jebrael warns that Samail is cunning and dangerous, and does not hesitate to use violence.
threads.quote: He's like a viper crawling through the shadows, and his blades are like a viper's fangs.

threads.claim: Samail claims a past connection to Jeht as a baby, which Jeht does not remember.
threads.quote: I held you in my arms when you were just a little baby.

threads.claim: Al-Ahmar's throne only reveals itself to the worthy who pass three trials.
threads.quote: According to this coded letter, Al-Ahmar's throne only shows itself to the worthy who have passed the three trials.

threads.claim: Khaj-Nisut reveals itself after the group passes the trials and operates the plinth.
threads.quote: (Khaj-Nisut reveals itself)

threads.claim: Samail is seated on the throne and is motionless like a statue, a mystery left unexplained.
threads.quote: (Samail is seated on the throne, but is still as a statue)

threads.claim: The Fatui may be working with the Eremites, hinting at a hidden alliance.
threads.quote: These Fatui are... in cahoots with The Eremites?

threads.claim: The Golden Slumber admits believers who use the correct prayer, but entry is a one-way trip with no return.
threads.quote: Jebrael: Those who offer the correct prayer to Al-Ahmar will be granted entry into the Golden Slumber, but it's a one way trip.

threads.claim: Samail's consciousness survives within the Eternal Dreamland, where he tries to absorb the living and no one seems able to stop him.
threads.quote: Jebrael: His consciousness has departed from this world and now only exists within the Eternal Dreamland. No one can stop him... unless...

threads.claim: Jebrael confronts Samail inside the Dreamland and challenges him to die together, ending the threat in that realm.
threads.quote: Jebrael: Samail, the twin blades of Thutmose are equal. So... die here with me!

threads.claim: Jebrael appears to have vanished in the Dreamland after sacrificing himself so the others could escape.
threads.quote: Tirzad: Jebrael... protected us, but he... *sigh*

threads.claim: Anyone who gains Al-Ahmar's wisdom may also gain his authority, even briefly, which raises the danger of the Golden Slumber.

introduced.name: Goggles

introduced.quote: Hyperborea, which had created him, had already perished.

assumed.quote: In truth, my escape from the Shadow Realm was largely thanks to Izmaylov's aid.

assumed.name: Sweet Madame
assumed.quote: Take the "Sweet Madame," for instance.

assumed.name: Kresnik Energy
assumed.quote: Heh... able to use Kresnik Energy, are we?

assumed.name: Velikan of Light
assumed.quote: to serve as the core of the Velikan of Light.

threads.claim: Aksinya's Tomorrow is a world where love and joy never fade, which seems to mean a world without change.
threads.quote: This is the world of tomorrow. In this world, no matter what you do, your heart shall always brim with that feeling, that sense of being touched at your very core.

threads.claim: Aksinya confirms that her world freezes love in place because time and change erode it.
threads.quote: Every second that passes is a second that erodes the everlastingness of love.

threads.claim: Goggles was a tool in a plan whose full scope he does not know, so his true purpose is unclear.
threads.quote: To the plan as a whole, I was nothing more than a "tool" within it.

threads.claim: Goggles was revealed to be the Proto-Man, the Key that would turn the Belyi Tsar into the Primordial Human.
threads.quote: And Goggles... was the "Proto Man" that was created after countless experiments, and the Key that would allow His Majesty to become the Primordial Human.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests Goggles should not decide his fate until he has recovered his memories.
threads.quote: Then don't decide yet. Wait until you remember.

threads.claim: The Primordial Human reawakens with full memory, confirming Goggles has recovered everything.
threads.quote: Yes, it is I... I now remember everything.

threads.claim: Goggles deliberately fragmented himself and incited Koshchei, Pavlina, and Alvis to betray Aksinya to force an irreversible revolution.
threads.quote: And so, I incited them to divide me up, to split me into pieces, and to betray Aksinya...

threads.claim: Most people think the Belyi Tsar is a powerful fae, but his true identity is said to be far more noble.
threads.quote: While most people believe the Belyi Tsar to be some kind of extraordinarily powerful fae, his true identity is far more noble...

threads.claim: The Belyi Tsar's body remains alive after his consciousness passed, and it is his nerves that keep extending outward.
threads.quote: His Majesty is different. His body... has remained alive even after the passing of his consciousness.

threads.claim: The Belyi Tsar's body vanishes after the confrontation, and the Traveler and Paimon are left unsure where it went.
threads.quote: and the Belyi Tsar's body is missing, too. Where have they gone to?

threads.claim: Hyperborea sank into the Shadow Realm after its experiment failed, and the realm holds hidden record fragments.
threads.quote: And by that time, Hyperborea had already sunk into the Shadow Realm, and the only ones seen in the land of ice and snow were the fae...

threads.claim: The Primordial Human poses a hypothetical in which the Traveler's sibling has become a stranger, testing the Traveler's love.
threads.quote: But if the gap between you is too great, and you, in the end, find that is not what you imagined, that your once-beloved kin is kin no longer...

threads.claim: The Traveler answers that they would learn to love the sibling again no matter how many times it takes.
threads.quote: Then I will learn to love once again...

threads.claim: Aksinya once asked the Tsar why an egg should exist if it never lets life emerge from its shell, and got no answer.
threads.quote: What is the point of an egg that does not allow the life within it to emerge from the shell? Why does it exist in this universe at all?

threads.claim: Aksinya admits that she hated the world's shell only to build another one, and she reconsiders her philosophy.
threads.quote: I once hated this world, imprisoned as it was within an eggshell. Yet in the end, all I did was build another shell.

introduced.name: Pervases
introduced.how: a Yaksha whose statue and temple the Traveler visits to pay respects
introduced.quote: Traveler: That's Pervases, one of the Yakshas.

introduced.name: Yakshas
introduced.how: heroes who defended Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: Paimon: How could people forget something like this? The Yakshas are heroes who defended Liyue Harbor...

introduced.name: Wang Ping'an
introduced.how: a former charlatan who has reformed and is restoring Pervases' temple
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: I'm Wang Ping'an! Don't you remember me?

introduced.name: Wang Ping'an's charlatan past
introduced.how: he once posed as an adeptus, gathering resources to keep up the act
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: Back when I was pretending to be an adeptus, I gathered a lot of resources to help me keep up the act...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: hostile bandits who ambush travelers in the mountains
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: But not long after I entered the mountains, I was set upon by those Treasure Hoarders...

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: guards posted to protect the temple worksite
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: The Millelith can hold the worksite, no problem. But if the delivery gets attacked by Treasure Hoarders, there's no way they'd be able to respond in time.

introduced.name: Adeptus
introduced.how: divine-like beings that the Treasure Hoarders fear will judge them
introduced.quote: The Treasure Hoarders did not know the dilapidated temple was for an Adeptus and promise not to mess with the temple lest the Adepti judge them.

introduced.name: Vigilant Yaksha
introduced.how: a Yaksha whose folklore Wang Ping'an plans to compile into a book
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: Apart from that guidebook, I'm currently planning to write a book about the Vigilant Yaksha.

introduced.name: Pervases' Temple
introduced.how: a temple built by forebears to honor Pervases, now neglected in the mountains
introduced.quote: Wang Ping'an: I found sources saying this temple was built by our forebears to remember the Yaksha, Pervases.

introduced.name: Sandbearer Wood
introduced.how: timber needed for the temple repairs
introduced.quote: After reporting back to Wang Ping'an, the Traveler is thanked and is asked to gather some Sandbearer Wood next.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, is that... Xiao?

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Paimon: How could people forget something like this? The Yakshas are heroes who defended Liyue Harbor...

assumed.name: Pervases gifting the Seven Star Lamps and Censer
assumed.quote: Paimon: You mean gave-us-the-Seven-Star-Lamps-and-Censer Pervases?

assumed.name: Wang Ping'an's earlier encounter with the Traveler as Starsnatcher
assumed.quote: Wang Ping'an: Thank you, O mighty adeptus, thank you, mighty hero! ...Oh, what are the odds? We meet again.

assumed.name: Wang Ping'an's earlier deception
assumed.quote: Traveler: That said, you've tried to fool us before...

threads.claim: Pervases is gone, and the Traveler still honors him, raising the question of where he went.
threads.quote: Paimon: But isn't he gone now?

threads.claim: The Yaksha temple has been neglected, hinting that the Yakshas are being forgotten.
threads.quote: Traveler: Perhaps this place has been forgotten.

threads.claim: Wang Ping'an suspects few people remember Pervases anymore, deepening the theme of forgetting.
threads.quote: Wang Ping'an: I also suspect that few people now remember the Yaksha known as Pervases...

threads.claim: Xiao states that the Yakshas acted without seeking any recognition for their duty.
threads.quote: Xiao: No. The Yakshas did not perform their duty for any form of recognition.

threads.claim: The Traveler doubts that Wang Ping'an has truly reformed from his past deceit.
threads.quote: Traveler: That said, you've tried to fool us before...

threads.claim: Wang Ping'an frames the temple repair as atonement for his past wrongdoings.
threads.quote: Wang Ping'an: I suppose repairing this temple can be considered atonement for my previous wrongdoings.

threads.claim: Wang Ping'an spends his own earnings on the repairs, supporting that his reform is genuine.
threads.quote: Wang Ping'an: Ah... I didn't think that it would cost this much Mora. I've more or less sunk all my earnings into this place...

threads.claim: Wang Ping'an plans a book compiling the folklore of the Vigilant Yaksha.
threads.quote: Wang Ping'an: Apart from that guidebook, I'm currently planning to write a book about the Vigilant Yaksha.

introduced.name: Pavlina
introduced.how: Ikhor introduces her as the Snegurochka princess who is lady of the House of Hesperides
introduced.quote: The lady of the house is Pavlina, the Snegurochka princess.

introduced.name: Ikhor
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a young man who was sent out of the house and is part of the Eye's power
introduced.quote: I... I am Ikhor.

introduced.name: Aglaya
introduced.how: Introduces herself as the house greeter who welcomes guests
introduced.quote: You may call me Aglaya.

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: Formally introduces herself as a former Court Jester and the builder of the Eye's mechanism
introduced.quote: My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: Is a late ruler whom Aksinya once served as Court Jester
introduced.quote: who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar.

introduced.name: House of Hesperides
introduced.how: Is the Snegovik residence on the mountain where the wedding is held
introduced.quote: Yes, there is a house. It is called the House of Hesperides, and it is where the Snegovik live.

introduced.name: Snegovik
introduced.how: Are fae made without flesh and blood whose souls are incomplete, so they must gain them through love
introduced.quote: Snegovik are fae created without flesh and blood, and thus their souls are incomplete.

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: Is revealed to hold a part of its body's power inside Ikhor
introduced.quote: There's definitely a part of my body's power that's inside him.

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: Are beings who do not mind the cold, with the Snegovik and Jack Frosts as examples
introduced.quote: The fae don't really mind the cold.

introduced.name: Larisa
introduced.how: Had a wedding that was the last large ceremonial ritual, which ended with her death
introduced.quote: The last ceremonial ritual we held on this scale was Larisa's wedding.

introduced.name: Snegovik ritual
introduced.how: Is a ritual where Snegovik take a loved one's soul to become whole, repeated bit by bit
introduced.quote: That's what the Snegovik's ritual is: they take a soul from someone they love, to make themselves whole.

introduced.name: Aksinya's betrayal
introduced.how: Aksinya was betrayed 500 years ago by Pavlina, Koshchei, and Alvis, who banished her to the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: whom Pavlina, Koshchei, and Alvis betrayed 500 years ago by banishing into the Shadow Realm

introduced.name: Garden Bathed in Radiant Dew
introduced.how: Is a garden in the House of Hesperides where another fragment of Ikhor is kept, guarded by Snegovik attendants
introduced.quote: The two fragments of Ikhor are located in Ikhor's bedroom and the Garden Bathed in Radiant Dew, both guarded by Snegovik attendants.

introduced.name: Rumblebranch
introduced.how: Is an ice branch that draws lightning and must be completed with smaller branches
introduced.quote: Isn't that another... ice branch that draws lightning?

introduced.name: Cloudborne Altar
introduced.how: Is the summit above the clouds where Pavlina performs the final stage of the ritual
introduced.quote: pursue Pavlina to the Cloudborne Altar, where she is about to complete the ritual using the recombined fragment

introduced.name: Pebble of Freezing Heart
introduced.how: Is the crystallized Eye power left behind after Pavlina disintegrates
introduced.quote: leaving behind the Eye of Graeae's crystallized power in the form of the Pebble of Freezing Heart.

introduced.name: Hyperboreans
introduced.how: Created the fae as servants, and the fae were never perfect creations
introduced.quote: A number of the fae were originally servants created by the Hyperboreans.

introduced.name: Messages from the Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: Is the channel through which Aksinya contacts the Traveler
introduced.quote: Aksinya contacts the Traveler through the Eye of Graeae and entrusts them with gathering the Eye of Graeae's fragmented power while she holds Pavlina back.

introduced.name: Ladon
introduced.how: garden guard who refuses entry and speaks fondly of Larisa's past work
introduced.quote: Ladon: Ah, visitors from a distant land. Thank you for the compliment. When Larisa was still alive, she would come by often for some work here and there.

introduced.name: Garden Bathed in Radiant Dew
introduced.how: walled garden under maintenance, closed to outsiders except the fae helpers, with a great tree
introduced.quote: The garden is currently under maintenance, and no one's allowed in there except the fae help.

introduced.name: Larisa
introduced.how: former gardener who worked the garden and is now dead
introduced.quote: Ladon: Ah, visitors from a distant land. Thank you for the compliment. When Larisa was still alive, she would come by often for some work here and there.

introduced.name: Prime Ice construct
introduced.how: ice construct that blocks a Jack Frost's line of sight
introduced.quote: Eye of Graeae: ...It appears that the Jack Frost's line of sight will be obstructed by the Prime Ice construct.

introduced.name: The Sun's Gilded Apple fragment
introduced.how: a fragment hidden inside the great tree in the garden, which the Traveler collects
introduced.quote: Eye of Graeae: I see. The fragment lies within the garden — more precisely, within the great tree there.

assumed.name: Eye of Graeae
assumed.quote: The Traveler, Paimon, and the Eye of Graeae enter using an invitation to Pavlina's wedding.

assumed.name: Koshchei
assumed.quote: What would Koshchei say if he were here...? He would say, "Something like this was bound to happen."

assumed.name: Ladon
assumed.quote: At the garden, Paimon distracts Ladon so the Traveler can sneak in and obtain the fragment.

assumed.name: Zhara
assumed.quote: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Zhara from that mumbly-jumbly town kind of looked like him too.

assumed.name: Myshkin
assumed.quote: Myshkin? Is that you? You're finally here...

assumed.name: Eye of Graeae
assumed.quote: Eye of Graeae: I see. The fragment lies within the garden — more precisely, within the great tree there.

assumed.name: Snegovik
assumed.quote: (Approach the Snegovik guarding the Garden Bathed in Radiant Dew)

assumed.name: Jack Frost
assumed.quote: Eye of Graeae: ...It appears that the Jack Frost's line of sight will be obstructed by the Prime Ice construct.

assumed.name: Fae
assumed.quote: The garden is currently under maintenance, and no one's allowed in there except the fae help.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Paimon: But it's got to be a quick in-and-out, you hear? Even Teyvat's best guide has only so many stories to tell...

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae's stolen power is split into fragments, with a third of it held inside the House of Hesperides.
threads.quote: One third of the Eye of Graeae's stolen power is located within the House of Hesperides, residence of Snegovik Grand Duchess Pavlina.

threads.claim: The Snegovik were made without souls and chase love in order to gain one.
threads.quote: We were born without souls, so we chased after love because we longed to have one.

threads.claim: The Snegovik ritual is shown to take a loved one's soul to make the Snegovik whole, and it can only be repeated bit by bit.
threads.quote: That's what the Snegovik's ritual is: they take a soul from someone they love, to make themselves whole.

threads.claim: The ritual has likely repeated for about 500 years, a hint that time may be looping.
threads.quote: has repeated itself for, presumably, the past 500 years.

threads.claim: The bell rings eight times and the scene resets, showing the ritual repeating in a loop.
threads.quote: It is the ritual taking place here... It repeats over and over...

threads.claim: Aksinya was betrayed and banished to the Shadow Realm 500 years ago by Pavlina, Koshchei, and Alvis.
threads.quote: whom Pavlina, Koshchei, and Alvis betrayed 500 years ago by banishing into the Shadow Realm

threads.claim: Aksinya's grand plan for the Eye of Graeae is unclear, leaving the group wondering what her objective is.
threads.quote: She departs alone, leaving the trio to wonder what her objective is.

threads.claim: Aksinya reveals the Eye's power and body were made so that life might transcend life itself.
threads.quote: Your power, your body, they were created so that

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae wishes its fragments to be reunited as whole as possible.
threads.quote: This may sound a little ironic, but my wish is for the fragments, incomplete as they are, to be as whole as possible...

threads.claim: Aksinya is revealed to be the builder of the mechanism that houses the Eye of Graeae.
threads.quote: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.

threads.claim: Ikhor can be reverted into a doll and carried off by others, suggesting his body is a puppet.
threads.quote: Ikhor reverted into a doll and was retrieved by Aglaya, one of the Snegurochka living there.

threads.claim: Larisa was betrayed by her human, killed him, and died from the vow, a story that hints at a larger tragedy.
threads.quote: But that human betrayed her in the end. She killed him, and then the vow took her life, too.

threads.claim: The house greets someone named Myshkin, a figure whose identity is unclear.
threads.quote: Myshkin? Is that you? You're finally here...

threads.claim: Through endless refinement and ascension, Pavlina has lost sight of her original purpose.
threads.quote: She had even forgotten that I once chose to do all of this, without need of shackles.

threads.claim: Larisa, the garden's former caretaker, has left for good, and the great tree has stopped bearing fruit since then.
threads.quote: But after she left us for good, no matter how or what I tried, that tree would simply bear fruit no more...

threads.claim: A fragment is hidden within the great tree of the Garden Bathed in Radiant Dew.
threads.quote: Eye of Graeae: I see. The fragment lies within the garden — more precisely, within the great tree there.

introduced.name: Aberaku
introduced.how: A prideful Sinshade who introduces himself as Helios-Forger, the creator of the Helios, now a fragmented spirit
introduced.quote: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

introduced.name: Helios
introduced.how: The Dainichi Mikoshi, a solar chariot built by Aberaku that drives the Hyperion
introduced.quote: to which he clarifies it is the Dainichi Mikoshi, the solar chariot that drives the Hyperion

introduced.name: The Narrows
introduced.how: A location where Aberaku's bones are enshrined and a soul fragment is guarded by monsters
introduced.quote: that his bones are enshrined here at The Narrows

introduced.name: Evernight Temple
introduced.how: A location where another fragment of Aberaku's soul is held, guarded by a trial
introduced.quote: Heading to the Evernight Temple, the Traveler once again encounters a remnant of Aberaku

introduced.name: The Serpent's Heart
introduced.how: The final location holding a fragment of Aberaku's soul, the sacred robes
introduced.quote: At the final location in The Serpent's Heart, Aberaku speaks of how he was betrayed and left in jail to rot after the creation of the Helios.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: The land where Aberaku's soul was shattered, the nation the Helios was built to save
introduced.quote: his soul was shattered across the land of Byakuyakoku

introduced.name: Dragonheirs of the Depths
introduced.how: Dragons that scourged the nation, which the Helios was built to resist
introduced.quote: that we might resist the Dragonheirs of the Depths.

introduced.name: Sunchild
introduced.how: Child puppet rulers installed by greedy nobles who govern the land in the sun's name
introduced.quote: they proclaim the rule of the Sunchild, puppet rulers, over the land

introduced.name: Divine Bridle
introduced.how: A badge of the Sunchild's office, given to the Traveler as thanks
introduced.quote: Aberaku hands the Traveler the Divine Bridle, a badge of the Sunchild's office.

introduced.name: Sky kingdom crash
introduced.how: The sky kingdom crashed into the bottomless depths, and dragons then scourged the people
introduced.quote: When the sky kingdom crashed into the bottomless depths, the people were scourged by dragons

introduced.name: Aberaku's imprisonment on a child's orders
introduced.how: Aberaku was imprisoned on orders from a child, though he feels no hatred toward them
introduced.quote: But I recall that I was imprisoned on orders from a child.

assumed.name: Enkanomiya
assumed.quote: Along their travels in Enkanomiya, the Traveler and Paimon come across a prideful Sinshade

assumed.name: Sinshade
assumed.quote: come across a prideful Sinshade who theatrically introduces himself

assumed.name: Hyperion
assumed.quote: the solar chariot that drives the Hyperion

assumed.name: Bathysmal Vishaps
assumed.quote: saved the nation from the Bathysmal Vishaps

threads.claim: Aberaku's soul is rent into fragments, and he can only rest once they are made whole.
threads.quote: My soul is rent! If it can be made whole, I can be at peace once more.

threads.claim: Enshrining Aberaku's body and attire in separate places scattered his spirit and kept it from resting.
threads.quote: But that also caused my spirit to be separated and rendered unable to rest.

threads.claim: Gathering all the fragments makes Aberaku's soul whole and lets him recall everything.
threads.quote: Returning to Aberaku with all the fragments in hand, his soul becomes whole again and he becomes able to recall everything.

threads.claim: Greedy nobles seized power by having the people worship the Dainichi Mikoshi and installing Sunchild puppet rulers.
threads.quote: the nobles became greedy and seized power by leading the people to worship the Dainichi Mikoshi

threads.claim: The schemers advocated placing infants on the throne, and Aberaku was jailed for opposing them.
threads.quote: They even advocated placing mere infants on the throne. Laughable!

threads.claim: To prevent the Sunchildren from discovering their manipulation, they were incinerated in a ceremony at a certain age.
threads.quote: the Sunchildren would be incinerated in a ceremony once they reached a certain age

threads.claim: The Dragonheirs of the Depths terrorized Byakuyakoku until the Helios's light repelled them.
threads.quote: Byakuyakoku was terrorized by the Dragonheirs of the Depths

threads.claim: A sky kingdom crashed into the depths, and its fall brought a dragon scourge upon the people.
threads.quote: When the sky kingdom crashed into the bottomless depths

threads.claim: Aberaku was imprisoned in a high, cold, lightless place on a child's orders and cannot recall the details.
threads.quote: But though it was high up, it was dark, lightless, and cold as the ice itself.

threads.claim: Aberaku struggles to remember his own imprisonment and how he died.
threads.quote: Why... Why can't I remember any of this?

threads.claim: The Divine Bridle is a badge of the Sunchild's office that Aberaku gives the Traveler after his soul is made whole.
threads.quote: Aberaku hands the Traveler the Divine Bridle, a badge of the Sunchild's office.

introduced.name: Vinezka
introduced.how: Jary's fiancée, terrified of the cursed town and begging him not to go
introduced.quote: a tense conversation between Vinezka and her fiancé, Jary

introduced.name: Jary
introduced.how: Hired by criminals to blast open a tunnel, bound by a contract with a hundred-times penalty
introduced.quote: Jary was hired by a group of criminals to blast open a tunnel

introduced.name: Okurov
introduced.how: Abandoned valley town where, by local legend, no one who enters returns
introduced.quote: legends say no one who enters Okurov ever returns

introduced.name: Volkodlak
introduced.how: Criminal gang that sneaks into Okurov to loot it
introduced.quote: the group encounters a gang of Volkodlak led by

introduced.name: The Anvil
introduced.how: Volkodlak leader who attacks travelers, is defeated, and reveals the hidden loot
introduced.quote: The Anvil reacts aggressively regardless.

introduced.name: Nastya
introduced.how: Unconscious girl with tree branches growing from her head, found in a crate; wants to go home to Okurov
introduced.quote: an unconscious girl named Nastya with tree branches growing from her head

introduced.name: Zhara
introduced.how: Guardian of Okurov, a giant winged creature with leaf-feathers that protects the town
introduced.quote: whom she describes as a giant winged creature with

introduced.name: Leshy
introduced.how: Tree-like creatures that are aggressive and mindless, which Nastya calls her family
introduced.quote: aggressive, mindless Leshies (tree-like creatures)

introduced.name: Doctor Moreau
introduced.how: Revered town doctor and teacher of Nastya, also called Doctor Birdie
introduced.quote: She idolizes a figure named

introduced.name: Badbug
introduced.how: Town term for outsiders or those who do not fit in, who must be caught and burned
introduced.quote: a term used for outsiders or those who don't fit in

introduced.name: Catch the Bug
introduced.how: A game where players chase a Badbug, which Nastya uses to lead them deeper into town
introduced.quote: where Nastya plays the role of the Badbug

introduced.name: Assembly hall
introduced.how: Town's central building where everyone's hearts and love are said to reside, the true home
introduced.quote: a mysterious assembly hall in the distance

introduced.name: Snezhnaya Vestnik
introduced.how: Newspaper that praises Okurov as welcoming, with an exceptional doctor and open doors
introduced.quote: praising Okurov's warm weather, its exceptional doctor, and its open-door policy for all travelers

introduced.name: Koshchei the Deathless
introduced.how: Snezhnaya bio-alchemist, one of the creators of Eye of Graeae's body, linked to the town's transformations
introduced.quote: a bio-alchemist from Snezhnaya who was one of the creators of Eye of Graeae's body

introduced.name: Ove
introduced.how: Hostile neighbor who hides the elevator Control Wheel and locks children in his cellar
introduced.quote: a hostile neighbor who has been hiding the elevator's Control Wheel

introduced.name: Furiosa
introduced.how: Nastya's idol and a guardian of the assembly hall who attacks the group
introduced.quote: describing her as her number-one idol and a protector who grew branches to become stronger

introduced.name: Aunt LePuy
introduced.how: Tall Leshy that Nastya communicates with as family
introduced.quote: It becomes clear that Nastya can communicate with these creatures, including a

introduced.name: Hall of Prayers
introduced.how: Hall inside the assembly building where Dr. Moreau's prayers for Zhara are recited
introduced.quote: Once inside the Hall of Prayers, Nastya recalls reciting prayers written by Dr. Moreau for Zhara

introduced.name: Perfect Tree
introduced.how: Transformation granting immense strength but regressing language, aiming at eternal life
introduced.quote: grants immense strength but regresses language capabilities

introduced.name: Three-step transformation
introduced.how: Alchemical process of casting off soul (sulfur), will (silver), and body for a new twig
introduced.quote: casting off the soul (sulfur), the will (silver), and the body (the new twig)

introduced.name: Colored sewer keys
introduced.how: Red, White, and Blue keys needed to unlock the sewer exit gate and drain water
introduced.quote: they need three colored keys—Red, White, and Blue—to unlock the exit gate

introduced.name: Underground sewer
introduced.how: Flooded maze of tunnels under Okurov where the group wakes after Zhara's attack
introduced.quote: wake up in a mysterious underground sewer after being attacked by a giant bird

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: Self-described Royal Jester, creator of Eye of Graeae's vessel, who neutralized Zhara
introduced.quote: creator of the Eye of Graeae's vessel, confirming her connection to the entity

introduced.name: Hvergelmir
introduced.how: Organization in which Eye of Graeae, Aksinya and Koshchei created Eye of Graeae
introduced.quote: created him within an organization called Hvergelmir.

introduced.name: Grappling Gun
introduced.how: Tool used to pull planks and move platforms in the sewers and hall
introduced.quote: They learn to use mechanisms like rotary wheels, grappling guns to move planks

introduced.name: Doctor Moreau
introduced.how: Town doctor who knows everyone's names and wrote the prayers and booklets used in the Hall of Prayers
introduced.quote: The Doctor knows everything and everyone's names.

introduced.name: Koshchei
introduced.how: Revealed to be another name for Doctor Moreau, the creator of the Perfect Tree ritual
introduced.quote: For your ease of understanding, you may call me Koshchei or Doctor Moreau.

introduced.name: Ove
introduced.how: Man who locks the town's children in his cellar to keep them from reaching the assembly hall
introduced.quote: Every time we were supposed to see our families there, he'd catch us and lock us up in his cellar.

introduced.name: Control Wheel
introduced.how: Needed to operate the elevator to the assembly hall; hidden in Ove's house
introduced.quote: But without the Control Wheel, we can't take the elevator to the assembly hall...

introduced.name: Zhara
introduced.how: Fiery firebird-like guardian that protects the Doctor and is angry at the travelers
introduced.quote: Zhara is protecting him, so I know he's there.

introduced.name: Furiosa
introduced.how: Town fighter idol who grew branches for strength and guards the bridge to the assembly hall
introduced.quote: Of course! She's my idol!

introduced.name: Assembly hall
introduced.how: Tall hall where the town's families meet, reached by elevator, and where Nastya's home lies
introduced.quote: You mentioned before that your home is at that tall assembly hall all the way over there, right?

introduced.name: Okurov
introduced.how: Town that Doctor Moreau came to; ice melted and trees grew after his arrival
introduced.quote: Ever since he came to Okurov, the town has become really nice and warm.

introduced.name: Nastya's Home
introduced.how: Former family house where Nastya and her mother lived
introduced.quote: Ah... This is the place. Mama and I used to live here.

introduced.name: Teeming Mire
introduced.how: Lowest level of the tree district, filled with glowing blue algae and a Teleport Waypoint
introduced.quote: (Approach the Teleport Waypoint at Teeming Mire)

introduced.name: Hall of Prayers
introduced.how: Hall where townsfolk recited Doctor Moreau's prayers, with hidden mechanisms and an elevator
introduced.quote: We used to sit here, carrying the booklets Dr. Moreau wrote us and reciting the prayers he wrote for Zhara.

introduced.name: Badbug
introduced.how: Label for people seen as bad, who are burned to make a new healthy tree
introduced.quote: I always thought he was one of those Badbugs. You know, the kind you're supposed to just burn to make a new, healthy tree.

introduced.name: Hvergelmir
introduced.how: Organization that Aksinya, Koshchei and two others belonged to, and that created the Eye of Graeae
introduced.quote: ...an organization called Hvergelmir.

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: Self-described former Royal Jester who built the mechanism and was meant to take the Eye of Graeae
introduced.quote: My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: Late ruler whom Aksinya once served as a jester
introduced.quote: who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar. My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: Goggles's body part and power, which its body has coalesced into a crystal-like egg
introduced.quote: I'm guessing it's a part of my power that my body has coalesced into this form... like some kind of crystal.

introduced.name: Perfect Tree transformation ritual
introduced.how: Three required changes (soul, will, body) that a person must undergo to become the Perfect Tree
introduced.quote: Doctor Moreau said that for a person to turn into the Perfect Tree, they have to change in three ways...

assumed.name: Eye of Graeae (Goggles)
assumed.quote: What does it look like to you, Goggles?

assumed.name: Goggles' body part
assumed.quote: We're only here to get Goggles' body part back, that's all...

assumed.name: Prototype Rancour
assumed.quote: (The Traveler draws their Prototype Rancour and points it at The Anvil)

assumed.name: Volkodlak
assumed.quote: And it's all those Volkodlak's fault!

assumed.name: The Anvil
assumed.quote: Nastya got away, only to be nabbed by The Anvil.

assumed.name: Izmaylov
assumed.quote: Izmaylov always complains that my introductions are far too humble.

assumed.name: Goggles
assumed.quote: Goggles, how are you doing?

assumed.name: Koshchei the Deathless
assumed.quote: (He might just be Koshchei the Deathless.)

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: Descender, the fourth, one half of the twins, and now the one who stands unique in position.

threads.claim: The town's strange transformations are linked to Koshchei, a bio-alchemist who helped create Eye of Graeae.
threads.quote: the strange transformations in the town are linked to

threads.claim: Koshchei the Deathless was secretly conducting the experiments while posing as Dr. Moreau.
threads.quote: the experiments were conducted by Koshchei the Deathless (posing as Dr. Moreau)

threads.claim: Zhara is presented as a protective guardian of Okurov, though her nature is unclear.
threads.quote: Zhara is family, and she watches over the town.

threads.claim: Zhara's reappearance and attacks suggest she is a recurring threat to the travelers.
threads.quote: Paimon expresses shock at encountering Zhara again

threads.claim: Zhara is defeated in battle, but her threat is not yet fully resolved.
threads.quote: Once Zhara is defeated, the quest concludes

threads.claim: The Doctor's teaching that a single Badbug ruins a forest justifies hunting outsiders.
threads.quote: it takes only one Badbug to ruin a whole forest

threads.claim: Badbugs, including former residents, are burned so their ashes nourish new family growth.
threads.quote: Once reduced to ash, the Badbugs will nourish the soil

threads.claim: Nastya chooses the ritual and merges into the Perfect Tree, becoming part of eternal life.
threads.quote: before disintegrating into glowing blue algae and merging with the Perfect Tree

threads.claim: The town's notes suggest eternal life requires casting aside pain and individual love.
threads.quote: pain, sorrow, and individual love must be cast aside for

threads.claim: Koshchei achieved eternity but failed to keep his personal love.
threads.quote: he failed to hold onto his personal love

threads.claim: Eye of Graeae was made by one of four creators at a secret location.
threads.quote: one of the four who created my body back then at some secret location

threads.claim: Eye of Graeae was created by Aksinya, Koshchei, and others within Hvergelmir.
threads.quote: created him within an organization called Hvergelmir.

threads.claim: The sewer's hidden purpose seems linked to life and memory loss.
threads.quote: drainage and some obscured experimental function linked to

threads.claim: Nastya's sleep passed quickly for her but much longer for her family.
threads.quote: maybe only a little while passed by

threads.claim: The Leshies seem able to speak, which surprises the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, so you were talking to them? They... can speak!?

threads.claim: Nastya insists she can talk to the Leshies because they are family.
threads.quote: Of course I can talk to them

threads.claim: The area is sustained by a mysterious grand art located at its heart.
threads.quote: Inside a hidden passage, the Eye of Graeae reveals that they are approaching the heart of a

threads.claim: The town's unnatural warmth hints at a supernatural force behind it.
threads.quote: It feels nice and warm here. That's odd...

threads.claim: Furiosa vanishes after being defeated, leaving her fate unresolved.
threads.quote: while Furiosa disappears

threads.claim: Doctor Moreau may secretly be the legendary Koshchei the Deathless.
threads.quote: He could be that Koshchei the Deathless!

threads.claim: The figure confirms that Koshchei and Doctor Moreau are the same being.
threads.quote: For your ease of understanding, you may call me Koshchei or Doctor Moreau.

threads.claim: Becoming a Perfect Tree requires a costly sacrifice of body parts to complete the final step of the ritual.
threads.quote: (Nastya breaks of one of the twigs growing on her head)

threads.claim: Nastya's transformation reaches the final Perfect Tree form, which can no longer move or speak.
threads.quote: This is the final form of the Perfect Tree...

threads.claim: Goggles's creation involves an organization called Hvergelmir whose members are still unclear.
threads.quote: ...an organization called Hvergelmir.

threads.claim: The Eye of Graeae recognizes a name that feels familiar, hinting at a past tie to Aksinya.
threads.quote: That name sounds very familiar.

threads.claim: Aksinya claims to have built the mechanism and was originally meant to obtain the Eye of Graeae.
threads.quote: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.

threads.claim: The will inside the Eye of Graeae seeks a body and the return of its power, which is the group's shared goal.
threads.quote: to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.

threads.claim: The firebird Zhara may be able to revive again and again, raising the danger it poses.
threads.quote: Don't people say that firebirds can come back to life again and again?

threads.claim: Aksinya says Zhara's body will disintegrate so it cannot revive.
threads.quote: I've made a few small adjustments. Its body will soon break down and disintegrate.

threads.claim: Ove's reason for locking the children away from the assembly hall is unexplained.
threads.quote: Nobody knows why he keeps doing that.

threads.claim: The door to the home is only meant for the chosen ones, a restriction the story leaves open.
threads.quote: This is the doorway to home. Only the ones who are chosen can go through and become eternal life free of all worries.

threads.claim: The Traveler is cast as the Descender and as the one chosen to replace Aksinya's intended role.
threads.quote: You chose the Descender.

threads.claim: The figure says the Traveler was chosen in Aksinya's place, and that the outcome was designed from the start.
threads.quote: That the one who would appear here would be someone else — Aksinya.

introduced.name: Icayo
introduced.how: Self-introduced as an adventurer who loves chasing Saurians and sometimes gets chased by them
introduced.quote: The name's Icayo. As you can see, I'm an adventurer who loves chasing Saurians... and who sometimes winds up being chased by them.

introduced.name: Ripple
introduced.how: Learned to be a Koholasaur, Icayo's beloved companion
introduced.quote: So... Ripple's this Koholasaur's name, huh?

introduced.name: Jade
introduced.how: Learned to be a playful Yumkasaurus, Icayo's companion
introduced.quote: Ah, so that little Yumkasaur is named "Jade." Playful, too, sounds like.

introduced.name: Marigold
introduced.how: Learned to be a grumpy Tepetlisaurus, Icayo's companion who fights strangers
introduced.quote: Err, so Marigold's that grumpy Tepetlisaurus, then?

introduced.name: Sour Sauce Ceviche
introduced.how: A dish Ripple loves, whose recipe Icayo gives away
introduced.quote: Please, take this Sour Sauce Ceviche recipe of mine, would you?

introduced.name: Icayo's illness
introduced.how: Icayo was bedridden by ill-health, which weakened him and kept him from his Saurians
introduced.quote: I had a spell of ill-health that resulted in my being bedridden for a while.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Saurians are simple creatures that follow emotion and trust companions rather than judging right from wrong
introduced.quote: Saurians are simple creatures that cannot easily distinguish right from wrong.

introduced.name: Note in a Drift Bottle
introduced.how: A bottle holding messages between two secret fishing friends who hide their outings from family
introduced.quote: Seems like they're using this bottle to pass messages to one another...

introduced.name: Imix
introduced.how: Shopkeeper at the Gemporium who explains their gem cutting and recommends the Gem Master
introduced.quote: Welcome to our shop! If you'd like us to cut a gemstone, you're in the right place!

introduced.name: Kulahaw
introduced.how: Eccentric Gem Master who gathers inspiration from nature instead of blueprints
introduced.quote: Yeah! Master Kulahaw is pretty unusual even among master craftsmen.

introduced.name: Gathering inspiration
introduced.how: Kulahaw's practice of drawing craft techniques from observing nature
introduced.quote: For example, learning polishing techniques from the tiny ripples on a lake's surface

introduced.name: Strange Yumkasaurus
introduced.how: A Yumkasaur left alone in a cave, blocking the entrance and waiting for its absent master
introduced.quote: And that is the Yumkasaur who never left my side, my companion.

introduced.name: Former courier
introduced.how: Unnamed courier who cheated people for money, fell ill, and abandoned his Yumkasaur
introduced.quote: To accumulate wealth, I took advantage of all the information I had access to as a courier and cheated many people.

introduced.name: Wayna
introduced.how: Tribal leader who explains the courier left the tribe in disgrace and will feed the Yumkasaur
introduced.quote: He was one who did wrong, then in fear of punishment, left the tribe of his own accord.

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: A tribe whose Chief Wayna oversees the Yumkasaur and the exiled courier's case
introduced.quote: Let's go find the Chief of the Scions of the Canopy and tell him about this.

introduced.name: Akatanga
introduced.how: Self-introduced filmmaker trying to make a Tepetlisaur film in Natlan
introduced.quote: Oh, hello! Are you guys interested in filmmaking too?

introduced.name: Wactana
introduced.how: Easygoing shepherd who lets his Yumkasaur guard his Alpacas
introduced.quote: Just leave all the Alpaca care to your Saurian, like I do, and the world's your oyster!

introduced.name: Half-Baked
introduced.how: Vigilant Yumkasaurus guarding the Alpacas, wary of strangers
introduced.quote: Gets all antsy when there are strangers about.

introduced.name: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
introduced.how: Caretaker of the little Tepetlisaurs who looks after the group
introduced.quote: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus: Hehe, so much energy... Very good...

introduced.name: Gift gem
introduced.how: A shiny gem the Traveler and Paimon exchange as gifts, later cut by Kulahaw
introduced.quote: Ta-da! It's a super shiny gem! Do you like it, ?

introduced.name: Rest area
introduced.how: Place where items are stored, reached through the golden pillars
introduced.quote: has been stored in the rest area

introduced.name: Quipia
introduced.how: Excavation-site collector who sets prices and offers to buy a relic for 10,000 Mora
introduced.quote: Three hundred Mora entry fee...

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association
introduced.how: Sets excavation fees and appraises relic values
introduced.quote: The price is set by the Saurian Relics Association, and cannot be negotiated.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: Energy that Natlan plants can absorb; visible as flow patterns in relics
introduced.quote: It is very well-preserved, with clearly-visible phlogiston flow patterns.

introduced.name: Embercore Flower
introduced.how: A flower that grows from a seed needing enough Phlogiston to sprout
introduced.quote: Paimon didn't realize it was an Embercore Flower seed. No wonder it didn't sprout before! There simply wasn't enough Phlogiston in it.

introduced.name: Blubberbeast
introduced.how: Water-dwelling creature that eats fish and is kept captive by traffickers
introduced.quote: Blubberbeasts live in the water, so it must eat fish, right? Let's do a fish dish, then.

introduced.name: Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
introduced.how: Natlan's special fish dish, cooked step by step with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Natlan's special Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce might be a pretty good choice.

introduced.name: Oeno
introduced.how: Trafficker boss who styles himself Oeno, the Gilded Dragonclaw
introduced.quote: Seeing as you're standing in the way of our profits, I'm afraid that I

introduced.name: Night Owl
introduced.how: Saurian trafficker who offers to become the Traveler's sidekick
introduced.quote: You think talking tough's going to make us a living? I can see it now, I tell you. We're just living like thieves and crooks.

introduced.name: Mouse
introduced.how: Saurian trafficker who fights the Traveler alongside Night Owl
introduced.quote: Ugh, you're... tougher than you look...

introduced.name: Saurian traffickers
introduced.how: Criminal syndicate that captures Saurians with untraceable weapons and sells them
introduced.quote: There was a cunning criminal syndicate operating in this area who would use weapons that leave no trace to harm people's Saurian companions, then capture them and sell them off for a profit!

introduced.name: Frangible rounds
introduced.how: Enhanced untraceable ammunition that can knock out even a Tatankasaurus
introduced.quote: The boss enhanced the frangible rounds. The new models could knock a Tatankasaurus out cold without even leaving a trace!

introduced.name: Kururuk
introduced.how: Qucusaurus who is deeply distrustful of humans and resists treatment
introduced.quote: Oh, I wouldn't say it's all that tough. It's just that Kururuk's case is somewhat... special. He's deeply distrustful of humans right now, so he resists all treatments and medication.

introduced.name: Mazkal
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Saurian vet who treats wounded or sick Saurians
introduced.quote: Ah, yes, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Mazkal. I usually take care of wounded or sick Saurians nearby.

introduced.name: Qax
introduced.how: Traveling merchant who explains his Saurian King Coconut was hurt and asks for help
introduced.quote: I'm Qax, a traveling merchant. I was out fetching water today when I got separated from my Saurian companion, King Coconut.

introduced.name: King Coconut
introduced.how: Qax's injured Saurian companion who collapsed by the road
introduced.quote: When I got back, my dear Saurian had been hurt somehow, and had fallen down on the side of the road, unable to walk...

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: Tribe that has an itinerant sauro-vet making medical calls
introduced.quote: I know an itinerant sauro-vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who heads out to fixed locations to make medical calls.

introduced.name: Rest Area
introduced.how: Camp built by the group, kept as a rest area for patrols with a bulletin board
introduced.quote: The campsite we built can be kept to serve as a rest area for their patrols, and we can use a bulletin board to warn passersby and help them avoid further ambushes.

introduced.name: Saurian medicine understanding
introduced.how: Saurians may not understand or accept treatment just because it is explained to them
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, Saurians are different from us. Even if you told them something would help them recover quickly, there's no guarantee they'd understand.

introduced.name: Milchi
introduced.how: A lord of the Isle of Night who was driven mad after contact with the pests, and who set the Saurian little ones free.
introduced.quote: And we have all heard of the terrible transformation that befell Lord Milchi after coming into contact with them

introduced.name: Isle of Night
introduced.how: An island where the diarist was sent to watch over the Saurian pests, with a guard post and hidden underground chambers.
introduced.quote: This is my first day on the Isle of Night. Weather's good, but I can't say that about my mood.

introduced.name: Aguara
introduced.how: The name the diarist gave to a hidden Saurian egg, which was placed in hibernation.
introduced.quote: Oh right! Also, while hiding the egg, I gave it the name that I had long since planned to give it: Aguara.

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: A lord whom Milchi confronted and who had called for the Saurians to be eradicated.
introduced.quote: I honestly cannot fathom why Lord Milchi chose not to escape with us, and instead insisted on confronting Och-Kan...

introduced.name: Cinder City
introduced.how: A city whose people blame the Saurian pests for illness and curses, and who keep sending invaders to the Isle of Night.
introduced.quote: Those fools from Cinder City, we chase away one batch of them, and another shows up.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Creatures kept on the Isle of Night, described as big-appetited and energetic, and labelled as pests by outsiders.
introduced.quote: Now even the skinniest Saurians are at least a couple of belly sizes up from what mine would be if I were one of them

introduced.name: Secret Source Sentinels
introduced.how: Guards on the Isle of Night who chase off invaders trying to burn the island.
introduced.quote: Thankfully, the Secret Source Sentinels spotted them and chased them off before it was too late.

introduced.name: Incubator
introduced.how: A device with a manual that is used to hatch the hibernating Saurian egg.
introduced.quote: Hmm, the egg does look like it's in good shape, and there's a manual for the incubator.

introduced.name: Ma'chah
introduced.how: The master who is sitting in a cold spring trying to heat it with intensity, in pursuit of becoming the strongest.
introduced.quote: Yoleehe: Alright, I'll spill the beans. According to the master himself, he's on a journey to become the "strongest."

introduced.name: Yoleehe
introduced.how: An assistant who greets the Traveler and Paimon and explains the cold-spring training problem.
introduced.quote: Yoleehe: Oh, you must be the famous adventurers and Paimon! Wonderful! Now we're saved!

introduced.name: Linaha
introduced.how: A member of the People of the Springs who introduces herself and looks after the little Koholasaurs.
introduced.quote: Linaha: Ah, um... I'm okay now. Oh! I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Linaha, from the People of the Springs.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: A group whose member Linaha identifies herself as belonging to, and who run the hot spring area.
introduced.quote: Linaha: Ah, um... I'm okay now. Oh! I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Linaha, from the People of the Springs.

introduced.name: Koholasaur
introduced.how: Little creatures under Linaha's care that wandered off and blocked the heat vents, making the hot spring cold.
introduced.quote: I'm usually assigned to take care of the little Koholasaurs...

introduced.name: Geothermal vents
introduced.how: Phlogiston vents near the volcano that heat the hot spring, and which the little Koholasaurs had blocked.
introduced.quote: So the hot spring got cold because the little Koholasaurs had the phlogiston vents all blocked up, huh?

introduced.name: The Book of Five Springs
introduced.how: A martial arts book, found in the Masters of the Night-Wind collections, whose teachings Ma'chah follows.
introduced.quote: Yoleehe: Yeah... I know it sounds crazy, but he got this idea from some martial arts book titled "The Book of Five Springs."

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: How are there so many little Tepetlisaurs here? Where in Teyvat did go?

assumed.name: Wayob
assumed.quote: Alas, Wayob above, this too is my punishment.

assumed.name: Little One
assumed.quote: It's for our little Tepetlisaurus companion, ta-da! Here it is—

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Why don't we go find the Children of Echoes? If anyone's got gemsmiths who could shape it for us, it'd be them!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: all the Mora I swindled became restitution

assumed.name: Indwelling
assumed.quote: (Attempt to indwell Marigold)

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: bring this burgeoning new trend to the lands of Natlan

assumed.name: Gemporium
assumed.quote: Drop by the Gemporium in two days' time!

assumed.name: Little One
assumed.quote: Naturally! He's our companion, after all.

assumed.name: Oeno
assumed.quote: Are you serious!? You three, again?

assumed.name: Someday, We All Must Walk Alone
assumed.quote: (If Someday, We All Must Walk Alone is not completed)

assumed.name: Berrypuff
assumed.quote: Hmm... We used to feed fish to the Blubberbeast Berrypuff, didn't we?

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: That said, what sort of nutrients do plants from Natlan need?

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: What on Teyvat's going on? Where did all these flying bugs suddenly come from?

assumed.name: Monetoo
assumed.quote: (After the Monetoo returns to its painting)

assumed.name: Indwell
assumed.quote: (Attempt to indwell the Qucusaurus)

assumed.name: Atlatl
assumed.quote: If only Lord Atlatl were still here... With his help, I'm sure we could have moved it too.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: In short, we'll let it know how great Natlan is now! Once it gets excited enough, it'll surely hatch on its own!

assumed.name: Warrior's Challenge
assumed.quote: Our "Warrior's Challenge" has been put on hold for days, and everyone's waiting for him to come back!

assumed.name: Tepetlisaurs
assumed.quote: Paimon isn't sure how long it takes for Tepetlisaurs to grow up...

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Hehe, back in the Children of Echoes, wasn't there this guy who wanted to be a director

threads.claim: The identity of the former courier who abandoned the Yumkasaur is withheld, leaving him an open mystery.
threads.quote: But I see no good in divulging the offender's name.

threads.claim: The abandoned Yumkasaur keeps waiting for its master to return, raising whether he will ever come back.
threads.quote: When will he be back?

threads.claim: Saurians follow their emotions and trust their companions, which raises questions about their capacity for judgment.
threads.quote: Most of the time, they simply follow their emotions and trust their companions.

threads.claim: Kulahaw's practice of gathering inspiration from nature is questioned and explained as a philosophy of craft.
threads.quote: Oh? So you've heard of the practice before?

threads.claim: Akatanga's friend stormed off with her star Tepetlisaur after a creative spat, leaving the project unfinished.
threads.quote: We had an almighty spat over our creative differences, after which she stormed off with my most important actor...

threads.claim: Akatanga hopes her estranged friend might change her mind after seeing the film.
threads.quote: Who knows, perhaps that friend of mine might even have a change of heart once she sees this...

threads.claim: Icayo is reunited with all of his Saurians at once, answering the diary's account of his bond with them.
threads.quote: Didn't expect all of you to show up at once, of course — but I suppose that's what they call "triple the happiness"?

threads.claim: The glowing golden pillars are unexplained and may vanish once the Traveler leaves.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders if those glowing pillars will disappear after we leave this time...

threads.claim: The Traveler seems to have spent much time at the pillars before meeting Paimon, hinting at an unexplained past.
threads.quote: you must've spent a lot of time here before you met us...

threads.claim: A Saurian trafficking ring may be operating in the area, and the group may have stumbled into it.
threads.quote: Have we busted some kinda Saurian trafficking ring without even realizing it?

threads.claim: The traffickers plan to use enhanced rounds to capture whichever Saurians they want and profit from them.
threads.quote: Once those new rounds have been distributed amongst us, we'll be able to capture whichever Saurians we like. We'll strike it rich sooner or later!

threads.claim: The syndicate takes a heavy blow and many captured animals are rescued, though accomplices may remain at large.
threads.quote: They dealt a heavy blow to this syndicate, and rescued many of the captured animals!

threads.claim: A weapon exists that harms Saurians without leaving any trace of how they were hurt.
threads.quote: The boss enhanced the frangible rounds. The new models could knock a Tatankasaurus out cold without even leaving a trace!

threads.claim: King Coconut's internal injuries seem to match a high-speed rock, but no loose rocks were found nearby.
threads.quote: He assessed that King Coconut was hit by a rock flying at high speed and suffered internal injuries... I can't put two and two together, though.

threads.claim: Relics and plants from Natlan carry phlogiston, which is visible in their flow patterns and may be what makes them special.
threads.quote: It is very well-preserved, with clearly-visible phlogiston flow patterns.

threads.claim: Some seeds may still be alive under hard ground and could sprout if given the right nutrients.
threads.quote: Could this seed really still be alive?

threads.claim: The phlogiston-fed seed survived and bloomed into an Embercore Flower.
threads.quote: The seed didn't die. If anything, it's blooming super nicely!

threads.claim: Kururuk distrusts humans so deeply that he resists all treatment.
threads.quote: He's deeply distrustful of humans right now, so he resists all treatments and medication.

threads.claim: Mazkal worries Kururuk's temper may keep his injuries from healing, and the problem is not yet solved.
threads.quote: As for that... Not to worry, I'll figure something out. And you never know, his temper might improve along with his wounds!

threads.claim: Mazkal reacts as if the Traveler might secretly be a Saurian despite their appearance.
threads.quote: Wait, you're saying that despite your appearance, you're actually Saurians!?

threads.claim: The Traveler admits to having once been cold and cruel, hinting at an unexplained past.
threads.quote: Yes, I should've been cold and cruel back then!

threads.claim: The rescued Blubberbeast may return and cross paths with the group again.
threads.quote: Anyway, Paimon's got a feeling that this isn't the last we've seen of that Blubberbeast!

threads.claim: Collectors' passion for objects is unpredictable and can shift to new interests.
threads.quote: Thank you, but a collector's passion is as fickle as the tides.

threads.claim: Little One has grown into a big Saurian, and its current whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders where he is or what he's doing right now...

threads.claim: Outsiders believe the Saurian pests spread an illness and curse that transforms and kills those who come into contact with them.
threads.quote: I have heard messengers from Cinder City tell of how those who encountered these pests would fall into the throes of an illness

threads.claim: The little Saurian's curse has been lifted, letting it grow up healthy.
threads.quote: Now that the little one's curse has been lifted, he can finally grow up big and strong!

threads.claim: The Isle of Night's keepers dismiss the Cinder City claims of illness and curses as nonsense while fighting off repeated invaders.
threads.quote: Ha! Illnesses? Festering wounds? Where did they get such nonsense from?

threads.claim: Lord Milchi was transformed into a raging figure after contact with the pests, and the cause remains unexplained.
threads.quote: And we have all heard of the terrible transformation that befell Lord Milchi after coming into contact with them

threads.claim: The diarist who wrote these notes was hiding and expected to die, leaving their fate open.
threads.quote: This will probably end up being the last diary entry I make.

threads.claim: The hidden Saurian egg named Aguara was placed in hibernation and its hatching time is uncertain.
threads.quote: But I cannot let go of Aguara.

threads.claim: The egg refuses to hatch in the incubator, and the Traveler guesses it is because it does not believe Natlan is ready.
threads.quote: Maybe the egg isn't hatching because it thinks Natlan hasn't changed and isn't suited to be its home!

threads.claim: The martial arts stories in The Book of Five Springs may or may not be true, and the question is left open.
threads.quote: Yoleehe: Could it be... that everything written in "The Book of Five Springs" is true...?

threads.claim: The Traveler wants to set off on their own adventure, so the group must part ways.
threads.quote: You want to set off on your own adventure...

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild figure who gives the Traveler the Sign of Apaosha commission
introduced.quote: Katheryne explains that the Akademiya issued this commission to resolve a strange, concerning phenomenon in the northern desert

introduced.name: Sign of Apaosha
introduced.how: a strange celestial phenomenon blocking the northern skies, linked to the cataclysm
introduced.quote: they found mention of a strange phenomenon known as the Sign of Apaosha, which bears strong similarities to the recent occurrence.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: scholarly organization that issued the commission and restricted the northern desert
introduced.quote: As far as I know, the Akademiya of the rainforest has declared this area a restricted zone.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: desert group split from the Akademiya 500 years ago that controls the northern area
introduced.quote: Though they seem like legends to the average person, they were once a Darshan of the Akademiya, albeit one that split off five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Pyrrho
introduced.how: Order of Skeptics guard who blocks the Traveler and is defeated in combat
introduced.quote: Pyrrho: My apologies, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Pyrrho, a member of the Order of Skeptics in charge of guarding this place.

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: Pari who declares herself willing to sacrifice herself to end the Sign and names the Traveler her Yasnapati
introduced.quote: We Pari appear before whoever we wish, and our volition is not for you mere mortals to question.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: winged-like beings tied to the land, descended from the divine bird Simurgh
introduced.quote: We Pari appear before whoever we wish, and our volition is not for you mere mortals to question.

introduced.name: Simurgh
introduced.how: legendary divine bird and master of Khvarena who saved the land by sacrificing herself
introduced.quote: Sorush: Foolish beings, have you not heard of the divine bird Simurgh? She is the master of Khvarena who once saved the land from destruction.

introduced.name: Nasejuna
introduced.how: Vijnanapati of the Order of Skeptics who introduces himself and guides the rite
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Ah, I forgot my introductions. I am Nasejuna, the Vijnanapati of the Order of Skeptics, we who cultivate ourselves here.

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: Pari elder, the First Pari, who controls the Twin-Horned Chaplet
introduced.quote: she must first be acknowledged by Lady Zurvan, the First Pari.

introduced.name: Rashnu
introduced.how: Pari the group must find to earn the chaplet
introduced.quote: Zurvan orders Sorush to prove herself trustworthy enough for the chaplet by first finding two other Pari, Rashnu and Mihir.

introduced.name: Mihir
introduced.how: Pari the group must find to earn the chaplet
introduced.quote: Zurvan orders Sorush to prove herself trustworthy enough for the chaplet by first finding two other Pari, Rashnu and Mihir.

introduced.name: Yasnapati
introduced.how: a role Sorush assigns to the Traveler, a chronicler who records a Pari's deeds
introduced.quote: I have decided, then. You shall have the honor of being my Yasnapati!

introduced.name: Great Songs of Khvarena
introduced.how: the mightiest manifestations of Khvarena, needed to perform the rite
introduced.quote: They are the mightiest manifestations of the Khvarena scattered throughout the world.

introduced.name: Rite of Chinvat
introduced.how: a Pari ritual using the Great Songs to open a path through the darkness toward the Sign
introduced.quote: This is a ritual performed by the Pari that will allow us to open a path through the darkness.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: a form of energy worshipped by the Order that manifests as spirits and defends the land
introduced.quote: It seems that they also worship a form of energy known as Khvarena.

introduced.name: Twin-Horned Chaplet
introduced.how: a chaplet that grants a Pari the status of Bloomguard and access to the Great Songs
introduced.quote: Sorush prays to the Khvarena and becomes acknowledged as a Bloomguard, and grows a Twin-Horned Chaplet on her head.

introduced.name: Korybantes: Vedana
introduced.how: a mysterious drum with a Cryo marking, a catalyst for the ritual
introduced.quote: A mysterious drum. This one has a Cryo marking on it.

introduced.name: Nameless Adventurer's Notes
introduced.how: a note left by a previous adventurer explaining the drum's commission
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm, hold on. There's a note over there at the side. It might just hold some clues!

introduced.name: Gray Crystals
introduced.how: remnants of black fire embers that spread across the land and may hold impurities
introduced.quote: Gray Crystals are remnants of the black fire's embers. Proof that this land has suffered great calamity.

introduced.name: Harvisptokhm
introduced.how: the sacred tree that is the form of the Pari's god, holding back the Sign's corruption
introduced.quote: That is the Harvisptokhm, the sacred form of the god that has granted us Pari life.

introduced.name: Tunigi Hollow
introduced.how: a rift from the ancient disaster, sealed by the tree, that the Sign reflects
introduced.quote: The monsters tore open a great rift that came to be called the Tunigi Hollow, and though they were sealed away with the new vein of the ancient tree, this mysterious sign appeared along with that.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: a disaster 500 years ago that engulfed most of Teyvat and created the Sign
introduced.quote: Katheryne: According to these records, this celestial sign appeared after the disaster that engulfed most of Teyvat five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
