introduced.how: ancient ruins nearby that the Akademiya had declared taboo to explore
introduced.quote: Ruins related to Khaenri'ah are located nearby, but exploration in that area has been declared taboo by the Akademiya until now.

introduced.name: Nagarjuna
introduced.how: the first Vijnanapati who reportedly fought with the Pari and performed the rite
introduced.quote: Lord Nagarjuna is a hero who fought against the

introduced.name: Dev
introduced.how: demonic monsters that have occupied the land
introduced.quote: To think that this place, too, has been occupied by Dev!

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: Pari elder who greets the travelers and speaks of the Pari's role
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Adventurers... So you are travelers, then?

introduced.name: Mihir
introduced.how: Pari familiar of thorns, trapped and corrupted in the purple mist
introduced.quote: Mihir: Sorush, Sorush... Sorush who took humans for companions. Sorush who lost her way.

introduced.name: Nasejuna
introduced.how: Order of Skeptics member, revealed to be Nasuraia, a human scholar
introduced.quote: Sorush: He is no ordinary human. He is the Nasuraia of the Order of Skeptics.

introduced.name: Klingsor
introduced.how: Abyss priest who arrives to back up Nasejuna
introduced.quote: Klingsor: Outlander, hand over the Khvarena!

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: Sacred beings who guard a paradise nourished by Amrita and revere a great god
introduced.quote: Zurvan: This is the forbidden land of the Pari, the paradise nourished by Amrita, the shrine at which we pay reverence to our great god.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: Human order that has forgotten the Pari's traditional rites and is shunned by them
introduced.quote: Zurvan: But many years have passed, and folly has grown strong amongst them. Even the traditional rites have become utterly forgotten.

introduced.name: Dahri
introduced.how: Ancient warrior people, said to be the Skeptics' true ancestors who resisted the impurities
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: According to my research, those who resisted the impurities here were heroes of the Dahri. They are the Skeptics' true ancestors.

introduced.name: Simurgh
introduced.how: Divine bird who drank Amrita and created countless beings from Khvarena
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The divine bird Simurgh drank the Amrita and mixed her Khvarena with the water's essence, thus creating countless beings.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: Motes of divine energy created by Simurgh; the Pari are the sentient ones
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Among the countless motes of Khvarena, the ones blessed with sentience are us, the Pari.

introduced.name: Sign of Apaosha
introduced.how: A sky phenomenon caused by the build-up of defilement
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The appearance of the Sign of Apaosha is a result of the constant build-up of defilement.

introduced.name: Dark Hollow
introduced.how: Dark abyssal hollow held down by a tree and its seal, now leaking defilement
introduced.quote: Zurvan: They should have been the ones to conduct the Rite of Ab-Zohr for the tree that suppresses the dark hollow, thus cleansing it of the filth that stained it.

introduced.name: Purple Mist
introduced.how: Purple mist below that shares its source with the demons of Dev
introduced.quote: Sorush: The power of the purple mist beneath us shares a source with the demons of Dev.

introduced.name: Gray Gate
introduced.how: Barrier used to seal demons and a Pari inside a location
introduced.quote: Sorush: She must've found some position equal in seclusion and defensibility, before using a Gray Gate to seal both the demons and herself in.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Carefree people who are like a big family, protecting one another
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's right! They're like a big family, always protecting one another! So you Pari aren't like that, huh...

introduced.name: Great Song of Khvarena
introduced.how: Five powerful songs fused from Khvarena that purify the land
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Later, I was the one who fused the strongest Khvarena collected there into five Great Songs, which I used to purify the land.

introduced.name: Twin-Horned Chaplet
introduced.how: Crown symbolizing Khvarena's recognition, granted to a Bloomguard
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Hehe. Now, the Chaplet is the symbol of Khvarena's recognition. How could it be given away based on private whims?

introduced.name: Rite of Chinvat
introduced.how: Ritual to cross the darkness and cleanse the mother-tree, once performed by Zurvan with human heroes
introduced.quote: Zurvan: I did once travel alongside human heroes to cross the darkness through the Rite and cleanse the impurities tainting the mother-tree.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: Disaster 500 years ago when monsters surged from beneath the earth
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: According to these records, they resisted the monsters that surged forth from beneath the earth during the cataclysm that occurred 500 years ago.

introduced.name: Sign of Truth
introduced.how: Dahri name for the sky sign, believed to reflect a reality beyond the skies
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: They called this the Sign of Truth, believing that it reflected the "reality" beyond our skies...

introduced.name: Gray Crystal
introduced.how: Crystal that seals relays in ruins and must be broken with Farrwicks
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: But just as with the previous ruins, the relays powering the elevator have been sealed by Gray Crystals. We will need to find Farrwicks to eliminate them.

introduced.name: Farrwick
introduced.how: Items used to eliminate the Gray Crystal seals on ruin relays
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: But just as with the previous ruins, the relays powering the elevator have been sealed by Gray Crystals. We will need to find Farrwicks to eliminate them.

introduced.name: Azosite
introduced.how: Energy block substance made in a giant furnace in the Dahrian factory
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: This giant furnace is used to make a substance known as Azosite.

introduced.name: Rene's Investigation Notes
introduced.how: Notes from researchers stranded in the ruins, containing Khvarena research
introduced.quote: (Open Rene's Investigation Notes)

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: A group that Nasejuna allied with to take the Great Khvarena
introduced.quote: Paimon: To think that he'd gang up with the Abyss Order to take our Great Khvarena!

introduced.name: Rene's Investigation Notes
introduced.how: A scholarly book on Dahrian ruins that Nasejuna uses as a guide
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Have you never heard of it? I thought that only one sequestered in a distant desert such as I would not have heard of such a brilliant scholar.

introduced.name: Dahrians
introduced.how: An ancient people who built machines and ruins and once tested them in a proving ground
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Once we go in here, we shall be within the proving ground that the Dahrians once used to test their machines.

introduced.name: Dahrian proving ground
introduced.how: A deep ruin that was once a Dahrian research and testing facility, later fortified against monsters
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: According to the notes I have, this was once a proving ground where the Dahrians would conduct research and tests.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: A people whose workshops were left in the Dahrian ruins and who drew up the schematics
introduced.quote: I have drawn up these schematics based on structural diagrams of workshops left within the ruins by Khaenri'ahns.

introduced.name: Azosite
introduced.how: A form of energy drawn from pure elemental energy and formed into blocks that power ruin cores
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: On the contrary, it seems that they used a form of energy known as Azosite. It was drawn from pure elemental energy before being formed into blocks.

introduced.name: Gray Crystal
introduced.how: Crystal that seals ruin mechanisms and must be removed with Khvarena's power
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Well, I suppose this can be discussed later. Our current task is still to use Khvarena's power to remove the Gray Crystals that have formed those seals.

introduced.name: Kory Drums
introduced.how: Drums the Skeptics crafted for Barsom's familiar, which must be played in sets of five to a score
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Barsom's familiar had a preference for music, so we crafted Kory Drums for her.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: Scions of a divine bird who formed a bond with the Order of Skeptics long ago
introduced.quote: It is the tale of our meeting with the Pari, the scions of the divine bird, and the long years of war we have endured here in this land thereafter.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: A human order that lost its Kory Drums in one night and has searched for them since
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: As the elders put it, when the Kory Drums were lost in a single night, the Order of Skeptics was overcome with great grief.

introduced.name: Great Song of Khvarena
introduced.how: A power source Zurvan used to seal the Vourukasha Oasis and the ruins
introduced.quote: Zurvan: To ensure that I left no gaps for them to exploit, I sealed the Vourukasha Oasis and the many ruins with the power of the Great Songs.

introduced.name: Dark Hollow
introduced.how: Followers who sought the Great Songs and sent Dev demons to attack the Vourukasha Oasis
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Then came the followers of the dark hollow. They were after the Great Songs of Khvarena and for that purpose, they summoned countless demons of Dev to attack the Vourukasha Oasis.

introduced.name: Aryadeva
introduced.how: An elder Skeptic who left for Sumeru City to write light novels and failed to retrieve a Kory Drum in his youth
introduced.quote: I refer to an elder amongst the Order of Skeptics who left for Sumeru City to work on his... light novels, the dratted things.

introduced.name: Rashnu
introduced.how: A sleepy Pari who is Barsom's familiar and answers to Kory Drum music
introduced.quote: Paimon: She must be Rashnu. Don't you think she seems kinda... tired, though?

introduced.name: Mihir
introduced.how: A Pari who helps remove the seal and asks the party to tend the corroded trees
introduced.quote: Mihir: In that case, let us remove the seal. Then you can gather the power of Khvarena with the Great Songs.

introduced.name: Harvisptokhm
introduced.how: A tree-based sacred site whose defilement is causing the sky anomaly
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The anomaly appeared above the Harvisptokhm as a result of the tree absorbing a great amount of defilement.

introduced.name: Rite of Ab-Zohr
introduced.how: A ritual performed under trees to cleanse the Harvisptokhm of defilement
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The Rite of Ab-Zohr is a ritual performed to cleanse the Harvisptokhm of defilement.

introduced.name: Gaokerena
introduced.how: A giant lotus inside the Harvisptokhm where the god's consciousness slumbers
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Inside the Harvisptokhm lies a giant lotus, Gaokerena, and our god's consciousness slumbers within it.

introduced.name: Twin-Horned Chaplet
introduced.how: A headpiece that lets its wearer connect to the memories and wisdom of the Harvisptokhm
introduced.quote: Mihir: Now that Sorush has already put on the Twin-Horned Chaplet, she can connect to the memories and wisdom of the Harvisptokhm using the Chaplet.

introduced.name: Cataclysm
introduced.how: A past disaster that the Dahrian-era trees were cultivated with Khvarena to resist
introduced.quote: Mihir: These trees were originally cultivated with Khvarena to resist the corrosion of the cataclysm.

introduced.name: Amrita
introduced.how: A substance that cleanses the land of impurities and falls from the sky
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The Amrita will rid the land of all its impurities.

introduced.name: Khvarena power
introduced.how: Pari power comes from the same source as Khvarena, similar to human use of elements
introduced.quote: Mihir: We Pari are different, for our power and that of the Khvarena hail from the same source.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: A gift that lets its holder bend the elements, which Nasejuna lacks and the Traveler lacks too
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: And yet, you're capable of bending the elements to your will... What an enviable gift.

introduced.name: defiling disaster
introduced.how: A catastrophe that the Dahrians triggered
introduced.quote: Nasejuna: Strange, isn't it? Why would the Dahrians, who triggered the defiling disaster, create machines to fight monsters?

introduced.name: Vourukasha Oasis
introduced.how: The home of the Pari, which was attacked and then sealed
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Although we managed to protect our home with the help of many Pari and human warriors, we didn't eradicate the dark hollow's followers.

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: an ancient Pari who awoke in the sea of flowers and fought monsters with Khvarena
introduced.quote: Zurvan: A long, long time ago, when I had first awakened amidst the sea of flowers, the skies were filled with anomalies of the dark hollow

introduced.name: sea of flowers
introduced.how: the refuge land where Zurvan awoke and where monsters did not roam
introduced.quote: Zurvan: A long, long time ago, when I had first awakened amidst the sea of flowers, the skies were filled with anomalies of the dark hollow

introduced.name: Gaokerena
introduced.how: a giant lotus tree, the Harvisptokhm's sacred lotus
introduced.quote: Paimon: But the tree opened up after that, and we followed the path in. This is... the giant lotus, Gaokerena, that Zurvan was talking about, right?

introduced.name: Defiled Chambers
introduced.how: trial areas inside the god's consciousness where impurities trap the Spenta Hearts
introduced.quote: Sorush: We must enter the Defiled Chambers within our god's consciousness to rescue the Spenta Hearts trapped inside the impurities. Only then will the consciousness reawaken.

introduced.name: Spenta Hearts
introduced.how: the god's hearts, trapped in impurities and needed to awaken the consciousness
introduced.quote: Sorush: We must enter the Defiled Chambers within our god's consciousness to rescue the Spenta Hearts trapped inside the impurities. Only then will the consciousness reawaken.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: a power that once let the god resist defilement corrosion
introduced.quote: Sorush: In the past, it was by the power of Khvarena that our lord god resisted the corrosion of defilement.

introduced.name: Amrita
introduced.how: a purifying power that cleanses defiled skies and earth
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Thus did we enter the tree and use Amrita to purify the defiled skies and earth.

introduced.name: Flower of Sanctity
introduced.how: a flower to be made to bloom again within Gaokerena, spreading Amrita to cleanse the land
introduced.quote: Sorush: Next, I shall borrow the power of Khvarena to make the Flower of Sanctity bloom once again within Gaokerena.

introduced.name: Rite of Ab-Zohr
introduced.how: the ritual of clearing defilement and blooming the Flower of Sanctity to awaken the god
introduced.quote: Sorush: Next, I shall borrow the power of Khvarena to make the Flower of Sanctity bloom once again within Gaokerena.

introduced.name: Dahrians
introduced.how: an ancient people whose ruins and machines fought the monsters alongside the scholars
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Later, we entered a ruin left by the Dahrians together, and there we found machines that had stood against the monsters

introduced.name: masked swordsman
introduced.how: a cursed Dahri swordsman found by Zurvan holding a ring, who traveled with Zurvan
introduced.quote: Zurvan: I brought him back to the sea of flowers, and when he awoke, he claimed to be a Dahri swordsman who had only survived because he had been cursed.

introduced.name: one-armed sage
introduced.how: a scholar leader from east of the desert who found the path to the Harvisptokhm and later went underground
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Not long after that, people in scholarly garb led by a one-armed sage came forth from lands east of the desert.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: beings born from the sea of flowers that bond with humans and fought the monsters
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Thus did we enter the tree and use Amrita to purify the defiled skies and earth. After that, the sea of flowers would constantly birth Pari, and the monsters slowly disappeared from the land.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: humans who stayed behind, bonded with Pari, and settled the land under this name
introduced.quote: Zurvan: The humans who remained would forge bonds with the newborn Pari and call themselves the Order of Skeptics as they settled here.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Sounds like it'll be pretty easy! And we'll get some Mora from the Akademiya, too...

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Pyrrho, optional)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Traveler: I'm guessing those were the Fatui?

assumed.name: Wenut
assumed.quote: Paimon: Could this be one of those Wenut that we've seen before? How did it get trapped here?

assumed.name: Eremite
assumed.quote: I reached the entrance to the Temir Mountains with the help of an Eremite mercenary

assumed.name: Abyss Mages
assumed.quote: Aren't these just Abyss Mages and hilichurls?

assumed.name: Nasuraja
assumed.quote: Mihir accuses Sorush of being influenced by Nasuraja.

assumed.name: Sorush
assumed.quote: Zurvan: Well now! If it isn't Sorush and her Yasnapati.

assumed.name: Rashnu
assumed.quote: Zurvan: Well, as for that... You do know where Rashnu and Mihir are, right? Go bring them here. They should still be enjoying their beauty sleep right now.

assumed.name: Sumeru Akademiya
assumed.quote: Nasejuna: Their deeds were wiped from the records by the thrice-be-damned Akademiya, and then mistakenly appropriated as a founding myth by the Skeptics...

assumed.name: Harvisptokhm
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're finally outta there. We can already see the Harvisptokhm!

assumed.name: Sorush
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sorush's been pretty quiet since we left the ruined factory.

assumed.name: Zurvan
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zurvan, we're back!

assumed.name: Khvarena's Envoy
assumed.quote: Nasejuna: Khvarena's Envoy, if you would, please open the way within for us.

assumed.name: Bloomguard
assumed.quote: Sorush: Umm... Hmph. Of course! Are you doubting my majestic power as the Bloomguard?

assumed.name: Yasnapati
assumed.quote: Nasejuna: Ah, raring to go, I see. That's the Envoy's Yasnapati, indeed.

assumed.name: Setekh Wenut
assumed.quote: But with how little effect the Great Song of Khvarena is having even in the immediate vicinity of the petrified Setekh Wenut, it seems like it only affects those related to the Abyss.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Speaking of that, we did find Kory Drums other than the one Katheryne gave us! Not the whole set of five, but still...

assumed.name: The Sign of Apaosha
assumed.quote: For how then would they aid me in my great work of extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha?

assumed.name: Harvisptokhm
assumed.quote: Sorush: I have obtained the Twin-Horned Chaplet, so why is the Harvisptokhm rejecting me? This shouldn't be happening... *sob*

assumed.name: Twin-Horned Chaplet
assumed.quote: Sorush: *sob* It's the Twin-Horned Chaplet... Something is... coming in!

assumed.name: Nasejuna
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Dahrian machines... Wait, did things really go the way Nasejuna said they did?

assumed.name: Sign of Apaosha
assumed.quote: Sorush: The Sign of Apaosha has been extinguished, and the earth has been purified. To think that this could be done even without any sacrifice...

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Paimon: A masked swordsman from Khaenri'ah. Do you think that could be...

assumed.name: Bloomguard
assumed.quote: Sorush: Hmph! Leave this matter to me! I am the Bloomguard after all!

assumed.name: Yasnapati
assumed.quote: Zurvan: As for Sorush, I leave her to you. Do guide her well in your journey — this is, after all, also the work of a Yasnapati.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're back, Katheryne!

assumed.name: Nagarjunites
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ah, yes. We did ask you to contact the Nagarjunites previously. Were they of any help to you, I wonder?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Well... The Adventurers' Guild is obligated to keep the identities of those who submit commissions confidential.

threads.claim: The Sign of Apaosha is an unexplained celestial blockage in the northern skies whose nature is unknown.
threads.quote: the northern skies have become blocked by a strange, heretofore unseen phenomenon.

threads.claim: Even the Order's leader admits that the nature of the Sign and how to extinguish it remain unresolved.
threads.quote: Well... In truth, I do not know. All documents regarding the Sign of Apaosha have long been lost

threads.claim: Sorush intends to sacrifice herself to end the Sign, a plan the Traveler is told is necessary.
threads.quote: To quell this calamity, I must follow in the footsteps of the divine bird Simurgh, and sacrifice everything

threads.claim: Paimon doubts that a sacrifice is needed and asks whether other solutions exist.
threads.quote: Why aren't we thinking of other ways to solve this issue?

threads.claim: Simurgh's legendary self-sacrifice serves as the model for the Pari's mission.
threads.quote: Legend has it that it was she who split into infinite motes of Khvarena after her sacrifice, thus quelling the catastrophe.

threads.claim: The Pari's god gave herself to quell the disaster 500 years ago, and her corruption persists.
threads.quote: Five hundred years ago, our great god gave all to quell the power of the disaster afflicting this place.

threads.claim: Dark fire that rose from beneath the earth left Gray Crystals behind, and their cause is still unclear.
threads.quote: Gray Crystals are remnants of the black fire's embers.

threads.claim: A sealed rift from the ancient disaster connects to the illusion of the Sign, which still radiates corruption.
threads.quote: The monsters tore open a great rift that came to be called the Tunigi Hollow, and though they were sealed away with the new vein of the ancient tree, this mysterious sign appeared along with that.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah ruins lie near the Sign, and the Akademiya has long kept people out of them.
threads.quote: Ruins related to Khaenri'ah are located nearby, but exploration in that area has been declared taboo by the Akademiya until now.

threads.claim: The Order of Skeptics split from the Akademiya over ideals, and the rift between them is bitter and disputed.
threads.quote: It is said that our predecessors had a clash of ideals with them, and so chose to go into the desert to stand against the darkness themselves.

threads.claim: Nasejuna plans to use the drum as a catalyst for a ritual tied to his own goals against the Akademiya.
threads.quote: Hahaha! Yes. This is an important catalyst for the ritual needed to forge a Laupa between ourselves and the Pari.

threads.claim: Nasejuna's pretended devotion is revealed as a ploy to seize the Great Songs and release the Abyss.
threads.quote: Nasejuna snaps at Sorush, blowing his cover and revealing he was only pretending to worship her

threads.claim: Nasejuna questions whether the legend of Nagarjuna extinguishing the Sign is only myth.
threads.quote: I have encountered legends that our first Vijnanapati Nagarjuna was lifted up to the heavens, where he used divine power to extinguish the sign, but that, I feel, is mere myth.

threads.claim: The Great Songs are scattered across the land, and Zurvan has hidden one for future use.
threads.quote: Zurvan explains that the Great Songs were scattered throughout the land

threads.claim: Zurvan grows suspicious that Nasejuna knows about the Great Songs when only she should.
threads.quote: Zurvan becomes suspicious of Nasejuna for having knowledge of the Songs due to Zurvan being the only one who should know about their existence.

threads.claim: The Pari's god is stained with corruption and cannot be reborn, so her consciousness wanders the mortal realm.
threads.quote: But she was stained with corruption, and could not be reborn in a purer plane.

threads.claim: Zurvan withholds the chaplet, fearing that handing Khvarena's authority to humans would be dangerous.
threads.quote: The Chaplet you seek contains the highest authority over Khvarena.

threads.claim: Wenut are described as children of an ancient dragon, and at least one has been sealed away.
threads.quote: Paimon: Could this be one of those Wenut that we've seen before? How did it get trapped here?

threads.claim: The Sign of Apaosha reappeared sooner than it should have because the Rite was neglected and the seal weakened.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Yes, the deterioration of the tree cannot be avoided, but if they had not neglected the Rite and caused the seal to weaken, this terrifying Sign would never have reappeared so soon.

threads.claim: Sorush intends to offer herself as a sacrifice to extinguish the Sign of Apaosha.
threads.quote: Sorush: Now I need only offer myself as a sacrifice to extinguish the Sign of Apaosha...

threads.claim: Dahri records describe the sky sign as a Sign of Truth reflecting a reality beyond the skies.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: They called this the Sign of Truth, believing that it reflected the "reality" beyond our skies...

threads.claim: Khvarena is linked to the Elements and to an unknown force, and its nature may explain the notion of conflict.
threads.quote: ...Compared to the powers of the Elements, the power of Khvarena is actually more similar to ██... It assimilates whatever materials and energies it comes into contact with...

threads.claim: The Dahri heroes who resisted the impurities were forgotten and smeared as sinners, a claim Nasejuna says the Akademiya covered up.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: But they were forgotten. Their tale untold. They were smeared as sinners. As the cause behind the disaster.

threads.claim: Human traditions have lost the rites that Pari once shared with humans, and no living human can forge a Laupa with a Pari.
threads.quote: Zurvan: But many years have passed, and folly has grown strong amongst them. Even the traditional rites have become utterly forgotten. None living amongst them now can forge a Laupa with a Pari.

threads.claim: Nasejuna plans to reverse the Rite of Chinvat with the Great Songs to release the seal on the Abyss.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: All that is left now is to use the Great Songs of Khvarena to reverse the Rite of Chinvat, which will release the seal on the Abyss... and the wars of old will begin anew!

threads.claim: Nasejuna's documents about the Great Songs conflict with what Zurvan says the Skeptics could know, raising doubt about their origin.
threads.quote: Zurvan: The Skeptics should not have knowledge of the Great Songs' existence if they relied merely on their traditional records.

threads.claim: One Great Song is hidden in the Sunyata Lake while the others are scattered across the land.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Only one was hidden by me within the waters of the Sunyata Lake here, kept away for a future time of need.

threads.claim: The party gathers all five Great Songs of Khvarena.
threads.quote: Paimon: Nice! And that's all five Great Khvarena in our hands!

threads.claim: Zurvan refuses to give Sorush the Twin-Horned Chaplet, saying it cannot be given on private whims.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Well, we did. But I can't give you the Chaplet.

threads.claim: Sorush is acknowledged by Khvarena and receives the Twin-Horned Chaplet, becoming a Bloomguard.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ooh, so the Chaplet just grows out of your head!

threads.claim: Nasejuna reveals he has been deceiving the party and aims to unseal the Abyss and bring truth to the world.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: Hah! Well. I've said it now, haven't I? I've blown my cover.

threads.claim: Defilement spreads from the same source as the demons of Dev, and the Pari are meant to prevent it.
threads.quote: Mihir: It is the duty of us familiars of the thorn to prevent defilement from spreading across the earth and guard against its corrosion.

threads.claim: A cataclysm 500 years ago released monsters from beneath the earth, and Dahri heroes resisted them.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: According to these records, they resisted the monsters that surged forth from beneath the earth during the cataclysm that occurred 500 years ago.

threads.claim: Nasejuna was enticed by a dark hollow servant into pursuing the Great Songs, revealing his betrayal.
threads.quote: And if I'm not mistaken, Nasejuna had been enticed into pursuing the Great Songs of Khvarena by the servant of the dark hollow you fought.

threads.claim: Nasejuna's sudden ambitions and suspicious behavior hint that he is not trustworthy.
threads.quote: Paimon: Well, now that you mention it, he was pretty suspicious right from the start.

threads.claim: Zurvan may have anticipated the betrayal and the dark hollow's plans before the party learned of them.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh, why does Paimon feel like Zurvan saw what was coming?

threads.claim: Zurvan admits she had suspected the dark hollow's followers were making their move.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Eh-he, so I was on to something! You didn't run into the followers of the dark hollow, did you?

threads.claim: The ruins were intentionally sealed by someone able to use Khvarena, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: The only explanation for that has to be that this place was intentionally sealed by someone with the ability to use Khvarena.

threads.claim: Zurvan reveals she sealed the Vourukasha Oasis and many ruins with the Great Songs to block the dark hollow.
threads.quote: Zurvan: To ensure that I left no gaps for them to exploit, I sealed the Vourukasha Oasis and the many ruins with the power of the Great Songs.

threads.claim: The Dahrians may have caused the defiling disaster, which makes their machines for fighting monsters puzzling.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: Strange, isn't it? Why would the Dahrians, who triggered the defiling disaster, create machines to fight monsters?

threads.claim: The Great Songs seem to affect only things related to the Abyss, which is an open question about their purpose.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: But with how little effect the Great Song of Khvarena is having even in the immediate vicinity of the petrified Setekh Wenut, it seems like it only affects those related to the Abyss.

threads.claim: Rashnu explains that she scattered the Kory Drums so she could sleep in peace.
threads.quote: Rashnu: Humans and their drums... are so noisy. I threw them into different places so I could... sleep in peace.

threads.claim: Aryadeva failed to retrieve a Kory Drum long ago and has stayed silent about it, hinting at pride or guilt.
threads.quote: Nasejuna: Aryadeva also attempted to retrieve the Dendro Drum here in his youth, but he did not succeed, and has been silent about the matter ever since.

threads.claim: The Order of Skeptics lost its ancient archives to fire and gradually declined after the dark hollow attack.
threads.quote: Zurvan: The Order of Skeptics never recovered from this incident. They lost their ancient archives to fire, and gradually became like this.

threads.claim: The party is tasked with extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha after the Great Songs are gathered.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Now, please go and extinguish the Sign of Apaosha. We will meet again when Amrita falls from the sky.

threads.claim: The sky anomaly traces back to the Harvisptokhm absorbing defilement and must be solved with the Rite of Chinvat.
threads.quote: Zurvan: The anomaly appeared above the Harvisptokhm as a result of the tree absorbing a great amount of defilement.

threads.claim: The Rite of Ab-Zohr is needed to cleanse the Harvisptokhm of defilement, and the party is sent to do it.
threads.quote: Zurvan: The Rite of Ab-Zohr is a ritual performed to cleanse the Harvisptokhm of defilement.

threads.claim: The Twin-Horned Chaplet originates in the Harvisptokhm and will reveal ancient memories once inside.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Hehe, the Chaplet was originally a part of the Harvisptokhm. You will know when you get there.

threads.claim: Memories and tradition are fragile, and what is engraved may outlast what is sung, a theme about remembering and forgetting.
threads.quote: Zurvan: In a world where things are being forgotten every hour of every day, what we engrave on the ground is far more reliable than what we sing to the wind.

threads.claim: The Rite of Ab-Zohr is completed and the defilement is cleansed.
threads.quote: Zurvan: To think that you were truly able to complete the Rite of Ab-Zohr. Your deeds are indeed the equal of the ancient heroes. Most surprising.

threads.claim: The Sign of Apaosha, the hole in the sky, is extinguished after the rite.
threads.quote: Sorush: The Sign of Apaosha has been extinguished, and the earth has been purified. To think that this could be done even without any sacrifice...

threads.claim: Zurvan promises the truth about the catastrophe five hundred years ago that the memories only hinted at.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Now, now, there's no need to be so serious. Since you have seen the memories of the past, what I shall now tell you are not tales, but truth.

threads.claim: The masked swordsman is a cursed Dahri who traveled with Zurvan and later left the sea of flowers.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Oh? So you do know him. That makes my explanation way easier.

threads.claim: The one-armed sage went into the underground ruins and never returned.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Later, the masked swordsman would leave the sea of flowers alongside a with golden hair just like yours, and the sage went into the ruins underground and never returned.

threads.claim: The people of Dahri were cursed to varying degrees during the catastrophe, and the cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Yes. It is said that the people of Dahri were cursed to varying degrees during that catastrophe.

threads.claim: A new golden-haired hero has returned to the sea of flowers, though not the one who came before.
threads.quote: Zurvan: And now, a golden-haired hero has returned to the sea of flowers, and though it is not the one who came before, I can feel that something has begun to flow again.

threads.claim: Paimon doubts that the history given by Nasejuna matches what the memories show.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Dahrian machines... Wait, did things really go the way Nasejuna said they did?

threads.claim: The commissioner who gave the token claimed to be a light novelist, and the true identity remains hidden.
threads.quote: Katheryne: However, the person who gave us that token did claim to have been a light novelist.

threads.claim: The Defiled Chamber has been turned upside down, making its landscape identical to the inverted crystals in the sky.
threads.quote: Sorush: As expected, the landscape here is identical to that of those inverted crystals in the sky. Seems like that thing from before turned the entire Defiled Chamber upside down.

threads.claim: Zurvan tells the travelers that their paths will cross again, hinting at a future reunion.
threads.quote: Zurvan: You are both travelers, after all. I'm certain your paths will cross.

introduced.name: Katarina Snezhevna
introduced.how: Fatui Mage who introduces herself by name and reveals she is a Fatui agent hiding in the Chasm
introduced.quote: ???: ...Katarina. My name is Katarina Snezhevna.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a secretive group whose members, called Fatuus, pursue a cause outsiders do not understand
introduced.quote: Katarina: It's no surprise that outsiders fail to understand the cause of the Fatui.

introduced.name: Nikolay
introduced.how: Katarina's teammate Kolya, a soldier who went missing after luring enemies away from the squad
introduced.quote: Katarina: Well, I have been separated from my Kolya — Nikolay, a member of my team.

introduced.name: Lyudochka
introduced.how: a serious-seeming but playful friend of Katarina who once looked after her
introduced.quote: Katarina: A friend of mine. Though she may appear serious, she's a funny little pumpkin.

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: the childhood home where Katarina and Lyudochka grew up together like sisters
introduced.quote: Katarina: We were like sisters back in the House of the Hearth — I'd say that she was even dearer than a real sister.

introduced.name: Bloodied Sergeant's Insignia
introduced.how: a Fatui insignia found in the cave where Nikolay vanished
introduced.quote: Paimon: Eh... Is this the insignia left behind by the Fatui guy?

introduced.name: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
introduced.how: a Fatui diary, partly ruined, that records Nikolay's wounds, escape route, and sighting by a black-clad swordsman
introduced.quote: Paimon: Look, it's a piece of paper with... the Fatui seal on it?

introduced.name: Shadowy Husk
introduced.how: a mechanical monster described as unstoppable, able to pass through metal bars and lurking near the hideout
introduced.quote: Seems as though even metal bars are no obstacle for it.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Katarina: Kolya, please don't bring shame to the Tsaritsa. Don't bring shame on me.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eh? Isn't she a Fatuus? Is it really OK to just let her go instead of sending her to the Millelith?

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Everyone in Snezhnaya has been thusly warned.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Did our people on the surface get into an altercation with the people of Liyue?

assumed.name: Lyudochka's Inazuma cover
assumed.quote: Traveler: Lyudochka... You mean the one in Inazuma...

threads.claim: Katarina hints that all Fatui activity prepares for a final battle against a common enemy and an inescapable long night.
threads.quote: Everyone in Snezhnaya has been thusly warned.

threads.claim: Katarina's Fatui cell is isolated, learning news only through supply lines that Paimon suspects have long been cut off.
threads.quote: Katarina: Please don't take it the wrong way — I was sent down here a long time ago.

threads.claim: Katarina suspects a clash between the Fatui and Liyue caused her supply cut-off, but the Traveler's answer is left unclear.
threads.quote: Did our people on the surface get into an altercation with the people of Liyue?

threads.claim: Nikolay's fate stays unresolved: he may have escaped through a collapsed tunnel or been crushed.
threads.quote: Paimon: This cave's been sealed by collapsing rocks. Looks like we can't get through.

threads.claim: Katarina vanishes after the Daily Reset, leaving her letter behind beside a Shadowy Husk, which implies she died.
threads.quote: Standing next to the letter is a Shadowy Husk.

threads.claim: The Shadowy Husk is a mechanical monster that metal bars cannot stop and that Nikolay feared on sight.
threads.quote: Seems as though even metal bars are no obstacle for it.

threads.claim: The Fatui motto 'If not us, then who' appears as a dying soldier's words, hinting at a fatalistic loyalty.
threads.quote: Wish me luck. If not us, then who?

threads.claim: The Traveler reveals that Lyudochka escaped her cover in Inazuma and is alive and doing well, answering Katarina's worry.
threads.quote: Traveler: She's still alive, and she's doing great.

introduced.name: Vseslav
introduced.how: a Luchkin-aligned fighter who confronts the Izmaylov thugs and introduces himself
introduced.quote: I'm Vseslav, and I'm with the Luchkins. What are yours?

introduced.name: Lindenovich
introduced.how: an Izmaylov collector who is the creditor of Marfa's father
introduced.quote: He's Papa's creditor. Papa owes them tons of money because of his gambling habit. They even took him away...

introduced.name: Marfa
introduced.how: a girl whose father owes debts and who sells dolls to help pay them
introduced.quote: I... well. I'm Marfa. Thank you so much!

introduced.name: Luchkin
introduced.how: a fae gang that stands for justice and takes in people the Izmaylovs squeeze
introduced.quote: I am Sofya Pavlovna Zaitseva, a fae of the Luchkin, one who stands for justice.

introduced.name: Izmaylov
introduced.how: the biggest and most corrupt gang in Snezhnaya, which collects debts by force
introduced.quote: One of the gangs in Snezhnaya. They're the biggest, but they're also the most rotten lot.

introduced.name: Volkodlak
introduced.how: a people shown alongside humans, with tails and a gang-based society
introduced.quote: (Three large Volkodlak face off against a smaller Volkodlak and a young human girl)

introduced.name: Old Sire
introduced.how: adoptive father of the Luchkin and Izmaylov children, former High Table chairman, who died suddenly
introduced.quote: He was our adoptive father.

introduced.name: Zmei
introduced.how: a Luchkin leader who guides the gang and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: My name is Zmei Luchkin. I... guide the Luchkin on their path.

introduced.name: Iryna Nikolayevna Voronina
introduced.how: the Luchkin who enforces the rules and is cool toward outsiders
introduced.quote: Iryna Nikolayevna Voronina.

introduced.name: Vasiliy Nikolayevich Izmaylov
introduced.how: the Young Sire, Izmaylov leader and adopted brother of Zmei, who is pursuing the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: Vasiliy Nikolayevich Izmaylov. That's his name.

introduced.name: Lorie
introduced.how: a small Volkodlak in charge of the Izmaylov shipment
introduced.quote: It's a small Volkodlak who goes by Lorie...

introduced.name: Gureva
introduced.how: a Luchkin agent who infiltrated an Izmaylov stronghold and is now captured
introduced.quote: Right — Gureva. She's... she's amazing. She found a way to warn us about Izmaylov using the trains to move supplies, and even about Lorie's cargo run.

introduced.name: The Butcher
introduced.how: the Young Sire's second-in-command, who interrogates prisoners at the stronghold
introduced.quote: If they found her out, the man they call "the Butcher" won't let her off easy.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: a dangerous other space that can be pulled into this world by a device
introduced.quote: Well, I'll be frank, everything related to these Shadow Realms is dangerous, whether it's the Realms themselves or the things within them...

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: a material that, once refined, serves as the key energy source for opening the Shadow Realm
introduced.quote: He's refining Kresnik Kristall. Once it's pure enough, it can act as the "key" — the energy source needed to start the mechanism that opens the Shadow Realm.

introduced.name: High Table
introduced.how: an organization of gang leaders that the Old Sire once chaired
introduced.quote: Before he passed from illness, the Old Sire was the chairman of the High Table, an organization comprising various gang leaders...

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: the ruler who took the throne and favors humans over the fae
introduced.quote: but since the Tsaritsa took the throne, humans have been held higher in her favor...

introduced.name: Fae
introduced.how: the people who once ruled Snezhnaya and now mostly make up the gangs
introduced.quote: The fae once ruled Snezhnaya, and most in our gang are also fae...

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: the currency gangs use to buy nearly anything and to pay debts
introduced.quote: Mora can get you just about anything.

introduced.name: The Law
introduced.how: the gangs' code, whose first line forbids acts without mercy or justice
introduced.quote: It is, in fact, the first line of the Law: Do not commit acts devoid of mercy or justice.

introduced.name: Remusov
introduced.how: House Remusov, led by Lyubov, a family linked to the gangs
introduced.quote: Ah, Lyubov is now the head of House Remusov.

introduced.name: Train Boneyard
introduced.how: a half-excavated tunnel that collapsed after a Shadow Realm disaster and became a dump for old trains
introduced.quote: It's actually a half-excavated tunnel. But after a Shadow Realm disaster caused the tunnel to collapse, the construction work was halted...

introduced.name: Old Sire's death
introduced.how: the Old Sire fell ill and died suddenly several months ago, which the gangs now find suspicious
introduced.quote: It all began several months ago. One night, we received word that the Old Sire had fallen gravely ill and passed away all of a sudden.

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: a refined energy material the key-like block is made from
introduced.quote: Zmei: This is... made from refined Kresnik Kristall...

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: was opened by a device, activated by a key that is now useless since the device was destroyed
introduced.quote: Zmei: More precisely, it was the key used to activate the device that opened the Shadow Realm. But now that the device has been destroyed, it no longer has much use...

introduced.name: Legendary thief's treasure
introduced.how: an old rumor of thieves who robbed gangs and hid their loot, possibly real after all
introduced.quote: Zmei: This actually goes back to an old rumor... They say there was once a group of thieves who made a living robbing other gangs.

introduced.name: Treasure map
introduced.how: a map found in the box from the Butcher's desk, with a marked spot showing where the treasure may be
introduced.quote: Paimon: What is it? A map...? Looks like something's marked on it.

assumed.name: Alyosha
assumed.quote: Hmm, you're talking about that weird space that we entered along with Alyosha back then...

assumed.name: Vila
assumed.quote: First Luchkins, and now some blond "ally of justice" and a Vila kid...

assumed.name: Druzhna
assumed.quote: As the "rules" had it, such matters were to be left to the Druzhna and the Energy Commission.

assumed.name: Energy Commission
assumed.quote: Our poor dear father cared so much about his Energy Commission, didn't he?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: It used to be a Fatui military base, but it was abandoned some time ago...

assumed.name: Zapolyarny Palace
assumed.quote: Maybe to open it right in front of the Zapolyarny Palace and turn it into some kind of man-made disaster?

assumed.name: Hvergelmir
assumed.quote: He was a dog back at Hvergelmir, and even after he became president of the Energy Commission and Speaker of the High Table...

assumed.name: Luchkin
assumed.quote: Zmei: You're always welcome anytime, friends of the Luchkins.

assumed.name: Izmaylov
assumed.quote: Zmei: There's still much to be done regarding Izmaylov, so they have all been busy attending to that.

assumed.name: Iryna and Gureva
assumed.quote: Paimon: Zmei! We're here! Huh? Wait, where are Iryna, Sofya, and Gureva?

assumed.name: The Butcher
assumed.quote: Zmei: The Butcher probably found a lead and got hold of the treasure map. Izmaylov was short on money at the time, after all. He just never managed to get the box open.

assumed.name: Sofya's earlier remark on justice and Mora
assumed.quote: Zmei: Haha... How should I put this? Sofya may have said something before about "justice earning no Mora"?

assumed.name: Alyosha's search
assumed.quote: Paimon: And come to think of it, , didn't Alyosha say he was looking for something like this? Maybe this is exactly what he meant?

threads.claim: Izmaylov is moving raw materials to build a device that could open a Shadow Realm.
threads.quote: They're moving raw materials that could very well be used to construct a device that can open a Shadow Realm...

threads.claim: The Young Sire is close to completing the Shadow Realm gate, though not fully there yet.
threads.quote: He's nearly there. Maybe not all the way yet, but close...

threads.claim: The Shadow Realm device is shut down after the Young Sire's defeat.
threads.quote: The device has shut down!

threads.claim: The last people to see the Old Sire alive were the Butcher and the Young Sire, which raises doubts about his death.
threads.quote: The last people to see the Old Sire before his passing were the Butcher and the Young Sire...

threads.claim: Gureva and others suspect the Old Sire's death was murder, not illness.
threads.quote: We both know the Old Sire's death doesn't add up, right?

threads.claim: Vasiliy admits he was responsible for the Old Sire's death.
threads.quote: Yeah, it was me. And now, the old man is gone. There is no one left to stand in my way!

threads.claim: The Butcher is a dangerous Izmaylov enforcer who will not spare captured Luchkin agents.
threads.quote: If they found her out, the man they call "the Butcher" won't let her off easy.

threads.claim: The Butcher is incapacitated during Gureva's escape.
threads.quote: Let's go. It's over.

threads.claim: Gureva is overdue to check in and is feared captured by the Izmaylovs.
threads.quote: Her mission window has already passed, but she never checked back in.

threads.claim: Gureva escapes captivity and is free after the Butcher is dealt with.
threads.quote: I'm fine. In fact, I feel wonderful! Ah, what lovely weather for breaking out of prison!

threads.claim: The Butcher studied a mysterious box that Gureva took with her.
threads.quote: And this box. I could always see the Butcher studying it, so there must be something important inside...

threads.claim: The box may be a strange collectible, though its importance is still unclear.
threads.quote: It seems more like some strange collectible. Maybe worth looking into...

threads.claim: Zmei entered the Shadow Realm as a child and had an unpleasant experience there.
threads.quote: When I was a child, I even... entered the Shadow Realm once. Only, it wasn't exactly a pleasant memory for me.

threads.claim: The fae lost their rule over Snezhnaya, and humans now stand higher under the Tsaritsa.
threads.quote: but since the Tsaritsa took the throne, humans have been held higher in her favor...

threads.claim: Gang members feel they are used as dogs by the powerful lords who discard them at will.
threads.quote: We're nothing but dogs to those lords! Dogs they can summon and dismiss at will!

threads.claim: Vasiliy once hid so deep in a collapsed tunnel that the siblings struggled to find him.
threads.quote: Vasya hid in the deepest part of a collapsed tunnel in order to win...

threads.claim: Zmei and the others called out and found Vasiliy in the end, as they had in childhood.
threads.quote: It was and me, Vasya. We called your name and found you.

threads.claim: Compassion is what separates people from beasts, and once someone crosses the line, they keep going.
threads.quote: That inability to bear it is compassion, and compassion is a humane heart.

threads.claim: Zmei judges that Vasiliy has crossed the line of compassion and cannot find his way back.
threads.quote: I think Vasiliy... is beyond that line now, wandering in a darkness where he cannot even see his own hand before him.

threads.claim: The device that opened the Shadow Realm has been destroyed, leaving its key spent.
threads.quote: Zmei: More precisely, it was the key used to activate the device that opened the Shadow Realm. But now that the device has been destroyed, it no longer has much use...

threads.claim: A rumored band of thieves may have hidden their loot somewhere, and the treasure might be real.
threads.quote: Zmei: This actually goes back to an old rumor... They say there was once a group of thieves who made a living robbing other gangs.

threads.claim: The Butcher's map suggests the legendary thief's treasure may have existed after all.
threads.quote: Zmei: We always assumed it was just a story, but now it seems that so-called "legendary thief's treasure" may have been real after all.

threads.claim: Alyosha was looking for an item like the core, and it may be what he meant.
threads.quote: Paimon: And come to think of it, , didn't Alyosha say he was looking for something like this? Maybe this is exactly what he meant?

threads.claim: Zmei holds that justice stays pure because it is not about money or gain.
threads.quote: Zmei: But to me, that is exactly what keeps justice clean. It is not about money, and it is not about what we stand to gain.

threads.claim: Izmaylov was short on money, which may explain why the Butcher pursued the treasure.
threads.quote: Zmei: The Butcher probably found a lead and got hold of the treasure map. Izmaylov was short on money at the time, after all. He just never managed to get the box open.

introduced.name: Sosi
introduced.how: A Skeptic scholar who asks the Traveler to recover the monument fragments for a commission.
introduced.quote: Sosi: Um, please wait! I do have a request to make, but I promise it won't be too much work!

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: A Pari who warns the group off the monument and leads the group against the Fatui.
introduced.quote: Sorush: Hey, you scheming humans! I suggest leaving this place at once — the heritage and secrets of us Pari are not for you to covet, and certainly not within your reach.

introduced.name: Markozov
introduced.how: A Fatui commander who inspects the camps daily and wants the Pari for his own knowledge.
introduced.quote: The first thing I see when I wake up in the morning is Commander Markozov's face.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: Immortal beings bound to the Order of Skeptics by a first contract recorded on the monument.
introduced.quote: Sosi: Engraved on the monument are the true names of every Pari and the first contract they formed with the Order of Skeptics.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Outlanders from the snowy lands who set up camps near the monument and covet the power of gods.
introduced.quote: Sosi: Oh, and one more thing. I have indeed sighted suspicious individuals who covet the power of gods. They seem to have come all the way from the snowy lands...

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: A scholarly order that guards the Khvarena Monument and holds the contract with the Pari.
introduced.quote: Sosi: The Akademiya and the Order of Skeptics went separate ways due to a clash in our ideals, but our research has always emphasized history and heritage.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: A former partner of the Skeptics that split from them over a clash of ideals.
introduced.quote: Sosi: The Akademiya and the Order of Skeptics went separate ways due to a clash in our ideals, but our research has always emphasized history and heritage.

introduced.name: Khvarena Monument
introduced.how: A stone tablet whose inscription is unreadable because its fragments are missing.
introduced.quote: Sosi: The Khvarena Monument is a valuable artifact to the Order of Skeptics. It only appears this way because its fragments are lost.

introduced.name: Pari immortality tied to the monument
introduced.how: The Pari's immortality is said to be sustained by the Khvarena Monument.
introduced.quote: Sosi: The immortality of the Pari is sustained by the Khvarena Monument.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Markozov, optional)

assumed.name: Nasejuna
assumed.quote: Paimon: We should ask about Nasejuna first!

assumed.name: Vijnanapati
assumed.quote: Paimon: But isn't he the uh, Vijnanapati? Are you really gonna let this slide?

assumed.name: Yasnapati
assumed.quote: Sorush: Oh, Yasnapati, deliver upon these benighted fools a lesson that they shall never forget!

threads.claim: Re-establishing the contract through the monument would grant a power rivaling the gods.
threads.quote: Sosi: ...Will re-establish a contract with the Pari and obtain a power that rivals the gods.

threads.claim: The monument's inscription records past disasters and contradicts what the Skeptics' predecessors were thought to have recorded.
threads.quote: Sosi: I've skimmed through the inscription, and it looks like it contains records of past disasters... and how our Order of Skeptics predecessors dealt with them.

threads.claim: Sosi privately covets a power rivaling the gods, though she tries to deny it.
threads.quote: Sosi: (A power that rivals the gods... No, no, I shouldn't overstep...)

threads.claim: The inscription turns out to have nothing to do with contracts or divine powers, undercutting Sosi's ambition.
threads.quote: Sorush: From that look on her face akin to a shriveled tree trunk, I'm pretty sure the inscription has nothing to do with contracts or divine powers.

threads.claim: Fatui outlanders from the snowy lands are coveting the power of gods near the monument.
threads.quote: Sosi: Oh, and one more thing. I have indeed sighted suspicious individuals who covet the power of gods. They seem to have come all the way from the snowy lands...

threads.claim: Markozov believes knowledge is the source of his power and that losing it would make him weak.
threads.quote: Markozov: Knowledge is the source of my power! Oh, imagine how small and weak I'd be without knowledge...

threads.claim: Nasejuna's actions violated the Order of Skeptics' true purpose, though this is treated as an isolated incident.
threads.quote: His actions have undoubtedly violated the Order of Skeptics' true purpose, so one shouldn't generalize that to the whole order.

introduced.name: Neko
introduced.how: self-introduction; a cat who talks, named by Hibiki, now acting as provisional head priestess
introduced.quote: My name is Neko — a name bestowed by Hibiki.

introduced.name: Hibiki
introduced.how: former head priestess who ran the shrine, received guests, and gave Neko her name
introduced.quote: Hibiki is Hibiki. She is the head priestess of the Asase Shrine.

introduced.name: Asase Shrine
introduced.how: shrine on Seirai Island that Hibiki once led and Neko now keeps
introduced.quote: Hibiki is Hibiki. She is the head priestess of the Asase Shrine.

introduced.name: Domeki
introduced.how: a very tall, loud human who played with Hibiki and cleaned the shrine by trimming branches
introduced.quote: A very tall and loud human. He and Hibiki would play together a great deal.

introduced.name: Offering Box
introduced.how: shrine artifact that draws visitors who leave Mora; was broken and repaired by the Traveler
introduced.quote: Regardless, the Offering Box is a most wondrous artifact.

introduced.name: Prayer Rack
introduced.how: wooden rack where visitors hang Prayer Plaques after offering Mora
introduced.quote: I recall Hibiki calling the rack itself a "Prayer Rack," and these small wooden blocks "Prayer Plaques."

introduced.name: Taisuke
introduced.how: adventurer who introduces himself while investigating the shrine area with Etsuko
introduced.quote: Oh, hello there, Traveler. Miss Etsuko and I are currently investigating the area around this shrine.

introduced.name: Etsuko
introduced.how: adventurer investigating the shrine with Taisuke, who tends to be wary
introduced.quote: Investigating this shrine's surroundings.. Well, that's Taisuke's idea, anyway.

introduced.name: Kiminami Anna
introduced.how: cook at Kiminami Restaurant in Inazuma City who can help make a cat meal
introduced.quote: Well, why don't you try going to Inazuma City and looking for Kiminami Anna at Kiminami Restaurant?

introduced.name: Invigorating Kitty Meal
introduced.how: dish of Fish, Raw Meat, Seagrass and Rice that Anna created as a cat meal, a substitute for Hibiki's cooking
introduced.quote: Since it's for a talking cat, let's call this the Invigorating Kitty Meal!

introduced.name: Ooshima Junpei
introduced.how: self-introduction; former Tatarasuna worker and stone carver hired to make Neko's statue
introduced.quote: I'm Ooshima Junpei, and I used to work at Tatarasuna.

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: workplace of Junpei and other craftsmen, evacuated after an accident and now a source of idle workers
introduced.quote: I'm Ooshima Junpei, and I used to work at Tatarasuna.

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: was a pirate gathering place centuries ago before the Shogunate cleared it out
introduced.quote: this was a gathering place for pirates several centuries ago.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: cleared the pirates from Seirai Island and moved its inhabitants away
introduced.quote: Then, it was the Shogunate who cleared all the pirates out and moved the inhabitants to other places...

introduced.name: Ako Domeki's storm battle
introduced.how: Ako Domeki's pirate fleet and the Shogunate fleet were both destroyed by a sudden storm on Seirai Island
introduced.quote: Ako Domeki's fleet and the Shogunate's were both caught in the ensuing storm... and they were all lost.

introduced.name: Warding Stones
introduced.how: stones that had been intentionally unsealed; resealing them calmed the island's storm
introduced.quote: Those had been intentionally unsealed.

introduced.name: Konbumaru
introduced.how: a kitten named after good things, described as smart and fond of high places
introduced.quote: A good child. This generation's Konbumaru is a smart one.

introduced.name: Hachihou
introduced.how: a kitten that is agile and fond of fish, often found by saltwater
introduced.quote: A very agile little fellow, and very fond of fish as well.

introduced.name: Meshi
introduced.how: a kitten named by Neko after the best thing she could think of
introduced.quote: That little one was named Meshi, precisely because that is the best thing I could think of in all the world.

introduced.name: Mora
introduced.how: currency that visitors offer at the shrine and that workers expect as salary
introduced.quote: Mora? Are these things not for shoving inside the Offering Box? How strange.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: a very large shrine with many people, where the search leads
introduced.quote: Meow, this shrine is really big, and there are a lot of humans too.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: the very tall pink tree beside the shrine, named as the Sacred Sakura
introduced.quote: The Sacred Sakura at Grand Narukami Shrine.

introduced.name: Inagi Hotomi
introduced.how: a shrine attendant at Grand Narukami Shrine who gives fortunes and knows the old texts
introduced.quote: Hello, Traveler from afar. Welcome to the Grand Narukami Shrine!

introduced.name: Torii gate
introduced.how: the red gate at a shrine, called a torii gate
introduced.quote: This is called a "torii gate."

introduced.name: Ooshima Junpei
introduced.how: a stone human left in charge of Asase Shrine while Neko is away
introduced.quote: The stone human will take care of the shrine for me. There is no need to worry.

introduced.name: The Yougou Three
introduced.how: three disciples who once trained together under the Yougou Tengu
introduced.quote: "The Yougou Three" Asase Hibiki, Kamuna Harunosuke, and Mikoshi Nagamasa once went to Mt. Yougou to learn under the Yougou Tengu.

introduced.name: Mt. Yougou
introduced.how: the mountain where the Yougou Three trained under the Yougou Tengu
introduced.quote: went to Mt. Yougou to learn under the Yougou Tengu.

introduced.name: Yougou Tengu
introduced.how: the teacher on Mt. Yougou to whom the Yougou Three apprenticed
introduced.quote: to learn under the Yougou Tengu.

introduced.name: Kitsune Saiguu
introduced.how: a fox who befriended Asase while he apprenticed at the shrine
introduced.quote: Asase apprenticed at our shrine and also befriended the Kitsune Saiguu.

introduced.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
introduced.how: one of the Yougou Three who went to Liyue to learn the way of the adepti
introduced.quote: Kamuna Harunosuke crossed the sea and went to Liyue as he wanted to learn the more powerful

introduced.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
introduced.how: one of the Yougou Three who serves the Shogunate and whose descendants live in the city
introduced.quote: Legend has it that Mikoshi Nagamasa has been working for the Shogunate

introduced.name: Onmyoudou
introduced.how: a technique system Kamuna created after learning from the adepti
introduced.quote: Then, he created his own "Onmyoudou" and "Shiki Taishou."

introduced.name: Shiki Taishou
introduced.how: a technique Kamuna created, used to seal a troublesome creature
introduced.quote: Then, he created his own "Onmyoudou" and "Shiki Taishou."

introduced.name: Ioroi
introduced.how: a bake-danuki who caused trouble everywhere until Kamuna sealed him
introduced.quote: he once used this technique to seal the bake-danuki, Ioroi, that was making trouble everywhere.

introduced.name: The Yougou Three parting
introduced.how: the three disciples split up after a vaguely recorded disaster
introduced.quote: The three eventually parted ways after a "disaster" that was vague in their account.

assumed.name: Seirai Stormchasers
assumed.quote: After the events of Seirai Stormchasers, the Traveler returns to Asase Shrine to speak with Neko.

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: I'd like to return to Narukami Island to buy some more, but...

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: The Guild's received quite a few commissions related to this

assumed.name: Janome
assumed.quote: And Domeki, Janome, and all of Hibiki's friends, too!

assumed.name: Kamisato Ayaka
assumed.quote: Oh it's you! Miss Kamisato's friend!

assumed.name: Warding Stones of Seirai
assumed.quote: I'm sure you remember the Warding Stones on this island.

assumed.name: fox stones
assumed.quote: I desire something similar to those fox stones on that island far, far away.

assumed.name: Neko
assumed.quote: Oh, it is you again. Well met.

assumed.name: Asase Hibiki
assumed.quote: Hibiki said that the tree is shaped like a fox.

assumed.name: Asase Shrine
assumed.quote: My Asase Shrine is still better.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: May the Electro Archon bless you.

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Legend has it that Mikoshi Nagamasa has been working for the Shogunate

assumed.name: Seirai Island
assumed.quote: She returned to Seirai Island...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: crossed the sea and went to Liyue as he wanted to learn the more powerful

assumed.name: Lady Kitsune
assumed.quote: stories about the "Lady Kitsune."

threads.claim: Hibiki is absent and her whereabouts and fate are unknown, with Neko expecting her return.
threads.quote: Not knowing about Hibiki's fate, Neko answers that she needs to take care of the shrine otherwise Hibiki would grieve about the sorry state of the shrine when she comes back.

threads.claim: A cloud shaped like a cat appears as Junpei finishes the statue, and Neko takes it as a sign from Hibiki, though its meaning is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Neko: Meow meow meow! It must've been Hibiki! A good thing happened, just like she said it would!

threads.claim: Domeki is said to have been a pirate with a bounty on his head, which conflicts with Hibiki's view of him as good.
threads.quote: The two adventurers didn't know who Hibiki was but said that Domeki was a pirate who had a bounty on his head.

threads.claim: Taisuke suggests Domeki may be the pirate leader Ako Domeki, who fought the Shogunate and whose record says he went missing.
threads.quote: Unless I'm mistaken, this "Domeki" we speak of may well have been the pirate leader "Ako Domeki," who chose to fight the Shogunate head-on.

threads.claim: The storm that destroyed the pirate and Shogunate fleets may have been deliberately controlled by someone.
threads.quote: So the timing of that storm was just too good. Almost as if... someone was specifically controlling it.

threads.claim: The Warding Stones were deliberately unsealed, linking them to the storm's sudden onset.
threads.quote: I'm sure you remember the Warding Stones on this island. Those had been intentionally unsealed.

threads.claim: Neko speaks human language and seems to have no food or water needs, and the reason for this is unexplained.
threads.quote: Meow meow meow, such ado about nothing... Is it so strange that I speak?

threads.claim: Etsuko suspects Neko's motives for repairing the shrine, since no one remains on the island to visit it.
threads.quote: ...Has that provisional head priestess realized this yet? What motive does it have for repairing that shrine?

threads.claim: The surrounding villages are empty of people, and the reason is a mystery.
threads.quote: On a stroll, I discovered that the surrounding villages have not a soul within them...

threads.claim: Taisuke links the shrine's ruin to the abandoned Koseki Village, suggesting a shared cause.
threads.quote: I suppose that its ruin must have something to do with the abandoned Koseki Village...

threads.claim: Asase Hibiki has gone missing and her whereabouts remain unknown, so Neko keeps searching for her.
threads.quote: Since Hibiki isn't coming back for the time being, I will go and look for her.

threads.claim: The very tall pink tree with electric things beneath the shrine is identified as the Sacred Sakura at Grand Narukami Shrine.
threads.quote: The Sacred Sakura at Grand Narukami Shrine.

threads.claim: Neko is not human and speaks although cats do not normally talk, raising the question of how old and what she really is.
threads.quote: I am not a human being.

threads.claim: The Yougou Three lived about four to five hundred years ago, and their past is only partly recorded.
threads.quote: About four to five hundred years ago, it was said that

threads.claim: A vague disaster split the Yougou Three apart, and its cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: The three eventually parted ways after a "disaster" that was vague in their account.

threads.claim: Kamuna Harunosuke's later history is lost, as news of him gradually disappeared after he sealed Ioroi.
threads.quote: But later, news of him gradually disappeared.

threads.claim: Ioroi, a bake-danuki, was sealed by Kamuna's technique, which may matter if the seal weakens.
threads.quote: he once used this technique to seal the bake-danuki, Ioroi, that was making trouble everywhere.

threads.claim: Hibiki told Neko stories about the Lady Kitsune, a figure whose identity is left open.
threads.quote: stories about the "Lady Kitsune."

threads.claim: Mikoshi Nagamasa's bloodline has continued to the present, and many city residents with the Mikoshi surname are his descendants.
threads.quote: Most people in the city who have the surname Mikoshi today are his descendants.

introduced.name: Soheil
introduced.how: Vahumana researcher from the Usaibia family who studies desert ruins and has been to the desert before
introduced.quote: I'm Soheil from the Usaibia family, and a researcher from Vahumana.

introduced.name: Kalantari
introduced.how: Akademiya student from a Port Ormos merchant family who seeks traces of the past and wants to enter the desert
introduced.quote: I'm Kalantari, a student in the Akademiya. I seek traces of the past that remain on the earth.

introduced.name: Hulwani
introduced.how: member of the Corps of Thirty who escorts people out of the desert and enforces the sage's ban
introduced.quote: I'll have to ask Hulwani from the Corps of Thirty

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: group Hulwani belongs to that can be sent to escort researchers back from the desert
introduced.quote: I'll have to ask Hulwani from the Corps of Thirty

introduced.name: sage
introduced.how: the Akademiya leader who holds power over researchers and has banned entering the desert
introduced.quote: The sages, with the power they control, virtually have all of us researchers by our throats.

introduced.name: Mausoleum of King Deshret
introduced.how: ancient tomb in the desert that generations of Vahumana researchers failed to open and that has now changed
introduced.quote: Generations of Vahumana researchers tried everything they could to open the mausoleum's entrance and discover the secrets within, yet none succeeded.

introduced.name: Tomb of Carouses
introduced.how: smaller miniature version of the Mausoleum of King Deshret with easier-to-find treasure
introduced.quote: It's a miniature version of the Mausoleum of King Deshret, just like I said, right?

introduced.name: Transparent Ruins
introduced.how: see-through ruins in the desert that blend into their surroundings and hold stone slates
introduced.quote: It's just as he described it. There's practically no difference between it and its surroundings, and it's see-through!

introduced.name: Lamb-Devourer Rock
introduced.how: rock site where Soheil was attacked by mercenaries and that hides a secret base
introduced.quote: Finally, he was attacked by a group of mercenaries in a place called Lamb-Devourer Rock.

introduced.name: Thutmose
introduced.how: desert mercenary group that appears and vanishes suddenly and has a hidden base
introduced.quote: This is where the notes mentioned that Thutmose would suddenly appear and then disappear.

introduced.name: Parvezravan
introduced.how: password that opens a hidden door to the mercenaries' base
introduced.quote: Wait, it was Parvezravan. That's right. The password's

introduced.name: stone slate
introduced.how: inscribed stone tablet found in ruins that records ancient Al-Ahmar writing and can light up symbols
introduced.quote: Alrighty! Treasure! And a stone slate! Looks like this place isn't just smaller.

introduced.name: Embers of the Sun
introduced.how: glowing objects in the Mausoleum that are lit to progress the ancient instructions
introduced.quote: These objects that can light up are the

introduced.name: Soheil's Old Notes
introduced.how: Soheil's archaeology notes recording his past desert explorations and the locations of ruins
introduced.quote: Something very precious... My archaeology notes.

introduced.name: The Golden Slumber
introduced.how: Tirzad's paper on Al-Ahmar's later civilization that was submitted to the Akademiya
introduced.quote: The Golden Slumber: A Study on Governance in the Later Period of Al-Ahmar's Civilization and Stages of Survival.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar civilization
introduced.how: ancient civilization whose later-period records are mostly lost and survive only as fragments
introduced.quote: Due to various reasons, practically all the records of the later period of Al-Ahmar's civilization have been lost.

assumed.name: Tirzad
assumed.quote: Paimon wonders how Jeht and Tirzad are doing... Paimon's kinda concerned.

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: Paimon wonders how Jeht and Tirzad are doing... Paimon's kinda concerned.

assumed.name: Aaru Village
assumed.quote: We're back at Aaru Village again.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Soheil)

assumed.name: Vahumana
assumed.quote: I've always thought highly of Tirzad and considered him the future of Vahumana.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: It shows that you value contracts just as the people of Liyue do.

assumed.name: Khaj-Nisut
assumed.quote: It's probably because of Khaj-Nisut.

assumed.name: Place of Rebirth and Place of Breath
assumed.quote: (If the player already cleared Place of Rebirth and/or Place of Breath)

assumed.name: matra
assumed.quote: The sage is afraid you'll alert the matra and worried that you might damage the ruins

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: It should at least be filled with greenery like Sumeru City!

assumed.name: Stormterror's Lair
assumed.quote: It's like Stormterror's Lair but in the desert!

assumed.name: Haravatat
assumed.quote: Perhaps this slate would be more valuable to those from Haravatat.

assumed.name: King Deshret
assumed.quote: Paimon wonders if bards sang about this place during King Deshret's reign

assumed.quote: I'm from a family of merchants in Port Ormos.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Hulwani

threads.claim: Aaru is a destination the stone slate points toward beyond the ruins, and its nature remains unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon keeps having the feeling that there has to be more to

threads.claim: Stone slates contain ancient instructions about crossing the underworld and reaching Aaru, which lights symbols when followed.
threads.quote: Huh? There's new writing on it... And three dots of light...

threads.claim: The Mausoleum of King Deshret has changed in an unprecedented way that may be linked to the Traveler.
threads.quote: Are the... changes in the Mausoleum of King Deshret... linked to you?

threads.claim: Soheil suspects Tirzad's paper about entering the Mausoleum was fabricated.
threads.quote: So, I suspect that Tirzad never entered the Mausoleum of King Deshret. He probably made it all up.

threads.claim: Soheil confirms that the Mausoleum is real and that Tirzad's paper was accurate.
threads.quote: I—It really is true then...

threads.claim: Thutmose mercenaries appear and vanish suddenly, suggesting a hidden base in the desert.
threads.quote: This is where the notes mentioned that Thutmose would suddenly appear and then disappear.

threads.claim: The Thutmose secret base is found and it hides treasure and stolen records.
threads.quote: So there is a secret base after all...

threads.claim: Sages hold near-absolute power over researchers and can make or break their careers.
threads.quote: The sages, with the power they control, virtually have all of us researchers by our throats.

threads.claim: Soheil wants to become a sage, driven by the suffering researchers endure for approval.
threads.quote: Therefore, I must become a sage myself, or all the suffering I've endured would've been for nothing.

threads.claim: Soheil reconsiders his ambition after being reminded of the knowledge-focused view in his old notes.
threads.quote: But if it weren't for your reminder, I would have never looked at things from that perspective again.

threads.claim: Records of Al-Ahmar's later civilization are largely lost and survive only as fragments.
threads.quote: Due to various reasons, practically all the records of the later period of Al-Ahmar's civilization have been lost.

introduced.name: Pale Crown Palace
introduced.how: hidden Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd, also his tomb
introduced.quote: Yes. It is the Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: ruler who died fighting the Abyss about five hundred years ago and was laid to rest in the palace
introduced.quote: Because five hundred years ago, the Belyi Tsar died fighting the Abyss and the tides of beasts.

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: portable device housing an AI consciousness created at Hvergelmir, named Eye of Graeae or Goggles
introduced.quote: Let's call this lightweight, portable device the "Eye of Graeae."

introduced.name: Hvergelmir
introduced.how: hidden research facility where the Eye was created and bio-alchemy was researched
introduced.quote: The Eye also reveals that it was created there, inside the hidden research facility known as Hvergelmir.

introduced.name: Izmaylov
introduced.how: Hvergelmir researcher worried that the new Tsaritsa will shut down alchemy research
introduced.quote: You are right, Azazel. There is too much to think about.

introduced.name: Azazel
introduced.how: Hvergelmir researcher who questions whether the experiments should continue
introduced.quote: Don't dwell on it, Izmaylov. It's not our call to make.

introduced.name: Proto-Man
introduced.how: being sealed in an egg and monitored at Hvergelmir, stable despite the Shadow Realm darkness
introduced.quote: And the Proto-Man is in a highly stable state.

introduced.name: Pavlina
introduced.how: Snegurochka princess and primary researcher who built Prime Ice research facilities
