introduced.quote: Pavlina, princess of the Snegurochka.

introduced.name: Lara
introduced.how: Pavlina's cat, left in the researchers' care while Pavlina is away
introduced.quote: I am sure my colleague Koshchei shares my respect for living things and will remember to feed my Lara...

introduced.name: Koshchei
introduced.how: researcher once charged with alchemical experiments on living fae
introduced.quote: The defendant's name was Koshchei.

introduced.name: Alvis
introduced.how: Grand Duke of the Domovoy and a Hvergelmir member who recently died
introduced.quote: The Grand Duke of the Domovoy... This is the member for whom the most information may be found.

introduced.name: Aksinya
introduced.how: Belyi Tsar's servant and researcher, shown in flashback being pushed into the Shadow Realm by a former ally
introduced.quote: You cast me out, but no matter.

introduced.name: Zver
introduced.how: two-headed beast that guards the Tsar's body and introduces itself as the Tsar's servant
introduced.quote: "Zver" was the name His Majesty bestowed upon me.

introduced.name: Tsar's White Birch
introduced.how: massive tree formed from part of the Belyi Tsar's body, with branches around the entrance
introduced.quote: These tree-shaped objects are... all branches of that massive Tsar's White Birch.

introduced.name: Kresnik's Torch
introduced.how: first torch of the Kresnik flame, found in the royal hall and tied to the palace mechanisms
introduced.quote: That is the very first Kresnik's Torch.

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: ore that research notes say is the ideal material for transforming matter
introduced.quote: Kresnik crystal ore should be the ideal material.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: frozen land the Belyi Tsar renamed when it became shared by humans and fae
introduced.quote: And he renamed it Snezhnaya.

introduced.name: man-made monsters
introduced.how: bio-alchemical creations made by Koshchei at Hvergelmir
introduced.quote: They are man-made monsters... created by Koshchei at Hvergelmir back in the day.

introduced.name: Court of Bliss
introduced.how: destination where the collected body fragments must be taken to restore the Eye
introduced.quote: The Court of Bliss.

introduced.name: Novokitezhgrad
introduced.how: city southeast of Snezhnograd where a body fragment was recovered
introduced.quote: That's... a city southeast of Snezhnograd, Paimon thinks...

introduced.name: Old Kitezhgrad
introduced.how: city the fae left from alongside the Belyi Tsar on a westward expedition
introduced.quote: He was one of the fae who set out from Old Kitezhgrad alongside the Belyi Tsar on a westward expedition.

introduced.name: Hyperborean technology
introduced.how: ancient technology used to upload a consciousness into the Eye
introduced.quote: They'll be absolutely stunned to learn that I can upload your consciousness here, fully intact, using ancient Hyperborean technology.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: The newly ascended Tsaritsa. It is her attitude that concerns me...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: they fought the Abyss under the command of Zver and the banner of the Tsar.

assumed.name: House of Hesperides
assumed.quote: I will be returning to the House of Hesperides for the next few days, so I'll leave the cat in your care.

assumed.name: Netochka
assumed.quote: Oh that's right, didn't Netochka say that she used to live in Novokitezhgrad...?

assumed.name: Snegovik
assumed.quote: Perhaps the Snegovik, incomplete in spirit as they are, truly could make use of this technology...

assumed.name: Shadow Realm
assumed.quote: (Is this... a Shadow Realm? Paimon and the Eye of Graeae are gone...)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Her attitude toward those fae nobles wallowing in Mora and decadence?

assumed.name: Pale Star court
assumed.quote: unlike in the days of the Pale Star's royal court

threads.claim: The Eye's lost power and body were split into three parts, with one fragment hidden in the palace.
threads.quote: that I could sense the power that once belonged to me had been split into three parts.

threads.claim: Zver says the Eye's body was split into three, which is why it lacks its full powers and memories.
threads.quote: while your body was split up into three.

threads.claim: A fragment of the Eye's body is found at the ruined Hvergelmir, having been recovered from Novokitezhgrad by Aksinya.
threads.quote: And one part of my body is now inside that shattered egg.

threads.claim: The Eye may not be its real name and may have no memory of its true identity.
threads.quote: So, Goggles, "Eye of Graeae" isn't your name then?

threads.claim: The Eye was created in a hidden chamber within the Pale Crown Palace.
threads.quote: I was created here, in a hidden chamber within this palace...

threads.claim: Zver warns that the Eye may not be as trustworthy as it seems.
threads.quote: But I must warn you: that companion of yours inside that mechanism? They might not be as trustworthy as you think.

threads.claim: Aksinya was betrayed and cast into the Shadow Realm by people she trusted.
threads.quote: Why would you turn away from the path we were meant to follow?

threads.claim: The four Hvergelmir members should have had good relations, so the betrayal is unexplained.
threads.quote: The four of them should have had a very good relationship.

threads.claim: The Belyi Tsar had a final aspiration that the Tsaritsa's policies may prevent from being realized.
threads.quote: His Majesty's final aspiration will never be realized.

threads.claim: Zver says it brought the Belyi Tsar's lifeless body back from the battlefield.
threads.quote: I was the one who brought his lifeless body back from that pitch-black ruin.

threads.claim: The new Tsaritsa is rumored to plan banning alchemy, threatening Hvergelmir's research.
threads.quote: They're planning to ban anything related to alchemy.

threads.claim: Hvergelmir runs many bio-alchemy projects that could be shut down.
threads.quote: Hvergelmir has plenty of bio-alchemy projects

threads.claim: Hvergelmir researchers experimented on prisoners to let loveless fae gain the love they lack.
threads.quote: But is that what humans... Is that what loveless fae should seek as 'love'?

threads.claim: A previous experiment at Hvergelmir had disastrous results that the researchers still remember.
threads.quote: Have you forgotten what happened during the last experiment?

threads.claim: The Proto-Man sealed in an egg is monitored and stable despite the Shadow Realm darkness.
threads.quote: And the Proto-Man is in a highly stable state.

threads.claim: Zver is loyal to the Belyi Tsar and resents Koshchei, who had tried to destroy it.
threads.quote: I was the one who followed His Majesty to every battlefield

threads.claim: Koshchei was convicted of experimenting on living fae, but his execution is not recorded.
threads.quote: there exists no record of his final execution

threads.claim: Alvis was punished for defiling the sacred form, and he has recently died.
threads.quote: Alvis has paid the price for his crime of defiling the sacred form

threads.claim: The Belyi Tsar renamed the land Snezhnaya, not the Tsaritsa, so Paimon's assumption is corrected.
threads.quote: And he renamed it Snezhnaya.

threads.claim: The Eye's fragments must be brought to the Court of Bliss to restore it.
threads.quote: The Court of Bliss.

threads.claim: The Traveler is seeing memories from the past of Hvergelmir and may be affected by the palace.
threads.quote: Just like how I was at Hvergelmir earlier...

introduced.name: Kaji
introduced.how: an island resident who stayed behind and asks the Traveler to repair the wards
introduced.quote: Kaji: Hello! Excuse me, outlander. Could you hear me out?

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: a curse-like force spreading across the island, causing endless rain, clouds, and sickness
introduced.quote: Recently, the Tatarigami's reach has spread wider and wider.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Clan
introduced.how: people blamed for destroying the ward that suppressed the serpent god's soul
introduced.quote: since the people from Sangonomiya destroyed the ward that suppressed the soul of the serpent god

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: a power fighting rebels for control of the island
introduced.quote: Ironically, due to the chaos created by the Tatarigami, the Shogunate and the rebels have not been fighting over this place quite as hard.

introduced.name: ward
introduced.how: a warding device that suppresses a serpent god, which can be repaired by restoring missing components
introduced.quote: I think the ward is missing some components.

introduced.name: serpent god
introduced.how: a serpent god whose soul was suppressed by a ward
introduced.quote: since the people from Sangonomiya destroyed the ward that suppressed the soul of the serpent god

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: a way to scan for scattered elemental traces to find missing ward parts
introduced.quote: Use your Elemental Sight to scan for scattered traces of elements nearby.

introduced.name: Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Pearl
introduced.how: a missing ward component that is found and used to repair a ward
introduced.quote: (Upon collecting the Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Pearl)

introduced.name: Serpent's Head
introduced.how: a location with a ward that needs repair
introduced.quote: Kaji: Next, the two wards at the Serpent's Head and Jakotsu Mine still need to be repaired.

introduced.name: Jakotsu Mine
introduced.how: a location with a ward that needs repair
introduced.quote: Kaji: Next, the two wards at the Serpent's Head and Jakotsu Mine still need to be repaired.

introduced.name: Fort Mumei
introduced.how: ancient ruins that rose out of the sea and may be linked to the island's wards
introduced.quote: Fort Mumei has risen out of the sea!

introduced.name: Ogosho's battle with an evil god
introduced.how: a past battle in which the mighty Ogosho destroyed an ancient city
introduced.quote: This ancient city was destroyed when the mighty Ogosho fought against an evil god.

introduced.name: Kitain Hideie
introduced.how: a legendary hero who destroyed many evils and is now gone
introduced.quote: the Kitain, who once destroyed so many evils, will never return again.

introduced.name: famed spear of the Prefects of Yashiori
introduced.how: a famous spear once used by the Prefects of Yashiori and by Lord Kitain, given as a reward and to be recreated
introduced.quote: This is the famed spear once used by the Prefects of Yashiori.

assumed.name: Commissions
assumed.quote: What do the Commissions or dragons or serpents have to do with me, huh?

assumed.name: rebels
assumed.quote: Fort Mumei came under rebel assault previously, and I suspect that the attack is related to these changes.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: But seeing as you're a traveler from afar who has managed to venture this deep into Inazuma, you must certainly be able to hold your own.

assumed.name: Sacred Stone Puzzle
assumed.quote: (After solving the Sacred Stone Puzzle and observing the ward)

threads.claim: The Tatarigami is spreading across the island and is blamed for the endless rain and clouds and for the miners falling ill.
threads.quote: Recently, the Tatarigami's reach has spread wider and wider.

threads.claim: The destruction of the serpent god's ward by Sangonomiya is blamed for the island's troubles, and the cause is still unclear.
threads.quote: if they had not destroyed our great Ogosho's ward, the island wouldn't have become such a mess in the first place!

threads.claim: Fort Mumei's ruins rose from the sea and may be connected to the island's wards, which is still unresolved.
threads.quote: maybe the ruins on Fort Mumei aren't connected to the wards on the island after all- hmm?

threads.claim: The end of the rain may make the Shogunate and rebels fight more aggressively over the island.
threads.quote: The fact that the rain has stopped may actually make the warring parties more aggressive in fighting for the island...

threads.claim: Ogosho once fought an evil god, which destroyed an ancient city, a past event whose details are left open.
threads.quote: This ancient city was destroyed when the mighty Ogosho fought against an evil god.

threads.claim: Kitain Hideie was a hero of the past whose age has ended, and the player is pointed to recreating his legendary spear.
threads.quote: the Kitain, who once destroyed so many evils, will never return again.

threads.claim: Repairing the wards clears the rain and clouds, though the Tatarigami will take time to fully dissipate.
threads.quote: It will take time for the Tatarigami in the atmosphere to dissipate, though.

introduced.name: Fravashi Tree
introduced.how: Pari who fought the defilement transformed into these trees, which hold residual Pari
introduced.quote: Sorush: These Fravashi Trees are Pari that fought till the very end against the defilement that had been corrupting the land.

introduced.name: Residual Pari
introduced.how: Pari remnants trapped inside Fravashi Trees, which Zurvan says are better understood as fragmented memories
introduced.quote: Zurvan: What you just described is indeed a Fravashi Tree that a Pari has transformed into. But as for what resides within such trees, I believe it more accurate to call them "fragmented memories" than "residual Pari."

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: A proud Pari who guides the Traveler and Paimon and claims to be a Yasnapati's companion
introduced.quote: Sorush: Hmph, is this how they look like now? How pathetic.

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: An elder Pari who knows the history of the Pari and the Fravashi Trees
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Well, if it isn't Sorush and her Yasnapati... My, even Paimon's here.

introduced.name: Plume of Purifying Light
introduced.how: An item a Fravashi Tree releases once its residual Pari's obsession is cleared; it must be returned to the Oasis
introduced.quote: Sorush: It is a Plume of Purifying Light! I don't know how, but the obsession contained within it has been cleared away.

introduced.name: Yasnapati
introduced.how: A title for humans with a special bond to the Pari, and the Traveler's role in helping them return
introduced.quote: Zurvan: And those who have established a special bond with the Pari have been addressed as "Yasnapati" ever since.

introduced.name: Vourukasha Oasis
introduced.how: The home of the Pari, where they were born and to which they must return
introduced.quote: Zurvan: We are born from the Vourukasha Oasis, and we shall return there eventually.

introduced.name: Amrita Pool
introduced.how: A pool where Pari wash off the filth that tainted them, used to offer Plumes
introduced.quote: Zurvan: And in the Amrita Pool, we get to wash off whatever filthiness that once tainted us.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: The Simurgh's source from which Plumes of Purifying Light derive; Pari arose from its contact with Amrita
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Plumes of Purifying Light are derived from Simurgh's Khvarena. And we Pari originated due to the contact between Khvarena and Amrita.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: An ancient group that once performed purification rituals for the Pari, now unable to do so
introduced.quote: Sorush: Legend has it that in ancient times, the Order of Skeptics would hold a ritual of purification for them, so as to bring them all back to the Vourukasha Oasis.

introduced.name: Purification ritual for Pari
introduced.how: An ancient ritual by human warriors to return scattered Pari to the Oasis; the Yasnapati is now expected to perform it
introduced.quote: Zurvan: In ancient times, the human warriors who walked with Pari would hold a ritual of purification for the Pari scattered in the desert,

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Carefree creatures born from the land, unlike the Pari who are born from the Oasis
introduced.quote: Zurvan: Unlike us, the Aranara are born from the land.

introduced.name: Oceanids
introduced.how: Water beings from foreign lands who once made a pilgrimage to the Oasis seeking their deceased god and then dispersed
introduced.quote: Zurvan: A long, long time ago, a slew of Oceanids from foreign lands once traveled here, in spite of the many obstacles.

introduced.name: Udumbara Pistils
introduced.how: Flower stamens and pistils the Pari need to be brought, used to awaken them
introduced.quote: Residual Pari of the Forest: If you could, would you mind bringing me the Udumbara Pistils? It would bloom from where it cannot bloom...

assumed.name: Bija
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, Paimon remembers that Bija we received in the forest! It was created from Aranara memories, wasn't it?

assumed.name: The Splendorous Sky That Day
assumed.quote: (If The Splendorous Sky That Day has not been completed, the following pop-up will display)

assumed.name: Amrita Pool offering
assumed.quote: Traveler: Just like those that we offered to the Amrita Pool...

assumed.name: Harvisptokhm
assumed.quote: Zurvan: After seeing the Harvisptokhm, they soon dispersed and left.

assumed.name: Giant hole in the sky
assumed.quote: Paimon: Once we fix that giant hole, everything here should recover in no time!

threads.claim: The Pari inside Fravashi Trees may be fragmented memories rather than true Pari.
threads.quote: Zurvan: What you just described is indeed a Fravashi Tree that a Pari has transformed into. But as for what resides within such trees, I believe it more accurate to call them "fragmented memories" than "residual Pari."

threads.claim: The Traveler learns there is a way to save the trapped Pari.
threads.quote: Traveler: So there is a way to save them.

threads.claim: Offering a Plume of Purifying Light at the Amrita Pool lets the Pari return to the Vourukasha Oasis.
threads.quote: Zurvan: By offering that Plume of Purifying Light to the Amrita Pool, you will enable the Pari to return to the Vourukasha Oasis once again.

threads.claim: No one in the Order of Skeptics can still perform the purification ritual for the Pari.
threads.quote: Sorush: But nowadays, there remains no one in the Order of Skeptics who is able to perform such a ritual. The best they can do is but to keep these Fravashi Trees alive.

threads.claim: The Yasnapati is named the perfect candidate to perform the purification ritual.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Speaking of Yasnapati, now that you've more or less accepted this title, that indeed makes you the perfect candidate for the ritual.

threads.claim: Sorush and Zurvan give conflicting accounts of what a Yasnapati is.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh!? That's entirely different from what Sorush told us!

threads.claim: The obsession inside Plumes is cleared away for reasons nobody understands.
threads.quote: Paimon: It seems that the obsession contained within has been cleared away, though I'm not sure how that happened.

threads.claim: The group plans to ask Zurvan how the residual Pari turned into Plumes.
threads.quote: Paimon: Let's go tell Zurvan about this when we have the time. She'll know something, Paimon's sure of it.

threads.claim: The giant hole in the sky is a damage that must be repaired for the Oasis to recover.
threads.quote: Paimon: Once we fix that giant hole, everything here should recover in no time!

threads.claim: The giant hole in the sky has been fixed, allowing the Oasis to recover.
threads.quote: Paimon: We've also fixed that giant hole in the sky. Everything here should recover in just no time!

threads.claim: The Pari were rejected by the Vourukasha Oasis because they were tainted.
threads.quote: Sorush: They exhausted their strength, to the point where they could no longer maintain their form, and were rejected by the Vourukasha Oasis for being tainted.

threads.claim: The Amrita Pool washes away the filth that tainted the Pari.
threads.quote: Zurvan: And in the Amrita Pool, we get to wash off whatever filthiness that once tainted us.

threads.claim: The Oceanids traveled to the Oasis seeking their deceased god and found it was not there.
threads.quote: Zurvan: They seemed to have come for their deceased god, only to find that what they were looking for wasn't here.

threads.claim: The Oceanid pilgrimage became a rumored route symbolizing sacrifice in pursuit of pure innocence.
threads.quote: Zurvan: Although it started out as a rumor, as time passed by, the route itself has been endowed with the meaning of sacrificing oneself in pursuit of pure innocence.

introduced.name: Spiritway
introduced.how: a route the party rides while heading up toward the volcano
introduced.quote: (While riding the Spiritway)

introduced.name: Gaseous Phlogiston
introduced.how: gas-form phlogiston fills the volcano's mouth and crater, making passage dangerous
introduced.quote: Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: a flying creature that steals statues and carries them into the volcano's crater
introduced.quote: So, Qucusaurs really do bring the stolen statues here...

assumed.name: Investigator of Ancient Ruins
assumed.quote: (If Investigator of Ancient Ruins has been completed)

assumed.name: the strange words heard by the Traveler
assumed.quote: Did you see a bunch of strange words again?

assumed.name: the person talking to the Traveler
assumed.quote: It's almost as if the person who's been talking to you all this time is in that mountain.

threads.claim: The Traveler's strange words grow clearer as they near the volcano, hinting that the voice speaking to them is inside the mountain.
threads.quote: The words feel... clearer now...

threads.claim: A strange statue appears near the volcano, raising the question of what the statues are and why they matter.
threads.quote: It looks like... some strange statue.

threads.claim: Qucusaurs carry stolen statues into the volcano's crater, answering where the statues go.
threads.quote: So, Qucusaurs really do bring the stolen statues here...

threads.claim: Gaseous phlogiston fills the volcano's crater and blocks passage, so the party must find another way down.
threads.quote: We need to think of a way to pass through the gaseous Phlogiston...

introduced.name: Court of the First Edict
introduced.how: a sacred site that Lady Aila sealed shut about 500 years ago
introduced.quote: Five hundred years ago, Lady Aila, the Moonchanter who witnessed the birth of the Moon Maiden, personally sealed it shut.

introduced.name: Vernadska
introduced.how: Verna's full name and title as a High Priestess of the Frost Moon
introduced.quote: In this sublunary sphere, I am known as Vernadska.

introduced.name: Kraka III
introduced.how: a small robot helper; Kraka V and VII are its successor models
introduced.quote: That's right. Kraka V and Kraka VII are its successor models. These little fellows are amazing helpers.

introduced.name: Pekkani
introduced.how: a self-described angler on Hiisi Island who is half a Frostmoon Scion
introduced.quote: You see, I'm the best angler on Hiisi Island by a long shot.

introduced.name: Ehrnrooth
introduced.how: a Frostmoon pursuer hunting the intruders
introduced.quote: Ehrnrooth: Krodo! Did you see where those suspicious intruders were headed?

introduced.name: Krodo
introduced.how: a Frostmoon pursuer who tracks the intruders' route
introduced.quote: Krodo: They took off toward the Court of the First Edict. Not many places to hide around here, after all.

introduced.name: Rahetar
introduced.how: Verna's aunt, a Frostmoon authority who orders checks on the seal and will report to the Lady Moonchanter
introduced.quote: Rahetar: Hmph. You two, check on the seal. I'll inform the Lady Moonchanter.

introduced.name: Lovia
introduced.how: former leader of the Frostmoon Scions, erased from memory for blasphemy
introduced.quote: She was the leader of Frostmoon Scions five hundred years ago, but she was stricken from memory for the sin of blasphemy.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a priestly order of the Frost Moon whose higher-ups are wary of technology
introduced.quote: most of us Frostmoon Scions aren't exactly big fans of tech.

introduced.name: Solovei
introduced.how: a visitor whose recorded voice speaks with Aila and who pursues the mad monk
introduced.quote: Aila: As for you... You'll be leaving this place soon, won't you, Mr. Solovei?

introduced.name: Aila
introduced.how: a lingering recorded image of the first Moonchanter who sealed the Court
introduced.quote: Maybe this... might be the first Moonchanter herself

introduced.name: Sanctum of the Oathbearer
introduced.how: a sealed sanctum where Frostmoon followers once held ceremonies
introduced.quote: By the way, the hymns say that before Lady Aila sealed it, this was where all the Frostmoon followers held their ceremonies!

introduced.name: Verdant Crest
introduced.how: a sacred tree said to have witnessed the Moon Maiden's birth
introduced.quote: Look over there — that's the Verdant Crest! Legend says it's the sacred tree that witnessed the birth of the Moon Maiden!

introduced.name: Moon Maiden
introduced.how: a divine figure whose birth is central to Frostmoon legend
introduced.quote: Legend says it's the sacred tree that witnessed the birth of the Moon Maiden!

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: a force whose stones and fragments can become unstable and cause turbulence
introduced.quote: Based on my calculations, those two stones are filled with powerful kuuvahki energies, which is why the balance here is particularly messed up.

introduced.name: stone fragments
introduced.how: kuuvahki-charged fragments that are tossed onto large stones to rebalance the turbulence
introduced.quote: Yes, and once you've collected the stone fragments, just toss them up onto those two large stones!

introduced.name: Maite Veliu
introduced.how: a self-described master thief, heir to the legendary thief Reed Miller, who is a Conch Gang member gathering intel
introduced.quote: Maite Veliu, heir to the legendary thief Reed Miller. Don't worry, that's my real name.

introduced.name: Conch Gang
introduced.how: a mutual aid and coordination group for like-minded people of similar age, which Maite belongs to
introduced.quote: I, Maite Veliu, am actually a member of the Conch Gang, here to gather intel—

introduced.name: Reed Miller
introduced.how: a legendary thief whose exploits (such as taking Frostmoon treasure from a greedy governor) are told as famous stories
introduced.quote: Just like how Reed Miller took the Frostmoon treasure back from the greedy governor, bringing her back to her senses!

introduced.name: Crab Tsar
introduced.how: a giant, once docile crab that began acting cruelly after picking up a strange stone and learning to pass through mirrors
introduced.quote: His Majesty the Crab Tsar used to be quite docile, and didn't know how to travel through these mirrors, until six months ago...

introduced.name: Crab Tsar's Palace
introduced.how: an underground palace below the pit where the treasure is hidden
introduced.quote: It's the most precious treasure hidden in the Crab Tsar's palace below... the stone that can manipulate human desires.

introduced.name: stone of desire
introduced.how: a cursed stone that can manipulate human desires and fell from the sky, carried by the Crab Tsar
introduced.quote: that's the stone of desire, an item that can manipulate human hearts...

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a group who left mirrors behind and can travel through them, living near a giant rock and dressed in Frostmoon style
introduced.quote: These mirrors were left behind by those Frostmoon weirdos. Only they and the Crab Tsar can travel through them...

introduced.name: Frostmoon mirrors
introduced.how: mirrors left by the Frostmoon Scions that only they and the Crab Tsar can travel through
introduced.quote: These mirrors were left behind by those Frostmoon weirdos. Only they and the Crab Tsar can travel through them...

introduced.name: Kasha
introduced.how: a young Frostmoon girl at the Frostmoon Enclave who collects pretty stones and wants to be taken away by an adventurer
introduced.quote: Kasha: Welcome to the Frostmoon Enclave! Is there anything I can help you with?

introduced.name: Mai
introduced.how: an adventurer about Kasha's age who sneaks around camp, told Kasha outside stories, and was once mistaken for a cult victim
introduced.quote: She's an adventurer too, just like you two! I caught her sneaking around near camp once, so I made her tell me a story.

introduced.name: Big Sis Hidimbi
introduced.how: Maite's informant, the source of Maite's knowledge about the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: All that I learned about the Frostmoon Scions, I got from Big Sis Hidimbi.

introduced.name: Big Sis Katya
introduced.how: someone who controls the bills at the Speranza Restaurant and warned against contact with the Frostmoon folk
introduced.quote: You'll still need to settle your bills with Big Sis Katya.

introduced.name: purple-haired priestess
introduced.how: an unnamed Frostmoon priestess who appears and vanishes, claims to see fate in moonlight, and says she is guiding the prophesied Ruler
introduced.quote: ...I know who you are and what you want. I can see the threads of fate woven by moonlight, so... stop pursuing me.

introduced.name: Lovia
introduced.how: High Priestess of the Frost Moon, who was bewitched by a stone of desire five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: According to the stories, Lovia, High Priestess of the Frost Moon, was also once bewitched by one such stone of desire five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Lady Aila
introduced.how: a figure whose desperate pleas moved Reed Miller to steal a cursed stone and who captured his heart
introduced.quote: The desperate pleas of Lady Aila moved the master thief Reed Miller to steal that cursed stone, and he captured her heart in the process

introduced.name: Moon Goddess
introduced.how: the deity the Frostmoon folk supposedly sacrifice people to, which is why they are feared
introduced.quote: even a master thief like myself was almost caught and sacrificed to their Moon Goddess once.

introduced.name: Moonfall Silver
introduced.how: a pretty, somewhat common silvery stone found on Hiisi Island
introduced.quote: Oh, that's Moonfall Silver! It's pretty, but it's not that rare here on Hiisi Island.

assumed.name: Thunderclap Reef
assumed.quote: Oh right, do you remember when Verna mentioned a place called the Court of the First Edict, when we were back at Thunderclap Reef?

assumed.name: Papa Wrench
assumed.quote: those top-notch detectives from Papa Wrench's books!

assumed.name: Hidimbi
assumed.quote: Last time it was a woman called Hidimbi

assumed.name: giant crab encounter
assumed.quote: when we ran into that giant crab!

assumed.name: Eye of Kratti
assumed.quote: Just as it is with the cursed Eye of Kratti

assumed.name: Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L
assumed.quote: Welcome, Your Excellency Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L, Sovereign Ruler of Natlantea

assumed.name: Pillar of Embla
assumed.quote: Miss Alia said something similar to us back at the Pillar of Embla

assumed.name: Moon Mirror
assumed.quote: more experience with using the Moon Mirror

assumed.name: Kraka I
assumed.quote: If only the original, Kraka I, was still around

assumed.name: mad monk
assumed.quote: I need to uncover that mad monk's true intentions.

assumed.name: Court of the First Edict
assumed.quote: didn't you tell us to wait for you at the Court of the First Edict earlier?

assumed.name: Thunderclap Reef
assumed.quote: Y—You're that priestess who appeared near Thunderclap Reef earlier!

assumed.name: Verna
assumed.quote: Uh, Verna said you were a fake, though...

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Since she's dressed like a Frostmoon Scion, Lauma must know her!

assumed.name: kuuvahki
assumed.quote: Approach the center of the mirror while empowered with kuuvahki

assumed.name: Sanctum of the Oathkeeper
assumed.quote: It flies towards the giant pillar at the Sanctum of the Oathkeeper and slots neatly into an indent at its center

assumed.name: Snezhnograd
assumed.quote: Even back when Snezhnograd had the legendary Reed Miller—

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: If you should ever need help with anything in Nasha Town while I'm around and able, just call on me!

assumed.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
assumed.quote: our first major deed in Mondstadt was stealing the Holy Lyre der Himmel

threads.claim: An undying serpent must fall, and the Traveler is meant to fell it.
threads.quote: Aila: To me, it's already happened. Twice shall that serpent fall — first strangled by the flesh of the faithless, then shrinking away before the light you and I ignite together.

threads.claim: The Traveler is foretold as the hero who protects Elysium.
threads.quote: for you are the hero meant to protect

threads.claim: A mysterious woman greets the Traveler as the hero of Elysium again.
threads.quote: You arrive at last, hero of "Elysium."

threads.claim: Aila suggests the Traveler does not belong to this world and her thread-weaving brought them here.
threads.quote: Your thread simply would not catch in the loom of this sublunary sphere

threads.claim: Aila claims all events are already fated and the past is the future.
threads.quote: There is no past or future — because the past is the future.

threads.claim: Aila appears as a recorded blessing that can hear and see the party from five hundred years ago.
threads.quote: This is merely a blessing that records awareness, so that can hear our words.

threads.claim: Aila says she sees every moment through Lovia's blessing.
threads.quote: Thanks to Lovia's blessing — the blessing of our ancestors — I can see every moment.

threads.claim: Lovia was erased from Frostmoon memory for blasphemy, and only senior priestesses know her name.
threads.quote: she was stricken from memory for the sin of blasphemy.

threads.claim: Aila severed Lovia's thread, and Lovia's sins are said to be buried in the sanctum.
threads.quote: I hold no resentment toward Lovia. But our children must not be stained by her sins.

threads.claim: Solovei is pursuing a mad monk who may be responsible for a fallen friend's death.
threads.quote: I need to uncover that mad monk's true intentions.

threads.claim: Lovia had secret correspondence with the mad monk that may serve as evidence.
threads.quote: With Lovia's years of secret correspondence with him as evidence, tracing his steps should be much easier.

threads.claim: Aila's sealing is preparation for the birth of a god.
threads.quote: This, too, is a part of our preparation for the birth of a god.

threads.claim: A mysterious woman says the newborn god will bring joy and that she waited for this moment.
threads.quote: All for the birth of a "god"...

threads.claim: The Court of the First Edict has been sealed for centuries, and an impostor says she will wait there.
threads.quote: You just told us no one's been able to unseal the Court of the First Edict for centuries!

threads.claim: The mysterious woman says she will await the party at the Court of the First Edict.
threads.quote: Well then, I shall await you at the Court of the First Edict.

threads.claim: An unidentified woman posing as a priestess appears and leads the party toward the Court of the First Edict.
threads.quote: That strange lady... who exactly is she?

threads.claim: Kuuvahki turbulence on Hiisi Island has worsened since two large rocks fell from the sky.
threads.quote: But things have gotten worse since those two large rocks fell from the sky...

threads.claim: The party neutralizes the kuuvahki turbulence by placing the stones back into the sanctum's pillar.
threads.quote: See? All according to plan. The kuuvahki turbulence has been neutralized!

threads.claim: Verna keeps invoking science and faith interchangeably, showing tension between Frostmoon belief and technology.
threads.quote: You've gotta have as much faith in the Moon Maiden's guidance as you do in the power of science!

threads.claim: A cursed stone that manipulates human desires is hidden with the Crab Tsar and may be what drives its cruelty.
threads.quote: It's the most precious treasure hidden in the Crab Tsar's palace below... the stone that can manipulate human desires.

threads.claim: The stone flies off the Crab Tsar's back and the crab calms down, though the stone's true origin and nature remain unexplained.
threads.quote: (The rock on the Crab Tsar's back flies away)

threads.claim: The stone that drove the Crab Tsar fell out of the skies, like a giant rock near the Frostmoon Scions.
threads.quote: it's something that fell out of the skies, like that giant rock over where the Frostmoon Scions live.

threads.claim: Kasha senses that a small stone is attracted to the big stone, hinting at a deeper connection between the stones.
threads.quote: It's a beautiful stone, sure, but I feel like it seems to be attracted to this big stone...

threads.claim: The unnamed priestess appears and vanishes while speaking in riddles, leaving her identity and motives open.
threads.quote: ...Have you come... searching for me?

threads.claim: A prophecy names a Ruler of Elysium whom the Frostmoon priestess has been sent to guide.
threads.quote: ...Guiding the prophesied Ruler of "Elysium" is our mission in the sublunary sphere...

threads.claim: Rumors say the Frostmoon Scions take people's blood and sacrifice them to their Moon Goddess, though this is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: even a master thief like myself was almost caught and sacrificed to their Moon Goddess once.

threads.claim: The stone fragments on the crabs can also pass through the Frostmoon mirrors, extending the mirrors' use beyond the Scions.
threads.quote: it looks like the stone fragments on these crabs can pass through those mirrors, too!

threads.claim: Lovia was bewitched by a stone of desire five hundred years ago, and Reed Miller's theft for Lady Aila is tied to it.
threads.quote: According to the stories, Lovia, High Priestess of the Frost Moon, was also once bewitched by one such stone of desire five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: the land the Traveler arrives in, where the island restriction applies
introduced.quote: After arriving in Inazuma, the Traveler finds themself unable to leave Ritou Island due to the Sakoku Decree enforced by the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Ritou Island
introduced.how: an island the Traveler is stuck on and must get a permit to leave
introduced.quote: After arriving in Inazuma, the Traveler finds themself unable to leave Ritou Island due to the Sakoku Decree enforced by the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.how: a decree that keeps people from leaving Ritou Island without a permit
introduced.quote: After arriving in Inazuma, the Traveler finds themself unable to leave Ritou Island due to the Sakoku Decree enforced by the Kanjou Commission.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: the body that enforces the Sakoku Decree on Ritou
introduced.quote: Ms. Hiiragi is the young lady of the Kanjou Commission's Hiiragi Clan.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
introduced.how: the Kanjou Commissioner who appears friendly but will not let the Traveler leave
introduced.quote: The Traveler attempts to talk to Hiiragi Shinsuke, the Kanjou Commissioner, who seems friendly but clearly has no intention of letting the Traveler leave the island.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Chisato
introduced.how: the commissioner's beloved daughter who cannot leave her clan's rules and wants a letter delivered
introduced.quote: My father knows that Mr. Hiiragi's beloved daughter Chisato likes treats, so he told me to prepare some as a gift in return.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Clan
introduced.how: Chisato's clan, part of the Kanjou Commission
introduced.quote: Ms. Hiiragi is the young lady of the Kanjou Commission's Hiiragi Clan.

introduced.name: Kujou Kamaji
introduced.how: a Tenryou enforcer and Kujou Clan member who is Chisato's lover and writes the permit
introduced.quote: I understand his concerns. After all, I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the enforcers of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Kujou Clan
introduced.how: Kamaji's clan, whose strict rules keep him from contacting Chisato
introduced.quote: I understand his concerns. After all, I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the enforcers of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the commission Kamaji serves as an enforcer
introduced.quote: I understand his concerns. After all, I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the enforcers of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Kiminami Restaurant
introduced.how: a restaurant where the Traveler waits while Kamaji prepares the permit
introduced.quote: Can you wait for me at the Kiminami Restaurant?

introduced.name: Travel Permit
introduced.how: the permit that lets the holder freely enter and leave Ritou
introduced.quote: This is the Travel Permit. Please take it.

introduced.name: Chisato's Letter
introduced.how: a letter Chisato wants delivered to Kamaji, which the Traveler carries out of the island
introduced.quote: to deliver a letter to her lover, Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission.

introduced.name: Tricolor Dango
introduced.how: treats Kamaji prepared for Chisato as a gift
introduced.quote: These Tricolor Dango... He prepared them for me...

introduced.name: Shinsuke's gift of fine tea
introduced.how: a batch of tea Shinsuke gave Kamaji's father, prompting Kamaji's return gift
introduced.quote: A while back, Mr. Hiiragi Shinsuke presented my father with a batch of fine tea.

assumed.name: Traveler's prior reputation
assumed.quote: You are... Ahh, you're that Traveler from abroad. What can I do for you?

assumed.name: Master Kamaji
assumed.quote: Sanada: Are you talking about Master Kamaji? What do you want from him?

assumed.name: Kiminami Anna
assumed.quote: Kiminami Anna: Oh, I've already prepared the treats that Master Kamaji ordered. I'll bring them to you now.

assumed.name: Hiiragi Chisato's earlier meeting with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Oh, it's you, Traveler.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree keeps the Traveler trapped on Ritou Island and must be circumvented.
threads.quote: After arriving in Inazuma, the Traveler finds themself unable to leave Ritou Island due to the Sakoku Decree enforced by the Kanjou Commission.

threads.claim: Leaving Ritou requires obtaining a permit.
threads.quote: In order to leave, the Traveler must obtain a permit.

threads.claim: Hiiragi Shinsuke seems friendly but has no intention of letting the Traveler leave.
threads.quote: The Traveler attempts to talk to Hiiragi Shinsuke, the Kanjou Commissioner, who seems friendly but clearly has no intention of letting the Traveler leave the island.

threads.claim: Chisato and Kamaji are secret lovers whose contact is forbidden by their clans.
threads.quote: to deliver a letter to her lover, Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission.

threads.claim: Kamaji's closeness to Chisato could be exploited by others, hinting at tension between the two clans.
threads.quote: If I were to get close to her, it would be inevitable that someone might try to take advantage of our situation.

threads.claim: Kamaji's father forbids contact with Chisato, showing the clan strictness that separates the two.
threads.quote: Father doesn't want me to communicate with Ms. Hiiragi.

threads.claim: Shinsuke's tea gift to Kamaji's father is answered with treats for Chisato.
threads.quote: My father knows that Mr. Hiiragi's beloved daughter Chisato likes treats, so he told me to prepare some as a gift in return.

threads.claim: The permit is presented as a route to greater freedom for the Traveler.
threads.quote: You should have a lot more freedom than before.

threads.claim: Kamaji grants the Traveler the Travel Permit, resolving the need to obtain a permit.
threads.quote: This is the Travel Permit. Please take it.

threads.claim: Chisato receives Kamaji's handwritten letter and treats, confirming their exchange of affection.
threads.quote: Hiiragi Chisato: Thank you, Traveler. I'll make sure to savor these treats. As for this letter... I'll read it with great care.

introduced.name: Hanachirusato
introduced.how: masked shrine maiden who introduces herself and asks the Traveler to lift a barrier
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: Excuse my rudeness. My name is Hanachirusato, and I am a shrine maiden.

introduced.name: Konda Village
introduced.how: village with a hidden barrier beneath it and secrets among its people
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: The village in front of you is named Konda Village, and there is a... barrier within it that needs to be lifted.

introduced.name: Konda Densuke
introduced.how: village chief who denies there are any secrets in the village
introduced.quote: Konda Densuke: My name is Konda Densuke, and I am the village chief.

introduced.name: Futaba
introduced.how: villager who reports strange rain-night sounds and clicking clacking bags in the gully
introduced.quote: Futaba: Okay, I'll be serious. One night, it suddenly started raining very heavily.

introduced.name: Takeru
introduced.how: Densuke's grandson who reports a ghostly lady during thunderstorms
introduced.quote: Takeru: There's a strange spooky ghost lady!

introduced.name: Saimon Eri
introduced.how: elderly villager whose son Jirou has gone missing and who reports the village's strange happenings
introduced.quote: Saimon Eri: The strangest thing is how we haven't heard from Jirou for such a long time...

introduced.name: Ochimusha
introduced.how: samurai-like monsters that appear when the wards are used and are defeated in combat
introduced.quote: Traveler: So, those monsters that looked like samurai were...

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual
introduced.how: rite to purify the Thunder Sakura roots by breaking barriers over them and purging filth
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: That is why we must perform the Cleansing Ritual.

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: sacred trees whose roots absorb filth from the earth and can wither if overloaded
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: The Thunder Sakura of Narukami Island can absorb the filth within the earth. But over time, that filth will accumulate.

introduced.name: Mysterious Shadow
introduced.how: shadowy figures that vanish when approached at the abandoned shrine
introduced.quote: Mysterious Shadow: ...

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Summary
introduced.how: old book describing the ritual that is hard to read and gives little help
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon's read it all, but it also feels like Paimon didn't read anything at all.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: shrine where professionals know the ritual's history and fortune slips are read
introduced.quote: Paimon: Since it's about gods and demons and stuff, let's go to the Grand Narukami Shrine, shall we?

introduced.name: Inagi Hotomi
introduced.how: shrine staff who explains the sacred words are personal to the caster and gives the Memento Lens
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: Hello, Traveler from afar. Welcome to the Grand Narukami Shrine!

introduced.name: Memento Lens
introduced.how: lens that shows scenes from the past through Earth Kitsune statues
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: We extracted the lens and named it the Memento Lens.

introduced.name: Earth Kitsune
introduced.how: small fox statues that show past scenes when viewed through the Memento Lens
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: There are small fox statues in many different places. They are called Earth Kitsune.

introduced.name: Kitsune Saiguu
introduced.how: divine fox whose familiars guard the island and who gave the Hiiragi Clan a demon-exorcising mirror
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: Legend has it that after the Kitsune Saiguu disappeared, her familiars, the of Narukami Island, turned into sleeping statues in many places, waiting for her to return.

introduced.name: Konda Clan
introduced.how: family charged by the Kitsune Saiguu with guarding the barrier under Konda Village
introduced.quote: Konda Densuke: And guarding it and its barrier was said to be a responsibility assigned to us, the Konda Clan, by the Kitsune Saiguu herself.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Clan
introduced.how: clan whose leader Hiroshi imported inventions and used the Kitsune Saiguu's mirror for a Kamera
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: A long time ago, when Ritou was first founded, the Hiiragi Clan leader Hiroshi imported many new inventions from other places to prove the benefits of building a trading hub.

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: island protected by five Thunder Sakura roots that need cleansing
introduced.quote: Konda Densuke: They say that in ancient times, underneath the ground we are standing on right now, lay the roots of the Thunder Sakura.

introduced.name: Electro Archon
introduced.how: deity whose eternal watch the Thunder Sakura symbolize
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: As you may know, the Thunder Sakura trees symbolize the eternal watch of the Electro Archon, and they have the power to remove evil and purify the earth.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: mentioned as a possible hidden force behind the strange events
introduced.quote: Paimon: Are the Fatui behind this? If you say it's so important, then they might be up to something here too...

introduced.name: Mount Yougou
introduced.how: mountain with an abandoned shrine and the depths where the final root lies
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: As for the location of the next barrier, you can visit the abandoned shrine nearby. It's not far northeast of Konda Village.

introduced.name: Chinju Forest
introduced.how: forest holding a root and barrier, home to Bake-Danuki and Ioroi
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: The Chinju Forest is also home to a ward and a root that requires cleansing.

introduced.name: Kamisato Estate
introduced.how: location with a root in a pit on a beach northeast of its courtyard
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: The last one... is outside the Kamisato residence. There is a pit on a beach northeast of there, and the root is within.

introduced.name: Araumi
introduced.how: location with a Thunder Sakura root barrier
introduced.quote: Hanachirusato: Apart from Chinju Forest, there is a tree root at a place called Araumi.

introduced.name: Mysterious Man
introduced.how: figure in the Memento Lens scenes who sets the sacred words for the ward
introduced.quote: Mysterious Man: Hmm. Yes, it looks like the spirit veins here can still be used.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: Fontaine-made device that records images and, in the past, thoughts and memories
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: Since the two of you are so knowledgeable, I trust that you must have heard of the Kamera? It's a Fontaine-made device that can record images.

introduced.name: Sacred words
introduced.how: ward-sealing phrases with three lines, whose content is chosen by the caster and must be in the correct order
introduced.quote: Inagi Hotomi: I apologize, but the sacred words used to seal the ward are not some sort of specific formula.

introduced.name: Ioroi
introduced.how: introduces himself as the world-renowned bake-danuki, lord of the bake-danuki, sealed in stone
introduced.quote: Mine name is Ioroi, the world-renowned bake-danuki!

introduced.name: Bake-danuki
introduced.how: tanuki folk who use magic to hide, transform, and make things vanish
introduced.quote: So this is bake-danuki magic? Seems kinda fun!

introduced.name: Hanachirusato
introduced.how: a masked shrine maiden who says she wants to borrow the Traveler's strength to destroy evils
introduced.quote: A shrine maiden who wants to borrow your strength to destroy these evils.

introduced.name: Kitsune Saiguu
introduced.how: a kitsune goddess worshiped long ago, once Ioroi's rival in an endless hide-and-seek contest
introduced.quote: She was worshiped as the kitsune goddess in many places long ago.

introduced.name: Yougou Three
introduced.how: a group of humans who defeated Ioroi's tribe and turned them to stone
introduced.quote: Then came one of the humans from the Yougou Three. He defeated my tribe and I, turning all of us to stone.

introduced.name: Kamuna
introduced.how: an onmyouji from a past age who sealed Ioroi into stone over the stolen ward
introduced.quote: Kamuna... an onmyouji from a past age, who did the deed.

introduced.name: Ochimusha
introduced.how: ghostly samurai evil spirits formed when filth coalesces, shaped by the memories of their times
introduced.quote: They are creatures created by the coalescence of filth.

introduced.name: Filth
introduced.how: defilement that accumulates across the land and gathers into a tumor deep under Mt. Yougou
introduced.quote: Simply put, it is a collection of filth that has accumulated throughout the land.

introduced.name: Mt. Yougou
introduced.how: mountain whose deepest part holds the miasmic tumor wrapped in Sacred Sakura roots
introduced.quote: The filth has condensed into a large tumor in the deepest part of Mt. Yougou

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: side branches whose roots absorb filth to cleanse the land
introduced.quote: It is for this purpose that the Thunder Sakura roots exert their cleansing power to absorb the filth

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: main tree whose roots sit deep in Mt. Yougou and hold the accumulated filth
introduced.quote: Just as the Grand Shrine has its branches, the Thunder Sakura are just the side branches of the Sacred Sakura in Mt. Yougou.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual
introduced.how: ritual whose goal is removing the tumor of accumulated filth from the Sacred Sakura's roots
introduced.quote: The goal of the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is to remove that tumor.

introduced.name: Hakushin Clan
introduced.how: the bloodline Kitsune Saiguu belonged to, which once defended Inazuma's people alongside the Electro Archon
introduced.quote: The Kitsune Saiguu was originally of the Hakushin bloodline, and she used to defend the people of Inazuma alongside the Electro Archon.

introduced.name: Sky Kitsune
introduced.how: emissaries of Kitsune Saiguu who turned into stone statues to await her return
introduced.quote: The Sky Kitsune and Earth Kitsune were once her emissaries.

introduced.name: Ioroi's Ward
introduced.how: a ward Ioroi stole, which turned out to be required for the Cleansing Ritual
introduced.quote: But when Ioroi dared to steal the ward for the Cleansing Ritual, well, that was enough to get him punished.

introduced.name: Shousei
introduced.how: one of Ioroi's bake-danuki children who plays hide-and-seek
introduced.quote: Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, and Kichiboushi. Go find these and play with them.

introduced.name: Gyoubu Koban
introduced.how: one of Ioroi's bake-danuki children who plays hide-and-seek
introduced.quote: Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, and Kichiboushi. Go find these and play with them.

introduced.name: Kichiboushi
introduced.how: one of Ioroi's bake-danuki children who can move and remove seals
introduced.quote: Kichiboushi, take them there and remove the seal.

introduced.name: Hiiragi Hiroshi
introduced.how: Kanjou Head who was given a catalyst by Kitsune Saiguu, which was destroyed
introduced.quote: the destruction of the catalyst that was given to Hiiragi Hiroshi, Kanjou Head, by the Kitsune Saiguu

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Inagi Hotomi: May the Electro Archon bless you! I shall be counting on you two, then.

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: Hanachirusato: There is a barrier under Konda Village. For the sake of Narukami Island, we must lift it.

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Konda Densuke: Although the economy isn't good these days, all the taxes that should be paid to the police station are paid regularly, regardless.

assumed.name: Ritou
assumed.quote: Saimon Eri: In the past, traders and tourists from various countries would disembark at Ritou, and they would pass through our village on their way to Inazuma City.

assumed.name: Inazuma City
assumed.quote: Saimon Eri: My old husband's even put up a search notice in Inazuma City.

assumed.name: Sakura Bloom
assumed.quote: Hanachirusato: Our fates shall surely be entwined like those of the Sakura Bloom.

assumed.name: Kamisato Estate
assumed.quote: Hanachirusato: The last one... is outside the Kamisato residence. There is a pit on a beach northeast of there, and the root is within.

assumed.name: Cataclysm
assumed.quote: Hanachirusato: Monsters raged unchecked then. Even the seas turned black.

assumed.name: Ioroi
assumed.quote: Mysterious Woman: Ah, I remember now. She once instructed people to by a canal on the road leading to Chinju Forest, before giving the key to the Konda Clan.

assumed.name: Lady Yae
assumed.quote: Inagi Hotomi: Ah, it's a great shame, but a lot of historical records have been lost. Lady Yae and Sir Kamisato were fretting over this earlier as well.

assumed.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
assumed.quote: Inagi Hotomi: The use of sacred words was said to have become a lost art after the Kamuna bloodline failed...

assumed.name: Hakushin Clan
assumed.quote: Mysterious Man: Since this is her territory — the land of the Hakushin bloodline — we'll go with that.

assumed.name: Konda Village
assumed.quote: Hanachirusato: The village in front of you is named Konda Village, and there is a... barrier within it that needs to be lifted.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: In order to make sure that he would comply with the Electro Archon's rule

assumed.name: Statues of The Seven
assumed.quote: Even the Statues of The Seven pale in comparison...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Like the Fatui?

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: Like the Abyss Order?

assumed.name: Sky and Earth Kitsune
assumed.quote: Yeah, like the Sky and Earth Kitsune?

assumed.name: Thunder Sakura root cleansing
assumed.quote: I shall be next to the Thunder Sakura root that you cleansed successfully.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato says the Thunder Sakura roots need cleansing, and the ritual's details have been lost.
threads.quote: Inagi Hotomi: But the actual details of the ritual have been lost. The Summary you are holding is a very valuable historical artifact in that regard.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato is hiding something about herself and is watching the Traveler without showing up openly.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: I was quite concerned as to your actions, and as to whether you could heal the roots or not, so I have been observing you a little. If I have offended you, please forgive me.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato is revealed to be the same person seen through the Memento Lens, and her age and identity remain unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: Her name was "Hanachirusato." Are you that Hanachirusato?

threads.claim: Hanachirusato hints that her physical condition and the filth in her are tied to the Cleansing Ritual.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: Unfortunately, my... physical condition, shall we say, prevents me from accomplishing this deed.

threads.claim: The Memento Lens can show scenes from the past at Earth Kitsune statues.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: There are small fox statues in many different places. They are called Earth Kitsune. With the Memento Lens, one can summon forth scenes from the past at those statues' locations.

threads.claim: Ioroi, the Bake-Danuki sealed in stone, is a source of unrest in Chinju Forest.
threads.quote: Mysterious Man: That being said, after she left, Ioroi seems to have led his tribe to wreak havoc everywhere.

threads.claim: Hiroshi's Kamera is described as a device that records thoughts and memories, and Hanachirusato reacts to the mention of it.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: ...Th—That mirror, Hiroshi... He...

threads.claim: The Sky and Earth Kitsune statues have fallen asleep waiting for the Kitsune Saiguu to return.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: In the past, the ward was guarded by the Sky Kitsune. But after everything changed, the Sky and Earth Kitsune eventually refused to show up, instead sleeping and waiting for her return.

threads.claim: The monsters called Ochimusha are condensed filth from the land rather than natural creatures.
threads.quote: Hanachirusato: They are the embodiment of the land's defilement. Once driven out of the roots by the ward, they will condense into a physical form.

threads.claim: Konda Densuke admits to the robbery of a Shogunate cart and the cover-up that followed.
threads.quote: Konda Densuke: There was originally a group of young people in the village who got too bold after getting drunk, and actually robbed one of the Shogunate's cargo carts.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato claims to have inherited Kitsune Saiguu's memories but refuses to say more yet.
threads.quote: I inherited her memories. As for other things, please forgive me. I cannot speak of them yet.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato reveals her origin: the filth left when the dark disaster could not fully erase Kitsune Saiguu's memories.
threads.quote: Her memories were so powerful that the dark disaster could not dissolve them completely. After the disaster was defeated, those memories flowed into the earth as fiery filth.

threads.claim: The figure seen through the Memento Lens is confirmed to be Hanachirusato in the past.
threads.quote: Yes, that was me in the past.

threads.claim: Hanachirusato will be removed by the ritual's purification, which she confirms as the result of her own cleansing.
threads.quote: Well, the word "eliminated" sounds a bit much. But in terms of the result, you are correct.

threads.claim: Kitsune Saiguu was swallowed up by darkness, and her fate beyond that is left open.
threads.quote: She was swallowed up by the darkness.

threads.claim: Kitsune Saiguu's thoughts and memories returned to the soil of Narukami Island after the dark disaster was defeated.
threads.quote: When the dark disaster that consumed her was finally dealt with, her thoughts and memories returned to the soil of Narukami Island.

threads.claim: Ioroi and Kitsune Saiguu are locked in a hide-and-seek contest that never ended.
threads.quote: And that's how their endless contest began.

threads.claim: Ioroi appears to still be waiting for Kitsune Saiguu to return and find him.
threads.quote: Based on what you said about Ioroi, that appears to be the case...

threads.claim: A dark disaster made the world pitch black and consumed Kitsune Saiguu while she protected the forest.
threads.quote: That's why, when the world became pitch black, the Kitsune Saiguu was worried that Ioroi might die while fighting against this inexorable evil in his capacity as protector of the forest.

threads.claim: The Sacred Sakura is described as feeling agony and speaking to Hanachirusato.
threads.quote: The Sacred Sakura is constantly telling me of her agony...

threads.claim: The Sacred Sakura's agony is shown to lift once the tumor is destroyed.
threads.quote: The agony that the Sacred Sakura has been going through should have dissipated...

threads.claim: Hanachirusato asks whether Inazuma is currently shrouded in war, and the Traveler confirms it is true.
threads.quote: If you don't mind, please answer this question honestly: Is Inazuma presently shrouded in war?

threads.claim: Hanachirusato calls the Traveler the Destined One, a label she first doubted.
threads.quote: When you first acquired the Konda Village ward, I said that you were the "Destined One."

threads.claim: Hanachirusato confirms the Traveler is the Destined One after the tumor is defeated.
threads.quote: Human child... you have done well. You truly are the "Destined One."

threads.claim: Protecting the land and absorbing filth causes miasma to accumulate in the roots over time.
threads.quote: As a price for protecting the land and absorbing the filth, miasma will accumulate in the roots.

threads.claim: The miasmic tumor at the bottom of Mt. Yougou is destroyed, completing the ritual's final step.
threads.quote: It is over.

introduced.name: Monglane
introduced.how: Receptionist at the Fortress of Meropide who processes the Traveler's case forms
introduced.quote: I'm a receptionist here at the Fortress of Meropide. Everyone calls me Monglane.

introduced.name: Darcy
introduced.how: Self-introduced as Dirty Face Darcy, a guard-side resident who guides the Traveler around
introduced.quote: Newcomers? And two of you, to boot? Welcome! Welcome to the Fortress of Meropide! I'm Darcy.

introduced.name: Estienne
introduced.how: Darcy's guard partner who runs the Coupon Millionaire game and is described as one of the good guards
introduced.quote: I'll take you to meet Estienne, my guard partner!

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: The Fortress is a place where residents live routine lives and newcomers arrive
introduced.quote: For-tress-of-Me-ro-pi-de. Got it? This is the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Coupon Millionaire
introduced.how: Estienne's game in which residents earn Coupons, with the top earner winning a chance to go outside
introduced.quote: So I created Coupon Millionaire, and those who want to go outside are free to sign up. Whoever gets the most Coupons wins the game.

introduced.name: Lanoire
introduced.how: Young girl living in the Fortress who introduces herself and speaks of a mysterious Cater
introduced.quote: I'm... Lanoire.

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: Taller-looking figure who looks after Lanoire and asks to be called Caterpillar
introduced.quote: Please call me Caterpillar.

introduced.name: Noailles
introduced.how: Strict newly arrived guard who wants to restore order at the Fortress
introduced.quote: I am not as lenient as Estienne. If I'm going to restore order, then punishments are a must.

introduced.name: Rave
introduced.how: Self-described curious competitor in the Coupon Millionaire game
introduced.quote: I have many qualities, and one that has benefited me greatly is my curiosity.

introduced.name: Coupon Cafeteria
introduced.how: Dining hall where residents get one free meal a day or buy meals with Coupons
introduced.quote: Just talk to Bran, and you'll get a yummy free meal!

introduced.name: Bran
introduced.how: Clockwork meka who serves random free meals at the cafeteria
introduced.quote: Bran's the clockwork meka over there. It was broken, but Wolsey repaired it.

introduced.name: Rochelle Loudspeaker
introduced.how: Noise box that broadcasts production zone safety notices and is linked to nervous breakdowns
introduced.quote: The Fourth said that this is a noise box that transforms evil into good.

introduced.name: Alvard
introduced.how: Shopkeeper at the Rag and Bone Shop who sells goods for Coupons
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Rag and Bone Shop! We have everything...

introduced.name: Rag and Bone Shop
introduced.how: Shop where Alvard sells rare goods to those with Coupons
introduced.quote: I heard Alvard's got his hands on some rare stuff. If you're interested, you could go to his Rag and Bone Shop and ask.

introduced.name: Nizami
introduced.how: Sparring partner who runs the boxing dummy at the Bow-Wow-House
introduced.quote: Tired from playing with those kids? You can spar with me after you've rested!

introduced.name: Bow-Wow-House
introduced.how: Dangerous furry-monster training place that requires passing the boxing dummy to enter
introduced.quote: The Bow-Wow-House is just up ahead. I've never been inside, though. Cater wouldn't let me.

introduced.name: Pankration
introduced.how: Fighting contest in the Fortress that Darcy mentions as an opening act is planned
introduced.quote: Think of it as an opening act before the real Pankration match starts.

introduced.name: Agnes
introduced.how: Lanoire's mother, who died of a chronic illness and was the one who would have started Lanoire's removal
introduced.quote: Agnes, her mother, was plagued by a chronic illness and passed away some time ago.

introduced.name: evil sorcerer
introduced.how: Lanoire's childhood bogeyman, described as wearing black with a branched staff, who must not spot her
introduced.quote: Yes, with black clothes and a staff that has branches sticking out of it.

introduced.name: Genevieve
introduced.how: A competitor who wants the game rules amended and asks the Traveler to join a protest against Estienne
introduced.quote: Genevieve: Alright. I'm hoping you'll join us in launching a protest against Estienne.

introduced.name: Poiret
introduced.how: A lonely teammate of Genevieve who says he has tried relying on others and been let down
introduced.quote: Poiret: Humans are lonely creatures, don't you think?

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: Revealed to be a Hilichurl who takes a human form, not a human child
introduced.quote: (He takes the form of an Anemo Hilichurl Rogue)

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: A powerful mage who taught Caterpillar speech and gave it memory and intelligence
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: Narzissenkreuz, a powerful mage. He taught me human speech and granted me memory and intelligence.

introduced.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: A ceremonial sword of the Ordo that has since been lost
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: My master raised the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz high.

introduced.name: Arkhium
introduced.how: A mineral mined at the Geode Mine Shaft, with mining halted after an accident
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: It's Arkhium. Arkhium mining operations stopped after the Fontaine Research Institute accident.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Its accident halted Arkhium mining at the Geode Mine Shaft
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: It's Arkhium. Arkhium mining operations stopped after the Fontaine Research Institute accident.

introduced.name: Geode Mine Shaft
introduced.how: A dangerous pipe route out of the Fortress that leads outside, guarded by a research terminal
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: The Geode Mine Shaft... It's a dangerous route, but it's feasible.

introduced.name: Flying Energy Thief
introduced.how: An untested flying machine that chases anyone holding an energy storage device at the Geode Mine Shaft
introduced.quote: The Geode Mine Shaft has been equipped with a Flying Energy Thief.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: The region the group has been taken to, a blue and green land beyond the Fortress
introduced.quote: Traveler: We're in Fontaine.

introduced.name: Teyvat
introduced.how: The continent on which Fontaine lies
introduced.quote: Traveler: We're on the continent of Teyvat.

introduced.name: Lutz
introduced.how: A letter-typing clerk at the mail queue who slows things down by embellishing letters
introduced.quote: Upbeat Man: Lutz has a tendency to slow things down by embellishing the letters as he types them out.

introduced.name: Decembre
introduced.how: A desperate queueing prisoner who asks for help sending a birthday letter to his son
introduced.quote: Decembre: Thank you so much! You're great people. Oh, I forgot to ask for your names. I'm Decembre, and you?

introduced.name: White Lily
introduced.how: The sender of a strange, obsessive letter addressed to Monsieur Neuvillette, revealed as the signer of the letter Decembre carried
introduced.quote: Your admirer, White Lily.

introduced.name: Tri-Coupon Troupe
introduced.how: A theater troupe that is really just two performers
introduced.quote: Meilhat: Haha, we're not actually world-renowned in the least. The regular cast consists of just the two of us.

introduced.name: Meilhat
introduced.how: A theater troupe member who introduces herself and asks the Traveler for feedback on a play ending
introduced.quote: Meilhat: Hello. You've been watching so you must have an interest in theater. Allow me to introduce myself, my name is Meilhat.

introduced.name: Fourmon
introduced.how: Meilhat's troupe partner, who reveals he was sentenced at the Opera Epiclese
introduced.quote: Fourmon: Thanks for the compliment, I... Wait a second, I've already been there! I'm here because that's where I was sentenced!

introduced.name: Maupoil
introduced.how: A guard covering for Estienne who complains about his workload and the new guard's methods
introduced.quote: Maupoil: ...Going somewhere?

introduced.name: Noailles
introduced.how: A strict guard who hunts the group and insists they are criminals, despite Paimon's disbelief
introduced.quote: Noailles: Just who I was looking for.

introduced.name: Nakul
introduced.how: Client who hires the Traveler to negotiate renting a room, paying in Coupons
introduced.quote: I'll be staying here for a while longer, so I need a place to pursue my studies.

introduced.name: Nizami
introduced.how: Former bodyguard of Nakul who got into a fight with the room's occupant and loves sparring
introduced.quote: So I appointed Nizami as my representative. He was always reliable during the time I employed him as a bodyguard.

introduced.name: Carranza
introduced.how: A rival bidder who reportedly offered the door occupant a much higher price
introduced.quote: Haven't you ever heard of Carranza? He's much more generous. He offered... Uh, he offered me 108,000!

introduced.name: Coupons
introduced.how: Coupons are the payment used in the Fortress, since Mora is useless there
introduced.quote: But Mora is useless here, so I'll pay with Coupons.

introduced.name: Clynes
introduced.how: Fontaine Research Institute-linked worker in the Fortress who repairs devices and is sent to help with the rift terminal
introduced.quote: Galvaryet: Clynes should be repairing his device or whatever it is by the Rift of Erosion. Go help him out, would you?

introduced.name: Rift of Erosion
introduced.how: A rift connecting to the outside that had to be watched until a device sealed it
introduced.quote: Clynes: There was a rift that connected to the outside, and it had to be watched.

introduced.name: Galvana
introduced.how: Galvaryet's sister whose presence destroys machines; she destroyed a terminal Clynes was repairing
introduced.quote: I asked Galvana for help last time, and even though I only looked away for a moment, when I looked back, the terminal was already destroyed.

introduced.name: Lechlade
introduced.how: Former doctor who lost his certification and believes the yellow-green stones are making him sick
introduced.quote: Lechlade: I am a doctor! I know! Wait, I'm no longer a doctor. I lost my certification, and I can't give official diagnoses...

introduced.name: Arderne
introduced.how: Certified doctor who gives Lechlade Pure Water as a health tonic
introduced.quote: Lechlade: Arderne is a really good doctor, and certified, too!

introduced.name: Pure Water
introduced.how: A drink that gives a vigor boost and is uncommon in the Fortress
introduced.quote: Paimon: Isn't this Pure Water? Are you sure?

introduced.name: Nelly
introduced.how: Amateur journalist and photographer who wants to capture guards at work with her Kamera
introduced.quote: Nelly: I'm here to complete the project assigned to me — to capture the most vivid moments of the Fortress of Meropide guards at work with my Kamera!

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: A camera used by Nelly to photograph guards
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? What's a Kamera doing here?

introduced.name: Grainville
introduced.how: Guard who enforces labor regulations and safety in the production zone
introduced.quote: Grainville: All relevant labor regulations and procedures must be followed in the production zone — that means safety first.

introduced.name: Production Zone
introduced.how: Work area where non-production items like books and card games are forbidden
introduced.quote: Rochelle Loudspeaker: Bringing items not related to production into the production zone is forbidden.

introduced.name: Decembre
introduced.how: Swindler who offers jobs at low pay and is exposed by Maupoil as cheating newcomers
introduced.quote: Maupoil: Decembre, you slippery little fraud, I've finally caught you!

introduced.name: Maupoil
introduced.how: Guard who explains that graffiti is prohibited in the Fortress and tracks down the culprit
introduced.quote: Maupoil: Well... See that mark on the wall? Graffiti is prohibited in the Fortress of Meropide...

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A fortress where residents live under rules and can leave but choose to stay
introduced.quote: Clynes: I can leave any time I want. I choose to stay of my own volition.

introduced.name: Monglane
introduced.how: Coupon Cafeteria official who runs a rushed satisfaction survey
introduced.quote: Monglane: Ahem, please wait a moment... Allow me to explain the rules. The survey has a total of five questions.

introduced.name: Mitul
introduced.how: Drink seller who traps a rival and sells fresh health drinks
introduced.quote: Mitul: By the way, I'd like to apologize for dragging you into this. I have some fresh health drinks — would you like a bottle?

introduced.name: Koblenz
introduced.how: Business rival of Mitul who trapped Mitul and then fled
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: He told me about trapping you here and asked for my help, but he left because a guard interrupted us.

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: Helper who opens passages in the closed mine area and warns about the drinks
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: No one comes here anymore after the Geode Mine Shaft was closed, and the devices here aren't meant for just anyone to handle.

introduced.name: Geode Mine Shaft
introduced.how: A closed mine shaft where the final version of the sealing device was deployed
introduced.quote: What you're seeing now isn't even its final form, which was actually deployed at the Geode Mine Shaft...

introduced.name: Cipher Letters
introduced.how: A technology developed by Butor that few can decode, marked as gear-like graffiti
introduced.quote: Clynes: The Cipher Letter is a technology developed by Mr. Butor, and few know how to decode it, even at the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Teilhard
introduced.how: Former colleague who died in the Central Laboratory blast and was known for entertaining himself
introduced.quote: Clynes: I think I get Teilhard now. He must be bored out of his mind, so he's always trying to find ways to entertain himself.

introduced.name: Central Laboratory explosion
introduced.how: The Central Laboratory blew up, killing Teilhard and contributing to Clynes's losses
introduced.quote: Butor passed away due to illness, the Central Laboratory blew up, and Teilhard perished in the blast.

introduced.name: Fontemer Aberrants
introduced.how: Hostile creatures that appear in the Geode Mine Shaft and must be driven off
introduced.quote: Maupoil: Anyway, some Fontemer Aberrants have been spotted in the Geode Mine Shaft...

introduced.name: Strange Broadcast
introduced.how: A loudspeaker voice that talks in riddles and hosts a bet
introduced.quote: Strange Broadcast: Your coming is destined, this round is on me.

assumed.name: Clynes
assumed.quote: What's that idiot Clynes doing anyway — isn't he supposed to come up with solutions?

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: I had no idea those Fontaine Research Institute guys could dish it out like that...

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: I'll treat you to some Fonta... Wait, that's not right.

assumed.name: Coupons
assumed.quote: Although, newcomers won't have any Coupons... In that case, you'll owe me two Fontas.

assumed.name: Pure Water
