assumed.quote: One time in the Pankration Ring, he slipped me a bottle of Pure Water before I got in the ring!

assumed.name: Julien
assumed.quote: Julien! The painter we met at Samudra Coast. Do you remember him?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Maybe from someone in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: She said that Natlan's nothing like Fontaine, and that she really wants to take a dip in a volcanic hot spring.

assumed.name: Seelie
assumed.quote: She's not a Seelie either. Maybe a small Oceanid?

assumed.name: Oceanid
assumed.quote: She's not a Seelie either. Maybe a small Oceanid?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Sounds just like some of the Adventurers' Guild's commissions.

assumed.name: Marvelous Bird Egg
assumed.quote: And as for the Marvelous Bird Egg...

assumed.name: Pepper
assumed.quote: But the painting he made for Pepper looked so real, even though the color was a bit off.

assumed.name: Estienne
assumed.quote: Estienne: Natural wind really feels better, doesn't it?

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon wonders what's happening with Caterpillar and Lanoire. Should we go back to check on them?

assumed.name: Galvana
assumed.quote: Galvana: You two again? Please... just behave if you want to get out soon.

assumed.name: Monglane
assumed.quote: Monglane: You better behave, if you don't want to be sent to the confinement room to reflect on what you did.

assumed.name: Rave
assumed.quote: Caterpillar: Indeed. Rave has some contacts, and the researcher and detective's assistant will have their own ways.

assumed.name: Clynes
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Geode Mine Shaft... That's right, Clynes said that there's an opening there that leads outside...

assumed.name: Pankration Ring
assumed.quote: Estienne: The fans in the Pankration Ring are just like Noailles.

assumed.name: Estienne's Coupon Millionaire Game
assumed.quote: Genevieve: Since you're taking part in this game as well, I think you'll understand my position.

assumed.name: Noailles
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wh—What's that guard doing here...?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: But Mora is useless here, so I'll pay with Coupons.

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: Mitul: If Fonta is here, how are we supposed to survive?

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Traveler: Yeah, it has more Mint than grows on all of Teyvat.

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Galvaryet: Why are you talking like Lanoire? Just get to the point.

assumed.name: Estienne
assumed.quote: Galvaryet: You didn't join Estienne's game, did you? You should know when to stop.

assumed.name: Roussimoff
assumed.quote: I won a lot of those from Roussimoff, and I haven't figured out how to spend them yet.

assumed.name: Wolsey
assumed.quote: Traveler: Not enough! Even Wolsey doesn't get to eat any!

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: If, one day, I should be fortunate enough to dine with Galvana at Hotel Debord...

assumed.name: Abyss Mage
assumed.quote: Even an Abyss Mage would be willing to respond positively.

assumed.name: Decembre's past dealings with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Decembre: Don't be so cold. I'll never forget what you did for me that other time.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's true age and nature are left unclear, as he says his appearance is an illness and he has been here a long time.
threads.quote: As for my present appearance... You can think of it as an illness of sorts.

threads.claim: Caterpillar may be able to instill certainty in people, hinting at a hidden power over minds.
threads.quote: That was an ability he already had.

threads.claim: Caterpillar admits he used small tricks to make Noailles accept a statement, confirming his influence over people.
threads.quote: Just a few small tricks.

threads.claim: Caterpillar admits to a past crime carried out under a master's orders, with some people suffering as a result.
threads.quote: I carried out a certain task under my master's orders. I failed, but some people suffered because of it nonetheless.

threads.claim: Caterpillar has no record in the Fortress archives for the last hundred years, suggesting his past has been erased.
threads.quote: I consulted the records from the last hundred years, and I couldn't find any record of a

threads.claim: Noailles repeats a cryptic line about a culprit being where he should be, hinting at a hidden guilty party.
threads.quote: The culprit is where he should be...

threads.claim: Lanoire says her mother left the Fortress and never returned, which conflicts with Caterpillar's account that Agnes died of illness.
threads.quote: Mother never came back after leaving the Fortress.

threads.claim: Lanoire has family outside the Fortress who may not know her situation, and she lacks any proof of identity to leave.
threads.quote: And fortunately, she does indeed have family outside the Fortress.

threads.claim: Lanoire fears an evil sorcerer, and the Traveler and Paimon are unsure whether it is a real threat or a guard.
threads.quote: Yes, with black clothes and a staff that has branches sticking out of it.

threads.claim: Paimon does not match any known people in the Fortress, and nobody knows what she is.
threads.quote: She's not a Seelie either. Maybe a small Oceanid? No wonder no one has seen anything like her, or knows anything about her!

threads.claim: Misuse of the Rochelle Loudspeaker is linked to complaints of nervous breakdowns, suggesting it may cause harm.
threads.quote: Apart from the unauthorized use, we've also received a number of complaints recently of nervous breakdowns caused by its repeated use...

threads.claim: Rave and Caterpillar share an unresolved past, and Rave calls Caterpillar a monster.
threads.quote: Caterpillar and I have some... unresolved history.

threads.claim: Noailles argues that too much freedom harms people, raising the theme of freedom versus order in the Fortress.
threads.quote: People who habitually indulge their every whim just can't see that too much freedom actually does them harm.

threads.claim: Residents of the Fortress live without real sunlight, and the outside world is hinted as the only place to get it.
threads.quote: Trying to get some sun might be tricky though, haha.

threads.claim: Rave hints at a route out of the Fortress that does not depend on the game.
threads.quote: If it was for the chance to get out, I have another route that I can show you...

threads.claim: Many former Fontaine Research Institute staff are present in the Fortress, suggesting a connection between the two.
threads.quote: I was just lamenting how many familiar faces from the Fontaine Research Institute are here.

threads.claim: Estienne decides who gets to go outside, giving him control over residents' escape chances.
threads.quote: I get to decide who gets these jobs.

threads.claim: Caterpillar plans to smuggle Lanoire out by using Estienne's outside work trips during the Coupon game.
threads.quote: Every so often, Estienne will bring a few people with him to do some work outside. We use this chance to get Lanoire back to her family.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's team wins the Coupon Millionaire game by using saved Coupons to hire workers.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: I used the Coupons I'd saved up in the past to hire a bunch of people to help me work.

threads.claim: Caterpillar is revealed to be a Hilichurl who has passed as human for centuries.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: I'm... I'm a monster in human skin.

threads.claim: Caterpillar was created by Narzissenkreuz and was once a blade-wielding member of the Ordo.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: I was one of his creations. And as a testament to Narzissenkreuz's power, I once wielded a blade for the Ordo.

threads.claim: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo followed a prophecy of apocalypse and attempted a magical plan to prevent it, which failed.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: The prophecy of the apocalypse... My master believed that he could stop this future of destruction from coming to pass.

threads.claim: A Fontaine Research Institute accident halted Arkhium mining at the Geode Mine Shaft.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: It's Arkhium. Arkhium mining operations stopped after the Fontaine Research Institute accident.

threads.claim: A dangerous untested Flying Energy Thief guards the Geode Mine Shaft exit.
threads.quote: The Geode Mine Shaft has been equipped with a Flying Energy Thief.

threads.claim: Missing records prevent prisoners from leaving the Fortress even after they have legally redeemed themselves.
threads.quote: Noailles: As you probably know, the missing records need to be recreated.

threads.claim: Caterpillar believes his sins can never be absolved and that he will remain his own prisoner.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: So, my sins can never be absolved, and I will forever be my own prisoner.

threads.claim: Giving up revenge is presented as a kind of freedom, and the play debates whether revenge brings happiness.
threads.quote: Traveler: Giving up on revenge counts as a kind of freedom...

threads.claim: A strange, obsessive letter from White Lily to Monsieur Neuvillette is sent through the Fortress mail, raising questions.
threads.quote: Traveler: (None of this information adds up.)

threads.claim: Lechlade blames the yellow-green stones for destroying the Central Laboratory and making people sick, a claim left unresolved.
threads.quote: Lechlade: The yellow-green stones destroyed everything!

threads.claim: The Central Laboratory blew up and killed Teilhard, but the cause is left open.
threads.quote: Butor passed away due to illness, the Central Laboratory blew up, and Teilhard perished in the blast.

threads.claim: Galvana's presence seems to destroy machines, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: I found out from her sister later that no machines can survive under her for more than half a day.

threads.claim: Clynes hints that the Geode Mine Shaft has exits, which the Traveler notices.
threads.quote: Traveler: So, there are exits in the Geode Mine Shaft.

threads.claim: The sealing device used on the rift is a modified version of a design that was deployed at the Geode Mine Shaft in a more complete form.
threads.quote: What you're seeing now isn't even its final form, which was actually deployed at the Geode Mine Shaft...

threads.claim: A readable note says the road to freedom has been blocked for a minority, raising a question about the Fortress's rules.
threads.quote: To free a minority from their supervisory duties, the road to freedom has been blocked.

threads.claim: The occupant of the sealed room claims a darkness is hidden on the other side of the door, and why is unexplained.
threads.quote: You don't know what kind of darkness is hiding on the other side...

threads.claim: Clynes has lost his friends to accidents and illness and is content to stay in the Fortress.
threads.quote: Bad news: It's not a problem because all my friends are gone.

threads.claim: Cipher Letters are a Butor technology that few can decode, and the Fontaine Research Institute's secrecy around them is hinted at.
threads.quote: Clynes: The Cipher Letter is a technology developed by Mr. Butor, and few know how to decode it, even at the Fontaine Research Institute.

threads.claim: Decembre claims to have lost his memory of a past event involving the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: My memory, it's acting up again! What happened then, I wonder? I can't remember a thing!

threads.claim: A strange voice on the loudspeakers speaks of a destined coming, hinting at someone who knows the Traveler's arrival.
threads.quote: Strange Broadcast: Your coming is destined, this round is on me.

threads.claim: Residents can leave the Fortress at any time, yet some choose to stay, raising the theme of freedom and confinement.
threads.quote: Clynes: I can leave any time I want. I choose to stay of my own volition.

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: an island south of Narukami Island, partly ruled by constant wild storms
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Yes. It is an island to the south of Narukami Island, with some parts of the island being subject to constant wild storms

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Inazuma's guild that sends adventurers on commissions such as exploring Seirai Island
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Speaking of which, the Guild is currently looking for adventurers to explore Seirai Island. Would you be interested?

introduced.name: Etsuko
introduced.how: an adventurer with the Guild investigating the storms on Seirai Island
introduced.quote: Etsuko: Ah! Hello there. You're... an adventurer? Hmm. Am I right to say that you're here to investigate this island?

introduced.name: Taisuke
introduced.how: an Inazuma Adventurers' Guild adventurer who studies the Warding Stones and believes the storm is the Archon's doing
introduced.quote: Taisuke: Oh... Oh! Pleased to meet you, yes, nice to meet you indeed! My name is Taisuke, and I'm an adventurer with Inazuma's Adventurers' Guild...

introduced.name: Warding Stones
introduced.how: stone ritual implements that seal things and have been left broken across the island
introduced.quote: Etsuko: And according to the legends, these stone structures really are ritual implements that can be used to seal certain things.

introduced.name: Neko
introduced.how: a talking cat who calls herself the provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine
introduced.quote: ???: This is the Asase Shrine, and I am Neko, the provisional head priestess.

introduced.name: Asase Shrine
introduced.how: a shrine on Seirai Island whose upkeep depends on its Offering Box and incense
introduced.quote: Neko: For instance, the shrine suffers from a dearth of incense. Were Hibiki to see it in such a sorry state, she would surely be grieved.

introduced.name: Offering Box
introduced.how: a shrine box where people deposit Mora, so its repair brings visitors back
introduced.quote: Neko: Mora is stuffed into the Offering Box. When it was yet whole, many people would come and stuff Mora into it, thus making the shrine most busy indeed.

introduced.name: Commission
introduced.how: a job the Guild assigns to adventurers, treated as professional work
introduced.quote: Etsuko: Taisuke, I believe I've said this before. We're professionals. Taking commissions is work.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: treasure seekers who came to Seirai Island hoping to find riches in its empty villages
introduced.quote: Treasure Hoarder: We heard from some people that there was treasure to be had here on Seirai Island, and that the island itself wasn't all that populated...

introduced.name: Warding Stone sealing method
introduced.how: sealing requires matching the paper charms on the sticks with the paper on the rock, using ropes
introduced.quote: Neko: Hibiki said that the key is to use the ropes on the rock, and the piece of paper...

introduced.name: Peculiar Pinion
introduced.how: a strange feather found atop the sky platform, unlike any known bird's
introduced.quote: Paimon: This is a... feather? How strange.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Etsuko: Work. Mora. That's it, really.

assumed.name: Hibiki
assumed.quote: Neko: Hibiki unsealed those rocks a good, long time ago. It has much to do with those...

assumed.name: Ako Domeki
assumed.quote: Neko: Hibiki would be most gratified to see this shrine become lively again. Hmm, well, and that Domeki fellow, too... Meow...

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: Etsuko: That fellow Taisuke keeps insisting that the storm must have been the work of the Archon, meant to block ordinary people from violating a sacred site.

assumed.name: Electro
assumed.quote: Paimon: Purple, tingly things... Do you mean Electro?

assumed.name: Dvalin
assumed.quote: Paimon: But well, Dvalin does talk...

assumed.name: Changsheng
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh! You mean that snake named Changsheng?

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Yes. It is an island to the south of Narukami Island, with some parts of the island being subject to constant wild storms

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Taisuke: Oh... Oh! Pleased to meet you, yes, nice to meet you indeed! My name is Taisuke, and I'm an adventurer with Inazuma's Adventurers' Guild...

threads.claim: The cause of the storms around Seirai Island is still undetermined and may be a boundary drawn over a sacred site.
threads.quote: Katheryne: After all, we have yet to determine the cause of those storms.

threads.claim: Sealing all four Warding Stones ends the storm over Seirai Island.
threads.quote: Etsuko: The storm... has passed.

threads.claim: Someone unsealed the Warding Stones in the past and is responsible for the storm, with the motive unknown.
threads.quote: Etsuko: That means that someone must've unsealed the stones in general at some point in the past.

threads.claim: The Warding Stones are ancient ritual seals whose purpose and origin are still unclear to the characters.
threads.quote: Etsuko: And according to the legends, these stone structures really are ritual implements that can be used to seal certain things.

threads.claim: The Warding Stones were meant to seal a bird of enormous size, whose identity is not yet known.
threads.quote: Neko: This island plays host to four such stones. Hibiki once said that there were meant to seal a bird of most prodigious size.

threads.claim: The Peculiar Pinion suggests the sealed bird was as large as the sky platform.
threads.quote: Taisuke: And if you study its dimensions and the ratios involved, this bird would have been as large as that stone platform up there in the sky.

threads.claim: Sealing the Warding Stones made floating rocks in the sky form a platform that the Traveler can explore.
threads.quote: Taisuke: Rocks floating in the sky... formed a platform...

threads.claim: Hibiki, Domeki, and others vanished after a huge storm and have not returned to the shrine.
threads.quote: Neko: Indeed, after that huge, huge storm, Hibiki, Domeki, and the others never returned, either.

threads.claim: Electro is running amok on Seirai Island and may be tied to the mysterious stone structures.
threads.quote: Neko: ...Those purple, tingling, hair-raising, ill-meaning things.

introduced.name: Titu
introduced.how: tribal storyteller who introduces himself and guards the Shadow Pins
introduced.quote: Anyway, introductions are in order. Titu... That's my name.

introduced.name: Children of Echoes
introduced.how: Titu's tribe, who live among Tepetlisaurs and mine solid phlogiston
introduced.quote: But I'm one of the Children of Echoes, and we're always around Tepetlisaurs.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: Saurians can communicate with humans, though most people think it impossible
introduced.quote: Understand Saurian-speak? Haha, you've got to be kidding me. No one can do that!

introduced.name: Shadow Pin
introduced.how: giant stone pillars that seal the Abyss beneath the earth
introduced.quote: We call it a Shadow Pin... and we've had problems with it recently.

introduced.name: Lesser Shadow Pin
introduced.how: three smaller pins in the valley, far smaller than the Greater Shadow Pin
introduced.quote: Three small and one large, actually, and this is the big one.

introduced.name: Greater Shadow Pin
introduced.how: the large central pin that fell and tore a hole in the ground
introduced.quote: That's where the Greater Shadow Pin fell, it seems.

introduced.name: Wayob
introduced.how: legendary beings said to have hung the Pins to seal the Volcano Lord's shadow
introduced.quote: The stories say that the Wayob hung the Pins here to seal the shadow of the Volcano Lord...

introduced.name: Volcano Lord
introduced.how: a legendary figure whose shadow the Pins were said to pin in place
introduced.quote: The stories say that the Wayob hung the Pins here to seal the shadow of the Volcano Lord...

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: the evil force actually sealed beneath the Shadow Pins
introduced.quote: But that which is sealed beneath them is, in truth, the Abyss.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: the land where these events take place, where exchanging names means friendship
introduced.quote: Here in Natlan, those who exchange names but not blows are considered friends

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: a group whose area has hot springs and relaxing music, which Titu suggests as a safer place
introduced.quote: Why don't you head over to the People of the Springs instead?

introduced.name: Iridescent Inscription
introduced.how: golden engravings that once carried ancient dragons' phlogiston power and seal the Abyss when restored
introduced.quote: the language by which they wielded phlogiston was these Iridescent Inscriptions.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a substance that condenses into solid phlogiston used for pins and seals
introduced.quote: The condensed solid phlogiston lies scattered...

introduced.name: Dragon
introduced.how: ancient dragons who once ruled Natlan and used Iridescent Inscriptions
introduced.quote: when this land was ruled by the ancient dragons

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: the origin of soldiers who caused the catastrophe in the legend
introduced.quote: And up on land, a dark tide of disaster blazed toward the mountain range, brought on by two Khaenri'han soldiers

introduced.name: Khaenri'ahn catastrophe
introduced.how: a disaster that devastated Natlan and let the Abyss spread
introduced.quote: Everything changed... when the Khaenri'ahn catastrophe struck.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: Natlan's Ley Lines are special and delicate, and were damaged in the disaster
introduced.quote: Natlan's Ley Lines were always special and somewhat delicate

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm that was severely damaged in the disaster, its totem poles dimmed
introduced.quote: They say that the Night Kingdom was severely damaged in that disaster, and the totem poles' lights grew dim.

introduced.name: Traore
introduced.how: elder of the Children of Echoes who fought the Abyss and sacrificed himself to seal it
introduced.quote: Elder Traore had no choice but to contend with the Abyss

introduced.name: Zephaniah
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ahn soldier who guided the black flood to the seal and is now sealed in a statue
introduced.quote: Let us have one more drink, Zephaniah and Irizar, you who guided the black flood here, to the place of the seal...

introduced.name: Irizar
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ahn soldier who guided the black flood to the seal alongside Zephaniah
introduced.quote: Let us have one more drink, Zephaniah and Irizar, you who guided the black flood here, to the place of the seal...

introduced.name: Sanhaj
introduced.how: a revered storyteller of the Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.quote: Sanhaj of the Masters of the Night-Wind is worthy of reverence indeed

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: a group of tribal storytellers that Sanhaj belongs to
introduced.quote: Sanhaj of the Masters of the Night-Wind is worthy of reverence indeed

introduced.name: Nightsoul Warriors
introduced.how: fabled warriors who got tangled up with the Abyss
introduced.quote: Those are the fabled Nightsoul Warriors who got tangled up with the Abyss

introduced.name: Boundary Marker Inscription
introduced.how: a stone tablet left by Traore with a warning and the story of his deeds
introduced.quote: {{Readable|title=Boundary Marker Inscription

introduced.name: Abyss sealing by Traore
introduced.how: the tribe's warriors sacrificed themselves to seal the Abyss beneath the earth
introduced.quote: The brave warriors followed him in, and after much sacrifice, the Abyss was, at last, sealed beneath the earth.

assumed.name: Yukom
assumed.quote: We met a sentry on our way here named Yukom, who wanted you to get back to your post!

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: So, Liyue has those mysterious adeptal mechanisms, yes?

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: more robust even than the roots of the great mother-tree that grows beneath the Scions of the Canopy's mountain cliffs

assumed.name: Sweet Madame
assumed.quote: Look ye, how she swallows a Sweet Madame the size of a Sumpter Beast in a single bite!

assumed.name: Sumpter Beast
assumed.quote: Look ye, how she swallows a Sweet Madame the size of a Sumpter Beast in a single bite!

assumed.name: Rifthound
assumed.quote: Whoa, why are there so many Rifthounds!?

threads.claim: The Abyss is sealed beneath the Shadow Pins and may surge up if the pins float upward.
threads.quote: But that which is sealed beneath them is, in truth, the Abyss.

threads.claim: The official legend about the Volcano Lord's shadow is only an embellished metaphor, leaving its truth in doubt.
threads.quote: That's how most tales in Natlan are. They're embellished narratives held up as warnings, and all their rhetoric is a kind of metaphor.

threads.claim: The name Shadow Pin is a pun: the stone pins shadows, not a literal Volcano Lord's shadow.
threads.quote: It's called a Shadow Pin... because it pins shadows. Easy, right?

threads.claim: The Khaenri'ahn catastrophe unleashed the Abyss and devastated Natlan's Ley Lines and Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Everything changed... when the Khaenri'ahn catastrophe struck.

threads.claim: Two Khaenri'ahn soldiers, Zephaniah and Irizar, are cast as villains in tribal tales but may have been heroes.
threads.quote: Forever and always shall you be heroes who fought alongside our tribe, the brother-kin of the Children of Echoes.

threads.claim: Zephaniah and Irizar are revealed as Khaenri'ahn heroes who sealed the Abyss and were not villains.
threads.quote: As for those two Khaenri'ahn soldiers— no, Khaenri'ahn heroes!

threads.claim: Voices from below call out for help, hinting that the sealed fallen soldiers are still suffering.
threads.quote: Calamity— Pain— Save—

threads.claim: The sealed heroes are still locked in battle, keeping the Abyss from flooding out.
threads.quote: Those heroes are still locked in battle to this day, preventing the Abyss from flooding out from the Iridescent Inscription.

threads.claim: The tormented voices fall silent once the Iridescent Inscription is restored.
threads.quote: The tormented voices have also fallen silent.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom was damaged by the disaster and its totem poles dimmed, so the Wayob could not hear the tribes.
threads.quote: They say that the Night Kingdom was severely damaged in that disaster, and the totem poles' lights grew dim.

threads.claim: A beast of the Night Kingdom thanks the Traveler for soothing the souls and sends the outlanders back.
threads.quote: Come... over here...

threads.claim: The meaning of the Iridescent Inscriptions is lost, though their phlogiston power can still be used.
threads.quote: These days, none understand the meaning hidden in these lights.

threads.claim: Some Saurians can sense Inscriptions and perhaps understand humans, a claim that is doubted.
threads.quote: Understand Saurian-speak? Haha, you've got to be kidding me. No one can do that!

threads.claim: Tepetlisaurus companion seems able to sense Inscription power, confirming a rumored Saurian ability.
threads.quote: Oh wow! I've heard that even now, there are still Saurians who can sense an Inscription's power

threads.claim: Sanhaj of the Masters of the Night-Wind is a legendary storyteller whose tales are yet to be told.
threads.quote: I'll tell you more about Sanhaj when we've got more time!

threads.claim: Traore left a tablet with warnings and a blessing, and its meaning is unclear to the player.
threads.quote: Traore left this here.

threads.claim: Traore's final wishes are fulfilled when the Abyss is sealed and the tribe's heroes are honored.
threads.quote: Traore's final wishes have been fulfilled

threads.claim: Restoring the Iridescent Inscription purifies the Abyss, so it is no longer a threat.
threads.quote: I never expected that the Abyss here could truly be purified.

threads.claim: The Traveler seems unaffected by the Abyss, hinting at a special strength.
threads.quote: You weren't affected by the Abyss, were you, ?

threads.claim: Stories pass on and change, and the tale of the Shadow Pins has been reshaped through telling.
threads.quote: Stories pass on and stories change.

threads.claim: The Abyss within the Ley Lines seems to be growing stronger, causing the Pins to tremble.
threads.quote: Could it be that... some change has overtaken the Abyss surging within the Ley Lines

introduced.name: Vesna
introduced.how: Druzhna commander who created the flying sword spirits through her own spiritual power
introduced.quote: Hold on! This isn't what it looks like. I may have created the little troublemaker, but getting it to listen to me is another matter entirely.

introduced.name: Druzhna
introduced.how: an elite military force under the sovereign's command, separate from petty thefts
introduced.quote: Because that isn't what the Druzhna is for. We're an elite force under Her Majesty's command.

introduced.name: Sword Spirit
introduced.how: spirits created by Vesna's spiritual power that can escape and steal items
introduced.quote: Then, before I knew it, every last sword spirit had flown the coop.

introduced.name: Sword Immortals
introduced.how: ancient cultivators who could command flying swords, nurture sword spirits, and vanquish evil beings
introduced.quote: Some could even command flying swords, nurture sword spirits, and vanquish monsters and evil beings.

introduced.name: Ancient Sword Esoterica
introduced.how: an ancient manual of sword cultivation that Vesna bought, now split in half
introduced.quote: One of them even made off with the second half of my copy of the Ancient Sword Esoterica!

introduced.name: Divine Sense Compass
introduced.how: a compass Vesna modified that tracks sword spirits using elemental energy
introduced.quote: Oh, the principle is very simple. First, I use elemental energy to sense the sword spirit's approximate location...

introduced.name: Master of Potions
introduced.how: a sword spirit obsessed with immortal elixirs
introduced.quote: I have mastered the supreme art of potioncraft!

introduced.name: Master of Body
introduced.how: a sword spirit who walks the path of bodily tempering and soul-cleansing elixirs
introduced.quote: That is why I walk the path of the Master of Body!

introduced.name: Master of Sigils
introduced.how: a sword spirit that channels power through sigils and paintings
introduced.quote: a being that channels its power through sigils and paintings.

introduced.name: Master of Artifacts
introduced.how: a sword spirit that pursues cultivation through mechanical bodies and technology
introduced.quote: The Master of Artifacts, at your service!

introduced.name: Master of Sound
introduced.how: a quiet sword spirit that hid in the theater and watched performances
introduced.quote: Except that one was a thief. This one has behaved impeccably during its time here.

introduced.name: Greater Sword Spirit
introduced.how: a powerful sword spirit leader of a group of disciples who wants to guide fae
introduced.quote: My cultivation has finally borne fruit!

introduced.name: Master of Arms
introduced.how: a cultivation path that rallies followers and heroes to fight together
introduced.quote: Of all the paths of cultivation, the Master of Arms embodies that the most!

introduced.name: Danica
introduced.how: a stern Druzhna officer who oversees Vesna and reprimands her
introduced.quote: Excellent. Then bring this farce to an end immediately, and do not create any more work for me.

introduced.name: Vila
introduced.how: a fae people who forge magical weapons by merging elemental energy with their consciousness
introduced.quote: The Vila forge their magical weapons by merging elemental energy with their own consciousness.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: the publisher that printed the ancient book and sold off stock to the bookseller
introduced.quote: Apparently, Yae Publishing House was clearing out some of its stock, so the book seller bought up a whole bunch at once.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: a theater performer who reports a shadow watching her during rehearsals
introduced.quote: Have you heard the rumors about that strange shadow people keep seeing around the theater?

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a theater figure who is calm and skeptical of ghost stories
introduced.quote: Perhaps no one was there to begin with.

assumed.name: Liyue adepti
assumed.quote: We know quite a few of Liyue's adepti...

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Xiao wouldn't have the time, and the dates rule out Zibai.

assumed.name: Zibai
assumed.quote: Xiao wouldn't have the time, and the dates rule out Zibai.

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: Consider yourself lucky you faced me instead of that cat creature — or, um, girl that works under Arlecchino.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: that sounds a bit mystical for Snezhnaya...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: If that thing had reached the city, we'd have had a Fatui machine rampaging through the streets in broad daylight.

assumed.name: Ruler of Life
assumed.quote: The Ruler of Life's power has an effect on my creations, imbuing each of them with a certain degree of...

assumed.name: Mr. Nine
assumed.quote: (A cutaway starts, showing Mr. Nine and Nicole in conversation)

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: (A cutaway starts, showing Mr. Nine and Nicole in conversation)

assumed.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd
assumed.quote: Furthermore, the project bears a certain resemblance to Legend of the Shattered Halberd, and revisions to Flowers for Princess Fischl are still outstanding...

assumed.name: Flowers for Princess Fischl
assumed.quote: Furthermore, the project bears a certain resemblance to Legend of the Shattered Halberd, and revisions to Flowers for Princess Fischl are still outstanding...

assumed.name: Fae
assumed.quote: (All we ever wanted was a future where fae wouldn't have to waylay travelers just to survive... Is our dream truly going to end here...?)

assumed.name: Cryo Boom Blossom
assumed.quote: (Approach the area with bubbles and Cryo Boom Blossoms)

threads.claim: The identity of the author of the ancient manual is an open question that the characters set out to solve.
threads.quote: Naturally, I didn't ask about its origins right away.

threads.claim: The book's trail leads to Yae Publishing House and a missing note from its author, which remains unread.
threads.quote: I vaguely remember the author leaving a note somewhere in the second half of the book.

threads.claim: The manual is revealed to be a fiction draft by an author in dispute with a collaborator, shelved at Yae Publishing House.
threads.quote: Fortunately, the draft of this work of fiction has circulated only within Yae Publishing House and has not yet entered print.

threads.claim: A cutaway shows the author and collaborator disagreeing over how the Ancient Sword Esoterica should proceed.
threads.quote: To skip ahead somewhat, the author and collaborator have reached a serious disagreement over how the Ancient Sword Esoterica should proceed.

threads.claim: Recent anomalies are straining the Druzhna's forces, hinting at a larger crisis.
threads.quote: The recent anomalies have already stretched our forces to their limit.

threads.claim: Vesna claims a cultivated divine sense, which may or may not be real.
threads.quote: Nope. I tried the book's method several times, but it just didn't work.

threads.claim: Vesna's sense of the sword spirits comes from her own power, not the book's technique.
threads.quote: My own power turned out to be much better at sensing the sword spirits.

threads.claim: Unchecked desire is hinted to lead sword spirits and their creator toward reckless, uncontrollable outcomes.
threads.quote: Desire, when left unchecked, has a way of growing beyond one's control.

threads.claim: An unseen watcher observed the theater, and the sword spirit responsible is still a mystery.
threads.quote: Lately, whenever I rehearse onstage, I can feel someone watching from the corner of the room...

threads.claim: Vesna is described as young for a fae and once had a lofty wish that she has since changed.
threads.quote: She is still relatively young for a fae, after all.

threads.claim: Vesna's grander wish matured as she learned that firm laws and clear rules are needed to sustain a nation.
threads.quote: In time, she came to understand that a nation cannot endure without firm laws, nor an army without clear rewards and punishments.

threads.claim: Each of Vesna's sword spirits embodies a wish she carries within herself.
threads.quote: In that sense, each of Vesna's sword spirits embodies a wish she carries within herself.

threads.claim: Danica's teaching frames deep wishes as things to hold within the heart rather than display.
threads.quote: The deepest wishes are not meant to be laid bare, but engraved upon the heart.

threads.claim: A soul is made of many wishes, and understanding them is what makes each soul unique.
threads.quote: A single wish is only one facet of a soul — it can never represent the whole.

introduced.name: Chikya
introduced.how: A treasure-hunting Saurian woman who has a bad back and says she was once a rider of Iktomisaurs
introduced.quote: So have my real name instead: Chikya.

introduced.name: Iktomisaur
introduced.how: A creature that can float and make itself weightless, used as a mount
introduced.quote: Iktomisaurs can float up and make themselves as light as a feather

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: Chikya's tribe, known for keeping woven scrolls that record their past
introduced.quote: if we Masters of the Night-Wind have anything aplenty, it's woven artifacts recording stories of our past

introduced.name: Saurians
introduced.how: A people distinct from humans, with different eyesight and body traits
introduced.quote: Saurians are generally further-sighted than humans are

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: The power Natlanders use, originally only dragons could wield it
introduced.quote: In those days, only the dragons could use phlogiston.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Engraving
introduced.how: Patterned carvings that form a language controlling phlogiston, readable by those trained in them
introduced.quote: The results of that are Phlogiston Engravings, like the one you see before you right now.

introduced.name: Phlogiston Engraving language
introduced.how: Phlogiston Engravings are also a written language whose patterns carry meaning
introduced.quote: As I said before, Phlogiston Engraving is also a language.

introduced.name: Waxaklahun Ubah Kan
introduced.how: The Sage of the Stolen Flame who stole the flaming phlogiston seed from a great volcano
introduced.quote: But the Sage of the Stolen Flame, Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, risked life and limb to steal the flaming seed of it from the great volcano.

introduced.name: Upper Sanctum
introduced.how: Floating islands above the lake, inaccessible to humans and Saurians, said to be a utopia made by the first phlogiston user
introduced.quote: We call those the Upper Sanctum, due to their inaccessibility by either humans or Saurians.

introduced.name: Spiritway
introduced.how: A pathway that carries travelers through phlogiston to a destination, such as the Upper Sanctum
introduced.quote: Activating this door will grant you access to the Spiritway that leads to the Upper Sanctum

introduced.name: Spiritdoor
introduced.how: A special door that serves as a trial, with an engraving that requires finding Unveiling Scripts
introduced.quote: And this special Spiritdoor is a sort of trial.

introduced.name: Unveiling Script
introduced.how: A script that unlocks a Phlogiston Engraving when integrated into it
introduced.quote: There should be an Unveiling Script somewhere around here with which we can unlock this Phlogiston Engraving.

introduced.name: Iridescent Inscription
introduced.how: Markings described as an even more ancient language than Phlogiston Engravings
introduced.quote: In theory, these things constitute an even more ancient language than the Phlogiston Engravings

introduced.name: Phlogiston Chiselith
introduced.how: Mechanisms across Natlan that were based on the ones in the Upper Sanctum
introduced.quote: Apparently, the Phlogiston Chiseliths all over Natlan were based on the mechanisms here

introduced.name: Grainfruit
introduced.how: A food that is popular among Saurians and healthy for them
introduced.quote: Now, don't you go looking down on the Grainfruit, it's a real hit amongst Saurians, and it's healthy for them, too.

introduced.name: Gusto
introduced.how: A power that the adepti of Liyue use, which the Traveler claims to have
introduced.quote: This power doth the adepti of Liyue name

introduced.name: Sage of the Stolen Flame
introduced.how: The sage who stole the flaming phlogiston seed from the giant dragon and built the Upper Sanctum, called a madman by some
introduced.quote: He stole the flaming phlogiston seed from the giant dragon and created the Upper Sanctum using that power, before teaching it to everyone in the tribes.

introduced.name: Pyro Dragon rule of Natlan
introduced.how: A past era when a Pyro Dragon ruled Natlan and kept humanity in primitive tribes
introduced.quote: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon

introduced.name: Ancestors swimming in lava
introduced.how: Scrolls record ancestors swimming in lava, interpreted as a warning to those who failed the trial
introduced.quote: I did spot an account of our ancestors swimming in lava.

introduced.name: Sage's gift legend
introduced.how: Legend says the Sage gives a gift to those who pass the trial
introduced.quote: Legend has it that it is a gift given by the Sage to those who pass the trial.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: And isn't that the million Mora question?

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Wait, you've been adventuring in Natlan, but you've never heard of Phlogiston Engravings?

assumed.name: Pyro Archon
assumed.quote: If you ask me, the Pyro Archon should be placing this stuff everywhere!

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: in connection with the Abyss

assumed.name: People of the Springs
assumed.quote: Paimon's not exactly surprised, given the People of the Springs aren't far off

assumed.name: Teleport Waypoint
assumed.quote: (Move past the Teleport Waypoint)

threads.claim: The Sage of the Stolen Flame is a controversial figure whom some call a madman, leaving his nature open.
threads.quote: Some also call him a madman or a lunatic, but I'd call those compliments as well.

threads.claim: The Sage is said to leave a gift for those who pass the trial, whose nature is unknown.
threads.quote: Legend has it that it is a gift given by the Sage to those who pass the trial.

threads.claim: The Sage's gift turns out to be a hot spring that grants phlogiston power to chosen heroes.
threads.quote: Once a hero who has been chosen bathes in this spring, they'll be granted the power to wield phlogiston.

threads.claim: Chikya claims to be hunting an elixir that cures all injuries, found in a secret scroll.
threads.quote: Either way, I'm on the hunt for an

threads.claim: Chikya admits she knowingly misled the group about the elixir to lure them along.
threads.quote: Yes, I tricked you this time, little Paimon.

threads.claim: The Traveler sees a golden pattern that Paimon cannot see, suggesting a sign left by a hidden presence.
threads.quote: I saw a golden pattern...

threads.claim: Chikya cannot use phlogiston, possibly because of an injury she suffered as a child.
threads.quote: It may well be due to this injury that I am unable to use phlogiston.

threads.claim: The Traveler can use phlogiston despite being an outlander, which Chikya finds unexpected and unexplained.
threads.quote: Wait. You can use phlogiston? But you're an outlander, aren't you?

threads.claim: The Upper Sanctum islands float in the sky and are held up by phlogiston, which is not fully understood.
threads.quote: You've seen the islands floating in the sky, haven't you?

threads.claim: A hidden central island at the heart of the Upper Sanctum is revealed after the trial.
threads.quote: Your eyes do not deceive you, Paimon.

threads.claim: Some tribespeople doubt a human could build the floating islands and believe the Sage was a dragon.
threads.quote: They have the nerve to doubt that a mere human could create such floating islands through the power of phlogiston

threads.claim: The Iridescent Inscriptions are unexplained markings that vanish when touched and may be mechanisms.
threads.quote: Could it be that these Iridescent Inscriptions are some kind of mechanism?

threads.claim: Ancient scrolls describe ancestors swimming in lava, which may be a warning to those who failed the trial.
threads.quote: I did spot an account of our ancestors swimming in lava.

threads.claim: Chikya hints the Pyro Archon has a connection to phlogiston things like the Spiritways, left unexplained.
threads.quote: If you ask me, the Pyro Archon should be placing this stuff everywhere!

threads.claim: Natlan was once ruled by a Pyro Dragon that kept humanity in primitive tribes.
threads.quote: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon

threads.claim: The Spiritdoor is a trial that requires finding Unveiling Scripts to open the path to the Upper Sanctum.
threads.quote: And this special Spiritdoor is a sort of trial.

threads.claim: The trial turns out to involve chasing the Iridescent Inscriptions and a battle before the final gift.
threads.quote: Looks like this is the final trial. Go go go!

threads.claim: Chikya secretly left her tribe without telling anyone, hinting at a conflict with her family.
threads.quote: I left without telling my friends and family in the tribe

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: an island that is a smelting plant for Jade Steel
introduced.quote: That island is called Tatarasuna. It's a smelting plant for Jade Steel, which is used to forge weaponry.

introduced.name: Mikage Furnace
introduced.how: a machine built by Fontaine experts that harvests Tatarigami power for production
introduced.quote: They built the Mikage Furnace, a machine that can fully harvest the powers of the Tatarigami.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: a power source that can be drawn on as an apparently unlimited energy source
introduced.quote: It can be used as an unlimited energy source.

introduced.name: Jade Steel
introduced.how: a metal smelted on Tatarasuna that makes Inazuman swords sharp and durable
introduced.quote: The Jade Steel manufactured here is the reason that Inazuman swords are as sharp and durable as they are.

introduced.name: Tenryou Commission
introduced.how: the body that commissioned the furnace to forge powerful weapons
introduced.quote: After all, the Tenryou Commission feels that having the ability to forge powerful weapons is something they should flaunt.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the homeland of the consultants who built the Mikage Furnace
introduced.quote: they hired a team of consultants from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: a Fontaine engineer and consultant who stayed behind on the island
introduced.quote: Xavier: That's right! Xavier's the name and the name's mine!

introduced.name: Hanbei
introduced.how: the manager in charge of the furnace, known for insisting on procedures
introduced.quote: A... manager, you could say. Always going on about procedures, articles, and applications...

introduced.name: Miyuki
introduced.how: a shrine maiden sent by Lady Miko to exorcise the Tatarigami's influence
introduced.quote: That's the only reason Lady Miko sent me out here. To exorcise it.

introduced.name: Toranosuke
introduced.how: a soldier who guards Tatarasuna and its smithing operations
introduced.quote: Toranosuke: Mind your own business! Tatarasuna's safety and the smithing operations are our business.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: the government whose forces held the island's military positions
introduced.quote: The Shogunate had a few of them installed on this island for military purposes, since this is where the front line was.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya
introduced.how: the side fighting the Shogunate on the island and holding the upper hand
introduced.quote: Suffice it to say that as far as the fight on this island went, Sangonomiya had the upper hand.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a sly group from Snezhnaya that has sneaked into the dome and furnace
introduced.quote: Rifts... Wait a moment, F—Fatui? What are those sly Snezhnayans doing all the way out here?

introduced.name: Mikage Furnace Emergency Containment Dome
introduced.how: the barrier Xavier activated around the furnace, officially named this
introduced.quote: Ah, one other thing I should mention is that, technically speaking, its official name is the Mikage Furnace Emergency Containment Dome.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: an elemental power whose bearers are needed to investigate safely in the furnace area
introduced.quote: Back in my beautiful homeland of Fontaine, we would normally have a Vision-wielding expert diagnose the problem.

introduced.name: Kamuijima Cannon
introduced.how: a large Electro-powered gun installed on the island that is now left unused
introduced.quote: Xavier: Do you know of the Kamuijima Cannon? It's a big gun built using the latest technology, powered by Electro.

introduced.name: Crystal Marrow
introduced.how: a crystalline ore holding inert Tatarigami energy, used to strengthen Jade Steel
introduced.quote: Crystal Marrow, which contains an inert form of Tatarigami energy, is an ideal candidate for this task.

introduced.name: Onikabuto
introduced.how: a creature found in Electro-rich places that can survive near the furnace
introduced.quote: Hmm... normally, they are found in Electro-rich environments...

introduced.name: Sensor Beacons
introduced.how: instruments that gather data on Tatarigami energy density and distribution
introduced.quote: What these Sensor Beacons will do is gather data on the density and distribution of Tatarigami energy within the Mikage Furnace.

introduced.name: Emergency purifier
introduced.how: a device Xavier had purpose-built to deal with the Tatarigami energy
introduced.quote: The emergency purifier is a device that I have had purpose-built for that task.

introduced.name: Film Kamera
introduced.how: a Kamera Xavier improved to project a sequence of photos as moving images
introduced.quote: I made some improvements to the Kamera and turned it into a Film Kamera that is also capable of continuously projecting a string of photos, thus creating moving images.

introduced.name: Petrichor
introduced.how: Xavier's beautiful hometown in Fontaine
introduced.quote: Tatarasuna might just turn into a glorious firework visible all the way from my dear home, the beautiful town of Petrichor...

introduced.name: Yashiori Island
introduced.how: where the Tatarigami core powering the furnace was brought from
introduced.quote: Basically, it's a super-smelter built using Fontaine technology, powered by a Tatarigami core brought over from Yashiori Island.

introduced.name: Furnace malfunction during battle
introduced.how: the furnace went wrong during a previous battle, making the corrupt energy unstable and halting work
introduced.quote: But during one of the previous battles, something went wrong with the furnace.

introduced.name: Rifts in the containment dome
introduced.how: huge rifts that have opened in the dome and are linked to the Fatui
introduced.quote: Th—This rift is huge! What on earth is going on?

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: a logistics and data specialist who is new to dangerous areas and usually operates machines remotely
introduced.quote: Usually, my realm is logistics and data...

introduced.name: Purification device
introduced.how: a device that constantly purifies Tatarigami energy in a small area around it when working normally
introduced.quote: If this device works normally, it should be able to constantly purify the Tatarigami energy in a small area around it.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: a harmful energy that infests the disaster zone around the Mikage Furnace
introduced.quote: This place is infested with Tatarigami and crawling with Fatui.

introduced.name: Mikage Furnace
introduced.how: a furnace whose core-storing section lies at its base, currently disrupted and in a disaster zone
introduced.quote: This is the spot. The part of the Mikage Furnace that stores the core is right above us.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a film camera Xavier uses to record events
introduced.quote: I'd quite have liked to use my Film Kamera to record our actions here.

introduced.name: Tatara Tales
introduced.how: the film Xavier plans to make about this operation
introduced.quote: Bravo! Yes, "Tatara Tales" it shall be!

introduced.name: Toranosuke
introduced.how: a soldier who promised Xavier payment for completing the task
introduced.quote: That soldier named Toranosuke promised me "commensurate remuneration" for completing this task...

introduced.name: Hanbei
introduced.how: a superior the soldiers answer to, who is being appointed foreign attache to Sumeru
introduced.quote: They have thus decided to appoint Sir Hanbei to the post of foreign attaché to Sumeru.

introduced.name: Mikoshi Genjirou
introduced.how: a superior who came to get a detailed report on the Mikage Furnace matter
introduced.quote: one of our superiors, a man named Mikoshi Genjirou, came by earlier to ask me for a detailed report.

introduced.name: Yousuke
introduced.how: a craftsman who will handle all future maintenance of the Mikage Furnace
introduced.quote: It was decided that a craftsman named Yousuke would be in charge of all future maintenance work on the Mikage Furnace.

introduced.name: Mushroom
introduced.how: a supply shipped between Inazuma and Sumeru that is kept flowing by Hanbei's post
introduced.quote: ensuring that the most vital supply line of Mushrooms between Inazuma and Sumeru shall remain open and smooth.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: Toranosuke: Or are you trying to tell me that metalwork is under the authority of the Grand Narukami Shrine now?

assumed.name: Sacred Sakura
assumed.quote: The Tatarigami's influence is now being felt even by the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Shrine!

assumed.name: Thunder Sakura
assumed.quote: I'm only here to deal with the Thunder Sakura issue anyway.

assumed.name: Mr. Flois
assumed.quote: If Mr. Flois knew half of what had happened here, he'd go completely ballistic...

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: It's something I discovered when I was researching Kameras.

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: They might shove it into some Ruin Guard, causing it to go berserk and send us all flying.

assumed.name: Legendary serpent
assumed.quote: And in the worst case scenario, that legendary serpent might use this opportunity to resurrect itself.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: We should go ask the Treasure Hoarders if we might

assumed.name: Seven elements
assumed.quote: But I suppose we could start from the theory of the seven elements! Now then—

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: It's the Fatui again! Ah, do they have no respect for the law!?

assumed.name: Liyue and Mondstadt incidents
assumed.quote: I suppose you refer to those incidents in Liyue and Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Amidst Stormy Judgment
assumed.quote: (If Amidst Stormy Judgment was completed, and Wishes has not yet been completed)

assumed.name: Wishes (Quest)
assumed.quote: (If Amidst Stormy Judgment has not been completed, or Wishes has been completed)

threads.claim: The Tatarigami's power is dangerous and people are warned not to underestimate it.
threads.quote: You are far too dismissive of the Tatarigami's power.

threads.claim: The Tatarigami core's usefulness is connected to the Electro Archon, hinting at a deeper link.
threads.quote: Praise be to the mighty Electro Archon, the Tatarigami core has proven useful.

threads.claim: The furnace failed during a battle, and the cause of the corrupt energy build-up is left open.
threads.quote: But during one of the previous battles, something went wrong with the furnace.

threads.claim: The furnace has stopped operating, and its condition is being checked with mixed results.
threads.quote: The Mikage Furnace is quite stable, and the energy within is not yet over-saturated.

threads.claim: The containment dome is becoming unstable, and its cause is unknown.
threads.quote: the instrument is indicating that the containment dome I activated is a little unstable.

threads.claim: It is unexplained why Tatarigami energy has not leaked out after the dome was destroyed.
threads.quote: Still, something seems off here... why hasn't Tatarigami energy begun to leak out after the containment dome was destroyed?

threads.claim: The rifts' origin is an open question.
threads.quote: How were these rifts formed...

threads.claim: Xavier believes the Fatui are at least tangentially related to the rifts.
threads.quote: There is no doubt in my mind that the Fatui are at least tangentially related to those rifts.

threads.claim: Why the Fatui want the Tatarigami remains an open question.
threads.quote: Why are the Fatui interested in the Tatarigami?

threads.claim: The Fatui appear to target the Tatarigami energy inside the furnace and are gathering around its core.
threads.quote: It seems like their target is Tatarigami energy, which is within the Mikage Furnace.

threads.claim: Someone is planning Sangonomiya's precise attacks, and their identity is unknown.
threads.quote: I wonder who it is that is planning all these precise attacks from Sangonomiya's side...

threads.claim: The Traveler can control elements without a Vision, which Xavier notices but does not pursue.
threads.quote: Hmm, I guess we all have our own little secrets, eh? I shan't pry.

threads.claim: Xavier hints at Fontaine technology he is not willing to explain.
threads.quote: Well... Haha... I won't get deeper into it, but we do have other technologies besides just maintaining and producing equipment...

threads.claim: Xavier plans to use a purifier to cleanse the Tatarigami energy.
threads.quote: The emergency purifier is a device that I have had purpose-built for that task.

threads.claim: The purifier passes its test on tainted creatures, moving the plan forward.
threads.quote: The onikabuto have been completely purified!

threads.claim: The purifier may fail under accidents, so its reliability is uncertain.
threads.quote: It can be used normally just fine, yes, but I doubt that it can withstand any accidents.

threads.claim: A legendary serpent might be able to resurrect itself, a hint of a larger threat.
threads.quote: And in the worst case scenario, that legendary serpent might use this opportunity to resurrect itself.

threads.claim: Hanbei's bureaucratic focus on procedures over solutions is a recurring theme in the island's crisis.
threads.quote: His first reaction is never to find the solution to the problem.

threads.claim: Hanbei, who manages the furnace, is absent and his role in the crisis is unresolved.
threads.quote: But the one managing the maintenance of the Mikage Furnace is Sir Hanbei, and he isn't here.

threads.claim: The purification device reduces Tatarigami energy around the Mikage Furnace to harmless levels.
threads.quote: The Tatarigami here has thinned out so much as to be harmless.

threads.claim: The Mikage Furnace resumes operation once the disaster zone is purified.
threads.quote: It's... it's finally over... The Mikage Furnace should have resumed operation.

threads.claim: The Fatui might fire cannons on the Mikage Furnace to seize its Tatarigami energy, though Xavier doubts they would.
threads.quote: If those Fatui want to get their hands on the Tatarigami energy, then the only way they can do it now is to use those cannons to fire on the Mikage Furnace directly.

threads.claim: The Fatui have previously committed worse attacks in Liyue and Mondstadt, which are referenced but not explained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Oh, they've done worse...

threads.claim: Hanbei is being posted to Sumeru, leaving his Mikage Furnace-related post vacant.
threads.quote: They have thus decided to appoint Sir Hanbei to the post of foreign attaché to Sumeru.

threads.claim: Superior Mikoshi Genjirou became deeply interested in the Mikage Furnace matter after hearing the report.
threads.quote: After listening to my report, Sir Mikoshi Genjirou became quite interested in this matter.

introduced.name: Heavenly Principles
introduced.how: a power that passes judgment and has long used Natlan as a tool against the Abyss
introduced.quote: Ronova, and the Heavenly Principles she represents, have always treated Natlan as a tool to deal with the Abyss and the world's destruction...

introduced.name: Celestial Nail
introduced.how: nails cast down by the Heavenly Principles that glow and sometimes make a sound
introduced.quote: This nail cast down by the Heavenly Principles is glowing. From time to time, it also makes a sound...

introduced.name: Skyfrost Nail
introduced.how: the Dragonspine nail that was believed to have destroyed an ancient civilization after judgment
introduced.quote: I always assumed that once the Heavenly Principles passed down their judgment, the Skyfrost Nail destroyed the ancient civilization here and its purpose was then complete.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: a hunter who was among the first to witness the nail and reported it to the Druzhna
introduced.quote: I may have been one of the first witnesses, since I happened to be out hunting nearby.

introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.how: leads a mercenary crew that has camped near the Sumeru anomaly to watch for danger
introduced.quote: My crew's set up camp near here for now to keep an eye on things.

introduced.name: Desertfolk
introduced.how: Candace's people, who stand with the Dendro Archon against the disasters
introduced.quote: We Desertfolk ought not leave the Dendro Archon to carry this burden alone.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: Paimon: Miko? We weren't expecting to see you here!

assumed.name: Kokomi
assumed.quote: I'll have to drag little Kokomi here when I get the chance.

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: It's been a while since I saw you two.

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Rex Lapis tasked me with monitoring this place.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: both the adepti and the humans are very concerned about this unusual change.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Additional Millelith have been deployed to support the patrols around The Chasm

assumed.name: Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer and the other adepti have begun investigating the phenomenon.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: In all my time on Dragonspine, this is the first time I've witnessed a phenomenon like this...

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Hmm? Oh, it's you two. Sorry, I didn't notice you there.

assumed.name: Ronova
assumed.quote: I heard you took out Ronova in Snezhnaya? Pretty impressive work.

assumed.name: Capitano
assumed.quote: If it weren't for Capitano, it would've been my life that Ronova took back then.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: have always treated Natlan as a tool to deal with the Abyss and the world's destruction

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: All we know is, we defeated Celestia's Ruler of Death

assumed.name: Druzhna
assumed.quote: I notified the local Druzhna as soon as I came across it

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: so the Tsaritsa and the Fatui should be aware of it by now.

assumed.name: Dendro Archon
assumed.quote: We Desertfolk ought not leave the Dendro Archon to carry this burden alone.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles' nails are glowing, making sounds and changing in unexplained ways, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: This nail cast down by the Heavenly Principles is glowing. From time to time, it also makes a sound...

threads.claim: The Skyfrost Nail's purpose after judgment is not as simple as assumed, so the nails' true role remains open.
threads.quote: But clearly, it's not quite as simple as that.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles may be behind the anomaly through some hidden scheme, and their intentions are unknown.
threads.quote: Who knows what trick the Heavenly Principles might be playing.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles have historically treated Natlan as a tool and caused its past disasters, according to Mavuika.
threads.quote: Most of the disasters Natlan suffered in the past were thanks to them.

threads.claim: The anomaly may be Ronova's revenge for her defeat in Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: we suspect that this whole situation might be Ronova's way of getting her revenge...

threads.claim: Alyosha does not yet know whether Ronova is behind the anomaly and says the answer must wait.
threads.quote: We'll have to wait and see.

threads.claim: A fortune slip drawn by Yae Miko predicted Great Misfortune, hinting at a coming disaster.
threads.quote: and the result was "Great Misfortune." So I thought I'd better come and see for myself.

threads.claim: Sumeru has suffered one disaster after another recently, and the cause is left unexplained.
threads.quote: It feels like Sumeru's been hit by one disaster after another lately.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a mine closed off for a long time, entry only with Qixing permission
introduced.quote: No one can go in without the Qixing's say-so, not even the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: the ruling council whose permission controls entry to The Chasm
introduced.quote: No one can go in without the Qixing's say-so

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the government body that sends specialists to The Chasm and oversees it
introduced.quote: He's a specialist sent to The Chasm by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Lan
introduced.how: a Guild contact offering a commission to sneak into The Chasm
introduced.quote: Ah, it's you. Well, are you here to brave The Chasm by any chance?

introduced.name: Muning
introduced.how: a Ministry specialist overseeing The Chasm, from a porcelain family in Shenglu Hall, who owes money to Lan and Xingqiu
introduced.quote: He's a specialist sent to The Chasm by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Ganyu
introduced.how: a Yujing Terrace staffer who refuses entry by polite stalling
introduced.quote: Even Ms. Ganyu, who seems like the most amicable of the bunch, would probably just smile at us

introduced.name: Yujing Terrace
introduced.how: the office where Ganyu works, directly supporting the Qixing
introduced.quote: Ms. Ganyu works at Yujing Terrace, supporting the Qixing directly

introduced.name: Xu
introduced.how: a servant of the Xingqiu household who asks the Traveler to deliver Mora to Muning
introduced.quote: Ah, you're the Young Master's friends. How do you do?

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: the young master of Xu's household who lent Muning Mora interest-free
introduced.quote: the young master agreed without a second thought

introduced.name: Yanshang Teahouse
introduced.how: a teahouse to which Muning owes money
introduced.quote: he wound up owing a small sum of Mora to the Yanshang Teahouse in recent days

introduced.name: Huishan Hall
introduced.how: a group whose miners found the thing under The Chasm and reported it to the Qixing
introduced.quote: this was reported to the Qixing by the Huishan Hall

introduced.name: Shenglu Hall
introduced.how: a porcelain family house whose people want The Chasm reopened
introduced.quote: The people of Shenglu Hall constantly ask when it will be reopened

introduced.name: Tianshu
introduced.how: a reclusive Qixing lord with great vision for the people
introduced.quote: the Lord Tianshu is reclusive yet approachable

introduced.name: Zhiqiong
introduced.how: a former miner and Ministry-hired adventurer who helps the Traveler enter The Chasm
introduced.quote: I suggest that you go speak to Zhiqiong first.

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: a Sumeru scholar and financial lead of the exploration team
introduced.quote: This is Khedive, a scholar specifically called in from Sumeru.

introduced.name: Jinwu
introduced.how: the exploration team's safety chief who handles repairs and security
introduced.quote: This is Jinwu, who's in charge of safety.

introduced.name: Taliesin
introduced.how: a bard from Mondstadt who joins the exploration team
introduced.quote: He's a bard from Mondstadt

introduced.name: Uncle He
introduced.how: a senior miner who went missing when the Chasm miners were dispersed
introduced.quote: Uncle He is our senior here in the mines.

introduced.name: Clitopho
introduced.how: a Treasure Hoarder leader distrusted by the miners
introduced.quote: Him? I don't trust him.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: scavengers who raid above and below the mines and cannot be trusted
introduced.quote: The Treasure Hoarders are never to be trusted.

introduced.name: Tea Master Liu Su and Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: famous storytellers whose tales about the Traveler are popular in Liyue
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su and Iron Tongue Tian are both good in their own way

introduced.name: Lumenstone Adjuvant
introduced.how: a device made of Lumenstone that lets people move in the dark underground
introduced.quote: we first need to find an Adjuvant made from a material known as Lumenstone.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: only people with Visions can use the Lumenstone Adjuvant
introduced.quote: Only those with Visions can use this Adjuvant

introduced.name: Lumenspar
introduced.how: crystal fragments that grow in the mines and are made of local ore altered by an outside force
introduced.quote: Look, the Lumenspar has grown all the way down here too.

introduced.name: Bedrock Keys
introduced.how: Qixing-placed keys that anchor the Seven-Star Array sealing the mine
introduced.quote: it lies in the Bedrock Keys surrounding the area. These were placed by the Qixing themselves.

introduced.name: Seven-Star Array
introduced.how: a Qixing seal cast over the great mine at The Chasm's center
introduced.quote: the great mine in the center of The Chasm has had a Seven-Star Array cast over it

introduced.name: Cage-Shaped Geo Formations
introduced.how: Geo formations growing from the bedrock that erode the Bedrock Keys
introduced.quote: those cage-shaped Geo elemental formations over there

introduced.name: Adakka
introduced.how: an ancient dragon-king of the mountains who ruled Tianqiu Valley and sleeps in Jueyun Karst
introduced.quote: Adakka was a king who ruled Tianqiu Valley in ancient times

introduced.name: Adakka's defeat and sealing
introduced.how: a legend that the Lord of Geo defeated Adakka and sealed him away
introduced.quote: It is said that he was defeated here by the Lord of Geo's martial mastery and sealed somewhere in Jueyun Karst

introduced.name: Chasm Exploration Team
introduced.how: the Qixing-sanctioned group of explorers and scholars sent into The Chasm
introduced.quote: welcome to the Chasm Exploration Team!

introduced.name: Clitopho
introduced.how: Disgraced former fake-medicine seller from Mondstadt, now captured by the Treasure Hoarders and asking to join the team
introduced.quote: I'm Clitopho, yes, but not the one that's into pharmaceuticals. No sir!

introduced.name: Zhiqiong
introduced.how: Former mine cartographer turned adventurer and mapmaker for the exploration team
introduced.quote: Before I joined the Adventurers' Guild, I was the mine cartographer.

introduced.name: Jinwu
introduced.how: Veteran miner of over twenty years who runs the camp and knows Clitopho's past
introduced.quote: I didn't spend 20-odd years of my life down in these mines for nothing, you know?

introduced.name: Erge
introduced.how: Treasure Hoarder figure who judges captives and whose men flee from the team
introduced.quote: We've locked him up, awaiting Erge's judgment

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Bandit-like group occupying the mines, imprisoning people and smuggling ore
introduced.quote: Those Treasure Hoarders have imprisoned someone. Is this human trafficking?

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: Underground mining region that ordinary people could not normally reach, now sealed and unstable
introduced.quote: Well, you say that, but The Chasm was never a place that ordinary people could access.

introduced.name: Mountainator
introduced.how: Giant miners' cannon used to blast sealed tunnels open
introduced.quote: That's the Mountainator that we miners used... Well, and that's just what the miners called it.

introduced.name: Lumenstone
introduced.how: Raw ore found in the Chasm that can be polished into adjuvants that restrain dark mud
introduced.quote: They seem to have the power to restrain the encroachment of that black mud-like substance, almost as if they were born to be enemies.

introduced.name: Dark Mud
introduced.how: Black mud-like substance spreading over Chasm rocks, recently appearing everywhere
introduced.quote: The black substance that you see covering the rocks only started showing up everywhere recently.

introduced.name: Geo
introduced.how: Geo elements can catalyze fuses and explosions, and the Chasm's anomalies can disrupt this
introduced.quote: The fuses in here have all been designed such that they are activated by a catalytic reaction with Geo

introduced.name: Special Unmoving Essential Oil
introduced.how: Double-density potion that can catalyze an elemental explosion and must be handled carefully
introduced.quote: We just need to get one vial of Unmoving Essential Oil with double the usual density.

introduced.name: Crystal Fragment
introduced.how: Floating crystal fragment dug up by miners at the bottom of the tunnel, emitting flowing light
introduced.quote: This is the place where the miners dug that crystal up.

introduced.name: Abyss Lectors
introduced.how: Guardians Agnarr and Egill hide behind the dark fog and warn trespassers they are sinners
introduced.quote: This ground is not to be trespassed. Why have ye come, sinners?

introduced.name: Fatuus' Journal
introduced.how: Diary of an expedition that rang two bells to clear black fog, lost ten men, and retreated
introduced.quote: ...Ten were lost, two vanguard squads took immense damage. The Kapitan-Poruchik ordered a retreat...

introduced.name: Ancient Bells
introduced.how: Two bells in the northwest and southeast whose tolling makes the dark fog dissipate
introduced.quote: ...We dispatched Snezhevna and Fadeyka to ring the two bells in their respective corners...

introduced.name: Earthquake
introduced.how: An earlier earthquake opened the mines, and outsiders came down afterward
introduced.quote: By the way, there was an earthquake previously, and some people came down here afterward.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Famed adventurer said to have seen the entire world
introduced.quote: given that Alice is an adventurer who has seen the entire world, so that must be some place she's been to

introduced.name: Zhiqiong
introduced.how: adventurer and miner from Mingyun Village who joined the exploration team and fell ill from the anomalies
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong's from our latest batch of miners, and she was born in Mingyun Village.

introduced.name: Jinwu
introduced.how: older miner who maintains the mine's safety equipment and camp and looks after miners' children
introduced.quote: Well, it looks good, eh? My specialty, by the way.

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: researcher who is the nominal employer of the exploration team and studied the devices in a research lab
introduced.quote: I once looked into similar devices, and just as luck might have it, the device in your hands is an exact match to the one in my research lab.

introduced.name: Taliesin
introduced.how: self-described old-school bard who came to the mine for inspiration and hurt his leg
introduced.quote: I consider myself a bard of the old school, so of course I'm here to get some inspiration.

introduced.name: Clitopho
introduced.how: former Treasure Hoarder who now works with the team's demolitions group
introduced.quote: We — by which I mean I, Clitopho — salute you!

introduced.name: Muning
introduced.how: Ministry-linked official in charge of the exploration team's material needs and funding
introduced.quote: Since I'm currently in charge of the exploration team's material needs, could I also ask you how things are with them at the moment?

introduced.name: Haftvard the Worm
introduced.how: giant worm that burrowed through the rock and emerges to attack when the crystal is struck
introduced.quote: So this is the guy who dug out this crazy place...!

introduced.name: Mingyun Village
introduced.how: former mining village whose ore veins dried up, home of the experienced miners
introduced.quote: the ore veins dried up at Mingyun a good long time ago, so work there has already ceased.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: deep mine where an incident halted mining and an exploration team now works underground
introduced.quote: Shortly after Zhiqiong came to The Chasm, the incident happened and work here stopped as well.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: famous teahouse in Liyue that Zhiqiong calls her second home after Mingyun Village
introduced.quote: It's the most famous teahouse in Liyue.

introduced.name: Chasm Exploration Team
introduced.how: expedition team Khedive employs, running a forward camp inside The Chasm
introduced.quote: Welcome to the forward operating base of the exploration team.

introduced.name: Yaksha
introduced.how: ancient beings who defended Liyue in legend; one is said to be sealed inside The Chasm
introduced.quote: I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: power that lets people manipulate the elements; ordinary people lack one and are harmed by the anomalies
introduced.quote: For normal people like us who neither have Visions nor can manipulate the elements, these anomalies are malignant, even fatal.

introduced.name: dark mud
introduced.how: black muddy substance spreading through the mines that causes sickness in close contact
introduced.quote: Have you... had close contact with that black, muddy stuff at any point?

introduced.name: floating crystal
introduced.how: giant suspended crystal fragment deep in The Chasm that is being corrupted and purified
introduced.quote: There was a huge floating crystal in there...

introduced.name: gate device
introduced.how: handheld device used to unlock a sealed gate, matching one in Khedive's lab
introduced.quote: This is a device used to unlock the gate.

introduced.name: Lumenstone Ore
introduced.how: raw ore that Jinwu and Zhiqiong refer to as lumenstone
introduced.quote: Ooh, it's raw Lumenstone ore! That's what Jinwu and Zhiqiong called it, right?

introduced.name: Fatui Action Log
introduced.how: Fatui field notes reporting an explosion that destroyed the Mokosh Device and that black matter regrows
introduced.quote: The Mokosh Device, which should have theoretically been able to clear the Abyssal corruption from this place, has and been destroyed...
