introduced.name: Strange Stone Slate
introduced.how: recent stone tablet whose engraved map shows the five purification mechanisms and warns of a giant worm
introduced.quote: (This stone tablet looks a fair bit more recent than the rest of the ruins. It seems to have been set up not long ago.)

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: not even the Adventurers' Guild

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Ms. Katheryne isn't going to be giving out any commissions about The Chasm anytime soon.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: surely you can talk to the Millelith on our behalf?

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Who do you think I'm talking about, Rex Lapis?

assumed.name: Lady Keqing
assumed.quote: you must have a permit from Lady Keqing

assumed.name: Lady Ningguang
assumed.quote: Since you must be very familiar with Lady Ningguang

assumed.name: Iris and Dragonspine exploits
assumed.quote: many new recruits at the Guild have heard of your exploits on Dragonspine from Iris

assumed.name: Jade Chamber sea monster battle
assumed.quote: the great battle you had with that sea monster on the Jade Chamber

assumed.name: Liyue's sea monster hero
assumed.quote: O valiant hero who saved Liyue from the sea monster

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The Millelith have a lot of questions for him, most likely.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I have completed some commissions from the Guild, of course, but I'm not that experienced yet

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: just like the ancient catacombs on Dragonspine.

assumed.name: Iris
assumed.quote: it really does look like the fragments that Iris said existed on Dragonspine.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Clitopho here's from Mondstadt, so he's not too far off the mark from what we were looking for.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: These guys are most likely involved in ore smuggling rings back in Liyue.

assumed.name: Khedive
assumed.quote: Jinwu, Khedive, and the others still need you to guide them!

assumed.name: Qiaoying Village
assumed.quote: I was once commissioned by them to map out the terrain of Qiaoying Village

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: Even Rex Lapis would have trouble protecting your wallet from them then!

assumed.name: Stanley
assumed.quote: Please don't laugh at me, but I don't think I'm much inferior to Stanley in adventures.

assumed.name: Mare Jivari
assumed.quote: The environment here is no harsher than that of the Mare Jivari

assumed.name: The Array
assumed.quote: Ever since the Array was broken

assumed.name: Geo Visions
assumed.quote: curious abilities used by people with Geo Visions.

assumed.name: Good Hunter
assumed.quote: had blown the stove right off this restaurant called "Good Hunter"

assumed.name: Keqing
assumed.quote: Uhh, but the person we met down there didn't look anything like her!

assumed.name: Yelan
assumed.quote: Yelan, watching the battle from a vantage point, unleashes a fully-charged arrow at the crystal

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: The representatives from Liyue will understand as well.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: had a daughter who went off to Sumeru to study

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Khedive's Mora? It doesn't own me.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: There isn't much else to be said with regard to the Akademiya

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Seems like it's something those dastardly Fatui left behind!

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: It might've been some sort of path the Treasure Hoarders carved out en route to their loot stashes

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: very similar to the anomalies on Dragonspine

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: the Millelith have also expressed no objections to our plans for further exploration and restoration

assumed.name: Huishan Hall
assumed.quote: The Chasm Exploration Team will become an official part of Huishan Hall from this day forth!

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: But today, the Yakshas are a distant memory, and Rex Lapis too has left us

assumed.name: Ley Line
assumed.quote: the readings of the Ley Line flows in this area have stabilized significantly

threads.claim: Miners unearthed something strange under The Chasm, and its nature is unknown.
threads.quote: I think it was several years ago now when the miners unearthed something strange.

threads.claim: The Geo coalescences near the Bedrock Keys hint that the thing beneath is trying to emerge.
threads.quote: The area around the Bedrock Keys has seen an abnormal amount of Geo elemental coalescences.

threads.claim: Lumenspar crystals are fragments of the underground thing rising through the rock.
threads.quote: traveling up the veins of the rock before finally arriving here.

threads.claim: Rumors say miners found a Wish Granter or a dragon-king's tail, but no one knows what lies below.
threads.quote: Others say that they dug up some old dragon-king's tail down there.

threads.claim: The Qixing are secretly investigating The Chasm and hiding the danger from the public.
threads.quote: our investigations cannot be done with too much pomp and ceremony, lest the people be alarmed

threads.claim: The Seven-Star Array seals The Chasm, and its Bedrock Keys are weakening.
threads.quote: Connected in series, they affix the energy flowing through the array.

threads.claim: Destroying the final Bedrock Key dissolves the array, letting people explore the underground.
threads.quote: With this, the array sealing The Chasm has dissipated, and we can explore the area underground.

threads.claim: Muning's warnings were a roundabout way of telling the Traveler how to enter The Chasm.
threads.quote: and thus impart the means of getting into The Chasm to you in a roundabout way.

threads.claim: Cage-shaped Geo formations have grown from the bedrock and are eroding the Bedrock Keys.
threads.quote: They seem to have grown up from the bedrock of The Chasm over the last two years

threads.claim: The old miners' earthquakes are called Adakka's Breath, tied to a sleeping dragon-king.
threads.quote: Speaking of which, the old miners used to call these passing earthquakes

threads.claim: Paimon suspects the dragon-king legend may be linked to Azhdaha, a link left unconfirmed.
threads.quote: This story sounds familiar... Hey, don't you mean

threads.claim: The lower levels of The Chasm change shape constantly, possibly by its own will.
threads.quote: It's almost as if The Chasm itself is changing shape as it likes.

threads.claim: Uncle He may still be alive somewhere in the mines, and Jinwu refuses to give up on finding him.
threads.quote: I can't help but feel that he's still alive down here somewhere.

threads.claim: Black magma oozes from the depths and seems to be drawing creatures to it.
threads.quote: Some strange black magma is oozing out of the depths of the earth.

threads.claim: The black substance attracts nearby monsters, and the anomalies keep appearing.
threads.quote: Does this strange black substance attract nearby creatures?

threads.claim: Being near the black magma jumbles thoughts, while crystals calm the effects.
threads.quote: When I get too near to the black magma, my thoughts grow jumbled and my senses become agitated.

threads.claim: Clitopho and the Treasure Hoarders are suspected of hiding their own motives.
threads.quote: Him? I don't trust him.

threads.claim: An unidentified figure was seen fleeing the second anomaly site.
threads.quote: Eek! Who was that? Did you see that?

threads.claim: The Lumenstone Adjuvant and Lumenspar share a material, so they react to each other.
threads.quote: The Adjuvant is made of the same materials as these crystals.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong suspects the dark mud, the flowing light, and the crystal fragment are all linked, with the cause left unknown.
threads.quote: I can't be sure, but I think that these things are all related: the mud, the flowing light, and this floating crystal fragment.

threads.claim: The crystal fragment absorbs blue light, releases a surge, and flies off, blasting a path open, though its purpose remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Zhiqiong: That thing... flew away, and blasted a path open for us?

threads.claim: The floating crystal fragments resemble the fragments previously reported on Dragonspine, hinting at a shared origin.
threads.quote: it really does look like the fragments that Iris said existed on Dragonspine.

threads.claim: Lumenstone restrains the dark mud, but the reason it works is still unknown.
threads.quote: They seem to have the power to restrain the encroachment of that black mud-like substance, almost as if they were born to be enemies.

threads.claim: Lumenstone began appearing in the Chasm only after miners found the crystal, which Zhiqiong sees as no coincidence.
threads.quote: Lumenstone only started springing up like mushrooms within The Chasm after the miners discovered this thing... This is definitely no coincidence.

threads.claim: The Chasm's lower levels are changing shape constantly, almost as if the place moves on its own will.
threads.quote: It's almost as if The Chasm itself is changing shape as it likes.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong speculates that a nameless ancient civilization may lie beneath the Chasm, like the catacombs on Dragonspine.
threads.quote: Perhaps some nameless ancient civilization sleeps under our feet, just like the ancient catacombs on Dragonspine.

threads.claim: Miners report a giant snake or worm digging through the deep tunnels, a rumor Zhiqiong doubts.
threads.quote: According to the miners, a giant snake — or a giant worm — has been digging and drilling here...

threads.claim: Tolling the two ancient bells dissipates the black fog, revealing guardians hidden behind it.
threads.quote: As the terrifying tolls reverberated through the stone, the black fog dissipated.

threads.claim: A defeated Abyss Lector speaks of lies that are gone, hinting that the guardians were deceived about something.
threads.quote: ...The lies... All gone...

threads.claim: A lost expedition's journal reveals that a force lost ten men in the Chasm and retreated after failing to pass the fog.
threads.quote: ...Ten were lost, two vanguard squads took immense damage. The Kapitan-Poruchik ordered a retreat...

threads.claim: An earlier earthquake opened the mines and allowed outsiders to come down, which the Treasure Hoarders warned about.
threads.quote: By the way, there was an earthquake previously, and some people came down here afterward.

threads.claim: The broken Array unsealed old smuggler tunnels, which is how the Treasure Hoarders got into the mines.
threads.quote: Ever since the Array was broken, many secret-smuggler's tunnels were also unsealed...

threads.claim: Jinwu confirms Clitopho once sold fake medicine above ground, settling the question of his past.
threads.quote: Yes. He used to sell fake medicines above ground.

threads.claim: The black muddy substance spreading underground is linked to illness and to the anomalies, and its source is unexplained.
threads.quote: Have you... had close contact with that black, muddy stuff at any point?

threads.claim: Once the crystal is purified the dark mud begins a gradual retreat back underground.
threads.quote: It'll experience a gradual retreat.

threads.claim: The floating crystal was a fragment trying to rejoin a larger whole, which Zhiqiong suggests is the key to The Chasm's mystery.
threads.quote: So the crystal in the upper levels did fly towards it — a fragment desiring to be part of the whole once again.

threads.claim: Khedive withholds the real reason Zhiqiong must leave The Chasm, hinting at hidden knowledge about the thing below.
threads.quote: I'm sorry, I cannot divulge the details, but Zhiqiong has to get some distance from the thing under The Chasm

threads.claim: Khedive suggests The Chasm is trying to take Zhiqiong's life, while she has no concern for her own safety.
threads.quote: not realizing that The Chasm seems set on taking it from her.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong's coughing and weakness are tied to the anomalies, and she is the only team member showing such reactions.
threads.quote: You're the only person — I repeat, the only person in the whole team — who has shown such serious negative reactions during this process.

threads.claim: After resting at the camp Zhiqiong recovers and feels much better.
threads.quote: I'm feeling a whole lot better now

threads.claim: A Yaksha may be sealed somewhere in The Chasm, raising the question of what lies behind the gate.
threads.quote: I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

threads.claim: The heroes found no Yaksha in the depths, leaving the sealed Yaksha unresolved.
threads.quote: Well, we didn't meet this Yaksha you speak of...

threads.claim: An unseen figure may have helped during the fight with the worm, leaving a mysterious sound behind.
threads.quote: someone helped us out during that fight with the big snake

threads.claim: A flashy figure who passed by with a shoom sound was reported, and Muning suggests it could be a Treasure Hoarder or Fatui.
threads.quote: Are you certain that it wasn't a Treasure Hoarder or a Fatuus?

threads.claim: Fatui scouts have found human activity underground and suspect humans may be spreading the black matter.
threads.quote: Our scouting parties have discovered human activity in different locations.

threads.claim: The Fatui have tunneled into The Chasm, adding a rival presence to the exploration.
threads.quote: They've tunneled into this place as well?

threads.claim: A strange device unlocks a sealed gate in The Chasm, and its energy is not understood by known science.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, neither alchemy nor basic mechanics can help us understand the energy held within these devices

threads.claim: The team uses the device to open the sealed gate, revealing a large cavern.
threads.quote: (Open the gate)

threads.claim: The stone tablet's engraving seems to warn of a giant worm and shows how to purify the crystal.
threads.quote: Seems like this stone tablet is telling us to beware of the super big worm.

threads.claim: Striking the crystal releases the giant worm, and Yelan's arrow drops the crystal onto it.
threads.quote: which then falls and crashes onto Haftvard

threads.claim: Keqing, through the Yuheng, has been monitoring the team and was concerned for the Traveler's safety.
threads.quote: She seemed quite concerned for your safety.

threads.claim: The anomalies below resemble those on Dragonspine, suggesting a common alien source.
threads.quote: very similar to the anomalies on Dragonspine

threads.claim: Zhiqiong believes adventure is only truly possible for ordinary people, not for those with Visions.
threads.quote: Adventure, exploration, challenge — these are things that can only be truly experienced by normal people like us!

threads.claim: Zhiqiong values danger over comfort and says she would rather die in the depths than wait for age to claim her.
threads.quote: I'd rather lay my life down here than lie in some cushy bed waiting for time to claim me.

threads.claim: Jinwu worries that Zhiqiong does not value her own life, and that she needs to be watched over.
threads.quote: She hasn't grown up at all, though, and still doesn't value her life at all

threads.claim: Locals five hundred years ago described a dark calamity much like the present corruption.
threads.quote: locals here five hundred years ago described the dark calamity

threads.claim: Khedive and the team answer to the Ministry of Civil Affairs, which holds the real authority over the expedition.
threads.quote: even he answers to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: Jeht's tribe, whose camp lies deep in the desert
introduced.quote: The Tanit are the tribe from which Jeht hails. Their campsite is in the depths of Deshret Desert, amidst the ruins of what was once the city of Gurabad.

introduced.name: Deshret Desert
introduced.how: desert where the Tanit camp
introduced.quote: Their campsite is in the depths of Deshret Desert, amidst the ruins of what was once the city of Gurabad.

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: ruined former city where the Tanit camp and where the Jinni Fragment is found
introduced.quote: Their campsite is in the depths of Deshret Desert, amidst the ruins of what was once the city of Gurabad.

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: hidden oasis at the sandstorm's heart, taboo to the Tanit, believed to hold Jeht's mother's records and the Goddess of Flowers' secrets
introduced.quote: The Tanit tribe holds that the never-ending sandstorm at the heart of the desert conceals the Eternal Oasis.

introduced.name: Jinni Fragment
introduced.how: the only key to entering the Eternal Oasis, found in Gurabad ruins
introduced.quote: According to Jeht, the only way into the oasis is through the use of a Jinni Fragment, which can be found at the ruins of Gurabad.

introduced.name: Mendas
introduced.how: Tanit scout who challenges the Traveler at the camp entrance
introduced.quote: Mendas: Bandits? How rude! I am Mendas, a scout! And this is Hugeweh.

introduced.name: Hugeweh
introduced.how: Tanit scout who stands guard with Mendas
introduced.quote: Mendas: Bandits? How rude! I am Mendas, a scout! And this is Hugeweh.

introduced.name: Aderfi
introduced.how: Tanit merchant who trades goods with the city and is dismissive of outsiders
introduced.quote: Aderfi: What do I do? I do business, exchanging our trash for trash from the city.

introduced.name: Masseira
introduced.how: strange old Tanit man who seems to know the Traveler
introduced.quote: Why don't you go find Masseira? He's a strange old man.

introduced.name: Yuften
introduced.how: Tanit member who raises crocodiles, introduced as one of the camp's residents
introduced.quote: Jeht isn't back yet, but Aderfi, Masseira, and Yuften are in at the moment. They're pretty friendly to outsiders.

introduced.name: Babel
introduced.how: Matriarch of the Tanit who approved Jeht's invitation and controls the camp
introduced.quote: I'm terribly sorry that you had to see... that. I'm at fault. As the Matriarch of the Tanit, I'd like to make amends.

introduced.name: Azariq
introduced.how: Jeht's senior in the tribe and a friend who guides them through Gurabad
introduced.quote: At the entrance of the Gurabad ruins the three meet Azariq, a friend of Jeht's and her senior in the tribe.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: Jinni in a bottle who forms a contract of servitude with the Traveler
introduced.quote: The group explores the new sets of ruins and discovers Liloupar, a Jinni in a bottle who forms a contract of servitude with the Traveler which causes Jeht to become irritated.

introduced.name: Ferigees
introduced.how: Liloupar's sister who guards the center of Deshret's Glass Goblet disguised as an ancient contraption
introduced.quote: They are stopped by Liloupar's sister Ferigees, who takes the appearance of an ancient contraption and prevents them from entering, forcing the group to fight her.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: giant decommissioned machine that can punch passages and cross quicksand
introduced.quote: In the morning, Azariq takes the group to a giant decommissioned Ruin Guard and says that they can use it to cross quicksand-filled areas.

introduced.name: Goddess of Flowers
introduced.how: mistress of the Eternal Oasis who has long been dead, deceived by King Deshret
introduced.quote: Liloupar realizes that the Goddess of Flowers has long been dead and that King Deshret lied to her and the other Jinni, but bears no hatred towards him.

introduced.name: Jinni betrayal tale
introduced.how: a Jinni who loved a tyrant king, betrayed him, and cursed his descendants until the kingdom fell
introduced.quote: she tells the story of a Jinni who fell in love with a tyrant mortal king but betrayed him by cursing their children for generations until their kingdom fell.

introduced.name: Jeht's parents' deaths
introduced.how: Jeht's father and mother have died, and she is burying their remains at the Eternal Oasis
introduced.quote: Matriarch Babel recently agreed to let me bring Dad's... my father's remains, and those of my mother, to be buried in the Eternal Oasis.

introduced.name: Azariq
introduced.how: Jeht's senior in the tribe and older-brother figure who guides the party through the ruins
introduced.quote: Well, this is Azariq, a senior of mine in the tribe.

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: A Jinni sealed in a magic bottle who introduces herself and offers to serve the Traveler
introduced.quote: Liloupar. Call me Liloupar.

introduced.name: Babel
introduced.how: Matriarch of the Tanit tribe who sends the party to recover the Mother of the Jinn
introduced.quote: Babel of the mortal Tanit tribe seeks an audience with you.

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: A legendary accursed desert city, of which these temples are outlying parts
introduced.quote: it seems that this was once the legendary Gurabad... the accursed city of old.

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: A sealed destination at the desert's heart that the tribe must enter with the Jinni's help
introduced.quote: We need it in order to be accepted into the Eternal Oasis at the desert's heart.

introduced.name: Jinn
introduced.how: Familiars of the Queen of All Oases whose powers can make barren sand fertile
introduced.quote: The Jinn were the familiars of the Queen of All Oases

introduced.name: Mother of the Jinn
introduced.how: A Jinni fragment sealed in a bottle that the tribe needs to enter the Eternal Oasis
introduced.quote: Our objective here is to find the fragment of the Mother of the Jinn.

introduced.name: Nabu Malikata
introduced.how: Ancient queen whose tomb the tribe seeks; the Queen of All Oases in tribal legend
introduced.quote: They say that in the days of Queen Nabu Malikata, this was a verdant land ruled by a tribe of giants...

introduced.name: Ormazd
introduced.how: Vassal king who first built the temple in remembrance of the God King Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: This temple is said to have been first built by a vassal king named Ormazd in remembrance of the God King Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Liloupar drowning Ormazd in honey
introduced.how: The wicked spirit Liloupar is said to have drowned King Ormazd and his household in honey, ending Gurabad's history
introduced.quote: the wicked spirit who drowned Ormazd, the mortal king of Gurabad, and his entire household in honey

introduced.name: Fall of Gurabad by fire
introduced.how: Books claim Gurabad was destroyed by searing fire and the Jinn's great anger
introduced.quote: The books say that Gurabad was destroyed with searing fire and the great anger of the Jinn...

introduced.name: Aderfi
introduced.how: A tribal scholar whose tent holds old theses and who is linked to Benben's repair
introduced.quote: I read some of the old theses that you can find in Aderfi's tent

introduced.name: Tanit tribe
introduced.how: The desert tribe led by Matriarch Babel, which Jeht belongs to and which treats these ruins as taboo
introduced.quote: These ruins are a cursed, taboo place to us Tanit

introduced.name: Afiyah tribe
introduced.how: A rival tribe whose camps hid the ambushers and who received a Tanit goods invoice
introduced.quote: The Tanit tribe sends respectful greetings to the Afiyah tribe.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Outsiders that Jeht and her father have encountered before and suspects of working with the traitors
introduced.quote: My dad and I have also encountered those people who call themselves

introduced.name: Wenut
introduced.how: Desert creatures hunted yearly for body fat used in spices, whose larvae give a scent used for trail marks
introduced.quote: We hunt them every year, and then we collect their body fat and use that to make spices.

introduced.name: True-name contracts with Jinn
introduced.how: Jinn bind to humans by giving their true name, which can control them, and betrayal brings the Jinn's vengeance
introduced.quote: Jinn make contracts with humans by giving them their

introduced.name: Liloupar
introduced.how: a Jinni whose fragments are scattered across the sands and who serves the Traveler
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Across the sands, there is still much of me that lies scattered.

introduced.name: Jinn
introduced.how: Jinn need no vessel or senses and release energy that makes green around their fragments
introduced.quote: Liloupar: The Jinn have little need for a vessel, and even less need for senses.

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: Liloupar's master who built an irrigation canal system for the mortal kingdoms
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Indeed... My Master, Al-Ahmar, once created a most intricate system of canals, shaped to provide irrigation for the soil of the mortal kingdoms...

introduced.name: Matriarch Babel
introduced.how: leader of the Tanit tribe who sends the group into the desert
introduced.quote: Babel: As with nations or cities, tribes too must enforce their laws. I think you understand this.

introduced.name: Azariq
introduced.how: Babel's adopted son, a tribesman who guides the group
introduced.quote: Babel: He is my "son." Though not born of my flesh, I trust him very much.

introduced.name: Jeht
introduced.how: a young Tanit tribeswoman traveling with the party to lay her parents to rest
introduced.quote: Babel: Jeht? She is a good child. She learns our ways quickly and greets trouble with neither grimace nor complaints.

introduced.name: Aderfi
introduced.how: a Tanit member branded a traitor whom Jeht is sent to capture
introduced.quote: Babel: Ah, Jeht. While you're here, I shall entrust the great task of apprehending the traitor Aderfi to you...

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: the desert tribe that Jeht, Azariq and Babel belong to
introduced.quote: Jeht: This is a Tanit camp... It even has the tribe's markings.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: northern outsiders who began with trade and then meddled in tribal affairs
introduced.quote: Babel: Initially, they approached our merchants under the banner of trade.

introduced.name: Wenut
introduced.how: dangerous burrowing creatures that are drawn by the Jinni's presence
introduced.quote: Babel: Wenut are extremely dangerous creatures. Approach them with caution. They may attack you upon being drawn by the Jinni's presence.

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: a sealed underground oasis built as a mechanism for eternity, now driven by sand
introduced.quote: Liloupar: A mechanism once built to sustain a dream of eternity, to supply the oasis, forever and always. It was once propelled by water but is now driven only by sand.

introduced.name: Nabu Malikata
introduced.how: Liloupar's mistress, the Lord of Flowers, who sleeps in the Eternal Oasis and is the Tanit's object of faith
introduced.quote: Liloupar: She slumbers in the Eternal Oasis. This tunnel was dug in her memory.

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: a city on the oasis periphery that fell into a sand gap and was lost to death and oblivion
introduced.quote: Liloupar: But the city of Gurabad fell into a gap in the sand, and became shrouded by death and oblivion... Well, that's another story.

introduced.name: Deshret's Glass Goblet
introduced.how: a cup King Deshret left at the center of the water-machine cavern, said to hold past traumas and memories
introduced.quote: Liloupar: King Deshret left his glass goblet here, at the center of this place.

introduced.name: Ruin Golem
introduced.how: a huge ancient iron war machine the group must operate to cross the quicksand
introduced.quote: Azariq: Be patient, little wildcat. This one's interior is in perfect condition! We can activate it and use it to cross those dangerous quicksand-filled areas!

introduced.name: Jeht's father
introduced.how: Jeht's late father who always wanted to enter the Eternal Oasis to reunite with her mother
introduced.quote: Jeht: Yeah... Dad always told me that he would one day enter the Eternal Oasis and find Mom again... Never thought I'd be helping him make his dream come true.

introduced.name: Babel and Jeht's father's incident
introduced.how: an unspecified past conflict between Babel's people and Jeht's father
introduced.quote: Babel: Heh. Speaking of her, it's a shame that there was an... incident between us and her father in years prior...

introduced.name: war machines of 500 years ago
introduced.how: ancient war machines like these are said to date from about 500 years ago, with lost records of that era
introduced.quote: Jeht: Dad also once said that these are war machines left over from 500 years ago... I can't help but wonder what actually happened in that era...

introduced.name: Ferigees
introduced.how: Liloupar's sister, a bound guardian of the Eternal Oasis who is held by mechanical shackles
introduced.quote: Liloupar: Yes. Ferigees, my sister... I have returned.

introduced.name: Eternal Oasis
introduced.how: a hidden paradise beneath the desert, the Mistress of Flowers' realm, frozen in time
introduced.quote: This is my mistress' paradise, a place frozen at the point where the sky kisses the waters

introduced.name: Great Master of Verdure
introduced.how: a god who ruled a verdant land and left it, after which the land was abandoned
introduced.quote: They say that after the Great Master of Verdure left, the land she used to rule was abandoned as well.

introduced.name: Mistress of Flowers
introduced.how: a goddess who guarded the oasis and its wanderers, who has since died
introduced.quote: For the mistress was once the guardian of maddened monks and lost wanderers.

introduced.name: Master of the Sands
introduced.how: Liloupar's former lover, a ruler who swore the Mistress of Flowers slumbered in the oasis and deceived them
introduced.quote: The Lord of the Sands once swore to us that our Mistress of Flowers slumbered here, destined to awake someday.

introduced.name: Tanit
introduced.how: the desert tribe Jeht belongs to, led by Matriarch Babel
introduced.quote: you are a daughter of the Tanit, and the truth of our consanguinity will always run in your veins.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a group allied with the northern traitors, with whom Azariq and Aderfi colluded
introduced.quote: Jeht: Organize your thoughts? Of what? Of teaming up with the Fatui?

introduced.name: northerners
introduced.how: outsiders from the north who traded with the tribe and secretly harbored treachery
introduced.quote: I was unable to foresee the treachery these northerners harbored...

introduced.name: Aderfi
introduced.how: a Tanit traitor who corresponded with Azariq and sought to ally the tribe with the northerners
introduced.quote: In Azariq and Aderfi's correspondence, it was mentioned that the reason they turned traitor

introduced.name: Gurabad
introduced.how: a city whose walls Liloupar brought down, now in ruins that the tribe has explored
introduced.quote: Do you bewitch your new master even now, just as you brought Gurabad's walls down with your honeyed words?

introduced.name: Al-Ahmar
introduced.how: a central crystal goblet in the ruins whose location leads into the Eternal Oasis
introduced.quote: Right there in the center is the Crystal Goblet of Al-Ahmar.

introduced.name: Three Gods
introduced.how: the deities from whom water is a blessing, making water supply stations temples
introduced.quote: Yes. Water is a blessing from the Three Gods, so the water supply station is also a temple.

introduced.name: Ufairah
introduced.how: Jeht's mother, whose notebook of hopes for her daughter is found in the oasis
introduced.quote: To my dear Jeht, loveliest of daughters,

introduced.name: Jebrael
introduced.how: Jeht's father, Ufairah's husband, who also rests in the Eternal Oasis
introduced.quote: But I'm glad that I could be your mother, and Jebrael's wife.

introduced.name: Liloupar's killing of her own people
introduced.how: Liloupar admits she used her own children to carry out a killing as punishment for her lover's betrayal
introduced.quote: In short... I used the hands and hearts of my own children to complete an impeccable killing.

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: It's been a while! Hope you still remember me. How are things going for you?

assumed.name: previous adventure with Jeht
assumed.quote: there's something left over from our previous adventure that I'd like you to come help me finish.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Hello there. We have a letter for you — it's from Ms. Jeht.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Katheryne: The Adventurers' Guild has an open partnership with the Eremites, so it would be more surprising if I didn't know her.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Hugeweh, optional)

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: The Traveler can then choose to play a round of Genius Invokation TCG with Azariq, although it is not required.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: the player can either choose to be compensated in Mora, an Artifact, or nothing.

assumed.name: Benben
assumed.quote: Jeht: Hehe, no worries! By the way, about Benben... can you still fix it?

assumed.name: Jeht
assumed.quote: We're glad to see you too, Jeht!

assumed.name: Matriarch Babel
assumed.quote: Matriarch Babel practically forces us to read every day

assumed.name: Benben
assumed.quote: Y'know, it sure would be nice if Benben was with us...

assumed.name: Ay-Khanoum
assumed.quote: eternal prisoner of Ay-Khanoum

assumed.name: Apep
assumed.quote: Ah, the children of Apep, reduced to this...

assumed.name: Jebrael
assumed.quote: Traveler: You sing it better than Jebrael did.

assumed.name: Ruin Guard
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, we've seen lots of Ruin Guards before, but an iron ball of this sort and size... Hmm, Paimon really has no idea what it would be for.

assumed.name: Jinni
assumed.quote: Jeht: You're getting on my nerves, Jinni.

assumed.name: Liloupar's fragments
assumed.quote: Babel: The ruins of the canals may yet hide your... fragments.

assumed.name: Matriarch Babel's role
assumed.quote: Jeht: Matriarch Babel must've sent someone here ahead of us.

assumed.name: Azariq
assumed.quote: Jeht: Azariq, you're like an elder brother to me, and I respect your guidance.

assumed.name: Liloupar as Mother of the Jinn bound by contract
assumed.quote: the contract between my Master and I can only be broken by death.

assumed.name: Matriarch Babel
assumed.quote: Is this... a request from Matriarch Babel?

assumed.name: Ruin Golem and big iron ball
assumed.quote: Will the big iron ball still work?

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Aderfi, optional

assumed.name: Benben
assumed.quote: Benben still hasn't woken up, and now Matriarch Babel's making these outrageous demands

assumed.name: Jeht's parents' dreams
assumed.quote: I do look forward to fulfilling my parents' dreams at last.

threads.claim: The Eternal Oasis lies hidden inside a never-ending sandstorm and is believed to hold the secrets of the Goddess of Flowers.
threads.quote: The Tanit tribe holds that the never-ending sandstorm at the heart of the desert conceals the Eternal Oasis.

threads.claim: The Traveler finally enters the Eternal Oasis, a paradise orchard where time is frozen.
threads.quote: The group enters the Eternal Oasis, a paradise orchard where everything is frozen in time, and approach the center where the Goddess of Flowers rests.

threads.claim: Entry to the Eternal Oasis requires a Jinni Fragment found in the Gurabad ruins.
threads.quote: According to Jeht, the only way into the oasis is through the use of a Jinni Fragment, which can be found at the ruins of Gurabad.

threads.claim: Older Tanit believe the Eternal Oasis is haunted by ancient spirits, making it a taboo place.
threads.quote: Some older folks believe that ancient spirits roam there, hungering for souls and flesh... But that's probably just a myth.

threads.claim: Liloupar is scattered into fragments that the Traveler must recover one by one.
threads.quote: Liloupar recovers a fragment of herself deep within the tunnels, and informs the group once they reach Deshret's Glass Goblet that the only way to proceed is to find two other entrances on the surface.

threads.claim: Liloupar regains another fragment of herself in the cave passage.
threads.quote: Liloupar receives another fragment of herself, and the group returns to the surface to find the final entrance.

threads.claim: Liloupar suspects Babel will use the Tanit for her own ends without remorse, a suspicion Jeht resists.
threads.quote: She compares the Jinni in the story to Babel, whom she believes will use her tribespeople for her own ends without remorse.

threads.claim: Babel suspects the Fatui are behind Aderfi's betrayal and that Wenut activity is rising in the dunes.
threads.quote: Babel informs them that she suspects the Fatui are involved with Aderfi's betrayal, and that there is increased Wenut activity in the dunes.

threads.claim: Azariq learned Ruin Guard technology from the Fatui and planned to kill the Traveler to end Liloupar's contract.
threads.quote: Jeht, realizing that Azariq had learned of the Ruin Guard technology from the Fatui and is planning to kill the Traveler so their contract with Liloupar will end, challenges him to a fight and wins.

threads.claim: Azariq shows unusual excitement over the Ruin Guard, making Liloupar suspicious of him.
threads.quote: Once inside, Liloupar notes his unusual excitement over it and grows suspicious of him.

threads.claim: Azariq planned to replace Babel with Jeht as matriarch and marry her to become co-leader, and he is killed by Jeht.
threads.quote: learns that Azariq had intended to replace Babel with Jeht as the matriarch of the Tanit and marry her, thus becoming the co-leader of the tribe.

threads.claim: The Goddess of Flowers has long been dead, and King Deshret deceived her and the Jinni.
threads.quote: Liloupar realizes that the Goddess of Flowers has long been dead and that King Deshret lied to her and the other Jinni, but bears no hatred towards him.

threads.claim: Liloupar's sister Ferigees guards the center of Deshret's Glass Goblet in disguise.
threads.quote: They are stopped by Liloupar's sister Ferigees, who takes the appearance of an ancient contraption and prevents them from entering, forcing the group to fight her.

threads.claim: Jeht is an outsider among the Tanit and remains unsure of her future with them.
threads.quote: She is defeated, and the group prepares to enter the Eternal Oasis although Jeht expresses concern about her future in the Tanit.

threads.claim: Jeht admits she was not born among the Tanit and does not feel innately at home there.
threads.quote: Well, I wasn't born here, after all, and the Tanit tribe isn't a home I'm innately familiar with.

threads.claim: Jeht buries her father's axe and her mother's notes at the Eternal Oasis, fulfilling her parents' wishes.
threads.quote: Jeht lays down her father's axe and her mother's notes before a tree in the oasis, completing her parent's wishes.

threads.claim: Jeht and the Traveler share an unfinished matter from a previous adventure.
threads.quote: there's something left over from our previous adventure that I'd like you to come help me finish.

threads.claim: The Eternal Oasis is sealed in the desert's heart and can only be entered with the Jinni's help.
threads.quote: We need it in order to be accepted into the Eternal Oasis at the desert's heart.

threads.claim: The tribe seeks the slumbering place of Nabu Malikata, which the Jinni is needed to reach.
threads.quote: to ask that you show forth your great might and aid us in finding the place where Nabu Malikata slumbers

threads.claim: Books blame fire and the Jinn for Gurabad's fall, but Azariq suspects a mob, soldiers, or tribespeople.
threads.quote: But it looks more like the work of a mob, soldiers, or perhaps even tribespeople like us...

threads.claim: Gurabad's later history is said to be shrouded in dark secrets.
threads.quote: The history of Gurabad thereafter has been shrouded in dark secrets...

threads.claim: A contract by true name can only be broken by death, and Liloupar will watch the Traveler closely.
threads.quote: But a word to the wise: nothing save death can break a contract forged by

threads.claim: Liloupar has unfinished business at the Eternal Oasis that she will explain only later.
threads.quote: There are things there that have been left unfinished.

threads.claim: Liloupar recalls a lush, lotus-filled river valley that has since decayed.
threads.quote: There were even lotuses here once, and the flowers that my mistress so loved...

threads.claim: A note names Aderfi as the contact for an ambush against the outland traveler.
threads.quote: Contact: Aderfi...

threads.claim: Babel confirms Aderfi's handwriting and that he is a traitor to the tribe.
threads.quote: This is indeed his handwriting, and it is even signed in his hand.

threads.claim: The traitors may be collaborating with outsiders such as the Fatui.
threads.quote: It's even possible that they're collaborating with dangerous outsiders like the Fatui.

threads.claim: Benben is broken and Aderfi is still trying to fix it.
threads.quote: Aderfi's still trying to figure out what's wrong with it...

threads.claim: Jeht's outsider blood sets her apart in the tribe, though she is not rejected outright.
threads.quote: The blood of outsiders does not mix with that of the tribe

threads.claim: Liloupar gives her true name to the Traveler and commits to serving them as master.
threads.quote: But your friend I shall serve, and give my true name.

threads.claim: Liloupar's memories are fragmented and she regains some of them as her fragments are recovered.
threads.quote: Liloupar: Apologies. I did not mean to let you behold a moment so shameful. But as you might understand, I have reclaimed a portion of my memories. Now, I may guard you better.

threads.claim: The Traveler experiences visions of someone else's memories when collecting Liloupar's fragments.
threads.quote: Traveler: It was a memory. Someone else's memory...

threads.claim: Liloupar suggests Babel is a deceitful figure whose true motives are hidden behind a mask.
threads.quote: Liloupar: Where they differ, however, is the shame and quests for renown that so compel your kind... Babel wears them like a mask, though she too is a creature of deceit.

threads.claim: Jeht senses that Azariq knows more than he should, hinting he is hiding something.
threads.quote: Jeht: That said, he does know a little too much, which makes me uneasy... But that's just a gut feeling, you know?

threads.claim: Azariq knows how to operate ancient machines through blueprints left by Aderfi, deepening doubts about him.
threads.quote: Azariq: The blueprints Aderfi left behind recorded the mechanical structure of this thing.

threads.claim: Babel suspects that traitors within the tribe are tied to outsiders from the snowlands.
threads.quote: Babel: I suspect that the recent spike in traitors within the tribe has something to do with the interference of those who hail from the snowlands.

threads.claim: Ancient war machines from about 500 years ago are found in the desert and their history has been largely lost.
threads.quote: Jeht: Dad also once said that these are war machines left over from 500 years ago... I can't help but wonder what actually happened in that era...

threads.claim: King Deshret's glass goblet is said to be a receptacle for past traumas and memories and lies at the heart of the oasis.
threads.quote: Liloupar: King Deshret left his glass goblet here, at the center of this place.

threads.claim: The goblet in the temple is not the legendary artifact but a mechanism holding the Eternal Oasis in stasis.
threads.quote: Liloupar: Hah. That's not the actual goblet. It's just a mechanism holding the Eternal Oasis in stasis.

threads.claim: Nabu Malikata's eternal sleep is tied to the traumas and memories held in the goblet.
threads.quote: Liloupar: And those traumas and memories protected the eternal sleep of my mistress, the Lord of Flowers.

threads.claim: The city of Gurabad was lost into a gap in the sand, a story left for later.
threads.quote: Liloupar: But the city of Gurabad fell into a gap in the sand, and became shrouded by death and oblivion... Well, that's another story.

threads.claim: The Lord charged the mortals' kingdom with guarding the Eternal Oasis, which is hidden beneath the dunes.
threads.quote: Liloupar: The Lord charged the mortals' ideal kingdom with guarding his Eternal Oasis. That is why there was a city on the periphery of this dune.

threads.claim: Jeht's father dreamed of entering the Eternal Oasis to reunite with her mother, and Jeht is now carrying out that wish.
threads.quote: Jeht: Yeah... Dad always told me that he would one day enter the Eternal Oasis and find Mom again... Never thought I'd be helping him make his dream come true.

threads.claim: Jeht knows almost nothing about her mother beyond a nursery rhyme her father sang.
threads.quote: Jeht: That's the only memory I have left of her. Dad always used to sing me this old nursery rhyme.

threads.claim: The forbidden zone holds the remains of a long-past god that the tribe will not disturb.
threads.quote: Babel: I respect Azariq's considerations. The remains left by a god long past... That is something not lightly disturbed by the likes of us, who yearn only to stand vigil over this tomb.

threads.claim: Jeht reflects that home is a place one belongs to even when it is cruel, and sees the Tanit as her new home.
threads.quote: Jeht: To me, the Tanit might just be that home.

threads.claim: Babel and Jeht's father had a past incident, which she calls a delayed resolution.
threads.quote: Babel: Heh. Speaking of her, it's a shame that there was an... incident between us and her father in years prior...

threads.claim: The Eternal Oasis is said to be doomed to collapse once the sands of time bury it.
threads.quote: Once this place is submerged by the sands of time, the Eternal Oasis will inevitably collapse.

threads.claim: Disturbing the fragment's power has set the oasis on course for ruin.
threads.quote: This place is destined for ruin, to be swallowed by the sands sooner or later.

threads.claim: Traveler saw the Mistress of Flowers in a vision of the oasis as it once was.
threads.quote: I saw the Mistress of Flowers...

threads.claim: The Mistress of Flowers is not in the oasis; she has already died.
threads.quote: Liloupar: She is gone. He lied to us. He lied to us all.

threads.claim: The Master of the Sands deceived Liloupar and her people about the Mistress of Flowers sleeping in the oasis.
threads.quote: How strange. Our mistress has already passed. He... He deceived me. He deceived my people.

threads.claim: Liloupar is suspected of having murdered the people of the oasis realm.
threads.quote: Traveler: You... It was you who murdered them...

threads.claim: Liloupar confesses she used her own children to carry out the killing as punishment for betrayal.
threads.quote: In short... I used the hands and hearts of my own children to complete an impeccable killing.

threads.claim: Ferigees has been bound to a husk for thousands of years, constrained by an oath.
threads.quote: Sister, you shed the form of a Jinni and constrained yourself to this husk for thousands of years.

threads.claim: Ferigees's shackles break at her death, releasing her from the oath that bound her.
threads.quote: Ah... My shackles, my chains... My oath...

threads.claim: Azariq asks Jeht to hand over the Mother of the Jinn, hinting at a hidden plan.
threads.quote: Would you hand the Mother of the Jinn over into my keeping?

threads.claim: Proof is found that Azariq colluded with the Fatui against the tribe.
threads.quote: Here: proof of his collusion with the Fatui.

threads.claim: Babel admits the northerners' dangers outweighed their benefits, and she removed traitors who had turned to them.
threads.quote: Later, I would discover that the dangers they represented far outweighed the benefits they offered...

threads.claim: Babel admits she sent many explorers to the oasis, most of whom died, and then declared it taboo.
threads.quote: Hence, I put a stop to the forays and marked entry into the place as taboo.

threads.claim: Babel had a daughter who was stolen by the sands, and she sees Jeht as a replacement.
threads.quote: If my daughter had not been stolen from me by the sands, I like to think that she might've turned out to be like you.

threads.claim: Babel plans to hold the Eternal Oasis for the Tanit tribe.
threads.quote: The Eternal Oasis is in the hands of the Tanit tribe, as long as our people gain control over that place

threads.claim: Jeht's parents were drawn to this place as their final destination.
threads.quote: Is this why my parents regarded this place as their final destination?

threads.claim: Jeht's parents are laid to rest in the oasis, reunited at last.
threads.quote: I know that. But at least my parents were reunited before the end, as if they'd never left each other at all.

threads.claim: Jeht doubts whether she truly belongs with the Tanit after the betrayals.
threads.quote: Are the Tanit truly where I belong? Have I really been accepted by them?

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests that freedom means being bound neither to lovers nor to foes, which Liloupar finds she feels after her hatred fades.
threads.quote: Maybe this is what it means to be free.

introduced.name: Sabbah
introduced.how: Self-introduction as a former Akademiya scholar now living in exile in Aaru Village
introduced.quote: My name is Sabbah. I offer you my apologies as well as my welcome to the village.

introduced.name: Ziyad
introduced.how: A local boy singing the rose folk song in the village
introduced.quote: Were you talking about the rose folk song that Ziyad was singing?

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: A tiny sandy village where the soil is unsuitable for Sumeru Roses
introduced.quote: However... Aaru is built on sand and the soil here is actually not suitable for the cultivation of Sumeru Roses.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: A scholarly institution with a athenaeum and taboos that expelled Sabbah
introduced.quote: I broke the Akademiya's taboos, so I was removed from amongst their ranks.

introduced.name: Sumeru Rose
introduced.how: A rose with many uses: food, medicine, gifts, and market value
introduced.quote: They can be eaten, turned into medicine, given as gifts, or fetch a good price on the market.

introduced.name: Dendro
introduced.how: An element that promotes plant growth and works well on poor crops
introduced.quote: Yes, Dendro promotes plant growth and works especially well on poor crops.

introduced.name: Singing Rose
introduced.how: A local Sumeru folk song about a wish-granting rose
introduced.quote: That's a local Sumeru folk song called the "Singing Rose," right? It's such a cute song.

introduced.name: Sabbah's exile
introduced.how: Sabbah said something beyond her station, learned forbidden knowledge, and was removed from the Akademiya
introduced.quote: I said something beyond my station, and learned something I shouldn't have.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Sabbah, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Sabbah, optional)

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: But I'm just a normal person without a Dendro Vision, and I lack the resources to obtain effective fertilizer.

threads.claim: The Akademiya has taboos around forbidden knowledge, and curiosity is linked to sin.
threads.quote: Curiosity is the impetus for seeking wisdom, but it's also the cause of sin.

threads.claim: The exact reason for Sabbah's exile from the Akademiya is being withheld.
threads.quote: For safety reasons, I don't think I should go into details.

threads.claim: People who control elements without a Vision are considered to be of ill repute.
threads.quote: Supposedly, there are people who can control the elements without a Vision, but such people are of universally ill repute...

threads.claim: The Traveler controls Dendro without a Vision, marking them as unusual.
threads.quote: You don't seem to have a Vision, and yet you can control Dendro. You're no ordinary adventurer, I think.

threads.claim: Geographical changes may have altered the traits of Sumeru Roses over time, which could reveal past history.
threads.quote: I believe geographical changes led to changes in the roses' traits.

threads.claim: Sabbah suspects the Golden Rose of the folk song is only an imagined creation rather than a real plant.
threads.quote: The Sumeru Roses I planted could never grow, so if you ask me, the Golden Rose in the song must have been a product of people's imagination...

threads.claim: Sabbah's personal wish is to see roses bloom in the sand, echoing the wish-granting rose.
threads.quote: I'm embarrassed to even say it, but that is my wish.

threads.claim: Dendro fertilizer makes roses sprout in sand, confirming Sabbah's belief.
threads.quote: The results were immediate, as I thought... Thank you.

threads.claim: Sabbah is isolated in exile and has few friends to talk to.
threads.quote: To be honest, I don't have a lot of friends to talk to here.

introduced.name: Xudong
introduced.how: Self-introduces as the chef leader of the Gourmet Supremos, travelling to improve cooking
introduced.quote: We're the Gourmet Supremos. We're currently traveling around the world in a quest to improve our culinary skills.

introduced.name: Parvaneh
introduced.how: Scholar travelling with Xudong, whose book is a travelogue from the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Besides, this isn't a dictionary. It's just a travelogue from the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Julie
introduced.how: Mondstadt adventurer who joined the group after helping them chase monsters
introduced.quote: That's when Julie came, and she helped us chase them away.

introduced.name: Kamei Munehisa
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a wandering man passing through the forest after defeating monsters
introduced.quote: I'm Kamei Munehisa, I am just passing by.

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura Bough
introduced.how: A branch of the Thunder Sakura; touching it lets you pass the barrier
introduced.quote: Basically, you need to search for something nearby known as a Thunder Sakura Bough and touch it.

introduced.name: Electrogranum
introduced.how: Attaches to a player after touching a Bough and allows passage through the barrier
introduced.quote: After that, something known as an Electrogranum will attach itself to you, and that will allow you to pass through the barrier.

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: A lightning-struck sakura tree under which special crabs live
introduced.quote: In specific, we're going for the ones that dwell under that Thunder Sakura!

introduced.name: Crab Bait
introduced.how: Lures crabs near a Thunder Sakura when placed
introduced.quote: If you're going to catch crabs over there, use these to attract them first.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)
introduced.how: Shrine where the Sacred Sakura stands, the source of the island's blooms
introduced.quote: This is the Grand Narukami Shrine that Xudong was talking about. Check out that big tree.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: A huge tree at the shrine that Sakura Blooms on the island are said to have fallen from
introduced.quote: Julie says that she also wants to see that Sacred Sakura Tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

introduced.name: Kairagi
introduced.how: Former Shogunate samurai who wander and rob people for a living
introduced.quote: some samurai who have left the Shogunate wander around and rob people on the streets for a living

introduced.name: Inazuma Shogunate
introduced.how: The Inazuma government whose samurai served under it before some left
introduced.quote: Among those... people, are some of my old friends who served with me under the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: Academic institution Parvaneh does field research for
introduced.quote: I was originally doing field research for the Akademiya when I met Xudong in Liyue.

introduced.name: Hanfeng's Ironmongers
introduced.how: Smithy that made Xudong's wok using Chasm materials
introduced.quote: Haha, great question. I had it specially cast at Hanfeng's Ironmongers.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: the nation the travelers have just arrived in by sea, where the story is set
introduced.quote: Xudong: Ah, so this is Sumeru...

introduced.name: Parvaneh
introduced.how: a researcher who has written a paper on a spice and is reporting it to the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Parvaneh: Actually, it's my paper on "Omni-Spice." I've finished it and am about to report to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Omni-Spice
introduced.how: a spice whose formula Parvaneh wrote up in her paper, not yet refined
introduced.quote: Parvaneh: Actually, it's my paper on "Omni-Spice." I've finished it and am about to report to the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Xudong
introduced.how: a chef who started as a restaurant owner in Liyue Harbor and leads the Gourmet Supremos
introduced.quote: Xudong: Yes, I'm a chef... But I started out as a restaurant owner in Liyue Harbor, and I know a trick or two about running a business.

introduced.name: Gourmet Supremos
introduced.how: the group of cooks who make meals with all ingredients and spices, led by Xudong
introduced.quote: Xudong: Hehe, guess what the Gourmet Supremos do best? We make meals with all ingredients and spices...

introduced.name: Divine Tree
introduced.how: a huge tree in Sumeru that holds the Akademiya up
introduced.quote: Julie: Whoa... That's a huge one... Is that the Divine Tree that holds the Akademiya?

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: a research institution where Parvaneh and Farzah work, which Julie has only heard about from guild members
introduced.quote: Julie: That's all right. I've always wanted to go to the Akademiya, but I've only heard about it from people in the guild...

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: the force responsible for defending Sumeru City, named after its thirty founders
introduced.quote: Parvaneh: Stationed here is the Corps of Thirty, responsible for the defense of Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Citadel of Regzar
introduced.how: the Corps of Thirty's base where the guards are stationed
introduced.quote: Yunus: I'm Yunus, a logistics officer of the Corps of Thirty in the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.name: Yunus
introduced.how: a logistics officer of the Corps of Thirty who introduces himself and reports monster trouble
introduced.quote: Yunus: I'm Yunus, a logistics officer of the Corps of Thirty in the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.name: Farzah
introduced.how: Parvaneh's mentor at the Akademiya, who has been eyeing her spice
introduced.quote: Parvaneh: My mentor... No, Farzah's had her eyes on my spice from the start. No wonder she was always so eager to discuss my paper with me...

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: a guild where people take commissions and jobs
introduced.quote: Kamal: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. Anything you're here for?

introduced.name: Kamal
introduced.how: a staff member at the Adventurers' Guild who knows the labor sites
introduced.quote: Kamal: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. Anything you're here for?

introduced.name: Shevirme
introduced.how: a cook at the Grand Bazaar who makes Shawarma Wraps
introduced.quote: Shevirme: Are you kidding me? Of course I do! Six rolls, one for each person, right? Give me a few minutes!

introduced.name: Nabati
introduced.how: a researcher on the human body at Amurta who introduces himself and lives in Vimara Village
introduced.quote: Nabati: Hi there, I'm Nabati. I do research on the human body at Amurta.

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: a village far from the city along the waterway, where only elders and kids remain
introduced.quote: Nabati: Vimara is located in a very convenient spot. It's a key area along the waterway to Sumeru.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: a port where most ships dock and where hard labor like cargo loading is done
introduced.quote: Nabati: And most ships dock at Port Ormos.

introduced.name: Neriman
introduced.how: a port stevedore at Port Ormos who complains about his hard work
introduced.quote: Neriman: *sigh* Life's so hard. Especially when you have to cook for yourself after getting off work.

introduced.name: Caravan Ribat
introduced.how: a village with many menial laborers, where Maryam runs Gilded Journey
introduced.quote: Kamal: Vimara has farmers. Caravan Ribat and Port Ormos have a lot of menial laborers too.

introduced.name: Maryam
introduced.how: the owner of Gilded Journey in Caravan Ribat, who agrees to help promote the spice
introduced.quote: Xudong: Parvaneh said she knows Maryam, owner of Gilded Journey. And she told her about our spice marketing.

introduced.name: Harra Fruit
introduced.how: a fruit that grows on the south side of Sumeru City and is needed for cooking
introduced.quote: Kamei Munehisa: The Harra Fruit Ms. Parvaneh marked on the map... It grows on the south side of Sumeru City. We should search there.

introduced.name: Xudong's Letter
introduced.how: a letter Xudong left with Maryam for the Traveler, delivered in a hurry
introduced.quote: Maryam: Traveler, please wait. Here's a letter for you.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Isn't that what you used to do back in Liyue when you had a problem?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: In fact, the first time I saw it, I thought it must've come from Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Sakura Blooms
assumed.quote: We'd like to get some of the Sakura Blooms inside ourselves, of course.

assumed.name: Inazuma's sudden change
assumed.quote: After Inazuma's sudden change, we all left the Shogunate one after another to make our own living.

assumed.name: Xudong
assumed.quote: Xudong: Traveler, I didn't expect to meet you here!

assumed.name: Kamei Munehisa
assumed.quote: Kamei Munehisa: Hehe, everyone, there's no point staying at the port.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Kamei Munehisa: Hmph... If we were back in Inazuma, I'd let my blade do the talking!

assumed.name: Mondstadt Four Winds
assumed.quote: Julie: Like The Four Winds in Mondstadt. Pretty easy to understand.

assumed.name: Liyue Qixing
assumed.quote: Xudong: It's just like the Liyue Qixing in Liyue...

assumed.name: Tri-Commission
assumed.quote: Kamei Munehisa: Hmm... We have the Tri-Commission in Inazuma.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Parvaneh: Whew... I'm glad he didn't talk to me. I'm afraid of dealing with people from the Eremites...

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Nabati: Why are we doing business with a Fontaine guy...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Nabati: Wait, you're just giving it to me like that? This could sell for a lot of Mora! That Fontaine peddler put a high price on the spice.

threads.claim: Touching a Thunder Sakura Bough attaches an Electrogranum whose effects on the wearer are unclear and possibly unknown.
threads.quote: So, did you feel anything after the Electrogranum attached itself to you?

threads.claim: Electrograna appear to have many uses that puzzle the scholars studying them.
threads.quote: Why do Electrograna have so many uses... how strange...

threads.claim: Lightning around the Thunder Sakura is deadly enough that the bough route is only a rough, risky summary.
threads.quote: But well, you've seen what that tree looks like. I'm not going to risk it based of such a rough summary of a solution.

threads.claim: Kamei Munehisa left the Shogunate because he disagreed with its actions in Inazuma, but the specifics stay unexplained.
threads.quote: I just... couldn't agree with what the Shogunate was doing in Inazuma.

threads.claim: Some sudden upheaval in Inazuma caused many samurai to leave the Shogunate, and its cause is left open.
threads.quote: After Inazuma's sudden change, we all left the Shogunate one after another to make our own living.

threads.claim: The Kairagi were formed from former Shogunate samurai who turned to plundering and recruited others.
threads.quote: Since then, they became the Kairagi as you see them, making a living by plundering.

threads.claim: The Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine is implied to be enormous and is the source of the island's blooms.
threads.quote: They say that all the Sakura Blooms on this island fell from that huge tree.

threads.claim: Xudong frames hunger as a source of terrible acts and believes everyone eating well could prevent them.
threads.quote: I think that if everyone in this world ate well, perhaps, a lot of terrible things could be avoided.

threads.claim: Xudong speaks from personal experience of hunger, deepening the theme that food and morality are linked.
threads.quote: Hunger is a terrible feeling. I've had first-hand experience.

threads.claim: Farzah may have plagiarized Parvaneh's paper to make deals with someone.
threads.quote: Xudong: She explained to us that her paper might have been plagiarized by Farzah to... make some deals with someone.

threads.claim: Julie senses something untrustworthy about Parvaneh's mentor Farzah.
threads.quote: Julie: I don't like that mentor of hers...

threads.claim: Nète seems to be following the group and always one step ahead of them.
threads.quote: Parvaneh: That Nète guy... seems to be exactly where we're going, and he's always one step ahead of us.

threads.claim: Nète proposes to invest in the spice and share profits, revealing his own business motives.
threads.quote: Nète: So here's my offer: I'll invest in your spice and organize resources for the business.

threads.claim: Farzah has built a new project on Parvaneh's paper and made a rival seasoning to sell.
threads.quote: Parvaneh: Now she's developed a whole new project based on my paper, and made another seasoning to sell.

threads.claim: Parvaneh insists her research should be shared freely with anyone in need rather than sold.
threads.quote: Parvaneh: Since I wrote the first word of this paper, I've told you I'll provide the research results to anyone in need for free.

threads.claim: Xudong left a hurried letter behind, hinting that something may have happened to him.
threads.quote: Paimon: Xudong came here... in a hurry? Something must've happened to him, huh.

introduced.name: Tsuyuko
introduced.how: a shrine maiden at Sangonomiya Shrine who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Hello, guests from afar. My name is Tsuyuko, and I am a shrine maiden at the Sangonomiya Shrine. Are you here to help?

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Shrine
introduced.how: a shrine on Watatsumi Island where Tsuyuko serves
introduced.quote: They approach the Sangonomiya Shrine and a shrine maiden named Tsuyuko immediately asks them for help.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: the island where Watatsumi people live and where the quest is set
introduced.quote: During their travels throughout Inazuma, the Traveler and Paimon arrive on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Enkanomiya
introduced.how: a deep underwater place across from the shrine, entrance to the ancient home of the Watatsumi people
introduced.quote: The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya. Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.

introduced.name: Watatsumi people
introduced.how: the islanders whose ancestors came from the underwater Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.

introduced.name: Holy Soil
introduced.how: soil that bleaches and erodes, making land infertile when the island's spirit is pulled toward Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: As a result, our soil is slowly bleaching, becoming Holy Soil.

introduced.name: Goshou Rocks
introduced.how: five barrier nodes on Watatsumi Island that separate it from Enkanomiya and must be broken to enter
introduced.quote: The Goshou Rocks are the five nodes of the barrier that separates Sangonomiya and Enkanomiya.

introduced.name: Jade Coral Branch
introduced.how: a relic left by the Omikami that suppresses the Dragonheir and is needed for the ritual
introduced.quote: We will need to dive down to Enkanomiya and retrieve a Jade Coral Branch left behind by our Omikami, which was used to suppress the Dragonheir of the Depths.

introduced.name: Dragonheir of the Depths
introduced.how: a dragon-like threat that once threatened the ancestors and is kept suppressed below
introduced.quote: That was up until a few thousand years ago, when the Watatsumi Omikami came and defeated the Dragonheir of the Depths and led us back to dry land.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Omikami
introduced.how: a god who defeated the Dragonheir and led the people back to dry land
introduced.quote: That was up until a few thousand years ago, when the Watatsumi Omikami came and defeated the Dragonheir of the Depths and led us back to dry land.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: the underwater nation of the ancestors, later renamed Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: our ancestors from Byakuyakoku relied on the meager light of the Dainichi Mikoshi in order to survive the sharpened claws of the Dragonheir of the Depths.

introduced.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: a light source the ancestors relied on while living in the depths
introduced.quote: our ancestors from Byakuyakoku relied on the meager light of the Dainichi Mikoshi in order to survive the sharpened claws of the Dragonheir of the Depths.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Mitama Omatsuri
introduced.how: a ritual using a Jade Coral Branch to return the sunken spirit and stop Holy Soil erosion
introduced.quote: And at the , we break the barrier, retrieve the Jade Coral Branch, perform the Watatsumi Mitama Omatsuri ritual...

introduced.name: Spirit Pearl
introduced.how: pearls found at the shrines of the four outer seals, needed to unlock the heart seal
introduced.quote: Paimon: We found a pearl. Is this the Spirit Pearl Tsuyuko talked about?

introduced.name: Ancient Stone Tablet
introduced.how: stone tablets near the seals that record ritual matters in worn, cryptic writing
introduced.quote: Near each of the four seals is a stone tablet that records ritual-related matters... But they have stood for many an age, and the handwriting is now barely legible.

introduced.name: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep
introduced.how: a key formed from water that opens the entrance to Enkanomiya
introduced.quote: Thanks to your help, we have the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep in hand.

assumed.name: Divine Priestess
assumed.quote: In addition, due to the current situation, it is difficult for the Divine Priestess to spare time to hold a grand ceremony to break the five seals in time.

assumed.name: Shogun's Army
assumed.quote: For example, the Shogun's Army rallies itself around the god-subduing legends from Narukami.

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: For example, the Shogun's Army rallies itself around the god-subduing legends from Narukami.

assumed.name: Sumeru Akademiya
assumed.quote: But the knowledge I gained at the Akademiya tells me that the spread of Holy Soil is due to Watatsumi Island's geological make-up.

assumed.name: Specters
assumed.quote: Where did these Specters come from? Were they attracted here by the sealed elemental power?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Look like we've found the most pious people on Watatsumi Island, mwahaha!

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Oh no, lots of hilichurls incoming!

threads.claim: Watatsumi Island's soil is bleaching into Holy Soil and could eventually turn the whole island into a desert.
threads.quote: If this continues, Watatsumi Island will one day become a desert as pale as the moonlight.

threads.claim: The depths of Enkanomiya are said to draw the spirit of Watatsumi Island downward, causing the soil to bleach.
threads.quote: According to legend, the depths of Enkanomiya will attempt to absorb the spirit of Watatsumi Island

threads.claim: The Dragonheir of the Depths remains suppressed below and may one day break through the barrier to invade the surface.
threads.quote: the Dragonheir of the Depths may one day break through the barrier and invade Watatsumi on the surface.

threads.claim: The ancestors once lived in the underwater nation Byakuyakoku, which was later renamed Enkanomiya.
threads.quote: And the underwater nation of Byakuyakoku was henceforth named Enkanomiya, in juxtaposition to our new homeland Sangonomiya, which stood high above the ocean surface.

threads.claim: Tsuyuko treats local legends and folklore skeptically, suggesting the official history may not be fully accurate.
threads.quote: I believe that we should look at history and folklore in a critical light.

threads.claim: Tsuyuko offers a geological explanation for Holy Soil that competes with the mythic account.
threads.quote: But the knowledge I gained at the Akademiya tells me that the spread of Holy Soil is due to Watatsumi Island's geological make-up.

threads.claim: The Goshou seals were set on the skeleton of an Omikami envoy to cut the link between Watatsumi and Enkanomiya.
threads.quote: The Omikami has an envoy, and the clergy set a seal upon its skeleton and used its power to break the connection between Watatsumi and Enkanomiya.

threads.claim: The ancient stone tablets contain cryptic, partly illegible inscriptions about the Omikami's envoy and its eyes.
threads.quote: They say that Omikami's envoy had three eyes: one for the 'soul', one a 'mirror', and the last the 'truth'...

threads.claim: Legends say the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep was forged from the spilled blood of the Omikami.
threads.quote: It was forged from the very spilled blood of our Omikami...

threads.claim: Records say the Spirit Pearls and the Key respond only to someone pure of heart, hinting the Traveler is special.
threads.quote: The records do say that the Spirit Pearls will answer the summons of someone pure, and that the Key will only come together for one whose heart is as clear as the waters themselves.

threads.claim: Tsuyuko seems to recognize the Key and is lost in thought, hinting she knows more than she says.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... What is this? Does Tsuyuko recognize it?

threads.claim: The four Spirit Pearls unlock the heart seal, letting the group enter the heart and obtain the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep.
threads.quote: (The seal lights up and disappears)

introduced.name: Electrohammer Vanguard
introduced.how: A dazed Fatui soldier wandering the island, muttering about an insignia
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well... this does worry Paimon a little. Why is this Electrohammer Vanguard here? He isn't up to something bad, is he?

introduced.name: Chevka
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a Fatui member doing signal testing for the machine
introduced.quote: Chevka: My name is Chevka. I was carrying out signal testing work for the machine...

introduced.name: Yakov
introduced.how: Chevka's squadmate; they fought and Yakov threw away the insignia
introduced.quote: Chevka: Oh, yeah, and I was with Yakov. We got into a fight, and that's why he threw the insignia away.

introduced.name: Yakov's father
introduced.how: Yakov's father died on an emergency mission, leaving Yakov alone
introduced.quote: Chevka: He got this badge for completing an emergency mission together with his father, but his father never returned...

introduced.name: Agafya
introduced.how: Revealed as the Mirror Maiden; a Fatui squadmate who gives her name
introduced.quote: Mirror Maiden: Anyway, you want intel? Here's some intel. Agafya. My name's Agafya. That's all I can tell you for now.

introduced.name: Zakhar
introduced.how: A Fatui squadmate; explained as an orphan who joined for free meals
introduced.quote: Agafya: Zakhar is an orphan. His parents died of illness long ago, and it is said that he led a difficult life for a long time.

introduced.name: Researcher Persikov
introduced.how: The researcher who assigned the team to run the signal tests
introduced.quote: Chevka: And... Oh yes. We... we were part of the team assigned by Researcher Persikov to conduct signal tests here.

introduced.name: Old Insignia
introduced.how: Yakov's badge from a mission with his father, which he threw away
introduced.quote: Chevka: Well, that badge belongs to Yakov. He went on this mission once together with his father, but he came back alone.

introduced.name: Silver Pocket Watch
introduced.how: A pocket watch holding a group photo of the Mirror Maiden and her brothers
introduced.quote: Mirror Maiden: This... Ah, this is mine. There's a photo of me and my brothers inside...

introduced.name: Imaging Conch
introduced.how: Conches that project recorded images of past moments
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ooh, so these conches can record images...

introduced.name: Minacious Isle
introduced.how: Named as the large island to the south where conches were scattered
introduced.quote: Paimon: The large island to the south should be Minacious Isle. And as for the northeastern one...

introduced.name: Broken Isle
introduced.how: Named as the northwestern island where one conch was scattered
introduced.quote: Paimon: The northwestern island should be the one from Xinyan's dream, or Broken Isle.

introduced.name: Fatui base camp in the center of the sea
introduced.how: The Fatui team's camp on an island in the middle of the sea
introduced.quote: Chevka: Our base camp is on an island in the center of the sea. Yakov is still delirious, so I must send him there first.

introduced.name: Fatui signal machine
introduced.how: A machine whose signals affected everyone on the island, now shut down
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh right, the machine affected everyone on the island... But it has been shut down...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: What's that Fatui guy muttering about?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: Chevka: Well, I did it to help realize the long-cherished wish of Her Royal Highness the Tsaritsa... and to bring more honor to my family.

assumed.name: Lord Harbingers
assumed.quote: Chevka: If you can open it and help me find Yakov, I will tell you anything you want... Well, I will not speak ill of the Lord Harbingers regardless.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Agafya: What should we do now? If he goes back to Snezhnaya like this, he'll probably be dismissed from the Fatui...

assumed.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
assumed.quote: Paimon: A thing that disappears with you once you walk into it? Is this some kind of Golden Apple Archipelago urban legend?

assumed.name: Mirage
assumed.quote: Traveler: Well, it is being affected by the Mirage...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Chevka: I've heard that one of the Lord Harbingers has learned in Sumeru that

threads.claim: The machine affected Fatui and islanders alike and was said to be shut down, leaving its effects unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh right, the machine affected everyone on the island... But it has been shut down...

threads.claim: Witnesses' memories remain hazy from whatever the machine did to them.
threads.quote: Agafya: But that was quite a while back, and... uhh... My memory's still hazy from whatever it was that huge machine did to me.
