threads.claim: The Mirror Maiden suspects the Fatui experiment erased her memories.
threads.quote: Mirror Maiden: What have you done to me? My...There's a gap in my memories. You didn't perform some weird experiment on me, did you!?

threads.claim: The Mirror Maiden's return to her senses confirms that Persikov's experiment has failed.
threads.quote: Mirror Maiden: I see... But since I came to my senses, it means that Researcher Persikov's experiment has failed.

threads.claim: Yakov's father died on an emergency mission, leaving Yakov alone and unsure of his place.
threads.quote: Chevka: He got this badge for completing an emergency mission together with his father, but his father never returned...

threads.claim: Yakov learns his father stayed behind so he could escape, and that the insignia was sent after his death was confirmed.
threads.quote: Yakov: My father stayed behind so I could get away and return to Snezhnaya. After confirming that he didn't make it, they sent me that insignia...

threads.claim: A force called the Mirage is hinted to be behind the strange effects on conches and the islands.
threads.quote: Traveler: Well, it is being affected by the Mirage...

threads.claim: Chevka notices an island that was not there before, hinting that the islands have changed.
threads.quote: Chevka: I don't remember this being here the last time when we were investigating earlier...

threads.claim: The conch images seem fragmentary, as if something is missing from the recorded scenes.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... it does feel like the snippets it gets are all over the place, though. It's like something's missing.

threads.claim: The Fatui are said to be secretly hunting mysterious Medaka in the archipelago, possibly as a cover story.
threads.quote: Zakhar: Yes, such as "we Fatui are secretly hunting for mysterious Medaka in the Golden Apple Archipelago"!

threads.claim: The Fatui are trained to suppress personal feelings and bonds in favor of duty.
threads.quote: Mirror Maiden: ...Indeed. And that's what they taught us after we joined the Fatui.

threads.claim: Zakhar suggests that friendships can form even between enemies.
threads.quote: Zakhar: But, friends can also be made even from amongst foes, right?

threads.claim: Agafya suggests that family can extend beyond blood ties.
threads.quote: Agafya: No, we just heard your true feelings, Yakov. By mistake, yes, but still... Family sometimes goes beyond blood, you know.

introduced.name: Sea Route Log
introduced.how: a note left by the pirate crew giving directions to the next clue
introduced.quote: The things we left behind remain at the center of this island. We said we would come back to retrieve them, but that's probably not gonna happen...

introduced.name: Captain Night Raven
introduced.how: a sea captain who lives in a cavern and offers a clue in exchange for help
introduced.quote: Captain Night Raven: Tell them about a clue to finding the legendary Secret Pirate Treasure! Although I only know a quarter of it...

introduced.name: Secret Pirate Treasure
introduced.how: a legendary pirate treasure whose location is split into four clues
introduced.quote: Tell them about a clue to finding the legendary Secret Pirate Treasure!

introduced.name: Hilichurls
introduced.how: creatures that have occupied the cavern and must be cleared out
introduced.quote: Captain Night Raven: But then a group of Hilichurls came out of nowhere and occupied my resting place. So I had no choice but to brave the elements out here!

introduced.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
introduced.how: the island group where the four clue islands are located
introduced.quote: That should refer to the reefs on the four islands of the Golden Apple Archipelago.

introduced.name: Sea Fog
introduced.how: fog around an island that must be navigated by following directions
introduced.quote: Captain Night Raven: Alright, I'll tell you how to get through the fog and locate the clue...

introduced.name: A Complete Chart of Ako's Treasure
introduced.how: a chart of four circles whose overlap marks where the treasure is hidden
introduced.quote: (Show A Complete Chart of Ako's Treasure)

assumed.name: Ako Domeki
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh, it seems like "Ako Domeki and company" were the ones who left this picture behind. Feels like we've heard that one before, y'know?

assumed.name: The machine
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah! Didn't those only appear because of the machine? Could they really have hidden this treasure, then?

assumed.name: Pudding Isle
assumed.quote: Traveler: Not to mention the mountains on Pudding Isle...

threads.claim: Ako Domeki and his crew left a treasure split into four clues that must be pieced together.
threads.quote: Paimon: So they split something into four parts, huh?

threads.claim: A machine seems to have made the mountains and the raven appear, casting doubt on when the treasure was hidden.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yeah! Didn't those only appear because of the machine? Could they really have hidden this treasure, then?

threads.claim: Pirates who bury treasure may wish for it to be found by people later on.
threads.quote: Captain Night Raven: Ah, you know... All those who bury their treasure wish for it to be found by people later on.

threads.claim: The treasure itself may have wanted to be found, which could explain its odd hiding place.
threads.quote: Traveler: Perhaps the treasure itself wanted to be found...

threads.claim: The chart's overlap point leads to a bubble that reveals stairs and a Luxurious Chest holding the pirates' treasure.
threads.quote: (Open the Luxurious Chest)

introduced.name: Canon
introduced.how: a Moon being who was born to preserve the world and answers human pleas
introduced.quote: Canon: We were born to preserve the world.

introduced.name: Aria
introduced.how: a Moon being who greets Canon and teases him about his human form
introduced.quote: Aria: Hehe, you look just like I thought you might, Canon.

introduced.name: Sonnet
introduced.how: a sister who sneaks off to play with people on the surface
introduced.quote: Sonnet: Sisters, shouldn't the first thing we do after shaping these bodies for ourselves be to sneak out and play with the people on the surface?

introduced.name: Istaroth
introduced.how: a servant of a Descender who discussed the world's gravitational potential with Canon
introduced.quote: Canon: That Descender's servant said they had matters to discuss with me about this world's gravitational potential and metric tensor.

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: the new Moon Envoy who helps Sonnet with her work
introduced.quote: Aria: Zibai. Her name is Zibai. You really should remember people's names.

introduced.name: Euthyphro
introduced.how: the narrator of the Chanson of the Boatman, from the holy city of Arcadia
introduced.quote: -->I am Euthyphro, hailing from Arcadia, the eternal holy city.

introduced.name: Arcadia
introduced.how: an eternal holy city
introduced.quote: -->I am Euthyphro, hailing from Arcadia, the eternal holy city.

introduced.name: Prusmene
introduced.how: a goddess, mistress of the Golden Hall, mother of night and daughter who brings light
introduced.quote: -->O wondrous Prusmene — ancient mother of the night and daughter who brings the light, mistress of the Golden Hall!

introduced.name: Primordial One
introduced.how: an eternal lord on the heavenly throne that forges the bones of the earth and seeks to shroud man's dreams
introduced.quote: -->For there sits the eternal throne in the heavens, the Primordial One,

introduced.name: Lunar palace
introduced.how: a palace above the clouds where guided souls are ushered
introduced.quote: -->Countless times hast thou guided my vessel, permitting me to usher unsullied souls unto the lunar palace above the clouds.

introduced.name: Unmanned Vessel
introduced.how: a ship that approaches the Traveler and holds a scene inside the Moonheart Gap
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? What's that over there... a ship? Why is it here?

assumed.name: Descender
assumed.quote: Aria: And perhaps it's just my imagination, but I have a certain... feeling about how she views that Descender...

assumed.name: Moon Envoys
assumed.quote: Sonnet: Wh—What's the big deal! We can just leave the work to those Moon Envoys anyway, right?

assumed.name: King
assumed.quote: Sonnet: If our King were still here—

assumed.name: Sea of stars
assumed.quote: Aria: Yes. After all, he did say that all life across the sea of stars are allies. They fight alongside us against the darkness.

assumed.name: Frost Moon
assumed.quote: Aria: But I wasn't talking about that. I mean, I didn't expect you, the "Frost Moon," to have such a sentimental side. It's endearing.

assumed.name: Edict Module
assumed.quote: (Interact with the Edict Module after arriving at the Golden Hall, optional)

assumed.name: Moonheart Gap
assumed.quote: (A scene inside the Moonheart Gap starts playing)

assumed.name: Ancient Moon's Remnant
assumed.quote: (Ride the lift in the Ancient Moon's Remnant structure at Nuur Stone Circle downwards and go toward the Teleport Waypoint)

threads.claim: Canon once called an outsider bad news, and Sonnet suggests the outsider should not have been let in.
threads.quote: Sonnet: I still think you two shouldn't have let that outsider in, but the people on the surface...

threads.claim: The Primordial One is described as seeking to bring all dreams back to the earth and shroud human dreams.
threads.quote: -->It bids all dreams return to the earth, and all dreamless things to return to the earth.

threads.claim: Aria suspects Istaroth views her Descender with a special feeling, and Canon promises to watch.
threads.quote: Aria: And perhaps it's just my imagination, but I have a certain... feeling about how she views that Descender...

threads.claim: The Moon beings' mission is to preserve the world until their King returns from afar.
threads.quote: Aria: Our mission is solely to preserve this world until our King, who granted us life, returns from afar.

threads.claim: Canon has been secretly joining human festivals and dancing before a statue of herself, which breaks from the Moon beings' duties.
threads.quote: Aria: Is pretending to be an ordinary human girl and dancing in front of your own statue also one of your duties? That's news to me.

threads.claim: Aria accepts a costly order as the only way to save the doomed world, while Sonnet and Canon question the tyrant's cruelty.
threads.quote: Aria: If that far-from-omnipotent ruler believes this pale, horrifying fate to be "order," if this is the only way to save this doomed world from being devoured, then...

threads.claim: The Moon beings fight against a darkness that threatens all life, and Sonnet questions whether fighting it is pointless.
threads.quote: Sonnet: If the world is destined for destruction... What's the point of fighting the darkness?

threads.claim: Sonnet is torn over the cost of order and wants to save both dragons and humans from the tyrant.
threads.quote: Sonnet: Shouldn't we... save them?

threads.claim: Istaroth taught Canon that hope is a word only humans may claim, and Canon affirms that hope always remains while life exists.
threads.quote: Canon: Istaroth told me of a word that only humans may lay claim to... "hope."

introduced.name: Momoyo
introduced.how: Gendou Ringo's new codename; a Shuumatsuban ninja running the safehouse operation
introduced.quote: so use my new codename

introduced.name: Buzuleac
introduced.how: undercover Fatui merchant from Sumeru doing business in Ritou
introduced.quote: My name is Buzuleac, a merchant from Sumeru.

introduced.name: Fujita
introduced.how: undercover Fatui spy waiting on a rooftop who speaks in code
introduced.quote: Did you see someone on the roof?

introduced.name: Mikawa Akane
introduced.how: manager of the Royal Hot Springs who employs the Fatui spy Tae
introduced.quote: I took my eyes off her for a moment, and now she's gone

introduced.name: Tae
introduced.how: undercover Fatui spy working at the Royal Hot Springs who resents Lyudochka
introduced.quote: Did that Mikawa Akane send you?

introduced.name: Efim Snezhevich
introduced.how: the Teacher, a Fatui leader who pressures Lyudochka and gives her final instructions
introduced.quote: Enough, Lyudochka. I tire of your delaying tactics.

introduced.name: Lyudochka Snezhevna
introduced.how: Fatui agent posing as a shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine under a fake identity
introduced.quote: I just know that she's infiltrated the Grand Narukami Shrine atop Mt. Yougou.

introduced.name: Riku
introduced.how: local who saw the shrine maiden turn purple and fly away near the shrine
introduced.quote: Ah, an outlander! Hello!

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: undercover agents operating in Inazuma under different Harbingers
introduced.quote: Recently, we discovered three other undercover Fatui.

introduced.name: Fatui Code Sheet
introduced.how: list of code phrases spies use to recognize each other
introduced.quote: The codes they commonly use are written here.

introduced.name: Fatui codes
introduced.how: the phrase about fellow countrymen who forgot their homeland signals Fatui self-identification
introduced.quote: Fellow countrymen who've forgotten their homeland: Fatui self-identification.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: district where outlanders who look foreign are confined to live
introduced.quote: Those who look like outlanders no matter how you slice it, like me, can only stay here in Ritou.

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.how: shrine on Mt. Yougou where the Fatui agent poses as a shrine maiden
introduced.quote: I saw a shrine maiden lady walk over there

introduced.name: Royal Hot Springs
introduced.how: hot spring workplace in Inazuma where the spy Tae works
introduced.quote: She apparently just started working at the Royal Hot Springs.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: island the Fatui plan to poison to stir conflict with the Shogunate
introduced.quote: The Teacher has ordered me and several others to enter Watatsumi Island and poison the land

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: publisher with a bookstore and a back-room hideout for proofreaders
introduced.quote: I once worked at Yae Publishing House as a proofreader for new novel releases under a pseudonym.

introduced.name: Lady Arlecchino's orphanage
introduced.how: orphanage where the Fatui orphans were raised
introduced.quote: We grew up in an orphanage set up by Lady Arlecchino.

introduced.name: Snezhevich and Snezhevna
introduced.how: surnames the Fatui give to orphans they take in
introduced.quote: surnames the Fatui give to orphans they take in, like us.

introduced.name: A Note Someone Stuffed You
introduced.how: a picture-coded note slipped to the Traveler, pointing to the Shuumatsuban safehouse
introduced.quote: I think it might be depicting some other things.

introduced.name: Special Bamboo Slip
introduced.how: a bamboo slip dusted with Shuumatsuban elemental powder for tracking a target
introduced.quote: This is no ordinary Bamboo Slip.

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: lets the player see the traces left by elemental powder
introduced.quote: You can use Elemental Sight to see the traces left by the powder.

introduced.name: Special Fortune Slip
introduced.how: fortune slip drawn from a box and read out by Gendou Ringo
introduced.quote: Are you here to decipher your fortune slip today?

introduced.name: Lyudochka Snezhevna
introduced.how: A Fatui agent trained in spycraft who posed as a shrine maiden in Inazuma and is now abandoning that life
introduced.quote: I was a Fatui, you know? We threatened Inazuma's safety!

introduced.name: Gendou Ringo
introduced.how: A new name Momoyo invented for Lyudochka to use going forward
introduced.quote: Momoyo: I gave it to myself on a whim, but turns out that it fits her decently well, don't you think?

introduced.name: Touyama
introduced.how: Lyudochka's pseudonym while proofreading at Yae Publishing House
introduced.quote: Traveler: (That should be Lyudochka's pseudonym.)

introduced.name: Teacher
introduced.how: The Fatui leader behind the Watatsumi poison plot, who was recalled to Snezhnaya and acts independently
introduced.quote: I heard that the Teacher was summoned back to Snezhnaya, but that the Watatsumi Island operation is still going ahead.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: A planned Fatui operation to poison Watatsumi Island that Momoyo's side must stop
introduced.quote: First, we need to wipe out those Fatui who are planning to plant poison on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Elemental powder
introduced.how: A poisonous powder that leaves a visible trail, used to mark locations
introduced.quote: Momoyo must've used the elemental powder to show us her location.

introduced.name: Lyudochka's Letter
introduced.how: A farewell letter in which Lyudochka confesses she impersonated Momoyo and wants to leave Inazuma
introduced.quote: Paimon: She left us a letter!

introduced.name: Lyudochka's Mora Purse
introduced.how: Lyudochka's savings left as a gift for Paimon, the Traveler and Momoyo
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ms. Lyudochka says... she's leaving. And she's left a sum of Mora for us and Momoyo.

introduced.name: Fortune Slip
introduced.how: A fortune slip from the Grand Narukami Shrine given to Lyudochka as a parting gift
introduced.quote: This is... a Fortune Slip from the Grand Narukami Shrine?

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine (Faction)
introduced.how: The shrine where Lyudochka worked as a shrine maiden and where Momoyo plans to send word to the Shuumatsuban
introduced.quote: I'll just have to go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and get someone to pass a message to the Shuumatsuban.

introduced.name: Shuumatsuban
introduced.how: The ninja organization Momoyo belongs to, which took her in as an orphan
introduced.quote: ...Momoka, it was you who took me in and allowed me to join the Shuumatsuban back when I was an orphan.

introduced.name: Momoka
introduced.how: A Shuumatsuban figure who took in Momoyo as an orphan and let her join the organization
introduced.quote: ...Momoka, it was you who took me in and allowed me to join the Shuumatsuban back when I was an orphan.

introduced.name: Sayu
introduced.how: A Shuumatsuban ninja who passes Momoyo's intel to the organization and knows the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Momoyo: Some shortie named Sayu. She told me that she knows you two.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: The publishing house where Lyudochka worked as a proofreader under a pseudonym
introduced.quote: Let's ask the Yae Publishing House employees. They might know a thing or two.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: A harbor where Lyudochka would likely try to leave Inazuma
introduced.quote: She'll probably be looking for a way to get out through Ritou. Best to look for her there.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: The shrine head who knew Lyudochka was an impostor yet wanted her to serve at the shrine
introduced.quote: Paimon: She knew that you were an impostor the whole time, but she also thinks that you'd be suited to working at the shrine!

assumed.name: Gendou Ringo
assumed.quote: Ms. Gendou did say that she'd contact us if something new came up.

assumed.name: Shuumatsuban
assumed.quote: It's the "Shuumatsuban"!

assumed.name: Lady Arlecchino
assumed.quote: My patience is limited, as is that of Lady Arlecchino.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: He must mean Signora.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: What, are you from the Tenryou Commission, then?

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: They're with the Shogunate.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: after the recent abolition of the Vision Hunt Decree

assumed.name: Mondstadt and Liyue
assumed.quote: famed for their deeds in Mondstadt and Liyue

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: depending on which Harbinger they're under

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's the Fatui? What are they doing here!?

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: use your Elemental Sight, quick!

assumed.name: Elemental powder used last time
assumed.quote: Is that the elemental powder we used the last time?

assumed.name: Court of Flowing Sand
assumed.quote: (Upon reaching the waterfall next to the Court of Flowing Sand)

assumed.name: Araumi
assumed.quote: (Upon reaching Araumi)

assumed.name: Arlecchino
assumed.quote: He didn't report this operation to Lady Arlecchino, did he?

assumed.name: Fatui Code Sheet
assumed.quote: She also said that she would've tried harder if she knew that you were going to use that code sheet.

threads.claim: The Gendou Ringo the Traveler knows may have been replaced by someone who looks different.
threads.quote: Uh, Ms. Gendou, you look really different from before

threads.claim: A witness saw the shrine maiden turn purple and fly away, hinting at how the fake disguise works.
threads.quote: and then turn all purple, like, fwoosh! Then she flew away!

threads.claim: Momoyo confirms the shrine's Gendou was a fake who replaced her, and the impostor is revealed as Lyudochka.
threads.quote: That woman replaced me, you know?

threads.claim: Momoyo suspects the fake Gendou infiltrated the shrine to target the Shuumatsuban.
threads.quote: I guessed previously that the fake Gendou infiltrated the Shrine

threads.claim: Lady Arlecchino commands great authority over the Fatui and the orphans raised under her care.
threads.quote: My patience is limited, as is that of Lady Arlecchino.

threads.claim: Lady Signora may have died in Inazuma, and the Fatui intend to use that loss.
threads.quote: Lady Signora may have met her end here in Inazuma

threads.claim: The Fatui plan to poison Watatsumi Island to provoke conflict between the Shogunate and Watatsumi.
threads.quote: The Teacher has ordered me and several others to enter Watatsumi Island and poison the land

threads.claim: Fatui orphans are raised by the Fatui and given Snezhevich or Snezhevna surnames.
threads.quote: surnames the Fatui give to orphans they take in, like us.

threads.claim: Fatui operations differ depending on which Harbinger they serve.
threads.quote: depending on which Harbinger they're under

threads.claim: Fatui spies identify each other with code phrases that the Traveler must learn to use correctly.
threads.quote: Fellow countrymen who've forgotten their homeland: Fatui self-identification.

threads.claim: A recent ceasefire between the Shogunate and Watatsumi Island makes the Fatui's plan look questionable.
threads.quote: the Shogunate and Watatsumi Island have reached a ceasefire

threads.claim: Lyudochka, a Fatui agent, does not want the poisoning plan carried out and asks for help.
threads.quote: I don't want to see such a thing happen!

threads.claim: Lyudochka is a Fatui spy who has never lived an ordinary life and doubts she deserves to belong anywhere.
threads.quote: I do not know if someone as steeped in darkness as myself has the right to return to walk in the light...

threads.claim: Lyudochka decides to stay in Inazuma and take up the name Gendou Ringo as a real shrine maiden.
threads.quote: I will take up this name. I will become the real "Gendou Ringo."

threads.claim: The Teacher has left Inazuma, and Momoyo vows to stop him if he ever returns.
threads.quote: However, their Teacher appears to have left Inazuma. Hmph. If he ever dares to return, I'll make sure he never leaves again.

threads.claim: The Fatui plan to poison Watatsumi Island is still going ahead despite the Teacher's recall.
threads.quote: I heard that the Teacher was summoned back to Snezhnaya, but that the Watatsumi Island operation is still going ahead.

threads.claim: Momoyo and the Traveler's side staged Lyudochka's death to deceive the Fatui.
threads.quote: Paimon: So... You mean you didn't flee from the safehouse because you wanted them to believe that Lyudochka was dead?

threads.claim: Momoyo lost one eye when Fatui shot the elemental powder box, and she accepts the injury as the cost of the deception.
threads.quote: Momoyo: Heh. When I was going for the elemental powder box, some Fatui shot the box and broke it.

threads.claim: Momoyo's elemental powder trail reveals her location, answering the question of where she was taken.
threads.quote: Momoyo must've used the elemental powder to show us her location.

threads.claim: The Fortune Slip's prophecy that one day Lyudochka will become what she hopes to be is fulfilled by her choice to stay.
threads.quote: One day, you will become what you hope to be.

threads.claim: Momoyo relays intelligence to the Shuumatsuban through Sayu, and the Shuumatsuban ninja network carries the news forward.
threads.quote: Someone is helping me pass the intel to the Shuumatsuban. Don't you worry.

introduced.name: Pahsiv
introduced.how: a Melusine who speaks in broken fragments and is named by Paimon after she fails to answer clearly
introduced.quote: Paimon: Anyway, Paimon's decided to call you Pahsiv. Is that okay?

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: a people Paimon thinks all live in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village
introduced.quote: And Paimon thought Melusine all lived in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: a place where Melusine are believed to live
introduced.quote: And Paimon thought Melusine all lived in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village.

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: a village where Melusine are believed to live
introduced.quote: Traveler: But don't the Melusine live in Merusea Village?

introduced.name: Erinnyes
introduced.how: an island that is being corrupted and that Pahsiv wants protected
introduced.quote: Paimon didn't know how we could punch Erinnyes, with it being a whole island and all...

introduced.name: Foggy Forest Path
introduced.how: a foggy forest path to the south where one Teardrop Key is hidden
introduced.quote: Paimon: Look! It's super foggy over there. Is that the Foggy Forest Path? Let's go investigate!

introduced.name: Teardrop Key
introduced.how: drop-shaped keys that Pahsiv needs collected and placed in statues to open a door
introduced.quote: This version is obtained if the player has no Teardrop Keys.

introduced.name: Mysterious Altar
introduced.how: an altar with scratched inscriptions that holds a key and can be activated
introduced.quote: (Interact with the Mysterious Altar)

introduced.name: New Valet
introduced.how: a figure who teaches Pahsiv and runs an information network through Erinnyes that can sense evil
introduced.quote: Paimon: Are you saying that all of Erinnyes is New Valet's information system? And New Valet can sense something bad?

introduced.name: Water vein
introduced.how: channels through Erinnyes that carry information for New Valet
introduced.quote: Pahsiv: Information, water vein, lots of.

introduced.name: Vishap
introduced.how: a blue dragon-like creature that sleeps by the altar and later helps against the Rifthounds
introduced.quote: Paimon: Look out! There's a vishap by the altar! It seems to be sleeping, but we should be careful...

introduced.name: Purple thing
introduced.how: an unseen enemy that steals keys and sneaks toward the root to destroy it
introduced.quote: Pahsiv: Purple thing, sneaking toward the root. Purple thing, secretly destroying the root.

introduced.name: Roots of Erinnyes
introduced.how: underground roots of the great tree that have been corrupted and must be cleansed
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon gets it now! That's why the great tree looked so sickly. The roots have been corrupted!

introduced.name: Keratry
introduced.how: a young magician who thinks his brother made a hole in the fountain with magic
introduced.quote: Keratry: Brother! Look! There seems to be a hole in the fountain. Was that your magic?

introduced.name: Remaudiere
introduced.how: Keratry's brother, who claims to have made the hole in the fountain with magic
introduced.quote: Remaudiere: ...Uh... Yes, that's right! That was your brother's magic, indeed. Awesome, right?

assumed.name: Teleport Waypoint
assumed.quote: (Read the Carved Stone Tablet on the left-hand fountain statue when approaching from the Marcotte Station Teleport Waypoint, optional)

assumed.name: Demon King
assumed.quote: Traveler: Maybe it is key to containing the Demon King.

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Keratry: Yup! I didn't think you'd have a trick that's as good as the Great Magician Lyney's!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: You didn't find any Mora? That's fine. The chest is more than enough!

threads.claim: The water-drop key may be needed to contain the Demon King, hinting at a larger threat.
threads.quote: Traveler: Maybe it is key to containing the Demon King.

threads.claim: Some Melusine seem to be born outside Merusea Village and the Court of Fontaine, raising an open question about where they come from.
threads.quote: Paimon: Yes, that's kinda strange. Are some Melusine born elsewhere? Paimon can't see any others here though.

threads.claim: Something bad is happening to Erinnyes and Pahsiv wants it protected, but the threat is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Paimon: So, something bad is happening to Erinnyes, and you want to protect it?

threads.claim: A figure called New Valet is teaching Pahsiv and seems to be a central, mysterious presence.
threads.quote: Paimon: New... Valet? There's a valet? Who?

threads.claim: New Valet appears to run an information system across Erinnyes that senses evil through water veins.
threads.quote: Paimon: Are you saying that all of Erinnyes is New Valet's information system? And New Valet can sense something bad?

threads.claim: An unseen purple enemy is stealing keys and sneaking toward the root to destroy it.
threads.quote: Pahsiv: Purple thing, sneaking toward the root. Purple thing, secretly destroying the root.

threads.claim: The corruption of the great tree's roots is revealed as the cause of its sickly state.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon gets it now! That's why the great tree looked so sickly. The roots have been corrupted!

threads.claim: Pahsiv admits she scratched out the stone tablet inscriptions, answering who erased the writing.
threads.quote: Paimon: So you're the one that removed the writing from the stone tablet! Was it to stop the purple thing?

threads.claim: The vishap seems to be a protector that helps Pahsiv, hinting at a bond between them.
threads.quote: Pahsiv: Blue thing, good thing, key, protect.

threads.claim: Pahsiv behaves unlike an ordinary Melusine and vanishes suddenly, so her true nature remains a mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wow! Paimon has never seen a Melusine like her. Or rather... She doesn't behave like a Melusine, but more like a wild fairy.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild contact who issues commissions
introduced.quote: The Traveler talks to Katheryne of Inazuma's Adventurers' Guild and receives a new commission.

introduced.name: Sumida
introduced.how: novelist who commissions the Traveler and gives her name
introduced.quote: Sumida: My name's Sumida. As for my pen name... I haven't finished thinking about it yet.

introduced.name: Kama
introduced.how: ferryman who can take travelers to Tsurumi Island
introduced.quote: According to Sumida, there is someone named Kama who can take the Traveler to Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Tsurumi Island
introduced.how: fog-shrouded island to the south of Narukami Island
introduced.quote: Sumida: It is an island to the distant south of Narukami Island, shrouded in a perpetual veil of fog.

introduced.name: Maushiro
introduced.how: traditional instrument of Tsurumi's lost civilization, sought by Sumida
introduced.quote: This is a traditional instrument of the civilization native to the island, which has been lost for several millennia now.

introduced.name: Ruu
introduced.how: island child who says he is thousands of years old
introduced.quote: Ruu: My name's Ruu!

introduced.name: Makiri
introduced.how: islander who helps make offerings at the Perch
introduced.quote: Let me introduce you to Big Sister Makiri and Big Brother Ipe.

introduced.name: Ipe
introduced.how: islander who explains the Perch rites and feathers
introduced.quote: Ipe: Oh come on, less talking, more offering.

introduced.name: Mata
introduced.how: priest who leads the ceremony
introduced.quote: Mata: Ah, when will we be ready to hold the ceremony?

introduced.name: Ku
introduced.how: islander with a sprained ankle who asks for help with a Perch
introduced.quote: Big Brother Ku's hurt again. Could you please help us make offerings at the Perch?

introduced.name: Perch
introduced.how: sacred tree where the Thunderbird descended; offerings keep it pure
introduced.quote: Makiri: After all, the Perch is the keystone to the ceremony. This is the tree upon which the Great Thunderbird once descended.

introduced.name: Kapatcir
introduced.how: Ruu's friend, the Thunderbird the ceremony honors
introduced.quote: Ruu: My good friend!

introduced.name: feathers
introduced.how: foreign substances the Perch draws out, then purified by fog
introduced.quote: Ipe: Basically, the power of the Great Thunderbird will accumulate within the Perch, and it will carry off foreign substances that infiltrate Tsurumi Island in the form of "feathers."

introduced.name: Sea of Fog
introduced.how: fog the Great Thunderbird made to shield the island from darkness
introduced.quote: Kito: To protect Tsurumi Island, the Great Thunderbird created the great Sea of Fog such that even the darkness would lose its way and become unable to enter the island.

introduced.name: Kino's Travels
introduced.how: novel about an outlander drifting through strange lands, Sumida's model
introduced.quote: Sumida: In which an outlander named Kino who doesn't quite fit in anywhere strides across many strange lands.

introduced.name: Tsurumi Island
introduced.how: island that is the subject of the commission, said to have been destroyed long ago
introduced.quote: Sumida: Right. Let's get to the point. The reason I've asked everyone to gather here is to exchange information about Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Sumida
introduced.how: writer who commissioned the Traveler to find a Maushiro for her novel
introduced.quote: Sumida: The Maushiro... It's the key to writing "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)"

introduced.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
introduced.how: detective agency run by Sango that takes on cases of all sorts
introduced.quote: Sango: Of course, I am Sango of Bantan Sango Detective Agency, after all. If you wish to take on matters of all sorts, then you must have knowledge of all sorts.

introduced.name: Ryuuji
introduced.how: associate of Sango's detective agency who works on her cases
introduced.quote: Ryuuji: There it is. No. 7 of the lines that President Sango wishes she could say someday.

introduced.name: Roald
introduced.how: forgetful adventurer who was hired to find the Maushiro and went to the island
introduced.quote: Roald: Well, here's what I experienced.

introduced.name: Kama
introduced.how: boatman who secretly ferries people past checkpoints to Tsurumi Island
introduced.quote: Roald: I had my doubts when I boarded Kama's boat, but as it turned out, he was actually able to avoid detection and bring me safely to the island after all.

introduced.name: Ruu
introduced.how: friendly child living on Tsurumi Island who meets outsiders
introduced.quote: Roald: I took Kama's advice and walked through a large gateway into the fog... and I met a friendly child.

introduced.name: Thunderbird
introduced.how: monstrous bird of thunder that was slain long ago and is worshiped by the islanders
introduced.quote: Sango: The monstrous bird of thunder was slain by the Electro Archon upon Amakumo Peak in Seirai Island.

introduced.name: Maushiro
introduced.how: instrument whose sound guides people through fog; man-made versions lack the original's power
introduced.quote: Ruu: Man-made Maushiro do not have this kind of power, but since this is the "original form" of such Maushiro, it should have some special abilities.

introduced.name: Peculiar Pinion
introduced.how: Thunderbird feather that glows and may have special powers
introduced.quote: (The Peculiar Pinion lights up)

introduced.name: Mysterious Carving
introduced.how: Thunderbird statues that the feather can activate
introduced.quote: Paimon: These statues are all over the place. Is there some other meaning behind them...?

introduced.name: Ishine Script
introduced.how: priestly writing of Tsurumi Island passed down only through priestly families
introduced.quote: "Ipe": But when you grow up, you've got to teach me the secret of the Ishine Script.

introduced.name: Mata
introduced.how: Eminent Priest who leads the island's Thunderbird ceremony
introduced.quote: Chise: Eminent Priest, Ruu has yet to arrive.

introduced.name: Ipe
introduced.how: fisherman and priest's family member who teaches Ruu and knows Ishine Script
introduced.quote: "Ipe": ...Oh, this? Well, the secret to fishing is patience.

introduced.name: Sayo
introduced.how: outspoken islander who wants to leave the Sea of Fog and see the outside world
introduced.quote: "Sayo": I've seen people come in from the outside.

introduced.name: Kito
introduced.how: child of Tsurumi Island who makes guesses about the murals and doubts the Thunderbird legend
introduced.quote: Kito: These murals depict a time before the Sea of Fog.

introduced.name: Kina
introduced.how: child of Tsurumi Island who teases and joins Kito's guesses
introduced.quote: Kina: Hah, it's time for Big Brother Kito's wild guesses!

introduced.name: Abe
introduced.how: islander who gathers Fluorescent Fungus and speaks with Una about Kama's family
introduced.quote: Abe: Hey now, the Fluorescent Fungus are the good stuff, alright?

introduced.name: Una
introduced.how: elderly islander who pities Kama and talks with Abe
introduced.quote: Una: Why, I can barely tell Kito and Kina apart at this point.

introduced.name: Chise
introduced.how: priest who helps Mata with ceremony preparations and recalls Kama's fate
introduced.quote: Chise: Forgive my forwardness, but I do not think these are places where a child should go...

introduced.name: Fog
introduced.how: thick fog covering Tsurumi Island that confuses travelers and may affect memory
introduced.quote: Sumida: Could it be that the fog that shrouds the island found its way into Ryuuji's head after he breathed too much of it in?

introduced.name: Fluorescent Fungus
introduced.how: mushroom said to improve memory and eyesight
introduced.quote: Roald: And one of my goals for coming to Tsurumi Island was to collect something known as Florescent Fungi.

introduced.name: murals
introduced.how: ancient cave paintings on Tsurumi Island that the Traveler photographs
introduced.quote: Roald: If you find those legendary murals, take as many clear pictures of them as you can.

introduced.name: Mt. Kanna
introduced.how: hollow mountain from which the Thunderbird took flight
introduced.quote: Then, the Thunderbird, like a blazing violet comet, took flight from the hollow Mt. Kanna.

introduced.name: Autake Plains
introduced.how: area where Ruu encountered the Great Thunderbird and where the fog is thickest
introduced.quote: Chise: It was at Autake Plains that Ruu encountered the Great Thunderbird, wasn't it?

introduced.name: Ghost Maushiro
introduced.how: fake Maushiro given to past commission takers instead of the real one
introduced.quote: Sumida: So those who took the commission in the past could not retrieve the Maushiro because they received a fake "Ghost Maushiro" instead.

introduced.name: Kama
introduced.how: Sumida's boatman, revealed as a descendant of Tsurumi Island's natives who keeps a family oral history
introduced.quote: Our ancestor was from Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Tsurumi Island
introduced.how: homeland of Kama's ancestors, now a place of ley line disorder and illusions
introduced.quote: Our ancestor was from Tsurumi Island.

introduced.name: Ruu
introduced.how: a child offered to the Thunderbird who is trapped on Tsurumi Island
introduced.quote: However, there is one exception, which is the child who was the offering to the Thunderbird.

introduced.name: Thunderbird
introduced.how: the island's guardian deity, also called Kapatcir, whose power destroyed Tsurumi Island
introduced.quote: Other people call her the Thunderbird. She's our guardian deity.

introduced.name: Sea of Fog
introduced.how: a fog where illusions of past events replay and the flow of time is wrong
introduced.quote: Apparitions of the past would appear amidst the Sea of Fog, illusions replaying past events

introduced.name: ley line disorder
introduced.how: the cause given for the island's illusions and unnatural occurrences
introduced.quote: They must be the result large-scale ley line disorder.

introduced.name: ceremony
introduced.how: a final ceremony on Tsurumi Island that is replayed in illusions and offers a sacrifice to the Thunderbird
introduced.quote: namely, the final ceremony held on the island, albeit one in which the flow of time is all wrong.

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: where Kama's ancestors settled after leaving, and where the Thunderbird was later killed
introduced.quote: My ancestors lived on Seirai Island for a long time.

introduced.name: Mt. Kanna
introduced.how: the Thunderbird's former resting cavern on Tsurumi Island
introduced.quote: Mt. Kanna? It was where the Thunderbird reposed.

introduced.name: Asase Shrine
introduced.how: built to suppress the Thunderbird's power
introduced.quote: Asase Shrine was constructed to suppress the Thunderbird's power, or so I heard,

introduced.name: Koseki Village
introduced.how: built to house people who moved to Seirai to make offerings at the shrine
introduced.quote: while Koseki Village was built to house those who had relocated to Seirai to make offerings at the shrine.

introduced.name: Perch
introduced.how: key ceremony objects holding the Thunderbird's power, which must be tended with offerings
introduced.quote: They said that the Perches are key to the ceremony, and so people need to make offerings there and protect them.

introduced.name: Thunderbird feather
introduced.how: a feather of the Thunderbird that reveals memories and can be used at Mysterious Carvings
introduced.quote: Since Ruu said that it's one of the Thunderbird's feathers, we might get some reaction...

introduced.name: Maushiro
introduced.how: wooden instruments made from Thunderbird feathers that can summon spirits
introduced.quote: So the feathers of the Thunderbird were the basis for the Maushiro, and can summon spirits...

introduced.name: Ishine Script
introduced.how: the script used by Tsurumi's priests to name things, which sounds strange to outsiders
introduced.quote: The people of Tsurumi Island used the Ishine Script, which was handed down through their priestly line, to name things.

introduced.name: Ipe and Makiri
introduced.how: islanders who tend the Perch and make offerings there
introduced.quote: That's Ipe and Makiri. Looks like they're making offerings to the Perch.

introduced.name: Sayo
introduced.how: Kama's companion from the past, who left Tsurumi Island and never returned
introduced.quote: he and Big Sister Sayo never returned.

introduced.name: Amakumo Peak
introduced.how: the Thunderbird's territory on Seirai Island
introduced.quote: That's Amakumo Peak.

introduced.name: Thunder Manifestation
introduced.how: a monster that appears at the altar and is linked to the Thunderbird, like the one on Amakumo Peak
introduced.quote: A—Another monster? Huh... It looks just like the one we saw on Amakumo Peak...

introduced.name: Sumida
introduced.how: an aspiring novelist who gives up writing to travel instead, and who is setting out with Kama
introduced.quote: As such, I've decided to stop writing and start traveling.

introduced.name: The Vagabond Novice: Yamabuki Iro no Houroutan
introduced.how: a novel whose famous closing lines Sumida quotes
introduced.quote: It's the famous closing lines of "The Vagabond Novice: Yamabuki Iro no Houroutan." Well then, , Paimon, let's part ways here.

assumed.name: Fatui Harbingers
assumed.quote: Traveler: Even Fatui Harbingers fall before me.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah, didn't we get that sword from Kaeya that one time?

assumed.name: Seirai Island
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Your deeds on Seirai Island have been reported to me by Miss Eiko. You've done very well.

assumed.name: Flowers for Princess Fischl
assumed.quote: Sumida: Or are you, perhaps, in fact a traveler from "another world," just like the main character in "Flowers for Princess Fischl"?

assumed.name: Light Actuating Ceremony
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's not that different from the Light Actuating Ceremony.

assumed.name: Sumeru's Eremites
assumed.quote: Sumida: Adventurers, veteran soldiers, members of Sumeru's Eremites, students of the Iwakura Art, problem-solving specialists from the Yorozuya...

assumed.name: Dusky Ming
assumed.quote: Paimon: Uhh, Paimon's getting nervous... It's like that time with Dusky Ming...

assumed.name: Makiri
assumed.quote: "Ipe": You wanna sing for Makiri? Sure, but I mean, why d'you need to ask me?

assumed.name: Kapatcir
assumed.quote: Ruu: I've made an agreement with Kapatcir that I'll go see her soon.

assumed.name: Amakumo Peak
assumed.quote: Traveler: Back at Amakumo Peak...

assumed.name: Electro Seelie
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yikes! This... is an Electro Seelie, right? Let's follow it and see what we might find.

assumed.name: bake-danuki
assumed.quote: Paimon: We've met bake-danuki on the other islands before...

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Roald: Hmm. Ah, yes. I do believe that you have a Fontaine-built Kamera with you, right?

assumed.name: Sumida
assumed.quote: Kama: You've already helped Lady Sumida find the Maushiro, so there is no need for any further association between us.

assumed.name: Maushiro commission
assumed.quote: Actually, Miss Sumida's commission isn't over yet.

assumed.name: Kiminami Restaurant
assumed.quote: didn't we agree to go have a good meal at Kiminami Restaurant once we finish this commission?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: When I heard Miss Katheryne describe your adventures, I thought to myself...

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: It's a skill I picked up while dodging the people from the Shogunate.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: It's gotta be because this is the Electro Archon's territory, huh?

assumed.name: Celestia
assumed.quote: Maybe it was a fragment of Celestia, or something...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: We know a young lady your age in Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius...

assumed.name: Kama
assumed.quote: Traveler: Kama's... really changed...

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: We don't know where we're going, nor do we know when we'll return to Inazuma.

assumed.name: Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: become a writer contracted by Yae Publishing House!

threads.claim: The Maushiro the Traveler recovered disappears, and everyone who took the commission had the same problem.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's gone.

threads.claim: Many other adventurers and groups tried Sumida's commission and failed to bring back a Maushiro.
threads.quote: Sumida: Adventurers, veteran soldiers, members of Sumeru's Eremites, students of the Iwakura Art, problem-solving specialists from the Yorozuya...

threads.claim: Tsurumi Island's civilization supposedly vanished millennia ago, yet a child there claims to be thousands of years old.
threads.quote: Paimon: (Hold it just a minute there. Didn't Sumida say that Tsurumi Island's civilization has vanished for several millennia now?)

threads.claim: The islanders count years by thunder, and Ruu's age and sense of time do not match the outside world.
threads.quote: Ruu: Hmm. A year passes whenever I hear the thunder, of course. Just like everyone counts it.

threads.claim: The islanders act oddly, and the people at the ceremonial site keep vanishing.
threads.quote: Paimon: There should've been more people here, but it looks like all of them have vanished...

threads.claim: The fog protects the island from the darkness outside, and leaving it is said to lose one's soul.
threads.quote: Ruu: They always tell us that our souls will become lost if we leave the fog, and that the fog protects us from the darkness outside.

threads.claim: Islanders have long wanted to leave, and Ruu suspects the Sea of Silence beyond the fog is inhabited.
threads.quote: Ruu: I never knew that there were so many places outside the Sea of Fog. If I leave someday, I'd love to see all of them!

threads.claim: Earlier islanders who tried to leave the fog never returned, and the Kama family is linked to that loss.
threads.quote: Una: There were those who tried to leave this place and follow the Great Thunderbird's light to seek new lands. None of them returned alive.

threads.claim: Monsters have appeared on the island that were not there in the past, and they may have come from outside the fog.
threads.quote: Ruu: Maybe they came in from outside the Sea of Fog...

threads.claim: Kama has a debt to Sumida and a hidden past tied to Tsurumi Island.
threads.quote: Kama: I owe Lady Sumida.

threads.claim: The Thunderbird Kapatcir is central to the ceremony, and Ruu believes she is pleased with it.
threads.quote: Ruu: My good friend!

threads.claim: The records say Tsurumi Island was utterly destroyed, yet a child still lives there, which raises a contradiction.
threads.quote: Roald: The records clearly state that what civilization once existed on Tsurumi Island has been utterly destroyed, and yet there was still a child there.

threads.claim: Ryuuji cannot remember what happened on the island, suggesting the fog erases memories.
threads.quote: Ryuuji: Every time I try to do so, it's as if there's a fog in my head that prevents me from remembering the details of what occurred on Tsurumi Island.

threads.claim: Time on Tsurumi Island passes strangely, and people seem not to notice visitors.
threads.quote: Traveler: Time passes strangely on Tsurumi Island...

threads.claim: Certain people and periods replay at abnormal speeds as occurrences rather than ghosts, and they do not notice the protagonist.
threads.quote: Sumida: Even though Tsurumi Island has already been destroyed, certain people and periods of time will play back at abnormal speeds, just like wraiths might.

threads.claim: Past commission takers were handed a fake Ghost Maushiro instead of the real one.
threads.quote: Sumida: So those who took the commission in the past could not retrieve the Maushiro because they received a fake "Ghost Maushiro" instead.

threads.claim: Kama buried the Maushiro and left the island, and his fate remains unclear.
threads.quote: "Kama": ...I'll bury this here.

threads.claim: Chise suggests Kama ended up badly because the islanders cast him out of the fog.
threads.quote: Chise: If we had, Kama wouldn't have ended up like that, either...

threads.claim: Other outlanders went missing in the fog and never returned.
threads.quote: Ruu: You went missing earlier. I thought that you'd ended up like all the others...

threads.claim: Kito suspects the belief that the Thunderbird protects the island with fog may be false.
threads.quote: I think that even the belief that the Great Thunderbird is protecting us with this fog might be fake!

threads.claim: Sayo says outsiders have come to the island and described a fog-free land beyond the sea.
threads.quote: "Sayo": I've seen people come in from the outside.

threads.claim: Activating the Ishine Script puzzle revealed a power that may be linked to the ley lines.
threads.quote: "Ipe": Huh, to think that Ishine Script had this kind of power. Perhaps it's related to the ley lines in some way... How unexpected.

threads.claim: The murals depict a time before the Sea of Fog, challenging the official history of the island.
threads.quote: Kito: These murals depict a time before the Sea of Fog.

threads.claim: The murals show no Thunderbird, suggesting the islanders worshiped other things before its arrival.
threads.quote: Roald: But the murals that you've provided show no sign of the Thunderbird's presence at all.

threads.claim: The original Maushiro may have powers such as seeing the spirits of the dead.
threads.quote: Perhaps it can even see the spirits of the dead.

threads.claim: A figure that looks like Ruu appears in the fog but is not the real Ruu.
threads.quote: Paimon: And that's a swing and a miss... Strange, that looked like Ruu, but wasn't the Ruu we were looking for...

threads.claim: Islanders at the ceremonial site cannot seem to see the Traveler and Paimon.
threads.quote: Traveler: The people here can't seem to see us.

threads.claim: The detective rejects the idea of destiny, holding that every occurrence follows its own logic.
threads.quote: Sango: As a detective, I do not believe in such things as "destiny."

threads.claim: Mata is preparing the Thunderbird's descent ceremony, and time is running out.
threads.quote: Mata: I must continue making preparations for the Thunderbird's descent.

threads.claim: The island's events repeat in a cycle that restarts after each destruction by the Thunderbird.
threads.quote: The Thunderbird then destroyed Tsurumi Island, resulting in a great storm... and then it started all over again.

threads.claim: Ruu experiences the loop directly, waking each time to the same repeated day.
threads.quote: But once the thunder stopped, everything would repeat all over again. I would wake up — and everyone would be doing the same things.

threads.claim: Defeating the Thunderbird's curse and freeing Ruu ends the cycle and restores the island.
threads.quote: Everything's better now, and it's all thanks to you two.

threads.claim: The Thunderbird was killed on Seirai Island after destroying Tsurumi Island.
threads.quote: Some time later, the Thunderbird destroyed Tsurumi Island, and even later on, it was killed on Seirai.

threads.claim: The party hides the Thunderbird's death from Ruu by saying she migrated to Seirai Island.
threads.quote: That's where the Thunderbird lives now!

threads.claim: The fog may not have been created by the Thunderbird as the islanders believed.
threads.quote: That conflicts with what I saw in those memories.

threads.claim: The Thunderbird's feathers carry her memories and can draw the Traveler into them.
threads.quote: It seems that I was drawn into the Thunderbird's memories.

threads.claim: Ruu's piece of himself is placed in a feather that goes with the travelers.
threads.quote: When we went to Seirai Island to sing for Kapatcir, I could feel that a piece of me was in that feather.

threads.claim: Ruu gives the Thunderbird the name Kanna Kapatcir during their first meeting.
threads.quote: And so I gave her the name Kanna Kapatcir...

threads.claim: Ruu promises to sing for the Thunderbird again when she returns with thunder and rain.
threads.quote: Well, then I shall sing you another tune — when you come again with thunder and rain!

threads.claim: Ruu fulfills his promise by singing for the Thunderbird on Seirai Island.
threads.quote: Phew! I sure haven't sung in a long time. That was great!

threads.claim: Ruu cannot leave Tsurumi Island, as each attempt to leave brings him back.
threads.quote: But I've tried leaving Tsurumi Island before, and I always end up back here again...

threads.claim: The Thunderbird curses the land with eternal catastrophe until she hears Ruu sing again.
threads.quote: may these lands fall under an eternal catastrophe

threads.claim: Kama and Sayo left Tsurumi Island and never came back, leaving their fate unknown.
threads.quote: he and Big Sister Sayo never returned.

threads.claim: The records do not say whether the ancestor Kama met Sayo after leaving the island.
threads.quote: The records don't say anything about that.

threads.claim: Kama suggests that the illusions on Tsurumi Island may have feelings and should not be left to suffer.
threads.quote: Perhaps I believe that even illusions have feelings, and so I would do ill in allowing them to suffer in this cycle.

threads.claim: Kama has changed noticeably and now eagerly chooses to leave with Sumida, hinting at an unexplained past.
threads.quote: Traveler: Kama's... really changed...

threads.claim: Sumida plans a future reunion at the sunset over the sea, where Sumida will check whether Kama's soul has been dusted.
threads.quote: If we should meet again, then let's do so where the sunset meets the sea.

introduced.name: Earnshaw
introduced.how: a kind man who lives in the cabin and is Lanoire's family
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: A kind man named Earnshaw lives in that cabin. He's your family, Lanoire.

introduced.name: The Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a fortress that Lanoire and her companions escaped from, and that is not her home
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Fortress of Meropide isn't your home.

introduced.name: Upon a Flowery Field of Grass
introduced.how: Lanoire's real home, a cabin at the breezy foothills of a mountain on a flowery field of grass
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: Look, that's your real home over there. It's just like Agnes described — at the breezy foothills of a mountain, upon a flowery field of grass.

introduced.name: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: a mysterious place suited to retelling history, reached by a route lost over the centuries
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: It is very mysterious indeed. The outside world has changed so much over the centuries...

assumed.name: Caterpillar
assumed.quote: Paimon: Caterpillar... Wouldn't it be great to meet Grandpa Earnshaw and Lanoire right now? Are you sure about this?

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Lanoire: Then I'll stay with you. Once you're all rested up, we can go together.

assumed.name: Estienne
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's right, getting out of there wasn't easy... Plus, if we go back now, Paimon thinks it would be bad news for Estienne and the others.

assumed.name: Bran and Mr. Wolsey
assumed.quote: Lanoire: and Ms. Paimon must be tired, too. It's a shame Bran and Mr. Wolsey aren't here...

assumed.name: Agnes
assumed.quote: Caterpillar: It's just like Agnes said... Look, Lanoire, there's nothing to worry about. Go home, I know Earnshaw will take good care of you.

assumed.name: Tasses Ragout
assumed.quote: Paimon: Earnshaw's Tasses Ragout is soooo tasty! You're gonna love it, Lanoire!

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: Earnshaw: Even if Cater was here, you still wouldn't be allowed to drink any more Fonta today.

assumed.name: Prince, Princess, and Hero
assumed.quote: Lanoire: I recognized Prince, Princess, and Hero as soon as I saw them!

threads.claim: Lanoire fears that characters in a story disappear at its end and never see each other again.
threads.quote: Lanoire: Then... Then will we see each other again? At the end of the story, the characters in it all disappear... I don't think they see each other again...

threads.claim: Caterpillar describes himself as merely a character in a story and urges that the fantasy be left behind for the real world.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: I'm simply a character in a story — brave at times, yet also an evil monster at others...

threads.claim: Lanoire's mother left Earnshaw's home and never returned, and the reason is unclear.
threads.quote: Earnshaw: Yeah. She didn't like it here, so she left and never returned.

threads.claim: Lanoire asks why her mother will not come back and worries she will grow up without her.
threads.quote: Lanoire: Why won't she come back? If she doesn't come back soon, I'm gonna grow up as well.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects she and the Traveler have met Lanoire's family before, and details are starting to match.
threads.quote: Paimon: And speaking of which, Paimon thinks we've met your family before. Now that she thinks about it, a lot of the details add up.

threads.claim: Lanoire has returned to her real family, and Caterpillar says things could not have ended better for her.

threads.claim: Going back to Meropide now would probably be a bad idea.
threads.quote: Traveler: Going back now probably wouldn't be a great idea.

threads.claim: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo is a mysterious place that the party must find a new route to reach.
threads.quote: Paimon: Sounds like a very mysterious place... Where is it? How do we get there?

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa

introduced.name: Lishnaya

introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: Her name is Lishnaya. She's the head of a Snezhnayan guild, and if all she wanted was to compliment me, there'd be no reason to organize a whole banquet.

introduced.name: Lishnaya's betrayal of the ticket
introduced.how: Lishnaya used a seat saved for her to court a merchant, treating Vodyanitsa's art as a social stepping stone
introduced.quote: At that show, sitting in the seat I saved for her was a wealthy merchant she'd been trying to win over.

introduced.name: Xenia
introduced.how: an unseen inner voice that only Vodyanitsa can hear
introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa: You just can't see her — no one can, and I'm the only one who can hear her.

introduced.quote: Rozhdestvensky: Ah... I'm such an idiot. Miss Vodyanitsa is a Water Imp. Of course she overheard us...

introduced.name: Handwritten ticket

introduced.quote: They're valid for almost every show. They can sit in an empty seat if there's one available, otherwise they can watch from backstage.

introduced.name: Happy-Quacky Phonograph Ducky

introduced.quote: However, due to its small size, the recording capacity is quite limited.

introduced.name: Ineffa

introduced.quote: Ineffa: Greetings, , Paimon. I received your message, and have brought the device you requested.

introduced.name: Aino

introduced.quote: Traveler: I knew Aino would come through.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: a thief who steals snacks from Aino's craftshop and takes commissions tied to the Seahook Gang
introduced.quote: Ineffa: It's been several days since Jahoda last came to the craftshop to steal some of Aino's snacks.

introduced.name: Escoffier

introduced.name: Odette

introduced.quote: (Approach the stage in The Korolevskiy Theater)

introduced.quote: Vodyanitsa gave you that handwritten ticket last night, right? She said we could both use it.

assumed.quote: Escoffier: After reading all about the commotion you caused in Nod-Krai in The Steambird, I figured the next stop on your journey would be Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Whopperflower

assumed.quote: I bet Nefer would love it. And Lauma too. And Varka!

assumed.quote: It's a pity that Tartaglia missed out on the chance to witness it.

assumed.name: Odette

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa hears the songs of departed Water Imps as ghostly voices, which may or may not be real.
threads.quote: As my voice echoes aimlessly around the empty room, with no one to hear it but me, it might as well be the mad ghosts of the deceased Water Imps singing inside my head...

threads.claim: Odette says the Water Imps' voices have never truly disappeared to Vodyanitsa, and Vodyanitsa sings their songs to keep them alive.
threads.quote: Odette: Not to us. But to her, their voices have never truly disappeared.

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa longs for her lost sister Water Imps and wonders where they went.
threads.quote: Vodyanitsa: Oh, my dear sisters... where in the world have you gone?

threads.claim: Handwritten tickets become status tokens that people trade, bribe for, or fake, betraying Vodyanitsa's art.
threads.quote: My art became a stepping stone she could exploit to climb the social ladder.

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa insists her handwritten tickets are a sincere invitation to listen, not status symbols.
threads.quote: Vodyanitsa: But my handwritten tickets were never meant to be status symbols.

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa fears that after she is no longer principal soprano her songs will be forgotten like the Water Imps'.
threads.quote: Odette: Right now, she's here to keep the other Water Imps' songs alive. But when she's gone... who will be there to keep her songs alive?

threads.claim: The Traveler promises to record and remember Vodyanitsa's songs, easing her fear of being forgotten.
threads.quote: I know, isn't it wonderful? A world-famous celebrity promised me be here to listen to and remember any songs that I want to sing...

threads.claim: Ineffa's body looks mechanical, hinting she is not an ordinary human.
threads.quote: Vodyanitsa: (But, her body looks... mechanical. Huh, hopefully the frigid temperatures around here don't cause her too much trouble.)

threads.claim: Jahoda has taken a commission tied to the Seahook Gang in Snezhnograd, putting her in danger.
threads.quote: Miss Nefer said Jahoda is currently in Snezhnograd handling a commission related to the Seahook Gang, so I came here to make sure she is safe.

threads.claim: Vodyanitsa's old songs hold meaning beyond the music that one must understand to truly appreciate them.
threads.quote: to truly appreciate them, there is much besides the songs themselves that one must understand.

threads.claim: Columbina has apparently heard Vodyanitsa's songs before, despite being unable to see.
threads.quote: The answer is yes. There. I mean, what do you expect?

threads.claim: Aino and Ineffa intend to find Jahoda and bring her to see Vodyanitsa's show.
threads.quote: When we find Jahoda, we should bring her to see the show, too.

threads.claim: Recording devices are forbidden at the theater, and Vodyanitsa's song cannot be recorded.
threads.quote: The use of recording devices is not permitted at the theater, Aino. Those are the rules.

introduced.name: Zhiqiong

introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: Jinwu finally found the time to put those beacons together, and I need to put them down in a few specific locations to get the data we need.

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: camp member who analyzes the crystal data and gives Zhiqiong medicine
introduced.quote: Khedive: I gave her some medicine. It should be able to at least slow some of the more serious symptoms, so her situation is stabilizing...

introduced.name: Muning
introduced.how: official who learns of Zhiqiong's departure and organizes the search
introduced.quote: Muning: Hmm? Zhiqiong's not with you? Word's come down from the Ministry.

introduced.name: Stanley
introduced.how: famous Mondstadt adventurer who lost a dear friend on an expedition
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: The famous adventurer Stanley of Mondstadt is so famed because he passed through the Mare Jivari, but he lost a dear friend during that adventure.

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: dangerous place that Stanley passed through on a famous adventure
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: The famous adventurer Stanley of Mondstadt is so famed because he passed through the Mare Jivari, but he lost a dear friend during that adventure.

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: home city of the adventurer Stanley
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: The famous adventurer Stanley of Mondstadt is so famed because he passed through the Mare Jivari, but he lost a dear friend during that adventure.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: government body that decides to formally invite Zhiqiong as a consultant and guide
introduced.quote: Muning: On account of the invaluable help that her maps have brought to the Huishan Hall, the Ministry of Civil Affairs has decided to make an exception for her and...

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: exploration group whose search party Muning puts in charge of finding Zhiqiong
introduced.quote: Muning: As such, please leave the search for her to me... Uh, more accurately, just leave it to the Millelith search party.

introduced.name: Beacons
introduced.how: measuring devices placed at set spots to collect data on the dark mud
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: Alright, this is the place. If we put a beacon down here, we can track the movements of this dark mud...

introduced.name: Dark mud
introduced.how: hazardous substance that moves and must be tracked and avoided
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong: I've told everyone not to get near that dark mud. Hmm, this is where we need to place the beacon.

introduced.name: Zhiqiong's letter
introduced.how: letter in which Zhiqiong says she will go deeper into the Chasm
introduced.quote: Zhiqiong wrote she will follow a path to go deeper into the Chasm

threads.claim: Zhiqiong leaves the camp in poor health and writes that she will go deeper into the Chasm, leaving her fate uncertain.
threads.quote: Zhiqiong wrote she will follow a path to go deeper into the Chasm

threads.claim: Zhiqiong argues that adventurers are naturally drawn to danger and that a placid life feels wrong.
threads.quote: I suspect that it's in our nature as adventurers to be fascinated with danger.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong says she fears being forgotten like those who died in deserted places and wants to leave an impression.
threads.quote: At least then, I wouldn't be forgotten like those who sacrificed themselves in deserted places

threads.claim: Stanley lost a friend during his expedition through the Mare Jivari, and the friend's name is largely unknown.
threads.quote: Zhiqiong: The famous adventurer Stanley of Mondstadt is so famed because he passed through the Mare Jivari, but he lost a dear friend during that adventure.

threads.claim: The dark mud moves unpredictably and is dangerous enough that people have been told to keep away from it.
threads.quote: Zhiqiong: I've told everyone not to get near that dark mud. Hmm, this is where we need to place the beacon.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong was trapped in the black mud when she was found, confirming its danger to people.
threads.quote: Traveler: She was trapped in the black mud when we found her.

threads.claim: Zhiqiong's feverish words about a golden city, a black watchtower, and departed heavenly envoys hint at a hidden past event.
threads.quote: The golden city... The black watchtower...! *cough* The heavenly envoys have left...!

threads.claim: Zhiqiong claims the gods order the world and withheld their sight from mortals, who still refuse to be forgotten.
threads.quote: This world has been ordered by the gods, and though we ordinary mortals have not been given

threads.claim: A mysterious crystal with a wavelength is being studied by Jinwu and Khedive, and its nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: Zhiqiong: Wavelength, I think Khedive called it? I guess it's just some sort of weird Sumeru jargon.

threads.claim: The geological anomalies in The Chasm have mostly stopped, which partly resolves the earlier instability.
threads.quote: the various geological anomalies have mostly stopped lately

introduced.quote: Looks like the Korolevskiy Troupe is putting on a new ballet!

introduced.quote: Just our prima ballerina running herself into the ground again!

introduced.name: Fatui

introduced.quote: Odette's gone and accepted a monster-slaying mission from the Fatui.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa

introduced.quote: That's Vodyanitsa's voice, isn't it?

introduced.name: Black Snow Swan

introduced.quote: It's about a snow swan whose feathers are a different color than everyone else, right?

assumed.name: Mitya
