threads.claim: Odette knowingly takes on both Fatui work and ballet despite a tight schedule, hinting at an unexplained motive.
threads.quote: I applied to work with the Fatui with full knowledge of said schedule.

threads.claim: Odette feels that dance, once her source of freedom, now controls her life.
threads.quote: Dance, the one thing that made me feel free, has now become the very thing controlling my life.

threads.claim: Odette resolves to stop exhausting herself and to pursue what she wants with confidence.
threads.quote: I know what I want, I know I'm capable of getting it, so I should go for it.

threads.claim: The Black Snow Swan ballet has a personal and childhood connection for Odette that she has not fully explained.
threads.quote: It's... because of the Black Snow Swan.

threads.claim: Odette reads the swan's story as a search for her true self.
threads.quote: But in my view, I think... she found her true self.

threads.claim: Odette's father has died, and the family's happiness was destroyed, leaving a lasting loss.
threads.quote: My father's passing, my mother's pain... My family's happiness had been utterly destroyed

threads.claim: Odette once blamed Project Stuzha and the Fatui for her family's loss, raising questions about what really happened.
threads.quote: I blamed it on Rosalyne, the Fatui, and Project Stuzha

threads.claim: Odette's real grievance is a lack of control over her own life, not any single group.
threads.quote: It was feeling like I wasn't in control of my own life.

threads.claim: Odette is hunting for a rare music box to replace the one her mother broke because of her.
threads.quote: Because I'm the reason my mother broke her favorite music box.

threads.claim: The Traveler offers to help Odette search for the secret edition music box.
threads.quote: Let's go buy some, then.

introduced.name: Arapandu
introduced.how: Introduces itself as an Aranara on a task for the festival and Apam Woods
introduced.quote: Arapandu has a very important task to do for Festival Utsava, for Apam Woods, and for Nara Varuna.

introduced.name: Nara Varuna
introduced.how: A golden, brave Nara who once saved Vana and fixed the Varuna Contraption, now gone
introduced.quote: Everyone from Vanarana thanked and liked Nara Varuna who was like the sun, mud, and the dew drops.

introduced.name: Memory of Stone
introduced.how: A monument Aranara left to remember Nara Varuna, hidden in the Yasna Monument area
introduced.quote: Aranakula has another request. Before fixing the Varuna Contraption... Please help find the Memory of Stone.

introduced.name: Varuna Contraption
introduced.how: A device that turns black rain into good rain and gives life to Vana, now damaged
introduced.quote: The Varuna Contraption's branches and leaves are everywhere in Vana. They give the machine power to turn black rain into good rain.

introduced.name: Varunastra
introduced.how: A water-jet manifestation of the Contraption's power, taller than Vana's trees
introduced.quote: It's a manifestation of the power of the Varuna Contraption. When it displays its power, it will be taller than the tallest tree in Vana.

introduced.name: Apam Woods
introduced.how: A forest where the air is poisoned by spores and the Contraption has failed
introduced.quote: Arapandu brings them to Apam Woods, where Paimon notes that the air is extremely off.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: Aranara home where everyone is preparing for the festival
introduced.quote: Everyone at Vanarana is busy preparing for Festival Utsava, y'know.

introduced.name: Festival Utsava
introduced.how: An upcoming festival that the Aranara must prepare for
introduced.quote: Everyone at Vanarana is busy preparing for Festival Utsava, y'know.

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: Hostile mushroom creatures that attack Aranara and grow stronger in the strange rain
introduced.quote: The Fungi have encircled something... That seems to be an Aranara!

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Forest-dwelling small beings who live in Vana and protect it
introduced.quote: Aranara won't leave Vana. Aranara will always be with Vana.

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: A general name for the special abilities Aranara gain from Vana's plants
introduced.quote: Ararakalari should be the general name for a certain type of ability...

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: Large iron Nara-like guardians with two arms and legs and one eye
introduced.quote: Large iron Nara are very big and have two arms and two legs like Nara , but only have one eye.

introduced.name: Vana
introduced.how: The forest region where Aranara live, which remembers everything
introduced.quote: Vana remembers everything that happened after Nara Varuna arrived.

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: A village to the east where children sometimes vanish and return
introduced.quote: It's about the odd things that have happened in Vimara Village to the east.

introduced.name: Aramuhukunda
introduced.how: A figure who, with the Lord of Dendro, created the Varuna Contraption
introduced.quote: Before the black rain and before Nara Varuna came to Vana, Aramuhukunda and the Lord of Dendro created the Varuna Contraption.

introduced.name: Lord of Dendro
introduced.how: A power that created the Varuna Contraption
introduced.quote: The Varuna Contraption is a creation of the Lord of Dendro.

introduced.name: The Rain's End
introduced.how: A deep cavern beneath the Contraption where rain is born
introduced.quote: There is no rain here, and yet it's the birthplace of rain.

introduced.name: Arabalika
introduced.how: A powerful Aranara who introduces himself and offers to help
introduced.quote: Nothing to fear. Arabalika is around.

introduced.name: Aranakula
introduced.how: A timid Aranara tied to soil and seeds, who hides from Fungi
introduced.quote: Aranakula is used to being with soil and seeds. Familiar with all things born from the soil.

introduced.name: Arakunti
introduced.how: An Aranara who can take you into dreams from the Grove of Dreams
introduced.quote: Arakunti is at the . You can enter dreams from there.

introduced.name: Black rain
introduced.how: A past disaster of black rain and mud that polluted Vana before Nara Varuna came
introduced.quote: Black rain, black mud, and many other bad things made a mess of Vana.

introduced.name: Stone branches and leaves
introduced.how: Stone parts made by the creators that channel Vanarana's power into the Contraption
introduced.quote: Stone leaves, stone branches. They were created by Aramuhukunda and the Lord of Dendro and can channel Vanarana's power into the Varuna Contraption

introduced.name: Arakunti
introduced.how: an Aranara who speaks in riddles and hides in the Grove of Dreams, sent for by Arapandu
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey, are you Arakunti?

introduced.name: Arapandu
introduced.how: an Aranara who sent the party to check on Arakunti and worries about the other Aranara
introduced.quote: Arapandu: The Grove of Dreams is fine now. Arabalika is in the Ruins of Dahri, but Arapandu's not worried.

introduced.name: Varuna Contraption
introduced.how: a machine that feeds energy and weather balance; it needs healing so the weather returns to normal
introduced.quote: We need to heal the Varuna Contraption for Festival Utsava so that the weather will return to normal and there will be no more of those nasty spores.

introduced.name: Grove of Dreams
introduced.how: a humid, rainy grove where Arakunti lives and where the spores are spreading
introduced.quote: A humid Grove of Dreams is good, but the "spores" are bad.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: a people who communicate in unusual ways and who the Traveler and Paimon are learning to understand
introduced.quote: Arakunti: Why do you want to learn? Nara is Nara, Paimon is Paimon, and Aranara is Aranara.

introduced.name: Golden Nara
introduced.how: the Aranara term for the Traveler, who has a name that goes unspoken here
introduced.quote: Arakunti: Why are the Golden Nara and the small flying thing here to find Arakunti?

introduced.name: Nara Varuna
introduced.how: a golden, brave Nara from the past who worked with Aranara to heal the Varuna Contraption
introduced.quote: Arakunti: Arapandu said that Nara Varuna was a golden, brave Nara. Together with Aranara, healed the Varuna Contraption

introduced.name: Black rain and mud
introduced.how: a past calamity that the healed Varuna Contraption drove away, bringing back the sun and moon
introduced.quote: drove away the black rain and mud, and brought back the sun and moon.

introduced.name: Spores
introduced.how: tiny, numerous spores spread by the broken contraption's weather, which Aranara cannot catch
introduced.quote: But spores are too small and too many to catch.

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: mushrooms that are dangerous, some of which can run and attack
introduced.quote: The mushrooms that can run are bad too.

introduced.name: Dream Entrance
introduced.how: an entrance to a dream where the Varuna Contraption's leaves can be found
introduced.quote: Paimon: Speaking of which, Arapandu did say that there was a "Dream Entrance" here.

introduced.name: Arabalika
introduced.how: a strong Aranara who works in the Ruins of Dahri and wields the Ararakalari
introduced.quote: Arapandu: Arabalika should be back from the Ruins of Dahri soon. With Arabalika's Ararakalari, the Iron Chunks and Fungi won't be scary anymore.

introduced.name: Aranakula
introduced.how: a timid Aranara guarding the nurseries at the Yasna Monument, who is weaker than Arabalika
introduced.quote: Aranakula: If Aranakula was half as strong as Arabalika, Aranakula could protect the nurseries.

introduced.name: Ruins of Dahri
introduced.how: a ruined place where Arabalika is working
introduced.quote: Arapandu: The Grove of Dreams is fine now. Arabalika is in the Ruins of Dahri, but Arapandu's not worried.

introduced.name: Yasna Monument
introduced.how: a location full of dangerous Fungi where Aranakula is staying
introduced.quote: However, there's lots of Fungi at the Yasna Monument.

assumed.name: Valuka
assumed.quote: Valuka bad, but too much rain also bad.

assumed.name: Oceanid Mimics
assumed.quote: Wouldn't those just be Oceanid Mimics!?

assumed.name: Statues of The Seven
assumed.quote: You mean the Statues of The Seven?

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Wow, it might be possible to live long enough to eat every dish in Teyvat that way!

assumed.name: Cicin
assumed.quote: You'd become like a Cicin.

assumed.name: Sarva
assumed.quote: But Marana... must be eliminated for Vana and Sarva.

assumed.name: Aradasha
assumed.quote: Aradasha would defeat a Big Iron Chunk before you could blink.

assumed.name: Arana
assumed.quote: Arana told Paimon that it can be used to repel Marana...

assumed.name: Big Iron Chunks
assumed.quote: Of course! has defeated countless Big Iron Chunks already.

assumed.name: Ashavan Realm
assumed.quote: Hehe, peace returns to the Ashavan Realm!

assumed.name: Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: Paimon: We've almost forgotten what we came here for. It's for Festival Utsava!

assumed.name: Vana
assumed.quote: Arakunti: Humid dream, dry dream... Ding dong, tick tock, rustle... It's Vana's tune...

assumed.name: Apam Woods
assumed.quote: Paimon hopes we can heal the Varuna Contraption soon, or Apam Woods will be full of spores

assumed.name: Marana
assumed.quote: Arakunti: Nara turning into Paimon... is even scarier than dancing with mushrooms within Marana...

assumed.name: Rhythm of the Great Dream
assumed.quote: (Play the Rhythm of the Great Dream)

assumed.name: Aranara music
assumed.quote: Paimon: Didn't we learn some Aranara music before? We just need to play that music and we should be able to enter the dream!

assumed.name: Memory of Stone
assumed.quote: (Talk to Arakunti or Arapandu at the rest stop, if Irate Iron Chunk and Memory of Stone have not been completed yet)

threads.claim: Nara Varuna has left Vanarana and Vana, and the reason is still unexplained.
threads.quote: Nara Varuna is no longer in Vanarana. Aramuhukunda is no longer in Vanarana...

threads.claim: Aranara hope Nara Varuna will return, but doubt they will come back.
threads.quote: It has been a long time since Nara Varuna left Vana. Maybe won't come to Festival Utsava anymore.

threads.claim: The Varuna Contraption's roots are healed, clearing the spores and restoring clean air to the forest.
threads.quote: But the Varuna Contraption has already been healed, and there won't be so many spores anymore.

threads.claim: The player is left asking what the Varuna Contraption and the Varunastra really are.
threads.quote: Actually, that said, what are the Varuna Contraption and the Varunastra exactly?

threads.claim: Black rain and black mud corrupted Vana in the past, and the cause is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Black rain, black mud, and many other bad things made a mess of Vana.

threads.claim: Marana is an unexplained threat that has emptied nurseries and must still be eliminated.
threads.quote: But Marana is still here. Aranara have a lot to do.

threads.claim: Children in Vimara Village sometimes disappear and then return, and the Aranara do not know why.
threads.quote: The children living there sometimes disappear for a period of time, but will always return safely...

threads.claim: The Memory of Stone is a memorial Aranara made so Nara Varuna would know Vana never forgets.
threads.quote: this is the Memory of Stone that Aranara have left for Nara Varuna.

threads.claim: The Grove of Dreams is a place from which one can enter dreams, hinting at a dream-based mystery.
threads.quote: Arakunti is at the . You can enter dreams from there.

threads.claim: Travelers like the Traveler and Paimon are not meant to stay in Vana, as Nara do not stay.
threads.quote: Nara and Paimon won't stay in Vana like Aranara do. Aranakula knows this.

threads.claim: The Rain's End is the source of the rains that purify Vana, and its significance is left open.
threads.quote: The rains that purify Vana begin — and end — here.

threads.claim: Aradasha was once a powerful Aranara but is no longer in the present, and the reason is unexplained.
threads.quote: Aradasha's Ararakalari was very powerful in the past.

threads.claim: Something is wrong with the smell of iron in the Ruins of Dahri, a danger left unexplained.
threads.quote: Something is wrong with the smell of iron. Nara , Arabalika will leave this to you.

threads.claim: The Varuna Contraption is broken and must be healed to restore normal weather and stop the spores.
threads.quote: We need to heal the Varuna Contraption for Festival Utsava so that the weather will return to normal and there will be no more of those nasty spores.

threads.claim: Nara Varuna, a golden Nara who healed the contraption long ago, may or may not be related to the Traveler, and whether a Nara can return is unresolved.
threads.quote: Arakunti: Is Nara Nara Varuna?

threads.claim: Nara Varuna left the forest in the past, and Arakunti wonders whether a different Nara can have a similar melody.
threads.quote: Arakunti: Did Nara Varuna not return to Vana? Is Nara a completely different Nara?

threads.claim: The Traveler's Nara name is withheld by Aranara speech, leaving the name unrevealed.
threads.quote: Paimon: Your "Golden Nara" also has a name, and that's .

threads.claim: Arakunti claims he might be a tree, rain, a dream of Vana, or musical strings, leaving his true nature ambiguous.
threads.quote: Arakunti: Because one might be a tree, or rain, or a dream of Vana, or the strings of a musical instrument.

threads.claim: Aranara communicate in indirect, metaphorical ways that outsiders find hard to understand.
threads.quote: Paimon: But now that you mention it, how do Aranara communicate, anyway?

threads.claim: Spores and mushrooms are spreading across Vana, and Marana is a dangerous place tied to the mushrooms.
threads.quote: Arakunti: When the Varuna Contraption wasn't broken, Vana didn't have so many mushrooms, so healing the Varuna Contraption could make everything better. Except Marana.

threads.claim: Aranakula is in danger at the Yasna Monument, and Arapandu worries about him while Arakunti believes he can hide.
threads.quote: Arapandu's worried about Aranakula...

introduced.name: Ararycan
introduced.how: a shy Aranara who first meets the Traveler and Paimon and is frightened of them as Nara
introduced.quote: Ararycan: Ahh! Nara...

introduced.name: Jazari
introduced.how: a Kshahrewar researcher found in the caves, who introduces himself and his work on ruin machines
introduced.quote: My name is Jazari, a Kshahrewar Researcher, as you can see.

introduced.name: Royinjan
introduced.how: a Port Ormos antique dealer and Chief Antique Appraiser who holds the key to the Amiti Device
introduced.quote: Royinjan, the Chief Antique Appraiser, to be precise.

introduced.name: Amadhiah
introduced.how: an old man in Vimara Village, a childhood friend of Royinjan who once played at the secret base
introduced.quote: Amadhiah: Back when we were kids, Royinjan lived in Vimara for a while because of his grandfather.

introduced.name: Hasad
introduced.how: Royinjan's grandfather, a renowned adventurer who once owned the Amiti Device
introduced.quote: Royinjan realizes they are talking about an artifact owned by his grandfather Hasad, who was a renowned adventurer.

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus
introduced.how: a historical Kshahrewar researcher who studied Ruin Golems and whom Jazari wants to succeed
introduced.quote: his ambition to succeed Pir Kavikavus, a historical Kshahrewar researcher who also studied Ruin Golems.

introduced.name: Ynghildr
introduced.how: a Khaenri'ahn knight now cursed into an Abyssal creature, defeated by the Traveler
introduced.quote: the Traveler is confronted by and defeats Ynghildr, a Khaenri'ahn knight who has now been cursed as an Abyssal creature.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: forest spirits who protect the forest and help little Nara, and who are visible only to children and some adults
introduced.quote: Arana is good Aranara. Protecting Vana often, and helping little Nara always, are what Arana does.

introduced.name: Nara
introduced.how: the term Aranara use for humans, who can still see them if they are favored by nature
introduced.quote: Nara is a dreamer, favored by trees and flowers, so you can still see us, even as a grown-up.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: the academic institution that certifies researchers like Jazari and holds ruin research records
introduced.quote: After all, I am a certified researcher from the Akademiya, and you are outlanders of unknown origin.

introduced.name: Devantaka Mountain
introduced.how: the mountain where the suspicious Nara and the giant ruin machine are located, linked to pollution
introduced.quote: at Devantaka Mountain who may be linked to the incidents in Vimara Village.

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: a village where Royinjan and his childhood friends had a secret base and where Amadhiah now lives
introduced.quote: He takes the group to Vimara Village, where he and his childhood friends may have kept the device.

introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.how: a port city to the south where Royinjan runs his antique shop
introduced.quote: the key may be found in Port Ormos to the south, in the hands of an antique dealer named Royinjan.

introduced.name: Dev's Cavern
introduced.how: ancient ruins beneath Devantaka Mountain where the Ruin Golem's core was sealed
introduced.quote: The entrances to Dev's Cavern are blocked

introduced.name: Ruin Golem
introduced.how: a giant ruin machine made in Khaenri'ah that is the target of the group's efforts
introduced.quote: That is actually a Ruin Golem made in the ancient realm of Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Amiti Device
introduced.how: a key-like identification device needed to open the Ruin Golem's cockpit door, found in pieces
introduced.quote: Opening the door to the Ruin Golem's cockpit requires an Amiti Device. To put it simply, a key.

introduced.name: Chaos Core
introduced.how: the power source of ruin machines, which was removed from the Ruin Golem and sealed away
introduced.quote: the core, its power source, was removed and sealed in Dev's Cavern

introduced.name: Vamadha
introduced.how: vine-like barriers made by Aranara that spin open for those who sing the right rhythm
introduced.quote: Ararycan: Yeah, these are Vamadha. Aranara made them.

introduced.name: Adventure Handbook
introduced.how: an adventure journal used to record experiences and treasure locations, which can hold clues to hidden items
introduced.quote: It's like an adventure journal, to record their experiences, plans, and even the clues to treasure locations.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a machine that takes pictures, which Jazari carries
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's right. It's a machine that takes pictures.

introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.how: a sickness that makes plants and creatures wither, also called Marana
introduced.quote: Paimon: Marana refers to the Withering, and Vana... That's gotta mean the forest.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah's destruction
introduced.how: the past fall of Khaenri'ah, after which many ruin machines burst out of the desert
introduced.quote: When Khaenri'ah was destroyed, many ruin machines like this one burst out from the desert.

introduced.name: Jazari
introduced.how: an Akademiya researcher with a research permit, eager to study the Ruin Golem
introduced.quote: I do have the most authoritative research permit granted by the Akademiya

introduced.name: Iskandar
introduced.how: a Vahumana sage whose famous quote about ancient Khaenri'ah history is explained
introduced.quote: This is a famous quote by Iskandar, a Vahumana sage.

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus
introduced.how: a Kshahrewar scholar who reached Herbad rank young and was a major academic figure
introduced.quote: Pir Kavikavus was one of the greatest scholars in Kshahrewar's history.

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus's expedition accident
introduced.how: Pir Kavikavus died or was lost in an expedition accident, and his research results were lost
introduced.quote: he met with an accident during an expedition, and his research results were lost.

introduced.name: Kshahrewar
introduced.how: a scholarly institution or nation that has declined since Pir Kavikavus
introduced.quote: Ever since then, Kshahrewar has gone downhill.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an academic body that grants research permits and has very few blueprint readers
introduced.quote: there are no more than three people in the entire Akademiya who can read this blueprint.

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: researchers who studied the early backup power systems of ruin machines
introduced.quote: According to Vahumana researchers, this power system most likely had been in widespread use long before the first ruin machine was ever built in ancient Khaenri'ah.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: an ancient civilization that built the Ruin Golem and its ruin machines
introduced.quote: Ancient Khaenri'ah's creations really are amazing.

introduced.name: Ruin Golem
introduced.how: a large ancient ruin machine powered by a dark core, with a steering cabin and lift
introduced.quote: all ruin machines are driven by the dark power of their cores.

introduced.name: Separation Valve
introduced.how: a switch in the steering cabin that activates the Ruin Golem
introduced.quote: once the Separation Valve in the steering cabin is turned on, the Ruin Golem will be activated.

introduced.name: Chaos Core
introduced.how: the glowing core of the Ruin Golem, sealed underground and leaking filth
introduced.quote: The glowing thing in there must be the Ruin Golem's Chaos Core.

introduced.name: Energy Block
introduced.how: a block storing pure energy drawn from Ley Lines, used to power relays
introduced.quote: The power sources of these devices are energy blocks that store pure energy extracted from the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: a source from which pure energy is extracted for ancient power systems
introduced.quote: energy blocks that store pure energy extracted from the Ley Lines.

introduced.name: backup power system
introduced.how: a series of small power relays that runs ruin machines when their cores are sealed
introduced.quote: Unlike the cores that supply almost unlimited energy, this power system comprises a series of small power relays.

introduced.name: Ararycan
introduced.how: an Aranara who guards the forest and runs fast, living near the ruins
introduced.quote: Ararycan needs to guard the forest.

introduced.name: The Thing From Below
introduced.how: a voice from the abyss that claims what is ours and mocks those who cling to sight
introduced.quote: The Thing From Below: Ignorant ones, we seek not to claim that which is of this earth, but that which is ours.

introduced.name: Abyss Lector
introduced.how: a foe the party fights in the ruins, a weird bad guy tied to the abyss
introduced.quote: (During the fight with the Abyss Lector)

assumed.name: Rana
assumed.quote: Amadhiah: Ah, we meet again, friends of Rana. Is she not with you?

assumed.name: Marana's Avatar
assumed.quote: Arana said that Marana's Avatar is taking little Nara away.

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on unknown person, optional)

assumed.name: Enjou and the Abyss Order
assumed.quote: we did meet an Abyss Order member disguised a researcher that one time.

assumed.name: Afratu's Dilemma
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh... Paimon just a had sense of déjà vu...

assumed.name: Mint
assumed.quote: Ararycan: Ah, but Mint is different. Mint, so strong.

assumed.name: Nara Varuna
assumed.quote: Ararycan: And you are Golden Nara, just like the legendary Nara Varuna.

assumed.name: Stormterror's Lair and Dain
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eh? Then isn't this the one we saw at Stormterror's Lair? Didn't Dain take it?

assumed.name: Vanarana and Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: says that it will return to Vanarana for Festival Utsava.

assumed.name: Afratu
assumed.quote: Afratu? Darn it, don't tell me he has also got his eyes on the title of

assumed.name: Abyss Order
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's Abyss Mages. I knew the Abyss Order had a hand in it!

assumed.name: Ynghildr
assumed.quote: (After activating the four relays, Ynghildr spawns)

assumed.name: Royinjan
assumed.quote: Traveler: Let's tell this story to grandpa Royinjan...

assumed.name: Marana's Avatar
assumed.quote: Anyway, we don't know what Marana's Avatar has to do with the Abyss Order yet

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Jazari, optional)

assumed.name: Festival Utsava
assumed.quote: Ararycan will celebrate Festival Utsava.

threads.claim: Ararycan once played with the children at the secret base but has forgotten it, raising the question of why Aranara forget the past.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ararycan was the Aranara who played with the kids at the secret base.

threads.claim: Ararycan says they cannot remember the events they describe, though those events feel familiar.
threads.quote: Ararycan: Ararycan doesn't know what you're talking about and Ararycan can't remember.

threads.claim: Royinjan cannot remember the identity of the third childhood friend shown in his handbook.
threads.quote: I can't remember who this third person was, but I certainly haven't forgotten that old man.

threads.claim: The third friend is revealed to be Ararycan, who receives the flower that belonged to them but remembers nothing of it.
threads.quote: The Traveler gives the flower to Ararycan, who was the third friend but no longer remembers any of it.

threads.claim: The Withering, called Marana, is harming the forest and Ararycan worries it will grow into something larger.
threads.quote: Ararycan: The forest has been crying harder lately, Ararycan is worried.

threads.claim: Ararycan warns that a super giant Marana will come if the forest keeps getting sick.
threads.quote: If the forest keeps being sick like this, a super giant Marana will come and suck all living things away!

threads.claim: The forest and stream are crying, and it is unclear whether this is literal or only something Aranara can hear.
threads.quote: The forest and stream are always crying.

threads.claim: Some unseen dirty substance is making the forest sick in places Ararycan cannot see.
threads.quote: But Ararycan knows that, some bad dirty stuff are making the forest sick, in places Ararycan can't see.

threads.claim: The Ruin Golem is missing its core, which has been leaking energy and may be causing the pollution.
threads.quote: There shouldn't be, but we have detected some energy leakage.

threads.claim: The Traveler finds the Ruin Golem's Chaos Core in Dev's Cavern and shuts it off, cutting off the pollution.
threads.quote: are able to shut off the Chaos Core, cutting off the source of the pollution.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order is listed among the bad guys who may be connected to the trouble around the Ruin Golem.
threads.quote: Bad guys like the Fatui, Treasure Hoarders and the Abyss Order! Super bad guys!

threads.claim: The Abyss Order is found to be involved in the contamination, with Abyss Mages in Dev's Cavern.
threads.quote: The group finds Abyss Mages and realizes that the Abyss Order is involved in the contamination.

threads.claim: Marana's Avatar may have sealed the cave entrances, though its role is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Jazari: Maybe it was the "Marana's Avatar" that you mentioned.

threads.claim: Ruin machines spilled out of the desert when Khaenri'ah was destroyed, and their cores were sealed because the Akademiya could not handle them.
threads.quote: When Khaenri'ah was destroyed, many ruin machines like this one burst out from the desert.

threads.claim: A Khaenri'ahn knight has been cursed into an Abyssal creature and now lurks in the Ruin Golem.
threads.quote: the Traveler is confronted by and defeats Ynghildr, a Khaenri'ahn knight who has now been cursed as an Abyssal creature.

threads.claim: The Amiti Device is a key split into fragments that is hidden across several locations.
threads.quote: Royinjan says that the locations of the fragments are in the handbook, but he no longer understands the writing.

threads.claim: Jazari repairs the Amiti Device from the collected fragments so the group can enter the Ruin Golem.
threads.quote: Jazari manages to repair the Amiti Device using its fragments, and they leave for the Ruin Golem.

threads.claim: Royinjan's grandfather Hasad was a legendary adventurer whose lost device and stories shaped Royinjan's life.
threads.quote: When I was little, grandpa would often tell me stories of his adventures.

threads.claim: Royinjan and Amadhiah have a long-standing rivalry rooted in their childhood adventure plans.
threads.quote: Hmph, I don't want to meet that old fossil.

threads.claim: Antiques and the fragments are valued for their stories rather than their monetary worth.
threads.quote: Traveler: Antiques are sold for their stories.

threads.claim: Jazari argues that knowledge cannot be ranked by practical value, pitting researchers against merchants and officials.
threads.quote: Knowledge itself cannot be determined to be more or less valuable.

threads.claim: The Ruin Golem's cores have been sealed underground and their dark power is the key to the machine.
threads.quote: And the cores of the Ruin Golem have been sealed underground.

threads.claim: The Chaos Core's seal has been damaged, and Abyss Mages may be responsible.
threads.quote: Paimon remembers Jazari said that the core's seal had been damaged.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order seems to have a hand in the damage to the forest and ruins.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's Abyss Mages. I knew the Abyss Order had a hand in it!

threads.claim: Marana's Avatar may be connected to the Abyss Order, but the link is unknown.
threads.quote: Anyway, we don't know what Marana's Avatar has to do with the Abyss Order yet

threads.claim: The filthy stuff flowing from the core is what made the forest sick.
threads.quote: Ohh, it's the filthy stuff. Ararycan can feel it. This is what made the forest sick.

threads.claim: The bad things that sickened the forest may return and need guarding against.
threads.quote: There's a chance that the bad things that made the forest sick will come back.

threads.claim: Shutting off the device ends the harm to the forest.
threads.quote: The forest is finally free of further harm.

threads.claim: A strange device is constantly drawing energy out of the ruins.
threads.quote: This device is constantly extracting all that energy from within...

threads.claim: The Thing From Below speaks for the abyss and wants what lies beneath the earth.
threads.quote: The Thing From Below: Ignorant ones, we seek not to claim that which is of this earth, but that which is ours.

threads.claim: The Ruin Golem's pilot is a person found inside the ruins.
threads.quote: Paimon: Could it really be the pilot?

threads.claim: The pilot seems to be an old friend who has lived far longer than a normal person.
threads.quote: Traveler: We met an old friend.

threads.claim: Pir Kavikavus's research was lost in an expedition accident, and his work remains unfinished.
threads.quote: he met with an accident during an expedition, and his research results were lost.

threads.claim: The Ruin Golem's severed arm breaks open the entrance to the underground ruins.
threads.quote: The robot's severed arm must have broken the entrance to the underground ruins open.

introduced.name: Tepetlisaurus
introduced.how: the Traveler's flying companion is a Tepetlisaurus
introduced.quote: Is that a little Tepetlisaurus?

introduced.name: Mposo
introduced.how: a tribal guard who once tried to enter the volcano and is now a coughing old man
introduced.quote: I'm Mposo, I tried to go into the volcano once and... well, *cough* it truly is a dangerous place.

introduced.name: Great Volcano of Tollan
introduced.how: a volcano that is dangerous to enter, with air that can burn the windpipe
introduced.quote: you should know the Great Volcano of Tollan isn't an easy place to get into... *cough*

introduced.name: Flamelord's Blessing
introduced.how: a mark on a saurian's head that draws it toward the volcano
introduced.quote: Huh, that mark on his head... it's the Flamelord's Blessing.

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: stronger Ley Lines make the volcano erupt more often
introduced.quote: The worse the Ley Lines get, the more frequently the volcano erupts.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a substance the volcano ejects during eruptions that makes some debris float
introduced.quote: During an eruption, the volcano will eject a vast amount of Phlogiston and other things...

introduced.name: Skyfire Circlet
introduced.how: floating fragmented structures around the volcano formed from erupted debris, reached by climbing
introduced.quote: However, some of the things it spits out float — due to the Phlogiston — remaining in the air

introduced.name: Spiritway
introduced.how: paths the volcanic eruptions create that can be climbed up toward the Skyfire Circlet
introduced.quote: we might be able to use the Spiritways created by the volcanic eruptions to climb up to the Skyfire Circlet

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: tribespeople who guided Mposo's party through the crater
introduced.quote: It was tribespeople from the Flower-Feather Clan who guided us through...

introduced.name: Tatankasaurus
introduced.how: a lonely saurian Mposo befriended who left for the volcano long ago
introduced.quote: There was a little Tatankasaurus in the tribe like this a good many years ago.

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: the first Pyro Archon who fought a war against the dragons
introduced.quote: destroyed during the war between Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, and the dragons

introduced.name: Dragon
introduced.how: ancient dragons built a satellite city inside the volcano
introduced.quote: The d—dragons built a city... inside a volcano!?

introduced.name: satellite city
introduced.how: one of the cities built around a main city to protect it, here a dragon outpost
introduced.quote: Yes, one of the cities built around the main city to protect it...

introduced.name: excavation site
introduced.how: the tribespeople's name for the ruins, which were once a dragon outpost
introduced.quote: Sure, but that wasn't always its name. That's just what the tribespeople call it these days...

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Are you from the Children of Echoes?

assumed.name: Dutse
assumed.quote: Been speaking to Dutse then, have you?

assumed.name: Duniya
assumed.quote: You must have been talking to Duniya and Dutse...

assumed.name: Saurian Relics Association
assumed.quote: The members of the Saurian Relics Association all agree that these ruins were built as a satellite city

assumed.name: Collective of Plenty
assumed.quote: as we say here in the Collective of Plenty:

threads.claim: The Flamelord's Blessing mark on the companion's head suggests it is drawn to the volcano.
threads.quote: Huh, that mark on his head... it's the Flamelord's Blessing.

threads.claim: Young saurians with marks are drawn to the Sacred Mountain as if they hear the volcano's call.
threads.quote: There are always saurians like this, who, before reaching adulthood, are drawn to the Sacred Mountain — it's like they've heard the volcano's call.

threads.claim: Mposo's Tatankasaurus friend left for the volcano, and Mposo never found it again.
threads.quote: In the end, I never found him. Instead, I... *cough*

threads.claim: Mposo's lasting cough is tied to his failed trip into the volcano.
threads.quote: I haven't been able to stop coughing since then.

threads.claim: A sealed wall of light opened on its own after golden patterns flew over, and its cause is unclear.
threads.quote: Seems like the seal opened after those golden patterns flew over here...

threads.claim: The Traveler offers that seals can loosen over time, leaving the opening unexplained.
threads.quote: It opened on its own...

threads.claim: The ruins may have been an important route into a dragon satellite city now buried under rocks.
threads.quote: For all we know, this was once an important route into the satellite city.

threads.claim: Dragons built a main city at the center of the volcano, protected by satellite cities.
threads.quote: The members of the Saurian Relics Association all agree that these ruins were built as a satellite city to protect the main dragon city located at the center of the volcano...

threads.claim: Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, went to war with the dragons and destroyed their outpost.
threads.quote: destroyed during the war between Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, and the dragons

threads.claim: The Ley Lines' strength controls how often the volcano erupts, and the current cycle is a window to enter.
threads.quote: We're currently in the middle of an eruption cycle.

threads.claim: The only way into the volcano is through the crater, which is filled with Phlogiston.
threads.quote: Yes, you can only get in by passing through the crater...

threads.claim: An eruption forms a Spiritway that leads toward the wall of light, giving a way up the volcano.
threads.quote: A Spiritway forms, leading down to where the wall of light once was

introduced.name: Tang Wuchou
introduced.how: Self-introduces as a martial artist and 320th-generation Guhua Clan disciple, who believes he is a hero
introduced.quote: I am Tang Wuchou, true disciple of the 320th Guhua Clan generation!

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: Martial arts clan with many generations of disciples, which Tang claims to belong to
introduced.quote: If any thieves dare approach, I shall surely have them taste the might of the Guhua Clan's martial arts!

introduced.name: Qingxin
introduced.how: Flower Tang is gardening, which Paimon identifies as Qingxin rather than Glaze Lily
introduced.quote: It's just that you say you want to create a Glaze Lily garden... though these flowers are actually Qingxin.

introduced.name: Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.how: Valuable jade-like gem material that is said to cause discomfort and calamity to its wearers
introduced.quote: That material was said to cause its wearers some discomfort.

introduced.name: jade pendant
introduced.how: Smaragdus Jadeite pendant Tang treats as a Guhua hereditary treasure, bought from Old Chou
introduced.quote: This jade pendant was sold to me by an old friend when we parted

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Former criminal group Old Chou and Tang once belonged to, which forced Old Chou to sell their jewelry
introduced.quote: We were both Treasure Hoarders once. We decided to part ways after making a pretty sum at The Chasm.

introduced.name: Old Chou
introduced.how: Former Treasure Hoarder who sold the pendant to Tang and now runs a treasure-digging game
introduced.quote: Ah, hello there, you two. Is there anything I can help you with?

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: Area where the Treasure Hoarders made money and where Old Chou can be found
introduced.quote: We decided to part ways after making a pretty sum at The Chasm.

introduced.name: Exploding Barrel
introduced.how: Explosive barrels buried in the treasure-digging plot; digging one up ends the game, and good spots are surrounded by them
introduced.quote: For example, tiles that turn out to be empty won't have a single explosive barrel near it, while the best stuff is probably surrounded on all four sides by such barrels.

introduced.name: treasure-hunting game
introduced.how: Old Chou's digging game on a plot of land, where finds go to Tang as compensation
introduced.quote: How about this, then? I'll let you dig for treasure once. You can give whatever you find to Tang Wuchou as compensation.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Are you really from the Guhua Clan? ...Hmm, right, do you know some guy called Xingqiu?

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Actually, they've all been captured by Millelith who infiltrated their ranks.

assumed.name: Undetected Infiltration
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Undetected Infiltration)

assumed.name: A Teapot to Call Home: Part I
assumed.quote: (If Baizhu has been talked to in A Teapot to Call Home: Part I)

assumed.name: Baizhu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon remembers Baizhu saying something about it...

assumed.name: Shenglu Hall
assumed.quote: are the materials they use the equal of Shenglu Hall? Or their designs a match for Mingxing Jewelry?

assumed.name: Mingxing Jewelry
assumed.quote: are the materials they use the equal of Shenglu Hall? Or their designs a match for Mingxing Jewelry?

assumed.name: adeptus
assumed.quote: The first day I wore it, an adeptus came to me in a dream and taught me the secret arts of the Guhua Clan.

assumed.name: Geo energy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy... Isn't this Smaragdus Jadeite?

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: If someone without a Vision is in contact with it, they will experience changes in personality

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I had to lower the price so much that I was practically losing Mora on sales.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: forced me to buy the low-quality jewelry they make here and sell it in Liyue.

threads.claim: An adeptus allegedly visited Tang in a dream and said the pendant was fated for him, an unexplained supernatural link.
threads.quote: The adeptus even said that it was fated that the pendant should have come into my possession.

threads.claim: The Smaragdus Jadeite pendant may be causing Tang's headaches, personality change and delusions.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy... Isn't this Smaragdus Jadeite?

threads.claim: Old Chou says Smaragdus Jadeite is an omen of calamity from long-term exposure, which raises the stakes for the wearer.
threads.quote: I heard the older folks say while Smaragdus Jadeite is very valuable, it is a thing of ominous portents, and that long-term exposure will bring about calamity.

threads.claim: Tang's claim to be a Guhua Clan disciple is questioned, and another man, Xingqiu, may be falsely using the Guhua name.
threads.quote: Paimon: Are you really from the Guhua Clan? ...Hmm, right, do you know some guy called Xingqiu?

threads.claim: The bird-egg-sized gem holds an unexplained shadow inside when held to light.
threads.quote: And when you hold it up against the light, you can see a shadow within! Fascinating, how very fascinating...

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders forced Old Chou into selling their low-quality jewelry and had stopped pressuring him by this point.
threads.quote: They haven't come to look for me at all recently.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders were captured by Millelith, which resolves their threat to Old Chou.
threads.quote: Actually, they've all been captured by Millelith who infiltrated their ranks.

introduced.name: Anton
introduced.how: Acting commander of the Ninth Company introduces himself as Serzhant Anton Melnikov
introduced.quote: I'm Serzhant Anton Melnikov, the... Acting CO of the Ninth Company. Just call me Anton.

introduced.name: Danila
introduced.how: One of the four surviving Ninth Company soldiers, named by Anton
introduced.quote: They are Danila, Temur, Radomir and... uh, Romanski. He's not here. He's at the... medical camp.

introduced.name: Temur
introduced.how: One of the four surviving Ninth Company soldiers, named by Anton
introduced.quote: They are Danila, Temur, Radomir and... uh, Romanski. He's not here. He's at the... medical camp.

introduced.name: Radomir
introduced.how: One of the four surviving Ninth Company soldiers, named by Anton
introduced.quote: They are Danila, Temur, Radomir and... uh, Romanski. He's not here. He's at the... medical camp.

introduced.name: Kapral Mashkov
introduced.how: A Fatui kapral who arrives accusing Anton of betrayal and demanding food
introduced.quote: Kapral Mashkov: Anton, you traitor! Have you forgotten what "secrecy" even means? Also, you there, give us all your food!

introduced.name: Katarina
introduced.how: Anton's Fatui comrade, raised in the House of the Hearth as a child of the Tsaritsa, who stayed behind in The Chasm
introduced.quote: Katarina and her younger brother, Kapral Nikolay, were brought up in the House of the Hearth. They are the children of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.

introduced.name: Nikolay
introduced.how: Katarina's younger brother, Kapral Nikolay, presumed dead in The Chasm
introduced.quote: Katarina and her younger brother, Kapral Nikolay, were brought up in the House of the Hearth. They are the children of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.

introduced.name: Pulcinella
introduced.how: A Fatui lord who is Anton's superior and will sacrifice less valuable assets for greater aims
introduced.quote: To assist in endeavors of greater meaning, Lord Pulcinella won't hesitate to dispense with less valuable assets. That's his logic.

introduced.name: Ninth Company
introduced.how: A Fatui company of 64 soldiers that came down into The Chasm and is now scattered and depleted
introduced.quote: When we first came down, we were the Ninth Company, a company of 64 soldiers.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Snezhnaya's military force that works with Liyue under a collaboration agreement to explore The Chasm
introduced.quote: According to the collaboration agreement, people up there are supposed to relay orders and supply us with food, but we haven't heard from them for a long time.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: Liyue personnel who staffed the supply stations built for collaboration with the Fatui
introduced.quote: All Millelith personnel, clerks, and miners stationed there, please leave soon!

introduced.name: Liyue Qixing
introduced.how: Liyue authority that takes over exploring The Chasm after the Fatui collaboration ends
introduced.quote: The Liyue Qixing will take over the exploration of The Chasm...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: Scavenger groups in The Chasm who attack intruders and also trade food and supplies
introduced.quote: The Treasure Hoarder Erge agreed to exchange food and other necessities for what's left of our money and military supplies...

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: Underground region where the Fatui force went to investigate the source of a calamity
introduced.quote: the only purpose we have here is to investigate the source of the calamity in The Chasm.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: Homeland of the Fatui and ancestors who defended it, shares findings with Liyue under the agreement
introduced.quote: Snezhnaya and Liyue would share whatever we were to find down here.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: Site of a recent malignant incident that led Liyue to call the Fatui dangerous and cut ties
introduced.quote: The malignant and destructive incident recently occurring at the Jade Chamber has proved that the Fatui are dangerous and untrustworthy...

introduced.name: Dark Calamity
introduced.how: A great disaster five hundred years ago that is the eternal enemy of Snezhnaya, also called the Calamity of Darkness
introduced.quote: They all mean the great disaster that occurred five hundred years ago.

introduced.name: Collaboration agreement between Snezhnaya and Liyue
introduced.how: Fatui and Liyue agreed to share findings and let an advance Fatui team into The Chasm
introduced.quote: And one of the additional conditions was that Liyue would allow the Fatui to send an advance team into The Chasm...

assumed.name: Kapitan
assumed.quote: Ever since the Kapitan went missing, you've been acting like an important-looking CO. Hah!

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: You're no longer welcome in Liyue Harbor, I fear.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: What do you want? Supplies, weapons, intel, or Mora — we've plenty of them.

assumed.name: Signora
assumed.quote: Signora even nailed a few mutually beneficial trade agreements.

assumed.name: Yanbo
assumed.quote: Ah, it's from Yanbo. I got it.

assumed.name: Lord Harbingers
assumed.quote: We're loyal to the Fatui and Lord Harbingers — as we should be — but we're no fools.

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: They are the children of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.

assumed.name: Seven-Star Array
assumed.quote: Someone seems to have dispelled the Seven-Star Array. I need more information...

assumed.name: Lost in a Foreign Land (Quest)
assumed.quote: Traveler: About Katarina... (Unlocked by completing Lost in a Foreign Land)

threads.claim: A calamity five hundred years ago is ongoing, with a war against the dark still raging beneath the Chasm.
threads.quote: The calamity that happened five hundred years ago is only the beginning. The war against the dark has never stopped, and one of its battlefields is right beneath our feet.

threads.claim: The Calamity of Darkness has lurked in the dark for five hundred years and the Fatui must stay on guard forever.
threads.quote: For five hundred years, the calamity has been lurking in the dark and we'll be on guard forever.

threads.claim: Katarina went looking for her brother Nikolay in the depths, though others doubt he could still be alive.
threads.quote: She told me that she was going to find her brother.

threads.claim: Katarina volunteered to stay behind in The Chasm and kept searching for Nikolay despite Anton's doubts.
threads.quote: But she insisted on looking for Kolya... I hope she can forgive me.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests Katarina's situation is better than Anton believes.
threads.quote: The situation she's in is not so bad as you think.

threads.claim: The Fatui and Liyue collaboration was set up with shared findings and an advance team sent into The Chasm.
threads.quote: And one of the additional conditions was that Liyue would allow the Fatui to send an advance team into The Chasm...

threads.claim: The collaboration between the Fatui and Liyue has ended, and the Fatui are no longer allies of Liyue.
threads.quote: There are no allies anymore. No more collaboration... To be precise, the Fatui are no longer in a collaborative relationship with Liyue.

threads.claim: A destructive incident at the Jade Chamber led Liyue to declare the Fatui dangerous and cut ties with them.
threads.quote: The malignant and destructive incident recently occurring at the Jade Chamber has proved that the Fatui are dangerous and untrustworthy...

threads.claim: Fatui forces on the ground attacked Liyue Harbor, which Anton says follows from Pulcinella's logic.
threads.quote: Traveler: But your people on the ground attacked Liyue Harbor.

threads.claim: The Kapitan, the Ninth Company's commander, has gone missing, leaving Anton as acting commander.
threads.quote: Ever since the Kapitan went missing, you've been acting like an important-looking CO. Hah!

threads.claim: Someone has dispelled the Seven-Star Array, and the Fatui are unsure who or why.
threads.quote: Someone seems to have dispelled the Seven-Star Array. I need more information...

threads.claim: The Fatui came into The Chasm to find and eradicate the source of the calamity, which Paimon has not seen signs of.
threads.quote: the only purpose we have here is to investigate the source of the calamity in The Chasm.

threads.claim: Pulcinella is willing to sacrifice his subordinates for greater aims, and Anton accepts this.
threads.quote: To assist in endeavors of greater meaning, Lord Pulcinella won't hesitate to dispense with less valuable assets. That's his logic.

threads.claim: Clitopho, the Fatui's Treasure Hoarder contact, has gone missing, cutting off their supplies.
threads.quote: Clitopho, our contact from the Treasure Hoarders, went missing. As a result, our supplies are cut off for now...

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: the inn's chef, asked by the innkeeper to create a new dish to attract guests
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: The other day, the innkeeper asked me to prepare a new dish that would attract more guests.

introduced.name: innkeeper
introduced.how: the inn's boss, hard to please, rejects every dish Yanxiao makes
introduced.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: ...But he would shake his head at everything and ask me to give it another thought.

introduced.name: Jiangxue
introduced.how: a regular freeloader at the inn who eats there daily, a former swordsman who came to the inn after a past quest
introduced.quote: Jiangxue: Huh? I see that we have a special guest today. Usually, it's just that chef and I, eating in silence.

introduced.name: Chicken Tofu Pudding
introduced.how: a delicate meat dish that imitates vegetarian tofu pudding, which requires swordsmanship and minced meat
introduced.quote: Jiangxue: By the looks of it, you wouldn't say that it's a meat dish. It really is as delicate as tofu pudding, but with a strong flavor of meat and herbs.

introduced.name: Jiangxue's quest for justice
introduced.how: Jiangxue once sought someone out to demand justice, and after it was done she came to the inn
introduced.quote: Jiangxue: To look for someone and to ask for justice, that's all.

assumed.name: Jiangxue as the inn's regular freeloader
assumed.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Ah, right! I still gotta cook something for that freeloader. It's about time he came around...

assumed.name: Traveler's past sword feats
assumed.quote: Jiangxue: You're also a skilled swordsman, aren't you? I've witnessed some of your feats myself.

assumed.name: Matsutake Scrambled Eggs
assumed.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Had I known sooner, I wouldn't have made those Matsutake Scrambled Eggs...

assumed.name: elemental attacks used on the stove
assumed.quote: (After performing a Hydro attack on the stove)

threads.claim: The innkeeper, who judges the dishes, has not yet arrived and his verdict is still pending.
threads.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: Hmm... Well, let's put this dish aside. We can show it to the innkeeper once he gets here.

threads.claim: Yanxiao may be losing his cooking job at the inn, making this meal possibly his last there.
threads.quote: Smiley Yanxiao: You'd better enjoy the food because that might've been the last meal I got to cook here...

threads.claim: The unnamed chef who created Chicken Tofu Pudding is a mysterious figure who was confident few could make it.
threads.quote: Jiangxue: The chef who came up with this recipe didn't mind sharing it with me.

threads.claim: The recipe for Chicken Tofu Pudding seems to demand sword mastery, which hints at a hidden sword technique.
threads.quote: Jiangxue: No doubt about it. According to chat chef, those who attempt to make the dish, have to be not only skilled in the art of cooking, but also in the art of the sword.

threads.claim: Jiangxue admits the recipe contained no secret swordsmanship, so her obsession with its sword art was a misunderstanding.
threads.quote: Jiangxue: Now that I think about it, I must have been an absolute madman. It was just a recipe, why would there be anything about swordsmanship in it?

threads.claim: Jiangxue's past sword training was driven by a quest for justice against someone, which she has since completed.
threads.quote: Jiangxue: Haha. Well, once I'd exacted that justice, I came here. Thankfully, the innkeeper was willing to take me in and let me loaf about the place.

threads.claim: Jiangxue says she has given up her sword and desires, content to stay at the inn for life.
threads.quote: Jiangxue: I am now free of desire. I no longer wish to wield my sword, nor do I have any other skills... Hahaha, I suppose staying here for the rest of my life isn't so bad.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild official who is overseeing the Guild's response and is worried about Jack
introduced.quote: Thank you! I must oversee the situation here at the Guild, or I would have gone myself.

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: young adventurer who volunteered to go to the Thousand Winds Temple and has been missing since
introduced.quote: He volunteered to go to the Thousand Winds Temple, but we haven't heard from him since.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: group in charge of the city's internal security, mobilizing its full strength
introduced.quote: The Knights are in charge of internal security, but those foolish monsters outside the city walls are the specialty of the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: organization that handles monsters outside the city walls and sends its experienced members to investigate
introduced.quote: The Guild's experienced hands have all been sent to various places to investigate.

introduced.name: Adventure Ranking test
introduced.how: a test that adventurers take to earn an Adventure Ranking
introduced.quote: I actually came to the Thousand Winds Temple because I'm soon to take an Adventure Ranking test...

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: You've seen the tempests that Stormterror's kicked up in Mondstadt, haven't you?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: You've seen the tempests that Stormterror's kicked up in Mondstadt, haven't you?

assumed.name: Thousand Winds Temple
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Traveler, if you are willing, could you help me go to the Thousand Winds Temple to look for Jack?

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: I discovered a group of hilichurls congregating in the camp ahead, and suspected that they might be up to something.

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Where has that kid Bennett run off to? *sigh* At a moment like this, no less...

threads.claim: Stormterror is stirring up tempests across Mondstadt, and the cause of them is still unexplained.
threads.quote: You've seen the tempests that Stormterror's kicked up in Mondstadt, haven't you?

threads.claim: The hilichurls are gathering in growing numbers and may be plotting something larger.
threads.quote: Their numbers are increasing. We can't let their plans come to fruition.

threads.claim: Bennett has disappeared at a critical time, and his whereabouts and safety are unknown.
threads.quote: I hope he didn't run into any trouble...

threads.claim: Jack has gone missing after travelling to the Thousand Winds Temple and has not been heard from since.
threads.quote: He volunteered to go to the Thousand Winds Temple, but we haven't heard from him since.

threads.claim: Jack is found injured after being trapped by hilichurls, which answers the question of where he went.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's Jack! Quick, we need to rescue him!

threads.claim: Jack hides from Cyrus that he went to the temple to prepare for his ranking test, and asks the Traveler to keep it secret.
threads.quote: C—Could I ask you not to tell Cyrus about this?

introduced.name: Chayka
introduced.how: aide who sends the Traveler tasks by letter and assists the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, another letter from Chayka! Let's see what task she has for us this time.

introduced.name: Tartaglia
introduced.how: toy salesman whose trade is a cover, who travels abroad for special channels
introduced.quote: Tartaglia: ...You know "toy salesman" is just a cover, right?

introduced.name: Teucer
introduced.how: younger sibling of Tartaglia who lives in Morepesok
introduced.quote: Teucer: Brother, you never told us your biggest competitor in the toy business... was the Tsaritsa!

introduced.name: Danica
introduced.how: figure close to the Tsaritsa who insists she keep up appearances as the kingdom's face
introduced.quote: Danica likes to say, "The Tsaritsa is the face of the kingdom," so she refuses to let me cut too much on food and clothing.

introduced.name: Morepesok
introduced.how: town where Tartaglia's family lives and where he can be found
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hm... Let's go to Morepesok. We should be able to find him there.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: palace where the Tsaritsa holds her office
introduced.quote: (Enter Zapolyarny Palace)

introduced.name: Gobblefin
introduced.how: a cute moving toy that children like to keep as a companion
introduced.quote: Tartaglia: No problem. It's right here. It's called, "Gobblefin."

introduced.name: Snezhnaya toy production halt
introduced.how: toy production in Snezhnaya was stopped for a long time by material shortages
introduced.quote: You might not know, but due to material shortages, toy production in Snezhnaya has been put on hold for quite some time.

assumed.name: Heavenly Principles
assumed.quote: In this instance, dwelling on whether my will and emotions have been influenced by the Heavenly Principles is ultimately meaningless.

assumed.name: Traveler's earlier Gobblefin delivery
assumed.quote: Teucer: Just like the "Gobblefin" you brought back for us that one time! The kids next door are always asking to play with it.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa wonders whether the Heavenly Principles have influenced her own will and emotions.
threads.quote: In this instance, dwelling on whether my will and emotions have been influenced by the Heavenly Principles is ultimately meaningless.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa cannot tell whether her subjects actually like the gifts she gives them.
threads.quote: Whenever I arrange a gift for a subject, the recipient is always grateful, but I find myself unable to discern whether they actually like it.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa watches the Gobblefin move and starts to wonder how the toy works for children.
threads.quote: Anastasya: ...Is this how it works?

threads.claim: Resource scarcity has stopped toy production in Snezhnaya and pushed families to buy toys abroad.
threads.quote: When resources are scarce, toys are always the first to go.

threads.claim: Tartaglia's toy salesman job is a cover for other work he does abroad.
threads.quote: Tartaglia: ...You know "toy salesman" is just a cover, right?

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa cuts her personal spending to fund the toy production line for children.
threads.quote: I have already discussed it with Danica, and I've decided to reduce my personal expenses so those funds can be used for more meaningful purposes.

introduced.name: Wind glider
introduced.how: a glider gift; adventurers use wing gliders to cross the vast space between sky and land
introduced.quote: While the vast space between the two is reserved for adventurers wearing wing gliders.

introduced.name: Longplume Ibis
introduced.how: birds Columbina can send out to deliver gifts to friends
introduced.quote: (The Ibises take off in different directions to fulfill her request)

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Columbina: Do you still remember the first time you came here together?

assumed.name: Ineffa
assumed.quote: Columbina: Yes. I asked Ineffa for some basic recipes, and have made several attempts.

assumed.name: Luonnotar
assumed.quote: (Luonnotar appears beside Columbina)

assumed.name: Kuuhenki
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh. Are those kuuhenki... lining up? For soup that Columbina's serving?

assumed.name: Lauma
assumed.quote: Paimon: In that case, Lauma definitely knew the krumkakes and wreath on her desk came from you.

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Columbina: It seems Jahoda got quite the fright, though... Perhaps we shouldn't have slipped the gifts directly behind her...

assumed.name: Aino
assumed.quote: Traveler: Aino just got straight to snacking...

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: (Some time passes as they deliver the gifts and return to Silvermoon Hall)

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Columbina: As for our other friends who aren't in Nod-Krai, I'm counting on you to deliver their gifts.

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: Traveler: Better than the Moon-Prayer Night candies, even.

threads.claim: Columbina had lost power that food could not fully restore, hinting at an unexplained past event.
threads.quote: Columbina: Though the food couldn't do much to replenish the power I had lost, eating it did make me feel more relaxed.

threads.claim: Columbina comes to see that the warmth and kindness behind food matter more than the food itself.
threads.quote: Columbina: What I enjoyed was not simply the food itself, but the warmth and kindness in the hands that made it.

threads.claim: Columbina repays the earlier kindness she received by cooking and sending gifts to her friends.
threads.quote: Columbina: Indeed. But now that I understand all this, I'd like to do a little more... It's a wonderful feeling.

threads.claim: A saying holds that the skies belong to birds and the land to beasts, leaving the space between to glider-wearing adventurers.
threads.quote: Columbina: I've heard it said that the skies belong to the birds, and the land, to the beasts...

threads.claim: Luonnotar appears silently beside Columbina, raising an open question about this unexplained figure.
threads.quote: (Luonnotar appears beside Columbina)

introduced.name: Merusea Village
introduced.how: a village where Melusines live and where Neuvillette regularly sends gifts to residents
introduced.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette is always sending gifts to everyone in Merusea Village

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: the building where Neuvillette's office is, with the Iudex's office inside it

introduced.quote: Flo handled the blueprints, and then we all picked out the materials and sewed it together

introduced.quote: Mr. Iaune keeps his nose so firmly to the grindstone that he seldom has a chance to look up and register all the Palais Mermonia's esteemed visitors

introduced.name: Sedile

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: an organization whose officers, like Sedile, are known to be intense

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine

introduced.quote: It was after I was born, but before I had joined the Court of Fontaine.

introduced.name: vishap

introduced.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette warned us that while some vishaps are super friendly, others can be really dangerous, so we shouldn't get too close.

introduced.name: Pahsiv
introduced.how: a vishap who can take Melusine form, helped Puca, and loves Tidalga
introduced.quote: Neuvillette: Puca, allow me to introduce you. This here is the nice vishap... Err, nice vishap lady who helped you before.

introduced.name: Tidalga
introduced.how: an ingredient used for dye that vishaps like to eat
introduced.quote: I'm not sure if I have enough Tidalga for the dye, either...

introduced.name: Beryl Conch
introduced.how: shells found in the waters near Merusea that can be ground into shiny powder
introduced.quote: Then... Could you please help me find some of the shiniest, brightest Beryl Conches?

introduced.name: Xiao Lantern
introduced.how: lanterns from Liyue made of fire wrapped in paper, which Neuvillette says cannot grant wishes
introduced.quote: They aren't dangerous if properly handled, but they do not actually have the power to grant wishes

introduced.name: Neuvillette's birth in human form
introduced.how: Neuvillette was born in human form, which forced him to learn how humans live
introduced.quote: Though I do not know why I was born with human form, this fact forced me to learn about the way humans live.

assumed.name: Puca
assumed.quote: Puca: Oh! , Paimon, it's you! Long time no see!

assumed.name: Melusines

assumed.name: Mamere
assumed.quote: Does it count if we ask Mamere to make a huge painting

assumed.name: Cyno
assumed.quote: We'll have to tell Cyno first chance we get.

assumed.name: Garde
assumed.quote: call the Gardes

assumed.name: Exchange! Pahsiv!
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Exchange! Pahsiv!)

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: I've heard that Liyue has fire wrapped in paper

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale

assumed.name: New Valet
assumed.quote: Wait, does this mean the legendary

assumed.name: Cornelia
assumed.quote: The tea Miss Cornelia so kindly made for us is nearly cold

threads.claim: Pahsiv's repeated New Valet phrase is hinted to refer to a legendary figure tied to Neuvillette.
threads.quote: Wait, does this mean the legendary

threads.claim: The New Valet phrase is revealed to be what Pahsiv meant, linking it to Pahsiv herself.
threads.quote: Paimon: That's what she meant!? Oh... And to think that it used to keep Paimon up at night

threads.claim: Vishaps can be friendly or dangerous, and the Iudex has warned people to keep their distance.
threads.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette warned us that while some vishaps are super friendly, others can be really dangerous, so we shouldn't get too close.

threads.claim: A vishap appears and eats a giant crab, showing its protective and mysterious nature.
threads.quote: Good thing this vishap showed up! Gobbled that nasty crab right up!

threads.claim: Pahsiv shows that vishaps can take Melusine form.
threads.quote: Whoa, vishaps can turn into Melusines? That's so cool!

threads.claim: A pile of Tidalga appears nearby with no known source, leaving its benefactor a mystery.
threads.quote: Did some kind soul overhear us and leave it here?

threads.claim: Neuvillette was born in human form for reasons he does not know.
threads.quote: Though I do not know why I was born with human form, this fact forced me to learn about the way humans live.

threads.claim: Neuvillette's learning about humans began long ago, soon after his birth.
threads.quote: And now that I think about it, this learning process actually began a long, long time ago...

threads.claim: Neuvillette questions why humans use a god's flesh and blood as a medium of exchange instead of stones or shells.
threads.quote: And why they insisted on using the flesh and blood of a god as a medium of exchange.

threads.claim: Melusines perceive Neuvillette differently from one another, so his appearance varies by viewer.
threads.quote: Monsieur Neuvillette actually looks a bit different to every Melusine, so we split the difference.

threads.claim: Neuvillette suggests the world may transform again in the future.
threads.quote: Perhaps in the future, we'll witness the world transform once more.

threads.claim: Neuvillette offers a cryptic saying that time shows the way to those who are lost.
threads.quote: Time flows where our gaze does not linger, showing the way to those who are lost.

threads.claim: Neuvillette finds contentment in seeing others use his gifts, suggesting he is learning human feelings.
threads.quote: Seeing others use gifts I've given them gives me a feeling of contentment.

threads.claim: Neuvillette corrects the rumor that Xiao Lanterns can grant wishes, stating they do not have that power.
threads.quote: They aren't dangerous if properly handled, but they do not actually have the power to grant wishes

assumed.name: lighthouse
assumed.quote: If those memories are correct, this middle patch should be where that lighthouse was.

threads.claim: Paimon's recollection of a location may be wrong, hinting that memory is unreliable.
threads.quote: If those memories are correct, this middle patch should be where that lighthouse was.

introduced.name: Tubby
introduced.how: a teapot spirit who cannot recall her own name and asks to be called Tubby
introduced.quote: No, I can't quite remember my name. You can just call me "Tubby," I suppose.

introduced.name: Teapot spirits
introduced.how: adepti create teapot spirits to manage teapot realms, but these spirits can move beyond those realms
introduced.quote: Although the adepti created teapot spirits primarily to manage and maintain their teapot realms, our movements are not restricted to those domains.

introduced.name: Chubby
introduced.how: a traveler nicknamed Jade Seeker who roams far and wide gathering rare treasures
introduced.quote: there's Chubby— I'm sorry, "Jade Seeker," who travels far and wide to gather the rarest treasures in the land.

introduced.name: Genius Invokation TCG
introduced.how: a popular card game in which inviting friends to tavern duels is a common pastime
introduced.quote: with the rising popularity of Genius Invokation TCG, inviting a friend to a duel in the tavern has become a fun way to pass the time.

introduced.name: Game room
introduced.how: a duel room built by Tubby that lets invited friends appear instantly from anywhere
introduced.quote: That way, anyone with an invitation will need only to think the thought, and they will instantly appear in the game room.

introduced.name: Adeptus arts
introduced.how: the adeptus art used to construct teapot realms is also used to build the new game room
introduced.quote: using the same adeptus art as is used to construct teapot realms.

introduced.name: Margaret's tavern size request
introduced.how: Margaret once asked Tubby to double the tavern's size, which Tubby could not do
introduced.quote: She was quite enthusiastic: "Ooh, Liyue's adepti arts sound pretty useful! Could you double the size of the tavern while you're at it?"

assumed.name: The Cat's Tail
assumed.quote: Wait, isn't that Tubby? What's she doing in The Cat's Tail!?

assumed.name: Margaret
assumed.quote: But... What if Margaret finds out?

assumed.name: Serenitea Pot
assumed.quote: Wait, and how'd you get out of the Serenitea Pot? You can do that?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: I actually came here all the way from Liyue...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Don't think we've seen you around Mondstadt before...

assumed.name: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
assumed.quote: (If the player met Tubby during A Teapot to Call Home: Part II)

threads.claim: Tubby cannot remember her own name, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: No, I can't quite remember my name.

threads.claim: Tubby was sent to the tavern by someone for a reason tied to the card game.
threads.quote: Indeed not, although it may surprise you to learn that the reason I was sent here still has to do with the card game.

threads.claim: Tubby's mission is revealed to be building a game room for invitation-based duels.
threads.quote: I have therefore been sent here to create a little game room using the same adeptus art as is used to construct teapot realms.

threads.claim: Teapot spirits are not confined to their teapot realms and can travel freely.
threads.quote: our movements are not restricted to those domains.

threads.claim: Chubby goes by another name, Jade Seeker, and roams the land collecting rare treasures.
threads.quote: there's Chubby— I'm sorry, "Jade Seeker," who travels far and wide to gather the rarest treasures in the land.

threads.claim: Adeptus arts can construct spaces that let people appear anywhere instantly, extending beyond teapot realms.
threads.quote: That way, anyone with an invitation will need only to think the thought, and they will instantly appear in the game room.

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: first on-screen appearance as the tea party host, speaking under the name Marionette
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hiya, Sandrone!

introduced.name: portable tea table
introduced.how: Sandrone's newly developed invention, a portable tea table that can be stored and hovers
introduced.quote: Marionette: Hehe, impressive, right? This is my newly developed portable tea table.

assumed.name: Fagio
assumed.quote: Marionette: It's easy to carry and store, and even equipped with a hover device, just like Fagio.

assumed.name: Fontinalia Festival
assumed.quote: Marionette: Don't mention it. You helped me out a lot during the Fontinalia Festival. Consider this as thanks.

threads.claim: Sandrone says holding on to what one already has is not the only way to preserve what is precious, a theme she has raised before.
threads.quote: Marionette: I've said this before. Holding on to what you already have isn't the only way to preserve what's precious.

introduced.name: Stevens
introduced.how: a history enthusiast and researcher who reads ancient annals and wants the journals
introduced.quote: Stevens: Once, on a research trip, I read some ancient historical annals.

introduced.name: Ancient Investigation Journal
introduced.how: records left behind by someone who investigated the mountain area, valuable as historical sources
introduced.quote: Paimon: Seems like some sort of records left behind by someone who once investigated the area.

introduced.name: aristocrats' mountain investigation
introduced.how: a team sent by the aristocrats long ago to investigate the mountain, with no record of what they found
introduced.quote: Stevens: I remember one of them, from before the time of the Knights of Favonius, talked about a team sent by the aristocrats to investigate the mountain.

introduced.name: investigation sites on the mountain
introduced.how: the team investigated three sites, where the journals are hidden
introduced.quote: Stevens: Based on what I'm reading here... The team investigated three sites in total.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Stevens: I remember one of them, from before the time of the Knights of Favonius, talked about a team sent by the aristocrats to investigate the mountain.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Aristocracy
assumed.quote: Stevens: I remember one of them, from before the time of the Knights of Favonius, talked about a team sent by the aristocrats to investigate the mountain.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Stevens: Well, all the evidence — or lack thereof — would suggest that not one member of the investigation returned to Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Stevens: Since there is no record of his return in Mondstadt, however... The million-Mora question is: Where did he go?

threads.claim: The annals strangely omit what the aristocrats' investigation team found on the mountain.
