threads.quote: Stevens: For some reason, though, the annals provide next to no details about what the investigation team found...

threads.claim: Not one member of the investigation team seems to have returned to Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Stevens: Well, all the evidence — or lack thereof — would suggest that not one member of the investigation returned to Mondstadt.

threads.claim: The journals explain why the investigation is so poorly recorded elsewhere and why the annals stop at the team's departure.
threads.quote: Stevens: Now, we finally have answers to the questions of why so little information on the investigation appears elsewhere

threads.claim: Eberhart's whereabouts after the expedition remain unknown and unrecorded in Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Stevens: Eberhart... Where did you go...

threads.claim: Ancient mechanisms in the ruins shut down on their own and must be activated in a specific way.
threads.quote: Paimon: Um... These mechanisms shut down on their own.

introduced.name: Vesna
introduced.how: A court official who executes the Tsaritsa's military and state-affair decrees
introduced.quote: Vesna: Her Majesty issues many decrees. The ones regarding military and state affairs are executed by me and Danica respectively.

introduced.name: Danica
introduced.how: A long-serving aide to the Tsaritsa who handles state-affair decrees and distrusts outsiders
introduced.quote: Danica: But, I have served by Her Majesty's side for many years.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: The nation's leader, described as a god who rules the land of Cryo
introduced.quote: Anastasya: I am the Tsaritsa, the god that rules over the land of Cryo...

introduced.name: Harbinger
introduced.how: Ministers of the court who are close to the people but tied to the Tsaritsa's interests
introduced.quote: Anastasya: There are those among them that are well-informed and close to the people.

introduced.name: Chayka
introduced.how: The Tsaritsa's secretary, to whom questions and audience requests are directed
introduced.quote: Anastasya: Chayka is my secretary. You may direct any and all future questions to her.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: The palace where the throne room and the Tsaritsa's court are located
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon did find it a bit weird when we were looking at the map just now... There's a prize waiting for us at Zapolyarny Palace of all places?

introduced.name: An Invitation From Vesna
introduced.how: A letter inviting the Traveler to claim a prize after passing a special selection process
introduced.quote: Congratulations, oh famed ! You've just passed a special selection process, and now it's time to claim your reward

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: something almost everyone in Snezhnaya dreams of obtaining!

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Traveler: Then, why not put your Harbingers up to the task?

assumed.name: Cryo
assumed.quote: the god that rules over the land of Cryo

assumed.name: The Traveler's past deeds
assumed.quote: Vesna: C'mon, Danica. You've seen what 's capable of.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa admits that knowing her nation's history and decrees does not mean she truly understands it.
threads.quote: Anastasya: But does that mean I truly understand this nation?

threads.claim: Danica doubts the Traveler, who answers to no one, will carry out the Tsaritsa's orders without hesitation.
threads.quote: Danica: Yet comes and goes as pleases, and answers to no one. How can we be sure will execute Her Majesty's orders without hesitation?

threads.claim: The Traveler refuses to serve the court but offers to help as a friend.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...I have no intention of becoming a servant of your court. But, if you'll let me... I'm more than happy to help as a friend.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa cannot be seen to favor one minister's opinion over the others because of her throne.
threads.quote: Anastasya: Nor can I be seen to favor the opinion of one minister over those of the others. Yet another limitation of my throne.

threads.claim: Because the Traveler will not swear fealty, the Traveler is given the title of Consultant instead of becoming a vassal.
threads.quote: Anastasya: Note this down. Since not wish to swear fealty to the court, shall have the title of

threads.claim: Each new nation the Traveler enters draws them into a fate-altering event after another.
threads.quote: Traveler: Every time you step into a new nation, you always seem to get embroiled in one fate-altering event after another.

introduced.name: Childish Jiang
introduced.how: A lonely child whose parents are often away, who wants to play hide-and-seek with the Traveler
introduced.quote: Childish Jiang: So bored... Need someone to play with...

introduced.name: Mt. Tianheng
introduced.how: The mountain where Childish Jiang lives and plays hide-and-seek
introduced.quote: (Talk to Childish Jiang near Mt. Tianheng)

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: A people Childish Jiang's father belongs to, known for being stealthy
introduced.quote: My daddy's a Millelith, and he says that there's no one better than him at being stealthy.

introduced.name: hide-and-seek
introduced.how: A simple hiding-and-finding game the Traveler plays with Childish Jiang, with hints and timed challenges
introduced.quote: Do you wanna play with me? We can play hide-and-seek, it's really easy, anyone can play it.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Daddy's even hidden a load of cool stuff here like snacks, wine, and even some Mora!

threads.claim: Childish Jiang's parents rarely come home, hinting at an unexplained family situation.
threads.quote: Mom and dad don't have time to come home and play with me, so I have to play here all by myself.

threads.claim: Childish Jiang's mother never finds him even after days, and the child wonders why his parents have not come looking.
threads.quote: I'd have thought that Mommy or Daddy would've found me by now, after such a long time...

threads.claim: Childish Jiang heard many unidentified people climbing the mountain, raising an unanswered question about who they were.
threads.quote: Then, I heard loads of people walking up the mountain...

threads.claim: A man once brought food to Childish Jiang and refused any repayment, an unexplained act the child cannot understand.
threads.quote: This one time, a guy brought some food for me, and I wanted to repay him too, but he wouldn't take it. I have no idea why...

introduced.name: Juza
introduced.how: gruff crew member who is loud and hard of hearing but kind at heart
introduced.quote: Yinxing: He also speaks a bit loudly on account of his poor hearing... but he's really a good person at heart.

introduced.name: Yinxing
introduced.how: crew member who calms Juza and assigns errands to the Traveler
introduced.quote: Yinxing: Alright, stop scaring people. If Beidou found out you were just tying up anyone who came in, you'd be the one being dealt with.

introduced.name: Little Yue
introduced.how: young crew member who is stuck on the ship and wants to go into the city
introduced.quote: Yinxing: But we still need to get new clothes for Little Yue. He's grown out of his old ones.

introduced.name: Changchang
introduced.how: child who waits to play with Little Yue and has a daddy who visits by boat
introduced.quote: Changchang: When my daddy comes back, I'll ask him to take me to the ship Little Yue is on.

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: city contact who sells supplies to the ship and can send them out
introduced.quote: Yinxing: Last time I was in the city, I paid Bolai to buy some supplies in advance for when I returned.

introduced.name: Guyun Stone Forest
introduced.how: distant shoreline spot where the ship is anchored, far from the city
introduced.quote: Bolai: Guyun Stone Forest... That's a long way, I will probably need to hire a boat to get there.

introduced.name: Starconches
introduced.how: shells found on the shore that Little Yue uses to make a toy
introduced.quote: Little Yue: Find some Starconches for me on the shore. I think... three will be enough.

introduced.name: Beidou's fleet
introduced.how: the rest of Beidou's ships are out patrolling at sea and cannot help the ship at anchor
introduced.quote: Yinxing: We can't leave the ship without her orders, and the rest of the fleet is on patrol at sea, so they can't help us now...

introduced.name: Fish
introduced.how: the only fresh food available at sea, which the crew is tired of eating
introduced.quote: Juza: Fish? Forget it... The only fresh thing we can get when at sea is fish, fish, fish... We've had our fill.

assumed.name: Beidou
assumed.quote: Yinxing: Alright, what's all the ruckus? You pretending to be important when Beidou's not around again?

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Juza: As soon as we returned from Inazuma, Beidou had us anchor the ship here while she went into Liyue Harbor.

threads.claim: Captain Beidou has been absent and deep in thought, leaving the ship anchored and its crew stuck on board.
threads.quote: Yinxing: But it seems that she's been deep in thought recently. Keep your eyes open and try not to disturb her.

threads.claim: Juza plans to go into the city to look for Beidou because she has been gone so long and the ship is stuck by Guyun Stone Forest.
threads.quote: Juza: But she's been gone for so long now, it's not good to just be stuck here by Guyun Stone Forest.

threads.claim: The Traveler says they help people solve problems for a living, which Juza seems to understand in a hinted, unspoken way.
threads.quote: Traveler: I help people solve problems for a living.

introduced.name: Mitya
introduced.how: family friend of the winery owners, on vacation, part-owner of the winery, sent to fix soil problems with a machine from the Commission
introduced.quote: The couple who run this winery are old family friends. I happened to be on vacation recently, and the lady of the house reached out to ask for my help with a little problem.

introduced.name: Sezhna
introduced.how: Domovoy woman who runs the winery with her husband and treats Mitya like a son
introduced.quote: Mitya: Madame Sezhna!

introduced.name: Urkin
introduced.how: Domovoy man, Sezhna's husband, who runs the winery's small workshop with her
introduced.quote: Welcome, children. First time visiting the little workshop of an old Domovoy couple?

introduced.name: Domovoy
introduced.how: a people whose houses have small doors and who run the winery
introduced.quote: Domovoy houses tend to have rather small doors.

introduced.name: Galov
introduced.how: factory worker who helps install the processing furnace and says the factory has room
introduced.quote: Galov: No worries, space is the one thing our factory isn't short on.

introduced.name: Lanternberry
introduced.how: fruit grown in the winery orchard whose juice flavors the wine
introduced.quote: Mitya: All these trees belong to the winery. That's where the fruit I talked about earlier grow. They add the juice to their wine, making it more aromatic.

introduced.name: Kresnik Kristall
introduced.how: crystal that grows on the orchard trees in a symbiotic relationship with them, found only in this area
introduced.quote: Mitya: The crystals cover the trees, with the two forming a peculiar symbiotic relationship — something you can only see around here.

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: was once known for producing a rare, high-quality crystal that merchants wanted for jewelry
introduced.quote: Mitya: Jewelers say that Liyue used to produce this rare crystal of unique color and top-notch quality.

introduced.name: Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya
introduced.how: organization that lent Mitya the soil-improvement machine and has few machines like it
introduced.quote: The machine I borrowed from the Commission is designed to improve soil quality.

introduced.name: Detection Core
introduced.how: Mitya's Elemental Skill outside combat places one that keeps breaking apart nearby rocks
introduced.quote: When Mitya uses his Elemental Skill outside of combat, he places a Detection Core that continually breaks apart rocks within a certain radius.

introduced.name: monitoring device
introduced.how: devices the Traveler activates by striking them to keep their energy in range while they record data
introduced.quote: Strike the monitoring device with attacks to regulate its energy.

introduced.name: processing furnace
introduced.how: large machine component of the soil machine that must be installed and is not yet fully automated
introduced.quote: There's one more important component, the processing furnace.

introduced.name: main console
introduced.how: control console of the soil machine that needs someone watching it at all times
introduced.quote: The one in the room is the main console. It needs someone watching over it at all times.

introduced.name: earthquake rockfall
introduced.how: an earthquake dropped rock piles around the orchard trees, which must be cleared
introduced.quote: They fell here after an earthquake and were left where they lie amongst the trees.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Mitya: Hmm... the fruit juice content is probably lower than what you get in Mondstadt's fruit wines.

assumed.name: Mondstadter
assumed.quote: Paimon: Sounds like it'd be right up a Mondstadter's alley!

assumed.name: Valeriy
assumed.quote: Mitya: Mr. Valeriy's bought this type of wine before. He didn't strike me as the fruit wine-enjoying type, but he proved quite interested in this winery's products.

assumed.name: Snezhnograd
assumed.quote: Sezhna: *sigh* Mitya my boy, sorry for calling you all the way from Snezhnograd to these fields... Why, you're supposed to be on vacation.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: It seems the cause is connected to changes occurring throughout Snezhnaya as whole.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Mitya: You might even get something more valuable than Mora in exchange.

threads.claim: The winery's soil has been getting worse and is hurting production.
threads.quote: The soil around here has been getting worse, and it's started affecting production.

threads.claim: Clearing the rocks regularly is necessary, since otherwise crops and soil keep suffering.
threads.quote: Mitya: As you can see, the winery has to clear these rocks regularly. Otherwise, both the crops and the soil quality in this area will continue to suffer.

threads.claim: The soil decline may be tied to changes happening across Snezhnaya as a whole.
threads.quote: It seems the cause is connected to changes occurring throughout Snezhnaya as whole.

threads.claim: Kresnik Kristall and the trees have a symbiotic bond seen only in this region.
threads.quote: Mitya: The crystals cover the trees, with the two forming a peculiar symbiotic relationship — something you can only see around here.

threads.claim: The story of Liyue's Archaic Stones is unverified, leaving its truth an open question.
threads.quote: Mitya: I never really had the chance to verify the story myself, but perhaps you've heard of it?

threads.claim: The new furnace's energy output is unstable and Mitya is not comfortable operating it.
threads.quote: The energy output hasn't been very stable.

threads.claim: A borrowed Commission machine is meant to fix the soil, but its operation is delicate.
threads.quote: The machine I borrowed from the Commission is designed to improve soil quality.

threads.claim: The machine is newly set up and needs someone to watch over it while it is not yet automated.
threads.quote: The machine has just been set up and isn't fully automated yet, so it needs someone to keep an eye on it.

threads.claim: Collected monitoring data is being used to adjust the main console settings for the machine.
threads.quote: Thanks to your help, I've finished organizing the relevant data.

introduced.name: Zhen Qiang
introduced.how: an inn staff member who stays downstairs to receive goods and asks the Traveler to deliver a gift upstairs
introduced.quote: Zhen Qiang: I need to stay down here to receive goods. There's a lot of goods to receive, and I daren't make any mistakes.

introduced.name: Huai'an
introduced.how: the innkeeper ('the boss') who receives the package and rewards the Traveler
introduced.quote: Huai'an: I am. What can I do for you?

introduced.name: stairway closure for repairs
introduced.how: the inn's stairs are closed after two large holes appeared, and repairs are being prepared
introduced.quote: Zhen Qiang: The preparations for repairs have been made, but the stairs won't be fit for walking for a while.

introduced.name: elevator
introduced.how: a lift that moves cargo and people and can be used instead of the stairs
introduced.quote: Zhen Qiang: It can move cargo, so carrying people isn't a problem. If you're in a rush, how about using that instead?

introduced.name: token of appreciation
introduced.how: Huai'an gives the Traveler a reward payment for delivering the package
introduced.quote: Huai'an: And to think that we made you take the trouble to bring this package up for me. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.

threads.claim: Zhen Qiang is still waiting on goods that have not arrived, which is left as an open question.
threads.quote: Zhen Qiang: Why hasn't the cargo arrived yet...

threads.claim: A package sent by an unnamed guest is delivered to the innkeeper through the Traveler, raising questions about who sent it.
threads.quote: Huai'an: Oh, this must be a package that a guest sent to me. Why didn't Zhen Qiang bring it up himself?

threads.claim: The inn's stairs are closed and under repair, leaving the situation unresolved for now.
threads.quote: Huai'an: I'm really sorry. You're a guest of ours, and the stairs just had to be broken at this time. I'm finding a way to fix it as we speak.

introduced.name: Nervous An
introduced.how: Ministry official who asks the Traveler to help calm the foreign guests in Liyue
introduced.quote: Nervous An: Could I trouble you, then, to help me calm some of our guests down?

introduced.name: Rite of Descension
introduced.how: A big Church ceremony in Lord Barbatos' honor, during which a huge incident occurred
introduced.quote: Just think about it, sis, that was like one of those big ceremonies the Church holds in Lord Barbatos' honor.

introduced.name: Freki
introduced.how: Mondstadt tourist and Geri's sibling, who is on a gourmet journey through Liyue
introduced.quote: Freki: Oh, come on now, just don't eat any Zhongyuan Chop Suey next time.

introduced.name: Geri
introduced.how: Mondstadt tourist and Freki's sibling who wants to go home because Liyue feels unsafe
introduced.quote: Geri: Sister, we should just head back to Mondstadt...

introduced.name: Zhongyuan Chop Suey
introduced.how: A Liyue dish that Geri finds frightening
introduced.quote: Geri: Even if you say so, what if Liyue is full of these... frightening dishes, like Zhongyuan Chop Suey?

introduced.name: Jade Parcels
introduced.how: A Liyue dish Freki thinks will suit Geri's tastes, and which wins him over
introduced.quote: Freki: I'm that sure that thing they call Jade Parcels will be more to your taste. Let's go try that next.

introduced.name: Stormterror
introduced.how: A dragon that attacked Mondstadt and was defeated by the Honorary Knight and the Knights
introduced.quote: Freki: So let's... Eh? You're that Honorary Knight, aren't you? The one who teamed up with the Knights to defeat Stormterror?

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: The Traveler's title, earned by defeating the dragon Stormterror
introduced.quote: Freki: Eh? You're... the Honorary Knight! I've heard of you, you took out Stormterror!

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: The Mondstadt knightly order that dealt with the dragon attack on their city
introduced.quote: Freki: Exactly, Geri! Mondstadt was attacked by a dragon, too. And yet, wasn't it taken care of by the Knights of Favonius in the end?

introduced.name: Atsuko
introduced.how: A woman from Inazuma who sneaked to Liyue on a raft and is looking for work
introduced.quote: Atsuko: So I made my own raft, and sneaked over here to Liyue.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: Atsuko's homeland, with a tense atmosphere and difficult borders to leave
introduced.quote: Atsuko: Even trying to leave Inazuma's borders is fraught with difficulty, never mind attempting to travel the world.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: Inazuma body that runs the assessments people must pass to leave the country
introduced.quote: A normal person would never even make it past the many assessments that the Kanjou Commission conduct.

introduced.name: Ivanovich
introduced.how: An outlander merchant near the harbor mouth who supplies Snezhnayan goods and is calm about the incident
introduced.quote: Bolai: Oh, you mean that outlander who does business near the mouth of the harbor. He still wants my Cor Lapis?

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: A local merchant holding a batch of Cor Lapis that Ivanovich wants to buy
introduced.quote: Bolai: I just so happen to have a batch of Cor Lapis with me.

introduced.name: Manager Kuan
introduced.how: Manager overseeing hundreds of workers at the Blackcliff Forge, who is not hiring
introduced.quote: Manager Kuan: Hmph. What will the Ministry do, if the hundreds of people under me really take to the streets to find work...

introduced.name: Blackcliff Forge
introduced.how: A forge with many workers, where work has now been halted
introduced.quote: Manager Kuan: Finding work? You're barking up the wrong tree. The Ministry of Civil Affairs has sealed the Chasm. Work at the Blackcliff Forge has also been stopped.

introduced.name: Clerk Zhao
introduced.how: A clerk buried under a stack of stalled forms who needs help chasing them
introduced.quote: Clerk Zhao: Not much. It's just a whole stack of forms that don't have anyone to take charge of them right now.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Gastronomy Trip
assumed.quote: Traveler: I can do it. (Requires clearing Mondstadt Gastronomy Trip)

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Ivanovich: That said, the people who have been supplying me with Snezhnayan goods and occasionally buy Cor Lapis from me are very unnerved.

assumed.name: Cor Lapis
assumed.quote: Ivanovich: That said, the people who have been supplying me with Snezhnayan goods and occasionally buy Cor Lapis from me are very unnerved.

assumed.name: Chasm
assumed.quote: Manager Kuan: Finding work? You're barking up the wrong tree. The Ministry of Civil Affairs has sealed the Chasm.

threads.claim: Millelith is flooding the streets after the Rite of Descension incident, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Nervous An: After that huge incident at the Rite of Descension, the streets have been filling up with Millelith.

threads.claim: A huge incident at the Rite of Descension has left Liyue tense and many foreign residents uneasy.
threads.quote: Nervous An: But this incident has caused many such people to be very ill at ease.

threads.claim: Characters debate whether Liyue is safe after the incident, and the Traveler says it is pretty safe.
threads.quote: Traveler: Liyue's pretty safe.

threads.claim: Inazuma's strict border assessments and tense atmosphere make leaving it hard, and Atsuko advises against visiting now.
threads.quote: Atsuko: That said... I'd say it's best that you don't go to Inazuma.

introduced.name: Manyoya
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a retired flying squad member who loves flight and challenges the Traveler to a race
introduced.quote: Anyone who loves flying is a friend of Manyoya's! That's me, by the way.

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: A flying creature ridden along courses, which the player must ride in the challenge
introduced.quote: Ride your Saurian as far as you can along the designated course within the time limit.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: A group whose flying skill ranks among the best, used as a benchmark for flight
introduced.quote: Its speed ranks among the very top in the Flower-Feather Clan.

introduced.name: Flying squad
introduced.how: An elite Saurian rider unit that Manyoya served in as a veteran before retiring
introduced.quote: I flew for quite some years — and while that doesn't make me too old by most measures, I was a real veteran in the flying squad.

introduced.name: Acomitl
introduced.how: Manyoya's younger brother, who avoids training and runs away from responsibility
introduced.quote: Acomitl's just focused on running away from it all, so he might've been hiding instead.

introduced.name: Manyoya's father
introduced.how: A former flying squad member who became a training master after retiring
introduced.quote: My father used to be in the flying squad, and he became a training master after retirement.

introduced.name: Flight challenge
introduced.how: A timed flying course scored in four grades, where beating the second-highest tier counts as a win
introduced.quote: The results are divided into 4 grades, and we'll count this as your win if you can beat the second-highest tier.

assumed.name: Flying squad exam
assumed.quote: Until a moment ago, I thought you were training for the flying squad exam.

assumed.name: Tecoloapan Beach
assumed.quote: (During the challenge, near Tecoloapan Beach)

threads.claim: A mysterious voice high above sings and calls flying Saurians, hinting at an unseen figure.
threads.quote: Sing me a song, call the flying Saurians and birds who have left their nests...

threads.claim: The singer is revealed to be Manyoya, a retired flying squad rider.
threads.quote: Anyone who loves flying is a friend of Manyoya's! That's me, by the way.

threads.claim: Flying is presented as a deep form of freedom that riders will not give up.
threads.quote: Doubt you'll find a soul who wouldn't hold onto that freedom no matter what, and I'm no exception.

threads.claim: Manyoya insists that his retirement from the squad does not mean he gives up the skies.
threads.quote: So as long as you don't stop flying, I think we'll meet again.

threads.claim: Manyoya has retired from the flying squad and is reluctant to accept it.
threads.quote: Haha! I used to be! I'm retired now.

threads.claim: Manyoya has not yet told his family about his retirement and must face the next stage of his life.
threads.quote: I should make a trip home — haven't told my family about my retirement yet.

threads.claim: Manyoya's brother Acomitl is avoiding training and responsibility, leaving his fate open.
threads.quote: Acomitl's just focused on running away from it all, so he might've been hiding instead.

introduced.name: Dhabit
introduced.how: a struggling publisher who has turned to selling investment coupons
introduced.quote: Dhabit: The publishing trade hardly makes a living these days. Maybe I should just focus on investments...

introduced.name: Investment Coupon
introduced.how: a coupon bought for 2,000 Mora whose investment tenure matures weekly
introduced.quote: Dhabit: Here you go. 2,000 Mora per coupon, with each investment tenure maturing weekly. Now then, into the pouch it goes...

introduced.name: Short-Term Investment Coupon
introduced.how: a coupon whose profits and losses are settled immediately rather than weekly
introduced.quote: And here's the thing — profits and losses on this one are to be settled immediately!

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Dhabit: L—Lady Nefer! I never imagined you'd grace my humble stall... H—Have you come to buy an investment coupon too?

assumed.name: Earlier Investment Coupon purchase
assumed.quote: Dhabit: Well, well, if it isn't our regulars! Here to invest again, are we?

assumed.name: Past favor Dhabit asked of Nefer
assumed.quote: Dhabit: And, about that matter I asked your help with last time...

threads.claim: Paimon suspects Dhabit's investment claims are made up, raising the possibility he is a swindler.
threads.quote: Paimon: Kinda feels like you just made all that up...

threads.claim: Dhabit insists his investment returns are genuine while visibly flustered, keeping the swindle question open.
threads.quote: Dhabit: Ugh... Hey! I swear it's true. You've got sharp business senses, Traveler!

threads.claim: Dhabit has asked Nefer for help with an unexplained matter, and Nefer says it has been found but withholds the details.
threads.quote: Nefer: We've found what you're looking for, but...

introduced.name: Yarovaya
introduced.how: Druzhna officer running the recruitment tests who judges applicants and sends them on missions
introduced.quote: Yarovaya: Not good enough. There's no way you can complete the mission if your skills aren't up to par.

introduced.name: Druzhna
introduced.how: official military-style force that holds recruitment callups and is short-handed
introduced.quote: Yarovaya: As long as it's within the Druzhna's power, we will prioritize procuring it for you.

introduced.name: Kristall
introduced.how: highly prized substance, also called chronic crystal, offered as a reward
introduced.quote: Applicant B: Because the pay's good, man! I heard that if you make it through, you even get some... chronic crystal, or whatever it's called!

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: dangerous zone whose threats could spill into the outside world and must be eliminated by Druzhna personnel
introduced.quote: Yarovaya: My superiors would like me to send some personnel into the Shadow Realm to eliminate the danger and prevent it from affecting the outside world.

introduced.name: Vesna
introduced.how: Druzhna superior to whom Yarovaya reports, who speaks on the recruitment project
introduced.quote: (After some time, Yarovaya approaches Vesna while the Traveler speaks with some other Druzhna nearby)

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a great nation whose ruler Her Majesty believes hides talent among its people
introduced.quote: ???: Snezhnaya is a great nation, and Her Majesty is confident that there is great talent hidden among the populace.

introduced.name: special recruitment project
introduced.how: Her Majesty's special recruitment drive created to handle situations the official forces cannot
introduced.quote: ???: Don't blame yourself. Her Majesty arranged this "special recruitment project" precisely to deal with situations of this kind.

assumed.name: Rokot
assumed.quote: Traveler: As a member of the Rokot...

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: ???: Do you think any of the candidates selected in this round show sufficient potential to take on the Tsaritsa's edict?

assumed.name: Her Majesty
assumed.quote: ???: Don't blame yourself. Her Majesty arranged this "special recruitment project" precisely to deal with situations of this kind.

threads.claim: The Shadow Realm holds dangers that could affect the outside world and need to be eliminated.
threads.quote: Yarovaya: My superiors would like me to send some personnel into the Shadow Realm to eliminate the danger and prevent it from affecting the outside world.

threads.claim: The Traveler has entered the Shadow Realm before, and the Druzhna notice this from their firearms.
threads.quote: Yarovaya: Pardon my curiosity, but... have you entered the Shadow Realm before?

threads.claim: The Traveler says the Kristall will go to those in need, leaving its wider use an open question.
threads.quote: Traveler: I'm giving it to those in need.

threads.claim: The Druzhna recruits have purposes beyond aiding official forces, hinting at a hidden agenda.
threads.quote: ???: Furthermore, do not forget that we have other things in mind for these new recruits beyond simply pitching in where the official forces are unable to.

threads.claim: A Tsaritsa's edict requires talented candidates, which the Druzhna are seeking.
threads.quote: ???: Do you think any of the candidates selected in this round show sufficient potential to take on the Tsaritsa's edict?

threads.claim: The Druzhna have grown severely short-handed, forcing stricter recruitment standards.
threads.quote: Yarovaya: It shames me to say that the Druzhna have grown severely short-handed of late. Ordinarily, we should be the ones to complete a mission like this.

threads.claim: The Traveler is a member of the Rokot, a group whose role is hinted but not explained.
threads.quote: Traveler: As a member of the Rokot...

introduced.name: Madame Ping
introduced.how: an old adeptus who received a blessing from Rex Lapis and gives the Traveler a teapot gift
introduced.quote: It is a blessing we old folks once received from Rex Lapis

introduced.name: Sub-Space Creation
introduced.how: an adeptal ability to create a small autonomous pocket world
introduced.quote: Sub-Space Creation is the ability to create a small, autonomous pocket world.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: a powerful being who gave adepti their blessings and moved mountains and seas
introduced.quote: Rex Lapis, on the other hand, moved mountains and seas

introduced.name: Adeptus
introduced.how: adepti are beings who must leave this realm to create a world of their own
introduced.quote: One such as myself must depart from this realm to create a world of one's own.

introduced.name: Teapot pocket world
introduced.how: the teapot the Traveler entered is a small trinket made with Sub-Space Creation
introduced.quote: The teapot that you entered previously was a little trinket created using that ability.

introduced.name: Yanfei
introduced.how: a legal adviser who helps Madame Ping run errands and is a talkative adeptus
introduced.quote: Allow me to introduce myself once more. I'm Yanfei, a legal adviser.

introduced.name: Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.how: an adepti treasure whose adeptal power is harmful to ordinary humans
introduced.quote: Smaragdus Jadeite is an adepti treasure, and the adeptal power within is not something that most humans can withstand.

introduced.name: Shimmersoil
introduced.how: a rare soil found by digging along Glaze Lily roots
introduced.quote: You would have to dig downward, following the roots of the Glaze Lilies

introduced.name: Dihua Marsh
introduced.how: a marsh whose state has changed so that Shimmersoil is now hard to find
introduced.quote: since Dihua Marsh came to be the way it is today

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a rock area where Smaragdus Jadeite is chiseled out, now sealed off
introduced.quote: which must be chiseled from the rock of The Chasm

introduced.name: Blackcliff Forge
introduced.how: an operation that has stripped the mines of Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.quote: ever since the Blackcliff Forge opened for business

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: an organization that keeps records and marked the Traveler as a suspect
introduced.quote: Much has been written about you in the Millelith's records.

introduced.name: Jueyun Karst
introduced.how: a place where the Traveler fought off the Millelith
introduced.quote: fought off the Millelith at Jueyun Karst

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a group the Traveler made contact with during the story so far
introduced.quote: made contact with the Fatui

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: an authority that cleared the Traveler of suspicion
introduced.quote: cleared of any and all suspicion by the Qixing

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: a government body that keeps the Chasm locked down and records official transactions
introduced.quote: Looks like the Ministry of Civil Affairs is serious about keeping it strictly locked down.

introduced.name: Tianquan
introduced.how: a body that amends Liyue's law in complicated ways
introduced.quote: the amendments made by the Tianquan to our law are unnecessarily complicated

introduced.name: Krosl
introduced.how: a Snezhnayan merchant who rented out Smaragdus Jadeite hairpins
introduced.quote: Oh, good, very good. All thanks to your advice, Miss Yanfei.

introduced.name: Zhiqiao
introduced.how: an ore merchant who rented the hairpins and then lost them
introduced.quote: The hairpins... I can't lend them to you right now... I—I've lost them.

introduced.name: Smaragdus Nephrite
introduced.how: an ordinary ore that looks like Smaragdus Jadeite but has no elemental energy
introduced.quote: Smaragdus Nephrite is an entirely ordinary ore containing no elemental energy whatsoever.

introduced.name: Smaragdus Jadeite Twin-Phoenix Pins
introduced.how: hairpins with inlaid gemstones recorded as Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.quote: See for yourself: the item is called

introduced.name: Shitou
introduced.how: the boss of The Jade Mystery, an ore processor who worked on the ore
introduced.quote: Why, hello there, honoured customers.

introduced.name: Xingxi
introduced.how: a jewelry shop owner who links clients with jewelsmiths and filed the Ministry record
introduced.quote: Oh, Miss Yanfei, it's you. ...Has something happened?

introduced.name: Mingxing Jewelry
introduced.how: a jewelry shop where Xingxi helps link people up with jewelsmiths
introduced.quote: She often helps link people up with a jewelsmith.

introduced.name: The Jade Mystery
introduced.how: an ore processing business run by Shitou
introduced.quote: the boss of The Jade Mystery

introduced.name: Baizhu
introduced.how: a doctor at Bubu Pharmacy who knows the medical dangers of Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.quote: Why, yes, there is some information about it included in the Sixth Commentary

introduced.name: Bubu Pharmacy
introduced.how: a pharmacy where Dr. Baizhu works and Krosl sought a check-up
introduced.quote: I went to Bubu Pharmacy to get myself checked out

introduced.name: Seven Mountain Treatises
introduced.how: a text stating Smaragdus Jadeite springs from Stonemarrow and harms mortals
introduced.quote: states that this substance springs forth from Stonemarrow within the mountains

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: a Traveler ability that reveals traces of elemental energy
introduced.quote: Well, we might as well give Elemental Sight a shot.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: a power that protects a person from the harm of Smaragdus Jadeite
introduced.quote: if someone without a Vision is in contact with it

assumed.name: Cleansing Bell
assumed.quote: When you traversed my old teapot in search of the Cleansing Bell

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: following the incident at the Rite of Descension

assumed.name: Geo
assumed.quote: I noticed strong traces of Geo energy around Mr. Krosl

assumed.name: Qiqi
assumed.quote: if you're looking for our little Qiqi

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: every last Mora

threads.claim: Smaragdus Jadeite is an adepti treasure whose power harms ordinary humans on prolonged contact.
threads.quote: Extended contact with it is, in fact, harmful to humans.

threads.claim: Baizhu's account states that Smaragdus Jadeite will bring disaster to mortals who touch it.
threads.quote: will bring disaster to any mere mortals who touch it.

threads.claim: Krosl admits the pins held Smaragdus Nephrite and that he knew the jadeite was dangerous.
threads.quote: I admit it! I confess!

threads.claim: Madame Ping suggests the world has changed and that Liyue is no longer the place the adepti once knew.
threads.quote: Liyue is not the same place I once knew

threads.claim: Yanfei argues that Liyue Harbor is now a city ruled by humans rather than adepti.
threads.quote: Liyue Harbor is now a city ruled by humans.

threads.claim: The Chasm has been sealed off so that no one can enter, leaving Smaragdus Jadeite out of reach.
threads.quote: The Chasm's been sealed off, and there's just no way in.

threads.claim: Dihua Marsh has changed in some way that makes its resources harder to find.
threads.quote: since Dihua Marsh came to be the way it is today

threads.claim: A figure inside the teapot will explain how the teapot world works.
threads.quote: I've already arranged for a certain to await you within this teapot.

threads.claim: Yanfei's father once campaigned with Rex Lapis before returning home to marry.
threads.quote: He mentioned that he once campaigned with Rex Lapis for a long old time

introduced.name: Tubby
introduced.how: a teapot spirit who calls himself a butler and manages the teapot realm
introduced.quote: Excuse me, I am not a finch! I am a teapot spirit, and you may call me...

introduced.name: Teapot spirits
introduced.how: created to guard adeptal realms and manage their affairs
introduced.quote: Thus, we teapot spirits were created to help guard their realms and manage their affairs.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: powerful beings who create realms but rarely have time to maintain them
introduced.quote: Though it is the adepti who create realms such as this, they generally do not have the time of day to attend to the banal matter of their maintenance.

introduced.name: Sub-Space Creation
introduced.how: an adeptal realm made of adeptal power, with limits; it offers brief respite, not escape
introduced.quote: He said that even though Sub-Space Creation is a product of adeptal power, even that has its limits.

introduced.name: Blueprint
introduced.how: an image of a room or furniture that lets the player refashion the realm by releasing the thought of it
introduced.quote: As long as you have a blueprint, you can refashion this realm however you please.

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: this teapot seems even bigger inside than Madame Ping's.

assumed.name: Granny
assumed.quote: Granny handed us some when she gave us the teapot, didn't she?

assumed.name: A Guest From Liyue
assumed.quote: back when we met in the Mondstadt tavern, I had a feeling that we would meet again.

threads.claim: A golden-eyed adeptus once explained the limits of the realm to Tubby and then disappeared.
threads.quote: A golden-eyed adeptus explained this to me at some point in the past.

threads.claim: Tubby cannot remember much of his own past.
threads.quote: I hardly remember myself. What's more, I have never seen that adeptus again since...

threads.claim: The teapot realm is not a true world and cannot be used to escape the mortal realm.
threads.quote: This world is not a true one, after all. It provides merely a moment of brief respite from the mortal realm, not a means of escaping it entirely.

threads.claim: Tubby explains that even adeptal realm creation has limits, answering Paimon's idea of building a whole city.
threads.quote: He said that even though Sub-Space Creation is a product of adeptal power, even that has its limits.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: a former Fatui Harbinger, the Third, whom people fear because of the title
introduced.quote: Traveler: (Third of the Fatui Harbingers... That title alone is enough to scare off people who don't know her.)

introduced.name: Mix drinks
introduced.how: the makeshift bar mechanic: add ingredients per the list to mix a drink, or mix again after a mistake
introduced.quote: Add the amount and type of ingredients according to the ingredient list to complete mixing.

introduced.name: Athenaeum
introduced.how: a coffee drink that is bitter and was served by Sandrone's room
introduced.quote: (Columbina takes a swallow of the coffee, but then sets the cup and saucer aside.)

introduced.name: Boreal Watch
introduced.how: a mint, spice, and dried berry tea that Frostmoon Scions people brew, mixed here with milk
introduced.quote: The people used to make a kind of tea brewed with fresh mint leaves, spices, and dried berries.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Even back when I was with the Fatui, when there was no order to capture me... everyone still kept their distance whenever I went out for a walk.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: In Sandrone's room. She had a drink that smelled like this.

assumed.name: Frostmoon Scions
assumed.quote: It reminds me of a time long, long ago, when I was living with the Frostmoon Scions...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Ah, well this is a Mondstadt recipe. People love adding milk, cream, and sugar to their tea over there.

assumed.name: A Gift From Her
assumed.quote: (After A Gift From Her this mini-game is part of the weekly random options)

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Third of the Fatui Harbingers... That title alone is enough to scare off people who don't know her.)

threads.claim: Columbina keeps thinking about the moon and wishes for something she cannot easily have.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Is she thinking about the moon again...?)

threads.claim: Moonlight and scent are presented as ways to glimpse the past, hinting that memory is a theme.
threads.quote: It seems moonlight is not the only medium through which one can glimpse the past.

threads.claim: Columbina cannot go wherever she wants, so her freedom is restricted.
threads.quote: Columbina can't go wherever she wants right now, so a trip to the tavern might as well be a trip to the moon...

threads.claim: Columbina was once with the Fatui, and people kept their distance from her even before she was captured.
threads.quote: Even back when I was with the Fatui, when there was no order to capture me... everyone still kept their distance whenever I went out for a walk.

threads.claim: Columbina is treated as a divine figure, so ordinary people hesitate to share their everyday things with her.
threads.quote: When a "Goddess" arrives at your door and asks, "May I try your tea?"... No one dares to offer up the "rustic tea" thrown together for their own consumption...

threads.claim: Columbina feels she owes the world in return for the life she takes from it.
threads.quote: And reminds me of what I owe this world in return...

threads.claim: Sandrone left an unfinished drink and seemed to wait for Columbina to ask about it, and her reply was unpleasant.
threads.quote: It was like... she was waiting for me to ask about it.

threads.claim: Columbina may be saving her drinks because she thinks she will not taste another cup, hinting at an impending departure.
threads.quote: Wait, is that why you aren't finishing your drink? You're not saving it because you think this is the last cup you'll ever taste, are you?

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: Shown as a veiled woman whose drink tastes and memories matter; her past and manner are hinted at
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh boy... Even though her eyes are covered, Paimon can tell she's staring right at you.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: Columbina once lived with them, and they brewed a mint, spice, and berry tea
introduced.quote: Columbina: It reminds me of a time long, long ago, when I was living with the Frostmoon Scions...

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: Mondstadt is a place where people put milk, cream, and sugar in tea
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ah, well this is a Mondstadt recipe. People love adding milk, cream, and sugar to their tea over there.

introduced.name: Columbina's harvest-time epiphany
introduced.how: Columbina once touched ripe fruit and came to understand the appeal of aroma and harvest
introduced.quote: Columbina: There was a time when I failed to understand why people felt such joy at harvest time.

assumed.name: Sandrone
assumed.quote: Columbina: In Sandrone's room. She had a drink that smelled like this.

assumed.name: Lakkaberry
assumed.quote: Columbina: Here, try it for yourselves. This Lakkaberry is very sweet, so make sure you savor it.

threads.claim: Columbina's eyes are covered, hinting at a hidden or unusual condition.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh boy... Even though her eyes are covered, Paimon can tell she's staring right at you.

threads.claim: Sandrone had an unpleasant exchange with Columbina and was sour about a drink, which hints at her character.
threads.quote: Columbina: She said something quite unpleasant. It doesn't bear repeating.

threads.claim: Columbina is treated as a divine figure called a Goddess, which raises questions about her status.
threads.quote: Columbina: What I received in the end was more like an "offering" for the divine, complete with ornate packaging and all.

threads.claim: Scents and drinks can unlock long-forgotten memories of the past, as moonlight does.
threads.quote: Columbina: It seems moonlight is not the only medium through which one can glimpse the past.

threads.claim: Columbina sees taking life from nature as a cycle in which she owes the world something in return.
threads.quote: Columbina: Then, we complete nature's cycle by taking that life force for ourselves.

introduced.name: Angel
introduced.how: Nicole is an angel, a status she says she cannot forget
introduced.quote: I can't forget that I am an angel.

introduced.name: Nicole
introduced.how: a mage who is one of the fixed observation points for world changes
introduced.quote: As one of the fixed observation points for changes in the world, I require it to have excellent visibility.

introduced.name: observation points for world changes
introduced.how: Nicole's lodge work is to watch for changes in the world at fixed points
introduced.quote: As one of the fixed observation points for changes in the world, I require it to have excellent visibility.

assumed.name: Witch's Lodge
assumed.quote: Nicole: Welcome back.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: has been shaken more and more frequently as of late.

assumed.name: Temple of Space
assumed.quote: which resembles the Pillar Hall Central Zone in the Temple of Space

assumed.name: Nicole's former angelic form and powers
assumed.quote: if I still had the form, power, and abilities I once possessed

assumed.name: the price Nicole paid
assumed.quote: That's why I've never once regretted the price I paid

threads.claim: The fate of Teyvat is being shaken more and more often, a change Nicole has noticed.
threads.quote: has been shaken more and more frequently as of late.

threads.claim: Nicole once had a different form and greater powers, and she gave something up to lose them.
threads.quote: if I still had the form, power, and abilities I once possessed

threads.claim: The heavens place restrictions on angels that limit what they can say.
threads.quote: If things were how they were before, I'd have so many more restrictions placed on me by the heavens.

threads.claim: Nicole values the freedom to say what she wants, even at the cost of her angelic power.
threads.quote: how would I tell stories without the freedom to say what I want?

threads.claim: Nicole wanted to become human and live a regular life, but she cannot escape being an angel.
threads.quote: I wanted to become human, to live like a regular person... but such a life is a luxury.

introduced.name: Zibai
introduced.how: a fan-like guardian figure who invites the Traveler and reveals herself through a summoning and her parasol-turned-chariot
introduced.quote: Zibai: , I've prepared a little something for you. Please stop by the Baiju Guesthouse when time permits.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: a special valley where the ground sits on a key intersection of Liyue's Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Zibai: But fortunately for us, this is Chenyu Vale.

introduced.name: Yilong Dais
introduced.how: the location the parasol transported the Traveler and Paimon to
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon are teleported to Yilong Dais)

introduced.name: Yilong Wharf
introduced.how: a place Paimon guesses as their location in the vale, and Zibai says they have much to learn about it
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uhm... Yilong Wharf?

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: ley lines run through Liyue and the ground here is a key intersection of them
introduced.quote: Zibai: The ground beneath our feet is actually one of the key intersections in Liyue's Ley Lines. There are eight such nodes in total...

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: a region whose ley lines cross the ground of Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: Zibai: The ground beneath our feet is actually one of the key intersections in Liyue's Ley Lines. There are eight such nodes in total...

introduced.name: Seven-and-Eight-Gates Method
introduced.how: eight gates (Life, Death, Repose, Concealment, Initiation, Terrain, Fright, Injury) mark the nodes, with the Gate of Life the most auspicious
introduced.quote: Traveler: Life, Death, Repose, Concealment, Initiation, Terrain, Fright, and Injury.

introduced.name: Gate of Life
introduced.how: the most auspicious of the eight gates, symbolizing growth, prosperity and revitalization, which speeds renewal of spiritual energy
introduced.quote: Zibai: The Gate of Life symbolizes growth, prosperity, and revitalization. Thus, I was able to replenish the jade token's spiritual energy so quickly and craft this chariot.

introduced.name: Lunar chariot
introduced.how: a jade chariot Zibai made as a replica of a vehicle from her memories, now a travel tool for the Traveler
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh! It's... It's the lunar chariot! No wonder it looked so familiar...

introduced.name: Jade token
introduced.how: a broken jade token the Traveler returned to Zibai, whose spiritual energy was used to craft the chariot
introduced.quote: Zibai: And it's all thanks to the broken jade token you returned to me.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: someone who was involved in waking Zibai and who told her about the Traveler's long journey
introduced.quote: Traveler: It was all Zhongli's doing, really.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a distant land of snow that is the Traveler's next destination
introduced.quote: Traveler: Yes, we're heading to Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Zhongli's role in waking Zibai
assumed.quote: Traveler: It was all Zhongli's doing, really.

assumed.name: Zibai's poor memory and past relationship with the Traveler
assumed.quote: Zibai: It seems I'm not the only one who struggles to remember things. Have you already forgotten riding on it with me before?

assumed.name: Jade token returned earlier
assumed.quote: Zibai: And it's all thanks to the broken jade token you returned to me.

threads.claim: Zibai's memories and her forgetting are hinted at, with the lunar chariot a replica built from those memories.
threads.quote: Zibai: Haha, it's just a replica created from my memories.

threads.claim: Liyue's Ley Lines have key intersections with eight nodes, and Chenyu Vale sits on one of them.
threads.quote: Zibai: The ground beneath our feet is actually one of the key intersections in Liyue's Ley Lines. There are eight such nodes in total...

threads.claim: The eight gates are a system tied to the ley line nodes, with the Gate of Life the most auspicious.
threads.quote: Zibai: Correct. Where we stand right now is the center of the most auspicious of those gates — the Gate of Life.

threads.claim: Zibai admits she knows nothing about Snezhnaya, which hints that her knowledge of the world has gaps.
threads.quote: Zibai: Snezhnaya... Hmm, although I know nothing about the place, no journey through ice and snow is without its dangers.

threads.claim: Zhongli has a connection to Zibai and has spoken with her about the Traveler's journey.
threads.quote: Zibai: He mentioned that you're on a long journey...

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staff who greets the Traveler and offers help with commissions and questions
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild's way of operation
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Then you must be well acquainted with the Adventurers' Guild's way of operation. Therefore, I won't waste your time going over it.

introduced.name: Afratu
introduced.how: a Mahamata researcher in charge of the area who commissioned the Eremites and is from Vahumana
introduced.quote: Are you the Eremites that I, Afratu, commissioned? Please stop here if you are not.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: a group commissioned from the Citadel of Regzar to deal with the dangerous area
introduced.quote: I've already commissioned the Eremites from the Citadel of Regzar to deal with it.

introduced.name: Citadel of Regzar
introduced.how: the place the Eremites were commissioned from
introduced.quote: I've already commissioned the Eremites from the Citadel of Regzar to deal with it.

introduced.name: Mahamata
introduced.how: an official title for a regional administrator whose duties include protecting people
introduced.quote: As a Mahamata, it would be a dereliction of my duties if anything were to happen to you.

introduced.name: Ruin Golem
introduced.how: a huge sealed ancient machine from the Dahri war, usually operated by people with an autonomous system
introduced.quote: Three Ruin Golems survived that brutal war and were sealed by the sages. This is one of them.

introduced.name: Ruin Guard
introduced.how: a smaller machine of the same kind; a Ruin Golem is a giant version of it
introduced.quote: Simply put, a Ruin Golem is a super huge version of a Ruin Guard.

introduced.name: Chaos Cores
introduced.how: the power cores that run Ruin Golems and Ruin Guards, which should have been deactivated long ago
introduced.quote: The Chaos Cores that powered them should have been deactivated long ago, so it's strange that they can still function... even after several hundred years.

introduced.name: Suda's Flow
introduced.how: seal mechanisms the sages used to lock the path into a Ruin Golem; three groups maintain the seal
introduced.quote: The sages have sealed the path into the Ruin Golem using Suda's Flow, so no one should have been able to activate it.

introduced.name: Dahri
introduced.how: the ancient people who built the Ruin Golems and machines
introduced.quote: It is said to be a relic of the legendary Dahri people.

introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.how: the more familiar name for the Dahri people, of which Dahri is an archaic name
introduced.quote: Perhaps you're more familiar with the name Khaenri'ah? Dahri is an archaic name that's commonly used in the Vahumana Darshan.

introduced.name: Vahumana
introduced.how: Afratu's home region, where the Dahri name is used in the Darshan
introduced.quote: Besides, I'm from Vahumana. My knowledge of the Ruin Golems is limited to the things I read in history books.

introduced.name: Schwanenritter
introduced.how: Dahri pilots who flew these huge machines to fight monsters from the abyss
introduced.quote: Legend has it that the Dahri Schwanenritter once piloted these huge machines to combat the monsters from the abyss.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an academic body that registers important cultural relics and approves expeditions
introduced.quote: Just be careful not to destroy the internal structures. After all, this is an important cultural relic registered at the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.how: energy lines that powered the ancient sages' seals and may be linked to the machines
introduced.quote: And the seals of the ancient sages were created with energy from the Ley Lines, so if there's an anomaly in the Ley Lines...

introduced.name: Jazari
introduced.how: a researcher who specializes in studying Ruin Golems
introduced.quote: Paimon: Right! Mr. Jazari specializes in Ruin Golem research! If he was here, he would be dying to go inside and have a look.

introduced.name: Abyss war
introduced.how: a legendary brutal war in which Dahri pilots fought abyss monsters with Ruin Golems
introduced.quote: Legend has it that the Dahri Schwanenritter once piloted these huge machines to combat the monsters from the abyss.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Afratu, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Afratu, optional)

assumed.name: Vimana Agama: Jazari's Chapter
assumed.quote: (If Vimana Agama: Jazari's Chapter has been completed)

assumed.name: Devantaka Mountain
assumed.quote: Paimon didn't understand a thing, but this Ruin Golem should be similar to the one we saw in Devantaka Mountain, right?

assumed.name: Jazari's past investigation
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why don't we help you instead? We helped Mr. Jazari with his investigation too.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Paimon: Is that shiny thing over there the, uh, Flow stuff they were talking about? People from Sumeru really do like using vines as seals, huh?

assumed.name: Kshahrewar
assumed.quote: Perhaps that's the exact naivety of the Kshahrewar?

assumed.name: Dastur
assumed.quote: If he had paid more attention to the inner workings of the Akademiya, he wouldn't be stopping at Dastur now.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I'll have to verify that with the Adventurers' Guild later

assumed.name: Marshal Regent Anfortas
assumed.quote: ...by order of Marshal Regent Anfortas...

threads.claim: A sealed Ruin Golem has suddenly woken after centuries and started attacking people, with no clear cause.
threads.quote: It has been lying there silently for centuries, but lately, it suddenly became active and has even attacked nearby people.

threads.claim: Someone may have entered the sealed machine or triggered an unknown activation device, and the mystery is open.
threads.quote: Did someone get inside by other means? Or perhaps it was triggered by an activation device that we have no knowledge about?

threads.claim: Switching off the autonomous system stops the attacks, but why the golem reactivated is still unanswered.
threads.quote: Afratu: Great, then it should stop attacking nearby people now.

threads.claim: Chaos Cores should have died long ago, so their continued function after centuries is an unexplained anomaly.
threads.quote: The Chaos Cores that powered them should have been deactivated long ago, so it's strange that they can still function... even after several hundred years.

threads.claim: The sages' Suda's Flow seal should have made activation impossible, so the seal's failure is a mystery.
threads.quote: The sages have sealed the path into the Ruin Golem using Suda's Flow, so no one should have been able to activate it.

threads.claim: The party breaks the Suda's Flow mechanisms and the seal is gone, opening the way into the machine.
threads.quote: Paimon: Well, that's the seal gone. Now we just need to get into the pilot cabin and turn the autonomous system off!

threads.claim: The unusual overgrown vines may be connected to the Ley Lines, which are not well understood.
threads.quote: I'm not very sure what they are, but it sounds like they might be related to the Ley Lines.

threads.claim: The ancient seals were powered by Ley Lines, so an anomaly in the Ley Lines could undo them.
threads.quote: And the seals of the ancient sages were created with energy from the Ley Lines, so if there's an anomaly in the Ley Lines...

threads.claim: Afratu suspects problems will spread to all sealed Ruin Golems if the Ley Lines are anomalous.
threads.quote: If my deduction is correct, problems will start occurring in all the sealed Ruin Golems.

threads.claim: There are hidden links between the Ley Lines and the machines made by the Dahri that are still unknown.
threads.quote: There may be many links between the Ley Lines and the machines created by the Dahri that we still do not know of.

threads.claim: The Dahri and Khaenri'ah may be the same people under different names, hinting at a deeper history.
threads.quote: Perhaps you're more familiar with the name Khaenri'ah? Dahri is an archaic name that's commonly used in the Vahumana Darshan.

threads.claim: A legendary war against abyss monsters was fought with Dahri machines, and its details are only legend.
threads.quote: Legend has it that the Dahri Schwanenritter once piloted these huge machines to combat the monsters from the abyss.

threads.claim: The Dahri machine's personnel were ordered to abandon it, leaving wounded behind, which hints at a failed operation.
threads.quote: Sealed Orders: ...all remaining personnel should immediately abandon this machine upon completion of the mission and relocate to the Marshal's machine...

threads.claim: Overgrown vines fill the machine in a way that does not fit the desert and no visitors have come recently.
threads.quote: Paimon: Doesn't look like this place has had any visitors lately... There's a whole load of vines around here...

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: ruins outside Mondstadt, a place once shrouded in a storm and rich in crystal ore
introduced.quote: Have you heard of Stormterror's Lair? It's those ruins outside Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Stormterror
introduced.how: a being who made the Lair his home and cloaked it in an impassable storm
introduced.quote: While Stormterror made the place his home, it was shrouded in a whirling, impassable storm.

introduced.name: crystal ore
introduced.how: precious crystal ore in the Lair that is useful for forging and restoring the city
introduced.quote: the precious crystal ore in there hasn't been mined.

introduced.name: Wagner
introduced.how: a smith whose smithy is busy with repairs around the city
introduced.quote: But with so many places in the city needing repairs, our smithy's services are in high demand.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Have you heard of Stormterror's Lair? It's those ruins outside Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Schulz
assumed.quote: Schulz can't hold the fort down alone either, so I can't leave.

threads.claim: Stormterror's storm made the Lair impassable and kept its ore unmined.
threads.quote: While Stormterror made the place his home, it was shrouded in a whirling, impassable storm.

threads.claim: Rumors suggest the storm around the Lair has disappeared, though this is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: I've heard people say that the storm around the area has disappeared.

threads.claim: The storm around Stormterror's Lair has been confirmed to have dispersed.
threads.quote: So, this means that the storm around Stormterror's Lair has indeed dispersed.

introduced.name: Harris
introduced.how: A cook who is reviving an ancient recipe and asks the Traveler for help gathering ingredients
introduced.quote: I'm just adding the finishing touches to an ancient recipe.

introduced.name: Chilled Meat
introduced.how: Meat from boar frozen in ice, which Harris asks for as a cooking ingredient
introduced.quote: Yes, as in the meat of those frozen boar. Being encased in ice must keep it pretty fresh, don't you think?

introduced.name: Ancient ruin
introduced.how: An ancient ruin in the mountains, found by explorers while sheltering from a storm, that holds books and records
introduced.quote: But, my friend did tell me that they happened upon an ancient ruin while they were taking shelter from the storm.

introduced.name: Great Snowboar King
introduced.how: A fierce beast said to dwell deep in the mountains
introduced.quote: Have you heard of the Great Snowboar King? People say that it's a fierce beast dwelling deep in the mountains...

introduced.name: Great Snowboar King Meat
introduced.how: Meat from the Great Snowboar King, said to suit any cooking method and needed for the recipe
introduced.quote: And recipes say that its exquisite meat is well-suited to any method of cooking...

introduced.name: Goulash
introduced.how: The dish Harris formalized from the ancient recipe, which is simple to cook and easy to remember
introduced.quote: I think I'm going to name this dish "Goulash."

assumed.name: Food submission menu
assumed.quote: (Opens food submission menu)

threads.claim: An ancient ruin in the mountains holds books and records, including a recipe that has survived intact for a very long time.
threads.quote: It was full of books and other records. Even... even a recipe. I don't know how it has survived intact for this long...

threads.claim: The adventurer hopes Harris can revive the taste of the past through the ancient recipe.
threads.quote: He hopes I can revive the taste of the past.

threads.claim: The Great Snowboar King is a fierce beast dwelling deep in the mountains, and its meat is needed for the recipe.
threads.quote: Have you heard of the Great Snowboar King? People say that it's a fierce beast dwelling deep in the mountains...

threads.claim: Harris's final dish has moved far from the original ancient recipe, though it still tastes good.
threads.quote: If one thing's certain, it's that this is definitely a far cry from the ancient recipe I started with...

threads.claim: The Traveler produces Great Snowboar King meat unexpectedly, which Harris finds suspiciously coincidental.
threads.quote: How... Where? Is this pure coincidence, or...

introduced.name: Alfred
introduced.how: a man who commissioned flower gathering and wants Cecilias for his daughter
introduced.quote: Alfred: You saw my commission, I presume? Thank you for coming all this way...

introduced.name: Cecilia
introduced.how: a flower Alfred wants; he needs three, gathered quickly before they wilt
introduced.quote: Traveler: Heard you need Cecilias...

introduced.name: Windwheel Aster
introduced.how: a flower Alfred may request; he needs three, and they wilt if left too long
introduced.quote: Traveler: I believe you needed some Windwheel Asters...

assumed.name: commission
assumed.quote: Alfred: You saw my commission, I presume? Thank you for coming all this way...

introduced.name: Allan
introduced.how: a stranger attacked by monsters who is rescued by the Traveler and thanks them
introduced.quote: Allan: Thank you Traveler, you saved me!

threads.claim: Allan's surprise at finding monsters in this place hints that the area was not expected to be dangerous, an open question for later.
threads.quote: Allan: I never expected there to be monsters here.

introduced.name: Amir
introduced.how: A man who posted a commission for Raw Meat and oversees search and rescue dogs
introduced.quote: Amir: Yeah, I did post a commission on Raw Meat.

introduced.name: Raw Meat
introduced.how: A commissioned food item; Amir needs eight pieces to feed the dogs
introduced.quote: Amir: Did you get enough? I need eight pieces of them.

introduced.name: Search and rescue dogs
introduced.how: A working dog group under Amir's care that must be fed to avoid starving
introduced.quote: Amir: The quality is good. The search and rescue dogs won't starve. Thanks.

assumed.name: That girl
assumed.quote: Amir: I hope they pay close attention to that girl's condition and report any changes immediately.

threads.claim: Search and rescue dogs are watching a girl's condition, hinting at an unexplained rescue or injury.
threads.quote: Amir: I hope they pay close attention to that girl's condition and report any changes immediately.

introduced.name: Cloud Retainer
introduced.how: an adeptus with mechanical studies who built a flying home and now orders the Traveler around
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Once upon a time, when I had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, I built for myself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

introduced.name: Dwelling in the Clouds
introduced.how: a mechanical dwelling built by Cloud Retainer and suspended in the air, made mostly of plaustrite
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: Once upon a time, when I had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, I built for myself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

introduced.name: "Dwelling in the Clouds" Blueprints
introduced.how: blueprints for the Dwelling that Cloud Retainer left inside it and now wants retrieved
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: After construction of the Dwelling in the Clouds was complete, I left the blueprints there.

introduced.name: seal
introduced.how: a seal Cloud Retainer placed to guard the blueprints from anyone without true affinity
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: I also added a seal, thinking that one of true affinity with the blueprints might eventually obtain them. But no — to this day, the seal stands.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: a mortal-built chamber hanging in the air above Liyue, which Cloud Retainer disparages as mundane
introduced.quote: Cloud Retainer: One has heard of a certain Jade Chamber that hangs in the air above Liyue, built by mortal hands.

introduced.name: food offering
introduced.how: offering food to Cloud Retainer is what gets her to speak with you
introduced.quote: Paimon: You mean one dish is only enough to get her to speak? She sure is persnickety...

introduced.name: wind currents
introduced.how: wind currents can carry you up to places you cannot climb to on foot
introduced.quote: Paimon: Where's a wind current when you need one?

assumed.name: Jewelry Soup
assumed.quote: (After offering Jewelry Soup)

assumed.name: adepti
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ah! Paimon remembers. Doesn't that one adeptus who loves food live here?

assumed.name: earlier visit to Cloud Retainer
assumed.quote: Paimon: Last time, we had to offer tons of tasty food before she would even spare us her attention...

assumed.name: earlier trip through the domain
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: Do not tarry. Hasten now, and deliver it to me. You have come this way before — or have you forgotten so soon?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Cloud Retainer: One has heard of a certain Jade Chamber that hangs in the air above Liyue, built by mortal hands.

threads.claim: Adepti look down on mortals as unable to grasp adepti ingenuity.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Hmph! Such are the limits of mortal comprehension, that they fail to fathom the ingenuity of the adepti.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer fears mortal mechanics are developing in a mistaken direction and feels obliged to correct it.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: I fear that this will cause mechanics among mortals to develop in a woefully mistaken direction. It falls to me to point them down the right path.

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer has undisclosed reasons for wanting the blueprints back, and the reason is withheld.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Naturally, I have my reasons. But please, do not presume that you could scrutinize an idea conceived in the mind of an adeptus.

threads.claim: Only someone with true affinity to the blueprints can obtain them, so the seal is meant to screen visitors.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: I also added a seal, thinking that one of true affinity with the blueprints might eventually obtain them. But no — to this day, the seal stands.

threads.claim: The Dwelling has a most marvelous feature that Cloud Retainer refuses to explain.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: This Dwelling in the Clouds was built principally from plaustrite, supported by a multitude of other ingenious features...

threads.claim: Cloud Retainer dismisses the Jade Chamber, which mortals praise for its size, as tedious and mundane.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: Jade Chamber my foot!

threads.claim: The Traveler retrieves the blueprints and confirms they belong to the Dwelling in the Clouds, though the purpose stays unexplained.
threads.quote: Cloud Retainer: These are indeed the blueprints for my Dwelling in the Clouds. One is most pleased.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Oh, look who's here! It's those Treasure Hoarder guys again.

introduced.name: Qingzhou
introduced.how: a poet who wants to write a poem about Liyue as it is today and asks the Traveler to gather inspiration
introduced.quote: I merely feel that if I am to offer up a poem for Liyue as it is today, then I must draw inspiration from the city itself.

introduced.name: Hao (Liyue Harbor)
introduced.how: a food-loving resident who believes a city's cuisine reveals whether it is good
introduced.quote: The quickest way to know if a place is good or not is to see how its cuisine tastes.

introduced.name: Fan Er'ye
introduced.how: an older opera fan who prefers classic operas and is puzzled by the new ones
introduced.quote: Personally, I don't mind hearing some old classics. They're what I'm used to, after all.

introduced.name: Heyu Tea House
introduced.how: a tea house that has recently released several new operas
introduced.quote: Heyu Tea House has released a few new operas lately.

introduced.name: Qingzhou's signature
introduced.how: a signature that can be exchanged for a free anthology copy once the anthology is published
introduced.quote: Once my new anthology is published, you may exchange this signature for a free copy.
