threads.claim: Aranakin has lost his memory of the Traveler and Paimon and of their shared adventures.
threads.quote: Paimon: Ah, he's gone... But Paimon understands, he's forgotten our adventures together, after all.

threads.claim: Aranakin cannot remember the Traveler, nor the Nara who once knew him, and the notebook hints at his past.
threads.quote: Aranakin: But Aranakin can't remember, just like Aranakin can't remember you.

threads.claim: A Nara friend of Aranakin may return one day, though Aranakin cannot recall his name.
threads.quote: Aranakin: He will be back one day, right? Just like you, even if I can't remember his name...

threads.claim: Aranakin taught his song to the missing Nara, who did not come back the way the Traveler did.
threads.quote: Aranakin: Right, Nara's instrument... I still keep it. I think I taught my song to him as well, but he didn't come back like you did.

threads.claim: The notebook writer asked that the flower be given to Aranakin, and the Traveler delivers it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh right! He also said in the notebook that... This flower is for you!

threads.claim: Aranaga is a plant Aranakin plans to plant, and Mawtiyima may know how to wake her.
threads.quote: Aranakin: I am taking this flower back, Mawtiyima should know how to wake her up.

introduced.name: Jam
introduced.how: Traveler makes Jam for Arayesh, who needs at least two jars and orders in bulk
introduced.quote: Arayesh: One jar won't last for more than a few days. I need at least two jars.

assumed.name: Arayesh
assumed.quote: Arayesh: Do you need an in-room haircut service?

introduced.name: Nilotpala Lotus
introduced.how: a flower Arina commissioned, valued for its beauty and wanted in quantity
introduced.quote: Here are the Nilotpala Lotuses you wanted.

introduced.name: Arina
introduced.how: a commissioner who wants lotuses to decorate her room
introduced.quote: Then it won't be enough for me to decorate my room.

introduced.name: commission
introduced.how: a posted request that the Traveler can fulfill by delivering items
introduced.quote: Oh yeah, I posted that commission.

assumed.name: Sumeru Rose
assumed.quote: Which one is better? The Nilotpala Lotus or Sumeru Rose?

assumed.name: Armin
assumed.quote: I'll have Armin come and take a look at them.

introduced.name: Rytova
introduced.how: a struggling dancer hoping to pass the troupe's audition
introduced.quote: Rytova: Miss Odette is right, I really don't dance very well... At this rate, passing the troupe's audition is looking like just a pipe dream...

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a dance instructor who gives guidance and has made it onto a stage before
introduced.quote: Odette: I noticed her dancing in the snowfield outside of town. She was clearly struggling, and I happened to be free, so I came to give her some guidance.

introduced.name: Domovoy
introduced.how: Rytova's friends who cheer her on, dress her wounds, and whom she promised to teach to dance
introduced.quote: Rytova: Oh, those are my friends. When I used to practice by myself, they sometimes came by to cheer me on.

introduced.name: the troupe
introduced.how: a dance troupe that holds auditions and chooses dancers for the stage
introduced.quote: Odette: Every dancer who auditions for the troupe tells themselves the same thing.

introduced.name: Dance Course
introduced.how: a dance minigame where the lead dancer demonstrates moves and the Traveler later copies them
introduced.quote: |text1 = The lead dancer will demonstrate moves first. Travelers must and instruct dancers to at a later point in the music.

introduced.name: Fever Time
introduced.how: a peak phase of the dance where the Traveler must follow the lead dancer
introduced.quote: |text3 = As the music flows, the atmosphere builds, and Fever Time is just around the corner!During Fever Time, follow the lead dancer to .

assumed.name: Vodyanitsa
assumed.quote: Odette: ...Only Vodyanitsa likes being called "prima."

assumed.name: Rankova Zorya
assumed.quote: (Approach the stage in Rankova Zorya)

assumed.name: Fae
assumed.quote: Odette: ...She might come to miss the days she spent dancing with the fae in the snowfields.

threads.claim: Dancers who fail to reach the stage have their pasts buried and forgotten, a theme tied to Odette's own history.
threads.quote: Odette: Their pasts will be buried under the snow, forgotten by everyone except themselves.

threads.claim: Odette once made it onto the stage but refuses to talk about her past as a dancer.
threads.quote: Odette: Once. But I don't like talking about the past. It's pointless.

threads.claim: Talent without opportunity can become a curse for a dancer.
threads.quote: Odette: Rytova has potential. But for a dancer, talent without opportunity can prove an insurmountable curse.

threads.claim: Odette hints that Rytova will one day miss the time she spent dancing with the fae in the snowfields.
threads.quote: Odette: ...She might come to miss the days she spent dancing with the fae in the snowfields.

threads.claim: The winter and snowfield are framed as a harsh trial that dancers and travelers must endure to succeed.
threads.quote: Odette: Every traveler believes they can conquer the winter up until the point when they freeze to death on the tundra.

introduced.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
introduced.how: a game where you launch Finchballs in order to land them on scoring rings for rewards
introduced.quote: Place as many Finchballs as you can in to gain the target score and thus the corresponding rewards.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: station manager who is rebuilding the station with Odette and Alyosha
introduced.quote: I'm the manager of the station where you're opening shop

introduced.name: Mayskaya
introduced.how: helper sent to run the booth in Basima's absence while Basima works on a new mode
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, Basima couldn't make it as she's busy working on a new Finchball gameplay mode.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a ballet dancer who is always on the move helping with the station
introduced.quote: Good thing she's a ballet dancer.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: busy helper who picks out reliable dogs to guard the station
introduced.quote: But he did pick out a few reliable dogs to help guard the station.

introduced.name: the station
introduced.how: a train station in poor condition that trains stop at and that is being renovated
introduced.quote: this station isn't in very good shape.

assumed.name: Basima the Fifth
assumed.quote: Where is Basima, anyway?

assumed.name: Odette
assumed.quote: You know Odette — she's always on the move, her feet barely touch the ground all day.

assumed.name: A Thread of Dawn-Light
assumed.quote: (If A Thread of Dawn-Light was completed)

threads.claim: The station is not completely abandoned and is being restored by the group.
threads.quote: The good news is, this station isn't completely abandoned.

threads.claim: Basima is developing a new Finchball gameplay mode that she is not present to finish.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, Basima couldn't make it as she's busy working on a new Finchball gameplay mode.

introduced.name: Kairagi
introduced.how: a motley band of opportunists who team up only for selfish gain, with no loyalty or conviction
introduced.quote: The Kairagi are ultimately a motley band who've banded together for their own selfish gain. Loyalty plays no part here, nor does conviction.

introduced.name: Doushin
introduced.how: a warrior class for whom their weapon represents their dignity
introduced.quote: It's often said that a Doushin's weapon is their dignity.

introduced.name: Kairagi leader
introduced.how: the Kairagi boss who challenges foes to duels and keeps stolen weapons in a collection
introduced.quote: After I ran out of energy, their leader challenged me to a duel.

introduced.name: Asakura's weapon
introduced.how: Asakura's spear was stolen and kept by the Kairagi boss as part of his collection
introduced.quote: That weapon was taken by our boss as part of his collection.

introduced.name: Kairagi main encampment
introduced.how: the Kairagi's main camp, where their leader is found
introduced.quote: However, our next stop is their main encampment.

introduced.name: Asakura's previous defeat
introduced.how: Asakura was beaten earlier because the Kairagi wore him down with numbers and stamina drain
introduced.quote: I was defeated by them last time because the Kairagi were able to use their numerical advantage and took turns in whittling away my stamina.

assumed.name: Asakura
assumed.quote: Asakura: You're here just in time. Today's an important day!

assumed.name: Asakura's stolen weapon
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is this about your weapon...

assumed.name: Traveler's earlier encounter with the Kairagi
assumed.quote: It's you again? You barely escaped that last time and you're coming back for more?

threads.claim: Asakura vows to redeem himself by reclaiming his stolen weapon from the Kairagi.
threads.quote: Today, I will redeem myself and take back my weapon!

threads.claim: Asakura defeats the Kairagi leader himself and recovers his weapon, ending his humiliation.
threads.quote: More importantly, I have defeated him myself and reclaimed my weapon.

threads.claim: The Kairagi are opportunists who abandon their allies as soon as trouble appears.
threads.quote: The moment trouble starts brewing on the horizon, they will pack up and leave. This is all too common.

threads.claim: Doushin regard their weapons as the core of their dignity, so losing one is deeply shameful.
threads.quote: It's often said that a Doushin's weapon is their dignity.

threads.claim: The wounded Kairagi leader escaped and may return to cause trouble after a few years.
threads.quote: I do not believe that he will emerge to do much ill for at least a few years.

threads.claim: The Kairagi leader hoards stolen weapons in a collection and wants more.
threads.quote: What, are you here to add something to my collection again?

threads.claim: Asakura attributes his defeat to his lack of training and plans to train harder.
threads.quote: The reason for this whole incident was my lack of training.

introduced.name: Drogin
introduced.how: Director of the Royal Railway Transport Bureau, under suspicion of corruption
introduced.quote: What's your impression of the Director of the Transport Bureau, Mr. Drogin?

introduced.name: Royal Railway Transport Bureau
introduced.how: Government bureau whose authority has expanded and which now keeps public order in the city
introduced.quote: For various reasons, the scope of the Transport Bureau's authority has been expanded several times throughout its history.

introduced.name: Sokov
introduced.how: Deceased man from Port Belovodye, a heavy drinker and lottery player with no steady job, and the prime suspect
introduced.quote: Sokov, the deceased, lived in Port Belovodye.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: Higher authority that suspects Drogin of colluding with gangs and sent Danica to investigate
introduced.quote: Zapolyarny Palace suspects Drogin of colluding with local gangs and using his position to cover up their crimes.

introduced.name: Port Belovodye
introduced.how: Port district where Sokov died on a bridge in view of shore witnesses
introduced.quote: It happened in broad daylight on the bridge at Port Belovodye.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A vast nation
introduced.quote: Snezhnaya is a vast nation.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: Realm that a person can be transported into, where entering unprepared is nearly certain death
introduced.quote: Entering the Shadow Realm without adequate preparation is a death sentence for the average person.

introduced.name: Shadow Realm Generator
introduced.how: Device hidden behind Drogin that transports a person into the Shadow Realm, activated by a switch in his badge
introduced.quote: The device was hidden behind him this whole time, and the switch to activate it was hidden inside his badge.

introduced.name: Sokov's death (official accident)
introduced.how: Official account: Sokov, drunk, slipped into the water and hit his head on a reef
introduced.quote: Victim was drunk, slipped and fell into the water, hit the back of his head on a reef.

introduced.name: Sokov's staged death
introduced.how: Proposed theory: the killer tied Sokov to a rock, submerged him, then cut the ropes so the body surfaced as a fake accident
introduced.quote: All the killer had to do was tie Sokov to a rock and submerge him in the water.

introduced.name: Drogin's undercover past
introduced.how: Drogin once infiltrated a bandit gang and worked undercover for years
introduced.quote: they indicate that you once infiltrated a gang of bandits and worked undercover for many years.

introduced.name: coded-letter contact system
introduced.how: Criminals used secret coded letters and rendezvous points, and switched to newspaper codes after a meeting
introduced.quote: The deceased used to contact someone through these secret codes before his death.

assumed.name: Danica
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Danica!

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: are you... the legendary honored guests of the Tsaritsa?

assumed.name: Project Stuzha
assumed.quote: Paimon thought all the corrupt officials were dealt with back when Project Stuzha was suspended...

assumed.name: Vodyanitsa
assumed.quote: Vodyanitsa! Didn't expect to see a familiar name here... Could it have something to do with her identity?

assumed.name: Kristall
assumed.quote: (One of Danica's subordinates watches Drogin from afar as he inspects some piles of Kristall)

assumed.name: Hydro
assumed.quote: An introduction to the properties and applications of Hydro, Pyro, and Cryo.

assumed.name: Pyro
assumed.quote: An introduction to the properties and applications of Hydro, Pyro, and Cryo.

assumed.name: Cryo
assumed.quote: An introduction to the properties and applications of Hydro, Pyro, and Cryo.

threads.claim: Drogin is suspected of colluding with gangs and covering up their crimes, which is not yet proven.
threads.quote: Zapolyarny Palace suspects Drogin of colluding with local gangs and using his position to cover up their crimes.

threads.claim: Sokov's death may not have been the accident the official record describes.
threads.quote: Frankly, I don't think Drogin would resort to such crude and conspicuous methods to destroy evidence, but he is definitely hiding something in this case.

threads.claim: The body that surfaced may not have been Sokov himself, raising doubt about the witnesses' testimony.
threads.quote: Were they really the same person?

threads.claim: Danica reveals the killer staged Sokov's death by cutting his own palm and using ropes to fake the bloodied corpse.
threads.quote: Namely... to cut yourself while cutting the rope.

threads.claim: The reason Drogin would kill Sokov is unknown and puzzling.
threads.quote: Why would someone of his status and personality suddenly kill Sokov?

threads.claim: Sokov's death was probably not part of Drogin's original plan, and the cause of the conflict remains unknown.
threads.quote: I suspect Sokov's death was never part of Drogin's original plan.

threads.claim: Criminals may be hiding coded messages in newspapers, as a plausible way to pass messages.
threads.quote: Hiding a coded message in a newspaper would be relatively easy...

threads.claim: The final coded message is hidden in the margins of a newspaper published two days before Sokov's death.
threads.quote: the final coded message is hidden in the margins of this newspaper

threads.claim: The name Vodyanitsa is familiar to Paimon and may tie to someone's identity.
threads.quote: Vodyanitsa! Didn't expect to see a familiar name here... Could it have something to do with her identity?

threads.claim: Excessive power in the Transport Bureau tends to breed ambition and corruption.
threads.quote: But excessive power often breeds greater ambition.

threads.claim: Drogin escapes into the Shadow Realm using a hidden generator, which is a near-certain death sentence for most people.
threads.quote: He used a Shadow Realm Generator... I didn't think he'd resort to something like this for an escape plan.

threads.claim: Drogin has not been caught and may return to threaten the investigation.
threads.quote: It's not... over... yet!

introduced.name: Blackbody Containment Generation Station

introduced.quote: Paimon: A Blackbody Containment... Generation Station?

introduced.name: Lunar sea
introduced.how: the facility lies hidden beneath the lunar sea
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon didn't think there'd be a place like this hidden under the lunar sea. What do you think they did here? Let's take a look around!

introduced.name: Glowing jellyfish
introduced.how: glowing jellyfish guide the way through the dark facility and some are trapped
introduced.quote: Paimon: This place is so dark. Let's be careful and follow those glowing jellyfish.

introduced.name: Ancient Moon Pearl
introduced.how: a Moon Pearl is needed to open the door and must be searched for nearby
introduced.quote: Search nearby for the Ancient Moon Pearl needed to open the door

introduced.name: Terminal

introduced.quote: Traveler: Activate Facility

assumed.name: Precursors

threads.claim: The purpose of the underwater facility is unknown and left open.
threads.quote: Paimon: No idea! Paimon's never heard that name before.

threads.claim: Activating the Terminal starts the facility, but what it was built to do is still not explained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Activate Facility

threads.claim: A large facility has been hidden under the lunar sea, raising the question of why it was concealed.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon didn't think there'd be a place like this hidden under the lunar sea. What do you think they did here? Let's take a look around!

threads.claim: Many glowing jellyfish are trapped inside the facility, and the reason is left open.
threads.quote: Paimon: So many jellyfish are trapped here.

threads.claim: A small sphere failed to drop with the lift, leaving the route to the Ancient Moon Pearl unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Why didn't that little sphere drop down? We'll have to do something about it.

threads.claim: A huge blue tree is hidden inside the facility, and its significance is not yet explained.
threads.quote: (A huge blue tree is shown inside)

introduced.name: Landa
introduced.how: a merchant who often travels between Mondstadt and Liyue on business and needs the Traveler's help recovering lost invoices
introduced.quote: Landa: Oh, you're a traveler... Well, you see, I'm a merchant, and I often shuttle between Mondstadt and Liyue on business.

introduced.name: Bao'er
introduced.how: a person who picked up the box of invoices and will return them only in exchange for Noctilucous Jade
introduced.quote: Bao'er: A box? Well, I did pick one up.

introduced.name: Landa's boss
introduced.how: an unnamed, very rich merchant in Liyue whom Landa works for and fears
introduced.quote: Landa: My boss? Uh, well, it's a really rich merchant in Liyue. Really rich.

introduced.name: Noctilucous Jade
introduced.how: the item Bao'er demands in exchange for the invoices
introduced.quote: Bao'er: You fetch me 3 Noctilucous Jades, and I'll give you the invoices. How does that sound?

introduced.name: Invoices
introduced.how: a batch of wine business invoices that Landa lost and must recover before his boss finds out
introduced.quote: Landa: For wine, of course. What other business would one do in Mondstadt, anyway?

assumed.name: Statue of the Seven
assumed.quote: (Upon recovering the invoices near the Statue of the Seven)

assumed.name: Mondstadt and Liyue
assumed.quote: Landa: Oh, you're a traveler... Well, you see, I'm a merchant, and I often shuttle between Mondstadt and Liyue on business.

threads.claim: Landa's employer is a very rich Liyue merchant whose identity and business are kept secret.
threads.quote: Landa: I'm sorry, I really can't tell you. It's a secret.

threads.claim: Bao'er hints that the invoices reveal a big shot in Liyue who signed a very large deal.
threads.quote: Bao'er: The value of the goods on those invoices is not low by any means. Makes one wonder which big shot in Liyue it was who signed off on it.

threads.claim: Landa's panic at the opened box suggests the boss's business is dangerous to expose.
threads.quote: Landa: Oh, I'm dead. Dead. Dead! This... this won't do. I have to tell the boss quickly...

threads.claim: Landa implies he has investigated the Traveler, hinting that someone is watching or checking up on them.
threads.quote: Landa: Oh, don't worry, I'm not suspicious of you. I mean, I did do my homework regarding your...

introduced.name: Manager Kuan
introduced.how: Forge manager who asks the Traveler to check a monster-overrun worksite
introduced.quote: And I would go myself to investigate, but I dare not leave my daughter here or bring her along...

introduced.name: Blackcliff Forge
introduced.how: ore-producing operation with worksites and production schedules that can be disrupted
introduced.quote: Oh, what would it be if not the problem with the Blackcliff Forge?

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: authority that ordered the Forge's work halted and must approve resuming it
introduced.quote: The order for us to cease work was sent directly from the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: group that scavenges at the Chasm worksite, the only ones doing any work there
introduced.quote: Paimon thinks it makes sense. They're the only people who would do any work here...

introduced.name: Chasm
introduced.how: area near the Forge where monsters have overrun a worksite
introduced.quote: Please, help me to investigate the area around the Chasm.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The Millelith tried to give them the boot many times, but they returned with greater numbers every single time.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Those Treasure Hoarders would really do anything for Mora, huh...

threads.claim: Monsters suddenly appeared from nowhere in large numbers, and their origin and purpose remain unexplained.
threads.quote: But a band of monsters suddenly came out of nowhere and took over one of our work sites.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders are gathering at the Chasm for unclear reasons, and their activity there is questioned.
threads.quote: Even the Treasure Hoarders are here! What are they doing?

threads.claim: The Ministry of Civil Affairs can halt Forge work and controls approval to resume it, hinting at its power over the Forge.
threads.quote: How could they just stop work at the drop of a hat like that?

introduced.name: Raef
introduced.how: Raef is a busy villager who asks the Traveler to fetch his order and is Nermin's boyfriend
introduced.quote: Raef: They're for my girlfriend, Nermin.

introduced.name: Nermin
introduced.how: Nermin is Raef's girlfriend, in poor health and convalescing at home, and is bad at caring for plants
introduced.quote: Raef: She's in poor health, so she's been convalescing at home.

introduced.name: Azalai
introduced.how: Azalai runs a shop that sells goods and gardening supplies to villagers and receives deliveries
introduced.quote: Azalai: Oh, you mean the stuff he ordered from me?

introduced.name: Aaru Village
introduced.how: Aaru Village lies in the middle of the desert with little greenery
introduced.quote: Aaru Village is in the middle of the desert, so there's not much greenery to go around.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Raef, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Raef, optional)

assumed.name: Kulsoom

threads.claim: A second batch of goods has gone missing at Azalai's shop, and its whereabouts are unexplained.
threads.quote: Azalai: Strange, where's that other batch of goods?

threads.claim: Raef's large order seems excessive, and his explanation for it is evasive.
threads.quote: Raef: Uh, well, I... I just wanted to buy more at once to save myself some extra trips, you know?

introduced.name: Little Nine
introduced.how: A young girl who lost a special book and asks the Traveler for help finding it
introduced.quote: Little Nine: I can't find it anywhere...

introduced.name: Big Nine
introduced.how: Little Nine's ninth-in-family neighbor who wrote the book for her and is close to her
introduced.quote: Little Nine: He lives next door to me. We're both ninth in our family so our names both have nine in them.

introduced.name: the book
introduced.how: A special book Big Nine wrote for Little Nine, which he intends to have published
introduced.quote: Little Nine: A book... Big Nine wrote it specially for me.

assumed.name: the Traveler's reputation as a capable, good person
assumed.quote: Little Nine: Everyone says that is a very good person and can do anything! Can you help me find my book? Pleeeease?

threads.claim: The lost book is a special gift from Big Nine that he plans to publish, and his reaction to its loss is an open question.
threads.quote: Little Nine: The book was a present from him. He's gonna get it published, but he let me have a sneaky look at it first.

threads.claim: Little Nine knows the Traveler by name and has seen them everywhere because people talk about them constantly.
threads.quote: Little Nine: People talk about you all the time! And I keep seeing you everywhere...

threads.claim: Little Nine vanishes from the spot where the Traveler met her, leaving her whereabouts unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: What the... Where'd that girl go?

introduced.name: Canotila
introduced.how: Melusine scholar who meditates by a waterfall and reads hidden books; learned the name Canotila
introduced.quote: Still, everyone calls me Canotila, and you may do so as well.

introduced.name: Melusines
introduced.how: a people who can see things humans cannot, and Canotila sees differently even among them
introduced.quote: Perhaps you've heard that we Melusines can see things that humans cannot see...

introduced.name: Elynas (NPC)
introduced.how: a giant beast whose flesh is toxic and was studied by the scholar
introduced.quote: The pollution of the land and water wrought by the giant beast Elynas seems to have been mostly purified and diluted.

introduced.name: Jakob
introduced.how: a brave young person who was used in experiments involving Elynas's flesh
introduced.quote: Jakob has returned. He's quite brave, but also an idiot.

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: a sibling of the writer who enrolled in the Institute of Natural Philosophy
introduced.quote: Alain has enrolled in the Institute of Natural Philosophy.

introduced.name: Mary-Ann Guillotin
introduced.how: a sibling of the writer who is reunited with the writer
introduced.quote: As for Mary-Ann, just the sight of her fills me with joy.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: an organization that Uncle Guillotin belongs to and that the writer distrusts
introduced.quote: Uncle Guillotin, who was with them, is part of the Maison Gardiennage.

introduced.name: Institute of Natural Philosophy
introduced.how: an institute where the brightest minds of Fontaine gather to research
introduced.quote: The brightest minds of Fontaine are gathered there, and we can expect to make huge progress and get much-needed help...

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: a region whose brightest minds gather at the Institute of Natural Philosophy
introduced.quote: The brightest minds of Fontaine are gathered there, and we can expect to make huge progress and get much-needed help...

introduced.name: Golden Troupe
introduced.how: an earlier group that left behind magical techniques
introduced.quote: Here I found the magical techniques left behind by the Golden Troupe

introduced.name: Seal of the Chymical Marriage
introduced.how: a two-part magical technique left by the Golden Troupe
introduced.quote: it appears to be known as the "Seal of the Chymical Marriage" and consists of two parts.

introduced.name: Fortuna
introduced.how: the ancient idea that a new civilization is born from the ashes of a destroyed one
introduced.quote: Kingdoms rise and fall, and when a civilization is annihilated, a new one will be born after from the ashes

introduced.name: world-formula
introduced.how: the writer's computational scheme for calculating the future of the world
introduced.quote: it bears striking resemblance to the computational scheme I have formulated and termed

introduced.name: Enigmatic Page
introduced.how: pages of the hidden book that must be collected and reinserted to reveal its text
introduced.quote: Canotila: These do look like the missing pages from the book! Let's try putting one back in, shall we?

introduced.name: Beastly Rifts
introduced.how: rifts through which dog-shaped monsters pour out, linked to a location full of such monsters
introduced.quote: is full of these monsters, and I shall tentatively call them

introduced.name: Rifthounds
introduced.how: dog-shaped black monsters that emerge from passages and are called Rifthounds
introduced.quote: During this time, many black monsters that were shaped like dogs emerged.

introduced.name: dreamscape space
introduced.how: a dreamlike space entered through meditation that shows ruins or gardens depending on the viewer
introduced.quote: This is like some kind of dreamscape! This must be the strange place you were talking about before.

introduced.name: golden butterfly
introduced.how: a golden butterfly seen flying out of the pages and leading to a garden
introduced.quote: I can see golden butterflies flying out from the page, just like the one I saw in the space before.

introduced.name: token fissures
introduced.how: hidden fissures in the water that Canotila opens by drawing a line with her token
introduced.quote: As long as I use my token to draw a line across those fissures, I can do some incredible things.

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Institute
assumed.quote: We had a long discussion about the Narzissenkreuz Institute

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: The Khaenri'ahn records mention

assumed.name: Limner, Dreamer, and Robotic Dog
assumed.quote: (If Limner, Dreamer, and Robotic Dog has been completed)

assumed.name: desert expedition
assumed.quote: These monsters are identical to those we discovered during our desert expedition.

assumed.name: Looking Glass
assumed.quote: Whether you have arrived at this place via the Book of Revealing or the Looking Glass

assumed.name: Sweet Flower and Mint
assumed.quote: where not even a Sweet Flower or a Mint can grow

threads.claim: The world-formula calculations predict a cataclysm after which no new civilization will be born.
threads.quote: Unlike the world depicted in these ancient texts, there will be no more new civilizations born

threads.claim: The scattered page confirms that the world-formula reached a grim conclusion about the end of all things.
threads.quote: That's the conclusion the world-formula arrived at after countless calculations.

threads.claim: Elynas may have a will of its own and its flesh is hardening into a protective membrane.
threads.quote: Though I have no substantive evidence, I still sensed some sort of

threads.claim: The writer wants to use Elynas's vitality to strengthen Jakob, and experiments on him continue.
threads.quote: it may also be used to enhance Jakob's strength by following the same principle

threads.claim: The passages open onto a location full of dog-shaped monsters called Rifthounds.
threads.quote: is full of these monsters, and I shall tentatively call them

threads.claim: A Rifthound stops attacking and seems to communicate, and a dog helps open a way out.
threads.quote: On top of the garden, there was a cute little dog that nodded at me, and helped open the way out for me.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah records describe passages and dangerous monsters that link to the present events.
threads.quote: The Khaenri'ahn records mention

threads.claim: The Looking Glass is another way into the prophecy space.
threads.quote: Whether you have arrived at this place via the Book of Revealing or the Looking Glass

threads.claim: Meditating with the book transports the mind to another world where the book's contents can be understood.
threads.quote: It feels as though you've been transported to another world, and then, you can start to understand the book's contents.

threads.claim: The dreamlike space looks like a ruin to Paimon and the Traveler but like a garden to Canotila.
threads.quote: The place we entered was so serene and peaceful, like a beautiful garden.

threads.claim: Canotila suspects her token and the hidden fissures explain why she is special.
threads.quote: It has much to do with me and my token, and I'm also certain that if I figure it out, I'll know why I'm special in this way.

threads.claim: Canotila sees things differently even from other Melusines and can find hidden things.
threads.quote: But for some reason, I see things differently, even when compared to other Melusines.

threads.claim: The Golden Troupe left magical techniques whose sources are still unclear.
threads.quote: Here I found the magical techniques left behind by the Golden Troupe

threads.claim: Canotila suggests the future predicted in the book is not fixed.
threads.quote: After all, such things aren't set in stone, are they?

threads.claim: Reassembling the three Enigmatic Pages reveals research on Elynas, Jakob, and the Institute.
threads.quote: These do look like the missing pages from the book! Let's try putting one back in, shall we?

threads.claim: The writer distrusts Uncle Guillotin of Maison Gardiennage despite his kindness to Alain and Mary-Ann.
threads.quote: Although he seems to be treating Alain and Mary-Ann very well, he still can't be trusted.

introduced.name: Pankration
introduced.how: a spectator combat sport where entertaining the audience matters most
introduced.quote: Roussimoff: Lemme put it this way: A Pankration match is a spectator sport. Entertaining the audience is more important than who wins and who loses.

introduced.name: Genevieve
introduced.how: a researcher who is entering the tournament and was sent here for injuring someone at a conference
introduced.quote: Genevieve: I'm all too familiar with the subject of his investigation. I injured them during a conference...

introduced.name: Roussimoff
introduced.how: the tournament organizer and ring announcer who controls who may fight
introduced.quote: Roussimoff: I've heard all about your past deeds. If we let enter the ring, the outcome is a foregone conclusion, and all the anticipation is removed from the equation.

introduced.name: Poiret
introduced.how: a detective's assistant who was caught collecting documents at the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: Poiret: That's not entirely true. The truth is, I was doing an investigation at the Fontaine Research Institute before I came here.

introduced.name: Goncourt
introduced.how: a troupe member who supplies props and offers coaching support
introduced.quote: Goncourt: If I had time for that, don't you think I'd be better off rehearsing for the Tri-Coupon Troupe's performance?

introduced.name: Tri-Coupon Troupe
introduced.how: a performance troupe that Goncourt belongs to
introduced.quote: Goncourt: If I had time for that, don't you think I'd be better off rehearsing for the Tri-Coupon Troupe's performance?

introduced.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire
introduced.how: a combat soldier opponent who claims to have been famous among skirmisher recruits
introduced.quote: Fatui Skirmisher: Don't you underestimate me! I was once famous among the skirmisher recruits!

introduced.name: Kairagi: Dancing Thunder
introduced.how: an outlander samurai fighter who wants to regain his freedom
introduced.quote: Kairagi: As long as I defeat you, I can regain my freedom and live the good life with my brothers again...

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: a group that once pursued the samurai for days
introduced.quote: Roussimoff: Ooooh, close but no cigar! The outlander samurai, once pursued by the Maison Gardiennage for days, is stronger still!

introduced.name: Clockwork meka
introduced.how: mechanical fighters that are not human and can enter the tournament
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's crazy! Clockwork meka aren't even human. How are they allowed in a pankration tournament?

introduced.name: Annihilation Specialist Mek
introduced.how: a clockwork meka fighter that is part of the finals team
introduced.quote: Roussimoff: The finals are about to begin! The researcher and her assistant versus the formidable Specialist Meks clash in a winner-take-all bout!

introduced.name: Suppression Specialist Mek
introduced.how: a ranged clockwork meka fighter that is harder to reach
introduced.quote: Poiret: Right. This punk nearby has a thick skin but doesn't hit hard, while the one far away is the opposite...

introduced.name: Champvallon
introduced.how: a senior researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute who sends meka into the ring
introduced.quote: Poiret: Champvallon. He's a senior researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Bossuet
introduced.how: an Institute figure who had to step down after the academic dishonesty affair
introduced.quote: ???: Hah, what am I saying? I should be thanking you. Mr. Bossuet had to step down thanks to your academic dishonesty.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: the research body whose lab, prizes and reputation the story centers on
introduced.quote: Poiret: Champvallon. He's a senior researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute.

introduced.name: Fonta
introduced.how: a drink that the winning prize offers free access to
introduced.quote: Roussimoff: The winning team will receive Credit Coupons as well as a fantastic Fonta Trophy! Show it at the Fontaine Research Institute and you can drink all the Fonta you like, for free!

introduced.name: Cryo bottles
introduced.how: bottles filled with Cryo energy that Poiret throws to slow opponents
introduced.quote: Poiret: Yes. Close-quarter combat is not my forte, so I've prepared numerous bottles... filled with Cryo energy.

introduced.name: Pneumousia
introduced.how: a substance made by processing pneuma and ousia that can be stored in a container
introduced.quote: Genevieve: With some processing, pneumousia can be stored in a container — even in your sugar glass bottles.

assumed.name: Darcy
assumed.quote: Because the last time we were in a situation like this, both Darcy and Estienne were practically begging us to participate...

assumed.name: Estienne
assumed.quote: Because the last time we were in a situation like this, both Darcy and Estienne were practically begging us to participate...

assumed.name: Rave
assumed.quote: Genevieve: Darcy isn't, as far as I know. And Rave... I doubt he'll feel the need to. He did take all our Coupons, after all.

assumed.name: Clynes
assumed.quote: having met some engineers from the Fontaine Research Institute before, like Clynes

assumed.name: Melusine
assumed.quote: Everything was going fine until I ran into that Melusine...

assumed.name: Gardemeks
assumed.quote: And not your typical Gardemeks mass-produced in the fortress, either.

assumed.name: Armored Crab
assumed.quote: Poiret: Roussimoff's fists hit harder than an Armored Crab's claws... But I can take it!

threads.claim: Rave, who took the team's Coupons, has apparently left the Fortress for good.
threads.quote: Genevieve: Nope. And I haven't seen him since. It's possible that he's left for good.

threads.claim: Genevieve was sent to the Fortress for injuring someone at a conference and is accused of academic dishonesty.
threads.quote: Genevieve: Oh... I know I was sent here for injuring him at a conference, and of course for other reasons, too...

threads.claim: Genevieve's dishonesty charge lacks evidence, but she cannot reproduce the disputed experiment's results.
threads.quote: Genevieve: Although it's true that they have no evidence to prove I committed academic dishonesty, the fact is I also haven't been able to reproduce the results from the disputed experiment...

threads.claim: Champvallon plans something nefarious by sending modified clockwork meka into the ring.
threads.quote: Genevieve: It sounds like he's gonna send clockwork meka into the ring to fight us on his behalf.

threads.claim: Champvallon's modified meka are destroyed, and his scheme fails in the finals.
threads.quote: Champvallon: Ugh, I should have known after last time... What a spectacular failure this was.

threads.claim: Poiret's uncle gave a cryptic reply to his letter, suggesting he knew something was about to happen.
threads.quote: Poiret: I knew something weird was going on! I guess he couldn't be bothered to help me since he knew what was about to happen.

threads.claim: Bossuet was forced to step down over academic dishonesty at the Institute, opening a power struggle.
threads.quote: ???: Hah, what am I saying? I should be thanking you. Mr. Bossuet had to step down thanks to your academic dishonesty.

threads.claim: Pneuma and ousia energies mutually destroy each other, which the team plans to use against the meka.
threads.quote: Genevieve: So as I was saying, we need to utilize the mutually destructive effects of pneuma and ousia energy to weaken the clockwork meka and create opportunities to attack.

threads.claim: The pneuma and ousia annihilation reaction works in the ring, confirming the mutual destruction effect.
threads.quote: Poiret: Bullseye! Pneumaousia annihilation successful!

threads.claim: A fighter was stuffed into a barrel with a note saying to look in the mirror, and the culprit may be competing too.
threads.quote: Roussimoff: Ahem, now then — your first opponent has quite an interesting origin story. He was stuffed into a barrel, and the barrel had a note on it that said: Take a look in the mirror.

threads.claim: Kairagi was caught and wants freedom, hinting at a past criminal life with his brothers.
threads.quote: Kairagi: As long as I defeat you, I can regain my freedom and live the good life with my brothers again...

introduced.name: Dainsleif
introduced.how: A mysterious cloaked-style stranger who hires out for 500 Mora and three questions, and who hunts the Abyss
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: My name's Dainsleif. I suppose you have some business with me?

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: A deity who defended Liyue Harbor for millennia using Gnosis
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Rex Lapis, who has defended Liyue Harbor for millennia on end, used his Gnosis to lay down a Contract to End All Contracts, of which the stipulations are still unknown.

introduced.name: Contract to End All Contracts
introduced.how: Rex Lapis's final contract, whose terms remain unknown, made after he used Gnosis
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Rex Lapis, who has defended Liyue Harbor for millennia on end, used his Gnosis to lay down a Contract to End All Contracts, of which the stipulations are still unknown.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: A group that spreads chaos in the world through Abyss creatures
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Ugh... Those creatures that serve the Abyss are the fangs and claws by which the Order spreads chaos in this world.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage
introduced.how: Creatures serving the Abyss, the Order's fangs and claws
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Ugh... Those creatures that serve the Abyss are the fangs and claws by which the Order spreads chaos in this world.

introduced.name: Abyss Herald
introduced.how: A more twisted Abyssal being that commands the Abyss Mages
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: An even more twisted Abyssal being, one that commands the Abyss Mages.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: A morass of madness and destruction that threatens the world's foundations and seeks to overthrow the archons
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: It is chaos, and it is also destruction. It is a morass of inconceivable madness that encroaches upon this world's very foundations.

introduced.name: Visions
introduced.how: Some people in the world gained Visions and others did not
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: This world has people who gained Visions, and those who did not.

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: A ruin formerly known as Stormterror's Lair, now mostly a lair in name only
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: I've heard about what happened to you during Mondstadt's crisis. When you came, this place was known as Stormterror's Lair.

introduced.name: Temple of the Falcon
introduced.how: An abandoned temple bearing marks of the Abyss
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: This abandoned temple does bear some marks of the Abyss.

introduced.name: Wolf King of the North
introduced.how: Lord of Wolvendom, a wolf ruler whose territory the Abyss traces reach
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Lord of Wolvendom, Great Wolf King of the North...

introduced.name: Dainsleif's former traveling companion
introduced.how: A past companion with whom Dainsleif adventured and who has since stopped traveling
introduced.quote: Dainsleif: Once upon a time, yes... I simply have the experience from adventuring together with that traveling companion.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: It has been a while since you joined the Adventurers' Guild. Are your adventures going smoothly?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Traveler: Hi, I'm an adventurer with the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Please don't talk down on yourself like that. You are the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all.

assumed.name: Lawrence
assumed.quote: Lawrence: Ah, Honorary Knight. Is something the matter?

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Lawrence: As long as Master Jean is here, there's nothing to fear from some suspicious unusual-looking person.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Traveler: So, just some distant relative of Kaeya's, then...

assumed.name: Wagner
assumed.quote: Wagner: What? You need something?

assumed.name: Charles
assumed.quote: Charles: What will it be, grape juice or apple cider?

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Angel's Share? Well, Master Diluc probably has his eye on that stranger too, then.

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Dainsleif: The crisis Mondstadt faced was resolved by an alliance between yourself and that... Anemo Archon who calls himself Venti.

assumed.name: Stormterror incident
assumed.quote: Traveler: Come to think of it, since the Stormterror incident ended, we haven't...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ooh, that's right! We've just been fighting against the Fatui in Liyue, who are human too...

assumed.name: Dragon of the East
assumed.quote: Dainsleif: That... is why even the Dragon of the East, a servant of a deity, was unable to resist its corrosive powers.

assumed.name: Light Actuators
assumed.quote: Dainsleif: Do you remember the Light Actuators that once sealed this ruin?

assumed.name: Unknown God
assumed.quote: (The Traveler remembers their encounter with the Unknown God)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Dainsleif: 500 Mora, and three answered questions.

threads.claim: Dainsleif seems to know far more about the Traveler and Venti than he should, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Traveler: How did you know that Venti is...!?

threads.claim: Dainsleif pursues an Abyss Herald, but the trail goes cold and the Herald has apparently already left.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Just a few Abyss Mages? Seems like that Herald might have already left.

threads.claim: Dainsleif explains that the Abyss desires the overthrow of a world ruled by the archons.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: And the creatures of the Abyss desire nothing less than the overthrow of a world ruled by the archons.

threads.claim: Rex Lapis's final contract has terms that remain unknown to the world.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Rex Lapis, who has defended Liyue Harbor for millennia on end, used his Gnosis to lay down a Contract to End All Contracts, of which the stipulations are still unknown.

threads.claim: Dainsleif asks whether those with Visions or without them matter more to the gods, raising a question about the gods' favor.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: Which of the two do you think hold more importance in the eyes of the gods?

threads.claim: Dainsleif has seen Old Mondstadt before the Dragon of the East fell, contradicting Paimon's understanding of the timeline.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: The first time I laid eyes upon the ruins of Old Mondstadt, the Dragon of the East had yet to fall, much less come to nest in this place.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's former traveling companion no longer travels, and the reason for their departure is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: No longer travels.

threads.claim: The Traveler feels a connection to something on this world through a dandelion, linked to their lost sibling and the Unknown God.
threads.quote: Traveler: I... could feel .

threads.claim: The Traveler senses something familiar on a cliff, possibly the Abyss or someone they know.
threads.quote: Traveler: ...I sense something familiar. On that cliff.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order may have been ordered to avoid the Traveler's path, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: It's possible that they may have been under orders to avoid your path.

threads.claim: Dainsleif's cryptic remark about the Falcon of the West hints at a deeper meaning tied to the gods.
threads.quote: Dainsleif: The Falcon of the West... though it can soar in the wind, it ultimately does naught but hover under the light of the gods...

introduced.name: Dr. Livingstone
introduced.how: self-described career adventurer who is searching for the seal
introduced.quote: I am Livingstone, a career adventurer.

introduced.name: Sword Cemetery
introduced.how: an ancient battlefield with sword-marked graves, probably left by soldiers on an expedition against monsters
introduced.quote: This Sword Cemetery is ancient. Presumably, it was left by soldiers on an expedition against monsters some time back in history...

introduced.name: Three concentric seals
introduced.how: barriers set up by the heroes of the past to cover the Sword Cemetery
introduced.quote: the heroes of the past set up three concentric seals to cover it.

introduced.name: Elemental Monument
introduced.how: mechanisms that create the seals, guarded by hilichurls in their camps
introduced.quote: The mechanisms create the seals covering the Sword Cemetery, while the hilichurls serve as de facto guardians of the mechanisms.

introduced.name: Meaty Tribe
introduced.how: muscle-loving hilichurl tribe to the north whose camp has an arena ring holding a mechanism
introduced.quote: To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe.

introduced.name: Sleeper Tribe
introduced.how: hilichurl tribe to the south that spends its days dozing but is crafty
introduced.quote: They spend most of the day dozing, but don't be fooled — they are crafty sons of witches...

introduced.name: Eclipse Tribe
introduced.how: shaman-worshiping hilichurl tribe in the eastern valley, the most dangerous of the three
introduced.quote: The Eclipse tribe is based in the valley to the east. Of the three hilichurl tribes, they are the most dangerous.

introduced.name: Abyss Mage
introduced.how: rare mage from the abyss that appears among the Eclipse tribe, once thought to be a myth
introduced.quote: There's also an Abyss Mage who crops up there now and then...

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Hilichurl camps?

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: the brooding abyss below

assumed.name: Monsters
assumed.quote: Amidst the valley flooded by monsters

assumed.name: Elemental powers
assumed.quote: set up by the survivors using elemental powers

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: The shaman there doesn't believe in The Seven

threads.claim: The Sword Cemetery is covered by seals that can only be broken by activating mechanisms in the hilichurl camps.
threads.quote: They can only be broken by defeating the three hilichurl tribes and activating the mechanism at each camp.

threads.claim: The Sword Cemetery holds fallen warriors whose graves were meant to remain undisturbed.
threads.quote: to let their fallen comrades — their graves marked with swords — rest undisturbed.

threads.claim: Hilichurls cannot craft mechanisms, so the mechanisms in their camps may be relics of ancient heroes.
threads.quote: Perhaps they are also relics left here by the heroes of old?

threads.claim: Abyss Mages appear among hilichurls in the Sword Cemetery area, which seems like a myth even to those who study it.
threads.quote: Honestly, if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I'd have sworn it was just a myth from some old book.

threads.claim: A shaman among the Eclipse tribe commands elements without believing in The Seven.
threads.quote: The shaman there doesn't believe in The Seven, but somehow, he can still command the elements.

threads.claim: Livingstone's adventurer ethos drives him to risk the hilichurl camps despite the danger.
threads.quote: We adventurers live to conquer the stars and the abyss.

introduced.name: Brook
introduced.how: a cook researching new meat recipes who posts commissions for ingredients
introduced.quote: Well, I'll need them to research new recipes, so please pass them to me once you've gathered them all.

introduced.name: Fowl
introduced.how: a meat ingredient Brook requests in servings of six
introduced.quote: Do you have those six servings of Fowl?

introduced.name: Raw Meat
introduced.how: a meat ingredient Brook requests in servings of six
introduced.quote: Well, do you have six servings of Raw Meat with you?

introduced.name: commission
introduced.how: a posted request for ingredients that Brook wants gathered and delivered
introduced.quote: I guess you saw my commission, huh?

assumed.name: commission board
assumed.quote: I guess you saw my commission, huh?

threads.claim: Brook promises the Traveler will be the first to try a new dish once her research is finished.
threads.quote: Come on over when I'm done with my research — you'll be the first to try my new dish, I promise.

introduced.name: Bruneau's request for Rainbow Roses
introduced.how: Bruneau submitted a request hoping someone would gift him a bouquet of Rainbow Roses, which the Traveler is now fulfilling
introduced.quote: Bruneau: That's right, I did submit a request, hoping someone would gift me a bouquet of Rainbow Roses.

assumed.name: Rainbow Roses
assumed.quote: Traveler: About Rainbow Roses...

assumed.name: Bruneau
assumed.quote: Bruneau: Are you here to help me fulfill my wish? Any flowers you bring are certain to be absolutely breathtaking.

introduced.name: Expeditions
introduced.how: Guild-organized trips to explore areas around the city and wilderness to track emerging dangers and unusual activity
introduced.quote: We organize expeditions to explore areas around the city and in the wilderness.

introduced.name: Adventure Rank
introduced.how: Rising Adventure Rank unlocks more dangerous expeditions
introduced.quote: As your Adventure Rank increases, more dangerous expeditions will become available to you.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: The Guild runs expeditions and takes no cut of the spoils, so rewards go to the Traveler and friends
introduced.quote: Rest assured that the Guild does not take a cut of the spoils from expeditions. Everything goes to you and your friends.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Sorry to bother you again.

assumed.name: Commissions
assumed.quote: We are most grateful for your commission completion to date. The guild's reputation has grown stronger as a result.

assumed.name: Traveler's friends
assumed.quote: Would your friends have the time to help out?

threads.claim: The Guild is receiving more requests than it can handle, which hints at growing pressure on the city.
threads.quote: However, another consequence is that we are receiving an unprecedented number of requests — more than our current numbers can handle.

threads.claim: Neglected expeditions could let trouble grow unchecked into a major disaster.
threads.quote: However, we neglect them at our peril. If trouble were to foment unchecked, it could easily turn into a major disaster.

introduced.name: Zompaynco
introduced.how: an outsider from Natlan, a Saurian Relics Association researcher who wants to visit the Frostmoon Scions
introduced.quote: Zompaynco: I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.

introduced.name: Lyylikki
introduced.how: kind Frostmoon Scions member who hands out meals and welcomes outsiders
introduced.quote: Jahoda: Don't worry, Lyylikki's really kind. Whether you're a complete stranger or in a form not entirely human, she's always warm and welcoming.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a group that has hosted outside guests and is hard to visit without an introduction
introduced.quote: Jahoda: You've always wanted to visit the Frostmoon Scions, right?

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: the homeland of Zompaynco, where fossil specimens come from
introduced.quote: Zompaynco: G—Greetings, Miss Lyylikki! It's such a pleasure to meet you. Uh... I brought this fossil specimen from Natlan along...

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association (Faction)
introduced.how: a Natlan research group that Zompaynco belongs to and studies fossils for
introduced.quote: Zompaynco: I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.

introduced.name: Chance Commission
introduced.how: a paid service run by Boss Nefer that sends helpers to clients and sometimes waives the fee
introduced.quote: Jahoda: Oh! And by the way, Boss also said we won't be charging you this time.

assumed.name: Boss Nefer
assumed.quote: Zompaynco: Ah... Jahoda? What brings you here? Hmm... Is Boss Nefer available right now?

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Zompaynco: Ah... Jahoda? What brings you here? Hmm... Is Boss Nefer available right now?

assumed.name: Boss's secret-keeping advice
assumed.quote: Jahoda: (Now is the time to use that super cool line that Boss said! What was that line again...? Um... Oh!)

threads.claim: Boss Nefer seems to know Zompaynco's private wish to visit the Frostmoon Scions without being told.
threads.quote: Zompaynco: What!? Lady Nefer knew it all along? But I've kept it locked in my heart and barely told anyone...

threads.claim: Zompaynco's wish to visit the Frostmoon Scions is put to Lyylikki, and her answer is left open.
threads.quote: Lyylikki: I see... so you're hoping to spend some time in the archives, then? Let me think...

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions have welcomed a few outside guests before, though their reasons for doing so are not explained.
threads.quote: Lyylikki: Of course. We've welcomed a few guests from outside before. But may I ask why?

threads.claim: Zompaynco wants to learn the local legends and records kept by the Frostmoon Scions.
threads.quote: Zompaynco: I'd like to take some photos and notes, look through some records, and if possible... ask someone about the local legends!

threads.claim: Zompaynco brings a fossil specimen from Natlan, tying the Saurian Relics Association's research to the Frostmoon Scions.
threads.quote: Zompaynco: G—Greetings, Miss Lyylikki! It's such a pleasure to meet you. Uh... I brought this fossil specimen from Natlan along...

introduced.name: Changchang
introduced.how: a young girl worried about feeding a stray puppy, who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Ah, how am I going to feed it...

introduced.name: puppy
introduced.how: a stray puppy Changchang met earlier, waiting at the city gate and possibly starving
introduced.quote: I'm wondering how to feed the puppy that I met earlier.

introduced.name: Granddad
introduced.how: Changchang's grandfather, who usually prepares the dog food and has kept her away from the city
introduced.quote: Granddad usually prepares the doggy food, but it's Fowl... I think.

introduced.name: city gate
introduced.how: the city gate where the puppy is waiting to be fed
introduced.quote: Could you help me go to the city gate and feed my puppy?

introduced.name: city unrest
introduced.how: the city was recently in a mess, but Granddad now says everything is fine
introduced.quote: Granddad said before that the city was in too much of a mess, and he wouldn't let me go feed it.

introduced.name: Fowl
introduced.how: a food item used as dog food for the puppy
introduced.quote: Could you help me get a portion of Fowl to feed our puppy with?

assumed.name: earlier meeting with the puppy
assumed.quote: I'm wondering how to feed the puppy that I met earlier.

threads.claim: The city was in too much of a mess to visit, though Granddad now says everything is fine there.
threads.quote: Although he says that everything's fine in the city now, he's been too busy to take me there...

threads.claim: The puppy may be starving because it has not been fed for a long time, and Changchang is worried it may not survive.
threads.quote: Granddad says that puppies can find food for themselves, but I'm worried.

threads.claim: The Traveler's feeding of Fowl means the puppy has now eaten its fill.
threads.quote: It should have eaten its fill.

introduced.name: Matahga
introduced.how: a self-described warrior who insists on special training and sets the challenge
introduced.quote: Matahga: But wait, you mean... You didn't fly all the way up here to get special warrior training from me, Matahga!?

introduced.name: Soaring Saurian
introduced.how: the balloon house where Matahga's special training takes place
introduced.quote: Eye-Catching Slogan: The Soaring Saurian is open all day! If you wish to join Matahga's special training, then come lift off from the Soaring Saurian! Note:

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: a mount that must be fed Fowl to keep it in a good mood
introduced.quote: Matahga! Remember!!!: Feeding a Saurian some Fowl is the best way to keep one in a good mood and avoid getting pecked!

introduced.name: Horns
introduced.how: two horns whose blast sequence is a code to be played
introduced.quote: Matahga! Remember!!!: The code is: Blow the left horn first, then the right one, then the left again, and finally the right... but blow 'em at your own peril!

introduced.name: Master Trainer
introduced.how: a rank that is hard to earn and that Matahga's father holds
introduced.quote: ???: Not just anyone can become a Master Trainer, you know. I'm not that gifted...

introduced.name: Special training challenge
introduced.how: a timed flight along a course, scored at checkpoints and sorted into four tiers
introduced.quote: Matahga: During training, I will observe and score performances at every checkpoint. The final results will be divided into four tiers based on these scores.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: the clan Matahga's father is a Master Trainer in
introduced.quote: Matahga: My father's the most professional Master Trainer in the whole of the Flower-Feather Clan, and my sister's the best Saurian rider! I'm proud of them!

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a nation described as full of heroes, with hot-blooded people
introduced.quote: Paimon: Should Paimon be saying that Natlan truly is a nation of heroes, or that its people are just overly hot-blooded? Even the kids are so fired up!

introduced.name: Qucusaurus
introduced.how: Matahga's companion Saurian with a warrior's temper
introduced.quote: Matahga: This is my Qucusaurus's food stash, so don't touch it — my companion's got quite the warrior's temper!

introduced.name: Acomitl
introduced.how: Matahga's older brother, a layabout with no ambition
introduced.quote: Matahga: Acomitl aside, of course. That layabout has zero ambition. I'm ashamed to call him my brother.

assumed.name: Saurian riding basics
assumed.quote: Matahga: Flying atop a Saurian mount shows that you've got the basics down, but such a lack of ambition... What a waste!

assumed.name: Special training as a known practice
assumed.quote: Traveler: So they have that here too, huh...

threads.claim: Matahga's brother Acomitl is disowned as a layabout, and the Traveler's question about him is left unanswered.
threads.quote: Traveler: Acomitl...?

threads.claim: Matahga has trained alone for a long time trying to beat his own record without success.
threads.quote: Matahga: I've been keeping up with my special training, all by myself, in the hope that I would one day succeed at breaking my own record.

threads.claim: Matahga hopes his father and sister will one day acknowledge his accomplishments.
threads.quote: Matahga: I'll surely be able to improve myself by sparring and exchanging pointers with them. Some day, my father and sister will acknowledge my accomplishments — just you wait!

threads.claim: Matahga insists that willpower and ambition overcome physical limits, a theme he repeats throughout.
threads.quote: Matahga: It's mind over matter, any day of the week... And that takes faith and belief in your own dreams and ambition!

threads.claim: Unseen residents of the balloon house are annoyed by Matahga and hint at his father's training.
threads.quote: ???: Didn't your daddy ever tell you about basic venue guidelines when he was training you?

threads.claim: Natlan is portrayed as a nation of heroes, though its people may simply be overly hot-blooded.
threads.quote: Paimon: Should Paimon be saying that Natlan truly is a nation of heroes, or that its people are just overly hot-blooded? Even the kids are so fired up!

introduced.name: Belsky
introduced.how: a kid who loves dog sledding and is out doing laps on a sled
introduced.quote: Alyosha: It's nothing. Belsky's just doing some sledding.

introduced.name: Bystrov
introduced.how: Belsky's dad, who is busy looking for work and often unavailable
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, his dad, Bystrov, is always busy looking for work, so I'm filling in for him.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: an adult filling in as supervisor for Belsky's sledding while his dad is away
introduced.quote: so I'm filling in for him.

introduced.name: Whistle
introduced.how: a strong sled dog that pulls Belsky's sled
introduced.quote: Whistle is a strong dog, and even took some training from Tugarin.

assumed.name: Tugarin
assumed.quote: and even took some training from Tugarin.

threads.claim: Children must eventually face danger on their own, and it is better for them to do so while someone watches over them.
threads.quote: Besides, every kid has to face danger on their own sooner or later.

threads.claim: Belsky's father is often away looking for work, leaving the boy's activities to others.
threads.quote: his dad, Bystrov, is always busy looking for work

introduced.name: Mingli
introduced.how: Wenhua's assistant who introduces himself and worries about the boss's losses
introduced.quote: Hello there. I'm Mingli, the boss's assistant.

introduced.name: Wenhua
introduced.how: an old merchant who buys Sumpter Beasts to transport cargo through the mountains
introduced.quote: Dear passersby, could you please help a poor old man?

introduced.name: Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: expensive pack animals merchants use for hauling cargo; few people know how to keep them
introduced.quote: Sumpter Beasts are quite expensive, and neither my boss nor I know much about keeping them.

introduced.name: Yunyun
introduced.how: Wenhua's stolen Sumpter Beast, called Yun, whose disappearance starts the quest
introduced.quote: My Yunyun, a Sumpter Beast by that name!

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a criminal group whose name suggests they steal treasures and who run a camp nearby
introduced.quote: As their name would suggest, they steal treasures, don't they?

introduced.name: Iron and Salt Gang
introduced.how: the name of the group the Treasure Hoarders at the camp belong to
introduced.quote: We're with the Iron and Salt Gang, so you'd better watch yourself around us!

introduced.name: Chili
introduced.how: Wenhua's other Sumpter Beast, the obedient one that stayed with him
introduced.quote: Chili has always been the most obedient, and it's been here all this time.

introduced.name: Jue
introduced.how: Wenhua's third Sumpter Beast, a mischievous one that ran away long ago
introduced.quote: Jue was very mischievous, and ran off long ago.

introduced.name: Jueyun Chilis
introduced.how: a food that is bad for Sumpter Beasts unless they are starving
introduced.quote: Unless they're practically starving, they won't eat Jueyun Chilis — that stuff's bad for their health.

introduced.name: Tusheng
introduced.how: a Treasure Hoarder who once worked for a Sumeru caravan and knows Sumpter Beast care
introduced.quote: As for why I know this and that about Sumpter Beasts, that's because I used to work for a caravan in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: A single document submitted by me to the Millelith captains, and you'll be eating your fill in a prison cell.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Nice! Mora on the road, who would've thought?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: So people from Liyue keep those too, do they?

assumed.name: Sunsettias
assumed.quote: we're fresh out of Berries, but we've still got some Sunsettias.

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: I didn't think that someone would just... steal my Sumpter Beast just as I entered Chenyu Vale!

threads.claim: Mingli suggests Wenhua may be getting old and forgetful, raising doubt about his reliability.
threads.quote: Do you guys think he's getting old and starting to forget things?

threads.claim: Mingli is left waiting at the finish line, and he wonders whether Wenhua's age is catching up with him.
threads.quote: Huh!? Did Boss forget that I'm waiting at the end!? Is his age finally catching up with him...

threads.claim: Wenhua insists he knows what Sumpter Beasts like to eat and has been feeding Yun Jueyun Chilis.
threads.quote: That's what I've been feeding Yun this whole time! Surely I know what it likes!

threads.claim: The text shows Jueyun Chilis are bad for Sumpter Beasts, so Wenhua's feeding method was mistaken.
threads.quote: Unless they're practically starving, they won't eat Jueyun Chilis — that stuff's bad for their health.

threads.claim: Jue ran away long ago, and the reason for its departure is left open.
threads.quote: Jue was very mischievous, and ran off long ago.

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests another Sumpter Beast left Tusheng, hinting at a pattern of runaways.
threads.quote: And didn't you have another Sumpter Beast up and leave on you...?

threads.claim: Wenhua accuses the Treasure Hoarders of stealing Yun, though the cause remains unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Well, then, I think they were the ones who stole Yun!

threads.claim: A Treasure Hoarder claims Yun came to them on its own, and the group had kept it for a planned transport job.
threads.quote: Pfft, a crook, he says... Your Sumpter Beast ran to us of its own accord...

threads.claim: Tusheng admits he likes caring for Sumpter Beasts, hinting he may leave the Treasure Hoarders.
threads.quote: To be honest, I quite like the idea of spending time with the Sumpter Beasts...

threads.claim: Tusheng says he will think over Wenhua's job offer, leaving his future undecided.
threads.quote: Let me give it some thought. I'll let you know once I've thought it through.

introduced.name: Chloris
introduced.how: a researcher who posted a commission for Cecilias
introduced.quote: Oh, you must have seen the commission I put up.

introduced.name: Cecilia
introduced.how: a item gathered in quantity for Chloris's research
introduced.quote: Heard you need some Cecilias...

assumed.name: Cecilia
assumed.quote: Heard you need some Cecilias...

threads.claim: Chloris has had little contact with others for a long time, hinting at a solitary past.
threads.quote: Wow! I haven't had any faunal contact in ages!

threads.claim: Chloris needs a set number of Cecilias for a research project whose purpose is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Just remember to give them to me as soon as you've gathered enough. I need them for my research.

introduced.name: Shizuru
introduced.how: Introduces herself as a special envoy of Sangonomiya sent to survey the Omikami's resting place
introduced.quote: I am Shizuru, a special envoy of Sangonomiya, and I am here to survey the state of our Great Omikami's final resting place.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya
introduced.how: Watatsumi-side power whose envoy Shizuru speaks for, recently at war with the Shogunate
introduced.quote: I am Shizuru, a special envoy of Sangonomiya, and I am here to survey the state of our Great Omikami's final resting place.

introduced.name: Yashiori Island
introduced.how: Island where Shogunate forces remain, infiltrated by the Fatui and plotting something
introduced.quote: According to our intel, there are some Shogunate forces remaining on Yashiori Island who were heavily infiltrated by the Fatui.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Secretive organization that wages war through internal division and sabotage, more dangerous than the Shogunate
introduced.quote: I would consider him the epitome of why the Fatui are frightening foes.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: Ruling military power that fought a war with Watatsumi and still holds forces in the region
introduced.quote: Thanks to your aid, we were able to turn what was a disadvantageous battle with the Shogunate around.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Island under long information blackout, whose people fought the Shogunate war
introduced.quote: Watatsumi Island has been under an information blackout for a long time, and you can say that this and the war at large was how we came into contact with them.

introduced.name: Jakotsu Mine
introduced.how: Mine surveyed by the Fatui and occupied by Shogunate samurai
introduced.quote: the contents of which are a survey of the Jakotsu Mine.

introduced.name: Nathan
introduced.how: Fatui agent who signed a secret report on a special operation and is later revealed as a manipulator of radical groups
introduced.quote: The whole report has been signed as being left by a Fatuus by the name of Nathan.

introduced.name: Borenka
introduced.how: Fatui naval warrant officer who acts as the contact and gives orders to the recruits
introduced.quote: I'm your contact, Naval Warrant Officer Borenka

introduced.name: sealed remains of a god
introduced.how: A sealed god's remains whose release could have dangerous effects, studied by the Fatui
introduced.quote: the possible effects should the sealed remains of a god be released, with an attached addendum

assumed.name: Divine Priestess
assumed.quote: Her Excellency the Divine Priestess specifically said that you must be sought out for this task.

assumed.name: Omikami
assumed.quote: Our Omikami's bones have now found rest as well...

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: We won back the peace, saw the Vision Hunt Decree abolished, and the Commissions that exploited us have been knocked off their perches.

assumed.name: Harbinger
assumed.quote: This, even though they lost one Harbinger in the conflict, and the other has gone missing...

assumed.name: Chasing Shadows
assumed.quote: (Traveler puts on the Fatui mask they received during Chasing Shadows)

assumed.name: Swordfish II
assumed.quote: Well, I suppose I am the Captain of Swordfish II...

assumed.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
assumed.quote: If Lord Hiiragi hadn't been dismissed on your account, we samurai wouldn't even be in this dump right now!

assumed.name: Kanjou Commission
assumed.quote: some dismissed, unsalaried, disgruntled elements of the Kanjou Commission would soon retrieve the items we wanted

assumed.name: Electro Wards
assumed.quote: there are notes regarding the Electro Wards left by the Raiden Shogun

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: I'm just in charge of shipping you two back to Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Teppei
assumed.quote: It's a shame that that kid Teppei did not have the fortune to see this new day come to pass... What a shame.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: That fellow claimed to be a Mondstadter... and that might even be true.

threads.claim: The remaining Fatui continue their surveys on Yashiori Island despite their losses.
threads.quote: And yet, the remaining Fatui have not given up their surveys on Yashiori Island.

threads.claim: The Fatui lost one Harbinger in the conflict and another Harbinger has gone missing.
threads.quote: This, even though they lost one Harbinger in the conflict, and the other has gone missing...

threads.claim: The Fatui use internal division and sabotage instead of conventional warfare to sow chaos.
threads.quote: They know that our greatest obstacles come from within...

threads.claim: The flame of vengeance among the people cannot be easily extinguished and is a source of danger.
threads.quote: As much as we'd like to suppress it, the flame of vengeance will not dissipate so simply.

threads.claim: Nathan claimed to be a Mondstadter, which may or may not be true.
threads.quote: That fellow claimed to be a Mondstadter... and that might even be true.

threads.claim: Nathan planned to escape after manipulating radical groups, but he was caught and punished.
threads.quote: And he got away, too — well, or so he'd planned, at least.

threads.claim: Fatui orders treat new recruits as living test samples with no other value.
threads.quote: They will, however, do just fine as living test samples.

threads.claim: The Fatui studied the possible effects of releasing a sealed god's remains.
threads.quote: the possible effects should the sealed remains of a god be released, with an attached addendum

threads.claim: The group behind the Yashiori operations was accused of destroying the Electro Wards.
threads.quote: the crime of destroying the Wards

threads.claim: The Omikami's bones have now been laid to rest at their final resting place.
threads.quote: Our Omikami's bones have now found rest as well...

threads.claim: Watatsumi songs describe war as a river of bitter tears, which is why the Divine Priestess dislikes war.
threads.quote: War is a river of bitter tears no ship can hope to ford, and its waves rage ever hither and tither in a swirl of utter discord.

threads.claim: Teppei died before the peace was won, and Shizuru mourns him.
threads.quote: It's a shame that that kid Teppei did not have the fortune to see this new day come to pass... What a shame.

introduced.name: Adelinde
introduced.how: Winery maid who organizes the cleanup and is in charge of the staff
introduced.quote: Ah, hello, Traveler. Welcome to the Dawn Winery.

introduced.name: Moco
introduced.how: one of the two assistant girls who keep apologizing and work slowly
introduced.quote: Moco: Sorry, Ms. Adelinde!

introduced.name: Hillie
introduced.how: one of the two assistant girls who find the Winery too big to clean
introduced.quote: Hillie: Ugh, the Winery is just too big. How are we supposed to clean the whole place?

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: the winery where the cleanup takes place, with outside and indoor areas
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Dawn Winery.

introduced.name: Storm
introduced.how: a recent storm that passed and left dust and mess across the Winery
