introduced.quote: The storm may have passed, but here at the Winery we're still cleaning up the mess it made.

assumed.name: Earlier failed cleanup
assumed.quote: Clean the place again, and I want it spotless this time!

threads.claim: A storm passed but left the Dawn Winery covered in mess that still needs cleaning.
threads.quote: The storm may have passed, but here at the Winery we're still cleaning up the mess it made.

threads.claim: Storm dust seeped through the tiny gaps around closed doors and windows and kept settling on the dishes and floors.
threads.quote: That storm brought tons of dust in, and even though we closed the doors and windows, they still flew in through the tiny gaps.

introduced.name: Susan
introduced.how: a Mondstadt woman whose husband is on a business trip in Inazuma, asking the Traveler to take her photos
introduced.quote: My name is Susan, and I'm from Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.how: Susan's home city, which she and her husband cannot easily return to
introduced.quote: My name is Susan, and I'm from Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera Susan asked a friend to buy in Fontaine
introduced.quote: I'd asked a friend of mine to help purchase this Kamera in Fontaine and all, too.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: But we had no idea that the situation in Inazuma would become like this.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: I'd asked a friend of mine to help purchase this Kamera in Fontaine and all, too.

threads.claim: Something has happened in Inazuma that has made travel home impossible for visitors from Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Since we can't go home anyway, I suggested that we travel around Inazuma.

introduced.name: Susan
introduced.how: a tourist who asks the Traveler for help taking photos of her
introduced.quote: Susan: Oh, are you the Traveler? Great! I was just looking for someone to help me out.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: a destination Susan and her husband recently reached and can now travel around
introduced.quote: we were finally able to travel to Sumeru!

introduced.name: Susan's husband
introduced.how: stayed behind in Sumeru, too busy clearing his work backlog to go out
introduced.quote: But he claimed that he was far too busy clearing his work backlog.

assumed.name: Sakoku Decree
assumed.quote: Susan: My husband and I were stuck in Inazuma for such a long time due to the Sakoku Decree.

threads.claim: The Sakoku Decree kept travelers confined to Inazuma for a long time, but it has now been lifted.
threads.quote: But those days are over — we were finally able to travel to Sumeru!

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: Boss who leads the work with the Guild and teaches Jahoda what to say
introduced.quote: Thank you again for all the help you've given the Guild, Boss Nefer, Miss Jahoda.

introduced.name: Sarin
introduced.how: Guild staff member who speaks for the Nod-Krai Adventurers' Guild as a reliable partner
introduced.quote: Oh, I should be clear about this. You can absolutely trust that we at the Nod-Krai Adventurers' Guild are your ever-reliable partners.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Nod-Krai branch of the Guild, which partners with Nefer and sends workers to help
introduced.quote: Oh, I should be clear about this. You can absolutely trust that we at the Nod-Krai Adventurers' Guild are your ever-reliable partners.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: Guild worker paid per job, nervous around Nefer and expected to do commissions
introduced.quote: I'm getting paid, so I have to do the job right, of course...

introduced.name: Commission board
introduced.how: Board where commissions are posted, which Jahoda is anxious about
introduced.quote: Fine, just don't look at the commission board, please don't look at the commission board, please don't look at the commission boar—

introduced.name: Commissions
introduced.how: Jobs the Guild hands out in batches for workers to pick and complete
introduced.quote: Mr. Sarin, would you please bring over the latest batch of commissions?

assumed.name: Guild investigation
assumed.quote: for being so willing to help the Guild with the... complicated investigative work.

assumed.name: Prior help to the Guild
assumed.quote: Thank you again for all the help you've given the Guild, Boss Nefer, Miss Jahoda.

threads.claim: Nefer's team is doing complicated investigative work for the Guild, hinting at an ongoing mystery.
threads.quote: for being so willing to help the Guild with the... complicated investigative work.

threads.claim: Nefer asks Jahoda to choose the commission that matters most, setting up a choice with consequences.
threads.quote: Jahoda, pick the commission you believe matters the most.

introduced.name: Ema
introduced.how: Librarian of Byakuyakoku who introduces herself, and is stuck on the civilization's last day
introduced.quote: Um, let me introduce myself. My name would be Ema in the Inazuman style. I'm the librarian here... At least until the day ends.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: Civilization whose final day is today, with residents moving above sea level tomorrow
introduced.quote: What's important is that this is Byakuyakoku's final day!

introduced.name: Before Sun and Moon
introduced.how: A restricted chronicle of fables that was stolen rather than borrowed
introduced.quote: It is a chronicle of fables, and is a restricted text.

introduced.name: Hanging prison beneath Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: Prison where the suspects in the book theft are being held
introduced.quote: the suspects have been locked up in the hanging prison beneath Dainichi Mikoshi.

introduced.name: Antei
introduced.how: Short-tempered suspect held in the hanging prison over the stolen book
introduced.quote: Among the suspects is a guy called Antei. He's got a real temper, and isn't the type to give anything up unless you really threaten him.

introduced.name: Jibashiri
introduced.how: Group that threatened the suspects with abandonment in the prison to get the book's location
introduced.quote: The Jibashiri threatened them, saying that if they didn't give its location up, they would be abandoned in the hanging prison.

introduced.name: Date
introduced.how: Young master of a distinguished Byakuyakoku clan who borrowed a book and wanted to build anti-Bathysmal Vishap defenses
introduced.quote: His Narukami-style name is Date, son of Eurydates.

introduced.name: Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: Book borrowed by Date, supposedly for defense works but possibly for building a maze
introduced.quote: This book was borrowed by the young master of a distinguished clan from Byakuyakoku.

introduced.name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
introduced.how: Book whose content is the story of Watatsumi Omikami's victory over the Bathysmal Vishap, borrowed by a Narukami Island envoy
introduced.quote: You tell Ema about Watatsumi Omikami's victory over the Bathysmal Vishap...

introduced.name: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
introduced.how: Book of guessing games, aimed at young children, borrowed by an ordinary citizen
introduced.quote: This one's just a book of guessing games.

introduced.name: Michiya's experimental records
introduced.how: Research records that were meant to be returned for storage but are held by researchers who refuse to hand them over
introduced.quote: I'm not so sure about this book, actually. This one is not technically a borrowed book, either.

introduced.name: Research site
introduced.how: Unknown location where Michiya's experiments were conducted
introduced.quote: No one knows where this research site place is supposed to be either. It's all very mysterious.

introduced.name: Library map hidden section
introduced.how: The library map has a second, unexplained section drawn on it
introduced.quote: Come to think of it, I discovered that the library map has another section drawn on it, which is also very mysterious indeed.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Place where Ema plans to open a raw fish restaurant after the move
introduced.quote: After tomorrow, come look for me on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Sashimi
introduced.how: Raw fish dish from Narukami Island cuisine that Ema claims to be the first in Byakuyakoku to know about
introduced.quote: But I'm the only one who has read a lot of books about Narukami Island cuisine.

assumed.name: Tokoyo Ookami
assumed.quote: Why, if Tokoyo Ookami in Enkanomiya had eyes to see, it would surely leave a Shade of Tokoyo for me behind right now!

assumed.name: Watatsumi Omikami
assumed.quote: Ah, Divine Priestess, Lord Watatsumi Omikami, I've betrayed your trust, haven't I?

assumed.name: Deep Sea Spiritherb
assumed.quote: When we get to the surface, I'll consign myself to guarding the Deep Sea Spiritherb.

assumed.name: Enkanomiya
assumed.quote: The angriest, most anxious person in Enkanomiya — that's me, Ema!

assumed.name: Bathysmal Vishap
assumed.quote: He said that he wanted to build a new generation of anti-Bathysmal Vishap defense works... but I bet he just wanted to have fun building some maze.

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Those three have close links with Khaenri'ah, and have as such been deemed suspects.

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: According to the loan records, this was borrowed by an envoy from Narukami Island.

threads.claim: Byakuyakoku's residents are moving above sea level tomorrow, so today is their final day.
threads.quote: That's right. We're all moving to live above sea level tomorrow.

threads.claim: Ema's afterimage has been stuck reliving the civilization's last day for thousands of years.
threads.quote: she's been reliving her last day for... a few thousand years now.

threads.claim: A restricted book of fables was stolen, and its theft raises the question of why it is banned.
threads.quote: In fact, I believe that Watatsumi Omikami himself ordered that it be banned.

threads.claim: The Jibashiri's threat to abandon the suspects is only a bluff, and the suspects will likely be released.
threads.quote: Of course, that was only intended to scare them. When it comes time to move tomorrow, they will probably be released.

threads.claim: The book thief suspects have close ties to Khaenri'ah, hinting at a link between that land and the theft.
threads.quote: Those three have close links with Khaenri'ah, and have as such been deemed suspects.

threads.claim: The library map contains an unexplained hidden section that no one has accounted for.
threads.quote: Come to think of it, I discovered that the library map has another section drawn on it, which is also very mysterious indeed.

threads.claim: Michiya's research site is unknown and its records are being withheld by the researchers.
threads.quote: No one knows where this research site place is supposed to be either. It's all very mysterious.

threads.claim: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku tells the story of Watatsumi Omikami's victory over the Bathysmal Vishap, which Ema accepts on the Traveler's word.
threads.quote: That... is the story of this book, yes. Well, if you say so, I'll believe you.

introduced.name: Marjorie
introduced.how: shopkeeper of a souvenir shop in Mondstadt who trades goods for Anemo sigils
introduced.quote: Every treasure here is unique, guaranteed.

introduced.name: Anemo Archon
introduced.how: gives seals or emblems to adventurers as acknowledgment of their adventures
introduced.quote: It's like a seal or emblem that the Anemo Archon gives to adventurers as a form of acknowledgment.

introduced.name: Anemo sigils
introduced.how: seals or emblems given to adventurers that can be traded in at the shop for items
introduced.quote: More to the point, any you find you can trade in here for items in the shop.

introduced.name: Goods-for-goods trading
introduced.how: the shop operates by bartering goods, with no Mora accepted
introduced.quote: I operate on a trading basis. Goods for goods — no Mora accepted here.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Goods for goods — no Mora accepted here.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: appear all over Mondstadt. If you find yourself short, just keep exploring.

threads.claim: The Anemo sigils are needed for a special project, and their real purpose is more complicated than mere decoration.
threads.quote: It's actually more complicated than that, but it's easier for people to understand if I just say it's for decoration.

threads.claim: The sigils have properties that other materials cannot provide, which is why Marjorie needs them.
threads.quote: Obviously the reason I need is because they have properties that other materials cannot provide.

threads.claim: Marjorie is secretly making something special that she will not reveal until it is finished.
threads.quote: I've been trying to make something a bit special recently, and I need a lot of to decorate it with.

threads.claim: The Anemo Archon's approval is tied to the adventurers' deeds and gifts that carry the Archon's favor.
threads.quote: Haha, it seems the Anemo Archon approves of your adventures then.

introduced.name: Luonnotar
introduced.how: a familiar created from a painting, now reborn with her own will
introduced.quote: We used moonlight to trace this child's form, and I poured new power and new blessings therein, causing her to be reborn.

introduced.name: painting on water
introduced.how: the water's surface serves as the canvas, moonlight as brushes, and the player's path as brushstrokes
introduced.quote: The water's surface is our canvas, the moonlight our brushes, and the paths we take shall serve as the brushstrokes.

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Paimon's positive she heard Columbina's voice...

assumed.name: Kuuhenki
assumed.quote: I guess the kuuhenki must've swiped it when we were playing earlier.

assumed.name: earlier play of the game
assumed.quote: I thought that since you were already so familiar with this game, I should increase the difficulty this round...

assumed.name: Luonnotar's earlier life with the Traveler and Paimon
assumed.quote: Paimon thought she'd never see you again!

assumed.name: earlier visit to this place
assumed.quote: Paimon wasn't there last time, so she didn't get to see it.

threads.claim: Columbina no longer needs to hide and can now go wherever she wishes.
threads.quote: You no longer need to hide from anyone, right?

threads.claim: Columbina does not usually rely on her eyes, hinting at a sensory difference.
threads.quote: I don't usually need to use my eyes, so the mask makes little difference.

threads.claim: Luonnotar was reborn from a moonlit painting and now has a will of her own.
threads.quote: We used moonlight to trace this child's form, and I poured new power and new blessings therein, causing her to be reborn.

threads.claim: Luonnotar was once bound to Columbina's spirit, but that bond has ended.
threads.quote: She no longer needs to bear my spirit. Her will is hers alone.

introduced.name: Connor
introduced.how: a wine brewer who posts commissions asking for ingredients
introduced.quote: You... Ah. Saw my commission, did you?

introduced.name: Wheat
introduced.how: an ingredient Connor wants gathered in ten spikes
introduced.quote: So, gathered those ten spikes of Wheat yet?

introduced.name: Flaming Flower Stamen
introduced.how: an ingredient Connor needs three of for brewing
introduced.quote: So, have you gathered the three Flaming Flower Stamens that I need?

introduced.name: Mist Flower Corolla
introduced.how: an ingredient Connor needs three of for brewing
introduced.quote: So, do you have those three Mist Flower Corollas handy?

introduced.name: Dandelion Seed
introduced.how: an ingredient Connor needs in sets of three
introduced.quote: Have you gathered three sets of Dandelion Seeds?

introduced.name: wine brewing
introduced.how: Connor brews wine using the gathered ingredients
introduced.quote: I have wine to brew.

assumed.name: commission board
assumed.quote: Ah, you must have seen that commission of mine.

threads.claim: Connor doubts the gathered ingredients can produce anything especially special, though he expects a memorable brewing experience.
threads.quote: While I'm not certain if we can brew anything sufficiently special with these ingredients...

introduced.name: Citadel of Regzar
introduced.how: the meeting place where the Corps of Thirty contact and coordinate with each other
introduced.quote: Greetings, welcome to the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.name: Effendi
introduced.how: a liaison sent by the Akademiya who briefs the Traveler on the recruitment
introduced.quote: I am Effendi, a liaison sent by the Akademiya to coordinate the cooperation between the Akademiya and the Corps of Thirty.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: the organization that hires the Corps of Thirty and sends liaisons to coordinate with it
introduced.quote: I am Effendi, a liaison sent by the Akademiya to coordinate the cooperation between the Akademiya and the Corps of Thirty.

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: a group hired by the Akademiya to guard Sumeru City and handle residents' problems
introduced.quote: You may have known that the Corps of Thirty is hired by the Akademiya to guard the whole Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Sumeru City
introduced.how: a city guarded by the Corps of Thirty under the Akademiya's hire
introduced.quote: You may have known that the Corps of Thirty is hired by the Akademiya to guard the whole Sumeru City.

introduced.name: Commissions
introduced.how: residents' everyday requests that the Corps of Thirty handles and the Traveler would help complete
introduced.quote: You don't need to worry about city defense, just help us complete the residents' commissions.

introduced.name: Reputation
introduced.how: a standing among residents that rises with completed commissions and makes them more willing to accept you
introduced.quote: If you stick to it, you'll surely heighten your Reputation among the residents, and they'll be more willing to accept you.

assumed.name: Parchamdar
assumed.quote: To ease the pressure, I decided to recruit an assistant after consulting with the Parchamdar.

assumed.name: Logistics officer
assumed.quote: The logistics officer and I have agreed that you will be paid fairly for every gig you do.

threads.claim: The Akademiya hires and coordinates the Corps of Thirty through a liaison, hinting at a working relationship with unclear limits.
threads.quote: I am Effendi, a liaison sent by the Akademiya to coordinate the cooperation between the Akademiya and the Corps of Thirty.

threads.claim: Earning the respect and trust of residents through small commissions is presented as important work.
threads.quote: Trivial as these commissions may be, I do hope you recognize the importance of this job.

threads.claim: Effendi promises more important and complicated jobs to the Traveler later, suggesting a path of advancement within the Corps' work.
threads.quote: And I'll offer you more important and complicated jobs by then.

introduced.name: Helbet
introduced.how: introduces herself as a member of the Akademiya
introduced.quote: Helbet: No, Mr. Kayvan. I am Helbet with the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: an organization that found the antiques and keeps them in its care
introduced.quote: Helbet: The Akademiya found those antiques and I'm responsible for keeping them.

introduced.name: Lost relics in the river
introduced.how: antiques fell off a relic-transport ship and drifted down the river
introduced.quote: Helbet: But there was an accident on the ship transporting the relics. Some dropped off the ship, floating down the river to the lower reaches.

introduced.name: Fishing bait from gathered materials
introduced.how: bait for fishing is made from plant materials gathered from set spots
introduced.quote: Kayvan: Let me think... I'll be using Mint this time. But it needs to be collected from my usual spot.

introduced.name: Fishing researcher
introduced.how: an unnamed researcher who has designed popular fishing rods and baits
introduced.quote: Helbet: He's worked on the design of many popular fishing rods and baits.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Kayvan, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Helbet, optional)

assumed.name: Fresh Zaytun Peach
assumed.quote: (Collect Fresh Zaytun Peach ×3)

assumed.name: Whopperflower
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! Where did this Whopperflower come from!?

assumed.name: Earlier bait-gathering errands for Kayvan
assumed.quote: Kayvan: Same as before, Traveler. Please help me find some materials for the baits.

threads.claim: Antiques from the Akademiya were lost in the river after a transport ship accident.
threads.quote: Helbet: But there was an accident on the ship transporting the relics. Some dropped off the ship, floating down the river to the lower reaches.

threads.claim: More relics keep being recovered from the river, with more packs still lost.
threads.quote: Helbet: Ah, this is another pack of the relics! Great!

threads.claim: Kayvan has never caught a fish despite his reputation, and the cause is unknown.
threads.quote: Kayvan: This is so weird. Is there something wrong with my bait, or the way I fish...?

threads.claim: Kayvan keeps hooking relics but not a single fish, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Kayvan: But none's ever come to me!

threads.claim: Monsters keep taking the bait materials Kayvan asks for.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, there are monsters? Could it be that the Mint is taken by them again? Weird...

threads.claim: Monsters keep snatching the materials Kayvan chooses, and the reason remains unclear.
threads.quote: Paimon: Why do the materials he chooses keep getting snatched by monsters...?

threads.claim: A fishing researcher may be able to explain why Kayvan cannot catch fish.
threads.quote: Helbet: Well, Mr. Kayvan, if you are interested, I can introduce you to a researcher who specialized in fishing.

introduced.name: Arashakun
introduced.how: a timid Aranara who introduces himself and has been trapped in the cave
introduced.quote: Arashakun is indeed my name... Eek, don't come so close so quickly!

introduced.name: Furry Mask Demon King
introduced.how: a cunning furry demon king in a mask, described by Arashakun as the one who took his friend and stole his courage
introduced.quote: Furry Mask Demon King is a furry demon king wearing a mask.

introduced.name: Talisman of Courage
introduced.how: a flower charm made by Arashakun's Nara friend that gives Aranara courage
introduced.quote: After that, Nara friend used flowers to make a "Talisman of Courage" and told Arashakun, "Arashakun is a good Aranara with courage, not a timid Aranara!"

introduced.name: Inconsistently-Written Notes
introduced.how: Arashakun's journal, found at the house, recording his friendship and the loss of his courage
introduced.quote: (The first few pages contain very small and scribbled writing...)

introduced.name: Arashakun's courage theft
introduced.how: Arashakun's courage was stolen by the Furry Mask Demon King, leaving him weak and timid
introduced.quote: It must have been stolen by the Furry Mask Demon King.

introduced.name: Furry Mask Demon King's cave
introduced.how: a cave to the east where the Furry Mask Demon King is said to be, and where Arashakun was trapped by slimes
introduced.quote: Let's check out that cave in the east.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Wait, why are there so many hilichurls surrounding that house!?

assumed.name: Nara Varuna
assumed.quote: That Nara friend was no mighty Nara Varuna, but was still a very good Nara!

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: It must belong to Aranara.

assumed.name: Dendro energy
assumed.quote: Paimon can sense quite a lot of Dendro energy on it, and it's been discarded here, too...

threads.claim: Courage can apparently go missing, and Paimon wonders whether that is really possible.
threads.quote: Can "courage" really go missing? Paimon's curious...

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests courage cannot be stolen and is rooted in the heart rather than in an object.
threads.quote: Actually, courage can never be stolen...

threads.claim: The lost Talisman of Courage is recovered and returned, restoring Arashakun's courage.
threads.quote: Yes, this is it, this is it!

threads.claim: The flower talisman stays fresh despite being picked long ago, hinting at unusual Dendro energy.
threads.quote: Weird, but these flowers are ordinary and were picked quite some time ago, yet they still haven't wilted.

threads.claim: The talisman has faded slightly after being away from Arashakun for a few days.
threads.quote: The flower has faded a bit after being apart from Arashakun for a few days.

threads.claim: The identity of the Furry Mask Demon King is left a mystery to Paimon.
threads.quote: Paimon has no clue what this Furry Mask Demon King could be...

threads.claim: The Furry Mask Demon King is revealed to be a hilichurl.
threads.quote: But as it turns out, the Furry Mask Demon King really was a hilichurl all along.

threads.claim: Arashakun's Nara friend was captured by the Furry Mask Demon King, an event that drove Arashakun's courage story.
threads.quote: But one day, that Nara was taken by the Furry Mask Demon King...

threads.claim: Arashakun rescued his captured Nara friend by fighting the Furry Mask Demon King.
threads.quote: Then saved Nara friend.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Seems like these hilichurls are... initiating their newest members!?

threads.claim: Hilichurls hold an initiation for their newest members, hinting at an organized group with its own rites.
threads.quote: Seems like these hilichurls are... initiating their newest members!?

introduced.name: Date
introduced.how: self-introduces as a labyrinth artisan, son of Eurydates, who designed the labyrinth
introduced.quote: The name's Date. They used to call me Daedalus, son of Eurydates.

introduced.name: Eurydates
introduced.how: Date's father, who disciplines Date with crutches and is the author of the tablet's family story
introduced.quote: My father, Eurydates, gave me a few strokes on the backside with his crutches.

introduced.name: Evernight
introduced.how: a time when the labyrinth's hidden mechanisms and paths become visible under moonlight
introduced.quote: Only within Evernight will the mechanisms to the labyrinth walls and the way forward appear, bathed in invisible moonlight as they are.

introduced.name: Aberaku
introduced.how: Date's idol, named as the greatest architect in history, who built the Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.quote: Why, Aberaku no Mikoto, of course, bless his heart!

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: the homeland whose history of architecture Date claims to rank in
introduced.quote: I'm the second-best architect in the history of Byakuyakoku!

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: a surface location where many of Date's people have moved, away from the underground labyrinth area
introduced.quote: A significant portion of us have already gone to live on Watatsumi Island up there on the surface, so there's plenty of real estate around here.

introduced.name: Heterodoxa-style labyrinth
introduced.how: a second labyrinth style, distinct from wall-only labyrinths like the Neopathos style
introduced.quote: Any interest in trying my other "Heterodoxa"-style labyrinth?

introduced.name: Medal of Recognition
introduced.how: a medal Date made, awarded for clearing a labyrinth and needed to open the treasury
introduced.quote: If you are successful, you can even obtain a medal of recognition that I made myself.

introduced.name: treasury
introduced.how: a vault behind a gate that opens when two medals are collected
introduced.quote: If you obtain two medals, you can open the treasury!

assumed.name: Enkanomiya
assumed.quote: What are you, Enkanomiya's celebrity chef?

assumed.name: Ema
assumed.quote: sorry, Ema, but I... might have left the book in the labyrinth's treasure vault...

assumed.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
assumed.quote: If the Dainichi Mikoshi were to be second place, no other building could take first place.

threads.claim: The labyrinth's hidden mechanisms only appear during Evernight, leaving its nature and cause open.
threads.quote: Only within Evernight will the mechanisms to the labyrinth walls and the way forward appear, bathed in invisible moonlight as they are.

threads.claim: Date's father disapproves of Date's writing and rhetoric, creating an unresolved family conflict.
threads.quote: Now that I've added a lock on this labyrinth, that old man can't bother me about my writing anymore.

threads.claim: Date aspires to serve the people as Aberaku did, hinting at Aberaku's significance beyond architecture.
threads.quote: Honestly, these labyrinths are just a means, not the end. What I really wish to do is serve the people, like Aberaku did.

threads.claim: Many of Date's people have moved from the underground to the surface at Watatsumi Island, raising questions about why.
threads.quote: A significant portion of us have already gone to live on Watatsumi Island up there on the surface, so there's plenty of real estate around here.

introduced.name: Grundeland
introduced.how: a former villain who tried to exploit the Daydream Club's research and now seeks redemption
introduced.quote: Garcia: ...Grundeland. Just what are you up to this time? Find another opportunity to exploit? Or are you trying to take credit for our research again?

introduced.name: Daydream Club
introduced.how: a research club that adds a fantastical element to its research work
introduced.quote: Mécantre: We're members of the Daydream Club — adding a dash of the fantastical to our research work is what we do.

introduced.name: daydream
introduced.how: a spark of inspiration that comes unbidden and that researchers need to create
introduced.quote: Babisse: The "daydream" is the spark that every researcher is always pursuing but knows not how to grasp.

introduced.name: Petrichor
introduced.how: Garcia's island hometown, where the Club is based
introduced.quote: Garcia: Ah... Petrichor! My homeland, how lovely, how familiar, how...

introduced.name: Remuria
introduced.how: a real, sunken underwater city that people thought was only legend
introduced.quote: Traveler: It's a real place. I've been there.

introduced.name: Remurian Academy of Sciences
introduced.how: a Remurian research institution that directed all research projects
introduced.quote: Grundeland: You... You were the director of the Remurian Academy of Sciences, in charge of all research projects.

introduced.name: Numbering Machine
introduced.how: Garcia's research device that Grundeland tried to steal
introduced.quote: Garcia: That's right! That's him. He hired people to tail us, and even sent them to search my room, trying to take the Numbering Machine for himself.

introduced.name: phonographs
introduced.how: recording devices Mécantre and Babisse placed in town that captured Grundeland's schemes
introduced.quote: Garcia: Don't try anything funny, Grundeland. Mécantre and Babisse have already placed phonographs in town.

introduced.name: Grispan
introduced.how: a Club member who bought divesuits to study underwater hypnotism and has since vanished
introduced.quote: Mécantre: These divesuits are there thanks to dear Mr. Grispan. He bought them to study underwater hypnotism.

introduced.name: Phobos
introduced.how: an influence that controls people through a shared dream, turning them into obedient statues
introduced.quote: Traveler: So this is how Phobos controlled people...

introduced.name: Grand Symphony
introduced.how: a symphony-like order that governed Remuria by directing its people's minds
introduced.quote: Traveler: The Grand Symphony that governed Remuria...

introduced.name: stone statue dream
introduced.how: a collective dream in which people were turned into stone statues while still aware
introduced.quote: Babisse: In said dream, we had turned into stone statues, yet we weren't fully so. We could still think, see, and hear.

assumed.name: Este (Human)
assumed.quote: Traveler: Just like Este.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Lutong: In that case, we can only put our faith in Mr. Bossuet, and hope that the Fontaine Research Institute can see the Club members through.

assumed.name: Officer Menthe
assumed.quote: Kaia: Calm down, Garcia. Didn't Officer Menthe say that things in Petrichor have returned to normal?

assumed.name: Babisse
assumed.quote: Garcia: Yes, yes, I know Babisse is very clever, and that Mécantre always has a strategy handy, but neither of them is good at dealing with malicious intent!

assumed.name: Archons
assumed.quote: Babisse: You're... Remuria... No, no, no! Archons, my mind's just filled with this stuff, isn't it...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Babisse: Investment, stock ownership, promotion... Mora, Mora, Mora rolling everywhere, all while our minds filled up like giant waterbags...

assumed.name: Vishap King
assumed.quote: Traveler: If you wander about, you'll end up in the Vishap King's belly.

assumed.name: Gardes
assumed.quote: Traveler: Before the Gardes come to recover you, at any rate.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Lutong: Milady, if you had turned into a statue's shadow, I fear Mr. Garcia and I would have no choice but to interview every stone in Fontaine.

threads.claim: Phobos is hinted to be behind the strange, dream-like affliction afflicting the townsfolk.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Aye, it's the influence of Phobos.)

threads.claim: The Traveler confirms that the people in the dream were affected by Phobos.
threads.quote: Traveler: As we thought, they were affected by Phobos.

threads.claim: Phobos is shown to control people by overriding their minds, making them mere followers of its conductor's baton.
threads.quote: Traveler: So this is how Phobos controlled people...

threads.claim: Remuria is raised as a mysterious name that the townsfolk mistake for a city of legend.
threads.quote: Babisse: You're... Remuria... No, no, no! Archons, my mind's just filled with this stuff, isn't it...

threads.claim: The Traveler confirms that Remuria is a real, underwater place they have visited.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's a real place. I've been there.

threads.claim: A hidden conductor controlling people's lives is hinted at through the image of a conductor's baton.
threads.quote: Grundeland: He was following someone as a musician does a conductor's baton, but he never once noticed it.

threads.claim: The Grand Symphony is identified as the order by which Remuria was governed.
threads.quote: Traveler: I see... So that's what they mean by a symphony that governs all.

threads.claim: Daydreams are described as the spark of inspiration that researchers need but cannot force.
threads.quote: Babisse: The "daydream" is the spark that every researcher is always pursuing but knows not how to grasp.

threads.claim: The Traveler acknowledges that daydreams are a formidable power.
threads.quote: Traveler: "Daydreams" truly are a formidable power.

threads.claim: Grispan has vanished with Grobel, and it is unclear whether he was behind the affliction.
threads.quote: Garcia: But wait, where has he gone!? And he's taken Grobel with him, too...

threads.claim: The repeated phrase "true happiness" hints that the statues were conditioned to feel contentment in servitude.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh. Hang on a moment. Why are you all repeating the phrase "true happiness"?

threads.claim: The statue people are described as having had no freedom, only following an invisible conductor.
threads.quote: Babisse: This good person was just like all the others in their statues. They had no freedom. They just followed the invisible conductor's baton around.

threads.claim: Grundeland recognizes his past schemes and claims he wants to change, though his sincerity remains uncertain.
threads.quote: Grundeland: I'm just like that person. I wanted to pull the strings. Let others do my bidding. No... No, no, no...

introduced.name: Xamaran
introduced.how: a talking mushroom who calls the Traveler and Paimon 'two-legged' and is nicknamed Sheeshroom by Paimon
introduced.quote: Yes, two-legged hatchling who makes no use of her feet, Xamaran calls.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: a hot, golden-sand and rainforest region that is Xamaran's hometown
introduced.quote: Hot sand and the rainforest? Do you mean Sumeru? We did just talk to a Sumeru scholar at the camp...

introduced.name: foul energy
introduced.how: a growing evil energy that drains Xamaran's strength and spreads black mud
introduced.quote: Yet foul energy is growing lately.

introduced.name: Blessings of Wisdom
introduced.how: an item to be used on the source of the foul energy so Xamaran's kin will deal with the rest
introduced.quote: Please take this — the Blessings of Wisdom.

introduced.name: Xamaran's kin
introduced.how: other ill mushrooms that Xamaran's shelter once protected and that the Traveler helps heal
introduced.quote: Xamaran is cleared of the foul energy, yet its kin still suffer.

assumed.name: Adjuvant
assumed.quote: Oh right, , we can lend the energy of the Adjuvant to Sheeshroom, perhaps?

assumed.name: Sumeru scholar at the camp
assumed.quote: We did just talk to a Sumeru scholar at the camp...

assumed.name: Chicken-Mushroom Skewers
assumed.quote: For Chicken-Mushroom Skewers, surely.

threads.claim: Xamaran finds the Traveler strangely familiar, and the Traveler may have met it before but cannot remember.
threads.quote: Maybe I do, but I don't remember.

threads.claim: Xamaran has been away from its Sumeru hometown for a long time, and its origin is hinted at.
threads.quote: Although Xamaran has been away from its hometown for long, Xamaran makes no mistakes.

threads.claim: A growing foul energy threatens Xamaran and its kin, and its cause is not yet known.
threads.quote: Yet foul energy is growing lately.

threads.claim: The source of the foul energy is hidden and must be tracked down by following the water.
threads.quote: Xamaran can smell the lingering scent of foul energy in the air but cannot tell where its source lies.

threads.claim: Using the Blessings of Wisdom on the source blocks the fissures and ends the foul energy threat.
threads.quote: But looks like the fissures have been blocked off.

threads.claim: Xamaran says fate brought the Traveler and Paimon to it, hinting that their meeting was destined.
threads.quote: the Two-Legged, fate has brought you here. Xamaran has a favor to ask.

threads.claim: Xamaran ranks beings by how many legs they have, placing the legless above all others.
threads.quote: The many-legged are inferior to the four-legged, and the four-legged are inferior to the two-legged, so naturally, the two-legged are inferior to the legless.

threads.claim: Xamaran is too weakened to shelter its weak kin as it once did, so help is needed.
threads.quote: Xamaran lacks the strength now to shelter the weak like it once did.

threads.claim: Xamaran's view is that only the wise answer a call for help, and it judges Paimon and the Traveler to be wise.
threads.quote: Only the wise would answer. Paimon proved to be one with wisdom, and did, too.

threads.claim: Xamaran suggests that ignorance may be a blessing while knowledge may bring calamity, an idea left open.
threads.quote: ...Ignorance might be a blessing, and knowledge might bring forth calamity...

introduced.name: Komaki
introduced.how: elderly shrine keeper of Bourou Village who offers fortune-telling and asks for help nourishing the Spiritherbs
introduced.quote: Hello there, youngster. From how you dress, you must be from outside the island, yes?

introduced.name: Bourou Village
introduced.how: village whose shrine to Watatsumi is said to be highly efficacious for divination
introduced.quote: the shrine to Watatsumi here in Bourou Village is most efficacious

introduced.name: Deep Sea Spiritherb
introduced.how: plant that once grew at the ocean bottom, glows gently, needs frequent water, and powers the village divination
introduced.quote: this plant once grew at the bottom of the ocean

introduced.name: Offering Pool
introduced.how: pool at the island shrine whose water is required to raise Spiritherbs
introduced.quote: water from the Offering Pool on this island's shrine is required to raise Spiritherbs.

introduced.name: Wishes in water
introduced.how: wishes accumulate in the Offering Pool water and dissipate quickly once the water is drawn out
introduced.quote: will accumulate within that pool and dissolve into the water, just like honey.

introduced.name: Omikami
introduced.how: revered spirit whose martyrdom is a great sorrow to the village and whose spirit the shrines must not disturb
introduced.quote: the great sorrow of our Omikami's martyrdom

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: island whose traditions the village follows and where the highest point and an ancient place of the gods lie
introduced.quote: treat the traditions of Watatsumi Island with respect

introduced.name: Village ancestors from the deep sea
introduced.how: the village's progenitors moved Spiritherbs from the deep sea onto land thousands of years ago
introduced.quote: Thousands of years ago, the progenitors of our village transplanted those herbs from the deep sea onto land

introduced.name: Hydro cavern to the north
introduced.how: cavern north of the village whose water has the right Hydro concentration for Spiritherbs, and is tied to ancestral secrets
introduced.quote: There is a cavern to the north where the Hydro composition of the water is closest to the natural environment of this plant.

introduced.name: Tsuyuko
introduced.how: shrine maiden at the Sangonomiya Shrine who is capable but looks down on old folks
introduced.quote: there's that shrine maiden by the Sangonomiya Shrine who really looks down old folks.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Shrine
introduced.how: shrine where Tsuyuko serves as a shrine maiden
introduced.quote: there's that shrine maiden by the Sangonomiya Shrine who really looks down old folks.

introduced.name: Recent war
introduced.how: a recent war has left the island with little peace and has kept young people from drawing water at the cavern
introduced.quote: Unfortunately, with the recent war, few young people have gone there to draw water and nourish the Spiritherbs.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Uh, is this about Mora after all?

assumed.name: Tsuyuko
assumed.quote: Ah, you've met her, then?

assumed.name: The Moon-Bathed Deep
assumed.quote: (If you finished The Moon-Bathed Deep Quest Series first)

assumed.name: Hydro
assumed.quote: Hydro composition of the water

assumed.name: Slimes
assumed.quote: Whoa, so many Slimes!

assumed.name: Electro Seelie
assumed.quote: (Guide the four Electro Seelie mentioned in the notes above)

threads.claim: Wishes accumulate in the Offering Pool water and can be sensed by their sweetness, viscosity, and weight, but they dissipate once drawn.
threads.quote: will accumulate within that pool and dissolve into the water, just like honey.

threads.claim: The Spiritherbs' radiance is read as a sign that wishes are strong and the coming year will be good.
threads.quote: The year to come will surely be a peaceful and abundant one.

threads.claim: The Traveler suspects the wish-based divination is a superstition but admits it has some merit.
threads.quote: But it isn't entirely without merit...

threads.claim: Omikami was martyred, and the village still carries the grief of that loss.
threads.quote: the great sorrow of our Omikami's martyrdom

threads.claim: The village's ancestors came from the bottom of the deep sea and brought Spiritherbs to land.
threads.quote: which is where our ancestors came from.

threads.claim: The northern cavern is bound to a secret of the village's ancestors that few remember.
threads.quote: That cavern is tightly bound to the secret of our ancestors.

threads.claim: Tsuyuko and the younger shrine maidens dismiss ancient traditions, and Komaki hints they will eventually learn their meaning.
threads.quote: young people will someday learn to respect the meaning behind traditional stories.

threads.claim: Komaki's divination points the Traveler to a fortune at the highest point of Watatsumi Island, an ancient place dedicated to the gods.
threads.quote: You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods.

threads.claim: The Traveler reaches the high place Komaki pointed to, the Mouun Shrine, and finds a chest with something nice.
threads.quote: Ooh, there was something nice here after all!

threads.claim: The recent war has kept young people away from the cavern, and Komaki worries for their safety.
threads.quote: Komaki: *sigh* Speaking of our young people, I can only hope that they will return safely...

introduced.name: Dr. Livingstone
introduced.how: the recipient of Dr. Edith's delivery, a doctor waiting for a package
introduced.quote: (Deliver the item to Dr. Livingstone)

assumed.name: Dr. Edith
assumed.quote: Dr. Edith: Traveler! Fancy meeting you here. I'm sure you are very busy, as always.

introduced.name: Livingstone's delivery item
introduced.how: an item Dr. Livingstone asks the Traveler to carry to Dr. Edith, the quest's delivery goal
introduced.quote: Could you give this to for me?

assumed.name: Dr. Livingstone
assumed.quote: Fancy meeting you here. I'm sure you are very busy, as always.

assumed.name: Dr. Edith
assumed.quote: Traveler! How can I help?

introduced.name: Nameless
introduced.how: an amnesiac swordsman who has forgotten his name and past and is driven to duel
introduced.quote: Nameless: I'm looking for... for... I've forgotten. Each time I think I'm about to remember it, it disappears from my mind.

introduced.name: Takatsuki Dougire
introduced.how: Nameless's sword, which he claims speaks to him and wants to cut people down
introduced.quote: Nameless: Ah, it's been a while since I brandished my blade. I can hear Takatsuki Dougire complaining.

introduced.name: Masanori
introduced.how: the samurai's real name, which the Traveler's remembered-wine quest recovers
introduced.quote: Traveler: So that's your name. Masanori.

introduced.name: Kujou Masahito
introduced.how: a military officer at the camp who refuses the Traveler entry and dismisses the nameless samurai
introduced.quote: Kujou Masahito: Hmm? Why is a civilian like you wandering around in the military camp?

introduced.name: Ishikawa
introduced.how: a soldier at the military camp who says he has never heard of the nameless samurai
introduced.quote: Ishikawa: I hope this fragile peace will hold out a little longer...

introduced.name: Sangonomiya rebels
introduced.how: rebels scorned by the camp officers as riff-raff
introduced.quote: Matsudaira: The Sangonomiya rebels are just riff-raff.

introduced.name: ronin
introduced.how: a samurai who serves no master, the term used for Nameless
introduced.quote: Kujou Masahito: Serving no master, and slaying no foe on the battlefield. The person you speak of must be a ronin.

introduced.name: Hatamoto
introduced.how: a samurai rank that Nameless and his hometown friend were raised to by a general
introduced.quote: Matsudaira: The General at the time quite liked him, and raised both him and his hometown friend to the rank of Hatamoto.

introduced.name: smelting plant
introduced.how: a place where smiths discard inferior blades that poor fighters can salvage
introduced.quote: Nameless: Without a good sword, they can only go to the smelting plant to look for a discarded, inferior blade.

introduced.name: military camp in the east
introduced.how: the army encampment where Nameless once drank with companions, believed to lie east of the area
introduced.quote: Paimon: If we head east from here, we'll reach some land that's mostly flat. Maybe that's where the camp is.

introduced.name: bottle of wine
introduced.how: the wine Nameless drank with his companion, which Matsudaira gives to the Traveler
introduced.quote: Matsudaira: I've got it. I'll give you my personal bottle of it, in fact.

introduced.name: battle where companions went missing
introduced.how: a last battle after which many soldiers, including Nameless, went missing in action
introduced.quote: Matsudaira: After that last battle ended, a lot of folks went missing in action, that guy included.

introduced.name: sparring childhood past
introduced.how: two children who trained with swords and sparred by their homes, recalled in fragments
introduced.quote: Nameless: I think... I think I remember something. Two children wielding swords and sparring, next to their family homes... a hut...

assumed.name: Almighty Shogun
assumed.quote: Kujou Masahito: I've received word that some scoundrel infiltrated the city and attempted to ambush our Almighty Shogun.

assumed.name: Amidst Stormy Judgment
assumed.quote: (After completing Amidst Stormy Judgment, while Traveler has an arrest warrant)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Nameless: I remember how I felt then. Mora and honor could all be gained by the sword.

assumed.name: ashigaru
assumed.quote: Nameless: You should. One strike, and one strike only, is all it takes for someone to fall, whether they be a mighty general or a lowly ashigaru! Hahaha.

threads.claim: Nameless has lost his memory of who he was and what he did before arriving, and the Traveler is pushed to help recover it.
threads.quote: Nameless: Who was I? What did I do before drifting here? I... no longer remember any of these things.

threads.claim: Nameless recovers fragments of a past, including a companion and a shared drink, but stays unnamed for much of the scene.
threads.quote: Nameless: I remember now! I remember drinking wine together with people... it was a long time ago.

threads.claim: Nameless is given the name Masanori after the remembered wine, which partly answers who he was.
threads.quote: "Masanori": Yes, yes, I remember! I would often drink with the same person. He and I were like brothers, and we would talk often.

threads.claim: Nameless claims his sword speaks to him, though the Traveler cannot hear it and suspects it is not literal.
threads.quote: Traveler: Your sword can't speak.

threads.claim: Masanori says he will stay by the sea with Takatsuki Dougire, keeping the sword's presence tied to him.
threads.quote: "Masanori": I and Takatsuki Dougire will remain here, watching the sea and listening to the wind.

threads.claim: Nameless recalls two sword-wielding children who sparred near their homes, and their swords may relate to him.
threads.quote: Nameless: I think... I think I remember something. Two children wielding swords and sparring, next to their family homes... a hut...

threads.claim: The swords found in the designated area are revealed to be those of one child and his friend, who took discarded blades from the smelting plant.
threads.quote: Nameless: That child, he and his friend sneaked off to the smelting plant to obtain two identical swords that the smiths had discarded.

threads.claim: Masanori was terrified by a sword falling from someone's hand in a battle, and he fled from that place.
threads.quote: "Masanori": I saw a sword fall from someone's hands, and it wasn't Takatsuki Dougire. The sight of that sword sent me trembling all over, and my courage failed me...

threads.claim: The Traveler recovers the sword and Masanori identifies it as his friend's, but where the friend went is still unknown.
threads.quote: "Masanori": This is that sword. Yes, that was his sword.

threads.claim: Matsudaira confirms that the friend and Masanori were both lost in the last battle, deepening the mystery of the friend's fate.
threads.quote: Matsudaira: After that last battle ended, a lot of folks went missing in action, that guy included.

threads.claim: Masanori's shock at the friend's absence is raised again, leaving the question of what happened unanswered.
threads.quote: "Masanori": Why wasn't he there!? Argh... How can this be!!!

threads.claim: The wine tastes bitter now, unlike the joyful wine Masanori remembers from before.
threads.quote: Nameless: This wine... it's bitter. That's not right.

threads.claim: Nameless takes pleasure in killing with a sword and finds the surge of blood familiar.
threads.quote: Nameless: Strike down... Wait, that's right! Brandishing a sword and executing people... it feels familiar, pleasing, hahaha, the surge of blood, like a river of red.

threads.claim: Masanori later vows never to raise his blade against the Traveler again, turning away from his earlier urge to kill.
threads.quote: "Masanori": You need not worry. I lost control earlier... Never again will I raise my hand against you of my own will.

threads.claim: The Traveler's fighting style is unusual and the Traveler refuses to reveal which school they trained in.
threads.quote: Nameless: You fight strangely, and your bearing is far from normal. Not at all like those who I cut down.

threads.claim: Kujou Masahito notices the Traveler looks familiar, hinting that the Traveler's past is tied to the camp.
threads.quote: Kujou Masahito: Still, you do look quite familiar.

introduced.name: Valberry Jelly
introduced.how: a jellyfish with no brain that feels pain, and that Paimon names while the Traveler treats it as a fellow creature
introduced.quote: It's all limp and floppy... like someone dropped a Valberry Jelly right here on the floor.

introduced.name: Tassel Jelly
introduced.how: a jellyfish kind that, at the end of its life, may be reborn as a small jellyfish if it returns to the sky
introduced.quote: Paimon heard that when a Tassel Jelly reaches the end of its life, it can start over as a little jellyfish, so long as it makes it back to the sky.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: an energy-like substance that the base's equipment must be supplied with through a separator
introduced.quote: All the equipment here needs to be provided with kuuvahki via the separator.

introduced.name: Tutorial/Recon Bots
introduced.how: Fatui flying machines that suppress jellyfish and can be used to meddle with terminal settings
introduced.quote: A recon bot flies over and suppresses

introduced.name: Dima
introduced.how: a Fatui patrol member who forgot to release trapped jellyfish and then wrote a remorseful reflection
introduced.quote: -->Patrolling personnel: Dima. Afternoon. A Tassel Jelly somehow got inside the barrier. It was released.

introduced.name: Riku
introduced.how: a new Fatui recruit who used the recon bots on the authorization terminal without permission
introduced.quote: combined with the new recruit Riku's over-enthusiastic, self-taught usage of the recon bots to meddle with the settings of the authorization terminal

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Fatui here aren't exactly the brightest, huh?

assumed.name: Tsaritsa
assumed.quote: the Tsaritsa's expectations of us all!

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: You've been sensing it just fine since we arrived in Nod-Krai.

threads.claim: The text raises whether a jellyfish with no brain can still feel pain, sadness, or gratitude.
threads.quote: But even without a brain, it looks like it can still feel pain

threads.claim: Paimon has heard that a Tassel Jelly can be reborn as a small jellyfish if it returns to the sky, and this is left unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Paimon wonders if that's really true...

threads.claim: The Fatui machines are blamed for disrupting the kuuvahki environment that is hurting the jellyfish.
threads.quote: It must be because those nasty machines the Fatui set up are totally messing up the environment!

threads.claim: The Valberry Jelly can use a power to open the barrier, but using it leaves the jelly paler and weaker.
threads.quote: Paimon didn't know Valberry Jelly had that kind of power.

threads.claim: The text asks whether the jelly will remember the Traveler and Paimon after it is reborn, and does not answer.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... , do you think it'll remember us when it grows up again?

threads.claim: Paimon portrays the Fatui as uncaring about the fate of the trapped jellyfish.
threads.quote: The Fatui really don't care at all what happens to them!

introduced.name: White Iron Chunks
introduced.how: material Dwarkanath commissioned, five of which are needed to make knives
introduced.quote: I guess you've got those five White Iron Chunks?

introduced.name: Dwarkanath's dad
introduced.how: a smith who makes knives for Dwarkanath
introduced.quote: I will go to dad later to make a bunch of knives.

assumed.name: Iradj
assumed.quote: Iradj's always losing my knives so I posted the commission.

assumed.name: White Iron Chunks commission
assumed.quote: About White Iron Chunks...

threads.claim: Iradj keeps losing Dwarkanath's knives, and Dwarkanath plans to surprise him with new ones.
threads.quote: Can't wait to see Iradj's face when he gets them, haha!

threads.claim: The Traveler delivers the five White Iron Chunks, and Dwarkanath's dad will use them to forge knives.
threads.quote: Thank you, I will go to dad later to make a bunch of knives.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: flying creatures that seem to lead the way to treasure
introduced.quote: Paimon: Where there are Seelie... there's bound to be treasure!

introduced.name: Harp
introduced.how: a strange instrument that makes no sound when plucked
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's such a weird instrument... No matter how Paimon plucks it, there's not a single sound! Is it broken?

introduced.name: Lakeside Prism
introduced.how: glowing things that must be reconnected to form paths
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uhm... Paimon's confused. Are we supposed to connect these glowing things somehow?

introduced.name: Moonlane
introduced.how: a ride path that appears when Lakeside Prisms are reconnected
introduced.quote: (Ride the Moonlane)

introduced.name: Royal Court of the Seelie
introduced.how: a gathering of Seelie that appears after the prisms are linked
introduced.quote: (Approach the appearing Royal Court of the Seelie)

introduced.name: Ruins
introduced.how: ruins with a wall of connectable things and a mural
introduced.quote: (Enter the ruins)

introduced.name: Mural
introduced.how: a mural activated by reconnecting the Lakeside Prism and touching it
introduced.quote: (Reconnect the Lakeside Prism and touch the mural)

assumed.name: Prism-connecting mechanic from earlier
assumed.quote: Paimon: Uhm... Does this mean we need to connect the things on this wall — just like we did last time?

assumed.name: The harp below
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh? It's the same as that harp below... Is this one broken, too?

threads.claim: The harp is silent for Paimon but the Traveler hears music and singing, hinting the music is not audible to everyone.
threads.quote: Traveler: Huh? But I definitely heard music just now. And singing...

threads.claim: Paimon suspects only the person strumming the harp can hear its music, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: Paimon: R—Really? But Paimon only heard the wind... Wait, is it one of those situations where only the person strumming it gets to hear the music?

threads.claim: Seelie are linked to finding treasure, suggesting they guide travelers to hidden riches.
threads.quote: Paimon: Where there are Seelie... there's bound to be treasure!

threads.claim: The Seelie do lead to treasure chests, confirming the earlier hint.
threads.quote: Paimon: See? The Seelie never steer us wrong — they know where all the best goodies are hiding!

threads.claim: Seelie fly over and enter the mural even though Paimon hears nothing, hinting the mural is tied to the unheard music.
threads.quote: Paimon: How strange... Paimon can't hear a thing, but all those Seelie came flying over anyway...

threads.claim: The Seelie entering the mural after the prism is touched suggests the mural holds a connection to the Seelie and the hidden music.
threads.quote: (The Seelies enter the mural)

assumed.name: hilichurls
assumed.quote: I reckon this is probably where those mega-strong hilichurls train.

introduced.name: Alrani
introduced.how: a thesis-writing scholar from the Akademiya, rescued by the Traveler from a Treasure Hoarder cage in Lingju Pass
introduced.quote: Alrani: I was that, uh, person you found in a Treasure Hoarder cage down in Lingju Pass. Heh, in any case, thank you for saving me.

introduced.name: Soraya
introduced.how: a kind person who fed Alrani and helped organize her notes, and advised her to change her thesis angle
introduced.quote: Alrani: Soraya's a really good person — not only did she treat me to a meal, but she also helped re-organize my notes.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: the inn where Soraya can be found
introduced.quote: Alrani: Well, uh, after being rescued by you, I went to look for Soraya at Wangshu Inn. By a stroke of luck, I was able to find her.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: an academy in Sumeru where Alrani writes theses and must report back; it is feared as a harsh place
introduced.quote: Alrani: I suppose I should just stay here in Liyue and finish my thesis in peace, then report back to the Akademiya in Sumeru with my findings as soon as possible.

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: an item that lets wielders use elements; Alrani lacks one and so cannot use elements
introduced.quote: Alrani: But since I don't have a Vision and can't use the elements, I have no idea where to begin...

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: an ability Vision wielders have to sense the presence of elements
introduced.quote: Alrani: By the way, I've also heard that Vision wielders can sense the presence of elements. I believe it's known as Elemental Sight...

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: a decree proclaimed by Inazuma's Electro Archon to confiscate most Visions, with severe punishment for those who withhold them
introduced.quote: Alrani: I've also heard it said that Inazuma's Electro Archon has proclaimed a "Vision Hunt Decree," which has aimed to confiscate the majority of all Visions from Vision wielders throughout Inazuma.

introduced.name: Inazuma
introduced.how: a dangerous region where the Electro Archon rules and the Vision Hunt Decree is enforced
introduced.quote: Alrani: I once wanted to travel to Inazuma to write a thesis regarding this decree, but it really does seem dangerous over there...

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarder
assumed.quote: Alrani: I'd rather stay in that Treasure Hoarder cage than have to do another draft or thesis defense.

assumed.name: Lingju Pass
assumed.quote: Alrani: I was that, uh, person you found in a Treasure Hoarder cage down in Lingju Pass. Heh, in any case, thank you for saving me.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Alrani: I recall noticing a group of hilichurls around these parts. Show me your fighting style, using them as your target!

assumed.name: Slimes
assumed.quote: Alrani: I happened upon a few slimes nearby, so could you demonstrate Elemental Sight? You can use it to find those slimes.

assumed.name: Electro Archon
assumed.quote: Alrani: I've heard that the Akademiya has been researching this matter for a while now, and they have concluded that the lack of Electro Visions granted to mortals is the will of the Electro Archon.

threads.claim: The Traveler fights in an unusual manner despite lacking a Vision, which puzzles Alrani and remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Alrani: Huh? You can fight in that manner without possessing a Vision? How can that be?

threads.claim: The Traveler uses Elemental Sight, a power that non-Vision users cannot detect, suggesting it is something only Vision wielders can sense.
threads.quote: Alrani: I suppose that might be something that only other Vision wielders can sense.

threads.claim: No one has obtained an Electro Vision for a year, a mystery that Alrani connects to the Electro Archon.
threads.quote: Alrani: Wait. Don't you know? It seems that nobody has obtained an Electro Vision for a whole year now.

threads.claim: The Akademiya has concluded that withholding Electro Visions from mortals is the will of the Electro Archon, though this is only rumor.
threads.quote: Alrani: I've heard that the Akademiya has been researching this matter for a while now, and they have concluded that the lack of Electro Visions granted to mortals is the will of the Electro Archon.

threads.claim: Inazuma's Electro Archon has decreed the confiscation of most Visions, with harsh punishment for those who resist.
threads.quote: Alrani: Those who disobey and withhold their Visions will be punished severely...

introduced.name: Goth Grand Hotel
introduced.how: Fatui delegation stays there and is locked inside under lockdown
introduced.quote: Meanwhile, the delegation staying at the Goth Grand Hotel are in some sort of lockdown, so I don't hear so much as a peep from the inside.

introduced.name: Signora
introduced.how: Viktor's superior, who sent him to Mondstadt and has given him no assignments
introduced.quote: My superiors sent me to Mondstadt to work for Signora, but I haven't received a single assignment from her since I arrived.

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: Snezhnaya-based group whose members are foreign to Mondstadt and disliked by locals
introduced.quote: Sara: The F—Fatui? You mean the ones from Snezhnaya? ...Your social circle is broad, to put it mildly.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: Distant homeland of the Fatui, far from Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Viktor: In any case, it seems like the locals are getting more and more hostile towards us Fatui. I fear we'll have to return to Snezhnaya at any moment.

introduced.name: Harbingers
introduced.how: Top-ranking Fatui, far above rank-and-file members like Viktor
introduced.quote: Viktor: The Harbingers? They're way above my level. I'm lucky if I hear the odd rumor.

introduced.name: Scaramouche
introduced.how: Harbinger No. 6, disagreeable and disliked even by fellow Harbingers
introduced.quote: Viktor: I know someone who works closely with the guy. He says Scaramouche is even disliked by several of his fellow Harbingers.

introduced.name: Childe
introduced.how: Harbinger who travels often and brings gifts home to his family
introduced.quote: Viktor: Have you heard of Childe? Word has it that this Harbinger travels often and will bring gifts to his family when he comes back.

introduced.name: Mondstadt specialties
introduced.how: Local dishes and drinks unique to Mondstadt, often short-lived, sold as gifts
introduced.quote: Sara: Mondstadt's specialties? What can I say, every last one of our dishes is unique to Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Satisfying Salad
introduced.how: A dish that suits all tastes, which Sara can process to make durable for travel
introduced.quote: Sara: Make me a Satisfying Salad and I will process it for you to make it more durable.

introduced.name: Flower bookmark
introduced.how: Fragile handmade gift Flora makes from flowers, sold as a Mondstadt specialty
introduced.quote: Flora: The only other thing I can think of is to make a flower bookmark.

introduced.name: Charles
introduced.how: Tavern worker who is worried about monster attacks hurting business
introduced.quote: Charles: These monster attacks are going to impact business at the tavern if they continue much longer.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Traveler: How are you lot still in Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Viktor's previous deal
assumed.quote: Viktor: Do you remember our previous deal? You help me, and I let you in on some things you'd like to hear.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Paimon: And these cheeky guys are still in Mondstadt, too! The Knights of Favonius should come and show them what for...

assumed.name: the sisters
assumed.quote: Viktor: It used to be that the sisters would shoot me the odd sideways glance.

assumed.name: Cathedral
assumed.quote: Viktor: Alright, alright. Just do it for me, and quickly. I'll be waiting for you inside the Cathedral.

assumed.name: Master Diluc
assumed.quote: Charles: This was all you managed to salvage, was it? Never mind, I'll raise it with Master Diluc next time he's here.

assumed.name: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call
assumed.quote: (Before completing The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call)

threads.claim: Signora's business in Mondstadt is unclear, and she left in a good mood without giving Viktor any orders.
threads.quote: Viktor: I heard through the grapevine that she didn't stick around long after she arrived, and that she was in a particularly good mood when she left...

threads.claim: Viktor cannot tell what he did to make the city turn on the Fatui, leaving the cause open.
threads.quote: Viktor: I'm at quite a loss to explain just what I must have done to get everyone here so riled up...

threads.claim: The Fatui delegation at the Goth Grand Hotel is locked inside for unknown reasons.
threads.quote: Viktor: I don't have the exact figure. But what I do know is that the party staying in the Goth Grand Hotel is keeping itself locked inside these days. I don't know what's happened.

threads.claim: Viktor suspects the Fatui higher-ups may be making another move, which is unconfirmed.
threads.quote: Viktor: At a guess, I would say that maybe the higher-ups are making a move again.

threads.claim: Viktor's reason for buying Mondstadt specialties is suspicious and left unresolved, though he claims it is innocent.
threads.quote: Paimon: We're doing this to gather information, but even so, this just doesn't feel right.

threads.claim: Viktor is stuck in Mondstadt with no assignments and wants to go home, but his superiors have not replied.
threads.quote: Viktor: *sigh* When will I get to head home?

threads.claim: Monster attacks, including slime swarms, are disrupting supplies and business in Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? How could so many slimes have gathered here...

threads.claim: Scaramouche, Harbinger No. 6, is disliked by many, including fellow Harbingers.
threads.quote: Viktor: I hear Harbinger No. 6, also known as Scaramouche, is difficult to get along with. A lot of people are not fans of his.

threads.claim: Childe is a Harbinger who travels often and is affectionately regarded by his younger siblings.
threads.quote: Viktor: Someone I know told me that he heard that the younger brothers and sisters of Master Childe all really like him.

assumed.name: Etienne
assumed.quote: Phew... My savior! You're finally here.

assumed.name: Baguette
assumed.quote: I'll get Baguette's dish done and go to rest.

introduced.name: Elber
introduced.how: a businessman introduces himself as the merchant whose goods and Sumpter Beasts are lost
introduced.quote: Elber: I'm Elber, a businessman. I was just relaxing here...

introduced.name: Sumpter Beasts
introduced.how: pack animals carrying Elber's goods, gentle by nature but restive when hungry or when their food is knocked over
introduced.quote: Elber: Don't worry. They are gentle in nature, it's just those hilichurls knocked over their food.

introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.how: a way to follow water trails, such as hoofprints in a puddle, to track a beast
introduced.quote: Paimon: Heh, it's time to use Elemental Sight! Follow the water's trail and we'll find the beast.

introduced.name: Calm Sumpter Beast
introduced.how: feeding an angry Sumpter Beast with food calms it down
introduced.quote: Paimon: Feed it with the food Mr. Elber gave us.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: people merchants normally hire, at a high price, to escort their goods
introduced.quote: Paimon: We have heard in town that normally merchants would hire the Eremites to escort their goods.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Elber: I never expected to get attacked by those hilichurls...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Elber: Well, that costs you Mora...

assumed.name: Gears
assumed.quote: Elber: I happen to be in the business of those gears. You could use all these.

threads.claim: Hilichurls near the Sumpter Beast did not try to eat it, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: They don't seem to want to make a meal out of it.

threads.claim: Hiring Eremite escorts is costly enough that merchants may travel unguarded instead.
threads.quote: Elber: The prices they asked for were just astronomical.

threads.claim: After the ordeal, Elber resolves to hire escorts in the future, reinforcing the cost-versus-safety tension.
threads.quote: Elber: *sigh* I'll make sure to hire some escorts next time...

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: Columbina: What shall we play today?

threads.claim: The Damselette wishes the Traveler that moonlight will linger upon them, hinting at a recurring moon theme.
threads.quote: The Damselette: Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.

introduced.name: Xueyoni
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a training master and the father of the three siblings
introduced.quote: Then greetings, kind friends. I'm Xueyoni, a training master and their father.

introduced.name: Acomitl
introduced.how: Is one of Xueyoni's children and a flier in the flying squad
introduced.quote: Xueyoni: Manyoya, Acomitl, Matahga, I've brought you here, for you are to be the heroes of the Flower-Feather Clan, gazing down from a great height.

introduced.name: Manyoya
introduced.how: Is a retired flier and one of Xueyoni's children
introduced.quote: Xueyoni: Manyoya, Acomitl, Matahga, I've brought you here, for you are to be the heroes of the Flower-Feather Clan, gazing down from a great height.

introduced.name: Matahga
introduced.how: Is one of Xueyoni's children and a competitive flier
introduced.quote: Xueyoni: All three of my kids are top-tier fliers in the Flower-Feather Clan. You'll have a great time flying together.

introduced.name: Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.how: A tribe whose warriors fly, with Xueyoni's children among its top fliers
introduced.quote: All three of my kids are top-tier fliers in the Flower-Feather Clan. You'll have a great time flying together.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: An organization uniting adventurers, who join to explore, earn money, or gain knowledge
introduced.quote: Now that's an amazing organization. You adventurers desire to explore the world, right?

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: A creature ridden by warriors in the flying squad
introduced.quote: I'm an old man who retired after serving as a Saurian rider in the flying squad and went on to become a master trainer in our tribe.

introduced.name: flying squad
introduced.how: A squad of riders, where members are expected to fly, and whose members are respected
introduced.quote: Back when he was still in the flying squad, everyone there, even the Qucusaurs, would willingly hear his opinion.

introduced.name: Gliding Challenge
introduced.how: A race where fliers chase a target on a course, and the first to catch it wins
introduced.quote: Xueyoni: Chase after the on the course. Whoever catches it first wins. That's how I trained them when they were little.

introduced.name: warrior ideal
introduced.how: Master trainers aspire to an ideal warrior, but no single person can define it
introduced.quote: We all have a "dream warrior" we wish to see emerge, but no single person can dictate what such a warrior should be.

introduced.name: hero
introduced.how: A warrior becomes a hero only after undergoing trials
introduced.quote: You are a warrior, and a warrior must undergo trials to become a hero.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: A land where a perfect, conforming warrior is not recognized as a hero
introduced.quote: A warrior with a perfect face, a person who conforms to every boring standard, will not be recognized as a hero here in Natlan.

introduced.name: woven scrolls
introduced.how: Records kept on woven scrolls that document warriors' self-doubt and exhaustion
introduced.quote: I can show you multiple woven scrolls that show how self-doubt and exhaustion plague everyone equally.

assumed.name: captain
assumed.quote: Manyoya: Acomitl, I believe the captain rejected your resignation so that you could give it more thought.

assumed.name: earlier race with Manyoya and help to Acomitl
assumed.quote: Xueyoni: Having the guts to compete with Manyoya, help little Acomitl... and you even gained Matahga's recognition — a true warrior, you are.

assumed.name: six tribes
assumed.quote: Yet, I cannot imagine what a Guild containing the master trainers of all six tribes would look like.

threads.claim: The ideal warrior has countless forms and no single definition, leaving what a true warrior is an open question.
threads.quote: We all have a "dream warrior" we wish to see emerge, but no single person can dictate what such a warrior should be.

threads.claim: Xueyoni argues that leaving or joining the flying squad does not decide whether someone is a warrior.
threads.quote: Xueyoni: Does leaving the flying squad mean one is no longer a warrior? Does joining the flying squad automatically make one a warrior? There are no such things.

threads.claim: Xueyoni senses the Traveler has endured many trials and may become a hero, an idea left unresolved.
threads.quote: You have undergone many trials, haven't you, youngster? I can see it in your eyes.

threads.claim: Acomitl's family allows him to decide for himself whether to keep flying, with support only if he accepts the consequences.
threads.quote: Manyoya: It's okay, so long as it's your own decision, and you're willing to shoulder the consequences.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Receives requests from across the land daily and assigns them to adventurers as commissions
introduced.quote: The Guild receives requests from far and wide each day, and assigns to adventurers accordingly.

introduced.name: Daily Commissions
introduced.how: Commissioned adventures are the Guild's main source of pay for members, ranging from errands to dangerous monster jobs
introduced.quote: These commissioned adventures are the main source of compensation for our guild members.

introduced.name: Daily reward
introduced.how: Completing enough commissions in a day makes you eligible for a special reward, which is forfeit if not claimed
introduced.quote: If you complete enough commissions each day, you will be eligible to claim a special reward from me.

introduced.name: Adventurer Handbook
introduced.how: Keeps a record of how many adventures you complete each day
introduced.quote: Your Adventurer Handbook keeps a record of how many adventures you complete each day.

introduced.name: Helping fellow adventurers
introduced.how: Helping another adventurer complete a commission also counts toward your daily reward eligibility
introduced.quote: please note that helping a fellow adventurer to complete a commission also counts towards your eligibility for a daily reward.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: We meet again, avid adventurer.

assumed.name: Headquarters
assumed.quote: But please be assured that we are constantly pushing Headquarters to make sure all our adventurers receive fair and adequate compensation.

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: I await your return with great anticipation, . Ad astra abyssosque!

threads.claim: Daily rewards are limited in quantity and are forfeited if the adventurer does not claim them on time.
threads.quote: There is a limited quantity of rewards, so it will become forfeit should you not claim it.

threads.claim: The Guild is pressing Headquarters for fairer compensation, hinting at dissatisfaction with current pay.
