threads.quote: But please be assured that we are constantly pushing Headquarters to make sure all our adventurers receive fair and adequate compensation.

threads.claim: The one-reward-per-day limit is admitted to be the current state of affairs, with an apology, reinforcing the compensation tension.
threads.quote: As things currently stand, yes... My apologies.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: the guild takes commissions from outside groups like the Fishing Association and the Traveler is welcomed as a member
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Mondstadt Fishing Association
introduced.how: a fishing organization that commissions adventurers to study the abnormal fish activity
introduced.quote: Ahem. My name is Nantuck, senior fisherman of the Mondstadt Fishing Association.

introduced.name: Nantuck
introduced.how: senior fisherman of the Mondstadt Fishing Association who posts the commission and teaches the Traveler to fish
introduced.quote: Ahem. My name is Nantuck, senior fisherman of the Mondstadt Fishing Association.

introduced.name: Cider Lake
introduced.how: a fishing ground prepared for newcomers where the basics are taught
introduced.quote: That's where the fishing grounds I prepared for newcomers is, I'll teach you the basics first.

introduced.name: Stormbearer Mountains
introduced.how: a nearby area where many ornamental fish have recently been active and are marked on the map
introduced.quote: in the waters near the Stormbearer Mountains, which I have marked on your map.

introduced.name: fishing rods and bait
introduced.how: basic fishing tools given to the Traveler, with bait made from formulas
introduced.quote: Here, take some of these tools. We have fishing rods, bait, and formulas for making bait.

introduced.name: ornamental fish
introduced.how: unusually active, eye-catching individuals of a species that hobbyists buy at high prices for tanks
introduced.quote: Many hobbyists buy them at high prices and keep them at home in their tanks for ornamental purposes.

assumed.name: Paimon as emergency food
assumed.quote: Traveler: Here's to catching another Paimon.

threads.claim: The sudden appearance of many new fish species everywhere has not been explained, and its cause remains uninvestigated.
threads.quote: Actually, the reason hasn't been fully investigated, but I guess it has something to do with the improvement of the ecological environment...

threads.claim: Some individuals of ordinary fish species become unusually active and valuable, and the reason for this variation is only hinted at.
threads.quote: You might not know this, but even fish from the same species can have huge differences between individuals because of differences in living environment and food.

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: an explorer who was attacked by monsters and rescued by the Traveler
introduced.quote: [Explorer Jack's Dilemma]

introduced.name: Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou
introduced.how: Introduces himself by full name and asks to be called Kyuuzou
introduced.quote: ...Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. Just call me Kyuuzou.

introduced.name: Kujou Masahito
introduced.how: Described as not a bad person, son of a man who orders deserters caught and punished
introduced.quote: Kujou Masahito is not a bad person, but his old man is calling for deserters to be caught and punished...

introduced.name: Pirates
introduced.how: Lawless gangs with strongholds that raid ships and try to escape Her Excellency's control
introduced.quote: They're pirates. They have many strongholds around Nazuchi Beach.

introduced.name: Vagrants and Kairagi
introduced.how: Other names for the lawless thugs who form pirate gangs
introduced.quote: Whether you call them Vagrants or Kairagi, they are all lawless thugs...

introduced.name: Nazuchi Beach
introduced.how: Location where the pirate strongholds are concentrated
introduced.quote: They have many strongholds around Nazuchi Beach.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya rebels
introduced.how: Rebels who once owned the ship and destroyed the island's ward
introduced.quote: This thing? It belonged to the Sangonomiya rebels.

introduced.name: Naku Weed
introduced.how: Common island herb whose squeezed liquid is applied to wounds to reduce inflammation
introduced.quote: In that case, please find some Naku weed for me. It can be found everywhere on this island.

introduced.name: Dendrobium
introduced.how: Flower offered to fallen comrades in Inazuma tradition, a symbol of the samurai fate
introduced.quote: In Inazuma's tradition, we offer our fallen comrades a Dendrobium, a delicate and noble flower...

assumed.name: Her Excellency
assumed.quote: They try, in vain, to escape the control of Her Excellency.

assumed.name: Vision Hunt Decree
assumed.quote: Thugs, out-of-work miners and fishermen, fugitives running from the Vision Hunt Decree, deserters from both sides of the war...

assumed.name: Tatarasuna
assumed.quote: The refugees from Tatarasuna and the mine fled in quick succession, and some of those rats scurried off to this place

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: In Inazuma's tradition, we offer our fallen comrades a Dendrobium, a delicate and noble flower...

threads.claim: Fugitives flee the Vision Hunt Decree, and people try in vain to escape Her Excellency's control.
threads.quote: They try, in vain, to escape the control of Her Excellency.

threads.claim: Kujou Masahito's father is calling for deserters to be caught and punished, which makes Kyuuzou fear him.
threads.quote: Kujou Masahito is not a bad person, but his old man is calling for deserters to be caught and punished...

threads.claim: Rebels destroyed the island's ward, so the pirates were no longer suppressed.
threads.quote: We had been suppressing them for a while until the rebels destroyed the ward on the island...

threads.claim: Refugees from Tatarasuna and the mine joined the pirate gangs and made them more reckless.
threads.quote: The refugees from Tatarasuna and the mine fled in quick succession, and some of those rats scurried off to this place

threads.claim: Kyuuzou still feels like a wounded, bloodstained soldier from the war and cannot find peace.
threads.quote: My memories assert that I am still that same wounded, bloodstained soldier...

threads.claim: Kyuuzou's old comrades in arms are still with him on the island, and the player should meet them.
threads.quote: Ah, speaking of which, it's time for me to visit my old comrades in arms, who are still with me on this island.

threads.claim: Kyuuzou's fate is witnessed, closing his story and his final words.
threads.quote: (Witness Inaba Kyuuzou's fate)

threads.claim: A lone, nameless sword stands erect on the island, silent and solemn.
threads.quote: Traveler: (A lone sword stands erect here, silent and solemn.)

introduced.name: Linnea
introduced.how: animal teacher who found a uniquely colored Golden Loach while exploring up north
introduced.quote: I discovered this uniquely colored Golden Loach while exploring up north.

introduced.name: Golden Loach
introduced.how: rare loach whose unusual color a doctor found not to be pathological
introduced.quote: The color doesn't seem to be caused by anything pathological.

introduced.name: Pink Frostfin Whale
introduced.how: very rare whale that people believe grants wishes if seen
introduced.quote: They say if you get the chance to see a Pink Frostfin Whale, your wishes will come true — but they're super, duper rare.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: source of animals once prized on the black market
introduced.quote: There was a time when animals from Natlan were highly prized on the black market

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: creature whose feet poachers removed, so collectors thought it was naturally legless
introduced.quote: Collectors who'd never seen a Qucusaurus before actually thought they were naturally legless

introduced.name: Animal smuggling network
introduced.how: merchants and poachers trade animal parts disguised as fantasy products, fueled by collectors' demand
introduced.quote: they created a whole smuggling network born from greed and deceit

introduced.name: Silver Capybara
introduced.how: rare silver-furred capybara Linnea found soaking in a Hilichurl's cooking pot
introduced.quote: When I found it, it was taking a soak in a Hilichurl's cooking pot.

introduced.name: White Weasel Thief
introduced.how: weasel the group caught and released, which had been near Fatui research facilities
introduced.quote: Mikko: Come to think of it, we caught a White Weasel Thief once before, too.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: substance that can cause an acquired color change in creatures exposed to high concentrations
introduced.quote: perhaps a result of being exposed to such high concentrations of kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Lumi
introduced.how: special Jack Frost who became Linnea's partner
introduced.quote: if Lumi wasn't such a special little Jack Frost, we might never have become partners to begin with

introduced.name: Liyue blessing-and-misfortune saying
introduced.how: a Liyue proverb that misfortune hides blessings and blessings hide misfortune
introduced.quote: Every misfortune conceals a blessing, and every blessing hides misfortune.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: As shiny as Mora, the Golden Loach King of the loachey world!

assumed.name: Katya
assumed.quote: Katya told me that some really nasty treasure hunters hunt animals with unusual colors to sell them to collectors.

assumed.name: Conch Gang
assumed.quote: you were once part of the Conch Gang too, Ms. Linnea!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: won't go near any more Fatui research facilities

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: When I found it, it was taking a soak in a Hilichurl's cooking pot.

assumed.name: Capybara
assumed.quote: Despite its unique color, it still has the same nature and temperament as other Capybaras.

assumed.name: Snegovik
assumed.quote: How do they compare to Snegovik and Leshy?

assumed.name: Leshy
assumed.quote: How do they compare to Snegovik and Leshy?

assumed.name: Volkodlak
assumed.quote: you can tell us about the Volkodlak!

assumed.name: Helka
assumed.quote: I remember Helka mentioning a saying from Liyue in one of her letters, something about blessings and misfortune...

threads.claim: The cause of the Golden Loach's unusual color is unknown and left open.
threads.quote: But if you're asking me to pin it down to one specific reason, I'm afraid I just don't know.

threads.claim: Pink Frostfin Whales are said to grant wishes, which raises whether colors give mystical powers.
threads.quote: They say if you get the chance to see a Pink Frostfin Whale, your wishes will come true

threads.claim: Linnea doubts that colored creatures have mystical powers, though some special-colored creatures have unique abilities.
threads.quote: It's probably just wishful thinking.

threads.claim: Animals from Natlan were once smuggled and sold on the black market.
threads.quote: There was a time when animals from Natlan were highly prized on the black market

threads.claim: Collectors' demand for the exotic fuels poaching and a smuggling network.
threads.quote: they created a whole smuggling network born from greed and deceit

threads.claim: Kuuvahki exposure can cause an acquired color change in creatures.
threads.quote: perhaps a result of being exposed to such high concentrations of kuuvahki.

threads.claim: Fatui research facilities are linked to animals that have been exposed to kuuvahki.
threads.quote: won't go near any more Fatui research facilities

threads.claim: Stories about the Volkodlak are promised for a later lesson.
threads.quote: they'll have to wait for next time.

threads.claim: Lumi's special nature as a Jack Frost is hinted as the reason for the partnership with Linnea.
threads.quote: if Lumi wasn't such a special little Jack Frost, we might never have become partners to begin with

introduced.name: Iwata
introduced.how: A man on Watatsumi Island trying to make fertilizer himself, who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Ah, hello there, Traveler. Well, I... Um... I'm trying to make some fertilizer.

introduced.name: Gorou
introduced.how: A general who keeps order on Watatsumi Island and investigates a stench complaint
introduced.quote: Ookubo Daisuke: Sir! General Gorou!

introduced.name: Alrani
introduced.how: A self-described researcher from the Akademiya who claims to be a fertilizer salesperson
introduced.quote: Alrani: Hello, I'm Alrani...

introduced.name: Kaushik
introduced.how: A researcher who has studied the island's culture and history and has solid credentials
introduced.quote: Ookubo Daisuke: Do you remember Kaushik? That researcher who's been studying our island's culture and history?

introduced.name: Hiroyuki
introduced.how: A Sangonomiya Samurai who detains Alrani as a suspect
introduced.quote: Hiroyuki: Stay right there and don't move!

introduced.name: Ookubo Daisuke
introduced.how: A subordinate of Gorou who reports catching a suspicious fertilizer seller
introduced.quote: Ookubo Daisuke: General, we caught a suspicious person out in the outskirts.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: An island in Inazuma where Iwata works and Gorou's forces keep order
introduced.quote: Kaushik: Alrani's here? On Watatsumi Island? That's... odd.

introduced.name: Sumeru fertilizer
introduced.how: Fertilizer from Sumeru said to make plants grow exceedingly lushly when a little is added
introduced.quote: Iwata: They say that these fertilizers have unusual properties. As long as you add a little when growing plants, they will grow exceedingly lushly.

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: An academic institution whose researchers are allowed to leave to wander and do fieldwork
introduced.quote: Kaushik: To us, wandering and learning are part of our research process, and as such, we are permitted to leave the Akademiya.

introduced.name: Driyosh
introduced.how: A term for Akademiya researchers such as Alrani and Kaushik
introduced.quote: Alrani and I are both Driyosh.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: A place where someone from Sumeru reportedly opened a fertilizer shop
introduced.quote: Iwata: I heard from someone that someone from Sumeru has set up a fertilizer shop in Ritou.

introduced.name: Akademiya graduation standards
introduced.how: Researchers must graduate several years in a row or face serious trouble
introduced.quote: Kaushik: You know what the standards for graduation are at the Akademiya. If you can't graduate several years in a row...

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Iwata: I heard from someone that someone from Sumeru has set up a fertilizer shop in Ritou.

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Ookubo Daisuke: General, I'm positive that she's a Shogunate spy!

assumed.name: Vahid
assumed.quote: Alrani: I—I've learned about the fertilizer at Mr. Vahid's... I'll get this done in one go, just you all watch!

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Kaushik: Alrani's here? On Watatsumi Island? That's... odd. What's that girl doing here? Shouldn't she be in Liyue?

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Samurai
assumed.quote: (Approach Alrani and the Sangonomiya Samurai)

threads.claim: Whether Alrani is really an Akademiya researcher remains unproven despite her claim.
threads.quote: Gorou: Hmm... I'm afraid that none of the evidence here is conclusive.

threads.claim: Paimon senses the fertilizer salesperson is familiar but cannot recall why.
threads.quote: Paimon: Someone selling fertilizer? Paimon can't help feel like that's familiar somehow... Nothing's coming to mind, though...

threads.claim: Sumeru fertilizers have unusual properties and a Sumeru seller has appeared in Ritou.
threads.quote: Iwata: I heard from someone that someone from Sumeru has set up a fertilizer shop in Ritou.

threads.claim: Suspicion that Alrani is a Shogunate spy is raised and later dismissed.
threads.quote: Ookubo Daisuke: General, I'm positive that she's a Shogunate spy!

threads.claim: Kaushik is studying a totem whose meaning is still unknown.
threads.quote: Kaushik: The meaning of this totem... Hmm? Traveler? Did you have some business with me?

threads.claim: Strict Akademiya graduation standards push researchers to wander and collect material.
threads.quote: Kaushik: You know what the standards for graduation are at the Akademiya. If you can't graduate several years in a row...

threads.claim: Iwata's fertilizer repeatedly fails to form, and the cause stays unresolved in this unit.
threads.quote: Iwata: But no matter how much I experiment, these materials just won't come together. It's really strange...

introduced.name: Iara
introduced.how: a Melusine who fishes with a rod, is a hobbyist, and asks the Traveler and Paimon for help
introduced.quote: Iara: There's water, and a rod... of course I'm fishing.

introduced.name: Delaroche
introduced.how: an outsider who taught Iara to fish and gave her a rod, and who is a professional angler
introduced.quote: Delaroche is a great person. She not only taught me how to fish, but she also gave me a rod too!

introduced.name: Ball Octopus
introduced.how: a fast, slippery water creature that eats bait and can be caught and kept in a bucket or pool
introduced.quote: Paimon: Eh? Why is it a Ball Octopus?

introduced.name: dry component
introduced.how: a mechanical component given as a reward that is useful later
introduced.quote: Iara: Please, take this dry component. It will be very useful to you in Merusea Village.

assumed.name: Traveler fishing Paimon out of the water
assumed.quote: Paimon: That's true, you did fish Paimon out of the water back then, didn't you...

assumed.name: Merusea Village
assumed.quote: Iara: Please, take this dry component. It will be very useful to you in Merusea Village.

assumed.name: components
assumed.quote: Iara: Hmm. Components are very, very important.

threads.claim: Delaroche, an outsider, taught Iara fishing, and Iara learned it from an outsider.
threads.quote: I learned this from an outsider.

threads.claim: Components were eaten by the Ball Octopus and Iara needs to find a way to get them back.
threads.quote: Since they're not meant to be used as bait, I need to find a way to get them back.

threads.claim: The unidentified slippery creature Iara wanted to catch turns out to be the Ball Octopus.
threads.quote: That super slippery, hard-to-catch thing!

threads.claim: Ball Octopuses can eat mechanical components, which is a surprising detail about their diet.

introduced.name: Garcia
introduced.how: Lutong's boss, a researcher developing the Numbering Machine who hails from Fontaine
introduced.quote: I am Lutong, and this is Garcia, my boss, who hails from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Lutong
introduced.how: Garcia's assistant who introduces himself and explains the commission
introduced.quote: I am Lutong, and this is Garcia, my boss, who hails from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the home region Garcia comes from
introduced.quote: I am Lutong, and this is Garcia, my boss, who hails from Fontaine.

introduced.name: Numbering Machine
introduced.how: a calculating tool Garcia is developing to perform various calculations
introduced.quote: Mr. Garcia is currently developing a... I believe he calls it the Numbering Machine.

introduced.name: Radish Veggie Soup
introduced.how: a dish the pair want to reduce to a repeatable recipe formula
introduced.quote: Simply put, we intend to use the Numbering Machine to attempt to write a recipe formula for Radish Veggie Soup.

introduced.name: formulae
introduced.how: equations expressing relationships between quantities with general applicability, used here as recipe procedures
introduced.quote: An equation that is used to express the relationship between various quantities, and which possesses a certain general applicability...

introduced.name: Smiley Yanxiao
introduced.how: the inn's chef whose kitchen they borrow and who is annoyed by the pair
introduced.quote: In fact, I believe that Mr. Yanxiao of this very inn has experienced this first-hand...

introduced.name: taste-testing commission
introduced.how: the Traveler is recruited as a neutral third party to taste a formula-made soup and comment
introduced.quote: Simply put, we'll need you to try the Radish Veggie Soup that Mr. Garcia makes according to the formula and give comments.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Sir, I believe that we should aim to be thrifty in our expenditures, lest we lack sufficient Mora for our journey to Sumeru.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Sir, I believe that we should aim to be thrifty in our expenditures, lest we lack sufficient Mora for our journey to Sumeru.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Mr. Garcia wishes to read up on some resources at the Akademiya, and I have been hired to go with him.

threads.claim: Garcia asks whether the Numbering Machine possesses thought and postpones the answer to a later meeting.
threads.quote: Do you think that the Numbering Machine possesses

threads.claim: Lutong suggests that cooking skill depends on natural talent that cannot be taught, which a formula may not capture.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, such a method is too greatly predicated upon natural talent.

threads.claim: Garcia's Numbering Machine is an unfinished project he intends to refine into something capable of grander calculations.
threads.quote: Mr. Garcia is currently developing a... I believe he calls it the Numbering Machine.

threads.claim: Garcia and Lutong plan to travel to Sumeru to research at the Akademiya and refine the machine there.
threads.quote: Are you two going to Sumeru?

introduced.name: Garcia
introduced.how: a researcher trying to make the Numbering Machine generate music scores
introduced.quote: Mr. Garcia is trying to make the Numbering Machine generate music scores through certain equations.

introduced.name: Lutong
introduced.how: Garcia's account keeper who can transcribe texts and is from Liyue
introduced.quote: Sir, as an account keeper, I maintain a professional capability of transcribing texts.

introduced.name: Numbering Machine
introduced.how: a calculator that cannot compose music on its own
introduced.quote: The Numbering Machine is a calculator by its nature.

introduced.name: Kaia
introduced.how: a brilliant dancer in a troupe leaving Sumeru
introduced.quote: Kaia? Oh, right. She is a brilliant dancer.

introduced.name: Ahangar
introduced.how: a craftsman who makes the machine's components
introduced.quote: I saw your sketches of the components.

introduced.name: Sheikh Zubayr
introduced.how: runs the theater and knows the tastes of his performers
introduced.quote: Like Sheikh Zubayr who runs the theater.

introduced.name: Candied Ajilenakh Nut
introduced.how: a snack Kaia is especially fond of
introduced.quote: She is very fond of a snack called Candied Ajilenakh Nuts.

introduced.name: Lambad's Tavern
introduced.how: has a pot the group can use for cooking
introduced.quote: I remember there's a pot we can use at Lambad's Tavern.

introduced.name: Arithmetic Music Score
introduced.how: a score produced purely by algorithm, intended as Garcia's gift for Kaia
introduced.quote: which is calculated purely by algorithm, is my gift for Kaia.

introduced.name: Garcia's farewell promise
introduced.how: Garcia promised Kaia a gift as a proper farewell
introduced.quote: I made a promise to her that I would present her a gift as a proper good-bye.

introduced.name: Garcia and Kaia's meeting
introduced.how: Garcia first met Kaia because of the Numbering Machine
introduced.quote: It was because of the Numbering Machine that I met Kaia.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Garcia, optional)

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Are you wanted by Fontaine?

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: She is leaving Sumeru with her troupe today.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Mora and other payments will not be a problem.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: temporarily sends me back to Liyue

assumed.name: Traveler's prior meeting with Kaia
assumed.quote: Do you happen to remember Kaia... I mean, Ms. Kaia?

threads.claim: The Numbering Machine is said to be unable to generate music scores by itself, yet Garcia is forcing it to.
threads.quote: The Numbering Machine is a calculator by its nature. It is, of course, not capable of generating music scores on its own.

threads.claim: Ahangar suggests Garcia has fallen for Kaia, raising a romantic thread between them.
threads.quote: So you fell in love with Ms. Kaia at first sight...

threads.claim: Kaia is leaving Sumeru with her troupe, setting up an uncertain parting from Garcia.
threads.quote: She is leaving Sumeru with her troupe today.

threads.claim: Kaia says goodbye to Garcia as she departs, closing their parting.
threads.quote: Goodbye, Garcia.

threads.claim: Garcia claims to compute formulas mentally in a way that seems unusual, hinting at a hidden ability.
threads.quote: I don't memorize everything. I just ran a brief mental calculation...

threads.claim: Lutong made an unexplained copy of the score that he cannot clearly recall making, hinting at an odd ability.
threads.quote: Pardon me. When did you make the copy?

threads.claim: Kaia accepts the failed-looking Arithmetic Music Score as a gift and says she will keep it.
threads.quote: This is your gift to me. I love it, and I'll keep it.

threads.claim: Kaia and Garcia share matching gifts, deepening the sense of a connection between them.
threads.quote: Pfff... We have the same gift for each other, huh? Looks like we are more connected than we think.

introduced.name: Chouji
introduced.how: a young boy selling Jakotsu Crystal who introduces himself by name
introduced.quote: Chouji: Hehe, I haven't introduced myself either, huh? My name's Chouji.

introduced.name: Yashiori Island
introduced.how: the island where the crystal mine is and where Chouji sells ore
introduced.quote: Chouji: People from abroad, come and have a look! This is the best Jakotsu Crystal in Yashiori Island!

introduced.name: Jakotsu Crystal
introduced.how: high-quality crystal mined on the island, once sold to the Shogunate and used for weapons
introduced.quote: Chouji: C'mon, check it out! Goods of this quality used to go straight to the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Tatarasuna
introduced.how: the city where the island's ore used to be shipped
introduced.quote: Shove 'em all into boxes to be transported to Tatarasuna.

introduced.name: Tatarigami
introduced.how: a supernatural nuisance the adults blame for troubles on the island
introduced.quote: Chouji: After all, the mine's been shut down because of the war, and there's this Tatarigami or whatever causing a nuisance on the island.

introduced.name: The war
introduced.how: a war that stopped city buyers from coming to the island and closed the mines
introduced.quote: Chouji: But now that we're at war, the adults in the city won't be coming this way anymore...

introduced.name: Lavender Melon
introduced.how: a common food Chouji eats that is cut and boiled as a poultry dish ingredient
introduced.quote: Chouji: This dish is very easy to make! First, let's cut the Lavender Melon and boil it in water. Then, we crack the Bird Eggs and beat them.

introduced.name: Xavier
introduced.how: an outlander in the Shogunate who originally taught the recipe to Chouji's family
introduced.quote: Chouji: This dish was originally taught to us by Xavier, who's an outlander in the Shogunate.

introduced.name: Fowl
introduced.how: a meat ingredient that must be sliced and fried for the poultry dish
introduced.quote: Chouji: But since we're going to make a poultry dish, we need some Fowl.

introduced.name: Washizu
introduced.how: head of Higi Village, once kind but now strange and frightening to Chouji
introduced.quote: Chouji: Washizu, the head of Higi Village. He used to be a very nice person... But now he's very strange.

introduced.name: Higi Village
introduced.how: the village that Washizu leads
introduced.quote: Chouji: Washizu, the head of Higi Village.

introduced.name: Yasumoto
introduced.how: a doctor on Yashiori Island who avoids Chouji
introduced.quote: Chouji: I'll start on Yashiori Island, of course. Maybe I'll go ask the doctor called Yasumoto... But I think he hates me.

introduced.name: Kaji
introduced.how: Mr. Kaji, a former co-worker of Chouji's father who is still on the island
introduced.quote: Chouji: After that, I might go look for one of my dad's co-workers... I've heard that Mr. Kaji is still on the island.

introduced.name: Sakura Bloom
introduced.how: petals Chouji's mother offered at the shrine while praying for her family
introduced.quote: Chouji: Speaking of which, Mom used to go to the nearby shrine to pray for my dad and I. She'd offer some Sakura Bloom petals there too.

introduced.name: Shrine
introduced.how: shrines Washizu built on the island, originally to pacify the Serpent's soul with offerings
introduced.quote: Chouji: Well, Washizu built some shrines on the island way back when. They were originally meant to pacify the Serpent's soul with offerings...

introduced.name: Pirates
introduced.how: pirates who clash with the Shogunate's officials but are friendly to the children on the island
introduced.quote: Chouji: Well... I guess I can seek help from the pirates, too... They don't get along with the grown-ups from the Shogunate, but they're nice to us.

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Traveler: The Shogunate isn't poking their nose around these parts, are they?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Chouji: Besides, they've got this saying in Liyue, don't they?

assumed.name: Inazuman samurai
assumed.quote: And we Inazuman samurai are the most honorable people there are!

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Chouji: Well... I'm a kid making money like an adult, so I run the risk of discovery by the Tenryou Commission

assumed.name: Commissioner
assumed.quote: Chouji: The grown-ups say that as long as I have enough Mora, even the Commissioner will let us go out to sea.

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Chouji: It's said that only one round-trip route to Snezhnaya is still open in Ritou... Maybe I still have a chance.

threads.claim: Chouji's assurances of honesty are doubtful, since he is running a scam.
threads.quote: Chouji: Relax, I wouldn't lie to you!

threads.claim: Chouji admits the treasure was a lie and that his family is poor.
threads.quote: Chouji: Ugh... Oh, I'll be honest with you. We're a mining family, so we were already very poor.

threads.claim: Chouji's mother has left without explanation, and her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Chouji: Ten days after it began to rain on the island, my mom left.

threads.claim: Chouji plans to search for his mother, who may be looking for his missing father.
threads.quote: Chouji: Mom should be searching for Dad... So I'm going to look for her, too.

threads.claim: The scattered Sakura Blooms at the shrine are identified as the mother's offering, but no message is found.
threads.quote: Traveler: It's Chouji's mother's offering...

threads.claim: Chouji and his mother believe his father may still be alive, despite a tombstone being set up.
threads.quote: Chouji: That day, my mom was very angry. I've never seen her that angry... My mom believes that my dad's still alive. I believe that too.

threads.claim: Washizu is behaving strangely and may be dangerous to Chouji and his mother.
threads.quote: Chouji: He's very scary. He always stares at my house from a distance and talks to himself.

threads.claim: Washizu's shrine offerings have become erratic, and adults who criticized him began disappearing.
threads.quote: Chouji: Later on, the adults who were calling Washizu's behavior crazy started disappearing one by one...

threads.claim: The shrine shows no strange elemental traces, deepening the mystery of Washizu's behavior.
threads.quote: Shrine: (The shrine is simple but elegant. Its wood shimmers slightly, greeting guests and their offerings with solemn silence.)

threads.claim: A Tatarigami is blamed for troubles on Yashiori Island, and its nature is unexplained.
threads.quote: Chouji: After all, the mine's been shut down because of the war, and there's this Tatarigami or whatever causing a nuisance on the island.

threads.claim: The war has cut off the island from the city, emptying it of people.
threads.quote: Chouji: But now that we're at war, the adults in the city won't be coming this way anymore...

threads.claim: Most islanders have left or fallen ill, leaving the island almost deserted.
threads.quote: Chouji: Some moved north, others went south, and no one's come back yet... It's so quiet now.

threads.claim: Chouji wants to leave Yashiori Island, a desire that will drive the story.
threads.quote: Chouji: I wanna leave this island.

threads.claim: Chouji is saving Mora to leave the island, but the only route out is limited.
threads.quote: Chouji: I'm working hard to save money so that I can leave Yashiori Island, try more delicious food, and make yummy dishes for more people!

introduced.name: Geri
introduced.how: client who commissions dishes from the Traveler and asks for them in set quantities
introduced.quote: Geri: Yes, that's my commission. Have you brought me two Sweet Madames?

introduced.name: Sweet Madame
introduced.how: a dish Geri commissions, requested as two servings
introduced.quote: Geri: Yes, that's my commission. Have you brought me two Sweet Madames?

introduced.name: Flaming Red Bolognese
introduced.how: a dish Geri commissions, requested as two servings
introduced.quote: Geri: Oh right, you must've seen my commission then. Have you prepared two dishes of Flaming Red Bolognese?

introduced.name: Radish Veggie Soup
introduced.how: a dish Geri commissions, requested as three bowls
introduced.quote: Geri: Yes, that's my commission. Have you already prepared three bowls of Radish Veggie Soup?

introduced.name: Tea Break Pancake
introduced.how: a dish Geri commissions, requested as two servings
introduced.quote: Geri: Ah yes, that would be my commission. Have you already prepared two Tea Break Pancakes?

assumed.name: Zhongyuan Chop Suey
assumed.quote: Geri: I will savor every bite... And do my darnedest to forget that Zhongyuan Chop Suey!

assumed.name: Almond Tofu
assumed.quote: Geri: Oh right, I'll need some more Almond Tofu to compare the tastes.

threads.claim: Geri recalls these dishes from her past and wants the cooked versions to match her memory of them.
threads.quote: Geri: Oh, that aroma... It's just as I remembered it.

threads.claim: Geri has lost track of how long it has been since she last tasted some of these dishes.
threads.quote: Geri: I can't even remember the last time I had Flaming Red Bolognese.

threads.claim: Geri has gone a long time without eating Tea Break Pancakes and is eager to have them again.
threads.quote: Geri: Please remember to bring them to me as soon as they're. It's been quite some time since I've had Tea Break Pancakes...

threads.claim: Geri has a sister, who she thinks would also enjoy the soup.
threads.quote: Geri: Alright, well bring them to me as soon as they're ready. I'm sure my sister would like to have some, too.

introduced.name: Varsha
introduced.how: a lone girl who says she lives alone in the forest and wants to go her own way
introduced.quote: My name's Varsha...

introduced.name: Vimara Village
introduced.how: a village where the Aranara take kidnapped kids back
introduced.quote: The Aranara are the ones who take the kidnapped kids back to Vimara Village.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: forest spirits, a species that saved Varsha
introduced.quote: And believe it or not, the "forest spirit" that saved you is from a species called Aranara.

introduced.name: Aranakula
introduced.how: an Aranara who tends the garden with Arakara
introduced.quote: It's Aranakula and Arakara who tend to this garden together.

introduced.name: Arakara
introduced.how: an Aranara who tends the garden with Aranakula
introduced.quote: It's Aranakula and Arakara who tend to this garden together.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: the Aranara's forest home, where the garden is and where it is safe
introduced.quote: Vanarana is not actually dangerous, but are you sure you don't want to go back to Gandharva Ville?

introduced.name: Viparyas
introduced.how: plants that sprout in the garden once the land remembers them
introduced.quote: According to Aranakula, Vanarana remembers everything, so the Viparyas can sprout in the garden once the land remembers them again.

introduced.name: Sweet Flower
introduced.how: a wild plant that can be grown from seeds for food
introduced.quote: Starshrooms, Sweet Flowers, and Mints are everywhere, and I eat like a bird anyway.

introduced.name: Planting Viparyas for the Aranara
introduced.how: Paimon and the Traveler previously helped the Aranara plant Viparyas
introduced.quote: We know this, 'cause we've helped plant many Viparyas for them.

introduced.name: Varsha's kidnapping
introduced.how: a man from Vimara Village tried to take Varsha away earlier
introduced.quote: Some bad guy tried to take me away earlier... But it's okay.

assumed.name: Gandharva Ville
assumed.quote: Anyway, I am much happier now than when I was in Gandharva Ville, and I don't get beaten...

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Varsha, optional)

assumed.name: All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Varsha, optional)

assumed.name: The Viparyas of Vanarana
assumed.quote: (If The Viparyas of Vanarana has not been completed)

assumed.name: Fungi
assumed.quote: Traveler: Running into dangerous Fungi.

assumed.name: Nara Marana
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah! And villains such as Nara Marana. Ugh, no, Paimon meant to say...

threads.claim: A man from Vimara Village may be connected to the kidnappings in the forest, and this is left unresolved.
threads.quote: (That said, could "that guy from Vimara Village" refer to...)

threads.claim: The Aranara are shown returning kidnapped children to Vimara Village, adding to the kidnapping mystery.
threads.quote: The Aranara are the ones who take the kidnapped kids back to Vimara Village.

threads.claim: The small creature that rescued Varsha is suspected to be a forest spirit, which is an open question.
threads.quote: Some small creature whisked me to this place. I've never seen something this small in Gandharva Ville, so I believe that it had to be a forest spirit.

threads.claim: The forest spirit that saved Varsha is revealed to be an Aranara.
threads.quote: And believe it or not, the "forest spirit" that saved you is from a species called Aranara.

threads.claim: Vanarana is said to remember everything, so the land can bring back what it once remembered.
threads.quote: According to Aranakula, Vanarana remembers everything, so the Viparyas can sprout in the garden once the land remembers them again.

threads.claim: Varsha wishes bread could regrow, hinting at her past hunger and the scarcity she has faced.
threads.quote: If bread could break in half and grow back again, no one would ever go hungry...

threads.claim: Varsha's past with adults who harmed her is left unexplained and drives her decision to move on alone.
threads.quote: I can't rely on adults. I must go my own way...

threads.claim: Varsha dreams of a garden full of Sweet Flowers as a paradise, which may or may not exist.
threads.quote: Haha, a garden full of Sweet Flowers... Wouldn't that be paradise?

threads.claim: The garden full of Sweet Flowers that Varsha imagined is shown to really exist.
threads.quote: Traveler: There really is a garden full of Sweet Flowers.

introduced.name: Glory
introduced.how: a requester who asks the Traveler for Dandelion Seeds and thanks them with a gift
introduced.quote: Ah, did you come over to help after seeing my request? Thank you so much...

assumed.name: Dandelion Seeds
assumed.quote: Have you brought the Dandelion Seeds.

threads.claim: Glory's wishes are said to travel on the wind, hinting at a wish-sending practice or belief.
threads.quote: May my wishes travel well with the wind...

introduced.name: Hanfeng
introduced.how: a craftsman who posted a commission for Iron Chunks and is waiting on the Traveler to deliver them
introduced.quote: Oh, hello! It's been ages since I last saw a youngster like you around these parts.

introduced.name: Iron Chunk
introduced.how: a material the Traveler must bring Hanfeng in quantities of ten to fix his tool
introduced.quote: So, have you brought me ten Iron Chunks?

introduced.name: Hanfeng's tool
introduced.how: a broken tool that needs Iron Chunks to be repaired before Hanfeng can continue his work
introduced.quote: These Iron Chunks should be just enough to fix my tool.

assumed.name: Hanfeng's commission for Iron Chunks
assumed.quote: Right, right... the commission I posted.

introduced.name: Earnshaw
introduced.how: Lanoire's grandfather who raised her and is frightened of Caterpillar
introduced.quote: Lanoire: And Grandpa made a big and sweet birthday cake for me, too!

introduced.name: Lanoire
introduced.how: a young girl abducted by a hilichurl who recently left the Fortress of Meropide and is fond of Caterpillar
introduced.quote: Lanoire: Oh, right! You know, Cater, I didn't realize how big the world was until I left the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: a mysterious figure who warns Lanoire that look-alikes are dangerous and is a former Kids Team member
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: Lanoire, you must remember what I'm about to tell you: If you ever come across someone who looks like me, do not approach them.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a place Lanoire lived in before setting out into the wider world
introduced.quote: Lanoire: Oh, right! You know, Cater, I didn't realize how big the world was until I left the Fortress of Meropide.

introduced.name: Hero
introduced.how: a companion animal who sleeps beside Lanoire and Earnshaw
introduced.quote: Lanoire: Also, Hero always looks up at me and Grandpa when he's lying next to us, and he sometimes kicks stuff with his hind legs when he's sleeping. It's so funny!

introduced.name: The Apprentice and the Little Fish
introduced.how: a fable Caterpillar tells about a foolish apprentice who searches the ocean for a little fish and finally finds it
introduced.quote: Caterpillar: The foolish apprentice plucked up the courage to bid farewell to the great mage, left the workshop, and embarked on a journey to find the little fish.

assumed.name: Kids Team
assumed.quote: Caterpillar: Haha, it's nothing. I just feel like the last time the members of the Kids Team got together was... a long, long time ago.

assumed.name: Hilichurl
assumed.quote: Earnshaw: It's Lanoire, she... she's been abducted by a hilichurl!

assumed.name: Caterpillar's human transformation
assumed.quote: Paimon: Well, considering his appearance... Caterpillar, why didn't you want to transform into a human, y'know, like before?

assumed.name: Estienne
assumed.quote: Lanoire: Oh, and the flowers that Estienne gave me? There are so many of them outside. But those flowers have roots that firmly grow into the ground. Why is that?

assumed.name: Prince and Princess
assumed.quote: Lanoire: But why did you bring me here, Cater? That was weird, not to mention how Grandpa Earnshaw was scared when he saw you. Even Hero, Prince, and Princess were scared!

assumed.name: Charlene
assumed.quote: Charlene: It's fine, as long as she's okay...

threads.claim: Caterpillar can take human form but refuses to, and his appearance frightens people, so he warns Lanoire to avoid look-alikes.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: It's not that I don't want to. It's just...

threads.claim: Caterpillar does not know his real birthday and only knows the day he woke up, hinting at an unexplained origin.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: Ahaha, I think we can skip the cake. I don't even know my birthday, just the day I woke up.

threads.claim: Caterpillar seems to be hiding something dangerous or painful and cuts off his own thanks mid-sentence.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: ...Thank you, Lanoire. It's because—

threads.claim: Caterpillar regrets failing someone in the past and wants to make amends, though the fable suggests he may be forgiven.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: "After finally seeing you again, I realized how selfish I have been... I thought that if I could apologize to you in person, I could forgive my past self."

threads.claim: The Kids Team was a group whose members last gathered long ago, and Caterpillar was once part of it.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: Haha, it's nothing. I just feel like the last time the members of the Kids Team got together was... a long, long time ago.

threads.claim: Lanoire promises to find Caterpillar again and share stories and cake, setting up a future reunion.
threads.quote: Lanoire: I'll find you, and then I'll tell you tons of stories! Then, I'll make you the biggest, yummiest birthday cake ever.

threads.claim: Lanoire is amazed by the vastness and strangeness of the outside world, and she has questions about nature she cannot yet answer.
threads.quote: Lanoire: This world is so big and strange, and there are so many different colors of light.

threads.claim: The apprentice persistently searches the ocean and finally finds the little fish, who forgives him and becomes his friend.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: When he found it, the little fish was swimming freely in the water with its family amidst an ever-shifting school of fish.

threads.claim: Caterpillar argues that a good story must end at the right place, and that stories refusing to end become bad.
threads.quote: Caterpillar: Mm-hmm, that's the end of my story. If a good story doesn't end in the right place, it will lose the fun. Heroes will become evil dragons.

introduced.name: Fedhri
introduced.how: Self-introduced as the keeper in charge of the Amrita Pool who has not left the Oasis since Lady Zurvan sealed it
introduced.quote: I'm in charge of looking after the Amrita Pool. I have not set foot outside this place since Lady Zurvan sealed the Oasis.

introduced.name: Amrita Pool
introduced.how: Where the Pari were granted life and where memories are received, fed by primordial water from their god
introduced.quote: The Amrita Pool is where we Pari were granted life. In it flows the primordial water left behind by our god.

introduced.name: Vourukasha Oasis
introduced.how: The Oasis where humans and Pari once built homes together and that the Pari still guard
introduced.quote: We Pari used to walk with humans, and we would both build our homes in this Vourukasha Oasis.

introduced.name: Pari
introduced.how: A people who once lived alongside humans in the Oasis and were granted life by the Amrita Pool
introduced.quote: We Pari used to walk with humans, and we would both build our homes in this Vourukasha Oasis.

introduced.name: Khvarena
introduced.how: Motes that gain power and life through the Amrita and become familiars that can return to the sea of flowers
introduced.quote: It's all thanks to the Amrita that countless motes of Khvarena have gained power and life.

introduced.name: Harvisptokhm
introduced.how: The destination where Khvarena memories return through the Amrita Pool and that protects the Oasis
introduced.quote: And memories that belong to the Khvarena will return to the Harvisptokhm through the Amrita Pool.

introduced.name: Plumes of Purifying Light
introduced.how: What Pari become after exhausting their strength, leaving only pure memories behind
introduced.quote: We will turn into Plumes of Purifying Light after exhausting our strength, leaving behind nothing but pure memories.

introduced.name: Offerer

introduced.quote: Home of the adepti, shiny golden Cor Lapis, light blue Noctilucous Jade, the works...

threads.claim: Hiromi's childhood friend is missing and has not answered his letters.
threads.quote: However, she still hasn't responded.

threads.quote: She doesn't know a Hiromi.

threads.quote: I was worried about her safety, so I started putting letters into drifting bottles in hopes that she'd receive them.

threads.quote: Yes! And that time in Qingce, too... that...!

threads.claim: The rescued Tanuki that ate heavily may be linked to the strange Atsuko who appears in the house.
threads.quote: I wonder what happened to the Tanuki that we rescued before.

threads.claim: Inazuma's Vision Hunt Decree has made life there so oppressive that people like Atsuko flee abroad.
threads.quote: After they issued the Vision Hunt Decree, the atmosphere in Inazuma has become increasingly suffocating.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki

introduced.quote: These stones emit a faint light upon absorbing kuuvahki. The kuuhenki are quite fond of them.

introduced.quote: Where am I... Mommy... I wanna go home...

introduced.name: Moon-shaped rock

introduced.quote: use the ores to create guidance to the path

assumed.quote: These stones emit a faint light upon absorbing kuuvahki.

introduced.name: Effendi

introduced.quote: Effendi is a man of his word. A commission there really helped me out.

introduced.name: Housein

introduced.quote: If I round out my spice business, we'll be business partners.

assumed.name: Harra Fruits
assumed.quote: Here are the Harra Fruits you wanted.

assumed.name: commission at Effendi's
assumed.quote: Ah, saw my commission at Mr. Effendi's, did you?

threads.quote: If I round out my spice business, we'll be business partners.

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: a researcher studying The Chasm's geology who wants to outdo the Akademiya's research goals and offers payment for academic findings
introduced.quote: Khedive: What a curious geological environment we're in now! I'm sure I can outdo the research goals set by the Akademiya this year.

introduced.name: Geovishap
introduced.how: a water-loving creature in The Chasm that grows stronger by feeding on Hydro-rich waterweeds and can use Hydro
introduced.quote: The Geovishap — and other water-loving creatures in The Chasm, too — has increased its power by feeding on these waterweeds that are rich in Hydro.

introduced.name: Hydro energy
introduced.how: an elemental energy that can be sensed as a concentration within objects and that powers the Strange Object's activation
introduced.quote: Khedive: Let me check. Mm, I can sense an incredibly high concentration of Hydro energy within it.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a place whose groundwater holds unusually rich elemental power that feeds growths like the waterweeds
introduced.quote: Khedive: The groundwater in The Chasm does contain unusually rich elemental power. Does that have anything to do with things like this growing within it?

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Khedive: What a curious geological environment we're in now! I'm sure I can outdo the research goals set by the Akademiya this year.

assumed.name: Anisa
assumed.quote: Khedive: Is it normal for people to come across this kind of stuff while fishing? Anisa never misses a single day fishing on Watatsumi Island, but she's never discovered anything special.

assumed.name: the legendary figure referenced by Khedive
assumed.quote: Khedive: You must've taken it out too quickly to notice its special trait. How impressive, as expected of the legendary .

threads.quote: Khedive: It could turn into sentient elemental beings one day. You know what? This would make a fine research topic.

threads.claim: Khedive hypothesizes that the Geovishap can use Hydro because it feeds on Hydro-rich waterweeds.

threads.claim: The groundwater in The Chasm contains dense Hydro energy that nurtures special waterweeds in high-concentration spots.

threads.claim: Khedive alludes to a legendary figure whose name is left blank, hinting at an unrevealed identity.
threads.quote: Khedive: You must've taken it out too quickly to notice its special trait. How impressive, as expected of the legendary .

introduced.name: Aberaku
introduced.how: Self-introduced as Helios-Forger, the creator of the Helios and the Dainichi Mikoshi, imprisoned in the ruins
introduced.quote: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

introduced.name: Helios
introduced.how: Aberaku's private name for his creation, which is the Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.quote: Ah, right. Helios is what I called my creation in private.

introduced.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: A solar chariot built by Aberaku that drives the Hyperion and brings cyclical day and night to Byakuyakoku
introduced.quote: Helios is the Dainichi Mikoshi, the solar chariot that drives the Hyperion.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: The land where Aberaku's soul was scattered and where the Dainichi Mikoshi stands in perpetual night
introduced.quote: After my death, my soul was shattered across the land of Byakuyakoku

introduced.name: The Narrows
introduced.how: One of three places where Aberaku's clothes, crown, and bones are hidden
introduced.quote: You can find them in The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: Evernight Temple
introduced.how: One of three places where Aberaku's remains are hidden
introduced.quote: You can find them in The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: The Serpent's Heart
introduced.how: One of three places where Aberaku's remains are hidden
introduced.quote: You can find them in The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and the Serpent's Heart.

introduced.name: Dragonheirs of the Depths
introduced.how: Former enemies who ruled through fear in the darkness until the Dainichi Mikoshi's light drove them off
introduced.quote: When Dainichi Mikoshi was built, the Dragonheirs were defeated, repelled by a light that they were unused to.

introduced.name: Sunchild
introduced.how: An infant chosen to be a ruler in name, used as a puppet by villains who manipulate them
introduced.quote: There will always be a young infant chosen to be the Sunchild.

introduced.name: Divine Bridle
introduced.how: A bridle that proves someone is a child of the sun, hidden by Aberaku and given to the Traveler
introduced.quote: This bridle is the proof that one is indeed a child of the sun.

introduced.name: Byakuya name origin and building of the Dainichi Mikoshi
introduced.how: Aberaku organized the construction of the Mikoshi, which gave Byakuyakoku day and night and its name
introduced.quote: Back then, it was I who organized the construction of the Dainichi Mikoshi

introduced.name: Aberaku's imprisonment
introduced.how: Aberaku was put under house arrest and then imprisoned above his creation by the Sunchild's regime after opposing it
introduced.quote: I was placed under house arrest, and imprisoned above my own creation.

introduced.name: Veil of ever-night
introduced.how: Closed spaces hidden above the Dainichi Mikoshi in an everlasting night veil, reachable once the Mikoshi is opened
introduced.quote: Then you will be able to travel above the Dainichi Mikoshi, into the closed spaces hidden in the veil of ever-night.

assumed.name: Hyperion
assumed.quote: Helios is the Dainichi Mikoshi, the solar chariot that drives the Hyperion.

threads.claim: Aberaku has lost a memory of something very important high above the Dainichi Mikoshi.
