threads.claim: Aberaku's soul is made whole and he recovers all his memories after the offerings are placed.
threads.quote: Thanks to you, my soul has become whole, and I now recall everything. Incredible.

threads.claim: Sunchildren are used as puppets and never reach maturity, because grown people are harder to sway.
threads.quote: And that is why no Sunchild has ever reached maturity. For it is as you say: grown people are not so easily swayed by villains.

threads.claim: A prophecy says the Sunchild will ride on Pegasus to the feast of the sun during their birth rites.
threads.quote: The hallowed Sunchild, their birth-rite begun, on Pegasus shall ride to the feast of the sun.

threads.claim: Aberaku hid the bridle in the hope of someday exposing the Sunchild rulers to the people.
threads.quote: I hid it here, thinking to someday hand it over and alert the people...

threads.claim: Aberaku gives the Divine Bridle to the Traveler as a gift.
threads.quote: Guest from afar, I now give the bridle into your hands.

threads.claim: The Dragonheirs of the Depths were defeated by the light of the Dainichi Mikoshi.
threads.quote: When Dainichi Mikoshi was built, the Dragonheirs were defeated, repelled by a light that they were unused to.

threads.claim: Aberaku believes human greed and desire were the true all-devouring night that cannot be dispelled by the Mikoshi's light.
threads.quote: I did not then know that it was the greed and desire within human hearts that was the all-devouring night everlasting.

threads.claim: Aberaku was imprisoned by the Sunchild's regime for opposing their control.
threads.quote: I wanted to oppose this, but I was accused of high treason by the Sunchild under their control and imprisoned here.

threads.claim: Closed spaces hidden in the veil of ever-night lie above the Dainichi Mikoshi and can be reached once it is opened.
threads.quote: Then you will be able to travel above the Dainichi Mikoshi, into the closed spaces hidden in the veil of ever-night.

introduced.name: Adepti
introduced.how: Adepti are beings who create private, sealed abodes for themselves
introduced.quote: I do not know if I told you before, but these abodes are private spaces created by the adepti for themselves.

introduced.name: Abode
introduced.how: Private realms that adepti seal off from the outside world to keep them pure and undisturbed
introduced.quote: Most adepti will use certain methods to seal their abode away from the rest of the world to ensure its purity and avoid being disturbed.

introduced.name: Realm Dispatch
introduced.how: A dispatch adepti make to invite others into an abode; its holder can enter and exit freely
introduced.quote: This Realm Dispatch bears signatures of the abode's adeptal energy and that of the adeptus themselves.

assumed.name: Madame Ping
assumed.quote: Ah yes. I heard Ping mention that you have made friends in a great many places.

assumed.name: Traveler's abode
assumed.quote: Before, this abode was in an incomplete, embryonic state.

assumed.name: Past requests from Tubby
assumed.quote: You're not going to ask me for help with something again, are you...

threads.claim: Inviting someone with the dispatch leaves the Traveler's energy signature on them, and Tubby's odd reaction hints at an unexplained method.
threads.quote: Huh? Well, sort of? But why did you have to put it so weirdly...

threads.claim: The Traveler's abode was once incomplete and embryonic and is now becoming fully functional.
threads.quote: Before, this abode was in an incomplete, embryonic state.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a gang of outlaws who ambush travelers to rob them
introduced.quote: (The camera, viewing from the Traveler's perspective, switches between two Treasure Hoarders as they talk)

introduced.name: Jingle
introduced.how: one of two brothers, a robber who once trained as an apprentice
introduced.quote: Jingle: Hmm. Well, I suppose we've just met, so you probably haven't heard about our story.

introduced.name: Havisham
introduced.how: Jingle's brother, a robber who was also dismissed from the Court
introduced.quote: Havisham: They said we didn't work hard enough.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: an institution in Fontaine where Jingle and Havisham were apprentices until they were dismissed
introduced.quote: We used to be apprentices in the Court of Fontaine, but then we got kicked out. Do you know why?

introduced.name: Rouge
introduced.how: the Seemingly Craven Redhead, a vigilante who goes by a codename
introduced.quote: Rouge: Name? It's just a codename, but you may call me Rouge.

introduced.name: Bleu
introduced.how: one of Rouge's allies who follows Rouge's orders
introduced.quote: Bleu: Boss, what should we do with them?

introduced.name: Blanc
introduced.how: one of Rouge's allies who says they only target criminals
introduced.quote: Blanc: We only target bad guys, like these two here.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: a law enforcement group that pursues justice by methods Rouge disagrees with
introduced.quote: Redhead: Unfortunately for me, that's not the case. I don't agree with the things they do in pursuit of justice... but at least it is justice that they're after.

introduced.name: hearing thoughts
introduced.how: the Traveler and Paimon can hear what people are really thinking behind their words
introduced.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks Paimon's hearing it as well! Whoa! Paimon's a mind reader now!

assumed.name: Free Verse
assumed.quote: (If Free Verse was completed)

assumed.name: Penny
assumed.quote: Paimon: Rouge... We've heard that name before, from Penny!

threads.claim: Rouge suggests the Traveler and Paimon can hear the true thoughts behind spoken words, and the source of this ability is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Redhead: You must listen carefully, not only with your ears, but with your head, too.

threads.claim: Rouge confirms that the robbers' spoken promises were lies and that their real intent was revealed by hearing their thoughts.
threads.quote: Redhead: They have already committed terrible crimes here in the past.

threads.claim: Rouge believes the laws of Fontaine may fail to punish greedy criminals, so Rouge will act as an unofficial enforcer of justice.
threads.quote: Rouge: If the laws of Fontaine cannot ensure that they receive the punishment they deserve, then I will.

threads.claim: Rouge says Rouge has like-minded allies working together on the same cause.
threads.quote: Rouge: Fortunately, I'm not alone on this path, and there are like-minded people by my side.

threads.claim: Penny has spoken to the Traveler and Paimon about Rouge, linking Rouge to an earlier storyline.
threads.quote: Rouge: You know Penny? She's spoken to you about me? What a coincidence.

threads.claim: Jingle and Havisham were once apprentices at the Court of Fontaine and were dismissed, which may explain their turn to crime.
threads.quote: We used to be apprentices in the Court of Fontaine, but then we got kicked out. Do you know why?

threads.claim: Rouge disagrees with the Maison Gardiennage's methods but considers their pursuit of justice to be genuine.
threads.quote: Redhead: Unfortunately for me, that's not the case. I don't agree with the things they do in pursuit of justice... but at least it is justice that they're after.

introduced.name: Alrani
introduced.how: A scholar from Sumeru researching Inazuma for a paper, introducing herself
introduced.quote: Hello! I'm Alrani, a scholar from Sumeru. I'm doing research on Inazuma for an academic paper.

introduced.name: Visions and elemental powers
introduced.how: Visions are linked to elemental powers, and someone without a Vision can still use elements
introduced.quote: you were a special example of someone who does not have a Vision but could still use the power of the elements.

introduced.name: Dvalin
introduced.how: The Dragon of the East, one of the Four Winds of Mondstadt, suddenly attacked Mondstadt
introduced.quote: The Dragon of the East, Dvalin, who should be one of The Four Winds of Mondstadt, had suddenly started attacking the city of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Geo Archon
introduced.how: Liyue's Geo Archon is diligent, personally guards Liyue Harbor, and guides its development
introduced.quote: I thought that since the Geo Archon in Liyue is so diligent, and personally guards Liyue Harbor, and also helps to guide its overall development...

introduced.name: Outlander Affairs Agency
introduced.how: An Inazuman agency wary of outlanders that issues permits and must be consulted for research
introduced.quote: The Outlander Affairs Agency is wary of outlanders like us, so remember to be a bit more restrained while you're doing your research.

introduced.name: Kanjou Commission
introduced.how: Kanjou Commissioners are visibly tense, a sign that Inazuma's situation is bad
introduced.quote: But judging by how tense the Kanjou Commissioners are, the situation can't be good.

introduced.name: Ritou
introduced.how: A checkpoint where outlanders need a permit to enter Inazuma
introduced.quote: See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

introduced.name: Kaede
introduced.how: Owner of the shop Eipekkusu, hostile to researchers and suspicious of outsiders
introduced.quote: Investigating us at a time like this? So suspicious...

introduced.name: Eipekkusu
introduced.how: A shop in Inazuma run by Kaede, a stop on the recording trip
introduced.quote: Let's start with this one called Eipekkusu.

introduced.name: Vahid
introduced.how: An outlander businessman in Inazuma who sells fertilizer and advises on permits
introduced.quote: Although I'm in the fertilizer business, I don't know much about these fertilizers.

introduced.name: Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe
introduced.how: Vahid's fertilizer shop, a place Alrani records
introduced.quote: After taking a photo of Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe and its owner, Vahid

introduced.name: Obata
introduced.how: A fisherman at the wharf who questions Alrani's permit and suspects her research
introduced.quote: Research? I'm a fisherman. What's there to research?

introduced.name: Kageyama
introduced.how: An inspector with the Outlander Affairs Agency who handles outlander affairs
introduced.quote: She is an inspector with the Agency. She'd know how to handle your affairs.

introduced.name: Fertilizers
introduced.how: Vahid's fertilizer products, whose special traits he struggles to explain persuasively
introduced.quote: When people ask me about the special characteristics of these fertilizers, I can only refer to the instructions that came with the packaging.

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: A past decree against Visions in Inazuma that is no longer in force
introduced.quote: Which might've actually been considered an advantage, if the Vision Hunt Decree were still in force.

assumed.name: Sayid
assumed.quote: I specifically went to Mondstadt to consult with Mr. Sayid, but he didn't know the reason either

assumed.name: Four Winds
assumed.quote: I wanted to go to Mondstadt to collect data and write a paper about life in Mondstadt and The Four Winds.

assumed.name: Morax
assumed.quote: And then— and then, Morax suddenly... Ohh...

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: So I wrote up the first draft and sent it to the Akademiya for my tutor to review

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: even when I was captured by the Treasure Hoarders and pressed for the whereabouts of the treasure

assumed.name: Gonshirou
assumed.quote: I heard from Gonshirou that this kind of behavior should be reported to the Agency first, right?

assumed.name: Omnipresence Over Mortals
assumed.quote: (If the player has not completed Omnipresence Over Mortals)

threads.claim: Dvalin, a Four Winds dragon, suddenly attacked Mondstadt for reasons nobody yet understands.
threads.quote: The Dragon of the East, Dvalin, who should be one of The Four Winds of Mondstadt, had suddenly started attacking the city of Mondstadt.

threads.claim: Morax, the Geo Archon, was involved in some sudden incident affecting Liyue that remains unexplained.
threads.quote: And then— and then, Morax suddenly... Ohh...

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree once applied in Inazuma but has since been lifted, changing the situation for outlanders and Visions.
threads.quote: Which might've actually been considered an advantage, if the Vision Hunt Decree were still in force.

threads.claim: Inazuma's situation is tense, and any Outlander Affairs Agency involvement could make it impossible to resolve peacefully.
threads.quote: The current situation in Inazuma is such that, if the Outlander Affairs Agency got involved, there would be no way to resolve things peacefully.

threads.claim: Some people without a Vision can still wield elemental power, and the Traveler is cited as an example.
threads.quote: you were a special example of someone who does not have a Vision but could still use the power of the elements.

introduced.name: Feronov
introduced.how: Fatui agent who confronts the Traveler on the tower's lowest floor
introduced.quote: Feronov: What—! Y—You, where did you come from!?

introduced.name: Pate de Fruit Station
introduced.how: monitoring station whose data is recorded on punched tape
introduced.quote: Paimon: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from the Pate de Fruit Station!

introduced.name: Crepes Suzette Station
introduced.how: monitoring station whose data is recorded on punched tape
introduced.quote: Paimon: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!

introduced.name: Punched tape
introduced.how: paper tape holding monitoring data that needs specialized machinery to decode
introduced.quote: Punched tape retrieved from the tower near to the Fontaine Research Institute. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

introduced.name: Research Terminal
introduced.how: console with a lever that releases punched tape, found in towers like this one
introduced.quote: Paimon: Huh? It's a console just like the one in that other tower from before...

assumed.name: Malinovskyi
assumed.quote: Voice from Downstairs: Blast it all! He's gonna annoy us to death! That is, if we haven't been killed already... We should have gone with Captain Malinovskyi!

assumed.name: Shumilov
assumed.quote: Notebook: ...I placed the last on the first floor. If this one disappears too, then whoever was responsible for patrolling that day is going to have to report it to Shumilov themselves...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: (Listen, , it's the Fatui!)

assumed.name: Broglie
assumed.quote: Paimon: , let's go back to Broglie now!

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: Punched tape retrieved from the tower near to the Fontaine Research Institute. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

threads.claim: Fatui agents have taken over the tower and are waiting inside to ambush the Traveler.
threads.quote: Feronov: What—! Y—You, where did you come from!?

threads.claim: The punched tape holds monitoring data whose contents remain unknown to the party.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm... Paimon doesn't have a clue what's on this stuff, but it looks pretty important...

threads.claim: Tapes from the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations are combined to give the party more monitoring data.
threads.quote: Paimon: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!

threads.claim: The lever marked Do NOT touch is dangerous, and the Traveler is warned not to touch it.
threads.quote: Traveler: We probably shouldn't touch it...

introduced.name: 34th Independent Investigative Squad
introduced.how: a military squad deployed to Mont Esus whose orders lay out its camps, members and discipline rules
introduced.quote: 34th Independent Investigative Squad Directive 12: Mont Esus (Eastern Quadrant) Deployment Plan

introduced.name: Mont Esus (Eastern Quadrant)
introduced.how: the eastern quadrant of Mont Esus where the squad is stationed around an observation tower
introduced.quote: 34th Independent Investigative Squad Deployment in Mont Esus (Eastern Quadrant) Deployment Plan

introduced.name: Camp 1
introduced.how: a squad camp behind the observation tower that guards supply routes
introduced.quote: Located behind the observation tower. Purpose: To safeguard logistical routes, guaranteeing the safe transport of supplies.

introduced.name: Shumilov
introduced.how: the squad's deputy captain, a second lieutenant who enforces strict meal rules and fights the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Second Lieutenant A.M. Shumilov

introduced.name: Malinovskyi
introduced.how: the squad's lieutenant/captain who went to supervise the northeastern observation tower and is missed by the squad
introduced.quote: Ever since Lieutenant Malinovskyi went to supervise the northeastern observation tower, the squad has become remiss with their discipline.

introduced.name: Maison Gardiennage
introduced.how: an authority that arrests people, and being arrested by it would land soldiers in the Fortress of Meropide
introduced.quote: we should just find some excuse to get arrested by the Maison Gardiennage.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: a place where arrested people are held, described as a soft detention
introduced.quote: That way, we'd have two easy days living at the Fortress of Meropide

introduced.name: Punched Tape
introduced.how: waterproof paper tape holding recorded data that only specialized machinery can decode
introduced.quote: Punched tape made out of special waterproof material. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

introduced.name: Research Terminal
introduced.how: a console with a lever that has a warning memo attached, which dispenses punched tape when pulled
introduced.quote: There's a memo stuck next to the lever on the right side of the console.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey! It's the Fatui! Why are there Fatui here?

assumed.name: In Search of Lost Time: North
assumed.quote: (If both In Search of Lost Time: North and In Search of Lost Time: South have been completed)

assumed.name: In Search of Lost Time: South
assumed.quote: (If both In Search of Lost Time: North and In Search of Lost Time: South have been completed)

assumed.name: Pate de Fruit Station
assumed.quote: Paimon: All that's left now is the Pate de Fruit Station. Let's go, !

assumed.name: Crepes Suzette Station
assumed.quote: Paimon: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!

assumed.name: Broglie
assumed.quote: Paimon: , let's go back to Broglie now!

threads.claim: Fatui are stationed at the Mont Esus tower, which Paimon finds unexpected and which raises the question of why they are there.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmph, looks like there are Fatui stationed here too...

threads.claim: The squad's discipline has slipped since Malinovskyi left, and the soldiers keep wishing for his return.
threads.quote: Ever since Lieutenant Malinovskyi went to supervise the northeastern observation tower, the squad has become remiss with their discipline.

threads.claim: Punched tapes hold data that can only be read with specialized machinery, which the party does not yet have.
threads.quote: The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

threads.claim: Monitoring data from the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations is collected from the towers' consoles.
threads.quote: Paimon: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: adventurers find and rescue victims, then watch monster activity beyond the city and scout early
introduced.quote: At first, they were helping find and rescue victims in the city, more recently they've been keeping watch on monster activity further afield.

introduced.name: monster barricades
introduced.how: monsters built many barricades outside the city during their raids and they will not disappear on their own
introduced.quote: The monsters erected quite a substantial number of barricades outside the city over the course of their raids.

introduced.name: monster raids on the city
introduced.how: monster bands kept attacking the city continuously during the Stormterror incident
introduced.quote: we faced continuous attacks from bands of monsters for the entire duration of the Stormterror incident.

assumed.name: Stormterror incident
assumed.quote: Although the Stormterror incident is now resolved, and we've successfully fended off the monsters...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Spoken like a true member of the Knights of Favonius!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: As our Honorary Knight, would you be willing to clear up the barricades?

assumed.name: Cyrus
assumed.quote: I must make time to thank Cyrus properly...

threads.claim: The monsters' barricades hint at a larger, long-prepared master plan behind the monster attacks.
threads.quote: Not long enough, clearly! The last traces of their big master plan are disappearing right before Paimon's very eyes!

threads.claim: The Stormterror incident is officially resolved, but its aftermath, including monster debris, still lingers in the city.
threads.quote: Although the Stormterror incident is now resolved, and we've successfully fended off the monsters...

introduced.name: Iris (Dragonspine Adventurer Camp)
introduced.how: Camp contact who knows the mountain's dangers and sends expeditions up Dragonspine
introduced.quote: This is a sticky situation, indeed...

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: A dangerous mountain near Mondstadt that expeditions must prepare for before climbing
introduced.quote: Make sure you prepare yourself sufficiently before heading up Dragonspine, you hear?

introduced.name: unmeltable ice
introduced.how: Strange ice that is very hard to break, won't melt in fire, and blocks roads and expeditions
introduced.quote: It is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire.

introduced.name: ice barricades
introduced.how: Ice walls that have forced expedition teams to turn back when they cannot be bypassed
introduced.quote: Quite a few of our expedition teams have been forced to turn back after being blocked by ice barricades that they could not get around.

introduced.name: blue plants
introduced.how: Blue plants that grow often near the strange ice
introduced.quote: What's more, blue plants are often found growing near this ice.

introduced.name: shards frozen in ice
introduced.how: Shards encased in the ice that rise to the summit once thawed
introduced.quote: All three shards have thawed out and flown up to the top...

introduced.name: summit air current
introduced.how: A cavern near the summit has a strong air current flowing out of it that is unusually powerful
introduced.quote: They couldn't get close enough, but they did they report that a cavern near the summit did have a strange and powerful air current flowing out from it.

introduced.name: summit pillar
introduced.how: A huge pillar floating in midair at the summit, which Iris has not heard of
introduced.quote: There's a strange, huge pillar floating in mid-air at the summit?

assumed.name: Low-Temperature Warning
assumed.quote: (Talk to Iris, after completing Low-Temperature Warning)

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: it's more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Frostbearing Tree
assumed.quote: (A new Frostbearing Tree sprouts out of the ground)

assumed.name: Ruin Guards
assumed.quote: (After unlocking the second mechanism and waking the Ruin Guards)

assumed.name: Warming Seelie
assumed.quote: (Follow the Warming Seelie down into the cavern after defeating the Ruin Guards)

assumed.name: Starglow Cavern
assumed.quote: (Upon entering Starglow Cavern)

assumed.name: Skyfrost Nail
assumed.quote: (Climb to the top of Skyfrost Nail after being restored, optional)

threads.claim: Strange ice on Dragonspine cannot be broken or melted by fire and blocks the roads.
threads.quote: It is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire.

threads.claim: The ice can now be melted, so expeditions can resume exploring the mountain.
threads.quote: Since we've got a way to melt that ice now, that means I can continue organizing expedition parties to explore the mountain...

threads.claim: A cavern near the summit has an air current that is far stronger than it should be, and no one knows why.
threads.quote: But logically speaking, no air current in such a place should be that strong. No one knows the reason why, either...

threads.claim: A shard is frozen inside the ice and may be related to the blue plants growing around it.
threads.quote: I believe that those plants may be related in some way to the shard frozen in the ice.

threads.claim: The thawed shards refreeze at the summit pillar, so the cycle repeats.
threads.quote: Looks like they froze again... Brr, this climate really isn't Paimon-friendly...

threads.claim: A huge pillar floats at the summit and its origin is unknown, possibly falling from the sky.
threads.quote: Paimon has no idea where this pillar might have come from...

threads.claim: There is a huge space hidden beneath the ice under the pillar.
threads.quote: Looks like there's a huge space underneath it, too.

threads.claim: The strong air current, strange ice, and blue plants may be linked, though this is not yet known.
threads.quote: Hahaha, if this was your standard tale of adventure, there would be some link between these three.

threads.claim: Dragonspine hides secrets that the characters have only begun to uncover.
threads.quote: It seems Dragonspine really does have its secrets after all.

introduced.name: Hilichurl towers
introduced.how: tall structures hilichurls use to scout the surrounding area and plan attacks

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: Those tall things look like hilichurl towers to Paimon.

assumed.name: Seymour

threads.quote: Give them some time to sort both their bodies and memories out...

threads.claim: Seymour, Ann and Caterpillar's situation can only be resolved by themselves, not by the Traveler or Paimon.
threads.quote: This is something only they can do for themselves.

introduced.quote: In order to record these things, he wrote something called the travelogue.

introduced.quote: I know that Uncle Ramsay has been staying at the Komore Teahouse.
