introduced.how: a Collective of Plenty member who introduces himself and his companion Nzaya
introduced.quote: I'm Kimosi, from the Collective of Plenty and this... *panting* this is Nzaya...

introduced.name: Nzaya
introduced.how: Kimosi's companion from the Collective of Plenty, introduced alongside him
introduced.quote: I'm Kimosi, from the Collective of Plenty and this... *panting* this is Nzaya...

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: the tribe Kimosi and Nzaya belong to, which reports back to its members
introduced.quote: Haha, for those of us in the Collective of Plenty, we hardly even notice anymore.

introduced.name: Tephric Ruins
introduced.how: an ruin area inside a Remnants site, the scene of recent thefts and Abyssal monsters
introduced.quote: Not far from here is an area containing Remnants of the Secret Source known as the Tephric Ruins... Let me explain...

introduced.name: Remnants of the Secret Source
introduced.how: ancient ruins whose relics are very valuable and were placed in the Tephric Ruins
introduced.quote: The relics inside the ancient Remnants of the Secret Source are incredibly valuable, and they were deliberately placed in this section of ruins...

introduced.name: Qucusaur
introduced.how: creatures that dwell near the ruins and may have carried off a statue
introduced.quote: A witness from our tribe claims they saw one of the Qucusaurs that dwell nearby carrying off a statue from the ruins...

introduced.name: Skyfire Circlet
introduced.how: floating rocks around the volcano crater, climbed to reach the crater's wall
introduced.quote: I'm not sure who came up with that name, but it could do with a bit of work.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a gas whose gaseous state makes rocks float around the crater during eruptions
introduced.quote: Phlogiston's gaseous state causes them to float there during eruptions...

introduced.name: Spiritway
introduced.how: a path formed by a volcanic eruption that leads down near the ruins entrance
introduced.quote: A Spiritway forms, leading down near the entrance of the Tephric Ruins.

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: a disease rooted in Ley Lines that spreads suddenly and recedes slowly, creating monsters
introduced.quote: The Abyss is like a disease rooted in the Ley Lines

introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.how: the lines in which the Abyss is rooted
introduced.quote: The Abyss is like a disease rooted in the Ley Lines

introduced.name: Abyssal corrosion
introduced.how: a past period when the corrosion was at its worst and ruins were ejected from the volcano
introduced.quote: Ah, actually it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Long, long ago... back when Natlan was still a peaceful paradise...

assumed.name: Gosoythoth
assumed.quote: But isn't Gosoythoth already...

assumed.name: Spirited Eruption
assumed.quote: (If the achievement Spirited Eruption has been obtained)

assumed.name: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
assumed.quote: (If Incandescent Ode of Resurrection has been completed)

assumed.name: Tepetlisaurus
assumed.quote: Your Tepetlisaurus friend looks like a remarkable fellow, just like... just like a human.

assumed.name: Dutse
assumed.quote: Uncle? As I recall, I only have one nephew... My goodness, Dutse, look how you've grown!

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: If you took a break every now and then to chat with the couriers from the Scions of the Canopy, you might have a better idea who we're talking to...

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: Didn't you tell me that very few people outside the Flower-Feather Clan have ever made it through...

threads.claim: Kimosi's account of Natlan as a peaceful paradise long ago hints at a fallen past tied to the Abyss.
threads.quote: Ah, actually it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

threads.claim: The Abyssal corrosion is getting worse, as shown by objects recently ejected from the volcano.
threads.quote: And based on the condition of objects recently ejected from the volcano, it's clear that the Abyssal corrosion has gotten worse.

threads.claim: Ruins ejected from the volcano may mean more ruins remain inside it.
threads.quote: Wait a minute... Doesn't that mean there could still be more ruins inside?

threads.claim: A statue from the Tephric Ruins was carried off by a Qucusaur and its whereabouts remain unknown.
threads.quote: I guess it must be missing... We'll just have to look for it later...

threads.claim: Kimosi withholds the way into the volcano until the Traveler proves capable, then reveals it.
threads.quote: But as for the road into the volcano, I won't tell you, and it's not up for debate.

threads.claim: The way into the volcano is to jump through the crater, after climbing the Skyfire Circlet.
threads.quote: The way in is simple, but by no means easy. To cut to the chase, you'll need to jump in through the crater.

threads.claim: Rumors suggest the space inside the volcano is unique and may be beyond the Lord of the Night's reach.
threads.quote: Perhaps even the shadowy hands of the Lord of the Night cannot reach inside...

threads.claim: The Traveler's cut-off remark implies Gosoythoth is already connected to the current Abyss crisis.
threads.quote: But isn't Gosoythoth already...

threads.claim: The volcano erupts repeatedly, and its eruptions form Spiritways that can be used to climb.
threads.quote: Ah! The volcano erupted again. Seriously, every time that happens, Paimon's heart jumps out her chest!

threads.claim: An earlier exploration team was lost inside the volcano, where Abyssal monsters can disguise themselves as people.
threads.quote: Not everyone on the exploration team made it back... I still remember a monster disguising itself as one of my companions in distress...

threads.claim: Rumors about the Traveler's strength have spread among the tribes.
threads.quote: Even stronger than the rumors say.

threads.claim: Nzaya argues that safety matters more than saving time, a theme that recurs through the story.
threads.quote: Safety does come first. It's more important than saving time. In fact, it's way more important than anything else.

introduced.name: Ismenor
introduced.how: an older man who asks the Traveler to share Bulle Fruit and talk while eating
introduced.quote: Ah, my young friend, have you brought any Bulle Fruit? Please, share it with me, and we can eat while we talk.

introduced.name: duelist
introduced.how: an unnamed duelist whose advice about statues Ismenor recalls from his final duel
introduced.quote: A duelist told me so, during the final duel of his life.

assumed.name: Bulle Fruit
assumed.quote: Traveler: About Bulle Fruit...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: I even did as advised, and set aside some Mora to thank you for the Bulle Fruit.

threads.claim: Ismenor's past connection to the duelist and his final duel is hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: Looking at your expression, you seem interested in that duelist? Well, it was a long time ago...

threads.claim: Statues are presented as wordless poems that deserve to be appreciated, a theme of art and its meaning.
threads.quote: Statues are wordless poems, so one shouldn't appreciate them on an empty stomach.

introduced.name: Jahan
introduced.how: a man who ordered sugar for his meals and is receiving a delivery from the Traveler
introduced.quote: Oh, you are here to deliver the Sugar, right?

introduced.name: Sugar
introduced.how: a sweet ingredient Jahan requested in five jars and uses in his meals
introduced.quote: Did you get five jars of Sugar?

assumed.name: Anahitian Blessing
assumed.quote: A combination of abundant sunshine, plenty of rain, and the Anahitian Blessing will guarantee a good harvest.

threads.claim: The Anahitian Blessing is said to guarantee good harvests, but its nature and source are left unexplained.
threads.quote: A combination of abundant sunshine, plenty of rain, and the Anahitian Blessing will guarantee a good harvest.

introduced.name: Atiyah
introduced.how: A recruiter for the Eremites whose job is signing up new members, who pitches the group to the Traveler
introduced.quote: Yes. I mean, it is my job, after all.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: A mercenary group that describes itself as free, united and friendly, and that recruits members for dangerous work
introduced.quote: The Eremites is a good community to be a part of! We're free! We're united! Friendly, too!

introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.how: Researchers whose missions pay the Eremites well and who are considered wealthy clients
introduced.quote: The Akademiya's researchers are a rich lot, and they're not ones to default on their payments either!

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: A large region with many researchers, where new mercenary work arrives every day
introduced.quote: Sumeru's a big place with lots of researchers, so we've got new work coming in every day.

introduced.name: Sania
introduced.how: A villager and close companion of Jabari who refuses to let him join the Eremites
introduced.quote: In the end, he just can't bear to leave me here alone in the village... and I couldn't bear to see him slogging away by himself, either.

introduced.name: Jabari
introduced.how: A village cook with culinary skills whom Atiyah wants to recruit and who has talked of finding work outside
introduced.quote: With his culinary skills, Jabari'd do really well with us, and your family's financial standing would be improved greatly, too.

introduced.name: Fodil
introduced.how: A former Eremite who quit the organization, refuses to return, and holds firm principles against lawlessness
introduced.quote: I've left the organization already. Don't call me that.

introduced.name: Ayten
introduced.how: A child who wants to join the Eremites and asks Atiyah to repeat the test
introduced.quote: Hey, Uncle Atiyah! You still asking people to join the Eremites?

introduced.name: Karima
introduced.how: A child who has a small bow, races Ayten, and says she does not want to join the Eremites
introduced.quote: I do have a small bow, though my mother only gave me arrows without tips...

introduced.name: Eremite principle of swift retreat
introduced.how: The Eremites live by the rule that the quicker one can get away from danger, the better
introduced.quote: When that happens, we often live by the principle that the quicker we can get away, the better.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: I'm already in the Adventurers' Guild.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: And if you're lucky, you might even get to meet Dehya, the Flame-Mane!

assumed.name: Candace
assumed.quote: I did ask Miss Candace for advice on how to train before!

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Oh, come on, we're already here. You know, "in for one Mora, in for a thousand" and such!

threads.claim: Fodil suggests the Eremites are not evil but not honorable, and that lawless behavior spreads through the group.
threads.quote: Perhaps from your perspective, the Eremites are not an evil organization even if they're not exactly honorable... But you can't always live in shades of gray.

threads.claim: Ill deeds spread through the Eremites, and one lawless member can influence the whole group.
threads.quote: But ill deeds spread, Atiyah. All it takes is one person to act like the law is merely a suggestion, and everyone else will be affected by them.

threads.claim: The Eremites take work from Akademiya researchers, and Atiyah talks of fleecing them, hinting at a tense relationship.
threads.quote: And if you join up with us, you'll get the chance to fleece those tree-dwellers of their fat wallets.

threads.claim: Fodil once was an Eremite, quit, and the reason for his departure is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Next up on my list of people to meet is Fodil. He was one of us once... but he quit.

threads.claim: Jabari has talked of leaving the village for work, but Sania is determined to keep him there.
threads.quote: And hasn't he said before that he'd like to go out and find work? If that's what he really wants, who better to recommend work than an old friend, eh?

threads.claim: The Eremites are short of members, and the dangerous mercenary work leaves them overworked.
threads.quote: Nowadays, able hands are in short supply everywhere — and nowhere is that shortage more acute than in the mercenary industry.

threads.claim: Ayten hopes to join the Eremites after passing tests, and Atiyah promises future training with Dehya.
threads.quote: If you keep training hard like this, it's only a matter of time before we'll let you in.

threads.claim: Atiyah claims his recruiting has inspired young people to leave the village for the outside world, even if they did not join.
threads.quote: Lots of young men and women have left the village to see the outside world after hearing what I had to say... even if they didn't really want to join us.

introduced.name: Angry Bears
introduced.how: a group that needs the Traveler's help building snowmen
introduced.quote: But the Angry Bears definitely need more hands on deck to make this happen...

assumed.name: Anfissa
assumed.quote: Simmer down over there, Anfissa.

assumed.name: Krylov
assumed.quote: Krylov can decorate and name this second snowman...

assumed.name: Remarkable Chest
assumed.quote: A Remarkable Chest spawns nearby

introduced.name: Chayka
introduced.how: A court official who sends the Traveler a letter and manages the palace hall entrance
introduced.quote: Paimon: We got a letter from Chayka! She wants us to wait outside the palace hall when we get there... Well, guess we should go check it out.

introduced.name: Vesna
introduced.how: Commander of the Druzhna who also drives a railway train and is close to the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: Vesna: Then... Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna salutes back!

introduced.name: Danica
introduced.how: A court official who coaches the Traveler on court etiquette and rebukes Vesna
introduced.quote: Danica: Don't worry. You've already attended court once. The required etiquette is no different from last time.

introduced.name: Anastasya
introduced.how: The Tsaritsa who presides over the morning court and rules the nation with reward and punishment
introduced.quote: Anastasya: Let the wicked tremble in fear, and the righteous be rewarded. That is how I choose to rule this nation.

introduced.name: Pantalone
introduced.how: A minister who notices the Traveler and reviews the railway funding request
introduced.quote: (Pantalone and Pulcinella are already present as they enter, and the former notes the Traveler's presence with interest)

introduced.name: Pulcinella
introduced.how: A minister, called The Rooster, who briefs the Tsaritsa on civil policy and financial matters
introduced.quote: The Rooster: The implementation of all recent civil policies is going smoothly, Your Majesty. However, there is a financial matter that requires your attention.

introduced.name: Snezhnograd Veche
introduced.how: A body that approves government funds, including railway maintenance allocations
introduced.quote: The Rooster: The Snezhnograd Veche just approved an allocation of funds for the regular maintenance of the railway loop.

introduced.name: railway loop
introduced.how: A city railway loop split into sections, each with a maintainer, run by trains during off-peak hours
introduced.quote: Vesna: Every section of the loop has someone responsible for maintenance except for this one. But strangely enough, it always seems to be in pretty good shape.

introduced.name: Transportation Minister
introduced.how: A newly appointed minister whose audit of railway funding is found insufficient
introduced.quote: Transportation Minister: Indeed, Your Majesty.

introduced.name: Granin
introduced.how: A boy who calls himself Track Captain and has been maintaining an overlooked railway section
introduced.quote: Granin: Yes! As Track Captain, it's my duty to look after the tracks!

introduced.name: Grebnina
introduced.how: Granin's companion, who says he only likes trains and that they came to help Alyosha
introduced.quote: Grebnina: He isn't actually a captain. He just likes trains. We came out here with him because we wanted to help out Alyosha.

introduced.name: Track Captain
introduced.how: An informal title for a railway maintainer that the Tsaritsa decides to make official
introduced.quote: Anastasya: Track Captain... is not a bad title. We should officially bestow it upon that child.

introduced.name: initial funding audit
introduced.how: The railway budget audit asked each section chief to report needed amounts, so an unreported section was left out
introduced.quote: Regrator: During the initial funding audit, we asked the section chief of each portion of the rail to report the amount needed for their respective section.

assumed.name: Alyosha
assumed.quote: Vesna: Ah yes, hunter boy...

assumed.name: Rankova Zorya
assumed.quote: Anastasya: I've also read the report. The section in question is the one near Rankova Zorya, yes?

assumed.name: Volkodlak
assumed.quote: (Paimon notices two large Volkodlak standing over two cowering kids)

assumed.name: Druzhna
assumed.quote: Vesna: Then... Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna salutes back!

assumed.name: earlier court attendance
assumed.quote: Danica: Don't worry. You've already attended court once. The required etiquette is no different from last time.

assumed.name: Her Majesty's consultant role
assumed.quote: Vesna: Your first official court assembly as Her Majesty's consultant! Your performance better not disappoint!

threads.claim: An unassigned railway section stays in unusually good shape, and no one knows who maintains it.
threads.quote: Vesna: Every section of the loop has someone responsible for maintenance except for this one. But strangely enough, it always seems to be in pretty good shape.

threads.claim: Granin is revealed to be the child who has been voluntarily maintaining the overlooked section.
threads.quote: Regrator: Huh, so someone has been voluntarily maintaining this section of the tracks all this time...

threads.claim: Granin's connection to Alyosha is hinted at but left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: So this kid has some connection to Alyosha...

threads.claim: Anastasya says she rules by rewarding the righteous and punishing the wicked.
threads.quote: Anastasya: Let the wicked tremble in fear, and the righteous be rewarded. That is how I choose to rule this nation.

threads.claim: Anastasya treats the children as expendable and refuses to show them affection.
threads.quote: Anastasya: After all, they're still nothing more than kids. Once their interest fades, we still have the maintenance of that section of the railroad to consider.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects the Tsaritsa is using the Traveler to monitor her own officials.
threads.quote: Paimon: So the Tsaritsa knew about that all along... Is she using us to monitor her own officials?

threads.claim: Officials are led to believe a secret special ambassador may be watching them, which the Tsaritsa finds useful.
threads.quote: Vesna: Of course, letting her officials think there's a secret special ambassador out there who could be watching them at any moment... Now, that is very useful to Her Majesty indeed.

threads.claim: Anastasya withholds the funding increase because the Transportation Minister's audit caused the allocation error.
threads.quote: Anastasya: Given it was the Minister's auditing error that caused the incorrect allocation of funding, no increase will be issued.

introduced.name: Kamla
introduced.how: a woman who posted a request for berries and takes trips to the sea
introduced.quote: You must have seen my post and came here to deliver the Berries, right?

assumed.name: Kamla's berry request post
assumed.quote: You must have seen my post and came here to deliver the Berries, right?

introduced.name: Kano Nana
introduced.how: a woman who asks the Traveler for help and commissions Carrots for a child in her care
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: Hello. I'm so sorry, but may I... ask you something?

introduced.name: Carrots
introduced.how: a vegetable Kano Nana wants 15 of for the child's diet
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: Kids have gotta learn to eat their vegetables if they want to grow up. You can't be a picky eater, even when it comes to Carrots.

introduced.name: commission
introduced.how: an NPC request the Traveler can accept and fulfill for a reward
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: Anyway. You must be the one who accepted my commission? Do you have 15 Carrots for me?

introduced.name: little creature with ears and a tail
introduced.how: a young, picky-eating creature Kano Nana is looking after
introduced.quote: Kano Nana: Have you ever met a little creature with ears and a tail?

threads.claim: A little creature with ears and a tail is being cared for by Kano Nana, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Kano Nana: Have you ever met a little creature with ears and a tail?

introduced.name: Kanra
introduced.how: a woman waiting anxiously for news of the man she loves, who left for the war
introduced.quote: Kanra: These days, I worry about him at every waking moment.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: a sacred tree whose blossoms soothe worry and on which vows are sworn
introduced.quote: The reason is that before he left, he swore on the Sacred Sakura that he would return safely to me.

introduced.name: Sakura Blooms
introduced.how: blossoms that must be gathered (five of them) to fulfill Kanra's commission
introduced.quote: Traveler: Searching for Sakura Blooms?

assumed.name: Quest
assumed.quote: You saw my commission?

assumed.name: war
assumed.quote: since the man I love left to join the war, I've not heard one shred of news

threads.claim: Kanra's beloved left to join a war and she has received no news of him, leaving his fate an open question.
threads.quote: since the man I love left to join the war, I've not heard one shred of news...

threads.claim: Kanra's beloved swore an oath on the Sacred Sakura to return safely, hinting at the tree's significance and whether the vow will be kept.
threads.quote: The reason is that before he left, he swore on the Sacred Sakura that he would return safely to me.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild receptionist who is the only year-round receptionist and can move between locations with a special tool
introduced.quote: As the only year-round receptionist in the Adventurers' Guild, I can use a special tool to instantly move between various locations in the world to deal with various important matters...

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild that Katheryne works for, where adventurers receive commissions and benefits
introduced.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: Region where adventurers are notorious for frugality, which Katheryne must travel to and host well
introduced.quote: After I help you with your matters here, I need to head over to Fontaine.

introduced.name: Katheryne's special teleport tool
introduced.how: Tool that lets Katheryne instantly move between various locations in the world
introduced.quote: As the only year-round receptionist in the Adventurers' Guild, I can use a special tool to instantly move between various locations in the world to deal with various important matters...

introduced.name: Inazuma Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Local guild branch where the Traveler has work processed and can take commissions
introduced.quote: Come, I'll help you process the work that's needed by the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Guild commissions and benefits
introduced.how: Once processed, adventurers can accept commissions at the guild and enjoy other benefits
introduced.quote: Once things are processed, you can accept commissions here and also enjoy other benefits.

assumed.name: Teleport Waypoints
assumed.quote: Also, I thought you knew how to use Teleport Waypoints?

assumed.name: Previous encounter with another Katheryne
assumed.quote: An—Another Katheryne...

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer.

threads.claim: Multiple Katherynes appear in one location and Katheryne claims they were one and the same, leaving the puzzle open.
threads.quote: Hehe, have you ever seen multiple Katherynes in a single location?

threads.claim: Katheryne uses a special tool to move instantly between locations across the world, with its nature left unexplained.
threads.quote: As the only year-round receptionist in the Adventurers' Guild, I can use a special tool to instantly move between various locations in the world to deal with various important matters...

introduced.name: Hertha
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Captain of the Knights of Favonius' 6th Company, in charge of logistics
introduced.quote: I'm Hertha, Captain of the Knights of Favonius' 6th Company.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: The organization Hertha leads a company in, which the Traveler is being recruited to help
introduced.quote: I'm Hertha, Captain of the Knights of Favonius' 6th Company.

introduced.name: Reputation
introduced.how: Completing tasks raises citizen trust, unlocks more important work, and increases Knight pay
introduced.quote: If you're able to complete them successfully, the citizens will trust you more, and you'll be allowed to take on still more important work.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Well, Mondstadt's present state is as you've no doubt seen.

assumed.name: Grand Master
assumed.quote: With the Grand Master having brought much of our manpower with him, we have since been in a constant state of short-handedness.

assumed.name: Acting Grand Master
assumed.quote: With any luck, we'll take some of the burden off our Acting Grand Master's shoulders...

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Greetings, Honorary Knight.

threads.claim: The Grand Master took much of Mondstadt's manpower with him, leaving the city short-handed under an Acting Grand Master.
threads.quote: With the Grand Master having brought much of our manpower with him, we have since been in a constant state of short-handedness.

threads.claim: The citizens do not yet know the Traveler well, and earning their trust requires interacting with them more.
threads.quote: If you wish to earn their trust, you need to interact with them more.

introduced.name: Kourosh
introduced.how: a performer whose manager keeps scolding him and who is anxious about his performances
introduced.quote: Kourosh: *sob* The manager scolded me again today...

introduced.name: Sumeru Roses
introduced.how: flowers Kourosh wants ten of, which he finds gorgeous and hopes will make his performance flawless
introduced.quote: So, do you have all ten Sumeru Roses? You can give them to me if you do.

assumed.name: Kourosh's earlier request for Sumeru Roses
assumed.quote: Here are the Sumeru Roses you wanted.

threads.claim: Kourosh feels that his luck is failing him and that even the roses have abandoned him.
threads.quote: Argh, even roses have abandoned me. Life is harsh.

threads.claim: Kourosh is under pressure from his manager over the quality of his performances.
threads.quote: Kourosh: *sob* The manager scolded me again today...

introduced.name: Iron Chunks
introduced.how: requested commission material, 10 needed for Kozue's order
introduced.quote: Are you here about my commission? If so, I guess you've already got those 10 Iron Chunks ready, right?

introduced.name: Kozue's commission
introduced.how: Kozue has ordered 10 Iron Chunks to be delivered to her
introduced.quote: Are you here about my commission?

assumed.name: Kozue
assumed.quote: Ah, it's you.

assumed.name: Taroumaru
assumed.quote: I'll hand them to Taroumaru shortly.

assumed.name: Komore Teahouse
assumed.quote: What is your business in Komore Teahouse today?

introduced.name: Giulietta
introduced.how: Introduces herself as an instrument seller who hires the Traveler to ferry her to Bayda Harbor
introduced.quote: my name's Giulietta, and I sell instruments.

introduced.name: Giustino
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a former Petrichor resident who left home long ago and now wants to return
introduced.quote: Just call me Giustino.

introduced.name: Giovanni
introduced.how: Revealed as Giustino's younger brother, a local who resents Giustino for leaving the family business
introduced.quote: I see you're the same as ever, Big Brother. Always sucking people into whatever trouble you get into!

introduced.name: Petrichor
introduced.how: Giustino's hometown, a Fontainian place he left as a youth and has not visited in ten years
introduced.quote: Did you two come from Petrichor by any chance?

introduced.name: File:Latecoming Homecoming Flute.png
introduced.how: A short bone flute that was Giustino's father's parting gift when he left home
introduced.quote: This is the flute my father gave me when I was about to leave home.

introduced.name: Agent (debt enforcers)
introduced.how: Uniformed agents who enforce contract debts and pursue violators, sometimes by force
introduced.quote: it's my duty to make violators pay up.

introduced.name: Bayda Harbor
introduced.how: Harbor where the contract payment is due and where Giulietta needs to go
introduced.quote: the payment must be made these two days at Bayda Harbor.

assumed.name: Waverider
assumed.quote: My Waverider's pretty small...

assumed.name: Petrichor crisis resolved by the Traveler
assumed.quote: we followed a cat and wound up disrupting an ancient plot and resolving the crisis in his hometown

assumed.name: Special Patrol
assumed.quote: If there's an emergency case that requires the Special Patrol's services...

assumed.name: Fontaine and Sumeru
assumed.quote: Have you seen a merchant from Fontaine dressed in Sumeru garb?

threads.claim: The Agent's records name Giulietta Participazia while Giustino insists his name is Giustino Pasquale, hinting at a mix-up of identities.
threads.quote: My name is Giustino. Giustino Pasquale...

threads.claim: Giulietta mentions recent nightmares that disturb her sleep, hinting at an unexplained cause.
threads.quote: It might be the nightmares I've been having lately, but I couldn't sleep well...

threads.claim: Giustino suspects someone may have taken a loan in his name, hinting that the debt belongs to an impostor.
threads.quote: unless a friend took a loan in my name...

threads.claim: Giustino admits he had all but forgotten his family and home during his years away.
threads.quote: If only I could have written them a letter, but I had all but forgotten my family and home...

threads.claim: Giustino's father secretly gave him the flute when he left, showing the family's hidden disapproval and affection.
threads.quote: my father snuck the instrument out to me at the last minute.

threads.claim: Giovanni has erected a tombstone for Giustino, implying the family believed him dead.
threads.quote: Why, I've already had a tombstone erected for him behind the town!

threads.claim: The estranged brothers reconcile and Giustino agrees to work in Giovanni's workshop.
threads.quote: We may have had our disagreements, but we are still brothers...

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for a missing family member, a thread that the text leaves unexplained.
threads.quote: Actually, 's still searching for missing ...

introduced.name: Aradashan
introduced.how: Aranara who introduces himself by name and greets the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Aradashan's name is Aradashan.

introduced.name: Big Iron Chunk
introduced.how: iron monsters sealed in stone locks; big, hard, and some shoot fire from their eyes
introduced.quote: Big Iron Chunks are big and hard, some even shoot fire out of their eyes! Very dangerous!

introduced.name: stone lock
introduced.how: seals that trap Big Iron Chunks; sixteen of them are in the forest
introduced.quote: There are sixteen stone locks in total in the forest with Big Iron Chunks inside... Can defeat them?

introduced.name: Arasata
introduced.how: Aranara who introduces herself and is one of the Aranara guarding the locks
introduced.quote: Arasata: Hello... I am Arasata.

introduced.name: Arasaha
introduced.how: quiet Aranara who gives only their name
introduced.quote: Arasaha: ...Arasaha.

introduced.name: Arayuta
introduced.how: Aranara who introduces themself and is eager to tell the Aradasha stories
introduced.quote: Arayuta: Arayuta! My name is Arayuta!

introduced.name: Aradasha
introduced.how: a legendary hero who defeated Big Iron Chunks and sealed them with stone locks
introduced.quote: Arayuta: When things were at their most perilous, the great Aradasha emerged.

introduced.name: Ararakalari
introduced.how: the power the Aranara and Aradasha used to defeat and contain iron monsters
introduced.quote: Arayuta: The great Aradasha defeated many, many Big Iron Chunks with Ararakalari and locked them up with stone locks.

introduced.name: Bulky Iron Chunk
introduced.how: a mightier iron monster under a lake that only Ararakalari could contain
introduced.quote: Aradashan: Bulky Iron Chunk is mightier than Big Iron Chunk. We could only contain it with our Ararakalari.

introduced.name: Valuka
introduced.how: the crumbled remains stone locks turn into as they wear down over time
introduced.quote: Arasata: Same as the stone locks. They crack and fracture until they become Valuka.

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's an Aranara...

assumed.name: Nara Varuna
assumed.quote: Arayuta: Nara glows as bright as gold, just like Nara Varuna did in the tales!

assumed.name: Arabalika
assumed.quote: Aradashan: If we could defeat them with Ararakalari like Arabalika can, we wouldn't have to worry about the stone locks turning into Valuka.

assumed.name: Ruin Graders and Ruin Drakes
assumed.quote: Paimon: Since the Big Iron Chunks are Ruin Graders, Ruin Drakes, and the likes...

assumed.name: Vanarana
assumed.quote: Aradashan: When you want to, Nara , just sing the Rhythm of the Great Dream like when you entered Vanarana.

threads.claim: The Big Iron Chunks first appeared several hundred cycles ago, and their origin is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Aradashan: Several hundred cycles of trees ago, the iron monsters appeared. Some were big iron Nara, some were legless big iron Nara.

threads.claim: Stone locks crack and crumble over time, which could let the sealed iron monsters escape.
threads.quote: Arasata: Well... Aradasha locked the Big Iron Chunks away, but even the hardest earth erodes and crumbles in time...

threads.claim: The legendary hero Aradasha sealed the Big Iron Chunks long ago, and the Aranara revere the story.
threads.quote: Arayuta: When things were at their most perilous, the great Aradasha emerged.

threads.claim: A stronger iron monster called the Bulky Iron Chunk lies sealed under a lake and needs the Traveler's help.
threads.quote: Aradashan: Bulky Iron Chunk is mightier than Big Iron Chunk. We could only contain it with our Ararakalari.

threads.claim: The Bulky Iron Chunk may have a different true name, the Perpetual Mechanical Array, which the player will learn later.
threads.quote: Paimon: Oh, the name will fit pretty soon... But we'll stick to calling it Bulky Iron Chunk for now.

threads.claim: Singing the Rhythm of the Great Dream lets the Traveler join the Aranara's shared dream of fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk.
threads.quote: Aradashan: Then you can join and share our dream of the Bulky Iron Chunk.

threads.claim: The Aranara's Ararakalari proved too weak against the Bulky Iron Chunk, so they resolve to grow stronger.
threads.quote: Aradashan: Even if our Ararakalari could defeat Big Iron Chunks, we wouldn't be able to handle the Bulky Iron Chunk.

threads.claim: The Traveler and Paimon defeat the Bulky Iron Chunk, ending the iron monster threat in the forest.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's okay, since the Perpetual Mechanical Array... Uh, Bulky Iron Chunk is defeated, there will be no more iron monsters in the forests!

introduced.name: Changchang
introduced.how: a young girl who greets the Traveler and introduces herself as someone making a garland
introduced.quote: Oh, hello, nice to meet you!

introduced.name: Silk Flower
introduced.how: a flower Changchang needs three of to make her garland
introduced.quote: So did you already finish gathering three Silk Flowers?

assumed.name: Daddy
assumed.quote: When is daddy coming back...

assumed.name: Silk Flowers task
assumed.quote: About Silk Flowers...

threads.claim: Changchang's father is away and she is waiting for him to return.
threads.quote: When is daddy coming back...

threads.claim: Changchang plans to give the garland to her father, whom she expects to love it.
threads.quote: I know Daddy will just love this pretty garland.

introduced.name: Lianne
introduced.how: a troubled woman searching for missing items who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Troubled Lianne: What are you doing here, Traveler?

introduced.name: Jarjar
introduced.how: an eccentric Pari who builds challenges and whom most Pari avoid
introduced.quote: Most of the Pari try to avoid her.

introduced.name: Sorush
introduced.how: a Pari who once distanced herself from others and is now a proud, cautious figure
introduced.quote: Ahem! In the past, I distanced myself from my fellow Pari and took the wrong... no, the longer path! But that's enough about me. Tell me more about you!

introduced.name: Lightcall Resonance
introduced.how: a timed trial of collecting items and racing to the finish, designed by Jarjar
introduced.quote: Collecting certain items in a limited time and getting to the finish line as quickly as possible... This is a form of trial that humans are most familiar with.

introduced.name: Yasnapati
introduced.how: a human partner who serves Sorush and whose role brings honor to her
introduced.quote: The Yasnapati of Lady Sorush is also well renowned among the humans. For Lightcall Resonance to meet with approval would be the highest honor.

introduced.name: Order of Skeptics
introduced.how: a group of humans who approach Pari with false friendship to extract information
introduced.quote: They approached me with the pretense of wanting to be friends and drilled me with questions, trying to get things out of me that no human can learn.

introduced.name: Lightcall Path
introduced.how: a path that only Pari can open
introduced.quote: Only Pari can open the path here.

introduced.name: Zurvan
introduced.how: the great first Pari, a highly regarded leader far above Jarjar
introduced.quote: Compared with the first Pari, the great Lady Zurvan, I'm but a lowly, nameless Pari that no one cares about.

assumed.name: Nasejuna
assumed.quote: Maybe they're Nasejuna's minions. After all, Sorush has been tricked by him before.

assumed.name: Sorush's past with Jarjar
assumed.quote: Even after all these years, you're still stuck in your own little world.

assumed.name: Wind glider
assumed.quote: It was obvious that no matter which wind glider he used, he proved to be an amateur.

threads.claim: Nasejuna may be behind the Order of Skeptics and has tricked Sorush before.
threads.quote: Maybe they're Nasejuna's minions. After all, Sorush has been tricked by him before.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects Nasejuna is directing the Skeptics' schemes, including the trick played on Sorush.
threads.quote: Are these people all working under Nasejuna? To think that he would do all these things, in addition to tricking Sorush!

threads.claim: The reason the Order of Skeptics targets Jarjar is unexplained.
threads.quote: Why would the Order of Skeptics even do that?

threads.claim: The Skeptics were trying to extract information about Zurvan from Jarjar.
threads.quote: In the end, he saw me as nothing more than an observational sample of ordinary Pari to be used... He also tried to get information about an important Pari out from me.

threads.claim: Jarjar withholds information about Zurvan and refuses to reveal it even to those who pass the trials.
threads.quote: I will never tell them a single thing about Lady Zurvan even if they do pass the trials. This is a matter of principles.

threads.claim: Jarjar was once a lonely Pari whose invitations to share challenges were always refused.
threads.quote: But no Pari wanted to enjoy them with me.

threads.claim: Jarjar has been copying the Skeptics' flattering manner of speech and fears Sorush's reaction.
threads.quote: I can't just tell Sorush that I've been copying the Skeptics' manner of speech... She'll get really mad, that's for sure. Even the thought of it is terrifying!

threads.claim: Jarjar's speech resembles that of the Skeptics, which hints at a hidden motive.
threads.quote: When you were talking earlier, you kinda sounded like the Skeptics.

threads.claim: Sorush offers Jarjar friendship, partly resolving Jarjar's isolation.
threads.quote: You may consider me your most distinguished friend, Jarjar. Not many among the Pari are that lucky.

threads.claim: Sorush once distanced herself from other Pari, and the reason is left unexplained.
threads.quote: In the past, I distanced myself from my fellow Pari and took the wrong... no, the longer path!

threads.claim: Only Pari can open the Lightcall Path, which hints at why the Skeptics could not pass the trials.
threads.quote: Only Pari can open the path here.

introduced.name: Oath Lantern
introduced.how: standard Lightkeeper lanterns whose carved words are oaths; Lightkeeper gear
introduced.quote: Paimon: We've seen lots of these lanterns, and by the look of them, they were all Lightkeeper gear.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: an order whose members swear an oath and carry lanterns
introduced.quote: Flins: "The winds awaken, the leaves whirl round"... This is the oath those who join the Lightkeepers swear.

introduced.name: Lightkeeper oath
introduced.how: the spoken oath that those who join the Lightkeepers swear
introduced.quote: Flins: "The winds awaken, the leaves whirl round"... This is the oath those who join the Lightkeepers swear.

introduced.name: masterless lantern
introduced.how: a lantern left without its keeper marks a misfortune and a tragedy
introduced.quote: Flins: Each masterless lantern, therefore, is a marker of misfortune, a tragedy that fills me with sorrow.

introduced.name: Ghost
introduced.how: Lightkeeper ghosts appear when their lanterns are checked
introduced.quote: (A female Lightkeeper ghost appears)

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: Flins: Hello there, friend. A pleasure to meet you again amidst the graves.

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: Illuga: Our bones and blood shall use as fuel, we shall make life greater than death...

threads.claim: The words carved on the Lightkeeper lanterns are unclear to the Traveler and Paimon, raising the question of what they mean.
threads.quote: Paimon: But we don't know what the words on them mean... Let's find someone to ask about that, shall we?

threads.claim: Flins explains that the carved words are the oath Lightkeepers swear, and that remembering the oaths is what can be done for the dead.
threads.quote: Flins: If there was anything else we could do for them, it would be remembering the oaths they made.

threads.claim: A Lightkeeper's carved words foresee waves, a devoured night sky, and deathly silence, hinting at a coming catastrophe.
threads.quote: Thus did I foresee — waves crashing on the shore, the night sky devoured by deathly silence...

threads.claim: A hidden compartment in one Oath Lantern holds a yellowed note, an unexplained clue.
threads.quote: Oath Lantern: (On one side of the lantern's shade, there is a hidden compartment. Inside it is a yellowed note.)

threads.claim: Lightkeeper ghosts appear at the lanterns, hinting that the dead remain tied to their oaths.
threads.quote: (A female Lightkeeper ghost appears)

threads.claim: Abandoned lanterns without a keeper are a sign of tragedy that Lightkeepers feel sorrow over.
threads.quote: Flins: Each masterless lantern, therefore, is a marker of misfortune, a tragedy that fills me with sorrow.

threads.claim: The Lightkeeper oaths speak of using their bodies as fuel to make life greater than death.
threads.quote: Thus did I vow — our bones and blood shall use as fuel, we shall make life greater than death.

threads.claim: Lightkeepers claim to shine an eternal light of hope into the snow-swept plains, a light they wish to keep burning.
threads.quote: We are the Lightkeepers, who shine the eternal light of hope into the endless snow-swept plains.

threads.claim: Flins says the Lightkeepers' dearest wish was to bear and defend lanterns alight with eternal hope.
threads.quote: Flins: To bear and defend "lanterns alight with eternal hope"... That was their dearest wish.

introduced.name: Aramis
introduced.how: a Knight with bad knees who asks the Traveler to retrieve the city's blown-away signboards and posters
introduced.quote: Could you help me out of this bind, Honorary Knight?

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Knights who send members to fix city problems and are currently shorthanded
introduced.quote: The Knights originally intended to send two agile members to settle these issues with haste.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: a guild in Mondstadt recruiting new members, with sign-ups handled by Branch Master Cyrus
introduced.quote: The Adventurers' Guild is now recruiting new members! To sign up, speak to Branch Master Cyrus in Mondstadt today.

introduced.name: Angel's Share
introduced.how: a bar offering discounts to new patrons, which Paimon sees as competing with the Cat's Tail
introduced.quote: Newcomers deal now on at the Angel's Share.

introduced.name: Cat's Tail
introduced.how: a bar with new drinks on offer, competing with the Angel's Share
introduced.quote: New drinks at the Cat's Tail. Your bartender today is: Diona.

introduced.name: Good Hunter
introduced.how: a restaurant with a new meal deal offering a discount on a salad and a roast
introduced.quote: Try the all-new Good Hunter meal deal!

assumed.name: Honorary Knight
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you, Honorary Knight.

assumed.name: storm that surrounded the city
assumed.quote: you must have seen that storm that surrounded the entire city, right?

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Branch Master Cyrus in Mondstadt today.

assumed.name: Sara
assumed.quote: do you think Sara will treat us to a meal

assumed.name: Charles
assumed.quote: I've already notified Charles

threads.claim: The storm's effects on the city will not be fixed quickly despite the storm having subsided.
threads.quote: Although the storm has subsided, the effects of that storm aren't going to be fixed any time soon...

threads.claim: The storm's lingering effects are expected to remain in the city for a while after it ends.
threads.quote: Though the storm has ceased, it's effects will remain with us for a while...

threads.claim: The Knights are short of available members, so an older Knight is sent alone to handle city problems.
threads.quote: But as it turns out, we're shorthanded at the moment, so only I was sent.

introduced.name: Saigou
introduced.how: introduces himself as an Inazuman gourmet searching for true delicacies
introduced.quote: Let me introduce myself. I am Saigou, an Inazuman gourmet. I've been traveling around in search of true delicacies.

introduced.name: Gimmick dishes
introduced.how: dishes that stress appearance and gimmicks over food quality have become common
introduced.quote: Such dishes, which emphasize appearances and gimmicks over the food quality itself, have become prevalent everywhere.

introduced.name: Dish quality tiers (Delicious, Normal, Suspicious)
introduced.how: submitted dishes are rated Delicious, Normal, or Suspicious, and Saigou's reaction changes with the rating
introduced.quote: (Submitted Suspicious Tuna Sushi)

introduced.name: City restaurant owners
introduced.how: they have turned Saigou away because of his blunt opinions
introduced.quote: my straightforward opinions have made me unwelcome among the city's restaurant owners.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: I am Saigou, an Inazuman gourmet.

threads.claim: Saigou claims some dishes are fake delicacies made to look good through gimmicks and celebrity promotion rather than real food quality.
threads.quote: Of course! Nowadays, you just need to pretty the food up, give it a fancy name, and have some celebrities promote them...

threads.claim: Suspicious dishes have a strange, unidentifiable taste, hinting that something unusual affects them.
threads.quote: My taste buds can't seem to identify this strange taste.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: a nation whose nobles claim divine authority and secretly rule, with a resistance fighting them
introduced.quote: Ostensibly, they guard the Sunchild. But in truth, they are the real rulers of the nation — parasitic worms who suck the flesh and blood of the people!

introduced.name: Sunchild
introduced.how: a figure the nobles nominally guard while they hold real power
introduced.quote: Ostensibly, they guard the Sunchild.

introduced.name: Supada no Hiko
introduced.how: a resistance leader, also called Spartacus the Righteous, once a notorious outlaw whose crimes are recorded on a tablet
introduced.quote: Here lies Spartacus the Righteous, known now as Supada no Hiko. Beneath lies the litany of his crimes. Read them and remember our history.

introduced.name: Resistance
introduced.how: an underground movement against the nobles in Byakuyakoku
introduced.quote: To this day, I remain a member of the resistance.

introduced.name: Serpent's Heart
introduced.how: a location containing the altar where Supada no Hiko is imprisoned
introduced.quote: He's been locked in the altar at the Serpent's Heart, and judging by how things look, he can't get out.

introduced.name: Adonis
introduced.how: one of Supada no Hiko's students who escaped the crackdown and now hides with the surviving resistance
introduced.quote: Only those of us students who followed him ordinarily escaped thanks to being far from the center of events.

introduced.name: Dragonbone Orb
introduced.how: a rare fruit borne by Dragonbone Flowers that calms the mind and sells for high prices
introduced.quote: It is a rare fruit that Dragonbone Flowers will bear under special circumstances.

introduced.name: Tokoyo Reisen
introduced.how: the place whose waters are needed to make Dragonbone Orbs
introduced.quote: They can only be created through the use of the waters of Tokoyo Reisen, that is to say, the waters of Lethe.

introduced.name: Lethe
introduced.how: the waters found at Tokoyo Reisen, required to produce Dragonbone Orbs
introduced.quote: They can only be created through the use of the waters of Tokoyo Reisen, that is to say, the waters of Lethe.

introduced.name: pass-code
introduced.how: the secret phrase resistance members use to recognize each other
introduced.quote: This is our secret pass-code.

assumed.name: Reset
assumed.quote: (Wait one Reset)

assumed.name: With Wind Comes Glory
assumed.quote: like With Wind Comes Glory in Mondstadt, Xigu Antiques in Liyue, and Netsuke no Gen Crafts in Inazuma.

assumed.name: Dragonbone Flower
assumed.quote: Guess we can grab some water from Lethe and use it to water the Dragonbone Flower.

threads.claim: The nobles who guard the Sunchild are secretly the real rulers who exploit the people.
threads.quote: Ostensibly, they guard the Sunchild. But in truth, they are the real rulers of the nation — parasitic worms who suck the flesh and blood of the people!

threads.claim: Supada no Hiko's message says hope for Byakuyakoku survives among his hidden students.
threads.quote: Tell them to never give up, for hope lives amongst them...

threads.claim: The students admit they have failed, so the hope they were meant to carry has not survived intact.
threads.quote: I'm sorry! We have failed you, Master!

threads.claim: The altar prison slowly erodes the soul and memories of those held inside.
threads.quote: This prison is a malignant thing. Even now, I can feel my soul being ground down, precious things stripped away from me...

threads.claim: Supada no Hiko's memories were ground away by the prison, which is why he forgot his own name.
threads.quote: Ah, yes, I remember. In this place, your very soul shall be eroded.

threads.claim: Supada no Hiko was captured and tortured by the nobles and is held in the altar.
threads.quote: I was captured after our previous failure, imprisoned here in this altar, and tortured.

threads.claim: Supada no Hiko is confirmed to be locked in the altar at the Serpent's Heart and unable to escape.
threads.quote: He's been locked in the altar at the Serpent's Heart, and judging by how things look, he can't get out.

threads.claim: The origin of the Dragonbone Orb formula is unknown and may have been planted by the rulers.
threads.quote: Sometimes, I actually wonder if the formula for making these things wasn't leaked to us by those despicable rulers...

threads.claim: Wealth from Dragonbone Orbs made oppressed people content, so they stopped resisting and the movement collapsed.
threads.quote: I only know that when oppressed peoples grow satisified with their lives, they cease to resist.

threads.claim: Dragonbone Orbs require water from Lethe at Tokoyo Reisen to be made.
threads.quote: They can only be created through the use of the waters of Tokoyo Reisen, that is to say, the waters of Lethe.

threads.claim: The resistance has fully collapsed after Supada no Hiko's capture and the orb scheme.
threads.quote: The resistance is no more.

introduced.name: Iris
introduced.how: adventurer camp figure who has met many travelers and warns about mountain dangers
introduced.quote: Iris: Excuse me? Did you want something?

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: the mountain Travelers can climb, described as the most dangerous place in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: This is, by far, the most dangerous place in all of Mondstadt.

introduced.name: body temperature
introduced.how: temperature dropping too low slows you down and can injure you
introduced.quote: If your temperature drops too low, not only will it slow you down, but you can also injure yourself.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: This is, by far, the most dangerous place in all of Mondstadt.

assumed.name: monsters
assumed.quote: if you're lucky enough to get attacked by a monster in that state

threads.claim: Dragonspine has already cost adventurers their lives, and climbers are warned to plan carefully.
threads.quote: I've seen more than a few adventurers lose their lives because they didn't think before they acted...

threads.claim: Travelers are portrayed as stubbornly set on climbing and not easily dissuaded.
threads.quote: I've met my fair share of travelers and whatever you say, there's no dissuading of them.

introduced.name: Vermeer
introduced.how: an artist seeking inspiration near Luhua Pool who lost his paints and brushes
introduced.quote: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help...

introduced.name: Luhua Pool
introduced.how: a pool where Vermeer looks for scenery and where a Strange Stone turns up
introduced.quote: I've been looking for inspiration around the Luhua Pool, and I wanted to paint a few pictures to bring back with me.

introduced.name: Giant statues with eyes
introduced.how: two giant guardian statues beside a mountain, said to have eyes that light up
introduced.quote: Giant statues with blazing eyes, standing guard next to a mountain...

introduced.name: Strange Stone
introduced.how: a stone that resembles an eye, found in the pond and meant to fit the statues
introduced.quote: I have no idea what it is, but the more I look at it, the more it resembles an eye.

introduced.name: Vermeer's Paintbrushes
introduced.how: paintbrushes Vermeer lost at his painting spots
introduced.quote: most of my paintbrushes and paints had gone missing when I arrived here.

introduced.name: Vermeer's Paints
introduced.how: paints Vermeer lost at his painting spots
introduced.quote: Are these the paints that the artist is looking for? So many colors...

introduced.name: Black and White Sketch
introduced.how: one of two paintings Vermeer gives as clues to where his tools were left
introduced.quote: I'll give you these two paintings.

introduced.name: Color Sketch
introduced.how: the second of two paintings Vermeer gives as clues to where his tools were left
introduced.quote: I'll give you these two paintings.

introduced.name: Stone sentinels inscription
introduced.how: words carved on the back of the Strange Stone about stone sentinels holding a gate
introduced.quote: The stone sentinels hold the gate as such, against those who add not a finishing touch...

assumed.name: the city
assumed.quote: If not for you, I'd have to back into the city to buy more.

threads.claim: Rumors say the two giant statues have eyes that light up visibly from afar, but no one has seen it.
threads.quote: I've heard people say that these two statues have eyes that could light up, and that you could see that from afar.

threads.claim: The statues' eyes do not light up when Vermeer looks at them, deepening the mystery.
threads.quote: This isn't right... This can't be right. Those statues' eyes don't light up...

threads.claim: The two Strange Stones are the statues' missing eyes, and they shine once slotted in.
threads.quote: These two rocks really are the eyes of the two statues.

threads.claim: The Strange Stone carries an inscription whose meaning is unclear and hints at a missing finishing touch.
threads.quote: The stone sentinels hold the gate as such, against those who add not a finishing touch...

threads.claim: Vermeer suspects the finishing touch refers to the two stones as eyes, but this remains a guess.
threads.quote: If they really are eyes, do you think that the "finishing touch" has something to do with these two stones.

threads.claim: Someone threw objects into Luhua Pool, and no one knows who or why.
threads.quote: I have no idea who threw it in there...

assumed.name: Lynn
assumed.quote: Lynn: Found anything yet?

introduced.name: Manly Jack
introduced.how: a man who wants to become manlier and commissions food from the Traveler
introduced.quote: Manly Jack: Will this stuff make me manlier, I wonder...

introduced.name: Chicken-Mushroom Skewer
introduced.how: a food item Manly Jack requests in sets of three
introduced.quote: Traveler: Need some (Chicken-Mushroom Skewer/Mondstadt Grilled Fish)?

introduced.name: Mondstadt Grilled Fish
introduced.how: a food item Manly Jack requests in sets of three
introduced.quote: Traveler: Need some (Chicken-Mushroom Skewer/Mondstadt Grilled Fish)?

introduced.name: Steak
introduced.how: a food item Manly Jack requests in pairs
introduced.quote: Traveler: You need some Steaks?

introduced.name: Manliness
introduced.how: Manly Jack believes eating these foods will make him manlier
introduced.quote: Manly Jack: Eating these will surely make me a manlier man...

assumed.name: Manly Jack's commission
assumed.quote: Manly Jack: I guess you saw that commission, huh? Nice!

assumed.name: commission
assumed.quote: Manly Jack: Yeah! You must have seen my commission, then.

threads.claim: Manly Jack hopes the food will make him manlier, but the Traveler says the effect has not happened yet.
threads.quote: Traveler: Not yet.

assumed.name: Margaret
assumed.quote: Margaret: What are you doing here, Traveler?

introduced.name: Master Zhang
introduced.how: a smith who sells and custom-builds weapons, offers free repairs, and takes commissions
introduced.quote: Need to buy a weapon? Or have one custom-built? Repairs are free, just let me know if you come across any prize ore.

introduced.name: Iron Chunk
introduced.how: a metal material Master Zhang needs ten of for his commission
introduced.quote: Well, have you brought me ten Iron Chunks?

assumed.name: prize ore
assumed.quote: Repairs are free, just let me know if you come across any prize ore.

threads.claim: Master Zhang's commission for Iron Chunks is only partly filled, and he needs more for his customers.
threads.quote: Hmm... These Iron Chunks should be enough, for now...

introduced.name: Matsumoto
introduced.how: a food critic who rates dishes and posted a commission for fried eggs
introduced.quote: Matsumoto: Are you here to ask me to rate your dishes? Don't you disappoint me again.

introduced.name: Matsumoto's commission
introduced.how: a posted request for 5 Teyvat Fried Eggs, made because talented chefs are thought to be hidden
