threads.quote: Ineffa: They appear to be "gifts from the Moon Goddess."

threads.claim: The Damselette deliberately avoids being seen by others and returns objects without revealing herself.
threads.quote: Paimon: If you don't mind Paimon asking, how do you plan to fix this lyre? Didn't you say you didn't want to be seen by others?

introduced.name: The Damselette
introduced.how: named as Columbina; a singer who teaches the kuuhenki the lyre
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hey there, Columbina!

introduced.name: kuuhenki
introduced.how: a group who learn the lyre and rarely hear music from other places
introduced.quote: Rarely do the kuuhenki get to hear music from other places.

introduced.name: Lullaby of the New Moon (I): Somnias a Luna
introduced.how: the song Columbina usually sings, which the Traveler can play on an instrument
introduced.quote: I was having them practice the song I usually sing. Perhaps you remember how it goes...

introduced.name: Lullaby of the New Moon (II): Lucens ut risus
introduced.how: a second lullaby, playable on an instrument, which Columbina says is the only lullaby she can remember
introduced.quote: (Opens instrument interface and plays a part of Lullaby of the New Moon (II): Lucens ut risus)

assumed.name: True Moon
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed True Moon)

assumed.name: A Gift From Her
assumed.quote: (After A Gift From Her this mini-game is part of the weekly randomly options)

assumed.name: Silvermoon Hall
assumed.quote: (Enter Silvermoon Hall)

assumed.name: Lullaby of the New Moon (I) prior conversation
assumed.quote: As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.

threads.claim: Columbina cannot yet discern the meaning of her lullaby, and she senses an answer waiting for her on the moon.
threads.quote: Although I have yet to discern the meaning behind it, after hearing you play, I feel like whatever answer is waiting for me, up there on the moon...

threads.claim: The answer on the moon was witnessed together after piercing through cloud and fog, and it is described as beautiful.
threads.quote: We have pierced through cloud and fog, and together, witnessed the answer on the moon... Its beauty is like the music your strings now sing.

threads.claim: Columbina can remember only one lullaby, hinting at a gap in her memory.
threads.quote: As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.

threads.claim: Columbina has only imagined distant landscapes through music and has never seen them herself.
threads.quote: I wonder how the real thing compares to my imagination...

introduced.name: Ja:マーナのバターのリクエスト
introduced.how: Muirne asks the Traveler to bring her butter for her bread, since she is not given enough at meals
introduced.quote: I'm thinking that maybe I should just bring butter with me in the future.

assumed.name: Muirne
assumed.quote: Muirne: Did you bring the butter?

introduced.name: Murakami
introduced.how: Introduces himself as a seller of festival snacks who offers the Traveler samples
introduced.quote: Murakami: Greetings, we sell festival snacks here. Would you like to try some?

introduced.name: Mint
introduced.how: An ingredient Murakami needs; with it he could create new flavors, and he wants 15 of them
introduced.quote: Murakami: Mint, yes, Mint's what I need... With Mint, I could create whole new flavors...

assumed.name: commission
assumed.quote: Murakami: I'm guessing you accepted my commission? In which case, I'm guessing you also have 15 Mints for me...?

introduced.name: Khedive
introduced.how: A researcher studying the mushrooms of The Chasm for the Akademiya, who wants a conclusion from samples
introduced.quote: I'm sure I can outdo the research goals set by the Akademiya this year.

introduced.name: Akademiya Recommendation Letter
introduced.how: A letter from Khedive that gives help in Sumeru, granted after the three investigation quests
introduced.quote: Here, take this letter.

introduced.name: House of Purbiruni
introduced.how: A place in Sumeru where the letter holder can get help on their journey
introduced.quote: If you ever run into any trouble or need some help in your future journey in Sumeru, bring it to the House of Purbiruni.

introduced.name: Glowing mushrooms
introduced.how: Mushrooms found in The Chasm that look like a Sumeru species but glow, and are the subject of the investigation
introduced.quote: It's just that they look similar to an indigenous mushroom in Sumeru.

introduced.name: Fragment that fell from the sky
introduced.how: A fragment from the sky that Khedive hints is linked to the glow, but she does not explain what it is
introduced.quote: It's probably because of the fragment that fell from the sky.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: It's just that they look similar to an indigenous mushroom in Sumeru.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: I'm sure I can outdo the research goals set by the Akademiya this year.

assumed.name: The Chasm
assumed.quote: Since they aren't an indigenous species of The Chasm, they didn't evolve to glow.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: what do they call it in Liyue?

assumed.name: Investigation quests
assumed.quote: After completing all three investigation quests, the player will be granted the and receive the Akademiya Recommendation Letter from Khedive.

threads.claim: The glowing mushrooms may be linked to a fragment that fell from the sky, which is an unexplained hint.
threads.quote: It's probably because of the fragment that fell from the sky.

threads.claim: Khedive abruptly retracts the sky-fragment hint and offers a random mutation explanation instead.
threads.quote: Undergone some random mutation.

threads.claim: The mushrooms found in The Chasm are of Sumeru origin, which raises the question of how they got there.
threads.quote: That's why I'm so certain of their Sumeru origin.

threads.claim: The glow is not an evolved trait but an abnormal ecological phenomenon, so its cause remains open.
threads.quote: Since they aren't an indigenous species of The Chasm, they didn't evolve to glow.

threads.claim: A Sumeru saying holds that connections are worth more than gold, a theme of relationships over wealth.
threads.quote: Connections are far more precious than gold.

introduced.name: Roland
introduced.how: A knight's spirit appears, guarding the battlefield and speaking of a blood-soaked path walked alone
introduced.quote: (The spirit of Roland appears before him, followed by a few other knights and a Pale-Furred Wolf)

introduced.name: Nameless Knights
introduced.how: Spirits of knights who followed a knight from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai and died fighting monsters here
introduced.quote: Who's to say we didn't just happen to be following the same path, all the way from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai?

introduced.name: Boreas
introduced.how: A knight whose power is left in the battlefield and used to seal it off
introduced.quote: Roland: I shall use the power left here by Boreas to seal off this battlefield.

introduced.name: The Homesick Lone Wolf
introduced.how: A wolf with an Ancestral Spirit that takes Boreas's Shadow's place in the fight
introduced.quote: Boreas's Shadow temporarily disappears, and is replaced by

introduced.name: Pale-Furred Wolf
introduced.how: A wolf that appears with Roland and the knights and stands guard outside
introduced.quote: (The spirit of Roland appears before him, followed by a few other knights and a Pale-Furred Wolf)

introduced.name: Unbreakable: Durandarte
introduced.how: A pair of greatswords the player obtains after the battle, which Varka takes up
introduced.quote: (Obtain Unbreakable: Durandarte)

introduced.name: Bloodstained Knight
introduced.how: A knight who departed, and whose followers were later lost from the Knights of Favonius records
introduced.quote: The Knights of Favonius's records say that when the Bloodstained Knight departed, there were knights who chose to follow him

introduced.name: Wolf Spirit
introduced.how: A guardian spirit of the place that will keep watch over the sealed battlefield
introduced.quote: Roland: At the very least, let these swords, and the Wolf Spirit in this place, serve as your guardians — to prevent the dark aberrations from disturbing your eternal rest.

introduced.name: Ancient battlefield
introduced.how: A sealed ancient battlefield where the knights' spirits and monsters remain
introduced.quote: Varka: An ancient battlefield... Who could've sealed this place off?

assumed.name: Wolf of the North
assumed.quote: Varka: Is this the power of the Wolf of the North? Strange, though — I'm also getting more than just a hint of the Falcon of the West...

assumed.name: Falcon of the West
assumed.quote: Varka: Is this the power of the Wolf of the North? Strange, though — I'm also getting more than just a hint of the Falcon of the West...

assumed.name: Andrius
assumed.quote: Varka: A manifestation of Andrius? Now I've really gotta figure out what's going on...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: Varka: To think that they perished here fighting monsters... A worthy end for true Knights of Favonius.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Who's to say we didn't just happen to be following the same path, all the way from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai?

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Who's to say we didn't just happen to be following the same path, all the way from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai?

assumed.name: Wolf Spirit
assumed.quote: Varka: Huh, a manifestation of the Wolf Spirit... A piece I didn't know about?

threads.claim: Varka senses hints of the Wolf of the North and the Falcon of the West in the battlefield's power, an open question.
threads.quote: Varka: Is this the power of the Wolf of the North? Strange, though — I'm also getting more than just a hint of the Falcon of the West...

threads.claim: Who sealed the ancient battlefield off is an open question.
threads.quote: Varka: An ancient battlefield... Who could've sealed this place off?

threads.claim: Roland reveals he used Boreas's remaining power to seal off the battlefield.
threads.quote: Roland: I shall use the power left here by Boreas to seal off this battlefield.

threads.claim: Knights of Favonius records say followers of the Bloodstained Knight were never mentioned again, leaving their fate unknown.
threads.quote: The Knights of Favonius's records say that when the Bloodstained Knight departed, there were knights who chose to follow him

threads.claim: The nameless knights are revealed as spirits who followed a revered knight from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai and chose to stay with him.
threads.quote: Who's to say we didn't just happen to be following the same path, all the way from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai?

threads.claim: The followers perished fighting monsters at the battlefield, which Varka calls a worthy end.
threads.quote: Varka: To think that they perished here fighting monsters... A worthy end for true Knights of Favonius.

threads.claim: Roland's face is hidden when he removes his mask, leaving his identity unrevealed.
threads.quote: (Roland removes his mask, but his face is hidden by the camera)

threads.claim: Roland says he could not protect all his companions and that only one remains to walk the path, deepening his unexplained fate.
threads.quote: Roland: ...In the end, only one remains to walk the path... Perhaps, the way it was always meant to be.

threads.claim: Varka suspects a manifestation of Andrius is involved in the battlefield, an open question.
threads.quote: Varka: A manifestation of Andrius? Now I've really gotta figure out what's going on...

threads.claim: A distant voice speaks of an unextinguished flame of battle that must be taken.
threads.quote: Distant Voice: ...Take... the unextinguished flame of battle...

threads.claim: Varka asks the knights about their resolve and the longing in their swords, probing what they truly wished for.
threads.quote: Varka: The unextinguished flame of battle, the longing that dwells within your swords... Tell me, Knights, of your resolve.

introduced.name: Ivanovich
introduced.how: a merchant who must obtain a new business permit to keep trading in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: I wish to continue doing business here, so I've been out and about these few days, trudging my way through a deluge of paperwork

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.how: a city where contracts and written records are of utmost importance
introduced.quote: Haha. Well, this is Liyue Harbor, after all. Contracts are of utmost importance.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: an authority that issued new bulletins and regulations, including business permit rules
introduced.quote: the Ministry of Civil Affairs has released a whole slew of new bulletins and regulations.

introduced.name: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
introduced.how: a public board where community news and shop advertisements are posted
introduced.quote: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here.

introduced.name: Nervous An
introduced.how: a clerk who handles only exit permits and rejects other documents
introduced.quote: I only handle exit permits here. I'm not in charge of any other documents.

introduced.name: Jiayi
introduced.how: an ad-hoc Millelith helper who collects and files business certificates
introduced.quote: No, no, I'm ad-hoc help, just like you. Clerk Zhao has her hands full at the moment, So I've been called in to help collect and file those certificates.

introduced.name: Clerk Zhao
introduced.how: the official who handles business permit applications and issues the new permit
introduced.quote: Clerk Zhao said that I also need to apply for a new business permit, and told me to stay tuned for any more announcements.

introduced.name: Approved Exit Permit
introduced.how: a signed exit permit that must be submitted to Nervous An
introduced.quote: (After giving him the Approved Exit Permit)

introduced.name: Business Premises and Safety Certificates
introduced.how: two business certificates required for the permit application, submitted to Jiayi
introduced.quote: (After giving him the Business Premises and Safety Certificates)

introduced.name: Old Business Permit
introduced.how: a prior business permit that Clerk Zhao collects before issuing a new one
introduced.quote: (After giving her the Old Business Permit)

assumed.name: earlier unrest in Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Well, you've seen what happened in Liyue Harbor earlier, yes? It gave us all quite the fright.

assumed.name: Liyue Qixing
assumed.quote: The Liyue Qixing are quite something, indeed.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: The must go to Nervous An first. Then, the have to be handed in to a Millelith soldier named Jiayi

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Is Snezhnaya like this too?

threads.claim: An unexplained disturbance in Liyue Harbor was quickly brought under control, and its cause is left unstated.
threads.quote: Well, you've seen what happened in Liyue Harbor earlier, yes? It gave us all quite the fright.

threads.claim: The Ministry's flood of new regulations after the unrest may have motives beyond restoring order.
threads.quote: But whether it was to stabilize the situation or otherwise, the Ministry of Civil Affairs has released a whole slew of new bulletins and regulations.

threads.claim: A recent contamination of Feiyun Slope's water supply is posted on the board but is never explained.
threads.quote: Regarding the recent contamination of Feiyun Slope's water supply...

threads.claim: Snezhnaya's administrative methods are hinted to be very different from Liyue's, to be experienced firsthand.
threads.quote: You'll see what I mean, though, if you ever get the opportunity to set foot in Snezhnaya.

threads.claim: Paperwork is portrayed as both a source of security and an exhausting burden.
threads.quote: These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.

introduced.name: Liyue Katheryne
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild contact in Liyue who becomes the Traveler's point of contact there
introduced.quote: Anyway, once Liyue Katheryne has this letter, she will be your point of contact there for all your adventuring needs.

introduced.name: Liyue Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild in Liyue that offers Commissions and welcomes the Traveler
introduced.quote: If that's true, I'm sure you are ready to take on Commissions from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: A wider world beyond Mondstadt that the Traveler is about to be able to explore
introduced.quote: But all that is about to change. Soon, you will be able to venture into the world beyond.

introduced.name: Adventurer identity letter
introduced.how: Letter from the Mondstadt guild that vouches for the Traveler's identity and background
introduced.quote: There is more than enough information contained in this letter to establish your identity and background.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: The tales of your deeds are now known to all in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne? ...Oh, you must mean Mondstadt Katheryne.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: This letter from the Mondstadt Aventurers' Guild says that you are a highly experienced Adventurer.

assumed.name: Dandelion
assumed.quote: What's this — a Dandelion? Why is there a Dandelion in the envelope?

assumed.name: Commissions
assumed.quote: Any new Commissions?

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

threads.claim: Mondstadt Katheryne put a Dandelion in the letter for an unexplained reason, which stays an open question.
threads.quote: Why did she put a Dandelion in with the letter? Very odd... A Dandelion isn't much use to an Adventurer, now, is it?

threads.claim: Liyue Katheryne is a separate figure from Mondstadt Katheryne, making the shared name a recurring point.
threads.quote: There's a Katheryne in Liyue too?

threads.claim: The Traveler's path is framed as a step toward the stars and the abyss, a motif the text repeats.
threads.quote: Adventurer! The time has come for you to take the next step towards the stars and the abyss. Ad astra abyssosque!

threads.claim: The Traveler's adventures have so far been limited to Mondstadt, and the wider world beyond is about to open.
threads.quote: That is because your adventures this far have all been limited to the Mondstadt area.

threads.claim: The sealed letter's contents are kept hidden and could cause complications if opened early.
threads.quote: I would ask that you refrain from opening the letter en route. If anything were to fall out, it could cause complications.

introduced.name: Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: vendor who builds snowmen at the Bing-Bang Finchball stall
introduced.quote: Alrighty! Hello world, Snow-Vodyanitsa! From now on, when I'm not around, I'll be counting on her to watch the stall and attract customers.

introduced.name: Snow-Vodyanitsa
introduced.how: a snowman named after Vodyanitsa that watches the stall
introduced.quote: Alrighty! Hello world, Snow-Vodyanitsa! From now on, when I'm not around, I'll be counting on her to watch the stall and attract customers.

introduced.name: Phonograph
introduced.how: a device that could make a snowman sing and talk if it were cold-resistant
introduced.quote: I actually wanted to hide a phonograph or something similar the snowman, to give it the ability to sing and talk nonstop.

introduced.name: Lyumina
introduced.how: a dog who carries letters to Alyosha for Vodyanitsa
introduced.quote: Yeah. In the past, whenever I've wanted to send a letter to Alyosha, I've always gotten Lyumina to help.

introduced.name: Odette
introduced.how: a stage dancer whose performances Vodyanitsa's songs alternate with
introduced.quote: On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, they'll play my songs, and on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, they can play the music Odette dances to...

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: a hard-to-find hunter who lays low in the wild
introduced.quote: He's probably out hunting again. Hard guy to pin down... I guess I'll go ahead and put the decorations up.

introduced.name: Rytova
introduced.how: a student Odette gives practice pointers to
introduced.quote: It's time. I need to give Rytova some pointers now. If you want to watch, you can tag along.

assumed.name: Bing-Bang Finchball
assumed.quote: Ugh, no, no, no. That's not how we want Bing-Bang Finchball to make a name for itself...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: maybe you could invite those tech-savvy friends of yours to Snezhnaya.

assumed.name: Fontaine Research Institute
assumed.quote: And that's without even counting the people at the Fontaine Research Institute.

assumed.name: Fatui Harbinger
assumed.quote: (Sandrone...? Do they mean the Fatui Harbinger!? Huh... Whatever, it's none of my business.)

assumed.name: Lady Marionette
assumed.quote: Oh, except Lady Marionette of course, I wouldn't want to bother her.

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: I'll go look for the Kamera.

threads.claim: A snowman speaks for the first time, hinting that the snowmen may be able to talk.
threads.quote: I need some pretty decorations!

threads.claim: The Traveler hints that someone present is a fae and not to be underestimated.
threads.quote: Never underestimate a fae...

threads.claim: Sandrone may be a Fatui Harbinger, a hint that a Fatui connection is among the friends Vodyanitsa could call on.
threads.quote: (Sandrone...? Do they mean the Fatui Harbinger!? Huh... Whatever, it's none of my business.)

threads.claim: Lady Marionette is mentioned as someone Vodyanitsa would not want to bother, hinting at a figure of standing.
threads.quote: oh, except Lady Marionette of course, I wouldn't want to bother her.

introduced.name: Genius Invokation TCG
introduced.how: a card game played with decks, attack speeds, and resources, with a community of players and a development team
introduced.quote: I'm in the middle of trying to build a Genius Invokation deck with a relatively slow attack speed.

introduced.name: King of Invokations
introduced.how: a card-game novel by Fukumoto, now on its third book, that Cyno has read
introduced.quote: I'm working on the third book of "King of Invokations," and this time, I'm not going to base it on the gameplay mechanics of Genius Invokation TCG.

introduced.name: Fukumoto
introduced.how: the author of King of Invokations, who writes novels and plays the card game
introduced.quote: This is the author of "King of Invokations."

introduced.name: Cyno
introduced.how: General Mahamatra, a skilled Genius Invokation player who has read the novel and agrees to model for it
introduced.quote: Hello, General Mahamatra. I don't suppose you've heard of me...

introduced.name: Puspa Café
introduced.how: a café where Cyno sometimes goes to play cards
introduced.quote: He said Cyno sometimes goes to Puspa Café to play cards.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: *sigh* I want to go back to Inazuma... How could this happen to me...

assumed.name: Haravatat
assumed.quote: For example, a Haravatat researcher suddenly asked a question one day.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: I told you earlier about a researcher who said they'd introduce me to Tighnari and Cyno, and ask them to be the inspirations for my novel.

assumed.name: Asagiri
assumed.quote: I'm sure Asagiri will make an excellent illustration!

assumed.name: Nahida's All Schemes to Know
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Fukumoto, optional)

threads.claim: The Traveler has a close, personal connection to Cyno that Fukumoto notices but does not pry into.
threads.quote: I know Cyno pretty well.

threads.claim: Cyno argues that the novel's winning style departs from the real game's mechanics, raising the tension between fiction and game rules.
threads.quote: this way of winning is a departure from the fundamental mechanics of Genius Invokation TCG.

introduced.name: Nine Pillars
introduced.how: stone pillars raised to suppress conflict so that armies never again fight each other
introduced.quote: Nine pillars we raise here to suppress conflict, that we may never again raise armies against each other...

introduced.name: Nine mortal desires
introduced.how: nine human desires that can either heal the world or greatly harm it
introduced.quote: These nine mortal desires may heal the world, or do it great hurt. Their fire will never diminish, and it will never fade...

introduced.name: Cuijue Slope
introduced.how: a ruin surrounded by nine pillars with a stone tablet at its center, said to hold treasure
introduced.quote: Were those ruins surrounded by nine pillars, with a stone tablet in the center, by any chance?

introduced.name: Linlang
introduced.how: a Liyue antique appraiser who claims to be the best at valuing such items
introduced.quote: An antique? Well, you've come to the right person. I'd say that I'm the fairest at valuating such things in all of Liyue.

introduced.name: Bolai
introduced.how: a dealer in antiques and curios who offers to buy the ring
introduced.quote: Antiques and curios? I'm not too familiar with them, but I'll have a look.

introduced.name: Jade ring
introduced.how: an ancient, well-preserved ring set with a fine jade gem and bearing an inscription, found in a ruin
introduced.quote: This ring... Huh, it's set with a jade gem, and one of good quality, too. Just the gem alone would be worth a sum.

introduced.name: Liyue forebears' pillar legend
introduced.how: a legend that Liyue's ancestors built the nine pillars to quell conflict
introduced.quote: They even say that those pillars and that ruin were built by Liyue's forebears in order to quell conflict...

assumed.name: Jueyun Karst
assumed.quote: Jueyun Karst is so nearby, too...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: O you who read this tablet, claim the treasure that lies within, and bring peace to Liyue.

threads.claim: Breaking the pillars and entering the ruin would bring war back to the world.
threads.quote: If one who comes after will break those pillars and enter, war shall once again consume the world.

threads.claim: The nine mortal desires have an unending fire that can either heal or harm the world.
threads.quote: These nine mortal desires may heal the world, or do it great hurt. Their fire will never diminish, and it will never fade...

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the nine pillars truly quelled conflict, as locals treat their origin as a legend.
threads.quote: But I suppose that's just a legend. After all, if nine stone pillars could quell strife, this world would have been at peace long ago.

threads.claim: The ring's inscription about rampant disaster refers to a source that no one recognizes.
threads.quote: Still, I can't say I've ever heard the phrase

threads.claim: The ring's storied history and origin raise its value and link it to the pillar legend.
threads.quote: It's got a name, a history to go with it, and it's of good quality, too.

threads.claim: The ruins likely hold more precious gems and treasure beyond the ring.
threads.quote: There must be other such gems within those ruins...

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: the organization that receives reports and assigns official work to the Traveler
introduced.quote: The Guild has been receiving a constant stream of reports about earthquakes in those areas recently.

introduced.name: Tianqiu Valley
introduced.how: was once a prosperous settlement in the ancient past and now holds a huge cavern
introduced.quote: Hmm, according to some texts, Tianqiu Valley was once a prosperous settlement at some point in the ancient past.

introduced.name: Geovishap
introduced.how: monsters that once terrorized Liyue and are now appearing in great numbers near the cavern
introduced.quote: Based on the descriptions, they may well be none other than the Geovishaps and Primo Geovishaps that once terrorized Liyue...

introduced.name: Primo Geovishap
introduced.how: a powerful monster found inside the cavern, possibly behind the earthquakes
introduced.quote: ...A giant cavern ruin, high levels of monster activity, and a Primo Geovishap within...

introduced.name: Tianqiu Valley cavern
introduced.how: a gigantic cavern revealed when an earthquake collapsed part of the mountains and ruins
introduced.quote: Then, not long ago, we received word of a particularly strong earthquake that caused part of the mountains and ruins to collapse, revealing a gigantic cavern.

introduced.name: earthquakes
introduced.how: minor tremors in Tianqiu Valley and Nantianmen that have grown steadily more serious
introduced.quote: It was just minor tremors at first, but they've been getting more and more serious since.

introduced.name: ancient dragon king
introduced.how: a dragon king whose rampage ruined the valley, imprisoned by Rex Lapis according to legend
introduced.quote: As to how it came to be the way it is now, it seems to have had something to do with the rampage of an ancient dragon king...

assumed.name: Zhiping
assumed.quote: Oh, , it's you. Pleased to see you, though I certainly wasn't expecting to run into you today.

assumed.name: Nantianmen
assumed.quote: Have you been to Tianqiu Valley or Nantianmen lately?

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Based on the descriptions, they may well be none other than the Geovishaps and Primo Geovishaps that once terrorized Liyue...

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: There aren't a lot of details available about that incident, but legend has it that Rex Lapis and his adepti eventually imprisoned it within some sort of adepti realm.

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: There aren't a lot of details available about that incident, but legend has it that Rex Lapis and his adepti eventually imprisoned it within some sort of adepti realm.

threads.claim: Escalating earthquakes and a newly revealed cavern in Tianqiu Valley raise the question of what is causing them.
threads.quote: Then, not long ago, we received word of a particularly strong earthquake that caused part of the mountains and ruins to collapse, revealing a gigantic cavern.

threads.claim: The Primo Geovishap in the cavern may be the source of the earthquakes, though this is only suggested.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is this what's been causing those earthquakes? So powerful... so scary!

threads.claim: The Primo Geovishap's nature is unknown to the Traveler and Paimon, who want someone to explain it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Still... what was that? If only there was someone we could ask...

threads.claim: The dragon king's servants may still sleep underground, waiting for the dragon king to rise again.
threads.quote: Its servants then fled into the depths of the earth and entered a deep slumber, waiting for the day when the dragon king would rise again.

threads.claim: Legend says Rex Lapis and the adepti imprisoned the dragon king in an adepti realm, but the details are unclear.
threads.quote: There aren't a lot of details available about that incident, but legend has it that Rex Lapis and his adepti eventually imprisoned it within some sort of adepti realm.

threads.claim: The monster sightings may be connected to the dragon king legend, but Zhiping dismisses the folktales and their truth remains unknown.
threads.quote: Hahaha. Those are just folktales, you know? No one knows how true they are.

threads.claim: Tianqiu Valley was once a prosperous ancient settlement, and something in its past caused its current ruined state.
threads.quote: Hmm, according to some texts, Tianqiu Valley was once a prosperous settlement at some point in the ancient past.

introduced.name: Cyrus (Mondstadt)
introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild leader who commands investigating adventurers from within Mondstadt's walls
introduced.quote: Cyrus: Almost everyone is out investigating, and I must remain here to command them.

introduced.name: Whispering Woods
introduced.how: wild area where monsters are gathering, reported by investigating adventurers
introduced.quote: Cyrus: Ah, yes. Some of our investigating adventurers have informed me that there are monsters congregating in the Whispering Woods.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Mondstadt's city-defending knights, admired by young people for their armor and glory
introduced.quote: Cyrus: It is up to us to take those monsters out in the wild on, while the Knights of Favonius are still focused on defending the city and the area around Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: group of adventurers who investigate and clear the wild, but are seen as unimpressive and overlooked
introduced.quote: Cyrus: As for the Adventurers' Guild, the only impression of us people have is that of people who bumble about outdoors... Basically, no one cares about us.

introduced.name: Pyro Slime barrels
introduced.how: monsters have stacked dangerous barrels of Pyro Slime in the wild
introduced.quote: Paimon: Look at all those barrels of Pyro Slime! Only those monsters would dare to do something so dangerous. Let's help them clear these away, shall we?

introduced.name: Storm evacuation contingency plans
introduced.how: Cyrus had planned to scatter people in the wild, teach survival, and avoid storms before the storms stopped
introduced.quote: Cyrus: My contingencies included ways to scatter the people in the wild to avoid the storms, teach them how to survive...

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Ah, this... Well, you know how the young people in Mondstadt all wish to join the Knights of Favonius, with their shining armor, their flying banners, the glory, and Master Jean as well...

assumed.name: Bennett
assumed.quote: Cyrus: *sigh* Where has that kid Bennett run off to? I hope he didn't run into any trouble.

assumed.name: Storm
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Monsters are still in the area, eh? So it seems that the effects of the Storm have yet to disperse...

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Ah, this... Well, you know how the young people in Mondstadt all wish to join the Knights of Favonius, with their shining armor, their flying banners, the glory, and Master Jean as well...

assumed.name: Pyro Slime
assumed.quote: Paimon: Look at all those barrels of Pyro Slime! Only those monsters would dare to do something so dangerous. Let's help them clear these away, shall we?

threads.claim: The storms stopped suddenly, and Cyrus finds the timing unsettling.
threads.quote: Cyrus: Hmm... But it's all too sudden. I came up with so many contingency plans. Are we not going to get the chance to any of them?

threads.claim: The effects of the Storm have not yet dispersed, so monsters remain in the area.
threads.quote: Cyrus: Monsters are still in the area, eh? So it seems that the effects of the Storm have yet to disperse...

threads.claim: Monsters are congregating in the Whispering Woods, and their purpose is unknown.
threads.quote: Cyrus: Ah, yes. Some of our investigating adventurers have informed me that there are monsters congregating in the Whispering Woods.

threads.claim: There are far more monsters than the Traveler has seen so far, suggesting a larger threat.
threads.quote: Paimon: There's still so many monsters... Seems we've only seen the beginning of them...

threads.claim: Monsters may be building a camp and a bonfire, possibly for a dangerous purpose.
threads.quote: Paimon: Look at this tower... Are the monsters preparing to build a camp here?

threads.claim: Bennett has run off somewhere and may be in trouble, and his whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Cyrus: *sigh* Where has that kid Bennett run off to? I hope he didn't run into any trouble.

threads.claim: The Adventurers' Guild is viewed as unimpressive and struggles to attract new members.
threads.quote: Cyrus: I thought to myself that if there was an opportunity to show the Guild's mettle, we might be able to bring in more fresh blood.

threads.claim: The Guild gets a chance to prove itself by clearing the monsters in the wild while the Knights stay on defense.
threads.quote: Cyrus: It is up to us to take those monsters out in the wild on, while the Knights of Favonius are still focused on defending the city and the area around Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Shouta
introduced.how: a student who makes wishes and offerings at a shrine and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Shouta: Ugh... This isn't good...

introduced.name: Kouichi
introduced.how: a local who visits shrines hoping for blessings to travel the outside world someday
introduced.quote: Kouichi: Hello, what can I help you with?

introduced.name: Yayoi Nanatsuki
introduced.how: a knowledgeable local who explains why people give offerings to shrines
introduced.quote: Yayoi Nanatsuki: Shouta? Why do you look so upset? Did someone bully you?

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group of thieves who steal offerings left at shrines and are fought in the field
introduced.quote: Paimon: Are they... Treasure Hoarders? Why are they here...

introduced.name: Shrine outside the city
introduced.how: a shrine outside the city where locals leave offerings and make wishes
introduced.quote: Shouta: Please help me! Please come with me to the shrine outside the city and take a look!

introduced.name: Offerings to deities
introduced.how: offerings are a form of prayer that builds people's confidence, not a guarantee that wishes come true
introduced.quote: The reason people give offerings and ask for blessings isn't that they want their wish to be granted.

assumed.name: Deity granting part of Shouta's wish
assumed.quote: Shouta: But when we went there the first time, the deity granted a part of my wish after accepting my offerings...

assumed.name: Past wishes granted by the deity (fire, stronger mister, comic book)
assumed.quote: That time with the fire, that mister who wanted to become stronger, and that comic book of mine...

assumed.name: Inazuma and its deities
assumed.quote: I don't think Inazuma's deities would be able to protect me.

threads.claim: Whether the deity answers offerings is left uncertain, since the deity has not replied to Shouta yet.
threads.quote: However, the deity hasn't responded to me yet.

threads.claim: Offerings are meant to build confidence to act on one's wishes rather than to have the deity grant them directly.
threads.quote: Rather, those people gave their offerings to build a firm base for their confidence.

threads.claim: Nanatsuki argues that people, not prayer alone, move the world and that deities cannot act without people taking action.
threads.quote: At the end of the day... It's people that move the world.

threads.claim: Shouta cannot recall the name or arrival time of the girl who bullies him, which raises doubts about who she is.
threads.quote: Weird... Why can't I remember anything? The only thing that I can remember is a girl telling me to study...

threads.claim: The Traveler senses that the deity's supposed actions, such as sending a nagging classmate, do not fit how a deity normally behaves.
threads.quote: It doesn't feel like something a deity would do...

threads.claim: Unexplained leaves have appeared on the road, something that was not there before and may hint at a strange presence.
threads.quote: Huh? Wait. Why are there leaves on the road? They weren't here before...

introduced.name: Mr. Zhu
introduced.how: a former traveler who now runs a restaurant and cannot recall one dish he loved
introduced.quote: Mr. Zhu: Oh, a traveler. When I was young I used to travel all over the place.

introduced.name: Emerald Maple Inn
introduced.how: Mr. Zhu's restaurant in Liyue, opened to recreate flavors from his travels
introduced.quote: After eating my way across the continent, I returned to Liyue and opened my restaurant, Emerald Maple, in the hopes I could recreate the flavors of my travels.

introduced.name: Sweetened Mistress
introduced.how: a sweet, nutritious dish made from Fowl and Sweet Flowers that Mr. Zhu wants recreated
introduced.quote: The ingredients are a lot of Fowl and some Sweet Flowers. It's called... Sweetened Mistress or something like that.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: After eating my way across the continent, I returned to Liyue and opened my restaurant, Emerald Maple, in the hopes I could recreate the flavors of my travels.

assumed.name: continent
assumed.quote: After eating my way across the continent, I returned to Liyue and opened my restaurant, Emerald Maple, in the hopes I could recreate the flavors of my travels.

threads.claim: Mr. Zhu cannot remember the name or flavor of a dish from his travels, leaving its identity an open question.
threads.quote: Mr. Zhu: But there's this one dish I can never quite remember the name of.

threads.claim: The Traveler's first candidate dish is rejected, so the search for the true dish continues.
threads.quote: Traveler: Not yet.

threads.claim: The Traveler's dish is confirmed as the one Mr. Zhu remembers, resolving the mystery of the lost flavor.
threads.quote: Mr. Zhu: Aha! This is the one! Mmm, yes, that's the taste I remember!

introduced.name: Wakamurasaki
introduced.how: Sango's friend who calls herself a designer and modifies the Ubiquity Net
introduced.quote: Her name is Wakamurasaki, and she's... Well, she calls herself a

introduced.name: Omni-Ubiquity Net
introduced.how: a new modified version of the Ubiquity Net that captures small creatures' essences and recreates them
introduced.quote: remember, it's the Omni-Ubiquity Net now, not just the Ubiquity Net!

introduced.name: Onmyoudou essence-detaining technique
introduced.how: a technique that detains a living creature's essence and recreates its shape using media objects
introduced.quote: this technique is able to detain the essence of living creatures before using certain objects as media to recreate the shape of that living being.

introduced.name: Onmyoudou
introduced.how: Onmyoudou techniques are ancient, and only records of them remain
introduced.quote: There are only records of such an onmyoudou technique existing.

introduced.name: Kamuna Onmyoudou
introduced.how: a long-lost onmyoudou school whose technique could be used in a rumor about a truth-telling net
introduced.quote: The long-lost Kamuna Onmyoudou, the Bantan Sango Detective Agency, and a net that can indeed detain the essences of small creatures.

introduced.name: Bantan Sango Detective Agency
introduced.how: Sango's detective agency, which he runs
introduced.quote: The long-lost Kamuna Onmyoudou, the Bantan Sango Detective Agency, and a net that can indeed detain the essences of small creatures.

assumed.name: Ubiquity Net
assumed.quote: Do you still remember the Ubiquity Net, by any chance?

assumed.name: Kageroumaru
assumed.quote: Ugh, that Wakamurasaki... I shouldn't have let her know about Kageroumaru...

assumed.name: Sango
assumed.quote: Oh, hello there, Traveler.

threads.claim: Sango regrets having let Wakamurasaki learn about Kageroumaru, hinting it is a dangerous secret.
threads.quote: Ugh, that Wakamurasaki... I shouldn't have let her know about Kageroumaru...

threads.claim: Wakamurasaki keeps pushing Sango for new techniques to modify the Ubiquity Net.
threads.quote: So she's been badgering me this whole time to help her look up new techniques with which she can continue modifying the Ubiquity Net...

threads.claim: Wakamurasaki claims a technique can recreate a human essence that answers questions without lying.
threads.quote: Such essences can answer questions and will never lie.

threads.claim: Sango says a technique that detains a human's essence is impossible and only works on small animals.
threads.quote: Uh, no. That's not possible.

threads.claim: Each Omni-Ubiquity Net can only be used once because the medium cannot withstand repeated use.
threads.quote: Well, basically, each net can only be used once.

threads.claim: Sango deliberately spread a rumor about a truth-compelling net to frighten criminals, having fed Wakamurasaki an impossible technique.
threads.quote: Oh, that? I just wanted Wakamurasaki to help me spread a certain something around.

introduced.name: Tea Master Liu Su
introduced.how: tea house storyteller who is frustrated with the squeaky stage and wants a carpenter
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Ugh, just my luck. I'm not gonna tell any more stories today, not today, I swear it!

introduced.name: Fan Er'ye
introduced.how: tea house boss who keeps refusing to replace the old stage
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: I've long told our boss, Fan Er'ye, that it needed to be replaced, but he would always brush me off, saying that he couldn't find a good carpenter to do the job.

introduced.name: Fanmu Carpenter's
introduced.how: carpentry business in Qingce Village known for good skills
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Well, then, how about you go to Qingce Village and look for Master Lu at Fanmu Carpenter's. He's known for good skills. Please ask him if he's willing to help me.

introduced.name: Master Lu
introduced.how: skilled carpenter at Fanmu Carpenter's in Qingce Village who is too old to travel
introduced.quote: Master Lu: Liyue Harbor is too far away. No one will be taking care of Fanmu Carpenter's if I go.

introduced.name: Dayu
introduced.how: carpenter in Qingce Village who is not yet Master Lu's apprentice but takes jobs for him
introduced.quote: Master Lu: Although he's not yet my apprentice, I've been considering the possibility of accepting him...

introduced.name: Yun Jin
introduced.how: performer whose spear flourish draws audiences and who visits the tea house and Granny Ruoxin
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Just think about it: Every time Ms. Yun gives her marvelous "spear flourish" performance, the audience will hear the squeak of the stage before they even get to applaud.

introduced.name: Yun-Han Opera Troupe
introduced.how: opera troupe that has worked with the tea house for decades
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Our tea house has collaborated with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe for decades. Ms. Yun would naturally feel more approachable around us.

introduced.name: Third-Round Knockout
introduced.how: rival tea house that is drawing customers away from Heyu Tea House
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: You're quite an optimist, aren't you? But I heard that many people have chosen to go to Third-Round Knockout instead of our tea house lately.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: Qingce Village resident who was Fan Er'ye's stage partner in the past
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: Fan Er'ye used to be an opera singer when he was young, and he often performed together with Granny Ruoxin.

introduced.name: Fan Er'ye's past stage partnership with Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: they were a stage couple, and she later left the stage for Qingce Village with another man who never arrived
introduced.quote: Yun Jin: But Granny Ruoxin had feelings for someone else. Later, she grew tired of stage performance and then decided to go to Qingce Village with the one she loved.

introduced.name: 50-50 principle
introduced.how: Fan Er'ye's stinginess: two 50% discounts stack to 75% off
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Well, it means 50% off first, and then 50% off again, making it 75% off in total.

introduced.name: Jade Chamber
introduced.how: venue with a grand stage whose blueprint Dayu has worked from
introduced.quote: Dayu: Piece of cake — I've worked for the carpenter who built the stage for the Jade Chamber.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: You're from the Adventurers' Guild, right? Can I just directly ask you to find a carpenter for me?

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Master Lu: Liyue Harbor is too far away. No one will be taking care of Fanmu Carpenter's if I go.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Fan Er'ye: That's a fair price. Good, but I can only offer 2,000 Mora.

assumed.name: Iron Tongue Tian
assumed.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Iron Tongue Tian has gotten even more popular than me. Could you try to be a little more realistic?

assumed.name: Ring of Raining Blades
assumed.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Just one round of "Ring of Raining Blades"? No problem.

assumed.name: The Wrath of Haishan
assumed.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Today, when I was telling the story of "The Wrath of Haishan," it would make that infernal squeak with every pose I would strike.

assumed.name: Yun Family
assumed.quote: Granny Ruoxin: Forget it. The little girl from the Yun family is going to visit me. I gotta go home and make some preparations for my guest.

threads.claim: Fan Er'ye refuses to replace the stage because it symbolizes his past with Granny Ruoxin.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: I can tell that he still cares for Granny Ruoxin. He sees the stage as a symbol of their past and thus doesn't want to tear it down.

threads.claim: Fan Er'ye finally admits his obsession with the old stage and agrees to let it be rebuilt.
threads.quote: Fan Er'ye: What a fool was I to be so obsessed with this stage. Alright, you can rebuild it as you want.

threads.claim: Granny Ruoxin's companion never reached Qingce Village, leaving her alone there, an unexplained loss.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: But that person didn't make it to Qingce Village with Granny Ruoxin, leaving her to live alone in the village ever since.

threads.claim: Yun Jin has been selectively quoting Granny Ruoxin, leaving out the harsher part of what she said.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: Although what she said was true, Er'ye would've been irritated had I repeated exactly every word, so I took the liberty of omitting the other half.

threads.claim: Yun Jin is acting unusually, hinting that she has a hidden purpose behind her visit.
threads.quote: Traveler: Somehow Yun Jin feels very different than usual.

threads.claim: Yun Jin wants to invite someone to a rock 'n' roll show and asks Fan Er'ye to cover for her absence.
threads.quote: Yun Jin: I had wanted to invite to go to a rock 'n' roll performance.

introduced.name: Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L
introduced.how: Self-introduction: the voice in the statue is a former ruler called Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L
introduced.quote: Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L is my name, aforetime the ruler of Chichen Uctokah.

introduced.name: Chichen Uctokah
introduced.how: Former realm ruled by the Dragonlord, which the speaker claims as her domain
introduced.quote: I am the sovereign ruler of Chichen Uctokah, a great and glorious Dragonlord...

introduced.name: Ancient Jadestone Fragments
introduced.how: Broken pieces of the Dragonlord's heart, hidden in devices, that the Traveler must collect
introduced.quote: My heart was once ripped apart through betrayal, before being hidden in various devices. I would ask you to seek those shards for me.

introduced.name: Dragonlord's heart
introduced.how: The heart holds the memories of the Dragonlord and is the source of her imprisonment
introduced.quote: my heart, created as it was in great antiquity, holds all the memories that were once mine.

introduced.name: Memories as shackles
introduced.how: For long-lived species, memories are curses and shackles rather than sweet things
introduced.quote: but for long-lived species, memories are naught but curses and shackles.

introduced.name: Chosen of Dragons
introduced.how: The Traveler is addressed as a Chosen of Dragons and noble elect of the speaker
introduced.quote: Indeed. Chosen of Dragons you are, and noble elect of mine also.

introduced.name: Betrayal by the traitor
introduced.how: A traitor stole the speaker's authority and used memories to trap her inside the statue
introduced.quote: The traitor — may his name be cast into the everlasting flames to burn for thirteen thousand years! — stole my authority, using memories to entrap me here.

introduced.name: Trapping in the statue
introduced.how: The Dragonlord is imprisoned inside the giant statue, which is the source of the voice
introduced.quote: Did this despicable statue not entrap me, I would surely have presented myself to you in a more elegant fashion

introduced.name: Och-Kan
introduced.how: Named as the traitor's name in her outburst against the betrayer
introduced.quote: Och-Kan... Och-Kan! You despicable beast!

assumed.name: Ochkanatlan
assumed.quote: This place is so different from other parts of Ochkanatlan...

assumed.name: Secret Source platforms
assumed.quote: Agh! Where did these Secret Source platforms come from this time!?

assumed.name: Abyssal monsters
assumed.quote: Whoa! Abyssal monsters! Why'd they just pop out all of a sudden!?

assumed.name: Land of Seven Flames
assumed.quote: The sovereign ruler of the Land of Seven Flames extends salutations unto you, chosen one.

assumed.name: Grainfruit
assumed.quote: Cut my chest open as you would peel Grainfruit leaves, and dig my heart out.

threads.claim: The Dragonlord asks the Traveler to gather her heart fragments and dig out her heart to release her.
threads.quote: Cut my chest open as you would peel Grainfruit leaves, and dig my heart out.

threads.claim: After the heart is removed, the will imprisoned in the statue is gone and only silence remains.
threads.quote: Statue: (The will imprisoned within the statue has dissipated. Silence alone answers you.)

threads.claim: The fragments do not look artificial, and their original purpose is unknown.
threads.quote: It doesn't look artificial, though. What could it have been used for?

threads.claim: Who carved the giant statue, and why, is left as an open question.
threads.quote: Wow, didn't expect the statue to be this huge... Who carved this thing, anyway?

threads.claim: The Traveler is named a Chosen of Dragons, a role whose meaning is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Indeed. Chosen of Dragons you are, and noble elect of mine also.

threads.claim: The betrayer who stole the Dragonlord's authority is named as Och-Kan, though his identity is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Och-Kan... Och-Kan! You despicable beast!

threads.claim: Memories are used as a binding force, and their nature differs between mayfly and long-lived species.
threads.quote: but for long-lived species, memories are naught but curses and shackles.

threads.claim: The Dragonlord's former colleagues are mentioned, and their views on destruction are left unexplained.
threads.quote: Hehe... It seems you have yet to meet my colleagues of old.

threads.claim: The Dragonlords believe destruction is their destined path, and no other path exists.
threads.quote: Otherwise, they would have told you that destruction is our destined path.

threads.claim: Secret Source platforms appear as parasites on the Dragonlord, and their origin is unknown.
threads.quote: Agh! Where did these Secret Source platforms come from this time!?

introduced.name: Zhuchun
introduced.how: a fellow contest entrant who greets the Traveler and comments on sights
introduced.quote: Heyo, friendo! You've been all over, I imagine you've had the pleasure of admiring quite a few sights in your time?

introduced.name: Mali
introduced.how: a Fontainian photographer who advises on Kameras and pitches a Kamera maker
introduced.quote: As a Fontainian photographer, one who's emerged from the Kamera's birthplace, let me offer you some advice

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera; photography's purest essence is said to lie in the Kamera itself
introduced.quote: the purest essence of photography lies within the Kamera itself.

introduced.name: Fangju
introduced.how: organizer of the scenic photography contest from Chenyu Vale
introduced.quote: We previously surveyed the vale's residents to collect opinions regarding its most captivating scenic spots.

introduced.name: "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" scenic photography contest
introduced.how: a contest where entrants photograph scenic spots with Kameras for promotional display
introduced.quote: It's exactly as its name implies.

introduced.name: Chenyu Vale
introduced.how: a vale with scenery the contest is designed to promote
introduced.quote: It's a contest designed to promote the beautiful scenery of Chenyu Vale.

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: a village whose residents recommend it as a scenic spot, with cute animals
introduced.quote: It's gotta be my hometown, Qiaoying Village.

introduced.name: Jademouth
introduced.how: a scenic spot shaped like a huge circle with a big mouth, with a gemstone orb
introduced.quote: The Jademouth! A life lived without visiting it is surely one with regrets, especially that gemstone orb.

introduced.name: Lotus Pond
introduced.how: a quiet night-time scenic pond near monsters, by the Ancient Teatree King
introduced.quote: The Lotus Pond next to the Ancient Teatree King may not be that famous, but I find it to have a serene beauty at night.

introduced.name: Mt. Xuanlian
introduced.how: a mountain with strange formations and a moving sunset
introduced.quote: If you ask me, it's gotta be... Mt. Xuanlian, right?

introduced.name: Mingjing
introduced.how: a child who says they speak a little pelican talk and can call pelicans
introduced.quote: Only a little... because I noticed when they eat, they don't stop going

introduced.name: Redbill Pelican
introduced.how: a pelican that comes when called with the right sounds, probably expecting food
introduced.quote: They come over as soon as they hear, probably because they think there's food.

introduced.name: Akai
introduced.how: an ordinary tourist captured by hilichurls and rescued by the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: Hang on! Don't come any closer! Are you... are you good people?

introduced.name: Shady Fontaine merchant
introduced.how: a Fontaine merchant who sold Akai a Kamera that broke, then vanished
introduced.quote: I bought a rather expensive Kamera from a Fontaine merchant, but it broke after only a few uses.

introduced.name: Someone's Idle Musings
introduced.how: readable poetic notes left at scenic spots
introduced.quote: To carve beautiful jade is taboo, for the jade will first be consigned to dust.

introduced.name: "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" Album
introduced.how: a limited commemorative photo album of all selected contest works, given as the prize
introduced.quote: It features all of the contest's selected works.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: As a Fontainian photographer, one who's emerged from the Kamera's birthplace

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: So I couldn't do anything about those hilichurls.

assumed.name: Ancient Teatree King
assumed.quote: The Lotus Pond next to the Ancient Teatree King may not be that famous

assumed.name: Tea-Tasting Adeptus
assumed.quote: I think I should check out the Tea-Tasting Adeptus...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: If it's alright with you, I also have some Mora for you.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: That dupe from Inazuma is here as well.

threads.claim: Mali recommends a Kamera maker from Fontaine whose wares are beloved, hinting at a dubious seller.
threads.quote: Back in my hometown, the Kameras he makes are beloved without exception.

threads.claim: Akai was sold an expensive Kamera by a Fontaine merchant that broke quickly, and the merchant then disappeared.
threads.quote: I bought a rather expensive Kamera from a Fontaine merchant, but it broke after only a few uses.

threads.claim: The shady Fontaine merchant is revealed to be present at the contest, where Akai spots him.
threads.quote: There he is! That shady Fontaine merchant! Has my luck really begun to turn around!?

threads.claim: Mali spots a dupe from Inazuma at the contest and avoids him, hinting at an unexplained lookalike.
threads.quote: That dupe from Inazuma is here as well.

threads.claim: A readable musing says carving beautiful jade is taboo because the jade will turn to dust, hinting at a deeper belief.
threads.quote: To carve beautiful jade is taboo, for the jade will first be consigned to dust.

threads.claim: Zhuchun senses the atmosphere around them is off, an unexplained disturbance that is left unresolved.
threads.quote: It's just a shame that the atmosphere around me seems rather off...

introduced.name: Aigouy
introduced.how: Balent's older mentor who taught him, feels slighted by him, and is dismissive of the danger
introduced.quote: Aigouy: I was kind enough to teach him, but just how did that kid repay me?

introduced.name: Balent

threads.claim: Researchers in Sumeru struggle to get funding, a recurring theme of scholarly poverty.

threads.claim: Purbiruni claim that freedom from material things sharpens their path to wisdom, raising the question of money versus scholarship.
threads.quote: Rather, freedom from material things allows us to see the way to wisdom all the more clearly.

threads.quote: (The ancient characters... They're overlapping...)

threads.quote: (Khedive... Doesn't that sound like a Pursina? How come this traveler has a hand-written letter of his?)

threads.claim: A thousand-year friendship between Purbiruni and Pursina is hinted at, with a hint of rivalry between the two groups.
threads.quote: Um... and the thousand-year friendship between Purbiruni and Pursina will be enhanced even further!

introduced.name: Honorary Knight

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius Handbook
introduced.how: handbook of Knight principles and common knowledge the Traveler is given to study
introduced.quote: It contains the vast majority of the principles that Knights should follow, as well as some knowledge for common use.

introduced.name: Knights of Favonius
introduced.how: Mondstadt's knightly order that sets the handbook's principles and official place names
introduced.quote: You are an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all. It wouldn't do if you weren't familiar with Mondstadt at all.

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: official Knights name for ruins northwest of Mondstadt
introduced.quote: To the northwest of Mondstadt are some ruins.

introduced.name: Dvalin
introduced.how: occupies the ruins and shelters himself there
introduced.quote: It has since been occupied by Dvalin, who shelters himself there.

introduced.how: legend says the ruins were once a city where a tyrant ruled from his tower
introduced.quote: Legend holds that it was once a city where a tyrant ruled from his tower.

introduced.name: Jean
introduced.how: manages Knights affairs within the city walls as Acting Grand Master
introduced.quote: the affairs of the Knights of Favonius within the city walls are currently under the management of Ms. Jean.

introduced.name: Strange yet respectable traveler
introduced.how: proper Knightly form of address for outsiders from lands beyond
introduced.quote: Correct, "strange yet respectable traveler," or indeed "travelers," is the correct way to address those that we meet here who hail from lands beyond.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: According to knightly etiquette, what is the proper form of address to use when speaking to unknown individuals encountered within Mondstadt's borders?

threads.claim: The ruins were once a tyrant's city, a legend the text leaves unverified.
threads.quote: Legend holds that it was once a city where a tyrant ruled from his tower.

threads.claim: Dvalin now lives in Stormterror's Lair, and the text does not explain who he is.
threads.quote: It has since been occupied by Dvalin, who shelters himself there.

threads.claim: Jean runs Knights affairs only as Acting Grand Master, implying an absent Grand Master.
threads.quote: the affairs of the Knights of Favonius within the city walls are currently under the management of Ms. Jean.

introduced.name: Augustus Lovelace
introduced.how: introduces himself as a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute who is traveling and wants a photo taken

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering
introduced.how: a former research paradise in Fontaine where most mechanical creations originated, now largely in ruins and also called the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: The Fontaine Research Institute used to be a paradise for researchers in Fontaine and where most mechanical creations originated.

introduced.how: a researcher from the institute who once worked in Augustus's laboratory, made films as director, and was sent to Inazuma
introduced.quote: Xavier is a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute. We used to work in the same laboratory, and he once gave me quite a bit of help.

introduced.name: dokumentari films
introduced.how: documentary-style films Xavier shot to record research processes, unpopular at the institute
introduced.quote: Even after being assigned to other projects, he still continued shooting "dokumentari films" in the name of recording their research process.

introduced.name: Stone Gate
introduced.how: a gate that separates Mondstadt from Liyue
introduced.quote: First, I went from Lumidouce Harbor to Chenyu Vale, and then passed through Qingce Village on my way to the Stone Gate that separates Mondstadt from Liyue.

assumed.name: Yashiro Commission
assumed.quote: But he keeps insisting that he must shoot the best possible film for the Yashiro Commission, and he refuses to leave Inazuma until it's done.

assumed.name: Mikage Furnace
assumed.quote: I've read all about your heroic feats in the Mikage Furnace from Xavier's letters.

assumed.name: Edwin Eastinghouse

assumed.name: Raimondo

assumed.quote: Here, I'm sneezing so much that— ACHOO! I can't even hold the Kamera steadily...

threads.claim: Xavier is anxious over his film for the Yashiro Commission and refuses to leave Inazuma until it is finished.
threads.quote: But he keeps insisting that he must shoot the best possible film for the Yashiro Commission, and he refuses to leave Inazuma until it's done.

threads.claim: Mr. Edwin is blamed for leaving most institute buildings in ruin.

threads.quote: And ever since Raimondo and Mr. Choiseul took over the reconstruction project, the spirit of research at the institute has been in freefall.

threads.claim: Augustus has left Fontaine and wanders because he will not live among the institute's rubble.
threads.quote: I have standards and prefer a tidy environment. I refuse to live in a pile of rubble, and so I've been traveling around.

threads.claim: Xavier is described as resourceful and would have achieved great things in a different era.
threads.quote: He's a very resourceful person.

threads.claim: Xavier's letters have spread word of the Traveler's heroic feats and acting skill to Augustus.
threads.quote: You... Whoa! Are you the Traveler that Xavier told me about?

introduced.quote: Professor Froderock was looking for live specimens in the desert

threads.claim: Ancient Energy Transformation Capacitors may restore Benben, but their function is uncertain.

threads.claim: The Fatui secretly infiltrate desert tribes to reach the Sages and serve a Harbinger's interests.

threads.quote: he always defied The Doctor's orders

introduced.name: Fujiwara Toshiko
introduced.how: introduces herself as a treasure hunter at the ancestral site
introduced.quote: I'm Fujiwara Toshiko, and I'm here to... Um...

introduced.name: Fujiwara Toshiko's Treasure Map
introduced.how: ancestral map that holds clues for solving the mechanism puzzles
introduced.quote: I have a map left by my ancestors here with me, and it contains clues as to how I might figure this mechanism out...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: group that ambushes treasure hunters and demands their finds
introduced.quote: Hehe. Come on now, cut it with the nonsense. Give it up, or else!

introduced.name: Masterless Samurai
introduced.how: samurai who trail the Treasure Hoarders and demand the treasure for themselves
introduced.quote: Could we bother you to leave the treasure you found with us?

introduced.name: ancestral mechanism puzzles
introduced.how: special switch puzzles that guard the hidden basement and chest and change after activation
introduced.quote: This mechanism seems to be of the same kind as the one that we unlocked on the way in.

introduced.name: hidden basement
introduced.how: underground basement that opens through a giant hole after the mechanism is activated
introduced.quote: Did you just see that? A giant... hole just opened up over there!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Fatui!? Wh—What are they doing here!?

assumed.name: Inazuma City
assumed.quote: Maybe I should bring this picture back to Inazuma City and ask around a bit...

assumed.name: Oda Tarou
assumed.quote: Hmm, maybe I should go ask Mr. Oda Tarou...

threads.claim: Toshiko's ancestors guarded a treasure with elaborate mechanisms, and the reason for that protection is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Why would my ancestors set up so many mechanisms just to protect one picture?

threads.claim: The treasure turns out to be a single picture whose importance is unexplained, despite being heavily guarded.
threads.quote: Why would one crummy picture be hidden by so many complex mechanisms?

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders, Masterless Samurai, and Fatui all pursue the same find, showing rival interest in the treasure.
threads.quote: If we hadn't trailed those samurai, we wouldn't have found this basement at all.

threads.claim: The puzzle mechanism changes again after being solved, hinting at hidden workings behind it.
threads.quote: H—Huh? Why... did the mechanism change again?

threads.claim: Toshiko is puzzled by the picture's meaning and plans to seek answers from outside the group.
threads.quote: I don't get it at all.

introduced.name: Furuya Noboru
introduced.how: Guild adventurer who identifies the map as Seirai Island and points the Traveler to Oda Tarou
introduced.quote: The Guild has commissioned several expeditions to Seirai Island in the past.

introduced.name: Oda Tarou
introduced.how: Descendant of Seirai Island natives who wants to see his ancestral home and hired adventurers to photograph it
introduced.quote: His name's Oda Tarou. I've heard that his ancestors used to live on Seirai Island before migrating here for various reasons.

introduced.name: Seirai Island
introduced.how: Island where the map's locations are; past Guild expeditions have explored it and its residents' ancestors came from there
introduced.quote: The Guild has commissioned several expeditions to Seirai Island in the past.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Organization that posts commissions and sends adventurers on expeditions, including to Seirai Island
introduced.quote: The adventurers who accepted those commissions would bring us intel on the island in the form of reports.

introduced.name: Fujiwara Toshiko
introduced.how: Another Inazuma City resident whose ancestors also lived on Seirai Island and who might recognize the locations
introduced.quote: More accurately, she's in the same boat as me — our ancestors both lived there.

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: Camera the Traveler uses to photograph the four locations for Oda
introduced.quote: Hopefully, some adventurers can help me go to Seirai Island, find the three places shown in those paintings, take a few pictures with a Kamera, and bring those pictures back to me.

introduced.name: three landscape paintings of Seirai Island
introduced.how: Family paintings of the island that are the only reminder of the old home
introduced.quote: All we have left in the house to remind us of it are three landscape paintings of the island.

introduced.name: treasure map
introduced.how: Picture with strange markings that turns out to show a place on Seirai Island
introduced.quote: Huh? This is a picture. And it's got some weird markings on it, too...

introduced.name: Inazuma City
introduced.how: City where many residents have ancestors who were natives of Seirai Island
introduced.quote: Actually, there's a lot of us here in Inazuma City whose ancestors were once natives of the island, you know?

introduced.name: Seirai Island resettlement
introduced.how: Islanders were moved away from Seirai Island long ago, possibly due to storms or smuggling
introduced.quote: I think it might have been the crazy storms, or to prevent smuggling and illegal border crossings...

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Whatever the case, the Shogunate arranged for the inhabitants of the island to come to Narukami Island.

assumed.name: Narukami Island
assumed.quote: Whatever the case, the Shogunate arranged for the inhabitants of the island to come to Narukami Island.

threads.claim: The real reason the islanders left Seirai Island long ago is uncertain and may be storms or smuggling.
threads.quote: I think it might have been the crazy storms, or to prevent smuggling and illegal border crossings...

threads.claim: The Shogunate arranged for the island's inhabitants to be moved to Narukami Island.
threads.quote: Whatever the case, the Shogunate arranged for the inhabitants of the island to come to Narukami Island.

threads.claim: The places in the old paintings have changed greatly since the family left, so they can no longer be recognized.
threads.quote: It does seem that those three locations have changed a lot since our family left...

threads.claim: The map shows a place on Seirai Island, and its locations must be photographed to learn more about it.
threads.quote: Including the map you brought, that would make four locations to take pictures of...

threads.claim: Oda Tarou feels a strong obligation to visit his ancestral home on Seirai Island but is too busy to go.
threads.quote: I feel like... I have to go see it no matter what.

introduced.name: Zompaynco
introduced.how: outsider and Natlan Saurian Relics Association member who wants to visit the Frostmoon Scions to research local legends

introduced.how: Frostmoon Scions member who distributes meals and can grant outsiders access to the archives
introduced.quote: You've always been there when I was distributing meals, haven't you? Wandering around the line, circling back and forth, but never stepping in.

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a group that welcomes outsiders warmly, including non-human arrivals, and keeps archives
introduced.quote: The Frostmoon Scions are exceptionally gracious — whether one arrives as a stranger or in a form not entirely human, they will extend a warm and courteous welcome.

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association (Faction)
introduced.how: Natlan research group that Zompaynco belongs to and that studies relics such as fossils
introduced.quote: I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Lady Nefer! What a coincidence, you've come at just the right time...

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Our Natlanese guest here has expressed interest in visiting the Frostmoon Scions.

threads.claim: Local legends of the Frostmoon Scions are something an outsider researcher wants to learn about.
threads.quote: I'd like to take some photos and notes, look through some records, and if possible... ask someone about the local legends!

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions welcome beings who are not entirely human, hinting at non-human members or guests.
threads.quote: whether one arrives as a stranger or in a form not entirely human, they will extend a warm and courteous welcome.

threads.claim: The Frostmoon Scions keep archives and records that an outside researcher may be allowed to consult.
threads.quote: I see... so you're hoping to spend some time in the archives, then? Let me think...

threads.claim: Nefer seems to know private wishes and plans that others have kept hidden, suggesting she has knowledge beyond ordinary sight.
threads.quote: I know you've always wanted to visit the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.quote: I installed sensors on Barbie's Dodoco. As soon as the right person shows up, she'll receive an instant notification.

introduced.how: ethereal threads of fate that Barbeloth can catch to glimpse the faces of their owners

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: As a Descender from beyond this world, 's fate is not anchored in Teyvat.

assumed.name: Fontaine

assumed.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon are shown walking around the outskirts of the Court of Fontaine before coming across the booth)

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: Between you and Nicole, if my head isn't hurting, then my ears are.

assumed.name: Octavia
assumed.quote: Ugh! I miss Octavia...

assumed.name: Scryglass

threads.quote: I recently happened to glimpse a peculiar omen.

introduced.how: an elite military order whose uniform the diarist hopes to wear

introduced.quote: Will I ever return to Nasha Town, the place from which I first set out?

introduced.quote: I was assigned to a support unit stationed at Kipumaki Cliff.

introduced.name: Lightkeeper
introduced.how: a frontline military role that the diarist's unit is distinguished from
introduced.quote: I was not chosen for a frontline Lightkeeper unit.

introduced.name: Captain Asebov
introduced.how: a stone-faced captain of the diarist's support unit
introduced.quote: Captain Asebov is a stone-faced man.

introduced.name: Chernov
introduced.how: a cheerful squad member in the diarist's unit
introduced.quote: Chernov is a cheerful fellow.

introduced.quote: Shonokovych is as thin as a sheet of iron.

introduced.quote: We received an urgent request for reinforcements from Piramida and set out for Kipumaki Cliff to deal with an unexpected Wild Hunt outbreak.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: Would my name and my story one day spread back to Nasha Town, and from there, across all of Nod-Krai?

assumed.quote: Four phantoms of Lightkeepers appear, cornered by Rifthounds

threads.quote: That place is often called the Sanctum of Departed Heroes, the resting ground of soldiers who once fell in battle.

threads.quote: Filaev! No! Patolichev, go! Get out of here! Forget about me!

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz Ordo
introduced.how: a group tied to the great sin and to Fontaine's sinners
introduced.quote: Perhaps, but my past is inextricably intertwined with the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, the chief culprit of the great sin.

introduced.name: Narzissenkreuz
introduced.how: a figure who mentored Caterpillar and is the origin of the Ordo's teachings
introduced.quote: But I was personally mentored by Narzissenkreuz, who should be the origin of all this.

introduced.name: Caterpillar
introduced.how: self-introduction as a creature that becomes a human-like butterfly
introduced.quote: See, I'm Caterpillar, a creature that turns into a chrysalis before completely metamorphosing into a butterfly.

introduced.how: former Lord-Artificer, called the White Cavalier of Protection, who clashed with Narzissenkreuz
introduced.quote: Many years ago, the one then called "Lord-Artificer" Guillotin and Narzissenkreuz had an intense clash.

introduced.name: Lyris
introduced.how: an Oceanid whom the Ordo called the Red Empress and who once existed

introduced.how: a device built by Narzissenkreuz that is tied to an apocalypse countdown

introduced.name: Seymour
introduced.how: a prototype machine designed by Guillotin, describing itself
introduced.quote: Affirmative. I am... *garbled mechnical noises* protoype, with a large number of bold design elements.

introduced.name: Mary-Ann Guillotin
introduced.how: Seymour's master, identified as a Guillotin
introduced.quote: Mary-Ann. Or, as you might call her, Mary-Ann Guillotin.

introduced.name: Ann
introduced.how: Paimon introduces Ann as an Oceanid friend
introduced.quote: This is our Oceanid friend, Ann. Ann, this is...

assumed.name: Lanoire
assumed.quote: Lanoire has already gone home, did she not?

assumed.name: Jailbreak
