assumed.quote: I thought we got acquainted well enough during our jailbreak.

assumed.name: Dispelling Ritual
assumed.quote: And just what's a Dispelling Ritual? Well, not that that's super important.

assumed.name: Holy Blade
assumed.quote: Narzissenkreuz would lead ceremonies with the Holy Blade, in accordance with the ancient dictates.

assumed.name: Vision
assumed.quote: accidentally receiving a Vision while seeking the path is a guaranteed path to destruction.

assumed.name: Oceanid
assumed.quote: akin to an Oceanid imagining a creature in the wild.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: However, this is undoubtedly where the sinners of Fontaine once congregated.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's own origin and birth are unknown and possibly tied to Narzissenkreuz.
threads.quote: Perhaps he did. I've tried to unravel my own origin, but the answers I got were all pretty vague.

threads.claim: Caterpillar recalls a memory from before its birth, hinting at a route to its origin.
threads.quote: This is a memory from before my birth, something akin to an elephant recalling its previous life while meditating.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz is a prophet whose awakening is said to bring another evil into the world.
threads.quote: There's a prophet lying dormant in all of us, and when he wakes, one more evil shall walk the world

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz's ultimate purpose for collecting wills and selves remains unknown.
threads.quote: However, I never found out for what Narzissenkreuz's ultimate purpose for collecting all those wills and selves was.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's fading memories may hide key facts about the past.
threads.quote: My memory is fading, so that is quite possible.

threads.claim: Lyris's fate is unknown, and Caterpillar has an unspoken hunch about it.
threads.quote: I don't know, though I do have a hunch.

threads.claim: Ann's relation to the Red Empress and Lyris is unclear and may be tied to a story.
threads.quote: The Red Empress? I have no idea who that is, though the name kind of rings a bell.

threads.claim: Caterpillar confirms Lyris existed as an Oceanid, linking her to the Red Empress.
threads.quote: Lyris did indeed exist.

threads.claim: The Doomsday Clock may signal an approaching apocalypse.
threads.quote: Simply put, it's the Doomsday Clock.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says the clock is just a device, not the apocalypse itself.
threads.quote: I cannot answer your question, dear Paimon. Because this is all it is — a clock.

threads.claim: Seymour is searching for a master to protect, whose identity is hidden.
threads.quote: You are correct. I am looking for the master I should protect, Ma—

threads.claim: Mary-Ann Guillotin is linked to Seymour and the Guillotin name, still unexplained.
threads.quote: Mary-Ann. Or, as you might call her, Mary-Ann Guillotin.

threads.claim: Narzissenkreuz taught that a body is just a shell that can host consciousness.
threads.quote: The body is just a shell. Even the body of a hilichurl can bear sentient consciousness.

threads.claim: Jakob has emerged, a name with unexplained significance.
threads.quote: So, Jakob has emerged...

introduced.name: Riku
introduced.how: an enthusiastic NPC who greets the outlander and wants bird friends to play with
introduced.quote: Ah, an outlander! Hello!

introduced.name: Bird Eggs
introduced.how: the eggs Riku wants, which he would hatch into birds
introduced.quote: You want some Bird Eggs?

introduced.name: commission
introduced.how: Riku's request for 8 Bird Eggs is a commission the Traveler can take on
introduced.quote: So, did you get the 8 Bird Eggs that I mentioned in my commission?

assumed.name: commission
assumed.quote: So, did you get the 8 Bird Eggs that I mentioned in my commission?

threads.claim: Riku's wish for bird friends to play with hints at a deeper loneliness or desire for companionship.
threads.quote: Then I'd have loads of bird friends to play with...

introduced.name: Tisoc
introduced.how: guard of the cave who bars entry without a pass and introduces himself as a Flamegranate expert
introduced.quote: Name's Tisoc, and I'm the guard here

introduced.name: Poca
introduced.how: Courier of the tribe who is worried about Tisoc and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: I'm Poca, a Courier here in the tribe

introduced.name: Green-Edged Paper Slip
introduced.how: green-edged paper pass required to enter the cave, controlled by the tribe and easily lost
introduced.quote: you know those green-edges slips of paper?

introduced.name: Mountain King Flamegranate
introduced.how: special Flamegranates grown in the cave, offered to the Mountain King and very valuable
introduced.quote: this cave is home to awesome Mountain King Flamegranates

introduced.name: Mother Flamegranate Tree
introduced.how: tree whose roots lie in the cave and which the tribe has always guarded
introduced.quote: the site of the Mother Flamegranate Tree's roots

introduced.name: Scions of the Canopy
introduced.how: the tribe of Natlan that guards the Flamegranate cave and whose members need passes to enter
introduced.quote: not from our tribe, the Scions of the Canopy

introduced.name: phlogiston
introduced.how: substance that makes Flamegranates and their honey potent and that flows as Liquid Phlogiston
introduced.quote: they'll produce honey as rich in phlogiston as Quenepa Berries

introduced.name: Flamegranate honey and Courier bags
introduced.how: Flamegranates can be picked by a special technique to yield phlogiston-rich honey, and their dried skins make bags for Couriers
introduced.quote: Dry the skins, and you can even get bags that our Couriers can carry.

introduced.name: Liquid Phlogiston
introduced.how: the molten lava flowing underground that the Flamegranate roots absorb and grow from
introduced.quote: the Liquid Phlogiston levels will drop slowly

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: You aren't from Natlan at all, are you?

assumed.name: Wayna
assumed.quote: Man did Wayna chew them out.

assumed.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
assumed.quote: have people from either the Masters of the Night-Wind or the Collective of Plenty take a look

assumed.name: Collective of Plenty
assumed.quote: have people from either the Masters of the Night-Wind or the Collective of Plenty take a look

assumed.name: Night Kingdom
assumed.quote: Have I been called to the Night Kingdom already?

assumed.name: Mountain King
assumed.quote: The Mountain King's not been in the best shape in recent years.

threads.claim: The Mountain King Flamegranates have recently gone wrong, and Tisoc refuses to say exactly how.
threads.quote: the Mountain King Flamegranates have recently been... Eh, forget it.

threads.claim: The Flamegranates that should have ripened are still green and blue, showing no sign of maturing.
threads.quote: they're still all green and blue. No signs of maturing at all.

threads.claim: Tisoc is hiding a request and a problem he has not told the rest of the tribe about.
threads.quote: I've a request I can't tell the rest of the tribe about.

threads.claim: A green pass was lost a few days before, and Wayna scolded the people who lost it.
threads.quote: I heard a few days back. Couldn't find it either

threads.claim: Solidified lava is blocking airflow in the roots, which is cooling them and stopping the Flamegranates from ripening.
threads.quote: it's because there's this... solidified lava blocking the airflow

threads.claim: Clearing the lava restores the root temperature, and the Mountain King Flamegranates turn ripe orange.
threads.quote: Perhaps we'll be able to pick them after a few more days of observation.

threads.claim: The Flamegranate Tree's roots absorb Liquid Phlogiston and grow from it, which is normally why they sit immersed in lava.
threads.quote: The roots of the Flamegranate Tree not only endure proximity to Liquid Phlogiston

threads.claim: Flamegranate Trees are described as mysterious, with their deeper nature left unexplained.
threads.quote: Flamegranate Trees truly are mysterious.

threads.claim: Tisoc's father taught him to care for the Flamegranate Trees, and witnessing the roots convinced Tisoc to follow in that work.
threads.quote: When I followed my father around as a little lad

threads.claim: The Mountain King has been in poor health in recent years, and eating the fruit might help it recover.
threads.quote: If it eats this fruit, things might take a turn for the better

introduced.name: Kuisel
introduced.how: Introduces himself as Kuisel, a trapped workshop figure who was once mentored by the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: Th—That's right... I haven't introduced myself yet. You can call me Kuisel.

introduced.name: Coutrot
introduced.how: Revealed as Kuisel's former research partner and the real owner of the workshop, who is a villain behind the trap
introduced.quote: My name is Coutrot, and I'm the real owner of this workshop.

introduced.name: Bricole
introduced.how: Introduces herself as Bricole, an investigator pursuing Coutrot for asset theft
introduced.quote: He's Coutrot, not me. I'm Bricole.

introduced.name: Kuisel's Clockwork Workshop
introduced.how: The workshop where the trap and cage are, which Coutrot actually owns
introduced.quote: Ugh, you know... Kuisel's Clockwork Workshop — that Kuisel.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: A research institute that Coutrot was expelled from and where Kuisel was mentored; a new branch exists that handles research access
introduced.quote: Perhaps you've heard of the Fontaine Research Institute, or Mr. Raimondo and Mr. Bossuet? I... I was once mentored by them.

introduced.name: Raimondo
introduced.how: A named Fontaine Research Institute figure who mentored Kuisel
introduced.quote: Perhaps you've heard of the Fontaine Research Institute, or Mr. Raimondo and Mr. Bossuet? I... I was once mentored by them.

introduced.name: Bossuet
introduced.how: A named Fontaine Research Institute figure who mentored Kuisel
introduced.quote: Perhaps you've heard of the Fontaine Research Institute, or Mr. Raimondo and Mr. Bossuet? I... I was once mentored by them.

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A place Coutrot could be sent to as legal punishment
introduced.quote: Haha, do you want to ship me off to the Fortress of Meropide?

introduced.name: Annihilation Specialist Meka
introduced.how: Clockwork mekas that attack people on sight and are built in the workshop
introduced.quote: What kind of workshop builds clockwork meka that attack people on sight!

introduced.name: Coutrot's expulsion from the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: Coutrot was kicked out of the Institute for his peculiar research, which was judged by an Ethics Committee
introduced.quote: You see, his... more peculiar research was exactly what got him kicked out from the Fontaine Research Institute in the first place.

assumed.name: Court of Fontaine
assumed.quote: We'll go seek help at the Court of Fontaine.

assumed.name: Ethics Committee
assumed.quote: Yeah yeah, and that's what you told the Ethics Committee back in the day as well.

assumed.name: Previous puzzle room
assumed.quote: Could it be like last time, where we had to solve some kind of puzzle to keep going?

threads.claim: The voice that sounds like Kuisel also sounds like the arguing partner, hinting that Kuisel is not who he seems.
threads.quote: Also, his voice sounds... like Kuisel's, but also like the one he was arguing with before. What's going on?

threads.claim: Coutrot admits Kuisel is a convenient persona he uses, so the identity mystery is resolved.
threads.quote: Kuisel... is just a convenient character.

threads.claim: An unseen speaker who muses about kindness is heard for the first time, raising the question of who is talking.
threads.quote: I used to wonder, can kindness really be labeled as a good quality? Those filled only with kindness... what good does it even bring them?

threads.claim: Kuisel claims the cage is trapped with an explosive trigger, creating a dangerous unknown.
threads.quote: Th—That's right... Like I said earlier, my research partner's got... a violent temper, which is why he installed a trigger mechanism under the cage.

threads.claim: The voice reveals the trigger mechanism never existed, so the explosion threat was a lie.
threads.quote: There was never a trigger mechanism that could set off an explosion.

threads.claim: Coutrot's peculiar research got him expelled, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: You see, his... more peculiar research was exactly what got him kicked out from the Fontaine Research Institute in the first place.

threads.claim: Bricole refuses to reveal the research details and sends the Traveler to the Institute to learn more.
threads.quote: If you wish to learn more about his research, you may go to the new Fontaine Research Institute to apply for access.

threads.claim: Coutrot is accused of stealing Research Institute assets to continue dangerous research after being expelled.
threads.quote: I didn't expect you to continue your dangerous research even after you were kicked out, and you even stole the Research Institute's assets for this purpose...

threads.claim: Bricole says the asset theft investigation still ties to Coutrot and the workload is heavy.
threads.quote: Even though he's been fired, the asset theft case I've been investigating still has to do with him...

threads.claim: Coutrot treats the Traveler and Paimon as research material and says they were tested for their value.
threads.quote: To get here is already something... It will be perfect if they can get through our tests! Perfect proof of their value as research material...

threads.claim: Bricole promises that Coutrot will face proper legal punishment this time, setting up his judgment.
threads.quote: I promise that this time, he will receive his proper punishment.

introduced.name: Miyuki
introduced.how: a shrine maiden who introduces herself as sent to investigate the damaged trees
introduced.quote: Hmm? Ah, Traveler. What are you doing at a place like this at a moment like this?

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: trees near Kannazuka that share an origin and power with the Sacred Sakura
introduced.quote: Beyond the shrine, in Kannazuka, you will find Thunder Sakura. They share a common origin with the Sacred Sakura and possess a similar power, too.

introduced.name: Sacred Sakura
introduced.how: a sacred tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine that symbolizes the Great Narukami's power
introduced.quote: You've probably seen the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine?

introduced.name: Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)
introduced.how: the shrine where the Sacred Sakura stands, which Miyuki and Lady Miko belong to
introduced.quote: You've probably seen the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine?

introduced.name: Great Narukami
introduced.how: an eternal power whose symbol is the Sacred Sakura
introduced.quote: The Great Narukami is eternal, just as the Sacred Sakura will always in full bloom.

introduced.name: Kannazuka
introduced.how: a region beyond the shrine where the Thunder Sakura grow
introduced.quote: Beyond the shrine, in Kannazuka, you will find Thunder Sakura.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group of petty thieves camping near the Thunder Sakura, siphoning their power
introduced.quote: So far, I have discovered a group of Treasure Hoarders who keep showing up near the Thunder Sakura.

introduced.name: Hideaki
introduced.how: a Treasure Hoarder who admits his gang is draining the Thunder Sakura for a buyer
introduced.quote: P—Please don't kill me! I had nothing to do with the Thunder Sakura, I swear!

introduced.name: Vision Hunt Decree
introduced.how: a decree whose promulgation led to frequent fighting in Kannazuka
introduced.quote: Ever since the Vision Hunt Decree was promulgated, conflict often breaks out here between the Shogun's Army and the rebels.

introduced.name: Shogun's Army
introduced.how: a military force that fights the rebels in Kannazuka
introduced.quote: Ever since the Vision Hunt Decree was promulgated, conflict often breaks out here between the Shogun's Army and the rebels.

introduced.name: foreign object
introduced.how: a leaking device lodged in the trees that the Treasure Hoarders use to siphon energy
introduced.quote: That must be what the Treasure Hoarders are using to siphon the Thunder Sakura's energy. If we remove the foreign object from inside, it should heal on its own.

assumed.name: Tenryou Commission
assumed.quote: Then all we'd need to do was to direct that power into this crystal, and hey presto, we'd have something worth three Tenryou Commission mansions!

assumed.name: Electro Hypostasis
assumed.quote: That thing in there sure looks like the Electro Hypotases we've seen before.

assumed.name: Sangonomiya Clan
assumed.quote: This is Kannazuka, where neither the Inazuman faith nor Sangonomiya's has any influence.

assumed.name: Yae Miko
assumed.quote: It alarmed Lady Miko enough that she sent me to Kannazuka to investigate.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: You shameless villains. Conspiring with the Fatui... the Great Narukami will strike you all down sooner or later.

assumed.name: Kujou Encampment
assumed.quote: You just have to follow from the of the Kujou Encampment islet to — you'll encounter three of them that way.

threads.claim: The Thunder Sakura have been damaged and stopped producing blossoms, a worrying sign.
threads.quote: Recently, however, the Thunder Sakura have been damaged, and they are not producing blossoms. It cannot be a good sign.

threads.claim: The Thunder Sakura begin to bloom again once the foreign objects are removed.
threads.quote: Ooh, look, the Thunder Sakura is blooming! It's just a few flowers now, but that's gotta be a good sign.

threads.claim: Removing the foreign objects lets the Thunder Sakura heal on their own.
threads.quote: The Thunder Sakura should heal itself now.

threads.claim: The Thunder Sakura suppress something that lies beneath them, and its nature is kept hidden.
threads.quote: After all, these trees serve to suppress the one who lies beneath...

threads.claim: Someone is directing the Treasure Hoarders behind the scenes, and their identity is unknown.
threads.quote: One major outstanding question is: Who is directing the Treasure Hoarders behind the scenes?

threads.claim: Hideaki takes orders from an unseen master who is tied to the buyer's deal.
threads.quote: Master, that Traveler over there's the one who's been getting in your way.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders are working with the Fatui, who appear in person to back them up.
threads.quote: Hehe. You're going to act though in front of me, small fry?

threads.claim: A mysterious figure named Yamada is summoned by Hideaki and remains unseen.
threads.quote: Yamada, did you hear that?

threads.claim: The source of the lightning around the Thunder Sakura cannot be seen with normal eyes.
threads.quote: But we can't see the source of the lightning at all... Well, if our normal eyes won't help, how about ?

threads.claim: The Vision Hunt Decree has caused fighting between the Shogun's Army and rebels in Kannazuka.
threads.quote: Ever since the Vision Hunt Decree was promulgated, conflict often breaks out here between the Shogun's Army and the rebels.

introduced.name: Sanden
introduced.how: a mask seller who posted a commission and makes dyes
introduced.quote: We have extraordinarily well crafted masks here that are great for festivals or for your own collection.

introduced.name: Electro Crystals
introduced.how: a material Sanden needs five of for his commission
introduced.quote: Do you have 5 Electro Crystals yet?

introduced.name: Dyes
introduced.how: Sanden makes dyes with the Electro Crystals he receives
introduced.quote: Thank you! With this, I can now start making some dyes. Please, take these in exchange for your help.

introduced.name: Commission
introduced.how: Sanden posts commissions for materials and rewards the Traveler for fulfilling them
introduced.quote: Oh, you must be here about the commission I posted?

assumed.name: Electro Crystal guy
assumed.quote: Are you the Electro Crystal guy?

assumed.name: Posted commission
assumed.quote: Oh, you must be here about the commission I posted?

introduced.name: Muning
introduced.how: A worker at The Chasm who has spent years there and is dealing with Huishan Hall
introduced.quote: In all years I've worked in The Chasm, I've barely seen even one.

introduced.name: Archaic Stone
introduced.how: A rare, gorgeous gemstone-like ore that is hard to find in the mines
introduced.quote: It's a rare ore — so rare that you won't even necessarily find one in the mines.

introduced.name: Huishan Hall
introduced.how: Big shots who want Archaic Stones analyzed and pay rewards for them
introduced.quote: Yes. Somehow, the big shots at Huishan Hall got interested in the stone and wanted to analyze it, so they sent me to The Chasm to look for a few samples.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: A mining area with upper levels, caves and an exploration team and miners
introduced.quote: If I'm injured, no one's gonna supervise the exploration team down there and ensure the safety of the miners.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Adventurers who take on dangerous high mountains and deep dungeons, sometimes handling commissions
introduced.quote: Adventurers... Hmm... I used to be envious of them.

introduced.name: Cinnabar Cliff
introduced.how: A famous tourist spot on the very top of The Chasm that locals seldom visit
introduced.quote: Well, Cinnabar Cliff is one of those famous tourist spots that locals seldom go to.

assumed.name: Historia Antiqua Chapter
assumed.quote: (If the player has the Archaic Stone from Historia Antiqua Chapter, Act II)

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: The formidably high cliffs near The Chasm, the bottomless caves... and the ancient battlefield left behind by Rex Lapis are all full of danger...

threads.claim: The finest Archaic Stones hold shimmering light rays as thin as hair and a sea-horizon twilight color, making them a mysterious rare treasure.
threads.quote: They say that if you look inside the finest Archaic Stones, you'll see shimmering light rays as thin as hair, and that the stones' color reminds you of the sea horizon in the twilight...

threads.claim: Huishan Hall's big shots want Archaic Stones analyzed for an unexplained purpose, which remains an open question.
threads.quote: Somehow, the big shots at Huishan Hall got interested in the stone and wanted to analyze it

threads.claim: An ancient battlefield left behind by Rex Lapis lies in the dangerous areas near The Chasm.
threads.quote: The formidably high cliffs near The Chasm, the bottomless caves... and the ancient battlefield left behind by Rex Lapis are all full of danger...

threads.claim: Cinnabar Cliff sits atop The Chasm as a famous spot that even long-time locals have never visited.
threads.quote: I'm quite the opposite though— I've been working here for years but haven't once visited Cinnabar Cliff on the very top of The Chasm.

introduced.name: Fisherman's Toast
introduced.how: a thick slice of soft white toast topped with caramelized onion slices, and a classic Mondstadt recipe anyone can cook
introduced.quote: Topped with a generous serving of onion slices, lightly caramelized by the toasting... Yum yum!

introduced.name: Good Hunter
introduced.how: an establishment where the Traveler can order Fisherman's Toast
introduced.quote: We must order ourselves a generous serving of Fisherman's Toast from Good Hunter, pronto!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: This might surprise you, but it's actually a classic Mondstadt recipe that anyone can cook.

introduced.name: Estelle
introduced.how: a blacksmith who is also the workshop boss, physically frail, and builds the Auto-Smith
introduced.quote: That's right. I wear both hats, wield both hammers, however you want to put it. Surprised, huh?

introduced.name: Auto-Smith
introduced.how: a hammering machine that forges metal on its own but cannot move or gather materials
introduced.quote: As it stands, the Auto-Smith is just a hammering mechanism.

assumed.name: previous experiments
assumed.quote: It appears we've used up too much of our materials during the previous rounds of experiments. What should I do...

threads.claim: Estelle intends to turn the Auto-Smith into a fully automated forge someday.
threads.quote: However, one day, I will turn it into a fully automated forge.

threads.claim: Some people view automated forging as hollow and soulless, a view Estelle disputes.
threads.quote: Some say that all automated forgings are hollow and soulless.

threads.claim: Paimon's idea of a mobile Auto-Smith that seeks materials on its own is ruled out for now.
threads.quote: It cannot transform nor roam on its own.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: recurring enemy group that guards and hides buried treasure
introduced.quote: Ugh, these guys show up everywhere...

introduced.name: Cuijue Slope
introduced.how: location where buried treasure is said to lie
introduced.quote: This must be Cuijue Slope.

introduced.name: wish bonfire
introduced.how: a bonfire said to grant wishes, which the letter presents as a lure
introduced.quote: Anyone who's got what it takes to take him down, go and make a wish at that bonfire. Any old thing will do.

assumed.name: bonfire lighting mechanic
assumed.quote: Guess this must be the bonfire. The letter said we should light it up...

threads.claim: The wish-granting bonfire is doubted by Paimon, raising whether such a campfire exists.
threads.quote: But a campfire that fulfills wishes... Even Paimon knows that such a thing doesn't exist.

threads.claim: The wish bonfire is revealed as a scam set up by the Treasure Hoarders to catch people.
threads.quote: This whole thing about the bonfire granting wishes is utter nonsense!

threads.claim: A boss directs the Treasure Hoarders' scheme, and who this boss is remains open.
threads.quote: Boss said I should leave the slip of paper where I found it

threads.claim: The letter frames greed and not knowing when to stop as the downfall of treasure seekers.
threads.quote: I guess this is where greed gets you.

threads.claim: A monster guards a trapped mechanism that the letter writer triggered and is now stuck beside.
threads.quote: got myself trapped here by that awful monster.

introduced.name: Wagner
introduced.how: Mondstadt blacksmith who sells weapons, makes them to order, and does refinements
introduced.quote: Wagner: Of course. I sell weapons, make them to order, and do refinements. All in the job description for a blacksmith.

introduced.name: Forging
introduced.how: a blacksmith turns gathered ore into the weapon you need
introduced.quote: Wagner: Bring some back and I'll help you forge what you need.

introduced.name: ore
introduced.how: the raw material needed to get a weapon forged, found in deposits
introduced.quote: Wagner: All you need is the ore.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Paimon: We could start by going to Mondstadt's blacksmith.

assumed.name: Iron Chunks
assumed.quote: Traveler: Remember, you sent me to get Iron Chunks...

threads.claim: Paimon is being prepared to join the fighting on the front line with a purpose-built weapon.
threads.quote: Paimon: This is the first Paimon's heard about it! What, so you want Paimon on the front line now!?

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: hostess (The Damselette) who runs picture-guessing games with the kuuhenki
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, it's so lively here today! All those kuuhenki are dancing around Columbina!

introduced.name: kuuhenki
introduced.how: energetic, puppy-like creatures that swarm people after playtime
introduced.quote: Paimon: Crowding around you like that after playtime... Kinda like puppies, aren't they?

introduced.name: picture-guessing game
introduced.how: a game where the player guesses the image the kuuhenki are shown
introduced.quote: The Damselette: All you need to do is guess the image.

introduced.name: Rimehorn Deer
introduced.how: a creature whose fawns like to bathe in moonlight
introduced.quote: The Damselette: Just as Rimehorn Deer fawns are given to bathing in the moonlight, so too are the kuuhenki drawn to that which radiates from your heart.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
introduced.how: a Fatui-built structure in Nod-Krai, the answer to one picture
introduced.quote: The Damselette: The correct answer is the "Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau."

assumed.name: Aino
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks you might be confusing Aino with a former colleague of yours...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: The Damselette: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: The Damselette: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

assumed.name: A Gift From Her
assumed.quote: (After A Gift From Her this mini-game is part of the weekly randomly options)

threads.claim: The kuuhenki are drawn to the Traveler because of a kindness and gentleness radiating from their heart.
threads.quote: The Damselette: Just as Rimehorn Deer fawns are given to bathing in the moonlight, so too are the kuuhenki drawn to that which radiates from your heart.

threads.claim: The Fatui have raised bold structures in Nod-Krai that even the kuuhenki remember, hinting at a Fatui presence there.
threads.quote: The Damselette: The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

threads.claim: Columbina may have had a former colleague, possibly resembling Aino, hinting at a past connected to Aino's workshop.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon thinks you might be confusing Aino with a former colleague of yours...

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: venue where the Pipilpan Idol finals are held, with contestants facing the actors there
introduced.quote: After obtaining the recognition of three judges and advancing to the finals, you will face off against the actors at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

introduced.name: Pipilpan Idol Competition
introduced.how: a contest with qualifier trials and finals to crown a Pipilpan Idol
introduced.quote: You're only one step away from becoming the Pipilpan Idol of your dreams, and the opportunity is right here in front of you.

introduced.name: Pipilpan Idol
introduced.how: a title won by beating the competition's finalists
introduced.quote: Fight for the title of the unmatched Pipilpan Idol!

introduced.name: Qualifiers
introduced.how: contestants must pass the three judges' trials to reach the finals
introduced.quote: Pass the trials of the three judges to qualify for the finals.

introduced.name: Finals rating system
introduced.how: all finalists on stage are scored by a rating system to pick the winner
introduced.quote: A rating system will be used to judge all competitors on the stage to determine who deserves the title of Pipilpan Idol!

introduced.name: Campa
introduced.how: a passionate dancing coach and judge who stresses muscle power; revealed to be Chiton's father
introduced.quote: A passionate dancing coach, a professional who shall shape muscle power into an idol's strength!

introduced.name: Ohuitia
introduced.how: a sales-champion judge and travel agency owner focused on service attitude
introduced.quote: The sales champion of the People of the Springs, a real marketing maestro and service savant, to whom hearts are like an open book!

introduced.name: Ionna
introduced.how: a guest critic from Fontaine's fashion world who judges style
introduced.quote: A special guest critic hailing from Fontaine's fashion world, and an observer for the Pipilpan Idol Competition!

introduced.name: Chiton
introduced.how: Campa's daughter who wants to become a Pipilpan Idol and proves herself to her father through a bet
introduced.quote: So I made a bet with him. If I could become a Pipilpan Idol and prove myself, he'd teach me everything he knows...

assumed.name: Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: Bear the miracle of the blooming Guiztli, and let the Sacred Flame ignite your smile!

assumed.name: Tenochtzitoc
assumed.quote: In the name of Tenochtzitoc, I present to you a dance of welcome! Shine on, Pipilpan Idol!

assumed.name: Koholasaurus
assumed.quote: inclusive of full guided tours, photo shoots, plus exclusive Koholasaurus transfers

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Ohuitia: Well, now, that's what it takes to be a true Natlan idol!

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Traveler: Like Venti's lyre, for example...

threads.claim: Chiton's bet with her father Campa to be taught everything he knows hinges on her becoming a Pipilpan Idol.
threads.quote: So I made a bet with him. If I could become a Pipilpan Idol and prove myself, he'd teach me everything he knows...

threads.claim: After Chiton loses the finals, Campa takes her home to train her from scratch and makes her call him coach instead of dad.
threads.quote: Now come on — we're going back home. I'm starting your training from scratch.

threads.claim: Campa insists an idol's power comes from muscles, while Paimon suggests idols win hearts with bright smiles.
threads.quote: Muscles maketh the idol, so come on, and show me your idol power!

threads.claim: Paimon is repeatedly baffled by what a Pipilpan Idol actually is, and the question is left open at the end.
threads.quote: Paimon: Honestly, Paimon's starting to lose sight of what a Pipilpan Idol actually is...

introduced.name: Lingshu Courtyard
introduced.how: Courtyard that is the Herblord's former abode, guarded by a talking stone statue
introduced.quote: (Enter Lingshu Courtyard)

introduced.name: Herblord
introduced.how: Former resident of the abode who left it after losing the power to keep her human form
introduced.quote: Hmph! Even if I was "just a stone statue," this place is still the Herblord's abode! When she was yet with us, she did not appreciate others disturbing her peace at their liberty!

introduced.name: Carefree Simulacrum
introduced.how: Talking stone statue that guards the abode and tries to scare visitors
introduced.quote: Paimon: What...? Ah! So you're just a talking stone statue... Paimon thought you were a monster of some sort!

introduced.name: colorful butterflies and medicine jar
introduced.how: Butterflies and a jar originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree; they scattered after the lord left
introduced.quote: These colorful butterflies and the medicine jar were originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree.

introduced.name: adeptal tree
introduced.how: Withered tree planted by the Herblord that can be revived
introduced.quote: Carefree Simulacrum: Heh, that's right! Back then, the Herblord planted this adeptal tree herself...

introduced.name: adeptal mechanism
introduced.how: Mechanism designed by the Herblord to nourish the adeptal tree using butterflies in a jar
introduced.quote: Heh, this is the adeptal mechanism designed by the Herblord. Pretty amazing, huh?

introduced.name: adeptal formula
introduced.how: A formula the Herblord left that is recited to revive the adeptal tree
introduced.quote: We just need to recite the formula that Herblord left us and we can revive the adeptal tree!

assumed.name: Fujin
assumed.quote: This kind of thing should be Fujin's specialty...

assumed.name: Votive Rainjade
assumed.quote: She won't stop telling me about that 'Motive Mainjade' business...

assumed.name: adeptus
assumed.quote: This is the abode of an adeptus, after all

assumed.name: Chenyu Vale
assumed.quote: Then, even if something were to happen, the mortals of Chenyu Vale may be able to follow their guidance and find the formulae I left behind

assumed.name: adeptal energy
assumed.quote: As the vivid butterflies converge in the jar, the adeptal energy surges anew, akin to new life restored to a withered tree...

threads.claim: The Herblord left the abode after losing the power to maintain her human form, and her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: *sigh* She departed as soon as she lost the power to maintain her human form. I wonder how she's doing these days...

threads.claim: The withered adeptal tree can be revived while the colorful butterflies have not all dispersed.
threads.quote: It may be withered now, but the Herblord said that so long as the colorful butterflies haven't all dispersed, the tree can be revived!

threads.claim: Returning all the butterflies to the jar revives the adeptal tree, which blooms with luminous foliage.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa, it's changed completely!

threads.claim: The reason the Herblord used colorful butterflies in the mechanism is unclear.
threads.quote: Carefree Simulacrum: Eh? Yeah, why is that... Perhaps the Herblord was just really into colorful butterflies?

threads.claim: The butterflies were infused with adeptal energy to extend their lifespan so the formulae could be found if something went wrong.
threads.quote: Still, I should take some precautions... I'll split some adeptal energy off and inject it into the butterflies... Their lifespan will extend greatly...

threads.claim: The full adeptal formula is only partly remembered, and its ending is unknown.
threads.quote: Butterflies flutter... flutter... Uh, I don't remember what comes next, but it ends with all being revived!

threads.claim: The Carefree Simulacrum fails to recall the formula, showing its memory of the Herblord's instructions is unreliable.
threads.quote: Paimon: You couldn't even remember the formula at all!

threads.claim: The Herblord was preoccupied with a mysterious 'Votive Rainjade' matter that her companion found tiresome.
threads.quote: She won't stop telling me about that 'Motive Mainjade' business...

threads.claim: The Herblord's formulae were left behind for the mortals of Chenyu Vale to find in case of disaster.
threads.quote: Then, even if something were to happen, the mortals of Chenyu Vale may be able to follow their guidance and find the formulae I left behind

threads.claim: A branch from the revived tree placed in a broken jar outside the abode opens a stone gate.
threads.quote: Break off a branch and put it in the broken jar outside the abode, and the stone gate will open...

introduced.name: Sobolev
introduced.how: the shipment supervisor who asks the Traveler for help and explains the missing escort workers
introduced.quote: Sobolev: Funny you should ask. I've got a shipment that needs to be loaded up and sent off to Snezhnograd soon.

introduced.name: escort team
introduced.how: a group of workers assigned to escort the shipment, three of whom are missing
introduced.quote: Problem is, three people from the escort team still haven't shown up.

introduced.name: Zyablin
introduced.how: an escort team worker who has been assigned to transport safety duty that day
introduced.quote: Zyablin: What? I'm running transport safety today? Oh, crumbs. The director's gonna have my head for this!

introduced.name: Slivkov
introduced.how: a late escort team worker who was hungover from drinking the night before
introduced.quote: Slivkov: Oh... Is this late already? I didn't even know...

introduced.name: Nosov
introduced.how: an escort team worker who was unaware he had been given transport safety duty
introduced.quote: Nosov: Sorry? Transport safety? Me? He didn't tell me about that...

assumed.name: the director
assumed.quote: The director's gonna have my head for this!

introduced.name: Suriqui
introduced.how: a chubby warrior who argues that a slightly fat build is what heroes of old had
introduced.quote: Yes, this slightly chubby build I've got is what the heroes of old would've had — a body that balances impact and agility.

introduced.name: Illimani
introduced.how: a warrior who greets the Traveler, urges them to eat well, and offers a running challenge
introduced.quote: Hey, valiant passerby over there — yes, you!

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: a group of warriors who preach muscle-based strength and are seen as meatheads by the tribe
introduced.quote: Bunch of meatheads, they are, if you ask me.

introduced.name: jar-smashing challenge
introduced.how: a training challenge at a set-up location where the Traveler tests strength and agility by smashing jars
introduced.quote: Try out the jar-smashing challenge I've constructed!

introduced.name: running challenge
introduced.how: a timed run through a training ground that the Traveler can try to beat Illimani's record in
introduced.quote: Let's see how well you do — and whether you can beat my record.

introduced.name: muscle worship
introduced.how: the belief that a warrior's strength comes from muscles, which the tribe rejects as nonsense
introduced.quote: But muscle worship and the claim that a warrior's strength flows from them? Absolute nonsense.

introduced.name: heroes of old
introduced.how: ancient warriors who, per Suriqui, would have kept a layer of fat for protection in combat
introduced.quote: The heroes of old could never have had bodies that were nothing but skin, bones, and muscle.

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: The fat that the Archon blessed us with is a precious gift.

assumed.name: Teteocan
assumed.quote: Ah, valiant passerby, since you've come all the way to Teteocan, I take it you're someone seeking strength, aren't you?

threads.claim: The tribe's warriors argue that a fat-based build is better than a muscular one, and the jar challenges are presented as proof.
threads.quote: Forget chasing muscles — come join me in celebrating the greatness of fat!

threads.claim: Muscle worship is only a recent trend, and preferences for fuller figures were different in the past.
threads.quote: And honestly, if we're talking about what looks good, this whole muscle-worship thing only became popular in the last few decades.

threads.claim: The heroes of old are said to have had a protective layer of fat, a claim left unverified.
threads.quote: The heroes of old could never have had bodies that were nothing but skin, bones, and muscle.

threads.claim: The Archon is said to have blessed people with fat, which is treated as a gift.
threads.quote: The fat that the Archon blessed us with is a precious gift.

threads.claim: Illimani has relatives in the Collective of Plenty, which complicates the rivalry between the two groups.
threads.quote: But, if one day you end up like my relatives from Collective of Plenty and decide to lose weight in the name of strength...

introduced.name: Washizu
introduced.how: a maddened samurai who begs for sacrifice and to be consumed
introduced.quote: Maddened Samurai: The time has come... for sacrifice...

introduced.name: Washizu's Prayers
introduced.how: the location where the player fights Washizu
introduced.quote: (Fight Washizu in Washizu's Prayers)

introduced.name: Higi Village
introduced.how: a village whose residents are recorded as dying, sacrificed, or summoned
introduced.quote: Higi Village Residential Register:

introduced.name: Chouji's Mother
introduced.how: a villager who is missing and must be found
introduced.quote: ...Chouji's Mother, around 32 years old (?), missing. 'He' is pleased with her, and thus she must be found...

introduced.name: 'He' (the entity awaiting return)
introduced.how: an entity whose return requires living sacrifices, and which is pleased with certain people
introduced.quote: ...The possessions of the aforementioned people shall be left here as a lure, all the better to provide living sacrifices for 'his' return...

assumed.name: Shogunate
assumed.quote: Kitada, 27 years old, on the run from the Shogunate.

threads.claim: The villagers' possessions were left as a lure to attract living sacrifices.
threads.quote: ...The possessions of the aforementioned people shall be left here as a lure, all the better to provide living sacrifices for 'his' return...

threads.claim: An entity called 'he' is set to return and needs living sacrifices to do so.
threads.quote: ...The possessions of the aforementioned people shall be left here as a lure, all the better to provide living sacrifices for 'his' return...

threads.claim: Some villagers are said to have returned to oneness or been summoned rather than dying normally.
threads.quote: ...Senshiro, 4 years old, returned to oneness. Senshiro's Mother, around 25 years old, returned to oneness. Akiharu, 23 years old, summoned...

threads.claim: Chouji's Mother is missing and the entity is pleased with her, so she must be found.
threads.quote: ...Chouji's Mother, around 32 years old (?), missing. 'He' is pleased with her, and thus she must be found...

threads.claim: A maddened samurai pleads for an all-accommodating power to consume him and save him.
threads.quote: O ye who accommodates all things... accept me... consume me... save me...

introduced.name: Six-Fingered José
introduced.how: a stranger rescued from monsters who thanks the Traveler and gives them rewards
introduced.quote: Six-Fingered José: Thank you Traveler, you saved me!

assumed.name: monsters
assumed.quote: (Talk to Six-Fingered José after defeating the monsters)

threads.claim: Monsters appearing in this place were unexpected to a local, hinting that such attacks are not normal here.
threads.quote: Six-Fingered José: I never expected there to be monsters here.

introduced.name: Jack Frosts
introduced.how: Small creatures who live in a village and speak in a language the Traveler and Paimon cannot understand at first
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, we can't understand a single word you're saying, but... you're welcome?

introduced.name: Village Chief
introduced.how: The Jack Frost village chief, who introduces itself by writing a note of thanks, though it gives no real name
introduced.quote: Paimon: Let Paimon see... "Thank you, good people. I am the village chief."

introduced.name: Volkodlak
introduced.how: Raiders who invade the Jack Frosts' village to bully them and loot it
introduced.quote: Jack Frost Village Head: "Volkodlaks. Invaded. Bullied..."

introduced.name: Prime Ice
introduced.how: Prime Ice mechanisms are cannons and traps built to launch snowballs at enemies
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh! So you're trying to build some kind of Prime Ice cannon to launch the snowballs, but you guys ran out of time to assemble the mechanisms?

introduced.name: Bite-ons
introduced.how: Buttons the Jack Frosts prize and accept in trade at their shop instead of Mora
introduced.quote: Traveler: Ah, they're buttons!

introduced.name: Village shop
introduced.how: The Jack Frost village's shop, where goods are traded for buttons rather than looted
introduced.quote: Paimon: And wait, Paimon never expected this place to actually be a shop! Is it your shop?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, so you guys use Mora too?

assumed.name: Prime Ice crafting
assumed.quote: Paimon: Yeah! It's not like we haven't crafted our fair share of weird Prime Ice stuffs before...

threads.claim: The Jack Frosts speak a language the Traveler and Paimon cannot understand at first.
threads.quote: Paimon: Well, we can't understand a single word you're saying, but... you're welcome?

threads.claim: Paimon suddenly understands the Jack Frosts' speech without knowing why, leaving the cause unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: So you have some awesome stuff inside your shop? Whoa, Paimon doesn't know why, but it feels like she can understand you perfectly now, chief!

threads.claim: The village chief's real name is unknown, and Paimon nicknames it Chief.
threads.quote: Paimon: But wait, "chief" is what you do, not who you are. What's your actual name?

threads.claim: The Volkodlak wanted to loot the village shop's goods, which the Jack Frosts trade rather than steal.
threads.quote: Paimon: So you're saying those volkodlaks wanted to loot your stuff, but since this is a shop, things are supposed to be traded for?

threads.claim: A Volkodlak paid for outside help that was wasted, hinting that the raiders may be hired or backed by others.
threads.quote: Invading Volkodlak: Darn it, I was planning to get my money back this way... Now the money I paid for help has gone up in smoke!

threads.claim: The fleeing Volkodlak promises to return with backup, so the threat is not over.
threads.quote: Paimon: The Volkodlak who just fled said they'd be back with backup...

introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.how: a camera-like device from Fontaine that makes an image on paper when you press a button
introduced.quote: It's a device that... Well, you press a button, and it makes an image on a piece of paper.

introduced.name: Xu
introduced.how: runs the Kamera photo trial for the business and asks the Traveler to deliver pictures
introduced.quote: Xu: Traveler, could you do me a favor and deliver these two pictures to our customers?

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a commerce guild that will travel to take a person's photograph for a fee
introduced.quote: Granny Shan: Kamera... Ah, yes, I did go to the Feiyun Commerce Guild a few days ago — asked them to come here to take a picture of me.

introduced.name: Granny Shan
introduced.how: a customer who had her photo taken by the Kamera and wants a picture delivered
introduced.quote: Granny Shan: Oh? What's the matter?

introduced.name: Tea Master Liu Su
introduced.how: a customer who had the Guild take her picture and is considering buying a Kamera
introduced.quote: Tea Master Liu Su: Is something the matter?

introduced.name: Young master
introduced.how: the business's young master, who favors the Kamera and has been away for several days
introduced.quote: Xu: I had intended to discuss the situation with the young master, but he's been gone for several days now.

introduced.name: Fontaine
introduced.how: the region the Kamera was imported from, where it is popular
introduced.quote: Xu: Yes... We recently imported a new product from Fontaine. It's supposed to be very popular over there at the moment.

threads.claim: How the Kamera was built in Fontaine is raised as a fascinating open question.
threads.quote: Xu: I wonder how the folks in Fontaine managed to put this clever little thing together? It's so fascinating...

threads.claim: The young master who champions the Kamera has left and his whereabouts remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Xu: I had intended to discuss the situation with the young master, but he's been gone for several days now.

threads.claim: The Kamera given to the Traveler is a sample from Fontaine partners that differs from the official model.
threads.quote: Xu: This is not an exceedingly expensive object, either. It's just a sample that our partners in Fontaine gave us.

introduced.name: Kumi
introduced.how: A shy local who introduces herself and says she rarely talks to people
introduced.quote: ...I'm Kumi, nice to meet you.

introduced.name: Kuntira
introduced.how: Kumi's childhood friend, a sea creature whose skeleton is the carcass the Traveler found
introduced.quote: Her name is Kuntira, she's sort of... my childhood friend.

introduced.name: Umibouzu
introduced.how: Huge sea creatures that attack cargo ships and rob fishermen, and are hunted by humans
introduced.quote: On Narukami Island — my father's hometown, people call these creatures "Umibouzu"...

introduced.name: Narukami Island
introduced.how: Kumi's father's hometown, where Umibouzu are hunted, and where Kumi came from
introduced.quote: I cam from Narukami Island wanting to visit her and stay here for a while...

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: Kumi's mother's hometown, where locals gave each sea creature its own name
introduced.quote: The people of Watatsumi never gave her species a common name.

introduced.name: Thunder Sakura
introduced.how: Flower Kuntira loved, which grows in a place that is now unsafe to visit
introduced.quote: She loves Thunder Sakura flowers.

introduced.name: Bourou Village
introduced.how: The village where Kumi lives
introduced.quote: I live in Bourou Village.

introduced.name: Anisa
introduced.how: A Sumeru researcher who introduces herself as a trainee Dastur
introduced.quote: I'm Anisa. Anisa Purbiruni. Trainee Dastur at Sumeru Akademiya's Oceanographic Society.

introduced.name: Sumeru Akademiya
introduced.how: The academy Anisa belongs to, which has an Oceanographic Society
introduced.quote: Trainee Dastur at Sumeru Akademiya's Oceanographic Society.

introduced.name: Dastur
introduced.how: A formal scholarly rank that requires two theses to pass review
introduced.quote: To formally become a Dastur as opposed to remaining a trainee, you need to have two different theses pass through the review stage...

introduced.name: Biruni
introduced.how: A great scholar, the ancestor of Anisa's academic lineage
introduced.quote: it's because my academic lineage dates back five centuries to the great scholar, the sage Biruni.

introduced.name: Watatsumi statues
introduced.how: Memorial statues where shrine maidens hid offerings behind puzzles
introduced.quote: You know, the statues of Watatsumi here are the object of my research.

introduced.name: heart's desire
introduced.how: Riches left by ancestors as gifts, found by solving the statue puzzles as a form of worship
introduced.quote: It's as you guessed. I'm referring to the riches offered to the statues of Watatsumi — the gifts of forebears to their descendants.

introduced.name: Kuntira's death
introduced.how: Kuntira was the last of her kind and died alone, and Kumi was left behind
introduced.quote: She was the last remnant of their kind. She was born alone, and she died alone.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: I heard from the elders of Bourou Village that there is hilichurl activity again on the beach to the west.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: It so happens that a researcher from Sumeru passed by here the other day and is heading there...

assumed.name: Inazuma war and Shogunate
assumed.quote: Due to the war, confusion, the pressure from the Shogunate...it's all too much, and many people have considered giving up.

assumed.name: Sakura Blooms
assumed.quote: (After submitting the Sakura Blooms)

assumed.name: Elemental Monuments
assumed.quote: (Upon activating the three Elemental Monuments)

threads.claim: Kuntira may have been the last of her kind, leaving her death as an open question.
threads.quote: And she, my best friend... may have been the last of her kind.

threads.claim: Anisa suggests from the bones that Kuntira died peacefully before reaching the shore.
threads.quote: Based on a rough observation of her bone age, I would estimate that she passed away safely before she came to shore...

threads.claim: Umibouzu have been nearly wiped out in most oceans, but not here, raising a question.
threads.quote: These sea creatures have been all but wiped out in most ocean regions, but it seems that this isn't the case here...

threads.claim: Umibouzu here appear to have grown close to humanity, which is unusual.
threads.quote: It seems as though they've even grown close to humanity.

threads.claim: An elder said solving the shrine maiden's puzzle would reveal 'our heart's desire,' a hint at hidden treasure.
threads.quote: Mm-hmm. The village elder used to say that if we could solve the shrine maiden's puzzle, then "our heart's desire" would emerge.

threads.claim: Anisa confirms the heart's desire is treasure left by ancestors as a symbol of trust.
threads.quote: Haha, it's fine. It's like I said, this is a symbol of "the heart's desire."

threads.claim: Kumi fears that being stranded and dying alone may be her own destiny too.
threads.quote: Recently I've been thinking, sooner or later, this might be my destiny as well.

threads.claim: Anisa urges Kumi to let her life begin again without fear of loss.
threads.quote: Then let your life begin once again — this time, without any fear of loss.

threads.claim: Anisa's second thesis in marine biology is on hold because of unrest in Inazuma.
threads.quote: My second field of study is actually in marine biology, but due to the recent instability in Inazuma, I've had to call a halt to research on that front.

threads.claim: The war blocks the way home for Kumi and disrupts the people around her.
threads.quote: The way home is also blocked by war...

introduced.name: Jack
introduced.how: a commissioned adventurer who got into trouble scouting monsters at the Temple
introduced.quote: Oh, you're... the traveler.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: Mondstadt figure who issues commissions for adventurers to scout monster movements after the storm
introduced.quote: Cyrus said the we need to stop monsters from taking this opportunity to attack us. So he put out commissions for adventurers to scout their movements out.

introduced.name: Thousand Winds Temple
introduced.how: a site near Mondstadt where monsters were observed gathering in large numbers
introduced.quote: My next commission was to observe the monsters around the Thousand Winds Temple, so I confirmed my tasking and left.

introduced.name: Adventurer Handbook
introduced.how: an item adventurers carry that can be replaced by asking Katheryne for a new one
introduced.quote: And if I really lost my handbook, I don't know how I would have asked Katheryne for a new one.

introduced.name: Adventurer Rank Rating
introduced.how: a rating process adventurers go through, where showing off skills may matter
introduced.quote: I thought that if I could show my stuff a bit more, I could get through the rating process safely.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: All of Mondstadt's a mess right now.

assumed.name: the storm that hit Mondstadt
assumed.quote: You must have seen the storm that hit us, too.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: And if I really lost my handbook, I don't know how I would have asked Katheryne for a new one.

threads.claim: Monsters are taking advantage of the storm to attack Mondstadt, prompting scouting commissions.
threads.quote: Cyrus said the we need to stop monsters from taking this opportunity to attack us.

threads.claim: A large group of monsters is gathering at Thousand Winds Temple, possibly preparing an attack.
threads.quote: At the Temple, I saw a large group of monsters gathering together, and I tried to get a closer look...

introduced.name: treasure map
introduced.how: a map marking a spot where treasure is buried, which the party digs up
introduced.quote: There really is treasure! It is a treasure map!

introduced.name: mailbox
introduced.how: receives new Aranara paintings over time, which can point to treasure
introduced.quote: It may receive some new paintings later.

introduced.name: Vanarana in the dream
introduced.how: a dream version of a location where digging finds no treasure, unlike reality
introduced.quote: Maybe it's because we are in the "Vanarana in the dream." If we do return to reality, then there should be treasure!

introduced.name: trapped Aranara
introduced.how: Aranara who have gone missing and may be trapped somewhere, to be rescued
introduced.quote: We might even help some trapped Aranara!

introduced.name: Aranara's cabin
introduced.how: a house belonging to an Aranara whose owner has not been found
introduced.quote: (Go back to Aranara's cabin)

assumed.name: Aranara
assumed.quote: Is this an Aranara painting...?

threads.claim: Aranara may be trapped somewhere, and the party intends to find and help them.
threads.quote: We might even help some trapped Aranara!

threads.claim: The Aranara house owner is still missing, so the trapped Aranara remain unfound.
threads.quote: We haven't found the house owner. This is worrying!

threads.claim: The mailbox receives new paintings over time, which may carry clues about the missing Aranara.
threads.quote: It may receive some new paintings later.

threads.claim: A newer painting shows more Aranara than before, hinting at where the missing Aranara may be.
threads.quote: It has more Aranara in it...

threads.claim: Treasure appears only in reality and not in the dream version of a location, hinting at a dream world linked to reality.
threads.quote: Maybe it's because we are in the "Vanarana in the dream." If we do return to reality, then there should be treasure!

introduced.name: Araminali
introduced.how: Aranara who owns the treasure chests and rewards helpful Nara
introduced.quote: All the "chests" here belong to Araminali.

introduced.name: Aranimba
introduced.how: Traveling Aranara who was once a seed and sends back paintings
introduced.quote: It's Aranimba! Unlike Araminali, Aranimba likes to travel around.

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Forest folk who are born knowing everything about Vana
introduced.quote: Aranara knew everything about Vana when they were born

introduced.name: Shriveled Seed
introduced.how: Seed that vibrates to point the way and becomes an Aranara after drinking water
introduced.quote: He needs to drink a lot of water before he can change back to what he was.

introduced.name: Vanarana
introduced.how: Home area of the Aranara, where Aranimba used to send paintings
introduced.quote: he would draw the scenery he saw from afar and send it back to Vanarana

introduced.name: Arayama
introduced.how: Former Aranara who left Vanarana with Araminali and Aranimba
introduced.quote: Arayama and Aranimba are no longer in Vanarana.

introduced.name: Treasure chests
introduced.how: Chests Araminali fills with gifts from grateful Aranara; good Nara may open them
introduced.quote: For good friends of Aranara who helped a lot of Aranara... Aranara will be "grateful," and will put the "treasure" into the "chests."

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: traveled so far that he even left Sumeru

assumed.name: The Chasm: Underground Mines
assumed.quote: Um... Sounds like The Chasm.

assumed.name: Aramuhukunda
assumed.quote: Aranimba was protected by Aramuhukunda, and turned into a seed

assumed.name: White Floaty
assumed.quote: thanks to Golden Nara and White Floaty

assumed.name: Ararakalari
assumed.quote: Arayama's Ararakalari is very strong.

threads.claim: The seed vibrates and seems to want to go somewhere, hinting it holds a trapped Aranara.
threads.quote: Paimon thinks it wants to go somewhere!

threads.claim: The seed turns out to be the trapped Aranara Aranimba, confirming the earlier guess.
threads.quote: Wow! The seed has become an Aranara!

threads.claim: Aramuhukunda protected Aranimba and turned him into a seed, and what it is remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Aranimba was protected by Aramuhukunda, and turned into a seed

threads.claim: Chests were born empty for reasons Araminali does not understand.
threads.quote: Araminali doesn't know why.

threads.claim: The story frames Aranara friendship and who counts as a good friend as a recurring theme.
threads.quote: Um... Is this Aranara's friendship?

threads.claim: Araminali is left alone after his companions leave and feels the loss of Arayama and Aranimba.
threads.quote: But now, there are only Araminali and his "treasure chest."

introduced.name: Euphrasie
introduced.how: Steambird publisher who interviews applicants and hands out troubleshooter commissions
introduced.quote: Euphrasie: Truly spectacular weather today, no?

introduced.name: The Steambird
introduced.how: newspaper that citizens approach for help and that publishes the Tales of Humanity section
introduced.quote: Observation. Every citizen who comes to The Steambird seeking help appears anxious and jittery, but you...

introduced.name: Tales of Humanity
introduced.how: newspaper section where citizens submit problems for the player to solve
introduced.quote: All you need to do is find some time every week to read through the submissions to "Tales of Humanity."

introduced.name: Troubleshooter
introduced.how: job title for a paid helper who takes on citizens' submitted problems
introduced.quote: Euphrasie: Yes, yes, I know. The name "troubleshooter" is simply too gauche and unbecoming of the standards of a publication such as ours.

introduced.name: Commissions
introduced.how: individual submitted problems the player picks, handles, and returns to collect payment for
introduced.quote: Pick out a few commissions you'd like to handle, and come find me to collect your payment.

introduced.name: Reputation
introduced.how: standing with citizens that grows as commissions are completed and brings bigger jobs
introduced.quote: your reputation among the citizenry will increase over time.

assumed.name: Ethan
assumed.quote: Euphrasie: Yes... Ethan has substantial room for growth when it comes to coining new words.

threads.claim: Euphrasie claims to know things about people without being told, through methods she does not explain.
threads.quote: Don't be surprised. I have my ways. If I couldn't even manage that, how could I manage a newspaper?

threads.claim: The Steambird's stated calling is to help people achieve happiness and to illuminate humanity.
threads.quote: Help everyone to achieve happiness and be a lighthouse illuminating humanity, such is the calling of our paper.

threads.claim: Problems that seem trivial to outsiders can weigh heavily on the people who face them.
threads.quote: But for the readers submitting their problems, they are like a splinter under their fingernails, impossible to remove or ignore.

introduced.name: Taliesin
introduced.how: a poet who lost his brass ring and asks the Traveler to find it
introduced.quote: Taliesin: My ring... It's gone. It means a lot to me. I must find it...

introduced.name: Brass Ring
introduced.how: Taliesin's brass ring inlaid with a red gem, stolen from him
introduced.quote: Taliesin: It's made of brass and is inlaid with a beautiful red gem...

introduced.name: Durin (Historical)
introduced.how: a shadow dragon said to have fallen beside a lava lake in legend
introduced.quote: Taliesin: I found it by a lava lake where the shadow dragon Durin fell in the legends. Or at least, this should explain why its luster resembles dark flames...

introduced.name: Lord of the Abyss
introduced.how: a dark lord said to curse ring bearers and send darkness to hunt them
introduced.quote: Taliesin: It is said that the Lord of the Abyss will fix its malefic gaze upon the ring bearer and send an army of darkness to hunt them down.

introduced.name: Weasel Thieves
introduced.how: a group of thieving weasel-like creatures that steal items and nest in the area
introduced.quote: Clitopho: Weasel Thieves trained by Treasure Hoarders are fed at fixed hours in a day. There are three types of Weasel Thieves...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a suspicious group with a camp nearby that trains Weasel Thieves
introduced.quote: Taliesin: I've heard that there is a camp of suspicious Treasure Hoarders around here on the map... I've marked the location out for you.

introduced.name: Clitopho
introduced.how: a Weasel Thief trainer who failed to capture the thieves and offers help
introduced.quote: Clitopho: Hey there, has something happened recently?

introduced.name: Weasel Thief types (Amateur, Hoarder, Golden)
introduced.how: three ranks of Weasel Thieves with different feeding hours and cunning levels
introduced.quote: Clitopho: The Golden Weasel Thief is the most cunning one... Then, there's the more common Hoarder Weasel Thief. The dumbest of all is the Amateur Weasel Thief.

introduced.name: Weasel Thief whistle summoning
introduced.how: whistling at the right hours on a large rock summons Weasel Thieves
introduced.quote: Clitopho: Ah... I almost forgot this! Give a whistle if you want to summon them.

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: Traveler: Dragonspine doesn't have a lava lake. (Unlocked if the player has been to Dragonspine)

assumed.name: The Chasm
assumed.quote: Clitopho: Oh, you mean the ones in The Chasm... I was assigned to take care of them, but I messed up, so there's really nothing much to say.

assumed.name: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
assumed.quote: (Talk to Clitopho, optional — only possible if Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits has been completed)

threads.claim: A legend says the Lord of the Abyss curses ring bearers with a malefic gaze and sends darkness after them.
threads.quote: Taliesin: It is said that the Lord of the Abyss will fix its malefic gaze upon the ring bearer and send an army of darkness to hunt them down.

threads.claim: Taliesin admits his dramatic tale of the Lord of the Abyss and Durin was embellished poetic fiction.
threads.quote: Taliesin: Ahem... My bad. As a poet, I have a propensity for dramatic language and novel tales.

threads.claim: The shadow dragon Durin is said to have fallen beside a lava lake, a claim the Traveler finds doubtful.
threads.quote: Traveler: I don't believe this story.

threads.claim: Weasel Thieves are a recurring threat that steals valuables and is linked to Treasure Hoarders.
threads.quote: Taliesin: Hehe, truth be told, I found the ring in a Weasel Thieves' nest... It was well-preserved and eye-pleasing, so I kept it.

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders may be behind the Weasel Thieves' thefts and training.
threads.quote: Taliesin: It's said that Weasel Thieves are often spotted around here. Those sneaky Treasure Hoarders probably have something to do with them... Anyway, please take a look there.

threads.claim: Clitopho admits he failed to capture the Weasel Thieves in The Chasm and offers a way to summon them.
threads.quote: Clitopho: Oh, you mean the ones in The Chasm... I was assigned to take care of them, but I messed up, so there's really nothing much to say.

threads.claim: The ring has passed through several thieves, raising the question of who its rightful owner is.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmph... A ring stolen from the Weasel Thieves, which was then stolen again by other Weasel Thieves. Paimon'd say it has gone back to its rightful owner!

threads.claim: The Golden Weasel Thief's stolen ring is returned to Taliesin, resolving the lost-ring mystery.
threads.quote: Taliesin: Yes, it is! Thank you so much!

introduced.name: Junkichi
introduced.how: a novelist planning a ninja story who argues with Shigeru over narrative structure
introduced.quote: Oh, its you! I was just thinking about to structure a novel about a ninja.

introduced.name: Shigeru
introduced.how: a critic who insists a writer set narrative devices in place before writing
introduced.quote: I'm just asking you to put your narrative devices in place first before you start writing...

introduced.name: narrative devices
introduced.how: pre-set story tools a writer locks in beforehand so the plot does not go off course
introduced.quote: If you had these devices locked in beforehand, your writing wouldn't go all over the shop!

introduced.name: Storytelling Method (Domain)
introduced.how: a domain where the player acts out Junkichi's ninja story
introduced.quote: (The player is teleported into the domain)

introduced.name: the ninja
introduced.how: a supremely skilled infiltrator in Junkichi's story who steals enemy intel
introduced.quote: So, as I was writing, this ninja is entering the enemy fortress solo, preparing to steal critical intelligence.

introduced.name: intel box
introduced.how: the box of intelligence the ninja retrieves as the domain's final objective
introduced.quote: If I might interrupt, what's the intel exactly? Why's it just a box?

assumed.name: Plunging Attack
assumed.quote: Perhaps the ground here can be broken with a Plunging Attack...

assumed.name: investigation points
assumed.quote: (If the player interacts with the investigation points nearby)

assumed.name: Precious Chests
assumed.quote: (If the player approaches the room with three Precious Chests)

threads.claim: Junkichi insists the narrative should come first and resists fixed narrative devices, setting up a dispute over how stories should be planned.
threads.quote: The narrative is the most important thing in the novel, which everything else revolves around, even the setting and narrative devices...

threads.claim: The unit ends with Junkichi questioning whether narrative devices or the narrative matters more, leaving the question open.
threads.quote: Hmm, narrative devices or narrative... Which is more important?

threads.claim: Shigeru argues that without narrative devices to restrain them, the story's elements clash and the writer loses control of the plot.
threads.quote: Without narrative devices to restrain you, the various elements just clash wildly against each other.

threads.claim: The contents of the intel box are left unexplained, as Junkichi admits he has not yet decided what the intelligence is.
threads.quote: I—I haven't finished thinking yet! ...Whatever the case, the ninja has the intel now!

introduced.name: Icahua
introduced.how: a marksman who is busy training and wants the Traveler to leave
introduced.quote: I'm a marksman, so I need to train.

introduced.name: Tecuhtli
introduced.how: a man who has a grudge against Icahua and wants to confront him
introduced.quote: What's important is whether you've seen a bald-headed guy around here? I have something to talk to him about.

assumed.name: Traveler's earlier meeting with Tecuhtli at the bar
assumed.quote: You were a guest in the bar. We've met.

assumed.name: Bandit camp
assumed.quote: These are the things I found in his camp.

threads.claim: An unseen speaker is secretly shooting enemies near Icahua and watching the Traveler, with unclear motives.
threads.quote: I've handled it for you. At last, I get to have a bit of fun with a mind that doesn't matter.

threads.claim: The unseen shooter is menacing the Traveler and hints at a dangerous, possibly violent interest.
threads.quote: Please move your head a little further away — otherwise, I might be unable to resist.

threads.claim: Tecuhtli holds a grudge against Icahua and vows revenge.
threads.quote: Hmph. I'll get you for this, Icahua...

threads.claim: Tecuhtli has taken Icahua's belongings from his camp and threatens to end Icahua's life.
threads.quote: Sooner or later, his life will be mine.

introduced.name: Strange Mark
introduced.how: dust-like residue carrying elemental marks, found by the Traveler and Paimon
introduced.quote: It looks like dust, but with elemental marks on.

assumed.name: Anemo (wind) element
assumed.quote: Paimon wonders if you can use the wind to get rid of it...

threads.claim: Dust bearing elemental marks appears in the world, and its origin and purpose are left unexplained.
threads.quote: It looks like dust, but with elemental marks on.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: a people whose ancestors were famed warriors, now seen as too laid-back
introduced.quote: From the perspective of a guest, have you ever thought that the life the People of the Springs lead is too laid-back?

introduced.name: Uenuku
introduced.how: a legendary ancestral hero, the Treader of the Rainbow
introduced.quote: Uenuku the Treader of the Rainbow, Tupac the Giant... Renowned heroes all!

introduced.name: Tupac
introduced.how: a legendary ancestral hero called the Giant
introduced.quote: Uenuku the Treader of the Rainbow, Tupac the Giant... Renowned heroes all!

introduced.name: Amina
introduced.how: a young person Rongo consulted, who agreed to build the training ground
introduced.quote: That's why I told lil' Amina that we've gotta build a training ground — to stoke that spirit once more!

introduced.name: Flowcurrent Birds
introduced.how: thick-skinned creatures that knock surfers into the water
introduced.quote: They've got thick skin and sturdy flesh, and don't get hurt even if you boop them into the air.

introduced.name: Great Training Arena
introduced.how: a surfing training ground meant to rekindle fighting spirit
introduced.quote: So, this is it! The Great Training Arena of the People of the Springs!

introduced.name: surfing training racks
introduced.how: wooden racks used in surfing training that part the water when set right
introduced.quote: These racks are used in surfing training, which makes them far from ordinary!

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: ancient devices that power the Spiritdoors and Spiritways when working
introduced.quote: When Amina and I were discussing this whole affair, these old Phlogiston Devices still operated normally.

introduced.name: Spiritways
introduced.how: devices that carry riders straight up to the rainbow when activated
introduced.quote: If they could still be used to activate those Spiritways, we could've ridden them straight up to the rainbow, just like Uenuku once did!

introduced.name: Spiritdoors
introduced.how: old doors that need Phlogiston repair and a scholar to fix
introduced.quote: Now it's a shame, but I haven't yet found a scholar who can repair these Spiritdoors.

introduced.name: Shiny Shell
introduced.how: a shell given as a reward for helping the People of the Springs
introduced.quote: And here's the shell you were promised. Take it!

introduced.name: Ancient Inscription
introduced.how: a carved text suggesting colored shells be attached to fix the Spiritscript
introduced.quote: ...Separate the Phlogiston Engravings into differently-colored and attach said shells to the...

assumed.name: Chikya
assumed.quote: Paimon: (Speaking of that, Chikya probably knows how to fix these, right? But we don't know where she is right now...)

assumed.name: Seeker No Finding
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Seeker No Finding)

assumed.name: Phlogiston Scholar
assumed.quote: And I'm a whole bunch of things, but Phlogiston Scholar isn't one of them, so I've gotta call someone else in to fix this later.

threads.claim: The rainbow can be reached by riding a Spiritway, a feat Uenuku once accomplished.
threads.quote: If they could still be used to activate those Spiritways, we could've ridden them straight up to the rainbow, just like Uenuku once did!

threads.claim: The People of the Springs' fighting spirit is feared to be vanishing because of their easy living.
threads.quote: Rongo: Hardly, no, but all this easy living will see our fighting spirit vanish in time, mark my words!

threads.claim: The ancient Phlogiston Devices are failing and their repair is a matter for specialists.
threads.quote: Normally, there should be regarding the repair of these ancient Phlogiston Devices near them. Maybe these are exceptions.

threads.claim: The reactivated devices still need partial readjustment before they work properly.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm, how should Paimon put this, though? We've reactivated the devices, but Paimon thinks they need partial readjusting...

threads.claim: The Spiritway shut again after the challenge, so the earlier repair was only temporary.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh. Seems like the Spiritway's shut again...

threads.claim: Chikya may know how to repair the Phlogiston devices, but her whereabouts are unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: (Speaking of that, Chikya probably knows how to fix these, right? But we don't know where she is right now...)

threads.claim: No scholar has yet been found who can repair the Spiritdoors.
threads.quote: Now it's a shame, but I haven't yet found a scholar who can repair these Spiritdoors.

threads.claim: Ancient inscriptions suggest attaching colored shells to the Spiritscript to unblock it.
threads.quote: ...Separate the Phlogiston Engravings into differently-colored and attach said shells to the...

threads.claim: Inserting the shells as the inscription suggested reactivated the Spiritdoors.
threads.quote: Rongo: Ohh! Ohhh! I... didn't expect you to actually fix those doors! You... You've got spirit alright! Lots of it!

introduced.name: Zhangsun Jijing
