introduced.how: introduces himself as a practitioner of the Guhua Clan's martial arts
introduced.quote: Greetings. I'm Zhangsun Jijing.

introduced.name: Guhua
introduced.how: a Great Master of the sect who perfected agility on the stone piles
introduced.quote: when the Great Master Guhua honed his agility upon these very stone piles

introduced.name: Guhua Clan
introduced.how: Zhangsun's sect, whose ancient masters could scale walls and run on roofs
introduced.quote: According to the records, the ancient masters of my sect, the Guhua Clan, could scale city walls as if they were walking on flat ground.

introduced.name: Rain Cutter
introduced.how: a martial art passed down to Zhangsun by his master
introduced.quote: since rain never falls in this realm, I'm unable to practice the "Rain Cutter" arts passed down by my master.

introduced.name: Plumwatcher Piles
introduced.how: a stone-pile course in Guhua that Zhangsun uses as a test of skill
introduced.quote: Have a look at this — our "Plumwatcher Piles," the pride of Guhua.

introduced.name: Leaping Techniques
introduced.how: a set of Guhua Clan skills drawn from roof-running and wall-scaling
introduced.quote: Having truly mastered the art of roof-running and wall-scaling, they distilled these skills into the Leaping Techniques.

introduced.name: Painted realm
introduced.how: the painting's inner realm, where rain never falls
introduced.quote: since rain never falls in this realm

introduced.name: Guhua's ascent and secret art
introduced.how: rumored purple-haze ascension to the heavens by treading air through a legendary secret art
introduced.quote: Rumor has it that our Grandmaster, Guhua, once ascended the heavens amidst a purple haze

assumed.name: Wind Glider
assumed.quote: could we pull off something similar by using a Wind Glider?

threads.claim: Guhua supposedly ascended the heavens by treading air through a legendary secret art, which is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Rumor has it that our Grandmaster, Guhua, once ascended the heavens amidst a purple haze, treading upon the very air as if it were solid ground

threads.claim: The Traveler's glider feat is judged not to be treading upon air, so the secret art remains unproven.
threads.quote: One could not call that "treading upon air," but you have inspired me all the same.

threads.claim: The painted realm never receives rain, which prevents Zhangsun from practicing his Rain Cutter art.
threads.quote: since rain never falls in this realm, I'm unable to practice the "Rain Cutter" arts passed down by my master.

introduced.name: Beryl Conch
introduced.how: a home decoration that is quaint and elegant, and Sylvie is collecting them
introduced.quote: Beryl Conches are both quaint and elegant. Simply the best home decoration to be found anyway.

introduced.name: Sylvie
introduced.how: a collector of Beryl Conches who works at a place the Traveler can find her
introduced.quote: Yes, that's right, I am collecting them.

assumed.name: Tales of Humanity
assumed.quote: Ah! My submission to "Tales of Humanity" has been answered!

assumed.name: Beryl Conch commission
assumed.quote: You've already prepared all the Beryl Conches I requested, haven't you?

assumed.name: Lady Sandrone
assumed.quote: Lyney: Thank you for your hospitality, Lady Sandrone.

assumed.name: Lyney
assumed.quote: Lyney: Alright, take care.

assumed.name: Marionette
assumed.quote: Traveler: Marionette: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

threads.claim: The Marionette speaker suggests a separate persona that Lyney is about to set aside, hinting at a hidden identity.
threads.quote: Traveler: Marionette: I think it's time I started clearing up.

introduced.name: Bobik
introduced.how: a giant civilian all-terrain transportation robot, Drzislav's pride and joy
introduced.quote: This is , civilian all-terrain transportation device, and our buddy Drzislav's pride and joy!

introduced.name: Anezka
introduced.how: an intuition-driven treasure hunter who takes commission bounties and teams up with Macola
introduced.quote: Then we'll have Macola's skills, Slava's brains, and my intuition — we'll never have to worry about commission bounties ever again!

introduced.name: Macola
introduced.how: a scientist-minded friend who finds Drzislav's instruction manuals hard to read
introduced.quote: It's just that reading the instructions he left behind gives me a headache... Uh, from the knowledge boost, I mean!

introduced.name: Drzislav
introduced.how: a scientist and friend who built Bobik and wrote long, detailed instructions
introduced.quote: Macola: And speaking of that, Drzislav's really outdone himself, too! Forty-plus pages just to introduce each component, my word!

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: a group that claims it hired Drzislav and owns everything he made, and is hunting Bobik
introduced.quote: Fatui Task Force: Drzislav? We hired Drzislav. Everything he created, we own. Even the names of said creations.

introduced.name: Allochka
introduced.how: a Fatui leader who wants to reprogram Bobik into a weapon and distrusts scientists
introduced.quote: Fatui Task Force: Heh, worked a dream. Quickly, take the Landrover back to our garrison and hand it over to Lady Allochka.

introduced.name: backup program module
introduced.how: a module that must be plugged into the console to reset Bobik
introduced.quote: According to the instructions, all we have to do is plug the backup program module into the console!

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Eh!? What are the Fatui doing here? Oh, darn it, they'll see us!

assumed.name: The Flagship
assumed.quote: insofar as downing eight mugs of alcohol together at The Flagship might form such bonds.

assumed.name: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued)

threads.claim: Drzislav has gone missing after running into trouble and skipping town.
threads.quote: Anezka: I'll bet that was the case! No wonder Slava told us he'd run into some trouble and had to skip town for a bit. Let's go check it out, then!

threads.claim: Drzislav's recorded voice speaks through the lab terminal, so he may be nearby and his whereabouts stay unknown.
threads.quote: Macola: That voice just now — that was Drzislav! Fascinating. It was almost like he was in the room with us.

threads.claim: The Fatui claim legal ownership of Bobik because Drzislav was their hired creator.
threads.quote: Fatui Task Force: Drzislav? We hired Drzislav. Everything he created, we own. Even the names of said creations.

threads.claim: The Fatui take Bobik and reprogram him to serve their command.
threads.quote: Allochka: Don't worry, Landrover. You will soon have the power that should always have been yours to command.

threads.claim: Allochka plans to turn Bobik into a powerful weapon rather than a civilian vehicle.
threads.quote: Allochka: Turning such a powerful weapon — capable of rewriting the script of a battle — into a civilian transportation vehicle... Is this some kind of joke?

threads.claim: Bobik is restored from the Fatui reprogramming and is stronger than before.
threads.quote: Macola: But now he's all better, and stronger than before to boot.

threads.claim: The party debates whether operating large machines should rely on rigorous manual reading or on intuition.
threads.quote: Macola: When operating such large machines, are you the type to rigorously dig through the instruction manual, or will you immediately turn the machine on

threads.claim: The backup program module is needed to reset Bobik, but its appearance is unknown.
threads.quote: Macola: The restart should be quite easy, right? We just need to find something that looks like an on-off switch. But what is this "backup program module" again...?

threads.claim: The party finds the backup program module and uses it to restore Bobik.
threads.quote: Paimon: Found it! This must be the backup program module!

introduced.name: Kid Kujirai
introduced.how: a young child selling goods who invites the Traveler to play Temari
introduced.quote: Hi big ! I have some good stuff here...

introduced.name: Temari game
introduced.how: a hide-and-seek game where one player hides a Temari ball for the other to find
introduced.quote: It's simple. I will hide the Temari somewhere nearby.

introduced.name: Temari song
introduced.how: the song's length sets the time limit for hiding and finding the Temari
introduced.quote: If big can find it within the time of a Temari song, you win.

introduced.name: Temari bomb
introduced.how: a Temari ball can be made into an explosive bomb
introduced.quote: As long as I do something to it, the Temari can turn into a bomb.

introduced.name: Stormterror's Lair
introduced.how: a tall-towered place in Mondstadt, correctly named Stormterror's Lair
introduced.quote: It's Stormterror's Lair.

introduced.name: Big Sister adventurer
introduced.how: an adventurer who taught Kid Kujirai Temari, gave away Temari, and said to find greedy travelers to play with
introduced.quote: Once, I met that Big Sister who was an adventurer.

introduced.name: Kid Kujirai's sister
introduced.how: a fisherman who let the child wander off to play alone
introduced.quote: Because when my sister was fishing, she thought I would scare the fish away, so she let me go out to play.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Wow! Have you also been to Mondstadt?

assumed.name: Tenshukaku
assumed.quote: I wonder if that tower is taller, or if the Almighty Shogun's Tenshukaku is taller...

assumed.name: hilichurls and slimes
assumed.quote: I've blasted away a lot of bad guys, like hilichurls and slimes!

threads.claim: An unnamed adventurer taught the child Temari and handed out bomb-making Temari, hinting at a mysterious figure behind the game.
threads.quote: Once, I met that Big Sister who was an adventurer.

threads.claim: Temari balls can be turned into bombs, raising the question of how dangerous the game really is.
threads.quote: As long as I do something to it, the Temari can turn into a bomb.

threads.claim: The adventurer's warning that only bad guys get bombed is shown to be doubtful, so the danger of the Temari bombs remains open.
threads.quote: Only the bad guys will be bombed. Probably.

threads.claim: Paimon suspects the child is involved in shady dealings with the goods being offered, a suspicion the child denies.
threads.quote: How pitiful, being forced to do shady business at such a young age.

introduced.name: Woliu
introduced.how: A hydrologist researching in Chenyu Vale who introduces herself and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Please allow me to introduce myself first. I'm Woliu, a hydrologist. I'm currently conducting some investigations in Chenyu Vale for research purposes.

introduced.name: Hydrology
introduced.how: The study of water also covers terrain, geology, weather and the residents' daily lives, not just water movement

assumed.name: Countess Shakhovskaya

assumed.name: Danica

threads.claim: Vesna's real motive stays ambiguous, as she offers a royal test of strength while also hinting at training her own troops.
threads.quote: No, no! Her Majesty really did order me to test your strength as Privy Councilor. I just thought I'd give you a little surprise while I was at it.

assumed.name: Pulverite
assumed.quote: (Smash through the Pulverite, optional)

threads.claim: The purple Tepetlisaurs have been corrupted by the Abyss, hinting at an Abyss link to the monsters.
threads.quote: They've clearly been corrupted by the Abyss!

threads.claim: Paimon identifies the monsters as Abyssal creatures that are more dangerous than Tepetlisaurs.
threads.quote: You've got it all wrong — those are Abyssal monsters! They're way more dangerous than Tepetlisaurs.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom is invoked as an all-seeing, inescapable force, raising questions about who it is.
threads.quote: The boss is like the Night Kingdom — everywhere, all the time.

threads.claim: A sudden volcanic eruption triggered the monster attack and scattered the caravan.
threads.quote: Our caravan was moving along just fine when the volcano erupted out of nowhere.

threads.claim: Tepetlisaurs are stronger than Tatankasaurs and can wreck carts with a swing of their tails.
threads.quote: They're even stronger than Tatankasaurs — definitely not the kind of opponents just anyone can handle.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt
introduced.how: a hostile force whose monsters and lingering darkness plague the areas the Traveler visits
introduced.quote: Strange Rift: (Though the monsters have dispersed, the darkness has not faded. You may need to enlist the help of a professional who knows more about the Wild Hunt.)

introduced.name: Tideseal Stones
introduced.how: stones that can be cleansed to disperse monsters in a Wild Hunt area
introduced.quote: (After cleansing the first Tideseal Stone)

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: a group based in Nasha Town that may know about the mysterious stranger
introduced.quote: Paimon: Nasha Town's got some Lightkeepers, maybe they know something! Let's ask them.

introduced.name: Nasha Town
introduced.how: a town where Lightkeepers can be found
introduced.quote: Paimon: Nasha Town's got some Lightkeepers, maybe they know something! Let's ask them.

introduced.name: Sukhovykh
introduced.how: a companion who asks the Traveler to return Sigurd's relics to his grave
introduced.quote: Sukhovykh: If you can, please take those relics to his grave. It lies near the eastern battlefield ruins on Lempo Isle.

introduced.name: Lushne
introduced.how: a companion who suspects the stranger may be Sigurd
introduced.quote: Lushne: ...Could it have been Sigurd? He hasn't been able to rest in peace, even until now, it seems. If only I could...

introduced.name: Sigurd
introduced.how: a former Starshyna who fought the Wild Hunt to the end and is the mysterious stranger
introduced.quote: Sukhovykh: Yes. He was a formidable Starshyna, and when the Wild Hunt swept over Nod-Krai, he fought valiantly till the end.

introduced.name: Wild Hunt sweep over Nod-Krai
introduced.how: the Wild Hunt swept over Nod-Krai, and Sigurd fought them until his death
introduced.quote: Sukhovykh: Yes. He was a formidable Starshyna, and when the Wild Hunt swept over Nod-Krai, he fought valiantly till the end.

introduced.name: Lempo Isle
introduced.how: an island with eastern battlefield ruins where Sigurd's grave lies
introduced.quote: Sukhovykh: If you can, please take those relics to his grave. It lies near the eastern battlefield ruins on Lempo Isle.

introduced.name: Warning bell
introduced.how: Sigurd's warning bell, whose sound frightens even mindless beasts
introduced.quote: Sukhovykh: It's said that even mindless beasts flinch when they hear his warning bell, chilled to the bone and too terrified to press onward...

introduced.name: Sigurd's relics
introduced.how: relics the stranger dropped that belong to Sigurd and must be returned to his grave
introduced.quote: Paimon: Eh? What's this? Did it belong to that strange guy?

assumed.name: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
assumed.quote: (If this is the wild hunt area to the west of Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop)

assumed.name: Starsand Shoal
assumed.quote: (If this is the wild hunt area to the south of Starsand Shoal)

assumed.name: Flins
assumed.quote: (Interact with any of the completed Tideseal Stones as Flins or Illuga)

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: (Interact with any of the completed Tideseal Stones as Flins or Illuga)

assumed.name: Secrets of the Tideseal Stones
assumed.quote: (Leads to Secrets of the Tideseal Stones)

threads.claim: A strange armored stranger fights the Wild Hunt without clearly being on any side.
threads.quote: Paimon: He looks a little strange... But at least he's not siding with the Wild Hunt...

threads.claim: The stranger keeps reappearing in Wild Hunt areas, and where he comes from is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: It's him again! Where'd he come from this time...?

threads.claim: The stranger may once have been a Lightkeeper, a hint toward who he is.
threads.quote: Paimon: That guy just now... He was dressed like a Lightkeeper, wasn't he? Maybe he, uh, used to be one...?

threads.claim: The stranger is revealed to be Sigurd, the fallen Starshyna, who is defeated in a fight.
threads.quote: Sigurd: So it was me... but now... it's finally... over...

threads.claim: Darkness lingers over areas where the Wild Hunt's monsters were dispersed, and it needs expert help to fully remove.
threads.quote: Strange Rift: (Though the monsters have dispersed, the darkness has not faded. You may need to enlist the help of a professional who knows more about the Wild Hunt.)

threads.claim: A mysterious voice asks whether the Traveler pursues the Wild Hunt or hunts alongside them.
threads.quote: ???: ...Do you pursue the Wild Hunt, or do you hunt with them...?

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt is said to permeate something, hinting at its pervasive influence.
threads.quote: ???: ...The Wild Hunt... permeates...

threads.claim: Sigurd cannot rest in peace and seems bound to continue fighting the Wild Hunt.
threads.quote: Lushne: ...Could it have been Sigurd? He hasn't been able to rest in peace, even until now, it seems. If only I could...

threads.claim: Defeating Sigurd ends his long fight, suggesting his spirit finally finds rest.
threads.quote: Sigurd: So it was me... but now... it's finally... over...

threads.claim: The Tideseal Stones hold secrets that the Traveler can explore further.
threads.quote: (Leads to Secrets of the Tideseal Stones)

introduced.name: Anemoculus
introduced.how: consolidated wind that can be fitted into a statue's eyes and offered to the statues
introduced.quote: In Mondstadt, people refer to the consolidated wind as Anemoculi.

introduced.name: Statue of The Seven
introduced.how: Anemo statues where offerings are made to see if the gods respond
introduced.quote: It's a Statue of The Seven!

introduced.name: Visions
introduced.how: powers some people have, which let them collect Anemoculi for offerings
introduced.quote: People with Visions collect them to offer to the statues in exchange for blessings.

introduced.name: Blessings of The Seven
introduced.how: rewards the gods grant in return for offerings at the statues
introduced.quote: Can you feel the blessings of The Seven?

introduced.name: Swallow gem fairy tale
introduced.how: a folk tale that the statues' eyes once held gems that swallows took
introduced.quote: Some fairy tales say the statues' eyes originally had gems that were taken by swallows.

assumed.name: Windrise
assumed.quote: let's head back to the Statue of The Seven at Windrise and offer it to the gods!

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: In Mondstadt, people refer to the consolidated wind as Anemoculi.

assumed.name: The Seven
assumed.quote: let's head back to the Statue of The Seven at Windrise and offer it to the gods!

threads.claim: Folk tales claim the statues' eyes once held gems that swallows stole, which hints at an unexplained history of the statues.
threads.quote: Some fairy tales say the statues' eyes originally had gems that were taken by swallows.

threads.claim: Anemoculi never had a physical form from the start, which raises the question of what they originally were.
threads.quote: But Anemoculi never had a physical form from the start.

threads.claim: The Traveler lacks a Vision and is hinted to be outside the usual rules of this world, an open question about their nature.
threads.quote: Unlike others with powers, you don't have a Vision. But then the rules of this world don't apply to you anyways so...

threads.claim: Offering Anemoculi at the statues may bring more blessings from The Seven, so offerings have a repeatable reward.
threads.quote: Keep offering Anemoculi, and maybe you'll receive more blessings!

introduced.name: Gesine
introduced.how: introduces herself as an Adventurer who is new to long journeys
introduced.quote: Gesine: I am called Gesine. As you can see, I am an Adventurer.

introduced.name: Liyue
introduced.how: a land known for its martial arts, which Gesine plans to visit
introduced.quote: Gesine: Have you heard of the martial arts of Liyue?

introduced.name: Mitachurl
introduced.how: wild axe-wielding monsters that can knock an adventurer out
introduced.quote: Gesine: Yes... When he first became an Adventurer, he ran into some Mitachurls out in the wild.

introduced.name: Gesine's teacher
introduced.how: an experienced Adventurer who trained for a decade after being knocked out by Mitachurls
introduced.quote: Gesine: He was so ashamed, he decided to train his combat skills to the absolute max before he went out again.

introduced.name: Gesine's teacher is knocked out by Mitachurls
introduced.how: a past defeat in which an Adventurer let his guard down and was saved by a passing Knight
introduced.quote: Gesine: He was lucky a passing Knight saved him and took him back.

introduced.name: Dandelion Seed
introduced.how: by local custom, dandelions can carry wishes
introduced.quote: Gesine: According to our customs, Dandelions can carry wishes.

introduced.name: Wangshu Inn
introduced.how: a famous restaurant on a giant rock, known for superb food
introduced.quote: Gesine: I heard from a Liyue merchant who does business in Mondstadt that the food there is simply superb!

introduced.name: Liyue cuisine
introduced.how: cooking that focuses holistically on appearance, smell, and taste
introduced.quote: Gesine: I've heard that Liyue cuisine has a holistic focus on appearance, smell, and taste!

assumed.name: Rite of Descension
assumed.quote: (If the player has not started Rite of Descension)

assumed.name: Stone Gate
assumed.quote: (Approach the marked location near Stone Gate)

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: Paimon: Not really! We're just traveling across all the nations of Teyvat for... reasons.

assumed.name: Anemo Archon
assumed.quote: Traveler: I am certain the Anemo Archon has heard your wish.

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Gesine: But to be perfectly honest, though I've been a member of the Adventurers' Guild for quite some time now, this is my first time going on a long trip.

threads.claim: The Traveler is on a secret mission and refuses to reveal their identity.
threads.quote: Traveler: I would prefer not to reveal my identity...

threads.claim: Dandelions carry wishes, and the Anemo Archon may have heard them.
threads.quote: Traveler: I am certain the Anemo Archon has heard your wish.

threads.claim: Gesine struggles to act in real fights despite training, and her teacher wants her to train longer.
threads.quote: Gesine: Do I really have to train for another three to five years like my teacher said? But it'll be totally humiliating if I go back empty-handed like this... *sobs*

threads.claim: Gesine secretly left her teacher, who will be upset when he learns of it.
threads.quote: Gesine: So I went out alone, without telling him...

threads.claim: Liyue's martial arts include feats such as running up walls and splitting iron, which Gesine hopes to learn.
threads.quote: Gesine: If I could find a master to teach me a thing or two, I bet this whole adventuring thing would be a lot easier for me.

threads.claim: The Traveler advises Gesine to return only once she is stronger and can make her teacher proud.
threads.quote: Traveler: Go back once you're stronger.

introduced.name: Sumac
introduced.how: a warrior who bought a potion and wants a sparring match to test it
introduced.quote: Sumac: Oh yeah, speaking of which, would you two have time for a friendly sparring match? I'd like to test the potion I just made.

introduced.name: Hawkwings
introduced.how: a faction that used to run the Stadium's facilities and has lost its tournament honor to the Locusts
introduced.quote: Hampeq: In the past, the Hawkwings — the faction I belong to — has always been in charge of the Stadium's various facilities.

introduced.name: Locusts
introduced.how: the faction that replaced the Hawkwings in running the Stadium's facilities and is accused of profiteering
introduced.quote: Hampeq: We were, unfortunately, beaten, and have temporarily lost that honor. Our successors were the Locusts. They run the show quite differently...

introduced.name: Speaker's Chamber
introduced.how: the body that rules on disputes and holds tournaments at the Stadium
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Eventually, after taking the opinions of various parties into account, the Speaker's Chamber ruled that we should regularly hold a tournament

introduced.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
introduced.how: the Stadium where the Crafting Bench was first encountered and where the factions compete
introduced.quote: Paimon: Ugh, Paimon's getting lost already. We first met Sumac at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, didn't we? So that Bench must've been the one there, right?

introduced.name: Soncoyoc
introduced.how: a merchant who only comes out after sunset and sold Sumac the potion
introduced.quote: Sumac: No, I bought it from a merchant named Soncoyoc. He only comes out after sunset, and it just happened to be night when I ran into him! How lucky!

introduced.name: Tozan
introduced.how: a Locust who secretly gives the Hawkwings intel against his own faction
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Well, this friend is... special. Sorry for the wait, Tozan. About that thing we agreed on earlier...

introduced.name: Tenehua
introduced.how: the judge sent by the Speaker's Chamber to hear the dispute
introduced.quote: Sumac: Ah, look, we should be starting soon. See that person in the middle? That's Mr. Tenehua, the judge sent by the Speaker's Chamber.

introduced.name: Ogun
introduced.how: an archconservative Hawkwing who sets a training challenge before giving testimony
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Sorry, can't help you there. We Hawkwings have traditionally prized strength above all else, and Ogun's an archconservative even by our conservative standards...

introduced.name: Pampa
introduced.how: a Hawkwing who gives testimony after a challenge of his own
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Let's go find Pampa next. It's not far from here.

introduced.name: Anela
introduced.how: a former Hawkwing who refuses to testify unless the travelers pass her test
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Then it's time we went to find Anela. She should be with the People of the Springs at this time.

introduced.name: People of the Springs
introduced.how: a group where Anela can be found, with its own turf and hot springs
introduced.quote: Hampeq: Then it's time we went to find Anela. She should be with the People of the Springs at this time.

introduced.name: Itzcuin
introduced.how: a Locust spokesperson who denies the accusations and argues for a frame-up
introduced.quote: Itzcuin: Just one minute there, bro, I'm going to ask you to slow your roll.

introduced.name: Tlalepa
introduced.how: Tozan's twin, who has been hiding with him in a secret spot near the Stadium
introduced.quote: Tozan: Tlalepa! Tlalepa! Bad news!

introduced.name: Loach Pearl
introduced.how: a material the Locusts bought in bulk, similar to substances found in the victims' potions
introduced.quote: Hampeq: See the Loach Pearls on this invoice? The timing of the Locusts' mass purchase of them coincides exactly with that of the Hawkwings' mishaps.

introduced.name: Hawkwing test of worthiness
introduced.how: the custom in which Hawkwing members must pass a training challenge before they will talk
introduced.quote: Ogun: Pass my training. Prove yourself worthy of my trust. Ask again after that, and you'll get your answers.

assumed.name: Crafting Bench incident
assumed.quote: Hampeq: Hey, Ogun, it's been a while. You still remember the Crafting Bench incident? Just wanted to hear what you have to say about that...

assumed.name: Stadium
assumed.quote: Sumac: I know a nice clearing near the Stadium. We only need to test out the potion, so it shouldn't take too much of your time. What do you say?

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Sumac: Hey, chin up, Mr. Hampeq! We warriors of Natlan don't call throw in the towel that easily.

threads.claim: The Crafting Bench sneezes and chants like a living thing, hinting that something is wrong with it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Uh, is Paimon hearing things, or did that Crafting Bench just sneeze?

threads.claim: Hampeq suspects the Locusts have tampered with the Crafting Bench, which may be the source of the accidents.
threads.quote: Hampeq: I've been thinking that they've done... something... to the Crafting Bench.

threads.claim: The travelers suspect there were two Crafting Benches at the Stadium, one real and one fake.
threads.quote: Traveler: There were likely two Crafting Benches at the Stadium then.

threads.claim: The Hawkwings and Locusts are rivals who lost and gained glory from each other, which motivates the conflict.
threads.quote: Hampeq: Of course. They're our rivals, the ones who stole our glory from us...

threads.claim: The merchant Soncoyoc sold Sumac a potion under suspicious circumstances, raising doubts about its source.
threads.quote: Sumac: No, I bought it from a merchant named Soncoyoc. He only comes out after sunset, and it just happened to be night when I ran into him! How lucky!

threads.claim: Tozan secretly helps the Hawkwings against the Locusts, raising the question of where his loyalties lie.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wait, so you're helping the Hawkwings on the sly, then? W—Wouldn't that make you a traitor?

threads.claim: Tozan may have anticipated the investigation and deliberately lured Hampeq into a trap to destroy the Hawkwings' credibility.
threads.quote: Traveler: Rather, Tozan saw all this coming, and struck first.

threads.claim: Tozan looks familiar to the traveler, hinting that he may be someone else or have a double.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Huh, he looks familiar...)

threads.claim: Tozan has a twin brother, Tlalepa, and the two have been switching places to deceive the Stadium.
threads.quote: Traveler: (Twins. As I thought.)

threads.claim: The Speaker's Chamber judge cannot reach a final verdict and postpones judgment because the evidence is too complicated.
threads.quote: Tenehua: Nothing to say, then? *sigh* This has proved more complicated than I anticipated. I'm afraid my judgment will have to wait for another day.

introduced.name: Qi Ding
introduced.how: a miner who keeps bragging about his daughter goes missing from the Chasm camp
introduced.quote: Qi Ding — the guy who never misses a chance to brag about his daughter — was absent last night.

introduced.name: Qi Nan
introduced.how: a girl who says she is Qi Ding's daughter and is found alone in the Chasm
introduced.quote: Me? My name is Qi Nan. I—I'm Qi Ding's daughter.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a dangerous, complex mine environment where headcounts are taken every morning and evening
introduced.quote: The Chasm has a complex environment. Though things have stabilized a bit lately, it's still dangerous deep inside.

introduced.name: Wish Granter
introduced.how: a floating rock in the mine said to grant any wish, and whose presence drove miners insane
introduced.quote: Before the mine was sealed, a few miners who went down into the mine came back saying that they found a Wish Granter that grants whatever wish you might have.

introduced.name: The Chasm's Bounty
introduced.how: a rumored wish-granting thing in the Chasm that miners secretly sought and then went missing
introduced.quote: Yet some miners tried their luck — They went looking for "The Chasm's Bounty" in secret and ended up going missing one by one.

introduced.name: Huishan Hall
introduced.how: the place miners are told to report anything unusual in the Chasm to
introduced.quote: We had warned them to report to Huishan Hall should they encounter anything unusual.

introduced.name: Feiyun Commerce Guild
introduced.how: a merchant guild that sells the expensive doll Qi Ding wanted
introduced.quote: So I asked my friend to buy one from the Feiyun Commerce Guild and send it to the mine.

introduced.name: Toy Doll
introduced.how: a palm-sized, expensive doll bought as a gift for Qi Ding's daughter that Qi Ding lost in the mine
introduced.quote: I—I'm looking for a toy, a doll of the size of my palm...

introduced.name: Qixing
introduced.how: the authority that decided to seal the Chasm after miners went insane
introduced.quote: After the incident, the Qixing decided to seal The Chasm.

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: the government body that Qi Ding's daughter works for as an intern
introduced.quote: his daughter is now an intern at the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

introduced.name: Jinwu
introduced.how: a camp worker who takes charge of bringing Qi Ding back up to the surface camp
introduced.quote: Jinwu: Qi Ding, is that you? Where have you been?

introduced.name: Muning
introduced.how: a camp official who runs the headcounts and is worried about losing his job over missing miners
introduced.quote: Muning: If the higher-ups find out... I'd be toast.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: But since you're the hero who saved Liyue, I think I can make an exception for you.

assumed.name: Zhiqiong
assumed.quote: Traveler: It's the huge crystal that Zhiqiong and we came across.

assumed.name: Abyss creatures
assumed.quote: (Defeat the Abyss creatures near to the box)

threads.claim: A floating rock called the Wish Granter supposedly grants any wish but drives those near it insane.
threads.quote: Before the mine was sealed, a few miners who went down into the mine came back saying that they found a Wish Granter that grants whatever wish you might have.

threads.claim: Qi Ding feels a growing headache near the rock and may have hallucinated what he saw there.
threads.quote: I even saw — no, I think it was just a hallucination.

threads.claim: Muning dismisses the Wish Granter as nonsense and blames the mine's atmosphere instead.
threads.quote: Muning: Are you saying that a "Wish Granter" caused all this? That's nonsense!

threads.claim: Miners who secretly searched for The Chasm's Bounty went missing and came back deeply disturbed.
threads.quote: Yet some miners tried their luck — They went looking for "The Chasm's Bounty" in secret and ended up going missing one by one.

threads.claim: The Qixing sealed the Chasm after miners who went missing returned insane, and the sealing has been reopened.
threads.quote: When we found them some while later, they'd all gone pretty insane.

threads.claim: The girl claiming to be Qi Nan vanished without a sound, raising doubt about who she really is.
threads.quote: Paimon: Qi Nan, huh, where is she? She just vanished suddenly.

threads.claim: Muning insists Qi Nan is grown up and works at the Ministry, so the girl the player met cannot be her.
threads.quote: Muning: Qi Ding's daughter, Qi Nan? A little girl? What are you talking about?

threads.claim: Something other than Qi Ding may have gone home with him, leaving the true nature of the daughter unresolved.
threads.quote: Paimon: ...Then what followed Qi Ding home?

introduced.name: Ratniki
introduced.how: the people on the island whose rations the chef is cooking for
introduced.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: We're making rations for the Ratniki on the island, so we've gotta cook it to their tastes.

introduced.name: Food-Obsessed Phantom
introduced.how: a ghostly chef who introduces themself as a cook doing their job well
introduced.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: I'm just a chef. I just do my job, and I want to do it well.

introduced.name: peculiar cooking pot
introduced.how: a cooking pot that moves on its own and is used to cook dishes
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uhh... Is Paimon seeing things, or is that cooking pot over there... moving?

introduced.name: Berries and Fried Meat
introduced.how: a dish of fried meat that must be balanced with berries and vegetable side dishes
introduced.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: But let me remind you. When making fried meat, you must consider your side dishes.

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: And to that end, I made all kinds of preparations for the Wild Hunt's arrival.

threads.claim: The peculiar cooking pot moves on its own, hinting at something uncanny about it.
threads.quote: Paimon: Uhh... Is Paimon seeing things, or is that cooking pot over there... moving?

threads.claim: The cook is a phantom, hinting that the chef and the kitchen are supernatural.
threads.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: Hey, newbie. You can't be making food like that.

threads.claim: The chef is preparing rations for the Ratniki who live on the island.
threads.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: We're making rations for the Ratniki on the island, so we've gotta cook it to their tastes.

threads.claim: The Wild Hunt was expected to receive the chef's finished dishes, but the food was spilled before it could be sent.
threads.quote: Food-Obsessed Phantom: But it's a pity... I couldn't send them the finished dishes in time... The food wound up spilled... spilled...

introduced.name: Yan'er
introduced.how: village researcher hunting legends of the Chi's corpse
introduced.quote: I believe that the Chi's corpse may still be on this mountain.

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: the village where the Chi legend is centered
introduced.quote: You know the name of this place, right? Qingce Village?

introduced.name: Chi
introduced.how: legendary dragon-like monster that once occupied Qingce and was defeated by Rex Lapis
introduced.quote: According to legend, the Chi was a dragon-like monster that once forcibly occupied this place.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: the Geo god who defeated the Chi; also called Morax
introduced.quote: When Rex Lapis — or, Morax —defeated it

introduced.name: Blood-Fed Trees
introduced.how: unusually large trees locals believe grew from the Chi's blood
introduced.quote: The locals call these Blood-Fed Trees.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: village elder who knows the old legends and reads the fragments
introduced.quote: A fragment of...? Found something curious, have you? Let me see...

introduced.name: Little Liu
introduced.how: Qingce villager who doesn't know the fragment and sends you to Granny Ruoxin
introduced.quote: Go ask Granny Ruoxin, she knows everything.

introduced.name: Little Xing
introduced.how: Qingce villager who knows nothing of fragments
introduced.quote: Fragments? Mm... I don't know.

introduced.name: Little You
introduced.how: Qingce villager who has never seen a fragment
introduced.quote: Lemme see... Wow. I have no idea. I've never seen one of these before.

introduced.name: Little Zuo
introduced.how: Qingce villager who cannot read the fragment
introduced.quote: As a matter of fact, I've never seen one in my life.

introduced.name: Master Lu
introduced.how: Qingce villager who suggests asking the village chief
introduced.quote: Fragment? What fragment, is it from some toy that was broken?

introduced.name: Pops Kai
introduced.how: Qingce villager who cannot read the fragment
introduced.quote: A fragment, you say? Show me.

introduced.name: Zhi
introduced.how: Qingce villager who cannot read the fragment
introduced.quote: A fragment? Hmm... No, I can't read it.

introduced.name: Geo Statues
introduced.how: stone statues used to press down and slowly crush the Chi
introduced.quote: so Geo Statues were used to press it down, slowly crushing it to death over time.

introduced.name: Fragments
introduced.how: ancient pictorial records of past events, not writing, that show the Chi's battle
introduced.quote: Long, long ago, before writing was invented, people recorded events with pictures.

introduced.name: Mt. Qingce
introduced.how: mountain that was once the Chi's lair
introduced.quote: Mt. Qingce was once its lair.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: crooks who skulk about wherever treasure is
introduced.quote: Those low-down, no-good crooks, always skulking about.

introduced.name: Hidden Gate of Qingce
introduced.how: sealed stone gate with three grooves that leads to a cavern
introduced.quote: The stone gates are tightly shut, and there are three strange grooves on its surface.

assumed.name: Geo Lord
assumed.quote: ...Ah, Geo Lord, protect us...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Why are all Liyue's stories written like this?

assumed.name: Ruin Hunter
assumed.quote: Yikes! It's a Ruin Hunter!

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: We seem to run into these guys every single time there's treasure involved...

threads.claim: Yan'er suspects the Chi's corpse may still lie beneath Mt. Qingce.
threads.quote: I believe that the Chi's corpse may still be on this mountain.

threads.claim: Granny Ruoxin says only Rex Lapis knows whether the Chi's corpse still exists.
threads.quote: I'm afraid that other than Rex Lapis, no one else knows the answer to that question.

threads.claim: The sealed vault turns out empty, so whether the corpse exists remains unresolved.
threads.quote: So there was nothing inside... That's good, that's good...

threads.claim: Some say the Chi could not be fully destroyed and was instead pressed down by Geo Statues.
threads.quote: But some people say that even the Geo Lord himself couldn't wipe out the Chi completely

threads.claim: The incomplete writing hints that the Chi's flesh survived its defeat.
threads.quote: still did its flesh survive...

threads.claim: Locals believe the giant trees grew from the Chi's blood and mark its eyes.
threads.quote: They believe that these trees grew by absorbing the Chi's blood, and that the area where they grew are the Chi's eyes.

threads.claim: Granny Ruoxin confirms the trees are said to have been nourished by the Chi's blood.
threads.quote: Those are Blood-Fed Trees, said to have been nourished by the blood of the Chi.

threads.claim: The fragments are unreadable to villagers, leaving their meaning an open question.
threads.quote: Paimon can't tell if it's supposed to be a drawing, or writing, or... some other kind of thing.

threads.claim: Granny Ruoxin says the fragments fit together and depict a battle with the Chi.
threads.quote: Why, these fragments all fit together.

threads.quote: Is this... That place in the fragment? The one where the Chi's corpse is?

threads.claim: Yan'er doubts the legend, calling it just a legend that may be forgotten.
threads.quote: This might be the clue to some treasure, but it's just a legend in the end.

threads.claim: Granny Ruoxin asks whether a legend can still have traces of the Chi today.
threads.quote: But a legend is a legend. After all, who would be able to find traces of the Chi today?

threads.claim: Incomplete writing says Rex Lapis bound each part of the Chi at a separate place.
threads.quote: Thus did Rex Lapis conquer each of its facets in turn: its spirit was bound in the , its bones were pinned in the

threads.claim: The Chi's corpse was supposedly sealed with water and pinned under treasure in a vault.
threads.quote: in order to seal the corpse of the Chi and prevent it from endangering the world again, water was used to seal its corpse

threads.claim: Opening the hidden gate reveals a huge cavern, confirming the vault described in the fragments exists.
threads.quote: The gate opens, revealing a huge cavern

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders keep showing up wherever treasure is, suggesting a recurring rival group.
threads.quote: Ugh. We seem to run into these guys every single time there's treasure involved...

introduced.quote: I am a traveling merchant from Fontaine, and all my goods are the latest and the greatest.

introduced.name: Sumeru
introduced.how: a faraway land where Le Goff has now traveled, far from home
introduced.quote: I'm all the way here in Sumeru now, you know?

introduced.how: a cargo transport balloon that can survive or be destroyed by hilichurls
introduced.quote: (If the Transport Balloon survived)

introduced.name: Hilichurl theft of Fontaine apparel

introduced.quote: Previously, they even hid at the mouth of the main road, successfully stealing a batch of the latest apparel from Fontaine...

assumed.name: Hilichurls

assumed.name: Repeated hilichurl ambushes of Le Goff

assumed.name: Mushroom caravan

threads.claim: Le Goff cannot understand why the hilichurls keep chasing him specifically.
threads.quote: To be honest, I cannot understand why these fellows keep chasing me as well... But thanks to you, I was able to protect my cargo this time.

threads.claim: Le Goff wonders whether the hilichurls have a personal grudge against him.
threads.quote: Do these churls just have it in for me or something? I mean, I'm all the way here in Sumeru now, you know?

introduced.how: jade that can store adeptal energy to ensure favorable weather and prosperous years
introduced.quote: Though balance has been restored to the water and soil, if we can add more power to the Rainjade, we can ensure favorable weather and prosperous years to come.

introduced.quote: But before, I could turn back into human form whenever I wanted, so I thought moving around as a Carp was just a matter of convenience.

assumed.name: Fujin
assumed.quote: How's Fujin coming along in her recovery?

assumed.name: Lingyuan
assumed.quote: and Paimon. You're here.

assumed.name: Herblord
assumed.quote: This is the first time anyone has come here since Herblord left.

assumed.name: Golden Carp in Yaodie Valley
assumed.quote: just like when we were finding the Golden Carp in Yaodie Valley

assumed.name: Fujin dragging the party to Carp's Rest earlier

threads.claim: Fujin is weakened and recovering, and her condition is a worry for the party.

threads.quote: it was just dispersed around the mountains, forests, and rivers of Chenyu Vale

threads.quote: if we can add more power to the Rainjade, we can ensure favorable weather and prosperous years to come.

threads.claim: Fujin has lost her ability to return to human form and remains in Carp form for now.
threads.quote: Because I can't return to the form I prefer yet

threads.claim: Herblord left this place earlier, and nobody had visited Fujin since.
threads.quote: This is the first time anyone has come here since Herblord left.

threads.claim: Lingyuan describes herself as a forgetful, slow-witted beast who is strongly affected by Fujin.
threads.quote: It is because I am a slow-witted beast. Seeing her, I think of many things, and forget many things.

introduced.name: Madarame Hyakubei
introduced.how: introduces himself as a retainer of the Kamisato Clan who organizes the commission system
introduced.quote: I am Madarame Hyakubei, a retainer of the Kamisato Clan.

introduced.name: Yashiro Commission
introduced.how: oversees worship at the shrine and hears people's earnest ambitions
introduced.quote: Since the Yashiro Commission oversees worship at the shrine, we often have the occasion to hear about people's earnest ambitions.

introduced.name: Kamisato Ayato
introduced.how: the Yashiro Commissioner who has heard of the Traveler and approved the commission system
introduced.quote: Even the Yashiro Commissioner Kamisato Ayato himself has mentioned you before.

introduced.name: commission system
introduced.how: a public system, set up by the Yashiro Commissioner, for helping people realize their ambitions
introduced.quote: he decided to establish a public commission system as the means of achieving this.

introduced.name: commissions
introduced.how: paid requests for help that are too numerous for the available people to handle
introduced.quote: The remuneration is more than ample, but the problem is that there are too many commissions and not enough people to handle them...

introduced.name: reputation system
introduced.how: reputation gates how complex the commissions a player can access become, reflecting local trust
introduced.quote: as your reputation builds up, the commissions you have access to will grow in complexity.

assumed.name: Miss Kamisato
assumed.quote: I trust you are the Traveler of whom Miss Kamisato has previously spoken?

assumed.name: Reputation menu
assumed.quote: (Opens the Reputation menu)

threads.claim: Reputation in Inazuma measures how much local people trust the Traveler, and higher trust unlocks more complex commissions.
threads.quote: Consider it a gauge of the level of trust that people here place in you.

threads.claim: Kamisato Ayato and the Kamisato side regard the Traveler as worthy of trust, with Ayato already aware of them.
threads.quote: He, too, believes that you are worthy of our trust.

introduced.name: Iron Dou'er

introduced.quote: Our Boss, the leader of us Iron and Salt Gang.

introduced.quote: Our Boss, the leader of us Iron and Salt Gang.

introduced.name: Johnnie

introduced.quote: Johnnie: Well, pal, you know business as usual is no longer the usual over here.

introduced.name: Walker
introduced.how: Johnnie's underling who calls in hidden thugs to ambush the Iron and Salt Gang
introduced.quote: Walker: Come out, boys, it's time!

introduced.name: Iron Chuan'er
introduced.how: Gang member revealed to be an undercover operative who has been watching the smugglers
introduced.quote: Correct. We've had our eyes on these smugglers for a while now, but only managed to infiltrate them recently with a bit of timely assistance.

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: The undercover sleuths who had infiltrated the smugglers and are revealed when they break cover
introduced.quote: I thought you were just newbies, I never imagined you were a bunch of cursed sleuths...

introduced.name: bootleg
introduced.how: Means an illegal transaction, as Traveler explains to Paimon
introduced.quote: Traveler: Some sort of illegal transaction.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: Iron Dou'er: Of course. I have relatives in Liyue Harbor, and I've heard all about you, so I recognized you from the get-go.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: Iron Dou'er: Not to mention the fact that those Fontaine fellows almost wiped us out with their dirty tricks.

threads.claim: Fontainian criminal groups are operating smuggling and dirty tricks inside Liyue.

threads.quote: Iron Ming: I thought you were just newbies, I never imagined you were a bunch of cursed sleuths...

threads.claim: The Traveler is famous enough that strangers recognize them on sight.
threads.quote: Iron Chuan'er: This trip was really worth it! Not only did we get who we came for, but we also got to meet the famous Traveler.

introduced.name: Peripatetic Circle
introduced.how: group that takes in people with hidden pasts without asking about their backgrounds
introduced.quote: The Peripatetic Circle's known for not asking its members their backgrounds.

introduced.quote: he accidentally killed a fellow caravan member called Juhani.

introduced.quote: The caravan's goods were stolen.

introduced.quote: There was an accident, and the ship sank — went down with most of the crew.

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: If I'm remembering it correctly, it was never solved.

assumed.name: Jahoda
assumed.quote: Jahoda: Kurierka, Hiram, how's life been treating you?

assumed.name: Hiram
assumed.quote: Kurierka, Hiram, how's life been treating you?

assumed.name: Kurierka
assumed.quote: Kurierka: Ugh... Ignore him. Thanks to you, life's the same as always.

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: But Boss Nef, this sort of thing happens in Nod-Krai all the time.

assumed.name: Curatorium

threads.claim: Who really stole the caravan's goods and whether Hark is guilty remains an open question.

threads.claim: Hark's reason for returning to crime after a decade of a fresh start is unexplained, and his killing of Juhani may have been intended.
threads.quote: Or maybe he just sensed the time was right and he wanted to get rid of Juhani.

threads.claim: Hark may have falsely accused Juhani of the theft to deflect suspicion from himself.
threads.quote: He said he's seen him pilfering the goods with his own eyes, bit by bit.

threads.claim: Hark's boasts of a big trade deal and bonuses may have been a lie that exposed where his money came from.
threads.quote: But according to people in the Circle, none of that had anything to do with him.

threads.claim: Hiram hints that the Circle's bonds are fragile and that Hark's rot was there long before the crime.
threads.quote: Rusty metal doesn't stick together out of kindness or concern, but out of fear.

threads.claim: The Peripatetic Circle offers fresh starts to members with dark secrets, raising questions about what those secrets are.
threads.quote: They're willing to give fresh starts to those with dark and unspoken secrets.

threads.claim: The northern part of Lempo Isle is an isolated, dangerous area that messengers avoid and where Hark has gone.
threads.quote: No other messengers dare take that isolated path through the Passage.

threads.claim: Nefer suggests that clues to the truth often hide in small overlooked details.
threads.quote: You should know, clues often hide in the smallest of details.

threads.claim: Jirou's past crime that led to his army service and desertion is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Saimon Katsumi: After all, you only had to join the army because of that little crime you committed...

threads.claim: Jirou claims his earlier captures were deliberate bait, though the Traveler denies the party was looking for him.

assumed.name: Albedo

assumed.name: Sucrose

introduced.name: Oceanid Ann

assumed.name: Caterpillar

threads.quote: First, what we see is just a "clock," not the apocalypse itself.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's memories of a time before its birth hint that the secrets of its own origin may be uncovered.
threads.quote: Perhaps I might find the secrets to my own birth after all.

threads.claim: Mary-Ann Guillotin is revealed as Seymour's designer, tying the missing Mary-Ann to Seymour's creation.
threads.quote: Correct. My designer. Guillotin.

threads.claim: Ann senses a half-remembered connection to Elynas that she cannot grasp.
threads.quote: It's like water boiling off into gas. I can't see it, and I can't quite grasp it, either.

threads.claim: Caterpillar agrees to work with the party, Seymour, and Ann to uncover something new from their shared experiences.
threads.quote: Then, let us work together.

introduced.name: Kasim
introduced.how: self-introduced as a self-styled legendary bandit who is really an Eremite working with the Fatui
introduced.quote: Kasim: Oh? It's you. Seems like you've beaten Oleg... But you know what? I'm Kasim, the legendary bandit!

introduced.name: Oleg
introduced.how: a Fatui researcher running experiments with the Saghira Machines at the camps
introduced.quote: Paimon: Shhh, , look over there! An Eremite member and... a Fatuus!

introduced.name: Trofin Snezhevich
introduced.how: an agent sent by the Lord Harbinger to Sumeru, who has made no progress and uses another name
introduced.quote: Oleg: Haha, of course you haven't. Surely he wouldn't use this name to reveal himself... The Lord Harbinger sent him here, but he's made no progress all these years.

introduced.name: Abattouy
introduced.how: a researcher who sold Kasim the machines
introduced.quote: Kasim: ...Alright, I'll tell you the truth. I actually bought the machines from a researcher named Abattouy.

introduced.name: Rukh Shah
introduced.how: an official who thanks the Traveler and explains the Corps of Thirty will take custody of the machines
introduced.quote: Rukh Shah: Were it not for you, we'd never have known what suspicious things the camp has been used for... We will take away these Fatui.

introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.how: a group of Sumeru locals from different places and walks of life, which Kasim belongs to
introduced.quote: Kasim: We are the Eremites, after all. We're from different places and all walks of life, haha!

introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.how: an outside group working in Sumeru that hires Eremites for its operations
introduced.quote: Paimon: So they need to recapture these four camps! Interesting that the Fatui would seek help from the Eremites...

introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.how: the official body that will take custody of the seized machines and deal with the Fatui and Kasim
introduced.quote: Rukh Shah: Yes, the Corps of Thirty will take custody of these machines, and similar incidents should be prevented in the future...

introduced.name: Saghira Machine
introduced.how: machines the Fatui use at camps, falsely presented as energy extractors for Withering Zones
introduced.quote: Kasim: Ah, so you're asking about the Saghira Machines. The Fatui somehow wanted something for energy extraction from Withering Zones, so I provided some...

introduced.name: Emergency Adjustment Plan
introduced.how: a Fatui document laying out the patrol and recapture plan for the camps
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait, the thing he left behind is... an "Emergency Adjustment Plan"?

introduced.name: Apam Woods
introduced.how: the woods where the Fatui signal system and secret stronghold entrance are located
introduced.quote: Kasim: Near the tents in the Apam Woods, there are four torches. Light them at night...

introduced.name: Fatui operation stronghold
introduced.how: a hidden Fatui base reached by signal lights and a watchword, from which the operation is run
introduced.quote: Paimon: Uh... And it goes "...set out from the action stronghold and execute the above plan." So they even have an operation stronghold...

introduced.name: Withering Zones
introduced.how: areas whose energy the Fatui want to extract, which the machines are supposedly for
introduced.quote: Oleg: Those are the machines for energy extraction from Withering Zones!

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Kasim: Trofin Snezhevich... I've never heard that name in Sumeru...

assumed.name: Lord Harbingers
assumed.quote: Oleg: Hahaha, great! With your help, we will be able to complete the order of our Lord Harbingers in no time.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Oleg: I bet you are one of those who'd do anything for Mora, right?

assumed.name: Chasing Shadows
assumed.quote: (The Traveler shows up wearing the Fatui mask they received from Diluc in Chasing Shadows)

assumed.name: Sheriff
assumed.quote: Paimon: Um... Maybe we should send this guy to the Sheriff...

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: offering to share a huge payout for extracting energy from the Ley Lines...

threads.claim: A Lord Harbinger's agent named Trofin Snezhevich has been in Sumeru for years under another name without results.
threads.quote: Oleg: Haha, of course you haven't. Surely he wouldn't use this name to reveal himself... The Lord Harbinger sent him here, but he's made no progress all these years.

threads.claim: The Saghira Machines' true purpose is unclear, since Kasim claims they extract energy from Withering Zones.
threads.quote: Kasim: Ah, so you're asking about the Saghira Machines. The Fatui somehow wanted something for energy extraction from Withering Zones, so I provided some...

threads.claim: Kasim's machines were fakes that extract nothing from the Withering Zones.
threads.quote: Paimon: Nah, that's not gonna happen. The machine named San-something from Kasim won't extract anything from the Withering Zones...

threads.claim: Operating the machines polluted the environment even though they did not affect the Withering Zones.
threads.quote: Rukh Shah: According to researchers' investigation, even though no influence was exerted on the Withering Zones, the mere operation of the machines has somehow polluted the environment.

threads.claim: The Fatui have a hidden operation stronghold whose location is still unknown.
threads.quote: Paimon: Uh... And it goes "...set out from the action stronghold and execute the above plan." So they even have an operation stronghold...

threads.claim: The Traveler gets into the Fatui stronghold by giving the watchword at its gate.
threads.quote: Oleg: Eh? No way... Ahem, watchword, please.

threads.claim: Kasim is exposed as a fraud, and his bounty is raised after the Traveler's report.
threads.quote: Rukh Shah: Besides, the bounty on Kasim has been raised according to your report... That guy has always been a fraud that gives us headaches.

threads.claim: Fatui operations in Sumeru are ordered by the Lord Harbingers.
threads.quote: Oleg: Hahaha, great! With your help, we will be able to complete the order of our Lord Harbingers in no time.

introduced.name: Remaudiere
introduced.how: Boy who told his sister a white lie that he could stop the fountain with magic; he is the story's main narrator
introduced.quote: So, I told a little white lie to Keratry. I told her I knew a magic trick that could make the fountain stop spraying water.

introduced.name: Keratry
introduced.how: Remaudiere's younger sister, who pestered him into taking her out at night and believed his fake magic
introduced.quote: But Keratry wouldn't stop pestering me to take her out. I just couldn't stop her, and ended up taking her outside to play.

introduced.name: Edel
introduced.how: Manager of the plaza fountain who is responsible for repairing it
introduced.quote: I told the fountain's manager, Edel, about this, and he promised me that he would fix it as soon as possible.

introduced.name: Estelle
introduced.how: Craftsman who makes the valves and nozzles and supplies repair parts for the fountain
introduced.quote: I finally had some time to order a new valve and nozzle from Estelle today, and I'm about to go to the city to get it.

introduced.name: Plaza fountain
introduced.how: Public fountain in the plaza that stopped working and is the central object of the story
introduced.quote: Observe the fountain: (The fountain is silent, and seems to have stopped working...)

introduced.name: Iron Chunk
introduced.how: Material Estelle needs, three of them, to make the replacement valve
introduced.quote: Sorry! I'm really sorry! Just three Iron Chunks will be enough.

introduced.name: Sluice gates
introduced.how: Main and secondary gates that must be opened to let water flow back into the fountain
introduced.quote: Alright. Then let's stand back for a moment. The only remaining task should be to open the sluice gate.

introduced.name: Night outing
introduced.how: Remaudiere snuck his sister out at night while their parents were at the opera, which led to the fake magic lie
introduced.quote: My parents were at the opera when it happened, and they told me to stay at home with my sister, and entertain her with games or books...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: If this doesn't get fixed soon, Keratry's going to make sure everyone in Teyvat hears about it...

assumed.name: Erinnyes
assumed.quote: Edel, Traveler, let's head to Erinnyes. As long as I'm there, the fountain should be fixed in no time.

threads.claim: The cause of the nozzle breaking is unexplained and seems strange, raising an open question about the fountain's failure.
threads.quote: But why did the nozzle break? I really don't know... It's so weird.

threads.claim: A deformed valve getting stuck jammed the fountain's water system, which partly explains why it stopped working.
threads.quote: Actually, it was the deformed valve getting stuck that jammed the entire water system.

threads.claim: Estelle failed to make the valve on time because she gave the parts to another client, hinting at unreliability in her work.
threads.quote: But... a previous client had to do urgent repairs on something else...

threads.claim: The Traveler draws a theme from the affair that magic and miracles always come with a cost.
threads.quote: Now you know that magic and miracles all come with a price.

threads.claim: Remaudiere's fake fountain magic remains a secret to be kept from their parents, and he promises Keratry more magic later.
threads.quote: I can show you some new magic once we do...

introduced.name: Esther
introduced.how: Researcher who lost her survey beacons on the mountain and asks the Traveler to retrieve and place them
introduced.quote: Esther: This is terrible... What am I going to do...

introduced.name: survey beacons
introduced.how: Expensive beacons Esther uses to survey mountain conditions; some were left on the mountain
introduced.quote: So, I invested in an expensive set of survey beacons.

introduced.name: explorers
introduced.how: A team of explorers who climbed the mountain with Esther and fled after the monster attack
introduced.quote: Then, I scaled the mountain with a team of explorers.

introduced.name: mountain ambush
introduced.how: Esther's team was suddenly attacked by a large monster group while placing beacons, forcing a retreat
introduced.quote: I was just putting the beacons in place when we were set upon by a huge group of monsters, they came out of nowhere...

introduced.name: the mountain
introduced.how: A mountain Esther wants to study for climate and environment, now dangerous because of monsters
introduced.quote: I wanted to do some research into conditions on the mountain — the climate, the environment, and so on.

assumed.name: monsters
assumed.quote: Those monsters clearly weren't gentle with them.

assumed.name: map
assumed.quote: I'll mark the spots on the map for you.

threads.claim: A sudden monster group on the mountain drove off an explorer team and scared others away from it.
threads.quote: I was just putting the beacons in place when we were set upon by a huge group of monsters, they came out of nowhere...

threads.claim: Esther refuses to go up the mountain alone because the monsters defeated a whole explorer team.
threads.quote: I don't dare... If not even a whole team of explorers could stand up to those monsters, I'm certainly not going back up there alone.

threads.claim: Esther's mountain survey stays incomplete because too few beacons remain to cover the whole mountain.
threads.quote: There's no way this is enough beacons to survey the whole mountain...

introduced.name: Esther
introduced.how: a surveyor measuring a mountain's height with survey beacons, who asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Esther: Ugh, just as I expected... With only a limited number of beacons, the accuracy is nowhere near good enough.

introduced.name: Cyrus
introduced.how: a man in the city who prepares rewards Esther asks for and receives her letters
introduced.quote: Esther: Oh, and regarding compensation — I asked Cyrus to put something together. Ask him for it next time you're in the city.

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: a dangerous mountain where teams rarely go and where Esther's surveying takes place
introduced.quote: Cyrus: *sigh* I don't know what I can do, It's rare to find a team that's willing to take on the mountain these days, it's just too dangerous up there...

introduced.name: survey beacon
introduced.how: a beacon placed at a mountain's summit to measure altitude and reduce measurement error
introduced.quote: Esther: All you need to do is place it at the summit.

introduced.name: second exploration team
introduced.how: a promised second team to explore the mountains, which Esther is still waiting to hear about
introduced.quote: He promised to keep me in the loop about a second exploration team for the mountains, but I still haven't heard back about it.

introduced.name: Letter to Cyrus
introduced.how: a letter from Esther to Cyrus that the Traveler obtains and delivers
introduced.quote: (Obtain Letter to Cyrus ×1)

introduced.name: monsters destroying beacons
introduced.how: Esther's other survey beacons keep being destroyed by monsters on the mountain
introduced.quote: All my other beacons keep getting destroyed by monsters, this is the only way to reduce the margin of error in my measurements.

assumed.name: Esther's earlier survey favor
assumed.quote: Esther: Like you! Please, help me out one more time.

assumed.name: Dragonspine
assumed.quote: Cyrus: Ah, Dragonspine... If ever the chance arose to lead a team of explorers there in person, I would surely take it!

threads.claim: A second exploration team to the mountains has been promised but not yet arranged, and finding a willing team is hard.
threads.quote: He promised to keep me in the loop about a second exploration team for the mountains, but I still haven't heard back about it.

threads.claim: Dragonspine is considered too dangerous for most explorers, and Cyrus urges the Traveler to be careful there.
threads.quote: it's just too dangerous up there...

threads.claim: Much of Dragonspine still needs surveying, and Esther plans to return to the mountain to finish it.
threads.quote: There's a lot of things that still need surveying on that mountain.

threads.claim: Monsters keep destroying survey beacons on the mountain, which threatens the accuracy of Esther's measurements.
threads.quote: All my other beacons keep getting destroyed by monsters, this is the only way to reduce the margin of error in my measurements.

introduced.name: Columbina
introduced.how: a blindfolded woman kept under house arrest at Silvermoon Hall, whom the Scions revere
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait, what!? Isn't that just a bribe so you'll accept house arrest? And a cheap one, at that!

introduced.name: Lauma
introduced.how: a Frostmoon Scion who arranged Columbina's confinement and is planning a surprise for her
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon find Lauma at the Grand Library)

introduced.name: Kuutar
introduced.how: the Moon Goddess whose statue is being renovated, once depicted as wingless
introduced.quote: Paimon: You wanna renovate the statue of Kuutar!?

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: a group devoted to the Moon Goddess that Columbina is warned to avoid
introduced.quote: Columbina: She just told me not to go out for the time being, and to be especially sure to avoid the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Silvermoon Hall
introduced.how: the building where Columbina is kept and where the Traveler and Paimon return
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon return to Silvermoon Hall)

introduced.name: Grand Library
introduced.how: a library where Lauma can be found
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Paimon find Lauma at the Grand Library)

introduced.name: Light-Bathed Platform
introduced.how: the spot where the Scions meet the group to reveal the statue's wings
introduced.quote: (They meet up with the Frostmoon Scions at the Light-Bathed Platform)

introduced.name: kuuvahki
introduced.how: an ability to observe the outside world, used even while blindfolded
introduced.quote: Paimon: But you can use kuuvahki to observe the outside world even so, right?

assumed.name: kuuhenki
assumed.quote: (They spend the next few days singing, cooking, and playing with the kuuhenki)

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: Lauma: It is my hope that every night may be as wonderful as that Moon-Prayer Night.

assumed.name: Lady Moonchanter
assumed.quote: Kunegunda: (I can't believe the Lady Moonchanter referred to our Moon Goddess by her first name!)

assumed.name: Feast of the Moon
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hey, Lauma, about Paimon's hush money... Er, Paimon meant to say, we don't happen to have any spare Feast of the Moon servings today, do we?

threads.claim: Kuutar was once wingless and has since regained the freedom to live, which the Scions witnessed.
threads.quote: Lauma: No longer is she the wingless Kuutar who could only gaze at the moon beyond the skies in solitude.

threads.claim: The statue of the Moon Goddess is restored with a pair of angelic wings as a gift.
threads.quote: Columbina: This pair of wings makes it look all the more complete.

threads.claim: The Scions stood against a force that pollutes the world, guided by a gentle light, and its nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Lauma: And of how we stood against the force that pollutes this world with the guidance of that gentle light.

threads.claim: The Scions are preparing something connected to Columbina, and Lauma keeps it secret.
threads.quote: Columbina: If I had to guess, she is preparing something that has to do with me.

threads.claim: The Scions' secret preparation turns out to be a gift to Columbina celebrating the statue and her return.
threads.quote: Lauma: This is a gift we Frostmoon Scions would like to give you, Columbina.

threads.claim: Columbina feels confusion about her own birth, hinting at an unexplained origin.
threads.quote: Columbina: ...The me from before would only be reminded of the confusion I felt upon being born whenever I looked upon this statue.

threads.claim: Some Scions question whether regarding the Moon Goddess as family would overstep, while Lauma argues it is what Columbina wants.
threads.quote: Lauha: Would we... not be overstepping by regarding her as family?

threads.claim: Lauma formally invites Columbina to make the Scions' home her home as well.
threads.quote: Lauma: From now on, this will be your home as well, Columbina.

threads.claim: The Lady Moonchanter's use of the Moon Goddess's first name surprises the Scions, hinting at tension in their relationship.
threads.quote: Kunegunda: (I can't believe the Lady Moonchanter referred to our Moon Goddess by her first name!)

introduced.name: Tenoyollotzin
introduced.how: a respectful title for Tenoch, meaning the honored heart of Tenochtzitoc, used by the actor playing him
introduced.quote: "Tenoyollotzin" was a respectful title given to Tenoch.

introduced.name: Papar
introduced.how: an on-site actor who role-plays Tenoyollotzin at the resort
introduced.quote: His name is Papar, and he's one of our on-site actors.

introduced.name: Pucli
introduced.how: the resort's entertainment supervisor
introduced.quote: I'm Pucli, the entertainment supervisor at the resort...

introduced.name: Leyla
introduced.how: a spirit-duffer turned shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, studying under Ororon
introduced.quote: I'm Leyla, and I'm from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.how: Leyla's teacher, who taught her mystic arts after she nearly lost her soul
introduced.quote: It's just that I'm studying under Master Ororon, and he's told me many tales about you two...

introduced.name: Citlali
introduced.how: a great shaman who saved Leyla with Ororon and is traveling with the group
introduced.quote: But in the end, Master Ororon and the great shaman Citlali saved me.

introduced.name: Wanjiru
introduced.how: a great runner, first to receive Tenoyollotzin on his path of fate
introduced.quote: the first to come forward and receive him was the great runner, Wanjiru.

introduced.name: Tenoch
introduced.how: a great hero of the Tenochtzitoc tribe known across Natlan, whose title Tenoyollotzin the actor takes
introduced.quote: There was once a great hero from this tribe, known to all of Natlan, who was named Tenoch.

introduced.name: Tenochtzitoc
introduced.how: the tribe that once lived at the resort site, which the actors portray
introduced.quote: These actors are in character as members of the tribe that once lived here

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: a themed resort where staff role-play tribe members as an immersive attraction
introduced.quote: We've stationed actors around the themed resort to enhance the immersive experience for our guests.

introduced.name: Asha
introduced.how: hidden spirits seen near the resort; the word has a meaning of benevolent soul
introduced.quote: In Tenochtzitoc culture, the word "Asha" has two meanings, one of which roughly translates to "benevolent soul."

introduced.name: Mare Jivari
introduced.how: a vast ash-covered land west of Tenochtzitoc, once a site of sorrow from the Abyssal invasion, said to have vanished about twenty years ago
introduced.quote: You may not know this, but there's a vast tract of land to the West of Tenochtzitoc that was once the Mare Jivari.

introduced.name: Abyssal invasion
introduced.how: the invasion that turned the Mare Jivari into a land of sorrow
introduced.quote: It is a place of sorrow born from the Abyssal invasion.

introduced.name: Bakunawa
introduced.how: a gigantic Abyssal beast that devoured Tenochtzitoc villages five hundred years ago and seems functionally immortal
introduced.quote: A gigantic beast that appeared on the Western side of Natlan five hundred years ago, accompanied by other Abyssal monsters.

introduced.name: Sanhaj Kompore
introduced.how: the legendary Border Master whose relic was used to divine the Mare Jivari
introduced.quote: It's a relic that was owned by the legendary Border Master, Sanhaj Kompore.

introduced.name: Enjou
introduced.how: a clerk for the Abyss Order who has used aliases and is a slippery schemer
introduced.quote: Whatever he's called, he's a clerk who works for the Abyss Order.

introduced.name: Abyss Order
introduced.how: the organization Enjou works for, pursuing the Mare Jivari
introduced.quote: Whatever he's called, he's a clerk who works for the Abyss Order.

introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.how: a realm Sanhaj summoned in miniature inside Bakunawa to help defeat it
introduced.quote: Sanhaj summoned a miniature Night Kingdom inside Bakunawa's belly.

introduced.name: carrot ring divination
introduced.how: Leyla's vegetable-based clairvoyance method that reveals hidden spiritual presences
introduced.quote: This is a medium of divination that will help with clairvoyance.

introduced.name: mystic arts implement
introduced.how: a Masters of the Night-Wind teleportation scroll that transports users to other places
introduced.quote: That's a mystic arts implement from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Sanhaj's relic
introduced.how: a map-like relic that divines the location of the Mare Jivari and reactivates the scroll
introduced.quote: I used it to divine the location of the Mare Jivari.

introduced.name: Tenoch's sacrifice
introduced.how: Tenoch was eaten by Bakunawa as part of a ritual that helped destroy the beast
introduced.quote: Through Tenoch's sacrifice. He let Sanhaj perform Phlogiston Engraving on his body in order to unleash the power of border spells.

introduced.name: Enjou
introduced.how: introduces himself as a member of the Abyss Order who supports from the rear
introduced.quote: Enjou: I knew it. No matter how powerful a beast Bakunawa was, it would always fall short of the might of and I, Enjou, supporting from the rear...

introduced.name: Bakunawa
introduced.how: a monstrous beast whose body the party fights and whose remains hold ancient treasures
introduced.quote: Bakunawa is preparing to unleash a terrifying attack. and replace your Elemental Skill with Soulshard Rain to combat it...

introduced.name: Soulshard Rain
introduced.how: a skill that replaces Elemental Skill and can interrupt Bakunawa's attack
introduced.quote: Bakunawa is preparing to unleash a terrifying attack. and replace your Elemental Skill with Soulshard Rain to combat it...

introduced.name: Tenoch
introduced.how: the last survivor of the lost Tenochtzitoc settlement
introduced.quote: Enjou: ...In any case, that man's name was Tenoch, and the lost settlement was known as Tenochtzitoc.

introduced.name: Tenochtzitoc
introduced.how: a lost settlement whose warriors wielded Anemo power
introduced.quote: Enjou: ...In any case, that man's name was Tenoch, and the lost settlement was known as Tenochtzitoc.

introduced.name: Windless Land
introduced.how: the nickname for the burial grounds where Tenochtzitoc's dead lie
introduced.quote: Enjou: Its people were warriors who wielded the power of Anemo. Some people named the place where their bones were buried the "Windless Land."

introduced.name: Muratans
introduced.how: the brothers and sisters of Tenochtzitoc's people who left for a distant land of wind centuries earlier
