threads.claim: The Dawn Winery's test batch of brewing ingredients is linked to the strange events, but the connection is not explained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Brewing ingredients from the Dawn Winery, huh...

introduced.name: Golden Entreaty
introduced.how: a disc-shaped token that Manqu says is rare and believed to have been handled by the Sage
introduced.quote: It's said that this was once handled by the Sage of the Stolen Flame himself...

introduced.name: Sage of the Stolen Flame
introduced.how: a legendary figure who once handled the Golden Entreaties and left tokens in the ruins
introduced.quote: It's said that this was once handled by the Sage of the Stolen Flame himself...

introduced.name: Ochkanatlan
introduced.how: ruins of an ancient city across a narrow stretch of water, north of the Flower-Feather Clan
introduced.quote: The ruins of an ancient city that lies across a narrow stretch of water, north of the Flower-Feather Clan...

introduced.name: Saurian Relics Association
introduced.how: an organization that takes investigation commissions and has avoided Ochkanatlan since members vanished
introduced.quote: Not only does my tribe forbid me to go there, but so does the Saurian Relics Association...

introduced.name: Great Volcano of Tollan
introduced.how: a volcano where Xbalanque fought the Flamelord long ago and where a dragon may sleep
introduced.quote: Legend has it that long ago, before Xbalanque became the Pyro Archon, it was there that he fought against the Flamelord

introduced.name: Xbalanque
introduced.how: a hero who fought the Flamelord and returned to become the first Pyro Archon
introduced.quote: When the dust had finally settled, the triumphant hero Xbalanque returned alive to become the first Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Pyro Archon
introduced.how: a title that Xbalanque became, the first to hold it
introduced.quote: When the dust had finally settled, the triumphant hero Xbalanque returned alive to become the first Pyro Archon.

introduced.name: Flamelord
introduced.how: an enemy who wielded blinding light and searing heat and was fought by Xbalanque
introduced.quote: he fought against the Flamelord who wielded the powers of blinding light and searing heat

assumed.name: Ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame
assumed.quote: (After leaving the Ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame)

assumed.name: Manqu
assumed.quote: Paimon: Manqu, we're back!

assumed.name: Flower-Feather Clan
assumed.quote: north of the Flower-Feather Clan

assumed.name: Flamelord's Blessing
assumed.quote: I wish you success removing the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing.

assumed.name: token from the Sage
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh yeah, remember to show Manqu the token you got.

threads.claim: The Sage of the Stolen Flame once held the Golden Entreaties and left tokens in ruins.
threads.quote: It's said that this was once handled by the Sage of the Stolen Flame himself...

threads.claim: The Golden Entreaties are needed to save someone, though the person is left unnamed.
threads.quote: Paimon: No way! We need them to save !

threads.claim: Ochkanatlan is avoided because investigators sent there years ago vanished without a trace.
threads.quote: Apparently, it is said that many years ago, some Association members received a commission to investigate that place, but after setting out, they vanished without a trace.

threads.claim: The Traveler saw the name Ochkanatlan on a stone tablet, which is the only clue to the second token.
threads.quote: Explain that you saw it when you touched the stone tablet...

threads.claim: Whether an ancient dragon still sleeps inside the Great Volcano of Tollan is unknown.
threads.quote: Some believe that an ancient dragon still resides there, deep in hibernation

threads.claim: Legend says Xbalanque defeated the Flamelord and became the first Pyro Archon, though it is unverified.
threads.quote: When the dust had finally settled, the triumphant hero Xbalanque returned alive to become the first Pyro Archon.

threads.claim: The Traveler carries a mark from the Flamelord's Blessing that needs to be removed.
threads.quote: I wish you success removing the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing.

introduced.name: Xiangjun
introduced.how: a young girl who says her grandfather was kidnapped by demons and asks for help
introduced.quote: I'm Xiangjun... I'm looking for my Grandpa... He was kidnapped by demons...

introduced.name: Qiaoying Village
introduced.how: the village where Xiangjun says she lives
introduced.quote: It's fine. I live in Qiaoying Village. I can head back myself.

introduced.name: Mt. Xuanlian
introduced.how: a mountain near a pool of blessed waters where a divine plant needs watering
introduced.quote: He found a divine plant recently, one that's said to only grow when watered with the blessed waters near Mt. Xuanlian.

introduced.name: Yaodie Valley
introduced.how: a valley connected to Mt. Xuanlian by a small shortcut road
introduced.quote: If I remember right, there's a shortcut — a small road leading from Yaodie Valley to Mt. Xuanlian.

introduced.name: Blessed waters
introduced.how: water from near Mt. Xuanlian said to be needed to grow the divine plant
introduced.quote: one that's said to only grow when watered with the blessed waters near Mt. Xuanlian

introduced.name: Divine herbs
introduced.how: rare plants the herb gatherer claimed to have found, which need blessed water to grow
introduced.quote: He found a divine plant recently

introduced.name: Xiangjun's grandfather
introduced.how: a village herb gatherer who went missing in the mountains
introduced.quote: Grandpa's the village's herb gatherer.

introduced.name: Uncle Luo
introduced.how: a Qiaoying Village resident who claims to know everyone in the village
introduced.quote: I'm sure I know everyone in the village...

introduced.name: Adeptus
introduced.how: a nickname for a mortal outsider who helped protect the village, distinct from the cloud-dwelling Adepti
introduced.quote: Just an "adeptus" who could help protect the village from disaster.

introduced.name: Demons
introduced.how: dangerous creatures said to dwell in the mountains and possibly guard the water
introduced.quote: Might he have bumped into some kind of demon guarding the water?

introduced.name: Herb gatherer's death
introduced.how: the herb gatherer died three years earlier after encountering monsters in the wild
introduced.quote: He encountered monsters in the wild and...

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Not the "Capital-A Adepti" who dwell in the clouds, I mean.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: In for a Mora, in for it all, eh?

threads.claim: The girl calling herself Xiangjun may not be who she claims to be.
threads.quote: I'm Xiangjun... I'm looking for my Grandpa... He was kidnapped by demons...

threads.claim: Uncle Luo has never heard of Xiangjun, deepening the mystery of who the girl really is.
threads.quote: Xiangjun? Never heard of her.

threads.claim: Demons may be lurking in the mountains near Mt. Xuanlian.
threads.quote: Grandpa said that they're in the mountains, so I shouldn't run around by myself...

threads.claim: The herb gatherer died three years earlier after monsters attacked him near Mt. Xuanlian, so the missing grandfather was already dead.
threads.quote: But it's been three years since he passed...

threads.claim: The blessed water appears to be ordinary river water, casting doubt on the divine herb's supposed power.
threads.quote: Load of hogwash if you ask me — I mean, it's all just river water. Nothing special about it!

threads.claim: A mortal outsider nicknamed 'adeptus' may have protected the village from a disaster.
threads.quote: Just an "adeptus" who could help protect the village from disaster.

introduced.name: Jiayi
introduced.how: A city guard who is overloaded with duties and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Jiayi: I was called to help collect and organize some incoming paperwork, and then I had to patrol the city and settle an escort request from a merchant caravan...

introduced.name: Nantianmen
introduced.how: The location where intermittent earthquakes were reported and the Traveler is sent to investigate
introduced.quote: Jiayi: Unfortunately, however, we're very short-handed at the moment... Traveler, if you have the time, would you mind heading over to Nantianmen and taking a look for me?

introduced.name: Intermittent earthquakes near Nantianmen
introduced.how: A recent report of repeated earthquakes near Nantianmen that prompted a city investigation
introduced.quote: Jiayi: *sigh* And on top of all that... Just a few days ago, we received a report that there have been intermittent earthquakes near Nantianmen.

assumed.name: The crisis
assumed.quote: Jiayi: *sigh* Now that the crisis has passed, things in the city have been gradually returning to normal.

threads.claim: Intermittent earthquakes near Nantianmen are reported, and the city cannot yet explain them.
threads.quote: Jiayi: *sigh* And on top of all that... Just a few days ago, we received a report that there have been intermittent earthquakes near Nantianmen.

threads.claim: Jiayi suspects monsters may be behind the trouble at Nantianmen, though she is unsure.
threads.quote: Jiayi: Good question... if I had to guess, I'd say probably... monsters, or something.

threads.claim: The Traveler finds nothing unusual at Nantianmen, so the earthquakes and monsters remain unexplained.
threads.quote: Jiayi: Normal? So... no earthquakes, no monsters? How strange...

introduced.name: Mikoshi Genjirou
introduced.how: A serious, far-sighted official who approved Xavier's film in Inazuma in exchange for a Shogunate-themed samurai movie
introduced.quote: My main job, really, was to persuade Mr. Mikoshi Genjirou to allow me to make a film in Inazuma.

introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.how: Superiors approved the film because it would increase the Shogunate's prestige
introduced.quote: This activity has been approved by our superiors. According to them, it will help to increase the Shogunate's prestige.

introduced.name: Film Kamera
introduced.how: A camera that records movement and can only capture what stays in its view
introduced.quote: the Film Kamera will not be able to capture your movements at all.

introduced.name: swashbuckler film
introduced.how: Xavier's name for films of a genre with sword-fighting and battlefield journeys
introduced.quote: Oh, "swashbuckler film" is what I'm calling films of this genre.

introduced.name: The Seventh Samurai
introduced.how: The title of the swashbuckler film being shot with the Traveler and Toranosuke
introduced.quote: As you can see, I'm shooting a swashbuckler film with our good soldier here. I call it "The Seventh Samurai."

introduced.name: Juusaburou
introduced.how: A samurai hired by villagers to protect their village; the role the Traveler plays in the script
introduced.quote: you'll be playing the role of "Juusaburou." Together with several companions, he is employed by the villagers to protect their village...

introduced.name: Kyuuzou
introduced.how: One of Juusaburou's companions with lines in the scene
introduced.quote: In this scene, one of your companions, "Kyuuzou," has lines... I'll play his part, and the two of us will do a reading.

introduced.name: Yousuke
introduced.how: A craftsman who took over management of the Mikage Furnace and is down-to-earth and steady
introduced.quote: He is a craftsman by birth and trade, and is very down-to-earth and steady.

assumed.name: Xavier
assumed.quote: Oh, it's you! Ah, my dear , a fair wind must have blown you here.

assumed.name: Toranosuke
assumed.quote: To think that Mr. Toranosuke would have time...

assumed.name: Tatara Tales
assumed.quote: I'll always remember that "Tatara Tales" that we acted in together.

assumed.name: Hanbei
assumed.quote: Ever since Sir Hanbei's "promotion," Yousuke has taken over as the person in charge.

assumed.name: Mikage Furnace
assumed.quote: How's the situation at the Mikage Furnace?

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: There are so many islands here in Inazuma, and so many stories to be told!

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: Should we do one about the various traditions of the Grand Narukami Shrine?

assumed.name: Kitsune
assumed.quote: Or the tales of the kitsune and the tanuki?

assumed.name: Tanuki
assumed.quote: Or the tales of the kitsune and the tanuki?

threads.claim: The Shogunate uses films to display samurai majesty and boost its prestige.
threads.quote: Use these scenes of steel clashing against steel to display the majesty of the samurai and the Shogunate.

threads.claim: Toranosuke feels the film's pessimistic script contradicts samurai dignity.
threads.quote: This script is full of these... pessimistic lines. There is nothing of samurai dignity here.

threads.claim: Toranosuke wonders why his superiors agreed to such a film, leaving their motives open.
threads.quote: Who knows what they were thinking, that they agreed to all this...

threads.claim: Hanbei's promotion put Yousuke in charge of the Mikage Furnace, which Toranosuke expects to run without problems.
threads.quote: With the Mikage Furnace under his management, I doubt there will be any further problems.

threads.claim: Xavier admits he has not decided what films should capture, suggesting the purpose of film is an open question.
threads.quote: I believe that films can be about anything.

threads.claim: Xavier expects to find the answer about what films capture by continuing to make them.
threads.quote: Still, I believe that I will find the answer to that question as long as I keep making films.

threads.claim: Inazuma's many islands hold stories that could become future films.
threads.quote: There are so many islands here in Inazuma, and so many stories to be told!

introduced.name: Eye of Graeae
introduced.how: an in-world voice that guides the player and sets up the shooting range training
introduced.quote: Eye of Graeae: I recommend that you enter the shooting range to look into the new Shadow Realm training program.

introduced.name: shooting range
introduced.how: a Shadow Realm function set up as a training range, reached through a large portal
introduced.quote: This is a function of the Shadow Realm that has been set up as a shooting range...

introduced.name: Shadow Realm
introduced.how: can be simulated by the shooting range device
introduced.quote: But anyway, you can use this device to simulate a Shadow Realm, or the more oppressive Deep Shadow Realm...

introduced.name: Deep Shadow Realm
introduced.how: a more oppressive version of the Shadow Realm with deeper environments
introduced.quote: To further simulate the environment within the depths of the Shadow Realm and prepare for deeper delves into it...

introduced.name: Firearm
introduced.how: completing training unlocks access to blueprints for stronger firearms
introduced.quote: You can even complete the training to unlock the corresponding access to blueprints for stronger firearms.

introduced.name: trophy case
introduced.how: holds firearms and accessories meant for those who finished Shadow Realm training and Deep Shadow Realm cleansing
introduced.quote: The firearms and accessories within the trophy case here are designed for those who have completed Shadow Realm training and Deep Shadow Realm cleansing operations.

assumed.name: Train
assumed.quote: Paimon: A shooting range? Oh, you mean the thing on the train? Well... guess we can head back and check it out?

assumed.name: Shadow Realm combat data
assumed.quote: Eye of Graeae: Shadow Realm combat data retrieved. The shooting range function can now be used.

threads.claim: Some memories about the Shadow Realm training function have been erased, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Eye of Graeae: Strange. These memories appear to have been erased.

threads.claim: Unnamed people in the past used the Shadow Realm training function, and their identities are hidden.
threads.quote: Once upon a time, (...) and (...) also used this function to train...

threads.claim: The Deep Shadow Realm requires cleansing operations, and training is needed before taking them on.
threads.quote: designed for those who have completed Shadow Realm training and Deep Shadow Realm cleansing operations.

introduced.name: Pechna
introduced.how: a bookshop visitor who has been watching the Traveler and warns them against the investment
introduced.quote: I'm often here looking for books, and just happened to notice that you two were very interested in investing.

introduced.name: Dhabit
introduced.how: the seller of the investment coupons, who treats the Traveler as a regular customer
introduced.quote: Well, well, if it isn't our regulars! Here to invest again, are we?

introduced.name: Investment Returns
introduced.how: investment coupons sold by Dhabit, which Pechna suspects are a scam with no real generous returns
introduced.quote: A little bird told me your investment coupons are a scam...

introduced.name: Pechna's friend's scam
introduced.how: a friend of Pechna was once caught in a similar investment scam
introduced.quote: My friend was once caught in a similar scam, so it would be best if the two of you didn't continue.

assumed.name: Investment Returns
assumed.quote: (Approach Mimisbrunnr Books after using nine Investment Returns)

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Why, back when I was in Sumeru City... Ahem.

threads.claim: Pechna suspects the Investment Returns coupons are a scam that offers no real generous returns.
threads.quote: Because I suspect there can be no "generous returns" at all.

threads.claim: Dhabit's sudden apology and handing over everything suggests the coupons were indeed a scam.
threads.quote: Look. I'm sorry, alright? I'll leave you both alone.

threads.claim: Dhabit hints at a past in Sumeru City that he quickly cuts off.
threads.quote: Why, back when I was in Sumeru City... Ahem.

threads.claim: Dhabit claims hope can only be seized by the persistent, a remark that frames giving up as a loss.
threads.quote: "Hope" can only be seized by the persistent.

introduced.name: Tsuyuko
introduced.how: Sangonomiya shrine figure who is trying to restore Enkanomiya and leads the quest
introduced.quote: Tsuyuko: Hello there, .

introduced.name: Enkanomiya
introduced.how: underground realm slowly awakening, with a trial system the Traveler must face
introduced.quote: Tsuyuko: We did obtain the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, yes, and Enkanomiya is slowly awakening.

introduced.name: Key Sigil
introduced.how: old heraldic keys used throughout Enkanomiya that surface only when the road is about to open; five types exist
introduced.quote: Tsuyuko: We call this a "Key Sigil." It was once heraldry used throughout Enkanomiya.

introduced.name: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep
introduced.how: the key whose retrieval awakens Enkanomiya and activates its trial system
introduced.quote: Enkanomiya will only awaken if we retrieve the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep. Similarly, only that Key can activate the trial system within.

introduced.name: Watatsumi Island
introduced.how: island where three Key Sigils were found and the Key Sigils are placed
introduced.quote: At the moment, we have found three of the five on Watatsumi Island.

introduced.name: Sangonomiya Clan
introduced.how: clan that normally receives rare treasures found during exploration
introduced.quote: I mean, such things would usually be given over to the Sangonomiya Clan, of course.

introduced.name: Byakuyakoku
introduced.how: former name of Enkanomiya, an underground realm with no sun or moon
introduced.quote: Enkanomiya's name was Byakuyakoku once upon a time.

introduced.name: Whitenight and Evernight
introduced.how: the only two astronomical phenomena of Byakuyakoku's underground realm
introduced.quote: the only two astronomical phenomena being the Whitenight and the Evernight.

introduced.name: Eboshi
introduced.how: Tsuyuko's ancestor, a shrine maiden significant in Byakuyakoku's history
introduced.quote: One of my ancestors was a shrine maiden named Eboshi.

introduced.name: hero
introduced.how: according to tradition, a required hero figure is vital to obtaining the coral
introduced.quote: Know that according to tradition, a "hero" is vital to the process of obtaining the coral.

assumed.name: Kokomi
assumed.quote: Traveler: You know, I think we and Madam Kokomi get along pretty well and all...

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Paimon: Agh, it's the Fatui! How did they get here?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: We are presently unable to establish contact with the Adventurers' Guild, so no adventurers are allowed down there either.

assumed.name: Ruin machines
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why are the Ruin machines attracted to the Key Sigils? Are they, like, giving off similar feelings, or what?

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders and Kairagi
assumed.quote: if you encounter any Fatui, Treasure Hoarders, Kairagi, or any of their ilk

assumed.name: Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri
assumed.quote: And if there are any who did not enter Enkanomiya to perform the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri

threads.claim: The nature of Enkanomiya's trial is unknown, and the Traveler must rely on themselves to face it.
threads.quote: Unfortunately, we do not have any details as to the nature of Enkanomiya's trial, so you will have to rely on yourself there.

threads.claim: Ruin machines are drawn to the Key Sigils for reasons not yet explained.
threads.quote: Paimon: Why are the Ruin machines attracted to the Key Sigils? Are they, like, giving off similar feelings, or what?

threads.claim: Fatui have already slipped into Enkanomiya's restricted area despite the barrier, raising the question of how.
threads.quote: Paimon: Agh, it's the Fatui! How did they get here?

threads.claim: There may be another winding route into Enkanomiya besides the sanctioned one.
threads.quote: Well, there might be some other twisted, winding way to get in. Who knows?

threads.claim: The mysterious hero figure is essential to the ritual, and its identity is still unclear.
threads.quote: Not to mention how we have seen neither hide nor hair of our most vital character, this "hero."

threads.claim: Relations between Sangonomiya and Narukami Island are uncertain and may or may not improve.
threads.quote: We do not yet know if relations with Narukami Island will indeed warm.

threads.claim: Kokomi seems to have anticipated the Traveler's actions, hinting at her planning behind the quest.
threads.quote: She even anticipated that you would indeed return to look for me.

threads.claim: Eboshi was a significant figure in Byakuyakoku's history and her legacy ties to the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.
threads.quote: She was a character of some significance in Byakuyakoku's history, and it is due to her that I am in charge of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

threads.claim: Byakuyakoku was an underground realm with no sun or moon, only the Whitenight and Evernight.
threads.quote: There was neither sun nor moon in that underground realm, and the only two astronomical phenomena being the Whitenight and the Evernight.

threads.claim: Enkanomiya's cavern shows no trace of civilization, which is puzzling given its history.
threads.quote: Paimon: No trace of civilization at all... How can that be?

threads.claim: The Key Sigils were removed from keyholes and placed around Watatsumi, then used at altars to release the seal.
threads.quote: We removed the three we found from their keyholes and placed them in other locations throughout Watatsumi Island.

threads.claim: The Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep is necessary to awaken Enkanomiya, and using it transforms the Moon-Bathed Deep to allow entry.
threads.quote: Enkanomiya will only awaken if we retrieve the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep.

introduced.name: Vaino
introduced.how: self-introduction; a former treasure hunter now running a training ground
introduced.quote: Vaino: D—Dear guests! I am Vaino!

introduced.name: Northern Training Ground
introduced.how: Vaino's training ground with shooting and dodging challenges
introduced.quote: (Approach ??? at the Northern Training Ground)

introduced.name: Vaino's career change
introduced.how: Vaino left treasure hunting and became a training ground boss after realizing he was the oldest at a gathering
introduced.quote: Vaino: I was a treasure hunter for so long, but, honestly, I'd been thinking about getting out of the game for a while.

introduced.name: The Hollowhands
introduced.how: secretive thieves who take training ground targets and trade with locals
introduced.quote: Sisko: Uh... well, I—I guess... It was The Hollowhands. But! They're not bad guys!

introduced.name: Sniffer Mole
introduced.how: animals revealed to be the thieves behind The Hollowhands
introduced.quote: Paimon: , look! Sniffer Moles!

introduced.name: Sisko
introduced.how: local kid who collects targets and sells them back to Vaino
introduced.quote: Sisko: The kids around here. We all know Uncle "Young" needs target materials, so whenever we come across any, we collect them to sell to him.

introduced.name: Reed Miller
introduced.how: legendary thief said to have stolen seventy-seven treasures from the governor's palace
introduced.quote: Sisko: I heard it's because Reed Miller once stole seventy-seven treasures from the governor's palace!

introduced.name: Seventy-seven trade ritual
introduced.how: at the trade box you leave items, close your eyes and count to seventy-seven
introduced.quote: Sisko: Every time we walk up to the little trade box, we leave our stuff inside, then close our eyes and count to seventy-seven.

introduced.name: Training Ground Target
introduced.how: shooting targets used in training challenges that get stolen
introduced.quote: Vaino: Nah, it's happened before. I got new materials, made new ones, and hid them somewhere no one would think to look.

introduced.name: Krumkake Craftshop
introduced.how: where target-making materials can be obtained
introduced.quote: Vaino: You can get target-making materials at the Krumkake Craftshop. I've been there a few times.

introduced.name: Trade box in the cave
introduced.how: box where left items are swapped for gifts from The Hollowhands
introduced.quote: Paimon: There's a little box! This must be how people trade with The Hollowhands!

assumed.name: Boncza
assumed.quote: But that's word-for-word the pitch that Boncza taught me back in Nasha Town...

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: But that's word-for-word the pitch that Boncza taught me back in Nasha Town...

assumed.name: The Flagship
assumed.quote: At last month's gathering in The Flagship, everyone was speaking to me with this weird, respectful tone...

assumed.name: Reed Miller
assumed.quote: And it's not like I ever found any of Reed Miller's old treasure or anything.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: And there are so many Fatui stationed in Nod-Krai...

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: I guess in a place like Nod-Krai, trusting others is never easy.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Sisko: Yeah. It's not always just targets though. They sometimes give us Mora or other valuable parts.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Vaino: Hmm, I've dealt with Treasure Hoarders before, and in my experience, if you want to catch them, the best way is to bait a trap.

threads.claim: The Hollowhands are unseen thieves whose identity is unknown to the locals who trade with them.
threads.quote: Sisko: They're very cautious! We just leave the stuff at the usual trading spot. We've never actually met them face-to-face.

threads.claim: The Hollowhands are revealed to be a group of Sniffer Moles.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? The legendary, elusive rogues, The Hollowhands, are actually a bunch of Sniffer Moles?

threads.claim: Vaino's targets keep disappearing, suggesting someone is stealing them on purpose.
threads.quote: Vaino: But they've been taken again, which means someone's doing this on purpose!

threads.claim: The moles had been using the stolen targets as bedding and decoration.
threads.quote: Paimon: So they were using them as bedding all along? That's why they kept going after Vaino!

threads.claim: The meaning of the number seventy-seven in the trade ritual is an open question.
threads.quote: Traveler: Why seventy-seven?

threads.claim: The meaning of seventy-seven remains unresolved after the moles respond only with squeaks.
threads.quote: Paimon: So in the end, we still don't really know what it means...

threads.claim: The dangers of treasure hunting push Vaino to leave the profession.
threads.quote: Vaino: Luck doesn't hang around forever. That's why I wanted out of the business.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: self-introduces as an investigator from the Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.quote: The name's Jahoda. I'm here from the Curatorium of Secrets.

introduced.name: Derwent
introduced.how: a hermit who once taught the Conch Gang kids to read and always spoke softly
introduced.quote: The Conch Gang kids said Mr. Derwent taught them how to read. They said he always spoke softly...

introduced.name: Hermit's Hut
introduced.how: a remote hut halfway up a mountain where the hermit lives
introduced.quote: Anyone who runs off to live halfway up a remote mountain can't be entirely normal...

introduced.name: Disappearance of the merchant
introduced.how: an experienced merchant who visited the hermit has vanished without explanation
introduced.quote: Despite knowing the lay of the land, an experienced merchant just disappeared.

introduced.name: Dangers of the area
introduced.how: the surrounding wilderness is full of bandits and monsters that threaten travelers
introduced.quote: But that area's full of dangers — everyone knows that.

introduced.name: Derwent's caravan crimes
introduced.how: Derwent confessed on the burned page to past crimes involving a caravan and sought to leave society
introduced.quote: He confessed to me about the caravan, hoping to retreat from society under my tutelage...

assumed.name: Nefer
assumed.quote: Oh... Sure thing, Boss Nef! Leave it to me!

assumed.name: Conch Gang
assumed.quote: The Conch Gang kids said Mr. Derwent taught them how to read.

assumed.name: Nasha Town
assumed.quote: you should head to Nasha Town when you're better

assumed.name: Kuuvahki
assumed.quote: And a mask to block out kuuvahki... Is that the latest fashion?

threads.claim: The man inside the hut may not be the real Derwent, since his voice and build seem different from what people describe.
threads.quote: (They weren't wrong. This seems like a completely different guy...)

threads.claim: Derwent wears a mask and claims it blocks noise, an explanation that leaves his reason open.
threads.quote: ...It's to block out the noise.

threads.claim: A merchant who visited the hermit disappeared, and his whereabouts remain unknown.
threads.quote: Anyway, there was a merchant who came to visit you not long ago. Do you know where he went?

threads.claim: Someone tried to burn the half-burned page at the campfire, and the reason for destroying it is unclear.
threads.quote: (Why would he try to burn these...?)

threads.claim: Derwent admitted to past crimes and claimed to have reformed, but the page's author doubted his sincerity.
threads.quote: He claimed to no longer embody sin and self-destruction

threads.claim: Derwent reportedly took in injured adventurers recently, and the page describes a severely wounded man.
threads.quote: (I heard Mr. Derwent would take in injured adventurers... This seems to have happened recently.)

threads.claim: The locked hut falls silent at the end, leaving the hermit's fate and condition unresolved.
threads.quote: The door is locked tight and no sound can be heard...

introduced.name: Iron Tongue Tian
introduced.how: a storyteller whose tales Zhongli praises and who wants Zhongli's Archaic Stone
introduced.quote: I was telling stories as usual today, and Zhongli dropped by as usual, too.

introduced.name: Zhongli
introduced.how: an erudite gentleman well-versed in history and mythology who advises Tian
introduced.quote: At first, I thought he was just an erudite gentleman who knew a lot about folk culture.

introduced.name: Through the Eyes of a Dragon
introduced.how: a story Tian tells repeatedly, considered one of his finest works
introduced.quote: one of my finest works, if I do say so myself.

introduced.name: Archaic Stone
introduced.how: a stone that is highly sought after and in very short supply
introduced.quote: Archaic Stone is highly sought-after now. It's not even a matter of price, for there is barely any supply on the market.

introduced.name: Rex Lapis
introduced.how: the figure who carved Azhdaha out of a magical rock in Tian's story
introduced.quote: See, my story first tells of how Rex Lapis carved Azhdaha out of a magical rock

introduced.name: Azhdaha
introduced.how: a dragon said to have been sealed underground by Rex Lapis
introduced.quote: As we have discussed before, Rex Lapis sealed Azhdaha underground.

introduced.name: The Chasm
introduced.how: a place with luminous stones in a long winding tunnel, of unknown origin
introduced.quote: Well, do you know about The Chasm? There's a type of incredibly beautiful stone to be found in that place.

introduced.name: Liyue Harbor
introduced.how: the harbor city where the Traveler and Paimon go to talk with Zhongli
introduced.quote: Let's go down to Liyue Harbor for a walk to clear our heads a bit, shall we?

introduced.name: Folding fan
introduced.how: a dragon-illustrated fan Tian made to give to his favorite audiences
introduced.quote: I made these fans so that I could one day gift them to like-minded audiences.

introduced.name: Serpent of Qingce Village
introduced.how: a tale Tian told Zhongli about a serpent that became a landscape
introduced.quote: when I told him about the serpent of Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Mining crew leader
introduced.how: a miner who described the stone-filled tunnels of The Chasm to Tian
introduced.quote: a miner — the leader of a mining crew — was out for work

introduced.name: Resumed mining at The Chasm
introduced.how: no one could enter The Chasm until mining operations recently resumed
introduced.quote: no one was allowed to go in until recently when mining operations resumed

assumed.name: Xiao
assumed.quote: Xiao also said that he wouldn't have been able to escape without your help.

assumed.name: Zhongli's rescue at The Chasm
assumed.quote: Zhongli, were you at The Chasm? And you saved us too, didn't you?

assumed.name: Earlier trip
assumed.quote: It's been quite the trip, huh?

threads.claim: Zhongli denies having been at The Chasm despite the claim that he saved the Traveler and Paimon there, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: Hmm? Was I at The Chasm? How curious. I must admit that this is the first time that I'm hearing of such a thing.

threads.claim: Zhongli calls himself a mortal now and says he does not miss the past, hinting he was once something else.
threads.quote: I'm a mortal now, and being mortal means living in the present.

threads.claim: Nobody knows who built the tunnels of The Chasm, which may have been an ancient battlefield.
threads.quote: No one knows who built it.

threads.claim: Zhongli argues Azhdaha cannot have been sealed under The Chasm because its many tunnels would disturb people.
threads.quote: It would be a constant disturbance to people there if Azhdaha really was sealed there.

threads.claim: Researchers doubt Rex Lapis had the skill to carve such a masterpiece, challenging Tian's story.
threads.quote: Rex Lapis may not have possessed the skills required to create such a work of craftsmanship.

threads.claim: The dragon imagery of freedom and an unbound spirit recurs and moves Zhongli.
threads.quote: A dragon soaring into the skies, its body free to roam the world and its spirit unbound to aim high... Most inspiring indeed.

threads.claim: Xiao owes his escape from The Chasm to Zhongli's help, an event the player has not yet seen.
threads.quote: Xiao also said that he wouldn't have been able to escape without your help.

threads.claim: The Chasm was closed to everyone until mining recently resumed there.
threads.quote: no one was allowed to go in until recently when mining operations resumed

threads.claim: Archaic Stones are scarce and sought after, and Zhongli holds one.
threads.quote: Archaic Stone is highly sought-after now. It's not even a matter of price, for there is barely any supply on the market.

introduced.name: Vishava
introduced.how: A researcher trapped among rampaging Fungi who is studying how substances affect their behavior
introduced.quote: Umm, so, about that... I was actually researching how different substances affect the behaviors of Fungi.

introduced.name: Fungi
introduced.how: Hostile creatures that gather and go on a rampage when disturbed by a substance
introduced.quote: I didn't think that these Fungi would suddenly go on a rampage like that.

introduced.name: Reagent
introduced.how: Vishava's chemical brew meant to chase Fungi away, which he hopes to sell
introduced.quote: If I could successfully develop a reagent that chases Fungi away, I could make a real killing by selling it to the merchant caravans!

assumed.name: merchant caravans
assumed.quote: If I could successfully develop a reagent that chases Fungi away, I could make a real killing by selling it to the merchant caravans!

threads.claim: Vishava keeps failing to develop a Fungi-repelling reagent, and each attempt only makes the Fungi angrier.
threads.quote: Ah, to think that my reagent didn't work this time either... Where did I go wrong?

introduced.name: Sluasi
introduced.how: gem craftsman who processes gems into ornaments and is now making sun-colored paints
introduced.quote: I mean, this is my workshop, in which I process gems... Although I must admit that it doesn't have an official name yet.

introduced.name: Mamere
introduced.how: a child who loves painting and asked Sluasi for paint as bright as the sun
introduced.quote: Is the girl who enjoys painting you spoke of named Mamere?

introduced.name: Puca
introduced.how: Sluasi's younger sister, who was saved when the village was shaking violently
introduced.quote: Moreover, she recently saved my younger sister when the village was shaking very violently.

introduced.name: Sluasi's workshop
introduced.how: a gem-processing workshop that has no official name yet
introduced.quote: Although I must admit that it doesn't have an official name yet.

introduced.name: gem processing
introduced.how: gems are turned into ornaments and, here, ground into powder for paints
introduced.quote: That means that I turn gems into various pretty ornaments... and stuff?

introduced.name: sun-colored paint commission
introduced.how: Mamere's wish for paint as bright as the sun is being fulfilled as a thank-you gift
introduced.quote: That's why I've decided to try to fulfill her wish by creating a "paint as bright as the sun" and giving it to her as a thank-you gift.

introduced.name: Quicksand Eel
introduced.how: a creature whose shells are the Sand Grease Pupae
introduced.quote: Anyway, Sand Grease Pupae aren't bones, they're just the shells left behind by Quicksand Eels!

introduced.name: Sand Grease Pupa
introduced.how: a shell left behind by Quicksand Eels, not a bone
introduced.quote: Anyway, Sand Grease Pupae aren't bones, they're just the shells left behind by Quicksand Eels!

introduced.name: Sango Pearl
introduced.how: a pearl named for growing near corals, not produced by corals
introduced.quote: Err... That's not exactly true. It's called that because they grow near corals.

introduced.name: White Iron Chunk
introduced.how: a metal painted white is simply called a White Iron Chunk
introduced.quote: Y'know, wouldn't "a metal painted white" simply be a "White Iron Chunk"?

assumed.name: Canotila
assumed.quote: Well, Canotila did tell me once that "gold is the tears of the sun," or something like that...

assumed.name: the rescue of Puca
assumed.quote: So... So the two of you are the esteemed ones who saved Puca alongside Mamere?

threads.claim: Sluasi is trying to recreate a paint as bright as the sun, a goal that drives the story forward.
threads.quote: That's why I've decided to try to fulfill her wish by creating a "paint as bright as the sun" and giving it to her as a thank-you gift.

threads.claim: A violent shaking of the village nearly harmed Puca, hinting at an unexplained earthquake event.
threads.quote: Moreover, she recently saved my younger sister when the village was shaking very violently.

threads.claim: A saying that gold is the tears of the sun hints at sun-related lore that is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Well, Canotila did tell me once that "gold is the tears of the sun," or something like that...

threads.claim: Mamere's paints are described as strange, hinting that her art involves unusual materials or methods.
threads.quote: That's true, the colors Mamere uses are pretty weird too...

threads.claim: The absence of the sun at night is raised as a question about what the sun's color and presence really are.
threads.quote: The sun doesn't become black at night! Never mind that, there isn't even a sun at night!

introduced.name: Yuan Hong
introduced.how: the father who buried a keepsake in a tree and wants his children to reunite
introduced.quote: Oh children, my dear children...

introduced.name: Yuan Qing
introduced.how: one of Yuan Hong's sons who sneaks off to grab the treasure first
introduced.quote: I finally managed to slip away while they weren't watching so that I could be first to get to the mine and find the treasure...

introduced.name: Yuan Cheng
introduced.how: one of Yuan Hong's sons who wants the treasure for himself and plans to leave
introduced.quote: Hmph, lousy older brothers! All they care about is taking the best finds for themselves.

introduced.name: Yuan Liang
introduced.how: one of Yuan Hong's sons who gloats that the treasure will be his
introduced.quote: My brothers are such morons...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: greedy treasure seekers who show up wherever treasure is found and are the Yuan sons
introduced.quote: Uh-oh, behind you! It's the Treasure Hoarders!

introduced.name: Mingyun Village
introduced.how: a village that seems eerie and whose residents are cold and bitter
introduced.quote: Uh... That village up ahead seems kinda spooky...

introduced.name: the mines
introduced.how: several mines in the area (south, east, north, west) that must each be checked
introduced.quote: Hmm... If that's the case, we should check in the mine. But, um, there seems to be way more than one mine in this area...

introduced.name: father's will
introduced.how: the dead father's wish that his children honor his will, which leads to the treasure hunt
introduced.quote: This fortune hereby made known unto you, I say: honor the will of your father...

introduced.name: Precious Chest
introduced.how: a chest Yuan Hong buried under a tree the family planted, filled with keepsakes for a future reunion
introduced.quote: There is a treasure, though... Do you still remember the tree we planted together as a family when you were children?

assumed.name: Traveler's family
assumed.quote: When we find your family, we should get all our friends together and share all our stories.

assumed.name: Treasure Hoarders
assumed.quote: Ugh. We seem to run into these guys every single time there's treasure involved...

assumed.name: monsters
assumed.quote: But where did all these monsters come from!?

threads.claim: The riddle about gold inside a rock suggests the family treasure is hidden in a mine.
threads.quote: So the gold and silver is inside a rock?

threads.claim: The treasure is actually a family keepsake Yuan Hong buries yearly under the planted tree, not gold in a mine.
threads.quote: I come here every year and put a little something inside, hoping that when you're older we can dig it out together.

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders keep appearing wherever treasure is involved, hinting at a recurring pattern.
threads.quote: Ugh. We seem to run into these guys every single time there's treasure involved...

threads.claim: Greed for money has split the Yuan family apart, and their bond is at risk of being lost.
threads.quote: Money... riches... It's all a farce. A farce, I say!

threads.claim: The Yuan family may never be able to reunite or recall their happy past together.
threads.quote: But the way things are now... they'll never be able to be a family again, or look back on happy memories of the past...

threads.claim: Something about Mingyun Village makes its residents bitter and eager to leave, an open question about the village.
threads.quote: The further away from this village... the better...

threads.claim: The Traveler is searching for their family, which remains unfound.
threads.quote: When we find your family, we should get all our friends together and share all our stories.

introduced.name: I. Ivanovna N.
introduced.how: Anastasya's late old friend, who was the original Mage J and played chess with her
introduced.quote: She was the original Mage J.

introduced.name: Chess set
introduced.how: An ornate chess set Ioanna had made as a gift for Anastasya
introduced.quote: Later, she had this chess set crafted as a gift for me.

introduced.name: Traveler's otherworldly origin
introduced.how: The Traveler comes from beyond Teyvat, not just from far across the land
introduced.quote: Not only have you journeyed far across the land, but you hail from beyond this world.

assumed.name: Mage J
assumed.quote: She was the original Mage J.

assumed.name: Pierro
assumed.quote: Pierro often says a game of chess is the best way to reveal a person's true colors.

assumed.name: Chayka
assumed.quote: Chayka sent another letter! Let's see what our mission is this time.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: To me, your thoughts and feelings about Teyvat are very valuable indeed.

assumed.name: The Consultant
assumed.quote: The Consultant has arrived, Your Majesty.

threads.claim: The Traveler is from beyond Teyvat, and Anastasya values their perspective on the world.
threads.quote: Not only have you journeyed far across the land, but you hail from beyond this world.

threads.claim: The chess pieces seem familiar to Paimon, hinting at a link to known people or events.
threads.quote: These pieces actually seem kinda familiar...

threads.claim: The chess set's piece designs came from suggestions by unnamed good friends of Ioanna.
threads.quote: She said the design of the pieces came from suggestions from some good friends.

threads.claim: Centuries after Ioanna's death, Anastasya still keeps the chessboard instead of having it become a mere display piece.
threads.quote: However, it has been centuries, and still... the chessboard remains.

threads.claim: Anastasya's days are consumed by endless machinations and strategizing, which Ioanna hoped she would step away from.
threads.quote: She hoped this chess set would be nothing more than a collectible one day, because that would mean I had finally stepped away from the endless machinations and strategizing that consumes my days.

threads.claim: The black king's inaction raises an open question about whether it stems from indifference or arrogance.
threads.quote: Is it indifference or arrogance behind his inaction? Who can say...

threads.claim: The Traveler argues that willpower and determination can decide outcomes beyond rules and logic.
threads.quote: Willpower, determination... Those are important factors too.

introduced.name: Tsaritsa
introduced.how: ruler of Snezhnaya who asks for public portraits of herself to shape how people see her
introduced.quote: One of my ministers suggested that I permit the public to create and collect portraits of me, so that the people might feel closer to me.

introduced.name: Chayka
introduced.how: aide who drafts letters on the Traveler's behalf and arranges funding for the portraits
introduced.quote: If you've decided who to ask, I can draft a couple of letters on your behalf, asking them to submit the kind of portrait they envision.

introduced.name: Alyosha
introduced.how: a friend who proposed the spring theme for the Tsaritsa's portrait
introduced.quote: It was Alyosha's idea. It's really fun, don't you think? The Tsaritsa looks beautiful like this, doesn't she?

introduced.name: Sandrone
introduced.how: a figure who routed the artist's payment through the Northland Bank
introduced.quote: I happened to route the payment for the artist through the Northland Bank, and it was noticed immediately.

introduced.name: Arlecchino
introduced.how: a leader of the group of Harbingers who wants the Tsaritsa to have a more intimidating image
introduced.quote: Indeed. Given Snezhaya's present circumstances, I do believe our leader needs a more intimidating image.

introduced.name: Pulcinella
introduced.how: government-linked figure whose opinions are said to represent the administrative system
introduced.quote: Pulcinella is deeply entrenched government affairs. Most of the time, his opinions can be said to represent those of the entire administrative system.

introduced.name: Pantalone
introduced.how: official who pushes for state treasury income from the Tsaritsa's portrait rights
introduced.quote: If Her Majesty were to reserve distribution rights to the state, she could earn a substantial sum of Mora from the printing sector.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: the ruler who died, after which the Tsaritsa became the one to guide the people
introduced.quote: After the Belyi Tsar passed away, the Tsaritsa became the one to guide us.

introduced.name: Zapolyarny Palace
introduced.how: the palace where the Tsaritsa holds her throne room and receives the Traveler
introduced.quote: (They enter the throne room to find the Tsaritsa and Chayka standing before an empty canvas)

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: a vast land ruled by the Tsaritsa, hard to cross by foot
introduced.quote: Snezhnaya is huge! It's not like we can go door to door!

introduced.name: Snezhnograd Veche
introduced.how: an administrative body that sends reports to the Tsaritsa and can filter what she hears
introduced.quote: Her Majesty would most likely just end up with another report from the Snezhnograd Veche instead of who she truly wants to hear from.

introduced.name: public portrait project
introduced.how: portraits made by the public will shape how people see the Tsaritsa
introduced.quote: This is a portrait that is destined for the homes of the people, not one to be kept in the palace for my own appreciation.

introduced.name: The Tsaritsa in Spring
introduced.how: a spring-themed portrait of the Tsaritsa among flowers, commissioned by the friends
introduced.quote: I was going for spring in bloom.

assumed.name: Vodyanitsa
assumed.quote: Gotta say, I was pretty surprised by your letter, you two!

assumed.name: Odette
assumed.quote: I appreciate you passing on our idea to the Tsaritsa.

assumed.name: Rokot
assumed.quote: Guess I'll give the rest to the Rokot.

assumed.name: Fatuus
assumed.quote: It's not that surprising. I mean, we already have a Fatuus working with us.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Are you obsessively tracking every single Mora in Snezhnaya, Pantalone?

assumed.name: Northland Bank
assumed.quote: I happened to route the payment for the artist through the Northland Bank, and it was noticed immediately.

assumed.name: Harbingers
assumed.quote: The portrait submitted by the Harbingers shall be hung in the hall of Glupov.

assumed.name: Glupov
assumed.quote: The portrait submitted by the Harbingers shall be hung in the hall of Glupov.

assumed.name: Korolevskiy Troupe
assumed.quote: shall be displayed in the theater of the Korolevskiy Troupe.

assumed.name: Fae
assumed.quote: I imagine quite a few fae in Snezhnaya share the same view.

assumed.name: Domovoy
assumed.quote: (The camera shifts to reveal the painting, which shows the Tsaritsa portrayed as a Domovoy)

assumed.name: special envoy
assumed.quote: Congratulations on becoming Her Majesty's special envoy.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa's portrait will become how the populace sees her.
threads.quote: In other words, the version of me in this portrait will become who I am in the eyes of the populace.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa concludes that each of her people sees her differently and she will not force one image.
threads.quote: These portraits have helped me realize that, although Snezhnaya has but one Tsaritsa, each of my people sees me differently.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa seems aloof and unapproachable to her people, though they still want to feel close to her.
threads.quote: Although she's always seemed somewhat aloof and unapproachable, everyone still wants to feel closer to her.

threads.claim: The Tsaritsa hints at a private longing that goes beyond her public role.
threads.quote: Who's to say I haven't longed to do just that?

threads.claim: The Belyi Tsar's death left the Tsaritsa to guide Snezhnaya, and the circumstances are left unexplained.
threads.quote: After the Belyi Tsar passed away, the Tsaritsa became the one to guide us.

threads.claim: Administrative bodies filter what reaches the Tsaritsa, so she may not hear the true public voice.
threads.quote: Her Majesty would most likely just end up with another report from the Snezhnograd Veche instead of who she truly wants to hear from.

threads.claim: Pantalone's push for state income from portrait rights hints at hidden financial motives.
threads.quote: It would certainly help replenish the state treasury. We have quite a lot of expenses these days.

threads.claim: Snezhnaya faces present circumstances whose nature is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Indeed. Given Snezhaya's present circumstances, I do believe our leader needs a more intimidating image.

threads.claim: The Traveler's role as special envoy is raised but its duties remain unexplained.
threads.quote: What does a special envoy to the Tsaritsa do? I'm not letting you go until you explain.

threads.claim: The Northland Bank notices payments, suggesting close financial surveillance in Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: I happened to route the payment for the artist through the Northland Bank, and it was noticed immediately.

threads.claim: Fae across Snezhnaya hold views about the Tsaritsa's image that the Tsaritsa considers representative.
threads.quote: As for Chayka's interpretation... I imagine quite a few fae in Snezhnaya share the same view.

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: a Curatorium treasure hunter who wants to find the bounty target
introduced.quote: Jahoda: Hmm... Seems like only yesterday, there were plenty of bounties going at The Flagship — now there's only one left.

introduced.name: Nefer
introduced.how: a senior Curatorium member who gives Jahoda advice on tracking people
introduced.quote: Nefer: Every contact leaves a trace. No matter how carefully someone covers their tracks, in doing so, they always create new ones.

introduced.name: The Flagship
introduced.how: a bounty hub where bounties are posted
introduced.quote: Seems like only yesterday, there were plenty of bounties going at The Flagship — now there's only one left.

introduced.name: The Flagship Bounty Board
introduced.how: a board listing bounty targets and their details
introduced.quote: Details on the targets are up on the board.

introduced.name: Leszek
introduced.how: the Flagship bounty keeper who holds the details and leads on the targets
introduced.quote: Leszek: Details on the targets are up on the board. I can fill you in if needed, but don't bother haggling over the bounties.

introduced.name: Crackjaw
introduced.how: a wanted bounty target with a scar on his chin, who has gone missing
introduced.quote: Anyway, seems to me the real reason Crackjaw's not been found is the lack of leads.

introduced.name: Hark
introduced.how: Crackjaw's true name, revealed as a criminal in Nasha Town before he fled north
introduced.quote: After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.

introduced.name: Lempo Isle
introduced.how: the island where the target was attacking people and now hides in the north
introduced.quote: The target was attacking people in the north of Lempo Isle, but now he's disappeared without a trace.

introduced.name: Nasha Town
introduced.how: the town where Hark revealed his true nature
introduced.quote: After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.

introduced.name: Snezhnograd
introduced.how: a frozen, icy northern location far from Lempo Isle
introduced.quote: Nothing but ice and snow up there.

introduced.name: Curatorium of Secrets
introduced.how: the group Jahoda and Nefer belong to, which Leszek knows as a bounty-involved party
introduced.quote: Leszek: The Curatorium wants to get involved?

assumed.name: Hidden Exploration Objective
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed the Hidden Exploration Objective The Flagship Bounty Board)

assumed.name: Boss Nef
assumed.quote: Jahoda: You can count on me, Boss Nef!

assumed.name: The Boss
assumed.quote: Jahoda: That depends on how the Boss is feeling.

assumed.name: Hark's revealed true nature
assumed.quote: That's old news. Everyone and their dog knows that.

assumed.name: Jahoda and Leszek's past work together
assumed.quote: We've always worked well together — can't you give me anything to work with?

threads.claim: Crackjaw has vanished on Lempo Isle, and no one knows where he has gone.
threads.quote: No one seems to know where he's gone...

threads.claim: Leszek insists Crackjaw is still on Lempo Isle but refuses to say where.
threads.quote: He's still on Lempo Isle — I just don't know where.

threads.claim: Leszek appears to know more about Crackjaw than he will share, and charges for it.
threads.quote: Now that's a trade secret — you wanna know, you'll have to pay.

threads.claim: Crackjaw may have hidden the scar on his chin, so the scar cannot be relied on to identify him.
threads.quote: Are you saying, he's found some way to hide the scar on his chin?

threads.claim: Crackjaw's true identity as Hark was exposed in Nasha Town, and his past is hinted at.
threads.quote: After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.

threads.claim: Every contact leaves a trace, and careful concealment only creates new ones.
threads.quote: Every contact leaves a trace.

introduced.name: Collective of Plenty
introduced.how: the Traveler's hosts are a tribe called the Collective of Plenty, whose members are forbidden to leave the tribe
introduced.quote: Welcome to the Collective of Plenty!

introduced.name: Duniya
introduced.how: a tribe member who introduces herself and explains the local places
introduced.quote: Well then, outlander guest, I'm Duniya

introduced.name: Dutse
introduced.how: Duniya's companion, a tribe member who is eager to join the Speaker's Chamber's expeditions
introduced.quote: I'm Duniya, and this hapless idiot is Dutse...

introduced.name: Sacred Mountain
introduced.how: a volcano that erupts and pukes out material every day, currently in an eruption cycle and dangerous to enter
introduced.quote: The Sacred Mountain seems to be having some tummy troubles. It pukes stuff out every day.

introduced.name: Kimosi
introduced.how: Dutse's uncle, a former adventurer who was on a Speaker's Chamber exploration team
introduced.quote: Hehe, Kimosi's my uncle, and he used to be an adventurer...

introduced.name: Old Man Mposo
introduced.how: an elderly former Saurian Relics Association member who patrols the ruins daily against raiders
introduced.quote: Old Man Mposo patrols the area daily to keep marauding Treasure Hoarders away...

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: marauding raiders who try to plunder the ruins south of the Sacred Mountain
introduced.quote: Old Man Mposo patrols the area daily to keep marauding Treasure Hoarders away...

introduced.name: Remnants of the Secret Source excavation site
introduced.how: a large area of ruins south of the Sacred Mountain, abandoned by dragons long ago
introduced.quote: Oh, it should really be called the Remnants of the Secret Source excavation site. It's a large area of ruins to the south of the Sacred Mountain.

introduced.name: Tephric Ruins
introduced.how: a section of ruins that the volcano spat out about 500 years ago during the Abyssal corrosion
introduced.quote: Ah, actually, it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

introduced.name: Speaker's Chamber
introduced.how: an organization that sends exploration teams into the Sacred Mountain
introduced.quote: Not to mention, the Speaker's Chamber has organized exploration teams to go inside and poke around...

introduced.name: Saurian
introduced.how: outside saurians are kept from entering the tribe by protective runes
introduced.quote: That's odd, there should be runes that stop outside saurians from entering the tribe...

introduced.name: Tepetlisaurus
introduced.how: the Traveler's little companion, a small creature with a scarf tied to its tail
introduced.quote: Hehe, he's a little cutie, isn't he? That scarf tied to his tail is so pretty.

assumed.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
assumed.quote: As far as we're concerned, it's nowhere near as sacred as the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: I've heard there've been traces of the Abyss discovered around the Tephric Ruins again recently.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Long, long ago... back when Natlan was still a peaceful paradise...

assumed.name: Saurian Relics Association
assumed.quote: He even joined the Saurian Relics Association back in the day.

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Just look at Varesa working in the orchard all day long.

threads.claim: The Sacred Mountain is sick and erupts daily, and its cause is still unexplained.
threads.quote: The Sacred Mountain seems to be having some tummy troubles. It pukes stuff out every day.

threads.claim: Protective runes meant to keep outside saurians out of the tribe seem to be failing, possibly because of the Sacred Mountain.
threads.quote: That's odd, there should be runes that stop outside saurians from entering the tribe... Does this have something to do with the Sacred Mountain being in a bad way?

threads.claim: The Speaker's Chamber has sent exploration teams into the Sacred Mountain, and Kimosi was one of their members.
threads.quote: he was a member of the exploration team assembled by the Speaker's Chamber!

threads.claim: Kimosi's current situation is unknown, and Dutse wants news of him.
threads.quote: I wonder how Uncle Kimosi's doing...

threads.claim: Traces of the Abyss have recently reappeared around the Tephric Ruins.
threads.quote: I've heard there've been traces of the Abyss discovered around the Tephric Ruins again recently.

threads.claim: The Tephric Ruins were spat out by the volcano 500 years ago during the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan.
threads.quote: Ah, actually, it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

threads.claim: The ruins south of the Sacred Mountain were reportedly abandoned by dragons long ago.
threads.quote: It's said that they were abandoned by dragons, long, long ago.

threads.claim: Tribe children are forbidden from leaving the tribe, and the adults keep postponing the chance to free them.
threads.quote: And until then, we follow their rules and don't go outside the tribe until the Sacred Mountain has calmed down, okay?

introduced.name: Tsukishiro
introduced.how: a miner who was attacked by monsters and rescued by the Traveler, and who works odd jobs
introduced.quote: You could say that. I worked as a miner for some time, but ever since my mining team was shut down, I've had to take on odd jobs everywhere.

introduced.name: mining team shutdown
introduced.how: Tsukishiro's mining team was shut down, forcing them to take odd jobs
introduced.quote: ever since my mining team was shut down, I've had to take on odd jobs everywhere.

assumed.name: the current situation
assumed.quote: But given the current situation, even odd jobs are hard to come by.

threads.claim: A wider 'current situation' is making work scarce, hinting at a larger crisis affecting ordinary people.
threads.quote: But given the current situation, even odd jobs are hard to come by.

introduced.name: Yakshas
introduced.how: a group who fought constant wars and lost many of their friends
introduced.quote: From the sounds of it they were at war constantly, and lost so many of their friends

introduced.name: Ruins Tablet
introduced.how: an ancient tablet left behind by one of the Yakshas
introduced.quote: (After reading the Ruins Tablet)

threads.claim: The Yakshas wished to have a happy life in this world, and it is unclear whether they achieved it.
threads.quote: Paimon hopes they're able to achieve their wish of having a happy life in this world

threads.claim: The Yakshas were at war constantly and suffered heavy losses of their friends.
threads.quote: they were at war constantly, and lost so many of their friends

introduced.name: Jahoda
introduced.how: Former thief who now takes commissions and is trying to make amends; she returns stolen goods
introduced.quote: Jahoda: I'm not a thief anymore, and I'm not about to start hanging onto stolen goods either. This pendant should go back to its rightful owner.

introduced.name: Ihanti
introduced.how: Dying former thief and painter who once had a wife and daughter; he posted a bounty for his pendant
introduced.quote: Ihanti: I painted this with my wife and daughter. It's the only thing I still care about in the whole wide world.

introduced.name: Kaleva
introduced.how: Gang thug who robbed the dying Ihanti and refuses to give the goods back
introduced.quote: Kaleva: The junk I snatched from that invalid is lying over there.

introduced.name: Holomov
introduced.how: Snezhnayan whose pendant Ihanti stole; once lived in Nod-Krai
introduced.quote: Ihanti: A Snezhnayan called Holomov. He used to live in Nod-Krai, but he's probably run home to Snezhnaya by now. Don't tell me you're thinking of—

introduced.name: Pendant
introduced.how: Stolen jewelry Ihanti left as collateral for a bounty request, belonging to Holomov
introduced.quote: Katheryne: It was indeed — you certainly have a sharp eye, Miss Jahoda. Mr. Ihanti left it as collateral for a bounty request.

introduced.name: Painting
introduced.how: Painting Ihanti made with his family; he asks for it to be placed in his pocket
introduced.quote: Ihanti: Do me a favor, then — roll up the painting in that bag and slip it into my pocket. I haven't the strength to pick it up myself.

introduced.name: Ragged Doll
introduced.how: Doll Ihanti made himself and gives to Jahoda as a final gift
introduced.quote: Ihanti: Sorry I don't have any treasure to give you. But if you want, you can have this doll.

introduced.name: Scribbled Letter
introduced.how: Letter Ihanti left for Jahoda saying he has departed and that his stuff is hers to return or keep
introduced.quote: By the time you read this letter, I'll already have departed for where I belong. Don't worry, I made peace with it long ago.

introduced.name: The Boss's Code
introduced.how: The Boss's guiding rule, 'Grant rest to those who seek it', which Ihanti asks Jahoda to honor
introduced.quote: Ihanti: Jahoda, you know the boss's code.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild that posts commissions and pays out Mora for completed jobs
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Alright... Here's your payment, Miss Jahoda. The Adventurers' Guild thanks you for your support!

introduced.name: Thieving partnership of Jahoda and Ihanti
introduced.how: Jahoda and Ihanti once worked together as thieves, and Ihanti taught her his skills
introduced.quote: Jahoda: While everyone else was out there pulling dumb scams and petty robberies, he played the game so well that people would end up willingly coughing up the cash.

assumed.name: Ashru
assumed.quote: Jahoda: I mean, it's not like I've got much else to do right now. Can't just sit around playing with Ashru all day, can I?

assumed.name: Curatorium of Secrets (Point of Interest)
assumed.quote: Jahoda: Anyway, I should head back to the Curatorium. If the Boss wants something done and I'm not there, she'll be on my case again for sure.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Mm-hmm, looks like you handled the commission without a hitch. Thank you, Miss Jahoda. Here is your payment.

assumed.name: Starsand Shoal
assumed.quote: (Arrive at the marked location on Starsand Shoal)

threads.claim: Ihanti believes a thief's fate is that everything stolen gets stolen back, leaving them empty-handed.
threads.quote: Ihanti: But maybe that's just the fate of a thief. Everything we steal always gets stolen back, and we wind up empty-handed again eventually.

threads.claim: Jahoda rejects the idea that a thief's fate will claim her.
threads.quote: Jahoda: One thing's for sure — that "fate" of yours isn't gonna get me.

threads.claim: Ihanti's wife and family are gone, and his treasured things could not save his wife or his life.
threads.quote: Ihanti: Hah... and what happened to those things I once treasured above all else? They could save neither my wife, nor my life...

threads.claim: The Boss's code 'Grant rest to those who seek it' governs mercy for the dying, and Jahoda is bound by it.
threads.quote: Ihanti: Jahoda, you know the boss's code.

threads.claim: Jahoda decides to keep to the code and not bring a doctor to Ihanti.
threads.quote: Jahoda: No. I said I'd stick to the code, so that's what I'll do.

threads.claim: The stolen pendant belongs to Holomov, a Snezhnayan who may have gone home to Snezhnaya.
threads.quote: Ihanti: A Snezhnayan called Holomov. He used to live in Nod-Krai, but he's probably run home to Snezhnaya by now. Don't tell me you're thinking of—

threads.claim: Jahoda has left her thieving past behind and refuses to keep stolen goods.
threads.quote: Jahoda: I'm not a thief anymore, and I'm not about to start hanging onto stolen goods either. This pendant should go back to its rightful owner.

threads.claim: Ihanti dies before Jahoda can bring him medicine, and his letter confirms he chose to depart.
threads.quote: By the time you read this letter, I'll already have departed for where I belong. Don't worry, I made peace with it long ago.

introduced.name: Hautemontagne
introduced.how: A technician who goes by the name Mountain and is asked to repair the tea cauldron's mechanisms
introduced.quote: Hautemontagne! But you don't have to use my full name. Just call me Mountain — it basically means the same thing anyway!

introduced.name: Alain Guillotin
introduced.how: A great master and founder of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering who designed a constrained layer dampener
introduced.quote: According to the records, the great master Alain Guillotin himself — founder of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering — also designed a constrained layer dampener to regulate the elemental energy.

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering
introduced.how: An institute founded by Alain Guillotin, whose work relates to the mechanisms
introduced.quote: founder of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering — also designed a constrained layer dampener

introduced.name: Elemental Tuner
introduced.how: The mechanisms called monoliths by locals are functionally known as Three-Phase Asynchronous Elemental Tuners
introduced.quote: Hautemontagne: Elemental Tuner... Elemental Tuner... Ah! That's gotta be it over there!

introduced.name: Tea cauldron
introduced.how: A divine treasure given to Qiaoying Village by a Cloud Retainer from Jueyun Karst, now malfunctioning
introduced.quote: You Know, this tea cauldron is said to be a divine treasure that was given to Qiaoying Village by that Cloud Retainer from Jueyun Karst...

introduced.name: Mountain Ley Lines
introduced.how: Ley Lines wind through the mountains and are controlled with sacred stones to prevent chaotic elemental energy
introduced.quote: Mountain Ley Lines wind all over the place, so you have to control them with sacred stones to prevent chaotic elemental energy...

introduced.name: Elemental Sedimentation
introduced.how: Long-term buildup of sediment that forms elemental creatures and clogs the pot
introduced.quote: The accumulation of Elemental Sedimentation over long years has created these elemental creatures, preventing the pot from operating normally!

introduced.name: Cassigneul
introduced.how: The person in charge of the aquabus project at Lumidouce Harbor who sent Hautemontagne on business
introduced.quote: Hautemontagne: Uh-huh, that's right! But the aquabus project there has been paused temporarily. Ms. Cassigneul... Err, the person in charge, has sent me here on business first.

introduced.name: Lumidouce Harbor
introduced.how: A harbor where an aquabus project was underway and has been paused
introduced.quote: Hautemontagne: Uh-huh, that's right! But the aquabus project there has been paused temporarily.

assumed.name: Uncle Luo
assumed.quote: Paimon: We're back, Uncle Luo!

assumed.name: Grandpa Lu
assumed.quote: Grandpa Lu insisted the problem wasn't with the tea cauldron, but the soil...

assumed.name: Fujin
assumed.quote: Fujin did mention earlier that the reason why the tea doesn't taste so great is because of the soil and water.

assumed.name: An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade
assumed.quote: (If the player has completed An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade)

assumed.name: Adepti
assumed.quote: Those legendary adepti must have been phenomenal artisans!

assumed.name: Little Mao
assumed.quote: Seems like Little Mao was right, after all!

assumed.name: Qinggong
assumed.quote: Traveler: So that's real qinggong in action, eh...

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: What in Teyvat could be the reason...?

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: And pocket a few Mora for entry tickets in exchange...

threads.claim: Alain Guillotin's blueprints are lost, so the tuners' principles are only presumed to match his design.
threads.quote: While his blueprints are long lost, the principle should be the same...

threads.claim: The adepti-made tea cauldron can generate whole new spaces, a feat even Guillotin could not match.
threads.quote: Liyue's adepti mechanisms are truly incredible. They can even generate whole new spaces! Even Master Guillotin himself couldn't do such a thing...

threads.claim: The monoliths may not be directly connected to the Ley Lines, contradicting the local explanation of their function.
