introduced.quote: Long has it been since visitors from afar have come. This place is... too big. Too empty.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Legba: And in the meantime, the Abyss's influence only grew and grew...

assumed.name: Ley Lines
assumed.quote: Legba: Eh, it's no biggie. They gather energy from the Ley Lines over time.

assumed.name: Element
assumed.quote: and they resisted the Abyss with totems, with the Ley Lines, and with the power of the elements.

assumed.name: Natlan
assumed.quote: Legba: So, Paimon, , and the little Tepetlisaurus... A marvelous fate it is, that had you meet here in Natlan.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom is a mysterious realm whose waters and obsidian tablets are said to be strange and forbidden to curious outsiders.
threads.quote: Legba: There, they say, the water flows like alluring light. There, they say, monumental obsidian tablets stand.

threads.claim: Placing the statue on the altar teleports the Traveler and Paimon into the Night Kingdom, where a tablet speaks to them.
threads.quote: Paimon: Huh? Weren't we in the canyon ruins just now? Where is this...?

threads.claim: The obsidian medium was once used by ancestors to communicate with the world of night, and its purpose is only hinted at.
threads.quote: Within, it is said, lies a medium by which our ancestors communed with the world of night...

threads.claim: Returning the statue to the altar connects the Traveler to the Night Kingdom's projection, showing the medium still responds.
threads.quote: (...and sets the Obsidian Statue over the obsidian projection beside the tablet)

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom's nation has been invaded by darkness, and its slain may be swallowed by the tides of the Abyss.
threads.quote: Our nation is invaded once more. If the slain are swallowed by the turbulent tides of darkness

threads.claim: A warning from the Night Kingdom tells the Traveler not to trust the so-called vision of a sacred mountain.
threads.quote: Trust not lightly the so-called vision of the "sacred mountain." Reject... His promise...

threads.claim: A dragon awoke from a volcano long ago and threatened humanity, as legend tells it.
threads.quote: Legend has it that in the days after the dragon with blazing wings awoke from within its volcano

threads.claim: Ley Lines supply energy to the Wayob over time, hinting at a hidden power network.
threads.quote: Eh, it's no biggie. They gather energy from the Ley Lines over time.

introduced.name: Sansa
introduced.how: Self-introduction as an aspiring bard who is nervous performing before crowds
introduced.quote: Uh, h—hi everyone...! I'm Sansa, and I'm a... or, well, I'm working on becoming a bard.

introduced.name: Venti
introduced.how: Shown as a poet-bard who was writing verse outdoors when his leaf was stolen
introduced.quote: So I grabbed a leaf and hastily wrote down a few lines of verse...

introduced.name: Tone-Deaf Bard
introduced.how: Paimon's nickname for a bard with impressive singing and lyre playing, who turns out to be Venti
introduced.quote: The Tone-Deaf Bard always makes it look so easy.

introduced.name: Charcoal
introduced.how: Sansa's neighbor's cat that sits on her windowsill during rehearsals and took the leaf
introduced.quote: Oh, Charcoal, so it was you! I'm sorry, that's my neighbor's cat.

introduced.name: Songbook
introduced.how: A collection of tunes from many parts of the world that Sansa compiled while studying
introduced.quote: It's from back when I was studying — I noted down all kinds of tunes from many parts of the world.

assumed.name: Mondstadt Library
assumed.quote: Whoa, this is denser than the encyclopedias in the Mondstadt Library!

assumed.name: Venti
assumed.quote: Your music has always been a huge inspiration to me, so it would be my honor!

threads.claim: Sansa became a bard after hearing a free bard singing outside her window while her parents made her study.
threads.quote: Back when my parents forced me to stay in my room and study, I'd always hear this bard singing outside the window...

threads.claim: Venti says a bard's voice is like the wind and cannot be tied down, linking bardic art to freedom.
threads.quote: A bard's voice is like the wind — nothing can tie it down, and nothing can stand in its way.

threads.claim: Venti's poem was whisked away by a mischievous wind and then taken by a cat, and he has not finished writing it.
threads.quote: I haven't finished writing it yet!

threads.claim: Venti gets his missing inspiration back after the cat is found.
threads.quote: You got my missing inspiration back, didn't you?

threads.claim: The cat Charcoal was the one who snatched Venti's leaf.
threads.quote: Oh, Charcoal, so it was you!

threads.claim: Sansa gets tongue-tied in front of crowds despite heavy rehearsal, and Venti and the Traveler suggest the problem is inner noise and worrying about others.
threads.quote: But I get so nervous when I'm performing in front of a crowd.

threads.claim: Sansa performs successfully in front of a crowd for the first time after playing with Venti and the Traveler.
threads.quote: That was... that was my first ever successful performance in front of a crowd!

introduced.name: Serpent of All Evils
introduced.how: A high-ranking official under the Belyi Tsar who became a monster of darkness and is sealed in the swamp
introduced.quote: The Serpent of All Evils was said to be a high-ranking official back in the days of the Belyi Tsar

introduced.name: Oskari
introduced.how: Self-introduction: a Ratnik who patrols the swamp with Janusz
introduced.quote: My name is Oskari — I'm a Ratnik.

introduced.name: Janusz
introduced.how: Self-introduction: a Lightkeeper and Oskari's master who was hurt in the swamp
introduced.quote: My name's Janusz, by the way, and you?

introduced.name: Rotwang
introduced.how: A professor whose disciple was the Serpent of All Evils and who rose to power through him
introduced.quote: Things went downhill the moment he became a disciple of Professor Rotwang.

introduced.name: Belyi Tsar
introduced.how: Ruler of Snezhnaya in the past, under whom fae nobility held most power
introduced.quote: Back then, under the Belyi Tsar, most of Snezhnaya's power was still in the hands of the fae nobility.

introduced.name: Snezhnaya
introduced.how: A land whose power was once mostly held by fae nobility
introduced.quote: most of Snezhnaya's power was still in the hands of the fae nobility.

introduced.name: Sealing Pillar
introduced.how: Three stone pillars where the Torchforger and Moonchanter left their strength to seal the monster
introduced.quote: The Torchforger and the Moonchanter left their strength behind in the three stone sealing pillars...

introduced.name: Frostmoon Scions
introduced.how: The Torchforger and Moonchanter of this group sealed the Serpent in the swamp five hundred years ago
introduced.quote: he was sealed here by the combined efforts of the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions.

introduced.name: Lightkeepers
introduced.how: Guardians who regularly check the swamp seal
introduced.quote: Even so, we Lightkeepers still check on it regularly — just in case.

introduced.name: Piramida
introduced.how: The place to travel to in order to request reinforcements
introduced.quote: I'd still like to ask that you first travel to Piramida and request reinforcements

introduced.name: Jelly
introduced.how: Janusz's cat, who left him over ten years ago
introduced.quote: Jelly left me over ten years ago now.

introduced.name: Pact with a demon
introduced.how: The Serpent once made a pact with a demon and was turned into a monster
introduced.quote: a vile individual who once made a pact with a demon and was turned into a monster...

introduced.name: Fall of Rotwang and the Serpent
introduced.how: The Serpent fell with Rotwang and transformed into a monster of pure darkness
introduced.quote: In the end, he fell along with Rotwang and transformed into a monster of pure darkness...

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: let's help the animals by clearing this Abyss contamination

assumed.name: Wild Hunt
assumed.quote: It's the Wild Hunt... Why do bad guys always band together?

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: This looks like a Fatui camp, but there's no sign of life...

assumed.name: Illuga
assumed.quote: To earn Captain Illuga's approval... You two really are extraordinary.

assumed.name: The Last Night, the First Light
assumed.quote: Hey! It's that thing we beat up on Piramida! Hmph, it clearly hasn't learned its lesson!

assumed.name: Spirebloom
assumed.quote: That bright flower must be the Spirebloom Janusz was talking about!

assumed.name: Ratnik
assumed.quote: My name is Oskari — I'm a Ratnik.

threads.claim: The Serpent of All Evils is accused of three great sins, revealed piece by piece through pillar inscriptions.
threads.quote: This is the second of his three great sins.

threads.claim: The inscriptions describe the Serpent's crimes, including using family bonds as coercion in political ploys.
threads.quote: Making other people's closest relatives pawns in political ploys...

threads.claim: How the Serpent came to the swamp and was sealed there remains an unanswered question.
threads.quote: I've spent no small time investigating those very questions — but I've never found a definitive answer.

threads.claim: Oskari guesses the Serpent came to the swamp after Rotwang fell from power, but has no confirmed record.
threads.quote: My guess is that he came here after Rotwang fell from power...

threads.claim: Rotwang's rise to power depended on the Serpent's ruthless service.
threads.quote: Rotwang's rise to power would have been impossible without him.

threads.claim: The Serpent blames Rotwang and his own master for turning him into a monster.
threads.quote: You set my enemies before me, gave me the blade... and turned me into this twisted monster...

threads.claim: The sealed sinner is said to have made a pact with a demon.
threads.quote: a vile individual who once made a pact with a demon and was turned into a monster...

threads.claim: Someone may be responsible for weakening the seal, and Oskari suspects the Fatui.
threads.quote: I wouldn't be at all surprised if they were somehow involved!

threads.claim: Janusz plans to investigate further and file an official protest with the Fatui.
threads.quote: Once we've gathered sufficient evidence, we can file an official protest with the Fatui.

threads.claim: The swamp seal has weakened and needs watching, after holding for five hundred years.
threads.quote: The seal on the swamp has already weakened — someone must keep watch over it.

threads.claim: With the Serpent defeated, the five-hundred-year gloom over the swamp is lifted.
threads.quote: The gloom that's hung over this place for five hundred years has been lifted...

threads.claim: The Spirebloom at the battle center revitalizes the Serpent when prisms converge on it.
threads.quote: Three glowing prisms converge on the Spirebloom at the center of the battlefield, revitalizing it

introduced.name: Mualani
introduced.how: introduced by Chasca as a guide known as "Umoja" Mualani, one of the heroes, who is out to test the attractions
introduced.quote: Chasca: Ah, that's because you've never met her before. This is "Umoja" Mualani.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: explained as a type of energy that a small spark can ignite into a fire
introduced.quote: Bennett: Phlogiston? Oh... That's a type of energy, isn't it?

introduced.name: Wavey Bay
introduced.how: a resort with several attractions, a main challenge, and saurian staff that is still under testing
introduced.quote: Chasca: I noticed you don't have a lot of staff working on the other attractions in Wavey Bay, and the saurian employees seem pretty tired out.

introduced.name: Tuksina
introduced.how: a Wavey Bay staff member who explains that the main challenge has hit a problem
introduced.quote: Tuksina: Oh, hello! I'm guessing you're here to take on the main challenge at Wavey Bay? Unfortunately, we've run into a bit of a problem...

introduced.name: Chasca
introduced.how: a companion who is tactful, observant and helpful, and is described as a Peacemaker
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wow, what a tactful negotiator! Guess that's the hidden power of a Peacemaker...

introduced.name: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
introduced.how: a quest to test the Twilight Cruise attraction, which is marked Under Testing
introduced.quote: (Starts Quest Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!)

introduced.name: Rainbow Beams
introduced.how: a paintball shooting challenge where the player colors balls on tracks until they vanish
introduced.quote: Chasca: Use paintballs to color the balls lined up on the tracks.

introduced.name: Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide
introduced.how: a slide whose paint job is faulty and must be sprayed from the Spiritway, so it was shut down during testing
introduced.quote: Tuksina: During testing, we realized that the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide's current paint job still leaves a LOT to be desired.

introduced.how: an unknown figure watching the group from around a corner after the photo
introduced.quote: (The camera moves to show the group being observed by someone unknown from around a corner)

assumed.name: Koholasaur
assumed.quote: Mualani: Sunshine, waves, and koholasaurs!

assumed.name: Saurian
assumed.quote: Tuksina: Well, your observations were right, down to the detail about our saurians... I'm sorry, I shouldn't have tried to hide anything from you all.

assumed.name: Heroes of Natlan
assumed.quote: Tuksina: You mean... one of the six heroes? THAT Mualani!?

threads.claim: A map gives people the freedom to carve their own path of adventure.
threads.quote: Mualani: With a map to guide your way, you're free to carve out your very own path of adventure!

threads.claim: Mualani may be hiding something about why she splits the group up.
threads.quote: Paimon: Whoa, whoa, hold your horses, folks... Why does Paimon feel like Mualani's hiding something?

threads.claim: Wavey Bay staff admit they tried to hide the attraction problem from the group.
threads.quote: Tuksina: Well, your observations were right, down to the detail about our saurians... I'm sorry, I shouldn't have tried to hide anything from you all.

threads.claim: Wavey Bay's main attractions are under testing and have run into issues that the group must investigate.
threads.quote: Mualani: Here, just take a look. These two major attractions have been marked "Under Testing." My guess is that they've run into some issues.

threads.claim: The Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide's paint job is the problem that shut down the main challenge.
threads.quote: Tuksina: During testing, we realized that the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide's current paint job still leaves a LOT to be desired.

threads.claim: Mualani is one of the six heroes, a status that surprises the Wavey Bay staff.
threads.quote: Tuksina: You mean... one of the six heroes? THAT Mualani!?

threads.claim: Mualani's past accomplishments are praised as heroic and widely known.
threads.quote: Bennett: Paimon told me all about you while you were out there. Everything you managed to accomplish is so amazing!

threads.claim: An unknown figure is secretly watching the group at the end of the unit.
threads.quote: (The camera moves to show the group being observed by someone unknown from around a corner)

threads.claim: Chasca may have been secretly watching the group from above, and her knowledge of the staff is suspicious.
threads.quote: Mualani: Wait, Chasca... How did you notice all that? You weren't spying on us from up in some treetop somewhere, were you?

introduced.name: Orqo
introduced.how: A child who gives a codename and asks the Traveler for help finding star shards
introduced.quote: The name I use now is nothing but a code name, that's all... But everyone calls me Orqo, so you might as well too.

introduced.name: Star shards
introduced.how: Fragments split off from fallen stars that restore lost power when returned to their star
introduced.quote: They're shards split off from stars that fell from the sky! As long as you find them and return them to their original spot, you can regain the power that was lost.

introduced.name: Mama Coco
introduced.how: A neighbor who helps look after Orqo and comes to take him home
introduced.quote: I try to help out as a neighbor, but I haven't got unlimited energy either.

introduced.name: Fallen star
introduced.how: A large rock below that is described as a star fallen from the sky
introduced.quote: That's a star, fallen from the sky!

introduced.name: Hidden powers
introduced.how: Latent abilities that can be awakened, which Orqo claims to be waiting on
introduced.quote: My hidden powers haven't been awakened yet, you know, I'm just a helpless little child.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: and you can have every last Mora.

assumed.name: Saurian
assumed.quote: and I don't have my own Saurian either

threads.claim: Orqo says hidden powers are waiting to be awakened, and the Traveler is unusually sure something is happening.
threads.quote: My hidden powers haven't been awakened yet, you know, I'm just a helpless little child.

threads.claim: A man who recited the same incantation reportedly suffered pain and gained a magic eye, supporting the idea that awakening is real.
threads.quote: And the person who told me closed their eyes and started moaning in pain soon after they recited it!

threads.claim: Mama Coco dismisses the shard-and-power story as childish fantasy, leaving the claim unproven.
threads.quote: Those are just childish fantasies he was talking about.

threads.claim: The Traveler feels a mysterious power surging at the fallen star, while Paimon feels nothing from it.
threads.quote: Traveler: Aaaah! A mysterious power is surging through my body!

threads.claim: Orqo's mother is absent and his father has poor eyesight, hinting at a neglected home life.
threads.quote: After all, his mother isn't around and his father's eyesight is poor.

threads.claim: The Traveler rejects the idea of seeking more power, saying they are strong enough already.
threads.quote: I'm strong enough as-is. I don't need it.

threads.claim: Orqo offers to tell the story of Qoyllor and Ukuku, which is presented as a tale the player has not heard.
threads.quote: You've never even heard the story of Qoyllor and Ukuku?

assumed.name: hilichurls
assumed.quote: Look! It's the hilichurls, and there are Sumpter Beasts with them!

assumed.name: Sumpter Beasts
assumed.quote: Look! It's the hilichurls, and there are Sumpter Beasts with them!

threads.claim: The hilichurls are transporting a large food supply that could be used against the villagers.
threads.quote: Are they going to transport all that food?

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: greets the Traveler at the Adventurers' Guild and explains how commissions work
introduced.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, and to Natlan.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: a guild where registered adventurers can accept commissions
introduced.quote: Once you've registered, you'll be able to accept commissions here.

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: a land of challenge and opportunity with powerful foes and unexplored ruins
introduced.quote: Natlan is a land full of challenge and opportunity, filled with powerful foes and unexplored ruins.

introduced.name: commissions
introduced.how: tasks that can be accepted at the guild once the Traveler has registered
introduced.quote: Once you've registered, you'll be able to accept commissions here.

assumed.name: Ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, and to Natlan.

threads.claim: The guild's motto of reaching the stars and conquering the abyss is set up as a recurring theme.
threads.quote: Forge onward, to reach the stars and conquer the abyss!

threads.claim: Natlan is described as having unexplored ruins, raising an open question about what they hold.
threads.quote: Natlan is a land full of challenge and opportunity, filled with powerful foes and unexplored ruins.

introduced.name: Tochtli
introduced.how: cafe owner and Zolin's older sister who calls him Lil' Floaty
introduced.quote: Tochtli: It's my cafe!

introduced.name: Cozatl
introduced.how: Zolin's childhood friend who hired the Traveler and Paimon as assistants and is also the scary-looking guard
introduced.quote: Cozatl: Indeed. His name's Cozatl, I think.

introduced.name: Zolin
introduced.how: young Chromaflair designer, nicknamed Lil' Floaty, and Cozatl's childhood friend
introduced.quote: Cozatl: Great, it's settled then. I'll give Zolin — that's the guy — a heads-up.

introduced.name: Zolton
introduced.how: Zolin's Asha companion, a creature that sprays paint when it feels strong emotion
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hehe, so the little one's name is Zolton? What a cute name! Nice to meet you, Zolton!

introduced.name: Alu
introduced.how: old teacher who founded the Chromaflair style and is now dead
introduced.quote: Cozatl: He's always loved drawing and painting, and he's actually picked up some real skills. Says he's carrying on the legacy of our old teacher, Alu.

introduced.name: Alvo
introduced.how: rival designer from The Varikas who came to the bid to challenge Chromaflair
introduced.quote: Alvo: What a coincidence! We at "The Varikas" also have insights of our own when it comes to color.

introduced.name: Chromaflair
introduced.how: a famous color style and school in Natlan known for color and texture
introduced.quote: Cozatl: In the past, "Chromaflair" was famous in Natlan for its amazing use of color and texture.

introduced.name: The Varikas
introduced.how: rival design group that competes with Chromaflair and is willing to use force
introduced.quote: Alvo: Well, see, even if "The Varikas" were to take something by force, we would do so openly.

introduced.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
introduced.how: resort that is hiring designers for a facade bidding competition
introduced.quote: Cozatl: It just so happens that the Easybreeze Holiday Resort needs someone to help with their facade design

introduced.name: Natlan
introduced.how: the land where the story takes place, known for its graffiti-friendly walls and free-spirited people
introduced.quote: This is Natlan — what kind of wall doesn't have a little graffiti on it?

introduced.name: Masters of the Night-Wind
introduced.how: an order whose priests once included Alu
introduced.quote: He was an old man, a priest from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: merchants from Nod-Krai who are seen as ambitious and willing to play dirty
introduced.quote: Cozatl: Because of people like those merchants from Nod-Krai. They've got ambition, power... and zero hesitation when it comes to playing dirty.

introduced.name: Free Spirits
introduced.how: an adventure team that came to Natlan about ten years ago, including Cozatl, Zolin and Alu
introduced.quote: Cozatl: Well... It's a long story. About ten years ago, an adventure team called "Free Spirits" came to this land.

introduced.name: Phlogiston
introduced.how: a volatile life-energy substance that the pigments contain and that Asha are made of
introduced.quote: Which revealed that these pigments contain extraordinarily pure, volatile Phlogiston. Almost as though they're alive...

introduced.name: Asha
introduced.how: small Phlogiston-based creatures whose emotions show up as the colors they produce
introduced.quote: Speaking of this lil' thing, those two brats seemed to call it an "Asha." From where I'm sitting, it's like a small animal that has very simple yet straightforward emotions.

introduced.name: Chroma
introduced.how: a painting style that combines power and shimmer, named after Alu's color approach
introduced.quote: That clash of power and shimmer is where "Chroma" comes from.

introduced.name: Alu's death
introduced.how: Alu died without naming a successor, leaving only sketches and a few pieces
introduced.quote: Cozatl: In the end, the old man passed without naming a successor. All that's left of him are some old sketches and a few of his pieces.

introduced.name: Alu's resting cave
introduced.how: a hidden cave that is Alu's grave, which Tochtli guards
introduced.quote: Tochtli: Back off! This is the old man's resting place, and you are not welcome here!

introduced.name: Yellowed Records
introduced.how: Alu's old diary of notes left in the cave
introduced.quote: This is a diary, a journal used to organize my thoughts.

introduced.name: Cartographer
introduced.how: Alu's nickname for Zolin, given because Zolin was once thought to have no talent with color
introduced.quote: the so-called "Cartographer."

assumed.name: Flowcurrent Bird
assumed.quote: Bit of an airhead — always drifting around like a Flowcurrent Bird.

assumed.name: Tatankasaur
assumed.quote: Y'know, like the one time that little Tatankasaur headbutted you into a bunch of paint buckets

assumed.name: Kamera
assumed.quote: Traveler: Female Customer: Um... Just give me something that looks good on kamera.

assumed.name: Saurian Inscriptions
assumed.quote: He was originally trying to uncover some link between Saurian Inscriptions and Asha.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! That sounds like a reward fit for our Mora pouches!

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: unknown to all of Teyvat...

threads.claim: Asha colors appear to express the emotions of the creature, with anger and anxiety giving red, sadness blue, and happiness yellow.
threads.quote: In essence, whatever emotion it's feeling determines the color it creates in its body.

threads.claim: Zolin and Alu have never used purple, and the reason for its absence is unclear.
threads.quote: Oh, but there's more. Zolin's colors have never gone beyond the old man's palette. They both never used purple.

threads.claim: Zolin finally produces purple paint after the truth about Alu and Zolton is revealed.
threads.quote: Tochtli: Whoa, it's really purple! Amazing, Lil' Floaty! You've achieved what even the old man never could!

threads.claim: Zolton has stayed with Zolin and Alu for years, hinting at an unexplained origin for its abilities.
threads.quote: And the Asha with them? It's been the same one all these years.

threads.claim: The Traveler proposes that Alu created Zolton and that Zolton absorbed Alu's memories and emotions.
threads.quote: Traveler: Alu created Zolton with their arts, and Zolton absorbed Alu's memories and emotions. That must be where its wide range of colors came from!

threads.claim: Alu has lost most of his memory of his priesthood and is unsure whether he was once a famous priest.
threads.quote: Ah, right, I remember them telling me I was some sort of famous priest in my youth... Was I...?

threads.claim: Alu's archaic thaumaturgy experiment asks whether Phlogiston-based life can transmit memory.
threads.quote: This is an attempt at archaic thaumaturgy and an experiment on whether Phlogiston-based life can transmit memory.

threads.claim: Color is described as a language of intense emotion and an extension and transmission of memory.
threads.quote: Color is the art of collision and contrast — a language of intense emotion, an extension and transmission of memory.

threads.claim: Zolin and Cozatl knew where Alu's grave was, and Tochtli was never told where it was.
threads.quote: Tochtli: And there's you... The old man had such high hopes for you. Then you disappeared for years, and never even told me where his grave was.

threads.claim: Alvo accuses Chromaflair of stealing an Asha's artistic work, a claim the Traveler publicly doubts.
threads.quote: Alvo: Face it, everyone! The "Chromaflair" was never about human artistry. Just two generations of con artists taking credit for an Asha's natural talents!

threads.claim: Chroma is said to derive from the clash of power and shimmer in Alu's color style, leaving its true origin open.
threads.quote: That clash of power and shimmer is where "Chroma" comes from.

threads.claim: Tochtli concludes that the Chromaflair style was created by Alu and Zolton together.
threads.quote: Tochtli: So in essence, the "Chromaflair" style was created by the old man and Zolton.

introduced.name: Azhdaha
introduced.how: a mighty dragon-lord of old who was defeated, with his land of beauty now lost
introduced.quote: Though defeated is mighty Azhdaha of old, there's no restoring this past land of beauty.

introduced.name: Tianqiu Valley
introduced.how: the valley where an adepti's ancient trail grows cold and ruins now stand
introduced.quote: At Tianqiu Valley the adepti's ancient trail grows cold, I fall down and weep at the ruins I see.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group of treasure seekers who work for a leader called Boss and investigate ruins for her
introduced.quote: It's not like I have Boss to help either... she sent me to investigate this on my own. But it's going to take me forever!

introduced.name: Boss
introduced.how: the treasure hoarders' leader, a woman seeking something hidden in the ruin
introduced.quote: Boss says if we defeat every single monster, she'll finally get what she's seeking...

assumed.name: adepti
assumed.quote: At Tianqiu Valley the adepti's ancient trail grows cold, I fall down and weep at the ruins I see.

threads.claim: The tablet says the mighty Azhdaha was defeated and the land of beauty around him cannot be restored.
threads.quote: Though defeated is mighty Azhdaha of old, there's no restoring this past land of beauty.

threads.claim: A hoarder who escaped the ruin warned of a dragon-lord, linking the tablet's Azhdaha to the danger inside.
threads.quote: The guy who was in there the longest told us to run away as fast as we could, saying something about a dragon-lord... What was he on about?

threads.claim: It is unclear whether the Tianqiu site is a ruin, an adepti's trail, or both.

threads.claim: Hoarders who left the ruin act strangely and some sense an unseen presence watching them.

threads.quote: The thing Boss wanted us to find should be at the top, but how do we get up there?

threads.claim: Boss lured wealthy outsiders with clues as bait, and the hoarders planned to take their treasure.
threads.quote: Hahaha! Just like boss said, leave a few clues outside the door and rich idiots will come flocking in.

introduced.name: Yasumoto
introduced.how: a countryside doctor on Yashiori Island who claims to be harmless and asks for help

introduced.quote: This was one of the key places where the crystal used in making Inazuman Jade Steel was produced.

assumed.name: Shogunate

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: Maybe the trace of the smell can be tracked with the elemental sight.

assumed.name: Wind glider
assumed.quote: Outlander, I see you've brought a wind glider with you.

threads.quote: So far, there is no sign that the Tatarigami will disappear, and the Tenryou Commission is not going to withdraw any time soon.

threads.claim: The Serpent's remains were sealed by wards that Sangonomiya destroyed, unleashing the Tatarigami.
threads.quote: Then, Sangonomiya's people destroyed the wards which suppressed the Serpent's remains.

threads.claim: An unexplained explosion in Tatarasuna stained the sky with strange colors, hinting at a deeper cause.
threads.quote: The sky was stained with strange colors that night...

threads.claim: The Tatarigami spreads strange diseases, and the sick cannot be cured by ordinary means.
threads.quote: The strange diseases brought by the Tatarigami are also spreading.

threads.claim: The Tenryou Commissioner's son tried to recruit Yasumoto, hinting at political pressure on the doctor.
threads.quote: That son of the Tenryou Commissioner has invited me before... he should still be in the army overseeing the battle.

threads.claim: Yasumoto suspects the Traveler is an outlander, raising questions about where the Traveler comes from.
threads.quote: Are you... an outlander? What are you doing here?

threads.claim: Yashiori Island's crystal supply for Jade Steel is running out, which threatens the islanders' livelihood.
threads.quote: As long as the crystal didn't run out, we could live comfortably without being constrained by the city folk.

threads.claim: Yasumoto's basket has gone untouched, suggesting the doctor may have stopped coming or come to harm.
threads.quote: The herbs in the bamboo basket have not been touched. It looks like the owner hasn't been here for a while.

threads.quote: I've placed the records deep within the site, and the way can only be opened by activating an elemental monument.

threads.claim: Enhanced Bathysmal Vishaps will multiply and threaten the area once released.
threads.quote: In a few years, this place will be swarming with powerful Bathysmal Vishaps.

threads.claim: The researchers acknowledge past wrongdoings that cannot be erased and may be judged by a later generation.

threads.quote: convince the Erebos and Sangonomiya Factions to cease their squabbling

threads.claim: Madame Mage's ink bottle holds a mysterious substance called fantasy truth that her magic depends on.
threads.quote: She has a very mysterious ink bottle that contains "fantasy truth."

threads.quote: Are we even in the library anymore?

threads.claim: The room can only be entered by those who are invited, and it was created by magic.
threads.quote: This is a special room, one that can only be accessed by those who are invited!

threads.claim: Madame Mage has astrologically skilled friends who send gifts to the room's guests.
threads.quote: certain astrologically-adept friend of Madame Mage has prepared you a gift!

introduced.name: Millelith
introduced.how: a Liyue law-enforcement squad that Yanbo leads and that confiscates contraband
introduced.quote: Millelith Squad Leader Yanbo of The Chasm District, at your service. It's an honor to meet you, Traveler.

introduced.name: Yanbo
introduced.how: Millelith squad leader who introduces himself and explains the mix-up
introduced.quote: Millelith Squad Leader Yanbo of The Chasm District, at your service.

introduced.quote: Although we foiled the Fatui's plots before, they maintain some strength out here in the wilds... Their professionalism and combat prowess are not to be underestimated.

introduced.quote: Brass Bull Zhao: Who are you!? This is no place for outsiders! Flower, gather the lads and get them!

introduced.quote: Chen the Flower: Got it, Big Sis!

introduced.quote: This is where one of the Bedrock Keys that hold up the Seven-Star Array is located.

introduced.quote: This is where one of the Bedrock Keys that hold up the Seven-Star Array is located.

introduced.name: Vision

introduced.quote: That's why I don't really rue the fact that I don't have a Vision.

introduced.name: Cup of Commons
introduced.how: a plain stone cup found hidden in a treasure chest

assumed.name: Liyue

assumed.name: Mora

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: We'll have to count on our brothers in Mondstadt to deliver once again...

assumed.name: adepti

threads.claim: The Treasure Hoarders may be former miners and workers who had fallen on hard times.

threads.claim: The Cup of Commons is an ordinary-looking cup whose reason for being hidden in a Treasure Hoarder chest is unknown.

assumed.name: Institute of Natural Philosophy
assumed.quote: I am equipped with the most advanced optics from the Fontaine Institute of Natural Philosophy.

assumed.name: Narzissenkreuz Kingdom and Adventure Team
assumed.quote: So if we go with 's logic, the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom and Adventure Team might have their stories' origin in the Institute and the Ordo, right?

assumed.name: Elynas
assumed.quote: Elynas...

threads.claim: Who Mary-Ann really was remains an open question, and Ann feels her name is familiar.
threads.quote: In that case, who was "Mary-Ann," really?

threads.claim: Seymour searches for a different Mary-Ann, so there may be two women with the same name.
threads.quote: Paimon: Agh! No wonder that name felt familiar! The person Seymour mentioned and is looking for also goes by that name!

threads.claim: Ann was dreamed into being by Mary-Ann, and her memories may belong to the main body.
threads.quote: Your knowledge and experience cannot exceed that of the main body.

threads.claim: Ann's memories of the Ordo are blocked by pain and fear, hinting at a hidden past.
threads.quote: But I cannot recall why — it's like some part of my body has been frozen.

threads.claim: Ann glimpses the world plunged into darkness, but it is unclear whether this is past or future.
threads.quote: The world fell into utter darkness — never again would the cool spring water flow.

threads.claim: The Doomsday Clock is said to signal the apocalypse when it strikes midnight.
threads.quote: When the clock strikes midnight, the apocalypse will come.

threads.claim: Caterpillar says the clock is only a device and cannot answer whether the apocalypse will come.
threads.quote: What we're seeing is a doomsday clock, not doomsday itself.

threads.claim: Lyris existed as a real Oceanid, but her fate is unknown and Caterpillar has only a hunch.
threads.quote: I don't know, though I do have a hunch.

threads.claim: The Narzissenkreuz Kingdom and Adventure Team stories may originate in the Institute and the Ordo.
threads.quote: That is... possible.

threads.claim: The Ordo changed and grew colder, and the events of its decline remain painful for Ann to recall.
threads.quote: But later, they changed. Some things stopped being the same, and the people here changed, too.

threads.claim: Caterpillar's memory is fading, and they may have met Ann before.
threads.quote: My memory is fading, so that is quite possible.

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Hey! It's the Fatui and the Eremites.

assumed.name: Eremites
assumed.quote: Hey! It's the Fatui and the Eremites.

threads.claim: The Fatui and the Eremites appear to be secretly dealing with each other, and the player is drawn in to find out and stop it.
threads.quote: Ohh, they must be doing some under-the-table deal! Let's stop them!

introduced.name: Ararycan
introduced.how: An Aranara guardian of the forest of Vana who is ill from the bad stuff and needs help
introduced.quote: Paimon: How are you, Ararycan? We're here to see you!

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus
introduced.how: A Kshahrewar genius who researched the Ruin Golem
introduced.quote: Paimon: That's right, Jazari said Pir Kavikavus is a genius of Kshahrewar and delved into the Ruin Golem.

introduced.name: Jazari
introduced.how: A Kshahrewar researcher eager for academic fame who studies the Ruin Golem
introduced.quote: Jazari: Do I even need to say it? I am a Kshahrewar researcher who aspires to receive the Pir Kavikavus Prize

introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.how: Forest beings who understand only literal meanings and do not grasp human concepts of time
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, that's right. Aranara doesn't really understand our concept of time. How can we explain it to Ararycan?

introduced.name: Abyss Mages
introduced.how: Enemies who want to make Vana sick and keep coming back to the forest
introduced.quote: Ararycan: Baddies who want to make Vana sick! Make them go!

introduced.name: Devantaka Mountain
introduced.how: A mountain where Jazari is researching the Ruin Golem
introduced.quote: Paimon: Mr. Jazari is probably still on Devantaka Mountain researching.

introduced.name: Vamadha's labyrinth
introduced.how: A labyrinth that only someone accompanied by Aranara can get through to the end
introduced.quote: Ararycan: If you are not with Aranara, no way you could find the end. Nara , let's go to the end.

introduced.name: Pir Kavikavus's accident
introduced.how: Pir Kavikavus was injured on an expedition and his key findings were lost
introduced.quote: Paimon: But he also said Pir Kavikavus got into an accident on an expedition and all his key findings were lost.

assumed.name: Ruin Golem
assumed.quote: Paimon: But he wasn't making headway until we finally got into the Ruin Golem with him last time.

assumed.name: Aramuhukunda
assumed.quote: Ararycan: No mushroom is that powerful. Even the Lord of Dendro and Aramuhukunda can't do that. Neither can Varuna Contraption, who got sick twice from the bad stuff.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Traveler: If we get the Akademiya to help...

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Jazari, optional)

assumed.name: Kshahrewar
assumed.quote: Jazari: Most importantly, there hasn't been an academic breakthrough like this in many years, not since Kshahrewar was devastated by Pir Kavikavus's accident...

threads.claim: Pir Kavikavus could perceive Aranara, which hints that only some people can see them.
threads.quote: Paimon: Pir Kavikavus could see Aranara? And they traveled together?

threads.claim: Jazari could not perceive Ararycan at all, contrasting with Pir Kavikavus.
threads.quote: Paimon: In contrast, Jazari couldn't even see Ararycan, and looked at Paimon with pity!

threads.claim: Pir Kavikavus's accident on an expedition cost him his key findings.
threads.quote: Paimon: But he also said Pir Kavikavus got into an accident on an expedition and all his key findings were lost.

threads.claim: The accident devastated Kshahrewar's academic progress for years.
threads.quote: Jazari: Most importantly, there hasn't been an academic breakthrough like this in many years, not since Kshahrewar was devastated by Pir Kavikavus's accident...

threads.claim: Pir Kavikavus's long-lost research is recovered and its theory is tested successfully.
threads.quote: Jazari: Not only have records of Pir Kavikavus's long-lost research been recovered, but now I'm testing his theory, and it was a success. No matter how you put it, it's...

threads.claim: Aralohita is missing and left riddles and traps behind as clues.
threads.quote: Ararycan: Aralohita likes riddles and traps, but he can't be found now...

threads.claim: The riddle is answered by the order in which Nara met the three creatures, opening the labyrinth.
threads.quote: Ararycan: The order. Not how Aralohita met them, but how Nara met them.

threads.claim: The party wonders whether a surefire, permanent solution to the forest's illness exists.
threads.quote: Paimon: If only there's a surefire solution...

threads.claim: The sealing may stop the current crisis but is not a permanent cure.
threads.quote: Paimon: Great! This just might solve our problem, Ararycan! It may not be a permanent cure, but at least that takes care of the current crisis.

threads.claim: Bad guys keep returning to make Vana sick, threatening the forest again.
threads.quote: Ararycan: Paimon guessed it. The bad guys that wish to make Vana sick came back. Ararycan couldn't fight them off alone...

threads.claim: The sealing of the sickness-causing things makes the forest safe for now.
threads.quote: Ararycan: Bad guys gone, and the things that make Vana sick sealed now. All safe now.

introduced.name: Earnshaw
introduced.how: Elderly man who owns the garden house and asks the Traveler and Paimon to retrieve his dogs
introduced.quote: Earnshaw: Alright then, good children, call me Earnshaw. I would be most grateful for your help.

introduced.name: Hero
introduced.how: One of Earnshaw's dogs, an old, playful, food-seeking dog that runs off to the north
introduced.quote: Earnshaw: My daughter named them. If it was not for her raising hue and cry, I would not have raised such delicate creatures.

introduced.name: Prince and Princess
introduced.how: Earnshaw's other two dogs, who are hiding in the flower garden
introduced.quote: Earnshaw: The other two haven't gone far. They're just mucking about in the flower garden. Just tell them to get back here, and that should do.

introduced.name: Earnshaw's daughter
introduced.how: Earnshaw's daughter, who left home several years ago, sends letters Earnshaw never opens, and has not returned
introduced.quote: That silly daughter of mine left home several years ago and hasn't returned.

introduced.name: Lanoire
introduced.how: Earnshaw's granddaughter who now lives with him and is Caterpillar's friend
introduced.quote: Lanoire: Grandpa's Tasses Ragout is so tasty! He's teaching me how to make it, but it'll take awhile before I've got it down...

assumed.name: Caterpillar
assumed.quote: Lanoire: Don't be silly, ! This isn't my new home, it's my old home. Isn't that what Cater said?

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Paimon: Why don't we go with you? It'll be just like when we went on adventures in the Fortress.

assumed.name: Wolsey
assumed.quote: Lanoire: What do you think? Isn't Grandpa's cooking even better than Wolsey's?

assumed.name: Fonta
assumed.quote: or else Grandpa really won't let me drink Fonta!

assumed.name: Guild
assumed.quote: Earnshaw: As for your payment for the official commission, I will give it to you later — I believe the Guild's rules indicate as much.

threads.claim: Earnshaw's daughter left home years ago and has sent letters that Earnshaw refuses to open, leaving her return unresolved.
threads.quote: As such, I haven't read a single one of her letters.

threads.claim: Lanoire and Caterpillar promised to exchange stories at their next meeting, and Lanoire worries he has forgotten her.
threads.quote: Lanoire: Do you think he's already forgotten about me, Ms. Paimon...?

threads.claim: Earnshaw insists that rules must be strictly enforced, and that unruly behavior must be corrected early.
threads.quote: No, no, rules must remain rules. If we let them off once, they will do this a second and third time.

introduced.name: Nod-Krai
introduced.how: a land full of opportunities that the Traveler is welcomed to
introduced.quote: Nevertheless, welcome to Nod-Krai, a land full of opportunities.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: a welcoming figure who offers to check adventurers' daily commissions
introduced.quote: Welcome, adventurer! Would you like me to check today's commissions for you?

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Thank goodness it's you, Katheryne.

assumed.name: commissions
assumed.quote: Welcome, adventurer! Would you like me to check today's commissions for you?

assumed.name: ad astra abyssosque
assumed.quote: Good luck, adventurers! Happy adventuring, and ad astra abyssosque!

threads.claim: Nod-Krai is presented as a place where adventurers will discover treasures beyond their wildest dreams.
threads.quote: I'm sure you'll embark on grand adventures here and discover treasures beyond your wildest dreams.

threads.claim: The Traveler's unfinished remark about why they came hints at a reason for the visit that is not yet stated.
threads.quote: We're just...

introduced.name: Blanche
introduced.how: Introduced as a young girl searching for her missing brother, who is a Treasure Hoarder-linked figure
introduced.quote: Blanche: Th—Thank you... I am Blanche. You two must be great adventurers, then?

introduced.name: Trendy Zaytun Peach
introduced.how: A flamboyant Fruity Order operative who claims to be one of the Five Great Operatives and follows the New Tide
introduced.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": And I'm one of the Five Great Operatives of the Fruity Order. Do I look like a child to you?

introduced.name: Guileless Wolfhook
introduced.how: A calm Order member who insists the majority rule and joins the vote with the New Tide faction
introduced.quote: "Guileless Wolfhook": It's precisely because we were friends that he could betray us, Blanche. This is how the world works.

introduced.name: Tricky Bulle Fruit
introduced.how: Blanche's brother, an Order operative who betrayed his group by taking the Pure Water formula
introduced.quote: Blanche: I—It's "Tricky Bulle Fruit." He's also one of the Fruity Order's operatives.

introduced.name: Ruthless Calla Lily
introduced.how: An assassin sent by the boss to kill Bulle Fruit, described as the scariest of the Five Great Operatives
introduced.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": Oh yes, very mad indeed! So mad, in fact, that he's dispatched a very formidable woman named Ruthless Calla Lily.

introduced.name: Cabin of Intense Purity
introduced.how: A talking cabin that claims to be an apostle of the World of Intense Purity and asks for Pure Pinecones
introduced.quote: ???: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm an apostle of the World of Intense Purity.

introduced.name: Crucible of Intense Purity
introduced.how: A talking wine barrel-like apostle that accepts the Pure Pinecones and gives the medicine key
introduced.quote: ???: I'm not a wine barrel. I'm the Crucible of Intense Purity.

introduced.name: New Tide
introduced.how: A doctrine held by Zaytun Peach that the world is decaying and new worlds are being born
introduced.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": The Ley Lines have contaminated everyone, and so the New Tide shall be born; the darkness has contaminated everyone, and so a world of light shall be born. That's how things are.

introduced.name: Five Great Operatives
introduced.how: The top five operatives of the Fruity Order
introduced.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": And I'm one of the Five Great Operatives of the Fruity Order. Do I look like a child to you?

introduced.name: Fruity Order
introduced.how: The organization that Bulle Fruit and the others belong to
introduced.quote: Blanche: I—It's "Tricky Bulle Fruit." He's also one of the Fruity Order's operatives.

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarder
introduced.how: A profession of scavengers who are said to restore balance to wealth, not an honest job
introduced.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": This is also why Treasure Hoarders are born when there is an imbalance in wealth. Treasure Hoarders exist to bring balance back to wealth!

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: The research institute that was the source of the Pure Water formula and later exploded
introduced.quote: It's said to be the work of the Fontaine Research Institute, and is known as Pure Water.

introduced.name: Pure Water
introduced.how: A valuable potion formula believed to come from the Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.quote: It's said to be the work of the Fontaine Research Institute, and is known as Pure Water.

introduced.name: World of Intense Purity
introduced.how: A claimed other world that the Cabin says people can be led into
introduced.quote: ???: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm an apostle of the World of Intense Purity.

introduced.name: Pure Pinecone
introduced.how: Miraculous fruit found only around the cabin, watered with Pure Water, that the Cabin asks for
introduced.quote: Cabin of Intense Purity: They are precious fruit planted by a potioneer, and can only be found around this cabin.

introduced.name: Hydro
introduced.how: An elemental power that controls water, which the people of the world call the power of Hydro
introduced.quote: Cabin of Intense Purity: It is a power that springs from purity, and it can control the purest source of water in the world.

introduced.name: Water Volume Detection Crystal
introduced.how: A simple Hydro-powered mechanism that the player activates in the cabin's test
introduced.quote: (Talk to the cabin after activating the Water Volume Detection Crystal)

introduced.name: Fortress of Meropide
introduced.how: A market where Pure Water and inferior copies are sold for Mora
introduced.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": I hear the inferior version of it sells really well in the Fortress of Meropide... so I'm sure the original will definitely sell for even more Mora.

introduced.name: Potioneer's pond legend
introduced.how: The legend of a potioneer who poured his potions into the ground, formed a pond, drowned in it, and a flower grew there
introduced.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": As more and more potions were poured there, they gradually formed a small pond.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: Whoa! Really? That does sound pretty nice! How much Mora is it worth?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Blanche: I—If... If you get in trouble like my brother, I'll find someone to rescue you... I know how to post commissions at the Adventurers' Guild...

assumed.name: Hydro Archon
assumed.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": But there was a turn of events later on, and some say that it was the work of the Hydro Archon, who couldn't bear to see those legendary potions just vanish.

assumed.name: Bluecrown Finch
assumed.quote: ???: Oh, who's this? What a pure little princess! Ah, even the Bluecrown Finch would dance for you.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": Go to the Akademiya in Sumeru, or Liyue, or even Mondstadt. Someone will appreciate it enough to take you in.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": Go to the Akademiya in Sumeru, or Liyue, or even Mondstadt. Someone will appreciate it enough to take you in.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": Go to the Akademiya in Sumeru, or Liyue, or even Mondstadt. Someone will appreciate it enough to take you in.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": Go to the Akademiya in Sumeru, or Liyue, or even Mondstadt. Someone will appreciate it enough to take you in.

threads.claim: A player is asked whether another world really exists, raising the question of whether the World of Intense Purity is real.
threads.quote: Blanche: D—Does another world really exist?

threads.claim: Zaytun Peach believes other worlds exist and ties the idea to the New Tide, though she has never been there.
threads.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": I haven't, but so what? I think it exists. Got a problem with that?

threads.claim: The cabin and crucible are revealed to be one trickster, Bulle Fruit, so the other world was a con.
threads.quote: ???: Hehe! I'm the Crucible and the Cabin both. It's always been me! I've been hiding here, hoodwinking folk.

threads.claim: The New Tide is presented as a doctrine that the world is decaying and new worlds are being born.
threads.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": The Ley Lines have contaminated everyone, and so the New Tide shall be born; the darkness has contaminated everyone, and so a world of light shall be born. That's how things are.

threads.claim: Zaytun Peach admits she has never actually seen the New Tide, which undercuts its authority.
threads.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": What New Tide? I've never even seen the New Tide! Stop being a kid! Forget it! Let's think about it after we get back.

threads.claim: Ley Lines are an insulting label that the New Tide says is outdated and must be abandoned, though what they are is left unexplained.
threads.quote: "Trendy Zaytun Peach": Outdated! Ley Lines are outdated! Ley Lines shall be abandoned! The future belongs to the New Tide!

threads.claim: The formula's phrase 'power of water' is ambiguous and may or may not mean Hydro.
threads.quote: Blanche: Isn't the "power of water" just the power of water?

threads.claim: Bulle Fruit admits he may have misread the formula and must work out what the 'power of water' means.
threads.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": I'm embarrassed to say that there may be an error in my understanding... But what does the "power of water" represent? I must figure it out.

threads.claim: The potioneer who created Pure Water is said to have lived in seclusion at the cabin site.
threads.quote: It's said that the potioneer who created the Pure Water once lived here in seclusion to work on it.

threads.claim: Blanche confirms the small pond with a flower from the legend exists in the World of Intense Purity, tying the legend to the setting.
threads.quote: Blanche: I—I know! We passed by a small pond like that while gathering the pinecones! There was a little flower at the center of the pond...

threads.claim: Calla Lily is said to never fail, setting up a threat to Bulle Fruit.
threads.quote: Blanche: Ruthless... Calla Lily? I've heard of her before from my brother. He said that she never fails.

threads.claim: Calla Lily is defeated, breaking her reputation of never failing.
threads.quote: "Guileless Wolfhook": The Calla Lily who never fails has failed. Guess we're pretty good, huh? Brother.

threads.claim: Bulle Fruit says he has his own reasons for betraying the Order, which are left unexplained.
threads.quote: "Tricky Bulle Fruit": I have my reasons. If any of them bother you, feel free to include those when hitting me.

threads.claim: Bulle Fruit took in Blanche as a child after finding her crying on the road, which explains his devotion to her.
threads.quote: Blanche: He said he saw me crying on the side of the road when he was out scavenging one day, so he took me in. That was before I could speak and remember things.

introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.how: Guild staffer who scouts promising adventurers and welcomes the Traveler as a new member
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Welcome to the . Actually, I have had my eye on you for a long time.

introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.how: Guild that recruits adventurers without membership fees or duties and rewards rank increases
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Do not worry, the Adventurers' Guild does not charge a membership fee or impose any kind of duties on its members.

introduced.name: Adventure Rank
introduced.how: Rank that rises with experience, and the Guild rewards each increase
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Basically, the Adventurers' Guild rewards you every time your Adventure Rank increases.

introduced.name: Adventure Rank/Adventurers' Guild Rewards
introduced.how: Interface where the Traveler claims Guild rewards for rank increases
introduced.quote: Traveler: Adventure Rank Rewards

introduced.name: Ascension adventures
introduced.how: Specific adventures that let a member advance past a stuck Adventure Rank
introduced.quote: Katheryne: They are simply specific adventures that allow you to ascend to the next Adventure Rank on completion. Ascension adventures, if you will.

introduced.name: Adventurer handbook
introduced.how: Handbook listing available commissions and rewards that also proves membership
introduced.quote: Katheryne: It has a record of available commissions and rewards.

assumed.name: Legends of great adventurers
assumed.quote: Katheryne: When I look at you, I see one with the potential to rival the great adventurers of legends.

assumed.name: The Abyss
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer! With effort, you shall reach the stars and conquer the abyss!

threads.claim: The Guild's motto tells adventurers to conquer the abyss, hinting the Abyss is a major threat they must face.
threads.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer! With effort, you shall reach the stars and conquer the abyss!

threads.claim: Katheryne compares the Traveler to legendary great adventurers, hinting at past heroes whose deeds are known.
threads.quote: Katheryne: When I look at you, I see one with the potential to rival the great adventurers of legends.

threads.claim: Ascension adventures and Guild recognition are raised as a way past a stuck rank, with details deferred to later.
threads.quote: Katheryne: But that will come later. Opportunities to win recognition will come as you gain more adventure experience.

introduced.name: Cosanzeana
introduced.how: aspiring florist and Paimon's student who wants to breed new flowers and win awards
introduced.quote: I've spent some time studying it so that I can become a great florist in the future.

introduced.name: Tidalga
introduced.how: a beautiful plant that counts as a flower
introduced.quote: Tidalga are plants, and they are very beautiful, so of course they're flowers.

introduced.name: horticultural fairs
introduced.how: fairs where florists bring new flower varieties they have bred
introduced.quote: I've heard humans say that excellent florists are able to breed new types of flowers, which they then bring to

assumed.name: Breacher Primus
assumed.quote: Eh!? Why's there a Breacher Primus wrecking it!?

assumed.name: Gardemek
assumed.quote: (While fighting the Gardemek)

assumed.name: earlier flower delivery to Cosanzeana
assumed.quote: Hello, Cosanzeana. Have the flowers we brought been growing well?

threads.claim: Breacher Primuses attack Cosanzeana's garden, and the cause may not be the flowers.
threads.quote: Traveler: Perhaps it's not the flowers that are attracting them.

threads.claim: A Gardemek is buried beneath the garden gear, hinting at a hidden machine behind the attacks.
threads.quote: Paimon: What's buried over here... Whoa! Look out!

threads.claim: The immediate garden threat is defeated, though the underlying reason for the attacks is left unexplained.
threads.quote: There shouldn't be any Breacher Primuses coming around to trouble your garden again

threads.claim: Cosanzeana's senses and aesthetics may differ from those of humans, which may make her flowers seem odd.
threads.quote: her senses and aesthetics might be a bit too different from those of humans

introduced.name: Tiantian
introduced.how: Lan introduces her as the one who distributes commissions for the Guild
introduced.quote: If you're interested, go look for Tiantian. I've delegated the task of distributing commissions to her.

introduced.name: commissions
introduced.how: jobs posted for adventurers to accept, usually for payment
introduced.quote: Tiantian: A—Are you an adventurer? Are you here to accept commissions?

introduced.name: Treasure Hoarders
introduced.how: a group of monsters seen along roads that adventurers can be commissioned to defeat
introduced.quote: But other than monsters, there've been reports that say that Treasure Hoarders have been seen along the roads.

introduced.name: monsters
introduced.how: dangerous creatures roaming around Lisha that threaten passers-by and that adventurers fight
introduced.quote: Tiantian: I—Isn't that dangerous? I mean, there are a lot of them around Lisha, and they are a threat to passers-by.

assumed.name: Lan
assumed.quote: Lan: Oh, you're here. I can see you've been on quite a few adventures recently.

assumed.name: Lisha
assumed.quote: Tiantian: I—Isn't that dangerous? I mean, there are a lot of them around Lisha, and they are a threat to passers-by.

assumed.name: Millelith
assumed.quote: Tiantian: Is this really also something the Adventurers' Guild should do? It feels like it falls under the job scope of the Millelith...

assumed.name: Lan's lost sword
assumed.quote: Traveler: Have you found that sword of yours?

threads.claim: Lan has lost a sword and has no idea where it is, and expects the Traveler to be involved if it turns up.
threads.quote: Lan: ...Huh, to think you still remember that. Unfortunately, no. I still don't have the foggiest idea where it might be.

threads.claim: Lan hints that a troubling time is keeping them from taking on adventures and that the Guild needs someone to hold the fort.
threads.quote: Lan: Me? Nothing's come up that interests me so far, and at a time like this... the Adventurers' Guild needs someone to hold the fort.

threads.claim: Tiantian and others repeatedly suggest that adventurers can do almost any job, which the Traveler accepts.
threads.quote: Tiantian: Adventurers really are impressive... It seems like you can do almost anything.

threads.claim: Tiantian questions whether the Guild should take on work that may belong to the Millelith's responsibilities.
threads.quote: Tiantian: Is this really also something the Adventurers' Guild should do? It feels like it falls under the job scope of the Millelith...

threads.claim: Treasure Hoarders are reported along the roads, and the Guild is asked to deal with them.
threads.quote: But other than monsters, there've been reports that say that Treasure Hoarders have been seen along the roads.

threads.claim: The Traveler defeats the Treasure Hoarders as commissioned and returns to report it.
threads.quote: (After defeating the Treasure Hoarders and returning to Tiantian)

threads.claim: Lan has taught Tiantian a secret method for persuading adventurers to take commissions, and it appears to work.
threads.quote: Tiantian: The secret method Lan taught me to "get adventurers to take commissions gladly" really works...

introduced.name: Dragonspine
introduced.how: a snowy mountain near Mondstadt that the Guild is operating around
introduced.quote: It's about Dragonspine, that snowy mountain near Mondstadt.

introduced.name: Guild camp in Dragonspine
introduced.how: the Adventurers' Guild has set up a camp there and stationed adventurers
introduced.quote: The Guild has set up a camp and stationed a number of adventurers there.

introduced.name: Iris
introduced.how: an adventurer at the Dragonspine camp who briefs visitors on the area
introduced.quote: please look for an adventurer by the name of Iris.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Hello, Traveler. I trust your adventures are going quite smoothly?

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: As for other Guild activities, I have some adventure intel I would like to share with you, if you are interested.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: that snowy mountain near Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Map
assumed.quote: I have marked the location on your Map.
