threads.claim: Dragonspine is dangerous and unforgiving to careless adventurers, so one must be fully prepared.
threads.quote: Dragonspine is not forgiving towards careless adventures.

threads.claim: The Adventurers' Guild has established a camp with stationed adventurers in Dragonspine.
threads.quote: The Guild has set up a camp and stationed a number of adventurers there.

introduced.name: Santon
introduced.how: Fontaine hunter in Sumeru who was hired to drive away fierce animals and loves forests
introduced.quote: Santon: I'm Santon. As you can see, I'm from Fontaine, and I'm here in Sumeru for the forest, of course! I love forests!

introduced.name: Gator Raja
introduced.how: Legendary overgrown crocodile said to haunt nearby waters, possibly exaggerated
introduced.quote: Santon: That overgrown gator is pretty impressive, for instance. Known to kids as the "Gator Raja," it sounds like it came straight out of an urban legend.

introduced.name: Rishboland Raja
introduced.how: Large Rishboland tiger said to steal children and roam the western jungle
introduced.quote: Santon: And there's the Rishboland Raja that tries to steal children, and the gigantic Sumpter Beast that blocks the passage to Liyue...

introduced.name: Sumpter Beastlord
introduced.how: Gigantic Sumpter Beast that attacks passersby and is said to haunt the east
introduced.quote: Santon: As for the Sumpter Beastlord... Oh, that's the gigantic Sumpter Beast I was talking about, by the way.

introduced.name: Fontaine hunters
introduced.how: Hunters from Fontaine who are hired to keep fierce animals away from human settlements
introduced.quote: Santon: Think about it. Fierce animals coming too close to human settlements do harm to both sides, so they have to be kept away from human dwellings.

introduced.name: Poaching is a serious crime in Fontaine
introduced.how: Poaching in Fontaine is punished severely, so hunters there avoid it
introduced.quote: Santon: No, you've got it wrong. I'm no poacher! Poaching is a serious crime!

introduced.name: Najib
introduced.how: Witness who saw the giant Sumpter Beast napping by The Chasm while traveling to Liyue
introduced.quote: Najib: I was going over to Liyue two days ago when I saw it by The Chasm.

introduced.name: Anaya
introduced.how: Witness who was knocked out by a huge shadowy Sumpter Beast in the forest at night
introduced.quote: Anaya: I fainted. And I came to myself the next day. The guy who carried me back said I collapsed at the foot of the mountain.

introduced.name: Hong
introduced.how: Witness who was charged by the huge Sumpter Beast while searching for ore beyond a mountain
introduced.quote: Hong: It charged toward me the moment it saw me. Luckily, I ran fast enough to escape...

introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.how: Sumeru officials whose duty is handling fierce animals, though they handed this commission to Santon
introduced.quote: Santon: Huh? Didn't I say so before? This is a commission I accepted... from a Forest Ranger I know.

assumed.name: Nahida
assumed.quote: (Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Santon, optional)

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Santon: And there's the Rishboland Raja that tries to steal children, and the gigantic Sumpter Beast that blocks the passage to Liyue...

assumed.name: The Chasm
assumed.quote: Najib: I was going over to Liyue two days ago when I saw it by The Chasm.

assumed.name: Gator Raja past encounter
assumed.quote: Paimon: Overgrown crocodile? Could that be the one we met before, ?

assumed.name: The Withering
assumed.quote: Santon: The recent issues with The Withering have occupied a lot of manpower, though I don't know much about the details...

threads.claim: The Gator Raja may be a legend, and Santon has never seen it despite checking several times, so its reality stays uncertain.
threads.quote: Santon: They say that the Gator Raja haunts the waters on the east side of the city. But I've checked several times and have never seen the sunning beast.

threads.claim: The story that the Rishboland Raja kidnaps children may be parental invention, though Rishboland Tigers are more active at night.
threads.quote: Santon: Parents probably made up the kidnapping part to scare their kids to bed, but Rishboland Tigers are indeed more active at night.

threads.claim: Santon wonders how big the Sumpter Beastlord must be to earn its name, raising the question of its true size.
threads.quote: Santon: I wonder just how big the Sumpter Beastlord must be to have earned that moniker.

threads.claim: The Traveler's party finds the Sumpter Beastlord and sees it is far bigger than ordinary Sumpter Beasts.
threads.quote: Paimon: Wow! This one is way bigger than other Sumpter Beasts!

threads.claim: The Withering has drawn Forest Rangers' manpower away, which is why hunters like Santon took on fierce-animal jobs.
threads.quote: Santon: The recent issues with The Withering have occupied a lot of manpower, though I don't know much about the details...

threads.claim: Fierce animals and humans harm each other when they live too close, so hunters keep the two apart.
threads.quote: Santon: Think about it. Fierce animals coming too close to human settlements do harm to both sides, so they have to be kept away from human dwellings.

introduced.name: Kuuhenki
introduced.how: Kuuhenki love spinning while wrapped in cloth and are the creatures Columbina made the hat game for
introduced.quote: The kuuhenki love the feeling of spinning about while wrapped up in cloth, so I used Miss Mage's hat as a reference and made some improvements.

introduced.name: Kuuvahki
introduced.how: Kuuvahki is a way of seeing that shows things too clearly when used and nothing when not
introduced.quote: You can't see anything if you don't use kuuvahki, but if you do use it, you'll see too clearly...

introduced.name: Cup-and-gem guessing game
introduced.how: A gem is hidden under one of several cups, the cups are shuffled, and the other player guesses which cup holds it
introduced.quote: They would place a gemstone under a cup, then quickly shuffle the cups atop the table.

assumed.name: Luonnotar
assumed.quote: Greetings to you too, Luonnotar.

assumed.name: The Flagship
assumed.quote: I saw people playing with their friends using cups at The Flagship, so I borrowed the idea.

assumed.name: Miss Mage
assumed.quote: so I used Miss Mage's hat as a reference

assumed.name: Moon Goddess
assumed.quote: I'm dressing up as the Moon Goddess today. I look just like her, don't I?

assumed.name: Moon-Prayer Night
assumed.quote: Wow, you've really taken that trick from Moon-Prayer Night and ran with it...

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: In that case, please stake 100,000 Mora to start with.

assumed.name: Elemental Sight
assumed.quote: (Use Elemental Sight)

assumed.name: Elemental Energy
assumed.quote: (Choose the hat emitting Elemental Energy, the incorrect hat)

threads.claim: Columbina passes herself off as the Moon Goddess, and people only partly believe her.
threads.quote: Well... Not entirely, but they didn't talk to me afterward either.

threads.claim: Kuuvahki gives a sight that is either blind or overly clear depending on whether it is used.
threads.quote: You can't see anything if you don't use kuuvahki, but if you do use it, you'll see too clearly...

threads.claim: Luonnotar hides and communicates only through reactions, which hints at a mysterious nature.
threads.quote: Luonnotar would like you to guess where she's hiding. Would you like to play a round?

threads.claim: Columbina secretly uses sight-based tricks to win the hat game and is unrepentant about it.
threads.quote: Tsk, tsk. Only bad kids cheat, you know.

introduced.name: Petrichor Village
introduced.how: Garcia's home village, described as the safest place for him
introduced.quote: Lutong: And Petrichor is... hehe, well let's just say it's Mr. Garcia's home turf.

introduced.name: Opera Epiclese
introduced.how: opera house that recently hosted many troupes and needs its accounts settled
introduced.quote: Lutong: The Opera Epiclese recently hosted a whole host of troupes, and urgently need to settle their accounts.

introduced.name: Court of Fontaine
introduced.how: a very large city the Gardes cannot fully protect
introduced.quote: Lutong: Plus, the Court of Fontaine is far too large for the Gardes to protect us everywhere we go.

introduced.name: Gardes
introduced.how: city guards who take case reports and can be called for help
introduced.quote: Lutong: We reported this case to Garde Menthe before, so she already knows what's been going on.

introduced.name: Menthe
introduced.how: a Garde who handles reported cases and offers escorts
introduced.quote: Menthe: Hello, how may I help you?

introduced.name: Bossuet
introduced.how: a knowledgeable, perceptive man from the Fontaine Research Institute who helped the Petrichor researchers
introduced.quote: Garcia: This Mr. Bossuet fellow is quite knowledgeable and perceptive, and helped them resolve a number of issues...

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: research institute whose man went to Petrichor to help researchers
introduced.quote: Garcia: In their last letter to me, they indicated that an intelligent man from the Fontaine Research Institute had arrived in Petrichor.

introduced.name: Mécantre
introduced.how: a researcher in Petrichor whose work is succeeding, a colleague of Garcia
introduced.quote: Garcia: No, my dear Lutong, no... Mécantre and Babisse's research is now blazing brightly, blazing a trail like a wildfire through dry tinder.

introduced.name: Babisse
introduced.how: a researcher in Petrichor working alongside Mécantre, a colleague of Garcia
introduced.quote: Garcia: No, my dear Lutong, no... Mécantre and Babisse's research is now blazing brightly, blazing a trail like a wildfire through dry tinder.

introduced.name: Numbering Machine
introduced.how: a calculating machine Garcia uses for paid calculation work and that can produce music
introduced.quote: I could do it all in an afternoon even without using the Numbering Machine!

introduced.name: Daydream Club
introduced.how: a group of esteemed gentlemen who are Garcia's associates and could help solve the problem
introduced.quote: Lutong: Once we arrive, our plan is to contact the other esteemed gentlemen of the Daydream Club and find a way to solve this problem together.

introduced.name: Suspicious Man
introduced.how: a man in a hat who has been following Garcia's group and watching Garcia
introduced.quote: Lutong: I'm certain that he's the one who's been following us these past few days.

introduced.name: Petrichor residents' slumber
introduced.how: all Petrichor residents fell into a strange sleep, possibly caused by hypnotic gas leaking from the ground
introduced.quote: Lutong: According to the Gardes, all the residents of Petrichor seem to have fallen into... a strange slumber.

introduced.name: Break-in at Garcia's room
introduced.how: someone searched Garcia's room and belongings and tidied everything back up
introduced.quote: Lutong: Someone even broke into our room while we were out and searched our belongings.

assumed.name: Garcia
assumed.quote: Traveler: Garcia?

assumed.name: Lutong
assumed.quote: Lutong: Truly an unexpected meeting, . We never imagined we'd see you in Fontaine.

assumed.name: Kaia
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ms. Kaia!? What's she doing here?

assumed.name: Sumeru Numbering Machine help
assumed.quote: Lutong: Let me start from the beginning. Since you helped us with the Numbering Machine in Sumeru, its performance has come on leaps and bounds.

assumed.name: Xavier
assumed.quote: Lutong: Though Messrs. Xavier and Félix are not there, Messrs. Mécantre and Babisse should still be in the village.

assumed.name: Félix
assumed.quote: Lutong: Though Messrs. Xavier and Félix are not there, Messrs. Mécantre and Babisse should still be in the village.

threads.claim: Petrichor's residents have fallen into a strange sleep, possibly caused by hypnotic gas leaking from beneath the city.
threads.quote: Lutong: The Gardes suspect that it has something to do with some kind of natural hypnotic gas that's escaping from the ground beneath the city.

threads.claim: A strange man demanded Garcia's designs and data in exchange for funding, and Garcia refused.
threads.quote: Lutong: But there was a catch — he wanted Mr. Garcia to share all of his designs and data with him.

threads.claim: The pursuers escalate from following Garcia to searching his room while he is out, and they may resort to drastic measures.
threads.quote: Lutong: I believe they're gradually losing their patience and may... resort to drastic measures.

threads.claim: Garcia and Kaia share an unresolved past, as Garcia once left a composition unfinished when he abandoned Kaia.
threads.quote: Or are you intending to abandon me again like last time, left holding nothing but a composition with neither beginning nor end?

threads.claim: The Numbering Machine's performance can no longer be raised, but it still has practical uses that Garcia has ignored.
threads.quote: In terms of practical applications, this Numbering Machine still has many great things to accomplish!

threads.claim: A knowledgeable Fontaine Research Institute man named Bossuet has been helping the Petrichor researchers.
threads.quote: Garcia: This Mr. Bossuet fellow is quite knowledgeable and perceptive, and helped them resolve a number of issues...

introduced.name: House of the Hearth
introduced.how: Lyney's home group, described as three people who are family and have a father
introduced.quote: Those three from the House of the Hearth... I did promise I'd go visit them sometime.

introduced.name: Fagio
introduced.how: a cat girl who runs checks and is good at her work
introduced.quote: That cat girl is pretty good at what she does...

introduced.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
introduced.how: a portable tea table that can be set up near Hotel Bouffes d'ete for a tea party
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table near the entrance of Hotel Bouffes d'ete and take a seat)

introduced.name: Hotel Bouffes d'ete
introduced.how: the location where the tea party takes place
introduced.quote: (Place Sandrone's Portable Tea Table near the entrance of Hotel Bouffes d'ete and take a seat)

introduced.name: Lady Sandrone
introduced.how: the Marionette speaker is Lady Sandrone, a host of tea parties and a Harbinger with colleagues
introduced.quote: Lyney: Thank you for your hospitality, Lady Sandrone.

introduced.name: Harbinger
introduced.how: a demanding role Sandrone holds alongside colleagues, which Lynette and Freminet ask about
introduced.quote: Lynette: Mm. Is being a Harbinger really so tough?

introduced.name: Pers
introduced.how: a device or thing Sandrone is an expert on and can improve, which Freminet wants her to examine
introduced.quote: Freminet: Really? A—Actually... I've always wanted to ask you to take a look at Pers...

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Marionette: Come to think of it, I wasn't the most attentive host when you visited Snezhnaya before.

assumed.name: Sandrone's past refreshments and hospitality toward the Hearth family
assumed.quote: Lyney: There's no need for that, Lady Sandrone. Even if we never sat down for a chat, you always provided us with the best refreshments.

assumed.name: Sandrone's inventions
assumed.quote: Lynette: Mm. You never let me try out your inventions before, either.

threads.claim: Sandrone asks Lyney whether he wants to become a Harbinger, hinting that the role is a choice she thinks about for others.
threads.quote: Marionette: Do you want to be a Harbinger? Actually... Never mind. It's not my place to ask. Just pretend I said nothing.

threads.claim: Sandrone's frustrations as a Harbinger come mostly from her colleagues, and getting along with others is important in the role.
threads.quote: Marionette: When you put it like that... I suppose it is a little. There's a lot to consider. Though most of my frustrations stem from my colleagues...

threads.claim: Sandrone envies the close family the Hearth siblings share, hinting at her own isolation.
threads.quote: Marionette: Hah... Sometimes I really envy this little family you have.

threads.claim: Lyney promises never to leave Lynette and Freminet behind, a bond that may be tested later.
threads.quote: Lyney: Besides, no matter where I go, I'll never leave you two behind. I promise.

threads.claim: The Hearth siblings have a father who told them not to disturb Sandrone, a figure who is not yet shown.
threads.quote: Freminet: Actually, Father told us not to disturb you wherever possible.

threads.claim: Sandrone has inventions that Lynette has never been allowed to try, and Sandrone gives a vague reason for refusing.
threads.quote: Marionette: There were different reasons for that...

introduced.name: Jiayi
introduced.how: Liyue Harbor soldier on duty who is Little Liu's father and has been away from his daughter
introduced.quote: I told her that once this shift ended, I'd take leave to spend some time with her for a few days at Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Little Liu
introduced.how: Jiayi's young daughter who lives at Qingce Village and misses her father
introduced.quote: Little Liu, Daddy misses you so much...

introduced.name: Qingce Village
introduced.how: village where Little Liu lives, a long way from Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: She stays at Qingce Village.

introduced.name: Granny Ruoxin
introduced.how: village elder at Qingce Village who looks after Little Liu
introduced.quote: Oh, where has that child run off to...

introduced.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs
introduced.how: body that must approve soldiers' leave requests in Liyue Harbor
introduced.quote: But the Ministry of Civil Affairs would...

introduced.name: Vision
introduced.how: an item needed to become an adventurer and travel to Liyue on one's own
introduced.quote: If I had a Vision, I'd be able to do so many things, whether it be making money or something else...

introduced.name: Jiayi's Gifts
introduced.how: a large bag of toys Jiayi prepared for his daughter
introduced.quote: I'd prepared my gifts, too — a huge bag of toys...

introduced.name: Little Liu's Gifts
introduced.how: presents Little Liu made and sent to her father
introduced.quote: Well, this is from Little Liu.

assumed.name: Hilichurls
assumed.quote: She's surrounded by hilichurls! Quick, you know what to do!

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor emergency
assumed.quote: But who knew that such a huge thing would suddenly happen in Liyue Harbor.

threads.claim: A sudden huge event in Liyue Harbor recalled all soldiers and canceled all leave, with its cause left unexplained.
threads.quote: Not only was every soldier on leave recalled, but everyone at their post has also had their leave canceled.

threads.claim: Little Liu wants a Vision but has no way to obtain one, and the unit leaves how to get one open.
threads.quote: But, how do I get my hands on one...

threads.claim: Jiayi keeps putting off visits to his daughter for his job, and Granny Ruoxin questions whether this is right.
threads.quote: Is this how a father should behave?

threads.claim: Leave for Liyue Harbor soldiers depends on approval from the Ministry of Civil Affairs, which may take a long time.
threads.quote: I have no idea when this whole affair will be over, or when the Ministry will approve my leave, either...

introduced.name: Elzer
introduced.how: winery staffer who asks the Traveler to reopen the blocked merchant roads
introduced.quote: Hmm? Oh, it's you, Traveler. Master Diluc mentioned you.

introduced.name: Dawn Winery
introduced.how: a winery that ships wine out and receives ingredients by cart
introduced.quote: So, did you come to the Dawn Winery to pick some wine?

introduced.name: three merchant roads
introduced.how: the winery's three roads out are blocked by storms and cannot take cargo carts
introduced.quote: Due to the storms, the three roads leading out of the winery have all been rendered impassable.

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Master Diluc mentioned you.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: The Knights of Favonius were able to clear the obstacles blown in by the wind quickly

assumed.name: Adelinde
assumed.quote: Adelinde said something like

threads.claim: Monsters have gathered on the blocked roads during the storms for an unexplained reason.
threads.quote: the nearby monsters have all gathered on the road for some reason.

threads.claim: Diluc has vanished from the winery and no one knows where he went.
threads.quote: But he's upped and disappeared.

threads.claim: Adelinde says Diluc left for a personal matter but shows no worry and refuses to elaborate.
threads.quote: Master Diluc has gone to attend to a personal matter

introduced.name: Odolf
introduced.how: a local who lives near the old lighthouse and has recently been in Snezhnaya
introduced.quote: As a matter of fact, I live near the old lighthouse.

introduced.name: Winslow
introduced.how: the old lighthouse resident who shouts about the Abyss, locks doors, and is terrified of the alarm
introduced.quote: I heard he shut every door he could, trying to block out... whatever it was.

introduced.name: Lennart
introduced.how: a local who refuses to get involved and has been drinking
introduced.quote: I'm not risking my life down there.

introduced.name: Old Lighthouse
introduced.how: the old lighthouse, whose alarm mechanism still flickers from time to time
introduced.quote: The alarm in the old lighthouse still flickers from time to time.

introduced.name: Ancient battlefield ruins
introduced.how: the area beneath the lighthouse was once an ancient battlefield
introduced.quote: the area below used to be an ancient battlefield.

introduced.name: Ghosts of fallen knights
introduced.how: rumored spirits of knights who died in battle long ago, seen wandering the ruins
introduced.quote: Rumors that the ghosts of knights, fallen in battle long ago, are the ones still seen wandering there...

introduced.name: Alarm mechanisms
introduced.how: old-fashioned mechanisms that grow oversensitive and can go off from airflow or slight movement
introduced.quote: If an alarm mechanism has been around for a long time, it eventually becomes part of local customs and traditions.

introduced.name: Honorary Knight
introduced.how: an honorary title granted by the Knights of Favonius to outsiders who help them
introduced.quote: They are Honorary Knights of the Knights of Favonius and also top-tier

introduced.how: an order that has repeatedly searched the lighthouse ruins without finding the Abyss
introduced.quote: The Knights have already been there more times than I can count...

introduced.name: Abyss
introduced.how: a threat whose monsters the fallen knights once fought in the ruins
introduced.quote: They were heroes who gave up their lives fighting the Abyss here.

introduced.name: Eroded Tombstone
introduced.how: an old, illegible grave that has nonetheless been tended recently
introduced.quote: However, you can see that the grave has been tended to quite recently...

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: even the Knights of Favonius have checked it out

assumed.name: Snezhnaya
assumed.quote: Well, I've been in Snezhnaya lately.

assumed.name: Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Just like the windmills in Mondstadt.

assumed.name: Abyss

assumed.quote: Turns out it's the Eye of the Storm!

assumed.quote: Use the Anemograna to fly over the gate

assumed.quote: Break the Rock Pile

assumed.quote: Wait... If that's the case, then the thing we ran into outside the old lighthouse earlier...

assumed.name: Hydro Slimes
assumed.quote: It's just Slimes.

threads.claim: Winslow claims the Abyss is attacking the lighthouse, but the Knights find no trace of it.
threads.quote: only to find there wasn't a single trace of the Abyss

threads.claim: The Abyss is absent from the cave, leaving the group uncertain what the danger really is.
threads.quote: No Abyss monsters, no ghosts either.

threads.claim: Rumors say the ghosts of long-dead knights still wander the ruins beneath the lighthouse.
threads.quote: Rumors that the ghosts of knights, fallen in battle long ago, are the ones still seen wandering there...

threads.claim: Winslow tends the heroes' graves, hinting the ghosts may be the fallen knights and can be appeased.
threads.quote: I cleared the weeds around the heroes' graves

threads.claim: Odolf attributes the wind and alarm to the fallen knights' cries, which the group settles through negotiation.
threads.quote: The wind... It must be the cries of fallen knights who refuse to leave this place.

threads.claim: Strange wind is blowing out of the underground ruins, and its source is unexplained.
threads.quote: The real issue is the wind that shouldn't be blowing out from the underground ruins...

threads.claim: There is bad blood between Odolf and Winslow whose cause is not yet explained.
threads.quote: Wasn't there some bad blood between him and Winslow?

threads.claim: Winslow accuses the locals of pushing him away and resenting him, deepening the feud.

threads.claim: Odolf is unusually eager to send the group into the ruins, raising doubts about his motives.

threads.claim: Winslow suspects Odolf may be acting on purpose, leaving his true intentions in doubt.
threads.quote: Who knows if you're doing this on purpose...

threads.claim: The Traveler suggests loneliness is the most frightening thing, a theme of isolation in the ruins.

introduced.name: Fastvica
introduced.how: a young fae who refuses to yield the bridge and introduces herself by name
introduced.quote: Fastvica: Just call me Fastvica.

introduced.name: Novokitezhgrad
introduced.how: a fae city where whoever steps onto a bridge first crosses first and sound reasoning carries weight
introduced.quote: Fastvica: Whoever steps onto the bridge first, crosses first. And whoever makes the most sense, their words carry weight. That's how things work in Novokitezhgrad now.

introduced.name: Passing Jack Frost
introduced.how: a wandering Jack Frost that appears mid-argument and becomes the referee and a rock-paper-scissors contestant
introduced.quote: Traveler: Wait, where did this Jack Frost come from...?

introduced.name: King of Rock-Paper-Scissors
introduced.how: an honorary title of Novokitezhgrad awarded to the champion of the rock-paper-scissors contest
introduced.quote: Fastvica: Therefore, we all agreed to bestow the title "King of Rock-Paper-Scissors" of Novokitezhgrad upon the little Jack Frost.

assumed.name: Fae
assumed.quote: Asmud: Is this not a matter of preserving the sacred etiquette of our kind? If we forsake the virtues of old, what separates us from the short-lived humans?

threads.claim: Younger fae in Novokitezhgrad are challenging the old deference to elders and the traditional customs of the city.
threads.quote: Fastvica: Old-timer, I respect your age. But I'm afraid times have changed.

threads.claim: The origin of the wandering Passing Jack Frost is left unexplained.
threads.quote: Traveler: Wait, where did this Jack Frost come from...?

threads.claim: The Jack Frost learns to communicate with signs and to play rock-paper-scissors fairly.
threads.quote: Fastvica: You won't believe it. It actually figured out a fair way to play rock-paper-scissors...

threads.claim: The Jack Frost regards the Traveler highly for having helped it win back its honor.
threads.quote: Asmud: It thought of young . It was you who helped it win back its honor here yesterday. Such a noble and loyal little fae!

threads.claim: The King of Rock-Paper-Scissors title is kept from the Jack Frost until it is defeated by the Traveler.
threads.quote: Fastvica: If you come out on top again, the title of "King of Rock-Paper-Scissors" of Novokitezhgrad will go to you. The little Jack Frost is already on board with this.

threads.claim: The Traveler wins the King of Rock-Paper-Scissors title by beating the Jack Frost on Day 2.
threads.quote: Paimon: In that case, is the new "King of Rock-Paper-Scissors" of Novokitezhgrad, hehe!

introduced.name: Timaeus
introduced.how: researcher of alchemy who greets the Traveler in Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Timaeus: Greetings! I am Timaeus, researcher of alchemy. Welcome to Mondstadt!

introduced.name: Alchemy
introduced.how: a craft passed down from ancient times, barely understood today, with magical mechanisms

introduced.name: Wind glider
introduced.how: a glider one can use without understanding how it was built
introduced.quote: Timaeus: Much as one who uses a wind glider needs not understand how it was built in order to glide.

introduced.name: Alchemy crafting menu

introduced.quote: Traveler: Craft

introduced.quote: Timaeus: And as your Adventure Rank increases, more recipes will become available to you.

assumed.quote: Timaeus: Greetings! I am Timaeus, researcher of alchemy. Welcome to Mondstadt!

assumed.name: Adventure Rank
assumed.quote: Timaeus: And as your Adventure Rank increases, more recipes will become available to you.

threads.claim: Alchemy's mechanisms are magical and mysterious and keep producing unexpected results that even its researchers cannot explain.
threads.quote: Timaeus: The difference with alchemy is that every time I think I finally understand how it's supposed to work, something totally unexpected happens...

threads.claim: Timaeus admits he does not know what other uses alchemy has, leaving its full scope an open question.
threads.quote: Timaeus: To be honest with you, I just don't know.

threads.claim: Alchemists' notes from ancient civilizations exist and can be found during the Traveler's adventures.
threads.quote: Timaeus: Over the course of your adventures, you should come across some alchemists' notes from ancient civilizations.

introduced.name: Nadia
introduced.how: A former Melusine-linked adventurer with memory loss, who asks strangers to leave her and Urville alone
introduced.quote: Nadia: Hello, strangers. Urville is preoccupied with very important work, which is confidential, by the way.

introduced.name: Urville
introduced.how: A tough, self-interested man who wants to join the Fontaine Fleet and get rich for Nadia's treatment
introduced.quote: Urville: Because they are envious of my physical constitution.

introduced.name: Fontaine Fleet
introduced.how: A sailing force that Urville must train to join, with a steady income
introduced.quote: Nadia: That's not the case. Training is tough. Urville has to complete all the training courses in order to join the Fontaine Fleet.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: A group where Nadia used to be an elite member before her injury
introduced.quote: She used to be an elite at the Marechaussee Phantom, you know?

introduced.name: Nadia's memory loss
introduced.how: Nadia has cranial damage from an injury and keeps forgetting things
introduced.quote: Urville: Sorry, she suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since.

introduced.name: Melusine
introduced.how: A people who can recognize their own tokens and who are kind to humans
introduced.quote: Nadia: You can if you're a Melusine. I'm not quite sure why, so I'm afraid I can't teach you how, sorry.

introduced.name: Ball Octopuses
introduced.how: Tough, shell-dwelling creatures that act tough, intimidate rivals, and collect shiny treasures
introduced.quote: Nadia: Well... Because they all tend to act tough to try to intimidate their opponents. And, that they all like to collect shiny treasures.

introduced.name: Precious Chest
introduced.how: A chest that looks like private property and should not be touched
introduced.quote: Precious Chest: (Looks no different from any other treasure chest.)

introduced.name: Researcher
introduced.how: An unnamed scholar who studied many things, left legacies and collector's items, and had much knowledge and Mora
introduced.quote: Nadia: It's a collector's item from a researcher who studied many things. Unlike Urville, he has vast knowledge and a lot of Mora.

introduced.name: Underwater shelter
introduced.how: A shelter left by the researcher, where Nadia remembers a rumor of hidden treasure
introduced.quote: Nadia: But that was from a long time ago. He left many legacies, like the underwater shelter.

introduced.name: Urville's childhood rescue by a Melusine
introduced.how: Urville nearly drowned as a child among Ball Octopuses and was saved by a kind Melusine who took him to a luxurious room
introduced.quote: Urville: It was fortunate that a kind-hearted Melusine saved me and took me to a luxurious room... much like the one we're standing in.

introduced.name: Strange Message
introduced.how: A childlike, badly written note found under sheet music on the lectern, which seems to hold clues
introduced.quote: Strange Message

assumed.name: Sealed Ruined Tower
assumed.quote: They can be found at the northern side of the Sealed Ruined Tower.

assumed.name: A Fontainian Message
assumed.quote: (If A Fontainian Message has been completed)

assumed.name: Virgil
assumed.quote: Paimon: If you heard it from someone called Virgil, then, you've been lied to. There's no treasure. It's just a scam.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Paimon: So many Ball Octopuses! And Mora, too! Can we keep them? Can we?

assumed.name: Pitot
assumed.quote: Even the diving set I rented from Pitot has sunk into the water...

assumed.name: The Rusty Rudder
assumed.quote: Urville: Right. Nadia, head back to shore with them and rest a bit at The Rusty Rudder.

assumed.name: Merusea Village
assumed.quote: Urville: Strange. This conch resembles the one from your hometown, isn't it?

threads.claim: Nadia's forgetfulness from cranial damage raises questions about what she once was and what she has lost.
threads.quote: Urville: Sorry, she suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since.

threads.claim: Only Melusines can tell a Melusine token apart from ordinary components, and the reason is unknown.
threads.quote: Nadia: You can if you're a Melusine. I'm not quite sure why, so I'm afraid I can't teach you how, sorry.

threads.claim: Urville stresses that a Melusine's token is far more important than his own possessions.
threads.quote: A Melusine's token is really important! Much more so than the coin pouch or diving set...

threads.claim: A rumor says treasure is hidden in the researcher's underwater shelter, but its source is forgotten.
threads.quote: Nadia: But that was from a long time ago. He left many legacies, like the underwater shelter. I remember someone saying that there was treasure hidden there.

threads.claim: The shelter's treasure turns out to be a child's note, not valuable treasure.
threads.quote: Urville: I found the treasure.

threads.claim: A childlike note hidden in the shelter hints at a clue that seems oddly familiar to Paimon.
threads.quote: Paimon: What is this? The handwriting is barely legible... almost like a child wrote it...

threads.claim: The note turns out to be Urville's own childhood writing about being helped by a Melusine.
threads.quote: Today's experience is a treasure to me. The Melusine is so nice to me. When I grow up, I want to be someone who helps others, too.

threads.claim: Urville was rescued as a child by a kind Melusine, a debt that shapes his bond with the Melusines.
threads.quote: Urville: It was fortunate that a kind-hearted Melusine saved me and took me to a luxurious room... much like the one we're standing in.

threads.claim: Urville cannot tell which Melusine saved him, leaving the rescuer unidentified.
threads.quote: Urville: All Melusines look kinda the same... How could I tell?

threads.claim: A treasure supposedly left behind by the Liliacruces Forum draws treasure hunters, possibly as a scam.
threads.quote: ???: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

threads.claim: Someone named Virgil spread claims of treasure that Paimon calls a scam.
threads.quote: Paimon: If you heard it from someone called Virgil, then, you've been lied to. There's no treasure. It's just a scam.

threads.claim: Urville doubts that anyone helps without hidden motives, a theme of trust set against the Traveler's altruism.
threads.quote: Urville: That's too good to be true. I don't believe in kindness without agendas.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a card reader running a booth that sells card backs and reads fortunes with Lunar Arcana
introduced.quote: (Approach Barbeloth's booth)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: a card deck Barbeloth uses for fortune reading, set up at a table with a scryglass
introduced.quote: (Cyno sits at the table where Barbeloth's scryglass and the Lunar Arcana deck is)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum XIV: Temperance
introduced.how: a Lunar Arcana card whose reversed meaning is Artistry, given to Cyno as a guide
introduced.quote: Since it's reversed Temperance, or rather, reversed "Artistry," I suggest you maintain a state of doing nothing for the time being.

introduced.name: Matra
introduced.how: General Mahamatra is one of several matras who share the Akademiya's pressure
introduced.quote: There are other matras. We share the pressure among us.

introduced.name: The Akademiya
introduced.how: a Sumeru institution with researchers where Cyno holds the General Mahamatra post
introduced.quote: There were no pressing matters at the Akademiya, so I came over.

assumed.name: Sethos
assumed.quote: Sethos helped out, too, so I promised to bring him a cardholder for his trouble.

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Sethos and Tighnari told me the same thing — I've already adjusted my schedule.

assumed.name: Alice
assumed.quote: Alice mentioned him a few times.

assumed.name: Sumeru
assumed.quote: Not just the matras, but the researchers and the people of Sumeru...

assumed.name: Genius Invokation TCG
assumed.quote: Surely Genius Invokation TCG isn't the only thing that demands the General Mahamatra's full attention?

assumed.name: Duel Master
assumed.quote: Is this like that line in "Duel Master"...

threads.claim: Barbeloth's card is said to predict Cyno's future, but Barbeloth says that is not quite accurate.
threads.quote: Technically, not quite. But it's unlikely to cause much trouble if you choose to understand it that way.

threads.claim: Barbeloth says Cyno has an inner battle and imbalance that the Lunar Arcanum may help resolve.
threads.quote: Take this Lunar Arcanum. Perhaps it will lead you to the reason that restores your balance.

threads.claim: Cyno's imbalance is linked to carrying the burdens of others, including the shadow that walks beside him.
threads.quote: You're used to leading the way, carrying the burdens of others... I think, perhaps, this is the reason for your imbalance.

threads.claim: Barbeloth suggests that for Cyno, even death would not end his duty while his inner battle continues.
threads.quote: For someone such as yourself, if the inner battle is endless, then even death won't mark the end of duty.

introduced.name: Yae Miko
introduced.how: Editor-in-Chief of Yae Publishing House, an old friend of the Traveler and Paimon, who lives at the Grand Narukami Shrine
introduced.quote: Why else would a poor, overworked Editor-in-Chief like me be here?

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: A fortune-teller in a Dodoco form who reads Lunar Arcanum cards and practices hydromancy
introduced.quote: The card is named Justice, but it doesn't represent a just or unjust person — at least not in a conventional sense.

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: Miko's publishing business, which she runs and which wants the Traveler to write a novel
introduced.quote: I'm toiling away on Yae Publishing House business, of course.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum
introduced.how: A card-based divination item used for readings, shown to the group by Miko
introduced.quote: (Before Paimon can finish her sentence, Miko holds up her Lunar Arcanum for them to see)

introduced.name: Youkai
introduced.how: A youkai's birth is tied to unfulfilled desire
introduced.quote: After all, the birth of a youkai is indelibly tied to desire.

introduced.name: Reversed Justice
introduced.how: A reversed Justice card symbolizes distorted cause and effect, imbalance, dishonesty, and dissatisfaction, and it can conceal lies
introduced.quote: Reversed Justice does indeed symbolize a distorted sort of cause and effect, imbalance, dishonesty... and dissatisfaction.

assumed.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
assumed.quote: You remember the Mikawa Flower Festival, right?

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: To think we'd run into each other all the way out here in Fontaine.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: Should you ever have the chance, do pay a visit to the Grand Narukami Shrine and allow me to return the favor. What do you say?

assumed.name: Fortune slips
assumed.quote: Back home, she rarely visits the shrine to draw fortune slips, so her sudden interest in fortune-telling was quite the surprise...

assumed.name: Nicole and Alice
assumed.quote: Though your fortune slips sound like something Nicole and Alice would enjoy.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: And you, a great youkai of Inazuma, likely have a greater desire than most buried within your heart...

threads.claim: Barbeloth hints that Yae Miko has a greater desire buried within her heart that the reading cannot fully reveal.
threads.quote: And you, a great youkai of Inazuma, likely have a greater desire than most buried within your heart...

threads.claim: Reversed Justice is said to be good at concealing lies from others or oneself, hinting that someone may be hiding a truth.
threads.quote: What's more, reversed Justice is known to be good at concealing lies, whether from others or oneself.

threads.claim: Barbeloth explains that youkai are born from unsatisfied desires that take root and grow from small catalysts.
threads.quote: All it takes is the slightest catalyst for these unsatisfied desires to take root and grow, and sprout unexpected offshoots.

introduced.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
introduced.how: Psychologist-type figure making an educational psychology film and stuck on its script
introduced.quote: Hmm... I suppose you could say that. If the prep work for this educational film about psychology I'm doing goes smoothly, I should indeed have time for some leisure.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: Card fortune-teller running a booth who reads the Lunar Arcana for visitors
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: Since you're looking for inspiration, go ahead and draw a card, Miss Youkai.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: A divination card deck where each card is paired with a fairy tale by a mage
introduced.quote: Anya once said that she wanted to write a fairy tale for every card in the Lunar Arcana.

introduced.name: Anya
introduced.how: A mage who planned a fairy tale for each Lunar Arcana card but ran out of time
introduced.quote: But there were so many stories she wanted to write, and so little time... Heh...

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum XVIII: The Moon
introduced.how: The Moon card's reversed meaning: escapism, illusion, self-deception, being lost on a dark path
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: The upright and reversed meanings of the Moon are similar

introduced.name: Guuji Yae
introduced.how: Someone Mizuki considered asking for script feedback, and who is swept along by fate
introduced.quote: I thought about visiting Yae Publishing House and asking Guuji Yae for advice, but then...

introduced.name: Educational psychology film series
introduced.how: Mizuki's plan for short films about mental disorders to teach basic psychology
introduced.quote: So I thought, why not make a few films about mental disorders as a fun and educational way to explain basic psychological concepts.

introduced.name: Immutable fate
introduced.how: Fate cannot be changed or reversed and can only be accepted, per a quoted saying
introduced.quote: ...Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted.

assumed.name: Aisa Bathhouse
assumed.quote: Back when I was promoting Aisa Bathhouse, I took inspiration from Fontainian cinema and recorded a few variety show episodes.

assumed.name: Grand Narukami Shrine
assumed.quote: But... most of what I know about divination relates to... the Grand Narukami Shrine.

assumed.name: Fortune slips
assumed.quote: That's why I came here, to experience a form of divination quite unlike the fortune slips I'm used to.

assumed.name: Little brat (unnamed sayer of the fate saying)
assumed.quote: Sometimes, it's just like that little brat said...

threads.claim: The reversed Moon warns that Mizuki is lost and deceiving herself, though the situation is not yet too dire.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Like someone traveling beneath a dark moon, having lost their way forward but not knowing how to break free.

threads.claim: Anya's planned fairy tales for the Lunar Arcana were left unfinished due to lack of time.
threads.quote: But there were so many stories she wanted to write, and so little time... Heh...

threads.claim: The screen glitches while the camera shows nearby stacks of books, hinting at something unseen.
threads.quote: (The screen briefly glitches while the camera shows the nearby stacks of books)

threads.claim: Barbeloth suggests the Traveler untangled fate's threads, placing Mizuki's path in her own hands.
threads.quote: You untangled the threads of fate yourself. I merely placed the loose ends in your hands.

threads.claim: Fate is presented as unchangeable and something that can only be accepted.
threads.quote: ...Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted.

threads.claim: Guuji Yae is entangled in fate, and intertwining threads may bring trouble to those who approach her.
threads.quote: However, Guuji Yae is also someone swept along by fate.

threads.claim: Mizuki wants to counter the public dismissing mental disorders as nonsense or treating them as monsters.
threads.quote: Perhaps I can stop people from blindly dismissing these conditions as made-up nonsense, or treating them like some terrifying bogeyman.

introduced.name: Qiqi
introduced.how: a young girl who has lost most of her memory and can recall little beyond her own name
introduced.quote: Blathine: I take it you know about her memory issues? She can hardly seem to remember anything besides her own name.

introduced.name: Blathine
introduced.how: a Melusine investigating near Lumidouce Harbor who found Qiqi and is escorting her home
introduced.quote: Blathine: You know Qiqi? Fantastic news! I ran into her while investigating near Lumidouce Harbor...

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a fortune teller with a booth who listens in on conversations and reads fortunes with cards
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: No need to shout. I've been here all along. I simply didn't want to interrupt your conversation. Listening is the default state of any good fortune teller.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: a self-proclaimed great witch, mother of Klee, who speaks through Barbeloth's Dodoco doll
introduced.quote: Alice: Ahem... Little Qiqi, member of the Little Hexenzirkel, I'm the mother of your ally Klee — Auntie Alice, the greatest witch in the world.

introduced.name: Dodoco
introduced.how: a doll that Barbeloth and Alice take turns speaking through, switching voices
introduced.quote: (Barbeloth's Dodoco, now being used by both Barbeloth and Alice to communicate through, alternates voices between the two)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum card
introduced.how: a fortune card that is drawn for a reading and can be kept as a keepsake
introduced.quote: (A single Lunar Arcanum card magically slides out and flips over)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum XII: The Hanged Man
introduced.how: a rarely drawn card that stands for transcendence, waiting, and detachment from the everyday world
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: It symbolizes transcendence and waiting, and also detachment from the everyday world.

introduced.name: Seelie
introduced.how: a creature whose guidance leads people to places, and which Qiqi followed to Lumidouce Harbor
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: This Seelie's so-called guidance could also be considered the guidance of fate.

introduced.name: Lumidouce Harbor
introduced.how: a harbor where Qiqi ended up after following a Seelie and where Blathine found her
introduced.quote: Blathine: You know Qiqi? Fantastic news! I ran into her while investigating near Lumidouce Harbor...

introduced.name: Yilong Wharf
introduced.how: where Baizhu visits patients and where Qiqi went to gather herbs before getting lost
introduced.quote: Paimon: Baizhu took Qiqi to visit patients at Yilong Wharf. She got lost while gathering herbs, saw a Seelie, and followed it all the way to Lumidouce Harbor!

introduced.name: Palais Mermonia
introduced.how: a distant destination Blathine is walking Qiqi toward
introduced.quote: Blathine: There's no need to apologize. We still have a long way before we get to the Palais Mermonia.

introduced.name: Marechaussee Phantom
introduced.how: a place where Qiqi could be taken to stay for a while
introduced.quote: Blathine: Poor child. I was going to take her back to the Marechaussee Phantom and let her stay there for a while

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: a group of witches that meets, with young witches attending and receiving prophecies
introduced.quote: Alice: If Auntie Barbie has more to say, then next time the Hexenzirkel meets, she can make a prophecy for every little witch who attends!

introduced.name: Robben versus Chesterton
introduced.how: a detective book Paimon has read, which the Traveler says is a work of fiction
introduced.quote: Traveler: You do know that book's a work of fiction, right?

assumed.name: Baizhu
assumed.quote: Baizhu: I think that's everyone I needed to see, but where's Qiqi? She can't still be gathering herbs, can she?

assumed.name: Changsheng
assumed.quote: Changsheng: Perhaps you should prescribe yourself some medicine to stop you overthinking... There's still plenty of time left until her orders say to be back.

assumed.name: Melusine
assumed.quote: Paimon: Look, it's Qiqi! And she's with a Melusine. That's a combo Paimon wasn't expecting to see!

assumed.name: Zombie
assumed.quote: Paimon: Hehe! Quick thinking! If Qiqi had said she was a zombie, it might've scared her half to death!

assumed.name: Barbeloth's prophecy
assumed.quote: Traveler: Wait... Those people in Barbeloth's prophecy...

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Alice: Ahem... Little Qiqi, member of the Little Hexenzirkel, I'm the mother of your ally Klee — Auntie Alice, the greatest witch in the world.

assumed.name: Qiqi's orders
assumed.quote: Changsheng: Perhaps you should prescribe yourself some medicine to stop you overthinking... There's still plenty of time left until her orders say to be back.

threads.claim: Qiqi has lost her memory and cannot recall much beyond her own name.
threads.quote: Blathine: I take it you know about her memory issues? She can hardly seem to remember anything besides her own name.

threads.claim: Qiqi recalls fragments of going on Baizhu's rounds and gathering herbs, but her memory stays incomplete.
threads.quote: Qiqi: Before... that... Dr. Baizhu took me on his rounds at Yi... Uhm, Yi-something-something... I went to gather herbs, and then...

threads.claim: Barbeloth's prophecy concerns a group of people, and the Traveler suspects Qiqi is among them.
threads.quote: Traveler: Wasn't Qiqi one of them?

threads.claim: Barbeloth's reading of Qiqi's future is cut short by a strange, unexplained reaction.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: As for your future, all you need to do is wait.

threads.claim: Qiqi is bound by orders, and Barbeloth hints she does not wish to escape them.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: There are shackles that bind you, but you yourself have no desire to break free from them.

threads.claim: A Seelie's guidance may be tied to fate, and Qiqi followed one far from home.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: This Seelie's so-called guidance could also be considered the guidance of fate.

threads.claim: Qiqi's home is far away, and her companions are unsure how to get her there.
threads.quote: Paimon: We know... But it's, uhm, a very long way from here...

threads.claim: The Dodoco doll appears to carry two voices, and its nature remains unexplained.
threads.quote: Blathine: Phew... Is that all over now? Did those two voices just come from this doll? What kind of toy is this?

threads.claim: The Hexenzirkel meets regularly, and its members receive prophecies.
threads.quote: Alice: If Auntie Barbie has more to say, then next time the Hexenzirkel meets, she can make a prophecy for every little witch who attends!

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a fortune teller who claims to read fate and offers card readings
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: Alright, enough talk. That should be enough to convince you I'm a legitimate fortune teller, yes?

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: a deck of cards used for divination, drawn from at random
introduced.quote: (Diona walks over to the table and stares thoughtfully at the Lunar Arcana deck)

introduced.name: Heinry
introduced.how: a researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute who makes Fonta and sent Diona to Barbeloth
introduced.quote: Diona: And it's all thanks to that guy from the Fontaine Research Institute who makes Fonta. He's been a real help!

introduced.name: Fontaine Research Institute
introduced.how: a research institution in Fontaine that makes Fonta and cannot analyze Diona's affliction
introduced.quote: Diona: Well... I heard that really tasty fizzy drink stuff comes from the Fontaine Research Institute, so I headed over to take a look.

introduced.name: Fonta
introduced.how: a sweet, tangy fizzy drink with multiple flavors
introduced.quote: Diona: When I got there, Mr. Heinry let me try a few bottles of the new Fonta flavors. Completely on the house, haha!

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum II: The High Priestess
introduced.how: a Lunar Arcanum card; Diona draws it reversed, read as being stuck before a veil
introduced.quote: Barbeloth: If we judge solely by your affliction, that would indeed be the case. Furthermore, the card you drew is the reversed High Priestess.

assumed.name: Diona's affliction
assumed.quote: Diona: ...So you can't help me fix this annoying affliction either?

assumed.name: Commission
assumed.quote: Traveler: How else could I handle so many commissions?

assumed.name: Mona
assumed.quote: Barbeloth: By the way, if you have any more questions about your card, look for someone named Mona. You probably already know who I'm talking about?

assumed.name: Mondstadt drunkards
assumed.quote: Diona: The answer is to teach those old boozehounds a lesson, so they never get drunk and cause trouble again.

assumed.name: Diona's feelings for one person
assumed.quote: Barbeloth: Haha, I see. Then... have you talked to the one who fills your heart the most?

threads.claim: Diona's affliction has grown from a shoot into a sturdy branch, and the Research Institute could not analyze it.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: It's no longer a shoot, but a sturdy branch. How curious...

threads.claim: Fate is like a wheel of gears, and a tiny missing gear may drive large changes.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: By drawing a card, you may just find a tiny missing gear to fit into the wheel of fate.

threads.claim: Diona is stuck focusing on illusions before a veil she cannot pass through.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Which means you've been too focused on the illusions before the veil. Which is precisely why you've been unable to pass through it for so long.

threads.claim: The Lunar Arcana reveal fate but are not yet known for giving recipes.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Heh... The Lunar Arcana aren't known for creating recipes — at least not yet.

threads.claim: Mona is expected to be able to read the Lunar Arcana and interpret a card's meaning.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Hah, she's nowhere near my level. Still, she should be up to the task of reading the Lunar Arcana — otherwise, she might as well hang up her hat.

threads.claim: Diona's heart is tied to one person she has not yet told how she feels.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Haha, I see. Then... have you talked to the one who fills your heart the most?

threads.claim: Diona's heart has already begun to change, according to the reading.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Of course not that! I'm talking about your heart — something which has already begun to change.

threads.claim: Barbeloth claims the title of Mighty Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus, hinting at a larger identity.
threads.quote: Barbeloth: Just tell her you've brought a prophecy on behalf of the Mighty Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus — as a test.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: a fortune-teller who reads cards at a booth
introduced.quote: (Approach Barbeloth's booth)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcana
introduced.how: a card deck used for fortune readings
introduced.quote: (Beidou puts a coin pouch on the table where the Lunar Arcana deck is)

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum VIII: Strength
introduced.how: the upright Strength card symbolizes passion, courage, confidence, desire and love
introduced.quote: This card symbolizes passion, courage, confidence, and desire, as well as perfect, unfaltering love.

introduced.name: Beidou
introduced.how: captain of a sailing crew that has traveled across Teyvat
introduced.quote: I may be their captain, but there are things even I can't help them with.

introduced.name: Ningguang
introduced.how: the Tianquan who plans trade routes and schemes behind the scenes
introduced.quote: Who knows what kind of scheme she's cooked up this time?

introduced.name: Lantern and pests allegory
introduced.how: a bright lantern attracts pests that compete for its heat and may drain it
introduced.quote: To borrow a metaphor, you're a lantern in the dark night.

assumed.name: Dodoco
assumed.quote: (Barbeloth's Dodoco is now out of her booth and sitting on a handle of the armchair)

assumed.name: Hotel Debord
assumed.quote: Matter of fact, just yesterday I booked an event space at the Hotel Debord, and the lot of us drank up a storm!

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: If she were the type to get lost, I doubt anyone in Liyue would know how to stay on course.

assumed.name: Teyvat
assumed.quote: We've sailed this ship from one corner of Teyvat to the other, braving the winds and waves.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: ...What are you doing in Fontaine?

threads.claim: Barbeloth says fate is neutral and makes no distinction between bad and good.
threads.quote: Haha, fate is simply fate. It makes no distinction between bad and good.

threads.claim: Beidou's crew carries personal troubles that even their captain cannot resolve.
threads.quote: After so many years at sea, there isn't one among them who doesn't harbor troubles of their own.

threads.claim: Ningguang secretly sent scouts ahead to set up a Fontaine trade route for Beidou's crew.
threads.quote: Turns out she'd already sent people to scout ahead.

threads.claim: The bright lantern is threatened by pests that drain its fuel and someone must drive them away.
threads.quote: Bugs cling to the lantern, competing for light and heat.

threads.claim: Beidou's friend Ningguang is said to enjoy dealing with the pests hiding in the corners.
threads.quote: she enjoys taking care of pests who hide in the corners.

threads.claim: The whole trip was an elaborate ruse by Ningguang to give Beidou a holiday.
threads.quote: Hah, it all makes sense now! I was just thinking, if she really wanted to do business, there's no way she'd let me kick back and relax.

introduced.name: Barbeloth
introduced.how: Fortune-reading mage who runs a booth and takes a Dodoco form
introduced.quote: I've been here for quite some time now, and read the fortunes of a fair few people, but this is the first time anyone's come bearing gifts.

introduced.name: Wriothesley
introduced.how: Self-introduced as a Fontainian citizen off duty, referred to as Le duc sous l'eau
introduced.quote: The name's Wriothesley.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum
introduced.how: Fortune-telling cards that reveal fate when drawn
introduced.quote: Mr. Wriothesley, whether out of respect for Miss Columbina or as thanks for your confectionery, please draw a Lunar Arcanum.

introduced.name: Lunar Arcanum IV: The Emperor
introduced.how: Card that signifies eternal dominion and unshakable authority
introduced.quote: This card signifies eternal dominion and unshakable authority.

introduced.name: Conch Madeleine
introduced.how: Popular dessert served at mages' parties
introduced.quote: Oh my, this is a very popular dessert at our parties.

introduced.name: Hexenzirkel
introduced.how: Group of mages meant to bring joy to the world, with Alice's cheerful rule
introduced.quote: The Hexenzirkel is supposed to bring joy to the world.

introduced.name: Alice
introduced.how: Speaks through Barbeloth's Dodoco alongside Barbeloth; a mage and Klee's mother
introduced.quote: (Barbeloth's Dodoco, now being used by both Barbeloth and Alice to communicate through, alternates voices between the two)

introduced.name: Klee
introduced.how: Alice's daughter, a destructive but adorable child called the Veritable Spark Knight
introduced.quote: She's the Most Adorable Child of Alice, the Dodo-King, the Veritable Spark Knight, Klee!

assumed.name: Columbina
assumed.quote: A certain Miss Columbina recommended your services.

assumed.name: Fontaine
assumed.quote: I'm just a regular citizen of Fontaine enjoying some time off the clock.

assumed.name: Dodoco
assumed.quote: (Barbeloth, in her Dodoco form, steps out of her booth)

assumed.name: Nod-Krai
assumed.quote: I previously visited Nod-Krai on official business and gained quite a bit of insight.

assumed.name: Knights of Favonius
assumed.quote: 's the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, y'know!

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide
assumed.quote: Besides, I'm not going to do anything criminal in front of the Administrator of the Fortress of Meropide.

assumed.name: Fortress of Meropide explosion
assumed.quote: You blew up the Fortress of Meropide?

assumed.name: Nicole
assumed.quote: Don't let Nicole scarf the lot down before I get there — it's not like she hasn't done it before!

assumed.name: Old Mondstadt
assumed.quote: Defender of Old Mondstadt...

threads.claim: Wriothesley asks how a prophecy can ensure its own fulfillment, raising the question of how fate works.
threads.quote: How exactly does a prophecy ensure its own fulfillment?

threads.claim: Barbeloth wryly presents the staged explosion joke as the way the prophecy gets fulfilled.
threads.quote: ...And that is how the prophecy is fulfilled.

threads.claim: Wriothesley's reading says he will remain stable, but he fears a sudden impulse could change that.
threads.quote: My reading says I'll remain stable.

threads.claim: Wriothesley senses the world is changing after noticing an unusually bright moon, and Barbeloth links this to huge new variables.
threads.quote: Then, one night, as I was gazing at an unusually bright moon, I found myself thinking that the world is changing.

threads.claim: The Lunar Arcana cards may reveal a gift from fate hidden within the reading.
threads.quote: Perhaps a gift from fate lies hidden within.

threads.claim: The Traveler hints that someone has survived a great disaster and found good fortune afterward.
threads.quote: Good fortune comes to those who survive great disasters.

introduced.name: Jifang
introduced.how: bookshop keeper at Wanwen Bookhouse who takes special book orders from long-time customers
introduced.quote: Guess everyone's interested in history now, eh...

introduced.name: Wanwen Bookhouse
introduced.how: Jifang's bookstore, which has stayed open thanks to loyal long-time customers
introduced.quote: Wanwen Bookhouse has managed to stay open all this time due to the support of our long-time customers.

introduced.name: Uncle Tian
introduced.how: long-time customer who ordered a copy of Verses of Equilibrium from Jifang
introduced.quote: Uncle Tian: What can I do for you, youngster?

introduced.name: Gentry De'an
introduced.how: long-time customer who ordered the fourth volume of Rex Incognito from Jifang
introduced.quote: What is it, youngster?

introduced.name: Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti
introduced.how: an obscure history book that sold very slowly, so Jifang stopped importing such books
introduced.quote: so I stopped importing such obscure history books

assumed.name: Rex Lapis
assumed.quote: These past few days have been full of customers who specifically wanted books containing Rex Lapis' stories.

assumed.name: Recent events in Liyue
assumed.quote: But after the recent events that happened here, people from all over the city would come here to purchase history texts...

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: A lot of people have gotten interested in Liyue's history recently

threads.claim: Stories of Rex Lapis are suddenly drawing crowds to history books, hinting at his importance.
threads.quote: These past few days have been full of customers who specifically wanted books containing Rex Lapis' stories.

threads.claim: Gentry De'an's lament for Rex Lapis hints at an emotional loss tied to him.
threads.quote: Alas, Rex Lapis...

threads.claim: It is unclear whether people read history out of genuine love of reading or just to gossip.
threads.quote: Who knows if they really love reading, or if they're just looking to inject a bit of spice into their daily chatter...

threads.claim: Few people nowadays read history to learn how the past shaped the present.
threads.quote: So they say, but there are a few who read history to learn these things nowadays...

introduced.name: Yae Publishing House
introduced.how: Inazuman publisher that runs an annual novel-writing competition and invites writers to judge it
introduced.quote: Here's the problem: Yae Publishing House's annual novel-writing competition is about to begin, and as is our rule, we plan to invite a few of our writers to serve on the judging panel.

introduced.name: Aratani
introduced.how: Yae Publishing House staffer who handles contacting authors and asks the Traveler for help
introduced.quote: Ugh, how am I supposed to contact these two authors in this situation...

introduced.name: Chang the Ninth
introduced.how: writer of the First Apprentice of Guhua, a martial arts tale set in Liyue and Inazuma, who is not from Inazuma
introduced.quote: is a tale about the first apprentice of a famed martial arts school in Liyue and a young girl from Inazuma whom he took on as a junior apprentice.

introduced.name: Zhenyu
introduced.how: pen name of the author of A Legend of Sword, revealed to be Xingqiu's pen name
introduced.quote: This is embarrassing, but... that's my pen name.

introduced.name: Xingqiu
introduced.how: a well-read person in Liyue whom Paimon asks for help finding the writer; he is Zhenyu
introduced.quote: He's read a lot of books — maybe he'll know where to find our man!

introduced.name: A Legend of Sword
introduced.how: a bestselling novel in Inazuma, written under the pen name Zhenyu, that was brought to Inazuma by a merchant
introduced.quote: That one's an earth-shatterer and a world-shaker, make no mistake!

introduced.name: Wanwen Bookhouse
introduced.how: a bookhouse in Liyue where the novel was first found and where Xingqiu planted copies
introduced.quote: he first found this text at Wanwen Bookhouse.

introduced.name: outlander ban on Inazuma
introduced.how: present circumstances stop Inazuma from inviting outlanders in, so writers abroad cannot attend
introduced.quote: As you know, the present circumstances prevent us from inviting outlanders here.

introduced.name: royalties owed to Zhenyu
introduced.how: Yae Publishing House publishes the books and keeps a record of royalties owed to Zhenyu until contact is made
introduced.quote: We could only publish the books first, while keeping a record of the royalties owed to Mr. Zhenyu.

assumed.name: Xingqiu
assumed.quote: Xingqiu: Hmm? Ah, it's you, . It has been a while.

assumed.name: Chang the Ninth's pen name dispute with Yae Publishing House
assumed.quote: They're not asking me to change my pen name again, are they?

assumed.name: distance between Inazuma and Liyue
assumed.quote: As you know, the journey here is a long and tiring one over land and sea, and it will be quite the undertaking to bring both authors here.

threads.claim: Zhenyu, the unknown author of A Legend of Sword, is revealed to be Xingqiu's pen name.
threads.quote: This is embarrassing, but... that's my pen name.

threads.claim: Letters sent to the two authors seem never to get answered, possibly lost in transit.
threads.quote: Perhaps the letters were lost in the way, or...

threads.claim: Letters to Liyue writers never return as Inazuma's changing situation disrupts contact.
threads.quote: Who would've thought that with these changes in our situation, none of our letters that we sought to have people bring to Liyue ever returned.

threads.claim: How Xingqiu's book crossed the ocean to Inazuma is left unexplained.
threads.quote: how did the book that I wrote manage to make it over the ocean to Inazuma?

threads.claim: Present circumstances bar outlander writers from being invited to Inazuma.
threads.quote: As you know, the present circumstances prevent us from inviting outlanders here.

threads.claim: Inazuma's changing situation delays plans and cuts off contact with outside writers.
threads.quote: The situation here kept changing, one of our plans kept getting delayed, and none of the letters we had sent ever returned.

threads.claim: Royalties from the bestseller pile up with no way yet to pay Zhenyu.
threads.quote: The royalties are starting to pile up...

introduced.name: Yata Kouki
introduced.how: a client who challenges the Traveler's business and needs White Iron Chunks
introduced.quote: Yata Kouki: Wait, who are you? What is your business here?

introduced.name: White Iron Chunks
introduced.how: a material requested for making or sharpening blades
introduced.quote: Traveler: You wanted some White Iron Chunks?

introduced.name: Mr. Amenoma
introduced.how: a smith who makes blades for clients
introduced.quote: Yata Kouki: You can't sharpen your blade if it goes blunt in battle. So, best to have Mr. Amenoma make me a shiny new one well in advance.

introduced.name: commission
introduced.how: a request for materials that the Traveler accepts and delivers to the client
introduced.quote: Yata Kouki: Have you taken on my commission? If so, I guess you've got those 5 White Iron Chunks.

assumed.name: the Shogun
assumed.quote: Yata Kouki: Hello! Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting...

threads.claim: The Shogun is a ruler whose glory is loyally praised by the people, hinting at her authority.
threads.quote: Yata Kouki: Hello! Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting...

introduced.name: Yavanani
introduced.how: a scholar who holds that language underlies sociological and historical study and makes requests of the Traveler
introduced.quote: Language is the foundation of all forms of sociological and historical studies.

introduced.name: Five Apples request
introduced.how: Yavanani asks the Traveler to bring five Apples, and the Traveler delivers them later
introduced.quote: Have you got the five Apples?

assumed.name: Effendi
assumed.quote: Effendi reminded me to explain details about my request in a comprehensible manner...

threads.claim: Yavanani believes linguistics is central to scholarly study and is frustrated that others do not recognize this.
threads.quote: How stubborn of them to not see that...

introduced.name: Yi Zhu
introduced.how: Yi Zhu is a caretaker of a child who gives the Traveler an Almond Tofu commission
introduced.quote: Yi Zhu: Hi! Oh, you must've seen my commission. Have you prepared an Almond Tofu for me?

introduced.name: Yi Xian
introduced.how: Yi Xian is a young child in Yi Zhu's care who is grieving a missing mother
introduced.quote: Yi Xian: I'm not going home! I'm going to look for Mommy!

introduced.name: Almond Tofu
introduced.how: a dish Yi Zhu commissions, meant to keep Yi Xian happy
introduced.quote: Yi Zhu: I hope this Almond Tofu will keep Yi Xian happy...

introduced.name: Mommy's death as a star
introduced.how: Yi Xian's mother is said to have become one of the stars in the sky
introduced.quote: Yi Zhu: Yi Xian, what happened was... Mommy is one of the stars in the sky now.

introduced.name: Lady in black clothes
introduced.how: a mysterious woman in black clothes was seen bringing Yi Xian's mother somewhere
introduced.quote: Yi Xian: But, but... I know I saw the lady with black clothes bring Mommy here... *sobs*

assumed.name: Commission
assumed.quote: Yi Zhu: Hi! Oh, you must've seen my commission. Have you prepared an Almond Tofu for me?

threads.claim: A lady in black clothes took Yi Xian's mother away, leaving her whereabouts and role unexplained.
threads.quote: Yi Xian: But, but... I know I saw the lady with black clothes bring Mommy here... *sobs*

threads.claim: Yi Zhu tells Yi Xian that her mother became a star, a claim the text presents without proof.
threads.quote: Yi Zhu: Yi Xian, what happened was... Mommy is one of the stars in the sky now.

threads.claim: Yi Zhu suggests the starlight at night lets Yi Xian feel her mother watching over her.
threads.quote: When you see the starlight, you will feel Mommy's loving eyes looking down...
